short_description: Demons already know about your presence, arm yourself with magic and embark on a dangerous journey!

name: BLUE REVOLVER
short_description: BLUE REVOLVER is a fresh new shoot-em-up built for newcomers and psychos alike. An adaptive difficulty system tailors the game to your skill level as you fight and flourish to evade the maniac environmental force, 'Blue Revolver'!

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails in the Sky SC
short_description: Picking up shortly after The Legend of Heroes: Trails in the Sky, Estelle travels across Liberl in search of Joshua. The journey involves more than seeking loved ones, however, as the Bracer Guild also tasks her with unraveling the mysteries behind the newly unveiled Society of Ouroboros.

name: Ghostlight Manor
short_description: Ghostlight Manor is a strategic puzzler with 60 hauntingly challenging levels. Encounter a cast of beloved classic monsters while locating the source of the monster invasion before it’s too late! In multiplayer test your skills against our brand new A.I.

name: Vaporwave World
short_description: 'Vaporwave World' is a simple and casual buiding game that has three art packs (Egypt, Roman, 1980s). You can customize the lights in the game, and you will automatically get various types of buiding items over time.

name: Spirit of Adventure
short_description: 'Spirit of Adventure' is a classical 2.5D dungeon crawl RPG game in which you'll take charge of a group of adventurers searching for the next callenge.

name: Knights College
short_description: KnightsCollege is a kemono visual novel set in the Knight College, where elite knight candidates live. In this game, every choice is presented as a card, and the protagonist lives in the dormitory while collecting cards.

name: Darksiders II Deathinitive Edition
short_description: The ultimate DARKSIDERS II experience! 1080p native resolution. Reworked and tuned game balancing and loot distribution. Improved Graphic Render Engine for even higher visual quality, lighting and shadows. Improved and reworked level, character and environment graphics.

name: PARANOIHELL
short_description: It's a long walk home...

name: Squatch
short_description: Squatch is a puzzle game in which you attempt to connect all squares in a scene by color matching their sides.

name: Insane Insects: The Inception
short_description: Played over five uniquely different arenas, Insane Insects - The Inception is an airborne Quake III on steroids, a classic old-school fragging game, speed, movement and skill based.

name: Extreme Exorcism
short_description: Extreme Exorcism is a paranormal platformer where every move you make comes back to haunt you.

name: CrossWorlds: Escape
short_description: CrossWorlds: Escape is a hardcore game in which you will have to deploy all your skills to survive in a huge open world that is susceptible to changes in weather, seasons and various natural phenomena.

name: Hotel Transylvania Popstic
short_description: Hotel Transylvania Popstic is a super fun VR rhythm game that combines high energy music with full body movement. The goal is to match fast-moving patterns of colorful orbs flying toward you with the corresponding colors on each end of your Wands or Popstic.

name: Virtual Maid Streamer Ramie
short_description: The Vtuber who came out of the screen was actually a maid!? Featuring the virtual maid who just wants to cheer the protagonist up. Follow this fluffy adventure with a little spice, full of charming moments and a few tears along the way.

name: CARSTEROIDS
short_description: A top-down shooter set in a dark future after humanity colonized the asteroids. The place is now a set for a vehicular combat game show.

name: Mio Garden
short_description: Take a break from reality. Mio Garden offers up a calming Virtual Reality experience unlike any other. Interact with a series of mini games or sit down, relax and meditate against the backdrop of a never-ending sunset.

name: Nominal
short_description: Push buttons, flip switches, and race against the clock. Climb into the cockpit of an alternate history, 1960’s era spacecraft: the Odyssey. Challenge your critical thinking skills playing solo, or let your friends play as your Mission Control in an asymmetric game of crisis communication!

name: Lovely Kitchen
short_description: Lovely Kitchen is a 2D arcade game filled with donuts, pizzas and pies. Jumping from donuts and avoiding all clever traps, reach the final goal and wake up the cook.

name: Shark Attack Deathmatch 2
short_description: Combat in Shark Attack Deathmatch 2 is savage, gritty, and brutal. Players hunt each other down in various game modes with the constant threat of terrifying sharks joining in on the bloodshed. Tear divers apart as you take on the role as the ocean's top apex predator, The Great White.

name: Project Root
short_description: Project Root the Shoot’em up Evolution.Project Root is a classic shoot’em up with open scenarioswhere the player's skill will be the key to survive.

name: Jubilee
short_description: Challenging precision platformer based on tight, fluid movement. Open map layout with multiple routes. Collect gems and save animals.

name: 铁道少女:梦想轨迹 2.0 Railway To Dream
short_description: 梦想轨迹是集合轻百合与养成元素的文字冒险游戏，玩家将扮演力图成为第一名女性动车组司机的田诗虹，在一个月期间接受川崎镜与韩德亮二人的指导，并在最后接受梁凌薇的考核。以此与两位童年好友和解，将三人之间那早已扭曲的轨迹，重新引导回正确的轨道上。

name: HACK_IT
short_description: HACK_IT presents players with a fully immersive hacking experience, you’ll meet characters and find out things you never imagined. Including interactive apps that will give you the power to shutdown servers and retrieve passwords.

name: Maze Up!
short_description: Maze Up! is a simple and fun maze/labyrinth puzzle for everyone. Just click the tiles to rotate them and find the fastest way through hundreds of labyrinths.

name: All-Star Fruit Racing
short_description: A high-speed multiplayer racer with a unique power-up system! Combine different juices for a range of attacking and defensive abilities. Drift through looping bends. Soar over monumental jumps, and defy gravity around tubular tracks in an explosively colorful racer!

name: CINEVR
short_description: CINEVR is a virtual, immersive and social Movie Theater to watch videos alone or with friends.

name: Alien Cat
short_description: Save the Universe with the Alien-Cat in this brand new puzzle-platformer game! Jump on your enemies heads, push the boxes and walk on the ceiling.

name: Furry Shakespeare: Oops! All Dragons!
short_description: Train a group of misfits. Put on a holiday play. Be awesome. Or ruin capitalism forever. That's also awesome.

name: Cursed Island
short_description: Search for secrets, solve puzzles, get ready to survive a series of dangerous nights in this action adventure full of challenges and difficulties. Will you be able to escape from the Cursed island?

name: Game Royale 2 - The Secret of Jannis Island
short_description: Game Royale 2 - The Secret of Jannis Island is the highly anticipated sequel to our successful first adventure game Game Royale - Riders of the lost bald. The game is a point-&-click adventure and a tribute to the great classics of this genre. In German language only!

name: Easter Riddles
short_description: A game and a brain teaser in one! The new Easter Riddles is a great way to spend an evening improving your mind!

name: Henri's Secret - Visual novel
short_description: A​ love story tainted with secrets, in the rhythm of Jay's songs and characters with unique personalities. ​Incarnate Lyla, a young high school student, as she lives her last year and meets Henry, the shy and rather unlikeable new boy.​ Lyla is intrigued by this very mysterious boy...

name: Old World
short_description: Old World is a revolutionary new historical strategy game where you lead your dynasty over generations of rule against rival kings and queens. Wage massive wars, manage your court, and build a dynasty — or watch your empire crumble to dust. What legacy will you leave behind?

name: Go Outside Simulator
short_description: For when you can't or won't go outside, go outside from the comfort of inside. Explore different environments, look for hidden Easter eggs, chill and relax in virtual worlds. Go Outside Simulator is a for fun game used to help in the future development of therapeutic VR programs.

name: Ascension: Deckbuilding Game
short_description: Ascension: Deckbuilding Game is now available for your PC and Mac, complete with 9 full expansion decks! Play alone or with friends to battle against the Fallen One for honor and victory. Conceived and designed by Justin Gary, Ascension will provide hours of engaging and strategic game play for enthusiasts and experienced gamers alike.

name: Alicia Quatermain 4: Da Vinci and the Time Machine
short_description: A new and unforgettable adventure: you’ll visit the Louvre, ancient Egypt and even the Atlantis!

name: Floor By Floor
short_description: Floor By Floor is a 2D action game where you fight floors of enemies trying to defeat the level's end boss. With 4 weapons to switch between and an ever increasing difficulty curve, Floor By Floor requires precision, timing, and mastery of each floor in order to beat the level.

name: Shadow Circuit
short_description: Shadow Circuit is a fast-paced, arcade-style, sports game in VR with unique physics and gravity mechanics. Players face down an AI opponent that challenges their reflexes and spatial awareness.

name: MinosMaze - The Minotaur's Labyrinth
short_description: Theseus is locked in Minotaur's labyrinth, help him escape!

name: Mystery Solitaire. Powerful Alchemist 2
short_description: Return to the Middle Ages and become a powerful alchemist! This is a new sequel to the beloved game.

name: Honey, I Joined a Cult
short_description: It's time to start working towards that ultimate goal of enlightenment, faith and money…lots and lots of money! Become the ultimate tycoon - create, customise, and manage your own cult whilst listening to funky music. Welcome to Honey, I Joined a Cult!

name: Libra of the Vampire Princess: Lycoris & Aoi in "The Promise" PLUS Iris in "Homeworld"
short_description: These episodes take place BEFORE 'Libra of the Vampire Princess', so they're a great introduction into Libra's vampire world. They're also perfect for fans who crave more of Libra's expanded universe. Both episodes were funded on Kickstarter thanks to our amazing Backers.

name: Space Battle VR
short_description: Space Battle VR is an action shooter set in space. It supports VR controllers to give you a real feel how it is to be a spaceship pilot. You can truly feel the cosmos with this game. Jump into an awesome adventure, help mankind, win a war, bring freedom and happiness to the universe. People need you!

name: Blight of the Immortals
short_description: A plague of undead creatures threatens to overwhelm the land and with the fall of each town to the Blight, more walking dead rise and the zombie apocalypse draws nearer. Innovative turn based single player, slow-real-time co-op multiplayer!

name: Sons of Ra
short_description: Sons of Ra is the award-winning competitive tower defense game by indie studio Pharaoh Hound Games. Play solo or join your friends in this unique strategic experience.

name: The Nightmare Inside
short_description: The Nightmare Inside is a short first-person horror game filled with puzzles connected to an amazing story.

name: A Shooty Bit
short_description: Postsoviet shoot 'em up borne from and reflective of the listlessness that modern, hyperconnected society injects into our selves

name: Outbreak: Lost Hope
short_description: Help a mother survive against the undead and find her her lost daughter in this hardcore survival horror nightmare.

name: Brain Games
short_description: A collection of popular classic games for brain improved and entertainment.

name: Hollow Witch
short_description: The witch woke up! She feels hollow and must gather magic, evolve and overcome the trials. Honor the memories of her equals fighting and absorbing mystic souls reaching an unmatched power! Consume or be consumed, what will be the fate!

name: Spring Falls
short_description: Spring Falls is a puzzle game about water, erosion, and watching things grow. Manipulate the landscape and bring wildflowers to life on a peaceful mountainside.

name: Rhythm Stars Climbing
short_description: Rock climb to the rhythm and beat to become the best star

name: Fool's Paradise
short_description: He's alone and keeps in a fool's paradise. Help Jack to open his eyes by getting through his dark adventure to the truth. Solve puzzles, explore Jack's memories and enjoy the ambient soundtrack.

name: Mystic Space
short_description: A fast-paced high action game where you encounter deadly enemies with unique abilities through various waves.

name: Mushroom Cats 2
short_description: Mushroom Cats 2 - is a cute point-and-click game about Mushroom Cats that live on magical islands. Any girl will melt from tenderness, and the kids will be delighted with the funny Mushroom Cats! This fairy tale will fill any heart with good!

name: Crystal Path
short_description: Your best friends will be your reflexes and your wits on this crystalline adventure!

name: Ring of Elysium
short_description: Escape an astonishing disaster in Ring of Elysium, a battle royale shooter developed by Aurora Studio.

name: Showbiz Tycoon
short_description: Own a movie studio, negotiate with talents, schedule releases, make money, expand your business and become the biggest in the industry.

name: Fabulous - New York to LA
short_description: Will Angela's expansion into LA turn into a Walk of Fame, or a Walk of Shame?

name: UBOAT
short_description: UBOAT is a simulator of a submarine from WWII era. It is a survival sandbox with crew management mechanics while its primary theme is life of German sailors. The boat is their home, but it can become their grave at any time.

name: Masquerade of Miasma
short_description: A bubble pop style game set during a Medieval plague, where proper sanitation, social distancing and toilet paper are key. Journey through this beautiful Medieval community, joined by other medical professionals, to save your home.

name: Winning Putt: Golf Online
short_description: Join the ultimate free-to-play PC golf experience. Perfect your golf game across ten beautiful courses. Play with friends worldwide anytime, anywhere.

name: 夕生 Halflight
short_description: Halflight is a 3D adventure game with classic puzzles. Players follow in the steps of the young boy Xi-sheng as he strays into an extraordinary phantom world -- a world where Memories intertwine with Nightmares, Hope casts its lot with Destiny, and any semblance of self-identity will be tested.

name: A Boy and His Blob
short_description: When Blobolonia is threatened by an evil Emperor, the blob comes to Earth looking for help. Instead, he finds a young boy. Help the blob dethrone the evil Emperor that's terrorizing Blobolonia and establish a friendship with the blob that will last a lifetime.

name: Cricket Captain 2019
short_description: Cricket Captain 2019 is the perfect companion for a hugely anticipated cricket season. With the World Cup and Australia in England, and the inaugural test-match championship, old rivalries will be put to the test and new ones created.

name: Broken Memories
short_description: Broken Memories is a first-person horror adventure game based on a person's story where he travels to another world in search of his dead wife's memories. you need to escape from the evil souls in order to survive. Moreover, few puzzles are added to the game, making gameplay more varied.

name: JumpBeard
short_description: Challenge awaits you in this platformer journey, where you take control of one legged captain called Rupert the JumpBeard in your tactical jumping adventure where your only way to go is upwards to find a mythical treasure but be wary, every missed jump will result in a fall back where you started.

name: Schwerpunkt
short_description: Schwerpunkt is a World War 2 military simulation game. Take control of hundreds of units over a large frontline, making daring manoeuvres to push your enemy back. Fight in one of the scenarios given or make your own in the map maker.

name: Peter World
short_description: This is Peter World Game, a game similar to Mario World, which has a lot of adventures and actions, good game-play. Peter, a solitary character that you go through many adventures in beautiful and great stages in a Pixel-Art open world.

name: Chesstle
short_description: A Turn-Based Multiplayer Strategy / Tactical game where you climb your way up the ranks in online competitive 1 vs 1 matches.

name: Belle-de-Nuit
short_description: Win duels and hearts as a swordswoman at Paris's finest luxury brothel! Fight for the honor of ladies of the night in this game of swords and seductions.

name: Tomb Joe
short_description: Embark on a journey to unravel the mystery of the Sceptre of Gods and Tomb Joe's father's disappearance. Armed only with his sharp wit and his trusty whip, Joe will have to face deadly traps, dangerous wildlife, and the best soldiers of the Reich to reach his goal and bring fame to his father's name once again.

name: Putin Life
short_description: Putin Life - a game that allows you to feel not only the leader of the Russian Federation, but perhaps the Lord of the world.Rob, steal, enslave.

name: Les Misérables: Jean Valjean
short_description: Discover the story of Jean Valjean, the hero of the novel 'Les Misérables'!

name: The Magic Storm
short_description: A hiddenobject game from 7-y.o. storyteller. The graphics are based on the works of a young artist.

name: Messiah
short_description: Bob is an angel ordered by God himself to go and clean up the putrid world of the future. He has been given the power of possession so that he can sneak up on any person, animal or genetically engineered being and leap right into their souls! The rules are up to you - enjoy the freedom.

name: Hinterhalt 3
short_description: Join the battlefield in this chaotic warfare and dominate your opponents in this whimsical and unique setting! Immerse yourself in an indispensable quirky conflict between nations of toy soldiers and lead your army to victory at all costs.

name: RAKETENWASCHMACHINE
short_description: RAKETENWASCHMACHINE is an action-puzzle game set in a constantly spinning world that will melt your brain

name: Dream Enders RPG
short_description: A visual, interactive story with unique characters, consequential dialogue choices, and branching story paths set in the world of an M.M.O.R.P.G.

name: Inconsistencies
short_description: When a young private investigator breaks into an old family home with her partner to solve a mysterious, inter generational double suicide, she sets off a chain of strange incidents.

name: The Deadly Tower of Monsters
short_description: Fire up your ray guns, crystal swords, and laser whips, and get ready for thrills and chills! With three incredible movie stars playing out decidedly B-level sci-fi exploits, Dick Starspeed, Scarlet Nova, and Robot will have you ready to jump off the side of the tower—right into adventure!

name: Soul-Ivy: C0
short_description: A hand drawn RPG/Visual Novel in an alien setting.

name: Sakura Santa
short_description: Koji is feeling a bit down. This year is the first Christmas he's spending alone. After moving away from home to attend the University of his dreams, he found his college life to be rather lonely. Feeling distraught, he wanders to his local shrine to make an offering.

name: The Misadventure Of Melon
short_description: Join Melon in this Misadventure that takes him through 6 amazing chapters, Snow, Caves, Forest, Swamp, Mountains and Corrupted lands to battle through corrupted creatures and to make your way back to the village and save the world from this evil.

name: Essence Of The Tjikko - Prologue
short_description: Explore a retro 3D fantasy world in Essence Of The Tjikko.Deep in a underground botanic lab, an hybrid plant child wakes up with no memory.Solve the puzzles and brave the traps in a 7 floor dungeon with more than 30 rooms.Will you find the sunlight?Available in 10 languages

name: ChessBase 15 Steam Edition
short_description: ChessBase is a personal, stand-alone chess database that has become the standard throughout the world. Everyone uses ChessBase, from the World Champion to the amateur next door. It is the program of choice for anyone who loves the game and wants to know more about it.

name: Octave
short_description: Octave is a point 'n click horror-adventure game with elements of action. Dark woods, monsters, paranormal activity, nice puzzles - all this is present in the game.

name: BloodRayne 2: Terminal Cut
short_description: Enhanced and updated for modern systems, this is the definitive edition of Rayne’s second adventure: a blood-soaked rampage of vengeance against the Cult of Kagan, a group led by Rayne's half-siblings that seek to carry out their father Kagan's legacy by creating a new era of vampire supremacy.

name: BLASTER LiLO
short_description: Blast through an endless horde of enemies in this survival shoot'em up or compete against other players in a battle for the ultimate score.

name: Automobiels and the Eisenhower Hiway System the Game
short_description: in this text based game the goal is to get to new york, but traversing the Eisenhower highway system can prove to be difficult

name: Void Raiders
short_description: Void Raiders is 'radical' top down rogue-lite shmup, with permanent character progression, character centric gameplay and never ending carnage in randomly generated environments.

name: Izanami
short_description: Izanami is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.The game is perfect for relaxing.

name: Tentacular
short_description: Tentacular is a VR game about a gigantic but good-hearted tentacled beast trying to figure out its place in the world.

name: Repit
short_description: Madness is the repetition of the same action over and over again, in the hope of a change. The challenge that Repit throws at your nerves is not everyone is ready to accept and only a few will be able to reach the end

name: Dull Grey
short_description: Dull Grey is an award-winning visual novel about growing up. Experience an emotional story of a mother and son in a dystopian world, make simple but meaningful choices and discover multiple endings. Will you see your story unfold in full colour?

name: Daily Chthonicle: Editor's Edition
short_description: This game lets you try on the role of a Supernatural Newspaper Agency boss and editor. The world it takes place in is a dark and haunted one, with ghosts, zombies, monsters and even shapeshifting murderers, pretending to be human after they have stolen their victims' bodies or infiltrated the humanity.

name: VirtuaCreature (Legacy Version)
short_description: The ultimate monster simulation! Train, feed, and battle with your own personal creature - Treat it well, and you'll see it evolve!

name: WAR PARTY
short_description: War Party is a strategy game where you enter a prehistoric world of Dinosaurs, Cavemen and Magic! Build up your chosen faction, gather resources, explore the land and command them against enemy tribes and wildlife! Will your story be about Life, Death or Balance? Can you survive?

name: JQ: chemistry
short_description: JQ: chemistry - is a quiz game about chemical elements in which a player must choose the correct answer from 4 options.

name: Killsquad
short_description: Hack and slash? Check. Twin-stick-shooter? Check. 4 player coop to slay hordes of aliens & bosses with your friends? Check. Skills, upgrades, weapons, gears, talismans and more to make you stronger? Check. Wake up, bounty hunter. We have a mission for you. Time to clean up the scum of the galaxy.

name: SAVAGE: The Shard of Gosen
short_description: A 2D action/platforming adventure with a healthy dose of RPG elements set in the hostile world of Lor, a classic sword and sorcery setting. The slave-hungry Argeshii empire dominates the known world, old and false gods conspire; brutal combat is the only means of survival!

name: BeatNClean
short_description: Our goal is to move forward in the subway we are in before any of our Life or Cleaning bars comes to an end. Depending on the situation, you can collect the garbage in the subway so that your cleaning bar does not fall or you can beat the gang members who cross your path in the subway.

name: Ninja JaJaMaru: The Great Yokai Battle + Hell
short_description: 'Ninja JaJaMaru : The Great Yokai Battle + Hell' est un jeu d'action en 2D. Il s'agit de la dernière interaction de la série Ninja JaJaMaru qui introduit de nouveaux contrôles et de nouvelles mécaniques de jeu dans la série.

name: Micron
short_description: Micron is a unique fusion of puzzle and rhythm gameplay. Place pieces on the board to deflect bullets of energy that fire to the beat. Guide the bullets to the exit through 51 challenging levels — and 12 bonus levels — featuring a variety of distinctive soundscapes. Your solutions create the music.

name: The Dark Occult
short_description: The Dark Occult is a psychological driven horror game that puts players in a constant state of anxiety that crescendos into raw panic and terror. You will encounter grotesque creatures, who will take your life at any moment.Your only goal -- survive.

name: Realms of Magic
short_description: Conquer the Realms of Magic. A 2D Action RPG in an epic fantasy setting that gives you a great level of freedom and customization. Explore the open world of the Old Kingdom as a knight or a wizard. Or build a house, plant fruits, invest in livestock… become a farmer… that also sounds nice!

name: Operation Deep Magic: Cryptanalysis
short_description: Reconnaissance operatives infiltrated a corporate building and extracted electronics and files encrypted with 56-bit DES. Items were handed over to you, the cryptanalyst. Your mission is to decrypt the files.

name: 100 hidden hares
short_description: 100 hidden hares is a hidden object game in the winter setting. Black and white hand-drawn graphics in a cartoon style. Ultra hard! Very difficult!

name: Triplicity
short_description: Triplicity is a fast paced and dynamic collectible card game in a stylized world of puzzles.

name: Trick & Treat
short_description: Trick or treating in a vampire's house.Trick & Treat is a light-hearted Halloween adventure. It's about exploring and solving puzzles in a spooky atmosphere. There will be some horror elements, romance, many bad ends and a happy ending of true love.

name: Roots of Insanity
short_description: As Dr. Riley McClein, you have to figure out what is real and what is not as you try to uncover the mysterious happenings at the hospital, while also trying to deal with your epileptic attacks that have haunted you all your life.

name: Infinity Heroes
short_description: Infinity Heroes is a simultaneous turn-based collectible hero card game. Features PC & Mobile crossplay, a single player Roguelike Adventure and Infinite Customization via name and card art replacement of every card with any image on your computer.

name: Tank Assault X
short_description: Tank Assault X is a hardcore, logical tank arcade built on the lines of the classic arcade games of the 1980’s.

name: Z-Rush Survival
short_description: Survive in your Virtual Reality (VR) space in this Horror-Thriller based shooting Game. Stay alive by shooting down Zombies that surround you at 360 degree angle. Test you agility, precision & strategy

name: Sudoku Quest
short_description: Sudoku Quest is the game for truly Sudoku lovers. You’ll be challenged to test your skills in Adventure mode with constantly increasing board difficulty. Various Sudoku types and sizes are provided to diversify your adventure experience.

name: Dead End Junction
short_description: Adventure. Gunslingers. Outlaws. Shoot-outs. War. Set in the Wild West, Dead End Junction hits on themes relevant to the setting, such as treatment of the Native American population and the scars left by the Civil War (represented fictionally in-universe); many of which are applicable today.

name: Frankenstein: Master of Death
short_description: Victor Frankenstein, an old friend and a brilliant scientist has managed to resurrect the dead! However the border between life and death is fragile and Victor has learned the hard way that this balance should not be tempered with...

name: Memento Mori 2
short_description: An award winning adventure crime thriller with a deeply plotted storyline which takes you to atmospheric settings all around the globe, including among other locations, South Africa, Finland and the USA.

name: Spear Master
short_description: You are the son of a mighty hero. Now it's your turn to protect the world from an ancient evil.

name: Brilliant Shadows - Part One of the Book of Gray Magic
short_description: Brilliant Shadows is a visual novel that follows the story of Veronica Ashmar, a new graduate of the Mountain and a necromancer. Tradition dictates that upon graduation, necromancers and paladins are to perform the pairing ritual.

name: Stray
short_description: Lost, alone and separated from family, a stray cat must untangle an ancient mystery to escape a long-forgotten cybercity and find their way home.

name: Newton's Life at Home - Pixel Art Jigsaw Puzzle
short_description: Newton's Life at Home is a jigsaw puzzle made with animated pixel art Gifs and a very cute kitten named Newton. Assemble the puzzles to find out what Newton the kitten likes to do at home.

name: Dreamscape
short_description: Addictive RPG with bits of strategy to enhance the gameplay, Dreamscape can be played in 4 different modes and features different rewards for completing them. You even get bonus heroes if you complete a mode without using the healing goddess!

name: The Temporal Invasion
short_description: EXPERIENCE this Story-Driven Alternate Reality Game (ARG) that blends Your Real Life with Science Fiction as it explores the Dark Limits of Conspiracy, Alternate History, The Supernatural and Fringe Science.

name: Virtual Reality Experiment Framework
short_description: VREF is a framework for academic experiments in virtual reality. Download now and take part in academic experiments to aid VR research. The current project aims to assess the technical feasibility of teaching fire training in rural areas.

name: Per Aspera
short_description: Make Mars your own! Take control of the world’s most sophisticated AI (AMI) and terraform the surface of the Red Planet for a city-building experience on a planetary scale. Transform this barren world into a lush paradise and explore the surface for any ancient secrets that may be waiting.

name: Umihara Kawase Fresh!
short_description: Umihara Kawase become open world? Clear the quests with rubbering action!

name: Auto Island
short_description: Completely open world. Just ride your cars, overcome mountain landscapes and forests. Find new cars.

name: Art of Guile
short_description: Customize your units as they level up according to your needs. Suppress, scare and surround your enemy. Use terrain to your advantage. Exploit their weaknesses. Diminish your foes and bring dominance to the battlefield!

name: Tactical Operations
short_description: Tactical Operations is a subsystem of investigative, organizational-preparatory, other actions and operational-search activities conducted under a single plan and aimed at solving individual intermediate tasks subordinated to the general objectives of investigating a criminal case.

name: VR Meditation SkyRun
short_description: You are welcome to meditate and enjoy the atmosphere of peace and fantsatic run of time in a silence high in mountains.

name: Wooden Floor 2 - Resurrection
short_description: The sequel to 'Wooden Floor'. Reveal the truth hiding in the dark, haunted mansion of Blackdust Field. A mysterious and horrific adventure game by Pheenix93.

name: Avalon Legends Solitaire
short_description: Avalon. A land of lush forests, great plains, tall mountains... and most of all, magic! The Druids of Avalon wield powerful healing magic, activated through the use of magic cards. Just like runestones, the magic of the cards is unlocked by placing them in the correct order.

name: Gilbert Goodmate and the Mushroom of Phungoria
short_description: The sacred mushroom of Phungoria has been stolen, Grandpa Goodmate is going to be executed and things ain't looking too good. Now it's up to YOU... catch the thief, recover the mushroom and save Grandpa... all by the end of the week. So hurry Gilbert, time is running out... Oh, and do try to keep your hands off the Princess!

name: Cards and Castles
short_description: Collectible cards come to life in this tactics and CCG hybrid! Collect cards, build decks, and challenge players head to head on a Tactical Game Board. Play as Vikings, Pirates, Ninjas and more!

name: Fasaria World: Ancients of Moons + Server
short_description: Fasaria World: Ancients of Moons is a single/multiplayer fantasy online experience that can be played locally from your PC (single player offline). Instructions are included on how to host your own server and how other players can join your game.

name: To Trust an Incubus

name: Heroland

name: Alteric

short_description: Base Dune 3D is a first-person shooter in which you have to go through a large secret laboratory destroying enemies. You can simply move around the game world and shoot the weapons that are given in the game.

name: InnerSpace
short_description: Soar through virgin skies and dive into lost oceans as you hunt for the ancient gods of the Inverse, a forsaken realm of inside-out planets. Created by a small team of seven developers and originally funded on Kickstarter, InnerSpace is a bright, colorful exploration flying game with no horizons.

name: Len's Island
short_description: Build, fight, farm and explore. Experience your own path. Whether it's building the home of your dreams, tending to your crops and watching the sun go down; or explore the mysteries of the Island and the darkness underneath, but you may want to take a sword with you.

name: RAYBEEM - Live in Your Music
short_description: Live in your music with Raybeem. Load in your favorite tunes and watch them shape the world around you in Virtual Reality. Find your vibe by selecting a theme that fits the pace of your mood and music. If only every reality was as sublime as Raybeem.

name: Hexcells Infinite
short_description: Hexcells Infinite is an ambient logic puzzle game for PC, Mac and Linux.

name: Chinbu's Adventure
short_description: A collectathon action rpg where you play as a young dragon named Chinbu with the unique ability to control all elements.

name: Atelier Meruru ~The Apprentice of Arland~ DX
short_description: Third release in the Arland series. Princess of the small frontier country of Arls, Meruru plans to use alchemy to stimulate the growth of her small country. Use Synthesis, Explore, and Battle to increase the population within the time limit and boost the advancement of the kingdom.

name: Earthlings Must Die
short_description: Commander, it is time to save Planet Earth and bring humanity to an end! Take control of our greatest weapons and unleash destruction onto the human cities. Have fun blasting the human ragdolls up into the air before they turn into bone and ahs.

name: Quantum Replica
short_description: Hide in time as you explore a cyberpunk metropolis to uncover the deep dark secrets of the Syndicate in Quantum Replica, a fast-paced stealth action.

name: Destiny Island
short_description: Destiny Island is a very short computer game. You play a man who visits his memories. You can walk and talk to mannequins about 7 sins. Associate essence with anything comes to your mind.

name: Thomas Scott
short_description: ThomasScott will allow players to explore the world through rotation, parkour and puzzle solving.

name: Land of Puzzles: Battles
short_description: In Land of Puzzles: Battles the king and queen need your help. To avoid war the king has accepted a challenge of puzzles to solve. He needs you to solve 15 sets of challenging puzzles and help him secure the kingdom.

name: Royal Booty Quest
short_description: Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, discover relics of immense power, slay monsters, forge new cards and boil new potions. Every bit will help.

name: Easy puzzle: Animals 2
short_description: This is a logical game in which the goal of the game is to rearrange the tiles to get the final picture. In the pictures that need to be collected, different animals are depicted

name: AI Rebellion VR
short_description: Do you want to fly a spaceship by your own hands like intergalactic pilot in VR? AI Rebellion gives you this unique opportunity with full support of Oculus Touch and HTC Vive.

name: Super Bombinhas
short_description: A colorful 2D platformer with carefully designed levels and a level editor

name: X-17
short_description: FPS/3rd Person Genre Shooter. Fight your way through an Alien Invasion not only on earth but on other planets.

name: Time Mysteries: Inheritance - Remastered
short_description: Face the Time Traveller to save the future!

name: Hot Pool
short_description: Adult people gathered at a hot pool party with boundless flirting and sex. Your goal is to arrange the characters according to their sexual orientation (including LGBT).

name: Hate Free Heroes Tactics: Strategy Building MMO
short_description: Hate Free Heroes Tactics is a community based online game and adventure. Help your city reduce aggro levels by building your agency, defeating aggromites and researching new ways of keeping city aggro levels at a minimum. Play from any web browser, PC, tablet or phone.

name: Mutiny!!
short_description: Mutiny!! is set in a world of fantasy, and adventure. A realm where airships can sail among the clouds as well as the sea, entering the flogiston to journey to other planes. There’s treasure spread out over many planes if you’re brave or curious enough to find it!

name: Gravitura
short_description: Pilot a ship around asteroids, planets, singularities. Learn how to put your ship into orbit, sling shot, and use gravity to your advantage. Perform precise maneuvers to move your way through the 35 levels in this highly challenging game. Build, share, download custom levels.

name: Nuclear 2050
short_description: One 3 atoms generators had a serious mistake, besides, panic broke out in the whole town. A gas was released and infected some people and, besides, also the scientists in the nuclear power station. Besides, you are alone and must stop the disaster!

name: PlayFortress
short_description: PlayFortress is a castle building game where the player controls characters such as the Lord, Master Mason and Engineer, using them to construct elaborate castle fortifications and settlements whilst managing their economy.

name: Hustle Cat
short_description: You are Avery Grey, the newest employee at a popular cat cafe called A Cat's Paw. The coffee's good and the staff is friendly (and kinda cute!) but mysterious. One day, you find a strange book in the basement, with letters you can't quite read...

name: Vector Velocity
short_description: In Vector Velocity movement is the name of the game. Run, Jump, Slide, Climb, Grind, Skid, Zipline and ultimately race your way from point A to B as fast as you can.

name: Sweet Tooth 3
short_description: Sweet Tooth 3 - is a physical puzzle game with a side view. In the third part, there are more new items to use and the game has become more difficult!

name: Sausage Fest
short_description: Sausage Fest is an online top-down shooter where 2-10 meat rods fight for dominance. Step into the dangerous world of Sausages as you battle other wieners in different game modes and maps to grow as big as you can and crush your enemies. Grow quick and pound hard! Lest you be pounded yourself...

name: Heroes of the Monkey Tavern
short_description: After countless days and nights celebrating within the infamous Monkey Tavern, our team of adventurers have spent every last penny... Their fates, however are about to change...

name: Dimensionality 3.5
short_description: Each of us is a celestial body in the vast universe. When our hero is on a common track in his life, this track takes him to another dimension.

name: 约会模拟器：原型
short_description: 《约会模拟器：原型》是一款基于文字的情感模拟游戏，玩家需要分析游戏文本内容并做出判断、采取行动，最终迎来属于自己的结局。

name: Ogrez
short_description: Immerse yourself in the world doomed to destruction at the hands of a distraught artificial intelligence - Ogrez. To do this, you should arm yourself with perseverance, attentiveness and strong nerves - otherwise your chances are zero!

name: Batsumaru
short_description: BATSUMARU is a short and minimalist puzzle game.

name: 幸存者 星星之火 | Survivor Spark
short_description: Survivor: Spark is the first episode of a series of anti alien invasion games. It's a classic transcendental third person shooting game!

name: 100 hidden cats 2
short_description: Hidden object game in the city setting. Black and white hand-drawn graphics in a cartoon style. Ultra hard! Really very difficult!

name: Hirilun
short_description: Hirilun is a time-trial-based first-person platformer in which you will explore a dark and strange city. Run, jump, glide, sprint and dash to achieve the best possible time, and compete with your friends in worldwide leaderboards.

name: Time of Piracy
short_description: Time of Piracy - is the simplest 2D platformer in which you have to do different levels playing as a courageous Pirate.

name: Miner Gun Builder
short_description: The game is an light-hearted version of an arcade space shooter but has substantial depth regarding the mechanics. If you like to tinker around and optimize stuff - This is the game for you.

name: Falling Blocks
short_description: Score and survive!

name: Soul Smith of the Kingdom
short_description: Soul Smith of the Kingdom is a business idle game involving smith workshop business. Play as Nine,heiress of the unparalleled Andelioar Workshop in the kingdom,instruct smiths and adventurers and make perfect weapons--all to revitalize the workshop!

name: 月夜赞歌 Melody in the moonlight
short_description: A difficult RPG puzzle game. Because of an accident, the two sisters entered a wrong time and space. Please help them find the hidden truth in this false space and time.

name: Solar Cram School/[太阳补习班]
short_description: You are the best child on earth! I believe that encouraging education will bring you different results. Here you can play as much as you can to train all kinds of students!

name: Eisenwald: Blood of November
short_description: Eisenwald: Blood of November is a new sandbox adventure in the world of Eisenwald. Take up your arms and fight for your cause (and find out first who or what you want to be fighting for).

name: Mr. Parkour 2
short_description: Mr. Parkour 2 is not a game for the faint of heart! In this 2D parkour platformer you have to jump over precipices, circular saws and traps on the way to the cherished crystal.

name: Cat's Lover
short_description: The adventure of an unknown man in an unknown field for your fun.

name: Kidgilantes
short_description: Rescue all animals from their enclosures without being caught by adults! But, you can’t do it alone. You and your friend will have to dress up as adults to get by in this zoo!

name: Sad :')
short_description: A simple game about a complicated matter. Be happy to earn points. Stay with other people to be happy.

name: Saiko no sutoka
short_description: Saiko No Sutoka is a Horror Survival Game where you as a Protagonist must escape and avoid the crazy yandere girl who wants you dead.

name: Poly Racing
short_description: Poly Racing is a low poly casual racing game that for some reason is really fun to drift in. Pick and paint whatever car you like, and just have fun drifting and jumping around. And Poly Racing, early access or not, is going to be a community driven game.

name: Subterraneus
short_description: Subterraneus is a point&click video game. A mouse, curiosity and some (twisted) logic are your only weapons to help Clodomir venture into the depths below his world!

name: Cube Raiders
short_description: Cube Raiders is a fun puzzle game for one or two players where you have to combine groups of dice using the energy of MagnetoGloves. Thanks to this power, it is possible to push or rotate the dice to solve the levels while trying to avoid the traps of each temple.

name: Moki
short_description: Moki is a precision platformer with psychological elements, a story of a little guy lost in your own mind, do you be able to leave this mindness prison?

name: STATUS: INSANE
short_description: Escaping from a Mental Asylum Has Never Been This Much of.. Fun.

name: Dustoff Z
short_description: Get those blades spinning and load up on guns and ammo, the time has come to rebuild humanity! Dustoff Z is a game about maneuvering combat-helicopters in one of the harshest weather conditions possible – A Zombie Apocalypse.

name: Tidy Your Room Simulator
short_description: The simulator which reflects everyones favourite activity: Cleaning up! Use different tools to destroy your furniture in this physics game and gather money from your destroyed furniture.

name: MH-Zombie
short_description: A 3D, sim-like arcade helicopter-shooter tower defense. Repair, re-arm, and upgrade your heli at the FARP as the battle permits. Three flight physics modes provide a stepped learning curve and wider accessibility, and the tutorial mode provides a safe learning environment.

name: These Lands
short_description: Follow the clues, solve the puzzles and reveal the secrets These Lands possess. Grab, throw and shoot your way through this mysterious VR puzzle adventure. Will you find your way through These Lands?

name: Underture
short_description: UNDERTURE is a short 6DoF immersive VR experience set in the New York City subway. Multi-axis freedom of movement, combined with spatialized audio, creates a uniquely immersive and transporting experience for the viewer.

name: DENIAL
short_description: Denial takes place inside your own dark mind, true or false, illusion or reality... It doesn't matter. It all feels the same and the stains on the walls still remain, maybe now it is time to clean them.

name: Unknown Woods
short_description: A brutal horror action FPS where you will be fighting for survival against creatures of the woods and finding out the mysteries that lie around in the dark forest

name: Across Flash
short_description: Across Flash is an arcade style shooter glider VR game developed by Uborm Technology Inc. You will guide one of two unique fighter crafts and explore a once great civilization that has fallen to ruin. Fly and battle through desolate arctic extremes, blustering desert ruins, scalding lava relic, or alien ecology.

name: Void Destroyer 2
short_description: Start with nothing... End with everything! All you have is a basic ship, barely fit for combat, with it you'll start your journey and empire. A open world space sandbox, inspired by and expanding the classics.

name: Adelantado Trilogy. Book Two
short_description: Get ready for new adventures and unexpected twists! The atmosphere is moody and grim but Don Diego tries to keep everybody cheerful. And ever-present rival Commander Rodriguez is more evil than ever.

name: Rize of the Summonds
short_description: Rize of the Summonds is a metroidvania game, in which player has the power to transform into legendary Summons including the fearless Dragon, stealthy Wraith, heavy Orc and agile Cat; each equipped with unique abilities in order to reach new areas, defeat enemies, and avoid traps.

name: Citizens of Earth
short_description: As the newly elected Vice President of the World, it's your job to save the Earth by recruiting friends, family, and the local townsfolk! ...A true politician would never get his own hands dirty, after all!

name: Psycholonials
short_description: While in communication with supernatural forces, two influencers launch a daring new social media brand.

name: Gobot
short_description: Gobot is an intense endless platform survival game focused on dodging falling meteors, Lasers, destroying robots, all while collecting powerups and upgrading abilities to help you survive.

name: VVVVV
short_description: VVVVV is a colorful, dynamic platformer action with puzzle elements, made in retro style.

name: VBOX Sim
short_description: Analyze race data and video from your favourite racing game using Circuit Tools - the tool of choice for professional racing drivers in the real world!

name: Empire of Angels IV
short_description: This is a SLG game that developed by SOFTSTAR in Taiwan. Is a dramatic, beautiful painting, use full-time vocal and funniest 3D game.

name: Arboria
short_description: Fight, die, and fight again in this dark fantasy trollz-like roguelite. As a Yotun troll warrior, descend into the ever-changing, creepy dungeons of Durnar. Use a variety of Symbiotic Weapons and Bio-Mutations to slay enemies and heal The Father Tree.

name: Joe's Wrath
short_description: After being mistakenly kidnapped by the Russian mob, Joe swears vengeance on those who had wronged him. It's up to you to help Joe fight through hordes of enemies on a killing spree he never thought he'd be part of (the main part).

name: Rebirth:Mr Wang
short_description: This is a plot game that uses mouse clicks to interact and level puzzles. The game has beautiful graphics and interesting plot. Use your wisdom to help your neighbors!

name: Dread X Collection: The Hunt
short_description: A horror anthology shooter in the Dread X Collection series. Co-produced by DUSK creator David Szymanski. Featuring 7 new short games, a robust launcher world set in an abandoned arctic base.

name: Ohr: אור
short_description: The people's cries have activated ancient Ohr deposits and woken you from your slumber. Now you must help them to find their frequencies, their souls ... your heaven.

name: Megapolis
short_description: Construct beautiful and functional city zones with plenty of modern blocks and keep your residents happy by providing all services they need, and they will reward you with a tidy profit. You can work your way to the top in the comprehensive campaign mode or you can create and play your own custom scenarios.

name: Doomed to Hell
short_description: Doomed to Hell is a roguelike-like top-down shooter where you play as Rose, a human in hell who will need to fight all of its monsters in waves of enemies, defeat bosses, and get new weapons to earn back his life on earth.

name: Blasters of the Universe
short_description: Blasters of the Universe is the first of its kind, bringing the bullet hell genre into first person VR. Intense gameplay is heavily reliant on physical movement, requiring the player to duck, dodge, twist, turn, and maneuver their way through tons of enemies and hundreds of bullets.

name: DE:VOID
short_description: An adventure psychological horror game which explores the themes of life and death in a unique way. Help a girl in the capsule to find her memories and escape from a mysterious world.

name: Sin Castle
short_description: Sin Castle is a slightly high difficulty adventure game that focus on puzzling， contains various policy elements, rigorous rules. The key of puzzle this game is reasonable attributes assignment, props use, and equipment collocation. As the grids opened, game player will encounter all sorts of strategic monsters and puzzling design.

name: Zone 10
short_description: Take command of your faction's only Starbase in Zone 10. In this innovative, arcade style, tower defense game you can build your own maze using specialty blocks and defend your Starbase against spaceships and ground troops that can blow up parts of your defenses.

name: illumine
short_description: Experience a different take on the roguelike genre. Explore a world created on the fly by your actions. Wonder about your purpose.

name: Vollun
short_description: Vollun is a first-person with great focus on story, puzzles and exploration. You wake up in a strange place full of mysteries. Something happened in this place and you're not alone.

name: STONEBOND: The Gargoyle's Domain
short_description: STONEBOND : The Gargoyle's Domain is a multiplayer gothic combat game. Fueled by our love for pixelated classics and 90s TV series, it is a 4-player couch game in which you form a fragile bond with another player, and win by protecting it together.

name: Cat Sorter VR
short_description: Live, laugh, and sort some cats. This adorafying party game supports Oculus and Vive room-scale!

name: The Toymaker's Apprentice
short_description: This world is dark. The Toymaker’s Apprentice has captured our citizens and enslaved us with his evil toys. Is there one amongst you brave enough to journey into his world on an unforgiving quest to end his tyranny and free so many lost souls……...

name: Maze Run VR
short_description: Maze Run is a rogue-like escape runner for VR. 100'000 square feet procedurally generated maze, destructible and paintable.

name: The Flea Evolution: Bugaboo
short_description: Relive The Flea or experience it for the first time in The Flea Evolution, a skill and ingenuity game where you have to guide the flea through a maze of intricate caverns. Your mission is to find the exit jumping between the different platforms, but be careful not to get eaten by the enemies!

name: 在线教育开发实习生 Elearning Development Intern
short_description: The internship life in an E-learning startup company has begun. No matter of which computer you are in front (inside or outside), you only need to work and learn!

name: Puzzling Peaks EXE
short_description: A charming, possibly spooky, story-rich physics puzzle game. You'll need quick reflexes, brainpower, and unconditional trust in your quirky artificially intelligent guide to succeed.

name: 23UL
short_description: A cute 2D adventure game help a little mushroom on his personal quest <3

name: Hymns of Resurrection
short_description: Calder and Ygritte are the King's elite soldiers. They come upon Karandir and the Occultists' wicked plans and become the ones responsible for preventing an evil resurrection and a new war.

name: Time Gap Puppies
short_description: A bullet hell shooting game that you can go back in time and use time lapse to always be successful, go back in time whenever you want and show all your skills.

name: 天天地下城
short_description: 作为陷入异化之地中的一员，未知的恐惧不断侵袭，在这黑暗笼罩危机四伏的死地，你当如何抉择？添加outpop1102（vx），领20元好礼~

name: Whispers of a Machine
short_description: Whispers of a Machine is a Sci-Fi Nordic Noir that tells the story of Vera, a cybernetically augmented detective in a post-AI world, who investigates a string of murders and unravels a dark conflict over forbidden technology.

name: Last Village
short_description: Arriving on a hunt in a small village, you become a witness to attack of alien forces on the ground, armed with a shotgun, you decide to repulse the alien intruders.

name: Spellspire
short_description: Spellspire is a thrilling mashup of word game and action role playing game. Pick letters from a grid to spell words and shoot them from your wand as spells. The longer the word, the bigger the blast! Can you make it to the top of the Spellspire?

name: DMT: Dream Dealer
short_description: DMT: Dream Dealer is a first person exploration game were you enter your dreams and start a long journey between worlds. You'll never know if what you see is real, or if you are in trance. A game made to delight your sensory system inspired in titles like: The Stanley Parable, Dear Esther.

name: DESKTOP MONKEY
short_description: A challenging game where you fight for the best places on Steam Leaderboards. A funny little Monkey living on your screen will prepare you for everything.

name: SaGa Frontier Remastered
short_description: The beloved 1998 RPG Classic, SaGa Frontier, is reborn with improved graphics, additional features, and a new main character!

name: Kuchisake Onna - 口裂け女
short_description: Kuchisake-Onna is a first-person horror adventure game based on a Japanese myth. The gameplay focuses on storytelling and stealth to avoid “Kuchisake-Onna” or else the Slit Mouthed Woman, there are also some puzzles for the player to solve, making gameplay more various.

name: Super Ultra Monster Smash!
short_description: The city-smashing VR experience you've been waiting for. Go on a room-scale RAMPAGE through New York City! Smash buildings, play with humans, and show Lady Liberty what real freedom looks like!

name: Grotto
short_description: Grotto is a mystical, narrative-focused experience. You are the Soothsayer. The one capable of talking with the stars and unveiling their messages. In a time of turmoil, the tribe of the valley turn to your powers of divination and come to you for guidance.

name: Beatbuddy: On Tour
short_description: ROCK SYMPHONIA WITH BEATBUDDY!Experience a fast paced action game set in the Beatbuddy universe! Help Beatbuddy to play awesome concerts all over Symphonia and master 36 funky levels in this SPIN-OFF from the awarded STEAM game Beatbuddy: Tale of the Guardians.

name: Cube Defense
short_description: You left alone camping in the mountains ... But during this time a virus has invaded the country and a cubic horde is heading towards you!

name: ROM: Extraction
short_description: ROM: Extraction puts you into the role of an Extractor where you must Throw, Slow, & Shoot your way to decimate as many extraterrestrial-bots as possible. ROM: Extraction begins as an homage to the classic arcade shooter with more game modes and maps to come!

name: MiniTrans
short_description: MiniTrans is a city building and traffic simulation game. Players independently build main cities and satellite cities, develop metropolitan areas and city clusters, and build various transportation facilities between urban areas to transport commuters to earn taxes.

name: The Unfolding Engine: Paint a Game
short_description: The Unfolding Engine: Paint a Game is a new paradigm of Metroidvania 2.5D game making software. That allows you to make the content of your game while you are playing it! The entire software is designed around allowing you to make and share worlds, share tools, and levels. All in real time.

name: Experiment Gone Rogue
short_description: In a dystopian future, an alien race, known as the Cirinians, rules over Earth and is building an army of genetically altered humans. Step into the shoes of an escaped experiment and wreak havoc across the facility in which you were created against your will.

name: Saving Mr. Sparkles
short_description: Save your cat Mr. Sparkles and bring him back home. Use your momentum in order to beat short but challenging platforming levels.

name: Extreme Forklifting 2
short_description: Always dreamed of becoming a forklift operator? Now you can!

name: Ruin City Gasolina
short_description: Eliminate the invasion of mechanical invaders and save what remains of the once great city.

name: Tesla Force
short_description: With science as your super power, charge up your coils and zap into action! Tesla Force is a rogue-lite top-down shooter featuring endless procedural gameplay with tentacle splitting action. Play as Tesla, Curie, Lovecraft and Shelley and blast the cosmic horror back into the galactic abyss!

name: The Watchmaker
short_description: The Watchmaker is an action adventure set in a strange steampunk world of giant clock mechanisms, where time has gone mad. Join Alexander, a clock tower keeper, on his quest to restore time to its natural rhythm!

name: Hotline Miami 2: Wrong Number
short_description: Hotline Miami 2: Wrong Number is the brutal conclusion to the Hotline Miami saga, set against a backdrop of escalating violence and retribution over spilled blood in the original game.

name: Princess Remedy 2: In A Heap of Trouble
short_description: An enormous Boss Tower has sprung from the ground, lifting entire towns up with it. Now, the people living on the tower are starting to contract all sorts of mysterious illnesses. Princess Remedy, still in Saturnian healing school, must use her powers to heal everyone and defeat the Boss Tower!

name: Hunahpu Quest. Mechanoid
short_description: An Indian Hunahpu has a simple objective- save his brother from the dreadful Mechanoid. However this objective is simple only at the first glance – in fact it is hard. You will need all your perfect reaction, strength and intelligence! Go ahead!

name: Gravinoid
short_description: Gravinoid is a tactical sci-fi VR action throwing game set in a dystopic future where humanity is falling and AI is prevailing. You - clone 7235 - have to work your way up towards the ascension room where your ultimate test awaits!

name: amazin' George 2
short_description: amazin' George 2 is a colourful, stunning 3D HD JRPG Style, turn based RPG featuring the Spacefarer cat, George. Help him rescue his Master from King Rattie and restore the dreamworld of Felina! With huge labyrinths and a gorgeous world to explore, amazin' George 2 is a definitive RPG experience!

name: GravPool
short_description: A simulation of the version of billiards that space pilgrims played during the starship migrations of the 2300s. Instead of aiming for pockets on a flat plane, you have six degrees of freedom with which to aim your shots. There are some new obstacles that make things a little more chaotic.

name: Alder Forge
short_description: Play as the Five Members of the Fourth Squadron and battle your foes using the game Adaptive Turn-Based Combat System, shape your own path in a story-driven game with a handcrafted world and unique characters.

name: Chocolate
short_description: Chocolate is a 3-4 minute reactive linear VR music video experience for the song by Giraffage that sets you as a robot in a cat-centric world of colorful chrome in which your hands interact with your environment and everything dynamically moves and changes to the music.

name: Catify VR
short_description: Embody a Parisian cat in VR and live the everyday life of a feline: walking, jumping, night-watching and clawing!

name: Crash Dive
short_description: WWII tactical submarine combat! Take command of a U-boat prowling the Atlantic in search of enemy convoys to sink. Sneak past the escorts and torpedo the transports. Or surface and use your deck gun in a daring night attack.

name: MiniCar Race - 极品飞车2019 Mini
short_description: Little Cars, BIG Fun! Start your engines! The most vibrant, super racing game you’ve ever seen is here! Unlock all kinds of fun cars! Challenge multiple race tracks, multiple racing modes!

name: Living Legends: The Crystal Tear Collector's Edition
short_description: Can you save the kingdom from a crystal curse?

name: Bear Adventures
short_description: Go through the levels collecting honey, set a time record, kill animals. In BEAR ADVENTURES you can play with friends, the co-op game mode supports up to 4 players!

name: Purple Heart
short_description: Hardcore pixel indie platformer with puzzle elements and history. Can you get to the end?

name: Dracula: Vampires vs. Zombies
short_description: Hordes of zombies and vampires prowl the city, looking for the last surviving humans. It’s a competition: who will get the last man standing. They don’t expect this man to be the most badass B-movie star Chuck Steelballz. Standing upon his trailer he’s going to deliver JUSTICE with his bow and arrows.

name: LOR - League of Runners
short_description: You will fight for the title of best runner in a beautiful fantasy world. You will need to pick up the scope to activate the portal and enter it. The main task - to pass as quickly as possible given the track.

name: Achromatic
short_description: Achromatic is a minimalist puzzle game about connecting dots in order to transform them all to one cohesive color. Along the way you will uncover unique dots with exciting properties to assist you on your puzzling adventure.

name: MineRalph
short_description: Roll your way through a hard-core, high-speed, fury-inducing, nail-biting, reaction-based physics-platformer where momentum and skill is the difference between making the jump and falling to your inevitable death.

name: Stop Santa - Tower Defense
short_description: Take the War on Christmas all the way to the North Pole! Santa has gone crazy and enlisted an army of evil elves, zombie Santas, and sadistic penguins. It's now up to you and the remaining elves to Stop Santa in this holiday themed tower defense game!

name: Knights of the Chalice 2
short_description: Knights of the Chalice 2 is a 2D RPG with turn-based combat. Create six Adventurers and set forth on an epic adventure against Evil. Overcome the odds with superior tactics. Enjoy a whole new dimension of complexity and variety based on the 3.5 ruleset! Includes a Module Editor.

name: Until None Remain: Battle Royale PC Edition
short_description: Until None Remain is a futuristic multiplayer third person shooter in a Battle Royale or Last Man Standing format. Matches pit weaponless players against one another in a death match that continues until only one player remains. Players must rush to acquire equipment to defeat the competition.

name: Pic Fed Evolution
short_description: The genesis of pic fed evolution is here with the digital wrestling figure sandbox. Create custom figures, props, setups, and scenes to take your ideal pic fed screenshots.

name: People Eater
short_description: A vicious, man-eating monster has escaped. And that monster is you! Rampage, devour, and dodge your way through endless procedurally generated levels. Overcome harrowing boss fights, unlock new monsters and upgrades, and compete for first place in the leaderboards. Sate your hunger or die trying.

name: Blake and Mortimer: The Curse of the Thirty Denarii
short_description: Help Blake and Mortimer protect a precious artifact and the fate of all mankind!

name: Bullet VR
short_description: The year 2020. You are a real war hero, who has gone through a lot and seen a lot of bad things, but you has not seen anything like that. A huge threat has come to your favorite planet - the Earth.

name: live Desktop Beauty
short_description: Customize your dream girl and let her pose and dance on your screen while you are working, playing, or surfing on the internet. The girl will appear on the top of any of your project, such as games, applications, browsers, and so on.

name: Duo Defenders - Tower Defense
short_description: Cute and cooperative tower defense game where you and your partner must reload towers with ammunition together.

name: Sakura Gamer 2
short_description: Follow antisocial Nekohime and her friends (or lovers), as they develop and sell the sequel to their super popular debut title, MikoMaid! A cute, sometimes sexy story about VN development, sprinkled with meta humor.

name: Smugglers 5: Invasion
short_description: Smugglers 5: Invasion is a standalone expansion for the turn-based science-fiction space trading game, Smugglers 5. It starts where the original game ended. After years of civil war, the Federation finally emerged victorious, crushing all rebellion. Then came the Jalkath, an invading alien race looking much like the tigers of Old Earth.

name: Seeker
short_description: Help Alfie find the the stars to get back home to his homeland. If you don't want to follow this short story you can explore this very beautiful island in search of my personal Easter eggs. these Easter eggs will be very hard to find but in the end it will be rewarding. Thank you for playing Seeker.

name: Space City - Build Your Empire
short_description: A sci-fi turn-based strategy that will make you immerse yourself in a new world.

name: CLOWN
short_description: You're trapped inside a series of mazes with a killer clown. Find the 8 playing cards to banish him before he finds you. Can you escape?

name: HyperRogue
short_description: A tactical puzzle/roguelike on a hyperbolic plane.

name: Exo: Into Starlight
short_description: Discover alien civilizations, unlocking interdimensional portals to exotic worlds. Follow in the footsteps of a lost race as you decode their language, unlocking the mystery of our origins in the Universe.

name: Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes
short_description: Find yourself trapped alone in a room with a ticking time bomb. Your friends have the manual to defuse it, but they can't see the bomb, so you're going to have to talk it out – fast!

name: EXA: The Infinite Instrument
short_description: Step into EXA, an immersive musical studio where you can compose, record, and perform music using expressive instruments of your own design. Jam with EXA’s huge sound library or your own, create virtual bands, invent 'impossible' playing styles, export to WAV/MIDI, and so much more.

name: Fox and Bunny
short_description: An ancient legend says - who cooks and tastes soup from 4 kinds of mushrooms, he will prove his love to the whole world and will consolidate the respect of ancient spirits.

name: Sierra Madre: The Wild West
short_description: Sierra Madre: The Wild West is a western, open world first person shooter survival game set in the 1870s. You play as a U.S. Marshall in the Wild West. Hunt outlaws, save the locals, and do whatever it takes to survive in your quest to rid the Wild West of injustice.

name: Life Lessons
short_description: A fetus in a simulation is taught a series of lessons about life by a primitive, overly literal artificial intelligence. There's 30 different 'lessons' to get through, but you probably won't survive.

name: Smoots World Cup Tennis
short_description: Smoots World Cup Tennis is an Arcade Tennis game with plenty of possibilities.

name: Danger Zone 2
short_description: Danger Zone 2 takes the crash action out of the Test Area and onto real public roads. A high speed driving game featuring speed, boost, traffic and crashes.

name: ThumBeat: Button Basher Edition
short_description: ThumBeat: Button Basher Edition is a short-form, button-bashing rhythm game for busy people!

name: VR Prison Escape
short_description: This is a VR immersive simulation game that simulates prison escape.

name: Toxic Terror
short_description: You're trapped deep within the toxic sewers. It's a dangerous place and you have to think quickly in order to survive. Grab all of the keys in a level to open the door to freedom... or at least the next level.

name: Astro Emporia
short_description: Astro Emporia is a CASUAL turn based randomised trading game where your objective is to make as much money in a limited amount of turns.

name: Demonic Blade
short_description: A boy. A demon. A pizza delivery girl. Sometimes all you need is to be in the wrong place at the wrong time. Everything is different than it seems to be.

name: The Enlightened League of Bone Builders and the Osseous Enigma
short_description: Reckon yourself to be a most esteemed anatomist, do you? Well then immerse yourself in an intriguing Victorian parlour of curios to see how quickly you can piece together Yorick's complete skeleton. There are lots of other things to explore too, so stop your lollygagging and see if you've got the right stuff to join the Enlightened...

name: Nine Circles of Hell
short_description: A simple strategy game: rotate a ring, align the notches and your marbles fall towards the center. Drop all your marbles through the central hole and you win.

name: A Day in the Woods
short_description: A Day in the Woods is a stylish re-imagining of the traditional sliding puzzle game. Solve 60 hexagon-tiled levels, with increasingly complex difficulty in as few moves as possible while avoiding the beasts lurking in the woods!

name: World Racing '95
short_description: Race like it's 1995! Classic arcade racing action with split-screen support, a single player story mode packed with 30 tough missions and a cross-country highway with branching routes makes this one of the meanest racers around.

name: Find The Cats - Memory
short_description: Beautifully crafted Memory board game which has engaged most of our childhood. Flip the tiles, match them, clear the board and try the next board with more tiles.

name: Crafting Idle Clicker
short_description: Craft a complex production line, earn idle cash and become an industrial tycoon!

name: Bunny Minesweeper
short_description: Multiplayer in Minesweeper? Yes! Play with your friends or random party in classic Minesweeper or try crazy challenging modes! Fun and hard simultaneously!

name: Mahjong Fest: Winterland
short_description: Go on a puzzle-solving Christmas holiday. Play classic mahjong solitaire game and build a Christmas town!

name: 苍夜
short_description: 整合了北方王国而崛起的国家鲁兹，其贤者终结战争并促成鲁兹为“和平守护国”的形势，而今突然战乱又起，贤者却失去踪迹，究竟又是谁在煽动？

name: Tactics & Strategy Master:Joan of Arc
short_description: This is a game of S·RPG, which tells the story of the of Jane .As the second work of crossing the series, there is a great leap forward compared with the previous one.You can play strategy, also can nurture your favorite roles.Everything depends on your decision!

name: Cowboy
short_description: This is a third person role-playing game，Players have swords, bows and arrows, and guns（You need to be on a horse to use it）,Players are free to explore the surrounding area,Players must maintain health，Players can kill nearby monsters or dodge attacks from monsters.

name: The Church in the Darkness ™
short_description: The Church in the Darkness is an action/stealth game where you infiltrate a religious cult and the story changes every time you play. It's 1977 and your nephew has moved deep into the South American jungle. Sneak into his commune, find out what's going on, and try to get the best ending you can.

name: Dr.Green
short_description: Dr.Green is a 2D retro, arcade, action platformer, inspired by games like Megaman and Ninja Senki. Take control of the orphan Dr.Green, on his mission to save the forest and take revenge on the evil forces trying to destroy it.

name: Die Young: Prologue
short_description: Die Young: Prologue narrates events that occurred a few hours before the main story of Die Young. You play as Nehir, a field agent on a mission to kill Brother No.1. The mission failed and now you have only one desperate attempt to reach the extraction point.

name: Crafty
short_description: After losing a fight with a humpback whale a band of pirates find themselves shipwrecked on an island. Play with 4-15 players online and attempt to repair your Pirate ship. Beware, Imposter Island is a game of social deception as one or more of your fellow pirates is not what they seem.

name: Layers
short_description: Layers is a puzzle platformer that has a unique twist. A level is made of up the 2 different layers which can interact with each other in certain ways. Use this interaction to solve the puzzles and get all the characters to the exit doors.

name: NASCAR Heat 4
short_description: NASCAR Heat 4 is the official video game of NASCAR. Looking and sounding better than ever with updated user interface, graphics and engine audio, race across 38 tracks in all three NASCAR National Series plus the fan-favorite Xtreme Dirt Tour.

name: Little Adventures
short_description: Little Adventures is a randomly generated Dungeon crawler, with heavy Rogue-like elements. Throughout the game players will find shops and upgrades which helps, to fight mysterious creatures throughout 5 randomly generated levels.

name: The Great Deer
short_description: The Great Deer is a point-n-click adventure game where you play as an intrepid explorer searching for an artefact of great value. Journey into an ancient and long forgotten temple, discover the secrets within, and uncover the dark truth behind a sinister ritual taking place within its walls.

name: Code Arcturus
short_description: Code Arcturus is a retro inspired arcade-style action platformer, with aliens, robots, spikes, explosions, and lots of coins. Blast your way through levels, compete for the fastest times on the leaderboards in Speedrun mode, or put your skills to the ultimate test in Nerfed mode

name: Skully Pinball
short_description: Skully Pinball is a game that reproduces the classic machines of the 90s in two different themes!

name: Hard Driver
short_description: Incredibly beautiful and dynamic Side-Scroller, where you control a car that flew into the air with a super-cool driver must Dodge obstacles, flying past clouds, shooting off flying debris and collecting various Goodies on the way home!

name: Escort Alia
short_description: Simple TPS. Escort your companion, Alia, to destination. It's a 3D version of the classic 2D maze. Alia thinks for herself and responds to enemies and follows the player.

name: Revenge: Rhobar's myth
short_description: A magical world full of witchcraft and wizardry awaits you!Join the worlds best wizard academy and embark on an exciting, mysterious journey. Learn 4 different and mighty spells to change the world around you, experience a breathtaking plot about the lost wizard Rhobar or challenge yourself in the freeroam mode!

name: Battle of Red Cliffs VR
short_description: 「Battle of Red Cliffs VR」 provides you with the chance to experience the great battle of Red Cliffs, one of the most historic battles from the Romance of the Three Kingdoms. Experience the novel gameplay features only available in VR.

name: Fur Up
short_description: Fur Up is a simple and sweet arcade score-chasing game. Constantly beat your previous score if you're playing alone, or survive the longest if you're playing against others.

name: Home Designer - Makeover Blast
short_description: Help your clients in this match3 game turn their drab living space into fantastic rooms! Solve matching puzzles to design and decorate the perfect home with beautiful furniture!

name: uFactory
short_description: uFactory is the ultimate in finely-tuned logistics challenges. Navigate the complexities of manufacturing processes inspired by real industrial methods.

name: S E V E R A N C E
short_description: Years after the Overflow, a catastrophe that plunged the city of Sci-Two into a decaying metropolis, a wayward smuggler stumbles into a plot surrounding the miracle drug Halcyon, veteran soldiers, and the corporation out to eradicate anyone too close to the truth, in a classic JRPG experience.

name: Who dies first
short_description: The darkest game in 2022 , depends not only on how dark it is, but also on how dark readers can imagine it. The goal of the game is not to kill dragons, but to control 'which character releases skills' and 'which character dies first' to obtain different game endings.

name: Zombie Killtime
short_description: Zombie Killtime is a fast-paced, action-packed, zombie platform shooter with 4 player coop gameplay. Survive against endless waves of zombies with your friends as you upgrade your guns and earn new ones.

name: Arauco Saga - Rpg Action
short_description: Arauco Saga is an action RPG, inspired by 2D classics for snes and megadrive.

name: Kingdom of Dinza
short_description: A top-down 2D, procedurally generated, open world fantasy RPG. Explore wild areas, forests and dungeons, fight monsters and craft superior weapons and armor as you uncover the mysteries and overcome the challenges of the Kingdom of Dinza!

name: RESEARCH and DESTROY
