short_description: Collect an intergalactic bounty of eccentric allies and deadly weapons, explore vibrant planets, and engage in risky turn-based battles to restore the Eyes of Chronos and save the galaxy in this strategic roguelike deckbuilder!

name: Sky in your eyes
short_description: Visual novel about the life in the post-soviet country. Cute artstyle, 10 animated CGs, 5 BGs and 5 chibi CGs in 4k, English voice-over for each heroine, animated live2d sprites, original OSTs and a dramatic story!

name: Obsidian Prince
short_description: Fight through dungeons in a tactical, turn-based roguelike where choices have real consequences. Recruit diverse heroes and steer them to their death... *ahem*... glory. Explore and rebuild the overworld to boost your heroes and discover hidden quests and new dungeons to master.

name: Gravity Vector
short_description: Gravity Vector is a challenging game where the player's main objective is to reach a target wormhole aboard a capsule, while facing different obstacles such as planets' gravitational pull, hostile entities, asteroids and more.

name: Car Mechanic Simulator 2015
short_description: New cars, new tools, new options, more parts and much more fun in the next version of Car Mechanic Simulator! Take your wrench! Create and expand your auto repairs service empire. Car Mechanic Simulator 2015 will take you behind the scenes of daily routine in car workshop.

name: The Interview
short_description: Adam Ridgewell is invited to a job interview, but things will get dark.

name: Sakura Angels
short_description: 日本語バージョンダウンロード開始されました。Two girls, blessed with magical powers, are faced with the task of saving the lonely protagonist from the clutches of a mysterious witch and ancient evil, sealed away long ago by his ancestors. What does this sorceress want from our protagonist?

name: Santa in search of toys
short_description: It's a nice 3D platformer with a side view. In it you have to play for Santa and collect a variety of toys to then put them under the Christmas tree in the house!

name: FAR: Changing Tides
short_description: An atmospheric vehicle adventure that follows the emotional journey of a boy and his ship as he embarks on a voyage to find a new home.

name: Quanect
short_description: The game has two realities, and in order to pass the level, you must move between them. Reality is not identical, objects and their position in different variations of the same room is different. You have to find a way out using these differences.

name: Bash the Teacher! - Classroom Clicker
short_description: It's time to show the teacher who is the real boss of the classroom in this hilarious idle-clicker game! Click away to blast the teacher with your chosen weapon - watch as the teacher’s frustration grows and discover their funny reactions!

name: Brass Brigade
short_description: Brass Brigade combines the aesthetic of Battlefield Heroes/Battlefield 1942 with highly customizable bot matches. Fight WWII's most iconic battles with as many bots as your PC can handle!

name: Draft Day Sports: College Football 2021
short_description: Draft Day Sports: College Football 2021 puts you in the role of head coach for your favorite college football team. Recruit, gameplan and make the right calls on the field to lead your team to the top of the ranks and the college football championship.

name: Shootball Arena
short_description: Shootball Arena is a fast paced online multiplayer game in which football and third person shooter merge together. Choose your avatar, hold your favorite gun and challenge your friends in exciting matches up to ten players. You need speed, agility and a perfect shot… do you have what it takes?

name: 伊始之战
short_description: The demon seal is about to be broken, and the world is in danger. Gather your teammates to find all the strength to break the seal tower and seal the demon again to save the world crisis. Adventure on the vast beginning continent, hiring, exploring, planting, alchemy and other games.

name: Shine's Adventures 5(World Of Box)
short_description: Girls came to a world of box. The robot NPC in here has an abnormality. We must sanction against these NPCs. In combat, players need to eliminate blocks to launch skills. You can combine blocks to get props and skills, or you can gain extra abilities through passive skills.

name: Rogue Legacy
short_description: Rogue Legacy is a genealogical rogue-'LITE' where anyone can be a hero. Each time you die, your child will succeed you. Every child is unique. One child might be colorblind, another might be a dward with have vertigo. But that's OK, because no one is perfect, and you don't have to be to succeed.

name: HoloBall
short_description: HoloBall plunges players into an action-sports arcade arena inspired by one of the most iconic games of all time. Use your paddles to hit, smash and curve the HoloBall past your opponent to score. Learn and master skillshots to outmatch your increasingly difficult opponents.

name: BangBang PewPew
short_description: Finally, modern lightguns have become available for the PC that bring back the classic feeling of aiming down the sights. It’s time for the games to catch up! 25 lightgun challenges. Turn-based multiplayer. Online challenges and leaderboards. Customizable targets.

name: Flank That Tank!
short_description: Twin Stick Shooter where everything breaks!Smash through walls, punch through obstacles, every thing is possible in the game with procedural destruction.In 22 fun-packed levels, you crash through anything to mop up all opponents.

name: The Surreal Imaginarium
short_description: Enter 'The Surreal Imaginarium', a virtual gallery full of other-worldy interactive paintings waiting for you to unlock their secrets.

name: Three Twenty One
short_description: 3:21 is divided into smaller adventure games that open a dialog with the player and encourage interaction and exploration. Through the player's interactions with these that serve as a timeline of events, they discover what 3:21 is really about and just how real games can get.

name: Steel Fury Kharkov 1942
short_description: Steel Fury: Kharkov 1942 is based on real-life events that took place from May 12 to 28, 1942. During a vicious German counterattack three Soviet Armies were surrounded and were forced to fighting in what has become known as the “meat grinder.”

name: Jar Battlers
short_description: Jar Battlers located in a toriyama-ish retro style pixelated world, where you have to get rid of your opponents using jars, bombs and more, in the numerous arenas of this crazy tournament!!

name: Run For Rum
short_description: Help Short Legs Bill find his rum!

name: Waifu's Spooky Space Station
short_description: The WSS space station was once one of humanity's best-known academy for idols and super stars . But nowadays it is just a place where myths and spooky stories are made. Can you survive its hundreds of rooms and and uncover the mysteries of the WSS?

name: Second Warfare
short_description: You have to become a soldier of troop rapid reaction forces, which are the elite special forces. You can send to perform combat operations anywhere in the world. Using different types of weapons, equipment, you can accomplish combat missions, and lead your team to victory over the enemy.

name: A Cheesy Game
short_description: NEW SPOOKY CHALLENGE AVAILABLE! A back-to-the-roots platformer that strives to be easy to understand, yet difficult to master. The game’s best features are its physics, level creator and of course – its endless supply of puns.

name: The Fog: Trap for Moths
short_description: Play The Fog, a captivating hidden object game with more than a few surprises lurking along its misty paths. You'll search for useful items, solve cleverly designed puzzles, and play mini-games unlike any you have encountered.

name: A Ton Of Feathers
short_description: Hunt for the truth in the most intense VR game ever made.

name: 去三国找大哥
short_description: 游戏目标是通过招募英雄大哥提升战力，然后征战关卡，提升大哥的战力。没有繁琐的操作，每天进游戏点宝箱领取奖励，提升大哥挂机即可

short_description: 'FAUCET VR' is a VR game based on the popular casual mobile game for healing 'FAUCET'. Enjoy dabbling in a fantastic virtual space popping falling drops from faucet.

name: Match Three Pirates II
short_description: Enjoy the great Match 3 Pirate Adventure. Form groups of three or more crabs, canons, steering wheels, explosives and other pirate items to unlock powerful boosters and complete all level goals. Use the right strategy, earn coins and build your own great theme park on Pirate Island.

name: Wardroid
short_description: Following the steps of the 'No.0 Wardroid', named Jona, and experience the escape from dangerous research facility, joining the organization against extremism, completing various tasks and finally proving herself on the battlefield.

name: Need for Speed™ Heat
short_description: Hustle by day and risk it all at night in Need for Speed™ Heat Deluxe Edition, a white-knuckle street racer, where the lines of the law fade as the sun starts to set.

name: Cricket Captain 2014
short_description: Cricket Captain is back for the 2014 season, with a beautiful new interface, updated 3D graphics engine, and all the attention to detail that you expect. Cricket Captain has been hailed as the best cricket management simulation every created, and with one of the most exciting cricket seasons for a decade in prospect, it’s about time you...

name: Lil' Horror Stories: The Camp Fire
short_description: You got a voucher for a free camping trip, sponsored by The Bank!! YAY!! Time to enjoy the nice outdoors... Good thing boogeymen and monsters don't exist... Heh... Do they?... Collect 12 logs to get through the night...Camp fires are safe... Crouch to be silent...Your Flashlight attracts them...

name: Crazy Christmas
short_description: You are Ethan! a former felony convicted who needs to deliver the cargo in time for christmas eve. Drive through the city with no morale but beware, The cops are hunting you! Good Luck!

name: Bouncing Odyssey
short_description: A bizarre hand-drawn (on paper with pencil ;) ) logic puzzle game. With Bouncing Odyssey, you'll experience 76 unique and challenging levels in three different worlds with four different physics based mechanics.

name: King of the Couch: Zoovival
short_description: Real-time natural selection! Who will survive, a bear with a cheese or a shark with a shotgun? King of the Couch: Zoovival is the latest evolution of the platform battle arena game genre! Fight as an animal, with a wide assortment of weapons, on multiple unique battle arenas in King of the Couch: Zoovival.

name: Zombie Killer Drift - Racing Survival
short_description: Welcome in the fantastic open world of Zombie Killer Drift - Racing Survival. The zombie tsunami is already here! Zombies roam the country and there is almost no escape.

name: Cybermere
short_description: Cybermere is a sci-fi hacking game. Use warez to penetrate ICE, mine for password fragments and break into database of various companies. You play as Lance, a novice hacker in 2033.

name: 审判者 高清重制全章节版
short_description: 'The Adjudicator' is an interactive video product deduced by real people. It uses the method of film + interactive gameplay to promote the development of the plot. The trend of the plot will be determined by you.

name: Lucky Tlhalerwa's Cybernetic Titan
short_description: First-Person Action Round-Survival Shooter, The IMS Cybernetic Titan Duo: SGT Kozack And CPL Sebastian Have To Survive Guerilla Warfare Attacks Of The Global Terrorism ConFederation Sent By High Ranking GTC officer MAJOR Nickolai Patrikov Who Wants To Kill Them For Sabotaging Protocol 87.

name: The Dweller
short_description: The Dweller is a puzzle game where you play as the MONSTER! It's time to get rid of all those pesky archaeologists snooping around in your lair. SCARE them, CRUSH them, DEVOUR them! ELIMINATE THE INTRUDERS!

name: DiRT Rally 2.0
short_description: DiRT Rally 2.0 dares you to carve your way through a selection of iconic rally locations from across the globe, in the most powerful off-road vehicles ever made, knowing that the smallest mistake could end your stage.

name: Ashley Clark: Secret of the Ruby
short_description: Detective Ashley Clark is puzzled by a series of mysterious kidnappings. The only connection between these unusual disappearances is a ruby pendant. Could someone be using this sparkling ornament to send a clandestine message, or could this be the handiwork of an underground cult?

name: Pro Rugby Manager 2015
short_description: Take the lead of your favourite rugby union team.Pro Rugby Manager 2015 covers all aspects of the challenges of a real rugby union manager: guarantee sporting success on the field and financial success off it and be the next Champion!

name: Happy Empire
short_description: Help the princess overcome difficulties, banish the evil wizard and restore the empire!

name: Connected Hearts: The Full Moon Curse Collector's Edition

short_description: This is highly difficult horror game. Please find one key, and playing. Don't be afraid , please be brave. Finally, hope you bravely a live

name: Evening Starter
short_description: A classic dungeon crawler RPG. When Ren Nosogi gets caught up in an incident that puts her in massive debt, she must use her skills as a Sweeper to take down an evil cult in order to pay it off.

name: Project Entertainment System
short_description: Play as the Grim Reaper in an FPS that draws huge inspiration from Retro FPS mechanics. You'll fight your way through the levels funded by the souls of your enemies where one bullet could be the difference between a well deserved victory or a broken 'R' key.

name: CatDog Puzzle

short_description: Infinite puzzles and Infinite levels, the typical infinite challenges of attracting, engaging users and comfortable music, try this magical puzzle game what educational effect it!

name: VehiCraft
short_description: This is a vehicle sandbox crafting game that you can build different ground vehicles to fight other vehicles. This game gives the maximum freedom for object placement and customisation for your vehicle.

name: Dead Space™ 3
short_description: Journey across space to the icy planet of Tau Volantis with Isaac Clarke and Sgt. John Carver to discover and destroy the source of the Necromorph outbreak.

name: Simona's Requiem
short_description: Simona's Requiem is a retro-styled platformer Inspired by old action-adventure games but with a modern touch. Pick up the scythe as Simona and slash your way to the Fisher King who has hidden behind the moon.

name: TrinityS
short_description: TrinityS condenses the thrilling elements of MMO RPG endgame encounters into a white-knuckle, 'Boss Rush' cooperative online action game for up to three players. Skip the MMO level grind and face off against fearsome foes that require precise coordination to defeat!

name: Princess Defender Episode 1
short_description: Several realms being attacked by monsters, and you don't know what to do, just fight

name: Faraday Protocol
short_description: Faraday Protocol is a first person puzzle game that will test your wits and intelligence. Use the Bia-Tool, an ancient pistol-like relic of an alien civilization, to solve puzzles by bending energy and manipulating enigmatic machinery.

name: Super Indie Karts

The game was KickStarted late in 2014 and is aimed for completion in 202x. You don't have to wait until completion though as you can join in now with Early Access!

name: VR Jurassic Escape
short_description: Welcome to the Dinosaur Island. There are thousands of various dinosaurs living in this beautiful and mysterious island. There are Tyrannosaurus that dominates the land, the pterosaurs flying in the sky, and the triceratops, stegosaurus and so on.

name: Papertris

name: PuppetShow™: Destiny Undone Collector's Edition

name: A-Train: All Aboard! Tourism

name: Reigning Cats
short_description: A new twist to a tower defense game, that will challenge your strategy and test your love for cats as you feed them and clean their litter box.

name: Elliot
short_description: Elliot is a colourful 2D platformer inspired by 16-bit classics, with a touch of hardcore. Don't be misled by appearances: it's a colorful game, but really it's technicolor hell!

name: The Endless White

name: Spock in the Dama Kingdom
short_description: Discover the Dama Kingdom in Spock, a great fantasy adventure game !

name: Shining Song Starnova
short_description: Take the stage in Shining Song Starnova!

name: Brutal Warrior

name: Aesthetic Melody
short_description: Sit back and enjoy 30 minutes of original electronic and vaporwave music in this challenging platformer, push forward to unlock Time Trial mode and a second playable character who completely changes the gameplay.

name: City Siege: Faction Island
short_description: The ultimate 2D Physics War Game - War just got fun, build your army with tanks, guns, spies, flame tanks and helicopters. Then embark on battles of mass destruction and tactical rescues. Bring peace to faction island by destroying all your enemies!

name: Maverta
short_description: Minimalist, relaxing, motion logic, interactive mind game.

name: Tap Tap Builder
short_description: Build the city of your dream! Tap to build the city, hire workers, earn money and become the greatest boss. But don't forget to deal with fires, crimes and unemployment. Let's start working right now, tap-tap the DOWNLOAD button!

name: The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante — Chapter 1&2
short_description: A narrative-driven hardcore RPG set in a gritty world where the gods are real. Set out on a challenging lifetime journey, where every choice you make has a price to pay and consequence to it. Will you become an inquisitor, a judge, or conspire against the old order? Dare to decide!

name: The Strike
short_description: The Strike puts the fishing rod in players’ hands as they head out to their favorite hot spots, including several popular lakes in North America. By combining high-quality, realistic game play, The Strike is quite the catch for gamers and outdoor enthusiasts alike.

name: Fierce Tales: Marcus' Memory Collector's Edition
short_description: Solve the mystery of a seaside town as you uncover your lost memories.

name: Frigore
short_description: An indie survival horror game. Simple gameplay, beautiful graphics and a cold and chilling atmosphere.

name: Kommissar

name: MMA Team Manager

name: Attack of the Giant Crab
short_description: Take control of the Giant Crab and cause the maximum amount of destruction while brushing off the military's puny attempts to stop you.

name: 夜雪冰娇

name: Police Stories
short_description: A fresh take on top-down shooters with an emphasis on tactics that forces you to make split second decisions. Neutralize criminals, rescue civilians and defuse bombs in Single Player mode or Co-op. And remember - shooting first is not an option!

name: ArcheAge: Unchained
short_description: ArcheAge: Unchained removes the barrier between you and the ultimate MMO experience.

name: Reboant Demo

short_description: A musician is a game that can generate animated music, and you can freely import the MIDI orbit in the game. Play the favorite music and write the music that belongs to your own step by step.

name: MECHBLAZE
short_description: An inferno roars over a destroyed secret military base. Then, from the flaming rubble...an invincible super robot is reborn! Mechs born of advanced science and modern weaponry battle in heavy weight Run 'n Gun mech shooter!!

name: Flesh Eaters
short_description: Flesh Eaters is retro style single player RTS zombie survival game with resource gathering and crafting. Zombies are everywhere! You must gather resources to build barricades, upgrade weapons and armour and explore the city under the siege of the dead

name: Quiet Thoughts

name: Sword Art Online: Lost Song
short_description: Enter the VRMMO world of the much-loved anime SWORD ART ONLINE! In Alfheim Online, a world of fairies and magic, you become the hero of the series, Kirito, and together with your wondrous friends try to conquer the floating land of Svart Alfheim.

name: The Adventures of Spunk Dodgers and Splat
short_description: Spunk Dodgers and his sidekick Splat are ambushed by a group of space pirates and crash land on a mysterious asteroid! As Splat, dodge wacky space monsters through hazardous terrain on your adventure to help Spunk Dodgers fix your ship!

name: HEVN
short_description: A desperate celestial mining engineer races against a vengeful hacker to save his friend, the only one who knows the way home. Survive the harsh conditions of a world riddled in conflict and uncover deep secrets best left buried light-years from Earth.

name: Horror Ville Maze Escape
short_description: Horror Maze Game

short_description: Haruto, along with Sengoku, Ukawa, and the other members of the first Phantom Triggers go to visit the grave of their old friend, and the memories of the life of Aoi - a young woman so vicious, and yet so pure - return once more. What events led to Aoi's final moments?

name: Power & Revolution 2020 Edition
short_description: The new version of Geopolitical Simulator 4, the ultrarealistic simulator of today's world where you play as the head of state or as the opposition! Stop the spread of the Covid-19 pandemic and restart the economy, participate in the US elections or engage in lightning wars with new 2020 scenarios.

name: E06-Anomaly
short_description: Discover together with Expedition Unit 06 new worlds. Solve the mystries of ancient civilizations and fight with his energy bow for survival.

name: Pushover
short_description: G.I.Ant is extremely clever, and highly trained in tactical maneuvers. What's more, he is extraordinarily strong, and super smart. His latest mission is to gain access to the crazy world of Captain Rat's Treasure Caves. Straight forward, huh?...... NOT!

name: Exodus Borealis

name: Devil's Deck
short_description: It is a Roguelike card game which owns interesting honeycomb and original combat rules. Whether adventures or combats, have rich variety of options.

Will Goo succeed? Puzzles, deadly traps and an army of foes in a labyrinthine underwater lab block his way.

name: President Trump The Way In Uganda

name: Laser Paddles

name: And I Must Scream
short_description: And I Must Scream is an experience horror game that takes the player through a journey of kid's imagination of how he perceives the world around him. Control Max as he navigates the literal and metaphorical landscapes of trauma on his search for strength and acceptance.

name: Starship Disco

name: Miasma: Citizens of Free Thought
short_description: Turn-based tactics in a dystopian future

name: 女巫与六便士 the sibyl and sixpence
short_description: It's a 15-minute experimental visual novel about a love affair as weak as tea. Story consists of two chapters, formed by a mixture of four clues. It tells a love story about the sibyl and the prince.

short_description: An Arcade Classic. This is the sequel to the classic brick-breaker game. You are the hero, Blippy, the paddle, that has to save planet Earth from a new threat. Over 40 Brand New Challenging Levels to Complete. See the brand new cutscenes at the end if you can complete the game!

short_description: Quick Trivia is a small multiplayer guessing game — with questions related to gaming.

name: NeoCube
short_description: Neocube is the puzzle game in which you try to find a way to pass a number of test chambers by using the unique features of a cube.

short_description: Scavengers from all over the galaxy have come to a dead Earth to loot the remains of the technology that can found in underground tunnels. name: Absent

short_description: Fadia, a young and courageous boy sets about protecting ‘Naria’, his home village, from the Khazdaks who are trying to pollute their river.

short_description: Rememoried is an independent video game, a virtual place where memories change to dreams and the only possible way is forgetting, which becomes a mechanism for proceeding to the next layer of dreams. The Surrealist explorative first-person adventure game.

short_description: Spaceforce Homeworld, missile hell of epic proportions, with PowerUps and Reinforcement Calls will bring back the nostalgia of classic retro arcade shooter games. For hundreds of years humans have searched for an answer to the eternal question: Are we alone in the universe? Get armed, kill the enemy.

name: RetroFighter VR
short_description: The ‘80s meets 21st century’s VR.RetroFighterVR brings the neon arcade style of the '80s into the VR. Feel the nostalgia of classic games on the latest gaming devices. Move your head to avoid obstacles and shoot a wide range of enemies with missiles.

name: Loco Dojo

name: Biodigital

name: Bouncy Cat
short_description: Bounce across platforms to obtain fish

name: I'm a cowboy: Western Shooter
short_description: I'm a cowboy: Western Shooter is a top-down shooter. Kill your enemies, complete missions and learn the story of the main character.

name: Witch's Tales
short_description: An evil Witch turned the famous Prince into a frog! Help poor Prince remove his curse and find his lovely Princess.

short_description: Can the game be a symbol of the life? Friends help, doors stop our movement, we must think and resolve difficulties. Is it a game or life?

name: Raptor: Call of The Shadows - 2015 Edition

More importantly, Saki must use her wits if she is to survive against an unspeakable evil hellbent on avenging unrequited love.

name: Knotwords
short_description: Knotwords is a minimal and elegant logic puzzle — with words. Arrange each section so every word across and down is valid. It may look difficult at first, but you'll be surprised at how quickly you pick it up! This is the kind of game I've been trying to design my whole career — I hope you like it

name: The Snow Fable: Mystery of the Flame
short_description: Embark on a match-three adventure of breathtaking magic and boundless imagination! A girl embarks on a quest to save her fiery friend. But with each step forward, she draws closer to an encounter with a dark force she could not have conceived!

name: SimpleRockets
short_description: I am excited to release my first game on Steam! SimpleRockets was released in 2013 for mobile and I've put a ton of work into it to get it ready for PC and Mac. It was inspired by KSP, and it offers a simpler 2D experience for building rockets and exploring space with realistic orbital mechanics.

name: Dirge
short_description: Fight paranormal monsters roaming a haunted house with up to four friends. One player can take on the monster role to hunt the investigators. To win the game, you must survive long enough to accomplish all of the tasks to defeat the monsters. Run, hide, or fight... the choice is yours.

name: 100 Pumpkins
short_description: Can you find all 100 pumpkins in this interconnected world? If you do, you will be rewarded based on how many lives you had to use!

name: The Sword and the Slime
short_description: The Sword and the Slime is a unique take on the 2D puzzle-platformer where you play as a flying sword and find an unlikely ally in a slime. Using only the mouse, protect and guide your companion through a dangerous dungeon full of nasty monsters and cruel traps.

name: Backstreets of the Mind
short_description: Sometimes we think that if we could change something from our past, our whole life would turn out differently.

short_description: The light of the world fades. Evil hearts seek the Power of the Elements - the forces which bind the universe together - thus threatening all of existence. An homage to the 8-BIT era with a charming art style.

name: Loneliness
short_description: An experimental, minimalistic microgame about loneliness. Originally released as a Flash game in 2010 that was featured by Extra Credits.

name: Sid Classic
short_description: Sid! Powerful souls were born here as beautiful women or boys. Then, they protect the Time and Space engine here. You can see a school fantasy that transcends time and space in a parallel world.

name: KeyWe

name: AI Drone Simulator

name: There is No Stairs

But he wasn't frustrated. Now he is designing an unprecedented new invention, dreaming of a world without rocket jumps... It's the stairs.
