short_description: You are the captain of a starship venturing through a massive open universe. Customize your crew and take command at the helm of your very own ship as you explore a galaxy torn apart by internal strife, alien threats, and political intrigue.

name: The Pest
short_description: Solve challenging puzzles and avoid dangerous traps of the computer defence system in this puzzle-platformer game about a tiny optimistic computer pest heading to the System's Core. Will he plunge our world into chaos, or will he have mercy? It's up to you.

name: One Giant Leap
short_description: Fly across the moon in VR with a motion-controlled jetpack

name: HELLO PLAYER
short_description: A little nice adventure spoiled by bloggers! Help me reach them and make them my friends by using various mechanics of movement! Also game absolutely doesn't have the fourth wall!

name: Cute Cats 2
short_description: Cute kittens are back in action! These fluffy fellas would train your memory and attention. Spend your time with pleasure and benefit. Compare pictures with cute kittens and find differences between them.

name: The Demon Crystal
short_description: The Demon Crystal, produced in 1984 by YMCAT, achieved great success as the pioneer of the action RPG genre and became a nation-wide hit. The first game in a trilogy, it is known as a 'legendary game.'

name: Sidequest
short_description: Once up a time in a world far far away, there lived a group of heroes bound together by fate, chosen to battle dark forces, on an epic adventure. THIS IS NOT THAT STORY Join, magog, Faiza, Arcturus, and Laira, on a journey the likes of which, has admittedly been seen many times.

name: Lockdown Hero
short_description: The perfect video game to play during Lockdown!

name: Community Inc
short_description: As a new Manager, build a happy community and trade with other races... for profit. Yes, that's right, we need their happiness so we can power up our portals. The Lings, your workers, will obey you and help you with your village. But beware, they can cause a lot of problems too.

name: CHRONO TRIGGER®
short_description: The timeless RPG classic returns loaded with upgrades! Journey to the forgotten past, to the far future, and to the end of time. A big adventure to save the planet, now begins…

name: MOTHERED - A ROLE-PLAYING HORROR GAME
short_description: An immersive first-person horror adventure where you play the role of LIANA - a young girl who arrives home after major surgery and is met with a strange mannequin claiming to be her mother.

name: Minebot expedition
short_description: Minebot expedition - Minebot is going on a new expedition! He won't miss any of the precious minerals wielded by the dangerous robo bees on their way in this offbeat platformer!

name: Fun Hospital
short_description: Build your own theme hospital! Here, you might meet patients with a lot of hair, or no hair; strange aliens, evil guy, super hero…

name: 家园（Home Land）
short_description: Running into the realm that once destroyed your homeland is mysterious and dangerous, but you can only get real redemption if you have revenge in your eyes, survive and kill them out!

name: S0
short_description: Test your action and mathematics skills in this top-down shooter designed to give you an educational experience unlike any you've had before.

name: Hard Night VR
short_description: Post-apocalyptic zombie shooter. Survive.

name: Maze Quest 1: The Forest
short_description: Maze Quest 1: The Forest is a simple relaxing puzzle game. Play as Sylvie the Elf and find your way home through 100 forest-themed maze levels.

name: Zombie VS Police
short_description: Zombie VS Police is an incredibly addictive third-person shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world infested with zombies. In this game you have to play as a police officer who fights zombies and protects his hometown!

name: Neon Beat Rider
short_description: Ride the beats with Neon Beat Rider, a neon-fueled rhythm game with a multi-path story and procedurally generated tracks!

name: Dominium Mundi
short_description: Dominium Mundi is a lightweight 4X strategy game set in the medieval period where 4 players compete to create the most influential empire. Expand your empire over the map, convert more people to your religion, and control more trade routes.

name: Submerged: VR Escape the Room
short_description: Trapped inside a room filling with water, you will decipher secrets and tools to aid your escape. Hold your breath and dive for answers within a submarine deep below the ocean.

name: Milk and Cookies
short_description: An adorable physics puzzle game about reuniting Milk and Cookies!

name: LightStrike
short_description: Welcome to the LightStrike VR Arena, where you face challengers that are out to destroy you before you can destroy them. Players stand on floating Game Pad areas floating high above the future world surface.

name: The Office Quest
short_description: Every day in the office is the same, clicking the same keys, attending the same boring meetings, wearing the same fluffy monster onesies, until something strange and magical happens. Now you need to sneak away, no matter how!

name: RhythmSlinger
short_description: Shoot with style to YOUR songs! RhythmSlinger is a kinetic trick-based VR rhythm shooter that generates fast-paced levels from .mp3 file

name: Stonewall Penitentiary
short_description: 7 Suspects. 1 Killer. Stonewall Penitentiary is an indie murder mystery adventure that is presented in the visual style of graphic novels. Discover why you and six others were kidnapped by an unknown captor as you search an eerie prison and solve mind-bending puzzles to determine 'whodunit'!

name: Chalo Chalo
short_description: Really slow racing for 3 to 8 players.

name: Noel's Hope
short_description: If you are interested in magic, dark and dangerous dungeons with traps and enemies, unusual islands, bright weather conditions, mysteries, stories, sea voyages on your own ship, hiding deep secrets through the ocean, then this adventure is for you!

name: Press Ctrl
short_description: A mind-bending puzzler where your avatar controls another avatar via an in-game keyboard.

name: Traveler
short_description: Traveler is a thrilling, winner-takes-all PvP(with limited vE) first person shooter. Compete against fellow players to reach high-tier loot spots and be wary of invasions by 'The Management' as they attempt to find and take down Travelers.

name: 100 nya
short_description: The game develops logical thinking. Taught to think through the moves in advance.

name: Qual
short_description: Qual is a fast paced top-down bullet hell that emphasizes on spell combinations.

name: Thumb-Thump
short_description: TT is for your THUMBS When a scene begins, a song will be played. If YOU can match the right keys at the right moment, your SKILL improves and the flowers turn green.

name: Farlife
short_description: SPACE! What life is out there? Perhaps some little green men that are absolutely gun nut crazy! Shoot, Loot, and have a hell of a Hoot, Explore open worlds, Discover alien life, upgrade your arsenal, and fumble your way through the cosmos.

name: Crisis VRigade
short_description: Crisis VRigade is a virtual reality action filled first person shooter that lets players take on the role of a SWAT trooper and deal with terrorist situations. Play solo or team with your friends with the coop multiplayer mode.

name: Juicy Memory Card
short_description: Simple and at the same time incredibly difficult game with finding pairs! It sounds easy, but you will plunge into a world where memory, concentration, attention and speed of thinking rule. Develop your memory and reaction, discover new levels and beautiful art that rewards your efforts.

name: Museum Of Extravagance
short_description: A surrealist experience in a strange museum

name: Hextones
short_description: Connect the Hextones by color or symbol and jump light-years in the Spacetime to be the great cosmic explorer. A challenging matchup puzzle game with a sci-fi mood.

name: AI＊Shoujo/AI＊少女
short_description: Ever wanted to get away from it all? Well here's your chance! In AI Shoujo, a tropical island paradise filled with beautiful girls is waiting for you! Customize NPCs with a rich suite of character creation tools, then watch as they think, learn, and love. Kick back, relax, and enjoy life in the sun!

name: FAR: Lone Sails
short_description: Traverse a dried-out seabed littered with the remains of a decaying civilization. Keep your unique vessel going, overcome numerous obstacles and withstand the hazardous weather conditions. How far can you make it? What will you find?

name: Nonogram - The Greatest Painter
short_description: Do you deserve to be called The Greatest?

name: Scott in Space
short_description: Scott in Space is a stylizied action platformer about the epic adventure of a lone guinea pig in space. Prove your guinea pig platformer skills and defeat the evil Rhino Empire!

name: I Am Your President: Prologue
short_description: I Am Your President: Prologue is a free narrative strategy simulator. Play as the previous US president, decide the fate of the world and run the country any way you like! Enjoy the unique storyline, make choices and carve your path to victory. Election Day is coming – can you secure your victory?

name: The Serpent Rogue
short_description: The Serpent Rogue is a botanical action-adventure game set in a medieval fantasy world. Master the art of alchemy, explore forgotten lands, tame wild beasts and protect the realm from impending disaster. You will craft, brew, boil, & concoct potions all in your stead to defeat an ominous danger!

name: VERSUS: The Lost Ones
short_description: Steal alien powers and absorb their memories! Can you outlast your opponents to escape from planet Versus? An epic adventure in a new galaxy.

name: The Hotel
short_description: The Hotel is a psychological horror thriller in which the player will have to face the evil living within the walls of a lonely hotel. But more importantly, the player will have to decide what this evil is to him. Maybe the nature of this evil is deeper than it seems at first glance.

name: Discs of Steel Party
short_description: Retro gaming multiplayer party insanity !Play against up to 6 friends and/or AI opponents in 3 completely different game modes.

name: TENS!
short_description: Combining sudoku-style number puzzles and block-dropping gameplay, the aim of TENS! is simple: place dice on the board, make ‘tens’ in any row or column and clear the board to win.

name: Yokai's Secret
short_description: 'Yokai's secret' is a decrypt game with ecchi girls. The 'Country of Yamato' once had cherry blossoms, and Yokai lived in peace with human beings. One day, the Yokai suddenly began to riot. In order to heal the world, you, as the 'Master Hentai', embarked on the journey.

name: Royal Frontier
short_description: Create your party of heroes and cross the dangerous frontier! Protect the caravan, fight bandits, get gold, rewards, and experience to survive another day.

name: LiMiT's Escape Room Games
short_description: Try to solve the puzzles of the 2 levels (apartment and office) alone or with your friends to escape from the rooms. Both levels are designed for 1 to 1.5 hours of play each. Can you beat this time?

name: Ironguard
short_description: Ironguard is a fast-paced roguelite shooter with procedurally generated levels and a wide array of unique weapons and items

name: Viki Spotter: The Farm
short_description: Welcome to a brand new colorful puzzle featuring a lot of pictures in pairs, between which you will have to find all the differences.

name: 2064: Read Only Memories
short_description: 2064: Read Only Memories is a cyberpunk thriller that explores the social challenges of tomorrow through classic adventure gaming. A journalist-turned-detective teams up with Turing, the world’s first sapient machine, to unmask a conspiracy that will shake the foundations of Neo-San Francisco.

name: PuppetShow™: Mystery of Joyville
short_description: Uncover dark secrets, find hidden clues, and solve nefarious puzzles, in PuppetShow: Mystery of Joyville.

name: Car Car Crash Hands On Edition
short_description: Car Car Crash invites you to play with toy cars like you always imagined. Peak around the corners of building as the cars zip by on the streets of the miniature towns and cities! Stand tall to get a birds eye view to see it all!

name: Bad Government
short_description: Buy this product and instantly get access to the decision-making handheld device of the president of a faraway land, in a far away, alternative universe. With access to this device, get ready to make decisions in the president's place.

name: Shattered Throne
short_description: Shattered Throne is a turn based fantasy strategy game that will challenge your skills as a general. No luck to blame, only your ability to master the unique units and leaders to exploit the combo system will decide if you are victorious.

name: Bitcoin Tycoon - Mining Simulation Game
short_description: Play as a new person who just get touched with the Virtual Currency area by starting mining in early 2014. Dig enough coins and expand your business, virtual currency exchange and complete trusts. Become the king of the whole bitcoin empire.

name: Giraffe Town
short_description: A giraffe born with slippery feet sets out to find love...

name: Bulk Dominoes VR: Kinetic Rush
short_description: Build and create domino chain reactions, knock them down, then push 1 button to set them back up again. It’s fun and easy! Plus you will not have to worry about accidentally knocking them down while you're building.

name: Faded Stories: Greenberg
short_description: Here in the city of Greenberg time is meaningless, and space is infinite. The city has endless history and yet... The whole place is fading away.

name: OVERTURN
short_description: You’ve found yourself inside a futuristic laboratory with no memory of who you are or how you got there. You begin to wonder - are there others like me?Find your way out of the confines of the laboratory and unravel the story to understand what’s going on.

name: Slime Fantasy: the search for the lost sword
short_description: The slime hero lost his holy sword. Without it, he is just an ordinary slime. Now, he will go on a journey to find his lost sword, and return to defend the slime kingdon.

name: Danger Room
short_description: Survive the holographic barrage of turrets in the Danger Room on the HTC Vive. Slow time, dodge lasers, suck bullets and fire them back at enemies!

name: Doomsday Vault
short_description: Rescue Earth’s precious plant life. In your robotic suit navigate a flooded city, break into an underground lair, explore ancient pyramids. Collect seeds and return them to the safety of the Vault. Nurture seeds to grow new sustainable crops. Unlock additional tools and items to customise your suit.

name: BAO
short_description: BAO is a brilliant mancala type boardgame from East Africa (Kenya, Tanzania). Like Chess and Go, Bao leaves nothing to chance. 100% strategy = 200% fun. Think many turns ahead and you will become a true BAO master!

name: Counter Fight 3
short_description: Counter Fight is never dead! “Counter Fight 3” is a work simulation game where the player becomes a chef of a pizza store and provides meals to unique customers who appear one after another.

name: FOOTBALLER
short_description: Plunge into the wonderful world of football together with millions of players from all over the world. Create and upgrade your character. Play online with friends in 1vs1, 2vs2, 3vs3, 4vs4 matches where every player is a real player. Find your comrades in our discord server and see you on the field!

name: RPG: Squad battle
short_description: Control 3 members super hero team, finish different missions and destroy evil bosses at different enviroments

name: CHARIOT WARS
short_description: CHARIOT WARS is a high quality story-led arcade racing game set in Ancient Rome with both singleplayer and multiplayer game modes.

name: FIRE  TRUMP - Air Combat VR
short_description: President Thump of Country A always provokes disputes between countries in the world, making people of all countries uneasy. In order to defend the peace of the world, let us fly fighter jets to war against this selfish politician!

name: A Duel Hand Disaster: Trackher
short_description: The only split-screen single player twin stick risk 'em up in which your score is meaningless unless you exist. If you do not extract you do not keep your score. Playing 'til death is not an option. Don't lose sight of your mission. Trackher.

name: Make the Burger
short_description: Make burgers with assorted ingredients, memorize orders and be quick before time runs out. Make your customers happy by eating delicious hamburgers, but remember, nobody likes to get wrong orders.

name: Houdini Redux
short_description: Houdini Redux is an easy to learn typing party game in which two players fight each other to gather the title of 'Grand Magus'. Different real mages to choose and to master.

name: The Enthralling Realms: The Blacksmith's Revenge
short_description: A challenging fantasy match-3 game! Help the Blacksmiths daughter Ara to avenge her village and defeat a vicious dragon.

name: GreedFall
short_description: Engage in a core roleplaying experience, and forge the destiny of a new world seeping with magic, and filled with riches, lost secrets, and fantastic creatures. With diplomacy, deception and force, become part of a living, evolving world - influence its course and shape your story.

name: One Strike
short_description: One Strike is a 2d fighting game with fast and furious gameplay, memorable characters, and a retro pixelart aesthetic! Choose between one of six unique fighters, travel to medieval Japan’s beautiful pixelated landscapes and fight to become the greatest warrior in history.

name: Wolfstride
short_description: Get wrecked in this immature grown-up RPG about a trio of troublemakers stumbling their way through a giant mecha tournament. Repair and upgrade the team’s hand-me-down rig, pick up odd jobs to pay the bills, and battle the best-of-the-best all while running from the regrettable choices of the past.

name: DoVille
short_description: Three Episodes now included! If you're looking for an adventure, look no further than DoVille VR! Whether you want to sleuth-cation on Juniper Beach, rescue Bigfoot Mountain from destruction, or time travel to Dino Gulch , there's something for everyone in DoVille VR.

name: Housekeeping VR
short_description: Housekeeping VR is a physics-based action game with a 70s futurist style for the Vive and Rift. It's a race against the clock as you completely destroy luxurious apartments in an attempt to make as much money as you can, and buy the biggest arsenal of tools to do the job!

name: NIGHTSTAR
short_description: This VR title is a unique room-scale third-person shooter. Control the Nightstar by moving your Motion Controller in space, shooting a vast variety of enemies, and avoiding obstacles and enemy fire. Play through 8 levels of non-stop action and immortalize your name on the global leaderboard!

name: Di[c]E
short_description: Di[c]E is a 3D survival game where your only weapons are dice. Manage to craft equipments to gain power and defeat hostile forces. Discover the secrets of a mysterious island and how to escape.

name: Defense the Farm
short_description: Short story of the farmer Bob. As on a sunny day,at his beloved farm began to arrive alive deads. As on this day, he seriously took up the defense of his territory. Defend the farm, destroy the incoming waves of amusing zombies using dexterity, tactics, and three types of weapons (pistol, rifle, automatic rifle).

name: Volcano Tower
short_description: Climb the infinite volcano tower and fight your way through the dangers within!

name: Shooty Squad
short_description: Shooty Squad is a fast paced, competitive multiplayer first person shooter with hilarious graphics and ragdoll physics. With weapons and maps focused on being as balanced and competitive as possible ! Also has offline Zombie mode.

name: World's End Club
short_description: Twelve kids, A 1200km journey A new type of action-adventure game that fuses a thrilling story with 2D side-scrolling action.

name: Star Sky
short_description: Star Sky is a game about a man taking a midnight stroll. You take the same road as many times as you want, each time hopefully unlocking new encounters. Can you unlock the mysteries of the night?

name: Classic Card Game Euchre
short_description: Try your hand at this old-time favorite card game. Trick-taking makes for an action-packed round of cards. Go for the perfect loner hand for spades trump.

name: Listen to the Wind
short_description: 'Listen to the Wind' is a side-scrolling hack-and-slash game with counter attacks as the game's core mechanic. It takes pace during the Ming dynasty Jiajing era where you'll be battling Japanese pirates. It features unique martial art heroes and a story branching gameplay.

name: King
short_description: This is a game that combines strategy, tactics and role-playing. You travel to a magical world and become a king. You will manage your own country and conquer the world through diplomacy and war.

name: Code Romantic
short_description: Code Romantic is a computer science puzzle visual novel wrapped in a science fiction love story.

name: Kavel
short_description: Drag Tetromino blocks onto a board of gems to make a match. Use bombs for impressive explosive effects. Kavel is an action-puzzle game that brings together block puzzles and match-3 in an exciting new twist. A truly unique new entry in the genre.

name: Last Day: Zombie Survival VR
short_description: A stranger, who awakens in a room with no recollection of how they got there, soon discovers they're pawns in a deadly game perpetrated by a notorious unknown person.

name: Infinitrap Classic: Ohio Jack and The Cup Of Eternity
short_description: InfiniTrap Classic is a fast paced puzzle game for hardcore players. (40 levels)

name: Midnight Renegade
short_description: Defeat the chief of a corrupt task force, and bring peace back to London in this 2d action platformer.

name: The Legacy: Prisoner
short_description: 'Legacy: Prisoner' is a HO adventure game, with a huge number of exciting mini-games and puzzles, which will take you right into a maelstrom of fantastic events in a distant world!

name: 疑義照会ウォーズ
short_description: This is a full-fledged adventure game (selectable type) based on the theme of the pharmacist's job, 'checking prescription. Determine if the prescription is correct, and if it is, make a 'Questionable Inquiry' to the doctor!

name: Operation Hardcore
short_description: Operation Hardcore is an action-packed 2D side-scrolling shooter inspired by classic twitchy action games of yesteryear, but with modern touches and conveniences.

name: Chicken Farm 2K17
short_description: Chicken Farm is a management game with clicker aspects, where you buy chickens, catch the eggs, work at the market, sell your chickens and ultimately profit.

name: Legend of Keepers: Prologue
short_description: You have been hired as a dungeon master by the Dungeons Company. Your job is simple: Protect their dungeons! Legend of Keepers: Prologue is a playable alpha that will help you get familiar with the game mechanics.

name: Escape the City
short_description: Escape The City - It's a first-person shooter, about a city that was attacked by enemies.Prepare your gun and leave the city immediately. Fight your way past various enemies on different locations of the city and find your way out!

name: HITMAN™
short_description: There is a world beyond ours. Beyond nations, justice, ethics. It never sleeps. It exists everywhere. And once you enter....there is no going back. Welcome to the World of Assassination. You are Agent 47, the world's ultimate assassin.

name: BlackShadows
short_description: BlackShadows is a survival horror game where you'll assume the role of a young scientist who is fighting against her worst nightmare... You'll have to escape from a strange and creepy place in order to survive. You think it's easy? Be careful : Black Shadows are never friendly!

name: Torii Path
short_description: A first-person views horror game. After being isolated by the undefined event, you have to find the path to the real world.

name: FriendZoned Archer
short_description: FriendZoned Archer is an action adventure game inspired by the classic NES Zelda. There is complete freedom of exploration, hidden Areas, hidden dungeons and key items to help you ease through the open world.

name: BionicBlitz
short_description: BionicBlitz is a fast-paced and chaotic arcade game. You play as OddBot, a cheeky, playful robot whose sole purpose is to obtain the highest possible score on the worldwide leaderboards.

name: Town of Night
short_description: Town of Night is a RPG-First-person dungeon crawler hybrid. Visit the town that sits atop a series of vast and dangerous dungeons. Explore, battle, loot and survive!

name: Dark Hill Museum of Death
short_description: Dark Hill Museum of Death is a journey through a virtual museum where uniquely themed exhibits are unlocked by solving puzzles.

name: Raisond'etre
short_description: Will you be able to uncover your raison d'être and solve the mysteries that await in this suspenseful thriller?

name: Devil May Cry 4 Special Edition
short_description: The smash-hit stylish action game DMC4 is back and better than ever, boasting new playable characters and game modes!

name: Try 'n Cry - Prologue
short_description: Through the ages the Greek and the Latin worlds shaped Europe and left culture, arts and laws... but left also a darker and deeper evil, which was not recognized or fighted by the next dominations. Thus, the ancient stories became Myth; the Myth became Legends, and everything was forgotten.

name: Acid Spy
short_description: Acid Spy is a first person stealth action game set in a cyberpunk universe. Infiltrate heavily guarded bases and take down your enemies with skill and finesse. Master the art of quick, deadly stealth to become the acid spy.

name: Just Random Squares
short_description: A simple, action-packed, arcade bullet hell game with progression system and some roguelite elements, where almost everything is a square! There are 100 randomized waves of enemies to beat, which includes 4 deadly boss encounters.

name: Strike Master Apocalypse
short_description: Strike Master Apocalypse is a 2D action-packed shooter in which you play Bluey, a human who has to survive an apocalyptic landscape. Bluey must endure the wrath of the mutant King Spider and his gang of barons hunting him down, who will try to get him by any means possible.

name: Hunting Moon vol.2
short_description: When I received a life-size puppet, I thought it was a prank, but the puppet moved suddenly...

name: Romans From Mars
short_description: You are a Roman Soldier, and you and your crossbow are all that stands in the way of the God of War, Mars, and his invading Martian army. Luckily, Jupiter has endowed you with awesome and terrifying elemental powers of Fire, Ice, Earth, and Lightning.

name: Heal Hitler
short_description: POV: You are Hitler’s psychologist in 1925. Diagnose his complexes by using both Jungian and Freudian psychotherapy and attempt to heal him. Resolve Hitler's trauma and prevent catastrophe via therapy and psychology. Succeed and avoid the war and holocaust.

name: EasyPianoGame
short_description: A rhythm game which uses MIDI files to allow you to play any piano song. Play a large number of patterns with various customizable difficulties and numbers of keys. Songs in MIDI are easy to find, and they are almost always free.

name: Street Warriors Online
short_description: First, realistic PvP brawling game for up to 8 vs 8 players with original, dynamic combat system and fast, round based battles. Create and develop Your character. Earn new skills and items that helps You beat Your opponents. Gather Your friends and fight together in a clan.

name: Dungeon Escape
short_description: Challenging 2D platformer with simple graphics and great chiptune soundtrack.

name: Low Magic Age
short_description: Adventure and fight in a medieval fantasy open world! Build heroic characters with various abilities, travel through villages, cities, or perilous dungeons. Strategic turn-based combat system and advanced character building - Fog of war, charging and flanking, and more in the fast-paced Arena mode.

name: The Maker's Eden
short_description: The Maker's Eden is a first-person hypertext adventure game presented in the style of a motion comic. You play a character trying to discover what their predefined purpose is, in a science fiction/noir inspired world filled with androids, flying cars and an early 20th century vibe.

name: Asterix & Obelix XXL: Romastered
short_description: Asterix and Obelix make an XXL comeback in a Romastered version full of Romans!

name: Simple Light Cycles
short_description: Simple Light Cycles is a sleek, fast-paced, hyper responsive, local multiplayer action game for 2-8 players. Outlast, trap, and attack your opponents, or construct a strategy all your own. Get some friends together and put your skills to the test!

name: Hidden Folks
short_description: Search for hidden folks in hand-drawn, interactive, miniature landscapes. Unfurl tent flaps, cut through bushes, slam doors, and poke some crocodiles! Rooooaaaarrrr!!!!!

name: Feel-A-Maze
short_description: YOU WILL FEEL-A-MAZE!

name: Kukui 2
short_description: Kukui 2 continues Kyle's story. In this psychological horror, you will test the limits of your mind with mind-numbing puzzles that will test your every ability. Help Marie's curiosity and keep her safe, fight bosses and unravel a story that has no equal in this genre.

name: Einlanzer
short_description: Einlanzer is a full-scale, epic fantasy role-playing game. The 40+ hour story of Einlanzer is deep, thought-provoking, and emotional, while remaining light-hearted and fun at times. Expect a strategic battle system, massive scope, regularly added content, and difficult moral decisions.

name: Opus Mortem
short_description: Play as the Death. Test your reflexes while trying to redirect souls to their respective destinations. Don't worry if it's a bit hard at the beginning, every work gets easier with time and experience!

name: Goblin Storm
short_description: Command the armies of Men, Goblins and the Dead as they battle for supremacy on battlefields across the lands of Arcwellion. Will you build a mighty kingdom and lead the armies of men to stand against the storm? Or will you command the invading hordes on the path to conquest?

name: Robot City Stadium
short_description: Robot City Stadium is a competitive multiplayer disc-combat sport focused on skill, nuance, and mastery.

name: Actual Sunlight
short_description: A short interactive story about love, depression and the corporation.

name: Action Alien: Survival
short_description: Fight hordes of aliens in a completely destructible petrol station with many weapons to grab and aliens to fight !

name: Corpse Killer - 25th Anniversary Edition
short_description: You're stranded on an uncharted island of Death. You're zombifying from Voodoo poison. A mad scientist is on your trail. Hundres of rotting stiffs are crawling out of their graves to chew your guys, and you can't kill 'em. They're already dead.

name: Welcome To... Chichester 2 - Part II : No Regrets For The Future
short_description: Taking place on the second day of the protagonist's holiday, who starts reminiscing with Grendel Jinx about how they first met. Inevitably, their discussion turns to a dark period in their lives, where tragedy and betrayal nearly cost them their friendship - and a lot more.

name: E.Z
short_description: E.Z is a simple hardcore platformer game the goal being get across to the other side of each of the 100 levels while each death throws you back to the previous levels.

name: PLAYspace Virtual Music Library
short_description: PLAYspace - virtual spatial music library with amazing FX player. Create a collection of your favorite music in 3D environment.

name: Tiny Bunny
short_description: Tiny Bunny is a non-linear horror visual novel. Those, who have heard the voice of the forest, are beyond help.

name: Ballads of Reemus: When the Bed Bites
short_description: Reemus the insect exterminator and his companion Liam the bear match wits with giant talking ants, termites and bed bugs in hopes of impressing the citizens of Fredricus once and for all! A fully voice-acted, funny, cartoon point and click adventure with animated cutscenes, side quests and more.

name: Clarent Saga: Tactics
short_description: A straightforward SRPG inspired by 16-bit classics and made with SRPG Studio. The storyline follows the armies of Prince Abel of Meyr as he battle Pherrelios who invade them. A great entry point for newcommers!

name: Leashed Soul
short_description: Use your imagination! How grateful would you be if you got the biggest and best present you could dream of? When Beydo, the wooden doll comes to life he starts on a mission that spans through 50 different levels and different seasons to thank his gift by planting trees and creating life. Embark on an exciting puzzle adventure!

name: Contact
short_description: Contact is a horror point and click adventure game. In a bizarre world where you are trapped in an accident, you must investigate and find the whereabouts of your family. You have to run away from the creatures that attack you and collect items to overcome obstacles.

name: CLT
short_description: Explore a sexual tarot deck and lose yourself in its labyrinthian meanings.

name: Wild Island Quest
short_description: In an endless air ocean of an alien world, small lonesome plots of land float above the abyss. But sometimes approach each other, and lands which have never met before, reveal their secrets.

name: Cypherpunk Essentials
short_description: 在这套交互视频课程《成为一名密码朋克》中，你会从玩乐里完成整个密码学的学习，从零开始，掌握密码学。​

name: REMOTE LIFE
short_description: Remote Life is a 2D Side scrolling space shooter (shmup) for PC. Experience a fast paced action game with insane scary graphics, and hyper jump into a brutal-frenetic-techno-alien world. Free the world from this dreadful nightmare before its nauseating breath of horror destroys mankind.

name: Red Town
short_description: Welcome to Red Town! This is an old small village in which the villagers live calmly, contacting with environment very seldom. But despite this they are very glad to tourists! Be sure: the locals are eager to help you!

name: Gutwhale
short_description: Gutwhale is a roguelite about managing the space between you and your ammo, while fighting your way through a digestive system!

name: Beyond Gravity
short_description: Beyond Gravity is procedurally generated 'platformer' where you jump in-between planets and try to collect as many pickups as you can. This gets progressively harder the further you jump. No need to worry tho as you can upgrade your character with loads of upgrades and power-ups!

name: Forest monster
short_description: This is a third person action role-playing game，The player is in a forest of monsters，The player is free to explore the surrounding area. The player must avoid the monster's attack or kill the monster, so as to ensure the life of the monster as long as possible.

name: Geisterland
short_description: Geisterland is a dark adventure game that takes place in a fantastic universe and talks about societal problems in a creative way. It talks about empathy and fairness... and if we might let them go to survive. Will you give up your principles to survive?

name: DREAMGATE
short_description: Dreamgate is a unique hardcore mix of deck building card battler, roguelite adventure and RPG. Build your deck, explore the Dreamgate world and defeat fearsome foes!

name: Cave to Kingdom
short_description: Cave to Kingdom is a cross platform 3D online medieval management & strategy game, featuring a single persistent universe with player driven economy, war, and taxes.

name: Kung Fu Panda Showdown of Legendary Legends
short_description: Join Po, Tigress, Monkey, Tai Lung, Master Shifu, and all of your favorite Kung Fu Panda characters as they compete in the thrilling Showdown of Legendary Legends. Up to four players can face-off in iconic locations throughout the Valley of Peace and beyond.

name: Finding Teddy
short_description: We are currently working on Finding Teddy 2 !!Stay tuned, we are currently sending confidential preview versions to journalistsSpecial Offer : Buy Finding Teddy and get Free OST !In BriefThe revival of Point'n-Click.Graphics completely handmade, realized pixel by pixel.

name: Panzer Elite Action Gold Edition
short_description: The Gold Edition contains both Panzer Elite Action - Fields of Glory and its Dunes Of War expansion!

name: Maximum Override
short_description: Maximum Override is a chaotic city destruction game where the machines come alive. Wreak havoc in a fully destructible randomly generated city with anything you can find.

name: WIDECROSS
short_description: Wide Cross is a quick paced and easy-going MOBA, based on the premise of 5v5 player versus player combat. Play with an assortment of captivating characters and utilize boundless strategies to gain the advantage over your opponents - A compelling battlefield from beginning to end, will begin now!

name: MadCowBalls2
short_description: Save the city from the mad cow balls and destroy the bricks. Gain skillpoints from high score and completing levels. Use the skillpoints to upgrade your balls, weapons and gain access to the 60+ power ups!

name: Russian Mailman Simulator
short_description: This is an epic first person simulation game where the player defends his mail truck, while delivering letters to the local Russian population. The player must upgrade his gear, survive radiation sickness, and fight wave after wave to fulfill his duty!

name: Happy Numbers
short_description: Happy Numbers is a relaxing, mind-blending, minimalist puzzle game that offer over 70 hand-crafted levels to immerse your self into. The game also constain a lot of beautiful characters to unlock.

name: TZOMPANTLI
short_description: TZOMPANTLI is a fast paced fighting game based on the comic books written and drawn by Mexican author Edgar Clément, about Angel Hunters, Archangels, Nahuales, Mexican policemen, japanese robots and ancient demons as they battle each other trying to collect the price on the Head of the Archangel Michael .

name: MeatPossible: Chapter 1.5
short_description: MeatPossible: Chapter 1.5 is a fast-paced, intense, endless side-scrolling flyer action arcade game which depicts the tragical events taking place in the outskirts of the Kingdom of Epicton. Fight in this epic aerial adventure against the Pigs and the Flies as you bring back peace to your Kingdom.

name: Here Comes Niko!
short_description: Here Comes Niko! is the cozy 3D platformer for tired people! You play as Niko traveling across scenic islands. Make new friends, catch fish, solve puzzles, snag bugs, and more! Oh, Did I mention your boss is a frog?

name: Depths of Dread
short_description: There is something unusual about the source of monsters coming from the depths below. Having been summoned by the king to investigate a dungeon beneath an old abandoned town, you are to put together a team that will purge the dungeon of evil before it spreads and consumes the land.

name: Shadowbane
short_description: MMORPG, unlimited free PVP. 12 races, 22 occupations, 48 affiliated occupations, more than 200 attribute points, more than 500 skill points. Open battlefield that can be arbitrarily harvested in the game. Its freedom and cruelty are its characteristics, and it is also a fair competition for power.

name: 武林志2 (Wushu Chronicles 2)
short_description: ARPG《武林志2》是一款由蜗牛游戏旗下独立游戏团队“江湖工作室”所开发的一款武侠沙盒ARPG游戏，为《武林志》的正统续作，使用最新自研引擎flexi3.0，画面效果大幅提升。游戏采用无缝大地图的探索机制，快意书写属于你的江湖。

name: Stalked at Night
short_description: Your name is Bill, a man that had a car accident in the countryside in West Virginia.You wake up from a car crash,not exactly knowing where you are.Before crashing you saw some big animal crossing the road and then following you for a while.Right now your priorities are to get out of this place.

name: Sweaty Palms
short_description: Climb, swing, fly, and shoot in a visceral fast-paced VR multiplayer action arena. Fight like a superhero, die like one.

name: Defeated Girl
short_description: Defeated Girl is a jigsaw puzzle.

name: Crazy Pixel Streaker
short_description: A Fresh and Insane Brawler with Roguelike elements. Lead a fellowship of jackasses abducted by angry aliens and forced to spread chaos into the most famous sports events. Instant fun, Retro Arcade style, for up to 4 players.

name: I am Ball
short_description: Control a ball that's bouncing non-stop! Gain new powers and explore mysterious worlds! Puzzle platforming goodness at its finest! Do you have what it takes?

name: 8bit Arena
short_description: Invite and battle your friends in this retro style local multiplayer action game. Choose your character, each with a unique skillset of 4 abilities, and compete in different arenas. Enhance your skill with full controller support and a direct competitive gameplay!

name: Hopscotch
short_description: Jumping game with fun graphics, jump and do not let the janitor catch you!

name: Democracy 3 Africa
short_description: Democracy 3: Africa is the new standalone 're-imagining' of the hit political strategy game 'Democracy 3'. Set entirely in countries on the continent of Africa, D3:A puts you in charge of these countries and challenges you to stay in power whilst fixing each country's problems, improving the quality of life for your electorate, and...

name: Gumball Drift
short_description: Based on the classic arcade racing style and console kart racers, this Fast Paced racer bring you into the track in virtual reality. With both utility and sport vehicles, Gumball Drift takes you on a tour of the world.

name: Funny Village
short_description: Funny Village is an open world third person shooter. In this game you have to fight with a real mafia. Ride different cars, earn money and buy different weapons to destroy the damned mafia. Be the hero of this village!

name: Another Try
short_description: The virus has devastated cities and lands, you are one of the last survivors! You will have to survive in a harsh post-apocalyptic world populated by the living dead.

name: Nyanco Space
short_description: Hi Nyancos! How are you? Crying Out Nyanco in the Center of the Universe!

name: Arcante: Definitive Edition
short_description: A Fantasy Action RPG. Create your party and head off on an adventure. Playing Turn-Based or Real Time is up to you.

name: Bunny Girl Story
short_description: The girl works in the Bunny Club. She loves to sing songs and dance. But she is alone. However one day there is an opportunity to change everything.

name: Star Boss
short_description: Become a big pilot of a tiny spaceship. Fight bigger opponents and prove that size does not matter. Exploit weaknesses of opponents. Get the edge thanks to the range of super weapons.

name: One More Shot
short_description: One More Shot is a VR shooting game, where participants attempt to break clay targets. Play against other players, your friends or IA. Try the single player mode where you´ll get coins that will help you win. Become the next great skeet shooter and get a place in the leaderboards.

name: CROSSFIRE II (2002)
short_description: Crossfire II is an Retro / Arcade / Top-Down Shooter, originally released in 2002 for the AMIGA. The main part of the game is a classic, fast paced, single player story campaign. Fly different space ships and fight, to save the universe as you know it. Also you get a survival and a local PvP mode.

name: ZCREW（Z字特遣队）
short_description: ZCREW is an isometric shooter that supports up to 4 player co-op. In the world destroyed by an alien virus, you are an elite member of the U.N.R - an apocalyptic salvation organization. Work alone or in a team to fight for the future of mankind.

name: How To Date A Magical Girl!
short_description: You're invited to the elite academy for magical girls! Will you take the opportunity to make new friends? Learn magic? Or... Will you try to date a cute magical girl?

name: Fear For Freedom
short_description: 'Two days ago a monster appeared in the hallway outside the office. Maybe if I just wait it will leave eventually.' A very short psychological game dealing with isolation, entrapment and the nature of fear.

name: The Housewife
short_description: Take on the role of the housewife and make sure the house is maintained, she lives to keep her husband happy. Learn how the world changes for an abused person. She believes that he only beats her when she disappoints him. Get deep inside the functioning psyche of a victim of abuse.

name: Stupid Raft Battle Simulator
short_description: Stupid Raft Battle Simulator is a physics based simulator game set during the golden age of piracy. Your goal is to defeat your opponent by eliminating all enemy units on the battlefield.

name: 缄默星空 Silent Space
short_description: 你还在怀念儿时第一次看宇宙骑士、太空堡垒时那种热血沸腾的感受吗？《缄默星空》是一款画面怀旧，玩法创新的星战RPG冒险游戏。多线叙事，多种结局，驾驶你的飞船，重温儿时的感动吧。

name: Outer Rim
short_description: Alert...Alert… This is a distress message being sent from the outpost Praxis. At 2200 hours the Alliance outpost Praxis fell to enemy forces. The Empire's war machine is active and has initiated an act of war against the Alliance. We need pilots. We need your help. Will you defend the Outer Rim?

name: МЕМОЛОГИЯ
short_description: MEMOLOGY is a comprehensive test that shows how deeply you are immersed in the culture of memes.

name: Angelo Skate Away
short_description: Angelo Skate Away is a brand new game based on the successful TV show Angelo Rules!

name: Evil God Korone
short_description: An unexpected collaboration from Tsugunohi, the game where horror invades daily life, and VTuber Inugami Korone, from VTuber group hololive. Inugami Korone, who has been live streaming many horror game, has become an evil goddess and taken over Tsugunohi. Now, chop your finger and give it to her.

name: Flyist
short_description: You control a small plane. You need to fly over and under the rocks and collect stars of distinction along the way.

name: Layer Section™ & Galactic Attack™ S-Tribute
short_description: Layer Section, the home console port of arcade game RayForce is back with new features and online ranking. Use the new lock-on laser function to defeat multiple enemies at once for a higher score in this gorgeous 2D vertical shooting game!

name: I Am Gooey
short_description: I Am Gooey is a top-down 2D atmospheric puzzle game where you must use your flame to light your way. As you ascend a certain ancient tower, time will pass, but you must reach the top by daybreak to fulfill your life's goal... To become the sun, so the world's daily cycle can continue!

name: Roomscale Tower
short_description: Roomscale Tower is a photogrammetric experience built for the HTC Vive. Become a knight of the Middle Ages and leave in search of wealth through towers filled with traps. Fight skeleton's army in intense survival mode. Climb mountains, catch piglets, throw knifes or relax at the tavern.

name: Element X
short_description: Element X is a hardcore roguelite bullet hell. Challenge ruthless enemies and claim your high score!

ONLINE sci-fi Multiplayer ZOMBIE game.It's 2030 AC, Beings from planet Venus are back and they declare WAR to humans with a deadly virus. Use ultimate military weapons, make body parts fly, clear the area from deadly hordes, Great amount of action to play alone or with at least 4 friends.

name: Brix VR
short_description: A breakout/arkanoid style game designed for VR.

name: Stardust Vanguards
short_description: Get your friends and bust out the controllers, STARDUST VANGUARDS is a local four-player dueling game inspired by old-school anime space operas, combining arcade-style battling with the ability to summon your own NPC army as support!

name: Red Beard Labyrinth
short_description: Explore the tangled cryptic labyrinth! Just find four magical diamonds opening new level portal in its depths.

name: I'm on Observation Duty
short_description: Your job is to monitor live surveillance camera footage and spot anomalies in the monitored rooms. Anomalies range from furniture movement to otherworldly intruders. When you spot an anomaly you have to file a report to fix it. You will need sharp eyes and good memory to survive the entire night.

name: Vortex Attack EX
short_description: Galaxy is in danger with hostile ships swarming from the opening vortex. Blast enemies with huge variety of upgradeable ships. Frantic arcade shooter featuring world leaderboards and fun multiplayer mode will keep you playing until all ships are unlocked; galaxies saved. WARNING:VERY_ADDICTIVE

name: Knockball pool
short_description: Play against yourself or the computer in this physics-based billiards hit!

name: The Dungeon Of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet Of Chaos
short_description: Step into the wacky heroic fantasy universe of the Dungeon of Naheulbeuk. Lead a team of unlikely and clumsy heroes in an epic and challenging tactical RPG. Live an adventure filled with humor, surprises and silly encounters.

name: Space Viking Raiders VR
short_description: Looking for an online co-op game to play through with friends? You want a hilarious story with full voice acting! Diablo meets Gauntlet in this dungeon crawler action RPG. Wreck havoc with physics and mass destruction in SPACE VIKING RAIDERS! Wishlist now!

name: 迷霧國度: 傳承 Myth of Mist：Legacy
short_description: In the mist-surrounded City of Time and Eternity, you are the son of a noble family, going between various factions aiming to fight against the upcoming disaster of the Mist of Doomsday. This game is for players who love SLGs and multi-ending RPGs. Join us and write your own legend!

name: Battle Grounds III
short_description: After 6 years of development, Battle Grounds III (BG3) is the next iteration in the classic franchise which began 17 years ago. Prepare for battle in the American War of Independence!

name: Conditus
short_description: Show your friends who's the strongest ninja, and make them suffer. Or team up with them to eliminate your enemies.

name: PomboTroll
short_description: PomboTroll is an extremely fun 2D game. Fly on the wings of a pigeon and earn points pooping and vomiting on other birds. Challenge other players for a gross battle and be the biggest troll pigeon of all!

name: The Journey: Bob's Story
short_description: The Journey: Bob's Story is an Exploration, Atmospheric and puzzle 2D platformer. Play as Bob, who goes on an adventure to find his best friend Neibag who left the village with a group of explorers through villages secret cave.

name: Blood Relation Part1.
short_description: Proceed with tools, notes, etc. in a closed building. Overcome various fears and complete tasks. Unlock secrets hidden in the building.

name: Untale: King of Revinia
short_description: Unravel the mystery of the King's sudden death... Claim your right for the throne. Try to stay alive as long as possible. Will you take the risk? The story for those who are brave enough to dive in a dark story and are able to think reasonably.

name: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim VR
short_description: A true, full-length open-world game for VR has arrived from Bethesda Game Studios. Skyrim VR reimagines the complete epic fantasy masterpiece with an unparalleled sense of scale, depth, and immersion. Skyrim VR also includes all official add-ons.

name: 鬼魂街
short_description: Third person shooter! With infinite bullets, can you kill ghosts and escape from ghost street?

name: London Detective Mysteria
short_description: The evening is as ordinary as they come for London, England as the curtains close on the 19th century. Mist hangs thick, beclouding the radiance of the moon and modest glow of gas lamps. Upon the resounding chime of Big Ben, a new tale of love and adventure like no other begins!

name: YOGA MASTER
short_description: Yoga Master is the first wellness game of its kind built entirely in 3D and designed by experts to help you reach the perfect balance between mind and body.

name: Hellbreachers
short_description: A journey to the hell and back! Hellbreachers is a retro styled action-platformer with RPG character progression system. Choose one of three heroes and than one of ten specializations, progress through spectacular locations and take on challenging bosses!

name: VillageBlade
short_description: VillageBlade is a dual tile-based card game and vivid city builder. Use cards to your advantage to build gameplay areas and spawn houses to reach new high scores in Frontier Mode. Create colorful landscapes and villages from a variety of tiles with no time limits or locked content in Build Mode.

name: Big Tower Tiny Square 2
short_description: Return to the revamped ruins of the BIG TOWER to rescue your PINEAPPLE from the geometric genius, BIG SQUARE! Combining mechanics from previous BIG TOWER TINY SQUARE games, this Tower challenges you to jump, flap, bounce, and ride your way to REVENGE!

name: My Lovely Wife
short_description: My Lovely Wife delves into the depths of a man’s grief after the sudden death of his beloved wife. Explore the notions of one’s willingness to do anything for love and the importance of letting go in this mix of dating, management, and alchemy simulators.

name: MightyIronBall
short_description: The MightyIronBall is lost in a odd world. Help him to back to home through warp gates. Play several levels in a fast, addictive platform game with a real physics friction system. A balance mix between skill and cunning against the time. Warp gates last a few seconds, there is no time to waste.

name: Keng's Little Universe
short_description: The game is divided into three parts, which simulate three stages of civilization respectively. The first is the survival of civilization in a multi-stars system. The second is the expansion and war of civilization in a galaxy. The third part is the exploration of god civilization in the universe.

name: Blue Barbarian Man
short_description: Indie platform game in which you control the blue barbarian man who has the sword to hit his opponents. You can also jump on your enemies' heads to defeat them. You need to collect items and defeat the bosses to win the game.

name: Demise of Nations
short_description: Demise of Nations is a 4X turn-based grand strategy wargame covering the rise of Rome till the fall of modern civilization.

name: Voodoo Whisperer Curse of a Legend
short_description: The entire town has been put into a deep, dark sleep by a mysterious evil force. Now young Lillian must find allies and uncover the dark secrets of voodoo in order to save her master and free her friends before it is too late.

name: Dusk Diver 2
short_description: The fully enhanced Ximending action game sequel! New characters! New scenes! New customizations! ——A new journey of adventure and guardianship is about to unfold!!

name: Square n Fair
short_description: Relaxing puzzle platformer.

name: Conway: Disappearance at Dahlia View
short_description: Sometimes it takes a nightmare to wake a place like Dahlia View. Lead the investigation into a missing child and discover the dark secret of Dahlia View in this story-driven observational thriller from the creators of The Occupation and Ether One.

name: Grisaia Phantom Trigger Vol.8
short_description: At last, an all-out war is at hand. The battle against the religious organization, The Fatal Answer (TFA), has entered its final phase, with CIRS and SORD preparing to send all of their troops into TFA's stronghold.

name: Light Repair Team #4
short_description: Light Repair Team #4 is a light-reflection puzzle game where you play as a light-pipe repair person. Figure out how to properly bounce, combine and split light so that you can return power to nearby buildings.

name: Masked Forces: Zombie Survival
short_description: What will you do when the zombie apocalypse comes, are you ready to tackle it right now and stay face to face with all the horrors that will appear?

name: The HeartBeat
short_description: The Heartbeat is a lightweight political simulation game that incorporates rhythmic, text-oriented options. All the player has to do in the game is keep himself and the city alive as much as possible.

name: Red Tractor Tycoon
short_description: This is your chance! It’s up to you and your trusty tractor to create a flourishing agricultural industry. You take the wheel in this farm simulation and determine how your farm should look. The further you progress, the more options you’ll have!

name: Space Moth DX
short_description: Fact: everything is better with lasers. So we put lasers on over 30 angry giant insects who want to stop you, Space Moth, from escaping Earth and going to the Moon. Show them who's boss and blast your way into space! (Check out the all new SPACE MOTH: LUNAR EDITION, linked below!)

name: Dark Arcana: The Carnival
short_description: Find the missing woman lost in a mysterious Carnival of Horrors.

name: Awesome Puzzle
short_description: Awesome Puzzle is an educational game for children in which you have to collect a picture from puzzles. The game has 12 levels, a pleasant atmosphere for children.Good music, nice graphics, mouse control, the game develops memory well.

name: Mighty Gunvolt
short_description: Take control of one of three playable characters (Gunvolt, Ekoro, and Beck) as you blast your way past the baddies in stage after stage of side-scrolling action! Each stage ends with a boss encounter. Defeat the boss to complete the stage.

name: Public Enemy: Revolution Simulator
short_description: Stealth and rebellion in an absurd totalitarian government.

name: Trove
short_description: Grab your friends, hone your blades, and set off for adventure in Trove, the ultimate action MMO!

name: Talent Not Included
short_description: Set in the fantasy land of Notthatmuchfurther, Talent Not Included tells the story of three actors, ready for anything, in order to give the performance of their life even if that means facing mechanical soldiers, animals, hardheaded monsters as well as rotating cylinders at their feet. Break a leg, you'll need it !

name: 10 Seconds to Win!
short_description: 10 seconds to win! is a platform game where you only have 10 seconds to complete each stage, be agile and skillful to complete all levels.

name: Infinite Beyond The Mind
short_description: Infinite - Beyond the mind is a slick 2D action-platformer where you take on evil Queen Evangelyn Bramann, ruler of The Beljantaur Kingdom as she works towards her dream of world domination.

name: Zombie Forest 2
short_description: Returning from Sunday fishing, you find yourself in center of the zombie apocalypse. Scuttling, you stumble upon a broken army jeep with weapons, equipment and coordinates of the nearest shelter. It is there that you have to get to, making your way through a forest full of zombies, marauders and fellow-sufferers.

name: The Deed: Dynasty
short_description: Getting away with murder has never been easy. These three members of a proud and noble family are separated by five centuries, but have in common a vengeful and murderous intent. Plans must be formed, blood must be spilled and evidence must be planted ...

name: Fire Arrow Plus
short_description: Fire Arrow and Fire Arrow X are time attack style shooters with a heavy emphasis on scoring. Otherwisely, you can call them coffee break shmups.

name: Skinscape
short_description: In this VR artwork, UK based artist Ian Truelove scales his paintings up to gargantuan proportions to show the beauty of the pixels they are made from.

name: STANDBY
short_description: Never STANDBY in this fast-paced, precise platformer and get out of the glitched world! Can you do it faster than anyone?

name: COROPATA
short_description: Himawari's on a quest to deliver radishes to the neighborhood, but first she needs help overcoming the Rube Goldberg puzzles in her way! (This is the Steam version of the game originally released in 2009 for the Nintendo DS, now for the first time in English!)

name: Magic Mouse
short_description: Magic Mouse is an action-adventure top-down dungeon crawl set in a fantasy world where the player fights their way through dangerous enemies, overcomes powerful bosses and survives perilous traps all while honing magical powers.

name: Sid Meier’s Ace Patrol: Pacific Skies
short_description: Battle to Rule the Pacific Skies!Take flight over the treacherous Pacific waters where ace pilots redefine historic World War II battles! Skillfully pilot the most iconic American and Japanese fighter planes of the Pacific War while representing the army or navy.

name: Coldage
short_description: Coldage is a narrative-driven adventure game about choices and consequences. Following a group of five Protectors sent on a quest to investigate the Refinery. You decide which characters respond to the events and how the story progresses as a consequence.

name: Hello Charlotte EP3: Childhood's End
short_description: 'All ended well.There was nothing to grieve about.' A farewell, and a greeting.

name: RAD
short_description: RAD is a 3D action rogue-like set in a post-post-apocalyptic world, where humanity has faced armageddon not once, but twice.

name: Etherlords
short_description: Four races of wizards, adepts of four magical schools, collide in a brutal fight for world domination. Etherlords, an iconic strategy created by Nival, became a bestseller in the world and earned highest grades from critics.Etherlords is an exciting mix of turn-based strategy and fantasy trading card game.

name: Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles
short_description: Experience an immersive and horrifying episodic single-player survival horror nightmare. Trapped alone in a desolate manor and hunted by monstrous foes, you will need to scrounge for supplies, manage your resources, solve puzzles and battle the undead to survive.

name: Habroxia 2
short_description: Blast off for a sequel that pushes every facet of 2D shoot'em ups to escape velocity!

name: Super Puzzle Platformer Deluxe
short_description: The title says it all. Take one part falling block puzzle game, combine one part old-school platformer, add a couple thousand pixels, blend and serve. Why match colored blocks when you can just shoot the hell out of them? Your goal is to survive as long as you can. From celebrated indie developer Andrew Morrish and Adult Swim Games.

name: Mob War Nazi Golds
short_description: Find the rival gang leader and find the Nazi Golds hidden from the past. You can progress faster with weapons hidden around and destroy rival gang members. The story will continue with free DLC.

name: Anarchy Arcade
short_description: Turn your entire digital life into a game. AArcade is a 3D desktop that launches shortcuts to absolutely anything you like. Join the anarchy of the persistent online metaverse, or remain in your own private reality. Casual in-game building features, plus hundreds of thousands of addons.

name: Darts and Friends
short_description: Darts and Friends is a classic darts playing game!

name: Zedfest
short_description: Zedfest is the goriest game show ever created! A hardcore 4 player co-op third-person shooter with the goal to complete objectives while neutralizing Zeds with lots and lots of visceral gore.

name: Legionwood 2: Rise of the Eternal's Realm - Director's Cut
short_description: Legionwood 2: Rise of the Eternal's Realm is an epic fantasy role playing game in the style of 16 bit classics like Final Fantasy IV and Chrono Trigger. Featuring non-linear gameplay, choices that define the story and exciting turn based gameplay, Legionwood 2 is a love letter to yesteryear.

name: Warp Factory
short_description: An automation puzzle game in which the player must build factories to produce various shapes and patterns, as well as to perform more dynamic tasks - featuring a system of portals that allow one to cut apart and reconnect space in paradoxical - and productive - ways.

name: 303 Squadron: Battle of Britain
short_description: The enemies are close, would you dare to join the Squadron? Tweak planes in a 1st person mechanic mode, set the clouds on fire in aerial fights sim and discover extra missions in an open world of RAF Base. Enjoy a gameplay based on a real history and become the Ace of Sky.

name: Spaceteam VR
short_description: A chaotic, cooperative party game! Shout technobabble at your friends until your spaceship inevitably explodes. Attempt to follow randomly generated, incorrectly assigned instructions. Work together… as a Spaceteam!

name: Beauty and the Beast: Hidden Object Fairy Tale. HOG
short_description: Take a dive into the magic world of your favorite fairy tale Beauty and the Beast! Experience unusual 360-degree panoramas and 3D views in the classic Hidden Object game! Help Belle to go through all the ordeals and find love!

name: Christmas Stories: Hans Christian Andersen's Tin Soldier Collector's Edition
short_description: The Rat King's wand has fallen into the hands of a vengeful baron. Team up with your new friend, the Tin Soldier, to stop him!

short_description: When three unscrupulous jerks meet an early demise, only the devil himself can give 'em another shot at that federal gold! Contains cussin' and such

name: Kitty Nigiri
short_description: The cat in space, sushi catching, laser puzzle solving, fireball dodging, kitten saving, chopstick wielding, flying VR game your cat's been dreaming about. Use your wits and dexterity, and prove yourself a potential champion.....

name: Infiltration: Alone in Combat
short_description: A Third Person Shooter Game where you have to infiltrate the enemy lines and complete the mission.

name: Hellenica
short_description: In this puzzle RPG, explore a steam-powered ancient Greece as Artemis' bear warrior on a mythological quest of technology and magic. Push, toss, and bounce friend and foe, and use the environment to your advantage. You choose the battles, allies, and plots you encounter.

short_description: Build, manage and grow a thriving colony in Kubifaktorium. The game features different biomes to explore, plenty of resources to exploit, complex machinery to build and interesting production chains to master.

name: Start! Heart Thief | 出发吧！偷心盗贼 | 出撃! ルビー | 出擊！偷心盜賊
short_description: Our heroine ruby is an orphan, Every morning, she goes out to explore the secret island of God Every night, she put on her nightdress

name: CLANNAD Side Stories
short_description: Delve further into the world of CLANNAD and experience the stories beyond the original visual novel adventure. Known as CLANNAD Hikari Mimamoru Sakamichi de in Japan, This Steam version features high resolution assets and is translated into English for the very first time.

name: HighFleet
short_description: Battle for survival in the skies of a mysterious future Earth in this unique action-strategy game mixing arcade combat, exploration, management and diplomacy. As giant flying ships wage spectacular aerial warfare, a prophecy tells of one who will save the world – could it be you?

name: KELVIN
short_description: Escape a distant planet before it is swallowed by a black hole

name: Slime Research
short_description: Slimy Puzzle Platforming

name: Pocket Cars
short_description: Pocket Cars is a fast paced arcade combat-racing game, where you can drive remote controlled cars that speed through amazing tracks.

name: The Chronicles of Quiver Dick
short_description: The Chronicles of Quiver Dick is a Crude Comedy RPG that has one goal and one goal only: To make you laugh! Play as Quiver Dick, a legendary storyteller and former badass, as he embarks on one of many downright crazy and entirely messed up adventures!

name: Shooty Fruity
short_description: Scan, serve & pack produce whilst shooting guns to defend your store from mutant fruit! A multi-tasking shooter only possible with VR & motion control. Scan! Shoot! Repeat!

name: Coffee Break
short_description: Cafe management and crafting sim where you live the hectic life of a Barista. Play alone or with friends for the price of a latte!

short_description: A quest around four kingdoms, colored by the seasons!

short_description: The vampire who died was given the right to seek truth because of rebirth. As the identity changed, she changed from a victim to a criminal suspect... How can this be self-certified?

short_description: The Red Prison is a roguelike based on the OGL-content of the SRD for 5th edition Dungeons & Dragons.

short_description: Castle Must Be Mine is a KingdomRush-like tower defense game. But developed for VR. In addition to constantly collecting Coins to building and upgrading defensive towers, also need to make full use of all kinds of skills and props to stop the 'enemies' into your castle.

name: Retro Snake Adventures
short_description: It's a unique twist on the Classic Snake Game. It's kinda like snake, but adventure mode. Collect keys to get through doors, but watch out for your tail and walls.

name: Cold Blooded Cube
short_description: You are a cube that no longer wants to be just a sheep and wants to make yourself famous whichever way it will be the easiest.

short_description: A game of numerical reasoning for practicing your logical thinking. A game of exploration and collection which may recall your childhood memories. A drawing game for you to paint your dreams freely.

name: Casual Spider Solitaire
short_description: A Spider Solitaire card game, with hints.

short_description: An addictive mix of lightning-fast puzzle battles, powerful storytelling and immersive visual novel elements, The World Next Door follows Jun, a rebellious teen girl trapped in a parallel realm inhabited by magical creatures, who must find her way home before time runs out.

name: Abrakadaboom
short_description: Face your friends as powerful wizards fighting in thematic arenas in this multiplayer party game that combines fun and intensity along with a gameplay that is both easy to learn and rich of subtleties. Get ready for lots of laughs and mayhem!

Welcome to the year 2100. You have been selected to conduct research on the most advanced space station in all of the history of mankind with the most advanced AI. However, things start to take a turn for the worse when the AI begins to turn against you.

name: Gibbous -  A Cthulhu Adventure
short_description: Crazy cultists. Cthulhu. A talking cat. Gibbous takes you on an expansive, traditionally animated, hand-painted adventure. Play as three protagonists and explore a lushly rendered Lovecraft-inspired world, unraveling ancient conspiracies. A comedy cosmic horror adventure made in Transylvania!

name: The Mysterious Cities of Gold
short_description: Play Esteban, Zia and Tao through numerous tricky levels full of puzzles, traps and infiltration phases in a wide variety of diverse gorgeous settings. Explore every nook and cranny of China, and escape Zarès’ hostile men, searching for the local City of Gold.

name: Beat Hazard 2
short_description: Experience your music collection as never before with this intense music driven arcade shooter. Each of your songs will have its own unique ebb and flow based on the music.

name: Haunted Jail: Alcatas
short_description: Haunted Jail: Alcatas is a 2D Survival Horror Game based on the paranormal events of the oldest and the most haunted prison in Alcatas, witnessed by those who set foot inside the place.

*** is a small game. It is easy to play,hope you find surprise and happyness in the game. And I will metain and expand this game until I have no better puzzle to put in it.

Lazo is waiting for your commands to fight monsters, survive the deadly traps, win the battles, and collect all valuables.Write (literally) the Story of Lazo in command-line format, and the brave Hero will obey your instructions to make history.

Unlock new cars and tracks by participating in series of races and don’t worry about anything, because you’ll never be left alone, your partner lady will contact you to get you out of any trouble.

short_description: Narcos: Rise of the Cartels is a brutal turn-based action strategy game based on the hit Netflix TV series. Explore the entire first season from two sides each with their own unique story. Join the narcos and expand the drug cartel empire, or take up arms with the DEA and bring it crumbling down

name: Apocalypse: 2.0 Edition
short_description: Apocalypse: 2.0 Edition is an extremely fast paced shooter, which mixes several modern mechanics into the classic zombie survival experience. This includes an economy; item looting; item management; quests; stats; and much more! Completely free with Steam.

name: Ground Pounders

short_description: Hire new soldiers and send them into battle with an inordinately growing army of various walking creatures.

name: People Playground

name: Dragon Battle
short_description: Will YOU be the Champion of Legend who defeats the Dragon King?

name: The Dark Eye : Book of Heroes
short_description: Experience classical role-playing together with your friends in a co-op multiplayer RPG based on THE DARK EYE license that lets you engage in party-based adventures in the fantasy world of Aventuria.

name: Theorem
short_description: Abstract puzzle game

name: Turbo Tunnel

name: Wizardry: The Five Ordeals
short_description: Welcome to the world of dungeon crawling! The classic dungeon crawler released back in 2006, returns to Steam with improved UI and more.

name: Across the Galaxy: Stellar Dominator
short_description: In the game,you can assist your allies in occupying and protecting resource-rich strongholds to strengthen their technology and develop more powerful weapons,attack other camps,prevent friendly strongholds from being invaded,assist your camps in developing technology. Strengthen your own technology.

short_description: The Indifferent Wonder of an Edible Place is a story about a building eater consuming a tower in a town condemned to be removed from history. It ponders the violence of erasure and the profound grief of surviving at the edge of despotism, when places of entangled heritage are willfully effaced.

name: Thunder Tier One

name: The Lost Sky

name: RISK: Global Domination
short_description: Take over the world in RISK Global Domination, the iconic strategy board game.

name: Choice of Rebels: Uprising
short_description: Lead the revolt against a bloodthirsty empire! You grew up under the iron fist of the Hegemony. Now is your chance to end their blood-fueled magic, as you forge a ragtag outlaw band into a rebel army.

name: Divinity: Original Sin 2 - Definitive Edition
short_description: The critically acclaimed RPG that raised the bar, from the creators of Baldur's Gate 3. Gather your party. Master deep, tactical combat. Venture as a party of up to four - but know that only one of you will have the chance to become a God.

name: FL337 - "Fleet"
short_description: Nostalgia on a new platform. Fleet is our rendition of the classic sidescroller beat 'em up. Enemies, Bosses, combos, and power ups fill up this action packed brawler.

name: Energy Island Corp.
short_description: Build and manage an electric grid ! At the start of the day, build new infrastructure and plan your day. Once ready, start the day then watch electricity production / consumption in real time to adjust your buildings settings. The growth of the islands depends on you !

name: Zombie Exodus
short_description: It starts with a daring escape from a zombie-infested city; it ends at Zombie Exodus, when a horde of zombies swarms outlying settlements like locusts.

name: Relics 2: The Crusader's Tomb
short_description: Four thousand miles. Twenty thousand pounds. Four murderous rivals. One unforgettable adventure.

name: Endless Horde
short_description: The horde is here to eat your brain and murder every single one of your scientists. Gather your forces, this is the last stand before we lose the facility! Place guards, close doors, and position traps. Survive as long as you can!

name: Wanderer of Teandria
short_description: Wanderer of Teandria is challenging 2D platform game inspired by classic representatives of the genre. Find crystals and fragments of the map, avoid enemies and traps, and defeat giant bosses to succeed on the way to your destiny!

name: Corpse Party: Sweet Sachiko's Hysteric Birthday Bash
short_description: Vengeful spirit Sachiko Shinozaki is having a birthday bash, and the lovable cast of damned souls from the Corpse Party series is invited! Join the revelers as they do their best to keep Sachiko happy and survive her twisted games in this midquel to Corpse Party and Corpse Party: Book of Shadows.

name: Speed Dating for Ghosts
short_description: Branching dialogue! Hard choices! A cemetery's worth of phantoms, wraiths, and poltergeists lookin' for love in all the blight places.

name: CatMafia
short_description: CatMafia is an arena Shooter with slasher elements and a top view. Earn points by fighting off waves of vile wolves, jackals and mice, and buy new equipment and first aid kits to be ready to fight the fattest opponent in the end.

name: Catch a Lover
short_description: Catch a Lover - a multiplayer game for 2-4 players in which one plays the role of the husband, who needs to catch wife's lover. Lover at the same time, should do everything to find a way out of the house.

name: The Hand of Glory
short_description: The challenge of a dangerous serial killer plummets detective Lazarus Bundy’s career into a chasm with no way out. In a desperate attempt at a comeback, Lazarus decides to secretly investigate the disappearance of Kathrin Mulzberg.

name: Vektor Z
short_description: Vektor Z brings fast and furious retro space blasting action to Steam! Blast your way through endless waves of asteroids and enemies to write your name among the stars! Vektor Z offers both relentless action and vibrant visuals that is certain to have you playing again and again!

name: VoidExpanse
short_description: Explore the vast reaches of VoidExpanse -- mine asteroids, upgrade your ship, trade, complete missions, advance your character and survive fast-paced combat with hostile aliens and mercenaries in the rich and exciting Sci-Fi universe of VoidExpanse!

name: Berries Challenge
short_description: Berries Challenge is a berries hunter simulator. Here you can walk around the forest and enjoy the nature, meet different animals and, of course, gather berries.

name: Resident Evil
short_description: The game that defined the survival-horror genre is back! Check out the remastered HD version of Resident Evil.

name: Astrohazard Solutions Ltd.
short_description: Astrohazard Solutions Ltd. is an interstellar and interspecies corporation dealing mainly with removing and redirecting asteroids and other cosmic junk that threatens their Clients.

name: It Takes Two
short_description: Embark on the craziest journey of your life in It Takes Two. Invite a friend to join for free with Friend’s Pass and work together across a huge variety of gleefully disruptive gameplay challenges. Winner of GAME OF THE YEAR at the Game Awards 2021.

name: Circle Empires Rivals
