short_description: Build your dream farm with your friends & animals in Big Farm Story. Grow crops, tend your fields, craft and explore the world in this farming adventure. Meet new friends around each corner, shape your own community and have fun writing your own story.

name: Bala na manga
short_description: Bullet in the sleeve. Shoot, dodge and reload.

name: Divekick
short_description: Divekick is the world’s first two-button fighting game. It distills the essence of the fighting game genre into just two buttons with no d-pad directional movement. Includes two extra playable characters: Fencer from Nidhogg and Johnny Gat from Saints Row!

name: Stress explosion
short_description: It's time to explode the massive amount of stress that has accumulated in you! By destroying them, messing them up and blasting them, This is a 2D action game with a refreshing feeling of destruction in various everyday situations. Save this world from stress! !

name: The forgotten phobia
short_description: The forgotten phobia is a horror puzzle game made in 2D pixel graphics.

name: Metro: Last Light Redux
short_description: It is the year 2034. Beneath the ruins of post-apocalyptic Moscow, in the tunnels of the Metro, the remnants of mankind are besieged by deadly threats from outside – and within. Mutants stalk the catacombs beneath the desolate surface, and hunt amidst the poisoned skies above.

name: Fragmented
short_description: Stranded in a hostile alien world, you must fight to survive. Hunt, harvest, craft, advance skills, and build using local resources along with technology from your voyage. Join others online or play offline in the world of Fragmented.

name: Happy Island Life
short_description: You, who lived freely on the island, originally lived a leisurely life of hunting wild boars and occasionally harassing the savages. But your life has changed since you rescued the beautiful lady who was stranded on the island in a plane accident.

name: Quar: Battle for Gate 18
short_description: Quar: Battle for Gate 18 is a turn-based strategic VR game set in the grimsical world of Alwyd. The Quar are cute alien ant-eaters. Don't mistake cute for gentle. They use their WW1 level technology to wage war across the face of their world.

name: JQ: countries
short_description: JQ is a quiz game about countries in which a player must choose the correct answer from 4 options.

name: Meu
short_description: Meu lets you explore, record and share your body movements along with unique psychedelic filters and adaptive music that you control with your movements. Create your own body language communication with friends who have VR or share your moves as animated gifs.

name: Goblin Quest: Escape!
short_description: Goblin Quest: Escape! is an award-winning action-packed dungeon crawler, action-rpg and reverse tower defense hybrid from BotBite Industries.

name: Strike Solitaire 2
short_description: The sea, the sun, and solitaire! Hit a strike on the seashore!

name: Destructo
short_description: Destruction sandbox with different game modes, dynamic building destruction and character customization.

name: Afternoon empire
short_description: we are remaking this game

name: Whip! Whip!
short_description: * Whip! Whip! requires a controller to play * 1980s Arcade video game style Action!

name: Drunk Puppet
short_description: Drunk Puppet is the most realistic walking simulator you'll be playing this year! Keep calm, because you are waiting for insurmountable difficulties, such as careless drivers and an inexplicable inability to step on the cracks on the sidewalk. You will laugh. You will cry.

name: Card Blitz: WWII
short_description: WWII card game - simple but deep, challenging but friendly. If you are into military history, collecting and fast game sessions then Card Blitz is perfect for you!

name: Bingo Hall
short_description: Bingo Hall is the ultimate bingo party game! Use 'Local' mode to host your own Bingo parties with any number of people! OR use 'Online' mode to host an online game of up to 50 people! everyone can join using any device with a browser, the perfect game to bring all friends/family together.

name: Dolguth
short_description: Dolguth is a 2D oldschool brawler for up-to 6 local players. Choose your mech to fight in one of the Dolguth arenas and destroy the other warriors. Each mech is powered with a melee weapon and a 6-bullets cannon. Each pilot has an EMP gun and a grapple to reach impervious zones.

name: Doors
short_description: Doors is a short, atmospheric first person logic game created by a one-man-team. Taking inspiration from Limbo and The Stanley Parable, Doors attempts to bring something new to the puzzle genre.

name: Plastris
short_description: There's barely anything on this barren land! Plunge into the world of this relaxing puzzle game and help it flourish by filling in every cell on the screen using two different shapes: the first puts objects inside of its borders and the second - removes them.

name: Alien Carnage / Halloween Harry
short_description: Starring hero 'Halloween Harry', Alien Carnage is an impressive game with no detail overlooked. Professional musical soundtrack, brilliant full-VGA graphics, non-stop animation and huge start-game and end-game cinematics. If Duke Nukem has a twin separated at birth, it's got to be Halloween Harry!

name: DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE
short_description: DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE revisits famous battles from the series through your custom Avatar and other classic characters. New features include the mysterious Toki Toki City, new gameplay mechanics, new animations and many other amazing features!

name: Subterrarium
short_description: Subterrarium is a puzzle game about digging, gardening, and vending machines.

name: Furi
short_description: The jailer is the key, kill him and you’ll be free.

name: Ascender
short_description: Ascender is a 2D explorative puzzle platformer. The game is set in the open world of GOA's districts, and the player will face many unique puzzles to solve.

name: Antarctica 88
short_description: Challenge yourself in an amazing and terrible story in the Antarctic ice!

name: RC Simulation 2.0
short_description: Drive all kinds of RC Cars, Boats, Rock Crawlers, Planes or Quadcopters on any of the 250+ Workshop Tracks. The game includes an in-game Track Editor and Vehicle Painter to create tons of scenarios and Paint schemes. RC Sim is made by a solo developer and still is in development.

name: The Use of Life
short_description: The Use of Life is a “game book”-style multi-ending JRPG. The main character’s various “attachments” fluctuate in accordance with the choices the player makes, and the ending changes depending on “the use of life” you choose through your journey.

name: Bloody Trapland 2: Curiosity
short_description: Take on the hard yet fair world of Bloody Trapland. Jump, slide, dash and dodge your way through the many deadly levels. Find secrets, solve puzzles, unlock mysteries and unravel the story. Go at it alone or bring your friends along for a co-op experience like no other. 1-4 players online and/or splitscreen.

name: Animal Doctor
short_description: Make your dreams come true with Animal Doctor! Would you like to spend your life caring for animals? With Animal Doctor you will be surrounded by animal friends and pets.

name: BattleSky VR
short_description: BattleSky VR is a Multiplayer VR flying first-person shooter, bringing Overwatch style gameplay to the VR platform. Each player picks a Hero with vastly different size, powers and gameplay style to engage in fast-paced aerial combats against other players.

name: Dreaming Atlas
short_description: 本游戏为roguelike回合制游戏，背景取材于中国古典神话，玩家扮演一位取经人，在完全随机的大地图中冒险，寻求机遇完成任务，提升自己，并管理寺庙，最终取得真经

name: Phantom Warfare
short_description: Phantom Warfare is a team-based FPS game, designed exclusively for VR. Choose one of three advanced weapons and make the best of your weapons to gain the victory。

name: RADARjAM
short_description: RADARjAM consists of the constant unpredictability of your enemy’s location. Dodge what you can't see in your radar equipped fighter!

name: The Silence Outside
short_description: The Silence Outside is a First Person Stealth Mystery game set on a space station in the near future. You play a freshly hired maintenance engineer thrust into the middle of a catastrophic power failure and caught between the competing interests of those on board.

name: Axiom Verge
short_description: Explore and uncover the mystery of a surreal alien world by blasting aliens and glitching your environment in this intense retro side-scrolling action/adventure.

name: Combo Postage
short_description: An action-packed platform-puzzle game! Dodge falling boxes, wrap them up in tape, then stomp them in stacks to rack up combos.

name: AREAZ
short_description: Survival cast away style game based on real survival experience and techniques. Adapt to various area(z), fight the exhaustion, manage your food income and energy consumption. Push your survival skills to the limits and conquer final barriers to reach your extraction point.

name: Corpse of Discovery
short_description: A first-person Walking Simulator exploring the deeper meaning of family, life goals, and personal choices (with a bit of humor and old-school sci-fi homage mixed in) – set on beautiful and lonely alien worlds.

name: Supreme Casino City
short_description: Let’s make your casino value up and enjoy it !

name: One Night In The House
short_description: One Night In The House is a first-person game with an emphasis on plot.

name: Cyclones Playground
short_description: Perfection County has been destroyed by a massive amount of tornadoes. The N.D.P.T. S.W.D. has been sent to Study and stop the record amount of tornadoes.

name: The Firelord
short_description: The Firelord is a platformer arena that tells of the adventures of a fire mage. Discover new abilities, create your own build and challenge the strongest fire magicians!

name: Maggie the Magnet
short_description: Science doesn't have to be boring! Use the powers of gravity and magnetic attraction to fling yourself across the laboratory and help Maggie solve dozens of puzzles to fulfill her mission as a researcher!

name: Imagine Lifetimes
short_description: A satirical point-and-click simulation game about the meaning of life. Born with the ability to choose, your actions and decisions shape the paths ahead of you. Question the absurdity of existence as you figure out what it means to be alive...

name: Aeve:Zero Gravity
short_description: 'Aeve:Zero Gravity' is an arcade space shooter about battles in open space. In a classic mode 'Shoot'em'all'

name: The Innsmouth Case
short_description: The Innsmouth Case is a text adventure game inspired by H.P. Lovecraft and the very first text-based adventure to combine horror and comedy in a fit and proper way.

name: Watson's Watch
short_description: A story driven game where the player assumes the role of a detective thrust into the middle of a series of disappearances on his relaxing vacation. Not only is the city of Watson’s Watch shrouded in mystery but so is our fearless detective. Unravel the story while dialogue interactions lead to its conclusion

name: Xeno Shooter
short_description: Xeno Shooter is a action shooter arena game! You play as a space cadet who travels to Andromeda with the mission of defeating the Primordials and thus, achieving a new home for humanity.

name: Ball of Wonder
short_description: Come with us to the magnicifent world of circuses.

name: Bridge Constructor Playground
short_description: Bridge Constructor Playground offers people of all ages an introduction to the topic of “bridge building”. This game gives you the freedom to let your creative side run riot – nothing is impossible. Across 30 innovative levels you have to build bridges over deep valleys, canals or rivers.

name: Blacksmith
short_description: Blacksmith is the definitive Blacksmithing experience. Make and sell Weapons, Armour and Tools. Send Heroes on Quests and unlock their unique potential. Grow the town of Ironwell and be a part of the community. Master the elements and bend them to your will! Find your true calling as the Blacksmith!

name: King Of Dirt
short_description: King of Dirt is actually best BMX game. You want tons of adrenaline and a lot of outstanding impressions? You dream is performing of Backflips, Supermans, and enormous number of other unbelievable tricks?

name: CORPSE FACTORY
short_description: Discard your sense of morality and enter the world of CORPSE FACTORY. An obscure website allows users to request a death. Victims supposedly receive a photograph of their own corpse before they are killed! With English voice acting by an all-star cast.

name: Skedaddle Out The Dungeon
short_description: Skedaddle Out The Dungeon is an indie developed Rogue-like. Fight your way through randomly generated dungeons against the many monsters that inhabit it. Collect unique items, coins, and bombs to help obliterate anything that stands in your way!

name: Cyber Driver
short_description: Cyber Driver is a small cyberpunk-style arcade flight game. It is fast, easy, tight, and repeatable, with elements of collection and challenges. Your only goal in the game is to constantly break the scores you have created before in the unique cyber atmosphere.

name: Wildlife Park 2 - Marine World
short_description: 'Marine Wolrld' offers 23 sea dwellers in 8 new Missions and 10 maps. A lot of new animaldevices, service, plants and decoration

name: Salvage Op
short_description: Engage in a series of Salvage Operations on deep space vessels which have been overrun. This virtual reality shooter uses a teleport mechanic which is friendly to those with motion sickness. Wield multiple weapons, interact with objects, and overcome your fears with a head mounted flashlight as you explore multiple challenging levels.

name: Sketchfab VR
short_description: Teleport yourself to Rome, hold a beating heart, or walk among dinosaurs. Open Sketchfab VR to discover a showcase of explorations through remote places, fantastic creatures, game worlds, cultural heritage, science and other wonders.

name: Incoming Forces
short_description: Prepare for one of the most action packed-shooters in PC gaming history! Every level is full of enemies and targets for you to destroy! You will become a soldier of the alien species and protect your home world from the forces of the Human armada.

name: AVA: Dark History
short_description: Mysterious, dark as night, hard as a saw platformer. AVA: Dark story in the world 'Koutei'

name: Porradaria 2: Pagode of the Night
short_description: O Ninja está de volta! Desta vez a procura do Lendário Saco de Batatas Fritas Infinitas!!

name: Easter!
short_description: World 'Easter!' big and mysterious, roam and explore it!

name: ZomB: Battlegrounds
short_description: Up to 16 players can join a match but only one can make it out alive. Jump out of the plane and land wherever you want. Scavenge for weapons, ammo, and other supplies and kill anyone you see.

name: LIGHTNING RETURNS™: FINAL FANTASY® XIII
short_description: Lightning Returns is the concluding chapter of the Final Fantasy XIII saga and series heroine Lightning's final battle. The grand finale of the trilogy brings a world reborn as well as free character customization and stunning action based battles.

name: Phoning Home
short_description: A tale of survival about two shipwrecked robots - ION and ANI - on their life-defining journey in this unique genre-mix of exploration, puzzle and survival.

name: POBEDA
short_description: Representative of the genre Shoot 'em up, performed in the style of retro games. In the game you have to take control of the crew of the KV-2. On the battlefield you will fight with tanks E-100, Tiger II, PzKpfw IV.

name: Dark Ages
short_description: In Dark Ages, you’re the Prince of the Great Kingdom, who as a child watched the King – your father – die at the hands of Garth, a power mad warlord with uncanny magical abilities. Garth sent you away from the Great Kingdom to be raised as a peasant, and to never fulfill your destiny as the future King. But Garth made a terrible mistake.

name: Atom
short_description: A simple hydrogen atom simulator.

name: On The Western Front
short_description: January, 1915. The Race to the Sea is over. The Great War has just begun. You are the commander of a single division in the meat grinder that is the Western Front. Lead your men over the top as you attempt to break the stalemate that is to claim the lives of millions over the course of years.

name: Astrog
short_description: ASTROG is a roguelike top-down action game with exploration and a simple progression system. Explore dynamically generated space, collect relics and artefacts, mine resources, upgrade your ship, experiment with skill combinations and fight hordes of enemies.

name: Circuit City
short_description: A relaxing city builder set on the tiny scale of a circuit board, where your data agents and electronic components sing a unique, procedurally-generated chiptune song for you as they work.

name: STAR WARS Jedi: Fallen Order™
short_description: A galaxy-spanning adventure awaits in Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order, a 3rd person action-adventure title from Respawn. An abandoned Padawan must complete his training, develop new powerful Force abilities, and master the art of the lightsaber - all while staying one step ahead of the Empire.

name: In Vitra - JRPG Adventure
short_description: Is there any truth to those rumours of a mysterious affliction spreading all over -In Vitra- ? The four heroes of this role-playing game with a turn-based combat system embark on an epic quest for a cure – and chance upon a far bigger mystery.

name: Beyond the Sunset 斜阳下的彼岸
short_description: Jessica, our protagonist, used to be a noteless writer. However, everything changed after she encountered a stranger…

name: The foreigner
short_description: 一件往事，一次邂逅，一段旅程，一丝乡愁，还有埋藏在砂尘的异国他乡的追忆

name: Cross Soul
short_description: A girl who is 'one person in two bodies' challenging a mystery dungeon. Items that can be transmigrated to change their form as well as spirit weapons. The story of a soul that spans the ages. And... tasty bananas.

name: Crew 167: The Grand Block Odyssey
short_description: Crew 167 finds himself alone on a spaceship hurtling towards a destination that may be the salvation that his home is seeking. Isolated, his mind begins to create hallucinations to keep him entertained. Dive into the mind of the character as he tries to make sense of the world around him.

name: The Trigger
short_description: The Trigger is a first person puzzle game. The goal of the game is to find a way out. Each time you start the game levels are procedurally generated. Generated from 50 to 70 rooms The maze is filled with traps. There are 3 types of traps in total.

name: Fighties
short_description: Fighties is a fast paced 2D platform fighter. Choose from a wide selection of Fighties each with their own unique play style. Beat down your opponents to become the strongest Fightie of them all.

name: BDSM: Big Drunk Satanic Massacre
short_description: BDSM is the first satirical action RPG where you get to play Lou, Satan’s son! Get some booze, kill the traitors, save Hell and rescue the hottest demoness from the clutches of those nasty people and mega-corporations!

name: Sleeping Beauty
short_description: You're walking by the riverside and notice an unconscious girl. You do everything you can to wake her up but fail to do so. Then, you notice a stranger jewel on her neck and take it... only to get involved in an erotic quest to save the kingdom!

name: The Astrolarix
short_description: Survive in the Astrolarix! A mysterious spacecraft with an unknown destination. This is an isometric adventure game with elements of survival, overcoming obstacles and find the safest route to progress in the story.

name: Beneath a Steel Sky
short_description: After being abducted by brutal soldiers and his kinfolk butchered, Robert Foster finds himself in Union City - a vast metropolis under the tyranny of a fascist AI. Alone, save for the circuit board of his best friend, Foster must discover the sinister truth - and why they specifically came for him.

name: Ricky did nothing wrong
short_description: Have fun with little puzzles in this Point & Click game! But be careful with the choices you make...

name: Crush
short_description: Crush is an old-school-styled shoot´em up. The game leads you through 7 challenging levels filled with action and great soundtracks. A must for all old-school shoot´em up fans!

name: Post Scriptum
short_description: Join the fight for victory in Post Scriptum, the only truly immersive WW2 collaborative tactical shooter. Ruthless realism with an impressive arsenal of authentic weapons and a detailed collection of vehicles across immense battlefields in this absolutely unique combined arms experience.

name: Tukoni
short_description: Tukoni is a point-and-click puzzle adventure, based on a series of award-winning books by the Ukrainian artist Oksana Bula. Play as Tukoni, the forest spirits, as you meet unique characters, solve captivating puzzles, craft new items, and explore a magical world filled with kindness.

name: Best of Us
short_description: It's the dawn of superpowers! Grab a cape and stand among the first heroes—or become the first villain!

name: ODIA
short_description: Slaughter the defenders of this dark land to claim the Cathedral. Utilize arcane weapons and dark magic to smite your enemies in this hardcore retro FPS inspired by early first-person shooter games.

name: SCP: Doki Doki Anomaly
short_description: SCP-8008-1 IS A HORROR DATING SIM WHERE THE BEST YOU CAN HOPE FOR IS SURVIVAL. SMOOCH SCP-173, SCP-682 AND EVEN SCP-096. DO NOT RUN THIS SOFTWARE WITHOUT CLASS-4 AUTHORIZATION.

name: Corpse Party 2: Dead Patient
short_description: High-schooler Ayame awakens from a coma in a seemingly abandoned hospital, strapped to an operating table. It turns out she’s not as alone as she thought, but she’ll come to wish she were. Step into the latest episodic installment in the Corpse Party saga, and try your best to survive treatment...

name: Ashi Wash
short_description: Clean a big nasty foot!

name: Laruaville 11 Match 3 Puzzle
short_description: That's not your regular Match3 game! It requires strategy. Unique game play, plus the town to build, a story and bonus games!

name: Star Chef: Cooking & Restaurant Game
short_description: Over 20 Million Downloads Worldwide! Play Star Chef, a cooking simulation game that celebrates delicious flavours, letting you run your own café and 5 star restaurant. Experience the joy of managing a bustling business dicing fresh ingredients while exploring your passion for cuisines across the world!

name: Polygon's Royale : Season 1
short_description: Polygon's Royal is the battleground survival game for everyone! It is a single player last man standing third/first person shooter for low spec pc’s with adjustable graphic settings for higher spec pc’s.

name: Necken
short_description: Necken is a tilebased roguelike set in the Swedish forest. It focuses on resource management and tactical decisions, rather than deep complex game mechanics. Movement is not turn based - everything moves freely, but the modular combat is. Necken is a small, simplistic roguelike hybrid.

name: Slay.one
short_description: Top-down multiplayer shooter

name: Valkalim
short_description: In Valkalim, you are in an unknown place tamed by enemies. There is something wrong with the sun, find out what happened and save the world from eternal darkness with the help of your axe and shield.

name: The Strayed
short_description: The Strayed is a classic old school side scrolling platformer with an original storyline, containing over 30 levels. This game is still in early access. Main hero is a young guy wandering around the strange island in search of his beloved, who disappeared after the crash of an aircraft on which they flew on vacation.

name: DepthQVR_AQUA
short_description: DepthQVR_AQUA is a fun, engaging, immersive ride & casual gaming experience. Also configurable for out-of-home PC Café, Entertainment Attractions, Brand Experiences, and Educational Attractions.

name: Shape Shooter
short_description: Shape Shooter is an action-packed, colorful, and hectic roguelike game. Survive increasingly harder random generated stages and collect relics, weapons, and active items to help you on your way. How long can you survive?

name: Bowl Bound College Football
short_description: One of the best college football simulation engines available, Bowl Bound College Football is the simulation game college football fans have been waiting for!

name: Need for Speed™ Hot Pursuit Remastered
short_description: Feel the thrill of the chase and the rush of escape behind the wheels of the world’s hottest high-performance cars in Need for Speed™ Hot Pursuit Remastered– a heart-pumping, socially competitive racing experience.

name: JungleKnight
short_description: This is a casual puzzle game, there will be small monsters on the road, the knight in order to get food need to avoid these monsters in order to get food forward!

name: CODE CRACKER 代码破译者
short_description: Relive nostalgic dream of that golden old age with the retrospective graphic. In this game, you play as a college student who meets diverse characters and solve multiple puzzles together with them. The story unfolds in different ways corresponding to the choices you made along with the gameplay.

name: Stargazer
short_description: When stargazer Zach watches the sky one night, he sees a star fall and land in the nearby woods. He rushes to check it out, only to find that out the star was actually a girl, and with her, magic returns to the world.

name: The Turkey of Christmas Past
short_description: The Turkey of Christmas Past is a third person, swordplay orientated, action game about Tom de Cat, master swordsman, and his one cat stand against the Turkey menace. With a fowl army hell bent on destroying Christmas, Tom is our last and only hope.

name: Filthy Lucre
short_description: Filthy Lucre is a tactical stealth HEIST game that gamers can play in single player and co-op, both split screen and online. With 15 missions across 5 locations, there are 30+ upgradable weapons and gadgets to unlock

name: Ball Escape
short_description: Open-World Puzzle Adventure

name: Train Chase
short_description: You escaped on a train, but the evil corporation is still chasing you. Defeat waves of enemies in a low-poly environment on a train with several of different weapons. Train Chase is a Wave Shooter optimized for VR, but playable with PC Hardware or Gamepad too.

name: My Dear Frankenstein -English Edition-
short_description: Play as man-made boy, Adam, in this emotional adventure. Explore the city at night in search of the fragments of his heart!

name: Whispers in the Dark
short_description: Whispers in the Dark is a mystical horror game in which you have to find yourself face to face with impenetrable darkness and what it keeps in itself. The nightmares of the past will come to life and will try with all their might to destroy you. Fear the whispers in the dark!

name: ICED
short_description: The protagonist goes winter fishing on a lake and is caught in a snowstorm. He decides to wait it out in a tent and falls asleep. When the cold wakes him up, he finds his burner empty, his tent cold, and the ice outside broken, leaving him with no way back to the shore.

name: Seven Mysteries: The Last Page
short_description: A horror RPG story-driven game about a group of students from the only school in a small strange town.

name: The Far Kingdoms: Forgotten Relics
short_description: In this Solitaire game you have to travel through 4 kingdoms and find stolen relics - play 150 Solitaire and Hidden Object levels!

name: Doomtrooper CCG
short_description: Get ready for demonic aliens, cyber-mechanical vehicles, and interplanetary chainsaw warfare! Doomtrooper is a digital adaptation of the physical card game by the same name. Play Warrior cards to form your squad and earn victory points by eliminating the enemy's forces. Now in Early Access!

name: Asteroid Bounty Hunter
short_description: Asteroid Bounty Hunter is a space shooter mixed with interesting boss fights and breathtaking visuals, with a reward system to take your skill to another level.

name: Haunt Chaser
short_description: Haunt Chaser is a 4 Player Co-Op horror game, can be played as a Single-Player too. Chasers need to use all the hunting equipment in order to banish the evil and save the poor souls from torment while uncovering deeply disturbing secrets. Also, there is a 4v1 party game mode.

name: Siegecraft Commander
short_description: Create the ultimate fortress and wreak havoc, raining destruction on your enemies with catapult-flinging fun!

name: Bad Sector HDD
short_description: Bad Sector is a game about immunizing a data storage device while a virus works against you.

name: Champions Of Chaos 2
short_description: Champions of chaos 2 is an Arena turn based RPG where the player can combine up to 10 different classes in a two man party to fight waves of enemies and gain reputation and allies. The battle system combine elements of “Grandia” and final fantasy with “Marvel vs Capcom” special moves.

name: Johnny Graves—The Unchosen One
short_description: Johnny Graves is an urban fantasy shooter that demands accuracy and fast reflexes. Johnny has a key role in the civil war of Hell. He has to fight his way through the front lines to help the lesser of two evils prevail...

name: Happy Penguin VR
short_description: Sometimes looks like Angry bird. The main viewing angle of the flight experience, skiing experience, swimming experience. A lot of fun.

name: Team Sonic Racing™
short_description: Team Sonic Racing combines the best elements of arcade and fast-paced competitive style racing as you face-off with friends in intense multiplayer racing.

name: THE KING OF FIGHTERS '97 GLOBAL MATCH
short_description: KOF ’97 is the final entry in the Orochi Saga, the original storyline of the KOF series, which is still played by enthusiastic fans around the world. KOF ’97 makes a return with new features such as online matchmaking, a new gallery mode, and custom menu BGM settings!

name: 魔法少女は自由に変身できない。
short_description: Magical girl 3D action shooting that can only transform for 15 seconds

name: A.R.M.: Absolutely Reliable Machine

short_description: Azuran Tales: Trials offers challenging combat, beautiful levels and merciless enemies to overcome. Journey across the World of Azuran as you discover its many environments, lore and history in a game that blends platformers with RPG elements.

name: SkyKeepers
short_description: SkyKeepers is a 2D action platformer following the journey of Tangi, as he desperately fights to reclaim both his world and life. Seamlessly chain together various attacks, launching foes skyward. When they’re airborne, teleport to your still hurtling foes to maintain the onslaught in visceral mid-air combat.

name: Escape From Earth
short_description: Escape from Earth is a 2D side-scrolling puzzle platformer adventure rpg. Your endearing alien character from the Planet Dyeog's normal day of delivering experimental space creatures has been turned upside down by mechanical errors on their ship. You find yourself hurling off course crashing into planet Earth.

name: Race & Destroy
short_description: Race&Destroy is an alternative view of racing genre in total. Earn money, upgrade and repair your car or buy a better car.

name: Slime's Revenge
short_description: Slime's have always been the bottom of the gaming food chain. But that is about to change. Slime's revenge is a short but challenging 2D platformer where you can fling yourself and stick to near any surface to reach the end of each level and fight back against the 'heroes'.

name: Initiation
short_description: Lost for far too long, he’s drowning in his loneliness looking for a lean comfort by remaining close to the same rock. His feelings elude leaving him in oppressive despair. How to find the spark to lit the darkness? In which form will it come to you?

name: Nebulas Lasso
short_description: Compete in this multiplayer battle-sport to capture the people of Earth. Utilizing each spaceship's unique weaponry and play-style are vital in achieving victory, where in this physics-based arena, mechanical skills, good understanding of each spaceship's strengths and weaknesses are critical.

name: Dawn of Fear
short_description: Dawn of Fear is a pure Survival horror where you have to solve puzzles in order to make improvements in the story. You will find notes that will be guiding you throught the narrative and you will have to administrate resources in order to get to the final stage of the game.

name: Last Contingency
short_description: Last Contingency is a post-apocalyptic survival game pushing survival to it's brink! start on the outer banks of a deserted island in hopes to move inland & find better loot! join a team or be a lone wolf either way keep a sharp eye or you might find yourself alone on the outer banks once again!

name: Bud Blitz
short_description: Bud Blitz is a fast-paced cannabis-themed action/arcade game with a splash of simulation. Grow your way to the top of the leaderboard while defending your crops from enemies by using a variety of outrageous weapons!

name: Stonescape
short_description: Completely destructible landscape to be explored, excavated and built on. Stonescape is a Fantasy game with destruction, building and exploration. An experience where the player can let their imagination take control.

name: Iron Lung
short_description: A short horror game where you pilot a tiny submarine through an ocean of blood on an alien moon.

name: Defend Your Castle
short_description: Defend your Castle against the relentless army of crayon invaders! Those crafty barbarian hordes have amassed their forces once again to challenge your domain. Will you and your court rise to the challenge, or stand aside as they raze your Castle to the ground?

name: Haimrik
short_description: Make words come to life in this action adventure unlike any other! Haimrik blends gameplay with the narrative of its story set in medieval times. Combined with crisp humor and rare visual style, Haimrik’s journey is sure to entertain. Word’s the word!

name: Timothy Leary's Mind Mirror
short_description: From the mind of Dr. Timothy Leary comes Mind Mirror, a trippy journey through your own mind. Mind Mirror is not just a game, it is a valuable tool to help you explore your own mind, make decisions, and to envision your ideal self. Play it by yourself or with a group of people.

name: Infinity Assassin (VR)
short_description: Infinity Assassin is an stealth action VR game that you can play with HTC Vive on PC. You can play various missions as an assassin in the medieval fantasy world.

name: The Long Gate
short_description: Explore mysterious caverns and solve the puzzles of the ancient machines that fill them.

name: Blaster Shooter GunGuy!
short_description: Blaster Shooter GunGuy is a 2D action rage platformer. Similar in nature to games such as IWBTG. But also inspired by Mega Man and Mega Man X.

name: CUBOTS The Origins
short_description: Be a part of an adventurous journey in Cubots: The Origins. Explore and survive in beautiful, atmospheric environments!

name: Blow & Fly
short_description: As a blowfish, traverse the world by rolling along the floor and propelling yourself through the air. Avoid the hazards and try to reach a vessel with water, which is vital for your survival.

name: Gronk Want Rock
short_description: Gronk want rock. bring rock from bottom to top.

name: Give It Up! Plus / 永不言弃 PLUS
short_description: Give It Up! Plus is an impossible music game that will challenge your skills and reflexes. If you enjoy sweating during the game, this is for you. Just don't blame the game if you start breaking things.

name: Ronister Adventure
short_description: Horrible creatures ravaged the entire autumn, taking their sacred fruits to other lands. Now Ronister goes out on an adventure around the world, facing various enemies and obstacles. On his journey he'll find vehicles and will get unique abilities to save our planet from the terrible Evil Bat.

name: Sacred Siren
short_description: Sacred Siren is a psychedelic virtual reality experience created for ᔕᙡᓮᙢ ᔕᗢᘎᒪᔕ's debut album, '𝔾𝕠𝕕𝕕𝕖𝕤𝕤', released on Business Casual.

name: Young Souls
short_description: Young Souls is a gorgeous 2D brawler meets story-rich action RPG. Fight hordes of belligerent goblins, level up with hundreds of weapons and accessories, explore, and journey between worlds, as rebellious twins battle their way to save their foster father.

name: BugOut
short_description: In this Modern Day Survival, you'll be faced with surviving in the Appalachian mountains while preparing for an apocalyptic event. Learn the skills you will need to survive, but keep up with what's going on, it's about to get really bad in the world, will you be prepared, Come and experience BugOut.

name: MotoGP™14
short_description: MotoGP™14 is back with a comprehensively overhauled and improved graphics engine. New game modes, all the riders from the 2014 and 2013 seasons and legendary riders from the history of the MotoGP™ give you the chance to live the dream of being a real rider.

name: Invadead
short_description: shoot at hordes of zombies using diffrent guns and grenades, epicly decimating them by your pure handsomeness.

name: DOUBLE INVASION!!
short_description: Push blocks. Shoot germs. Heal your body.

name: Lucky VS Aliens
short_description: Play for the penguin, who must protect his cows from UFO! Do not let the aliens pick up their cows and hit the flying saucer with dynamite and a built catapult!

name: Draft Day Sports: Pro Football 2022
short_description: Draft Day Sports: Pro Football 2022 puts you in the role of general manager of your favorite football team. Every decision can be made by you from drafting, trading, signing free agents right down to creating and calling your own plays to lead your team to championship glory and becoming a dynasty.

name: The Source of Evil
short_description: The source of evil - Hush-Hush Mission is a FPS adventure virtual reality game. Players are expected to have a ferocious fight with the mutated creatures in the abandoned underground lab.

name: 奇迹之旅

name: Sandwich Sudoku

name: Familiar Travels - Volume One
short_description: Familiar Travels is a different kind of graphic adventure with a focus on diverse relationships, an important, story and forging genuine connections with the cast.

name: Spelunky
short_description: Spelunky is a unique platformer with randomized levels that offer a challenging new experience each time you play. Journey deep underground and explore fantastic places filled with all manner of monsters, traps, and treasure.

name: Farmtale
short_description: Build your farm from one chicken and explore the world as you progress. Buy animals, harvest crops, hire workers for management, and advance through unique buildings, quests, upgrades, and items in the ultimate idle clicker hybrid!

name: Take That
short_description: Fast-paced Western shooting game, can quickly play the core content even if you only got 10 minutes break. Multiple modes are added to the game to help you kill time when you don't know what to play.

name: FETUS
short_description: Fetus is an arcade hardcore platformer set in ancient Rome.

name: Farmer Pug Dash
short_description: Your animals have all gone missing and it's your job to get them back! Find your animals in adventure mode and collect coins to decorate your farm! Find them all!

name: Spot Girls Difference
short_description: Spot Girls Difference is a game to find different things. Come on, find different things among all kinds of beautiful women. Every level will have a new beauty, and different places may be in any location of the beauty.

name: Bit Heroes
short_description: Explore a vast new MMORPG world inspired by your favorite pixellated dungeon crawlers. Collect and craft thousands of pieces of loot to increase your power. Build your team by capturing monsters and bosses to fight at your side in old school, turn-based combat.

name: Ruinverse
short_description: RPG with a two-souled heroine! Discover the mystery behind the stone monuments!

name: PopSlinger
short_description: Join a magical girl with a soda-powered arsenal on a dreamy quest to save her home! In this part beat-‘em-up, part musical shooter, you’ll experience the whimsical story of Ria and Gin as they fight against sinister invaders from another dimension…and maybe even groove to that funky beat!

name: Spaceflight Simulator
short_description: In Spaceflight Simulator, you will get to build your rockets, plan launches and flights, attempt landings, deploy payloads and explore new worlds.

name: Empty Handed
short_description: 2d point-and-click 3rd person indie horror game where you collect items and clues and solve puzzles to uncover a mystery while evading the frequent pursuit of an unstoppable killer.

name: Let's Split Up (A Visual Novel)
short_description: Let’s Split Up is a visual novel with 24 completely different endings that change not only the outcome but also the beginning, the setting and the characters themselves.

name: Boss Monster
short_description: Boss Monster is a dungeon-building game based on the boardgame of the same name.

name: Shakedown: Hawaii
short_description: Build a 'legitimate' corporation via open world missions, shakedowns, sabotage and property acquisition.

name: Lost Legends: The Weeping Woman Collector's Edition
short_description: It's up to you to stop the legendary Weeping Woman from terrorizing the children of San Cristobal!

name: Fantasy Mosaics 14: Fourth Color
short_description: Fantasy Mosaics 14: Fourth Color is a multi-color nonogram game that features pixel art puzzle designs and allows you to build a fantasy landscape that reflects your progress in the game.

name: Ultreïa
short_description: A little robot becomes a pilgrim and crosses a wild post-apocalyptic world to find the meaning of life.

name: 그랑 엠파이어
short_description: 강대국들과 이들에게 둘러싸인 인간의 왕국은 말하자면, 동아시아의 모에화와도 같습니다. 위기에 처한 인간의 왕국을 구원하고, 강대국의 지도자인 그녀들의 마음을 노리세요! 미연시적인 요소와 전략적인 요소를 경험하실 수 있도록 최선을 다했습니다.

name: Orbs
short_description: Orbs is a truly unique science-fiction multiplayer online role playing game featuring an open world where players are sent to explore, control and rule futuristic and mysterious zones in order to discover their secrets.

name: Crystal Quest Classic
short_description: Crystal Quest is a fast moving, adrenaline-boiling video arcade game from 1987 that won many awards. Now on the latest hardware.

name: Heckabomb
short_description: Explosive twin stick shooter. Lots of upgrades. Full controller support. Awesome soundtrack.

name: Super Bounce Ball
short_description: Bounce balls and collect star on the platform, easy in early levels, but gets harder. There will be rotating saws that move which you must avoid. Shooting turrets that fire bullets that you need to dodge.

name: VR Wonderland 2：Adventures in a Fruit Boat
short_description: In the game you will become a villain smaller than an orange, and then row a boat made of oranges, sailing on the sea.

name: Asura: Vengeance Edition
short_description: Asura is an Action Rogue-like set in a fantasy world inspired by the richness of Indian mythology. It features a unique procedural skill tree which changes on every play-through.

name: Trinity.Town: Monastery | Martial Arts and Meditation
short_description: You always wanted to train your martial arts skills in a perfect environment and practice with a virtual Bo or sword? Of course meditation belongs to the martial art. This brings strength for the ever new tasks you have to face every day. Transform your home into an incredible training arena and relaxing refuge.

name: Armoured Alliance
short_description: Control a tank in this realtime action strategy battle to capture all the bases. Use overpowered turrets to destroy your enemies by yourself or as a team.

name: Schizm: Mysterious Journey
short_description: SCHIZM: Mysterious Journey is graphical, first person perspective, 3D prerendered adventure game with a compelling nonviolent SF story combined with highly non-linear gameplay, where the player chooses the order in which most of the puzzles are solved.

name: Crash Forts
short_description: Crash Forts is an addictive physics and destruction game. You have to destroy various structures with the help of tools.

name: Cookie Store
short_description: Running a cafe is not an easy job. Especially when you're not making profits. Comedy, romance, friendship, and business combine in this unique Visual Novel!

name: The Floor is Jelly
short_description: The Floor is Jelly is a game that answers the question: what if everything you touched was made of jello?

name: Exo Racing
short_description: Exo Racing is for everyone who wanted to take part in illegal racing but been scared of legal consequences and risk of getting hurt.

name: Pokka Man
short_description: Pokka Man is a kidfriendly game for everybody. But a real challenge for the Retro classic gamers. Pokka Man Arcade is fun, challening and a difficult platform survival game. You begin at the top and you have to go down as far as possible through the dangerous obstacles. Reach the highest level with your skills.

name: Collapse
short_description: Challenge your building skills, record the fastest time you can finish a game, and watch out for collapses

name: Super Flipside
short_description: An ultra hard multitasking dodge 'em up.

name: Monsters sandbox
short_description: Multiplayer game with the ability to connect via LAN or Internet. Fight monsters alone or with friends. Find weapons and ammunition during the game or buy them in the store. Different game modes.

name: Wuxing Master 五行师(CCG)
short_description: 'Wuxing Master 五行师(CCG)' is a multiplayer online Collectible Card Game(CCG) which is based on Chinese traditional myths. Its rules and numerical value have been honed for ten years. Now the game is available for Windows, Android and iOS, on each of which can you share the data.

name: Fat Prisoner Simulator
short_description: Fat Prisoner Simulator - a soccer simulator where you play the role of a prisoner. The jail managers have noticed that some prisoners, who really like to eat a lot, can hardly go through the doors, including those of their cells.

name: Reversilly
short_description: Reversilly is a new type of real time chaos action game! that combines the familiar game of 'Reversi' with real-time action elements.

name: Godking: Master of Rituals
short_description: Godking: Master of Rituals is a fantasy strategy game inspired by great classics, bringing a host of new features and a rich new world to conquer. Pick your faction and your god-like avatar. Build your empire and crush all enemies in this glorious 4X with endless replayability.

name: Neither Day nor Night
short_description: Neither Day nor Night is a challenging, precision platformer. The Adventure of a girl trying to find her younger sister in a mysterious and bloody world. Use your skills to avoid obstacles, enemies, traps. Make your way through by thinking and doing - exactly in that order!

name: Fleeting Iris
short_description: Ayame is a beautiful girl from Japan that is living a carefree life in search of happiness. One fateful day, she met Robert, a CIA agent who was in Japan during a mission. They become engaged and move to America together. However, not all is as simple as her previous life!

name: Barbarous 2 - Tavern Wars
short_description: Join Emyr and the Barbarous party on an epic Time Management adventure!

name: Night & Day
short_description: The personifications of Night and Day learn to get along. Discover each other’s unique skills to help both Night & Day come to realize that new paths will open up if they work together.

name: FRACTER
short_description: FRACTER follows a veiled young hero who has set out on a perilous quest for light through a cryptic labyrinth of shadows.

name: Wildlife VR
short_description: A virtual reality hunting game, where you can shoot ducks, a deer, a boar, cans and TVs.

name: 2Dark
short_description: 2Dark is a stealth adventure game developed by Frédérick Raynal, the pioneer of survival horror games and creator of Alone in the Dark®. Make your way through the lairs of psychopaths, unravel intrigue where madness mingles with horror, and, above all, save the kids!

name: Rebels & Redcoats
short_description: Rebels and Redcoats recreates the battlefields of the American Revolutionary War. The war began in 1775 when the American colonies rebelled against the British Empire, declaring their independence in 1776.

name: Tiny Hill
short_description: Tiny hill - Are you ready to learn the story of a small hill? In this quirky hardcore platformer, you take on the role of a microscopic inhabitant of a small hill who is trying to collect as many coins as possible to fulfill his dream..

name: PhotoWorld: Smooth Сorners
short_description: PhotoWorld: Smooth Corners is a third person 3D visual game in which the world is created for the player.

name: SAVANNA SHOT VR
short_description: You are a savanna's National Park Ranger! With nature-rich savannah, you must drive a 4WD off-road car and use an anesthetic gun to manage the ecology of animals!

name: Tobari 2: Dream Ocean
short_description: Tobari is back in the latest action platformer from indie developer, desunoya. Use that staff and smack around your enemies for their magic as you traverse the Dream Ocean. Seek out the mysterious voice that calls to you from beyond the sea as you journey with Tobari into this unknown new world.

name: Mr. Shadow
short_description: Mr. Shadow is a 2D graphic adventure game. The player uses a simple point and click interface to solve diverse puzzles. Enter a surreal and dark world inhabited by shadows.

name: Shanghai Office Simulator
short_description: What’s really going on in those offices in the Far East? Do they really work 210 hours a week, getting paid pennies on the dollar? Find out the answers to these questions and more, unless of course, you fear KANG GE, overlord of the cubicles, in which case you wouldn’t last a minute in Shanghai...

name: Exteria
short_description: Exteria is an old school fantasy first person shooter. Play through the short story and fight for a highscore in survival mode!

name: RollingSky
short_description: Rolling Sky is a ball running game that combines rhythm and fun.

name: King Boo
short_description: Play as King Boo, who unfortunately has lost their royal adornments and must find them back before being allowed back in the castle! A simple, colorful adventure game for young players.

name: H-Isekai Loves
short_description: What will you do when you are accidentally transported to another world? Looking to survive and return to the old world ? Or become the main character of this story? Try our new game. And of course, this is your chance to make your own Harem. Definitely !

name: Pavlov VR
short_description: Pavlov vr is a multiplayer shooter in VR with heavy focus on community features. Realistic reloading features and fast paced combat as part of the core experience. Play the #1 most popular VR shooter on PC today.

name: Guardian of The Demon Valley
short_description: This is an exciting shooting game.The game is set in a dark canyon, you’ll play a warrior who swears to defend the saint ice crystal that seals the devil with his life. would you be able to complete the mission of defending the sealing ice crystal against the horrible monsters’ continuous offensive?!

name: Jack troubles
short_description: This is a first person shooter game,The player is a shooter with multiple weapons,Players are free to explore the surrounding area,Enemies are scattered around the player and inside buildings,Players can kill enemies or avoid enemy attacks and maintain health,Players can also grab enemy weapons.

name: The Witcher Adventure Game
short_description: The Witcher Adventure Game is a digital adaptation of CD PROJEKT RED’s board game set in the brutal fantasy universe of monster slayer Geralt of Rivia. Travel across the beautifully rendered world of The Witcher and complete a variety of quests — hunt deadly beasts, solve ancient mysteries and more.

name: Quiet Godo
short_description: You're home alone. Explore the rooms, find the keys, and, most of all, watch your tongue!

name: Kittypocalypse
short_description: Kittypocalypse is an in-depth, strategic tower defense game built exclusively for VR. Across a diverse range of environments, defeat the hordes of evil alien kitties and salvage what's left of your home planet

name: A Small Robot Story
short_description: A Small Robot Story is an adventure-platformer where you play as Rae, a small robot who activates and has no idea why. So you need to set out and find out what's up! With a heavy emphasis on story, A Small Robot Story will take you through forests, factories, caves, laboratories, and more.

name: SOLRAVEN
short_description: You are the best pilot of Republic. Your mission is cease the launch of enemy nuclear missile.

name: Beach Pong
short_description: An interesting arcade game in which you need to hit the ball and try to beat the opponent. Classic pong under the scorching southern sun!

name: Zero Tolerance
short_description: Created by Randel Reiss Kill or Be Killed If this 3D game doesn't your adrenaline pumping, nothing will. Zero Tolerance has you killing alien terrorists who want to annihilate your defense colony.

name: Album Corvus
short_description: A dark fantasy dungeon crawler/roguelike. Fight one-on-one in turn-based combat. Find gear that improves or completely changes your tactics. Delve procedurally generated dungeons where choices matter. Die, upgrade your characters, unlock new skills and experiment with perks to find the best build.

name: Seven Deadly Dates
short_description: You've studied latin for a few months and you accidentally read a passage from your textbook which lands you in a demon speed dating bar. Unsure of how to get home, you decide to ride it out and see how things go. Maybe you'll even find a date! Or maybe you'll find death? Who knows...

name: Smaller
short_description: Enter Smaller, a world of things that are larger than you. Help George to overcome his shrunken condition and return to his right size. But, you must overcome the dangers of this fantasy world.

name: Realms of Antiquity: The Shattered Crown
short_description: A retro-CRPG for the TI-99/4a home computer, also playable in modern Windows.

name: Attack of the Mutant Penguins
short_description: Wade In And Kick Some Penguin Butt! Unfortunately they are really tough nuts to crack and have a vicious streak running through them that threatens the peaceful tranquility of your world. Mutant Penguins is a truly bizarre concept, wholly original, and with the emphasis placed firmly on FUN.

name: 不充钱还想过关的坦克大战？

name: Mindframe: The Secret Design Collector's Edition

name: Xenociders
short_description: Hide, hunt and be hunted. Xenociders is a tense stealth VR shooter set on a lush planet ruled by ferocious alien dinosaurs.

name: Candy land
short_description: In front of you are cards with different 'delicious' images. The images are hidden from you. You need to find all pairs of identical images. You can open two cards at the same time. Remember the pictures, look for their pairs, and try to use as few attempts as possible.

name: Shine's Adventures 6 (Go! Girls)

short_description: ★★★ PINT-SIZED POWERED-UP RACING ★★★ Get behind the wheel of 12 ultra-cool, fully tune-able miniaturized racing cars and take on 20 race tracks and some devious opponents through a comprehensive 'Championship Mode' and a multitude of 'Special Events'. Get online for an 8 player multi-player battle and become the ultimate Table Top racer!

name: Fabrication
short_description: Fabrication is a story-rich turn-based RPG. In an effort to uncover the truth behind their recent schemes, a rebellion rises against the ruling authority known as the Government. You will play as four individuals drawn by this common goal.

name: Cross Country Skiing VR

name: Let's Learn Janggi (Korean Chess)
short_description: Study piece movements, checkmate conditions and tactics; learn Janggi inside out! Solve endgame puzzles and play against AI opponents, perfecting your Janggi strategy.

name: LVL99: AxeRage

name: Grim Dragons

This story begins with the belated start of school life for Hinako Shirai, who has just recovered from a leg injury due to a tragic accident. The magical sisters Yuzu and Lime bestowed to her a special power to become a 'Reflector'.

name: The Undying Plague
short_description: The Undying Plague is a top down shooter where your task is to fend off waves of attacking enemies and survive as long as possible. At your disposal will get a few weapons that we can improve for the money earned on the battlefield. Enter a world of pain, suffering and bloodthirsty zombies. Can you stop the plague?

name: Cube Defender 2000
short_description: Laser bolts threatening your cube's existence? Let them come and render their petty attacks useless.

name: RoBoRumble
short_description: Build powerful battle robots from components like Chassis, Weapon and Booster. The battle’s starting and you’re right in it – with freely definable camera perspectives, spectacular effects, unlimited zoom and scroll, colored light sources, terrain morphing and 3D sound. Pure action – pure excitement!

name: 1001 Jigsaw. World Tour: Australian Puzzles
short_description: 1001 Jigsaw World Tour: Australia. A puzzle game and tour guide!

name: The Cathedral: Allison's Diary
short_description: Two years later from 'The Hospital', you are interested in visiting the place where Rachel and Alfredo should have been buried. 'The Cathedral' is the second chapter of the Allison's Diary horror saga. In the sacred cathedral of Sant'Andrea there is something frightening waiting to be discovered.

name: The Catacombs of Solaris Revisited
short_description: The goal of the game is to find your favourite room in the catacombs.

name: Beat Aim - Rhythm FPS Shooter
short_description: Beat Aim - rhythm aim trainer designed for FPS players with AI generated maps. Makes improving your aim incredibly fun while listening to your favorite songs. Open any music and customize level generation. Combination of osu! and KovaaK's trainer.

name: Mini Island: Autumn
short_description: Mini Island: Autumn is a one small hold & Gun, boss Rush mini-game of Casual difficulty!

name: FlowDot
short_description: An indie game for people that like a challenge!

name: Lords of the Realm II
short_description: The great Lords of England have their eyes on the the English throne! Muster an army and overrun your enemies' castles in this classic, nail-biting strategy game that blends turn-based and real-time gameplay.

name: Fantasy Dungeon VR
short_description: Fantasy Dungeon VR is a roguelike dungeon crawler with gesture-based abilities. Use more than just your sword for fighting.

name: RTAG rise
short_description: Die, Respawn, Try again. RTAG rise is a rage inducing, 'get from point A to B and don't get impaled along the way' platformer. Quick, responsive controls; Instant Respawn and the ability to play with up to 3 other players is the core of RTAG rise

name: DreamWatcher
short_description: Welcome to the Great Library of Dreams, where chaos has just been unleashed! Play as The Agent in this fantasy 3D Metroidvania filled to the brim with surprising secrets, daring traversal, confounding puzzles and menacing monkeys. Rid the library of the creatures wreaking havoc and bring back order!

name: Mana Maker
short_description: Magic is a wonderful thing, so why not make more? In Mana Maker, your goal is to make mana so you can conjure minions to do it for you! Once you conjure Cthulhu you may ascend and unlock even more possibilities!

name: Inside Grass
short_description: Children have dug a magic medallion, as a result of which they shrink to the size of insects in their garden! One of them is kidnapped by ants. You need to find magical medallion and rescue your family!

name: Undarkened: Revival
short_description: Undarkened is a wizarding survival-adventure game where you must unravel the mystery of what, or who, corrupted your homeland. Explore a devastated world alone or with your friends, find out what happened, and try everything you can to save your home.

name: Eschew
short_description: Eschew is a bullet hell where you play as an unknown alien visitor, traveled to Earth in search of a stolen, cosmic power source. Survive the overwhelming onslaught of Earth's military might!

name: Player Power
short_description: A chaotic football arcade game!

name: Arcadia Fallen
short_description: Play the role of a young alchemist apprentice who is unwillingly bound to an illegal spirit. Suddenly drawn into a war between humanity and magic, they must join a group of unlikely heroes to escape their own doom, hopefully saving the world along the way.

name: WRC 7 FIA World Rally Championship
short_description: Take on all the challenges of the 2017 World Rally Championship: the official cars and drivers, 13 countries, 52 Special Stages, every surface, more powerful cars, more demanding physics, longer races, and an eSports mode to keep you on the edge of your seat all year round.

name: The Great Tournament
short_description: Play a young peasant boy who becomes squire to a legendary knight. Travel the realm competing in jousts, archery, and melee competitions. Train hard in order to become a powerful knight and eventually compete in The Great Tournament to decide the fate of the realm in this medieval story.

name: Quiet Valley
short_description: Explore and uncover the mysteries behind the haunted Quiet Valley High School. Classic style indie horror, with an abstract disorienting visual style. Make your way through to discover the two different endings!

name: Squally
short_description: Squally is a 2D puzzle RPG programming game that teaches you how to hack. Control the world by rewriting it in x86/x64 assembly language!

name: Perfect Tides
short_description: Perfect Tides is a point and click adventure game about the agony and anticipation of being a teen. Set in the year 2000, you follow Mara, an internet-obsessed young writer who lives on a so-called island paradise.

name: Aarklash: Legacy
short_description: In Aarklash: Legacy take command of a mercenary squad in search of truth and guide it through countless battles.Welcome to Aarklash, a land of chaos where incessant battles between the forces of Light, Destiny and Darkness have lasted since the beginning of time.

name: Utopia Process
short_description: Pilot two ships to protect the last cities on Earth

name: CRYPTARK
short_description: Cryptark is a 2D sci-fi shooter where you take on the role of a heavily armed privateer seeking to earn government contracts by boarding deadly alien space-hulks. It's up to you to strategize a plan of attack, pick an equipment loadout, and destroy the central core to be victorious.

name: Vaccine
short_description: Heal the sick, save the world! You will master simple levels in an addicting and challenging missions to save the world!

name: Construction Machines 2014
short_description: Become a boss of a construction company. Demolish old houses, flatten the ground, fill foundations with concrete and build new buildings - this is what you do. Sit behind the wheel of different construction machines - from trucks and diggers to huge cranes.

name: 1, 2, 3... Bruegel!
short_description: A playful VR experience into Pieter Bruegel the Elder’s painting “Children’s Games”.

name: Sanguine Melancholia
short_description: A turn-based RPG set in a dystopian future. With Earth's population decimated and demons roaming the planet, the governing Council decides to outlaw hunting down the beasts. With their administration having failed them, it falls to a small group of rebellious Hunters to keep innocents safe.

name: Steel Empire
short_description: Steel Empire is a steam punk shoot'em up game featuring a frantic combat filled with powerful enemies and insane obstacles. Enjoy a beautiful world and retro game-play as you dodge and shoot your way through classical stages to fight the evil empire!

name: Elsewhere High: Chapter 1 - A Visual Novel
short_description: Welcome to Elsewhere High, 'a school for exceptional children.' In this visual novel, players are able to immerse themselves in the world of the outcast. Each student at Elsewhere High has fallen short of expectations at their original high school; they've flunked out, skipped class, wrote threatening notes, or grew to be a...

name: Elven Legend 2: The Bewitched Tree
short_description: Elven Legend 2 - exciting time-management strategy in a fantasy world, where an evil witch has bewitched the Life Tree of the Elven Kingdom.

name: Won't You Be My Laser?
short_description: An 80s-themed puzzle game in which you avoid the line of sight of lethal gun turrets... while acquiring pick-up sticks.

name: DARK
short_description: DARK is a unique stealth-action game with RPG elements in which you take on the role of the ultimate hunter: a vampire. Ambush your enemies from the shadows, roam the darkness and use powerful vampire skills to dispatch your opponents.

name: Rebound Ball
short_description: An arcade game. You have to use the ball to destroy figures on the level to go further.

name: Traffic Jams
short_description: In this wacky VR game, control traffic your way in the face of outrageous events and flagrant road rage. Easy? Think again! Traffic Jams throws in monsters, (un)natural disasters, and up to 4 non-VR friends in party mode!

name: 无上道
short_description: 《无上道》是款东方仙侠题材的ARPG网页游戏，主要讲述了主角聚集神州和四荒改造为永界，领导众生走向全新文明的故事。 游戏画面大场景绘图、特色打斗效果设计、丰富的人物造型，将角色的英雄儿女气概展现地淋漓尽致，高度展现唯美仙侠世界。 玩法方面，伴随着剧情推进，各类高级神器、神秘灵宝将不断升级解锁，玩家战力也会随之提升，远古神物、威武坐骑、激萌伙伴，都将一一来到，并一直陪伴玩家战斗。

name: Almightree: The Last Dreamer
short_description: The world is shattering and you are the only hope to restore the balance. A thrilling and challenging 3D puzzle platformer game, Almightree: The Last Dreamer has you racing through a crumbling world to find your way to awaken the life giving Almightree.

name: The Cave
short_description: Assemble your team of three from seven unlikely adventurers, then descend into the mysterious depths to explore The Cave!

name: The Waylanders
short_description: Slip the bonds of fate in this party-based RPG filled with Celtic myth and historical legend. Discover thrilling adventure alongside mortal companions and immortal allies as you explore the world of The Waylanders.

name: Interactive Fiction and Adventure Creator (IFAC)
short_description: IFAC is a system to create old school text adventure games and interactive fiction. Enter scenes/locations, interconnect them with movements, add items and use IFACs built-in language to program complex responses to player input and game state. It's a rapid development tool to tell your story.

name: Chessboard Kingdoms
short_description: Chessboard Kingdoms is a multiplayer, turn-based strategy game inspired by the chess mechanics. Employ warriors and engineers, build siege machines, construct walls and towers, consult your court wizard — all while exploring vast landscapes of the realm and satisfying your puzzle-solving appetite.

name: Next Day: Survival
short_description: Next Day is a multi-player SURVIVAL game with elements of RPG, in an imaginary country in Eastern Europe. Carry out an array of tasks, learn skills, and develop your character. Have shootouts with opponents and earn a reputation.

name: The mouse and the cheese
short_description: An arcade-style strategy / maze game!! Collect all the cheeses to pass the level !!

name: Total War: WARHAMMER II
short_description: Strategy gaming perfected. A breath-taking campaign of exploration, expansion and conquest across a fantasy world. Turn-based civilisation management and real-time epic strategy battles with thousands of troops and monsters at your command.

name: Stupid Stories
short_description: Stupid Stories - A 2D adventure. Travel through time and relive your grandfather's exciting adventures, or at least how he remembers them.

name: Starship Theory
short_description: Starship Theory is a ship building survival game. Mine and trade to gather resources. Plan and construct new upgrades. Train and manage crew. Fight to survive.

name: Red's Kingdom
short_description: Help lead Red on a journey across the land in search of his missing nuts, overcoming obstacles and unlocking abilities in this charmingly epic isometric puzzle adventure!

name: League of Angels-Heaven's Fury
short_description: 'League of Angels – Heaven's Fury' is a revolutionary 3D online action RPG that takes place in a fantastical world loosely based on Western mythology.

name: Moon Observatory Iris
short_description: Otome game. A story made to heal both the reader and writer's heart.

name: Pecaminosa - A Pixel Noir Game
short_description: Pecaminosa is a Police Action RPG, in which you embody a disgraced detective on the strangest case of his career: helping the ghost of a dead mobster in his aim to wash away his sins and reach for Heaven. Grab your gun, hit the streets and do what you do best: investigate and interact with the scum

name: Timmy the Tiger's Big Adventure
short_description: This is a small game designed to be a cute, fun, and casual experience for gamers of all ages. It was made in RPGMaker XP so the controls are simple and easy to use. Take control of a tiger and guide him to his new home, after a mysterious disaster threatens to destroy everything he knows.

name: Tactical Troops: Anthracite Shift
short_description: Top-down, turn-based game that mixes tactical skills and the feeling of 80's sci-fi movies. Command a troop of soldiers in a singleplayer campaign or fight on one of 24 multiplayer maps. Explore the planet Anthracite, using advanced teleportation technology and gridless movement.

name: Vacation Adventures: Park Ranger 13
short_description: Help run Pinecreek Hills and New England’s Minuteman Valley Help the famous Park Rangers run Pinecreek Hills. Have fun organizing events on Bluewaters lake, Cherokee river and Apache trail.

name: BirdGut
short_description: BirdGut is a hand-drawn 2d puzzle-platformer from the perspective of an outcast bee who gets eaten by a bird, and discovers that the bird's internal organs are not organs at all, but facilities in which the consumed insects are brainwashed and enslaved. Experience this bizarre one-man project for yourself.

name: TankVR
short_description: TankVR is a open world arcade tank game, where you have to destroy all hostile tanks. The objective is to destroy all tanks on the map. After the game is finished, your score is now shown in the leaderboard. Challenge your friends, if you are brave enough.

name: Crowd Simulator
short_description: It's really crowded!!! Crowd Simulator is a unique, fun experience that places you in different crowd scenarios. The main objective is to move with and against crowds.

name: Carton
short_description: Enter into the universe of cardboard, the ground, grass, trees, characters, everything is cardboard ! Make and explore your continent for finding a place where you can build your town. Survive of seasons and the night attack of goblins. Create a warrior group and assault the goblin castle !

name: Panzer Paladin
short_description: Hop in the Paladin power armor, seize melee weapons from the demonic invaders and give them a taste of their own medicine!

name: Airball
short_description: In this classic isometric action game, you have been transformed into a fragile ball of air by an evil wizard. Can you make your way through over 250 fiendish rooms to find the means to turn yourself back into a human?

name: Cellyon: Boss Confrontation
short_description: Cellyon: Boss Confrontation is a multiplayer online co-operative game (or MOCO) that brings boss fights to the competitive scene. How? A group of up to 4 players, custom character abilities and challenging battles against deadly bosses where you will have to be strategic and quick to react.

name: AVA: Dog Tag
short_description: A.V.A: Dog Tag is a, military-themed, team-based tactical First Person Shooter based on class-distinctive weaponry and strategy. Choose your fight in close quarter combat, hold down key engagement points, or zone out enemy team as a sniper and pick them apart.

name: Harsh
short_description: Open World Survival RPG set in a high fantasy environment. Craft items and fortresses, wield spells and magical equipment as you face everything from undead to intelligent factions whose reaction towards you is based on your treatment of them.

name: 修仙重生记

name: Tokyo Xanadu eX+
short_description: Tokyo Xanadu eX+; a massive action RPG from the masters of the genre, Nihon Falcom! When high school student Kou Tokisaka encounters the nightmare realm known as the Eclipse, his world is forever changed.

name: OfficeBots: Reality Bytes [VR]
short_description: OfficeBots: Reality Bytes is a little game with a big heart. Explore a wonderfully weird corporate office, listen to your robotic co-workers’ stories, and help to solve their problems. Ultimately your goal is to find a way to escape, but your journey to freedom will give you many opportunities to brighten up another's life.

name: JAB!
short_description: Stab, shoot or blow up your friends. JAB! is the physics-based party game where you collect silly bobbleheads and fight with guns and lightning bolts and stuff.

name: Longshot Universe

short_description: It’s the year 1850, and there are great times ahead! Establish a transport company and be its manager. Build infrastructure such as railways and stations, purchase transportation vehicles and manage lines. Fulfill the people’s needs and watch cities evolve dynamically.

name: A Dog Named Mato

short_description: Play as a former captain (of a space ship) on the run in the frist part 'painful days at home' when your ship crashed and you had to hide inside the home of some unknown guy. Enjoy a gameplay with no hassle, as time doesn't matter here, promise.

name: Elpida: Crônicas de uma guerreira
short_description: Elpida é um RPG onde o jogador vive as aventuras de Rebeca, uma destemida que visa realizar a sua tão esperada vingança contra os assassinos de seu pai. Devido a isso, ela enfrenta diversos desafios sem ao menos abaixar a cabeça.

Build shelters to keep protected and tools to assist in the tasks, try to create alliances with other survivors, explore this new world to find new ways to stay alive in a survival game in...

name: ReCore: Definitive Edition
short_description: From creator Keiji Inafune and the makers of Metroid Prime comes the ReCore: Definitive Edition, an action-adventure crafted for a new generation. As one of the last humans, forge friendships with robotic companions and lead them on an epic adventure through a dynamic world.

name: Fourtex Jugo
short_description: A challenging single-player strategy puzzler with rule-based mechanics and hand-crafted levels.

name: PAPER BIRDS
short_description: Paper Birds is a 30 minute interactive story about a young musician in search of true inspiration. Starring Ed Norton, Joss Stone, and Archie Yates, this VR film offers unique moments of interactivity, inviting you to conduct music, unlock portals, light up the invisible world, and more.

name: Railroad Pioneer
short_description: Be a pioneer and build the most famous transcontinental railroad tracks in the United States of America throughout the 19th century.

name: Please Find Me
short_description: This game is horror. Michael, an ordinary clerk went on a camping trip and got into trouble. During the trip in the forest a heavy rain began and he had to shelter in a cave, what happens next will depend on your choice.

name: RockaBowling VR
short_description: RockaBowling is a VR bowling game set to a classic rockabilly theme. Enjoy immersive visuals and solid gameplay as your ears are filled with classic sounds of rock.

name: Resurgence
short_description: When his daughter Rosie goes missing after a car crash, Jason Dawn thinks his debts with the mob have come back to haunt him. His past leads him to a final confrontation where Jason learns the terrible truth.

name: Sakura Shrine Girls
short_description: Two cat girls appear before Toru, a skeptical priest in training. One of them carries herself with dignity and grace, while the other lives her days without a single care. With them, Toru slowly realises that there is more to this world than there seems.

name: Street Heat
short_description: Four-player arcade racing with a sensational synthwave soundtrack! Take to city streets in local or online mutiplayer and race across hazardous tracks. Boasting an unbelievably satisfying handling model, Street Heat will have you punching the air as you master its seat-of-your-pants drift physics.

name: Escape Bloody Mary
short_description: If you summon an evil spirit, you have to be prepared to face the consequences. Locked in your bathroom you must use your surroundings to stop Bloody Mary from coming through your mirror and claiming your soul in this thrilling VR escape. Bloody Mary… Bloody Mary… Bloody Mary…

He awakes in the middle of the night to discover blood everywhere, a rampaging killer on the loose dressed in a mascot costume and himself involved in a deadly game of cat and mouse!

name: Forest Legends: The Call of Love Collector's Edition

name: Grapple Dog
short_description: Jump, Swing and Zip your way through colourful worlds and exciting challenges in this unique 2D action-platformer! Master the power of the Grapple on your adventure to save the world!

name: Riddle Joker

name: Star Puzzle
short_description: A beautiful puzzle game in which you collect pieces into a whole picture, choosing between difficulty levels and dozens of levels, improving your skills, limited time and lives.

name: Water Margin - The Tale of Clouds and Wind

Vengeful forces seek to destroy the heroic outlaws of Mount Liang. A tale of immortal deeds now begins, let all listen and take heed.

name: Heart of the House
short_description: When your uncle Kent mysteriously disappears, you'll embark on a journey find out what really happened. What will you sacrifice when trapped in a haunted manor? Will you destroy this evil or claim its power? And can love bloom in a haunted house?

name: Pathologic Classic HD
