short_description: Arcade Mode: Challenge up to 3 of your friends in different arenas in this unique and colorful experience and be the very best invader! Cellz simulates the journey of a bacterium in the human body where your only goal is to successfully destroy all the organism, one organ at a time!

name: The Majesti
short_description: Before there were cities, towns, or even people, magical animals known as Majesti ruled the world. Discover the Majesti's origin. Uncover the secret of their power. Travel 200,000 years to discover their fate: utopia...or extinction?

name: Exodus H
short_description: Take command of your own colonial ship. Ensure the survival of your inhabitants and try to find a new habitable planet. This is the goal of the the Exodus H Space Commanders.

name: Broken Ground
short_description: Broken Ground is a multiplayer artillery game with destructible terrain and lots of weapons.

name: Multiscreens
short_description: A program in VR that lets you have as many virtual monitors as you want.

name: Ants! Mission of the salvation
short_description: Sweet little universal strategy game inspired by Lemmings. The action may be slow, but the challenges are tough and the yummy images will bring you back to the table over and over. You may even feel the need to bake a cake while playing.

name: WizardPunk
short_description: Become the wizard you always wanted to be! A mix of the fighting and roguelite genres, WizardPunk allows you to play any of the 4 playable characters the way you want to play them. Become a Shaman, Alchemist, or Witch to further customize your abilities.

name: Serpent Fusion
short_description: Serpent Fusion is a difficult puzzle game based on Snake where you grow longer by attaching boxes to your back instead of eating food. From this, you also gain the ability to stand still and move backwards, allowing you to reverse into boxes and stick to them.

name: Combat Wings
short_description: It’s the 4th of June, 1942, and Japanese bombs are raining down on Midway – and you. This lethal assault is a prelude to an invasion whose success gives the enemy control over the Pacific. You are one of the American airmen who hold the outcome of this decisive battle in their hands.

name: Handy Dandy
short_description: The two adventurers Handy and Dandy have caused a dimensional tear which is now separating them and the entire cave where they have to solve platforming puzzles to reunite again in this 2D co-op game.

name: Otter of My Life
short_description: Meet your significant otter~

name: Swarm Universe
short_description: A highly modifiable top-down shooter featuring highscore-driven singleplayer challenges and online-multiplayer competition. You get arenas, racetracks, mini-games and various online-multiplayer modes. Plus powerful modding-tools to create your own levels and game-modes.

name: Space Force Squadron
short_description: Space Force Squadron is a horizontal 2d shmup. Choose between 4 pilots with different spaceships and different attributes. Buy upgrades for ships using points earned in battles. This is arcade style game, meaning there is no possibility to save.

name: Ice Caves of Europa
short_description: Ice Caves of Europa will challenge your reflexes and your mind, blending free-flowing precision flight with confronting science fiction ideas about the nature of humanity. An inquisitive flying robot exploring the hazardous caves beneath Europa stumbles upon a sinister interplanetary conspiracy.

name: Kinaman vs Gray Elephant
short_description: Hardcore platformer Kinaman vs Gray Elephant. Inspired by the stories of one blogger about childhood.

name: The Island: Into The Mist
short_description: 'The Island: In To The Mist' is an adventure game. It includes basic features of adventure genre and add some new systems to interest you. You have been given a chance to experience a group of university students, who confined in the island. There is a terrific but interesting story you will see.

name: New Outbreak
short_description: New Outbreak is a 2D top-down zombie survival game. It allows you to survive how you want, build the things you want and take care of your companion.

name: How to Fool a Liar King
short_description: Regina finds herself magically transported to the land of Eroolia, clueless about how to return home. She meets Juli and his companions who are in the middle of a journey to Laarz, a country of cat people. Will she find out how to get back home? Or will she fall in love before that happens?

name: Bientôt l'été
short_description: Bientôt l’été is a videogame for two players. Two players who pretend to be lovers. They pretend to be lovers separated from each other by lightyears of deep space. They have lonely walks along the shore of a simulated ocean, thinking wistful thoughts of each other. Thoughts from ancient Earth literature by Marguerite Duras.

name: Spirit Run - Fire vs. Ice
short_description: Get ready for the run of a lifetime. In this endless platformer you play an elemental spirit that has the ability to change form. Spirit Run: Fire vs Ice is inspired by games such as the platformer Canabalt and the classic shoot ‘em up Ikaruga.

name: Caelum: Into the Sky
short_description: Caelum is a world of many wonders and treasures, in development for the HTC Vive. This world holds many secrets, and some have been unearthed by the events of the past. Some are hidden behind massive doors some behind riddles and puzzles, it is up to you to find your way and snatch up the glory and wealth.

name: Hack, Slash & Backstab
short_description: Hack, Slash & Backstab is a 1 - 4 player arcade dungeon crawler with a twist! Work together as warrior, rogue, wizard and archer to survive a dangerous world. But only one player will be crowned the winner: it becomes a fight to the death, as betrayal and backstab become the tools of choice.

name: Skateboarding pro
short_description: Skateboarding pro is a skate game set in the United States. Take control of your skateboarder to skate through cities to complete the objectives of each scene

name: Dread Templar
short_description: Dread Templar is a fast-paced retro FPS that combines 90s classic shooter elements with modern skill-based FPS controls. You are a Dread Templar who entered Hell seeking revenge. But in order to get it, you have to fight your way through the dark realm!

name: Maniac Path 2
short_description: Maniac Path 2-this is the continuation of a crazy game about a maniac who has to kill a lot of his victims.

name: Omega Racers
short_description: Race against the clock on the Practice mode or face opponents and dispute the pole position in this racing game inspired by some retro games, like Rock 'n Roll Racing.

name: "Warehouse Tycoon"
short_description: Warehouse Tycoon is a business management game in which you control all parts of your warehouse: Buying/selling products, designing your warehouse, and most importantly making a profit.

name: Touhou Shinreibyou ~ Ten Desires.
short_description: 飛び出そう、いつも通りの弾幕へ それが結果として世界をひっくり返す事になるだろう プリティでデュアリスチックなシューティング幻想！

name: Oh, you touch my balls ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)
short_description: Oh, you touch my balls ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°) - is physic puzzle game Solve the puzzle and guide the ball into the cup

name: Drums Rock
short_description: Drums Rock is an arcade drums game for VR, follow the rhythm of rock with your drums and smash the demons. Live a unique campaign: with different levels, challenges, songs and worlds. Drums Rock is an ideal game to feel like a rock hero, while destroying hordes of demons to the rhythm of rock!

name: King of the Savage Realms
short_description: Real-time resource / defense game. Advance your build level by destroying enemies. Enemies are spawned from camps on either side of your territory. Eliminate the camps (and all spawned enemies) to end the raids and conquer the Scenario.

name: Brutal Games
short_description: Brutal Games is a first-person shooter in which you have only one task - the last to stay alive! You start the game without any means of protection, and therefore you need as soon as possible to get yourself weapons and ammunition that are scattered around the level.

name: Box Out!
short_description: Help Boxy escape its factory and survive the outside world by mastering its 6 transformations: Rocket, Steel, Bubble, Spikes, Vapor and Fire. More than a hundred levels of increasing difficulty will put your skills, reflexes and cunning to the test. Die, retry, perfect your run and dominate the competitive leaderboards.

name: Crescent Hollow
short_description: 'As above, so below, discover the mysteries of the hollow'. Step into the world of Anthropia. Will you help the empires of the world, or destroy them? 4 different classes with unique stories, & 12+ party units to summon at the barracks. (Build an Empire, Custom Party, Deep character stories)

name: Conan Chop Chop
short_description: Conan Chop Chop is a party roguelite for 1-4 players full of mayhem, loot, and adventure. In this outrageous take on Conan the Barbarian, you are the muscle-bound hero foolish enough to try and stop the evil wizard Thoth-Amon!

name: Hexagun
short_description: Hexagun is a match3 shooter on the hex grid. Clean the playing field by forming groups of three or more like-colored hexagons. Enjoy today with great gameplay for everyone!

name: Aivolution
short_description: Aivolution is a machine learning educational game in which you design and train Ai creatures to compete in various challenges and unlock new levels.

name: Sudden Strike 4
short_description: Sudden Strike is back! The beloved Real Time Strategy series returns, this time with bigger battlefields, more units, better graphics, new scenarios and legendary commanders – making Sudden Strike 4 more tactical and realistic than ever before!

name: Palm Reading Premium
short_description: Palm Reading Premium is the most luxury and professional palmistry and chirology software out there. (4K@120FPS)

name: Calico & Co.
short_description: Help Calico in her quest to rescue her lost kittens and unravel the mysteries surrounding the culprit.

name: MacShot
short_description: Adventure retro game for PC. The best of old games!

name: OASE - Other Age Second Encounter
short_description: OASE - Other Age Second Encounter is a game with elements of Puzzle, Adventure Game, Dating Sim, and Visual Novel.

name: HyperParasite
short_description: A rogue-lite twin-stick shooter/brawler that never plays the same twice. Collect and control 60 different characters as the body-snatching alien Parasite with a grudge against humanity. Fight to the top of the food chain: possess the President, push the Big Red Button and one-up the human race.

name: ShowdownVR
short_description: Test yourself in atmospheric battle arena by dodging attacks, scoring, earning action points with combos and using them to ultimately crush your foes with counter attacks. Enjoy the perks of slowing time, teleporting and even taking over and steering a ship in the middle of a mighty ocean!

name: non - The First Warp
short_description: A genre-first time-manipulation, high-resolution (up to 8K), unconventional 2D point & click adventure.

name: Compost
short_description: Compost is a gardening game. A god game-life simulator-fast paced arcade game. It's super duper fun and played with only a mouse. It's both intense and relaxing. Feel like a scientist as you play with shrubs and bugs. Mess with robots and make giant explosions.

name: ARISEN - Chronicles of Var'Nagal
short_description: ARISEN is a narrative card game where you use your emotions to create your own story in a dark fantasy universe.

name: Re;Lord 1 ~The witch of Herfort and stuffed animals~
short_description: Take command of the demon, Wilfried and liberate Groessen from the control of the Witches of Ruin in this strip battle RPG! Retake territory, gather allies and use the art of sorcery to battle and strip the witches' of their clothing in the name of Saarland!

name: SWARMRIDER OMEGA
short_description: SWARMRIDER OMEGA is an 'endless runner'+'twin stick shooter' ARCADE mashup. Based on SWARMRIDERS(2016), OMEGA is a darker and faster version, featuring the Saint from UBERMOSH Vol.5.

name: Zup! Zero
short_description: Minimal physical puzzle with explosions

name: 傲皇忆剑诀
short_description: In the continents of disputes among nations, countries have organized competitions. You can recruit all kinds of martial arts to help you win the competitions in the future. You can also establish relationships with these generals, such as husband and wife, brothers and so on. The abilities and attributes of these generals are random.

name: Fortuito: Lost History
short_description: Fortuito: Lost History is an indie adventure first-person horror, face the unknown with classic fps mechanics, solve puzzles and immerse in this bad trip!

name: BAD BILLY 2D VR
short_description: Billy is really angry! Billy's girlfriend Jessica was kidnapped by creatures from a 2D World. Billy has to follow the creatures into the 2D World to free Jessica.

name: Tower Miners
short_description: Tower Miners is a local multiplayer game. Mixed out of strategy, tower defense and random party game genre.The goal is to beat your enemy by destroying his base. Also additional game modes are on the way

name: Villager's Biography
short_description: Nowadays, the villagers, each more awesome than the next. There are not many villagers like you who have worked hard to earn money. Collecting, fishing, stealing, working, cooking, a variety of ways to make money, two actress in a leading role can be married. The next life winner is you!

name: Miss Fisher and the Deathly Maze
short_description: Episode 1 and 2 of the award winning murder mystery, visual novel adventure in which you become the Honourable Miss Phryne Fisher, the glamorous and stylish detective!

name: NECROSIS : RECONFIGURATED
short_description: NECROSIS : RECONFIGURATED is one Indie Arcade FPS Game That Brings The Player One Fast Paced Experience with huge variety of weapons to unlock!

name: Dexter Stardust : Adventures in Outer Space
short_description: A Spacey Classic Point and Click Adventure for All!

name: DUO
short_description: DUO is an arcade game designed from the ground up for virtual reality. Now you can immerse yourself in a virtual world with a classic retro game.'This could be Vive’s best brick breaker. Give it a go.'

name: Rise High
short_description: Rise High is an arcade action game in which you have to defend your workers from an alien invasion while they try to build skyscrapers!

name: Max and the Book of Chaos
short_description: “Max and the book of chaos” is and arcade 2D action game with elements of run and gun and shoot ´em up classic games with a strong arcade feeling. A kid who will have the destiny of the world in his hands. Will have to face this wave of disasters, save the world and free your buddies.

name: Tippy Tree
short_description: Christmas is just around the corner and it’s time to decorate! Tippy Tree is a virtual reality puzzle game that has you decorate the tippiest of trees. Celebrate the holiday season with trinkets aplenty, but watch out, without careful planning, all of your work may come crashing down!

name: Radium 2
short_description: Ra² is a physics based skill game with puzzle elements, inspired by the smallest elementary particles of our universe.

name: Dragon Rider
short_description: Dragon Rider is a VR Compatible intense multiplayer arena game set in the skies on the back of a Dragon! Short matches with up to 4 players make for fast paced action.

name: Minimal Move
short_description: A story-driven cooperative puzzle game. Your adventure starts when two space investigators, Ido and Kaiten, land in a wonder cubic world, where they attempt to discover the truth about the planet…Engage your brain, cooperate with each other, solve the puzzle and think in 3d!

name: Deathbloom: Chapter 2
short_description: Continue your journey through Bachman Manor as you inch closer to freedom, or towards your mysterious friend Christina and her candle-lit secrets. Going deeper into the estate reveals more locations like the Abandoned Wing, Lower House, and the bunker complex 'Salvation'.

name: Chained: A Victorian Nightmare
short_description: Chained: A Victorian Nightmare is a haunting VR adaptation of Charles Dickens' classic tale, A Christmas Carol. Prepare to be transported into a bone-chilling journey of self-discovery.

name: Extreme Tactical Executioners
short_description: Set in the near future, Earth is becoming uninhabitable. Human Beings send AI-driven robots to your planet, Impulse, to eliminate your species in preparation for their colonization of your planet. Blast your way through hordes of enemy bots to protect your home and prevent the human invasion!

name: Suicide Adventures
short_description: Lost in the abyssal depths of limbo, you are a tortured soul who is trapped between life and death, stuck in a dungeon whose puzzles will test you as you strive to go into the afterlife.

name: Girl Amazon Survival
short_description: Stay alive fighting with the bandits and zombies. Hunt animals, build houses.

name: HIVESWAP: ACT 2
short_description: Continue Joey and Xefros’s adventure through the dark and dangerous planet Alternia. Meet dozens of unique and memorable characters, some more helpful than others, as you navigate this volatile alien culture. Hurry up! There’s a train to catch.

name: Life Redemption
short_description: Maybe we are all ordinary people, but we have a brave heart to face them in the face of difficulties!Brave the search for the key to save your sister from the zombie manor!

name: Blurple Food Wars
short_description: Return to classic 80s shooters while fighting off the fast food horde in this retro space shooter.

name: Euro Fishing
short_description: Euro Fishing immerses you deep into the adrenaline-packed action, fun and beauty of Europe’s most famous lakes. Master your rod, line and tactics, and refine your technique to become a top angler. This is the closest you can get to real fishing from the comfort of your own couch.

name: Underdog Arena
short_description: A pretty simple action game with a twist; the worse you do, the stronger your character becomes. Grab a friend!

name: Offroad Mania
short_description: Offroad Mania — based on realistic car physics game for everyone, who like off road and challenge. Play in Classic (240 levels) + Free roam + Racing + Endless. Unlock 11 amazing 4×4 off road cars (different suspensions, engines, sounds) for fun driving. Regular free updates!

name: Virtual Virtual Reality
short_description: A game about VR, AI, and our collective sci-fi fever dreams. In a future where AI has transformed society, can humans still find purpose? Find out with Activitude, a service that lets humans aid AI clients in increasingly curious ways.

name: ROBOTIX: The Escape
short_description: Robotix is an intense platformer game where you are stuck on a spaceship. Lots of obstacles stand in your way & your goal is to escape, but with the obstacles in mind, what will happen?

name: Tunescape
short_description: Check out new VR experiences without buying more apps! Browse shared tunescapes, or create and share your own with building and animation tools that let you create whatever you can think up.

name: Inside the Backrooms
short_description: Inside the Backrooms is a horror multiplayer game mixed with different mechanics that will make you spend an intense night with friends. Explore, think, interact, but be careful, it is rumored that there are several entities wishing to find you...

name: Myth of Ethary
short_description: Join Maruse in a classic RPG game while searching for her father through Ethary.Watch as she gets companions, fights against evil and finds her own fate ...

name: Sweet Treats
short_description: Fun and colorful candy themed match 3 game. Featuring 100 levels. Work your way up the ladder and become a mastery pastry chef.

name: Paper Dolls VR
short_description: PaperDolls VR is a first-person VR horror game with oriental features. Explore the ancient ruins of the late Qing dynasty and search for your daughter . A complete story line goes through the whole game

name: Zelle
short_description: Zelle is a occult adventure game. You can explore the inside and outside of the castle using adventure game mechanics and battle demons with strategic mouse clicks. Your goal in this game is to bring the protagonist home.

name: Escape from Monkey Island™
short_description: Fourth in the legendary Monkey Island series of graphic adventures!

name: Swiss Knife
short_description: It's been 2042 years since the 'Great Disappearing', on Earth, humans & animals are no more. The planet is now inhabited by Swiss Knives, little robots created by humans before the disaster. In reality, that is because humans created Swiss Knives that the Great Disappearing occured.

name: Higurashi When They Cry Hou - Ch.4 Himatsubushi
short_description: Higurashi When They Cry is a sound novel. The music, backgrounds and characters work together to create a world that is the stage of a novel for the user to read. They laugh and cry and get angry. The user takes the point of view of the protagonist to experience the story.

name: Fatal Velocity: Physics Combat
short_description: Fatal Velocity: Physics Combat is a multiplayer first person physics combat smasher where speed and the environment are literally your weapons! Players utilize physics based weaponry and abilities to overcome, thrash and smash their opponents with extreme speeds into oblivion!

name: Pixel Space Battles
short_description: Fly for a spaceship and destroy enemy alien ships to return to your homeplanet – Nibiru

name: Claire
short_description: Claire is alone, lost, and hunted. The world has quickly becomes shrouded in darkness with unseen threats stalking Claire from the shadows. Aided by her dog and armed only with a flashlight, Claire must conquer her fear and find her comatose mother. However, there are others lost in the darkness seeking salvation.

name: Kingdoms and Castles
short_description: Kingdoms and Castles is a city-building simulation game about growing a kingdom from a tiny hamlet to a sprawling city and imposing castle. Make trade agreements, alliance, and war with neighboring AI controlled kingdoms. Each villager and resource is individually simulated.

name: One Final Breath™
short_description: Find your daughter in the halls of the abandoned St Mary’s Boarding School, which was once a hospital with a dark history. Play as the run down father who must overcome his issues and bring his child home in this episodic horror series.

name: Action Alien
short_description: Jump into the action and battle your way through hordes of aliens from deserts to tropical islands with fully destructible environments !

name: Dark Abyss
short_description: 'Dark abyss' is a 2D Platform&Action&Maze game.The main character need to find and defeat the boss deep in the maze and gain the power of the boss.Use new power to explore more complex mazes and fight more difficult enemies.

name: Vane
short_description: In a ruined desert, a strange golden dust transforms a free-spirited bird into a determined young child, setting off a chain of events that will reshape the world itself.

name: Terror Lab
short_description: You have just awoken without knowing who or where you are. You can't remember anything but it is clear you are not alone.

name: The Monster
short_description: 《清》是一款具有惊悚和压抑元素的像素画风角色扮演类游戏。某天深夜，家中突然发生了奇怪的异变，家人的离奇惨死、若隐若现的鬼影……这些仿佛都和失踪已久的双胞胎中的清有关。主角为了调查事情的真相，陷入了恐惧和回忆之中。

name: Capsa
short_description: Capsa combines exploration with a strong social component. It features a large, rich open-world that players can explore and discover together with other players and friends.

name: Equivoque
short_description: A story-forward visual novelette about a young apprentice who is thrust into a conflict between two magicians; one a famous escape artist, and one a fraudulent medium.

name: Mysterious Things
short_description: Mystic Things is a 3D find and click puzzle game in which you have to find some items on the map within a certain time.

name: Light Of The Past
short_description: Light Of The Past - 2D platformer in pixel style. Here you will need the ability to move well and think quickly.

name: Hexahedral Pathfinder
short_description: Taking a twist on the classic box pushers, this simple yet deceivingly challenging puzzler will push the limits of your imagination, as you control the blocks in unison through Contains over 150 patiently handcrafted levels and 50 additional challenge levels for those confident in their skills.

name: Billion Beat
short_description: Behold, Billion Beat! It's a brutal boxing bonanza. Beat the bicuspids off a bevy of bizarre baddies. Be a badass and bet on your brawn to bag a billion bucks! Booyah, baby!

name: Vanguard: Normandy 1944
short_description: In Vanguard: Normandy 1944 players fight with their squad to survive in hardcore multiplayer combat for historic D-Day objectives on real battlefields.

name: Ruined King: A League of Legends Story™
short_description: Rise Against Ruin - Unite a party of League of Legends Champions, explore Bilgewater and set sail for the Shadow Isles to uncover the secrets of the deadly Black Mist in this immersive turn-based RPG.

name: Cazzarion: Demon Hunting
short_description: Demons are troubling here. Kill the brood of evil and send it back to hell. As opponents, the demons of hell are fighting against you. You landed in the middle of the Demons Apocalypse, choose your weapon and shoot.

name: Stone Story RPG
short_description: An auto-RPG with strategic combat, deep crafting and programming elements, animated entirely in ASCII-art. In a realm of perpetual darkness, a single stone could change everything...

name: Defensive Measures
short_description: Defensive Measures is an FPS/Tower Defense Hybrid game. Deal with your enemies first hand or let your turrets do the talking while you sit back and enjoy the show.

name: TrackMania² Valley
short_description: TrackMania² Valley is the third environment of TrackMania², the sequel to Nadeo Studio’s online racing phenomenon TrackMania, already enjoyed by millions of players. Valley is a new take on the classic arcade rally racing genre. Flirting between arcade and simulation, Valley marks a new checkpoint in the history of racing games.

name: Black One Blood Brothers
short_description: Black One Blood Brothers is a single player sandbox tactical shooter inspired by the first Rainbow six and Ghost Recon.

name: Древняя Русь
short_description: Do you want to learn fascinating facts about the history of Ancient Rus? Take a quiz to test your knowledge, and learn some interesting facts about early history of Russia and Ukraine along the way.

name: Space Pilgrim Academy: Reunion
short_description: Margaret Dale crosses the galaxy in search of her lost mother, determined to solve once and for all the mysteries surrounding the destruction of Latona station.

name: Codemancer
short_description: Aurora needs to learn magic to rescue her Dad, but the way Magic works in Aurora's world is the way Programming works in ours! Defeat evil puppets, Solve ancient puzzles and Explore the world of magic! Includes: • 50+ Gameplay levels • Fully Voice-Acted Story • 3 Animal Familiars to Choose From

name: 战术狂想3-枪战足球(Chimera of Tactics 3-Gun and Soccer)
short_description: This is a gun and soccer SLG, player need to command team members to grab soccer with gun and shoot at the goal! ╰(*°▽°*)╯

name: Brimhelm
short_description: Go forth and reap in this episodically told action RPG with fast-paced dynamic combat, and fulfill your destiny as the primum messorem - the reaper of errant souls. Solo developed game brought to you by Northfire Studios.

name: Foxen Island
short_description: A charming and casual single-player 3rd-person game of exploration and discovery; mysteries abound on Foxen Island! As the titular Foxen you prance and leap your way across the enchanting and atmospheric environment of the Island, while solving the puzzles left behind.

name: Dracula: Love Kills
short_description: The Queen of Vampires emerges from the ashes of history, seeking to destroy the world of humans and rule over its ruins! No one, human or vampire, will stand in her way!Count Dracula awakens, weakened and stripped of his powers after years of healing from his last battle with Dr. Van Helsing.

name: RUGBY 20
short_description: Rugby 20 gives you the complete rugby experience! With overhauled tactics management, optimised graphics and more realistic player behaviour, the game is a true reflection of modern rugby.

name: Treasure Drifter: Nian
short_description: 'Treasure Drifter: Nian' is a game combining defensive action and walking exploration. Bring your partner to learn different character stories, defeat difficult enemies, and unlock different puzzles on the long road. Grow and explore the world in the cycle of departure and return.

name: Scream Collector
short_description: Build up a haunted house in this Halloween themed Idle Clicker game!

name: Dream Mirror
short_description: You are transported to a magical world where you can Interact with immersive environments to solve challenging puzzles. Where you get to find different types of mystical ancient devices in the form of keys, which will help you to open portals to different worlds.

name: Biggest Stream Hover Racing
short_description: Biggest Stream Hover Racing is a Twitch integrated racing game for windows. With up to 500 viewers racing against the streamer using ai controlled hover cars all kinds of mayhem and fun occurs for both you and your fans.

name: Guardian
short_description: Run, jump, fight, and dash your way through a fast paced action platformer as you take the role of the last known guardian of the gods. As Skye your adventure to stop a coming cataclysm will take you throughout the world from flying citadels to caverns deep inside the earth.

name: Congresswolf
short_description: Is the next member of Congress a werewolf? Can you survive a lycanthrope's bite? There’s no silver bullet for winning an election!

name: Dungeon Girl
short_description: Every year, the demon chooses a beautiful girl from the world and bind her up and put her in a dungeon. This year the girl named Yang was chosen. Will she succumb to her powers, or will she manage to escape with wisdom and courage?

name: Northern Journey
short_description: A norwegian happysad game set in a northern land! Adventure through a beautiful and very varied wilderness. Dive, fly, use ziplines and find different weapons to aid your journey to reach the cold mountains and below. Encounter over 50 unique bosses and enemy types!

name: Gun on the Chickahominy
short_description: Gun on the Chickahominy (GotC) is a casual pixel target game set during the American War Between the States. Players take command of a small cannon crew situated on the banks of the Chickahominy River and attempt to stem the Federal invasion of Virginia.

name: Captain Disaster in: The Dark Side of the Moon
short_description: A comedy scif-fi point & click adventure game with several odd characters (all voiced by the same person) and multiple strange inventory objects to try out! References to classic sci-fi and point & clicks abound.

name: Maia
short_description: Maia is a colony building game set in the not-so-distant future. Your colonists make planetfall on a hostile world and you must ensure their survival and their safety, constructing their off-world habitat from almost nothing and sheltering them from a dangerous, often deadly environment.

name: Zom Nom
short_description: Zom Nom is a humorous, 2.5D, side scrolling platformer with puzzle elements. Play as Barry, a brain munching, gob spitting, slap happy Zombie. Spit and slap your way through the streets and sewers to take on the President of the World. Claim your place as Ruler of all Human and Zombie-kind.

name: Alphadia Genesis
short_description: Alphadia Genesis chronicles an epic adventure with Fray and his investigative team from the Archleign Kingdom as they set out to solve a mysterious murder case in a nearby city. Immerse yourself in stunning 3D battles!

name: The Unseen
short_description: The Unseen is a multiplayer thriller FPS in a one VS many format. Terminate The Unseen with modern day weapons or hunt the S.W.A.T. from the shadows.

name: Chimeras: Mortal Medicine Collector's Edition
short_description: This medicine is deadly...

name: Bow to Blood: Last Captain Standing
short_description: Become a Captain! Fly your ship and command your crew as you compete to become Champion in a winner-takes-all reality show. Build relationships and plot betrayals to avoid getting voted off the season and become the last captain standing. Optional VR support.

name: Puzzle Cafe VR
short_description: Puzzle Cafe VR is a relaxing jigsaw puzzle game made for VR. Relax in a nice cafe and solve some jigsaw puzzles, complete challenges and upgrade the cafe scenery.

name: Horse Riding Deluxe
short_description: Explore a beautiful open world, full of horses and other animals. Or just enjoy the beautiful view while riding. In the world of Horse Riding Deluxe you and your horses have no limits. But train and care for your horses well because the various races will demand everything from you!

name: Dreamer: Puzzle
short_description: A very relaxing puzzle based on the Dreamer game. When putting together the paintings, gradually discover the story of a sick boy.

name: Tiger Tank 59 Ⅰ Super Tank
short_description: In this game , Players need to control their tanks, through the enemy lines, break the enemy base, or defeat the enemy tanks

name: Super Gear Quest
short_description: Super Gear Quest follows a young Kewtian called Starter who wakes up on a strange planet, long after a great war. Having been offline for decades, it turns out that Starter woke up just in time to stop the end of the world.

name: Reginald's Death Arena
short_description: 4 player chaotic single screen battle arena, with multiple game modes, items, and quirky mechanics. Regurgitate what you eat onto opponents with various status effects depending on what you consumed. Burn it all to the ground!

name: Water Pipeline
short_description: Water Pipeline is a strategic puzzle game. Objective of this game is simple, rotate the different pieces of pipe in order to get water and save the life. There is no time limit but you have limited moves for each round and you have to complete the pipeline before running out of moves.

name: Songs2See
short_description: Songs2See is your personal companion to learn a musical instrument in a fun way. It rates your play in in realtime and helps you train sight reading and finger dexterity with its interactive sheet music display.

name: Lakeview Cabin 2
short_description: The ultimate 2D horror is back! Dive deep into the diverse world of horror movies! Nothing can prepare you for the R-rated challenges you will face!

name: Escape Memoirs: Mansion Heist
short_description: 'Escape Memoirs: Mansion Heist' is a co-operative atmospheric reverse escape-room puzzle game. You are a master thief who has been hired to rob a mysterious mansion, filled with various puzzles. Do you think you have what it takes to conquer the challenges that await you in the mansion.

name: Afterbern Democralypse
short_description: Brawl for a brighter future!

name: 正宗台灣十六張麻將2
short_description: 大宇1997年出品的１６張麻將遊戲，以台灣最常見的打法與計台方式為準。並將各種計台方式和規則都考慮進去，提供玩家各式的選擇，以符合自己打牌的習慣。遊戲提供自由對戰、雀壇風雲、群龍爭霸等三種模式。

name: Robot Paradise VR
short_description: Enjoy a Sci-Fi RPG-Action-Adventure with head controls for walking and voice recognition actions.

name: Haiki
short_description: Haiki is the BRUTAL precision platformer where decapitation is just the beginning! Dive head-first into four worlds of colour-switching, laser-dodging, lightning-fast action. Haiki is the platformer where you don't need a body to get ahead.

name: Temple of Apshai Trilogy
short_description: In this classic dungeon crawler, hack and slash your way through over 500 rooms with dozens of terrifying monsters. A true 1980s fantasy game, experience the frustrations and triumphs of the tabletop gaming inspired combat. Temple of Apshai is waiting. Silently lurking. Patiently waiting. For you.

name: VOICE
short_description: VOICE is a game about the story of living in a dystopian world where speaking is forbidden.

name: The Jackbox Party Pack 3
short_description: The threequel to the party game phenomenon features the deadly quiz show Trivia Murder Party, the say-anything sequel Quiplash 2, the surprising survey game Guesspionage, the t-shirt slugfest Tee K.O., and the sneaky trickster game Fakin’ It.

short_description: A scavenger hunt with your dog, what will you find today? Loot Hound is a casual exploration game with elements of sim and strategy.

name: 萌萌２次大戰（略）３ Moe Moe World War II-3
short_description: What is Moe Moe World War II - 3? Moe Moe World War II - 3 is the part 3 of Moe Moe World War series. The main characters are weapons that play by lovely girls who are World War II weapons. The game types of Moe Moe World War II - 3 are blended simulation and adventure.

name: Vox Machinae
short_description: Strap yourself into the cockpit of a robot seven times taller than a Tyrannosaurus Rex and prepare to do battle in Vox Machinae: the ultimate giant robot combat action-simulator for both VR and standard screens.

name: Foot Massage
short_description: The player plays the role of a foot masseuse. Every night to receive city beauties, provide foot massage services. Serve people and meet own little hobbies.

name: Airship Commander
short_description: Steampunk Airship Battle Simulation

name: Astoria: The Holders of Power Saga
short_description: Astoria: The Holders of Power Saga is a charming 35+hr RPG with an epic, twisting story, containing intricate characters and cinematic cutscenes. done in classic 90's, RPG-style storytelling.

name: Abrix 2 - Diamond version
short_description: Abrix 2 is an addictive puzzle game for everyone. Try over 170 different levels of puzzles and secrets and help Abrix, a tiny toy robot, to find a way out. Abrix 2 is a continuation of a hit game Abrix the robot. Now with new graphics and full of new stuff it's better than ever.

name: Gamitate - Meditate, Relax, Feel Better
short_description: Gamitate is a like a gym for your mind and soul. 'Work Out' your mind with carefully selected meditation techniques! Gamitate is designed to make you feel calmer, happier, and more peaceful. Enjoy the benefits of a wide variety of easy meditation techniques.

name: 1001 Black Raven Jigsaw
short_description: Learn how the adventure ends - beat 500 puzzles with varying difficulty!

name: Fly Fish
short_description: This is a casual game that does not contain any violent elements. We will experience its way home from the perspective of a young flying fish. Go home by sprinting, jumping and flying through the dilemma on the road, Improve players' ability to resist setbacks

name: Pictures of Life
short_description: Do you know which building is the tallest in the world? What is the most expensive car in the world? Which animal moves faster than all the others? In the Pictures of Life you will be able to test your knowledge and logic!

name: Strike Force Remastered
short_description: As a member of Strike Force, it is your job to defeat a hostile terrorist group. In Strike Force Remastered, you will engage in 15 different missions with your own tactics, in every possible terrain. Develop your own plan to attack the terrorists!

name: Castle Itter - The Strangest Battle of WWII
short_description: The Battle for Castle Itter is a solitaire card driven tabletop boardgame.

short_description: Evil forces have turned these five hunky beefcake time-displaced boys into animals! You've got to help cure them and maybe even fall in love! Mystery! Intrigue! Romance! No furries, despite the title! A dating sim by Wilson Taylor, Maia Gross and Travis Tohill.

short_description: Advance in Society and bargain with creatures in the Wood in a Regency fantasy of manners, daring, and magic. Will you join your daemon overlords in destroying your hometown or will you defy them?

name: Boomerang Fu
short_description: Slice and dice your friends with boomerangs in this frantic physics party game. Join a crew of your favorite foods as you grill, chill and spill your enemies. Discover ridiculous power-ups and stack them together in deadly combinations.

name: Frutakia 2
short_description: Frutakia is back and better than ever! 4K@120FPS.

short_description: Behold is a 2D twin-stick shooter in a dark fantasy setting! Barbarians, insane wizards, total despair and bloody pieces.You are playing as a monster who is stuck between two armies.

short_description: A Sci-fi procedural spaceship exploration game, where you unlock new weapons and abilities as you complete missions and gather bounties. Deploy your advanced tactics mech unity, in this 3rd person shooter game!

short_description: Greetings Tycoons! Your favorite mobile game is now available on Windows & Mac! Are you as excited as we are? Happy Fishing!

Challenge your friends and the community to master your dungeon or play the countless dungeons of the community.

short_description: If classic top-down shooter Loaded was merged in a lab with Resident Evil you might get something like Undead Blackout: Reanimated Edition. Reimagined and rebuilt from the ground up with the latest version of Unreal Engine 4, this is a frantic, unrelenting and supremely challenging shooter.

name: The Disney Afternoon Collection
short_description: Starring a cast of beloved Disney characters, The Disney Afternoon Collection takes you back to a golden era of gaming and afternoons filled with adventure. All six classic games feature new and improved visuals and include filtering options that replicate a retro look and feel.

short_description: You are the captain of a starship. You must capture as many data pods as you can and make it to the star with them before your time expires.

short_description: Survive 10 minutes please is an action roguelike 2D zombie game where you have to survive a zombie horde by any means. Kill them, Upgrade yourself, Choose your abilities and try your best to survive in a challenging game.

name: Cube Zone
short_description: Cube Zone is a frenetic puzzle game! Think fast, match the color patches on the board or drop them all before you reach the end! it may seem easy at first, but we guarantee that our different maps and varied mechanics will put you to the test!

name: Session Seven
short_description: Session Seven is a free point & click adventure game in which you play as Ryan, an estranged father and husband who has just awoken, beaten, bruised, and alone in a locked cellar.

name: Baldur's Gate II: Enhanced Edition
short_description: Rediscover the beloved RPG classic— now enhanced for modern adventurers! Gather your party of heroes and continue the legendary adventure in this story-rich fantasy epic where every choice matters.

name: Labyrinth of the Chaka King

Let Instant Dungeon! create a new dungeon just for you, complete with glittering treasures, vicious monsters, brutal boss battles, wild power ups and most importantly fun, Fun, FUN!

name: Riff Racer - Race Your Music!
short_description: Create arcade stunt racetracks from audio in your music library, or from a selection of 25 bundled songs. Race the music to stay in sync. Score big by pulling off jumps, drifts and rolls. Challenge other racers to your favourite tracks. Have you got what it takes to win at your favourite song?

name: Coffee Crawl
short_description: The world has fallen asleep, and you're among the few who are still awake. Choose your class, manage your resources, craft items, collect loot, work with other survivors, and survive to see the next dawn; in this unique blend of action RPG, survival, and roguelike.

name: Soldat
short_description: Soldat is a unique 2D (side-view) multiplayer action game. It has been influenced by the best of games such as Liero, Worms, Quake, and Counter-Strike and provides a fast-paced gaming experience with tons of blood and flesh.

name: Tactics Maiden Remastered
short_description: Dive into a gripping medieval fantasy RPG, and lead your heroes in over 90 scenarios to stand up against noble despotism in a world full of political intrigues. Engage in thrilling, turn-based battles for territory to defeat your adversaries controlled by a truly devious AI.

name: Sipho

name: Ant War: Domination

Train your ants with new skills, manage their daily work load, and travel across the town in search of new land. Sharpen your pincers and be ready for a fight because everyone from beetles and slugs, to the town police and the army will try to stop your...

name: Slice of Life

name: GUNGRAVE VR
short_description: GUNGRAVE is back! Undead assassin Beyond the Grave returns from a 14-year slumber ready to rumble in VR. Experience this classic series like never before as you step into Grave's boots to tackle waves of enemies and massive bosses with the gunman's legendary arsenal!

name: Zball VI

name: Exorzine

name: Grim Horde
short_description: Gather your minions, conquer the lands and become the Darklord! Grim Horde is a fast arcade game with rogue-lite elements, where you lead your armies through the lands of the mortals, raze villages and claim souls. Die and rise again from your ashes and learn new summoning spells.

name: Visitors
short_description: When you buy a country farm you should be ready for anything, even an alien invasion. A house far from civilization is all our hero has ever dreamed of, and it just so happens that a juicy offer has presented itself.

name: We Were Here Forever
short_description: You both awaken imprisoned inside the sinister Castle Rock - were you betrayed, or simply not that clever? Find out in the newest co-op puzzle adventure in the We Were Here Series! Do you and your partner have what it takes to face the dark forces of this realm or will you be trapped… forever?

name: VGL: Imperative
short_description: You will have to visit the patient's apartment, find out about the agent's disappearance and submit a report to VGL Corporation. The task is easy, but after you enter the apartment, the picture will change and only the goal will remain - to survive!

name: Universe Sandbox
short_description: Create and destroy on an unimaginable scale... with a space simulator that merges real-time gravity, climate, collision, and material interactions to reveal the beauty of our universe and the fragility of our planet. Includes VR support for HTC Vive, Oculus Rift+Touch, and Windows Mixed Reality.

name: 封神外传
short_description: 本游戏根据经典怀旧游戏FC封神榜和神话小说《封神演义》改编。 作者在致敬经典的同时又加入了丰富的人物角色和剧情。 台词诙谐幽默，剧情欢乐。 更有多彩的支线任务。 主要出场人物：哪吒、小龙女、木吒、杨戬、杨婵、申公豹、姜子牙、龙吉公主、妲己。 谱写了一段既沙雕又悲壮的神话故事。

name: Eekeemoo - Splinters of the Dark Shard
short_description: In this awesome third person adventure game you will help Eekeemoo rescue his friends from the clutches of the evil Dark Shard! Your quest will take you deep into the Dark Shards four corrupted splinter worlds.

name: Push Blox 2
short_description: Block-pushing puzzle game with challenging high quality levels.

name: Mark After Dark
short_description: Mark really needs to get laid. Will you give him a happy ending?

name: The Amazing Shrinking Giraffe
short_description: You are Ginger, an everyday talking giraffe has been chosen to save the Universe. You have been given powers are to change size from the size of the Universe to the size of an atom. You are now 'The Amazing Shrinking Giraffe'.

name: Bullyparade - DER Spiel
short_description: For the 20th anniversary of the legendary comedy show, Bully & Co are coming back to the big cinema screen. And on your PC!

name: Chaos Caves
short_description: Chaos Caves is an all-action couch game where you blast each other with completely unreasonable weaponry. Games last about a minute, everyone gets a turn at the Nuke, and failure is just as funny as winning. Next time, grapple out of range!

name: The World According to Girl
short_description: A deck-building roguelike caring game In a collapsed world, a plan to raise a young girl into a savior begins in order to find the only salvation. You become an 'administrator' to raise a girl to become a savior, and raise her by selecting 'human resources (cards)' with various effects.

name: UNDERZONE
short_description: SEARCH - RESCUE - SURVIVE - Smash walls, shoot enemies, rescue survivors, upgrade your Mole Mech, and uncover a dark conspiracy within a 22nd century disaster zone. Underzone is a new twist on the 'roguelite' genre, featuring procedural enemies built out of unique combinations of components.

name: Gripper: Prologue
short_description: Gripper: Prologue is the first chapter of an Action RPG on wheels where you tear singing hearts of your relatives out from bosses. Welcome to the world of Burning Man where androids burn men. Literally.

name: Major Stryker
short_description: In the not-so-distant future, the calamity of World War III led to eventual world peace. But, it didn't last. Earth was invaded by alien marauders - the Kretons. Earth's united military force, still depleted after the mighty onslaught of WWIII, was not nearly sufficient to repel the numerous Kreton attacks.

name: Doctor Watson - The Riddle of the Catacombs
short_description: Dr. Watson experiences in the new part of the successful '3D Hidden Object' games exciting adventures at amazing destinations. NEW: The Gameplay of the famous Hidden Object Games will be ported to 3rd dimension.

name: DELTAZEAL
short_description: Triangle Service presents the essential arcade experience! Power up your ship, evade enemy fire, and blast your way to the final boss in DeltaZeal!

name: Insect Swarm
short_description: The swarm is a swarm of thousands of alien zerg, and you, as the only survivor of this wasteland, you need to face them and fight with blood, good luck!

name: Wars of the Roses
short_description: Fight the various battles of the Wars of the Roses throughout the Medieval ages. Each campaign is themed around fights between the Lancaster and Yorkist houses during various different periods of the countries rule

name: Imhotep, Pyramid Builder
short_description: Do you like watching others do all the work?Cats do!In this unique game (AVX req'd) you plan, direct and oversee the construction of a Pyramid in Ancient Egypt.Organize agriculture, plan the village, direct the building and watch thousands of workers on screen, in real time.Build it, stone by stone!

name: Godfall Ultimate Edition
short_description: Aperion is on the precipice of ruin. You are the last of the Valorian knights, god-like warriors able to equip Valorplates, legendary armor sets that transform wielders into unstoppable masters of melee combat. Ascend in Godfall, the first-of-its-kind, looter-slasher, melee action-RPG.

name: Ghost Files 2: Memory of a Crime
short_description: The life of a private detective is tough and no one knows it better than Arthur Christie - an ex-cop, effective and tough as a nail. This time he will face an investigation in which not only truth is at stake, but also his life.

name: トラウマーメイド
short_description: ヤンデレホラーな恋愛アドベンチャーゲーム。人魚姫・お姫様・王子様の歪な三角関係を描く物語。狂気の物語を全キャラクターフルボイス・全編アニメーションでお届け。物語の主人公となり、魅力的なヒロインたちを攻略してください。

name: - Arcane Raise -
short_description: Arcane Raise is a role-playing video game franchise, wherein a group of resurrected hunters known as Shades, fight alongside humans against monsters in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by an infestation. Do you have what it takes to survive this hostile land?

name: Distant Memoraĵo
short_description: This is the story, pure and sometimes frustrating, of two girls intertwined through their fumbling efforts to communicate. Learn a new language and the universal emotions behind our words!

name: Deadly Sin 2
short_description: A thousand years of peace are shattered by betrayal, political upheaval, and war. Play as the hero Carrion Iblis, as the story of Siegfried, the Empire's true successor, plunges the world further and further into darkness.

name: Summer Knights
short_description: An RPG about childhood nostalgia- and how stupid it is.

name: Airport Madness 3D
short_description: This is the seventh version of Airport Madness, offering players a 3-dimensional air traffic control experience from a control tower perspective.

name: Endro
short_description: The endros need your help to survive in this world of endless monsters that keeps appearing. Make the endro species last for eternity and help them defeat the evil.

name: Lamp Head
short_description: The protagonist of this game is a strange man with a lamp instead his head who needs to breach out of the darkened and dangerous odd place at whatever cost.

name: My Heart Grows Fonder
short_description: Visual novel about a couple who are reunited after a three year separation. Have the two moved on during their time apart? Or will old passions be rekindled?

name: Bugs 'N Boo Hags
short_description: PAINT THE TOWN BLUE in this frenetic mashup of tower defense and retro-style platforming action inspired by South Carolina Lowcountry folklore, history, and culture!

name: Heathen - The sons of the law
short_description: Indie game inspired by the novel 'The island of Doctor Moreau' by HG Wells.

name: Pyramid Quest
short_description: Pyramid Quest is an exploration and treasure-hunting game inspired by classic platform games. The goal is to find the three parts of an artefact and open the gate to the next level while collecting diamonds and coins.

name: Operation Breakout
short_description: A fantastic FPS to play together with your friends or alone.Go into the savage world of Operation Breakout and get yourself to the top!A great game without Pay2Win!

name: Sunny Hillride
short_description: Start your craziest family holiday with a turbulent and crazy family journey in Sunny Hillride - even your pet parrot is on board! Race and jump across hilly, colorful landscapes of forests, deserts, snowy mountains and beautiful meadows.

name: Rocket Science
short_description: Take part in a Russian space program. Design spacecrafts and send them off to explore the vast expanses of space. Experience the real scale of the Solar system and the size of its celestial bodies.

name: Starstruck: Prologue
short_description: The free first chapter of Starstruck: Hands of Time, an upcoming story-rich rhythm adventure game where you play guitar and abuse time travel! Control a giant hand destroying a miniature town, or play as the two guitarist kids living in it. For extra fun, plug in a Guitar Hero controller!

name: Blood Code
short_description: A story about an ordinary human girl and her romantic encounters with knights and princes. These characters may be gentle, passionate, considerate, or inhospitable. There are many character styles to suit a variety of individual player tastes.

name: Piece Of Mind
short_description: Piece of Mind is an action packed first/third person survival sandbox game, challenging players instincts and strategic planning. Both player and pet will try to survive various sicknesses, the harsh environment, unpredictable climate and predators.

name: Cursed Sight
short_description: Being able to control fate would be a blessing for many. To Miyon, it is her greatest curse.

name: Comedy Quest
short_description: Comedy Quest is a point and click adventure game by Trav Nash. Can you become the greatest comedian in three gigs?

name: 狗蛋神冒险-搞笑的声控冒险
short_description: A 'very silly very naive' dog egg game

name: Hell Knights
short_description: Hell Knights is a small but fun Bullet Hell Shoot'em Up with a four player Co op mode. Made by some Indie dude, living in a dungeon.

name: Battlesloths 2025: The Great Pizza Wars
short_description: Sloths. Pizza. Chaos. Battlesloths 2025: The Great Pizza Wars is the fast-paced multiplayer competitive twin-stick shooter of your slothy dreams & the sequel to Battlesloths. Compete with up to four human players or AI sloths. Use a myriad of weaponry to destroy your enemies in a quest to... EAT. ALL. PIZZA!

name: The Chills
short_description: The Chills is a 2D Top-Down Survival Horror game based on the paranormal activities experienced by Jim, who lived in a room in one of the most Haunted hotels in America.

name: rFactor
short_description: rFactor is a realistic easily extendable racing simulation from Image Space Incorporated. It offers the latest in vehicle and race customization, great graphics, outstanding multiplayer, and the height of racing realism.

name: Merry Glade
short_description: What has Bunny done? Why does everyone want to kill him? And why is Carrot so delicious? You’ll find all the answers in this game…

name: Slobbish Dragon Princess 2
short_description: Takeru and Haru's life of slacc is upended once more as Iris, dragon queen of the Sea and Water factions shows up on Earth to claim the seas and bar all humans from entering them. Hijinks and plenty of dragon girls await in Slobbish Dragon Princess 2!

name: KAMUI
short_description: Centuries have passed since the events of RefleX and mankind has once again attained civilization. Now, ancient technology born of a twisted mind sets in motion a chain of events designed to bring divine retribution down upon mankind.

name: PROJECT AZRIEL
short_description: That's right, zombies can make you think better. PROJECT AZRIEL is the least boring brain trainer in the world and has been shown to increase fluid intelligence. It’s a ton of fun to play so get it soon and have a blast taking down zombies while training your brain to work better.

name: Card Hog
short_description: Pig-based dungeon crawler packed with weird creatures, powerful weapons, magical shenanigans and loads of exciting card combinations!

name: System Under Surveillance
short_description: System Under Surveillance (SUS) is a charming stealth puzzle adventure, where you have to avoid and trick enemies rather than fight them. Take control of Adam and his little robot, TURBO. Use their unique abilities to navigate a maze-like dystopian city. Do you have what it takes to escape?

name: Deluded I
short_description: A worn out detective with his demons to fight and a homicide case to solve. Deluded is an interactive crime thriller movie with point-and-click investigation and adrenaline pumped quick time events.

name: Egg Over It: Fall Flat From the Top
short_description: Take on a real tactical jumping adventure with Egg Over It!!! A challenge where you'll have to lift the egg to the top in search of its source, but explore carefully; a single failed jump could lead to a long fall.

name: Birthright
short_description: Try to rise for power in a medieval sandbox world. Where Lords and Families battle each other for the utlimate power. Become your own Lord, Merchant or Adventurer getting entangled in the lands history.

name: Death and Betrayal in Romania: A Dana Knightstone Novel Collector's Edition
short_description: Can you escape from the grasp of a lovestruck ghost?

name: Football Drama
short_description: There is a story behind every goal. You're Rocco Galliano, the existentially troubled manager of a struggling football team. Train players, choose your own narrative, survive the drama, and play turn-based football matches via tactical cards and hard choices.

name: The Quest For Excalibur - Puy Du Fou
short_description: By order of his beloved king, the wizard Merlin sets out on a quest to find Arthur’s heir, gather Excalibur’s 15 fragments and bring Arthur back from the dead.

name: O.V.N.I. Abduction
short_description: Face terrifying enemies from another planet who want to stop you at all costs in this first-person adventure. Explore terrifying and dark settings, solve puzzles and use the objects you find on the map to progress in your adventure.

name: Live the Life
short_description: Live the Life is the first person life simulation game focused on the deep player's interaction with the environment. Design your apartment using advanced building features, visit stores to buy furniture, food and clothing you like, and more completely free content coming soon

name: Injustice: Gods Among Us Ultimate Edition
short_description: Injustice: Gods Among Us Ultimate Edition enhances the bold new franchise to the fighting game genre from NetherRealm Studios. Featuring six new playable characters, over 30 new skins, and 60 new S.T.A.R. Labs missions, this edition packs a punch.

name: Hell is Other Demons
short_description: Hell is Other Demons is an action-platform shooter, with Roguelite elements. Explore a sprawling, hand-crafted world full of demons, insanely over-the-top boss fights, and a heavy synthwave soundtrack.

name: BIT.TRIP Presents... Runner2: Future Legend of Rhythm Alien
short_description: Runner2 is the sequel to the critically acclaimed and IGF award winning BIT.TRIP RUNNER. In the style of the BIT.TRIP series, Runner2 is a rhythm-music platforming game. Players will run through fantastic environments, using brand new moves, to brand new soundtracks as they run, jump, slide, kick, and soar toward the goal of tracking...

name: Isle of Skye
short_description: Five clans are fighting to rule over the Isle of Skye. Only the chieftain who develops the best clan territory and trades wisely will be king!

name: Second Coming
short_description: Second Coming is a sci-fi cartoon gamebook with turn-based 3D battles (xcom-style). It is a sci-fi adventure where you and your team explore an alien ship and uncovers its secrets. This game will appeal to both gamebook enthusiasts as more traditional gamers - extending the gamebook format with digital effects and narration.

name: Notruf 112 | Emergency Call 112
short_description: Emergency Call 112 – The Fire Fighting Simulation is an exciting, fully detailed simulation of the eventful life of a big city fire department. It was developed in cooperation with and modelled on the fire brigade of Mülheim, Germany. Mülheim has one of the largest and most modern fire stations in Europe.

name: EF Universe: Reclaiming the World
short_description: An idle game with a collectible card theme. Open booster packs, collect cards, build an elaborate stat chain, manage 6 different currencies, battle your way across 9 different regions, and reclaim the world!

name: Aqorel
short_description: Cook up different solutions to elemental puzzles as you make deliveries on a strange planet. Combine and use the elemental seasonings in this unique system to create your path forward.

name: The Wizards - Dark Times
short_description: Face the end of the world in the sequel to The Wizards. The critically acclaimed VR spellcaster returns with a gesture-based system, challenging enemies, grand adventure, and the ever-witty narrator.

name: Netherspace
short_description: A sci-fi shoot'em'up game with heavy focus on upgrades experimentation, featuring two unlikely heroes that must work perfectly together, despite their share of secrets, to surpass their limits and succeed in eliminating a threat that might destroy both Earth and Andraxia if left unchecked.

name: Finding Alina
short_description: Alina was kidnapped! You must find her through this indie point-and-click game! Your best intel indicates that Alina is likely to be in this abandoned building. Navigate along the scenes to find clues and items that will let you overcome your obstacles.

name: Spirits of Mystery: Song of the Phoenix Collector's Edition
short_description: Reunite the Dragon and Phoenix Kingdoms to stop the evil witch!

name: Equin 2: The Warren Peace
short_description: When an evil wizard writes a 6000-page book to bore the townspeople to death, it's up to you to take the damn thing and return it FROM WHENCE IT CAME.

name: Age of Farming
short_description: 'Age of Farming is a dynamic game, which lets you control the whole process, from plowing and sowing to investing in buildings and wind farms.

name: Runaway Train
short_description: Train is leaving the station, but soon you notice, that something is missing... Rails! You have to lay tracks right in the path of the moving train to keep it from crashing. The goal is connect all stations, if you can... The problem is that the train is getting faster and faster with each laid piece of track.

name: Fire With Fire Tower Attack and Defense
short_description: Fire with Fire is an online player vs player tower defense strategy game about ascendant fireball creatures fighting over the last remaining fuel sources of a dying planet. Save the trees and rise up the leader boards. New unique towers, creeps and arenas in development.

name: The Abnormal Place
short_description: The Abnormal Place is a game about Abigail, a young woman who has lost her voice and has found herself in a strange resort and hotel inhabited by monsters. Abigail must recover her voice and navigate through the hostile world or she'll be forever trapped.

name: Pyrite Heart
short_description: When a feud with her brother gets too hot, Princess Ahri Remono, a young woman with a heart of fire, accepts a challenge that she cannot thrive in the world outside the Imperial Palace. In her first day in class, the boisterous princess finds a potential rival in the student body president.

name: Cryptographer
short_description: Cryptographer is a challenging puzzle-platformer that rewards player skill. Make use of bombs, switches, gates, and cannons to clear a path to the escape portal. Be careful with your navigation, however, because the crypt walls collapse as you move.

name: Ground War
short_description: The Ground-War is a 3D-RTS Game use special to the artillery unit.

name: Ace In Space
short_description: Your name is Adrian Clarke and you've been given the opportunity to live the rest of your life on a distant planet under the watchful eyes of benevolent robots. Help shape society on T-3R4, build relationships with the other settlers, and keep Earth updated through your blog!

name: New England Detective: Breakfast in Boston
short_description: A tale of treachery, beauty and passion, don’t miss the first installment in the New England Detective series. NED: Breakfast in Boston is a crime mystery detective visual novel with an intriguing dating sim aspect.

name: 放置勇者：远征/Idle Heroes:Odyssey
short_description: As a hero leader, you need to recruit your hero, collect treasures and equipment, and run towns to upgrade the combat team.Facing powerful monsters on the expedition, you also need strategies to match heroes, skills and treasures, finally save the world again.

name: Rock Boshers DX: Directors Cut
short_description: Get ready to take a trip back to the 80s, the 1880s! Help young Queen Victoria fight her way across Mars and attempt to escape home in this exceedingly retro arcade adventure! Prepare to bosh rocks! - with only the occasional break for tea and scones.

name: Command: The Silent Service
short_description: Submarine warfare from post-WW2 to the present day! Lay mines, strike land targets with cruise and ballistic missiles, creep up to surface ships to take hull shots undetected, sniff sensitive electronic emissions, tap undersea communications cables, covertly deliver special-forces teams ashore, and of course hunt down anything on the sea...

name: Tea Party Simulator 2015™
short_description: Ever wanted to be a tea party extraordinaire? Well now you can. Each new level brings it's own challenges you must overcome on your quest to become the ultimate tea party master. Comes with the original Tea Party Mode and now a Mode 2 (after beating all the levels), for a whole new experience!

name: School Grounds
short_description: Strange mannequins silently stalk visitors to the school grounds as they piece together the mystery of what is happening at the school.

name: Goblin Defenders: Steel‘n’ Wood
short_description: Battle hordes of monsters in Goblin Defenders: Steel 'n' Wood!

name: Pon Para and the Great Southern Labyrinth
short_description: Chosen by the gods, you must battle savage monsters, corrupt priests, and mad philosophers to save reality from the dark god of destruction!

name: Havoc Runner
short_description: 'Havoc Runner' is a futuristic action and 2D platform game that will take you to Titan's moon to face killers robots, missile launchers, and automated weapons in a hostile environment where you must find and destroy the Tupan computer, preventing a missile attack on the planets of the solar system.

name: Snake Pit
short_description: 'Snake Pit' is a Puzzle Game with a simple but incredibly Fun Gameplay. Help the little Caveman escape the Snakes and defeat Medusa.

name: Last Farewell
short_description: Last Farewell is a Survival Co-op game where you are tasked to work together with others (or solo) in order to ensure your own survival for as long as possible. Gather supplies and craft during the day in order to protect yourself and the sanctuary, the Town Hall, during the night.

name: Underwater hunting
short_description: Underwater hunting: Plunge into the underwater world. Your character-a small fish piranha. The glory of these river predators is truly black - river killers, bloodthirsty robbers, river hyenas, sharks. And she always wants to eat.

name: Arcanbreak
short_description: A short story-driven game about two inquisitors, Arun and Quila, investigating a murder. During the game you'll control both, each having their own set of skills you'll need to solve the mystery.

name: Warlordocracy
short_description: A party-based RTWP (real-time with pause) RPG that gradually grows into a large-scale strategy game as you amass soldiers and fame, or infamy.

name: Command: Desert Storm
short_description: Command - Desert Storm is a new DLC release for Command: Modern Air/Naval Operations. Fourteen historical & hypothetical campaign scenarios plus a bonus contemporary standalone scenario cover the major actions that marked the conflict, allowing you to explore the events that happened - and the ones that could easily have.

name: Kind Words (lo fi chill beats to write to)
short_description: A game about writing nice letters to real people. Write and receive encouraging letters in a cozy room. Trade stickers and listen to chill music. We're all in this together. Sometimes all you need are a few kind words.

name: Reigns: Her Majesty
short_description: Reigns: Her Majesty is the revolutionary follow-up to the smash swipe ‘em up hit Reigns.

name: Gem Rush
short_description: The well-loved board game comes to Steam. This mountain is rich in mystic gems. Combine gems to open up new rooms, providing new ways to dig up gems. Race against other players or race together against the clock to dig the greatest mine in this fast-paced, easy-to-learn strategy game.

name: Last of Ass
short_description: LAST OF ASS - is a horror game in which the protagonist survives horrible events by just turning the wrong way on the highway.

name: Farstorm
short_description: Farstorm is a 3D Action Anime RPG (AARPG) where you control Kazuko, an elven princess with a tyrant father dominating the Elven land.. Go back in time and stop your father from taking the throne, even if it costs you your life. For the people of Farstorm!

name: Nemesis Perspective
short_description: Challenge your friend in a classic hero versus giant boss monster setting. Wielding VR equipment your objective is to prove your superiority by crushing those who disturb your sacred peace (namely your friend who’s playing as your opponent with console controller).

name: Fuel Renegades
short_description: Fuel Renegades is an epic arcade racing game REAL FREE (no DLC, no loot boxes, just fun), where your brain will produce tons of adrenaline because of the awesome races endings. Play up to four players in the same computer enjoying the polished mechanics that gives you a smooth game feel.

name: Mortal Glory
short_description: Mortal Glory is a fantasy-themed tactical roguelike game about recruiting a team of gladiators and pitting them against brutal competition in a blood-soaked tournament. Train your gladiators, find a legendary sword, learn ancient spells, recruit a celebrity, cheat - do whatever it takes to bring glory to your name!

name: Nature Park
short_description: Adventure Games

name: SynthWaves
short_description: A retrowave tower defense game where the player must manage their arsenal of sentries to fight off waves of synths, stop their invasion, and take the fight to their home.

name: Button Lock
short_description: Navigate through a series of intricate—or possibly incredibly simple—mazes. But beware, as you are only given a certain number of moves to work with. You must make the most of your surroundings and discover unconventional pathways in order to proceed in this head-scratching puzzle game.

name: Operation Abyss: New Tokyo Legacy
short_description: When reports of kidnappings and strange incidents begin to break out across Tokyo, Hinowa Academy's very own Xth Squad is dispatched to investigate and neutralize the imminent danger. Loyalties will be questioned and secrets will be exposed as they desperately search for the truth!

name: Heartless
short_description: It's a 3D action game called Heartless. Heartless has the story of the protagonist struggling to escape the looming threat. Please enjoy the deep story and action with good hitting sense.

name: Brotate
short_description: A casual platformer with a twist. Navigate your way through the obstacles to reach the end.

name: Drakkhen
short_description: The prophecy has been fulfilled. The world shall be ruled by the dragons. On an island far away, their lords prepare for the conquest of the lands. There is only one hope for mankind. The emperor sends out four heroes -- warriors and magicians -- to solve the puzzle of tears and prevent the invasion of the Drakkhen.

name: We Are The Caretakers
short_description: We Are The Caretakers is a sci-fi turn-based squad management RPG. Assemble arcane teams of protectors to defend your planet and the endangered wildlife you rely on. Unite the world against an extraterrestrial threat. Fight for our future.

name: Interstellar Transport Company
short_description: Build a galactic transportation empire and supply humanity with everything it needs to colonize the stars. In this sci-fi logistics simulator, grow your company from a local transport agency into an interstellar logistics behemoth! Singleplayer, vs AI, and online multiplayer.

name: CuberPunk 2090
short_description: CuberPunk 2090 is an adventure game set in the village of Cuberovka. You play as Vova, a gamer and former president of Cube-States.

name: Nightmare Trails
short_description: Fight off monsters in a national park and send them back to their own dimension!

name: Case 02: Paranormal Evil
short_description: A survival horror puzzle RPG. Roll your dice to perform checks for elements such as Willpower or Firepower, and save a girl in a hospital full of evil spirits and zombies.

name: Ultimate Under Water
short_description: Ultimate Under Water is a clean and stylish interactive 3D live wallpaper that display cute low-poly under water fishes on the desktop with animated backgrounds. You can control and interact with fishes with your mouse.

name: High Noon VR
short_description: There is a new sheriff in town! High Noon is a fun VR shooter where you play as a sheriff in a small town somewhere in the Wild West.

name: Photonic Distress
short_description: Photonic Distress (or PD for short) is a blend of First/Third Person puzzler/platformer with a unique twist. Navigate your way through randomly generated dark levels, lighting your way up and collecting Memory Fragments to wake up!

name: Space Expand
short_description: Take control and expand your empire through different constellations in this minimalist 4X strategy game.

name: Slow living with Princess
short_description: Gideon Ragnason was banished from Ruti's party because he was 'not strong enough.' Since then, he has retired from the front lines of battle and changed his name to Red. Now, he has opened an apothecary in the frontier land of Zoltan, and hopes to live a slow and happy life there!

name: Privateers
short_description: Privateers is a roguelite set in a fantasy nautical world. Players are set free into an archipelago where they can become a heroic navy captain or an evil pirate overlord depending on the choices that they make.

name: Up All Night
short_description: Unearth secrets hidden between the trees. Solve a murder. Confront what awaits in the darkness. Whatever transpires, you’re guaranteed to be up all night.

name: ThrustLander
short_description: ThrustLander is an action cave-flyer with modern graphics, classic gameplay, challenging levels and beautiful visuals. Battle through over 250 levels and 3 game modes including a retro mode!

name: WWII英雄列伝 最強の虎　クルト・クニスペル
short_description: その男を超える者は歴史上二度と現れないであろう。 敵戦車撃破数公式記録168両、非公式を含めると190両を超える戦車を撃破したとされ、その驚異的な記録とは裏腹に謎に包まれた伝説の戦車エース、クルト・クニスペルの戦歴を追体験する歴史戦術SLG。

name: Ad Exitum
short_description: AD EXITUMExperience Ad Exitum, a horror survival jump scare indie game of Since Idea Games, which is developed with Unreal Engine 4

name: Hartacon Tactics
short_description: Hartacon Tactics is a turn-based tactical RPG, featuring higly deterministc mechanics, beautiful hand-painted 2D art and deep gameplay.

name: Stay or Leave / 留离
short_description: This is an adventure ARPG with great sense of blow.You can collection of stones,wood and straw etc to make the props or equipment you need.You can also take care of the plants of the camp to get food.Maybe you can go fishing quietly,just forget the whole world...Give full play to you!

name: Drone Combat
short_description: The goal of the game is to destroy the enemy base and this can be achieved by controlling the hill in the map center, defeating AI and collecting upgrades, or defeating the mini boss(Thus summoning them to your team as an AI attacker).

name: The Region
short_description: The region is affected by an unknown virus that has destroyed almost all living things.

name: Sky Is Arrows
short_description: A deep and twisted fantasy world with heroes, big battles, exploring weird locations, dodging traps, and permanent death. Players must be prepared to: Get their armies out of danger, protect their castle from attackers, and empower their hero enough--- To desolate all enemies!

name: BombGears
short_description: Test your artillery skills on BombGears, a turn based game with voxel procedural maps.

name: Infinity war
short_description: Inifinity War is a multiplayer turn-based strategy game where you will have to defend your capital, explore modules, create tanks and of course fight. To win the game, you need to capture all the enemy capitals.

name: DEAD OR SCHOOL
short_description: Underground dwelling girl Hisako is aiming for the surface in a zombie infested Tokyo. Hack and slash RPG! Obtain weapons and gear from enemies, and customize your skill tree to create your own unique and powerful a character!

name: The Book of Regrets
short_description: Escape a nightmarish realm filled with puzzles and deadly beasts!

name: Nemezis: Mysterious Journey III
short_description: Nemezis: Mysterious Journey III is a puzzle adventure game with countless brain-teasers, in which two tourists find themselves engaged in a series of mysterious events.
