short_description: It came from space and ate our brains is a unique Arcade top-down shooter. Looking for addicting gameplay, four-player co-op mode, and tons of aliens to send into oblivion? You’ve come to the right place!

name: Zero Punctuation: Hatfall - Hatters Gonna Hat Edition
short_description: HATFALL is a high-energy game of skill and hat-wearing born from Zero Punctuation, the hit online video series from The Escapist, created by the man behind ZP, Ben 'Yahtzee' Croshaw.

name: Chimeras: Cursed and Forgotten Collector's Edition
short_description: You're off to Scotland!

name: SYNTHETIK: Legion Rising
short_description: SYNTHETIK is an unforgiving tactical shooter rogue-lite where freedom and experimentation is key. Fight in a world overrun by the Machine Legion and their Gods. Experience the next level in gun-play and dive into unparalleled build options and Android upgrades. Can you defeat the Heart of Armageddon?

name: HANGMAN
short_description: The purpose of the puzzle is to guess the unknown word by adding the correct letters. For every unsuccessful attempt, a part of the human body will appear on the gallows.

name: RMB: Knowledge park - All World
short_description: Fun learning game for children ages 1 and up, preschoolers, kindergarten. Best app for Kids.

name: Pixel Shooter
short_description: In this 2D platformer game, get your gun and shoot all monsters in your way or just run away to the exit.

name: King of Crabs
short_description: Battle Royale with crabs, and no shrinking arena! Intense massive multiplayer fun, battle with up to 100 real players per game! Scrap, scavenge and slaughter your way to becoming the King of Crabs!

name: InMind 2 VR
short_description: An adventure game about a scientific journey inside the emotions chemistry of human brain. You'll take part in the process of one teenager named John becoming an adult, and help shape John's future self, by triggering emotions in key moments of his life. The destiny is in your hands! VR isn't required.

name: Super Yodelland: Legend of the Katzenbär
short_description: RUN.JUMP.PARAGLIDE.CLIMB.YODEL.A nice 2D-Jump-'n'-Run video game for everyone of all ages.Focused on exploring an alpine world full of mysteries.

name: Rest In Pieces
short_description: Welcome to Rest In Pieces , control AI driven Agents in the battle against hordes of demons. Show your skills on the battlefield and on Global Leaderboards in this singleplayer Horror Survival VR Shooter.

name: Voice Shooter "Pif Paf"
short_description: Voice Shooter 'Pif Paf' this is a simple, but funny 'shooter' where the fire (shooting) is implemented by voice.

name: HVRGUN
short_description: Welcome to HVRGUN, the worlds best Assault Pilot Training program. Where you'll be placed directly into a virtual battlefield and test your ability to dodge, shoot, and destroy an endless onslaught of enemies!

name: Armorgeddon
short_description: Armorgeddon: Test your skills and strategies as an armor commander in levels where the units change every time you play. Landscapes are treacherous in the war torn future that is Armorgeddon. Armorgeddon is bringing the concept of a classic turn based hex board game into 3D life

name: Derpy Conga
short_description: A physics-based puzzle-platformer about the importance of friendship! Gather your friends in a conga line and help them save their endangered planet, but beware: the longer the chain, the harder to control! On the other hand (haha!), journeys are better with friends on your side.

name: Arcade Spirits
short_description: Arcade Spirits is a romantic visual novel that follows an alternative timeline where the 1983 video game crash never occurred. It's 20XX and you've just started a new job at the Funplex game arcade. Who will you meet along the way? Will you find the romance you're seeking?

name: Putt-Putt® and Pep's Balloon-o-Rama
short_description: Help Putt-Putt® bounce his pal Pep into the air to pop colorful balloons--some filled with hidden surprises!

name: Dokuro
short_description: This charming, chalk-art puzzler tests your wits and tugs at your hearstrings as the bony underdog Dokuro strives to solve and swashbuckle his way through the Dark Lord's castle to save the Princess.

name: Trials of Argolis
short_description: Every year daring warriors and fighters from all across the land travel to the province of Argolis to partake in a sacred trial of strength and endurance.

name: Tanky Tanks
short_description: Tanky Tanks is an intense, fast-paced tank shooter game. It is fun, easy to learn, and addicting. Play alone, together with friends or against your friends, and show your navigation and reaction skills in 6 different game modes and countless levels.

name: Orbit Defender
short_description: You are in the control of the Planetary Defense System of Earth. Your job is to protect Earth using turrets orbitting the planet. You have gotten full control of the planet and you are responsible to keep the planet intact.

name: Infferno
short_description: Infferno is a post apocalyptic isometric top down shooter for 1-2 Coop Players Online or Local Offline

name: Boom Boomerang
short_description: Master the skill of throwing and catching virtual boomerangs to destroy bombs before they explode in this challenging and unique arcade-style VR game.

name: Rhythm Overdrive
short_description: Rhythm Overdrive is a shootem up / rhythm game, where ennemies are trying to kill you while dancing on the musics BPM ! Collect power ups to enhance your weapons, use bombs to clean the screen from all the ennemies, and try to get the first places on the leaderboards !

name: Unchosen: Forsaken
short_description: VR horror rouge-like game where the player will need escape a purgatorial environment by completing a set of objectives and finding useful tools and equipment while avoiding and out-smarting hostile monsters and traps.

name: 觉梦：赛博
short_description: 一个无所事事的网络侦探，有一天他的好友刘玄介绍了一个疑点重重的委托，拜托他去调查赛博梦境的杀人案，主角确卷入了更大的阴谋。

name: TEEN DATE SIMULATOR
short_description: Who'll be the ONE? All will be revealed... Teendate is a dress up and dating game for youngs.  Fill out the personality test and this game show your possible features. Choose your character and browse through the candidate guy profiles, send blue heart to show your date intention, then pick your dreamy date. Style your outfit.

name: Lux mina
short_description: In this unique roguelite platformer, you push through multiple randomly generated stages and fight against a variety of enemies. By enhancing your loadout and combining many different runes, you can create an individual playstyle.

name: Crash-Site: Conquest
short_description: This game is a multiplayer experience that is fast-paced with rapid firing guns, Fast movement, and quick response. You will be playing for 2 minutes and 45 Seconds and your objective is to get the best K/D to win.

name: Houdini's Castle
short_description: SOLVE THE MYSTERIES OF HOUDINI'S CASTLE Beautiful Hidden Object Game Play Combined with Mysterious Adventure! All Ages Game Play!

name: RollerBaller
short_description: RollerBaller is a racer against the clock. Stay on the path or suffer the consequences and get back to your last checkpoint! Rather infuriating title, it will boil your blood and should only be played by the most patient.

name: Christmas Horror
short_description: Santa has living for hundred years by taking away the soul of the bad children. This time, you're the choosen and it's up to you finish off Santa forever or escape at your own.

name: Tempo Wizard
short_description: Tempo Wizard is a funny four beats plan battle game.

name: Sniper Strike: Special Ops
short_description: Intercept, eliminate and extract. It’s time to engage the enemy.Sniper Strike is a high-octane sniper experience that pits you in battle across three gameplay modes and hundreds of missions. Scout through immersive environments, engage in rapid-fire combat and build the ultimate super-soldier.

name: Roguelite 2
short_description: Roguelite 2 combines roguelike dungeon crawling with turn-based jRPG gameplay. Features a 50-floor randomly generated dungeon, hundreds of treasures to discover, more than 10 playable classes and a quest system.

name: Pokitaire
short_description: Poker meets Solitaire in this innovative new mashup! Pokitaire is a fresh mix of Solitaire and Poker... Drag cards between Solitaire stacks to create poker hands, like a full house or royal flush. Each new hand increases your score multiplier to get you to the top of the leaderboards!

name: ADR1FT
short_description: ADR1FT is the story of an astronaut who wakes up floating silently in space amongst the debris of destroyed space station…the only survivor of a catastrophic event, left with no memory, a critically damaged EVA suit leaking oxygen and no way home.

name: Echo - An Indie Tale
short_description: You are fragile and the world is dangerous. Explore with care and courage. Solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, in search of something. An outlet? An answer? A hope? A doubt?

name: Witch The Bloodlines
short_description: Witch The Bloodlines is an FPS horror - adventure game that focused on reversing a curse of the 18th century village which you are living in. Discover the living forest and experience the horror that you are in.

name: Highschool Romance
short_description: Can you find love as the only boy in an all-girls school? Find out, in this slice-of-life visual novel game with multiple endings.

name: Rose Action
short_description: Players take on the role of a female secret agent and complete a series of manhunt missions.

name: Avenger Bird
short_description: Avenger Bird is a platform side-scroller game with pixel-art graphics, but your hero isn't just a regular hero. You are playing a bird that can flap it's tiny wings to fly and glide for a limited distances. It's a retro inspired 16-bit era game with innovative and challenging fly/glide mechanic.

name: Kōmori Fruit Rush
short_description: Kȯmori is a Hyper-Casual object/fruit catching game with a few twists from the norm. It sets out to challenge all ages and will be able to challenge some of the most skilled individuals in their quest to be and stay the best.

name: Clan O'Conall and the Crown of the Stag
short_description: Master the powers of three Celtic Heroes in this hand-drawn action platformer! Solve challenging puzzles, slay unworldly demons, and cross beautiful landscapes by swapping instantly between characters. With an all-original Celtic soundtrack. You've never heard of it, so it must be mythical!

name: Arma Tactics
short_description: Arma Tactics is a turn-based close-combat strategy game, where you take control of a four-member Special Forces team. There are no given strategies, rails to move on, or paths to follow; it‘s up to you to decide how you will play through both the story-driven missions and generated missions with randomized objectives.

name: Memorise'n'run
short_description: Challenge your ability, your reflexes and your memory to avoid from the shots while you solve a memory game, because in Memorise'n'Run you need to memorize the cards while survive of a real bullet hell.

name: Many Faces
short_description: Many Faces is a classic, retro arcade shooter from the 90s. Blast your way through randomly generated levels to confront the Many Face King!

name: Devil Spire
short_description: Roguelite Pseudo-3D Dungeon Crawler. It's King's Field but procedurally generated, and with Hexen-style graphics!

name: Mouse Mayhem Shooting & Racing
short_description: Help the cute little mouse 'SUEAKY' as he race, shooting and destroying enemies and overcomes hurdles with nothing to lose!

name: 幻想英雄传 卡片对决
short_description: This game is based on a turn-based card battle and incorporates a random loop dungeon to explore the RogueLike-style game. Play a variety of characters in the game and experience the ever-changing adventure!

name: Who Must Die
short_description: You are replacing a doctor, charged to find who, among the three patients, is the one that is contaminated. To do this, you can use a whole range of experiments to be performed on the sick. You can also ask the guard to do the dirty work for you.

name: Hypt
short_description: Hypt is an action arcade game set in a dynamic world of villainous viruses. Turn the deadly digital infections against themselves and break free of the labyrinth that is Hypt! Featuring 120 immersive levels, Hypt will keep you entertained for hours.

name: Great Battles of Carolus XII
short_description: Great Battles of Carolus XII is a hexagon-based strategy game developed by a Swedish indie game studio. In this simple historical strategy game, the player will command the Swedish army. With the Carolean gå-på spirit, the player shall perform great deeds and overcome almost impossible odds.

name: CONCLUSE
short_description: Concluse is an atmospheric horror game which features puzzles, outstanding cutscenes, and something a little twisted..

name: Phaser
short_description: Phaser presents a unique take on the 2D-platformer formula by allowing you to take control of each level. By learning the power of color-switching, you will be able to phase in and out challenging obstacles from your path, find new and creative ways to victory, and avoid otherwise certain death.

name: Desert Child
short_description: You are a hungry, young hoverbike racer who needs to get off Earth before it E-X-P-L-O-D-E-S. Hunt bounties, throw races, and do whatever you can to get to Mars and win the Grand Prix.

name: 中外名将对决
short_description: Every civilization has had some wars that changed the history of the world. On these battlefields, many outstanding generals have emerged. put famous generals to fight on the same battlefield, Choose the card to play, and get the victory by attacking the enemy's main city first!

name: Olympic Boxing
short_description: Olympic Boxing Championship brings you all the sensations of real boxing competitions.

name: Morps
short_description: Morps game is 2D pixel art strategy with simple principies of fight and defense. Use your king to control Morp´s world. The future of little creatures and end tyranny of king Gark is in your hands.

name: Election Year Knockout
short_description: Become President in this hilarious Punch-Out-inspired political sim where all laws have been replaced with boxing! Each opponent has unique tactics and special moves to test your skill and strategy on your way to the White House! Form your own third party and hit the campaign trail. Literally.

name: Perilous Warp
short_description: Perilous Warp is a fast-paced indie retro-shooter inspired by the classic 3D-actions. Communication with a distant space colony has been lost, and you bravely step into the teleporter with the desire for glorious adventures. But do not expect to win in a heartbeat!

name: Please Subscribe
short_description: Please Subscribe is the sequel to Gamer Career Tycoon from 2018. Develop your own livestream channel from the ground up. Manage and operate, overcome challenges, learn new tricks in order to rise in the charts, and possibly, become the next big internet superstar.

name: Kunlun Fight
short_description: It is a first person VR fighting game With KUNLUN FIGHT official authorization, you can train your reaction and boxing technique, and fight against the best martial arts masters in the world. All characters use motion capture！

name: Satellite Repairman
short_description: All the planets in the system have suddenly decided that the galaxy isn’t big enough for all of them! You’re not sure who launched the first missile and it doesn’t really matter! You’ve got nothing to do with it… you are just… the satellite repairman!

name: Magic Time
short_description: Magic Time is an adventure in the arcade genre with a magical setting.

name: Trident
short_description: Trident is a surreal adventure/action game about a seafaring adventurer, who is cursed to be a monstrous sea creature. who wakes up on a dark shore. Players use a magical Trident to fight an teleport around the terrain.

name: Ishmael
short_description: Ishmael is a short multimedia-enhanced hypertext story about perpetual cycles of displacement and violence as seen through the lens of a child. Takes about 15 minutes to read/play through.

name: Girl and Goblin
short_description: 1500 achievements + 13 pretty girl CG + plot + puzzle。 Sakura, a novice adventurer, alone in pursuit of goblin to the depths, accidentally by...

name: Soter
short_description: Play the role of a planet trying to keep the few humans who remain alive as you travel through an asteroid field in this simulator inspired by the classic Maxis game Sim Earth.

name: SURVIVORS LEFT: X
short_description: Minimalstic keyboard-based arcade game. In SURVIVORS LEFT: X you make 50 survivors to pass through dangerous puzzle levels. Quick tip: DON`T mess with Crabo.

name: RevolVR 3
short_description: RevolVR 3 is a multiplayer PvP shooter staged in the robotic version of the Wild West. Socialise and play mini-games in the saloon, participate in fast-paced death-matches versus your Steam friends!

name: Oblivion Tesseract VR
short_description: A potential girl with the curse of blood...finally awaked from the slumber...A mysterious cube unveiled all the secrets of her thrilling dreams, Family's history, paranoid space of time and eternal curse…

name: Wasteland Remastered
short_description: The RPG classic rises from the nuclear ashes! Wasteland Remastered is an overhaul of the 1988 title that brought the post-apocalypse to video games. See where the Wasteland series began and experience the character and world the sequels are built on.

name: The Spiral Scouts
short_description: Join Remae, the newest member of the Spiral Scouts, on her slap-tastic puzzle solving adventure through a world of crazy characters and redonkulous realms. Experience a fartwarming tale of personal growth, self discovery, poop, wieners and butts.

name: Sébastien Loeb Rally EVO
short_description: Sébastien Loeb Rally EVO brings off-road racing to a whole new level of simulation and engagement. It will enable you to drive the best rally cars from the past up to the present day in the most exciting off-road events across the globe.

name: Pokris
short_description: A combination of poker and a certain falling blocks game. Match cards into pairs, straights, flushes, and more as they drop from the top. Beat your high score before the board fills up!

name: The End of Dyeus
short_description: Go in a quest for Dyeus in a primitive and cryptic open world ! Face mysterious assailants in intense and fast paced sword fights, and survive against a carnivorous fauna. Will you uncover the truth about Dyeus?

name: Monochrome Order
short_description: Guide the world toward the right direction through Judgments in a fantasy RPG with multiple endings! Your Judgments will greatly affect the story and your character's role in both good and evil paths. As there are multiple endings, explore different routes to guide the world toward the right direction!

name: The Underground Watcher/地下监察员
short_description: This is a story about a girl working underground, experiencing some people and some things.

name: J-Girl
short_description: The background of this game is set more than 200 years in the future, scientists will discover new energy -- crystal energy (abbreviated as 'J'), and use it to make fighting girl robot. The player as the male driver will drive the girl robot to fight.

name: Aery - Vikings
short_description: Aery – Vikings is a story-driven 3D flight exploration game in which you control a little bird that is on its non-violent journey to complete a shire impossible task of the gods. Make your journey through a wonderful, peaceful, and exciting world and enjoy the feeling of flying.

name: First Class Escape 2: Head in the Clouds
short_description: 'First Class Escape 2: Head in the Clouds' is a co-operative atmospheric escape-room-style puzzle game, set in a beautiful luxury airship. Do you think you have what it takes to overcome the challenges that await you on the airship?

name: Almazy
short_description: Almazy is a classic indie arcade game for the fans of Boulder Dash® and Emerald Mine genres. It features 100 unique hand-crafted levels by the hardcore fans of the genre.

name: Lost Daughter
short_description: Lost Daughter is an open-world action game which tells the story of Sawyer trying to find his daughter.

name: Kaiju Kite Attack
short_description: OH MY KAIJU!!! IT'S...KAIJU!!! KAIJU KITE ATTACK!!! The FIRST EVER SHMUP-platformer! Get your kite in the sky now! The Kaiju are coming to town to burn it down. Save your Meemaw! Save the universe! FLY OR DIE!

name: aMAZE Untouchable
short_description: aMAZE Untouchable is a straightforward and surprisingly-difficult celebration of the simple beauty of the maze with calm soundtrack.

name: Moot District
short_description: Build and defend! Make Moot District yours!

name: Marie's Room
short_description: Marie's Room is a short story exploration game about an unconventional friendship between two classmates. You play as Kelsey, remembering Marie's room as it was twenty years ago. But something’s off. What happened to Marie?

name: I dream of you and ice cream
short_description: A sinister creature has enslaved mankind. Solve puzzles, gather components for a machine you are building, find comfort in your dreams.

name: Tidal Shock
short_description: An underwater arena shooter with a shocking twist. 8 players battle in a classic respawn arena to capture the reactor and boil the competition!

name: Hoverflow
short_description: Hoverflow is a first-person platformer in a mysterious world, featuring a relaxing soundtrack, secrets to uncover and time trials. Jump, slide, and most of all keep your flow going in order to finish handcrafted levels.

name: Jelly's Adventure
short_description: Move : →←↑↓ Jump : Space bar (You can long Jump or short Jump) Respawn : Space bar Reset the save point : R

name: Zombie Kill of the Week - Reborn
short_description: Zombie Kill of the Week - Reborn is a challenging, fast paced, 2D survival shooter! Featuring a compelling single player survival mode and cooperative multiplayer for up-to four players, this is one zombie firefight you're not going to want to miss!

name: TRYP FPV : The Drone Racer Simulator
short_description: TRYP FPV is the next generation of drone FPV simulator with new and unique features. Full of innovations, high graphics quality and ultra advanced physics, you will love the feels of flight. Let's TRYP !

name: TownCraft
short_description: TownCraft is a chill-out crafting and city-building game. Instead of just surviving, you must turn your empty plot of land and its rarely-used road into a bustling town full of shops, workers and taverns.

name: Veer
short_description: Use relative teleportation and the ability to change the direction of gravity to progress through the temple, where everything revolves around the core experience of puzzle solving. Do you have what it takes?

name: Loop-Loop DX
short_description: Far into the future, a galactic super prison known as 'The Prisom' keeps the Galaxy's most dangerous criminals within it's colorfully crystalline walls. Escape this superstructure by blasting down prison staff, other criminals, and even... yourself.

name: Skydiving Simulator VR
short_description: Skydiving Simulator VR is a Virtual Reality parachuting experience in 4 different locations: Grassplains, Future City, Tropical Islands, and Snow Mountain. Perfect for casual gamers and sports seekers. Support for both HTC Vive and Oculus Rift.

name: Wheelie King VR
short_description: Realistic motorbike simulator. Real wrist throttle and clutch! 4 camera angles.

name: Play with Balloon
short_description: 'Why should VR games be single player only? Wouldn't you like to play with your friends??' The HTC Vive has two controllers. So we thought why not make a new style of game that allows the player without the play as well This game consist of simple and funny modes.

name: Pan-Dimensional Conga Combat
short_description: Developed in a top secret lab over the course of the past eighteen months, RGCD.DEV's Pan-Dimensional Conga Combat is a rhythm-synchronised, old-school, score-chasing arcade game that plays like some alien coin-op from another dimension.

name: Crystal Sequence
short_description: Challenge your mind with this amazing puzzles! Try to find the Crystal Sequence to advance to the next levels.

name: European Mystery: The Face of Envy Collector's Edition
short_description: A series of robberies takes a deadly and supernatural turn!

name: The Savior's Gang
short_description: A self-proclaimed Savior must travel through numerous ancestral locations guiding his worshipers to reach the promised land. The numerous dangers that these locations present will make it very difficult for all that worshipers to survive.

name: The Legend of HyperStar
short_description: The Legend of HyperStar is a roguelike,Darksoul like indiegame.Play a well-trained, beautiful and powerful brave girl, challenge various levels. Get more powerful props, strengthen runes and skills, and get better weapons and equipment in random events.

name: Battlefield Alliance（战地联盟）
short_description: Do not give up your fighters, do not give up your position, do not give up your honor. Do not give up your fighters, do not give up your position, do not give up your honor. Do not give up your fighters, do not give up your position, do not give up your honor. Important thing to say three times!

name: Son of a Witch
short_description: Action roguelike for 1-4 players with cute graphics and deep game mechanics. Combine dozens of different weapons, magic items, potions and spells with unique effects to beat 8 enemy factions and 28 bosses. Can you find the ancient goblin artifact at the end of the dungeon?

name: Loud or Quiet
short_description: Loud or Quiet is a brutal top down shooter set in a fictional 90's America. After losing your job, your plan to rob your workplace goes drastically wrong when you are dragged into a life of crime by a mysterious woman who is not who she seems.

name: ExZeus 2 (Legacy)
short_description: ExZeus 2, a fast paced colorful 3D shooter on rails.

name: Weapons Genius
short_description: You act as a weapon genius and create ever new types of weapon with better specifications.

name: Survivor of Eschewal
short_description: You suddenly wake up and find yourself on a beach of a strange island. This island does not feel right from the start because you could have swarn this island was not here the previous night. Now all you can think of is getting off this island alive.

name: Eat, Sleep, Bet, Repeat
short_description: You are unemployed and living in a filthy town centre bedsit circa late 1980's Britain. There are no jobs and there is no future but you don't care because there is a betting shop, kebab house and pub right outside your front door and today is the day your benefits cheque arrives! NEW 3D RACES!

name: 10mg :)
short_description: Play a series of tiny games based on well-known classics, each with a unique twist and connected to each other. Race cars, hit golf balls, uncover mines, and more in this experimental action/puzzle game.

name: Board
short_description: Board is a minimalist puzzle game that offers a relaxing short experience.

name: Monarch of Greed - Act 1
short_description: In Labyrinth Mode, challenge 9 levels, with each one being more challenging than the last! In Story Mode, control various characters and make the right choices to avoid the multiple dead ends and find a way to get out of an abandoned orphanage.

name: Khan: Absolute Power
short_description: The epic based classic online game Khan takes on where Genghis Khan reached the end of his expedition. The game takes place at small kingdom of Eurasia where Genghis Khan's brutal force was never able to conquer. You will re-visit the history and prepare the battles against the greatest conquer of history.

name: Hell Blasters
short_description: Hell Blasters is a bullet hell shoot 'em up where you can blast the bullet hell away!

name: Crypt Hunter
short_description: An action VR roguelike.

name: Entity Researchers
short_description: You just got hired by EIRI; researching and battling the Visitors, a dark sci-fi RPG with themes of exploration and survival.

name: DragoDino
short_description: DragoDino is a 2D rogue platformer on PC/Mac/Linux.

name: MISSING: An Interactive Thriller - Episode One
short_description: MISSING is an episodic series bringing the 90's FMV games and classic adventure together in a unique experience. Use your brain to solve puzzles, find items and use reflexes in action sequences to help the characters progress in the story.

name: CosmicBreak Gun & Slash
short_description: A hack and slash with the 'CosmicBreak' characters! 'CosmicBreak Gun & Slash' is a spin-off of 'CosmicBreak', an MMO battle shooter featuring robots and humanoids! Take control of familiar characters from a top-down perspective and defeat enemy robots that come at you!

name: Escape From Mandrillia
short_description: Local VR vs PC horror game: 1 VR player controls a lone robot trying to escape an underground lab; up to 2 PC players control giant alien monkeys. Customize your experience with gameplay modifiers, ranging from tense survival stealth to brutal nonstop action!

name: Armored Warfare
short_description: Wage war against players around the world with an unstoppable arsenal of powerful armored combat vehicles. Use 100+ vehicles to engage in furious PvP tank combat, complete co-op missions, and crush your enemies on breathtaking maps, from scorching deserts to neon-drenched urban jungles.

name: Space Geekz - The Crunchy Flakes Conspiracy
short_description: A crazy 1st Person Point & Click Adventure about radioactive crunchy flakes, talking vegetables and honkyfants with digestive problems.

name: Ayo: A Rain Tale
short_description: Embark on a perilous journey to help Ayo fetch water for her family. Overcome challenges as you explore Sub-Saharan Africa in a daily daunting chore, gaining skills and wisdom along the way. Experience Ayo's harsh environment as she braves the unforgiving drought in this adventure platformer.

name: BROKE PROTOCOL: Online City RPG
short_description: Everything can be modded in this city sandbox with jobs, NPCs, apartments, garages, gangs, and more. Broke Protocol is an open-world action game with a strong focus on RP and custom content. You define your own goals and identity in a persistent and reactive world.

name: Pyro Fighters
short_description: Pyro Fighters is a scrolling space shooter with platforming physics. Use your flame gun to propel yourself in the air and fight through an alien army with up to four players.

name: LABYRINTH OF TOUHOU - GENSOKYO AND THE HEAVEN-PIERCING TREE
short_description: Challenge the Great Tree with the maidens of Gensokyo! Challenge the mysterious great tree that suddenly appeared! Form and develop a large team from the characters of Touhou Project, and challenge the powerful foes that stand in your way! Now, enter the labyrinth that pierces even the skies!

name: TENGAI
short_description: Miko-san and ninja girl blast away! The best of eccentric Japanese-style shooter is here! With online rankings!

name: MY TIME ALIVE
short_description: In 2023, industry leading pharmaceutical company 'HT Pharmaceuticals' found the complete cure for COVID-19, and they released the vaccine to the public. 9 months later, not much is left of mankind. Complete supply missions and conduct research studies to help find the cure to the infection.

name: BAFF 2
short_description: Minimalist, hardcore and challenging game in the genre of avoid-em up that will test your reflexes, timing and planning! This game is hard as hell!

name: Countersnipe
short_description: Multiplayer Seek and Snipe

name: Crucial Throw
short_description: Outplay your enemies as you dash, juke and launch through arenas in this fast paced local multiplayer game for 2 or 4 players.

name: Trickster VR: Co-op Dungeon Crawler
short_description: A procedurally generated fantasy adventure, starring floating islands, epic loot and a horde of orcs! Try your skills against orcish combat expertise, ancient magic and ragtag airships!

name: Hidden Through Time
short_description: Embark on a colourful hand drawn journey of discovery through the ages! From missing dinosaur eggs in the stone age, to a king's crown in medieval times, can you find them all? Discover, create and share worlds with your own hidden treasures in Hidden Through Time!

name: Alchemic Dungeons DX
short_description: Blending rogue-like dungeon exploration with item crafting, Alchemic Dungeons DX is a game of endless variety!

name: War Solution - Casual Math Game
short_description: Whole wars were won by the use of Math. Developed for those who like to exercise their brain or want to gain agility in mathematics. In ‘War Solution’ your calculation skills and quick thinking will be put on prove to destroy enemies. Can you win this war?

name: Crimson Gray: Dusk and Dawn
short_description: A slice of life visual novel with the emphasis on the slicing. Play as a mentally unstable young woman with blood on her hands trying to adapt to a normal life.

name: Retro Classix: BreakThru
short_description: Recover a captured fighter jet from deep within enemy territory in Data East’s thrilling arcade land-based shmup. Break through enemy lines with your high-speed vehicle capable of blowing away enemy forces and leaping across vast chasms. You’re coming home in that fighter jet, or not at all.

name: BE THE HERO
short_description: VR COMIC SUPER HERO GAME'BE THE HERO' is a transitional super hero game which takes you from an interactive comic book to playing as a powerful ninja hero with intense action and fluid locomotion. Stop dreaming, it's time to Be the Hero!

name: Shardlight
short_description: A post-apocalyptic adventure game from the publisher that brought you Primordia, Gemini Rue and Technobabylon! A young woman stricken with a deadly plague searches for a cure in a hostile world.

name: The Last Wizard
short_description: It’s a regular Tuesday evening when you are pulled from the Earth and sent to a place where magic still exists. You are given a wizard's tower filled with arcane knowledge that you are expected to learn. Thrust into a war between two nations, it's up to you to save the kingdom where you now live.

name: AO Tennis 2 Tools
short_description: Get ready for AO Tennis 2 with the incredible AO Tennis 2 Tools. Through this, give yourself a head start by creating all your players, venues and much more!

name: Tank Commander: Battlefield
short_description: Get ready to blow up the tanks, shoot for the enemy tanks and claim victory. Accept your commander missions, firing to kill enemy tanks . You need be a tanks hero to win WW2 Battles.

name: Murder at Midnight
short_description: Sneak, hunt, and discuss in this thrilling game of predator vs. prey! Murder at Midnight is a game that pits people against each other in a race to finish objectives before they can be hunted and will leave you wondering who you can trust.

name: Gratuitous Space Battles 2
short_description: Have you ever wanted to be admiral of a huge, sprawling space battle-fleet of your own design? Ever wanted to design a fleet of battle-cruisers so powerful they can rip all who oppose them into space-dust? Ever wanted to build a battleship with purple rotating radars and 64 engines? Well we have good news for you...

name: The Monster Inside
short_description: A film noir style audio-visual novella. A mysterious woman... a string of murders... and a man with a hidden past.

name: Choice of Kung Fu
short_description: Become the world's greatest kung-fu fighter or find true enlightenment in this interactive fantasy novel. What question will you ask the Dragon Sage?

name: Evolution of a Mini World: Physics Wonderland
short_description: We have built a mini universe with real physics basis, simulation and imagination. The game uses realistic environments and models to tell a story of a mini universe.

name: CHEXS
short_description: CHEXS is an evolution of chess, a new take on the old classic. It is a strategy game played on a hexagonal board where both sides move all of its pieces within a single turn, then all movements are solved simultaneusly.

name: Space Junk
short_description: Intense action, retro-styled visuals, a sizzling synth soundtrack and tons of cool Sci-Fi references, all rendered in vibrant, neon graphics. Get your trigger-finger ready, turn the lights down, the sound up, and blast your way through level after level of fast paced, Junk smashing action!

name: Combat Force
short_description: Combat Force is a first person shooter down to its core, currently offering a thrilling zombie mode experience with a day and night cycle, power-ups, unlockables, quests, easter eggs, zombie variants and much more fun! Currently Developed by 1 man to create the ULTIMATE FPS SHOOTER.

name: Bunny Mahjo
short_description: Classic Mahjong Solitaire is not single-player game anymore. You can play with friends in 3d-environment. Play together, win together, unlock more figures together.

name: Earth Liberation
short_description: Earth Liberation brings together fast-paced RTS gameplay and old-school style gaming experience. Command your troops on the ground & in the air. Grind through intense battles with alien invaders to liberate our planet. Humanity depends on your tactics and wits!

name: Elden Gunfire 2
short_description: A comic, funny and cute online multiplayer third person shooter game for everyone with fantastic cartoon 3D next generation graphics and captivating gameplay.

name: COSMOS
short_description: COSMOS is a difficult platformer shooter where you fight through fast-paced vertical levels with the use of wall running and precise gunplay.

name: Mystery Tales: The Lost Hope Collector's Edition
short_description: Free Emmett from an evil spell and save the townspeople from murderous demons.

name: Towards the Sky
short_description: Towards the Sky is a relaxing 3D platformer with a minimalistic and colourful design, fun game mechanics, and an interesting, randomly generated level layout. No playthrough will ever be the same, and it is up to the player how they choose to reach the top.

name: Hot Pinball Thrills
short_description: These 3 HOT pinball tables are the ultimate joy for fans of action packed arcade rounds. Thanks to state-of-the-art technology you’ll experience a premium physics simulation. Amazingly detailed, right down to realistic reflections, this game delivers the most intense pinball experience.

name: SMILE GAME BUILDER
short_description: SMILE GAME BUILDER is a game making software. Programming is NOT a required skill! All necessary materials are included such as 3D models, graphics, music and more. NOW, all you need is your creativity!

name: Music Boy 3D
short_description: Music Boy 3D is a rhythm-based 3D runner game with the unique webcam head-tracking technology. This game is distinguished by the accuracy and interactivity of the sound.

name: Ultimate Racing 2D
short_description: The ultimate top-down racing game, with 35 racing classes, over 45 visual stunning tracks, extensive career mode, championship mode and online/offline multiplayer modes.

name: Damn, what was yesterday?
short_description: Damn, what was yesterday? Is an adventure game that tells how a regular party of old friends can end.

name: Marle: The Labyrinth of the Black Sea
short_description: The discovery of ruins near the Island of Isola has caught the attention of many adventurers, including Archmage Marle. However, what she finds there is unlike anything she has seen before. A labyrinth which seals away the strength of any who may enter it...

name: Arizona Sunshine®
short_description: Built exclusively for VR, Arizona Sunshine® puts you and up to 3 fellow survivors in the midst of a zombie apocalypse. Survive solo or in co-op, handle weapons with real-life movements, and explore a post-apocalyptic world in VR. Putting the undead back to rest is more thrilling than ever before.

name: Quad Dice Defence
short_description: This is a tower defense game where you use four dice to build a turret. The rolls of the dice are the ability value of 'number of shots', 'time reload', 'damage(& range)' and 'magazine'. Try your best to clear all 40 stages, which are getting more and more difficult!

name: Mini Racing World
short_description: Race in a low poly colorful world in different environments. Choose between various cars, each one with its own driving style. Customize your vehicle as you wish and improve its performance to win the more difficult events!

name: Medieval - Embers of War
short_description: Medieval - Embers of War is a side scroller fighting game. The game offers a fast paced, casual gameplay that puts players in a fantasy world where the land is being torn apart by conflict. Players will take on adventures, epic rivals and control of their own castle.

name: Praey for the Gods
short_description: Praey for the Gods is a boss climbing open world adventure game where you play a lone hero sent to the edge of a dying frozen land to explore and solve the secrets of a never ending winter. Grapple, glide and grab hold of massive beasts as you fight to survive and return the world to proper order.

name: Rat Simulator
short_description: A survival stealth role-playing simulator where you play as a rat in a suburban neighborhood.

name: Archipelago: Navigable VR Comic
short_description: Archipelago is a navigable VR comic containing 65 characters and 6,787 lines of dialogue. It is intended to be a family-friendly story world, suitable for all ages. It is NOT A GAME. You are placed inside a comic world as multiple stories play out in real-time around you.

name: BioShock™ 2 Remastered
short_description: In BioShock 2, you step into the boots of the most iconic denizen of Rapture, the Big Daddy, as you explore through the decrepit and beautiful fallen city, chasing an unseen foe in search of answers and your own survival.

name: Keen: One Girl Army
short_description: Keen: One Girl Army is a sliding puzzle game with turn-by-turn tactical combat and a hint of adventure!​ Guide Kim, a grumpy little girl raised by her grandmother on a journey to stop an evil secret society from destroying her village.

name: Vinyl
short_description: Vinyl is a dynamic indie music game created by graduate students at the University of Utah EAE program, that experiments with the aesthetic distance between gameplay and music.

name: VR Guest
short_description: VR Guest is an experience in which you get to have dinner with Albert Einstein, Mozart, and Kleopatra. Enjoy watching them have a thoughtful dialog, and ask questions at the end!

name: Summer In Trigue
short_description: Discover adventure, mystery, and romance during an eventful Summer in Trigue with this yuri-only dating sim set on an enchanting Caribbean island.

name: DOUDY
short_description: Dare you play this game? Doudy and disturbing, dark and horrible. A realistic puzzle simulator with photorealistic graphics

name: Asteroid Girl
short_description: Help the cute asteroid girl conquer the universe.

name: Math RTS
short_description: Math RTS is a new RTS strategy game that focuses on solving mathematical problems in a new and exciting way.

name: Lost Lands: Mistakes of the Past
short_description: In a new series of 'Lost Lands' Susan has to go to the past to try and correct other people's mistakes. Will she succeed? What problems will she face there? All this can be learned by sinking into the new series of 'Lost Lands: Mistakes of the Past'.

name: Legend of Mysteria RPG
short_description: An exciting JRPG by the writer of Labyronia. As tensions grow between factions of mages, you are framed for the murder of a demigod. Solve the mystery behind his assassination or risk a war that could send the world into chaos for millenia.

name: Battle Sorcerers
short_description: - Online magic battle VR game, 'Battle Sorcerers' -Devise your own tactics and win death-defying battles!The power of creation lies within your hands.

name: Intralism: Rebuild
short_description: Rebuild - is a remake of fast and hard rhythm game Intralism. Listen to music and match arcs to the beat. Master all beatmaps or create your own and challenge friends in the online multiplayer. But remember: wrong button - failed try.

name: The Almost Gone
short_description: Experience the intricate dioramas and connections of your life, and the ripples we all make, in this award-winning narrative puzzle game about death, loss, and mental health.

name: Genghis Khan
short_description: 'Aoki Okami to Shiroki Mejika: Genghis Khan' was released in 1987, the second in the series. This was also the first title in the series to be released outside of Japan under the title 'Genghis Khan.' The game includes 2 scenarios.

name: 幻想殇物语
short_description: RPG maker game，Linear adventure game

name: My Personal World
short_description: If you bored at stay at home and you want to create your own Personal World you can do it with this game. Random objects spawn from up and every 15 minutes world gravity activates, you have to finish the your personal world before big time over.

name: Super Pig
short_description: Put your best mouse shot in Gruik's butt and make it fly as far away as possible!

name: Broccoli Bob
short_description: 'Broccoli Bob' is an adventure game that combined with puzzle.

name: SteamDolls - Order Of Chaos : Concept Demo
short_description: SteamDolls is a steampunk inspired metroidvania game with a grimy touch of brutality.

name: TankZone Battle
short_description: TankZone Battle is a dynamic 3D action game. Dynamic and exciting battles are awaiting you, where the power of ammunition is not everything. Use your speed and agility to defeat your rivals!

name: XXZ: XXL
short_description: Zombie Apocalypses turned out to be somewhat different from what science fiction authors used to write. Only women can turn into zombies. Day Z caught you in one of the biggest strip clubs in Las Vegas. You are gathering a group of three people in order to escape the city.

name: Flix The Flea
short_description: Inspired by the 8-bit classics and with a host of challenging environments and features - Flix The flea is the high flying platformer from one-man game studio, Psychotic Psoftware.

name: The Sunken Hero
short_description: The Sunken Hero is a game, in which one bullet and your equipment will not survive, sending you to the forefathers. Be careful and do not let yourself be intimidated by some sea monsters. Show dexterity and ingenuity. A variety of weapons, nice graphics and music for true connoisseurs of the genre.

name: Animal Super Squad
short_description: Animal Super Squad is a physics-based adventure game that lets you play as your favorite animal. Speed through a world full of dangers and bananas. Create your own levels, share them with the community, or forget all that nonsense and just play other people’s stuff.

name: Heroes of a Broken Land 2
short_description: Procedurally generated strategic RPG with multiple parties and endless worlds to explore. Recruit heroes, build towns and explore dungeons in your quest to restore the Broken Land.

name: Les Manley in: Lost in L.A.
short_description: Someone is kidnapping the hippest stars in Hollywood. Les Manley must scour La La Land – sifting through out-of-work actors, rock stars and gorgeous babes – to unravel the mystery in this point and click adventure.

name: Signs of the Sojourner: Prologue
short_description: Try out the first trip! In this narrative card game about relationships and communication, navigate conversations in a colorful world reminiscent of our own. Learn and grow through the cards you choose to play. Who will you become? What will you leave behind?

name: Maya Star
short_description: In a magical land ruled by an ancient evil, a prophecy says that salvation will come with the awakening of a new hero. Explore different maps, fight evil creatures and decide the fate of Maya Star.

name: Paint Drying Simulator
short_description: This is literally a game about watch paint drying for 6 hours, so.. ..do you feel like wasting money and time? XD

name: Astrocat: Milky Way Journey
short_description: Skylar is an astronaut cat who took a lot of cool pictures of the Milky Way, but she needs to gather the pictures to send to the scientists of her planet, help her and discover lots of data and curiosity about our galaxy in this 2D puzzle.

name: Cosmic Star Heroine
short_description: 3 exotic planets to explore. Aliens. Robots. Magic. Forbidden technology. Ruined Worlds. Ghosts. Long-lost secrets. Conspiracies. A galactic threat. And one brave heroine to make things right. Cosmic Star Heroine is an exciting new RPG from the creators of Cthulhu Saves the World.

name: Gold Rush: The Game
short_description: Become a gold miner. Work hard, dig deep, explore the world, and you’ll become the wealthiest person in Alaska. Use a variety of specialist machines to find as much gold as you can.

name: Exosphere
short_description: Shoot, jump & bounce your way into the outer layer of the atmosphere!

name: Redemption Cemetery: Children's Plight Collector's Edition
short_description: A warlock's curse has trapped you in an otherworldly cemetery! Explore Hidden Object scenes and save the warlock's victims!

name: Earth Elements
short_description: Earth Elements. In three words: Dig, Mix, Build. Resource collecting, building and surviving game with not one but a few of game characters. Start with digging of Elements on map, mix in mixers, build new features on map, advance in Epoch, finally collect specific amount of uranium to win a game.

name: The Sundew
short_description: You are Anna Isobe, a cyborg cop abandoned by progress and thrust into the midst of a global conspiracy. Experience classic point and click gameplay as you travel across the dark future, and make choices that will seal the fate of the world.

name: Star Sky 2
short_description: Take a walk through the moonlit hills and explore the choices life has to offer. Uncover your destiny.

name: Dezzan
short_description: Dezzan will dip you into the world of dangerous quests. Dozens of traps, crowds of mutants, puzzles, mazes, twisted dungeons, dark stations, and other challenges await you. Compete with your friends for the best playthrough.

name: Radline: Quarantine
short_description: Prepare yourself for the night. The hunt begins, as the sun goes down...

name: Lost Alone
short_description: You are an intern headed to a secret military lab. Your plane crashes into a helicopter on arrival and you are the only survivor. Now you must hunt down different items to survive. But it's not so simple.

name: Critter Clicker
short_description: Casual farming simulator with unique, flexible gameplay. Autoclicker is built-in and free. Gather resources, upgrade critters and buildings, sell your farm when you want a bigger one and never stop expanding.

name: One Hour Left
short_description: Espionage is hard work. You will have to get to the enemy base and pretend to be your own among strangers. Can you cope with your task and can you prevent a war? But remember that you only have one hour left. But remember that you only have one hour left.

name: Christmas Patchwork Frozen
short_description: Down the rabbit hole with Alice's Patchwork!

name: Cannon Brawl
short_description: Cannon Brawl is action RTS and artillery hybrid. Pilot an airship, command powerful weapon emplacements and use the destructible terrain to out think and destroy your enemy! It's a new take on artillery strategy!

name: Froggerty Arcade 2
short_description: The hop is on. More classic arcade froggy goodness from Tudou Games.

name: Defense and Revenge
short_description: Defense and Revenge is a turn-based strategy set in fantasy universe. You have to lead orcs tribe, provide defense and take revenge on enemies invading your land.

name: The Spirit Master of Retarnia -Conqueror of the Labyrinth-
short_description: A traditional 3D RPG where the player traverse numerous dungeons and battle monsters. Loot tons of gears to power up your heroines and customize your team to your playstyle! But don't let your party lose in battle or they will suffer!

name: Unending Galaxy
short_description: Unending Galaxy is a unique space-sim in which you can fill any role from pirate or trader to the leader of a large galactic empire.

name: Ling
short_description: Following the call of inner heart, the young man starts another journey of adventure. Faced with tough enemies and fierce fights, it is not certain whether the young man can reach the “final”. The only choice is moving forward with determination and clenched fists swinging great sword.

name: Glo Phlox
short_description: Glö Phlox is a top down twin stick shooter in a deep interconnected metroidvania world. Explore a unique narrative-based experience with easy to learn combat that’s difficult to master.

name: Secret Girl
short_description: This is a pleasant and relaxing casual game that contains various mini-games. Play and discover new girls. Buy new pictures for points and look for hidden levels.

name: Pummel Paladins
short_description: Pummel Paladins is a 1v1 brawler with a creative twist. Don't be mistaken, just because the knights lost their weapons doesn't mean they are going to stop their destined duel. Push, parry, utilize the environment and items to outplay your opponent in this retro, dungeon arena!

name: Terra Mystica
short_description: In a world of fantasy, called Terra Mystica, 14 races are fighting together or individually against their opponents to gain power and territory. Using their resources smartly and terraforming wisely to gain supremacy and lead their own settlers to victory.

name: Artizens
short_description: Create the most customizable character ever and take on ferocious monsters with your friends online.

name: oldTail
short_description: Collect shiny herbs. Seven maps! Seven herbs! Seven ways! Find and track clues.

name: Achievement Lurker: Another one bites the dust
short_description: This game has turn based combat, xp system as well as a boss fight, You will collect in game items and win the west Turn based Combat XP Level System Boss fight NPC Easy 100% Easy Life Yikers

name: Tomatenquark
short_description: Tomatenquark is a multiplayer & singleplayer first person shooter, a community homage to Cube 2: Sauerbraten.

name: In League
short_description: Tactical multiplayer shooter built from the ground up for VR. Team up with other players wielding a wide array of realistic guns, grenades and melee weapons in Hunt or Hostage mode. Winning takes strategy and teamwork as you fight through rich interactive environments.

name: Red Number: Prologue
short_description: You have to survive on Mars as a simple technique of John, he will have to fight with dangerous enemies, find other survivors and learn that the accident occurred in the colony 'a New Dawn'.

name: Dirty Bomb®
short_description: Work together or die alone! Fight to restore peace to London or tear it down for profit in the most challenging team based shooter around.

name: Atomic Society
short_description: Build a town in a post-apocalyptic world. Gather resources to expand and survive. Express your moral and ethical views by setting laws that affect how people live. What kind of society will you make?

name: Captures
short_description: A chess-based puzzle game.

name: Tunnel Blast
short_description: Tunnel Blast is an action game where you control a pilot flying through a series of tunnels. But they are dangerous, and you need to blast your way through them!

name: Bullet Wave
short_description: Bullet Wave is a driving first-person shooter straight out of the 90s. Go to the space station to fight against hordes of zombies, combat drones and infernal evil spirits.

name: Hinata in Hot Maze
short_description: while traveling, Hinata found a maze and decided to enter it filming everything with her camera, the further she went through it, the hotter it became in it and she had to undress because of the heat, the maze is drawn during its passage

name: 同居指南 | Cohabitation Guide
short_description: What! My house is occupied!' Our male protagonist utters an incredible howl. He clearly lives happily in his big house. His parents can work outside all the year round, but they are occupied by three sisters in the best three bedrooms. Liao Feiluo, Xiang Yuyao and Zhu Nanjun! What are you three doing?

name: My city and army
short_description: Strategy game of building war

name: TileDynasty FPS Arena
short_description: Looking to bring the old arcade-game feeling back from nostalgia. Bunny hopping is taken to the next level with smooth movement, allowing you to navigate fluidly through the maps, while defeating your opponents!

name: Livestream: Escape from Hotel Izanami
short_description: In this side-scrolling action-adventure game, you'll need to scour the inside of an abandoned hotel, looking for clues to solve the mystery of the hotel and ensure your escape from a mysterious, murderous mascot intent to kill.

name: Atomorf
short_description: Atomorf loves radiation and collects plutonium, but is afraid of very hot and sharp objects.

name: Jung's Labyrinth
short_description: Jung's Labyrinth is a psychological exploration game that uses Jungian psychology, mythology, alchemical and dream symbolism in a series of active imaginations to map the process of individuation. Confront your inner archetypes, collect messages that other travelers left behind and reach your Self.

name: Amazing Human Simulator
short_description: Do you like destruction? Then let's enjoy destruction to the utmost!

name: Mr Nibbles Forever
short_description: Endless runner, platformy goodness wrapped in the cutest package! Everyone's favourite hamsternaut is back! Escape the cage, avoid spiders, collect nibbles and rocket to the moon!

name: Danmaku Amanojaku ~ Impossible Spell Card.
short_description: ルール無用の弾幕地獄週間！ 華麗に、ずる賢く、卑怯な手でしのぎきれ！

name: JAAHG: The Crows Cry
short_description: A nostalgic arcade horror mystery game where you collect clues as you run from an unknown entity.

name: C.S.S. CITADEL VR
short_description: Are you ready to survive and escape from the C.S.S. CITADEL?

name: Just Spin
short_description: A minimalist arcade game with a challenging twist.

name: Undertaker's
short_description: Inspired by the economy simulation games oft the mid 90s, Undertaker's let's you manage your very own funeral home.

name: Gaze At Maze
short_description: Gaze At Maze is a 2D top-down Maze game based on the story of a weird maze world which is full of weird looking creatures, powerful bots guarding the human embryos against intruders.

name: Color by Numbers - Halloween
short_description: Paint by numbers - an interactive coloring book for children. This mathematical game teaches children to recognize numbers and solve simple mathematical examples. In addition, this program develops memory, attention, imagination, and logical abilities.

name: Collide
short_description: Collide is a sliding puzzle game. As an orange square, players must collect all of the coins on each map then slide to the finish, using as few moves as possible. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move around the map. Players can create and share their own maps.

name: Transporter Truck Simulator
short_description: Transporter Truck Simulator gives you a very realistic truck driving experience! Deliver heavy oil tanks and other cargos loaded in your oil truck. Operate big trucks to deliver oil tanks and complete different missions on TIME!

name: Ritter
short_description: Ritter is a knight, whose purpose is moving along the walls of the castle to destroy enemy soldiers and collect honor medals at the same time.

name: Dark Skies: The Nemansk Incident
short_description: A very personal shooter project with focus on atmosphere and exploration. Every step could be your last. Set in the fictional Nemansk Region in Eastern Europe, your task is to find information about a meteorite and a missing science team.

name: Heavy Memories
short_description: Classic top view, destructible walls, powerups, environment and enemies, as well as the ability to complete the game with various types of tanks!

name: Victorian Mysteries: The Yellow Room
short_description: In this hidden object adventure a young woman is attacked and murdered in the middle of the night inside a locked room. There are only two ways out: a dead- bolted door and a single window blocked by iron bars. How did the murderer escape?

name: Uprising 2: Lead and Destroy
short_description: After a century of bloody galactic battle, a horde of intelligent bloodthirsty aliens, known as the Kri’iSara, threaten to exterminate all human life. New Alliance Command is counting on you to destroy the alien menace.

name: Nancy Drew®: The Shattered Medallion
short_description: No One is Immune to Sudden Death on this Reality TV Show!

name: Stubbs the Zombie in Rebel Without a Pulse
short_description: Be the Zombie. Kick A** and Take Brains.

name: Tanklike
short_description: Tanklike is a cooperative 2D shooter for 1 - 4 players. Improve your stats, upgrade your arsenal, and ricochet your way to victory!

name: Red Rope: Don't Fall Behind
short_description: Red Rope is a terrifying, enigmatic adventure for 1 or 2 players who want to test their bond. Explore the Labyrinth, get acquainted with its bizarre inhabitants, its secrets and its rules. Face enemies, traps, puzzles, and ferocious bosses. Only the best will find the way out and become heroes.

name: Adventure Craft
short_description: Adventure Craft is a challenging procedurally generated sandbox RPG with roguelike elements. Hunt monsters, horde loot, and craft weapons and armor, to survive in a vast ever-changing RPG world full of action, extreme danger and wonderful surprises.

name: Wizards
short_description: Artillery tactics games are back! Grab some friends and get ready for an all out Wizard war! Create your own way of play with tons of unique spells to choose from. With randomly generated terrain and unlimited combinations, you'll never know what will happen next. Completely free to play.

name: Call Of The Mighty Warriors
short_description: Two kingdoms in battle against each other, the king Bennevert called for the legendary mighty mercenaries to defend strategic posts in dangerous lands in the battlefield. Are you prepared to be a mercenary?

name: Adam's Venture Chronicles
short_description: Help renowned explorer and adventurer Adam Venture and his accomplice Evelyn discover artifacts, unravel ancient mysteries, decipher strange symbols and solve ingenious puzzles around gorgeous historical sites from the 1920's.

name: Moon Hunters
short_description: Play alone or with friends! A co-op personality test about exploring an ancient, occult world in 5 days. How will you be remembered?

name: Mayor of Defense
short_description: You are the village chief. Just when you thought the promised slow life was waiting for you... A monster that attacks without end! Almost a one-man operation! Black Village! Work to get materials, money and hire mercenaries to defend your village.

name: Time To Parkour
short_description: Lost in the depths of the universe, you don't know what to do to get out of here. Simple gameplay, challenging trails, if you fall down , try again. If you take the checkpoint you will spawn there. Its an adventure in the dark universe.

name: Pillars of Eternity

name: Relaxing Kite

name: Every Day's Different

Passing traps and different locations in daylight or at night, leaving the chase the player will have an interesting adventure on behalf of a young thief saving his house from conspirators.

short_description: Two small experimental games made as part of a one-week game workshop in Zagreb, Croatia, as part of a project called 'Interactive Empathy - Citizenship & Storytelling in Video Games'. Inside is also a documentary video about the workshop, as well as a booklet about the whole project.

name: Scatteria - Post-apocalyptic shooter

name: Dino Dini's Kick Off™ Revival - Steam Edition
short_description: Dino Dini is back and so is Kick Off! As the original advertising for the game in 1989 declared: 'Playing it is easy, mastering it will take time - A lot of time'. When you score an amazing header goal in injury time to win a match after coming back from behind, it feels like nothing on earth!

name: Lost Lands: The Wanderer

Cirno is added to the team as head of HR, and Marisa sets her sights on rebuilding Kirisame Magic Shop.

name: Albert and Otto

Utilize a little bunny in creative ways to solve puzzles. Levitate sheep, use them as torches or wolf bait and make your way through a dangerous land.

name: Dragon Saddle Melee
