short_description: Do you miss mind-blowingly difficult games? Then Bear Adventure will be a real find for you. In this incredibly challenging game, you have to play as a funny bear who has to get through all the obstacles and eat all his food!

name: Lust from Beyond: M Edition
short_description: Descend into madness in a first-person survival horror inspired by Lovecraft and Giger. Solve the mystery of esoteric cults. Cross the gate to the blasphemous land of Lusst’ghaa. Play the new M-rated cut of the fan-favorite Lust from Beyond.

name: Yumeutsutsu Re:After
short_description: What happens 'After?' Five stories to continue the possible endings of Yumeutsutsu Re:master.

name: Size It
short_description: Size It is an action puzzle game that will send you to help a mad scientist who created a device to resize his body.

name: Pumpkin Dog Xtreme
short_description: Pumpkin Dog Xtreme is a 3D platformer inspired by 3D platforming games from the 90’s. Unique Retro soundtrack, over 24 levels and a boss battles and bonus stages. The game has a large amount of different levels and large number of enemies.

name: Guardian of Lore
short_description: A mystical library houses books of ancient folktales from lost civilizations. Play as prince Sayri, and protect these stories from wicked magic that aims to erase their memory forever. Enter each story and save it from within... or at least part of it.

name: Souldiers
short_description: Fight for your freedom in a sprawling fantasy world caught between the living and the fallen. Hone your skills in a retro epic featuring puzzle platforming, metroidvania exploration and crunchy soulslike combat.

name: My Koi
short_description: My Koi, number 1 hit on the Mac App Store (Games), is a beautiful and relaxing fish pond app. Customise and name each fish. Feed them daily. Watch them grow. Collect new fish. Escape and Relax.

name: Sol Dorado Heist
short_description: Choose your path and solve the mystery of the Sol Dorado Heist!

name: Motivational Hero
short_description: Motivational Hero is a Emotional and Motivational Puzzle-Platformer 2d with levels based in Motivational Analogies

name: Glitch's Trip
short_description: Help Glitch save his planet from intergalactic tyrants in this innovative and vibrant retro-styled action platformer.

name: Cymatically Muffed
short_description: Don't you hate it when you wake up and some scientist has experimented on you and stolen your headphones? Muffed is a fast-paced top-down shooter where you and your friends can find that guy and make him pay. Or fight everyone you know in the best 2-16 player PvP games around, your call.

name: My Nuclear Octopus
short_description: My Nuclear Octopus is a psychedelic retro arcade game for fans of pure out-and-out arcade blasters that takes two minutes to learn and hours to master! It's an overload of sight and sound for you to lose yourself in. Can you make it to the top of the leaderboard?

name: Puzzle Light: Connect
short_description: Connect the pieces to form the circuit and turn on the lights in this puzzle game.

name: Trick & Treat Remake
short_description: This is the remake version of the free game Trick & Treat, with some visual updates such as redrawn maps and new UIs. It's a light-hearted Halloween adventure in a vampire's house, where you explore the mansion and solve puzzles in the spooky atmosphere.

name: CTHON
short_description: Embark - if you dare - upon a desperate battle against the unknown horrors of the beyond; featuring roguelike elements, including procedural generation and permanent death, CTHON seamlessly blends visceral combat with strategic character building.

name: WARRIORS ALL-STARS
short_description: A battle of heroes where everyone is the lead! The very first all-stars title for Koei Tecmo! For the first time in Warriors series, flashy action combines both the traits of the original series and new exiting elements such as “Musou Rush”, open scenarios and multiple endings!

name: Mr Rabbit's Memory Game
short_description: Game is meant to improve vocabulary and memorizing skills of playing children. Kids will learn new shapes, colours,numbers and letters in addition to spending a lot of time having fun

name: Secret Santa
short_description: Sneak around children, pets, and the elderly as you deliver Christmas joy. Complete the list of deliveries, and have some cookies.

name: Sausage Hunter
short_description: Sausage hunter is an exciting platformer in the best traditions of hand-drawn games.

name: Another FPS Game
short_description: Aren't you tired of always playing the same game?

name: Immortal Planet
short_description: Immortal Planet is an action RPG with challenging combat that rewards patience and punishes recklessness. Explore the crumbling remains of a society of immortals trapped in endless cycles of rebirth. Fight your way to discover the planet's mystery and escape its curse.

name: Project Exhibited
short_description: A thrilling first-person action-stealth game. Play as Dana, the inventor thief, and use your gadgets to fulfill your task; retrieving a special artifact from a private art collection in a mysterious palazzo.

name: The Last Turret
short_description: After a millennia in peace, you have become an ancient relic from the long ago ages of war. You’ve weathered the centuries on your perch in constant vigil and when invaders appear in the northern sky, you are the only line of defense. Upgrade your weapons and defend the Etherians!

name: The Wall
short_description: Combining dynamic maps and progression with slick combat, The Wall offers an infinite number of ways for you to construct your own battles.

name: Bugged Dungeon
short_description: Dodge obstacles and solve puzzles in this ZX homage! Help Bumble undo the curse on his family, and re-gain your controls one by one in each of Bugged Dungeons’s 20 brain-bending rooms. Create your own levels and share for other players to play them.

name: Skate City
short_description: The acclaimed skateboarding game comes to PC! Complete over 100 challenges and countless combos across real-world, iconic destinations or chill out and ride at your own pace with Endless Skate. Then, share your best 2.5D skate runs from every angle with our multi camera in-game recording tools.

name: The Last Tinker™: City of Colors
short_description: The Last Tinker is a joyous action adventure and definitely no platformer, as there is no jump button. Koru, a boy from the slums of Colortown, must rise and stand against the Bleakness, a dark force intent on wiping out joy. Koru must use color and emotion to restore life to Colortown!

name: Once upon a time
short_description: « Once Upon A Time » is an adventure game in which a young woman, finds a magic book and is instantly teleported inside. Each chapter of the book is one single tale in which you will have to solve riddles in fairy tale designed settings. Magic and nature will be friends and foes.

name: Cat way Domino
short_description: Find a new way to play Domino, helping a cat going trough different paths, finding the best domino pieces combination to keep the cat alive, in a relaxing ambience

name: Zombie Training Simulator
short_description: Are you ready for the zombie apocalypse? We've done the research and want to make sure you're prepared. When the news reports the zombies are here and your friend gives you a call, 'They're here. I need you,' how will you respond? That's right, you'll say 'I'll be right over. We've got this thanks to ZTS!'

name: Sumo
short_description: Sumo is a multiplayer physics-based party game for up to 4 players, featuring silly spherical characters with unique powerful abilities. Use a combination of mobility and tactics to survive the longest on Arenas which are just as much of a threat as your human or AI-controlled opponents.

name: The Memory of Eldurim
short_description: Begin a quest for long-lost truth on your vivid journey through a new fantasy world. This open world action RPG requires and rewards your original choices. It starts with your character, includes creativity in combat, and ends with the cultures, cities, and fate of the world.

name: Shining Plume 2
short_description: Explore a new, larger world, full of secrets and hidden locations in this direct sequel to Shining Plume featuring 3 different endings!

name: Caveman Warriors
short_description: Jump back in time and free your inner caveman. Smash heads in this local cooperative platformer game. Play solo or team up with up to 4 players. Inspired by games like New Super Mario, Joe & Mac, Metal Slug and Trine.

name: Lost in Red Valley
short_description: Lost in Red Valley is a survival game set in feudal Japan. Explore. Craft. Survive! Alone or with friends!

name: Thrice in a row: A new adventure
short_description: Continuation of the great puzzle. Available 28 completely new levels. Thrice in a row is a logic game for creating chains of identical elements. The goal of the game is to put in a row from 3 identical elements, get points and go to the next level There are also bonuses.

name: Warface
short_description: Warface is a contemporary MMO first person shooter with millions of fans around the world. It offers intense PvP modes, compelling PvE missions and raids that you can challenge with five diverse classes and a colossal customizable arsenal.

name: Lab BreakOut
short_description: Lab BreakOut is a hardcore precision gravity-shifting platformer with minimal graphics.

name: Satisfactory
short_description: Satisfactory is a first-person open-world factory building game with a dash of exploration and combat. Play alone or with friends, explore an alien planet, create multi-story factories, and enter conveyor belt heaven!

name: Perfect Plan
short_description: Perfect Plan is a single-player first person shooting game. The game based on a simple plot of two pals Tom & Bill planning to steal a multi million dollar formula. However, their path are riddled with many obstacles and challenges to overcome.

name: Scrapper
short_description: Flying through treacherous terrain, avoiding dangerous enemies, scavenging everything you can find. Scrapper is an action packed space flight rogue-lite pitting you against dangerous sectors of space. How long can you survive?

name: The Glade
short_description: The Glade is an immersive first-person survival shooter game built exclusively for VR. Fight to survive increasing waves of attacking giant spiders while earning points to upgrade your weapons.

name: SurvivalIsLand
short_description: 'Survival Island' is a open sandbox survival game. We will be born on a barren island, and there will be many rare and exotic animals on this island. By collecting, building, manufacturing, and fighting his survivors, we will finally survive on this deserted island.

name: Waterside Chirping 水畔空蝉
short_description: Aileen was an ordinary village girl. However, after she been cursed on by a weird man, everything changed…

name: Barro 2020
short_description: Try not to fall!

name: Luna Online: Reborn
short_description: Luna Online: Reborn is an anime themed MMORPG set in the cute fantasy world of Blueland. The world is in chaos, join forces with your friends and push back the monsters that threaten Blueland!

name: Monsters of Kanji
short_description: Help Marty save his world by understanding it.

name: Beyond The Destiny
short_description: A team of indie-developers are excited to present a new sci-fi MMO shooter game on the Unity 3D engine. Beyond the Destiny is a new science fiction multiplayer online game with an open game universe, which combines the genres of classic role-playing games, real-time strategy and third-person shooter.

name: Santo Island Incident
short_description: MYSTERY - EXPLORING - PUZZLE - Overgrowth took over the whole Santo Island and facility as a result of an unknown incident. Your mission is to find out the source of the incident and solve what's happened at Santo Island.

name: Crusader Kings III
short_description: Love, fight, scheme, and claim greatness. Determine your noble house’s legacy in the sprawling grand strategy of Crusader Kings III. Death is only the beginning as you guide your dynasty’s bloodline in the rich and larger-than-life simulation of the Middle Ages.

name: Through Abandoned: The Forest
short_description: You continue your journey in worlds of Abandoned.

name: DooM in the Dark
short_description: The space station has undergone an unknown contamination from space, the previously unknown X virus mutates, almost the entire station crew is infected, you need to stop the army of mutants before they break through to Earth and doomsday began!

name: Dear Devere
short_description: A romance/mystery visual novel set in 1930s Scotland, told through a letter correspondence.

name: A Bavarian Tale - Totgeschwiegen
short_description: “Totgeschwiegen - Chapter I” (“deathly hush”) is a third-person RPG detective story, set in rural Bavaria in 1866. As the young Medical student Valentin Schmidt you will travel to Wolpertshofen, when a sudden death causes turmoil in the small Bavarian village.

name: The Seven Keys: Escape Room
short_description: Escape Room The Seven Keys is a graphic mystery adventure where your logical reasoning will help you escape, in addition to solving different challenges.

name: Aster Fpv Drone Simulator
short_description: Aster Fpv is the Fpv Drone simulator including fps mode, play in multiplayer or alone. Sneak between moving construction cranes. Practice chasing cars. Race single or multiplayer between buildings and natural obstacles.

name: Locked Fears
short_description: Locked Fears is a first person puzzle/horror game with platforming elements and creepy atmosphere. You play as Samuel Custer, a late worker at UNIVERS HORIZONS, when things at the office start to drift into a dreadful situation. With the help of an unknown Individual you try to survive and escape this nightmare.

name: Slay
short_description: Slay is a turn based strategy game where your goal is to conquer the island by buying men and using them to capture your enemies' hexagons. By combining two men you can create a single more powerful man who is able to kill weaker men.

name: Shards of Feyra
short_description: This is a turn based tactical RPG, which could be played with your friend or solo. Each player will control 2 heroes and try to help the village leader with various quests and save the land of Feyra.

name: BRANE™: Prototype
short_description: BRANE™: Prototype is a short free innovative 2D indie puzzle game for Windows and Linux.

name: Name The Song Quiz
short_description: Guess name of the song! Contest with friends and family, up to 18 local players. Play in teams. Use your favorite songs.

name: Destination: Pluto The VR Experience
short_description: Walk on Pluto! Based on actual images and data from NASA's New Horizons mission, Destination Pluto: The VR Experience is an amazing 3D virtual reality excursion to the surface of Planet X.

name: qomp
short_description: You are the Ball. Escape.

name: Oasis Shooting Ops
short_description: Top-down action game, in which you'll have to fight off waves of different enemies. In this hell of a battle you won't be able to solely rely on your weapons. You'll have to use your creativity and set up different traps to survive.

name: Pro Strategy Football 2018
short_description: Attention! PSF 2020 will be released in early September! With a full in-game editor, the ability to run multiple careers and season campaigns, full Play by Play of all games, and more, PSF 2020 is a massive update to the Pro Strategy Football series!

name: VoidGate
short_description: VoidGate is a third-person dungeon crawling action-RPG. It consists of randomly generated dungeons, lite survival elements, and permanent death.

name: Hero Quest: Tower Conflict
short_description: Hero Quest is a Tower-battle in the most literal sense! Defeat waves of enemies as they attempt to overthrow your keep! Wisely deploy your units into the battlefield and use spells to destroy the enemy tower!

name: Bounce Ball
short_description: A physics based puzzle game. Bounce the ball of angled surfaces to get it to the finish.

name: Deep Horizon
short_description: Deep Horizon is an underwater platformer that’s both relaxing and annoyingly clever in its puzzles and environments. With smooth controls, 360 degrees of freedom and 24 hand-crafted levels, each challenge is designed to charm and entertain.

name: Arsolid Productions
short_description: Your dreams and wishes have come true in this immense new world of adventures and stories, in a game like never seen before.

name: Deadly Traps
short_description: Battle yourself through dangerous traps in this fast-paced platformer.

name: Boppio
short_description: Boppio is a game about obtaining materials, constructing buildings, and assembling a spaceship to return home. In order to succeed you will need to automate and optimize your base. Mine minerals and combine them into new items that will help you build your return vessel.

name: SPLIT BULLET
short_description: SPLIT BULLET is a game all about 'splitting up' a massive crowd of enemies—yes, those polygons—crawling towards you. Don't let 'em get you and survive as long as you can, by using your instincts and weapons.

name: AEGYPTUS
short_description: Aegyptus is an adventure game which is a bit unique. Explore the open world map by solving puzzles to gain access to the pyramids and escape from the desert and traps.

name: SteamWorld Dig 2
short_description: SteamWorld Dig is back! Dig deep, gain riches and unearth the terrors of the underworld in this platform mining adventure influenced by classic Metroidvania style games.

name: I’m going to die if I don’t eat sushi!
short_description: If you don't keep eating sushi, you'll die! A 3D action game in which such a hero makes a big adventure! Fight the evil that attempts to erase sushi from the world!

name: Empyrean Frontier
short_description: Empyrean Frontier is an epic real time strategy game that mixes classic RTS gameplay with a multi-stage campaign in which the player commands a persistent fleet of ships through a galactic map. Boss battles, base building, planet destroying superweapons, and tactical skirmishes create a unique blend of genres.

name: Skeletal Avenger
short_description: Guide a skull-chucking skeletal warrior on a quest for vengeance. Skeletal Avenger is a roguelite dungeon crawling hack'n'slash where you'll build a new playstyle with perks each run. The ultimate goal is revenge, but first you need to master deadly tools and learn to defeat peculiar enemies.

name: Fobia
short_description: A little girl tries to escape from her fears overcoming various obstacles in her path.

name: CloseCall
short_description: An explosive racing fantasy.

name: UpBoll
short_description: UpBall is a game of climbing up by controlling the speed of time Each death will not reset the level or let you start over If you are unskilled, then stop the time and think about what to do next The game is inspired by “SUPERHOT”

name: The Walsingham Files - Chapter 2
short_description: After discovering a major clue concerning the double homicide in Willowdale Nature Reserve, Sara is mysteriously convicted on false bribery charges that brings the investigation to a grinding halt. Fortunately, an old friend investigating a related case just so happens to be around the corner…

name: Chinese SimpleLife
short_description: Chinese SimpleLife is a living environment simulation.

name: Whispered Secrets: Ripple of the Heart Collector's Edition
short_description: In a battle between love and magic...

name: Donald VS Martians
short_description: Donald saves the universe!

name: Last in Orbit
short_description: Last in Orbit is a Horror game with a focus on surviving a A.I. gone Crazy. Your the first to arrive on a new space station meant for human living but in the preparations ahead you found out that the A.I.

name: Statue Defender
short_description: Defend the statue from being destroyed by waves of enemies. Choose your class. Level up. Customize your hero. Earn achievements and show the world you are the number one statue defender!

name: Biscuitts
short_description: Biscuitts is an arcade game.

name: TenebriS
short_description: Tenebris is a hardcore platformer in which you play as a skull trying to get out of a dark dungeon

name: Kingdom Under Fire: Heroes
short_description: The cult hit Kingdom Under Fire saga continues on PC in glorious HD. Control seven new heroes across fifty brutal missions of hybrid hack n’ slash action and strategy. Crush your foes, hoard their treasure, and upgrade your forces for the next battle.

name: Today Is My Birthday
short_description: Today Is My Birthday offers a classic horror experience for fans of the genre, thrusting players into insurmountable odds with only a few tools at their disposal to escape death. Your own survival instincts, problem solving skills, and willingness to explore will shape your fate.

name: Encased: A Sci-Fi Post-Apocalyptic RPG
short_description: A tactical sci-fi RPG set in an alternative 1970's, where an enormous and inexplicable artifact –the Dome– is discovered in a remote desert. Fight enemies, explore the anomalous wasteland, level up your character, join one of the forces in the ruined world.

name: Queen At Arms
short_description: When a young woman is forced to lead a mad king's army, can she do what it takes to survive? A genre-defying fantasy visual novel.

name: Game Of Puzzles: Dinosaurs
short_description: A puzzle game in which you have to assemble a single image from individual pieces.

name: TheWandererVR
short_description: Simple VR Archery shooting game. Defend yourself against the oncoming enemies with arrows.

name: Red Fox and the Four Seasons
short_description: Red Fox has waken up from a very special dream. 42 centuries ago foxes were magical creatures that could regulate the weather. However, this magic came from a crystal which the foxes wore around their neck. The crystal had been lost for such a long time that it became a myth. A story to tell the children.

name: CHRONO CROSS: THE RADICAL DREAMERS EDITION
short_description: CHRONO CROSS is an RPG that transcends time and space, unfolding across two interlinked parallel worlds. With over 40 party members to meet, people and dimensions will intertwine in this epic drama about the planet itself.

name: Greenspawn Restaurant
short_description: Greenspawn Restaurant is a unique combination of a cooking game and a shooter. Take control of an odd restaurant joint and cook your way through the ridiculous and unforgettable adventure to glory and success!

name: Lupa
short_description: A beautiful stylized polygon 3rd-person exploration game, with a semi-open world and a beautiful She-Wolf, called Lupa who is looking for her missing pack and her two little cubs. With a story inspired by Roman mythology. Join Lupa in this beautiful world and her journey!

name: Warp Glider
short_description: Pilot a gravity-defying craft at blazing speeds. Pull off aerial acrobats using stackable weapons to survive the swarming Bandits. Retro arcade action and out of this world flight control! Now with Co-op!

name: Ring Runner: Flight of the Sages
short_description: Ring Runner combines the fast-paced action of space combat with the rich story and skill variety of an RPG.Trek across the universe in a 30 hour long story-driven campaign based on a companion Sci Fi novel, or challenge 6 scenarios alone, cooperatively, or competitively through local or online multiplayer.

name: Dark Sauce
short_description: Take gold from the dragon, and not become a barbecue. Colorful cubic platformer about pig and dragon

name: ★ Fallalypse ★ Death or Cress ♝
short_description: The communication with SH42 looking for new planets suitable for life was lost. The last message sent from it said: 'Death or Cress'. A space-marine and a priest of the newly-formed Space Battle Church set out on a search of the survived or to read the funeral service for the remains of the dead.

name: Deadly Cosmic
short_description: Deadly Cosmic is a short,but fun game inspired by horror games from the 90s.You play as Raquel,a scientist who needs to save her co workers from an accident.But something sinister is happening to the facility.What are those creatures?Where did they come from? And the most important: can she survive?

name: Company of Heroes 2 - The Western Front Armies
short_description: The Western Front Armies is a multiplayer standalone for COH2 that adds two factions to the roster of playable multiplayer armies: the Oberkommando West (OKW) and the US Forces (USF). Each army can also be purchased separately.

name: Wartales
short_description: Wartales is an open world RPG in which you lead a group of mercenaries in their search for wealth across a massive medieval universe. Explore the world, recruit companions, collect bounties and unravel the secrets of the tombs of the ancients!

name: Stickman Destruction 2
short_description: Stickman Destruction 2 is back! new levels, more vehicules, always fun to crash those stickmans ! Get all achievements and unlock all levels and vehicules in this physic and minimalist based game!

name: Neos VR
short_description: Welcome to the metaverse! A shared social universe where both casual users and creators coexist. Play and explore with your friends, collaborate with your coworkers or grab powerful building tools and create something new right inside VR.

name: Space Dance Harmony
short_description: Space Dance Harmony is a VR dance rhythm game where you replicate real dance choreographies with your entire body to play. Immersed in breathtaking environments shaped by the sound and aesthetics of popular dance music, Space Dance Harmony is your space to get free and to dance.

name: Beyond Enemy Lines 2
short_description: Take the role of a special agent deployed deep beyond enemy lines where terrain and conditions are barbaric. You will seek, locate and destroy the enemy while causing havoc and confusion. Emerge a hardcore tactical experience in vast, nonlinear missions where skill and tactical decisions matter!

name: Romance of the Three Kingdoms II
short_description: 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms II' is the second in the series and was first released in 1989. Experience the strategies of the Three Kingdom. A variety of strategies brings the world of the Three Kingdoms to vivid life. Players take the role of a Ruler of the time and strategize their way into total control.

name: Fragmentum
short_description: Fragmentum is an Experimental Real Time Strategy (RTS) game with customizable units and factions, dynamic units and complex 3D terrain. Units are built from voxel-like modules that determine their stats and abilities. Features multiplayer, Procedural maps, replays, and a simple single player campaign.

name: Cavyrn
short_description: Take control of the hero of the lands and guide them through the dungeons of Cavyrn as they fight to clear the infestation that has taken root. Use swords, unique items and a cunning mind to gain victory

name: ELDR  LEGACY
short_description: 《ELDR LEGACY》 is a magical dark dungeon adventure game with a little Crewe style. The player uses all kinds of weapons and magic to destroy the enemy in a castle full of strange, firepower

name: The Soldiers Factory
short_description: The Soldiers Factory is a top down stealth game. Stay undetected and sneak past enemy soldiers or secretly kill them. Overcome security cameras and laser barricades. Experience an exciting story with many unpredictable twists and turns.

name: The Night Christmas Ended
short_description: Team up with the world’s biggest goblin on his quest for gold and be a total Christmas bastard.

name: USA Truck Simulator
short_description: Travel across USA as king of the roads, where you are a trucker who delivers important cargo across impressive distances! USA Truck Simulator offers everything a trucker’s heart desires!

name: Ranch Simulator
short_description: Builder. Farmer. Hunter. Trader. Ranching certainly isn’t your average job. Think you have the skills to turn your family’s rundown homestead into the most prosperous ranch in the valley? Then it’s time to head out into the wilderness in this captivating single and multiplayer open-world simulator.

name: Curious Expedition
short_description: Curious Expedition is a roguelike expedition simulation set in the late 19th century. Together with famous personalities you will venture on unprecedented expeditions to regions never explored before for fame, science and treasures.

name: 平妖奇谭 Kungfu & Monster
short_description: “Kungfu & Monster is a turn based SLG, the idea of the combat system is from Chinese Kungfu, it’s trying to show you a unique journey to hunt monsters.

name: TEMPUS
short_description: TEMPUS is a puzzle adventure game with time travel. Each time you advance, you will see the island where you live change over thousands of years. You can only travel forward so it is a one way trip, how far will you go?

name: Power Tools VR
short_description: VR game that gives you an adrenaline rush from chopping, lopping, slicing, dicing or shaping blocks using different power tools. Or you can even take a more artistic approach and see what you can create using the tools to sculpt the block.

name: DemonPandemicVR
short_description: We all have inner demons, now it's time to face them. You are a lone wolf, you must scavenge for weapons and yeet your environment across seven maps as you try to survive this VR shooter against waves of demons.

name: You're Not Special
short_description: You're Not Special is a (mostly) non-combat, choices-matter, puzzle-based RPG. There are great forces set to doom the small kingdom in which you live and only the chosen one can stop them. The problem is, you're not the chosen one.

name: Legends of Amberland: The Forgotten Crown
short_description: The game is a classic western RPG inspired by the games from the 90s. Basically, it’s the kind of game I personally find missing nowadays. Light, fairy tale, epic, heroic, slightly humorous and without the need of endless grind to progress.

name: Survival Ball
short_description: Single or Local Co-Op physics-based game with six distinct stages developing a simple premise: As the decaying world challenges you, don't fall!

name: Asdivine Saga
short_description: Uncover the evil machinations behind a warring kingdom in a fantasy RPG!

name: Quinterra
short_description: Customize your army and control the battlefield in this challenging turn-based tactics game with roguelike progression!

name: Re:Legend
short_description: Adventure with friends in a beautiful world of wonder and fantastic creatures. Build, craft, farm and fish, as you raise and breed amazing pet companions!

name: SoTo
short_description: SoTo is a challenging game which you need a good plan to pass safely through the path of enemies. In order to collect the keys and unlock the locks, you need to adjust your timing well.

name: Jelly Is Sticky
short_description: Explore a world of colorful jelly blocks that can be deformed and stuck together. Use them in surprising, unexpected ways to build clever contraptions and solve delightful puzzles.

name: Sleep Tight
short_description: Sleep Tight is a fast paced action horror game. Survive the waves of monsters if you can, upgrade different weapons to help you. Remember pay attention, listen closely, and don't let them get you!

name: Nyxx
short_description: A classic 2d bullet hell shoot'em'up.

name: AngerForce: Reloaded
short_description: AngerForce: Reloaded is an action-packed vertically scrolling shoot'em up game that pays homage to the classics of 90’s arcades. This high octane experience is set against the backdrop of a 19th century human world that has seen the outbreak of a robot rebellion.

name: Zombie Waiting
short_description: Many years ago people and trolls had lived with peace in the world. Until the zombie virus spreads...

name: StratoBash
short_description: Be a contestant on StratoBash! Race up the floating islands along the stratosphere, bashing off Eyeoids, solving puzzles & more to score. Use VR controllers to throw Bashers, or play with a mouse & keyboard.

name: Victor
short_description: A third person gladiator fighting game, in which you defeat waves of enemies to claim victory

name: Serious Breakdown
short_description: Serious Breakdown is a platformer, in the role of a robot, you need to clean up the levels as much as possible and get the necessary parts. Learn to dodge or kill enemies. At the end of the path, you will need to defeat the main villain of this universe.

name: Gon' E-Choo!
short_description: 'Gon' E-Choo!' is a 3 stage, arcade-style game based on the earliest arcade platformers. Collect 10 letters in each stage while avoiding an irate and unrelenting gator!

name: Demon Hunter: Chronicles from Beyond
short_description: Discover your true identity and face a mysterious entity from another dimension!

name: Cruentis The Murderer vol.1
short_description: A story of murder, demons and lost souls. The eternal struggle between good and evil. Based on an original story you'll test the fear in the shoes of a teenager trapped in a temporal limbo, between present and past. You interpret the main characters of the story and try to return to the reality of your life.

name: Death Collector
short_description: Sever and preserve the tongues of the dying to steal their stories! Whether you gather their tales and memories for the greater good, or use what you learn to become one of the elite who decide what to call 'History' is up to you.

name: Time Carnage

short_description: Close Combat is a pausable real-time wargame series, heavily focused on historical accuracy and realistic soldier psychological profiles. Team management is crucial as every man in your team matter.

name: 幻梦之城(C T O D)
short_description: This game is a combination of tower defense and horizontal board operation elements. You have no other choice in the game. The only choice is to defeat your opponent and survive

name: Siege Hammer
short_description: Siege Hammer is an entry-level VR game created for the entire family to enjoy. Uniquely-designed for comfort, it delivers hours of fun-filled playtime. Are you the hammer…. Or the anvil?

name: Project VR Wild Hunt
short_description: Welcome to the Wild Hunt Project VR - this is a 100% transfer of the hunting process in VR, with a huge variety of wildlife and a rich arsenal of hunting weapons.

name: Crazy Farm : VRGROUND
short_description: 'VRGROUND: Crazy Farm' is a party game based on a clash between a farmer and animals who are stealing his apples. Farmer who is using VR(or PC) and animals who are using smart device can choose one of 3 game modes to play and enjoy together.

name: The secret of the stone
short_description: The secret of the stone - single-player game in which the player has to find his sister and solve the mystery of a mysterious stone.

name: The Parenting Simulator
short_description: This is a story where you do something more terrifying than entering a haunted house, more dangerous than assaulting an alien horde, and more important than ruling a fantasy kingdom. You, and you alone, must turn your newborn baby into a functional adult. Will you be a tiger mom or a helicopter dad?

name: The Martian VR Experience
short_description: The Martian VR Experience is an interactive, immersive adventure from the perspective of astronaut Mark Watney. Participants perform tasks for Watney’s survival, fly onto the surface of Mars, steer at zero gravity through space, drive a rover, and experience key scenes from the hit film in an interactive virtual reality environment.

name: The Haunted Exmone Theatre
short_description: The Haunted Exmone Theatre is a 2D Survival Horror Game based on the story of a paranormal investigator called Omar, who got an urgent call from the owner of the Exmone Theatre to investigate the building for the paranormal evidence.

name: Kokorogawari
short_description: Kokorogawari (Change of Heart) is a GxB otome human drama visual novel set in a grounded and authentic portrayal of modern-day Japan. While the two main themes are about love and the arts, Kokorogawari also explores the complexity and depth of familial relationships and emotions.

name: LOGistICAL 3
short_description: LOGistICAL 3 is a strategy puzzle game where you transport different cargoes to complete all the towns throughout each country and/or state. The whole game is a huge puzzle while each city is its own little piece of puzzling. Plenty of cities are easy enough plus a bunch of tougher challenges.

name: Crimson Gray
short_description: John is a young man suffering from severe depression. As he loses his sense of purpose in life, he begins to see the world in unfocused gray. Just when he begins to lose all hope, John meets a girl... a very special girl.

name: Street of Sanctuary VR
short_description: Since several months ago, an insurgent group called “Futealer” have made a lot attacks on federal facilities. Your squad is sent to Sanctuary Street to stop them from approaching a crucial science facility called Neb Lab. This won’t be a difficult task for seasoned soldiers like you.

name: MC Lars: The Video Game
short_description: Jump, fight, and fly your way through a dozen songs from MC Lars’ discography!

name: Tenebrous Dungeon
short_description: As a war brews over the secession of the Tenebrous Highlands from the Kingdom of Gnarmania, you alone must infiltrate the dungeons of Tenebrous Keep and stop a rebel lord from tearing the kingdom apart.

name: Anime Cards
short_description: Welcome to the game 'Anime cards'! A real puzzle in the style of 'anime'.

name: You Have 10 Seconds 3
short_description: The official third installment in the You Have 10 Seconds series! Dodge spikes, lasers and solve puzzles to make it to the exit before time runs out! Over 300 new levels, brand new gameplay mechanics and more!

name: Break The Targets
short_description: Break the Targets (BTT) is a unique time-trial platformer game with simple controls featuring hundreds of levels and an online leaderboard for competitive placing.

name: Симулятор Сидения у Подъезда
short_description: Гыгы

name: The Fairy's Song
short_description: Marnie, a bored goth girl, accidentally stumbles upon a sleeping female knight in the forest. Together, the pair must work to break a centuries-old curse, while romantic feelings between them begin to grow.

name: Mystic Vale
short_description: Are you ready to lead your druidic clan and cleanse the Valley of Life? Mystic Vale is a stunning digital version of the Origins award-winning AEG card game. Debuting the unique Card Crafting System, players take turns building powerful combos in order to stop the curse. Play online or local hotseat.

name: The Adventures of Clive McMulligan on Planet Zeta Four
short_description: Clive McMulligan is a 2D retro-inspired action/puzzle/platformer with challenging old school style gameplay. Over 70 levels with fast-paced gravity switching mechanics.

name: Penguins of The North
short_description: What could be easier than moving a punch of quacking penguins from screen left to screen right?

name: Asdivine Hearts II
short_description: With a world on the verge of being frozen in ice, hearts unite once more in a sequel to the smash hit RPG series!

name: Tricks and Treats
short_description: Clear plates and collect candies to complete matching puzzle levels in a spooky setting. Charge powerups to blast through various obstacles and collect silver and gold to decorate your spooky mansion.

name: Nono's magic general shop
short_description: 'Nono's Magic General Shop' is a collecting tycoon game.You will play as 'Nono', a 16-year-old girl who helps out at grandma's magic general shop. Come and help Nono run the business!You will develop all kinds of products to achieve the ultimate goal - Become the most popular magic generl shop in town!

name: Berserker
short_description: Side scroller game with story-driven elements, based in old Viking age before all known written sagas and scripts, we follow Asbjorn as he must save and protect what he cares the most for.

name: Driver Booster for Steam
short_description: Driver Booster for Steam is a must-have driver updater to keep drivers and game components up to date. It is very powerful and easy-to-use for all Windows users.

name: Bullet Hell ADVANCED
short_description: Early Access Game. An overarching turn based universal / solar system game featuring fleet to fleet combat engagements that also allow players to pilot a superfighter to inflict extra damage and call in fire missions on enemy ships. Roguelite dungeon crawler and 4 player multiplayer to be developed.

name: Life and Debt: A Real Life Simulator
short_description: Life & Debt: A Real Life Simulator is a 2D pixel art life management simulator. Life & Debt focuses on the beginnings of new home ownership after moving out of your parents' house. You will have to maintain your finances and cashflow while having a really bad shopping addiction.

name: Little Lost Robots
short_description: Little Lost Robots is a challenging puzzle game designed for players who want a proper mental workout. Help the robots reach the rescue portal by placing a sequence of commands for them to follow, pressing play, and hoping nothing crashes!

name: Core Awaken ~Jilelen and LittleSnow~
short_description: Cool and cute 2D Scroll action game!

name: Flatwaters: The Curse of Echita
short_description: Flatwaters: The Curse of Echita is an open world game in which we will have to conquer each island of the city 'Echita' and loot all the treasures in it.

name: Rift Keeper
short_description: Embark on your journey, travel through rifts and restore the balance as the Rift Keeper in this handcrafted 2D roguelite platformer with challenging, fast-paced action gameplay.

name: Space Captain McCallery - Episode 3: The Weaponmaster's Challenge
short_description: Captain McCallery voyages to a planet of prehistoric monsters in search of a reclusive Weaponmaster.

name: Fragmental
short_description: An intense competitive and co-operative, couch-play multiplayer twin-stick shooter with some of the fastest and most frantic gameplay around. It’s a single screen, explosive arcade blast of fun where the weapons and arenas are deadly and the rivalry is fierce.

name: Your Royal Gayness
short_description: The library is on fire, cats have overrun the city and a wolf is munching on grandmothers in the forest. On top of that, princesses are knocking on your door, hungry for marriage! Survive royal life as a gay prince in this ultimate fairytale parody game!

name: Little Island
short_description: Little Island offers you the experience of interacting with a variety of cute animals in a VR space. Dive into a world full of nature and adorable animal children. You will be healed by interacting with the lively animals. Help them in their time of need, play with them, and love them.

name: Robot King Part 2: Boss Battles
short_description: The second in a 3 part series, Robot King Part 2 continues the journey of a robot on a quest to find his place in a kingdom where everyone seems bent on his destruction. 'Robot King 2: Boss Battles' is as the name indicates: a series of boss battles.

name: Maze Workout - Lost Urban Exit Game - Trials1
short_description: It's a maze game with 60 levels, you are alone, find the keys and the exit.

name: Space Voyager
short_description: Space voyager is a solo action/puzzle game with simple and effective gameplay. Swipe your way through space, but keep an eye of the fuel gauge !

name: Dr. Professor Scientist's Weapons Testing Facility
short_description: DPSWTF is a casual tower defense game with roguelike elements, where instead of placing towers, you build the best tower of them all. Combine the best projectiles with effective modifiers and push back the incoming hordes. Research them all to conquer the secrets of the Great North!

name: Slamdunk VR
short_description: -This is a VR game that really brings you the shooting experience. -We’ve got a powerful physical system that allows everyone to shoot like a NBA star! -There is an online ranking board as well. Come on! Show your excellent shooting techniques and your best score to the world!

name: Age Of Forays
short_description: Feel yourself in the role of warrior. Do raids, improve your ship, improve your hero, control your combat unit. Become a part of the great history of the northern kingdom

name: Call of Senpai: Waifu Warfare Origins
short_description: Take control of the beautiful Miki, and explore the area from the ocean coast, to the deep jungle. Advance through the storyline and fight through various challenges for the title of main waifu and 5 million dollars.

name: Zombo Buster Advance
short_description: Zombo Buster Advance is a tower defense game taking place inside buildings with interchangeable elevators. Deploy, swap and shoot like a boss!

name: The Signal State
short_description: Set in a post-apocalyptic future, The Signal State puts your logic skills to the test with complex puzzles inspired by modular synthesizers. Repair machines, rebuild an abandoned farm, and be part of a revolution that will change the fate of agriculture once and for all.

name: Bobbi_Cities
short_description: In 10 levels, players can use fireballs, snowballs and boulders to attack enemies in addition to building defensive towers, and can summon reinforcements for defense.The fireball can cause a lot of damage, and a snowball can slow down the enemy, and the boulder can destroy the enemy.

name: Top Trumps Turbo
short_description: Top Trumps™ Turbo is a brand new, exclusive fun and exciting Top Trumps™ card game brought to you by Funbox Media. Use the cards and your skills to beat the computer and become the ultimate Top Trumps™ Turbo Champion!

name: The Walking Vegetables
short_description: It’s the 1980’s and an evil alien race has invaded Earth, turning all vegetables into crawling, bawling, mauling abominations. You are about to join Department Radical, the grooviest police force on Earth. Are you a rad enough dude (or dame) to smite these ravenous creatures?

name: Dread Hunger
short_description: A game of survival and betrayal. Eight Explorers path their ship through the unforgiving Arctic. Among the crew, two traitors call on dark powers to undermine them.

name: The Underground Man
short_description: Moscow: somewhere in the near future. The city and perhaps the Earth's surface has turned into a radioactive ash. Those who decided that they could not exist in such conditions began to live under the ground.

name: ガリア戦記　雄篇アンナーレス
short_description: 『ガリア戦記』を舞台にしたターン制ストラテジー。 シンプルなコマンド方式に、ストーリーの数々が華を添える。

name: Offside
short_description: “Offside” is Detective Mystery Sports Game and Yuri Dating Simulator set in Manchester, in the North of England. Play as Detective Inspector Linda Broadmarsh as she is put on one of the highest profile cases in all of Manchester’s history.

name: Legends of Pixelia
short_description: Legends of Pixelia is an action RPG that combines retro pixelart with modern gameplay mechanics. Choose a hero class, crawl through procedurally generated dungeons and show your reflexes in challenging boss fights. Single player & local multiplayer, best played with gamepad.

name: Tiger Fighter 1931 Tora!Tora!
short_description: This is a shoot em up game , In this game the player combats a large number of enemies by shooting at them, the game is set in the Chinese People’s War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression,off the air of the North Eastern Province.

name: Sweet Match 3
short_description: Sweet Match 3 is a simple match 3 game. Drag and drop the candy and get a high score. Made in Construct 3. Enjoy your game!The game has nice graphics and music.Collect as many Jelly as you can and get the most points.Forward!

name: Bombernauts
short_description: Bombernauts is an explosive online multiplayer battle game with fully destructible voxel terrain. Throw stupid amounts of bombs to blow your robot friends off the world into the deadly lava below where they will surely die a fiery death!

name: Faster Than Possible
short_description: Try to get the lowest time by abusing triple jump, wall climb, and wall hugging mechanics! The fastest time wins!

name: Project X
short_description: Two teenagers were disappeared in the vicinity of the Grackham National Park. At night a roar is heard from the forest. Nearby, a group of archaeologists finds a cave and skull of an unknown creature.

name: City of Brass
short_description: A first-person action adventure, inspired by Arabian Nights, from senior BioShock developers.

name: Miniature Garden
short_description: Miniature Garden is a Japanese mystery visual novel with multiple endings and art by Korie Riko (Lump of Sugar).

name: Louie Cooks
short_description: Your cat Louie is one of a kind: He wants to become a marmalade-cook and expects your help protecting his fruity ingredients from the onmarching waves of enemies, called cuties!

name: Military Life: Tank Simulator
short_description: Have you ever dreamt of riding a tank? Now you have got the chance to do it. The times when this sort of simulation was highly complex and enormous complicated are over. This game differs completely from the others and captivates with its intuitive and easy to learn gameplay.

name: Six Sides of the World
short_description: Six Sides of the World is a puzzle videogame that takes you into an intergalactic journey through different star systems riddled with brain-racking challenges.Spatial orientation, logic and pure wit will be your weapons to go through the different cube shaped planetary systems.

name: The Legend of Azarias
short_description: Play the the Archangel Raphael in your quest to save the girl Sarah from Asmodeus's castle! Can you defeat the hordes of demons in this giant castle and save Sarah before it's too late? You need to travel the giant 13 floors and to get to the top in this action packed, first person dungeon crawler.

name: Cake Invaders
short_description: The Japanese just love their famous German-inspired Baumkuchen cakes, and hungry invaders from across the universe have discovered these delicious treats too! Are you up to the challenge of protecting the precious desserts from waves of alien attacks? Save the cakes!!

name: Hubert's Island Adventure: Mouse o' War
short_description: Zip and zap your way to victory!

name: Frosty Kiss
short_description: It's been a year since Semyon returned from 'Sovyonok' and met the girls from the camp in the real world. But it's New Year at hand! And it needs to be celebrated!

name: Claw Crane Company
short_description: Claw crane store management game. Make machines, arrange the prizes well, and aim for the world's best claw crane store. It's not only manage, you can also play, and must play yourself on the machines!!

name: 愛神餐館MAX
short_description: Love, restaurant, and RPG adventure all in one, the origin of the 'Cupid Bistro!!' series is here! As the main protagonist Rato Coriander, you need to run a bistro as part of your final year assignment. In one year's time, you are the one to decide all different endings with 13 beautiful girls!

name: 6 Seasons and a Game
short_description: This is a completely free, volunteer made, multiplayer, satirical parody of common thematic elements found in American broadcast television serieses (yes that's actually a word)

name: Soccer Battle Royale
short_description: Imagine battle royal and soccer will be combined in one game. This is exactly this game, Soccer Battle Royale.

name: Courier of the Crypts
short_description: Courier of the Crypts is a 2D puzzle adventure game where you have to survive as a Courier on his first errand to the ominous crypts. Main tool to achieve the mission is a Magic Torch which you use to illuminate your path, defend from darkness and solve puzzles - it must never run out!

name: King Of Gods: Angel The Awakening Of A Demon
short_description: King Of Gods aka K.O.G. is a 2D RPG released by O.T.B.S. The game was developed and written by Westwood W. Hinds... The first release of K.O.G. is Chapter 1: Angel The Awakening Of A Demon....

name: Jay Schilling's Edge of Chaos
short_description: A text adventure mystery with a modern parser.

name: Mysteries of the Undead
short_description: Demystify the zombie island and break the ancient curse!

name: Sands of Fire
short_description: Take control of forty tons of pure armored destruction! World War II is raging, and the enemy is fighting hard for every inch of territory in North Africa. Devastate the opposing forces with superior tactics, cunning strategy, and tremendous might.

name: Rainbow Dreams
short_description: Join Luka Sanguis, a college student unwittingly married to a Goddess, as he uncovers the mysteries of the world around him in this slice of life/comedy visual novel. Living a double life, Luka tangles with both his personal troubles as well as his role in saving the world from Daemons.

name: Helping Hand
short_description: Welcome to Helping Hand! A game about expressing yourself using only your left hand. What about your right hand, you say? Well that’s broken. As well as all the other bones and muscles in your body. Find out why and explore the different environments and character within this indie game!

name: Car Tehc
short_description: You may not know much about cars, it doesn't matter. We don't want you to unscrew thousands of screws like other games. We offer to you, a fun car repair simulation with simple mechanics.

name: Kingdom Under Fire: The Crusaders
short_description: The cult heavy metal fantasy action-strategy gem comes to PC in HD. Lead your armies from the front lines, giving strategic orders to your forces while wading into hack n’ slash action battle. Crush your foes across four campaigns, and spend the spoils of war on upgrading your forces.

name: Arcane Worlds
short_description: A game inspired by classic Magic Carpet, with modern graphics and features. You play as a sorcerer, exploring mysterious worlds, changing them, discovering ancient secrets, creating new spells, fighting creatures and other mages, building and destroying as you please.

name: Glare1more
short_description: Glare is a word entry type of game. Aim to clear it by inputting words or phrases found during conversation.. Glare 1more is a remake of the free game, Glare 1, and includes a bonus scenario. If you enter the correct words and phrase during Glare’s conversation the story will advance.

name: ADAPTR
short_description: Build physics-based vehicles from a range of modular blocks, solve puzzles to move down from orbit, across the Earth's surface and deep into the lost labs. Locate missing robots, explore secret areas and unlock the secrets of a long-lost civilisation.

name: CricVRX - VR Cricket
short_description: Virtual Cricket requires real batting talent to play. Ideal for Home and Arcade use.

name: MENTAL
short_description: MENTAL is an open-world action shooter for VR Veterans. Explore, earn money, level up, and fight increasingly resourceful gangs as a low-life criminal who finds himself in the middle of a plot to take over the flow of 'carbide' in the city. With great power, will you choose to be responsible?

name: Kinda Heroes: The cutest RPG ever!
short_description: Side-View & Scroll RPG made with love!

name: Joyo Kanji Quiz
short_description: A quiz that helps you review all Japanese characters that kids must learn when they go to school. From 1st grade all the way to secondary school, you can learn all 2,136 Joyo Kanji, their meanings and pronunciations.

name: Player City
short_description: Adventure game that integrates 3D semiotics with the real world through videos and photos of the city of Farroupilha (Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil). Take control of the character 'Kiwinho' and get to know the sights.

name: Vitality Girl Ⅲ:Pixel
short_description: The game tells the story of a sinful city where a mysterious assassination organization was born. Players play as a trainee assassin in this killer organization. As long as one more task is completed, he can become a full member, but he has also discovered a shocking secret.

name: Space Captain McCallery - Episode 1: Crash Landing
short_description: Space Pirate Captain McCallery has Crash Landed on an alien planet! Explore a strange and hostile alien world in this Low-Poly 3D Action-Adventure game.

name: Severed Steel
short_description: A stylish single-player FPS featuring a fluid stunt system, destructible voxel environments, loads of bullet time, a unique one-armed protagonist, and a dark electronic soundtrack.

name: Rebound
short_description: Rebound is a physics based reflex arcade game where the player must keep a ball within bounds of the screen, while aiming for the most points and longest time survived possible in a single round. Sounds simple, right?

name: The Benza RPG
short_description: The epic quest to fix a broken toilet seat and save the world is now in your hands! The hit Japanese comedy series 'The Benza' continues in this FTP retro JRPG!!

name: Blocks Stacking
short_description: Casual/puzzle game where the goal is to get as high as possible placing blocks on top of each other. Controlled by keyboard and mouse or gamepad. 4 difficulty levels make sure that anyone can play it, and for reaching certain goals you will be given cosmetic rewards.

name: Mind's Eye: Secrets of the Forgotten
short_description: Follow an enterprising journalist who smells murderous intent behind what everyone assumes was a suicide.

name: SCALEPLANET
short_description: Somewhere in the third dimension there lives an alien Joe. He can't sit still. He constantly travels and explores the world and galaxies. This time he came across a new planet.

name: Oh Jeez, Oh No, My Rabbits Are Gone!
short_description: A scary noise in the night has spooked your poor rabbits, and now all 100 of them have scattered across the valley! Run, climb, jump, and call out commands to your darling bunnies to bring them home to safety in this short n' sweet puzzle platformer — but make sure to be home before dark.

name: DEAD
short_description: Dead is a Competitive Zombie killing game and is free to play for anyone who wants to take their mind off of life.

name: Bomb Bomb! My Friends
short_description: 'Bomb Bomb! My Friends' is a 3D multiplayer bombing game where you can design your own level and then throw bombs with your friends to destroy it. Try not to fall and you will become the final winner.

name: Dungeoncraft
short_description: Dungeoncraft is a fantasy real time strategy game featuring multiplayer sandbox survival type gameplay, dynamic world expansion, and 3D grid based digging and building.

name: Sakura TTS
short_description: Sakura TTS is a well-optimized and intuitive Text to Speech program. This program is perfect for real-time communication through Text to Speech. With Sakura TTS you have full control over details and qualities about your TTS voice. Sakura TTS also lets you link specific sound clips to your hotkeys.

name: Generic Jumper
short_description: Jump through a quiet land and learn of it's past. What really happens when a chosen one saves the world? Experience challenges that emerge from simple blocks; Discover new uses for the ubiquitous crate; and Platform your way to the end of a story.

name: SUPER BUILD
short_description: Build, design, and explore your own fantasy world using over 1000+ items, in this relaxing sandbox game. No missions, no objectives, no timers. Just stress-free building, exploration, and good vibes.

name: Belladonna
short_description: Belladonna is a gothic adventure game, twisted and dark. Take the role of a corpse girl rising from the dead in an abandoned laboratory, and unravel the mysteries concerning your own death and reanimation.

name: Bubonic: Outbreak
short_description: You are in debt, your wife and kids have left and you have nothing left to lose, but how far will this take you? It is just another regular day at the office as a private detective and you find on your desk a letter from a friend tipping you off to something good. What will you find? Only time will tell...

name: Nanoui
short_description: The book of Nanoui has been stolen, plunging the kingdom into chaos and allowing the forces of evil to rise. Set in a fantasy world of great castles, magic and dragons, our four heroes begin their quest to retrieve the powerful artifact and save the kingdom.

name: Marcella Moon: Saboteurs on the River
short_description: Play as amateur sleuth Marcella Moon to investigate a series of sabotage incidents on the Louisiana bayou.

name: SokoBunny
short_description: SokoBunny is new fully 3d look at classic sokoban. Play alone or with your friend online, kick the cargo in the warehouse labyrinth.

name: Golf For Fun
short_description: Golf for fun, is a 2D golf-based game, focused on generating challenging and entertaining players, where you can play precisely crafted maps to test your skills.

name: Flower Design Ⅱ
short_description: An artistic floral arrangement simulation game, a vase of flowers can track your mood at the moment.

name: Legends of Murder Collection
short_description: When a murder is committed under mysterious and supernatural circumstances, the Inspector arrives on the scene, ready to interrogate witnesses, decipher riddles, and fend off attackers seeking their next victim. Ready your spyglass and sword as you take on these two murder mystery RPGs.

name: BAPTISM
short_description: BAPTISM is a short kinetic novel about a madman, a child, and a lake.

name: Dandelion - Wishes brought to you -
short_description: Dandelion -Wishes brought to you- is a female-oriented game developed by Cheritz. The game was released in South Korea in August, 2012. The English translation for Dandelion was released on Nov, 2012. Dandelion is known as a unique dating simulation with a sensational storyline and charming characters.

name: Pegasus: Broken Wings
short_description: Follow a new set of events involving Pegasus-5 crew with them being stuck in a city under curfew after a terrorist attack and getting entangled in a massive conspiracy. Stick close to your allies, build romantic relations, and make important choices.

name: Fair Deal: Las Vegas
short_description: “Fair Deal: Las Vegas” is a side scroller 2D pixelart retro arcade shooter where you play as Paul Riggs, a former corrupt cop from Detroit that travels to Las Vegas seeking revenge on the mafia that made him do terrible things for money.

name: Numberline 3
short_description: Numberline 3 is hard, but very interesting puzzle game, which will force your mind work for all 100%. You relax, play and listen good soundtrack in the beginning, but after a few levels the game becomes difficult and more exciting.

name: Inexplicable Geeks: Dawn of Just Us
short_description: Enter a world of ridiculously underpowered superheroes as you navigate a comic and pop culture convention celebrating their history. Gather stories, piece together history, and interact with the denizens of the super and the geek.

name: The World Of Others
short_description: The World Of Others is a Singleplayer First-Person-Shooter with a unique Story. Fight your enemies with up to 5 different weapons. Collect ammunition for the weapons to be ready to fight. Care for your injuries with medipacks to hold out.

name: No Umbrellas Allowed
short_description: Reveal the true value of the items coming into the shop. Each item has their own history. Dig deep to see what is behind them and become an expert appraiser. Begin a tug of war with customers. With their own expectations and knowledge, they never give up on money.

name: Sky Fleet
short_description: Take to the skies as part of the Sky Fleet, defend sacred floating islands, build strong bases and towers to protect their resources, as well as shoot down waves of rogue drones trying to strip-mine them!

name: Return to Krondor
short_description: Return to a world of danger, magic, and betrayal.

name: TOTO Quest
short_description: Toto quest is a 2D platform game where the brave Toto, prince of the desert, embarks on a dangerous adventure to discover all the secrets of an ancient pyramid.

name: Koboomballs
short_description: Kobooomballs is an arcade-style, top-down, twin-stick shooter with light RPG elements. You use your 'icetank' to clear an area by destroying enemy mazes, then use salvage to upgrade your icetank before moving on to the next area.

name: STAR WARS™: Squadrons
short_description: Master the art of starfighter combat in the authentic piloting experience STAR WARS™: Squadrons. Feel the adrenaline of first-person multiplayer space dogfights alongside your squadron, and buckle up in a thrilling STAR WARS™ story.

name: Umbra: Shadow of Death
short_description: Just as you were enjoying a walk with your sister she was kidnapped by evil space robots! Umbra: Shadow of Death is a 2d physics platform puzzle game that has seven large levels for you to conquer. It has puzzles, traps, monsters, robots, a high-performance truck and a mini-gun!

name: The Den of Worms
short_description: The Den of Worms is an open world exploration game where you must enter the Astral Plane on an esoteric quest to save your dreams from being eaten. On your way you will grow plants, hatch worm eggs, restore the life to towns, battle monsters, and uncover secrets.

name: Barbaria
short_description: Barbaria is a VR combat/builder mashup. Attack other players, build defenses, and equip your team as you compete to be the Mightiest in Barbaria!

name: Internet Simulator
short_description: Web-browser simulator from beautiful locations

name: POPOP!
short_description: Pop all the bubbles in the most satisfying game you'll ever play! Can you pop 'em all?

name: Not Their Will
short_description: Not Their Will is a 3D Top-down shooter in which you are an alien that uses the weapons of the enemies against them.

name: CometStriker
short_description: CometStriker is an arcade action shooter featuring dodging, power-ups and intense boss fights.

name: LIMINALPHOBIA
short_description: Travel through dark dingy apartments and cold stone basements. Stay away from the many creatures following you around every corner. Find collectibles and outlast the demons. walk this first-person horror experience through twisting mazes and search for keys. Outlast the demons and find any way out.

name: RADical ROACH Remastered
short_description: RADical ROACH is a fast paced shoot em’ up, set minutes after nuclear hell falls from the sky engulfing all but a few tough little bugs.

name: Searching for objects in the forest
short_description: Searching for objects in the forest is a classic game in the genre of 'I'm looking for'. During the game, you will have to get acquainted and search various places.

name: Operation: Cheek Clapper
short_description: Storm the base and clap alien cheeks in this fast-paced action game. Instant, quick, no fuss, alien fun!

name: Loco Road
short_description: Have you ever dreamt of participating in a deathrace where everbody blows up??! Me neither! But thanks to the sick minds of our Game Design students now you can do it! In this frenetic game you have to avoid beeing last in each lap or you will die and look bad doing it!

name: Another Sight - Definitive Edition
short_description: A teenager who has lost her sight and a mysterious cat team up in a surreal fantasy adventure into the unexpected, weaving a tale that brings together some of the world’s greatest minds: Monet, Tesla, Edison and other historical cultural icons.

name: Billy
short_description: Take control of Billy and Polly as you make your way through a colorful and challenging world full of precision platforming goodness.

name: Nightfall Comes
short_description: Nightfall Comes is a rogue-lite action game based on top-view 3D actions that tells the story of the four characters who gathered in a castle built on a fief, led by their last lingering feelings of the extinct world.

name: Tally Ho
short_description: Only a perfect servant can solve a perfect mess! Being the perfect gentleman's gentleman or lady's lady doesn't make you an angel. Can you untangle your employer's knottiest problems with elegance and unruffled grace?

name: 审判者
short_description: 'The Adjudicator' is an interactive video product deduced by real people. It uses the method of film + interactive gameplay to promote the development of the plot. The trend of the plot will be determined by you.

name: Derpy Fight
short_description: Derpy Fight is a local-multiplayer game where the first player to die, wins !

name: AstroShift
short_description: AstroShift is a unique free-roam 2D space shooter, where your ship's destruction isn't game over - you get flung into space, and you have to find and board a new ship before your air runs out, and YOU explode - you know, because science...

name: Weapon and Armor: Mahjong
short_description: Weapon and Armor: Mahjong is the perfect game for the casual player looking for fun and extensive gameplay. The goal of this game is to match open pairs of identical tiles and remove them from the board. The game is finished when all pairs of tiles have been removed from the board.

name: Learn Japanese To Survive! Hiragana Battle
short_description: The ideal introductory course to the Japanese language! Learn how to read and write Japanese characters (Hiragana) at a steady pace. A full-blown RPG specifically designed to keep you engaged. By playing along, you’re going to be introduced to the Japanese language like never before!

name: Inheritors2078
short_description: Inheritors 2078 is an RTS/TPS/FPS hybrid game with full Multiplayer & Co-op support, taking its events in the near future where the world is being dominated by evil robotic incarnates that were once enslaved by humans.

name: Food Bomber
short_description: It is a flight shooting game with funny and horror elements. Beautiful and strange masters of nightmare are waiting for you.

name: Ashes Cricket
short_description: Ashes Cricket is the officially licensed video game of cricket’s greatest rivalry. Bringing all the fast paced action, big hits and skill that you see in the greatest cricket competition on earth, you’ll be able to play in the men’s and women’s 2017/2018 Ashes tours.

name: World of Wonder
short_description: An open world VR game full of discovery and danger set in a beautifully vast landscape. Navigate the mysterious ruins and use your abilities to traverse and explore. Choose to play peacefully or upgrade your weapons by harvesting resources and build a base to call your home.

name: Leadwerks Game Launcher
short_description: Leadwerks Game Launcher lets you play a variety of creative, experimental, and wacky mini-games made with Leadwerks Game Engine. Fly a spaceship through an asteroid field, play a round of golf, or ride a lawn mower while dodging killer cows. It's free and there's a constant supply of new things to try.

name: VR Fitness Gym (Cycling, Marathon, Football, etc)
short_description: VR Immersive Fitness Gym: 6 New VR Exercises You Never Experienced.Bored with exercise? Virtual reality, immersive fitness might help you.1) VR Football Battle; 2) VR Immersive Cycling; 3) VR Immersive Running & Marathon; 4) VR Apple Games; 5) VR Immersive Shooting; 6) VR Yoga (Coming)

name: Depth Of Consciousness
short_description: Depth Of Consciousness is an incredible adventure in your own mind, a test of reactions and agility. Travel to all corners of your consciousness.

name: Sugar * Style
short_description: Sugar * Style is a Japanese-style visual novel produced by Smee, a Japanese developer of romance VNs. Be the perfect husband for your future wife and conquer her heart with your husband-powers!

name: Caves Of Mars
short_description: Caves of Mars is a new 2D sci-fi action adventure space shooter game set in the mysterious caves of the planet Mars. Your mission is to navigate your spacecraft through 100 procedurally generated levels, battle against and destroy enemies and alien lifeforms and collect as many gems as possible.

name: Space Probes
short_description: Space Probes is a Shoot Em Up (SHMUP) inspired by productions from the 90s released on SNES, MEGADRIVE, NEO-GEO, PC-ENGINE etc.

name: Academy of Magic - Lair of the Beast
short_description: Join the young magician Dennis and his freinds in this magical match-3 game, to save a kidnapped student from a monstrous beast.

name: Zombies on a Plane
short_description: Take on the role of the captain of a troubled jumbo jet carrying infected passengers intent on bringing the plane out of the sky, or pit yourself against hundreds of zombies in the interior of a jumbo jet or even walk along the outside as you fight to regain control as one of the passengers.

name: Mythic Defender
short_description: In this VR game combining Tower Defense & Archery, dexterity and strategy will be your best allies to help the gods to protect their kingdom against mythological creatures! Grab your bow and join this epic fight. Will you be able to defeat all enemies and keep the treasure of the gods safe?!

name: Spaceship Looter
short_description: Spaceship Looter is an action roguelike game, where mercenaries of all stripes rob drifting schooner, lost transtport ships and abandoned military cruisers - all what is filled with tons of valuable loot and hidden in the deep space.

name: TRIOS - lofi beats / numbers to chill to
short_description: TRIOS is a relaxing, minimalist maths puzzle game. Take your time, chill out with some numbers. Deceptively simple, surprisingly challenging.

name: Helix
short_description: HELIX is a single player platform action game. Use your special skill of changing gravity and go on a platform adventure of a lifetime. Go fast as you can by upgrading your character and try not to die by dangerous spikes.

name: A Rabbit and the Mystic Fog
short_description: 'A Rabbit and the Mystic Fog' is a virtual reality adventure in which you go on a search for the inhabitants of the valley, who have disappeared since a mysterious fog appeared in their homeland. Help the little rabbit by completing the story around the charismatic characters of the valley.

name: The Necklace Of Blood Part II
short_description: The Necklace of Blood Part II is the second part of a two parts thriller visual novel. It continues immediatly after the first part finished

name: The Blackout Club
short_description: The Blackout Club is a first-person co-op horror game centered around a group of teenage friends investigating a monstrous secret beneath the skin of their small town. 1-4 players explore procedurally-generated missions against a fearsome enemy you can only see with your eyes closed.

name: Void Encounter
short_description: Void Encounter is a 3D FPS alternative to currently very popular impostor-hunt games. Void Encounter takes that concept a bit further and features creepy level design, lighting features and random or impostor-initiated events.

name: Мистер Вселенная
short_description: In this game you have to go through a difficult path - from a mere mortal to Mr. Universe, the legend of sports and cinema, whose list is achievements updated in real time.

name: KingdomDefense
short_description: A fantasy game that combines Tower defense, MOBA, and RPG elements. Tutorial and five game levels. Single-play only.

name: The Arab Republic of Taghia
short_description: The Arab Republic of Taghia is an arab spring tyranny simulator. You have followed in the footsteps of your father and been 'elected' to lead the Arab Republic of Taghia, and must hold onto power through any means necessary.

name: Veccol
short_description: Blocks of different size and color falls from the top, rearrange the colors and place the blocks to match three or more of one color in any direction. Set up cascading line-clears for extra points.

name: Stories of Liane
short_description: An experimental narrative-focused walking-simulator experience that explores dark settings and stories through multiple perspectives.

name: 深入敵境 Behind Enemy Line
short_description: In the game, a large number of enemy troops will continue to hunt you down !! you have only one purpose!! kill all the enemies !! Now !! Be mentally prepared !! You are about to land on the battlefield !!

name: Midvinter
short_description: Midvinter is a cozy little point-and-click game, which invites you to explore Swedish folklore using puzzles and riddles as well as compelling music and voice over. In it, you as a player take on the role of gnome - the guardian of the farm - and get to interact with various dark and fantastical creatures.

name: ARENA 3D
short_description: Fast paced, bright and colourful arcade action accompanied by a pounding soundtrack.

name: Shiki
short_description: 2.5D fantasy adventure homage to 'The Little Prince '. 2.5D world consisting of 3D sphere model and pixel art. A Fantastic world view with subtle original graphics.

name: Planet's Edge
short_description: Travel between dozens of stars, harvest resources to repair and upgrade your equipment, meet and negotiate with friendly (and hostile) aliens, and do whatever it takes to stay alive and bring Earth back in this groundbreaking sci-fi RPG.

name: VR Party Pack
short_description: It's finally here! A social virtual reality game designed for parties! Cup pong, basketball, baseball, bowling, climbing, ping pong + so many more all in one bundle!

name: Dark Legion VR
short_description: Dark Legion VR is a first person shooter (FPS) and magic game. You can move freely using Vive or Oculus and teleport yourself. All the scenes are open and free.Weapon System,Huge battle scenes, advanced game level design, and smart AI, making you indulged in the game for a dozen hours (which we wouldn’t suggest you to go for that long,...

name: Pro Cycling Manager 2021
short_description: Manage one of 80 teams in over 260 races and 700 stages. From strategy to recruitment, it's up to you alone to make the best decisions. Experience more realism and authenticity with the new features added for 2021.

name: Magic Forest
