short_description: Space Conquest is a casual multiplayer fps for VR (PvP), combining fast-paced gameplay with competitive close quarters combat. Instantly jump into a game across different maps with no queues.

name: Climb Challenge
short_description: Climb Challenge is a third person perspective game were the player must navigate through three challenging levels. Each level has a unique design and play style challenging the players observation skills, puzzle solving skills, speed and most of all their determination to complete the game.

name: Krystal the Adventurer
short_description: Krystal's home has been burned down by a magic sword sent by a wizard, and it's up to you to help her beat him up!

name: Warman
short_description: Warman is an action-adventure game. Explore and fight your way through handcrafted challenges on your own or with your friends. Each dungeon layout is unique!

name: Empty Horizons
short_description: Following the sudden death of her father, Mireille Maiorano is sent to live with her uncle in France. Enter Lyon, a tactless, perverse Frenchman charged with escorting to Mireille to her new home. She hates him passionately, with everything she has... so why does he make her heart flutter?

name: Society's Paradigms
short_description: Society’s Paradigms is an action-packed social commentary based on the innovative combination of Rogue-lite and RPG elements. Explore a randomly generated world to obtain new skills and abilities. Experiment and combine passive and active skills to achieve insane combos and satisfying combat.

name: Scutter
short_description: Scutter is a VR arcade-style obstacle race for a hexapod robot. While exploring the planet Cryla, an alien virus rains down potentially ending your mission. Fire, Roll and Fly your way through action-packed maps of increasing difficulty to collect energy crystals and teleport Scutter back home. Free demo available!

name: 1001 Jigsaw. Cute Cats
short_description: A new game in the series of 1001 Puzzles. Cute, funny, cozy cats will melt even the coldest hearts! Assemble the puzzle pieces and enjoy the cute faces of pets.

name: In My Shadow
short_description: Play with shadows using your imagination to solve brain twisting platforming puzzles as you unfold a journey of loss, nostalgia and acceptance.

name: Dark Flame
short_description: Being a Dark Flame, the flame goes out quickly, you will have little time to find your way out, be smart or learn fast!

name: Agent X
short_description: Agent X is a short FPS game. The police officers named Turk give 5 task to complete! Let's see if Agent X can withstand against bad girls!

name: DYNASTY WARRIORS 8 Empires
short_description: DYNASTY WARRIORS 8 Empires is the latest installment of the 'Empires' series, in which you aim to conquer ancient China using both strategy and the one warrior versus one thousand tactical action the WARRIORS series is known for.

name: God of Failure
short_description: Defend your castle from the orcish chavs, lure them into your traps and destroy them.

name: Goddess Of War Ashley
short_description: 'Goddess Of War Ashley' is a vertical scrolling flying shooting game. The player controls the protagonist fighter plane to fight the enemy in the air,

name: Delicious - Emily's Road Trip
short_description: Travel with the O'Malleys as they take a trip down Route 66!

name: Paladin's Oath
short_description: Complex Strategy Fantasy card game RPG inspired by board games like Mage Knight or Gloomhaven. Combines elements of RPG, light deck-building, puzzle and strategy. Absolutely no micro-transactions, virtual currencies or any of that, ever

name: Onde
short_description: Catch a wave in this smooth sound-surfing platformer: Let ethereal tunes carry you fluidly through serene abstract landscapes, tune into soothing sound spheres and revel in a meditative journey of life.

name: Train Frontier Classic
short_description: Train Frontier Classic is a stylized landscape building and multiplayer train riding sandbox, inspired by the fun of model railroad building. Fill a scene with miles of scale track, hundreds of props, and a personal train car setup -- then go online to share and ride your creation with friends!

name: True Racing
short_description: The best way to start a carrer as politician? YES!!! ONE WORD!!! Wheels!!!... and, this is about it, how to solve political stuffs that can't be fixed within the democracy, with the democracy of the best, and humorist stuff, races, oponents, weapons, plus Wheels as vehicles, everything here

name: Ben and Ed
short_description: Ben and Ed is a 3D platformer, in which the player controls Ed the Zombie, who is forced to participate in a grotesque game show called 'Rundead'. Will he beat all obstacles Hans Showmaster confronts him with, to save his best friend Ben?

name: Briquid
short_description: Briquid is a simple yet challenging water physics puzzle game. Build bricks, remove them, or change the direction of gravity to get the water to its destination.

name: MX vs ATV All Out
short_description: All Terrain, All Vehicles, All You! MX vs ATV All Out is the complete off-road racing and lifestyle experience! Find your Rider Style at your private compound, Free Ride across massive environments, and compete in the best series events!

name: Beeswing
short_description: Beeswing is a game set in a small village in rural Scotland, the village I grew up in. Visit the places and people who shaped a life and discover their stories. Represented in hand painted, water colour graphics with a unique, acoustic soundtrack.

name: The House in Fata Morgana: A Requiem for Innocence
short_description: 'A Requiem for Innocence' is a companion to the visual novel 'The House in Fata Morgana.' It tells the tale of a young man dragged down by his ambitions and a girl both worshiped as a saint and maligned as a witch. For them, there is no happily ever after.

name: Fast Food Mania 3D
short_description: Fast Food Mania 3D - a game in the genre of three in a row with a set of glasses, made in 3D graphics.

name: IHF Handball Challenge 12
short_description: With IHF Handball Challenge 12 users can experience the fascinating sport of handball on their PC. Up to five players can compete for national and international trophies in the TOYOTA Handball- Bundesliga, the Spanish Liga ASOBAL or the IHF World Cup.

name: Robots n Lasers
short_description: Robots n Lasers is my first Project to be published. It is a shooter based on fast reactions, aim and a little bit of patience.

name: Netsoccer
short_description: Netsoccer 2 is a multiplayer online soccer game and it's free to play. Each gamer controls a player, not a team as is common in most soccer games. You can join different teams and have matches against other teams or you can just have a practice match online.

name: Totally Unbalanced
short_description: Totally Unbalanced is a 3D platform game where you have to complete puzzles and overcome obstacles. Totally Unbalanced also features (currently) two multiplayer modes : sumo arena with 4 players and racing mode with 16 players.

name: Void of Heroes
short_description: Mech battle royale and team deathmatch! New type of battle royale mode, built around a vertically rising death zone, instead of the common constricting circle!

name: Branches
short_description: Branches is an arcade scoring runner game.

name: 云端之约
short_description: 假如人工智能拥有了自我意识，你会怎样看待它们？或者说，他们。在信息技术高度发达的时代里，当人与人之间的交流只剩下屏幕的文字时，你的每一次选择，将带你揭开这个世界不一样的真相。科技与神话交织碰撞，邀你共赴一场云端之约。

name: Beardy the Digger
short_description: You play as a gnome digger who wants to collect all the diamonds in order to return home. It will not be easy for him to do this, because at every step he is in danger - from red-hot lava to poisoned darts. Be careful and attentive, and you can help the dwarf collect all the diamonds!

name: Dinosaur Hunt
short_description: Dinosaur Hunt is an intense action shooter that will take you on an epic journey of hunting the world’s most horrifying animals!

name: EVERING
short_description: EVERING is a turn-based RPG that tells an epic story through witty dialogue with charismatic characters. Uncover the origin of the mysterious hero and find out something you weren't looking for.

name: Psychocat: The Answer
short_description: 'Short' Arcade Game about the life of a cat named 'Zag', who desperately seeks an answer. The evil and unique gameplay is about reversing the controls on the keyboard.

name: Amerzone: The Explorer’s Legacy
short_description: The first adventure from the author of Syberia and Syberia 2, Benoît Sokal. In Amerzone you'll travel through enchanting landscapes, from Brittany to tropical forest. You'll have to solve the mystery of these famous white birds…

name: Squirrel Divorce
short_description: Squirrel Divorce - Top Down game where you control a squirrel and dodge the moles that crawl out of their holes, and also run away from annoying ex-wives and collect scattered luggage around the location. Each time one of the wives steals your truck and you have to catch up with a heavy truck.

name: Run Ralph Run
short_description: Ralph is a smart dinosaur, and a great shooter.

name: PLANES ATTACK
short_description: Your homeland sky is under attack. Will you defend it?

name: HexLab
short_description: HexLab is a logical game with a relaxing atmosphere and original gameplay.

name: Dungeons & Dragons: Chronicles of Mystara
short_description: Dungeons & Dragons: Chronicles of Mystara brings reworkings of two of Capcom’s classic arcade hits - Dungeons & Dragons: Tower of Doom and Dungeons & Dragons: Shadow over Mystara – together in one definitive digital package.

name: WarpBall
short_description: Football with a futuristic twist, WarpBall lets players teleport around the pitch for unrivaled mobility. Taking sports to the next level

name: Achievement Simulator
short_description: Ever wanted to know what achievement hunting is like? Earn money, buy games, and idle for achievements with the goal of reaching 100,000 achievements.

name: Heart of the Emberstone: Coliseum
short_description: Coliseum gives you a telekinetic playground to wield a mystical power, solve puzzles, and meet 'The Beast,” in a slice of fantasy from the VR world of The Gallery: Heart of the Emberstone.

name: Lifespan 5seconds
short_description: Lifespan 5seconds is a stage clear action puzzle game made by PixelGameMakerMV. While generating a block with a lifespan of 5 seconds Try on all 50 stages!

name: Space Balls
short_description: Shoot yourself into space as high as you can in this arcade game with a retro soundtrack!

name: M1 Tank Platoon II
short_description: The definitive simulation of modern ground warfare!

name: Draw a Stickman: EPIC 2
short_description: Imagination is the key, as you enter a magical storybook full of mystery and wonder, unusual creatures, and enigmatic puzzles! Create your own original Stickman and then watch it come to life in DRAW A STICKMAN: EPIC 2! Jump in to this action-packed adventure that allows for endless creativity!

name: Time Machine - Find Objects. Hidden Pictures Game
short_description: An exciting adventure through space and time awaits for you in the newest hidden object game! Immerse yourself into a real investigation, full of intrigue and mysterious temporal anomalies!

name: Far Away
short_description: Far Away is a visual novel full of dark humor depicting immersive storylines rather than romantic drama. You will play as Krosa, a typical girl who experiences gang conflicts, crimes, conspiracies, and family grudges in the port city of Bedjan.

name: Channel Player
short_description: Play multiple VR movie titles saved on your PC or WebDAV server as if they were a single movie file. and You can also browse still images and comic books (zip, cbz). A keyboard or XBox game controller, Oculus Touch is available.

name: Freedom Fighters
short_description: Freedom Fighters is an intense third-person action game set in an alternate history New York during the invasion of a foreign superpower. Take on the role of Chris Stone, a hard-working plumber, and rise through the ranks of the resistance to prove yourself as a charismatic leader.

name: Not The Robots
short_description: You are a robot in an office building. You have to eat furniture and not get caught. A mysterious story unfolds.Not The Robots is this year’s most exciting Roguelike Stealth Furniture Eating Simulator. It’s a game with random levels, permadeath, and the goal of eating furniture - which is also your stealth cover.

name: Witchkin
short_description: Witchkin is a first person 'hide-and-sneak' survival horror game in the vein of Slender.

name: Stickman in the Portal
short_description: Cubes, panels, buttons and many, many portals.

name: Evil Ritual - Horror Escape
short_description: You woke up in a cold and scary dungeon, and you don't know how you got there. After examining the situation and finding an old lamp, you try to get out, but you meet on your way: screamers, notes and various objects. Later, you realize that you have become part of an evil ritual!

name: Grand Battle
short_description: In this intense fully featured Action RPG, players fight with multiple heroes to save the world. And sometimes they chill and do some crafting!

name: Mechajammer
short_description: A tactical cyberpunk turn-based RPG set on an off-world grindhouse jungle colony. Skulk through the shadows or charge in guns blazing. Recruit a unique party for large squad-based assaults as your adventure plunges you deep into the city’s secrets.

name: Hero Siege
short_description: Hero Siege is a Hack N Slash Roguelike RPG with randomly generated zones, loot, randomized enemies, bosses and more! 4 Player Online Multiplayer!

name: Secret of the Rendrasha Blade CH1&2
short_description: A classic JRPG at heart, but with modern game design elements baked in, with a ton of secrets, hidden humor, easter eggs, and questionable / offensive choices to be made.

name: Blade and Ham
short_description: Blade and Ham is a classic fantasy beat'em up with modern picture! Grab your sword sharpen blade and don't forget a ham.

name: Rayland
short_description: Your mission is to help the inhabitants of Rayland to transport the energy of the Domus through the various lands contained in the path. For this, you must correctly position the Reflectus and rotate them so that the energy rays reach the necessary Domus.

name: Prank!
short_description: The story of how practical jokes can spoil the perception of the world

name: Affliction
short_description: Affliction is a survival horror shooter designed to engage players with a thrilling storyline, surreal environments, merciless foes, a chilling atmosphere, and an unforgettable gameplay experience. Players must explore, scavenge, and fight in order to survive and live to tell the tale.

name: An Elder Scrolls Legend: Battlespire
short_description: TRAPPED IN THE REALM OF DARKNESS

name: FUTURE GPX CYBER FORMULA SIN VIER
short_description: Master a 700 km/h cyber machine! Amazing graphics! Includes a VR mode! Make your best lap with the transformation system and the multi-step boost, just like in the 'Future GPX Cyber Formula' anime! Become the next world champion!

name: Kicks Online
short_description: Kicks Online is a Freestyle Football game available for free on Steam. It featured street soccer modes and rules, 1v1 , 2v2 , 3v3, 4v4 and 5v5 matches, and unconventional fields like roofs, streets and factories.-online.net/

name: Surviving Titan
short_description: You've crash landed on the planet Titan. Suffering from amnesia and armed with only a basic survival kit you begin exploring the planet looking for any signs of life. Can you craft, build, and survive long enough to discover the secrets of Titan and escape?

name: Battle For Korsun
short_description: January 1944. The German Army had their last toehold on the Dneiper River. The Soviet player must coordinate the offensives of his Fronts to encircle the Germans quickly, before the Germans powerful reinforcements arrive.

name: Eclipse: New Dawn for the Galaxy
short_description: Eclipse places you in control of a vast interstellar civilization, competing for success with its rivals. But instead of overcomplex set of rules and overall epicness, it offers more accessible choices, more elegant mechanics and much faster gameplay.

name: Metal Assault
short_description: Metal Assault is a free to play action packed 2D side scroller with rough 'em up, shoot 'em up fun! Grab some friends, grab a weapon and get in the thick of battle with defense specialist Carl, sharpshooter Marie, the brute force of Burton and tactical expert Ai!

name: Counter Spell
short_description: 'Counter Spell' combines elements of classic role playing games with modern stealth-based shooters. Single player, multiplayer coop, and competitive multiplayer are all supported with different game modes for each. An open, streaming world makes for an exciting sandbox to adventure in!

name: Out There Somewhere
short_description: You play an explorer stranded on a dangerous alien planet. Low on fuel, your only hope for escape is to find the planet’s core in this incredibly clever action-puzzle-platformer.

name: SmuggleCraft
short_description: As a smuggler, your hovercraft is your life. Customize your hovercraft to fit your needs and traverse the dangerous SideWays to increase your reputation. Evade the authorities and aid the many inhabitants of Dirahl to prove you’re the best smuggler around.

name: Speyarranoth
short_description: Speyarranoth is a classic sci-fi space asteroid shooter in 3D. You control the game using WASD and shoot with the space key. It's wonderful to just blast full speed through the asteroid fields lasers ablaze and enjoy the explosive light show.

name: Six Faces | Overpower
short_description: Fluid gameplay in a extremely challenging puzzles. Six faces, four powers (🚀,📦, 💣,⚓), easy to learn, hard to master. A fun 3D Puzzle game. With tons of combination possibilities and challenging levels. Solve (if you can) all 64 hand-drawn puzzles.

name: Alice's Patchwork
short_description: Assemble patchwork mosaics while you travel with Alice and the famous characters of Wonderland and Looking-Glass Land

name: Hylics 2
short_description: A surreal RPG with a unique graphical style and droll scenario.

name: Illegal Race Tuning
short_description: Go to the street and become the most wanted racer dominating the Underground.

name: Train Simulator: East Coast Main Line London-Peterborough Route Add-On
short_description: One of the busiest routes on the British rail network springs to life in the stunning East Coast Main Line London-Peterborough route for Train Simulator, featuring the classic High Speed Train and commuter Class 365 EMU.

name: SpookyKillers: Chapter 1
short_description: Your skin has melted and now you're a living skeleton.Trying to escape this creepy world full of zombies and strange people will sure be a challenge to your madness.

name: Try Hard Parking
short_description: 'Hardest and most Rage Inducing Parking Game in The World'. Navigate crazy obstacle courses in pursuit of your holy parking spot in this 80s Arcade Style driving game.

name: Darkness and Flame: The Dark Side f2p
short_description: There is no one in the world who could return from the Dark Side inviolate… “Darkness and Flame. The Dark Side” is an adventure game in the genre of Hidden Objects, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters and complicated quests.

name: Maze Roller
short_description: Meet Bernard. He enjoys long rolls along the beach and candlelit maps but what he loves most is cheese. Unfortunately, the cruel developers at Meerkat Gaming have placed his favorite treat at the end of a series of complex mazes and he needs your help to find it.

name: ELEVATED
short_description: ELEVATED is a multiplayer (8 vs. 1) thriller action game where eight death row inmates try to complete the given tasks to gain their freedom while being chased by the 4th horseman of the apocalypse, 'The Death'.

name: Super Huey™ III
short_description: Super Huey™ III is a direct sequel to the PC’s first helicopter simulation, featuring tense combat and daring rescues in over 35 dramatic missions! This revamped version of the 2003 classic enhances the original while still packing all the high-flying and explosive action you remember.

name: The Christmas Gifts
short_description: The Christmas Gifts is a 2D Old School Christmas Themed Action Platformer based on the story of a boy named Kim who is in search of his gifts which got stolen from his garden.

name: Through the Mirror
short_description: A hard, mind bending platformer based on imagination and quick reflexes.

name: The Outer Worlds
short_description: The Outer Worlds is an award-winning single-player RPG from Obsidian Entertainment and Private Division. As you explore a space colony, the character you decide to become will determine how this player-driven story unfolds. In the colony's corporate equation, you are the unplanned variable.

name: Mobocratic
short_description: Mobocratic – Play as the president of the distant Bear Island where the lives of the citizens are yours to be improved – or destroyed. Lead the nation to prosperity – or witness its downfall!

name: Killer Gin
short_description: Classic Epic Fantasy Adventure - A JRPG with optional dating and farming mechanics

name: Spell Karts
short_description: Race around in magic infused go-karts with friends to win shiny pebbles. Or try your hand at one of the arena modes where you pit yourself against your friends in close-quarters combat. If you get enough pebbles you can buy new vehicles and avatars to show off your new found riches.

name: Portal Dungeon: Goblin Escape
short_description: Portal Dungeon is a medieval fantasy action game where you have to activate a network of dungeon portals and clear them from the monsters.

name: Spacelair
short_description: Spacelair is a retro sidescroller arcade adventure with various gameplay challenges; health, air, food, work, education, energy, purchase buildings, mini-missions, greenhouses and without violence or shooting. Dive into the parallax future and discover your lair today!!

name: Digital Diamond Baseball V7
short_description: Digital Diamond Baseball is a computerized baseball simulator that allows gamers to play individual games, series, or entire seasons, using players from any baseball season in history. Never pay for a new season again!

name: Alien Robot Monsters
short_description: Epic sci-fi tower defense action with 16-bit era look and feel, pitching your colonists against an almost endless horde of hostile alien robots who strongly oppose your attempts of colonizing their planet! Deluxe version includes the soundtrack!

name: The Guest
short_description: 'The Guest' is a gloomy adventure full of enigmas where the exploration of your surroundings comes to prominence; puzzles, secrets and riddles will help you discover who has locked you in this somber hotel room and most importantly, why.

name: Möbius Front '83
short_description: Defend America from an alternate-universe America using state-of-the-art 1980s military hardware in this intricate and tactical turn-based strategy game.

name: Buckler 2
short_description: BUCKLER 2 is a retro-styled roguelite platformer that tells a story about love, hate, and everything in between. Join Venice and his friends as they embark on an epic adventure across Sector Omega, an unfamiliar world filled with enemies, allies, hazards, and more!

name: Icarus Starship Command Simulator
short_description: In this 'starship command simulator' you will fight your way to the center of a randomly generated galaxy where a massive star is about to go supernova and destroy all life. Can you find a way to stop it?

name: Lost Island
short_description: Trapped on an Island. Find items to survive and finish missions

name: Crawlers and Brawlers
short_description: Become an adventurer and go on a fantastic journey through epic procedurally generated dungeons. Collect powerful loot to develop your character and then brawl online with your friends on 12 different multiplayer maps.

name: Memory Maze
short_description: Memory Maze is a new maze game with an original concept. Designed for all types of players and all ages.

name: Into the Abyss
short_description: You are Sonja, a student of necromancy fighting to rid the world of a terrible illness that's taking the lives of all mankind. Fight alongside a zombie, a witch and even death in this exciting journey of persistence, friendship and determination!

name: Pipeline Of Emperor Yu
short_description: 'Pipeline of Emperor Yu' is a puzzle game combining historical legends with classic water pipe gameplay! Facing all kinds of obstructions of the heavenly visions and unsuccessful grievances of three people, you need your wisdom to solve all these problems. Various elements such as sky mine, ground motion, fog, ice skating, etc.

name: 僕と彼の危険な同居生活
short_description: 「僕と彼の危険な同居生活」はニューヨークに留学した大学生の陽向が事件に巻き込まれるうちに、一癖あるシェアハウスの住人たちと男性同士の友情を超えた絆を育んでいくBLゲームです。

name: Storm over the Pacific
short_description: Storm over the Pacific is a game that takes place during 1937-1945. It depicts the conflict between the Japanese Empire, the USA and other allies during World War II.

name: Adventure Hero
short_description: Run and collect coins and power-up to fight with bosses in fantastic worlds.

name: Collect Objects
short_description: Collect objects, how more you can? You need to solve puzzles to collect objects.

name: Project:Sphere
short_description: Arcade video game in 3D, of frenetic action, in which you will have several modes to test your skills, maps that will change as they look, maps that will change their structures, skins for your sphere! Fight to survive or kill everything you can in this game full of spheres!

name: Crazy Sapper 3D
short_description: Classical Minesweeper gameplay in all new 3D way!The best game mechanics features from Minesweeper combined with a hero in 3D and new goal. A lot of obstacles in the level and bonuses to avoid it, Sapper need to go through mine field and reach Finish line, its not gonna be easy though.

name: Super XYX
short_description: Super XYX is a new shmup from the creator of Fire Arrow X, Megatank, ZPF and a couple of others. Co-developed and published by Team Grybanser Fox.

name: The Wizard or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying About My Face and Love the Tactical Dungeon Crawl
short_description: You play as Kevin, the handsomest wizard in school — until your face gets stolen! Learn gesture-based spellcasting as you beat challenging enemies through mind boggling mazes in this turn-based tactics game. Can you catch the thief and save face?

name: Nott Longa
short_description: A folk horror graphic adventure about nostalgia, lost futures & decay, designed as an interactive nighttime story to enhance your dreams. Collect hidden objects, help strange inhabitants, solve arcane riddles: find your way home through a ruinous reality haunted by glitches and folkloric creatures.

name: Valkyrie's Arrow | 瓦尔基丽的箭
short_description: This is an indie game that tests your skill selection and matching strategies. You can use the fragmented time to quickly enjoy the game, thereby releasing work and study stress. . . Ollie gives !!!!!

name: WILOO
short_description: Help Wiloo to rescue his buddy in this 2D old-school platformer with colorful graphics and heartwarming soundtrack.

name: New Lands 2 Collector's Edition
short_description: Grow cocoa beans, apples and sugarcane. Make the best sweet treats around and win the contest!

name: Anahita
short_description: Anahita loves her doll. Its been her best friend as long as she can remember. One morning Anahita awoke to find that someone stranger had stolen her precious doll! She has to find this thief and retrieve her cute and beloved doll.

name: Alien Monopoly
short_description: In different worlds, different groups of people compete for wealth and become the last strong.

name: The Necklace of Blood
short_description: The Necklace of Blood is the first part of a two parts thriller visual novel. That tells the story of a man at the service of darkness

name: The Thought Police Hotline: Episode 1
short_description: Do you like comedy and sci-fi and want to try something new? This visual novel is the first episode and it's John's first day at the Thought Police Hotline. You can click to move the dialogue forward. Estimated 1h to 1h 45m reading time depending on reading speed.

name: Zombie Teacher
short_description: Zombie Teacher is a gloriously retro platforming adventure that pays tribute to the video game stars of yesterday. Your task is to help our villain become the star of his very own game. All you must do is collect 66 vintage arcades from across the globe...sounds simple enough!

name: Tabbris Yor
short_description: Tabbris Yor is a sci-fi TPS shooter (with switchable camera to FPS). Serving as a private security agent of a human colony on Ganymeade, the largest moon of Jupiter's largest moon, your mission is to find each of the aliens and eliminate them - before they eliminate you!

name: Zooicide
short_description: Zooicide is a casual team-based multiplayer game featuring animals fighting against humans within a playfully dangerous environment, the zoo.

name: Aviator - Bush Pilot
short_description: As the busy operator of a hangar and runway in the heart of a region like the Serengeti, there are countless ways to earn a living. As an ‘old school’ bush pilot, you must undertake challenging jobs to make the lives of both tourists and locals a lot easier.

name: Ambush
short_description: Ambush is a party game up to 2-8 local players. Stay hidden in a crowd, spot other players among the bots, and slice them up with your freshly sharpened katana. Strategy and violence will be part of the game.

name: Route Me Mail and Delivery Co
short_description: Memorize your routes, deliver mail, collect hidden mail & pay off that pesky debt! Become the ultimate postman.

name: AddForce
short_description: Dear fellow Players, Please do not purchase the game anymore because it will become free anytime soon! If you have already purchased it, thanks a million. I do hope you liked it!

name: Fire for Effect
short_description: Fight off a seemingly endless rain of bombardment and cover an evacuation effort with the meager defenses of the besieged cities and your surprisingly potent gun

name: Drive
short_description: Drive is a VR arcade racing game that puts you in the car letting you experience racing as if you were actually out on the track. Featuring traditional racing modes and arcade-like challenges there is plenty of racing to be had whether racing against the AI or your friends online.

name: Spirits: Ciel Bleu
short_description: Willard Rouse is an ordinary 17-year high school student who is often by himself. By accident, he discovered that he is a spirit bearer, one who could summon and use the power of spirits. After getting kicked out of Rainvalley Academy, he transferred to Ficaso Academy.

name: The Wolf Among Us
short_description: From the makers of the 2012 Game of the Year: The Walking Dead, comes a thriller based on the award-winning Fables comic books. As Bigby Wolf you will discover that a brutal, bloody murder is just a taste of things to come in a game series where your every decision can have enormous consequences.

name: Another Sight - Hodge's Journey
short_description: Take control of Hodge the cat in a brand new, stand-alone prequel story in Another Sight - Hodge's Journey. Tackle new platforming challenges using Hodge's nimble feline skills to solve puzzles and misteries as he travels between the world of dreams and the world of the real.

name: Tank 51
short_description: Tank 51 is an increasingly difficult retro styled fast pace shooter. Aliens have invaded planet earth and it is up to you the player to stop the alien invasion..in your tank.

name: DREAM GIRLS VR
short_description: DREAM GIRLS VR is experience, meet all girls, play with them at the party in show room...Everything depends on your imagination

name: Faceted Flight
short_description: Faceted Flight is a stylized stunt flight game designed to deliver the thrill of flight. Take control of the Hover Jet and challenge ghost racers in Ring Attack or just relax and explore Free Flight....or you could always hop into the cockpit of the Jump Seat and give Target Practice a try. What are you waiting for? Do a barrel roll.

name: Alone in the Dark: The New Nightmare
short_description: From the moment Edward Carnby and Aline Cedrac set foot on Shadow Island, they are confronted by mysterious, evil creatures intent on thwarting their progress to recover 3 ancient tablets believed to hold the secret key to some incredible menacing phenomena. Danger threatens from every corner.
