short_description: Business simulator with rich economic model (markets with shortages and surpluses, websites with black hat SEO, etc.), flexible configuration of movie production, complex casting, two modes of shooting (fast and detailed ones) and other features. Beautiful graphics and no sexually explicit content.

name: Crazy Flasher Series 2021
short_description: The classic flash game series CrazyFlasher, which used to accompany young people, is packed by its author Andy law and uploaded to the world - famous game platform steam, which is convenient for players to collect.

name: 两体
short_description: 两体是一款轻松欢乐的平台对抗游戏，采用了经典的物理炮术玩法，有着个性鲜明的战斗英雄。玩家们选择自己的阵容与伙伴，与其他队伍来一场激烈的场地争夺战！

name: ABE VR
short_description: ABE VR is an intense experience that recreates the horrifying story about a misguided robot seeking the unconditional love of humans…at whatever cost.

name: North Stars
short_description: North Stars(NS) is a parabolic ballistic multiplayer online throw game with multiple roles and skills and different game modes. May you come to throw the ball?

name: BULLET HEAT
short_description: BULLET HEAT is a virtual reality arena shooter and sandbox game. Interact with different weapons, fight off waves of enemies, and experiment with different physics and building mechanics.

name: Rogun Arena
short_description: Classic shooter with three game modes: Arena-battles with waves of monsters and people. Defrag-skill and time levels. Single player - a story game in the classic style.

name: Any Candy
short_description: Any Candy is a simple match 3 game, tap screen drag and drop the candy get high score. Made in Construct 2. Enjoy the game!The game has nice graphics and music.Collect as many Jelly as you can and get the most points.Forward!

name: Memory Oblivion Box
short_description: 一份工作，让秦幽羽的父亲从此失踪，紧接着又是母亲的突然离去。虽然从未放弃过寻找，可是事情却毫无进展，直到那天……

name: Construct: Escape the System
short_description: „First person platforming gameplay at its very best!“ Construct: Escape the System is a sci-fi themed first person platformer that sees you trapped in a computer system, trying to escape. Explore the system and discover the 8 empowering 'ability orbs'.

name: SCIENCE SHOW VR : THE ABYSS
short_description: A five-sense, deep-sea scientific exploration VR content that travels through the five oceans in search of marine topography and secrets of reproduction.

name: Death Goat
short_description: Death Goat is a bloody arcade shooter featuring hordes of brutal enemies & eardrum destroying Heavy Metal.

name: Obscura
short_description: A new reality of fear. What you see may follow into your dreams, that will soon turn into nightmares.

name: Happy Hops
short_description: Endless hopping fun! Relax and unwind by jumping between Lilly-pads to earn points. Earn bonus points for collecting lotus flowers. Collect enough to earn new high scores! Supports controllers and keyboard controls

name: Nancy Drew®: The Secret of Shadow Ranch
short_description: Take a Wild Ride into Terror and Trickery to Rein in a Ghostly Secret!

name: Hoa
short_description: Hoa is a beautiful puzzle-platforming game that features breathtaking hand-painted art, lovely music, and a peaceful, relaxing atmosphere.

name: Sphaera
short_description: Sphaera is a game about relaxation and exploration in a huge grass field filled with animals.

name: FarRock Dodgeball
short_description: FarRock Dodgeball is a sports RPG based in NYC that includes a Story mode, Arcade mode, and a Versus mode. Buying sneakers in Harlem to improve your stats, Eating NY pizza in Brooklyn to replenish your health…this is more than a dodgeball game, it's an experience…the real NYC experience.

name: Mechs & Mercs: Black Talons
short_description: You are commander of the Black Talons company, currently stationed in the Oberon system. After an eventful campaign, the military Tzanar Union has overrun the planet of Genai and blocked all departure from the system: leaving you and the Black Talons stranded.

name: Broken Universe - Tower Defense
short_description: Get ready to rethink all your defense strategies! Build barricades to stop monsters, or lure them into a maze and attack. A variety of stages that change each time depending on how you play them.

name: Behind the Frame: The Finest Scenery
short_description: Guide brush strokes and solve a variety of puzzles to help an aspiring artist complete her masterpiece amid her brusque neighbor’s gaze and his pesky cat. As her painting starts to take shape, uncover an emotional tale of chance and artistry revealed behind unrelated yet familiar moments.

name: Shiba Mekuri 柴めくり
short_description: January 23, 2021. A small family member has joined our family. A two-month-old Shiba Inu puppy. We named her Hina. This is a puzzle game with lots of cute daily videos of Shiba Inu Hina.

name: Mini Tone - Minimalist Puzzle
short_description: Mini Tone is a minimalist puzzle game that combines musical notes and physical intuition. Find the perfect angle and launching point to eliminate all musical blocks from each level. Can you execute the Perfect Path?

name: Futbolín Revolution
short_description: Show your skills at table soccer. Play with your friends or challenge the machine and fill your trophy case. In the world's first multiplayer VR table soccer game.

name: StarMade
short_description: The ultimate space sandbox. Participate in epic fleet battles, form alliances, strive to dominate entire galaxies and harness the universe’s resources for your industrious empire or the destruction of others. Customise your experience, the universe is yours!

name: Shot of Rhythm
short_description: Shot of Rhythm is the arcade music shooter in VR. Use your music library to generate your levels and fight waves of enemies.

name: There's a Butcher Around
short_description: There's a Butcher Around, a brutal hide & seek. Bill the butcher has escaped from the asylum and is looking for new victims. During the game you will have to find a place to hide, remembering that your friends are also trying to hide from the butcher. Every round, Bill the butcher chooses a spot to investigate, are you well hidden?

name: Visibility
short_description: Visibility is a platformer that is completely dark until you place your lights. Each level has a limited set of lights which you must strategically place around the level in order to illuminate your path to the exit.

name: Heroic Mercenaries
short_description: Heroic Mercenaries is an action game taking place in a beautiful fantasy world. The legendary dragon Naoce just destroyed your town, will you be able to take your revenge? Choose your character and form your mercenary band by recruiting allies such as knights, swordsmen, assassins and even cute dogs!

name: The Last Act
short_description: Sarah’s an aspiring actress and finally got her big break! Productions come with their challenges and romances, but Sarah never thought her big break would bring a ghost! Will this supernatural hiccup ruin everything Sarah's worked for? Help her solve the mysteries, and she may also find love!

name: The Unlikely Legend of Rusty Pup
short_description: From the original creator of Conker's Bad Fur Day comes a delicately told tale of a dog that thinks it's a toy, or is it a toy that thinks it's a dog?

name: BOLSOMITO
short_description: Defeat the communistic evils in this politically incorrect game and be the hero that will free the nation from misery. Be prepared to face many kinds of enemies that intend to establish a criminal ideological dictatorship in the country. A lot of brawl and good laughs.

name: Love Thyself - A Horatio Story
short_description: In a society where everyone is a clone of the Emperor, can you survive long enough to find out who you truly are? Try out the brand new visual novel set in the Endless Universe!

name: Do You See the Waving Cape
short_description: A point&click visual novel indie game with a very special narrative style. This game is inspired by the author's childhood and tells a story about Love, Growth, Dreams, and Reality. it perfectly integrates different types of gameplay into sentimental and interesting stories.

name: Darkout
short_description: Crashed and alone on a world mankind tried to leave behind, Darkout challenges players to survive on Illuna, in harsh, procedurally generated biomes, utilizing the game’s sandbox features to build shelters, craft weapons, and research new technologies.You are not alone.

name: Cat Simulator : Animals on Farm
short_description: Sneak up on your enemies, help Farmer, Goat and Piggy, and start a family!

name: Typical
short_description: A single declaration of love changes everything! Will Amaterasu be able to maintain her friendships, or lose them forever? Will cherished memories sour, or will she find the strength and resolve to overcome her troubles?

name: Cave Quest
short_description: Play a thrilling Match3 game! Match gems of the same kind to destroy them and to get bonuses and power-ups.

name: Astrotour VR
short_description: Astrotour VR is an exploration, adventure game for Virtual Reality (HTC Vive, Oculus Touch & Quest). Experience full process to space, from astronaut registration to spaceship ride. Explore known but also unknown planets and receive as much information as possible!

name: The Pathless
short_description: From the creators of ABZÛ, The Pathless is the mythic adventure of an archer and an eagle in a vast forest. Become the Hunter, a master of archery who travels to a mystical island to dispel a curse of darkness that grips the world.

name: Owl's Midnight Journey
short_description: Magic journey through the night forest looking for adventure!

name: It's A Wipe!
short_description: A game of fantasy guild management! In It's A Wipe! you assume the role of a guild leader within a fantasy game world. You must recruit other players, lead them to victory against increasingly difficult odds, and make sure that your group remains happy enough to stick with you!

name: Luxury Hotel Emporium
short_description: Who does not dream of luxury and wealth? In “Luxury Hotel Emporium” this dream is within one’s reach. Start as a small hotelier with a bed and breakfast and rise to an international economy magnate with deluxe hotels all across Europe.

name: Kabitis 2: Fire Sword
short_description: Two games of Kabitis in one package.

name: Chromatic Fantasy
short_description: Charming and challenging puzzle game, in which fantasy creatures are trying to escape the dungeon imprisonment. Interactions between characters and obstacles are determined by their color.

name: Empires Apart
short_description: An exciting free-to-play Real Time Strategy game set in medieval times. Uniquely designed factions, customization options, singleplayer and multiplayer gameplay. Gather resources, raise an army and lead your civilization to victory in a classic RTS, brought to the modern age.

name: Small phrases Great stories
short_description: Learning a language may be a challenge, happily here you practice playing, as fast you evolve faster you unlock new skills in-game and in life.

name: BrainyJoy
short_description: in a fantasy universe, the player have to kill all the static demons and avoid or kill sorcerers in a network to take goodies in order to kill the static demons.

name: Boring in paradise
short_description: Two arcade games in one: 'Antipain' & 'Antitrolley'. The first is a pseudo-three-dimensional runner. The second is 'anti-G.T.A.', which deals with the 'trolley problem'.

name: POP: Methodology Experiment One
short_description: POP: Methodology Experiment One is an experimental game by Rob Lach which was designed music first, with the gameplay and aesthetic derived from the creative flow of the music production process. What emerged is an emotional psychedelic roller-coaster of interactive vignettes.

name: A Sirius Game
short_description: A Sirius Game is 3D, action-adventure game with RPG elements. It requires the player’s ship to escort other merchant ships to different ports unharmed by the pirates and also trade different items for money.

name: Zen! Slider
short_description: A minimalistic puzzle game where you will have to use all of your brain capacity to pass the levels.

name: Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe
short_description: Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe takes the classic game of Tic-Tac-Toe and adds a strategic layer to it. Game modes: classic, classic forget, ultimate, ultimate forget, ultimate forget total.

name: Mainframe Defenders
short_description: MAINFRAME DEFENDERS - Turn-based tactics centered around gear and unit customization. It offers simple combat, high replayability, and tons of loot. Items don't just provide stats boost, but also offer distinct mechanics that can be combined into powerful builds.

name: Bomb Bots Arena
short_description: Send your Bomb Bots into online arenas or blast your friends off the couch locally in Bomb Bots Arena! Bomb Bots Arena is a pure multiplayer experience with every element of the game tailored to please competitive and casual gamers alike.

name: Drag Star!
short_description: Get ready, honey! You're a contestant on Drag Star!, the reality TV drag competition. You better throw shade, serve looks, and slay each episode to become the next drag icon!

name: EvilMorph
short_description: Evilmorph – this is a platform game the main feature of which is a transformation into your enemies after killing them. After slaying the foes you obtain their abilities which gives you one kind of power instead of another. Will you be able to overcome all the obstacles of the grim labyrinth? Will you face against the numerous enemies?

name: Puzzle Mania
short_description: The almost real puzzle experience

name: Venture Arctic
short_description: The second entry in the Pocketwatch Games back-catalog, Venture Arctic is an “Interactive Nature Documentary”. Caribou and Wolves roam the tundra while Polar Bears and Orcas patrol the icy seas. The player must harness the forces of sun, snow, and wind to create balance in these fragile ecosystems.

name: The Park
short_description: Set in a creepy amusement park hiding a dark and sinister secret, The Park is a first-person psychological horror experience focused on exploration and storytelling.

name: Rust
short_description: The only aim in Rust is to survive. Everything wants you to die - the island’s wildlife and other inhabitants, the environment, other survivors. Do whatever it takes to last another night.

name: 遊んで将棋が強くなる！ 銀星将棋DX2
short_description: Shogi software with functions that even beginners can enjoy. Have fun learning and become stronger!

name: Geometry Defense: Infinite
short_description: Geometry Defense: Infinite is a classic infinite tower defense game where you must build a maze to slow enemies and build towers to destroy them. An action-packed and engaging game requiring focus to take on challenges and test your skill.

name: Punchout: Music
short_description: Punchout: Music is a virtual reality rhythmic boxercise game.

name: Wrongworld
short_description: Crash-landed on a surreal, low-poly world filled with freakish inhabitants, choose between permadeath and non-permadeath modes and embark on an epic (and ridiculous) survival adventure. Will you manage to stay alive as you unravel the mysteries of Wrongworld and search for a way home?

name: Silence of the Sleep
short_description: You play as a man called Jacob Reeves. A man who has lost his reason to live. He throws himself into a blackness to end his misery, but instead of it being the end he wakes up without a memory of his life before.

name: BitBattle
short_description: BitBattle is a 2D multiplayer action shooter. Zero Aim, 100% Bullet Hell! Collect Weapons and Items and fight against friends or other players. You also can race in our FunRun Mode. But be carefull, its not easy!

name: Scrapshoot
short_description: Grab some friends and duke it out in chaotic party mayhem for up to four players! Send enough bots hurtling into your opponent's nexus to win, but watch out for unpredictable weather hazards! Snap up precious upgrades to gain control of the arena, crush your enemies, and seize victory!

name: Air Combat XF
short_description: This is a 3D flight action arcade game(Version 2.00). Version 1.00 is also included, please try it.

name: Super Marxist Twins
short_description: A Parody Propaganda Platformer! Fight for The People through the challenging campaign and contribute to the Common Good by making your own levels and sharing them with your Comrades.

name: Something for Someone Else
short_description: Something for Someone Else is a short atypical experience, a brief journey into the mind of a distressed game developer that feels haunted by a game he made. All in the form of a poorly hand drawn narrative platformer accompanied by the beautiful musics of Celluloid Jam.

name: The Chronicle
short_description: When a mysterious package appears in his living room, Detective Walter Miles is suddenly transported to a World War II Era newspaper building. Can you solve the mystery and escape?

name: Pixel Puzzles 2: Space
short_description: Pixel Puzzles 2: Space is a traditional style jigsaw puzzle game in a universal style, each piece uniquely shaped like no physical puzzle could be.

name: Stop the Bus!
short_description: Bus simulation record breaking 3D game.

name: Korpus: Buried over the Black Soil
short_description: Korpus: Buried over the Black Soil is a first-person horror game in which you have been sent to evaluate an abandoned house, set somewhere in Eastern Europe. Uncover the houses past and the secrets buried within.

name: Eron
short_description: Eron is a 2D platform game that allows the player to actively switch between two parallel realms. The player will have to depend upon this power to finish each level.

name: Dashy Square VR
short_description: Dashy Square VR is a rhythm-based arcade platformer with over 40 soundtracks from 22 different awesome song artists.

name: Void Wisp
short_description: The rules of Void Wisp are simple: Gain points by getting close without crashing. Lose points by playing it safe. Distance isn’t important. Simple controls and custom game options means anyone can pick up and play this high score focused ambient runner.

name: Raid on the Ruhr
short_description: For PC and VR. Time to blow up some Dams! Fly and shoot your way through the rivers of the Ruhr Valley while reliving this incredible feat of daring, brilliance and skill.

name: ConcPerfect 2017
short_description: ConcPerfect 2017 is a skill-based 3D platformer, with some puzzle elements. Overcome a variety of obstacles with the use of a propulsion-inducing blast (conc grenade) and careful maneuvering.

name: OSK - The End of Time
short_description: OSK is a stylishly brutal platformer in which you climb an enormous tree, up towards the sky as a squirrel escaping the chaotic apocalypse down below.

name: Urban Trial Freestyle
short_description: The city is your playground! Nothing will stop you on your freestyle trials bike. Use the urban landscape to pull spectacular tricks - backflips, 360s, wallrides, ollies, and more. Customize your bike to boost your performance in Time Attack or Stunt mode. Choose between speed and style, developing your own unique riding style.

name: Cricket Captain 2018
short_description: Cricket Captain returns for 2018 with an updated match engine, extensive additions to the records and statistics (including stats of every historical international player), Ireland & Afghanistan as playable test nations, improved internet game, improved coaching, and much more.

name: Doll Explorer Prologue
short_description: 'Doll Explorer Prologue' you can play a free thinking puzzle game where you choose commands such as 'move forward' or 'attack' to traverse a dungeon!　In search of dungeon treasures, the adventures of apprentice witch Tia and her magical life form Doll begin!

name: Disturbed R.I.P.
short_description: 2.5D Platformer Action-Adventure game. An illusory adventure in the form of a linear uroboric path. Or a short narrative story with platforming elements.

name: planetarian ~the reverie of a little planet~
short_description: In time for the 10th anniversary since its original release in Japan, planetarian is an engaging and emotional visual novel from legendary game studio, Key. A sub-brand of VisualArts, Key are also famed for creating Kanon, AIR, CLANNAD, Little Busters!, Rewrite, and Angel Beats!

name: PRO EVOLUTION SOCCER 2019
short_description: Feel The Power Of Football with PES 2019 offering new licenses, photo-realism and new myClub!

name: Copoka
short_description: Copoka is an open-world exploratory indie game where you play as a bird flying around a city looking for twigs to build your nest.

name: Forklift Load
short_description: Why did the humans disappear? How was the AI created? Who created the AI and what is the purpose of the AI? An open-world sci-fi forklift adventure in which you must uncover the truth behind the mystery.

name: Sniper Rust VR
short_description: A Virtual Reality campaign pitting you, the Agency’s best sharpshooter, against a global insurgency.

name: YUME 2 : Sleepless Night
short_description: In times of war people are on edge and it is more difficult to trust people. People will consider how to survive in the corner of the chaotic world, and so does Monghan. Players can experience the difficulties of wartime life from various angles.

name: 守卫魔兽-Guardian of Warcraft
short_description: This is a summoning tower defense strategy game, with different abilities of monsters and traps, with different effects. the player will continue to upgrade while defending, Become stronger, and summoning more powerful monsters to resist the brave.

name: Chicken Chase
short_description: Chase Chickens in VR! They will run away from you and keep hatching more chicks until you free them. But, don't let the coop get too crowded!

name: Maximum Archery The Game
short_description: Maximum Archery The Game is an Ultra-Realistic first person Bow Hunting simulation. Players must master hunting equipment and the elements just like you would in a real life buck hunt. The game is targeted for users who love to experience a challenging bow hunt for monster white tail deer.

name: SwingStar VR
short_description: Swing around a virtual reality world using a giant sticky hand attached to your head. SwingStar VR is a third-person swinging physics puzzler that puts players through a wild ride, accelerating the player as they swing. It's wacky and super fun.

name: 0Gravity
short_description: 0Gravity is a game whose action takes place in zero gravity (predictably). Confuse your opponents and anticipate their actions to win in pixel 2D levels. There can be only one space marine!

name: Hexon
short_description: Just a nice puzzle, which you can spend a couple of hours.

name: Alien Cat 3
short_description: Having found his home on one of the distant planets, the space cat decides to settle down on it. But the local creatures did not appreciate this choice and decide to drive away the furry alien. Our task is very simple, to protect yourself and your shelter from the attacks of unfriendly monsters.

name: Sakura Magical Girls
short_description: Date three magical girls who make a spectacular entry into a beach resort, protecting love itself from the forces of evil in the newest Sakura game from Winged Cloud!

name: Zom Tom
short_description: Zom Tom is a 2.5D shoot' em up dungeon-crawler where you slay zombie bodies, survive the hell-spawn onslaught, and full send copious amounts of lead downrange.

name: A Light in the Dark
short_description: ──We cannot choose in this unfair world.The rich boy stuck in his never changing daily life...The fierce girl struggling for survival...Two people in totally opposite positions in life.In the face of confusion and the choices before them, what will they find...?

name: Game Character Hub
short_description: Game Character Hub is an art program that is focused on game asset creation, especially RPG Maker's. It provides a built-in generator for character and tileset creation.

name: Deathbloom: Chapter 1
short_description: Inspired by classic survival horror. Bachman Manor sprawls into a maze of corridors, bedrooms, foyers, and more. Filled with puzzles, traps, and hidden passageways that explore the secrets of its dark history and occupants.

name: GRAV
short_description: GRAV is a sand box experience where you explore a multitude of planets, hunt strange alien creatures, build and defend outposts, craft weapons and armor, and attempt to survive against other players in a hostile environment.

name: 36 apples
short_description: Collect apples and uncover the secrets of a self-contained world.

name: Spacebase Startopia
short_description: Spacebase Startopia captivates with its original mixture of economic simulation and empire building strategy paired with classic RTS skirmishes and a good dose of humor.

name: Gravulse
short_description: Welcome to Gravulse, an innovative space curvature laboratory that is trying to 'flip' the laws of physics, literally. Here you have to go through many test levels using various new technologies!

name: Gigapocalypse
short_description: Become a customizable giant monster with manifold skills in Gigapocalypse, inspired by classical Kaijū movies such as “Godzilla” and “King Kong” and the game classic “Rampage”.

name: Guns of Midnight
short_description: This brutally difficult arcade shooter pits you against the clock, armed with only your wits and a big f---ing gun. Race to escape the city before the stroke of midnight, compete with your steam friends and with players around the globe to secure your place on the leaderboards!

name: The Big SokoBang
short_description: Explosion of new game features and elements enhancing the classic.SokoBang ('The Big SokoBang') is a brain trainer game for people who enjoy intellectual challenges.Each level is an exciting puzzle.

name: Cute Blocks
short_description: Cute Blocks.This is a simple arkanoid game. Shoot down blocks with a constantly moving ball and do not let it fly down.

name: Sparkle 3 Genesis
short_description: Step into the amazing world of Sparkle – a surreal ocean, where life is thriving and conditions are perfect to make an evolutionary leap.

name: The Cat Games
short_description: Do you like cats? Then this is the purrfect game for you!

name: Gunman Clive 2
short_description: Gunman Clive returns in an all new adventure. Now in Color!

name: Envy the Dead
short_description: Envy the Dead is zombie survival roguelike, in which you are leading group of unique, randomly generated characters through destroyed lands, infested with zombies.

name: Mircron Wars XR
short_description: Is an easy to play arcade space shooter, with an endless area to play in and countless Enemies to destroy. There are 18 ships to unlock and play as. Many different enemies to blast away at. Boss ships. HD graphics. Awesome Music. Lots of Weapons to blast away at the enemy ships with.

name: Cut 2017
short_description: Casual games with a little bit of horror.

name: Y.E.T.I
short_description: Y.E.T.I is a third-person shooting game that focuses on classic shooting and precision mechanics. Fight against anything that threatens humanity. Or rather, whatever the government says that threatens humanity. You play as an investigation agent, involved in special missions.

name: Nelo
short_description: Nelo is the lightning fast, out of this world, genre-blending, bullet-hell, character-action epic meticulously crafted by the loving couple at Magic & Mirrors.

name: Hate Wave
short_description: A turn-based action and strategy game. Hate wave is not for everyone, it is as difficult as getting a second chance to live. Hate Wave is a mix of the gameplay and difficulty of Dark Souls and the wave mode of Call of Duty.

name: Mister Shizz: Don't Let The Shizz Hit The Fan!
short_description: Race your way to freedom on the Toiletdega T.P. track to make your escape from the Toxic Fan Monster Gourmand; he eats people like Mister Shizz for breakfast and blows bathrooms up for lunch! How long can you last in this endless runner game before Mister Shizz hits the Fan?

name: 依澪 Zero Plan
short_description: 《依澪》是一款恐怖解谜像素游戏。在游戏中玩家将操控谜之少女”澪“或神秘男人”玖“ ，在这个怪物横行的意识世界里找到世界崩坏的真相并生存下去。

name: Board Defenders
short_description: Board Defenders is super-structuring the rules of the world’s most played game of all times - chess. A modern vision thrilling and fun fast action game, combining the pace of an arcade with the challenge of a logic puzzle - brain game, based on chess rules.

name: Bigger Guns
short_description: Everything is a weapon ! Cross-platform IO and DeathMatch Battles

name: Orion Sandbox Enhanced
short_description: This is a 2D crafting survival sandbox game. You will be able to explore a huge 2D side-view world, building houses, crafting tools, weapons and armour from the resources you collect. There is a day/night cycle and each night many dangerous monsters can be found and defeated.

name: GRAL
short_description: GRAL is a futuristic racing game with combat elements, a tribute to the 90s games such as Megarace, POD, DethKarz. Rides fast racing cars that spin 600Mph on articulated tracks with shortcuts, jumps, parabolic and death rides!

name: 玄龙山
short_description: Orange ,the Police chief ,was ordered to investigate the riots caused by the white snake. Finally came to the Bailongzhuang, intending to find out. Unexpectedly, this is just the beginning of a disaster. A conspiracy to subvert the country has already begun blatantly.

name: Survival Games
short_description: Survival Games is a Multiplayer survival voxel shooter in an ever-changing world full of secrets, traps, wildlife and treasure. Play in 64 player games ONLINE in three different game modes. Zombies, Battle Royale and Arena now Available.Never play the same game twice with a unique world that changes every time you play!

name: Yakuza Kiwami
short_description: SEGA’s critically-acclaimed entry that started a legend. Become Kazuma Kiryu, an up-and-coming yakuza who takes the fall for the murder of a crime boss, only to emerge from prison ten years later to a changed world. Remastered from the ground up, now in 4K and uncapped framerates on PC.

name: DJ Streamer
short_description: The DJ Streamer plays your audio files out to other programs with a virtual microphone.You can now quickly create a play list from existing files on your computer to broadcast to others. Many popular file formats are supported, such as wave, ogg, windows media and MP3.

name: EPΘCH
short_description: With an inspired blend of Zelda + Souls + Metroidvania style gameplay, EPΘCH delivers a nostalgic single or online co-op action RPG experience.

name: MUMMMASTER!
short_description: Protect the tomb of the pharaoh from plunderers! Craft mummies, gut corpses, collect resources, create stronger monsters every time. And most importantly, do not let the cat steal!

name: Lu Bu Maker
short_description: I have reincarnated in the gender-bent world of Dong-tak. If I wish to survive, I've got four years to raise Lü Bu the right way.

name: Frog Fractions: Game of the Decade Edition
short_description: The classic web game, reborn! Enjoy this remaster in glorious 4k resolution! Follow this frog on its arcade action adventure through swarm of bugs and beyond! Purchase the hat DLC for the ultimate experience, if you want to eat bugs while wearing a hat!

name: ! Wild Russia !
short_description: «Wild Russia» is an open-world horror adventure game. Its action takes place in a striking provincial Russia, and any of your actions or inaction can lead to serious consequences.

name: 黑暗料理?!
short_description: 这是一款你从未玩过的餐厅模拟游戏！高度自由的做菜玩法，创造和探索菜谱，昼夜系统结合了农场牧场的经营养成，顾客口味偏好多种多样，还有更多奇葩内容等你探索

name: Kamikaze Veggies
short_description: A stealth adventure game with an absurd-driven story and third-person perspective for a single-player or co-op. Complete secret war missions, solve the showy puzzles, and save the veggies world!

name: Rising Noracam
short_description: Climb the ruins to get the legendary treasure that is at the top. The control is very simple, but one mistake will cause you to fall and keep falling. Game of that type

name: All Over
short_description: An indie Action RPG/adventure/puzzle Complete story-based quests, solve puzzles, use your sword and spells to fight and gain loot from monsters. Gather resources to build and craft potions and items. Fight legendary bosses.

name: 末日航路-The Termination
short_description: It's a story of deception and redemption. You receive a mysterious invitation to a seven days doomsday journey. An expectant interstellar journey has become a doomsday route to the end. There is only one word difference between 'victim' and 'perpetrator'.

name: Scramble
short_description: Scramble is a resource management game in which you compete against other companies for the colonization of the New World.

name: Drug Dealer Simulator
short_description: Have you ever thought about expanding your own crime empire, without the legal and moral consequences? SIMULATE IT! Now you will finally be able to crawl into the dark alleys of the drug dealing business! Become a street business mastermind, or a ruthless gangster - it's up to you!

name: Galaxity : Beta VR
short_description: Galaxity is a wonderful virtual world. In this game, you can create an avatar and customize it with a variety of costumes. You can also talk to people and become friends with them. Join Galaxity, and enjoy various mini-games and fun videos together!

name: Angry Bunny
short_description: Be a hero bunny and try to find way to back home. Avoid enemies and traps and explode big carrot which is obstacle between rabbit hole and bunny.

name: Apollo4x
short_description: Apollo4x is a casual-to-difficult space trading tycoon game, where success is measured in earnings from how efficient your trade routes are in transporting supplies to demands on your planets. Combat is card based, and uses a unique system never before seen.

name: 1HEART
short_description: Soviet City is a city management game in a totalitarian economy. In Soviet City life is not the purpose, it is a resource - just like coal and food. The totalitarian machine needs to keep running and that is all it matters. This economy needs a leader that can master the art of terror.

name: Custodian: Beginning of the End
short_description: Custodian: Beginning of the End is a brutal and difficult platformer designed for caution and reaction. Explore, seek secrets and collect mechanisms to become even stronger and meet the impending End!

name: FinalFire
short_description: 'FinalFire' (FF) is a modern war as the background of China's modern armored warfare competitive game, the game is China encyclopedia, tank contains from 59 to 99 a type of all tanks in China. Global modern armored melee, dynamic battlefield.

name: TOGETHER VR
short_description: Come! Indulge yourselves in your own private den and create sweet and loving memories with her!

name: Tomorrow for Mar
short_description: Pass your final, graduate university and... finally confess?! Tomorrow for Mar is a 2.5D VN about crushes, tricky finals and starting a new chapter of your life.

name: HELLGATE: London
short_description: The return of a sensational game! Hellgate is an action RPG game you have been waiting for. Since its first release Hellgate won the hearts of thousands of fans and now it's time to bring back memories and dip into the near future of 2038. For all mankind!

name: Wandering Through The Vines
short_description: You find yourself in a strange land, by shooting and melee defeat your foes and journey to the end...

name: The Handbook
short_description: Embark in a chaotic quest in a fantasy world to save a small town from certain destruction. Play as the great wizard Tim in an RPG while learning powerful spells and leveling your character. Explore the world, find its secrets and unravel the story behind The Handbook.

name: Pass to Hell
short_description: Pass to Hell is a game where your choices lead to consequences. You will become Death and you will decide who is worthy to go to Heaven and who is to Hell.

name: MinerXP
short_description: Pick up your pickaxe!!!Make your inference, use the best strategy and highest speed, DIG THEM ALL!!!

name: SAMURAI CHALLENGE
short_description: SAMURAI CHALLENGE is a VR Action Game which tests your sword skills in virtual worlds resembling battlefields on which samurai fought.

name: One Late Night: Deadline
short_description: One Late Night: Deadline continues the story of One Late Night, a horror/mystery game where you play the role of an office worker caught in the middle of the paranormal activity that has broken out in a seemingly ordinary office building. Freely explore the 5 story office complex that houses several different companies.

name: PULSOR
short_description: PULSOR is a fast paced shoot em' up space arcade game where you orbit a black hole. Use your quick reactions and aim to blast the obstacles in your way !

name: War of Gaia : Into the Fire
short_description: War of Gaia: Into the Fire is a Sci-Fi Survival game where you gather resources, build bases, create and join factions, go to war over scarce resources, find and salvage tech, customize your armor and weapons, and discover the hidden mysteries of the uncharted planet you are stranded on.

name: HENTAI CLIMBER
short_description: HENTAI CLIMBER - third-person game where an anime girl must climb a mountain.

name: GO-4-Soldier-1
short_description: GO-4-Soldier-1 is a turn-based puzzle-adventure set in the African bush. Fight your way through ten beautifully handcrafted levels.

name: Bet On Soldier
short_description: Delve into a world where war has become a media frenzy! Survive your battles and bet on your victories!

name: TT Isle of Man Ride on the Edge 2
short_description: Racing across an over 60 km long ultra-technical track at breakneck speed requiring realistic riding skills... that is the challenge that awaits in TT2! Lots of new features lie ahead: open world, reworked physics, classic motorbikes, and more…

name: Flapping Over It
short_description: You will not pass this game, as the failure will always haunt you.

name: Nightmare Simulator
short_description: 3D Horror FPS Based On Korean Folklores & Free FPS RPG DLC

name: Deputy Dangle
short_description: You are Deputy Dangle and today you're getting deputized. Everything is going great until the elusive criminal, known only as GMA, decides to crash the party. Within minutes of becoming a deputy you're now hot on the trail of Dangleton's most infamous criminal.

name: Basketball Pro Management 2014
short_description: Basketball Pro Management 2014 is the perfect mix between management and simulation. Become the coach of your favorite team and bring it to the top by managing a multitude of parameters each day: (rosters, trainings, finances, staff management, tactics, search for new talent and so on).

name: Inner Chains
short_description: An FPS horror game set in a surreal, dark and deadly biomechanical world never seen before. Humankind is just a small part of a hostile universe. Want to survive? Discover its secrets.

name: Malatzshia
short_description: Malatzshia is a non-classical RPG that contains some very tricky riddles. The play time can vary between 4 and 10 hours. You start the game being told you are trapped in your own dream. In order to wake up you will have to find a code that is hidden deeply within the vast dreamland.

name: Tachyon Project
short_description: Tachyon Project is a dual stick shooter heavily inspired by classic shoot'em ups. We’ve combined many unique enemy types, a large variety of weapons and power-ups with innovative gameplay to ensure a long lasting challenge and discovery at every new level.

name: Oath
short_description: Take the Oath, overcome the Trials, and discover the truth of the Heart in this original indie RPG.

name: Try To Survive
short_description: Today is a special day. The government decided to make an extraordinary and unpredictable experiment. Its objective is to learn how people are going to behave and what they will do if given full freedom and thus allowed to do just whatever they want for a period of 24 hours.

name: 3D PUZZLE - Old House
short_description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful house

name: Heartbeat: Regret
short_description: This short & challenging horror adventure will drive you nuts! Type your way out of this cursed mansion and avoid the regret monster by hiding, running and setting traps. But don’t lose the rhythm of your heartbeat or make typos, they may cause you a heart attack… Fully playable without visuals.

name: Dyno Adventure
short_description: Experience an exhilarating new sense of fun while running, jumping and stomping on enemies as you take control of Dyno, a cute dragon who has lost their family. Dyno Adventure bring you everything fans love about 3D platforming. Help Dyno to look for their children!

name: Skeleton Troubles
short_description: Skeleton troubles - This platformer will put on your shoulders an unusual task - resurrect your skeleton hero, collecting bones and hearts in the dungeon so that he regains his strength and teach all his enemies a lesson. Jump over the spikes, dodge the cunning slugs that will shoot at you and run to victory!

name: Where Angels Cry
short_description: Investigate a mysterious, medieval monastery and reveal the terrifying truth in this puzzle adventure game of clue-search and investigation!

name: PandaSG
short_description: A little cute panda, holding a gun to defend its little hometown...

name: Aurora
short_description: Will you be able to figure out what is happening on the fictional earth-link planet of Wenryll and stop the sinister group that is behind it all? Battle your way to the truth and stop Wenryll from falling into chaos!

name: aMAZE 3D
short_description: This is a continuation of the fascinating game aMAZE. Now in 3D!

name: VR Walking Simulator
short_description: It is a VR Walking Simulator. Nothing more, nothing less. Explore beautiful scenes optimized for VR viewing, take pictures of the scenery, make a collage, and relax.

name: Go home, go home?
short_description: 原本閒暇無趣的生活，因一隻白兔全變了調。要趕快找到回家的路，還是留在這瘋狂的世界呢？這是一款以《愛麗絲夢遊仙境》奇幻文學發想的解謎 RPG 小品，採用多結局劇情與獨特的美術風格，並塞入了許多愛刷存在感的蜥蜴比爾。

name: TwinCop
short_description: TwinCop is the most cooperative game, EVER. Play this action-packed, co-op, twin-stick shooter with your best bud or significant other. You and your friend are TwinCop: One player controls the right arm; the other controls the left arm; both of you control movement.

name: KiKiMiMi / 听能力搜查官
short_description: 新米国际搜查官“雏田·斯宾塞”被派遣到日本樱木町警察署，她需要使用自己的某种超能力来调查14年前一桩悬而未决的案件！

name: Maestro: Notes of Life Collector's Edition
short_description: A missing girl has been lured away by evil music! Stop the young prodigy and save everyone from the evil Maestro!

name: Mad Experiments: Escape Room
short_description: Award-nominated escape game. Alone or with up to 5 players, explore 3 unique rooms, solve mind-bending puzzles, and unravel the dark secrets of the Professor Cheshire and his experiments.

name: Pluviophile
short_description: Pluviophile is a very short experience about the mood of rain in the woods.

name: Impossamole
short_description: Monty lay back on his sun lounger and contemplated his situation. His previous adventures had financed these last few years of utter bliss. He had everything that a mole could want. His own island in the sun, more money than a mole could ever spend - paradise!

name: Gamer To Game Developer Series 1: More Than a Gamer
short_description: Welcome to the new GTGD S1, a Unity 2017 multiplayer tutorial for game developers. This training course is of intermediate difficulty so you should first be familiar with the basics of coding in Unity. This tutorial will teach you the key elements of the Unity 2017 multiplayer system (sometimes called UNET).

name: 零怨 The curse of the dead
short_description: '零怨 The curse of the dead' is an independent game with the theme of horror and adventure. The player will play the role of 'Jiang Ling' who is looking for the whereabouts of his wife. You can only find the whereabouts of his wife in the old building.You need to solve the mystery yourself.

name: Lucky Villager
short_description: Lucky villager - The luckiest villager goes hunting for gold! Take all the treasure from the evil leprechauns before they chop you into juicy bacon in this hardcore platformer!

name: THE NED BALLS
short_description: THE NED BALLS - a Classic - physical timekiller, where the player controlling the ball, must go the distance and get to the checkpoint, for a minimum period of time.

name: Hand Cannon Virtuoso
short_description: Hand Cannon Virtuoso is a VR roguelite bullet hell where you build your arsenal by collecting cards. Fight your way to the top of a shape-shifting tower filled with powerful foes!

name: AdVenture Capitalist
short_description: Welcome, eager young investor, to AdVenture Capitalist! Arguably the world's greatest Capitalism simulator!

name: Nyan Cat: Lost In Space
short_description: Play with the most celebrated flying cat in human history. Drink milk, eat ice-cream, collect coins, buy gorgeous boosts, fly like a superhero (sorry... supercat), jump onto platforms made of cake, avoid angry dogs, and discover the infinite space.

name: Right Way
short_description: Take the right path!

name: Griefhelm
short_description: Griefhelm is an award-winning party game with lethal medieval weaponry. Skewer your friends, deflect their blows, and push your advantage in local and online multiplayer. Find some friends and cut off their heads!

name: Legends of Aria
short_description: Discover a world forged by players, where your choices write the story. From seasoned Mage to ambitious Warrior, from adventurous Treasure Hunter to humble Merchant, choose your path and experience Legends of Aria on your own terms.

name: Holomento
short_description: Holomento is an Indie Permadeath Action-RPG focusing on the dangerous quest of passing through the mysterious Eventide Hollow – and rebuilding it step by step.

name: Drone: Remote Tactical Warfare
short_description: Set in a dark vision of a high-tech future, Drone: Remote Tactical Warfare is a unique gameplay experience combining stealth, strategy and visceral action.

name: Dungeon Escape VR
short_description: Dungeon Escape VR is an immersive escape-room puzzle game. To escape you need to solve the challenges and puzzles found in the dungeon.

name: Empires Of Creation
short_description: Take on the role of fleet commander and lead your empire to victory. Conquer enemies in high octane battles to upgrade your ships and gain credits for use on the galactic market. Exploit your relations with friends and foes to establish a monopoly over your corner of the universe.

name: Valhall 2000
short_description: Challenge your friends and enemies to endless battles in Valhall 2000! Fight head to head in a multiplayer 2D platform style shooter. Pick up an AK47 or a Rocket Launcher and blast them all! Other game modes include coop adventure puzzle, zombie, and time attack race. Play on PC, Mac, Linux, iPhone, Android

name: 末日血战
short_description: 《末日血战》是一款免费的放置策略游戏，在这里，指挥官，您将率领您的英雄小队，在危机四伏的末世之中，搜索物资，探索秘境，抗击外敌，打造专属于您的英雄基地。

name: Twisted: Enhanced Edition
short_description: Twisted:EE is an action-platformer game combined with the best gameplay elements like time and object manipulation, clever enemies, traps and other challenges.

name: RollerCoaster Tycoon®: Deluxe
short_description: RollerCoaster Tycoon Deluxe takes you for a ride in the original RollerCoaster Tycoon and its expansion packs, Corkscrew Follies and Loopy Landscapes. Create the ultimate theme park using a variety of coaster types with giant loops and barrel rolls and in-park attractions like suspended monorails and water-soaked plume rides.

name: Brain Bait
short_description: Arcade, Puzzles, Speedrunning: Old school one-screen puzzle action game. Lure all Zombies into the traps to advance to the next level. Includes Steam Leaderboards and Personal Challenges.

name: Coffin Mall
short_description: An atmospheric retro survival horror game. Your first night on the job as a mall cop gets rudely interrupted, and you must survive somehow.

name: The Legend Of Vraz
short_description: The Legend of Vraz features a fun filled exciting gameplay of 6-9 hours amidst fantasy worlds created with stunning hand painted 2D art and inhabited by mesmerizing characters. The highlight of the game is its exquisite hand painted 2D graphics in traditional I

name: The Chronicles of Joseph of Egypt
short_description: Enjoy this challenging match-3 game and relive the classic story of faith, family, and forgiveness in 'The Chronicles of Joseph of Egypt'! Help Joseph and find matching tokens to build rows of three or more of the same kind. Earn stars and build up a town and get upgrades and power-ups.

name: The Culling Of The Cows
short_description: The Culling Of The Cows is a side-scrolling shooter / tower defence game. You will take the role of Sammy, a soliloquizing schizophrenic farmer with a self prophesied mission to lay waste to the disease spreading over his farm.

name: Shrug Island - The Meeting
short_description: Shrug Island is a warmly wistful adventure, an open door into a playful celebration of music, mystery and nature’s dances.

name: Hidden Shapes Lovely Cats - Jigsaw Puzzle Game
short_description: If you love cats, you are in the right place! Relax and have fun with beautiful puzzles of cute kittens having fun, hand-drawn, created exclusively for you to rescue your tranquility and be amazed by a beautiful art for each puzzle solved!

name: Final Fleet
short_description: A lone interstellar fleet must travel across a distant and perilous galaxy in the hope of reaching safety. Final Fleet is a Virtual Reality fleet building, space shooter.

name: Drying Paint Simulator VR
short_description: After a long and cold journey, 'the artist' has finally arrived at his deserted cabin in the woods. The perfect peaceful place to create his final masterpiece. The artist's Magmum Opis. Drying Paint Simulator VR is the narrated exhilarating story of an artist (you) creating their last painting. A masterpiece.

name: Dreamland Solitaire: Dark Prophecy
short_description: Enter a world of magic in a stunning new solitaire adventure! Guide a kindhearted fairy, a noble knight and a powerful wizard as they pursue the evil witch, Jill, who intends to destroy the knight's realm and enslave its people.

name: 踏马的世界
short_description: 这是一款由个人开发的武侠游戏，全开放世界，众多场景，几十种种武学技能可以随意修炼搭配，多个美女可以抱走，高自由度的玩法，丰富的剧情，即时战斗系统让你玩得更流畅。

name: Kid,napper: Gosh, I'm Kidnapped by a Pupil
short_description: I had to admit, the only thing that is more scary than a murder weapon, is that girl, who is not even supposed to hold it

name: Koni: The Secrets of Castle
short_description: Classic Sokoban game set in Koni's castle from the fantasy world of Chronicles of Sarval. Solve challenging puzzles and discover the secrets of Koni's castle.

name: The Cooking Game VR
short_description: Enjoy the fun and excitement of preparing fast food dishes, competing with rival chef and serving hungry customers! Now you can cook against another player, and compete to see who has higher score on the leaderboard. The game is fully playable in single player and multiplayer PvP mode!

name: Blue-Collar Astronaut
short_description: Arcade space-physics meets your student loans. Blue-Collar Astronaut literally and figuratively explores upwards mobility on your way to the All-American Space-Dream.

name: No Tyrant
short_description: A FPS shooting hero counter dictator game.

name: Marbles: Razor's Wrath
short_description: Marbles: Razor's Wrath is a single-player platformer game based on finding collectable items. You will face enemies and use the core slam mechanic in order to defeat enemies and overcome challenges. Control the old technology left behind in the post-apocalyptic world to break barriers in the way!

name: Christmas Tale - Visual Novel
short_description: Christmas tale - it's a short choice-based visual novel about two days before Christmas.

name: Screaming Loaf
short_description: Play as Loaf and use his scream attack to defeat evil jams and cheeses in this wacky puzzle-platformer. Split into sliced bread to be in several places at once, figure out where best to drop slices to solve puzzles and beat enemies more efficiently. Don't let the fillings make Loaf into sandwiches!

name: Prehistoric Hunt
short_description: Dive into intense dinosaur hunting adventures with your friends. Complete hunting contracts for Preton Corporation. Gather rewards, improve your equipment and become a master hunter. Are you the hunter or the hunted?

name: VR Time Travelling in Medieval Towns and Islands: Magellan's Life in ancient Europe, the Great Exploration Age, and A.D.1500 Time Machine
short_description: Medieval Western European towns emerged in the 11th century. Before the 11th century, during the Merovingian and Carolingian eras, although there were sporadic towns, they did not become a climate.

name: The Afterglow of Grisaia
short_description: A side story to The Labyrinth of Grisaia, this game explores protagonist Kazami Yuuji's past, focusing on his life with Kusakabe Asako, the CIRS agent who rescued him at a young age from a terrorist organization. Secret passages of The Labyrinth of Grisaia are revealed within...

name: Halloween Forever
short_description: Something mysterious is happening in the pumpkin patch this Halloween! You control Pumpkin Man, a humanoid pumpkin thing animated by occult forces on a quest to discover why things are so creepy. And you vomit candy corn.

name: Cubixx HD
short_description: Cubixx HD is a fast paced action puzzle game which sends high scoring, combo chasing gameplay to the third dimension!

name: Poppy Toast
short_description: Poppy Toast is an Action Arcade game about escaping the notorious Razzle HQ and bringing Poppy Toast to the world whilst avoiding Razzle's advanced block defence system. See how far you can get and be hailed a hero!

name: Snow Strike
short_description: Fly your F14-LBC 'Rapier' on a series of air bound missions. Your task – to destroy the labs, bomb refineries, and stop the enemy convoys. But watch out for those enemies who are armed with heat and radar guided missiles!

name: Kapital13
short_description: Kapital 13 is a fun casual strategy game. The game is about you owning your own company. You have to manage all the actions of the workers and yourself. Managing your inventory is also really essential. One of the many features is investing your money and many others.

name: WEJAM
short_description: With WEJAM you can make music with strangers in real-time. It's so easy to use, that anybody can create beautiful grooves within a minute.

name: Fox! Hen! Bag!
short_description: In this short first-person adventure game, you have to bring your friends over to the other mountain by using a tramway car. But beware! Each friend has their own agenda. You have to talk to them to decide which order they should be moved in. Based on a classic riddle.

name: Top Torch
short_description: When the torches touch, the top torch wins. Fly with finesse to defeat your friends.

name: Fuzz Dungeon
short_description: The well back to your job has been absorbed inside a sasquatch sex amulet. Journey through 15 levels of absurdist human history to try and bring it back.

name: Color +
short_description: Your goal is to score more points over a long distance. Good luck

name: Hero's Descent
short_description: Battle against time in this faced-paced retro-inspired Rogue-like

name: Archibald's Adventures
short_description: A paranoid computer issued a lock down on a mad scientist's mansion after his experiments and security robots broke loose, and you are trapped inside! Overcome all the pitfalls of the mansion in this action puzzle game! Test your skills and wit in nearly 200 levels!

name: Mech Troid
short_description: MechTroid is a sci-fi themed shooter, the gameplay consists of shooting your way through the levels getting upgrades as you go and learning the different enemy types like many arcade classics.

name: 10mg: You are such a Soft and Round Kitten.
short_description: 10mg is a collection of 10 minute long games. You are such a Soft and Round Kitten is about a curious kitten. Come, take the form of this kitten.

name: EMERGENCY 4 Deluxe
short_description: Coordinate firefighters, police, medical personnel and specialists in the classic EMERGENCY 4 Deluxe! Now with the previously untranslated bonus missions in English.

name: Sub Rosa
short_description: Sub Rosa is a multiplayer first-person shooter about tense deals, double-crosses, and the occasional high-speed car chase.

name: Death's Gambit: Afterlife
short_description: Death's Gambit: Afterlife is a challenging 2D action platformer with deep RPG elements. As an agent of Death bound to his service, unravel the mystery of Siradon and discover the true price of immortality.

name: Loopback
short_description: Loopback is an arcade-style scrolling shooter game where you will battle through waves of enemies, fight unique bosses, and build new weapons as you complete the loop.

name: Paradigm Shift
short_description: A group of young adults, gifted with elemental powers by the anomaly, are forced to go to battle with these unknown forces. Sooner than later, they come to find out that they're a lot more connected to the unfolding chaos than it seems...

name: Tumbled
short_description: indie puzzle game, where you tumbled your way to the portal, without missing the platforms.

name: Mò The Frog

Dress the part of Mò the frog in the epic adventure to free Avalaar's kingdom from the oppression which the terrible Peter's the troll and his henchmen, the black captains, try to bring by conquering it.

name: Darkness Within 2: The Dark Lineage
