short_description: Phasmophobia is a 4 player online co-op psychological horror. Paranormal activity is on the rise and it’s up to you and your team to use all the ghost hunting equipment at your disposal in order to gather as much evidence as you can.

name: Shigatari
short_description: Shigatari is a samurai role-playing game with historical artwork.

name: Highlands
short_description: Highlands is a hand-drawn turn-based strategy game with unique characters, resource management and RPG elements where the focus is directed toward decision-making.

name: Stealthy ninja
short_description: 'Stealthy ninja' is a side-view platformer with an exciting and fun gameplay. You will have to run through intricate mazes, climb ceilings, climb vertical walls and collect scattered coins on the levels.

name: The Climber
short_description: Dylan and Isis are the couple of characters in this new game. They face challenges of Rafting, Rapel and Tracking in 3 diferent phases. In these modalities they will be exposed to the forces of nature and to complete their paths without risks, they know that they should respect it as the first rule.

name: Fill And Cross Christmas Riddles
short_description: The most magical night of the year. It's coming... RIGHT NOW! 120 new levels in Christmas Griddlers!

name: Nyctophobia
short_description: Your truck is wrecked, your flashlight is dimming and darkness surrounds you. Your fears come alive. Get to the generator and bring back the light before “The Keeper” finds you.

name: Blast Out
short_description: Get ready for the wildest Top-Down Arena Brawler you’ve ever experienced. Navigate deadly arenas and battle it out against your enemies using over-the-top ability combos. Through a unique ability system, players can change and augment any character’s set of abilities to play exactly how they want to play.

name: PogoChamp
short_description: PogoChamp is a hilarious 3D platformer inspired by I Am Bread and Getting Over It, but with a deliberate focus on being 'Fun, not Frustrating'. Where most QWOP-like games involve complex & unintuitive control schemes, PogoChamp's controls are easy to understand (though still tricky to master).

name: SCP-087: Recovered document
short_description: SCP-087: Recovered documents - first-person horror, that tells the story of a classified object.

name: 我来自江湖 From Jianghu
short_description: 《我来自江湖》是一款结合武侠、角色扮演、模拟经营多种元素的独立游戏。在游戏中，你需要扮演一个小势力的掌门，带领弟子在开放的江湖里自由探索，发展自己的势力，经营不同产业，在风云诡谲的江湖里生存下去。

name: Lucky Night: Poker Games
short_description: Exciting Blackjack and Texas Hold'em games in VR.

name: Babel: Choice
short_description: Babel: Choice is a 2D action-adventure Roguelike game which combines with the elements of RPG and shooting games. In the game, the player will play the part of Alexander, the son of the evil duke, aiming to break through the perilous and capricious Tower of Evil.

name: UNDERWATER: STAY ALIVE
short_description: An amazing alien world is revealed in from of your eyes. Your task is to survive and find out the cause of your ship's tragic events. But BEWARE !!!  You are not the only survivor in the ocean’s depth.

name: Zeran's Folly
short_description: You're not a bad guy just because you have murderers as friends and holy knights want to kill you, right? Lone is on a quest with his two big axes and three loyal friends to find the four artifacts he needs in a world he doesn't bother to understand.

name: Kakatte Koi Yo!
short_description: Kakatte Koi Yo! is a cute 2D platform fighter where you play as cats, use fish with special powers to fight, and achieve victory! Challenge your friends in 1v1, 2v2, and free for all combat, or hone your skills in the single player time trials.

name: Science Simulator
short_description: Science Simulator - The Science Educational Video Game

name: Koi-Koi Japan [Hanafuda playing cards]
short_description: 'Hanafuda' is a traditional Japanese card game. Now you can enjoy 'Koi Koi,' its most well-known variation, in a purely Japanese milieu with elegant and refined graphics. Online Multiplayer!!

name: Root Double -Before Crime * After Days- Xtend Edition
short_description: Rescue squad captain Watase Kasasagi wakes up without his memories in the middle of his most critical mission yet-- a nuclear meltdown at a research facility. In an unfamiliar place and without his years of training, he must rescue the survivors and escape...

name: Fujii
short_description: Explore and grow a colorful, whimsical garden in this peaceful, VR adventure. The power to make plants blossom and thrive is literally at your fingertips. Collect critter eggs and seeds to cultivate and bring the garden of your dreams to life.

name: Finding Paradise
short_description: A story-driven adventure spanning a lifetime, following two doctors traversing through a dying man's memories to fulfill his last wish.

name: Cheese Maze
short_description: Cheese Maze is a small and addictive maze runner where you control a little mice and try to get all the cheese. Find your way through many different levels and face enemy's like cats and traps placed to catch you. Collect every cheese and bring it to your home.

name: RHEM II SE: The Cave
short_description: RHEM II SE - The Cave Special Edition is an intricate pure-puzzle first person adventure game. The player explores a hidden city far beneath the earths surface. RHEM II SE features non-linear gameplay non-violent story and mind-bending puzzles.

name: Legend of Towercraft
short_description: 'Legend of Towercraft' is a Free-to-Play Tower Defense/ARPG which has NO Pay-to-Win elements. The world is in ruins and as the Guardian of your community below the mountain, you have the task to rebuild your town and protect it from the growing corruption.

name: NASCAR Heat 5
short_description: NASCAR Heat 5 challenges you to become the 2020 NASCAR Cup Series champion. Features all the official teams, drivers and cars from the three NASCAR National Series as well as the Xtreme Dirt Tour, racing on 39 authentic tracks.

name: Agony
short_description: Agony is a first-person, survival horror set in hell. You will begin your journey as a tormented soul within the depths of hell without any memories about your past. The special ability to control people on your path, and possess demons, gives you the measures to survive.

name: Spermination: Cream of the Crop
short_description: You may have beaten off others and came first a thousand times, but you've never tasted the sweet Cream of the Crop. This sequel is harder, faster and will blow your crusty socks off! Choose from 3 difficult leagues: Hand, Mouth and the coveted Cream Pie! Crack the egg & unlock your bundle of joy!

name: Rocket Armor
short_description: Rocket Armor is the most realistic and exciting flight combat experience in VR today! It features a completely new type of flight control system and maneuvering capability – it’s like really flying using two huge rockets strapped to your arms!

name: Stakeholder Game
short_description: Investment business simulation game. Become the richest billionaire ever! Build your financial empire out of merged companies and increase your capital.

name: BoomCrash
short_description: BoomCrash is a small physics-based game aimed at destroying buildings and other architectural structures using explosives.

name: Viy: Retold Story
short_description: the game in the quest genre is based on the Gogol's story 'Vij'.

name: MotorSim 3
short_description: A straight line car performance simulator that allows you to configure power, weight and other characteristics as you wish, so you can check how any car behaves (acceleration and top speed).

name: D: The Game
short_description: Los Angeles, 1997. There has been a mass murder at a general hospital on the outskirts of downtown. Richter Harris has shut himself up in the hospital and taken hostages, leaving the police helpless and unable to move in.

name: Tesla Effect: A Tex Murphy Adventure
short_description: Tex Murphy is the last of the hard-boiled gumshoe detectives living in dystopian post-World War III San Francisco in the 2050s. Tex is an honest and good-natured private investigator with a penchant for bourbon, cigarettes and getting himself into trouble.

name: Ratty Catty
short_description: Ratty Catty is a Multiplayer / CO-OP hide & seek game about the adventures of a domestic cat Catty and hazel dormouse Ratty, who eats the foods in the house, feeds its babies, and lives in a small rat nest.

name: Endless Combat
short_description: Endless Combat, is a coop game which is about fighting as characters with unique skills against zombies, the game also contains free for all mode

name: Zulin Time
short_description: Classic platformer inspired by early NES games, telling a story about hardships of Mr. Zulin: video blogger, sex symbol, and overall just a swell guy.

name: Grim Tales: Echo of the Past Collector's Edition
short_description: Who’s puppeteering the past?

name: Cupid Kiss
short_description: Use your logical thinking to help the couple slide their way to find each other in this relaxing and innovative puzzle. Just be careful not to let any imp get in the way of love.

name: Candy Disaster - Tower Defense
short_description: Candy Disaster is a 3D tower defense game where you create trap combos to stop the candy thieves. Adventure to different planets, and match traps according to your strategy to create brand-new combinations! Dozens of clever trap combos to discover!

name: Infinite Turtles
short_description: Design computational circuits which defy restrictions of our universe in this open-ended puzzle. Your completed creations become components to solve future challenges. As you design a circuit and can place your design within it, where there is a smaller you doing the same, and so on to infinity.

name: BLOCK CAT SPACE GOLF
short_description: It's minigolf!.. With a cat!.. In space!.. With the price of a pizza slice comes the classic minigolf experience taken into a new dimension with shifting gravity, diamond collectibles and Space Cats. With zero calories!

name: SaGa SCARLET GRACE: AMBITIONS™
short_description: With the fate of the world uncertain, follow the journey of Urpina, Taria, Balmaint, and Leonard as they call on their might and set out to carve a new future. Take charge and shape your own adventure with ultimate freedom of choice.

name: Pixels Guide to Staying Dead
short_description: Lock n’ Load your maths! In this shared screen party shooter, if you're below 0 health you’re a skeleton. Above 0, you’re a human. Get your opponents to exactly 0 health to defeat them!

name: China VS Roman
short_description: This is a war strategy game with the mouse control.

name: Skater Frog
short_description: He was a skater frog, she said see ya later dog.

name: Reshaping Mars
short_description: 「Reshaping Mars」is a colony simulation game on Mars, you will start by gathering resources, storing food, accepting immigrants, and building a better colony together. Develop powerful technologies for Mars Reshaping, make Mars great agai..sorry, just great. Don't forget to make the residents happy.

name: Polity
short_description: Polity is a social RPG in a user-generated world that includes casual games and co-op city building. Be an unforgettable leader or a successful jobholder!

name: M.C.I. Escapes
short_description: M.C.I. Escapes: Solve a miracle to help a friend you haven't even met before, as you journey through Space & Time - In your Mind.

name: HEX Hacking Simulator
short_description: Use your communication skills to bypass internet security measures,and successfully hack into the most secure banks. Choose to take on the role as Hacker, taking direction to disarm each protocol; or Control, and relay instructions to your partner.

name: Great Paintings VR
short_description: Great Paintings from the Great Museums of the World in Virtual Reality. More than 1000 famous paintings to admire and enjoy.

name: Worldwide Sports Fishing
short_description: Worldwide Sports Fishing is a 3D fishing simulation with fishing waters all around the globe. Special feature: you can recommend your dream fishing water and if possible it will get into the game! The Game is constantly evolving.

name: Ghost Terminator
short_description: Let's vanish some ghosts! Explore, shoot, run, throw grenades, have some fun and get a little scared. Your mission is to find and annihilate all the ghosts.

name: Changed
short_description: You are trapped in an experiment, trying to find ways to make you still 'yourself' , persevere, and survive.

name: Oliver's Adventures in the Fairyland
short_description: A small adventure metroidvania game, where you playing as our-time teenager, who was summoned by wizard in fantasy world! And that wizard gave him a quest - return stolen king's treasures!

name: Call of Senpai: Waifu Warfare 2
short_description: Take control of Maria, a girl with Ukrainian roots. Explore the open world and complete quests from your friends and handlers to earn points and qualify for the $5 million Call of Senpai tournament.

name: Winter Wolves Classic Games Collection
short_description: Collection of 7 classic games, from boxing sim to tv station management, from detective visual novel to strategy/shooter mix.

name: TeamJumpers 2: New Reality
short_description: A team-based Indie platformer involving traversing multiple realities to explore and defeat bosses and enemies from all corners of the multiverse! From the demogoblins of the inside out, all the way to the end where you must face the one pulling the strings.

name: Purrate Adventure: Volcano Isle
short_description: Explore, Platform & Plunder a large Volcanic Isle in search of Coins, Gems, Crowns, and the 5 hidden talismans!

name: Highrisers
short_description: An Urban Survival RPG! Crafting, Exploring and Defending in a desolate metropolis haunted by the mysterious dreamers. Lead a team of 4 survivors through this urban desert of skyscrapers and high-rises, where the streets are crowded with the mutated victims of a strange disease.

name: Naval Battles Simulator
short_description: Naval Battles Simulator is a WWII real-time strategy and simulation game.

name: LAST EMBRYO -EITHER OF BRAVE TO STORY-
short_description: The young girl 'Sill', who longed to become an adventurer, came to the Developing City Aletia. However, shadows came quietly... No one had expected what kind of crisis Sill would encounter. But every footprint left by her will soon become mythology...

name: Viscera Cleanup Detail: Shadow Warrior
short_description: After the battle is over, someone has to cleanup the mess! Introducing Viscera Cleanup Detail: Shadow Warrior from RuneStorm, a unique crossover mini-game that combines the worlds of Viscera Cleanup Detail and Shadow Warrior.

name: XTHRUST
short_description: Simple Controls - Hard to Master. Fly your rocket drone in round based multiplayer races and single player challenges. Beat the best times, gain XP with spectacular flying and win races to earn coins. Race through a growing range of maps and upgrade your rocket drone.

name: RPS Runner
short_description: RPS Runner is a simple runner game where you have to choose the correct object from Rock, Paper or Scissors in order to defeat the on-coming objects.

name: Bazaar
short_description: Fly on a magic carpet through the mystical land of Bazaar, collecting exotic trinkets for your journey! Beware dart traps, sea cobras, and hungry crocs that lurk around corners. Vandal monkeys have stolen relics from the guardian of the labyrinth - will you recover them in time or be trapped forever?

name: Camera Obscura
short_description: An ancient tower in a forgotten land. A lone photographer on a desperate search. Facing dangerous animals, crumbling architecture, and perilous pitfalls, can you reach the summit of the Tower, and perhaps, redemption?

name: Blocks!: Richard III
short_description: Richard the Third is an epic two-player wargame that recreates the bloody dynastic struggle in the 15th century between the royal houses of Lancaster and York for the throne of England.

name: Patrick's Parabox
short_description: A mind-bending recursive puzzle game about boxes within boxes within boxes within boxes. Learn to use infinity to your advantage as you explore a deep and elegant system.

name: Street Outlaws 2: Winner Takes All
short_description: The stakes have just been raised! In this high-octane sequel, you have to prove your mettle in some of the roughest and most unforgiving drag and street races across the United States.

name: Pit People®
short_description: In this fast-paced, turn-based, co-op adventure you'll quest and explore, find awesome loot, customize your fighters, and recruit strange species! Come master your destiny in this strategic game of positioning.

name: String Rush
short_description: String Rush is a puzzle-platformer where you don't control your avatar in real time, but you have to enter the movement commands (input) inside a string and execute them all together.

name: Takelings House Party
short_description: A frantic and whimsical local multiplayer party game for VR. Takelings have invaded this quiet suburban home and it's up to Hal to exterminate these pests using whatever means necessary!

name: Totemlands
short_description: Totemlands is a relaxing crafting, building game where you raise totem poles, hunt spirits, decorate and explore the lands.

name: This World Unknown
short_description: A medieval fantasy visual novel with an otome twist. Rhea works as a nurse in a village hospital and lives a peaceful life - until one of her patients contracts a mysterious illness. Go on an exciting adventure, meet a varied cast, and see if true love conquers all!

name: VR: Vacate the Room (Virtual Reality Escape)
short_description: VR: Vacate the Room is a short Escape the Room game.It is a VR Experience where you need to find clues to solve puzzles and find your way out.

name: Cubiya
short_description: Cubiya is a 3D puzzle game, where you are asked to think around the box. You play as a small astronaut who is trying to rebuild a world. Run around chunks of the planet to find and build beacons, and reconnect the broken world. Explore different chunks of the world solving puzzles along the way.

name: Hotel Collectors Edition
short_description: Reveal the great mystery that lies behind high walls of the Bellevue hotel!

name: Ghost Beat
short_description: Ghost Beat is a rhythm based precision platformer.

name: ATRIA-1
short_description: Charge Game Studio presents a dark Sci-Fi action thriller. Challenge yourself as a space colonist on a Russian ship lost so deep in the Universe that even the strongest com ties are torn. Feel the ruthlessness of cosmos, painful past, and extraordinary events on the ship that all mix up into horror.

name: Ground Zero Texas - Nuclear Edition
short_description: As a tactical weapons expert, you soon discover it's crawling with aliens disguised as humans. Welcome to Ground Zero Texas.

name: Caribbean Odyssey
short_description: Step into the epic adventure of the legendary pirate Captain Henry Morgan. Inspired by true events from 16th century, Caribbean Odyssey is a beautiful tale of loyalty, love, betrayal and revenge. Explore a lavish and colorful world of secrets in 2.5D.

name: Cafe Crush
short_description: A choice-driven visual novel featuring mini-games and quizzes, set in a quaint little café run by three cute girls.

name: Massive Air Combat
short_description: Over 100 air fighters and 3D dogfight! You can enjoy large-scale aerial dogfight. A free soundtrack (all 14 music) and 3 free DLC games are included.DLC games are for Windows only.

name: A Mysterious Gallery
short_description: In this rather special museum, you will have to observe all the paintings of famous artists! 'A Mysterious Gallery' is a mix between a hidden object game and a puzzle game.

name: 只兔：不灭的勇者
short_description: A hardcore 2D action platformer developed by one person. Play as a memoryless rabbit TOOK to explore the vast Moon Cave world and defeat dozens of powerful enemies, collect the treasures scattered in this world and regain the glory of the Moon Up Group!

name: Masked and Mysterious
short_description: Enter a twisted world, in which nothing is as it seems. You play the role of a father, who wakes up on a traumatic night to find his children missing. You start finding clues about possible whereabouts and.....

name: Windforge
short_description: WindForge is a side-scrolling block-building game where you explore hostile skies in an ever-changing Steampunk world. Everything you see can be created or destroyed, creating an RPG without barriers that rewards creative problem solving and improvisation.

name: Kingdoms CCG
short_description: *** Game is closing on Nov. 30, 2018 ***Kingdoms CCG is an exciting, feature-rich trading card game featuring 27 unique heroes, over 900 cards, guilds, crafting and tournaments with prizes! Find your Kingdom and join the battle for control of the fantasy world of Euna. Victory awaits!

name: Tessa's Ark
short_description: A Sci-fi RPG set in a world where humans have shed the limitations of the corporeal body to inhabit existence as beings of pure thought. Solve puzzles to unlock the secrets of the digital reality.

name: [Speer DX]
short_description: Throw your speer, use it as a platform, and puzzle-platform your way through 125 stages in this director's cut version of the classic [Speer]!

name: 遇见猎人
short_description: An independent single game. The game's enclave is very small, the game is open to the world, Sandbox games. Players can explore freely on a large map, and can manipulate a pair of male and female characters to fight at the same time.

name: V-Racer Hoverbike
short_description: V-RACER HOVERBIKE is a fast-paced futuristic racing game in VR (HTC VIVE, OCULUS RIFT and Windows Mixed Reality). Available for Arcades on SpringboardVR

name: Random(platformer)
short_description: a minimalistic 2D platformer game with randomly generated levels. a level can't be exactly the same twice!

name: Pure Metal: Feature 1
short_description: Old school shooter fun. Can you save Pure Metal from the clutches of evil? Kill the hoards of enemies and rain righteous fury on the bosses and save the planet!

name: Ball
short_description: This game is 3D rolling game, and really hard to beat. Try to speed run the game!

name: Hollywood Visionary
short_description: Make the movie of your dreams amid the glamor and romance of 1950s Hollywood! Hire Alfred Hitchcock, seduce Greta Garbo, or build your studio into a powerhouse.

name: Quantum Apex
short_description: Sci Fi Stunt/Street Racer With Nitrous. Strong emphasis on fun. I need time to morn my baby boy :( progress halted until further notice.

name: Mushroom Quest
short_description: Rethinking of the classic sokoban genre, slow and kind game with original gameplay elements. Mushroom Quest is a retro styled and addictive arcade, ideal to spend few unhurried evenings.

name: Lumo
short_description: Witness the rebirth of a genre in Lumo – a classic isometric adventure with a modern twist for gamers young and old alike!

name: Martin Goes on the Attack
short_description: Martin is an advanced robot controlled from the main computer, you have to take control of a strong and fast robot soldier.

name: No One But You
short_description: A Visual Novel/Dating Sim about Hideaki who has moved from his small village to a much larger town, Okutama.

name: Monstro: Battle Tactics
short_description: Monstro takes the traditional tRPG gameplay and reconstructs it into a completely deterministic, logical experience with a twist of tactics. All of this is spiced up with ridiculous, tongue-in-cheek lore and approachable difficulty.

name: Byte Driver
short_description: Byte Driver, the 1979 revolutionary arcade racer, is back! Drive fast. Hack your enemies. Fight for your life. Survive if you can.

name: ECHORIA: Ancient Echoes
short_description: An immersive story-based RPG by Adam Waind.

name: Kill The Monster Z
short_description: Kill The Monster Z is a pixel-style, side-scrolling action game where you play The role of The main character, trying to destroy what you see as enemies, but it's not that easy.

name: Super Amazeballs
short_description: SUPER AMAZEBALLS is a VR dexterity puzzle game that'll twist your brain! Using both hands: Tilt, spin, and rotate 3D 'amazeballs' to roll a pinball through mind bending tracks!

name: Dead End Road
short_description: Dead End Road is an atmospheric driving game, with a low-fi aesthetic and procedurally generated elements. Complete your journey to seek the assistance of the old witch at Dead End Road; Get there before daybreak and perhaps, just perhaps, you can escape this nightmare.

name: Dimensional Intersection
short_description: Dimensional Intersection is an interactive musical visualizer for virtual reality. Featuring music from artists such as Globular and MONS, it will take you to a new reality through surreal scenes filled with interactive real-time fractals, infinite tunnels and morphing 3D models.

name: Chess Knights: Shinobi
short_description: Chess Knights: Shinobi is an original turn-based puzzle game inspired by Chess. Become a Ninja in feudal Japan and prove your skills in the art of infiltration, sabotage and assassination.

name: Toymaker
short_description: Toymaker is a roleplaying game that takes place in a dark, snow-filled world, where life is harsh and the people living there have become hard and cold. In this land, the darkness has eyes, the winter wind whispers with a piercing voice and the frost hungers for warm flesh.

name: Andalia
short_description: Andalia is a fantasy real-time strategy game (RTS) with a diverse range of civilisations, resources and environments. Build up your town and lead your forces into war against enemy players. Alternatively you may construct a monument and hold it long enough to reach victory.

name: Bryce's Movement Engine¹
short_description: Be prepared for a trip into yesteryear! Bryce's Movement Engine¹ is an MSDOS Ware meets Post-Trainwreck-era game set in the halcyon days of 1998! An all-new classic adventure, BME¹ is the ultimate tribute to a mega-cool era of awesome gaming!

name: The Last Dogma - Wilder Wein Edition
short_description: HG101: 'Like the beloved games of bizarre gaming auteurs, you kind of have to meet it by its own standards and not your own, and even then you may not like it. But if you do end up liking it, you may end up liking it a lot.'

name: Curse of the Dead Gods
short_description: You seek untold riches, eternal life, divine powers - it leads to this accursed temple, a seemingly-infinite labyrinth of bottomless pits, deadly traps, and monsters.

name: Oakwood Academy of Spells and Sorcery
short_description: Oakwood Academy of Spells and Sorcery is a fun adult visual novel filled with romance and adventure. You play as Thomas Middleton, a first-year student, who tries to get by while encountering a diverse set of wacky and fascinating characters along the way!

name: Hamster All-Stars
short_description: Horse betting is out - hamster betting is in! Build crazy race tracks for cute hamsters, then bet on who will to earn credits. Use these credits to unlock all kinds of cool objects, like bumpers, funnels & tubes.

name: Caladrius Blaze
short_description: An epic tale that begins from shooting missiles! The newest work of the Caladrius series with lots of new features that exceeds the original story!

name: The War for the West
short_description: Rule the land as you see fit, using alliances, intrigue or warfare to establish your House as a dominant force in the realm's politics.

name: Pilgrimage
short_description: Bring devoutness to a faraway place, where is the place of the Buddha,No worries, no fear, no controversy, quiet, settling down and quietly feeling the beauty of pilgrimage.Life is a spiritual practice, born in nature, and gratitude.It's a spiritual journey ...It's pilgrimage ...

name: Sucker for Love: First Date
short_description: Put the 'love' in 'Lovecraftian horror'! Perform terrifying rituals to win the affections of eldritch horrors and smooch 'em... at any cost!

name: In The Search For: Revenge
short_description: In The Search For: Revenge is a very short, intentionally unpolished, abstract and odd game with no dialogue and little to no music.

name: Zombie Camp: Last Survivor
short_description: This casual action horror shooter takes players through eerie farmlands and creepy cemeteries in two tense campaigns. A lone survivor of the apocalypse needs to overcome endless waves of walking zombies, skeletons and other creatures of the night.

name: Gamma Blast
short_description: Blast your way through enemy waves. Strike at enemy formations prioritizing targets depending on the situation. Rip them to pieces using an arsenal of powerful and versatile weapons. Put your reflexes to the test dodging a fire storm of enemy projectiles. Destroy challenging Bosses to achieve victory.

name: BASIC ROGUE
short_description: BASIC ROGUE is a turn-based dungeon crawler. You have very limited inventory space, skills, weapons, armor, and stats which all need to be managed while fighting enemies, gathering treasure, and figuring out what your primary objective is. This game will appeal to players looking for a challenge.

name: SOK
short_description: SOK is a sokoban classic puzzle game. The goal of the game is to move all the boxes to their positions. It's not as easy as it seems. The player can push one box at a time, but do not pull it off.

name: Natural
short_description: Very beautiful game of natural jigsaw puzzle game! Collect the full image of the different small pieces. You can either play with very relaxing on Casual mode, Customize mode or Challenge Mode. Support unique game modes like Rotation, Limited Pick, Blind, Black Hole, Color Layer, and so on.

name: The Thief Girl ~ 盗賊少女 ~
short_description: 'The Thief Girl' is a stealth mission game in which you control a thief girl to collect treasure and get to the goal. Use the mouse to guide the girl to the goal while keeping her hidden from the monsters. Use emergency evasion actions when the monsters are about to find you to conquer the stage.

name: Caravaneer 2
short_description: A post-apocalyptic trade simulation game with turn based isometric combats. The game features detailed economics simulation and a rich branching story where your choices actually matter.

name: Spellarium 7 - Match 3 Puzzle
short_description: Collect coins coins to refuel the 7th element, Time, to stop the world from decaying.

name: Nibû
short_description: Nibû is a real-time strategy game set in an alternate history ancient near east. Build, expand and fortify yourself in different scenarios to fight the oncoming armies of the allied hordes.

name: Gauntlet™ Slayer Edition
short_description: The classic Gauntlet 4-player co-op action gameplay returns in a completely new experience! Battle the endless hordes of foes as you and your friends fight for treasure and glory via both local and online co-op multiplayer. Invade the Darkness!

name: Xmas Zombie Rampage 2
short_description: John Iron is back, the Marine Killing Machine. Zombie invasion in China! Alert! Alert! They have stolen the Xmas presents and the priceless girlie photo collection from the famous Sakura Gallery with all the lovely girlie photos. Time to strike back! The chaos strike back! Hooray!

name: NARUTO SHIPPUDEN: Ultimate Ninja STORM 4
short_description: The latest opus in the acclaimed STORM series is taking you on a colourful and breathtaking ride. Take advantage of the totally revamped battle system and prepare to dive into the most epic fights you’ve ever seen !

name: Anthology of Fear: Prologue
short_description: Anthology of Fear is the first-person psychological horror, focusing on the story and solving the secrets of the game world. Discover the beginning of the first of three completely unique dark stories in this climatic prologue.

name: WATCH / 透视
short_description: This is a platform puzzle game related to our 'WATCH' vision.

name: MASSIVE CHALICE
short_description: MASSIVE CHALICE is a tactical strategy game set on an epic timeline from Double Fine Productions. As the Immortal Ruler of the nation, you'll take command of its heroes, forge heroic marriages to strengthen your Bloodlines, and battle a mysterious enemy known as the Cadence in a 300 year war.

name: Aye Aye, Captain
short_description: Aye Aye Captain is a game about crewing a ship on the high seas of the 1500 and 1600s. You'll have to manage a crew, provide them with consistent booty, rum, and fight off mutinies all while pillaging vessels of royal navies, other pirates, and trading companies.

name: Subcube
short_description: Subcube is a puzzle game designed to make your brain nervous system a Gordian knot. The goal is to construct cubes by rotating blocks on a board. Use your imagination and creativity and push your spatial awareness to its limits in order to solve the puzzles.

name: Fair Strike
short_description: Fair Strike is a game about brave pilots and their lethal celestial weapons fighting against terrorism and drug trafficking. So don't waste your time and jump into the cockpit of a modern attack helicopter and join a war against world terrorism. Your goal is simple - Kill them all!

name: Fitforce
short_description: No matter what happens outside, keep exercising at home using only a computer and a smartphone. Your workouts won’t be boring ever again with entertaining and interactive gameplay. Have fun and be healthy with Fitforce.

name: Tiger Soldier Ⅰ
short_description: Tiger Soldier is a military-themed run & gun shooter game.

name: Anime Otaku Girl 二次元宅女
short_description: 一款益智类小游戏，通过“吸附物件”获得积分购买道具并不断过关，内置无限关卡，难度逐渐增大。

name: Space Force
short_description: Space Force is a single - player, local, arcade, shooter game. With over 1000 waves to survive, leader boards to prove yourself to be the best, unique arsenal to tear through your enemies. The Space Force is a game that was inspired by 'Metal Slug,' 'Galaga,' and 'Hawking Raptor Call of the Shadow.'

name: Haunting Hour
short_description: Cooperate in this Cross-platform Multiplayer Virtual Reality Escape Room to escape the Witch’s Castle. Pit your wits against twisted puzzles and crazy challenges as you and your fellow imprisoned ghosts race against time. There's only an hour until the Haunting Hour begins, will you make it out?

name: The Bus
short_description: The Bus is the next generation of city bus driving simulation set in the capital of Germany, Berlin, on a realistic scale of 1:1. Transport passengers on different lines across the city with various busses. Manage your fleet and team up with other drivers online.

name: dino game
short_description: You fell from your UFO... How do you get back? Explore a foreign and friendly world inhabited by geysers, tall trees and dinosaurs. Learn its rules and systems and craft your way back to your spaceship!

name: Ignited Steel: Mech Tactics
short_description: Ignited Steel is a mech roguelike turn-based-tactics game. Manage a team of overheating old-tech mechs, more heat means more vulnerability and damage! Unravel the galaxy’s story as you travel from node to node, improving your mechs, acquiring new pilots, and defeat the sentient A.I. overlord!

name: Subnautica
short_description: Descend into the depths of an alien underwater world filled with wonder and peril. Craft equipment, pilot submarines and out-smart wildlife to explore lush coral reefs, volcanoes, cave systems, and more - all while trying to survive.

name: Alice's Jigsaw Time Travel 2
short_description: See Alice and her friends! Solve 100 unique patchwork mosaics!

name: G-MODEアーカイブス01 フライハイトクラウディア
short_description: A JRPG whose story takes place in the sky!

name: Battle Bruise 2

name: Rob Riches
short_description: Plan your steps carefully as you traverse ancient temples, filled with dangerous traps and puzzles.

name: The Jackbox Party Pack 5
short_description: It’s the biggest Party Pack yet, including the return of the classic pop culture trivia mash-up YOU DON’T KNOW JACK: Full Stream; the game of hilarious hypotheticals Split the Room; the lyric-writing, robot rap battle Mad Verse City; the inventive drawing game Patently Stupid; and the outer space fling-fest Zeeple Dome.

name: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition
short_description: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition features “The Last Khans” with 3 new campaigns and 4 new Civilizations. Frequent updates include events, additional content, new game modes, and enhanced features with the recent addition of Co-Op mode!

name: Snowmania
short_description: Enter the Freedom Square in Brno invaded by snowmans and enjoy the christmas mood with them by playing their minigames, opening gifts or just exploring the square. You can build your own snowman, defend the christmas tree, fight with ghost snowmans and more, all in one place.

name: Hot And Lovely 3
short_description: This is an interesting leisure origami game, which can exercise your hands-on ability. In the game, you must fold the paper as much as possible into the specified cute graphics in the specified origami times. The game is very challenging from easy to difficult.

name: Darksburg
short_description: DARKSBURG is a co-op roguelite in which you must escape a procedurally generated medieval city overwhelmed by undead forces. Fight alongside up to 3 friends, overcome the revenants and get out while you can...

name: シルヴァリオ ヴェンデッタ-Verse of Orpheus-
short_description: This is not a story of a hero.This is the story of the loser. It is a story in which a man who once escaped fights to recover his star.

name: Odysseus Kosmos and his Robot Quest: Episode 1
short_description: What do you do if you are the only one left aboard a spaceship? Your team has embarked on a mysterious expedition a few years ago, the ship’s machinery has started acting up and it seems there are ghosts wandering about. Luckily, the black hole above you doesn’t pose any problems…yet.

name: Adam The Storyteller
short_description: Help Adam to solve puzzles around him after being kidnapped by a mysterious land-grabbing floating island. A hand-drawn puzzle-adventure with funny characters, hundred levels and power-up puzzles with unique abilities that will help You to get through a puzzle maze.

name: Eventide Night
short_description: A fantastic Shooting Game Music.

name: Life of a Wizard
short_description: Write an archmage's autobiography in this 80-year 130,000-word interactive fiction! Play good or evil, man or woman, as you bring peace to the kingdom or take over the world with your sorcery. Brew potions, raise the dead, summon mythical beasts, control men's minds, and blast away your enemies.

name: The Evil in the Forest
short_description: «The Evil in the Forest» is a 3rd-person fantasy horror adventure game. The game tells you the dark story of a man named Derek Bain - a single father who, being a researcher in the field of natural resources, arrives with his daughter Kate in a mystical forest...

name: PrincessGuardiansParodyH

name: Pupperazzi
short_description: Put your love for pups to the test - we have a bunch of dogs that need their photos taken, doggone it! Photograph and catalogue the finest (and derpiest) dogs to build your career, upgrade your camera, and discover new canines. WOOF.

name: Nightmare
short_description: The courier, Lympha, tells her; 'If you were to defeat the boss, Malignant Tumor, in this world, you shall return to your own world.' Julia strives with an Anticancer Drug held in her arms. Believing that, the flower blooming at the nidus, is glimmering in Nightmare...

name: 双子树 TwinTrees
short_description: Live Danmaku interactive game.

name: 孙美琪疑案 第五季
short_description: 《孙美琪疑案》系列第五季，共包含6个DLC，分别是：徽州古宅:蝶儿、鬼船:邓秋平、回廊:余仁仁、超杀:陈双十、金牙:宗大宝、南河:游乐园。

name: ProjectM : Daydream
short_description: Experience a daydream like never before in VR. Experience skydiving, hang out at the beach, or just chat with a digital friend in the comfort of a virtual kitchen.

name: Nothing!
short_description: What do you play? I play nothing!

name: SincereMen
short_description: This game is a First Person Shooter video game based on VR technology with realistic graphic and hardcore action shooter gameplay. The main character is a trained ranger that come to help his partner from the edge of the chopper using a heavy machinegun and try to save him.

name: State of Mind
short_description: State of Mind is a futuristic thriller game delving into transhumanism. The game explores themes of separation, disjuncture and reunification, in a world that is torn between a dystopian material reality and a utopian virtual future.

name: True Blades™
short_description: TRUE BLADES™ is a cutting edge medieval fighting adventure which provides a very realistic and immersive sword fighting experience for VR. Fight hordes of monsters or strategically duel against highly skilled knights and develop true-to-life fighting skills.

name: Pencil Fantastic
short_description: This is currently just an art game, you create single line drawings by controlling a pencil from the third person. Levels, collectible items and even shooter elements are all in development so stick around!

name: BoxRunner
short_description: BoxRunner is a classic style arcade game that challenges you and your trusty robot 'Mr. Doo-Dad' against the clock. How many boxes can you and Mr. Doo-Dad open before Mr. Doo-Dad's battery runs out?

name: PAGAN: Autogeny
short_description: A thousand worlds surround our own, composed of bits and bytes. When they die, where do they go; what secrets do they hide? Stumble ye, wayfarer, through the wreckage of a dead MMO.

name: MADiSON
short_description: MADiSON is a first person psychological horror game that delivers an immersive and terrifying experience. With the help of an instant camera, connect the human world with the beyond, take pictures and develop them by yourself. Solve puzzles, explore your surroundings and most importantly, survive.

name: Voxel Shot VR
short_description: Shoot Voxel zombies in VR! Utilize an arsenal of weapons to eliminate the approaching brain-hungry zombies. Don't be fooled by their cute appearance! Resilient zombies, helicopters and huge bosses are closing in to seal your doom. Can you survive the Voxzombocalypse?

name: VCuber
short_description: Control the light ball and crush the bricks! Nara the girl can destroy the bricks by hitting the light ball and controlling its direction of movement, using the ball to clear all the bricks in the scene, but be careful of the enemies and their bullets.

name: Paunch
short_description: One-on-one physical online duels.

name: Shiren the Wanderer: The Tower of Fortune and the Dice of Fate
short_description: The Classic Roguelike Wanders Onto Steam! Adventure with Shiren the Wanderer and his sidekick Koppa, the talking ferret, through a world filled with cunning monsters, deadly traps and countless treasure.

name: Star Sky 3
short_description: Deep beneath the moonlit sky, the final adventure awaits! The final chapter in the Star Sky trilogy following another journey through a mysterious and enchanting world.

name: Doctor Who: The Edge Of Time
short_description: A new mysterious enemy threatens to tear apart the universe and only you can stop them! Doctor Who: The Edge Of Time lets players embark on an adventure through space and time. Travel across the universe, visit alien locations, pilot the TARDIS and solve the mystery of the controlling force behind the Reality Virus.

name: The Magician's Workshop
short_description: When your master is murdered, you must uncover the magical secrets of Renaissance Italy, before your rival apprentices expose them first!

name: 吾光笔记Holimas Z Notebook
short_description: 你在一栋被完全封锁的公寓里觉醒，但是除了自己的化名以外对自己的过去一无所知。神秘的幕后黑手逼迫这所公寓里所有人自相残杀，而你以及这所公寓乃至整个世界真正的真相是什么？

name: The End o,,,o
short_description: Face the grim reaper at 3 frames per second.

name: Sugy the Christmas elf
short_description: It is Christmas time and the snowmen are revolting! Christmas is near but the snowmen have kidnapped all reindeers. How can the presents reach the children nevertheless? Save Christmas!

name: HAUNTED: Halloween '86 (The Curse Of Possum Hollow)
short_description: A brand new NES homebrew game independently developed by Retrotainment Games and released on an NES cartridge. This classic style beat 'em up / platformer adheres to all NES hardware restrictions and pushes the limits of game play on the console. '86 takes you in and around the town of Possum Hollow on Halloween in 1986.

name: Skull Bullets
short_description: Skull Bullets is a roguelike game with RPG elements. You are a risen from the dead shooter who is trying to get out of the endless forest with the undead. Upgrade your skills, get new weapons and deal with a whole crowd of enemies. Will you be able to get out? It all depends on you.

name: 1, 2 BLAME!
short_description: Online multiplayer game where deception and truth will suit up. Solve the clues, equip and use items, debate who’s the shadiest player and unmask the Killer!

name: The Chicken's Fall
short_description: Once Upon a time, A chicken that dreamed of flying, she tried 30 times... and fell. Fall, dodge obstacles and don't die.

name: Piñata
short_description: Could you find empathy with a Piñata? Perhaps you just want to exercise or relieve some stress? The Piñata HTC Vive experience is designed to question your moral compass; what will it be, the chainsaw or the watermelon?

name: VR垃圾分类_Refuse classification
short_description: Combining advanced VR technology with hot topics of people's livelihood, through interesting and vivid interactive experience of VR, students'learning enthusiasm is greatly mobilized. In the VR garbage sorting contest, students can grasp the key points of the propaganda activities.

name: Behold The Dark
short_description: Behold The Dark is a 2D isometric action, adventure game with pixel graphics and survival horror elements emphasizing on lighting mechanics. Fight off monsters, interact with people, stay in the light, do whatever it takes to fend off that horrible oblivion.

name: 末路希冀
short_description: 《末路希冀》是一款设定在末世后的生存冒险游戏。你将为了在凶险的末世生存而竭尽全力，并为了生存下来的希冀而踏上冒险的旅途。整理好你的装备，选择你在末世生存的道具，末世的旅途在就脚下

name: Void Memory
short_description: You, who was born in a world full of darkness, should wander this hollowed land to find the Relics for a person who created you. However, fallen and lost souls with trap-filled trials await in your course of doing so. Can you survive in this crumbling world and start a new era?

name: FukTopia 2
short_description: A post apocalyptic Beat Em Up game.

name: Spooky Mahjong

name: Final_SIM

short_description: Destiny Hunter is a story based RPG game in which you can control two characters, a female warrior and a female Archer. The story is about searching a better place to live and of course find your Destiny. You need to pass through cold places and reach into a better place to finish the game.

name: Tales From The Dragon Mountain: The Strix
short_description: Tales from the Dragon Mountain is a puzzle adventure game of exploration and object finding inspired by folklore and myths. You see it in your dreams, you feel it in your blood; the ancient evil awakening in your ancestors' homeland - the distant Dragon Mountains!

name: Herman Electro
short_description: We combined mind-bending puzzle mechanics with a roguelike structure to create a captivating experience unlike any other. Acquire powerful supertools, conquer electrifying puzzles, discover hidden secrets, and fight for your freedom!

name: Crazy Alchemist
short_description: * special note: this game also supports PC and VR two platforms,you can play it in pc without VR . Crazy Alchemist is a simulation game full of medieval fantasy and magic. Have your own alchemy studio, using a variety of novel raw materials to refine the amazing alchemy products.

name: vreezy: Girl's Pictorial Story Vol.1
short_description: Here in the studio, You are the manager of a cute girl who came here to model. Touch all the points in front of your eyes. And try to talk to her. Who knows? A new story might unfold that you never knew.

name: Shambled Spiral
short_description: Singleplayer Genre - Weird/Casual/FPS Purchase now to possibly get a much better version in the future for FREE!

name: Between Me and The Night
short_description: ‘Between Me and The Night' is a surrealist action adventure game that walks the thin path between sanity and madness. Take on the role of a young boy and explore and interact with the mysterious house in which he lives.

name: HecatoncheirStory
short_description: You are a young monster hunter who moves between worlds in search of special prey.

name: Altarays
short_description: Would you like to try out an extrasensory experience based on real events? Enjoy your first out-of-body experience in virtual reality. During this first out-of-body experience you’ll travel back to Egypt. But not the Egypt they told you about in history books, definitely not.

name: 刺沙
short_description: 《刺沙》是一款还原传奇单职业特色的游戏。游戏中主角色战士，带领宠物征战玛法大陆。野外地图BOSS，副本BOSS，各种精英BOSS等你去挑战。野外战斗，激情PK，炫酷觉醒，各种玩法带你领略传奇不一样的体验！

name: Mall Mayhem
short_description: Mall Mayhem is a game with one very simple goal: destroy the mall. How you do it is up to you. In your arsenal is a variety of abilities perfect for the job. Almost every object in every mall can be destroyed so your destructive spree won't end anytime soon. Watch out for shoppers!

name: SpaceVibes VR (Point & Click, Abstract, Disco Music)
short_description: An Artistic VR “Shooter” Game For Everyone! Enter space and enjoy shooting flying objects with a laser gun while jamming out to the SpaceVibes soundtrack! A game without gore, that doesn’t encourage shooting living things… In fact, you can’t!

short_description: Join the fun as adorable animals battle for athletic supremacy across a variety of fantastic arenas! Play against friends across multiple platforms over the Internet. In FurBall, you play on teams of up to 2 players on each side in noble competition, attempting to score goals for your team!

name: PearsAndGrayWitch
short_description: A boy who likes 'Apples' but whose name is 'Pears' will prove himself, through a series of trials, to be redeemed and to find his way back home.

name: Womb Room
short_description: Welcome to the Womb Room, the beginning of the end. The ultimate human life simulator. Is this a roguelike? Is life a roguelike?

name: Boxman's Struggle
short_description: What's better than climbing mountain in a cardboard box? Getting deep frustration every time you fall from it.

name: ボク姫PROJECT

name: Jumper Jape

name: Widgets and Gidgets
short_description: You are a lowly gnome, making parts, earning shinnies, building (and repairing) machines on a quest to earn 1 million shinnies.

name: Tank Battle: 1945
short_description: The end is near for the Third Reich, masters of Europe for too long! In Tank Battle: 1945 you will fight some missions as the German Army, in its last efforts to prevent the Allied advance.

name: Dragon Wars

name: Good doktor
short_description: Game simulator of the work of a general practitioner in a hospital. Your goal is to identify diseases in patients and achieve the highest level. Take care of the routine of the physician, control of coupons and carefully check each incoming patient for the presence of certain diseases.

name: Si Kancil : The Adventurous Mouse Deer
short_description: Once upon a time, there is a little Mouse Deer, his name is Kancil. Kancil live in shady forest far away from the city. Actually that forest is a peace place for the animals before the hunters came. They catch animals, they also cut down the trees to get the woods and burn the forest.

short_description: ShadowSide is a First Person Exploration game. A policeman Alex Carter has been watching over the tranquility in the town for many years. He protects the people from robbery and crime. Nothing but a routine.

name: The Astro Parcel Service

name: Drifter's Tales
short_description: This strategic card game invites you to live small stories in the universe of The First Spine. Choose a story and fight fearsome enemies! You may discover the secret that surrounds the Forgotten Valley.

name: CozyTyper
short_description: CozyTyper is a relaxing game where you can enjoy a cozy atmosphere while you spend your time improving your typing accuracy and speed, without the pressure of a ticking clock. Take your touch typing to the next level with calm practice and muscle memory training! Slow is smooth, smooth is fast.

name: Combined Arms Operations Series
short_description: The Combined Arms Operations Series simulates hypothetical battles between World War II armies. Assemble your forces, out plan, and outfight your enemies to master the art of combined arms warfare in chaotic simultaneous turns where commanders must adapt quickly to an evolving battlefield.

name: AI Battle Royale Generator
short_description: Generate your own Battle Royale simulations filled with Artificial Intelligences trained using machine learning! If you are a Twitch.tv streamer, your viewers can create their own AI and join the battle! There are more than 100 million playable maps!

name: Pixel Galaxy
short_description: A non-shooting shoot 'em up where you must grow, make friends, and survive together.

name: Fire Escape
short_description: A neo-Hitchock murder mystery set in Brooklyn. When the clock strikes eight, a suspenseful thriller begins to unfold in real time. Watch closely from the fire escape as your suspicious neighbors embroil you in a simmering, interactive crime.

name: Love n Dream

name: Teratini VR
short_description: In this VR adventure, you are the Dragon Mage who glides through the air, smashes attacks back at opponents, and beckons a dragon when the going gets rough. Invent new moves and perfect them in the Sanctuary before taking back Teratini.

name: The Uninvited: MacVenture Series
