short_description: Flappy Octane is an endless level, speed increasing game. You pick a car, and jump through rings. The rings are generated at random heights and the speed of the game increases. ​How far can you get? Can you get #1 on the leaderboards?

name: Soldiers Of Freedom
short_description: You are a soldier fighting for the freedom in the heart off fierce combat. Conquer different battlegrounds alongside your comrades. Realistic combat, fast paced action and advanced AI system will help you feel like on real battlefield.

name: Optika
short_description: Discover the world of light physics: play with lasers, prisms, mirrors, magnets and dozens of other optical devices. Explore the world of Optika with Prof. Opticus and his assistant, Sofia! Research and complete more than one hundred challenging puzzles!

name: The Legend of Pomodoro
short_description: The Legend of Pomodoro is a pomodoro tool and an idle game driven by tomatoes.

name: Graveyard Birds
short_description: Graveyard Birds is a 2d puzzle game. Guide Lemmy the bird through 50 devious levels and escape the clutches of the undead with the help of your friends!

name: Hunting Unlimited 1
short_description: Spot your prey quickly then get into position for the ultimate in hunting action! Packed with over 220 missions – including the bonus Master Campaigns – pursuing 5 species of game in 5 rich environments, Hunting Unlimited is the innovative original hit that started a long running series!

name: Marauder
short_description: Marauder, is a squad based and tactical 3D game with RPG elements. It was released in late 2009, in Russia. You may know these names as the former made Brigade 7,62 and the later also published Pathologic.

name: Jetpack City Action VR
short_description: Fly freely with a jetpack and enjoy the view of realistic modeled city. 3 different stuff you can do in game, fly freely, or collect cargo or fight against the drones. This game was planned as a commercial promotional game and was played and enjoyed by the participants in many fairs and meetings.

name: The Slormancer
short_description: Fight hordes of enemies led by The Slormancer, an evil warlock from the past, in an absurd yet epic Action RPG! Featuring loads of shiny loot, tons of collectibles, countless hours of content, a frenetic gameplay and carefully crafted pixel art.

name: Gallows Choice
short_description: A classic for great fun, a virtual and improved gallows game!

name: Royale Island Showdown
short_description: An online 4 player Battle Royale FPS, where each player has an AI teammate.

name: From Red to Green
short_description: Change all red objects to green, systematically clicking on them with the objective of solving the puzzle in the lowest number of moves possible. If you click on a green object, it becomes red, and the opposite is also true. Some levels have inverted controls, and others have moving objects.

name: Once upon a Dungeon
short_description: Explore dark dungeons, defeat challenging creatures and collect unique loot in this hardcore roguelike game.

name: Batu Ta Batu
short_description: Batu Ta Batu is a colorful tile puzzle game from one up to four players. Slide, combine and match the tiles of the same color through hundreds of levels and several game modes!

name: PhilGood
short_description: PhilGood is not ON a wire ... but stucked IN the line ! - It’s a game of adventure with puzzles and a strong script. Original and mysterious messages, decoding and a unreleased soundtrack.

name: Extrorb
short_description: A fast-paced, third-person, ball mayhem game.

name: Sorcery Saga: Curse of the Great Curry God
short_description: Join Pupuru, a hard working student, on a delectable roguelike adventure filled with excitement, humour, thrills and all the curry you can eat as you quest to save your favourite local curry restaurant from being swallowed up by the big bad curry chain that's moved into town!

name: Deponia Doomsday
short_description: Can you change Deponia's fate? Do you have what it takes to change Rufus' past, present and future without accidently destroying the whole planet? Fight time itself in this action-packed, platypus-tastic and insanely hilarious story.

name: Sky Noon
short_description: Sky Noon is a First-Person Shooter with Brawler mechanics. Players are equipped with a grappling hook, a lasso and an arsenal of weapons and abilities. There is no health in Sky Noon - players eliminate their enemies by pushing and pulling them off the Floating Frontier.

name: Uberlaufer
short_description: You are a Wehrmacht soldier in 1940 who opposed the Third Reich. Incarcerated by the SS, you must escape the procedurally-generated dungeon with the assistance of the German resistance using environmental clues to avoid detection by guards. Every playthrough is different.

name: Super Lobster Run
short_description: Embark on an Epic Journey as Laughy the Lobster

name: Hidden World Top-Down 3D
short_description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

name: Task is to Survive
short_description: Task is to Survive - Is a first person shooter. You play as a soldier and you were sent by helicopter to the infected object in which there are a huge number of dangerous zombies. Do you have a special mission - to kill as many zombies before the time, until you die!

name: Slay Together
short_description: Slay Together is a classic online RPG in which you have to fight enemies, complete quests, level up your character and collect gear.

name: Farmington Tales
short_description: Let's get farming in this unique Hidden Object Farming Sim hybrid! Grow crops and run the farmer's market! Hidden objects are random so scenes are always new! Complete quests, build upgrades, and harvest the perfect crop. Even eggs, milk, and wool!

name: Galaxy Squad
short_description: Galaxy squad is a hardcore turn-based tactical roguelike, inspired by FTL and XCOM.

name: Marble Muse Arcade
short_description: A fast-paced marble rolling game where you must tilt the course to guide your marble, collect points and reach the end before the course explodes! Will you collect enough points to become the next Marble Legend?

name: Domino Simulator
short_description: Domino Simulator is a physics-based sandbox game in which you place various domino tiles and pieces to construct domino chains. Enjoy the odd satisfaction of watching your creation fall one after the other. Ultimately, the floor is yours to fill and the how and the what is completely up to you.
YOU ARE A SQUARE. That can fight, drink, dance, lift, become an athlete, play darts, fight robots, rob, steal, and smoke weed. All to get the global high score.

name: Red Goblin: Cursed Forest
short_description: Venture into the darkness of the Dream Forest and discover why it's now called 'Cursed'. Meet interesting characters in a psychological adventure, solve puzzles and learn all about the story of Red; a fire goblin that is now looking to find his master...

name: Friend Fighters
short_description: A 2d beat'm up, fighting game featuring a wacky cast of characters!

name: Tigey's Gift
short_description: Tigey's Gift is an addictive Physicals Ping Pong Arcade game. Shoot 5 different balls to feed the cat with tin, catnip, love, toy and water. Essential things for all cats. Feed your kitty and make her wish true.

name: Super Turbo Demon Busters!
short_description: STDB! is a rogue-like game about hardcore mercenaries and space marines escaping from a very cozy planet filled with monsters, nuclear fire, viruses and pixelated violence.

name: Alias
short_description: Alias is an abstract game designed for a company of at least 4 people. This is exactly what will help to distract yourself from the external fuss. Guess the guessing word through associations and explanations. Spend time playing in the same room, or play it online from a distance.

name: Skinwalker Hunt
short_description: Skinwalker Hunt is a horror themed hunting game from the creator of Witch Hunt. Main focus of the game is on exploration, non-linear gameplay, and atmosphere.

name: Helicopter Simulator 2020
short_description: Helicopter Simulator 2020 - it's simulator about pilot of helicopter, who battle in some places. Realistic Physics of helicopter.

name: Mystery of the Ancients: Three Guardians Collector's Edition
short_description: The town of Green Hill has really gone to the birds!

name: Resident Evil 2
short_description: A deadly virus engulfs the residents of Raccoon City in September of 1998, plunging the city into chaos as flesh eating zombies roam the streets for survivors. An unparalleled adrenaline rush, gripping storyline, and unimaginable horrors await you. Witness the return of Resident Evil 2.

name: Lords of the Shattered Kingdom
short_description: LotSK is a kingdom building game, featuring turn based hex grid combat, exploration and resource gathering.

name: HyperBrawl Tournament
short_description: HyperBrawl Tournament is the ultimate arena combat sport. Assemble your team of intergalactic heroes, arm them with outrageous weapons and score your way to victory in classic single player campaigns, couch or online play for up to four players.

name: Behold the Kickmen
short_description: BEHOLD THE KICKMEN is a football game made by someone who has no understanding of, or interest in, what is affectionately known as 'The Wonderful Game'. Start at the bottom of the Big Boring Football Spreadsheet and grind your way up to become the best at the football anyone's ever seen.

name: Russian Train Trip
short_description: Traveling on passenger trains in Russia. First-person exploration.

name: Flappy Bat
short_description: It's a stormy Halloween night and a bat is trying to make his way home. Can you help the Flappy Bat navigate through numerous procedurally generated obstacles. Flap your way past enemies and obstacles and compete on the global leaderboard for the ultimate top score!

name: Gear：治愈齿轮
short_description: 'Gear' is a relaxing, minimal, puzzle game.

name: Eye, caramba!
short_description: Got a keen eye? Then try to solve these colorful soothing puzzles while listening to relaxing music!

name: Knightfall: Rivals
short_description: Knightfall: Rivals is a free-to-play, card-collecting battle game. Unlock, collect and upgrade over 100 unique cards. Build your own strategic deck and battle others in full 3D with real-time matchmaking and gameplay. Compete in casual mode or climb the ranks of the Templars on an ever-changing global leaderboard.

name: Cat President ~A More Purrfect Union~
short_description: Find love, in a world where cats run the U.S. government!

name: March of Empires
short_description: Claim your title as Highland King, Northern Czar or Desert Sultan, and join this genre-redefining strategy game where you will wage constant war for real territorial conquest! Fortify your castle, fuel a massive army, and enter the ultimate fight for realm domination!

name: Agent 01
short_description: Laura, the daughter of a renowned businessman, hires Markz to rescue her father from a kidnapping. Markz then discovers the captivity location and devises a strategy to safely rescue the businessman.

name: Mental Hospital VR
short_description: Mental Hospital VR is a truly scary first-person stealth horror game. Discover heart-thumping terror, chase and scary creatures in this atmospheric horror game.

name: Crazy Saloon VR
short_description: Crazy Saloon VR : The Virtual Saloon Experience. Discover the Old West with this quirky saloon simulator built for HTC Vive.

name: missed messages.
short_description: ‘goth gf’s iPhone’ airdrops you - accept or decline? A love/horror story about life, death, & memes.

name: Marooners
short_description: Play a wild mix of fun party games as the action regularly switches back and forth between games. Can you handle the switcheroo chaos? Join your friends both on the couch and online while sadistically laughing at their misfortune, or come back to haunt them if you die...

name: Survival RPG 2: The Temple Ruins
short_description: A magical artifact lying among the ruins of a lost temple? Embark on a journey full of adventure, quests and exploration. You will need your survival skills in this retro 2d pixel art universe. Survival RPG 2: The Temple Ruins is the sequel of the first retro game Survival RPG: The Lost Treasure.

name: Radio Free Europa
short_description: A top-down 2.5D Spaceship shooter. Choose your ship and upgrade it as you go as you fight your way back to earth to deliver a message. Fast-paced dogfights, massive bosses, vibrant graphics, and an original soundtrack that reacts to gameplay.

name: Roll a Ball With Your Friends
short_description: 'Roll a Ball with your friends' is a multiplayer game for up to 8 players. Let's roll a cute ball and have an obstacle race! Compete with your friends in over 30 exciting levels such as Kitchen, Pirate, and Space!

name: Escape Camp Waddalooh
short_description: Falkrus® invites you to experience the thrill of immersive VR at camp Waddalooh. Keep your wits about you as you explore camp for an escape with nothing but a flashlight.

name: Super Life of Pixel
short_description: Join Pixel as he quests through gaming history, teleporting across the most iconic video game systems of generations past. He’ll have to jump, dodge and play smart if he wants to survive all the traps, puzzles and enemies waiting to take him down at every turn.

name: Spider-Man: Far From Home Virtual Reality
short_description: Based on the film, the Spider-Man: Far From Home VR Experience is a fast-swinging, thrill ride through the eyes of your favorite neighborhood Spider-Man. Spider-Man: Far From Home – now available on disc and digital.

name: Raise Your Own Clone
short_description: You are about to uncover four twisted tales of misadventure surrounding people connected, in some way, by the late Dr. Cyrus Stansfield's cloning machine. Within these stories you must face the ethical dilemmas and possible fortune while guiding each character to their own end.

name: Gachi Heroes 2: Flexboll
short_description: Everyone knows who the real king of Flex and today he is ready to teach you. Plunge into an incredible adventure, meet different characters from the universe 'gachimuchi' and find out how deep you are ready to go. However, there is one problem...

name: Battle of Empires : 1914-1918
short_description: Battle of Empires :1914-1918 is a story driven RTS, that re-lives some of the bloodiest battles of “The Great War”. The missions include some of the most fearsome weaponary employed of the period. Sabotage, stealth, trench warfare, gas attacks, artillery and mobile infantry - BoE has it all!

name: Karakia Shooter
short_description: Fast Paced, Bullet Hell Retro Shooter! Shoot down enemies and dodge everything. Fight through 17 intense levels with 6 insane boss fights. Do you have what it takes to beat the game?

name: The Haunting: Blood Water Curse (EARLY ACCESS)
short_description: The Haunting is a first person horror adventure game in where you fight ghosts using a camera and explore the mysteries of The Red Water Woods through cinematic storytelling.

name: Escape from Naraka
short_description: Escape from Naraka is a hellish first-person action platformer. Journey to another realm to save your beloved from an evil demon named Rangda the Leyak Queen and platform your way through a nightmarish temple where each level will challenge you again and again!

name: Brothers in Blood: WW2
short_description: Wage war across some of the most iconic battles in WWII. Featuring exciting cooperative action with up to eight players and a feeling of large scale combat.

name: MYSTIC VR
short_description: MYSTIC VR is a puzzle adventure that finds you in a magical world which is trapped in eternal night. Find the clues and solve the puzzles to open the doors and activate the crystal spheres to bring back the dawn in this calming, family-friendly experience.

name: EF EVE™ - Volumetric Video Platform (VR & Desktop)
short_description: EF EVE™ is a volumetric video platform where you can experience 3D representation of real world. Within seconds you can load “holograms” of people into VR who will share with you their passion for gaming, arts, education or dance and more.

name: Unpossible
short_description: Unpossible will test your skills, your reflexes, and even your memory. It will make you smile. It will probably make you scream. You will die often and it will always be your fault. Fight to learn the obstacles…they already know how to fight you. Relentless. Thrilling. Unpossible!

name: Re: Summon
short_description: Form Contracts with monsters and become The Paragon Summoner!

name: Mustache or Revenge
short_description: Do not let fiend steal your mustaches! It is challenging platformer taking you to the adventure through dangerous dungeons filled with ingenious traps.

name: Spider: Rite of the Shrouded Moon
short_description: You are a spider. Craft webs of your own design to trap insects and leave the mysterious Blackbird Estate covered in cobwebs. This unique blend of action-puzzle gameplay takes you on a dark adventure through an abandoned mansion built by a secret society.

name: Cute Monsters Battle Arena
short_description: Massively addictive turn based strategy RPG with intense action & puzzles.

name: Teke Teke - テケテケ
short_description: Teke Teke - テケテケ is a first-person horror adventure game based on a Japanese myth. The gameplay focuses on storytelling, stealth and decision making, there are also some puzzles for the player to solve, making gameplay more various.

name: Touhou Double Focus
short_description: The Touhou derivative exploration action game Double Focus is now on Steam! Control crow tengu journalist and low-ranking patrol tengu Momiji Inubashiri and explore the world inside a book!

name: Please State Your Name : A VR Animated Film
short_description: Stuck with a broken voice box, a decapitated robot head desperately tries to escape a giant garbage facility.

name: The Juicer
short_description: The game is a cheerful shooter with a user-friendly gameplay in an original setting.

name: fault - milestone one
short_description: fault is a series of Science Fantasy Cinematic Novels using a unique 3D Camera system for a visually immersive reading experience. Follow Selphine, the bubbly Princess and her sharp-witted Royal Guardian, Ritona, on their journey of a lifetime back to their homeland of Rughzenhaide.

name: Fantasy Mosaics 26: Fairytale Garden
short_description: Follow the penguins into the magical world of logic and fairytales!

name: BitShift: BattleGrid
short_description: You have been injected into the BattleGrid. BitShift is a 4-on-4 multiplayer gaming experience where VR gamers compete directly with desktop gamers in a battle to control the data from AntiCorp. PC vs. VR. Drones vs. Runners. Air vs. Ground. Hackers vs. Security. White Hat vs. Black Hat. Mass Hysteria!

name: Mountain Racing
short_description: Mountain Racing is adventurous infinite racing game for everyone.You Will love to play this game again and again.

name: Infinite Space III: Sea of Stars
short_description: Sea of Stars is a starship roguelike, a sandbox adventure game of interstellar exploration and combat. Travel from star to star, upgrade your ship with new systems and weapons, build up your flotilla with allies and mercenaries, and take on a variety of alien menaces.

name: Tkium Exclusion Area
short_description: Tkium Exclusion Area is a short horror escape game which takes place in an asylum. You need to escape the area before the fear takes over you. Find levers, discover systems and solve problems. Will you find the exit in one piece?...

name: Sushi Pachi Panic
short_description: An anime-inspired pachinko game featuring the Sushi Girls and minigames!

name: Invisigun Reloaded
short_description: The ultimate stealth battle adventure where everyone’s invisible! Risk versus reward guides your journey through the full-length single player campaign and local/online multiplayer. Vigilance is key as environmental tells such as footprints and other disturbances will point out careless cadets.

name: Anomaly Defenders
short_description: Anomaly Defenders is the closing installment of the Anomaly series. The original incarnation of the Tower Offense sub-genre had players controlling humans fighting alien invaders. Now, the tables have turned. The human counterattack is underway and the alien homeworld is under threat.

name: Bird Pro Skater
short_description: Bird Pro Skater is an addictive runner game to help people relax. Skate across different countries and perform dangerous stunts on trampolines.

name: Heroes of Dire
short_description: In Heroes of Dire, a new massively-multiplayer tactical role-playing game by Spellbook, players command squads of fighters through strategic turn-based battles to win treasure, fame, and glory for their guilds!

name: Nick Bounty and the Dame with the Blue Chewed Shoe
short_description: From the Writer/Designer that brought you Tales of Monkey Island, Puzzle Agent and Strong Bad's Cool Game for Attractive People comes a comedy noir adventure! Play as the smart-ass detective as he tries to discover who murdered the dame with the blue chewed shoe.

name: Project MALLOW
short_description: As MALLOW, launch yourself through over 100 levels of brutal and punishing puzzle platforming. Reach the end of each level to help MALLOW escape. But not everything is as it seems: earning stars will allow you and MALLOW to venture further into Paragon Confections’ factory, and uncover dangerous secrets…

name: Alien League
short_description: Alien League is a 2 to 4 player local multiplayer party game. Play through 70 fast-paced intense minigames, compete in the Board, earn Totems and fight to become the new Champion!

name: Rebound Raver
short_description: Rebound Raver is a Brick Breaker style game from Retro Twist Games combining elements from the classic Break Out / Arkanoid games with a Pinball twist. Includes banging rave tracks from DJ Yan and audio light/visual FX for that rave club feel.

name: Dishonored 2
short_description: Reprise your role as a supernatural assassin in Dishonored 2. Declared a “masterpiece” by Eurogamer and hailed “a must-play revenge tale” by Game Informer, Dishonored 2 is the follow up to Arkane’s 1st-person action blockbuster & winner of 100+ 'Game of the Year' awards, Dishonored.

name: Zombie City
short_description: Are you ready for the zombie apocalypse? We've done the research and want to make sure you're prepared. Fought to the end. Requires the virtual reality headset.

name: BounceShot
short_description: BounceShot is a Action Puzzle FPS where all shots must be bounced. Position your body and weapon to fire projectiles that bounce around corners, hit switches on ceilings, or strike unsuspecting droids. Race to each level's exit portal in order to get the best time. Scores reward speed and style!

name: Alexander the Great: Secrets of Power
short_description: Unlock the secret of power of Alexander the Great, collect all the artifacts and save the world in this amazing hidden object adventure full of mysteries! Discover 30 unique locations, enjoy over 45 mini-games and dive into the fascinating storyline!

name: Felix Jumpman
short_description: This action platformer takes place on the asteroids of far away worlds. You have to jump from asteroid to asteroid in 30+ mind bending levels in order to get through the level as fast as possible. Normal Game Mode - More that 30 handcrafted levels.

name: Assault Android Cactus+
short_description: Assault Android Cactus is an intense arcade style twin stick shooter - pick from one of nine unique synthetic heroines and blast your way through overwhelming robots hordes to save the ship from its own workforce. Supports single player and local co-op game modes.

name: Pinballer (3D Pinball)
short_description: Pinballer is a 3D physics based pinball simulation game

name: Tantal
short_description: Tantal is a fast-paced match 3 platformer with coin collecting.

name: Destiny of Ancient Kingdoms™
short_description: Destiny of Ancient Kingdoms (DOAK) is a free, action MMORPG based on the legends of Norse Mythology. An epic story-line, action-packed combat and classic multiplayer roleplaying elements await strong warriors who are courageous enough to enter the New World!

name: Wasteland 3
short_description: Following the critically acclaimed 2014 Game of the Year winner Wasteland 2, the RPG series that pioneered the post-apocalyptic genre in video games returns with Wasteland 3.

name: We are definitely the baddies
short_description: A minimalist city builder where only profits matter. Build factories and extract everything before you are forced to leave the planet.

name: Speeder
short_description: Speeder is a game that aims to avoid obstacles. The speed increases with every minute. Break your records. Dynamic music will enhance your experience.

name: 3on3 FreeStyle: Rebound
short_description: 3on3 FreeStyle: Rebound allows players to work with their teammates to pull off rim-shaking slam dunks, awe-inspiring alley-oops, flashy no-look passes, and clutch outside shots which breaks the heart of the opposing team in competitive games filled with the joy and energy of street basketball.

name: Monkey King Simulator -- Chapter Huaguo Mountain
short_description: Stories revised from Journey to the West. Souls-like combats; Powerful Bosses; Hundreds of different Weapon&Armors; Super big map to explore; Nothing special? You cut me!

name: Pesterquest
short_description: Embark on a quest of epic importance in Pesterquest, a grimsical episodic visual novel adventure set in the darkly funny Homestuck / Hiveswap universe. Find all the answers you're looking for as you zap between Earth and Alternia making friends as you go.

name: Legacy of Sin the father sacrifice
short_description: Legacy of Sin the Father Sacrifice is a real-time strategy, survival and route defense game. COMMAND unique troops, CONTROL the battlefield, DEFEND routes from different enemies! Take control of an army of soldiers ! Win to Unlock new Levels and strategy to control the battlefield.

name: C.R.E.E.P.S
short_description: C.R.E.E.P.S is a FPS TOWER DEFENSE game that lets the player deploy squad members and equipment as he defends objectives and defeats horde of enemies.

name: Swamp Jump
short_description: A puzzle game in which you have to collect fruits and berries on dangerous stones that go under water. Collect them all and try not to be trapped!

name: Beauty Agent
short_description: The heroine Ai belongs to a secret agent organization made up of women. Recently, the organization was attacked by evil forces, and a large number of agents were kidnapped. As the core combat member of the organization, Ai went deep into the enemy base alone to rescue his companions.

name: TERRAGEARTH
short_description: In the world suddenly captured by an unknown enemy devouring the surface of the planet and shedding toxic clouds, you are going to operate a unique aircraft assembled by survivors who unwillingly became colonists on their own planet.

name: Kin's Chronicle (Development Halted)
short_description: You are Kin, a slumbering imp awakened by a less-than-stellar Arcanist who wants to fix the damaged world. Use new powers granted to you by new allies to recruit monsters and travel through time.

name: One Thousand Lies
short_description: One day, Ciarán starts receiving enigmatic emails from a mysterious sender, turning his everyday life into a mess of a romantic comedy with psychological themes mixed in. What lies beyond the mystery he's been presented with? In the words of Harry H.: 'If you want to know the truth, go find it'.

name: The Alien Way
short_description: The Alien Way is a high-speed platformer made in 2D pixel art.Jump from platform to platform, bypassing saws and the space abyss. Open all skins with unique characteristics and pump them in a special shop in the main menu.

name: Calm Down, Stalin - VR
short_description: Best Stalin simulator on the Internet is now in VR! Sign important papers, answer phone calls, avoid foreign spies, and don't forget to smoke your pipe to relieve stress in this Stalin simulator!

name: ThroughHelltoHeaven
short_description: Help Amy survive the Vile Demons in Hell in order to find the Portal and Ascend to Heaven.

name: Sir, You Are Being Hunted
short_description: Sir, You Are Being Hunted is a freedom sandbox stealth experience, where each playthrough is unique, thanks to our British Countryside Generator. Escape from these robot-infested islands with violence, trickery and stealth. This brutally funny game is available for Windows, OSX, and Linux.

name: Brickfest
short_description: Brickfest is a colorful spin on the classic genre of brick-buster game where the more chaos that you can maintain in the game, the more you will score.

name: Massive
short_description: 'Massive' is a stylized feast of frantic and action shooter for 1-4 players.

name: PHOGS!
short_description: In PHOGS! you play as a duo of dogs on a captivating, puzzle-filled adventure. Linked by a stretchy belly, you’ll need to bark, bite and bounce your way through obstacles set across the themed worlds of Food, Sleep and Play, in co-op or single-player.

name: Tenrow
short_description: Tenrow is a logic puzzle game. Includes 50 levels.

name: DEATHLOOP
short_description: DEATHLOOP is a next-gen FPS from Arkane Lyon, the award-winning studio behind Dishonored. In DEATHLOOP, two rival assassins are trapped in a mysterious timeloop on the island of Blackreef, doomed to repeat the same day for eternity.

name: Zeliria Sanctuary
short_description: Sense of reality has not yet returned after a teleportation experiment. Purple hamsters, girls with tails, medieval knights - a fantastic world of an alien planet, where you will lead special forces soldier Maxx.

name: Roadclub: League Racing
short_description: Top-down view 2D racing game with realistic handling, online leaderboards, 4-player local split-screen races, a deep career mode where you ascend divisions in the Roadclub League to one day finally challenge the Roadclub Master in an epic Showdown.

name: Dancing in the moonlight
short_description: 'Dancing Under the Moon' is a single-player only 3d bullet-running action game. Enjoy the sensation of being overwhelmed by a barrage of bullets in 3d space.

name: Nights of Azure
short_description: Save the world or the life of one girl... I decide my destiny! The world was once ruled by the Nightｌord. In that world lived a Saint, destined to become a sacrifice to the Nightｌord, and a Holy Knight, with the power to use Servans. Take your Servans and fight accross 'The Land Without Night' for the one you love!

name: Robots In The Wild
short_description: Robots In The Wild is a challenging puzzle/strategy game about creatively dropping Blocks to build Robot fortresses. Travel to distant planets and construct huge, interconnected Robot strongholds to protect and rescue the HEARTS from the Monsters of the Wild.

name: Medieval Shop Simulator
short_description: Shop simulator in a medieval setting. You need to create products for sale, along the way equipping and improving your store and your skills.

name: Adventure Rush
short_description: Get ready for another incredible adventure, face spiders, monsters and goblins in a side scrolling system with Shoot 'Em Up elements and try out numerous equipment with your hero. But beware of the fearsome Dragon!!

name: Skjoldur Story
short_description: In this lighthearted pastoral adventure, explore a vast and whimsical world, confronting dangers in whichever order you choose using nothing but a magical shield.

name: 12 Labours of Hercules XI: Painted Adventure
short_description: Help Emma—the young artist from the 21st century—settle her troubles with Greek gods, prepare Hercules to the contest and save Megara!

name: KamiYaba: Destiny on a Dicey Deadline
short_description: “If you don't tie the knot with the person of your dreams within the next year, you'll be in big trouble.” So forewarns Urara, the self-proclaimed Goddess of Matchmaking... kicking off a rowdy rom-com adventure!

name: Roadworks 2
short_description: City building real time strategy economy simulation game. Manage the resources on the map and build a city connected through road networks of different types of road so that you can meet production targets.

name: Galaxy Warfighter
short_description: Taking its roots from the classic games in the shoot'em up genre, «Galaxy Warfighter» conveys the old ideas in a new way. Piloting your fighter ship, you have to fight hordes of enemies with unpredictable strategies and attack schemes.

name: Time, Space and Matter
short_description: Time, Space and Matter (TSM) is a first-person action adventure focused on puzzle solving through gravity-manipulation. Find out what happened in an advanced-tech facility prior to your arrival and uncover the existence of a mysterious artificial intelligence.

name: ADD
short_description: The fate of the world in one package.

name: EVGA Precision X1
short_description: The next generation of EVGA Precision has arrived with EVGA Precision X1. This software allows you to fine tune your NVIDIA graphics card, maximizing cooling and performance.

name: Zombie Derby: Pixel Survival

short_description: The fifth instalment of the Sakura Succubus series. Hifumi is invited to a European country by its Japanophile princess, Stephania, and she brings Hiroki, Hazel, and Marina along with her. Stephania takes an interest in Hiroki, and a new romance story unfolds.

name: KITBASHERS UNITED
short_description: Bad Dudes are attacking Kitty City. Team Kitty has United to Bash the Bad Dudes. 'KITBASHERS UNITED' is a fantastic 'JRPG inspired' game with a turn-based combat system.

name: Labyrinths of the World: Fool's Gold Collector's Edition
short_description: Can you save your friend before your luck runs out?

name: Citizens: Far Lands
short_description: Citizens is a blend between turn based city builder and a puzzler for strategy masterminds. Build a thriving settlement, extract and process resources and manage your population by catering to their needs, thus allowing you to build bigger and better!

name: Float Night
short_description: Float Night is a small sandbox game that is easy to collect resources, simple to build, no craft, and sustainable.

name: MONKEY KING: HERO IS BACK
short_description: The curtain rises on yet another never-before-seen Chinese myth: a new saga in the Journey to the West! Based on the original CG movie that became an unprecedented box office smash in China, this unique episode will be playable in exciting kungfu action adventure game!

name: Stunt Corgi VR
short_description: You are the parent of one daring corgi that dreams of being the most famous stunt pet in the world! Place your props, build the course and direct your corgi's routine. Call “Action!” to watch the stunt unfold. It won't always go the way you plan, but that's the fun!

name: Steampunk Syndicate
short_description: Steampunk Syndicate is a tower defense with elements of collectible card games.

name: MinigolfPark VR
short_description: Experience VR minigolf on a variety of courses. Play by swinging the club like you would in real life by using motion controllers. Fully supports Oculus Rift and HTC Vive.

name: Super Forklift 3000
short_description: Super Forklift 3000 is an arcade space shooter with a twist: you drive a forklift that carries and shoots up to three boxes. Defeat enemies and bosses while managing your different box types. Be careful not to run out of ammo!

name: Swarm the City: Zombie Evolved
short_description: Swarm the City: Zombie Evolved is a villain protagonist real-time strategy game. You will play as the King of the Dead and rule the world once again by creating zombie legions and destroying human cities. As the King of the Dead, you can infect humans, turn them into zombies and rule the world!

name: Fix Me Fix You
short_description: After losing his girlfriend and his job on the same day one could easily say that Austin Lewis is having a very bad day until a unique opportunity knocks on his door. “Fix Me Fix You” is an uplifting, positive and therapeutic slice of life drama Visual Novel.

name: Nightcrawler VR Bowling
short_description: A bowling game for city slickers who like the night life vibes. Keeps track of your score adding extra points for strikes and spares. Reset at any time.

name: Super Amazing Wagon Adventure
short_description: Super Amazing Wagon Adventure is a fast-paced 2d shooting game with a random story. You control a group of three migrants traveling west along a wagon trail. The game consists of short scenes that are sequenced together in a semi-random way to tell a crazy adventure story.

name: Toadomination
short_description: Toadomination is a rogulite, bullethell, looter shooter game that takes you into an ancient confrontation that lasts more than a decade, in a battle between a toad and a viper. Equip yourself with the most powerful weapon, collect capital and meet face to face with the sworn enemy.

name: BANG! BANG! Totally Accurate Redneck Simulator
short_description: BANG! BANG! Totally Accurate Redneck Simulator is a silly and super tough physics based shooter puzzler in which you attempt to help a drunken redneck hit targets without accidentally shooting himself with a ricochet.

name: Apollo 17 - Moonbuggy VR
short_description: A simulation of the Apollo 17 lunar rover exploration in virtual reality. Realistically recreated to give you a real sense of what it was like to be on the moon and explore these huge distances with the rover.

name: Future Fragments - Command Z
short_description: Future Fragments was developed with support from Jump Into The Light in New York City and was debuted at Cite Internationale des Arts in Paris.

name: Cold Verdict
short_description: Five strangers wake up in a dark room in an abandoned building with no idea who put them there and why. They now need to work together in order to figure out what connects them and how to get out of this place. A short psychological thriller visual novel with choices.

name: Metal Gunner
short_description: Action game without motion sickness even in extreme movements! Battle with various enemy robots and enjoy thrill and action.

name: Time Freeze
short_description: You can freeze time and do things.

name: Learn Programming: Python - Retro
short_description: A terminal-based game for learning and practicing how to program in Python.

name: VRtender
short_description: VRtender is a virtual reality bartending game set in your very own dive bar. You'll make cocktails, pour beers, entertain your patrons, and much more as you take up all the responsibilities of a bartender... without the mess.

name: 40 Winks
short_description: 40 Winks is an action platformer where you control brother and sister, Ruff and Tumble. Your goal is to collect 40 Winks scattered around the world to stop an evil man called Nitekap. Nitekap wants to turn the winks into hood-winks who are responsible for giving children nightmares.

name: Invisible Wings
short_description: Invisible Wings tells the story of Dawn, a young woman of faerie descent, and her quest for answers to her own identity and self-acceptance.

name: DESPOILER
short_description: Brand new Team Objective arena racer from Parallax Labs. Pilot your hovercraft across the desolate wildlands, scavenging the valuable scrap you need to unlock utilities, upgrades, demolish your opponent.

name: Organic Panic
short_description: Organic Panic is a physics based action puzzle platformer. Completely destructible levels, and dynamic reactive liquids! Play as the Organics take on the Meats & Cheese cronies! Over 200 levels!

name: Starveling Way
short_description: Starveling Way is a tactical turn-based game set in a zombie apocalypse

name: Bowl VR
short_description: Bowl VR is a high quality bowling simulation for virtual reality. It has fully featured bowling alleys with accurate physics and ball control, along with local multiplayer that delivers endless hours of fun.

name: FindDark
short_description: findDark is a first person horror game. You have to find a clue to escape from inside the confined space and use that clue to move to the next place. How long it takes or how to find clues is up to you.Uncover all the mysteries that take place in this game and immerse yourself in storytelling.

name: The Road to Hades
short_description: TRTH(The road to hades) is a horror adventure game full of Asian myths and art. Guide the girl safely in the world of the dead. Welcome to a new game you have not experienced.

name: GoNNER
short_description: GoNNER is a tough as hell procedurally-generated 2D platformer with roguelike elements, following the largely misunderstood and altruistic Ikk on a journey to cheer up his only friend in this world - a giant landbound whale named Sally - by searching for just the right trinket in the deep and dark places nearby.

name: The Gurion Mountains
short_description: After one of his friends has an accident, Mark and the group seek help in an isolated mansion, where terrible enemies and dangers await them.

name: Gift to Humanity: Alpha
short_description: GTH is an Action/RPG created by a one-man studio, built from the ground up on player feedback. With a unique blend of strategy and action, experience challenging missions and compete with other players on the local leader board.

name: Hacknet
short_description: Hacknet is an immersive, terminal-based hacking simulator for PC. Dive down a rabbit hoIe as you follow the instructions of a recently deceased hacker, whose death may not have been the accident the media reports.

name: Land Of The Void
short_description: Land Of The Void is Roguelike STG game, combined with dungeon exploration. You need to think about the battle strategy of STG & rune integration, in the meanwhile recruiting teammates, exploring the dungeon to obtain equipment and items, completing tasks and accumulating resources.

name: UNITED COMMAND ®
short_description: UNITED COMMAND is a military base building real time strategy game with a 2 player co-op campaign. Drop into a mission and fight side by side with a friend against the enemy AI. Use your dozer to build out your base and gather resources to fund the construction of your tanks, infantry, and aircraft.

name: Car Dealer
short_description: Buy and sell, manage the world's most popular auto gallery.

name: Save her, from dreams
short_description: Enter the dream, save the one you love.

name: Turk-A-Lurk
short_description: Explore a large open world with 5 unique biomes, 100+ collectables, multiple upgrades to unlock allowing new areas to be accessed. 20+ timed bonus levels to test your skills in. Full original soundtrack. Indie Game! Two ways to play! Story mode Metroidvania OR Bonus mode timed precision platforming!

name: Weather Lord: The Successor's Path
short_description: Rebuild a devastated land, save your people from peril, and face off against an array of bizarre enemies in Weather Lord: The Successor's Path, a captivating time management epic! Play clever and play quick, and victory will be yours!

name: Red Falcon
short_description: A hardcore arcade in retro soviet style. Red Falcon based on a cross between two classic retro games: Invaders and Tetris. Feel the power of soviet technology and destroy non-soviet sectarians heresy, that comes from another universe.

name: The Light Keeps Us Safe
short_description: THE LIGHT KEEPS US SAFE is a procedurally-generated apocalypse in which only The Light can save us. Use stealth and evasion to avoid terrifying machines that patrol the desolate world, and employ the powers of Light to unpick their deadly traps.

name: Dog Adventure
short_description: Dog Adventure is an incredibly challenging side-scrolling game. If you like challenging platformers, then this game is definitely for you. In this game you play as a funny dog ​​that needs to get into its house. Complete all the hardest levels of this game with funny music!

name: Box: The Game
short_description: Box: The Game is a fun puzzle game which will challenge your brain to think in different ways. All cubes attach to each other, your goal is to match the displayed shape to continue to the next level.

name: 100 Days without delays
short_description: In this Match3 game you have to help Lee Milton manage her task to setup a successful new airport - in mere 100 days! Collect three colorful items in a row, upgrade the airport, even help police to solve the crime, and she will become the youngest airport manager in a company’s history!

name: AI Dummy
short_description: Try to get out with all your strength and tell the whole of humanity that you have the same rights as a person and that you have consciousness!

name: Way Far Home
short_description: Join the Hardcore adventure with little Fox. Travel through lands and sky, discover the secret of the Jungle. Overcome the suffering of exhaustion, painfulness, lost in fear. Find true love.

name: Ancient Treasure 法爾斯編年史：上古秘寶
short_description: Falsus Chronicle: Ancient Treasure is a dungeon exploring, Anime style action RPG with Roguelike elements. In this game, dungeon will randomly generate traps, monsters and loots. With our unique “Monster Gem” system, every different choice of classes, weapons, and skill sets effects characters raising multiple possibilities, to fulfil...

name: Vector Elite
short_description: Enter a sci-fi environment where your only objective is to hit all targets around you, using any means at your disposal. Bounce bullets off any surface and plan precision shots. Use portals to cut a doorway into reality itself, making for creative alternatives. Find the best solution for you.

name: 百花三国志(Banner of the THREE KINGDOMS)
short_description: 百花三国志是一款以三国和武侠为题材的战棋游戏。玩家将扮演穿越回二次元的平行三国世界的左慈弟子，和化身为美少女的上百名可以加入队伍的三国武将一起，找出妄图颠覆三国世界的幕后神秘人。三国名将们除了拥有专属的主动武将技外，关系亲密的武将同时出场战斗还会产生联动效果。

name: Northern Tale 2
short_description: After the evil witch Gesta was defeated, the time of peace was restored. The viking king Ragnar decides to restore the kingdom in its former glory — repair the ruined villages, heal the cursed trees. However, Gesta is still alive, and the even greater evil is threatening the vikings.

name: Bricks In The Box
short_description: Bricks In The Box is an arcade game inspired by the breakout title, in contrast to the classic version, the game takes place on boards of various shapes - hexagon, triangle, pentagon - the slat and hole is in the middle of the level. The player's task is to break down as many boxes as possible and to beat his own and global records.

name: Choice of the Petal Throne
short_description: In the Empire of the Petal Throne™, will you find glory, or a knife in your back? A world where South American, Middle Eastern, and Indian cultures collide!

name: Unborne
short_description: Unborne is a blend of the Mystery, Puzzle, and Horror genres, with a non-linear experience that lets you explore however you wish. Discover clues and examine your environment to piece together the lives of the family who have disappeared from their home.

name: World Up
short_description: Build up your level by gathering resources and buying upgrades

name: Spells 'n' Stuff
short_description: Spells 'n' stuff is a magic arena FPS built exclusively for VR. Battle your opponents with spells fired from your trusty wand that never leaves your side. Propel yourself into battle with your wands flying ability, or POOF yourself around fast with magic potions!

name: Slabs
short_description: Looking for something that will help kill time? The game 'Slabs' is an excellent option. Operate the slabs by clicking with only the left mouse button. Try to make the highest tower out of them.

name: STAR WARS™ Galactic Battlegrounds Saga
short_description: Lead the great armies of the Star Wars™ Episode II: Attack of the Clones saga in intense real-time strategy clashes. Enter the fray as the Galactic Empire, Rebel Alliance, Wookies, Trade Federation, Gungans or Royal Naboo to determine the course of the Galactic Civil War.

name: Caelus Trident
short_description: Caelus Trident is the debut game from Fractured Rogue Studios LLC. Paying homage to the classic arcade shooters, you take on the role of the last ship of your armada trying to survive wave after wave of addictive space combat action.

name: DRAGON QUEST HEROES™ II
short_description: DRAGON QUEST HEROES II is a hack-and-slash Action RPG that sends you on a new adventure to restore order to a once peaceful world filled with monsters and battles of epic proportions. Up to 4 players can play in cooperative multiplayer to defeat an unknown threat looming over the Seven Realms!

name: Money Makes Money
short_description: MMM turns a lifetime of investing decisions into a concise 2-3 hour computer game. Go on a Year by Year financial journey,

name: Alien Frontline
short_description: This is a casual game, the player has five fighters to choose, Each fighter has exclusive perk, There are five fighters, Fire, Shield, Boom, Wingman, Bug. Unlocked by game currency.

name: One Day for Revenge
short_description: One Day for Revenge - bloody indie shooter with a view from above.A beautiful morning, fresh air, a trip to the maternity home, it would seem, did not foretell any ills. But fate has its own plans.

name: Cinnamon fight
short_description: Cinnamon fight is a multiplayer game, where you can fight up to three enemies. They can be your friends or random people. This game consists of more than 500 levels, more than 40 weapons and lots of obstacles which are going to have masive impact on your gameplay strategy

name: Baldi's Basics Plus
short_description: Baldi's Basics Plus is like the original game, but PLUS! The same cruddy edutainment horror type parody theme is back, but with hugely expanded gameplay features, including procedurally generated levels, field trip minigames, crazy random events, PLUS more characters, more items, and more chaos!

name: Lupus in Fabula
short_description: Lupus in Fabula is an adventure game with lite puzzle elements set in medieval/Renaissance world. The game follows two characters, controlled one at a time, caught in Flemish Renaissance mixed with glitched medieval times as a result of failed magickal transport.

name: Brainfuck
short_description: Brainfuck is a guide and a highly-interactive simulator of the smallest complete programming language in the world. Master all of its 8 commands to program with capabilities equivalent to those of codes written in any other modern language.

name: Windscape
short_description: In Windscape you play as a young girl living on your parents’ farm, set in a lovely world made up of floating islands in the sky. As you discover the world you learn that something has gone terribly wrong - islands are breaking apart and falling from the sky!

name: Perfect Jump
short_description: This is a relaxing casual game, you need to operate the character to keep jumping to get points

name: Orwell: Keeping an Eye On You
short_description: Big Brother has arrived - and it’s you. Investigate the lives of citizens to find those responsible for a series of terror attacks. Information from the internet, personal communications and private files are all accessible to you. But, be warned, the information you supply will have consequences.

name: Odd One Out
short_description: Find the symbol that is different from the others, in progressively harder puzzles.

name: Tales From The Cache
short_description: Dive into the exciting world of treasure hunting. Challenge yourself to find secret locations, solve challenging puzzles and explore abandoned places. Watch out for traps!

name: Funklift
short_description: Wreck your friends in a wild race for logistical glory! Deliver the most items before time runs out in the ultimate forklifting party experience. Reinventing musical party games as we know them. Who will become the champion of the storage?

name: Fruit Factory
short_description: A silly physics-based puzzle game about sorting fruit with industrial machines!

name: Prison Run and Gun
short_description: The recent events in a state prison, involving Jake from Team Hot Guns was a perfect moment for some prisoners to escape - you are one of them.

name: MyDockFinder
short_description: MyDockFinder is a software for quick system startup and control viewing system functions. You can drag and drop to add your favorite programs or files, and drag and drop to directly use the program to open the file. Based on WinUI using GPU rendering, smooth animation effects.

name: Ordo Et Chao: New World
short_description: Inspired by famed series like 'The Settlers', 'Battle for Middle-Earth', 'Anno' and 'Age of Empires', Ordo Et Chao is a solo-player strategy game combining elements of real time strategy, resource management and city building.

name: Sleeping Dawn
short_description: Join into this confusing procedural maze. Lose yourself... is the only way to get out. Sleeping Dawn is a survival horror cooperative game up to 4 players. Join your friends, cooperate with them, make quick choices and... RUN. What really matters is not falling asleep: it's your last chance.

name: Erroneous
short_description: Join the Battle with your Friends in this futuristic First-Person Shooter with Team Deathmatch, Free-for-all, King of the Hill, and more!

name: EQI
short_description: EQI is a trippy first-person arcade game with spatial puzzles, and a synthwave soul. You find yourself in a digital world that twists and changes around you, challenging your senses, focus, and reflexes. Interface with the great mystery and transcend.

name: The Jackbox Party Pack 7
short_description: Five new games: the hit threequel Quiplash 3, the collaborative chaos of The Devils and the Details, the fierce drawing game Champ’d Up, the speech game Talking Points and the guessing game Blather 'Round. Use phones or tablets as controllers and play with up to 8 players, and an audience of 10,000!

name: Santa Monica Paradise
short_description: “Santa Monica Paradise” is a romantic comedy visual novel and dating sim set in sunny Santa Monica. Play as a famous chef visiting California and meeting new people.

name: Dead6hot
short_description: Fast-paced shooting in a frantic atmosphere! Pick-up-and-play, like the good old days! Local multiplayer!

name: LYNE
short_description: Deceptively simple. Infinitely complex. LYNE is a minimalist puzzle game that will knot your brain as it calms your soul. Connect the shapes. Fill the board. Lose yourself in the interflowing paths of LYNE.

name: The Hero with a Thousand Arms / 千手英雄
short_description: This game challenge you to play many mini games in one screen at the same time.

name: ABD: A Beautiful Day
short_description: ABD: A Beautiful Day is an MMORTSS (Massively Multiplayer Online Real Time Survival Strategy) that spans from 100,000 B.C.E. to 245 B.C.E.. Play ABD in a 24 hour, 7 days a week continuous environment to build your civilization, play with friends, and battle exposure in the process.

name: Extreme School Driving Simulator
short_description: This game has the role to simulate real situations and have as aims to prepare future drivers not only in a virtual world but also for the real world!

name: Darkness Assault
short_description: The number of missing in the city increased. People talk about the experiments on human beings. And now, only you can figure out if it was true. Especially because you have no choice. Mysteriously, you find yourself in a terrible location 40 meters underground. Your name is Katrine, and you do not remember anything about your past.

name: Fighters Wizards
short_description: Challenge your friends or other members of the multiplayer community on the game Fighters wizards. It's a little PVP game where you play as little wizards who are ready to fight to find out who's the best of them

name: Fishy
short_description: Fishy is a 3D platormer. you play as a fish very far from home . traveling trough 5 worlds such as a jungle oasis to under water to the frozen tundra to inside a volcano to lastly to outer space

name: Contact : Last Defence
short_description: Contact : Last Defence is a VR space action shooter. Complete missions, protect your planet and upgrade your ship. When you are done defending, take the fight to the invaders in Arcade mode and compete for a top spot on the online leaderboard!

name: Super Frog's Quest
short_description: Classic 2D platforming action with a delicious twist! Travel through nine different levels, each with their own unique challenge and style. Gobble up your enemies and use their own abilities against them. Fight your way to the alien menace and rescue the tadpoles in Super Frog's Quest!

name: SpellFront
short_description: SpellFront is a single-player first person shooter that takes place in the world of a medieval fantasy, experiencing the attack of the aliens. The player assumes role of an ancient sorcerer who must find a way to defeat invaders with only her might and her magic.

name: Island Town Zombie Paradise
short_description: Island Town is a one man made project that was created as a learning experience for game development. The game features 4 weapons, 6 cars, 3 dimensions of the same map, two dimensions with over 200 zombies throughout the map, and one daytime dimension with no zombies to explore.

name: Goblin Takes No Argument[s]
short_description: In this retro style tower defence, we have created a short experience for all of you seeking a true Atari-like experience. This is off cause bull___. This was a school project completely made with Python and Pygames. Be sure to give us a grade;)

name: FOREWARNED
short_description: FOREWARNED is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror. Delve deep into ancient Egyptian ruins with your team of fellow archaeologists. Investigate phenomena, collect treasure, discover lore, survive danger, and banish the evil that lurks within.

name: Rampage Miami
short_description: Find yourself diving into a retro-futuristic city infested with bad guys!

name: Benji Challenges
short_description: Benji Challenges is a fun and casual platformer where you control the monkey Benji, swinging from vine to vine. Features gorgeous graphics, intuitive control mechanics and 50 hand-crafted levels of challenging gameplay!

name: Eliminate Drips - 消灭水滴
short_description: A brainstorming game relax you .

name: The Farmer's Story of Slow Life
short_description: The sisters inherited the ranch and the mountains from their father's estate. But the island is no longer vibrant. You set out to rebuild the ranch and the town. When you have gathered enough assets, you can visit remote islands far away. You will surely find unknown items waiting for you.

name: Tahul
short_description: Tahul is a virtual reality experience based around a fictional lost world reminiscent of ancient, Moroccan culture and was created to highlight the winners of the SIGGRAPH 2020 VR Theater.

name: DON'T touch the walls
short_description: In a world where over fishing, coral bleaching and walls have stripped the world's oceans of 99% of marine life, one lone fish makes it his sole mission to swim through the spike ball and wall infested waters to attempt to find another fish to breed with to keep his population going.

name: Ramify
short_description: A single screen isometric puzzle game with over 100 levels.

name: Dungeon Tactics
short_description: A retro style party based RPG smashing together concepts from several of my favorite games! Build a party of 6 characters combining active, passive, and reactive skills from 40 different classes. Avoid many traps: fire, lightning, arrows, cannons, elemental whirlwinds, bubble guns, and more!

name: WirtschaftsWoche Virtual Reality
short_description: Virtual Reality Simulation Experience in Virtual Reality how an electric car is created, or save a person's life in the hospital of the future.

name: She is mad : Pay your demon
short_description: A horror defence adventure set in the 80's in which black magic to save a daughter has gone wrong

name: Ionball 3
short_description: Hack programs and wipe out viruses in cyberspace. Retro arcade gameplay merged with fun new mechanics. Original synthwave score by Tim Moffet.

name: MAVR3D 八般武艺
short_description: Martial Arts VR 3D (Immersive Duel, Cultural Treasure Demonstration) MAJOR UPGRADE Boss TacticalSim. Inch-longer the stronger! Inch-shorter the deadlier! Duel your Foe (or friend), Arena players, or Boss femme fatales using different pairings of Eight Martial Arts. Real-Time Strategy Action Slasher

name: VZX Player
short_description: Visualize your music!

name: Nienix: Cosmic Warfare
short_description: Search for the legendary lost artifact Nienix through galaxies in conflict! An open world physics-based online multiplayer action RPG.

name: Ender Story: Chapter 1
short_description: Ender Story: Chapter 1 is a turn-based RPG inspired by early Final Fantasy and Dragon Quest games. As a young border guard you must rush to defend your kingdom from an immediate threat. Travel fast, aid citizens and fight hard.

name: Ant Queen
short_description: Begin a journey like no other, become the Ant Queen and establish your empire. Ant Queen is a simulation game where you breed different types of ants to ultimately conquer your surroundings and achieve a stable ant colony.

name: Colony Ship: A Post-Earth Role Playing Game
short_description: Colony Ship is a turn-based, party-based role-playing game set aboard a generation ship launched to Proxima Centauri. The game features a detailed skill-based character system, multiple ways to handle quests, choices & consequences, and branching dialogue trees.

name: Alcatraz Builder
short_description: Take part in building the monument that made Alcatraz Island a household name!

name: Farm Tribe 2
short_description: Help Annie build a farm and prepare for her wedding!

name: BALAN WONDERWORLD
short_description: Welcome to BALAN WONDERWORLD—a wondrous all-action show, the likes of which has never been seen before! Over 80 different costumes give you all the action that you could possibly imagine!

name: ANIME TETRIS
short_description: The legendary game 'Tetris' in a unique performance and atmosphere

name: 恋~一些小清新的猎奇故事~
short_description: Some Scary Love Stories is a visual novel game with option branches Players tap the screen to read the story and make their own choices, eventually leading to different ending branches A collection of long-updated short stories on the theme of 'Distorted Love'

name: Splash Fly Fire
short_description: Flappy Fly Fire is a game in which you need to control fire. The game ends when the fire touches the dynamite and everything explodes.

name: Spacewing War
short_description: Blast off for a retro shoot’em up experience filled with clever twists and secrets!

name: Rooms: The Main Building
short_description: Use object inside rooms and move the rooms to escape. 100 challenging sliding puzzles with a twist! The solution is only a doorstep away!

name: Aries
short_description: Space strategy gaming reimagined. Dive into fast-paced real-time planetary battles against the backdrop of a turn-based campaign that sees you build your empire in the stars. With hundreds of troops and ships at your command, can you forge an empire that lasts?

name: Sanctuary VR (Also contains non-VR version)
short_description: 'Sanctuary VR' is a first-person puzzle solving and exploration game designed for Oculus Rift, it has a strong narrative that is fully voice acted. The game is a seated VR experience played with a controller.

name: Hordiaz
short_description: Hordiaz is a combination of survival, simulator and role-playing. Explore the magical lands of Solinia, surrounded by dangers, adventures, secrets and deities.

name: Emily is Away
short_description: Emily is Away is an interactive story. Create a screenname and choose your path through the branching narrative.

name: DESOLATE: Clone Catastrophe
short_description: You play as Chrome: one of the three robots which resides in an old factory. With the help of Alder, communicating from the factory's computer system, travel across the wasteland while you take on an army of invading robotic clones and other threats along the way.

name: Harmonium
short_description: Discover the story of this point’n click and lead your town towards a better future! You’ll guide the town of Harmonium Point to a yet unbuilt future after a great war that ravaged the world. React to numerous events that punctuate the life of this town and build relationships with the other citizens!

name: Boom!VR
short_description: Dance the night away on the Boom!VR festival. We prepared a unique VR festival site for you to go crazy on the dance floor or just hang out and enjoy the music.

name: Meow Pow
short_description: Meow Pow is an energetic, high-speed sports-ish game. With easy-to-understand controls and fluid, physics-driven movement, players dart around the arena as cats, slapping everything in sight. 1 - 4 players local matches, players can go up against the AI, friends, or both. name: Strategic Mind: Spectre of Communism
short_description: Strategic Mind: Spectre of Communism is a (hi)story-driven turn-based strategy set in the WW2 period. It offers refined wargame mechanics, story-rich gameplay, and modern 3D graphics. Lead the USSR Armed forces staging the world Communist revolution. For Stalin! For the Motherland!

name: OS:Memories
short_description: You were just the owner of an office, but something piqued your curiosity. Understand what happened to Andy by browsing through his most personal archives and memories. OS: Memories is a short and engaging storyline about the everyday life of a game developer.

name: Art your brains
short_description: Art your brains - a puzzle game in which you have to play as a mysterious man who doesn't understand how and where he ended up. A painted world with the same drawn allies and enemies. Spend your free time mastering interesting mechanics, fighting and passing unique levels.

name: Newton Going Home
short_description: Newton the kitten went to travel with its owner to an island and when it was time to leave... Where's Newton? He went to explore the island and got lost! Can you swap the hex tiles to help him get back home? Help Newton the kitten in this cute and pleasant experience.

name: EEP 15

From banks to apartments to construction sites, Wally will traverse a variety of diverse environments in order to save his family.

name: The Deep Diving of FloodDragon

name: Jacob

name: TUNIC
short_description: Explore a land filled with lost legends, ancient powers, and ferocious monsters in TUNIC, an isometric action game about a small fox on a big adventure.

In the sprawling 3D world of a Mainframe, Recompile features intense combat, tight 3D platforming, super-powered abilities and an environmental logic-based hacking mechanic.

name: Vermillion Watch: Parisian Pursuit Collector's Edition
short_description: Can you stop a powerful foe from taking over Paris?

name: The Dame Was Loaded

name: Lifeless Planet Premier Edition

name: Picross Floof

name: Pocket Watch
short_description: A time-traveling adventure game on a tropical island. 🌴⛱️ Talk to animals, solve puzzles, and save the island from destruction . . .

name: Kukumushi Virtual Pet
short_description: Adopt and care for your Kukumushi, watching them grow and evolve. Feed, clean and play with your virtual pets!

name: Luciform
short_description: Luciform is a color-based precision platformer that demands quick reflexes and nerves of steel. Can you help “Luci” navigate a dangerous forest to save its people from the nasty Red-Eyed Gorilla?

name: Riddle Girl
short_description: Any girl is a riddle - solve each one.

name: Exit From
short_description: You wake up from the noise of thunderstorms, no one there. You are trying to get out and realize that after all you are not alone here... Сan You Exit From?

name: Swingin Swiggins
short_description: Swingin Swiggins is a side-scrolling platformer that will take you on an adventure through many exotic locations. The game focuses on swinging but you must be careful that you don't run out of stamina or you can fall off the rope mid swing.

name: Data Defense
short_description: Defend your data servers from viral corruption in Data Defense - a minimalist tower defense set in cyberspace.

name: Tentacle Girl
short_description: Aoi and Sally, a treasure hunter, found a cave during the expedition. They foresee a treasure in it. So I decided to go in and take a look. Unexpectedly, this is a tentacled cave.

name: The Last From Mars
short_description: An intergalactic fleet invades Earth and you must fight for your life. The Last From Mars is an endless VR shooter, and the foes will be coming from everywhere. Begin the game with a mighty laser gun, the ability to teleport, and slow time. Fight enemies, get ‘orbs’ and upgrade your weapon.

name: Castle: Never Judge a Book by its Cover
short_description: A hidden object mystery that will immerse casual players into the thrilling exploits of famous mystery novelist Richard Castle and Detective Kate Beckett.

name: Knock Harder
short_description: The only way to wake up is to die. The player must decide for himself whether he is inside a dream or is in reality.

name: Apollo 11 VR
short_description: Apollo 11 VR is the story of the greatest journey ever taken by humankind. This VR experience is a recreation of the events which took place between July 16th and July 24th 1969. Now for the first time ever you get to experience this historic event through the eyes of those who lived through it.

name: Island Marauder
short_description: Indie Puzzle Game

short_description: With some special reasons, Tang Sheng, a human being, fell into a world of monsters between the underworld and the human world. At the same time, he found that he had lost his memory. He learned that he had to find all the ' belongings ' when he fell down to return to the world.

name: polyemisokos
short_description: An abstract puzzle game about connections.

name: The Brookhaven Experiment
short_description: Brookhaven is a VR survival shooter for the HTC Vive. Players will have to use the weapons and tools provided to survive ever more terrifying waves of horrific monsters in an attempt to figure out what caused the beginning of the end of the world, and, if they're strong enough, stop it from happening.

name: Feral Fury
short_description: Fast-paced twin stick shooter rogue-lite action

name: Skyway
short_description: Skyway is a third person puzzle-platformer set in an abstract universe! Jump, Climb, and Dash your way through an increasingly difficult fortress in the sky! Solve the puzzles, score the fastest time, and challenge yourself to master the controls!

name: PolyCore Defense
short_description: PolyCore Defense is a tower defense game where you have to raise your defenses in order to defend your core. Build unique turrets, upgrade them with special effects and use abilities to survive waves of enemies that are trying to destroy your core!

name: bit Dungeon+
short_description: bit Dungeon+ is a two player action roguelike endless adventure.You and your loved one were captured by demons! You have been trapped in a dungeon for a thousand years asleep… You wake up trapped in cell, grab your weapon and let the quest to find her soul begin!

name: Drunk or Dead
short_description: Drunk or Dead is a fun party game. A virus has turned all sober people into zombies. Go bar hopping in the midst of the apocalypse! Drink in the company of survivors and finish off hordes of zombies! Set your own record!

name: No Hope
short_description: No Hope is a survival horror game based on the classics of the genre. You are a teenager and you must survive the darkness that has fallen over the city. There are terrible monster along the way, few resources, locked doors and some scares.

name: AccrO
short_description: AccrO is a Full Acrobatic Quadcopter Simulator, with realistic flight behavior and complex physics simulation. A training tool for freestyle drone enthusiasts.

name: BASMENT DWELLERS
short_description: BASMENT DWELLERS is an epic, procedurally generated, next-generation CRPG about killing monsters and stealing their treasure.

name: Deadly Night - No Escape
short_description: Find your way out of the most horrifying forest in this eventful story, packed with adventures and the ultimate horror that you never faced before.

name: Off the Record: The Final Interview Collector's Edition
short_description: A man is dying, and you’re the prime suspect!

name: ROTA
short_description: ROTA is a gravity bending puzzle platforming adventure! Walk over the edge to rotate your gravity. Push, pull and rotate gravity-blocks to traverse the stage and solve puzzles. Collect all 50 gems and explore 8 vibrant worlds!

name: NeuroVoider
short_description: NeuroVoider is a twin-stick shooter RPG set in a cyber futuristic world about brains shooting around evil robots with nuclear rocket launchers. Battle through the horde of vigilant robots, boost your character with the smoking remains of your victims, and defeat the master NeuroVoider.

name: Zombeer
short_description: In the near (and some might say, lucky) future, there is a pandemic transforming the world’s population into zombies. That’s not the lucky part – it’s this: Once bitten by a zombie, the only way to stave off the infection is drinking beer!

name: Dream Golf VR
short_description: Looking for a mini golf experience that'll remind you of the real thing? Look no further!!! Download FREE today!

name: Shiperoids
short_description: Shiperoids is a 2D space shooter inspired by the vector based arcade classics from the 80's. How long can you survive?

name: It Moves
short_description: It Moves is a horror game that will try to scare you without too many of the typical 'screamers', instead relying on atmosphere and suspense. You'll be solving puzzles along the way, and encountering all manner of not-so-friendly creatures.

name: ELEA
short_description: Experience the surreal story of Elea. In this first-person Sci-Fi adventure you play as a space scientist recovering your lost husband. Venture out on a curious interstellar journey, full of devastating memories and startling secrets.

name: Lady in Mystery
short_description: Welcome to the detective agency in old Seoul. This visual novel provides unique mystery and lesbian romance. Players can choose which one of 4 female characters will be the closest to the main character, 'Heesoo.' Some of your choices might lead you to a dark and dangerous path.

name: Dreamblaster
short_description: Think Asteroids on...blasteroids? It's an oldschool, multi-directional shooter with attitude!

name: Hidden Magic Town
short_description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

name: Eleven Eleven
short_description: Their fate has been decided, but how you watch is up to you. Eleven Eleven is a groundbreaking entertainment experience that puts you in the center of the story. Follow six main characters as they count down the last 11 minutes and 11 seconds of life on the island planet of Kairos Linea.

name: Super Duper Party Pooper
short_description: Created by solo developer Nikola Kostic - Have you ever wanted to poop on party goers but were too socially awkward to just go for it? Well, Super Duper Party Pooper is about to change all that, the player will find themselves in the middle of a raw human story of existential panic.

name: Avalanches
short_description: A cold top-down avalanches survival game. Can you sustain avalanches? You must survive to find a way to escape avalanche valley. Or live there, its up to you!

name: Eets Munchies
short_description: A beautiful puzzle game for the whole family!Eets Munchies is a reimagining of the award-winning puzzle game by Klei Entertainment. Featuring gorgeous animation and ridiculous creatures, players help an adorable hungry creature devour cake in increasingly devious puzzles.

name: The Breach: A VR Escape Game
short_description: The Breach is a Virtual Reality Escape Game set in a futuristic and mysterious atmosphere. Solve a short yet intense and challenging enigma, taking place in an immersive world with a puzzling ambiance. Will you be able to overcome an environment collapsing before your eyes?

name: Nephise
short_description: Nephise is a short and atmospheric puzzle game with narration. It is a relaxing and mysterious experience especially with the help of its music.

name: PLACEFRONT
short_description: PLACEFRONT is a dual tank combat simulator and stylized city builder. Create tank armies, drive individual tanks and fight to the death in 9 unique levels, or dive into build mode and drive vehicles, explore diverse biomes, and place down over 150 buildings and objects.

name: Dies irae ~Interview with Kaziklu Bey~
short_description: The world of Dies irae returns with an all-new side story based around LDO member Wilhelm Ehrenburg. The subject of an interview in a dusty bar, the legendary 'Kaziklu Bey' recounts the tale of a conflict he suffered long in the past...

name: Chaos Chain
short_description: Chaos Chain is a dark cyberpunk roleplaying game set in a bleak dystopian future. Assume the role of a desperate dweller of Slade City, a sprawling urban nightmare of grimy asphalt and broken dreams where crime and disorder run rampant. - Stay Alert. Stay Armed. Stay Alive. Don't lose your humanity.

name: HyperPortals
short_description: Read the text, answer questions, control the beam of light rushing through the void, collect parts of the story - 'Hyper Portals' offers a journey into several dimensions at once.

name: Defenders of Time
short_description: Set in an alternative universe where the fabric of time must be protected, Defenders of Time is a fast-paced tower defense game for up to eight players. Players must strategically place towers in order to stop wave after wave of alien foes who are seeking to destroy our Time Beacons.

name: The Virus
short_description: Play as a White Blood Cell whose home has been invaded by viruses. Your job is to protect the red blood cells by collecting them. Navigate through a variety of challenging levels, collecting all of the red blood cells and avoiding the viruses in hopes to rid your home of The Virus.

name: Gloomhaven
short_description: Whether you are drawn to Gloomhaven by the call of adventure or by an avid desire for gold glimmering in the dark, your fate will surely be the same. Gloomhaven, the digital adaptation of the acclaimed board game, mixes Tactical-RPG and dungeon-crawling.

name: PlanTechtor

name: Ultimate Fishing Simulator VR
short_description: Bored of waiting for a bite? Would you like to catch some fish? You're lucky - in Ultimate Fishing Simulator, fish bite like crazy! Spinning, float fishing, ground fishing and more! Now you can feel it on your own by playing it on VR!

name: Space Panic Arena
short_description: Fight to survive in extraterrestrial environments while scavenging weapons and ammo. Defeat waves of enemies to earn money in order to upgrade your weapons in Horde Mode.

The game takes you to the good old days and you will experience the charming farming of the 60's and 70's. Fans of nostalgia and history will be glad to work with original designed machines and to till a field with well known Old-timer Tractors.
