name: Audioshield
short_description: Block the beats! Audioshield puts you at the point of impact for every hit in your songs. Block incoming orbs with your shields and feel the music. Works with any song!

name: Spellarium 8 Match 3 Puzzle
short_description: That's not your regular Match3 game! It is a Match3 Puzzle. Part 8 has a new bonus game and a new gameplay you won't see in other Match 3 games.

name: Legends of Talia: Arcadia
short_description: The story of a legendary female knight, Arcadia, who discovers there are penalties to pay when a hero can’t save everyone.

name: Starship Clicker
short_description: A science fiction clicker with an arcade twist.

name: Train Station Renovation - First Job
short_description: Welcome to the prologue to Train Station Renovation. This is where you will learn and teach how to renovate these small and the largest train stations in the world.

name: Colonies
short_description: Build your own colony and defend it with a powerful army of tanks, defensive towers, and different sized mechs on alien planets!

name: Tanks With Hands: Armed and Treaded
short_description: Rev up your engine and challenge your friends to an all-out melee! Whack your opponents with a vast array of weapons and survive deadly stage hazards. Perfect for parties and get-togethers! May the best tank-man win!

name: Space Struck Run
short_description: Space Struck Run is a small game where you take control of Dectron The Cyborg, where you have to do your best to survive in outer space while the difficulty keeps rising.

name: At Dead Of Night
short_description: At Dead Of Night is part horror film, part horror game and part ghost hunt. It blends live-action and graphics to create a unique immersive horror experience like no other. Steam Deck version now available (yet to be Steam reviewed - current review is for the non-optimised game).

name: VARIABLE PICTOGRAM JUMP
short_description: An instant death action game with flying pictographs. Use jumping and zooming in and out to reach your goal! In addition to the single mode, there is also a mode that allows up to four players to compete.

name: Terra Incognito - Antarctica 1911
short_description: Survive all the odds and reach the South Pole before your competitors with this simple, abstract and compelling strategy game.

name: Farm Under Fire
short_description: Farm Under Fire is an online multiplayer 3rd person shooter, with old-school vibe and heavy metal music running in the background! The Devil has come down to Earth to begin mighty FARMING! He possessed the pigs, and now they wreck havoc around the world!

name: Nebula Invasion
short_description: Nebula Invasion was designed for those who enjoy the classic type arcade games, a spaceship shooter with great gameplay. Aliens attack many different ways from marching to dive bombing. You have the tools to fight back with a ship that can power-up with double, triple, rapid fire, or plasma cannon.

name: Edge Run
short_description: You have to go through an amazing test, the outcome of which will decide your whole future life. However, not everything is as simple as it seems.

name: Exertus
short_description: Through use of the fluid movement set and dynamic level elements, players have the simple aim of getting from point A to point B, either by using the beaten path or the off-path environment within semi-linear levels.

name: Hyper Bit Chasm
short_description: Hyper Bit Chasm is an epic adventure game filled with fast paced action every step of the way. Embark down a deep and treacherous chasm utilizing a brilliant 8-bit retro aesthetic!

name: TinShift
short_description: Delve into the world of the future, where everyone is out for himself in the humans vs robots stand-off. Pick a traceur, loot an awesome gun, and beat damn machines. Or choose a robot and use his unique skills to get back at those humans for your Boston brothers.

name: THE MONSTER OF MEMORY:DESTINY
short_description: Winning the 8th Golden Manga Award in Taiwan, 'THE MONSTER OF MEMORY:DESTINY' has been adapted from the manga of the same name! Memory... Does it represent all a person has? Represented in the form of a visual novel, the ultimate in brotherly love...

name: Bibi Blocksberg ™ - Big Broom Race 3
short_description: This is only just the beginning of a wild witch rally: Bibi and her friends saddle their broomsticks and set off to discover exciting worlds. Using secret witchcraft potions and daredevil flight manoeuvres they travel back to the age of dinosaurs, the Orient and Transylvania. Wit-Wit, off you go!

name: Poltergeist Treasure
short_description: Poltergeist Treasure is an absurdist comedy point & click adventure game following Sir Typhil of Creulor as he attempts to escape a haunted forest.

name: Snapshot VR
short_description: Snapshot is a VR arena shooter built for e-sports with competitive solo and team play. Inspired by the real-life sport, Snapshot feels like playing paintball in the future. One shot, one kill. In competitive teams of up to 5, communication and coordination are the keys to victory.

name: The Last Escape of Yeti
short_description: Yeti living in the forests of Karelia was kidnapped by the evil oligarch Ivan Ivanov.... Now he has to win in an unequal battle local mafia and corrupt police officers. To do this, he needs to go through the streets of the city filled with dangers.

name: Super Slinger
short_description: Super Slinger is a cute and funny pixelated arcade-like shooter where you fight against the alien invasion in an attempt to send them back home. Cute art, juicy gameplay, difficult stages, and SLINGSHOTS!

name: Military Crusaders
short_description: Build your military state, create an army, lead your crusade and crush the enemy

name: Memorize Cards
short_description: This is a little game in the genre of paired images for memory.

name: Only After
short_description: After a teenage girl goes missing, psychiatrist Judy Williams and detective Michael Grady try to piece together the strange circumstances of her disappearance. Their only clue is David, Julie's boyfriend, who's been found in a nearby forest.

name: Jotun: Valhalla Edition
short_description: Jotun is a hand-drawn action-exploration game set in Norse mythology. In Jotun, you play Thora, a Viking warrior who died an inglorious death and must prove herself to the Gods to enter Valhalla. Impress the Gods!

name: SOOT
short_description: SOOT is a Simulation and Strategy game where you control the terraforming crew of the Ziggurat, a roaming space station that orbits small planets and exploits their resources. Follow Captain Christopher Mason and Lieutenant Ferdinand McCann as they (and you) master the craft of terraforming.

name: Only One Burn
short_description: Land the craft without crashing. Oh, and you only get one burn!

name: Feast Your Eyes
short_description: A surreal and quiet horror tale about a murderous little marshmallow who's escaped death row. A mysterious plague that makes people stare at dirt... Creepy love letters trying to win your affection... You may have closed your eyes, but now it's time to feast.

name: Umbraseal
short_description: All enemy shoot bullets like crazy! 《Umbraseal》is a bullet-hell dungeon crawler top-down shooter. Fight your way through ever-changing dungeons by shadow ability and unique bullet.

name: Lunacid
short_description: Lunacid is a first person dungeon crawler inspired by old FROMSOFT games like Shadow Tower and King’s Field.

name: MAZE: A VR Adventure
short_description: 'MAZE: A VR Adventure' is a roguelite horror game. Lose yourself into the darkness of a procedurally generated maze. Rely on your sense of direction and your magical skills to get out alive. Two types of locomotion systems available to meet the player's needs. HTC Vive or Oculus Rift are required.

name: Slide Ride Arcade
short_description: Fun word arcade game where you have to spell the words out of sliding letters. Use the power-ups or get busted. Casual and friendly entertainment featuring 4 game modes. The challenge for whole family is ON!

name: Falcon
short_description: When you climb into the cockpit of the F-16 Fighting Falcon, get set for the 'flight of your life' as the powerful FALCON F-16 takes you streaking across the sky at Mach 2.

name: Tales of Fire
short_description: Tales of Fire is a short story-driven game, embark on an adventure to bring fire to your ant village or else they all die to the cold winter breeze. Platform your way through mushrooms, escape from evil spiders and make friends along the way. Can you save them?

name: Yet another tower defence
short_description: Ancient demons summoned from the deep dark abyss, and brought ruin to Tiede, land of our home. You should know your towers, and use them wisely. Bring your sword, worrior, and your brave heart! Join me in this defence of the ancient...lands!

name: Tennis Story
short_description: A tennis game that's not about what happens on the court. It's about being young, not having a care in the world. It's about the adventures with your friends you'll remember for the rest of your life.

name: RICO
short_description: Two cops, one case and only 24 hours to bust the bad guys! Become a loose cannon police detective and face off with criminal gangs in this procedurally-generated action movie FPS. Join forces with a friend and take down those crooks, buddy-cop style!

name: Ghost 1.0
short_description: A mysterious agent, capable of becoming a digital ghost, sneaks aboard the Nakamura Space Station. This is where the fun begins: the station is well-protected with its heavy defences, never-ending arsenal of weapons, and mysterious artifacts. It will all have to be destroyed.

name: Solitaire Bonbon
short_description: Cook lots of sweets and enjoy it! 200 levels in the sweet world theme!

name: Endless Fables 2: Frozen Path
short_description: Pamela Cavendish returns for another adventure! The famous anthropologist ventures into the northern reaches of Europe to rescue a friend who went missing while following the trail of Norse gods. Is this mere coincidence or is there something more behind the legend of Loki and Hodur?

name: Vapour
short_description: WARNING! This game has an Age Restriction of 18. Vapour is an experimental horror game, that fuses elements of both old school and modern horror titles with the frantic game play of classic First Person Shooter titles. Blending horror, shooter, action, puzzle and platformer in a dynamic yet cohesive combination.

name: Radical Spectrum: Volume 1
short_description: A band of aliens led by the careless Prince FaceBox have invaded the future city of Nucleusport, bombarding it with radioactive waste from their own polluted planet. Only one man has the tech and the cojones to fight back. Take on the role of Doc DuBrane and wield his super-powerful Prisma Cannon in this endless arcade-style shooter.

name: Gulman 5
short_description: Gulman 5 – is a single-player first-person shooter by Svyatoslav Gulyaev.

name: Hero must die. again
short_description: The hero defeated the demon Guile, but lost his life in the process. Given five more days to put his affairs in order, guide him to the best possible funeral in this anti-RPG where he grows weaker.

name: LIBRARY
short_description: LIBRARY is a cute game about hanging out and throwing stuff at your new friends! · ◡ · 💌

name: Dark Dimensions: City of Fog Collector's Edition
short_description: Search for a town consumed by fog! Unlock forbidden doors and uncover mysterious items!

name: LEVEL UP!
short_description: Rogue-like platformer/shooter with destructible levels and bosses, and procedurally generated levels and enemies.

name: Alien Flex
short_description: Aliens are very fond of flex. This guy is no exception, he wants to dance for you. But for that he needs space drugs for aliens. You need to kill all the guards and steal drugs.

name: Shadow Legend VR
short_description: Shadow Legend is an exploration-RPG exclusively designed for VR where you play as the Grand Master of the Knights Templar in a story-driven medieval crusade. Freely explore densely filled worlds and use your sword, bow, and magic skills to save your kingdom from the destruction of Lord Adaroth.

name: Cross Maid
short_description: 互相认错性别的两人，机缘巧合之下开始同居生活 产生羁绊到互相依恋再到自我怀疑，温馨欢乐的短片小故事

name: 月圆之夜 (Night of Full Moon)
short_description: 'Night of the Full Moon' is a stand-alone roguelike card game. Take adventure into Black Forest. Random event, random plot leads to different endings.

name: Witcheye
short_description: Set off on an adventure as a mild-mannered witch who transforms into a flying eyeball of vengeance after a smarmy knight and wizard steal her spell ingredients.

name: AA Touch Gun!
short_description: Classic timekiller. Defend yourself from the attack of the aircraft. Destroy all the planes. You can get bonuses for the destruction of enemies. Watch out for small and fast plane

name: Xenobox VR
short_description: Fight for the future of the planet on the last frontier! Do not let the enemy destroy the last obstacle on the way to capturing the Earth! You are to be strong, clever, and very attentive. You will have to move a lot in order not to get caught in the crossfire of the enemy.

name: Spacecats with Lasers VR
short_description: Spacecats with lasers VR is a wave shooter where you can prove to be the su-purr-rior feline in the galaxy by destroying not so claw-ver rat enemies with your mighty lasers! Customize your spacecat and choose perks to improve it as you get to harder waves.

name: Bird Game
short_description: Bird Game is a short, zen-like fly 'em up where you navigate a bird through a black-and-white line drawing landscape.

name: Galaxy Reavers
short_description: This is a fun yet challenging RTS game. To survive in the vast galaxy, you need to build up your own fleet and customize your warships. You will also learn to control them efficiently in battle to defeat your enemies, conquer planets, and expand your galactic empire!

name: Dark Mechanism - Virtual reality
short_description: Travel through clockwork in this infinite level game. Avoid obstacles, collect the perks and don't touch the Mechanism.

name: Grave Mania: Pandemic Pandemonium
short_description: The Locas are back!

name: Knife Club
short_description: Welcome to the club. Knife Club puts your reflexes and throwing skills to the test. With head to head online combat, it is the adrenaline pumping multiplayer experience the VR community has been waiting for.

name: Bombshell
short_description: Bombshell is an Action Shooter game in which bomb disposal technician turned mercenary for hire, Shelly 'Bombshell' Harrison must strong-arm her way across 4 planets in an Unreal Engine-powered galactic adventure to rescue the president (and humanity) from an apocalyptic alien threat.

name: MonsterS in haha Island (群妖志)
short_description: To be immortal, The most important thing is to have a long life.Our hero wants to be immortal, so he came to this island to find the secret of longevity in frogs.

name: Final Assault
short_description: Final Assault is a WWII themed Action Strategy Game that capitalizes on the full power of Virtual Reality. Command massive ground battles as the skies erupt in dynamic dog fights and bombing runs. Combat requires quick thinking and fast reflexes. Fight the battle, win the war!

name: Gun Range VR
short_description: Gun Range VR offers you a sandbox style gun range for HTC Vive which includes interactive items, achievements, unlocks, frequent updated items. If that is not enough you can also enjoy the 16 different mini games Gun Range VR offers, all with their own online Leader Boards to compete for the top slots.

name: Skull Rogue
short_description: Skull Rogue is an RPG in the classic rogue-like style. You have to pump your ordinary skeleton to an incredible level from scratch.

name: aMAZE Dark Times
short_description: aMAZE Dark Times is a straightforward and surprisingly-difficult celebration of the simple beauty of the maze with cool soundtrack and timer!

name: Gems
short_description: Addictive match-three game with gorgeous graphics and a simple interface.

name: Insect Revolution VR
short_description: You’ve spent years working your behind off as part of the Doomsday Force, the secret military elite squad that got stuck dealing with every apocalyptic threat. Yeah, it was a thankless job, but you don’t care. You’ve finally retired to your own private tropical island.

name: Kate's Test
short_description: Help Kate solve puzzles and escape trouble as she learns to use her new body in this cute and lewd action adventure game.

name: Romance of the Three Kingdoms XI with Power Up Kit
short_description: 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms 11 with Power Up Kit' is an expanded version of 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms 11,' which was released in 2006 as the 11th game in the series. The grand battles that shaped the course of Chinese history are shown in 3D space! In Administration, players freely develop cities.

name: Dark Cases: The Blood Ruby Collector's Edition
short_description: Your father was murdered while he was investigating a crime. Travel back through time to save him!

name: Remaya Idle
short_description: Click to destroy your targets, or stay AFK and let the Archer destroy them for you. Loot potions to increase your damage. Equip rare gear to improve your stats. Farm epic books and use them on your items to modify them. Also, can you reach End Game to invade legendary dungeons?

name: ATOLL
short_description: The earth has been struck by an extinction level meteor, eliminating most of humanity. Survive by managing resources beneath the ocean surface in a single-person submarine craft. Test your survival skills to see if you can once again reach the ocean surface and uncover the fate of the earth!

name: Spartaga
short_description: Spartaga starfighters battle through a VR Bullet-Hell! Jump into a classic genre re-imagined for Virtual Reality. Spartaga's combat gameplay, intuitive controls, challenging enemies, and arcade atmosphere will immerse you in the action.

name: Stranger of Sword City
short_description: Your flight crashes after passing through a mysterious portal. As the sole survivor, you awaken to an unfamiliar land lit by stars you’ve never seen. This land is Escario. Quickly marked as the Chosen One, the Stranger of Sword City, you must defend this place, and choose your allegiances carefully...

name: Dance Studio VR
short_description: Dance Studio VR is a virtual reality dancing game. The Player can choose different characters to play as, and can choose their own songs to play. The goal of the game is to mimic the dance moves of the other two characters in the studio. The faster and more accurate the players moves, the faster they win.

name: Chess++
short_description: If regular chess has become stale and you're looking for a unique, new challenge, Chess++ is the game for you! Play a game against the AI in a chess board with 3 dimensions, new movesets, and new rules.

name: Yoku's Island Express
short_description: Meet Yoku, the pint-sized postman protagonist of Yoku's Island Express! Use a unique blend of pinball mechanics, platforming and open world exploration to unlock the secrets of Mokumana Island, help the locals, awaken ancient deities and much more in this amazing new tropical adventure!

name: AliveInVR
short_description: Control Ableton Live from VR. Ever wanted to use a giant Push or Launchpad from within VR? AliveInVR controls Ableton Live allowing you to trigger clips, play instruments and mix with a giant 3D Controllerist interface in VR.

name: Nicky - The Home Alone Golf Ball
short_description: A poor and home alone golf ball needs your help to get your goal - to find his home ( a hole in a golf track ) in less movements as possible. Nicky moves only with mouse, you just need to drag, look at some point and release. The game is funny and challenging!

name: Leave No One Behind: Ia Drang
short_description: Leave No One Behind is tactical real time strategy war game. Experience some of the hardest battles fought during the Vietnam War in 1965 between US Army and the Army of the Northern Vietnam for landing zones X-Ray and Albany and for Plei Me special forces camp.

name: Pirate Cannons AHOY!
short_description: Ahoy mateys! Take charge of your fort defenses as hostile pirates invade to steal your treasure! Defend your treasure chests in this classic cannon-shooting take in this casual tower-defense game.

name: Itadaki Smash
short_description: Itadaki Smash™ is a Beat 'em Up game that pays tribute to the classics of the genre. Gain new skills and revive the spirit of the arcade by unleashing an arsenal of combos, throws and special attacks.

name: IMHA
short_description: IMHA is an action horror FPS set on a mysterious island ravaged by a demon invasion.

name: toz
short_description: Sand, powder, life simulation game

name: Super Kickers League
short_description: The best alternative to conventional football games is here!

name: Pointless
short_description: Pointless is a game about destroying Dots. Each Dot you destroy adds one point to your score. You can add your score to a global point pool, and see how many Dots have been destroyed globally. Rad!

name: Snakes on an Extradimensional Plane
short_description: Abstract HTC Vive game where you help adventurous space mice with tiny little jetpack escape the glowing snakes! Collect powerups for points and compete on the leaderboards!

name: Chainless
short_description: Escape from prison and swing your way through the city in floating chains, avoiding various obstacles, trying not to fall and not to get caught.

name: Iron Wings
short_description: ARCADE-ACTION WWII air combat -Player takes on the role of the two pilots, Jack and Amelia, as they attempt to take down Nazi aerial menace across a rich campaign of missions, each with numerous objectives and enemies as well as side objectives.

name: Quarter Horse Racing
short_description: Spend a day at the races - Quarter Horse races.

name: Hard Helmets
short_description: Hard Helmets is a 2D real time strategy game where you can face other players in amazing battles through the use of world war II inspired characters that will reinforce your command with attack and defense strategies by using war bonds during every battle. Will you be able to deploy the perfect strategy to capture enemy facilities?

name: Nordic Storm Solitaire
short_description: Help northman Elof lead his people to a land promised by the God Feyr! Beware… this land is under dispute by the Jotun Idyl, an archrival of the ancient Gods. Play through 130 challenging solitaire levels and chase away the Jotun Idyl!

name: Trailer Trashers
short_description: PLAY ONLINE WITH STEAM REMOTE PLAY TOGETHER! Join with up to four players in this Hectic twin stick bullet bouncing frenzy. Challenge your friends in Death-match, Last Man Standing, Shotgun Soccer or crown yourself king of the 'couch' in the all-including Party Mode!

name: The Chronicles of Nyanya
short_description: A sweet jRPG-style game about cats, brutal massacres, cuteness, racism and social issues, friendship, sinister thoughts, hilarity and Nazi furniture. It’s an epic attempt to blow your mind with adult themes hidden behind bright cartoon graphics.

name: Sheaf - Together EP
short_description: Enter virtual reality to listen to the debut EP “Together” of synthwave producer Sheaf. No gameplay involved -- just sit back, relax, and enjoy the music while you drive through a retro low poly world.

name: Depopulation
short_description: The world’s pollution is threatening all life on Earth. Employed by a Billionaire, and chosen for your high intelligence and psychopathic tendencies, it’s up to you to save the world by any means necessary.

name: Kagura's Dreamland 神樂夢境
short_description: Enter Kagura's Dreamland and pass through each level to defeat your dark ego.Each dream is accompanied by delightful music, and on the way, you will meet cute bears, kittens, Slimes, etc., and fight with them in an imaginary battle.

name: My Free Farm
short_description: You’ve never seen a farm like this! You can breed massive monster fruits, raise super animals, and organize cow races. Tend to your fields and sell your farm-fresh product. Experience the most expansive farm game of all time – play now!

name: Baby Redemption
short_description: Baby Redemption is a high paced rogue-like shooter where you have to save babies in glorious intense slow-motion action. Weapons, bullets, babies, fun and bullet-time. What more do you need?

name: Twin Edge
short_description: Twin Edge is a refreshing circular take on the Rhythm Game genre. Divide your attention evenly between two rotating circles and try not to lose your rhythm!

name: Shift Shaft
short_description: Take Shaft on his way to find his meaning of existence! Shift Shaft is a Indie Side-Scroller with a variety of gamemodes to play.

name: Retro Racer
short_description: Retro Racer is neon lights, a fantastic city, synthwave, and the most vivid images of the 80s. Supercars, vhs effect, IBM computer graphics, glitches, analog synthesizers. Immerse yourself in the world of a neon future that will never come.

name: Grim Tales: The Vengeance Collector's Edition
short_description: When his sister is murdered, you must prove your nephew’s innocence!

name: Help Me Now
short_description: Help Me Now is a horror and suspense game, where the player faces several challenges to save the terrifying house he finds! You control Thomas Histed, an investigative detective who lost consciousness and woke up in a psychopath's home in Arizona! Hide and plan your escape route in time ...

name: Mr.Empathy: The Canceled Game.
short_description: Ever had a rage playing a puzzle game? Would you like to have? Enter the fun world of Mr. Empathy and have fun with metaphors and puzzles in this 3D/2D game.

name: The Grass
short_description: An adventure in a grassy field where you must break the curse to get out. A title of action adventure and survival horror Are you ready to overcome this challenge?

name: Astroderps
short_description: Astroderps is a fun puzzle game that you can play for all ages. Your goal is to guide your Astroderps from one portal to the next while avoiding dangerous obstacles.

name: Nasty Rogue
short_description: Mysterious Dungeon Exploration, Secret Items and Powerful Bosses, Fluid Movement Upgrades. Unique Enemies dropping Epic Loot. Level up your Stats, Enchant your weapons and Armor pieces.

name: Five Seconds of Bad Music
short_description: Think. Expect. Stay within 5 seconds.

name: Nightmare Of Melanie
short_description: Players will constantly experience their inner voice between the truth and fear from Ling's perspective, and face the most cruel fate hidden in the deepest darkness after the horizon is clear and swept by fear one after another...

name: The Night of Joe
short_description: The Night of Joe is an action-horror game set in a supermarket at night. Joe is trying to exit, to do so he has to find and activate some escalators while a monster is chasing him. He has a special flashlight to help him see through the dark but also to transform and stop the Night for a few seconds

name: Kestrel
short_description: Shoot'em up with an emphasis on progression and growth through upgrades. Fly, shoot, die, upgrade, repeat.

name: Dungeon No Dungeon
short_description: Dungeon No Dungeon is a turn-based roguelike game with a unique hand-drawn art style, with a strategy system based around body parts that you've likely never encountered before.

name: Escape from the Princess
short_description: Rosetta dreams of becoming a magician, but she isn't cut out for it. Fate brings her together with a mysterious witch, who is pursued by the princess herself. The witch promises to make Rosetta a magician in return for her help. But Rose falls in love with a witch who is clearly hiding something.

name: Those Who Came: Healing Solarus
short_description: With their world on the verge of collapse, the spacefaring Sainen sent forth a ship of explorers, hoping to find a new home to survive extinction. Work with others to create a safe haven for your people on a hostile planet and heal it in this sci-fi coop survival RPG where teamwork is key to success

name: Airranger
short_description: Airranger is a bow and arrow multiplayer game. Nothing in usual in the realm of conventional gaming, sure, but it makes for one of the best VR game with a headset donned. You can move around or fly to the sky, as well as use your unique weapons to defeat all your opponents in your own way. only the last one standing can win.

name: First Time in Paris
short_description: Join amateur travel blogger Kate Robinson and her daughter Nicole as they go on their first big business trip to save a Parisian hotel!

name: Magna Graecia
short_description: Magna Graecia is a colorful building strategy and puzzle game in ancient Greek style in which you create a sprawling village with olives and grapes by placing buildings strategically, leveling them up, receiving adjacency bonuses, and expanding your territory, while enjoying the whole process.

name: 神启神落
short_description: 这是一款魔幻类地牢探险、角色扮演多玩法游戏，玩家扮演神启者，不断的招集神落者（游戏中的英雄）对抗挑战，目前开放试炼之地模式，支持选择的英雄提升等级及属性，同时游戏具有独特的魂体转化系统，每一次对噬魂者的毁灭都对应了新的神落者的重生，在之后的其它模式，玩家会召唤这些英雄参与群体战斗

name: PowerUp Elevation
short_description: PowerUp Elevation is a autorunning platform game in a farm full of elevators and deadly traps. Can you traverse the perils within and steal a kiss from your 'mate'?

name: Caretaker Sacrifice
short_description: An epic sci-fi 6DOF adventure, puzzle and shooter featuring the voice of David Hewlett (Stargate). At the end of time, struggle through a hostile alien machine to solve the ultimate mystery and fulfil your final mission.

name: Lost Ruins
short_description: Lost Ruins is a 2D side-scrolling survival action game, where you play as a young girl that has awoken in a strange and foreign place without her memories. Explore a dark and dangerous world, battle hideous monsters, and topple incredible bosses.

name: Meridian: Squad 22
short_description: Meridian: Squad 22 is a single-player science-fiction real-time strategy game with a focus on base building and advanced tactics. Every single choice, every tactical decision you make, shapes the outcome of your story.

name: Super Arcade Boy in Defender of Planet Earth
short_description: A Retro Style Classic Side-Scrolling Shoot'em Up with Super Arcade Boy's Debut! Fly him through 8 levels while defeating waves of enemies and bosses with amusing dialogue, power-ups, HD graphics and full controller support. Super Arcade Boy's up to the challenge. ARE YOU?

name: Super Lucky's Tale
short_description: A delightful, playground platformer for all ages that follows Lucky, the ever-optimistic, energetic, and lovable hero, on his quest to find his inner strength and help his sister rescue the Book of Ages from Jinx. Jinx is the scheming and mysterious villain trying to reshape the world, but for what reason?

name: Refund Me If You Can
short_description: One maze, one monster tracking you down, will you have the courage and dexterity to escape this nightmare in less than two hours ?

name: Prison Tycoon Alcatraz
short_description: At Alcatraz you need to deliver total punishment and minimum privilege to ruthless murders and hardened criminals. Do you have what it takes?

name: Brood
short_description: Immerse into a mythical meadow full of unrevealed secrets as you play as a fox attempting to find his way home.

name: Startup Panic
short_description: Quit your job and build an exciting startup! Survive the tech bubble, compete with rival CEOs and expand your office from bedroom programmer up to the heights of global corporate sabotage! As long as you don't get hacked... or kidnapped...

name: G String
short_description: Slip into the Standard Issue Biosuit as Myo Hyori, a gifted Korean teenage girl who must face the perils of the future. Survive many hazards, explore a seemingly endless metropolis and beyond as the world around you implodes and history marches towards its inevitable conclusion.

name: Raster Prime [REMIX]
short_description: Your mind will short-circuit in this atmospheric pixel sci-fi puzzler with eight (8) levels of increasing difficulty. Decipher each binary sequence to travel further into the unknown, and unearth a deeper mystery that may never be fully understood.

name: Little Adventurer III
short_description: This is a first-person casual game that focuses on going home after helping the little girl, and a few mini-games.

name: Humans V Zombies
short_description: Play Humans Versus Zombies, a new kind of battle royal FPS. There are three distinct game modes, survival mode, get to the objective, last man standing.

name: 楚汉争霸
short_description: 《楚汉争霸》以真实的楚汉历史为背景，配以宏大的地图场景，是一款操作方式便捷、游戏体系完善的即时战略游戏。玩家在游戏模拟的真实楚汉背景下，可以身临其境的体会到攻城掠地、指点江山，并且通过自己努力最终结束诸侯纷争，一统天下的乐趣！

name: Arabian Treasures: Midnight Match
short_description: This is the rags to riches story told in a match 3 puzzle adventure within an Arabian themed game!

name: Kowi Ishto: Battle of Akonoli
short_description: Kowi Ishto: Battle of Akonoli is a 16-bit inspired, Action Packed, Arcade Style, Space Shooter.

name: TinyKeep
short_description: TinyKeep, a top-down procedurally generated dungeon escape game with permadeath - you die and it's game over. Master the frantic physics-based combat, lure enemies into traps or make them fight each other for dominance. There are many ways to survive in TinyKeep!

name: Flying Pengy
short_description: Very dynamic arcade game with many different types of blocks, enemies, and power-ups. Play as a cute penguin that jumps out of the plane and smashes his enemies with basketballs, fire balls, acid balls, explosive balls, and boomerangs.

name: Pendelum
short_description: Pendelum is a physics-based puzzle platformer with a pendulum that requires patience, skill and creativity.Use only gravity and external influences to reach the goal, create your own puzzles, compare your performance with others and above all - DON'T RAGE!

name: STARWAY VR
short_description: Hey, captain! Now you can Remote control your spaceship and shooting space monsters!Hello VR game lovers, we do NEED YOUR SUGGESTIONS, so now the price is only $3.99, please try ans tell us your comments.In the coming 2 months, we are planing to add:1. Enemy - You will encounter enemies in the space.2.

name: Beast Crimes
short_description: A beastly crime investigation drama.

name: What do you hear?? Yanny vs Laurel
short_description: What word or name do you hear, and how far do you have to move the slider to hear another? Check it out and be surprised by the possibilities of your brain!

name: Chaotic Airport Construction Manager
short_description: A simulation game making fun of Germans needing 16 years to build an airport. Are you able to do better?

name: Luna and the Moonling
short_description: A unique spin on classic adventure gameplay! Luna and the Moonling stars two unlikely friends that must work together to solve a mystery and save their kingdom. Inspired by some of the greatest adventure puzzle classics, Luna and the Moonling will challenge you for hours!

name: Inner Tao
short_description: Master the opposites in this meditative puzzle game.

name: 30 days to survive
short_description: '30 days to survive' - the game is going day, in a world where there is a zombie Apocalypse! The protagonist has to survive 30 days on a randomly generated map full of dead.

name: Train Simulator Classic
short_description: Welcome to the ultimate railway hobby! Master complex operations on the DB BR 411 ICE T, BR Class 390 Pendolino, Union Pacific AC4400CW, and more as you explore authentic routes. Whatever you love about trains, Train Simulator Classic lets you take your hobby to the next level.

name: The Kids We Were
short_description: A cinematic adventure game with a heavy focus on narrative.

name: The Sunny Day 晴天
short_description: In the story, the player plays the KUI, a 14-year-old girl with mental illness, who falls into her own spiritual world for an unknown reason during a daily activity. Players must pass through puzzles and various strange characters to communicate. The player's attitude toward various items in the game will affect the outcome of the game.

name: Bahamut2-dragon's bride
short_description: When Clear sealed Bahamut again, he grew up for the second time and still aspires to become an adventurer. What awaits him is a more magnificent adventure story, and everyone is welcome to experience it.

name: VR GAME-Brick of War 魔块战争
short_description: VR GAME-Brick Of War is an VR shooting game that is suitable for any age player,Players need to challenge monsters from all sides in the game. There are plenty of monsters and they have different forms of attack.

name: Bus Simulator 21
short_description: Experience the daily life of a bus driver in two open world cities either in the USA or Europe. Drive up to 30 licensed buses by international manufacturers, including a double-decker and e-buses. Take your passengers to their destinations safely and on time - either in single- or multiplayer mode.

name: Slide Stories: Neko's Journey
short_description: Follow Nina and her cat, Neko, on a journey through beautiful places in this relaxing and minimalist slide puzzle game.

name: Final Foe
short_description: Final Foe is an isometric fantasy arena that challenges you to slay waves of monsters in a mysterious dungeon. Single player and co-op modes. Modifiers and boss rounds. Survive and fight to the end, until the last enemy is killed!

name: Break Stuff With Coins
short_description: Ever wanted to just let loose and Break stuff? Break Stuff with Coins lets you do just that. Toss coins at stuff, and break or manipulate it, all in a wacky physics world. Unlock new coins, each with unique bonuses or destructive effects that will definitely spice up your playstyle.

name: Zima uhodi!
short_description: Play snowballs? In May? Why not!

name: Metal Heads
short_description: Metal Heads is solo developed, crazy local or online multiplayer party game with head-banging metal music, where up to 8 players compete in mini-games and board game modes with a whole bunch of insane mini-games that are easy to play, but difficult to master.

name: Resurrector
short_description: n ancient evil awoke after a thousand years of sleep. You are this evil.

name: Terrain Defender
short_description: Pass the spherical pointer over the different bags to increase points at the cost of increasing the time in departure.

name: 三国英雄坛
short_description: This is an open-ended text strategy simulation game with no specific route to achieve achievements or impact the ending. The direction of the game is determined by the players themselves, recruit the characters they want to recruit, and collect their favorite props.

name: Gladiator: Blades of Fury
short_description: Gladiator: Blades of Fury is a melee combat action fighting game set during the medieval period. Players can play as a gladiator from four different clans, namely the Barbarians, the Assassins, the Knights, and the Dwarves. All heroes are unique and have their own weapons, skills, and fighting styles.

name: March of War: FaceOff - M
short_description: The Battlefield Card Game with a roguish community. Come join us and immerse yourself in an alt history Steampunk universe where the impossible is possible. Choose the faction that complements your play style, build a devious deck & battle your opponent across the battlefield. + iOS & Android.

name: A Mass of Dead
short_description: Massacre of zombies! Survive the zombies. Buy and upgrade weapons and equipment to massacre zombies. Kill special zombies like zombie dogs, get unique weapons and equipment that you can’t buy from the shop. Be unbeatable using power boost and massacre zombies.

name: Racing Classics: Drag Race Simulator
short_description: Looking for a game where you can drive legendary classic rides? Get the most out of each car in the iconic style of the '70s and '80s and test their original performance in classic head-to-head drag races!

name: WolfQuest: Classic
short_description: LIVE THE LIFE OF A WILD WOLF! As a two-year-old gray wolf in Yellowstone National Park, hunt elk and moose, find a mate, and then establish a territory and raise your pups.

name: Dice Legacy
short_description: Dice Legacy is a dice-based survival city builder set on a mysterious ringworld. Your ship has reached the shore of an uncharted continent. Roll and use your dice to gather resources, expand and defend your settlement, survive the winter and interact with the strange inhabitants of this eerie world.

name: DEFECTIVE
short_description: You must save the world, whatever the cost...

name: Rise of the Slime
short_description: Be the hero that no-one saw coming. Help Slime defy the odds by playing insanely powerful cards in this charming, relaxing and strategic deckbuilding adventure.

name: 八尾
short_description: 《八尾》是一个志异怪谈的女性向古风游戏，以男女主的爱情故事为明线，八尾猫之谜为暗线，展开动人心弦的故事。

name: OlympicVR
short_description: OlympicVR is a singleplayer/party game for HTC Vive. Get yourself in action and challenge friends in different disciplines to find out who will win. Three difficulty modes (easy, normal and extreme) will change the experience adding unique elements to the game.

name: The Adventures of Mr. Bobley
short_description: The Adventures of Mr. Bobley is a 3d platformer adventure game featuring physics based puzzles and challenges that also require you to drive vehicles and operate heavy machinery. Set at a skyscraper construction site. The game is all about physics and interaction with the environment.

name: Global Soccer: A Management Game 2018
short_description: In Global Soccer: A Management Game 2018 there are no restrictions, the whole world becomes playable! The 210 playable nations and the 4000+ playable clubs guarantees truly infinite hours to play.

name: Thousand Threads
short_description: Explore a beautiful open world where you deliver mail, find artifacts, help people out, and fend off folks you’ve wronged.

name: ECO HOLE
short_description: ECO HOLE is a survival game for one or two players with unique gameplay. Strange events began to happen in the world, and people began to turn into monsters. You are mysterious heroes who suddenly appeared at the right moment, and you strive to stop the nightmare at any cost.

name: G.A.M.E.S
short_description: 4 Games. One Collection. One Deal Not to be Missed. G.A.M.E.S includes 4 indie games, 3 of them brand new to Steam and 1 of them, a classic pastime from a bygone era. You are hustler? No?! Well you are now!

name: Please The Gods
short_description: Journey to the land of the Gods in this atmospheric turn-based indie RPG. Vanquish deadly beasts of Finnish mythology, survive in the unforgiving wilderness and earn the favour of the ancient pagan Gods!

name: R.O.O.T.S
short_description: R.O.O.T.S is a real-time strategy game that pits the player against colorful yet invasive enemies that must be overtaken before the player themselves is uprooted! Warfare has never been so beautifully unorthodox.

name: Tiles
short_description: Tiles is a unique action-puzzle game that will both convolute your mind and burn your finger tips!

name: Pertinence
short_description: Pertinence is a top-down adventure with minimalist graphics that explores various puzzle and action mechanics. The goal of the game is to freely explore rooms in a grid layout while collecting as many 'alloy' as possible. These will unlock new areas and abilities.

name: War Builder League
short_description: “Build and Fight” multiplayer for mature players. Build your own Machine, join combat and win the battle using tactics and strategy.

name: Virtual Hero VR
short_description: VR experience based in “Virtual Hero”, the original Movistar+ TV series in collaboration with Zeppelin TV, Grupo Planeta and Snofokk. An adventure where the user will be the main character, immersed in the TV series scenarios and able to interact with the series’ characters and elements.

name: Theseus
short_description: Theseus is an immersive VR experience that offers a new take on the myth of the Minotaur. Discover the potential of a 3rd person perspective in Virtual Reality: enjoy a mix of exploration, story and combat, with a strong cinematic feel.

name: Color Crush
short_description: Color Crush is a match 3 game. Swap and match the shapes. Solve the levels making smart moves.

name: DashBored
short_description: Enter a bizarre and idiosyncratic world! Adventure into the unknown, and defeat horrid monsters! A story of Love, Loss, and the end of the Multiverse.

name: NewTaskbar
short_description: Organize your Windows environment with a new virtual taskbar, elegant and powerful the NewTaskbar bar can contain as many applications as you want.

name: Angry Arrows
short_description: Angry Arrows is a cooperative archery game about rescuing hostages from enemy strongholds using nothing but bows and arrows. Just remember, one fatal mistake and it's back to square one.

name: Gnomes Garden 3: The thief of castles
short_description: Gnomes Garden 3 — a new chapter in this exciting fantasy/strategy game. Head off into unknown lands and defeat the warlock!

name: Last Dream
short_description: Last Dream incorporates the best features of classic RPGs: replayability and complete immersion into a vast world, rich with detail.

name: Sea of Lies: Nemesis Collector's Edition
short_description: A series of unexplained deaths baffle authorities, and you’re called in to investigate.

name: Meteorfall: Krumit's Tale
short_description: Krumit's Tale, the second game in the Meteorfall universe, is a new take on the deckbuilding roguelike genre. Use your cards to clear dungeons, then upgrade your deck with new cards and perks to press forward. The fate of the world is in your hands.

name: Mini Island: Night
short_description: Mini Island: Night is a one small hold & Gun, boss Rush mini-game of Casual difficulty.

name: Zombie Defense Shelter
short_description: You control an elite soldier of the future guarding the entrance of the shelter, which is besieged by crowds of zombies.

name: Unknown Fate
short_description: Unknown Fate is an enigmatic story-driven action adventure set in a surreal world full of mind-twisting puzzles and bizarre creatures

name: Shardbound
short_description: Shardbound is a Tactical CCG that combines board-based tactical gameplay with the depth of content found in collectible card games. As a Ranger, you'll form a Noble House with your friends and battle other players to claim the riches of an ancient world.

name: Sinful Eden
short_description: Sinful Eden is a point 'n' click adventure with dating sim and RPG elements. You take on the role of a young man living in Karigon Island, Karigon law states that all males who're of age are duty-bound to marry, failure to comply will result in execution, as ordained by the high priestess Aurora.

name: Get Off My Space!
short_description: Get Off My Space! is a tower defense game where you rely on skillful tower placement and resource management to beat upcoming dangers of the galaxy. Combining strategy and micro managing fire groups you will overcome the hardest level objectives.

name: Enter the Gungeon
short_description: Enter the Gungeon is a bullet hell dungeon crawler following a band of misfits seeking to shoot, loot, dodge roll and table-flip their way to personal absolution by reaching the legendary Gungeon’s ultimate treasure: the gun that can kill the past.

name: xiuzhen idle
short_description: 这是一款简单的修仙模拟游戏！可肝可放置！集中了多种极具成长性的游戏系统与玩法。从炼气、筑基到飞升仙界，甚至跨入神界的过程中，将不断体验新的成长玩法。或是炼丹、炼器、驭兽、画符，或是招募弟子、经营门派、创建神国，即可以简单的挂机放置方式体验玩法与数值的疯狂成长。

name: Tiamat X
short_description: Featuring six levels of intense shooting action, Tiamat X is a rip-snortin tribute to the side-scrolling space shooters of yesteryear, and would be right at home blazing away on the screen of a booming, beer-stained arcade cabinet.

name: Survive The Dark
short_description: Survive The Dark is a story-driven, physics-based first person simulator in a post-apocalyptic mountain overrun by zombies. Clinging to life, you find yourself in the mountain full of zombies. Your goal is to survive in the depths of a nightmarish environment using truly intuitive means to escape.

name: Subway Midnight
short_description: Board the train! Run away from a weirdo! Solve some puzzles! Make friends with some ghosts! Try not to become a ghost yourself!

name: Jump To Die 2 - Bloody Soul
short_description: Watch them die.

name: Monktastic
short_description: Step back in time to this nostalgic jungle themed game. Monktastic is a game for all ages. Avoid obstacles, cocoa bullets, fire and much more as you climb your way to the next level.

name: Just Like Golf
short_description: Third person golf ball simulator.

name: Leaf Tree
short_description: A puzzle game to relax and create beautiful trees while solve each level. Move the block on the correct way to fill all the spaces

name: Proven: A Math RPG
short_description: Proven: A Math RPG is a retro-style role-playing game (RPG) that teaches math while never forgetting that it is a game!

name: Legion's Crawl
short_description: Descend the dungeon and slay the evil! Legion's Crawl is a combination of classic roguelike principle and modern 3D environment with intuitive GUI. Choose your hero and difficulty, challenge the randomly generated dungeons!

name: SEEP Universe
short_description: Kick butt in this retro 2D action-platformer! SEEP Universe is an indie game for PC inspired by the 8-16 bit era!

name: Shotgun Legend
short_description: Eugene must battle aliens and the undead in search of a truck rim, as it seems to be his ticket home.

name: Mirage of Dragon
short_description: Mirage of Dragon is a unique, 2D platformer, with an open world that gives you a freedom of exploration. Wander the maze, solve puzzles and discover all of the game endings in a mysterious, dreamy place.

name: Kapellmeister
short_description: Run. Hide. Follow the orders. Keep quiet. Complete tasks. Don't forget to check the cameras; someone is stalking you. And if you are lucky, maybe you'll get out of this loop of never-ending and repeating events.

name: Fly, Glowfly!
short_description: Tired of AN INDIE PIXEL-ART 2D SHOOTERS WITH A VERY DEEP STORY? Then be sure to check Fly, Glowfly! Your goal is to help this little shiny (and a bit stupid) thing to reach the finish by placing blocks on it's way. Sounds like a mobile puzzle, but... a picture is worth a thousand words, play it now!

name: Araha : Curse of Yieun Island
short_description: Araha: Curse of Yieun Island is a survival horror game. You will explore the hospital on an island as 'the Boy' who is looking for his sister. Starting from the abandoned hospital, You will journey through the cursed island covering the Sharman's sanctum, Cemetary in the mountainside and more.

name: Unreal Heroes
short_description: Unreal Heroes is a game in 2D inspired by strike force heroes and built on unreal engine 4.

name: Exocomets
short_description: Exocomets is a basic yet difficult action game where you try to survive as long as possible against incoming waves of comets. One hit, and your ship is dead. Survive for as long as possible by collecting powerups and stars to beat every level!

name: Legends of the Universe - StarCore
short_description: Metroidvania style action/platformer with tons of abilities, enemies and exploration.

name: Mind Over Melee Radio
short_description: Dank Tunes, Dank Memes and everything in-between. Play a stupid game, win stupid rewards. Fill the void in your life with some simple numerical validation for the glorious cause of the Infinite Grind.

name: Airstrife: Assault of the Aviators
short_description: Use Aileron Rolling or Evading your enemies' attacks while having a realistic damage system. Use different planes with upgradable parts and numerous weapons you can mount to your planes to destroy your enemies. Fly solo or play with your friends and enjoy local coop. A modern re-invented classic.

name: Judas
short_description: Judas is an atmospheric psychological horror experience. Accidentally trapped in an apartment complex, you face dark paranormal events that push you to escape as fast as possible; yet, fleeing is not an option.

name: POSTAL Redux
short_description: POSTAL Redux is a high definition remake of the classic dark and surreal twin-stick isometric shooter. Take control of The Postal Dude as he fights to survive in a world gone mad with violence.

name: Al Emmo and the Lost Dutchman's Mine
short_description: Join feeble Al Emmo on a journey into the heart of the Wild-West in search of love, adventure, and gold! A looming, thousand-year-old Aztec curse is bound to keep Al on his toes. Does redemption lie within the haunted depths of the Lost Dutchman's Mine? Find out in this Wild Western adventure game.

name: Candy
short_description: This is a candy-style bubble shooter game.

name: Unsouled
short_description: Unsouled is a 2D action RPG game requiring immense elaborate control. Take a break from repetitive attack and dodge action by challenging yourself with the world of Unsouled.

name: MMA President
short_description: A Mixed Martial Arts (MMA) sports management game for the PC deskop/laptop. Run any of 25 different MMA companies and compete to become the best in the world. Find the next generation of MMA stars and watch them become legends in the sport.

name: Joy Climb
short_description: You must move upwards. Higher! To the Top!!! But more often you fill fall down.

name: Fleet Defender: The F-14 Tomcat Simulation
short_description: The catapult officer calls for full afterburner. 50,000 pounds of thrust spools behind you as your F-14 strains for release. Less than three seconds later your Tomcat screams through the air at 150 knots. You climb to meet your wingman, then head off to join the fight.

name: Fireworks Desert Blast
short_description: You're alone in the desert with an endless supply of fireworks. Let the rockets (and your imagination) fly.

name: My Little Dictator
short_description: A satirical dark-comedy parody of WW2, featuring genderbent anime dictators and generals! A ridiculous visual novel with turn-based battles, decision branches based on player choices, romance, drama and lots of fun things to play and unlock...

name: 岚零之风 - Wind Horizon
short_description: 这里是岚零岛，远离大陆的海中孤岛。在一次风暴过后，人们发现森林里的动物全都销声匿迹了。为了调查这种异象，洛零再一次前往森林。这次，他终于遭遇了造成异常的“犯人”，而除此以外，还有一位来头微妙的“外来者”现身了……

name: aMAZE
short_description: aMaze is a straight-forward and surprisingly-difficult celebration of the simple beauty of the maze.

name: Double Time
short_description: Double Time is a very fun and dynamic game. With more time. there are more chances!

name: Formula Truck 2013
short_description: Formula Truck 2013 for Windows - PC is the official simulator of the popular Brazilian Formula Truck series.

name: Just Ignore Them
short_description: One night can feel like a lifetime of pain, suffering and horror to a child...do you have what it takes to survive the night? Play as an 8 year old child who is tormented by monsters in his house. Your choices make his future which lives can be saved or ended.

name: Fox-Trot Over Run
short_description: Fox-Trot Over Run, (FTOR) is an intense, top-down wave-based shooter. Fight for survival against unique enemies with various capabilities. Featuring customizable and upgradable weapons. Survival depends upon your ability to fire and maneuver, while ensuring to not get over run!

name: GOLF in PAPER
short_description: Casual golf simulator in the form of a puzzle. In the style of drawings in the notebook.

name: Super Lee World
short_description: Inspired on the classics, but with unique challenges, enemies and worlds.

name: Her Story
short_description: A woman is interviewed seven times by the police. Search the video database and explore hundreds of authentic clips to discover her story in this groundbreaking and award winning narrative game.

name: Vulture for NetHack
short_description: Vulture for NetHack is an isometric graphical interface for the roguelike engine: NetHack.

name: Gold Rush! Anniversary
short_description: Gold Rush! takes you back to the year 1849, when gold was discovered in California. It was certainly one of the most exciting times in American history. Gold Rush! includes the three routes tens of thousands took to the gold regions.  Become Jerrod Wilson and experience each trek as you travel from New York to California.

name: Dark Parables: Return of the Salt Princess Collector's Edition
short_description: Explore kingdom ruins and meet the exiled Salt Princess.

name: 生化迷城
short_description: Biochemical Lost City is a 'zombie' theme mobile game that combines gunfight shooting + RPG gameplay. This game perfectly integrates role-playing and shooting themes, not only keeps firepower during fierce battles, but also makes your operating experience more exciting.

name: Mini Words - minimalist puzzle
short_description: 721 words. That is enough to cover 90% of conversations in English. Unscramble those words in Mini Words - a unique mix of puzzle, word search and hangman.

name: The Adventures of Mr. Poop
short_description: The Adventures of Mr. Poop is an addictive platformer with an incredibly intricate plot, a lot of levels in which you have to overcome many interesting and difficult challenges. What is the price of survival?

name: 怪奇幻想夢物語 怪獣綺譚 桜蛇伝
short_description: ■人と人ならざるもの、惹かれ合う二人の物語をグラフィックとムービーで演出！　天地明宵、四つの幻獣に護られたイタル国を舞台とした「怪獣綺譚」シリーズ。

name: GTTOD: Get To The Orange Door
short_description: The objective is in the title. Launch yourself gun-first into a neon synthwave virtualscape FPS as you wall run, slide, clamber, and dash around each level at supersonic speeds.

name: Echo of Combats
short_description: Echo of Combats is an online collectible card game in an unusual fantasy setting, that combines classical gameplay with original mechanics, dynamic battles and careful deck-building, which is sure to appeal to all kinds of players.

name: Lucky Rabbit Reflex!
short_description: An otome dating simulation game, Lucky Rabbit Reflex! sees our seventeen-year old heroine beginning her first and final year at a new school. Will she find friendship - or even romance - amongst the motley crew at Northmain College?

name: Don't Die, Minerva!
short_description: Help Minerva survive her adventure in a haunted house full of sinister ghosts! This spooky rogue-lite features heaps of procedural dungeons, ghosts, and loot.

name: Afelhem
short_description: You are an adventurer seeking to explore the great world of Afelhem. Fight thousands of tough monsters, delve into depths of dangerous dungeons to challenge even stronger bosses and claim your glorious treasure!

name: Disc Ninja
short_description: Immerse yourself in a breathtaking virtual reality setting and practice your Disc Golf skills in the comfort of your own home.

name: Rhythm Girl
short_description: Enter the world of music magic book with Kung fu girl and enjoy your travel of music!

name: The Village
short_description: The Village - is a combination of SNES / PS1 J-RPG style games and riddle game.

name: Green Elephant: Epilogue
short_description: Green Elephant: Epilogue is a first-person detective quest set at a Soviet military base after the events of the Russian art film “The Green Elephant”.

name: Rebirth of Island
short_description: Survive, adapt, and research in the New World, with its rules, dwellers, and their laws. Head the colonization of these locations and ensure the independence and security of your population.

name: RC Fun City
short_description: RC Fun City is a singleplayer simulation game about radio controlled vehicles.

name: WarForwards
short_description: WarForwards - It's an action game with dynamic gunplay in close quarters, inspired by the film 'John Wick' and transferred to the 2D Top-Down Shooter format.

name: Gremlin Invasion: Survivor
short_description: Gremlin Invasion: Survivor is a co-op overhead action shooter. With 8 different levels to choose from and up to 8 players, you'll play together in a survival-style mission to blast away hordes of gremlins that have come to take you out.

name: Return of Red Riding Hood Enhanced Edition
short_description: This visual novel is a collection of alternative realities. How events would turn out and how they end will depend on your choices. Visit wolf's den and solve his secret, or try to tame the wild beast. Eat a pasty with mushrooms and experience something new, or feed it to the old lady, because it's her favorite filling.

name: OVERGRAVITY
short_description: Overgravity is a 2D multi-player space themed shooter.The main feature that distinguishes it from other shooters is the speed of the gameplay, not to mention the dozens of weapons and powerups.There are also six single-player modes which can be highly customized.

name: Gravity Control
short_description: Gravity Control is a puzzle platformer where you don’t control the player directly but indirectly by changing the gravity direction.

name: Guardians of Greyrock
short_description: A tactical, turn-based high-fantasy adventure card game like no other. Take charge of an elite party of heroes to search out and purge the realm of darkness. Save the ailing Kingdom of Greyrock... in this life or from beyond death itself!

name: Commissar Catlov
short_description: The new leader of the Rats has begun threatening other animals and this is getting serious. But Catlov and his alliances are not going to let this arrogant rat to break the peace and are ready to take the necessary steps to withstand this aggression.

name: Mindless Running
short_description: Mindless Running - it's a classic runner with story mode. Explore a randomly-generated world while listening to a unique soundtrack!

name: Researchity | Open World Survival Game
short_description: A survival open world survival crafting game. Build your own base, Tame the wild live, farming, collecting resources. You will need to do all this in order to Survive. You might never know what is out there until you go looking for it

name: Viking Brothers
short_description: By the horns of your helmet, this is a Viking adventure you'll never forget! Join two brothers as they set off across a battle-scarred kingdom to drive off savages, restore their land, and search for the magic items that will breathe new life into their once magnificent realm!

name: League of Light: Wicked Harvest Collector's Edition
short_description: Someone – or something – is stealing the children of Blake’s Mountain!

name: Kly-Kly
short_description: help the magical creature named Kly-Kly defeat 4 monsters

name: GizmoVR Video Player
short_description: GizmoVR is a virtual reality media player. Supported video formats: 2D/360/180 avi, mkv and mov 4K, 8K

name: TombStar
short_description: Take on the Grimheart Gang as you shoot, dodge, cloak and explode your way across TombStar in this Space Western rogue-like shooter. Grab your guns, buckle your spurs and take back the planet – for justice, for revenge and for the galaxy.

name: Something Ate My Alien
short_description: SAMA is a hand painted, digging and puzzle adventure where you take the role of a mining ship and the little Alien blob crew hijacked by a pirate ship. Your Aliens have to dig, fight and puzzle their way through the subterranean worlds fulfilling the ransom demand. Can you do it?

name: Spate
short_description: Spate is a surreal experience set in a world that seeks to draw the player into its reality. Spate is a dark, brooding, and beautifully crafted emotional journey that is seen through the eyes of a struggling addict.

name: RB: Axolotl
short_description: Five axolotls appear one day through a void, their entire existence shrouded in mystery. A suspenseful tale, dripping with humor and full of surprises, lined by an underlying emotional theme that will strike a chord with just about anyone.

name: CAGE
short_description: With lightning-fast gameplay fully exploiting all three dimensions of motion, CAGE is a shooter unlike any other. The 'tether' allows for unprecedented freedom and agility of movement, creating explosive action.

name: Engare
short_description: Engare is a game about motion and geometry. Part puzzle game, part drawing tool, Engare is all about your geometric imagination. It’s a meditation on the dynamics of simple machines and the beauty buried deep within repeating motion.

name: Driveby Gangster
short_description: Driveby Gangster is a 1930's era game where you assume the role of a vigilante out-of-work private eye. Your goal is to eliminate the enemy gangsters that have invaded your quaint west-coast city while avoiding innocent bystanders.

name: Farming World
short_description: Whether you specialise in grain, fruits or even maintaining your own dairy farm, in Farming World you have the ultimate choice on how you shape your business. With dozens of seed types to choose from and an extensive stock market listing, you’ll have to adapt to become profitable.

name: Anime Jigsaw Girls - Office
short_description: Challenging jigsaw puzzles, featuring sexy anime girls in an office setting. Relaxing background music to match the theme and mood.

name: RollerGirls From Beyond
short_description: RollerGirls from Beyond brings side scroller action into VR. Skate, Jump, Ride and Stomp your way to save the Cows of the planet Bovina from Dr Creepy and his Alien Army.

name: Hypersonic Speed Girl / 超速少女
