name: Buddy Simulator 1984
short_description: Thanks to next generation AI technology, BUDDY SIMULATOR 1984 simulates the experience of hanging out with a best buddy! Your buddy learns from you, constantly adapting to your interests and personality. But most importantly, your buddy can play games with you!

name: HellStar Squadron
short_description: Embark on an adventure through space with the ferocious HELLSTAR SQUADRON. Dodge wave after wave of bullets, shoot the demons back to hell, and save the galaxy in this fresh, retro shoot 'em up/bullet hell experience!

name: Moi Mei 2
short_description: 'Moi Mei 2' tells the story of a brave girl, doomed to a feat, through a visually stunning puzzle platformer.

name: Run or Die
short_description: Run or Die is a fast paced Endless Runner that focuses on movement based abilities (and a huge Ion Cannon)! Players must make decisions in the blink of an eye in order to make their way through a hazardous city environment where every run is different!

name: Room of Pandora
short_description: The Room of Pandora is a third-person interactive puzzle game. The little man is trapped in a strange room, you need to escape the room. Discover multiple endings, secret rooms, and Easter eggs. There are seven endings, corresponding to seven achievements. Some puzzles may totally blow your mind.

name: Bocce Time! VR
short_description: It's time to head to the park for some VR bocce action! Bocce Time's various courts will have you throwing, bowling and spinning to win in online matches of up to 4 friends or single player against AI. Closest to the pallino wins, folks! It's Bocce Time!

name: >Connect
short_description: Dive deep into a world of cyberhacking and break into hundreds of computers in order to uncover secrets held by greedy corporations and of course self-profit along the way.

name: Panzer Knights
short_description: Panzer Knights is a single-player, story-driven tank shooter where you, a German Tank Commander, lead your platoon of tanks across Europe circa WWII. Experience battles spanning the entire war as you strategize, battle, and best your enemies!

name: About Love, Hate and the other ones
short_description: About Love, Hate and the other ones is a puzzle game, in which you influence your surroundings by the force of Hate and the power of Love. Find a way through caves and ice, castles and factories, all by the might of your puzzling!

name: Super Ledgehop: Double Laser
short_description: Cutie anime girl realizes her cool big bro is missing?? Cheese it up with Chizuru and SHOOT TO THE BEAT OF THE SONG in this top down bullet hell shooter! Absorb enemy bullets using your waveshines to utilize their bullets as your own! Show those cheeseheads that you're better!

name: Video Realms
short_description: Short sci-fi stories for Windows PC

name: Nauseous Pines
short_description: Nauseous Pines is the story of two nightschool students, united by fate and charged with creating their very first video game project. 'Nauseous Pines'

name: Magic Scroll Tactics / マジックスクロールタクティクス / 魔法卷轴 / 魔法捲軸
short_description: A side-scrolling tactical RPG where elevation is the key to victory!

name: Run Zeus Run
short_description: 'Run Zeus Run' is an endless runner with modern mechanics of a platformer, dynamic music, incremental challenge needing patience, focus and bit of strategy. Try to get the highest score, the highest amount of coins, the highest monster kills and play until you are the best Zeus in the world.

name: Relicta
short_description: Relicta is a first-person physics-based puzzle game where you need to creatively combine magnetism and gravity to unravel the secrets of Chandra Base.

name: Captain Sabertooth and the Magic Diamond
short_description: Embark on an epic quest for treasure in Captain Sabertooth and the Magic Diamond, a pirate platform-adventure game for the whole family!

name: VolChaos
short_description: Volchaos is an ultra-challenging old school platformer.

name: Iron League
short_description: Behold the clash of heroes! Iron League is a MOBA teamfight of the warriors named 'Ironsides'. The League does not care what their motives are, as long as they give a good fight. How about you? Do you wanna be the strongest Ironside? Then, take a bold step into the Iron League!

name: Adolescent Santa Claus
short_description: This visual novel game tells the tale of a cute little Santa Clause appearing

name: Box Labyrinth
short_description: Solve environmental puzzles by pushing boxes around, making bridges, pushing buttons, and riding conveyor belts. In certain stages, you will be given a partner, and you can switch control between you and your partner at any time.

name: Jumplord
short_description: Jumplord is an action platforming experience with rogue-lite and metroidvania elements. The gameplay focus is on staying in the air by jumping off enemies, using your weapon and knowing the environment to survive each area.

name: SkydiveSim - Skydiving Simulator
short_description: SkydiveSim now enables you to experience Skydiving and BaseJumping from your headset. You can choose from Airplane, Helicopter, Balloon or BaseJumps.

name: Among the zombies
short_description: Among the zombies - you have to play as a survivor in a city filled with zombies.

name: Archer's story
short_description: Now you an archer. Kill the enemies and bring yourself the world that belongs to you. You can earn 500 achievements by killing enemies and get to the end of the level...if you can. Also, you can turn on the voice of one of the most popular streamer in the CIS, Evil Arthas.

name: King rocket
short_description: Rocket launch is an indescribable experience that you will remember for a long time. In King rocket, you have the opportunity to independently launch a rocket into the sky, and moreover, control it.

name: Replica
short_description: Replica is an interactive novel game played through a cellphone and social media. The insane experience of peeping into someone's private life through a cellphone will transform you into the state's greatest patriot.

name: Bear With Me - Collector's Edition
short_description: The Bear With Me - Collector's Edition contains all three episodes, telling the whole story of Amber and Ted. It also includes the original soundtrack, a digital art book and full puzzle and script design documents.

name: Battle for Esturia
short_description: A turn-based strategy RPG featuring an open world filled with monsters, dungeons, and interesting characters.

name: Noble In Exile / 落魄之家
short_description: As one of a once noble family, design and build your own ancient Chinese town using your remaining resources and influence. Plan and manage every industry and every store individually. Casual on simulation, hardcore on management.

name: War Of The Zombie
short_description: War of the Zombie brings together the best of turn-based simulation and real-time strategic gameplay action across the entire world at the very start of a mysterious undead outbreak.

name: MiniBikers
short_description: MiniBikers is the craziest race to reach your hands! The animated series that has captivated millions of people around the world has a new star: You! Create your own stories or change the racing rules and become a World Champion.

name: 25°N 71°W
short_description: Bermuda Triangle, 2023: An airplane is on its way to America. Suddenly the engines fail. At the end of the day there's a lone survivor: you, stranded on a desert island. Welcome to 25°N 71°W - a survival game where you have to mine, craft and build - to survive somehow!

name: Space Pilgrim Episode IV: Sol
short_description: Locked away in the most secure prison in the galaxy, with little hope of escape, Gail Pilgrim faces the most difficult ordeals of her life. Her only hope lies in trusting those who she has come to regard as her friends.

name: Summer: Jigsaw Puzzles
short_description: Colorful and bright Summer: Jigsaw Puzzles will strike your imagination in assorted piece counts, shapes and levels of difficulty. Dozens of Summer Jigsaw Puzzles to suit any puzzler. Whether you love puzzles with beaches, nostalgic scenes and family gatherings, great vacation destinations or hometown scenes.

name: Cube
short_description: Cube is a puzzle/platform minimalistic game with a rotation mechanic, your logical thinking, dexterity and precision will be challenged, try to get the best score while pass through 49 levels with progressive dificulty. It can be harder than it looks.

name: 東方苦粗芸物語 Touhou KSG Story
short_description: in Japanese language only yet. 'Overview' This game is a fan game of Touhou fan movie. The setting etc differs from what is called Touhou series of Shanghai Alice. It is an omnibus by several genres such as action, shooting, puzzle, sports.

name: 1001 Spikes
short_description: Discover the lost treasures of Ukampa in South America as Aban Hawkins searches for his estranged father, world-famous archeaologist, Jim Hawkins. Aban Hawkins races into the frozen tundra of the antarctic, undiscovered temple ruins and the vast caverns of South America in search of his father and the legendary treasure rumored to lie...

name: Slot Idler
short_description: An idle game that simulates playing on fruitmachines. Multiple machines available. Sit back, watch the reels spin and enjoy your winnings.

name: Vagrant Hearts
short_description: Enjoy pure 16-bit RPG goodness! Scarllet and Beatrice are two close sisters. One of them has the gift of healing, the more she knows about her gift the more she realizes how big her responsibility is. Features party splitting, beautiful artworks and an intricate storyline.

name: Infinity Wings - Scout & Grunt
short_description: Infinity Wings - Scout & Grunt Take control of your chosen fighter (either Scout or Grunt) in this side scrolling shooter.

name: Beyond Contact
short_description: A fiercely formidable sci-fi survival game, set on a hostile alien world that wants you dead! Alone, or with a crew, do you have what it takes to survive?

name: Wizard of Hunting Life
short_description: Wizard of Hunting Life is an action RPG game. Hunt to level up, earn money to buy equipment and challenge stronger enemies.

name: Forest Battle 森林战斗
short_description: You will encounter powerful enemies, but you can defeat them to obtain money or rewards, improve your stats or buy sellswords to fight together at your own choice, featured treasures and equipment can also make you more powerful. What are you waiting for? Come fight in the forest!

name: KING GOD DOMAIN
short_description: It is an innovative WEBGAME that can satisfy both casual and competitive players. It integrates some popular gameplay on the market. It can be said to learn from the best of others and create a game with its own characteristics. Turn-based card recruitment battle: Let players

name: Platform Builder
short_description: Let your creative spirit shine with Platform Builder and create your own 2D side-scrolling platformer games. With tons of features and the option to upload your own game assets, the possibilities are endless. Platform Builder is simple, powerful, quick to learn, and a whole lot of fun!

name: Judge Dredd 95
short_description: Respect the badge! Dredd is back, and he's cleaning up the streets of Mega-City One again in this classic shoot-em-up platformer.

name: Daenerys doesn’t want Hentai
short_description: Daenerys does not want Hentai! but John Sand does not agree. Collect chests filled with gold to make war on him! And save Daenerys!

name: Bulby - Diamond Course
short_description: Bulby - Diamond Course is a colorful 3D Platformer inspired by a classic old 16-bit game. Bulby features tons of levels in Story Mode, Coop, Multiplayer, and a built-in Course Editor to create your own courses and share with the internet.

name: Serious Sam VR: The Second Encounter
short_description: Serious Sam VR: The Second Encounter is a sequel to Serious Sam VR: The First Encounter - frantic arcade action FPS, featuring singleplay and co-op campaign, various multiplayer modes, all presented in glorious VR and with different locomotion movements.

name: Dark Quest
short_description: Dark Quest is a turn based fantasy role playing adventure game where players assume the role of a mighty barbarian on his epic quest to destroy the forces of the evil sorcerer and save the land from evil.

name: Half Wing
short_description: Rita and her parents lived in the spirit family but the demons invaded the spirit family, Rita survived and embarks on the journey of seeking the truth. This is a free and refreshing RogueLike game, designed a lot of weapons, magic skills and strike action, will let you indulge in them.

name: Peku - Space Dragon
short_description: Did you ever want to become a planet eating dragon? Do you want to crush Aztec spaceships? Buy now and transcend into another Dimension where the past and the future are the same thing.

name: DeepStates [VR]
short_description: DeepStates [VR] - Experiences designed to calm your mind and drift away. Wind down in compelling natural sceneries with dense atmospheres.

name: Haste Heist
short_description: Haste Heist is the stealth game for Action and Puzzle game enthusiasts, approachable for all ages. Easy to pick up and growing in complexity, Haste Heist keeps you on your toes as you tip-toe your way to riches.

name: Maze Art: Purple
short_description: Maze Art: Purple - is a minimalist game of simple mazes with relaxing music.

name: 3x64
short_description: Connect blocks of the same colors on the constantly changing gravity! Try to survive as long as possible - you can call for help many mighty powerups or even craft your own!

name: LAETUS.
short_description: LAETUS. is a precise 2D-Platformer that will challenge your mental fortitude and physical abilites. With simple design and gameplay mechanics, exploiting your colour-changing and movement abilites will bring you success. The developer really didn't hold back on these levels...

name: I am on Fire (小小火神）
short_description: The flames, the screams, the heat, it was like a nightmare that would never go away, and I woke up to find that I was the only one left in the land, and I went all the way south to get rid of the pain. Power by Unreal5

name: Arkin
short_description: Arkin is a first person space combat experience. Take control of the latest in starfighter technology and fight for humanity's survival against the brutal alien onslaught.

name: War Tech Fighters
short_description: War Tech Fighters - the space action game that combines the spectacular action of Japanese Anime with Hollywood Blockbusters. Configure, upgrade and customize your War Tech and dive into battle to fight back the Zatronian forces and save your galaxy!

name: Krim: The War in the Crimea 1941-42
short_description: KRIM: The War in the Crimea 1941-42 is an operational/strategic simulation of the German 11th Army’s operations in the Crimean Peninsula from late October 1941 through 4 July 1942.

name: Anticorps VR
short_description: Fantasy & unreal universe for a fun and spectacular strategy game. Miniaturized in a sick body use the field to create colonies, collect resources and make fixed defenses to protect the antibody. Disinfect all !!

name: Before The Last Hour
short_description: Play a unique rogue like game, mixing item and card games in an original post-apocalyptic universe. Explore, upgrade your equipment, fight unique monsters and bosses. And unlock all the secrets of the Before The Last Hour universe.

name: Once Upon an Electric Dream
short_description: Princess Rosavel is on a deep space mission but can’t quite remember her purpose. Can she recollect her memories and find out why she went on such a dangerous journey?

name: Triangulate
short_description: Triangulate, a game that is easy to learn but hard to master. Stack the falling triangles to create bigger triangles of the same color making them disappear along with the black background. A very simple concept, but doing it for an entire level requires quick memory, clever strategy, and great dexterity.

name: StopTime Drive
short_description: StopTime Drive is a unique turn-based racing puzzle game that combines arcade racing with a top-down view and an opportunity to think over each move. A slightly oldschool and hardcore, with the original mechanics and different ways for passing!

name: Creepy Races
short_description: Drive a vintage car down sinister roads while break pumpkins.

name: Police Air Transporter
short_description: Some say “Airplanes!” Others say “Cars!” Why choose if you can combine both? Police Air Transporter will help!

name: 100 Chests
short_description: 100 Chests is an adventure/exploration game where you are tasked with finding all one hundred chests throughout the world. Travel to different planets and find all of the chests hidden throughout each world in order to obtain new rewards.

name: Evertown
short_description: Evertown is a RTS (real-time strategy) game with some survival elements. The goal is to raise your town to make it safe (the longest you can).

name: Eurobi Racing
short_description: Eurobi Racing is a simple and addictive time killing game. Upgrade your vehicle and power-ups to maximize high-scores, purchase new cars, and compete against others! Be prepared to run into law enforcement, wonky crash physics, and buggy sound effects.

name: Quizality
short_description: Quizality - Gamers Edition is a single player multiple choice quiz, set in a Virtual Reality land. Bursting with videogame trivia, that covers all generations of gaming.

name: Lamentum
short_description: Lamentum is a pixel art survival horror game, set in New England in the mid-nineteenth century.

name: The MoneyMakers Rallye
short_description: A turn-based rally through Europe with the goal of becoming the richest!

name: Redemption Cemetery: Bitter Frost Collector's Edition
short_description: Stop the bitter Spirit of Cold from killing your ancestors!

name: DreamFly
short_description: DreamFly: The game that simulates flights in your dreams! It is a sandbox game, there are no goals. But before you start your adventure, you will need to, well, learn how to fly.

name: West Legends
short_description: Wild West Theme, MOBA Shooter, Various Modes, Battle Anytime, Anywhere.

name: BorderStrain
short_description: Explore the world of Pangea as you embark on your adventure in this Open-World 2D ARPG. Follow and unravel the fate of the Firstborne or craft your own destiny alone or with friends with full multiplayer support.

name: #KILLALLZOMBIES
short_description: #KILLALLZOMBIES is an insane twin-stick zombie shooter with Twitch streaming interactions, where you survive hordes of zombies on a dynamically changing arena and spectators may affect gameplay via special Twitch chat commands.

name: Snake Deluxe
short_description: Nine different game modes, achievements, leaderboards and a quirky soundtrack. It's Snake Deluxe.

name: Hero Zero
short_description: Become a hero, build your own Hide-Out and start by saving your neighbourhood. Level up your skills, collect incredibly weird superhero gadgets, and join a superhero team to save the world!

name: Gloom and Doom
short_description: Gloom and Doom is a visual novel throwback to 90s slacker movies - complete with the solitude and sarcastic retorts - but with a supernatural twist. Push a powerful but unmotivated wraith to complete his stagnated quest to enter heaven, while trying to kill the suicidal but unkillable Doom Bringer.

name: Blood Card 2: Dark Mist
short_description: Dark Mist is a card game that combines elements of the roguelike deckbuilder genre with enemies that appear in waves. Defeat monsters and level up during battle to keep yourself going.

name: 夜之归途 Night Homing
short_description: 【官方Q群：213634733】扮演小魔女寻找回家的路，在路途中结识到各个种族的萌萌哒的使魔，召唤使魔替小魔女迎击阻挠前进的敌人吧！

name: Avatar Raiders
short_description: Get ready, the zombies are coming! Avatar Raiders is a viewer game for Twitch streamers. Your viewers can join the defense against endless waves of zombies. Let your viewers join via your chat, throw emotes or grenades and compete together against a mighty army of super cute zombies.

name: This Merchant Life
short_description: This Merchant Life is a trading strategy game set in the troubled medieval kingdom of Peregrine. Turn a rickety wooden cart, two horses and a few coins into a thriving entrepreneurial triumph!

name: Viper Attack
short_description: Inspired by classic arcade games, Viper Attack is a fast, addictive arcade shoot-up! Master the challenge and fight your way through many brutal levels

name: Keep Wall
short_description: Blocked bullets of tanks by blocks of trucks, keep wall with a full of blocks

name: Majin Woman
short_description: Control a giant girl and protect the earth from invasion in this circular style side-scrolling shooter. In the name of world peace, you can use melee combat to pave a path through your foes (then devour them!) or obliterate the legions with a giant holy machine gun!

name: Burst Drive
short_description: DASH, BOOST, DRIFT, SHOOT! A challenging space shooter with tons of eye candy. A game to master for the highest score or to have a break with while waiting for other games or just to have some couch co-op fun.

name: Megalo Polis
short_description: Do you have what it takes to survive the cutthroat competition of the campaign trail and become the next US President? It’s time to rub elbows, oversell your scant promises, and engineer a few scandals―because nobody gets into the White House without getting a little dirty.

name: Escape Simulator
short_description: First-person puzzler you can play solo or in an online co-op (best with 2-3 players, but playable with more). Explore a set of highly interactive escape rooms. Move furniture, pick up and examine everything, smash pots and break locks! Supports community rooms through the level editor.

name: Viking Village
short_description: A fun minimalist RTS - build and defend your Viking Village from enemies like Knights, Pirates and Barbarians. Attack enemy villages on randomly generated islands. Play 1v1 multiplayer!

name: Monsters and Weapons
short_description: Monsters and Weapons is a strategic rogue-like game based on decision making. You fight your way through 3 areas as one of ten different classes. Slay monsters, buy items in shops and spend your resources wisely. In Monsters and Weapons every decision counts!

name: Biotope
short_description: Biotope will be the most detailed and realistic aquarium simulator on the market. Biotope makes it possible to create complex aquarist ecosystems and simulate realistic life cycles of plants and fish.

name: Anima
short_description: Immerse yourself in the world of Anima, a powerful entity with magical powers. Help Anima in her quest to obtain freedom from the prison she's been trapped by her own kind.

name: CUBG: Car Unknown's Battlegrounds
short_description: New survival by battle cars of war with many guns in battleground royal 3D pixel

short_description: Turn-based planning and realtime battles, with a choice-driven story, all set in a dystopian future

name: Rocwood Academy

name: Onyx
short_description: Play as Rowan, a secluded witch with a bad temper, in this intense adventure worth 30-40 hours of gameplay!

name: Rollfall: Quest of Acceleration
short_description: RollFall is what you'd expect, Roll the cube and let it Fall! This sounds easy but it gets tricky fast.

name: Decisive Campaigns: Barbarossa
short_description: Command a true operational structure. Can you balance and prioritize three different Theatres in order to achieve your objective?

name: SuperSecret
short_description: SuperSecret is a Tiny Adventure made just for You. A very special Secret is hidden on the strange islands of Prisoner’s Keys. It is yours to find, but first you must find it. Run, ride, and puzzle your way to discovery.

name: Puss in Boots: Fear Not Hooman
short_description: The legendary Puss in Boots have to go through the worst to save his hooman. Anansi tricks Puss into retrieving Mjolnir, the most fearsome and powerful weapon in existence from Land of the Dead. Now, you too can be part of the fairy world!

name: Valknut
short_description: An old school city building RTS where your people's greatest threat are the elements.

name: Wolfenstein: Youngblood
short_description: Wolfenstein: Youngblood is the first modern co-op Wolfenstein adventure. Team up with a friend or play solo as one of BJ Blazkowicz’s twin daughters and wield a powerful arsenal of new weapons, gadgets, and abilities to liberate Paris from the Nazis.

name: Isaac the Adventurer

name: AISZplus

Experience the intense 4 player co-op narrative campaign, competitive multiplayer as human or Ridden, and frenetic gameplay that keeps you in the action.

name: VireFit
short_description: LOAD THE WORLD OF GREAT SPORT. Box, tennis and basketball try it in virtual reality. Get ready for the real training, practice strikes and throws, develop agility and accuracy, set records and compete with friends.

name: TrenchesWIP

name: Randy And Teddy Adventure Road
short_description: A puzzle 2.5D platformer where Randy, main character, and Teddy, his pup go on an amazing Adventure Road! Go with them and travel to 5 worlds where you'll meet pesky robots that will make this journey hard. Solve challenging puzzles and earn stars and achievements in this Mario-like platformer.

name: Worms W.M.D
short_description: The worms are back in their most destructive game yet. With a gorgeous, hand-drawn 2D look, brand new weapons, the introduction of crafting, vehicles and buildings plus the return of some much-loved classic weapons and gameplay, Worms W.M.D is the best worms experience ever.

name: El Tango de la Muerte
short_description: Do the tango to win the heart of your loved one! Each song in this casual RHYTHM game will unveil the story of Luciano and Martita. Influenced by games like OSU and Crypt of the Necrodancer, with a pinch of melodramatic humor, inspired by the best Latin American soap operas!

name: NERVE

name: Daemonsgate

name: Ironheart
short_description: Pilot and customize a giant iron war mech in this alternate medieval history! The Papacy, Caliphate, and the Mongols are at war, and they all have mechs.

short_description: Play as the snarky Witch Thief, on her quest to steal all the magic she possibly can! Naturally those who have the magic don't want to give it up so she does what she does best. That is, kicking in the front door and taking it all anyway!

name: Fire and Steel
short_description: Fire & Steel is the first chapter of a fast-paced, old-school, arcade aerial shooter where you burn down the mighty armies of World War II as young Dragon Aiden!

name: Tank of War-VR

name: TRANCE VR
short_description: Going for the biggest and fastest VR experience available. Make massive jumps to collect checkpoints and race against time as you dodge and shoot drones.

name: Border Control
short_description: Defend America from murderous zombie hordes, waves of unwashed orcs, and the military stength of enemy nations all bent on the destruction of the homeland.

name: Only If
short_description: Only If is a surreal first person adventure-puzzle game. You play as Anthony Clyde, who, after a heavy night of partying, wakes up to find himself in an unfamiliar bed with no memory of the previous night's events.

name: SACRALITH : The Archer`s Tale
short_description: SACRALITH: The Archer's Tale is a VR bow-and-arrow shooter. Help your AI companions as you pass various locations together toward the game's main goal: the magic stone called Sacralith that grants you power over dragons.

name: Resthedex

When the countdown begins on clocktower, you are going to need to act fast!When the countdown ends you'll face against enemies which will destroy your city unless you take some precautions!

name: Extortion

name: 60 Seconds! Reatomized

name: Bunker Punks

name: Marimba VR
