name: VRでエミリアと異世界生活-膝枕&添寝編
short_description: The app allows you to enter the world of 'Re:ZERO - Starting Life in Another World.'

name: Say Goodbye
short_description: This visual novel about an ordinary man with his typical problems. Suddenly, you got a report that your distant cousin died in a car crash. Fortunately, her daughter wasn't with her. You take the girl under your wing. But soon, something starts to go wrong...

name: Broken Robot
short_description: Broken Robot - 2D side-view platformer built on the physical control of broken robots, each race you get a new robot that does not have the best balance.

name: Endless Treasure Hunt
short_description: Endless Treasure Hunt is a colorful endless runner, your job is to collect as many coins and materials as possible to buy new submarines, warships and helicopters to increase the maximum distance traveled.

name: Trigger Witch
short_description: Trigger Witch is a 2D, twin-stick, action/adventure game set in an odd open world where magic is mundane, but firearms are the new unknown! You are Colette, and as you graduate from the Stock, a curious man invades your world... Welcome to the world of Witchcraft and Triggery!

name: The Annoying Game
short_description: Run, jump, die, repeat. Help Teddy on his journey through the complex, 2D dungeon, where every step will try (and usually succeed) to kill him. Are you patient enough to finish one of the most difficult games of the year?

name: Rubber and Lead
short_description: Rubber & Lead is a 2D Top Down Vehicle Combat RPG- Shoot your way through post-apocalyptic Arizona. Go on missions, upgrade your cars, equip your weapons, and blast away your enemies!

name: Jewel Match Twilight 3 Collector's Edition
short_description: Send shivers down your spine... with this creepy-crawly Match-3 quest that will chill you to the bone and make your flesh crawl. Discover eerie scenes and restore abandoned buildings, but beware of marauding creatures in this dark land.

name: Neko Candy Shop
short_description: Relaxing puzzle game with adorable neko girls.

name: En Route: Space
short_description: En Route: Space is a 2 player co-op puzzle game where you need each other to figure your way out through the mysteries of space. Work together, open your mind and trust one another to persevere this adventure.

name: Damn virgins
short_description: Seven virgins will be sacrified unless you help them! Just to clarify, your help is only needed to avoid the sacrifice, solving their virginity problem is a bit more complicated as you will discover. FMV adventure inspired in classic adventure games. Solving puzzles usually unlocks a videoclip that reveals the plot.

name: Sphere 3: Rage of the Devastator
short_description: Sphere 3 brings you exciting PvP battles in every corner of the world, realistic non-targeting combat, unique universe with its intriguing history and memorable characters, political intrigue, struggle to control the ancient castles, engaging crafting system and much more!

name: Monomino
short_description: Cheerfully wandering across blocky terrain, the Monomino babies haven’t a care in the world. But little do they know they’re walking into peril. You are responsible to deliver them to safety.

name: Space Fat: To the Core
short_description: Starting in space battle your way through all the layers of the atmosphere and into the planet itself in this roguelike vertically scrolling shooter. Can you survive long enough and make it To The Core?

name: Starlord
short_description: You are a Starlord. In command of a planet but hungry for real power. Your ultimate aim: to control the entire Galaxy and enable your family dynasty to rule forever. But one thousand other Starlords have similar ambitions!

name: Snow Trail
short_description: Snow Trail is a puzzle game that revolves around pushing snow blocks in order to reach a goal. Snow blocks can be pushed into water to create bridges, placed on pressure plates to open certain areas and much more! With 100 levels and multiple mechanics, each level has its own tricks!

name: Qvabllock
short_description: «Qvabllock» — pixemalism game with elements of puzzle, with minimalistic gameplay. Collect all the colored squares to take the main green and go through all 30 levels.

name: Starship
short_description: Starship is a game where you have to destroy your enemies while dodging asteroids as well as various space dangers in an endless survival!

name: MOAR - Appeteaser
short_description: The sandbox version of Mayhem on a Rainbow - VR. It offers endless fun with arena and wave shooters, spiced with mini games and upcoming new features. A glimpse into the wacky apocalypse where zombies fly in slow motion and chickens lay airstrikes! Saddle up your unicorn and fire up the spaceboat!

name: Overclocked: A History of Violence
short_description: Set against the backdrop of a catastrophic thunderstorm raging over New York City, Overclocked explores an archetypical, yet actual condition of mankind: violence. This psychological thriller mixes frightening fictional thriller elements using innovative narrative structures.

name: Market Dominion
short_description: The Cold War quietly rages on around the world as tensions rise between states. During these turbulent times, you are tasked as the CEO of a new, enterprising company. Can you overcome obstacles to become a burgeoning company and dominate the market?

name: Plug Me
short_description: Plug Me is a tricky puzzle platform where the timer is a physical object in the game world! You are able to walk on the green parts of this bar as a platform, but you must be careful not to fall off as the power is drained.

name: Big Screen Games - Pack 1
short_description: Time to bring the party into your living room. Introducing Big Screen Games, a party game experience where players use their phones as controllers - and play together on the big screen. Prepare for disastrous doodles, awkward face-offs and a pink cow that wants to ruin your day.

name: Stones of the Revenant
short_description: Retro-Arcade style platformer with six unique playable characters. Team up with local co-op or try to defeat the Revenant and his minions solo in this challenging quest to save the realm of the living!

name: Pressure Overdrive
short_description: Pressure Overdrive is arcade twin-stick madness on hot wheels in a colorful bathtub-punk setting!

name: On Board Remastered
short_description: Stein bock games is always improving it's products in order to give a good gaming experience to our customer . We are always listening to our customers to find out what are their needs and wants in their game. We value their opinion since to us it is one of the most important ingredient one can use in order to make a video game.

name: Our Beautiful Earth 2
short_description: Find hidden objects, animals and different items in the most beautiful places of the world. Explore a variety of wonderful scenes and experience different customs and cultures, also see many different kinds of animals.

name: Asemblance: Oversight
short_description: 'Asemblance: Oversight' is a first-person exploration and puzzle-based game.  You are part of a team of scientists and engineers charged with using a classified technology to aid in recreating the human mind.

name: Incitement 3
short_description: An expansive dystopian sci-fi world awaits you! Equipment customization, a varied cast and an epic story in this sci-fi epic from Astronomic Games.

name: Under: Depths of Fear
short_description: Enter the mind of traumatized WW1 veteran Alexander Dockter and experience the terrorizing nightmare of trying to escape a sinking ocean liner while being haunted by the most terrifying entities you’ve ever come across.

name: Angkor: Runefall
short_description: Save an magical village in this extraordinary Match-3 game! Use the ancient runes to cast magic and defeat the dark powers.

name: Chester One
short_description: Now FREE and worth every penny! A love letter to classic platforming action and 90s animation oddness. Eat magical candies to change the art of the world around you as you fight through 40 levels unlocking new Chesters, battling strange baddies, finding secret secrets, and reclaiming your cupcakes!

name: Starcaller
short_description: Starcaller is a fast-paced, puzzle solving, score attack virtual reality game. Solve multiple unique puzzles as fast as possible, complete the ritual before time runs out, and become the Starcaller. It's easy to pick up and play, hard to master, but fun for everyone.

name: A Wizard's Lizard
short_description: Conquer the forces of Death in A Wizard’s Lizard, an action RPG for Windows, Mac, and Linux. Explore ever-changing dungeons, filled with powerful weapons and items. Battle back the hordes of evil. Rescue villagers to improve your town and increase your power for your next trek into the dungeon.

name: Aztech Forgotten Gods
short_description: Aztech Forgotten Gods, the cyber-stone universe action-adventure game that follows Achtli, a young Aztec woman, in her quest to become a hero by wielding the power of the gods.

name: Noodle Jump
short_description: Jump, Noodle, Jump! Or you will get eaten by the horrifying giants calling themselves 'humanity'! In this 3D platformer with partially randomly generated levels and challenging endbosses, you need to run for your life and survive... Will there ever be an end to your torture or even a chance for payback?!

name: Celtabula
short_description: Celtabula is a Celtic-style puzzle game with imitation board game, where each level has many solutions. Think: if you can not go through the level for a long time, maybe you should try a different approach?

name: Puzzle & Chess
short_description: Puzzle & Chess is a relaxing and minimalist game that mixes puzzle challenges with chess moves. Click on pieces, solve the puzzles with a pleasant and relaxing environment. You don't need to know how to play chess to have fun. No score, no timer and no pressure.

name: Last Hope
short_description: Your ship explodes and you are left desperately clutching to a tiny planet in an attempt to power your suit until help arrives. Clutch to life in the eerily serene beauty of space with an epic orchestral soundtrack, Last Hope will have your heart racing in all the best ways.

name: Delicious - Emily's Miracle of Life
short_description: Help Emily through the ups and downs of her pregnancy! 👶 🍼

name: Titty Crush
short_description: Titty Crush is a lighthearted Match 3 game with cute anime characters which doesn't take itself too serious.Meet the girls while experiencing the story or hunt for new highscores in the arcade modeand unlock some new outfits for our girls for future dates ;)

name: Panda in the clouds
short_description: Panda in the clouds is a grid movement platform puzzle game where your challenge will be to reach the flag and fulfill all the objectives of the level.

name: The Land of Pain
short_description: The Land of Pain is a Lovecraftian horror adventure. After something strange appears in the woods, you'll have to learn how to survive as you fend off a dark and disturbing evil. Flee from an unrelenting enemy, solve puzzles, and unravel the ancient mystery that's befallen this land.

name: RCRacer VR
short_description: RCRacer VR is an action packed radio controlled toy car simulator. Be in the middle of the action as you control your car to victory.

name: Fran Bow
short_description: Fran Bow is a creepy adventure game that tells the story of Fran, a young girl struggling with a mental disorder and an unfair destiny.

name: Archer Guardian VR : The Chapter Zero
short_description: Archer Guardian VR Player's perspective of VR shooting game

name: My Dear Frankenstein
short_description: This game is an exploratory adventure game that wanders around the city at night. Become a newborn monster and search for lost pieces of your heart!

name: Book of Beasts — The Collectible Card Game CCG
short_description: Book of Beasts is a strategic collectible card game, with cards representing the eponymous beasts, inspired by myths from around the world. In the game, two beast summoners compete against each other with their decks of cards and try to outwit each other.

name: Discord Bot - Controls
short_description: Make your own Discord bot today with Discord Bot - Controls. Use our easy and modern interface to design your own Discord bot.

name: Slider
short_description: Sliding puzzle game.

name: Malus
short_description: Malus is an Isometric Action RPG game aiming to bring back the nostalgic feeling of Diablo 1 but with a unique combat system.

name: Scary Maze
short_description: Scary Maze is an exciting horror-action hybrid where you run through a maze killing zombies, ready to eat you as soon as they can.

name: Return to Earth
short_description: Return to Earth — a dynamic shooter subgenre of 'survival'.The player assumes the role of a soldier who must defend your planet from the attack waves of enemy invaders.

name: Visualis Dynamics
short_description: Educational software to show a large number of mechanics problems, from pendulum to planetary orbits.

name: Video World
short_description: ​Video World is a Halloween synth-pop musical about working at a video store. It is a companion video-game to the EP 'Video World' from Australian synth-pop artist Monster Mansion.

name: HEARTBEAT
short_description: Make friends, make enemies, go fishing, collect cards, beat up sharks, beat up tigers, obtain the denim blade, train a fuzzy infantile insect for battle, and uncover ancient secrets in this monster-filled adventure.

name: my brother lives in a canyon
short_description: my brother lives in a canyon is a short adventure game about two brothers reminiscing over short-wave radios.

name: D-Corp
short_description: D-Corp is a couch co-op game for up to 4 players. Work together on tasks such as turret maintenance and harvesting natural resources while being under continuous attack by alien cacti!

name: My Coloring Book: Food and Beverage
short_description: Presenting you a simple yet inspiring coloring book which will help you spend your leisure time in a fun way. Play with colors, be creative and have fun!

name: The Neon Boy
short_description: The Neon Boy is extremely agressive platformer in which the neon guy escapes from the captivity

name: 校长模拟器
short_description: 校长模拟器是一款开罗式玩法的休闲类模拟经营游戏。在游戏中玩家将以高中校长的身份管理整个学校，充分调动学校的资源，完成上级布置的任务。将学校建立成为全国一流的高中。

name: Spark Five
short_description: Welcome to Project Spark. Help our little android friend navigate across multiple, challenging levels in search of bio-matter. You see, we are in desperate need of those primarily to restore human civilization and undo the damage caused by our own problem child - Artificial Intelligence.

name: Override: Mech City Brawl
short_description: No gears, no glory! Control gigantic robots and duke it out in this 3D mech brawler! Epic battles await in local and online Versus mode, 4-player Co-op – where each player controls one part of a mech – and a single-player game mode. Each mech has its own gameplay style, special moves, and finishers.

name: Movie Studio Boss: The Sequel
short_description: You have just been appointed the head of a new Movie Studio and have been given 10 (now 50) years to make it the most successful studio around. You are up against seven other computer controlled Studios all trying to be the best Studio in the world!

name: Lucent Bounds
short_description: Lucent Bounds is a short and challenging 3D platformer. Make your way through an alien ocean planet by jumping, dashing, slamming, gliding, and swinging about. Avoid hazards, collect treasures, and challenge yourself in speed runs.

name: Pro Pain Labs
short_description: Pro Pain Labs is a 2D platformer set within a facility designed to test the durability of robots. Hop, skip, and jump your way through levels littered with dangerous hazards to avoid.

name: Burger Shop 2
short_description: Make tasty food items to serve hungry customers in this fast-paced food making game!

name: 推箱子(Push Box)
short_description: More than 132 levels designed each with an answer and an increasing difficulty in this game, wishing for better ideas of yours.

name: Grim Facade: Mystery of Venice Collector’s Edition
short_description: Two young ladies have gone missing and it’s up to you to find them in Grim Façade: Mystery of Venice, a fun Hidden Object game!

name: Tasty Planet
short_description: Control a tiny ball of grey goo with the ability to eat anything smaller than itself. The more it eats, the bigger it gets! Soon you'll be able to eat the entire planet!

name: Blade Runner: Enhanced Edition
short_description: Armed with your investigative skills and the tools of the Blade Runner trade, you'll be immersed in a world that lives and breathes around you with breakthrough lighting and visual effects. Your ability to survive will be put to the test in the richest game environment ever created.

name: Sudoku3D
short_description: Sudoku puzzle - from easy to hardcore... Fully random generation with a choice of field size and difficulty.

name: Crazy Race
short_description: Crazy Race is a fast-paced arcade racing game with low poly graphics and great physics.

name: Talisman: Prologue
short_description: Talisman Prologue is an adaptation of the classic fantasy board game Talisman by Games Workshop. This version focuses on single player experience. An epic tale of dice rolling and card drawing takes you on a quest throughout the land to rescue Princesses, slay Dragons and recover lost artefacts.

name: Leowald
short_description: Adventure awaits in the kingdom of Leowald--a land of treasure, ruins, and murderous pirate cats.

name: Rescue your chickens
short_description: This game is a story of a father who is left alone to take care of his chickens. You must use your skill to avoid all sort of forest creatures and to save all 10 chickens. Fight bosses, and be prepared for an epic finale. The game difficulty start from easy to hard making this game last for hours of fun gameplay.

name: Super Kaiju
short_description: Super Kaiju – the greatest and most anticipated sports tournament on the planet is here!

name: Push For Emor
short_description: Push For Emor is an open world(s) SciFi FPS RPG with light RTS building elements thrown in for good measure. Fight your way across 11 planets, engage in space combat, disable enemy craft and board enemy wrecks, explore abandoned space stations and defeat evil planet governors.

name: Realms of the Haunting
short_description: Forged in the Beginning and protected by the Seven Seals, there lies a place where thought and creation intertwine. The center for all realms of existence, it is the balancing force between good and evil, man and spirit. A focal point for all energies, and the one element that has kept the consuming nature of darkness at bay... Until now.

name: Buck Bradley Comic Adventure 2
short_description: Buck and Ciroki load their bicycle with wheelbarrow-sidecar onto a train headed towards New Milan: it seems that the creator of this futuristic city, the Architect, may have the knowledge to make Ciroki human again! Look for clues that will help you solve riddles and unravel the puzzle!

name: Planet of the Apes: Last Frontier
short_description: Planet of the Apes: Last Frontier is a narrative adventure game of conquest, betrayal, and survival. When the fates of a tribe of apes and a band of human survivors intertwine, two worlds collide as their precarious existence hangs in the balance.

name: Race Project
short_description: Win or loose, it's easy! The rules are simple, be the first who crosses the finish line or survive. Believe me, don't trust anyone!

name: Chicken Coop
short_description: Chicken Coop - Top Down View is a game where you have to beat eggs and provide yourself with offspring. Beat them in the right direction so that the chickens get their long-awaited eggs. Your work will be duly rewarded, happy chickens and lots of chickens.

name: Hidden & Dangerous 2: Courage Under Fire
short_description: Hidden & Dangerous 2 is a first and third person tactical shooter that builds upon the tremendous success of Hidden & Dangerous. You lead a small squad of Allied soldiers deep behind enemy lines, to carry out secret missions during World War II.

name: Eggcelerate!
short_description: Eggcelerate! is a silly yet very challenging time-trial racing game where you try over and over again to improve your time without dropping an egg.

name: Steady
short_description: A deceptively simple movement game that will challenge you through a set of 50 unique levels. Dodge moving obstacles, cannon balls, and spinning contraptions to see how far you can go.

name: Unleashed
short_description: Plunge into the brutal Mystria, a corrupt world founded on sorcery and lies. Explore a dense open-world sandbox RPG with a rich history and narrative and a rewarding combat system brought to you by a multi-award-winning team.

name: Monster Girl Manager
short_description: Summon, consult, and train procedurally generated monster girls in this dungeon roguelite. Evaluate the strengths and weaknesses of different monster types as you prepare the ultimate team to defeat dangerous enemies and collect powerful artifacts. (Game is SFW)

name: Nine Lives or Less
short_description: Nine Lives or Less is a rogue-like action game about a cat going on an adventure with a special jetpack.

name: HUBE: Seeker of Achievements
short_description: HUBE: Seeker of Achievements - is a hardcore-platformer game. Try to open all game levels, and collect all achievements.

name: Robo Instructus
short_description: Robo Instructus is a puzzle game in which players manoeuvre a robot by issuing instructions via a simple programming language. As players progress through the game they unlock new functions to overcome new puzzles, each of which can be solved in multiple ways.

name: 飞花令 春饼
short_description: Battle with computer, by reciting poems

name: Gakuen Club
short_description: Gakuen Club is a school life love story that begins when you discover a secret at your academy, setting off a chain of events that you never imagined. Enjoy the different distinct and unique characters along with their own stories and wonderful voices.

name: 漏气宝大冒险 Balloon Man Adventure
short_description: 《Balloon Man Adventure》 is a parkour game

name: Lolly Pang VR
short_description: Charming Aliens are coming! Lolly Pang VR is the VR bow game that you defend the cookie factory from the aliens who want to get cookies. Defeat all the aliens and protect you cookie factory!

name: G-senjou no Maou - The Devil on G-String
short_description: You play as Azai Kyousuke, the son of an infamous gangster. Kyousuke knows what he likes and lets nothing stand in his way in getting what he wants. Referred to as God by his classmates, he often enjoys listening to Bach and 'working' part time for his stepfather.

name: Sakura Swim Club
short_description: In Sakura Swim Club, follow the story of Kaede, just your average guy. Upon transferring to a new school, he meets two beautiful girls in the swim club. Things haven't gone well for the swim club lately, but with Kaede's help, that all changes.

name: Past Particles
short_description: Recording and Playback. Solving a puzzle with your past self. High intelligence and mechanics needed.

name: Why War?
short_description: Why War? is a 2D shooter adventure game about two soldiers from different sides who don't understand why they are fighting each other, so instead they break all the rules and team up to stop the war. You are trying to destroy the leaders in both sides and prove that war isn't the solution to any problem.

name: QuestEvent
short_description: QuestEvent is a Adventure RPG. You will have a world to explore, practice different Skills and doing Quests. The graphics of the game are Pokémon likely. But the Content is based on several huge MMORPG's.

name: Grim Earth
short_description: Adventure through a Grim and yet beautiful Earth, teeming with life, humor and killer robots! Features hand-drawn art, a blend of action & exploration ... and hidden chests with hexadecimal codes :D

name: Yuzi Lims: Hentai
short_description: Yuzi Lims: Hentai - is a game in which you need to identify 10 differences between two pictures and click on the difference.

name: Cellar
short_description: A story-focused game about six strangers stuck together for a month, and a machine that must be kept running.

name: To End All Wars
short_description: Ageod’s To End All Wars is a grand strategy game set during World War One. Players will take control over one of the major powers that so desperately fought for control over Europe and to end all wars.

name: Do Not Feed the Monkeys
short_description: A digital voyeur simulator where you watch strangers through surveillance cameras. Invade their privacy and witness their most intimate moments, but don’t interact with the subjects – anything could happen if you dare feed the monkeys!

name: Blob Boy
short_description: Roll, Bounce, and Swing your way to the top of the mountain in this 3d momentum-based precision platformer! Be warned, this game is NOT for the faint of heart! you will fail, many... MANY times! Are you up to the challenge?

name: Beat Blast
short_description: Create musical beats that kill. Beat Blast is a music maker, bullet hell, dungeon crawler, roguelite. Battle through dungeons and defeat big bosses. Collect weapons, passives and musical instruments!

name: The Cup
short_description: The Cup is a fast-paced rogue-like dungeon crawler, where adventurers fight off hordes of enemies to find the ultimate prize, the Cup of Life. Can you fend off countless minions and slay the boss?

name: Spin Rush
short_description: Spin Rush is 2D arcade game, where you have to collect dots and match colors.

name: Superbugs: Awaken
short_description: A Communication-Based, Co-Op game for 2P. Play either as the Scientist or the Hunter with communication as your only weapon to save your precious cat, Mimi, from deadly Superbugs!

name: Bright Bob
short_description: Bright Bob - a Fascinating and colorful game of skill and reaction, Bob only has time to blink :)

name: Santa Jump
short_description: Santa Jump is a 2D side-scrolling arcade platformer about Santa giving out gifts to all the kids for the holiday. For a larger area of coverage, he needs to climb higher and higher, jumping on platforms.

name: EXIT - The Curse of Ophir
short_description: An exciting Escape Room experience awaits you! A famous writer has disappeared at the Hotel Ophir and you've been hired to find him! Rumors of gold, unexplained phenomena, and a curse surround this remote place. Can you solve the disappearance of Tory Harlene and escape from the hotel?

name: Sword of Hypotenuse
short_description: Cut, squash, and headbutt other tofu ninja in this adventure searching for the truth of the Pythagoreans' Theorem! Explore various world permutations and collect rare Alogon history as you break and link different worlds to create the true Number Line.

name: Dantes Bullet Inferno
short_description: Dantes Bullet Inferno is a shoot-em-up where the player fights against hell as Dante. This top down shooter includes a speedrun mode called time-dilation.

name: Mike was Сursed
short_description: In a quiet Canadian town with a population of 17 thousand, people start disappearing; especially women and children. A spouse of a disappeared woman discovered what happened, and returns from his business trip. Once he comes back, he realizes that his family was not the only one to disappear.

name: Galaxy Union
short_description: Economic based 4x, puts you in a large galaxy with hundreds of systems as a CEO of a colony destined to rule over all competitors, features dozens or more opponent CEOs.

name: Alice!
short_description: Alice chased the rabbit. Then, she fell. she fell from top to bottom. Slam! The noise echoed. Shoot, my butt. It must be the destiny of 「Alices」 to suffer. But still, shouldn’t she watch out for herself to avoid going through such incidence in the 21st century?

name: Blocks!: Hammer of the Scots
short_description: Hammer of the Scots brings both the rebellion of the Braveheart, William Wallace, and the uprising of Robert the Bruce, the Bandit King, to life. As English, you seek to pacify Scotland by controlling all important nobles. The Scots also seeks their allegiance to support the struggle for freedom.

name: Slap City
short_description: Slap City is a Seriously Fun platform fighter with a perfect mix of characters from the Ludosity universe. Play Locally or Online. Slap it hard in Ranked or fast and loose in Slap Ball game mode. We are the original inventors of Clutch Technology.

name: Occultus - Mediterranean Cabal
short_description: A thrilling quest at the heart of a powerful occult society. Dive into the heart of an unbelievable investigation set against stunning Italian backdrops. Make your way through the many hidden object scenes and solve the increasingly original puzzles. Your time is limited, so warm up those gray cells!

name: Dial-In
short_description: Traverse the analogue signals of an old TV in Dial-In! A reflex-based puzzle platformer that takes you through many varying channels, each with their own unique themes and music. Explore Over 100 Stages with classic and modern takes on platforming formulas, all in an immersive 2D style.

name: Apple Slash
short_description: Repel an invasion of mysterious charming creatures in a vast murky marshland. Strike your foes in a God-like slash-based manner and experience ambiguous encounters brimming with personality.

name: Yashik
short_description: You play for an unusual character. You must pass challenging puzzles. How to? By creating your own platforms! Some platforms are bouncy, some can move. But you only get a few. Use them wisely, player.

name: Youmandriver
short_description: Do you know how to drive a fast car on open roads and a lot of traffic ? With realistic vehicle physics, traffic density and roads ? Realistic roads are designed for legal speed, not to let a gamer be 80% of the time full throttle driving a 500 HP car...

name: War Operations
short_description: Try to get out alive in this epic game of War and Destruction!

name: Stories of Bethem: Full Moon
short_description: Be enchanted by a classic style action-packed adventure full of secrets, puzzles, unrequited love, exploration and loads of madness. Discover the amazing story of Khoma and the Witches of Bethem.

name: Marvel: Ultimate Alliance 2
short_description: As Civil War is stirred, Iron Man leads the Pro-Registration side while Captain America spearheads the stand on Anti-Registration.

name: Bounty Hunter: Space Detective
short_description: Take the role as the new Detective on Space Port Aurexia, your assigned with checking the traffic coming into the Port and ensure that no bad eggs get through, we know who we're looking for but it get's really difficult when rush hour hits, you're our only hope detective!

name: ロストカラーズ／再装版 / LOSTCOLORS
short_description: A world without color 'Lost Colors'. In order to get rid of the evil that has befallen him, Real travels back and forth between worlds of color, solving the mysteries of the world.

name: Aim Hero
short_description: Aim Hero is an ultimate solution for practicing firing accuracy to do better in FPS games.

name: Star Sweet
short_description: The goal is simple as a roasted cucumber. The gambling field is studded with jewels, you need to swipe the same diamonds in a row to clear the field.

name: Twelve Floors Below.
short_description: A claustrophobic horror game taking place in an elevator.

name: Baklava Simulator
short_description: Build your own market. You can buy the materials to make the baklava and have it done by your staff. In addition, many functions of the content is located.

name: Googass
short_description: This is a sci-fi RPG type game inspired by things such as Final Fantasy 7 and Die Hard. It is a party based RPG maker game with 7 playable characters.

name: Spheriums
short_description: As Arcos in a single-player journey to rescue your civilization, you will discover forgotten weapons to defeat the Drainers. During your adventure, you will need to upgrade your equipment, gather resources, solve puzzles, and travel to enchanting worlds filled with unique creatures.

name: Gunscape
short_description: Gunscape provides easy-to-use tools based on a block-placement interface everybody's already familiar with to create all types of maps. Don't like building stuff? Then just blast your way through hordes of monsters or duel with other players!

name: Dark Slime
short_description: Go through a huge number of caves, solve many puzzles, and fight against the strongest enemies!

name: LIRE
short_description: Reveal the story behind the haunted mansion while looking for Sebastian. LIRE is a survival horror video game inspired by old horror RPG maker games 'IB' and 'The Witch's House'.

name: Chambered
short_description: Chambered is a single-player, story-based VR shooting game with an emphasis on weapon progression. Featuring trackpad locomotion, 13 guns, and 140+ weapon mods, Chambered is sure to keep you playing for hours.

name: Pitch Perfect Ear Training
short_description: A quiz game that tests how pitch perfect your ears are! Review notes/pitches, intervals, chords and scales. You can also try to guess the key of a musical piece created using a proprietary custom music writing algorithm. Fresh music to keep your ears fresh!

name: fox soldier
short_description: 'FOXSOLDIER'is an action RPG hardcore sci-fi adventure game with multiplayer competition as the core.Only use the left and right buttons of the mouse to operate the 4 action systems of shooting, long sword, kung fu and locomotive.

name: Space Soldier
short_description: Space Soldier is a single-player adventure game, you will play the role of a Protagonist to clear the enemy in the level

name: Huntsman: The Orphanage (Halloween Edition)
short_description: MORE STORY THAN GORY! A HYBRID OF ALTERNATIVE HORROR AND CREEPYPASTA...Welcome to the Halloween Edition v1.03! Take a deep breath, dim the lights, put on your headphones...Non-linear first-person gameplay lets you explore Grimhaven Orphanage and discover the characters who once lived there – voiced by Dan Bull, Chuck Huber and Raychul...

name: Omno
short_description: A single-player journey of discovery through an ancient world of wonders, created by solo developer Jonas Manke.

name: Captain Lycop : Invasion of the Heters
short_description: A space shooter mixing adventure, action and tactics. Face off against pen-pushing insects, merciless enemies and epic bosses. Your only hope is to banish all cowardice and follow a virtuous path.

name: DungeonEpic
short_description: DungeonEpic is an old-school Roguelike with a few modern twists. Dungeon City is famed worldwide for its mystical dungeons, and hopeful adventurers come from throughout the land to test their skill and seek their fortune within. Seek out the secrets of the dungeons, and even learn to build your own!

name: Spinch
short_description: Transcend the material realm and assume your true form as Spinch, a hyper-agile organism consumed by the quest to rescue a litter of its missing offspring, in this side-scrolling, psychedelic platformer from the mind of award-winning Canadian cartoonist, Jesse Jacobs.

name: Griddlers Beach Season
short_description: It’s time for adventures at sea with Griddlers Beach Season! 120 unique griddlers will make your vacation even more fun

name: kirakira stars idol project AI
short_description: 'I want to be an idol!'The story of the beginning to the top idol singer starting from the accidental reunion of the new face manager ' Nobuyuki Kinoshita ' and childhood friend ' Ai Amane' of the talent agency.

name: Retro Football Boss
short_description: Retro Football Boss is a historical football management simulation featuring the English professional leagues from 1888 to 1998 (with German leagues coming soon). This is your chance to take a trip down memory lane or right the wrongs of the past.

name: Wings Of Legends
short_description: Wings of Legend is the first person VR game. You are the dragon rider. Do you want to fly? Ride the dragon and fly! Start an exciting journey through a sharp cliffs, incredibly beautiful canyons and breathtaking views.

name: Hello Neighbor Alpha 4
short_description: Alpha 4 of Hello Neighbor was the final alpha during the stealth hit's development. Sneak into your creepy Neighbor's house to figure out what he's hiding.

name: Reborn Tribe
short_description: Reborn Tribe is a medieval style simulation INDIE GAME developed by one person. In this game, players build houses and hire staffs to run the farms, pastures, etc. You have to encounter a lot difficulties and find out the reason why your tribe disappeared.

name: Haramatia
short_description: Haramatia is a terrible and extremely dangerous planet. The once thriving civilization, as usual, destroyed itself, leaving only the gray earth, aggressive animals and distracted biorobots. The main character absolutely does not remember anything, and in the course of the plot will understand who he is and how he turned out to be on this...

name: Crypto Is Dead
short_description: 'Crypto is Dead.' That's the first thing you read in the paper this morning. A goldfinger attack has crippled the world economy. For a month, the old physical currency will be put back in place. As a notaphilist, open your bank and use your expertise to determine the genuine from the fake bills.

name: Russian Hunter
short_description: Russian Hunter is the most realistic hunting simulator you've ever seen!

name: RollingBall: Unlimited World
short_description: And again you get into the world of a rolling ball. Only this time the level is just one, and it's unlimited. Easy control and insanely exciting passing obstacles with a rolling ball. Go around and jump over obstacles using only a mouse. RollingBall: Unlimited World will let you relax and rest.

name: Wow Dance
short_description: Wow Dance is a real person 3D video experience game Here, you can choose your favorite real-life idol to present beautiful dances for you, enjoying immersive audio-visual feast. While watching, you can shake the support sticks to cheer for the idol, creating a brilliant stage effect together!

name: LP
short_description: A Panda in a cocoon travels through a spinning world!

name: Happy Mining
short_description: Discover a colorful world filled with resources in a single player mining adventure. Mine resources and expand your productions to earn even more gold.

name: Live Empire 2
short_description: This is a simulated cultivation game.

name: Sig.NULL
short_description: This is a remake and expansion of an earlier PuzzleScript game, Signal. What I thought was so brilliant about the original is that while the rules never change, the level design is such that your ability to fully comprehend and exploit those rules shifts radically over time

name: PASSAGE
short_description: PASSAGE™ is medieval mayhem in a dark twisted world that's constantly changing. Grab hold of modern artillery, magical power-ups, and your trusty old axe in this adventure to rescue twin girls taken for a truly unholy sacrifice.

name: Panmorphia: Enchanted
short_description: A room escape game set in the magical world of Panmorphia. Wield the four elements and upgrade the amulet!

name: Radar Warfare
short_description: Radar Warfare is a bullet hell/fast paced arcade shoot 'em up with radar theme and retro style. 27 stages will challenge you with different waves and enemies. How long can you survive?

name: VIOLET: Space Mission
short_description: Violet: Space Mission is a 2D precision action game in space, about dodging asteroids, data collection and space exploration. You are Candidate Alpha, sent on the Violet Programme for this mission. Good luck and godspeed.

name: Die drei Freunde von der Reitschule
short_description: Real estate sharks are targeting Laura's uncle's beautifully located riding school. To save the indebted riding school, Uncle Arthur needs a lot of money, which his son Christian wants to win by winning the big horse show. However, a mysterious accident prevents him from doing so.

name: Fake Hostel
short_description: Fake Hostel is a classic pipe puzzle game with lots of fun scenes and pleasing artwork. You play as Pedro, the plumber. Since your house attracts a lot of attention from young girls, you decided to rent it out to them. Your task is to take good care of the girls.

name: Puff Town
short_description: This is a casual board game that requires walking by rolling dice with the goal of reaching the finish line when the catnip runs out.

name: Towertale
short_description: Fight your way up a Tower of bosses and unveil the mystery that lies up in its peak. Play four intertwined storylines and unlock multiple endings. Now with co-op up to 4 players!

name: The Dark Room
short_description: Addictive and vicious retro-styled comedy puzzler chock full of profanity, abuse, unfairness and warped logic. Will You: Go North? Find Light Switch? Cower and whimper like a beaten swine? Make your decision and escape The Dark Room! Just remember - YA DIE! YA DIE! YA DIE! YA DIE!

name: Sacred Earth - Promise
short_description: Sacred Earth - Promise is a four- to six-hour visual novel/RPG experience set within a fantasy world of floating continents and ancient ruins, with a dynamic custom battle system and a compelling cast of characters.

name: Magical Girl Noble Rose
short_description: This game is an RPG with a classic storyline that features Noble Rose, a girl who transforms into a magical girl to fight an evil organization. Use special attacks to wipe out the enemies and help the women in the city from the Bio Soldiers!

name: PixPhys
short_description: Make your dreams come true in our game! Build cars, boats, rockets, space stations and don't stop at nothing!

name: Calvino Noir
short_description: The film noir stealth game. Calvino Noir is the exploratory, sneaking adventure through the 1930s European criminal underworld. Architecture meets Noir as you become unwillingly entangled in a revolutionist plot.

name: Grim Dawn
short_description: Enter an apocalyptic fantasy world where humanity is on the brink of extinction, iron is valued above gold and trust is hard earned. This ARPG features complex character development, hundreds of unique items, crafting and quests with choice & consequence.

name: Star Trek: Starfleet Command Gold Edition
short_description: Dozens of missions & more than 50 ship designs put you in the captain’s chair for an amazing real-time space combat experience commanding ships from the United Federation of Planets, the Klingon Empire, the Romulan Star Empire, the Hydran Kingdom, the Gorn Confederation or the Lyran Star Empire!

name: Morphopolis
short_description: Morphopolis is about transformation and discovery. Morphopolis takes you on a puzzle adventure through a fantastical insect world. Starting as an aphid grub, you embark on an epic journey of metamorphosis toward your spawning ground.

name: Spacelines from the Far Out
short_description: Run your own 60s-inspired space-age alien airlines in this randomly-generated chaotic 1-to-4-player local and online co-op game!

name: FreeCell Quest
short_description: FreeCell Quest is an RPG Free Cell game. You've never played Free Cell like this before! Explore 533 cities while collecting cards, gold, levels, armor, and spells on your epic quest of card sorting! Think quickly before the cards strike and drain your precious health. A new twist on a classic game!

name: Over My Dead Pixel
short_description: Over My Dead Pixel is a top down shooter where you command antivirus software to defend your computer from malware. Beware, firing your weapons will shrink your playspace. Maneuver deftly to avoid the enemies and the walls, as one single hit means restarting.

name: Vomitoreum
short_description: Vomitoreum is an FPS Metroidvania with a focus on atmosphere and horror, inspired by the paintings of Zdzisław Beksiński.

name: Dead Maze
short_description: Dead Maze is a 2D MMO game set in a destroyed contemporary world, filled with zombies. Explore the world, scavenge and craft as many items as possible, to survive the hostile environment and upgrade your gear and camp as you go.

name: Ambidangerous
short_description: Ambidangerous is a top-down shooter that puts your ambidexterity to the test. Simultaneously control two elite soldiers as you fight your way through four randomized areas, five unique bosses, and a dozen enemy types. Take the challenge alone or share the controller with a friend for co-op play!

name: Girl Jigsaw
short_description: This is a 'beautiful girl puzzle interactive' game, in the game, your goal is to put the puzzle pieces together, and interact with the character.

name: Winging It
short_description: Play as a young owl born into a desert full of tasty prey and scary predators. Glide through the desert on a journey of survival, growing your abilities along the way.

name: Choice Chamber
short_description: Choice Chamber is a real-time, crowdsourced, procedurally generated game where your fate is in everyone else's hands.

name: Play The Fox
short_description: Chinese horoscope online battle 'Play The Fox' released!

name: Spell Swap
short_description: A chaotic wizard vs wizard 2D fighting game where the last spell you cast WILL come back right at your face. Swap spells and obliterate your opponents!

name: Ascendants Rising
short_description: ASCENDANTS Rising is a CO-OP Action RPG that lets you create your own unique playstyle and team to explore an ever-changing Multiverse teeming with deadly enemies, formidable Boss fights, and amazing loot.

name: BallRoll
short_description: Experience metaphorical descent into the land of darkness and then back to the light.

name: Good Doggo
short_description: Train your dog in this treat-balancing action game

name: Neko Ghost, Jump!
short_description: Neko Ghost, Jump! is a puzzle-platformer where you switch between 2D & 3D perspectives to zip your way through 40+ levels across eight intriguing worlds.

name: Capsule Hotel Simulator
short_description: Atmospheric experience for those wishing to get in a capsule hotel to catch the vibes of cyberpunky low level of life bordering with coziness

name: Outrage
short_description: Outrage is a short cyberpunk dungeon crawler. You manage a team of vigilantes and must undertake various missions in the city to strengthen your team and your cause in order to bring a powerful enemy to justice.

name: BABYLON'S FALL
short_description: Experience acclaimed developer PlatinumGames' signature combat in BABYLON’S FALL with up to 3 other players or take on the Tower of Babel alone, in this new cooperative action RPG.

name: Escape from GULAG
short_description: 'Escape from GULAG' is the maze game that increases difficulty as you progress through the levels.

name: TaskForce Gamma-13 : An SCP Tale
short_description: The idea was to capture a wasp, but you found a nest...This game is a third person shooter , an combination of Resident Evil 4 with Splinter Cell and Gears of Wars, where you, a member of the Gamma-13 task force should recover a lost android, but found much more than expected.

name: Little Earth
short_description: An educational VR experience about the solar-system. Meet little animals and learn about the seasons.

name: Kinkoi: Golden Loveriche
short_description: Kinkoi: Golden Loveriche is a Japanese-style visual novel produced by Saga Planets, a Japanese developer of romance VNs. The game won numerous awards in the year of its release in Japan for its art, music, characters, and story.

name: Hotel R'n'R
short_description: Hotel R’n’R, the gonzo VR rockstar simulator! Sell your soul to The Devil, smash up hotels and become Infamous. Pressure from hotel staff and your own limp wrists are against you, but with over 36 weapons, and a World Tour ahead of you, it’s time to get creative.

name: Veritex
short_description: Veritex is a multiplayer survival game. The goal is to survive versus the wilderness around you, build bases, and fend off other players that can murder you and take your loot.

name: Pogostuck: Rage With Your Friends
short_description: Climb a surreal mountain on a pogo stick and make friends along the way.

name: UFO: Afterlight
short_description: The story is situated on Mars. It starts where UFO: Aftermath left off and runs simultaneously with UFO: Aftershock. While the Laputans on Earth are fighting Wargots and Starghosts and finding out what caused the destruction of their home planet, a small colony on Mars is trying to survive and flourish.

name: Alisa
short_description: Alisa is a Horror-themed Action Adventure game and a genuine throwback to the golden age of 90s 3D games.

name: Chocolate makes you happy 6
short_description: Casual colorful physical puzzle with sweets, jumpers, teleports, accelerators, reverse gravity, traps, treadmills and explosions.

name: DMM Connect Chat
short_description: DMM Connect Chat is a social communication service that allows you to use your own avatar and interact with others in a virtual space. Anyone with a PC can play for free.

name: Hate Free Heroes Agents of Aggro City [3D Enhanced]
short_description: Hate Free Heroes is a modern day role playing game that takes the player into the role of an H.F.H agent and researcher dedicated to decreasing the rise of 'Aggromites' in the city.

name: Clash of Vessels VR
short_description: Assume control of your fleet to confront your opponent. Pick and place your ships to deploy them on the battlefield. Seek and destroy your opponent's fleet before losing yours.

name: BARRICADEZ
short_description: Barricadez is a mix of tower defense and survival game. Take on your care robot and explore the underground, find new blueprints, gather resources and build your defenses and traps to survive through the night against a myriad of zombie-like creatures. Your goal: to defend the defenseless cradle.

name: HEPH
short_description: You are the only one who has to deal with the worst situation happens on this spaceship, and make sure it arriving the destination safely. Gathering material and craft items. Shoot, Sneak, Run, Use your own strategy to survive.

name: Streets of Chaos
short_description: Streets of Chaos is a unique strategy/board game where you become the leader of a resistance in an apocalyptic world. Features a randomly generated world each game, high-res graphics and original music, and an open-ended strategy model that evolves and encourages thought and planning.

name: Mayan Prophecies: Cursed Island Collector's Edition
short_description: A shipwreck on a volcanic island unearths deadly secrets!

name: Martians Vs Robots
short_description: Martians want to regain control of their planet! But we have not yet finished exploiting Martian mining resources... We're going to have to defend ourselves!

name: A dead world's dream
short_description: A Dead World's Dream is a challenging retro platformerAs a peaceful alien, explore a harsh world looking for hidden species.Unlocking upgrades and power-ups, travel to even more treacherous places.Carefuly examine your surroundings before jumping toward new dangers and secrets.

name: Mirror Party
short_description: Come out and party with bishojos from the Mirror series in a world of fun mini-games featuring online mode. There’s also a Gacha Machine where you can easily get OVER 300 pieces of collectibles (1000+ when upon formal release): CGs/Cosplay Album/Video/OST and more!

name: Tumblebugs
short_description: Save your backyard buddies from rolling into the Black Bug Empire's underground lair. By launching colored bugs from your back with precise timing you can free more bugs with matching color, but you have to act fast and save them all before you run out of time.

name: Solitaire Legend of the Pirates
short_description: Solitaire Legend of the Pirates is a card game for those that love the romance of piracy!120 unique deals await you!

name: Yoshiwara Higanbana
short_description: --Whether I end up after falling in love, in your arms or in a scarlet prison? It's up to you to make my vow of higanbana fall or wither-- Even if it's only for one night, I want to be held by you...

name: HiddenFrog
short_description: Scale the tower and get back home as fast as you can!

name: Castle Wars VR
