short_description: Throw Knives is a new casual and addictive retro-style game that will help pass the time at lunch, at work, during insomnia. Its essence is to compete in throwing knives at a tree. Sounds simple, but it's actually not that easy. Try to hit the target without hitting other knives.

name: The Capture Worlds
short_description: In 'The Capture Worlds' you will travel to other worlds to fight monsters which you've never seen before. Capture them, train them and fight back! Become the new ruler of the monsters! Start your new journey now!

name: Unreal Sandbox
short_description: Build and play with others with a physics based sandbox created in unreal engine 5

name: WT2
short_description: Destroy, smash and blast your way to victory. Use advanced weapons and vehicles to dominate the battlefield.

name: Warshmallows
short_description: Blink, and you’re hit. Warshmallows is a hilariously fast-paced multiplayer shooting game, where you battle over the championship as sweet but dangerous marshmallows at war!

name: Edna & Harvey: The Breakout
short_description: The award-winning debut adventure game from the creators of Deponia and The Whispered World now on Steam. Accompany young Edna and her talking stuffed bunny Harvey on a whacky attempt to escape from her padded cell. Experience a bizarre journey all across the insane asylum and far beyond its brick walls.

name: Cat Powered UFO
short_description: Cat Powered UFO is a blend of turn-based RPG combat and old-school Zelda top-down action. Collect cats, visit crazy dimensions, and be a jerk to NPCs. Find combos of 'Illegal bonuses' to break the combat system! Cat Powered UFO is a quirky and light-hearted game with a self-aware sense of humor.

name: Kotodama: The 7 Mysteries of Fujisawa
short_description: A highschool visual novel with a difference! While Fujisawa Academy may seem like a normal school, beneath the surface lie dark and sinister secrets. Puzzle-battle your classmates with the power of Kotodama to strip away their lies - and a lot more!

name: Destiny’s Plan
short_description: Finn is the protagonist of this story, by a ridiculous coincidence, gets to the hospital, but contrary to fate - rejoicing in this, begins to live in a new way. And falling in love with his new friend, unfortunately, cannot remember one important thing. Will you understand what you have forgotten?

name: VR-NISSAGE 3 - John Wentz Art Exhibition
short_description: VR-NISSAGE 3 - A room scale virtual reality art exhibition of paintings by artist John Wentz

name: Peekaboo Lite
short_description: Peekaboo — A Cross-Platform Hide & Seek online game. Players are divided into two teams: Props and Hunters. Props hide, taking the form of objects and adopting their physical properties, and hunters try with all their might to find them.

name: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition
short_description: Winner of more than 200 Game of the Year Awards, Skyrim Special Edition brings the epic fantasy to life in stunning detail. The Special Edition includes the critically acclaimed game and add-ons with all-new features like remastered art and effects, volumetric god rays, dynamic depth of field, screen-space reflections, and more.

name: Placebo Effect
short_description: Placebo Effect is a fast-paced shooter video game set in a stunning 3D world of hostile inner-space. It combines flying, shooting, and challenging boss fights in a perilous microverse of mystifying science.

name: Savage Vessels
short_description: Rogue-like top-down-shooter with pixel-art, physics and hard survival.

name: Lost in Reefs: Antarctic
short_description: Lost In Reefs: Antarctic – Complete Match3 Levels and Find a Lost Civilization!

name: Design it, Drive it : Speedboats
short_description: Design and drive your own speedboats with simulation quality physics including blowover/chine walk/porpoising dynamics. Popular with real life boat racers. Free drive anywhere or compete on courses through leaderboards. 40+ adjustable design parameters. Solo developer.

name: The Piano That Stops Time
short_description: 시간을 멈추는 피아노(The Piano That Stops Time)는 감성적인 비주얼 노벨입니다. 악보 없이는 피아노를 치지 못하던 주인공이, 자유자재로 피아노를 연주할 수 있는 소녀 '예린'을 만나면서 겪게 되는 이야기를 따라가 보세요.

name: KOLOBOK
short_description: Go through the epic path of Kolobok, prove to yourself and everyone that he is alive and can think.

name: Glitch Assassin
short_description: Glitch Assassin is a Sci-Fi VR shooter which puts the player in the shoes of an assassin tasked with maintaining order in a simulated world. Complete various missions eliminating threats to the AI's directive of saving the planet from extinction...

name: BoomXR
short_description: Ninja rhythmic boxing workout

name: BOX
short_description: BOX is a logic puzzle-platformer where you must navigate small mazes to collect every 'dot'. Rotate the stage to change the layout of the level, as well as your own position within it. Take your time.

name: Snake Pass
short_description: Slither, coil and climb your way to the top of Haven Tor in this one of a kind physics based, puzzle platform adventure from award winning independent studio Sumo Digital!

name: Puzzle Party
short_description: Puzzle Party is a simple, damaged pixel style block pushing puzzle game with a few twists! Jump into the perpetual void as you immerse yourself in the odd tale of Amid, his old partner, and the strange phenomena that surrounds their abandoned passion project.

name: Knockout Bowling VR
short_description: Knockout Bowling is bowling like never before. Set in two new and exciting scenarios with a choice of bottles or bowling pins to knock out, this game is guaranteed to give you hours of bowling fun.

name: The Whisperer in Darkness
short_description: Rumors resurface. Legends are resurrected. In this Lovecraftian visual novel, play as Alex N. Wilmarth, skeptic and professor at Miskatonic University, to unravel the hideous secrets centered at a secluded farm in the hills of Vermont, coming ever closer to mortal peril.

name: TUBWT
short_description: Welcome to TUBWT, the place where all your memories will be resurrected, the place where every corner is your mind, the place where everything you see is yourself. Can you get out of the long-forgotten fragments of memory? Can you accept reality again?

name: Twin Mind: Ghost Hunter Collector's Edition
short_description: Can the twin detectives solve a new case? You are the only one who can help them catch the killer. Are you up for the challenge?

name: Sheepageddon
short_description: Sheepageddon is a 2d puzzle game where you play as a cute wolf that is constantly craving for sheep to eat in order to not starve to death.

name: Max: The Curse of Brotherhood
short_description: Max: The Curse of Brotherhood is a cinematic adventure filled with action-packed platforming and creative puzzle-solving. Armed with only a Magic Marker, Max must confront evil at every turn in a hostile and fantastical world in order to save his kid brother, Felix. Join Max on his great adventure!

name: Puzzle Galaxies
short_description: Puzzle Galaxies is a groundbreaking puzzle video game similar to games like Bejeweled and Candy Crush. You must match jewels stored in a space station in a manner similar to Bejeweled, but there's a twist - there are enemies that will come by and try to take matching jewels on you!

name: LIBLADE
short_description: Slash, slash, slash. Sometimes you have to dance, sometimes you have to be precise. 'LIBLADE' is a side-scrolling action game where you slash and slash by playing the stick. Use the twin-stick slash action to slash down everything and defeat the strongest enemies that stand in your way.

name: Grid Masters
short_description: Fight for victory in a 1v1 or 2v2 grid-based deathmatch in Grid Masters. Represent your favorite faction as one of five characters (with more to come), each with their own unique abilities. Toss massive bombs, rocket punch, or send explosive robot minions to take your enemies down!

name: Squareface
short_description: A 3rd person action-RPG that puts you in full control of a miniature paper figurine set to solve the mystery of its existence. The game features complex character customization and weapons arsenal, base building, driving, accessory and ally management.

name: GetMeBro!
short_description: GetMeBro is a real-time head-to-head battle game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Enter the battlefield and knock down your opponents in an unforgiving race for your life. Create the best strategy and ensure your victory by choosing from a variety of abilities.

name: Volleying
short_description: Tired of sports games in which the computer doesn’t respect your commands? As a physics-based game, Volleying gives the players more control over their moves, as well as delivers unique matches each round. Invite your friends over or play remotely and enjoy this predictably unpredictable experience!

name: Shadows of time
short_description: Shadows of Time is a challenging top-down stealth game. Sabotage items, control time around you, sneak behind your enemies to take them by surprise. The game offers you, unique stealth mechanics. Take a direct, brutal approach or avoid combats is up to you!

name: Colory Engine
short_description: Colory Engine is the core app for all Colory applications.Colory VR Painter: A virtual reality painting and vfx app.Colory STUDIO: A desktop app for live video virtual production. (currently in beta).Colory Modkit: A free modkit to publish you own content.

name: Twilight City: Love as a Cure
short_description: In Twilight City: Love as a Cure, you're a young vampire passionately in love with a human. However, the curse of being immortal comes at a high price. Your burning desire for blood can destroy your love. It's up to you to search for a cure in the mysterious city of Skylight.

name: -KLAUS-
short_description: Klaus is lost and alone. Who? Where? Why? He doesn't know anything. Only you can help him find the truth. Join Klaus and K1 - a friendly brute - as you explore this puzzle platform game, through a geometric kaleidoscopic world with high contrast and pop art.

name: Duck Life: Battle
short_description: The ducks are back, but this time they're angrier. Forget racing, now it's time to battle! Train your duck's power, health, defence, speed, and special attack abilities in 25 brand new mini games. Explore the world battling other ducks, entering tournaments and completing quests to become the greatest duck battler of all time.

name: Dark Space
short_description: Overcome difficult platforming challenges, solve puzzles and escape dangerous enemies hiding in every corner of Dark Space!

name: Your way
short_description: Your Way is a travel simulator with a conundrum element. Here you can walk through the forest and admire nature.

name: Cursed West
short_description: Cursed West contains the spirit of Glories of the past, Holding aspects such as Difficulty and Mechanics. Adding more modern visuals in both, levels with traditional 2d gameplay, as in the 3d levels

name: Rogue Rising
short_description: 2D roguelite action. Exhilarating action with easy controls. Grab the relics and use your skills to conquer the tower as many times as you can. Even the toughest bosses will be easy depending on your luck!

name: Eggys Games Flash Collection
short_description: The Eggys Games Flash Collection is a gigantic collection of all games released by Eggys Games which includes 22 full games! This is the collection of over 10 years of work that have been released over the years.

name: StellarHub
short_description: StellarHub is a starbase management game where your job is to build a safe and functional space station. Deal with the challenges of managing a station crew while taking care of everyone’s needs. Your tasks include construction, extraction of resources, defense, trade, and more.

name: The Narrator is a DICK : Longer, Harder, and Uncut
short_description: In this narrated unfair platformer there's one man who's always out to get you... The Narrator. He's a real jerk, but with determination and a lot of skill MAYBE you can make it through this crazy adventure. Remastered with new Online Co-Op and Extended gameplay!

name: Deus Ex Machina, Game of the Year, 30th Anniversary Collector’s Edition
short_description: Back by popular demand, the legendary video game and first ever interactive movie, starring Jon Pertwee (Doctor Who), Ian Dury (the Godfather of Punk), and Frankie Howerd (comic genius). Hailed as a breakthrough in the development of video games, Deus Ex Machina won Game Of The Year, and is currently the subject of movies, books,...

name: Last Days of Old Earth
short_description: Last Days of Old Earth is a rich strategy game set in our far, far future where the sun is dying. Can you command the last noble tribes of humanity as they attempt to survive among the machines and marauding clans?

name: Shutter Nyang
short_description: Shutter Nyang is challenging Platformer Action game. The players play as the ‘Cat’ whom got separated from his friend, a little girl. Using mystical camera, create your own unique imagination to help the ‘Cat’ get back to his friend. Nyang! Nyang! Nyang!

name: Waste X
short_description: To Waste X one must practice; avoiding, jumping, and fighting deadly viruses that wish to get close to your host, reproduce, & end you.

name: Eternal Dread 2
short_description: The world was at the edge of despair. Driven to the brink of extinction, mankind exhausted all their able-bodied men in a futile war against the demon hordes, leaving behind only the female, the young and the vulnerable. And so it came to the women to take up arms and protect what remains of humanity.

name: Reproduction Man
short_description: Reproduction Man is a 2D puzzler where you help some very simple-minded sperm get to the egg. This cult classic of the Windows shareware era was brought back for its 20th anniversary with all-new graphics, animation and sound. Its outward cuteness belies some very tough puzzles.

name: Tech Madness
short_description: Nice graphics, excellent atmosphere and uncomplicated plot - all ingenious simple! You take a rifle, look for parts to fix the radio tower and fix it - this is the whole simple, but ingenious Tech Madness!

name: Dragon Glory
short_description: Dragon Glory is an outstanding MMORPG that takes place in an exciting world of magic, dragons, dungeons and unforgettable adventures.

name: Fingertips  mountain  sea
short_description: Fingertips mountain sea: everyone's heart longing for the peach garden

name: Your amazing T-Gotchi!
short_description: A cute game where you care about a green anime girl!

name: Galactic Dreams
short_description: Humanity is racing through space on the wings of hope, away from the emerging threat of a cosmic cataclysm that could spell extinction. And mysterious aliens with powers beyond imagining follow them everywhere they go.

name: Robin
short_description: Robin is a short slice of life game that was made to give some visibility to an invisible illness - Chronic Fatigue Syndrome.

name: Tree Strike
short_description: The incremental tree striking platformer, strike trees, collect them, die and make the numbers go up.

name: Grave of the Petrified
short_description: Set in an ancient Greek temple where Medusa has been sneaking around for centuries, petrifying whoever crosses her path, the player will go through a spine-tingling escape experience.

name: 1001 Jigsaw: Earth Chronicles 4
short_description: 1001 photos of our fantastic planet! Discover the breathtaking beauty of our world alongside 1001 Jigsaw: Earth Chronicles 4!

name: Spacen: The Beginning
short_description: As Gary Rogers, the player battles through hordes of enemy spaceships in several missions, evading projectiles, asteroids and defeating powerful bosses. Gary collects debris from destroyed enemies and exchanges them at the home base for ship and weapon upgrades.

name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Portal Power
short_description: Shredder and the Kraang have spread chaos and evil across dimensions, and it's up to the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles to stop them!

name: Powernode
short_description: A zen puzzle game but also a brainy challenge! Reach the highest score in 'Powernode', a puzzle game that requires planning and organizing skills.

name: Toilet paper wants to be a basketball
short_description: A hard-hitting action-adventure game about realizing big dreams hidden in the light weight of toilet paper. Overcome obstacles, successfully dodge obstructive objects, and lay down paper to create a path in the middle of nowhere to reach the basketball goal.

name: Cook, Serve, Delicious! 2!!
short_description: The highest selling and most intense restaurant sim ever made is back! Deceptively easy to learn but incredibly difficult to master, Cook, Serve, Delicious! 2!! is your journey of being the best chef in the world with your small but humble restaurant on the 50th floor of the Teragon Supertower.

name: Linklight
short_description: Linklight is a relaxing minimalist puzzle game that consists of rotation based puzzles; unplug yourself from your surroundings as you navigate your way through endless puzzles.

name: cat notebook
short_description: explore a cat notebook

name: Him & Her Collection
short_description: Him & Her Collection is a collection that brings three games from the puzzle platformer series with unique gameplay related to the gravity of the world. Only love can win in the end!

name: After You
short_description: After You is a narrative game with puzzles, but it is not an easy game, here you will not have indicators or tutorials, nor can you save when you want. In After You you need to put all your attention and use paper and pencil to move forward, if you're looking for an easy game, this is not your game.

name: Unsung Knight
short_description: 'Unsung Knight' is a card game that combines Roguelike elements. Build your unique deck, collect powerful props, and then defeat the Lord of Darkness to save the Legion!

name: Football tournament
short_description: Football has united all the countries of the world on the football field, and numerous football tournaments are held every year. This time there is a place for your team in the standings, choose it and play football.

name: Пацанский цитатник / Russian Test
short_description: Russian Test is simple test about some specific russian culture in some places

name: Hentai Temple
short_description: Hentai Temple is a classic Sliding puzzle game but with a slight Japanese touch ...

name: Elastic Fantastic
short_description: Elastic Fantastic is a very difficult physics-platformer with a challenging game mechanic.

name: CYBRID
short_description: CYBRID is the action-rhythm VR of the Cyber Future! Swords and Pistols are in your hands. Slash and Shoot! Don't let this stop you! Run, dodge, and jump among the neon lights of the city to a powerful soundtrack!

name: Millionaire Dancer
short_description: Dance to rhythm & beat and show off your skills.'Millionaire Dancer', the title given to the best dancers, is yours.

name: My Ten-day Girlfriend
short_description: This is a simulating game combined with Galgame. “Highland Island” is the place where the Devil died, this place has become popular tourism after decades. Not sure if it's the call of fate or conspiracy, me-a senior Otaku is traveling here from another world, and my dream trip starts here! ٩(๑>◡

name: Cube Runner 2
short_description: Cube Runner 2 is a 3d action platformer that's simple to learn, exciting to play, and deep enough to challenge even the greatest gamers.

name: Princess Maira: Initiation
short_description: First instalment in the series of 2D action side-scrollers, taking place in very distant galaxy and not so distant future. Gameplay main hallmarks are fast-paced laser guns shootouts, punch 'n' kick combats, managing obby-like obstacles, using wits in overcoming deadly traps and witty dialogues.

name: Crazy Factory
short_description: Crazy Factory VR is a bunch of silly virtual reality mini-games in an automated robotic factory. You are a robot working in a factory directed by an artificial intelligence. Carve shoes, punch pickaxes, throw crystal glasses and uncover the truth !

name: Mahjong Deluxe
short_description: Mahjong Deluxe is a solitaire game based on the classic Chinese game where you are challenged to eliminate all the tiles from the board. It includes 12 lovely backgrounds and 1,008 different puzzle layouts along with relaxing background music.

name: A Top-Down Job: Blood Gain
short_description: A Top-Down Job: Blood Gain is a indie stealth-action offering time-tested gameplay.

name: Hoyle Official Casino Games
short_description: The fun never stops when you choose from over 20 casino games! Pull up a chair and deal yourself into Hoyle Official Casino Games Collection!

name: One Ship Two Ship Redshift Blueshift
short_description: Redshift Blueshift is a tournament-ready pong-like 2D shooter in which two pilots fight for glory in their variable paddle ships! Power up your shields, unleash a horde of drones and homing missiles on your opponent and keep the hyper-ball in play! Supports local multiplayer and single player vs AI. Gamepad strongly recommended.

name: Lazy Galaxy
short_description: Lazy Galaxy is a mix between RTS and idle/clicker game. Lead an evil (albeit lazy) alien race to conquer the universe!

name: MiniDrivers
short_description: The craziest races are now on your hand with MiniDrivers! The animated serie which is loved by millions of people around the world has a new main character: You! Create your own stores or change the rules becoming World Champion.

name: Coma: Mortuary
short_description: Coma:Mortuary is the introduction part of a trilogy about events in the world of the dead. The game`s genre is Adventure-Ambient with Horror-quest element.

name: My Wet Leto Comic
short_description: 一个欢乐气氛的悬疑文字冒险类游戏。你将不断在十位不同身份的角色间切换视点来推进故事的发展并达成各种各样的结局。这是由一个个平凡而又独特的个人故事所拼出的新的物语，或许里面也有着你的故事……？

name: Surgeon Simulator 2
short_description: It’s time to ‘scrub in’ solo or jump into 4 player online games in this physics-based surgery sim with ludicrous coop and competitive play, plus an awesome builder mode. Unearth the mysteries of the Bossa Labs Medical Facility and save Bob’s life. Get ready to team up for trauma!

name: BLINK: The Last Night
short_description: A vengeful entity comes to kidnap the girl you're babysitting. Guide your way through various psychological twists and turns as you begin to realize that not everything is as it seems. BLINK: The Last Night is a short first chapter of a four-chapter psychological horror story.

name: Wishy Washy
short_description: In Calamityville, every day comes with a new disaster… and someone (you) has got to clean it up come rain, sleet, or…spaghetti sauce.

name: Brawlout
short_description: Brawlout is the platform fighting game, designed for couch play, online ranked matches and competitive tournaments. Now at 2.0!

name: Zombie Friday
short_description: Fight zombies of scalpers, miners and other vile characters on Black Friday night. Zombie top-down shooter with funny references to most recent events tormenting gamers.

name: Betrayal
short_description: The West Marches is a corrupt land ruled by immoral leaders. You are one of four Knights with a lust for power, and in the pursuit of power, the end justifies the means. Betrayal. A web of intricate possibilities - but fair play isn't one of them.

name: Capcom Fighting Collection
short_description: Ten of Capcom's most popular arcade games in one bumper collection! A wide variety of titles are included from series such as Street Fighter and Darkstalkers, Cyberbots, and the first home console port of Red Earth! And of course, all titles support online play!

name: It's Spring Again
short_description: 'It's Spring Again' - an educational game for children ages two and up. It uses game mechanics to teach children about the seasons.

name: Unearthing Mars VR
short_description: Unearthing Mars is a VR adventure game set on the mysterious Red Planet. Unearthing Mars provides hours of unique gameplay experiences, ranging from puzzle-solving to first-person shooting, the game will allow players to resolve challenges from a variety of game genres.

name: Grim Tranquility
short_description: Humans have ruined Earth’s ecology after years of denying scientific truths, and now search for a new home among the stars. Hostile aliens force us to confront the mistakes that led us here. Explore alien worlds as humanity searches for a new home in this sci-fi, roguelite, tactics-based adventure.

name: Plasma Attack
short_description: Plasma Attack is a top-down side scrolling shooter game where the character is a flying spaceship equipped with a base laser.

name: Legacy - Witch Island 3
short_description: Your next hidden object adventure on Witch Island is about to begin! It’s up to you now, to take on these unique puzzle challenges to stop the evil witch and save two worlds from certain destruction!

name: Atelier Ayesha: The Alchemist of Dusk DX
short_description: 'The promise begins.' The 'Dusk' series, a trilogy of RPG titles from Gust's popular Atelier series, tells the story of a world on the verge ruin, told from the perspective of its unique characters. The 1st title in the series 'Atelier Ayesha' is now available as a deluxe version.

name: BlackShot: Mercenary Warfare FPS
short_description: BlackShot is a free-to-play, first-person shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world.Join other mercenaries in brutal team combat, multiple game modes, and experience in-depth customization to create your perfect warrior!

name: NeoBoom
short_description: Your goal - to deliver the sphere of the right place. How? BOOM!To put and remove the mines.Start the beam and calculate the trajectory.Fly and explode mines.To make the ball hit in the right place.

name: Aeris&Zack
short_description: Currently the world's only hybrid 3d pixel style, comfortable flight feeling, relaxing play experience,rich exploration elements and mini-games.

name: Fairy Godmother Stories: Dark Deal Collector's Edition
short_description: Someone in Fairy Tale Land is selling wishes, but at what cost?

name: Cyberhunt
short_description: Cyberhunt is a retro procedurally generated twin stick shooter, that takes you back to the sweet to the sweet arcade machines era!

name: Mountain Rescue Simulator
short_description: When danger calls – it's down to you become a lifesaver in Mountain Rescue Simulator! Now you and your team are in demand! Use your special vehicles such as helicopters, quad bikes or snow cat to rescue people. Take care of broken bones or rescue lost hikers!

name: Birthdays the Beginning
short_description: The origins of the world are yours to decide in this engaging and open-ended builder experience! Shape the geography, control the temperature, and give rise to diverse lifeforms. Witness the birth of an entirely new ecosystem, made with your very own hands!

name: Paladin Duty - Knights and Blades
short_description: In this first-person game, you must free all places from thieves and invaders knights using your weapons. Don't forget to block your enemy attacks when possible, it is essential for your survival. When attacking get them from behind or hit the head to get an instant kill.

name: COVID Kawaii!
short_description: COVID Kawaii! is the cutest pandemic tower defense this side of the partition glass. Using the power of common sense and cleaning products, defend your personal space from the oncoming virus hoard. Can you go the social distance?

name: Green Ranch
short_description: 'Green Ranch' is a very addictive Time Management game settled in the famous farming genre with beautiful graphics, an easy to learn but hard to master gameplay and tons of levels and missions to keep players of all ages entertained for a wonderful - and really - long time.

name: Tree Simulator 2021
short_description: Wood you like marginally improved graphics? Do you like leafing it all behind and taking root in some random field? If so, you are a tree, be the best tree you can be. Prepare for a deeper and more detailed understanding of what it is to be a tree. A true work of art.

name: Steel Fight
short_description: Steel Fight is a fighting game with dynamic gameplay, unique characters and detailed art. Choose one of characters. And travel to the world where steel is the only weapon. Enjoy beautiful stages by facing each opponent.

name: Dream Stone 2
short_description: Escaping from the dream still continues on the sequel of Dream Stone.

name: Chickens Madness
short_description: Chickens Madness gives you the ultimate power of being and behaving like a chicken in a very unique set of party games against your friends.

name: Button Frenzy
short_description: Button Frenzy is a minimalist arcade game about having quick reactions and sharp muscle memory. It's a game that will test your mastery of the gamepad. It's simple enough to pick up and play, but deviously difficult enough to keep you challenged for hours.

name: Between Time: Escape Room
short_description: You are going to steal a time machine. In this escape room, you have to travel through time, explore mysterious places and solve puzzles to get priceless treasures. Will you be able to make it back alive?

name: Ninja Stealth
short_description: Evade the guards and the defences to escape the evil facility on this click and play stealth game, there will be difficult on your path, young padawan!

name: MARY
short_description: MARY - is an adventure shooter with surviving elements where you will survive in zombie apocalypse playing as a girl named Jane.

name: Range Day VR
short_description: Too lazy to go to the range? Is your gun in the repair shop? Never fear Range Day VR is here. If you like playing with realistic guns in an open VR sandbox, then this might be the game for you. Range Day VR is designed to give players a taste of what an actual gun range is like while letting players explore iconic realistic firearms...

name: I'm Hungry
short_description: Play the role of a fast-food restaurant employee in I'm Hungry VR game. You can definitely learn how to make fries, hamburgers and milk shake in the VR world and possibly the real world, as well! The game takes advantage of the VR technique, and it perfectly shows a realistic vision of a fast-food kitchen to the gamers.

name: Phantom Halls
short_description: Phantom Halls is a squad-based side-scrolling comedy-horror game. Play as a group of teens as they attempt to survive the night in a haunted mansion. Single-player and local co-op supported!

name: My Time At Portia
short_description: Start a new life in the enchanting town of Portia! Restore your Pa's neglected workshop to its former glory by fulfilling commissions, growing crops, raising animals, and befriending the quirky inhabitants of this charming post-apocalyptic land!

name: Gambit Heart
short_description: Turn-Based Tactics meets Open-World Exploration in Gambit Heart! Make your hero, meet new friends, find treasure, defeat dungeons, and more in this fun new take on role-playing games! Early Access means watch the world grow!

name: Lost Circus VR - The Prologue
short_description: Meet a mysterious Clown and his abandoned circus. Will You dare to start a thrilling night excursion? If You dare to get into a barrel on the old, rusty cart, pushed by a strange Clown - get ready for an extreme experience.

name: 异化之恶〇Abnormal Treatment
short_description: 治疗异化者的疗养院，某日出现了异化。 追随着浮现而出的疑点，调查、解谜、探寻真相。 隐藏于其中的究竟是善意，还是纯然的“恶”？

name: Sudoku Minimalist Infinite
short_description: Classic Sudoku distraction-free. Just you and the game.

name: FROG X BIRD
short_description: Daring amphibian warriors take flight to prove themselves as TOP FROG OF THE ARENA.

name: Demon Grade VR
short_description: Demon Grade is a VR FPS featuring free 360 degree movement, with no jogging in place, no teleporting, and no rails. In Demon Grade, you will explore dynamically generated levels in first person perspective while fighting relentless demonic enemies and collecting demon shards to unlock various weapons.

name: Dog Duty

short_description: The ground is your weapon in the fast paced battle arena of Georifters. Team up with or against your friends to punch portals, twist tunnels, flip lasers, and steal the ground from under each other using a unique arsenal of weapons and abilities in this ground busting adventure.

name: The Ultra Code
short_description: Build machines... break codes... win the war! It's 1942 and the world is engulfed in war. Meanwhile, in a country mansion in South East England, a group of expert mathematicians are fighting a war of their own, breaking an unbreakable Nazi code... Enigma!

name: TORINTO
short_description: Torinto is a Run N 'Gun game that can play up to two people simultaneously, with frantic levels and a chaotic environment, players need to beat all enemies and defeat all bosses.

name: Twilight Phenomena: Strange Menagerie Collector's Edition
short_description: You've come to Mexico to explore a mysterious mansion. But this is no vacation. Your cousin is missing, and the house is crawling with bizarre and deadly creatures!

name: Madland
short_description: Find sanity within the Madland. A first-person shooter game, developed entirely by a one-man team, that let's You dive into the cold mystery of the Dark Abyss. For players who love HALF-LIFE , OUTLAST , and THE LONG DARK.

name: LOTUS Minigames: Berlin Traffic
short_description: A basic implementation of a barricade board game. Play with your friends and find out, who drives best.

name: Soulfire
short_description: Soulfire is a battle royale fighter that pits more than 20 teams against each other in a struggle for win.Compared to similar games, it features a 2.5D souls-lite combat system.

name: The Superfluous
short_description: 'The Superfluous' [soo-pur-floo-uh s] A cave-diving, sci-fi, rogue-lite, platformer with jet packs and lots of explosions. Help stop an apocalyptic asteroid on collision course with Earth. Lead a squad to the center of the asteroid and blast it into space dust.

name: Physics car FOREVER
short_description: 'Physics car FOREVER' is a 2d simple physics simulator driving game. Your goal is to get to the finish.

name: Energy Balance
short_description: Energy Balance is a number puzzle. You have to swap power units in such a way that their sums form correct chains both vertically and horizontally. The game is easy to learn, but very hard to master. So, are you ready to peep under the hood of an alien spaceship?

name: Mecho Tales
short_description: An all-new adventure in the world of Mecho Wars! Run and shoot through chaotic platforming levels filled with spikes, bottomless pits and an army of deadly robots. Go it alone or team up with your friends in 4-player local multiplayer. Directed by Luc Bernard.

name: All Our Asias
short_description: A free game from the co-creator of Anodyne. Explore someone's mind and discover their secrets in this surreal, PSX-like adventure about a father, son, Asian-America and race. Control Yuito as you explore his dying father's 'Memory World' - what supernatural things will you discover?

name: Dare to Stay
short_description: In the town of Redstone, Pennsylvania, an evil returns striking chaos that once targeted families in the 1950s. Detective Alasdair, a successful investigator is reassigned and is forced to relive the haunting cases of his past.

name: FLASHOUT 2
short_description: FLASHOUT 2, the sequel to the highly-acclaimed anti-gravity racer FLASHOUT 3D is finally here! Get into one of many ultra-fast ships and use your arsenal of rockets, guns, bonuses and upgrades to fight your way to victory!

name: OneShot
short_description: OneShot is a surreal top down Puzzle/Adventure game with unique gameplay capabilities. You are to guide a child through a mysterious world on a mission to restore its long-dead sun. The world knows you exist.

name: Desert Things
short_description: Desert Things is a 3D find and click puzzle game in which you have to find some items on the desert location within a certain time.

name: DYNASTY WARRIORS 7: Xtreme Legends Definitive Edition
short_description: The new modes and replay elements of 'Xtreme Legends', even including downloadable content, have been packed into the thrilling one vs. one-thousand action game 'DYNASTY WARRIORS 7', comprising a massive single title that is available now for a reasonable price!

name: Color Chain
short_description: Color Chain is a small casual tile-matching video game.

name: MegaRamp
short_description: In this game you have to position the game elements in a exact way to get the ball from the top of a ramp inside a basket on its botton. The game uses real world physics on the ball movement and all your sense of localization will be demanded to complete the challenges.

name: TREBUCHET
short_description: TREBUCHET! The Industry Award Winning New Classic! Starting with a set of balls and pieces, move your blocks around to free your balls and tilt the board to align to and knock out opposing pieces! Eliminate the enemies King piece - or reach the opposing corner with your King first to Win the game!

name: Holiday Escape
short_description: Holiday Escape is a casual game in which you play a snowman trying to outrun a large snow ball while grabbing as many ornaments and presents as possible to spread holiday cheer.

name: Movie Studio 18 Steam Edition
short_description: Simplicity is key with Movie Studio: From importing your media with simple drag and drop to using the most advanced features. No matter your skills or knowledge, editing your videos should always be intuitive and fun. Use the automatic workflows, or explore infinite creative possibilities.

name: Late Night 1320
short_description: Rescue a classic from the junkyard and bring it back to life. Then take it to the country backroads and work your way up the list of racers to earn your rep, discover new drag spots, and compete against The Chain. Become the Late Night king.

name: Super BOO Quest
short_description: Super BOO Quest is a lighthearted game suitale for every kind of player, from casual to hardcore. It is a mix of arcade, puzzle, and stealth, to be played alone or with a friend. The game is presented with 16 bit-style graphics, as a tribute to Super Nintendo.

name: Let's Ride! Silver Buckle Stables
short_description: Let’s Ride! Silver Buckle Stables challenges you to become the best horse rider you can be. Aim for the blue ribbon in barrel racing and agility, while taking care of prize horses in your very own stables.

name: TECHNOSPHERE RELOAD
short_description: Go on a dangerous journey into the heart of asteroid to save humanity from disaster! Control the TECHNOSPHERE, roll, jump, balance, solve puzzles and go through the mazes.

name: Game Tycoon 1.5
short_description: Welcome to the Game Industry!The year is 1982. Three young entrepreneurs discover the computer and potential to strike it rich in the Games Industry! Their love for computer games is a common bond that they all share but they are also in fierce competition with one another in a race to build a successful Games Development House…They...

name: Corpo Tale
short_description: You play as Martin, a Senior Test Engineer, working in a Test Department and it is Monday, yes... the dreadful Monday. From the beginning of the game you embark on an epic quest to make sure that things actually start working.PLEASE NOTE THAT THE GAME IS NOT YET AVAILABLE IN ENGLISH!

name: Warsworn: DRAGON OF JAPAN - EMPIRE EDITION
short_description: Warsworn: Dragon of Japan is a real-time grand strategy game, created by a one-man development studio. Players will draft their own clans, compete in high spirit battles, and come up with epic strategies in order to unify Japan.

name: Reaching for Petals
short_description: Reaching for Petals is a poetic adventure about love, loss, and ambition. You will travel to the peak of the ever-reaching mountain to uncover the true nature of your mysterious and seemingly unguided journey.

name: Minskies
short_description: Minskies Furballs is not a port, but a spiritual clone of Puyo Puyo. In a tournament against a cast of crazy characters, you must guide and rotating falling pairs of cats of different colours to make up colour combinations.

name: Infinite Skyline: Superflight
short_description: Infinite Skyline: Superflight is a flying simulator focused on getting checkpoints and approximation points. Set in a huge city with 50 checkpoints and several secrets to be found.

name: Make Route
short_description: Can you make a way for every car and bring it to the finish line? No accidents, the correct sequence, creative solutions!

name: Find Match Icons
short_description: Find the icon among hundreds of others.

name: Prehistoric Kingdom
short_description: Take control of limitless power in Prehistoric Kingdom to build, manage and grow the ultimate zoo for extinct animals.

name: Zom-bie, or Not Zom-bie
short_description: New installment in the zombie survival RPG genre and a first from Games Master Mind!

name: Always Sometimes Monsters
short_description: Set out on a cross-country journey to win back the love of your life and endure the hardship of making story-defining choices that affect your life and the lives of those around you.

name: POLYGON
short_description: POLYGON is a tactical multiplayer 1st person shooter. You have to battle on large-scale maps using various weapons with up to 32 players. Properly managing your existing arsenal and skills, you have to lead your team to victory.

name: Extreme Truck Simulator
short_description: Extreme Truck Simulator is a new funny truck game unique through its gameplay. If you thought this truck simulator will be easy, think again!

name: admeowture
short_description: This is a third person shooting game. Players just need to hold down the mouse and let go. Throw out the synthetic drink and you can play. Right click to knock down the cats in an abnormal state, and you can take food from them. Then we'll have a delicious meal.

name: King and Kingdoms
short_description: Factions, countries and empires that have truly existed in the real history await you. The only difference is that it is in your hand to rewrite their history. Become the ruler of any country you want and lead your nation from small village to the way to be the magnificent empire!

name: Firmament Wars
short_description: Firmament Wars is a multiplayer strategy game with fast-paced real-time warfare. Build a wall, fire cannons, and launch missiles on your way to victory! Select from 7 government types and compete with up to 8 players on a variety of maps! Go forth and conquer!

name: Edmersiv
short_description: Enjoy the first educational lab for VR. Interact with several different educational objects, simulations, animations, environments and games.

name: OMEGA PATTERN - VISUAL NOVEL
short_description: Omega Pattern is a Visual Novel which offers a variable multiple-choice decision system. This means that both the number of decision points and the number of choices or options that you will find in those decision points may vary according to your previous decisions during the game.

name: Erica
short_description: Erica is a live-action, FMV thriller that puts you directly at the heart of the mystery. Your choices, your consequences.

name: Above the Skies
short_description: Dylan is the head of a small village and captain of The Eagle and he takes it upon himself to find The Grail and stop the Falls, saving those he cares for. The journey will be long and perilous, but the whole world above the skies depends on it.

name: In to the 029
short_description: In to the 029 is a horror game based on live-action 3D graphics. Collect clues through simple puzzle solving and investigation. Face the truth through endlessly repeated investigations amid the growing tension and fear.

name: FlickSync - Mad Hatter VR
short_description: Players can take on the role of Alice, the March Hare, or the Mad Hatter in an Alice in Wonderland themed Flicksync experience. **This game requires a microphone to play**

name: Sloth: Heart to Heart
short_description: Sloth: Heart to Heart is a Kinetic Visual Novel about human connection, and the lack thereof.

name: Shadow Watcher
short_description: This game is a RPG action type game with female protagonists. Use all kinds of active and passive skills: assassination, back stabbing, rebound, counterattack, pursuit, combo, and active skills to show their skills in the face of a variety of enemies in bloody confrontation.

name: Knuckers Test Fight
short_description: Knuckers Test Fight is a couch fighting game with funny characters, cute costumes, various weapons, tricky levels, and mini-games.

name: Kamodo Steve: Janitor on Fire!
short_description: Kamodo Steve is an 2.5D action sidescroller where you play as Steve, an unwilling hero with unrealized power. Steve and his friend Shiloh team up to disrupt the sinister plans of the Robber Barons, a kabal of industrialists whose only motivations are success, power and greed.

name: The Short Story of a Drifting Labyrinth
short_description: A fast paced 3D isometric action game which gives the player a choice between strategic, hack-n-slash, or mixed style gameplay. A newly entrapped resident of the Labyrinth, you must attempt to escape using the guidance of the long term captives.

name: On the Wings - Birth of a Hero
short_description: You are not born as a Hero. But you can become one! Bruce and Ursula are sister and brother living with their mother. One day their life starts to change with a Dragon. Now, it is time to become a Hero by saving their village and their captive father from Dark Rider. Get ready for a nice RPG story.

name: Abelana's Atom Maker
short_description: Visualize atomic orbitals, navigate across energy levels, gain an intuitive understanding of the composition of atoms and their electron configurations by assembling all elements of the periodic table. An educational VR experience designed for use by enthusiasts and academics alike.

name: Please Knock on My Door
short_description: A summary of every emotion you'd rather lock away and forget.

name: Crapht Box
short_description: Crapht Box is a Fantasy Physics Sandbox, inspired by the Fantasy Console genre. It brings a simulated world with a number of disks and tools, and leaves you to play, program, create and share disks.

name: Vectrix
short_description: Vectrix is a rhythmic, techno, top-down shoot 'em up with a synthwave soundtrack and a grid of enemies based on John Conway's 'Game of Life' cellular automaton!

name: mr.President Prologue Episode
short_description: This country needs a hero. This country needs a mr.President.

name: Strange and weird museum
short_description: The photographer visits the museum where the strange things happen. Take pictures of what is going on in strange and weird places.

name: Germination
short_description: An astronaut has crash-landed on an alien planet, and it's started to rain... seeds. Featuring a campaign and an endless mode with leaderboards, Germination is an arcade platform-em-up about stomping your way to the highest combo, excruciatingly detailed with hand-crafted animations.

name: Dura Vita Online
short_description: Dura Vita Online is a multiplayer RPG in a medieval fantasy setting. You are an ordinary citizen living your life when The Occurrence happens. Now evil has started to spread across the land and you have no choice but to take up arms and destroy it!

name: Guntastic
short_description: A fast paced couch and online arena brawler with comically violent, one-shot one-kill battles that last for just 25 seconds – after which anyone who's still alive is forcibly eliminated. Explode your friends in this frantic homage to the 16bit coin-op games of the past!

name: Core Awaken ~The Yuka~
short_description: A 2D scrolling action game with 3DCG. The protagonist YUKA is a robot fighting for the human side against a robotic rebellion.

name: Dogolrax
short_description: You awake on an unknown planet with amnesia. What are those horrific monsters? Who are these mysterious priestesses? Inspired by cult classics such as 'Another World', 'Flashback' and others, Dogolrax aims to surprise you in ways few games have.

name: Way Back Witness
short_description: 《归路：见证 Way Back Witness》是一款架空世界回合制RPG游戏。 玩家扮演“异界来访者”马次娜·骸，见证忒瑞阴德上的是是非非。在这不属于自己的世界中踏上那注定不平凡的归路。

name: SRX
short_description: Fly anything you want and reach the top of the world rankings! Will you be fast enough ?

name: Fear Corporation
short_description: Fear Corporation - This is a game about the hero's fear of his phobias, the hero is terribly afraid of clowns, statues and dolls. Waking up from a nightmare at night, the hero begins to realize that he is still in a dream, because he observes all his most terrible nightmares.

name: Blind Postman
short_description: Help blind postman, who sees only walls, to collect all the letters and to find an exit out of labyrinth.

name: Starshot: Space Circus Fever
short_description: Travel across the galaxy on a zany 3d platforming adventure. As Starshot, the star-juggler of the greatest circus in the universe, you must save the circus from crippling debt by scouring the cosmos for performers to put on the best circus show in history!

name: Orwell: Ignorance is Strength
short_description: Step into the shoes of a government official in a top-secret department of the Orwell surveillance program. Given the power to both uncover and fabricate 'the truth', how far will you go in the service of your country? Season 2 of Orwell, the award-winning surveillance thriller.

name: Heavy Impact
short_description: Heavy Impact thrusts you into the ring as a first-person robot brawler made for Virtual Reality. Deliver devastating blows, and dodge big hits! Slow down time to deliver crucial combos, or avoid trouble in the last second. Become the king of the bob-and-weave, test your metal and scrap the competition!

name: Aliens Are Rude!
short_description: The robots were dancing happily away until the aliens came and crashed the party! Engage in space combat, traverse planets, learn abilities from aliens, upgrade with perks and titles, strategize, dodge, shoot, and reclaim the nebulous!

name: Breath of Ghosts
short_description: Breath of Ghosts is a first-person horror game made in realistic 3D graphics that immerses you in an atmosphere of horror and scares you in every way. The main goal is to survive and be saved.

name: Yeminj
short_description: Yeminj is an score chasing arcade game, kill thousands of enemy's on a small arena using your sword and magic, cashing in on gems on burst to increase your power facing infinitelly harder waves, competing for the top place on the leaderboard, do you have what it takes ?.

name: Hot Speed
short_description: In a mysterious underground bar, gathered a group of beautiful face, hot figure of the female drivers. The player takes on the role of one of the drivers and conquers the other drivers with his powerful driving skills.

name: Naked News
short_description: Join in the fun with an unforgettable experience unlike any other! Naked News brings some hardcore, crass, dirty, vulgar, dark humour into an easily offended world, not pulling any punches and making fun of everything with this visual novel-style comic, Sitcom-esque episodic!

name: Zodicat
short_description: Playing Zodicat and Save The 12 Zodiac!!!

name: Shmup Moments
short_description: Shmup Moments is a shoot-'em-up game that's easy to pick up and play. With arcade-like gameplay, slick controls and sound, hot beats and lighting, and a classic bullet hell ambience, it's the perfect game to chill out with when you need a break from AAA titles, or to meditate with before going to bed.

name: Hanako in the abandoned school
short_description: This is a walking simulator game where the story takes place in an abandoned school.You must escape the curse of Hanako and escape alive.Explore the school and collect the materials left behind to uncover what once happened in this school and find a way to escape.

name: Rival Stars Horse Racing: Desktop Edition
short_description: Play Rival Stars Horse Racing for the ultimate horse racing experience. Care for and train your own stable of horses, breed the perfect champion, manage a homestead ranch and race for victory!

name: Witchtastic
short_description: Witchtastic is a challenging 2-4 player coop game about brewing and delivering magic potions as fast as possible. Take on the role of aspiring witches and experience charming adventures. Need a break from all the yelling of your friends? You can practice in a single player campaign as well!

name: Mesmer
short_description: A unique revolution simulator where every encounter matters. Mesmer! The pearl of the old world. At least it used to be. But this city has failed its people. Unite the people, spark a revolution and storm the castle. Build a better Mesmer.

name: Birth ME Code
short_description: The second entry of the Abime Series. Play as the mastermind in a death game where you must find the traitor while concealing your identity. Six hours, one school, six deaths. Nine participants fight for survival: it's kill or be killed, trust or deceive, escape or die.

name: RRRR
short_description: RRRR controls the super soldier Rabbit. Save civilization from destruction in the battle for freedom.

name: Actual Volleyball
short_description: Do you find yourself lying awake at night, wishing you had an outlet for your untapped talent and insatiable love for the sport of volleyball? Well, friend, have I got news for you! Your problem can be solved with just two words: Actual Volleyball.

name: Dollhouse
short_description: Dollhouse is a frightening film noir horror story sure to send shivers down your spine. Survive a horrifying trip into the mind of detective Marie. Piece your past together, but watch your back, as something gravely dangerous is hunting you down.

name: Tiger Tank 59 Ⅰ
short_description: This is a tank war game, players need to control their tanks, through the enemy lines, break the enemy base, or defeat the enemy tanks, open the way for the Allied offensive.

name: Angels of Fasaria: Version 2.0
short_description: Angels of Fasaria was originally released in 2005. With thousands of downloads and over 48 thousand active users in the browser based game, Angels of Fasaria maintained a loyal following and support base. After the release of 'Fasaria World' and later the 'Ancients of Fasaria' mmorpg.

name: Smash team
short_description: Multiplayer arenas with different game modes.

name: Robonauts
short_description: Shoot through storms of weird and funny creatures, jump between planets by switching gravity, and relive the childhood fun of your very first arcade shooters - alone or with a friend in co-op!

name: Always Higher
short_description: Always Higher is a single-player sci-fi adventure shooter VR game. Play as a secret agent, collect data modules, avoid enemy soldiers and escape underground facility!

name: MXGP2 - The Official Motocross Videogame
short_description: MXGP2 - The Official Motocross Videogame is the evolution of the previous Milestone’s Motocross game MXGP. The game is based on the 2015 FIM Motocross World Championship license.

name: sotas/时空幽灵
short_description: This game is composed of several different game spaces. Players get resources (such as gold coins) through the game, and go to different game spaces through shuttles. Different games have different identities, different game scenes and enemies. For example, in the beginning of the game space, the player is a warrior.

name: StoneTide: Age of Pirates
short_description: Embark on your most immersive, open world, pirate action experience ever! Will you survive the World of StoneTide?

name: PRICE
short_description: The hero Ivry wakes up from a nightmare and finds himself in a weird room. To escape from fear and darkness, he has to search and explore on his own until he discovers the truth and finds his sister Iva.A puzzle game 《PRICE》

name: 病毒恶化 VirusCrisis
short_description: Virus Crisis is a Roguelike RPG indie game with abundant stories and endings.You will be a high school student who encounters a Zombie virus outbreak and try to survive(or fall in love) with your girl teammates in the apocalypse. You need to lead everyone to survive with your wisdom and bravery.

name: Fishing Together
short_description: Are you bored at home during the epidemic? As the United Kingdom and the EU have just introduced bans on gatherings of more than 6 people, in such cases, how can we play with friends? We still need to be social however, and we need entertainments for ourselves too.

name: Freelance Trucker: Insurance Fraud Edition
short_description: Driving a big rig in a rigged economy has its risks, but that's why you have insurance.

name: Glista
short_description: Collect gems, avoid traps and reach your way out in this addictive two-button controlled game.

name: Ponchoman
short_description: Kill the creatures and upgrade your weapon to survive as much as you can.

name: Delta Light
short_description: Delta Light is a retro Arcade strategy/puzzle game where you draw lines to remove parts of the field while enemies try to stop you. Combine your speed and insight to out maneuver and puzzle your way around the enemies to complete the many levels! Pick it up and have a go!

name: Harvest Hero Origins
short_description: A wave defense game in classic arcade style. Play the infinite survival mode alone or with a friend (co-op), or play story mode and experience the origin story of the Harvest Hero!

name: TSIOQUE
short_description: TSIOQUE (pronounced: 'chiock') is a dark but playful Point & Click adventure, hand-animated in meticulous, frame-by-frame 2D. Escape the clutches of an Evil Wizard and discover the secrets hidden within the spellbound castle of your ancestors.

name: 窓の中の先にあるもの
short_description: This game is a puzzle game in which you aim for the goal window by switching between two perspectives, one viewed from the side and the other viewed from above. The biggest feature is that when you change the viewpoint, the depth and height also change.

name: COVID-19 (CORONA VIRUS)
short_description: Do you have what it takes to perform everyday tasks and curve balls life gives you to survive this quarantine? If you do you will get out this quarantine successfully and life will go back to normal.

name: Rascal Fight | 捣蛋大作战
short_description: Rascal Fight is a multiplayer arena brawler with a casual and cartoonish touch. You'll have an exciting combat experience against other players in challenging environments as a rascal.

name: Riddles of Fate: Memento Mori Collector's Edition
short_description: Death needs help from the only detective he trusts – you!

name: Twin Mind: Power of Love Collector's Edition
short_description: Famed twin detectives go on a new case! They are the only people skilled enough to find out what happened to a woman that vanished in the broad daylight. But it seems like they need your help to uncover this mystery.

name: Oknytt
short_description: Oknytt is an old school point-and-click adventure game where the player takes the role of a small, seemingly insignificant creature, leading it through a dark world filled with beings and areas inspired by Swedish folklore, in search of a place to belong.

name: In the Service of Mrs. Claus
short_description: You’re the only elf who can save Christmas from the forces of darkness! Clash with cults, gods, and giant corporations to preserve Mrs. Claus's empire.

name: The Front of Greed
short_description: No, Pay to Win/ Yes, Original Military FPS OBT 15:00 GMT/UTC + 2

name: Squarelands
short_description: Squarelands is sandbox adventure game where you explore a randomly generated world while fighting, building and becoming stronger as you play! Mainly inspired by Terraria, Squarelands aims to provide plenty of freedom for the player.

name: Jim Power -The Lost Dimension
short_description: Special Agent Jim Power-The supernatural alien, Vaprak, threatens to defeat our world which is the last planet that stands between him and a dimensional vortex.

name: Children of Silentown: Prologue
short_description: Prologue to Children of Silentown, a dark adventure game that tells the story of Lucy, a young girl growing up in a village deep into a forest inhabited by monsters. People disappearing is nothing uncommon in the village, but this time, Lucy is old enough to investigate on her own. Or so she thinks.

name: Chess Multiple Boards
short_description: Chess battle is re-imagined as 3D! In this variation of chess, we have up-to 8 parallel boards and the pieces can travel between them.

name: Travel Riddles: Trip To Greece
short_description: Travel to Greece and unlock its secrets, through a series of challenging riddles and puzzles! Through more than 8 episodes and 200 levels, a collection of 96 unique artifacts from the ancient world to the modern day are yours to collect. Make use of power-ups to set the best score!

name: Tesseract VR
short_description: Tesseract VR is a puzzle game placed in a fantastic environment.

name: I was rebuilt
short_description: I was rebuilt is a platform rage game were you play as R3B, a robot created by Dr. Zhang. You must help R3B to complete all the tests of a TV show to get the module of free will.

name: StrateZ
short_description: StrateZ is a casual post-apocalyptic RTS game where you fight to survive as one of three separate factions be it Survivor, Zombie or Marauder.

name: Agarest: Generations of War 2
short_description: Following the huge successes of the number 1 Steam top selling epic SRPG, Agarest: Generations of War and its prequel Agarest: Generations of War ZERO, Ghostlight are proud to release the massively updated sequel to the series, Agarest: Generations Of War 2!

name: Chronicle of Forgotten Times: Pawn of the Gods
short_description: The kingdom of Ayderia is going through terrible times, people suffer from hunger and disease, and at this time the feudal lords are at each other’s throats in the struggle for influence and power.

name: First Impact: Rise of a Hero
short_description: First Impact: Rise of a Hero immerses you in a beautiful comic book world where you can run, jump, fly, and summon elemental powers to protect citizens. Experience a lush array of islands and cityscapes and uncover the truth about a mysterious force sending meteors to Earth. For PC & VR!

name: Yo My Yo!
short_description: Yo My Yo! is a simplistic 2D racing game, in which the player must avoid collisions on the road during a given time.

name: Christmas Clicker: Idle Gift Builder
short_description: Help save Christmas in this idle builder game! Build workshops and presents!

name: Streets of Red : Devil's Dare Deluxe
short_description: Welcome to Streets of Red: Devil's Dare Deluxe, the permadeath multiplayer horror beat'em up that bestows players with the skills of retro gaming heroes in a fight against a legion of undead monstrosities. The chills, thrills, bills, and opportunity to learn new skills won't stop until every street runs red with blood!

name: My Cute Pagangirl
short_description: ⨁My Cute PAGANGIRL⨁ – a satirical visual novel with “Match3” gameplay. Spend your summer vacation with cute pagan anime girls in Magna Germania! Set off into a dangerous journey full of secrets and mysteries!

name: Javva Juice
short_description: Adventure little wizard named Javva, looking for his Coffee stolen by evil skeleton King. Enjoy challenging gameplay - then Javva Juice for you! Here you have to work hard to be like before you go through the next dungeon!

name: SPACECOM
short_description: SPACECOM – a strategic-to-the-bone, starfleet command game in which deception, smart movement, and choices to battle decide victory or defeat.

name: Potion Commotion
short_description: Live the CRAZY life of a Wizard’s assistant in this hilarious Clicker game! You’ll be in charge of making wacky and wonderful Potions, using ingredients produced in your garden. With plenty of twists and turns along the way, the fun never stops! Do you have what it takes?

name: Gods of Sand
short_description: Train gladiators. Manage a ludus. Fight in the arenas. Conquer the tower. Gods of Sand is a gladiator manager with intense turn-based combat, inspired by the Swords and Sandals series, in a dark and unforgiving setting.

name: SixGenerals | 六小将传说
short_description: This is a Three Kingdoms strategy game to eliminate the class, here through various ways to obtain the Three Kingdoms, in the battle through the elimination of the same block and the martial arts plan combination to win, complete the Three Kingdoms.

name: Skeleton Warrior
