short_description: This is a Twin Stick Shooter style game that requires the utmost survival against the relentless enemy. You can earn points by playing the game and use the points you earn to purchase six main weapons, six special weapons, and six types of upgrades. Leverage a wide range of unique weapons and upgrades to score even higher!

name: FORCED SHOWDOWN
short_description: Deckbuilding empowers this challenging bullet hell adventure! Each character is a unique experience: Choose a deck of unlockable cards to boost you in new ways every battle - 'My whirlwind shoots fireballs!?'. Battle hordes of brutal foes to become a superstar in C-SAR’s ever-changing game show.

name: Foodtruck Arena
short_description: Foodtruck Arena an unconventional mix of car combat and football game, combines two things that make the world go round: food and sports. Become one of the legendary chefs, take part in an unforgettable tournament, battle against formidable opponents, and climb to the top of the culinary world!

name: Fist Puncher
short_description: Return to the glory days of sidescrolling beat-em-ups, courtesy of developers Team2Bit and Adult Swim Games. The sinister Milkman holds the city of San Cruces in his nasty criminal grip, and it’s up to legendary black belt neurosurgeon Dr. Karate and the rest of the Fist Puncher team to deliver old-school justice to the lawless streets.

name: System Shock: Enhanced Edition
short_description: Re-discover what made System Shock the first of it's kind, a ground breaking immersive sim that would inspire a generation of games to come....

name: Telefrag VR
short_description: Telefrag VR is a hellishly fast-paced shooter with visceral movement and combat mechanics. Dash, shoot, and teleport around unique arenas that feature impossible geometry where there is no right side up and death can come from any direction.

name: Kate Kite
short_description: 《Kate Kite》 is a running game, beautiful painting style, beautiful music,You will love it.

name: Wolf Adventures
short_description: Interactive novel in pixel style about the king HappyWolf. You're a powerful king Happy Wolf of the kingdom EbenGrad. For a long time, your citizens were happy about everything, but times have changed.

name: Anniversary Collection Arcade Classics
short_description: 8 KONAMI arcade classics of the 80s, from Nemesis to TwinBee. Including bonus eBook packed with new information never before revealed to the public.

name: Commando Jack
short_description: A Tower Defence game, that actually allows you to sit inside the turret and come face-to-face with the enemies! Addictive strategy - action game, with loads of shooting and explosions! Nearing 2 MILLION DOWNLOADS!

name: Shoemaker
short_description: Shoemaker is a unique shoe workshop simulator game where you need to fix boots

name: Security Hole
short_description: Can you push through?! Security Hole is a challenging spatial puzzle with a cyberpunk story. You become a hacker who passes 3D virus blocks through security holes to save humanity. The game mechanics look like a workout tool for spatial thinking.

name: Taxi
short_description: A sliding Tile puzzle game with 29 levels ranging from easy to skull cracking. A killer soundtrack and great visuals make this a must play game! Try to get the taxi from start to the airport on each level.

name: OCEAN CITY RACING
short_description: Popular open-world driving game features an explorable Free Roam Environment, a thrilling Race Mode and a highly addictive Time-Trial Mode.

name: Occurrence at JCR Outpost
short_description: A scientific mission in Antarctica goes awry when something is released from beneath the ice! Who is friend? Who is foe? Only you can solve the mystery of the Occurrence at JCR Outpost!

name: Umbrella Corps
short_description: Join the corps! Umbrella Corps brings a competitive experience featuring new types of strategy and technique blended with elements from the world of Resident Evil, to create a unique kind of shooter!

name: KINGDOM of the DEAD
short_description: Immerse yourself in a dreadful hand-drawn horror world and push Death’s armies back to the underworld!

name: Zorya: The Celestial Sisters ™
short_description: In this award-winning cooperative puzzle game, play along with a friend as either Aysu or Solveig and help bring back the night in this never sleeping world. But be careful, you must safely navigate the shadows to solve the increasingly complex puzzles.

name: Invisibox
short_description: Invisibox is a tough puzzle game where you have to solve sliding puzzles by controlling invisible boxes while avoiding various obstacles.

name: Laser Attraction
short_description: Play with lasers and solve puzzles in Laser Attraction. Use reflection, refraction, dispersion and filtration to direct the laser beams, mix and separate colours, open doors, hit targets and complete puzzles.

name: Sophie's Cubes
short_description: Create, scramble, and solve puzzle/magic cubes.

name: Seven Kingdoms 2 HD
short_description: Seven Kingdoms 2 is an award-winning classic real-time strategy game of intrigue and diplomacy, of trade and industry, of betrayal, espionage and conquest.Take control of any of twelve emerging Human civilizations: Egyptian, Indian, Persian, Chinese, Japanese, Mongol, Greek, Roman, Carthaginian, Norman, Viking or Celt.

name: Zombie Murder Hell Arrives
short_description: Command two robots with their own shooting methods. Choose which one to control, using different parameters and super attacks. Shooting monsters will help you upgrade your robot of choice. Face a giant boss at the end of each scene!

name: Weaverse
short_description: Weaverse is a story-based first-person sci-fi adventure game with strong action elements, puzzles, and unique gameplay mechanics.

name: Aircraft War
short_description: Aircraft War is a 2D aircraft battle game. There are 5 different sections, 5 different player planes and 5 different enemy planes in this game. There are 3 different options in the game: single player , co-op and versus. Good game to everyone.

name: Rejoinder
short_description: Fight an army of skeletons and evil warriors! Collect coins to upgrade your gear! Defeat tough bosses in this roguelite with procedurally generated levels!

name: Scribble Plus
short_description: Scribble+ is the quick-draw, multiplayer party-game designed from the ground up to be playable by the whole family, anywhere in the world (especially with Twitch integration!). All you need is connection to a web-browser, and any phone, tablet, laptop or desktop can become a controller.

name: Arizona Rose and the Pirates' Riddles
short_description: Join Arizona on her epic treasure-hunting quest, with over 200 levels of picross to solve and numerous treasures to discover.

name: Oil Wars
short_description: Strategy and simulation game where you will be faced to enemies for control of oil refinery and strategic resource locations.

name: RAW FOOTAGE
short_description: Raw Footage is a first-person horror game, travel with nothing but your camera through forests inhabited by vicious creatures while capturing what footage you can of them. You’re not the first, but if you can expose these beasts to the world you’ll be the last.

name: Sonic Forces
short_description: The fate of Sonic the Hedgehog’s world is in your hands – Join the Uprising.

name: Dairy Princess
short_description: その名作の『ラクノープリンセス』はいよいよSteamに登場しました！『ラクノープリンセス』は酪農シミュレーションゲームです。プレイヤーは街外れの牧場を経営する女の子となります。

name: The Chronicles of Jonah and the Whale
short_description: A classic tale is brought to life in match3 game 'The Chronicles of Jonah and the Whale'. Follow Jonah as he goes from being an ordinary man to a true prophet of God in this memorable story of obedience, mercy, and forgiveness.

name: Viking Brothers 2
short_description: Join the Viking Brothers on an all-new, humor-filled adventure!

name: Citadel: Forged with Fire
short_description: This massive online sandbox RPG features elements of magic, spellcasting, building, exploring and crafting. As a newly minted apprentice of the magic arts, you will set off to the dangerous world of Ignus. Tame mighty beasts, forge alliances, explore uncharted territories or fight for dominance!

name: Turing Complete
short_description: Learn CPU architecture with puzzles

name: All To Race
short_description: Participate in the craziest races organized by a multi-million dollar company that has decided that everyone can participate regardless of the vehicle you compete with, all to race!

name: INFLUXIS
short_description: A sci-fi underwater survival and exploration game

name: T. B. P.
short_description: This is a game in which the player needs to navigate through the planets of the corresponding type (so that the other planets are the same as the one on which the rocket is located).

name: Street Striker
short_description: Street Striker is an arcade game about street fighting. Choose your hero and arena, find weapons, or use your hand-to-hand combat skills to stand up against waves of bandits and complete the level.

name: Apollo 11 VR HD: First Steps
short_description: To mark the 50th anniversary of the iconic lunar moon landing, you can now relive humanity's first steps on the Moon in Apollo 11 HD : First Steps.

name: Flipped On
short_description: In Flipped On your main objective is to complete each stage without destroying your vehicle. Your vehicle takes damage every time you crash into world objects.

name: Drift Horizon Online
short_description: Drift Horizon Online - Drifting simulation game! - Nice & optimized graphics! - Realistic car sounds (Blow off, Exhaust, Backfires, Skids, etc)! - Realistic physics!

name: Tale of Fallen Dragons
short_description: This is a dungeon crawler game with roguelike elements based on Ancient Chinese story. Under the Fallen Dragons Temple, you`ll fight with various dragons which all have different shapes. The art style is based on real artifacts from China, we hope you could experience a different style of our culture.

name: Black Rose
short_description: Equipped with a flashlight, investigate an abandoned funeral home that's said to be haunted. Find out what really happened to the people who once worked there, and hope that this dark, eerie building doesn't become your final resting place.

name: Sexy Breakout
short_description: Play response outstanding block breaking appeared! Break the blocks and collect all sexy graphics!

name: Drive Megapolis
short_description: Improve your real life driving skills! Drive Megapolis is designed to be interactive and also a learning opportunity. Tracking your driving mistakes and clearly highlighting them, allowing you to learn and improve. With a huge variety of vehicles with unique driving styles, maps, pedestrians and traffic.

name: Kill Tiger
short_description: As the excellent killer,you finally eliminate the last hidden danger of Your Majesty. What you face is not the supreme glory,but the cold shackles. What conspiracy is there behind all this! ? Passing through layers of dense fogs, and getting across the gears layer upon layer, You will search the cruel truth!

name: Coast team
short_description: Located on an island off the coast (third-person view), players can try out a variety of weapons.Players are free to explore the islands,The premise is to avoid the attack of the enemy and kill the enemy, otherwise the player will die,Players can choose the appropriate terrain and appropriate weapons to deal with a variety of enemies.

name: VR Maze
short_description: Have you ever experienced VR through a maze? It can bring unparalleled visual effects to the player, and it can also bring the player an immersive maze experience.

name: SPACE DVRTS
short_description: SPACE DVRTS is the definitive dart combat experience set in space for the HTC Vive

name: Fancy the Frog
short_description: Be a hero Fancy the frog. finish levels and avoid dangerous enemies

name: Mysterious warrior
short_description: Mysterious warrior - Introduces a 2D action platformer adventure. You have to play as a mystical warrior, carry out the orders of the servants of the deity and destroy the evil spirits that have infected this world.

name: FATE
short_description: Play (or Re-play) This Classic Dungeon Crawler!During the golden days of action RPGs, FATE was a powerhouse, winning runner-up for PC Magazine’s Role-Playing Game of the year. Popular enough to spawn 3 sequels, this was one of the premier dungeon crawlers of its time.

name: JUMP UP
short_description: Enter the world of Jump Up, take on the parkour challenges and discover all the secrets of the game!

name: Groundless
short_description: Groundless is a local multiplayer arena game where you build and destroy the ground you walk on.

name: Seek Girl V
short_description: This is a Sokoban casual game. Players need to fill the holes in the ground with cubes to rescue the trapped girl.

name: Russian Prison Tattoo Simulator
short_description: Become a tattoo artist in Russian Prison. Get introduced to tattoo iconography and special meanings of Russian Prison tattoos

name: Big Thinkers 1st Grade
short_description: Big Thinkers 1st Grade is the perfect learning supplement to your child's classroom experience. Ben and Becky Brightly's contagious wonder and ability to transform themselves into a variety of shapes and forms engage kids in a fun world of learning and discovery!

name: Dino Galaxy Tennis
short_description: Dino Galaxy Tennis is a 2D side-view action Tennis game set in space on the surface of various planets with all sorts of dinosaurs. Choose from exciting single-player tournaments, challenges and multi-player modes.

name: Ollie-Oop
short_description: A game about a skateboarding dog named Ollie, who goes on the adventure of his dreams! Play with your pup friends and wreak havoc in all kind of fantastical environments.

name: Space Demon Combat Tactics III
short_description: Join the High Commander as the eternally loyal Green in an epic journey to save the Blues from the menace of the Greys and their evil Red Gems!

name: Banana Town
short_description: Be who you were meant to be. Be a Banana!

name: L-Way
short_description: L-Way is a minimalistic labyrinth-puzzle game.

name: Alienautics
short_description: Play as a bionic supersoldier to destroy the underground colony of the Octylian regime on an alien planet. Alienautics is a cinematic third person sci fi action shooter.

name: NEO: Commanders
short_description: NEO: Commanders is a 2D strategy game with RPG elements that extend the strategic gaming experience. The player's task is simply to build a strong army and conquer enemy territory.

name: Delila's Gift
short_description: Delila's Gift is a VR Picture book created using Tilt Brush! It tells the story of a small sea creature named Delila and her struggle to understand belonging, ownership, fear, othering, and the darkness surrounding her.

name: C. Kane
short_description: An old-school, satirical game in the vein of classic Japanese console RPGs. Features talking beavers and Media Moguls.

name: Beyond Shattered Isles
short_description: Beyond Shattered Isles is a fast paced first person parkour game. Grapple, dash and jump through this beautiful broken world.

name: Protect the Earth
short_description: You are the best pilot in the space force and the earth needs you to protect itself from an alien attack. Protect the earth and then go to the invader's planet to finish them off once and for all.

name: Bug Battle
short_description: Bug Battle Game is a simple top down shooter game. Players shoot at animated bugs that are spawned by a boss crawling on top of the screen. Once a specific amount of baby bugs are killed, the player is then able to damage the boss bug and level up.

name: Warriors: Rise to Glory
short_description: In this rogue-lite turn-based RPG, you create a bloodline of gladiators, fight online with or against your friends in the arena, decide the fate of your fallen rivals, and bring honor, wealth, and the spoils of war to improve your legacy.

name: Nautical Life
short_description: Buy yachts and customize the interior with furniture, besides fishing around the world!

name: Android Helipad
short_description: Android Helipad is an arcade style flight game inspired by the classic 1992 game, 'UGH!' In Android Helipad you play as android pilot Ellie in the future of 20XX. Your mission is to safely deliver passengers to their destinations while avoiding dangerous hazards. Will you be successful in this low poly adventure?

name: Path Of Wuxia
short_description: Path of Wuxia combines classic wuxia world and youthful school life with anime art style, features simulation gameplay well known by Heluo fans. Play as a young Xia who join the academy known as the Hermitic Pavilions of Xia, grow strong along with various schoolmates and seek your own path of Xia.

name: Kolumno
short_description: Don't let yourself be fooled by its minimalist looks, Kolumno is one of the most elegant and challenging games in recent time.

name: STRIDE
short_description: STRIDE is a high-octane parkour adventure in virtual reality. Fight for your life as you hurtle through the rooftops of a futuristic metropolis. Step into the shoes of a master freerunner as you vault, swing, and shoot your way through this action-packed adventure. Multiplayer now available!

name: Airport Madness 3D: Volume 2
short_description: Our second volume of Airport Madness 3D compliments the first one with eight new airports, new aircraft, more gates, and sharper detail. Volume Two offers New York John F. Kennedy, Toronto Pearson, Miami, London City, San Francisco, Lukla Nepal, Hong Kong, and Chicago O'Hare.

name: WRC 9 FIA World Rally Championship
short_description: WRC is the leading off-road simulation franchise. It returns with even more realistic gameplay and more content than ever: 3 new rallies, 35 new special stages, creation of your own custom championships and completely redesigned engine sounds.

name: Firelight Fantasy: Resistance
short_description: Firelight Fantasy: Resistance is a spectacular third-person sword fighting game

name: Vesper: Zero Light Edition
short_description: Thousands of years after the activation of the Vesper Protocol, a small android crosses a fallen world, hunted by merciless machines, to control the power of Light and decide the fate of his race.

name: Phantasmat: Crucible Peak Collector's Edition
short_description: Is it possible to die, but remain trapped on Earth for eternity?

name: Lost City of Vampires
short_description: Sent by the Council to hunt the 'lost city' factions... You must destroy an entire bloodline and put an end to an unsanctioned blood war by remaining the last vampire standing in this single player shooter challenge. (Not Exactly, but Similar to a Battle Royale)

name: Kilta
short_description: Kilta is a single-player auto battler strategy RPG featuring item management, an interesting story supported by a growing cast of unique characters, charming pixel art in a 2.5D environment, and a stunning soundtrack.

name: 破东荒 - Chaos Of East
short_description: 《破东荒》是一款roguelike类横版动作游戏，抛弃了传统的地牢关卡形式，糅合了大量的中国元素，简单粗暴的游戏体验以及大量的游戏内容，带给玩家易上手、趣味多的直观体验。深度研究国内玩家体验偏好，打破一些传统模式，为玩家带来新奇体验。

name: Endless Soul Light Solitaire
short_description: Help your friends in their search! Classic solitaire in a fantasy setting!

name: Ben 10
short_description: Ben, Gwen, and Grandpa Max once again have their cross-country road trip in the Rust Bucket cut short by super villains and their evil, world-threatening plans. As Ben Tennyson, it’s up to you to save the world.

name: The Seven Districts of Sin: The Tail Makes the Fox - Episode 1
short_description: As an auditor of Hell, you're sent off to investigate a wayward governor. Where will your journey bring you? An otome visual novel with both intrigue and humour, featuring 2 male and 2 female love interests as well as 9 different endings.

name: Dumb Little Creatures
short_description: Help a group of innocent creatures avoid all deadly hazards and get back home safely.

name: Alien Prop Hunt
short_description: Jump into an exciting new take on a classic concept! Alien Prop Hunt is an action packed team-based game where one team desperately tries to hide in plain sight, while the other relentlessly searches through environments to find them!

name: Purrfect Apawcalypse: Patches' Infurno
short_description: Patches is dragged to school for the first ever cat-and-dog school day! All he needs to do is get this damn collar off and wreck some havoc! Will he prove cats and dogs can get along, or will he make this the Purrfect Apawcalypse?

name: MXGP 2019 - The Official Motocross Videogame
short_description: Experience the excitement of the 2019 season for the first time in the series! Race in official MX teams, share your gaming experience with the community thanks to the Track Editor and the Waypoint mode and practice in the Playground to learn to ride like a real pro!

name: Wolves Team
short_description: The latest version is updated on October 9, 2019.'Wolves Team' is a multiplayer gun fighting VR game , having 3 modes .PvC mode : All players are in one team , fighting zombies . Single player can play this mode . Killing the boss in limited time makes the mission completed .

name: Our Past
short_description: OUR PAST is a story-driven first-person adventure game focused on exploration and puzzle-solving. The player will appear in the role of the main character Patrick trying to find the truth behind his grandfather's death.

name: Pixamal Zoo
short_description: You’ve taken a job as the Zookeeper of a rundown zoo that will soon be turned into a carpark. Improve the zoo and fill it with adorable Pixamals to get more fame and visitors. Only you can save the zoo!

name: Monsterland
short_description: 2D tile-based shooter in style of Doom 2 (1994), inside a story-driven campaign with scripted sequences.

name: Lucid Dream Adventure
short_description: Lucid Dream is the story of little Lucy, who goes on an adventure into the world of dreams with the mission to save her mother.

name: The World After
short_description: Set during a pandemic lockdown in France, The World After is a FMV adventure game experience that tells the story of a man who tries to uncover the truth behind his strange nightmares and the mystery of the village he's living in.

name: Deck Adventurers - Origins
short_description: Card fighting game with deck building mechanics, in which you'll also customize the deck's own cards.

name: Not Without You
short_description: The Pilcri have been captured! You must save them! Enjoy dozens of levels and hours of puzzles to test your wit and help these lovable creatures escape!

name: 1000 days to escape
short_description: Only 1000 days left until the end of the world. You have to realize the largest space program ever to save as many people as you can. Explore planets, colonize them, help people find a new home.

name: Hell To Raze
short_description: Play as the Prince of Hell in this Hack and Slash top-down platformer. Fighting to reclaim his throne after being framed for his fathers' murder, the prince uses his sword to grapple and swing through hell; slaying any demons that get in his way.

name: Pronty
short_description: Guide Pronty and its Javelin partner Bront as it defends the once great city of Royla. Explore the deep sea, fight mutant sea creatures, and discover the secrets behind this new Atlantis in this beautiful action-packed adventure.

name: ASSAULT SHELL
short_description: Engage in an action packed shoot em' up adventure! Choose from 4 powerful fighters and fight through 5 intense stages! Multiple tough and challenging bosses stand in your way, so use the insanity system BLANK STAND to erase them all!

name: Saving Sunrise
short_description: You need to collect resources, build your shelter, hold the defense, and also need to make sorties in search of ammunition and medicines.

name: Ghostbusters™
short_description: Grab your Proton Pack and join the Ghostbusters alongside your friends, exploring Manhattan, blasting ghosts, and trapping those runaway ghouls.

name: Noel the Mortal Fate S1-7
short_description: This is a story about the revenge of a girl who lost her arms and legs to a devil... Noel The Mortal Fate is a charismatic adventure game, now available worldwide on Steam in English, Japanese and Simplified Chinese with seasons 1 - 7 available now in one package.

name: PUT ANNA
short_description: Ordinary Japanese girl-sorceress comes to Russia…

name: Monsters In The Shadows
short_description: Low-poly horror fps survival shooter game. Kill monsters hidden within the walls of an abandoned city.

name: 8BitBoy™
short_description: Huge classic platformer with several power-ups and 8-12 hours of main story & 300+ hidden locations just begging for exploration · 56 big Levels · 5 huge worlds

name: Math+Sticks - Coffee Break Club
short_description: A puzzle for math lovers with matchsticks that won't burn you, but will light up your mind Challenge your mind moving, adding and removing matchsticks until you find the correct solution. How many tries do you need to solve each level?

name: Heroes of the Three Kingdoms 7
short_description: 《三国群英传Ⅶ》由宇峻奥汀研发，是三国群英传系列第七作。游戏内除了拥有系列作中广受好评的千人战之外，全新升级了武将技，添加更多的战略系统，在武器的合成、士兵的强化等方面都做了全新的设计。藉以触动玩家每一根运筹帷幄的思考神经，挑战玩家战术运用的极致。

name: Rider's World: I Want To Ride!
short_description: In 'RIDER'S WORLD - I WANT TO RIDE!' you can take care of your own horse and ride out with your own horse. The game offers fun for young and old.

name: Maze 4D
short_description: This game is a 4D maze puzzle game featuring Time Trials, standard, and other modes coming soon! Compete with yourself and friends in two categories: Time and Minimum Number of Moves!

name: Pestis
short_description: A young Plague Doctor, only to learn that the Academy sent to a small village, which, like the whole country is gripped by plague

name: Hats Are Not Allowed
short_description: A FighterRPG set in an absurd Robo-Authoritarian society. The forbidden headwear has awakened your consciousness. Defeat all who come against you in tense duels. Ignite the fires of an uprising, lead your forces in battle and decide the fate of Genu Corp.

name: POPGOES Arcade
short_description: Battle the corrupt animals of the forest, collect valuable items and abilities, and save the world, TWICE, in this retro-styled RPG adventure! As an official spinoff of the Five Nights at Freddy's horror game series, you can expect familiar characters, loads of secrets, and maybe some scares...

name: The Penguin IQ Test
short_description: Are you intelligent enough to save the penguin? Help him get back to the ice floe. This test will measure your IQ and give you a result between 0 and 180.

name: The Guild Gold Edition
short_description: It’s the year 1400- the late Middle Ages. Europe sees the dawn of the golden age of the new departures and the free spirit. Under the rule of the bourgeoisie and businessmen, more and more towns are emerging from the clutches of the aristocracy and are achieving independence, power and wealth.

name: Fatal Gem VR(The First Match-3 VR Game)
short_description: Fatal Gem is the first match-3 VR game and during the game, evil aliens trap the player whose left hand is tied to a time bomb so the player should try to match the gems with the mattock. Keep working and try not to be blown up. Good luck, poor miner!

name: Alpha Command
short_description: Arcade style retro game in virtual reality.

name: Baptize Billy
short_description: Baptize Billy is an arcade style shoot'em up that'll leave your anus busted and your mind disgusted.

name: Winged Sakura: Endless Dream
short_description: Discover. Build. Defend. Survive. Escort. Open endless doors, discover endless new rooms, and defeat endless robots. Build towers, form contracts, gain new allies, and survive the Endless Dream.

name: Angel and Devil,ninja,sushi,tempura,panda and the statue of liberty
short_description: Shooting game to defeat the devil with angel's arrow.

name: Indigo 7
short_description: Indigo 7 is a fast-paced multiplayer puzzle game for up to 4 players, with a cool and fun single-player story mode plus more than 6 different play modes. Get the best score, conquer the territory before your opponent and don't run out of moves in this amazing adventure! Easy to learn hard to master!

name: Liquid Sunshine
short_description: Guide a monkey, horse and a rhino through challenging puzzles, and discover the roots of their relationship through a full-blown comic book backstory.

name: Liberte
short_description: A story-driven, top-down rogue-like set in an alternate-history, Lovecraftian version of the French Revolution. Play solo or Co-op and influence the fate of four unique factions in their clash for power.

name: Snakebird Primer
short_description: The snakebirds are back, this time yellowbird joins the team on a more relaxed island with easier puzzles. A casual puzzle game for the entire family as well as a primer for the serious challenges of the original game.

name: Valkyrius Prime
short_description: Fight through countless enemies and hulking bosses in this indie shoot-'em-up! Teleport to dodge enemy fire, then counter with an assortment of powerful weapons. Valkyrius Prime features all new character art and story, plus many more improvements over the original.

name: Brutality club
short_description: This is a one-on-one fighting simulator.

name: CROSSNIQ+
short_description: CROSSNIQ+ (CROSS-neek plus) is a speed-focused, arcade-style puzzle game inspired by 'y2k-era' visual design - a tribute to highly polished, small-scope Japanese games from the late 90's.

name: Fruit Attacks VR
short_description: Suit up to defend the earth against a fruit alien invasion! Get your daily serving by piloting one of several distinct SATI speaker robots to unleash devastating sonic attacks using unique shot-curving controls. Think fast though, the host of rotten fruit alien invaders will use different tactics to defeat you.

name: Graviton
short_description: The Traykonians don't believe there's intelligent life on Earth, and it's up to you to prove them wrong. Manipulate gravity to solve their mind-bending puzzles... just try not to accidentally fling yourself into any lasers.

name: NewCity
short_description: The Regional City Builder: Let's Build Something New.

name: [Chilla's Art] The Caregiver | 終焉介護
short_description: The Caregiver | 終焉介護 is a psychological Japanese horror adventure game about a caregiver.

name: Death Becomes You - Mystery Visual Novel
short_description: Who killed your best friend?! Find out the truth before 4 suspects frame you instead! Death Becomes You is a mystery visual novel where you untangle the dark secrets of your fellow magic university students.

name: Ladder Box
short_description: Ladder Box is a 3D puzzle game. Navigate boxes with mesmerizing mechanics, utilize the unmovable boxes to make one of the moving ones reaches the only exit!

name: Bloons Monkey City
short_description: Create, upgrade, and customize your very own Bloons Monkey City in this groundbreaking blend of city building and tower defense awesomeness!

name: Downward Spiral: Prologue
short_description: Downward Spiral: Prologue is a mysterious and atmospheric zero gravity thriller powered by innovative, free movement in VR without motion sickness.

name: I Love Finding Critters
short_description: I Love Finding Critters is a classic hidden object game where you can search for a huge assortment of animals! Squirrels, hamsters, chicks, ducks, and so many more! Find them all in beautiful scenic locations and solve puzzles and play mini games as you go along.

name: The Cows Are Watching
short_description: Did you ever wondered about the rumors of cow tipping? Now it´s your turn! Use the darkness and silence of the night to enter the meadows and tipp as much cows as needed to enter the next level.

name: Wizards: Wand of Epicosity
short_description: When the Wizard of Darkness awakened, it was up to one man to defeat him. When that man was accidentally killed by one idiot, Tobuscus (or 'person of extremely low intelligence' - gently put), the responsibility of becoming an AWESOME WIZARD fell onto him...

name: Alpha Zoo
short_description: A cozy typing game for parents to play with their young children. Build a zoo, ride the rides, eat and shop, explore and play together!

name: The Caribbean Sail
short_description: Name your crew, purchase supplies, sail the world, harpoon fish, plunder your enemies, die horribly, unlock a new Captain and do it all over again!

name: PUZZLE: ANIMALS
short_description: PUZZLE: ANIMALS - a logical game in which your task is to collect puzzles and get a picture of different animals.

name: POWERTRIP
short_description: You've been called out in the middle of the night to fix an Emergency Generator. Not a great start to the evening.

name: Desert Law
short_description: Desert Law is a new spin on the traditional real-time strategy that immerses players into a post-apocalyptic world where gasoline is the new world currency.

name: VOID
short_description: VOID is a visual novel themed around espionage and revenge. You play as Arthur Woods, a man seeking revenge from the death of his loved one, forging himself into a deadly assassin. Along the way, you will meet people who may (or may not) be your allies, as you try to untangle the web of lies and intrique surrounding your girlfriends...

name: Wolflord - Werewolf Online
short_description: Is your friend a bloodthirsty werewolf? Is your neighbor a demon from the eternal abyss? Band together in the small town and unmask the evil characters before everything is lost.

name: Square Journey
short_description: Square Journey is a minimalist arcade game that aims to help Square reach the depths of his inner dungeon in search of a greater understanding of himself.

name: Kittens of Fear
short_description: Kittens of Fear is a fast-paced, first-person horror game. 100% jump-scare free.

name: visser
short_description: visser is a short game about fishing

name: Avalon Legends Solitaire 2
short_description: Harness the power of the cards as you travel across Avalon through 300 meticulously crafted levels of engaging solitaire to collect the resources you need to restore the kingdom to glory.

name: Bunhouse
short_description: Bunhouse is a cute, simple, bunny-filled game focused on growing plants and managing a greenhouse with fellow buns. Take care of your leafy plant buddies by balancing the amount of water and light they get. Play with friends and upgrade your greenhouse for wholesome, relaxing fun.

name: Bhavacakra Grace
short_description: Will Grace succeed in her job as a mercenary?

name: Chook & Sosig: Walk the Plank
short_description: Chook & Sosig: Walk the Plank is a charming point-and-click adventure about tabletop gaming, mischievous friends, and spectral poultry.

name: Ocean's Crabellum
short_description: Shoot 'em up! The former soldier Crab have to holster up his old Parabellum guns. He must wreak massive havoc to clean up the Big Ocean from villains and get revenge for his friends. Destroy the unrestrained mafia gang led by giant octopus in the best tradition of top-down and scroll-action shooters.

name: Gift from the Gods
short_description: In this challenging maze-like platformer from 1985, become the mythical Orestes, brother to Electra, as he searches labyrinthine catacombs for the fabled Euclidean Shapes and avenge the murder of his father, Agamemnon, by his mother, Clytaemnestra.

name: Monads II
short_description: The second work following [Monads], released in 2019.This is a puzzle-tactics game without RNGs, so you can revert your action anytime. Find your own solution of prepared stages, following the story of 6 protagonists.

name: Slaveblade
short_description: DISCLAIMER: Made by one dev. Slaveblade is the story of Idraxymus the Enslaver. Already dead and tormented, Idraxymus makes a deal for resurrection. Everything in his path must be slain and his final destination is a mystery. Slaveblade is an exploration about what it means to live and die.

name: Satan's Castle
short_description: This game is an action & strategy. While attacking you can summon monsters at the same time and fight.

name: The Stalin Subway
short_description: 'The Stalin Subway' is a First Person Shooter-style game where the events take place in post-war Moscow. The game allows to plunge into the depressing atmosphere of the Stalin's period and to play as a Soviet officer.

name: Parkour Polygon
short_description: Dodge hazards, climb walls, and kick off of signs in your rush to the flag! Parkour Polygon delivers a 2D parkour experience with a striking minimalist style.

name: Lilycle Rainbow Stage!!!
short_description: ★The Lilycle Yuri Drama CD series comes to life, featuring an all-star cast, now in a fully-visual adventure game. While Lilycle is a must read for any dedicated yuri fan, it contains a selection of nice and easygoing stories to warm the hearts of one and all!★

name: Balrum
short_description: Balrum is an old-school, turn-based, open world RPG with deep tactical combat. Explore a huge living fantasy world with dozens of side quests next to an epic main quest. Grow your own crops, build your home, and craft your own custom items.

name: Fallen girl - Black rose and the fire of desire
short_description: The lady of the noble was taken to prison by the countess 'I don't want to be reduced to a plaything without consciousness.' ——In the face of the bad taste of the countess, how to use their body and wisdom, in order to avoid suffering? 'Before I lose my mind, I want to find that life.'

name: DUMB Infernal
short_description: Enter the infernal hellscape as a lone warrior fending off an army of monsters in arcade style combat.

name: Becoming a Dandelion Spore
short_description: - Drag your mouse in the direction of the wind - The flower will fly in the drag direction. - Please go to the end. - If a conflict occurs, start over.

name: Zeko
short_description: A calm and cute original puzzle game. Clear stages to unlock the next one. Each stage has its own challenge.

name: Secret Saga: Xamadeon Stone
short_description: Are you good at finding things and enjoy interactive levels? You are at the right place! You need to dig for artifacts, look inside a lion's mouth, beep-boop the cars and much more in Secret Saga!

name: Dungeon Manager ZV
short_description: Japan’s megahit dungeon simulation game is now in English and available globally. Manage your own dungeon and micro-manage your zombies, monsters, minions and traps. Think strategically to summon your forces, level them up and defend against endless invaders and boss units.

name: dancing chair
short_description: Two men struggle to get the chair!!! After stopping the music, If you can sit the chair at a certain time , YOU WIN !

name: Wild world
short_description: This is Wild World, there is danger at every step.

name: Florence
short_description: Florence Yeoh feels a little... stuck. Her life is an endless routine of work, sleep, and spending too much time on social media. Then one day, she meets a cello player named Krish who changes everything about how she sees the world and herself.

name: Little Hats
short_description: Little Hats is an open-world survival game mixed with RPG elements, in which you play as a Gnome! Set in a magical world, you will have to survive, build, and explore, in order to discover the secrets of the forest and the many lands that lay beyond!

name: HALF DEAD 3
short_description: Become a member of the highly anticipated sequel of the co-op sci-fi show. Gather a team of four friends. The more partners the more chances to survive. Find your way out in a deadly new room complex filled with even more sophisticated traps.

name: The Fantasy World of Mahjong Princess: General Version
short_description: This is a 2D Japanese Mahjong game with adult simulation features. You are a big Mahjong fan who got reincarnated in another world. As the world‘s top Mahjong tutor, you need to build your own team and train your students while developing special relationships with them.

name: Synced Warriors
short_description: Synced Warriors is a puzzle game where each button press controls all of the characters on the screen at the same time. You must navigate them to different locations while killing off the extra warriors.

name: Myriavora
short_description: Myriavora is a roguelike swarm action shooter in a sci-fi setting. You unleash a storm of fire and ice upon giant spiders, dodging their frantic attacks via cool moves.

name: SHADOW STEP
short_description: Blaze your own trail through uncharted and mysterious territory!

name: 栄冠は君に レジェンドパック
short_description: High school baseball simulation. Become a coach and aim for Koshien! Fourth in the Artdink Legend Pack series. This game is only available in Japanese.

name: Dark Sun Pictures' Dark Sun - The Space Shooter
short_description: New free shooting game (almost free). Dark Sun is an Arcade RPG space shooter. Get a chance for legendary gear in one short raid for an upcoming full 3D MMORPG done via Amazon's Lumberyard engine.

name: The Eyes of Ara
short_description: Explore a vast, mysterious castle riddled with secret rooms and challenging puzzles in this award-winning puzzle adventure.

name: Ink Plane
short_description: Short arcade game drawn and coded by Artur Petrov. You have to fight the pirates in the air, sea and land.

name: The Light Empire
short_description: Enter this universe 'Roguelike / RPG' randomly generated, or you'll be in control of a spaceship and take your crew in the depths of the universe to save your people.

name: Kimmy
short_description: Kimmy is a visual novel game about a young babysitter in 1968. Dana takes a lonely girl named Kimmy under her wing, worried that she's having trouble making friends. Let summer begin! Collect trinkets, play street games, and learn about Kimmy and her mysterious family as summer passes by.

name: Singularity Shooter
short_description: Singularity Shooter is an arcade with realistic gravity physics of black holes, where your task is to avoid meteors and collect as many points as possible. Lots of bonuses can help you in your space adventure.

name: Found Horror Game 11.exe
short_description: You'll scream in pleasure... You'll choke with fear! Play through 11 sick, frightening and perverted games, released in an experimental episodic format that relies on you, the players, to continue. Can the curious souls brave through the hidden depths of each game to reach the shocking conclusion?

name: Hero of Light VR: Episode 1
short_description: 'Hero of Light VR' is an action VR game with an eastern fantasy background. The ancient continent in the Eastern realms are experiencing a holocaust. Priests of an occult order have breathed life into ancient demons, summoning them into calamitous destruction across the lands.

name: Quible Sphere
short_description: Roll through 40 different levels that increase in difficulty, avoiding several obstacles and using powerups in order to get to the end of each level!

name: Jad
short_description: JAD is an atmospheric jumping and puzzle platformer.

name: PUZZLE: BIRDS
short_description: PUZZLE: BIRDS - a logical game in which your task is to collect puzzles and get a picture of different birds

name: Nova Genetics
short_description: Nova Genetics is open-world sci-fi zombie survival game. With focus on survivability/exploration and quick decision making. Should you try to run and live to fight another day or build outposts and fight against threat hordes.

name: soko loco
short_description: A train transport strategy game. Build tracks, order trains, and collect resources to build more! Feed towns to gain more workers, and streamline your production process to build a giant, final monument!

name: POPPIN' DONUTS
short_description: お菓子を揚げて、積んで、登って　王子様に会いに行こう！このゲームは、お菓子の国のステージにドーナツで道を作りながら、王子様の待つゴールを目指すアクションゲームです。

name: Detours
short_description: Play as Daniella as she moves across the country with only the help of her ex.

name: Reignfall
short_description: Reignfall is a real-time strategy game with elements of city-building and third-person action. Build a city and defend your keep against waves of increasingly difficult enemies. Can you survive against the fallen horde?

name: Scrap Garden
short_description: Scrap Garden is a charming puzzle platformer about the adventures of Canny, a lonely robot, who awakens in a post-apocalyptic world to find all other robots shut down and seized up. What happened to the City? Why did all robots stop moving? Did anyone survive except him?

name: SPECIAL FORCE VR: INFINITY WAR
short_description: SPECIAL FORCE VR: INFINITY WAR is a tactical multiplayer, being developed for virtual reality head mounted displays. It combines VR's realistic combat style and convenience with a high level of combat experience. Let's become the best Special Forces by using firearms and throwing grenades like in real!

name: Santa's Story of Christmas
short_description: Santa’s Story of Christmas is a story-driven adventure game. Santa has been robbed and Christmas is in danger! You have to help him to save Christmas this year. Get into the right Christmas spirit and let a story be told, accompanied by a wonderful hand-drawn artwork and selected music.

name: Song of Farca: Prologue
short_description: You are Isabella Song – a hacker PI. Your job is to hack cameras, phones, and computers, as well as question suspects, analyze evidence and draw conclusions. But don't forget that in Farca city, even criminals can end up victims.

name: Stabby Cats
short_description: Fighting your fellow kitties with your incredible agility and arsenal of sharp weaponry in this 2D action game! Toss knives, climb around mansions, and stab your friends to see who will be rewarded the coveted golden yarn!

name: Gears Tactics
short_description: Gears Tactics is the fast-paced, turn-based strategy game from one of the most-acclaimed video game franchises – Gears of War. Outnumbered and fighting for survival, recruit and command your squad to hunt down an evil mastermind who makes monsters.

name: The Sealed Ampoule
short_description: The Sealed Ampoule is a “dungeon agriculturalization Roguelite game” combining elements of dungeon exploration and clicker-style gameplay.

name: TRIPILL
short_description: Puzzle game with planning elements, 300 levels, many hours of fun. The game is to collect pills. You are controlling three viruses , each of them can only move in one way. You can combine them together to move in different directions.

name: Dimension Hunter VR
short_description: Dimension Hunter allows you to immerse yourself in this tongue in cheek, over the top, retro-arcade experience, with a unique choice of free or railed movement. Fast paced, hardcore, fluid gameplay mechanics with a unique, and yet familiar, comic book style of carnage and gore.

name: Moonstrider
short_description: Moonstrider is an action roguelike about shipwrecked astronauts trying to survive the journey back to Earth. Leap between planets with your trusty rocket boots, gather powerful items, fight against deadly and cunning aliens, and discover what really stranded you in the depths of space.

name: Bounty Below
short_description: Bounty below is an idle adventure game about mining and smithing items. While your units are mining for you delve into the endless dungeon to gain even more ore!

name: Castle Clamber
short_description: Castle Clamber is an arcade action platformer for one or two players inspired by games of the 80s and 90s.

name: Buried: An Interactive Story
short_description: Buried is a playable, interactive story told through stunning photos, a haunting soundscape, and gripping text. You play the role of Roger Hastings, a logger working the forests with his crew. When he awakens to find his friends missing and no memory of what's happened, he begins searching, uncovering something that should have stayed...

name: Home Creator
short_description: Home Creator provides you with a set of tools to create your dream home! Choose the size of the room, change the walls and flooring, fill your home with furniture and appliances, cut through windows and doors. Home Creator will make you feel like a real interior designer!

name: Chronicles of Lurra
short_description: The Chronicles of Lurra is a free to play RPG set in the fictional world of Lurra. You follow Trent, the main character as he is dragged from his home through time and space to the world of Lurra.

name: Coffee Pot Terrarium
short_description: Created by two brothers, Coffee Pot Terrarium is a turn-based puzzle game of tile manipulation. Raise new pathways to traverse the map, drop tiles to eliminate the enemy. Stop and smell the cherry blossoms.

name: Honey Villa
short_description: You play as a hacker who lives alone in a villa. In a rainy night, there was a knock on the door. after opening the door, a beautiful girl fainted in front of the door. She was just drunk. The hacker took the girl into the house for the night. The next morning he girl suggested sharing the house...

name: Magician's Gambit
short_description: Chess! Magic! VR! Play this age-old Game of Kings against the best strategic mind in the Kingdom - a master tactician and chess paragon unlike any other. Word is he has never been defeated... Will you rise to the challenge?

name: Mike the Cat
short_description: Single Player Endless Runner

name: Mysterious Night (The First Night)
short_description: Puzzle and mystery genre, find objects to escape. The game evokes exploration and discovery of mysteries with a hint of gloom and curiosity. Mystic Night (first night) is a story about a boy named Uri and the mysteries surrounding him.

name: Happy Halloween
short_description: Happy Halloween - is a usual 2D platformer where you have to do various picturesque hardcore levels playing as a main character Jack.

name: Oh...Sir! The Hollywood Roast
short_description: The boys are back , and they look better than ever! Oh…Sir! The Hollywood roast is a brand new spinoff to the surprise indie hit 0f 2016, Oh…Sir!! The Insult Simulator. This time around we’re taking tinsel town down a few notches, whilst classing up the joint.

name: Tower Ascent
short_description: Tower Ascent is a Virtual Reality climbing game, where the player is challenged to reach the top of each tower! Compete with other's time, or take your time finding just the right hand hold to reach the top. Master all the levels and reach the top as fast as you can!

name: Dark Nebula VR
short_description: Dark Nebula is a sci-fi VR shooter full of insane encounters and bloody kills.

name: Aerial Guardian
short_description: Aerial Guardian is a large scale multiplayer battle first person shooter. Choose from several classes and play as a soldier to embroil yourself in a space fleet battle. Choose from a variety of over 20 weapons and several vehicles including mechs.

name: I Am Bread
short_description: You are bread. Your mission, become toast! Take on all hazards to deliciousness as you head on an epic adventure in one of the the toughest games ever baked. All of the game modes (including Bagel Race) are now unlocked so there's sure to be something to suit everyone's taste!

name: A Mazeing Tower Defense
short_description: A traditional mazeing tower defense game with a fresh twist that'll have you playing for hours on end!

name: Infernax
short_description: Infernax is the adventures of a great knight who returns to his homeland only to find it plagued with unholy magic. Uncover the mysteries of the curse and face the consequences of your actions.

name: MIRADOR
short_description: MIRADOR is a 2D action game. You arrive at a temple... Kill several monsters to grow, get skills, and go through it!

name: The Dishwasher: Vampire Smile
short_description: The followup to 2009's Dead Samurai, The Dishwasher: Vampire Smile is a combo-fueled, fast-paced, stylistic 2D action platformer that features the series' staple gritty, graphic novel-inspired art style, built on a new engine that allows for an even more visually gruesome experience.

name: Tower Defense Sudden Attack
short_description: Tower Defense Sudden Attack is a strategy game set in a military base seized by many terrorists and now is under attack.

name: Boston Nursing Home
short_description: Boston Nursing Home is a First-Person Indie Horror Game. There’s luggage stacked on the ground, bloodstains on the wall. What happened here and why did people move out in such a hurry? What unpredictable disaster made everything lose control? The truth, is waiting to be uncovered...

name: Fieldrunners 2
short_description: Get ready to DEFEND THE WORLD! The biggest sequel in tower defense history is finally here: Fieldrunners 2 has arrived! From Subatomic Studios, creators of the award winning classic strategy game comes an all new adventure that was years in the making.

name: Takorita Meets Fries
short_description: Deep under the sea, there is a princess who didn't know anything about french fries. This is her story, Princess Takorita's fated encounter with the french fries.

name: Fragments
short_description: Evan faces a frustrating battle with his conscience. It's one he cannot afford to lose, or he'll spend the rest of his life behind bars. Under intense scrutiny and questioning from two savvy detectives, how will he fare? That, is entirely up to you.

name: Hentai NetWalk
short_description: Hentai NetWalk is a network construction logic game, and what you need to do is to connect all the devices to the network.

name: Sudden Strike 2 Gold
short_description: At the height of World War 2, take command of German, Russian, British, American and Imperial Japanese armies on battelfields across the globe. Sudden Strike 2 expands on all aspects of the classic RTS game with new units, maps and epic campaigns.

name: Puzzle Dungeon
short_description: Test your mental arithmetic, language and cognitive abilities while you adventure through Puzzle Dungeon in an attempt to retrieve the fabled Hypercube.

name: Einherjar
