short_description: 在21世纪30年代的世界，任何新鲜事物都不足为奇，城市里每天都喧闹非凡。“我”和妹妹则是离开了那热闹的中心，搬到了这偏僻的乡下地带，和在这里认识的朋友们每天生活在愉快的日常里。不过这平静的日常又能持续多久呢？

name: Aquarium Simulator
short_description: If you ever wanted your own aquarium, but could not get it. This game is for you, take care of your own aquarium and compete with your friends, which of you is richer. Do not forget, your aquarium lives even when you turn off the game.

name: Husbandry
short_description: As an entrepreneur from a far away galaxy, raise and breed the exotic creatures of Earth, then sell them back to your home world.

name: Death Rpg
short_description: Top Down drag & drop RPG strategy game. Help 3 survivor to kill enemies in different worlds.

name: Low Desert Punk
short_description: A stoner trip in the desert on a 50s chevy pickup. A classical hardcore arcade game where you must to score fleeing and smashing enemies and cleaning your karma.

name: MOF
short_description: Survival Horror First person Shooting Looting Game

name: ANCIENT SOCCER
short_description: Welcome to the global VR tournament. Here you control soccer teams of special non-human players to complete various challenges. Tactical and fast-paced, this game is designed to be the arena of competition for VR players all over the world!

name: Avocado Love
short_description: Avocado Love is a colorful and enjoyable platformer with a side view. Pirates have kidnapped the soul mate of our hero Avocado, help him save her and reunite again.

name: Traffic Command: Reborn
short_description: Traffic Command Reborn - Take command of the traffic in the streets, redirecting cars, and telling them when it is okay to stop, and when it is okay to go. One big game of Red light green light keeps you on your feet in this addicting traffic driving game.

name: The Longest Five Minutes
short_description: A hero faces his greatest foe, the Overlord. But there's one problem: Why can't he remember anything!? In the midst of battle, his allies' words and the Overlord's taunting trigger flashbacks, slowly rebuilding his memories. Will our hero remember everything before he falls to the Overlord?

name: Clouds of Rain
short_description: In Clouds of Rain you will play multiple characters, each with his own story. Explore a hand drawn world with various regions, face harsh battles and sail the skies. Resource management, preparation and tactical fights are at the core of the game.

name: NALOGI 2
short_description: NALOGI 2 - new satirical game in the genre of RPG. The emperor became emperor after the election. Again. For eternity. PAY TAXES!

name: Agricola: All Creatures Big and Small
short_description: Agricola: All Creatures Big & Small is a digital adaptation of Uwe Rosenberg's award-winning two-player board game featuring farming and livestock breeding.

name: Zombo Buster Rising
short_description: Shoot zombies from terrace like a boss! Zombo Buster Rising Remastered brings you a nostalgic experience of classic 2D side shooting-defense in enhanced build right from your Steam library!

name: Down the Drain
short_description: Take a trip below the sink with Marta in this top-down 2D shooter through randomly generated mazes of pipes. Defeat gooey enemies, overcome strong bosses, and learn what's really going on when trouble starts brewing beneath our tubs and under our streets.

name: The Automatician
short_description: Take on the role of Emma in a first person puzzle game, solve puzzles and problems in a Victorian mansion. Prove your worth as a candidate to become 'The Automatician' and build increasingly complex chain reaction machines. Can you become the new Automatician?

name: EPONYMOUS
short_description: EPONYMOUS: In Which a Work Is Known by Its Reading is a short-form narrative about unreliable infrastructures.

name: HammerHelm
short_description: HammerHelm is a unique blend of third-person adventuring and strategic town building. Create your dwarf character and build a flourishing town above ground. Complete quests, craft weapons and armor, defeat dangerous enemies and be the leader your townspeople need!

name: Wizard of Legend
short_description: Wizard of Legend is a no-nonsense, action-packed take on wizardry that emphasizes precise movements and smart comboing of spells in a rogue-like dungeon crawler that features over a hundred unique spells and relics!

name: Fine Sweeper
short_description: Fine Sweeper is a Minesweeper variant with additional features such as a campaign mode, “classic mode”, item drops, leader-boards, and achievements.

name: Robinson: The Journey
short_description: When the Esmeralda crashes on Tyson III, Robin is left stranded. He must rely on his wits – and HIGS, an AI unit from the ship – to survive. As he searches for the lost crew and comes face-to-face with dinosaurs, Robin discovers that Tyson III is not the paradise once promised.

name: Sydney Hunter and the Curse of the Mayan
short_description: In this pixel-perfect homage to the classic action platformers, you play as Sydney Hunter - an explorer who gets trapped inside a Mayan pyramid while he's out exploring!

name: Jinga Online
short_description: Grab a block from anywhere under the last completed row and then put it on the top - that's it! The longer you play the harder it'll be as the tower becomes more and more unstable, however, you'll also unlock stuff faster. Good luck!

name: Bandit Kings of Ancient China
short_description: 'Suikoden: Tenmei no Chikai' was released in Japan in 1988 and later in the US as 'Bandit Kings of Ancient China.' It is a simulation game based on the novel 'Suikoden' or 'Water Margin,' a Chinese classic. Players play as a bandit being pursued by imperial officers.

name: Booth: A Dystopian Adventure
short_description: The year is 2036. In this famine-riddled world, food-centric sovereignty has been established. Living alone inside a food-inspection booth, you are striving to find truth and peace beyond the borderline.

name: This is My Dungeon
short_description: You are the Dungeon Master. Manage the dungeon, direct the monsters and fight off intruders who try to destroy the dungeon core!

name: Higurashi When They Cry Hou - Ch.6 Tsumihoroboshi
short_description: Higurashi When They Cry is a sound novel. The music, backgrounds and characters work together to create a world that is the stage of a novel for the user to read. They laugh and cry and get angry. The user takes the point of view of the protagonist to experience the story.

name: Brazilian Root®
short_description: Brazilian Root® is an indie action game in first person perspectve. Benjamin, a former special ops soldier, was running for governor, but 30 days before voting day his daughter was mysteriously kidnapped. He will relive his fighter days and You will help him find his daughter and get his revenge.

name: Kaet Must Die!
short_description: This is the hardest, most challenging, horror puzzle game you will ever play. 30+ hours of sanity-testing puzzles over the course of 10 horror filled levels. You are Kaetheran, an extremely powerful psionicist with a flair for cyberpunk style. You have awoken in a dank sewer without your mind powers.

name: Board Games VR
short_description: Play board games in virtual reality. Backgammon, Chess, Checkers, etc. Check out the game description and announcements for a continuously updated list of games and features.

name: Fly of butterfly
short_description: Fly, butterfly, fly. Relaxing game for those who do not like stress and like when everything is simple and easy.

name: FPV Freerider
short_description: RC Quadcopter Racing Simulator - Fly (and crash!) all you want regardless of the weather, all for the price of a few replacement props.

name: Robin Hood: Winds of Freedom
short_description: Help Robin Hood and his merry men rescue King Richard from a cunning kidnapper! With its cast of timeless characters, rollicking story of heroism and addictive gameplay, Robin Hood: Winds of Freedom can turn hours of idle time into a quest for fun!

name: Geek Resort
short_description: The first tycoon game based on the geek universe!

name: Space Station Sprint
short_description: Space Station Sprint is fast paced sci-fi first person shooter. Infiltrate each space station and complete your objective before your escape ship is spotted by the enemy. Use special abilities, find permanent upgrades, time bonuses, collectibles, and secrets throughout each space station.

name: Amaranthine Voyage: The Obsidian Book Collector's Edition
short_description: Enter the role of Eve Glover, one of the best CCPP's agents, sent to investigate the lack of radio communication from your scientific team on Iceland, researching harmonium radiation.

name: Grand Mountain Adventure: Wonderlands
short_description: Grand Mountain Adventure: Wonderlands lets you explore freely and at your pace entire ski resorts and the surrounding mountains. Unlock ski lifts and reach new areas by competing in challenges, or enjoy the scenery while you find your own path down the mountains.

name: Run Jump Fail
short_description: You wanna run? You wanna jump? You're gonna fail. Again. And Again. But its fun to fail...right? Take control of HappyMan and hop skip and jump your way past low walls, big balls and spinning red things! A bunch of obstacles await, so get to it.

name: Dad Quest
short_description: Embark on a great Dadventure in this unique comedy, story-based 2D platformer. Raise your child to become the weapon they were always meant to be.

name: Voyeur
short_description: In Voyeur, you take on the role of a private investigator hired to collect evidence of wealthy CEO Reed Hawke’s corruption by a member of his family. Originally released on the Phillips CD-i back in 1993, it was one of the first games to fully utilize Full-Motion-Video as an integral game mechanic.

name: 真探
short_description: In order to improve the efficiency of selecting talents, the Chicheng police specially developed a test system-the true detection system, with the black robe company. As a tester, you need to complete the cracking of the case under the rules of the system.

name: Long Gone Days
short_description: A modern-day RPG that imagines the world of war that's coming for us, with a focus on language barriers and the human cost of these conflicts.

name: Seers Isle
short_description: Seers Isle is a narrative game, set in a fantasy version of medieval northern Europe, where your choices impact the fate of a group of characters.

name: 3x3 the immersive fiction chapter one : Math awakening
short_description: 3x3 is an interactive adventure game in 2d cartoon style mixed with narrative and movie sequences. The gameplay dynamic is close from an escape game. An episodic format of nine chapters is planned for the first part of the story call prologue connected with mini TV series from 3x3 whole universe

name: aMAZE St.Patrick
short_description: aMAZE St.Patrick is a straightforward and surprisingly - difficult celebration of the simple beauty of the maze with Saint Patrick's Day art and calm soundtrack.

name: Dark Sales
short_description: Dark Sales is a 2D action RPG that takes place in a modern office setting.

name: MicroTown
short_description: Build and manage your own settlement! A relaxing village construction and management simulator.

name: Mushihimesama
short_description: Battle huge 'Koju' bugs in CAVE's beautiful fantasy shooter, Mushihimesama. Experience the thrill of bullet hell from the masters of the genre as you evade visually stunning shot patterns with thousands of bullets.

name: 100 hidden snails
short_description: Hidden object game in a surreal style. Extremely hard!

name: Fly Destroyer
short_description: Do you hate flies? Then this game is for you! Flies .. they are everywhere! Arm yourself and destroy them all!

name: ASDAD: All-Stars Dungeons and Diamonds
short_description: Compete against a friend in an exhilarating diamond-collecting race where quick and strategic thinking and good maze-navigation skills are key to outmatch your opponent and emerge victorious!

name: Twilight on Yulestead
short_description: Break the curse on your town and yourself with only your cleric's staff and being half your normal size.

name: Camp Grizzly VR
short_description: You Are a Camp Counselor taking care of 4 kids. Keep the children entertained, or they'll leave and wander off... Don't let the fire run out, it's bear season!

name: Life is Strange: Before the Storm
short_description: Life is Strange: Before the Storm is a new three part standalone story adventure set three years before the events of the first game. This time play as Chloe Price, a rebel who forms an unlikely friendship with Rachel Amber in a dramatic new story in the BAFTA award winning franchise.

name: DRAKERZ-Confrontation
short_description: The Trading Card Game in Augmented Reality.

name: Jack B. Nimble
short_description: Jump in the shoes of Jack B. Nimble and master the whip in this cute, retro infinite runner.

name: The Red Exile
short_description: The Red Exile is a Survival Horror game with procedural level generation, perks, and an AI-controlled Killer.

name: Hungry Piggy vs Chicken
short_description: Hungry piggy vs Chicken: Yes! We are Hungry! We all love the delicious eggs! Hungry piggy vs Chicken features hours of gameplay, challenging puzzles, and lots of replay value. Each level requires logic and skill to resolve.

name: LARA CROFT AND THE TEMPLE OF OSIRIS™
short_description: Lara Croft and the Temple of Osiris is the sequel to the critically-acclaimed Lara Croft and the Guardian of Light, and the first-ever four-player co-op experience with Lara Croft.

name: FEIST
short_description: A desperate, savage survival experience full of stunning visuals, dynamic creatures, and a haunting soundtrack.

name: Icebound
short_description: A steampunk visual novel and puzzle game set in Permia - a world in the depths of an ice age. Dougal, a wandering alchemist, must compete against several eccentric individuals for the ultimate treasure.

name: Glass Masquerade
short_description: Welcome to Glass Masquerade - an artistic puzzle game inspired by Art Deco & stained glass artisans of the 20th century. You need to combine hidden glass pieces to unveil clocks and themes exhibited by various cultures of the world at the 'International Times Exhibition' - an interactive electronic show.

name: Zup! 9
short_description: Minimal physical puzzle with explosions

name: Clash of Irons
short_description: Real-time tank RPG+SLG game. It recreates the classic tanks of World War II and restores the shocking war scenes with fantasy World War II plots. Command your futuristic tanks across history and rekindle your war spirit with the will of iron and blood.

name: Just One Line
short_description: Just One Line is a fantasy RPG gamebook-like indie game heavily focused on choices and their consequences in which you may compete with other players in an interactive leaderboard. Create different Adventurers and embark on epic quests, unlocking new content for your next playthroughs or create and share your own adventures with the...

name: DotLine
short_description: DotLine is a challenging minimalist puzzle game. Click on puzzle elements to drive the ball to the exit without falling into the void. Completing the game will require fast thinking and reaction !

name: Uninvited
short_description: Stay alive in this weird and peculiar horror experience. What begins as a game between friends turns into a race for your life. Take a breath and enter the house. Welcome to Uninvited.

name: Champions of Aerial
short_description: Champions of Aerial is a battle arena fighting game with up to four players where the goal is to under a series of rounds, push the other players off the platform and be the only one remaining, to be the Champion.

name: Space Betrayers
short_description: A deduction game unlike any other. Experience a unique mix of card game, crisis management and backstabbing.

name: Arcade Mayhem Juanito
short_description: Arcade Mayhem Juanito is a retro experience about arcade-hopping. Teleport into different video games, play with unique mechanics inspired by well-known arcade games, face stunningly animated bosses and join the fight against the clonocell invasion.

name: Fallback
short_description: Lead the rebellion in an epic rogue-like adventure. Guide your jet-pack equipped post-apocalyptic volunteers through a labyrinthine underground complex by jumping, dodging, and battling against robot minions (and masters) to get to the surface — and bring life back to the scorched Earth.

name: Dega Madness
short_description: Play through 15 different heroes and use your abilities as you work towards the end of an orbiting platform without being destroyed.

name: Reiner Knizia's The Confrontation
short_description: A turn-based strategy game pitting two players of Light and Shadow against each other with asymmetric forces and hidden units.

name: Galaxy in Turmoil
short_description: Galaxy in Turmoil's conceptual Early Access game is a FREE multiplayer combined-arms game set in a brand-new universe, created by a team of volunteers. It’s all about endless arms races, corporate espionage, and, most of all, blasting up on the enemy faction and taking their stuff.

name: Hypnorain
short_description: Hypnorain is a vertical bullet hell shooter. The player guides a character through handcrafted levels, shooting and dodging their way through an army of enemies and their mesmerizing bullet patterns.

name: flChess 2
short_description: Chess game in 3D environment, where advanced artifical inteligence with 6 levels of strength can make you work hard for win.

name: TPORT
short_description: A first-person puzzle game with a teleporting mechanics. Enter puzzle rooms that can only be solved via utilizing personal teleporter units. Discover the secrets of the tech giant IRT and its teleporting technology.

name: The Last Weekend
short_description: «The Last Weekend» - This weekend you'll never forget.

name: Festival Tycoon 🎪
short_description: A micro-management sim about music festivals! Design the perfect festival grounds in ‘create’ mode, then manage the event itself in ‘live’ mode! Book bands, sign deals, plant flowers, fix toilets, and grow your show into a global phenomenon.

name: iREC
short_description: A narcotics police officer invades a logistics company, suspected of drug trafficking. Looking for evidence, he discovers an even greater secret, and his mission now and leave the place alive. iREC presents moments of tension, with an incredible atmosphere of terror.

name: Wolfie's Break Out
short_description: Back in my day we had to go outside and to a place called 'The Arcade' to play video games. take a trip back to simplistic controls and try to beat your high-score or even challenge your friend to beat it with this retro arcade brick breaking game!

name: Epic Cards Battle 2 (TCG)
short_description: 3D PVP Free Fantasy Strategy TCG Online Game！Experience the legendary battles. Hundreds of cards. 3 Card types: Creature, Spell, Trigger. Campaign and Arena and Ladder.

name: Catlateral Damage: Remeowstered
short_description: The premier first-person destructive house cat simulator is back with a vengeance! Play as a mischievous cat, swat your human's possessions onto the floor, scratch up curtains, smash precious keepsakes, and show your owner who's boss.

name: Hero Hours Contract
short_description: Magical girls are real, but the pay sucks! Join the Union of Magical Girls in a tactical, turn-based adventure, as they fight to protect the city from evildoers by day, and fight to become unionised by night.

name: Neurodeck : Psychological Deckbuilder
short_description: Neurodeck is a psychological deckbuilding card game to challenge your fears. Build your deck & capacities by answering personality tests, visiting rooms or meditating. Face your phobia and defeat them through the power of life-inspired cards.

name: Lumin's Path
short_description: Lumin's Path is an atmospheric 3D platformer using light and darkness to impact the world in mysterious ways.

name: Telepath Tactics
short_description: A deep indie strategy RPG with destructible battlefields; the ability to build bridges, traps, and barricades; the ability to shove enemies off cliffs and into lava; and full-fledged mod support.

name: Puzzle One
short_description: Puzzle One is an extremely difficult casual permutation puzzle sandbox.

name: The Black Death
short_description: Plague has left a trail of destruction across 14th century Europe. Survivors confront sickness and scarce resources in a land rife with banditry. Fight for scarce resources and learn new crafting techniques. But at all times you MUST avoid the plague. This is the land of ‘The Black Death’.

name: PUT IN BAD
short_description: PUT IN BAD is a simulation game that will allow you to plunge into the difficult life of the president! Objective: to save enough money and leave the presidency.

name: 封妖录
short_description: 讲述一个斩妖除魔的故事，故事中有正义，也有阴谋，有算计，也有恩情。整个流程只需要4-5小时。

name: The Intern
short_description: The Intern - O Estágio is a platform/action with elements of rpg/jrpg and anime elements, a deep story places the player in the shoes of an aspiring creative lady who will travel through worlds, times and dimensions

name: Last Hope on Earth
short_description: An single/multiplayer game of survival in a desolated post-war future world. A group of clone challenges the dangers of a forbidden Earth trying to survive against monsters made of pure radiation.

name: Escape War
short_description: Are you ready for escape adventure? Do you answer is “yes”? Let’s go!

name: Lion Quest
short_description: Take Jethro the Lion on a magical journey, traversing space and time to prevent the imminent collapse of the universe. Oh and your friend Ronald the Bear is missing, maybe you can find him whilst you’re out exploring?

name: BoomBox
short_description: Drum to the rhythm of the music in VR with Pupa the cat! Visit beautiful environments, play with friends in multiplayer, easily download community levels, and unlock items through challenges to customize your cat and your experience in Boombox!

name: Super Sketchy Party
short_description: A drawing guessing party game for at least 3 players. Played with your smartphone and works locally and online combined for the ultimate fun.

name: Square Game
short_description: Test your thinking an strategy skills in a remake of the classic Puzzle-Game Microsoft Russian Square Plus! Edition

name: Spellwake
short_description: Spellwake is an online 3D Action RPG where Anything Goes. It features fast-paced hack n' slash against hordes of monsters and powerful bosses. Spellwake's vast class system allows you to make nearly infinite variations of builds.

name: Stronghold HD
short_description: The original castle sim, Stronghold HD allows you to design, build and destroy historical castles. Engage in medieval warfare against the AI in one of two single player campaigns or online with up to 8 players.

name: Raji: Prologue
short_description: Raji: An Ancient Epic is an action-adventure game set in ancient India. A young girl named Raji has been chosen by the gods to stand against the demonic invasion. She must use the powers granted to her by the gods to rescue her brother as she battles to face the demon lord Mahabalasura.

name: Super Turbo Sudoku
short_description: Welcome to 'Super Turbo Sudoku', a game not about love, trust, hope or bravery, but about solving Sudokus. No matter if you prefer to just relax solving easy riddles or if you want to prove yourself with insane challenges, this game has it all!

name: Control Freak
short_description: Control Freak is the wacky action game where you have to think fast to out smart your friends.

name: Endangered
short_description: Aliens are invading Earth and are taking out Earths military assets. Join them in the conquest of planet Earth.

name: Fishards
short_description: Combine the intense, skill-shot PVP of Magicka or Battlerite with some wacky 2-legged-fish and you've got yourself Fishards! The unique spell combining mechanic creates a brand new type of PvP​ ​arena​ experience that you have to try with friends!

name: FUSER™
short_description: Welcome to FUSER™—a nonstop virtual music festival where you and your friends control the music! Mix elements of the world’s most popular songs like “Don’t Start Now” by Dua Lipa, “Old Town Road (Remix)” by Lil Nas X ft. Billy Ray Cyrus, “Blinding Lights” by The Weeknd, and more!

name: Astria
short_description: Enter the doomed world of Astria, a land destroyed by Cataclysm where all living things are dying. Play as Gwen, an Astrian willing to make his last move before everything ends.

name: My Riding Stables: Your Horse world
short_description: You always wanted to run your own estate, decide yourself about the look of your stable and look after your own horses? With this PC game your dream comes true.

name: Hadean Lands
short_description: Alchemy, puzzles, and a crashed starship. Old-style interactive fiction — a classic text adventure. No graphics! No dialogue trees! No point-and-click! You type your commands, and read what happens next.

name: Mine Crazy: The Korean Grinder
short_description: This is the essence of Korean grinder MMO. This game strongly shows the art of 'Grinder' game.

name: The Medium
short_description: Discover a dark mystery only a medium can solve. Travel to an abandoned communist resort and use your unique psychic abilities to uncover its deeply disturbing secrets, solve dual-reality puzzles, survive encounters with sinister spirits, and explore two realities at the same time.

name: In The Ember 余烬之中
short_description: Angelina was originally an ordinary adventurer.But since she met a weird man and robbed her of her job,everything has changed.

name: The Blitzkrieg: Weapons of War
short_description: Become commander and defend the motherland from invading enemy forces. Utilise a devastating arsenal of weaponry, and survive the blitzkrieg!

name: Rise of Insanity
short_description: In Rise of Insanity, as a doctor of psychology you will explore the darkest recesses of the human mind. Overcome your fear to find the truth behind the tragedy that has befallen your family.

name: The Kite
short_description: The Kite is a small dramatic point-and-click adventure. The game highlights the problems of a struggling family.

name: Chiaro and the Elixir of Life
short_description: A young engineer named Chiaro gives life to a steam powered robot called Boka, and together they embark on a quest for the fabled Fountain of Elixir, in order to restore the lost race of alive machines to the world.

name: 打豹虎 Spider Derby
short_description: Spider derby is a blood sport involving spiders that occurs in different forms in several areas of the world. In this game, you need to explore new land to catch new spider for fighting. At the same time, you need to train it even use a new spider to feed it.

name: Parapsychology
short_description: Parapsychology is a co-op horror game that can be played with 1-3 people. Find the demon in the house with your friends and destroy it with instructions.

name: Breaking earth
short_description: This is a fantastic 3rd person stealth shooter. You have to collect parts for a spaceship to fly away from a dying earth in a post-apocalyptic world. Fighting enemies and mutated spiders will not make you bored in the game.

name: 1812: Napoleon Wars
short_description: A strategic game about the war of Napoleon and the Russian Empire.

name: Riaaf The Spider
short_description: Help the spider Riaaf get his fill!

name: NEKO-NIN exHeart 3
short_description: 'We have arrived from the Fuuma Village in order to serve you, sir!'

name: NECROTOPIA
short_description: NECROTOPIA is an exploratory action game, in which a monster, who woke up on a stormy night by lightning, picks up junks as weapons and searches for who he/she is. Use various types of weapons to defeat enemies and explore the fascinating world.

name: Double Switch - 25th Anniversary Edition
short_description: Welcome to the Edward Arms, a mansion full of intrigue and shady characters who are never as they seem. At first, you must watch rooms closely, trapping any intruders with ingenious hidden devices.

name: Lara Croft GO
short_description: Lara Croft GO is a turn based puzzle-adventure set in a long-forgotten world. Explore the ruins of an ancient civilization, discover well-kept secrets and face deadly challenges as you uncover the myth of the Queen of Venom.

name: Mind Mirror
short_description: Help Omar on his journey through this puzzle experiment! Logical deductions and problem solving skills will be tested in this sci-fi puzzle environment. Let’s combine puzzle, exploration and escape room elements. Play with your friends!

name: GO AWAY, THERE'S KUMIS OVER THERE!
short_description: This arcade runner is about a horse and our favorite drink - kumis! Collect cookies, pick up items like multipliers, bombs, HPs and try to get as high score as you can. Cookies are your best friends in that game!

name: Survival Hell
short_description: Survival Game is a Single-Player PvE sandbox game where you are a survivor of some mysterious event, that got majority of the population infected. You must survive by finding food, shelter, watching out for wildlife, bandits, and infected people. If you decide to do so, you can help other survivors.

name: Minicraft Shooter
short_description: Minicraft Shooter is an epic time killer shooter with a top view in which you face an endless crowd of zombies, in the scenery of a cyberpunk metropolis, a modern city and a green forest. and all this in a cubic style!

name: My First Music Workshop
short_description: This game is a music workshop simulator game where you need to fix musical instruments.

name: Boat Violence: Ship Happens
short_description: Boat Violence is a 4-player local party game where you use your pirate ship to outplay, outwit and murder your opponents. Load your cannons and get ready to hurt your friends. Best played within punching distance of your friends.

name: Children of a Dead Earth
short_description: The most scientifically accurate space warfare simulator ever made. Now with Steam Workshop!

name: Beat Your Meat
short_description: These ain't no pigs in blankets! Take control of a pig and challenge your friends at Beat your Meat. A fast paced 4 player arena combat game, featuring a variety of game modes! Try Pigskin for an action packed 2v2 sports game, or Fattest Pig and duke it out to become Boss Hog!

name: My Sail And My Sea
short_description: Half sandbox navigation game, including construction, exploration, trade, operation and other elements, combined with instant combat and round game.In addition, the game also has a built-in blueprint editor, which can use cubes to stack everything and share with each other.

name: Melancholy Republic
short_description: A story driven experience about an ambitious, newly elected senator Claire Lockridge. Follow Claire as she struggles to uncover her father's assassin and prevent a war in the heart of her country. A story of courage, love, defiance and self-sacrifice; Claire will forever change the course of history.

name: Steampuff: Phinnegan's Factory
short_description: Phinnegan's Factory is a frantically fun action shooter for the HTC Vive and Oculus Rift. Jump, dodge, duck and shoot your way through endless waves of mechanical monstrosities and multiple levels of madness.

name: Colour Box
short_description: Colour Box is a puzzle game about colouring boxes. Made by Daniel Michaneck with music by Jonathan Krieger Rozenberg.

name: ClickRaid
short_description: A Multi-player incremental clicker game.

name: WhiteBird 白鸟
short_description: WhiteBird is a rather traditional Chinese Martial-Arts RPG game. English version is on preparing. If you would like help translating the game, please contact me ;) Wish you like the story !

name: Crusaders of the Lost Idols
short_description: Crusaders of the Lost Idols is an idle game of heroic awesomeness! Create a band of fighters to fight monsters, earn gold and create strategies for the perfect formations over multiple campaigns! Upgrade your heroes, collect unique gear, and unlock new Crusaders in regular new events.

name: The Long Sky VR
short_description: This game is the VR version of my other game 'Long Sky', which integrates all the optimizations of the latter and is completely re-created for VR control. In the game, players will come to the spacecraft, avoid meteorites and enemies in a 3D parallel battlefield.

name: CASTILLO: Shattered Mirrors
short_description: Castillo Shattered Mirrors is a Gothic FPS and Collectathon. Battle legions of the undead in your quest to defeat Dracula with an arsenal of mythical weaponry. Enter dimensional gates through Dracula's castle and decide which worlds to enter, shards to collect, and bosses to defeat.

name: Spy Tactics

name: Poly Puzzle: Furries 2

name: Animallica

name: Mysteria of the World: The forest of Death

short_description: Edge Of Existence. Is a throw back to the Classics of RTS where you can build up your base and build up your massive army. Ranging from Ground units , Air Units and Sea Units. We also take you on a story base RTS where a faction has a meaning to the map or why its in-game. We are a balance focus on PvP, PvE and Story/Campaign.

The season is long, and the challenges aplenty, as you navigate your way through domestic campaigns and international competitions, within officially licensed leagues.

name: Narrow Escape

name: Monster Monpiece

name: ZYX STORY
short_description: Try to destroy the curse in this epic adventure and survive in this platform/puzzle game. Avoid death by enemies and lasers with your beautiful rifle.

name: Drifting Cloud
short_description: Play online in drifting cloud with up to 3 friends in 3 challenging gamemodes or chill out in a relaxing singleplayer mode where you can try to get a highscore and unlock new rockets with different special abilities and playstyles.

name: Pepper's Puzzles

name: Haprokon

name: Naninights
short_description: Naninights is a point-and-click horror adventure. Someone accidentally left a gate open and a test subject escaped. Explore the dark halls of the lab and find him before he finds you...

name: Tomato Jones - Episode 3
short_description: Tomato Jones - Episode 3 is a physics based ball-rolling platformer. The third sequel of its greatly fun predecessors - 'Tomato Jones' and 'Tomato Jones 2', already available on Steam.

name: Rosy Manga
short_description: Rosy Manga is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.The game is perfect for relaxing.

name: Adventure in Kana Village
short_description: The evil devil has tied the princess! Only by learning the Japanese Kana can you defeat the devil and save the princess.

name: Pop This Pop-It
short_description: Pop this Pop-It is a 2d pop-it, relaxing game where you pop bubbles, get bonuses and accumulate successful roles.

name: Milford Heaven - Luken's Chronicles
short_description: Milford Heaven, a small medieval village, is under attack!! Won't you do nothing? Luken's castle is filled with treasures! Come, help the villagers, loot Luken's castle and became as rich as you have never dreamed before!

name: Zball
short_description: Zball is a physics puzzle game. The goal is always the same - deliver the green ball to the green platform, but the ways change.

name: Ezy
short_description: A small 2D platformer in pixel style. You play as a dinosaur 'Ezy', you need to get to the castle, but it will not be easy.

name: Bedtime Blues
short_description: They say that child’s imagination is pure and innocent, but what if said imagination becomes a nightmare? Enter the pixelate world of a young, troubled mind, and survive the night!

name: Your Chronicle
short_description: 'Let's begin your own story.' This is a text-based idle RPG game. There are already more than 2,500 unique story actions and it's still growing.

name: Ladybird Reflect
short_description: Ladybird Reflect is a Breakout game about a ladybird on a journey to find its lost children and it needs your help to get them back.

name: Six Second Slam
short_description: You have six seconds to race to the next level, before the door slams shut! Ten levels, six seconds each! Can you finish in a minute? How far can you get? Is it even possible? Find out, in Six Second Slam!

name: The Ghost Ship
short_description: Psychological horror game based on an old cursed ghost ship. Navigate the town of Hollow Point, and the accursed ship while trying to keep from going insane. Run, hide, and fight your way through the undead and save the town from a curse that has plagued Hollow Point for centuries.

name: 疯狂厨房VR
short_description: A VR based first person kitchen simulation casual game

name: Mortal Decay
short_description: You are a veteran, in a post World War 3 apocalyptic world. Starving and alone, you fight to keep your sanity in the hell that this world has decayed into. In a desperate attempt to find food, you stumble your way into an abandoned prison, but you find out it is not as abandoned as you believed...

name: Little Noah: Scion of Paradise
short_description: Join the genius alchemist Noah and her cat companion Zipper as they explore ancient ruins to uncover the secrets hidden within! Create unique teams and combos from 40+ recruitable allies in this casual but compelling game!

name: Creature Discomfort
short_description: Adventure game with an inventory and puzzles that are not very hard.

name: Garage Drummer VR
short_description: An immersive drum kit simulation in a virtual garage on a beach.

name: DreadEye VR
short_description: DreadEye is a virtual reality experience that allows you to become an Indonesian shaman. Immerse yourself in terrifying experiences set in haunted rural Indonesia, and discover the gruesome horrors lurking in the shadows!

name: Star Aegis
short_description: Star Aegis is an old school, wave-based arcade shmup without shooting. Choose which side of the ship to protect with your shields and reflect the enemies bullets back at them or just ram them down with your shield.

name: Hard Vacuum
short_description: Hard Vacuum is a single-player space combat game developed from the ground up for virtual reality. Be the pilot of a starfighter with a fully interactive cockpit.

name: Terra Bomber
short_description: Terra Bomber is presented as a two dimensional sideways scroller based upon the classic arcade shooters of the 1980s.

name: Last Hope Z - VR
short_description: Developed exclusively for virtual reality the game 'Last Hope Z' gives you an incredible drive of races and shooters at the same time. Spin the wheel, shoot sharp, discover new guns, change and upgrade cars, and save your four-footed friend!

name: Spaceship Simulator
short_description: Design your own spacecraft with captured components in an unknown galaxy to defeat strange space creatures and finally escape from the galaxy.

name: Looterkings
short_description: Looterkings is a procedural dungeon-crawler you can play online in coop-mode with up to 3 of your friends. Loot as much as you can on your way up from the dark caves beneath earth to the surface, gear up and reach your ultimate goal ravaging the hallowed halls of the Elven Queen, eventually.

name: Ukraine Defense Force Tactics
short_description: Turn-based strategy in which you lead a heroic defense of Ukraine under siege by the despicable Russian Z force. Outmaneuver an endless deluge of enemies using combined infantry-and-armor tactics to survive against all odds.

name: Observatory: A VR Variety Pack
short_description: Observatory is a variety pack for VR headsets. It includes three games and a music video: Procedural downhill racing, spacejet-horror with microscopic submarines, island-puzzling with physics-based creatures, and a trippy official music video for a song by Icky Blossoms.

name: Bombs Away
short_description: Are you mentally prepared for bombs away? Choose one of 8 different styles of tanks to battle your friends from invisibility to flame throwing tanks. You'll need quick reflexes and some carefully planned strategy to be successful in battle. Good luck, and see in you in Bombs Away!

name: Pants Quest
short_description: Pants Quest is a tiny, lovingly crafted point & click adventure game about finding your way in life. And your pants. name: ZeroZone2020

name: Infected Prison
short_description: This is a realistic first person VR game, players in the zombie apocalypse of human survival. Search for supplies and ammunition in a prison full of zombies to rescue other survivors.

name: DoubleTap
short_description: Stylish pistol action for the movie hero/dapper spy/assassin with a dark past that you don't want to talk about/cool person in all of us.

name: Expeditions: Viking
short_description: Circa 790 AD. A small band of Norse warriors lands on the shores of England. History may have forgotten their names, but their actions live on. As the chieftain of your clan, let ambition guide your choices in the party-based RPG Expeditions: Viking. How will history remember you?

name: Blueprint Tycoon
short_description: Build your settlement, gather goods, ensure maximum efficiency and make a profit!

name: Somewhere: Sect of Relic
short_description: Year 1990. Hakan received a squeaky call by his wife. He came around in an her place and tried to find her. Wandering down narrow roads he suddenly understood... It was the place where supernatural had been spilled. And A sect comes to the city.

name: Army Gals
short_description: Can you survive with three women in the middle of nowhere. In this Survival, Romance Visual Novel adventure.

name: Master of Rogues - The Seven Artifacts
short_description: A roguelike adventure in a world of dungeons, filled with dangerous monsters. Your Main quest is to find the Seven Magic Artifacts.

name: Devastated
short_description: Devastated is a post-apocalyptic action adventure game with role-playing game elements. You take control of an experimental supersoldier, and are sent to huge wasteland with only one goal: find the man responsible for the apocalypse and enslavement of the survivors, and take him down.

name: Keyboard Warrior
short_description: Keyboard Warrior is platform game with high tempo battle mechanics using many buttons and the story of a dreamer becoming a keyboard warrior.

name: Abandonment
short_description: Kevin found his wife missing when he returned home from a business trip. He was worried that his wife would be kidnapped by a 'pregnant killer'. Kevin decided to set out to find his wife and uncover the truth behind her kidnapping.

name: Bubble Bobble 4 Friends: The Baron's Workshop
short_description: Use your bubble-blowing abilities to trap your enemies and conquer a variety of stages in this action-puzzle game! Includes the original arcade game, The Baron is Back expansion, and a new exclusive Workshop Mode only on Steam!

name: Five Nights at Freddy's
short_description: Welcome to your new summer job at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, where kids and parents alike come for entertainment and food! The main attraction is Freddy Fazbear, of course; and his two friends. They are animatronic robots, programmed to please the crowds!

name: ReThink
short_description: As an inmate of a government-controlled Correctional Facility in the year 2275, you have the right to prove yourself worthy of being part of Society again. Show your skills in logical thinking by solving puzzles of varying size, type and difficulty in this first-Person puzzle game, and redeem your freedom!

name: Trivia Night
short_description: Play trivia game on your own or with your friends and challange them. Up to 6 player battle!

name: Spooky Ghosts Dot Com
short_description: Ruby the ghost hunter has a tough gig this Halloween. Explore the haunted mansion, take down some ghosts, battle spooky bosses, and rescue the lost cats!

name: Caliper 2
short_description: Caliper 2 is an absolute, turn-based puzzle. By manipulating objects with different properties, you need to put some object on the button and enter the portal.

name: Ghost Buster 3D

short_description: Wayblock is a New Puzzle Game! You can use just the available blocks (Wayblocks) to make a way until the Infinity fire. If you are Ready, click in the player and Go!

name: The Forgotten Void
short_description: A journey of the mind with puzzles and turn based combat.

name: Chasing the wind
short_description: Chasing the wind is a casual level game and parkour game, accompanied by laid-back music, constantly flight forward. Faced with various obstacles, you need to consider the way to pass the game skillfully or flexibly. Of course, smooth levels are the fun of this game.

name: DATH
short_description: Slasher platformer with RPG elements. You have to fight for the creatures of darkness against the kingdom.

name: Panic Diet!!

name: Block Wave VR
short_description: Compete for the high score in this fast paced, addictive virtual reality block puzzler designed for the HTC Vive! Inspired by 1980’s Synthwave with an original score, Block Wave will keep you immersed for hours.

name: Asteroid Five

Dive into the deeps of the asteroid aboard your ship, collecting information and samples of many beautiful minerals and lifeforms while searching for more complex and intelligent beings

name: This Throne Is Mine - The Card Game
short_description: You play as King of Qin, the one ended the 500-year civil war on this land. Act like a King to manage your follower and the royal court and unite the country. Ready to defence your throne?

name: Seeking Revenge

Find your friends if they are still alive and uncover the dark secrets of the forgotten valley before they are gone forever.

name: Soulash
short_description: Eat the villagers, murder bunnies, milk cows, or exterminate gods! Soulash is a traditional, turn-based roguelike where your goal is to consume the souls of the living, conquer the vast fantasy world and decide its fate.

name: Stickman: Fidget Spinner Rush
short_description: Run! Just run and collect fidget spinners! Avoid obstacles and bloody traps.

short_description: A girl named Herb who claims to be a great witch lives in a poisonous swamp on the outskirts of a faraway country. One day, a red jewel is stolen from a shrine under her control. Herb escapes the swamp for the first time in order to recover her jewels.

short_description: TV Kid is an addicting roguelike clicker game with endless possibilities for item combinations! Click through channel after channel and try to defeat television itself!

short_description: Will you manage to make a thriving metropolis or will you have to settle for a small rural town?

short_description: A Quick Death is a 2-Player local multiplayer Western Shootout where timing, reflex, and psychology are the name of the game. name: Broken Thorns: West Gate

Can you think quickly to predict who you need to destroy first? Headshots eliminate faster and earn more points!

name: Containment Initiative: PC Standalone
short_description: Shoot zombies, get money, upgrade your gear. Now featuring local split-screen co-op.

name: Trapped on Monster Island
short_description: Stuck working as a servant on a passenger ship, Eris finds herself yearning for a new life. When a surprise storm strikes the ship, she finds herself marooned on a mysterious island. What brought her there, and for what purpose?

name: UFO穿越 （UFO Cross）
short_description: Aliens cross the stars and attack the earth!Hunting humans... Are you willing to shoulder the burden of saving the world?Rise up and fight!

name: Forklift & Box
short_description: Check out this game, its a puzzle game to test your speed and ability to go through mazes quickly. you take your forklift and you race it around pushing blue and red blocks, placing your red blocks into the striped zones to move to the next levels and beat the time.

name: Protect The Treasure
short_description: In a distant future, humanity left Earth and many creatures were left behind. You have to survive in this dangerous world and protect the last treasure left by humans.

name: Cyber Pool
short_description: The neon-emblazoned tables of Cyber Pool are calling. Will you take on the challenge?

name: Trash Sailors
short_description: Trash Sailors is a hand-drawn co-op sailing adventure for one to four players. Create the trashiest team in history, in online or local co-op and find your way in the aftermath of a great trash tsunami.

name: Space Cruise
short_description: Space Cruise is a hybrid of both metroidvania style platforming and traditional bullet-hell gameplay, allowing the player to choose which play style resonates with them most for each run. With power-ups for both methods of gameplay, randomised levels on the branching paths, and leaving the final decision to the player, each run should...

name: Room 208
short_description: Victor Rockford, a spiritual medium has been asked to use his otherworldly abilities to stop the EVIL that resides inside Room 208 of 'The Great Leaf Hotel'. Does he have what it takes to put a stop EVIL? Or will the EVIL claim yet another victim?

name: 3dSen VR
short_description: 3dSenVR breathes new life into your favorite NES games by magically converting it into 3D and letting you play in VR

name: Vacant Planet
short_description: You awaken on an unknown planet that has been devastated by a virus of some kind. Scavenge gear and get ready for a battle of survival. Do anything you can to live and find out the secret behind the tragedy of your new home. and find out what's wrong with it.

name: Face It - A game to fight inner demons
short_description: Carefuly crafted puzzles in a challenging 3D plaformer take the player on a surrealistic journey through a maze of feelings. In Face It, abstract concepts are shaped into gameplay: darker emotions are monsters and traps, while brighter concepts are the powers you need to beat the levels.

name: Rookie Math Pro
short_description: Rookie Math Pro is the new social learning platform that engages six to eleven year-olds to practice and learn mathematics in a fun, interactive and safe environment. Discover secrets, unlock characters, collect coins, earn trophies and level up!

name: Gold Crusader Remastered Edition
short_description: Your gold is lost! All you have ever fought for! It's time for a last crusade and get back what's yours! Craft your own sword and fight in procedurally generated dungeons for your gold!

name: Strange Lands
short_description: Strange Lands is a fun, light, old-school platformer with a few modern twists. With a style and simplicity reminiscent of the classics, Strange Lands delivers an escape to worlds beyond our own. Join Sarah as she fights her way past untold dangers and numerous challenges.

name: Chunky Orbits
short_description: Get up-close and personal with Gravity. Chunky Orbits is a simulation of free-floating objects in space based on real life physics. Each object in the scene attracts each of the others in a cosmic tug-of-war that we call Gravity. Toss out a few boulders and contemplate the wonders of the Universe.

name: InsanZ - Retro Survival Horror
short_description: InsanZ is a retro-survival-horror-game of the latest generation. Discover the crazy world of InsanZ, face the nasty creatures from hell and survive to bring back balance to the world. Fight with over 13 different weapons against hordes of monsters, explore the dire world of InsanZ, discover old paths and hidden secrets, use the terrain...

name: iaidoka_interlude
short_description: A pseudo 8-bit action platformer taking a bit of inspiration from film-noir and samurai dramas, iaidoka_interlude applies a few parkour and fighting game influences to mix up familiarity with a little uniquity.

name: The Hero Unmasked!
short_description: Impersonate your identical twin as the Swashbuckler, masked champion of justice! You have two weeks to rescue the REAL Swashbuckler and marry the mayor before superpowered criminals take over the city.

name: Asterix & Obelix: Slap them All!
short_description: Asterix & Obelix, return in a new adventure full of slaps! Play as Asterix and Obelix and cross the most iconic landscapes of the saga while facing a host of enemies, in a Beat Them Up filled with action ... and slaps!

name: SUPER BOT
short_description: Take part in the adventures of 'SUPER BOT', an action adventure game from a third person perspective. The main character is a cute robot, which, due to the domination of the industrial planet by nasty bugs, sets out to fight to regain energy and save his friends.

name: Brine
short_description: Stranded at an Island, the Vessel is broked, do whatever it takes to survive.

name: Hentai Mosaique Neko Waifus
short_description: Hentai puzzler, micro visual novel, with a sprinkle of RPG. All the neko girls in town heard all about you, now they can finally meet you!

name: Dark Bestiary
short_description: Dark Bestiary is a turn-based tactic game with RPG elements. The very core of the game consists of continuous and exciting battles with monsters rather than a deep story. So, you will have to explore a rich combat system and discover your character’s possibilities.

name: The Hike
short_description: The Hike is a first person horror/survival game in which you must survive the horrors that start while investigating a mysterious emergency message in a simple hike through the Red River National Park. Your chance of making it back to society relies entirely on your legs, you're no fighter.

name: Lihue
short_description: Lihue is a narrative adventure that takes place in the dream of a 26-year-old trans girl. Through her memories you will know her deepest desires and fears. Explore the landscapes of her mind to discover the reasons that led her to undertake this journey into the dream world.

name: DayDream Mosaics
short_description: Solve over 100 logic based nonograms to earn crystals and rebuild 3 tranquil sanctuaries. Unlock gorgeous wallpapers along the way. Level progress is saved at all times.

name: Cruel Galaxy: Discordia
short_description: Cruel Galaxy: Discordia is a turn-based role-playing game, including tactical space combat, strategic elements and original story, filled by despair.

name: 探灵警探
short_description: 《探灵警探》是一款像素风悬疑、解密游戏，故事以主人公从医院苏醒，通过一步步调查揭开事情的原委。游戏解密过程不算复杂，但需要多加注意游戏中的文档。

name: 三和大神
short_description: 三和大神模拟器，体验三和大神的挂逼生活，日结，上网，黑厂，开宝箱，大水，挂逼烟，挂逼机，瘫痪，海信大酒店，修车。

name: The Donnerwald Experiment
short_description: A mature dreampunk RPG with German folklore, demons galore, interactive combat mechanics and more!

name: The Incredible VR Game Show
short_description: No auditions required. Put on your VR headset and be a contestant on the greatest game show of all time, The Incredible VR Game Show!

name: Tony Stewart's Sprint Car Racing
short_description: Jump into a 900 horsepower Sprint Car for some Saturday night dirt racing action! Feel the rush as you slide through the turns to take the checkered flag!

name: PEE WAR！
short_description: Play pee Superman and destroy the city and the forest! Destroy everything in your sight and avoid the human army attack!

name: Street Hoop
short_description: The legendary 3 on 3 arcade basketball game returns.

name: Magic Tavern
short_description: Use your magic spell to destroy the mugs and goblets that materialize in front of you. Hit the hourglasses for some extra time!

name: SnowFighters
short_description: Make snowball and Throw to the rivals!! Snowball fight e-sports action game !!

name: World of Subways 2 – Berlin Line 7
short_description: Volume 2: 'U7 - Berlin' is the next release continuing the successful product series ' World of Subways' introducing famous subway lines around the world to all subway enthusiasts. After Vol. 1, Vol. 2 contains the route U7 of Berlin`s subway.

name: Shadows 2: Perfidia
short_description: Shadows 2: Perfidia is a survival horror game inspired by classics like the Penumbra series and Layers of Fear. Explore a darkened office complex and uncover the truth behind the horrifying events that have befallen its inhabitants.

name: SkydiVeR
short_description: 'All you need is 20 seconds of insane courage and I promise you something great will come of it' - B. Mee SkydiVeR is the first parachuting simulator specifically made for VR. Launch yourself into the sky like never before!

name: Abalyte
short_description: Abalyte is a 2D-roguelike metroidvania that focuses on the player's skill and inventiveness. While other games have crutches or progression systems that help the player beat the game, Abalyte does the opposite and throws you in a spike-pit.

name: Au fil de l'eau
short_description: Au fil de l'eau is a short meditation game about kayaking and immersion in a beautiful landscape. Leave your apartment and go on an adventure.

name: 1979 Revolution: Black Friday
short_description: 1979 Revolution: Black Friday is a choice driven, narrative game that brings players into the brooding world of a nation on the verge of collapse. Play as Reza, an aspiring photojournalist, and make life and death decisions as you survive the gritty streets of Iran in the late 1970’s.

name: FukTopia
short_description: FukTopia is a post apocalyptic beat em up game.

name: Disney•Pixar Cars Toon: Mater's Tall Tales
short_description: Cars Toon: Mater's Tall Tales is inspired by Disney/Pixar's wildly popular animated shorts of the same name. Cars Toon: Mater's Tall Tales is part of the Mania! video game franchise, featuring fast-paced, multiplayer, family fun.

name: Ketchup and Mayonnaise
short_description: Frenetic, chaotic battles! A dynamic duo, who are the best of friends, come out swinging in this pretty absurd RPG!

name: Draft Day Sports: College Basketball 2017
short_description: Draft Day Sports: College Basketball 2017 puts you in the role of head coach of your favorite college basketball team. Every decision can be made by you from staff hiring, recruiting, scouting and all the way to making each substitution to lead your team to tournament glory and becoming a dynasty.

name: Go Rocket
short_description: An arcade game about a rocket flying in endless space.

name: 新世勇者传
short_description: Neolithic brave man is a JRPG game made by RPGmakerMV.

name: The Flying Turtle Jewel Quest
short_description: The Flying Turtle Jewel Quest - The new match 3 game is here, with brilliant jewels in over 600 dazzling puzzles! A magical journey filled with waves of excitement and brilliant visuals! Swap jewels to clear the way, and match pieces to crush each challenge that lies ahead.

name: Heroes of Scene
short_description: Heroes of scene is a multiplayer strategy game with an indirect control. You are in charge of the Kingdom of live toys. Build your own castle and summon toy warriors and spells to win!

name: Baseball Mogul 2017
short_description: The groundbreaking franchise that revolutionized sports games continues to redefine the way you run and manage your favorite baseball team. This year's version includes more than 100 updates and new features.

name: Crowns and Pawns: Kingdom of Deceit
short_description: Legends of the past come back to life in this charming point-and-click adventure. Pack your bags and journey with Crowns and Pawns: Kingdom of Deceit through modern day Europe to uncover the secrets of the king who was never crowned.

name: INIT.
short_description: INIT. will test your ability to see through illusion and discover innovative and cerebral challenges that can be solved as simply as changing the way you perceive them.

name: Mortadelo y Filemón: Operación Moscú
short_description: Mortadelo and Filemón must go to Moscow, in Russia, to take control of an old and valuable object: the Sacred Book of the god Ra-Amun, which is looked for by the Sixth Sect to summon the god Apis and to dominate the world.

name: Coffee Shop Tycoon
short_description: Manage your own coffee shop and control every detail to make it the most popular one in town! Roast your own beans and create your recipes. Hire and train your staff, manage your economy and marketing, and destroy your competition to become the ultimate legal coffee monopoly in Coffee Shop Tycoon.

name: Project Reset
short_description: Play as a boy who got back from a 1 month vacation and has returned to school, only to find that he meets 3 new friends, and gets into a new hobby! Meet all 3 of these characters in Project Reset, a free visual novel!

name: Howloween Hero
short_description: A spooky trick-or-treat adventure about a mischievous puppy on a mission to score the evening's best candy. Create your costume, explore the neighborhood, and help your friends track down a menacing monster to save Halloween.

name: Ego Hearts
short_description: Ego Hearts is a small interactive reflection about death and what do we leave behind it. Take a paper plane and share your warmth to get the February away.

name: Outliver: Redemption
short_description: Derek Okoye’s accident on the day of a big trial becomes a window for redeeming his lost values…

name: PingBall VR
short_description: PingBall is an easy to grasp, physically accurate and intuitive crossover between racquetball and breakout.

name: Old Gods Rising
short_description: As the consultant for a maverick director's new film: 'Old Gods Rising,' Professor Tom Winston arrives at Ashgate University to find that things are not quite as they seem. Has he become the unwitting star of Kayfer’s latest project?  Or, has he stumbled into something far more sinister?

name: The Trials of Olympus II: Wrath of the Gods
short_description: Play the epic match3 saga, that tells the tale of Angelo and help the outcast god from Olympus continue his quest and save his true love, princess Amara...

name: Mini Madness
short_description: Mini Madness is an arcade racing game inspired by such titles as Re-Volt or Micro Machines. Players are racing on crazy, expanded vertically tracks placed in a single-family house and in its large garden, by taking control over miniature remote cars.

name: SPITLINGS
short_description: Frantic Gameplay, Juicy Visuals, Hypnotic Beats: SPITLINGS is a cute but unforgiving Hardcore Arcade Game for 1 - 4 players in which you waggle through a gauntlet of bouncy bubbles.

name: Billy 101
short_description: Meet Billy, a robot who is tired of his work on the production lines, who then decided to blow up everything and everyone in order to make his own choices.

name: Overload Playable Teaser 3.0
short_description: A playable demo of the game Overload, a new six-degree-of-freedom shooter from the creators of Descent. Version 3.0 is from April 2018.

name: Five Nations
short_description: Five Nations is a real-time sci-fi strategy game for PC platform. Encompassing tactical combat in space in real-time mixed with micromanagement of economy, construction, and production featuring different kind of single player modes.

name: Monsters and Warriors - Onet Match Connect
short_description: Monsters and Warriors - Onet Match Connect is a super fun matching game with cool challenges and brain teasers! Enjoy hours of fun connecting images of Monsters and Warriors. Test your skills by matching and linking the same kind of images and work your way up to victory!

name: A Front Too Far: Normandy
short_description: A World War 2 Game in a Open World RPG Style!

name: Dragon Iris
short_description: A Rich story about Humans and Dragons living in a place called Trae. A new tale about the origin of the Dragons, their society and relationship with Humans. Play with both Humans and Dragons in a tactical battle system.

name: Box Maze Extreme
short_description: Think you got what it takes? Challenge Yourself with 30 Extreme levels! More enemies and obstructions, checkpoints instead of saves. Box Maze Extreme is not for the faint-hearted. Includes FREE skins!

name: TSUKUMOHIME
short_description: 《TSUKUMOHIME》是一款幻想的古代東洋風遊戲，玩家扮演的「創物者」，在一個神秘的世界中，帶領化身美少女的「物靈」們展開一場不可思議的冒險旅程。

name: WeakWood Throne
short_description: WeakWood Throne is a 2D Action RPG with the open world. In the story you will find out what happened in the WickWood Kingdom; why its inhabitants get poorer every day, and soldiers-beasts wander on their fields; what's wrong with the new king, and how to dethrone him.

name: Spice&Wolf VR2
short_description: The team behind the original series has gotten together to bring you into the world of Spice and Wolf again for a second installment of VR animation! Animation has evolved from 'watching' to 'experiencing.'

name: CompliKATed
short_description: Retro, 90’s style rock’n diamonds with logic gates/binary puzzles. Fail to succeed. Dodge gravity balls. Collect items to unlock the exit. Use logic gates to solve puzzles.

name: NORSK: Epistle
short_description: NORSK: Epistle is an experimental singleplayer game. Set in the atmospheric abandoned Siberian town the game will introduce how to solve puzzles using second dimension in 3d world to understand what happened with humanity.

name: I'm an adventurer
short_description: Want to be an adventurer, but the reality is not so simple. If you can't become an adventurer, why not to be the boss of the adventurers! Set up an Adventurer's guild! chatting, hiring, solving quest, making adventurers stronger.

name: SARE  Inception
short_description: SARE Inception set in a visually stunning fantasy universe full of meaningful choices and impactful consequences. Dangerous underground, Creatures, Hidden Passages, Magnificent Villages, and Action are waiting for you in this game. Help sare find her brother in fantastic scenes. This game consists of 6 sections where 3 are combined.

name: AeternoBlade
short_description: AeternoBlade is a Time-Manipulation Hack-and-Slash Action-Puzzle Game. Join Freyja to take revenge on Beladim, the Lord of the Mist who destroyed her hometown and unravel the mysteries of AeternoBlade.

name: Puppy Chef Academy
short_description: Puppy Chef Academy is a Virtual Reality cooking experience designed to help you learn how to cook without the stress and mess of a real kitchen. Throughout your adventure you’ll cook tasty recipes, learn about cooking, and even make some friends along the way!

name: Starman
short_description: 'Starman: Tale of Light' is a slow paced puzzle adventure, with beautifully crafted sceneries and soothing music.

name: A Year Of Rain
short_description: A desolate realm, kept in flux by the rhythm of battle. A proving ground for those with great ambition. A Year Of Rain is the ultimate team real-time strategy game. Choose your faction, team up and take control of a legendary hero to lead your armies!

name: One Gun 2: Stickman
short_description: Back in Stickland, lived-was Stickman. And he had a cat, whom he loved very much. They all did together, even bitcoins mined. But one day ... the cat was gone. And then stickman realized that the time had come and got a shotgun.

name: The Language Game
short_description: The Language Game is a 2 player quiz-style game that will improve your vocabulary and pronunciation as you play. Our innovative system lets you learn from any language to any other language, so each player can learn a different language.

name: Arcade Moonlander
short_description: Explore space and race against the clock in this retro styled adventure game.

name: Is Simon There?
short_description: A few months have passed since the death of my son, Simon. Ever since that tragic day, I find myself falling into the darkest emotions I could ever imagine. I am haunted everyday with what I have done; But sometimes, I am haunted by more than just my emotions...

name: YUMENIKKI -DREAM DIARY-
short_description: As long as I have dreams in my heart, I can never escape. I can never awaken from my dreams. Maybe if I follow the dream just past this doorway, then someday I can wake up again...

name: Mad Zombie
short_description: This game is a top-down tps game where players must shoot zombies everywhere in this city. This game is designed to allow players to relax and destroy the most zombies. how to play: Press the W A D S button for moving. Press left mouse to shoot. And use the mouse cursor to set direction.

name: Nordic Warriors
short_description: Enter the real time tactical nightmare of Nordic Warriors and use your handful of brave souls to stem an endless horde of undead horrors. You'll need to take advantage of the terrain and your Hero abilities to heal and lead your units as you blast, smash or slash your way through the unfolding apocalypse.

name: Oona the Druid's Path
short_description: Join the young druid Oona in an adventure to complete her first task to become a full druid. Travel through thick forests and swamps, face the creatures inhabiting them, reach the Cloud Kingdom and fight against the evil Meiga in this beautiful 2.5D platformer game.

name: Don'Yoku
short_description: If you love shoot ‘em up and you love ‘em hard, with glorious music, with screen filling bullet patterns and huge token cancels, then Don’yoku is just for you!

name: Axiom Alternative
short_description: A short kinetic visual novel, independently written by Redewaan Duckett, giving an alternative take on the Welcome To... Chichester series

name: Antonball Deluxe
short_description: The breakout title from Summitsphere, Antonball Deluxe is a retro, high-octane smorgasbord of ballbusting arcade action! Antonball Deluxe quite literally turns the breakout genre on its head, blending traditional brick-breaking gameplay with tight, intense platforming.

name: Space Station 51
short_description: You are a member of Space Station 51. When you wake up, you find that a zombie virus has broken out on the space station. You need to follow the command of the station master and take a series of actions.

name: Cross Set
short_description: Cross Set is a simple and brain-teasing new number puzzle game.

name: Phobos
short_description: Discover an expansive online multiplayer world of battle, stories, and intrigue. Wield great weapons or conjure terrifying magics. Explore the world, solve quests, and slay great beasts and players alike.

name: Katy and Bob: Safari Cafe
short_description: Katy and Bob: a new chapter in the adventures of Katy and Bob. Head into the safari park and grow your business!

name: 异星夺宝
short_description: This is a game that uses shooting to solve puzzles! You're a graduate student in interstellar Archaeology, and for your summer internship this year, you're flying solo to exotic alien ruins in search of hidden treasures!

name: Front Page Sports Football
short_description: Step into the Manager's Shoes with Front Page Sports Football! Recruit, train, and coach your players to victory. Delve into the opposition's strategy with replays and stats, create a customized gameplan from thousands of plays, and push your players' skills to new limits.

name: Now Boarding
short_description: Now Boarding is an action-tycoon game focused on running an airport. Create calm from chaos in a busy airport. Get your passengers to the correct destination before they freak out!!

name: Age of Enigma: The Secret of the Sixth Ghost
short_description: Paranormal activity and freakish events stalk the land. The dead haunt the living and take possession of their homes….

name: Hypership Out of Control
short_description: Space is a dangerous placed for even the most seasoned starship pilot, full of asteroids, multicolored floating blocks, and space mines. It's even more dangerous when you your accelerator is stuck to the floor and your brakes are out.

name: Switch Galaxy Ultra
short_description: Switch Galaxy Ultra is an insanely addictive, fast-paced arcade challenge. Weave your way past obstacles and enemies as you travel across the galaxy collecting Tantalum for Dakur Technology. It’s loaded with content and features that will have you blazing across the galaxy at breakneck speeds.

name: Galactic Dominion
short_description: Galactic Dominion is a fast paced 4x space strategy game. Explore the stars, perform research, manage your colonies, build a fleet, defend your systems, and conquer the galaxy. Play through an epic story driven campaign or alternatively customize your games for countless re-playability!

name: Verdungo
short_description: King Verdungo has been taken hostage and it's up to you to rescue him. Travel across a diverse world to make your way back home, hopefully you arrive in time to save him before he meets an untimely demise.

name: Sink
short_description: Do you regret a choice in your life This is a game about faith, life and soul...

name: Survivor Dieland
short_description: You're gonna get yourself killed being out here all by your lonesome... There's monsters on this island! Besides, It's not always the beasts you should be afraid of... Beasts are easy to predict. They just want to kill and eat you. Humans are much harder... They'll pretend to be your friend first...

name: 100 hidden birds
short_description: Hidden object game in the cartoon city style. Ultra hard! Really very difficult!

name: Sharp
short_description: Boot up and navigate a fractured digital world to uncover valuable data hidden amongst dangerous traps and viruses.

name: Log Challenge
short_description: Log Challenge is an arcade game where you will have lots of fun in a 'quest for diamonds' action trying to collect as many diamonds as fast as you can moving through a dangerous plank while avoiding heavy swinging logs.

name: RoboSnakes: Core Wars Legacy
short_description: An alien voice resonates within your head: IF.PROGRAM.ROBOSNAKE.SMART. KILL.ENEMY.AI.THEN.WIN.AGAINST.FRIENDS. SAVE.HUMANITY.

name: Holdfast: Nations At War
short_description: Fight on multiple fronts in Holdfast: Nations At War - A multiplayer first and third-person shooter set during the great Napoleonic Era and WW1. Charge into battle with over 150 players per server!

name: Old Salt
short_description: A Naval Strategy With No Reinforcements On The Way. Command a Custom Fleet with faction abilities in Multiplayer matches or Faction Campaigns.

name: A Mortician's Tale
short_description: A Mortician's Tale is a short, story-driven game about a mortician tasked with running a funeral home.

name: The Guild 3
short_description: The Guild 3 is a fascinating trade and life simulation that takes place during the late Middle Ages. Step into the shoes of a citizen, acquire businesses and mansions, produce goods and trade them, start intrigues in politics and society, love, hate, bribe, fight and live through good and bad times!

name: Project Demigod
short_description: Become The Hero! Combine multiple fantastic superpowers and weapons in unique combinations to take on physics-based Ninjas, Robots, Gangs, Mutants, Aliens, and more in Project Demigod!

name: Soulless: Ray Of Hope
short_description: Soulless is a 2D side-scrolling puzzle platformer. Set out on your adventure to save your childhood friend by traveling through a colorful world using mechanics and items to complete both relaxing and rushed puzzles. How far would you go to save a friend?

name: Cahors Sunset
short_description: Cahors Sunset is a light-RPG in which you control the decisions of an old French man. Your goal is try to keep the main character alive for as long as you can through the decisions you make each month. Every action have wanted and unwanted effects on your character's health.

name: Vanildo's Journey
short_description: Vanildo, a skilled retired adventurer is forced to return to work because of the peculiar events that are taking place in the city of Pirarotoba, including the disappearance of his old friend.

name: Sandbox Anything
short_description: A creative building-like game, where the objective is to throw physics enabled objects to create structures to allow the objective of the level to be completed. Can be a very challenging puzzler or an easy, sit back and relax game. Includes built in Level Editor and extensive Multiplayer functionality.

name: Project AETHER: First Contact
short_description: As a threat from beyond looms over the solar system, take control of the AETHER prototype in this rhythmic and tactical space shooter - fusing classic arcade-style action with stunning 3D environments and an engaging sci-fi story.

name: One Man Is Not No Man
short_description: Do you want to fight with a sword? Do you want to feel like a hero? 'One Man Is Not No Man' project will quench that desire! You will defend the castle from the army of enemies on your own!

name: Zettavolt Trigger
short_description: The security robots of Zettavolt Inc. have been hacked and are bent on tearing down the company from the inside out. Safe from hacking due to his A.I., it's up to Trigger to stop the rampaging robots before they ruin the fiscal year.

name: Strikey Sisters
short_description: Say hello to a fantasy themed action arcade brick breaker! Featuring cute characters, silly humor, powerful magic, crazy bosses, and even local 2 player co-op mode!

name: Among the Innocent: A Stricken Tale
short_description: Among the Innocent is a first-person adventure thriller that takes place on an abandoned farm in the eastern Free State, South Africa. The gameplay is inspired by classic point-and-click adventure games, and is packed with intrigue, puzzle-solving, and exploration.

name: X Mushrooms
short_description: Girls X Mushroom is an indie game developed by Wild Grunt and is a third-person perspective action game. The game emphasizes intense fighting.

name: Retro/Grade
short_description: Play a classic Shoot 'Em Up... in reverse!

name: Deadlight: Director's Cut
short_description: A zombie outbreak eradicated all hope of returning life back to normal, now only survival lives on. Run, hide and fight your way through the undead as Randall searches for his family in this gorgeous, gritty, destroyed world.

name: 能量冲击 Energy Shock
short_description: Energy Shock is a turn-based action game with roguelike elements. In-game attack and movement are combined. Whenever you want to attack, you have to move forward. Attack also means you will enter the enemy‘s range.

name: Cellings
short_description: Cellings is a creative sandbox game taking place in an abstract procedural world full of various species. Experience the full evolution of cells across 3 generations, compete with other species, and explore breathtaking worlds.

name: Who Stole My Beard?
short_description: Your beard has been stolen! You and your loyal dog Leo must investigate the people and places of Beardsville to solve the crime. Uncover conspiracies, find new beards, and remember to pick up the groceries in this charming town of bearded intrigue.

name: The Great Fusion
short_description: Finally comes to Steam the funniest graphic adventure game from Android and iOS. Featured by Google twice, with more than 100,000 downloads and thousands of positive reviews, The Great Fusion is back remastered with full HD graphics and redesigned comics.

name: Royal Agents: Sweet Zombie
short_description: Royal Agents: Sweet Zombie is a turn-based squad game with unlikely agents trying to stop evil in time for tea. You control a team of three agents of the crown with different skills and backgrounds, tasked with the assignment to investigate and stop any evil-doings in a graveyard.

name: In the House of Silence

The power over the shards is bitterly contested by Masters, the immortal beings mortals believe to be gods.

name: Gas Guzzlers: Combat Carnage

name: Void -Dementia-

name: RC Plane VR

name: Shadow of the Tomb Raider: Definitive Edition
