Try ShapeSim, currently the most easy to use scene builder and world constructor. Simply grab an object/prop and place it to where you like it, and whichever direction you want it to face.

name: Tribes of Midgard

name: Sea Dogs: City of Abandoned Ships
short_description: Fortune and glory awaits you! In Sea Dogs - City of Abandoned Ships you can choose to go it alone and become the most feared pirate of the seven seas. Or you can prove your loyalty to one of four different navies; French, English, Spanish, or Dutch.

name: Starlight Shores

name: Furry Hentai Quest
short_description: The world of Klytoria is in danger! Will you be able to make it far away enough from the castle? Using your choice of Hentai, Furry, or human characters you must eschew obstacles and carefully navigate the lands... Can you save Klytoria?

name: Lost Lands: Redemption
short_description: “Lost Lands: Redemption” is an adventure game in the genre of Hidden Objects, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters and complicated quests.

name: GearStorm - Armored Survival
short_description: GearStorm - Armored Survival is a story-driven, open-world sci-fi survival adventure. Discover what led to the Phage, a deadly virus apocalypse and our escape to a alien world. Explore a vast alien planet, build your base, create your colony, acquire vehicles, weapons, and supplies to defend it.

name: Star Girl Proxima
short_description: Become a magical girl hero and defend the alien world of Proxima Centauri b in Star Girl Proxima! An 8-bit style action-platformer.

name: Casual Golf

name: Celestrion

name: 1001 Jigsaw. World Tour: France

name: Ninja Girl and the Mysterious Army of Urban Legend Monsters! ~Hunt of the Headless Horseman~
short_description: In a world where monsters thrive and wraiths run wild, and ghouls and ghosts roam the streets, there exist those who hunt the creatures that do humans harm.

name: Ballistic M.A.D.ness

name: Comet Golf
short_description: Embark on a journey as a small comet through a colorful galaxy and use black holes as a wormhole to explore over 20 different levels! Use the planet's gravities and galactic currents to hit the comet past various celestial bodies into the black hole and get warped to a new area.

Shock Force 2 brings you to a hypothetical conflict in Syria between the forces of NATO and the Syrian Army. Play either on WeGo or Real Time in an incredibly detailed and realistic 1:1 tactical simulation.

short_description: Might makes right in the wild wood! The award-winning board game of asymmetrical woodland warfare comes to cross-platform digital play! Combine subtle strategy and bold daring to guide your forest faction to victory!

name: 水果祖玛 | Fruit Zumba
short_description: Classic Zuma, reset back! One of the most classic and joyful games, we have launched a new content: a new game map, gorgeous animation effects, well-designed levels.

name: Mighty Dungeons

name: RapStar Tycoon
short_description: Become a rap star in RapStar Tycoon. Walk the path from an unknown artist to a world-class star. Create songs participate in rap battles, shoot a music video. Live your music!

name: Mostly Intense Monster Defense

name: Cooking Trip
short_description: Cooking Trip – walk the path to perfection. Fulfill your dream and become a great chef!

name: Football Blitz

name: Battery-out
short_description: Battery-out is an action platformer with power routing.

name: The Music Machine
short_description: A teenaged girl and the vindictive ghost that's possessing her deal with cosmic mysteries and interpersonal struggles in this character-driven narrative-focused horror adventure.

name: Sable Maze: Twelve Fears Collector's Edition
short_description: Your daughter's lost in the Maze of Fears, but you'll face more than her disappearance if you dare to enter.

name: Love Story: The Way Home
short_description: After being passed from one orphanage to another, all Katherine wants is a family to call her own.

name: Stardew Valley
short_description: You've inherited your grandfather's old farm plot in Stardew Valley. Armed with hand-me-down tools and a few coins, you set out to begin your new life. Can you learn to live off the land and turn these overgrown fields into a thriving home?

Remember, collaborating and fighting is just a means to survive, not an answer to the secrets in this world. Your mission is to figure out the truth of this world.

short_description: You play as Tetra, a teenage boy living his days out as an college student. Tetra meets Autumn; a girl he first met on a social networking site and has grown fond of. Tetra is invited over to Autumn's house for the first time for a date night. However, the two find out that they are out of Autumn's favorite chips.

name: To the Edge of the Sky
short_description: This stunning post-cyberpunk indie visual novel is waiting for you to dive in. Explore the secrets of Olympia, the most technologically advanced country on Earth, as one of its top secret operatives. Can you complete your mission without regrets?

name: Record of Agarest War Mariage
short_description: The story explores reincarnation through several generations, as the Archdemon continues to spawn even after the current Hero vanquishes them. In this SRPG, fight as the Hero (or Chosen One), who is trusted to produce an heir who can put an end to the Archdemon once and for all!

short_description: It was supposed to be a simple suicide case – a quick inspection and lots of boring paperwork. But the more you delve into this secluded island and the twisted family relations of the owners, the more complicated and unclear this case becomes.

name: Ricerca VR
short_description: RICERCA, which in Italian means “search,” is an animated installation experience. In it, we follow the life of a man on a search who travels through different memories and worlds to find something he has lost.

name: Cat and fish
short_description: You are a brave cat who got lost in the forest in search of food. You have to collect all the food, while getting out of the forest alive. Be careful, because the forest is full of various traps and obstacles!

name: Aura Kingdom 2
short_description: Great remake of a classic MMORPG! Enjoy the satisfying MMO gameplay and stunning graphics on your PC! Embark on new adventure to the world Ramayan and screenshot every step of your journey. Summon Eidolons, establish tactics for party battles, and most of all... create YOUR legend as a Hero.

short_description: «Mumps» — This is a game about a pig called a Mumps, which should collect all the acorns for itself for the winter. Feel like a pig and survive collecting acorns. Help the pig to pass all levels.

Find yourself in the center of political events, international scandals and simply relax in the aquadiskotheque on the territory of the 'hotel', completely recreated according to the drawings.

name: Human Factory
short_description: Build a factory to store, process and sell Humans. Sell their meat, skin and souls. Become the greatest cosmic space deity in the multiverse.

name: Red Comrades Save the Galaxy: Reloaded
short_description: Vasily Ivanovich Chapaev and his fellow aide Petka realize that someone has stolen the Red banner from the HQ. Although it's not the end of the story yet! Somewhere on the moon, legions of alien invaders prepare to conquer Earth. But could such a little thing really give a scare to the Red Army heroes?

name: School Bus Driver Simulator
short_description: The School Bus Driver Simulator game offers you the chance to contribute to our future, namely, to transport the children to school.

name: RollerCoaster Tycoon® 3: Complete Edition
short_description: Build the park of a lifetime and rediscover the critically acclaimed rollercoaster simulation bestseller. Feel the thrill of a genre-defining classic, complete with two huge expansion packs.

name: Rolling Adventure
short_description: Drive with precision, jump and speed up your way on this exiting conveyor-belt platformer. Explore with care and close attention, the handcrafted puzzles filled with the hardest challenges.

name: Super Cable Boy
short_description: Super Cable Boy is a retro inspired platformer, where you are playing a living handheld gaming system with a power cord. Collect game cartridges to become more powerful and take on your quest to defeat 'the Glitch', an entity that 1▧01☠01௹1‱☣∰0␢⌀▧ ..

name: Zen Chess: Blindfold Masters
short_description: In Zen Chess: Blindfold Masters you will put your memory and chess skills to the test by solving puzzles without seeing the pieces.

name: Viticulture Essential Edition
short_description: This is the official digital adaption of the boardgame Viticulture by Jamey Stegmaier & Alan Stone.

name: Island Dash
short_description: You are controlling the Tourist through the whole Island. Your goal is to collect as much money as quickly as possible, so the Tourist can buy himself a Hotdog. If you are to slow and he runs out of calories, he will die. :( Do you think you can make it?

name: Puzzle Box
short_description: A cute little indiegame where the goal is to go through all the levels and reach the cake, but be quick! The crow might get the before you, and maybe you have to shapeshift into something different to be quicker.

name: Melting Hearts: Our Love Will Grow 2
short_description: The harsh winter conditions make farming almost impossible. Ancient farming secrets must now be unlocked as you are forced to learn to grow crops in winter and make friends and enemies in an equally icy social climate.

name: Fantasy Strike
short_description: A fighting game designed from the ground up to be so easy to control that even non-fighting game players can play it, yet deep enough to play in tournaments. Vibrant graphics and excellent online play.

name: CityPunk
short_description: By speeding on the city to get money to buy luxury cars, set records on different roads.

name: Internet Cafe Simulator 2
short_description: Internet Cafe Simulator 2 is an extremely comprehensive and detailed internet cafe business simulation game.

name: Advanced Tactics Gold
short_description: Advanced Tactics: Gold offers a unique and infinitely replayable wargaming experience for any strategy fan. Building off of the enormous success of Advanced Tactics: World War II, the Gold edition gives players a more powerful game editor, much improved random game engine, many new features and abilities, and more.

name: Trawl
short_description: Trawl is a first person experiential game of discovery and creativity. First you must figure out how to operate the various parts of the boat, manipulating the wheel, throttle and the net. Then, trawl the sea to recover discover what secrets are hidden in its depths and record your findings on your typewriter.

name: The Body Changer
short_description: A single player metroidvania 3D game with cooperative gameplay. Find out what's going on by taking control of distinct characters and change between them whenever you want. An unique mix of 3rd person shooter and challenging puzzles!

name: Action SuperCross
short_description: The grandfather of all physics-based motorbike simulation games. This retro gem is the predecessor of Elasto Mania, a truly unique and challenging experience. Try this piece of gaming history yourself!

name: Killing Floor: Incursion
short_description: Killing Floor: Incursion is a fully-realized, multi-hour, story-driven adventure with an additional endless mode. In solo or co-op mode, travel diverse environments, from creepy farmhouses to the catacombs of Paris, in order to uncover who... or what is behind the Zed menace.

name: It's A Racing Game
short_description: This is a racing game. This is an ONLINE racing game. There are many games like it, but this one is mine.

name: Axis Football 2016
short_description: Axis Football is a an American football simulation featuring innovative aimed passing and massive customization.

name: The Stranger: Interactive Film
short_description: The Story: Your wife died in a boat accident. After the funeral for months you have been away from everyone and everything. You have retired to a farm in the middle of nowhere. But maybe.. you're not alone.

name: SOS
short_description: In SOS: BR, You are 1 of 32 players on La Cuna Island, forced to fight to the death. Along with your wits, you will have to equip yourself. Guns are certainly an option, but melee weapons are just as deadly. Keep your eyes open for footprints and other indicators that help you stalk your enemies...

name: Mimpi Dreams
short_description: Help Mimpi save his friends by peeing on everything in his path in this sequel! No seriously, you save Mimpi’s progress by peeing on checkpoints in this game. Platform through six different worlds of puzzling dreams in this dog adventure. Chill in this trippy, casual illustration come alive.

name: Might & Mayhem
short_description: King Dragon's flames burned away the old realm, and his monsters rule the ashes. But an ember of hope still flickers, waiting for the right hero to rekindle it: You! Might & Mayhem is a turn-based strategy rpg featuring live PvP battles, alliances and epic single-player quests.

name: DrakulA
short_description: DRAKULA is an action-platformer with puzzle elements where you play as Van Helsing. Use your wooden stakes to climb obstacles and kill enemies on your war.

name: LEAP
short_description: LEAP is a fast-paced, multiplayer first-person shooter featuring epic large scale battles, each with players armed to the teeth. Fight for either the United Earth Defense Coalition (UEDC) or the rebel Exo-Terrans - whoever pays the most, wins your trigger finger and excessive arsenal.

name: Tail Drift
short_description: Tail Drift is a fast action racing game where you zoom through fantastic environments. Compete while flying around floating islands, ancient temples and desert canyons, with a fleet of unique planes to take through a variety of game modes.

name: ViKubb
short_description: ViKubb lets you play the ancient game of Kubb in Virtual Reality for the first time ever with fully realistic physics! Challenge players online or practice against AI and become the Kubb World Champion!

name: Daffy Fish
short_description: Daffy Fish takes the classic Flappy Bird gameplay mechanic to a whole new levels in this arcade style action game that will take you though 20 challenging levels. Compete with your friends for the highest score in each of the 3 different difficulty modes of play.

name: Wardens
short_description: A turn-based tactical board game with card battler elements. Contains sandbox elements for you to build your own units, craft your own abilities and set your own game rules with a fully integrated editor. Also, a single-player campaign with challenges and boss fights is on the way.

name: OhShape
short_description: OhShape is a rhythm VR game where players have to move their full body to go through, punch or dodge walls following the beat of the music. It's an immersive game for all type of players inspired by the Japanese TV show Hole in the Wall.

name: ALPAGES : THE FIVE BOOKS
short_description: RUN, ESCAPE, SHOOT, SURVIVE AND FIND THE 5 BOOKS ! An indie Arcade Horror Game.

name: DANGER! Escape Lab
short_description: DANGER: Escape Lab! revolves around a conspiracy theory about current events worldwide. Players impersonate a scientist whose role is to save his own life and possibly millions of others by stopping the outbreak.

name: A Summer's End - Hong Kong 1986
short_description: A Summer's End is a visual novel set in 1980s Hong Kong. It tells of a love story between two women. Lush and vibrant visuals, the game features over 400 unique hand-drawn artwork inspired by Asian cinema and 1980s anime.

name: Ultimate Super Bean
short_description: A First-Person Free-For-All Bean Battle! Run Around On A Map That Changes Once A Month, And Use Guns That Also Cycle Out Often! Collect The Skins To Show That You're The Ultimate BEAN!!

name: BM Studio
short_description: BM Studio is a program for creating melodies. Select the sounds you like and the program will turn your keyboard into a musical instrument!

name: Age Of Omens
short_description: You, the Illuvitar have been summoned to save mankind in it's final hour. Will you answer the call? Build, battle, and survive your way through a saga worthy of remembrance in the Age of Omens.

name: Cleo's Lost Idols
short_description: Cleo's Lost Idols is a comedy sandbox physics game where you command workers to create mayhem! Emit fire and lightning, squirt water jets, push boulders and dodge fire traps whilst trying to find the missing statue pieces. There's an in-built video creator and tools to upload straight to YouTube.

name: The Lone Chameleon
short_description: A 2D puzzle-game about cooperation and empathy.

name: おんがくしつ / MUSIC ROOM
short_description: This game is a J-horror game in which a friend invites you to go to school to test your courage.

name: Naturalist Stories
short_description: Take photos, get rewards and unlock new animals in your nursery

name: Skautfold: Usurper
short_description: Usurper is a Metroidvania Action-RPG. With Eldritch horrors having been unleashed by the outer-worldly Citadel, your job is to rid London of its terrors. Use the new 'Guard' system that rewards skillful play and accuracy, to uncover the massive structure and defeat the nightmares lurking within.

name: Liberty Prime
short_description: Welcome to an apocalyptic fantasy world where humanity is on the brink of extinction, glory is valued above gold and freedom is hard earned. In the age of Great Drotus Empire, a lone mercenary accepts a contract to liberate 13 nations of The Empire in order to regain his lost 'Glory'.

name: Shot in the Dark
short_description: Armed with nothing but a six gun the lone bandit will need a quick hand and a sharp eye to fend off the nightmares lurking in the dark.

name: 局外人 L'Etranger
short_description: A unique visual novel about the high school experiences in alternate-history East Asia.

name: War Robots: Planet Defender
short_description: In the distant future, the human beings begin their interstellar travel in the vast universe, and lots of rich planets were mined. But not every planet is peaceful, cruel pirates, wandering rebels, runaway robots, monsters.... We have to face these challenges.

name: Speedgunner Ultra
short_description: Speedgunner Ultra is a dynamic platformer in which you can transform your character into a combat aircraft by pressing a button. Use all sorts of tricks to speed up and try to complete the level faster than anyone else.

name: Shadows: Awakening
short_description: Shadows: Awakening is a unique, isometric single-player RPG with real-time tactical combat. You embark on an epic adventure with challenging gameplay, a gripping storyline and enchanting graphics.

name: Trains VR
short_description: Hop on the Puzzle Train! Welcome to the fantasy world of railroads, locomotives, and stations where you can become both a constructor and a conductor. Relive your childhood dreams with 40 levels packed with logical puzzles and multiple solutions. Build, Ride, Fail, Repeat, Succeed!

name: Car Trader Simulator - Welcome to the Business
short_description: Welcome to the prologue to Car Trader Simulator. Here you will learn all the most important in mechanics and economics in the game and you will play your first mission.

name: Harvester of Dreams : Episode 1
short_description: Harvester of Dreams is a first person adventure game, taking you on board an steampunk airship. Unravel the secret of the ship while you are exploring it room after room.

name: ACE Academy
short_description: ACE Academy is a slice-of-life, story-centric comedy game with elements of dating-sim; fully voiced and extensively interactive!

name: History2048 - 3D puzzle number game
short_description: History 2048 is a familiar logic game, with beautiful graphics. Travel trough the evolution of mankind, meet with famous kings, warlords and adventurer.

name: Arwinia
short_description: Arwinia is a retro-style fantasy action platformer. Play as Trenton on a quest to find and bring a powerful wizard back from the shadows. As a ranger use your longsword, shortbow, and dexterity to navigate this perilous journey.

name: Battle Brigade
short_description: Experience the intensity of head-to-head battle with Battle Brigade! Choose from 8 iconic characters, then battle against them with a robust variety of match options.

name: Craft Craft Craft!
short_description: Craft Craft Craft! As the name suggests, you produce items and sell them to other kingdoms, whether in our own city and develop our army and fight with other countries and villages.

name: Rebel Forces
short_description: Are you ready to be the ultimate soldier and fight until you defeat all of your enemies?

name: Sandmason
short_description: You are a mine worker, stuck deep in an underground cave system. All you have are your hi-tech mining tools. In order to get out of the caves, you will have to shape the dynamic environment to your advantage. You can also create force fields for different purposes.

name: Micro Miners
short_description: 'Micro Miners' is an addictive idle game where the main goal of the game is to unlock all of the cosmetic pets in your player's personal world. Earn credits from the hard work and hours that you put into the game to get the feeling of satisfaction when all of your hard work pays off!

name: Agent of Chaos
short_description: Agent of Chaos is a top-down wave survival game about an avatar of chaos using powerful elemental weapons to defeat hordes of heroes.

name: Brass: Birmingham
short_description: Welcome to the Industrial Revolution! Lead your fast-growing business enterprise, build and develop new industries, multiply your income and don’t get distracted by your rivals. Show everyone you are the real deal!

name: Gondola's Adventure
short_description: Lead Gondola on an adventure, climbing between the depths of the earth to the skies. Just remember to watch your step along the way.

name: Forgotten Sound 1: Revelation
short_description: “Music is the melody of life”. Prince Shahbaz remembers hearing this sentence constantly from his mother. Following her death, Shahrdad Shah, his father, had forbidden playing all instruments as he couldn’t bear the memory of his beloved wife that accompanied the music.

name: One More Roll
short_description: One More Roll is a marble game heavily influenced by Super Monkey Ball & Marble Blast. So far the game has 100+ Levels across 7 different worlds with many more to come in the future. Enjoyable both for casual players and hardcore speedrunners.

name: Perspective
short_description: Perspective is an experimental platformer. The player avatar moves in a 2D space that transforms when the player changes perspective in 3D space. The player needs to use this mechanic navigate the 2D avatar to a goal in order to progress from level to level.

name: Everything Explosive
short_description: Welcome to Everything Explosive! This game contains battle royale modes, a boss battle, PvP environments, AI to practice against in battle royale, and much more! All developed by a solo 15 year old indie game developer. Come join the party!

name: Star Rangers™ XE
short_description: Explore space and build on other worlds in Star Rangers! Star Rangers is a space exploration and construction game that allows players to build habitats and spacecraft, acquire gear and explore the solar system.

name: Reflections ~Dreams and Reality~
short_description: A visual novel about a girl who wishes to escape her fate and those who follow closely behind her. Features both GxB and GxG routes.

name: Magical Squash
short_description: 'Magical Squash' is a virtual reality sports game.The players will view a fantasy squash court immediately at home or even in the office.Within10 minutes, the player will get their body exercised and enjoy a healthy and fun experience.

name: Groove Fit Kingdom!
short_description: Rhythm x Fitness x VR! Play games with the animals in Groove Fit Kingdom and get fit!

name: KiKi's adventure
short_description: On a day out fishing,Alan and his father accidentally found a red-haired woman unconscious on the beach,Save her home after the discovery of the woman in addition to his name (qiqi), lost all memory. A few days later, while kiki was resting at home, Alan's father came to her house and asked for her help.

name: SHIPS AT WAR
short_description: A physics-based strategy game with player-made battleships, submarines and aircraft carriers. Use pre-built ships and sink the enemy by deploying aircraft, torpedoes, depth charges or shells. Or built your own ships in the extensive ship-editor.

name: Hoverboard Chase
short_description: HoverBoard Chase - 3d hoverboard race where you have to dodge cops, earn influence points for tricks and monitor your character's health bar, because in the end you can get caught!

name: Marinatide
short_description: Marinatide is a sea fishing and exploration game, combining elements of strategy and adventure. Roam the sea, catch fish and complete the quest to fishing glory!

name: Fallout: A Post Nuclear Role Playing Game
short_description: You've just unearthed the classic post-apocalyptic role-playing game that revitalized the entire CRPG genre. The Fallout® SPECIAL system allows drastically different types of characters, meaningful decisions and development that puts you in complete control. Explore the devastated ruins of a golden age civilization.

name: Symphonic Rain
short_description: The reborn HD edition, Remastered by Siro! Set in Piova, the city of music and endless rain. Guide Chris Vertin on the path to become a master musician in a harmonious fusion of Visual Novel and Music-based gameplay.

name: VRITRA COMPLETE EDITION
short_description: A challenge from ancient times delivered to gamers. That excitement from the past has returned. The complete version of VRITRA, the 2D fantasy shooting game, is out now!

name: Action Ball 2
short_description: Take to the skies with the thrilling, brick-busting excitement of Action Ball 2, the electrifying sequel to the hit arcade game! Soar above the clouds in your paddle-equipped ship and fight back the relentless robots in level after level of eye-popping fun.

name: Azrael
short_description: Traverse this ominous 2D Dungeon Crawler as Azrael; A mysterious being. With three unique endings, the player is tasked to simply explore and watch as they learn more about their character, the situation, and consequences. Includes an original soundtrack and artwork.

name: Angry Rocketeer Frenzy
short_description: Angry rockeeteer frenzy - Are cursed robots trying to take over Earth? Not on my shift! Take your trusty rocket launcher into service and destroy all the enemies of our planet in this unusual mix of shoot 'em up and roguelite genres!

name: Metavusking
short_description: Start the concert! Metavusking is a singing game where you sing on a stage in virtual reality. It supports both monitors and VR headsets.

name: Pillowheads: It's Party Time
short_description: Pillowheads is a local multiplayer party game for up to 4 players. Pick your Pillowhead and play against your friends in various, modifiable game modes. Kicked out too early during a round? No problem: Fight yourself back into the game by sabotaging your opponents successfully. It's Party Time!

name: On Key Up: A Game for Keyboards
short_description: Get to know your keyboard with this unique, physics-based puzzle game! Bounce, roll, paint, and even break objects with each press of a key.

name: A Study in Steampunk: Choice by Gaslight
short_description: Steam-powered mechs meet forbidden sorcery in this interactive steampunk novel, inspired by Sherlock Holmes, Dracula, Jekyll & Hyde, and Jack the Ripper!

name: Rifle Storm
short_description: A turn-based strategy game with roguelike elements. Build a powerful squad, explore randomly generated worlds, acquire almighty gadgets and capture the bunker!

name: Lemuria: Lost in Space - VR Edition
short_description: Lemuria: Lost in Space is a unique adventure, full of mysteries, puzzles and shocking discoveries. It's a combination of point 'n click adventure, RPG and survival game.

name: BEAK SQUADRON
short_description: BEAK SQUADRON is a challenging, indie, 3rd-person flight game set in a galaxy where ducks and guinea pigs have been at war for eons. Not for players who are looking for an easy experience. Designed for controller play.

name: Bayla Bunny
short_description: Bayla Bunny has discovered a book full of maps to magical treasures and loot, and sets out on an exciting adventure to discover them all. Energized and ready to explore, she takes off running and once she gets going, she rarely stops!

name: Bleeding Edge
short_description: Grab your team and tear it up in Bleeding Edge, an electrifying online brawler where every fighter comes mechanically enhanced for mayhem!

name: 方解夢異聞 ～ Avant-Garde Discerning Paralleler (東方二次創作STG)
short_description: 幻想郷で急速に進み始めた近代化現象の謎に、あの息ぴったりの式神コンビと、異色の邪仙&山彦コンビが挑む！ 全16ステージ+αの、ステージ選択制東方二次創作縦スクロールSTG！ステージ選択制ならではのバラエティに富んだ弾幕の数々を、君は攻略することができるか！？

name: Orc Assault
short_description: Once upon a time all was peaceful and serene in the far off land of Camalon, but the silence has been broken as the Orc hordes have returned to the peaceful kingdom to claim the land that they once held most sacred.

name: CubeZ
short_description: CubeZ is an action game with destroy the brain to kill mechanics, fully destructible characters, and a high level of customization that gives you the freedom to play with your own style. From tanked out battle axe warriors to SMG ninja assassins, everyone gets to play how they want.

name: Frederic: Resurrection of Music Director's Cut
short_description: New version of cult game with new levels and exclusive Steam online multiplayer! Frederic Chopin – a long time deceased classical compositor – returns back from beyond the grave to fight intense musical duels. In his way stand some of the worlds greatest pop stars charmed with enormous profits that wild commercialization provides

name: Moonfall
short_description: Almost extinct and slowly dying, mankind's only hope is to reach the Valley where the broken fragments of the Moon once fell. Manage your squad of travellers through dangerous wastelands in this turn-based Tactical Roguelite.

name: Suzunaan on Fire
short_description: Suzunaan on Fire is the first Touhou doujin game produced by Creator Team from SakuraGaming. Players will roleplay Kosuzu Motoori and figure out the way to escape from fire. If you like puzzle games and also like Touhou, welcome to play our first game.

name: SkyPrimal
short_description: Having lost your tribe, you, as the sole survivor, find yourself in an era of deadly danger and exciting adventures. You have to build yourself a shelter, make weapons, protect yourself from wild animals, and prove that you are not a prey, but a predator.

name: The Last Leviathan
short_description: The Last Leviathan is a physics-based, ship building and destruction sandbox. On your voyage to uncover where The Last Leviathan lies you will discover a world full of rival ships, mythical monsters, wrecked flotsam, physics-puzzles and hidden treasures.

name: European Fishing
short_description: Do you want to relax by the water in beautiful nature? European Fishing allow you to go on a virtual fishing tour.

name: Dark Forest Project
short_description: You are a military man who was sent on an assignment to investigate in a dark forest due to the frequent disappearance of people. After spending a little time, you realize that ancient prisoners are being revived in this forest, and the longer you are in it, the more and more of them.

name: Abridged
short_description: Abridged is a strategy board game where the goal is to connect to any two opposite edges of the 8x8 board by placing pieces to form a continuous bridge. Defeat your opponents by building over them and connecting your path first.

name: Henchman For Hire
short_description: Henchman for Hire is a VR game designed by students where you drive, jump and sabotage Peace City for the super villain Dr. BAD while traveling on a surprisingly resilient moped!

name: Conclave
short_description: An online RPG with the story and turn-based combat of a classic fantasy tabletop campaign. Play a party of up to four characters solo, or co-op with other players. Adventure together in real time, or take turns at your leisure.

name: Duck Hunting
short_description: Welcome to the realistic world of duck hunting. Shoot ducks , gaining experience!

name: CRAFTSMAN
short_description: Craftsman is a game about a cubic world in which you can build anything you want. Explore the location, get resources and indulge in creativity!

name: LOTUS-Simulator
short_description: For the first time, bus, tram and train are simulated extremely realistic in a single game – and you can drive them, build them or create the world around. LOTUS – simulation will never be the same!

name: Territory Idle
short_description: Strategic idle game. Develop the kingdom, then abdicate and get gold! For gold, you can buy new tiles and expand the territory.

name: SENRAN KAGURA Bon Appétit! - Full Course
short_description: The busty shinobi of SENRAN KAGURA exchange their kunais for kitchen knives in this epic cooking/rhythm showdown! Culinary warfare is carried out via rhythm battles, and players who can create the ultimate Super Dish may be treated to a special feast for the eyes as well.

name: Strife: Veteran Edition
short_description: Hailed as the original FPS-RPG game that spawned countless imitators, Strife: Veteran Edition is a love letter to the classic from 1996.

name: Motivational Hero Vol. 2
short_description: Motivational Hero is a Motivational Puzzle-Platformer 2d with levels based in Motivational Analogies

name: EX LIFE
short_description: EX_LIFE is a sci-fi, futuristic interactive game, different and very stylish, with a unique and rich gameplay, in which the player must solve puzzles by putting himself to the test. Interacting with an AI with a strong personality, the protagonist have to survive and solve the mysteries.

name: Out of Reach
short_description: You’re a castaway stranded in the middle of nowhere. Storm is gone, the worst certainly not. Look for food and resources, craft gear, make shelters. These are the basics, you need much more to stay alive on this cut-off-the-world, yet not desert island. Build & burn, sail & explore, be Out of Reach!

name: Connection
short_description: Don't lose the signal to get out of here.

name: Steps From Above
short_description: Survival Experience and a capturing story

name: Mars: Chaos Menace
short_description: Humanity is terraforming Mars, but chaos and destruction threaten the planet. Battle your way through innumerable hordes of enemies that wish to destroy you and face the most terrible and powerful monsters in the galaxy. Our destiny is in your hands.

name: Happy Guy
short_description: Haro works in a cosmetic hospital. He left his job after problems with a nurse. His life changed a lot after that. He meets more beautiful girls. Who will be the most important girl in his life?

name: GunWorld VR
short_description: A Realistic, Physics Based, Gun Simulator Sandbox in VR. Experience Physical hands, and Guns that are calibrated to real life.

name: Bleeding Border
short_description: Bleeding Border is a first person 3d survival horror game in which the player must escape through the top of a monster infested building using his own blood as the only defense mechanism.

name: Hard to Be a God
short_description: Hard to be a God is a Sci-Fi RPG with adventure and espionage elements.

name: Planet Jump 2
short_description: This is a game in which you will travel around the planets, learn new things and sometimes even complete quests.

name: Last Group Out
short_description: Shoot, loot and try to escape with your life in this online co-op looter shooter!

name: Guts and Glory
short_description: A game about father and son riding their bicycle through obstacle courses of death, and other fun family experiences. Created by HakJak

name: The Lost Wizard
short_description: Enter the magical castle of The Lost Wizard,you are tibiothar a skilled wizard, the castle was attacked by the evil skeleton king, free the magician Althazar from the tyranny of skeleton king and bring peace inside the castle of Althazar, destroy the army of darkness. Your actions will be remembered forever.

name: Spelunky 2
short_description: Spelunky 2 builds upon the unique, randomized challenges that made the original a roguelike classic, offering a huge adventure designed to satisfy players old and new. Meet the next generation of explorers as they find themselves on the Moon, searching for treasure and missing family.

name: Get Packed: Fully Loaded
short_description: Get Packed: Fully Loaded is the expanded edition of the couch co-op removals game that’s full of calamity and physics-based carnage for 1-4 players.

name: Ember Kaboom
short_description: Ember's a fox who loves adventure. Run, jump, and ride through 30+ colorful, fast-paced obstacle courses in a quest to get your missing soul back!

name: Last Boss -9x9 Action Battle-
short_description: 9x9 Action Battle This is an arcade shooter game. The player has two actions. These are attack and evasion. Avoid various attacks from the boss and defeat the boss. Please defeat four bosses. Then you should be able to meet the true boss.

name: Open The Door
short_description: Physics. Simulation. Puzzle. 3D. Indie.

name: GemBreak
short_description: GemBreak is an action-packed physics puzzle game on steroids, with great speed and action/tactical -oriented gameplay.

name: Eye of the Owl - Bosch VR
short_description: Go back in time over 500 years to Hieronymus Bosch's studio and explore his masterpiece - The Garden of Earthly Delights

name: She Will Shoot
short_description: She Will Shoot - is a cool zombie killer from the third person in a variety of scenery. Choose an arena and use different types of weapons to clear it of zombies.

name: Active Neurons 2
short_description: Active Neurons 2 is a puzzle game in which you have to discover 12 greatest inventions of humanity and reflect on the power of human thought

name: Hide & Chick
short_description: Hide & Chick is a multiplayer hide-and-seek party game in which you kill each other amongst tons of identical looking NPCs. Key to winning is blending in with NPCs.

name: Together - A Wish No One Remembers
short_description: Torn between his recent broken heart and his desire to never subject anyone to that kind of suffering, Vince decides, despite his own feelings, to learn more about this mysterious girl who just confessed her love to him—still hoping in the back of his mind that his unrequited love will one day be reciprocated.

name: stikir
short_description: This game is about making this game.

name: Princess and Knight
short_description: Play the game and you'll be welcomed by many unique characters and their stories. The game 'Princess And Knight' is an Tactical-RPG game that follows a funny and interesting story.

name: Slayers, Inc.
short_description: Slayers, Inc. is a roguelite twin-stick shooter about killing hordes of demons. Acquire items to brutalize them in new and unique ways, empower yourself with Artifacts to kill 'em with style, don't forget to keep your combo going, and give those infernal fools the boot!

name: Grimm & Tonic: Aperitif
short_description: Maintaining a healthy Work-Life balance is pretty tricky on a good day but it’s damn near impossible when your boss threatens foreclosure on your mortal existence. As the new bartender at DEAD-END, you’ll make new friends, mix weird drinks, all while navigating Life, Death and everything in between.

name: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations
short_description: If you like to make puzzles, Super Jigsaw Puzzle is your game. Enjoy its comfortable and intuitive interface and its relaxing music that will allow you to concentrate on the difficult task of solving these beautiful photos that pose a real challenge for lovers of puzzles.

name: House of 1000 Doors: Serpent Flame
short_description: Giant snakes have burst out of the Earth and are wreaking destruction across every continent! Your mission: travel back in time to four different epochs to gather the elements needed to activate a machine that can destroy the ancient beasts.

name: STRIDER™ / ストライダー飛竜®
short_description: Strider returns in a brand new adventure, complete with incredible side-scrolling action, and lightning fast combat all in a massive interconnected world! Download the full game February 19th and become the original assassin!

name: Slice&Dice
short_description: Slice & Dice is a puzzle game where the objective is to place the die in the goal frame. Using realistic physics, the player can move the die by affecting the cubes within the environment through a variety of actions like slicing and destroying them. It’s a party game that players and viewers alike can enjoy!

name: MIBT
short_description: Help the government agents in black thong to end the alien threat and the invasion of the machines. 1 or 2 players. Individual and cooperative. Gamepad compatible. Demo available.

name: REDITUM
short_description: Embark on a dizzying simulation experience.

name: Freedom: How I Escaped
short_description: This is your chance. The time has come to put oppression in your past. The escape plan is ready, but you must avoid all surveillance and run undetected. Its time to make your own path. To make your own future. Its now or never.

name: The Uncertain: Light At The End
short_description: The Uncertain is a story-driven adventure game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Humanity disappeared from the face of the Earth and has been replaced by robots. Together with Emily, one of the survivors, you will have to witness how people try to live in a world ruled by robots.

name: Last Heroes 2
short_description: Find out what is ahead for Amelia and Roland, as they are headed to Odaro continent, in this new entry in the hit RPG series Last Heroes!

name: Kill or Love
short_description: A visual novel about obsession, loneliness, and, based on your choices, varying amounts of murder.

name: Petoons Party
short_description: Ready for a great adventure? The Petoons need your help to face the evil Kitra! Kitra wants to conquer the island of Kimera and steal the Petoons magic to control their world. Petoons Party is a party game full of fun mini-games to enjoy with family and friends.

name: The Oil Blue: Steam Legacy Edition
short_description: It is the future, and the world is in grave need of oil. You and a crew have set off into the ocean, reclaiming old island drilling sites for oil production as you work for the UOO, the biggest oil supplier in the world. The working conditions are dire. You have no choice.

name: Afterparty
short_description: In Afterparty, you are Milo and Lola, recently deceased best buds who suddenly find themselves staring down an eternity in Hell. But there's a loophole: outdrink Satan and he'll grant you re-entry to Earth.

name: Laboratory of Nightmares
short_description: You are one of the best fighters of the GIBAR unit, and therefore you were sent to destroy a secret laboratory guarded by armed soldiers. This is a dynamic game with a top view in which you have to survive in a secret laboratory and find a way out of it.

name: Ero Date
short_description: Match 3 at the time with cute girls.

name: one night, hot springs
short_description: Haru is invited by her old friend Manami to spend a night at the hot springs. All Haru wants to do is enjoy the hot springs like everyone else, but she doesn't want to cause any trouble...

name: Psycho
short_description: ”Psycho” is a 3D horror game that allows you to explore and survive with your friends in the terrible mystery bunker.

name: Draft Day Sports: College Football 2020
short_description: Draft Day Sports: College Football 2020 puts you in the role of head coach for your favorite college football team. Recruit, gameplan and make the right calls on the field to lead your team to the top of the ranks and the college football championship.

name: Attached
short_description: Magic was an active force all over the kingdom. People used it to heal their wounds, fight against their enemies. However world is changing, Something started to spread called 'Technology'. Some people call it devil and others try to assimilate it. What do you believe Magic Or Tech?

name: The Last Hope: Zombie Defense TD
short_description: The world is overrun by zombies, which are getting stronger with each level... Build towers to stop hordes of zombies and save the world! Get powerful upgrades and create your amazing tactics! Experience an amazing adventure in a post-apocalyptic world!

name: Hand with hand
short_description: 'SaveHer' is a shooting collection type of game. You need to break through the obstacles and explore all kinds of dangerous places. You will get all kinds of guns to save the girls trapped in different dimensions.

name: MechaNika
short_description: If it's not cool, it will disappear. If you're not cool, hide. MechaNika is here.

name: Chuckie Egg 2017
short_description: Run, jump, dodge, collect eggs! There's a new Harry in town as the popular platform game debuts on PC.

name: OFFSIDE
short_description: Between a Runner and an Hack & Slash game, Offside lets you play as the young boy through 4 exciting levels, in which reflexes and agility will be the key in defeating Olaf’s plans and getting back the soccer ball collection.

name: Fantasy Royal VR
short_description: 'Fantasy Royal VR' is a VR strategy battle game played in a sci-fi world. Make one's mark in the world through future virtual strategic sports. Only those who can control various battlefields and unique units can become true champions.

name: Scribblenauts Unmasked: A DC Comics Adventure
short_description: In Scribblenauts Unmasked: A DC Comics Adventure, Maxwell unites with Batman™, Superman™ and the rest of The Justice League™ to restore order to the DC Comics Universe. Challenge your imagination as you battle the mightiest villains in an exciting, action-filled adventure through GOTHAM CITY™, METROPOLIS™, ATLANTIS™ and other iconic...

name: TealGrounds
short_description: TealGrounds is a third-person, puzzle, horror game with randomly generated world that takes place in an underground workshop of a scientist known as Dr Willis. Your goal is to solve puzzles, avoid aggressive machines and find the exit.

name: Shotgun, Dungeons, Laser Traps
short_description: A first person puzzle shooter. Shoot boxes, push bombs, fend off enemies, find a way out of laser-mechanical traps.

name: Flippin Kaktus
short_description: Flippin Kaktus is an action-driven vendetta with 80s vibes, featuring a spiky hero with the thorny past and rage-outbreaks combat style.

name: VirZOOM Arcade
short_description: VirZOOM Arcade is a collection of virtual reality sports for the VirZOOM bike controller. Your pedaling and leaning propel you through race tracks, battle grounds, and soaring skies. Play online live or against ghost players.

name: SQUAKE
short_description: The mix of Snake+Quake! Quite clever, eh? We thought so. SQUAKE is a massive multiplayer action-packed combat-trains game! Collect wagons to become longer. Destroy other trains and try to not die by hitting yourself, because that would be totally embarrassing.

name: Zap Zap Zombie Cats
short_description: You are one of the few survivors of a zombie cat-pocalypse. With only your wits, your weapons, and a few turrets, you must defend yourself from the hordes of zombie-cats that come at night. Grenade, blast, shoot, heal, and place traps to survive each wave until safety comes with the sunlight.

name: Beast Quest
short_description: Embark on an epic action-adventure to save the Kingdom of Avantia from ruin. Based on the best-selling fantasy novels, Beast Quest comes to Steam for the first time ever, with a rich, progressive storyline, vibrant settings, and an excess of compelling challenges.

name: Nancy Drew®: Midnight in Salem
short_description: How Far Would You Go to Escape the Past? Step into a story filled with danger, intrigue, and complicated relationships in Midnight in Salem, the new 3D mystery adventure with detective Nancy Drew. Time is short, and you, as Nancy Drew, must solve the mystery before the clock strikes midnight.

name: Mother Stone
short_description: Take the role of Agent Blair as she fights her way through Zombies, Cultists and Giant Snakes to uncover the truth about the Mother Stone. Battle challenging bosses, Collect useful power-ups to give Agent Blair an edge over the unknown monsters that plague The Thurston House.

name: Abberbury
short_description: Enter the dungeon of a medieval castle full of traps, enemies, mysteries! Can you overcome all obstacles to justice?

name: Rotten Tide
short_description: Rotten Tide is a horizontal 2D tower defense game where players must protect the world from the attacks of all kinds of monsters who are threatening the humans in big cities all around the world.

name: Dungeon Reels Tactics
short_description: Dungeon Reels Tactics is a challenging party based RPG roguelike with Slot Machine based Combat. Your party members' unique slot machine will supply your abilities each turn. Make the best decisions to succeed in Battle. Lose party members, recruit new ones, and try to reach The 'Great Evil'.

name: Undiscovered House
short_description: First-person, story-based horror game. The game evokes a grim atmosphere, a sense of dread, and tension. Players solve mild puzzles and find and use keys. They find supplies for a flashlight and experience jump scares. Discover the gruesome secrets of the house.

name: Stoneshard
short_description: Stoneshard is a challenging turn-based RPG set in an open world. Experience the unforgiving life of a medieval mercenary: travel across the war-torn kingdom, fulfill contracts, fight, mend your wounds and develop your character without any restrictions.

name: Galimulator
short_description: Galimulator is a galactic empire simulation and sandbox game. See how Empires rise and fall, and how the people in them climb through the ranks to bring prestige to their Dynasty. Then throw in an invasion of self replicating Smatter monsters if you want to spice things up.

name: The Devil's Chosen
short_description: Swim after an uneasy night with your girlfriend in a dark, strange and sinister forest, feel the intense exploration, create new weapons, find secrets, fight demons and strange animals never seen before, and of course don't forget to rescue your girlfriend from the Old One.

name: BasCatball Saturn: Basketball & Cat
short_description: Play basketball. In Saturn. With cats. Are you ready for the whole galaxy's hardest matches? Solve puzzles and win the Bascatball intergalactic championship!

name: Citystate II
short_description: Build the cities of a new Nation and bring about your vision of the ideal society. Citystate II is a modern city-builder featuring political customization and realistic economics with a focus on macro management.

name: Birth Patrol
short_description: 2D shoot 'em up in which you play as Jill the birth control pill and go back in time and abort Hitler.

name: Highway Junkie
short_description: Exciting race on the highway! A variety of modes of physics and tight traffic will not let you relax!

name: Filthy Hands
short_description: Experience the multiplayer action of an armed robbery where a hostile intruder will do everything he can to steal the safe from a wealthy family. Play as a family of 3 or as a brutal home invader attempting to steal the family's hard earned savings.

name: The Universim
short_description: Jump straight into managing your own planets as you guide a civilization through the ages. Build the ultimate empire in The Universim, a new breed of God Game in development by Crytivo.

name: Blue Horizon
short_description: A story driven open world first person, single player game. A fantasy action adventure set in the Golden age of Caribbean Piracy. Fight Pirates and creatures, discover islands and caves, ports and tribal villages. Build up your inventory, craft ships and rule the waves, Blue Horizon has it all!

name: Space Rangers HD: A War Apart
short_description: Space adventure, open world RPG, strategy, arcade, quest and more!

name: Kalimba
short_description: Jump, switch and fly your way through mind-bending subterranean puzzles in this stunning new platforming adventure from the award-winning Press Play!

name: 与芙兰朵露一起捉迷藏吧
short_description: 一款轻松欢乐的RPG角色扮演探索游戏，二小姐有全程语音，适合芙兰厨。

name: DOOM Eternal
short_description: Hell’s armies have invaded Earth. Become the Slayer in an epic single-player campaign to conquer demons across dimensions and stop the final destruction of humanity. The only thing they fear... is you.

name: Calmed by the Dark Leviathan
short_description: Calmed by the Dark Leviathan: An Open-World Action-RPG story set in the distant future where the Earth is ruled by dragon gods. It's up to Europa, Sofia, Claire and Virginia to fight, capture and upgrade giant monsters to save the world!

name: Riftwalker
short_description: Riftwalker is a rogue-like tower defense in a world consumed by darkness, featuring rich backstory and endless, detailed procedural levels. You play the role of a riftwalker in a scouting party sent to investigate a nearby missing star, but find more than you were expecting - a civilization, or rather, what's left of it.

name: Monolith VR
short_description: Try and look for a mysterious metal monolith that's full of riddles.

name: DEAD GUN
short_description: DEAD GUN is a 2D platformer with roguelike elements. Take control of a soldier of the elite squad Z-800 and go on an operation to clear friendly worlds from enemies in order to save them.

name: Technotron Defense
short_description: Techotron Defense is a stylish tower defense game with relaxing soundtrack and deep and hardcore tower defense gameplay

name: Everpath
short_description: Everpath is a roguelite RPG with hand-crafted pixel art, explore a procedural generated world with the combat and item system of the classics action RPGs. Embark yourself as a member of the Northbarrow army, choose and personalize your class to find what is lurking in the wilderness of Northbarrow

name: Il Sole e la Luna 2
short_description: Role Playing Fantasy Game. Spectacular turn-based battles with unique settings. Fully explorable world (Open World)!

name: Evochron Legacy SE
short_description: Advanced Space Flight, Combat, Trading, and Exploration Simulation. Set in a vast explorable universe, Evochron Legacy offers freeform gameplay with many diverse objectives and paths to choose from.

name: COG Back To The 80s
short_description: Welcome to the year 1980 where everything almost went to hell, why? Let's just say that sometimes you have to be a fucking psychopath if you want change to happen, but every change has consequences. Welcome to COG a horror shooter.

name: DoomAI
short_description: Kind of DOTA game, experience the adventure experience of ai zi and hu together during the game. If you are a fan of casual games, then you must not miss.

name: Monster Jam Steel Titans 2
short_description: More Trucks! New Worlds! Monster Jam Steel Titans 2! Monster Jam Steel Titans 2 features more fan-favorite trucks in brand new Monster Jam worlds!

name: Never Ending Night
short_description: Never Ending Night is a 2D side-scrolling exploration game. As the Player, you roam through a mysterious world you have no recollection of. Traverse through a broken world and survive through the mechanical monstrosities that have managed to survive the calamity...

name: Desert monsters
short_description: This is a third person action adventure game,The player is located in a deserted desert full of monsters,Players are free to explore their surroundings.Players must avoid monster attacks or kill monsters to survive,Small monster attacks are lower, large monster attacks and higher health,Players need to survive as long as possible.

name: Dungeon Marathon
short_description: Dungeon Marathon is a new style of game where you must run through Dungeons, no fighting allowed!

name: 10mg: Sealed Estate
short_description: you are locked inside by a creature. figure out how to escape from the estate you have been locked inside. who lived here? who are the voices haunting your every step?

name: Super Neat Cat
short_description: A retro style simple platforming adventure! A small cute cat must save their world from an ancient Nanobot Virus. Explore a beautiful pixel art land as you try and find the source of this destruction.

name: HYPERNOVA: Escape from Hadea
short_description: HYPERNOVA: Escape from Hadea combines classic real-time strategy with tower defense in a vast open world, becoming something special in the process – the original RTDS! The world is colorful and charming, but make no mistake: this is a deep and diverse strategy game with old school sensibilities.

name: The RPG Engine
short_description: Host immersive tabletop campaigns in a world imagined entirely by you! Build from the ground up with The RPG Engine, an intuitive virtual tabletop that lets you create unparalleled roleplaying environments for your party to get lost in.

name: Ignatius
short_description: Ignatius is a atmospheric puzzle-platformer game with an interesting story. The game with its visual form and plot refers to the old silent movies.

name: Crown and Council
short_description: Crown and Council is a casual strategy game with short game sessions.

name: Alan's Attitude
short_description: Alan's Attitude is 3D puzzle game, where you become a programmer. Your goal is to sit by the PC and finish the job. And what is your job? You'll find out.

name: Ball Driver
short_description: Ball Driver is a casual action/racing/platform/reflex game which you control a ball (shocker!) through various stages. You have to complete every level within the time limit to succeed.

name: Usotsuki Game / 谎言游戏
short_description: 当主人公醒来时，就发现自己与几位不认识的男女被关在了一起… 此时，一个奇妙的广播响起 「来，让谎言游戏开始吧！」

name: Amazething
short_description: Trap filled mazes with an ever growing difficulty await to test your skills. Please be advised that this mixture of maze-running and relaxing beats might still cause your controller to get stuck in your screen.

name: PIVO
short_description: PIVO is a game that solves puzzles between 2D space and 3D space. Experience transcending space with a cute corgi.

name: Elite Archery
short_description: In Elite Archery you play as an adventurer in search of treasures and wealth! Unfortunately the natives will not let you get their hands on their sacred treasures so easily!

name: Hentai Waifu
short_description: Hentai Waifu is a casual puzzle game, where you reveal gorgeous girls pictures while you relax in a 3 difficulties puzzle.

name: Flying Girls
short_description: 'Flying Girls' is a horizontal shooting game with classical Chinese ink painting style.

name: PC Creator - PC Building Simulator
short_description: Try yourself as a PC builder and build your dream PC from 200+ real components!Complete different PC building and PC repair orders to upgrade your business: build a PC from zero, install popular OS', upgrade computers, install different programs and games, fix PC parts, and much more.

name: Homeworld Defense
short_description: Homeword defense is a strategic game in which you will protect your planets from the waves of asteroids, find out why they appear and save your world from the threat once and for all. To protect the world, you will have to use weapons that asteroids can help you discover.

name: Flipon
short_description: Join Kat and her crew in an epic quest in Flipon, a juicy, fun and fast-paced arcade puzzle game!

name: Sabres of Infinity
short_description: Wage a war of gunpowder and magic! As a gentleman-officer of the Royal Dragoons, will you sacrifice your fortune? Your honour? Your men? Your own life?

name: Never Give Up
short_description: Never Give Up is a hardcore platformer determined to turn you into bloody chunks. Run, jump, and slide your way through ever-changing levels that get harder each time you succeed. You’ll need to try, die, and try again if you want to conquer the game without pressing the Give Up button.

name: Bunker Down
short_description: Bunker Down is a bomb-survival genre game set in an apocalyptic city. The city is being overrun with aliens and you have to make your way to the bunker deep underground. Throw bombs being dropped from the sky to avoid your doom.

name: Deios II // DEIDIA
short_description: [WELCOME]ALT.DIETYNETDeidia is an exploration glitch-venture game where you explore a lonely unstable world, with glitches, forgotten ruins, and unknown lands abandoned in lonely BBS systems. Corrupt the world to find new paths. Find the worlds behind a thousand doors.

name: Artemis: God-Queen of The Hunt
short_description: Olympia is not for the faint of heart. Explore, hunt, and survive (or try) in this ultra-hard platformer that focuses on being airborne.

name: Sound Slide
short_description: Sound Slide is a rythm puzzle racer, bringing you to 4 different environments around the world! Each environment has its own distinctive music: go with the flow and hop from lane to lane to get to the end!

name: Citadel
short_description: Citadel is an indie cooperative survival game with rogue-like elements inspired by “Cube” the movie.

name: Empires in Ruins
short_description: A most offensive defensive Grand Strategy game, with a black humor infused plot, set in a grim, disillusioned world. Quell the rebellion, tame the Western Marches, disobey your orders and save your brandy. Not strictly in this order.

name: PROPHECY OF THE NUN
short_description: The path of a group of friends falls on a mysterious mansion, and the extraordinary events that take place in the mansion are told.

name: SYNTHSPACE
short_description: Synthspace is the ultimate virtual synthesizer. It combines the familiarity of real instruments with the possibilities of virtual worlds. A room full of synths for the price of a nice lunch. *mic drop*

name: ZEROED
short_description: Soar across vast landscapes and battle opponents with a unique take on flight combat racing. Get ready to break the sound barrier in this deceptively simple game that will always be a challenge, so buckle up and get ZEROED!

name: Fantasy Mosaics 18: Explore New Colors
short_description: Uncle Aaron and the mysterious lady penguin go on a vacation trip to explore new colors for mosaic puzzles! Along the way they make new discoveries and build a fantasy landscape! Enjoy this installment of fantasy mosaics that also includes a new feature allowing you to view the background art with a puzzle image in progress.

name: Soccer Manager 2015
short_description: If you love football as much as we do, you live and breathe it. Start managing your favourite club in a matter of minutes. Play in 48 leagues from 36 countries around the world and choose from over 800 clubs. Lead living legends to victory in this fast-paced, action-packed single-player game.

name: Virtual Race Car Engineer 2020
short_description: Intermediate level setup tuning - VRCE fine tunes your baseline setup to get the most out of the car… fast! Now with even more options and advice.

name: Titanfall - The Final Hours
short_description: Written over the past four years, journalist Geoff Keighley ('The Final Hours of Portal 2') chronicles the making of TITANFALL from Respawn Entertainment. This longform app features never-before-seen photos, video and concept art from early development versions of the game.

name: Life of Lon: Chapter 1
short_description: Life of Lon is a science fantasy adventure game starring you as Lon. Your journey will take you to the stars, beneath an alien ocean, and through time. A beautiful and curious creature named Yep will accompany you on your travels- aiding you in unlocking the mysteries of Paracosma.

name: Dungeoneers
short_description: You stand before a dungeon crawler 10 years in the making. Fast-paced, tabletop-insipred gameplay. Light story and banter. 80's nostalgia. Quick sessions. Multi-platform. Classic art & narration. Easy to learn. Hard to master. Enter if you dare.

name: Hobo: Tough Life
short_description: Hobo: Tough Life is an urban survival role-playing game where you play as a homeless person. Play alone or team up in online co-op. Explore the streets of Praslav, scavenge for food and supplies, beg, steal, and do whatever else it takes to survive the forthcoming winter.

name: Bad Pad
short_description: Bad Pad is a metal pumped metroidvania platfomer about a gamepad's buttons who came to life. Oozing with original music and storytelling songs, all in the spirit of metal. Precision platforming, boss fighting, puzzle solving, mini games and more...

name: This Side (Early Access Game)
short_description: Fight your natural fears and help your friend to find a way to escape this forgotten place. Set on an abandoned mine. This Side is a roguelike survival horror game that you will have a terrifying experience with a friend to find the way to freedom.

name: Bad Mojos
short_description: You are the last survivor, badmojos attacked the city.Bad mojos is Voodoo dolls with one single objective, to destroy all life and only in your power to stop them. Today is a bad day for badmojos. Take a gun in your hand and start to protect the city from evil voodoo.

name: Shwip
short_description: Dominate global leaderboards as you face off against an unrelenting geometric force. Shwip combines twin-stick arcade action with tight controls, insane pixel destruction & devastating weapons & abilities. Evade, outlast and play with style in four game modes over single & local multiplayer.

name: Unitied
short_description: Unitied is a minimalistic & relaxing puzzle game

name: MeiQi:Story
short_description: Collect new clues and solve new cases in the latest game in the 'Meiqi' series. The new chapter 'Story' takes place after the pendulum case. Liu Qingchun mustered the courage to walk into Wang Yong's house.

name: VR Game Station
short_description: Lots of games in only one place for your VR devices.

name: Space Hulk: Ascension
short_description: Space Hulk: Ascension is a 3D, digital, turn based, strategy game, which re-interprets the classic board game experience, and adds new RPG style mechanics, new weapons and missions, new enemy types, 3 playable chapters and loads of other new features to the single player experience.

name: Cuit
short_description: In CUIT, it is only you and your mind. A challenging and relaxing puzzle game, ready to test you from top to bottom. Navigate a current through a circuit. Power a target, avoid the explosives. Sounds easy? Try it - and guess again. A logical challenge - for everyone.

name: Snakes - N - Ladders : Origins - Episode 1
short_description: Every ancient game has a story behind its origins. Scripted from an exciting Sci-Fi perspective, this is a story of how the ancient Snakes&Ladders board game came to be. Snakes-N-Ladders: Origins - Episode 1 is a small, fun, tense, and entertaining shooter game.

name: Island Idle RPG
short_description: Lead the Balgairs - mercenaries creatures and experts in the art of hard working - manage the workforce, inputs, capital, other resources and help provide all the equipment and weaponry needed to defeat bosses in distant Dungeons

name: Hellbound
short_description: Classic First Person Shooter style game. Like the good old days. An action game focused on speed, gore, guns, and metal music. Inspired by the 90s’ classics with modern visuals and audio!

name: STICK ENGINE
short_description: STICK ENGINE puts the tools in your hands to create insane stick shenanigans and share them with the world using the STEAM WORKSHOP.

name: Chuusotsu! 1.5th Graduation: The Moving Castle
short_description: Join Arue and her merry Chuusotsu band on her first visit to a certain doujin event in the Big Site, and share in her struggles as an aspiring manga creator!

name: Cabals: Magic & Battle Cards
short_description: Cabals combines the strategic deck building of card games and tactics of a chess like board game. The classic collectible card game is now designed from the ground up for PC. Choose your side, build your perfect deck and battle in the War of Cabals to decide the fate of humankind!

name: Melbits™ World
short_description: THE CUTEST CHALLENGE ! The cooperative puzzle-platformer game that will equally charm and challenge your friends and family. Communication and coordination are the key to success in the Melbits™ mission!'

name: Brick Blaster
short_description: Brick Blaster is a classic brick breaking game with 100 levels to complete, power-ups to grab, and bosses to defeat!

name: AIRHEART - Tales of broken Wings
short_description: Airheart is a dieselpunk airplane action rogue like game, where every colorful level is built on top of the previous one, all the way up to the stratosphere. Welcome to Granaria, a flying city in the clouds. Meet Amelia - a young pilot and fisherwoman wishing to reach the abundant worlds edge.

name: Candy Mandy
short_description: Classic game in the popular 'three in a row' genre.

name: cross board soccer
short_description: 14 balls soccer !!!

name: Re:DESTINY
