name: Deadly Premonition 2: A Blessing in Disguise
short_description: Deadly Premonition 2: A Blessing in Disguise is an open-world survival horror video game serving as both a sequel and prequel to the original Deadly Premonition: The Director’s Cut.

name: Goodbye Deponia
short_description: More chaos, more destruction, more Rufus. Not one, not two, but three Rufuses cause all kinds of crazy mayhem in the long-awaited adventure comedy Goodbye Deponia!

name: The Trail: Frontier Challenge
short_description: Are you ready to discover the undiscovered? Are you ready to climb the tallest mountains, wear the finest clothes, and earn a fortune beyond compare? Then welcome to the New World! Welcome to The Trail: Frontier Challenge!

name: Hyperventila
short_description: An adventure filled space fantasy RPG with a teambased multiplayer mode. Set out into the galaxy and make a name for yourself or join your friends online in a game of social deduction.

name: Zombie Derby
short_description: Zombie Derby is a small 3D racing action in the world of zombie apocalypse.

name: vrkshop
short_description: vrkshop is a VR woodworking game. You are challenged to build projects with hand tools without snap-to-guides or limits on how to cut or fasten the lumber. The precision of your project is left entirely up to you. Have fun. Be productive.

name: My Lil Horror
short_description: Just a basic puzzle solving/survival game. Kill zombies, have fun, get to the end without dying! Updated versions may include more weapons, extra chapters, and more.

name: Crappy Climber
short_description: Use your mouse to flick and navigate your character through a Highly difficult and unforgiving Climb. . . You will fail miserably, multiple times... So just Git gud! Or tell your friends you couldn't finish it.

name: SPACE-FRIGHT
short_description: SPACE-FRIGHT is a cute stealth horror game.

name: Never give up!
short_description: Someone is killing half-bloods (half-elves, half-humans) in a small city. The protagonist, a young half-blood girl called Mia Silverlight, falls into a whirlpool of events.

name: GUILTY GEAR
short_description: The origin of the series, the abnormality of the fighting game genre, now returns... HEAVEN or HELL？LET'S Rock！

name: planktOs
short_description: Dive into an explorable water world where Elders are mysteriously being trapped in crystal prisons. The freedom of the elders depends on a single naive little spirit to explore and find a way to release them.

name: Island Saver
short_description: A group of amazing islands need your help! Horrid plastic waste has washed up and you need to sort it out with your trusty Trash Blaster! But look out for the Litterbugs. They love mess and they’re out to muck things up.

name: Forgotten Fields
short_description: Forgotten Fields is a cozy narrative game about Sid - a struggling writer who travels back to his childhood home one last time before it's sold off. Visit old friends, relive memories, solve puzzles and play through sections of Sid's book in this warm game about nostalgia and the passage of time.

name: The Haunted Island, a Frog Detective Game
short_description: You're a detective, and a frog, and it's time to solve a mystery.

name: Super Match! The Ultimate Matching Game
short_description: Fun and addicting physics-based matching game!

name: Marshmallow Tank
short_description: A tank simulation game，with cartoon style，battle royale，destory everything you can see!

name: Cultures - Northland
short_description: The Vikings are back! Get this RTS classic!

name: Rising Star 2
short_description: Start a band, and take on the world in this music industry simulation/role-playing game. Success doesn't come without hard work, and making connections in your local music scene is the only path to stardom.

name: Rhyme Storm
short_description: Rhyme Storm is the world's first freestyle rapping rhythm game! It's packed with awesome beats, hilarious topics, and mind blowing visuals that dance and pulse to your performance. You won't be asking if you can freestyle rap -- you'll be wondering how fast you can go!

name: Lands of Pharaoh: Episode 1
short_description: Lands of Pharaoh is a multi-camera-angle based adventure game. The hero, Heragos, tries to get to Cairo in order to find the messages, related to his divine duty, left for him by Nefertiti.

name: Reincarnated As A Monster
short_description: Reincarnated As A Monster is an RPG game that you became a monster and try to survive in a fantasy world. Uncover the truth about the world, and make your choice to help or destroy others. Of course, it will affect the story's ending. The battle is not just lost or win, but you can also escape from battle!

name: I am Weapon: Revival
short_description: Have you ever faced your worst nightmare? What if you have no choice but to move on and see what’s behind it? Then you’d better arm yourself with a couple of big guns, stock up on ammo and show them all what a real nightmare is!

name: Picross Beach Paradise
short_description: Get ready for a romantic journey! 120 fun griddlers await you inPicross Beach Paradise!

name: Demon Cycle
short_description: Demon Cycle is a casual strategy game, where luck favors the prepared. You have limited turns to make enough coins to pass the floor. Your choices will determine the outcome.

name: Fold
short_description: Fold and expand blocks until only one of each color remains in this original puzzler.

name: I, Cyborg
short_description: Outfly, outshoot, and outwit your enemies as an outlaw cyborg on the run! You're a cyborg copy of Ypsilanti Rowe, the interstellar outlaw, whose enemies (and exes) are gunning for you. Can you upgrade your brain and pull one last heist?

name: School of Dragons
short_description: Fly fast, train hard, and learn well to become the Ultimate Dragon Trainer! Join Chief Hiccup and Toothless and embark on the thrilling adventures of DreamWorks Animation’s ‘How to Train Your Dragon’. Play with your friends and explore mysterious worlds in this action-packed learning experience!

name: Genius Calculator
short_description: Genius Calculator is a game that will challenge all your math skills and turn you into a real human calculator.

name: Pukan Bye Bye
short_description: Created to enrage.

name: Konrad the Rocket
short_description: Konrad the Rocket: A hardcore platformer inspired by Orwell's 1984 and jetpacks.

name: Battle For The Sun
short_description: Battle for the Sun is an action-packed, first-person shooter documenting the realities of war seen through the eyes of a special forces soldier in a world under alien attack. We find ourselves abruptly thrown into an adventure as a talented soldier carrying out his duty in this epic war.

name: VIRUS OF SURVIVORS:LIFE SIMULATOR
short_description: VIRUS OF SURVIVORS:LIFE SIMULATOR is a brand new simulation game, where you can explore the human body and fight against viruses and infections .The game begins on the emergency class, where a sick man lies, who waiting for a medicine of vital… You will be the medicine capsule which can redound the healing, and you enter into the human...

name: Idle Expanse
short_description: A sci-fi themed incremental game which allows you to expand your capitalistic empire across the galaxy! Hire mercenaries to pillage alien planets for resources, with the singular goal of making as much money as possible as quickly as possible! Totally not a playful commentary on real Terran society.

name: LOGA: Unexpected Adventure
short_description: A Classic fun beautiful platform game that is made to challenge you with more than 30 levels

name: UBERMOSH
short_description: UBERMOSH is an arcade game about cutting bullets with a sword, in a gun-filled cyberpunk mosh pit.

name: Battle Support
short_description: After the end of the third world war, most of the countries in the world have completely fallen. Coupled with bad weather, there is a shortage of supplies around the world. Everyone wants to build their own army independently to capture more supplies and expand more areas. Rule the world.

name: Dark Pathways
short_description: You wake up in your cell, but this time the door is open and strange creatures will chase you across amazing worlds. You have to look for objects and tools scattered in the labyrinth that can be used to finally stop this threat. Only then you can come back to the peace of your cell.

name: Sensorium
short_description: Sensorium is a small open-world puzzle game about the 5 senses: touch, taste, sight, smell, and hearing.

name: Trivia Vault Basketball Trivia
short_description: Welcome to the Trivia Vault contestant! Play as a contestant in a gameshow called Trivia Vault Basketball Trivia and bring your thinking hat. Answer Basketball trivia questions as quickly as you can, the faster you answer the higher the cash value.

name: PuckOFF
short_description: PuckOFF is a seriously unforgiving hockey goon simulator missing one thing: rules. You can do whatever it takes to win a game and you have different ways to do so; you can either outscore or outlast your opponents. Except lots of cheap shots and opponents who won't hesitate to put you down.

name: Nice Shot! The Gun Golfing Game
short_description: Golf meets FPS in this unique twist on the beloved golf genre. Use a variety of guns and your skills & finesse to rack up bonus points and come in under par! But beware-- this is one golf game that won't hold your hand! Unlock courses and a secret gun in single player, or play against your friends in multiplayer!

name: TRIDENT BARRAGE
short_description: A shooting game, in which the hero is taken from the modern world and flung into a fantasy world. Use weapons such as assault rifles and magic.The key to conquering this game is to be able to properly use the 3 different properties of fire, ice, and lightning.

name: Battle High 2 A+
short_description: The fast-paced fighting action of the Battle High series comes to Steam! Face-off in the tough halls of San Bruno High for the Elementally Advanced as 14 students (and 1 insidious faculty member) and discover the secret behind the mysterious illness stripping students of their powers!

name: 8-Bit Armies
short_description: 8-Bit Armies is a retro Real-Time Strategy game. With a colorful, blocky voxel art style, 8-Bit Armies is Petroglyph's most fast-paced, friendly, and accessible RTS game to date. Featuring a campaign of 25 single-player missions, 12 co-op missions, multiplayer and skirmish modes.

name: Animals Memory: Underwater Kingdom
short_description: Animals Memory: Underwater Kingdom is a card game with images of various underwater animals that will test your memory. The aim of the game is to find pairs of cards.

name: Tank Hero VR
short_description: Come and enjoy the Tank VR journey!!!

name: Slime Jumper
short_description: Slime Jumper is a cool Jump 'n Run somewhere between Super Mario and Super Meat Boy with nice, direct controls. You can buy different slimes with stars collected while playing the levels.

name: Broforce
short_description: When evil threatens the world, the world calls on Broforce - an under-funded, over-powered paramilitary organization dealing exclusively in excessive force. Brace your loins with up to four players to run ‘n’ gun as dozens of different bros and eliminate the opposing terrorist forces that threaten our way of life.

name: Pixel bomb! bomb!!
short_description: Long time ago, there was a beautiful Queen in Leroy Forest. The Queen was very narcissistic. She dressed up splendid every day and thought she was the fairest woman in the Forest. Every beautiful girl in the kingdom would lose good looks by the Queen's curse.

name: Kenshō
short_description: Restore the balance of nature.

name: Battlefield™ 2042
short_description: Unleash the unexpected with Battlefield™ 2042 – Season 1: Zero Hour. Battlefield™ 2042 is a first-person shooter that marks the return to the iconic all-out warfare of the franchise.

name: Knockdown the Ball Twice
short_description: Meet the most annoying ball rolling game!

name: Midnight Caravan
short_description: Midnight Caravan, a richly illustrated choose-your-own-adventure with an unique narrative arc set in an age renowned for its shadiness, where nothing is only what it appears to be.

name: Trap Them - Sniper Edition
short_description: In this puzzle shooter you take the role of a sniper. Collect all the crystals without getting caught by the RoboTTech robots. Be smart about shooting down the environment to shape it to your needs and guide the crystal collector safely through the caves.

name: lightblue
short_description: An ancient legend, a shattered family, an exorcist priest. Embrace the crucifix, have faith in the Lord and face the evil inside lightblue.

name: AUTOCROSS MADNESS
short_description: Driving a muscle car on edgy cliffs?! Sounds like a bad idea... But actually it's quite fun! Car physics will make the game-play control easy, but hard to master!

name: Hollowed
short_description: Hollowed tells the story of a woman who will do anything to bring her perished loved one back to the world of the living. Control Halia and her spirit Oco simultaneously on a single controller in this side-scrolling puzzle platformer.

name: Marble Mage
short_description: Dash and roll your way through 60 fast-paced levels to try and find the way back home after a magic exam goes wrong, leaving a young mage stranded in a strange dimension. Marble Mage offers classic marble-rolling platforming with a unique twist: Charge up and release to blast off in any direction!

name: Attempt[42]
short_description: Challenging first person puzzle platformer.

name: 动绘（Drawing）
short_description: Drawing is a brand new video puzzle game, where you can experience the excitement and happiness brought by artworks.

name: Gunlocked
short_description: A twin stick shooter without the twin stick, Gunlocked is a sci-fi action roguelike about careful positioning and upgrade selection. Manage unique targeting systems across multiple weapons and upgrades, as you battle legions of alien ships, and then do it all over again!

name: LesLove.Club: Emily and Sarah
short_description: A relaxing puzzle game for lesbians. Love is Love!

name: Agtnan: Monster Shutdown Sequence
short_description: You're an escaping robot in a retro sci-fi world using warp tubes, portals, conveyor belts, bombs and more to keep your circuits intact for another day.

name: Fist of Physics
short_description: Punch a robot in the face! Robots are running wild in San Francisco. Fight through multiple rounds against different opponents to save the city. Fist of Physics uses Midas’ VR physics to let players literally reach out and touch their opponent. Every response and movement looks real.

name: Force of Nature 2: Ghost Keeper
short_description: Force of Nature 2: Ghost Keeper offers incredible adventures full of mystery, danger, exploration and magic. This game combines the genres of Survival, Sandbox, Action, Adventure, RPG, Strategy and Resource Management

name: Where's My Horse? An Escape the Room Adventure
short_description: Experience an at-home Escape Room adventure! Find secrets, solve puzzles, and open locked chests to help you solve the mystery- where did your horse go?

name: MinSweeper
short_description: MinSweeper is a minimalist take on the classic Minesweeper. Simple relaxing game play in which you avoid mines on a puzzle board and try to get the best time. MinSweeper also includes 3 minigames

name: Thy Sword
short_description: Thy Sword is a hack n' slash platformer with procedural levels and roguelike elements. A world of Sword & Sorcery awaits!

name: Seed of Life
short_description: Seed of Life is an epic adventure game about the persistence of life. You're Cora, the last known survivor of Lumia, a dying planet. Your only hope to save your homeworld is to activate the Seed of Life and rekindle the sun once again. Will you be the light that conquers the darkness?

name: 破坏效应
short_description: 《破坏效应》是一款融合了MMO和MOBA双玩法的游戏，暗黑式ARPG英雄乱斗、立体地下城对战、非对称式英雄阵营、自定义动作技能，开启不一样的战场体验。力求让玩家体验最没有束缚的乱斗快感，从一场战斗开始，你无所不能，异世英雄，即刻乱斗上场！

name: Flowers -Le volume sur hiver-
short_description: Suoh finally uncovers the the truth behind Saint Angraecum Academy in this emotional conclusion to the Flowers visual novel series.

name: Daedalic Complex
short_description: Daedalic Complex is an adventure, RPG, dungeon-crawling game with elements of storytelling and harsh survival. In this game, a player is required to find an exit for each stage by means of meeting certain conditions while surviving unforgiving level-designs and combats with hideous monsters.

name: Vinyl Reality - DJ in VR
short_description: Master the art of DJing in VR! Learn how to mix tracks like a pro using two accurately recreated vinyl turntables and a fully-featured DJ mixer with intuitive controls. Import your music collection and stream live from several audio reactive environments or build your own using the SDK.

name: Gun Club VR
short_description: Take to the range with an arsenal of the world’s most powerful weaponry in Gun Club VR. Addictive gameplay and unsurpassed realism combine to make Gun Club VR the ultimate virtual weapon simulator. The only thing missing is the smell of the gunpowder.

name: Shadows on the Vatican: Nightingale
short_description: Writing on a blog and using her obscure ability, the mysterious Nightingale has been helping people in danger for years. Now, she’s forced to disappear, facing threats from a killer... one of those people she helped in the past. An interactive short story featuring an advanced navigation UI.

name: Tale of Ninja: Fall of the Miyoshi
short_description: Play as a ninja through the Sengoku period of Japan. There are many possible ways to assassinate the target and find your own nindou.

name: Star Explorers
short_description: Explore a randomly generated galaxy in your own spacecraft: land on planets, encounter aliens, find resources, upgrade items, delve into caves, map out and document different systems and worlds, seek a new home for the human race.

name: Cursed House 10 - Match 3 Puzzle
short_description: Solve tricky Match3 levels, play bonus games and lift the curse!

name: The Deed II
short_description: Can you commit the perfect murder? Outside a brothel in 1930s Paris, a man recognises one of the orderlies who had cruelly abused him while he was in a mental asylum. Some deeds cannot be forgiven ...

name: Mindframe Arena
short_description: Lead your Tec team on an epic journey through the worlds of Mindframe Arena

name: Witches' Legacy: The Ties That Bind Collector's Edition
short_description: A stranger reveals Edward's past.

name: Song of Memories (Complete Scenario)
short_description: A next generation romantic adventure game with a story focused on songs and ultimate decision-making. In addition to a massive scenario that takes place in an academy, this game features over 40 hours worth of voices played by an all-star cast of voice actors.

name: BAD END THEATER
short_description: select your protagonist and explore a variety of terrible fates!

name: She is Mermaid
short_description: Tired of your normal city life? Maybe it's instinct, maybe it's science, but nature is calling Hiroto back to his rural hometown! Little does he know that his childhood friend has somehow gotten herself turned into a... mermaid!?

name: Lemma
short_description: Immersive first-person parkour in a surreal, physics-driven voxel world. Every move can modify the environment. Surfaces pop in and out of existence at will.

name: Desecration of Wings
short_description: The Endless Court is eternal, ruled by Immortals who have guided the four races of the world since the dawn of time. But they seem very concerned with preventing anyone from studying the broken ruins that litter the world, and peace is more fragile than it seems.

name: Attack of the Labyrinth +
short_description: The forces of evil have invaded the land. A labyrinth of evil has appeared in the kingdom and legions of monsters are pouring out of its vile depths. The king has called upon a small party of heroes, the Champions of Virtue, to vanquish the demon within and free the land from a grim fate!

name: Spy Chameleon - RGB Agent
short_description: Spy Chameleon RGB Agent is a challenging arcade-puzzle game where the player needs to avoid being spotted thanks to the color-changing mechanisms of the main character.

name: OK Bob
short_description: OK Bob is a short atmospheric escape room game. Find clues, read notes, and solve puzzles to ultimately make your escape. OK Bob was created exclusively for VR.

name: The Island of Eternal Struggle
short_description: The Island of Eternal Struggle is a turn-based jRPG adventure where four outcasts battle malicious wildlife, topple a corrupt empire, and battle powerful deities in an attempt to save the world.

name: Tower of God
short_description: Turn-Based Action RPG

name: WISGR
short_description: A game that takes place on the planet WISGR. The Darkness emerged after years defeated by the light . A young man named boghe tries to save his planet that will be ruined.

name: Sacrificial Lighthouse
short_description: You are a girl called Maya who ends stranded in island with a lighthouse during a storm. What is this strange place? How did she get here? What to do next? Explore this small island and lighthouse to understand what happened to Maya.

name: Lost Contact
short_description: LOST CONTACT is an exciting realistically designed space station shooter. As the main character of unflinching Nil Heard you will experience soul grabbing horrors of facing the mutant monsters of the Universe.

name: Ball Grabbers
short_description: Two-player Arcade mayhem in tight arenas - Toss the ball to your opponent's goal before they get the chance!

name: jingor 2048
short_description: PLAY 2048 IN THE CUBE EXPANSION(JINGOR FACE)! RULE:Move the mouse in the jingor face and press the arrow keys to move the number until 2048 appears. Of particular interest is the addition of numbers across an edge in the jingor face.

name: Struggling Ball
short_description: Struggling in lots of different levels which are challenging and beautiful.

name: Shmups Skill Test シューティング技能検定
short_description: Some say you’re only as old as you feel. Shmups Skill Test says you’re only as old as you shoot! Shmups Skill Test is a clever way to evaluate your shmup skills in the form of a 'gamer age'. Challenge and unlock shoot-’em-up-based minigames in a gauntlet of shmup nostalgia goodness.

name: SUPERHOT
short_description: SUPERHOT is the smash-hit FPS where time moves only when you move. No regenerating health bars. No conveniently placed ammo drops. It's you, alone, outnumbered and outgunned. Snatch weapons from fallen enemies to shoot, slice and dodge through a truly cinematic hurricane of slow-motion bullets.

name: SAVE THE SCHOOL FLOWER ACTION
short_description: One day, the campus flower of XX University spent a night. When she opened her eyes, she found herself on a strange military base. She was looking about for her way home. All I can see are mutants walking around outside. And then, somehow, you were transported here,

name: Animation Throwdown: The Quest for Cards
short_description: Family Guy, Bob's Burgers, Futurama, American Dad, and King of the Hill join forces in Animation Throwdown, your favorite new collectible card game. Collect your favorite characters, combine cards to make hilarious combos, and battle your way through an adventure of animated proportions.

name: Filthy, Stinking, Orcs!
short_description: Place towers and man the weapons in this tower defense VR game to defend against a horde of Filthy, Stinking, Orcs!

name: Tooth and Claw
short_description: VR title for use with the HTC Vive. Player vs Player gameplay. Steam Achievements.

name: Christmas Rampage
short_description: Christmas Rampage is a 2D twin-stick shooter game. A fun adventure of Rudolph v2.0 in a shooting rampage eliminating evil Santa and his minions from ruining the spirit of Christmas. May the spirit of good buffs and useful weapons be with you in defeating Santa's diabolical creations and minions!

name: AntQueen 3D
short_description: Experience a game where you live through the cycle of an ant colony. You can dig your own tunnels, organize your colony, customize your army, but you need to survive every wave of attack!

name: Still Model 3
short_description: · A simulation bondage art, and beautiful models appointment, together with the photography game.

name: Super Star Blast
short_description: Super Star Blast is a space based game with challenging levels of increasing difficulty. All enemies must be shot down to finish a level and go to the next one. A scanner around the player tells roughly where the enemies are located.

name: INDICTED
short_description: 'INDICTED' is a first-person psychological horror game exploring the fears of Arthur, a police investigator with a dark past. With immersive graphics and environments, and a touch of horror from the 80s and 90s. Thus bringing a unique experience of horror and survival.

name: The Pillar
short_description: Welcome to The Pillar! Escape room game leading throughout mystery islands. Solve dozens of puzzles in the first-person adventure.

name: XOMBEE MPFPS
short_description: Single or Online Multiplayer First Person Shooter

name: Maize
short_description: Maize is a first-person adventure game about what happens when two scientists misinterpret a memo from the U.S. Government and create sentient corn. And that last sentence is pretty much the least ridiculous thing about the game.

name: Convicted Galaxy
short_description: Stranded in an unknown galaxy full of escaped prisoners who grow stronger with every passing moment. Build a space station, upgrade your ship, and dogfight your way out of the galaxy. Take risks when necessary, but don't forget that you only have one chance.

name: Happy Z-Day
short_description: Today is supposed to be your daughter's birthday, But something happened in this town. Almost everyone has turn into a Monster. You need to protect your daughter and her birthday party!

name: Teddy Floppy Ear - Kayaking
short_description: Based on a famous Polish cartoon, Teddy Floppy Ear stands out as a great entertainment for children. Prepared by an experienced team, Teddy Floppy Ear – Kayaking mixes fun adventure game with a healthy dose of learning, perfect for young minds. Send your kid onto an unforgettable journey with the world’s most charming bear.

name: Spice Road
short_description: Strategy, trade and empire building on the old Silk Road. Spice Road is a town building, social and economic simulation game full of original challenges.

name: HORROR TALES: The Wine
short_description: Explore a post-pandemic fictional Mediterranean island and confront your fears! Immerse yourself in a seemingly abandoned city and struggle to find a precious Banydebosc red wine bottle to cure your loved ones. But be aware; your Nemesis is hunting you. Indie Jumpscares included! :D

name: Block King
short_description: Blast the floor out from under your opponents' feet to send them to their doom; before they do the same to you. Will you risk an early loss to grab the power up and gain an advantage?

name: Tiny Bubbles
short_description: Play with squishy clusters of soap bubbles in this mesmerizing physics puzzle game. Winner of over a dozen indie gaming awards!

name: Snow Island
short_description: Snow Island is a one small hold & Gun, boss Rush mini-game of Casual difficulty.

name: Krautscape
short_description: Krautscape is an action-packed racing game with bird-like flying cars and procedurally built racetracks.

name: Gone In November
short_description: Coming home after visiting your doctor for the last time, you are told that you only have three more days to live. A sequence of short memory fragments flashing through as you try to run away from what you have done.

name: Battle of Heroes 3
short_description: The hero acts as a mercenary who is sent to the border of the kingdom. Use combat and magic skills, explore the fantasy world, develop a hero and warriors, towers, aura, magic, weapons. Explore and create magical items. Grow a dragon or a cerberus.

name: Gunfire Reborn
short_description: Gunfire Reborn is a level-based adventure game featuring FPS, Roguelite and RPG. Players can control heroes with various abilities to experience diverse Build gameplay, use various weapons to explore procedurally-generated levels. You can play the game alone, or join 4-player coop.

name: Million on Mars: Space to Venture
short_description: Million on Mars delivers the most realistic Mars city-building MMO experience. Granted 40 acres of real Martian terrain, shop for rovers, energy systems, & factories to begin production on Mars. Leverage your skills and rovers, prepare your settlement for the arrival of the initial 20 Martians.

name: Star Trek™ : 25th Anniversary
short_description: Beam aboard the USS Enterprise to join Captain Kirk and his intrepid crew in this classic adventure game. Eight original missions, each styled as episodes of an imagined fourth season of Star Trek: the Original Series, featuring the voice talents of the original actors!

name: SAMOSBOR 2D
short_description: 'SAMOSBOR 2D' is a side-shooter platformer in which you have to shoot a lot of enemies at the levels of a huge building.

name: POLAR
short_description: Are you a target? or not?The target mode, one of the polar game modes, brings a different perspective to survival.If you are a good player, you can survive in a minute without dying.

name: Survivor Squad
short_description: Survivor Squad is a Strategy Action game where you control a Squad of up to four survivors and guide them through a highly randomized world looking for supplies to aid you on your journey.

name: Totally Convenient
short_description: Experience the most inconvenient way to serve customer in this brain-melting multi-tasking eye-hand coordination game! Use your sharp reflexes and your deep concentration to throw delicious food at demanding clients in 70 overwhelmingly tense levels!

name: Crystal Reign
short_description: Battle hordes of woodland creatures, strategically place weapon towers across the landscape, enter your weapon tower and unleash a rain of fire on your enemies, and annihilate your enemies with your ultimate attack in hand-to-hand combat!

name: Slobbish Dragon Princess
short_description: After discovering a strange, lizard-like being on the side of the road, things start to change for Takeru. And wouldn’t you know it, that lizard was actually the princess of the dragons! Now begins their bizarre, yet down to earth daily life.

name: Emergency 2016
short_description: There's no shortage of action in EMERGENCY 2016. Command firefighters, police, technical relief forces and paramedics in all new emergencies. With a brand new vehicle and large scale events, you'll take on rescue missions like never before!

name: Citizen Sleeper
short_description: Roleplaying in the ruins of interplanetary capitalism. Live the life of an escaped worker, washed-up on a lawless station at the edge of an interstellar society. Inspired by the flexibility and freedom of TTRPGs, explore the station, choose your friends, escape your past and change your future.

name: Darkwood
short_description: Darkwood - a new perspective on survival horror. Scavenge and explore a rich, ever-changing free-roam world by day, then hunker down in your hideout and pray for the morning light.

name: Fairy Fencer F Advent Dark Force
short_description: Long ago, a war raged between two powerful deities. Each was sealed away, their weapons scattered throughout the world. Our hero in this RPG, Fang, happens upon one such weapon and now he alone must choose which deity will awaken again!

name: Cinnet
short_description: An endless night in a house infested with demons in first person!

name: DREAMO - Puzzle Adventure
short_description: The plane crashed, bringing an abrupt end to your journey. You regain consciousness in a strange lucid dream filled with interactive cube puzzles, where a mysterious voice guides you through the changing landscape. What is happening? Who are you? Do you have what it takes to wake up?

name: The Blight
short_description: The Blight aims to evolve the open world survival with unprecedented levels of horror, strategy, and prediction, where knowledge and skills become the ultimate weapons for long-term survival.

name: Warlock's Tower
short_description: A punishing puzzler with elegantly designed levels around one brutal rule - one move equals one life lost.

name: Jurassic Attack
short_description: Jurassic Attack - is a dizzy 3D shooter with surviving and hardcore elements during the Jurassic period. The main point of the game includes that you will have to survive among bloodthirsty lizards having minimal resources.

name: The Journey - Episode 1: Whatever This Is
short_description: The first step that you never knew you needed to take to get to wherever you're wanting to go...

name: Capcom Arcade Stadium
short_description: Relive the Capcom classics! Get 1943 -The Battle of Midway- and game logo wallpapers free with your download!

name: Mortal Kombat X
short_description: Experience the Next Generation of the #1 Fighting Franchise. Mortal Kombat X combines unparalleled, cinematic presentation with all new gameplay.

name: Saint Kotar
short_description: Saint Kotar is a psychological horror detective game set in a cursed valley in rural Croatia. Investigate the disappearance of your relative in the occult-ridden town of Sveti Kotar as you switch between conflicting realities through the eyes of two godly men.

name: DuelVox: Max Quality
short_description: DuelVox: Max Quality is an offline first-person shooter made in western style. In this game there are many levels with different tasks, to complete them you will need ingenuity and dexterity, and sometimes even strategy.

name: Master Spy
short_description: Throw on your invisibility cloak and put your reflexes to the test in this brutal precision platformer brimming with espionage, intrigue, and betrayal! Featuring an Original Soundtrack by Grammy Award Winner RAC.

name: Orn the tiny forest sprite
short_description: Beautiful levels and a lovable hero take the spotlight in Orn the tiny forest sprite, a 3D side-scroller inspired by both classic and modern platformers.

name: Overcoming Pain
short_description: Do you like weapons and ammunition? Do you like action? Do you like adrenaline in the blood and crowds of enemies?

name: Star Command Galaxies
short_description: Star Command Galaxies is the ultimate starship simulator. Become Captain and recruit your crew, build your ship, explore a randomly generated universe and battle alien ships across the galaxy.

name: Project CARS 2
short_description: THE ULTIMATE DRIVER JOURNEY! Project CARS 2 delivers the soul of motor racing in the world’s most beautiful, authentic, and technically-advanced racing game.

name: Virage Rally
short_description: Virage Rally is a rally racing game with procedurally generated stages.

name: Color Sudoku
short_description: A colorful new way to play your favorite game, this Sudoku variation must be filled with colors instead of numbers.

name: LASTFIGHT
short_description: LASTFIGHT is bringing 2v2 3D fighting back to your living room! Pick up any available object in one of the 8 stages and teach your opponents a lesson! Play in local multiplayer mode, for up to 4 players, or one-player story mode, with a cast of 10 characters inspired by the comic book LASTMAN.

name: Blue Angels Aerobatic Flight Simulator

name: Pharaoh + Cleopatra

name: Keita's Adventures on the African Savannah

name: DinosaurIsland

name: Gem Legends

name: Riddles of Fate: Into Oblivion Collector's Edition
short_description: The seven deadly sins have plunged peaceful Riddlestone into chaos! Rescue the royal family and save their people from destruction.

name: Mr. Dubstep

name: PhyxBox

name: Return home

name: Puzzle - STONE BLOCKS

name: Lisssn

But instead of having only to look closely and to combine, this one is especially about hearing and listening closely.

name: Kingdom Rush Origins - Tower Defense
short_description: Command your elven army and defend mystical lands from sea serpents, evil sorcerers, and wave after wave of gnoll tribesman, all with the help of brand-spankin’ new towers, heroes, and spells to fend off every last baddie.

name: The Virtual Reality Museum of Immersive Experiences

name: Llama Villa
short_description: The simulation game with Llamas!

name: Hidden Town

name: Gogte

name: Strategic Command WWII: War in Europe
short_description: Strategic Command WWII: War in Europe is a deeply immersive turn based strategy game covering the greatest conflict in modern history!

name: The Blind Prophet
short_description: A point'n'Click adventure game. Resolve mysteries and fight the Great Evil.

name: Virtual Desktop
short_description: Virtual Desktop is an application developed for the Oculus Rift / Rift S, HTC Vive, Valve Index and WMR headsets that lets you use your computer in VR. This app is NOT for the Oculus Quest. You can browse the web, watch movies, Netflix or even play games on a giant virtual screen.

name: OVIVO

name: FEMINAZI: The Triggering

name: Nyasha Land of Elves

name: Hardcore ZBoy

name: Road Z : The Last Drive
short_description: Drive your way through hordes of zombies in an arcade repetitive game to collect hardware and upgrade your vehicles. You can add turret, flamethrower and nitro bottle.

name: Dexterity Ball 3D™
short_description: Dexterity Ball 3D is an unconstrained, physics and skills based platform game, which can be played in three modes. There is no convoluted back story or adventure included. Your goal: collect all the gems as fast as possible. Are you ready to be challenged?!

name: Logic World

name: OmniBus
short_description: OmniBus is next-to-last gen physics game about the most powerful bus in the universe that can’t stop or even slow down for reasons incomprehensible to the simple human mind.

name: Post War Dreams
short_description: POST-WAR DREAMS is a 2.5D Story-Rich, Side Scrolling Action Game, set in the wasteland of USA, plagued with constant war.

name: CANNON
short_description: CANNON is a minimalist puzzle game made with cannons that shoot balls to destroy cubes. Activate the cannons in the right order to destroy all number cubes in the scene.

name: Kindred Spirits on the Roof
short_description: During lunch one day, Toomi Yuna meets two 'Kindred Spirits' on the roof of her school. When they insist she help them nurture young love, Yuna finds herself playing 'yuri cupid' to six unique and adorable couples. Can she remain aloof or will the promise of a 'yuritopia' reach her too?

name: ESC
short_description: An interactive novel about identity, roleplay, and dreams.

name: Escape from hospital
short_description: You have to get out of a hospital filled with zombies. In the course of the passage, you need to inspect all the places so as not to miss something important. A large arsenal from knife to flamethrower, but a limited amount of ammunition will make you think about their consumption.

name: Castles

name: Castles

name: Imperium Galactica II

name: Order No. 227: Not one step back!
short_description: Be a brave soldier! Immerse yourself into the harsh world of merciless battles!

name: Crystal Story: The Hero and the Evil Witch
short_description: An evil witch has stolen the Crystal of Power. It’s up to one brave hero to save the world... by hiring mercenaries to do the job for him. Play as the members of Mercenary Inc as you explore randomly generated dungeons, battle fierce monsters, and collect loot in this 2.5D turn-based RPG.

name: A Collection of Bad Moments
short_description: A Collection of Bad Moments is an adventure game where the player discovers themselves in various tough situations and must use their wits to figure a way out! The moments vary from a deadly asteroid mission and mysterious virtual reality simulation to an airship duel!

name: Card City Nights

name: Hover Ship

name: Planet TD

name: Super Ninja Hero VR

name: Heretic Operative

name: Auto Battle Royale
short_description: Kill or run away, and the last survivor is the winner!

name: Through The Fragmentation
short_description: Atmospheric first person adventure game focusing on immersion and exploration. Meet strange characters, discover secrets and try to unfold the mystery of the Fragmentation.

name: Pearls of the Oceans
short_description: Together for the Planet! Evade and outsmart the many dangers of the oceans, collect the Pearls to save the World. Stay on your toes through 100 handcrafted levels and challenge yourself to climb the leaderboard and prevent the war to begin.

name: Venture Valley
short_description: Be Your Own Boss!

name: Trenchlore
short_description: Enter Daqul, a vast oceanic trench teeming with alien lifeforms. Dive your way through various biomes, meeting strange creatures and dangerous enemies... all the way to the very bottom.

name: 《Curse of disaster spirit : Anecdotes of mansion》
short_description: Enter the weird adventure game of exploring in the haunted old house. In the game, you will encounter all kinds of weird and weird events. Search for clues scattered around the room and explore the hidden truth in this old house step by step.

name: LIBERTY VR
short_description: LIBERTY VR is an action adventure game, taking place in alternative version of American Revolution. Main protagonist is the American soldier who is fighting against evil created by ancient alien race.

name: DoraKone
short_description: Follow along with the adventures of Dulce as she finds new friends, new fun, and maybe even romance in the world of Dragon Connection, a hot new augmented reality mobile game.A, short, sweet free all-ages GxG visual novel featuring cute girls, friendship, and romance!

name: Let`s not stay friends
short_description: Friendship is a wonderful thing… unless you are friends with a girl who has no idea you have feelings for her! Inske, a student of magical arts, is troubled by the upcoming outdoors exam, and can't even imagine that someone might want to use the test as an opportunity to get close to her.

name: LoveChoice
short_description: 'What is love?' We try to answer that with this game. The game encourages people to have a warm, soft, and understanding heart.

name: Survive Together
short_description: Survive Together is a 2D world simulator where players are thrown into the many perils of nature, and together, overcome them to build a thriving empire.

name: MIGHT
short_description: MIGHT is a team arena brawler with fun and fast-paced combat. Choose from many different classes, each with their own unique style. Classes are easy to pick up and play but mastering them is harder.

name: Wathitdew Record™ Game Studio BATTLEFIELD

short_description: Pug with Bomb is a game in the genre of the Bomberman series, where the player uses bombs to make his way to collect keys and destroy enemies, simultaneously finding bonuses from blown up wooden walls, which can make it easier for him to play or vice versa to kill.

name: The Last Cube
short_description: Cube puzzler and an epic adventure. Stamp stickers to the sides of your cube to imbue each surface with unique powers, which are vital to solving puzzles and finding secrets.

name: Desert lost
short_description: This is a third person action game,Players are surrounded by monsters,Players are free to explore the surrounding area.Players must avoid monster attacks or kill them to survive,Watch out for the monster leader. It's very dangerous.

name: Flying Angel

name: Landing
short_description: Conquer gravity and land a rocket on the platform. And over and over again. But conditions will change, and the path is not always clear.

name: Absurd Chess
short_description: Compete against up to 100 players in various, REALLY absurd chess modes never seen before! You will have to adapt to new rules and develop your own tactics that will allow you to dominate the board.

name: Selma and the Wisp

Play over 100 variants, including Klondike, FreeCell, Spider, Canfield, and Golf. Embark on a expedition or play individual games. Unlock new backgrounds, card backs, and decks as you play.

name: Wind Angel Ⅲ

name: Samurai Jack: Battle Through Time

BONUS: 3 Additional 'Last Half' Games included FREE!

name: Romance of the Three Kingdoms VII with Power Up Kit

short_description: Big Buck Hunter will bring the arcade experience to your living room with this fast paced, addictive arcade shooter! The all new control and aim mechanics will make this a must pick up and play arcade shooter experience.

name: Un Pas Fragile

name: Might of the Stones

name: To Battle!: Hell's Crusade
short_description: Classic, old-school, turn-based battle in a satirical medieval world. Raise a Holy Army and stop the march of Evil.

name: PixelJunk™ Nom Nom Galaxy
short_description: Welcome to SoupCo, Astroworker! In Nom Nom Galaxy, construct and automate gigantic soup factories on unexplored planets throughout the universe, harvest flora and fauna to turn them into artisanal soups, and rocket your product into the gullets of the galaxy!

name: ZhanDou (VR and Non-VR)
short_description: Developed by KX Games, Zhandou is one of the first MOBA style games available on VR and Non-VR platforms. Along with Zhandou's unique theme, playable characters, environments, and fighting system, Zhandou will be the first game based on ancient Chinese civilization and mythology. The game is considered 'early release'

name: Apogee: Apex of War
short_description: First and third person single player sci fi action shooter. Destroy the Neurobonded menace and prevent humanities extinction.

name: Bubsy: The Woolies Strike Back
short_description: Watch Bubsy glide like a bat, jump like a jack rabbit, bounce like a red rubber ball and run…run Bubsy run. This is the Bubsy adventure you were born to play.

name: Devil Engine
short_description: A last ditch effort to destroy what was once to be our savior. A final mission to eliminate a disastrous future. A single ship against Earth’s entire military. The Andraste is the only hope to defeat...the Devil Engine.

name: The Cherry Orchard

An eccentric aristocrat and her friends try to sort out her debts so that she isn’t forced to sell her beloved cherry orchard, but there’s just one problem: she doesn’t understand the value of money at all.

name: Soldier Front 2
short_description: Across any terrain, with any weapon, against any opponent—the war must go on! Test your prowess with modern first-person shooter action in intense warzones ranging from labyrinthine urban locales to dusty desert battlefields. The gear, combat, and settings are designed to create an exceedingly realistic and fast-paced style of gameplay.

name: Last Warrior
short_description: In this game you will be able not only to plunge into the middle ages, to feel as a brave warrior, but also to have a good time.

name: Tipping Point
short_description: Tipping Point is an immersive, photorealistic adventure game with challenging puzzles and a satisfying story filled with drama, humor and unexpected plot twists. Original music, lifelike characters, animals and scenery all come together to create a cinematic experience.

name: GROW: Wild West
short_description: GROW: Wild West is an interactive cartoon, that tells us about events occuring in a small town in wild west. Become a mayor and lead the development of the town and follow the story in the best traditions of a spaghetti-westerns of the last century. Fates of the residents of a small provincial town depend on you!

name: Awakened
short_description: In this indie horror game dubbed - Awakened, you'll be playing sidescroller levels, first person view 3D environments, top down stealth levels, puzzles and more. You see, it's a series of minigames within the game and they're all tied together by a growing and riveting storyline that'll entertain you, challenge you, scare you, and keep...

name: PixHunter
short_description: There can't be any left! In PixHunter you must shoot down all enemy aircraft you encounter during your missions. But be careful! They will become stronger and more trained. Be precise and dodge enemy fire!

name: OlliOlli2: Welcome to Olliwood
short_description: Drop in to Olliwood and prepare for finger-flippin’ mayhem in this follow up to cult skateboarding smash OlliOlli.

name: Atelier Totori ~The Adventurer of Arland~ DX
short_description: The second release in the Arland series. In a search for her missing mother, Totori tours the world of Arland as an adventurer accompanied by her friends. Use Synthesis, Explore, and Battle to fulfil requests, raise her rank as an adventurer and venture into brand new lands.

name: Test Tube Titans: Taster Trial
short_description: Take on your friends in a chaotic physics-based wrestling match using giant monsters that have been procedurally mutated to be unique every time you play. Or, craft a custom titan and take it for a walk through the neighbourhood, tearing up everything as you go!

name: Sweety Little Witch
short_description: Sweety Little Witch is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.The game is perfect for relaxing.

name: Tales of Lagoona 3: Frauds, Forgeries, and Fishsticks
short_description: Return to Lagoona at the bottom of the sea for a new Hidden Object adventure! Poseidon Park is in trouble once again as the latest repairs have gone horribly awry. Mayor Finn has disappeared and Leona and Theo are desperate to save the park.

name: Lab.Gen.
short_description: It is Labyrinth! No, a LOT of labyrinths which always will be different because of procedural generation. And what about controls? They are simple. Left, right, up and down – that’s all you need to know.

name: MARSUPILAMI - HOOBADVENTURE
short_description: Discover the Marsupilamis as you have never seen them before in an adventure full of surprises!

name: Kiya
short_description: Kiya is a five minute virtual reality piece telling the story of two sisters valiant but unsuccessful efforts to try to rescue their third sister, Kiya, from a deadly attack by her ex-boyfriend. Using two separate recorded calls to emergency workers, the experience puts the viewer on scene as the tragic events unfold.

name: 3 on 3 Super Robot Hockey
short_description: 3 on 3 Super Robot Hockey, how hockey should be played. No rules. Just smash, bash, and trash your opponent and score!

name: Aefen Fall
short_description: Aefen Fall is a first-person parkour fantasy game. Run, jump and use your alchemical powers in a DieselPunk world to reach your goal as quickly as possible. Your abilities, your freedom.

name: OverKill
short_description: A fast paced top-down shooter made with Game Maker. Customize your robot with weapons and specials. Fight your way through 4 different stages against hordes of ever changing enemies.

name: Aquarius
short_description: Aquarius is a 90's style arcade game where you play as a cave diver in search for treasure, guarded by the ocean's fiercest predators and its cuddliest minnows. Navigate through the caves, collect the treasure, and survive!

name: Earth 2150 Trilogy
short_description: Your heroes and your armies will need strong leadership to take them on a spellbinding odyssey that has everything a gamer’s heart could wish for breathtaking worlds in space, battles against cunning enemies and even downright treason from your own government faction - are you up to it?

name: Tiestru
short_description: Tiestru offers a new perspective to strategy games. The player has control all over the map and defines his strategy with the structures that he builds. Each structure, each connection, each location offer new and enhanced powers. In this deep and complex game everything is up to you! Define your strategy!

name: Super Hyperspace Avenger
short_description: Super Hyperspace Avenger is an endless scroller-shooter inspired by classic arcade games with tons of bullets and enemies.

name: Blink God
short_description: You must climb to the top of the world using a unique teleport called Blink. so... do you like bungee jumping?

name: DEX : Speed Run - Level Maker - World Records
short_description: Play together with the leader, take the first places, create levels in this action platformer! New levels every day

name: Dark Haunting
short_description: A multiplayer co-op horror game.

name: Ancient Journey VR
short_description: It is the first museum in the world from where you can set out for a trip to ancient times. It's the only occasion to admire ancient buildings, search through Egyptian temples, see under your eyes the beauty of Japan and feel the atmosphere of ancient temple in India.

name: Dream Knights
short_description: Dive into colourful and surreal dreamscapes in a traditional 2D side-scrolling platformer. Master different skills to help you traverse and battle your way through a horde of strange enemies.

name: Warplanes: WW1 Fighters
short_description: Become a pilot! Immerse in WW1 aerial combat like never before in a captivating VR experience. Be a pilot during the Great War in Warplanes: WW1 Fighters. No matter whether you prefer arcade games or flight simulators – a variety of options will let you adjust the game to your preferences.

name: Oftalmogarden
short_description: Oftalmogarden is a fast and chaotic roguelike sci-fi eyeball monster shooting game. Shoot your way through hordes of enemies, collect upgrades, weapons, and gadgets to grow stronger, but accumulate curses over time. Speed is your best ally to survive, the sky is watching and death will not wait.

name: Kaiju Big Battel: Fighto Fantasy
short_description: Giant monster mayhem! The evil Dr. Cube has used a forbidden weapon to tear apart time and space. It's up to the Kaiju Big Battel Heroes to travel through time and set things right! A turn-based RPG from the makers of C. Kane.

name: Life Tastes Like Cardboard
short_description: A game about boredom and self-pity. It's about myself mostly. You walk around and press the 'interact' button. Sorry for making this.

name: Cargo 3
short_description: Cargo 3 is a futuristic action game set in science-fiction horror world, which links the best features of the genre: unusual dynamics and thrilling high intensity of the gameplay.

name: LISA: The Painful
short_description: The miserable journey of a broken man...

name: Defend Your Buttress
short_description: Defend Your Buttress is a simple game. You defend your wall to your dying breath. Why? I don't know... Because the evil stick-man want to break your wall and kill you. For some reason.

name: Make Sail
short_description: ﻿Make boats and sail them. Survive an ocean of storms and beasts to find better pieces to make your ship bigger, faster, stronger, prettier, stranger, wilder: more yours.

name: Riders of Asgard
short_description: Riders of Asgard is a fun and challenging Viking BMX game. Unlock new maps and items to upgrade your Bike and Rider, and access previously unreachable places. Riders of Asgard features a full single player campaign as well as local multiplayer to take on your friends!

name: I'm from area 51
short_description: I'm from area 51. There are hundreds like me. My task is to kidnap cows. Work is not dusty and pay a lot. Millions of people are coming to us soon. So I flew to the farm of an old man to steal his cows without any problems, but something went wrong.

name: Teslapunk
short_description: An arcade shoot-em-up with a retro science-fiction theme.

name: 明途之境
short_description: Mysterious Land Of Finding Yourself is a turn-based rogue-like independent game imitating real-time It tells the story of people in some other worlds being sent by an indescribable existence to a secret realm composed of multiple worlds for trial.

name: Princess Evangile W Happiness - Steam Edition
short_description: It's a new Princess Evangile, with nine new love stories! Includes the original common route and a route for all nine heroines!

name: Dragon Boar and Lady Rabbit
short_description: help Lady rabbit to recover the carrots, through her I think Lady Rabbit will be able to find the carrots, you will have to recover them all.

name: It Could Have Been Me
short_description: A journey from Afganistan to Sweden. Experience 26 documentary stories and 5 surreal worlds in VR. Rap from Emilia Carapic (Bac Nini)Voices from experiencers during the Night of Culture in Lund, where over 80 people tried the experience:'The coolest thing I've seen!

name: C14 Dating
short_description: C-14 Dating is an otome dating sim that combines archaeology, friendships and love.

name: Maguntsche: Chapter One Remastered
short_description: Darkness closes in fast on the town of Macungie, Pennsylvania. Explore the depths of the Realmverse and put a stop to the Superior's demonic forces. The Maguntsche Demon is on the hunt. Will you be able to stop this entity once and for all? Or will it find new victims to take in your place?

name: Super Catscape
short_description: Super Catscape is a 2D sidescroller retro platformer about Kim, a brave kitten who is abducted by strange alien creatures. Kim has to find a way to escape from the strange alien planet, saving all captive pets in his way back to Earth.

name: Toverblade
short_description: A magical deck-building strategy game. Train your heroes, explore a dangerous world, and overcome enemies such as wolves, giants, and ice golems on your way to a mysterious fortress.

name: Time Drifter
short_description: Drift your way through time to save humanity from an evil panda.

name: Perraw - FPS Clone War Alpha
short_description: Perraw is a FPS multiplayer/Tower Defense placed in an futuristic environment Developed in free time as a hobby. WARNING: THIS GAME IS EARLY ACCESS ALPHA.

name: Starters Orders 7 Horse Racing
short_description: Starters Orders 7 is the latest in the acclaimed horse racing management series from Strategic Designs Ltd. New features include in-depth breeding stats and lineage, realistic dynamic commentary, newspaper style race and form cards, new racecourses, old-school style betting shop race modes and more.

name: Snowballer
short_description: Reminisce your youthful days, or just be actively malicious in this bloody serious, fast-paced First-Person Snowball Fight / Sled Racing Simulation. Sandbox elements: Build your own snow forts, simulate NPC battles, Survival challenges and Time Attack Downhill Racing

name: RollerCoaster VR Universe
short_description: Virtual Reality Roller Coasters: Visit dinosaurs forest, medieval castle, space, underwater, horror, micro-world and city environment.

name: 1/2 Red Riding Hood
short_description: There is this girl known as the Red Riding Hood. She has the strength of ten men. This is a completely different story about the familiar fairy-tale character Red Riding Hood. A much darker and twisted version.

name: Physics Cake
short_description: Physics Cake is a 2-D physics simulation game where you can draw containers, objects, or anything you want really and put whatever chosen physical object you want inside of it.

name: Casual Challenge Players Club- Anime Bilhar game
short_description: If you like anime and pool, then this game is for you. Play the story mode or have fun playing with your friends and family.

name: Darkness Rollercoaster - Ultimate Shooter Edition
short_description: The ultimate rail shooter in this corner of the Galaxy !

name: Metis One
short_description: Metis One is an action-packed co-op top down shooter in the design style of the arcade classics. Take command of the A6-Gravitus to defend the people of Jupiter Colony, Metis One, against an unrelenting alien onslaught. With Drop-In Co-op, Player Two can join the action at anytime!

name: Monsters of Little Haven
short_description: At the heart of the action are a twelve-year-old Kenneth and his younger sister Esme, children of the Murphy family, who hit the trail of a mysterious monster following series of entangled events.

name: Synthrally
short_description: Synthrally is a local multiplayer arcade sports game with simple, fast-paced action. Choose from an array of selectable classes, map variants, and alternate play modes to mix things up and keep gameplay exciting!

name: Yet Another Level
short_description: I’m a high-school student and this is my first trial experiencing in game design. Yet Another Level is a 3D dungeon adventure game where the map is procedure generated. As you play along and explore treasures, you’ll surprisingly found out all the weapons or abilities are based on Urban Dictionary (Agglomerate etc).

name: Heart of Enya
short_description: A 2D narrative-focused strategic RPG with visual novel elements. You play as Willow Wisp, a campfire spirit who guides a group of amateur adventurers in harnessing the warm magic of self love to fend off the Frost that surrounds them.

name: Anetona
short_description: Embark on a quest across a multi-era world against humans, creatures and machines in order to rescue the princess from the evil red dragon.

name: Darkened Glory
short_description: Darkened Glory is an epic fantasy action game where each player fights for glory of a darkened age in a mythical land.

name: Alchemist's Castle
short_description: Fight your way through the dungeons of the Alchemist's Castle, collect power ups and take back what is rightfully yours from the Alchemist himself in this old-school metroidvania!

name: [Chilla's Art] Okaeri | おかえり
short_description: Okaeri is a VHS Japanese psychological horror game about a middle school girl and her mother who recently moved to a new house.

name: The Old West Savior
short_description: In this game you play as the sheriff in a beautiful pixel art world, save the town and all the old west from the bandits and become The Old West Savior!

name: Mickey Storm and the Cursed Mask
short_description: Welcome to the world’s greatest waterpark! In this resort full of wild adventures and thrilling waterslides only you, and your sister, can stop the evil Dr. Fisher! Jump, slide and rush through a series of challenging 2.5D water slides to take him down!

name: No Lights
short_description: Survive in countless levels and search for the lights.

name: Wardens of the Amber Cage
short_description: A cooperative action dungeon crawler. Support Virtual Reality headsets. Become a warmage and keep the horrors inside the Amber Cage !

name: Olympus Griddlers
short_description: Help the Gods of Mount Olympus to decode ancient scrolls and become a hero of the legends of Greece!

name: HueBots
short_description: HueBots is a deceptively challenging top-down puzzle game. You control a team of colorful robots that will only interact with objects that match their color; they will also keep moving in one direction until they collide with something that matches their color.

name: Break Space: Out of Bounds
short_description: Break Space: out of bounds is a game that will bring 80's nostalgia to today's modernity! Control a spaceship and prevent the Terran nation from being enslaved by the Marthians

name: Wormhole City
short_description: Wormhole City is a sci-fi adventure game with run-and-gun mecha combat and interactive cyberpunk environments. You must interact with your surroundings to achieve your objectives and progress throughout the game.

name: Alien Shooter 2 - New Era
short_description: A desert, an abandoned city, cramped underground corridors of MAGMAs research centers, and for hundreds of kilometers around there is only darkness and thousands of monsters coming from all sides. You have only two options - to achieve your goal or die.

name: Titan shield
short_description: Titan Shield is turn-based combat tactical game. Lead your party into the depths of the Titan's hold to deal with its owner.

name: House of Rules
short_description: Congratulations! You're hired as a new waterer in Black Kiwa. Water the plants, and we'll pay you 30 G per hour. You'll never find any other job this generous. No, we're not hiding anything from you. If you just follow the work protocols and stay out of trouble, everything will be fine.

name: Diamonds
short_description: Pick up diamonds as they fall from the sky, shoot enemies to make them drop the diamonds they've gathered, and bring the spoils back to your base to win.

name: Red Spider3: A Heroine Never Dies
short_description: Red Spider 3: A Heroine Never Dies is a H Kong Noir style Visual Novel.ボイス総収録時間12.9時間！同人ゲームオブ・ザ・イヤーにて【主演女優部門】【熱部門】【泣き部門】【作曲部門】の4部門にノミネート！

name: Fishing Sim World®: Pro Tour
short_description: Fishing Sim World: Pro Tour features an authentic career mode where you work your way up to an elite angler competing against over 100 of the best anglers in the world across Bass, Carp and Predator fishing whilst unlocking sponsorship opportunities, gaining career earnings and social media followers as you go.

name: The Last Conflict
short_description: The Last Conflict is a 2-D multiplayer online action and strategic based game inspired by classic games Resident Evil, Silent Hill, and Zombie Ate my Neighbors, bringing them together to create a fun zombie killing experience.

name: Poly Bridge 2
short_description: The acclaimed bridge-building indie-hit is back! More levels, more features, more physics fun!

name: Dormant World
short_description: A retro NES/Famicom-inspired platformer, Dormant World leaves the fate of the world in the player's hands. Can you single-handedly defeat the gods of sleep and save the world from endless slumber?

name: Viscera Cleanup Detail: Santa's Rampage
short_description: Tragedy! Santa; the toy giving folk-hero, and purveyor of fine Christmas goods, has had enough. Endless requests from greedy children wanting more and more every year, tax increases, pressure from elf unions, bills, reindeer!

name: The Yellow Quiz
short_description: The Yellow Quiz - a fun multiplayer game for parties that turns your smartphone into a wireless game controller.

name: Species: Artificial Life, Real Evolution
short_description: Play with evolution! Species: ALRE is a scientifically-grounded, emergent simulation of natural selection. Creatures evolve and speciate in response to in-game mutation and selection forces, allowing you to experience and tinker with evolution in real-time.

name: Brimstone
short_description: Take control of a sinner to enter a trial to prove you are worthy to fight the mythic Brimstone. Travel through 3 different zones and kill each zones boss to gain the power of the demons. Fight and fight again until you have the power to kill the Brimstone.

name: 12 Labours of Hercules IV: Mother Nature (Platinum Edition)
short_description: The legendary hero Hercules and his wife Megara are back, ready to embark on their next adventure! The Gods are outraged at their defeat and have summoned a fearsome beast who can match Hercules's god-like strength.

name: Story of the Survivor : Prisoner
short_description: Story of the Survivor is an action RPG that takes place during a zombie apocalypse. The world is dead and now there is no one to stop you from escaping the Prison.... or is it? Follow the story of Steve and his prison mates as they try to make their way to freedom.

name: MOAI 5: New Generation Collector’s Edition
short_description: Powerful magic is at your fingertips as you prepare for a ceremony that will protect your island home! Guide the young twins Hika-Ri and Kao-Ri as they go their separate ways on a journey that will culminate in a once-in-a-lifetime experience!

name: Who wants to strip this babe? Streamer Girl
short_description: The combination of the well-known TV show with the best genre of games on earth.

name: The Signifier Director's Cut
short_description: This story-driven adventure follows a mystery of death and despair from reality into the surreal realms of objective memories and subjective experiences. Search the mind, solve puzzles, and unravel the dark truth in this psychological thriller.

name: Cyber Ops
short_description: Become a military hacker and help your black ops team reach their goal in this noir cyberpunk tactical game. Scan, hack, overtake, control and manage high tech devices, vehicles and even enemy cyborgs with cutting-edge implants.

name: Seasons With Furry
short_description: A puzzle game where you need to assemble a complete image from several pieces.

name: Refreshing Sideways Puzzle Ghost Hammer
short_description: New System Game, Sideways Puzzle! Let's release ghosts from Blocks!

name: 神舞幻想 Faith of Danschant
short_description: A 3D ancient and fantasy RPG console game is created by Beijing Joyfun. Users will have a fabulous adventure and start their own legend in a fictional world based China’s traditional mythology.

name: Metro Sim Hustle

name: Pleasure Puzzle:Workshop 趣拼拼：拼图工坊
short_description: The best jigsaw puzzle jigsaw workshop, super simple operation to create your Jigsaw to share with the whole world! The picture is released in the form of free DLC.

name: Cherry Tree High Girls' Fight
short_description: Cherry Tree High Girls' Fight is a strategic turn-based card battle fighting girl raising simulator where you play the role of the new coach in the circuit. Train your team to become #1 among all of the rival schools!

name: Divine Favor
short_description: A man wakes up in Heaven.

name: A Night With Gigsjaw VR
short_description: A VR Survival Horror game set in a decrepit out of commission restaurant. Survey the cameras and your surroundings, conserve and recharge your power, and whatever you do... Do NOT let them in your room.

name: Victorian Admirals Marianas Incident 1887
short_description: A steam-ship period naval combat games focusing on fleet-scale battles in real time. The naval combat game allows you to set up battle squadron groups, their formations and management, with realistic ship models and characteristics, as well as advanced ballistic and weapon models

name: Märchen Forest
short_description: This is the story of a young girl and her magical adventure.

name: Crying is not Enough: Remastered
short_description: Crying is not Enough is a Third-Person Survival Horror Game.The player has to face enemies, using weapons and other survival mechanisms. He has to solve various puzzles and make progress by slowly unfolding the story.

name: Anime Bubble Pop

name: Confusing game

You will follow a path from the start until you reach the CDC which holds the man who can make the cure, the aliens who made the virus, and you.

name: Color Knight
short_description: Color Knight is a first person perspective action game with a unique color based combat system. You enter an open island in order to destroy color crystals and earn currency - color shards. Spend them on ship's upgrades, then go again on land. Every time different experience.

name: WORLD OF PARANOIA
short_description: WORLD OF PARANOIA is a management game where the player controls a supercomputer that is in charge of governing an utopia.

name: Hop Step Sing! Kisekiteki Shining! (HQ Edition)
short_description: Enjoy a front row ticket to a performance by Japan's newest idol group: Hop Step Sing! Niina, Mikasa and Shikiri will sing and dance their way into your hearts in this, an immersive VR experience of their debut single: 'Kisekiteki Shining!'.

name: Snake Charmer - TPS Snek
short_description: Amazing 3D adventure of the snake, Snek, who has been dumped by his girlfriend, because he was too small. now he's eating his way to find true love!

name: Commander '85
short_description: 13 May 1985: Today is my BIRTHDAY!!! Mum gave me the best present ever! a Commander 85 – a super modern computer with real artificial intelligence! It’s very smart, and I can talk to it and play games on it. I can’t wait till the other boys see it!

name: Super Zombie Arcade
short_description: Take on the zombie horde in this post apocalyptic crazy adventure. This game gets more and more difficult and crazier zombies spawn when player reach higher levels. Unlock new weapons by reaching higher levels. How many can you kill? How long will you last? watch out for the runners

name: SHOCK TROOPERS 2nd Squad

name: Starship Tunnel

You wake up in unknown surroundings to the sound of the Game Master’s unfamiliar voice, surrounded by five others. A third of your group have been infected with a virus, but who will escape?

name: Breaking Blocks
short_description: An exciting 2D action platformer in the vein of arkanoid.

name: Jesus Christ RPG: Lucifer
short_description: Finally the long awaited prequel to Jesus Christ RPG is out! Play as Lucifer, the devious dark angel, in this retro arcade styled four-directional shooter.

name: FOOD FACTORY VR

name: Zombie Quest
short_description: Top down survival RPG. Customise your character, follow the trail of quests, search for loot, craft ammunition and collect, recycle or trade your objects with other players to survive.

name: Ride 'em Low

name: Drawn Story
short_description: Play as an artist looking at a painted world. You're able to create new items in this world by simply drawing them. Use your own imagination to lead a stickman character through a variety of puzzles by drawing things he can use. There’s always a few ways to solve each puzzle.

What will she do when she is alone? What strange stories will happen in the process, and in the process of exploration, you may find some strange secrets....

name: Aim God

name: Race The Sun
short_description: You are a solar-powered craft. The sun is your death timer. Hurtle towards the sunset at breakneck speed in a futile race against time. Delay the inevitable by catching speed boosts which reverse the setting sun - if only for a moment.

name: Incredible Dracula 3: Family Secret
short_description: Save Dracula from the unspeakable horror of pesky relatives in this thrilling new adventure! With colorful graphics, challenging missions, and a storyline full of laughs, Incredible Dracula III: Family Secret goes for the jugular and hits the funny bone!

name: Bad animals - rabbit

name: Gear of Glass: Eolarn's war

name: 初颜 - The Prototype
short_description: Find yourself becoming Masato Gu - a desperate young physicist, and try to discover the truth about a lab accident five years ago in which you lost your love, with the Time Machine! But before that, will you succeed in clearing an unjust murder charge before running out of time…?

name: LX Patterns
short_description: How smart are you? The ability to recognize patterns is used to measure intelligence. LX patterns is a puzzle game in which you have to identify different patterns while listening to a relaxing soundtrack.

name: 祈風 Inorikaze

name: The Tiny Tale 2

The Troll and his fellow Gremlins must find the remaining holy shrines scattered around the kingdom to heal the cursed one and banish the Necromancer.

name: FireSquad

You will need to manage the fire spread, break through doors and windows, search for survivors and rescue them to safety before the fire becomes unmanageable and the building collapses.

name: Bocce VR

name: Wrestling Empire
short_description: The lightweight champion of wrestling comes full circle with higher resolution visuals and a smoother frame rate - whilst still retaining the retro style that puts the fun first!
