name: Electric Sleep
short_description: Electric Sleep is a pixel art interactive story. Explore a crumbling world through the perspective of different emotions.

name: Butsbal
short_description: Fast Pace Shooter

name: The Far Frontier
short_description: The Far Frontier is a combination of two popular game genres: match 3 and strategy. While playing, two players fight using a shared match 3 area. They must use tactics and strategy to win.

name: Rise of Humanity
short_description: Battle enemy bots, plan your strategy to complete missions, collect, upgrade and merge powerful cards to save humanity in this tactical turn-based game!

name: CAR DESTROYER
short_description: Car Destroyer is a pixel racing arena that will make you fight in ruthless wastelands.

name: Bionic Hunter VR
short_description: Hunt down Monsters in a Sci-Fi Horror Survival Shooter and test your Skills among other players! Live an immersive experience with latest generation graphics.

name: VR SHOOT AROUND - Realistic basketball simulator -
short_description: VR SHOOT AROUND is a 'Simulater of basketball shoot around' that will provide you fantastic physical calculations, fantastic sounds and a fantastic rich court.

name: The Indestructible Moxy Boxy
short_description: Heal and reload by inhaling defeated enemies in this precision, twin-stick shooter. Solve action-oriented puzzles and explore an adorably violent world, in a thoughtful story - told through shoebox dioramas.

name: The Magnets
short_description: The Magnets is a logic puzzle game.

name: CyberRebeat -The Fifth Domain of Warfare-
short_description: Enter the world of hackers where Hiro and Misa must uncover the circumstances behind a mystery arson attack on a company that may be tied to the legendary hacker 'Warlock'. What will they uncover in their pursuit of the truth? A visual novel that brings the world of hackers to life!

name: AIRA VR
short_description: You believed tower defense is only about building towers? That's not quite right – because AIRA VR is not like other tower defense games in virtual reality. Once the battle starts you find yourself in the midst of the fight!

name: Bob's Cat Challenge
short_description: Oh no! The cats have gotten loose - and it's up to our hero, Bob the Yeti, to collect them all!

name: Slordax: The Unknown Enemy
short_description: In this classic top-down shoot 'em up, fly the deadliest ship in the galaxy on a dangerous first-strike mission to annihilate an alien threat before they become too powerful to stop. Pick up upgrades from fallen enemies along the way and become an unstoppable force!

name: Fishing: North Atlantic - Enhanced Edition
short_description: Commercial fishing in North Atlantic! Discover majestic world of Canadian Nova Scotia while admiring the vast diversity of ocean life. Search for the ocean gold with upgradable fishing boats and various fishing gear as you progress in your fisherman career.

name: Havsala: Into the Soul Palace
short_description: Havsala is an investigative puzzle game with rich storytelling full of historical references and mysticism. Search the room for the clues left behind by the previous reincarnations of a single soul, solve the puzzles and unravel the mystery.

name: CITY WARS: TOKYO REIGN
short_description: CITY WARS: TOKYO REIGN takes the customisation and strategy of a traditional CCG and introduces a dynamic battlefield where tactile mechanics and turn-based battling combine. Choose a FACTION, build a COMBAT CASE and take to the streets.

name: Tumblestone
short_description: Tumblestone is the first original action-puzzle game of the past fifteen years -- completely reinventing the genre into a deep and cerebral puzzle solving experience that you won't forget.

name: Huedango
short_description: This game is intended to be simple and easy to play to pass time. Inspired by 90s hand-held consoles. In this game you select an egg to hatch and take care of one of the many creatures. If you keep your creature alive long enough it will eventually mature.

name: Canary in a Crater
short_description: Canary in a Crater is an asteroid-delving 2D platformer about digging deep, uncovering valuables, and fighting off hungry alien snails. Spend your hard-earned credits on a wide variety of unlockable gadgets and upgrades to get you deeper and deeper!

name: Koliseum Soccer VR
short_description: Koliseum Soccer VR is the most epic game of table soccer in VR. Also called Babyfoot, Foosball or Kicker, it is one of the most iconical arcade game ever. We recreated the gameplay that everyone knows but with a twist. Now you can dribble your way to the goal, manage to keep a clean sheet when 3 balls are on the pitch... and many more!

name: Train Mechanic Simulator VR
short_description: Take your chances as a real train mechanic in VR. Find locomotives in need of help and repair them in one of the 3 workshops located in a vast open world covering the area of over 6,000 acres. You will face all kinds of damages in all sorts of trains: diesel, electric and even old-school steam units

name: Puzzle Monarch: Zombie
short_description: Solve 15 sets of ancient puzzles and unlock your way to the bottom of the tomb. Each set contains a three by three and six by six puzzle. To move on to the next level you will have to solve both puzzles and journey deeper into the tomb.

name: A Case of Distrust
short_description: A Case of Distrust is a narrative mystery from 1924 San Francisco. Play as private investigator Phyllis Cadence Malone in this historical 2D adventure game.

name: Breaking Wheel
short_description: Breaking Wheel is a sidescrolling 3D platformer. You control a wheel and have to collect as much coffee and coins as you can in more than 50 unique levels with a plethora of interesting gameplay mechanics.

name: Mixed Estate
short_description: Mixed Estate is designed to bring solution for you to be confident in purchase.

name: Supesu 2
short_description: Immerse yourself into the atmosphere of endless universe by puzzle game Supesu 2.

name: AmIHero
short_description: Be the master of all sports!! Meet hermit masters and receive absurd missions to succeed!!!

name: Pleiades - A Subversion Saga Game
short_description: A sci-fi, horror, thriller, mystery and conspiracy fps.

name: The Oath of The Dark Magic Queen
short_description: Deep inside a forest, a voice calls out to the hero. It is there that he crosses paths with Omaylas, the Dark Magic Queen. Imprisoned in the forest, she offers to swear an oath to the hero in exchange for her freedom, but is there a secret agenda to her actions?

name: A Curse From Beyond
short_description: A text-based cosmic horror adventure game

name: Galaxy Control: 3D Strategy
short_description: Build your base and battle with other players to control the galaxy! Galaxy Control is an ultimate space combat strategy game with fast-paced combats! Gather minerals and extract uranium, defend your base with laser towers, missile turrets, cannons, walls and mines.

name: StroodleDoodle
short_description: StroodleDoodle is a fun 3D World-Building and Modeling Tool for Virtual Reality where Everything is 3D Printable! Make your ideas reality.

name: Quarres
short_description: Quarres ('squares' in Middle French) is a 2D puzzle in which your goal is to match the tiles in your board with the pattern on a sample board.

name: Raubritter
short_description: Ready for a medieval survival experience? You want to build but also fight? That is a game for you. You have been robbed from your title and lands. Survive in the dark forest, rob merchants, burn villages, build a camp, gather a fearsome band and reclaim what is rightfully yours!

name: Hyposphere Z
short_description: Hyposphere Z is a retro cyberpunk 3D puzzle platformer where you control a sphere, collect coins, solve puzzles and overcome obstacles by jumping or dodging them.

name: Lost Saga NA
short_description: Part fighter, part brawler and made from pure awesomeness, Lost Saga is an action-packed beat-em-up styled game that will take your skills and push them to their max! Switch from over 60 heroes on the fly, letting you create an endless amount of combos!

name: COVID - 19 BIOHAZARD
short_description: Are you ready to get the vaccines and survive the virus ? Covid 19 Biohazard is a first person shooter game based on level progresion were you have to find the vaccines and get to the exit before the time ends, but beware the Viruses will try to take you down.

name: Quantum Flux
short_description: Quantum Flux is an old school style rogue-like following the Artemis. A prototype vessel aiming to save humanity from destruction, to do so it must find a way through a difficult and hostile universe to create a new home for the human race.

name: Noah's Ark
short_description: Noah has been commanded by God to put two of each animal aboard his ark to save them from the flood.

name: Fish & Bubbles
short_description: Purchase fish, feed them to collect coins, upgrade your tank and Zen out in... 'Fish & Bubbles'! Updates will be released regularly, stay up to date on our Steam posts, or join our Discord!

name: Million Arthur VR: Character Command RPG
short_description: A tale of one million Arthurs vying to be the one true king. The vivid world of 'Million Arthur' comes alive with amazing VR graphics - jump into the fray with flashy card battles against mighty foes!

name: BallClimbing
short_description: Spin, jump, go to the top of the mountain.

name: Bridge! 3
short_description: In Bridge! 3 you have the opportunity to build your bridges and their carrying capacity to the utmost! Let your creativity run as a bridge builder and take the challenge to prove yourself as a true master of bridge building.

name: El Hijo - A Wild West Tale
short_description: El Hijo is an exciting spaghetti-western stealth game, in which you guide a 6-year-old boy on his quest to find his mother.

name: Red Black Poker
short_description: Red Black Poker is a modern remake of the classic game of video poker. With crisp vector graphics and a simple interface, this extremely addictive game will keep you entertained for hours. Red Black Poker simulates a casino video poker machine. This game doesn't require real money to play.

name: Dark Dimensions: Homecoming Collector's Edition
short_description: For years, Barton Mansion sat abandoned, a haunting reminder of an obsession gone wrong. But something sinister still lurked there...and it's stirring.

name: Engine Evolution 2020
short_description: Engine Evolution is a multiplayer racing game that uses similar principles as World of Tanks - with each PvP race, against 11 other players, you gain experience and credits, for which you can buy various upgrades for your bike, or unlock the next bike.

name: By Any Means Necessary
short_description: The 2D RPG where you can't use items in battle. Follow Captain Yusef and his team on their quest to find the source of the monster spawning portal in this turn-based RPG.

name: Nijowari: Where Angels Fall
short_description: Nijowari: Where Angels Fall is a rich, kinetic visual novel with two main characters, each one with its own story and its own life. Follow our hero's steps in this daring mix of plot-driven and slice-of-life visual novel with heavy character development and hard-hitting special effects.

name: Dark Parables: Queen of Sands Collector's Edition
short_description: Team up with the Red Riding Hood Sisters to defeat the nightmares!

name: Hektor
short_description: Experience terrors only madness can conjure in HEKTOR, a psychological horror game set in a world that literally moves with your every twist and turn.

name: Devil fight
short_description: This is a third person role playing action game,The player acts as a demon, surrounded by monsters,Players are free to explore the surrounding area. Players can kill monsters or avoid the attacks of monsters. Players need to keep their health as long as possible.

name: City of Ages: Picture Supportive Text MUD (server and client included)
short_description: Two windows apps come with your purchase! A Text MUD Server [and its VB6 code] SQL support and admin commands. The client plays sounds and shows your pictures and connects to the server on port 23 [optional] or one of two dynamic ports [set now to 4000/4001].

name: BRIKS 2
short_description: BRIKS 2 is a classic retro arcade game with animated characters, animated backgrounds, boss monsters, power-ups and custom music. Collect bonuses and power-ups and power your way through over 100 new levels and unlock hidden levels.

name: Vagante
short_description: Vagante is an action-packed platformer that features permanent death and procedurally generated levels. Play cooperatively with friends both locally and online, or adventure solo in this challenging roguelike-inspired game.

name: Fate Seeker
short_description: Fate Seeker is an original action role-playing PC game developed by JSL ENTERTAINMENT. You play as “the Chosen One”, destined to change the universe. Wonder freely in countless main storyline, and challenge yourself to solve mysteries, master martial art and nurture friendship or even true love.

name: DEBUFF
short_description: Nine fantasy heroes await your leadership in single player campaign, multiplayer battles and raids and last but not least, killing football game! Gain experience to level up, assign skill points, purchase bonus buffs to fight DEBUFF. Oh, and don't forget to kill Hellga!

name: Solitaire: Learn the Flags!
short_description: A combination of using flashcards for learning with the classic card game Solitaire.

name: Goddess Of Card War
short_description: 'Goddess of Card War' is a card game with classical Chinese graphics.

name: Ghost Exile
short_description: Ghost Exile - is a cooperative horror from 1 to 4 players: when hunting for ghosts, you need to determine the type of ghost, carry out a ritual of exorcism and then the ghost can no longer harm anyone. Be careful! Hasty conclusions can lead you to a sad outcome.

name: Don't Shoot Rabbit / 不要射中兔子
short_description: Don’t Shoot Rabbit is a mini game, as my first completed game product. Though I didn’t provide English UI support, it won't be too difficult to understand how to play it. One round may take 3-5 minutes to play, to win all trophy it may take 0.5-1 hour, or maybe more. Compete with your friends, win a high score, and play fun!

name: Escape from Covid
short_description: Escape from Covid is a fun and exciting platformer. Guide your character through a contaminated world in which you have to escape the virus. Fight challenging bosses.

name: Fury Unleashed
short_description: Shoot your way through the pages of an ever-changing comic book in this fast-paced roguelike. Play solo, in local or online co-op, expand your weaponry, and upgrade your hero with each run. All that to find out why has your creator lost his faith in you and to prove him wrong.

name: Shadowy Contracts
short_description: Shadowy Contracts is a stealth and RPG hybrid, where the player can go on contracts to kill targets for gold. The gold can be used to hire and lead mercenaries into battle, and/or use the gold to purchase weapons and potions.

name: The Inevitability
short_description: The main hero of the game was alone. All of his family died. He continued to cling to the life... but Death... seems trying to pick him up... Throughout the game something have been chasing and wants to send you to the other world to meet his family... and as if you were trying to hide it finds you...

name: Rikki & Vikki
short_description: Puzzling Action for One or Two Players.

name: Hot Squat 2: New Glory
short_description: Welcome back to Flynn Fitness! Prepare for an intense leg workout with this overhauled squatting experience. Compete to do as many squats as you can, create your own custom workout routines, unlock flashy cosmetic items, try out a brand new exercise, and more...all while supporting charity!

name: The Growth Journey
short_description: A game about tactical growth, where growth is irreversible.

name: Hidden Valley Tower Defense
short_description: Hidden Valley TD is a tower defense with rogue-like elements offering many different strategies. Built towers, upgrade magic, and gather artifacts to see how long you can last against waves of undead minions!

name: Shopkeeper Simulator VR
short_description: Manage your own shop in this VR tycoon game! Buy delicious items and sell them at a profit. Unlock helpful equipment to reach the end of the day. But beware of thieves who grab your money when you're not looking!

name: Disaster crisis/灾难危机
short_description: 《灾难危机》主要讲述外来生物人入侵地球，为解救快崩溃的世界，你将扮演幸存者、战士等角色，从安德烈亚斯城市开始，在冒险的旅程上解决阻止这场外来生物人入侵地球的大灾难。你将组建英雄的队伍，在地图上升级刷怪，购买搜刮最强武器装备，带领他们完成艰巨的任务，直到打倒最后的幕后敌人。

name: Snood
short_description: Forget Life, Play SNOOD!

name: Libertad o Muerte!
short_description: Libertad o Muerte!, the wars of independence of the Spanish Colonies is a turn-based game in 19th century America. Players are the Patriots, fighting for freedom, or the Royalists, trying to keep the empire under Spanish control. Who will prevail?

name: John Christian
short_description: The John Christian Game is a story of heroism of a young man, who after receiving the armor of God, goes in search of imprisoned lives. On his journey, he will need to face obstacles and enemies who want to keep these people in prison.

name: Chimeras: What Wishes May Come Collector's Edition
short_description: Always Read the Fine Print

name: Fruit Basket TV
short_description: Fruit Basket is the world's premier lethal obstacle course gameshow. Contestants run, jump, and dodge their way to a shot at one million credits, while the timer on their lives ticks down. Join the competition, shoot for the best times, and unlock the most fashionable of hats in order to stay alive.

name: The Beasts Of 9500
short_description: Come to the world of beasts 95 million years ago, you can experience prey, grow, die, and survive as best you can.As you grow, you will hone your speed, stamina, and aggression to become the king of the century.

name: Rorys Restaurant: Winter Rush
short_description: Follow Rory's story as she visits her hometown after her first successful restaurant business! Rory's Restaurant Winter Rush features an amazing mix of Match3 game plus Cooking! This game has every genre you love and are already familiar with: Match3 and Hidden Object!

name: Escape The Pacific
short_description: Raw, real survival in the Pacific. Build a modular floating base. Master realistic sailing mechanics. Face challenging Pacific-like weather & seasons. Hunt, craft, build & navigate using Sun Dial, Sextant & Triangulation. Explore an endless island cluster-based world. Simulate real life scenarios!

name: Gladiator of sparta
short_description: A classic addictive/fun indie mini game for windows that you will play every time!. Do you ever wonder what is like to be in a realistic combat arena and how it feel? Play as Octavius , the greek warrior who is forced to fight in the gladiatorial arenas with many of the best soldiers in the empire..

name: Weapon Shop Fantasy
short_description: A shop game with RPG? Or is it RPG with a shop? Collect materials, Craft weapons, Train your staff and defeat your enemy! This is Weapon Shop Fantasy!

name: Crimson Glaive Sigma
short_description: Enjoy this 2D metroidvania-like bullet hell platformer. Jump, dodge and traverse using your jet pack. Find weapons and abilities. Fight bosses and escape an old space station drifting through the cosmos. You are alone, with nothing but a space suit and a gun. Just keep going! Persevere and triumph!

name: Grass Max
short_description: Multiplayer car fight with some of the fastest and frantic gameplay around.

name: Azure Reflections
short_description: Azure Reflections is an insane, side-scrolling bullet hell fangame based on one of the hottest shooting game series to come out of Japan, the Touhou Project! Enemies come at you from all directions with a relentless hail of bullets! Fight back with a well-timed Danmaku Rush to tear your way through bullets and enemies alike!

name: Scars of Summer
short_description: A slice of life RPG. Due to family circumstances, Keita finds himself living with his childhood friend Ryoka for the summer. Explore a contemporary Japanese setting, and enjoy spending time with Ryoka.

name: Sheol
short_description: Play as Charon's servant and try purify to your own soul!

name: Night Witch: 588
short_description: Join the legendary female aviators that struck fear into the hearts of Nazis in this plane-stealth game.

name: Deep Cave
short_description: Deep Cave is a roguelike game about the adventures of a brave dwarf in search of great riches.

name: Driving School Simulator
short_description: Buckle up, adjust your mirrors and get ready to put your driving abilities to the test as you prove your skills on the streets! Choose between driving a traditional car, bus, or truck and prepare to navigate city streets, mountain roads, or scenic highways.

name: Dice Tactics
short_description: A video game that plays like your favorite tabletop RPG game. With every roll, fate is placed in your hands.

name: ZombieFight VR
short_description: This is a real experience, the screen realistic, operating fever-level exciting, slightly terrorist elements VR shooting game.

name: Heebie Jeebies: The Roller Coaster
short_description: Heebie Jeebies is a horror roller coaster game created especially for VR. To survive the whole ride, you will have to hold the handles in front of you. If at any point you will release them - GAME OVER. This is the perfect game for you to experience something spooky and to scare your friends as well.

name: Red Death
short_description: Red Death is a vertical shooter, Prologue of the series Project Starship!

name: 白玉的幻梦 Dream of Hakugyokurou
short_description: 幻想乡下起了无止尽的雨，街上能看到的熟悉面孔越来越少，异变却久久没有解决，这时，幽幽子失踪了......

name: Tic-Toc-Tower
short_description: Tic-Toc-Tower is an action packed puzzle platforming game in which players have only ten seconds to complete a room! You will be pushed to the limit to reach the end of every level, which also features an additional challenge.

name: Clou - Roll & Heist
short_description: Become one of the greatest thieves of all time in this digital roll & write game. Use your dice cleverly, plan your moves smartly and get the most loot.

name: 灵文西游

short_description: Help the hero get out of limbo. Get to level 25 and learn its history. Jump on the platforms. Beware of shurikens and shoot the activators. Search the level for the entrance to the next level, but be careful! Platforms are destructible - do not make unnecessary movements!

name: Sorcerer's Tournament
short_description: This turn-based RPG is about growing and improving new characters with mini-games between each battle as you permanently unlock new spells, modes and difficulties. Pick the way your student fights, and develop them to reach the number one spot!

name: Gorogoa
short_description: Gorogoa is an elegant evolution of the puzzle genre, told through a beautifully hand-drawn story designed and illustrated by Jason Roberts. Winner of Debut Game at the 2018 BAFTA Games Awards, as well as Best Mobile Game and the Innovation Award at the GDC 2018 Choice Awards.

name: 月影待蚀-前夜 / The Incomplete Lunar-First Night
short_description: This is a visual novel game with the theme of furry characters and homosexual love. You will play a human character who is about to become an furry in the game, break into a small town in Southwest China by mistake, and get involved in the local wonderful past.

name: Bullet Quest
short_description: Defend against waves of ever increasing enemies by harvesting resources then building up a base and your defenses. Takes place in a bleak mechanical dystopia were the factory reigns supreme.

name: Yoko Redux: Dreams of a Blue Planet
short_description: I've been h4ving these dreams la7ely. They can't be real...8ut what if they are? I close my eyes and I see her fac3. Follow Locke as he tries to discover the secrets of Yoko in this point and click, cyberpunk noir adventure.

name: FITRIZ
short_description: Food puzzle game. Complete lines of food blocks and collect 175+ food items in 30 levels with the help of a raccoon.

name: Gridform
short_description: Fight in an arcade arena against tons of enemies with weaknesses to be exploited. Progress through a campaign of 75+ levels each presenting a new challenge with different win and fail conditions. Gameplay so tight and colorful it will bring tears to your eyes.

name: Voltage High Society
short_description: First-person Metroidvania. Fight and explore a decayed city ruled by cybernetic monsters, find upgrades and weapons to unlock new areas. Cyberpunk and bodyhorror with gritty retro aesthetics.

name: From Within
short_description: Delve into a fantastic old-school RPG featuring great characters and an exciting storyline, from the makers of Skyfall and Ashes of Immortality.

name: Japanese TeTris
short_description: Japanese TeTris is Tetris like you've never seen before - incredibly addictive in stylistic graphics too!

name: Vestaria Saga II: The Sacred Sword of Silvanister
short_description: Vestaria Saga II continues the adventures of Zade, bringing the tales of him and his companions to a thrilling, satisfying end. They will encounter allies both new and old while uncovering more mysteries behind the vile Margulites and their plan to plunge Vestaria into a new age of darkness.

name: 你与月光同罪-As Guilty As the Moon
short_description: This is a realistic + survival oriented work. The murder of a girl in a ride-hailing service two years ago, brought your 12 fates back together. You wake up in a strange room, and things are getting weird around you. In the fog, not everything you see is the truth. Is everything real or unreal?

name: Virus Protocol
short_description: Let virus destroy white cells and get to here and there :D

name: GOOG
short_description: GOOG is a top down survival game with bullet elements. Explore GOOG and discover the secrets of this strange world. Defeat the idols of this world on a path to discover who you are and why you're here.

name: The Dragon and the Djinn
short_description: You hold a djinn in a bottle. Make a wish! Will you slay the dragon, or overthrow the emir? Or will you free the djinn, and accept the consequences?

name: Godumas
short_description: GODUMAS is a co-op horror game for 1-4 players. Explore the strange island, solve location based puzzles, run or sneak your way through local inhabitants and find a way to escape… before you are sacrificed.

name: Idle Factory
short_description: Idle can also build your industrial empire.

name: Sapiens
short_description: Create your own prehistoric civilization and lead your tribe in a world you shape. Start with nothing, build towns and industry, and advance through thousands of years of technological breakthroughs in this intimate yet expansive colony sim.

name: Richman 4
short_description: *** This game is only available in Chinese ***《大富翁4》为掷骰子回合制桌上游戏，玩家在游玩时，除可购买土地、股票外，还可投资公司、参加拍卖，过足富豪瘾。游戏支持单人、多人游玩，玩家既可以与计算机AI角色一同游玩自得其乐，也可和二三好友一起，来一局富豪间的财富PK。

name: Book of Yog Idle RPG
short_description: The Book of Yog is a 3D idle RPG game presenting with Cel-Shading skills. You can rally heroes, develop the kingdom and explore secrets of the lost world. Dozens of heroes, hundreds of skills, thousands of equipment, free combinations, come and form the most powerful team that belongs to you!

name: Koi-Koi VR: Love Blossoms
short_description: The story is a multi-ending that depends on your choice.We look forward to welcoming you.

name: Gems of Destiny: Homeless Dwarf
short_description: Enjoy the Match 3 gameplay in an intriguing story of dwarf Axel rebuilding his destroyed village. Earn coins by using 5 unique boosters to create a new city for Alex and his friends. Be amazed about the creation of the beautiful hand-drawn Dwarf's Forest World

name: REDSIDE episode 1

name: MMI

name: Alchemia: Creatio Ex Nihilo
short_description: Alchemia is a turn-based strategy roguelike with a hint of puzzle. You'll collect alchemical reagents, building your own personalized combat satchel, and combine them into magical recipes, unique to each run, to battle against outlandish foes.

name: I'm Prop
short_description: I'm Prop is an online hide-and-seek game in everyone's favorite prophunt genre. Here Hunters try to find magical dwarfes that live off of energy of their surroundings.

name: NYYO
short_description: NYYO, a 2D Action game full of enjoyable quests. Seize swords and shields to help V, who needs to know what is waiting for him outside the village. Head off on the adventure together to reveal NYYO’s hidden secrets

short_description: 'Ruadh: Warbands' is a tactical, turn-based roguelite that invites players into the world of Ruadh - a gritty fantasy setting inspired by Norse mythology. Gather warriors from the five clans, travel the land, manage your warband, and fight through increasingly powerful enemies!

name: Mirror Chains
short_description: Novel match-3 gameplay + all kinds of beautiful girl characters = this game, you are welcome to challenge~

name: Digimon Survive
short_description: Digimon Survive presents a hybrid visual novel and tactical RPG set in a mysterious world filled with dangerous monsters and deadly battles that will test your ability to survive.

name: TVs: The Awakening
short_description: What happens when a TV wakes up and finds himself in an illusional world, where the facts become a crazy dream, TVs is a platformer game combining intense action with challenging puzzles and fight the scary bosses.

name: The Silent Sky Part I
short_description: The Silent Sky is a hand-drawn, point-and-click adventure game about a boy who goes wandering while searching for his dog. Without even realizing it, while under the night's silent sky, his epic journey is about to begin.

name: Ghost Watchers
short_description: Ghost Watchers is a co-op online horror game. You will explore and hunt ghosts in abandoned houses

name: Crafting Town
short_description: Crafting Town Is : A Crafting game with Simulation&Building where you can Craft and Develop your Village, Source Management and Quests.

name: Catellite-609: feline space adventure
short_description: Help the cats find alien friends! By exploring space using 'Catellite-609' cats will be able to: build rooms, upgrade 'Catellite-609' facilities, and develop a cat crew. Enjoy a unique space adventure!

name: Lord Winklebottom Investigates
short_description: It’s the 1920s and the world’s foremost detective is about to embark on his most challenging case yet. Thankfully, in this world that’s not quite like our own, there’s nobody better to crack the case than the great detective and gentleman giraffe, Lord Winklebottom.

name: Omitted
short_description: Omitted is a first-person psychological horror game. Experience being left alone in an old hospital, discover its secrets and try to survive.

name: EarthRoyale
short_description: EarthRoyale is a Map simulation Observer game where the game each turn chooses one of many events to edit the world map

name: Soul Wargame
short_description: This is a dark style strategy game that combines Wargame and Rogulike. Everyone received a mysterious invitation after destroying the conspiracy of the cult. You will lead a group of undead warriors on an adventure journey to defeat invincible enemies one by one.

name: 国際指定怪異123号 廃村
short_description: 毎年出現する「廃村」と呼ばれる奇妙な無人村には、必ず１人の少女が生贄として幽閉される… 廃村に突入する３人の特殊部隊と、監禁された１人の少女を操作し、脱出を目指します。

name: Age of Undead
short_description: Age of Undead is a multi-genre game (turn-based, RTS, FPS) that allows you to face the frightful Zombie Apocalypse with 3 unique factions: the Army, the Infected, and the Survivors. Make strategic choices in the Campaign, then go into battle and fight to survive!

name: AI Dungeon
short_description: An AI-powered text-based RPG like you've never played before. Write stories, interact with realistic characters, and experience virtually infinite worlds and genres. Escape to alternate universes where you direct the action and anything is possible!

name: Everdell
short_description: Harvest resources to build a village of woodland critters in this adaptation of the award-winning tabletop board game!

name: Earth's Center of Gravity
short_description: Earth's Center of Gravity is a mystic horror visual novel with multiple endings. The story revolves around Tower Antiques. 'No one remembers how long Tower Antiques was there. But it remembers everyone. Even the ones who did not visit it yet.' Tower Antiques is waiting for you to write your story.

name: 隐秘的原罪8
short_description: 《隐秘的原罪》是由本格工作室开发的推理解谜系列游戏。本作以架空的民国时代为故事背景，围绕侦探和巡警联手侦破一个个奇案的故事，在扣人心弦的推理过程中，弘扬人性的真善美，抨击人性的丑恶，同时科普诸多的常识知识。

name: I commissioned some bees 4
short_description: I paid 10 more artists to hide bees in their artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

name: Soccer VR Football
short_description: Simple, arcade Soccer (USA) / Football (EU) Virtual Reality game. If you are a soccer/football fan and you dreamed of controlling your team while sitting next to the pitch, you can do it now in VR. Now with CAR FOOTBALL & FOOSBALL (Table Football) game modes!

name: Pixa Clicker
short_description: Pixa Clicker is a Point & Click Idle Clicker with a connected RPG, in which the objective is to earn an absurd amount of money. To do this you'll need a lot of stores that offer a variety of items or jobs.

name: Nectar
short_description: An explosive Shoot ‘Em Up like no other, Nectar focuses on five hummingbird sisters, each with their own playstyle. Defeat powerful bosses, unlock new cosmetics, compete in online leaderboards, and save your world from the invading bee army!

name: Apostle: Rebellion
short_description: A sci-fi, turn-based RPG. Humanity has reached a point where the majority of people opt to become cyborgs called Roids. However, social inequality is once again at a breaking point.

name: CYCLEBREAKER
short_description: Deflect bullets and take down invading robot minibosses with just your laser sword, in pursuit of the highest combo!

name: Fastest Fantasy Life Simulator
short_description: Welcome to the Fastest Fantasy Life Simulator! Get up to four friends and together you prepare for your fantasy life! Meet pesky lords, humorous dragons and friendly goblins. Every decision you make will determine the fate of your life. How will you decide? What does the future hold for you?

name: RaceLeague
short_description: Car racing game with heavy focus on user-created tracks and multiplayer

name: Illusion 幻覚
short_description: Delivery personnel headed to a condominium building to deliver a package.

name: OverNight
short_description: So, are you up for a challenge? Can you survive the night with the Spirits at some of the most haunted locations in the world? And if you are afraid of ghosts and paranormal activities, you better team up with your friends because every horror is little less scary when you are not alone in the dark.

name: Graduated
short_description: You are a freshly graduated college student, and countless choices are unfolding before your eyes, how do you go forward, and finally live the life you want to live.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Kuro no Kiseki
short_description: The Legend of Heroes: Kuro no Kiseki is finally coming to Steam®! The sprawling Republic of Calvard is experiencing an unprecedented economic boom brought on by post-war reparations. Here is the beginning of a new 'Trails (story)'.

name: Re-Volt
short_description: Re-Volt lets you guide one of 28 remote control cars through insane race tracks set in unusual environments. Curbs become huge walls, toys are obstacles, and everything is fair game to drive on, through, or over.

name: Poulet Poulet
short_description: Classic-style 2D platformer with hand-crafted fun stages, a vengeful chicken, and an evil exotic fish.

name: Kingdom Gun
short_description: Play solo or team up with 2 - 4 players and battle through hordes of enemies in this action roguelite! Multiple playable characters, discover secrets, unique abilities, and tons of unique items!

name: Find the Cats
short_description: Cat Lady has lost all of her cats! Please find them for her. This is a short and easy, kid-friendly 3D hidden object game with over a hundred cats to find, spread over several areas.

name: Cowgirl Adventures
short_description: 'Cowgirl Adventures' is a strategy shooting casual puzzle game. Players will play the role of a cowgirl to pass through many levels, fight against various enemies, and finally capture them one by one (?) Adventure story.

name: Forest Mystery
short_description: Forest Mystery is a casual walking simulator.

name: 这里有妖
short_description: 数以亿计的妖怪遍布整个世界各地。人类需要一个英雄要去弄明白妖怪的来源。去打败妖怪。为人类生存而努力下去。

name: Curse of the Deadwood
short_description: Curse of the Deadwood is a unique evolution of a twin-stick genre that allows for single or couch co-op play. Take control of two unlikely friends as they fight back hordes of wooden zombies. Work together to save the beautiful world of Knottington from the Curse of the Deadwood.

name: Connect the Dots 3D
short_description: Connect the Dots 3D is a casual puzzle game.

name: Yacht Mechanic Simulator
short_description: Build your own yacht empire! Renovate old yachts, patch their hulls, fix their engines, and add new parts. Design and install beautiful interiors of your vessels. Pilot your ships and check how they handle the water. A completely new installment in the famous ‘Mechanic Simulator’ universe!

name: Catch Me!
short_description: Compete online against your friends and other players in this chaotic and fast paced 4-player game of tag! Race across different locations, jump through windows, electrocute the other players or throw cats at them. (No cats were harmed in the production of this game.)

name: Sweet Transit
short_description: Sweet Transit is a unique city builder where the railway is king and trains are the sole means of transportation. Quaint villages will expand to bustling cities, farms to industrious factories, and steam-powered rail to combustious diesel... and beyond in this interconnected, train-driven world.

name: Bear and Breakfast
short_description: Bear and Breakfast is a laid-back management adventure game where you build and run a bed and breakfast...but you’re a bear.

name: Mech Shuffle
short_description: Mech Shuffle is a roguelite deck builder where you choose a pilot and a mech to build a unique deck. Earn new cards and card upgrades to improve your deck over a run. Scout the battlefield, secure the beachhead, and repel the invasion!

name: Tomb Robbing with Friends
short_description: An 8-player party game about pushing your friends into traps so you can steal their treasures! Dodge spikes, grab coins and become the richest tomb robber!

name: Space Bandit
short_description: Brutal (one hit kill) twin stick shooter with hilariously clever fun enemies that don't just run at you like an idiot. Also has roguelike and Sci-Fi stuff.

name: Nash Racing 3: Drifter
short_description: Nash racing series is back. Tune your drifter car, drift and collect achievements in this car tuning simulation game and try to tame this beast and powerful car

name: Sweet Office
short_description: This is a game that combines relationship simulation and whac-a-Mole mode.The story takes place in the office of a company, you will meet three girls with different personalities. Help them solve their problems in work and life and win their favor.

name: 露娜传
short_description: Quick browsing of video content: Video 0:00-2:30 (plot introduction) Video 2:30-6:40 (game system, features and mechanism) Video 6:40 end (battle picture)

name: De'Vine: Heavenly Acres
short_description: Welcome to your farm on Heavenly Acres! Farmland that presents many opportunities. Harvest trees & plants. Grow Crops. Romance with other misfits. Collect up to 200 unique monsters and compete with monster battles! Indulge in the underground for buried treasure and dangerous monsters!

name: Crossfar
short_description: Fight in fast-paced PVP space battles with hardcore team tactics in zero gravity! Choose from five drone classes upon respawns and put your spectacular pilot skills on display to defend your gate, destroy or sneak past the enemy defenses, cross the field and breach the enemy gate on the far side.

name: Kentor and also Bloby in: Part 1 - The Krookening
short_description: Join Kentor and also Bloby on a colorful quest to catch Krooktor and save their invention!

name: Doodle Drive
short_description: Doodle roads and shapes and unleash your driving skills on the path you have crafted to reach the Finish line. A 2d creative driving / puzzle / physics game.

name: Hunkenstein
short_description: The most fearsome monsters of classic cinema are now common household pests. You're the new exterminator in town. Unlicensed, of course. Shoot, crush, burn, or mulch these physics-based ghouls, then collect the check.

name: Motorbike Video Puzzle
short_description: A jigsaw puzzle with videos shot on motorbikes. Enjoy this unique experience to the sound of Rock 'n' Roll

name: The Manga Works
short_description: Make history with manga! Turn your work into anime, drama, and even movies!

name: Escape Room Academy
short_description: It takes the joy of Escape Rooms in a casual and joyful experience. Resolving riddles, getting clues and cracked puzzles have never been so fun and cheerful. Each room has its own quest, and to solve it you are provided with two decks of cards(Clues and Locks) and a room view to inspect.

name: Autonauts vs Piratebots
short_description: Create, automate and defend an impenetrable base. Assemble and command a Bot army to combat an entire Piratebot invasion. Build, program and battle your way through five different zones.

name: The Mortuary Assistant
short_description: Alone with the dead... Embalm corpses, banish demons, save your soul.

name: All Ashes and Illusions
short_description: A dark visual novel about a young prince's unhealthy infatuation with his nursemaid, and his misguided attempts to win her heart.

name: Death Slave : You Need to Master Death
short_description: Death Slave is a 2D puzzle-platformer where the player must intelligently kill their character in different ways to gain new powers to solve platforming challenges.

name: REDSHOT
short_description: Quick reflexes and clever strategies are required in REDSHOT, a bullet-time metroidvania where everything is deadly, but you are deadlier. Can you save the royal city from total destruction? ...Can you do it with style?

name: Escape Yourself
short_description: You will take on the role of Danny Bent, a boy who wakes up in a train car. Without memories and without knowing why he is there, he soon realizes that something strange is going on. Can you solve all the puzzles? Of discovering the truth? Will you be able to escape?

name: Rhythm Knights: Double Treble
short_description: Play as the Rhythm Knights in this hand-drawn colorful rhythm fighter reimagining. Featuring tons of levels and a brand new input system. This package also contains a full remastered version of the original game! This is the ultimate Rhythm Knights package!

name: Hard West 2
short_description: Hard West 2 is a journey to the heart of darkness in the American West. Take control of a supernatural posse and catch the mysterious Ghost Train. Outsmart, outcheat and outgun your enemies in this turn-based tactics game set in a Wild West world where nothing is as it seems.

name: Physics Playground
short_description: Physics Playground is a little indie game in which you can experiment with different cubes, tools, buttons and of course physics.

name: Desktopia: A Desktop Village Simulator
short_description: Desktopia is a city-builder game which simulates an evolving, medieval-esque village along the bottom of your desktop, allowing you to work, watch, or browse something else while you play.

name: Boat Crew
short_description: Boat Crew is an action-packed singleplayer game that is all about leading your men. Command a PT boat against Imperial Japan in the the Pacific War. Manage your people and your resources; beg, borrow, and steal to obtain what you need to bring your campaign to a victorious conclusion.

name: Rush Rush Rally Reloaded
short_description: The acclaimed 2D Dreamcast racing game

name: Move 78
short_description: Uncover the mystery behind each of the group's hidden motives and lost memories. What brings them together? What happened to the outside world, and who is The Botfly Killer that haunts their nightmares?

name: Overdose WW2
short_description: Overdose WW2 is an FPS game set in the Second World War. It is a game that aims to offer an experience like 90s FPS games. Overdose comes with content that aims to offer you a long gameplay and nostalgia. The game is an FPS game set in the second world war.

name: FAMILY BATTLE タッグアリーナ
short_description: A huge fight between the members of the strongest family!? Pave the way to victory with just the two of you! The 2 vs 2 tag-team battle action begins here!

name: 都市媚影-CityFascination
short_description: city fascination is a modern urban RPG set in a parallel world. In different life levels to make their own choice, is hand in hand with a confidante bland through life, or?

name: PlayWith
short_description: Tired of the old 'WASD/ZQSD' key binding ? Want to challenge you with some weird key bindings ?PlayWith is a 2D hardcore platform game where every level have a different key bindingDid you ever jumped with 'Y', got to the left with '5' and to the right with 'E' ?

name: Move That Box!
short_description: Move that Box is a retro, arcade, top-down style action-puzzle game based on logical thinking, but also requiring reflexes. Move, push, throw, melt and even blow up items to reach the goal.

name: 永恒至尊 Eternal Supreme
short_description: To save her people from the world destruction, the supreme tried to breakthrough to the legendary supreme realm but failed! She is coming back. In this fantasy world with various traces, you will explore the race origination, recover the prehistoric secrets, and become the most powerful supreme!

name: Dash Shooters
short_description: Dash Shooters is a multiplayer, fast paced racing game, where the main movement mechanic is dashing! Race your friends to the finish line through a randomly generated map, dodging obstacles, gathering powerups, shooting crystals/other players, and dashing through objectives along the way!

name: NoAmmo
short_description: You are a tanker who has run out of shells, your rifle has run out of bullets, you are wounded and powerless, but you must complete the task, so despite the crowds of enemy soldiers, you continue to move forward, transferring your coordinates to the base and praying for a victorious end!

name: Be
short_description: Build, relax or explore in a beautiful world. Chill out next to a lake or build crazy structures (with friends!) Choose your own weather & time of day.

name: Radial Flow
short_description: Flow to the beat of your own music in this punishingly difficult mouse-precision arcade game. Enjoy endless challenge and replayability with over 30 different levels of various difficulties. Includes Steam achievements and leaderboards.

name: PARTHIAN STRIKE
short_description: Decades after the war with the machines, mankind has fallen into underground shelters to escape nuclear radiation. However, they are destroyed one by one by machine soldiers walking on the ground. The people challenge their last battle with humanoid weapons that were once used in the Great War.

name: Warrior Maiden
short_description: Warrior Maiden is a colorful and enjoyable side-scrolling platform game.

name: War of Bellrook
short_description: Go forth on a text-based, choose your own adventure where you can choose your role and embark on adventure as various different people who tread different paths.

name: Camp Canyonwood
short_description: Build and manage a struggling summer camp to restore its former glory! Each summer, teach new campers activities like fishing, archery and more, while protecting them from dangers natural and supernatural. Keep campers happy to earn funds for improving the campground until it's better than ever!

name: Pink Explorer
short_description: Pink Explorer Is an Retro style 2D Platformer. Play as the Pink Explorer and try to beat all the different levels littered with sweet platforming, enemies, gravity puzzles and more!

name: South of the Circle
short_description: South of the Circle is an emotional narrative experience exploring the relationship between Peter and Clara, Cambridge academics caught up in the political conflict of the Cold War. The story focuses on the weight of life choices - between career, true love and the desire to keep our promises.

name: Go Home
short_description: This is a match 3 game with a dog theme. The game has an innovative goal achievement system. There are also four other types of mini-games. In the game, you help the dog find its way home. Cute puppies are looking forward to your help.

name: HordounD
short_description: HordounD is a mysterious and prosperous city full of puzzles and mysteries. But the darkness broke out and enveloped the city, hiding it under water.

name: Warfield
short_description: Warfield ,Singleplayer and Multiplayer War Game.

name: ToyCar
short_description: Race around tracks in small cars with your friends. Use the boost to pass them and leave them in the dust. But be mindful of the temperature, we do not want the engine to go boom are we?

name: Solar Nations
short_description: Command grand fleets and wage strategic wars on an interstellar scale in this new take on galactic Grand Strategy. Transform nature to suit the needs of Empire and surge forward! Will you guide aspiring interstellar nations to glory, or rekindle the flames of a long lost Empire?

name: Hop Step Sing! VR Live Hop☆Summer 2nd
short_description: Hop Step Sing!'s Second VR live performance, 《Hop☆Summer 2nd》 is now available on Steam! Put on your VR goggles and enjoy the 360-degree immersive live concert experience you had never seen before!

name: Frogun
short_description: Join Renata as she adventures across a world of mystical ruins with the titular FROGUN! Frogun is an old-school platformer with the soul of the PS1/N64 era, in which your frog-shaped grappling hook is a your best friend!

name: Hearts United
short_description: In the beginning, there was only once race, today known as the Ancestors. Now, there are more, and the conflicts are ever rising, on an eternal war for survival, after consequences of ill resolved problems, all races and people, for once, will have to learn to work together or be destroyed.

name: Cut to the Core
short_description: How much of someone can you cut away before there's nothing left? Find out in this chilling kinetic visual novel - IF YOU DARE!

name: The Adventures of Poppe
short_description: A 2D adventure platformer game where a little man named Poppe explores different locations, finds various items and uses them along his way, fights against dangerous insects and survives in this gigantic world.

name: LUMbA: REDUX
short_description: LUMbA: REDUX Is a challenging, fast-paced, bullet hell shooter. Take control of LUMBA and cleanse this world of the monsters that have consumed it.

name: Aznak
short_description: Ivan Abel, a young village boy who's mother was abducted by a mad king and his knights. Gathering companions at different locations to create our cast of party members he is able to experience all different types of regions and cultures. Can they save his mother and the world?

name: Retreat To Enen
short_description: The year is 3600 CE. After narrowly avoiding extinction, humanity turned away from war and strife, choosing life and peace. Time for you to undertake the rite of passage. Journey to the legendary Enen. Explore, forage, hunt, build, and meditate to finish the rite and find your place in the world.

name: Nyaruru Fishy Fight
short_description: This game is a Metroidvania game with intense battle. Explore the world and collection power-ups with your cute cat girl! When magic curse suddenly occurred in a small town and all the residents grew cat ears, the real cat girl Nyaruru started her way to uncover the truth...

name: Map Of Materials
short_description: As the hero in Map of Materials, you'll embark alone on a journey to discover your past and escape from the dark secret of a long-abandoned land. Armed with a sword and a bow, you'll confront a threatening shadow that will try to stop you.

name: Super Owlboy
short_description: 'Super Owlboy' is a side-view 2D platform game. The goal is to complete levels of varying difficulty by overcoming obstacles. Spikes, saws, flying projectiles and moving platforms are waiting to stop you on your way.

name: ZONERS
short_description: ZONERS is 1 vs 1, high speed, galactic, sports action! Featuring weird characters, a stylish art style, an awesome soundtrack and tons of customisation & accessibility settings to play with. It's time to get into the zone!

name: Tiny Tactics
short_description: Tiny Tactics is a Tower Defense game with a heavy focus on mazing, with mechanics inspired by the Auto Chess genre.

name: Magefall
short_description: Magic focused 3D action rogue-like survivor. Sling powerful spells in first person action. Unleash massive explosions to blast away enemies! Survive the onslaught of elementals utilizing over 70 active and passive spells chosen upon leveling up. Soar above your foes and rain down destruction!

name: PlateUp!
short_description: Cook and serve your dishes, design and decorate your restaurants, and expand your culinary kingdom with new unlocks, abilities and dishes in procedurally-generated locations. Classic cooking action with permanent roguelite progression. Hire your friends - or do it all yourself!

name: Voxrush
short_description: Voxrush is a time survival FPS game with a full destructible voxel environment. Kill monsters, take points, upgrade stats and weapons, use skills and find a better way to survive as long as possible to become the best!

name: The Dark Heart of Balor
short_description: Archdemon Balor has opened the Gate of Hell into the human realm and hordes of demons and monsters have flooded into your world destroying everything in their path. You must protect those who are still alive and ultimately destroy Balor to close the Gate.

name: Kokoro Clover Season1
short_description: Plop down on the couch in your comfiest pajamas, grab a big bowl of cereal, and prepare to enter 'Kokoro Clover', a 2D platformer inspired by Sunday morning Japanese anime shows of the past! Transformations, cards, dancing, and robots! Let's find out what this wonderful world has in store!

name: A Mage Reborn
short_description: Walk the path of a legendary mage, combining four different schools of magic to devastating effects.

name: Fight For It
short_description: Turn-based, rogue-like adventure of randomness. Roll lots of dice to test your luck.

name: Space Ballers
short_description: Space Ballers it's a game between ships that aims to score the most number of goals in challenging arenas with many obstacles along the way.

name: Afterslave
short_description: Afterslave is a short visual novel about a boy that have reached culmination of his life in a totalitaristic country

name: Supernova Tactics
short_description: Customize your army with different traits and items. Unlock permanent upgrades to go deeper in this survival Auto-Battler/Roguelite hybrid!

name: Inn Mage
short_description: Inn Mage combines two game types: management simulation and role-playing. As a mage, you need to creatively use magic scrolls to manage inn and deal with competitor.

name: Love, Money, Rock'n'Roll
short_description: Love, Money, Rock'n'Roll: the romanticism of the Eighties, mystery and intrigues, betrayal and sacrifice, hatred and passion — all this and more in the new game from the creators of the legendary visual novel Everlasting Summer!

name: PTRL Stockcar Edition
short_description: PTRL Stockcar Edition is a challenging arcade racer set in a fictional racing series of the 80s

name: Koncolos
short_description: 'Do you know a monster that dwells around here?' she asked. An ordinary barkeepers' journey, intertwined with the only survivor from a shrouded monster hunter company, started with this question.

name: Lys and Ruka's Magical Bag
short_description: Something strange is afoot as a mysterious dungeon appears outside the town of Litos. Gather weapons and items to fight the enemies before and get out of sticky situations in this fast-paced action RPG from desunoya!

name: Third Wild
short_description: Third Wild it is a game that combines survival with fantasy. Survive, fight, build your buildings, and go on an adventure in a medieval open world with monsters and strange areas for you to explore.

name: Quest: Escape Dungeon
short_description: Join the group of adventurers in the quest for treasures! Solve puzzles and fight the dungeon guards to find the cave full of gold and get back home safely.

name: Mothercore
short_description: A tower defense game with weird and wacky towers and enemies. Play in the two modes, Story mode and Arcade mode. And follow a weird story about an organization and last power source humans have.

name: For another day
short_description: Start to play in the open world to master the game! For another day is a new world that need to be discovered from scratch by you.

name: In Your Books
short_description: In Your Books is a short adventure game where you play the granddaughter of a bookseller. After her disappearance you'll have to take the place of your grandmother. Recommend books, learn to know the locals, solve secret mechanisms and discover where she left.

name: GigaBash
short_description: Claim your place as king among Titans! GigaBash is a multiplayer arena brawler with gigantic film-inspired kaiju, larger than life heroes, earth-shattering special attacks and fully destructible environments.

name: Boneraiser Minions
short_description: Amass an army of deamonic undead to fight endless waves of heroes intent to end your boneraising ways! In this gothic-horror auto-battle roguelite, use the bones of slain heroes to raise your minions, collect powerful relics and spells, and unlock meta upgrades, all to survive King Gigald's crusade!

name: Egglien
short_description: A retro space themed action shooter where your bullets send you flying through the air!

name: 江湖群雄传
short_description: The legend of heroes in the Jianghu is a martial arts open world role-playing game.

name: Spiriat
short_description: Fly at high speed! Escape from the darkness that haunts you. Absorb as many light orbs as you can to unlock the different graphic stories. Dodge the orbs of darkness that will delay you on your way! Only then you will meet the masters who will guide you to your destiny.

name: 烈山海前传之黑帝君临
short_description: 《烈山海前传之黑帝君临》是一款关于“自我找寻”的上古神话题材的RPG游戏。是烈山海游戏系列的第三部。

name: Luna Sky RDX
short_description: Momentum...speed! Physics puzzles and robots. Bounce? Explore? Dash? Swing? Skate? Fly? ...and blow things up? Yes!

name: Eira
short_description: 'Eira' is a role-playing game developed by the independent team 'Gearonin'. In this game, you will play a girl named 'Rui' who just turned 15 years old. Together with the thoughtful and handsome butler 'Ralph', she runs and protects the ancient magic shop left by Rui's grandmother 'Eira.

name: Rooftop Garden Simulator
short_description: Who said the city can’t be its own escape? In Rooftop Garden Simulator, you can transform your urban corner into a warm and relaxing agricultural space. Build, explore, and connect with the sprawling, citified landscape in a stylized simulation that’s designed to be fun for gamers of all ages.

name: Mark's Magnificent Marble Maze
short_description: Unwind from the stress of daily life with this magnificent marble maze. Sometimes all you need is a place to let your mind wander.

name: Solo War Medieval
short_description: Solo War Medieval is a first-person shooter game like no other. You need to survive against infinite amount of knights alone, but modern weapons would help you a bit. Modern weapons vs. medieval knights - what would be outcome?

name: Gummy Jump
short_description: you are a gummy where you have to get to the top of the hill, even one small misstep you will fall quite far back down.

name: Hooked on You: A Dead by Daylight Dating Sim™
short_description: Welcome to Murderer’s Island. Your companions: four dead-sexy Killers who, underneath their murderous exteriors, just want a little romance. Flirt your way into their hearts, uncovering dark twists along the way. Will you find true love, forge friendships… or get hacked to death?

name: Unknown
short_description: Darkness. Nothing. There’s no memory of what has become. All you have is a flashlight to navigate the horrors ahead of you. Use your wits to solve the puzzles and escape the levels of the dreaded facility. You don’t seem to be alone though…

name: Hidden Objects with Edgar Allan Poe - Mystery Detective
short_description: Plunge into the mystical atmosphere of Edgar Allan Poe’s famous story! Feel like a detective unexpectedly caught up in the most mysterious and unusual investigation! The newest hidden object game with a storyline

name: Cat Dungeon
short_description: Cat Dungeon is a puzzle game where you must guide a cat out of a dungeon. Push objects to create a path to the door. Collect keys, pull levers and use teleports to escape the dungeon.

name: Champs TD
short_description: Champs TD is a Tower Defense Game with endless replayability. Slay thousands of Minions in randomized Waves. Summon powerful Champions with 28+ unique Abilities. Earn Experience, Level Up and choose from 100+ Talents to improve your Champs just the way you want.

name: Real estate tycoon
short_description: 'Illusory life: urban real estate tycoon' is a simulated business role-playing game with urban theme. We try to restore the game world like a novel of urban face slapping, and give the players a 'capitalist' identity.（We are a very poor studio, so English translation will be launched in the future）

name: Zapling Bygone
short_description: Zapling Bygone is a twisted metroidvania where you murder your foes and steal their abilities by wearing their skulls and absorbing their consciousness into your hive-mind.

name: Sokobalien
short_description: Do you have what it takes to build the biggest space farm in the galaxy? Help the alien reach this goal in this classic Sokoban puzzle style game! Push cows, sheep, pigs and chicken so that the correct UFO beams can abduct them. (Also, as a side-quest, collect all the hats you can!)

name: Hindsight
short_description: What if the physical objects of everyday life, the possessions we hold close, were actual windows to the past? Peer into distant memories and unseen futures in Hindsight.

name: Forrader Hero
short_description: Forrader Hero – turn-based game with roguelike elements where heroes can’t step back and must fight through the end to save their soul in ‘Forgotten Proto.World’ fighting hordes of monsters, undead creatures, and their overlords.

name: Tanks Boom Boom
short_description: Set aside! The Mega-Tank is coming, destroying everything in front of him. Our advice is to join the tank cabin,using all it’s skills like : speed booster,time warp,money booster,otherwise you risk being eaten alive. Convince yourself right now that either you win or you are bound to lose.

name: Creature Creator
short_description: BUILD. PAINT. PLAY. Create your own creatures to explore online worlds with friends and collect parts to upgrade in this creative multiplayer experience!

name: 天香与小百合 - Tinheung & Sayuri
short_description: Tinheung & Sayuri is a game of visual novel. This is a short Yuri story across age, nationality and gender.

name: Movie Theater Simulator
short_description: This is a movie theater simulator where you can watch fair use documentaries and other video on various subjects. Want to go to the movies without leaving your house? now you can get the movie theater experience from your bedroom with virtual reality simulator

name: Bulletkour
short_description: Bulletkour is an action-parkour game about using a gun to shoot your way through various obstacles as you try to escape an abyss with virtually nothing except skill.

name: Vanaris Tactics
short_description: Vanaris Tactics is a short narrative tactical RPG experience that tells a story about refugees fleeing their occupied motherland. You lead a group of refugees looking for freedom outside the walls of Vanaris, unite your people and use tactical prowess to escape your oppressors.

name: New Horizon
short_description: New Horizon is a survival with RPG game. Explore a vast world in search of resources, build, upgrade your equipment and fight monsters to survive.

name: Hidden in the Dark
short_description: You and your friends are going to spend a weekend at Amy's parents' vacation home. Mysteriously, they discover that there is a murderer in the house, and they need to act fast if they don't want to be caught. pronto

name: Dan the Inmortal
short_description: Dan wants to reach the top to drink the fountain of mortality, will he be able to reach his goal?

name: Turbo Golf Racing
short_description: Turbo Golf Racing is an arcade-style sports racing game for up to eight players online. Slam into oversized golf balls and race your friends in an explosive dash to the finish flag.

name: Dreadful Hours
short_description: You must stay alive in this creepy house you found in the middle of a forest.Multiple monsters are attacking you at every moment, you must survive using cameras, padlocks and being stealthy.To make it even worse you aren't alone in the house. Your power is limited, and your devices use power.

name: Armor Girl Simulator
short_description: 'Armor Girl Simulator' allows you to create your ideal female warrior by combining her body and various dress-up parts. You can upload your warrior to the server and share it with other users.

name: Foster: Ghost Child | 養小鬼
short_description: Foster: Ghost Child provides an atmospheric horror that incorporates East Asian elements rarely used in games. The game makes use of Chinese traditional elements to convey a distinct and frightful storyline that incorporates Taoism, Buddhism, and Chinese mythology.

name: Icarus Challenge
short_description: Fly around the beautiful island on your own and feel the free! To fly, you only have to spread your arms and flap. No need to use joy stick or keep looking in the direction of travel. If you can fly as you wish, let's challenge 'Icarus challenge'. It is simple. fly higher than anyone else!

name: PLANETOIDS
short_description: PLANETOIDS is a 2D hand-drawn game that is a retro space arcade game. In it you have to shoot and dodge meteors, comets and wandering planets in outer space.

name: Spectre Of Eternity
short_description: An action bullet hell. Dodge enemies attacks and collect upgrades to make it to the end of each level.

name: Infinity Project: PATTERNS
short_description: Strange powers and void-like beings threaten the struggling normalcy of the Nameless City, a hopeful region at the end of the world that clings to a past life.

name: Cultivation Story: Reincarnation
short_description: Cultivation Story: Reincarnation is a top-down pixel art style action roguelike based on cultivation and Chinese mythology.

name: Hot And Lovely 5
short_description: A very interesting puzzle game. You need to remember the different pictures by flipping the cards, and find the same pictures to eliminate.

name: Earth's Shadow
short_description: Earth's Shadow is a third person action Sci-Fi dungeon crawler set in the year 3081 on planet Sumbra; a remote alien planet where legends of valuable relics surround this black world, calling to the greedy and brave explorers seeking a bright future... but end up uncovering an even darker past.

name: Bug Dolls: Soviet Project
short_description: This is a horror game about a small town engulfed in dangerous dolls.

name: IKO 39
short_description: IKO 39 is an adventure sci-fi detective. Find out what happened at the station, which had lost contact with the Earth. Emie – the artificial intelligence of the station – will help you to solve the mystery.

name: ROGUELINE
short_description: TwIn-stick RogueLike Shoot'em up Action!

name: SharkDrag Episode 5: Uniting the 5 Kingdoms
short_description: A 2D classic RPG style game with unique custom-made monsters. Travel across the continent of Penta, fighting a variety of hostile creatures, and gathering allies as you go. A not too serious adventure awaits!Made in RPGMaker VX Ace, by a two person team.

name: Bicycle Rider Simulator
short_description: Bike, nature and you - ride along beautiful forest landscapes, rivers and mountains. Enjoy birdsong, explore dense forests and make your own route! Accelerate, jump, explore and try not to crash on your way!

name: Mission: Driver
short_description: Start the engine and become a legendary driver! Control a variety of unique vehicles with realistic driving physics. Master dozens of challenging missions and break all the records!

name: Sokorun: One Box
short_description: Sokorun: one box, it's a sokoban game, with minimalist and pixel graphics style. A classic dungeon game. Avoid the traps, activate the buttons, unlock the doors and help little Logan scape.

name: Some Synergy
short_description: In this local co-op 2D platformer game, you and your friend cooperate to reach the end. Two of you simply needs to progress right. With different platforms that provide different challenges, how will you and your friend progress?

name: Tribe War
short_description: It is a strategic card game (SCG) that combines the genre of card games and chess. Create an original deck and use your card to target your opponent's base Stores, card packs, and new species will be added in the future.

name: Great Deceiver
short_description: Marie Mamiya reigns supreme, and by her whim, she'll train an ordinary man into shape—in the pursuit of beauty.

name: Miko no Kanata: Curious Tales from Oguni Shrine -Cycles-
short_description: All the heroines are miko! Fighting miko! Working miko! Moe miko! A girl's love that pierces through time. A tragic fate imposed upon these fighting shrine maidens. And the darkness who seek to rampage through the world of night... With those strong feelings, will Yuuya and Akiha be together?!

name: Mechabot Defender
short_description: Deploy your turrets and defend against an ever-growing mechanical horde! Upgrade your turrets separately in unique ways, use unique character abilities, and create powerful synergies.

name: NetaJump
short_description: NetaJump is a indie casual game where you grasp the chance to jump higher, unlock skins, or follow the hints in the skin descriptions to unlock them.

name: The Dancer: Definitive Edition
short_description: Run from the most terrifying monster the world has ever seen - royalty free music.

name: VOIDCRISIS
short_description: 'VOIDCRISIS' is a four-player tower offense game on an undulating battlefield. Operate combat bio-machines called VA (Vital Armor) drawn with dynamic mechanical art shaders and work together to clear high-difficulty stages.

name: Burrow of the Fallen Bear: A Gay Furry Visual Novel
short_description: A gay furry visual novel, full of fantasy and RPG elements. Experience Krile’s journey before he saves the Furry Heroes, Meet 3 unique hot adventurers, Fight with them, Buy items that impact your story, Unlock branches, Explore the Fallen Bear’s burrow. Everything through a classic choice system.

name: Logic Circuit: Marble Puzzle
short_description: Marble Puzzle to spend time, where you must fulfill up to 60 challenges! Move the pieces to create a path and get the metal marbles to reach the base of the board, you must make each of the bases fall a corresponding number of marbles.

name: MORODASHI SUMO
short_description: Do you know the traditional Japanese national sport 'Morodashi Sumo'? You can use any hand, so let's remove the opponent's 'Mawashi'. If you make the opponent 'Morodashi', you win.

name: Memory Traces: Japan
short_description: Memory Traces: japan. It's a first-person 3D puzzle where the player needs to restore destroyed artifacts.

name: Action: Vengeance
short_description: Action: Vengeance is a first-person shooter that is the debut project of Knuckle Duster studio. In the game, we play the role of a rebel living in a city enslaved by an armed conflict, whose aim is to destroy the security services and the city's mayor. The game is focused on dynamic action.

name: Ren's Demons I
short_description: Did you think this game was only about saving the world from an army of demons? No. This is a game about YOU. On the surface, it may be a new form of innovative experimental philosophical narrative RPG, but its deeper secrets could make you a god.

name: My Destiny
short_description: My Destiny is a single-player game about a bear cub who follows his mysterious fate,wandering through a cold,but at the same time amazing world.Discover the touching fate of the bear cub and go all the way to the end.

name: Codename Nemesis
short_description: Codename Nemesis is an indie, top down, action/stealth RPG set in a 70's Noir themed world with story rich movie styled cinematics and retro low poly, comic book styled graphics.

name: Fruit Girl Kiss
short_description: A beautiful girl with a bunch of fruit puzzles and you who are racking your brains to solve these mysteries, what kind of sparks will you create? Please wait and see!

name: Arcade Paradise
short_description: Manage profits, pick up gum, do the laundry and get coin to unlock arcade units and flip the family laundromat business to become an Arcade Paradise!

name: Last Night of Winter
short_description: Wake up and walk, Warden! Because the siege continues. We must find the Heir... And finally put an end to this cursed night.

name: Witchhazel Woods
short_description: Your dog has been kidnapped by a lonely ghost! To save her, you must go on a journey through the woods, helping the creatures you meet along the way.

name: DON'T STOP, YOU'LL DIE!
short_description: DON'T STOP, YOU'LL DIE is a top-down arena shooter with bullet hell and roguelike elements where if you stop moving you DIE!

name: Egg Hop
short_description: Use eggs to hop your way through the temple to make your way to the treasure.

name: Just Go
short_description: You will experience from absolute Novice to Top Go player, and show your talents in major Go leagues! The game also includes notable Go matches in history for you to explore. The full-dubbing tutorial for beginners will let you appreciate the charm of Go!

name: Attacker-chan!
short_description: Attacker-chan! is a 2.5D short, roguelike action game with cute animations. Complete your missions by subduing out-of-control mechs.

name: 風色幻想3:罪與罰的鎮魂歌
short_description: 风二发售之后的两年，于２００４年，搭配着全新３Ｄ引擎所推出的「风色幻想Ⅲ～罪与罚的镇魂歌～」。游戏本身在众多玩家的引颈期盼下，再次以战略角色扮演的方式呈现。由于本作品是风色全系列作里唯一以两个主角之观点来述说故事内容的革新之作。因此对该作品如此安排是否得当的赞否两论讨论也在当时讨论的十分火热．．。当然本作依然维持着风色系列优良剧本的传统，它交杂着私人友情与国家大义间挣扎的剧情，甚至还获得了当年「计算机玩家」所举办的『计算机玩家第八届游戏金像奖自制类最佳游戏剧本奖项』之肯定。

name: Super Kenney
short_description: A relaxed and enjoyable platform jumping puzzle adventure game, come and complete the adventure with Kenney! ! !

name: 魔導聖戰:風色幻想
short_description: 于1999年年初推出，同时也是《风色幻想》系列作的首部曲。当年以严谨深奥的故事设定以及较偏动漫风格的画风，在国内尚充斥着一遍武侠风游戏的时代里，出人意外的大放光采，同时也奠定了该系列作品往后的热销基础。当然其中描写的极为深刻的角色互动以及让人惊讶的剧情发展，直到现在亦还有论坛津津乐道的讨论着，可见其当年的人气以及受欢迎的程度。

name: Roadkill
short_description: Roadkill is a fast paced, multiplayer shooter where you drive armed vehicles in post-apocalyptic levels. Upgrade your vehicles and destroy your opponents. It's a simple game, kill or be killed. Inspired by the classic game Twisted Metal .. its fast and fun!

name: Cult of the Lamb
short_description: Start your own cult in a land of false prophets, venturing out into diverse and mysterious regions to build a loyal community of woodland Followers and spread your Word to become the one true cult.

name: Yumahorome ~Toki o Tometa Yakata de Asu o Sagasu Maigo-tachi~
short_description: 《真愿朦幻馆～在时间暂停的洋馆里追寻明天的羔羊们～》是由日本美少女游戏知名品牌Lump of Sugar（方糖社）于2022年6月24日发售的最新力作。本作由由人气画师萌木原文武担当原画与人物设计，由知名剧本家中岛大河创作剧本。片头主题歌《静寂之门》由新锐创作型歌手逢濑晶创作并献唱。

name: Book Quest
short_description: Book Quest is an action adventure RPG presented in retro pixel art style featuring cinematic cutscenes and dialogue. Throughout this medieval fantasy, gameplay alternates between top-down and side-scrolling perspectives.

name: Tyrant's Blessing
short_description: Tyberia has been turned into a paradise by the Tyrant, free from war, suffering, and death - because nearly everyone has been turned into the undead. Take charge of the last living warriors in tactical, turn-based battles and drive the Dead Army into the sea!

name: Arosia
short_description: Arosia is the Tile Map game based on Strategy and Luck. Use your strategy skills with best of luck to occupy World! Don't stop untill the World is yours.

name: War Dots
short_description: Fast paced tug-of-war auto-battler. Unleash hordes of soldiers and wreak havoc upon your enemies!

name: Animal Trail ☆ Girlish Square
short_description: Magical girl idols are here! Get ready for the performance of a lifetime from the idol group Animal Trail ☆ Girlish Square! Gao~!

name: New Tanks
short_description: A new dizzying game about tanks. Dynamic battles that will not let you relax and get bored.

name: Red Hood Adventure
short_description: Red Hood Adventure is a side-scrolling platform slasher game. An alternative story of Little Red Riding Hood, times are difficult and the Hat is armed with weapons. Grandma needs pies again and they need to be delivered. Creatures living in the forests also want pies, and maybe not only.

name: STRANGER
short_description: STRANGER is a Single-player Survival Thriller Horror Game. Choose your house and difficulty, or customize your own. Then survive until dawn. Uncover mysterious truths about the STRANGER. Play on PC Version or VR Version

name: Planetary Defense: An Orbital Turret Defense System
short_description: 2D space shooter and turret defense come together to create the Planetary Defense this world needs! Shoot down asteroids and aliens and survive the bosses in this arcade like game featuring custom built satellites, projectiles and upgradable Cannon and Planet Shield

name: Tightrope Theatre
short_description: Tightrope Theatre is now hiring daredevils! Hop on a shaky unicycle and complete increasingly dangerous tightrope acts! Do you have what it takes to become a superstar?

name: Lightfire Defense
short_description: You are the last Lightfire Keeper. Use the power of the elements to protect your beacon from incoming waves of enemies. Explore mysterious worlds to find a way to prevail over the inevitable.

name: Spider Slingers
short_description: Play as a web-slinging spider and struggle your way to the top in this unforgiving rage platformer.

name: Dodge
short_description: Come to a tense and exciting game, Train your refection. Dodge incoming traps, Get a high score!

name: Stereo Boy
