short_description: Blit, plucky robot astronaut, is stranded on Planet SO-671, a mysterious world that was split in half by an ancient catastrophe. Use Blit’s unique teleportation ability to jump between parallel worlds, solve mind-bending puzzles, and find a way home!

name: Kojimachi
short_description: Kojimachi is a widget style pet game where you can feed and care for your pet on the island you decorate.

name: Super Demon Survivors
short_description: Super Demon Survivors is a homage to time survival reverse bullet hells, set in a familiar world pitting multiple characters against hordes of demons and monsters in a multistage free for all.

name: 骸亡禁决：Skeleton King
short_description: A role-playing nonlinear game. 1. Tomb robbing: obtain bones. 2. Summon: resurrect bones. 3. Battle: PK between players' skeletons. 4. Market: free trading skeleton. 5. Occupy: occupy the altar of soul power, absorb soul power alone, and upgrade bones.

name: Neon Circle
short_description: Rotate, think, wait, jump and rotate the screen.

name: SokoChess
short_description: SokoChess is a minimalistic puzzle game about pushing chess pieces. Use your pieces to push the black figures to their destination, but be careful! The opposing pieces will capture yours if you give them the chance!

name: PIP
short_description: PIP — cute puzzle game with pipes. Enjoy a relaxing time connecting pipes.

name: Pitch Black: A Dusklight Story - Episode One
short_description: A narrative driven exploration game. Close your eyes and listen. Uncover. Choose. Fight. All within the dark and eccentric sound world of Pitch Black. The light will know.

name: Magic Сity Detective: Secret Desire Collector's Edition
short_description: The Others are experiencing another trouble. Prevent the upcoming bloody conflict between the elves and vampires! Someone is trying to bring discord to the fragile world of the Others. Will they succeed? It depends on you. Are you up for the challenge?

name: Sissa's Path
short_description: Sissa's Path is a sokoban game where you play as the kitten Sissa! You will have the opportunity to get to know one of the curious hobbies of Sissa's: Playing with her toys! Help Sissa move her toys to the corrrect spot in this fun but challenging game. Can you help Sissa organize her toys?

name: 風色幻想6:冒險奏鳴
short_description: 于２００７年暑假所推出的风色系列「赤与蓝的抉择篇」第二作。承继着系列作各代优点，加上已趋成熟的系统引擎，这套堪称风色系列最精典的巅峰作一上市便得到极大的人气回响，而且本代新导入的「羁绊对话系统」，也让玩家们终于可以自由的挑选同伴里头最为喜欢的角色进行对谈交心，并让结局产生数种不同分歧。另外，也因为其故事内容虽为前作故事发生的三年之后，但由于主要角色皆已不同之故，因此就算您是头一次接触风色系列，也能简单的融入其中。当然若玩家曾接触过前作（五代），那这些耳熟能详的冒险者们从五代至六代间的成长，亦是会让人感到加倍的感动．．．

name: Super Asqr
short_description: Super Asqr is a collection of different game types and modes, both single and multiplayer, offered under one package with simple but elegant visual/audio feature set. Being a live game and guided by community, all these game modes are shaped by player feedback!

name: 風色幻想XX:交錯的軌跡
short_description: 为弘煜科技于2008年6月发行的战棋角色扮演游戏。继『风色幻想５～赤月战争～』与『风色幻想６～冒险奏鸣～』这两部作品成功构筑出完整且立体的「赤与蓝的抉择篇」世界观后，为了承接本系列最后完结篇而于2008年六月底所推出的最新枢纽作品。而本作除了大大改变原本风色系列所使用的ＲＡＰ战斗方式外，还大胆的启用了两名主角，以双重视点的章节交错进行方式立体呈现出整个异世界 「树罗大地」的奇妙世界观，当然这也正好符合了这次所用的标题「ＸＸ」这个代表着「DOUBLE CROSS」的双重交会意含，让这部最新的风色幻想系列作，有了最为不同的玩法与内容。

name: The Cold Forest
short_description: The Cold Forest is a hardcore survival walking simulator game. You have a goal, and it's important, but can you achieve it?

name: Gigant
short_description: Gigant is a horror point and click adventure game. Escape from the terror of the unknown creature 'Gigant' and the conflict that revolves around it.

name: Al Andalus 711: Epic history battle game
short_description: In Al Andalus 711 you don't play as a warrior, but as a villager who tries to survive in a country that is being invaded and must face the risky roads, the lack of experience and the constant danger of enemy soldiers and hostile bandits.

name: Arcade Waifu
short_description: A relaxing puzzle game with girls who love games.

name: Aim Trainer X
short_description: Aim Trainer X is a challenging aim training assistant that helps you improve your reactions, reflexes and all-around aiming.

name: Paranormal Preparatory School
short_description: This school for supernaturals isn't hell, but it is a hellmouth! Can you make peace between the vampires and werewolves, and close the portal to hell?

name: Fantôme
short_description: Fantôme is a multiplayer (5 vs 1) psychological - horror game where you play with friends to Escape or as a Grifter, betray your friends and offer them as a sacrifice, to win.

name: Chico and the Magic Orchards
short_description: Solve puzzles by rolling a giant walnut in this retro-handheld-inspired adventure. Explore a variety of levels each with unique mechanics. Help Chico build his winter stash and find his way home!

name: Super Bullet Break
short_description: Save the world of online multiplayer games from a rogue AI in this deck-building strategy roguelite! Collect more than 160 cute and colourful Bullets as you move through maps based on iconic game genres and defeat enemies in challenging turn-based combat.

name: Collapsed
short_description: Challenge your mind with a 3D physics-based puzzle game. Take control of a cannon and use your limited supply of cannonballs to bring each level crashing to the ground. Using gravity, momentum, and logic, plan how to knock down each structure and leave nothing standing after the collapse!

name: Milliopoly - Language Quiz and Learning
short_description: Become a millionaire by using your foreign language knowledge. Invite your friends and family!

name: Breakthrough
short_description: Breakthrough is an hardcore roguelike-shooter with high risk/rewards mechanics. Help Clunky see the sunset behind the mountain by fighting tireless monsters. Both balanced and very difficult, Breakthrough will conquer the heart of thoses seeking a great challenge.

name: Limited Lifetime Corp
short_description: Lead your LLC to its inevitable destruction in this day by day management sim. Harvest resources, make a profit, expand your Corp. But be careful; from the local fauna to the Syndicate, no one wants you to succeed.

name: Monkey Milk
short_description: You're monkey must collect fruit to process into delicious beverages while avoiding not-so-friendly creatures that live alongside the groves of fruit in this level based, top down game.

name: Idle Hero
short_description: Idle Hero is a reference game in its genre. No endless walkthrough and unreachable goals. Everything is completable with guaranteed fun, pleasure and challenging but fair tasks.

name: Revenge of the Orcs: Flag of Conquest
short_description: A fantasy visual novel about the end of an era when humans and orcs are at war. Driven by a burning desire for revenge, one orc hoists a flag of rebellion. Soon, it will become a flag of conquest!

name: Plane Attack
short_description: Control an airplane with a third-person view, and your task is to destroy all enemy equipment on the battlefield. Stock up on armor and fuel to last longer on the battlefield. The plane is equipped with an endless supply of missiles and bombs. Minimal interface and understandable for any language.

name: Arctictopia
short_description: Arctictopia is a puzzle-solving game in the Arctic Ocean. Figure out routes and plan your moves to help mama polar bear find her cub on the melting ice.

name: My Bunny Girl
short_description: One day a lonely guy finds an amulet and puts it on his pet. His rabbit is transformed into a beautiful girl. He is embarrassed and does not even know what to say, but for the beauty girl he is not a stranger, because he is her master!

name: 風色幻想5:赤月戰爭
short_description: 在风色幻想前系列「菲利斯多篇」完美结束后的一年，由风色幻想原制作班底所全力打造，在故事与游戏设定内容上完全创新的全新作品。其中，双女主角的设定概念导入，加上轻小说式易读幽默又不失深刻设定的剧情内容、以及经由电子报形式发行的「弥赛亚公报」等等概念，都成功的让这款特别针对新一代玩家族群所精心设计的作品，在甫上市后便获得各大入口论坛的一致好评与推荐，也重新让风色系列在当时已日渐示微的单机游戏市场里，重新取得活力并开辟了另一片天空。

name: Colorful Recolor
short_description: Colorful Recolor is a fast-paced puzzle game with a kaleidoscopic collection of brain teasers. Play through 100 levels with engaging mechanics, striking biomes, 10+ distinct elements, and an abundance of colors. Paint your way through this colorful world!

name: ProjectZombieSurvivors
short_description: Level-based x Wave-based Zombie ShooterYou gain experience by defeating zombies and gain skill points as you level up!There are a total of 27 different skills! You can gain experience by defeating zombies and gain skill points as you level up!Explore the city and collect items!

name: Ashen Will
short_description: Trapped, and with enemies closing in, your only chance of survival is to rely on the simple camera you hold. Ashen Will is an atmospheric maze-based horror game, where your options are preciously low. No one is coming to help. No one is coming to save you. Survive.

name: 風色幻想4:聖戰的終焉
short_description: 故事直接承续着风Ⅲ结局发展，甚至风Ⅲ的记录还能直接共享，可说是风色幻想系列作自Ⅰ代至今的「菲利斯多篇」之大完结。因此其内容除了有着超豪华的历代著名角色大集合外，贯穿数代间、延续千万年的层层谜题也在本作中逐一的解开，并引起诸多让人赞叹的游戏高潮，可说是风色幻想系列自风一推出以来的六年里，最为精彩且壮大的完结之作。

name: City Eye
short_description: In the world of City Eye, you’ll become an operator of the Central Monitoring System, who will try to prevent the effects of every single transgression in the game. Use city maps to track dangerous areas and don’t let the suspects run away from the Police.

name: Lost in Play
short_description: Go on a feel-good adventure with a brother and sister as they explore dreamscapes and befriend magical creatures. Lost in their imagination, Toto and Gal must stick together and solve puzzles to journey back home. This whimsical puzzle adventure game will make you feel like you're playing a cartoon!

name: AsteroIdle
short_description: An asteroid mining based idle game. Travel in space and discover.

name: Underwater battles
short_description: Underwater battles - casual puzzle game made in 2D graphics.

name: Harry Is A Porter
short_description: One day, you suddenly find yourself a porter who is driving a truck in a village. Your driving skills will be perfected after completing different tasks. When you become proficient in driving your truck, you can challenge more interesting levels.

name: Under Waves
short_description: Under Waves is an arena shooter survival mini-game inspired by arcade classics. Boost your energy levels, killing endless waves of enemies, battling for high scores. Includes great 80's synthwave soundtrack!

name: Hide Alone
short_description: You try to play dangerous hide and seek with a doll at home alone. Started out of curiosity, this hide-and-seek game has rules that must be followed or your life will be at risk. Never get caught by them, stay calm and survive to the end.

name: OrbiTank
short_description: Tanks in space!

name: Garden Guardian
short_description: Take control of master gardener Snippy Shrubs and keep your garden safe at all costs! A new take on classic LCD games, rethought through a modern lens! Complete objectives through 18 Trial levels, or hop into the four Endless levels to show that you can garden with the best of them!

name: Scare Train VR
short_description: Scare Train VR is a Ghost Train in fully immersive Virtual Reality. A six-minute ride through a Creepy abandoned mine, that is far from empty. Please take a seat and Prepare for Suspense and Jump Scares. Are you brave enough to ride the Scare Train?

name: Cartomancy Anthology
short_description: Dive into the world of divination with the Cartomancy Anthology, a collection of introspective and compact digital experiences presented together in a virtual tarot deck.

name: Escape the Backrooms
short_description: Escape the Backrooms is a 1-4 player co-op horror exploration game. Traverse through eerie backrooms levels while avoiding entities and other danger to try and escape. Free content updates with new levels and game modes keep the community rewarded.

name: BombViking
short_description: It is a run game. You must use a mouse and keyboard. Run for a high score

name: NEAVE 2
short_description: Explore the world of NEAVE 2 as you hunt for magical floating cubes. If you're feeling competitive, race for the fastest time to claim a top spot on the leaderboard.

name: Rasetsu Fumaden
short_description: In the Edo period, in a world where demons, humans, and gods exist together, Rasetsu Raki, a princess of the demon tribe who possesses great sealing powers, helps people and defeats the enemies by skillfully using various 'sword techniques' and 'barrier techniques'.

name: Dead District: Survival
short_description: Dead District is a multiplayer and single-player survival sandbox game in an open world where the player has a wide range of options.

name: Axiom Verge 2
short_description: Explore a sprawling, alien world in the sequel to the award winning Axiom Verge.

name: Putinist Slayer
short_description: Putinist Slayer is a fast-paced action about destroying putinists in deep space. Let loose in infinity roguelike shoot’em up with sticky gameplay. Kill hordes, dodge, upgrade, eliminate bosses and reach new highest records! With memes from Ukraine.

name: Nonozle
short_description: A number logic puzzle game. Solve nonograms to form pixel-art images. Features 200 hand-made puzzles.

name: Pulling No Punches
short_description: A classic 2D arcade action game animated frame by frame. Survive a fictional pandemic in a city filled with madness and denial.

name: Moondrop
short_description: Moondrop is a cozy farming roguelite. Build a farm on a shifting mountain. Find treasure in its hidden trails. Use your skill at farming and alchemy to hold off the vanishing mists. When they inevitably arrive, retreat and rebuild the village to upgrade your next farm. Can you reach the summit?

name: Pinch of Fighting Girls
short_description: Pinch of Fighting Girls is a cute sideways action fighting game! You must control the fighting girls and clear all the monsters in the map!

name: LEGENO SLAYER
short_description: Use and combine powerful weaponsDefeat all the endless waves of enemies.And become a Regeno Slayer.

name: Farthest Frontier
short_description: Protect and guide your people as you forge a town from untamed wilderness at the edge of the known world. Harvest raw materials, hunt, fish and farm to survive. Produce crafted items to trade, consume, equip and fight with as you battle for your survival against the elements and outside threats.

name: Way On Where
short_description: Kyle the master thief, in an unexpected turn of events meets new people. Little does he know, this will lead to new beginnings and his life wont be the same anymore !

name: Two Point Campus
short_description: Build the university of your dreams with Two Point Campus, the sim with a twist from the makers of Two Point Hospital. Build, hire staff and run an academic institution packed with wild courses.

name: Marvel’s Spider-Man Remastered
short_description: In Marvel’s Spider-Man Remastered, the worlds of Peter Parker and Spider-Man collide in an original action-packed story. Play as an experienced Peter Parker, fighting big crime and iconic villains in Marvel’s New York. Web-swing through vibrant neighborhoods and defeat villains with epic takedowns.

name: Party Bunch
short_description: Psychological and fun game with lots of game modes for a big group of friends!

name: SGS Operation Downfall
short_description: Project Manhattan failed! Operation Downfall, the Allied plan for the invasion of the Japanese home islands is set in motion. Start with Operation Olympic to capture Kyushu, and move on with Coronet, the landing near Tokyo. Force Japan surrender with the largest amphibious operation in history.

name: Timothy and the Tower of Mu
short_description: Ascend the tower to save your grandfather in this classic, hardcore action-platformer. The Tower of Mu is waiting for you... Push past each check point to the next awaiting challenge; dashing, jumping, and slinging your way up to the towers peak. Die. learn. Overcome.

name: Mutagenic
short_description: Mutagenic is an upcoming rogue-lite with simple controls, yet engaging mechanics. The rules are simple: mutate, kill, collect, unlock, die. Repeat. Kill monsters, collect mutagen, spend mutagen to upgrade characters. Mutagen is not permanent, how will you spend it?

name: Tower Fall
short_description: Tower Fall is a fun PC alternative to the board game known as 'falling tower'.

name: Sail
short_description: Open World VR Pirate Adventure Game!

name: 風色幻想SP:封神之刻
short_description: 以全新故事为主轴的《风色幻想ＳＰ》，除了再一次以极为震憾动人的深刻内容与华丽的人物风格获得了玩家们极大回响外，它成熟的内容系统亦也让该作品创造了更胜前作的爆发性销售量，甚至还获得了当年代表着最有人气的游戏大奖GAMESTAR之肯定，可说是实至名归的千禧年PCGAME界代表作品。当然，这款简称为风ＳＰ的风色异色作，亦是老玩家们最为津津乐道、风色迷决不能错过的风色经典之作。

name: Invader Signal
short_description: Invader Signal - In this game, you choose a certain color of your charge to destroy asteroids flying in your direction, which can change their colors and cluster. You need to be careful when striking, as spaceships are constantly flying in front of you, which cannot be touched!

name: Matcha
short_description: Matcha is a simple puzzle game, built around the beautiful Korean writing system, Hangul.

name: Bloodwatch
short_description: Bloodwatch is a short horror game about surviving at all cost on the island when the maniacs are trying to find and kill you. Explore, finding weapons, items, find the leader and kill him.

name: Catizens
short_description: Inspired by RimWorld and The Sims, Catizens is a colony management simulation game where you watch over unique cats with quirky personalities, as you help them build and grow their settlement while exploring new lands, facing off against wildlife and overcoming the challenges of each environment.

name: Space Crusaders
short_description: Try to survive the demon onslaught in this fast-paced top-down shooter. Battle oncoming enemies as they try to destroy you, collect their souls to level up your character and weapons. Collect relics and unlock new characters and weapons to become more powerful!

name: A Tale of Paper: Refolded
short_description: A Tale of Paper: Refolded is a puzzle-platformer that tells the story of Line, a magical character made of paper who can use origami to change its shape. Transform into a frog, a rocket, a bird and more as Line embarks on an emotional journey to fulfill the dream of its creator.

name: GALXAGAR
short_description: 'Don't go to GALXAGAR'; a phrase uttered by many who have traversed its rim. Untold treasures, and terrors, await within its blackened depths. Ready your craft, spacefarer, because you're about to enter the most dangerous sector in all the stars. Get ready.. for GALXAGAR!

name: 异世界的回响千雪之歌
short_description: The protagonist Qian Xue died unexpectedly after working too hard. Unexpectedly, he was favored by the God of life because of his special 'talent' in his soul after death, and he also got the opportunity to resurrect. However, resurrection always requires a price.

name: Magus Pocus
short_description: A 2D platform action adventure game. With medieval fantasy setting. Composed of 9 phases divided into 2 stages and at the end of each stage a boss. With simple and fun movement where you defeat your enemies by jumping on them or using your magic sword. The game will provide you with hours of fun.

name: Slaycation Paradise
short_description: Are you tired of the same boring old vacations? Then boy have we got the tonic for you! Slaycation Paradise offers the ultimate in multi-dimensional apocalyptic tours. Slay away your worries with Twin-Stick action mixed with Tower Defence as you visit the end-of-world scenarios of your dreams!

name: City Block Builder
short_description: Experience a beautiful tycoon management style game that allows you to build your own business empire in Los Angeles during the 1950s era. Manage businesses ranging from Movie Theaters to Jazz Clubs to Restaurants and more!

name: Happy's Clocks
short_description: Run around an enormous mysterious house that once belonged to your dad, while running away from terrifying monsters and solving interesting puzzles. Discover what happened or maybe what was supposed to happen when you left.

name: ALTAIR BREAKER
short_description: Enter the world of ALTAIR and fight against the army of LAWS left behind roaming around Vastus Isle in this Map-based Sword Fighting VR game. Team up with your friends and experience the feeling of transcendent battles in VR.

name: 双线交锋：收获日
short_description: are you ready? Soldiers, take up your weapons and let your footprints cover the harvest battlefield! This is a very hard core game, independently developed by sun Shen game studio

name: We Are OFK
short_description: From indie pop band OFK: the Music Biopic series and Interactive E.P. about four friends dreaming, dating, and paying rent in Los Angeles. A story of the creative process, and the things that get in the way.

name: The witch of the Ihanashi
short_description: This game does not support English, the following is Japanese description.沖縄の離島へ引っ越した少年は、世話になるはずだった祖父が蒸発したことを知らされる。離島での自活を覚悟したとき、魔女を名乗る少女と出会った。異界の魔法を扱う少女と琉球文化の根付く離島での生活。二人を待ち受ける運命とは────。

name: Termalloc
short_description: Connect terminals to the server. Securities are coming. Keep yourself safe.

name: Neodash
short_description: Drift at full speed across gaps, traps, and neon-drenched environments that react to a captivating soundtrack. Build and play community-made tracks, or dive straight into a spectacular campaign.

name: The Unsettled
short_description: The Unsettled is a first-person psychological horror game. You, as a paranormal investigator, is on a journey to find a missing girl. In order to find the truth, you plan to visit a boarding school in the Indian Himalayan Region.

name: Way of the Hunter
short_description: Become the new owner of a hunting lodge nestled among gorgeous habitats and rich animal populations. Explore vast open world environments and hunt with a premium selection of firearms. Enjoy the perfect hunt on your own or with friends in co-op.

name: Galaxy Survivors
short_description: Shoot alien invaders, upgrade your ship, level up your weapons and save planets to defend against the invasion. Choose your favorite between the different unlockable ships and buy perks between your runs to ensure victory. After you triumph, hunt for achievements and ascend to save more universes

name: Dann Fox & The Time Machine
short_description: A third person platformer with fast paced combat, beautiful cartoon graphics and challenging levels that explore different time periods in History! Upgrade your character and use a variety of weapons to fight enemies and bosses!

name: This rain will never end - noir adventure detective
short_description: This rain will never end unless you discover who killed the mayor of the city!

name: 3D Pacman
short_description: '3D Pacman' is a casual game. The player controls a Pac-Man to move, and when Pacman touches the small square, he can eat the small square.

name: ZooKeeper
short_description: Become a Zoo Keeper, manage and build the zoo of your childhood dreams! Take care of the animals and create ideal conditions for them. Grow your zoo, add extraordinary species and prepare amazing attractions for visitors.

name: Nightmare Hunter
short_description: One day in the dream, some one showed up and claimed there is a dream called paradise. From that day, dream demons that can suck human memory and spirit increased. In order to make everything return to its original state, Yoru, who awakened as a demon hunter, decided to challenge the initiator.

name: RockSlide
short_description: A simple game about run away from rocks and others dangers, How long do you survive?

name: Food Factory
short_description: Food Factory is game where players can produce food using various machines starting from gathering base products.

name: WHY I was Born
short_description: 'I was born without knowing what to do with my life, and I just rolled with life...' Trace the life of an ordinary man and search for the meaning of life in this ball action adventure.

name: 黄金矿工大冒险
short_description: 'Gold Miner Adventure' is a cartoon-style casual game. Players need to control their claws to catch gold, and they can pass the level after reaching certain points.

name: Fashion Police Squad
short_description: Even at this moment, our fashionable city is under assault. Baggy pants, dull suits, sightings of socks with sandals. A message needs to be sent, and it needs to be sent in style... Time to serve some good ol' Fashion Justice!

name: Neko Journey
short_description: Jump into this attractive and mysterious world! Save your lovely sister and the mythical creatures that inhabit it, imprisoned in the fortified castle by an elderly wizard!

name: Vesper: Ether Saga - Episode 1
short_description: Live the adventures of Vesper, the comic book heroine, through a video game mixing role-playing, tactical and card game features, with graphics mingling traditional watercolor drawings and pixel art. Come and discover the world imagined by Jérémy.

name: Madcap Mosaic
short_description: Carefully craft your Mosaic in this fantasy themed deckbuilding game. Battle by battle, tile by tile, you'll form synergies and build up your Mosaic's combo potential, hoping to beat the curve as you forge deeper into enemy territory.

name: Hammer 2 Reloaded
short_description: 'Hammer 2 Reloaded' is a first-person shooter game. Players take on the role of a sharpshooter and fight against the forces of darkness in another city.

name: Summer Games
short_description: Compete in a wide variety of athletic events in this classic game from the 1980s, including pole vault, gymnastics, 100 m dash, and skeet shooting. Included are the ZX Spectrum, Amstrad CPC, Atari 2600 and Sega Master System versions.

name: CosmoOdyssey:Trip to Mars
short_description: CosmoOdyssey: Trip to Mars is a first-person spaceship adventure with a special Ukrainian flavor.

name: Trouble Town
short_description: Online game based on teamwork. Play with your friends and join one of the class groups to win.

name: Madden NFL 23
short_description: Play your way into the history books. Control your impact with every decision in all-new ways. Call the shots in Franchise with free agency and trade logic updates, leave a legacy in Face of the Franchise: The League, and assemble the most powerful roster in all of Madden Ultimate Team™.

name: Eyes Over Us
short_description: Eyes Over Us is a surreal procedurally generated narrative strategy game were you will play as a Lovecraftian entity watching over two humans being experimented with. The power to change everything it's on your hands..wait? do you even have hands?...tentacles?

name: cheesequest
short_description: A dark card game where you try to eat the cheese.

name: Flappy Bird
short_description: 'Flappy Bird' is a casual game in which the player controls a cute bird through obstacles after obstacles.

name: We See You
short_description: We See You is a rhythm based down-scrolling runner. You play as a pair of eyes trying to go as deep as possible, avoiding enemies moving in different patterns with a goal to get a good score to top the leaderboard.

name: Deus Novum
short_description: Deus Novum is the god game you've been waiting for. Cast miracles with the power of your villager's prayer, train your creature to behave or misbehave, build elaborate villages, and fight back against the forces of evil.

name: Underworld Re: Card
short_description: Japanese Anime Style X Roguelike Deck-building CCGReborn into Underworld As A Hero!'Underworld Re: Card' is a game that combines deck-building and Rogue-like elements. Players are reborn into various races to fight and explore in the fantasy world.

name: BattlefieldPriest
short_description: this is a RTS strategy game,if you like Warcraft or Command & Conquer you maybe like this game players controller a priest to healing soldiers and choose which kind of soldiers the kingdom need , killing monters and murch for their nests

name: Dream magic will
short_description: This is a highly difficult magic strategy tower defense exploration game. You need to explore the big map and collect all kinds of cards, heroes and magic to fight. There are many levels in the game. You need to make strategic arrangements to resist the attack of all enemies and win.

name: Anomalous Zone ███
short_description: Containing breakthrough? Supernatural invasion? Space-time chaos? A serious supernatural event has occurred in ██████. You will play the role of an investigator involved in the incident, facing the unknown environment and defeating the terrifying enemy.

name: Cursed to Golf
short_description: Cursed to Golf is a golf-like adventure where every shot counts. Players are tasked with making it out of Golf Purgatory to become a Golfing Legend. With insane hazards, otherworldly power-ups and tons of replayability, will you make it back alive or will you forever be… Cursed to Golf!?

name: Monster Breakout
short_description: Break bricks, dodge attacks, collect power-ups, and defeat all the Monsters in ten different worlds featuring a unique boss, soundtrack, and theme!

name: Rune Teller
short_description: Become a powerful Rune Teller traveling through the open world of the Runegea. Recruit great colleagues for a fun journey, craft through a variety of items, and solve the requests of the Runegea residents. At the end of a long journey, you will find the reason for your resurrection.

name: Anvil Life
short_description: In this game that offers unlimited fun in Singleplayer, Sandbox game type; You will be able to upgrade your items, expand your military, win loot with quests, and try many combinations to bring the characters to the state you want.

name: Backpack Hero
short_description: The inventory management roguelike! Collect rare items, organize your bag, and vanquish your foes!

name: Cahertis
short_description: In a medieval fantasy world, you play Frey Modnos, a young royal guard recruit, and you will have to free the Athara continent from a great threat.

name: Missing Persons
short_description: Missing Persons is a horror-survival game that you play as an officer to uncover the truths behind reported paranormal encounters and missing person cases near Southern California.

name: Rollerdrome
short_description: Rollerdrome is a third person action shooter that seamlessly blends high octane, visceral combat with fluid movement and tricking mechanics into one complementary and challenging whole, to create an original adrenaline-pumping shooter experience like no other.

name: Pandea Stones
short_description: In the game you play the Pandean hero, Tin, which has a mission to save his planet from alien threat. You will be facing many obstacles thru different environments, where you will meet angry robots and funny looking animals.

name: Grand Hike
short_description: Go on a unique and unforgettable Hike and discover the old historical forest and it's secrets. Get ready for an calm and relaxing adventure far away from the civilization. What kinds of encounters will your Hike have?

name: 大江湖之苍龙与白鸟
short_description: 传统战棋SRPG，150+武功秘籍，分为：剑法、刀法、棍仗、拳掌、指法、特殊、音律、酒艺、盗术类武学，3主线剧情，30+可邀请的江湖队友

name: Bounty of One
short_description: Fallen hero of the Wild West, you’re wanted and in disgrace! Grab your guns, survive endless hordes of bounty hunters and fight to clear your name! Bounty of One is a fast-paced casual roguelite bullet hell for 1 to 4 players. Dash, Dodge, Shoot, Repeat!

name: Wizcave
short_description: Take on the role of a magician and explore the mystery of underground caves. Fight monsters and try to recover the artifact from these caves, use your staff to summon spells. The road will not be restless, you will encounter many obstacles and enemies during your journey.

name: Expedition Agartha
short_description: Expedition Agartha is a hardcore multiplayer First Person Looter Survival game. Explorers and Mercenaries from around the world find themselves on a mysterious island in the Lost Continent of Mu. Launch your expedition, encounter ruthless enemies, and discover the secrets of Agartha.

name: Don't Die, Mr. Robot! DX
short_description: Deep in the electro-abyss lives a little robot who loves to eat exploding fruit. He also likes staying alive. That’s where you come in… Get the fruit. Avoid the enemies. Try not to die. (Spoilers: you will die).

name: Dragon Mine
short_description: Go through the numerous mazes and try to get to the cave full of gold waiting at the end, but remember - the journey won't be easy. Think fast and move precisely to get to the exit - any delay may result in the escape portal to be covered with mysterious water, blocking your way out.

name: I commissioned some bees 5
short_description: I paid 10 more artists to hide bees in their artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

name: Red Matter 2
short_description: Red Matter 2 is an adventure that takes place during a dystopian Cold War whose events unfold after Red Matter. It is the story of how people trapped in a reality created by their rulers, rebel against their destiny and fight to do the right thing.

name: Don't Get Distracted
short_description: Don't Get Distracted is a horror themed rage game. Just press and hold the buttons that pop up on the monitors, easy enough right?

name: 东方光耀夜 ~ Lost Branch of Legend
short_description: Welcome to Eientei, combine multiple colors of mana to build your ideal deck, duel with gensokyo girls, and chase back the mysterious moon treasure. Also, enjoy the unpredictable Roguelike with fantasy Danmaku!

name: Sir Whoopass™: Immortal Death
short_description: Meet Sir Whoopass, the hero from the small indie studio Atomic Elbow, who due to a series of hilarious and poor life choices manages to bring chaos and disarray to an utopian world. He must find The Legendary Villain-Beating Artifact™ to vanquish The Immortal and stop him!

name: Blossom Tales II: The Minotaur Prince
short_description: The Minotaur King has returned...and it's all your fault! Lily's back for a new 'classic' action-adventure set hundreds of years after The Sleeping King!

name: Treehouse Riddle
short_description: 'Treehouse Riddle' is an adventure game where you unfold its story by solving riddles and puzzles. Just like the treehouse itself, the 60+ riddles and puzzles are made of wood.

name: Timberman VR - grab an axe, chop trees, beat records!
short_description: Timberman, the devilishly addictive retro-style arcade video game goes 3D and beyond. It’s now available in VR! Take a deep dive into a game that is easy to learn but not-so-easy to master. Discover whole heaps of fun in a brand new type of reality - a virtual reality!

name: Reed The Robotanist Plus
short_description: Reed the Robotanist is a fast-paced 3D platformer where you use the recoil of your gun to navigate and blast your way through numerous crazy levels, all to take down a megalomaniacal oil baron!

name: Mobmania
short_description: Defeat various bosses that get thrown at you using an arsenal of unique weapons, items, and character abilities. Can you survive the onslaught of monsters?

name: Land of chaos
short_description: 'Land of chaos' is an rpg+ lightweight rougelike independent game based on Diablo like forms. The author is still in the process of learning and exploring the game production, and he also apologizes for this. There are still many bugs in the game, but the author will continue to update it.

name: Night Flight
short_description: Pixel RPG Roguelike Shooter based on ATARI games. Shoot, survive and level up your ship. How long can you survive?

name: Hidden Cube World Top-Down 3D
short_description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

name: A Last Will and TESTament: Horror adventure
short_description: Yet another normal first-person adventure horror game in an escape room style with nice graphics, inventory, story, voiceover and good price & gameplay. Solve puzzles, collect notes. Fulfill the last will and find a testament. Loosely inspired by Play with Me: Escape room.

name: NONOGRAM - KAWAII CUTIES
short_description: This game, called 'NONOGRAM', is a logic puzzle that correctly fills the squares from the given hints. Solve the puzzles and complete the 'cute' picture!

name: Lost and Hound
short_description: Lost and Hound is a scent hound adventure following the reluctant yet strong-willed Corgi, Biscuit. Hunt down criminals, help people that are in trouble or lost, solve mysteries and save lives in this blind-accessible canine story.

name: Spelldash
short_description: Spelldash is a hardcore FPS speedrunning game where you kill enemies mid-air to reset your double jump and dash to traverse the levels in your unique way

name: Thymesia
short_description: Thymesia is a gruelling action-RPG with fast-paced combat and an intricate plague weapon system. In a kingdom where death spreads, play as a mysterious character known by the code name 'Corvus'. Prey upon your enemies, wield the power of disease and find the truth in your own memories.

name: World Serpent
short_description: Take control of giant snake monster consuming everything in its way! Nowhere is safe from you on this planet! Not even in space.

name: cyVeRpunk
short_description: cyVeRpunk is a fast-paced VR on-rail shooter where the player works for the mob in a futuristic cyberpunk-themed city. No motion sickness.

name: Self-Delusion
short_description: Self-Delusion is a first-person survival horror in the original setting of grim fairy tales. You will faces such unique monsters like: Kolobok, Leshy, Boggart, Lapot and other strange characters. Explore, hide or run. Just don't get devoured by them.

name: KIKURA
short_description: The second installment of the '刻一刻(KIK)' series!'Utsushiyochigai'It is a world that exists parallel to the present world in which we live, a world inhabited by gods and Yokai.This story is a new generation Urashima Taro, in which two girls confront yokai in order to solve the cursed beach incident!

name: Your Love Story 被你忘记的那个夏天
short_description: This is a AVG with love as the theme. No matter how old you grow, every summer when cicadas sing, you can still remenber of your childhood dreams, childhood friends with whom you share memories, and those pure and shining love like crystal.

name: Last Visit
short_description: Last Visit is a combination of an adventure game and survival horror. Discover a captivating story full of secrets and fear. Dark atmosphere, constant sense of danger and various puzzles will make you never forget this experience.

name: Kalinur
short_description: Defeat the mage Kalinur and bring peace back to the kingdom in this mini metroidvania with a lot of action.

name: Financial freedom for the few
short_description: The simulator of the Road to financial freedom, players will start as a college graduate entering the society, through work, investment, passive income and other ways to improve financial, family and physical and mental health, to achieve financial freedom. Help him push the wheels of his fate.

name: Frail Hearts: Versicorae Domlion
short_description: Frail Hearts: Versicorae Domlion is an old-school JRPG with a deep and mysterious storyline placed in a fictional dark city of Gris. Explore the story of four troubled souls and kill the abominations that threaten the existence of reality itself.

name: Fragment Hunters
short_description: Crystal Souls: Fragment Hunters is a top down indie space game where you shoot enemy ships, gather crystals, and upgrade your own ship.

name: DOMINUS RAGE
short_description: Hardcore Beat 'Em Up is a game, created in the best traditions of old masters. Fight to defeat all your enemies. Dominus feels that the Tavor has come back to life again. He returns to Altran, where his enimies are waiting for him.

name: Periphery
short_description: A refugee capsule lands on an uninhabited planet. You have to survive, rebuild civilization and, if possible, regain control over the Earth. One big universe, one endless pvp session for all players.

name: Light
short_description: The protagonist is to commemorate the Syrian boy on the beach, control the character to escape and solve mysteries in my fictional inner world, understand the worldview of the game and the cruelty of past wars during this period, and finally make their own real choices.

name: Regiments
short_description: Regiments is a Real-Time Tactics game set in Germany 1989. The Cold War has gone hot, and the inferno is raging. Lead your Regiment through the fires of conflict and the fog of war. Break through the lines, call in artillery, maneuver, feign retreats, stage defenses, counter-attack. Do not relent.

name: Redhot Rabbit
short_description: 1922...The Big Apple...Mugsy's turf got plucked by a gang of trouble boys. The ever-lovin' jazz rabbit is gonna jump on heads and clip those goons. He'll bop his way to the biggest boss and take back what's his or get zotzed, ya' follow? Soundtrack is the bee's knees - truly hep and jake.

name: Ember Crusade IV
short_description: Ember Crusade IV is a twin stick looter shooter roguelike where you embark on a blazing crusade to save the solar system from a demonic invasion.

name: Berserk Soccer
short_description: A soccer game with a brutal playing style.

name: YONESAWARA HOSPITAL
short_description: In 1978, the clinic was closed due to the sudden disappearance of the director. Ten years later, a phone call to an investigator sets the story in motion. What happened to the director? The investigators go to the abandoned clinic to track down the disappearances that occurred in the past.

name: Ikonei Island: An Earthlock Adventure
short_description: Explore. Gather resources. Craft tools and gear, build your base, and farm the land. Thwart pirates, fight monsters, and befriend magical creatures. Embark on this wholesome adventure: Ikonei is yours to discover! Multiplayer coming soon!

name: Kati The Astronaut
short_description: Help Kati the Astronaut traverse the depth of space and defeat enemies to save the universes!

name: ESCAPE IT
short_description: A man has been trapped in a house. He doesn't remember anything, but he knows that he should leave the house as soon as possible. He encounters many unique challenges, which require his brain to work at its best. Will he be able to make it out? Or is he going to stay in the house forever?

name: Climb Challenge - Castle
short_description: The player needs to climb the building by clinging and climbing the walls.

name: First Date : Late To Date
short_description: FIRSTDATE: LATE TO DATE is a romantic-comedy interactive cinematic (FMV) game in which the audience determines the progress of the movie with the options that appear every minute.

name: Adventure Trip: New York Collector's Edition
short_description: Want to experience the adventure of the Big Apple? From the lush green Central Park to the city view from the Brooklyn Bridge and beautiful historical landmark such as the classic Rockefeller Center. The game will take you through 20 ethereal locations.

name: Little League World Series Baseball 2022
short_description: Little League World Series Baseball 2022 allows you to Pitch, Slide, Slam, and Rally your way to Williamsport-glory as you compete to become the World Series CHAMPION of Little League®!

name: Untitled Crossing Record
short_description: 未命名穿越记录是一款异世界题材的团队养成策略游戏，讲述一名小说家意外穿越到自己的作品中，在与自己创作的背景似是而非的世界里建立自己的公会、探险并获得足以影响世界的力量、揭露时空扭曲的真相并寻找同样迷失在异世界中的青梅竹马的故事。

name: Silent Love
short_description: This is a terrorist decryption adventure game that took place in 1913.

name: Far Away From Home
short_description: Far Away From Home is a story-driven tactical RPG. Battle foes in turn-based combat, turn monstrous enemies into friends, customize your party with a variety of builds, and craft powerful gear to enhance your playstyle. Unfold the mystery of your lost party as you try to find a way home.

name: Escape: The Endless Dogwatch
short_description: A point and click adventure game with a horror twist! You play as 2nd Officer Walton on the SS Carolina. Explore the ship, use items, find the crew, and try to survive! A fun, challenging and satisfying experience!

name: Boney's Research On Humans!
short_description: Boney is an aspiring journalist looking for the next big scoop when he gets a tip about a secret lab operation he ends up going to the biggest scoop of his undead life! Now he has to return to Monsternett and share his findings with the undead world!

name: KILLRUN
short_description: Run n' gun parkour speedrunner. Race to set the best times and create the fastest routes. Smash the pro times on every level and unlock new weapon packs as you progress through a prototype playground of replayable FPS mechanics. From the creators of BATTALION.

name: SONOHIGURASHI VS. TOUHOU UNIVERSE2
short_description: 90's-style 2D fighting action in which real-life men fight in cosplay. A major update version of the second series. * This work is a secondary creation game work based on the Touhou Project.

name: Tribe Explorer
short_description: TribeExplorer Is an Retro style 2D Platformer. Play as the Tribe Explorer and try to beat all the different levels littered with sweet platforming, enemies, gravity puzzles and more!

name: CAPTROON
short_description: 'CAPTROON is an arcade game about facing waves of insectons, with a weapon and a shield that can be activated when available.'

name: Mimicry
short_description: Monster vs. human squad in a sci-fi multiplayer online horror game!

name: Idle Zombies Clicker
short_description: Idle Zombies Clicker is a fun and crazy clicker game. No endless walkthrough and unreachable goals. Everything is completable with guaranteed fun, pleasure and challenging but fair tasks.

name: Delusional
short_description: When Kevin, the burglar, gets lost in the woods, he comes across an old abandoned mansion nearby. Later on, he'd decided to rob this mansion. However, he later discovers that the mansion he is attempting to rob is owned by an ex-doctor who is now known as a wanted Psychopathic Murderer.

name: TAMAKAGURA: Tales of Turmoil
short_description: Yuma Nagumo, a young freelance exorcist, struggles between his own ideals and the harsh reality of life around him in this turn-based tactics RPG. As more and more urgent quests pour in, he and his friends protect the land from evil, but a terrible threat rises to stand in their way...

name: The Bridge Curse Road to Salvation
short_description: Fear, anxiety, and laughter are the symbol of youth. Experience the true paranormal haunting with your friends from the first-person perspective and stay alive. The Bridge Curse Road to Salvation is an adaptation of a horror film, includes Taiwanese urban legend and an intriguing backstory.

name: Time Keeper
short_description: Time Keeper is a story driven puzzle platformer where you flip switches, activate devices and solve 'cause and effect' mechanical puzzles. Find lost parts, secure the Temporal Crystals and explore the mysterious Dark Zones while avoiding danger at every turn.

name: 矿老板模拟器
short_description: 'Mine Boss Simulator', as the name suggests, is a game that simulates a mine boss. It is also the sequel to 'Lick Dog Simulator'.

name: Rule No. 2
short_description: Because sometimes all that you really want from life is to be blowing up a bunch of $#!% while also gazing at some chesticles -- as fast and as expeditiously as possible. Sturgeon General's WARNING: 'Risk of Waifus, Guns, Nudity, Instant Action and Mayhem.'

name: Picture Builder
short_description: This is an artistic innovative puzzle. Build pixel pictures from blocks by stacking them on top of each other with partial overlap. (But for those who like to just relax, there are also modes of playing the classic mosaic.)

name: Ambulance Chauffeur Simulator
short_description: You have a green light from the police, because you have to break any traffic rule to do your job well. The more lives saved, the cleaner your karma will be. Always be prepared because the call can come at any time!

name: Justin Wack and the Big Time Hack
short_description: A cozy 2D Point & Click adventure featuring multiple playable characters and plenty of silliness. Oh, and there's time travel and relationship stuff going down too. And robots – lots of robots...

name: Tuin
short_description: Plant seeds, pull weeds and sell vegetables - all while doing something else!

name: Lonely White
short_description: 론리 화이트(Lonely White)는 단순하면서도 빠른 액션과 함께 탐색 요소가 주가 되는 흑백풍 어드벤처 RPG입니다.

name: Queen's Wish 2: The Tormentor
short_description: You are in a barbarian land. They are trying to kill you. The Queen demands you tame them. So what now? Escape into an exciting, open-ended story and cunning tactical combat. Epic, indie fantasy adventure. Freely explore a huge world, fight for fame and power, and shape the world as you choose.

name: Hush Hush - Only Your Love Can Save Them
short_description: A Visual Novel with a twist - improve skills, charm girls, and learn dangerous secrets... by any means necessary.

name: A.V.A Global
short_description: A.V.A is a classic FPS shooter game featuring various types of PVP/PVE game Modes. Depending on the battlefield, you can choose Pointman, Rifleman, and Sniper and enjoy strategic team play.

name: Cannon Canines
short_description: Cannon Canines is a 3D, mini-tank driving, action-adventure game! Play as an adorable dog, and join a crew of freedom-fighting animals in the Pawpad Isles in order to free your friends from a tyrannical megacorporation!

name: Mirror Beauty
short_description: Players play as an adventurer who urgently needs to obtain the spirit of holy water in order to save important people, but at this time, there are a bunch of beautiful women who are eyeing you.

name: 藏梦 Hidden Dream
short_description: “Hidden Dream” is a game about puzzle, exploration and collection in horizontal version. In this game, players are supposed to participate in the story about how did Princess Wencheng complete her journey to Tibet that for getting marry with Srongtsen Gampo in Princess Wencheng’s fantasy world.

name: Deathrun Guys
short_description: Deathrun Guys is an online platform racing game with a Bunnyhop system to gain speed! Compete in competitive mode or against your friends. Run, jump and knock down your enemies to win the race and secure your trophy.

name: Dumb Little Robots
short_description: Dumb Little Robots is a 2d puzzle game where you control robots that each have a single function. Help them work together through 51 levels. Find new robots as you go and learn how they change the possibilities!

name: Hole in the Clouds
short_description: Pop all the clouds and then sink your shot! Hole in the Clouds is a nonstop minigolf game with puzzle and platforming elements. Swing through the trees, block cannon balls, and let off sprinkle bombs on your way to the hole.

name: Saber Ship
short_description: Travel through the spatio-temporal tunnel with your ship. Destroy aerialships to gain enough energy to meet any possible challenges ahead.

name: Morph King
short_description: A single-player Chess variant where you go up against endless enemies while controlling a single piece. Use your wits and a morphing mechanic to outmaneuver swarms of pieces in this arcade, randomized strategy game!

name: The Alchemist Shop: An Apprentice's Life
short_description: Help Faih to deliver well brewed potions to your customers in the best of the alchemist shops! Dive into an innovative experience that mixes Visual Novel and Solitaire. Make your choices, manage your cards and try to impress your master. Are you up to the task?

name: Chompies!
short_description: Chompies! is a cute couch sports game where you fight for the ball to reach the top of the level and score a goal.

name: Force Reboot
short_description: Force Reboot is a fast-paced FPS with rogue-lite elements. Force Reboot is entirely focused on nonstop gameplay. You need to get past all of the rooms as fast as you can.

name: PUTIN IN JAIL
short_description: One more day...

name: Picot Ether
short_description: 『ピコエーテル』は新型ウイルスが蔓延した都市を救う薬剤調合シミュレーションゲームです。 プレイヤーは『Ｒ－ＢＯＷウイルス』が蔓延した都市の診療所医師となり、抗ウイルス薬の開発に勤しみます。

name: PAC-MAN WORLD Re-PAC
short_description: PAC-MAN arrives home on his birthday to find the Ghosts have kidnapped PAC-MAN’s family & friends and ruined his party! Off to the rescue, PAC-MAN sets out to Ghost Island!

name: Race me now
short_description: Race fast, race to win, race to master, race me now!

name: Armored Lab Force VULVEHICLES
short_description: Raze the road less traveled with your Vulvehicle, the ultimate all-purpose armored combat machine! Whether flying through the sky, or burrowing deep underground, these gals stop at nothing to blast through terrain and enemies alike in this comical action STG!

name: Making Lovers After Stories
short_description: Making Lovers After Stories contains the official extra stories for Making Lovers. Experience the crazy stories that are happening to your favorite girls!

name: Noblesse Oblige
short_description: Spark romance amid secrets in a crumbling mansion! What will you sacrifice for love? Can you trust your own heart?

name: Bounce your Bullets!
short_description: You cannot stop moving forward. Your bullets get stronger and stronger after they bounce enough times. Bounce your Bullets! is a casual yet increasingly difficult colorful shmup where you survive for as long as possible against growing waves of enemies.

name: Guild Wars 2
short_description: Guild Wars 2 is an award-winning online roleplaying game with fast-paced action combat, deep character customization, and no subscription fee required. Choose from an arsenal of professions and weapons, explore a vast open world, compete in PVP modes and more. Join over 16 million players now!

name: Quick Tower Defence Ultimate
short_description: Unlock upgrades, talents and colours for your towers to defend against scores of enemies. Battle on over 50 maps of varying difficulty, plus make your own or download more from the workshop

name: Overloop
short_description: A puzzle-platformer set in a dystopian world where the invention of a cloning device has messed things up, big time. Armed with a clone gun and a mighty fine mustache, the chore of saving THE WHOLE OF CIVILIZATION rests on your shoulders. Don’t blow it.

name: A Clumsy Flight
short_description: Shoot down swarms of planes to survive your adventure through the clouds. Make smart upgrade decisions along the way to not get submerged by the hundreds of enemies coming your way.

name: BROK the InvestiGator
short_description: The very first PUNCH & CLICK! Brok is an innovative adventure mixed with beat 'em up and RPG elements. In a grim world where animals have replaced mankind, what kind of detective will you be?

name: Carnivores: Dinosaur Hunt
short_description: Carnivores: Dinosaur Hunt is a first-person hunting simulator where you hunt the largest and most dangerous beasts to ever exist – DINOSAURS.

name: 外道催眠術師と囚われのマリオネット - The Savage Hypnotist's Puppets -
short_description: The girls are deprived of their freedom by hypnosis and their hearts are about to be shattered. Is it possible to escape from this daily life that has turned into hell?

name: Jade Order
short_description: Play as an ancient warrior that has been tasked to light the sealed beacons of its millenary Order. Avoid the impending doom and complete 50 different puzzles as you aid the Jade Goddess cleanse the land from the cursed flames of the plague.

name: Fly to hope
short_description: Fly to hope is a platformer action game. Use your shotgun and machete to overcome enemies. Fight with strong bosses and collect 3 missing part of your aircraft.

name: Starless
short_description: Starless is a stealth-action game with horror elements, inspired by classic works of sci-fi. You wake up on a giant space Ark swarming with dangerous monsters. Will the colonists survive or will they roam the endless space forever?

name: 小虎传：大菠萝深渊
short_description: 这是一款十分看脸的游戏：随机生成十八层大深渊，随机分布地貌和物资，击杀妖怪掉落随机的战利品。随机结识的队伍小伙伴，或是一大助力，或是打酱油的。绿蓝紫橙的装备，获取完全看脸。欧皇也许一路横扫，非酋也能靠技巧通关。一切未知，等待你的探索。

name: Madville+
short_description: Madville+ is an arena shooter with rogue-lite elements, where you fight incoming waves of aliens and customize your guns as you progress. It is designed to have short play sessions (30-40 min) and replayability.

name: ALIEN XENOBLASTER
short_description: Arcade themed game with loads of content such as incel aliens, crude humor, comedic undertone and more.

name: How to Build a Magnificent Kingdom
short_description: The once prosperous kingdom of Avon now lies in tatters with nothing left in its coffers and a pitiful four citizens to its name. Yet even in its darkest hour, Princess Ariadne is determined to restore it to its former glory. Will her perseverance carry her through?

name: Office Racer
short_description: Office racer is a little racing game where you race around your office. RACE FAST AS YOU CAN! Get the racing started! You race like a furious head to win the competition. It a fun racing game and there is a cool backround music bringing the atmosphere. You drive with a RCformula car fast as you can.

name: Islets
short_description: Take to the sky and reunite a fragmented world in this surprisingly wholesome metroidvania! Help Iko adventure across beautiful hand-painted islands, receive letters from a quirky cast of characters, and face powerful monstrous adversaries.

name: Decorporation
short_description: Decorporation is a fast-paced violent FPS that combines roguelike mechanics (random procedural level generation and permadeath) with skill-based style scoring.

name: Pixxxel
short_description: Pixxxel is a game where you can immerse yourself in the colorful world of platform games, but far from simple ones.

name: 禁忌taboo
short_description: 《禁忌》是一款关于表里世界、梦境与现实的悬疑恐怖剧情游戏。 故事围绕中学生徐灿的视角，讲述春游校车事故之后，徐灿意外觉醒某种诡异的感知能力，与神秘少女岳灵药一起重返废弃矿镇调查真相的同时，逐渐寻回被遗忘的记忆……

name: War Tanks
short_description: Control the tank and destroy all the enemies. Monitor the condition of the tank's armor and fuel. You can switch between three views: First-person camera, third-person and top view. Minimal interface and understandable for any language.

name: Soul Hackers 2
short_description: Explore a supernatural RPG with stylish summoners and dark dangers lurking under the neon lights of a cyberpunk Japan. It is up to Ringo, an agent of Aion, to save the world from apocalypse.

name: Islands of Nyne: Battle Royale
short_description: Drop into massive, alien-built arenas and begin the frantic search for weapons and gear - all while trying to stay one step ahead of the advancing plasma field… or the sights of other contenders. ION offers its players a skill-driven, first-person-only Battle Royale all built into a unique sci-fi universe.

name: Marine Survivors
short_description: You are military volunteer. what? you did not volunteer? It's too late! You are already in the middle of the battlefield. kill the alien for the humanity! Marine Survivors is simple action rogue lite game. kill aliens, earn exp gem, upgrade your weapon. unlock various collection.

name: Griddy
short_description: Relax, clear your mind and fill it)

name: ENDGAME: Survival
short_description: Big group of people will be dropped into a deserted island where they will have to survive.

name: 进入后室 Get into Backrooms
short_description: This is a back room theme leisure games, Enter the back room, avoid the entity, find the exit, and find the truth. There are cakes, milk tea and party balloons =) There's nothing here. Don't believe it=( Join us =) Run away=(

name: Midnight Fight Express
short_description: A former member of the criminal underworld is lured back into “the life” by a mysterious drone claiming they have until sunrise to prevent a citywide criminal takeover together.

name: My Dear Sister
short_description: My Dear Sister is a first-person story-driven mystery-horror game with puzzles and exploration experience. The game focuses on the secrets of Fellows Family and the story of twin sisters Alice and Astrid.

name: Prime of Flames
short_description: This is a special strategy game that combines Wargame and Roguelike. As the guider of the former ancestors, you revived and arrived. In the name of Star Envoy, you leave for the Human camp, and lead the warriors of different clans with talents and abilities to find the truth of history and disaster.

name: Wildlife Planet: The Incremental
short_description: Wildlife Planet is a Simulation & Idle game with the theme of wildlife and nature. You will unlock more and more species as you level up and learn the species knowledge. This is a game with refreshing scenes, immersive background music, and different kinds of wild animals and plants.

name: Descentium
short_description: Whilst researching the mysterious new element Descentium, A remote facility in Southeast Asia has gone radio silent. Alina, an elite operative who works for Descent Laboratories has been sent to investigate. Will Alina discover the secrets of the temple or fall into madness?

name: Fishing Game
short_description: Fishing game is an itty bitty game inspired by the fishing minigame in Stardew Valley. Filled with a bunch of goofy writing and a handful of spicy gimmicks. Collect over twenty unique fish and add them to your compendium as you navigate through a world of quirky characters and strange locations!

name: Witch girl got killed.
short_description: Witch Girl Got Killed. is a first person fantasy horror action game. As a magical girl trainee, you must infiltrate a labyrinth that has appeared in town and destroy the labyrinth's brains.

name: Pocket City
short_description: A casual city building game. Become the mayor and create your own metropolis! Create residential, commercial, and industrial zones. Build parks and recreation spots. Respond to crime and disasters. Watch your city come alive!

name: Just Jump
short_description: Are you done with big difficult games, with lots of complicated controls to remember? Just Jump is a simple 2D Platformer racing game, where your goal is to set the best time, but with one catch you can't jump!

name: Mount Wingsuit 2
short_description: Are you ready to up your wingsuit game to the next level? Mount Wingsuit 2 has everything that made the original great, plus all it needs to be the definitive wingsuit VR app. There is a whole new mountain, new game modes and a vast, open world.

name: 山海长歌
short_description: Shan Hai Chang Ge is a war strategy tower defense game based on the battle of the deer. The Chiyou army is about to attack your city, you need to continuously improve the army lineup, use the recruitment order reasonably, and help the Yellow Emperor defeat Chiyou.

name: Takoyaki Party Survival
short_description: You should consume a good balance of protein, carbohydrates, and fats to survive. The nutritional balance changes depending on the ingredients you put in your takoyaki. If you are overloaded with calories, you will be too full to eat, so please consume calories by squatting.

name: Earthling's Undertaking
short_description: 《天地归虚》是一款中国上古神话题材的修仙RPG+策略战棋游戏。玩家扮演一名落魄宗门的掌门人，游历神秘莫测的太初世界，经营门派培养弟子，寻仙求道提升修为，探索太初世界天道倾斜的原因，揭露诸仙背后隐藏的阴谋，打破命运的樊笼，谱写属于自己的神话传说。

name: Kedama's Adventure
short_description: A Story about Kedama in Gensokyo. This is a fan game basedon Touhou Project.

name: Roxy Raccoon's Bowling Bash
short_description: 10-Pin Bowling where you are the ball! Watch the time and avoid obstacles as you aim for the high-score and conquer the ever-changing landscapes. The next chapter in the Roxy Raccoon Saga awaits as a new foe approaches!

name: Hex Picross
short_description: Hex PiCross is a picross game built on a hexagonal grid with a beautiful minimalist design and a uniquely prepared soundscape. Click to color the hexagonal cells so that all columns and diagonals are zero.

name: First Time in Rome
short_description: Travel blogger Kate Robinson and her daughter Nicole are headed to Rome for a big job with a local tourism agency!

name: Delta Manifold
short_description: Explore a strange interconnected world, find weapons to shoot those that stand in your way, and discover hidden upgrades and abilities to discover even greater secrets in an action adventure first person metroidvania.

name: SD GUNDAM BATTLE ALLIANCE
short_description: SD Gundam Battle Alliance is a multiplayer Gundam action RPG where you can smash foes solo or with friends in thrilling mechanized combat. Acquire new mobile suits, power them up, and take them into battle in various missions!

name: Like No Other: The Legend Of The Twin Books
short_description: Dan is a bumbling first-time adventurer who risks everything to solve the legend of the twin books by exploring the abandoned town of Red Pines.

name: Ultimate Fishing Simulator 2
short_description: Are you a fishing fanatic? With Ultimate Fishing Simulator 2 you can prove it! Here's a fishing simulator with six picturesque locations where you'll catch more than 60 species of fish, including the giant tiger shark. Grab your rod, adventure awaits!

name: Slingshot Adventure
short_description: After making a slingshot Ralph decides to go on a journey between different scenarios to test his skills. Help him to overcome the challenges along his adventure.

name: Golden Rails: World’s Fair
short_description: The mayor of your hometown needs your help constructing a world's fair! Continue conquering the Wild West with your favorite characters Jack and Jill. Complete 60 exciting levels and help rid the city of insidious bandits and build the most grandiose exhibition in the world!

name: MAGITERRA
short_description: Magiterra is a farming simulator game with RTS controls. With a little bit of added fantasy elements, create your crop fields, produce hundreds of resources, fulfill many different missions, help your kingdom prosper and live in wealth!

name: Animal Simulator
short_description: Animal Simulator is a new open world game, where people and animals meet. Choose one of the many diverse animals as your character and try to survive with your pack and your new human friend.

name: Yars: Recharged
short_description: Shoot from affar or get nibble away up-close and personal in a boss-rush, bullet-dodging revival of the 1982 Atari classic title, Yars' Revenge. Take on 60 unique enemy encounters alone or with a friend in local co-op.

name: Conquest Emperor
short_description: This is a match-3 RPG game! You are called to another world. This is a world ruled by empresses, all you have to do is defeat and conquer all empresses and eventually become the king of Galan.

name: I Was a Teenage Exocolonist
short_description: Spend your teenage years on an alien planet in this narrative RPG with card-based battles. Explore, grow up, and fall in love. The choices you make and skills you master over ten years will determine the course of your life and the survival of your colony.

name: 山间有点田-Sweet In the Mountains
short_description: This is a casual work about farming and raising babies. You open your eyes, and not only are you in ancient times, but you're surrounded by two babies of unknown origin. In order to make a living, you started the story of farming, raising babies and getting rich, all by yourself.

name: Stunning Policewoman
short_description: This is a city full of crime, the player as a stunning policewoman, criminals arrested and detained in the police station.

name: Hot Lap League: Deluxe Edition
short_description: Take complete control of your vehicle, perfect your driving, and prove your place in the Hot Lap League. Drift and race your car around 150+ mind blowing tracks, each requiring unique techniques and strategies. Improving your time by racing your best is the only way to the top.

name: CARROT: Pancakes and Waffles
short_description: a tiny slice of life game where you live a peaceful day in a whimsical hand-painted world

name: Edge Of The End
short_description: Post Apocalyptic Horror Survival Game

name: Lighthouse Keeper
short_description: You are tasked with taking care of the old Lighthouse in a small island. Repair its broken parts, hunt for food to get by, gather materials to craft stuff to help you along your journey.

name: Fallen Legion Revenants
short_description: Your choices will decide the fates of many! Manipulate the castle above and lead heroes into battle in the world below in this real-time action RPG!

name: Warriors of the Nile 2
short_description: Warriors of the Nile 2 is a fast-paced Roguelite strategy game. This time our Warriors are equipped with a more unique combat style. Freely choose the adventure route, use the skill tablets to strengthen characters, lead your squad to repel the Roman legion.

name: NHRA Championship Drag Racing: Speed For All
short_description: NHRA™ is back – bigger and better than ever! Immerse yourself into the teams, tracks, tuning, and strategies, then strap into the driver’s seat in your ultimate quest to become the Champion among the true Beasts of the Strip™.

name: Desktop Girlfriend
short_description: Desktop Girlfriend is a desktop interactive girlfriend game that allows users to interact with their virtual girlfriend in various ways, such as interactive games, customizing her hairstyle, hair color, and more.

name: La Pucelle: Ragnarok
short_description: For the first time in the West you can experience La Pucelle: Ragnarok, now loaded with lots of extra content including new scenarios, new recruits, and DLC characters! It even has new voices, new music, and quick travel, dood!

name: Spooky Mansion Manager
short_description: Spooky Mansion Manager is a turn-based management game where you create Spooky Tours in a mansion you inherited from your grandpa. The ultimate goal is to acquire a hundred gold bars in as many weeks to repay a loan. NOTE: This is not a scary game (i.e., it doesn't have any jump scares, etc.)

name: Across The Globe
short_description: A nation simulator set in 19th-century. Acquire resources, research technologies, build infrastructure, conquer foes. Experience dynamic population, realistic economy and great power diplomacy.

name: Save Daddy Trump 3: Rise Of Evil
short_description: after many years the peace has been disturbed in Peaceland. New army has captured Daddy Trump again. Now Kiki Trump is more powerful than ever and need meet new very powerful enemy and his army to save daddy Trump again in this low poly RPG game

name: Deadly Night
short_description: Carol is down on her luck, hitchhiking across the country. She arrives at a small roadside motel but there's something strange about the owner. As the secrets unravel, she finds herself entangled in a long, DEADLY NIGHT! Can she escape from hellish nightmare or will she die trying?

name: 徹夜報告書 | Midnight Report
short_description: 徹夜報告書 | Midnight Report。それはレポート課題に追われる学生の悲劇体験。徹夜作業による幻覚をコンセプトとした和製3Dサバイバルホラーゲーム。

name: May's Mysteries: The Secret of Dragonville Remastered
short_description: Follow May, an independent and charismatic girl, in her quest to find her missing brother. An exciting puzzle adventure with hidden object elements.

name: Go To Heck
short_description: Go To Heck is a fast-paced 2d sidescrolling action roguelite, descending through Cyberheck and using your railgun to destroy all the devils in your way.

name: Headpunk: The Comic-Style Battle Chaos
short_description: Headpunk is a 3D comic-style player vs. player (PvP) deathmatch game. In the game, everyone is the enemy except you. Either shoot enemy players with the Pump Gun or blow their heads with the Rocket Launcher.

name: Bhop Craze
short_description: Break the record! Beat your friends! Be the fastest of all! Compete with other players for the title of the best player. Run and jump through beautiful levels and discover dozens of mechanics that will give you unbelievable fun in the game!

name: Idle magic herb
short_description: This game is a hang up game that integrates elements such as cultivating immortals, farming, playing strange things, and collecting cards. Protect the liver and protect the liver.

name: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: All-Star Battle R
short_description: Hirohiko Araki's masterpiece, brought to life as a fighting game! Battle with 50 colorful characters, wielding Stands, Hamon, and more! See how characters who could never meet in the story interact when they come face to face!

name: MicroWorks
short_description: MicroWorks is an online party game where you must successfully complete various types of fast-paced microgames one after another without pause, faster and better than your opponents.

name: Scorphius
short_description: You have survived the plague. Set in the dark world of Scorpion you will delve into the dungeons and travel high up into the heavens to put an end to the plague. The focus is on the adventure, combat and powerful items and passive skills which allows character customization.

name: Hot“Sento Girls”and love
short_description: This is an adventure game that depicts the slapstick mishaps of a crossdressing boy. He decided to dress up as a girl as part of running his grandma’s traditional Japanese bathhouse (Sento). Is it really possible to run the Sento without his crossdressing being exposed?

name: Gerda: A Flame in Winter
short_description: Walk the path of Gerda as her quiet life is turned upside down during the World War 2 occupation of her small Danish village. Choose where to go, how to act, and who to trust in this intimate narrative RPG-lite experience inspired by real life events. How far would you go to protect your loved ones?

name: Crazy Chicken Xtreme
short_description: Hunt mischievous moorhuhns across a mystical campsite in the forest, shoot them down in the old walls of a knight's castle, or put your marksmanship to the test in a medieval marketplace.

name: Colorless World
short_description: Immerse yourself in this strange Colorless World. Unleash new mechanics and defeat obstacles, monsters, and bosses. As you unravel a hidden story told between the lines that will shape your ultimate destiny.

name: Moon Whalers
short_description: Cutest Bullet Hell In the Galaxy! Recruit captains and crewmates to become a Moonwhaler! Battle through endless waves of Space Whales in search of the legendary White Whale.

name: Kitten Burst
short_description: Kitten Burst is an adventure/racing game about a flying cat set in the year 200X. Explore abandoned sites, and race through circuits to save Cyberspace.

name: Wormatozoa
short_description: A gross 2D point-and-click precision platformer about parasitic worms. Guide them through a human body as they evolve from tiny parasites to city-engulfing monsters in this tough-as-nails arcade slither-em-up!

name: Kid Ball Adventure
short_description: We invite you to take control of Kid Ball, all bouncing, no limbs. Master the parabola of jumping to become a Kid Ball master and manage to overcome 100 levels full of traps, enemies and final bosses that stand between you and your little love.

name: Golazo! 2
short_description: Dynamic arcade football game with medium-sized fields, no fouls, and offsides whistled. Add street gameplay to this mix to have just pure fun & action!

name: Hotdog Quest: One With Everything
short_description: Go on a quest to obtain a hotdog in this highly stylised 3rd person platforming adventure!

name: Are You Smarter Than A 5th Grader
short_description: Based on the popular TV franchise, this charming couch co-op quiz game for 1-8 players will have you face more than 6800 fully English-voiced questions. Prove how much you still know from school and that you are, in fact, smarter than a 5th grader.

name: Rhapsody: A Musical Adventure
short_description: Dive back into your NIS roots and experience a game that laid the foundation for the beloved Disgaea series with Rhapsody: A Musical Adventure. Sharper graphics and updated image optimization bring this classic title into the present!

name: Tank Mechanic Simulator VR
short_description: Renovate & build II World War tanks. Experience highly detailed & realistic simulation game. Take tanks fully apart by using different tools. Transform them from rusty and ruined to fully working. Check them on the training ground, sell or put into your own museum.

name: The Monster Under Your Skin
short_description: Play as an unnamed man who suspects his wife of something, and dive deep into his memories of the day when he was about to propose to her. Your choices can influence the story. Genre: thriller.

name: The Backrooms Footage
short_description: You have found a camera with a footage in it. For some reason you can't rewind the video, and as soon as you try winding it forward you find yourself in the Backrooms. Figure out whats in the footage and try to ESCAPE AS FAST AS POSSIBLE!

name: Blocked!
short_description: Couch multiplayer is back - Blocked! is a local multiplayer party game for up to 8 people that is all about being easy to pick up and start playing. Outsmart your friends in various classic and unique minigames.

name: Re-Spawn Tournament
short_description: Re-Spawn Tournament is a competitive, arena-style multi-player first person shooter game with fast-paced, high energy combat that requires both reflexive skill and tactical thinking.

name: Unify
short_description: Unify, the most fast paced top down shooter there is. Only the most skilled can survive!

name: Who's Who?
short_description: Enjoy an intense game of wits with friends all around the world! Experience a sense of thrill and achievement by becoming the last survivor. Play different modes including 'Police and Thief' and 'Where`s everybody?'.

name: Call of Dusk
short_description: Call of Dusk is a multiplayer game where the player will venture into a very tense night not only facing demonic creatures but other players.

name: ORX
short_description: ORX is a new take on the well-known tower defense genre, blending mechanics of popular deck building and tabletop games to create a truly unique experience. Grow your castle, expand your domain, and take a stand against hordes of green-skinned attackers!

name: Oblige Of CHAOS
short_description: 2D art and 3D action. Elemental Reactions. Not too big Open World. Battle , Puzzle and Explore. Life has no save point.

name: Amber City
short_description: A girl in a white dress wakes up in a ruined city. She uses her light to light up mysterious cocoons, reverse time, and restore the city to its former splendor. You take on the role of this mysterious girl. As you restore Amber City, more and more of its history will unfurl before you.

name: One by One
short_description: Phobias have awoken in this dark roguelike shooter One by One! Dive into procedural dungeons, unlock forbidden equipment, unleash the might of your soul and strike down bosses to save the world.. or is it late?

name: Plank Road
short_description: 'Plank road simulation' is a game that allows you to enjoy easy and free simulation of plank road construction. It creates your legendary plank road with the construction method of Chinese traditional frame structure.

name: Hear Your Path
short_description: Hear Your Path is a maze game where, in order to find the exit, the player needs to listen and play each note of the proposed music. However, the notes and the exit are hidden, like Minesweeper, so be careful when listening to a note, because It may not be the right one to give sequence to the music

name: Doxxed
short_description: After a botched face lift, a movie star confines herself to her penthouse apartment where she learns that her fans’ obsession may have turned fatal.
