short_description: It's time for an incredible adventure in pixel art roguelike platformer game - Space Roguelike Adventure! Be the hero! Save the universe!

name: Goliath: Playing With Reality
short_description: Narrated by Tilda Swinton, winner of Best VR Work at the 78th Venice International Film Festival and Emmy®-nominated GOLIATH: PLAYING WITH REALITY is a 25-minute animated VR experience about a man who spent years isolated in psychiatric institutions but finds connection in multiplayer games.

name: DnD Adventure: Rogue's Choice
short_description: With debts to pay to the underworld, you need to make a lot of coin fast! Perhaps worse, you're wanted by the King's men for desertion. Survival is your first priority...

name: Her Name Was Fire
short_description: Her Name Was Fire is a Tarotpunk twin stick roguelike with deck building elements where you progressively unlock spells and upgrades to defeat hordes of void creatures. Survive the 5 stages of grief and vanquish the Major Allegories.

name: Kamiwaza: Way of the Thief
short_description: Join honorable thief Ebizo on the streets of Mikado, and put your thieving skills to the test! Will you walk the path of honor for the sake of family? The choice is yours to make.

name: Link Bomb☆Party/链接炸弹☆派对
short_description: Come and join this refreshing blasting party~

name: Huge Jaws
short_description: Huge Jaws - a game about a shark in the indie simulator genre, made in cute 3D graphics with nice music.

name: Mage and Monsters
short_description: Create an army and use spells while it fights for you. Mage & Monsters is an active auto battler, where you must choose wisely between upgrading the might of your army, or increasing the power of your spells.

name: Relapse
short_description: A 3D deck building roguelike game. Collect over 240 abilities; level them up, enchant them, pair them up with over 100 trinkets, and synergize them with your companions' abilities to create endless combinations to defeat your foes.

name: Stardeus
short_description: Stardeus is a deep colony sim set on a broken starship manned by drones and hibernating human survivors. As the AI, have your drones repair your ship, save your crew and travel the stars in this beautiful simulation.

name: Endless
short_description: 《时无烬》是一款时光穿梭的冒险类剧情解谜游戏。玩家通过操作主角解谜收集线索和乘客互动，逐渐揭开他们的故事，解救船上的人们。但船难的真相似乎远没有那么简单，这背后到底隐藏着什么？是灵异事件？亦或是.....

name: DRAGON BALL: THE BREAKERS
short_description: DRAGON BALL: THE BREAKERS is an online asymmetrical action game in which a band of 7 ordinary citizens tries to survive the Raider (a classic DRAGON BALL rival such as Cell, Frieza, and Buu), who will hunt and evolve into an unstoppable force!

name: Aquillanto
short_description: Aquillanto is a super-tight platformer with a reactive style of play and a huge variety of unique and fun challenges. Craft ink-shooting magic pens and battle the horde of deadly and reactive monsters! Hand-crafted levels, three worlds to explore, missions to go on and a Gold Pen to be found! Enjoy.

name: Pitstop in Purgatory
short_description: Astrid wakes up in Purgatory and has to make peace with her death. Only problem is... she doesn't remember anything! Point and click your way through adventure-based gameplay mixed with visual novel storytelling, and solve the mystery of our heroine's untimely demise.

name: Star Trek Prodigy: Supernova
short_description: Dal R’El and Gwyndala race against time to save their friends, their ship, new alien species and an entire planetary system before a supernova destroys them all, while battling a deadly new enemy that will stop at nothing to destroy the Protostar and change the very course of history!

name: Deep Abyss
short_description: Become a diver yourself to explore the unknown. Take a trip to your deep abyss. Experience a poetic and fantastic world as you explore the deep sea and space.

name: Path to purge
short_description: When the demon is a lovely little girl, will you still give her a wide berth? In the face of increasingly hard fighting, Play the Demon to purge the Human beings that corrupted by the Holy Spirit. Dealing with the angel's difficulties, let's see how far you can go

name: Phantom Thief Mew's Secret Prima
short_description: In an unexpected turn of events, Miu becomes a phantom thief. As a phantom thief, you have to carry out various mission along with her childhood friend, Chinatsu. To complete your mission,you have to sneak into the targetted location and dodge the obstacles in the way to proceed.

name: Wormhole Adventurer
short_description: Explore the wormhole network, defeat the hostiles, mine and craft to rebuild your space station. customize your ship to your playstyle

name: Scorn
short_description: Scorn is an atmospheric first-person horror adventure game set in a nightmarish universe of odd forms and somber tapestry.

name: Oil-Manager
short_description: Who hasn't dreamed of building an oil empire? Make the dream come true.

name: 鬼人偶/Ghost Doll
short_description: 'If this continues, mother will......' Before the collapse of winnie, can return to the mother's side?Find a way to escape this place!

name: Touhou Library Survivors
short_description: Thousands of fairies and familiar faces are swarming the Scarlet Devil Mansion Library! Help Patchouli Knowledge survive by attacking back with bullet hell Spell Cards, gathering experience, and upgrading exponentially!

name: The Cute Fighter
short_description: The universe of the game takes us to the world of anime and fantasy characters, dynamic battles, beautiful locations from cities, clubs, streets of Tokyo to the steppes of Afghanistan.

name: The Dead City
short_description: It's been a few months since the zombie apocalypse began.The world has fallen.The earth is inhabited by zombies, looters and small groups of survivors.

name: Expansion Core
short_description: Expansion Core is a Nomadic Survival game that borrows both first person and real time strategy elements. Gather resources, craft tools and build allies to help you survive. Inventory management is key as you move throughout the landscape.

name: Project Wunderwaffe
short_description: Project Wunderwaffe will take you back into the realities of World War II, the end of which seems to be near. Germany is now just a shadow of its power. Your order is to build a secret military base and construct weapons of unprecedented power. Will you be capable of turning the tide of war?

name: Dark Chess
short_description: Dark Chess is a game of chess with fog of war. Fast paced PvP battler based on classic rules. Whether you are a die-hard chess-lover or an amateur board game admirer, Dark Chess will appeal to anyone who likes the thrill of battle.

name: Quadrata
short_description: Quadrata is a minimalist puzzle where you control two different characters with the same keys on either side and collect diamonds with a limited number of moves to finish.

name: Hallowlands
short_description: Hallowlands is an open world procedurally generated RPG adventure. Explore a world full of monsters, harvest resources, and craft unique items. An adventure awaits!

name: The Asafo Journey
short_description: Become Asafo in this action adventure platformer. Chaos is corrupting the lands of the Nile valley and it's up to you to restore the balance. Run, jump and fight your way to the hidden enemy.

name: Night Gate
short_description: Night Gate is the result of crossing an open-world Castlevania with the action of Resident Evil. You play as a Vampire Hunter on a quest to kill the Master Vampire, Grendel! Set in the swamps of the American South, take your Airboat to explore in a 20+ hour open-world RPG horror game.

name: Dance of Decapods
short_description: A minimalist single screen bullet hell where your space insect must survive waves of enemies. Evolve to fight back with more than 30 different parts, from bio weapons to bullet enhancement.

name: LEGO® Bricktales
short_description: In this puzzle-adventure, use an intuitive brick-by-brick building mechanic to solve puzzles and bring your creations to life! Experience a charming story as you explore beautiful LEGO® dioramas and help the people inhabiting them.

name: Zombie Arena
short_description: Zombie arena is a multiplayer first person shooter gamer, focused on cooperation to annihilate zombies and various monsters in a post apocalyptic world.

name: Pixelmancer
short_description: Pixelmancer is a casual roguelite game developed by a single developer. You play as a necromancer with pets that will aid on your journey, you can upgrade almost anything for your hero and your pets. You will die constantly but become stronger and better with every death. How far can you go?

name: Coral Island
short_description: Coral Island is a vibrant and laid-back reimagining of farm sim games. Be who you want and experience enchanting island living at your own pace—live off the land, nurture animals, build relationships with a diverse cast of townsfolk, and make the world around you a more vital and harmonious place.

name: Nickelodeon Kart Racers 3: Slime Speedway
short_description: Nickelodeon Kart Racers 3: Slime Speedway features a cast of over 40 iconic characters; drift, slide and boost your way to the finish line on tracks inspired by legendary Nickelodeon shows!

name: Somber
short_description: Somber is an atmospheric action-platformer that takes place in the semi-open world of Gloom. A hand-painted game filled with stunning environments, Somber demands absolute precision from players who wish to unlock its many secrets.

name: The Quintessential Quintuplets OMOIDE VR ~ITSUKI~
short_description: The Quintessential Quintuplets OMOIDE VR ~ITSUKI~ is the first official VR adventure game based on the popular manga series. Play as Futaro Uesugi and enjoy spending time with the youngest Quint, Itsuki, in this VR adventure game.

name: The Lost Village
short_description: It's a horror, first-person play game, and investigate the town and uncover the secret behind the town's abandonment. Also, you have to solve and overcome the puzzles created by the devil and the puzzles that require instantaneous agility with your crisis response skills.

name: Letux Game
short_description: Letux Game is a 2D Top-Down action rogue-like with powerful bosses and awesome upgrades.

name: 一本橋ワタル
short_description: You control a character on a bicycle. and ride up, down, and jump through a three-dimensional course. and jump through three-dimensional courses. There are more than 30 different courses!

name: NoiseBox.噪音盒子
short_description: Realize the small space that you want to hide, let it wrap your body and mind, imagine what kind of space it is, and what is outside it? Noise Box can help you answer this question.

name: PGA TOUR 2K23
short_description: Hit the links with more swagger in PGA TOUR 2K23. Now featuring playable male and female pros, including Tiger Woods, new licensed courses, more control options, an authentic PGA TOUR MyCAREER, Course Designer, and new MyPLAYER Skills and Archetypes! PGA TOUR 2K23. More Golf. More Game.

name: Heat and Run
short_description: Heat and Run is a 2D multiplayer shooter, strategic and frantic! Take on players from around the world in 4vs4 battles: Select a hero with unique skills, master the creation of Blocks in intense battles and destroy the opponent Flame to win the game.

name: Hexxagon - Board Game
short_description: Hexxagon is an abstract strategy board game played on a hexagonal board.

name: The Last Oricru
short_description: The Last Oricru is an action RPG with a strong emphasis on storytelling and player choices. The player awakens in a sci-fi medieval world on the brink of a war and starts influencing the destiny of the whole world. The game is designed as both single-player and a co-op experience.

name: Spell Defender
short_description: Spell Defender is a 3D, Third-Person, wave defence, survival Roguelite. Use magical powers to defeat waves of enemies. Each wave rewards you with a choice of a new power. Find synergies and combine these powers to create the ultimate defender.

name: Space FURY - The Phantom Menace
short_description: Tear up your enemies using various power-ups and weapons in this old-school space shooter!

name: Milk Girl -Sweet memories of summer
short_description: Adventure game of living together with a girl with mother milk in summer. You can move a pedestrian, talk to a girl, researching, earn money. Enjoy living together!

name: Lamp Simulator
short_description: Lamp Simulator is a realistic game. In the game, you can create the environment you want by changing the intensity and color of the lamp light in your room. You can use the light coming from the monitor in your steam broadcasts in the light settings you have adjusted.

name: Beat The Devil
short_description: Rocketman demon and his army have kidnapped Terzonators wife. So you need collect weapons destroy army and demon boss to resque your wife

name: Beautiful Mystic Survivors
short_description: Roguelite bullet-hell meets sexy anime in Beautiful Mystic Survivors, as you rise to help gorgeous heroines destroy countless invading monsters. Plan your builds, upgrade heroines, and survive against the clock. Experience polished 3D graphics, flashy VFX, and surrounded by thousands of monsters.

name: Island Berry
short_description: Dreams can take you anywhere.

name: One Many Nobody
short_description: The future of humankind is at stake. The planet's energy resources have run out and the need to find an alternative energy source has become the main priority, at any cost. Are you willing to accept your fate in this pixel art puzzle-adventure game set in a futuristic dystopic world?

name: Numeral Lord
short_description: minimalism strategy game

name: N-GON
short_description: An acid trip back to classic vector arcade action games with the unique bullet magnet mechanic. Dodge ruthless attacks, bend your projectile trajectory, destroy waves of enemies with the massive explosion chains. Die a lot! Then try again and get yourself to top of the leaderboards

name: Trifox
short_description: Trifox is a colourful and cartoonish action-adventure featuring a phenomenal fox with a multitude of talents! Choose from a trio of classes – Warrior, Mage, Engineer – or mix-and-match abilities to create a tailor-made hero! Inspired by the golden age of 3D platformers.

name: Puzzle: Triangles
short_description: Puzzle: Triangles - The game is a challenging and interesting puzzle game.

name: Egression
short_description: You’re here for puzzles, and that’s what you’ll get. Step into a deluxe virtual escape room establishment. Challenge your mind with handcrafted puzzles designed exclusively for VR. Explore immersive environments and piece together the clues to escape!

name: Atari Mania
short_description: A wild journey through videogame history, Atari Mania is a microgame collection wrapped in a hilarious retro-driven narrative of exploration and surprise.

name: Unders_core
short_description: The reimagined roguelike deckbuilding experience. Build two separate decks every run to find overpowered combinations and discover unexpected synergies. Discover a sci-fi world, face hostile fauna and experience unique and challenging runs.

name: Valkyrie Champions
short_description: Team up with up to 4 online players and defeat hordes of monsters in this action based looter-shooter! Unlock powerful tiers of weapons and equipment to develop your character into an unstoppable champion!

name: RCPG
short_description: RCPG is an arcade combat-racing game, where you drive remote controlled cars that speed through amazing tracks with combat abilities.

name: Blockpop Heroes
short_description: A parodic minimalist runner focused on jumps.

name: Little Witchelsa: Pumpkin Peril
short_description: Enter the world of witches and solve all kinds of puzzles in this fun blend of match 3 and hidden object game!

name: Home Run High
short_description: Train your baseball players and create a winning team!

name: Not Your Mama's Autobattler
short_description: Invite your friends, build your team and prepare for battle.

name: Stay Out of the House
short_description: Edge of your seat STEALTH HORROR as you try to escape the house of a cannibal SERIAL KILLER.... You will be hunted by an intelligent and deadly AI - use your wits and whatever tools you can scavenge to make it out alive...

name: A Hero's Rest
short_description: Build shops, craft items with hundreds of customization options, and manage your resources wisely to lead your Heroes to success. Immerse yourself as proprietor of a medieval fantasy town in a world abounding with Heroes and Monsters.

name: The Death Tree
short_description: The Death Tree is an ambiental, first-person, horror hunting short game. Set in a nightmarish dark forest that involves action and 'jump scares' through a tension and intrigue atmosphere. Hunt creepy monsters,ruthlessly creatures and witches.

name: ICEwall
short_description: An action roguelike shoot 'em up. Draft power-ups between levels to become stronger and build crazy combos. Several player ships to unlock, multiple game modes, leaderboards and achievement challenges!

name: Stranded: Alien Dawn
short_description: Brave a new world in Stranded: Alien Dawn, a planet survival sim placing the fate of a small marooned group in your hands. Forge your story through compelling and immersive strategic gameplay as you make vital decisions to protect your survivors.

name: Acretia - Guardians of Lian
short_description: Two worlds merged. A feud that lasted for hundreds of years. The flame of destruction slowly pulsates in the gap. Join your legion on a great journey to cut the chains of hatred and save the world from the primordial darkness.

name: Orgynizer
short_description: Organize amazing swinger parties and match people, activities, rooms, and toys for an explosive evening. A light-hearted sex-positive puzzle romp that also supports a good cause.

name: Asterigos: Curse of the Stars
short_description: Embark on a journey full of danger in this action RPG, inspired by Greek and Roman mythologies. Explore the breathtaking city of Aphes and forge your way through legions of unique foes and mythical bosses to discover the truth behind the city’s curse.

name: Inner Call
short_description: Inner Call is a 2D adventure game where you play as a wise orc and help the locals with their problems. For the last 20 years, the forests have been filled with various monsters, which are now aggravating the villagers.

name: Lost Eidolons
short_description: Lost Eidolons is a turn-based tactical RPG with a gripping cinematic narrative, set in a waning empire riven by civil war. Take on the role of a charming mercenary captain, Eden, and lead his band of allies through epic encounters on a classic turn-based battlefield.

name: One More Gate : A Wakfu Legend
short_description: One More Gate is a rogue-lite deck-builder that combines exploration and turn-based strategic combat. Head out to discover fantastic places, master the power of Wakfu to create destructive card combos, and defeat all those who would stand in your way!

name: Beeny
short_description: A vertical 2D platformer featuring a round bee in an early 90s prerendered environment.

name: Ever Seen A Cat? 3
short_description: A relaxing hidden object game. Find yet more cats in several new fairy tale themed environments! Every play through is different!

name: Spellbearers
short_description: Spellbearers is a top-down, 2D, twin stick shooter inspired by 'Super Smash TV'. Battle against hordes of magical enemies to liberate the rulers of three kingdoms that have been overtaken by dark forces. With staff in hand, do you have what it takes to uphold the title of The Spellbearer?

name: 古巫竞技场 Ancient Witch Arena
short_description: 'Ancient Witch Arena' is an independently developed light survival Roguelike, hand-painted fantasy dark world. Resist hundreds of enemies, conquer bosses, explore combinations between characters and skills, and finally become the king of the arena.

name: Jettatura
short_description: Jettatura is a challenging first-person dungeon-crawler (DRPG) with round-based combat. Form a band of up to six mercenaries to scout the subterrene world to reclaim a stolen ancient artifact from the surreptitious death-cult that pilfered it!

name: Deadeye Deepfake Simulacrum
short_description: Embody the ultimate cybernetic corporate agent. Master deadly gunplay, time manipulation, and supernatural abilities. Hack computers, people, even the individual bullets flying at you. Confront the future, and die trying.

name: Idle Cyber Dungeon
short_description: This is a Cyberpunk style role-playing game. Players don't need a lot of operations, they just need to think about some strategies to complete the victory.

name: Dead Second
short_description: Dead Second is an Action Arcade Cover Shooter featuring the 'Dead Second' bullet time reaction system with high fidelity impact physics reactions. Experience Intense shoot outs and gunplay unlike any game before it!

name: Don't Get Eaten!
short_description: Test your survival skills in this third person shooter. Defend your base against a never ending zombie horde. Try different tactics and see how many nights you can survive.

name: Sunday Gold
short_description: Sunday Gold is a point-and-click, turn-based adventure game set in grim, dystopian future. Play as a ragtag trio of criminals to hunt down and expose the dark secrets of an evil mega-corporation and the malevolent billionaire behind it.

name: Arata Haunted Asylum
short_description: Arata Haunted Asylum is a 2D Top Down Survival horror game based on the story of a haunted asylum located in Japan. You will investigate the asylum for the proof of the paranormal.

name: The Eternal Cylinder
short_description: Control a herd of charming creatures called Trebhum and explore an unforgettable alien world filled with exotic lifeforms and surreal environments. Discover dozens of mutations to overcome puzzles, explore new biomes, and survive on a dangerous planet.

name: Protect My Cheese
short_description: A stunning and chaotic tower defense strategy game where we play as cats to defeat the cheese-hungry rats. Survive against waves of enemies and guard the cheese.

name: The Entity Code
short_description: The Entity Code is a sci-fi themed 2D puzzle game with simple but challenging mechanics.

name: Final Recurrence
short_description: With so many missing persons cases revolving the Shepherd's Hill forest, why is yours any different?

name: Dead End City
short_description: A post-apocalyptic arcade shooter. Collect fuel and dodge enemy fire as you fight back against the evil Scorpio gang. Mixes cars, shmups and themes that would have been right at home in 80's anime and arcades..

name: Gust
short_description: A retro dungeon crawler game set in a dark world. Compete with everyone for the global leaderboard. Use your Gust to deflect danger and to solve puzzles.

name: The Story of Barker
short_description: A mysterious detective story on an abandoned ship with an unexpected ending.

name: DIMENSIONAL SLAUGHTER
short_description: ALL GUTS. ALL GLORY. NO FILLER. Kill to Heal, and never stop Moving in this fast-paced Arena Movement Shooter with Rogue-Like Mechanics as you traverse Dimensions and Slaughter hordes of enemies in hopes that you may someday return home.

name: Magitek VR
short_description: Magitek VR is a magic adventure game that uses gesture driven spells based on the four elements. Use magic to fight enemies and solve puzzles as you explore the world of Embra.

name: Potato Survival
short_description: Potato Survival is a short story game about a character who lives alone on the open sea. Collect potatoes and try to survive for 21 days with the knowledge you gain daily. Unlock new skills to create a more meaningful day to day life!

name: Strong Moon
short_description: Strong Moon is an action and adventure platformer hard-as-hell videogame inspired in the 90's cartoons.

name: Grand Prix Story
short_description: Enjoy racing at your own pace in this racing team management simulator.

name: ASTLIBRA Revision
short_description: Confront time and fate in the 2D action RPG, Astlibra Revision. Explore meticulously crafted worlds, fight brutal boss battles, and upgrade your skills to take down enemies lurking around every corner.

name: Phantom Hysteria
short_description: Phantom Hysteria thrusts you into the ghost hunting genre. Play solo or co-op with up to four players, where you will have to investigate, banish, and neutralize phantoms with your taped-together gear.

name: Quriocity
short_description: Quriocity is a sci-fi city builder game set on a bare alien planet very similar to Earth. Build and upgrade a wide variety of units to extract resources and provide services, such as maintenance, food production, education, entertainment and many more.

name: Fueled Up
short_description: Fueled Up is a chaotic couch co-op spaceship recovery game for up to four players. You and your crewmates must fuel, fix and rescue damaged spaceships before the evil space octopus gets its tentacles on them!

name: Bulls and Cows
short_description: Bulls and cows is an ancient puzzle game of password cracking. Now, we make the process of this game more concise and interesting.

name: TitTok 3
short_description: TitTok 3: FINAL CHAPTER. An adventurous 2D puzzle-platformer with Cats, explosions, portals and deadly lasers! An epic conclusion to the enchanting trilogy. TikTok ≠ TitTok

name: Cracked
short_description: Cracked is a difficult 2D Platformer. Dominate the leaderboards by completing the maps as fast as possible. Explore the abandoned Factory, the desert Pyramid and the jungle Temple.

name: Day of the Dino: Survival
short_description: In this alternate timeline, German Scientist found a way to make a door way into a different reality. By doing so managed to bring dinosaurs into our world. Being Germany's last hope to push the Red Army out of Reich the scientist unleash the dinosaurs upon the world.

name: Oh Sheep!
short_description: Oh sheep! is a fast paced arcade game where you gather and protect sheep from monstrous creatures for the highest score!

name: Atama
short_description: USE PSYCHIC POWERS in ATAMA to see through the eyes of your pursuers to avoid detection as you investigate a cursed rural Japanese village. You can't fight back; you must rely only on your abilities and your wits to avoid your enemies. Inspired by Forbidden Siren and Junji Ito.

name: Vs Chat Pack
short_description: The ultimate game pack for Twitch streamers! Play four different games against and with your viewers. Experience a new level of audience engagement and viewer interactions with Vs Chat Pack!

name: The Darkest Tales
short_description: When a nightmare creeps into reality, the only ones that can help are those whose magical powers we’ve believed in since childhood. A brave teddy bear heads to the far side of “happily ever after” to rescue his owner, Alicia.

name: Unusual Findings
short_description: Three friends uncover mysteries in the 1980s. Follow their amazing adventures in a game where your decisions really matter. Be prepared to spin like a record on your incredible journey back to the era of synthesizers, VHS Rental stores, 8 bits games and evil alien conspiracies.

name: Tile Town
short_description: A simple, yet challenging, relaxing strategy game set on a hexagonal grid. Place down individual tiles with various building to get the highest score possible, all while creating a picturesque medieval town in the process. Try to beat your previous score or go on a stroll in the first person mode.

name: Infinity War Land
short_description: 'Infinity War Land' is a roguelite dungeon shooter.

name: Andromeda Survivors
short_description: Defeat thousands of enemies that are invading Andromeda! Andromeda Survivors is a casual game with rogue-lite elements where you collect skills and upgrades for your ship to create amazing builds!

name: Timemelters
short_description: Strategy... Witches... and Time Travel! Featuring both a single player and a Co-op campaign, and designed by a small indie team of 3 people, TimeMelters is a challenging strategy-adventure featuring a unique game mechanic which allows the players to go back in time and fight alongside themselves.

name: CyberBlocker Complete Edition
short_description: It is a block breaker with a gauge type power-up system. The player's ship can always fire a shot, which, combined with the power-up system, makes it an aggressive block breaker. The difficulty level can be adjusted depending on the ship, so it can be enjoyed by both beginners and experts.

name: Korean BBQ Simulator
short_description: A fun and wacky -* cough* I mean, totally realistic physics-based grilling game based on Korean cuisine. Take control of the grill at a Korean BBQ restaurant and become the master of meats. Can you compete with others online and earn the ultimate title of Korean BBQ Master?

name: ARRIVAL: ZERO EARTH
short_description: Fight giant War of the Worlds -style aliens invading Finland during a Winter in the 90's. Build an army of local townspeople in this chaotic semi-autobattler roguelike. Navigate thru the snowy countryside to obliterate the aliens from cosmic dimensions.

name: 红月
short_description: This is an open world RPG game,in this game. You can design your own weapons and equipment and customize your character. All players can simply make MOD and experience the joy of creation!

name: DAGURI: Gambling Apocalypse
short_description: DAGURI: Gambling Apocalypse is an open world gambling simulator. You must help ‘Daguri’ pay the debts he racked up during an unintended gambling spree. Roam the world, bet on gambling mini-games, and make some money!

name: No More Heroes 3
short_description: Travis Touchdown is back, baby! The otaku assassin takes up his trusty beam katana once more to slash his way to the top of the Galactic Superhero Rankings and save the world in the latest entry in the No More Heroes series.

name: TRIANGLE STRATEGY
short_description: A new tactics RPG from the team who brought you the Bravely series and Octopath Traveler. An epic tale, brought to life with stunning HD-2D graphics. Make difficult decisions in this story set against a backdrop of the war-torn continent of Norzelia.

name: Byte Lynx
short_description: Byte Lynx is a fast-paced RTS with no units. Build defenses, dismantle your enemy, and steal their buildings in this deeply tactical building combat-based strategy game. Expand your arsenal across a series of diverse levels!

name: Venice 2089
short_description: Explore a future Venice struggling with the effects of rising water slowly destroying the city as a bored teenager, with your hoverboard and your trusty drone.

name: Chasm: The Rift
short_description: Prepare for terror in this ground-breaking classic old-school FPS. Following the destruction of Time you are left to battle in this horrific hellhole of multilevel interconnected missions populated by gruesome grotesque creatures.

name: Hypogean
short_description: Hypogean is a 2D action rpg with a heavy emphasis on story that bolsters a unique combat system allowing for flexibility and player expression. With the ability to sacrifice subordinate's, equip core's like knockback or stun to your sword and shield allowing for creativity in your boss encounters.

name: Dungeon Liberator
short_description: Dungeon Liberator is a game mode where eight or two players face off in 1v1 rounds, with the goal to be the last player standing. Players need to compete with opponents for Minions and attack orders. Reaction speed will become as important as tactical ability.

name: Stella Pastoris
short_description: Shepherd the last remnants of the Malthusian monks marooned on Proxima Centauri B. As a mechanical saint, will you delve into forbidden means to save your people or allow them to go quietly into the night? Set up production chains to spend limited resources to save as many as you can.

name: Ozymandias: Bronze Age Empire Sim
short_description: Build an empire in a single sitting. All the strategy of a classic 4X in a faster format, which also shines in multiplayer.

name: IndividuaLand
short_description: Turn based combat strategy game with town management. 16 different Jungian personality types. Teach skills to characters, attract new visitors, improve profession skills, go on adventurers, craft items, fight with more than 100 monsters in 6 different type adventure areas.

name: Gravity Chase
short_description: Welcome to the futuristic anti-gravity arcade racer with a twist. Gravity Chase racing competition takes place on tunnel tracks for super-fast 360 degree Zero G racing.

name: Gnome Online
short_description: Gnome Online is an innovative, Real-Time, fast-paced, PvP, Sandbox MMORPG.

name: Fury Turn
short_description: Save the scientists! Prevent biological catastrophe! Eat all the burgers on the way!

name: My Bloody Weekend
short_description: 'My Bloody Weekend' is a survival horror in Quick Time Events, set in a mansion where a killer with a cleaver tries to kill a girl ... can you survive? Real actors, real terror!

name: Cloaks and Capes
short_description: C&C is an action_packed, Roguelite shooter with a dark theme. Inhabit Cloaker,A caster who grieves for vengeance and whose sole purpose is to resurrect his son as you engulf celestial beings in flames of anguish. Embrace powerups and spells as you pave your path through traps filled Caverns, Abysses

name: Hard Life
short_description: This game is a survival game. Even though there are zombies in the game, the biggest challenge is the cold-temperature balance. The SandBox mod of the game is under construction. Apart from that, there are 3 different sections. The goal is to reach the farthest corner of the map.

name: Wordle 5
short_description: Wordle 5 is the culmination of the Wordle series with brand new puzzles 10 new categories, 500 puzzles

name: Epic Astro Story
short_description: Battle baddies and foster interplanetary diplomacy in an epic space colony sim!

name: Astraea
short_description: Astraea is a 2D Shoot 'em up game. You will fight through enemies of increasing strength and frequency. As you defeat enemies you gain access to upgrades to make your ship stronger. Attempt to max out your ship and try to beat others high scores.

name: Shadow Heroes
short_description: Welcome to play this fast-paced mild Roguelike action game 'Shadow Heroes'. Please follow our working group: 'Tower Games'.

name: Overhaul
short_description: Solve your way through this fast-paced rogue-lite puzzle game and outwit unforgiving creatures as you venture into the mysterious Power Plant!

name: Actua Soccer 2
short_description: In this classic soccer simulation from 1997, experience fast-paced action with a variety of game modes, from friendlies to seasons. Play with one of 11 national teams, Alan Shearer's hand picked All Star team, or your own custom team. Features motion capture from a young Michael Owen.

name: Fresh Start Cleaning Simulator
short_description: Feel Good Post-apo simulator of cleaning up and repairing a fallen world in single-player FPS mode. Clean polluted environment, repair, renovate and turn on objects long forgotten by time. Make new friends, take care of nature or even plant a forest. Give these places a Fresh Start!

name: Hello Puppets: Midnight Show
short_description: “Hello Puppets: Midnight Show” is a stealth horror adventure set in the 1980s on the set of a children’s TV show. You are a master puppet maker whose prized creations--the Handeemen--have come to life and are hunting you. Play hide and seek against advanced AI that forces you to adapt and improvise.

name: UNCHARTED™: Legacy of Thieves Collection
short_description: Play as Nathan Drake and Chloe Frazer in their own standalone adventures as they confront their pasts and forge their own legacies. This game includes the critically acclaimed single-player stories from both UNCHARTED 4: A Thief’s End and UNCHARTED: The Lost Legacy.

name: Internet Generation
short_description: A story about a dying chat server. Moderators are abusing their power, the owner has neglected the server, and the lives of members are miserable. And you, as a newcomer, will pick up your keyboard, and overthrow the owner and moderators' tyranny!

name: Sumo Seals
short_description: Sumo Seals is an arcade party game that supports up to 4 players where you and your friends team up or compete against each other in a series of minigames where you control seals that bounce and stomp their way through skill and reflex based challenges.

name: Mars Base
short_description: Welcome to Mars Base, humanity’s foothold on the Red Planet! Join the expedition as an interstellar botanist and make history: turn barren soil into fertile farmland, grow food for colonists’ tables, and unearth the secrets of Mars! Are you ready to science the “crop” out of everything?

name: Jennifer Wilde: Unlikely Revolutionaries
short_description: In 1921, young French artist Jennifer Chevalier becomes embroiled in death, espionage and revolution, assisted by the ghost of Oscar Wilde. A hand-drawn Point & Click adventure with a unique comic book inventory design.

name: Reefland
short_description: Reefland - is a colorful city-building simulator with a relaxing atmosphere, where you are up to paint the island by placing buildings.

name: Echo
short_description: ”Echoes of the heart' can be heard the moment each other's paths intertwine. 'Echo' is an action RPG with a perfectly sized storyline and a unique progression system. The story begins with Lin, a young, solo adventurer. Many secrets lie within a closed off forest. Can you hear that faint voice?

name: With Good Intentions
short_description: The Age of Blade and the Age of Gun entwined. The master of the knights and the imperial captain are separated by centuries, but bound by memory. Solve the mysteries of the cursed abbey and its immortal lord. Rejoin the link of time. Find out where the road will take thee with good intentions.

name: Destiny's Sword
short_description: Destiny’s Sword is a Living-Narrative Graphic Adventure. Explore distant worlds, forge friendships and lead your troops through an epic adventure.

name: Void Scrappers
short_description: Blast hordes of alien ships into junk. Collect the scrap to upgrade your ship into an unstoppable force of destruction. Unlock new characters and weapons and upgrade your stats between runs.

name: King of the Hat
short_description: A 2D party platformer where you fight with a hat! Throw your hat to attack, defend and bait opponents. But watch out! If someone jumps on your hat... you die!

name: Potionomics
short_description: You’ve inherited your uncle’s potion shop—and a huge debt. Better get brewing! Customize your store, hire heroes to gather ingredients, befriend (or romance) fellow vendors to learn new haggling strategies, and go head-to-head with competitors in this narrative-driven, deck-building shop simulator.

name: The Shadow Government Simulator
short_description: A turn-based strategy game where you lead a secret society towards world domination. Investigate the influential and convert them to your faction via bribery, seduction and intimidation. Reshape society's power structures to fend off rival societies and the world's nations in your quest for power.

name: Park Story
short_description: Unravel handcrafted puzzle dungeons and confront your demons in Park Story — a reimagination of the classic top-down action RPG. Trapped, Parker must defeat Caim to escape haunted Mahagow Glen Country Park, helping friendly ghosts with unfinished business and unlocking the park’s deepest secrets.

name: Sky Puzzle
short_description: 'Sky Puzzle' is a real-time turn-based card strategy game. You will meet all kinds of women, and through the test of courage and wisdom, you will further draw closer to each other. Of course, they are not ordinary girls~

name: Frog In the Well
short_description: Frog just wants to get out of the well.

name: The Last Hero of Nostalgaia
short_description: The Last Hero of Nostalgaia is a satirical action-adventure, brought to life by a twisted and wicked tale. Featuring hard but fair combat, *full character customization, unique battle armor and engaging narrative mechanics rich in lore, Nostalgaia plunges you into almost certain death at every turn.

name: The Pegasus Expedition
short_description: The Pegasus Expedition is a story-driven sci-fi grand strategy game set in a key moment for humankind’s survival. Facing an overwhelming threat at home, humanity sends expeditions to the Pegasus Galaxy in a desperate attempt to find a refuge for the population of Earth.

name: Mythos: Sudoku
short_description: Embark on a mythic adventure and experience sudoku in a whole new way, with new rules and magical items as you overcome trials and find your way home.

name: One True Hero
short_description: One True Hero is an epic 3D platforming adventure featuring a young hero who can barely save himself! Explore ancient ruins, defeat an army of evil minions and unravel the mystery of the sinking town!

name: Magnetic Structures
short_description: Colourful magnetic rods and balls are at your command, Well, everything is ready, so it's time to build. Beautiful magnetic structures will be made by your hands.

name: Horoscopicus
short_description: Horoscopicus is a 2D Retro style platformer where you complete levels based on the zodiac signs! There are also secret animals to find and pet throughout the game! Can you find them all? :D

name: Horror Tycoon
short_description: Scare, terrify and thrill guests as you build the haunted house of your nightmares. Design and customize your creations with incredible detail to scare your guests, or risk losing it all in this tycoon/tower defense hybrid!

name: 13 Steps
short_description: Find a way out in this horror/time loop Game. Hide, run, and uncover the mysteries of the 'EOS Complex' as you are pursued by the automated security bots gone rogue. They only move when you do, so tread carefully, every step could be your last.

name: BYTE CATS
short_description: Delve into a story-driven adventure and channel your inner kitten in this challenging old-school platformer. Perform wall-jumps, evade deadly obstacles, hunt mice and use powerful abilities to destroy everyone who stands in your way!

name: Dead Containment
short_description: Dead Containment is an on-rails shooter inspired by classic arcade games. Players fend off the undead as they race through a city under siege, blasting away the horrors that roam the streets using a variety of weapons. Playable solo or online co-op.

name: Walking In The Abyss
short_description: Explore a mysterious castle in the middle of the forest and discover its secrets in this 2D horror game.

name: 无极修仙传·序章
short_description: This is a xiuxian theme RPG independent game. This game tells about the protagonist ye Lan first entered the Fairyland in a series of things experienced when practicing atmosphere. It is currently a prologue and will be open in other forms.

name: 无路可退
short_description: No Way Back is a platform and shooting game that you can't stop, if you like speed and challenge, I think you shouldn't miss it.

name: Richman 11
short_description: Richman 11 is a casual game in Monopoly genre, it is the 11th episode of the franchise. In the game, players could select maps, characters and group play, creating free play or challenge play. Try to earn money and win the play by investing properties, using cards, etc.

name: Disc Golf Online
short_description: Play Disc Golf online with friends in a casual, but physically accurate Disc Golf simulation. Explore beautiful and diverse procedurally generated worlds. Play a new course every time, or replay your favourite course to master it.

name: Symphony Of Motion
short_description: An innovative musical playground that turns your motion into music. Featuring a large selection of motion-reactive synthesizers, multi-pitched drum and melodic percussion pads, a built-in looper, and a drum kit builder that will keep you jamming for hours on end.

name: Eureka
short_description: Eureka is an open-world business management simulator. From gold mining to wheat farming, choose your products, manage your resources, and grow your business however you see fit!

name: Backrooms: Escape Together
short_description: Backrooms: Escape Together is a 1-4 player coop horror experience. You are at the mercy of the entities lurking and must do whatever it takes to survive while completing each level's objectives. Multiple new levels will be added each month as we develop the true Backrooms experience.

name: Trader of the Night
short_description: A horror-themed stock market simulator where the player must make enough money to pay their debt in time. Buy, sell and short shares in fictional companies, earn dividends, pay taxes and follow the in-game news for possible hints on what to invest in. No previous experience in stock market required.

name: Crash Bandicoot™ 4: It’s About Time
short_description: It’s About Time - the critically-acclaimed Crash Bandicoot™ 4: It's About Time is now on Steam!

name: Battle of Kings
short_description: The time of war has come! Take the command of your kingdom and use your strategic skills to defend the siege against your fortifications. You can’t win only by defending your Kingdom. Develop your economics, assemble and upgrade your army to defeat the enemy forces in a real Battle of Kings.

name: Clown Theft Auto: Woke City
short_description: Woke City is the city of future, dreams and hope. Imagine a perfect society where everything is built on equality, where crimes are nonexistent, and anger is just a theory of the past. Immerse yourself into the wokeness. This is the future everyone wants and needs.

name: Thread
short_description: A puppet themed platformer metroidvania with a focus on platforming rather than combat. Throw your crystal scissors into walls to create your own platforms, explore a twisting and mysterious land, and solve puzzles on a worldwide scale.

name: MAXIM
short_description: MAXIM, is a concept game where the idea of a machine future come to life.Through the trenches of The Great War witness the inception of your demise.And the coming of a new age.

name: Portal war
short_description: 'Portal war' is a classic 2D 'Tug of War' strategy game. You need to plan and send correct uncontrollable troops towards the enemies and hope they beat them.

name: Altero
short_description: Altero is an atmospheric puzzle platformer game that will tease your brain! Control Adi the voodoo doll and accept to sacrifice yourself in order to team up with your past. Dive deep into the darkness of the Sorrow forest and rescue the lost souls to find your peace.

name: Retrowave Rider
short_description: Retrowave Rider is a 2D precision-platformer where you control not only the character but also the level itself. Dive into synthwave worlds filled with retro-inspired visuals and smooth synth sounds, and experience this journey with all of its trials and glories.

name: Persona 5 Royal
short_description: Don the mask and join the Phantom Thieves of Hearts as they stage grand heists, infiltrate the minds of the corrupt, and make them change their ways!

name: Blaze in Space: Beat a-Maze
short_description: Modern arcade with a puzzle twist. Guide your spaceship through a neon maze. Think quick and keep the momentum to beat other players!

name: Sigil of the Magi
short_description: Sigil of the Magi blends roguelike deckbuilding with turn-based combat for a deep tactical experience. Navigate a world full of dangers and mystique as you craft your deck, obtain relics, and prepare your party of champions for any challenges ahead!

name: Gotham Knights
short_description: Batman is dead. It is now up to the Batman Family - Batgirl, Nightwing, Red Hood, and Robin - to protect Gotham City.

name: Amberial Dreams
short_description: The hit series returns! Roll and bounce in this jumpless precision platformer for all skill levels. Play through an eerie campaign, best the wicked difficulty, or create your own levels to share with the world!

name: Paper Nebula
short_description: Paper Nebula is a fast-paced arcade-style scroller, reinvented as a Roguelike! This space shooter will have you blasting through endless waves of alien ships while trying to scout a way out of the nebula. With adorable paper-style graphics and intense gameplay, who wouldn't want to be trapped here?

name: Cthulhu Mythos ADV 闇に囁く狂気
short_description: A Cthulhu Mythos-inspired 2D adventure game. Escape from an abandoned hospital using your 'ability' and 'luck.' Enjoy this engaging cosmic horror story through dice rolls that determine your fate!

name: The Way Home: Pixel Roguelike
short_description: Pixelart Roguelike Action Game! Trapped on a strange island, Kevin and Cheese struggle to return home. Encounter other lost people and terrifying monsters lurking on the island. Help our unfortunate duo find THE WAY HOME!

name: TAKIBI
short_description: Forgetting the busyness and coldness of daily life, we sometimes gaze at the flames and then at ourselves. It would be nice to have such a time.

name: Stranded Nightmare
short_description: After getting into a storm you end up stranded on an Island with strange occurrences. Try to escape and survive against humanoids from failed science experiments in various environments. Explore the Island with its bunkers and laboratories! Can you find a way out and solve the mystery?

name: Da Tutu
short_description: 'Da Tutu' is a minimalist leisure game, waving a stick to let the rabbit take off.

name: Slime Hero
short_description: Slime Hero is a slime collecting and fighting game, you need to collect and select the best slime team to pass all the stage, after that you can go to challenge the boss, try to dodge all the attack and kick away all the enemy.

name: NEO: The World Ends with You
short_description: 'Only the possibility of you can change our fate' Rindo comes to the grim realization that his life is on the line when he is forced to compete in the so-called 'Reapers' Game.'

name: Undercraft
short_description: Create your world in this sandbox game where you can dig, build, explore, fight, and farm. Have a different experience in a day or night adventure. Explore a procedurally generated world alone or with friends.

name: A Plague Tale: Requiem
short_description: Embark on a heartrending journey into a brutal, breathtaking world, and discover the cost of saving those you love in a desperate struggle for survival. Strike from the shadows or unleash hell with a variety of weapons, tools and unearthly powers.

name: TOGUM
short_description: Priscilla was enjoying the holiday eve at her house, however, her friend Nara discovers a series of codes and hidden messages inside an abandoned house. Could these codes be related to the strange lights that have appeared in the middle of the sea? Based on a true story...

name: Moss: Book II
short_description: Moss: Book II is the award-winning sequel to the fan favorite VR game Moss and is being hailed as a top contender for VR Game of the Year and has secured a spot on multiple essential and must-play lists. Book II is a single-player action-adventure puzzle game from Polyarc tailor-made for VR.

name: New Tales from the Borderlands
short_description: Decide the fates of altruistic scientist Anu, her ambitious, 'streetwise' brother Octavio, and the fierce, frogurt-slinging Fran. Claw and con your way through five thrilling chapters!

name: EXTREME BIKE X
short_description: Amaze everyone with your speed and tricks! This motocross racing game is impossible to put down! Add to the fun by making your very own racetracks!

name: CAPTAIN STARONE
short_description: Became the hero ' Captain StarONE ' in this game blending action and ‘inaction’. You set your strategies and combos, then multitask as the game carries out your attacks. Watch the battles unfold and be ready to jump back in to guide our hero!

name: Infested: Space Colony
short_description: Infested: Space Colony is an intense action top-down shooter in a dimly-lit environment where aliens roam in shadowy darkness. Explore various sections of the colony ship. Hunt down aliens before they hunt you down.

name: Coin Blitz
short_description: Need more money in your life? Play Coin Blitz!

name: Observo
short_description: A third-person survival horror game styled after early-2000s horror game classics. What was supposed to be a regular inn turned out to be hiding a nightmare inside...

name: Aero Striker - World Invasion
short_description: Aero Striker is a highly stylized action-packed flight combat simulator game that is intentionally designed to be easy to make it more enjoyable and less nerve-racking. The aim is to have fun making aliens explode while experiencing the sensation of flying. Let none of the evil aliens escape!

name: Klitorax
short_description: Hurry Up, Klitorax needs to find the next toillet! Faith is in your hands and if you dont hurry, it will also be in your pants . . . and on the floor . . .

name: Wojak This Game
short_description: Be the Wojak who can complete in the shortest amount of time with the fewest deaths!

name: Oathbreakers
short_description: Oathbreakers is a multiplayer fantasy VR RPG that incorporates a unique blend of strategic precision-based realtime action combat, with unrestricted player vs player competitiveness, in a relaxing survival RPG themed environment.

name: Learn Japanese RPG: Hiragana Forbidden Speech
short_description: Dialogue changes from English to Japanese as you learn and progress in this comedic RPG backed by professional Japanese voice acting. Master reading hiragana and over 240 common words used in anime!

name: ソラナと陽の工房
short_description: 'Sorana to Sunny no Atelier' is a somewhat nostalgic JRPG that focuses on item synthesis.

name: Port Cranes : Container Age
short_description: Control a Giant Container Crane! The container crane that supported the logistics revolution is now available as a game. Real-time weather changes and state-of-the-art graphics recreate the world of cranes. Perform challenging missions to become a first-class operator!

name: Cubelander
short_description: Take on the role of the Cubic Commander in our latest tower defence game! Fight off geometric invaders through multiple hostile environments, build an energy system and economy to setup huge defences, with your trusty arsenal of futuristic towers and faithful defenders!

name: Mineralis
short_description: Think, talk, and fight your way through moral dilemmas in this hyper-meaningful JRPG. No grinding or filler content - only unique enemies and conversations. Engage your party in campfire discussions. Gain karma and create history in a land torn by conflict. Can you overcome fate?

name: Space Menace
short_description: Space Menace is a real-time sci-fi space exploration and space battle game. You play as a space captain, seeking fortune and glory as you see fit. Leave your mark on the world and determine the fate of the galaxy with your decisions.

name: Cult Of Babel
short_description: Roguelite Overpowered Wizard Simulator & Dungeon Crawler. Slay hundreds of cultists using the power of ancient cards and your magical arsenal. Choose from a diverse set of cards to create unique, game-breaking builds and shoot down the horde trying to stop you from climbing the tower of babel.

name: Meow Defence
short_description: You will drive a spaceship, smash the bricks surrounding the Meow star, and rescue the trapped cats

name: Open The Gates!
short_description: Become king of your own castle in this strategic sidescrolling castlebuilder game. Manage the economy, build defenses and keep your citizens happy. Control diverse armies and fight in large-scale real-time strategy battles.

name: Spectator
short_description: Featuring Backrooms, Slender, FazPizza, and many more locations based on Creepy stories! You are here to watch surveillance cameras in real time and report any kind of suspicious activity. Anomalies range from furniture movement to otherworldly intruders.

name: Monster Prom 3: Monster Roadtrip
short_description: Embark on a road trip like no other in this co-op narrative survival adventure. Visit fun locations, meet wacky characters, and manage your resources wisely. And yes: you still can date some hot monsters ;)

name: DEATHWATCH
short_description: You've been tasked to observe supposedly haunted locations. Observe and log paranormal events and use the tools at your disposal to gather data on any potential paranormal threats and exterminate them if necessary.

name: VariDungeon
short_description: Explore infinite random dungeons with amazing retro pixel art graphics ! Find the best build by testing all the power-ups available, and don't forget to look for all the secrets !

name: Terror of Hemasaurus
short_description: A retro city smash 'em up with satisfying destruction physics. Play as a Giant Monster unleashing terror upon mankind in this modern arcade experience with the action turned up to eleven.

name: Resident Evil Re:Verse
short_description: Beloved Resident Evil characters clash in a fight to the death! Test your skills against other players in six-person deathmatch battles.

name: Lucy Dreaming
short_description: Discover a dark family secret and rid a young girl of her nightmares in this splendidly British point & click comedy adventure. Playing as sharp-witted Lucy, explore both dreams and reality to meet all the colourful characters who'll help you solve puzzles, gather clues and find a murderer.

name: Harmony's Odyssey
short_description: Harmony’s Odyssey is a 3D fantasy adventure puzzle game set on mythical dioramas full of riddles, perky creatures and magic. Embark on a fantastic journey through remote fabled lands tangled by a rowdy cat and bring peace to its inhabitants.

name: Right and Down
short_description: A deep roguelike and card game that is played using only two buttons: Right and Down! Choose your hero and explore randomly generated card dungeons, gather powerful artifacts to get new abilities, and fight against mighty enemies! Will you make it to level 50?

name: Warhammer 40,000: Shootas, Blood & Teef
short_description: From the developers of the Guns, Gore and Cannoli franchise comes a new 2D run & gun platformer: Warhammer 40,000: Shootas, Blood & TEEF! Spearhead an Ork invasion, destroy the hive city and kill your warboss! ‘Ere we go!

name: WHATEVER
short_description: Inspired by true events. Drifting the giant cargo ship through a tiny, winding canal... What could go wrong?

name: REQUISITION VR
short_description: REQUISITION VR is an action survival shooter designed specifically for VR with insane crafting mechanics and the ability to make traps to fight hordes of zombies. Become a survivor of a zombie outbreak in a single or 4-player co-op mode to stay alive in an apocalyptic world.

name: Witch Amelia
short_description: 'Witch Amelia' is about Rody who dreaming of becoming a hero and his childhood friend Amelia went on an adventure together. Both believe that their relationship and this feeling of happiness will last forever.

name: THE TRADER -Goods Dealer Simulator-
short_description: Build your own shop. Run the shop and buy new furnitures. Manage your own economy, buy 50 and above items and sell. To be successful, stay out of crime and serve your customers in a good manner.

name: Candlehead
short_description: Explore a dark and eerie first person horror game where your doom flickers in the form of a candle barely visible through the dusky gloom.

name: The Dead Prince
short_description: Play the role of a blood magic assassin fulfilling the pact his family made long ago. Use your assortment of magical abilities to sneak through bases, take down guards, and assassinate your target.

name: Nitro Kid
short_description: Synthwave roguelike deckbuilder set in the neon 80's. Pick your agent. Build your deck. Hit card combos and fight through the floors of INFINITY tower. Featuring 30+ fresh Synthwave tracks by LudoWic, Tonebox and Jules Reves.

name: Hidden Shapes - Trick or Cats
short_description: Relax and have fun with our kittens' trick or treats in Halloween-inspired monster costumes! Solve beautiful hand-drawn puzzles and be amazed by the creativity of our kittens. A beautiful puzzle created to delight you and rescue your tranquility.

name: Deadlink
short_description: Get ready to put a sizable dent in the profits of megacorporations in Deadlink, a guns-blazing cyberpunk FPS with roguelite elements. Your mission is to conduct covert ops while piloting a humanoid combat shell. And no, 'covert' doesn’t mean 'quiet.'

name: Bunny Eureka
short_description: A cozy game. Build a bunny town, and take care of cute bunnies. grow plants and add buildings, and enjoy happy bunnies living in your town. Let these soft cute bunnies be with you.

name: Robot Resistors
short_description: Robot Resistors is a rogue-lite action game with auto-attacking weapons and deep customization. Choose from multiple stages, characters, weapons, and upgrades to make each twenty-minute run unique. Escape your brutal robot overlords or be turned to scrap!

name: Purple War
short_description: Purple War is a classic online multiplayer RTS game. Gather resources to build base and train troops, and command your troops to take down the opponent. Intuitive and fast-paced but easy to learn, allowing players to concentrate on strategizing during intense battles.

name: Chacara
short_description: Hitting the highway immediately after finishing a crazy party was definitely not a good idea... Now you are stranded on the road, luckily, there is a cozy country house nearby, what could go wrong?

name: Of Blades & Tails
short_description: A turn-based RPG that is action-oriented but rewards a thoughtful approach. Explore a fantastic land populated by different animal tribes. Follow the main story or hunt for treasures in ancient ruins and mysterious dungeons. Develop your character and gain powerful equipment.

name: VANQUISH
short_description: This is Vanquish! A top-down pixel art shooter where you play as either an Orc Warrior or a Gnome Magician which have both crashed onto a cursed island.

name: CRAYON SHINCHAN The Storm Called! FLAMING KASUKABE RUNNER!!
short_description: The action-packed 'Crayon Shin-chan' runner anyone can casually play is here! Gather various costumes and crew and blaze through the streets of Kasukabe and the world of the movies!

name: Are You Afraid of the Dark
short_description: Are you afraid of the dark? you should be. Enjoy this horror game that thrives on your fear of darkness and unknown.

name: Search 4 Bigfoot
short_description: It's a dark night in the forest, and something is lurking just beyond the trees. Can you find Bigfoot before he finds you?

name: RPG Developer Bakin
short_description: RPG Developer Bakin is a game development tool that allows anyone to create RPGs using intuitive operations and advanced features without the need for programming knowledge. Several game asset DLCs are also available, so you can enjoy creating games from the day you purchase it.

name: The Jackbox Party Pack 9
short_description: Save your next party! 5 new games in 1 Party Pack: the trivia bluff-off Fibbage 4, the team test Quixort, the joke auction Junktopia, the silly guessfest Nonsensory and the reality TV game Roomerang.

name: Tiny Solar System
short_description: A single player space game where you fly a rocket around a tiny solar system with realistic physics, including take off, orbiting, orbital transfers and landings. Help settling other planets and moons. No time limits, no stress. If you crash you just get rescued.

name: Father's Day
short_description: The dream of living happily ever after was destroyed after Phil lost his wife and son. Obsessed with the desire to return them, he develops a plan that he does not tell anyone about.

name: Reality
short_description: Reality is a single-player action horror game. Use stealth and shooting to get through a wide variety of enemies. Wandering freely around the realistic school and grounds, you come upon a startling revelation involving a certain schoolgirl.

name: Closer To Home
short_description: Closer To Home is a dialogue-focused surreal horror exploration game. Navigate connections between reality and dreams, look for weird stuff and make friends. There is no reason to fear death.

name: JoJo Siwa: Worldwide Party
short_description: Run through JoJo's worlds to her biggest hits including D.R.E.A.M, Bop and Nonstop! Can you match the rhythm and make the crowd go wild?

name: FREM Sprite32!
short_description: Play, learn, and experiment with programming in the Sprite32! 8-bit microcomputer sandbox. Use the high-level FREMScript programming language to write programs, create dynamic pixel art, and explore audio generation. Play tutorials and challenges to learn all the aspects of the system.

name: Zombie Apocalypse Survival Simulator
short_description: From the creators that brought you The Test Trilogy & many other experiences, comes Zombie Apocalypse Survival Simulator. Will you survive in the new world? Or will you become just another victim to looters, bandits, or worst of all... The Voracious Dead. There's only one way to find out...

name: Liberation Special Forces
short_description: This is tactical first person shooter that you lead a small squad with different weapons to eliminate opressors to avoid them from terrorising free people.

name: Pillars Of Protection
short_description: Pillars of Protection is a team-based tower defense game. Towers can take on complex movement paths. You can play online multiplayer in PvP or PvE modes. Build a base to protect your core from the onslaught of incoming monsters. Play as a shooter, melee, mover, or healing hero.

name: Batora: Lost Haven
short_description: Embark on an epic adventure to save Earth in this interplanetary action RPG. Harness the ancient powers of Sun and Moon to take on a variety of unique enemies while solving diverse puzzles and exploring stunning sci-fi worlds, each with its own curious stories, inhabitants, and mysteries.

name: Extreme Truck Stunts
short_description: We think you've heard a lot of legends about how hard it is to be a real truck driver.

name: Hell is Others
short_description: Hell is Others is an extraction horror PVPVE top-down shooter. Outside the safety of your apartment lies the noir hellscape that is Century City. A city of endless night that straddles the line between reality and insanity. Explore, hunt and loot in a place where blood is literally currency.

name: FAITH: The Unholy Trinity
short_description: What you are about to do has not been approved by the Vatican. As a young priest, struggle against demons, insane cultists, and your own weakening faith in this pixel horror game inspired by the era of classic 8-bit gaming and the 'Satanic Scare' of the 1980s.

name: Lion King Simulator
short_description: In this hunting simulator, you will play the role of a predator who is looking for food for himself and his family.

name: The Valiant
short_description: Embark on a journey of brotherhood and redemption in The Valiant, a squad-based RTS set in 13th Century Europe and the Middle East. Command and level-up your medieval knights as you fight through an epic SP campaign, then take your skills online in both cooperative and competitive MP modes.

name: Free My Sight
short_description: FREE MY SIGHT is eight easy exercises which helps You perform eyes movements and stretching mixing gentle music to relax Your mind and release Your stress: sometimes Your eyes deserve it: relax Your mind and stretch Your eyes

name: Riley & Rochelle
short_description: Uncover the lives, losses, and stories of two musicians from opposite sides of the tracks as they become superstars, fall in love and fall apart in this 90s narrative puzzle game.

name: Project Beril / 贝丽尔养成计划
short_description: This is an AI game.

name: Actua Ice Hockey
short_description: In this classic ice hockey simulation game from 1998, experience fast-paced, motion-captured ice hockey action, playing in the 1998 Winter Olympics in Nagano. Choose from a roster of world-class teams, or create your own custom team and lead them to greatness.

name: Pressure Within
short_description: A post-apocalyptic third-person shooting game that reminds you of the true horrors of the apocalypse. Where do I use the bathroom? Rid the streets and suburbs of zombies and other monstrosities while you solve awful riddles.

name: 云城异闻录
short_description: 本游戏剧情参考豫章书院的真实事件，在一些地方你发现一些文章，证明这里以前也有人来过这里，但是都没有走出去，你惊奇的发现写这些文章的人都出现在学校的违纪人员名单，于是你要逃脱这里，你需要通过寻找关键文章通过提示找到钥匙推进剧情最后逃离这里，这是一款第一人称视角的RPG恐怖游戏，玩家将扮演一位受害的学生，可以在游戏中体验到真实的“豫章书院”事件，目前处于持续更新中，后需将推出更完善、更精彩的游戏内容、更大的地图、更丰富的场景

name: DAVE THE DIVER
short_description: Welcome to 'DAVE THE DIVER', a marine adventure set in the mysterious Blue Hole. Explore the sea with Dave by day, and run a sushi restaurant at night. Uncover the secrets of the Blue Hole, and unwrap this deep sea mystery involving 3 friends, each with distinct personalities. New adventures await.

name: Relayer Advanced
short_description: GODWARS TEAM presents the SRPG 'Relayer Advanced'! The game depicts the fierce battle between the 'Starchildren' and the extraterrestrial 'Relayer' and lets you use the 'Hate' and 'Big Bang' systems to lead the battle to victory!

name: The Backrooms
short_description: The Backrooms is a first person survival horror game set in one of the most terrifying environments of the human psyche. Explore an ever evolving nightmare while running from terrifying creatures to stay alive.

name: SOWON
short_description: In the middle of the night, while finding her parents, a girl falls to the toy world through attic locked for a long time. Will it be possible for her to find her parents and go back to her world? Let's solve some puzzles and explore the mysterious toy world.

name: fig.
short_description: You do not know anything, yet you have to move forward. Wander through the corridors of a mysterious factory and recover your abilities. Fight patroling drones and break through to demanding boss battles. Seek a way out and find the meaning of the game's title.

name: Titanium Hound
short_description: Titanium Hound is retro-looking video game in cyberpunk genre, where you are going to pilot huge and agile exoskeleton to crush hordes of crazed security drones and abominations to uncover conspiracy carefully crafted by one of global corporations.

name: Machine Gun Fury
short_description: On a bold and potentially dangerous mission to revive the classic Arcade military shooter. Fully loaded with addictive top-down and side-scrolling run-and-gun gameplay, pixel-perfect 2D graphics, explosive SID soundtrack and massive destruction! Fight on foot and in heavily armed vehicles.

name: Loser's Romance
short_description: The no social skills dating sim.

name: CESSPOOL
short_description: Make the right choices for discover all the mysteries of a psychedelic world in this minimalist JRPG where actions are done through mini-games!

name: Party Maker
short_description: Builder. Designer. Renovator. Unleash your creativity in over a dozen unique places, get the right equipment, prepare the space, use what you find. Wanna make a crazy party?

name: BLOWFLY
short_description: This is an NES style platformer game, fly and explore to find pink poo in the map and destroy them, which is the only condition to pass the level. You need to avoid dangerous traps, defeat the alien creature AssMan that invades the earth, and achieve the final victory!

name: Square Farm
short_description: A relaxing and addictive farm-themed block puzzler. Harvest crops by filling your big square field with blocks of seeds that come in a variety of challenging shapes. Progress through the seasons, earning money that can be used to upgrade your cozy farm.

name: The Siege of Brimir
short_description: Play as an alien with super powers in frenetic battles against the army. Fly, punch, burn and smash them. They will fall under your power and there is nothing humanity can do to avoid it.

name: A Thousand Years
short_description: A real time strategy game in which you manage small parties of angels and devils. Equip units and watch them auto-battle in a procedurally generated world.

name: Para Eyes
short_description: Para Eyes is a spot the difference horror game. Flip through security cameras and find anomalies. But be careful not to go insane.

name: 恋爱绮谭 不存在的真相
short_description: 《恋爱绮谭~不存在的真相~》是一款文字冒险游戏。 初到江城的顾唯，意外成为了一起社会新闻的主人公。凶险的都市中，他需要在混乱的舆论和虚假的情报中找到唯一的真相，也需要在两名各有千秋的少女间完成自我的抉择。秋去冬来，覆盖城市的厚厚积雪下，究竟掩藏着什么样的秘密......

name: Ace Pilot Europe
short_description: Arcade style World War 2 aircraft game. Control multiple fighters in dogfights. Fly bombing run with B25 and B17. Hunt submarines with a B24. Drop paratroopers in a C47. Attack trains. 10 different missions over Europe. This is my second indie game and it's a lot of fun.

name: Good Night, Peregrine
short_description: A short experimental visual novel where you spend time with the titular Perry, a shut in recluse gamer, and his friends. Meet a colorful cast of characters in a strange world much like our own. Learn and explore secrets from the past. There is no happy ending to this game.

name: Garbage Pail Kids: Mad Mike and the Quest for Stale Gum
short_description: Garbage Pail Kids are back in this Long-Lost, All-New platforming adventure. Featuring four playable characters, six secret-filled levels, and a trading-card system, Garbage Pail Kids: Mad Mike and the Quest for Stale Gum is a throwback to the golden era of 80s gaming.

name: Dear Nostalgia
short_description: Text-based adventure horror short game

name: Endoparasitic
short_description: Three limbs ripped off, infected with a deadly parasite, you must save your research. Drag yourself through the corridors of a secret research lab on a remote asteroid, fight off horribly mutated monsters, inject countless syringes of vaccines, and survive at all costs.

name: Jump Ball
short_description: Spin and Jump of many challenging obstacles.

name: Bones of Halloween
short_description: How long can you survive the night of the pumpkin skeletons? A small but spooky first-person shooter with a Halloween theme

name: Maximum Velocity
short_description: Maximum Velocity is a Street Racing MMO That allows you to customize your cars the way you want to. Drift, drive, or drag and unlock cool rewards and skins to upgrade your builds.

name: Magic Axolotl
short_description: Magic Axolotl is a tiny game about draw the spells on the screen to defeat the enemies.

name: Hidden Shapes Animals - VR
short_description: Tired after a hard day at work? Now, with the help of VR, you will delve deep into an environment exclusively prepared for you to have fun and rescue your tranquility, surprising yourself with each solved puzzle!

name: Mosaique Neko Waifus 5
short_description: Unique hentai puzzle about flirting with cute anime Neko girls. 'Neko Waifus' is a series loved by millions around the world

name: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® II
short_description: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® II drops players into an unprecedented global conflict that features the return of the iconic Operators of Task Force 141.

name: Artifacts of Eyru
short_description: Artifacts of Eyru is a rogue-lite first person shooter with RPG elements. Play as 4 classes as you delve into the dungeons of Eyru, claim powerful artifacts, and unravel the mysteries of the planet.

name: Outer Darkness
short_description: Lay waste to hordes of evil in the Outer Darkness. Learn and augment spells and upgrade your character's abilities. Unlock and harness 8 different elements with unique gameplay to escape the forsaken dominion.

name: Ghost of Dragon
short_description: Ghost of Dragon is a semi-idle role-playing game. Players can build battle teams with unique heroes, flexible equipment, soul gems and powerful pets; the unique resident system provides players with great freedom for town management, whether it is forging equipment, capturing pets, refining soul...

name: Dark Past
short_description: Dark Past is based on psychological horror by paranormal activity occurring during your investigations. Play solo or up to 4 players to try and solve the mystery of what entity is left behind.

name: Jewel Match Twilight 2
short_description: Make your blood run cold... with this spooky match-3 adventure! A scourge has taken over the kingdom and destroyed its strongholds. Traverse a dark land full of haunted horrors! Keep evil at bay in 90 enormous levels designed to delight and fill you with fright.

name: Park Ranger: Lost In The Woods
short_description: Explore the map and search for clues relating to the missing person's report, but be careful. You're not alone, you are being followed. Looking at him only makes it worse, he is always watching. He is always coming.

name: Lost Amulets: Four Guardians
short_description: A unique combo of hidden object games, tile-matching puzzles and challenging mini-games!

name: WikiArena
short_description: The 'trivia roguelike' where Wikipedia articles battle it out and you predict the winner! Guess the length and popularity of articles randomly pulled from Wikipedia's daily growing archive of 6.5+ million entries! Featuring arena, endless and a WikiBot duel mode, no two runs will ever be the same!

name: SPACE DUDES vs ALIEN DUDES
short_description: SPACE DUDES vs ALIEN DUDES - Alien Dudes are attacking the Base, It's up to the Space Dudes to Stop Them ! Play Across Many Maps and Game Modes to Win the Day !

name: The Space Eater (Working Title)
short_description: The Space Eater is a mystery adventure game inspired by classic horror RPG Maker games. Investigate your surroundings for clues, solve puzzles and move forward.

name: Ancient Islands
short_description: Tower-defense mixed with economy elements. It features complex skill trees, resource trading, building your own village, and setting individual tactics for each tower. Can you defend what you've built from hordes of enemies? Visit Ancient Islands and test your tactical sense!

name: Arkanoid - Eternal Battle
short_description: Discover or re-discover, the emblematic block breaker game in a fully modernized version! Classic elements from the franchise will definitely make a comeback, with a brand-new look, new rules, as well as new effects, bonuses and features!

name: Step By Step Hero
short_description: A Walking Simulator Adventure in a randomized world where every step counts!

name: PHOBOS Project
short_description: Phobos Project is a first-person psychological horror adventure exploring the depths of psychological horror. In this experiment you have to find a way out and keep your sanity level up through different hostile environments. Face your dread and try to find the source of the nightmare !

name: A Walk With My Dog
short_description: Go on a walk with me and my dog Ezio. Play fetch, tug of war, explore & enjoy the sounds of nature!

name: NSG
short_description: NSG tells a story about Hugo, on his last year as a high school student, while he confronts the great dilemma of choosing a career. He dreams about making a movie and needs to decide between his dream and financial stability.

name: Personal Chef to the Stars
