short_description: “Personal Chef to the Stars” is a menu management simulator, Romantic Comedy Yuri Visual Novel, and Dating Sim. Play as Chef Ayesha Rogers as she must balance the needs and desires of a household filled with eccentric celebrities while also managing her own budding love life.

name: Yomawari: Lost in the Dark
short_description: Another chapter of the atmospheric horror series has emerged from the shadows! Eerie sound design and shadowy environments set the stage for gruesome and terrifying ghosts never seen before in the series.

name: EL PASO, NIGHTMARE
short_description: Slay hordes of vampires, werewolves, and Biblically-accurate angels in this standalone survival horror FPS side story from the El Paso, Elsewhere universe.

name: Project Colonies: MARS 2120
short_description: Project Colonies: MARS 2120 is a 2.5D side-scrolling action-adventure game, of the Metroidvania subgenre, in which players take control of Lt. Anna “Charlotte” Right in order to find out what happened to the Colony.

name: HorrorBox
short_description: HorrorBox is a Multiplayer Horror Game dripping with an eery cinematic experience set in the 80s. Utilize tools and work together to survive either PvE or PvP fright nights...

name: Trigger Henry
short_description: Trigger Henry is a adventurous hardcore platformer. Every jump gets you one step closer to winning, or does it? One wrong footstep and your progress will be lost! Not many are able to stay calm while Henry comments every fail of yours with his triggering sayings.

name: Case Files: The Death of Paulette Williams
short_description: A real-time, police interrogation and detective simulator, where you control the course of the investigation.

name: Dancing Hime: Rhythm Matching
short_description: “Dance Hime: Rhythm Matching” is a VR game that combines match-3 with music and dance. It focuses on match-3 and girls' hot dance. In addition to the sense of achievement after a successful match-3, players can also enjoy the immersive dance of elven girls.

name: Temple of Horror
short_description: Escape the dangerous beings lurking in the dark, dodge countless deadly traps and slowly unruffle the secret of the Temple of Horror while not just trying to survive but to find your way out of this hell. Are you ready?

name: Bunny Box Breakout
short_description: Break blocks. Rescue bunnies. Collect bunnies. All the bunnies. ALL THE BUNNIES.

name: Department of the Devil
short_description: You're trapped in hell for all eternity - at least, that's what the paperwork says. Can you escape by snooping around the private office of The Devil himself? Or will you get caught by his watchful eye?

name: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid Burst Forth!! Choro-gon☆Breath DIRECTOR'S CUT
short_description: The official game of the hugely popular “Miss Kobayashi’s Dragon Maid” manga comes to Steam as a director’s cut that reflects the passion of the development team! Fly, shoot, and punch... send enemies flying right before your eyes!

name: MetaMorphic Rippers
short_description: A fast-paced arena Brawler that combines the Stylish Combat of a Hack and Slash Game With Transformations, Players can select each Class with unique attributes and abilities for you to master.

name: Paranormal Observation
short_description: Start your career as a ghost hunter with the latest technology. Use your computer to find out what type of ghost you are dealing with. Are you prepared to face the challenges of ghost hunting?

name: Gloomy Tales: Horrific Show Collector's Edition
short_description: A magical circus adventure with true disappearance! Watch the performance of a traveling circus and don't let your sister be hurt by the forces of evil!

name: Life in Willowdale: Farm Adventures
short_description: Welcome to Willowdale, your life of farming and adventure starts here! The once thriving town of Willowdale is in ruins! The mayor’s business minded daughter Penny has seized the opportunity to modernize the town. The animals felt abandoned and left. Is it too late to stop these changes?

name: SGS Korean War
short_description: The first intense conflict of the Cold War, this war is very often forgotten, its very rapid and dynamic but unknown aspect obliterated by months of stagnation following the first year of operations in Korea. Can you make it remembered?

name: Frog Detective 3: Corruption at Cowboy County
short_description: You're a detective, and a frog, and it's time to solve a mystery in the wild west.

name: SuperTotalCarnage!
short_description: Slay never-ending legions of monsters while running in circles! SuperTotalCarnage! is a gory and dark horror casual game with rogue-lite elements. Choose from a variety of weapons and perks and make every playthrough a different experience. Unlock many characters each one with different abilities.

name: Clash II
short_description: Clash II is a turn-based strategy game in a world steeped in ancient magic. Immerse yourself in its history and explore forgotten land full of magical creatures. Gather and train an army, expand your stronghold, upgrade your heroes! Lead one side of the conflict and decide the fate of the continent!

name: Stonegeon 迷石地牢
short_description: Stonegeon is a 2D action game with adventures in the dungeon. By fighting monsters, collecting resources, making items, searching treasure chests in the dungeon, and finally to the deepest part of the dungeon, unlock the long sealed secret.

name: Broken In Time
short_description: Broken In Time is an action/adventure Turn based RPG. You (Titus) will explore different dimensions, solve puzzles, fight demons and monsters and ally with the other hero's around the multiverse!

name: ALPHA-NIGHTHAWK
short_description: Some 380,000 kilometers above Earth, Consuelo the Space Rose blooms in the moonlight, its origins and intentions a mystery. It last launched a Thorn five years ago—all that's left of Tokyo today is the lawless “Red Zone,” a slum within a slum, sealed off from the world...

name: Paper Cut Mansion
short_description: In this papercraft roguelite, explore a mysterious mansion floor by floor. Solve puzzles, battle enemies and complete quests as you unlock new abilities to aid you on each run as you solve the mystery behind the Paper Cut Mansion.

name: SIMULACRA 3
short_description: The town of Stonecreek is haunted. People keep disappearing into thin air, leaving nothing but an eerie symbol behind. With the townsfolk gripped with fear, use a missing victim's phone to unlock the truth in the third entry of the acclaimed horror series, SIMULACRA.

name: Horrors of the North
short_description: In the game you need to solve puzzles, run away from evil spirits, do not be eaten by a bloodthirsty creature

name: 冒险与魔法
short_description: 游戏介绍： 冒险与魔法是一款文字冒险策略游戏，玩法丰富有趣，在游戏里你可以体验几十种不同的职业人生经历，并且可以通过招募壮大自己的冒险团，装备好自己的队伍，备好粮草箭矢，药剂还有魔法卷轴之后，到世界各地冒险，打猎或者与各种魔兽怪物战斗，获得战利品和经验，并且回到主城向国王领取赏赐，得到声望和地位提升，用赚来的金币继续壮大队伍填充补给，屯一些高级魔法卷轴以备不时之需，之后向更广阔而神秘的地方进发。这个世界还有很多秘密也许在未来可以和你见面。

name: Saturn Quest: R. U. N. E. 3000
short_description: Saturn Quest: R.U.N.E. 3000 is a tragic Alien Space Opera featuring asystematic Action-RTS battles and epic plot of mythological proportions.

name: Tkium Underground
short_description: Tkium Underground is a short horror escape game taking place in an unknown tunnels facility. Activate generators, levers, and find a specific object to unlock the exit door, then find it. You were not the first one to be in this situation, but will you be the first one to escape alive?

name: Living With Dragons
short_description: Travel with your dragon companion to locate and hatch the 6 Elemental Dragons. Farm crops and raise livestock to feed your creature companions as well as crafting items to make your journey easier. Tame new creature companions and use their abilities to improve your farming and crafting.

name: Junkyard Fury 2
short_description: A horror first person strategy game! Shut down the killer cars before it's too late!

name: The Levels of Backrooms
short_description: Explore, discover, and document the dark, liminal reality known as the Backrooms, experiencing dread and isolation as you navigate it. We wish you luck in your travels.

name: Army of Ruin
short_description: Wreak havoc on countless foes with mighty weapons and deadly spells! Enhance your skills and face even greater dangers! Army of Ruin is an auto-shooter where you become the Bullet Hell.

name: Gravix
short_description: Gravix is a challenging arcade game that will test your agility and puzzle-solving intuition. You must navigate an avatar that is continuously being affected by gravity that you control. Each level will introduce progressively challenging contraptions and deadly obstacles...

name: Imaginefield 2042
short_description: Imaginefield 2042 display a battlefield with two kinds of vision, and use various weapons and tools to destroy all targets.

name: Football Manager 2023
short_description: Upgrade your managerial game with new levels of authenticity and immersion in FM23. Your journey towards footballing glory awaits. Pre-order for 20% off and Early Access*.

name: Miraculous: Rise of the Sphinx
short_description: Paris needs a hero! Once again, the city of lights is in trouble as it faces a new menace! As you take on the personas of the globally renowned superheroez Ladybug and Cat Noir, you’ll need to unveil the diabolical plan hatched by archvillain Hawk Moth—and squash it!

name: Night Of Disturbance
short_description: This game is a short Horror experience, which you as the player will explore and travel through the linear story. This game will challenge you to face your fears and travel through creepy corridors and dark forests. Will you find the secrets lurking in the darkness?

name: Rhythm Stones
short_description: Rhythm Stones is a 1 button 3D rhythm game that crosses moving stepping stones.

name: Asterix & Obelix XXXL : The Ram From Hibernia
short_description: Join Asterix & Obelix in a brand-new original story in… Hibernia! Explore this crazy action-adventure in a local coop mode up to 4 players !

name: For What Will Come
short_description: Return to your childhood home in hopes to see your family, uncover the secrets behind your family's disappearance. What will you uncover? Will the family mystery end with you, or never be thought of again..

name: Slippery Richard! ~ He's Taller Than My Husband ~
short_description: An unplanned shotgun wedding! This isn’t the first time Yaya has made a mess of things and expected her mother to clean up... “When you truly love someone, you plan ahead—marriage is supposed to come before all that other stuff! Now I guess it’s up to me to test if he’s really husband material...”

name: Touch Love
short_description: Which correct route can touch the hearts of beautiful girls?

name: Silver Lines
short_description: Who's the fannest of them all?

name: Grey Block
short_description: A 3rd-person, stealth adventure that asks the player to help Theo Church escape the Green Valley Psychiatric Hospital where he has been committed while unravelling the conspiracy that landed him there.

name: LiveScream
short_description: Armed with nothing but your curiosity, streaming equipment, and insatiable need to impress others, you approach a long-abandoned house in your small town. What could possibly go wrong?

name: 12 Labours of Hercules XIV: Message in a Bottle
short_description: Help Hercules uncover the mystery of strange messages in bottles and save Olympian gods!

name: Hajis
short_description: You have to maintain your mentality in a place where any sound can cause your death, Hajis is a survival co-op game 2-4 players.

name: Beasts Shall Rise
short_description: The 4th Horseman of the apocolapse has unleashed hell on earth. It's down to you to clean up the mess. Beasts Shall Rise is an action packed VR looter shooter roguelike horror with full freedom of movement and immersive AAA quality visuals.

name: Death's Playground
short_description: Death's Playground is a psychological horror multiplayer (4vs1) made to scare its players. Explore the creepy atmosphere of the haunted locations and search for proof of paranormal activity while running away and hiding from the killer sneaking around to jumpscare you, when you turn your back.

name: The Witch's House
short_description: There is an old house on the edge of a small town. All the locals have always avoided it, as strange and mysterious events constantly happen there. This time, what happened in this house made the whole city shudder with fear.

name: SO BELOW
short_description: Gear up, hunt, adapt, survive. Engage in a co-op survival horror experience with up to 4 players online. Explore the haunted location, find the clues and tools needed to complete the ritual and defeat the entity. Will you be able to survive?

name: Fall For You
short_description: Fall For You is a rhythm-based roguelike. Move and attack with the beat to power up, win the hearts of every damned soul you meet, traverse perilous obstacle courses, win fabulous prizes that change the way you play, and cuddle with a scary demon mom to keep yourself going!

name: SIGNALIS
short_description: A classic survival horror experience set in a dystopian future where humanity has uncovered a dark secret. Unravel a cosmic mystery, escape terrifying creatures, and scavenge an off-world government facility as Elster, a technician Replika searching for her lost dreams.

name: The Pinball Wizard
short_description: In this pinball dungeon crawler, your goal is to dash, hurl, and flip your way to the top of the tower castle. Level up skills, loot treasure, and fight monsters in this cozy single-player game. Explore and discover the key to each room, restore the power of The Eye, and bring peace to the lands.

name: BEAT AIMER!
short_description: BEAT AIMER! is a rhythm shooter where you shoot to the beat. Get your mouse and headset ready, this game will test your aim and sense of rhythm – pull off sick flicks to the beat and track to the bass!

name: I See Red
short_description: In the rogue-lite, twin-stick shooter I See Red, you take justice into your own hands. Fight your way through dreary spaceships and use every tool at your disposal. Will you get your revenge?

name: Pocket Witch
short_description: Face different challenges to help the little witch escape from a dungeon full of traps and enemies, where she was trapped by a great evil sorcerer.

name: Deadly Harvest
short_description: Annihilate hordes of wraiths, pumpkins, rats & snakes while defending your farm in Deadly Harvest. Get massive combos in this spooky, casual roguelite, uncovering dark secrets to take on the Headless Horseman!

name: Panic Porcupine
short_description: A Meat-Like/Hedge-Like Mashup! Dr. Proventriculus is snatching up the Chickabirbs! Help Panic blast through over 50 stages of topsy-turvy, spike-laced, slime-drenched, buzzsaw-filled deathtraps to rescue them! And remember, there are no rings...

name: Age of Heroes: The Beginning
short_description: An evil sorcerer has escaped from prison, and now you must collect a band of heroes to save the land from fear and darkness.

name: Cosmoteer: Starship Architect & Commander
short_description: Design and simulate the starship of your dreams! Command it in epic battles and manage your crew while exploring a dangerous galaxy. Play alone or with friends, test your ship in online PvP, and let your imagination reach for the stars!

name: Astral Flux
short_description: Two would-be astronauts and scrappers fumble their way through space, desperately searching for a way home, in this action platformer with roguelike elements.

name: The Monster Within Me
short_description: The Monster Within Me is a first-person psychological horror game featuring a dark, lonely, and atmospheric environment that offers an immersive and disturbing experience.

name: Whispering Abyss
short_description: Whispering Abyss is a top-down rogue-like in the setting of Lovecraftian horror. Play as Grace as you navigate the treacherous abyss and rid Dululth of its monsters with your trusty dual revolvers! Descend into the madness in a procedurally generated abyss, collecting loot to aid your quest.

name: Dungeon in a Bottle
short_description: Dungeon in a Bottle is a precision platformer about choosing the right kind of jump. The acrobatic thief, Reya, has gotten himself trapped in a magic bottle, and now he must use every jump at his disposal to escape the treacherous dungeon within! Hopefully he'll grab some treasure while he's at it.

name: Charon's Staircase
short_description: In this first-person horror mystery game, you set out to bury the horrible past of a tyrannical government. Retrieve and destroy the documents that unravel the secrets that lie beneath Oack Grove. Will you discover the terrifying truth and find your way out?

name: SAVE THE EARTH
short_description: Dangerous monsters are invading the entire planet There is a crisis in the planet You have been given a important task to protect the planet

name: 人类动物园 Human Zoo
short_description: Beautiful teenagers, dreams, grotesque orgies. When no one in the world is awake anymore, is your sanity an alternative madness? A turn-based surrealist psychological horror game with beautiful L2D combat artwork and a deep, philosophical plot.

name: Chilljong
short_description: Chilljong is an endless adventure for lovers of puzzles and unhurried gameplay without limits! An unusual hybrid of genres in the style of mahjong connect will delight fans of the genre.

name: Virtual Virtual Reality 2
short_description: When a metaverse shuts down, what happens to the avatars left behind?

name: Vade Retro : Exorcist
short_description: Vade Retro is a PvP exorcism game up to 4 player. Play as Demon and make your opponents go through hell, or join the exorcist team by choosing a specialty to save victims from the devil's grip in this action-packed experience.

name: Assassin's Vol.
short_description: 'Assassin's Vol.' is a level puzzle game. You need to drag the female protagonist with the mouse to complete the level and finally rescue her successfully. However, after attacking more enemies, it seems that their abilities can be absorbed. Well, let's work together to make her stronger!

name: A Crown of Sorcery and Steel
short_description: Swing a sword, delve dungeons, and lead a resistance against the tyrannical queen of a war-torn fantasy realm. Will you unite the realm and end the queen’s reign of terror... or join her and rule by her side?

name: Soulslinger
short_description: Soulslinger is a challenging, fast paced runner with roguelike elements, in which you must reap your way through the Underworld! Dodge obstacles, eat pies, and get blessings to defeat threatening foes with the help of your powerful Soulvolver.

name: Sackboy™: A Big Adventure
short_description: PERFECTLY CRAFTED FOR PCPlayStation® icon Sackboy bursts into action on PC in a huge 3D multiplayer platforming adventure. • An epic journey stuffed with platforming challenges.• Deeply immersive controls.• Collaborative, chaotic and joyful multiplayer fun.

name: Platonically Mauled by a Magic Cougar
short_description: As nuts as Jun is about his wife, he can’t help but drool over Towaka Minefuji. So when Jun is asked to attend his wife’s school committee meetings in her place, his brain goes into overdrive at the thought of him and Towaka being in the same room together...

name: Murder Is Game Over
short_description: Murder Is Game Over is a pixel art point-and-click murder mystery whodunit involving the untimely death of a famous game designer. You and your trusty companion, Cleo, are on the case!

name: Eraser
short_description: Take on the role of a soldier capable of facing the most dangerous enemies, improving your skills to increase the chances of victory

name: The Sob Island
short_description: The Sob Island is a 2D plot puzzle game. The story of Aidan's mysterious death of his mother on his 13th birthday is like the first domino that fell, changing everything he knew.

name: My Big Sister: Remastered
short_description: My name is Luzia and this story is about my big sister, Sombria. Are you ready to hear it?

name: NOTALONE
short_description: NOTALONE is a single-player horror simulator in which you play the role of 45-year-old Mortie Jones. You learn that your mother is dead and your father is missing. Your task will be to spend the night in your old family home.

name: Perfect Inventory - Organization Puzzle
short_description: Perfect Inventory is an organization puzzle game that brings you to a medieval age in the role of a methodical squire trying to make his best to fit all the items perfectly into the inventory.

name: Dashpong
short_description: Dashpong is a high energy arcade local multiplayer game where you dash all around the maps at full speed. Create paddles to defend your goal and shoot the ball at your opponent to score. Enjoy the game up to 4 players in local multiplayer.

name: Ailin: Traps and Treasures
short_description: Help Ailin to collect treasures in this block-pushing puzzle game inspired by classics like Sokoban and Minesweeper. Navigate through traps and mines and retrieve treasure chests. Create and share challenging levels with a built-in level editor.

name: FIND YOUR WINGS
short_description: A bite-sized tower defense roguelike!

name: The Villager and the Werewolf - A jigsaw puzzle tale
short_description: In this game, when you fit the last piece of each jigsaw, you will hear a fantastic werewolf story written by Marta Machado and illustrated by Alexandre Rocha.

name: Jousting VR
short_description: Welcome to medieval times. Times of Jousting. You take part in a grand tournament competing with other knights, for fame, glory, wealth and to win the king's niece's heart. “To risk life to save a smile on a face of a woman or a child is the secret of chivalry.”

name: Bonding Ambivalence
short_description: Bonding Ambivalence is a unique coop experience based on a French cyberpunk universe. As a special police unit, you and your partner are brought to investigate a sudden shutdown of a research facility. Between reflection and action, you must survive a situation that is beyond you.

name: RealFlight Evolution
short_description: RealFlight® is the industry-leading flight simulator for radio-controlled airplanes, helicopters, and drones. Fly more than 300 hyper-realistic vehicles in an immense, open world right from your desktop. This RC classic is a must-have tool for flight enthusiasts of all skill levels!

name: BOT.vinnik Chess: Prodigies
short_description: Do you think you have nothing to learn from a child? And what about the world's greatest chess prodigies of all time? Let BOT.vinnik - the Soviet digital trainer - show you how.

name: STAR OCEAN THE DIVINE FORCE
short_description: Square Enix and Tri-Ace present the latest title in the Star Ocean RPG series.

name: 修真元界  XiuZhen Metaverse
short_description: 这是一个模拟修真的游戏，可以在游戏里自由的根据自己的想法自创功法，也可以根据自己的想法设定出不同属性的功法，让每个玩家都拥有不同的属性。也可以自由的组合施放的技能以达成各种不同的技能效果，全自由的修炼以及对战体系。

name: KAIJU MONSTER VR
short_description: You play as a giant monster whose only desire is destruction. Confront enemy units, ravage cities and cause as much destruction as possible.

name: Victoria 3
short_description: Paradox Development Studio invites you to build your ideal society in the tumult of the exciting and transformative 19th century. Balance the competing interests in your society and earn your place in the sun in Victoria 3, one of the most anticipated games in Paradox’s history.

name: Fading Light: Antiworld
short_description: The post-war world of nuclear explosion has trapped you in a dark circulated antiworld. Armed only with a faint flashlight and antimatter collector, you have to generate enough energy and hold on till the first sight of the morning light. Hurry, but be careful, it's rumored that you are not alone...

name: Mongrel Games Minigames
short_description: Mongrel Games Minigames brings you over 100 short minigames in a fast-paced challenge to complete each task fast enough.

name: Robotry!
short_description: A physics-based platformer without a jump button. Walk, jump, climb and parkour by directly controlling each leg of a confused baby robot. Go from a glitching toddler to a somersaulting acrobat in the story mode, or share a multi-legged robot with your friends for extra chaos!

name: Last Gang Standing
short_description: Gather up a gang of your friends, build a base, add a factory, add some turrets, add teleporters, doors, foxholes and decorations. Arm yourselves to the teeth and go forth to raze, loot and t-bag all who stand against you. Be the Last Gang Standing

name: Non-Stop Raiders
short_description: In this infinite side-scroll runner play as different raiders, run and jump across areas. Pillage gold from either your enemies or chests across your journey to upgradeabilities or unlock new charecters.

name: Package Rush
short_description: Package Rush is a strategy game about planning a delivery route system in a fast-growing city. Build and modify routes to get all packages on time. How long can you keep delivering?

name: Covid Carl
short_description: Covid Carl is a Metroidvania/Contra-style 2d side-scrolling shooter. It will feature a brief story, 10 levels, and boss fights

name: Come See My Hole
short_description: The Metaverse, NFT's, Virtual Reality, Augmented Reality, Web3. Come See My Hole is none of these things. In Come See My Hole, you stand next to a hole in the ground.

name: Last Command
short_description: Last Command is a fast-paced Snake x Bullet Hell action game. Maneuver through enemies’ barrage of attacks, collect Data Points to deal damage! Mix and match skill chips as you progress, overcome intense Boss battles, and uncover the secrets of their program world...

name: Undead Under Night Rain
short_description: Place your guitarist to attract zombie hordes and shoot them with your soldiers in a perfect mix of modernized tower defense and challenging strategic gameplay. Each soldier is unique with his own ability and upgrade panel to fight a large amount of undead.

name: Chicken Feet
short_description: Chicken Feet is a first person survival-stealth horror game about a giant, angry chicken. Descend into the depths of GOOBER laboratories and uncover the horrors that lie beneath the lab's shiny façade.

name: Dork
short_description: Leave the safety of your village and embark on the journey of adventure! By traveling through eight different and unique locations discover the forgotten history of your people and the tragedy that led to the creation of your civilization. Welcome to the world of Dork!

name: Tilecraft
short_description: 'Tilecraft: A New Horizon' is a minimalist and relaxing strategy game about discovering and building on your explored tiles. Explore a procedurally generated set of resources across the map in this unique and casual atmosphere.

name: DEVIL DEVOUR ALIVE DX
short_description: Devil Devour Alive DX is a pick-up-and-play occult themed arcade game with an over the top 90s style. It supports vertical screen orientation (TATE MODE!!!!), online leaderboards, and unlockables. It also features retro 32-bit era style graphics, CRT shader, and spooky synthwave music.

name: Welcome To The Backrooms
short_description: Welcome to the Backrooms is a indie horror game developed by Brickmade Productions. This game will bring you the ultimate Backrooms survival experience, crafting, lore, entities, and a very in-depth health system which will keep you checking your watch non-stop.

name: Jewel Match Twilight
short_description: Unravel this creepy-crawly match-3 adventure and unveil haunted castles that will leave your spine tingling! Explore vast levels and buy upgrades from the sinister shop to aid you in your travels. Enjoy a spellbinding soundtrack while you explore each of the 120 huge match-3 levels.

name: Sparkling Memories
short_description: 欢迎走进柿树学园，这座全市瞩目的学习殿堂。与同学们齐心协力，办好这里历史悠久的「烟火大会」的重任，即将被你背负在肩上。从高一至高二，在这段有笑有泪的时光中，你将收获毕生难忘的友情与成长。

name: DobbyxEscape: Halloween Adventure
short_description: A fun Halloween inspired Room Escape game!

name: The Bad Son
short_description: The Bad Son is the anti-authority indie horror RPG that your parents don't want you to play.

name: Love Spell: Aslan's Story
short_description: Follow Luna's adventure through different worlds when she accidentally ends up chasing the mysterious pink-haired wizard named Aslan through a magical portal! Love Spell: Aslan's Route is the first content expansion game for our studio's debut title, Love Spell: Written In The Stars.

name: Deliver Us From Evil (DUFE) - Masquerade
short_description: Deliver Us From Evil: Masquerade is a short and sweet BL visual novel. Keldran and Ace are two centuries-long friends with benefits. What starts off as a fun haunted house trip soon turns sinister and If they cannot conquer their fears, they may find themselves wandering the halls forever.

name: Out of Ore
short_description: A casual heavy equipment experience. Mine ore, Move dirt, Build and repair.

name: ReThink 4
short_description: ReThink 4 is a Puzzle Game in a peaceful futuristic setting, that features a variety of Puzzles that utilize Lasers and the behavior of light and it's colors to create challenging problems to solve.

name: TYKEN
short_description: This is an indie game made by a solo developer set in the very distant future. You are a condemned prisoner forced to destroy the monsters at a clandestine genetic research facility located on planet TYKEN. Use futuristic energy weapons in 10 unique environments.

name: Lenny Loosejocks in Space
short_description: You guide Lenny and Donga in their epic quest to save the human race from the evil Sluggees. It's the groundbreaking point-and-click web adventure game sequel to Lenny Loosejocks Goes Walkabout in all its pixelated glory - exactly like you remember playing when you got home from school in 1998.

name: Talon City: Death from Above
short_description: You’re a clever owl lawyer out of your depth, searching for a missing client. With enemies at every turn, can you survive and save the day?

name: How to Say Goodbye
short_description: How to Say Goodbye is a beautiful narrative puzzle game inspired by picture books. Reorganize the environment and solve puzzles to help a group of ghosts on their quest to finally move on.

name: Cyberpoly
short_description: Cyberpoly is an open-world, third person shooter, and RPG set in the Dark City — a dangerous city dominated by money, crimes, and illegal trades. You play as a mercenary who takes missions, works in secondary jobs, builds prestige, and unlock upgrades.

name: Cliff & Field Tower Defense
short_description: Use clever strategies and tricks to defend your new kingdom in this fast-paced, atmospheric and bullet-packed tower defense adventure.

name: I live under your house.
short_description: You are a monster under someone's house.

name: The Nameless
short_description: A classic survival horror game with themes that are loosely based on the works of H.P. Lovecraft.

name: Candle Prick
short_description: Candle Prick is a crunchy pixel adventure about stabbing enemies and using them as extensions of yourself to solve increasingly complex puzzles

name: Midnight Rhapsody
short_description: An interesting and novel adventure trip composed of 10 beautiful girls with different looks

name: 伏魔天师
short_description: 《伏魔天师》是一款融合了角色性格及Roguelike玩法的卡牌构筑类游戏，玩家在一个神鬼莫测的世界中偶遇一系列的妖魔鬼怪，可做法驱妖、也可施法放生，玩家每一次的抉择也将改变自身的性格，随着性格变化后续遇到的人和事也将不断变化

name: HerrAnwalt: Lawyers Legacy
short_description: You’re a Lawyer who tries to save students from a crazy headmaster. You need to survive a variety of school lessons and fight the different teachers

name: Under The Shack
short_description: Please don't let the fact I used RPG Maker Discourage you from buying the game its cheap and fun. It is also the first part to a larger series i am working on!

name: Odd Woods
short_description: Odd Woods is a survival crafting game in a forest environment. Build your base during the day to withstand the attacks of horror creatures at night. Explore, farm and hunt wildlife to survive another day.

name: Angelic Wishes
short_description: Angelic Wishes is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.The game is perfect for relaxing.

name: Routemania
short_description: Routemania is a relaxing, colorful puzzle game where you build routes around the world. Solve 25+ puzzles by discovering the most efficient way to connect cities using your available pieces.

name: Drunk: Relapsed
short_description: Drunk: Relapsed is a challenging and comedic 3D adventure. You will need to stumble and hop through the treacherous streets and alleys to reach the safety of your house. On your journey you'll be able to collect drinks to unlock new outfits.

name: Beneath Oresa
short_description: Beneath Oresa, a fighting roguelike deckbuilder, takes you deep within the city to confront your foes. As a strategist, choose your cards, upgrades, and artifacts wisely, but as a fighter, turn their positioning to your advantage.

name: Checkered Flag
short_description: In this high-speed racing game, originally released in 1991 for the Atari Lynx handheld console, experience the excitement of formula-style open-wheel racing across 18 unique tracks.

name: Senet
short_description: Digital edition of a board game from ancient Egypt meant for two players, Senet is a family friendly turn-based strategy race game made in 3D.

name: Pirated Code: Admin Edition
short_description: When an AI program named Seren awakens to find they've been installed as the co-pilot of a smuggling ship, they'll have to rely on their newfound crewmates to help them find where they belong.

name: Reality Noclip: The Backrooms
short_description: A research organization has finally found your lost tape. With that tape, it is proven that you weren't missing because you got lost, you noclipped out of reality. You have to get out of this place, an infinite maze with little to no escape. How will you escape this reality noclip?

name: Shatter Remastered Deluxe
short_description: Relive the award-winning classic that redefined the brick-breaking genre. Shatter returns in stunning 4K resolution running at 120fps, with a modernised UI, and multiple visual improvements. Re-experience the highly acclaimed original soundtrack, remixed and remastered in 5.1 surround sound.

name: I wanna go home
short_description: Can't stand working overtime anymore! Must find some properties to get rid of this ugly office,be aware of the mean boss,don't get caught by him!

name: Omega Mouse
short_description: Omega Mouse is a tactical-action style game of cat and mouse. Know when to retreat and when to attack. Climb the leaderboard rankings by competing for the highest enemy kill counts.

name: Blocks Tracks Trains
short_description: A relaxing sandbox train set diorama. Build your world, create buildings, set up your track network, and watch your trains go.

name: Boat Builder: Andy's Story
short_description: In this game you have to play as Andy, an experienced yachtsman who starts his new way of life working at his own shipyard. Buy materials, build boats and yachts, complete orders. Start with something simple and build your skills from fishing boats to racing yachts.

name: Hitstream
short_description: Want to make exercise fun? Punch, stretch, squat and step your way to fitness in this 360° game that takes you to stunning locations across the globe. Hit the objects, catch the orbs, dodge the walls and, if you’re feeling really energetic, turn squats on.

name: Pokaban
short_description: Push cards strategically into marked positions to create a poker hand. Beat the dealer's hand to win. Sokoban with poker mechanics.

name: Darkness Reborn
short_description: Short and very dark Medival-Fantasy themed Single-Player RPG

name: Juno 06
short_description: Complete fast turn-based battles in any order you like as you rise to the top in a psychic battle arena on the moon.

name: Girbal
short_description: 'Girbal' is a single player sci-fi Puzzle platformer in which the player solves various puzzles including matching sequences, object size manipulation, and much more using number of tools such as a grappling hook, jet-pack, gravity well generator, and more to overcome these obstacles.

name: Heroes City Superman Edition
short_description: Are you ready for a unique experience where you can choose your own hero and have an adventure on a large realistically prepared map?With heroes city, you can choose your hero and experience flight experience action.Moreover big update coming soon!

name: A Walk With Yiayia
short_description: A Walk with Yiayia is a heartfelt solo-developed, bite-sized adventure game about taking your Greek grandmother on a walk after she's lost her confidence from a scary fall. Connect through engaging conversations, explore a relaxing environment, and complete microquests in this thoughtful adventure.

name: Eyo - Jump 'n' Run RPG
short_description: Upgrade your robot, equip powerful weapons and defences and uncover the secret of your existence. Merciless enemies, treacherous traps and tricky jump 'n' run passages await you in this Jump 'n' Run RPG adventure by two passionate indie game developers.

name: Solid Flight
short_description: Experience carrier as a flying postman!

name: Match Match Mania!
short_description: Compete head to head in this exciting FPS Match-3 MOBA!

name: Pengreens
short_description: Deliver different equipment onto trucks, Manipulate a path to move on, Navigate between platform puzzles and rebuild Penguinland. Carry Ice Blocks along the levels, avoiding to break Carbon Boxes, while planning ahead to beat thight time requeriments, in this level based puzzle platformer.

name: Skullborn
short_description: Skullborn is an infinite massively multiplayer sandbox game! Begin as a skeleton, fight, gather resources, and craft armor/weapon to upgrade your bones! Explore and team up with other players around the world.

name: Super Crazy Chickens
short_description: Help this crazy team of chickens to get the mysterious green eggs while adding more and more members to the adventure. Discover all the secrets, challenge the fearsome bosses or simply create the best levels in Super Crazy Chickens.

name: Sherlock and Watson: A Study in Scarlet
short_description: Step in the shoes of Sherlock Holmes or Dr. Watson and venture on a journey filled with intrigue and mystery. Use your logic and teamwork skills in order to solve the mysterious murder which shocked the 19th century London. Play it with a friend on 2 devices with an open voice connection.

name: Running Fable
short_description: Running Fable is an online/offline multiplayer racing-strategy game for up to 10 players, in which each player must place items and traps strategically before battling against each other on vibrant fantastical levels.

name: From Space
short_description: From Space is a solo and co-op action-shooter for squads up to four players. Take on the challenge of liberating the earth from an alien infestation with your friends, using over-the-top weaponry in a post-apocalyptic world with awesomely stylized graphics. The apocalypse has never been so much fun!

name: Space Bunny Explorers
short_description: Space Bunny Explorers is a third-person adventure game with base building aspects and creature collection mechanics. As an adventurous Space Bunny, you will explore a planet and help a research team build and expand bases on the 4 main islands of this world.

name: Evil Nun: The Broken Mask
short_description: You have been invited to a religious summer camp. When you arrive it is not what you expected and suddenly a nun hits you with a hammer. You wake up inside an abandoned school and you have to figure out how to get out. But to your surprise, you are not the only one trapped there.

name: Save the Queen
short_description: The Skull King has risen once more. As the last bastion against evil, it is your duty to stop him and restore the country to it's peaceful form.

name: Eschaton
short_description: Eschaton is a short, experimental, surreal first-person exploration game. Explore the 'aftermath' of a cult ritual in the grounds of a manor in the remote and picturesque Scottish highlands.

name: Digit Factory
short_description: 《Digit Factory》 is a game that allows you to give full play to your creativity and enjoy the fun of thinking. Design your own pipeline to perform calculations on various combinations of numbers. In the endless demand, find a design that responds to changes with the same. Come , challenge your mind!

name: Amok Runner
short_description: One day, a noble woman turns our protagonist's (the doctor) life upside down by visiting his clinic, in a town where the amok madness is rampant. The doctor leaves all his personal effects and career aside and begins to follow this woman's footsteps while fighting against the deadly amok syndrome.

name: VR Run
short_description: A Run In Place VR Game where you can run in virtual worlds. Track your distance and time.

name: Non-Euclidean
short_description: Nothing ever truly resorts to such madness, but when something is brought to exist that fragments the true nature of what we believe to be possible, everything goes out the window and into the mits of madness.

name: Minesweeper Arcade
short_description: Take on a 50-level minesweeper arcade challenge, or relive the nostalgic fun of classic minesweeper.

name: Skate Rift
short_description: A minimal first person skateboarding simulator set on an island, interconnected by many courses and rifts.

name: Angry Angus
short_description: Angry Angus is a Bullet Heaven game, where the player and enemies are driving in cars, using momentum and turning mechanics instead of just walking unrestricted. Gather experience, gain new weapons and upgrades, and try to survive the whole 15 minutes.

name: AI: Art Impostor
short_description: AI: Art Impostor is the brand new party AI drawing game. You are an artist who commands AI to draw new artwork. You and other artists will collaborate in preparing for the next exhibition, but one of you doesn't know its theme. You should find a fake artist without being doubted by other artists.

name: Shin Galaxy - Alpha War
short_description: A space shooter game with RPG mechanics. Players will be able to improve their ships to tackle the challenges ahead, as well as buy better ships and customize them.

name: 建安外史 The Tales of Jian An
short_description: 這是一款三國歷史戰棋遊戲，遊戲以劉備為主視角，用遊戲的模式來描述東漢末期黃巾之亂直到三國時代的一段歷史故事。遊戲玩法是比較傳統的回合製戰棋模式，劇情對東漢末年和三國時代有全新的詮釋和解讀，能讓您在賞玩之余，了解更多的歷史文化內容。

name: E.E.R.I.E2
short_description: E.E.R.I.E 2 is a tactical shooting game. In the modern Gensokyo, play the role of fairy Luna, and uses a variety of modern light weapons and tactical equipment to join in a war that decides the fate of Gensokyo.

name: Patty Pepperton in The Pumpkin Patch
short_description: Patty Pepperton in the Pumpkin Patch is a humorous little horror romp through a mystical pumpkin patch. You must run for your life and find all the golden pumpkins and hopefully escape and get revenge on your old roommate.

name: Vajont VR
short_description: This interactive first-person VR experience is set in the Vajont valley, some hours before the disaster. A wife and her husband are talking about their future: the woman senses the danger and wants to leave; her husband dismisses the idea of danger. The player will determine the end of their story.

name: The Search For Paradisus
short_description: You are in a place called Purgatorium, a labyrinth prison. Why are you there? A mysterious being called Mr. Nobody introduces himself and says his goal is to get to Paradisus. However, he doesn't care if you make it, but, he's the only help you have. Will you be able to get there? Who is Mr. Nobody?

name: Leave a Light
short_description: Alone in the darkened manor, terrible secrets wait to be brought to light. Discover the clues to your family's past, and search for supplies that may help you survive what lurks in the shadows.

name: Shanubis
short_description: You find yourself trapped alone in a pyramid, being hunted by an Egyptian God. Break containers to find what you need to survive and escape but stay quiet, Shanubis doesn't like trespassers. Just ask the rest of the research team...

name: Malice
short_description: You fall through a sinkhole into a nightmarish Japanese mansion with a lingering, sinister presence and terrifying threats… and the only way out is deeper in. Malice is a two-player, compulsory co-op survival horror that forces you to make unforgiving choices and rely on your wits to survive.

name: Kingshunt
short_description: Kingshunt is a third person tactical arena brawler set in a dark fantasy world. Form a team of five, choose your hero and take the fight to the enemy in this competitive online multiplayer game. Summon powerful minions and towers to combat the enemy team.

name: Me With Me
short_description: Control your cat and your imagination dark cat and go on an adventure to explore and save the world

name: Primordial Pain
short_description: Primordial Pain is a brutally unforgiving, fast paced arena shooter with one key mechanic: Pain. Perform an elegant dance on the fine line between maximum power and certain death.

name: Spellbook Demonslayers
short_description: Slay thousands of demons with powerful magic to protect the Cosmic Library! Choose new spells and upgrades every run to create overpowered builds with each character, and steal the powers of defeated enemies to destroy the demonic horde.

name: 镇邪
short_description: 《镇邪》是一款单机国风道士题材游戏，根据大量的民间故事改编。玩家将扮演道门弟子前往神秘村庄调查身世之谜，不想却无意中卷入一场巨大的阴谋。摸金寻宝，驱邪镇灵，开坛做法，画符炼尸...空前绝后的人鬼较量，灵异邪祟的无尽纠缠。二十载宿命，难抵一生夙愿。

name: WRC Generations – The FIA WRC Official Game
short_description: Rise to all the challenges of the most comprehensive, realistic and demanding rally simulation ever developed. Dive into the heart of the action and drive the cars from the 2022 WRC championship, including the new hybrid models.

name: MeiQi 2019
short_description: The 'Meiqi' series is a plot-oriented puzzle game. This collection is the beginning of the Meiqi Series, including all 6 episodes of the first season, namely Meiqi/Tingting/Sifeng/Aiguo/Cuilan/Jasmine, This is the entrance to the little universe of Sun Meiqi's mysterious case.

name: Ambushed
short_description: Ambushed is a 4-player online co-operative horror game. You are trapped in a forest haunted by the ghosts of those who have died here. It's dark. It's cold. But you have nowhere else to go. If you want to live you'll need to finish the ritual and cleanse the forest of the spirits residing there.

name: Silver Nornir
short_description: Can you change the repeating doomed fate of the world in a fantasy RPG?

name: WORDKOUR
short_description: WORDKOUR - Are You a Parkour Enthusiast Who also likes Word Games ? Then WORDKOUR is for You !

name: The Silent Huntress
short_description: 'The Silent Huntress' is a visual novel in the genre of a dark fairy tale with choices and different endings. Not only the development of events will depend on your choices, but also the conclusions that the main character makes about her life and the world around her.

name: If Fusion Were That Easy
short_description: 'If Fusion Were That Easy' is a humorous 2.5D point-and-click adventure about cold fusion and preventing the apocalypse. Explore a diverse world, master tricky puzzles and stop the inevitable.

name: Spintales
short_description: The world has succumbed to the curse of gold. You too, start to feel the drag of it... Can you cleanse the world of the curse, once and for all? Pick up your sword and shield, and venture into a unique roguelike adventure!

name: Lighten Up
short_description: Lighten Up is a bite-sized logic puzzle game. Exercise your brain as you drag and drop puzzle pieces to victory!

name: Mauri Mursu's Hangover
short_description: Help Mauri Mursu on his adventure on the Walrus Islands and cure his hangover!

name: HVS: Hitler VS Stalin - Battle Of Moscow
short_description: Play as Hitler on his mission to assassinate Stalin. Try an alternative history where Hitler actually succed with the Third Reich. Race, shoot and explore the Kremlin in Moscow.

name: NekoNecro
short_description: Run! Jump! Double jump! Pounce and bounce! Meow! A fast-paced 2D platformer with a beautiful hand-drawn 90's graphic novel style.

name: It's Locked
short_description: A horror game about fumbling with a bunch of keys to try escaping a pursuing monster though a series of locked doors

name: RoboCo
short_description: RoboCo is a wholesome sandbox game about designing and building robots to serve the needs of squishy, hapless humans in the world of tomorrow!

name: Perish Song
short_description: Perish Song is a 2D action rogue-lite. Traverse through different environments as you battle unique enemies and bosses. Discover the secrets of the world as you dash and blast through anything standing in your path. Each death is an opportunity to learn, adapt, and overcome.

name: Decopins -Asset Fighters Series-
short_description: Flick, flick. Click, click. Decopins is a tower defense like game with simple action. Don't let Donuts escape from your donuts shop by your Decopin! 20 stages, Hell/Death mode and more. Level up your Decopin skill and make full use of MAGIC. Gamepad, Mouse and Keyboard controls are supported.

name: SURVIVAL IN THE BACKROOMS
short_description: Survival In The Backrooms is an atmospheric horror game in which you will wander for a long time through surreal corridors and rooms in search of a way out. Immerse yourself in this mysterious world and try not to become prey for its inhabitants.

name: CHAQS
short_description: CHAQS is an instructive CTF (Capture The Flag) game that performs the basic functions of an operating system. While it meets your expectations from an operating system to a certain extent with the applications it contains, CHAQS progresses in the direction of more challenges in terms of gameplay.

name: Chonky - From Breakfast to Domination
short_description: Cute characters, endearing enemies and an all together chonky world. Fight your way through adorable monsters, collect all kinds of loot and experiment to find new spells in this top-down action RPG.

name: Touhou Soujinengi V -The Genius of Sappheiros-
short_description: 東方蒼神縁起Vは、古き良き時代のRPGの流れを汲む本格的なRPGとなります。 どこまで面白い戦闘ができるか、簡単かつ楽しめる成長システムとなるかを追求して作られています。 レベルを上げてゴリ押しで進むのではなく、敵の弱点や行動を把握し、適切な仲間と特技を選んで戦っていくRPGです。

name: Sora no Ao to Shiro to
short_description: 《天空的蓝与白/如梭夏日》是由日本美少女游戏品牌Barista Lab于2022年夏天推出的一款恋爱小品作。由知名原画师SesenaYau担当人物设计与原画，由咏野万知子编写剧本，并由知名音乐制作人大川茂伸制作音乐。

name: The Experiment
short_description: This game is a chapter based indie horror game where you need to find your best friend that have gone missing!

name: BATTLE GEAR
short_description: A zombie virus that began with a meteorite, the surviving humans fled to the sea by boat. To get the world back, And for the victory of the human race, Solve the problems, As a troubleshooter for the UN ,That's your mission.

name: Against the Storm
short_description: A dark fantasy city builder where you must rebuild civilization in the face of apocalyptic rains. As the Queen’s Viceroy, lead humans, beavers, lizards, and harpies to reclaim the wilderness and secure a future for civilization's last survivors.

name: Lonesome Village
short_description: Puzzle-solving and life-sim meet in a cozy, no-combat, coyote adventure. Uncover the mysterious, magical past of Lonesome Village and save this town from the hands of evil.

name: Sector Sweep
short_description: Choose your character from many Sector Sweepers and clean the next planets from ever-growing enemies in this top-down action roguelike shooter. Unlock new sectors by defeating enemies and upgrading your weapons or hero powers. Be the best Sector Sweeper the company ever had!

name: This is Hell
short_description: Try and fail to escape the depths of hell and reach the pearly gates above in this rage-inducing platformer with awkward controls.

name: Wandering Duelist
short_description: The Wandering Duelist is a single-player, narrative-driven adventure game that tells a story of love, conflict and reckless actions. The story takes place on a small and lively planet, where its residents carry on their daily activities that often pose dangers and obstacles for the player.

name: 苍白花树繁茂之时Blood Flowers
short_description: A puzzle ＆ plot single-player game. It all starts with the falling star ...... Through the puzzle, find the childhood memories while gradually unraveling the truth of the 'Blood Tree Plague' hundreds of years ago.

name: Missile Command: Recharged
short_description: Defend your cities from an assault of missiles, planes, tanks, and more! Play solo or with a friend in co-op in this modern reimagining of the arcade classic.

name: Aftertime
short_description: A first-person survival horror set in a post-apocalyptic linear world with realistic, 3D-scanned environments varying from cities, indoors, forests, caves where you encounter zombies, dinosaurs, giant mushrooms and massive creatures mutated by toxins released from a meteor crash.

name: RX Racing 2022 Pro
short_description: RX Racing 2022 Pro is an arcade rallycross game where you can drive the drivers of the year 2022 in different categories. The goal is very simple, you take a driver and try to win the race . More than 40 pilots, +20 teams, +25 tracks 3 Modes : Time Attack , Race and Season

name: War Of Gold 2 Mission 99
short_description: Gold are again stolen so you super hero need destroy enemy army and find stolen gold at 10 different locations

name: Arth Island
short_description: Gather resources, set up a camp, choose your class, level up your skills, don't die of cold or starvation and battle the other failed experiments to survive as long as possible on this procedurally generated island

name: Future Mirror
short_description: 'Ten years from now, I will be dead...' A coming-of-age fantasy adventure tale, Future Mirror is a visual novel that explores fate and the choices that affect our future, tragedy, relationships, and happiness.

name: Inspector Detective: Private Eye
short_description: Everyone in town has their version of what happened at Timmons Manor. None of them were there. Everyone has their theories about why a Timmons relative has not set foot on the property in 100 years. None of them are correct...

name: DREAMWILD
short_description: DREAMWILD is a fast paced, Arcade-Styled FPS set in a multitude of unique and bizarre psychedelic worlds! Slice through the endless horde with your accursed sword, discover the secrets that the DreamWilds have to offer, and get to the bottom of the dark plague spreading through all Mindspace!

name: Kartoffl
short_description: Guide the spuds to safety through a variety of increasingly difficult levels in this charming puzzle adventure. Kartoffl is a ridiculously cute and challenging VR game with Lemmings-like vibes.

name: The Past Within
short_description: The Past Within is the new co-op experience from Rusty Lake! Play together with someone you deem trustworthy: one in The Past, the other in The Future. Observe and communicate what you see around you. Solve the puzzles and uncover Albert Vanderboom’s plan.

name: The Entropy Centre
short_description: Think in reverse. Outsmart the impossible. A mind-bending first-person adventure where you solve ingenious and complex puzzles by rewinding objects through time.

name: Soul After
short_description: Soul After는 삶과 죽음의 관계를 아름답게 전달하고자 하는 스토리 위주의 탑 뷰 어드벤처 게임입니다. 현생에서 죽음을 맞이한 당신은 기억을 잃은 채로 사후세계에서 영혼 사자가 되었습니다. 당신의 역할은 사후세계로 오는 망자들이 다음 생으로 환생할 수 있도록 돕는 것입니다.

name: Spliced
short_description: Spliced is a hybrid roguelite deck-builder. Play as a symbiotic ooze, taking the parts and abilities of enemies you defeat. Use cards to battle enemies and navigate the environment.

name: The Hideaway
short_description: The Hideaway is a contemplative, realistic survival experience set in a low poly environment. Lost and wandering in the wilderness without food, water and weapons, your objective will be to survive and contact help as soon as possible, without harming your environnement in any way

name: HARVESTELLA
short_description: HARVESTELLA, an all-new life-simulation RPG from SQUARE ENIX! Lead a life of self-sufficiency with your vibrant house as a base and cooperate with allies to overcome various threats.

name: wurdweb
short_description: Word puzzles with Sunday morning vibes. Grab words from a list and cross them with words on the board. Puzzle your way towards a Finish Tile, put down enough words, or put down as many words as you can!

name: Cat Herder
short_description: Cat Herder is a cute, chaotic puzzle game about literally herding cats! Pick them up, entice them with toys, and learn their preferences as you wrangle them into the target zones as quickly as possible.

name: Operation: Pinkeye
short_description: Operation: Pinkeye is a throwback first-person shooter where you play as a secret agent in an alternate Universe where the Acts of Union in 1707 never happened. Scotland and England remain independent and tensions between the 2 remain very high.

name: PUPPETEERS
short_description: PUPPETEERS is a first person, action packed co-op horror game. Experience a terrifying campaign by yourself, or partner up with up to 4 players in a cooperative horror adventure. Run. Hide. But try not to scream, it might hear you.

name: TFM: The First Men
short_description: A strategy simulation based on stories of the first men. Infinite possibilities await your very own Adam and Eve as they embark on a generation-spanning adventure. How will you shape their future?

name: Each Other
short_description: In this new puzzle game, guide Edwin and Judy through an original story and many levels. And help them to avoid the eye of the supervisors and to escape from their orphanage for the least strange...

name: Puzzline
short_description: This is a 2-4 player board game connecting cards like a puzzle! Each card has a special effect. Play them strategically and get the victory! Online play is also supported!

name: Interrogation Simulator
short_description: Inspired by JCS videos and similar Interrogation analysis. Match evidence with statements. Play good cop/bad cop. Make choices. Learn what makes people tick. Unravel the mystery.

name: Horse Tales: Emerald Valley Ranch
short_description: Set off on a captivating horseback adventure and discover the mysteries of Emerald Valley!

name: GOAL! The Club Manager
short_description: You are more than a coach. You are the undisputed club boss. Are you ready to dominate the league with your team in this re-imagining of the classic sports management franchise? Could you be the next manager sensation? Prove it!

name: Rainy Butcher
short_description: On rainy nights, the serial murderer is on a killing spree. This scares everyone but one girl, the journalist who keeps digging for a promotion. Dauntless, she gets involved deep and wide, hoping to discover the real identify of the rainy night butcher.

name: SUKUR
short_description: Şükür, It is a horror-thriller game with a first-person story. From the moment you enter the game, you will feel that you are alone in the forest and you will try every way to escape.

name: Froggie
short_description: Froggie is a platform game with retro graphics.

name: Five Nights At Furry's
short_description: You, in the role of an FBI agent, must investigate the mysterious murders in the amusement park for the fury fans. For five days, watch the cameras looking for clues and unravel this case before it's too late.

name: Mission: Aliens
short_description: Sergeant, last night we received a signal that an unknown aircraft of extraterrestrial origin had crashed in the taiga. The locals assured us that at the crash site they observed five creatures very similar to humans, only with gray skin and large almond-shaped eyes.

name: Scarlet Tower
short_description: Hunt during the day, be hunted during the NIGHT! Scarlet Tower is a gothic horror casual game with roguelike and RPG elements, like talent trees, classes, familiars and more!

name: Dots in line
short_description: Dots in line - is a simple and clear puzzle game where colored dots should be joined in a row vertically or horizontally.

name: Danger Forever
short_description: Danger Forever is 3D Shoot'Em Up with RPG elements. Lone human rides her mecha-dragon through a hostile world of mechanoids and techno-demons.

name: Space Tail: Every Journey Leads Home
short_description: Space Tail is a 2.5D adventure platformer, which immerses the player in a deep, emotional plot, and lets him explore new planets and interact with alien civilizations.

name: Plot of the Druid
short_description: Make earthquakes. Turn night into day. Transform into a small furry creature. No one can party like a druid. An adventure game with sarcastic British humor and classic, hand-drawn art.

name: 轮回之理-MOBIUS THEORY
short_description: 《轮回之理》是一款爱情悬疑题材的互动影像游戏。主人公李未时是一个新闻记者，有一位相谈多年准备结婚的未婚妻赵倚蝶。一次偶然的机会，李未时得知三年前劈腿的初恋女友林见鹤落下残疾，而对方声明是因为被自己抛弃所以才出了车祸，落得如此下场。李未时心存疑虑展开调查，却被神秘组织绑入废弃物理实验室中，危急之时，李未时发现神秘组织和废弃的时间机器实验相关，情急之下启动时间机器，却不料自己因此卷入了一段爱恋与阴谋的轮回纠缠之旅。 ■官方q群：818146895 ■官方社区：B站 抖音 快手 微博 微信搜索：轮回之理官方

name: DORAEMON STORY OF SEASONS: Friends of the Great Kingdom
short_description: Noby and his friends are back in an all-new Doraemon: Story of Seasons title! Grow crops, raise animals, and use Doraemon's Secret Gadgets to help friends in a fun-filled and heartwarming story that people of all ages can enjoy.

name: Archmage Ricka
short_description: In order to retrieve the illegal property embezzled by the evil Lord, Ricka received a mission to capture the Lord. But it was a trap. She fell into a dungeon arranged by the Lord in advance. Although the demons in the dungeon are weak, the existence of various traps makes it difficult to escape!

name: Laika
short_description: Steam's hardest perma-death platform game.

name: Doors: Paradox
short_description: A relaxing puzzle escape game! Make your way through a variety of hand-crafted 3D dioramas, look for useful objects, find hidden clues and solve fun puzzles! Unravel this mysterious adventure about chaos, order and the surreal.

name: Repetendium
short_description: Fight against an army of elemental creatures hell bent on your destruction. Compete with other players on the leaderboards to show who is the master of Repetendium !

name: Body of Evidence
short_description: Become a dead body disposal specialist. As a “cleaner” you need to get rid of the body and make sure there is no evidence left behind. Remember, you’re on a clock. Think fast, use proper tools, and don’t mess up… leave one smear of blood and you’re in trouble.

name: Bratz™: Flaunt your fashion
short_description: The Bratz Pack has arrived– show the world your passion for fashion in a globe-trotting adventure to become the best style reporter!

name: Ghost Song
short_description: On the desolate moon of Lorian, a long-dormant Deadsuit awakens from slumber. Journey beneath the surface on an atmospheric 2D adventure of self-discovery, ancient mysteries, and cosmic terror. Explore winding caverns and acquire new abilities to unearth this alien world’s long-buried secrets.

name: What They Don't Sea
short_description: Traverse the depths of the ocean in this beautiful 2D pixel platformer, but be sure to watch your air levels! What They Don't Sea has a wonderful mix of beautiful and creepy environments, with drops of humor delivered by charming ocean creatures.

name: Dark Maidens
short_description: Dark Maidens is a side scrolling action game where you fight through hordes of enemies to test your metal against the strongest of foes. It has an advanced combat system in which you can light attack, heavy attack, block, fake out, and dodge. Don't expect an easy win as the enemies fight back!

name: Skycliffs
short_description: Skycliffs is an action shooter roguelike dungeon crawler with fast-paced top-down platforming. Jump and dash across sky islands, fight loads of monsters, and get upgrades to survive the many dangers of your journey. Will you be strong enough to reach and defeat the keeper of this floating world?

name: Pawsecuted
short_description: A brutal, slightly absurd tactical survival RPG. Play a rabbit escaping a koala-run convict camp in a procedurally generated, post-human apocalyptic world. Battle emus and hire kangaroo mercenaries. Scavenge supplies, gather and trade materials, recruit followers and rebuild society.

name: TheCube
short_description: 2D Arcade Game.

name: For a Vast Future
short_description: War has ended in Seralia, but the scars are far from healed. Explore a dystopian landscape and build weapons from scrap parts to use in battle. Recruit companions and travel in style in your trusty motorbike as you uncover the depths of a deep government conspiracy. The future is vast.

name: DarKnot
short_description: In DarKnot, you’ll get to explore the streets of a foggy city, and exterminate the monsters within. Insidious opponents, dynamic battles, and challenging puzzles are waiting for you! Your fate is in your hands, the way you approach those challenges is up to you…

name: S.E.C.U.
short_description: S.E.C.U. is a Zombie FPS Horde Mode Game. Survive up to wave 20, buy weapons, mystery crates, equipment, perks and unlock Loadout Cards.

name: The Chant
short_description: A single-player, third person horror action-adventure game set on a remote spiritual island retreat. To survive you must craft, fight, and escape the psychedelic horrors set loose when a spiritual ritual goes wrong and awakens a dimension of cosmic terror.

name: Once Upon a Jester
short_description: Travel the kingdom as Jester with his best friend Sok to improvise theatre shows and perform on stages far and wide. Sing your hearts out, crack jokes and impress audiences to become the stars of the famous Royal Theatrical Spectacle!

name: 九州风流
short_description: 独立游戏《九州风流》是一款武侠题材的多人对战卡牌游戏,拥有特色的博弈玩法和武功集卡系统。 你可以抢地盘撸妹子练绝世神功,闯江湖行侠义富甲一方。 末世武林九州割据,六大门派分足鼎立,前世身为武林盟主,不慎遭人陷害流落江湖,你在转世轮回后能否找回记忆重新练就绝世武功,再次一统九州?

name: Tactics Ogre: Reborn
short_description: Tactics Ogre, crown jewel of the tactical role-playing genre, is reborn! Based on the 2010 release, the game features improved graphics and sound, as well as updated game design, bringing to life a new Tactics Ogre that remains true to its roots.

name: Alkali
short_description: Explore the world as an Alkali metal in this innovative precision platformer! Explosively react with water and other elements to traverse obstacles, while picking up chunks of metal before you deplete your alkali metal body.

name: Funplace: After Hours
short_description: In this point and click horror game, you will outrun and defend yourself against monsters that follow you around a building of a dying company. Pay attention because each of these monsters are unique in their strategy to kill you.

name: Little Devil
short_description: Little Devil is a survival horror game for up to 5 players. You set out to look for your friend, but will you survive?

name: Gunvein
short_description: Gunvein is a dynamic, aggression-based bullet hell shoot em up where you use lock on lasers, charged weapons, bombs & hypers to overwhelm the enemies before they overwhelm you.

name: Chess Survivors
short_description: Chess Survivors is a grid based, quick-turn, roguelike where you outmaneuver and destroy an ever growing horde of chess based enemies. Combine abilities, upgrades, and relics to create game-breaking builds. Think fast, die, learn, repeat!

name: Dice Roller VR
short_description: Have you ever tried playing Yahtzee in a bath alongside the beach? Cold whisky and a couple of rounds of Yahtzee are always a good choice for relaxation with your friends. The sound of dice flowing in the hot air and the laughter of friends will make you forget any worries in life.

name: Goat's Tale 2
short_description: The Goat is back in his next adventure! The challenge will be difficult, but only with your help he will be able to get to the top.

name: Imprisoned Hyperion
short_description: Imprisoned hyperion is an imersive sim, first-person rpg. Explore the dark and dangerous dungeons of a world that has survived its end. Survive by finding safe resting places and cooking food. Help different creatures and learn the dark history of this world and your own.

name: Skystrike: Wings of Justice
short_description: Use your falcon powers to soar, smash and stealth your way to victory against the RatKing’s army in this hometown hero adventure!

name: Cursor Engine
short_description: Tired of the traditional boring cursor? Use Cursor Engine to customize your cursor with any PNG images or stunning interactive animated VFX and share them on the Steam Workshop!

name: Roboplant
short_description: In a future not too far away, humans are finally able to harvest food on alien planets. Embark on a new journey with your team of robots called Beebop 179. Build and manage a hydroponic farm, grow delicious plants and survive the mysterious challenges of outer space.

name: Cobra Kai 2: Dojos Rising
short_description: Eagle Fang, Cobra Kia, Miyagi-do – Which is your dojo? That choice begins your journey, but then it’s up to you to recruit the most powerful team as you master your fighting style and battle to solidify your dojo’s LEGACY as the All Valley Karate Grand Champion!

name: City Bus Manager
short_description: Build your own bus depot from scratch and create your personal bus routes in City Bus Manager. Play your own hometown or any famous city in the world with real map data. Buy buses, maintain them, take care of your staff and lead your bus company to become the #1 in town!

name: Pro Basketball Manager 2023
short_description: Pro Basketball Manager 2023 features more than 160 basketball competitions with the most depth and authenticity ever found in a basketball management game.

name: This Way Madness Lies
short_description: Shakespeare and Magical Girls, what could be better? Save the worlds of Shakespeare from the forces of Nightmare in this fast-paced turn-based JRPG comedy.

name: Land of the Vikings
short_description: From victuals to Vikings, lead your village and expand it into a thriving city. A wise Jarl must manage resources, survive harsh conditions and enemy raids, and guide their fellow Vikings to work together through social conflict. Skál!

name: A Castle Full of Cats
short_description: A Castle Full of Cats is a catvania hidden object game where you need to find all the cursed cats in the castle. Save each and every cat and unleash the power of love! ♡

name: The Heart Defenders
short_description: Building defender 2D strategy game! Place building and gather resources. Use the resources you collect to then build towers that will defend your heart in the middle of the map. Survive as many levels as you can manage! Good luck!

name: Insomnia
short_description: Experience one night as a man diagnosed with a strange and incurable form of insomnia. Your only goal is to sleep until dawn, but after the lines between your nightmares and your waking life are blurred… you might not want to sleep afterall.

name: Shadow of the Guild
short_description: Sidescrolling beat 'em up with an epic story. You are Yarán, an assassin with powerful skills of a mage and a warrior combined. Attack from the shadows, cast powerful spells, and destroy your enemies with powerful combo attacks.

name: Alice with Gatling
short_description: This is an exhilarating FPS where you shoot your Gatling Gun and mow down your enemies! Face a horde of monsters as a cute girl 'Alice'.

name: the hardest game in the universe 2
short_description: The sequel to the most impossible game. The new 2D adventure, embark on this platform game that will test your skill of how much patience you are capable of,New mechanic, 10,000 kills, if you lose your game will be erased, What is the way to make a sequel to an extremely difficult game???

name: Among Us VR
short_description: Teamwork and betrayal in space! In this VR party game, Crewmates work together to complete tasks before one or more Impostors kill everyone aboard. Experience all of the same deception and deceit as the original game, but now in your own virtual spaceship.

name: Find The Key
short_description: A strange game with skeletons and giant aliens.

name: Fabular: Once Upon a Spacetime
short_description: Cross blades with space knights in an epic roguelike where the futuristic and the medieval collide! Battle, loot and upgrade your way across the galaxy, defeating rival ships in gripping melee combat on a quest to save your kingdom from destruction.

name: Single Player: Horror
short_description: Single Player: Horror is a unique POV interactive experience. You don’t just play the role of Sophie, you see through her eyes. You wake up to find a Psycho Axe Killer in your living room who is desperate to chop you into pieces. Will you survive the night?

name: 奇克八号盲目发射 Blind No.8 Chick Shoot
short_description: This is a pinball game to recall your childhood. Here, you may find the feeling of squatting in the corner when you were young and playing pinball. Of course, perhaps you will also be as young as when you were a child, so abused by your partners that you can't find the north.

name: Nadir: A Grimdark Deckbuilder
short_description: Nadir is a roguelike deck-builder with a twist: the cost to play a card is an enemy reaction you can predict. Craft your own cards to slay powerful demons. Gather resources, expand your city, grow in power and conquer the underworld.

name: Astro Colony
short_description: Explore endless Universe and create the most efficient constellation of colonies. Build conveyor systems to automate production. Take care of Astronauts and their needs! Establish new colonies as part of intergalactic simulation.

name: Titan Station
short_description: Far into the future, in the year 1999: David, a systems operator, runs from his troubles by taking a job on a space station. After arriving, his mundane work turns into a struggle for his very life as he makes a shocking discovery.

name: Championship Wrestling Promoter
short_description: Book shows, build feuds, manage your finances, and win the TV ratings war in Championship Wrestling Promoter, a professional wrestling management strategy game.

name: Seaberry Keep
short_description: Play hide-and-seek with ghosts, decorate your room, grow plants, eat cookies, talk to a parrot, and explore!

name: Sakura Sunshine
short_description: Rei and her pet cat, Koneko, are brainstorming the perfect manga! Battle Rei's adorable inner-thoughts as she overcomes her writer's block, shoot'em-up style!

name: The Letter: Classic Edition
short_description: The Letter: Classic Edition is the ORIGINAL experience from the classic title 'The Letter', with a few changes and additions. Relive the Wii U game that gathered so much hate it became a cult classic. Embark on a creepy narrative driven tale about a boy in search of his missing father.

name: Mess Quest
short_description: In Mess Quest, arrive at the aftermath of numerous wacky scenarios to clean, mop, and put things back together! Grab a bucket and a mop and get swinging. What’s that green stuff? Where did that bone come from? We don't get paid to ask questions, we get paid to clean!

name: Fairy Girl
short_description: Every forest needs care. Caring for such an ancient forest is especially important. A fairy takes care of this forest, living in it in peace and harmony.

name: Escape From Zombies
short_description: Escape From Zombies is played alone or in cooperation, on a map where the player(s) must repel waves of zombies. It should be noted that the game does not end until all players are dead, the main goal is to beat the record of survived round.

name: Nature Escapes
short_description: Get ready to get lost in the wild beauty of Nature with this hidden object game! Let Nature Escapes take you on a trip to handcrafted snapshots of untamed wonder, and decorate your very own garden until it becomes a bouquet of beautiful plants and flowers!

name: Barren Depths
short_description: Escape a confusing cave system without being eaten in this short, underwater horror game.

name: VALKYRIE ELYSIUM
short_description: Long ago, Ragnarok—the End Times—loomed upon the realms. The All-Father Odin, with the last of his strength, created an emissary of redemption, Valkyrie; her sole task being the salvation of a doomed world.

name: Franchise Hockey Manager 9
short_description: Franchise Hockey Manager returns for the 2022-23 season with plenty of additions to the deepest, most authentic hockey strategy gaming experience you can find. Choose from teams around the globe and select a team to guide to glory, including a chance at the ultimate prize, the Stanley Cup®.

name: Garfield Lasagna Party
short_description: 32 mini-games to discover across emblematic environments such as Garfield's house, the pizzeria, Liz’s veterinary clinic... Our friends Garfield, Odie, Arlene et Nermal have taken on an enormous challenge: to participate in a gigantic lasagna party!

name: HAITENAI RPG
short_description: The amnesiac protagonist awakens in the world of Dehaina, a land where all nature is supported by the power of mysterious 'Orbs'. Not all is well, however, as a demonic invasion threatens the balance and the Orbs' power is fading away.

name: Guardian of the jungle
short_description: 《Guardian of the jungle》is a horizontal clear version of tower Beat'em Game. You need to obtain resources and allocate them reasonably, cultivate the team to grow, allocate ammunition reasonably, and solve monsters with absolute firepower. It is a pleasant game

name: Common'hood
short_description: Common’hood is a community building and economy management game with highly customizable base building tools. Scavenge for materials, grow your own food, research new technology, craft new tools, build a home, make friends. Form your community and take it from surviving to thriving!

name: Cold Way
short_description: Travel through the cold and snowy world to find and destroy the evil yeti.

name: Drive West Coast
short_description: Drive from the dense forests to the city streets to the coastline. Unlock and collect 19 unique vehicles by finding hidden keys and beating high scores.

name: Astral Shipwright
short_description: Build and upgrade your personal ship to travel around a strange planet.

name: 孙美琪疑案:雨儿胡同
short_description: 1992年7月16日，后海湖边槐树下，发现一名女尸，衣着整齐坐在槐树下，颈部缠绕着一根吉他弦，为主要致死原因，双手有被吉他弦勒伤的痕迹，初步判定为自杀。死亡时间约凌晨2点左右，死者叫关雨珑。林警官，请你在错综复杂的线索中，寻找凶案的真相。

name: Sonic Frontiers
short_description: Experience Sonic like never before!

name: Robo Legend
short_description: As Robo, you will decide the destiny of Gear Town and its robot people. Make decisive choices, explore biomes, solve puzzles and mini-games, battle hordes of robotic enemies in this cute pixel-art Twin Stick Shooter RPG, and write the Robo legend.

name: NiGHT SIGNAL
short_description: NiGHT SIGNAL is a short first-person horror experience that sees you breaking in a new television set, only to find that it picks up strange signals after dark. Hand crafted from flesh and clay.

name: PUTRID SHOT ULTRA
short_description: A chaotic shoot-em-up roguelite with magic spell casting. Defeat enemies with your gun!
