short_description: Bubbbles is a casual VR puzzle game where you'll need to get to the core of a pile of bubb(b)les! Match the correct color / texture bubbles to remove all similar touching bubbles while more fly in from the sky to throw you off.

name: Hubris
short_description: A recruit of the Triple-O is sent to the Twin planet system to search for agent Cyanha. To survive, you’ll have to shoot, swim, climb and jump your way through the harsh environment of a planet being terraformed. Together with pilot Lucia, you have to fight the wicked enemies of the OOO.

name: Princess Dating Sim
short_description: Princess Dating Sim is an non-linear visual novel where you court multiple princesses at the same time. You'll need to woo them, and see what their tastes are before you can pick a partner to marry!

name: JellyCar Worlds
short_description: It's a Car, made of Jelly! Squishy Physics, Tactile, Silly & Imaginative Driving/Platforming

name: World Racing 2 - Champion Edition
short_description: World Racing 2 is back - revamped with a new look! The highly acclaimed racing spectacle makes the streets on your screen glow like never before! The new Champion Edition offers modding and Steam Workshop support. Are you ready to start the race of your life? The roads are waiting for you!

name: Maskonauts: Chat'Attack
short_description: Shoot and loot the content of your favorite Twitch channels! Get in your Maskopod and play in real time with Twitch chats activities! Survive waves of texts, Emoticodes and enemies to defeat the Blockbossters and save the Maskotios!

name: Rift Rangers
short_description: Rift Rangers is a sentai themed casual rogue-lite where you defend against an endless horde of dimensional creatures. Construct and upgrade your defensive turrets while dodging enemies! Find the right combination of turrets and upgrades to become an impenetrable fortress!

name: Yi Xian: The Cultivation Card Game
short_description: Yi Xian: The Cultivation Card Game is an online DBG with a background of cultivation. Every game is a deck building from scratch. Players can have stronger decks by changing cards, and then build more powerful routines to defeat all opponents to win.

name: Path of Ra
short_description: Reincarnated into a hieroglyph, the spirit of a Pharaoh needs you to accompany him on his last journey. Help him overcome the many obstacles that beset the path of Ra by rearranging the tiles of the wall frescoes. Find out the truth about the king of Egypt's mysterious death.

name: Lazerball
short_description: Take aim & smash an electric dodgeball into your opponents! Jump, dodge, curve & trick-shot your way to victory! Play up to 8 players, in teams or solo and become the Lazerball champion!

name: The Maze: Humanity
short_description: An immersive multiplayer VR RPG filled with adventure and heart pounding action. A dynamic experience in an apocalyptic realm. Will you enter The Maze to defend humanity?

name: Zombie Defence TD
short_description: Zombie Defence TD is a tower defence shooter where humans fight off waves of invading zombies on a planet ravaged by an apocalyptic holocaust. You'll control different heroes with different skills to defeat the waves of invading zombies.

name: Grey Heritage: Faded Vision
short_description: Command a rebellion as Leon Beaumont, Exiled Prince of Astrea, against the king that betrayed him. Engage in a classic turn-based tactical RPG experience as you unravel untold secrets from the past. Recruit allies, manage inventory, and train your soldiers in this JRPG inspired journey!

name: Yokai's Wish
short_description: Destroy all the plans to seize the world by these beautiful demons, because if you do not cope with them, they will terrorize our planet for thousands of years, gather all your will into a fist and give them a decisive resistance!

name: N₂O
short_description: Pilot your customized craft across 30 psychedelic tubular levels of adrenaline-pumping action, fighting a constant stream of terrifying insectoid aliens trying to stop you in your tracks, all set to a soundtrack by The Crystal Method. Features a 2-player local coop mode.

name: Black Cycle
short_description: Consumers have power. A short walking simulator game that makes you think a little about how we normally consume.

name: Extinction / Zombie İnvasion 1
short_description: We are trying to kill the doctor who started the zombie epidemic. And various zombies and scary events await us on this journey.

name: Magic Staves
short_description: Magic Staves - 2D strategy in the Tower Defense genre, the main task of which is to resist the onslaught of countless monsters of the powers of darkness. Place various defensive towers along the perimeter of the attack line and spend money on construction wisely, because your success depends on it!

name: Tiles and Towers TD
short_description: A 3D tower defense where not only the towers matters but also the ground that alters the towers. Spiced up with randomized wave modifications, skilltree, unique towers and spells. Voila! You get Tiles and Towers TD!

name: Christmas Blaster
short_description: Christmas Blaster: Christmas Blaster is an Arcade-type action video game. Santa needs to save Christmas and face creatures with a lot of explosion in this action-packed game.

name: Unsolved Case: Fatal Clue Collector's Edition
short_description: Solve a series of tough cases, full of personal drama! In the new game series, you have to unravel some of the hardest mysteries using both logic and your intuition!

name: Listeria Wars
short_description: Listeria Wars is a real-time tactical game. You defend against the pathogenic microbes, attacking an infected organism. A key feature of the game is the parallel viewing experience. In addition to the game process, you can view the life of the human whose body has become the pathogenic battlefield.

name: Space Shells
short_description: Space Shells is a rogue-lite sci-fi VR game following an intergalactic mercenary tasked with hijacking a fleet of stunningly designed spaceships. Eliminate enemy droids, making clever use of specialized robotic shells to complete each treacherous mission.

name: Gastova: The Witches of Arkana
short_description: Gastova is a lighthearted 2D platforming adventure game. Journey into Arkana and become the Guardian Witch!

name: To Be or Not to Be
short_description: This is a text adventure game that combines the gameplay of desktop pets and mini-games. You can advance the plot by clicking on the dialogue, or play mini-games to accumulate values to trigger new plots, and you can also cultivate your favorite characters by hanging up.

name: My Desktop Girlfriend
short_description: Scroll through the social media feed, search for YouTube videos, listen to ASMR, watch anime. Whatever you do, your Desktop girlfriend will always be with you.

name: IXION
short_description: Authorised by DOLOS AEC, you will guide the Tiqqun space station onwards in a perilous journey to find a new home for humanity. Station infrastructure, population management, exploration, survival, these responsibilities fall to you. Will you find hope out there in the dark? Good luck Administrator.

name: PIEN & PAON plus
short_description: Run away from the mysterious monsters 'PIEN' and 'PAON'! A pop and cute 3D horror game!

name: Super Geisha Neon
short_description: Kind-hearted girl was trapped by the evil shogun. He wants to forcefully marry her, but that’s not gonna happen — our brave geisha will surely find the way to escape her prison cell and past all the deadly traps and labyrinths of the mighty evil-doer.

name: Impaler
short_description: Impaler is a minimalist arena shooter with spikes. Summon spikes to slay monsters, build barriers, and reach higher ground. Impaler's rogue-like elements ensure each run is a unique challenge.

name: The Fantastic Kitty Rue
short_description: On the retro-futuristic planet of Felmuria lives a little girl named Felicity Rue. Despite living in destitution, she dreams of becoming the most famous tap dancer in the galaxy! The Fantastic Kitty Rue is a blend of visual novel, point-and-click, and rhythm game!

name: The Chicken Game
short_description: Have you ever wanted a hyper-realistic industrial chicken farming simulator? Us neither. Design your own farm from the ground up and watch it whimsically expand as you work to reconstruct long forgotten legendary chicken genomes. With so many paths to take, what will YOU choose to create first?

name: Portal Dungeon
short_description: In “Portal Dungeon”, in this multiplayer Roguelite adventure game with random elements, as an adventurer, you and your friends will bravely find the last portal in this portal world, defeat powerful enemies and save the world.

name: 2 Many Pixels
short_description: 2 Many Pixels is an endless & fast-paced 2D minimal shooter. Blast enemies & unlock upgrades to help you survive for as long as possible!

name: Find the Gnome 2
short_description: Help find these adorable gnome creatures. Is it behind the tree? Is it in the bushes? Look, what shuffles over there? *click*. Features hand modeled stylized low poly lush 3D environments with as much interaction as possible, supported by atmospheric music. And comics! Its all about the feel.

name: Bad-Draw
short_description: This game is in the type of 2D platformer. It's about the revenge of a character made of drawings.

name: One Life
short_description: One hit death bullet hell action featuring upgrades, unlockable abilities, minigames, hats and you.

name: MannyTD
short_description: Manny TD is a hybrid tower defense and third-person shooter with random in game elements. Join and get your personal high score!

name: Scary pictures: Yavez - seven deadly sins
short_description: Scary pictures: Yavez - seven deadly sins in the novel-horror genre. The game will plunge you into the atmosphere of the classic and gloomy history of the Soviet times. You have to face many life choices that will have consequences and lead to one of eight endings.

name: High On Life
short_description: From the mind of Justin Roiland comes High On Life. Humanity is being threatened by an alien cartel who wants to use them as drugs. It’s up to you to rescue and partner with charismatic, talking guns, take down Garmantuous and his gang, and save the world!

name: Aokana - Four Rhythms Across the Blue - EXTRA2
short_description: Aokana - EXTRA2 is the official Misaki after story for Aokana.

name: Lodventure
short_description: Embark on a 1-4 players survival adventure in search of a myth called the Lod Stone in a mysterious wilderness. Discover resources, build your base, sow your crops. Fight the keepers in the regions in order to solve the mystery of the Lod stone.

name: Choice of the Viking
short_description: Sail forth to a land of gods and giants! Wield your sword, words, and magic to take your place among Iceland’s chieftains and forge your legacy of honor.

name: Chop Goblins
short_description: Pursue the malevolent Chop Goblins through time, and foil them with devastating weapons, in this bite-sized FPS from the creator of DUSK, Iron Lung, and Squirrel Stapler

name: FastRogue
short_description: Easy to play, easy to retry. FastRogue is a traditional rogue-'like' but customized being able to play for a short time.

name: What A Ball
short_description: WAB What A Ball - A different kind of ball racing games. Follow Blue's adventure running against MORE THAN 600 Balls racing together. Be the Ball: Crash, jump, bounce and run up to 300 Km per hour. It's very challenging and hardcore game, if don't believe us, just try it.

name: Actua Golf
short_description: In this classic golf simulation game from 1996, test your golfing skills on two challenging 18-hole courses, across a variety of game modes such as foursome, four ball challenge, and skins. Customize your golfer and lead them up through amateur and pro ranks.

name: Bots Are Stupid
short_description: An ultra-precise 2D platformer where you give robots instructions instead of directly controlling them. Master the campaign levels or create and share your own. “It’s Mario Maker with coding” - Lewis Brindley, Yogscast.

name: Aquarium Travels
short_description: Recover aquariums from the evils of darkness!

name: Last Shape Standing
short_description: Last Shape Standing is at its core a survival game where each player needs to survive through a multitude of chaotic and fun randomly selected challenges, be it bullet hell, PVP, a zombie apocalypse or even dangerous quizzes!

name: Quarry Simulator 2021
short_description: Quarry Simulator - innovation simulator and economical strategy about creation of the quarries. You beginner magnat and you need earn some money for his bussiness.

name: Faraway: Jungle Escape
short_description: Faraway: Jungle Escape is a relaxing adventure escape game full of new puzzles to solve. The second sequel of the Faraway trilogy.

name: Wrapped With a Kiss
short_description: Date the small holiday town's cute local carpenter and help Noel rekindle her relationship with her family in this emotional Christmas themed otome visual novel!

name: River City Girls 2
short_description: The River City Girls are back! Misako, Kyoko, Kunio, and Riki - joined by newcomers Marian and Provie - hit the streets for an all-new beat-'em-up adventure! Team up for local or online co-op and explore a massive world packed with new abilities, enemies, locations, and more!

name: Martin and the Magic Staff
short_description: Discover the world of a fabulous puzzle platformer in the pixel art style. You have to help the aspiring magician to pass all the challenges and fill his sorcerous staff with pure magic.

name: Isolated Room
short_description: What to do when your days are not going well? What to do when you need to wake up and manage a troubled life, in which you need to work, eat well and still have time for yourself? Isolated Room is about that, and maybe a little more.

name: SokoFrog
short_description: SokoFrog is a puzzle game about pushing boxes, help your frog friend get to the next level.

name: Space Mercenary Defense Force
short_description: Defend against an alien invasion and take down the mother ship! Equip your ship with a selection of branching upgrades to create unique builds each game and unlock new ships and permanent upgrades to help win the fight.

name: Nordic Ashes: Survivors of Ragnarok
short_description: Nordic Ashes is a Norse inspired action-roguelite enemy hell, where you’ll have to survive hordes of creatures. Unlock new weapons and abilities as you battle through different realms. Design the most broken build and slay your enemies before they surround you!

name: Virtual AI - Aki & Mika
short_description: A touching, feeling, and melting experience. Looking for a sweet VR game?

name: Military Conflict: Vietnam
short_description: Military Conflict: Vietnam brings an intense, fast-paced and fun first-person shooter experience. Set in the heat of the Vietnam War, side with Viet Cong guerrillas or U.S. Army soldiers in fierce close quarters combat. There is no hesitation. Kill or be killed!

name: Garden Galaxy
short_description: Discover, collect and organise to create your own unique garden in this relaxing idle / creative sandbox!

name: Sky Squadron
short_description: Jump in the bloomin' gunner seat as Keith Koala to save your mates & their island paradise from the evil invading empire! Sky Squadron offers a unique Aussie twist on shooter classics like Star Fox and Panzer Dragoon, while adding thrilling & immersive VR gunner gameplay.

name: Fate Seeker: Journey
short_description: Fate Seeker: Journey is an action role-playing game that combines random elements of Roguelite. In this game, you will be the hero to choose talents, obtain items and combine skills to defeat enemies in every stage.

name: Baker Business 3
short_description: Manage your very own bakery. Discover recipes, bake tasty treats and sell them to your customers. Unlock upgrades such as ovens and display shelves to expand your bakery. Customize the interior and exterior style to create your dream bakery.

name: Fastraq
short_description: Fastraq is a high-speed anti-gravity racing game. Drive on roller coaster like tracks, overtake your opponents and engage in combat. Experience tight turns, 360 degree loops and intense combat.

name: LONGEYED PROJ
short_description: Prepare to be assigned to help investigate and identify anomalous creatures called the LONGEYED.

name: Immortals Fenyx Rising
short_description: Immortals Fenyx Rising brings grand mythological adventure to life. Play as Fenyx on a quest to save the Greek gods.

name: House of Ghosts
short_description: House of ghosts is a single-player horror survival game. Stop the demon and find out the name of his victim before he drags you to hell. Run and hide. Just don't get caught.

name: World of Naples
short_description: Play single player or local co-op. Story more or Brawler is up to you. Remote play with friends. Simple mechanics. 20 levels, 4 bosses, 6 PVP arenas.

name: Sleep Paralysis: The Uncanny Valley
short_description: A story-rich first-person psychological horror game. You are in a lonely house, suffering from sleep paralysis. Deal with Thomas’ past trauma and make meaningful decisions that prevent you from going insane.

name: Not A Thief Simulator
short_description: You are a thief who steals in every house without power. Take everything and throw it in your truck without being noticed by the police and become the thief you always wanted to be.

name: Cassiodora
short_description: Cassiodora is a medieval fantasy game inspired by classic shoot 'em up with unique mechanics and epic boss fights. Save the princess Cassiodora by yourself or with up to 2 friends on the same screen.

name: My Gaming Club
short_description: In the game My Gaming Club you can feel exactly what it's like to own a gaming club, because realism is one of the main features of the game. Assemble PC, buy furniture, food for your club and for your visitors. This game is not just a gaming club simulator, this game is a real life simulator

name: Insomnia: Theater in the Head
short_description: Hickory dickory dock. The city's deep in sleep. The clock's ticking. The sheep's bouncing. Hickory dickory dock. The girl tosses again, only with more things swarming into her head... In this Point & Click puzzle game 'Insomnia', the show in the head is rolling on again. Alas, any sleep tonight...

name: My Life: Pet Vet
short_description: Cute little pets need your help!

name: Splatter
short_description: Splatter is a first-person fever dream where you blast constantly-adapting enemies into neon sprays of pulp and slime. Enter a digital mindscape constructed by four anonymous administrators. Can you survive? Can you remain sane? Can you remain yourself?

name: Lil Gator Game
short_description: Embark on an adorable adventure, discover new friends and uncover everything the island has to offer. Climb, Swim, Glide and slide your way into the hearts of the many different characters you meet on your travels!

name: EvoMon
short_description: Evomon Is a creature collector in tamagotchi version. Take care of your evomon since its infancy and discover its new evolutions, have fun playing the mini-games, adventure in mysterious expeditions, battle intensely against different monsters to reach the title of Evomon Champion.

name: Wavetale
short_description: Surf the waters of a submerged city! Unravel the past, save the islanders from mysterious sea monsters and discover secrets hidden under the surface.

name: Hidden Cats in London
short_description: Meow meow! Kittens are hidden in London, let's find them all. A short and pleasant experience! Start with a Beautiful monochromatic illustration, relax and find all the cats one by one to reveal the final colored art. Play through different modes, find special cats, and unlock bonus levels!

name: CRISIS CORE –FINAL FANTASY VII– REUNION
short_description: CRISIS CORE -FINAL FANTASY VII- REUNION is a remaster of CRISIS CORE featuring updated graphics, combat systems and soundtrack. Follow the tale of SOLDIER operative Zack Fair, as he discovers the secrets of Shinra's dark experiments.

name: Nightmare knock
short_description: How would you like to know that an uninvited guest, about whom you know absolutely nothing, will come to you at night? One thing is clear, he is unlikely to come in peace. What will you do? Prepare for his visit? Will you take a knife or hide in the closet? It's up to you.

name: Eggcelerate! to the North Pole
short_description: Deliver Easter eggs on the North Pole and drift around snow banks without dropping an egg. The time-trial challenges are snow joke in this eggspansion.

name: Beauty from Wisdom
short_description: After some brainstorming, although you are a little tired, enjoying the beautiful scenery may relax you.

name: The Elevator Game with Catgirls
short_description: Kirin plays the elevator game and disappears. Will her girlfriend, Asahi, be able to find her? The Elevator Game with Catgirls is a horror visual novel with point-and-click elements, inspired by the Korean urban legend, Elevator to Another World.

name: INCOMER
short_description: First-person action game against hordes of alien intruders.

name: HeatStroke
short_description: HeatStroke is a simulation game tasking you to transcribe an unhinged short story while driving down a seemingly endless desert road.

name: 私のリアルは充実しすぎている フルボイス版
short_description: 顔良し、頭良し、性格良し。 完全無欠のリア充女子が送るドタバタラブコメディ！（たぶん）

name: Xmas Apocalypse
short_description: It's Christmas Eve during the Zombie Apocalypse and Santa has to gun down hordes of the undead or Christmas is ruined! Level up your firearms with upgrades from the Christmas skill tree and find the most destructive combinations. A festive horde-survival third-person shooter with roguelite elements.

name: Scholar of the Arcane Arts
short_description: Scholar of the Arcane Arts is a Roguelike Action RPG where every spell you cast interacts with one another. Learn new spells, solve puzzles, unlock secret dungeons, and defeat monstrous beings to save the world invaded by five Planes of magic!

name: INCUR Survival
short_description: A SURVIVAL open-world game. Gather resources, Hunt, Craft tools and armor, Tame Animals, Ride Animals, Build, and defend your base from creatures, and other players.

name: Fabric Of Reality
short_description: In this game, you are the bullet hell. Face off against 100 waves of enemies and bosses by collecting a deck of attack cards that activate in real-time to unleash destruction upon everything in sight. There's an insane amount of customizability leading to an infinitely replayable experience.

name: G-MODEアーカイブス+ 女神転生外伝 新約ラストバイブルII 始まりの福音
short_description: Boy, be the light that illuminates the world. The gospel of the beginning rings out in the land covered with despair.

name: Pixel Happy Game Girls
short_description: In this cute kinetic visual novel: Your childhood friend Masako invites you to work at her indie game studio, and help accomplish her dreams. You soon learn that making a game is harder than it sounds.

name: Crazy City Driving
short_description: Crazy City Driving is a car driving game around the city. Get behind the wheel of one of the cars and get to the finish line, but remember your time is limited!

name: Planet Surfer
short_description: Dodge Obstacles. Acquire upgrades. Save the world. Planet Surfer is a non-stop anti-gravity survival racer and the ultimate forward scrolling don’t run into stuff game developed as a love letter to the temple run quintet and the early 3d sonic games.

name: Aery - Path of Corruption
short_description: You play as a bird-like spirit and fly through the different scenarios of the decision-making process of the protagonist. Each level represents a different path that the protagonist could take. Discover the different paths, find their possible outcomes, and find a good future for your new friend.

name: mummification
short_description: mummification - Fight ravenous mummies and cooperate with your AI teammates to survive !

name: Automaton Lung
short_description: Make use of your special abilities to skate, shoot, and fly through over 40 unique locations. In a strange land with almost no information you must be resourceful and clever. Question everything you see and trust nothing you hear.

name: PYRMD
short_description: PYRMD, a multiplayer horror game that takes place in an Egyptian pyramid, is played with five players: one mummy and four survivors. Survivors must find the lost tablets and reach the door before getting caught. Alternatively, the Mummy must catch all of the intruders. Only the brave will survive…

name: Sakura Hime 3
short_description: You have just graduated school and have landed your first job as a butler for the luxury apartments 'Sakura Gardens.' Your main goal is to become an excellent butler who gives the girls all the pleasure and happiness they need!

name: G-MODEアーカイブス+ 女神転生外伝 新約ラストバイブル
short_description: Together with the demon, we will open up our destiny. The story that is the end of everything and the beginning of everything.

name: Metro Simulator 2
short_description: Metro Simulator 2 is a unique game featuring recreated Moscow Metro and realistic train controls.

name: Death Below
short_description: Death Below - is a third-person action adventure with elements of survival horror. The plot of the game is based on the legend of the Soviet experiment of the 1940s.You will plunge into a dark world, and begin an exciting investigation, fighting on your way with thousands of distraught people

name: Outworld Patrol
short_description: Control a space rover as you jump to avoid obstacles on a horizontally scrolling landscape while shooting down alien ships that shoot missiles from above or charge you head on. A love letter to the first game I ever played on PC.

name: Zombies Attack
short_description: Zombies Attack - the mechanics are based on tower defense, 2D graphics with a top view, a memorable and atmospheric soundtrack, colorful and beautiful graphics and unforgettable experiences.

name: Glory to the Robots!
short_description: A game in the genre of management strategy. Here you can build your own factory for the production of robots, and on another planet, and extract resources and test robots on other different planets.

name: Crystal Winter
short_description: Naoki was really excited about spending Christmas with his beloved. But those plans weren't meant to be - Naoki saw her hugging another guy. Christmas seems ruined but just one random encounter can change everything. This is a Japanese-style kinetic visual novel about Christmas.

name: Substance 3D Modeler 2023
short_description: Adobe Substance 3D Modeler is an innovative sculpting and modeling app that aims at redefining how we create in 3D by combining VR and desktop experiences with a more natural approach to 3D modeling.

name: SCP: Keter
short_description: Based on the SCP Foundation 'Keter' is a Dead by Daylight and Left4Dead-inspired Multiplayer Game.

name: The Block
short_description: The Block is the world's smallest city builder. Place randomly generated buildings on a square and watch your tiny city block come to life! It's a very small game with no goals, challenges or fancy features - hence the very small price :)

name: Out of the ground
short_description: Strange things happen on a mysterious island, whence out of nowhere, evil spirits begin to crawl out of the ground and you, the greedy pirate 'Redbeard', are sent to this island to figure out what's wrong.

name: Dungeon: Faster & Deadlier
short_description: A roguelite card game full of strategic possibilities and simple mechanics. Gain experience every step of the way and use chance to your advantage. Consider your possibilities, tacticize and search for the right path. Fulfill your destiny!

name: The Detroit After
short_description: You are a robot, you have to kill everyone...

name: G-MODEアーカイブス+ 女神転生外伝 新約ラストバイブルIII 夢幻の英雄
short_description: Gather round, demons. Awaken, heroes. A tale of strange evil passed down from generation to generation on the frontier planet of Damir.

name: Jewel Match Winter Wonderland 2 Collector's Edition
short_description: ’Tis the season for chestnuts, mistletoe, and Match-3. Travel snow-clad lands across more than 200 huge levels and rebuild a cozy village. Then start decorating the houses for the festive season. Grab a hot chocolate while you play bonus games with jigsaw puzzles, clutter, or spot the difference.

name: Meteorites 3D
short_description: Experience the retro arcade shooter inspired game Meteorite 3D built for modern 3D rendering, being a spiritual successor to the space games of old

name: Master of Magic
short_description: Take up the role of a great wizard, wield powerful spells, command fantasy races and challenge your rivals in this remake of a cult turn-based strategy classic. Do you have what it takes to become Master of Magic?

name: The Awakening Program
short_description: A man discovered he has a tumor that will lead to his death.

name: Maptroid: Worlds
short_description: A metroidvania experienced entirely in the map! Explore and fill the map of several planets in this minimalistic and abstract metroidvania game, collect powerups to get to new places, and discover lore items to read. Have extra fun in the puzzletroid maps, or relax in zentroid.

name: Frontier Hunter: Erza’s Wheel of Fortune
short_description: After the empire invented the airship, people finally became able to fly across float continents and islands. And thanks to that, the empire expands rapidly.The top hunter, Erza, leads an exploration team to explore the savage frontier where the empire can’t reach.

name: Sakura Mirror
short_description: Sakura adores her reflection in the mirror! She admires her beauty and tenderness in the mirror. She takes care of herself for hours in front of the mirror and she applies make-up.

name: Aka
short_description: Find inner peace in a small, open-world game. On these carefully handcrafted islands, you can take a nap on a giant monster, feed baby dragons, take care of the fauna and flora... ...but demons from your past might come back to remind you what you want to forget.

name: Ooglians
short_description: Ooglians are coming! Nothing excites an ooglian more than smashing machinery. Protect your machinery with more machinery which attracts even more ooglians. How unfortunate.

name: Cygnus Enterprises
short_description: Take charge of a derelict outpost on a faraway planet. Rebuild your base and manage your employees help it thrive. Battle fierce creatures and gather resources in a lush alien environment.

name: Akai Katana Shin
short_description: Be guided anew into an epic tale set in the Taisho era with three titles from Cave's Akai Katana series that has captured the hearts of passionate shoot 'em up fans. New features include an online leaderboard and new musical arrangements.

name: Oriental Dynasty - Silk Road defense war
short_description: Experience the perfect combination of tower defense and the historical plot of the Silk Road, so as to bring an amazing epic game adventure experience! You will follow our protagonists in a strategic battle on the Eurasian continent! Come on, buddy, this epic fantasy adventure needs your help!

name: Instinct War - Card Game
short_description: Enter in a bitesized roguelike dungeon crawller. Choose your hero and face relentless enemies through an everchaging card-based dungeon. Collect items to power up your hero to face the Instinct War.

name: Melatonin
short_description: Melatonin is a rhythm game about dreams and reality merging together. It uses animations and sound cues to keep you on beat without any intimidating overlays or interfaces. Harmonize through a variety of dreamy levels containing surprising challenges, hand-drawn art, and vibrant music.

name: Starcom: Unknown Space
short_description: Starcom: Unknown Space is an action RPG of space exploration and adventure. Build your own starship while discovering an epic story in a universe of strange mysteries, alien factions and uncharted worlds.

name: Project Survivor
short_description: A retro style game that can be played in 2D platformer mode and top-down mode. Hunt monsters, collect coins, and buy weapons to become stronger. Play with 3-classes and a variety of weapons. Enjoy cute retro style pixel art that you see on a nostalgic CRT monitor filter.

name: 五代十国之玉知
short_description: This is a literature game talk about Madness,base on the craziest history from China.

name: Boat Simulator
short_description: An adventure on the high seas like you've never seen before, with realistic graphics and sounds. Experience the sensation of sailing the entire ocean through the most mythical ships.

name: Down Fast VR
short_description: Ride mountain bike at crazy speed in VR. Down Fast VR puts you behind the bars of a fast mountain bike beast. Go through high speed technical mountain trails full of stunts. Use your controllers and headset to steer, lean, spin, flip and many more. Try to stay in control and be the fastest!

name: Animal Survivors

short_description: A chill cleaning game set at the end of the world.

name: UNRESTRAINED
short_description: UNRESTRAINED - is a great 3D horror game in which you have to survive in a mental hospital, playing as a reporter named Carl.

name: Battle Mage
short_description: Battle Mage is a rogue-like/souls-like/Metroidvania. It features fast responsive sword, bow and spell combat, in an endlessly repeating randomly generated environment. With a narrative that takes the player throughout the massive maze-like world.

name: Darwin's Aquarium
short_description: Breeding and training fish is your hobby. Discover new species - evolve favorable characteristics and train your AI fish brain to behave like real-life fish. Learn about AI and genetics by playing.

name: Drago Noka
short_description: The surface has become overrun with huge giants and dangerous pests, leaving an uninhabitable world in their quake. Humans have nowhere to live, and so… they live on the backs of dragons! Develop your very own village, gather various materials, and create new items with your very own hands.

name: Red Flower
short_description: Red Flower is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls. The game is perfect for relaxing.

name: DUNGEON WALK－竜迷宮の管理者－
short_description: 主人公だけがループを繰り返す世界で、自分を殺した者の正体を暴くため、迷宮の最奥を目指す。ローグライク×カードゲーム×ループシナリオで構築されたファンタジー世界で、自分だけのデッキを作り、死の真相に辿り着け。

name: Highway Speeder
short_description: Endless highway destruction

name: Tom Clancy’s The Division® 2
short_description: HISTORY WILL REMEMBER In Tom Clancy’s The Division® 2, the fate of the free world is on the line. Lead a team of elite agents into a post-pandemic Washington DC to restore order and prevent the collapse of the city.

name: Beneath Her Starry Sky
short_description: A fantasy/adventure visual novel - as Freya Fae, track down the master assassin Orick Genn before he brings ruin to your home city. Rely on faithful companions and make friends with the citizens as you encounter dangers lurking through the streets.

name: Radiant Cell
short_description: What do you do when you're locked inside a video game with a crazed AI and some guns? You RUN and KILL...That's what you do! In the world of radiant cell, get ready to defend yourself as you wall run, shoot, slow down time, and of course grapple. This game was created by a one developer

name: 初夏倾语 - Summer Whisper
short_description: 这是一段发生在高中校园内纯情青涩的百合恋爱故事。曾经无数次注视她的脸颊，想要将她拥入怀中，让她倾听自己当下的全部情感，却总在她对未来的期望中止步不前……学生时代的恋爱会无疾而终，还是还得偿所愿？

name: GROSS
short_description: GROSS is a unique twist on the classic tower defense genre. After building your formidable defenses, you will jump into the fray to take on enemies head-on. Make sure to collect as much cash as possible to upgrade your defenses and stay ahead of the game. Can you outlast the waves of enemies?

name: Xuan-Yuan Sword V
short_description: *** This Game is only available in Chinese *** 本游戏为回合制RPG。主角陆承轩身负强大力量却无法控制，阴差阳错来到神话中的山海界，在此结识了众多不同物种的奇妙伙伴，一路抽丝剥茧，解开山海界、黄帝、轩辕剑之间的过往密辛，展开高潮迭起的精彩旅程。

name: Lendas do Pebol: Mythic Football
short_description: A football game with characters you've never seen before! Get ready for a 1-on-1 Football match with mystical players! Choose your favorite Amazonian legend and fight to score a goal! Who will do better? The Boto? The Uirapuru? The Big Cobra? The Boitata? The power is in your hands!

name: AgentRoy - Secure The Temple
short_description: Agent Roy - Secure the temple is a thrilling 3rd person action shooter. Roy is fighting a battle he cannot hope to win. 5 minutes. Deadly mercenaries. Can he hold the fort until the backup arrives? Prepare for the worst.

name: The Sword That Kills Christmas
short_description: On this journey your choices dictate everything. You might end up poisoning one of Santa's reindeers or trying to find your mom (you're an orphan) or something entirely different. Where will your path lead?

name: Sapu
short_description: Help Sapu on this adventure in the middle of the forest to find a cure for his grandfather who was bitten by a poisonous carnivorous plant.

name: 回溯勇者 Backdate Hero
short_description: Backdate Hero is an action Rogue lite game that integrates many elements. The game builds a completely elevated world with multiple civilizations as the core. The main character played by the player will become an important key in the world to save the world destroyed by meteorites.

name: Brazen Thief
short_description: Top Down View is a game where you have to fight off all the enemies. Your hero is a thief and he will not be allowed to leave so easily. Throw carrots at them, but do not forget to pick it up again. Knock out medicines from them to last as long as possible. I know you will succeed!

name: Finnish Army Simulator
short_description: Military service, just like you remember it! Or if you don’t, you’ll feel like you do.

name: Wilderless
short_description: Wilderless is a walking/hiking/photography simulator set in a fantasy wilderness. Players can explore a beautiful, procedurally generated natural open world. Tons of options allow you to configure many aspects of the world, and you can choose your initial world seed to generate different worlds.

name: SANRI
short_description: SANRI is a first-person psychological horror game where you play a schizophrenic character whose wife disappeared during camp. Face the delusions, solve the mystery and try to find her despite your constantly distorted perception of time-space.

name: Midnight Alert
short_description: A promising new horror FPS franchise has arrived. Getting a gun to protect yourself from their creatures doesn't mean you won't have to worry about the horrors that surround you.

name: Yeah！Fighting Girl
short_description: This is a relaxing and casual game. Five cute girls owe a huge debt for breaking the naked statue of the demon king. In order not to be sold to goblins, they are forced to go to an arena and start fighting to earn money to pay off their debts.

name: The Militant Mouse
short_description: The militant mouse is a hardcore 2D platformer with elements of survival in which you have to fight enemies.

name: Hack and Shoot Heroes
short_description: A Twin Stick Shooter with melee attacks, Enemy Waves Survival game! Choose from different heroes, fight climactic enemy waves, level up, collect coins, fight against the endboss in three different levels and have fun.

name: Road Trucker
short_description: Get behind the wheel of your truck and go on a long journey along difficult forest roads.

name: Horror Tale 2: Samantha
short_description: A chilling continuation of the adventure of Tom and his friends

name: The Escape: Together
short_description: The Escape: Together is a 2 player online CO-OP psychological horror. The paranormal creature has taken over the house. You must use everything you find to survive and make your runaway.

name: Cars vs Train
short_description: The Cars vs Train is a simulation-adventure game, where horsepower is measured to another level. Your mission is not to allow the train to reach its destination before you in order to prevent danger.

name: Aurora's Journey and the Pitiful Lackey
short_description: Join Aurora and the Lackey in this side-scroller adventure with Run and gun and platformer mechanics, mini-games and lots of enemies. In 1927, Aurora, a young astronomer, receives the journal of her father who disappeared four years earlier and embarks on a journey to find him.

name: Ocean Punk
short_description: A pixel ocean survival game. Ocean current disasters have submerged the land and devastated the planet. As survivors, you need to build survival bases and pick up things to help you handle all situations, like the changing climate and the invasion of enemies.

name: Gatewalkers
short_description: Gatewalkers is a cooperative action RPG game with survival elements, where players travel across different worlds in order to save their own. Explore procedurally generated worlds, face hostile inhabitants, face challenges like extreme weather conditions, toxic atmosphere, lack of water and more.

name: The Last Hair
short_description: Move, jump, toss hair! It is a simple platformer game. Reach your destination avoiding obstacles with multiple humorous elements! If you hit an obstacle and the game is over, start over! Reach your destination and meet the princess! It's a simple and fun game!

name: Fears to Fathom - Carson House
short_description: Noah Baker, an 18 year old highschooler experiences unsettling occurrences while house-sitting for a media personality, little did he know what was about to unfold that night.

name: Johny Explorer
short_description: As Johny, you go deeper and deeper into the cave in search of treasures, watch out for the many traps and enemies waiting for your life

name: Mutant Monty
short_description: In this surreal game, released in 1984 for home computers by Artic Computing, dodge dangerous enemies and collect gold across 40 fiendishly difficult levels. Levels include such bizarre environments as the Pit of Eternal Slime, the inside of a neutron accelerator, and the desolate wastes of Pithor.

name: LiMiT's Escape Room Games 2
short_description: The next chapter of the Escape Room bundle with better controls and jumping! ;) This time you (alone or with friends) can expect 4 levels, which differ in difficulty. The rooms are designed for a gameplay of 1-1.5 hours each. Can you beat this time again?

name: Frame - Portals on Steroids
short_description: Frames are devices that can stitch two parts in space together. And they can do much more: They can move, change size and gravity of objects and appear in any size or number... All these mechanics are used to provide mind-bending levels in this logic-based physics-puzzler.

name: Bing in Wonderland
short_description: A Roguelite monster killing satisfaction galore without any exploration elements. The game is filled to the brim with exotic enemies and stages with a collection of deep and robust boons, weapons, and items plus an abundance of pointless features and useless details. (no controller supported)

name: Escape Jump
short_description: Escape Jump is a precision platformer where you and your funny companion jump and fall, rage-quit and fall, flip your table, destroy your computer, put it back together and then you fall.

name: 三國立志傳
short_description: 少年劉關張，立志看遠方！ 網羅文官武將，組成自己的常勝隊伍。 在實戰中或學堂裡修練各項武技及計謀。 調派將領，分兵合擊，佔領戰略要地。 練功昇級，裝備寶物，培養蜀漢真英雄。 百餘關卡，網狀劇情，重寫三國新世紀。

name: 候鸟
short_description: 你知道候鸟吗？候鸟有夏候鸟和冬候鸟之分。夏候鸟就是「春天来北方，秋天去南方」的鸟，他们一年四季都生活在很温暖的环境里，而冬候鸟……则是春天就飞向北方，飞到又远又冷的地方生活，冬季才返回的鸟。尽管它们可能会在同一个地方各自度过一生中一半的时光——却从来没有机会在一起。

name: Aquatico
short_description: Aquatico is a survival city builder set within the depths of the sea. Strategically build an underwater city atop the ocean floor and face the challenges that accompany an oceanic life.

name: Sass VS Fash: Girlballs of Steel
short_description: Sass VS Fash is a retro FPS throwback to the Wolfenstein series where the political and supernatural combine into a nazi-killing, action-filled romp in your mission to finally assassinate the Führer of Johannland, Johann W. Weiss.

name: Armoured Cavalry: Operation Varkiri
short_description: Double joystick / mecha / roguelike, each with its own unique mecha, matched with 100 skills, drive powerful war machines!

name: Vengeful Guardian: Moonrider
short_description: Vengeful Guardian: Moonrider is a side-scrolling action platformer that channels the golden age of classic 16-bit action games in a full-throttle quest for revenge. Created to defend a totalitarian state, the Moonrider rejects its programming and now seeks vengeance on its creators.

name: タイピングで愛を伝えよ
short_description: This game is for Japanese only. タイピングで愛を伝えよ is a typing game for Japanese. Players must type poop-related words as quickly and accurately as possible. Even if you are not good at typing, you can have fun practicing with this game.

name: Xuan-Yuan Sword: The Cloud of Han
short_description: *** This game is only available in Chinese ***单人回合制角色扮演游戏。三国时代初年，大汉丞相诸葛亮在数年的休息生养之后，毅然决定展开北伐复兴大业。然而此时此刻谁也没有想到，汉军中突然出现一支来历不详、身份神秘之奇兵部队，在不久的未来，却将左右整个大汉之命运……

name: Barista Simulator
short_description: Barista Simulator lets you experience making a wide variety of coffees just like espresso, latte, cappuccino or even your special mix of coffees. While managing your coffee shop, you play as a Barista and make the coffees your customers want. It's up to you to choose how to treat your shoppers.

name: UnderDungeon
short_description: Embody Kimuto on the first day of his new job in this humor-packed dungeon crawler with surprising secrets to discover!

name: Sidestep Legends
short_description: Practise your sidestep skills as you dodge spells coming at you from all directions. Level up and choose from a variety of upgrades and new abilities to increase your chances of survival in this moba inspired rogue-lite. Unlock new characters and explore different skill combinations each round.

name: Scrap Riders
short_description: Become Rast, a member of the outlaw bikers gang Scrap Riders, make your way through the wastelands and the big metropolis controlled by corporations. Act as a smuggler with caustic humor to survive in this post-apocalyptic world.

name: Confabulation
short_description: Your memory is fading. Things around your home keep changing; they are not what they appear to be. Find what is wrong, take pictures to restore your memory. Try to remember. Learn what you have forgotten, learn what has happened. It is not what it seems to be.

name: Showrunner
short_description: Create and run your own TV show! An isometric management game where you craft scripts, populate your world with characters and cast actors to play them. Hire and manage staff, develop your studio and gain a dedicated following.

name: Encoded War
short_description: Here is the 5-year contract to get your son back. You must become the morse messenger during World War II. Deliver our encoded messages and lead Deutschland to victory!

name: Starless Hotel
short_description: Find a way out in a weird 5-star hotel that loses a star every night

name: Another World - Thought Taboo
short_description: 'Another World - Thought Taboo' is a different world adventure game, you will explore this mysterious and dangerous world alone, and gradually discover the truth hidden in it.

name: Lil Baby Poop's NIGHTMARES
short_description: A cute, family-friendly, fast-paced and challenging action platform game in a vintage rubberhose cartoon style, accompanied by old-school jazz music. Find your way through every level, avoid traps and fight off creatures to eventually wake up from each of 13 nightmares.

name: Novastella Island
short_description: This is a slow-paced building game. Accidentally traveled to an island in another universe, you decided to collect resources and make tools to find a way home. But you'll also lead an amazing life, make some friends with the local Lilles, build a home, and reform the island while finding a way back.

name: Horror haze
short_description: Explore the world, learn magic spells, defeat enemies and solve tricky puzzles. All this awaits you in 'Horror haze'.

name: The Multi-Medium
short_description: The Multi-Medium is a visually unique 2D puzzle platform adventure in which you play as an interdimensional explorer lost in the multiverse. Travel to diverse worlds, each drawn or painted by hand in a different medium and style, in search of your place in the cosmos.

name: String Along
short_description: Fun and relaxing arcade game, you control two dots connected by a piece of string. Dodge and capture enemies for as long as you can. Each level is slightly more challenging than the last, how far can you make it?

name: A Bit of Tactics
short_description: In the farms of Abitof monsters are grown for their yield of rare items. But a successful harvest is not easy, for these crops fight back. As with all creatures their hearts yearn for tactics. Use this as your advantage, progress through the dungeon defeat their boss and reap the rewards.

name: Lunch Tycoon
short_description: Lunch Tycoon is a management strategy game where you run all parts of your restaurant. Keep customers happy and you'll earn stars, but miss too many orders and - you'll business will slow to a crawl.

name: Survivor:Stay In The Light
short_description: Stay in the light, hunt the dark. Create your own hero through the four dimensions of role, skill, talent, and blessing outside the battle. In the battle, choose the most suitable equipment and weapons strategically to improve your strength and continue to fight.

name: Sharded World
short_description: Sharded World is a survival game with minimalistic gameplay and roguelite elements. Your main task is to collect all the pieces of the main character's soul. They are needed to defeat the main villain Lich. He destroyed our world. And now the fate of the world depends only on you.

name: 創業王 CEO
short_description: 經典商業模擬遊戲《創業王》讓你一圓當老闆的夢想！選地建廠，佈置廠房、僱用員工，打造夢幻生產線！ 自由組合數百種原料，創意研發理想商品！ 轉戰各行各業，一手包辦醬油大亨和石油大亨！ 發揮企業影響力，打造美麗新市鎮！ 豐富的任務關卡模式，真實呈現商場激烈競爭！

name: The Bad Kids
short_description: As an adaptation of the popular suspecse TV series, Cat's Cradle, this game combines investigation, solving puzzles and reasoning with original stories, which can build a more Immersive experience. Game will build new stories based on original setting and focus on the inner world of the character.

name: Farlanders
short_description: Terraform, strategize, and construct a Martian colony in this retro-inspired turn-based city builder. Create a comfortable living for your citizens, research alien artifacts, and uncover the secrets of the Red Planet.

name: Putin Destroys Alien
short_description: In an alternative reality where putin have been ruling russia for thoudsands of year. Democratic alien in space are trying to spread fake propaganda to the people and make them betray their great king.As the last heir to the throne of a great reign, have to do what is right and smite their ass.

name: BLINNK and the Vacuum of Space
short_description: Welcome to deep space station Norpopolis – where a batch of escaped critters are causing chaos! Grab your Vacuumizer 5000 and go undercover with BLINNK the robot to catch them all. VR for autism.

name: Caves of Lore
short_description: Engage in tactical grid-based combat in this classic-styled fantasy CRPG.

name: Surviving the Abyss
short_description: Earth, 1976. You have been tasked with managing a deep-sea science facility working to perfect cloning. Explore the darkness and keep your crew alive in this hardcore survival colony builder. And beware. The darkness hides untold horrors.

name: 100 Keys To Your Heart
short_description: Figure out a way to get the correct key for every door in this sweet Puzzle Platformer game.

name: Kitten Kingdom
short_description: Join adorable kittens in Kitten Kingdom, a 2D platformer game with engaging gameplay, cute graphics, and an amazing soundtrack. Explore a vast and colorful world, collect money, and navigate challenging obstacles. Escape the monotony of everyday life with this charming game for all ages.

name: The Simulacrum
short_description: The Simulacrum is a deckbuilder with procedurally generated cards. Obtain cards through a roguelite mode, acquire a large collection and challenge the hidden guardians of The Simulacrum.

name: Persona 3 Portable
short_description: If I say there’s an hour “hidden” between one day and the next... would you believe me? Master the power of the heart, Persona, and uncover the tragic truth of the Dark Hour.

name: Avernus
short_description: Avernus is a challenging action-adventure game set in an ancient, mysterious tomb of a dead god. Delve into its labyrinthine halls and protect its secrets from a malevolent pretender.

name: A Space for the Unbound
short_description: A slice-of-life adventure game with beautiful pixelart set in the late 90s rural Indonesia that tells a story about overcoming anxiety, depression, and the relationship between a boy and a girl with supernatural powers

name: Demon Queen Melissa
short_description: The previous Demon Lord was defeated by the hero, and his daughter took the throne. Although Melissa is said to surpass her father in strength, she is now seeking ways to coexist with humanity.

name: DancingSim
short_description: DancingSim is a mini-tool for watching virtual characters dance, with built-in characters, costumes, animation resources, and customizable scenes. It supports Workshop and you can import characters, animations, and background music as you wish.

name: Estencel
short_description: Slash your way through Estencel! Traverse across a corrupted, maze like city fighting horrors. Customize and arm yourself into the ultimate monster killing assassin in this fast paced Dark Fantasy Action. Solve the mysteries of this world before they swallow you whole.

name: House of Shadow
short_description: House of Shadow is an action-adventure metroidvania wherein you wield the powers of darkness! Explore, traverse obstacles, battle monsters born of light, slay fearsome bosses, and claim the Shadow Throne!

name: Touch the Color
short_description: Take your reflexes and aim to the next level with Touch the Color, the arcade-style reaction and accuracy game that’s easy to pick up but hard to put down.

name: Let's Pet Pets
short_description: Let's Pet Pets lets you pet pets of all different types and sets. Pet Points buy helping hands and items. Quests give you heart points. Heart points buy eggs and upgrades. You can prestige to get heart points and reset your helping hands and items. Upgrades and Pets are permanent.

name: Light the Backrooms
short_description: You will be hounded by ghosts in the Backrooms of a ghost hunting company from midnight to 6 am. New kinds of crazy ghosts will be introduced daily, but you will also be notified how to deal with them. Take advantage of the two types of lights and survive five days of crazy business.

name: Grand Theft Auto III – The Definitive Edition
short_description: It all starts in Liberty City. With revolutionary freedom to go anywhere and jack anyone, Grand Theft Auto III puts the center of the criminal underworld at your fingertips, if you have enough guts to take it.

name: Project Malice
short_description: An isometric roguelike third-person shooter about a ruined Earth and the unending chaos engulfing it. Fight hordes of the infected, gather loot, make allies, traverse spacetime, and venture into the depths of what we could've prevented.

name: Red Wukong
short_description: Red Wukong is a 3d action platformer with a Beat 'em Up style combat powered by Unreal 5. Each level is a different challenge, also the world map is highly explorable and hides some dungeons. Some gameplay aspects are influenced by snes platform classics, bringing then to the new generation.

name: Adventure's Pixel World
short_description: Face goblins, trolls, bats, giant golems, spiders, angry chickens, dangerous traps and much more to complete levels that get more and more challenging. Collect as many candies as you can to unlock stronger characters. Attention: Only legends will succeed!

name: RPG Architect
short_description: Want to build a game, but not sure where to start? Focus on designing your game and let RPG Architect do the rest! We've abstracted most of the nitty-gritty stuff out so you can focus on building your next great adventure!

name: Dark Shrine
short_description: Dark Shrine is a short horror game set in a japanese shrine.

name: Definitely Not Fried Chicken
short_description: Definitely Not Fried Chicken is a business management sim with a Twist! Grow your drugs trade through legitimate fronts by managing both sides of the business. Acquire new 'businesses', meet new clientele, Develop more potent narcotics, make lots of money and leave a city in ruin!

name: Alien Egg: Ascent
short_description: Jump your way into outer space to help a lost alien egg find its way back to its homeworld!

name: Graze Counter GM
short_description: A refreshing and highly re-playable bullet hell style shooter that WANTS you to play dangerously! Ride the razor's edge of life and death in this high-risk high-reward danger oriented arcade style shooting game.

name: 2112TD: Tower Defense Survival
short_description: Get ready for the ULTIMATE tower defense onslaught. Build, deploy, research and upgrade your defenses in this epic, old school RTS inspired sci-fi adventure.

name: Your Story
short_description: In Your Story, a visual novel with point’n’click elements, you leave the safe quiet of your family’s inn and embark on a fantasy adventure. It’s a wholesome growing of age tale. The mystery awaits just beyond the horizon…

name: The secret pyramid VR
short_description: A VR shooting game with Roguelite elements on the theme of ancient Egyptian tomb exploration.

name: 无尽星海(Endless Stars)
short_description: The story takes place in the distant future. You will play a captain of a star ship and go into deep space. You need to manage your resources carefully. In the game, you can investigate the outliers of various planets, discover the wonders of the universe or learn the stories of lost civilizations.

name: World Championship Boxing Manager™ 2
short_description: The boxing world is at your fingertips in this deeply detailed and outrageously entertaining sports management simulation. Enlist competitive fighters, recruit top-notch staff, and ride the hype train all the way to endorsement city! Watch your fighter rise to the top, or get KO’d trying.

name: Cracks In Hell
short_description: Defeat the swarming monsters of hell and save mankind

name: Palette Swap
short_description: A monochrome action platformer where the palette changes the environment around you

name: PocketCiv
short_description: A solitaire civilization tabletop game. Plan your moves. Build your empire. Expand your civilization. Try to survive.

name: 虚空灵药园
short_description: He mistakenly entered the secret realm of the void with abundant aura, met the seriously injured female master, and then embarked on the life of cultivating pills

name: Activate: 激活
short_description: Use items and your wisdom to activate the block maze!

name: Fraymakers
short_description: Fraymakers is the ultimate customizable platform fighting game, featuring a cast of some of indie gaming's biggest icons. Duke it out with up to 4 players and call on assists to help out in the heat of battle. Create and play custom characters, stages, modes, and more for infinite fun!

name: Makis Adventure
short_description: Fight, dash, swim and bite your way through 3 different dungeons. Let the inner shark out! Face many different opponents and defeat powerful bosses. Makis Adventure is a pixel art platformer with a bite!

name: Qdice
short_description: A turn-based multiplayer strategy boardgame

name: Blinded by Fear
short_description: Interned, blind and alone. Fulfil your contractual obligation to the corporation that owns you. Your vision, modified by a cybernetic LiDAR device, is the only way to investigate the ANIMA, an abandoned futuristic mining facility with a dark secret...and even darker horrors.

name: Star Ring
short_description: 长篇×乙女向×模拟养成 欢迎来到星之诗学院！追求梦想的你，就是未来最璀璨的明星。——九种职业路线，七位可攻略角色，丰富的游戏系统，打造独一无二的演艺圈传奇。

name: FORTUNE the FATED
short_description: To unlock ancient spells needed to defend the galaxy, can you navigate fantasy quests, noir cases, heroic competitions, dystopian worlds & space heists?

name: Lake Haven - Chrysalis
short_description: Detective Zeke Reynold is called to investigate what he assumes will be another case he'll quickly forget, but what he finds will be sewn into the fabric of his existence forever.

name: 星の欠片の物語。しかけ版
short_description: Help a stranded girl escape with just your eyes in this puzzle game designed specifically for VR. From the stationary convergence point between the two worlds, use the 'Focus Lock' to tell her the steps she has to take in order to put the star back together.

name: Tristia:restore
short_description: Saw, hammer, and invent!

name: BoxLoop 2
short_description: The Time Looping Evil Boxes Are Back! Solve The Riddles and Help Save Our Hero Aous From The Time Looping Evil Boxes In This Roguelike Adventure.

name: Avoid The Rain 2
short_description: This is an agile parkour game. You can dodge quickly to avoid raindrops falling from the sky and go to the designated place.

name: Boing
short_description: Boing is a fast paced action game where you are the weapon, defending against waves of more and more challenging enemies.

name: Tracadie Bird Shit
short_description: Play as a bird in a small city called Tracadie.

name: T-Rex Dinosaur Game (Unreal Engine 5 Edition)
short_description: Next-Gen version of the cult game.

name: Flaming Thunderer
short_description: Flaming Thunderer is an action-platformer with adventure elements. Darkness has overtaken your village, monsters have come to your lands.

name: Zooblies
short_description: Pause time, drag blue objects around, and dodge different species of Zooblies in this physics-based puzzle platformer!

name: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas – The Definitive Edition
short_description: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas: It’s the early ’90s. After a couple of cops frame him for homicide, Carl ‘CJ’ Johnson is forced on a journey that takes him across the entire state of San Andreas, to save his family and to take control of the streets.

name: Image
short_description: Image is a first-person horror game. Explore haunted, ever-changing environments in an atmospheric, confused world and enjoy a truly terrifying gaming experience.

name: Bram The Toymaker
short_description: A scary bedtime story or a horrid physical entity? The story goes that the toymaker is an undead figure who comes out at night leaving a toy on the children’s bedroom window to lure and capture them. A folktale passed through generations within the family might hold some dark secrets.

name: Xploquest 3
short_description: Xploquest 3 is a turn-based role-playing game where you explore an open world and manage your character.

name: Gem Worlds
short_description: Gem World is a short roguelike/puzzle hybrid. Explore 50 levels in 5 unique worlds. Dodge boulders, collect gems, fight (or avoid) monsters. Unlock and upgrade more than 10 diverse skills. Exploit obstacles like mines, icicles, cactii, and more. Turn-based and easy to play.

name: Ensora
short_description: Ensora is a side-scrolling action-shooter about survival and loot-gathering. Fight gangs of thugs and Corporation soldiers for the remaining resources on the planet. Solve the mysteries of the Portal and try to return home.

name: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City – The Definitive Edition
short_description: Welcome to the 1980s. From the decade of big hair and pastel suits comes the story of one man's rise to the top of the criminal pile. Grand Theft Auto returns with Tommy Vercetti’s tale of betrayal and revenge in a neon-soaked tropical town full of excess and brimming with possibilities.

name: 80's Mania Pinball
short_description: Throwback to the golden age of arcade with this incredible pinball machine. Simple, funny and hard to dominate.

name: AColony
short_description: A colony building game with an emphasis on unexpected events, online co-op, and managing a unique community. Build your colony, feed your colonists, research technologies, craft advanced weapons, explore the world, fight enemies and defend your property.

name: PK Girls
short_description: Your face is my strength to defeat other girls.

name: The Burrito Quest
short_description: Your burrito is missing. You have to find it. What are you waiting for?

name: After Wave: Downfall
short_description: Arcade shooter where the player battles against monsters, completes various missions with a cool battleship. Deathrix invaded the world and released a mysterious meteorite causing a great flood. Players can upgrade their ships for better performance to fight the most brutal enemies.

name: Human or Not
short_description: Aliens are entering Earth disguised as humans. It's your job to expose these imposters. Can you tell who is human and who is not? Choose your own path while you keep the Earth safe.

name: RE:CALL
short_description: Memories are malleable and changing them will modify the present. Tackle mind-bending puzzles that rely on altering your own recollections to shape the future.

name: It Lurks! A Noir Horror RPG.
short_description: Take on the role of a hardened Private Detective in this horror themed classic-styled Role Playing Game that pits you against fearsome foes in an exciting turn-based and interactive battle-system.

name: A Matter of Principle
short_description: A Matter of Principle is an interactive historical comic in visual novel format. You have to participate in one of the most high-profile events of the XX century.

name: Jumping Cat
short_description: 'Jumping Cat' is a simple and straightforward platform jumping game. In order to revive the lost kingdom, our cat hero puts on his cape and overcomes many obstacles to collect Gold Coins and Paw Gems in dungeons full of traps!

name: Inmortuae Metuunt: Rise of The Undead
short_description: Inmortuae Metuunt: Rise of the Undead features a PvE battle with wave progression, the further the player goes, the harder it gets. It offers 4 characters with distinct stories and abilities, along with a catalog of maps and weapons.

name: Maiz
short_description: Using laser beams, reflexions, blocks and button to push and activate, solve the puzzles in Maiz to discover the story of this Moroccan village.

name: Devil's 5 Days Mischief Game
short_description: A Role-Playing Game as play as an adventurer who travels with the pact demon, who is also his girlfriend, Ria, attend to a business contest with a powerful adventurer that lasts for five days to decide who will be the next pact holder.

name: Nope Nope Nope Nurses
short_description: Yamada falls into the clutches of the “OG Three,” a triple threat of veteran nurses!

name: Tristia:legacy
short_description: The revived original story of Nanoka Flanka, a budding inventor and crafter.

name: 魔女の館
short_description: Genre ：VR Novel Game Movement ：Teleport movement Languege : Japanese Basic Operation Read the story: Left Trigger Button Movement : Right stick Inventory display : Y button Grab and release : Right grip button Grabbing door handles: left and right grip buttons

name: Epic Race: The Stadium
short_description: Let's challenge winding tracks in a stadium.

name: Sudden Market
short_description: The supermarket has just closed, hurry up to find and collect all the products on your list without getting caught by the security guard!

name: Frido
short_description: Robot time traveler got into the past. To get out, he needs to get to the time machine, passing more than 10 exciting levels.

name: 错误之事
short_description: The Wrong Thing is an avg short visual novel produced by Coffee Studio. It tells the story of a former company's slaves who was fired at home and a female high school student from the first person perspective.

name: WHITE WATER
short_description: 自由的去探案 按照你自己的想法

name: Punch A Bunch
short_description: A challenging boxing game with an emphasis on player skill that takes time and practice to master. Fight your way to the top through 3 different championships each featuring unique opponents.

name: The Duck Song Game
short_description: The ever so loved The Duck Song has returned.

name: Outcasts of Dungeon:Epic Magic World Fight Rogue Game Simulator
short_description: Outcasts of Dungeon is a third person fantasy action Being in the role of a powerful War Mage with dozens of deadly weapons and spells, defend your kingdom fortress from a rampaging mob of beastly invaders.

name: Mangavania
short_description: Old school action platformer game with pixel art graphics.

name: Fateel - فتيل
short_description: Follow the journey of a crime detective who has been kidnapped by an unknown gang, and now he must solve the mysteries and find a way out.

name: Not born to be King
short_description: Not born to be King is a simulation game where you embody a medieval king and try to lead your kingdom to success. Face a large variety of events, build a strong economy, and make the right decisions to prosper in this ruthless world.

name: 幻境咖啡馆-Dreamland coffee
short_description: Du Qing, the heroine, opened a cafe in a foreign country alone after the adventure of Wonderland Lovers. A new story began when she took in a little boy who lingered outside her door on opening day...

name: Martial Fire
short_description: Martial Fire is a classic 2D adventure game. Explore dungeons, ancient forests and deadly wastelands; fight enemies and solve riddles!

name: Gunslinger Nova
short_description: A top-down, 2d space-shooter that pits the user against swarms of alien ships from other dimensions. Destroy all enemies and portals as fast as possible. Battle increasingly tougher enemies through 40 Campaign levels and Endless Mode!

name: Theseus Protocol
short_description: Theseus Protocol is a deck building roguelike where rebirth offers strategic opportunity. Utilize a powerful suite of cards and weaponry to uncover the cruel truth behind the dystopian sci-fi world of Mark City.

name: Lone Traveler
short_description: Lone Traveler - A story about a lone traveler, you have to dig, explore the location, fight monsters in order to survive on the island! Build a wooden ax or a stone pickaxe and go on an adventure!

name: A Sad Journey
short_description: A wonderful third-person adventure game about a rabbit looking for his missing parents. In this journey you will search for Paws that will take you to special places where you will get your memories back.

name: Scrap Games
short_description: Scrap Games is a 3D side-scrolling beat'em up game with a simple gameplay system that offers many possibilities. Choose your robot character, upgrade it and go through the next stages by defeating your enemies. Prepare yourself and let the fight begin!!! Beat them up!!!

name: Simp
short_description: This is a survival horror game.

name: Cyber West: Hidden Object Games - Western
short_description: A unique cyberpunk western! Conduct an investigation like a real detective in the world of Cyber Wild West! The newest hidden object game with a storyline. Сarve out your own legend!

name: Hell Slayer
short_description: Clear your way down to hell and bring punishment to the one responsible, Lucifer, fallen angel and king of sins. Face unending hordes of demons, optimize and perfect your build.

name: Catoise
short_description: Make portals and levitate objects to solve puzzles - help Catoise get back home after a shopping trip in space ends in a crash landing. Collect parts of the damaged ship scattered across this strange planet. Meet friendly and unfriendly animal characters along the way.

name: Old Shadow
short_description: A game based on J.R.R. Tolkien's novel The Lord of the Rings. A variant 'Metroidvania' with elements of survival and crafting.

name: No13Shelter
short_description: 1 3D story text adventure playing game

name: Durka Simulator
short_description: Durka Simulator is a visual novel where you are waiting for adventure and mystery.You as the main player are being sought to take away your power.You and mysterious must not let them catch you!With you will always be your friends as a lemur named Zina, Mysterious and Larry

name: Stonga Bird
short_description: Stonga Bird is a score attack game about pushing your bird to its limits. A difficult game about avoiding pipes using a floaty-feeling irradiated bird.

name: Waiter
short_description: Waiter is a first person game about a waiter. In this cool game, you play as a waiter who needs to serve drinks to club customers. This game will give you unforgettable emotions of joy and fun. Play it with fun and perky music!

name: Larcin Lazer
short_description: In this puzzle game combining action and stealth, your memory will be your best tool! Remember the location of the lasers, they disappear as soon as you move. Avoid deadly lasers with style, steal from the richest and save your cat 🐱 Prepare for a MEMORABLE heist

name: Dead Space
short_description: The sci-fi survival-horror classic returns, completely rebuilt to offer an even more immersive experience — including visual, audio, and gameplay improvements — while staying faithful to the original game’s thrilling vision.

name: SUA
short_description: SUA is a rather dark adventure game. This game was made by RPG Maker MV. The game was created by referring to the history of South Korea. I think there will be difficulties in encountering neutral or hostile characters. Everyone, try to escape with the girl.

name: bloody lonely cold
short_description: bloody lonely cold is a survival horror game from a first-person perspective. In a future large Japanese hospital. There is a brave beautiful girl who bravely faced monsters in order to survive. When you are with her, don't panic, don't be afraid.

name: A Modest Legacy
short_description: Welcome to A Modest Legacy, a medieval, real time strategy game. Here you will use city building and combat tactics to conquer your enemies in hopes to be the last kingdom standing. Good luck!

name: Pizza Tower
short_description: Pizza Tower is a fast paced 2D platformer inspired by the Wario Land series, with an emphasis on movement, exploration and score attack. Featuring highly stylized pixel art inspired by the cartoons from the '90s, and a highly energetic soundtrack.

name: Endless Nesla
short_description: Endless Nesla is a demanding infinite runner game with dynamic movement mechanics and immersive graphics. Escape Nesla, and challenge other players on the Leaderboards !

name: Hope
short_description: Mistakes are not an impediment, but an opportunity to grow. Play and learn from your mistakes. Come and recharge your hopes.

name: Forspoken
short_description: Forspoken follows the journey of Frey, a young New Yorker transported to the beautiful and cruel land of Athia. In search of a way home, Frey must use her newfound magical abilities to traverse sprawling landscapes and battle monstrous creatures.

name: Rogue Station
short_description: This 'space station builder simulation roguelite' puts you in charge of a remote station orbiting a gas giant. Fight off enemy ships, fleets and rival stations to dominate your corner of space. Build and upgrade your station, hire and manage your crew. Survive as long as you can.

name: Watch Dogs®: Legion
short_description: Build a resistance as you fight to take back a near-future London facing its downfall. Welcome to the Resistance.

name: The Adventurer's Domain Online
short_description: Multiplayer Online RPG offering a shared world for players to adventure merging ‘classic’ MMO vibes with more modern third person action combat systems.

name: Brick Odyssey
short_description: The roguelike block-breaker that the gaming world needed! Choose your hero and destroy bricks to make him fight. Skillfully maneuver the ball, optimize your upgrades wisely, and maybe you will reach the end of this Odyssey!

name: ATONE: Heart of the Elder Tree
short_description: ATONE is a Norse mythology-inspired, hand-drawn game that blends interactive storytelling and complex puzzles with a rhythm game combat system. Inherit the role of a young warrior named Estra as she journeys through Midgard to unveil the truth behind her father’s death.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Kuro no Kiseki Ⅱ -CRIMSON SiN-
short_description: Witness the sins spun by jet-black and crimson-- The latest chapter in the Kiseki saga is finally here! Kuro no Kiseki II is loaded with unique content, including a variety of new challenges throughout the Republic of Calvard.

name: Temple of Starlight
short_description: Temple of Starlight is an abstract first-person puzzle game with a striking retro visual style. Use colored lights to clear obstacles and explore an ancient temple along with its forgotten history.

name: 可识此阵
short_description: 策略构筑玩法+2048操作方式的休闲卡牌游戏。

name: Roller Drama
short_description: The visual novel / sport management mashup game of your (anxiety-ridden?) DREAMS! Lead a team of Roller Derby athletes using strategy and real-time controls. Outside the ring you’ll have to manage five big personalities as they grapple with friendship, heartbreak, and late capitalist society…

name: Hood Warfare
short_description: Welcome to Detroit. Gang violence has become an epidemic, forcing all civilians and police to leave the city. All that remains are soldiers of the Bloods and Crips. The city has become an abandoned battlefield where gangs engage in large scale firefights known as 'Hood Warfare'.

name: David Slade Mysteries: Case Files
short_description: Take to the dark and violent streets of downtown Riverside, where you investigate gruesome and violent homicides using a range of Forensic tools and your wits! Inspired by the classic Police Quest adventure series, reborn & reimagined for VR.

name: The Forgotten Tapes: Analog Nightmares
short_description: A collection of horror stories, realized by 9 developers. Each with its own unique take on Analog Horror! Experience these spooky tales through the interactive hub world & choose what to play at your own pace. Just don't die of fright!

name: Resultarias
short_description: Resultarias is a surrealist adventure game narrated by dream exploration. You play as Utsuki, a girl that for some reason doesn't want to leave her room and will only explore the world through her dreams.

name: 草食系男子の言いなり入院生活- A passive boy at the Huntress clinic -
short_description: The protagonist is unable to move due to a car accident and is now being approached by the heroines. And so begins a hospital stay surrounded by prank-loving female doctors and nurses!!

name: Hi-Fi RUSH
short_description: Feel the beat as wannabe rockstar Chai and his ragtag team fight against an evil megacorp with raucous rhythm combat! From Tango Gameworks comes Hi-Fi RUSH, an all-new action game where the world syncs to the music.

name: Onion Assault
short_description: The evil Croquetto Empire is trying to conquer Onionia and it's up to one brave onion farmer, and his mom, to stop the tyrannical invading fascist army! Old-school 2D platfoming from the creator of Gunman Clive and Mechstermination Force.
