name: A Legend of Wisdom Part I
short_description: Enter the fantasy world and feel what it's like to be a real traveler! Create, try new spells and face the greatest evil in this world!

name: Poly Skies
short_description: Poly Skies is a casual village builder and colony sim designed to help you relax. Take care of your villagers who are seeking refuge from dangers below the clouds.

name: Saint Kotar: The Yellow Mask
short_description: Follow the fear of Benedek Dohnany and Nikolay Kalyakin and play the onset of a dark and chilling narrative adventure. Make decisions and affect the events that precede a macabre series of murders, allegedly related to devil worship and witchcraft.

name: CallOfTree
short_description: Fisrt Person Shooting Game And Beautiful scenery. The story is about a bad god named Gideon tormented humans and a tree that couldn't stand summoned a warrior from another world in a chaotic situation due to the war of the gods The trees are all unique, so you can easily find trees to interact with

name: Power Chord
short_description: Power Chord is a rock'n roguelite deck-building game. Assemble Earth's mightiest musicians, battle your way through legions of demons, discover new cards to enhance your instruments of destruction, and take back the city, one dive bar at a time.

name: Just One
short_description: How are you Master? We have a new mission for you!

name: Inhabit
short_description: Make your way around your home and surrounding areas, practicing healthy habits and exploring the world in this open ended slice of life puzzle game.

name: Stay Human
short_description: Explore a hex based procedurally generated cityscape, infested with assorted zombies, collect powerful and novel zombie slaying weapons, medical supplies and food. Rescue fellow survivors to grow your party, defeat powerful zombie bosses, escape the city... but most importantly... Stay Human!

name: 鞭炮&烟花：春节模拟器Firecrackers&fireworks：china new year simulation
short_description: Realistic style of firecrackers and fireworks simulator, there are a variety of fireworks types and play, you can use firecrackers and various props such as manhole covers, cow dung to interact, you can also hold a romantic fireworks show, wish you a happy game！

name: Flip of Light
short_description: A precision platformer where you can instantaneously flip from ceiling to floor. Run, jump, and flip your way through difficult and vibrant stages, each themed around a pair of complementary colors. Master a constant barrage of new level mechanics, each designed around your flip ability.

name: Warmonium
short_description: Featuring team fighting turn based tactics with multilevel pathfinding. Inspired by late 90's to early 2000's board games it's a fantasy come true for fans of strategy war games! Catering to the casual and competitive player, from ranked games to custom maps.

name: New Witch in Town
short_description: Make friends, cast spells, and uncover secrets in your magical small town! Will you preserve the forest or let the town grow?

name: The madness of death
short_description: The madness of death is a first person psychological horror game. Explore the house in order to escape from it and break the curse of the Death Stone. You will have to solve the puzzles in order to advance and try not to stay in the dark.

name: The Green Room Experiment (Episode 1)
short_description: You're locked in a dream and you need to wake up. This game is designed on an escape game structure, you must solve a puzzle to move on to the next table. You will be transported to a dreamlike, strange universe, mixing exploration, mystery and poetry.

name: Ballistic Zen
short_description: Skate. Strafe. Wallrun. Master a unique movement system based on old-school air-strafing, updated for the modern age. Use your hoverblades to find collectables and follow lines in an open world. Feel the Ballistic Zen.

name: 8 Ball 3
short_description: Where to jump? Which way to go? Should I go on or fall? Which balloon to choose? Take your intuition to the extreme.

name: GRUNND
short_description: A handcrafted point-and-click adventure about traveling through a town that appears ordinary… right up until revealing its surreal and twisted nature. You’ll encounter hidden agendas, lurking gods, and decisions that change the very nature of your journey in this mystery and SciFi fusion adventure.

name: CATACOMBS: The Beginning
short_description: Catacombs: The Beginning - is an excellent 3D shooter where you have to survive in the catacombs overfull of various monsters.

name: Scary Turnaround
short_description: While walking in the mountains, you fall into a cave. There is practically no light in it, you will have to find your way out of it by exploring the abandoned rooms of what was once a laboratory. As you explore, you'll need to find the key that will open the door to your freedom.

name: Hyper Shapes
short_description: Hyper Shapes is a frenetic minimalist Boss Rush where understanding the enemies attack patterns and weaknesses is key.

name: I commissioned some bunnies
short_description: I paid artists to hide bunnies and carrots in 15 artworks. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

name: The Dark Side Of Mars
short_description: Survival horror game where you need to find your way through the maze that is the Red Arc Facility. You need to Find four Key cards and one Space Suit to escape the facility alive. Some enemies run and some relentlessly follow you and all you have is a torch.

name: Garden In!
short_description: A cozy and peaceful sandbox game about growing tiny and lovely plants. Just relax, take care of your seedlings, and watch your dream garden come to life.

name: WHALIEN - Unexpected Guests
short_description: Push and Pull your way through this heartfelt adventure! Fin, the mechanical whale you call home, is plagued by mischievous Squiddies. As Ernest Hemingwhale you set out on a Fin-tastic journey to help your friend with his unexpected guests.

name: 仙界之剑 仙王少女战记
short_description: This game has been elaborately produced, and the content is very rich. Welcome friends who like to nostalgize and play with RPG.

name: Handyman Corporation
short_description: In Handyman Corporation you become the owner of a business where you handle a variety of jobs in cleaning, maintenance, design, and construction. Accept contracts, play minigames to perform every task required. Then expand your company – buy spare parts, tools, train skills, and manage employees

name: Rival Rides
short_description: Rival Rides is an exciting multiplayer VR party game taking place in an out-of-this-world theme park. Compete with your friends online in various mini-games and wild rides, in order to collect the highest amount of golden egg trophies and become the Rival Ride’s champion!

name: Deathtide Survivors
short_description: A Roguelite where you are the Boss Fight! Defeat endless tides of the undead, complete tough challenges and dethrone powerful bosses. A Horde-Survival Roguelite where you unlock ancient powers and create overpowered character builds to become an unstoppable army-destroyer.

name: The Rocket Jumper
short_description: The Rocket Jumper is a 3D platformer that puts a twist on traditional gameplay by incorporating rocket jumping as the main element.

name: Alice Escaped!
short_description: Explore the stylish world of Wonderland with Usada and Kotora as they search for a mysterious girl named Alice! A Metroidvania action game with a rich, exhilarating battle system all wrapped up in cuteness!

name: Super Kids Racing : Mini Edition
short_description: Super Kids Racing : Mini Edition offers wide variety of challenges which involves 5 different seasons with many different types of vehicles to choose from. Players will love to complete these challenges with their friends in split-screen multiplayer mode.

name: Forest Of Relics
short_description: Use the Run / Jump / Hanging / Paragliding to pass through various obstacles and obtain treasures. Spinel, the guardian of the ruins, is testing you.

name: Bus Simulator: Car Driving
short_description: You have to be a great public bus driver in this bus game simulator.

name: 三国群英战略版
short_description: 开局一队将，一座城，开启你的三国之旅。 运筹帷幄，策略经营，成就每个枭雄心中的帝王梦。 只有5%玩家能真正玩懂的烧脑三国游戏！

name: Forkscythe
short_description: Are you ready to test your skills and bravery in the ultimate horror action game? Introducing Forkscythe, a retro FPS unlike any other. Set in a nightmarish world overrun by attacking skulls, you'll need quick reflexes and strategic thinking to survive!

name: Land of Towers
short_description: Land of Towers is a VR adventure game for the whole family. Reality-based quests, distinctive architecture, intuitive controls, creative workshop, picturesque locations for relaxation.

name: TAMERLANE
short_description: 2D-top-down shooter focused on avoiding your enemies and defeating them from a distance. Experience real historical combat of the medieval ages taking you through Europe, the Middle East and India. Encounter a wide range of enemies requiring you to master the art of mounted archery.

name: Liars Race in Lost Ruins
short_description: This is a FPS game in which players repeatedly play alliances and treacherous tactics to evade the traps of the huge labyrinth and reach the goal to get the treasure hidden in the depths of the labyrinth.

name: 情人泪
short_description: Players will play as Lin Xi, the notorious female demon in the rivers and lakes, and start a series of love-hate entanglements with Lu Yi, a disciple of the Right Way, and a disciple of the Hehuan Sect, and every choice of the player will be crucial.

name: Path of a Player
short_description: This Game is loosely based on Solo Leveling

name: Mahokenshi
short_description: Begin your journey to become a mighty samurai mage! In a blend of adventure, strategy and deckbuilding gameplay, choose how you will follow the way of the Mahoken. Explore the Celestial Islands, build your deck, battle challenging demons, and protect the land from the forces of corruption.

name: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon® Breakpoint
short_description: Become a Ghost, fighting against a rogue spec ops faction called the Wolves, in the latest Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon®!

name: Akari: School Trip
short_description: Akari: School Trip is an immersive, action-packed adventure game based on a popular Japanese manga. As the player guides Akari, a courageous school girl, through a mysterious and dangerous world.

name: Rogue Blaster
short_description: Rogue Blaster is a shooting game that adds a twist to the FPS genre by adapting some rogue-lite aspects. The planet you crash-landed on is teeming with monsters! Use different equipment and items to survive the attacks until your ship is ready to leave.

name: Neptunia: Sisters VS Sisters
short_description: With Gamindustri on the brink of destruction, Nepgear and the Candidates must band together and restore order!

name: A Maiden Astrologer Divines the Future
short_description: This work is an adventure game that you can enjoy about an astrologer named Izumi who feels happy and rewarded when 'making someone happy' or 'being able to support someone'.

name: Fallen Bride Mege
short_description: Mege is the childhood sweetheart of the protagonist. Lucky enough, he is able to marry Mege with everyone's blessing and lives a happy life. But the sudden news of layoffs broke his peaceful days.

name: Ultimate Flight Simulator Pro
short_description: If you want to feel like a real pilot, this airplane game is for you.

name: Superfuse
short_description: Superfuse is a comic-book-styled hack'n'slash ARPG with a rich and accessible skill customization system. Craft unique skills from a huge array of powerful fuses, select one of three classes and embark on this journey alone or with up to 3 friends. When humanity needs hope, be the hero!

name: Whackerball
short_description: Whackerball is a twin-stick shooter roguelite with Breakout inspired mechanics. Master the unique combat system as you venture through a multitude of diverse areas while collecting powerful and game changing upgrades.

name: PERISH
short_description: PERISH is a stylish 1-4 player FPS with a cross to bear. Slay hordes of creatures on the black sands of Purgatory and sell their gold-stained corpses to craven priests. Kill magnificent bosses and use the proceeds to gain entrance to Elysium, a place of cosmic revelations.

name: QUALIA ~The Path of Promise~
short_description: “Machina” is the world’s first android to pass the Turing Test. Incidentally, she is also dressed like a maid. Dr. Hiro Koshino ends up taking Machina home and has her work as a maid. As she continues to learn and grow, he also begins to develop certain feelings towards her…

name: Elohim Eternal: The Babel Code
short_description: Explore a vibrant world where ancient religions fuse with technology in this character-driven JRPG. Master deep turn-based combat as you battle with divine magic against beasts with mecha parts. Embark on a grand adventure to retrieve the sacred Babel code needed to face your Gods.

name: Please Teach Me Onedari Shogi
short_description: Onedari Girls are Shogi novices. When they face a difficult situation, they request a “Do-Over” or “Hint.” Accept their requests to get along with the girls!

name: Kindergarten secret
short_description: Kindergarten secret - detective, horror and puzzle in one game. You will be able to play as several characters in the frame of one game, complete twenty unique quests and uncover the main secret of the story.

name: Interference: Dead Air
short_description: All hell's breaking loose in a mysterious research facility and the only person who can save the day is the night shift security guard in the booth outside. Remotely control systems, guide scientists to safety or just… goof off? You’re not in danger. Yet.

name: JETT: The Far Shore + Given Time
short_description: Embark on an interstellar trip and deploy to a mythic ocean planet in a low-flying jett in this cinematic science fiction action adventure with immersive sim elements from Superbrothers, known for Sword & Sworcery EP.

name: ROGLE
short_description: ROGLE is the classic game of Wordle with a mix of rogue-like elements, that increases in difficulty as you succeed. As you play, you will gain abilities that will increase your chances of finding the word while the difficulty increases and you challenge enemies that will attempt to stop you.

name: Lawbringer
short_description: Lawbringer is a fast-paced arena fighting roguelite. Hack, slash and shoot your way through enemy hordes to appease the Autarch. The faster you slay your enemies, the greater His favor. Pick up game changing skills and a variety of weapons. Kill fast, grow strong and cheat death.

name: Dimensions: Dreadnought Architect
short_description: Build Easier But Produce Fancier! Design your dreadnought from modules. Command your capital ship with a captain experience. Beat distinctive enemys with smart strategy. Plan route on procedual generated galaxy map. Have fun with your friends through network.

name: Tennis Online Duel
short_description: Online Tennis Duel is a realistic first person tennis game with an ideal physical ball. Play with your friends or someone random across the internet.

name: Heavyarms Assemble: WWII
short_description: This is a strategy game with the theme of WWII. As a battlefield commander, maintaining your army's motivation and satisfaction, promoting your generals, managing your own economy, dealing with your friends' armies, and real time grand battle. What kind of commander will you become in the process?

name: Candy Arkanoid
short_description: Candy Arkanoid is more than just a simple arcade game - it also includes role-playing elements, allowing players to level up their candy Arkanoid and customize its abilities. So why wait? Satisfy your sweet tooth and soon blast your way through the candy cosmos!

name: Cubis
short_description: 'Cubis' is a good old classic style action puzzle. Roll the cube and and destroy the enemies and objects.

name: M.U.D.S.: Mean Ugly Dirty Sport
short_description: Jump into gridiron mayhem with M.U.D.S. (Mean Ugly Dirty Sport)! This top-down action sports game combines rugby, RPG character development, management simulation and strategy into an original title you’ll have trouble putting down. And remember – the only way to win is to PLAY DIRTY!

name: Myristica
short_description: XUM studios' singleplayer horror game Myristica takes place in Karnataka, India. You have ran out of fuel on your way home from a long day of river fishing, only to stumble upon a mystifying, yet deadly swamp. Can you get out alive before you fall prey to the elements?

name: Natural Spirit
short_description: Natural Spirit is a third-person adventure game where you will play as the shiba Yukito, to help the spirit Aura to save the tree of life from a certain death that would doom us all.

name: Raiden IV x MIKADO remix
short_description: Buckle up and blast off with Raiden IV x MIKADO remix! This classic arcade shoot ‘em up comes fully equipped with new music, battle modes, vertical screen play, and more!

name: The 2nd page of the medical examination diary: Another story of exciting days of me and my senpai
short_description: 'The 2nd page of the medical examination diary: Another story of exciting days of me and my senpai' is the novel game. This is the love story between the resident doctor and the nurse at the hospital. 'The adult love with the nurse who is a childhood friend.'

name: Old Bira´s Farm
short_description: Old Bira created an game to have fun with his animals! Collect apples and fly through courses full of obstacles and see how fast you can do it! but don't crash, or you'll have to start over!!

name: BACKROOMS: APPREHENSION
short_description: A terrifying and immersive multiplayer horror experience with social deduction elements. Survive as a scientist stuck in the Backrooms, just be very careful who you trust, someone is not what they seem!

name: Guns & Fishes
short_description: Guns and Fishes is a fast-paced action platform game that uses fishes as ammo for fighting various enemies. Help Diver to fight against the evil shark yakuza who wants to steal all the corals for their magical powers. Fight your foes with various weapons and advance through the map with your skills

name: Variant 22
short_description: Variant 22 is a extraction based survival game set in a procedural roguelike post American wasteland. Singleplayer or Multiplayer Coop, Scavenge loot from contaminated areas then base build back in the 'safe zone' against endless hordes of the infected.

name: Glass Heart
short_description: A 20% chance is all you have to survive the surgery. Will love give you the strength to continue this life or will you be singing with the angels? The choice is yours in Glass Heart.

name: Nurtured human Plan: Meet a Date！
short_description: Pixel beauty girl love raising game！Let's take it as the author's personal delusion!

name: Our Summer Sports
short_description: It's time for some summer fun! The competition heats up in this series of sports contests!

name: Biblios Dice
short_description: Biblios Dice is a digital adaptation of the dice game by Dr. Finn. In it you are working as medieval monks to produce illustrations and improve the prestige of your abbey. Manipulate the value of the five different resources, buy and sell at the market, and gain the bishop's favor.

name: Clockwork Survivors
short_description: Don't hold forward, don't press fire, but focus on the vertical in this autorunning reverse bullet hell roguelike. Master the level layout by lapping the same short section several times while you gather steam for your hot air balloon companion. Make the balloon & yourself happy.

name: Windmills
short_description: Master your combat techniques and explore a magic world in this combat - focused metroidvania. Help the unreliable narrator complete his story which changes depending on the player's actions.

name: Black cotton: Wuneng
short_description: This is a role-playing ARPG game. The player will play Pig Bajie. The background of the plot is that Bai Gujing ate Tang Sanzang, and his skill increased greatly. Sun Wukong was killed alive. Pig Bajie seeks to revive his master and elder martial brother. The plot is rich and interesting

name: Battle of Vukovar: Rain of Steel
short_description: Join the historic battle for Vukovar at the end of the 20th century through multiplayer combat. Play in teams choosing one of the five modes or outside the team in a free for all mode. Accomplish your goals using real weapons from the war while moving through an accurate simulation of the city map

name: Spellmasons
short_description: Spellmasons is a turn-based, tactical roguelike where you devise spell combinations to overcome the forces of evil and corruption. Play solo or team up with your friends in online multiplayer, and delve into the intricacies of magic where clever combinations yield powerfully satisfying results.

name: Flower Memories
short_description: Exercise your memory alone or with a friend in a beautiful and relaxing environment.

name: Idle Drift Kings
short_description: Idle Drift Kings is a top-down idle game with physics based drifting mechanics. Start your drifting career and earn reputation to buy upgrades and travel to new drift spots. Climb the ranks to become the next Idle Drift King!

name: Joe Wander and the Enigmatic Adventures
short_description: Start the best Enigmatic Adventure of your life! Solve brain-teasing puzzles, explore different worlds with smooth platforming, and enjoy the beautiful scenery in the mysterious world of Joe Wander.

name: The Backrooms - Nightmare Dimension
short_description: The Backrooms - Nightmare Dimension is a Co-op online horror game with up to 4 players, where you and your friends take on the roles of soldiers who are part of the SCP Foundation with the mission to eliminate the mysterious entities found in the infamous place called 'the Backrooms'.

name: Orbital Strike VR
short_description: Orbital Strike VR is a tactical space combat sim with a unique twist that takes players out of the cockpit and into the element. You and up to 3 friends will dodge flak fields, call-in fire support, and provide terminal guidance for the capital ships of your fleet.

name: SpellForce: Conquest of Eo
short_description: On a journey to great magical might, explore and control the lands of Eo in this ever-changing turn-based strategy role-playing game. Field armies and heroes in tactical combat, finish hundreds of quests, and gather spells and artefacts to become the most powerful mage of all.

name: Brave Soldier - Invasion of Cyborgs
short_description: Brave Soldier: Invasion Of Cyborgs is a pixel art platform game with a lot of action. Help the soldier save the world from the Cyborg Invasion! Good Luck!

name: Metal Black™ S-Tribute
short_description: Collect NEWALONE to level up your beam, then release energy! The home console version of the incredible side-scrolling shooter Metal Black is back with online rankings. Two players can play together!

name: Inkulinati
short_description: Inkulinati is an ink-based strategy straight from medieval manuscripts, where a rabbit’s bum can be deadlier than a dog's sword. Become a master of the Living Ink, build your own bestiary, defeat medieval superstars and collect perks to unleash hidden powers.

name: Captain!
short_description: You play as a pirate captain navigating the Caribbean to exploit all of its hidden plunder. As the captain, you can order those you command to do your dirty work for you, but don't be fooled you will have to take matters into your own hands from time to time.

name: Rat Cage
short_description: On a freezing blizzard night, a lone rat wandered into a suspicious building. Solve the mystery and escape from the terrifying building as quickly as possible.

name: ShiodomeTrainSimulator
short_description: A realistic fictional railcar driving game is now available! Please enjoy driving on the various types of lines, over 70 km long, multiple tracks, tunnels, and various scenery changes. Single-track sections and many other types of trains are scheduled to be available in the future.

name: Meet Ball Girls
short_description: Boys like to play ball, and they prefer to play with beautiful girls. . .

name: HYPERBLADE
short_description: HYPERBLADE is an instant-death, dashing-only slasher game full of blood and improvised badassery. Time manipulation and physics-based gameplay elements give the player a unique and challenging experience.

name: Awakened Evil
short_description: Awakened Evil is an action platformer inspired by the classics. Jump and slash your way through intense linear stages that will put your skills to the test. Do you have what it takes to slay all the bosses, and take on evil itself?

name: Amabilly
short_description: Amabilly is a lovely girl who loves rock 'n' roll, and this story is about her greatest adventure! With her favorite guitar as a weapon, she faces strange creatures and even the greatest of the challenges! It's time to Rock!

name: Minigame Game
short_description: Minigame Game is a first-person focused minigame collection that supports anywhere from 2-16 players.

name: Paperback Adventures
short_description: Combine word wizardry and superior strategy in this roguelike deckbuilding adventure. Craft a unique deck of letter cards throughout each journey, collect rewards from your victories, and each adventure unlocks new cards.

name: OPEN DOOR
short_description: A scientific experiment in which no one survives, in a first-person survival horror game made by one developer In the role of a random person who is trapped in an experiment, try to get out and find out what is happening in this abandoned place.

name: Space Escaper
short_description: It's a pixel art space shooter that has some other ways to help defeat enemies besides just shooting/bombing them directly. Different abilities to help you avoid damage or defeat enemies. You also can upgrade your aircraft to defeat powerful enemy.

name: Move Nature
short_description: Immerse yourself in the world of Move Nature. Discover hidden animals to solve relaxing 3D isometric puzzles as you manipulate the world by control the weather, scale and move nature.

name: Lawnmower Game: Find Trump
short_description: Lawnmower is back. Now your mission is to drive awesome lawnmower in big open world, collect items and finally find legendary Trump

name: Helvetii
short_description: Helvetii is a character-action game set in Gallic Celtic Mythology. Challenge the everchanging rot with 3 characters, use the gifts and powers bestowed by primal deities and show your mastery of combat by pummeling, juggling and slamming your enemies in a gorgeous 2d presentation.

name: WAR Card Game_uvr
short_description: WAR Card Game_uvr is a computer game version of the card game 'WAR' but with a medieval theme. Play at your own speed (fast or slow) with the auto-play feature! Save the game whenever you want and then load the game to continue playing later! Pause the game whenever you need to! The game talks!

name: Super Video Golf
short_description: Super Video Golf is a turn based 90s themed golf game, with up to 4 players locally or 4 computers online allowing a total of 16 players in a single game. Offline modes include a tutorial, CPU opponents, a driving range and a clubhouse with billiards games, such as pool and snooker.

name: Disgusting Puzzle 2
short_description: Disgusting Puzzle 2 is a puzzle game designed for persons over 18 years old. The game is very simple, you have to collect a picture, which consists of 20 elements. With successful assembly a button will appear with the transition to the next level.

name: The King's Dilemma: Chronicles
short_description: Lead the King’s Council for generations as the consequences of your decisions decide the kingdom’s resources and political standing. Form alliances, solve dilemmas, and prepare for the final uprising that was foretold by an ancient prophecy

name: DiggerSim - Excavator & Heavy Equipment Simulator VR
short_description: DiggerSim - Virtual reality Excavator & Heavy Equipment Simulator

name: The Cooking Class
short_description: Come Cook With Us! Let's learn together how to cook delicious meals for you and your family. Because remember, can't live with an empty belly! Find the right VHS scattered around the house through a random system of placement in order to find the code to escape the house. Good Luck!

name: Puzzle Bobble™2X/BUST-A-MOVE™2 Arcade Edition & Puzzle Bobble™3/BUST-A-MOVE™3 S-Tribute
short_description: In Puzzle Bobble 2X and Puzzle Bobble 3, shoot bubbles that pop when 3 or more of 1 color touch. Try standard mode, challenge mode, stage creation, and 1,026 player-made stages. Also play BUST-A-MOVE 2 Arcade Ed. and BUST-A-MOVE 3. New: rewind, slow mode, and quick save.

name: Rhythm Sprout: Sick Beats & Bad Sweets
short_description: Enjoy chill Lo-fi walks and fight bosses to K-POP, EDM and Hip-Hop inspired tracks. Features a quirky story, 30 handcrafted levels and various EX-modes to refresh your gameplay.

name: SEASON: A letter to the future
short_description: Leave home for the first time to collect memories before a mysterious cataclysm washes everything away. Ride, record, meet people, and unravel the strange world around you. Immerse yourself in the world of Season, a third-person meditative exploration game.

name: 8-Bit Adventures 2
short_description: 8-Bit Adventures 2 is everything you love about NES, SNES and PS1-era JRPGs - with all of the charm, heart and soul, but none of the inconvenience. Dynamic turn-based battles & pixels with personality!

name: The Killer
short_description: Dominic, an assassin is hired to kill a farmer who is fighting over land with a wealthy local man, in the middle of your mission someone notices something strange and calls the police, so Dominic must face the cops to get out of the place without getting caught.

name: Extreme Car Drift Simulator
short_description: If you want to drift wildly, this game is for you. With the drift game, you can have a great car driving simulation experience.

name: Fliese
short_description: 'Fliese' is a minimal logic puzzle game

name: Iron Sky: A Lunar Adventure
short_description: You find yourself on the Moon in a downed flying saucer wearing a cracked space-suit helmet, under the watchful eye of Obergruppenführer Gruber of the Fourth Reich. One thing is certain: you don't belong here.

name: Naturia
short_description: Discover nature and survive with what you can find in this environment.

name: Dungeon Shooter : Dark Temple
short_description: A retro style FPS & RPG game.

name: Button VR
short_description: Button VR is a game where the core idea is to press the button to progress to the next level with each new level having increasingly harder puzzles and new content to solve.

name: Fall and Destroy
short_description: Perhaps the craziest simulator of falls and destruction that you have seen! A variety of attractions, 'beaters' and physics settings on the levels will definitely not let you get bored.

name: Backfirewall_
short_description: Hello and welcome to Backfirewall_, a first-person tragicomic adventure set inside a smartphone. You are the update assistant. Solve wacky puzzles to counter the update and save the previous operating system from deletion. The fate of the System is in your hands!

name: SpongeBob SquarePants: The Cosmic Shake
short_description: Wish-granting Mermaid’s Tears in the hands of SpongeBob and Patrick… What could go wrong? Sure, the very fabric holding the universe together could come undone, opening portals into wild Wishworlds. But that’s nothing our favorite sponge can’t handle- with the right cosmic costume!

name: The Trasamire Campaigns
short_description: The King is dead. The war for his Kingdom has begun. Become one of Trasamire's legendary founders and explore their bid for the throne in this colorful strategy puzzler.

name: Guacomole
short_description: GUACOMOLE is a classic arcade shooter with a twist... Survive endless waves of chip enemies with only one bullet. A seamless cross between classics such as Pong and Asteroids. Enjoy a challenging and strategical experience that will leave you hungry for more!

name: 回响之战
short_description: The War of Echoes is a card game with magic themes. It has a traditional strategy of collecting card games. At the same time, the fighting mode of the game is an innovative fighting mechanism developed by combining the traditional card playing mechanism with automatic fighting.

name: Truck Simulator Ultimate 3D
short_description: Complete all truck game missions as a good truck driver in the city.

name: PHANOTIA I: ESCAVIVE
short_description: 'Phanotia I: Escavive' is an ARPG game using pixel style. Players will play the role of 'Connecticut' to find rescue in the wilderness and make the Mobile Fortress 'Oslou' out of danger.

name: Spelp
short_description: The SPELP program needs YOU to annihilate thousands of aliens with a variety of weapons, members and unique capacities. Unlock characters and make up your own team to fit your playstyle.

name: Kitten Hero
short_description: Kitten Hero is a fast-paced, action platformer were you play as a litle cat (very cute by the way), trying to rescue his friend from a evil artificial intelligence.

name: Crossroad of Worlds: Mystery Agency Collector's Edition
short_description: It's time for another adventure! Immerse yourself in an amazing world of puzzles and riddles! Become a detective, solve cases and help people all over the multiverse!

name: Methods: The Canada Files
short_description: Methods: The Canada Files is a mystery visual novel set three years before the events of Methods. In the last few stages of the Canadian detective competition, Detective Larika Downs is determined to discover the truth at all costs!

name: The Helper
short_description: The Helper is a fast-moving, energetic, fun and madness-packed 2D video game that allows you to play as “The Helper” (hence the name, duh!), a lad that helps The Professor by gathering Gravity Crystals for his secret experiment.

name: Alien Slayers
short_description: Alien Slayers is a roguelite time survival game where you hunt down hostile alien creatures on various planets. Grab your weapon and survive to the end to become the strongest alien.

name: Mighty Mage
short_description: Mighty Mage is a top-down arena shooter rogue-lite where you play a cute mage wielding up to 5 elemental spells at a time to fight off hordes of enemies. Choose from a variety of upgrades and spells to create unique builds.

name: Stream Runners: Heroes
short_description: Stream Runners: Heroes is a retro style idle game for live streamers to play with their viewers on Twitch. Players can add Runners to the game to fight enemies, earn points, and defeat bosses. There are many ways to use this game with your community, it's all up to you and your chat!

name: The Symbiant
short_description: The Symbiant is a BL / Yaoi / Gay visual novel about two men, both from vastly different worlds, embracing their sexuality and their newfound romance. It is also a tale of interstellar friendship and being gay in space!

name: Knockback Knockout
short_description: KNOCKBACK KNOCKOUT is a 2D online party game for 2-6 players.

name: Duplicado
short_description: Duplicado is a unique, procedurally-generated puzzle game that is both meditative and challenging. Journey across a peaceful avocado orchard, planting trees as you slide and solve your way through a nearly endless number of stimulating puzzles.

name: Delirium
short_description: Solve puzzles and explore Lola and Danny's delirious house.

name: Knight Solitaire 2
short_description: The time has come to go on incredible new adventures in a new Knight Solitaire 2!

name: Dungeons and Myths 2
short_description: 'Dungeons and Myths 2' is a 2D tower defence game with a roguelike element. Place traps and monsters to defend your dungeon, pick upgrade after every wave of enemies! New enemies and new defence tactics!

name: EL NE RUE
short_description: EL NE RUE is a very simple game created with Pixel art.

name: Second Front
short_description: Second Front is a tactical WWII turn-based strategy game. Craft & share your own scenarios and maps or use your strategic prowess in 48 scenarios set in iconic locations. Command over 40 types of infantry and 216 tanks, vehicles and guns. An infinite tactical sandbox experience.

name: Mullet Hell
short_description: Blast your way through hair curling enemies to prove you are worthy of the mullet! Mullet Hell is a casual rogue-like, reverse bullet hell where you must fend off foes who seek to remove your luscious locks from your head.

name: Back Rank Chess
short_description: Do you like the Endgame in chess? Here's a brand new chess variant! Defend the back rank against the onslaught of enemy pawns. Easy to learn , advanced artificial intelligence , 66 hand-crafted stages.

name: Deliver Us Mars
short_description: Deliver Us Mars is an atmospheric sci-fi adventure taking you on a suspense-fuelled, high-stakes mission to recover the ARK colony ships stolen by the mysterious Outward.

name: Battle of 2048 - Fantasy Edition
short_description: Join Prince Olwyn on a quest to save his kingdom. Fierce warrior, stealthy rogue, powerful mage and skilled cleric will join your party as you fight enemies and strive for victory in this new take on the classic 2048. Can you and your team emerge triumphant and restore peace to the realm?

name: Tell Some Story: Foz
short_description: Action-adventure + Third person shooter. The year is 2042, the near future, the gloomy world of cyberpunk will offer you the role of detective Foz. Random circumstances drag the hero into a showdown between gangs and corporations, where he has to make a choice on whose side he is.

name: Cleaning Queens
short_description: House cleaning has never been more fun - just relax and clean now!

name: UnderBackrooms
short_description: UnderBackrooms is a cooperative horror game set in a mysterious parallel universe of empty rooms and endless corridors. With moments of tension and surprise, players must be on guard to survive. Explore the backrooms and uncover their secrets to escape this nightmare world.

name: Project Nosferatu
short_description: A fast-paced Action RPG with a fully customizable arsenal combo battle system. Varied landscapes of an interconnected world bring unique dangers in each area, which tie together a complex story about the mystery of the nocturnal, subterranean species known as 'Umbrakhs.'

name: DEFECTIVE
short_description: DEFECTIVE는 퍼즐 요소가 가미된 단편 어드벤처 게임입니다. 고철 폐기장에서 깨어난 간호 로봇 '온누리-480'은 길 잃은 소녀 '설'을 부모님에게 데려다 주어야 합니다.

name: The You Testament: The 2D Coming
short_description: This 2D remake of the biblical epic puts YOU on the scene of each story, where you can either repeat history or rewrite it! Follow in the footsteps of a prophet as he seeks to enlighten the masses, and find your place among them as the struggle to survive tests your faith...

name: Fallen Hero: Retribution
short_description: So you're a villain now? Let's see if you survive the experience.

name: Tails: The Backbone Preludes
short_description: Tails: The Backbone Preludes is a post-noir narrative adventure with branching choices. It is an intertwined series of vignettes about change, circumstance, and consequence. Guide four characters through formative moments in their lives in a dystopian Vancouver inhabited by anthropomorphic animals.

name: Your Only Move Is HUSTLE
short_description: Master your technique, execute flashy combos, and outsmart opponents across the world, frame-by-frame. Slow down the clock to fine-tune your fighting style in this innovative, turn-based combat simulator. Pulverize your friends and choreograph spectacular fight scenes. No training mode required.

name: Towers Deck
short_description: Towers Deck welcomes all heroes who are ready to defend the castle. Construct towers, use spells, build deck and get ready for enemy attacks. Strategize towers placements, unlock new technologies and become the best!

name: Undisputed
short_description: Become Undisputed in the most authentic boxing game to date! Featuring true to life visuals, bone-jarring action, and more licensed boxers than ever before, Undisputed gives you unprecedented control to master every inch of the ring.

name: Nuclear War Simulator
short_description: Nuclear war simulator is a detailed realistic simulation and visualization of large-scale nuclear conflicts with a focus on humanitarian consequences. It lets you design conflict scenarios and estimate the consequences using a population density map and realistic weapons effects.

name: The Adventures of LinShanHai
short_description: 林山海是一个性格孤僻但头脑冷静具有敏锐观察力和推理能力的刑警，擅长破获棘手和离奇的案件。九十年代，这位传奇警探侦破了一系列重大案件，这些案件将以一个一个的小品的形式呈上，并汇总为林山海探案集。

name: Winnie The Pooh: The Serial Killer
short_description: Winnie The Pooh: The Serial Killer is a Third Person Shooter where your goal is to use a stealthy approach and kill as many civilians as possible or hostile approach and kill as many police as possible before the time runs out.

name: SATUS
short_description: SATUS - global fantasy strategy, in which you can lead one of the 4 fractions: magicians, dwarfs, dark side, hell virus. Every fraction is unique. Capture all the enemies, arrange the end of the world, build a great empire!

name: Beaver Clicker
short_description: Beaver Clicker is an idle game where you collects logs, then using these logs, you can acquire all sorts of sources for these logs, like convincing squirrels, sponsoring school field-trips, or even taming the fungi found in nature itself to help you in your wood collecting journey.

name: Daily Dadish
short_description: It’s an adventure that lasts a whole year! Daily Dadish is a retro platformer that features over 365 handcrafted levels - one for every day of the year! Face challenging foes, unlock cool characters, and help reunite Dadish with his missing kids all over again!

name: Otome Legends
short_description: A visual novel where the routes are not routes, the endings are not endings, and your choices are not real choices.

name: TROJAN
short_description: Trojan is a stealth game in which you have to extract a file from a damaged system. Sneak through the levels and avoid enemy attacks to get the file and finish the level.

name: Sonic Colors: Ultimate
short_description: Join Sonic in the high-speed adventure of a lifetime across a colorful interstellar amusement park. Color the Universe in Sonic Colors: Ultimate!

name: The Fairy's Secret
short_description: In this sequel to the fantasy yuri visual novel, The Fairy's Song, Marnie and Lisbeth return to Fenchapel to visit Marnie’s grandmother. Things soon become complicated, however, when they run into two figures from the past who ought to be dead.

name: Broken Blade: Prelude
short_description: Broken Blade: Prelude(프렐류드)는 판타지풍의 시뮬레이션 롤플레잉 게임입니다. 당신은 세계의 운명을 지켜보는 '관찰자'가 되어, 제국의 황녀였던 카모밀레와 그 동료들의 앞을 막아서는 시련을 헤쳐나가기 위해 함께 노력해야 합니다.

name: Madorica Real Estate 2 - The mystery of the new property -
short_description: The note-taking, floor-plan based real estate mystery game is back and bigger than ever, with even more puzzles to solve!In this game, visit properties and solve puzzles by noting down information and clues on a printed floor plan.

name: OUTSTAND
short_description: OUTSTAND is a game that reflects the real face of dark and intense fear to the person from a first-person camera angle. Your treasure-seeking friend is trapped! Can you save him? Solve puzzles, watch out for the items around you and most importantly survive!

name: Drawing From Memory
short_description: Drawing from Memory is an online party game where you and 2-4 friends try to figure out what your most and least favorite characters look like by Drawing them from Memory.

name: Pigskin Punter!
short_description: Cute and silly arcade game about punting pigskins! Indie developer looking for feedback! Can you beat the game?

name: Chess Defense Saga
short_description: A chess-themed tower defense game with unique strategies, stories, and illustrations!

name: 一个人的木偶剧
short_description: 一场木偶剧马上就要开演了。你是观众，同时也是演员。 请将演出进行下去，获得一个完美的谢幕—— 什么，你说还没看过剧本？ 不好意思，现在已经开演了，请你即兴发挥吧。 参演过程中请注意保护自己，不要受伤。

name: Wipe Factor
short_description: Wipe Factor is a multiplayer party game where you and other contestants compete as a team to overcome various physical obstacles and parkour chaos until one team wins!

name: 高考夺魁记
short_description: 高考+卡牌+rougelike+美少女=？？？。浩如烟海的知识牌库，种类繁多的构筑方案，变幻莫测的随机事件……在平行时空与各个角色相遇，去创造你的史诗传记吧！

name: Minibots TD
short_description: It’s defense time! Arrange your forces against the invading Robotic tribe called the Kaids. Choose your arsenal and place them wisely for excellent road defense. Prove your defenses against challenging enemies.

name: Don't Starve
short_description: Don’t Starve is an uncompromising wilderness survival game full of science and magic. Enter a strange and unexplored world full of strange creatures, dangers, and surprises. Gather resources to craft items and structures that match your survival style.

name: Dark spell
short_description: 通过猎杀不断增生的克苏鲁魔物！获得信仰值，升级武器，选择你的专属职业， 策略组合，一把20分钟的肉鸽体验，直接射爆刷爆爽爆！！你还可以选择关卡模式！

name: Hogwarts Legacy
short_description: Hogwarts Legacy is an immersive, open-world action RPG. Now you can take control of the action and be at the center of your own adventure in the wizarding world.

name: Midnight Scenes: From the Woods
short_description: Disturbing incidents begin happening after the arrival of a new patient at Fernwood Creek Mental Health Center. Welcome to a new dimension of horror. Welcome to Midnight Scenes.

name: Tower Walker: MMO Grind Simulator
short_description: Tower Walker is a fresh new addictive auto-grinder rich with features, inspired by classic MMORPGS and RTS games with indirect control over your hero. The mysterious tower awaits!

name: Yggdra Union
short_description: In order to recapture her homeland, Yggdra gathers her allies and confronts the empire. 'Yggdra Union' is a tactics RPG that features three elements: the 'Union System', in which players team up with her allies to launch attacks, the exhilarating 'Clash' through army battles, and the 'Tactics Card'.

name: Fight & Crush
short_description: How about a rematch?

name: Death Trials (Director's Cut)
short_description: An action horror game about scientific trials gone wrong! Run and hide or FIGHT your way to escape. Plenty of jump-scares and perfect for streaming!

name: BETA-SIXDOUZE
short_description: A gargantuan rose looms in the night sky, poised to strike at any moment. Enter Yosuke, a combat pilot on an unlikely mission: to take to the stars with the mysterious Hanaco and contain Earth's greatest threat! But will this mismatched duo find common ground in time? And who is Hanaco, really...?

name: Asian Food Cart Tycoon
short_description: Grow your satay business and become the most successful satay entrepreneur in the world!

name: Detective Super Star
short_description: Join the famous Detective Doyle to solve a series of murder cases in this captivating hidden object, adventure game.

name: Garbage Truck Simulator
short_description: The compactor is hungry! 3D simulation game with authentic trucks and realtime destruction physics. Fill the compactor with garbage and keep pressing the button until everything has been smashed. Drive the truck from one stop to the next and collect every pile of garbage from the streets.

name: Balloon Man
short_description: Action, Puzzle, Soulslike, Platform

name: Lockes The Thief
short_description: A talented thief is summoned to sabotage a sinister plot devised by his own tribe.

name: Under the Sky World~Another~
short_description: 'Under the Sky World' is another story of IF.If KARIN in the main plot infected with [virus], so on the wrong path of words ......This is a small story about KARIN 'if' -

name: Sunrider 4: The Captain's Return
short_description: Captain Kayto Shields returns from exile in Sunrider 4: The Captain’s Return for a new space adventure!

name: Full Moon Kit
short_description: Let's relax and get some refreshment with the cute animals in ‘Full Moon Kit’. Collect more than 90+ free-moving animals and enjoy a cool swim with fountains and bang jumps. Enjoy the beautiful scenery. This is the invitation to the peaceful pool and mysterious world of healing for you.

name: Girl Fantasy
short_description: 'Girl Fantasy' is a visual novel with a theme of youth. It tells the love story of the woman who went to play with the man during the summer vacation and stayed at the man's house, then moved the man with 'sincerity' step by step, and finally stayed with the man.

name: F1 Crazy Stunts
short_description: Have you ever imagined doing stunts with a formula 1 car? Welcome to the parallel universe!

name: Multiplayer Werewolves
short_description: Multiplayer Werewolves - You and Your Team are the last remaining Humans on Earth. Can You Survive ?

name: Army War: Shooting Simulator
short_description: You must take back the previously captured base in this military war game. As a commander, you must complete all challenging missions.

name: Scorchlands
short_description: The gears of the economy are oiled with magic. Build colonies, connect them with lasers, discover new tech and terraform a hostile moon. Enchanted items will be useful when encountering monsters, but magic tools are not just flashy weapons. They are the fuel which makes wealth and resources flow.

name: Jigsaw Puzzle Lovers
short_description: Puzzle lovers rejoice!

name: Bumblebee - Little Bee Adventure
short_description: Bumblebee – Little Bee Adventure is a story-driven, narrative 3D flight exploration game in which you control a little bee on its journey to find a new home. On its quest to find a beautiful and fitting it discovers distant places, friendly and calm animals, and amazing and dangerously habitats.

name: Street Lords
short_description: Procedurally-generated gang warfare meets turn-based strategy and FPS action to deliver an immersive, brutal, endlessly-replayable strategic-shooter - generate your city, customise your gangs, and fight in first person on bloody urban battlefields.

name: Berry Madness
short_description: In Berry Madness you need to find all the berries in the world to beat the game. Berry Madness takes place in beatiful world. You need to find all the berries to become a champion berry hunter.

name: House of the Soul
short_description: Begin a journey of deception and discovery in 'HOUSE OF THE SOUL', a first-person exploration and story based experience. Explore an isolated mansion and descend into its lower levels as you discover the hidden secret project of the obsessive inventor who lives there.

name: Fingers' Dating
short_description: It's the happiest thing to do on a date with a girl, but maybe it's just you tonight.

name: Spikair Volleyball
short_description: Control the 4 players of your volleyball team. Recruit players, train them and win tournaments to become the best volleyball club.

name: Phoenix Nightmare
short_description: Step into inmersive horror experience in the desert of Arizona. Your car broke down after traveling miles. A few meters away is a suspicious abandoned gas station. Crazy kidnapper is on the loose! Search and find ways to escape and survive collecting stuff, shooting guns and solving puzzles

name: The Utility Room
short_description: This VR Journey takes you to the 'behind the scenes' of the Universe. Beyond a door lies a barren landscape inhabited by strange rocky heads. Here, the maintenance and heavy lifting required keeps existence stable and temporal. You are a tourist. Don't do anything foolish.

name: Mystic Gate
short_description: A Mystic Gate created by the gods suddenly appears in the human world. Adventurers challenge themselves with the tests that await them beyond the gate. In order to earn your wish you must defeat hordes & bosses in this roguelike dungeon exploration bullet hell!!

name: Idlenetics
short_description: Exciting idle tycoon game that immerses you in a beautiful medieval world. The game features a hex-based map that is divided into different zones, each of which is unlocked as the player progresses through the game.

name: The Cursed Knight
short_description: The Cursed Knight is an action / platform / shoot‘em up game, based on a « die and retry » style and made with love and passion to pay tribute to the games made in the 90s.

name: Taxi Driver Simulator: Car Parking
short_description: Become a good taxi driver in the city and complete the car parking mission.

name: Vampire Slayer: The Resurrection
short_description: Vampire Slayer is a fast paced multiplayer fps featuring two completely different teams, Vampires and Slayers.

name: The Maiden, the Butler, and the Witch
short_description: Irina must leave home and complete her pilgrimage to become a full-fledged witch. However, the Demon Lord has built a castle on the island and summoned monsters threatening its citizens and her coming-of-age journey.

name: The Tales of Bayun
short_description: Can a flat world resting on the backs of three demon bears live in peace? Of course not! Immerse yourself in the universe of the dark Slavic legends, explore the characters' stories and make difficult choices that affect the course of events. Bayun the Cat will help you. If you're lucky, that is.

name: Gomorrah
short_description: A dark and suspenseful narrative RPG about an Italian mafia family, where morality is tested with every branching decision.

name: Starway: BaRaider
short_description: This is a sci-fi VR action shooting game. Mechanical frenzy is coming! Players have to teleport to survive from thousands of bullets.

name: Returnal™
short_description: BREAK THE CYCLE Fight to survive as this award-winning third-person shooter brings Selene’s story to PC. Take on roguelike challenges. Engage enemies in bullet hell-fuelled clashes. Share your journey through Returnal™ with another player.

name: Beef Jerky
short_description: A gritty, short-form narrative experience about a young man who lives with his sickly older sister. Struggling to support the both of them, he comes home from work one day to find something strange at his front door...

name: Inky & Blinky
short_description: Join Inky & Blinky and all their friends in this addictive little puzzle game where your goal is to get Blinky back to Inky.

name: Last Order
short_description: Last Order is a 2D action game with pixel art style. To recover the 'Last Order' in devastated world, you'll use a variety of wire actions.

name: Pharaoh: A New Era
short_description: The legendary city-builder returns. Lead the creation of one of the greatest civilizations the world has ever seen in this 4K remake with modernized UI. Build monuments, manage your population through hundred of hours of gameplay and explore 4,000 years of history through more than 50 missions.

name: Twin Cobra
short_description: Blast battalions of tanks into smoking craters and conquer air and sea from the sky's fastest attack chopper! Toaplan's coin-op shooter Twin Cobra flies to PC with fresh features and quality-of-life updates!

name: EVIL BELOW™
short_description: Take the role of a mother searching for her child in a mysterious world filled with dark creatures blinded by faith and greed. Prepare to run, hide, kill and survive.

name: Loretta
short_description: Loretta is a psychological thriller that makes the player an accessory to the heroine’s crimes, leading her through a self-crafted nightmare. Loretta’s story revolves around a woman handling betrayal, her husband’s infidelity, and reclaiming her agency during the socially tumultuous 1940s.

name: Blue Fish Yokohama
short_description: Blue Fish Yokohama is a relaxing tile-based puzzle game. You are a fish that eats miso ramen, cheese ramen and tantanmen by jumping, bumping, bouncing and splashing through a Japanese restaurant. Solve 50 handcrafted levels with unique game mechanics.

name: Plains of Pain
short_description: Survival multiplayer post-apocalyptic game. Feel the final end of the world, where hope has died. Explore the autonomous post-apocalyptic multiplayer open world and try to survive in these Plains of Pain.

name: Elemental Adventure
short_description: Embark on an action packed adventure! Elemental Adventure is a fast paced build-oriented ARPG. Featuring 8 distinct classes each with 12 unique skills, all with their own progression trees. Craft powerful gems to further customize endless possible combinations and face the ultimate challenge!

name: 天下霸圖
short_description: 經典武俠經營策略遊戲《天下霸圖》，結合門派經營、弟子養成及戰略元素，玩家可扮演武當、峨嵋、丐幫、魔教…等12種各具特色及獨門武學的掌門人，招收弟子因材施教、採集資源煉丹練功、擴大地盤設立分舵，不論是消滅其它門派一統江湖，或以聲望讓各派歸順，都能享受成為一代武林霸主的快感！

name: Terrarium Builder
short_description: Build as many terrariums as you like, enjoying lo-fi peaceful and relaxing music. Sculpt the terrain, choose plants and decorations, and finally take pictures to share with everyone.

name: WILD HEARTS™
short_description: Master ancient tech to hunt down giant beasts.

name: It Returned To The Desert
short_description: Unique mix of turn-based tactics and adventure game. Defend the town of Glint Rock against radioactive giant ants! Convince the townsfolk to join your party in a non-linear campaign with high replay value. Discover all the little secrets and stories in the lively town of Glint Rock.

name: Meme Quiz
short_description: Meme quiz – a quiz type game about modern meme culture. Can you become a Meme Master?

name: Gigantosaurus: Dino Kart
short_description: Race around Cretacia as your favorite dino in a prehistoric kart championship almost as big as Gigantosaurus’s appetite!

name: The Lone Alien
short_description: This is a story about an alien who had a shipwreck on a planet where people lived and now he needs to figure out how he can leave this planet.After all, people's technologies are far behind those that he has on the planet.

name: HELLCARD
short_description: Hellcard is a unique cooperative deck builder rogue-like game. Descend into the paper dungeons on your own, recruit computer-controlled companions or join other players' lobbies in fast-paced tactical card battles against the armies of darkness and the Archdemon himself!

name: Castle Destroyers
short_description: Gather resources, build, power up and battle. Choose between two different teams in Castle Destroyers, build your castle with your teammates and attack the enemy. No stopping until you destroy the other side!

name: Zero-G Gunfight
short_description: WWIII has ended in total annihilation but the battle continues in outer space. Challenge 1-3 friends in the fast-paced & frantic arenas of Zero-G Gunfight. Pickup different guns that change how you move & fight. Dodge enemy bullets & avoid unique hazards as you strive to be the last one standing!

name: Crime Passional
short_description: You thought that after leaving that abusive relationship, your life would slowly start to improve, but a cold night in early 2006, the nightmare returned. Your ex-boyfriend came back and wants to take you with him, by force if necessary.

name: Blanc
short_description: Blanc is an artistic cooperative adventure that follows the journey of a wolf cub and a fawn stranded in a vast, snowy wilderness. They must come together in an unlikely partnership to find their families.

name: GameDev LiTuber Simulator
short_description: 3D Simulation game to become a GameDev as well as a YouTuber with waifus

name: Tower Skydiver
short_description: A fast paced skydiving adventure game through different worlds, dodge objects, fight bosses and find your way through mazes to get to the end of the stages.

name: Parasomnia
short_description: Where to run? Where to go? You can't stop, the horror is close!

name: See You Later
short_description: There are so many things I want to do with the rest of my life. Like dreaming with you, laze around with you, look at the moon, eat rice with you, go on the biggest wedding trip to Antarctica, and most importantly - say goodbye to you.

name: Zellige: The Tilemaker of Granada
short_description: Zellige : The Tilemaker of Granada is a meditative and relaxing historical game, set in medieval Al-Andalus, where you play as a skilled tilemaker and design intricate Islamic mosaic patterns to decorate a merchant family's palace. Let your creativity flow and create beautiful patterns !

name: De Feet
short_description: De Feet is a first-person role-playing game, set partly in a medieval fantasy world and partly in modern times. The player controls the character Ricky in a switchable first-person and third-person perspective. Combat is reminiscent of a first-person shooter.

name: Plan B: Terraform
short_description: Terraform a lifeless rock into a lush and habitable world. Build trucks, trains and sprawling factories on an enormous hexagonal planet. Grow its population to millions. Enjoy a dynamic simulation of atmosphere, temperature, water and forests.

name: Broombot Battlegrounds
short_description: Battle to the death as adorable household cleaning robots in this frantic physics-based arena combat game! Compete in 1-4 player cage matches with your friends (or enemies) to be the meanest clean-machine of them all!

name: PRIMITIVE HEARTS
short_description: A voice calls out and four heroes hear its call. Can they rise to the challenge? Or will the Empire capture the land's Crystals and achieve their evil goals?

name: Anyone There?
short_description: 'Anyone there ?' is a first-person horror game. You are investigating a school where a Creature has been released. Scan the clues and find out his identity before he finds you.

name: DR LIVESEY ROM AND DEATH EDITION
short_description: DR LIVESEY: AHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHHA, gentlemen, from now on, rom and death means the same thing for you.

name: The end is nahual: If I may say so
short_description: It's sometimes a point-and-click adventure about nothing, it's sometime chaos... Get to the end...

name: Hardwar
short_description: You’re now an Operative, a free agent and a speculator in the claustrophobic terminally ill city of (Misplaced) Optimism, the last crater cluster on barren mined-out Titan.

name: Merchant of Bohemia
short_description: Fast-paced trade simulation game with RPG elements. Choose your character, buy goods and wander around the medieval Bohemia to make profit. Don't forget to recruit some manpower to keep you safe along the way!

name: Golden Gloves VR
short_description: Golden Gloves VR Boxing Game (Officially Licensed)

name: I WILL BE THERE
short_description: No trip is alike! I WILL BE THERE is the love story of a lonely man with an RV in a zombie-infested world. It is a unique 'Survival-Adventure' game with visual novel aestethics and role-playing elements.

name: Truxton
short_description: The ruthless Gidans invite you to an explosive space scramble! Head into the mighty Super Fighter and disintegrate your foes in all directions with various upgradeable weapons. Toaplan's no-frills vertical shooter Truxton speeds onto PC with new features and quality-of-life updates!

name: Going Deep
short_description: Going Deep is a game played with a third-person view. Going Deep contains action and horror genres. using different materials you can craft/upgrade weapons, armors, knives, pouches, ammos and more

name: IBIS AM
short_description: All I want you to do is catch fish and search for others who seem hungry. You are only a bird.

name: Karagon (Survival Robot Riding FPS)
short_description: Survive, shoot, construct, and ride killer elemental robots. Craft equipment, explore multi-floor buildings, build and farm, uncover schematics, and progress through technology tiers. Alone or with friends in this brutal post apocalyptic open world survival robot riding crafting shooter game!

name: FFF
short_description: FFF is a funny game about friendship, family, and fun. You are a newly elected space emperor, and your goal is to make everyone your friend. Even if they don't want to be. You will travel through the vast expanse of space, spreading your kindness to anyone.

name: Dust & Neon
short_description: Dust & Neon pits a single cowboy against an army of robots in this fast-paced, roguelite action twin-stick shooter, set in a futuristic Wild West.

name: Mortal Meal
short_description: Play as an untethered spirit, collecting fragments of your past while fleeing a cryptic force looking to consume your soul. Explore and survive an increasingly nightmarish world. Who are you? How will you avoid the harvest of your soul? What will you uncover with the time you have left?

name: Police Car Armored: Cop Simulator
short_description: If you like police games, this police car driving simulator is for you.

name: Stardust Exile
short_description: Stardust Exile is a MMORTS set in the Milky Way galaxy, containing currently known stars and exoplanets with their real characteristics. The remaining star systems are procedurally generated based on currently known data. You can create your own ship designs with an in-game ship generator.

name: Baldy Bounce
short_description: Baldy Bounce is a relaxing 3D platforming adventure game with collectables, mini-games, character customisation, and much more.

name: Little Land War SRPG
short_description: Turn-based, Fantasy Strategy RPG (SRPG). With a simple UI, you can play lightly. Various battlefields await you: plain, mountain, lake, volcanoe, labyrinth, castle. Each character grows in battle. Recruit ancient tribes and defeat enemy soldiers and monsters.

name: Aircraft Infinity
short_description: We present you a fun simulation game in which you pilot an aircraft and have the mission to destroy parts of a large asteroid that has broken into millions of pieces and is heading towards Earth.

name: Neon Blast
short_description: Neon Blast - A head-scratching puzzle game

name: The Sea of Death
short_description: The Sea of Death is a mystery puzzle adventure in which the story revolves around the people and experiences that the protagonist, who has lost his memory due to an accident, meets in the process of regaining his memory.

name: Knights of Braveland
short_description: Knights of Braveland is a cooperative beat'em up action game with a generated story. You will hack, slash, and smash your way to victory. And with your friends it is much more fun. Play local or online.

name: Animal Kingdom
short_description: Welcome to Animal Kingdom, a hidden animal game where you collect pawprints, cameras and coins while searching animals in fantastic locations! With 3 game modes and trivias between the chapters, Animal Kingdom will provide hours of fun for Hidden Object fans in surreal settings!

name: Rooftop Renegade
short_description: Power up your hoverblades in this speedrunning platformer! Weave through futuristic cities making split second pathing decisions. Boost through constant bombardment and dangerous hazards. Go it alone or bring up to 3 friends for local multiplayer mayhem.

name: Rise of Fox Hero
short_description: Rise of Fox Hero is a colorful 3D platformer with fun combat and puzzle elements. Armed with a sword and a shield, jump and fight your way through beautiful and colorful levels.

name: Lucie's Potager
short_description: Farm and sell exotic plants with Lucie in this shopkeeping RPG!

name: Souls of Chronos
short_description: The Apocalypse shattered a world in disarray. Facing his impending death, a young boy named Sid crossed paths with Torii, a girl who feeds on the energy of time. In the harbour town of Astella, a mysterious adventure is about to unfold along with the investigation of an unusual crime...

name: Book of Shadows
short_description: In the 1000 years after the Battle of the Holy Demon, the Book of Shadows suddenly appeared on the mainland. It is said that people have the power to rule the country if they get it. So the major sects and organizations participated in the competition for this book.

name: Tofas Sahin: Online Car Driving
short_description: Drift in the city with the multiplayer tofas sahin game.

name: Destinesia
short_description: Destinesia is a sci-fi metroidvania which you are looking for a new home for humanity. Parkour your way through most dangerous jungles and explore the ancient dungeons. Upgrade your suit with the remains of your ancestors. Reveal the oldest secrets of Homo Sapiens.

name: Terix Survivors
short_description: Mow down thousands of Monsters and survive until dawn! Terix Survivors is a gothic horror casual game With Many Visible Powers . That Help You To Fight where your Character choices can allow you to quickly snowball against the hundreds of monsters that get thrown at Are you a Hero or a Noob! Show Us

name: 連縁无現里 ~ Misremembered Memories
short_description: A retro styled Len'en fangame inspired by the Japanese PC-98 Touhou Project games. Enjoy a nostalgic shoot-'em-up experience with faithful graphics and music without the hang-ups of outdated hardware.

name: Anime vs Evil: Apocalypse
short_description: Defeat evil forces together with those cute anime girls!

name: District Steel
short_description: District Steel is a full locomotion VR action game, inspired by the FPS classics. Blast your way through the underground SenTRI facility, equipped with a mechanical arm that gives time bending powers and a selection of deadly weapons.

name: Elderand
short_description: Only the strong will conquer this gruesome action platformer with RPG elements. Dismember demonic creatures and terrifying bosses by wielding brutal weapons in intense skill-based combat. Slay or be slain as you collect glory and treasure in this nightmarish 2D world.

name: The Last Pawn
short_description: The Last Pawn is a shooter platformer where you play as the last hope of your kingdom. In your journey across the land, you will find yourself dealing with multiple enemy types, boss battles and 21 different levels.

name: Wild West Dynasty
short_description: Cowboys, Settlers & Gunslingers! Build your own ranch, grow it into a settlement and soon more settlers will join you in your quest for happiness and prosperity. Will you manage to build a ‘Wild West Dynasty’ or will you end up on the gallows?

name: Out Zone
short_description: Blast through alien hordes as the finest cyborg mercenary in existence! To emerge victorious, you'll need to manage time and resources skillfully. Toaplan's run-and-gun smash-hit finally arrives on PC, reloaded with new features and quality-of-life extras!

name: Base Jump
short_description: Base Jump is a fast-paced competitive action platformer available for one or two players locally.

name: Angel's Gear
short_description: Angel's Gear is a challenging horror-flavored Metroidvania set in a world tainted by a mechanical disease.

name: Alien on the Radar
short_description: Multiplayer game of hiding and seeking, also with bots. Become an alien and use stealth to deceive others, or a marine and survive long enough to escape.

name: OVE : The Sword of Liberation
short_description: It is an action-adventure game that deals with the journey of Elia, a girl of fate, to free Ella from the tower.

name: Sorry We're Open
short_description: Sorry, We're Open is a Supermarket Management Horror RPG. As the new Manager of your local supermarket, you'll need to make the hard decisions to keep the store running. Remember, your store's reputation and your employees' livelihoods are in your hands.

name: Real Zombie War Simulator
short_description: Destroy all zombies with sniper or other gun in this zombie game.

name: Zombie Apocalypse - The Last Fortress
short_description: Defend your base against hordes of zombies while using a variety of weapons, vehicles, explosives, soldiers and turrets in this survival tower defense game. Will you be able to create your own strategy and survive for 30 days?

name: DESTROY Simulator VR
short_description: Destroy houses and relieve stress, now in VR!! It is also possible to compete with everyone in the score challenge

name: Noobs Want to Live
short_description: Noobs Want to Live is a fast-paced roguelike featuring several characters and a large pool of skills to choose from (that synergize with one another, too!) Fight, kill, grow. Each run is a new chance to create a steamrolling build!

name: Interkosmos 2000
short_description: Go to space. Save the Future. Try not to Die. Welcome (back) to the world of Interkosmos for an even wilder, weirder and more wondrous adventure.

name: Fantasy World Souls
short_description: What if we animate all the RPG Maker sprites and put them in an MMO, and it's still monster breeding style? This is the purpose of this game.

name: Mind The Pipes!
short_description: Equipped with a highly advanced protective suit, the nameless hero in 'Mind The Pipes!' embarks on a dangerous journey to prevent the bankruptcy of his employer. Concentration and quick thinking are essential for survival in this game!

name: TitTok Kitty
short_description: TitTok Kitty - cute and kind puzzles with Cats. 50 unique puzzles! The goal of the player is to build pictures consisting of different elements. Three puzzle formats and three difficulty levels: Easy, Normal, Difficult! TikTok ≠ TitTok

name: Hydrofoil Generation
short_description: Hydrofoil Generation is a realistic sailing and foiling simulator. An exciting and accurate first-person simulation of multiplayer 'in-shore' regattas. Put your skills and heart to the test!

name: JOIN tiles - Anatolian game to play
short_description: JOIN tiles - Anatolian game to play is a puzzle game whose aim is to combine broken tiles. Our game, which offers a pleasant and fluent gameplay, contains the works of Anatolian Tile art of hundreds of years.

name: Dream Fight Will
short_description: This is an exciting and interesting action adventure game. You can control monsters to fight. The game includes single-person adventure, single-person Roguelike, or 2-person duel, 5-person team adventure, 5V5 camp battle, and 20-person chaos fight!

name: The Future Radio and the Artificial Pigeons
short_description: 2061, Japan. Mankind has lost the sky, and with it, its connections. All of it was taken away by birds... ...By countless artificial pigeons flying through the sky.

name: Zen Paint
short_description: A peaceful color-by-numbers game set on a hexagonal grid. Play at your own pace and relax while you complete a variety of levels with differing themes, sizes and complexities.

name: Bolt Bot Screwy Viruses
short_description: Take control of a robot named Bolt in over 50 levels of 3D platforming fun inspired by classic platform games. It is a collect-a-thon at heart and rewards the player constantly in an evolving hub world!

name: Gallery Manager
short_description: 'Gallery Manager' is a role-playing game with a high degree of freedom. You will play an administrator to run and manage the gallery.

name: Pong Ping
short_description: A Pong Ping type game. A Single Player Arcade Physics based Tennis Like Game!

name: Turbo Cat Fight
short_description: Turbo Cat Fight is an Experimental Pixel Perfect Fighting Game. Both players get to choose their loadouts and they fight it out! Challenge your friend to an ultimate showdown of an earthshaking fist trade!

name: Polyrhythm Master
short_description: A music game in which you play visually represented, complex polyrhythms with surprisingly simple controls. Neither the difficulty nor the ease of existing music games exist here.

name: Natti
short_description: “Natti” is a roguelike tower defense game unfolds in the Otherworld of Korean folktales. Place defense towers, collect equipment, and strategically utilize various heroes to defeat all the monsters and protect the Otherworld with “Natti”, goblins in form of animals.

name: NOTHING TO LOSE
short_description: A retro horror and adventure game.

name: Fumpers
short_description: Fumpers? Your goal is to complete the track by jumping. Let's See How Quick You Can Be at Doing This.

name: 違う冬のぼくら／BOKURA
short_description: 'I wanted to find out how far 'far away' really was.' BOKURA is a two-player puzzle adventure game. Play as two boys who ran away from their homes and work together to take yourselves somewhere far, far away.

name: Operation: Harsh Doorstop
short_description: I got sick of games with lootboxes and predatory monetization... with no single player missions or mod support. So our community started making this game instead. A shooter sandbox with all the features a game should have. Oh... and we're funding it on Patreon and giving it away for free.

name: Dreams in the Witch House
short_description: Dreams in the Witch House is an open world horror adventure game, where you guide Walter Gilman, as he prepares to face the dreaded May-Eve witch ritual in the legend-haunted city of Arkham. Choose your own approach and reveal the secret of the Witch House before it's too late.

name: The Last Shot
short_description: An adventurous engineer, a diesel-punk world divided by endless conflict, and a whole lot of colossal guns. Sounds like a good time! With massive war machines threatening your home, will you be the one small cog that brings it all to a halt?

name: Wanted: Dead
short_description: Wanted: Dead is a new hybrid slasher/shooter from the makers of Ninja Gaiden and Dead or Alive. The game follows a week in life of the Zombie Unit, an elite Hong Kong police squad on a mission to uncover a major corporate conspiracy.

name: Horror Adventure
short_description: Horror Adventure is a interactive experience set in a procedurally generated haunted house. You're a paranormal investigator and you find yourself exploring what appears to be a old abandoned manor.

name: Multiplayer Cowboys
short_description: Multiplayer Cowboys - The Town is being taken over by Ghosts. Can You and Your Posse Survive ?

name: The Abyss
short_description: 'Everlasting night. Shadowed crescent, red moon runs. Watch the sleeping sun.' -The White Crown Traverse throughout Mondreich, Learn its secrets, and free yourself from the chains of power and madness.

name: Monsters of Seabrook
short_description: Capture, train, and fuse together minions into your ultimate weapon against foes and the gym leaders of Seabrook. Become the resident Monster Expert and collect them all!

name: Arthas - The Game
short_description: A great game about a Great man!

name: CyberHeroes Arena DX
short_description: Survive all the waves in this cybernetic auto battle rougelite. Customize your robot for unique combat and fun!

name: Spy Bros. (Pipi & Bibi's DX)
short_description: Those wacky gangsters are up to no good... Dodge them, plant the bombs and flee the building before it blows up!

name: Turnament
short_description: You are a space mining apprentice with a bright future ahead. However, your superior Commander Neek would rather watch a movie than teach you anything. Can you collect crystals and survive on your own?

name: Tony Slopes™
short_description: Immerse yourself in a world of absolute chaos in this hilarious and outlandish racing adventure! Choose your racer, grab some headgear and select a ‘vehicle’ (anything from a bathtub to a humpback whale!) Race through beautiful environments in solo and multiplayer and battle hard for that No.1 spot!

name: Hunting Labyrinth
