name: Universal Truck Simulator Tow Games
short_description: Get behind Truck steering wheel drive Car Driving & Parking Free Games Simulator Truck

name: Torico's b-day gift hunt
short_description: Torico's b-day gift hunt - Toriko slept peacefully, looking forward to the upcoming party on her birthday, but bad luck - all the gifts were stolen! Restore justice and return the gifts to their place in this game inspired by the classic platformers of the 90s!

name: Refund Me If You Can : Lexy's Story
short_description: Lexy grandmother is sick. Will you be fast enough to bring her medication in time ?

name: STIVENELVRO LEGENDS
short_description: It is an adventure game, 2d platforms, where you control Stivenelvro, jump, turn, slide through different obstacles getting the keys that will unlock the legends and thus get more abilities. All this being guided by his friend GhostPower and his machine to teleport him to different worlds.

name: OWLMAN
short_description: The following is a series of tapes recovered near the Overlook National Park where four people were recently reported missing- a family of three and one motorist.

name: Arcade Party
short_description: It's time to venture into the world of arcade games! A mysterious game console has kidnapped your beloved streamer. Have a party with your friends. Use your gamer abilities to clear the various games that are blocking your way.

name: Rat Chef
short_description: Ratchef is ulinary adventure where you play as a robotic rat and serve food. Upgrade your kitchen, Unlock new maps as you level up.

name: Johnny Lionface
short_description: A twisted story-driven action-RPG with endless ways to build your party of colorful combatants.

name: Flashback
short_description: Flashback is a strategy game oriented to your choices. You will play the role of a deliveryman and live in a turbulent city for a month. You will meet various characters and experience events, and those characters' fates will cross and they will usher in their own futures based on your choices.

name: Your Turn To Die -Death Game By Majority-
short_description: Your Turn To Die -Death Game By Majority- is a multi-ending horror adventure game. Sara Chidouin returns home from school late one night to discover that something's gone terribly wrong. When she comes to, she finds herself, her friend Joe, and 9 other people trapped in a mysterious place.

name: Final Fort
short_description: FinalFort is a survival game with defense as the core gameplay, and when the end comes, you use the last human shelter to constantly dig minerals, build walls and various turrets to defend against the endless zombie army.

name: Boundary Walls
short_description: Overview: You are a source of light trapped inside walls and you need to escape from these walls surrounded by various traps, but how? The light sources you find around open a gateway for you to move on to the next level, and you can only get out of here by collecting them.

name: Artificiality-人造物-
short_description: This is a story puzzle RPG. Lead the Main character Hiber, who woke up from the snowstorm with no memory, on a journey home to find his memories, stop the snowstorm in this city, and the farewell and parting with the important thing——

name: Endless Dark
short_description: An existential horror game in which you are tasked with keeping a sleeper colony ship intact. No enemies or NPCs share the ship with you - only creaking metal echoes and endless dark. Overcome random events, system failures, and the downward spiral of your sanity to see your mission through.

name: Nuke Survivors
short_description: A game about why Nuclear War Is Bad. Also, a cool, hard FTL-meets-Missile Command(TM) action game, with roguelite choices and deck-building mechanics.

name: Pocky & Rocky Reshrined
short_description: The original cute and hardcore shrine maiden shooter is now available on Steam! Completely new game, a sequel to the home original 'Pocky&Rocky' (Super Nintendo Entertainment System)! The adventures of Pocky&Rocky begin once again.

name: ReverseRoom
short_description: ReverseRoom is a new type of action puzzle game in which players must skillfully use two modes, Play Mode to move characters and Puzzle Mode to rotate the stage and change the terrain.

name: Logic - Keypad
short_description: Puzzle game with numbers. Observe, find and combine clues to open doors. No horror. No storyline. Just Logic!

name: Clive 'N' Wrench
short_description: Clive ‘N’ Wrench is a 3D platformer starring Clive, a rabbit, and Wrench, the literal monkey on his back. Your adventure takes you hurtling through time and space in a 1950’s refrigerator on a heroic quest to thwart the tyrannical Dr Daucus and stop his evil plans.

name: Tartarus Longo Itinere
short_description: Tartarus is a DungeonCrawler in Card format that will drop you into the fiery Inferno. Use your skills to kill as many creatures as possible and successfully pass the Mephisto's test... The Long Itinere.

name: Dracula Defense!
short_description: Dracula Defense is a top down 2D tower defense game where the player will need to act strategically to survive an onslaught of enemies trying to attack a base. Only you can Defend Dracula!

name: Gatedelvers
short_description: Fight, sneak, cast and jump your way through hostile worlds in this dungeon-crawling roguelite. Make use of everything you find and upgrade your gear to your liking. Discover the lost worlds beyond the Gates, alone or with friends.

name: Boot & Shoot
short_description: stranded in space with nothing but a gun, hostiles start showing up out of nowhere... what now? you can't escape, but you can boot and shoot

name: Offroad Jeep 4x4: Car Driving Simulator
short_description: In this offroad game, become a great 4x4 car driver in a big town.

name: My Dream Setup
short_description: My Dream Setup is a simulation game about building the room you've always dreamed of. A huge selection of furniture, computers and their accessories, posters, pictures, plants, and other interior details await you. Try all of them and create your dream setup.

name: Pixel Composer
short_description: A Node-based pixel art generator, editor, and VFX compositor. Create beautiful and complex effects in a non-destructive manner. Pixel Composer comes with a powerful graph system that supports multiple image manipulation, feedback effects, loop, physics, and fluid simulation.

name: Ultra Blade
short_description: Defend Mankind's last city from the endless hordes of darkness! Ultra Blade is a horde survival RPG with rogue-lite progression elements. Build new heroes to take on new challenges while cutting through 1000s of foes at once. New heroes unlock new powers, making runs more dynamic the more you play.

name: Redemption Reapers
short_description: Descending suddenly on the world, the macabre Mort armies destroy nation after nation, leaving humanity decimated in their wake. Among the forces resisting the Mort is a small band of mercenaries known as the Ashen Hawk Brigade.

name: The Hero's Journey through Time
short_description: On your journey you will meet a wide variety of heroes who are as different as fire and ice. You will meet brave warriors who risk their lives for their beliefs, but also benevolent magicians who use their powers for the good of others.

name: Sally Can't Sleep
short_description: Sally Summers, an average Jill living in her apartment in L.A, has trouble getting to sleep one night. As it turns out, her favourite pillow needs some new feathers! Are you a bad enough dude to collect the feathers in this First-person Dream exploration Collectathon Platformer?

name: How long can you survive
short_description: How long can you survive is a survival game that the more time you spend in the same game, the harder it will be to kill the enemies.Try to reach the top of the leaderboards by getting the longest time possible in infinite mode.

name: Defending Earth
short_description: As the Earth faces the greatest asteroid storm in the solar system, players must strategize and use a variety of weapons, tools and other resources to protect the planet. With a countdown to the incoming storm, players must act quickly and make strategic decisions to save Earth from the asteroids.

name: Remembering/Not remembering Sin
short_description: Shunichi Sasaki, a young man who lost his past memories due to higher brain dysfunction, was criticized as a 'murderer'. Who was he really? Use memory notes to supplement his memories and explore his past.

name: The Nightmare Journey
short_description: In a peculiar and macabre universe, little Arthur faces his greatest fears, nightfall is what scares him the most, in this brief period of darkness his syndromes transcend the limits of the psychic, monsters are always on the prowl, will this time he escape ?

name: 11 Years Ago
short_description: 11 Years Ago is a puzzle-solving single player adventure game made with Unreal Engine 5 and it is the final project of the Red 32 team of BigRock School.

name: Research Story
short_description: Set out to discover and record plants and creatures for the Violet Archive. Grow crops, tame animals, and build the perfect farm! Forge friendships along the way as you begin your life as a researcher!

name: Roadkill Raceway
short_description: In the not so distant future... the power of animal rights organizations has increased 10 fold. All animals are considered to have human level rights with one exception - getting in the way of a public service vehicle is not covered.

name: Luckily, My Arm Is A Shotgun
short_description: You are lost on a cursed island full of monsters... Luckily, your arm is a shotgun! Explore a mini open world and blast your way through waves of demons in this short adventure.

name: Mask of Fury
short_description: Mask of Fury is a dynamic party brawler with ragdoll physics. Team up with friends to complete the campaign or challenge each other in a variety of local or online multiplayer game modes!

name: Small Town Detective
short_description: Small Town Detective is a single-player game where you need to find the killer among other citizens!

name: Extra Lives
short_description: See how long you can survive in a world full of brainless zombies and heartless humans! Find your place among hundreds of other characters spread across several warring factions, and battle to reclaim every corner of a sprawling city in real-time.

name: Toy Rider
short_description: Toy Rider is a fast paced action car racing game with lots of powerups, tracks, vehicles, adventures, and more. It's not just about speed it's about balancing, timing, proper use of powerups & high speed. Get ready to race against the most ruthless AI in the world, Start your engines now!

name: A SIMPLE REQUEST
short_description: In the town of Morton, Louisiana, a series of mysterious deaths and disappearances occur the police bring in Detective Thompson, an experienced investigator known for solving complex cases. As Thompson delves deeper into the case he uncovers a dark past and sinister forces operating beyond the town.

name: 50 Days To Survive
short_description: You find yourself alone in the middle of a desert, and devoid of all hope. Quickly find what to eat, what to drink, what to shelter you, and improve your comfort of life to avoid death. Can you survive for 50 days? Let's see that.

name: ENTROPOLY
short_description: ENTROPOLY is a time-trial platformer inspired by platform fighters. Wavedash into the psychedelic realms of the elements and help Poly fight chaos to restore balance.

name: 平凡的我與幽靈的同居生活
short_description: 物部才人在參加完父母的葬禮後回到家裡，但由於才人打算到東京找工作，於是便到東京尋找新居住的地方，在找了幾天後才人終於找到了一個便宜而且不錯的地方，因此爽快簽約並從原先的地方搬走，但入住後靈異事件不斷，打電話詢問經紀才知道這裡的上一手女主人死在這裡，簽約前也有跟自己說過，這時才人也隱約記起。 才人一開始並未完全接納伊藤，但在日復一日的相處下，才人和伊藤似乎都在彼此身上得到了某些東西，戀愛喜劇般的同居生活就此展開。

name: Otherwar
short_description: OTHERWAR is an surprising mash-up of Tower Defense & Bullet Hell games. Build and manage fortifications to defend the Gate of Heaven against the Hordes of Hell, while soaring over the battlefields as the defender Angel, and meet the monsters in direct combat!

name: 三千世界
short_description: 《三千世界》是一款沙盒角色扮演游戏。游戏旨在构建出不同的世界供玩家游玩。创建自己的角色开始冒险，与栩栩如生的npc交互，通过各种方式强化自己，经历一段属于自己的冒险之旅。

name: PolyRoyale
short_description: JUMP, LAND, FIGHT! Play in Battle Royale or Endless Deathmatch mode on small selectable PolyRoyale maps with a small number of players. You fight against bots and players as solo, duo or squad. Different weapons will help you survive. Only one can win!

name: The Castle Burns!
short_description: Kill literally all of the Goblins, Orcs and other monsters with ridiculous oversized weapons and items born from pure insanity in this 2D Roguelike Arena Survival game! Do it fast, because The Castle Burns!

name: A Lone Piece
short_description: Easy to learn. Hard to master. A Lone Piece is a chess themed puzzle game where you control a single pawn caught in the middle of opposing hostile pieces. Your main job is to escape the board, but sometimes offence is the best defense. Become more than just A Lone Piece.

name: Alephant
short_description: A word-less abstract puzzle game about language.

name: R.A.T.T.Z. Maze
short_description: Have you ever wondered what it would be like to be a Mouse? Have you ever wondered what it would be like to be inside of a Maze? Wonder no more! In R.A.T.T.Z. Maze you will have to rely on the mouse to smell, and your brain to remember! Welcome to the Maze, Good luck!

name: Gladiators and Glory
short_description: A Turn-Based Fighting Game Set in the Roman Era, where you can develop your Gladiators and fight them in arenas to increase the glory of your Ludus.

name: DESTRUCTURE: Among Debris
short_description: DESTRUCTURE: Among Debris is an intense mix of brick breaker, air hockey and bullet hell set in a post apocalyptic world. Destroy structures, dodge bullets, fire guns and buy perks to lay even more waste!

name: Stuffo the Puzzle Bot
short_description: A laid-back but smart puzzle game. Stuffo is the last remaining puzzle bot stuck in a world filled with bite-sized brain-teasers. Help Stuffo to solve the mind-bending puzzles by using various blocks to climb, push and teleport your way to the exit.

name: Sokoball Dreams
short_description: Sokoball Dreams is a minimalist puzzle game. The goal is to beat all the puzzles using the least possible moves.

name: Sky traveler
short_description: Simulator of life in the Japanese village. Building your own village. Use the portal to move around the islands and collect resources. Once you're ready - go to other worlds. There is work for you too. Relax and feel like a hero in this world.

name: Lords of Infinity
short_description: Lead an ancient and crumbling noble house in a rich gunpowder fantasy setting. Lie, bribe, and conspire to secure power and prestige – or to save a doomed kingdom from itself.

name: Infinite Incantation
short_description: Fight for survival as you battle massive hordes of enemies. Wield powerful spells that you can mutate and evolve to ludicrous strength. Customize your character's stats, elemental affinities, and make upgrades to become the ultimate spell-slinging force of destruction.

name: Infested Fortress
short_description: Dig into the mountain, collect resources to build your fortress, grow your population and keep them alive (and happy), learn new deadly skills, gather and refine materials to craft powerful items so you can fend off the many dangerous monsters threatening your colony in turn-based tactical combat.

name: Fremdganger - The Cheating Demon
short_description: In this twisted meta-game, you follow four friends on their cursed journey of love and betrayal, told through a long-forgotten Storyteller. Solve puzzles, make meaningful decisions, and unravel the mystery behind the Storyteller with the help of a reality-breaking RETURN-mechanic.

name: Moorhuhn Piraten - Crazy Chicken Pirates
short_description: 90 seconds to hunt as many chickens and collect as many points as possible. Beat your personal record and compete with players around the world.

name: Street Boss
short_description: Become the boss of the streets. Take down anyone who stand against you.

name: Scars Above
short_description: Scars Above is a challenging sci-fi third-person action adventure shooter combining the rewarding feel of overcoming difficulty with a compelling and intricate story, set in a mysterious alien world to explore.

name: Castle Kingdom Wars
short_description: Make your own strategy to beat your enemies. Characters have different skills so you can defeat your enemy with different tactics. Knight, swordsman, archer, skeleton, mage, catapult and much more hero are ready to fight for you.

name: Simple Increment
short_description: Simple but addictive idle clicker game for those who just wants to relax and have some fun.

name: The Ouroboros King
short_description: The Ouroboros King combines the tactical depth of chess with the build variety and replayability of roguelikes. Build a formidable army, discover powerful relics, and buy surprising gadgets to defeat the Covenant.

name: Arclight of City
short_description: in the future, the crime rate of the city was high. The increase in the rate of crime had brought huge costs to the prison and the discipline system, and a large number of criminals would commit crimes again not long after they were released.Until someone proposed the 'prison city'

name: Have a Bloody Goal
short_description: Have a Bloody Goal is a fun first person zombie soccer game. The game puts you against a small number of zombies, hordes of zombies, giants, or give you an infinite amount of time to score as many goals as you can and not lose to your opponent who's also trying to score against you.

name: CardShark
short_description: CardShark is a roguelike card-battler game in which you take the role of a young daring shark, seeking adventure. Battle your way through each floor of a dangerous dungeon in an endeavour to reach the bottom...

name: Ball laB 2
short_description: Roll and jump through challenging but interesting levels in a minimalistic style!

name: Unification
short_description: Unification is a gravity-shifting VR parkour roguevania. Descend from the orbital factory into the layers of the black hole engine. Explore vibrant shifting architectures in a harmony of momentum and destruction... assuming you’re able to overcome the traps and inhabitants in your path.

name: shita ni
short_description: A surreal dream exploration game, both beautiful and terrifying.

name: ふりかけ☆スペイシー
short_description: 『ふりスペ』はネオ昭和×ギャグ×ビジュアルノベル！ゴスでブリなドレスを身にまとい、オタク文化を愛する「さぁたん」は2浪中のハタチ。ひょんなことから謎のワープに巻き込まれ、たどり着いたのはネオ昭和、出会うは狂気の女子高校生たち！？

name: Takenoko - Tilt Five AR
short_description: Gardeners in imperial Japan have been tasked to see who is worthy of caring for the sacred panda. Cultivate your plots, grow bamboo, and complete objectives in this holographic adaption of the award-winning board game now available for Tilt Five™!

name: Cold Shell
short_description: Cold Shell is a top-down, sci-fi, arcade brawler with persistent RPG elements. Bash thugs and change wallpapers.

name: Konkan Coast Pirate Solutions
short_description: A cozy puzzle game about helping pirate ships do pirate things. Set up the simulations. Watch how the ships behave. Explore how the systems interact.

name: We Are Screwed!
short_description: Save the Multiverse in We Are Screwed!, a chaotic co-op space action game for 1-4 players! Team up and face swarms of foes as you pilot your way through a procedurally generated galaxy. Blast your enemies, extinguish fires, clean up, repair, recycle and explore where no one has screwed up before!

name: Anti-Bully Adventure
short_description: You're a person who has been getting bullied online, then you find a comment that looks positive and decide to click the link attached. An evil virus corrupts your computer and you have to try to get rid of it. Will you be able to do it?

name: Surprising My Neighbors 2
short_description: Surprising My Neighbors 2 – a first-person game where you will be leaving your surprises at the doors of your favorite neighbors. You moved to a new city a year ago. One morning, you went outside and found poop at your door again. It looks like someone of your new neighbors left it there.

name: Cavimilation
short_description: Cavimilation is a 2D shooter/platformer throwback to classic high score chasing games with the addition of modern roguelike elements. Explore an endless procedurally generated cave filled with treasure and monsters, where every mistake takes its toll and where every bullet counts.

name: Cockroach Simulator household survivor
short_description: Cockroach Simulator household survivor Allows you to simulate being a cockroach that even you can't imagine. In its view, you too are a terrible thing.

name: Stickman Trenches
short_description: Stickman Trenches is a Real Time Strategy game in which you need to manage your men and weapons and build up your defenses in the brutal trenches of Stick World War 1.

name: Pact of Steel
short_description: A WW2 Tower Defense game, with minor aspects of an RTS game.

name: SokoChess White
short_description: SokoChess White is a puzzle game about pushing Chess pieces into their destination and overcoming various obstacles. Enjoy 70 different handcrafted levels with a unique twist on the Chess formula.

name: Unforgettable Voyage
short_description: Unforgettable Journey is pirate puzzling adventure game full of treasure, traps, and enemies. Play as different members of a dysfunctional pirate crew and harness each of their unique abilities to solve puzzles, avoid enemies, acquire upgrades, defeat the boss, and get the ultimate treasure.

name: Pasha Planet: Reborn
short_description: “Pasha Planet: Reborn” is the debut game of Scorpio Game, a Taiwanese indie game development studio. Players will take on the role of Bobbie and clear stages of challenges to solve the final mystery!

name: Dust Devil
short_description: Dust Devil is a coffee-break super hardcore minigame. With only one mouse button and your hyper bike you will overthrow a corrupt regime! Race from town squares to skyscraper rooftops in under 5 minutes. Help people on the streets and outspeed riot cops. Catch Prime Minister before he runs away!

name: Road To Place
short_description: Road To Place is a dice rolling roguelike based on chance. The number you roll on the dice can affect everything in the game. Manage resources bullets, food, medicine, and money. Your goal is to survive, there are things that will make that difficult But your main objective is Get to 'the place'

name: Dreadful River
short_description: The realm is under attack. The king and his most loyal guards are trying to save the Eternal Crown. Floating down a vast river on a simple raft, you have to fight enemies, improve your gear, find allies and explore mysteries along the shores. Can you turn the tide?

name: Hightail
short_description: How far can you survive? This game will give you a challenge to survive the wildlands and collect miles as you drift in unknown direction and try to avoid obstacles.

name: Ruined Kingdom
short_description: Ruined Kingdom is a real-time strategy, RPG and reverse tower defense game. Defeat the insolent humans, control the battlefield, Defeat rival tribes! Take control of an army of Orcs fighting to conquer! Win and gain experience to unlock new upgrades and unique abilities.

name: Dice Hero: The Unoriginal Story
short_description: Roguelike game where you build up your character to defeat monsters. Use dice as energy to attack and collect items and blessings. Explore worlds and defeat bosses to unlock new progression. Choose your path and playstyle, you never know what's around the corner.

name: Demolition Master - Destruction Simulator
short_description: Demolition sandbox with different guns including nature powers. Slow down time, change gravity and much more to play around! With compaign and sandbox mods.

name: Fairytale Theatre
short_description: Momotaro's Adventurous Activity

name: The Legend of Heroes: Kuro no Kiseki
short_description: Dive into the newest chapter of the Trails series with Kuro no Kiseki and experience the adventure with enhanced combat, updated visuals, and high-speed game mode!

name: Gone Rogue
short_description: Gone Rogue is a stealth-action game with elements of tactical RPG. Get into the role of a thief from the city slums. Lurking in the shadows, sneak unnoticed past enemies, get behind any locked doors, and carry off rich loot.

name: Faraway: Arctic Escape
short_description: Faraway: Arctic Escape is a relaxing adventure escape game full of new puzzles to solve. The final sequel of the Faraway trilogy.

name: Endless Spaceship
short_description: Defend yourself from thousands of obstacles and enemies, the more points, the better placed in the world ranking!

name: Fight With Keys
short_description: A combination of action and rhythm games, players need to move characters while entering corresponding keys.

name: NOT ME
short_description: The eight adventurers will explore the mysterious island, but the ship has been damaged by the storm and cannot return. Little did they know that the werewolves on the island had already killed the two adventurers and blended in with the team, playing hide-and-seek with the other humans.

name: EDEN: Create World
short_description: EDEN is a physical sandbox. No limits, create worlds and play the way you want! To create worlds, we give you a large set of tools, game mechanics, smart and not so smart NPCs, cars, weapons and many other interesting things.

name: Phantom Brigade
short_description: Phantom Brigade is a hybrid turn-based & real-time tactical RPG with an innovative timeline-based command system. See the future, predict enemy actions, and plot your counterattack on the timeline! Outnumbered and out-gunned, lead the Brigade's campaign to retake their war-torn homeland.

name: Dragon Pinball
short_description: Challenge the Dragon and free the Kingdom!

name: SlipDream Resonator
short_description: SlipDream Resonator is a multi-directional rhythm game with unique twin-stick controls. Inspired by both classic rhythm games and top-down shooters, SlipDream Resonator offers addictive arcade gameplay designed to challenge while featuring eye catching visuals and a heart pumping soundtrack.

name: I Am Your President
short_description: Play as a fictional US president in this satirical narrative strategy! Lead Democrats or Republicans to make America great again. Again.

name: Shopping Center Tycoon
short_description: Shopping Center Tycoon Is : Market Simulation & Tycoon and Improve your market. Grow, Design and Manage your Shopping Center with the right Strategy.

name: TRAUMA Broken Paradise
short_description: You woke up in a Mansion in the middle of the Forest, with no memory. Seeking answers about your past, embark on this scary Psychological Thriller based on the Classic Games that you liked best from Survival Horror in the 90s/2000s.

name: Gunpowder Punk
short_description: Gunpowder Punk is a game in pixel art cyberpunk world. You play as unnamed hero who fights against hordes of psycho gangers and their bosses.

name: Chess Morph: The Queen's Wormholes
short_description: An original puzzle game inspired by chess. Control a lonely Queen with shapeshifting abilities and defeat the enemy army. Move wisely, explore the wormholes on the board, take the enemy shape and kill them all.

name: Flip That Coin!
short_description: Flip That Coin! is a game about flipping coins up in a random direction and clicking on the coins to score points! How fast can you flip and click the coins?

name: Wheelie King 5
short_description: Online & Offline modes Customize bikes. Upgrade bikes. Wheelies, Endos, Real stunts & Drifting. Manual & Automatic gears.

name: The Entity Within
short_description: The Entity Within is a echolocation Hardcore Stealth Horror game, each map has its story and each monster (called entities in the game) has different powers. Join this atmosphere and try your best.

name: Dead Inside
short_description: A thrilling, first-person, action-survival game set in the modern post-apocalypse. As mankind’s last hope, you’ll traverse the hospital ravaged by a lethal plague. the fight for survival gets progressively more difficult as the story unfolds. Be ready for violence

name: King Of The Castle
short_description: Take your rightful place on the throne in this political party game for 4+ players. Rule the kingdom with an iron fist or silver tongue as you steer through bloodshed, intrigue & madcap disaster! Can you keep your crown when others plot your downfall? More importantly, can you keep your head?

name: Interstellar Conquest
short_description: Take planets and assemble your fleet. The conquest of space is now, navigate through asteroid fields and hide in nebulas to outsmart your opponents. Experience the challenge of ion storms disrupting your ship's sensors and become the ultimate space fleet commander.

name: Courier Chief Tycoon
short_description: Develop the distribution network in your city and turn your warehouse into a big company. Hire motor couriers, deal with customer complaints and at the same time make sure you don't run out of products.

name: It's Hasegawa-san!?
short_description: I tried using a suspicious dating app with the intention of taking a chance to date some girl, but what I didn't expect is that the girl who came was the usually honest and serious classmate of mine...?

name: The Big One
short_description: Challenge your enemies by overcoming a simulation in perpetual construction. The Big One is an action/platform game of the 'dungeon crawler' type, where your reflexes and concentration will be put to the test.

name: Star Survivor
short_description: The last ship against the endless. Exterminate as many as you can, and gather points to upgrade your ship from a crafted deck of equipment and power-ups. Will your choices be enough to overcome the thousands hunting you? Survive the swarm in this rogue-lite + survivors + asteroids mashup.

name: Poly Vita
short_description: Poly Vita is a relaxing puzzle game about helping a lost wanderer named Maya restore her soul. Pick up and place tiles one by one to form pathways and guide Maya through each puzzle. Collect each of Maya's soul fragments, while avoiding dangerous obstacles blocking your path.

name: Everyone's Happy Place
short_description: EHP is a single player money game where you have just got kicked out of the house and now you have to get yourself back on your feet with a starting £2000 and a new job opportunity. Explore the world with vehicles and admire the colourful atmosphere. Grind up as much money as possible.

name: Kingdom Run VR
short_description: Kingdom Run VR is an action-packed fitness game; explore trapped tombs, avoid dangers, collect gems and eliminate enemies!

name: Dinosaur Simulator
short_description: Colonise a newly discovered planet with dinosaurs, give these creatures a new chance at life! More than 40 species of dinosaurs are waiting for you to bring them back to life after 66 million years!

name: Sokfest
short_description: Point-and-click your way through an online festival terrain, celebrating the 100th Sokpop game! Befriend the characters from all 100 Sokpop games, and explore a bustling festival with colourful characters!

name: Presentiment of Death
short_description: Do you hear that? Sounds of classical music and an arrow rushing by. Burst your way through the enemies inhabiting on different game levels and come out a winner. Remember, all in your hands — a bow and a chance to survive...

name: The Adventures of LinShanHai - Chapter2:Bus Bombing
short_description: The bus to the suburbs suddenly exploded, the scene was a mess, the sales staff, including all 10 people on board died. Lin Shanhai led the scene investigation team to conduct a detailed investigation and visited all the families and friends of the deceased, but the case is still no clue.

name: Escape First Alchemist ⚗️
short_description: First-person escape game, playable solo or co-op with up to 4 people. Solve riddles of a reclusive alchemist that trapped you in his workshop. Brew potions and overcome challenges as he laughs at your failures and makes light of your successes...But what if things are not what they seem?

name: Verlet Ascend
short_description: Verlet Ascend is a physics based, action platformer with roguelike mechanics, a fully destructable procedurally generated environment, and rope swing physics. Fight creatures, loot enemies, upgrade your character, and climb your way up in an endless parkour.

name: Neopunk
short_description: An open world cyberpunk retro RPG. Start a new life as an agender mercenary who moves to the dark and neon lit streets of Kaanalos City. Freedom awaits you in Neopunk. Solve a murder. Buy apartments. Deliver pizza. Who will you be?

name: Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty
short_description: A new dark fantasy Three Kingdoms action RPG from Team NINJA, the developers of Nioh.

name: Blockappend
short_description: A 3D puzzle game where you append blocks to each other by flipping them around.

name: Esperia ~ Uprising of the Scarlet Witch ~
short_description: Dive into the world of Esperia, a fantasy tactical RPG with visual novel elements! Lead Diana and her allies into grid-based tactical battles to uncover the secrets of the Kingdom and the world.

name: Captain Meow
short_description: FPS RPG Action Adventure

name: Card Crawl Adventure
short_description: Card Crawl Adventure is a single player card game with light deck building and roguelite elements. Engage in a unique path based combat mechanic to battle against devious tavern bosses. Visit a variety of cozy taverns, collect cards and improve your deck with magic equipment items and charms.

name: I commissioned some bees 14
short_description: I paid more artists to hide bees in 20 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

name: No Way Out
short_description: Escape the monotony of your daily routine and discover a path beyond this seemingly endless cycle. Embrace the thrill of the unknown, as you embark on a journey to break free from the ordinary. Will you be brave enough to take the leap, even if there seems to be No Way Out?

name: Crazy Designer
short_description: A strategy and simulation game about interior design. The player has to make the perfect arrangement of compartment, furniture and decoration to satisfy everyone's different request. 9 topics and more than 1200 items in the game.

name: Krakout (C64/CPC/Spectrum)
short_description: In this simple twist on classic arcade block-breakers, originally released in 1987, take on the challenge of 100 fiendish levels. Contains the Amstrad CPC, Commodore 64 and ZX Spectrum versions of the game.

name: Painter Simulator
short_description: PAINTER SIMULATOR is a new generation game in which the emphasis is placed on the player's imagination and perceptiveness. Create the world in the colors you want to see with a brush.

name: The Guard
short_description: You are on the night shift at the mall. While you were taking your post, your partner went missing. All the time you hear some kind of noise. You need to find out their origin and find your partner. As you pass, you will need to find the keys and open locked rooms.

name: Ghosted
short_description: Guide the ghosts home by solving color puzzles. After solving color puzzles designed by a unique master, you will soon become a puzzle master too. Oh, and don't miss Master's big band music.

name: Shop Heroes
short_description: Craft legendary items, gear up your heroes for epic quests, and fight for the top of the Trade Wars and PvP Leaderboards in the original smash hit fantasy tycoon: Shop Heroes!

name: GUN KING
short_description: Take down hordes of chess pieces to survive and be crowned Gun King. First choose from over 14 guns. Then level up to mix and match a variety of upgrades to create your very own build.

name: Dungeons of Aether
short_description: Delve into Dungeons of Aether, a turn-based dungeon crawler set in the Rivals of Aether universe. Control four new heroes as they uncover the mysteries of the Julesvale Caverns in Story Mode or test your mettle in the grueling Challenge Dungeons.

name: Evolution Tale
short_description: Chop down trees, mine rocks and pick up plants to combine them and craft a total of 500 different items that can be used to evolve and develop new technologies until you reach the modern ages.

name: Mahjong - Legacy of the Toltecs
short_description: Become the best mahjong player in the world in the great mahjong game 'Mahjong Legacy of the Toltecs'! Search for an ancient, powerful artifact that will help you find incredible treasures. Overcome obstacles, collect magical mana and become a legendary adventurer.

name: Servants of Sumomon
short_description: This is a single player roguelike-deckbuilder game. Unlike other games of the genre, player must design every level of the game to survive against the invader. To design levels, player should summon creatures and increase their strength by giving right items.

name: THE MEME HUNTER
short_description: THE MEME HUNTER is a dynamic first–person shooter in which you will exterminate crowds of evil memes. They're everywhere. They're out for your blood. They will follow you wherever you go…

name: Vincent's Horror Story
short_description: In Vincent's Horror Story, players are immersed in a spine-chilling and bizarre atmosphere teeming with frightening monsters and mind-bending challenges.

name: The Excrawlers
short_description: Action-RPG slasher game in which you and others hero will have to plunge into the dark atmosphere of dungeons full of monsters and madness.

name: Elephantasy: Flipside
short_description: Use and upgrade magic items, collect hidden treasures, and uncover the secrets between two worlds in this cute isometric puzzler! When a certain vacationing Elephant stumbles upon a way into the land of the dead, will she unwittingly let something far more sinister slip through?

name: PARANORMAL GIRLFRIEND
short_description: A mysterious girl shows up at your house and things get wild...

name: Programming Without Coding Technology 2.0
short_description: Learn programming concepts and develop applications and 2D games.

name: Garten of Banban 2
short_description: Continue the story of Banban’s Kindergarten. Delve deeper into the bizarre establishment where the place was left suspiciously empty. Try to survive the unexpected residents, all while uncovering the truth behind the place…

name: Cache Grabbers
short_description: Cache Grabbers is a chill first-person cartography puzzle game. Navigate through 30 levels in a strange environment, using only your compass, metal detector and shovel to find and GRAB THE CACHE — and maybe even a way to escape.

name: Space Pop - Bubble Shooter
short_description: 'Blast off into the galaxy with our new bubble shooter game! Explore 200 levels set across stunning intergalactic environments and pop your way to victory. With intuitive controls and addictive gameplay, you'll enjoy hours of bubble-blasting fun.

name: Apocalyptic Vibes
short_description: A vintage immersive first-person shooter on GZDoom. With an atmosphere of a cold and melancholic postapocalypse, elements of dieselpunk, mix of a retro-style and realism and romantic shoegaze as a soundtrack.

name: Public Land Hunter
short_description: Experience the challenge of hunting public land in this retro hunting sim. Hunt a variety of game using a range of weapons on procedurally generated parcels of land. Scout, set up and shoot.

name: A Fox and His Robot
short_description: Become a fox and escape the grip of powerful Artificial Intelligences in a 2D action-platformer. A young fox and his robot search for meaning in a beautiful yet dangerous world.

name: CARTOONITE
short_description: Choose your favorite vehicle from an infinite number of possibilities. Have fun crashing into objects to collect resources and build your own world. Show your friends what you've built and do stunts with them.

name: Rustled Pete
short_description: Rustled Pete is a very unforgiving boss fighting game. There is only one boss in the game and his name is Pete The Rustled. He has 4 forms, each one is harder than the other. Good luck!

name: Rytmos
short_description: A relaxing puzzle game where you create music by solving mazes. Travel from planet to planet and discover new music. Jam on top of the music from the planet with a great selection of 20+ fun unlock-able musical toys.

name: Fateweaver: The Alchemist's Quandary
short_description: You are The Fateweaver; an ancient beast of legendary status. It is your job to determine which way Fate will unravel as you dig deep into the psyche of those who beckon. Decide whether to help those who beg for your mercy, or invoke the wrath of the Gods upon those you deem unworthy of existence...

name: Frack the World
short_description: Frack the World is a resource management game about successfully running a hydrofracking company while also dealing with the state of the environment.

name: Treasure Hunter VR
short_description: Metal detecting in virtual reality.

name: One Military Camp
short_description: Build your own military camp, manage the economy, recruit the best candidates and train them to become elite specialists. Send them on missions across the land to end the war once and for all!

name: So Much Stuff
short_description: Time to find ALL the stuff.

name: Meg's Monster
short_description: Take control of the Underworld’s grumpiest ghoul to help a lost little girl find her way home in this creepy-cute indie adventure. Just be warned: if she cries, the whole world dies.

name: 浮世万千三天地情殇
short_description: Xianxia story to independent games, original story, personal development, text volume of more than 300,000 words.

name: Voltaire: The Vegan Vampire
short_description: Rebel against your legacy in this farming action roguelite. Tend your spooky farm by day & defend your crops from enemies at night! Upgrade Voltaire, youngest son of Dracula, with devious new abilities & discover dozens of new plants to cultivate. Send dad a message: a vegan life is no missed steak!

name: ball-e
short_description: Become the ultimate Ninja Ball Warrior in ball-e, a hardcore roguelike platformer. Parkour through procedurally generated stages, mastering abilities to overcome challenges. With endless variation, every run offers a new experience. Stay determined and adapt, because there's always a way forward!

name: Yihongyuan
short_description: Can I float in life without becoming trapped in the mire of the dirt , is myconfidence。Charm them with your personal charm

name: Basements n' Basilisks: Storms of Sorcery
short_description: A visual novel paying satirical homage to the world’s greatest TTRPG. Make important choices, roll countless dice, build lasting relationships, explore magical lands and experience all the rest of the crap you expect from a fantasy game without the hassle of finding actual friends to play with!

name: Spirit Eyes
short_description: Spirit Eyes is a horror game in which, as an experienced exorcist, you take a contract to an abandoned house in Wyoming. Player must discover the type of ghost and try to get rid of it. As you try to communicate with the spirit, you will have to make choices that will affect the course of the game.

name: Full Gear
short_description: Fight and engineer your way through a steampunk dungeon in this traditional roguelike. Build Drones to gain additional firepower, use Wheel Tokens to time your attacks, and learn from the past as you go. Are you better than the machines?

name: VRNOID
short_description: VRNOID is a bricks breaker game mixed with Air Hockey in virtual reality. Swing your striker to hit the ball, destroy bricks, collect power-ups, and dodge bullets. Prepare yourself for challenging levels and bosses that are waiting for you in this retro space.

name: The Smile Alchemist
short_description: Follow the growth of a young alchemist aiming to become the best in the world!

name: First Person Hooper
short_description: Attack the basket with your jump shot in First Person Hooper, a chill, arcade-style, halfcourt hoops game with first-person shooter gameplay. Score the basketball creatively using timing, movement, and skill. Rank up on Leaderboards in score and time attack modes or master your shot in free play.

name: Belle Automata: Chronicle I
short_description: Aureve is content with making tapestries with her master—but when he dies, his family sells her to a reclusive buyer. Thrown into a world of other androids, she must find her place and above all, answer the question: how does one weave a new identity when the strings to the old have been cut?

name: Anemoiapolis: Chapter 1
short_description: The most relaxing horror game you'll ever play. Anemoiapolis exists in the uncanny valley of American architecture -- endless carpeted floors and lonely malls. Escape for your life, and enjoy the scenery.

name: The Final Bastion
short_description: The Final Bastion is a Multiplayer PvP & PvE Tower-defense with a classic Medieval-Fantasy theme. Compete against players in head to head online in a PvP, sending waves against the enemy and growing your economy. Play side by side with your friends in PvE and see who survives the longest.

name: Rev Up! RC Grand Prix
short_description: It's time to rev up, and race your way to the title of RC Grand Prix Champion!

name: Lilly's Flower Shop
short_description: Enjoy this great Match 3 Flower Shop Adventure. Form groups of three or more flowers, gardening stuff and other flower shop items to unlock powerful boosters and help Lilly to realize her dream. Use the right strategy, earn coins and build the most beautiful flower estate in town.

name: Minos Station: Escape Room
short_description: You are trapped in one of minos games, an escape room creator, you have several puzzles to solve, and several clues to follow to solve those puzzles, but each time you go to the next escape room, the puzzles are more complicated.

name: REMEDIUM: Sentinels
short_description: Become a Sentinel and face the plague in roguelite fast-paced auto-shooter set in the same world as REMEDIUM game. Combine items and alchemical elements to acquire more powerful weapons and create unique builds to defend the plague survivors against the endless hordes of mutants!

name: LIQUID
short_description: Liquids is a surreal adventure game. When Emma, the actress girlfriend of scientist Albert, dies strangely, police detective Todd investigates the unsolved case, and bizarrely Emma's body appears out of nowhere within many time and space.

name: A Terrible Place
short_description: What seems like a simple mission turns into a fight for survival as the island wakes up to greet its new arrivals.

name: OscarWildeCard
short_description: He loves dinner parties. He loathes you. A most amusing card game.

name: Ball Army vs Zombie
short_description: A real-time strategy survival game. The picture quality is beautiful，Powered by Unreal Engine 5 （UE5） Place balls to block zombies Don't let zombies into the house Player's hand speed, strategy matching, ball matching, Protect the surviving humans, the ball warriors protect the humans

name: 流浪荒岛
short_description: Wandering is a pixel-style sandbox action-adventure where you play as a drifting desert island adventurer trying to survive on a pristine desert island. You can explore unknown islands on a raft and get unique resources and treasures. Conquer powerful enemies and acquire rare equipment.

name: Lunar Mirror:The Pavilion of Desire
short_description: This is a side-scrolling exploration and puzzle game with the background of the horror story of Cthulhu. You can move the character through A and D, talk to the character in the scene, press the F key to interact with the props in the scene, and complete the puzzle by collecting clues.

name: Germinal
short_description: Jump, hover and clean your way through this precision platformer combining permissive jetpack mechanics with a compassionate narrative about getting lost in your own fear.

name: Teleport VR
short_description: With Teleport VR, you can explore ancient Egypt and Rome, medieval times, and even science fiction futuristic locations, all from the comfort of your own home. Image and category libraries will continue to expand with new fascinating locations and themes.

name: Project Dark
short_description: Trapped in a House that no longer feels like your own, the only way out is to face the darkness and find a way to survive. With something Lurking in the Dark. You are not alone.You will Have to Face the Darkness to Survive. The question is - Can you Survive?

name: Drift Experience Japan: Supporter Edition
short_description: Get the Supporter Edition of Drift Experience Japan and enhance your experience with new maps and extra content!

name: 大懒子勇闯魔王城
short_description: You will incarnate the protagonist 'Big Lanzi' who has lost his memory but has the ability of [rebirth] and wake up on an unknown island. With the 'help' of the villagers on the island, they challenged the Great Devil again and again, and gradually solved the truth on the island

name: Lovelorn sanatorium Ⅲ
short_description: This is a spoof plot puzzle game. Click the dialogue to advance the plot. There are many puzzle-solving levels in the game. You can find props by exploring and solve puzzles according to the game prompts

name: Happy Live,Show Up!
short_description: 荣获颇多奖项的Favorite社新作，《Happylive show up》强势登陆Steam平台！ 身处异乡他国，在伙伴的友情与爱情的帮助下，奏响属于大家的“Happy Live”！

name: The Crimping
short_description: A campy first-person horror game based on one of America's most haunted locations. Use your wits and reflexes to escape supernatural encounters within Oregon's underground 'Shanghai Tunnels.'

name: Milo no Senki 3
short_description: In this new entry to the turn-based tactical-RPG Milo no Senki serie, Lord Milo and his group of companions will travel to the realm of the dead in order to bring back their departed friend, Prince Nelson...

name: K-Pop & Rock Band Manager
short_description: A new star is born! Favour Toys B.V. Entertainment wants to release a new 4-member Band. You have to choose the trainees who you think are ready to make their debut to the public and make a new history. How you manage the band will determine their future.

name: Stellar Sovereigns
short_description: Indie 4X space strategy game with TB empire management and RTS combat set in a 3D star cluster. Build an interstellar empire by colonizing and conquering star systems, develop your colonies establish trade routes and construct fleets from a range of retrofittable capital & escort class vessels.

name: CucumbeRunner
short_description: CucumbeRunner is a action platformer in which you have to help the determined Cucumber through many challenges! Jump, do amazing mid-air stunts, collect gems and uncover carefully hidden secrets!

name: Phantom Island
short_description: You are the only survivor of a plane crash and you find yourself on mysterious phantom island. Can you solve the mystery of the island and get out of it relying only on yourself and your survival skills?

name: Frogurai
short_description: Welcome to feudal Japan, a world of samurais and danger. In this world, you play as a frog samurai tasked with taking down the snake clan and bringing an end to the war.

name: IDEA
short_description: IDEA is a game about discovering and sharing. Explore gorgeous landscapes, roll down highways and stumble upon welcoming cottages and abandoned dumpsters. Help your ideas find their way – and share them with the world when they stop, before beginning your journey anew.

name: Evil's Den: Forsaken Dungeon
short_description: Evil's Den: Forsaken Dungeon is a rogue-lite dungeon crawler featuring procedurally generated levels where you will battle through hordes of monsters to close portal to Hell, opened in the villages church.

name: Pretend Cars Racing
short_description: An old school top-down racer with split-screen multiplayer.

name: Sanctuary Saga
short_description: Protect your caravan and face the brutal Untamed Wilds in roguelite turn-based RPG Sanctuary Saga. Engage in row-based combat across multiple varied biomes and keep your group together using a dynamic relationship system.

name: Swords Fantasy: Battlefield
short_description: Swords Fantasy: Battlefield is a game from the 3rd person, including battles with swords.

name: Powerful Courses
short_description: A good game for learning and self-development. Here you will find a lot of interesting and useful things.

name: Lattice Dancer
short_description: This is a very compact game, but an intuitive game that can be played without having to think too hard. Perfect for when you just want to unwind and have fun. You'll find yourself coming back to play it from time to time. Please give it a try.

name: Polar Penguin
short_description: Help the lost penguin find his way home to his family. Magnetize your way through obstacles along the journey and avoid possible dangers on your path. This game is a short physics based platformer using magnets to traverse yourself and your surroundings.

name: Figment 2: Creed Valley
short_description: Figment 2: Creed Valley is an action-adventure game set in the human mind. Nightmares are spreading chaos and enemies have overrun once-peaceful lands. Join Dusty, The Mind’s courage, as you make your way through puzzles, musical boss fights and unique environments. Face your fears head-on.

name: Final Profit: A Shop RPG
short_description: Final Profit is a merchant life-sim RPG that presents a critique of capitalism. Manage your shop, make investments and harsh choices as you explore a story filled world. All while working towards earning enough coin to take down the corrupt Bureau of Business!

name: DC's Justice League: Cosmic Chaos
short_description: Suit up as Batman, Wonder Woman and Superman and take on some of the most powerful Super-Villains in the DC universe with DC’s Justice League: Cosmic Chaos.

name: Steelborn
short_description: Steelborn - is a run and gun platformer game inspired by the classics and made by a team of Abuse, Ranger-X, Contra, Metal Slug, Blaster Master and H.E.R.O fans.

name: Looking Up I See Only A Ceiling
short_description: A short psychological adventure about a stressed girl who wants to explore her ceiling.

name: The Azmodeus Project
short_description: Venture to the Azmodeus Island and try to survive in a post apocalyptic world riddled with zombies and other dangers.

name: Draft - In the woods
short_description: Draft - In the woods is a casual, relaxing and challenging puzzle game. Solve the levels by removing all the nodes using neatly drawn line cuts.

name: Living Legends Remastered: Wrath of the Beast Collector's Edition
short_description: Can you take on Goldilocks’ mantel and protect the kingdom?

name: Hero's Adventure
short_description: Hero's Adventure is an open-world RPG: A pixelated Jianghu survival simulator where you start as a nobody and struggle your way to rise in the world of martial arts. We plan to add EN localization after optimizing the current Early Access version launched on Mar. 8th.

name: Lawnmower Game: Zombies
short_description: Cut grass, unlock new mowers and avoid deathly zombie enemies

name: Swords & Bones 3
short_description: The Swords & Bones saga reaches its third chapter! Inspired by past classics 2D action-platformer games, get ready to fight your way through more than 50 levels full of with enemies, traps and pitfalls. RPG elements enrich the gaming experience.

name: Relic Space
short_description: Experience deeply simulated, hex-based space combat as an elite starship pilot. Explore a ruined solar system, upgrade your ship, and lead your faction to greatness in this tactical, space RPG with 4X elements.

name: Xheres
short_description: Either FPS or TPS, choose your play style and survive the apocalypse on your own or with your friends. But one must know for sure it ain't gonna be easy, there are hordes waiting for you. Not even considering tough ones... Nevertheless it's gonna be fun.

name: Boulette Hell
short_description: Defeat bosses in this bullet hell with unique characters and silly stories. Will you be able to escape the clutches of a contract you signed for the purchase of a yogurt maker?

name: Block'Em!
short_description: Block'Em! is an action-filled block-building party game for 2 to 4 players! The controls are simple but the road to victory is complex: be the first to reach the goal or be the last Blocky standing!

name: Haulin' Oats
short_description: Haulin' Oats is a board game about truck driving, the US highways, and oatmeal. Four players compete to deliver their cargo then return to the warehouse while avoiding various dangers along the way. Take part in sabotage, races, curses, and more to get the upper-hand.

name: Crystal Riders VR
short_description: Test your archery skills in this action-packed virtual reality reimagination of the endless runner genre. Immerse yourself in diverse landscapes, shoot tornadoes out of a bow, battle giant dragons, and much more in this progressively chaotic adventure. How far can you get?

name: Sears: The Sky Frontier
short_description: Sears: The Sky Frontier is a beautiful and epic real-time strategy game that puts you at the head of an army of little stone men against formidable invaders, smartly planning the battle and leading the defense in unique and atmospheric locations.

name: Strawb
short_description: Find your way through challenging puzzles and catch your friend by clever movement and destruction of blocks.

name: Volley Pals
short_description: A chaotic, cartoon style arcade volleyball game with local multiplayer for up to 4 people. It's designed as a party game with each level featuring different themes and mechanics.

name: Crazy Clown
short_description: Crazy Clown - Top Down Shooter, a game in which you need to take your own and destroy all your abusers. You have not only a machine gun in your arsenal. Use all the variety of weapons and crush your enemies. Take revenge on them, clowns can not only make fun!

name: Crusader's March
short_description: Vanquish the ever-growing hordes, Command your army, grow in strength and numbers, and conquer your enemy's castles in this casual top-down roguelite.

name: More than words
short_description: In a dystopian world the manufacture of androids is priority. Marian Anderson is the first android created by the Soul Shell Corporation, and it requires you to test Marian about her intelligent behavior. Will she be able to convince you that she is as human as you? Could she have feeling?

name: Jigsaw Puzzle Delicious Foods
short_description: Delicious Puzzles is a puzzle game that challenges your puzzle-solving skills with mouth-watering images of dishes from around the world. With over 50 beautiful images and 5 difficulty levels, this game is a visual feast for foodies and puzzle enthusiasts.

name: CalmLine
short_description: Overcome levels with the help of various tools and your mind. Are you sure it's easy?

name: ONI : Road to be the Mightiest Oni
short_description: Break your enemies' souls to reclaim your pride. On Kisejima, demon warrior Kuuta and his partner Kazemaru challenge these souls to a trial. All in order to defeat Momotaro, who is both human and evil monster… A tale of sky and wind as they embark upon an island quest.

name: House Builder VR
short_description: Travel around the world and through the ages to build iconic designs! Beware unpleasant temperatures and dangerous fauna! Now in VR to fully immerse in the adventure...

name: Someday You'll Return: Director's Cut
short_description: How far would you go if your daughter didn’t come home? Someday You’ll Return: Director’s Cut is a first-person psychological horror. This story-driven game offers enhanced features, an improved story, and additional content. Enter the woods if you dare and begin a search you’ll never forget.

name: Romancelvania
short_description: Bite into Romancelvania, a darkly comic genre mashup, combining side-scrolling action and tongue-in-cheek romance into one completely absurd and unforgettable adventure.

name: PARANORMASIGHT: The Seven Mysteries of Honjo
short_description: How far would you go to bring someone back from the dead? Discover the depths that some will go to in this horror-adventure game.

name: 50 Rounds
short_description: A round based zombie killing experience. Each wave will be harder than the last; with bosses showing up at possibly the worst of times. Good luck you will need it.

name: Ghosts from the House of Flesh
short_description: Ghosts from the House of Flesh is a horror puzzle game made in 2D pixel art. In the game, you have to collect hidden totems in the forest with ghosts of all kinds.

name: 告死天使复仇之夜 Death Angel Nightmare
short_description: Death Angel Nightmare is a traditional RM horror character adventure game with single story and multiple death achievements. The story length is less than 2 hours.Matsushita and Taojing are a loving couple, but they are caught in the chase. Why is this?

name: ITRP _ Aero Star
short_description: Dynamic, unpredictable and hardcore runner. Try to overcome a long and very varied track with a lot of unique challenges. Can you reach the finish line?

name: KOP KILLER 22XX
short_description: KOP KILLER 22XX features fast-paced, bloody combat with a retro aesthetic. Climb, mantle, and leap from walls to outflank KAPITAL Operatives and gain upgrades to expand your move-set. AI enemies hunt you through grim 23rd century environs as you recruit a team of comrades to take down KAPITAL.

name: The Black Grimoire: Cursebreaker
short_description: A story driven medieval fantasy adventure inspired by oldschool RPGs of the past. Explore a sprawling open world, converse with its many inhabitants, fight its varied monsters and unravel the story of Rothar Aercrest – the cursed lord to the remote woodlands of Imberthale.

name: Deck 'Em!
short_description: Look, kid. Deck Em! is a solitaire-style boxing game. A card game you play to play. But you’re not even a contender. You’re a nobody. A total long shot. The Champ is a stone-cold killer. As big as an ox. Stronger than oak. But you got a lot of heart, kid. And, Mickey loves you.

name: HIGhSCORE
short_description: HIGhSCORE is a 2D platform jumper with rogue-lite elements where players collect items to boost their attributes, score higher combos and reach more points. Unlock new features and customize your character as you level up. Compete with other players on the online leaderboard in singleplayer mode.

name: GOOD LUCK BABY!
short_description: An out of this world yuri visual novel about falling in love, defeating an evil Empress, and finding a magic baby on your crush’s doorstep.

name: Knights of Pen and Paper 3
short_description: Enter the new and improved world of chivalry, class warfare and off-beat pop references. Knights of Pen & Paper 3 is a true sequel to the turn-based, retro style, pixel-art adventure full of danger and saving throws you hold so dear!

name: Kingdom of EXPLORERS
short_description: Kingdom of EXPLORERS is an adventure RPG game for up to 2 players. Each player needs to explore, collect, manage shared resources to unlock new terrains, upgrade weapons to defeat the enemies, Bosses and save the Dwarves Hidden Island!

name: Chippy & Noppo
short_description: Chippy is good in low places and Noppo is good at jumping. It is an action puzzle where two guys work together to make a toy with a theme! What kind of toys are those two really good friends going to make,and what kind of future are they going to make?

name: Shelltered
short_description: Shelltered is a short and Difficult Precision Platformer, inspired by Dream-Exploration games and a world depicted through the eyes of two young birds who's about to leave the comfort of their shelter.

name: Masterplan Tycoon
short_description: Welcome to the resource management game where your creativity and logistics skills are put to the test! In this minimalistic simulation you will build interconnected chains of products and open new missions by completing various tasks to create the biggest system you can.

name: Field of Arms: Tactics
short_description: A strategy game set in the 18th century Caribbean recreating clashes between the empires of the time. Manage resources and armies via three integrated game layers; a strategic overworld for logistics; city building for production and tactical battles to conquer your enemies.

name: Talus
short_description: Control Talus in this challenging boss rush where you'll face increasingly stronger enemies

name: Tank Online: War Shooting Simulator

name: A TAVERN FOR TEA
short_description: A fantasy tea-brewing adventure. Listen to your customers' worries and brew them the tea that they didn't know they needed.

name: Not For Broadcast VR
short_description: Get closer to the truth than ever in the VR edition of Not For Broadcast. Keep the cameras rolling, censor the swears and immerse yourself in the powerful, alluring and occasionally deadly world of broadcast television news.

name: Strange Town
short_description: Strange Town is a very fun survival game with a multiplayer role-playing theme. The game can be played with 3-8 people. The traitorous Werewolf will appear among you as you try to survive!

name: Goblin Keep
short_description: Voxel World Town Building and Survival game with building tools, combat, destruction, and multiplayer

name: 三国真龙传
short_description: 本游戏希望能成为给所有热爱三国游戏玩家的一封情书。 本人从业游戏行业13年有余，感叹市场上的游戏都是氪金网游，再也找不到当年最初玩游戏时候感觉。 于是开发了这款三国游戏。游戏从一开始和刘备从楼桑村开始，会一直持续到诸葛亮五丈原结束。玩家经过的每个场景，穿戴的每件装备、每个技能，都经过精心制作。同时本游戏非常注重细节和游玩时的体验。 如果你在本游戏游玩的过程中获得开心，产生共鸣，认可本作，那么就是这款游戏最大的荣幸。

name: Aery VR - A Journey Beyond Time
short_description: In Aery – A Journey Beyond Time you are in the role of a flying god-like creature which observes the world and their inhabitants while they grow and evolve through time. Are you ready to explore time itself?

name: Zombie Watch Part II
short_description: First-person single-player / survival / RPG game with zombies and wildlife.

name: Within
short_description: Explore a broken world and gain the power to fix it, dealing with demonic adversaries along the way.

name: GHOST HUNTER
short_description: GHOST HUNTER - is the simplest 3D shooter with horror elements where you will have to fight with different ghosts!

name: Chinese Chess Party (Xiangqi)
short_description: Chinese Chess(Xiangqi) is no longer just a 1v1 game, Chinese Chess Party can support up to 4 players. You can play against the computer on a 1v1 game or even play a 2v2 team game with a computer teammate.

name: EXIT The Game – Trial of the Griffin
short_description: An exciting Escape Room experience awaits you! Can you uncover the secrets of Greifenstein Castle and escape?

name: CRAZY GUY
short_description: CRAZY GUY is the story of a space tramp who travels across worlds with the simple goal of clearing out enemies. You joined a war nomad as he explored a small cluster of enemies on a secret planet.

name: Brain Hole Girls
short_description: Can a perfect body and a smart brain coexist?

name: Heavy Armored Assassin
short_description: A military-themed stand-alone 3D simulation shooting game, drive vehicles through the enemy's rear, and at the same time command your two-vehicle formation, break through the enemy's defense line, search and destroy the intruder command post.

name: Rabat Protocol:Metal Rhapsody
short_description: Join the guerrilla and take down the enemies on your vehicle in this 3D third-person shooting game! Gain EXP and upgrades by defeating enemies, choose new weapons and combat skills. Use gold gained from battles to buy tactical packs and combine them into your own combo and beat the enemies!

name: Pricia Defense
short_description: One day, the North Fortress of the kingdom Eneluffe is invaded by northern sorcerers. The princess of the kingdom Eneluffe, 'Pricia', with 'trap magic' in her hands, which is only available to the royal family of Eneluffe, stands up.

name: Dune of the Desert
short_description: A vehicular-combat focused game set in a post apocalyptic desert, the player takes the role of a bounty hunter tasked with taking down some of the most feared creatures in the desert. Collect artefacts, crystals, and other highly sort after items to upgrade your vehicle for high intensity combat.

name: Buildest
short_description: Buildest is a fun action game, where you play as an architect and manage a team of industrious workers to create buildings in different architectural styles. You can also play with friends in co-op mode!

name: XenoWorld ~The Rondeau of Astra~
short_description: 《異境迷走TRoA》是一款結合戰棋、卡牌和Rogue的戰棋遊戲。你將操控「主戰者」，在一關又一關的迷霧森林中，擊敗所有敵人，並揭開異世界「亞斯特大陸」的秘密......

name: Dangerous Road
short_description: Dangerous road is a cars game it has a large map and about 5 missions and it will be updated in the future the game has more than 5 driving behavior and more than 50 cars also there is a story mode that will be available in the next updates the game is focusing the drift and the realistic drive

name: Tanky Tanks 2
short_description: Tanky Tanks 2 is an intense, fast-paced tank shooter game. It is fun, easy to learn, and addicting. Play alone, together with friends or against your friends, and show your navigation and reaction skills in 6 different game modes and countless levels.

name: Wars of Cards: ROMA
short_description: Wars of Cards: ROMA is a multiplayer strategy game. Compared with the high-fidelity, brain-burning strategy game masterpieces, Wars of Cards: ROMA adopts a minimalist gameplay of maps and cards, which can easily satisfy the desire of strategy lovers to color the map.

name: Project Liminal Redux
short_description: Project Liminal Redux is a first-person horror made in realistic 3D graphics. The gameplay consists of collecting notes, solving riddles and escaping from various entities. The main goal is to survive and escape.

name: 破洞小世界 呆望窗
short_description: Role-playing game, is a turn-based combat, 2 d images.Game content.The game has a lot of novelty, waiting for you to explore.

name: Station 99
short_description: Station 99 is an action-adventure game with first-person shooter (FPS) elements.

name: Mr. Saitou
short_description: A short game about an average white-collar worker who struggles to find meaning in a life full of constant overtime and isolation. After an accident lands him in the hospital, Mr. Saitou is spirited away to a strange fantasy world where an unexpected friend takes him on a life-changing adventure.

name: Steel Defier
short_description: Are you ready to escape from your tight prison cell? A malfunction in the defense system of a transport spaceship accidentally killed everyone aboard, except for one last survivor… You and your suspiciously orange suit.

name: Psychic Investigation of Sakuragi Haru
short_description: 3D first-person horror game set in an abandoned middle school　　 While running away from the attacking enemies, gather information about what happened at the school and solve the mystery.

name: The MisAdventures of Xenos
short_description: 'Princess Fayne leads in 'The MisAdventures of Xenos,' a hilarious, turn-based RPG parody. Full of crude humor, meta jokes, and retro graphics, enjoy a fresh take on classic RPGs with new game+ mode. Discover a what-if quest line and defy genre conventions. Clear in 6 hours. Join the adventure now!'

name: Barnstormers: Determined to Win
short_description: Travel back in time to the era of Negro League Baseball. This immersive experience sets you in the 1940's where legends of the game were making a name for themselves in spite of the oppositions set against them. Experience the story first hand as a player during this pivotal time in history.

name: Ogu and the Secret Forest
short_description: Explore the wonderful world with baby Ogu! 'Ogu and the Secret Forest' is a 2D adventure game with hand-drawn characters and various types of puzzles. Befriend bouncy characters and defeat strange creatures to unravel the mystery of the charming world.

name: Into The Backrooms
short_description: Explore and survive levels based on the popular creepypasta lore. Each level offers various escape routes but also introduces perilous obstacles. Players can immerse themselves in the seemingly boundless and unsettling levels of the backrooms, experiencing the game's eerie and intricate mazes.

name: Vampire Story
short_description: Vampire Story - this is a 2D RPG with elements of survival in which you will need to complete the tasks of the demon you serve.

name: Trash Horror Collection 3
short_description: We bring you 10 short horror/comedy games in this collection. Inspired by the 'Tales From the Crypt' series and cult horror movies from the 80's/90's.

name: Aqua Marbles - Ocean
short_description: Deep in the abyss of the ocean lies an underwater kingdom. Dive into a submarine atmosphere complete with colorful graphics and exciting music, but keep an eye out! In the deepest darkest corners lie sunken ships and castles full of danger. Check out match-3 from a fresh perspective!

name: Revival Quest
short_description: To save their hometown from being shutdown, Ravilla and Tyris must do everything in their power to revive the town's once thriving mine and revive Elsinki to its former glory. Another classic RPG from developer ShiroKuroSoft!

name: Moonflower
short_description: When the source of the kingdoms magic is in danger, High Alchemist Nika Skylar has no choice but to intervene. Joined by a mysterious detective Skylar must act before the kingdom is plunged into darkness.

name: The PenguinGame -Antarctic Savior-
short_description: -Collect air conditioners, save Antarctica! Only you can save penguins. Antarctic savior! This is an open world adventure game with various contents such as sports mini-games, FPS, boss battles, item farming, quests, platformers, and puzzles.

name: Storyteller
short_description: Storyteller is an award-winning puzzle game about building stories. Start with a title, settings and characters and create a story that fits the story’s description. Play with stories of love, intrigue, crime, monsters, betrayal, and more!

name: Resident Evil 4
short_description: Survival is just the beginning. Six years have passed since the biological disaster in Raccoon City. Leon S. Kennedy, one of the survivors, tracks the president's kidnapped daughter to a secluded European village, where there is something terribly wrong with the locals.

name: The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners - Chapter 2: Retribution
short_description: Hunted by the seemingly unstoppable Axeman and facing off against the Tower’s latest push for total dominance, discover what connects these new threats together before it’s too late. New faces, places, weapons and gear all await you on your journey to a final showdown for the city's fate.

name: Gverse
short_description: Gverse is an MMORPG developed in the first quarter of 2021. The main aim of the game is not PvP. The main purpose is to create your own avatar and spend time with your friends in the Gverse universe, which is a digital world. So what awaits us at Gverse?

name: CODING ROBO
short_description: Learn programming in a fun way! An educational game that teaches the basics of programming and algorithmic logic. No prior knowledge of programming is required to play.

name: My Life as a Cult Leader
short_description: After you lose your job and apartment, you're left with nothing. Forced to spend the night on a cold park bench, you curse your fate, only for a beautiful woman calling herself Shima Itsuki to appear and ask you to be a cult leader...

name: Eloriasha
short_description: A difficult, 'die and retry' old school action-platformer about a man's crazy journey to save the world.

name: Schildmaid MX
short_description: Outnumbered and outgunned in deep space? No problem! Turn your enemies' attacks into pure bullet heaven with your shield tech and absorb projectiles to power up your ship and score big! But when your shield expires and it's danger time, you better switch up your strategy fast...

name: The Die Is Cast
short_description: The Die Is Cast is an interactive fiction set in a medieval-fantasy universe. You will have to balance your skills and make the right decisions to survive the scenario and reach your goal.

name: Polygone
short_description: Polygone is a low-poly, yet highly visual take on the classic 'Zombie Modes' in modern first person shooters. Play with up to four friends to fight off endless hordes of over 50 different zombies and bosses on a massive map that you'll need to unlock areas to explore.

name: Ten Seconds Trillion
short_description: Ten Seconds Trillion is a unique clicker game with simple goals but addictive gameplay. Can you reach one trillion value just by clicking and buying upgrades?

name: pWordle
short_description: pWordle is a fun and challenging word puzzle game inspired by the popular game Wordle and is available in multiple languages. With a virtual keyboard, Word of the Day, and Freeplay mode, a jukebox, gallery, players can unlock images and earn Steam achievements while improving their vocabulary.

name: Monster Racing League
short_description: Monster Racing League is a fast-paced multiplayer combat racing game that has been crafted for maximum fun. The monsters drive themselves, freeing up players to time the use of offensive and defensive abilities to disrupt their opponents. Races are short, hectic, sometimes reckless, but always fun!

name: Radical Road
short_description: A casual, one button, arcade game about getting a car to go as far as it can on an infinite procedurally generated road, while collecting coins.

name: Dark rune
short_description: Dark rune - A story about a bounty hunter who decided to serve the local sheriff. The area is full of dangers and you have to deal with them alone. Find the dark rune stolen by the dark magician!

name: Ghosts of Tabor
short_description: Ghosts of Tabor is VRs only FPS PVP and PVE survival game where you will use your wits, skills and resources to survive. Inspired by games such as Escape from Tarkov and DayZ, featuring different scenarios from scavenging to looting and crafting. Will you survive long enough to make it out alive?

name: THNT : Target Hunt 'N Terminate
short_description: You’ve woken up in an artificial body on a strange and hostile world. Can you uncover its secrets and fight your way out? Take part in a metal fueled FPS single-player campaign that combines frantic action with tactical decision-making.

name: Hearth's Light Potion Shop
short_description: A cozy, casual potion-making, relationship-building, and shop-managing game, that is complimented by an array of deep mechanics to keep crafting potions satisfying and interesting regardless of how many times you've done it.

name: Horror Explus
short_description: Paranormal first-person horror game. which takes place in thunderous weather, an abandoned psychiatric hospital. In that place, you find horror experience or just escape. It's your choice.

name: Out of the Park Baseball 24
