short_description: Play What The Pros Play! Officially licensed by MLB, the MLB Players Inc., and KBO, Out of the Park Baseball 24 is the newest in the award-winning sports strategy series. A sports fan’s dream come true - and the only game ever to win Metacritic PC Game of the Year Award TWICE.

name: NOT the Hero
short_description: NOT the hero Yes, you are not the hero in this story, neither are you the right guy. but you will be doing it anyway!

name: Words of Wisdom
short_description: Poetic, philosophical and challenging platformer experience? That’s all about Words of Wisdow — innovative mix of hardcore platformer with text riddles and word puzzles.

name: Turbo Racing
short_description: Turbo Racing is an arcade motorsport drift racing game filled with driving fun and a healthy competitive spirit.

name: Legendary Realms: A Fantasy World Odyssey
short_description: Legendary Realms: A Fantasy World Odyssey is a multiplayer sandbox adventure game. Create your own character, select classes, and take on quests to earn rewards and level up. With a range of equipment and multiplayer options, it's an immersive experience that will keep you engaged for hours.

name: Atelier Ryza 3: Alchemist of the End & the Secret Key
short_description: The final summer, the final secret... Ryza's final adventure is about to begin!

name: BLOOD RITE
short_description: A gruesome human resources game. Mine gems to spawn new minions. Sacrifice these minions to keep ahead of the fire. Then use their blood for special powers like shields, power-ups, and daggers to defeat incoming foes. Towers will turn minions into archers, electrocutioners or human crossbow bolts.

name: WAR ON THE STREET
short_description: WAR ON THE STREET is a top-down shooter game in which you have to fight a group of terrorists occupying the streets of Zamir city. Take them out, run or die.

name: Tide Girl: Phenomena
short_description: Enjoy the murder by the word.

name: Scar of the Doll: A Psycho-Horror Story about the Mystery of an Older Sister
short_description: 'Scar of the Doll' is a remake of the full-fledged psychological suspense ADV that was produced by Child-Dream in 1998 and recorded an exceptional hit.

name: Farm Day 2023
short_description: Looking for a fun and addictive farming simulation game? Look no further than Farm Day 2023! Develop your farming capabilities, grow crops, and build your own town. With beautiful graphics and a relaxed gameplay style, it's perfect for players of all ages. Start your farming adventure today!

name: 我在终点线等你
short_description: 一个讲述少年少女勇敢踏出追梦第一步的青春日常系故事。

name: Yukiiro Sign
short_description: A story of three girls and one season in the snowy town of Minamiouse.

name: Deceive Inc.
short_description: Go undercover as the world’s greatest spies in this tense multiplayer game of subterfuge. Disguise as anyone, deploy an arsenal of high-tech gadgets or neutralize the competition. As long as you extract with the objective, no trick is too dirty when you work for DECEIVE INC.

name: Backrooms Exploration
short_description: Traverse your way through this Atmospheric Psychological Horror! Explore the 9 eerie levels of The Backrooms, a place where everything seems familiar, with a constant feeling of something or someone watching you. Why were you chosen to enter The Backrooms?

name: Can of Wormholes
short_description: Push, slice, ingest, flip, and squish worms in this puzzle game in which you play as a little sentient tin can.

name: GRAPPIN
short_description: After a difficult awakening, you stumble upon the Grip, a mysterious artifact and grappling hook. Climb up the Mountain to bring back the Grip to the top and unravel the mystery surrounding the Grip. Bon voyage!

name: Misericorde: Volume One
short_description: Misericorde: Volume One is the first part of a series of mystery visual novels set in a convent in 1482.

name: Omen of Sorrow
short_description: Omen of Sorrow brings monsters of horror, literature and mythology together for a fighting game experience unlike any other. Inspired by numerous arcade classics but offering its own unique innovations and mature aesthetics, Omen of Sorrow positively bleeds style!

name: WWW
short_description: World Wide Warfare (WWW) is the final battle between the good and evil forces of the ancient and modern world. Join the fray.

name: 三國立志傳2
short_description: 人氣經典策略RPG遊戲《三國立志傳二》，不僅強化一代深受歡迎的特色，更加入多項新玩法！戰鬥模式新增騎馬打仗、機關車、特殊計謀，並加入天候與風向增添謀略性！重要的將領還會隨著成長改變造型，更高自由度的開放劇情，劉備、曹操與孫權三國主君任你選，吳蜀魏三國名將英雄伴你重寫新三國！

name: Battle Tracks
short_description: Unleash mayhem in Battle Tracks, a top-down action-adventure game. Confront waves of enemies, play with or challenge friends, explore six unique worlds, and earn stars to advance through uncharted territories.

name: Warp Tango
short_description: Warp Tango is a 1-6 player co-op survival shooter where you exterminate waves of darn vermin with your friends. Warp between the map's islands, grab strange weapons, and revive your teammates until the vermin claim you.

name: BookyPets Legends
short_description: BookyPets Legends is a videogame of adventure, exploration and collecting, whose main objective is to encourage children from 7 to 12 years to read in an easy and funny way.

name: Adventures of DaKoo the Dragon
short_description: Adventures of DaKoo the Dragon has over 150 levels, using a randomized vortex level rollout to make every run of the game unique. Animations, enemy spawning, and attacks are all randomized to enhance the immersion. With multiple ways to attack you will take on 5 Bosses among multiple obstacles.

name: Formula Retro Racing - World Tour
short_description: A retro racer updated for the modern age, rediscover nostalgic racing as you drive through iconic locations in Formula Retro Racing: World Tour Fusing 90s-style arcade racing with realistic physics, split-screen multiplayer, and 60fps performance. With new tracks and car types!

name: The Dawn is Inevitable
short_description: The Dawn is Inevitable is an interactive crime drama/neo-western novel inspired by classic RPG games. A mysterious stranger is forced to hide in a village called Rassvet. This place is isolated from the outside world for the whole winter and keeps many dark secrets.

name: Innchanted
short_description: Run a Magical Inn with friends! Yarrul’s family Inn has been stolen by an evil wizard landlord! Team up with friends to reclaim your family's legacy. Manage your inn, brew potions, fish, cook, and fight in this hectic & heartfelt magical adventure. Play solo or co-op for 1-4 players.

name: Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon
short_description: Step into a dark reimagination of Arthurian legends in this first person, open world RPG. Explore a world stuck in everlasting autumn, witness falling legends and make meaningful choices woven into a complex, branching storyline.

name: Rally 9000
short_description: Complete tracks as fast as possible to unlock levels and car upgrades! Customize your car & build custom levels and enjoy your own rally!

name: Be a Rock
short_description: A unique 3rd-person exploration game set in a beautiful open world. Your spirit is born in the form of a rock as you explore canyons, deserts, and volcanic lands in order to uncover secrets of the past. The game features puzzle solving, and a distinct storytelling style. For fans of Journey.

name: Merging Cubes
short_description: Unique puzzle game absolutely addictive gameplay. Puzzles with thousands pieces! Hardcore challenges and infinite fun!

name: Super Uriel
short_description: Keep one eye open! Super Uriel is back, and he is on a mission to defeat the Greedy Slime Monsters once and for all. Casually play and/or speedrun through 30 action packed levels. This video game is an exciting mix of platform and rpg. Prepare for ultimate game-play glory!

name: Chinese Expeditionary Force - Assault Team
short_description: Chinese Expeditionary Force - Assault Team is a tactical stealth game set in the expedition of the Chinese Expeditionary Force to Burma during World War II. The assault team consists of five characters, each with their own special skills. You can use different strategies to complete the mission.

name: All Goblin
short_description: All Goblin is a surreal third person experience containing jumping puzzles, interconnected world design and a semi-automatic slingshot. All Goblin is an ever expanding Goblin Game, it contains the necessary components for a Goblin related experience.

name: Troublemaker
short_description: Grab a backpack, boxing tape, and focus on what high school is all about: Beating the ever loving crap out of one another! Troublemaker blends favorite action-adventure-beat-'em-up elements from the strongest traditions in the genre.

name: BETON BRUTAL
short_description: Climb a massive overgrown concrete tower while constantly at risk of falling and losing precious progress. BETON BRUTAL offers a fluid and responsive first person parkour experience through tranquil brutalist architecture.

name: The Last Of The Core
short_description: The Last Of The Core is a third person survival horror shooter for one player where you are a soldier member of the 'Two Six' team. You must recover samples in an area where there was an incident at the research facility and dinosaurs are on the loose everywhere.

name: Terra Nil
short_description: Terra Nil is an intricate environmental strategy game about transforming a barren wasteland into a thriving, balanced ecosystem. Bring life back to a lifeless world by purifying soil, cleaning oceans, planting trees, and reintroducing wildlife, then leave without a trace.

name: OrbRider
short_description: OrbRider makes indoor cycling fun! You ride and explore up to 7 different tracks and biomes as you take on multiple challenges, gather resources, and unlock new and undiscovered areas. Personal ANT+ USB hardware dongle and ANT+ enabled speed sensor or smart trainer equipment required.

name: Pop Some Eyes
short_description: Pop Some Eyes is a FPS game where you control Mr. Pineapple Bundy, in a space jail where he must fight aliens to survive. The game features fast-paced action, unique sci-fi/comedy storyline, and 3 different weapons. Help Mr. Pineapple navigate the dangers of the space jail and defeat alien forces.

name: Farmer's Father: Save the Innocence
short_description: War breeds heroes you've never heard of. You are the ordinary person holding a huge burden of protecting what's most precious and innocent. Fight with hunger, wounds, cold, disease, and enemy cruelty. Defend your family and survive the war!

name: 9 Years of Shadows
short_description: Fight to bring beautiful colors back to a hand-crafted world of darkness and discover the story of Europa, a young warrior, and her ghostly childhood companion, Apino.

name: Takara Cards
short_description: Takara Cards is a fusion of deckbuilding and tactical RPG about adventuring through Cosmos and Karma. Pilot medieval ships using Cards and find the Dragons! Each adventure through space offers new challenges and events in this roguelike!

name: Train to Nowhere
short_description: How could an ordinary trip turn into a nightmare? Discover the secret of the creepy train and help the main hero get out of this pool of horror.

name: Ascendant's Roguelike
short_description: A fantasy based roguelike. Ascend and slay endless hordes or monster while gaining the abilities of each creature you slay.

name: Traffic Brains 2
short_description: Fix urban traffic issues by placing road signs and programming traffic light patterns. Create green lanes, and divert traffic!

name: DROP - System Breach
short_description: Welcome to DROP, a fast-paced action-strategy hacking simulator. Ready to hack your way to fame and fortune while avoiding getting caught? Use stealth and cunning to maneuver between the ongoing power struggle of corporations and factions to control the fragmented networks in the city.

name: Random Chat
short_description: Based on the weekly Naver Webtoon 'Random Chat,' this new visual novel breathes life into the story by re-forming it into a love simulation game!

name: Survival Sprint
short_description: Try your best to choose and match different weapons, supportive items and also your unique active skills. Your goal is to survive!! Use coins to upgrade your characters, unlock new characters and also maps.

name: Super Passport Bros
short_description: Join Matt and Pat as they traverse through strange lands to find their love interests. This game is a 3D platformer with platforming elements. This game has secret levels, secret characters and multiple endings.

name: Manacle | 猪仔
short_description: Manacle is set in an impoverished town where players take on the role of a desperate father who becomes a black-market doctor. Players will face chilling truth as they uncover the secrets behind the town's decline and the source of its evil. Get ready for a thrilling and intense gaming experience.

name: ZED ZONE
short_description: A great catastrophe has come, and you, who are on duty, crash and trapped in a Zed Zone. There are zombies and monsters everywhere, In order to escape, by collecting materials, upgrading skills, building shelters, defeating zombie waves and mysterious mechs, chasing a glimmer of hope.

name: Industrial War
short_description: Explore the world In the 1920s, with more than 800 cities and 200 mines. Know your industrial chain and plan the role of each city; know your nation's unique polity structure and adjust your overall strategy. Resist the restlessness of your neighbors, acquire resources, and develop your industry.

name: Crush the Industry
short_description: Work your way to the top of a big game studio in this roguelike deckbuilder inspired by classic JRPGs!

name: Spike Mtn
short_description: Master fast and fun movement in Spike Mtn to overcome tough challenges in this 2D precision platformer!

name: Amazo
short_description: Amazo is an Adventure action game with platform elements set in the Amazon rainforest. In it, you will have to fight mysterious enemies, double jump to reach high locations and avoid falling into deep abyss. On your journey, You will have the help of a little girl and a monkey. Come on, let's go!

name: Pyramis
short_description: Pyramis is a H.R Giger & retro-scifi-inspired survival horror game, that will bring back the genre to its roots and modernize it in the process. The game is driven by its story, beautiful environments, exploration, and horrific themes.

name: Mars Colonization
short_description: The time has finally come when we can enjoy a new stage in human development!

name: Crimson Connect Origin
short_description: Survive, collector's heroes!! game is a fusion genre of real-time strategy and roguelike. Survive to the end through defense-style battles

name: Reclusive
short_description: Robert Livingston sails to a remote northern island to spend the last days of his life there and encounters unexplained phenomena and creatures.

name: Arithal
short_description: Arithal: Chapter Ildsted is a short experience where it takes the player on a classic adventure game combined with turn-based battle mechanics, set in a dark-but-lighthearted world wreathed in snow and beset by monsters from the depths of the ocean. Survive at all costs.

name: sim4D ATC
short_description: You will act as the apron/tower controller and command the inbound/outbound operations by issuing voice commands in the virtual radio channel. The AI captain will interact with synthetic voice. Current version needs to have basic ATC knowledge, and the tutorial will be released in a later version.

name: Bullet Casters
short_description: Embark on an epic Bullet Hell adventure in a fantasy world filled with bizarre monsters and eccentric magicians!

name: LUNARK
short_description: A pixel-art sci-fi adventure set in the midst of a rebellion against a totalitarian regime, LUNARK is a modern take on the 2D cinematic platformer genre of the '90s. Run, jump, hang, climb, roll, and shoot your way through gorgeous and mysterious locations!

name: Lovers in Playa Rosa
short_description: “Lovers in Playa Rosa” is a Romantic Comedy Visual Novel and Yuri Dating Sim where you play as barkeeper Tina Lee as she takes a trip to Mexico to improve her fortunes and explore lesbian love!

name: Drakkar Crew
short_description: Hey rookie, climb aboard! We're heading for adventure across the North Sea on our reliable Viking ship! Choose from one of the charismatic characters, hire some warriors and engage in bloody battles!

name: Celebrity Simulator
short_description: After playing carefree for a few years, I suddenly found that my boss is not young, it is time to settle down and find a good person to marry.

name: Future Front(Idle Game)
short_description: [No internal purchase, 0 payment! Subversive innovation! 0 payment for a thousand players in the same service!] Still playing the card game of charging money for ten consecutive draws?Come and try our subversive and innovative [buyout strategy card game with a thousand players OL]!

name: HIT
short_description: As a newcomer to the gaming industry, I present you with the game I made to kill time while you waiting anything or anyone. The game was created as a car simulator. In subsequent updates, new cars will also be added open world, physics will get a new character similar to real life

name: 三国世界 - TKWORLD
short_description: This is a Cyberpunk style Three Kingdoms MMORPG. Players will start their adventure from the three kingdoms characters who are cyberized. In the game, you will be able to play Zhao Yun, Lv Bu, Zhuge Liang, Diao Chan and many other legendary characters of the three kingdoms

name: ZaBaTa!
short_description: ZaBaTa! is an online multiplayer game where you must find human players hidden among AI NPCs. Blend in, complete missions, and most importantly - don't get caught! Play ZaBaTa! with friends for even more fun.

name: Arena Renovation
short_description: Take on the role of a one-man renovation team tasked with restoring various sports facilities to their former glory. Many of them have been destroyed as a result of time or lack of care. Don't let them go into complete oblivion - roll up your sleeves and breathe new life into them!

name: 1000 Man General
short_description: Command an army of 1000 troops. Create squads from a variety of unit types and give them orders to perform devastating strategic maneuvers. Then lead your army into battle and slice the opposing army into pieces.

name: Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead
short_description: The epitome of a modern traditional roguelike: with turn-based play and a RPG-like skill progression system, it hearkens back to some of the major aspects of this genre. This game has an incredible depth, with a deep inventory system, vehicles and boats, NPCs with their own stories, and more.

name: Gripper
short_description: Gripper is a story-driven action game with boss fights on wheels. Tear your enemies apart with a grappling hook. Rip out their metal hearts to gain abilities. Rescue your family and uncover the secrets of the collapsing world.

name: Idle Simple RPG
short_description: A simple placement game, which only needs to set the role to fight, can achieve full automatic combat.

name: Aery - Calm Mind 3
short_description: Calm down from the hassle of your daily life, experience the feeling of flying, and immerse yourself into beautiful and atmospheric landscapes.

name: Monster Factory
short_description: Play as an unknown organism with different abilities bent on devouring everything in its path. Start as a small blob, rolling around absorbing objects, eating bigger and bigger objects as you go.

name: Hexes
short_description: In Hexes, you move gems on a diamond shaped game board. Matching three or more gems of the same colour will remove them from board. Keep finding matches to prevent your board from filling up.

name: Squad Game
short_description: Squad Game is a unique game that combines side-scrolling adventure with quarter-view turn-based strategic battles.

name: Summer Daze: Tilly's Tale
short_description: A fantasy adventure visual novel with humor and heart, by acclaimed adventure game writer Lori Ann Cole. Starring the voice of Zehra Fazal as Tilly, a mischief-making rogue at Hero-U, the school for heroes.

name: Nautikin Adventures
short_description: You are the Nautikins, the dominant species on this ocean planet! Build boats, planes, and helicopters to explore a vast sea filled with islands and mysteries. Play in a sandbox with unlimited parts or a campaign where you strive to reach your goals. Embark with online multiplayer or singleplayer.

name: 赌神模拟器：亚洲风云God Of Gamblers
short_description: Participate in the God of Gamblers Tournament to compete for the Ring of God of Gamblers, date casino beauties, and whether you can gain intimacy is up to you.

name: Catacombs: The Asper Case
short_description: In 1804, doorman Philibert Asper's body was found in the Catacombs of Paris. His death remains unsolved to this day. This VR experience takes you 20 feet underground to uncover the truth about his demise. Find out what lurks in the darkness, but make no mistake, spirits never come alone.

name: Combat Mission Battle for Normandy
short_description: Combat Mission Battle for Normandy faithfully recreates the experience of tactical land warfare in Western France during World War Two.

name: DeathKeep
short_description: DeathKeep is a D&D dungeon delving the way you like it - fast, furious and fun! An evil Necromancer has escaped from his icy prison and is wreaking havoc upon the surrounding lands. Journey to this frozen wasteland and destroy the forces of evil - if you dare.

name: Unknown Ways
short_description: Buckle up and take a ride on this wholesome adventure to places you couldn't even imagine. Help this golem boy to find a way out of these forests and mountains.

name: SHIRIME: The Curse of Butt-Eye
short_description: In SHIRIME: The Curse of Butt-Eye | 尻目 find your missing girlfriend Sharon in Shirime Forest, stalked by the malevolent yokai Shirime. Collect pages to uncover the mystery, but beware: every page increases the intensity of Shirime's pursuit. Can you survive and unravel the truth?

name: Ghostland Yard
short_description: Uncover the truth about the Ghostland Yard investigators disappearance in this challenging 2D platformer. Travel accross the world in more than 130 handcrafted levels to find your friends!

name: Active Soccer 2023
short_description: Explosive retro arcade action is back! Active Soccer 2023 is an exciting retro arcade football game providing a fast-paced arcade experience, implementing amazing playability and responsive easy-to-learn/hard-to-master controls.

name: Cloak & Dagger: Shadow Operations
short_description: A short, single player, third person, tactical stealth action game set in the early 1990's meant to be finished in one sitting. Use the shadows, shoot out lights, stun enemies, and conceal yourself in the darkness through 5 Missions.

name: Tomomon
short_description: Experience the best of both worlds with our monster taming game - relive the nostalgia of classic role-play games, while enjoying fresh and immersive gameplay. Capture and train unique monsters in stunning environments, and put your skills to the test in challenging 3v3 battles.

name: Phantom Hunter
short_description: Unleash your inner Phantom Hunter in a supernatural 8-bit world! Battle against relentless ghosts, dodge a hail of bullets, and gather materials to unlock new classes and customize your abilities with powerful pendants. Will you rise to the challenge and become the ultimate ghost exterminator?

name: T.D.Z. 3 Dark Way of Stalker
short_description: Atmospheric Stalker adventure in the post-Apocalypse world!

name: The Great War: Western Front™
short_description: The Great War: Western Front is the definitive WW1 strategy game. Play a deciding role in history with this real-time tactical experience as you take charge in the iconic Western Front from 1914 to 1919. Pick your faction and lead your forces to victory.

name: Plasma
short_description: Plasma is an engineering sandbox. Unleash your creativity with fun and intuitive robotics, physics, and visual programming tools.

name: Solbane
short_description: Battle against bosses in a shoot'em up combined with RPG elements. Choose between three diverse classes, and create your combo build from a pool of over 50 abilities. The game features a variety of bosses that require different strategies and builds to conquer.

name: Beyond Polaris Guardian
short_description: Beyond Polaris Guardian is a action-rpg and TPS on a flexible campaign system with different stories. Incarne 3 unique characters and develop your personal story thanks to the innovative Galactic Network system.

name: 江城创业记
short_description: 如果可以的话，你想过回古代开办工厂、精炼石油、甚至建造大型计算机吗？一场即将到来的陨石坠落闹得人心惶惶，而你的工厂却在此时挖出了一台古怪的时光机，际遇风云，你穿越回千年前的江城，成为了一个工坊主……为何穿越的会是你？门派之争、工坊暗斗、异族矛盾、皇子复辟，江城平静的表面暗流涌动，你又能否玩转千年前的江城？

name: experiment: one
short_description: Psychological horror in which you will have to try on the role of a psychologist on a helpline, as well as be drawn into a series of strange events taking place in the office.

name: Death Roads: Tournament
short_description: Combine deadly racing, deckbuilding, and roguelite style to get car battles unlike anything before! Choose a driver, car, weapons, and sponsors to overcome tactical encounters. Adapt to an ever-changing race to come out on top and earn entry into the last safe haven on the Divided States of America.

name: PictoPull
short_description: 3D block puzzles built from pixel art! Push, pull, and climb on the blocks of a PictoPull puzzle in order to reach the goal. Create your own puzzles and share them!

name: GunSoul Girl 2
short_description: This is a third-person shooting game.The story takes place in the future world, because of the doomsday worldview caused by the proliferation of artificial intelligence viruses. You will use the gunsoul girls to complete missions and fight against evil organizations, mutant monsters and more.

name: Linked Worlds
short_description: Linked Worlds is a JRPG with unique twists to the genre. Immerse yourself in strategic battles that take place in a grid-based movement system, 100 abilities to equip and unequip offering a deep level of customization, and a time mechanic that adds an extra layer of challenge to your adventure.

name: Temporian
short_description: If you were sent back 10,000 years into the past, could you not only survive, but give ancient Earth a technological leap forward? Based on real techniques and technology, (re)invent everything from an apple pie to electricity.

name: The Adventures of LinShanHai - Chapter3:The Headless Woman
short_description: 本案是林山海探案集的第三案，有人报告一个废弃厂房最近恶臭难闻，有人发现房梁上挂着一具腐烂的尸体，系A市人民医院太平间丢失的女尸，尸体有被侵犯的痕迹，头被割去。警方调查毫无头绪。您将在多个案发地点进行搜证调查，破解这宗神秘的案件

name: Final Age
short_description: FINAL AGE is a first person single player psychological horror game . The player takes on the role of a curious investigator who is drawn to a cottage which was previously owned by an army man Samuel, who mysteriously disappeared during a war. Contains tricky puzzles. Needs good observation skills.

name: AsteRoid Rage
short_description: Destroy everything in this short casual physics game!

name: Crosswalks
short_description: Crosswalks in a visual novel that tells different stories when you switch among perspectives. In 2018, an explainable portal appeared under the city of Sanghville, linking two parallel universe together. On one side there are dozens of unsolvable crimes, while the other side was always peaceful...

name: Search
short_description: The existence of all mankind is under threat. You are the only hope!

name: Hana's Campus Life!
short_description: What does one do when a girl appears, claiming to be a god? For college student Jeong Lee-Han, his life suddenly becomes turned upside down by the appearance of the god, Hana. A supernatural love comedy visual novel with multiple endings.

name: I commissioned some dogs
short_description: I paid more artists to hide dogs and bones in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

name: Deadnaut: Signal Lost
short_description: From the developer of cult hits Deadnaut, Zafehouse Diaries and Fear Equation comes Deadnaut: Signal Lost. In this slick, fast-paced roguelike you’ll take control of a single Deadnaut, unlock suit upgrades and abilities, fight cosmic horrors, and investigate drifting wrecks and abandoned moons.

name: Super Greedy Cat
short_description: Help King-Meow to collect gold to increase your cat speed and make the higher score in this precision platformer.

name: GUTTERBRAWLERS
short_description: GUTTERBRAWLERS is a snappy 2D fighting game with a combat system inspired by early Klassics. Featuring online mode with rollback netcode implemented using GGPO open-source code.

name: Stories from the Outbreak
short_description: Stories from the Outbreak is a turn-based zombie roguelike RPG. Lead a group of survivors from the doomed city of Riga towards the ferry sailing across the North Sea. Scavenge supplies, fight the zombies, decide the fate of your crew. What are you willing to sacrifice to survive the zombie plague?

name: 『LACKGIRL I - "Astra inclinant, sed non obligant."』
short_description: A visual novel about a magic battle between girls. Iris' is a boarding school where students learn about magic. The girls gathered there all have mental defects. This is a story of magical girls with flawed minds and their battles and growth.

name: Souls of White Star
short_description: Souls of White Star is a sci-fi turn-based card wargame Roguelike strategy game. The different design of [double-sided technology moving cards] and [bandwidth draw cost] will test your judgment and decision more!

name: Smalland: Survive the Wilds
short_description: Experience a big adventure on a tiny scale! Enjoy multiplayer survival in a vast, hazardous world. Preparation is key when you're this small & at the bottom of the food chain. Craft weapons & armour, tame & ride creatures, build encampments & explore a strange new land.

name: The Last Worker
short_description: The Last Worker is an immersive narrative adventure centered around a lone worker’s last stand in an increasingly automated world. Kurt works for the world’s largest retailer and is forced to choose between capitalism or activism.

name: Saga of Sins
short_description: Saga of Sins is an expiatory action-adventure which features a mystical storyline and a rewarding arcade gameplay! Transform into demonic creatures and fight the seven deadly sins.

name: Silver Box Classics
short_description: This collection brings back a gathering of adaptations of the events in the first four Dragonlance role-playing modules, at the beginning of the War of the Lance. These are the first video games adaptations of D&D that started it all.

name: Mr Rabbit's Cambridge Point and Click Adventure
short_description: Discover an imagery Cambridge in this dynamic point and click adventure game. Find Mr Rabbit before The SS P320 leaves!

name: ACL Pro Cornhole
short_description: Immerse yourself in the most realistic Cornhole simulation ever created with accurately motion captured player movement, detailed 3D modeled environment, official ACL bags, and commentary from legendary Cornhole personalities Trey Ryder and Bernie Nabors.

name: Super Puzzle Cross
short_description: Super Puzzle Cross is a real time puzzle game with rogue-like features. Use one of six weapons, each providing a different puzzle experience. Upgrade your character with armor, artifacts, and even pets to prepare for life and death puzzle combat.

name: Project Astra Dominium
short_description: Project Astra Dominium is a Tower Defense game with Basebuilding and Automation elements. Build up your base to become a supply hub for Earth's desperately needed materials, gather resources while defending against an unknown alien threat and improve your tower's and AI capabilities.

name: Spelljammer: Pirates of Realmspace
short_description: Swashbuckling excitement and the magic of D&D adventures - in wildspace. Captain your own Spelljammer ship. Recruit officers and crew to man your magical ship. Soar into the ether and explore the planets of Realmspace.

name: Doodle World Deluxe
short_description: The award winning NES homebrew, now available for the PC. No emulator required! Play as Doodle and travel across the world to defeat King Eraser and his minions. This Deluxe edition includes the never before released, Doodle World Redrawn! Two games in one amazing package!

name: Sifu
short_description: Sifu is a realistic third-person brawler with tight Kung Fu combat mechanics and cinematic martial arts action embarking you on a path for revenge.

name: Final Dose
short_description: There's an issue with your vaccination status. To correct it, you've been ordered to arrive at an unlisted clinic. You don't have much choice so you walk in... to get attacked by a psychotic nurse! You better find a way to escape before she injects you with the FINAL DOSE!

name: The Orphan
short_description: In The Orphan, you'll step into the shoes of Eric, a young orphan who has returned to the abandoned orphanage. As you explore its dark and twisted corridors, you'll encounter all manner of supernatural creatures and otherworldly horrors that will test your courage and your sanity.

name: Crab Champions
short_description: Claw your way across exotic islands combining fluid movement with fast paced combat to become a Crab Champion in this third person shooter with roguelike elements.

name: Age of Gladiators Reforged
short_description: Age of Gladiators Reforged is a remake of the 2016 indie game. A single-player strategy/management experience set at the height of the bloody gladiatorial games in ancient Rome that allows you to manage your fighters as they increase in level, forging them into killing machines and champions.

name: Trans Agent X
short_description: Evil gatekeepers. Transgendered protagonist. Overdue reckoning.This is a casual sci-fi action-adventure bullet-hell dodger about transgender people re-visiting a post-apocalyptic earth and searching for a lost artefact. A wholesome trauma-healing adventure.

name: Digital Diamond Baseball V11
short_description: Digital Diamond Baseball is a statistically accurate baseball simulator and tabletop board game companion.

name: Banana Clicker
short_description: Collect bananas, hire workers, and gear up your banana in Banana Clicker, the ultimate idle game. Can you become the best banana collector?

name: Capoo Pals
short_description: Completely stress-free desktop games, heal your boredom at work and school Let the cute and funny Capoo accompany you every moment of using the computer

name: Papa's Freezeria Deluxe
short_description: Return to Calypso Island to serve seasonal sundae treats in Papa's Freezeria Deluxe! Craft sundaes for all your quirky customers while earning tips, points and Special Recipes. Switch gears and take a trip in the Food Truck to concoct your own chilly creations and see who shows up!

name: The Last Hero
short_description: The city needs your help!

name: Water tank| 貯水槽
short_description: One day, one year after his wife's disappearance, the protagonist decides to cut away their memories and painful memories in order to break his hopes that she will come back to him.

name: United Assault - World War 2
short_description: PACIFIC - EASTERN FRONT - NORTH AFRICA - WESTERN FRONT | Fight on land, sea and air in an open world rogue lite FPS set in authentic theatres of of World War 2.

name: Blind and Schizophrenic
short_description: Fornicate with hookers, smoke weed, or just sit at home collecting welfare, how will you spend your life as a blind old man with schizophrenia? Can you survive even one day as this poor, decrepit wretch? Or will you show the world that it should pay attention to irate old farts with nothing to lose?

name: Johnny Chainsaw
short_description: A platformer without a jump button. Use your chainsaw to navigate the world.

name: Historic Fighters
short_description: Historic Fighters is a turn-based game with single-player and two-player modes. Pick a class of fighters ranging from warriors from ancient Sparta to gun-wielding cowboys, build your score and unlock new class levels and game items to build a great team!

name: DREDGE
short_description: DREDGE is a single-player fishing adventure with a sinister undercurrent. Sell your catch, upgrade your boat, and dredge the depths for long-buried secrets. Explore a mysterious archipelago and discover why some things are best left forgotten.

name: Railways: Train Simulator
short_description: Mind the gap and start managing your railways through this strategic journey! All aboard! This train is ready to depart!

name: Unlimited Fight Ultimate Strike
short_description: In the best 3D style, a continuation of the first game in the Unlimited Fight series, with improvements in combat mechanics, visuals, stories and much more, immerse yourself in this world full of action, epic and intense battles alone or with friends

name: Island Bender
short_description: Island Bender is a physics-based couch-fighting earthbending game with up to 6 players. Throw rocks at each other, collect power-ups and master your bending style to beat your opponents.

name: 一九三零 浪漫譚
short_description: 《1930 浪漫譚》為以臺灣文史題材女性向文字冒險遊戲。講述因一場意外，玩家須協助失憶的「名士」找回記憶。在尋憶的過程中，玩家將在「世界之書」記載的歷史中扮演重要的見證者，並穿梭於各種充滿歷史人文韻味的街道巷弄間，與名士們一同找回缺失的記憶。

name: Vault City
short_description: You come out of the Vault, build a magnificent city.

name: The Last of Us™ Part I
short_description: Experience the emotional storytelling and unforgettable characters in The Last of Us™, winner of over 200 Game of the Year awards.

name: Survive Now
short_description: In this thrilling top-down roguelite survival game, you'll face off against hordes of creatures in a desperate battle for survival. You'll need to collect energy to unlock new skills and upgrade existing ones, and every moment counts as you fight your way through waves of monsters.

name: Vertigo 2
short_description: Vertigo 2 is a single-player VR adventure. Explore the depths of the vast Quantum Reactor as you descend to finish your journey home.

name: BulletLive
short_description: BulletLive is a rhythm shooting game in which players shoot targets in VR space in rhythm. Players shoot targets that appear in all directions with blasters held in both hands at the right time.

name: Glory Room
short_description: Glory Room is a Roguelike game that can be played quickly and lightly. It proceeds with stories of the characters who have no choice but to come to the hellish arena. Various items, monsters and traps give you trials. Overcome it and create your own show to defeat the demons and reclaim your glory!

name: INFINITE GUITARS
short_description: Fight mechs with metal-crushing rock in Infinite Guitars, a genre-melting Rhythm RPG featuring vibrant anime-inspired art and a blazing original soundtrack. Battle against war machines with electrifying Guitar Solos, and save the planet!

name: Boom Royale
short_description: Boom Royale - Shooting Game Boom Royale-building Flash is intense combat multiplayer! Take on up to 8 players online in this 2D game with cartoony visuals and gameplay between Soldat and Halo, inspired by the shooter Mini Militia and Teeworlds.

name: Robot Lawn Mower
short_description: Robot Lawn Mower is a relaxing and satisfying robot grass cutting game

name: Speed Dates Part I
short_description: Speed Dates Part I is a romantic-comedy interactive (FMV) game where you determine the course of the conversation with the options that appear. Experience a speed date with 18 attractive women.

name: MouseLife - Parenthood
short_description: Mouse Life - Parenthood is a simulation type game in which you play as a little mouse who has to raise his child. You will have to scavenge for cheese, stop ants from stealing it and stay away or hide from the cats that wish you gone.

name: 斗地主少女在线版
short_description: This is a game of multiplayer online competition+character collection. In the fierce battle between three players and landlords, different characters are used to play games, making the game process full of changes.

name: SimPoly Drive
short_description: Welcome to our open-world transportation strategy game! Choose from a variety of vehicles to transport goods and people across a dynamic landscape. Level up and increase your income as you explore the world. Become the ultimate transportation tycoon in our thrilling new game!

name: Well...
short_description: 'Well...' is a very difficult first-person platformer. Start off by helping an old woman get a ring that she 'dropped' down the well, what happens after, you'll never expect. Disclaimer: If you're experienced at CS climb, this game may be easy for you.

name: Fantasy Empires
short_description: Create alliances, defeat enemy kingdoms and forge an empire in this Dungeons & Dragons game world! Under the computer Dungeon Master, you’ll interact with fantastic races, command dozens of troop types, send your heroes on quests and construct a variety of buildings and fortifications.

name: Anyaroth: The Queen's Tyranny
short_description: A pixel-art platformer adventure game with lots of action and a memorable story.Dive into the depths of planet Anyaroth and free its people from the tyranny of the Queen. Join the Rebellion and fight against the Regime’s mind-control system. The anya civilization needs you!
Detective visual novel about mysteries of rural Russian town in 90-s, anime style.

name: 柒愿传说
short_description: 一款回合制的RPG游戏。1549个地块组成的大地图，每个地块都会触发一个事件，非线性叙事，您可以自由地探索这个世界。本作的主要战斗系统是融合了卡牌元素的RPG回合制战斗，除此之外还包含了建造、挖矿、种植、好感度、合成、装备、镶嵌、交易、宠物收集、派遣、赌场小游戏、卡组收集等多项养成系统，同时满足您种田、收集与战斗的爱好。

name: Heartwood Heroes
short_description: A fast-paced board game for up to 4 players featuring humorous quests, quick turn-based combat and multiple-choice events. Explore the board, equip your character, get a job, and fight to become Hero of the Week! Play locally or online with Steam Remote Play.

name: Golden Rails: Valuable Package
short_description: After losing some packages, postman Philip turns to his new friends, Jack and Jill, for help in delivering all the remaining packages to their rightful owners. But it's not just a simple delivery task; the bandits are willing to do whatever it takes to get their hands on the valuable packages.

name: RAIDBORN
short_description: RAIDBORN is a straightforward first-person fantasy action RPG featuring procedurally generated dungeons and quests. Plunder a treasure-strewn world, upgrade your gear, level up your skills, and hurl yourself into intense combat.

name: 无限投影2
short_description: In the novel and anime worlds, players could collect apostles and fight against the forces of chaos. Build the legendary team and conquer all the multiverses!

name: ALTF42
short_description: [3rd Person / Permadeth / Adventure] ALTF42 brings a host of new traps to the table. Be careful not to break your keyboard and mouse from all the excitement.

name: Samurai Slaughter House
short_description: VR-only physics-based combat game. Use stealth and creativity or brute force to take on your foes in a vast physics based sandbox. Battle both humans and demons while exploring a large metroidvania-style open world. Collect items and power up your character. Explore towns and interact with NPCs.

name: DragonStrike
short_description: The FIRST-EVER dragon combat simulator! This is DragonStrike, where the deadly skies above the Dragonlance game world of Krynn explode before your very eyes. The first-person viewpoint propels you into a fully animated, 3D world of action and excitement! To the skies brave knight - and victory!

name: KingMini
short_description: It's time to challenge yourself! KingMini is a game filled with extreme challenges and passion, putting your perseverance and skills to the test. This game is highly recommended for players who crave challenging and fulfilling gameplay. Don't hesitate, take on the challenge with KingMini right now!

name: Prison Life 2
short_description: Play as a Prisoner or a Guard with up to 12 players(or alone) in an online prison game. Loot, Craft, and make your way to the exit, or investigate and arrest wanted players as a guard!

name: Architecture Zeitgeist
short_description: Architecture Zeitgeist is a project that aims to popularize and make architecture education accessible. The game consists of 3D tours where the player will be able to visit and interact in real time with iconic architecture projects.

name: 蕾拉 Layla
short_description: “Layla” is a walking simulation and visual novel combined game about a story of memories of old times.

name: Qualification as Rogue
short_description: A platformer combining fun controls and puzzles to solve traps

name: Dice Kingdoms
short_description: Dice Kingdoms is a turn-based strategy game where resource collection is based on dice. Build efficiently to quickly expand your kingdom. Roll dice to gather resources while risking natural disasters. Attack and defend while developing your kingdom to achieve victory!

name: Full Metal Sergeant
short_description: Be the drill instructor! Insult recruits with no remorse! Can you transform flabby recruits into lean war machines within 12 weeks?

name: Desktop Table Tennis
short_description: Clear your desk for an all new way to play ping-pong! Settle the score with a Rainbow Smash!

name: It Comes In Waves
short_description: A short, minimalist, experimental open-world adventure about guilt and grief. Explore, shoot, scavenge and bring a specimen to The Sanctuary. Beware PERMADEATH.

name: Across the Valley
short_description: Across the Valley is your friendly VR farm where you really lend a hand. Instead of clicking around in menus, you care for the animals and plants with your own hands. Instead of looking at the farm from up above, you yourself can relax in this hand-drawn paradise.

name: Tagger Mascot
short_description: In a residential area with dusk setting, a life-or-death game of tag begins！

name: ToriDori
short_description: ToriDori is a world at the intersection of time. Take on the role of a mystical ship captain and set out to search for differences and temporal paradoxes. A relaxing adventure suitable for all ages awaits you. Pet the cat and set sail!

name: The Game of Fourtune
short_description: How far will you go to get your deepest wish granted? In The Game of Fourtune, help guide Clyde & Devon through this cruel game of life and death. Only one participant will get their wish granted. Four rounds and four deaths each round, are you ready to see if fortune is on your side?

name: Last Year
short_description: Team up with four other Classmates to survive against a sixth player controlling a dreadful, horrifying Fiend, in this evolution of multiplayer horror games inspired by classic horror stories.

name: TerraScape
short_description: In TerraScape you build your own dream city. Each pack of cards in TerraScape offers different buildings and ways to expand your kingdom. Place your cards wisely in the game world to earn points and receive new cards as rewards!

name: Lucky Slots
short_description: Lucky Slot is a single player quick-play game that is fun for all the family - keeping Vegas-style slots in a fun and safe way for all.

name: Bottoms Up!: Part 1
short_description: The most intoxicating story you will ever read... Literally! Bottoms Up! - is a linear Visual Novel type of game that only aims to present compellingly an interesting fantasy world, colorful characters and the largely funny, but sometimes dark shenanigans they get into.

name: Roxy Raccoon 2: Topsy-Turvy
short_description: Roxy Raccoon 2: Topsy-Turvy is a Tilt Maze/Labyrinth style like no other. Play through the next chapter in the Roxy Raccoon Saga, compete in various game modes and customize & create your own levels, then share them with the world!

name: Boomerang Battles
short_description: Boomerang Battles is a fast paced action roguelike where you battle your way through 100 floors of a deadly dungeon with your trusty boomerang in a bid for your freedom. Pick your favourite boomerang, learn its attack patterns, find upgrades, and battle against exciting bosses. Escape if you can.

name: Necogram
short_description: Necogram is a classical nonogram puzzle game in the company of beautiful neko-women

name: EA SPORTS™ PGA TOUR™
short_description: The exclusive home of the Majors, EA SPORTS™ PGA TOUR™ features Pure Strike for superior golf gameplay, powered by ShotLink®, and unrivaled access to the world’s most exclusive golf courses.

name: Spiritfall
short_description: Spiritfall is a fast-paced Action Roguelite with combat inspired by Platform Fighters. Slash, smash, launch, and wall-splat a multitude of enemies using an ever-changing arsenal of divine powers.

name: Terminal Velocity
short_description: Terminal Velocity is an escape flight game. The pace of the game is very tight. The player's goal is to survive as much as possible.

name: Undeadly
short_description: THE DEAD RISE - Direct a group of survivors in a turn-based strategy survival game. Use survivor abilities, scavenge for resources, all while navigating a warped reality strewn with inexplicable phenomena. Come nightfall, undead seek the living. Can you survive, UNDEADLY?

name: Brain Damage
short_description: Challenge your skills and push your limits in Brain Damage, the intense 2D action roguelite shooter with wave-based gameplay. With each upgrade, brain damage increases, making the game more challenging as you progress. Push the game to its limits. Can you break the game before it breaks you?

name: Car Delivery Man
short_description: Immerse yourself in the era of the 90s, driving cars of those years. Become a driver who delivers cars to different countries.

name: Apex Armor Swap Trainer
short_description: The 100% accurate representation of the Armor Swap system from Apex Legends. Use your real game Mouse Sensitivity and Field of View parameters and choose your training mode. Now you're ready to become the best Armor Swapper in the world.

name: Gender Dysphoria
short_description: A short non-linear narrative game about negative experiences after coming out as transgender.

name: Ravenswatch
short_description: Fallen heroes of old folk tales and legends: you are on the verge of a crucial battle against the Nightmare invading and corrupting your world. A roguelike action game from the creators of Curse of the Dead Gods©, playable solo or in online co-op.

name: KITS
short_description: KITS is an assembly game. Discover, construct and admire beautiful little works of art. Set your own complexity and challenge levels and enjoy KITS the way you like to play.

name: The Magical Mixture Mill
short_description: Brew magical mixtures for the local questing heroes - and keep them coming back for more! Team up with a mushroom-loving witch to restore her run-down shop. Build automated production lines, experiment with exotic ingredients, explore a cozy world - and try not to blow everything up.

name: Iron Age
short_description: Iron Age is a First-person dungeon crawler set in a Sci-Fi Fantasy world with Realtime melee combat.

name: Filthy Animals | Heist Simulator
short_description: Filthy Animals is a chaotic multiplayer heist game for 1-4 players. Become a mutant animal working for criminal mastermind Tony as you steal, fight, fall over, and eat tacos while trying to make off with the loot. Solve puzzles, avoid enemies, and bumble your way to victory, ya Filthy Animal!

name: Dark Dead
short_description: Dark Dead is a hardcore 2D action-platformer in which you have to fight an ancient evil and try to understand how and why you ended up in this place.

name: The RailIdle
short_description: Run the rails at the base, collect materials, and use them to head out on your adventure. The rails run automatically, so you can leave them alone! The further you advance, the more side content you unlock!

name: Gambit!
short_description: Gun up and wreak havoc in Gambit! – a 4-player campaign-driven shooter-adventure in a world of gangs, guns, and mayhem.

name: Brinefall
short_description: Embark on an epic journey in Brinefall, where you'll gather resources and construct your own village while exploring a vast open-world filled with secrets and mysteries. Battle fierce enemies and collect valuable loot in this unique blend of sandbox and RPG gameplay.

name: Moviehouse – The Film Studio Tycoon
short_description: Welcome to the big show! Ready the camera, unleash your creativity and and pile up the profits! Grow your operation with your razor-sharp business sense and usher in a new era for filmmakers worldwide.

name: Mizz Survival
short_description: Mizz Survival is Survival game Style , Crafting Building Adventure with friend in the wide world or fight with orther team and meet the horrors at night. 2 GameMode ( 1. Survival , 2. Team Battle )

name: Bye Bye Swingby
short_description: 'Bye Bye Swingby' is a fresh and unique simulation game that tells a sad story of escaping a destroyed Earth and exploring a new world. Take a rocket into space and use the gravity of the stars to travel to new worlds in Swingby.

name: Farm in another world
short_description: Farm in another world tells about the events of a young man born in another world. A World where you can be agriculture, warrior or fisherman! It's up to you to complete this disappearance story! Don't forget to get along with the people in town!

name: Text Twist 3
short_description: • Over 1000 Different levels to play. • Complete dictionaries and thousands of levels for English, German, Italian, Russian, Portuguese, Swedish, Spanish, Turkish, Dutch, and, French languages. • Easy to play. You can use your touch screen or a mouse to play the game.

name: Song Of The Prairie
short_description: Song of The Prairie is a 3D relaxing farm game. A hero who defeat the demon begins a new rural life. Experiencing the fun of exploration to the town. Harvesting giant fruits and crops. Taking care fantastic animals. Dating with someone you like. Just enjoy the farming life only belongs to you!

name: Figure Workshop
short_description: A virtual Figure maker,which generate by MMD model and motion.

name: Brewmastery: Tavern Simulator
short_description: Brewmastery is an innkeper & beer brewery simulator. Build your own brewery and revive the old Tavern. Develop your territory, grow ingredients and try different recipes in a realistic brewing process. Tavern guests can tell you stories & give tasks. And don't forget to pull apart drunk Orcs!

name: Chief Emoji Officer
short_description: Chief Emoji Officer is a text adventure that recreates the absurdities of the tech world by letting you become CEO using only emojis. Climb your way through corporate America by getting promoted, making allies, avoiding layoffs, and turning Redify into the most successful company in the world.

name: 4 Seasons Runner
short_description: Avoid the obstacles by jumping over them and beat your own highscore.

name: The Library of Babel
short_description: Join Ludovik in a 2D Stealth Platformer and Graphic Adventure, as he explores the jungles of a futuristic Babylon to discover the secret behind the Library of Babel’s sudden lockdown and the mysteries behind their mythical creators.

name: HYPERVIOLENT
short_description: An ancient evil has awoken in the depths of a remote mining asteroid, stirred from its slumber by man's lust for power. Unaware, you answer a distress call and become stranded, surrounded by monstrous foes. Unravel the mystery of this madness and stop its spread in this violent retro shooter!

name: 巫族 WITCH RACE
short_description: 'Witch Race' is a lightweight Rogue Auto Chess game, which tells the dark era of the Fantasy World Isefa continent. Strategic formation of army, unlock heroes, make good use of arms and powerful combination skills. Witness the final fate of Witch Race and understand the truth behind the story.

name: MoonLess
short_description: Moonless is a challenging side-scrolling platformer in the style of classic arcade games of the 1980s, where you control a helpless astronaut who has been left stranded on the moon, and now has to face an invading alien force to earn a chance to go home.

name: The Unbeatable Path
short_description: In this realistic and immersive first-person horror adventure, you have to beat riddles and puzzles in a hellish environment. While doing so you will unveil the story of Mia and find out why she was finally driven to taking her own life. Will you change her story for the better?

name: Fluxion
short_description: Fluxion is a thrilling 3D action platformer where you control a spaceship racing through a twisting tunnel, collecting energy orbs and avoiding obstacles.

name: Monster Hide
short_description: Monster hide is an action and cooperation first person shooter for 2-8 players in which you will have to work as a team to achieve your objective in hunt mode or you can also fight with other players in pvp mode.

name: First Racer
short_description: First Racer is an arcade racing game with convenient and simple controls, various game modes, diverse tracks, a wide selection of vehicles, simple stylized graphics, interesting AI, local multiplayer on one screen, visual and technical tuning.

name: Getting Freaky With Fujiki
short_description: In a secluded room of a coworking space, you meet a female student named Fujiki. She talks to you about things in her daily life which you quietly listen to in your room. All while hoping for some peace and quiet. How will your daily life change in your interactions with Fujiki?

name: Celebrity Slot Machine
short_description: Celebrity Slot Machine is a single player quick-play game that is fun for all the family - keeping Vegas-style slots in a fun and safe way for all.

name: Witch's Garden
short_description: 《魔女的花园》是由日本美少女游戏知名大厂Windmill Oasis（风车社）为纪念品牌成立十周年所倾力打造的奇幻恋爱大作。本作同时也是第一部搭载E-Mote动态立绘演出系统的作品，当年一经公布便引起业界震动，并在美少女游戏大赏中荣获诸多奖项。

name: Starblast: 3D Wars
short_description: Twinstick with 3D graphics.

name: Kujlevka
short_description: A flying saucer crash-lands in a distant Russian village, turning a rundown kolkhoz into the first, thin bridge between civilizations. As the first point of contact, you must dictate how this encounter unfolds and ultimately determine history’s outcome.

name: Grimgrad
short_description: Build your own Slavic settlement. Overcome the hardships of medieval life and don't anger the Gods!

name: Oxygen
short_description: Oxygen is a survival city builder. Build your city around the Oxygen Center and ensure your people's survival in a post-apocalyptic future, threatened by crack explosions, deadly winds, droughts and frosts. Lead your people and more importantly keep the Oxygen Center running!

name: The Wingless Bee
short_description: The Wingless Bee is a brand new Frogger-inspired game where a bee named Bella is abruptly thrown far away from the hive she lives and works at. With her wings destroyed, she can only hop to get back home.

name: Story of Animal Sprite
short_description: Story of Animal Sprite is a casual merge game where you will restore the homeland for cute animals by building various fancy structures.

name: VOENKOMAT
short_description: VOENKOMAT is a social game. This game makes it possible to become a worst enemy of teens and guys from CIS countries - military comissar. You need to send to the army as many as possible soldiers, protect yours military HQ from foreign spies and save your soul from karmic devastation.

name: The Wolf of Derevnya
short_description: When the villagers of Derevnya begin turning up maimed, suspicion falls on you. Track down the beast to clear your name and save the village—but to unravel the mystery, you will need to confront your own past. A survival-horror choose your own adventure set in Kievan Rus'.

name: The Dungeon Vendor
short_description: Travel to dungeons. Meet new heroes. Craft new weapons. Collect the loot. You are The Dungeon Vendor. The world has become a dark place and heroes are answering the call. It is time for you to help them by creating powerful weapons… for a tidy profit of course.

name: Curse of the Sea Rats
short_description: Embark on an epic, hand-animated, ‘ratoidvania’ adventure, where your crew has been turned into rats by a pirate witch! Explore a rich non-linear world, enjoy fun action platforming, face challenging bosses, and unlock unique abilities - either alone or in local co-op!

name: STRANGER OF PARADISE FINAL FANTASY ORIGIN
short_description: Developed in cooperation between Square Enix and Team NINJA (Koei Tecmo Games), STRANGER OF PARADISE FINAL FANTASY ORIGIN is a hard-core action RPG that takes the FINAL FANTASY series in a new direction. Experience the boldest and most merciless battles in FINAL FANTASY history.

name: My Dear Dad 父亲
short_description: 小芊的父亲拖着疲惫的身体回家，却发现自家房子被大火吞噬。为了救女儿，他毅然决然冲进火场，但在见到女儿的那一刻晕倒。再次醒来时，他发现自己身处一个陌生的地方，而女儿小芊也不见了踪影……

name: Super Death Game SHOW! VR
short_description: ─ ─ How did this happen? It seems that future TV shows have gone as far as they can go. Incredible cash prizes if you complete your mission, but if you fail, you'll have to go to....... We bring you the most psychotic and crazy VR experience.

name: Kabaret
short_description: Welcome to the Kabaret - where monsters from Southeast Asian myths and folklores dwell. Perform tea ceremonies, play traditional games, and question your humanity.

name: Amigo: Kebab Simulator
short_description: Friend! I need your help to run my Kebab business, take care of placing the orders, keep the place clean, serve customers properly, try to have positive reviews, improve the place And, beware those of health!

name: Evil Of Demons: Algailah
short_description: There is a child did not listen to his mother, because there is a Algailah Demon kidnaps children at noon, so he went out to play at noon, but Algailah Demon appeared to him and kidnapped him to underground to face danger in order to survive and escape before the Algailah Demon eats him.

name: Orbital Bombardment
short_description: Orbital Bombardment is a unique space shooter game, with retro vibe and synthwave music. You orbit around planets and bombard the evil aliens to save the galaxy. Use different space ships with unique weapons to your tactical advantage to defeat the planetary defenses and to destroy the enemies.

name: Melon Journey: Bittersweet Memories
short_description: Melon Journey: Bittersweet Memories is a story-exploration game about getting caught up in the outlandish happenings of a small town where melons are illegal. Silly and cute on the surface, but are things really as peaceful as they seem?

name: On The Job
short_description: Sneak your way past guards and obstacles through as many levels as you can in this turn-based roguelite stealth game, getting top secret documents and super cool gadgets on the way!

name: Money Maker
short_description: Embark on a journey to build the greatest empire ever known by simply clicking your mouse. Your goal is to amass as much wealth as possible, and you'll do so by starting small and gradually expanding your empire one click at a time.

name: 学園ハンサムFighters
short_description: Gakuen Handsome Fighters' is a single-player 2D action game. The handsome boys fight using punches, kicks, and special moves.

name: Hard to make a romantic cartoon!
short_description: Yunjae possesses the body of a character in a romantic comic. Will he be able to go back to his original world? BL game 'hard to make a romantic cartoon!'

name: Wayhaven Chronicles: Book Three
short_description: Your decisions will shape who is friend or foe, who will share in your secrets, and just how your romance with a certain vampire will grow!

name: Forests, Fields and Fortresses
short_description: Forests, Fields and Fortresses - is a mix of a puzzle and a board game in which you have to build your kingdom.

name: Evil is Back
short_description: 'Evil is Back' is a retelling of the movies 'Evil Dead 1 and 2'... With everything a low budget short film should have. For fans of 80's trash horror movies.

name: 1971: Indian Naval Front
short_description: Learn about the biggest naval conflict since WWII. Third-person vehicular combat game based on 1971 India-Pakistan war. Conduct missions based on actual events. Control naval units including aircraft carriers, warships, jets and choppers. Crack morse coded messages and progress through levels.

name: MINDHACK
short_description: Change the minds of evildoers…for good! MINDHACK is a text adventure game where you meet unique evildoers, hack their minds, and rewrite them into happy people!

name: 我在地球修仙有系统
short_description: 都市修仙+暗黑+放置摸鱼+妹子养成？这可能是一款和你想象中不太一样的刷子游戏。刷宝，筑基，放置，飞升成仙，系统开挂，这款比小说还精彩的国漫修仙都市游戏里全都有。快来开启爽文般带着妹子打怪兽的后宫养成人生吧！

name: Traveler's Game
short_description: Your name is Camus Chen. Because of a recommendation from your friend Lu, you downloaded a battle simulator game famous for its sociability. You meet strangers and learn about their lives by simply chatting with them online. Unexpectedly, you will reveal a big secret of yourself...

name: Mechaneer Resta's Grand Adventure
short_description: One day, the robots around town go out of control and start running amok. It's up to Resta and her good friend Curie to identify the source of the disturbance and save everyone!

name: Passpartout 2: The Lost Artist
short_description: Embark on your struggling artist adventure. Draw and sell art to cheeky critics to reclaim your lost art career. Explore the endearing art-starved town of Phénix and show them you're a true artist!

name: First Light
short_description: After a decade of living in the dark, away from the world. Bahar, and his wife Guidry, believe the Plague has ceased to be and are on the pursuit of a way out, a way back to the world they once knew.

name: RPG Stories
short_description: RPG Stories is an Early Access World builder & 3D Virtual Tabletop that provides you with all necessary, easy-to-use tools & assets to bring your Fantasy, Modern & Sci-Fi TTRPG quests to life! By summer 2023, you will be able to connect with your party & play online your favorite TTRPG sessions!

name: Supplice
short_description: Supplice is a stylish throwback shooter inspired by the mid-90s FPS glory days and the legendary Doom modding community. Mixing the retro stylings of 90s era shooters with colorful graphics and frantic gameplay, it creates an experience that's ever so familiar but also exciting and fresh.

name: Adventures of  The Carrot Captain
short_description: A cute Platformer based inside the cartoony fantasy world of a Saturday Morning Cartoon.

name: Mystery Case Files: The Dalimar Legacy Collector's Edition
short_description: It’s the opportunity of several lifetimes when the intrepid Master Detective finds themselves in the body of their greatest rival!

name: Race Code
short_description: An excellent racing game set in realistic and legendary locations. The old school racing game that you have been waiting for a long time is now with you.

name: Rescue Agency: The Kidnapper of happiness
short_description: Rescue Agency combines the best elements of strategy and farming with storytelling and exciting missions. This is a secret, unknown world of adventure and magic! You have to go to the mysterious country to save its inhabitants from the insidious Kidnapper of Happiness.

name: SparkleWand Puzzle
short_description: Unique Puzzle Game ! Seemingly easy casual game at first but will still challenge you. Test you skill and perception and try pulling off tricky shots. Fun for all ages !

name: Interior Worlds
short_description: Snap your own homemade liminal space photos using a mysterious SLR camera as you explore a variety of empty, strange, and familiar spaces.

name: Meet Your Maker
short_description: Meet your Maker is a post-apocalyptic first-person building-and-raiding game where every level is designed by players. Play solo or with a friend as you mastermind devious maze-like Outposts full of traps and guards, then gear up for methodical fast-paced combat raiding other players’ creations.

name: Fireball Spam
short_description: A two-button, 1 shot, 1 kill fighting game! Taking all of the action of fireball wars in other fighting games and upping the stakes with instantaneous death! No d-pad. No EX-moves, No frills. Just jump, shoot and win!

name: MADGUN
short_description: MADGUN - fast-paced, old-school first-person shooter with 90s graphics where you need to score the most points by killing monsters. Destroy all enemies and complete a special mission.

name: VR Museum
short_description: VR Museum - a virtual exhibition of historic machines, flying, would-be flying, and wannabe-flying. Walk as close as you want and DO touch the exhibits!

name: Bride Of Darkness
short_description: Maria's plans for the future are completely ruined, as her parents unexpectedly marry her off. But an unwanted marriage is not the worst thing that awaits Maria, and her own life is at risk.

name: Jewel Match Aquascapes Collector's Edition
short_description: Dive into a wondrous Match-3 undersea world and let the cares of life drift away! Make matches across sprawling coral reef levels, and collect sparkling treasures to restore magnificent maritime mansions to their erstwhile splendor.

name: Cat Pipes
short_description: Meow!! Challenge your mind and help the cats in this minimalist and relaxing puzzle game! Rotate the pieces and create the perfect path to the cats.

name: I commissioned some ladybugs
short_description: I paid more artists to hide ladybugs and aphids in 20 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

name: Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly
short_description: Dust off your coffee machine and prepare your warmest smile to meet your customers again in the second episode of the much loved coffee brewing and heart-to-heart talking simulator; Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly.

name: Exogate Initiative
short_description: Build and manage mankind’s first mission across the universe! Create a sprawling facility underground, recruit a diverse group of specialists from around the globe and explore mysterious new worlds through the Exogate.

name: The World of Pirates
short_description: Welcome in this simulation-action game of 'The World of Pirates' where you take the role of a pirate battling to take over the sea.

name: Crash & Bump
short_description: Crash & Bump is an online multiplayer shooter... mixed with obstacle courses! Eliminate your opponents while dodging the obstacles and take advantage of the power-ups to get the victory.

name: IRON WORLD
short_description: IRON WORLD is a top-down open world RPG. Experience the unforgiving life of a space settler travelling across the post-apocalyptic world. Drive your own car, fight, explore.

name: Lightracer Spark
short_description: Lightracer Spark is a Sci-Fi Narrative game. You are an amender from a high civilization, descending to various extraterrestrial worlds. Guide living beings to prosperity, or nip a spark in the bud. Accumulate strength through choices and strategies to grasp the rise and fall of all civilizations.

name: Thriving City: Song
short_description: In 960 A.D., the Zhao Song Dynasty was established. As the mayor, you'll need to help the townspeople settle down, cultivate the land and expand. However, when the emperor issues a national mandate, conflicts between factions threaten city development—what strategy will you adopt?

name: Quadrium
short_description: Quadrium is a fiddly match-3 game. Clear the board by dropping the tiles off the edges. Various bonuses like boxes, glass, fog, static tiles and portals add variety to the gameplay. Juicy and soft graphics, relaxing music and no time limit allow you to enjoy the innovative gameplay.

name: Busway Islands - Puzzle
short_description: Busway Islands is a puzzle game about organizing roads and rails across a large archipelago. Your goal is to create a safe and efficient route between bus stations, ensuring that all passengers are picked up along the way.

name: NervBox
short_description: NervBox is a VR, physics-based, multiplayer sandbox where players can experience an unparalleled level of co-op interaction and combat.

name: The Traveler's Path
short_description: In 'The Traveler's Path', you have to help the character reach his destination by swapping and rotating the pieces of the path. Test your thinking and logic skills in this challenging puzzle game.

name: Cave Crawler
short_description: Cave Crawler is a short horror game where you pilot a drone into a cave and discover something horrible.

name: Goblin Dash
short_description: Goblin Dash plays similarly to other action platformer games, allowing the player to move the goblin character up and down to jump across platforms and defeat enemies. The game challenges the player with difficult abilities and mechanics, and requires skill as a platformer to complete.

name: Erin and the Otherworld
short_description: In this turn-based casual strategy deckbuilder defeat ancient Celtic monsters as a druid by creating constellations. Power up your altar and learn more rituals to save your homeland.

name: Armechgeddon
short_description: Armechgeddon is a chaotic action rogue-lite with a minimalist control scheme. Pick the right mech and pilot for the job, and lay waste to hundreds of enemies with your custom arsenal.

name: OTXO
short_description: Enter an inexplicable, abstract mansion to rescue a loved one in this fast-paced, brutal, and dark roguelite filled with precise but savage gunplay and time-bending slow motion. Face your inner demons and unveil the secrets of the Mansion.

name: Floating Islands of Nucifera
short_description: Floating Islands of Nucifera is an open world shop keep game set in an abandoned world in the sky. Adventure across the fantasy world of Nucifera in your airship, summon powerful creatures to your side to aid in dangerous turn-based combat, and loot treasures to help pay off your family's debt!

name: Unscripted
short_description: Dive into the world of a wannabe writer and his friends trying to make it in Hollywood. Build deep friendships, go on hilarious adventures and fall in love. Make highly impactful choices and shape your story in this true-to-life dating sim.

name: Survival: Fountain of Youth
short_description: Survival: Fountain of Youth is a challenging single-player open-world survival game set on the Caribbean islands. Survive as a shipwrecked 16th-century explorer, craft tools and shelter, and uncover the secrets of both an ancient civilization and your own fate.

name: 孟德大小姐与自爆少年THREE KINGDOM FANTASY
short_description: 《孟德大小姐与自爆少年》是一款文字冒险（AVG）游戏，完全原创剧情，将带给大家一段穿插了过去与未来的棋局与因缘。游戏中，玩家将扮演普通大学生郭风笑，开启一场独特的奇妙旅程。

name: Enjaulados
short_description: Enjaulados is a fantasy and fiction video game in 3d in which the protagonist Sirius will have to dive into utopian worlds and save fantastic beings to get out of the cage of screens in which she finds. But is there an even greater danger outside that stalks the planet?

name: Adventure Awaits
short_description: Adventure Awaits bucks the current trend of endless stats & dialog by restoring the era of the 80s Ultimas when RPGs were simpler and more approachable. The story, quests, and all maps are procedurally generated to provide endless replayability. The free demo and paid full versions are identical.

name: Fear Of Mine
short_description: Fear of Mine - a visual novel in the genre of adventure and horror. An alien mushroom creature has brought you under his influence, and now it seems to take over the whole world. Can you escape its grasp? Can you survive? Can you at least save others from falling prey to the same fate as yours?

name: Fateful Mages
short_description: Relaxing 2d puzzle game where you unlock characters and stories through solving puzzles and decide their fate in a magical but unforgiving world.

name: Soulvester VS Lil' Beezey
short_description: Show Lil' Beezey who the boss of Winkletown is in this addictive and fast paced 2D action roguelite! Created from scratch in only 14 days and nominated for GDWC Game Jam GOTY, Soulvester comes to Steam for the first time, now with controller support and achievements!

name: Mushroom Pin
short_description: 《Mushroom Pin》 is a relaxing but challenging puzzle game. You need to put the mushroom pins in the correct socket according to the rules of the levels.

name: DE-EXIT - Eternal Matters
short_description: Embark on a surrealistic afterlife journey to discover the secrets of the broken and mysterious Plane of Memory in this cinematic adventure with a hint of stealth. Dive into a wonderful voxel world with an intense atmosphere and save the day!

name: LaborSurviveManual
short_description: 2D pixel TPS game, Through the keyboard control move and attack, Defeat the enemy gain experience to upgrade and strengthen weapons to live as much as possible.

name: Is It Wrong to Repay the Debt in a Dungeon?
short_description: To repay the debt, both Akane and her mother have to earn a lot of money! Explore the dungeon, challenge strong enemies, and even use her own body! Everything she is trying to do is for saving her family!!

name: Kill It With Fire VR
short_description: The spider: Usually hairy, often poisonous and ALWAYS up to something. Take your arachnophobia to new heights in Kill it With Fire VR, and deal with spiders by any means necessary!

name: Spurdo :D
short_description: Spurdo :D is an Action Adventure Comedy game where you play as Spurdo, travelling to different past lives, each containing its own separate story, style, and gameplay mechanics. Offering a wide variety of scenarios and humorous interactions, you choose how you want to experience those lives again.

name: Coal Mining Simulator
short_description: Welcome to the world of Coal Mining! Start with almost nothing and get to the top - develop your mine, sell coal, buy new machines and avoid dangers in this sandbox simulator. Take control of numerous mining machines. Destroy, mine, drill, transport and blow things up.

name: Skellies Ain't Scary
short_description: Skellies Ain't Scary is a bullet hell rogue-like with minimalist graphics. Delve into dungeons, collect guns and items. Build the strongest synergies and beat all the bosses. Uncover the secrets of the dungeon and collect the lost treasures that await you.

name: Trade Bots: A Technical Analysis Simulation
short_description: Trade Bots is an educational simulation game featuring technical analysis and algorithmic trading. Buy or sell an unknown stock using its real, historic data based solely on patterns and technical indicators. As your profit increases, unlock upgrades that help expedite + automate gameplay with bots.

name: Cat Rescue
short_description: Cat Rescue is a casual 2D Platformer game about a cat finding it's way back home. Can YOU complete the journey?

name: Juruna Game
short_description: In a forest the rabbit was being enslaved by the magical fox. One day Juruna's daughter was taken away along with the other rabbits. Even though Juruna is more fragile, he decides to go on a mission to face his enemy and try to recover his daughter and the other rabbits.

name: 24 Solar Terms
short_description: 24 Solar Terms is a seek and find puzzle game with the theme of the traditional Chinese twenty-four solar terms.
