Play as a team of 4 survivors in a game inspired by all 3 original Evil Dead films as well as the Ash vs Evil Dead television series.

name: Super Kill-BOI 9000
short_description: You cannot survive alone, you are merely a human with a stick. But you can upgrade Kill-BOI 9000, to build your very own killing machine! Choose from a large variety of weapons and upgrades to combine them. Unlock weapons, armor and hats to customize your loadout.

name: Riboud and fairies
short_description: Riboud and Fairies is an excellent horizontal board game for beautiful girls, similar to Super Mario. It has extremely exquisite dynamic CG. Its level design is also very creative, and the dialogue is also very funny.

name: Sword Smash
short_description: Outline'Sword Smash' is an exhilarating TopDown 2D action game where you defeat many enemies and progress through the stages. The objective is to control the player and defeat numerous monsters and bosses.

name: Roots of Pacha
short_description: Be a part of a thriving stone age community. Discover “ideas,” domesticate crops, befriend animals, and contribute to the growth of your village. Play with friends in co-op or explore the early days of civilization in single-player.

name: One Eleven
short_description: A horror detective visual novel in which twelve people are stranded on an island. Few will survive until dawn. The player has to find out who is the killer. Can he?

name: Propagation: Paradise Hotel
short_description: Trapped inside the Paradise Hotel, you are desperate to find your sister. Explore dark surroundings, gather resources, and survive terrifying encounters. This intense single-player VR survival horror game with great storytelling will get your adrenaline pumping.

name: Gods Of Defense
short_description: Tower Defense Rogue-like. Defend a temple on a procedural map with variety of towers. Craft your strategy through Boon and Curse cards. With every run earn faith to upgrade the weapons. Many progression paths keep you engaged and entertained without getting stuck.

name: Tiny Life
short_description: In Tiny Life, you control a set of people that live together in a household. You take care of their daily needs, build their skills, forge new relationships... or just mess up their entire life in whatever way you can think of!

name: Beach Gas Gas
short_description: Beach Gas Gas is a high-speed driving game that is all about adrenaline and excitement.

name: Pixel Madness
short_description: Pixel Madness is a simple 2D clicker game where your main goal is to level up/craft/fight bosses and complete different achievements.

name: KAKU: Ancient Seal
short_description: KAKU: Ancient Seal puts players in the role of Kaku who’s tasked with going on a journey across a sprawling continent to restore balance to the land. Accompanied by your pet pig, you’ll have to brave the four elemental regions and conquer their lords if you’re to fulfill your destiny.

name: Clausum
short_description: Immerse yourself in the bone-chilling world of Clausum. With no means to defend yourself, solve puzzles, explore and uncover the true horrors that lurk within the house. Will you survive, or succumb to the malevolent forces that await you? Face your fears in this immersive psychological horror game.

name: THE LAST HUMAN IS A BIKER
short_description: THE LAST HUMAN IS A BIKER (TLH) is a few hours of pure entertainment. In this 2D shooter you play as John, the last human, and unleash his fury in his quest of vengeance! With unlimited item synergies, make the choices that will allow you to survive against countless swarms of aliens!

name: Piggy Gambit
short_description: Piggy Gambit is a game that harmoniously combines the elements of chess, box puzzles, and flow control into a coherent puzzle game about a piggy searching for the meaning to his life.

name: Penguin Noir
short_description: Penguin Noir is a fast-paced pinball-style arcade game where the goal is to collect three pearls throughout each level, maintaining a combo of explosive actions to rack up massive scores.

name: We. The Refugees: Ticket to Europe
short_description: ‘We. The Refugees: Ticket to Europe’ is a socially engaged, text-based RPG about a journalist looking for his big break by uncovering the plights of refugees travelling from Africa to Europe. It is a story inspired by true events.

name: Q REMASTERED
short_description: This game 'Q REMASTERED' is a simple puzzle game that anyone can enjoy! You can freely draw lines and shapes on the screen. The drawn object will fall down due to gravity. You will use the object to solve more than 1200 missions. Can you get the ball out of the cup? Let's challenge!

name: Paws of Coal
short_description: The miners of Rabbit Burrows are falling ill, and it is hurting production. As an eminent scholar of the Animal Kingdom, Charles Quill has been summoned by the Crown to help them solve the outbreak. The miners know and respect the young scholar, but there seem to be other things at play.

name: Raimodula
short_description: Raimodula is a dynamic arcade platformer, featuring customizable characters and randomized progression. Unlock habilities, fight modular enemies and navigate surreal environments with intense and polished gameplay!

name: ToyBox Puzzle
short_description: These toys are all over the place! Arrange and organize the mess by fitting everything inside the grid in this relaxing and colorful puzzle game with over 100 levels that will test your critical thinking skills.

name: Below the Surface:Uncovering the Truth in the Sewers
short_description: 玩家将扮演年轻警探Chen，在昏暗潮湿的下水道中搜集各种线索并揭开失踪女孩背后的真相。通过推理解开谜题，最终将凶手绳之以法，让正义得以伸张。快来破案！

name: Linia Stripes
short_description: Linia Stripes is a relaxing game of identifying stripes of progressive length on countless, colorful boards. As you play, you’ll be able to collect many wonderful patterns to create unique wallpapers, ready for use and customization!

name: Jigsaw Puzzle Fever
short_description: Jigsaw Puzzle Fever is a single player game that is fun for all the family. Pick one of the ten starting puzzles to get on your way.

name: Kalevania
short_description: Kalevania is a retro action platformer loosely based on Finnish mythology. Fight with bare hands, sword, axe, bow, and 11 runic weapons. With 50+ enemy types and collectibles, enjoy a full retro gaming experience! Play as Väinämöinen and relive classic console gaming!

name: The Magic World
short_description: Party fantasy RPG. You control a party of characters, moving around the game world. Collect items, complete quests, communicate with NPCs, try to survive, destroy enemies with various magic and weapons.

name: Room of Depression
short_description: 'Same encounter, different world.' Moon is a young woman who lives an ordinary city life as an office worker. However, because she suffers from depression, she reacts and deals with things in a way that is very different from regular city folk.

name: LIFELIKE
short_description: Lifelikes aren’t real! At least, nobody thought living appliances as smart as humans could be, until all hell broke loose in rural Ohio. Fight back in radio-inspired combat against toasters, lamps, and other living objects as you get to the bottom of a magical mystery in this electromagnetic RPG.

name: The Witch of Fern Island
short_description: Welcome to Fern Island! As Abrill, become immersed in the island’s culture, uncover its deepest secrets, and master magical trades. Overcome the challenges of the island to demonstrate your mastery of magic and become the most well known witch around!

name: Brave Bubble Heart
short_description: In Brave Bubble Heart you'll face strange creatures and solve puzzles while saving as many souls as you can that are lost in the abyss. Your life is your ammunition. Do not die!

name: The Paper Arcade
short_description: The Paper Arcade is a collection of classic arcade-style games with a unique drawing and sketchbook aesthetic. Enjoy fast-paced, high-score chasing action, challenging puzzles, and casual games. Each game is brought to life with stunning hand-drawn graphics. Addictive, retro-style gaming fun!

name: Adventures of Ben: Rabbit Run
short_description: World of Valentardia will not let you get bored for a second! Adventures will require the hero to be not only determined but also to be faithfully accepted.

name: Suicide Guy
short_description: Suicide Guy is set in the incredibile and extraordinary dreams of its protagonist. What would you do in order to save the thing you love most? Immerse yourself into his weird dreams and help him to wake up before it's too late.

name: Karl Marx and the Ring of Communism
short_description: Workers of the world, unite! You have nothing to loose, but, like, less than two dollars. - Karl Marx... would probably say about this challenging platformer. Play as the great thinker, overcome capitalism and return the world to the one righteous state of universal, common, great and equal poverty.

name: Sorcerer's mid-month exam
short_description: A vr-only fantasy action game. You can parry most of the monster's attacks, then you can kill them all easily. Hate the parry? Then you can use the auto-lock-enemy spells to fight with them.

name: Civatlas
short_description: Civatlas is a historical city-builder game progressing through the Medieval and Renaissance eras. Build a Utopia of thine own creation!

name: Garten of Banban 3
short_description: Embrace the horrors of Banban’s Kindergarten. Delve even deeper into the depths of the establishment that was left suspiciously empty. Try to survive the unexpected residents and continue the search for your child…

name: DUCKLYTE
short_description: DUCKLYTE is a top-down shooter with roguelite elements where you play as a constipated little duck trying to stay alive as long as possible in a randomly generated farm with progressively stronger enemies.

name: Frozen Shelter
short_description: Frozen Shelter is an indie first-person walking simulator game made in realistic 3D graphics. As a location, the player will be presented with a bunker built during the Cold War of the USSR. The fascinating atmosphere of loneliness will put pressure on the player throughout the game.

name: The Reacher
short_description: The Reacher is a platform game with different aspects in it. Run, slide and swing for reaching the goal. It is designed for speed runs.

name: Tuya
short_description: A frightening experience in the Japanese countryside!

name: World Turtles
short_description: The World Turtle carries entire civilizations on its back through outer space, and the gentle Meeps are the only ones on a quest to save it. Cooperation, rather than conquest will save the day, so prepare to harvest, build, research, and explore the void in this wholesome turtleback builder.

name: Redfall
short_description: The town of Redfall is under siege by a legion of vampires who have cut the island off from the outside world. Trapped with a handful of survivors, slay alone or squad up in open-world FPS action.

name: RICE - Repetitive Indie Combat Experience™
short_description: A rich paragraph of information which will try to charm and pique interest, trying to catch your eye in a sea of competition using a slew of buzzwords such as ‘bullet heaven’ and ‘in-depth meta-progression’, in a vain attempt to make you believe this game is any different from others in its genre.

name: 三国吞天传 幻想姬武神战记
short_description: This is a turn based RPG type game! Players can purchase new equipment, defeat bosses, search for hidden treasures, replace powerful equipment... as well as beautiful character portraits and dazzling magic! Welcome friends who love nostalgia to play with RPG!

name: Thesmophoria
short_description: Do you and your friends have what it takes to impress the Greek Gods?

name: Before Resignation
short_description: It is a game in which the main character, who suffered from stress after being unfairly treated at the company, takes revenge the day before leaving the company.

name: Two Portals - A Gemstone Puzzle Game
short_description: Open locks, activate gemstones, join passages to the grid and advance to the next level! Two Portals - A Gemstone Puzzle Game is a grid-based movement minimalist puzzle game.

name: City of Beats
short_description: Shoot. Groove. Loot. Repeat. Cross an ever-changing city skyline, flowing through encounters in tune with the cityscape’s beat. From the weapons you fire, to the enemies you shoot, to the zen-like flow, the only way to win is to become one with the beat.

name: FatSheep Crisis
short_description: Fat Sheep Town has monsters! Use skills to defeat them. Plugins help warriors survive. Many maps have risks and rewards. Pick an occupation and weapons. Level up weapons. Combine skills, plugins and weapons. Defeat the villain!

name: 挑战不死之王
short_description: 挑战不死之王是一款动作Roguelike游戏。在地下城中，众多的不死族首领等着你去挑战，不断的提升自己才能得到不死之王的认可，寻找他，并战胜他，是你唯一的选择,但他不会给你这个机会.

name: Tape to Tape
short_description: Tape to Tape is a roguelite hockey game where every choice matters on your journey to build the best hockey team. Choose your path, hire unique players, discover synergies between them, pick unique abilities, bribe the referees or visit the Blademaster on your way to restore hockey's former glory.

name: Unnatural Season Two
short_description: Raise a new organization from the ashes of the SRT and guide Silver Cross Incorporated to protect the innocent from the darker side of humanity.

name: Soul Survivors
short_description: Rise, fallen hero! Enter Soul Survivors, a harrowing journey into a dark and retro world that demands skill and courage. Every moment could be your last, but with each setback, you grow stronger. Embrace the challenge, overcome daunting foes, and cleanse the world of its cursed lands.

name: On the other side
short_description: Take on the role of a modern exorcist in this realistic ghost hunting horror. You have to fulfill contracts related to paranormal phenomena. Your main weapon is an old camera that can shoot what is not visible to the human eye.

name: Age of Wonders 4
short_description: Rule a fantasy realm of your own design! Explore new magical realms in Age of Wonders’ signature blend of 4X strategy and turn-based tactical combat. Control a faction that grows and changes as you expand your empire with each turn!

name: Night of Horror
short_description: You are on the night shift at the bank. You hear noises all the time. You need to find out what they are and find your partner. As you pass, you will need to find the keys and open locked rooms.

name: cmd error
short_description: A top down 2d puzzle game set in the far future. Explore the remains of a lost civilization, or create your own stories in the in-game map editor. Share your maps on the steam workshop and download maps to play from the community!

name: Finding Hannah
short_description: Finding Hannah is a relaxing puzzle game about a woman navigating a midlife crisis. Hannah’s got it all: a well-paying job, a fancy coffee machine, and a comfortable life – so why isn’t she happy? Lead her on a journey of self-discovery as you explore beautiful scenes and find hidden objects.

name: AFL 23
short_description: AFL 23 - IT'S TIME TO FLY!! Feel the Atmosphere, Chase your dreams and Make it your own - in the most realistic AFL game ever!

name: 2D Dogfight
short_description: 2D Dogfight is a simple air combat game. Players can drive various jet aircrafts from the Cold War to modern times to complete various types of combat missions. The game has a basic simulation of the physics of aircrafts, allowing players to experience the charm of air combat in the 2D world.

name: Lost To Riches
short_description: Fight your way through an army of demons in order to escape a cursed casino, using a variety of powerful items, weapons and holier than thou upgrades in this Rogue-Lite experience!

name: Metal Mutation
short_description: In a not-so-distant future taken over by companies and technology, a Cyborg and an AI fight together to save mankind from nanoviruses. Play alone or as a team of 4 players in this Post-Cyberpunk Action Roguelike Dungeon Crawler!

name: Bare Butt Boxing
short_description: Fight in completely unregulated alien boxing bouts and knock out players online in BARE BUTT BOXING, a chaotic multiplayer brawler with physics-based characters.

name: After Stream
short_description: After Stream is a first-person psychological horror game. You will take on the role of a streamer who returns home to stream, but something goes wrong..

name: KILLBUG
short_description: KILLBUG is a fast-paced, first-person movement shooter set in an endless arena. Slash and shoot your way through hordes of ravenous insects, mastering fluid aerial movement mechanics as you fight for glory on the leaderboards.

name: Psionic Awake
short_description: Psionic Awake is a Roguelike game . Collect resources during the day and defend against monsters at night. It emphasizes any combination of weapons, talents, treasures and partners.

name: PieClicker
short_description: PieClicker is a beautiful clicker game designed to be visually appealing. Click, Get Pies, Upgrade Pies.

name: Ethyrial: Echoes of Yore
short_description: Enter a world on the brink of civil war and discover the secrets of Irumesa in an old-school, hardcore MMORPG. Navigate treacherous politics, fight terrifying monsters, foster mighty guilds with friends, and usher in a golden era - or drown Irumesa in the dark ages.

name: Endless Monday: Dreams and Deadlines
short_description: 'Endless Monday: Dreams and Deadlines' - In this short story from the Endless Monday, Penny, a mild-mannered corporate grunt, spends a weekend at the office in an effort to finish her project on time while overcoming distractions from coworkers, space aliens, imaginary friends, and herself.

name: Farmburgh
short_description: Farmburgh is a point-and-click idle farming sim game that offers a fresh take on the classic genre. Grow crops, raise animals, craft goods, and decorate your farm. Suitable for hardcore optimizers and casual fans alike. Become the ultimate virtual farmer in Farmburgh!

name: Bananaguy
short_description: Bananguy returns for a new epic adventure! Collect 'Power Coins' and explore goofy worlds in the ultimate search for the legendary golden banana!

name: Survival Shooter
short_description: This is a first-person shooter game where you use various weapons to defeat enemies and explore the world. You must manage your health, use limited resources wisely, in order to survive in this challenging world.

name: The Last Vagabonds
short_description: The Last Vagabonds is set in a zombie apocalypse. Fight against zombies and travel with a friend or alone through the forsaken world.

name: No Man's Island
short_description: No Man's Island is an uncompromising wilderness survival game. Enter a strange and unexplored world full of strange creatures, dangers, and surprises. Gather resources to craft items and structures that match your survival style. Play your way as you unravel the mysteries of this strange land.

name: Silica
short_description: Silica is a crossover of FPS and RTS where up to 3 factions battle for control over the planet of Baltarus. Lead from above as commander, or experience the action first-hand, either alone, or with friends. Join one of two human armies, or hunt them down as the territorial aliens.

name: Jumping Frog -A Time Traveller-
short_description: The game is a first-person exploratory jumping action game. The game is an exhilarating game in which the player controls a robot that can jump to high altitudes and repeatedly ascends and descends through stages with many elevation differences. Collect the 4 items in the stage to reach the goal.

name: Bottle
short_description: Bottle is a very short game in which you play as an alcoholic man of solitude.

name: SGS NATO's Nightmare
short_description: What if the Warsaw Pact had attacked NATO in the mid-1980s. Or the other way around? Study this titanic conflict, within its most emblematic theater, Germany and Central Europe. Will you be able to achieve your goals without escalating into an uncontrollable nuclear conflict?

name: Midnight Shift
short_description: A 90's horror inspired first-person game about working the midnight shift at a gas station.

name: Amazing Maze
short_description: Amazing Maze brings new mechanics to the classic 'roll a ball' genre where you have to capture the crystals and find the way out in beautiful mazes. Use your creativity and logical thinking to overcome obstacles or use them to your advantage. Be quick and put your name on the top of the leaderboard!

name: Z.O.N.A Project X VR
short_description: Z.O.N.A Project X - thrilling single-player VR shooter. Explore Chornobyl's exclusion zone, a hazardous apocalyptic world filled with anomalies. Survive using your weapons, scavenge for resources, and save humanity from doom.

name: Knight Crawlers
short_description: Spawn your own enemies in this wobbly physics based rogue-lite action RPG and mow down hundreds of foes to your heart’s content. Fend off the Hordes of the Corrupted Realms by choosing powerful skill cards, enchanting equipment, and extracting living essence to upgrade your crawler.

name: Axolotl Kingdom
short_description: Axolotl Kingdom is a charming hand drawn pet simulator, where you can adopt your own Axolotl. You can customise your Axolotl with 20 unique accessories, with options for all styles! Our Kingdom is brimming with life, with locations such as the Cafe and Arcade. There’s so much to explore and enjoy!

name: SMYS : Show Me Your Stairs
short_description: SMYS is a 2-4 player local-multiplayer party game. Challenge your friends in this building race to the top! Gather blocs in various minigames and then use them to build your stairs as fast as possible, use your special items wisely to disturb your friends' minds and reach the objective first.

name: Catch The Fox
short_description: It's a massive game of tag, who will win?

name: Suicide Guy: Sleepin' Deeply
short_description: In this new chapter of 'Suicide Guy' you'll be challenged with even more insane puzzles, generated by the surreal dreams of the Guy. You'll encounter the weirdest of the living beings as you go deeper and deeper into his subconscious. This time to wake him up you'll need all your skills.

name: 200 DAYS Zombie Apocalypse
short_description: You must survive a Zombie-infested world.

name: Mia and the Dragon Princess
short_description: A live-action, interactive action movie following Mia, a plucky barmaid whose life is thrown into chaos when a mysterious woman turns up at her workplace, on the run from a group of violent thugs and unable to speak English.

name: Arto
short_description: Breathe color into a desaturated world in this action-RPG. Fight unique enemies and bosses in a quest to bring life back to your world. Explore different biomes in ever-changing art styles, with varied mechanics, from hack-and-slash to stealth and platforms!

name: Legend of Utorepia
short_description: The Last Hero departs for the mysterious world of Utorepia.What you see at the end of that journey ...? Feature-length retro RPG!

name: Ritual
short_description: Ritual is a first-person psychological horror game. Immerse yourself in this sinister experience of terror, where everything familiar becomes strange to you, find the necessary elements to complete the ritual and solve the mystery.

name: Essential Power
short_description: Essential Power is a short visual novel. The main character's mundane routine is turned upside down when he meets Mia, a talented designer.

name: NeuroNet: Mendax Proxy
short_description: You are Arc, a city management AI. Designed to manage a city-wide AR metaverse known as the NeuroNet. Meet its many users, build relationships and help or hinder their lives while trying to balance the wider needs of the city. Find your humanity in a world losing theirs to technology.

name: Showgunners
short_description: As a contestant on a high stakes reality game show of the future, you must survive a dangerous urban environment packed with traps, confounding puzzles, and heavily armed psychopaths. Turn-based combat in hand crafted levels, built for entertainment.

name: Vagabond
short_description: Explore procedurally generated living worlds in this 2D sandbox RPG. Meet hundreds of characters in cities, complete quests, craft powerful items, buy and furnish your home or fight monsters in dungeons.

name: Magic Toenail
short_description: Magic Toenail is a strategic wizarding roguelite where every step you take is a tactical maneuver! You shoot when you move and move when you shoot, so even the simplest enemy encounters will quickly become high-stakes puzzles!

name: Swarm Grinder
short_description: Swarm Grinder is an action roguelite game with pixel art graphics. Battle enemies to make your way through a mass of spreading and evolving cells hosting dormant enemies. Collect a variety of game-changing skills and upgrades to create unique builds.

name: Phijkchu Quest
short_description: Phijkchu Quest is an experience in which you will discover truly what it means to be on a Phijkchu Quest.

name: Fuga: Melodies of Steel 2
short_description: The sequel to the captivating tale of Fuga: Melodies of Steel has arrived! This turn-based RPG is back with a ramped up battle system for more strategy, as well as a brand new event system that gives you more thrilling choices to affect your experience!

name: VR Tractor Farming
short_description: Immersive experience in 'Farming Tractor' VR game that lets you tractor driving and farming activity in open world like growing crops, feeding animals, and watering plants, modern drone farming and drive through risky road. Day & night view experience the farming in darkness, rain and a full moon.

name: Ends
short_description: A highway gothic horror. Your bus was late and now you can't catch your next bus home. You'll need to walk the next couple of miles... alone... at night.

name: Lore: Curse Of The Elemental
short_description: Play as an adventurer, along side your companion, and uncover a dark secret within the most haunted castle in Ireland. This is a third person mystery adventure and the first installment of a larger series.

name: Drift
short_description: You were deep in uncharted space on a research mission. Disaster struck. Together with your friends, explore a mysterious asteroid field and mine whatever resources possible to build what you need to survive.

name: Super Cars (Amiga/C64/CPC/Spectrum)
short_description: In this top-down combat racer from 1990, take the wheel of a high-powered super car in an all-out deadly race. Use your prize money from a series of dangerous, high-octane races to upgrade your car, adding everything from a turbocharger to missiles!

name: Band Camp Boyfriend
short_description: Will you lead your marching band to victory as drum major? Explore band camp and attend rehearsal alongside an unforgettable cast of characters, where every choice matters. Find love or face tragedy in 7 routes with 35+ different endings in this colorful, musically-rich otome visual novel.

name: Occupy Mars: The Game
short_description: Survive and colonize Mars in a highly technical, open-world sandbox game. Build and upgrade your base, discover new regions, conduct mining operations, retrieve water, generate oxygen, grow crops, and fix broken parts.

name: Poosh XL
short_description: Poosh XL is a neon-infused, one-button arcade score chaser. That's it! That pretty much says it all. If you like that first sentence you'll probably enjoy this game. Otherwise, refund it, I don't care, I just work here. (The spiritual successor to Ding Dong XL)

name: Mommy Simulator
short_description: Mommy Simulator is a unique and engaging game that simulates the experience of being a mother.

name: D-World Gate
short_description: A roguelite game where the player controls the actions and the character automatically attacks. Control the brave with different talents, survive the fight with monsters and enrich their own profession composition, become a master of all profession, defeat the Kings of the undead in this world.

name: Ultimate Ragdoll Game
short_description: Ultimate Ragdoll Game is a Sandbox game without any limits. Have fun with multiple ragdolls available in Steam Workshop and build your very own constructions using wide variety of blocks.

name: Touhou: Gensokyo Survivors
short_description: Youkai have overrun Gensokyo! There's no resolving this incident, just try to survive! Touhou: Gensokyo Survivors is the latest take on the survivor genre, this time with the unique twist of a grid-based inventory system. Hoard as many items as possible if you want to survive!

name: Dream of Echo
short_description: In Dream of Echo your first goal is to find the only real portal that will allow Echo to wake up and get out of his dream. Be careful, however your shadow will not let you any respite

name: After Dark
short_description: After Dark is a zombie wave survival game that pits you against unrelenting hordes of the undead, you must use every strategy to outlast the ever-increasing waves of zombies and complete missions. You are not expected to survive.

name: Crystal of Atlantis
short_description: Years ago, a visitor from another world foresaw doom for a certain civilization on Earth. To save its people, he gave them a child to be raised among them, hoping his knowledge and insight would be enough to save them from their fate. Play a thrilling Match-3 game and help to save the earth!

name: Eliminator: The Encapsuled Nemesis
short_description: Eliminator: The Encapsuled Nemesis is an tactical single-player shooter for everyone. Sneak to hostile fortifications, destroy your foes, capture flags, collect new weapons and fight your way through enemy lines to crush their evil plans.

name: A Raving Lunatic
short_description: This is a role-playing game. As our protagonist, you will lead your friends to fight for survival and pursue freedom!

name: Unalive 010
short_description: Your only hope is to fight - alone in a twisted lab

name: Assault On Proxima
short_description: The Terran colonies on Proxima C5 have been atttacked by hostile aliens! Dive into a new and exciting Sci-Fi First Person Shooter! Blast through hordes of aliens in the singleplayer or co-op campaign. Battle online in PvP matches. Defeat the Gacrux invaders and lead the Assault on Proxima!

name: TT Isle Of Man: Ride on the Edge 3
short_description: An iconic course for motorbike fans. 200km of open roads to practise on. Challenging physics. A simulation for the best riders.

name: Gunsmith Simulator: Prologue
short_description: Enter the world of gunsmithing and become a real expert in making, repairing and modifying weapons in Gunsmith Simulator: Prologue. Open your workshop, be creative and excel at gunsmithing!

name: Siberian Village
short_description: Become a resident of an Siberian village and get to know its inhabitants. Take part in the life of a small Siberian village. Feel the atmosphere of Siberia, having been in the role of its resident.

name: Darkest Dungeon® II
short_description: Darkest Dungeon II is a roguelike road trip of the damned. Form a party, equip your stagecoach, and set off across the decaying landscape on a last gasp quest to avert the apocalypse. The greatest dangers you face, however, may come from within...

name: B3
short_description: B3 will be a first-person VR shooter where you have to defend your base from waves of attacking monsters.

name: Biscuitts 5
short_description: Biscuitts 5 is a First Person Shooter game.

name: Lotte
short_description: A minimalistic five-minute puzzle platformer, where you become a fly when you die. Immerse yourself in a soothing forest and use your ability to become a fly to solve puzzles.

name: Melon Knight
short_description: Tiny little adventure with roguelike elements, where your next step decides everything. Fight your way through a dungeon full of monsters, bats and bugs. Find a magic book and save the Kingdom of Lei! (or destroy it). Retro style!

name: DIVINE PEARL™: Survivors
short_description: DIVINE PEARL™: Survivors is a bullet heaven survival game set in a shonen anime world, unleash energy wave attacks and increase your power level on each new planet visited!

name: Model Eight
short_description: A shoot em' up with a manga inspired look. Destroy enemies, and use their salvage to gain more power.

name: The Ranch of Rivershine
short_description: Saddle up and build your own horse ranch! Raise foals, care for your horses and train them as you explore the western wilderness! Participate in cross country competitions and become your town's champion. Befriend the villagers who'll help you on your adventure at the Ranch of Rivershine!

name: A Day Out
short_description: A Day Out is a monster-hunting and case-solving co-op shooter. Capture monsters and discover a new supernatural world with your friends!

name: Urbex Night Security
short_description: Atmospheric horror game. Walking simulator interspersed with various events, sometimes simple puzzles and a bit of running away. Student starts working as a security guard in the old abandoned factory that hides a dark secret.

name: Death or Treat
short_description: The Halloween spirit is missing! Play as Scary and help him save HallowTown. 'Death or Treat' is a 2D action-roguelite and hack & slash, with handpainted environments and traditional animation. Explore all the worlds and defeat hordes of enemies using different weapons and skills.

name: Pan'orama
short_description: Relax and unleash your creativity in this new city building puzzle game. Create amazing landscapes and discover wide range of structures with special abilities. Enter the world of beauty and tranquility with the panoramas of your own creation and don't forget to pet your new animal friends!

name: Swarm
short_description: 'SPIDER-MAN WITH GUNS — this is what VR was made for!' SWARM is a fast-paced, arcade-style grapple shooter, with quick sessions, bright colorful worlds and globally competitive leaderboards that will take you back to the glory days of Arcade Games.

name: Eddie's Arcade
short_description: Uniquely satisfying puzzle game spread out over different graphical themes. The puzzles get harder as you advance, giving you the pleasing sense of accomplishment. Collect arcade tokens to unlock new machines. Over 125 levels for hours of play.

name: Super Bear: Hunt for the lost beer
short_description: Enemy Spider and his army has robbed Super bear beer bottles, so now you have to kill enemies and big spider boss to save beer bottles.

name: Cluck
short_description: Cluck is an extremely fast-paced fps arena shooter. Spawn with only a pistol and find weapons, armor, health and powerups such as the Quack and Speed along the map. Jump pads and portals are also around the map, enabling you to get to your destination. And customize your own chicken!

name: Voodolls
short_description: Voodolls is a cooperative Action Tower Defense game in spherical worlds. You play as voodoo dolls looking for redemption and are forced to protect your Puppet Master from the demons that are chasing you. Friends, totems, and rituals will be your most valuable assets during this crazy adventure!

name: Beyond your Fear
short_description: Descend into an atmospheric, story-driven psychological horror game where the player must investigate a case, solve riddles, and make hard choices on the way to uncovering what lies beyond your fear.

name: How a Retired Strategist Saved the Country
short_description: How a Retired Strategist Saved the Country is a real time strategy simulation game where you manage resources to develop your country. The player is asked by elves, beastmen... Etc. various heroines ask you for help, and then you take command of their country's army.

name: Project Screwed
short_description: Work together with your friends in this stressful 4-player couch co-op game as you defend against hordes of enemies trying to destroy your base. Manage both your time and your resources in an effort to balance all the needs of your base. Are you and your friends up for the task?

name: Magecraft
short_description: Annihilate hordes of mobs and challenging bosses with the ultimate Spell Building system. Infinitely customize your weapons and see how quickly you can break your computer! Abuse the open-ended nature of the spell creation system to destroy the game balance.

name: Logicats
short_description: Logicats is a beginner-friendly programming game. Learn programming concepts through reading code in a fun and effective way. Perfect for classrooms or at home. Start your programming journey today!

name: Midautumn
short_description: Crashing at Grandma's was meant to be a break from your responsibilities. But relaxing might prove hard when the Spirit World is real, its entrance is in your basement, and you're its newest guardian. Blast evil spirits and save your hometown in this rogue-like dungeon crawler!

name: CANINE
short_description: PSX style horror game about a boy looking for his dog, kidnapped by an evil corporation that runs experiments with pets.

name: I commissioned some bees 15
short_description: I paid more artists to hide bees in 20 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

name: Creeping Deck: Pharaoh's Curse
short_description: Creeping Deck is a strategic roguelite deck-builder with RPG elements. Build and refine your deck as you progress through each dungeon, facing off against bosses and enemies. Upgrade, and unlock new skills, options, and artifacts to protect all of Egypt!

name: Little Army
short_description: Little Army is an auto battle game in which powerful insect rulers clash for power. Each faction has its own specific abilities and effects in battle, and the Tyrants provide different aids to their armies. Expand your ranks and crush your enemies.

name: My monstrous roommate. (étude)
short_description: There is a monster living in your apartment.

name: Mechabellum
short_description: Mechabellum is an epic auto-battler taking place on the newly colonized planet of Far-Away. You’re the Commander of an army of mechs fighting it out in massive PvP battles. Customize and level up your units, strategically place them on the battlefield and watch them destroy your enemies.

name: Solitary PaperPlane
short_description: Solitary Paperplane is a perfect game for the lonely ones to address their loneliness. A relaxing and immersive experience that players can enjoy at their own pace and a hyper experience for those who like the fast pace with added obstacles. Please keep an eye out for this game!

name: ABSURDIKA
short_description: It's time for you to overcome the fear of conflicts. Every time someone blamed you you stood quiet and kept your anger inside. The demon you are about to face impersonates this fear.

name: BountyHeart
short_description: BountyHeart is a Roguelite Match 3 + Tactics RPG where you assemble a group of outlaws searching for the legendary bounty. Assemble the perfect crew by befriending those you meet along the way, or defeat them for their bounty and strengthen your party... the choice is yours!

name: Teacher Certification Hell
short_description: This producer wants you to study on Steam again!! This is a game about Teacher Certification Knowledge. Depending on your strategy (ability), choose the right item at the beginning, and then use the answer to break through each Layers! After 100 layers, waiting for you may be......

name: Obscurite Magie: The Blood of Kings
short_description: Adventurer Lietta Fane's mentor and guardian Negel was murdered. She swears vengeance against his murderer and sets off to confront her destiny.

name: Late for Class: Variety King
short_description: Use 9 movement mechanics to climb your way to school. 'Late for Class' is a tribute to punishing games that are difficult, frustrating, yet somehow satisfying. Expect lots of falling and getting back up!

name: Burning Secrets - A Bara Visual Novel
short_description: In one of Zafir's expeditions, the old wizard disappears and Fin decides to rescue him with Luxus's help. Embark on this journey in Luxus' shoes and have the opportunity to fall in love with one of them playing this short visual novel with multiple endings - including a polyamorous one.

name: Far Cry® 6
short_description: Enter the adrenaline-filled world of a modern-day guerrilla revolution. With stunning vistas, visceral gunplay, and a huge variety of gameplay experiences, there's never been a better time to join the fight.

name: Chess 432
short_description: It's the first ever chess battle royale for 32 players! Prove yourself battle after battle in one giant game of chess unlike anything you've played before.

name: Cargo Truck Racer
short_description: Race through challenging tracks with automatic movement and fragile cargo management. Collect stars, climb the leaderboards, and unlock achievements in this fast-paced, truck racing game with an energetic drum n bass soundtrack and low-poly graphics.

name: Project Drift
short_description: Drift on the famous mountain roads in Japan! Driving various Japanese cars! Challenge local fleets!

name: Voidtrain
short_description: Become a crew member of an Interdimensional Express Train! Discover a new world full of mysterious creatures, enemies and places. Upgrade and customize your train, gather new materials and build better weapons. Play solo or online сo-op with up to 4 people.

name: MathLand
short_description: Educational video game for kids. Improve your mathematical level in addition, subtraction and multiplication. It is not just a math app—it's a real educational adventure!

name: 富甲天下4
short_description: 富甲Online新登場，賺錢、徵才、打寶、升級，組自己的夢幻隊伍！ 城池建物添風貌，箭塔、兵營、私掠站，多種組合功能多變！ 錦囊妙計轉乾坤，單挑、野戰、攻城戰，文官武將各顯神通！ 賭場鬥智拼手氣，擲骰、賽馬、下寶物，緊張刺激欲罷不能！ 關卡地圖新花樣，天梯、開路、熱汽球，劇本加倍絕對過癮！

name: Idle ShowOff
short_description: This is a Idle game with the simplest leveling mechanism.By using the 'Show Off' button, you can CUSTOMMM Text to break through the dimensional wall and release your inner huge Presence to your STEAM Friends List ! ! ! ! ! !

name: Another Fisherman's Tale
short_description: Another Fisherman's Tale, sequel to the award-winning A Fisherman's Tale, is a new mind-bending VR puzzle-adventure. A poetic story with unique VR puzzle mechanics. Detach, Replace and Control your hands, solve puzzles, explore new locations and discover the truth.

name: Duru – About Mole Rats and Depression
short_description: Follow the story of Tuli – a story about the struggle with insecurities, depression and friendship, told in a colorful, accessible way. Run, jump and paint your way through puzzle filled tunnels while also dealing with an unhelpful AI companion you just can't get rid of.

name: AETHERIS
short_description: Embark on a heroic quest to rescue your village from a relentless Shade. Traverse vibrant, incomparable landscapes in this captivating turn-based roguelite. Journey alone or with companions—the adventure awaits!

name: No Crime
short_description: The story takes place in South East Asia. Start from a drug case, follow private detective Sui Feng to discover a mysterious complexion full of conspiracy, overcome his intermittent amnesia, and avenge for his love…Can you find out the real culprit through fragments of memories?

name: Atomic Survivors
short_description: Atomic Survivors is an arena shooter with minimalistic gameplay and simplistic roguelike elements in which you have to fend off many waves of opponents. Collect Resin every run to buy one of several upgrades of your choice. And remember: for best results, choose wisely.

name: A Special Place In Hell
short_description: Scavenge for weapons, ambush your friends, die trying. A Special Place In Hell is an 8-man fast-paced top-down battle royale-lite inspired by 4-bit games of the Atari 2600 era.

name: Paint by Pixel 2
short_description: Create your pixel masterpiece today!

name: VIVIDLOPE
short_description: VIVIDLOPE, the head-spinning, mind-bending arcade game with a puzzle touch! Master the imaginative realm, where the gravity doesn't quite work as you're used to, overcome your foes and keep on painting!

name: Crimson Song - Yuri Visual Novel
short_description: It was only meant to be another annual visit to his mother's grave, but midway through Diandrir's story was shrouded in darkness. A kinect visual novel about darkness and girls' love.

name: Porpetha
short_description: An action, adventure and musical game. Perfect for hanging out and having fun.

name: Virago: Trepidation
short_description: Hello everyone! We don’t have much to say in here, so we want to use this space to remind you to be kind to yourself

name: Morbid Catastrophe
short_description: A game based on a recurring nightmare.

name: Spriters, Hopes Blooming Dawn
short_description: Spriters: Hopes Blooming Dawn is an RPG-style game that takes you on an epic adventure through a world filled with magic, mystery, and danger. Battle dangerous creatures, collect Gems with unique powers, and uncover the mysteries of your past in this engaging and innovative game.

name: It Is Ticking
short_description: The world is being attacked by terrorists, they use highly dangerous explosive devices to cause massive destruction in urban zones. You, A bomb-defusing expert, must take action to protect our nation's lives.

name: Just Survival - The Zombie Awakening
short_description: Just Survival - The Zombie Awakening is a early access version of a 4 Year Post-Apocalyptic Zombie Survival Open World MMOPG. This new survival game, immerses you in a unique earth as humanity is fighting back & teaming up to Survive the Infected Zombie Hordes! Visit 'about this' page for more Info.

name: The Seven Awakenings: I Randall
short_description: Run your own shop in the Middle Ages. Manage your economy and serve your customers well. Collect the elements to discover who you were in your previous life and fight off bandits if necessary. Unveil the veil of prophecies and discover your own secret.

name: maboroshi caravan
short_description: maboroshi caravan is a simulation game about a journey through the desert. Many are represented by small, abstract pixel arts. Set out on a journey through a vast desert with diverse expressions with companions. The game is played with mouse and keyboard.

name: Old Coin Pusher Friends 2
short_description: 'Old Coin Pusher Friends 2' is an online cooperative coin pusher game set in the Edo period. Players work together to defeat yokai, repel skulls, and aim for the jackpot. As the game progresses, players can upgrade their abilities and equipment to become stronger.

name: Car For Sale Simulator 2023
short_description: Car for sale simulator 2023 game in detail, you can buy and sell vehicles in the town and you can sell more vehicles by establishing a vehicle gallery and developing your company.

name: Multiplayer Military
short_description: Multiplayer Military - Aliens are invading the Military Base. The World needs Your Help. You and Your team of Elite Soldiers must take out ALL Aliens and Save the Planet.

name: Aerial Platforms
short_description: Aerial Platforms is a first person platformer game. Run your way through levels, before the timer hits 0:00, jumping on different platforms while 'the floor is lava'

name: friends world
short_description: This is a voxel style sandbox game that focuses on survival. You can do anything inside and destroy any block. and cooperatively survive and fight with friends in a world. If you like playing Minecraft, this is a game you must not miss.

name: Toon Toon Racing
short_description: Toon Toon Racing is a stylized racing game with pretty cool physics and music. Choose your car and get ready!

name: TORIDAMA: Brave Challenge
short_description: Who is the bravest?

name: Love on Leave
short_description: Your goal is to enjoy your time off surrounded by nature as you nurture a hearty romance with the Amakusa sisters!

name: Bear No Grudge
short_description: Take control of Bear and shoot, skate, race your way to justice across multiple locations in this thrilling action game.

name: Kargast
short_description: Kargast is a dark narrative exploration game with light RPG elements, branching endings, and a semi-satirical view of narrative RPGs. It tells the story of an unwell child on the brink of death, and his adventures through his surreal, cryptic surroundings.

name: TSUNDERE MILFIN
short_description: ☪️TSUNDERE MILFIN is a visual novel about a working relationship with a Muslim ladyboss. Solve match3 puzzles and properly invest company money to win the favor of your lewd religious boss :3

name: Demon Scrolls
short_description: Stop the Primagen before he can find the Demon Scrolls to usher in an Age of Darkness in this Single Player RPG

name: Last Holiday
short_description: Last Holiday is set in a picturesque North Bohemian village during the holidays in year 2000, where a good little singer seeks refuge from an angry old man. You have to take care of all your needs, such as food, drink, cigarettes, beer, girls and just about everything that goes with village life.

name: Firmament
short_description: Firmament is a new puzzle-adventure game by the legendary game studio behind the best-selling games Myst and Riven. Featuring deep storytelling and world-building, discover the story of this seemingly abandoned world as you explore and unlock the mysteries of 3 unique Realms… and beyond!

name: Castle Of Alchemists
short_description: Defend your castle in this fast-paced tower defense/action hybrid game with stunning pixel art graphics! Play as alchemically enhanced warrior Bellator, set traps, build towers, craft powerful weapons, and defend your home! The fate of the castle lies in your hands!

name: Grey Haven
short_description: Grey Haven is a game where you explore Nightmare and build a village with the Friends you saved. Explore the Nightmare with the help of the witch, help the friends and gather resources to build your haven.

name: Greedventory
short_description: Greedventory is a gorgeous pixel-art action RPG experience, where the only thing between you and an embarrassingly swift death is your mouse. Strike, parry, and cast powerful spells on your enemies, loot ancient treasures, explore a brutal realm, and become the hero you never wanted to be!

name: The Dark Pursuer
short_description: You find yourself locked up alone in an abandoned place, but something is nearby, something dark and dangerous. Try to look for ways to get out of there before you can no longer...

name: 七楼幸存者
short_description: A 2.5d roguelike action game

name: Starship Troopers: Extermination
short_description: Starship Troopers: Extermination is a 16 player co-op FPS that puts you on the far-off front lines of an all-out battle against the Bugs! Squad up, grab your rifle, and do your part as an elite Deep Space Vanguard Trooper set to take back planets claimed by the Arachnid threat!

name: Rule the Waves 3
short_description: Rule the Waves III is a simulation of naval ship design and construction, fleet management and naval warfare from 1890 to 1970.

name: Bad Times at the Silver Lake
short_description: Immerse yourself in the story of Sarah and her dog Shibu. Solve the mystery of the terrible virus infection and save the city of Salt Lake. Solve puzzles, shoot zombies and learn the terrible secrets of this city.

name: First Odium
short_description: First Odium is a classic turn based RPG that strays from the norm.

name: Darwins Trash
short_description: Blast disgusting foes in this randomly generated lootfest roguelite dungeon crawling puzzle shooter extravaganza! No two games will ever be the same in this cave of insanity and ill-repute, and indeed, you will never be the same after experiencing this insidious piece of software.

name: Avian Knights
short_description: Battle it out with your friends or compete for the title of Grand World Champion in Avian Knights, the crazy game of mounted mayhem combat! Featuring an 8-player competitive arena mode, a classic arcade co-op mode, and tons of weapons and power-ups, there’s plenty of ways to play!

name: Magic Machine Gun
short_description: Lots of enemies are coming at you, destroy them with your magic bullets! Strengthen talents and choose unique relic combinations,Make your character stronger

name: Hells Bend on Wounded Knee
short_description: Fast paced FPS arena shooter with elements of retro shooters. Fight the oppression.

name: Zenful Journey
short_description: Step into a world of serenity and tranquility with Zenful Journey, the ultimate walking simulator for those seeking a moment of calm in their day. This zen-themed game invites you to explore a beautiful forest at your own pace, ticking off items on your list as you go.

name: Nova's Cube!
short_description: Nova's Cube! A Bullet Hell Game!

name: Zigglox
short_description: Team up with friends or get online and find blocks to build the highest and prettiest tower before the other team! Beware though, some blocks are... specials!

name: Trail of Ayash
short_description: Trail of Ayash is an innovative and exciting open world game focused on the indigenous people, their struggles. Our world is a unique version of the lands dominated by the myths and legends of Its Inhabitants. Various tribes interact with one another, engaging in diplomacy, war, and expansion.

name: Kuroinu Redux
short_description: Desperate to end a bloody war, the Seven Shields Alliance—led by an elven goddess incarnate—seek out the assistance of the protagonist Vult and his Black Dog Mercenaries. He turns on them and takes control in this visual novel story of betrayal.

name: August Walk
short_description: The game has three story branches: normal, realistic, and mystical walk. In the normal branch you can just walk around the summer city, the forest and the spring.

name: Adorable Witch5 : Lingering
short_description: Adorable Witch5 : Lingering is a role-playing game with light-hearted and casual level solving in which the player takes on the role of the main character who is trying to learn and help his classmates in the magic world to reach the final ending.

name: 无目的地 aimless
short_description: It's a shooter game designed to destroy buildings and it's very stressful when the buildings are broken to pieces The game such as name, aimless, find a place to calm down, see yourself, fumble the road, exploration of follow up, as long as keep moving forward, always arrive!!!

name: Spaceship Survivors
short_description: Spaceship Survivors is an anime-style arena survivor roguelike where you play in space to fight against loads of alien spaceships. Create unique builds to survive and kill the final boss, or go for an endless run. You can unlock 33 playable spaceships.

name: Country Bumpkin Yutaka
short_description: Yutaka is returning from a month in the countryside at her grandmother's. She's excited to meet her friends and her sister again, but destiny has bigger plans for her...

name: Resident Silent
short_description: Resident Silent is an FPS shooter with an emphasis on atmosphere and exploration. You control a man who must escape from a town populated by zombies, the only weapon is a revolver.

name: Stack Masters
short_description: Do you enjoy playing around with the physics in games? Then this is the game for you. Stack Masters is built around exploring that concept in a competitive way. Including a built in level editor and Steam Workshop support, the game offers a never ending supply of physics sandbox gameplay to explore.

name: Live Art: Impossible Challenge
short_description: A challenging and fun game for all ages. Hold the draw button to make your character move along the lines of an image, avoid obstacles, and bring the beautiful art to life! Test your skills, and have good laughs with friends. All levels are well-crafted and carefully tested.

name: Against All Odds
short_description: Water's cut. Rent's due. Jobs are scarce. Time to get rich. Enter the Slaughter League and win against all the odds in a dizzying array of lethal multiplayer races. In this competitive, multiplayer platformer party game, there can only be one winner, so kiss those friendships goodbye!

name: Humanity
short_description: A unique blend of puzzle-solving and action-platforming. Play a lone Shiba Inu charged with commanding massive, marching crowds to the goal in Story Mode, or browse a wide array of user-made levels crafted via the in-game Stage Creator!

name: Eye of Saccharine
short_description: A girl suffering from hallucinations tries her best to live a normal life in the megapolis. She sees an advertisement for a certain doctor presenting a revolutionary technology for diagnosing and treating the psyche, 'G.L.A.Z.A'.

name: Abandoned World
short_description: Third-person action survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world. After the big disaster you will face bad things

name: Overdrive Escape
short_description: Enter the neon-lit world of Overdrive Escape, 3D first-person shooter game that will test your skills. Explore randomly generated levels, fight against waves of enemies, and choose your weapons wisely. Play now and see if you have what it takes to make it out of the city alive!

name: Groob
short_description: Embark on a challenging roguelike adventure, mastering tactical deck-building and intricate strategies as you explore unknown dungeons. Build your powerful deck, adapt to changing enemies, and utilize cards and items for victory.

name: Cook Serve Forever
short_description: Bathe in the sights, sounds, and story of Cook Serve Forever, a narrative cooking game where you serve delicious recipes to the hungry masses of Helianthus. Play your way with perks that dynamically change the difficulty while you help Nori and her partner Brie make it big in the culinary world!

name: Blood Gazm
short_description: Bloodgazm - action game where players fight against waves of aliens to save their planet. There are three arenas, powerful weapons, and retro-style graphics with breakcore music. The game has mixed reviews and is recommended for fans of challenging action games with retro aesthetics.

name: MatchR: Now Hiring
short_description: Fight with your colleagues to ascend through the MatchR company in this Match-3, RPG and Roguelike mix! Choose, upgrade and use your skills to emerge victorious! Gain new character traits during your runs which will drastically change the way you plan your matches! Also... Sticker collection!

name: Text Twist Classic
short_description: Get ready for some word-finding fun game in Text Twist Classic! Around 1800 different words to learn! Look at the jumbled letters and find all the word combinations. Over 8000 levels. Two different modes to play: Untimed and Timed.

name: KIDNEY STONE Clicker
short_description: KIDNEY STONE Clicker is a Simple Clicker idle game but odd theme. Kidney stones by clicking rapidly on the screen to break them down into smaller pieces. Collect stone for power-ups and make your body healthy.

name: The Backrooms Deeper
short_description: Your son had no-clipped into The Backrooms three years ago and you've finally found a way in to get him back. Armed with only a video camera and your determination, you set out on a journey to find him and get him out no matter the cost. Traversing the 12 levels will test your courage and resolve.

name: The American War
short_description: The American War is a first person shooter that takes place during the Vietnam conflict. The narrative is told through comic book panels from the perspective of a US Veteran recounting his experience. The accuracy of this account is dubious, twisted by trauma and the use of military stimulants.

name: Railroad Engineer
short_description: Build railroads, drive trains, collect resources, deliver goods, and grow cities.

name: Turbotron
short_description: Turbotron is an action puzzle game where you play as a robot trying to escape an abandoned industrial complex by collecting gems and navigating through obstacles. The game has 60 levels and features challenging puzzles that test your reaction time and speed.

name: Tavern of Empire
short_description: Tavern of Empire is a story role-playing game. It has a turn-based action system. As a spy from a different country, you are sent to clean up monsters in a town. Thanks to graphics and music, you can play calmly or ambitious.

name: ASSASSIN: The First List
short_description: Assassin is a stealth action game in which information is power. Become the master assassin, taking on the role of a highly-trained agent who's been sent to eliminate a group of targets from around the world. They will never know what hit them.

name: Materialization of memories
short_description: Materialization of Memories is a Survival Horror game where you can never be sure you are in control of the situation. The materialisation zone has many surprises in store for you.

name: Nosy Little Fly
short_description: Nosy Little Fly is an unique 2D side scroller. Instead of moving sideways, you can add force to your character in any direction. You must manage your inertia in order to finish the levels. It is very funny and challenging! Are you skilled enough, though?

name: Death Horizon: Reloaded
short_description: The Horizon scientific research laboratory is a deceptively quiet place. When you came round, there were hundreds of the living dead all around you. Use both hands and your head: never stop shooting, climb up pipes and ladders, grab hold of ropes, and throw everything you find at the zombies.

name: Saint Hell
short_description: Saint Hell is a 2D RPG in which you will need to choose the side of angels or demons and lead them to victory.

name: I Am Sakuya VR: Touhou FPS Game
short_description: Now in VR! Dodge bullets, shoot enemies and even stop time as you navigate through 15 beautiful levels in this perfect blend of bullet hell and VR FPS. Uncover the origins of Sakuya Izayoi's past and investigate the mansion where the scarlet vampires resides in this Touhou Project Fangame!

name: Tin Hearts
short_description: Behind every brilliant invention, hides a magical story. Guide a troop of tin soldiers through a magical toy-filled world, in this immersive narrative puzzle adventure game from members of the team that brought you Fable.

name: Hime's Blossom
short_description: Spring rain, sakura petals are slowly falling off... You can feel the sweet scent of flowers in the air. Each of the princesses is looking for her own special petal...

name: Gather
short_description: Harvest crops, pick fruit and collect vegetables all while investigating and exploring a series of tiny islands along the way. Discover secrets hidden in the islands while relaxing and gathering a variety of objects along the way.

name: Bullet Time Battle
short_description: Bullet Time Battle is a FPS that adds precision to combat against enemy forces with bullet time. Experience an explosive gameplay as you plant/defuse bomb or capture/defend flags while battling enemies. Are you ready?

name: Sujeto 124: El hombre de traje
short_description: Daniel Arias heads towards a mysterious house that his company bought, investigate the place and solve the puzzles that you will find to discover the terrible truth.

name: Small World Of Golf
short_description: Chill out and relax with 2 Golf Games in 1.Play 18 holes of Small Golf & 18 holes of Mini Golf, each with 2 game modes, normal play & par or under.Thanks for checking out Small World of Golf.

name: Hexapoda
short_description: After the last human war, gases were spread through the atmosphere making it unbreathable. The richest to fled to orbital colonies and the others took refuge underground. Get ready to fight giant Insects for the future of humanity !

name: DARKSITE
short_description: DARKSITE is a single player FPS horror experience. Use puzzle elements, exploration, audio cues, and combat to escape.

name: 像素世界 Pixel World
short_description: This is a pixel sandbox game where you can place multiple different elements into the scene to create a unique little world.

name: Scramble All Fighters
short_description: Amazing graphics. Countless different units. An addictive Battle Pass. We have none of those things. Just one carrier and as many tiny fighters as you can muster to hold back hordes of enemy fighters and bombers. Victory is not enough - you may win the battle, but still lose the war!

name: Cute Puzzles!!!
short_description: Cute Puzzles!!! The game is very simple, you have to collect a picture, which consists of 20 elements.

name: Aliens Tower Defense
short_description: Sometimes it's better to prevent something that might happen...

name: AQUA KITTY UDX
short_description: AQUA KITTY UDX blasts onto PC in this enhanced Ultra Deluxe Edition including the epic Dreadnought game mode!

name: LEGO® 2K Drive
short_description: Welcome to Bricklandia, home of a massive open-world LEGO® driving adventure. Race anywhere, play with anyone, build your dream rides, and defeat a cast of wild racing rivals for the coveted Sky Trophy!

name: The Outlast Trials
short_description: Red Barrels invites you to experience mind-numbing terror, this time with friends. Whether you go through the trials alone or in teams, if you survive long enough and complete the therapy, Murkoff will happily let you leave… but will you be the same?

name: Emiline: The Ghost of White Willow
short_description: A psychological horror VR game. Taking place during the events of D-day, find yourself trapped in the gothic horrors of White Willow Manor Hall. Follow your sections lieutenant into combat before fighting a new battle of survival in the dark haunted past of the house.

name: Love Love Joe Biden: The Joe Biden Dating Simulator
short_description: Welcome to the retirement home! To win Joe's heart, you'll have to navigate the enticing world of gilfs, big hunky wolf-men, and sleepy presidents... Do you have what it takes?

name: Dead City
short_description: It doesn't matter who you are or who you were before. Welcome to the Dead City!

name: SubwaySim Hamburg
short_description: Explore the picturesque U3 line of Hamburg's elevated railroad in the new SubwaySim Hamburg!

name: Screws Loose
short_description: Be the best battle bot in this fun multiplayer shooter. Challenge others to this deathmatch style game across various maps and battlegrounds. Get more kills than your foe and win the match.

name: Hand of Doom
short_description: Sign a contract in blood! Travel throughout the planes of existence slaying or befriending powerful doomlords in this wizard simulator inspired by the FMV games and dungeon crawlers of the early 90's. Learn powerful spells to solve puzzles and combat the dark forces amassing against you.

name: Elypse
short_description: Embark upon a tragic tale and discover the ravaged world of Elypse! Fight your destiny in an arduous 2D adventure, story rich platformer, in a mesmerising and mysterious world.

name: Mass Effect 2 (2010) Edition
short_description: Are you prepared to lose everything to save the galaxy? You'll need to be, Commander Shepard. It's time to bring together your greatest allies and recruit the galaxy's fighting elite to continue the resistance against the invading Reapers.

name: Morels: Homestead
short_description: Build your very own homestead in this sandbox VR adventure. Grow and harvest crops, explore and dig up treasure, trade and sell your way to glory as you grow your homestead into something amazing.

name: Magic Garden
short_description: Players need to plant various plants to defend their gardens, and at the same time, they need to cultivate these plants to increase their combat effectiveness.

name: Cubic Figures
short_description: Cubic Figures is a minimalistic puzzle game where you need to make up different figures from a number of given shaped blocks.

name: V-Hunter Puzzler Dx
short_description: Hunt a plethora of monsters using unique items in a dynamic turn-based grid puzzler! Complete the bite-sized levels in as few turns as possible and help V-Hunter defeat the evil vampire Alric!

name: Deadblast
short_description: Arrange the warriors correctly to defeat the enemy!

name: Evil Wizard
short_description: Evil Wizard is a humor-filled action RPG that puts you in the shoes of a former Final Boss. Rise from defeat, rediscover long lost powers, and fight to reclaim your castle from an army of so-called heroes.

name: AngelStrike
short_description: AngelStrike is an exciting 2D side-scrolling shoot'em'up with handmade pixel-art and a variety of action-packed missions. Play solo or local co-op with friends to rescue refugees, stealthily deliver supplies, escort your allies, and take down hordes of machines in 40 levels across 5 different areas!

name: Blooming Business: Casino
short_description: Blooming Business: Casino is a relaxing tycoon simulation game with a retro Vegas twist. Build and run your own fantasy casino in a bustling world full of animals, drama and danger.

name: Multiplayer Turtles
short_description: Multiplayer Turtles - Evil Frogs are attacking the Turtle Temple. You and Your elite team must Hack & Slash Your way to get rid of the invaders.

name: 桃の華は鮮血に染まる
short_description: 陰陽師の少女達が冒険をする純和風テキストアドベンチャーゲーム。 おとぎ話のような世界を、小説感覚で読み進んでいく。 途中の選択肢で結末が変化するため、何度も試して神の一手を掴み取れ。

name: Travel Cuisine Collector's Edition
short_description: Tammy and Matthew dream of owning their own restaurant! But how can you achieve your dreams without the much-needed experience and capital? The culinary tournament is the solution to all problems.

name: End of Lines
short_description: Travel across landscapes devastated by a catastrophic climate meltdown, following a small family in search of somewhere habitable. With limited supplies and facing potential death at every turn, your choices will decide their fate. Will they manage to settle down?

name: Death From Above
short_description: In Death From Above, you are a lone Ukrainian military drone operator battling Russian occupation forces. Hidden behind enemy lines, you command a 'super drone' to seek and destroy tanks, take back communication towers, recover stolen goods, and fight for a better tomorrow. Slava Ukraini!

name: Metro Manager LA
short_description: Metro Manager LA is a strategy simulation game about connecting communities throughout Los Angeles. Manage maintenance, security, wait time, and train capacity as you attempt to keep the riders of Los Angeles happy.

name: The Pit
short_description: Fight extremely challenging bosses by dodging their every attack and landing powerful combos. In a game that tests your reaction speed while making you feel untouchable.

name: The Mage
short_description: Casual 2D puzzle platformer game that will transport you to a world of magic. Play as a powerful mage on a quest to save his King from a dark and malevolent force that threatens to destroy everything in its path.

name: The Baby In Yellow
short_description: You've got a new babysitting job, and things are taking a turn for the weird. Feed him, read him a bedtime story, and try not to fall into his dreams. How long can you stay in control?

name: Lord of the Click: Interstellar Wars
short_description: Let’s do it once more, people! New chapter of the critically acclaimed Lord of the Click series is finally here. And it's tetralogy now meaning we’re done with the trilogy thing and up for something bigger. Interstellar Wars take the neverending conflict to a whole new level — in space!

name: Cosmic Overdrive
short_description: Cosmic Overdrive brings fast-paced rounds of a VR sci-fi runner that prioritizes comfort, immersion and engagement. Physically maneuver your spacecraft with interactive machinery. Fly cautiously to survive, but not so cautiously that the portal closes before you can make it through.

name: Super Astrovade
short_description: Dodge, weave and evade a maze of enemies... with no guns and no upgrades. Attack with your thruster. Charge your shield to stay alive. Rack up a giant score by dodging endless waves of bullet hell. How long will you survive?

name: Mr.T Survival
short_description: Mr.T Survival is a survival game set in the wild jungle of nature. Players take on the role of Mr.T, a backpacker on his travel journey who encounters an accident that leaves him stranded on a remote and unfamiliar island. Gather resources to craft items and structures that match your survival style

name: Kingmaker Academy: Warrior's Duels
short_description: Dear warriors of the Kingmaker Academy! Face your talented colleagues in challenging duels at our school’s most important tournament! Improve your skills with each duel, become the king of warriors and rule the school. But beware, remember it’s a roguelike! You dont want to be eliminated, do you?!

name: Ezerath's Last Hope
short_description: A dungeon crawler, beat em' up RPG with an open world for you to explore.

name: Lorena and the Land of Ruins
short_description: Lorena and the Land of Ruins is a third-person 3D platform shooter in which you explore a beautiful fantasy world filled with many mysteries and ruins of the past!

name: Do Not Feed the Monkeys 2099
short_description: Spy on strangers through security cameras, invade their privacy and discover their secrets in this digital voyeur simulator. Welcome to the future of The Primate Observation Club. Even in 2099 the rule about messing with your unlucky subjects still remains in this sequel: DO NOT feed the monkeys!

name: Big Sword Hero
short_description: A platform fighting game with 4-player local, a party game that guarantees the mix between fun and epic battles with tense disputes. Simple mechanics and with varied maps and modes, each dispute is always unique.

name: Hello Neighbor VR: Search and Rescue
short_description: A suspenseful family-friendly VR experience set in the Hello Neighbor Universe.

name: Nyan-Nyan Punch!
short_description: 냥냥펀치(Nyan-Nyan Punch!)는 귀여운 동물귀 소녀들이 공중에서 1대 1 싸움을 벌이는 액션 게임입니다. 언뜻 보면 슈팅 게임처럼 보이지만 펀치를 날려 시원한 근접 공격으로 싸워야 합니다!

name: Mystery Case Files: Incident at Pendle Tower
short_description: Pendle Tower was once a lavish high-rise hotel, but a new renovation has awakened a long-dormant secret within its foreboding halls.

name: Heliopolis Six
short_description: Embark on a cosmic odyssey as the director of your own space station in a galaxy full of wonders. Skillful management is vital as you construct and connect station components, oversee resource handling, and guide your space haven to reach new heights amidst the stars.

name: Pegafuerte el terrible
short_description: You are a man with a mission: shoot to the aliens that are trying to take over the world and rescue your little town 'the powerful candle' Side scrolling platform game, similar to 'Metal Slug', single player, offline, many checkpoints and varied levels!

name: Twilight Struggle: Red Sea
short_description: Answer the summons of the trumpets and bear the burden of the Twilight Struggle. Set during the ideological tension of the Cold War, Twilight Struggle: Red Sea places the United States and the Soviet Union at odds in the Horn of Africa. Every choice you make will impact the balance of power.

name: Fairy Fencer F: Refrain Chord
short_description: Help Fang and the gang harness the power of song in this comedic tactical RPG romp.

name: Glitch Busters: Stuck On You
short_description: It’s a normal day on the net, until a virus outbreak turns everything upside-down. Only your squad of GLITCH BUSTERS can take on the net’s kookiest bugs in an online world gone haywire in this 1-4 player co-op 3rd person shooter.

name: CONVERGENCE: A League of Legends Story™
short_description: Traverse the sprawling city of Zaun as Ekko, a young inventor with a device to manipulate time, in this story-driven action platformer. Collect parts, craft gadgets, and unlock abilities—then rewind time to adapt your approach to every new challenge.

name: After Us
short_description: Explore the corners of a surrealistic post-human world to give life on Earth a second chance in this touching story about sacrifice and hope.

name: The Shape of Things
short_description: Experience a relaxing atmosphere from the comfort of your cozy room by solving small 3D puzzles inside collectible gachapons, and find the original shape of things inspired by Rubik’s style.

name: Roots Need Control 3.0
short_description: A coalition of large corporations trying to destroy the root flowers is invading Daejeon. Protect the root flowers. It's not going to be easy. Because... Roots Need Control.

name: Hello Goodboy
short_description: A lost soul and his dog set out on an otherworldly trek through the afterlife in this wholesome, non-linear adventure game. Pass into the world beyond, perform acts of kindness for other souls, and mend mistakes from a forgotten past life - all with a very good boy by your side!

name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun
short_description: Load up your Boltgun and unleash the awesome Space Marine arsenal to blast your way through an explosion of sprites, pixels and blood in a perfect blend of Warhammer 40,000, frenetic gameplay and the stylish visuals of 90’s retro shooters.

name: Zone VX
short_description: Upgrade, fight, and survive against an unrelenting enemy onslaught in this adrenaline-fueled vehicle combat roguelike. How long can you stay alive?

name: Trans Neuronica
short_description: LINK nodes; UNTANGLE paths; REBUILD memory; ASSESS humans; A puzzle where logic goes hand in hand with surgical precision and humans ask artificial intelligence for help. But only if you trust them enough.

name: Oldowan
short_description: Oldowan is a first-person casual survival sandbox game that is focused on very early humanity and how it developed. The crafting is all based on real practices, but the survival aspects are relaxed. Play solo or with 1-3 friends.

name: Above Snakes
short_description: Piece by piece, create your own world in this relaxing Wild West-inspired worldbuilder. Craft, farm, hunt, build your base, and explore.

name: Greed and Grind
short_description: Hello guys I am bringing you this time around a small cozy little game about greed and grinding!! If you played my previous games you should know what to expect! If you didnt... This is a small Idle game where the character battles autommatically while everything you do is drink a coffee.

name: Number8
short_description: Sci-Fi 3D first/third person corridor shooter with full free movement, dynamic controls, destruction physics and a variety of enemy types. Your protagonist woke up in an unknown place, with no memory of who she is, but with combat skills. Get out alive and try to understand the place you're in.

name: The Chronicles: Wasteland Assault
short_description: The wastes of Dubai have been overwhelmed by Screamers. Play and evolve the iconic characters from the hit novel; The Chronicles: Wasteland and take back the dead lands. Survive against the horror and use whatever it takes to last long enough to build sanctions, unlock characters and many items.

name: Morte Accendere
short_description: A sci-fi zombie infected third or first person action with elements of parkour, combat with weapons or hand to hand, many modes of transportation. Ability to craft items and build your safe zone.

name: Party Bots
short_description: Party Bots is an online party game for up to 100 players. Survive on your platform in a chaotic arena and be the last bot standing!

name: Super Virus Defense
