short_description: Fight the virus in this fast paced arcade shooter with a dash of tower defense!

name: Hijack Overdrive
short_description: Hijack Overdrive is a fast-paced action game where you steal enemy vehicles mid-combat to fight back. Jump from gunship to gunship in order to pilot your makeshift fleet through the enemy forces. It's a unique genre-mix of Platformer, Shootemup, and a bit of Towerdefense.

name: The Hopebringer
short_description: The Hopebringer is an Unreal Engine 5 powered top down RPG, featuring procedurally generated scenarios in a fantasy setting. Partake in single player, or online co-op adventures. Unlock new scenarios, which you can then repeat at any time in multiplayer.

name: The Last Survivors
short_description: Kill the zombies and take on challenges by helping the last survivors in the city. The Last Survivors is a fun roguelite action game with an infinite power-up experience that is repeatable every time you play. Never stop, collect as much XP and Boosters to get stronger by choosing your upgrades.

name: The Icon Battles: Game
short_description: Fight your desktop icons! Play as any of your desktop icons, choose one of different classes, dodge the attacks and strike back!

name: 이세계메이드
short_description: Mansion Made Love Simulation Game

name: Galactic Conquest Battle Infinity
short_description: In the year 3200. The Ethernal ore used as fuel for spaceships was beginning to run out, a galactic war broke out for control of the Ethernal, the galactic emperor Erick V issued a challenge to achieve peace, 'the faction that can produce the most Ethernal will control the entire galaxy'.

name: 爆裂！スイーツランド - PANIC IN SWEETS LAND -
short_description: Crushing combos and beat up enemies! No complicated controls, just fun with a variety of fighting actions! The joy and faults of a pretty magical girl knocking down her enemies? Yes, please! A delicious and crazy action game with bright and colorful sweet action!

name: GG Land
short_description: GG Land is the ultimate playground for gamers & creators. Build your dream game in minutes with our no-code tool, challenge friends in multiplayer mode, or explore endless creations!

name: Missing Critters
short_description: Embark on a delightful adventure and seek out the Missing Critters hidden within intricate cartoon scenes, with a soothing lo-fi soundtrack and no time limits - just relax and unwind. Enjoy a captivating experience that will provide fresh challenges, as each play-through is unique.

name: Future Racer 2000
short_description: Only You Can Be The Future Racer 2000

name: Chronicles of 2 Heroes: Amaterasu's Wrath
short_description: Amaterasu and her yokai army rule over feudal Japan. Switch in real time between Kensei and Ayame to defeat the goddess in this intense, 16-bit action platformer with Metroidvania elements and gorgeous pixel art.

name: HexDefense
short_description: HexDefense is a roguelike tower defense with an emphasis on constant action with little to no downtime. Defend your city by building towers, upgrading them with money from their fallen foes, and equipping them with strange items you find out in the world!

name: Bread & Fred
short_description: Grab your best bud for help in this new co-op challenge to help two adorable penguins, Bread and Fred, reach the top of the snowy summit. Time your jumps, cling to walls and swing across gaps to see how far you can make it before you tumble all the way back down the mountain.

name: Kizuna AI - Touch the Beat!
short_description: Say hello (morning!) to a new kind of rhythm game, and hang out in a virtual space with Kizuna AI!

name: 守麥精靈黛芽
short_description: Play as a wheat fairy, using the magical energy of the wheat field to dispel the threats of wheat! Combine different skills to make your own attack style! And let the wheat grow and harvest smoothly under the test of other nature fairies.

name: Shrommzzz
short_description: Fung around and find out! A cozy mushroom foraging and farming game. Plant shromspores on 6 different islands to unlock all combinations. Can you make all 100 of 'em pop up? Challenge accepted!

name: Spiral Dystopia
short_description: Kou Osakaki has spent his entire life watching over his family's shrine, peacefully whiling away the days with his close childhood friends. But when a beautiful young girl transfers to his class, everything changes.

name: Prime Directive
short_description: Prime Directive is a first person 3D action-adventure shooter in which players control Marty, a small but brave robot. Marty acquires unique abilities to fight enemies and solve puzzles while exploring a mysterious alien world.

name: Only Up!
short_description: Have you ever wanted to walk up to the clouds? Embark on an exciting journey in Only UP! Exploring a huge world full of secrets and mysteries, you have to get as high as possible, and the most interesting starts above the clouds...

name: Date with Foxgirl
short_description: Have you ever wondered why you don't have a girlfriend? Or have you ever wondered if you will ever find a girlfriend? Sometimes it doesn't take much to meet a beautiful foxy girl... Just go to a cafe for coffee in time, and have a little perseverance and desire...

name: Idle Taoist Mage Warrior
short_description: Are you familiar with the three major professions of warrior, mage, and Taoist. Simple placement gameplay.

name: Ketamina
short_description: 'Ketamine' is a First-Person game in which you need to uncover why you woke up without any memory in an apparently unremarkable apartment, until you discover the secrets of the resident and consider whether you really want to stay or leave.

name: Nature Hunter
short_description: Realism, craftsmanship, self-regulating vegetation, plants, insects, mushrooms, ruins, in a semi-open world.

name: Trials of Kokoro
short_description: In this Visual Novel RPG, you will customize a group of heroes' equipment and skills before leading them into strategic battles. An emotional storyline merges with exciting, turn-based combat and party management in this epic adventure across the continent of Vitaria.

name: Tenders Fight
short_description: Tenders Fight is a fast-paced FPS Game. Fight against mutant chickens, dash through them, break through doors and find your way to Earth. As the last spaceship survivor, use your boxing skills to DESTROY EVERYTHING! These chickens will test your abilities to their limits, can you defeat them?

name: Erophone:Re
short_description: The interactive narrative puzzle game Erophone has now been newly upgraded. Welcome to Noruma City, where you can interact with Ajin girls of different personalities.   Come to explore their past and the world.

name: Memoryland Prelude
short_description: Trapped in a world of memories, you must retrace the past after a glitch in the simulation threw everything into chaos. Discover cards that can summon strange creatures and fight to unravel the mysteries of Memoryland.

name: VR-太阳系
short_description: Welcome to this exciting gaming world, where you will transform into a true space explorer and embark on a magnificent journey of exploring the wonders of the universe!

name: Tentacle Prawn: (Actually) A Cthulhu Dating Sim
short_description: It's got action! It's got romance! In this RPG-Dating Sim, gather your party and try to settle a centuries-old dispute among your monster and human classmates! The fate of Winter Prom is at stake!

name: AOISHIRO HD REMASTER
short_description: Japanese adventure game. Aoi Shiro is an adventure game that sets stage in both the modern real world and a mythical world. Aoi Shiro takes place in the same universe as its predecessor, Akai Ito.

name: Approval
short_description: A new sensation! Real-time roguelike! Approval tower 'Aprival' that everyone dreams of breaking through The Monono monory is Using the tower of approval that suddenly appeared in the village Develop a village!

name: Astro Traveler
short_description: A retro style space sim where you mine, trade, bounty hunt, pillage, and explore. In this game you choose you own path as you navigate the galaxy while balancing faction alligence and legality of your actions.

name: Annie and the AI
short_description: Step into the role of Esme, an AI built by Annie but built for what purpose? Evolve and learn by solving visual puzzles accompanied by beautiful hand-drawn artwork. Learn all about Annie's life, befriend her, and grow together.

name: INTERNULL
short_description: After waking up in the facilities of a once-successful tech company, you must find your way out and uncover the mysteries of InterNULL with your only tool being a Virtual Reality Headset.

name: Broken Minds
short_description: Broken minds is a CASUAL TURN COMBAT RPG, with a rich lore, where you control a 13 year old boy, in a mission to overcome his trauma

name: 十五
short_description: This is a plot exploration game set in the 1990s. In the game, you will go back to the age of 15, make up for those regrets and mistakes, rewrite our story and destiny, and explore different life and destination!

name: Idle: Multipliers
short_description: An IDLE game for your fun and relaxation. Multipliers based prestige system and various gameplay possibilities

name: Wild Frontier
short_description: Escape to an enchanting, living sandbox surrounded by wildlife and nature.

name: Protodroid DeLTA
short_description: Reach your potential in a fast and fluid 3D action-platformer set in a beautiful and hopeful Solarpunk world. Take on challenging bosses, upgrade your systems, and show humanity the promise of AI.

name: Marlon’s Mystery: The darkside of crime
short_description: Marlon's Mystery will test your skills as an investigator. Join Abby Marlon to solve the riddles in this captivating mystery and hidden object game. Embark on an enigmatic adventure and discover the darkest secrets of the Taylor family.

name: Birds Aren't Real
short_description: A short story-driven psychological horror game. No visual jumpscares; only mentally disturbing.

name: BATSUGUN Saturn Tribute Boosted
short_description: A PIONEER OF THE BULLET HELL GENRE BY TOAPLAN IS BACK!

name: Indemon Tales
short_description: Earn the respect of a guild full of monsters and demons as a lone human by taking part in dangerous dungeon adventures and uncover secrets behind the mysterious demon kingdom of Tarborea.

name: Tuk Tuk Race
short_description: Let's race a tuk-tuk through beautiful scenery!

name: Hot Heat Reset
short_description: A fast-paced maze action game where you play as an unknown speedster hiding under a skull who is in pursuit to recover his stolen lands and is about to deal with a lot of EXPLOSIONS! Get ready to RESET everything!

name: Elsia War
short_description: Join the fight to end the never-ending struggle of the Elsia continent. In this classic SRPG, enhance your units' strength with limited resources and achieve victory. Your choices throughout the game will impact relationships, life and death, and the starting forces and plot progression.

name: Flying Carpets Over Shark Infested Waters
short_description: Combat and survival. Escape from the Death Maze and from Rat Island. Defeat the pirates in aerial combat, while sharks swim below. Board the pirate ship and steal their gold. Everyone and everything is out to get you. Get them first. In the final scene find and terminate your nemesis. The parrots.

name: Dynopunk
short_description: An ironic adventure with cyberpunk aesthetics set in a world where humans have been replaced by dinosaurs. Become a top-notch repair shop mechanic: fix gadgets, have heart-to-heart talks, and offer drinks to your customers — everything to fulfill your ultimate dream.

name: Eclipse Survivors
short_description: Experience the ultimate challenge in Eclipse Survivors, a bullet-hell / area shooter game featuring epic bosses inspired by classic 16-bit titles. Collect XP gems, master unique skills, and dodge countless enemy bullets as you face off against hordes of foes. Will you survive the eclipse?

name: Summer Trip Cruise
short_description: Hey you, we need a captain! Drive the cruise ship with the on-screen rudder, avoid obstacles, take pictures and enjoy the ride. Take it easy... or take the challenge!

name: Diluvian Winds
short_description: Diluvian Winds is a management game set in a small hamlet at the foot of a lighthouse. Welcome weary travelers and help each other to try and survive the unpredictable weather. Grow your hamlet on land, under the sea or among the clouds.

name: Frontline: Panzers & Generals Vol. I
short_description: Experience the thrill of commanding your army to victory in this exciting Table-top World War II Hex-strategy game. Strategize your way to success by conquering objectives and outsmarting your opponents!

name: Araka~JK Exorcist Horror RPG
short_description: Manipulate the main character with power of telepathic, looking for the trace of Araka, an Exorcist imprisoned in the other world.

name: The Lord of the Rings: Gollum™
short_description: Play as Gollum on his quest to retrieve his Precious. You will need to climb the mountains of Mordor, sneak around Mirkwood and make difficult choices. Who will gain the upper hand: the cunning Gollum or the innocent Smeagol?

name: Gaslamp Cases 5 - The dreadful City
short_description: Play the 5th part of the Match3 saga! Morgan, Jack, and Eleanor have solved numerous mystical casesin and out London, but their return to London greets them with terror. London is quarantined, caught in the grip of a mysterious illness, with no cure in sight - can they save thousands of lifes?

name: Animal Kostume
short_description: No talk, compadre. It's Animal Kostume time! Follow kroc-boy in his path to overcome a series of difficult levels in this hardcore 2D platformer with a lot of enemies, bullets and surprises.

name: Balls and Coins
short_description: Are you looking for a definite solution to boredom? Then you are in the right place. Physics-based running game Balls and Coins promise excitement, tranquility, and peace of mind, while also pushing your limits. Avoid enemies and obstacles, collect coins, and be the who achieves the highest score.

name: Alpaca Sprint
short_description: Run, dodge trees, and see how far you can get in this retro arcade inspired runner!

name: Charge!
short_description: Charge! Lead your elite squad to advance! Use dozens of weapons, armor sets, and relics to create a variety of gameplay styles and eliminate endless enemies!

name: Blue Man Adventure
short_description: short game time, no story、no dialogue. The core of the game is battle-oriented, The ultimate goal of the game is to kill the biggest monster.

name: Pengun
short_description: Pengun is a 3rd person shooting, defense, survivor game. shoot down threats in Antarctica. and survive as long as possible.

name: Tennis Manager 2023
short_description: Immerse yourself in the ultimate tennis simulation, where your decisions both on and off the court will shape the destiny of your academy. Be the number 1 manager and become a national Team Captain to lead your team to greatness. Serve your colors and win the World Cup of Tennis!

name: Kirin Come
short_description: Kirin Come is a SCI-FI comedy Visual Novel. Help Rachel Reid and her charming partner Mary find their happiness somewhere among the cold vacuum of space!

name: Phonk Cats
short_description: Play the dynamic rhythm game to the best phonk tracks! Play solo or versus your friend, customize your cats, choose different game modes - Phonk Cats are waiting for you!

name: Knight Trail
short_description: A silly little micro RPG. You are Sir Knick, trying to save the kingdom without dying from general incompetence. You're free to explore the expansive world any way you'd like, but beware of what you might encounter.

name: Railway Empire 2
short_description: Don the coat of a clever entrepreneur, take over a small railway company in the early 1800s and turn your steam engines into the workhorses of the economy. Grow your company into the largest railway company of the continent and outsmart your competitors.

name: Turbo Shell
short_description: Turbo Shell is a fast-paced precision platformer where, instead of running and jumping, you push and pull yourself to get ahead at high-speed. The more skilfully you master this unique mechanic, the quicker you’ll conquer ever more challenging levels - and reach your goal in record time.

name: AKAIITO HD REMASTER
short_description: Japanese adventure game. Set in the present age, the game unfolds from the point of view of Kei Hato, a girl who has a special blood called 'Nieno Chi'. A special system called the blood sucking system is used.

name: Five Nights at Tinky's
short_description: Five nights at Tinky's is a indie horror game, where you apply for a job as a nightguard at the 'Tinkys Lasagne Place'. You only need to work for 5 nights to receive your payment, but soon you will find out that you are not alone... Can you survive the 5 nights?

name: Bounda Forever
short_description: A lovely style of painting rogue-like games. In the game you face a tide of enemies, defeat them, and survive. The game offers many weapons to help you win. No long story, no ending, any time you can be reckless to a game.

name: Cruel Reality: A horrible dream
short_description: Horrible Dream - first of the Cruel Reality trilogy, a visual novel with elements of psychological horror.

name: Haishan
short_description: 'Haishan' is a traditional Chinese-style cultivation roguelite game. Set in a world where the revival of spiritual Qi has awakened demons that wreak havoc on the modern world, you traverse ancient realms with the aid of the 'Kunlun Mirror,' embarking on a journey of cultivation.

name: Cruise Ship Manager
short_description: Take the challenge of managing a cruise ship! Maintain your vessel, plan your route, and sell tickets to the wealthiest passengers. Give tasks to your crew and keep their morale high. Choose the ship's layout and the offered amenities. Keep the prices right, passengers happy, and your wallet full!

name: Pawperty Damage
short_description: Smash, kick, stomp and chomp your way through a fully destructible city! Go to town in this cathartic action sandbox, either alone or in split screen local multiplayer.

name: Halls of Torment
short_description: Slay hordes of terrifying monsters in this horde survival roguelite. Descend into the Halls of Torment where the lords of the underworld await you. Treasures, magic trinkets, and a growing cast of heroes will grant you the power to vanquish the horrors from beyond. How long can you survive?

name: Indoor Kickball
short_description: Indoor Kickball is fast paced 1v1 game of kickball played where your parents wouldn't let you. Destroy the living room, kitchen, bedroom, basement, and many other rooms of the house with a chaotic game of kickball.

name: HeliVR Simulator
short_description: With intuitive controls, effortlessly take off and master helicopter flying, saving yourself countless hours of practice. So, put on your headset, get comfortable, and enjoy the seamless experience!

name: おいでませ、こくりさん - Welcome Kokurisan -
short_description: A short novel game with ASMR starring VTuber 'Kurune Kokuri'! With the ASMR voices, players can enjoy a close situation with Kurune Kokuri.

name: How many Deaths to Clear?
short_description: 'How many deaths to clear?' is a time attack game where you compete to clear the game as quickly as possible while keeping your death count as low as possible. Try to clear the game as fast as you can without dying too much, and enjoy the thrilling sensation that comes with it.

name: Haunted Tower
short_description: A game about Strategy, not Gems. Tower Defense indie game focused on strategy with well-balanced levels and a variety of game modes.

name: Koler
short_description: In Koler, a rogue-lite stylized world, you have the power to slay infected creatures or cure them and make them your companions. Build your arsenal with tons of Relics and Color Shards, and combine them to defeat the Void Lord. With endless possibilities, the choice is yours.

name: In the footage
short_description: 'In the footage' is a horror exploration game.[/h2]You awaken in an empty room with nothing to do but play a videotape lying on the floor and contemplate the meaning of the footage. That's all you can do at this point.

name: Medved Hellraiser
short_description: You are the only one who can restore order to the world! Arm yourself and stop this madness using your shooting potential.

name: Kung Fu Legend
short_description: A funny open-world game made for the lolz.

name: Miasma Chronicles
short_description: From the creators of Mutant Year Zero: Road to Eden comes a beautifully crafted tactical adventure you won’t forget. Embark on a quest across a post-apocalyptic wasteland torn apart by a savage force known only as the ‘Miasma’.

name: Bat Boy
short_description: Ryosuke isn't just your regular high-school kid. He and his fellow sports-star friends secretly battle against the evil invading forces of Lord Vicious, hellbent on hosting sinister athletic events for his own amusement! Ryosuke is Bat Boy!

name: Zombie Defense
short_description: A Single and cooperative game for 4 players, you are a fighter of a special purpose unit, your task is to destroy waves of zombies by taking convenient positions and using tactic

name: The Lone Blade
short_description: The Lone Blade is a 3D platformer where you are a soul trapped in a sword. In order to redeem yourself, you will have to create your own path: jump, dash, spin, or spike to the ground and walls to go through the deserts and climb canyons, and temples... to the highest mountain.

name: Caveman Ransom
short_description: A fun 16-bit style platformer where you play a caveman fighting against bandits and dinosaurs. It is perfect for carefree gaming and a must for kids as well as for those who want to experience that 1990s nostalgia!

name: Planet of Lana
short_description: A young girl and her loyal friend embark on a rescue mission through a colorful world full of cold machines and unfamiliar creatures. Planet of Lana is a cinematic puzzle adventure framed by an epic sci-fi saga that stretches across centuries and galaxies.

name: SHINOBI NON GRATA
short_description: Shinobi alert! Use your 7 shinobi weapons to survive the bloodshed! Introducing a hard core 2D ninja action game by Hyper-retro graphics.

name: Inkbound
short_description: Inkbound reinvents turn-based gameplay in a fluid online-only co-op roguelike from the creators of Monster Train. Play solo or party up to dive into the magical, dangerous books of the Atheneum Library and fight to save this rich, ever-expanding world.

name: Delusion
short_description: Delusion is an unusual puzzle game that tells a story about a beautiful world, full of life and colors, which changed beyond recognition after a series of unexplainable events had taken place.

name: Project Romboid
short_description: Project Romboid is a hard, arcade shooter roguelite in which you will have to pick and combine items so that you can survive waves of enemies that will chase you and shoot at you. New items will appear every level. Combine them to create powerful builds that will help you survive.

name: Return to Grace
short_description: A daring space archaeologist has just unearthed the ancient resting place of a long lost A.I. god known as Grace. Adventure with various fractured A.I. personalities as you uncover the great mystery of why she was shut down all those years ago.

name: Farworld Pioneers
short_description: Explore an open world, sci-fi sandbox – in PVP, PVE, and co-op. Build and manage colonies on alien planets, and recruit AI survivors with unique personalities and skills. Craft, build, mine, farm, or get your electric death rifle and say hello to your neighbors.

name: Mobius' radio waves
short_description: 刚入学的大一新生伊琳，却在一个风雨交加的夜晚，听到了来自杂物间内部的来电铃声……这通神秘电话究竟来自何人？杂物间为何会成为禁忌？伊琳手臂上的无限印记又意味着什么？文字冒险推理游戏《莫比乌斯的电波》，就此展开！

name: Suicide Guy VR
short_description: Experience Suicide Guy now in Virtual Reality for the greatest, most immersive snooze! These surreal dreams have never been so chaotic and frantic. If you're faint of heart, do not play this game.

name: Gninja Pig
short_description: Gninja Pig is a platformer 2D game with pixel art. A unique dose of cuteness with movements and attacks to take on challenges. Humans disappeared after a mysterious disaster, so you have to survive on your own but maybe you’ll find allies in your adventure.

name: Heaven Forest NIGHTS
short_description: The sequel to the Heaven Forest series. While the first game was about the meaning of life, this new one is about its opposite: what is the meaning of death? Since we are sentient beings who know that sooner or later we will die, do our efforts in the everyday life have a meaning at all?

name: A Street Cat's Tale 2
short_description: The Adventures of House Cat Cinnamon

name: Super Mega Baseball™ 4
short_description: Super Mega Baseball™ 4 is where the Legends play. The signature combo of arcade-inspired style and immersive gameplay returns with over 200 baseball Legends and a grand slam of presentation upgrades.

name: Everdream Valley
short_description: A farming adventure with a dash of magic. By day, restore your quaint homestead into a summer paradise. Raise crops, care for animals and rebuild to your heart's content. At night inhabit the various farmland creatures through your dreams and bring enchantment to the valley.

name: Crowd Playground
short_description: The one and only crowd simulation game, Crowd Playground!

name: Just Skill Shooter
short_description: Just Skill Shooter is a first-person shooter game where you take on the role of a soldier fighting enemies in two different maps. You have access to different weapons - a rifle, a shotgun or other- which you can use to eliminate enemy combatants.

name: That's My Space
short_description: The universe is yours to conquer in That's My Space. Gather resources, craft powerful weapons, upgrade your spaceship and battle against enemy nations to become the ultimate space explorer.

name: Death Harvest
short_description: Death Harvest is a cooperative VR indie game in which players assume the role of a group of survivors from the Boston combat unit - the Reapers. Fight for the survival of your colony in a post-apocalyptic world full of zombies.

name: Magenta Horizon
short_description: Magenta Horizon is a fast-paced 2D action platformer game that is heavily inspired by the Spectacle Fighter genre. Playing as a Reaper of the twisted purgatorial afterlife, push your skills to the limit to destroy the hordes of demons and epic bosses to reach your destination.

name: Speedway Challenge 2023
short_description: Speedway Challenge 2023 is a 3D speedway game. Feel speedway emotions thanks to realistic riding physics. Play online mode with friends or local in career mode, league mode, challenges, tournament and quick matches. Are you ready for the challenge?

name: System Shock
short_description: A first-person fight to the death in the depths of space!

name: STASIS: BONE TOTEM
short_description: Get ready for a thrilling underwater adventure with classic point-and-click gameplay. Explore with three characters simultaneously. Featuring atmospheric isometric graphics, rendered video, and a soundtrack by Mark Morgan, BONE TOTEM takes you on a journey to hidden places deep below the waves...

name: Sybil is Haunted
short_description: Sybil has a very scrambled mind. Some days she just needs you to push her along. Help Sybil navigate the horrors of her bedroom and see what adventures await. Find every ending to see what lays in her future. HYIPHYOP

name: Heaven Forest - VR MMO
short_description: The pressing human questions about life depend directly on our attitudes toward the universe. You'll find the answers you're searching for through a series of reasonings and clues during your journey in this game as well as in your own life.

name: Comrades and Barons: Gates of Freedom
short_description: The Great War had barely ended, when Red Army started an offensive westwards to ignite the revolution in Europe. In this turn-based hex wargame you will experience the war operations of that exciting and turbulent time.

name: Mega Maze
short_description: 当传统的迷宫游戏被放大千百倍后，挑战一词将不足以形容其难度。随机生成的迷宫，有限的时间，在仅有标记道具的帮助下，您需要多久才能全部通关？

name: Driftwood
short_description: A game about high-speed downhill longboarding and a sloth named Eddy. Carve up the mountainside as you drift through the beautiful landscape, and find the perfect balance of speed and control.

name: DOOMBLADE
short_description: Deep underground, Gloom Girl discovers DOOMBLADE, a sentient weapon hellbent on escape after eons in chains. Together, “Doom and Gloom” embark on a vengeful quest to unlock the powerful abilities and destroy the Dread Lords once and for all in this 2D Action Metroidvania.

name: Escape from the Marble Monster
short_description: Rotate the world, physics will move the marbles. Dodge obstacles, collect stars, lead monsters to a quick death, a journey against the clock full of challenges and fun.

name: Abstract Driver
short_description: Abstract Driver is a 1-person game where you have to move inside a cylindrical space. This game is a dynamic action game in which you have to control the camera to the rhythmic music and score points. If you collect a certain number of points, you get achievements.

name: Wise Garden
short_description: Play as a gardener in Wise Garden, a puzzle game inspired by feudal Japan. Play with zen garden's elements and find your own solution to please your clients. Establish yourself as the best gardener.

name: Locuras en el Banaverso
short_description: Madness in the Banaverse, is an adventure game featuring El Bananero, the legendary youtuber famous in Latin America, as the main character, who will go through levels full of puzzles, comedy, laughter, opponents and other challenges. To solve them he will use his abilities or the help of allies.

name: Tornado: Research and Rescue
short_description: Get ready for non-stop action with Tornado: Research and Rescue! Chase down violent tornadoes using 90's style doppler radar, deploy scientific probes, and earn money to upgrade your equipment. Enjoy a unique experience with procedurally generated tornadoes and scenarios!

name: Unboxing
short_description: An idle game about unboxing and selling items! Optimize and automize your work with drones and relax watching them work while you manage and upgrade new contracts!

name: Unknown Memoirs: The Rental
short_description: 'Unknown Memoirs' is a short horror game series focusing on distressing tales of horror. 'The Rental' centers on the main character moving into a rental that they found online. Little do they know of the horrors that await them.

name: Our Adventurer Guild
short_description: Become the new Guild Master of the Adventurer Guild and lead your adventurers in explorations and turnbased tactical battles. Will the Guild strive under your leadership? Or will it finally disband under it?

name: We Love Katamari REROLL+ Royal Reverie
short_description: The second title in the Katamari Damacy series has returned in a remastered, powered-up version! This new REROLL comes with improved graphics and gameplay enhancements. In Royal Reverie, roll up katamari as the King of All Cosmos in his boyhood!

name: My Summer Adventure: Memories of Another Life
short_description: A strange incident turns the life of an ordinary young man upside down when, having fallen asleep on a regular train commute, he wakes up in another country... in a body of a Japanese student! An unforgettable summer adventure awaits, promising many fateful meetings and momentous occasions.

name: Violet Bricks
short_description: Violet Bricks is an exciting puzzle game with modern 3D graphics. Help Violet defeat alien robots across dozens of challenging levels and collect power-ups to become stronger. A game that offers modernized nostalgic fun!

name: Cosmic Strike - The last Sub Sector
short_description: Giant capital ship combat! Equip your crew, choose your ship and rage battle across the stars in this top down 2D strategic shooter. Unravel the story as you fight hordes of enemies, build up your base, and become the fleet commander this sector needs in its darkest hour.

name: The Adventures of LinShanHai - Chapter5:Three Trees
short_description: 三棵树案件:报案人称自家孩子放学没回家，至今不知去向。由于学校到家需要经过一片树林，家长怀疑孩子在树林中走失。 在精美逼真的3D场景中，只需要使用鼠标操作。全新探案玩法,玩家首先需要在案发现场搜证线索,认真的分析每条线索，透过分析和关联，解锁新场景，破解案件真相。

name: We Are One
short_description: Team up with your greatest ally - YOURSELF - in this VR puzzle shooter where mind-bending challenges meet action-packed FPS gameplay! Plan ahead and clone versions of yourself that flawlessly execute your previous moves in multiple time loops. Battle your way across increasingly complex levels!

name: Killer Frequency
short_description: Killer Frequency is a first-person horror puzzle game set in 1987, that puts you in the role of a late-night radio talk show host in small town America whose callers are being stalked by a mysterious killer.

name: Etrian Odyssey II HD
short_description: Take off to the skies for High Lagaard, a mysterious castle beyond the clouds. Assemble a team of heroes, seek the mystery of the colossal Yggdrasil tree and uncover the truth of the city!

name: Pandamonium
short_description: A panda who stumbles into the Lost Capital of Hell. Explore a beautiful and dangerous world with hand drawn crisp pixel art and 2.5D graphics. Face perilous foes, bosses and friendly allies. Customize yourself with abilities and outfits that will help you conquer your way through this doomed land.

name: TASUKEMONO
short_description: A new style 'strategy-like' puzzle game! Control multiple cute characters and navigate a little girl to the goal! As the girl gets deep into the forests, her secret will be revealed...

name: Heaven Island Life
short_description: 'Heaven Island VIVE' is an experience designed for the HTC Vive in which you'll explore wonderful places. The inspiration for the environments comes from the book 'Origins of Architectural Pleasure' in which the welfare is of primary importance. The game requires the HTC Vive device.

name: Shame Legacy
short_description: Shame Legacy is a first-person survival-horror, set in a forsaken cultist village. You attempt to survive using stealth and escape. By solving puzzles, you unravel the mystery that's h(a)unting you.

name: To Hell With The Ugly
short_description: To Hell with the Ugly is an adventure game where you play as Rock Bailey, a gorgeous yet shallow young man, who must investigate and fight his way to freedom after being kidnapped. Alternate between turn-based combats and investigation in this film noir adaptation of the novel by Boris Vian.

name: Sugar Tanks
short_description: Sugar Tanks is an intense, fast-paced, and super-sweet tank shooter game. Defend your sweet home world from evil grey tanks, trying to sap all the color from it. Unlock more heroes with their own sweet perks and upgrade your tank.

name: FightBit
short_description: FightBit is a side-scrolling beat-em-up with pseudo 8-bit graphics and rudimentary gameplay influenced by contemporary melee focused combat games.

name: Slayers X: Terminal Aftermath: Vengance of the Slayer
short_description: So.... got what it takes to be a X Slayer?!?... 7 weapons, blood and gore, twisted music by Seepage & Psyko Syndikate, and maps where you can blow up everything. its awesome. started making it in 1998 in high school with my friend and now im 37, so i have life experience now.

name: Cinderstone Online
short_description: Cinderstone Online is a cute and colorful MMORPG. Protect the world from the rivalry gods wanting their stolen lands back. Climb your way for glory, farming, trading, conquering and becoming the ruler of a region. Explore and find new locations filled with rewarding loot and mysteries to uncover.

name: Mislight
short_description: An Adventure Platformer game with RPG elements about a girl who is kidnapped by a shadow monster and taken to a forest where she has to fight her way out by using a magical flashlight as her only weapon.

name: Gnome
short_description: You're taking care of your friend's house but a garden gnome appears.

name: Etrian Odyssey HD
short_description: Beyond the village of Etria lies a mysterious forest with a colossal crack opening to a puzzling labyrinth. Lead a team of explorers into the dungeon with the promise of riches, fame, and adventure!

name: Shattered Heaven
short_description: Shattered Heaven is a single-player deck builder card game with RPG elements and an ambitious branching narrative, set in a dark fantasy world. The game focuses on a card game and roguelike gameplay fueled by a great replay value, thanks to procedural dungeons, a deep crafting system.

name: Astebros
short_description: Choose your hero among three different characters and go through procedural dungeons to eliminate your formidable opponents!

name: Girls Cairo Papyrus
short_description: You are a newbie butler that just received a letter from your master, the Lady. She is coming to the island you've worked with for a vacation. If you satisfy her, you will gain a chance to be promoted to a proper butler. And with it, under the help of the twin maids, your trials began...

name: TailQuest Defense
short_description: Explore a tiny world, defeat hundreds of enemies, experiment with the environment, find all secrets and enjoy the Adventure with a friend or in single player mode!

name: DESORDRE : A Puzzle Game Adventure
short_description: Immerse yourself in the multidimensional universe of Desordre. Solve intricate puzzles, push the boundaries of 4-dimensional thinking. Get ready for a unique experience where reflection takes on a whole new dimension

name: HOLEHOLE
short_description: 'HOLEHOLE' is a relaxed adventure game where players freely explore a map, collect objects, and assist residents through conversations. The game features a visual novel-style storytelling experience and allows players to progress at their own pace.

name: Touhou Mini Map
short_description: Touhou Mini Map is a strategy building game that allows you to create a panoramic map of Touhou World

name: Street Fighter™ 6
short_description: Here comes Capcom’s newest challenger! Street Fighter™ 6 launches worldwide on June 2nd, 2023 and represents the next evolution of the Street Fighter™ series! Street Fighter 6 spans three distinct game modes, including World Tour, Fighting Ground and Battle Hub.

name: Disaster Area
short_description: Disaster Area is a stylized game that includes online combat and campaign mode. In the campaign mode, players will be brought into an unknown disaster. You will fight with your teammates to break out of the encirclement of horrible unknow creatures and explore the source of the disaster.

name: Frigato: Shadows of the Caribbean
short_description: Frigato: Shadows of the Caribbean is a challenging Real-Time Tactics stealth game set in the intriguing realm of pirates. Take command over a motley crew of sea rogues and beat the British Royal Navy to the Caribbean’s most valuable treasure.

name: Shop-Like - The Rogue-Like Item Shop Experience
short_description: An Item-Shop Game meets the concept of roguelikes! Endless Replayability and countless options to victory are awaiting you in Shop-Like! Shop-Like is all about running a business in order to pay your debts, so you will not land in the brutal hands of debt slavery.

name: 不和我推谈恋爱就会死？！
short_description: 不和我推恋爱就会死？！

name: Monsters 'til Midnight
short_description: Use steampunk weaponry to vanquish the legions of evil and survive until the clock strikes midnight! In this fast-paced horde survival game, each powerful upgrade can help turn the tide. Go it alone, or join another player in your pursuit to outlast the inevitable march of time itself!

name: Rerun
short_description: Rerun is a mini turn-based tactics roguelike where you're lost in an ever-changing, branching dungeon, which is also your skill tree. Harness your questionable abilities and curious upgrades in order to keep your adventurers alive and escape the dungeon!

name: Vampire: The Masquerade – Swansong
short_description: Play as 3 vampires, wield their powers wisely, and strike the right balance between your human and animal side in a heart-pounding story in which your choices will decide the fate of Boston.

name: Grotesque Realm
short_description: Looking at the terrified expressions of your teammates, what the hell is chasing us again? Watch the trailer to find out.

name: Beautiful Summer
short_description: Beautiful Summer is a 2D adventure game in which you need to win the hearts of girls.

name: Chris - The Element Runner
short_description: In Chris - The Element Runner, race through an endless 2D stage filled with elemental particles as you dodge stones, flames, water, and air. Simple graphics and gameplay make it easy to pick up and play for quick sessions. Test your skills and see how far you can survive in this thrilling adventure.

name: Morrok
short_description: In this point & cklick adventure join young detective Rudolf Pasaret to solve the greatest mystery of the 19th century. Guide the detective along the brink of insanity through a world created by an evil madman as you unravel a mystery of black magic and false accusations to discover the truth.

name: Three of Us 我们仨
short_description: In the mysterious jungle, there are many secrets hidden... It seems that the monsters are whispering... But the brave three warriors will definitely guard this forest! Now, towards that forest, let's go, BATTLE! Any monster will eventually be brought to justice!

name: Big Byz Wars
short_description: Big Byz Wars is a sci-fi 2.5D side-scroller set in a mysterious future where flying cities provide refuge.As a mercenary, defend the largest flying city, Byzantium, facing fierce enemies.With cool graphics & immersive gameplay.The game takes you on an action-packed journey through a dangerous world.

name: 希望之光1：灵菌涅槃
short_description: Light of Hope 1: Fungi Spirulina is a strategy wargame. Players will meet various partners with distinctive abilities to build the strongest adventurer team! Carefully designed maps, tactically changing enemies and complex and unpredictable terrain make every battle full of games

name: Spiral Up
short_description: An extremely challenging 2D Platformer made by a bunch of Jump King lovers: breach the sky, or torture yourself, with spring and gravity. Can also be played with your friends, either for a race or for co-op.

name: Farting Simulator
short_description: Get ready for a gut-busting good time with Farting Simulator! You experience the joy of controlling an uncontrollable bodily function in a meme-filled and comedic open-world sandbox environment. Farting Simulator is a hilarious and entertaining adventure that's sure to leave you FARTING out loud.

name: The Tartarus Key
short_description: There’s no way out for Alex Young who wakes up to find herself locked in a strange mansion filled with puzzles, traps, and cameras following her every move. Whether she and her companions live or die, and find the truth behind their abduction, is up to you in this first-person mystery thriller.

name: Heaven Island - VR MMO
short_description: More a Journey in your Inner Self than a game, 'Heaven Island' is an experience in which you'll explore wonderful places. The inspiration for the environments comes from the Renzo Piano designs and from the book 'Origins of Architectural Pleasure' in which the welfare is of primary importance.

name: Mortal Fighter
short_description: Mortal Fighter: Choose from 15 unique fighters, battle in 2 dynamic environments, and engage in 15 gripping encounters in Story Mode. Test your skills in Player vs. Player, Local Co-op, or Online Multiplayer. Train in Training Mode and unleash your inner warrior in this intense fighting game.

name: Myriads: Renaissance
short_description: Myriads: Renaissance is a turn-based strategy game with city-building and 4X mechanics. Set in a fantasy world made up of thousands of floating islands, you must grow your capital and expand your kingdom. Resist waves of powerful corsairs and construct defence towers to survive their incursions.

name: Save The World
short_description: In a world plagued by conflict, greed, and division, hope arrives from beyond the stars. The aliens have come to Earth, and they're listening to everything you say and make it a reality. What will you do with all this sudden power? Will you be able to save the world?

name: Pogoman
short_description: Challenge yourself with demanding jumps across all levels, unlock every gadget, and be particularly careful not to break anything in your surroundings.

name: Urban Flow
short_description: Control the city's streets and keep the cars moving in perfect harmony in Urban Flow. Navigate complex intersections and avoid accidents as you progress through increasingly challenging levels. Play with up to four players in local co-op mode for added fun with family and friends.

name: Haunted Hotel: Personal Nightmare
short_description: After 20 years, you receive a letter about your missing mom and sister. Answers are waiting at the Freedom Hotel, but nothing there is quite as it seems. Can you overcome your deepest fears and save your family in time?

name: Etrian Odyssey III HD
short_description: Set sail to an undersea labyrinth in search of the Deep City of Armoroad! Lead a party of adventurers to explore the vast dungeon in search of untold technology, treasure, and lost secrets.

name: Nextbots In The Backrooms
short_description: They only look ridiculous at first glance, but they're not! Run. Don't stop, don't try to hide, just run!

name: Woodle Tree 2: Worlds
short_description: Woodle Tree 2: Worlds is an open world platformer/adventure videogame. This time the forces of evil are taking over the Wood Lands with a black substance that is absorbing energy and life from the living creatures! Will you be able to take over this enormous new evil force?

name: Woodle Tree Adventures
short_description: Woodle Tree Adventures is an old school platform game with a catchy and unique art style! Explore a total of 6 worlds and save the lands with the magical water drops you'll find through your journey, bringing back peace and balance and finally becoming the new hero!

name: Red Moon: Survival
short_description: The world is thrown into chaos when the moon suddenly turns red, causing its residents to turn into zombies.

name: Kvark
short_description: Kvark is an FPS game set in a fictional version of the 80s Czech Republic. The player finds themselves in an underground facility that is falling apart as they travel through it. They will have to navigate through dark tunnels and will encounter many obstacles and enemies that will test their skills

name: Return
short_description: Return to your home planet after 200 years of space travel in this atmospheric, art-driven adventure. Shoot, slash, and roll your way through dangerous enemies and ancient bosses, purchase items and unlock powerful weapons, and explore your unfamiliar home for parts to repair your ship.

name: Battle Talent
short_description: Battle Talent is a challenging physics-based roguelite sword-fighting game. Tired of fighting boring enemies? Battle Talent has created for you a mega seamless procedural dungeon with over 80 enemy variants, 100 weapons, 60 perks, and multiple landscapes that change each time.

name: Friends vs Friends
short_description: A frantic, online PvP shooter that combines combat and deck building. Choose a character, customize your card-based loadout, and get ready for the fights of your life!

name: ArchiHexago
short_description: ArchiHexago is a casual puzzle game which takes inspiration from match-3 genre and takes it one step further. Each tile type has unique pattern which you need to match in order to gain points. And each level has different tile sets and obstacles to give you a variety of challenges.

name: Blooby Block
short_description: Help Block rescue his friends from the terrible bluebies. This cube pushing puzle Game is an evolution of the clasic sokoban/box pushing type games in a multilevel 3D. Enemies, spells and traps add another level of complexity. The difficulty grows fast, and the puzles become unforgiving very soon.

name: DREAMLINED
short_description: DREAMLINED is a physics-based automation/destruction game about building machines and crushing dreams.

name: Astride
short_description: Explore Astride, a horse game set in a Scandinavian-inspired environment. Care for and train horses, reveal mysteries, and more!

name: DEFENDUN
short_description: It is a real-time power defense merge game. Players can combine warriors, archers, and wizards to create a strong hero to fend off attacks from demons.

name: Aenas-猫与海：序章(Aenas-Cat and The Sea-Prologue)
short_description: Follow a little cat lady to travel in a black and white style fantasy world, eliminate enemies, and learn about this world.

name: Class of '09: The Re-Up
short_description: The REJECTION SIM returns! Explore a slice of chaotic life in late 2000's American high school as you assume the role of Nicole once again. A 100% fully voiced VN presenting as the most culturally accurate period piece in the history of gaming.

name: Fallen Kingdom
short_description: You have received a mission from your king. Will you complete this task? Or will you decide your own path?

name: Shards of Nogard
short_description: Shards of Nogard is a powerful, evocative fantasy adventure game that will surprise you with fastpaced combat, mind-boggling puzzles, beautiful hand-crafted environments and an immersive story about the eternal battle set in the medieval fantasy world.

name: Myth
short_description: Myth is a puzzle horror multiplayer game that guarantees an intense and headache-inducing experience with friends. Why the headache, you ask? Well, let's just say the puzzles are so mind-bendingly hard, they should come with a complimentary bottle of aspirin!

name: Tutenstone
short_description: In Tutenstone, you play as an adventurer who has discovered an ancient pyramid filled with valuable treasures. However, many treasures are hidden behind stone blocks that need to be destroyed.

name: Magic Paper
short_description: Magic Paper is a hack and slash roguelike game in which you can build your own set of magics to use.

name: Candle Knight
short_description: Never let your light go out. Wield a powerful flame, overcome menacing creatures and explore the shadows of a ruined castle in this compelling 2.5D action adventure platformer which features a unique dynamic difficulty system.

name: Liminal Space
short_description: Welcome to Liminal Space. We have been expecting you. Choose your map and try to escape. It's up to you if you want monsters chasing you or if you want a peaceful experience with no threats. With an unsettling soundtrack and fun graphic options, you'll have a good time for a cheap price.

name: Decarnation
short_description: Decarnation is a story rich adventure horror game. Solve cryptic puzzles, fight disturbing enemies, explore a phantasmagorical world of dreams and nightmares, and face the most terrifying monsters from the darkest parts of your soul.

name: Survival & Horror: Hangman's Rope
short_description: Are you ready to uncover the secret of the cursed town? Immerse yourself in the ambiance of the Wild West and its mysterious events, and discover the truth about what lurks on the grim streets of this town.

name: Glass Masquerade 3: Honeylines
short_description: Get ready for the Glass Masquerade sequel! With brand new textured glass pieces, immerse yourself in the beautiful world of painted glass art. Assemble jigsaw puzzles inspired by different cultures and themes with new play modes and various fragments cuts.

name: Cell Machine Indev
short_description: Get ready for the ultimate 2D sandbox puzzle game experience with Cell Machine: Indev!

name: Rebirth evolution
short_description: 2D pixel style simulation business strategy game Build and operate your own survivor base, recruit and cultivate various professional combatants. Clear zombie strongholds, reduce regional infections, survive in the apocalypse, and establish your own power.

name: Homebody
short_description: Homebody is a survival horror puzzle game about a group of friends haunted by memories of the past and hunted by a relentless killer. Move on or die trying.

name: IVAN POE
short_description: Ivan Poe is a third person find-your-way puzzle adventure following this cuboid character as they keep truckin' on through the Cosmic Soup.

name: 绛河之上 Under Supernova
short_description: An instant strategy science fiction simulation survival sandbox game. Players can control individuals, teams, and manage multiple bases. Players can farm, build, excavate, fight, produce, graze, explore, trade, record and pass on knowledge, and can also fly a spaceship to explore the starry sky.

name: Dragon's Hoard
short_description: 'Grow Big or Go Home!' Hunt down dangerous enemies and hoard loot to help your pet dragon grow. Once fully matured, take to the skies and ride your dragon to guide it back home! Go solo or join others in this Online Multiplayer Action-Adventure game.

name: No More Rainbows
short_description: YOU ARE THE BEAST! Rampage through colorful worlds to reclaim your desecrated Underworld from parasitic beings of joy. Use intuitive locomotion mechanics to run, jump, claw, and climb using only your hands in an adventure that will remind you of your favorite platformers.

name: You'll stay here forever
short_description: Proxima Centauri b was discovered on August 24, 2016. The rovers sent to the planet are not responding. It turned out that the planet's atmosphere does not allow radio signals to pass through. You have been sent to the planet's surface to find them.

name: Tears Fall Low
short_description: Unravel the mystery of a fallen tear on its journey back to the surface!

name: Pile Up!
short_description: 'Pile Up!' is a strategic building game which you need to build houses, fulfill your people’s requests and manage your risky buildings in different ways on a small land. But don’t let your guard down in this chill environment, we only get you relaxed so you destroy everything you did.

name: Concentrating
short_description: By playing this game, you can quickly clear your mind and be focused. Choose difficulty that suits you, and play for about 1-2 minutes, you would be quickly prepared for study and work.

name: Press Axe
short_description: It's a game to find the legendary duck using a double-edged axe.

name: Woodle Tree 2: Deluxe+
short_description: A new edition of Woodle Tree 2 is here, with many enhancements! Will you be able to save Mother Nature in this vast open-world Adventure? This time a devastating menace is taking over the Wood Lands with a black substance that is absorbing life and energy from all living creatures!

name: Poly Bridge 3
short_description: The best just got better! Rediscover your engineering creativity in this genre-defining bridge engineering and puzzle solving masterpiece.

name: B..:EvaSive
short_description: Welcome to a world of dangerous rectangles where quick reflexes and maneuvering will help you keep breathing... Well, for at least a few more seconds! Two buttons. Life or death. How long can you survive? Okay, so you died. Try Again. Die. One more time. Die. Just one more. Die. One more!

name: クラブ・スーサイド
short_description: 私は、自殺を考えている。クラブ・スーサイドへようこそ。自殺を考える少年達に寄り添う、奇妙な一週間。命を思考するノベルアドベンチャー。

name: Tower Defense 2D
short_description: This is a tower defense game.

name: Nacht-sama is quitting being the demon king!
short_description: Demon King Nacht's castle has been attacked! In order to find out who was behind the attack, Nacht used her ability to go back in time. After one investigation, Nahat found that things were not simple. She decided to slowly start building her prestige...

name: Rise of Jericho
short_description: Lead hunter-gatherers and give rise to human civilization in Jericho, the oldest city in the world. Gather resources, craft tools and build structures to protect villagers and make your city thrive.

name: MotoGP™23
short_description: Open the throttle, pass your opponents and cross the finish line: live the dream of being the next champion with the new MotoGP™23, more amazing and challenging than ever!

name: The Summoning
short_description: The Summoning is a fantasy role-playing adventure, set inside a huge labyrinth with 40 different levels and hordes of monsters. Use steel, magic and wit to fight, cast and puzzle your way through the evil that lies within. Struggle to survive and grow strong enough to fight and defeat Shadow Weaver.

name: Cat Souls
short_description: Will your 7 lives be enough? Use your lives and souls wisely to finish the levels and save your friend! Ruby and her friend went on an adventure and successfully found the mythical Hourglass of time! Sadly the end of that adventure is the beginning of a new one.

name: Tamagoneko
short_description: Get off the tree and face the world full of saws, pits and spikes in this hardcore 2D platformer about the nimble white Cat. Make your way through wild plains, thorny deserts and crystal caverns on a challenging yet exciting journey to rescue the lost kitten eggs!

name: Slayer
short_description: Step into the unforgiving world of Slayer. Fight your chances with or without friends in a chaotic attempt for survival. Discover new ways to better your odds against new foes, and uncover the truth behind this anarchy. Do you accept the challenge? How long will you survive...

name: CODA
short_description: ///CODA is a short narrative exploration game with four diverse chapters that each tell unique stories connected by a surreal museum. Take a peak through the looking glass and wander...

name: Burning Branch
short_description: Blaze a trail through a gauntlet of unique and varied bosses, in this rogue-like boss rush about smoldering want.

name: Tokyo Pinball
short_description: A game designed to introduce the fun of pinball. Whether you have never played pinball before or not, I hope you will enjoy playing it!

name: Zombie Soup
short_description: Zombie Soup is a top-down shooter combined with hack and slash action that follows Ricky, a backpacker who is thrown into an unexpected adventure in an unfamiliar town as he shoots and dodges his way through hordes of bizarre creatures and challenging bosses to save a kidnapped girl!

name: Covenant: Project Zero
short_description: Covenant: Project Zero is a space opera set in a universe where interstellar corporations and big money interests run everything. Embark on an action-packed adventure as Captain John Covenant, accompanied by a band of rag-tag misfits, to confront the dark evil lurking in the universe.

name: 怪才俱乐部2-The Immortal Beloved2
short_description: You were a miss in the manor, but an accident completely disrupted the trajectory of your life... When the whole world is falling, where do you go in the face of the terrible truth and the unknown future?

name: Frogsong
short_description: A heartfelt adventure in a fantasy world of frogs! Talk to weird and wonderful characters, fight vicious bugs, and explore a vibrant world in this charming action RPG.

name: SHIMAZU
short_description: SHIMAZU is a side-scrolling action/dark art style game. Take on the role of a samurai named Shimazu, who's son is kidnapped and his wife is killed by an evil demon called Takeda with help from another demon called Fudo.

name: Sáivu
short_description: Sáivu: Spill basert på samisk kultur. Utforsk 8 årstider med unike utfordringer. Vinn gaver til offersteinen. Hjelpespill: Joikememory, eventyr, overnaturlige. Bygg lavvo, joik dyr, lag medisin, bekjemp overnaturlige, jakt, fang rein, lag duodji, fisk på isen. Avslutningsspørsmål om læring.

name: Lita's Dream
short_description: Popular high school girl Lita finds herself trapped in a strange dreamlike world. She needs to escape from a dangerous, eerie castle with the help of her mysterious ally, Ian.

name: Mask of the Rose
short_description: A marvellous romance with a hint of murder. Lose your heart to a stolen city in this game of amorous intrigue! Seek love, for yourself or your friends. Help a murdered man find justice. And watch out for the bats.

name: Dark Rift
short_description: According to Legend, When this Universe Was Created, A Master Key was Forged to Lock Away All Ancient Secrets and Infinite Powers The Cosmos Had to Offer.

name: Labyrinth of Axarith
short_description: Players make adventurers and challenge numerous labyrinths, and mix good old 3D exploration dungeons, real-time battles, and card-like choices in this RPG.

name: Super Archer
short_description: This is a challenging casual tower defense game.

name: Death Rabbit Arena
short_description: Death Rabbit Arena is a realistic first person and third person shooter that takes place in real world locations. Play with friends online or offline against the computer or by yourself and explore big open world maps.

name: FlippedDream
short_description: Changing the direction of global gravity, finding the exit in a number of 3D-platformer mazes.

name: Blightlands Blacksmith
short_description: Blightlands Blacksmith is a medieval fantasy blacksmithing simulator with exploration and combat elements. Mine, smelt, forge, assemble, grind, and rune-craft weapons to supply a legion cohort, and defend yourself as you delve into the mine for new materials. The cohort's success depends on you.

name: Loop8: Summer of Gods
short_description: Your choices shape the world in this coming-of-age RPG. As a new arrival in a 1980s rural Japanese town with a mysterious ability to loop time, your every decision and relationship will affect the outcome of battles against the invading Kegai.

name: Thunderday
short_description: Thunderday is a twin stick shooter where you play as one of several heroes fighting through multiple worlds to find the one responsible for destroying their home.

name: Vegan Rebellion
short_description: Fight to survive from horde of hunters. Choose from a variety of guns and upgrades to create an ultimate killing machine!

name: Repella Fella
short_description: Repella Fella is an interactive, point and click, choose your own adventure. This cinematic tale is set in a post-apocalyptic, futuristic Australia. Alternate between 3 intertwining stories. Replay the game multiple times to attempt different solutions and achieve every possible ending.

name: Zortch
short_description: Meet Zortch Maxinum: short order cook, amateur engineer and professional slacker; Bored and tired of her day job she decides to go on a holiday but alas she picks a cheap option: turns out it's a scheme by aliens who capture humans to eat their brains! also this game is a sci-fi horror comedy fps

name: Quadrium 2
short_description: Quadrium is back with a new and exciting mash-up of marble popper and match-3 challenge! Discover new bonuses and antibonuses and develop new strategies. Use mines to clear the field with explosive chain reactions and encounter fun boss battles that pit you against exciting challengers.

name: YGGDRASILL
short_description: 'YGGDRASILL' is a click idle game, you can plant the seed of the last world tree entrusted to you by the goddess, and synthesize stars to save the decayed world.

name: Pro Cycling Manager 2023
short_description: Manage a team of professional cyclists: control the budget, recruit young talent, train riders and devise race strategies. Jostle for position to reach the top of the world rankings!

name: Brain Show
short_description: Compete with your friends in brand new quiz game. Take part in crazy TV Show. Dynamite explosions, sobbing mates, ruined friendships! Sounds like fun? It will be – with Brain Show!

name: Battle Grid
short_description: Face relentless alien hordes, collect their resources and assemble an unstoppable squadron of mechs! In this Action Roguelite, discover game-breaking synergies, mix and match weapons and units, unlock upgrades, harvest and conquer alien planets.

name: 富甲天下2
short_description: 經典三國大富翁遊戲，老玩家回味紀念版。單挑！野戰！攻城！劉備、曹操、孫權，誰能一統天下？城池經營新增「建物」設計，如「市集」可提高稅金收入、「護城河」可以增加城池的防禦力、「糧倉」可加快人口成長、「練兵場」可訓練士兵，「兵營」可進行徵兵，「書院」可增加駐城武將的智力。

name: Thrusta X
short_description: Thrusta X is a 2D retro-style shoot'em-up where the goal is to convey an experience rather than acquiring a high score or the best upgrades. Story, puzzle, and battle elements are combined into one flowing adventure. Every level throws something new at the player.

name: Bleak Sword DX
short_description: Discover and destroy increasingly horrifying creatures across an oppressive lofi world, wielding fierce weaponry and powerful magic in this pocket-sized action adventure.

name: Chasing rabbits in snow
short_description: Aliens will release rabbits with plague in the North Pole in order to conquer the earth. As the guardian of the North Pole, you need to catch the rabbits in the shortest time to protect the North Pole.

name: Secrets of the Witch House
short_description: Secrets of the Witch House is a challenging, procedurally generated, permadeath, action roguelike. Encounter fierce monsters, dark secrets, devastating weapons and pachinko as you wage war against an ancient evil.

name: Hotel Manibella
short_description: Get ready for the ultimate horror puzzle game! Check into Hotel Manibella for a spine-chilling experience. With a unique art style and secret storyline, journey through the floors of a haunted hotel, with each level becoming scarier and more intense.

name: Barkelona
short_description: Learning Spanish is Ruff!

name: Super Monkie Bounce Fatal
short_description: Reject Humanity, Return to Monke ! In Super Monkie Bounce Fatal, you goal is to make your car reach the end of the track to snatch the win. The catch ? You're not actually driving the car !

name: Amnesia: The Bunker
short_description: Amnesia: The Bunker is a first-person horror game set in a WW1 bunker. A relentless, AI-driven monster stalks you. Survival depends on finding tools, crafting items, and keeping the lights on.

name: A Whisper in the Twilight: Chapter One
short_description: An ancient moon shrouded in mystery. Alien enigmas. An adventure beyond the Earth.

name: Destruct Blocks
short_description: Destruct Blocks is an addictive isometric puzzle game that combines strategic thinking, block destruction, and color matching challenges. Navigate a shape composed of colored blocks through intricate levels, strategically demolishing target blocks while avoiding others.

name: The doll
short_description: Lucy bought an exquisite large doll at a low price. While she combs its hair and chats with it, Little does she know that her nightmare is about to begin...

name: Metania
short_description: Metania is an Indie Psyhological Horror game uses Physics to pass obstacles Interaction with lights Objects doors furniture etc.

name: Greyhill Incident
short_description: This story-driven Survival-Horror game is about a classic Alien-Invasion which takes place during the early 90s. As Ryan Baker, equipped with a baseball bat and a few bullets in his revolver, the story takes you across the atmospheric neighborhood of Greyhill which is invaded by UFOs & Grey Aliens.

name: Zodiark Reform: Bandage Rewind
short_description: The mysterious planet observer, Lance, arrives on this planet to investigate something, and Bandagemon, as a companion on the journey. 《Bandage Rewind》 is a 2D platform puzzle game where you need to rely on your observation skills and intuition to solve various puzzles .

name: Viking Heroes 4
short_description: Join the Viking heroes in a race against time to save the world from eternal darkness. As the sun and moon falter and Fenrir threatens to consume them, the Vikings must travel across realms to forge a magical chain that can capture him.

name: Carnival in the hut
short_description: There are ingredients on the level that you have to drag into the pot. Drag into the pot: eggs, oil, water in a bucket, flour in a bag, and dough (on water). (The name of the items is shown in the lower left corner.)

name: Tour de France 2023
short_description: Ride shoulder to shoulder with the best cyclists and show your panache to triumph on the Champs-Elysées in the official video game of the Tour de France 2023! Compete in mountain or flat stages and experience all the action of the Grande Boucle.

name: Reincarnated in a stone in a different world, I want to protect the girl, so I will be strong
short_description: The main character wakes up one day in another world, reincarnated as a stone. There, he meets a magician named Anna, the Queen of Femt Kingdom. He then joins her on her quest...

name: Chest
short_description: The story of 《Chest 》 is about Capulet, who has forgotten how to undo the spell after having transformed into a Chest for a time until found by Zong. Having turned back human with Zong's help, Capulet then decided to go on the quest to help those who have also turned into chests.

name: Riders Republic
short_description: Jump into a massive multiplayer playground! Bike, ski, snowboard, or wingsuit across an open world sports paradise.

name: Late Night Drive
short_description: Explore various maps with your friends or play solo and relax. Whether you prefer a relaxing drive or a fast-paced, action-packed race, the choice is yours. Get ready to unforgettable journey through the city streets under the moonlit sky!

name: Harmony: The Fall of Reverie
short_description: The fate of humanity is at stake. Use your gift of clairvoyance to see into the future and stop an apocalypse that threatens the balance between your world and the deities'.

name: Battle For Cosmos
short_description: Battle For Cosmos is a fast-paced, action-packed RTS set in space. With a focus on the battle it is perfect for those who want a thrilling and engaging strategy game without the unnecessary filler. Take control of your empire, build your defenses, and conquer the cosmos!

name: System of Souls
short_description: SoS is a puzzle and first-person platform game, where you play as L-064N, who wakes up in The ION laboratory, place where you will have to go through different logical trials created by the artificial intelligence of the place, in order to recover memories and understand this enigmatic world.

name: HANA : Hide and seek
short_description: A cute RPG Maker horror game

name: Nocturnal
short_description: After years of traveling, Ardeshir finds his native island covered in a mysterious fog. Carve your way with fire and steel to find out what happened to your people in this action-platformer game. You’re the only one who can discover the secrets that lie beyond the Mist.

name: Jumbo Airport Story
short_description: Just imagine: your own world-famous airport! A game with sky-high levels of fun!

name: Star General
short_description: Star General is light-years ahead of its proud ancestors from the award-winning 5-star strategy series. It proposes a two-level combat system that accommodates space combat and surface combat. Resource management - conquer enemy planets and develop them for your needs.

name: Pressure Washer
short_description: A VR cleaning simulation game. Unleash your imagination and stress with your power pressure washer gun. Just Aim it and blast all the dirt and mud away from the surface. Dive into different areas and objects to clean for. Just sit back and relax, all it brings to you is happiness and joyful.

name: Lavrynthos
short_description: Lavrynthos is an independently created VR short, a funny and philosophic story that places you at the heart of the labyrinth of Crete to tell you the story of the unlikely relationship between the Minotaur and his next meal: a girl named Cora.

name: Survivors Will
short_description: This is a casual Roguelike game that allows characters to become stronger and stronger through repeated choices, breaking free from the heavy siege of monsters!

name: Espresso Tycoon
short_description: Espresso Tycoon - a coffee shop simulator. Create your brand, decorate the coffee shop, manage your employees, and take care of your customers. Use the 3D coffee editor to create coffee recipes, order supplies, and collect rating points. Build the whole coffee business and complete all the missions!

name: Beyond The Evil
short_description: Beyond the Evil is an psychological horror game that places the player to a hard experience to find who created one supposed plague that might doom the world.

name: Lonely Path
short_description: Lonely Path is a relaxing puzzle game where you move and stacks tiles to create paths through 5 nature themed, hand-drawn regions! Try your hand at 100 different levels or make your own and share them with the community!

name: Square Inertia
short_description: Try to set the fastest times possible in Square Inertia: a fast-paced, momentum-based precision platformer. Race against the clock to improve your own personal best times and beat the author times set for each level.

name: Gravity VR
short_description: Gravity VR is a unique short interactive experience in a surreal world with no ground beneath your feet, where everything is forever falling. You'll meet two old brothers living a surprisingly ordinary life... But nothing lasts forever.

name: Magic and Machines
short_description: A retro fantasy RPG with turn-based battles, puzzles, and six unique characters. It's perfect for players who grew up with turn-based RPGs and are looking for a new adventure, and also accessible for new players as it doesn’t take itself too seriously.

name: R.O.O.T.
short_description: This story is about a corporation named RavenTech, set in the near future. R.O.O.T.

name: Dark Legions
short_description: SUBTLE STRATEGY. RUTHLESS ACTION! That’s classic DARK LEGIONS from SSI. You get all the maneuvering, trickery and deception of the best strategy games.

name: Undead Citadel
short_description: Exclusive for VR, UNDEAD CITADEL immerses you into an adventure encountering hundreds of Undead in breathtaking combats crammed with numerous foes. Slash, stab, crush, shoot or dismember with your own hands, as you find the way into the depths of the cursed citadel.

name: BossHunter VR
short_description: BossHunter VR is the first version of the game where players will have to fight many interesting opponents, use multiple weapons, and a unique mechanic of its kind where the player directly commands a weapon to execute something with the help of speech. The hunt is on!

name: F1® 23
short_description: Be the last to brake in EA SPORTS™ F1® 23, the official video game of the 2023 FIA Formula One World Championship™. A new chapter in the thrilling 'Braking Point' story mode delivers high-speed drama and heated rivalries.

name: Astra And The New Constellation
short_description: Travel the galaxy as Astra, a starlet on a mission, in this retro-inspired Pico-8 platformer!

name: Guardians of Holme
short_description: Guardians of Holme is a tower defense game with deckbuilding and roguelite elements. Players must use the terrain to their advantage and formulate defensive tactics by strategically placing powerful traps to repel endless waves of enemies.

name: Kingdom of Wreck Business
short_description: The depths of the Atlantic hide more than 12,000 sunken ships out of which at least half haven’t been located yet. As a depth explorer you will earn money from extracting valuable cargo from wrecks, grow your company, buy exploration vessels and real estate.

name: NextNight
short_description: This is a third person tower defense game where you need to use the space wisely to place defenses to kill zombies at night.

name: Hoppy Hop
short_description: Join Hoppy in this classic action platformer as you collect candies, dodge enemies and jump. After all, you are a rabbit!

name: Pandamander's Projector Platformer
short_description: Bring your digital characters to life in the real world! Use any projector to make unique characters, create custom levels, and transform any space into a thrilling gaming experience. Immerse yourself and redefine holidays with this game that pushes boundaries of gaming!

name: Math & Topology
short_description: A puzzle that challenges both the topological and mathematical skills of the player. Draw lines, use operator tiles to produce new numbers, and complete levels with square- and hexagon-shaped tiles!

name: Bus Simulator 23
short_description: Drive your daily bus route and reconnect with an old friend

name: [Chilla's Art] Night Security | 夜間警備
short_description: Night Security | 夜間警備 is a Japanese psychological horror game about night security.

name: bugTDX
short_description: Buy, sell, and merge towers in this tower defense roguelike inspired by Bloons TD6 and Super Auto Pets. With 40+ towers and 15 enemy types, this chill tower defense game provides hours of fun replayability!

name: We are Eva
short_description: Play the game in multiple dimensions at the same time, traveling through them at will in this unique 2D platformer that defies boundaries! I'm Eva, by the way, and I promise we'll have fun! Or maybe not... Maybe we'll both suffer horribly... How should I know? I'm just a video game character...

name: Space Reign
short_description: An indie space-sim and strategy game featuring ship and fleet combat mixed with management of a private space corporation. Claim sectors for your faction and raise its influence in the near-future, where resource exploiting corporations are in a state of constant conflict over territory control.

name: It's Only Money
short_description: The mayor of Rockhaven threw you down a hole into the Undercity. Why? Net worth too low. In this 1-4 player low-life simulation, emerge to the surface to steal from the rich, fight tycoons and reclaim the city block by block. Buy houses, businesses and whatever your materialistic heart desires!

name: Unibat
short_description: Real-time strategy Unibat is a game where you build your own kingdom and manage them, train knights and fight against enemy camps of orcs.

name: FOX ADVENTURE ~HOMEWARD JOURNEY~
short_description: A challenging 2D platform game.

name: Golf Club Architect
short_description: Build and manage your very own golf club from tee to green and everything in-between.

name: Something's Out There
short_description: Something's Out There is a micro-horror creature hunting game, featuring multiple unique creatures across multiple maps. Hunters work together using the tools provided at base or found around the map to track down, hunt, and ultimately kill the creature of which only stories claim exist.

name: Four Lights
short_description: Psychic urban fantasy Visual novel 'Four Lights'

name: Bounty: Drag Racing
short_description: Bounty: Drag Racing is the most complete online drag racing experience on the market. Race the fastest and most varied types of dragsters in the world. Customize and fine tune your cars to achieve maximum performance and hop online for the closest type of racing!

name: Combat Mission: Red Thunder
short_description: Combat Mission Red Thunder focuses on the hard fought Eastern Front battles of Bagration and Poland, from the swamps of Belarus to the gates of Warsaw during the summer of 1944.

name: 侠客春秋
