short_description: 正义不是这个江湖里唯一的选择。 面对绝世武学，是选择众叛亲离私吞功法，还是上交掌门蛰伏待发？ 身处险恶江湖，是胸怀正义弑魔证道，还是沦陷深渊为祸武林？ 更多门派、武学以及功能玩法，高自由度不做太多束缚。 历练、奇遇、双修、传承，从寂寂无名到一代盟主。 每过一代就会成为下一代的先祖，战斗时可以唤醒祖宗十八代加入战场。 解锁更多羁绊，获得先祖传承，与道侣子嗣一同并肩作战！

name: Venture's Gauntlet VR
short_description: Venture's Gauntlet VR is a thrilling, immersive adventure game set in breathtaking landscapes. Test your stamina, accuracy, wit and reflexes as you navigate treacherous terrain, solve puzzles, and navigate obstacles. So get ready to embark on the adventure of a lifetime!

name: Majoneko
short_description: A hard puzzle platformer of predicting trajectories and climbimg a giant castle!

name: Druidwalker
short_description: You are a druid preparing the forest for winter. Traverse the paths at your own pace, meet the animals, enjoy the music, all wrapped in a peaceful roguelike experience.

name: Doomer
short_description: Try on the role of a Russian Doomer, who lives in a typical post-Soviet building. Your pointless life filled with routine and addictions. Can you cope with it?

name: Story Of Infinity: Xia
short_description: 'Story Of Infinity: Xia' is A martial arts style Roguelike adventure A·RPG standalone game. The background of the story is set for the martial arts, the internal force martial repair system was born soon. Allow you to explore the uplifting changes in the world of Reiki in a pleasant blow.

name: Deducto 2
short_description: A fun sus-like game where you backstab your co-workers and get mad at your co-workers for backstabbing you. (up to 10 players)

name: TV Head: Eight Pages
short_description: You find yourself all alone in the middle of a dark forest. You have no weapons and no place to wait for help. The dim flashlight that lights the way is your only friend. Your goal is to explore the location to find eight pages and leave this frightening place.

name: SS.Archives
short_description: This is a text adventure game with elements of horror, suspense, and puzzle-solving. Players take on the role of a detective, encountering various mysterious cases. These cases may be bizarre, eerie, or seemingly calm on the surface, but with turbulent undercurrents beneath.

name: Sounds of Nature
short_description: Sounds of Nature. It is supposed to take you to your favorite place that will relax you and recharge your batteries. You have 20 different scenes at your disposal. There is no interaction or rush in this game. Enjoy very realistic graphics created on Unreal Engine 5.

name: White Blade
short_description: Strategic turn-based combat, utilizing various complementary skills to deal with enemy attack patterns.

name: Night Terrors
short_description: Experience a chilling adventure unlike any other! Join Kenny on a journey to conquer his night terrors and discover the ultimate solution. Kenny's parents, desperate for a remedy, have sought the help of a renowned doctor who offers an experimental drug to banish these haunting nightmares for good.

name: The Hermit Chronicles
short_description: The Hermit Chronicles is a 1st-person survival horror game set in a deep forest. Assuming the role of a hermit, you will have to get food, scout your neighborhood, and search for resources to make gear. But after the sun goes down, you'll have to survive for real...

name: Gate of Souls
short_description: I got a job as a night guard. They promise to pay a lot, but for my own safety I have to follow strange rules. As you progress, you'll have to find keys and open locked rooms. A first-person game with elements of horror. Explore the hospital and its rooms, collect batteries for your flashlight.

name: Marabundle
short_description: Play a series of small games of multiple genres, each with a unique playstyle and visuals! Defeat skeletons, play cards, ride a train or fight aerial combat in this collection of indie games.

name: Idle: Generators
short_description: An IDLE game for your fun and relaxation. Generators based gameplay and two prestige systems with various gameplay possibilities

name: VR Giants
short_description: VR Giants is a local coop VR game in which one VR player and one gamepad player work together. The VR player controls a giant and must protect and support the tiny player who is controlled by the screen player. The tiny player can use the body of the giant as an extension of the level.

name: Plushie Bomber
short_description: Blow your enemies up with their own bombs in this explosive 2D action platformer! Catch the deadly plushies' bombs in time to throw them right back to the sender! Will you uncover the cute fluffy toys' origins?

name: BattleBit Remastered
short_description: BattleBit Remastered is a low-poly, massive multiplayer FPS, supporting 254 players per server. Battle on a near-fully destructible map with various vehicles!

name: Jorel’s Brother and The Most Important Game of the Galaxy
short_description: “Jorel’s Brother and The Most Important Game of the Galaxy” is a point-and-click adventure about an eight-year-old boy who lives with his eccentric family in the shadow of Jorel, his handsome and popular brother. Based on the award-winning Brazilian animation “Jorel’s Brother”.

name: Oblivion Override
short_description: Embark on a raw, fast-paced odyssey in Oblivion Override. Master 25+ weapons, embody the killerbot, and conquer war-torn wastelands. Inspired by Castlevania and Roguelikes, this action-packed adventure will test your mobility to the limit. Evade, dash, and dance amid shifting dungeon walls.

name: Spider
short_description: Spider is a unique puzzle game that puts players in the role of a brave spider, exploring a variety of stunning environments and overcoming challenges. Players need to use the spider's special abilities and intelligence to solve puzzles and complete the objectives of each level.

name: Fall of Porcupine
short_description: Fall of Porcupine is a unique story adventure. The collision of work and daily life – an exciting reflection of an unhealthy healthcare-system. Experience the exciting story of Finley and his friends in a lovingly illustrated world and uncover the darkest secrets of Porcupine and its residents.

name: Quebec Mortis
short_description: Quebec Mortis is a retro-styled survival horror game. It has elements from the modern survival horror games but in a NES-era fashion. It is packed with puzzles, action and a creepy atmosphere. Complete it in one evening!

name: Lost In The Shadows
short_description: Become the hero who will be the first to defeat the toughest enemies of the dungeon. Develop your character to become indestructible. You can gain levels, distribute points and upgrade your abilities.

name: Crushing Depths
short_description: 'Crushing Depths' is a first-person horror game set deep down on the ocean floor, you will take control of an underwater drone tasked with locating points of interest using 3D spatial sound and once found scan them to build a story, but be on careful lookout for anything that may lurk down there!

name: Senpai Arena
short_description: Welcome to the arena! Create your character and go battle against zombies for a place of honor on the Steam leaderboard!

name: The Game of Annie 安妮的游戏
short_description: Hi,This is a third person action shooter game. Support for custom character size, support for costume change, use guns and bows for long-distance combat, can also use cold weapons for melee combat, with some training elements. Enemies include monsters and humans.

name: Park Beyond
short_description: Park Beyond is a theme park simulation game that gives you the freedom to create and manage the Parks of your Dreams! Whether you love to manage finances and visitor experience or just create fun and cosy parks, the game has something in store just for you!

name: Вий: Визуальная новелла
short_description: Визуальная новелла по мотивам мистической книги Н. Гоголя

name: OVERWHELMED
short_description: Enter the neon world of OVERWHELMED! Fight waves of enemies, using shooting and dashing skills to evade fire. Trigger your special 'Overheat' ability to defeat enemies more easily. Unlock characters, each with unique abilities and varied arsenal, to discover new gameplay styles.

name: Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six® Extraction
short_description: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six® Extraction is a tactical, co-op, PvE first-person shooter where you and your squad face an evolving alien threat. Teamwork, tactics, and flawless execution are key to your survival.

name: Voxel Miner: Dwellers of The Deep
short_description: Voxel Miner: Dwellers of the Deep, is a single player game where you mine resources to upgrade different skills, abilities, and fight the creatures you come across along the way! Strategize your upgrades, fight monsters, or just sit back and enjoy the satisfying mechanics. The choice is yours...

name: DUBIUM
short_description: DUBIUM is a survival deception game set in a near future sci-fi environment. Five Frontiers must work together to complete different missions to escape before it’s too late. But beware, one of the Frontiers is a Traitor whose goal is to escape and leave the others to fall into the abyss.

name: Ashen Arrows
short_description: Ashen Arrows is a Nordic mythology-themed VR archery game featuring roguelike gameplay, tower defense elements, and puzzles.

name: Brainroll
short_description: Embark on a mind-bending adventure as Brainroll! Solve challenging puzzles in this sokoban-style game by moving brain blocks while sliding on ice. Relax in Brainroll's world, where clever thinking is the key to success. Get ready to roll your way to victory in this puzzle-packed sliding experience!

name: Beetle Elf
short_description: Play as a cute mini elf, Start an adventure in a human city. Conduct a beetle battle with players. Each city can accommodate up to 4,000 players simultaneously.

name: The Zone: Stalker Stories
short_description: Tactical card battles and narrative RPG exploration in a world of monsters and anomalies. As one of the last remnants of humanity, trapped in the Zone, it's your turn to become a Stalker and walk where others fear to tread.

name: PsychWorld
short_description: Export a vast procedurally generated world where you never know what you'll see next. Explore and loot a variety of structures such as the catacombs. Slaughter enemies, grow your defenses, and escape the prison that is your mind. Just make sure you're not followed...

name: Rooms of Realities
short_description: Rooms of Realities is an anthology of virtual Escape Rooms that you can enjoy in co-op or solo mode. Discover the secret that connects all the rooms.

name: Stardust Defenders
short_description: Stardust Defenders is a tower defense, roguelike, bullet hell, where you will face hordes of enemy creatures with the power of forest spirits, leveling up and choosing upgrades that will allow you to survive.

name: Dordogne
short_description: Immerse yourself in a unique narrative experience and explore the thousand summer colors of Dordogne as you revisit your childhood to uncover lost family secrets in this touching formative journey.

name: Heavy Metal Titans
short_description: Heavy Metal Titans is a modern-retro Run n’ Gun Shoot ‘em up that takes players on a blood-soaked time traveling quest to defeat General Glen Planamento and retrieve the stolen time crystal, a powerful relic that can manipulate time and reality.

name: Dice World
short_description: Dice World is a turn-based roguelike game. Create your own party by combining skills with character. You need dice to use skills, but you also need strategic dice choices depending on the situation. Collect relics and enhance your skills to defeat your enemies!

name: Mixed Unit Tactics
short_description: Mixed Unit Tactics is a medieval turn based strategy where you control a growing army. Command your units well to take advantage of their unique strengths as you push through hostile forces to reclaim your home castle.

name: COLD DEPTH
short_description: COLD DEPTH is a first-person survival horror game set on the 'Oasis' underwater complex. Whether you survive or not depends on finding, recycling and 3D printing items and supplying energy to the right parts of the stations.

name: Reflector Rhythm Master
short_description: A hybrid of a block breaker and a music game. A strange and fun mechanic where all of the stages fit on one screen. And the antithesis of the easy-to-see music game.

name: Cricket Captain 2023
short_description: Create your own cricket management legacy with Cricket Captain 2023. A new adaptive aggression system, designed for the modern game, puts you in control. Enhanced statistics include historical international player rankings (including all-rounders), real-world form data, and wicket keeper statistics.

name: THE SEGMENT TWINS
short_description: The Twin Hunters fell into The Segment World... Combat various monsters and bosses, and complete their segmented journey! THE SEGMENT TWINS is a hack-and-slash game with simple controls and a unique character tag action feature.

name: Pixel Ripped 1978
short_description: The latest game in the Pixel Ripped series! Travel back to Pixel Ripped creator Bug's past at ATARI and team up with Dot on another adventure to defeat the evil Cyblin Lord.

name: PACK MY STUFF
short_description: Unleash the fun with PACK MY STUFF! Discover and pack objects into boxes in this exciting puzzle and hidden object game. As a mover in Neuberg, assist residents in packing their possessions. Enjoy the simplicity and thrill!

name: ProtoCorgi
short_description: Get ready to Bark’em Up! Play as Bullet, a C³ class (Cute Cybernetic Corgi) pup on his quest to save his owner, a brilliant scientist kidnapped by an alien race that wants to rule the galaxy. ProtoCorgi is a retro pixel art shoot’em up with a strong arcade feel!

name: Cube Airport - Puzzle
short_description: Cube Airport is a puzzle game where your objective is to construct a runway to enable the airplane to take off safely. To do this, you need to correctly fit the runway cubes into the indicated positions on the platform and proceed to the next level.

name: Layers of Fear
short_description: All stories must come to an end, even twisted and eerie ones. The canvas. The stage. The novel. This narrative-focused psychological horror experience is ready for its final brushstrokes, its curtain call, its final chapter. Are you ready to return and face your fears one last time?

name: Heist Kitty: Multiplayer Cat Simulator Game
short_description: If you’re a cat and you’re following the rules, you’re doing it wrong. Choose a cute kitty and create multiplayer mayhem in this open-world sandbox game where fun is always a whisker away.

name: 勾八麻将(J8 Mahjong)
short_description: Conquering Girls with Mahjong

name: Burger Cooking Simulator
short_description: Become the burger chef in the physical-based Burger Cooking Simulator. Skillfully use your hand to interact with ingredients and utensils to complete orders. Grill, fry, make burgers, watch your time, and keep your customers in a good mood.

name: Wizardry School: Escape Room
short_description: The School Headmaster needs your help to recover the Philosopher's Stone. In this escape room you will have to explore your wizardry school, solve puzzles, learn new spells and put your magical skills to the test. Will you save the school?

name: |][-@I7 in vitro #デッド・インヴィトロ
short_description: '|][-@I7 in vitro #Dead in vitro' is a vertical scrolling bullet hell shooter developed by Cupro Laboratory. Control 'Ferrum' a boy who was newly born as a zombie in a certain laboratory, and confront powerful enemies.

name: Creature Lab
short_description: Become a mad scientist! Conduct crazy experiments, mix mutagens, breed abominable creatures, and attach monstrous body parts to them. Manage your inventory, expand your lab, and make sure your hideout is safe. Send your creations into the city to obtain salvage and test subjects!

name: DownhillVR
short_description: DownhillVR is the ultimate virtual reality mountain biking video game that brings the thrill of extreme downhill racing right to your living room. Experience the rush of speeding down challenging tracks and catching air off jaw-dropping jumps, all while immersing yourself in stunning environments.

name: Daydream: Forgotten Sorrow
short_description: In this puzzle platformer, you will embark on a touching journey through the surreal world of a person's mind as a young Griffin and his faithful bear, Birly. Overcome challenges, avoid traps and defeat enemies to help the man find peace.

name: Call of Zombie
short_description: Call of Zombie is a survival shooting game set in the World War II era. As waves of zombies approach, your task is to protect the armory. By skillfully utilizing the remains of zombies, you can achieve unexpected effects and outcomes.

name: The Wonderful One: After School Hero
short_description: SUPER-DUPER-FUN SIDE-SCROLLING LASER SHOOTING ACTION!!! JOIN LUKA IN HIS JOURNEY TO BECOMING A FULL-FLEDGED HERO! Important note: A copy of The Wonderful 101: Remastered is not needed to enjoy this standalone version.

name: Kingsblood
short_description: Autochess meets a grimdark RPG! Assemble a powerful guild, lead them through treacherous missions and dungeons, and unlock their true potential with smart combat decisions.

name: TROUBLE JUICE
short_description: Trouble Juice is a Side Scrolling Shooter Roguelike set in a TV show tournament that is broadcasted across the universe. Use your character's special abilities, and unlock prizes in the Achievement Bingo. Become the ultimate champion and earn your place in the galaxy's hall of fame!

name: Bad Dream: Purgatory
short_description: Explore a hauntingly surreal landscape filled with unused characters from a cancelled project in Bad Dream: Purgatory. Will you give them purpose, or will they be doomed to suffer?

name: Danger Drop
short_description: Defy gravity, conquer challenges, and reach new heights in this thrilling platformer. Do you have what it takes? Can you overcome the trials, avoid deadly falls, and prove your platforming prowess?

name: Times Of War
short_description: 'Times Of War' - A sci-fi tower defense strategy game with armored vehicles, tanks, choppers, planes, explosive action, and a lot of unique environments. Upgrade towers, earn Tech points, manage resources, and defend your base in epic battles. Get ready for intense warfare!

name: STIM
short_description: Created as a college project. In STIM, you are the Captain of a spaceship exploring different planets, foraging for items, and crafting STIMs to sell to aliens for credits. Upgrade your gear, decorate your ship, and buy new machines to speed up your process in this exciting VR game.

name: Chronicles of Vipers
short_description: Chronicles of Vipers is a remake-demake first-person shooter inspired by old 8-bit and 16-bit console games, as well as VHS-era movies.

name: Mars First Logistics
short_description: Build physically simulated rovers and transport awkwardly shaped cargo across the surface of Mars. Earn funds, unlock new parts, and use your ingenuity to help the martians establish a new home. Playable solo or in online co-op!

name: NUKITASHI
short_description: Seiran Island. Even here in paradise, there are those who work in the shadows to bring it down... Confront the tyranny of a twisted system in this long-awaited visual novel adventure.

name: Impeachment Survivors
short_description: Survive the Impeachment! Impeachment Survivors is a political parody action roguelike with many waves of enemies, upgrades, and comedy. Be hypocrite, be corrupt, be a politician!

name: Tyrion Cuthbert: Attorney of the Arcane
short_description: In Tyrion Cuthbert: Attorney of the Arcane, you play as a defense attorney who practices law in a world of fantasy and wizards. You must defend clients accused of various crimes committed using magic and use the rules of magic to prove them innocent.

name: Sel Mounta-Siege the Demon Castle
short_description: A single player RPG about directing a seven man party in their ongoing travels across a fantasy island in their efforts to save the world from an impending invasion!

name: LUMbA: HANGOVER
short_description: Experience the thrilling aftermath of Lumba's crusade in LUMbA: HANGOVER! The substance has spread to four new victims, led once again by Pal. Together, they will engage in a doomed campaign across their world in this fast-paced, top-down shooter.

name: Docking Ships
short_description: Prepare to embark on a charming and cozy puzzle adventure in Docking Ships a delightful game that combines the charm of pirate ships with the brain-teasing challenge of navigating through a grid tile system to successfully dock your vessels.

name: Bandit Brawler
short_description: Bandit Brawler is a FPP open world comedy game. Fight, rob, steal and gamble your way to become the top bandit! Additionally, save a chicken.

name: Colored Effects
short_description: Colored Effects is a puzzle platformer game where you use different abilities to advance through levels. Each color grants a unique ability. Switch between the colors and their effects to collect gems, defeat bosses, and solve fun puzzles.

name: 抗日英雄Anti Japanese Heroes
short_description: This is a horizontal action game with 6 optional characters, including Farmer, Martial Monk, Qigong Master, Eighth Route, Secret Service, and King of Slingshot. Faced with countless invaders, can you kill all the enemies or end the game?

name: Mimi the Cat - New Friends
short_description: Help Mimi move, climb, or carry boxes to reach her bed and rest. Unlock adorable cats and choose to play with them in this challenging Sokoban-like game!

name: Planetary Delivery
short_description: Embark on a global delivery adventure in Planetary Delivery! Learn geography, deliver packages against time, upgrade your plane, and explore breathtaking landscapes. Relaxing, educational, and super chill gameplay awaits! Become the ultimate delivery expert today!

name: Neon Nexus
short_description: Neon Nexus is a procedurally generated, sci-fi roguelike. Navigate the world, fight enemies, and work your way to the extraction zone. Try and get out alive!

name: D Life
short_description: This is a new genre of game that uses mutation and wind to explore electronic life forms and take pictures. The sound system by industry veteran Yuriko Keino features background music that changes depending on the current situation.

name: Biomech Hell
short_description: A run and gun that mixes old-school mechanics from games like Contra, Gunstar Heroes and Metal Slug; with more modern features and a large dose of violence. A total arcade experience for all lovers of retro gaming!

name: Backrooms Abyss
short_description: Explore and survive levels based on the popular creepypasta lore. Each level offers various escape routes but also introduces perilous obstacles. Players can immerse themselves in the seemingly boundless and unsettling levels of the backrooms, experiencing the game's eerie and intricate mazes.

name: Stale Nation
short_description: You recently reach the end of a trail after a long hiking trip. You come home to a world plunged into chaos from an outbreak of infection that turns people into rabid beasts. Will you find a way out of this madness?

name: Night Escape
short_description: 'Night Escape' is a tense and strategic multiplayer game. Uncover the hidden assassin, solve puzzles, and escape the mysterious mansion before it's too late. Survive the night or become a victim. Embark on this deadly race for survival.

name: Happy Wagon
short_description: A happy little game about the struggles of old-timey travelling.Happy Wagon features several difficulties, unlockable characters, an endless mode and achievements. Happy Travels!

name: Mutrix
short_description: Mutrix is a music movement VR game, in which players need to use a lightsaber to slash flying notes, the greater the movement, the higher the score. The game library is rich, covering a variety of styles of music. Let's rhythm together!

name: Grimlord
short_description: Grimlord is a dark fantasy action RPG built for VR. Use every type of weaponry and armaments with full customization and limitless move sets to annihilate anyone who dares to stand between you and your destiny

name: 太公传承
short_description: A relaxed casual repair fairy game, suitable for leisure time to open a light pigeon game. You can play as a disciple brought up by Jiang Ziya and experience the life of a practitioner without the aura of the main character in an overhead world.

name: Backrooms Society
short_description: Backrooms Society is a 1-8 player co-op horror game. Make your way through unique levels of the backrooms while trying to survive and avoid mysterious entities. Scavenge each level for gear and resources, bring it back to The Hub where you can sell valuables and buy/craft new gear.

name: Granny: Chapter Two
short_description: You have to escape Granny and Grandpa...You have five days...

name: Journey Into Darkness
short_description: In an unknown environment, only this light can bring a little warmth, but the continuous decline of the battery is stripping away my sense of security, I have to escape! A zombie game for 1-4 players. In darkness, players use flashlights to affect zombie behavior, explore, escape and reach the end.

name: Aliens: Dark Descent
short_description: Drop into the gripping journey of Aliens: Dark Descent, a squad-based, single-player action game in the iconic Alien franchise. Lead your soldiers in real-time to stop a new and terrifying kind of Xenomorph outbreak on Planet Lethe.

name: OURWORLD
short_description: 'OURWORLD' is a 1:1 global flight simulator. You'll battle awakened A.I.s, safeguarding our world. It features 3D city modeling, multiplayer online gaming. Deluxe version include all aircraft and features.

name: CREATURES
short_description: Creatures is a multi-player that adds a gaming layer to music. Based around the pioneering artist BillyRacxx, we're creating a world where his fans can game and enjoy unique music that will constantly be updated.

name: Granny
short_description: You have to escape Granny`s house...You have five days...

name: Hookah Cafe Simulator
short_description: Have you ever wanted to know what is it like running your own Hookah Cafe Business? Let's Simulate It. Upgrade your shop with new types of equipment to attract and impress more customers.

name: VINE
short_description: Embark on an epic 20-hour adventure, beating challenges to reach the end. A captivating puzzle platforming experience with a unique tongue/rope mechanic, testing your dexterity and problem-solving skills. Meet other Poros in a desolated research facility in search of Paradise. Can you reach it?

name: Granny 3
short_description: You have to escape Granny and Grandpa...You have five days...

name: Gemini: Binary Conflict
short_description: ‘Gemini: Binary Conflict’ is a multiplayer, class based, first person shooter set in the midst of an interplanetary war. With exotic environments and a bold visual style, the game provides a subtle mixture of mechanics both familiar and unusual to create a unique and engaging gameplay experience.

name: Jigsaw Puzzle World Memories
short_description: Discover historic monuments with our puzzle game! With 20 incredible images and 5 levels of difficulty, this game will challenge your mind and take you on a journey through history. Test your skills in free mode or challenge mode. Play now and start exploring the world of historic monuments!

name: LET ME OUT
short_description: LET ME OUT - is a psychological horror with a depressing mood. The life of the main character lies in your hands. Help him get out of his difficult condition and walk this path with him.

name: Yuri Dating Agency
short_description: Yuri Dating Agency - a speed dating simulator for WLW. You're a girl who likes girls, walking into this Yuri dating agency to find yourself a date. Here, you will be able to get to know lots of girls. Will you be able to win their hearts?

name: Casino Resort Tower
short_description: Casino Resort Tower is a simulation game where you build and manage a casino hotel skyscraper from the ground up. While trying to solve the problems caused by troublesome customers with a CEO that dreams about a luxury office.

name: Soul Survivor: Trials of the Goddess
short_description: A retro, choices-matter dungeon crawler JRPG with roguelike elements. Features a unique gameplay loop: Take up to 3 'free' items per area Fight 3 battles of your choosing Choose wisely! You Died? Revive and try again, taking up to 3 upgrades into your next life

name: Six Days in Fallujah
short_description: Six Days in Fallujah is a realistic first-person tactical shooter based on true stories of Marines, Soldiers, and Iraqi civilians during the toughest urban battle since 1968.

name: Tuttle: Star Flower Harvest
short_description: Tuttle: Star Flower Harvest: become a space flower farmer, fight off pests, learn new skills, and find out the secrets of the Starflowers! Your actions shape the Galaxies. Dig in now!

name: Steel Racer
short_description: Steel Racer is a 2D pixelated old school racing game, inspired by classics from the 80s and 90s era, featuring great chiptune music, arcade gameplay style and high speed cars! Are you ready to become the 'Steel Racer'!?

name: The Merchant's Guide to the Kingdom
short_description: You are an NPC and shopkeeper in an MMORPG world. Trade, craft and manage a guild to acquire the most powerful gear and face dangerous dungeons, world bosses, rare spawns and up to 40-man raids while following the campaign to aid in the protection of the ancient and powerful Elemental Stones.

name: Alia's Carnival! Flowering Sky
short_description: 本作是日本美少女游戏知名品牌NanaWind（七风社）制作的超能力校园恋爱题材作品，是《爱丽娅的明日盛典!》的续作。本作由业内知名女性画师七尾奈留和Mitha联合担当原画与角色设计；由超人气声优桐谷华、秋野花、阳茉莉等领衔为游戏女主角献声。

name: Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine
short_description: Help Dr. Fetus create the perfect Meat Boy clone in a unique new twist on the tile-matching puzzle genre. In classic Meat Boy fashion, an endless cavalcade of devious and deadly traps stand between you and victory in this hardcore puzzle game that will push your skills to the limit.

name: The Bookwalker: Thief of Tales
short_description: The Bookwalker is a narrative adventure in which you play as Etienne Quist, a writer-turned-thief with the ability to dive into books. Use your powers to journey between reality and book worlds, and steal legendary items like Thor's Hammer and Excalibur to restore your ability to write.

name: That Which Gave Chase
short_description: A first-person dog sledding thriller. Play as a sled dog musher hired to transport a scientist deep into the unforgiving wastes of the arctic.

name: I, the Forgotten One
short_description: To defeat the rebel knights and stabilize the crown, you must journey through the most dangerous realm in the kingdom--your own wretched past.

name: Fireball Wizard
short_description: Fireball Wizard is a lovingly crafted retro arcade platformer. Blast your way through 4 worlds and 40+ levels to defeat the big bosses and find all the secrets. Unlock spells and costumes as you go to help you face the challenges ahead.

name: Pop and Chicks
short_description: Help Pop the hen rescue her chicks. Take one move at a time, and be careful where you're going.

name: Goodbye Dr. Sanchez
short_description: Goodbye Dr. Sanchez is a first person two player coop horror game where you must escape from the evil Dr. Sanchez’s imprisonment. Explore Sanchez’s domains. Avoid traps and other perils. Communicate with your partner and provide them useful information in order to survive.

name: Dating Simulator
short_description: Dating Simulator is a simulation game where you meet and interact with different people.

name: NOAH
short_description: 말할 수 없는 아이 ‘노아’가 되어 멸망해가는 세상을 여행해보세요. 모종의 이유로 인류는 큰 재앙 속에 빠졌으며, 우리가 살던 시대의 인류는 거의 사라지기 직전입니다. 여러분은 작은 해파리 로봇과 함께 과거를 여행하며 그 이유를 알아보게 됩니다.

name: Sugarcreek
short_description: Sugarcreek is a story-based adventure game following Eddie the high-school goat and his closest friends as they try to find his missing step-sister before the week is over!

name: Unimime - Unicycle Madness
short_description: Master the art of unicycling and venture across breakneck flat surfaces, minimal inclines, and pocketbook-sized crates! Look forward to 90 handcrafted levels, unlockable characters, and a game that's hard to master and hard to put down!

name: Chronautical
short_description: In this narrative-driven sci-fi mystery, investigate across space and time to uncover clues and unravel the secrets of a star system that has disappeared, and the man trying to find it.

name: 战争时代
short_description: Every capable nation and organization has begun to expand its territory, and the player is the ruler of a small town (although it doesn't look like it's a town), relying on the player's skills and the town's inhabitants to keep the town alive in the face of an invasion from outside.

name: Monopoly Madness
short_description: Rediscover the MONOPOLY® you love in a way you’ve never seen before. This is Madness!

name: Medical Record Sheet
short_description: The game is a single-player combat roguelike in which you play the role of a doctor who chooses various medical records to treat, and then controls various human immune guards, equipped with a variety of core weapons to enter various areas of the human body to fight against a variety of pathogens.

name: Chloé’s Requiem -encore-
short_description: Chloé’s Requiem -encore- is a 2D Adventure Horror game set in Modern Europe. The genius violinist Michél is invited into an old mansion. Inside waits Chloé, who asks him to “Break the curse of the mansion”. What awaits the pair after the mystery is solved…?

name: Invaders from the Third Dimension
short_description: A retro space game with 3D graphics and modern controls. Rotate your ship and shoot at any angle, instead of just sliding back and forth. Enjoy 3D graphics with lighting effects and realistic explosions.

name: TERO - Terror Hour
short_description: Your mother didn't let you watch TV at night... and even after her death, she still won't let you... Don't let her catch you watching that damn horror movie you just bought... Cover yourself with the blanket!

name: Loading Simulator
short_description: A game for the most patient! Loading has never been so exciting! If you love loading screen and puzzles, this is what you're looking for!

name: Forever Skies
short_description: Forever Skies is a first-person post-apocalyptic survival game. Return to Earth, ravaged by an ecological disaster. Fly, upgrade and customize your mobile high-tech airship base. Scavenge resources to survive, face dangers on the surface and hunt for viral pathogens to cure a mysterious illness.

name: Sakura in Paris
short_description: “Sakura in Paris” is a Romantic Comedy Visual Novel and Yuri Dating Sim. Play as Sakura Maeda as she travels to Paris, learns about her father and, if everything goes right, may fall in love with the woman of her dreams along the way.

name: 英雄之旅
short_description: 《英雄之旅》是一款放置挂机类游戏，核心玩法就是打怪刷装备，穿更好的装备打更强的怪，体验爆极品装备的快感。你可以通过搭配技能和天赋，挑战竞技场和罪魂之塔，解锁神器，获得强大的能力。此外，你还可以收集各种伙伴、图鉴和幻化，让你的冒险更加多彩。

name: Creepless
short_description: This is a multiplayer co-op horror game for 1-4 players. Collect items, repair car and get out! But monsters will bother you.

name: 坦克英雄 TankHero
short_description: Tank Hero is a third-person 3D game. This game requires players to operate a tank to eliminate enemies along the way and advance to the end in a complex road environment. Facing different environments, choose the right tank to start the challenge!

name: Nova Lands
short_description: Nova Lands is a factory building, exploration, and island management game. Explore, engage in combat, and automate your industry. The planet you’re on is full of mysteries, creatures, people, and things to do. Welcome to your new home amongst the stars!

name: 百煉登神  Immortal Tales of Rebirth
short_description: In 'Immortal Tales of Rebirth,' an action RPG fusing fantasy , play as a struggling young master, tame spirit beasts, uncover lost martial arts & hidden realms, and challenge ancient divine beasts. Discover secrets & hidden events for rewarding experiences. Dive into this thrilling adventure!

name: Sevyal
short_description: Sevyal is a single-player horror game set in an underground hospital. Something has gone wrong and as a government official, you must visit the location, repair the electricity, survive, establish communication with the military, and escape.

name: I Made Myself An AI
short_description: Build circuits and manage heat as you complete tasks in this surprisingly intuitive puzzle game unlike anything you've ever played before.

name: Feed All Monsters
short_description: Feed All Monsters is a cute and cozy Line Puzzle game. Assist a team of delivery workers in their quest to bring tasty food to all the little monsters. Find the optimal path for each worker in order to get all the monsters fed.

name: Survivor's guilt
short_description: A great earthquake with a magnitude of 9.2 occurred. The day when rescue arrives is unknown. Make full use of your smart phone and the supplies you have left, and continue to fight against the hunger and fear that is attacking you.

name: Ramen Oil Pecking Simulator
short_description: Have you ever wanted to collect oil floating in a bowl of ramen by pulling it with chopsticks? This game will completely satisfy your desire to do so!

name: Trepang2
short_description: Become the ultimate badass in Trepang2: A gory, action-packed FPS set in the near future. Unleash all hell on your enemies, dodge bullets and leave a trail of destruction in this hardcore and frenetic shooter.

name: Magi's Dream
short_description: Enter the Magi's Dream. Survive endless waves of enemies while getting stronger by using the arcane powers of the Magi! Push your creative limits in this pixel art reverse bullet-hell. How long can you survive the dream?

name: Bombing!! 2: A Graffiti Paradise
short_description: Welcome To Graffiti Paradise! Explore for hidden secrets, meet interesting friends, unlock painting tools, and fill your world with colour!

name: Limit Choice
short_description: In this game, a wide variety of unique cards will make their appearance, each wielding diverse skills to support your battles. With every confrontation against enemies and overcoming of difficult trials, your deck evolves, gaining ever-increasing power.

name: Necrodome
short_description: NECRODOME is a real-time, 3D, futuristic motorized mayhem. Drive a powerful, armored vehicle bristling with mega-weapons. Win or die in 30 daunting arenas. Keep on winning and you’ll make it to the Necrodome!

name: Blood Field | Cỏ Máu
short_description: Explore a sinister world with environments based on Vietnam culture and a storyline inspired by Vietnam myths and folklore.

name: Wrong God
short_description: Wrong God is an action roguelike where you play as a demon summoned by mistake. Navigate randomly generated levels, face different enemies, and adapt to changing weapons every 5 seconds. Survive the catacombs and fix the cult's error.

name: NoRoY
short_description: A dark adventure full of tense moments that will test your skills. Your main goal is to climb to the top while avoiding difficult obstacles and disturbing creatures. NoRoY is very agile, but a single mistake can cause you to lose all your progress.

name: AEW: Fight Forever
short_description: Developed by YUKE’s, AEW: Fight Forever combines nostalgic arcade-wrestling with All Elite Wrestling finishers and moves. Featuring a big roster of AEW talent, multiple match types, robust career mode, tons of customization options, more than 40 weapons, and so much more!

name: Skedaddling In Egypt
short_description: Skedaddling In Egypt is a first person speedrunning game where you use your parkour skills and mummy wrappings to swing and slide your way through your crumbling tomb. Compete with others through an online leaderboard, collect treasures, and more!

name: My Little Sister's Special Place
short_description: Our hero used to go to Akiba a lot when he was younger. It wasn't to have fun, but for his little sister's sake. One day, his younger sister is gifted a Christmas trip, and they spend time together as if they're a couple. This is the delightful and touching love story of these two siblings.

name: Expand & Exterminate: Terrytorial Disputes - Endless Base Defense
short_description: The best elements of Real-Time Strategy (RTS) and Tower Defense genres combined into a new Base Defense game. Defend against countless waves of enemies while you expand your base, gather resources, and research technologies to defeat the ever strengthening enemy units.

name: UWD - You Will Die!
short_description: You Will Die is a indie game survival shooter top-down with waves of zombies to kill.

name: 15 Minutes Dungeon
short_description: Can you beat the dungeon in 15 minutes? Roguelike + RTA.

name: Merchant of the Six Kingdoms
short_description: Become a medieval merchant and master the arts of bartering, haggling, and investing, Explore 20 markets, barter with 200 characters, and trade in over 1,800 items in a dynamic bartering and haggling system that will challenge and reward.

name: Yomi 2
short_description: A fighting game in card form. Learn your character, practice combos, and read the opponent's tendencies. Strategic, turn-based card battling that lets you experience the nuances of fighting games like Street Fighter and Fantasy Strike by a lead designer who worked on both.

name: LOOPERS
short_description: Tyler is a high schooler on a mission. He's going to use every minute of summer vacation to go on as many GPS-assisted scavenger hunts as possible. After running into some old friends during one of these hunts, strange things start happening: The day resets and today plays out exactly like yesterday

name: Take No Prisoners
short_description: Take No Prisoners is a hard-core top-down 3D shooter that allows you to blow away enemies. As Slade, a mercenary surviving on the fringes of a post-nuclear world, you'll fight through 20 non-linear territories populated by hordes of twisted mutants and refugees.

name: Life Not Supported
short_description: You are the lone survivor orbiting a potential new home planet, tethered to what’s left of your ship. Gather nearby debris and assemble a make-shift vessel in an attempt to survive the harsh realities of space. Maybe you'll live long enough to uncover the truth behind the ships malfunction...

name: One Lonely Outpost
short_description: An alien world sometimes needs a farmer’s touch to bring it to life. In this sci-fi, colonization-life sim, terraform a barren world: turn wastelands into verdant landscapes while exploring, farming, building, and unlocking all the mysteries of this strange new planet.

name: Pekoe
short_description: Blend tea and friendship in the flavorful world of Pekoe, a cozy cat-filled tea-making simulator about taking the time for self-care and connecting with what makes you happy. Build relationships, upgrade your teahouse, and discover new recipes as you work towards creating a place you can call home.

name: Tamageddon
short_description: Battle against an army of balls coming your way in this fast-paced survival roguelike! Pick the right weapons and power-ups as you level up and continue your carnage. Unlock new characters and levels as you grow stronger!

name: Idle Ultimate
short_description: An idle game with endless features and possibilities. Generators, multipliers, prestige system, bets, investments, converters and many more features are waiting for you!

name: Imprecision
short_description: Imprecision is a first/third person, action game set in The Middle Ages. In Imprecision, you play as a lone archer, Örvar, who is training to take down The Black Knights of Bjørn and their kingdom. You are determined to defeat King Bjørn the Bloodthirsty and take back what is yours.

name: Grab The Goblins!
short_description: Grab The Goblins! is a cute hidden object game where you need to find tiny goblins to stop them running amok!

name: Abyss Dive
short_description: Abyss Dive is a 2D side-view game where the player as a diver explores the ocean and with the help of his harpoon, can break air shells, fend off underwater monsters, and also fight his way to a mysterious treasure!

name: Ghost Trick: Phantom Detective
short_description: Ghost Trick: Phantom Detective, the classic puzzle-solving mystery adventure directed by Ace Attorney creator Shu Takumi, is back! This long-awaited HD remaster features upgraded visuals and sound and new gallery content.

name: Choo Choo Survivor
short_description: Drive your train to safety while shooting down endless hordes of zombies blocking your way. Upgrade your weapons and abilities and become absurdly powerful! Try out the free demo here on Steam.

name: Don't let Him In
short_description: A Psychological Third Person Cinematic Experience - Some roads are better left untraveled.

name: Amarantus
short_description: Roadtrip across the country. Confront a tyrant. The revolution will be messy—but the relationships will be messier.

name: Little Friends: Puppy Island
short_description: Get ready for a pawsome puppy adventure in Little Friends: Puppy Island! Discover exciting locations, dig up hidden treasures, build and expand your holiday resort, and meet plenty of lovable little friends to care for on your very own un-paw-gettable, tropical island adventure!

name: Storm Swordsman
short_description: This is a 2D action adventure game of stealth assassination, swordsmanship and ninjutsu duel! There is no refreshing combo, and there is no Wushuang who mows the grass. hesitates will not lose, but carelessness will die! In the world of swordsmen, the victory or defeat is in the blink of an eye!

name: Panpu-ja
short_description: You control three employees of a cleaning company, carrying out their jobs, but be careful, as engaging in activities outside of work may lead to undesirable outcomes.

name: Shogun Showdown
short_description: Shogun Showdown is a turn-based combat game with rogue-like and deck-building elements. Position yourself and attack at the right time, upgrade your tiles and combo them to get ready to face the Shogun!

name: Schachkampf - Fantasy Chess
short_description: A fantasy chess game in a beautiful pixelart world. This is the game you always wanted on your SNES back in the days.

name: Perfect Partner
short_description: Perfect Partner is a party game with 2 people work closely together to defeat other teams to win. The road to the championship is full of obstacles, your teammates may be your worst enemy! Have fun in this game or meet the soul mate you are most acquainted with here.

name: Love Shore
short_description: Play as Sam or Farah as they attempt to navigate the neon thrills of their cyberpunk city Love Shore, solve murders, fight gods and maybe fall in love.

name: Milita Aventuro
short_description: 在90年代的东欧国家，由于艾斯佩罗族和伊多诺族之间的矛盾，进而引发了双方的战争。玩家将扮演故事的主人公艾斯佩罗族的少女——弗洛拉，穿越战火过后的断壁残垣，结识抱持着不同想法理念的人们，在残酷的战争中竭尽全力生存下去，并揭开隐藏在战争背后的真相。

name: Salty Hounds
short_description: A unique dating sim / RPG that gives you total freedom to romance five handsome guys in an open-world metropolis.

name: TimeK
short_description: This game is a side-scrolling puzzle action game where the player controls time to navigate through obstacles and enemies while collecting items and reaching the goal.

name: Prediction Game
short_description: It's a game to predict what it will say by looking at pictures and names.

name: Waking Atlas
short_description: Wake the great titan Atlas before he drops the world in this colorful and weird JRPG!

name: Revival: Recolonization
short_description: Set in a post-apoc version of Earth, Revival is a 4x strategy game where the world and its rules can change at key moments, creating a deep and highly replayable experience.

name: Peaceful Lands
short_description: Peaceful Lands is a relaxing minimalist building strategy game where you place tiles to create a beautiful and ever-growing village landscape. A great way to relax, sit back and watch your beautiful land grow. Strategize, beat your high score and have fun.

name: Chef Capybara
short_description: Chef Capybara is a hardcore platformer where you play as a capybara cooking a variety of dishes. Explore different worlds, collect ingredients, and avoid traps while preparing meals. Unlock new outfits by collecting gems. Get ready for an exciting culinary adventure!

name: Kingdom Eighties
short_description: Kingdom Eighties is a short story-based standalone expansion set in the Kingdom universe. A singleplayer epic adventure of micro-strategy and base building. Defend your town against the mysterious Greed, and discover the secrets of your family lineage!

name: Dimensional Dexterity
short_description: Get ready to immerse yourself in the innovative gameplay, where the central mechanic revolves around the seamless shifting of Dimensions. With each shift, the world around you transforms, presenting new obstacles to overcome and hidden paths to discover.

name: HAELE 3D - Feet Poser Pro
short_description: HAELE is a versatile 3D feet poser and customizer app. It is an easy to use foot anatomy reference tool for the artist, with a wide palette of detailed options and animations to create the feet you need be it highly realistic or stylized. Change poses, lighting, materials, colors and many more.

name: Lisle Engle Heavy Distance
short_description: Heavy Distance is the ground breaking interactive single from Lisle Engle.

name: Other World Survivors
short_description: Other World Survivors is a Rogue-like action game inspired by survivor games and classical games. Pick a hero and survive in the endless coming monster tide, build every skill on your own, and finally defeat the Dominators.

name: STORY OF SEASONS: A Wonderful Life
short_description: Put down roots on your new farm in the peaceful town of Forgotten Valley. Bring life to the land by cultivating crops and raising animals, find love among the town's friendly folk, and make lasting memories with a family of your very own.

name: SLUDGE LIFE 2
short_description: SLUDGE LIFE 2 is the grimiest first-person vandalism sim since the first SLUDGE LIFE—but, like, twice as dense. Explore a huger, weirder, gnarlier open world loaded with secrets, weirdos, jokes, and, of course, plenty of spots to tag.

name: Lifespace Traveler
short_description: Lifespace Traveler is an action-packed, easy to learn, hard to master cyberpunk game where reality is split into dimensions called Lifespaces. No hand holding. No mercy. Fight your way and test your reflexes in fast-paced, brutal combat as you reveal the mysteries of an unforgiving dystopian world.

name: A Long Journey to an Uncertain End
short_description: Explore the known and unknown galaxy with a ragtag crew of eclectic new friends in this narrative management space opera. You are a sentient spaceship, an outlawed commodity, and there's an entire galaxy between you and freedom…not to mention your abusive ex on your tail.

name: DotDot
short_description: Subject 'AISister' is attempting to solve some puzzles. Understanding the concept between dots (octagonal prism) and lines is crucial to complete those intricately designed levels. You can interact with the surrounding environment and objects to discover clues about the story behind.

name: Russpuppy Kid Books
short_description: Your child will explore interactive stories, enjoy engaging reading games, and even bring their own book to life. Foster creativity, vocabulary, and a love for learning. Encourage the budding reader and writer in your young one. Experience the thrill of learning!

name: Parsec lost in space
short_description: Dodge! Speed up! Destroy! Here you will have to challenge yourself to the maximum in order to defeat all the challenges and leave in one piece. Relying only on your reflexes and the movement of your ship, you will have to face everything from asteroids to giant robots!!!

name: 実録パワフル野球拳スラッガー山田
short_description: - 野球拳 - それは投と打を駆使する伝説のマーシャルアーツ

name: Adolf Hitler RPG: Last Minutes of the Millennium Empire
short_description: Adolf Hitler RPG: Last Minutes of the Millennium Empire is a simple and short game where you get to put an end to the man who initiated World War II.

name: My Eggs
short_description: My Eggs - Side-view game with a physical world, where the player by controlling the direction of the wind moves objects in the game, as well as the main character, who must collect all the eggs and deliver to the destination.

name: Tiska Buska
short_description: Fight for redemption through the eyes of Mahkklen, a mysterious figure in search of vengeance in this world of dishonesty and tiranny, this action packed unseen combination of adventure and racing games offers you 9 levels of pure intrigue and danger, each one with a different new challenge!

name: Formula 2707 - All Stars Kombat
short_description: Formula 2707 - All Stars Kombat is a combat driving simulator inspired by the great hits of the 2000s. It recreates the classic arcade game action and offers fun without speed limits. Formula 2707 offers a split-screen multiplayer mode for those who miss long couch nights with friends.

name: Alterium Shift
short_description: Embark on a journey through the living world of Alteria and experience its dynamic quests, unique turn-based combat, and choice-driven storylines. With three branching narratives and unforgettable characters, Alterium Shift is a retro-inspired JRPG that offers a new adventure with every playthrough.

name: REC: Beyond The Lens
short_description: REC: Beyond The Lens is a first-person horror game that tells the story of an unresolved past, with realistic graphics. Explore an unknown location, investigating dark secrets while using a body camera to document every step

name: Wendigo
short_description: A stealth horror game in the woods, investigate and progress while drawing as little attention to yourself as possible.

name: Octane Remix
short_description: Octane Remix is a fast paced, non-stop Obstacle Hell Roguelite Racing Game! Choose your racer, choose your playstyle, and test your skills against the simulation dome!

name: 房间的秘密2：起点
short_description: 《房间的秘密2：起点》是由Noface工作室制作的非恐剧情向解谜游戏，也是《房间的秘密》的续作。甜美回忆的糖衣，可能包裹着难以想象的黑暗内幕。永远留在童年的美梦中？还是选择揭开真相？让我们回到故事的起点，从头开始这场冒险......

name: Sliming
short_description: In 'Sliming, players must navigate the slime through numerous obstacles to reach its destination by bouncing it. The control of avoiding obstacles such as spikes, saw blades, and moving platforms creates a thrilling experience for players.

name: Honey Are You There?
short_description: Matthew Nate, a middle-aged man plagued with mental health problems whose home has become a site of unexplainable paranormal activity and a malevolent female entity is pursuing him to his death.

name: Cryptid
short_description: Cryptid is a single-player horror fps game that chronicles an experienced hunter and a creature's encounter from the perspective of the Body Cam.

name: Square Word: Summer Edition
short_description: Square Word is coming on Steam! Discover 120+ words spread in 4 sunny themes! Complete objectives & collect stamps!

name: Ettrian - The Elf Prince
short_description: Unravel the truth behind betrayal and reclaim your rightful place in Ettrian - The Elf Prince, an epic adventure of survival and redemption!

name: Anamnesis
short_description: Anamnesis is a psychological horror game with a heavy focus on tension, you'll never feel truly alone as you explore the vast darkness of the office. Relive a digitized memory of a power cut, with nothing but a box of matches for protection.

name: The Deer
short_description: 'The Deer' is an educational inter­ac­tive expe­ri­ence for children.You'll be an ancient Deer during the Pleistocene (Ice Age) epoch and you'll discover everything about this marvelous era.Unfortunately there were no T-Rex during this age since they were already extinct millions of years before.

name: Cease To Breathe
short_description: You wake up stranded. Your head is bleeding and the car's windshield is smashed. As night falls, a storm approaches. Perhaps the house nearby can offer a lifeline.. or perhaps it's home to a festering evil. Either way, you're going to find out, first hand...

name: Nightsteel Survivors
short_description: Nightsteel Survivors is a 2D shooter with 'roguelite' elements set in a dangerous robot-filled laboratory. Choose from various characters with unique abilities and face challenging bosses. Upgrade your skills and equipment to survive and escape the Nightsteel labyrinth.

name: Devil's Dive
short_description: Devil's Dive is an action platformer rogue-lite. Dive deeper and deeper into the depths to regain your title as Lord of the Underworld... if you can defeat the usurpers! Death will see you spat out, returned to the surface. But you may Dive again, stronger!

name: Dream Catcher
short_description: Find over 70 unique monsters to battle, collect and raise. Your monsters will go through a branching path of evolutions to help you explore a dream-like open world. Let your dreams become a reality or look for a way out.

name: 1$ Fun: Clock Simulator
short_description: Click once a second. Every second. You are the clock.

name: Rumple Town
short_description: Rumple Town is a card drafting game, that involves defending a town that is populated by beans. Recruit beans to protect your town, and attacks the invading monsters. Can you and your town survive?

name: Full Quiet
short_description: In this open-world game of survival, mystery and adventure you must learn how Pap and his radio buddies maintained their radio grid, protected the lands they now walk and silenced the forest in order to find your missing son.

name: Infinite Random Defense
short_description: Infinite Random Defense is a tile-based defense strategy game.

name: 孵化之地 wild eclosion
short_description: You have to kill monsters to get resources, build your own terrain, build your own buildings, and get equipment to enhance yourself. But you need to accept a constant stream of challenges to prove your ability. You have the strength to lead the new era!

name: Blind Sound
short_description: Blind Sound is a Game about, Exploration and Puzzle-solving. This is a Linear Story Based horror game which sets in a science facility. You will discover tons of thing and find about the Creepy history of this facility with Full of Creatures That extremely Dangerous.

name: Neon Parkour 2
short_description: Control a blue cube and complete challenging trails and puzzles to reach the target! Red cubes that will destroy you the moment you touch them! Help the blue cube reach its destination in Neon Parkour, which has a minimal design. Jump, dash and swing to solve challenging trails!

name: Mars Survivors
short_description: Ready to tackle the challenge? On Mars, confront countless mutated creatures and mechanical monsters. Choose survivors, weapons, and skills wisely for diverse battles. Employ precise shooting, agile dodging, and strategic use of props and skills to fend off enemy attacks.

name: Chosen Angels
short_description: Chosen Angels is a side scroller game where you have to play as an angel, who must cope with not an easy job. Need to have time to deliver all the angels on the right path. The color of their wings corresponds to their color of the door. Do not hesitate, with time there will be a lot of them.

name: Putin Must Die - Defend the White House
short_description: Vladimir has gone mad. He has created an army of Russian-speaking Putin clones to destroy America, and the White House is the final frontier. You must defend the White House against invading hordes of Vladimir clones, or become one of them. Zombies have Procedural Dismemberment.

name: 危城逃生
short_description: Everything in the world has changed overnight, and you will face difficulties, thrills, and death with the protagonist. Search for keys, solve puzzles, engage in battles, and use all your means to escape from residential buildings, taking your first step out of the city!

name: Grandma's Cane
short_description: ”Grandma's Cane” is a 3D personal development survival lawn mowing game that gradually strengthens by continuously developing enough resources and props in the early stages, and ultimately battles against the boss.

name: Sergeant Squidley: Space Cop!
short_description: There's been a murder in Moontropolis, and it's up to Sergeant Squidley to solve it! In this retro roleplaying/adventure hybrid, you’ll spend a week as Squidley trying to crack the case. But between family troubles and saxophone practice will you even find the time for detective work?

name: A Dark Room ®
short_description: Critically acclaimed, minimalist text-based rpg. Come light the fire.

name: Inn The Dark
short_description: You have been sent to aid in a Triple Homicide case. But you soon find that things are not as they seem. Inn This first person horror game you must investigate the strange super natural on goings in a haunted hotel. Run and hide from danger using only a Flashlight and Camera!

name: TEAM SIX - Armored Troops
short_description: A squad-based strategic action game where you command six types of special units to complete missions. It offers a variety of gameplay options, including large-scale battles, infiltration, sniping, and armored warfare.

name: Alight in the Dark
short_description: Alight in the Dark is a reverse bullet hell rogue-lite with a strategic ability and equipment system where player choice is not only crucial, but a core part of developing your build, allowing you to either survive or dominate based on the choices you make.

name: 1$ Fun: iHUGU
short_description: One hug can change the world. Hug once every creature you meet. Don’t forget anyone.

name: Future Offline
short_description: Future Offline is an Oldschool SINGLE PLAYER Roleplaying game. It simulates a MMORPG and many mechanics are based around a MMO design. This game may primarily appeal to those looking for nostalgia of old MMOs or RPGs from the early 2000s or before.

name: PASKA BATTLE STYLE!
short_description: The time has finally come! All the most dangerous people in the world have reunited to show off their talents in the annual Paska Battle Style anniversary and you, yes, YOU, will have to shut their big egos off!

name: Next Station: Zombies
short_description: 'Next Station: Zombies' is an indie-casual game that throws you into a post-apocalyptic world infested with hordes of ravenous zombies.

name: Dream Land
short_description: This is a challenging pixel sandbox RPG set in an open world. You can forage, hunt,mine, build, craft and develop your character without any restrictions.Everything is unknown and dangerous,you need to figure it out and survive.

name: Fox Run
short_description: Improve your reflexes and gain more experience in your skills to avoid obstacles in your way

name: Approaching Cao Army
short_description: This is a positional combat game that combines elements of Snake, Grid Avoidance, and Vampire-style combat. Players control the entire team of heroes by controlling the leader. The cute art style, beautiful music, and smooth rhythm combine to offer a pleasant experience.

name: Axial Disc 2
short_description: The long awaited sequel to Axial Disc 1!

name: Quantum Derelict
short_description: 'Quantum Derelict' is a rogue-lite survival horror game set in a chilling Lovecraftian inspired narrative. In the uncharted vastness of space, outwit the sinister cult of VUGSHERYOG and the lurking horrors as you strive to retain your sanity, find rescue, and survive against all odds.

name: Jello
short_description: Jello is a physics-based platformer redefining movement mechanics. Jump, slap, slide, swim and roll using your controller or mouse in an unconventional, tactile way

name: 1$ Fun: Estiman
short_description: ESTIMAN is a relaxing arcade game with original estimation-based gameplay

name: Doomies
short_description: An ultra violent platformer arcade shooter game, with tons of guns, metal music, super satisfying gameplay, funny one-liners, dark humor and a freak-ton of spicy ketchup!! Hell yeah!

name: Jagged Alliance 3
short_description: The country of Grand Chien is thrown into chaos when the elected president goes missing and the paramilitary force known as “the Legion” seizes control. Hire mercs, meet interesting characters, and fight in tactically deep turn-based combat in this true successor to a beloved franchise.

name: Undomestic
short_description: Uncover forgotten secrets on a secluded medieval island. Journey through a dynamic world influenced by time and weather. Build, battle, and unravel the enigma. Shape the destiny of this captivating adventure.

name: Earth Defender
short_description: Play as one of the last surviving humans on a post-apocalyptic Earth, where resources are scarce and danger lurks around every corner. As you scavenge for supplies, fend off vicious enemies, and build a small colony, you must use your wits and combat skills to survive in this harsh new world.

name: Elysium Above 履云录
short_description: In SRPG Elysium Above, you will be a Commander of state Bo to direct the heroes to fight against enemies, and defend the newly restored land that has been annexed for 11 years! Wit the era of chaos and excitement with eight heroes!

name: OXENFREE II: Lost Signals
short_description: Five years after the events of OXENFREE, Riley returns to her hometown of Camena to investigate mysterious radio signals. What she finds is more than she bargained for.

name: Gravity Circuit
short_description: Gravity Circuit is a flashy action packed 2D platformer in the spirit of console classics. Follow Kai, a lone operative war hero who harnesses the mysterious powers of the Gravity Circuit, on an adventure in a futuristic world inhabited by sentient robots.

name: Over & Under
short_description: Jump and stick your way through tons of levels chock full of increasing difficulty, unique mechanics, and minimalistic intrigue. Get to the next level, fail, try again, fail again, try again, and finally reach the next checkpoint-- twelve times. It all makes you wonder... what's in store at the end?

name: Nock
short_description: Nock is bow & arrow soccer. Skate and zip around the pitch while using a bow and arrow to blast the ball into the other team's goal. With intuitive controls and realistic physics, Nock is easy to learn but difficult to master.

name: Exoprimal
short_description: Exoprimal is an online, team-based action game that pits humanity's cutting-edge exosuit technology against history's most ferocious beasts – dinosaurs.​​

name: Summer Valley Hike
short_description: Embark on a soul-soothing journey through the captivating Summer Valley. Leave your worries behind and let the beauty of this peaceful world envelop you. Summer Valley Hike is your ticket to a serene escape from the chaos of everyday life.

name: Mecha Kucha Gacha Defence
short_description: Try your luck! Mecha Kucha Gacha Defense is a pixel gacha defense game. It is a game to smash enemies by summoning units through gacha. If you think you're running out of luck, get more units with more payments(free)!

name: Castaway Station
short_description: An anomaly has destroyed your cruiser, stranding you alone on a hostile planet. Castaway Station is a roguelike deck-builder game with limited-use cards and permanent death. Complete dangerous missions to locate other survivors and gather the resources you need to live another day.

name: Touhou: New World
short_description: Delve back into the world of Touhou in this bullet hell action-RPG adventure! The boundary between Gensokyo and the outside world has been breached, and it falls to Reimu Hakurei and Marisa Kirisame to discover why. Level up skills, forge new equipment, and explore Gensokyo to uncover the truth!

name: 东方梦想终点~Touhou Fantasy destination
short_description: What kind of game is this? This is a second fan game of Oriental project. This work contains different settings from the original, so please pay attention to the players who feel uncomfortable about it

name: Mirages
short_description: Mirages is a 3D narrative and horror game with folk stories. One night, seven brides headed to the Captain Mansion but strayed into a place full of ghosts - Regret City. Horror haunts the small town. Due to destiny, actors, warlords, and offspring of the town are drawn in. They are closer to truth.

name: 仙途
short_description: Taoist friend, come and cultivate immortals together! This game can create unique characters at the beginning. We have an original breakthrough system, with a plethora of mind techniques ! Unique soul system, all non boss monsters can be captured and captured to obtain souls!

name: Zodiac - Hellish Memory
short_description: Challenge your ability, your reflexes and your memory to avoid from the bullets to defeat the zodiac spirits while memorize the cards and survive of a real bullet hell with difficulties for all playstyles.

name: Battle Bows
short_description: Grab your bow and rain magical arrows down from your castle tower. Defend the castle heart against increasingly challenging waves of evil balloons and defeat difficult giant bosses in this epic archery VR wave shooter. Play online co-op mode or solo and climb to the top of the seasonal leaderboards!

name: Greed of Man
short_description: Greed of Man is an open world multiplayer game where you live in a town ran by real players.

name: Invector: Rhythm Galaxy
short_description: Navigate breathtaking, celestial worlds while mastering the beat of chart-topping hits from today’s most popular artists, such as PinkPantheress, Charlie Puth, and more. Discover fresh new music from tomorrow’s biggest stars on a cosmic trip where every note guides your way.

name: Hitler Waifu
short_description: Welcome to the absurd world of Hitler Waifu! In this satirical video game, you take on the unconventional character of Eva, Adolf Hitler's wife.

name: Delivery Kore
short_description: It is an open world adventure game that tells the story of Kore, a girl who lives in Eleusis, a forest in Middle-earth where spirits gather, and Poring, who was born from Soul Jams. Become Kore, a forest girl, explore the forest of Eleusis with Poring, and deliver Poring to a new world.

name: Cute Capybaras
short_description: Spend your time with profit and pleasure! Play the puzzle game with the cutest and friendliest animal in the entire world! Find difference on pictures with capybaras!

name: 枪神细胞 Gunnery Cell
short_description: This is a Rogue bullet shooting game, you will play a resurrected cell in the arena, use the unique weapons you get, use the purest violence to kill the enemies in the arena and survive, collect energy to make yourself stronger, until finally incarnate as a god!

name: Throwback
short_description: Throwback is an action/arcade VR game packed with throwing-based stylish destruction and discovery.

name: Cotton Tale
short_description: Cotton Tale is a deceptively difficult precision platformer. Hopping is the name of the game. Each jump is precarious and getting to the top will take everything you've got. The journey may be long, and your falls may be great, but remember... failure is part of the fun!

name: Uber Destruction
short_description: Uber Destruction is a roguelite where you fight against relentless hoards of surreal foes. explore a vast collection of weapons and items, discover your personal playstyle! Embrace the bullet hell madness online with friends or in local co-op. Are you ready to seize the wheel and conquer the chaos?

name: Life of Slime
short_description: You play as a slime named Slami, who has to find his way in life. You have to accompany him on this path, helping him solve problems and remain himself in this big and very versatile world, where it's very easy to lose yourself.

name: Call Hating
short_description: Master outdated technology and navigate the phone tree from hell to get your internet back on. At all costs.

name: Sapiens Craft
short_description: Begin as a small stone age tribe. End as a global super power in a future age. Craft and research your way through history!

name: Heart of Iona
short_description: The Heart of Iona is Narrative Game where choices shape the story. During Ella's coronation, the castle is attacked, leading her to a secret chamber with a trapped dragon. Freeing him sets off a chain of adventures, as Ella learns the power of her heart to alter the Kingdom of Iona's destiny.

name: Multiplayer Mercs
short_description: Multiplayer Mercs - Bad Dudes are attacking the Refinery, it is up to You and Your Elite Force Team to Stop Them !

name: Atelier Marie Remake: The Alchemist of Salburg
short_description: It's not about saving the world. In this 'leisure adventure RPG,' failing student Marie pursues alchemy, adventures, and quests while aiming to graduate in five years. 'Atelier Marie,' the origin of the Atelier series, has been remade with new elements!

name: Summer Party Time
short_description: Get ready for the best summer ever! Party with your friends anytime, anywhere!

name: Paddle Flap
short_description: Ready, set, FLAP! Flex your paddle flapping skills in this casual but engaging arcade game. Imagine pinball, but remove all distractions and just focus on the ball action. Use the paddle to strike the falling balls and make them hit the right targets to earn points, power-ups and achievements!

name: The Legend of Santa
short_description: Run and jump through the North Pole on a quest to take back Santa's Workshop from the evil South Pole Troll and save Christmas!

name: Backrooms: Realm of Shadows
short_description: Backrooms: Realm of Shadows is a horror game that takes place in a seemingly endless maze of interconnected rooms and hallways, known as the Backrooms.

name: City Car Parking Simulator
short_description: Enjoy city driving in the City Car Parking Simulator, full of realistic driving experiences and challenging parking missions. Customize your vehicle and test your skills in this simulation game that offers a unique atmosphere with its graphics.

name: SGS Battle For: Stalingrad
short_description: The terrible 'rat fights' (Ratenkrieg) fought out in the urban area of Stalingrad end of 1942, on a battalion scale and two days per turn scales. Relive one of the fiercest and deadliest battles in history, a ‘Hell in a Small Place’.

name: Unholy
short_description: Open the doors between your everyday reality and a dark unholy world to unveil the mystery of the disappearance of your child. Explore both worlds to find clues, solve puzzles, decide whether you infiltrate or fight brutal enemies and stand up to an aberrant establishment.

name: Ducky's Delivery Service
short_description: Propeller-powered duck delivery action! In Ducky's Delivery Service, you are a duck who uses a propeller backpack to fly around and deliver mail. Master the flight physics, grow your delivery business, fulfill special delivery requests from other ducks, and earn time attack ranks and high scores.

name: BOSSGAME: The Final Boss Is My Heart
short_description: BOSSGAME: The Final Boss Is My Heart is a lesbian romance boss rush! Sophie and Anna are broke and trying to pay rent by hunting devils. Fight colorful bosses, flirt with your girlfriend, and uncover the mysteries of Mammon City in this lightning-fast action game!

name: eCheese Zone
short_description: eCheese Zone! A punishment game like no other, a hardcore digital escape room, an activity to get mad at. Featuring lots of text to read, an hour long punishment timer, secrets, and easy directions to follow (you will not read them and you will mess up). Are you up to the eCheese challenge?

name: AniCursor
short_description: AniCursor is an application for creating animated cursors. Download pre-made cursors from the Steam Workshop or create your own using the unique editor.

name: Only One Way Up
short_description: Reach new heights in a mysterious world above the clouds, full of secrets to explore. Ascend on your journey and get as high as possible in Only One Way Up! Step up into a realm way above the clouds..

name: Crystal Tower Defense
short_description: Stop an endless hoard of crystal-type enemies from reaching the portal to earth! You can build your own labyrinths, unlock new turrets, upgrade them, unlock abilities, and also gather permanent bonuses.

name: Lost Crystals
short_description: Unearth the hidden gems waiting to be discovered in the foggy valley. Immerse yourself in the calm and let the magic of Lost Crystals wash over you. Are you ready to embark on a tranquil adventure like no other?

name: Darkzan Arena
short_description: Challenge the greatest legends and creatures in this epic coliseum! Collect your treasures and upgrade your gears until you become number one in the entire multiverse. The game is an Arcade based on waves of enemies, each enemy has a unique behavior and a list of specific rewards.

name: FARSIDERS
short_description: 'Farsiders' is a top-down (isometric view) 3D action Hack-and-Slash RPG game set in a stylized futuristic cyberpunk world. Embark on a journey as 'Cassie' to the past with references to real world legends (Arthurian) where the worlds of sci-fi technology and medieval magic collide.

name: Peasant Kingdom
short_description: Peasant Kingdom is a PVP survival game where players can build castles, craft items, fight other players for resources, besiege and defend castles.

name: Odyssey Moon
short_description: Discover Odyssey Moon, the charming ARCADE game filled with shooting, upgrades, and adorable characters. Explore the moon in space, enhance your character with unique combinations, and immerse yourself in this cute adventure. Get ready to fall in love!

name: Undead Wilderness: Survival
short_description: Undead Wilderness: Survive the unforgiving jungle, unravel its mysteries, and escape the relentless horde of bloodthirsty zombies. Scavenge, manage resources, and fight for your life in a heart-pounding race against the growing undead threat.

name: MUA
short_description: This is a team online battle game. Use various characters to win the battle!

name: inRun
short_description: Experience the magic of classic arcade racing with an innovative open-world multiplayer system and optional Virtual Reality support that, for the first time in a driving game, produces no motion sickness.

name: Tether
short_description: Explore the ruins of a space station that mysteriously went offline. Brave a slew of hand-crafted challenges, uncover the darker secrets aboard the ship, and piece together the real reason everyone's gone missing . . .

name: Paint by Pixel 3
short_description: Unleash your creativity and paint your way pixel by pixel!

name: Crime O'Clock
short_description: Crime O'Clock is a hidden objects investigation and time exploration game with a deep storyline. Investigate cases through time and evolving maps by unveiling a multi-eras linked story. Will you be observant enough to solve the mysteries? Crime waits for no man!

name: Hellworld!
short_description: A story-driven 2D platforming game in which you possess your enemies and use their abilities to solve puzzles and make your way through the land of Hellworld.

name: 三國立志傳3
short_description: 經典人氣回合制角色策略遊戲【三國立志傳3】，不僅帶來更豐富的任務關卡、特殊地形配合天、地、人三系法術，變化出更多戰術，並強化人物獨特的技能，讓玩家自由打造最強隊伍！還有隱藏關卡，神秘的古文組合裝備等你來蓃集！
