name: The Trade Prince
short_description: The Trade Prince is a logistical economic simulation game in which you build automated trade networks across multiple planets to produce increasingly complex goods.

name: The Dungeon Tower
short_description: Can you beat The Dungeon Tower? A Fun roguelike where you can select one of the heroes to battle against the tower. Increase your level, gain new skills and complete quests to personalize your hero to kill the lord! Try and die in this journey until you can get stronger power ups to beat the game!

name: Underworld Adventures
short_description: Underworld Adventures is an excellent 2D adventure game, with RPG elements, in which you need to destroy an ancient evil and free your country from terrible monsters.

name: GAIA Survivors
short_description: Control a variety of robots and destroy invaders from outer space in order to save the destroyed earth! 'GAIA Survivors' is a 'Shoot 'Em Up' type sci-fi rogue-lite casual game with a retro-futuristic worldview.

name: SURVIVAL SISTERS：2048＋1
short_description: The popular 2048 puzzle ''SURVIVAL SISTERS:2048'' is now powered up and available as ''+1 (plus one)''! In a devastated world, the Sisters have returned from the depths of despair to cultivate the sustenance of life today......!

name: Build and Drive Racing
short_description: Get ready for a new experience on Windows desktop and VR, where you get to build your ultimate racing machine, tailored to your driving style and optimized for performance, or race to the finish line with a monster what makes you smile.

name: Let's! Revolution!
short_description: Let’s! Revolution! is a colorful roguelite puzzle mashup about stopping a narcissistic King from ruining your world. Flip tiles to uncover the hidden path to the King. Use deductive reasoning to avoid his cronies or take them all down in strategic turn-based combat.

name: The Experiment
short_description: The tests went wrong. He has been transformed. It is hostile toward others. You have been assigned the task of killing the horrifying creature. Listen closely as it could be around any corner.

name: Homeseek
short_description: Homeseek is a post-apocalyptic survival strategy game set on a dystopian, resource-strapped Earth at the beginning of the next century. In a dried-up wasteland where water has become the new gold, every choice becomes life or death. With your guidance, survival just might be within reach.

name: Meaningless
short_description: Solve puzzles by moving blocks to guide the ball to the exit in a minimalist 3D world. Take the time to appreciate your success; it's hypnotizing and satisfying to watch.

name: Evergreen - Mountain Life Simulator
short_description: Evergreen is a simulation game about leaving the stress of the city behind and starting a new life in a mountain valley.

name: Koi Zen: Opposite Colors
short_description: Immerse yourself in a vibrant and tranquil puzzle game, featuring elegant koi fish to enhance your gameplay. Take control of both the white and black pieces to paint the board with amazing colors.

name: Speedway Racing
short_description: In Speedway Racing, you will enjoy the fastest, most spectacular races at over 350 Km/h, avoiding multiple collisions against 20 rivals.

name: Xenonauts 2
short_description: Wage a global war of resistance against an alien invasion. Command turn-based tactical battles, build a network of covert bases, directly control your fighter wings, and achieve strategic victory in a simulation of asymmetric warfare against a technologically superior foe.

name: Power & Revolution 2023 Edition
short_description: The latest edition of the ultrarealistic world simulator where you play as the Head of State or as the opposition! New Additions: dive deeper into the war in the Ukraine with artillery, trenches, mines, troop morale, etc; detailed immigration management; the justice system; and children.

name: GOBLiiiNS5
short_description: GOBLiiiNS5 - The Invasion of the Morglotons Point'nClick adventure game in 2d. French and english version. 16 great levels full of puzzles, characters and humor.

name: Whispike Survivors - Sword of the Necromancer
short_description: Cultivate the strongest monster in this horde survivor farming game! Fight against waves of creatures to beef up your Whispike and use its seeds to create even stronger hybrids!

name: Fallen
short_description: Be the light that shines on the world by climbing to the top. The way up is never easy. Can you avoid all obstacles and climb to the top?

name: Queen of the Otaku: THERE CAN ONLY BE ONE
short_description: A short visual novel about a manga club torn between its two competing princesses.

name: Techtonica
short_description: Techtonica is a first-person factory automation game set beneath the surface of an alien planet. Work alone or in co-op to build factories, gather resources, research new technologies, mold the destructible terrain, establish a base of operations, and uncover long-forgotten secrets.

name: Please, Forgive Me
short_description: 'Please, Forgive Me' - is a psychological horror game that tells the creepy story of an overconfident realtor named Pavel. He needs to check the old apartment and rent it to a certain woman. This night will turn into a real nightmare for him.

name: Dream Swing
short_description: Grapple and air-strafe your way to the top of the Leaderboard in this fast-paced movement-based time trial. Collect as many candies as possible within 5 minutes as you dip and weave around the ruins in the sky. Can you handle the speed?

name: Piero's Pilgrimage
short_description: An simple exploration game where you walk a dog

name: Cantirium: God Slayer
short_description: A colorful metroidvania in which you must help catgirl save a world on the brink of destruction, honing your exploration and combat skills in epic battles to challenge the gods themselves!

name: Viewfinder
short_description: Challenge perception, redefine reality, and reshape the world around you with an instant camera. Viewfinder is a new single player game offering gamers hours of interesting and fun experiences while uncovering the mysteries left behind.

name: Piscirazzi: Fish Photo Shooter
short_description: Dive into Piscirazzi, an underwater photography roguelite! Take photos of exotic fish and choose upgrades to enhance your camera. Then review your stunning photos to improve your photography skills. Can you snap them all?

name: My Child Lebensborn Remastered
short_description: My Child Lebensborn is a story-driven nurture game based on real events. Play as the adoptive parent of Karin or Klaus, and experience the struggles they go through alongside them. Balance your time and resources wisely, while helping your child cope with the effects of hatred.

name: Re-Bounder
short_description: In this bouncy sequel, released in 1987 for the Commodore 64, take on the role of an eternally bouncing tennis ball once more, travelling over a surreal landscape, but now equipped with powerful weapons and tasked with saving the world from evil aliens!

name: Arcadegeddon
short_description: Rise up and play with up to three friends in this ever-evolving cooperative multiplayer, roguelite shooter. Explore multiple biomes, mini games, find hidden chests, and defeat numerous enemies and bosses.

name: Bullet Destroyer
short_description: Someone challenges himself and climbs a mountain, and someone climbs a beanstalk.

name: Roto Force
short_description: Shoot and dash your way through frantic missions! A twin-stick shooter set in a rotating world. Unlock weapons, move quickly and fight tons of bosses.

name: PuzzleSquare
short_description: A Chinese traditional ink-style puzzle game.

name: Lakeburg Legacies
short_description: Take fate into your own hands in Lakeburg Legacies, a social-based village management sim where love is your favourite resource. Play matchmaker to create the most effective, and most loved up, couples and help your kingdom thrive. How long will it take you to crown a sovereign?

name: Tea For God
short_description: God Emperor is held in a place beyond our world. Explore a huge strange complex while fighting hordes of robots. All while you keep walking around your room, bringing the immersion to another level. Customise your experience into an intense shooter, a roguelite explorer, a relaxing trek.

name: The Complex: Expedition
short_description: When an expedition with your team into the complex goes horribly wrong, you're left alone and lost, wandering the seemingly infinite maze of hallways, otherwise known as the Backrooms. Might there be something following you?

name: Around Us : Zombie Shooter
short_description: Around Us is a multiplayer cooperative zombie shooting game. There are various kinds of zombies and bosses. A lot of weapons and upgrades are waiting for you to unlock via waves. Try to survive the highest wave that no one ever reaches!

name: My Klutzy Cupid
short_description: In the midst of leading an ordinary life, I began to feel the urge to find myself a girlfriend. Yet somehow, I couldn't bring myself to take the first step. But one day... 'What's this...?' A single notebook had fallen right in front of me. 'Hey, you! Yes, you! Why aren't you picking it up?'

name: Gnome Enchanted Jigsaw Puzzles
short_description: 'Gnome Enchanted Jigsaw Puzzles' bring the whimsical world of gnomes to life! Discover the magic as you assemble pieces featuring vibrant, enchanting gnome realms. Ideal for both kids and adults, these puzzles offer a unique blend of challenge and charm. Perfect for a cozy evening indoors!

name: YEAH! YOU WANT "THOSE GAMES," RIGHT? SO HERE YOU GO! NOW, LET'S SEE YOU CLEAR THEM!
short_description: Cute and comical stickman characters have arrived for you to enjoy 'those games' you've seen and wanted to play before. Play a variety of minigames fully, thoroughly, and enjoyably to your heart's content!

name: Full Void
short_description: Full Void is a 2D Cinematic Puzzle Platformer set in a dystopian future. A young teenager, scared and alone, must use all their skills to defeat a rogue AI that keeps mankind oppressed.

name: Krzyżacy - The Knights of the Cross
short_description: A story-driven deckbuilding RPG set in the history of Krzyżacy - The Knights of the Cross. Unlike traditional deckbuilders, the teammates you recruit decide the success or failure of battles. Fight the war against the Teutonic, or tackle roguelite runs in this strategic deckbuilder unlike any other.

name: Monsters Idle RPG
short_description: Explore the world of Arcadius - a place filled with many types of mythical creatures - manage your creatures, items, capital, other resources and capture all creatures by battling in diverse biomes and places.

name: Keepers
short_description: Keepers is a space-themed clicker game. You are an employee of a center tasked with saving a planet - a typical light-year.

name: Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition
short_description: Plan your next move wisely, every additional combo can make the difference! Whether in solo or duo, online or offline, mix and match your units to defeat your enemies in this Definitive Edition of Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes!

name: STONKS-9800: Stock Market Simulator
short_description: Simulator of an 80s Japanese stock market businessman. Chill, catch a retro vibe and watch your profits grow in the text-based game STONKS-9800.

name: Fungal Colony Simulator
short_description: You are but a humble Mushroom farmer. You feel the need to farm mushrooms.

name: Cramped Room of Death
short_description: A puzzle adventure in close quarters! Use your spear to defeat enemies and collect treasure, but plan your moves carefully—each room has tight turns, deadly traps and no margin for error.

name: Zombie Exterminator
short_description: Zombie exterminator is a top-down shooter roguelite where you play a soldier. Combine weapon parts and create unique weapons. Use gadgets and relics to exterminate zombies. Fight against zombies and horrendous creatures.

name: Jeepney Simulator
short_description: Embrace your inner jeepney driver! Pick up passengers, calculate change, and weave through traffic in this Filipino-made driving game. Feed your family, customize your jeepneys, and unlock more rides! Don't forget to bring your towel!

name: Strange Investigations: Secrets can be Deadly Collector's Edition
short_description: Join Dane, the intrepid investigator, as she unravels the truth and grapples with what to believe in this haunting story from imagination to reality!

name: Private Property
short_description: Private Property - the brand new VR zombie shooter set at the end of the XIX century Montana provides endless hours of great fun! This coop multiplayer allows players to team up to jointly defend the Private Property from hordes of Zombies.

name: The Last Veggies
short_description: The Last Veggies is a 2d top-down shooter roguelite where you play as a farmer or his friends fighting hordes of monsters while trying to save humanity by delivering fresh veggies. Play different maps with different characters and an always changing set of Items and Upgrades.

name: Stillborn Slayer
short_description: Stillborn Slayer is a beautifully crafted pixel-art bullet hell action-roguelike game set in a cursed Dark Continent, with challenging boss fights, exploration, and complex combat. Master dodging and rolling skills to fight incomprehensible monsters and slay the Horned God to end the Curse.

name: Back alley chronicle
short_description: One summer afternoon, Saeki is invited by his friend Maeda to go to an old book festival. . . By chance, the self-proclaimed genius scientist Nanaban asked him to search for the lost book! A mysterious incident happens there!？It's that kind of story!

name: Lost Forest
short_description: Experience the beauty of nature and embark on a serene adventure in Lost Forest. Uncover the mysteries, find solace, and immerse yourself in this enchanting world. Are you ready to get lost?

name: Shaper
short_description: Shaper is an integrated 2D dungeon editor allowing you to create your own adventure. Create a dungeon with enemies, objects, decorations and share it with your friends and the community!

name: Doctor Cat
short_description: Reflect as you have fun with stories about a group of cats who after being cornered by the problems in there lives decide to go to Doctor Cat. Solve adorable jigsaws while uncovering the story of there patients

name: Tranquil Garden: Adventurer's Edition
short_description: Tranquil Garden: Adventurers Edition is a personable, easy-to-pick-up RPG with a Character-Driven Narrative that places you in control of Juniper the Hunter, accompanied by Cedar the Archer and Lily the Hero. And this new, definitive version of the game puts your journey in a whole new perspective!

name: Brewpub Simulator
short_description: Quit your day job, open a bar! Decorate the place, create your own beer and design your labels. Keep your kegs full and your customers happy, and never stop growing!

name: Gym Empire - Gym Tycoon Sim Management
short_description: Build the gym of your dreams in the first ever gym tycoon simulation management game. Gym Empire is the sim where you become a gym tycoon. Build, manage, hire staff and create your Gym Empire how you want. Will you build a commercial gym or specialise in a certain field? The choice is yours.

name: 开局一只蛋
short_description: The player plays as a strange animal, the opening of an egg, can hatch different strange animals, devour other strange animals continue to evolve. Fight off the friars who come to capture the alien, find and destroy the portal guarded by the friars to achieve the final victory of the game.

name: Magical Girl Dash
short_description: Magical Girl Dash is a retro arcade where you fight against the forces of evil in a runner style game. Protect the city and, most important of all, recover the stolen cakes from your favorite bakery!

name: Abnormal Status ~Tattoo / Prohibited Books / Parasites~
short_description: In the present day, the majority of the human race has become capable of using magic. The sudden rise of this power has not been met with adequate laws and regulations, and the world is rapidly becoming a wasteland as crimes and discrimination intensify.

name: 魔女的夜宴
short_description: 《魔女的夜宴》是日本超人气美少女游戏品牌YUZUSOFT（柚子社）的经典名作。女主角绫地宁宁由当红声优桐谷华配音，是该社历代作品中最具代表性的女主角之一。国际中文版拥有超越原版的1920X1080的高清画质。本作也曾在美少女游戏大赏和萌系游戏大赏中斩获众多奖项。

name: Sticky Business
short_description: Experience the joy of running your own cozy small business: Create stickers, pack orders and hear your customers’ stories. Time to build the cutest shop on the internet!

name: MAD WAY
short_description: MAD WAY is a game where you have to climb a strange universe without falling to find your love!

name: In the Village of Grandfather: Summer,Sun,Heat.
short_description: Harvest. Take care of the territory. Prepare the perfect vegetable garden.

name: Crystal Math
short_description: An infinite math runner with varying speeds and difficulty to test your skills.

name: Onka
short_description: Explore the mansion and escape in this 3D horror game. Solve the riddles and escape from the ghosts that roam the mansion!

name: SpeedOverflow
short_description: Who is not obsessed with the passion and pleasure brought by speed? This is an exhilarating roguelite hack-and-slash game with fast-paced action. You can choose different characters and level up to face hordes of enemies, embark on an unstoppable path, and conquer the unforgiving challenges!

name: Pick-a-Pocket
short_description: Stealth your way through Victorian-Era streets and Pickpocket your way to the top. Stay Vigilant as other thieves will be out and about, ready to steal your rewards or as easy marks to increase your stash. Avoid Bobbies, vanish from the light and disappear with your ill-gotten goods by day break.

name: Latte Stand Tycoon +
short_description: Use your barista skills and reflexes to mix the perfect latte and rebuild your family home and cafe to their former glory.

name: Carry Onward
short_description: Carry Onward is a narrative gameplay short that follows a grieving man as he packs up his home. Immerse yourself in his thoughts and emotions by interacting with items, which shape his internal state. Experience the transformative power of memories and the hope that arises from embracing change.

name: Feudal Friends
short_description: Produce your soldiers, Improve your equipment, Battle and Win in a chaotic castle! Build your team for 1-4 Online Co-op and PVE mode options! Determine your strategy with over 40 Rune options and be the first to destroy the opposing tower.

name: Froggy's Battle
short_description: Froggy's Battle is an action roguelike game set in a loop. Help Froggy the steezy magician skater frog defeat all the baddies squatting her favorite riding spot. Choose your upgrades carefully, become more and more powerful and kickflip yourself through waves of enemies and ferocious bosses!

name: Frank and Drake
short_description: Frank and Drake is a modern gothic tale that puts players at the heart of a supernatural mystery through its non-linear branching paths, mini-games and puzzles, and unique rotoscoped art. Take your time, explore, and soak up every word.

name: Breach In Space
short_description: Breach In Space is a 2D shooting game with challenging combat and very hard platforming. Find a way back to home galaxy through 4 different planets.

name: Demon Lord Reincarnation
short_description: Assemble a party, explore the dungeon, fight your way through hordes of monsters, and defeat the Demon Lord in this brutal dungeon crawler. Are you up to the challenge?

name: Pocket Academy 3
short_description: After 12 long years, we're back and bringing the school festival with us!

name: 沉默的蟋蟀
short_description: 《沉默的蟋蟀》是一款以斗蟋蟀为主题的“收集+养成”游戏。在一个叫做大夏国的地方，四季皆可斗蟋蟀，人人酷爱斗蟋蟀，斗蟋蟀是全民娱乐，更是最重要的产业之一。你可以去冲击天梯第一，也可以选择组建自己的蟋蟀战队去角逐全国联赛总冠军，更可以追求传说中的无双虫王！

name: To The Sky
short_description: To the Sky is an exhilarating action-adventure game where your goal is to reach the sky by overcoming obstacles and scaling towering walls. Be prepared to start anew if you fall while ascending. Challenge yourself, ascend higher, and uncover the mysteries above the clouds in To the Sky.

name: DROS
short_description: Discover the world of Dros, a beautifully detailed story-driven adventure about a slimy little creature and her human bounty hunter shell.

name: FUNG
short_description: UNLEASH THE LIVING PIXELS - Nurture your mesmerizing slime mold and dive into the depths of a radiation-soaked realm, harnessing its energy. Whatever you do, do not stop feeding the FUNG!

name: Coreborn: Nations of the Ultracore
short_description: A social survival game set in the open world of Ultracore. Build, grow and defend your town. Survive the elements and Sorgoth’s onslaught. Cooperate as you go on adventures to loot, gather resources, and make history. All of it together with friends old and new.

name: Red Line
short_description: Moving into a shabby apartment, a saturnine girl with hidden secrets finds a notebook that allows her to communicate with another world. A thrilling adventure taking place across multiple timelines ensues.

name: Purrfectly Hidden Cats - Kittenwood
short_description: Dive into 'Purrfectly Hidden Cats - Kittenwood', an engaging hidden object game brimming with elusive cats, interactive elements, and captivating mini-stories. Venture beyond whiskers in a world rich with surprises and discover the wonders of Kittenwood!

name: Shy Cats Hidden Orchestra
short_description: Shy Cats Hidden Orchestra is a hidden object game where you need to find musician cats that are embarassed to play their music. When you find them, they will play songs for you.

name: Train World
short_description: Train World is a railroad simulator that allows you to design, manage and operate your own railway network. Start at the dawn of railroad technology and evolve into a modern railroad company. Deliver cargo and transport passengers, open new regions and expand your network.

name: Toleo
short_description: Run, jump, slide, and flap your way through beautiful, hand-crafted worlds.

name: Devinica
short_description: A corporate artificial intelligence simulator.

name: 犬神ディフェンダーズ / Soul Dog TD
short_description: Fight alongside a dog in this tower defense game! Defeat foes and choose 1 of the 3 items they drop. Simple controls make the game easy to pick up and play, and before you know it you'll be hooked! Can you survive against 30 waves of enemies?

name: Battle 3D - Zombie Edition
short_description: Military strategy game with zombies. Handle your units from above or handle the unit you want individually. Edit your own missions by adding units wherever you want.

name: Nightmare Zapping
short_description: A horror channel browsing game where each channel holds a different nightmare to experience, explore them and find out the truth about what has happened in a small town where the inhabitants have disappeared.

name: 辩游记
short_description: 辩游记是第一款辩论主题角色扮演游戏。 玩家可以按自己的节奏，推动主线剧情、探索支线故事、训练和备赛。同时，游戏将复刻现实中的辩论环节如：立论、答盘、质询、对辩、总结，再加上各种趣味技能和小游戏，让玩家体验游戏化后的辩论人生。

name: Safari Pinball
short_description: Take a Safari through Africa in the most entertaining Pinball!

name: Bloodhound
short_description: Crush the cult of Astaroth and vanquish her hellspawn, make them squeal and hide where they came from. Enjoy a Fresh Look & Old Fun in this arcade horror FPS game inspired by the legends of the 90s.

name: Granny Remake
short_description: 'Granny Remake' is a scary horror game where you must escape from a sinister Granny. Test your wits, stealth, and survival skills in an intense, immersive experience. Navigate through a terrifying environment, feeling the suspense at every step.

name: Treasure Chest Clicker
short_description: Click your way to a fortune in Treasure Chest Clicker! Discover gold, level up and find all the rare treasures hidden inside the chests!

name: Kill The Cute
short_description: Kill The Cute is a gore 2D game about killing cute things for no reason. Choose the best character that suits you, capture their souls, discover the most powerful skill builds, upgrade your characters and unchain your cute agression!

name: Valiant
short_description: Valiant is a first person shooter game.

name: BlazingAngel Mistletear
short_description: Become a transforming heroine and use various attacks and sweet combos to defeat enemies and monsters, and save your younger sister in this side-scrolling action game!

name: Pulse Codex EP
short_description: Decode the control glyph and challenge strange entities in a short audiovisual composition / videogame hybrid.

name: Murder Is Game Over: Streaming Death
short_description: Embark on a thrilling pixel art adventure with Detective Guy & Cleo as they solve a mysterious murder. Explore an eerie seaside village, search for clues, interview suspects, and unravel the truth in this whodunit mystery.

name: Outer Space Shack
short_description: Build and manage space outposts on the Moon and Mars in this realistic simulation game. From the first step on the Moon to Mars colonization, launch rockets, take care of your astronauts and expand your base as you explore the cosmos. No grind, just pure management and exploration fun.

name: Super BAWK BAWK Chicken
short_description: Run, Jump, Dash, and Bawk your way through this quirky infinite runner. As a charming chicken with super powers, you’ll collect whacky items, catch rowdy rascals and soar to new highscores in Super BAWK BAWK Chicken!

name: The Immolate
short_description: You will be subjected to the savagery of the spirit possessed by the devil. Try to get out of the old house you were trapped in! Retro survival horror game in the 90s

name: The Adventures of Bluke Bifton: Chapter 1
short_description: The Adventures of Bluke Bifton is a hand-drawn, episodic adventure game set in a world of absolute absurdity. Ally (or make enemies) with a cast of strange characters, and make choices that determine your fate.

name: Punch Club 2: Fast Forward
short_description: You have come here to read game descriptions and play fighter management sims…and you’re all outta descriptions.

name: Trap Attack
short_description: TRAP ATTACK is a fast-paced arcade game. Use your teleporter to move around the levels and try to avoid the traps. Traps will increase in number and in difficulty over time. Test your reflexes, survive as long as you can. How long can YOU last?

name: Obscure Chronicle of Dynasty
short_description: 这是一款「虚构的，但也应当是合理的」剧情向战棋类游戏，又似可将它看作是一段异位面的三国历史。因而诸君或将发现，游戏前期的剧情尚可称作较为熟知的三国故事，但是剧情愈后，和本位面差别愈大。许多在正史上着墨甚少乃至寥寥数笔的人物，亦可能在这段迥异的时空中绽放出别样的光芒。

name: My Friendly Neighborhood
short_description: Something scary is happening with everyone's favorite Saturday morning puppet show, The Friendly Neighborhood! Play as Gordon, a repairman sent to get to the bottom of this disturbing dilemma. Fend off puppets and solve puzzles in this survival horror adventure.

name: AI Olympius
short_description: Join forces with rebels and their technologies to have a chance to restore freedom in a world that has fallen to the uncontrolled dominance of supreme artificial intelligence.

name: West Ride
short_description: Explore a mysterious world, conquer challenges in West Ride, an anime-inspired open-world driving game full of excitement and adventure.

name: Bloodecay
short_description: A deadly plague known as erosion broke out in the land of Elworth. It corrupted all life, bringing pain and destruction – Idonia, as the knight accepting the bloodthirsty imprint set out on a path to redemption, exterminating plague minions and destroying ancient evils

name: Outliver: Tribulation
short_description: Outliver: Tribulation is a story-driven survival horror action game set in a supernatural realm of African mythology about a soldier on the run who mysteriously finds herself in the middle of an ancient ritual.

name: Gluua
short_description: first-person 1-4 multiplayer horror game. The game will allow players to take on the role of a spirit liberator who will be able to freely choose missions based on the difficulty and readiness they like or want to do. Players will encounter the supernatural and find the truth in that place.

name: Trance, Trauma
short_description: A woman has killed herself. Uncover why in 3 surreal hexagon rooms. Trance, Trauma is a point-and-click narrative puzzle game set during the aftermath of a tragic incident, where you play as the soul of a victim - seconds before her death.

name: FLOWFALL
short_description: Unique puzzle/arcade game where you must fit the correct shapes into the correct gates as you fall.

name: Stack Stones
short_description: STACK STONES, a physics based multiplayer stacking and party game with multiple game modes. Enjoy playing alone to beat your former best mark or compete against others in funny multiplayer matches ... but watch out for your opponents, they want to smash your stack!

name: GoreBox
short_description: Extremely violent Physics-based sandbox game with lots of custom content, active ragdoll physics and gore for fun, killing time, and stress relief.

name: Rocket Horizon
short_description: Rocket Horizon is a game where you control a rocket to dodge obstacles on different planets.

name: Gunsmith Simulator
short_description: Become a Gunsmith and unveil the great pleasure of working in your own workshop! Repair, restore and personalize guns to make unique pieces that every firearm lover will appreciate.

name: 废土华夏Wasteland of East
short_description: A Chinese style wasteland pixel style role-playing game. The combat mode is turn based combat chess. Can collect resources to manufacture weapons and props. Play the role of an expatriate comrade performing a mission on the abandoned soil of Huaxia.

name: eSheep
short_description: Discover a magical world on your screen! Our adorable animated sheep will bring joy and adventure to your everyday life. With fluffy wool and adorable button eyes, it will enchant you. Get the animated sheep and experience unique entertainment on your desktop!

name: Linia Super
short_description: Linia Super is a mesmerizing puzzle game where you’ll go hunting for color sequences, drawing a line to create the correct connection between the different shapes on the screen.

name: Cross Tails
short_description: What will the tails witness after a crossing tale? A tactical RPG that portrays a fantasy story of a war between the canine and the feline tribes playable from both points of view.

name: Folcroft Monastery
short_description: You've been hired by an outfit known as SMS Group to retrieve an artifact lost somewhere inside the abandoned Folcroft Monastery. Locals say the place is haunted by restless spirits, but the pay was too good to pass up. You asked little questions. Find the artifact requested and get out alive.

name: The Shell Part I: Inferno
short_description: Unravel a string of gruesome murders terrorizing Tokyo in this mystery-thriller visual novel. The secrets of a case from six years prior may just be the key to the current unending cycle of tragedy—and the thing that cracks this woeful world’s shell may be one girl’s smile.

name: I commissioned some unicorns
short_description: I paid more artists to hide unicorns and wands in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

name: Great Ambition of the SLIMES
short_description: A tactical simulation game where you make slimes take over humans to fight your battles! You have weak, weak slimes under your command. But what if they have the ability to occupy human bodies? Lend your wisdom to the slimes and help them take over the world!

name: Trippy's Disc Golf
short_description: Trippy's Disc Golf: Immerse yourself in an open-world environment and conquer challenging courses. Throw discs, master precision, and explore stunning landscapes.

name: Micro
short_description: Se aventure nas profundezas do mar com um Micro-ondas humanoide e um vírus falante. Nesta aventura, você deve descobrir como voltar para a casa do seu criador, mas para isso terá que enfrentar muitos desafios, de peixes metralhadora a polvos sniper.

name: Sentimental Death Loop
short_description: Just as you begin to settle in for a fun day at your best friend's house, something changes in her and she kills you. And not just once—she ends your life time and time and time again.Your goal is to escape from this endless loop of despair.

name: Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart
short_description: Blast your way through an interdimensional adventure with Ratchet and Clank – now on PC! Help them take on an evil emperor from another reality as you jump between action-packed worlds and beyond at hyper-speed!

name: What Lies Between
short_description: Transported to a new world, jump and dash your way across the strange land to return home!

name: Recordance
short_description: Recordance is a sci-fi themed first person shooter game. Utilize experimental weapon systems and vehicles to defeat an unknown enemy across multiple environments. Unlock new weapon systems and customise your droid and vehicles as you battle towards victory!

name: Gravity
short_description: Gravity is a challenging, physics-based puzzle game. Move objects around then turn Gravity on. Beat each level by getting the red ball to the exit. Get there quickly to unlock prizes.

name: KnightMan
short_description: Knight Man is a 2d Pixel-art retro style platformer. Play As Knightman, a heroic warrior who has taken it upon himself to save the 5 realms from the clutches of evil. Traverse through 20 hand-crafted levels across 5 unique zones, each populated by a variety of enemies and hazards.

name: Let's School
short_description: Dive into the exhilarating role of a headmaster entrusted to revive your alma mater! Beyond just bricks and mortar, train teachers, recruit students. Sculpt your school into a unique educational haven! Let's School!

name: The Old House
short_description: A little story about returning to The Old House.

name: Whispers in the West - Co-op Murder Mystery
short_description: Whispers in the West is a point-and-click murder mystery game that supports online co-op for 1-4 players. Each story is an hour-long intriguing mystery waiting to be solved. You can either work solo or team up with your friends to solve the cases. Things may get heated!

name: Remnant II
short_description: Remnant II pits survivors of humanity against new deadly creatures and god-like bosses across terrifying worlds. Play solo or co-op with two other friends to explore the depths of the unknown to stop an evil from destroying reality itself.

name: HYPER METEOR
short_description: YOU ARE LOST IN SPACE! ALL WEAPONS ARE DOWN! Survive by ramming your ship into meteors and hostile forces.

name: Elite Status: Platinum Concierge
short_description: Find the unfindable and do the impossible? It’s all in a day’s work for you. As a concierge, how far will you go to make billionaires’ dreams come true?

name: THE LAST BREATH
short_description: Survive the post-apocalypse world. There's a predator who's going after you. This is Online and local party games enjoyed by 1 to 5 players. you have to Survive in an end-of-life world.

name: The Banished Vault
short_description: A strategy game of exploration, endurance, and space travel on an interstellar gothic monastery. Explore solar systems, harvest resources, construct outposts, and face hazards in the challenging universe of The Banished Vault.

name: Hop Step Sing! Shikiri Shiishiba - By My Side
short_description: This time the concept is “Let’s hold hands”. While on a date with Shikiri by the seaside in midsummer, you can hold her hands, take photos and create a dream-like VR music video that fans will not be able to resist.

name: Mystery Box: The Journey
short_description: Welcome to the 4th chapter of the popular 'Mystery Box' puzzle game series! 10 new boxes full of enigmas to crack are waiting for you on this journey through lost worlds.

name: The Frozen Garden
short_description: The Frozen Garden is a short third-person horror game inspired by classic survival horror that will immerse you in an intriguing and unsettling world.

name: Night&Scape
short_description: Night&Scape is a cooperative board game for up to 4 players. Explore the world of dream, find dream's shard and escape ! The fate of this world is up to you.

name: Green Squares
short_description: Pure Simple Physics Fun. Challenge yourself in a chaotic and colourful time trial where there are green squares, that need to be not green!

name: PixelJunk™ Scrappers Deluxe
short_description: Clean up the streets of Junktown as a team of robot garbage collectors. Trash your opponents with up to 4 players or go it alone in this beat ‘em up that’s also a clean ‘em up!

name: Explore the backrooms
short_description: A backrooms game full of story puzzles, monsters and places to explore

name: キラーの謎 -QUEST OF KILLER-
short_description: 2Dタイプのアクション系RPG。VC++で白紙から完全手打ちで自力のみで約2万行のプログラムを組んで作成。グラフィックも音楽もオリジナル。

name: The Future Project
short_description: Take control of an AI soldier, explore planets, and partake in fast paced combat in The Future Project, a first person metroidvania. Explore distinct worlds, obtain new weapons and abilities, and defeat powerful enemies in humanity's quest to journey the stars.

name: One Deck Galaxy
short_description: Roll your dice and cleverly use them to build up your civilization from its humble homeworld, growing to create a Federation spanning countless star systems.

name: Cast
short_description: In a small projection, trapped within a cage. Keys and destination lie scattered, to the west and east. High walls are easy to climb, spikes hard to evade. Switching from three dimensions to two, a path is found unobstructed.

name: Smash Dungeon
short_description: Smash Dungeon is a brutal, dark, intense, action rogue-like. Hack and slash your way through the procedurally generated dungeons on your own or in couch co-op, using a combination of armor & weapons upgrades, passive items and power-ups to kill everything in your path to claim the riches below.

name: FRACTALS OF DESTINY
short_description: Fractals of Destiny is an Hybrid RPG with a epic story that is mixed by the best features from action RPGs and classic RPGs with blends them seamlessly. Feel the vibes in the world that mixed by magic and futuristic

name: Super Catboy
short_description: Super Catboy is an action-packed platformer created in a high-bit pixel art style, combining the best elements of the golden 16-bit platformer era of the 90s with some ‘pawsome’ new mechanics! And let’s not forget; there’s plenty of CAT CONTENT!

name: Rat Catcher
short_description: Embark on a perilous journey as a fearless rat catcher in this nostalgic 90's-inspired dungeon crawler horror game. Explore dark and treacherous dungeons, facing off against horrifying monsters and collecting an array of eerie rats. Can you survive the darkness and emerge as the ultimate hero?

name: Sakura Bunny Girls
short_description: An action visual novel with a splash of fanservice about a security guard who gets entangled with three mysterious, attractive, seductive bunny girls who just so happen to have superhuman powers.

name: Jump Tracks
short_description: Action! Danger! Coins! What more could you want from a game?! Jump Tracks is a game all about timing and reflexes. Zoom off the tracks, clear each level, and try not to die along the way in this tiny and twitchy arcade tapper. It's harder than it looks! Good luck!

name: Star Quest
short_description: Star Quest is a third person single player game that integrates space exploration, flight driving, action puzzle solving, and gunfight shooting. The game is developed with Unreal Engine 5 . In the vast universe, you can start this exciting journey by driving your own spaceship.

name: The Deadlands
short_description: The Deadlands, is a haunting journey of vengeance. Conquer undead horrors, face formidable bosses, and harness their souls to save your son from an evil necromancer. Pixel art meets gothic aesthetic in this intense, captivating metroidvania.

name: Asura's Trial
short_description: Learn new skills based on simple key combinations in this easy to learn, hard to master adventure RPG. Combine over 100 different skills from 5 diverse classes to create an unbeatable combination and reclaim your body by finishing Asura's Trial.

name: Grisaia Chronos Rebellion
short_description: The newest installment in the Grisaia visual novel series. All of the girls from Mihama, past and present, must face off against a new evil terrorist organization in an all-out war.

name: Music Store Simulator
short_description: With Music Store Simulator you can lead a musical instruments manufacturing company. Create, sell, earn and reinvest improving and developing your business. Expand your Brand and climb to success in order to become the world's largest manufacturer of musical instruments!

name: Forest Frenzy
short_description: Shoot to survive, shoot em' up, score attack! A wave based shooter where you must buy weapons and upgrades to survive! Get local high scores or compete on steam leaderboards!

name: Civic Story
short_description: When a sudden election rocks the country, whose side are you on? In Civic Story, you'll encounter colourful characters and situations that show how the upcoming election affects you, your colleagues, and the nation in this funny and insightful 8-chapter Visual Novel parody of our world today.

name: Samurai Kento
short_description: Play as Kento, an Elder Samurai, and face the evil Yokai in this 2D pixelated mini action RPG set in Feudal Japan based scenarios!

name: Nonorelia
short_description: A logic puzzle game and sci-fi visual novel rolled into one. Solve nonograms to overcome obstacles as Noah Von Sterne struggles to save his colony and reunite his family, or unwind and sharpen your mind with our relaxing Picture, Random, and ASMR Modes.

name: ○ △ □ -circle triangle square-
short_description: Puzzle game using three types of objects (○, △, and □) to solve problems

name: Achievement Display Cabinet
short_description: Achievement Display Cabinet is a casual game with 3 built-in mini games.You can earn Steam achievements by completing game tasks and decorate your Steam personal homepage with these achievements.

name: Last Bloody Snack
short_description: Last Bloody Snack tells the story of a boy named Cody, who suffers from severe psychological disorders and has visions of a monster that will try to eliminate everything he hates. The game explores a strong theme, focusing on maternal responsibility.

name: Driving Strikers
short_description: Driving Strikers is a 2.5D car football extravaganza in a 90s-style! Play 4-player matches across 5 different stadiums with wildly different and beautiful environments!

name: Beacon's Bluff
short_description: Beacon's Bluff is a 2D pressure puzzler with horror elements. Keep the beacon's light alive and survive your shift by solving intriguing puzzles. Become engrossed in this discerning horror puzzler -- Beacon's Bluff is the first in the Story Machine Shorts series.

name: 互联网大亨 Internet tycoon
short_description: At the dawn of the Internet Age, could the player take up the role of a dauntless entrepreneur and establish the most successful internet company? When the player becomes CEO, will they still treat their employees well or have a change of heart?

name: Full Moon Rush
short_description: Take on a howling challenge in Full Moon Rush! This classic shoot 'em up is a bullet hell masterpiece with a boss rush twist. With 10 epic battles and old-school graphics, you'll need expert shooting skills to survive. Customizable health and Assist Mode make it accessible to all.

name: Grandma's Legacy VR – The Mystery Puzzle Solving Escape Room Game
short_description: Mystery, puzzle solving, challenges and secrets surround your grandmother's disappearance. Explore the different rooms and unravel the unsolved secret that your grandma keeps in Grandma’s Legacy. Check our first escape room experience in VR.

name: 夕照原
short_description: 《夕照原》是一款另类的殖民地建设游戏，作为一名普通市民，你无法操纵他人，只能依靠自己的努力，去创造影响。 但请相信，城市不会辜负于你。

name: Thematic Solitaire: Noir
short_description: Thematic Solitaire is a series of classic solitaire games (Klondike) with different settings depending on the style. In the Noir edition, sit back and relax while playing Solitaire with a noir atmosphere, listening to great jazz on a rainy night.

name: Tsukisas Arena
short_description: The laboratory you've just joined as an assistant is on the verge of closure...! To save the lab, engage in a slapstick science adventure game (with occasional action elements) with 'Prof. Shiika', who is a genius but a social misfit!

name: Arcadian Atlas
short_description: Arcadian Atlas is a Tactical RPG about the choices people make for love and power, and how those decisions tear a kingdom apart.

name: Ikkarus and the Prince of Sin
short_description: A Yaoi slice-of-life about making drinks, meeting peculiar bartenders, and hunting cute monsters. Follow Ikkarus, a gallant legendary hero, and get ready to meet Damian, a gentle archer; Orakh, an orc war chief, and Zistran, the prince of the underworld.

name: One Life - Parkour Project
short_description: One Life - Parkour Project is an exhilarating Parkour & FreeRunning video game that challenges players to push their physical abilities to the limit in an urban environment. The game is designed to be challenging, and players will need to hone their parkour skills to make progress.

name: Koa and the Five Pirates of Mara
short_description: Join Koa and Napopo on a 3D platformer adventure through the islands of Mara! Outwit traps, explore the ocean, maneuver dangerous environments, and have fun in 8 wild worlds on their quest to recover stolen pirate loot.

name: Uptown Outbreak
short_description: Use your driving and battling skills to defeat the virus and restore the game to its former glory.

name: Super Intern Story
short_description: Super Intern Story is a fun little adventure about working as a monster in a video game. Wear different costumes, get slain by heroes all while getting yelled at by your boss! Discover the joys of working behind the scene — as an unpaid intern in the game industry!

name: Simantik
short_description: Survival first-person shooter in an anti-utopian world with steampunk elements. Explore the map, enter every house, complete quests, communicate with other characters, and a large arsenal of unusual weapons and abilities that you will receive during the passage will help you survive.

name: Lethal Crisis  Proto Sphere リーサルクライシスプロトスフィア
short_description: 最速の飛翔感を自負するアクション『リーサルクライシス』が ローグ系ランダムダンジョンを引っ提げてリニューアル!! ■攻撃・防御・エアダッシュが一体となった 　「アサルト」を軸に、 　ハイスピードで爽快なアクションバトルはそのままに 　今回はローグダンジョンシステムを採用! 　重力ありでも空中戦が得意だからこそ 　どこにゴールがあろうが問題なく突き進める! 　ランダムダンジョンを周回しながら力を蓄え 　プロトスフィアに潜む強敵達を撃破せよ! ■今回は新たな切り札、空間兵器スフィアタイラントも登場! 　敵を自分の空間にまきこんで、有利なルール下で撃破せよ!

name: DERE. Some Answers Before I...
short_description: Come back, for no one is waiting for you. Search for your memories - no one ever knew you. Destroy everything in your path - all around you are nothing but ruins. End the endless cycle, for it has long since closed in on itself.

name: Super Raft Boat Together
short_description: The world's been flooded. All you have left is your Super Raft Boat… and your friends! Work together to expand your raft while fending off the strangely violent (and wealthy??) creatures of the sea in this multiplayer roguelike shooter. Will your crew survive and reach the Final Island?

name: Basalt Breaker
short_description: Basalt Breaker is a fresh, 3rd person, isometric take on a beloved puzzle game. Explore classic rooms, perfect your skills on replay-able daily puzzles, or try uniquely shaped custom floors. The perfect comfort game to play while queuing for a match or sitting through a tedious meeting.

name: Pseudoregalia
short_description: Deep within the realm of sleep, Sybil finds herself pulled to a distorted castle. Grow strong, and unlock new abilities to build up a deep movement system, fight enemies, find secrets, and free the weary soul of Castle Sansa, in this retro-inspired 3D Platformer Metroidvania.

name: Bengbo
short_description: A crazy roguelike shooter where being on a roll and rolling dice is synonymous. Upgrade yourself and battle mechanical adversities in a corrupt casino set in a future Sweden!

name: Manager can be Tough!: Case of the Kidnapped Waitress
short_description: Hack, slash, and blast your way through hordes of beastly enemies and powerful bosses to rescue your beautiful waitress in this sexy 2D Side scrolling action game!

name: Delivery INC
short_description: Delivery INC is a fast-paced time management game where you’ll be challenged with quick decision making and planning. Build a fleet of vehicles and drivers. Make deliveries before the customer’s patience runs out. Put your logic and delivery skills to the test in any real-world city.

name: Double Beauty
short_description: Players need to move the puzzle pieces and combine them together in the right way to restore two complete pictures of beautiful women. After completing the level, the player will be rewarded with two beautiful pictures of beautiful women.

name: The Ninja Saviors: Return of the Warriors
short_description: Alluring audio! Pixel art perfection! Beat-em up beauty! Discover how hard a 32,000kg ninja hits with The Ninja Saviours!

name: SIZIF
short_description: SIZIF is a 3D endless runner where you simply control a ball and avoid obstacles to generate score for the longest time possible and climb the leaderboard. During a game you can unlock bonuses to either make your run easier or generate more score.

name: Doug's Nightmare
short_description: Defeat enemies and epic bosses, unlock new weapons and skins. Help Doug overcome his anxiety and demons. All that and more in this cartoony, hand-drawn Bullet Hell.

name: Undaunted Normandy
short_description: Play the acclaimed World War 2 deck-building game. Use your cards to seize the initiative, bolster your forces, or control your troops on the battlefield. You will face intense resistance, machine gun fire, and mortar bombardment, but a great commander can turn the situation to their advantage!

name: 东方妖精武踏会 - Touhou Fairy Knockout ~ One fairy to rule them all
short_description: You will role-play as playful fairies with unique personalities, and accomplish your own Gekokujō in Gensokyo where the strong gather! Make your own favorite fairy character the strongest with your own hands!

name: SPECTRE
short_description: Employ stealth tactics as the Spectres, or defend your objectives as the heavily armed Reapers in this thrilling teamwork-driven multiplayer action experience!

name: Zombie Hunter: D-Day
short_description: The apocalypse is here. Zombies flood in from all sides. You have 80 days until the rescue team arrives. Your desperate struggle for survival begins now!

name: Droidmals: Lavanlier Town
short_description: A classic JRPG with a horror setting and collectible creatures. Delve into abandoned buildings, shady woods and secret laboratories to recover all the creatures before it's too late!

name: Vicious Star: kill All
short_description: 'Vicious Star' is an engaging turn-based strategy game, thrusting you into the role of a village guardian fighting intense battles. Within the game, you'll assemble your team, mixing and matching various characters and runes, and deploying unique skills to obliterate the monsters menacing your home.

name: Terminal 81
short_description: Thanks to the financial crisis of 2008, Lorena migrated to Terminal 81 to work, but what seemed like a simple Latin American neighborhood, it was a dangerous region dominated by a mysterious criminal organization that carries out murders, kidnappings and human trafficking.

name: Lunacy: Saint Rhodes
short_description: Lunacy: Saint Rhodes is a first-person survival horror game. Explore your dark family history and experience a gut-wrenching feeling of terror. You are being watched; never alone, never safe.

name: Sanfu
short_description: 2000年，山城市新闻频道的电视画面莫名跳出一则旧广告，而广告的代言人是已经去世的特异功能少年——三眼神童。有传闻三眼神童的亡魂劫持了电视信号。 调查局受命展开调查。随着调查的深入，一个藏在黑暗处的犯罪团伙逐渐浮出水面。

name: Keep Killing
short_description: This is an alternative game where you only need to live to fight, fight to live

name: End of Edge
short_description: End of Edge is a hardcore wuxia action game

name: Furquest
short_description: A cute and cozy RPG where every enemy has their own unique minigame, and where there are two sides to every soul: Main and Invert!

name: Sinned
short_description: Sinned is a fast-paced retro FPS game situated within the darkest depths of hell where you will fight demonic legions and Pandemonius, Lord of Hell himself!

name: Demonic Supremacy
short_description: Demonic Supremacy is an old school 3D shooter with a certain nostalgic flavour and few gamer-friendly features. It offers several hours of hurricane gameplay rocking through memorable levels with the explosive heavy metal soundtrack!

name: Hamboy : AutoChess Survivor
short_description: Hamboy is a rogue-like arena shooting game where you fight against aliens by strategically combining 12 attributes and 10 types of weapons to create synergies. As the waves increase, you'll realize that you shouldn't spend gold recklessly.

name: Komorebi
short_description: A fully voice acted story about a group of friends who experience visions of their future - and the anxieties they endure as they try to walk their own path in a predestined life. All while living under the watchful eyes of the ever-present Argus Corporation.

name: Mix Universe
short_description: Mix Universe is a unique musical sandbox game that puts you in the role of a Mixonaut tasked with creating and sharing musical vibes throughout the universe called mixes. All mixes are built in-game and play 100% real-time based on their connections.

name: Forklift Simulator 2023
short_description: Start your job in this realistic forklift simulator. Experience realistic controls, intricate maneuvering, and precise cargo handling. Complete missions, master different forklift models, and prove your skills in this immersive simulation game.

name: The Books Tale: A hop adventure!
short_description: The Books Tale: A Hop Adventure is a game where you help Verbum save a library from creatures that threaten the interdimensional knowledge books. Overcome levels in a world made of blocks and explore unimaginable worlds to gather the energy necessary to purify them.

name: MAKABAKA
short_description: This is a Third-person pronoun grass cutting game, a unique magic girl theme game, with the background set in a mysterious autumn forest. The player will play the role of a magical girl with a natural magical talent, facing the threat of ghoul appearing in the forest

name: Xuan-Yuan Sword: Mists Beyond the Mountains
short_description: This Game is one of the most popular RPGs in the Chinese Speaking Area and has won many awards around Asia. The game story takes place in an era of collision between East and West, covering a wide range, spanning Eurasia, the Arab World, Francia, and China.

name: Mr. Run and Jump
short_description: Help Mr. Run and Jump defeat the terrifying Void and collect all of the Power Gems from the Realms of Color! Venture through a dazzling and dangerous world, dodging countless enemies and conquering hundreds of fierce platforming challenges to save the day!

name: 蒼い夏休み
short_description: マルチエンド謎解きアドベンチャー。 突然姿を消した女の子を見つけるために、残されたノートパソコンを調べよう！

name: Double Dragon Gaiden: Rise Of The Dragons
short_description: The Double Dragon brothers return in this fresh addition to the iconic beat 'em up franchise. With roguelite elements, every playthrough is a chance at new action. Tag in with 2 of 4 starter characters or unlock 9 additional characters, each with their own special moves and unique playstyles.

name: Probo Rush
short_description: Probo Rush is a classic shoot 'em up bullet hell game with a boss rush twist. Fight against machines, aliens, and nature as you take on ten challenging boss battles. With adjustable health and an Assist Mode, Probo Rush offers a challenging but accessible gaming experience.

name: Otok
short_description: This is a very chill Sandbox 'City Builder', No Goals, just build your island as beautifully as you can with the given buildings.

name: Only Climb: Better Together
short_description: Tired of sitting on the ground? Take a sky-high journey with your friends in Only Climb: Better Together! Touch the clouds with your own hands and find out what's behind them, but remember, there are no easy paths…

name: Moka Future
short_description: ⟪末卡未来⟫是一款2d像素风格的俯视角类幸存者游戏。末卡大陆正在遭受魔物的入侵，你必须抵御魔物一波又一波的进攻……

name: 魔界堕ちのラズリエル -Lazriel: The Demon's Fall-
short_description: Lazriel, an angel of heaven, has been plunged into the demon world far below. Now her only hope of returning is for her to climb the tower. But will she succumb to the demons' powers before she makes it back alive?

name: Bounce & Roll
short_description: Control and guide the ball through a series of obstacles, testing your skills and abilities in a 3D environment, either solo or with a friend.

name: Murder At The House
short_description: 11 people trapped in an old abandoned house together. 8 Innocents. One Detective. One Murderer. You are either the murderer or detective. You must interrogate suspects and find clues in order to solve the mystery, before it is too late.

name: Crimson Tactics: The Rise of The White Banner
short_description: Crimson Tactics: The Rise of The White Banner brings you an epic adventure in the form of a turn-based tactical RPG. Set in a medieval high fantasy world, witness a massive political disruption through the lives of different characters and fight for the fate of Wendalle.

name: Bloxs
short_description: Bloxs is a 3rd person 3D platformer game where your goal is to collect as many coins as possible to win a house.

name: Supreme Ruler 2030
short_description: Rise to power as any modern day country in a realistic military, political and economic simulation. Command your country's diplomacy, espionage, and resource management to strengthen your position. Use real-time tactical control of your military to fortify your place as the Supreme Ruler.

name: Swapshot
short_description: In Swapshot, you take control of this fearless protagonist, equipped with an incredible teleportation gun. Your mission is to overcome a series of challenges in a world filled with 2D platforms and intriguing puzzles.

name: Super Box Delivery: Beyond the Horizon
short_description: Get ready to hop into the driver's seat and embark on an epic journey like no other in Super Box Delivery: Beyond the Horizon!

name: Alfredo's Sneaky Meal
short_description: Alfredo's Sneak Meal is a stealth platform arcade game where, armed only with a frying pan, you have to help Alfredo get his meal in a building full of zombies and bats.

name: 主动防御(Active Defense)
short_description: This is a strategy tower defense game where players need to choose the appropriate defense towers based on different maps and enemies. The game also offers a variety of defense towers, maps, and an endless mode waiting to be unlocked by the players!

name: Miko Melee
short_description: Fight monsters and keep the village safe!

name: Heist Force
short_description: Single-player 3rd-person action heist game. Infiltrate banks, outmaneuver enemies, execute high-stakes heists. Engage in intense shootouts, utilize diverse weapons, navigate dynamic environments. Can you become the ultimate Heist Force?

name: Nine Nights
short_description: 《Nine Nights》is an indie hardcore action-adventure game. You will become the killer Ci Lang, escape and fight back in the crisis-ridden world of Nine Nights. You have to rely on the high martial arts skills tenacious fighting, struggling to lead to the road to revenge.

name: ハクスラダンジョンⅢ
short_description: 【Genre】 Huxla RPG Character make-up (more than 500 face glamour) + Occupation selection (20 occupations) Enchantment synthesis Sub-event Collectors will love the Armor Book and more! Huxla lovers will love the many features throughout the game! Create your own party and enjoy the Huxla experience!

name: Endlight
short_description: Releases Friday July 28, 2023. Break through and outlast shifting, twisting, chaos. Dodging is for cowards, start SMASHING.

name: Native Hunter
short_description: Inspired by an existing indigenous tribe, where they live on an island called 'North Sentinel Island'. Native Hunter gives the player the possibility of living the experience in the body of an indigenous person completely isolated from society, just like the Sentinelese do.

name: Office Girls and Games
short_description: In this Visual Novel, you'll join Chloe and Jessie in the popular mobile game, Isekai Online. Eliminate arguments and disagreements in this strange duo and lead them to victory!

name: Nifa's First Mission
short_description: It's up to the young knight Nifa to save her village! Will she be able to do it?

name: Sugar Sweet Temptation
short_description: On the whimsical Night of the Fairies, Crow Yamada lands on the rooftop of a quaint patisserie known as Folkroll. Without any memories, he strives to help the cute employees by becoming the best baker around in this sugary sweet visual novel.

name: Time Bandit – Part 1: Appendages of the Machine
short_description: A who̴͊leso̶̬̙̍me real-time adventure with a dark secret. At your relaxing new job managing resources and collecting crystals, everything you do seems to take ... much, MUCH longer than it should. In retro 3D cutscenes, uncover a company's conspiracy--and sneak around at work to steal back your time.

name: Elysium Trials
short_description: Skill-based Fantasy Shooter on rails with an Epic touch, how you defeat enemies matter! Shoot, unleash powerful lightning magic, and Dragons, beware of dragons as you battle through 8 unique enemies all with unique attacks in vastly different worlds with an epic fantasy rock/metal soundtrack.

name: CONCLUSE 2 - The Drifting Prefecture
short_description: Concluse 2 is an atmospheric horror game which takes place immediately after the events of Concluse. It holds to the atmosphere of the first while introducing combat and more..

name: Arms Evolution: ZOMBIE DESTROYER
short_description: 'Arms Evolution: ZOMBIE DESTROYER' is a unique Roguelite tower defense game. You will slaughter thousands of zombies in the game and enhance your weapon towers through build character in the RPG way. and , the game also offers an idle mode, so you can enjoy building weapons anytime and anywhere.

name: Mega City Police
short_description: Retrowave Skill-Based Action Roguelike about tough cops fighting crime and keeping peace the old-fashioned way. Choose your cop and dive into hardcore action against enemies and bosses using a huge arsenal and special abilities that will define your playstyle. The law will make crime bleed.

name: Boomeraxe
short_description: Who says a twin-stick shooter needs guns? Boomeraxe is a bullet hell dungeon crawler with a unique core mechanic: Your only weapon hurts you too.

name: Rightfully, Beary Arms
short_description: Rightfully, Beary Arms is a bullet hell roguelite that is about much more than collecting loot, dying and losing everything. Carefully choose enemy upgrades against your own, then plan your dungeon crawl tactfully to gun through unique factions of enemies, strategically preserving loot after death.

name: The Black Pepper Crew
short_description: Assemble your crew, gear them up and fight creatively on this easy to learn but hard to master turn-based tactical roguelite. Capture the most dangerous bounties in the city, cash that juicy bounty and improve your chances of survival on a city filled with crime and jazzy grooves.

name: Touchly Volumetric VR Video Player
short_description: Touchly is the next evolution of the VR video player. Turn videos into volumetric, immersive experiences.

name: Flock of the Low God VR
short_description: This combat-based survival horror VR game immerses you in the terrifying world of the feature film MALUM as you attempt to survive the last shift in a decommissioned police station while fighting off a violent cult & their demonic creatures. Play Single Player or Co-Op VR & prepare for Hell!

name: USC: Counterforce
short_description: Lead your Space Commandos in an epic revival of turn-based squad tactics inspired by the likes of UFO/XCOM, Space Hulk, and Aliens, featuring in-depth skill & combat systems and multiple game modes. Discover the truth behind the demise of colony MC83-A and join the USC in defending humanity

name: Antkeep
short_description: A living ant tower defense, upgrade abilities to increase competitiveness. Combine different ant species to form an aerial defense and kamikaze attacks. Deploy ants to collect honey. Breed ants to expand your territory and compete against red fire ants to save the natural environment of the island.

name: Xanthiom Zero
short_description: Play as Captain Grisham, and uncover the secrets of Planet 4-514 in this thrilling prequel to Side Scape!

name: Access Denied: Escape
short_description: Access Denied: Escape is a puzzle game where you have to hack data vaults and interact with various devices to escape.

name: Too Many Sheep
short_description: Too Many Sheep might be the ultimate sheep herding game. Work together with up to 4 players navigating challenging courses or compete with each other to herd your sheep the fastest. Too Many Sheep offers fun for players of all levels. Will you collaborate or compete? Play Too Many Sheep to find out!

name: Offroad Mechanic Simulator
short_description: Service off-road vehicles and take them for a drive! Offroad Mechanic Simulator lets you modify many classic off-road vehicles and prepare them for daunting tasks that no normal car could ever hope to complete. Test your work and climb steep cliffs or drive through rivers and deep layers of mud.

name: Fruitalistic!
short_description: Fruitland is in peril! Use your launchers and trusty fruit squad to repel the sugary invaders, and bring peace once again.

name: Lethal Operation Episode 1 healer Rugitta
short_description: 1時間程度のステージを繰り返し遊ぶのではなく、 キャラをじっくり育てながら広い世界を冒険する――。 そんなSTGがあってもいいじゃないか!! …というのがこのゲームのコンセプト。 多数の仲間とウェポンを集め、広大な世界を巡り、 戦争ばかりで日々傾いていく環境と世界を救ってください。 同じリーサルオペレーションの「レイ編」と比べ アクションRPG寄りにバランス調整がされています。 ブレイクによって大多数の弾を消しやすく レベルと装備でどんどん防御性能が上がるので STGが苦手な人でも毎秒100発撃ってくるような凶悪ボスを 間違いなく倒せるようになります!

name: Vampire Hunters
short_description: To hunt vampires, you’ll need guns. Lots of guns. Mow down vampires, demons, and more by stacking your guns into absurd, impossibly awesome builds. Test your firepower in this rogue-lite retro FPS, where steampunk meets the undead. Will you become the baddest Vampire Hunter in Transylvania?

name: Hockeysplit
short_description: This game is fast-paced arcade hockey style about learning from mistakes to learn the real hockey

name: Rise of the Triad: Ludicrous Edition
short_description: The HUNT Returns... AGAIN! Play the original Cult Classic '90s FPS remastered in 4K Ultrawide with UNLIMITED frame rates, RESTORED content, NEW episodes, a LEVEL EDITOR, online MULTIPLAYER, LUDICROUS gameplay options and MORE. Make 'em EAT LEAD or they'll bury you in a lunchbox!

name: MF-01 Aerostrike
short_description: A Tactical Shmuplovania. Aerostrike combines elements from Metroidvania, Bullet Hell, and Shmup genres. Take flight in the MF-01 Aerostrike, explore a large underground base, battle against squadrons of hostile ships of all shapes and sizes, and find a way to escape alive.

name: Nightmare Manor
short_description: Welcome to Nightmare Manor - a terrifying horror game that will take you to an old manor steeped in dark history. In this game, you will feel the cold breath of the past, finding yourself in a place where sinister entities live.

name: LOOP LOOP ROOM
short_description: This is a simple puzzle platformer game filled with a variety of gimmicks. There is no story! Do your best and gobble up the stars in each stage♪

name: Potio Mellow
short_description: Potio Mellow is a turn based collectathon where you stack cards to collect herbs, materials, and craft equipment. Spend your day wisely, complete objectives and travel to new locations.

name: The Casino Empire
short_description: 'The Casino Empire' is an exciting game that puts you in charge of building your own Las Vegas-style casino empire.

name: Bouncers
short_description: Bouncers is a single player retro styled action game that has you avoiding enemies to climb the leaderboard. The bouncer will bounce around the screen in random directions and multiply over time, but more enemies for example the asteroid will appear.

name: Nightshift
short_description: Feel the retro vibes of the ‘80s with the colorful experience of NIGHTSHIFT - an 8-bit visual and playable arcade experience! Make your way on the highway, collect all the cassettes, boost your speed and reach Synthecity!

name: Obby
short_description: run, jump, puzzle. Your tasks that you have to master in Obby with Kitty.

name: Clockwork Owl
short_description: Clockwork Owl is a Coin Pusher Roguelite. Use turn-based classic arcade coin-pushing physics mechanics as a means to battle forest critters, while making your way up a tree. Collect a deck of new cogs from random encounters and upgrade your owl at shops to survive this permadeath journey.

name: Lab Cat Escape
short_description: Get ready for an action-packed adventure in 'Lab Cat Escape,' an exhilarating endless runner game. Guide a clever lab cat through a perilous laboratory, using gravity-switching abilities to dodge obstacles and achieve high scores. Run and switch gravity in this addictive, fast-paced runner!

name: WHITE ALBUM: Memories like Falling Snow
short_description: The classic visual novel from AQUAPLUS that launched one of Japan's most beloved franchises, WHITE ALBUM is a story of love in many forms. Will a couple cling together, or drift apart on the cold wind? The album of their relationship will be as white as snow, and as poignant.

name: Pigsaw
short_description: Escape the nightmarish human abattoir in this blood-soaked Horror FPS.

name: Pilfer: Story of Light
short_description: A 3D platforming journey, featuring a cute raccoon that must save the forest from darkness! Master dozens of different level mechanics as you run and jump through course-based worlds, saving other animals along the way.

name: かぞえ飯
short_description: Have you ever wondered how many grains of rice are in your bowl when you are eating white rice? This game is a very simple game in which all you have to do is count the rice grains in the bowl. You will never have to worry about how many grains of rice are in your bowl again.

name: Coonwood
short_description: Coonwood is a multiplayer horror game. One player takes on the role of the alien who crashed on an unknown planet. The other players (2-4) play as raccoons. But in the place where they are located, anomalies occur and the characters begin to possess different abilities.

name: My First Craft Survival
short_description: When I woke up, I found myself on an uninhabited island. And I had nothing with me! Anyway, the first priority is to find food to avoid starvation. At night, mysterious creatures attack, so I need to craft equipment and build a base to defend myself! In the end, there's a boss waiting for me!

name: Exo-Leviathan
short_description: A lone pilot sent to the main asteroid belt, your task is to collect carapaces, dragon remains. But beware, they might not take too kindly to you collecting them. A short sci-fi, first person, indie, thriller/horror game. Triggers my Thalassophobia.

name: DAIR
short_description: A complex fighting game with one attack. Features fast-paced, expressive movement and rollback netcode.

name: Betty & Earl
short_description: Betty & Earl is a relaxing and thoughtful puzzle game where you control everything at the same time in order to reunite the two main characters. The world is connected, and whenever you move, everything follows. Find a way to reconnect Betty & Earl in a world that constantly gets in the way.

name: Nightshift Survival
short_description: When kids enter this mysterious amusement park at midnight, there’s only one way: Survive. Nightshift Survival is a challenging rogue-lite game where you will encounter hordes of scary creatures living in Millennium Park. Which other mysteries this place hides?

name: 1989 QianShanMen
short_description: In a distant realm, there lies a mysterious and beautiful country known as the Winter Country. Currently, Winter Country is under the control of a political party called the 'Dongshan Party'... And on Winter Calendar June 4th, 1989, an event unfolded at the QianShanMen Square...

name: Axon TD: Uprising - Tower Defense
short_description: From the developers of Element TD 2 comes a Mazing Tower Defense where you can expand the map layout itself. A huge arsenal of towers and a wide variety of enemies clash in a battlefield that shifts on your whims. Engage in single, cooperative, or roguelite gameplay.

name: The haunted hospice
short_description: The Haunted Hospice, You got yourself stuck in the hospital while you where searching for your friend. Are you capable and smart enough to escape from the hospital and save your friend? Remember that you are not alone in the hospital there is always danger lurking.

name: Mage Tower 2: Call of Zadeus
short_description: Mage Tower (2013) was one of the first deckbuilders with damage-based combat. Ten years later, Mage Tower returns in a brand new open-world Roguelike adventure! Travel across a huge procedurally generated world, collect cards, battle enemies, delve into dungeons, and DEFEAT ZADEUS!

name: All-In-One Summer Sports VR
short_description: 9 Summer Sports in Just 1 Game! Embark on the ultimate summer adventure. Experience the thrill of various sports on our breathtaking tropical island. More than a game, it's your personal summer paradise, your ticket to a sports-filled, sun-soaked virtual vacation.

name: Sorrow Asylum
short_description: Sorrow Asylum is a looping horror game, a mix of an abandoned asylum and your mind's prison.

name: Demon's Bane
short_description: Save the animal kingdom in this innovative roguelike deckbuilder. Battle enemies, unlock abilities, and customize your deck. With 10 classes, 350+ cards, and a 100 different enemies. Experience strategic card combat with a twist.

name: Flesh
short_description: Dive into a surreal journey as you devour a ship and battle peculiar creatures in this 2D side-scrolling bullet hell shmup. Unleash your skills, dodge relentless barrages, and uncover hidden mysteries in a hand-drawn world of flesh and gore.

name: Polyglot Language Learning Quiz
short_description: Learn languages like a polyglot! Build vocabulary in French, German, Italian, Lithuanian, Polish, Portuguese, Spanish, Japanese, Chinese & Korean

name: HG Adventure
short_description: You suddenly enter a whole new world empty-handed. Start a whole new adventure all your own. Farming, fishing, building, cooking, alchemy and living a quiet life. Or is it fighting monsters, learning skills, building equipment and discovering the world's hidden secrets? Or maybe I want them all.

name: Settlemoon
short_description: After the moon vanished, the fantasy game world of Settlemoon lays abandoned in darkness. Re-light the skies, provide rest and resources for travelling adventurers, and piece together what happened to the world.

name: A Nest for Us
short_description: Fly through the forest collecting twigs to build your nest with in this minimalistic, nature-inspired platformer.

name: The House
short_description: You are an 18-year-old Spanish boy called Antonio who one day went shopping, and when he returned home he noticed things that were somewhat strange...

name: KAGITORI -BIRD IN THE CAGE HIDING THE KEY-
short_description: This game is an English translation of a visual novel game released in Japan. In this work, the main character, a boy, and four heroines, who happen to live in a mansion, work together to solve a murder that took place in a certain town in Japan.

name: Refidenptio
short_description: A Boomer-Shooter with epileptic 1-bit pixel art. Immerse yourself in an enigmatic story destroying all enemies in front of you with a unique combat mechanic. Face depression head on, your enemies are just things created by your mind.

name: Sclash
short_description: Sclash is a plug’n play 2D samurai fighting game full of tension where one hit is enough to kill. Play as a hand-drawn samurai in beautiful painted settings and fight your opponent in epic solemn duels where each move matters. Manage well your stamina, breath and take your time to land a deadly hit.

name: Nebula's Descent
short_description: Colorful bite-sized roguelike twin-stick bullet-hell dungeon crawler! Explore a procedurally generated research lab, throw black holes at monsters, dodge lasers, and fight a final boss beyond comprehension!

name: Battery Hunter
short_description: 'Battery Hunter' is a 2D pixel-art style linear level game where player must ensure their ability to defeat the final boss.

name: The Scrap
short_description: The Scrap is an independent third-person shooter that takes place in a futuristic world inhabited by robots.

name: OPERATOR
short_description: In OPERATOR, you will play as an elite 'Tier 1' operator undergoing dangerous clandestine operations all over the globe. With a strategic, measured, and unforgiving style of gameplay. You are the tactical advantage, Good luck.

name: panomap
short_description: panomap is an interactive geography game for your Twitch chat! Explore new places around the world and observe your surroundings with your viewers. Everyone, including yourself, tries to guess your location by just typing it to your chat. Let the competition and bragging begin!

name: Music Man 2: New land
short_description: Sequel to Music man game. Collect all notes at 4 different levels to play piano and find also mysterious blue crystals

name: Cornucopia
short_description: Cornucopia - an immersive 2.5D farming sim with 50+ NPCs, innovative compost system, unique card system, 200+ recipes. Befriend, date, marry, and have children with 31 NPCs. Attend festivals, auction animals, fish, craft, and play mini-games. In-depth gardening, pet-assisted interactions, and more!

name: Canvas of Kings
short_description: Canvas of Kings is a minimalistic mapmaking tool that focuses on randomness and auto-generated elements on user-definable and interactive paths and plots.

name: Chinese Chess-Wargame
short_description: This is a new game based on the expansion of the traditional Chinese chess game 'Chinese Chess'. It not only retains the basic rules of the original Chinese chess, but also adds new war chess elements. You should be able to get started quickly. Take the challenge to become the new master.

name: Only Jump: GoHome回家
short_description: No matter how far you go, never forget the direction home. In this game, your only objective is to go home.

name: SokoSolitaire
short_description: SokoSolitaire is a card-pushing puzzle game inspired by Sokoban and Solitaire. You'll find yourself pushing, stacking or flipping cards and more across 60 different handcrafted levels.

name: Firebird
