short_description: Firebird is a narrative road trip that takes place in Slavic folklore, in an adventure that ressembles a traditional tale. Aboard your truck, travel to the far north, meet colorful characters, and face the creatures inhabiting these sacred lands.

name: Martin
short_description: Martin is a block-pushing, grid-based puzzle game. Use items, push blocks and navigate your way around various game mechanics to retrieve Martin's crown.

name: Bite Size Terrors: Erobos Heaven
short_description: Unsettling & Disturbing Events Quickly Rise After Being Saved By God.

name: The Friends We Left Behind
short_description: The Friends We Left Behind is a puzzle-solving horror game where you must survive different 'escape room' situations to win. Play 5 separate bone-chilling levels with unique gameplay featuring different Imaginary Friends. Play solo on your PC in a dark room and volume turned up high, you chicken.

name: Verses of Enchantment
short_description: A magical card game where you duel wizards using AI generated poetry. Travel a rich world, meet fellow wizards, collect cards and build a deck that will inspire enchanting poetry!

name: Forest Golf Planner
short_description: Create and customize your own golf course in this charming management sim.

name: TD Tower Defense
short_description: Build your towers according to the enmey you are facing in the wave. Upgrade your turrets to increase range, damage or rewards. Each enemy wave will be random and increases in speed and damage resistance. How far can you go!

name: Oceanhorn 2: Knights of the Lost Realm
short_description: Sequel to the critically acclaimed action adventure. Experience a gorgeous new third person 3D view and embark on an epic journey that unfolds the mysteries of what happened 1000 years ago.

name: A Slug's Dream
short_description: Take on the role of a famished slug and wiggle your way through a series of challenging yet accessible puzzles. Push, rotate and warp anything that stands between you and those yummy flowers!

name: Koi x Shin Ai Kanojo
short_description: 《想要传达给你的爱恋》是日本美少女游戏知名大厂AMUSE CRAFT旗下品牌Us:track制作的恋爱题材大作。人气原画师君岛青、仓泽磨子与白玉联袂为本作担当原画与角色设计，由知名话题剧本家新岛夕领衔编写剧本，并由业内资深音乐人水月陵制作音乐。本作各女主角也均由业内知名声优出演。

name: Sherlock Holmes Consulting Detective: The Case of Banker's Final Debt
short_description: This mysterious case involves the murder of Oswald Mason, found dead at home. Lestrad and Scotland Yard believe that the murder was a result of Mason disturbing a burglar. I have my doubts. The Treasury wants us to investigate the case as Mason was dealing with sensitive Treasury work at the time.

name: Roxy Raccoon's Mancala Madness
short_description: When a Voodoo Priestess seeks vengeance upon the world, it is up to one Raccoon to stop her! Learn the basics & master the tactics of the classic board game as you prove, once and for all, that you are the true Mancala champion!

name: The Adventures of Panzer 2
short_description: Set approximately 1 year after the events of the first game, Panzer returns to his role as Raid Leader of the Zergadins. The old team has been 'recruited', an all-new state-of-the-art headquarters built, and a world of adventure awaits!

name: Bit The Apple, So What?
short_description: A short musical theater play set in dystopian Eastern Europe, based on a biblical story.

name: Cyber Strider
short_description: Blast your enemies! Create the ultimate build! Travel to the edge of space, in this epic rogue-lite action packed bundle of chaos inspired by slay the spire & FTL.

name: Super Space Club
short_description: Super Space Club is a lo-fi arcade space shooter to chill to. Defend a vibrant galaxy as a club of misfit heroes and battle endless waves of spacecrafts to the tune of atmospheric beats. Outlast your enemies and vibe to the rhythm of the stars.

name: DRACOMATON
short_description: Dracomaton is a top-down roguelike bullet hell about Eclipse, a small robot who awakens in an abandoned factory filled with corrupted training bots and the secrets of cosmic dragons. Fight your way to the top of the tower by transforming your robot body, changing your entire arsenal on the fly!

name: Devil's Island
short_description: Devil's Island is an FPS with elements of survival, maintained in a horror atmosphere with post-apocalyptic themes in a world that has already ended. This is a game whose history combines what has long been forgotten with what may yet come.

name: Snake Jump
short_description: You're a snake who is tired of living on the ground. You wanna explore the sky and go as high as you can. Take on a thrilling obstacle cours and a beautiful mystery awaits you at the top...

name: El Norte Salvaje, Juego De Cartas RPG
short_description: The Wild North, RPG card game, is a card game with a medieval and fantasy theme for one player in which we control a hero who has at his disposal a deck of nj cards that he will use to advance overcoming different scenarios until completing the campaign map.

name: School Bus Driving Simulator
short_description: Experience a realistic school bus with the exciting School Bus Driving Simulator! Get students safely to school, earn rewards, and customize your bus.

name: Dance Hero: More Jiggle
short_description: Dance Hero: More Jiggle is a Dance/Rhythm/Twerk and Customization Simulator with many unique features. Twerk through the story, hire many interesting characters to dance with, explore a huge city and even customize your main character with clothes from real-world fashion brands!

name: A Guidebook of Babel
short_description: A plot adventure game with the butterfly effect at the core. After death, you will soon realize you've boarded the Babel...and while this may feel like the twilight zone, you will be given a pen to rewrite the past so future events can unfold.

name: Premortal VR
short_description: Premortal VR is a medieval VR-only game. Explore and survive the procedurally-generated wilderness. Gather resources and craft gear. Build formidable bases. Overcome all boss trials to ascend!

name: Welcome to Kowloon
short_description: This is an indie horror from the first person, in which you find yourself in an area called Kowloon in search of cheap housing. The inhabitants of this place only at first glance seem to be ordinary people, but if we dig deeper, we will see their real faces.

name: this morning I decided to die
short_description: Follow a girl through the last day of her life.

name: ApocalypticSoup's Racing Sim Experience (A.R.S.E)
short_description: Enjoy a semi-realistic arcade racer solo or online with friends. With a selection of serious and wacky vehicles to choose from, take on your friends in some skill based drift racing. Drift mechanics are rewarding, though difficult to master.

name: Taboo Trial
short_description: In the rogue action game 'Taboo Trial', you will play as a young female warrior from the Norse mythology, who can transform into multiple cute and sexy female warriors. In the visually stunning 3D world, you will use your combat skills to uncover the truth behind the Twilight of the Gods.

name: Mandemon
short_description: Decaying Japanese school buildings, a series of bizarre incidents, eerie Mandemon legends. Lies and truths intertwine, love and hate entwined in the mist. What should one do? Whom should one believe? Welcome to this cruel world filled with deception and harm —

name: The Radiants
short_description: The Radiants is a magical adventure visual novel with light stat raising & multiple endings. Choose what kind of Oracle you will become and maybe find romance along the way.

name: PLONG
short_description: Roguelike brick-breaking arcade game. Wreak havoc as a rogue virus in the distant year of 1998.

name: Nova: Cloudwalker's Tale
short_description: Nova: Cloudwalker's Tale is a charming puzzle game about moving clouds and walking on them to gather the lost star shards across the skies.

name: LogiCircuit
short_description: LogiCircuit is the next generation of circuit building! Use various logic gates and integrated circuits to simulate real life computers, games, programs, and more!

name: Only One
short_description: Immerse yourself in the chilling world of Only One, a spine-tingling horror experience that will leave you trembling with fear. Explore the depths of a haunted mansion, where darkness reigns and secrets lurk in every corner. Uncover the truth behind the paranormal occurrences.

name: Thronefall
short_description: A minimalist game about building and defending your little kingdom.

name: Collision Paradise
short_description: Hey, darling! Get ready for some adorable monster-smashing action with your balls! Oh no, there are so many of them! Help, save me! But don't worry, sweetheart, you've got this! Smash those monsters, unlock the most stunning CG rewards, and let's have a blast together! You're my hero!

name: Laruaville 14
short_description: Touch the Oriental Wisdom from the ancient sage himself and build him a town!

name: The Life of a Magical Circle
short_description: The Life of a Magical Circle is a narrated roguelite in which you dodge obstacles and pick up circles. Some of the circles are part of your goal, but some of them are just for fun. It's up to you to figure out which is which and to try to stay focused.

name: Greedland
short_description: Greedland is a top-down shooter mixed with survivor-like elements. Slaughter the monsters, break out of the siege, and welcome the dawn of victory! (Player progress from Next Feast demo will also be available in the retail version.)

name: Digs
short_description: Defend your valuable chest in randomly generated maps with various towers, traps and obstacles to modify the path that the enemies must follow in 'Digs', the ultimate rogue-like tower defense game. Experience unique mechanics, upgrade your defenses and face off against challenging enemies

name: Pet
short_description: A horror visual novel about trying to get home to feed your cat.

name: Lethal Operation Episode 3 Lethal Arms of Justice リーサルアームズオブジャスティス
short_description: キャラをじっくり育てながら広い世界を冒険する――。 そんなSTGの最終編。ショットを合成して、いいとこどりのショットも作れる！ シリーズ最強の敵たちに最強の武器やスキルの組み合わせで対抗し、 この物語の真実に辿り着いてください―

name: Enjoy the Diner
short_description: Why not enjoy the diner? The moon is as full as it'll ever be, and there's even a drink fountain.

name: Lethal Operation Episode 2 destroyer Rei リーサルオペレーションレイ編
short_description: キャラをじっくり育てながら広い世界を冒険する――。 そんなSTGがあってもいいじゃないか!! …というのがこのゲームのコンセプト。 「ルギッタ編」と比べシューティング寄りで、すべて束ねた火力はまさに一撃必殺。 大量の敵を次々に破壊していく爽快感をお楽しみ下さい!

name: Sliding Rails
short_description: Lead the TRAIN by sliding the rails. Get the STARs! This game is a sliding puzzle! Slide the rails and lead the train to the goal.

name: Clan monsters
short_description: Clan monsters is a game in which you have to use your dexterity and reliable weapons to destroy monsters that appear from portals. Different types of weapons will be given you for completing levels. Fire, monster a lot of levels with different platforms! There is easy controls system.

name: Wildwood: A Town Building Game
short_description: Welcome to Wildwood, the ultimate town building game. Start from nothing. Provide food, shelter and protection for your settlers. Forage for resources, research new technologies, Craft new items, construct new buildings and grow from a surviving colony into a thriving one.

name: erozld
short_description: Mio is an adventurer who dived into a dungeon, dreaming of getting rich. She falls into a pit and, battered and bruised, obtains a holy sword called Aphrodite. However, the holy sword is a magical sword with special powers.

name: Guilty Me
short_description: In Guilty Me, take the role of Lucy on a scary nighttime journey home from the coffee shop. Face psychological terror, explore a dark environment, and uncover hidden secrets. Survive the chase and immerse yourself in a gripping walk simulator of suspense.

name: Soul Stalker
short_description: The survivor roguelike where you slay your psyche. Take down waves of enemies in the natural evolution of the genre established by Vampire Survivors, with visuals inspired by Paper Mario.

name: Hector The Cat - Treasure Hunter
short_description: Hector the Cat: Treasure Hunter is a rogue-lite action-adventure. Explore and battle your way through procedurally generated levels to gather as many Treasure you Can and become the Best Treasure Hunter.

name: Planetary Exploration Company
short_description: An action rogue-like, bullet heaven, management sim. Survive alien hordes as you explore planets, extract resources to build tools and unlock new items, complete jobs to earn money while you manage your employees and make your company grow.

name: Sym.BIOS: Torn Asunder
short_description: Sym.BIOS: Torn Asunder is a text-based visual novel with tricky moral choices and beautiful art. Its epic sci-fi story is told through vivid dialogue, featuring 7 main characters. All your decisions will have consequences down the line: will you succeed in your mission?

name: TurtleQuest
short_description: TurtleQuest is a 2D-Platformer where you are sent on a quest to save your little turtle village from an unknown disease. You have to follow an ancient path through the old mountains, riddled with bewitched traps, to find the sacred plant Zingiber, which might help to cure all turtles.

name: Neon Idle
short_description: Buy the neons and earn money as much as you can! - Enjoy the enthusiasm of the neon design. - Enjoy the chain effect of skills, terrains, and upgrades. - Calculate which upgrade can effectively increase the normal earning of money!

name: Your Spaceport!
short_description: Manage your very own space station in this Tycoon game. Sell fuel and repairs to the visitors. Manufacture and research new ways to defend your business and make more money. Survive against all odds.

name: Alchemist's Fantasy R ~ A Girl's Alchemic Furnace ~
short_description: The young alchemist Meti from the village, along with her boyfriend Nero, begins a quest to find their missing master. Meti's ability to synthesize magical creatures helps the couple overcome various challenges they encounter on the way, and they discover a secret that changes their lives.

name: Pulse of Love
short_description: 'Pulse of Love' is a captivating visual novel set in the vibrant world of the Korean K-pop scene drama. Experience the exhilarating journey of love, passion, and self-discovery as you navigate the highs and lows of fame.

name: Bunker 21 Extended Edition
short_description: 'Bunker 21' is a story-driven first-person action game in a post-apocalyptic world. You are the last survivor. Explore the secrets of Bunker 21. Fight against monsters. Find answers in a devastated world.

name: 春待ちトロイダル
short_description: 「春待ちトロイダル」は高校生活を再体験する、ループ型選択形式アドベンチャーゲームです。 クラスメイト達と対話を行い関係性を深めることでストーリーを進め、謎を解き明かします。 なぜ主人公はここに呼ばれたのか、この島で何が起きているのか。 あなたの手で、全てを解き明かしてください。

name: Vae Victis
short_description: Vae Victis is a ruthless minimalistic turn-based strategy game. Engage in intense multiplayer battles with friends or fight through an expansive campaign. With unique units, factions, and abilities you will have to be cunning with your tactical decisions to claim victory!

name: The Pit
short_description: The Pit is a 2D pixel platformer with precise jumps, coin collecting and enemy encounters accompanied by a mysterious atmosphere and soundtrack. One or more missed moves can cost everything. Man up and defeat the evil!

name: ぼくは人狼になりたい
short_description: 'I Want to Be a Werewolf' is a text-based adventure where you can enjoy the detective elements of the Werewolf game and the stories of the characters.A strange room when you wake up. 'werewolf game' that starts without knowing the purpose. Mystery & suspense that sees through deception.

name: Objector
short_description: In Objector, you play as an enemy of the king. Join the history of opposition against ruthless power in a diverse fantasy world by facing difficulties and beating bosses waiting for you in challenging gameplay.

name: Ninja or Die: Shadow of the Sun
short_description: Set at the heart of a cataclysmic event in Edo Japan, Ninja or Die: Shadow of the Sun is an ultrafast Roguelite inspired by Japanese folklore. Unleash the power, speed and soul of the Ninja, using acrobatic jumping to move and attack.

name: Scary Siam Mall
short_description: Scary Siam Mall is a horror game in Tha Song Mueang Plaza shopping mall. atmosphere and scary

name: Cine Tracer 2
short_description: Cine Tracer 2 is a virtual filmmaking sandbox used for pre-production for live action productions.

name: Wind Love

short_description: Solve mysteries, gear up, build and explore! Live the chill life of a hippy scientist.

name: Dare Course
short_description: Take part in a breathtaking obstacle course show! Test the limits of your physical training, speed and reaction limits. Go through the long track with lots of traps and obstacles in your way, complete all tasks and win!

name: Charlie | The Legend
short_description: 'Charlie | The Legend' is a Multiplayer asymmetrical horror video game in which 4 Players must face a diabolical doll possessed by a demon. You decide! Play as Charlie and defeat the other players or face Charlie as a survivor.

name: Monster Tribe
short_description: Explore an island filled with collectible creatures, a vast and varied wilderness, and dangerous towers on your way to restoring harmony with the land of Akama.

name: Nerved
short_description: Nerved is first person horror game, about a paranormal investigator couple and their latest adventure in the “Bitterwood Forest.” This last case that they have chosen to persuade, will deliver a charnel impact on the couple’s fate, both personally and professionally.

name: CRYPTEX
short_description: An action-packed FMV game set in Istanbul. A friend captured by mafia, a cryptex, and other mafia leaders who have the cryptex's ciphers. Thanks to POV shooting, you are the leading role in this interactive movie. Make your choices and decide the end of your game owing to 6 different finals.

name: Brain Boom
short_description: Plunge into the atmosphere of mad fun with funny zombies.

name: Atlas Fallen
short_description: Rise from the dust and glide the sands of a timeless land, filled with ancient dangers, mysteries and fragments of the past. Hunt legendary monsters with powerful sand-infused weapons and abilities in spectacular, super-powered combat.

name: KENDO
short_description: KENDO is a pure VR sword fighting game focused on realism. Enter a virtual dojo and face a series of unique practitioners with their own styles and techniques. Use timing and skill to land the winning point. Dodge thrusts, swing and lock shinais to follow the true way of the warrior.

name: I Want To Be Human
short_description: A vampire girl, a hat boy and an adventure packed with tonnes of exploding body parts – go on a bloodthirsty rampage of death and destruction in a quest to become human again!

name: Road Patrol Truck
short_description: Drive your Road Patrol Truck and tow all the cars that were left in wrong places by their owners. Put the city streets in order!

name: Alone in the Dark 2
short_description: The sequel to the critically acclaimed Alone in the Dark, this new adventure sees our hero, Edward Carnby, in 1923 confronting the many faces of evil in the darkness of Derceto, a house in which entering is the easy part and leaving could be hell!

name: R.B.I. Baseball 16
short_description: Make the play with your favorite Major League Baseball team and win the World Series! R.B.I. 16 features enhanced lighting and graphics, revamped defensive AI, an improved batting system, and the ability to sim through games in Season mode.

name: No Sushi, No Life
short_description: You’ve arrived at a robot sushi bar with one goal in mind… To eat all the sushi you can. Grab all the sushi coming your way and stuff them in your mouth! Test your reflexes as more and more plates of sushi rush toward you!

name: Viktor Crysworth
short_description: Viktor Crysworth is an intelligence-based science fiction visual novel that has managed to extend from the Federal Security Service to the Kazakh Foreign Intelligence Service.

name: Sextris Effect
short_description: Sextris Effect reimagines the classic 90s bootleg for 2019, bringing Sextris into the modern era with gorgeous visual effects and VR support.

name: F1™ 2017
short_description: MAKE HISTORY - Win the 2017 World Championship, break every record in the fastest ever F1™ cars, and race some of the most iconic F1 cars of the last 30 years.

name: Forest Harvester Simulator
short_description: Great pit-saw mission starts on one of the most wooded areas. Control a modern forest harvester and produce as many timber as possible. Also, you can build an industrial base and process the raw wood into more valuable products!

name: Open The Chest 2
short_description: Hello Player ! In this puzzle game, your job is to open the chest. Yeah, a chest with your MOUSE !

name: Taima Miko Yuugi
short_description: This is a world overrun with demons and monsters. Thanks to exorcists, those monsters could be suppressed. The source of an exorcist’s energy, if the mana of an exorcist is taken away, her clothes will be torn apart by the monster, so the body is exposed, especially the between the breasts and legs.

name: eFootball  PES 2020
short_description: Experience unparalleled realism and authenticity in this year's definitive football game: PES 2020.

name: Wrath Of The Fire God
short_description: Wrath of the Fire God is a fast-paced VR action shooter. Venture down into the realm of the Fire God using your archery skills to retrieve the 4 magical gems stolen from your village.

name: Steel Arena: Robot War
short_description: You're one of the most powerful army of robots on Earth. Your mission is to protect the planet and restore peace as fast as possible. Fight off an attack of enemies and lead your army to victory!

name: Fallen Kingdom
short_description: Someday any kingdom comes to an end. Most often this is due to wars, but what if it happens because of magic?

name: Dead Cubes
short_description: Dead Cubes is an endless, wave-based first person shooter. Survive for as long as you can against the undead, no matter what it takes.

name: 都市恐怖故事
short_description: A diary reveals the adventures of the protagonist's unknown. In the game, players will follow the protagonist's pace to explore all kinds of supernatural phenomena and solve all kinds of well-designed checkpoints. Come and experience this game created by a team of four!

name: RIDE 5
short_description: Rev up your engine and get ready to hit the track with RIDE 5. An adrenaline-filled gaming experience that is so authentic it will make you feel like you're truly racing at break-neck speed.

name: Piano Play 3D
short_description: Piano Play 3D! This is a great piano playing game. Listen to the music and tap on keys at a proper time. Just choose your favourite classical composition and start to play!

name: Force of Elements
short_description: Force of Elements is the game of head-to-head combat where your field of battle is a match 3 gem board. Choose a unique hero, swap gems to unlock elemental mana and annihilate your opponent in fast-paced battles that will leave you hungry for one more round.

name: Oneirogen
short_description: Oneirogen is a dreamlike circular journey through the depths of the developer's subconscious. Take a break from reality and dive into this surreal world that is perfect for an inspiring jaunt.

name: Sink Again
short_description: Sink Again is a humorous game with a pirate theme, turn-based tactics with board game elements and much more.Assemble the perfect team of pirates and go in search of treasures.The game continues the tradition of turn-based tactics and brings many new elements and mechanics to the genre.

name: Tamashi Party
short_description: Ghosts have a hard life so come out of your coffins and face your friends. Take advantage of the chaos to surprise, push, trap and unleash hell on them. No Eternal Rest for losers in Tamashi Party.

name: Quantum Retribution
short_description: To become a prisoner in this place you need to commit something really terrible. A kind of disaster, that lead to the deaths of many people. But the problem is that you don't remember anything at all! Are you really guilty? That's the big question!

name: MISTOVER
short_description: ''MIST-ical' RPG with expeditions for finding the key to survival. Choose your next step wisely and keep in mind that your every move will change the future. Create your own 'Corps' and explore through various regions in the Pillar of Despair: forests, lakes, mountains, cities, cathedrals, castles, and much more.

name: 香山31号
short_description: QZQ Studio is proud to launch the fourth project. For the first time, try the sci-fi adventure game in the near future. As a masterpiece of the four-person independent game studio, we are constantly striving to create a richer and more interesting game experience for the players, welcome to advise.

name: Viral Cry
short_description: You're a spec ops operative with a mission to infiltrate the office of GeneWeaver, a biotech research corporation. Things went terribly wrong: an experimental virus broke out of containment, turning all the residents into a crazed abominations. Deal with the situation - prevent a global pandemic!

name: DEAD DOZEN
short_description: DEAD DOZEN Escape is a first person horror survival experience. Form a team with up to 4 players and escape from the depths of the mysterious pyramid in the heart of Siberia, or do it all on your own.

name: Pretend
short_description: An online and local party game of teamwork and betrayal for 4-15 players.

name: PlatONIR
short_description: PlatONIR - is a hardcore-platformer game. Try to open all game levels.

name: The Poisoner (Prelude)
short_description: Immerse yourself in a dark atmospheric thriller. You are a police detective on the trail of a dangerous criminal. You must solve a challenging logic puzzle to escape from the basement before it’s too late.

name: Otaku's Fantasy
short_description: A new world had opened the door for me. All kinds of women threw themselves at me, and for all kinds of strange reasons. No matter it is a mixed-race lady with huge buttocks, a well-known news anchor secretly wants to be whipped, or a hungry cugar that almost eats me up, they all wants to know what it's like to be with me.

name: Sovereignty: Crown of Kings
short_description: Assume the leadership of one of the lands of Sovereignty and guide your people to glory and prosperity. By wisely combining soft and hard power, you can eventually hope to reign over the whole land. However, In this divided and merciless land, holding onto power is likely to prove harder than seizing it!

name: Falcon City
short_description: Step into the shoes of Kurt, a cynical rabbit detective, and fight crime in this retro style point and click adventure. Overcome scheming criminals, fat and lazy office workers and a shortsighted, doughnut-eating boss to solve the mystery of a kidnapped girl!

name: Damnation City of Death
short_description: Damnation City of Death features survival gameplay, where you fight against monsters, cold, hunger, thirst and other players. The Gameplay is an action packed fight for survival, where you always need to be ready for the next encounter you face. You can also do various missions with friends.

name: FINAL FANTASY VI (Old ver.)
short_description: The highly rated and widely popular sixth instalment of the legendary FINAL FANTASY series comes to PC!

name: Nightmares from the Deep 3: Davy Jones
short_description: Learn Davy Jones’s secrets in order to defeat him in the final battle!

name: Village of Adventurers 2
short_description: This is a tactical RPG with Galgame elements. As the owner of the village, which will be attacked by all kinds of monsters as the story expands, you'll need to recruit cute adventurers, use magic, and build walls defend it. Remember that those cute girls may need ‘comforting’ after doing hard work.

name: Xtreme League
short_description: Go snowboarding whenever you like, regardless of the weather outside the window! Learn new tracks and renew your board! Xtreme League is waiting for you!

name: Disaster Dragon x Girls from Different Worlds
short_description: Dungeon Conquering SRPG

name: The Tavern
short_description: The Tavern is an experimental dark fantasy adventure trying to find a new side of role-playing. A mix of Visual Novels and RPGs, it is very interactive and allows you to explore your surroundings and make hundreds of minor and major choices.

name: Goblin Walker
short_description: This is an unconventional 2D belt-scroll action game, in which players won’t beat devils or dragons as invincible warriors, but evil, greedy and despicable Goblins. You will break into the villages which are guarded by soldiers and warriors and kidnap the villagers as sacrifice for the resurrection ritual of the Goblin King.

name: Battle Sad Boy
short_description: The game is cartoonish in nature. It features multiple ideas and is not limited to one style of play.

name: AVARIAvs
short_description: Experience Ultrafast Turnbased Combat in AVARIAvs! Command 16 unique heroes, wield mind-bending Real Life Debuffs and unleash epic Focusburns to claim victory. Build YOUR party, destroy the enemy, WIN!

name: Battle Ready
short_description: A tactical multiplayer first-person shooter game like no other. Put your skill and teamwork to the test as you battle across vast landscapes, day and night. Are you ready?

name: Strike Cars
short_description: Become a participant of the crazy car battle tournament. Equip your car to the maximum and be ready to fight. Try to survive in this armored cars extreme race.

name: Sandbox Testing Game
short_description: Physics is a sandbox test game.

name: Otherland MMO
short_description: The fascinating multiverse of Tad Williams’ critically acclaimed Otherland novels transformed into a full scale MMORPG with a new storyline. New game worlds and improvements, better performance and a revamped UI, Otherland: Next is the next step in the game’s evolution.

name: Real Farm
short_description: Grow your way to success in Real Farm. Work your way up from nothing in career mode or start with an established farm in free mode. Complete jobs and manage land, crops, animals and staff as you strive to become a respected farmer in the community.

name: Munchkin: Quacked Quest
short_description: Dive into Munchkin: Quacked Quest and re-discover the parody, puns, and humor from the hit card game Munchkin by Steve Jackson. Gather gold, throw your foes (and friends) into sacrifice pits, collect ducks, eliminate the monsters and reach the highest level to win the game!

name: Procedural Soccer
short_description: Work your way up from an unknown, low-league team up to the Championship league, or just play a quick game against another team. Explore your world, play different teams and find your favorite!

name: Pottery Crafts: Hand-Made Simulator
short_description: Feel the joy of handwork with Pottery Crafts: Hand-Made Simulator. Unlock your creativity making ceramics designed by you.

name: Nether: Resurrected
short_description: Nether is a unique, first-person, multiplayer urban survival experience. Set in a post-apocalyptic world, Nether forces players to make life-saving decisions in a fast-paced struggle against players and the environment. Join tribes, hold territory, scavenge, craft, trade and loot your way to stay alive.

name: The Last Farm
short_description: The town of Riverside has suffered a disaster and is on the verge of starvation. They need your help to restore their farm and grow food in a harsh and unforgiving land. Customise your crops, build vast automated systems and endure toxic blightstorms, and rebuild The Last Farm.

name: EPEJSODION Dodgeball Defense
short_description: Time to hit the parquet! EPEJSODION Dodgeball is a sports game, where YOU can lead over 100 powerful teams to victory! Play an extensive singleplayer campaign, hone your skills, then beat your friends!

name: Club Lighting
short_description: Welcome to the nightclub! A place for groovy music, best DJs and for sure pretty girls. Make those girls dance, and you will get your reward!

name: Commands & Colors: Ancients
short_description: Hexwar Games has partnered with GMT Games to bring you a digital version of Commands & Colors: Ancients the board game. The game allows players to portray important engagements of ancient history. The battles focus on the historical deployment of forces and important terrain features on the scale of the game system.

name: Master Of Secrets: Dark Europe
short_description: You are a novice of the Magistrate, the most powerful organization in Miltenstein. Start the uneven path from the beginner to the experienced cryptographer, become the decryption grand master and expose a coup against the King. Each your action and decision will have consequences.

name: Sanctum Breach
short_description: Sanctum Breach is a Hardcore top down ARPG in the vein of games such as Diablo 2, Path of Exile and Grim Dawn. With a heavy focus on Endgame content and build customisation.

name: 1 For Yes, 0 For No
short_description: A short science fiction visual novel about a curious but lonely artificial intelligence named Oswald.

name: Shotgun Raiders
short_description: Polish your Shotgun and pull some Grenades because its time for SHOTGUN RAIDERS! A 2d fast action platform shooter with Trading Cards. Inspired by the easy controls of classic mario, limited gun angles of the good old arcade shooters, and level crafting.

name: eFootball PES 2021 SEASON UPDATE
short_description: Celebrate 25 years of PES with the eFootball PES 2021 Season Update* - available at a special anniversary price!

name: Saving Stages
short_description: Have you ever watched a rocket launch and land its own booster and thought 'Wow I want to do that!' Well look no further, because you came to the right place!

name: BLACK DAY
short_description: BLACK DAY is a single player Sandbox tactical shooter that allows you to personalize the game experience by setting different variables such as equipment, location, difficulty and type of Hostile encounters.

name: Vadine: Bite-Man
short_description: Decimate. Obliterate. Vadine uses his own blood to wreck his foes. Conquer 12 epic boss battles. Navigate past traps and contraptions at every corner. So have a drink to Vadine:Bite-Man!!!

name: Mille Bornes
short_description: Rediscover the original French racing card game in this digital adaptation! Trust your steering wheel, and be the first of your friends to reach the finish line! But be careful: a flat tire, an accident, or an empty gas tank could be lurking at every turn!

name: WWE 2K20
short_description: NOTE: All multiplayer servers for WWE 2K20 will be shutdown as of 6/30/2022. After that time, all game functions requiring online servers will no longer function.

name: Goblin Squad - Total Division
short_description: Command your tribe of goblins. Recruit new, unruly, reluctant fighters as they travel and pillage the human’s kingdoms! Time to take your sweet, sweet revenge on the pink oppressors!

name: The Tower - The Order of XII
short_description: The Tower: The Order of XII is a humble puzzle game, a fantasy interconected franchise of games, stories and characters. Who said Indie games couldn't have their own version of a shared universe?

name: Deadly Kingdom
short_description: Welcome to Deadly Kingdom, the ultimate medieval experience you always wanted. You play the role of Sir Gareth, a lord commander appointed by the king to protect the land. The kingdom was once ruled by a very powerful king and his guards had a mission, to protect the red crystal.

name: Population Zero
short_description: Survival on Kepler is a race against time. Make the most of the remaining 168 hours or get turned into an unworldly being by the Sphere. Complete quests to help NPCs, explore the diverse landscape, survive wildlife and other players. Uncover Kepler’s mysteries and your mission’s true goal.

name: The Last Pixel
short_description: Experience the world as The Last Pixel in existence as it travels through two different eras of classic gaming in an experimental 2D game inspired by Pong and Super Mario Bros. With over 10 levels to beat, this short but fun adventure will take you for a ride.

name: Piano Cat
short_description: Piano Cat is a challenging rhythm-based platformer game where you will run through different environments filled with unique soundtracks, jump to the beat, collect bonuses, avoid obstacles on your way and soar towards the goal to complete all levels.

name: MisBits
short_description: MisBits is a riotous multiplayer, action-driven sandbox for warriors, builders, and creators alike. Head roll, body swap, and wield absurd pickups, through competitive battles modes and mini-games. Or build and edit games your way, with your rules. Just watch out for exploding chickens!

name: Myridian: The Last Stand
short_description: Myridian: The Last Stand is an old school 3×3 platformer featuring beautiful 2D pixel art, an orchestral soundtrack and intense action!

name: Fading Visage
short_description: Where am I? This place frightens me. How can I get out of here? I've lost my way in a thick fog. Wherever I go, I keep coming back here, again and again, as if I have to finish something. I can dimly remember that I've been here already...

name: Whale Island
short_description: Whale Island is an immersive VR experience that offers the wonder of a different world. Two experiences are set around Whale Island, the first is based on a platform near the island where a narrative plays out. The second experience takes you for a flight over the island.

name: Chronicles of Elmyra
short_description: The young wizardess Faira has been commissioned to investigate strange deadly nightmares. Start this new adventure exploring the world of Elmyra. Will she be able to complete her mission?

name: Hyper Train Corporation
short_description: Try what it feels like to be one of the top managers of the corporation engaged in construction of the vacuum tube train network. Enhance roads and trains, set the rates and deal with accidents. Design high-speed rail transportation and connect the world’s megacities!

name: Dawn of China: Rise of Qin
short_description: Visit the ancient China of the Warring States period in this global strategy game. Choose any of the Chinese states or their neighbours and unite the Celestial Empire!

name: Don't Tax Me, Bro!
short_description: Run for your life in a destitute city while the police try desperately to take your coin. Beat the highscore, chuck gas tanks at people, grab coins with a vacuum, step on stray dogs, unlock items to wear and don't get taxed! Run like a madman. Die like a boss.

name: Vibrant
short_description: Hotline Miami meets abstraction. Vibrant brings you 'in the zone' through hyper-focus. Your last freedom is movement.

name: Shark Week: Operation Apex
short_description: Use virtual reality to uncover the secrets of the big blue in an atmospheric deep sea dive. As you bear witness to an underwater marvel, your mission becomes clear. Take your research rig out into the open sea in search of the largest great white shark ever seen…

name: 梦涯
short_description: As the third bomb of the studio work, we turned our attention to the Republic of China. In that chaotic era, players will experience a tortuous life with the protagonist, let us wait and see.

name: Ghosty
short_description: Ghosty is a lighthearted top-down action-adventure RPG that features tons of puns, witty dialogue, charming story elements, and a pixelized art style. The game experiments with a splash of unique mechanics that are used both in and out of combat.

name: Endica VII The Dream King
short_description: A Co-op 'Metroidvania' inspired by hits from the 90's! Explore Endica with your friends in a 4-Player Retro Game featuring elements from Run & Gunners, Platformers, Bullet-Hell Shooters, as well as Street Fighter Moves and RPG Elements! Also features Versus Mode & Mini-Games!

name: Queer Man Peering Into A Rock Pool.jpg
short_description: A joyful, strange experience in which a middle-aged queer man toddles around a strange island attempting to re-furnish his empty house.

name: Food Truck VR
short_description: Food Truck VR is a Restaurant Simulator! Build up your menu, frantically serve up to 4 customers at a time, and cook on all manner of different equipment to craft your recipes! You, the player, will be graded on how well you cook!

name: Warlander
short_description: Wreak your path of vengeance in a procedurally generated dark fantasy world, with a unique take on stamina-based combat. Battle in arenas with interactive environment, where every run will be one of a kind. Experience a variety of abilities and power-ups, along with permadeath. Slice, Die, Repeat.

name: The East New World
short_description: A retro-inspired action platformer game with the high quality pixel art style. Tight controls, complex level design (including multiple paths and secret areas), RPG elements, collectibles and achievements, boss fights, NPCs, a fair amount of challenge and decent number of levels.

name: Rapture Rejects
short_description: The Rapture Has Happened. You didn't make the cut. Rapture Rejects is a top down isometric last man standing game set in the apocalyptic Cyanide & Happiness universe.

name: Dungeon Quest
short_description: Fight through enemies in search of an ancient artifact. Three playable classes. Six dungeon levels.

name: Whack the Serial Killer 20 Ways plus Neighbour, Burglars...
short_description: Abducted and tied up in a basement by a psychopathic serial killer, it's up to you to turn the tables on this freak and find all the ways to kill him in the most brutal and bizarre of fashions. Includes 3 previous games - Whack Your Neighbour, Burglars & Creeps.

name: Poly World
short_description: Poly World is a rhythm based game which combines amazing levels of different difficulty and carefully selected soundtracks.

name: Shadow Man
short_description: He is coming, stalking criminals in the spirit world and the real world. A possessed man is coming, a voodoo mask in his chest and lines of power in his back. Shadow Man is coming, trailing evil from Liveside to Deadside. To stop an apocalypse. To save your soul.

name: Forever Lost: Episode 1
short_description: Awaking in a mind you don’t know to a world you can’t remember. Surrounded by things that can’t be real, haunted by experiences long forgotten.

name: Galaxy V
short_description: You're an alien in outer space, hunting for new planets to conquer. However, it won't be easy. Standing in your way is a competing alien species' intelligence injection. Steal it, and win the battle for intelligence in outer space.

name: Protein for Muscle
short_description: Longing for muscles is one of the fundamental aspirations of humanity. Protein, which exists for muscles, is the only item we can trust. Steal protein without being found in machomen. It ’s easy.

name: DriftWay
short_description: DriftWay is the drifting simulator. If you love cars, engines and drifting this game is for you.

name: Extreme Soccer
short_description: Enjoy a 3 VS 3 street football game with players all around the world!

name: Castle Torgeath: Descent into Darkness
short_description: Castle Torgeath: Descent into Darkness is a unique blend of action, RPG, and survival in a 3D dungeon environment. Trapped in the dungeons of an ancient castle, you must scavenge for supplies, avoid traps, combat your foes, and confront the sinister threat that lurks within.

name: Tiki Trials
short_description: Undertake a fast-paced gauntlet of platforming challenge to appease the Tiki Gods! Jump, dash and sprint your way through 150 quick-fire trials. Gather shiny coins, buy funky masks, and beat the clock! Now with a Level Editor!

name: Annual Intruders 2.0
short_description: A home invasion horror game about participating in an annual challenge.

name: Nuclear Power Station Creator
short_description: Travel to Japan of the second half of the 20th century to get first-hand knowledge of how a nuclear power plants works.

name: Skyshine's BEDLAM
short_description: BEDLAM is a strategic turn-based strategy game set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. Now with more battle strategy!!

name: Remalmok
short_description: Remalmok- is a first person horror game.

name: Finding Kathy
short_description: Finding Kathy is a 3D brain puzzle game in which you have Limited Movements to Unlock the traps. Move around the tiles, Disarm traps, Collect naughty pieces of Kathy's photos, Complete a lewdness album, and Save her from the bad orcs.

name: The Legend of Protey
short_description: Step into the gooey metaphorical shoes of the least likely hero in gaming history, who must save his world from the greatest villain in gaming history!

name: Shadowplay: Metropolis Foe
short_description: Lead a band of lawless rebels and take the dark streets of StarCity in this fast-paced deck-building roguelike game, set in a cyberpunk world. Choose your next move carefully: every decision matters!

name: Snowballed: Crazy Downhill
short_description: Welcome to the snow adventure Snowballed: Crazy Downhill! Control a small snowball, which merrily rolls down the slope, and don't let it face big obstacles!

name: Once Upon A Death
short_description: Play as a sinister sorcerer who discovered the secret knowledge of necromancy. Raise an undead army, start a zombie apocalypse and seize the throne!

name: Tin Hearts: Prologue
short_description: Behind every brilliant invention, hides a magical story. Tin Hearts: Prologue is the first Act of the full new Tin Hearts game, set to release this winter.

name: Flaming Pixels
short_description: Do you want something bright, funny and a little crazy? We are pleased to introduce Flaming Pixels - simple yet incredibly exciting arcade platformer! Pixel characters and dynamic 8-bit music coupled with an excellent gameplay - take a dive into the retro atmosphere!

name: Trainiac
short_description: Shoot your way through enemies as you jump from train to train in this unique action game. The difficulty increases as you progress. Watch your back as you might encounter drive-by shootings. How far will you get?

name: Frontier of Fortune
short_description: Frontier of Fortune is the 10th episode of Fortune Chronicles, a strategic game of territorial dispute among countries/kingdoms in Fortune. Experience the fun and impressive Fortune series that has continued for 12 years.

name: VR Laser Harp
short_description: Simulation of the Laser Harp used from the 80's, with original samples taken from an Elka Synthex for the authentic experience. Change octaves and scales to provide a full keyboard, this is a close simulation including the limitations of that original system.

name: Rats - Time is running out!
short_description: Pressed for time?! Same for this rat, but he can manipulate it! Join RedEyes the Rat on the heist of his life. Sneak into the bank, steal the diamond, evade the guards . . . and then get out! But most of all, be clever, trick time, and take back what’s ours from the Pigs who control all the banks in Swine Island City.

name: 沉默沼泽
short_description: You are a policewoman, but with the occurrence of a murder you become a murderer! The victim is a master who loves you deeply! You're innocent! How should you deal with the sudden planting of false accusation? How do you escape? It all depends on your choice.

name: ARMORED CORE™ VI FIRES OF RUBICON™
short_description: A new action game based on the concept of the ARMORED CORE series that uses the knowledge gained from FromSoftware's recent action game development.

name: Constellation Distantia
short_description: Constellation Distantia is an action-adventure game with lightweight strategy and rpg elements. Player will unravel the story of Distantia in a game of missions, mining, crafting and surviving. And of course fast paced flying.

name: FarSky
short_description: FarSky is a short survival game in the depths of the Ocean. Collect all the pieces of your submarine and reach back the surface.

name: Gochi-Show! -How To Learn Japanese Cooking Game-
short_description: Japanese Cooking Everywhere.

name: Frequent Flyer: A Long Distance Love Story
short_description: Emi falls in love with Isobel on her vacation, but Isobel is hiding secrets that will shake Emi to her very core... do you trust her?

name: C.Q.C. - Close Quarters Combat
short_description: Fight in this action-packed, gory and fun top-down shooter against hordes of zombies, complete objectives and blaze your trail in 4 different settings. Stand your ground with up to four players in a local split-screen Co-Op match or fight against your friends in a variety of PvP maps.

name: Killing Time
short_description: As a trained assassin, all the battles that Hatsuki has been in will reappear in all kinds of ways. As the player, you hold her destiny, whether the game ends in NTR, pure love or even hold on to virginity, it’s all up to you!

name: Deadly Curse: Insane Nightmare
short_description: Deadly Curse: Insane Nightmare Edition is placing you in the midst of an action-packed adventure game where you are in control. You enter a mental hospital where doctors are experimenting on patients unlike never before. A priest is here to help the doctors without knowing the stuff they do to those patients.

name: Baby Shark VR Dancing
short_description: INDULGE YOUR KIDS IN AN UNDERWATER 360° ADVENTURE WITH BABY SHARK!

name: Longest Monday: Unveiling

name: Hipster Attack

name: Mountain Trap 2: Under the Cloak of Fear

name: The Heiress

name: Succubus Rem

name: Prison City

name: Stories of Blossom

name: Acceptance

Each player chooses his Hero, his spells, and jumps into battle. Pick up Halzae's essence in the arenas to fire up your spells, and fulfill the objectives.

name: Games of Glory

name: All For One
short_description: All For One is a fantasy-themed 'Zero-Sum Free-For-All'. When you defeat an enemy player, you gain all their accumulated experience points (XP), no matter how much stronger or weaker your foes are. Use experience points to unlock new abilities, weapons and skills so you can face stronger opponents.

name: Spheroid

name: KillStreak.tv

name: QuartoⒸ

name: Harald: A Game of Influence

You play as a man named Hector, who returns home after several years trying to escape his past. Every step will submerge you in a journey to discover Hector´s darkest secrets as he gets closer to the place that haunts him…

name: SUPERFIGHT
short_description: The hit card game goes digital with over SEVEN HUNDRED cards, including the Core, Blue, Purple, and Challenge Decks! Create fighters from random cards, then go head to head and argue over who would win in a fight. Unlock new content by playing a match with up to 4 players OR voting as a spectator!

name: Weapons of Mythology - New Age -
short_description: Enticing battles wait for you in Weapons of Mythology ~ New Age ~. Be ready to participate in exciting PVPs fights, epic boss hunts, and guild territory wars. Five character classes are available: Vajra, Ascension, Solar, Lotus and Mist. Choose yours and immerse yourself in this big open world, full of surprises and possibilities.

name: Remnants of a Beautiful Day

Use your Skills and Power-Ups to beat as many enemies as possible and collect diamonds to level up.

The Collider is a fast-paced and compelling arcade game that will put your reflexes to the test. Tune in with the energizing electronic music and beat your friends' high scores.

Fly through the skies as and blast your way through enemies with a more stratify based shooting system! Use guns, rockets, hover canons, and more and weave through hundreds of bullets!

Head to the level editor to make your own creations to share with the world. Search from an online repository of challenges people have published.

Transform a pristine beach into a popular travel destination by using strategic skill and economical thinking. Give free rein to your creativity!

short_description: Three ships, ten planets, thousands of people in danger and millions of meteors between them and you. short_description: Platfinity™, fast & easy game creation!

short_description: A collectible card game that combines the iconic world and characters of the Fable series with fast-paced tactical gameplay. Choose between Good and Evil to alter your special abilities and even the cards in your deck. Compete in leagues and events, or take on a boss with a friend in co-operative mode.

name: Abandoned
short_description: You wake up in a house, not knowing who or where you are or how you got there. First thing is to try and figure out how to get out. And while doing so...is what you are seeing real? Play to find out.

short_description: Welcome to Alpha/Omega: The Christian RPG! Play through the major events of the Bible, gather a party of angels, animal companions, and followers of the faith as you fight off real-life temptations in spiritual combat and explore a variety of game-inspired dreams.

name: Jaguar I-PACE Concept | Virtual Reality Experience

HTC Vive customers can now explore the design and engineering stories behind I-PACE Concept through a blend of cinematics and immersive VR technology.

Inspired by the content creator Fedmyster, feel the stress of editing, interact with your stream viewers and see how long you can keep them entertained while also maintaining your life and keeping up with your work.

name: Mad Machines
short_description: Smash, shoot and explode each other into blocks. Loot blocks for ammo, growth and repair. Custom games and 24h endless running Free-for-all PvP. Up to 20 players. Online multiplayer. Up to 10 players per match. Dedicated servers.

That leaves the other hand free for petting your pocket rabbit (if you have one) or defending yourself from wild bat attacks (if you have one).

name: 利刃 (Blade)

In order to sustain the colony, the player must gather resources found in the wild. With these resources, the player can build homes, mines, campfires, and mills which also generate resources.

name: Glass Wing

Each ship has a coloured shield that protects the player from bullets that are the same colour. Do customers love your product because of the beautiful things they see when they take it or do they need it, even if it has a bad effect on them?

name: Aeioth RPG
short_description: Aeioth was fashioned after classic MMORPG games, but we made it completely free and single. As the ruby system for in-app-purchases was discarded, you can now experience the world with no additional cost.

name: In Space We Brawl
short_description: In Space We Brawl is a frantic couch twin-stick shooter. Get ready for the excitement of pure local multiplayer matches for up to 4 players, including teams. Choose from more than 150 combinations of weapons and ships and conquer maps full of obstacles such as asteroids and black holes!

name: Mining Industry Simulator
short_description: Mining Industry Simulator provides insight to the everyday life of a business manager in the mining industry. And the best thing about it is: you're the boss!

name: Sol705
short_description: A new free graphic adventure in the spirit of good old classics from the '90s. Join this hilarious first episode lead by a group of mysterious friends looking to break out from school and spend the time at their secret research club.

name: Nanobotic
short_description: Nanobotic is a free to play first person shooter multiplayer online battle arena extravaganza (FPS MOBA). In Nanobotic you can craft weapon elements on the spot and switch between them with ease, you can also craft different types of artificially intelligent (AI) minions and control their actions.

name: Drum Simulator
short_description: The best drum kits for your PC! Record your own drum beats and play them back!

name: PAC-MAN™ and the Ghostly Adventures
short_description: Pac is back in an all-new experience for a whole new generation of fans. Featuring an original storyline inspired by the show as well as all the charming characters from the highly anticipated PAC-MAN and the Ghostly Adventures animated series created and produced by Avi Arad, acclaimed director and founder of Marvel Studios.

name: Gump
short_description: join doobie in his misadventure. a 2D arcade platform shooter.

name: AWAKE
short_description: Your goal ? SURVIVE ! Explore the island and tame the wilderness ! Find food and drink, collect ressources and craft ! WARNING: THIS GAME IS IN EARLY ACCESS, PLEASE BUY THIS GAME ONLY IF YOU WANT TO PARTICIPATE IN THE GAME DEVELOPMENT AND IF YOU ARE READY TO ENCOUNTER BUGS.

name: Campfire Pro
short_description: Complete your character design, plot manipulation, and worldbuilding all in one place. Designed to be a revolutionary tool for writers to plan out their stories, Campfire Pro has exactly what novelists and screenwriters need to go from the seed of an idea to a detailed plan that’s ready to be executed.

name: Twin Saga
short_description: Immerse yourself in a vivid and exciting anime world! For ages, the twin goddesses watched over mankind. Until one sister, in her lust for power, destroyed the delicate balance between the twins. Order has turned into chaos and it is up to you to fight for the future of all life!

name: Dead Stop
short_description: Dead Stop is a manic, mad-science filled zombie tower defence game that would even have Einstein reaching for his 'How to deal with a Zombie Invasion' handbook!

name: Manhunter
short_description: When John 'Striker' Gullivan left the SAS, he's been far from thinking about retirement. A skilled sniper, veteran of many covert operations, he was ready to take on the less legal side of the 'business'.

name: Just Fishing
short_description: A game with stunning graphics, realistic physics and system of fish behavior. Real tournaments and competitions, teams and ratings. Compete with other players. Defeat them all, be the best!

name: Juventus VR
short_description: Juventus VR: experience the Juventus universe in virtual reality.

name: Steamcraft
short_description: Steamcraft is a multiplayer shooter in a steampunk setting. Build a one-of-a-kind vehicle for land and air battles, equip it with weapons, and crush your foes!

name: Bunker - Nightmare Begins
short_description: Bunker (Nightmare Begins) experience, survive and escape, from a bunker where each of your games will be different from the previous one. Wander in the corridors where the darkness will not be your only enemy.

name: Chernobyl Commando
short_description: 26 years after a fatal accident in Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant that covered half of the Europe in clouds of radioactive smoke, a large group of terrorists took over the area, trying to steal all the remaining radioactive waste - and use it.

name: CABAL Online
short_description: The original revolution of action has arrived on Steam. Put your skills to the test in one of the most renowned action-oriented and diverse MMORPG experiences of all time. Play now for free!

name: Dodge
short_description: Use your mouse to move around the game area avoiding cubes and getting the highest score you can set. Your score only depends by your reflexes and skills, so if you lose, the bad is all yours. Enjoy!

name: Let the Cat in
short_description: Help little kittens to get into the house, reach their favorite basket and fall asleep. To do this, you need to arrange all the things and mechanisms inside the house for creating fantastic chain reactions, in order to open the door!

name: Sanctus Mortem
short_description: Millennia in the future, an interstellar war between the Zinethian Confederation and the Thrasik Empire has erupted leaving entire sectors a spaceship graveyard. Equipped with more advanced weaponry, the Zinethian Confederation is on the verge of winning the war, but all is not as it seems.

name: Fly to KUMA MAKER
short_description: 'New stages are packed with contraptions to block the Kuma's progress! Solve the puzzles to get the Kuma to their destination! Try your hand at designing your own stages with Maker Mode! Make your own original stages and share them for players world wide to try!

name: Naught Reawakening
short_description: Play with gravity to guide Naught through a mysterious underground world where darkness is a relentless enemy that takes many forms. Naught Reawakening is an adventure and platform game that challenges your skills giving you full control of Naught and his environment.

name: Blessed Ones: The Magic Wolves
short_description: Blessed Ones: The Magic Wolves is a silly little fairy tale about wolves (magic ones, obviously) and pigs and adventurers, coming in the form of a japanese-style RPG focused on strategic turn-based combat and party building. It is goofy, flexible, difficult, emergent, and open, in more ways than you might expect!

name: Dungeon Hunter Champions
short_description: Rally your Champions and lead the charge to save the Multiverse from the greatest threat it has ever known. Switch easily between PC and Mobile devices, and keep fighting wherever you go with this cross-platform hack 'n' slash!

name: Time of Dragons
short_description: This is an MMO shooter where you ride dragons armed with missiles and lasers!

name: Everyday Lite
short_description: Manage a Faerie colony and cook delicious food for them using a deep cooking system which allows for custom recipes and experimentation!

name: Chronicles of a Dark Lord: Tides of Fate Remastered
short_description: The world of Cora beckons once again in this HD Remaster of the game that began the saga of the Dark Lord, Magus Drakhen Lee!

name: Rebirth Fantasy
short_description: Rebirth Fantasy is an open world MMORPG, Explore a world of fantasy where Monsters, goblins and dragons exist. Play the way you want, create skills, craft items, fight different monsters and explore anywhere without being blocked on a story progression!

name: And You're There, Too
short_description: And You’re There, Too is an ongoing collaborative experience that asks people around the world to quickly describe the future they dream about for themselves. No two playthroughs will be the same.

name: Disney's The Jungle Book
short_description: Play as the man-cub, Mowgli, an orphan raised by a pack of wolves in the jungle. No parents. No school. No problems. Great life, huh? Except, there’s a rumour that Shere Khan, the man-eating tiger is coming after you. You’ve got to swing your way through the jungle and reach the man-village.

name: Uplands Motel: VR Thriller
short_description: Trapped in a lonely motel, after your car breaks down in the middle of nowhere, you'll have to do everything you can to get out of there before it's too late. Be the protagonist of your own action thriller in virtual reality.

name: Land of Dread
short_description: Land of Dread is an isometric colony simulator with an emphasis on gathering resources, building resource-generating structures, and fighting hostile demons. Upgrade existing structures, assign jobs to colonists, and invest gold into resource imports.

name: Deep Noise
short_description: Deep Noise is a top down survival horror game off a submersible sonar. A crew exploring Europa went missing and your vessel stopped working. You must find power, air, and the messages in the depths of Europa.

name: Deer Hunter: Reloaded
short_description: Deer Hunter is Back! Deer Hunter: Reloaded is a 1st person hunting simulation game based off of the #1 hunting franchise in the World. Deer Hunter will provide an authentic hunting experience for players as they venture to some of the top-rated hunting regions in North America from the plains of West Texas to the rugged terrain of Alaska.

name: Scroll2Read
short_description: This unique game is a simplified 3d-person action game whose defining feature is singing. The player works to defeat dangerous magical creatures and protect the cursed city of Highwoods armed with only a mouse and microphone. The Empire needs your voice!

name: Heal Them All
short_description: Vicious germs strike again! Face them and repel the invasion in Heal Them All – an addictive Tower Defense game!

name: How To Make Your Grandpa Happy
short_description: How to Make Your Grandpa Happy is a short experimental game about being a granddaughter who tries to repair her grandpa’s photo album. Put the photos in the right place to help the grandpa remember the past!

name: つんつんVR / TSUN-TSUN VR
short_description: The world of Ready Player One has finally come! In TSUN-TSUN VR, you can feel as if you are really poked by a girl. Through the real touch experience, TSUN-TSUN VR has realized the most immersive experience ever.

name: Gnomes & Goblins (preview)
short_description: Explore the interactive fantasy world of Gnomes & Goblins from Jon Favreau, produced by Wevr in collaboration with Reality One. Interact with an enigmatic resident and take a first step into the lucid dream of Gnomes & Goblins and its many realms and denizens.

name: Rebellion Corporation
short_description: On planets occupied by robots, mine resources and escape while fending off their attacks! The Ark's survival is entirely in your hands. Many elite crews with abilities will assist you in your mission. The various turret modules are always doing their best to defend your base without your attention.

name: Whisker Squadron: Survivor
short_description: A cosmic roguelite on-rails shooter with wild 30-minute runs that will take your feline flight crew to thrilling new heights with each randomized adventure. Your plan is simple: wreak vengeance on the Swarm and try to survive.

name: LAB.AR
short_description: Narrative sci-fi horror quest. Travel to the mysterious research center as a Dr. Robert O`Neil on his mission to reveal old secrets of Howard Deus, the renowned researcher of cancer who died by mystical circumstances.

name: Affogato
short_description: Affogato is a RPG featuring a unique 'reverse tower defense' mechanic. Play as a sorceress managing a café in Arorua. Meet customers from all walks of life, hear their stories and travel into their minds to help them defeat their inner demons. Experience a city life that exudes magic and excitement.

name: Astronaut: The Best
short_description: Astronaut: The Best is an occult management adventure where people aren't just numbers: they're incompetent screwups. Your duty is to turn them into national heroes, or the government will have you killed.

name: Great North Shelter 2
short_description: Great North Shelter 2 combines humor, horror and unusual game mechanics. Unearth dark secrets, experience paranormal encounters, and delight in surprising interactions as you journey through this atmospheric walking simulator.

name: Escape Space
short_description: Fight. Customize. Upgrade. Fight back! In Escape Space, you're a mercenary and do contract missions for/against different factions to earn a living. Use that cash to upgrade and unlock new weapons & mods to get stronger the more you play!

name: Mini Knight's Journey
short_description: Mini Knight's Journey is a linear action-adventure platformer game about two twin brothers who, with their father, go on a journey to defeat the school bullies! Play as one of the two brothers and face this incredible adventure!

name: Fallen Guns
short_description: Stand still and shoot in slow motion, walk and time returns to normal. Perfect shots and correct timings are what you're looking for in Fallen Guns.

name: Sengoku Dynasty
short_description: Build and manage villages in an open-world feudal Japan. Survive, explore, meet unique characters, and establish your legacy. Play solo or in co-op multiplayer.

name: Shadow Gambit: The Cursed Crew
short_description: Welcome to the Lost Caribbean! In this stealth strategy game, join a ghost ship with a living soul and assemble a cursed pirate crew. Embrace magical powers to defy the menacing army of the Inquisition, who stands between you and the mysterious treasure of the legendary Captain Mordechai.

name: Desynced
short_description: Desynced is a sci-fi strategy game with fully customizable units and behaviors. Gather, build, research, and explore the unknown. Alone or with friends, unveil the mystery of an AI on the edge of self-awareness and uncover the hidden truth in this blend of strategy, automation, and exploration.

name: War and Peace
short_description: The classic board game War and Peace comes alive on your computer. Be Napoleon – or stand against him – in a series of short scenarios that cover the epic battles of the age from 1796 on, or in a multiplayer-only grand campaign that may – or may not – end on the field of Waterloo.

name: Maces and Dices
short_description: Maces and Dices is a turned based rogue-like where dice decide what actions you can take, but it is up to you to make the most out of every roll. When both your healthbar and available actions consist of dice, you better hope that you have brought the right ones.

name: Daymare: 1994 Sandcastle
short_description: Daymare: 1994 Sandcastle is a third-person story-driven survival horror game prequel to the critically acclaimed Daymare: 1998. Step into the shoes of agent Dalila Reyes, a former government spy now in the service of H.A.D.E.S. unit and prepare to face the true horror.

name: Charrua Soccer - Pro Edition
short_description: With lots of action and adrenaline, Charrua Soccer is an arcade that brings you only the most fun part of soccer! Play friendly matches, tournaments or create your team and lead it to glory in career mode! Have fun playing alone or with friends, in competitive or cooperative mode!

name: En Garde!
short_description: En Garde! – the swashbuckler action game! Battle graceless guards and nefarious noblemen in fast-paced fights full of spectacle. Use the environment, your wit and your blade to teach them all a lesson!

name: X Invader
short_description: Become the master hacker 'X' and hack into the digital world. Utilize various weapons and hacking add-ons to create your own combat build. Wipe out the incoming enemies with exhilarating hack and slash action!

name: Hammer of Virtue
short_description: A hammer-smashing action game with fully destructible environments. use your hammer for combat or smash the environment to launch debris towards your enemy to create emergent and chaotic gameplay interactions in a wild adventure.

name: Eris Dysnomia
short_description: Eris finds herself alone in a world full of monsters with a scythe and a gun as her only means of protection. Join her on her journey as she battles her way through a swarm of enemies to reach her goal!

name: Space Mechanic Simulator
short_description: Become a Space Mechanic! Get your hands dirty, explore the depths of space and repair broken machinery. Diagnose problems using diagrams and tools, perform repairs, manage your resources and watch the simulated machinery come alive. Or just gaze upon the beauty of the Solar System.

name: The Last Seal
short_description: When a presumed to be extinct race starts wreaking havoc, Joan and Cadel begin what will be the journey of their lives.

name: For the Crown
short_description: Immerse yourself in the captivating world of 'For the Crown'! Choose a perfect settlement location, construct buildings, and shape a majestic kingdom. Expand your city wisely, forging a glorious empire. Are you ready to conquer 'For the Crown'?

name: Jumplight Odyssey
short_description: Keep hope alive on your adventure to the mythical Forever Star! Gather survivors, repair and build out your starship, brave black holes, and fend off attacks, all while managing the daily soap opera of your colorful crew.

name: Crow's Nest
short_description: Embark on a journey in this city builder game, crafting and managing your own pirate island. Keep your crews satisfied and your captives in check, all while sending your ships out to gather gold from your nautical adventures.

name: Chickenoidz Super Party
short_description: Chickenoidz Super Party - multiplayer top-down arena shooter for up to 4 players. You can play local or altogether online via Remote Play. Steal the show using an array of incredible weapons, special equipment and even mutations. Smash your opponents to smithereens, rip everything around you.

name: Journey to the West Survivor
short_description: 'Journey to the West Survivors' is a survival game. You can choose from 12 interesting characters and combine various playstyles among over 200 skills. Additionally, you can get married, cultivate crops, build structures, recruit partners, and work together to fight against enemies.

name: Project Hunt
short_description: It is a semi-realistic hunting game. Animals are shot and killed with guns. The shot review shows animal detail and the bullet's hit.

name: Million Monster Militia
short_description: ROGUELIKE MILITIA RECRUITMENT SIM ⚪ Assemble a rag-tag army. ⚪ Liberate America from big boss demons. ⚪ Create game-breaking synergies!

name: Mondealy
short_description: Embark on a cute top-down pixel adventure/puzzle in the fantasy kingdom beneath your hometown. Inspired by Undertale and Oneshot. The free demo is available below.

name: The Danger Zone
short_description: The Danger Zone is a post-apocalyptic 2.5D shooter with a side view and elements of survival in the unique style of 'eternal sunset'.

name: Dragon Princess is Hungry
short_description: Eva, the half-dragon, half-human princess. Pfel, the steward, who serves Eva. They visit a mysterious isolated island infested with monster girls, and Pfel collects food for Eva on the island. However, there is a secret hidden on the island.

name: Pure Gore (Sandbox&Playground)
short_description: Pure Gore is a 2D physics action sandbox & people playground simulation, where you can build your own world.You can create or use pre-built vehicles, machinery, rockets, bombs and most importantly mutilate melons (fruit) with one of the over 100 elements. Its a steam port!

name: Tales & Tactics
short_description: Roguelike Squad-based Autobattler in a Tabletop RPG setting. Draft your army, carefully equip and position your units, make important choices, and meet a colorful cast of characters as you make ready for the Grand Tournament.

name: SAIVO
short_description: !!Caution! This Game is stillborn. It died during development!! SAIVO is a short (10min) story. You play as Desmond Holeman. His family disappeared in Finland 41 years ago. Desmond is a workaholic. His wife has pressured him to go to Finland to unplug at his family's old cabin.

name: NecroNomNomNom: Eldritch Horror Dating
short_description: Plunge into the depths of sanity and Lovecraftian lore in this Eldritch Horror Dating Visual Novel. Will you find love or madness?

name: Synthwave Racers
short_description: Race at hypersonic speeds. Drift through physics-defying courses. Customize your Rider. Jam out to melodic Synthwave music tracks. Play alone offline, race your friend's ghosts, or duke it out online against other players in Synthwave Racers.

name: Age of Reforging:The Freelands
short_description: Age of Reforging: The Freelands is a medieval fantasy sandbox, strategy, and survival RPG. Players will take on the role of a 'reforger' chosen by the goddess of fate, growing and expanding their party on a journey through a vast land of opportunity - the Freelands - to adventure as they wish!

name: BANCHOU TACTICS
short_description: Banchou Tactics is a strategy turn based role-playing game in the Japanese Gangster High School

name: Swarmcade
short_description: Survive the relentless swarm in this arcade take on the Bullet Heaven'/Survivors-like Action Roguelite. Slay 1000s of foes, level up, loot chests and make your character more powerful than ever. Unlock perma-upgrades and more heroes, so you can even the odds on future runs.

name: Breaking Box
short_description: Breaking Box is a 3D multiplayer game with a level editor in-game. You can create your own levels, challenge levels, and enjoy the competition with friends!

name: Deathbulge: Battle of the Bands
short_description: A role-playing game featuring musical themes with an affinity for the sick and ridiculous. The story revolves around a deadly battle of the bands contest, where entrants can attack and be attacked with music.

name: Dungeon and Craft
short_description: In this adventure with a total of 6 weapons, you will produce your own weapons and turn the mushrooms you collect from the forest into pots that you can sell. In the dungeons, you will fight against challenging creatures for 16 waves and improve your character.

name: Nowhere: Mysterious Artifacts
short_description: Nowhere: Mysterious Artifacts is a Multiplayer Survival Horror game for up to 4 players. Set in the Middle of the Unknown, you can craft, build, explore and discover secrets in the exciting first chapter from EFNSOFT.

name: Six Ages 2: Lights Going Out
short_description: Life after myths. Death, disaster, despair. A standalone survival-storybook combining interactive fiction and turn-based strategy. The world is ending, and your small clan’s survival depends on how you manage its relationship with the remaining gods and their followers.

name: Penny Larceny: Gig Economy Supervillain
short_description: A comic book adventure of freelance supervillainy, petting cats, and/or destroying capitalism in which your choices determine success in a series of daring heists and capers.

name: Lawgivers II
short_description: Lawgivers II is a political sandbox game that features multiple electoral systems, approve/reject bills and govern a country. Start out your career from the very bottom, and perhaps one day, lead your nation to become the most influential in the world.

name: Cannibals
short_description: A father tells his daughter a story about cannibals he met in his youth. The story depends entirely on your actions, but not every plot development will suit your daughter...

name: Brie Parmesan Mysteries
short_description: Sneak past guards, follow the cheese, find evidence in this isometric stealth adventure. Play as Brie Parmesan, a master detective and a rat working to undermine the criminal underworld of Chicatgo. Can you find enough evidence to solve case and bring the Cat Meowfia to justice?

name: City of Murals
short_description: City of Murals is a cute and gross, action-platformer, rogue-lite. Explore a colorful world with violent and non-violent guns, special traversal abilities, and creatures that range from friendly to deadly. The world is competing to see who can live the longest. How long will you survive?

name: Lambda Spellcrafting Academy
short_description: Develop magical programming abilities while building spells. Lambda Spellcrafting Academy is a card-based puzzle game where you build spells (programs) to solve puzzles. Fun for complete beginners or professional wizards.

name: Top Villain: Total Domination
short_description: How would you conquer the world? In this text-based supervillain rpg, you can vanquish your nemesis, fight heroes and villains, and find yourself!

name: Great Houses of Calderia
short_description: Great Houses of Calderia is a Feudal Grand Strategy game focusing on family dynamics & stories. Use your family strengths to compete against rivals to rise in the ranks of Calderia - produce, trade, scheme, bribe, and battle to build your legacy of power!

name: Kodama Battles
