short_description: Singleplayer AutoChess Roguelite with a jolly bunch of Kodamas to collect, gather and upgrade. Build an unique team with unexpected synergies, try new playstyles each run and become king of the moonlight forest!

name: An Ankou
short_description: Death is not the end. You’ve been chosen as the Ankou, a servant of Death who aids lost souls using the tools of your old trade. Roam haunted lands to find resources, craft weapons, and slay hordes of demons in this action-exploration roguelike.

name: UFO: Unidentified Falling Objects
short_description: Unidentified Falling Objects is a unique mashup of platforming and puzzle destroying gameplay. Players are dropped into the puzzle where they must dodge the falling obstacles and destroy blocks to make big combos.

name: Pocket Bravery
short_description: Inspired by classic fighting games from the 90's such as Street Fighter, Fatal Fury and The King of Fighters, 'Pocket Bravery' channels the 'Neo Geo Pocket' aesthetic for a modern fighting game with a retro twist!

name: 九霄风云录 Legends Of The Divine Land
short_description: This is a deck-building Roguelike game with simple operation but super playability. How to play: Select a level to break through, and after passing the level, choose a fellow Taoist to join the team. Daoists will have skills to increase each other's attack power, choose the team reasonably.

name: BOOK OF HOURS
short_description: Restore a crumbling occult library by a winter sea. Build the world’s foremost collection of grimoires and arcana. Master the invisible arts. BOOK OF HOURS is a narrative crafting RPG set in a 1930s world of hidden gods and secret histories. What sort of Librarian will you choose to be?

name: Seonbi : Scholar of Joseon
short_description: Seonbi : Scholar of Joseon is a side-scrolling action rogue-lite game that features an unnamed scholar who want to correct the chaos in the Joseon Dynasty after the end of the Imjin War.

name: Doll Explorer
short_description: Doll Explorer is a turn-based strategy game in which players conquer dungeons by combining various actions such as 'take one step forward' and 'attack in front of player'. The adventures of Tia the witch, Doll the magical life form, and Lilith the princess of the demon tribe begin!

name: Touhou Juuouen 〜 Unfinished Dream of All Living Ghost.
short_description: 東方Project第19弾は、対戦型弾幕シューティング！ ダークで元気いっぱいで、ちょっぴり可愛い妖獣たちの狂宴をお楽しみに。

name: Sven - Completely Screwed
short_description: Play the passionate, immoral ram Sven and try to bring every sheep from the flock to their climax - but don’t get caught by shepherd Lars and his trusty dog Wotan in the process! Spunkier and hotter than ever before!

name: TICKDOWN
short_description: You have two real-time hours to locate and defuse a weapon of mass destruction. Use the powers of Water, Earth, Fire, and Air to fight your way through hordes of enemies to reach your objective.

name: GINSHA
short_description: GINSHA is a unique atmospheric pixelart Action Adventure Platformer with special Gravity Shield and Dash Mechanics. It combines a versatile Platformer core with RPG, Souls and Crafting Elements to an Anomaly among Metroidvania games.

name: The Devil's Face
short_description: The Devil's Face offers a unique and unforgettable experience, taking you on a journey into the afterlife. The atmosphere is hauntingly nostalgic, reminiscent of classic horror games but with a fresh and modern twist.

name: Sunkenland
short_description: Get ready for a Waterworld-themed survival game with modular base building, sunken city scavenging, crafting, base defense, and invasions of NPC clans for resources and territory. Ready for the water apocalypse?

name: BlazBlue Entropy Effect
short_description: Experience the brilliant action combat gameplay! The pinnacle of roguelite action games!

name: Seven Nights Ghost
short_description: 'Peaceful days full of curses' A heartwarming horror game about exploring in a mysterious company housing and living with a ghost for 7 days

name: Wyrd Gun
short_description: A roguelite looter shooter about breeding guns and leveling up to survive hoards of creatures on a strange planet!

name: Captains of the Wacky Waters
short_description: Sail across the Wacky Waters to reach Heaven alive. Loot, shoot and defeat other captains as you find more crew members and upgrade your ship with new cannons and crazy gadgets. Sink. Repeat.

name: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® II
short_description: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® II drops players into an unprecedented global conflict that features the return of the iconic Operators of Task Force 141.

name: Retchid
short_description: You are a TEC Engineer from Earth ordered to retrieve and return sensitive data from the TEC Mining Facility on Titan. On arrival, you discover that the facility has been invaded by beings from another realm. Contend with these abominations as you complete your mission and escape Titan.

name: The Black Pool
short_description: In the forest outside of town, four friends discover a mysterious black pool that transports them to an unknown world. To fight their way home, they must unlock and master supernatural abilities. Play cooperative or solo in this high-paced action game of skill that varies each session.

name: HiveCorp
short_description: Join the HiveCorp mercenaries in their fight against an onslaught of enemies in this action rogue-lite auto-shooter. Avoid enemies, level up and combine powerful weapons and equipment to survive.

name: Binding of Elements
short_description: In this action-rougelike game you'll have to survive waves of monsters and fight against bosses. You'll be able to combine different elements to get unique abilities and arm yourself against the challenges. Choose from a variety of upgrades and improve your character or abilities.

name: Under The Waves
short_description: Stan, a professional diver in the North Sea, is struggling to overcome a life-changing loss during an extended mission underwater. Stuck in his self-imposed solitude, he starts to experience strange events and will have to make the most significant choice of his life...

name: Bodhi 'n' Friends
short_description: Your old friend you co-founded a game studio with has contacted you 4 years after the studio shut down and you both parted ways following a major controversy. He tells you he's got the studio set back up again and would love to discuss a new game project with you. What could it be?

name: Dash Cup Kickers
short_description: Super fast paced arcade action soccer with incredible power dashes, sweet mega tricks and unbelieveable powerful super shots! Master all tricks, skill up your team, develop the best technique and earn gold in all cups! Play online or locally with up to 4 players in varying stadiums

name: Mist Slayer
short_description: Mist Slayer is an action Roguelite game. You are a time traveling hero, called to aid in a mystical war, and armed with unique weapons and skills. Face down amazing enemies in parallel universes, collecting various power-ups, and exploring as you go. Play alone or team up with friends.

name: Paper Planet
short_description: Paper Planet is a planet-defender, arcade roguelike with a doodley, Flash-inspired artstyle. Battle through waves of unique enemies and bosses. Combine items with strange and wacky effects for insanely overpowered runs. Play with 1-4 players, for some chaotic co-op fun!

name: Shotgun Knight
short_description: Shotgun Knight is a hardcore precision platformer. You will embark on an impossible climb with nothing but yourself and a shotgun to propel yourself upwards while falling losing all your progress countless times.

name: ghostpia Season One
short_description: 'In my dreams, I can get out. In my dreams, I can fit in.' 'ghostpia' mixes the adorable art style of an illustrated book with glitches-and-noise effects. There are no choices to be made. There's only a lonely girl in a ghost town and her story full of mystery, friendhood...and a bit of violence.

name: Metavaxx
short_description: The world's first minesweeper shooter. Identify infected cells, peacefully clear your way around them... or shoot 'em down and face the consequences.

name: Looper Tactics
short_description: Welcome again, wandering soul. Will this be the time of your success? Watch your steps as you advance in this roguelike-deck builder and engage in auto-battler card encounters of increasing difficulty. Get stronger in each battle, rise from the ashes, and break free from endless reincarnation!

name: The Matchless Kungfu
short_description: The Matchless Kungfu is an open world sandbox RPG game based on a WuXia background. You can play any martial arts role you imagine in this wild world. Travel through the great wilderness, or be the leader of the group. The most important thing is, build your own story and live the experience!

name: Hello Engineer: Scrap Machines Constructor
short_description: Build incredible machines with scrap parts, navigate the wildest Amusement park rides and challenge iconic creepy Neighbor and his evil bots! Become a true Engineer, solo or with friends!

name: Smurfs Kart
short_description: Who will be the fastest Smurf in town? That is the question you will need to answer in this dynamic kart racing game in the world of Smurfs!

name: Rev to Vertex
short_description: Rev to Vertex (R2V) is in Early Access now! Immerse yourself in the virtual racing ground. Explore the vibrant hills and shimming metropolis of Hong Kong. Realistic driving physics and battle system. Defeat rivals and race your way to the top.

name: It's a Wrap!
short_description: It's a Wrap! is a challenging puzzle game about making movies in 1980s Hollywood. Figure out the perfect timing of props, actors, and special effects as the Director. Then jump into the scene as the movie's star in a traditional 2D platformer.

name: Voidside
short_description: Voidside is a high-octane Parkour FPS in which you jump around locations pulled out of time, unlock powerful new weapons and fight massive hordes of enemies all while trying to get a high score!

name: Hammerwatch II
short_description: Gather your heroes and journey beyond the dungeons of Castle Hammerwatch to explore a pixelated world like never before. Aid King Roland’s resistance while helping villagers along the way. Battle beasts, finish off hordes of the undead, and face the forces of evil.

name: Notes of my silence
short_description: Plunge into the silence with Stephan, young musician that lost his hearing and, at the same time, the meaning of life.

name: Station 37
short_description: Dive into the immersive world of STATION 37, a retro shooter where you'll face off against mutated creatures and security bots in the decaying remains of a once-great research facility.

name: Ship Graveyard Simulator 2
short_description: Dust off your torch and hammer - it's time to get back to work, you have a new job to do. Visit the new beach coast with the largest, biggest ship graveyard in the world, dismantle huge ship parts and collect tons of precious steel. Roll up your sleeves, it's time to get back to the business.

name: Samurai Vandalism
short_description: The land of Yamato is filled with cruel rebels, oppressive nobles, and dangerous monsters. Fight as a Hozuki samurai to bring justice to the land!

name: Magocracy: Experimentation
short_description: The first Flying Third Person Shooter where you can customize everything.

name: 拾光集
short_description: 一个生活跌入谷底的男人，阴差阳错的穿越回90年代，重新遇到自己的亲人与朋友。 改变吧！用这仅有一次的机会！你的每一次选择都只有一次，且无比重要！

name: My Little Sister Fiona
short_description: My Little Sister Fiona is a short kinetic novel about a brother taking care of his reclusive little sister. How far will you go to make sure she feels safe and protected?

name: Stone Age: Digital Edition
short_description: Forge your way through the early days of recorded history and build the foundation of human civilization. How bright is humanity's future? It depends on You! Lead your Tribe through the Stone Age!

name: Fate Chapter 2 : The Beginning
short_description: Fate chapter 2 is a psychological horror game from the first person perspective and offers a complete story and experience. The game includes many different regions and puzzles. See you right around and solve the mystery and the most important SURVIVE!

name: Robotherapy
short_description: An emotional dark comedy about robots doing therapy. In Robotherapy, you're a robot therapist in a dystopian society that killed all the humans, but is still not happy. Treat patients, meet weird robots and enter their minds. If killing all humans doesn't bring happiness, then what does?

name: VIDEOVERSE
short_description: Relive the days of past social gaming networks and dive into this fictional video game era, where the 'Kinmoku Shark’ gaming system and its online social network 'Videoverse' were still popular…

name: Strategic Mind: Spirit of Liberty
short_description: Prove to have a true Strategic Mind! Spirit of Liberty will put your strategic planning skills to the test. It’s a hardcore, turn-based, historically accurate strategy game set in WWII. Lead Finnish forces against an overwhelming threat through the Winter War, Continuation War, and Lapland War.

name: Meta Sudoku
short_description: Meta Sudoku is a minimalist game, fresh interface and quiet music is very suitable for relaxation, reduce fatigue, give you the most comfortable experience.

name: I Am Future: Cozy Apocalypse Survival
short_description: I Am Future is a relaxing survival game about building a cozy rooftop camp amid a flooded post-apocalyptic city. Set up a farm, cook delicious food, dismantle tools for crafting resources, automate chores by recruiting cute robots, and uncover the mystery behind the catastrophe.

name: Jolly Roger
short_description: A short BL Visual Novel about romance and pirates.

name: Command Heroes
short_description: Mullets, missiles, and monsters fly in a hectic, intergalactic resource race. Build bases, command troops, pilot vehicles, elemental artifacts supercharge weapons, level up, upgrade almost anything, and master unique hero abilities. Multiple game modes keep strategies fresh. Choose your side.

name: Poached : Hunt The Hunter
short_description: As a game ranger, use your expert tracking skills and cunning to outsmart invading poachers.

name: Art Reborn: Painting Connoisseur
short_description: Dear curator, you are about to embark on a journey to captivate the audience! You will be in charge of an art gallery.Impress the museum curators around the world with these masterpieces, collect badges, apply for support funds, and learn the value of art!

name: Dust Fleet
short_description: Assume command of a battle fleet and deploy immediately to the Dust Zone, commander. Our main food supply station has gone dark and the United Earth Nations (UEN) needs to know why in this 4X RTS space sim. Manage your ships, control space stations, and watch your back.

name: STANDBOX
short_description: STANDBOX is a single-player physics sandbox about bullying a ragdoll. Shoot him, push him, watch him get back up until he doesn't.

name: Moving In
short_description: Moving In is about relaxing in a cozy environment. You decorate the house you are moving in. There is no goal, no timer, no challenges. It is all about having a relaxing experience.

name: The Wratch's Den
short_description: A byte-sized Dungeon Keeping roguelike: dig out your lair, populate it with monsters and protect the Wratch from heroes come for easy prestige.

name: Combat Beans: Total Mayhem
short_description: Battle online in frantic third person arena-based combat. Customize your bean with unique cosmetics and bully your buddies across multiple game modes.

name: Kingdom Incremental
short_description: Kingdom Incremental is a satirical city builder and incremental game. To be the wealthiest ruler, you must build a fortified settlement and balanced economy, strategically invest in upgrades, and expand your kingdom across the globe! Then burn everything down to start again with even more power!

name: Untamed Tactics
short_description: Untamed Tactics is a Tactical RPG set in world of colorful animals. Relive the legend of Greycoat’s escape into the untamed Wilds in a tale of lost honor and finding a new home as you fight, talk, and think your way through this beautifully illustrated adventure!

name: Fort Solis
short_description: Fort Solis a riveting story-driven thriller on the Red Planet.

name: Rap Attack!
short_description: Tour around the world and become a rap star in this fun 2D pixel-art platformer!

name: Block Buster Billy
short_description: An alien family had a picnic on Billy's island. They had to leave in a hurry, causing Junior to forget his cubes. Can you help Billy figure out the mind-boggling alien puzzles?

name: JumpPower
short_description: A Alien(maybe) Want Broke Fuse. It need jump and jump to touch the fuse to broke it. Every Jump Will Have Some Risk Of Falling. If no adapt the jump range, every jump and pray is same.

name: Russian Village Simulator
short_description: This is a simulator of life in the Russian countryside, where the player will be engaged in the garden, picking mushrooms and berries, collect firewood, hunting and fishing, brew moonshine and much, much more.

name: Dangeresque: The Roomisode Triungulate
short_description: Join Dangeresque, the world's greatest private eye/crooked cop, as he puzzles his way through 3 bite-sized roomisodes in this classic-style point n' click adventure.

name: Lifeless Moon
short_description: During an expedition to the Moon, two astronauts find themselves in a familiar town back on Earth. They soon discover the town is the beginning of a strange and mysterious journey...

name: Garten of Banban 4
short_description: Explore the abandoned levels of Banban’s Kindergarten. Survive the residents of the establishment that was left suspiciously empty. Uncover the truth behind the place, and find the whereabouts of your missing child…

name: Bomb Rush Cyberfunk
short_description: Bomb Rush Cyberfunk is 1 second per second of advanced funkstyle. Battle rival crews and dispatch militarized police to conquer the five boroughs of New Amsterdam. Become All City.

name: SolarBlack
short_description: SolarBlack is an action-rhythm game made exclusively for VR where you slice and shoot to the beat to defeat an other-worldly threat. Immerse yourself in new worlds and experience the music in every pulsating atom.

name: Until Last Tomorrow
short_description: UNTIL LAST TOMORROW is an open world action and adventure game that takes place here in Brazil, in the city of Goiânia, in an extremely dangerous environment, where you will have to survive the pandemic that has taken over the world.

name: High Sea Saga DX
short_description: Set sail and join yer crew in search of treasure and glory!

name: Agatha Christie - Hercule Poirot: The London Case
short_description: Hercule Poirot is back in a brand-new adventure, set in the heart of London.

name: Elemental Odyssey
short_description: Elemental Odyssey is 2D platformer where you need to RUN, JUMP, SLIDE, AVOID TRAPS, and don't let the game make you mad!!

name: SPRAWL
short_description: SPRAWL is a hardcore retro FPS set in an endless cyberpunk megalopolis. Escape the walled city and take on the militarized government of the sprawl. Fueled by the blood of your enemies and a mysterious voice in your head, make your way towards the spire to topple whatever lays within.

name: Love Too Easily
short_description: A memory of a sweet kiss from last night. A lost cell phone. Three suspects. Become the main character's helper, make story choices, collect hints, and clear mini-games. A full-scale mystery romantic comedy interactive movie.

name: Kill The Crows
short_description: 'Kill The Crows' is a fast-paced top-down arena shooter set in the twisted western world. A gunslinger burning with vengeance steps into the ruins of a forsaken town, ready to face death. Prepare for one-shot, one-kill gunfights using classic revolvers and fanning techniques.

name: Pirate Dragons
short_description: PLAY A DRAGON in this third-person, action RPG! During the time of sailing ships and piracy, you are a dragon. Grow your hoard by battling sailing ships, trading goods, or becoming a pirate!

name: Goodbye Volcano High
short_description: Goodbye Volcano High is a cinematic narrative adventure about love, change, and the end of the world. Guide Fang through their final year of high school as they try to make things right before time is up.

name: To The Core
short_description: To The Core is an incremental game about extracting and using resources from planets to buy upgrades.

name: GanaBlade
short_description: This is a hot barrage shooting game. Destroy enemy planes with powerful firepower, shuttle and evade in the barrage. Various scenes with rich colors Planets, Fire Stars, Jupiter Stars, Water Stars, and huge battleships. It's time to drive a space fighter and show your strength! !

name: Adam
short_description: Adam is a realistic sci-fi themed game that combines the Rogue-Like and FPS genres. As a betrayed soldier, the player fights for revenge against his enemies. Get ready to destroy your enemies by powering up your own robot! Now you can play CO-OP mode!

name: Verne: The Shape of Fantasy
short_description: Become Jules Verne and adventure into the dangers that hide in Hemera, a fantastic parallel world built from his own imagination. Explore, solve puzzles and unlock the most coveted secret of the mighty Atlantis.

name: Rush for the Ages
short_description: Remake history and race your opponents for a complete and glorious timeline in this lightning-fast card game.

name: Flopparena
short_description: A chaotic mixture of third person, melee fighting, physics-based combat, and lots of enemies. Fight to stand victorious in this tabletop combat game!

name: Wayfinder
short_description: Become a Wayfinder, and unlock their powers as you choose your path and playstyle while pushing back a hostile force that has overtaken your world. Control the Chaos as you directly shape and customize the endless adventures you go on with friends, because Wayfinders are stronger together.

name: Sea of Stars
short_description: Sea of Stars is a turn-based RPG inspired by the classics. It tells the story of two Children of the Solstice who will combine the powers of the sun and moon to perform Eclipse Magic, the only force capable of fending off the monstrous creations of the evil alchemist known as The Fleshmancer.

name: Tinting Time
short_description: Tinting Time is a Japanese-style crafting game. Play as a creator who can create all kinds of solutions, and spend some leisure time in the city of Folest. The game's creation system that combines crafting and complex resource management gameplay is eye-catching.

name: Europa One
short_description: Explore the ice-encrusted ocean of Jupiter's moon Europa.

name: HAINYA WORLD
short_description: You are an adventurer, you need to explore this continent, make good use of the resources of this continent to arm yourself, explore this world full of monsters and unknown things and survive!

name: WrestleQuest
short_description: TAG TEAM WITH DESTINY! Pro wrestling and RPG fantasy collide in the ultimate pixel powered adventure. “Macho Man” Randy Savage and tons of other icons offer guidance as you powerbomb your way to glory beyond the ring. This hero’s journey ain’t just an epic quest, it’s WRESTLEQUEST!

name: Magic Stone Guardians
short_description: Magic Stone Guardians is a tower defense game that can be played in VR. You are the guardian god of an underground temple, and you must fight off enemies who try to steal the crystal. Summon Guardians by combining cubes made of magical stones!

name: Oblivion Eagle
short_description: A masked group called the Onis has taken the world as its own. With an enchanted gun at the ready, you set out to destroy them and save everything that remains from the brink of chaos. Experience fast-paced action-RPG gameplay in this fresh, new take on the light-gun genre!

name: Mirrored Souls
short_description: A mind-bending “single-player-coop” puzzle-platformer in a beautifully illustrated soothing, lovely game.

name: Forbidden Magic
short_description: Catch a magical arsonist before you lose your heart! Will you romance a rival agent, your hellhound shapeshifter partner, or your boss—an actual devil? A sweet romantic text-based, role playing game.

name: Mystery Box: Hidden Secrets
short_description: A point-and-click puzzle game where you have to solve intriguing riddles around different boxes and discover some cool stories about popular inventions!

name: The Man Came Around
short_description: The Man Came Around is a survival game with narrative choices. Play five activists fleeing a police state. Cross the border. Evade the cops. Scavenge resources. Survive the elements. Will you put your group at risk to help others along the way, or betray your principles to survive?

name: 要来点百合吗 Love Yuri
short_description: Shu Yu, a popular writer, became sisters with Lu Xi, an online voice actress.But when Lu Xi accidentally discovers that her favorite yuri author is actually her sister Shu Yu, she becomes increasingly attracted to Shu Yu's personality and a forbidden romance gradually unfolds between them...

name: Dead Metal
short_description: 1-4 player co op roguelike with turn based combat and an emphasis on exploring randomly generated dungeons in order to find loot and complete missions

name: [Chilla's Art] Parasocial | パラソーシャル
short_description: Parasocial | パラソーシャル is a Japanese horror game about a live streamer.

name: XENOTILT: HOSTILE PINBALL ACTION
short_description: LIGHTNING STRIKES AGAIN!! XENOTILT, the sequel to the cult hit, DEMON'S TILT. Get ready for another PINBALL FANTASY. XENOTILT shreds the envelope with face-melting gameplay & graphics.

name: Future Daoshi
short_description: The future world is full of monsters and beasts. As a surviving Daoshi, you shoulder the mission of reviving the sect and saving mankind. Can you be the last hope for mankind in the siege of various monsters?

name: The Rewind Factory
short_description: A software update fails and you end up in a test track. The only way out: complete the test track. You can rewind through time, wall run, dash, slide and slow down time to complete the test chambers as fast a possible. Can you beat the fastest time in this FPS movement based game?

name: Soulkeeper Diaries
short_description: Soulkeeper Diaries is a story-based action adventure game that takes place in different worlds. Help Dogu to find his homeland while exploring worlds and islands with his balloon.

name: Vectorio
short_description: A minimalistic base-building tower-defense game. Collect and automate resources, research new technologies, setup supply chains, and fight back against the ever growing onslaught of enemy forces with a variety of powerful defenses.

name: Galaxy Kingdoms
short_description: Galaxy Kingdoms is an action/adventure shooter. Feel the journey of a bounty hunter as he explores the galaxy in search of quests and treasure. Strengthen yourself by buying new weapons and armor and then take on more powerful enemies.

name: Voidborn
short_description: Voidborn is a fast-paced roguelite FPS that combines skill-based action and swift movement with roguelite level progression and character customization. Rip apart demons with devastating weapon builds and reach as far as possible before you inevitably perish and become reborn stronger than ever.

name: Gaia Trek
short_description: In 'Gaia Trek', you will play as Gaia, the shattered will of a planet, and command your spaceship to explore new worlds, collect and refine various resources, build a home on the damaged spacecraft, summon a wide range of monsters, and ultimately, devour other shattered wills to repair yourself.

name: DepowerBall
short_description: DepowerBall is a competitive dragon-feeding party platformer. Be the first to feed the Dragon Queen and score points to win three rounds. As you win rounds, the other players will even the odds by taking away your powers, forcing you to adapt your strategy...or get left behind.

name: Shadow of Ether
short_description: Shadow of Ether is a first person horror game where a man with a spiritual power goes deep into the lower astral plane to banish an archon in a secluded haunted house in a forest.

name: Daisy Flies to the Moon
short_description: A sci-fi RPG that takes you to the Moon and beyond!

name: Dwarves: Glory, Death and Loot
short_description: Assemble your dwarf legion and annihilate tons of orcs! This game provides a refreshing combat experience, cleverly integrating RPG growth, roguelike adventures, and auto-chess. It's fast-paced yet rich in strategic depth - perfect for slacking off during work and decompression!

name: ルミエルマグナ(LumiereMagna)
short_description: 3D action fighting with 4 types of magic Defeat the monsters that await you in the ancient ruins Infinite game magic action game

name: Towers of Thana
short_description: Towers of Thana is an action & strategy game where you invoke magic and summon towers to defend mythologies against a dark corruption. Travel to their homelands and rally legendary gods and creatures to your cause against Ogur, a God turned evil, and his corruption.

name: Return of the Host
short_description: Return of the Host is a top-down Sokoban-like puzzle game with twisted puzzles and an exciting story

name: Cat's Request
short_description: Cat's Request is a fantastic detective story about an extraterrestrial cat named Ash and his virtual assistant, living in a metropolis governed by artificial intelligence.

name: Chicken Journey
short_description: Play as an adorable chicken in this relaxing platformer. Jump, climb and solve puzzles to find the answer to the ULTIMATE question a chicken can ask...

name: WarBox: Arcane
short_description: As adventurers in the world of Arcane, players embark on a charming and whimsical journey through a fantasy realm filled with unique creatures, cultures, and landscapes ready to be explored.

name: ANIMARAMA
short_description: ANIMARAMA is a short humorous interactive puzzle game in which you have to help the characters of the game solve their problems. Challenge logic and common sense to complete all levels of the game. Is it weak for you to do it?

name: Smells Like Burnt Rubber
short_description: Get ready for a fast-paced, adrenaline-fueled racing experience with Smells Like Burnt Rubber. Choose your car, customize it, and hit the track in this intense arcade-style game. Play with up to 4 friends in Splitscreen or join the Online Multiplayer. Are you ready to burn some rubber?

name: The Orphanage
short_description: Zack has a simple choice.. Run. Escape. Survive. With lots of puzzles to solve, Keys to find, Puzzle items to obtain to help progress through the game to lead to your escape. Will you live to tell the tale of JJ Randalls Orphanage?

name: Crystal Tales Tactics: Echoes of the Libertas War
short_description: Inspired by Fire Emblem and Final Fantasy Tactics but with NO GENDER RELATIONSHIP RULES, Save the world from an evil emperor Using the power of six elements while Dating whoever you want.

name: Aggregator Elevator System
short_description: Challenge your logic and strategy in new ways in this deductive tile-placement puzzle game. Master a rich system of logical rules where you must arrange blocks within a grid to make all the numbers add up correctly. AGGREGATE!

name: Dungeon X Dungeon
short_description: Arcadia 's best treasure hunter Luke is a dungeon hunter to prevent the resurrection of the Evil! We invite you to the world, which is filled with interesting stories, encounters with friends, action games that will defeat invulnerable monsters and use various elements to get through the dungeons.

name: Trine 5: A Clockwork Conspiracy
short_description: The Trine series is back with its biggest adventure! In their fifth outing, the Heroes of Trine are pitted against dastardly and duplicitous villains, who will stop at nothing to seize control of the kingdom. The clock is ticking to save the world of Trine!

name: Demolition Party
short_description: Demolition Party is a 4-player online multiplayer car game that guarantees a blast! Navigate through unique maps, wield an array of diverse guns, and, for a twist, even challenge AI opponents. Get ready to redefine 'party' with demolition-fueled excitement!

name: Heartless & Dreadful : Return by 72 Hours
short_description: Heartless and Dreadful is a character action game, made mostly by one person. It features complex and satisfying combat and a short story campaign with multiple, brutal difficulty options, allowing for quite a bit of replayability. And additional unlockable side content.

name: Don Duality
short_description: Don Duality is a Chaos Manager game with card mechanics. Send your gangsters to the heist and launder money in your restaurant. Hire staff and upgrade your establishment, but remember that life like a roulette wheel and not everything can be fully controlled in Don's journey.

name: Box To The Beat VR
short_description: Punch your way to the top with Box to the Beat VR!

name: Magnetron Rebellion: Fully Loaded
short_description: You are a single ship outnumbered and outgunned by the enemy fleet. The one advantage you have is a powerful magnet that is capable of capturing the enemy bullets and firing them back at the enemy!

name: Don't Flee
short_description: Don't Flee - is a psychological horror-thriller, all the actions of which take place in an old abandoned school, wherethe player finds himself to save his brother. However, soon he realizes that everything he sees is not true...

name: Pushing the limit
short_description: Pushing the limit - a game in which you'll have to overcome obstacles and find ways out of different situations!

name: Sender
short_description: The winds of the frozen wasteland are calling in this atmospheric horror game. Operate an aging vehicle to locate the missing driver of the previous expedition. Be careful not to stray from the path...

name: Королевская ночь
short_description: 'Королевская ночь'– нелинейная визуальная новелла в жанре ужасов. Десятки лет одиночества заставят её мыслить иначе..

name: Mediterranea Inferno
short_description: Explore the inner demons of three childhood friends on a summer retreat. Unearth secrets, fears and obsessions as you help them reconnect and rediscover themselves. A mature and treacherous visual novel from the creator of Milky Way Prince – The Vampire Star.

name: Omen Fall
short_description: Omen Fall is an action platform game with challenging battles set in the fantastic and vast lands of three different realms. Resurrect from the Balbal with Neu, where death is forbidden, and fight to destroy the chaos. Improve Neu throughout your journey and learn his dramatic story.

name: Conundrum 929
short_description: Conundrum 929 imitates an online internet mystery inspired by the likes of Cicada3301. It features a replica of a browser that allows you to navigate between different internet pages just like in reality. An elaborate hint system gives everyone the opportunity to experience a true internet mystery.

name: Kaya Joshi: Magical Detective
short_description: Kaya Joshi: Magical Detective is a family friendly Hidden Object Adventure. The game blends Hidden Object game play with Adventure gameplay.

name: Final Exerion
short_description: Call on CELLs, change your weapon, and shoot however you want!

name: Terrain Explorer
short_description: Terrain Explorer is a terrain adventure and shooting battle game featuring spaceships and a target planet training ground. SteamVR needs to be set up to run with OpenXR.

name: Franchise Hockey Manager 10
short_description: Franchise Hockey Manager returns for the 2023-24 season with plenty of additions to the deepest, most authentic hockey strategy gaming experience you can find. Choose from teams around the globe and select a team to guide to glory, including a chance at the ultimate prize, the Stanley Cup®.

name: Kingdoms Rise and Fall
short_description: Kingdoms Rise and Fall is a captivating Real-Time Strategy game that takes you on an epic journey through different eras, spanning the entirety of history and beyond! Kingdoms Rise & Fall focuses more on culture, science, and keeping your nation happy over time.

name: The Rings of Powder
short_description: 'The Rings of Powder' is a fun and ironizing game combining exploration with the construction of an underground kingdom and elements of real -time strategy and idle. The project is an irony of both some legendary and less legendary movies and scenes from reality.

name: West of the Witchlands
short_description: West of the Witchlands is a twin-stick shooter / roguelike about killing ancient gods with magic and revolvers

name: Dead Humanity
short_description: 'Dead Humanity' first person It is a horror game. You too can join this adventure. A tense story, rich graphics and themes that question the depths of human nature make the 'Dead Humanity' game unforgettable. How far will you go to survive in this post-apocalyptic world?

name: A Lively Haunt
short_description: Are you bold enough to enter A Lively Haunt alone? Or must you join a friend to investigate this 2-player, old-school, text parser adventure game?

name: Adrift Program
short_description: Supply energy to many spaceships in this small, chill resource and time management game, inspired by Overcooked. A Cooked-Like, if you will!

name: The Mythical City
short_description: Protect the magic crystal, to which waves of enemies are coming!

name: William's dad's secret
short_description: You can't sleep at night. There's something trying to get into your room and you don't know what it is. You must do whatever is possible to stop it.

name: Spread Out! Hold Naar' Havok
short_description: Easy and deep wargame. Choose your army (the Elves or the Orcs), win the war by controlling 5 of the 9 territories or by killing the enemy king. Deploy reinforcements.

name: EA SPORTS™ WRC
short_description: Build the car of your dreams in our biggest rally game ever, EA SPORTS™ WRC, the all-new official videogame of the FIA World Rally Championship, the first developed by the award-winning team behind the DiRT Rally series.

name: SUPRACORE
short_description: SUPRACORE is a roguelike base building game. Build your base, upgrade it and defend against ongoing waves of enemies to gather more resources and expand your Core!

name: Card Age
short_description: 'Card Age' is a casual, idle, God's perspective simulation management game. Survive and develop in an exquisite world composed of a variety of cards, gradually unlock new technologies, build industrial assembly lines and face various interesting challenges, and build your own Card Age.

name: Looks Good
short_description: 'Looks Good!' is a casual game with various art styles and gameplay including organizing, storing, arranging, puzzles and other content. Each book in the game has a theme, and players need to stack and arrange the scattered objects in the book.

name: Cyber Space Driver
short_description: This is First Person, Endless Driving game in CyberPunk setting.You can choose any of (4) CyberPunk style maps, Upload your own music, songs, tracks to the Game Radio. Through your way, you be able to see Different, Random, CyberPunk Events.

name: Unavailed
short_description: What was once a very promising future, Mia's life has taken a turn for the worse. Now living alone, supported by money from her parents, any aspirations she once had are but a fleeting memory.

name: SCP-479: Shadows of the Mind
short_description: You are a Class D personnel on an experimental mission for the Foundation to investigate SCP-479. The facility is linked to anomalies affecting the human psyche, gradually driving them insane. Please remember to take your pills.

name: Procambarus fallax
short_description: This is a visual novel game featuring toxic wave of electricity with a gameplay duration of 5-10 minutes. You will spend some bedtime moments with your “best friend” that can be either enjoyable or less pleasant. Will you take the medicine?

name: New Star GP
short_description: New Star GP is a fast and exciting arcade motorsport game with crisp retro visuals. Play career mode and work your way through decades of racing while upgrading your car and your support team... or chase high scores in championship mode on your own or in split-screen with up to three friends!

name: Dimensions
short_description: In the Multiverse everything is possible, so each level is another world, another universe, live this incredible adventure.

name: Hamster on Rails
short_description: Embark on this adventure through different worlds with your friend, the railway builder Hamster! Help the Hamster village collect minerals by building crazy railways to solve fun challenges.

name: Crocogame
short_description: Crocogame is a fast-paced roguelite game with intense moment-to-moment combat and flexible character customization. Use your resources efficiently to take on increasingly difficult threats. Great challenges also bring great rewards!

name: Thief Simulator 2
short_description: The door to your robber’s career is waiting! Just crowbar the lock off and force your way through the threshold. Learn skills, collect tools and become a master of the thieving trade!

name: Wargroove 2
short_description: Trouble stirs on the shores of Aurania. An ambitious new faction has unearthed forbidden relics capable of catastrophic consequences. But how far will they go to achieve glory? Take to the battlefield, sea, and sky with a cast of new Commanders, using your wits to wage turn-based war!

name: League TD
short_description: 'League Tower Defense' is a strategy tower defense game that combines unique defense towers and various upgradeable components to unleash different attack effects. Come and build your perfect defense line.

name: Skibidi Verse
short_description: SkibidiVerse is a captivating game where you will take on the role of the cameraman tasked with saving the city.

name: Oxygen Cocktail
short_description: Embark on a captivating adventure in Oxygen Cocktail, an open-world visual novel game. Solve puzzles, make friends, and uncover secrets in a charming rural village. Immerse yourself in a unique aesthetic that blends isometric pixel art and other styles.

name: Hidden Cats in Rome
short_description: Mamma mia! Our cats are now in the great city of Rome! Let's find them! Start with a monochromatic illustration and reveal the final colored art. Play through different modes, find special cats, and unlock bonus levels! More than 970 hidden objects to find! Enjoy the extra bonus level, NERD ARENA!

name: Flying Shark
short_description: Experience Toaplan's arcade shooter Flying Shark (AKA Sky Shark) on PC with the latest quality-of-life features. Ride through the skies as they burn in a rain of armor-piercing bullets! You have been chosen for the mission. Because you are the best pilot there is!

name: Jigsaw Puzzle Nature
short_description: Jigsaw Puzzle: Nature offers 30 unique levels in a relaxing atmosphere. Go on a colorful adventure through the seasons and complete beautiful jigsaws!

name: FPVSIM Drone Simulator
short_description: FPVSIM is an FPV simulator that combines great graphics with great stick feel, featuring high consistency with its machine learning powered quadrotor dynamics engine that's also also hand tuned by top drone racers around the world.

name: Ebenezer and the Invisible World
short_description: Embark on a story-rich 2D Metroidvania adventure with breathtaking hand-drawn art, playing as miser-turned-hero Ebenezer Scrooge in a reimagined Victorian-fantasy based on Charles Dickens’ classic novel, A Christmas Carol. Enlist the help of ghosts to save the people of London before it’s too late.

name: The Book Of Hiro
short_description: “The Book of Hiro” is a 3D visual puzzle game where players solve challenges and puzzles using illusions and perspective to find the hidden key in the map. The game tells the story of a brave villager named Hiro who was ordered to meet the king and encountered various challenges and puzzles.

name: Hungry Adventurer
short_description: Help hungry ninjas survive their starvation and face various enemies in this foodnastic platformer! Are you ready to collect some food? Be careful food is very addictive!

name: New Yankee: Mary's Dark Side
short_description: The bond between John and Mary is unbreakable. They embark on adventures together, and always support each other. But their lives take an unexpected turn when Mary's memory is lost. Join John in an epic quest to restore Mary's memories now!

name: Art Heist - Escape Room Adventure
short_description: An escape room inspired adventure. A stormy night, a secluded villa. An artwork has been stolen during a heist. Use your puzzle solving skills to track down the painting before they escape!

name: BeZombie Anime Invasion
short_description: Dare to survive in BeZombie Anime Invasion! Navigate a monstrous city as a transformed heroine, recover lost memories, and unravel your past. Thrilling battles and a compelling story await, all in vibrant anime style. Do you have the courage to face your past and challenge fate? Start journey now!

name: The Puppeteer
short_description: Punishing pixel-art platformer about puppetry and potions!

name: Five Days of Hell
short_description: A survival game in which you have to explore a desert canyon, face anomalies and various monsters.

name: Halloween Stories: Black Book
short_description: When your world and the supernatural realm collide, can you survive?

name: Cavemen Tales Collector's Edition
short_description: Help Sam and Crystal and their family to find a new home in this time management strategy game! Explore, guide the tribe, build, gather resources, overcome obstacles and enjoy the tale of family, friendship and courage!

name: Noctuary
short_description: Two young illuminators, Fancia and Alina, start their adventure in the bright and fascinating Inlixaland... ...in pursuit of becoming trustworthy 'Arborangers.'

name: Clouds Ahoy!
short_description: Clouds Ahoy! is a frantic coop multiplayer game. Alone or with up to four friends you make up the crew of a flying Skyship. Fight alien monsters, maintain the onboard systems, complete deliveries, and upgrade your Skyship to survive between the clouds.

name: DanceDouDoou
short_description: Click! Drag! Pop! ~~~Stretch & Relax~~~DanceDouDoou is a Casual rhythm /Beat/Dance Simulation Game where you,and your fellow animals can practice dance move By Mouse Click and Drag. Just Dance along with your Favorite music and,Have Fun!

name: Tracks of the Arcana
short_description: A tarot-inspired adventure game where you travel the cosmos with your magical train, fighting enemies and crafting resources, all while drawing tarot cards that shape your destiny.

name: CyberTD
short_description: Mutant viruses threaten the very heart of cyberspace! You'll need the right tactics and the 'help' of your support drone to build a deck of terrific upgrades in this innovative deckbuilding tower defense game packed with roguelite elements!

name: 梦染深秋
short_description: 2006年的秋天，集川市发生的犯罪案件日益增多，毒品及暴力犯罪屡禁不止，当地警方对于犯罪团伙的调查迟迟得不到进展。主人公“林秋”作为一名在校学生，原本与那些犯罪活动并无瓜葛，但却在某次散步时意外目睹了犯罪现场，此时他才发现自己早已身处漩涡之中。

name: 网瘾少年2005 Internet addicted youth 2005
short_description: Netjunker 2005 is a story-oriented role-playing game that incorporates a variety of scenario-appropriate gameplay. You will play the role of Wang Xiaoleng, and face the criticism of Internet addiction and games from teachers, classmates and parents in the early 20th century.

name: Bozalleth's Curse
short_description: Nightmares that wake you up in cold sweat. The world of dreams hides secrets and your sins. The game 'Bozalleth's Curse' tells you the story of Mary, who had an unfortunate accident eight years ago.

name: Dungeons & Keyboards
short_description: Ready your typing skills and defeat the quirky enemies of the Tower of Verbum. Collect coins, relics, and experience to buy items, assign stats and unlock permanent upgrades. How far will your typing skills take you?

name: Budget Cuts Ultimate
short_description: Enter a VR stealth game as the last human amidst robot managers programmed to 'optimize' the workforce. Escape the office alive by sneaking past enemies or unleash a fistful of knives, quivers of arrows, grenades, and coffee mugs onto their unsuspecting circuits!

name: Spacecraft Tactics
short_description: Spacecraft Tactics is a 2D turn-based tactical space game. Save the last rebel outpost in the campaign. Develop a strategy, execute it in tactical battles and micromanage your ship. Play various game modes single or multiplayer. Create your own ships, scenes or mods and share them.

name: Monolith
short_description: Enter this classical science fiction point and click adventure to struggle for the survival of the space explorer Tessa Carter. Accompanied by an unusual friend, she will soon learn more about herself than this foreign environment, she desperatly tries to escape.

name: I commissioned some bunnies 2
short_description: I paid artists to hide bunnies and carrots in 15 artworks. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

name: Drive Up
short_description: Embark on a thrilling journey in 'Drive Up.' Scale the floating objects on a mysterious island in the ocean. There are no saves; one fall, and you're back to square one. How high can you climb?

name: Twilight Town: A Cyberpunk FPS
short_description: Twilight Town: A Cyberpunk FPS is a brutal, funny, bloody FPS game with an advanced gore system. Featuring 15 beautiful levels, a variety of weapons and a deeply engaging story that follows the journey of a young man and his friend tackling on a criminal underground to give his AI wife a real body.

name: Liquid Space Dimension
short_description: Fly and fight through the vibrant universe of Liquid Space Dimension in this retro-inspired action shooter! As Sid Seaburn, pilot of the Star Drifter, master a wide range mechanics like drifting, laser beams, and torpedoes to get the highest score possible and stop the evil general Ra-Baba!

name: Alibi: The Dinner Party
short_description: Play as a Police Detective investigating a murder at a luxurious villa. When your old friend Jasmine Lee becomes the prime suspect, it's up to you to reveal the truth. Navigate a gripping case filled with twists and turns that'll leave you guessing until the very end.

name: Citizens: On Mars
short_description: Experience the ultimate turn-based colony building game in Citizens: On Mars! As the leader of a fledgling Martian settlement, your mission is to develop a thriving colony amidst the harsh and unforgiving environment of the Red Planet.

name: Suicide Guy: The Lost Dreams
short_description: The Lost Dreams is the new chapter from the Suicide Guy game series: a first person puzzle game set in a world of new crazy dreams. In this adventure you'll have to find a way to wake up from your nightmares.

name: Deep Secret
short_description: This is a casual puzzle match-3 game. Players need to use the mouse to select two unobstructed squares, and if they are the same, they will be eliminated. After success, you can advance the plot and story development of the two protagonists!

name: Space Vikings
short_description: Pillage and plunder across the galaxy as part of a crew of Space Vikings in this sci-fi roguelite bullet hell dungeon crawler. Find exotic weapons, upgrade them with powerful augments, explore mysterious alien planets, and unleash viking vengeance on their inhabitants.

name: Wyvia
short_description: Wyvia is an open world 3D action RPG inspired by classic JRPGs. Save your world from a monstrous invasion. Choose from 10 classes customizing them with a robust cross-class skill system, craft and upgrade tons of weapons, explore dungeons battling a variety of enemies, and defeat terrifying bosses!

name: The Eastern Drive : Car Simulator
short_description: A fun and casual car driving game with Asian vehicles. Perform stunts, undertake missions, or freely cruise around the city.

name: Cubenomics: A puzzle game
short_description: Cubenomics is a physics puzzle game. Draw lines around a cube to create tracks the ball can ride along. Unlock the exit, then guide the ball to the exit to solve each puzzle.

name: Song Song
short_description: The story is about a detective This is a psychological puzzle game, The game belongs to the psychological horror genre

name: Death of the Rising Sun
short_description: Welcome to an Indiana Jones meets Stargate epic action adventure! In this third-person shooter, the intense fighting will keep your lust for action satiated, the exotic locations will keep you guessing with massive puzzles, and the cinematic visuals will tickle your senses.

name: Lobber
short_description: LOBBER is a top down hack and slash where you can hack, slash, and chop your way to victory! Cut off skeleton's heads and catch their skulls to perform powerful moves!

name: 末世孤镇 Doomsday Lonely town
short_description: 《Doomsday Lonely town》is an idle tower defense game. In the doomsday world, you can form your team to resist the attacks of monsters and protect the isolated town behind you.

name: Maumau and the Labyrinth
short_description: Maumau, an adventurer, found a huge treasure chest in an ancient ruin. However, she was taken into the other dimension by the girl who appeared from the treasure chest. Maumau's unique adventure to survive begins.

name: Football Legend
short_description: Take over a professional American football team, in this single-player football management simulator. As both general manager and head coach, build a football dynasty that will last for decades to come. Trade, draft, sign free agents, and coach your way into the hall of fame!

name: MULTIPLAYER CAVEMEN
short_description: MULTIPLAYER CAVEMEN - The Village is being taken over by DinoSaurs. Can You and Your Pack Survive ?

name: Paintball 3 - Candy Match Factory
short_description: Join Boldy, the adorable green monster, on his sweetest and most thrilling adventure to fix the broken candy match factory: Paintball 3!

name: yebushou：defeat pirates
short_description: Find the leaders of each area and use your skills and reflexes to kill them.

name: Cat Attack
short_description: JRPG similar to Final Fantasy/Lufia with an overworld and a variety of dungeons. Many party members with unique skills/abilities. Not early access, but will be updated in the future based on user input and other information.

name: Bonfire And Tail
short_description: Bonfire and Tail is a multiplayer action party game developed by avidya studio. Through the gameplay, we want to bring players back to childhood and have simple fun together. Draw a torch from the bonfire and ignite other players' tails! If your tail is on fire, wiggle it to put the fire out!

name: G-MODEアーカイブス+ 女神異聞録ペルソナ 異空の塔編
short_description: Escape from the other dimensional space ruled by demons. Another story of the Persona users.

name: The Fading Worlds
short_description: The world has an end date, the apocalypse is approaching every minute, The Fading Worlds. Can you stop a force of nature?

name: Lonely Turret 2
short_description: Build up your defense turret with unique attachments to survive waves of enemies and bosses. With 5 unique levels each with their own endless mode and over 50 attachments to try out and upgrade, the fun never ends.

name: Voyager 2
short_description: Launch the Voyager space probe to the furthest depths of the Solar System! Use gravity to slingshot around planets and scan, orbit, or land on targets to earn stunning replays of your accomplishments.

name: Widow in the Endless Labyrinth
short_description: The story begins with a missing superhero and Widow the supervillain is the only suspect in this case. Does she have something to do with the missing superhero or is she trying to hide something? This game is an action-roguelike game with randomly generated mazes.

name: Escape from Death
short_description: 'Escape from Death' is a 256,000-word interactive horror adventure novel by Tova Näslund. It’s entirely text-based—without graphics or sound effects—and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

name: Forza Motorsport
short_description: Out-build the competition in the all-new career. Race your friends in adjudicated multiplayer events. Compete in over 500 cars on world-famous tracks with cutting edge AI, advanced physics, and tire and fuel strategy.

name: Playtown
short_description: Playtown is a horror game set in a kid's dinosaur-themed indoor playground. Roam the kids play areas, pipe lands and ball pits to uncover and find your daughter's necklace, while unraveling the mystery surrounding the once happy place. Remember .. you are not alone.

name: Enigma Quest
short_description: Explore an enigmatic museum, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover lost secrets in this immersive puzzle-adventure game.

name: Moonlight Mayhem
short_description: Moonlight Mayhem is a 4-15 player multiplayer horror game where the goal is to eliminate werewolves for humans or vice versa. To do this, you can team up with players, but make sure they are on your side or they could decide to backstab you.

name: The Secrets Of Hope
short_description: Lose yourself in an immersive story, as you follow a man coming to terms with terminal cancer. Explore a surreal world from a first-person perspective. Revisit both new and old memories and follow along as he discovers The Secrets of Hope

name: Finding America: The Great Lakes
short_description: Explore the beautiful areas surrounding the Great Lakes of America!

name: Relgiros
short_description: RELGIROS, a plateform game, tests your patience and determination as it paces up surmounting obstacles, to boost you with the adrenaline rush. Through the game, the protagonist breezes through obstacles and traps, with a goal to prove worthy of the foresighted critical missions.

name: SpeedRooms
short_description: A first-person platformer for beginners and experienced speed demons alike. Solving each room is a simple enough task, but to reach the top of the leaderboard you will need to prove your wit and tenacity.

name: Lost Girl In Mirror
short_description: This is a girl puzzle adventure game, through the wisdom of the gentlemen's minds, through the complete patchwork scenes, to save the girls trapped in the mirror, to give them a place to live. More than a dozen different characters and scenarios for you to explore.

name: Defense Cards
short_description: Defense Card is a very creative barrage shooting game. It combines the gameplay of barrage shooting and card use. It also has a random in-game growth mechanism, making it an addictive and fast-paced bullet hell game. curtain shooter

name: Selfish Cupid - BL Dating Sim
short_description: Ten has the ability to see other people's soulmates after he was chosen to be the cupid's vessel. He is tasked to help bring couples together. But there is just one problem... Ten couldn't care less about other people's relationships. He only cares about his own love life.

name: Cosmosiege
short_description: Cosmosiege is a reverse tower defense auto battle game. The task at each level is to destroy the towers located in the center of the screen with the help of summoned combat units. Place your units in real time and try to defeat the enemy base!

name: Stress, Out!
short_description: Stress, Out! is a Top Down Gore Shooter where you can use special abilities to destroy enemies to let some stress out.

name: Beneath The Backrooms
short_description: Beneath the Backrooms is an horror and exploration game; Lost in the Backrooms, your character will have to fight his/her mental health problems and monstrous creatures. In the darkness.

name: Vapor Up! With Man with Apple
short_description: An interactive museum with parkour! Run and jump like a parkour master and save your dog from rats. You are robot from a vaporwave ghetto. Sounds cool, right?

name: 国際指定怪異124号 東京廃村
short_description: 特殊部隊全滅ホラー／４人ザッピング操作アクション。全てがリアルタイムに進行する中で、極限のストレスが狂乱のアドレナリンに進化するまで戦いましょう。心折れるまで挑む、１ラウンドが短くリプレイ性の高いハードコアなゲーム性をお楽しみ下さい。

name: Witches' Hallow
short_description: Witches' Hallow is a top-down arena game where you fight against hordes of creatures as a witch who can use up to 5 weapons. Choose one of the witches, develop her as you wish and explore 3 different spooky areas! Don't forget to stay alive while doing this!

name: BOINKGAME
short_description: A lesson in momentum and it's consequences. BOINKGAME is a precision platformer where walls make you rage.

name: Spooky Dwellers 2 - Collector's Edition
short_description: Save your parents' house from mischievous spooky dwellers in a thrilling Match 3 ghost-hunting journey. Unleash talismans, conquer puzzles, and restore harmony!

name: AirportSim
short_description: AirportSim is an Advanced Airport Ground Handling Simulator with true-to-life visuals and operations, licensed planes and vehicles, real airports and live weather conditions. Enjoy the many tasks alone or with friends, making this experience unforgettable.

name: ENDLESS™ Dungeon
short_description: ENDLESS™ Dungeon is a Rogue-lite Tactical Action game, set in the award-winning ENDLESS™ Universe. Recruit a team of shipwrecked heroes, plunge into a long-abandoned space station, and protect your crystal against never-ending waves of monsters… or die trying, get reloaded, and try again.

name: DEADPOINT
short_description: 'Deadpoint' is an engaging third-person survival game set in an apocalyptic world overrun by zombies. Players take on the role of a resourceful scavenger, tasked with navigating the dangerous landscape and ensuring their survival amid the hordes of undead.

name: Star Farmer: Warlock of the Universe
short_description: In this relaxing bullet heaven, farming adventure, play as a powerful Warlock who has a side hustle harvesting plants in space.

name: The Telephone
short_description: The Telephone is a first-person psychological horror game that will transport you to a world governed by anxiety. You will have to explore the house in which you are locked and the mysterious town of Lonely Plain, searching for clues that can help Roberta regain her memory.

name: Lowlander
short_description: Return with us, to the days of yesteryear. When 8 colors were enough, and the pixels were individually detectable to the human eye. This is LOWLANDER, a fantasy role-playing adventure from simpler times. This might be your father’s RPG!

name: Experimentation
short_description: A linear visual novel about five short stories, unrelated at first glance. Be prepared for mysticism, gloomy atmosphere and light psychological horror. Not recommended to play if you are experiencing depression or severe psychological state.

name: Cody's Nightmare
short_description: Cody's Nightmare is a spooky 2D pixel art game about a little boy named Cody who is stuck in his nightmare! His only way out is to conquer his fears! But don't worry, he won’t be alone. He will get help from his friends inspired by his favorite toys, comics, and video games.

name: Void Survivors
short_description: Void Survivors is a fast-paced action roguelike game where you have to survive relentless hordes of monsters for 20 minutes!

name: Incubus - A ghost-hunters tale
short_description: You are on your first solo ghost hunt, under the watchful instructions of Bear and Jen from the O.P.G paranormal team. Use real gadgets in a real location, a house investigated by the developers on the request of three different owners. It is a case worthy of a video game, so welcome to Incubus.

name: Jane Austen's 8-bit Adventure
short_description: Play as Jane Austen, English novelist, in this 2D platforming adventure. Explore 8-bit England, fight enemies with your quill, and confront characters from Jane Austen's novels!

name: KurOba
short_description: KurOba, Selçuklu'dan Osmanlı'ya uzanan bir strateji oyunu. Medeniyetleri yönet, kaynakları kullan, tarihî olayları deneyimle ve savaş. Geleceğe yönlendir, kaynakları sürdürülebilir kullan. Tarihi bir yolculuk!

name: Climbing Over It with a Spear
short_description: Climb a mountain with a spear, if you fall, you get up.

name: Hell Throne
short_description: A fast-paced action roguelite game with bullet hell elements, encounter based combat and high replayability. Make your way through monster infested realms as you pick and choose from a multitude of upgrades and abilities to create the meanest build possible!

name: Fritz - Your chess coach
short_description: Fritz. Your chess trainer! Chess is fun with me! With AI help you learn to play brilliant winning games even as a beginner. Or play at professional level without help. Always with a humorous commentary. I also find opponents for you on the chess server and give you tactics training.

name: Mousey
short_description: Mousey is a retro style 3D-platformer that takes inspiration from various early 2000's classics. Travel through air ducts, explore rooms, watch out for hazards and most importantly - collect cheese.

name: Radiant Silvergun
short_description: Set on the earth and in space on July 14, 2520 A.D., the film explores the mystery of mankind's extinction. Various terrains become battlefields. Enemies attack from all directions. There are 23 bosses in total. Aim for a high score by making full use of score bonuses and level-up weapons!

name: SHAPE HUNTER
short_description: SHAPE HUNTER is a 2D roguelike action game in which players defeat an infinite number of monsters.

name: 疫地求生
short_description: 《疫地求生》是一款像素风丧尸末日题材的角色扮演生存游戏。 你将扮演Z城的一个普通青年，在一个平凡的假期里， 丧尸危机突然爆发了…… 你必须使出浑身解数，和你的同伴一起，努力在这末世中生存下去。

name: Goo Keeper
short_description: Lead Rolly in his adventure within the wonderful world of Shroomast, and explore its deep semi open-world underground. Goo Keeper is a pure metroidvania with tons of unique bosses, hand-crafted worlds and creatures, and tons of awesome abilities.

name: HELL HUNTER - Anti-Nomen
short_description: A story driven adventure horror audiogame in which you have to interact with room elements, survive to environment gimmicks and fight real time battles based only on stereo audio. Learn the enemy patterns and hear where the attacks come from to dodge their attacks in time and then attack.

name: ENTANGLED SOULS
short_description: Explore your nightmares and avoid your mortality. The truth is hidden in the depths of your dreams. This is a horror action adventure game that can be played with simple movement controls and a single button. There are no lines or sentences. You can play regardless of your location or language.

name: Moonstone Island
short_description: Moonstone Island is a creature-collecting life-sim set in an open world with 100 islands to explore. Make friends, brew potions, collect Spirits, and test your strength in card-based encounters to complete your Alchemy training!

name: Chick-Chick
short_description: You play as chickens who have to survive on unstable platforms in various universes of the chicken coop, will you be able to keep the balance and hold on, compete with friends and beat the record!

name: Brothers in Hell
short_description: After you die, Death gives you the chance to come back to the world of the living to fulfill your deepest desire. Take the chance. Get back on your feet, and claim your revenge in this stealth action-adventure game

name: Dungeon Dreams 2
short_description: Roguelike Romance JRPG. Create your character and get a room at the Magic Academy dormitory, to win the Challenge of the Infinite Dungeon! A game with town building, relationships, and many quests with alternate routes.

name: Sea of Survivors
short_description: In Sea of Survivors, you can sail your ship in any direction but you can never stop moving. Evade and destroy hordes of pirates and sea monsters to gain experience, level up and choose upgrades for your ship. Discover mysterious curses, unlock unique treasures and fight for survival.

name: Cropisle TD
short_description: After an earthquake, you're sent to an island for rebuilding. Face nightly critter attacks, set up towers, and farm. Your mission is to seal the island or secure crops before defenses are breached. Now, grab your shovel and hammer, and enter the defensive battle!

name: Grace of Letoile
short_description: Fight with battle automata to turn back time in a fantasy RPG!

name: Mage of the Olekta Desert
short_description: Aisha takes on a mission to deliver a letter to a mage living in the Olekta Desert. To her dismay, she must traverse the dangerous ruins and defeat the bandits and cultists that roam inside... or somehow get through unnoticed.

name: Psyche60s
short_description: Immerse yourself in Psyche60s, an innovative experience that takes you back to San Francisco in the 1960s. Created by renowned photographer Roberto Rabanne, Psyche60s features unique artwork, original music, and rich historical insights. Experience a paradigm-shifting cultural 'Youthquake'!

name: Only Up Girl
short_description: Embark on an exciting adventure in the heights, preventing the villain Vill from accomplishing his goal. Confront him, overcoming the condemnation of humanity. Don't stop, keep climbing, girl!

name: Rilla Shotgun
short_description: Slay Demons as a Gorilla with a Shotgun in this 90's Pixel Art Style Boomer Shooter

name: Upload Simulator Silicon
short_description: Upload Simulator Silicon is an incremental game about uploading, making money, hacking, and ascending as a powerful entity that controls the very laws of the universe using powerful technologies you discover throught your journey.

name: No Son Of Mine
short_description: No Son Of Mine is a survival horror game focused on combat, stealth, exploration, puzzle solving and uncovering a gruesome mystery.

name: Whitestone
short_description: On the 'Sunchaser' capstone voyage to the Arctic, it's smooth sailing until Jack's quarters are broken into and his friend goes missing. Unsure who to trust, Jack is forced to fight nightmares both mental and physical as he becomes the prime suspect for a terrible deed.

name: Nightzoid
short_description: Nightzoid is a single-player, horror-puzzle indie game. Try to find out the mystery before death catches you.

name: Tales Of Aravorn: An Elven Marriage
short_description: In the first spin-off of the VN/RPG Loren The Amazon princess, play as Elenor or Saren again and travel to Triberg to make sure that the arranged elven marriage between Lydia and Marian goes smoothly. Be careful: the demons are planning something...

name: Legendary Slide 2 - Platinum Edition
short_description: Play Legendary Slide II in the Platinum Edition! Remove all mahjong tiles from the board, solve over 80 unique mahjong puzzles, and collect gems to restore the ancient Temple of the Air Gods and continue your journey through the legendary world of Legendary Slide II.

name: Sins Of Treatment
short_description: Sins of Treatment is a 3D horror from the first person, everything happens in some liminal spaces. The gameplay consists in collecting information, solving riddles and escaping from various entities. The main goal is to understand what is happening to you, how you got here and who you were before.

name: 2024 U.S. Election Simulator
short_description: The 2024 U.S. Election Simulator puts you in control of an American election night like never before. Customize your very own political candidate and run a realistic campaign that leads up to election night!

name: Clown Art
short_description: 'Escape from Clown Art in a terrifying horror game. Solve puzzles and escape the nightmarish mansion before it captures you.'

name: Ambusher
short_description: Ambusher is a tower defense game. Set your traps. Build your towers. Prepare your defense and survive until sunrise.

name: Sinoepoch
short_description: Sinoepoch is a grand strategy game based on the historical fantasy of the Three Kingdoms period in Chinese history. In the current version, players can create their character, 'travel' to the end of the Eastern Han Dynasty,create their family legends.

name: Origami Lovers
short_description: Origami Lovers is a casual to midcore Jump'n'Run/Platformer set in a cardboard and paper world. Overcome obstacles and challenges while collecting different abilites that will help you navigate through the level.

name: Welcome teacher
short_description: This is a horror RPG Maker MV game. Explore the quiet countryside shrouded in darkness, and uncover the hidden secret of terror that lies behind it.

name: Space Trash Scavenger
short_description: Grab your jetpack and explore procedural asteroid fields, derelict spaceships and abandoned outposts. Build your Space Rig to process scavenged trash. Craft, trade and fight your way home in this interstellar, open-world survival sandbox.

name: The Devourer: Hunted Souls
short_description: Play as a paranormal investigator in our hybrid between first person survival and psychological horror story game. Investigate a haunted forest with up to 5 players CO-OP, try to lift the curse, experience a tragic story and take decisions together. Will you survive or will you lose your soul?

name: Shroomchitect
short_description: Help shroomies transform a big mushroom into a cozy little home! Care for them, help them garden and build things, relax, and take nice pictures!

name: Video Game Library Simulator
short_description: Videogame Library Simulator is an interactive, immersive, recreation of that feeling you get when you're browsing your videogame library and nothing there jumps out at you.

name: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® III
short_description: In the direct sequel to the record-breaking Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® II, Captain Price and Task Force 141 face off against the ultimate threat.

name: Furious Rage
short_description: Furious Rage is a linear 2D platformer about an unusual hero who finds himself in a strange place. Guide your character through dark locations and don’t let the monsters destroy you! All locations have doors that block your path and levers from them and enemies that will try to interfere.

name: Japan Train Models - JR East Edition
short_description: Build, view, and run realistic reproductions of trains in your own railway space! Japan Train Models is a model train puzzle and layout crafting game for model train fans that allows you to create 'Train Models' and 'Scenery' just like a puzzle.

name: MY DAUGHTER IS A CULTIST! SE
short_description: YOU'RE JUST A NORMAL GUY TRYING TO GET SOME SLEEP. YOU HEAR A BUMP IN THE NIGHT. WHAT WAS THAT? WHY IS YOUR DAUGHTER ACTING SO WEIRD? IS IT PARENTHOOD OR A HORRIBLE CURIOSITY THAT COMPELS YOU TO FIND OUT? A Short horror experience.

name: ARK: Survival Ascended
short_description: ARK is reimagined from the ground-up into the next-generation of video game technology with Unreal Engine 5! Form a tribe, tame & breed hundreds of unique dinosaurs and primeval creatures, explore, craft, build, and fight your way to the top of the food-chain. Your new world awaits!

name: Small Saga
short_description: Beneath the streets of London, an angry mouse seeks revenge against the god who stole his tail. An epic RPG of miniature proportions!

name: Special Ops: Operation Assault
short_description: Special Ops: Operation Assault - FPS action vs. global terrorists. 20+ missions, 4 unique locations, 11 upgradable weapons, 6 secret missions. Defuse bombs, rescue hostages, act fast against the clock! Engage in intense battles, be the hero!

name: UnderOneRoof
short_description: This is a 10 minute short story game adapted from real events. Players will follow the perspective of the female protagonist, click on items or move through the prompts of the scene and tags, and experience this unexpected family upheaval.

name: Pathogenesis: Overcome
short_description: Hardcore story-driven Action RPG about those who survived after a global pandemic on the territory of Leningradskaya Oblast, Russia. A story about finding your place in a destroyed world, where the greatest danger does not come from the infected.

name: Fragile Feelings
short_description: A sweet, slow burn yuri / lesbian visual novel about an anxious young teacher being swept off her feet by the cool, competent school nurse.

name: Defendor
short_description: Defendor is a throwback to the fast paced arcade games of the 80s.A retro style, arcade shooter where you upgrade your base to increase the capabilities of your ship, unlock new weapons, ships and cause more mayhem.Defend your base until everyone makes it into the escape ship.

name: Lies of P
short_description: Lies of P is a thrilling soulslike that takes the story of Pinocchio, turns it on its head, and sets it against the darkly elegant backdrop of the Belle Epoque era.

name: DIVINE SHOCK
short_description: Swing, smash, and combo your way through the dead. DIVINE SHOCK is an infinitely scaling first-person rogue-lite, where you are a Paladin, standing between the dead and the mortal realm.

name: Adventures with Alan Parkour 3D
short_description: The goal of the game is to reach the portal that will take you to the next level. To do this, you need to jump on the blocks without falling into the lava.

name: Cannon Block Ball
short_description: Knock down blocks from the platform using balls in this physics-based game. Encounter various block types, from explosive bombs to rotating and growing blocks, adding challenge and strategy to the gameplay.

name: The Fall Of Elements
short_description: The Fall Of Elements is an action-adventure game set in an ancient dungeon. You are chosen by the Elements to find an evil enemy. Solve puzzles, explore a vast dungeon, overcome obstacles in your way and fight forbidden magic.

name: Doomsday School
short_description: This is an RPG survival game You will play a human in the zombie world, to survive and fight

name: Exit the Backrooms
short_description: Embark on a journey through 15 levels of the Backrooms designed to trigger the liminal feeling in your brain. Be ware, because one of the 8 entities could be stalking you at any moment.

name: Case of the mysterious death of Keiko Haraeda
short_description: Japan, September 12, 1999, at 8:00 p.m., Ms. Keiko Haraeda collapsed in her room and was found dead. Although the police have ruled that there is no case and closed the investigation, many puzzling points remain, and the family is still calling for information.

name: Desktop Basketball 2
short_description: Invigorating basketball everyone can enjoy together! Prepare for the next evolution in dunking!

name: World Fit
short_description: Make exercise fun! Travel the world while getting fit!

name: PIXELS
short_description: PIXELS is the new way of pixel battles. Share your art to the world on a huge canvas.

name: Neon Little Soul
short_description: Neon Little Soul is a frenetic and fun action platformer game, a little gem of minimalist pixel art, retro style and arcade spirit.

name: Recordbooks
short_description: 'Recordbooks' is a Photorealistic bodycam first-person tactical shooter . You will play as a secret agency agent whose duty is to solve Complex and Mysterious cases of your duty area .Your Detective and Tactical skill is needed to solve these complex cases.

name: Estelaroid: Escape Room
