short_description: You are in a spaceship, alone. The crew disappeared, and the ship quickly approaches a black hole. In this science fiction Escape Room, you must put your wits to the test and thus repair your spaceship before being trapped forever in the universe.

name: V Gate
short_description: V gate; It is an open world game that includes first and third person shooter, survival, exploration, crafting, horror, thriller, team, building, mystery, management concepts and drags you towards different worlds with explorations.

name: UFO ROBOT GRENDIZER – The Feast of the Wolves
short_description: For the first time in video game history, climb aboard Grendizer the Legendary Robot and fight against the forces of evil to defend our planet Earth!

name: Treasure Hunt girl
short_description: This is a game to find hidden objects, in this cartoon world, there are many hidden props in the world, you need to find a handful of them.

name: Gnostic: Survivors
short_description: Gnostic: Survivors is a survivor style 3rd person co-op game where you pick your weapon, level up to unlock legendary upgrades and survive the never ending horde of enemies. Play solo or with up to 3 friends.

name: 仙侠镇尘箓2
short_description: 'Treasure Town 2'is a game that simulates the operation of a cultivation sect. Players can hire cultivators to explore secret realms, cultivate spiritual plants, or refine pills and magic treasures, ultimately enhancing the sect's reputation and becoming the first sect in the cultivation world.

name: SWORD ART ONLINE Last Recollection
short_description: The culmination of the SWORD ART ONLINE game series, Last Recollection features the largest roster of SAO playable characters and sub scenarios!

name: Spooky Tower
short_description: You have been left alone. Your only tools are your trusty jetpack and your item spawner. But your spawner has malfunctioned and will only spawn random items! You must ascend the tower to fix your tool and defend your outpost from the approaching danger!

name: PP
short_description: This is a 'butt' as the protagonist of the breakthrough game Players will take the role of a pink ass in a hurry to go to the toilet. Dodge all kinds of fast food attacks on the way, break through the obstacles and finally reach the toilet!

name: Money Transporter
short_description: 'Money Transporter' is an intense game that puts you in charge of transporting money safely from the bank to the ATM and back.

name: MareQuest: An Interactive Tail
short_description: A terrible darkness threatens a world of overwhelmingly adorable mares. Can a new cute mare with amnesia save the world or will she lose more than her memories along the way?

name: Martian Secrets
short_description: Martian Secrets is a 3D free-view meditation hidden object game where you have to fly around the map and look for the required items. But be careful, if you choose the wrong item, you will have to start all over again!

name: SANGI
short_description: A fast paced and combat oriented 2D platformer. Use multiple weapons and create multiple elemental reactions to efficiently eliminate your enemies. Experience a short story about your origins and try getting the best score possible in the arcade mode.

name: Grasshoping
short_description: Humanity has polluted your home and it is time to look for a new paradise. Hop your way through history but be careful, water and currents may dissolve your progress to nothing in this challenging 3D platformer.

name: Shooter
short_description: With time ticking away and your ammunition running low, do you possess the nerve, skill, and resourcefulness required to etch your name into the annals of western legend? Ride off into the frontier sunset, one shot at a time, in Shooter.

name: Somnipathy
short_description: Somnipathy is a story focused point-and-click horror adventure. Sleep Paralysis. Restless Leg Syndrome. Night Terrors! Help Aggy overcome nightmares, earn upgrades during the day, and survive another night.

name: Snaky Survivor
short_description: Guide a snake-like character as it gathers soul fragments to stave off hunger, weaving through hazardous obstacles in a race against time.

name: King Krieg
short_description: Combine abilites to create infinite possibilities of spells and decimate thousands of enemies. King Krieg is a top-down arena roguelite where YOU are the KING and you buy mystical items, find powerful guns, and craft new spells

name: Captain Goose
short_description: Embark on a dangerous journey with the crew of the brave Captain Goose! The sailors will have to reach the very edge of the World to break a terrible curse. However, the Abyss will do everything possible to prevent this...

name: The Sirena Expedition
short_description: The Sirena Expedition is a short PSX-style horror-platformer in which you explore a mysterious underwater facility.

name: NOBLE KNIGHT
short_description: NOBLE KNIGHT is a 2D platform game with RPG elements. Kill different enemies with your powerful sword and protect the peaceful island! Climb the locations to complete the task and deal with the monsters that stand in your way, and beware of deadly traps.

name: Dash & Swing
short_description: A fast-paced action platformer, use your acrobatic skills to navigate through challenging levels. Swing and dash through a variety of obstacles to reach the end of each stage. With intuitive controls and thrilling gameplay, Dash & Swing offers an exciting experience for players who love platformers.

name: Penrose
short_description: Penrose is a non-linear interactive novella unlike anything you've played before. Scroll forwards and backwards through an ever-changing story. Manipulate the environment, explore every possibility, and unravel the mystery at the heart of everything.

name: Japanese Style Tien Gow
short_description: 'Tien Gow' is a game played by four individuals using a set of 32 tiles known as 'Tien Gow Tiles.' We present an easy to learn 'Japanese-style Tien Gow.' Based on the tiles dealt, players take turns playing their tiles, and the one who plays the strongest tile in the end wins the game.

name: Nuclear Option
short_description: Fly near-future aircraft with immersive physics on intense battlefields, facing land, air and sea threats. Wage war against AI or other players with an array of potent weapons. Wield tactical and strategic nuclear weapons, capable of annihilating anything in their path.

name: Nightmare Vortex
short_description: 我们的游戏是一款轻松休闲的Roguelike动作游戏。在这里作为玩家的你需要尽可能的活下去，同时尽可能地将你获得的每一个要素有计划地组合起来，击败噩梦中的反派，跳出生活中让你困扰的漩涡~！

name: Don't Fall
short_description: Climb higher and higher in “Don’t Fall”! Face daring challenges, explore a world filled with secrets, and reach incredible heights. The sky is your limit!

name: WFD
short_description: Oh no! The slimes are ruining the crops! Let's defend the field with the water gun! Watergun Farming Defense!

name: Khaligrad
short_description: Slip on the boots of a freshly-arrived officer in Khaligrad, a captivating strategy game that plunges you into the heart of a grueling military campaign. Lead your battalion for the Empire or the Union, with intense turn-based battles and unforgiving management phases.

name: Anaphora
short_description: Anaphora is a miniature movement shooter with rogue-lite elements that takes place in a single small arena.

name: The Imperial Capital Burns - Muv-Luv Alternative Total Eclipse
short_description: A prequel to Muv-Luv Alternative Total Eclipse which follows Takamura Yui and her friends during their time as surface pilot cadets.

name: Beyond Sunset
short_description: Cyberpunk first-person shooter with a rich story and RPG elements. You are Lucy, an enhanced street samurai searching for lost memories. Fight in large, open, interactive levels overtaken by yakuza, zombies, robots and bosses!

name: Castle Master TD
short_description: Fortify, Strategize, and Conquer in our dynamic tower defense game. As master of your own castle, you’ll build powerful structures, plan strategic defences, and engage in epic battles against relentless enemies. Each choice you make shapes your kingdom’s destiny.

name: MULTIPLAYER OBBY
short_description: MULTIPLAYER OBBY - A Fun Obstacle Course Race Party Game. Make your way across moving platforms, jump pads, rotating beams and bridges that suddenly open, and more. The first player to pick up the trophy is the winner!

name: Deep Sleep
short_description: If sleep is a long torment...

name: Hidden Series 1
short_description: Experience the engaging and addictive Hidden Series 1 game to find the hidden objects across 40 challenging levels. We have carefully crafted the puzzles which will give the ultimate challenges unlimited fun and allow you to relax.

name: Take the King!
short_description: Forget (almost) everything you know about chess! Help your King to escape dangerous dungeons. Use your pieces wisely and exploit the special squares to avoid vicious traps and defeat nasty enemy pieces.

name: MIMIC
short_description: Uncover the mystery of the MIMIC through a psychological horror experience with puzzles along the way.

name: METAL GEAR SOLID: MASTER COLLECTION Vol.1 BONUS CONTENT
short_description: Volume 1 will feature a variety of bonus contents including the two regional versions of Metal Gear, the original version of Snake's Revenge, the first and second Digital Graphic Novels in video form, and a digital soundtrack.

name: Simple Solitaire
short_description: Play the most basic and simple game of solitaire. This game follows the rules of TriPeaks.

name: Salt and Sacrifice
short_description: Join your fellow Marked Inquisitors in this online coop successor to award-winning 2016 Soulslike Salt and Sanctuary.

name: Raiding.Zone
short_description: Multiplayer Dungeon Raiding inspired by World of Warcraft and Warframe.

name: Game Store Simulator
short_description: Buy and sell video games, upgrade your shop,load the cargo in your vehicle and take it to your store. Sell them to customers, make improvements and purchase new items to increase customer satisfaction and earn your place in the video game sales empire.

name: Magic Escape - Yo.Doggies
short_description: Join three adorable doggie companions in our enchanting escape puzzle game. Brew a witch's potion, uncover secrets, and have a spooktacular adventure together!

name: Abandoned Cabins in the Woods
short_description: Abandoned Cabins in the Woods is a 2D Top-Down Survival Horror game based on the story of a paranormal investigator and streamer called Thomas who decided to investigate the haunted Idaho woods for the paranormal evidence upon the request of his fans.

name: Monolith O Pesadelo
short_description: First person horror, Simple short game, look for keys, unlock passages. Be in an unknown location with a Dark atmosphere. In each phase there will be a different challenge, survive and advance while you try not to get caught. Avoid Scares.

name: Hexa Puzzle Saga
short_description: A block hexa puzzle roguelike where you optimize hexagon puzzles by putting cities together and extending roads to help your kingdom endure. Daily leaderboards show off the greatest rulers.

name: Persha and the Magic Labyrinth -Arabian Nyaights-
short_description: Persha and the Magic Labyrinth is a new kind of puzzle RPG that combines 3-match puzzle and dungeon RPG. Control the main character 'Persha,' a young girl, to solve the mysteries of the tower and catch your nemesis 'Rock'!

name: imomushi
short_description: This is not 'The Great Adventure of the Cute Caterpillar.'

name: Life is not Auto
short_description: 'LIFE IS NOT AUTO'is a rhythm + survival based timing game. You manually control the organs to keep your character alive until life ends.

name: Arcana Alchemia
short_description: 《炼爱秘仪》是由日本知名美少女游戏品牌Lump of Sugar（方糖社）制作的奇幻恋爱题材作品。本作由萌木原文武担当原画与角色设计，由业内多位剧本家携手担当剧本，人气声优天知遥、步莎拉领衔为本作女主角献声。曾荣获萌系游戏大赏年度声音金奖以及月间奖。

name: Cosmos: Stella Returns
short_description: Cosmos: Stella Returns is a metroidvania that will bring you to the mysterious planet of Memoria. Shoot, jump, collect materials and new items in this action-platform with a vintage flavor!

name: Animal Trail ☆ Girlish Square LOVE+PLUS
short_description: Idol otaku, Nakamori Taiga and the girls of idol group Animal Trail ☆ Girlish Square are back in this series of side stories featuring Haneru and Tetora!

name: Ground Parkour : First Mission
short_description: Ground parkour: First Mission, in short, you compete with yourself to reach the highest point on the track with different characters and different abilities in a construction site in the city. Each character has different abilities and you progress on this track full of obstacles. Enjoy!

name: HYNPYTOL
short_description: They're coming. There's no hope. Still, you're a HYNPYTOL.

name: BENDERMAN VR
short_description: BENDERMAN VR - A retro pipeline puzzler! Bend pipes in VR, beat the clock and collect wrenches while staying under the pipe budget. Nostalgic 80s-90s style.Will you be a Plumbing Maestro or a Drenched Dabbler?

name: I'm on Observation Duty 6
short_description: A spot the difference -type of puzzle horror game about monitoring live surveillance camera footage and spotting anomalies. Anomalies range from furniture movement to intruders. Fix anomalies by filing reports. You will need sharp eyes and good memory. The goal is to survive the entire night.

name: The Jackbox Party Pack 10
short_description: Become a party legend! The celebrated franchise returns with epic drawing battles in Tee K.O. 2, chaotic type-offs in FixyText, time-travel trivia in Timejinx, hidden identity intrigue in Hypnotorious, and group music-making in Dodo Re Mi.

name: Mad Sage
short_description: Mad Sage is a 2D action roguelike where you play as a bizarre sorcerer, go to the magical forest and calm the monsters. The forest is full of different types of monsters, for each enemy you need to find your own approach.

name: Fright Animatronics 2
short_description: Fright Animatronics 2 is a first-person horror game where your task is to work in a warehouse for a week. What can go wrong?

name: Keo and the Cosmic Crystals
short_description: Keo and the Cosmic Crystals is a 2D platform game with colorful and cute graphics, featuring high difficulty and precision challenges.

name: Costly Adventure
short_description: In Costly Adventure, Match-3 gameplay meets the concept of roguelite runs. Party of adventurers is seeking a mighty artifact but they must meet the ever increasing payment demands from the bridge Troll.

name: findgold
short_description: Although it's just a simple game of catching gold, it requires cultivating your patience early on.

name: Werewolf Pinball
short_description: Beware of the full moon, the werewolf it's coming for you.

name: amazin' Mage
short_description: amazin' Mage is a top-down, randomly generated dungeon crawler with crafting and with excellent replay value!

name: Valfaris: Mecha Therion
short_description: Therion returns as the hunt for Lord Vroll continues. Pilot an advanced machine of death and destruction in this explosive 2.5D side-scrolling shoot ‘em up, and sequel to the critically acclaimed Valfaris. Strap in and unleash mecha hell!

name: Main Action
short_description: Main Action - 3d top-down shooter with pixel graphics, not a long game with magic and monsters. In this game you will save the world and the villagers from evil. You are a magical creature who alone must cope with evil.

name: Chase Survivors
short_description: Survive the apocalypse for 15 minutes! In 'Chase Survivors,' evolve your character and your weapons to face hordes of horrifying creatures. Rescue is already on the way, just wait.

name: Asterogues
short_description: Beat up planets in Asterogues, a cosmic bullet hell shoot-em-up hybrid! Pick your character from a band of outcasts banished to the Asteroid Belt, dodge and shoot your way through a brutal onslaught of bullets, and take revenge against the Solar System!

name: 执谕者：坠月之兆（Archenemy: Lunafall）
short_description: An era of 'peace' just liberated from the powerful ruling of The Church, A doomsday prophecy of 'the fall of the moon', A struggle and intrigue around the 'last Saint'. 'Archenemy: Lunafall' is a romantic and suspenseful visual novel, which will tell a story about 'self' and...

name: Divine Pig
short_description: The player is an ordinary warrior who is turned into a pig when defeated by a water monster in battle. In order to become human again, players need to go through different levels Step by step, transform into human form and acquire skills. Defeat demons through ultimate efforts and become humans.

name: dotAGE
short_description: Village elder, help us! The Apocalypse is approaching, and we need your guidance to survive. Assign your workers and build a thriving village against the pending doom. DotAGE is the merciless survival roguelite turn-based city builder. Will you fulfill the Prophecy?

name: Rising Dead
short_description: Survive a zombie-infested mall for 3 days. Fight, scavenge, rescue, and customize your character in this dynamic game.

name: Marshmallow Imouto Succubus
short_description: Tsukikawa Keisuke had a strange dream. That dream involved his younger sister but instead of her usual, innocent self, she had lust in her eyes. So he finds out that a succubus lurks within her! How will he choose between his innocent sister and the allure of a lustful succubus?!

name: CRIXUS: Life of free Gladiator
short_description: CRIXUS is a first-person single-player life simulator, Ludus manager, and a hack-and-slash game based in ancient Rome. You are Gladiator and Ludus Manager. Fight in the arena, manage your gladiator school and roam the fictional city. Win tournaments and become the most famous Ludus.

name: Death Again
short_description: Death Again is a single player horror fps. Journey through a nightmarish realm that lies between dimensions in search for salvation.

name: Adventure Trip: London
short_description: If you are a virtual bird but love adventure too, this game is just for you.

name: 3D Survivors
short_description: '3D Survivors' is a flashy and vibrant casual game. Take down the approaching monsters from all directions with high firepower. Obtain various power-up items to prepare for the final boss. Use the acquired score to upgrade the characters.

name: Cozy Space
short_description: 'Cozy Space' is a relaxing home decoration game with true-to-life models and rooms. Enjoy a leisurely gaming experience and easily create cozy spaces. It cleverly blends music elements, allowing you to be a composer, interior designer, or simply relax without specific tasks!

name: One Life Clicker
short_description: A unique idle clicker game with RPG elements. Contains a hardcore survival mode with only one life available and a full progress reset

name: 池畔追思 Poolcore Reflection
short_description: Pool core games. Explore the open pool core, find all the ducks, and unlock new scenes. Relaxing sound effects, no ghost elements, short process, produced by a 15 year old junior high school student alone.

name: Mosa Lina
short_description: a hostile interpretation of the immersive sim, where nothing is planned, and everything works

name: Lords & Blades
short_description: You are on Eswaydan, a snowy mountainous region in the larger Thuyr kingdom. Eswaydan valley, as its called, is surrounded by snowy mountain tops. The land has a curse, every five years a hero is conjured out of the Hillside hut. Save this land as it is your destiny. This is your adventure.

name: Summon
short_description: I wonder who's knocking there?

name: Pumpkinman
short_description: Pumpkinman is variation of classical arcade games in Halloween setting. Travel through world of mystery, full of creatures from tales and horror stories. Improve Your skills and face final adversity.

name: I commissioned some cats 5
short_description: I paid artists to hide cats and wool in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

name: dEskape
short_description: 'dEskape' is a base-building game which sits across the bottom of your desktop allowing you to work, browse, or watch something else while you play. It's idle when you like and active when you want.

name: Lost Princess
short_description: Play this walking simulation. Collect items and try to find missing Princess in big open world

name: IGNISTONE
short_description: 'IGNISTONE' is a roguelike action game that focuses on parry. Your goal is to reach B100F in the dungeon. Find weapons and amulets that suit your playstyle, in a world full of playfulness!

name: Raincouver
short_description: Welcome to Raincouver, a sprawling cyberpunk metropolis on the brink of oblivion. With the city falling into chaos, the government races to eliminate the threat, setting the stage for a desperate mission to rescue your loved one before Raincouver is reduced to ashes at ground zero.

name: Bright Side: Riddles and Puzzles
short_description: Who is lying? Who will survive? Which way is safe? Watch unusual stories and solve tricky riddles with your friends or solo! The more you train your brain, the faster you learn to spot the tiniest details, solve problems and reach smart conclusions.

name: Labyrinthatory
short_description: The best puzzle-based top-down pixel art comedy collectathon adventure based in a retro futuristic formica punk science mansion ever made! Solve hundreds of puzzles with variable difficulty settings as you move through a comedy-mystery storyline.

name: Only Up! 1
short_description: ⭐⭐⭐Have you ever wanted to walk through the peaks and have an eagle vision? To fly over the world like a God ! Embark on an exciting journey in Only UP: Rising ! Play as Jacky, a teenager from the ghetto who wants to get out of poverty and join the wealth of the neighboring metropolis ! ⭐⭐⭐

name: Sunrise's Order
short_description: Sunrise's Order is a farm simulation game in which the player is alone on an island, and seeks to become an accomplished small farmer. The player must use a delivery service called Animazon to support the farm and grow the farm's reputation.

name: 普帕高中 PUPA
short_description: Dare to relive your high school? Welcome to Pupa High School, a blend of 2D, Roguelike card game and visual novel, crafted with a dash of life experiences. It's all about resource management, making choices, and navigating the complex relationships to cultivate your digital alter-ego into maturity.

name: PIN CRASHER
short_description: Pin Crasher is an exciting and unique casual game that combines the classic sport of bowling with the fast paced action of endless runners.

name: Goblin Conqueror
short_description: Kanami, a former Dragon Slayer who lost her job due to the extinction of dragons. Now, she has embraced her new job as a Monster Hunter, wholeheartedly committed to vanquishing goblins.

name: TOSS!🍌
short_description: IT'S TIME TO GO BANANAS! Swing & toss yourself freely across spacey jungle-gym playgrounds as an acrobatic monkey, in this bananas VR platformer. Your agility, timing and VR gamer skill are about to go on a truly bananas ride!

name: The Intruder
short_description: Uncover the chilling secrets of 'The Intruder.' Navigate a haunted mansion, solve puzzles, and evade the lurking darkness. A suspenseful horror-adventure that tests your survival instincts.

name: Jelly Express
short_description: Welcome to Jelly Express - the physics-based co-op game that's as cute as it is fun! Transform into wibbly-wobbly jellies, tackle all obstacles to get those packages delivered! Do it alone, or have a partner to help you out! Stretch, jump and wiggle your way to victory.

name: Paraido
short_description: Paraido is a relaxing yet challenging puzzle game. Complete levels by moving and rotating the puzzle pieces into their correct positions.

name: Double Dragon Advance
short_description: The crown jewel of the Double Dragon series gets a highly anticipated revival! Experience familiar enemies and stages from throughout the series!

name: Solo Hunt
short_description: Welcome to Solo Hunt, the ultimate action rogue-like game! Fight with fearsome monsters in procedural generated worlds.

name: P.R.O.T.O.C.O.O.L.
short_description: P.R.O.T.O.C.O.O.L. It is a multiplayer TPS game with fantastic and colorful graphics, developed by a small team. Fight across multiple game modes and ever-growing maps. Take to the Field, Fight and Survive!

name: Maginet
short_description: Maginet is a turn-based abstract strategy game where two guilds of mages battle each other. Dominate the arena with your wit and wisdom, play locally with friends and against the AI, or online across the world!

name: Aether
short_description: Embark on an electrifying topdown roguelite arpg adventure in Aether. Unleash elemental magic, defeat enemies with fast-paced combat, and conquer challenging boss battles. Unlock divine relics for unique power-ups to save the world in your own way. Are you ready to become a legend?

name: Wormswarm
short_description: Wormswarm is an experimental platformer about jumping on abstract wriggling worms while scoring points.

name: YOMAS
short_description: YOMAS - is a 2D platform game with RPG elements. As you progress through the game, you will encounter new weapons, potions, and coins. All this is required to destroy enemies and bosses!

name: The Last Hero: Journey to the Unknown
short_description: In a world dominated by evil, only one hero against many enemies, explore, conquer, and don't give up if you get lost! Help our hero in this platform game in the fight against the forces of evil.

name: Room Cleaning 2
short_description: Room cleaning 2 - Continuation of the first part of the game! This time you will plunge into the medieval magical world and put things in order in every room that you meet on your way! You have to try out the role of a student who has just been hired!

name: Traffic Tour
short_description: Chill and simple car driving game.

name: Sleepless Night
short_description: Your nightmare haunts you every night, but... are they really nightmares? You better survive them!

name: Bumper Arena
short_description: Buckle up! Bumper Arena is a party game in which you drive a bumper car through a series of arenas featuring different mini-games. Bump and bounce your opponents off the walls, earn the most points during the round and try to win the game!

name: Furious Farm: Total Reap-Out
short_description: The world's first combine-harvester racing game. Fling tires at your opponents and set fields ablaze to reap more grain than anyone else and win the Grain Prix!

name: Velocity Valley
short_description: Race up to 8 players for the fastest lap in 7 minutes. Manage tire wear (soft, medium, hard). Completing 8 laps earns players a coin bonus to unlock new tracks. Violations such as going on the grass, crashing, or multiple cars in the pitlane incur a 3-second penalty.

name: Silent Hope
short_description: Explore, fight, and produce items to grow stronger as seven distinct heroes in this silent world. Guided by the Princess, you'll delve into the Abyss and learn the mysteries of the King and his now-ruined kingdom. In a world without words, what hope is there for humanity?

name: TAGLINE
short_description: A lightning fast, graffiti-based platformer set in a funky, hip-hop metropolis! Explore open levels and master dynamic, movement based abilities. Build your reputation and liberate the city through varied challenges: from parkour trails to basketball shootouts!

name: Demeo Battles
short_description: Demeo Battles is a competitive PvP turn-based strategy game. Choose your champion, assemble an army of monstrous minions, and team up with fellow champions in your quest for turn-based glory!

name: Untold Atlas: otome sim inspired by expedition adventures
short_description: An anime, choice-driven expedition visual novel where you bond and interact with fellow coworkers and three romance-able characters to unlock group chats & romantic scenarios in the story! Choose daily actions to experience branching routes based on your answer choices and relationships (GxB or GxG)

name: At Light Speed
short_description: At Light Speed is a challenging 3D platformer. This world is filled with massive asteroids, obstacles and death defying jump challenges, all to be completed on just one life.

name: 鸡肉哥哥 Chicken Brother
short_description: Exploring in the huge sinkhole, you can transform from a chicken to a muscle man, by jumping, gliding and climbing from the bottom of the sinkhole to the outside world.

name: SHARK! SHARK!
short_description: Inspired by the legendary SHARK! SHARK!® game released in its original version for the Intellivision® home console in 1982, this reimagined version for up to four players offers you a modern and addictive gameplay, fantastic graphics, great sounds, lots of levels and many underwater characters.

name: Pixel Boy - Lost in the Castle
short_description: 2D puzzle game in pixel art graphics. Solve almost 100 levels. No time limit, no enemies. Just fun.

name: Spirittea
short_description: Hey human, we've got problems! This town is crawling with troublesome spirits, and you're the only one who can see them. You'd better get that old bathhouse up and running, maybe that'll help them chill out!

name: Hunteroids
short_description: Our cities are being attacked by meteorites & you are the only one able to protect us! However, your weapon can only destroy one type of meteorite... Create bubbles in the sky & transform all meteorites until they have the right shape, colour & rotation before exploding!

name: SHOVE
short_description: Send your rivals, friends, and yes, even your loved ones flying across this silly yet competitive arena! Fight for royalty, fame, and most importantly, bragging rights. With over 50 unique maps and a wide range of power-ups and obstacles, the laughter will never stop!

name: Ghost Member
short_description: 【Ghost Member】is a single-player ghost investigation horror adventure game. You investigate ghosts in a house where a member of the occult research club who went missing was investigating. The story progresses by using multiple items to find traces left by the ghost and identify the type of ghost.

name: Howl
short_description: Howl is a turn-based tactical folktale set in medieval times. A sinister 'howling plague' has ravaged the land, turning all who hear it into feral beasts. You play a deaf heroine plunging into danger in search of a cure.

name: FORSISTED : The Sacred Souls
short_description: FORSISTED is a horror game, a mission to find an object in an abandoned mansion that is known to be cursed.

name: For The King II
short_description: Battle against Fahrul's tyrannical Queen alone or as a party of four players in the sequel to For The King, the massively popular turn-based roguelite tabletop RPG. Will you unravel the once beloved Queen's terrible secret?

name: Dream Town Island
short_description: A town sim where you raise generations of residents. Unlock new stores and facilities, help your residents find love, or cash in on the stock market!

name: New Zombie
short_description: Military agent Harvey Heller, having received orders, flies with his team to protect a group of scientists who are to create a vaccine. But halfway to his goal he finds himself in a small town where he saves a little girl. From this moment begins his long and not easy journey.

name: Eklips
short_description: Make squares around a dot. A score-based endless puzzle, easy to learn, hard to master. Different difficulty modes for different tastes.

name: Livestream 2: Escape from Togaezuka Happy Place
short_description: Can you escape the horror of being hunted down...? The sequel to the survival horror game 'Livestream: Escape from Hotel Izanami' is now available!

name: The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo
short_description: The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo is a whimsical point’n’click adventure with a surrealist story, astounding hand-drawn animations and hilarious puzzles. Mr. Coo is trapped and broken into pieces. But most of all, he has no idea of what’s going on. Is that a giant chicken over there?

name: Tetris Bliss
short_description: Are you ready to challenge the block fun and explore the wonderful world of Meitu? Come experience this addictive Tetris game eliminate blocks, collect gift boxes, and uncover the secrets of Meitu!

name: Super Spooky Subgame Spectacular
short_description: Plunge into a realm of spine-tingling delights, where ghoulish subgames beckon! Embrace frightful fun in the Super Spooky Subgame Spectacular!

name: Liyf
short_description: Master the art of light and shadow in this unique 2D platformer, controlling both the hero and their shadow to conquer puzzles and foes. A visually stunning, mind-bending adventure awaits!

name: Fruit Salad
short_description: Drop adorable fruit to merge them and create even larger fruit in this cozy physics puzzle game!

name: Ghost Feed
short_description: 这是一款由制作者真实人生经历和感悟衍生而来的游戏。主角来到一座古旧小镇，在阴森大宅中遭遇了古怪的灵异事件。最终发现，自己和宅子的人事物，有很深的联系……

name: A.I.LIENS
short_description: A.I.LIENS - A 3rd Person Shooter RPG with Advanced A.I., Abilities, Player Stats, Inventory, Loot, Dialogue, Interaction, Firearms, Melee Weapons, Weapon Upgrades, Save/Load and much more

name: The Backrooms Origins
short_description: Enter the Backrooms and search for truth. Be careful in there! Because they are coming for you!

name: Pretty Girls Klondike Solitaire PLUS
short_description: 'Pretty Girls Klondike Solitaire' the solitaire game with Klondike rules, is now available in a powered-up version! Play solitaire against 11 beautiful girls, from cool beauties to tsundere ladies!

name: American Eristics
short_description: Would you believe one of your friends is a killer? Return home in this 2.5D horror story.

name: RogueMusk
short_description: RogueMusk is a fast-paced action shooter with a third-person view in a cybersecurity setting. While running vast distances, collect scattered particles of matter, pick up temporary upgrades and conduct targeted fire at the sentry droids. Buy upgrades for your pistol and carefully watch your step.

name: Escape from Norwood
short_description: Explore a city that lives without your input in this illustrated text adventure. Observe the lives of its inhabitants behind the veil of your invisibility magic. Find items and combine them to solve intricate puzzles. Set your own pace as you control time and move freely in an open fantasy world.

name: BROWN BOB
short_description: Join Brown Bob in his thrilling adventure and help him save his beloved pet!

name: Project Third Eye
short_description: Enter the groundbreaking world of Project Third Eye, a VR physics game where creativity meets interactivity. Build anything with powerful tools and add logic using the visual scripting panel. Embark on an immersive adventure of endless possibilities. Get your copy now!

name: Off-Road Rides
short_description: Off-Road Rides is an exciting 3D driving game in which you have to drive a car of your choice and avoid obstacles on a construction side off-road scenery.

name: Clay Monkey: The Master Potter and The Kiln God
short_description: Clay Monkey is a top-down exploration game based on sourcing materials from the earth to make ceramic art that will be displayed in a final art exhibition. With a dream, not just a monkey; an artist.

name: Battle Shapers
short_description: Battle Shapers is a blazing-fast, sci-fi FPS roguelite in which you shoot and smash your way through swarms of corrupt robots. Wield powerful weapons, abilities and game-changing new powers stolen from ruthless Overlords.

name: LuLu's weapons shop
short_description: 《露露的装备店》是一款模拟经营向RPG游戏。在游戏中，你将扮演名叫露露的精灵少女，在一个偏远的小镇上，从零开始经营一家装备店。据说，这个小镇的上一家装备店才开几天就倒闭了，而这一次，能够将店成功运营起来吗？

name: Devilish Blind Date
short_description: This game is heavily inspired by『Vampire Survivors』 You are summoned into an Isekai and fighting monsters with a mysterious girl, Nanako.

name: Let Them Fall
short_description: Let Them Fall is a dynamic puzzle-strategy game. Transport objects using conveyor belts to the target zone. With each level, the game gets tougher with diverse shapes, colors, and limited space on procedurally generated maps. Will you take up the challenge?

name: Dusty Crib
short_description: Dusty Crib is a hidden object game. Slow gameplay will allow you to concentrate on searching and finding all the necessary things from the list to complete the level. Look more carefully as many items end up in the most unexpected places.

name: SWORDCAR
short_description: SWORDCAR is an automotive CAR-achter action game with a healthy serving of gore. Slash and slice at 100 MPH and bathe in the blood of the mysterious BUSY CORP.

name: Dirt Bike Racer Simulator
short_description: Get realistic motorcycle experience on offroad terrains with Dirt Bike Racer Simulator! Complete quests, explore the open world, and enjoy the adrenaline-filled ride.

name: Lost Hope: Backrooms
short_description: Lost Hope, a chilling singleplayer horror game set in the eerie Backrooms universe, challenges players to delve into enigmatic locations teeming with bizarre and inexplicable phenomena.

name: Rogue Cards
short_description: Rogue Cards is a roguelite deck builder, where every run is unique and long term strategy matters. Set in a randomized fantasy world, where death is only the next step to being a godlike deckmaster.

name: Jack Dragon and the Stone of Peace
short_description: Jack Dragon is a retro game love letter to 80 and 90s arcade games. Avoid nasties, jump on platforms, glide around the screen and collect gems! Sounds easy, right?

name: Up to Gods
short_description: Up to Gods is a single-player platformer game known for its unique story and philosophy. In a world where the gods have declared war on humanity. You must navigate the challenging and sin-filled path prepared by the gods to reach them and save the future of humanity.

name: Digital Eclipse Arcade: Invasion of the Buffet Snatchers
short_description: Rude aliens have arrived to sample Earth's legendary all-you-can-eat buffet, and they're sending a smorgasboarding party down to YOUR dining room. Can you assemble and deliver their plates of food before the aliens wreck the restaurant?

name: Drunken way to Home
short_description: You've drunk too much... Let's go home while being aware of the dangerous around you! Drunken movements are fully simulated with physical calculation. Enjoy your drunkenness :)

name: GoldenLand: Card game
short_description: GoldenLand: Card Game is a card strategy in which the player has to use cards represented by various monsters. Each card has a unique behavior with which you can strengthen or attack other cards.

name: Pizza Delivery [zebaxx]
short_description: You are a young Spanish woman who has just moved to the outskirts of Venice, and has just found a job in a newly opened pizzeria...

name: The Line TD
short_description: In The Line TD, you decide your path and you survive! Plan your strategy, carve your own path, choose your difficulty and survive the longest!

name: 只管战斗 Unorthodox game
short_description: 一款只管战斗的肉鸽

name: Relic Hunters Legend
short_description: Save the galaxy in this action-packed co-op Looter Shooter! Join during Early Access to get an exclusive player badge—available for a limited time!

name: It Happened Here: Beacon of Truth Collector's Edition
short_description: Dive into a cold case of murder and betrayal at a lighthouse!

name: The Gap
short_description: Driven by a rare neurological affliction plaguing his family, Joshua has to recover his memories by exploring parallel realities through déjà vu. Facing the innermost depths of his past – moments both joyous and painful – seems to be the only way to get his life and family back together.

name: Стены
short_description: Slava is an ordinary guy living in a shabby socket. Well, like living, existing. He has lost all his dreams, and now he has one task - not to live until dawn. But before that you need to write a will...

name: exclusion| 間引き
short_description: One day, the protagonist happens to be on a train that has a train accident. The accident, which made national headlines, set off a chain of tragedies for those who were also present. Who is the victim and who is the perpetrator?

name: Mob Factory
short_description: Mob factory is an tower defense and automation game for the lazy adventurer. Smelt down enemy loot into turrets & factories to automate an ever expanding dungeon from the comfort of your tower.

name: aerofly RC 10 - RC Flight Simulator
short_description: Aerofly RC 10 is the ultimate radio controller flight simulator for beginners and experts alike.

name: Boots and Daggers
short_description: How much COIN can you grab before time runs out?

name: Speard
short_description: Speard is a fast paced platformer. Beat levels as fast as you can. Traverse your way through vast worlds with only a Spear and a Rocket Jump.

name: Capybro
short_description: Play as a Capybara and be a bro to your forest friends as you make your way to the spa.

name: I doesn't exist - a modern text adventure
short_description: Classic Zork meets Existential Crisis. A modern text adventure that explores themes of control, isolation and mental health while levelling up the genre with beautiful pixel art.

name: Spookermarket
short_description: A survival horror that takes place in a supermarket. Collect all the items on your shopping list and make it out alive.

name: Zonescape
short_description: You wake up in one of the prison cells. By chance, you end up with a key in your pocket that you can use to open your door. Escape from the most secure prison in the world!

name: Village
short_description: A young boy has come to a distant village to visit his grandmother. Arriving at the final station, in some wilderness, we find newspaper clippings on the platform. This is where our tangled story begins.

name: Katana Rama
short_description: A mobility based, fast paced action game where you play as a hacker program, with the mission of breaking out of a digital security system. Lay waste to all that stands in your way.

name: Unispies - Chapter 1 Havana Cuba
short_description: A group of smart, latin american, attractive female hackers steal 2 billion of bitcoin from a communist dictator. Then their lives and family are targeted by the dictator for that crime. The team of girls are rescued by Omar, an ex Mi-6 British agent who runs the Spies for Hire team called Unico.

name: Shrink Assault
short_description: Shrink Assault is a Sci-Fi game featuring a mix of Infinite Runners and Rail Shooter games! Skilfully control your spaceship to dodge obstacles and eliminate the threat! Can you survive?

name: Block The Monster
short_description: The way I make it becomes the way! A round at the square block! Square Block 3D Tower Defense with various routes and strategies! Turn the tide of battle by deploying powerful heroes. How many waves can you hold on until the defense collapses and breaks down?

name: Falls and Jumps
short_description: Falls and Jumps is an endless 2D platform game about where you need to stay alive by jumping on platforms that appear for a short time and avoiding deadly traps. Your task is to hold out as long as possible.

name: Lost Paws
short_description: Play as a stray dog in an open world survival game! Run, jump, dig, and bonk your way through a vast city and its surrounding areas. Meet new people and learn new abilities as you search for a way home. How you play determines how the world will play with you. What kind of doggo will you be?

name: Ultrazone
short_description: Take control of the soldiers to guide them and restrain the enemy forces

name: Son of Perun Kharkiv
short_description: Son of Perun: Kharkiv is a first-person shooter in the setting of Kharkiv of the future and retrowawe.

name: Ponk's Jam: The Tulip Thief
short_description: Guess who’s back, dudes and gally?! In an all new universe, Ponk is here to save the world of Obal from the threat of The Tulip Thief! Embark on a huge journey through 6 crazy environments to retrieve the Artefacts from the 5 Beholders; and also meet hilarious characters along the way.

name: Project Regolith
short_description: Work together with a partner to solve a series of non-Euclidean Escape Room puzzles to uncover the mystery behind the vanished crew of Outpost Rhea, a deep-space research facility experiencing strange spatial anomalies.

name: Shipwrecked
short_description: Shipwrecked on a uncharted island, master survival alone or with friends. Battle, build, and conquer foes as you confront the mysteries lurking in its shadows.

name: Backrooms Doors
short_description: Backrooms Doors - This is an atmospheric first-person horror game. Explore spaces that can't exist in the real world and find your way out before the entities find you.

name: Soul's Majesty Rise of Gilda
short_description: Soul's Majesty Rise of Gilda! Story based platform game. Sometimes it will drive you crazy with its difficulty! Overcome obstacles, pass levels and collect the story!

name: Protolife: Other Side
short_description: Reverse Tower Defense game where you control waves of creatures against towers. Protolife game spin-off.

name: Astrea: Six-Sided Oracles
short_description: Astrea is a DICE-deck-building roguelike that flips the script on deckbuilders by using dice instead of cards and an unique dual “damage” system: Purification vs Corruption. Build a dice pool strong enough to purify Astrea's out-of-control corruption and save the Star System.

name: Lords of the Fallen
short_description: A vast world awaits in all-new, dark fantasy action-RPG, Lords of the Fallen. As one of the fabled Dark Crusaders, embark on an epic quest to overthrow Adyr, the demon God.

name: Aladdin of the Forsaken Lands
short_description: Experience a fantastical take on the classic Arabian Nights tale! Using the classic ATB (Active Time Battle) combat system, six adventurers will travel across sand dunes and past colossal sandworms to uncover a treasure which may save their kingdom.

name: Mineko's Night Market
short_description: Mineko’s Night Market is a narrative-driven, social simulation adventure game that celebrates Japanese culture and invites players to craft whimsical items, eat delicious snacks, and ultimately enjoy all the cats.

name: Adventure Apple Robots
short_description: Help the hero to find out why his brother is always running away, explore this fantastic world and unlock new skills as he ventures.

name: Ghostbusters: Spirits Unleashed Ecto Edition
short_description: This is an asymmetrical game of hide and seek. In true form to IllFonic’s past titles, this title is a 4v1 setup where players will either play as part of a team of new Ghostbusters or a singular Ghost.

name: Akui - The Insane Cultists
short_description: A fist person dark mystery adventure in a parallel world peppered with monsters and puzzles.

name: Aatral
short_description: In ancient India, King Vallaan ventures to an infected Eng Empire to rescue his queen, Alli. Evil powers and creatures control the land. Can Vallaan overcome the darkness and save his beloved, or will they both succumb to the sinister forces?

name: Uprising
short_description: Grab your bat, lock your shields and light up that molotov: it’s time to take to the streets! Uprising is a brutal modern day riot simulator, where you fight either as police or protestors in a frenzied multiplayer melee/shooter mash-up.

name: Fish Game
short_description: Fish Game is a detailed and highly “sofishticated” aquarium simulator, lovingly crafted *by* enthusiasts *for* enthusiasts! Featuring fish with personalities and dynamic relationships, water quality modeling, and so much more! Made with support from our friends at Smarter Every Day!

name: Sunken Ships
short_description: Explore a little seaside coast of submerged ruins, sunken ships and lonely islands.

name: Cube Jump
short_description: Minimalist cube jumper with good music and plenty of levels!

name: Micro Games: Volume 1
short_description: Retro 2D collection of 4 micro games

name: Marble Magicks
short_description: In this Game your goal is to place 3 marbles of the same color next to each other, by taking a marble from the top depot and letting them fall on the scales below.

name: Dungeon Dungeon!
short_description: Dungeon Dungeon! is a turn-based RPG featuring roguelike elements and unique combat system. Recruit companions, upgrade skills, collect loot. Become a dungeon adventurer and lead your party to conquer the dungeons!

name: Memory Fragment
short_description: Roid, a repairman in a small town, finds a photo album full of memories in an old box in the barn. Join him on his journey into the polaroid pictures of the memories he had before he became a repairman!

name: Stream to 3D
short_description: Stream to 3D provides fully automatic on-the-fly conversion of 2D videos to 3D, as they are played or streamed, together with off-line conversion. Designed for VR headsets and beyond, bring your 2D videos to life in breathtaking 3D and embark on a journey of immersive entertainment.

name: Empyreal Dawn
short_description: Empyreal Dawn is a Gothic Fantasy Adventure where you lead a party named Caeruleum. Accompanied by the Swordsmaiden Alice Starwell, undertake your first steps toward becoming legendary heroes! Featuring full voice acting, an original soundtrack, and more!

name: Bellus Battle
short_description: Enter the world of Bellus, a world where cute animals run wild in a epic battle for glory. Blast your friends with Shotguns, Rail guns, Zeus lightning bolts, Bombs, Portal Guns, and much more. This is BELLUS BATTLE. Be the last one standing!

name: Polygons Tower Defense
short_description: Defend this colorful world with a brilliant strategy! Strengthen your battlefield and don't let enemies reach their destination. Make amazing combinations, and choose the most powerful elements wisely!

name: Ridevery
short_description: In the game you have to become the fastest and most reliable pizza delivery guy, conquering realistic city streets on your high-speed scooter.

name: TOBOR
short_description: TOBOR is a surveillance simulator game where your mission is to observe an insane world using a surveillance camera. You have 7 days to gather intelligence and investigate the tragic story of Undercroft.

name: Quarantine-Z: Survival
short_description: 2 years have passed since a virus totally unknown to humanity originated in your small town. People have become aggressive and cannibalistic.

name: Shinogi Chess Club 2: Resistance
short_description: As Himiko Masaki continues the search for her mother, the resistance to change ever marches on when new rebellion groups challenge the city's obsession with Shinogi Chess, and the struggle for truth envelops Yoshino High School. Every move counts in Shinogi Chess Club 2: Resistance!

name: Mtn Chaos
short_description: Conquer treacherous mountain terrain in Mtn Chaos! Drive powerful off-road vehicles, jump ramps, dodge obstacles, and customize your ride. Experience intense racing and thrilling challenges in this adrenaline-fueled off-road adventure!

name: URBO
short_description: URBO is a relaxing and meditative city-building puzzle game. Begin with an empty grid of landscape, choose an architectural style and build. Aim to support the needs of your people and your own aesthetic tastes, and watch your city flourish.

name: Two Moon : Space Rabbit
short_description: I didn't know what you'd like, so I brought six weapons from Earth. The items are as similar to those on Earth as possible. So will you grow stronger for me, or will you defeat me? Whatever you choose, it will play out as I expect.

name: The Bloodline
short_description: The Bloodline is a sandbox adventure RPG that lets you play your way. Reforge bonds between kingdoms, explore the wilds, craft and plan adventures and wield mighty weapons or magic as you prepare for what is to come…

name: Rolling Toolman 2 Deathly Traps
short_description: New rolling toolman game. Try to reach finish fast and avoid deathly traps

name: Survival on a deserted island
short_description: The players of 'Survival on a deserted island' are immersed in a challenging and adventurous desert island. We need to constantly explore islands, find resources to manage our hunger, thirst, and physical strength, and build shelters to resist the threat of terrifying skeletons wandering around.

name: Skull Island: Rise of Kong
short_description: Embark on a quest to avenge the death of your parents at the hands of the alpha predator: Gaw. Conquer waves of primal beasts and defeat the minions of your arch-nemesis. Traverse the mysterious island and uncover secrets as you encounter swamps, waterfalls, jungle, and skullite-filled caves.

name: SONIC SUPERSTARS
short_description: Adventure through the mystical Northstar Islands in this all-new take on classic 2D Sonic high-speed action platforming.

name: ALEON's Nightmare 2
short_description: Welcome to the World of Nightmares! You play as Aleon, you woke up in an unfamiliar place. You need to understand what is going on and get help from the surrounding objects. The nightmare world includes different parts. Castle, Kingdom, Forest, and Dungeon.

name: Limerick: Cadence Mansion
short_description: Limerick: Cadence Mansion is a detail-rich first-person action-horror adventure with deep lore, intricate puzzles, satisfying combat, and a happy little marionette who really wants to say 'hello.'

name: Dynaforce
short_description: In the classic FPS style, Dynaforce combines tactics and marksmanship. You'll collaborate with your team to devise strategies and take down enemies, participating in intense battles on various maps.

name: NASCAR Arcade Rush
short_description: The thrill of NASCAR meets the rush of arcade racing in a new game that puts you in the driver’s seat of a completely new NASCAR experience with re-imagined, iconic racetracks in unmatched high-speed, wheel-to-wheel action!

name: Animal Planner
short_description: A relaxing sliding puzzle game about arranging animals to make them happy.

name: STAR OCEAN THE SECOND STORY R
short_description: In this science fantasy RPG, choose between Claude or Rena, play through their perspectives, and unlock various endings. Recruit allies and defeat foes in fast paced real-time battles.

name: 樱花校园之恋模拟器
short_description: 1. The background of the game is an interesting story that happened in the small town of Sakura on the campus. The gameplay is still very free. 2. You can also learn more knowledge and experience various daily activities, waiting for players to explore in the game.

name: Higher or Black
short_description: A card game where the objective is to correctly predict the next card. If one fails to do so, they will be punished and have to try again.

name: Toufra
short_description: Toufra is a challenging speedrunning game. Your only companion is your trustworthy grapple to manipulate in air. Take on this challenge throughout multiple immersive levels set in dark enviroment.

name: Rise of Gun
short_description: Rise of Gun - immerses you in a world of zombie apocalypse as a gun store owner. Buy parts, craft, sell, upgrade your store and hire workers. Help to humanity survive

name: 8-Colors Star Guardians +
short_description: Alien monsters have invaded Earth! It's up to the Star Guardians, a dysfunctional group of heroines, to protect the planet and awkwardly save the day (yet again)! Fight evil with pixelated style, in this turn-based, choose-your-boss-path game made with just 8 colors!

name: Limos' Lair
short_description: In this Action-Puzzle Metroidvania, you will explore the lair of a long-gone mythical creature and unravel its mysteries. Consume enemies to gain their abilities, use your frog-like tongue to grapple and fight, explore the land, solve puzzles, find secrets, and complete challenges.

name: Surreal House
short_description: Surreal House is a point-and-click puzzle game inspired by escape rooms. Use items, open locks, and solve puzzles in the different rooms of varying themes. Enter the house if you dare.

name: KILLING DREAMWORKS
short_description: It's a murderous adventure filled with whimsy, grotesque ghosts and high-powered weapons. Find your AI teammates and form a powerful fighting squad. Draw your cards to get powerful props and skills. Collect all kinds of materials and fight against the tide of monsters hunting.

name: Soul King
short_description: Slice, shoot, and drink tea all while being chased through tight retro FPS levels by the whispering wall of death in this score-focused corridor shooter inspired by The Club and classic 90's Shooters.

name: Tile Lands
short_description: Tile Lands is a minimalist, City Building strategy game about managing and optimising buildings using a limited deck of tiles.

name: TRANSFORMERS: EARTHSPARK - Expedition
short_description: Battle and explore as courageous Autobot, Bumblebee, in an exciting action adventure to stop his nemesis, Mandroid, from becoming the ultimate evil cyborg.

name: LoFi Kitten
short_description: Step into the dreamy world of LoFi Kitten, where the soothing LoFi music meets the adorable charm of cats. Immerse yourself in a relaxing and heartwarming experience combining the challenges of puzzle games with the calming embrace of LoFi beats and melodies. Ready to let the music guide you?

name: Void Runner
short_description: Climb and parkour your way to the skies exploring mysterious realms in a unique world blending earth and void where the sky is not the limit. but do not fall, The higher you go, the harder it gets.

name: DreadHaunt
short_description: Join the hunts as 3-5 agents in this multiplayer Co-op & PVP about horror and deception. One of you will be possessed then become a ghost, and the others must survive the haunting!

name: Penguin Hatchery
short_description: Penguin Hatchery is a game about hatching penguins. Yeah, that's pretty much it. With the help of some clicking and some random things that sometimes make sense, sometimes don't you can begin to hatch penguin eggs and eventually hatch them at an insane rate!

name: Златогорье
short_description: В то время как армия нечисти подошла к Златогорью - у людей уже не было больше сил бороться, и тогда Светлые Боги решили сделать исключение и послали героя, который должен спасти человечество и найти свое прошлое и будущее.

name: Elon VS Ai
short_description: Elon VS Ai is a 3D arena shooter in which you have to play as a warrior on a large arena, shooting persistent robots, gaining experience, improving skills, buying new weapons and fighting different types of robots.

name: Myrcella the Meandering Mage
short_description: “Myrcella the Meandering Mage” is comedic fantasy point-and-click adventure game and yuri dating sim. Follow Myrcella as she travels around the beautiful Kingdom of Falkenhorn, solves the townsfolks’ problems using her magic and charms the local ladies too! Adventure and romance await!

name: Pirate Haven
short_description: Sail the seas as a pirate captain in this challenging roguelike action adventure game! Battle other pirates, search for booty, and upgrade your ship at ports. You can also find ship power-ups and encounter dangerous boss events and storm events.

name: Boaty Tanks
short_description: Embark on an aquatic adventure! Control a small boat, armed with weapons, and navigate arenas. Battle enemy pool floats, test your skills, and immerse yourself in thrilling boat combat. Survive challenging fights and show off your shooting skills!

name: REPLAY BOYS
short_description: Band emergency! This was supposed to be Hannah’s day off, but now she’s been roped into managing The Replay Boys, an up-and-coming boy band. Make choices to stoke multi-timeline romances, keep the band from killing each other, and fight a resurrected ’80s pop star ghost. Can you manage?

name: Last Hopeless
short_description: Killis hundreds of zombie and get new reinforcement items for survivng. choose your best item set and upgrade them to get hidden skill. Last Hopeless is a rogue-like game with some physics feed back, you can play with gun, hammer, kitchen knife and other hundreds of items to survival longer.

name: Inukari - Fateful detour
short_description: The standalone addon for Inkuari - Chase of Desception with two new world and local multiplayer duel mode. Its a fast and smooth action jump & run game like in the good old days.

name: Q2 HUMANITY
short_description: he smash hit game “Q REMASTERED”, which became extremely popular amongst users in Japan in early 2023, is now coming back! 'Q2 HUMANITY' is finally available as Early Access! In 'Q2' the sequel to 'Q1' you can play as a character yourself. You can fly, jump, run, draw, grab, throw, and so on.

name: Mistward
short_description: Mistward is a survival city-builder set on a mysterious island enshrouded in a poisonous mist! Create light sources to keep the mist at bay, build houses and command humans to gather resources. Explore the island and find a way out!

name: Monkey Party
short_description: Merge balls, unleash adorable monkeys, and build a tower of fun in Monkey Party! Master precision placement for maximum monkey mischief. It's a charming puzzle adventure that's easy to play and hard to put down!

name: Survival Dead Poly
short_description: Survival Dead Poly is contains almost everything you need to survival and have an adventure games.Good luck on your journey!

name: Outerstellar
short_description: Stranded on a hostile and deadly planet, you must gather resources, build shelter, and fight to survive each night. But the secrets of this world await in a gripping sci-fi survival PvP game.

name: Billionaire Simulator - Rags to Riches
short_description: You are poor. You have no money. Life is unfair. Until you discover a mysterious software on your computer that allows you to make money by just clicking your mouse. The more you click, the more you make. Pretty soon, you're wealthier than you could have possibly imagined... And yet you want more.

name: Jewel Match Atlantis Solitaire 4 - Collector's Edition
short_description: Immerse yourself in the enchanting depths of the mystical underwater realm of Atlantis Solitaire! Delve into numerous intricate underwater levels and build stunning aquatic landscapes. Tackle the latest Supersize, Challenge, and Match-2 levels as you unlock a multitude of new solitaire variations.

name: Lucky gem
short_description: Work with various sprites to collect gems of different colors and shapes, and help the sprites repair their home.

name: Marine Glory
short_description: Marine Glory is a single player sailing looting adventure. Find treasures, buy and upgrade new ships and explore multiple universes.

name: Baby Climbing
short_description: Baby Climbing is a 3d third person game where you control a baby in a dream where you have to climb platforms in order to reach the end. climb the platforms and complete the mission without falling and overcoming the obstacles

name: Get Me Out, Please
short_description: Work together with friends to escape an abandoned school in this horror escape action game for up to four players, but beware: one of you will become a monster.

name: Shitting Pigeon
short_description: Shitting Pigeon is a 3D pigeon stealth action game and bird droppings simulator. Fly over the city, scare people and eat a lot of bread.

name: Hanabi
short_description: Connect vertical, horizontal, curved, and crisscross ropes well,Burn the ropes to ignite the fireworks balls!Let's set off beautiful fireworks!

name: Prescience
short_description: Unlike other single player deckbuilder, you are going to fill a bag with black and white stones. Wether you can use your skills depends on the order you pick the stones. Build a unique combo, defeat powerful enemies, and don't forget to use your Prescience!

name: RAINBOW HIGH™: RUNWAY RUSH
short_description: Play as the Rainbow High girls, explore the school and use their unique talents to complete your first art assignment. #LetYourTrueColorsShine

name: Made Marion
short_description: A romantic action-adventure visual novel based on Robin Hood lore. Play as Lady Marion and choose what kind of leader and lover you want to become. Join Robin's rowdy rebels in Sherwood or tackle the political pitfalls of the Sheriff's Nottingham. Fight for freedom and fall in love!

name: Liminal Border Part I
short_description: First game of a four-part visual novel series. Nerdy Itsuki Ninomae accidentally creates a “digital hypnotism movie.” Showing it to his neighbor causes him to learn her and a classmate’s dark secret, dragging him into the underbelly of society.

name: Endoparasitic VR
short_description: Three limbs ripped off, infected with a deadly parasite, you must save your research. Drag yourself through the corridors of a secret research lab on a remote asteroid, fight off horribly mutated monsters, inject countless syringes of vaccines, and survive at all costs.

name: FLOAT
short_description: A aimless rafting trip, anything possible will be your boat. Tiny boats will be swallowed by fast-flowing rivers, but mighty boats will stand firm. When encountering danger, do you choose to avoid it or bravely overcome it? Use your ingenuity to make this journey go further!

name: Art of Golf
short_description: Go on a golf journey. Explore beautiful landscapes. Play in tournaments, beat challenges or compete for high scores. Have fun with many extra sports, minigames and game modes.

name: Army Troop
short_description: Army Troop is an old-school PvP World War 2 online first-person shooter. Reminding you of the good old days World War games.

name: Gamebesh
short_description: Gamebesh offers an enjoyable Prop Hunt experience designed for a minimum of two players, with room for up to eight players. It introduces two engaging classes: Hunters and Hiders. Both classes receive a random spell at the start, adding a unique thrill to the game.

name: Wild Hunting
short_description: Immerse yourself in a virtual world of outdoor hunting in wild environments full of animals.

name: Venus Puzzles
short_description: Come explore a unique world of beautiful women, unleash your puzzle solving skills, collect the most fascinating artworks, and enjoy endless enjoyment.

name: Boxing Champion
short_description: Boxing Champion is a very special experience, when the monster rushes at you, don't hesitate, 'PANG, PANG' give it two punches, and the crazy boxing fight begins. Before gaming, SteamVR needs to be set up as OpenXR.

name: _message:
short_description: _전언:(_message:)은 심리적 공포 요소가 포함된 텍스트 어드벤처 게임입니다. 달에 잔류하여 지구에 있는 본부와 통신을 하는 사이, 당신은 점점 이상한 낌새를 눈치채기 시작합니다...

name: The Attic
short_description: Explore a strange and mysterious complex to find your missing son. Can you sneak through the depths of loss and survive the horrors that stalk you in The Attic? A first person cinematic experience with a haunting soundtrack.

name: Love Connect
short_description: If you are lonely and bored at home alone, little brother, come and play with me. If you win, you will be given the reward that a man wants.

name: JJJ
short_description: 'A normal vacation' the three friends were thinking, when they were drawn into a macabre ending.

name: Poly Survivor
short_description: Hordes of monsters are threatening the Poly Village! Raise your weapons, choose your equipments and enjoy the battles……But be aware of those powerful monsters! Make full use of the environment and collect items continuously. Keep getting stronger until finally you defeat your enemies.

name: Atlantis Academy
short_description: Arcane magic bubbles up from a forgotten city…can you harness the power of the depths? You’ve tamed a feral water dragon and are now eligible to train alongside other magical merfolk at the Academy. A sublime, underwater fantasy RPG!

name: Dungeon of Horror
short_description: Dungeon of Horror - a 2D-pixel dungeon labyrinth, where you play as a girl trying to find the way out and discover all the dark corners of this frightening place. Watch your steps, avoid traps, collect all loot and escape the dungeon!

name: Rooms
short_description: You have found yourself in unexplained circumstances in an endless building with no apparent way out. Traverse through 100 rooms filled with monsters and puzzles and uncover the secrets of this building.

name: Demon Of The Dark
short_description: A 3D Survival Horror Game, in which the player has to investigate an abandoned hospital, while looking out for whatever danger that resides in the unknown darkness. Play Demon Of The Dark for a bone-chilling experience, like none other!

name: Ancient Relics - Egypt
short_description: Embark on an Egyptian adventure with Linda and Robert, solving puzzles and restoring a once-thriving village to its former splendor.

name: Little Goody Two Shoes
short_description: Venture into the woods as you play Little Goody Two Shoes, a phantasmagorical horror narrative adventure where all your decisions matter!

name: World War ToonZ
short_description: Navigate across the city while surviving wave after wave of zombie attacks in this high-action zombie apocalypse. As you progress deeper into the apocalypse, join your fellow troops in multiplayer to discover who will reign supreme as the final survivor.

name: Just Find It 3
short_description: Explore hidden variations and engage with exciting new challenges in Just Find It 3!

name: Midnight Heist
short_description: Go on heists through Midnight City alone or with up to three friends to fulfill tasks as a hacker for various organizations. Improve your reputation, earn money and uncover the secrets of shady companies in this co-op horror game.

name: Wiki's Wild Ride
short_description: A birthright denied. An alliance forged. A plan hatched. The Jerks have locked away your dinners deep in the depths of the basement! Now you must ride your trusty steed through the house and reclaim what's rightfully yours!

name: Overpass 2
short_description: Identify the best routes and balance of power, speed and precision to overcome obstacles at the controls of a UTV, ATV or Rock Bouncer. In both solo and multiplayer mode, your talent and choices of technique will make the difference.

name: Devoid Prototype
short_description: Fight, Mine, Scavenge, Trade, Craft or Mission your way through the Anadeia Galaxy as you explore synergies of different skills, ships, weapons and equipment alone or on the couch with a friend in this sci fi space sim.

name: I AM DIE
short_description: I AM DIE is a physics-based 3D puzzle platformer in which you play as the dice itself, guiding a ball through ramps, tubes, conveyors, and other obstacles. Explore, solve problems, and try not to roll a six!

name: Fish on the desktop
short_description: Fish culture in reality is expensive and time-consuming! In this game, your desktop is connected to the sea and lake, where you can purchase various types of fish and cultivate on-hook without affecting the computer operation. It's enjoyable to watch the fish swim freely on your computer desktop...

name: The Backrooms Recorded
short_description: Navigate a nightmarish labyrinth, avoid eerie entities, and uncover dark secrets in this liminality based horror game. Explore realistic levels, unravel secrets, and figure out life or death puzzles. Will you escape the madness? Brought to you by a solo 13 year old dev.

name: Mercenaries Saga 3 -Gray Wolves of War-
short_description: “Mercenaries Saga 3: Gray Wolves of War” is a tactical simulation RPG set in a fantasy background. It is the third game of the Mercenaries Saga.

name: The Great Fear
short_description: Deep Fear will make you plunge into an atmosphere of horror and hopelessness. For salvation, you can only rely on yourself.

name: 悸恐
short_description: 这是一款只能在夜晚才能打开的第一人称恐怖游戏。玩家将扮演负责几十年前调查恐怖杀人案的老侦探，在快找出真相的时候，回想起尘封的记忆......

name: Hitler is my crush
short_description: Hitler is my Crush is an absurd adventure in which you will plunge into the world of black humor and satire. You have to take on the role of a girl who is in love with Hitler and does not want to share him, and go on an absurd journey with Hitler, who is captured by saboteurs.

name: Heads Will Roll: Reforged
short_description: Hardcore survival RPG with non-linear story that lets you play as a young medieval soldier who over the course of battles and adventures becomes the most formidable and respected knight of his era. Or, if he’s not lucky enough, perishes in the chaos of the Hundred Years' War.

name: Tribe: Primitive Builder
short_description: Chill out as you explore the beautiful, realistic island of exiles. Gather resources, craft tools, construct buildings and settlements. Manage tribe and automate your gameplay. Discover 4 lands, a storyline and save the inhabitants of the island.

name: Cactus Simulator 2
short_description: Cactus Simulator 2 is a game in which you can become a cactus.

name: Fusing Noracam
short_description: Climb the mysterious tower to get the legendary treasure said to be at the top. The controls are simple, but if you make even one mistake, you will fall. You can also connect to the internet and climb with someone.

name: Springtime Hike
short_description: Experience the beauty of spring and the wonders of the forest in Springtime Hike. Explore hidden locations, uncover the secrets of nature, and complete the ultimate hike. Your journey begins now.

name: Blood Red
short_description: Blood Red is a co-op survival horror game that can be played with 1-4 players. Figure out the demon and banish it using your special demon hunting kit!

name: Three Days to Chicago
short_description: One of them is visiting a friend in Chicago. The other wants to shake things up in New York City. It starts in San Francisco, but where this relationship goes is all up to you.

name: Extreme Bus Driver Simulator
short_description: Are you ready to become an experienced bus driver? Experience the thrill of transporting passengers in a realistic city with Extreme Bus Driver Simulator! Get passengers to their destination on time and safely, earn rewards and customize your bus.

name: Star Trek: Infinite
short_description: Star Trek: Infinite is a grand strategy experience that lets you play your own Star Trek story as the leader of one of four major factions in the galaxy. Follow the specially crafted story or blaze your own trail in the first Star Trek grand strategy game.

name: Jet Up
short_description: Jump with jetpack!. only you need to do is go up! the only thing you need is your skill!

name: Saturnalia
short_description: A Single-Player Survival Horror Adventure: play as a cast of characters exploring an isolated village haunted by an ancient ritual—but beware, its labyrinthine roads will change each time you lose all your characters.

name: Install Fee Tycoon
short_description: Chaos3D, The popular game engine, has started charging developers each time their games are installed. They are also paying you to re-install those games. Get Rich, and destroy the video game industry in the process!

name: Conquistadorio
short_description: The conquistador, who has faced many trials in his life, decided to retire and become a hermit. Just lying in his solitary cave away from people. But it seems that fate itself throws new challenges at you even in such a simple matter.

name: COLOR BOMB!
short_description: COLOR BOMB!: Just a simple color-matching game.

name: Edge Of Dead: Under A Uranium Sky
short_description: A bullet hell that let's you pickup and throw the furniture! Throw grenades and activate shields, stun enemies, shoot and dodge enemy fire and set the floor ablaze. Buy a porcupine shotgun from the shop or try a rancid burrito!

name: Arthur's Teacher Trouble
short_description: Explore Marc Brown's 'Arthur’s Teacher Trouble' in an interactive animated adventure. Join Arthur as he tackles homework, spelling quizzes, and school competitions. Relive this cherished classic with animations, voice narration, and hidden bonuses.

name: 1 Bit Survivor
short_description: 1 Bit Survivor is a unique blend of turn-based combat and survival horror! Carefully manage your resources to solve procedurally generated combat puzzles. Survive 28 Days and save your Pet Cat from the Zed-pocalpyse!

name: Ludus Mortis
short_description: Grid-Based First Person Dungeon Crawler set in a Dark Fantasy version of the Imperial Rome. Create and develop your party, explore catacombs, manage your Gladiatorial School and fight demons and undead to free Rome. Inspired by old-school cRPG from the 80s and 90s.

name: SpellBounders 2
short_description: Conquer the denizens of Diretome Keep with wits, words, and magic in SpellBounders 2, a dark fantasy roguelike word-game.

name: Mercenaries Saga 1 -Will of the White Lions-
short_description: Mercenaries Saga 1 is a turn based tactical simulation RPG. It is the first of the series followed by many other solid simulation games: Mercenaries Blaze and Mercenaries Rebirth being the most recent addition to the series.

name: 房间的秘密3：女团回归夜
short_description: Wake up to attach themselves to love beans, it is said that our group to collapse the house? Return to the night, but the sound source was stolen by hackers; Female group members black material scandal is constantly exposed; A thrilling bureau in the bureau, launched at this point......

name: Doma
short_description: Step into the concrete heart of the post-Soviet era in 'Doma'. Delve deep into the architectural psyche of a bygone epoch, and craft iconic Soviet panel buildings block by meticulous block. With every structure, you don't just build a building - you forge a piece of history.

name: Red Titans
short_description: RED TITANS is a single player vertical shoot em up, use the resources available to stop the threat, you will have to be very skillful since there are no continues.

name: Alchemist: The Potion Monger
short_description: First-person Alchemist Simulator with RPG elements. Explore the world, gather ingredients, and sell or use potions you craft to help others and fend off enemies. Adopt pets to help you with your alchemy knowledge (and to pet them). Decorate your home however you like and brew your destiny!

name: Peaks of Yore
short_description: Travel around The Great Gales to climb challenging peaks in this physics-based climbing adventure set in 1887. Meet like-minded mountaineers, unlock helpful climbing gear, and become a pioneer of mountaineering.

name: Ugly
short_description: Unravel the dark secrets hidden throughout this stirring puzzle platformer about a tormented nobleman confronting the traumas of his past. Use an innovative mirror mechanic to solve challenging puzzle rooms and defeat towering bosses as you strive to piece together the ugly truth.

name: Idle Build RPG
short_description: This game is an idle RPG game. Players only need a few simple operations to enjoy the joy of obtaining top-quality equipment.

name: To Infinity
short_description: To Infinity tells the adventures of a schizophrenic astronaut. The astronaut escapes from the world and goes to search for other planets where he can live with his spaceship, and in the meantime, he constantly makes parkour, witnessing the epic view of the universe.

name: DinoBlits
short_description: Create your dino chief, lead your tribe. Survive waves of enemies, explore and settle on foreign islands. Find a way to avoid extinction!

name: Meet Her There
