short_description: A short, intense, dark visual narrative in 2 colors. You are stuck reliving a single day, over and over. Explore a tiny, giant world of a relationship between two people. Don't get arrested. Try to reach the person you love and escape the cursed time loop. Is it not too late?

name: Wizardry High School Exam
short_description: Pass your magic exam with flying colors by surviving a final test within our dungeons. No worries, even though there may be numerous, highly resilient, and quite deadly exam golems, there is still time for you to excel, enhance your abilities, and learn a few new spells along the way.

name: Vox Populi: Spain 2023
short_description: Play as an existing or fully customisable political figure, and campaign for the Spanish general election of 2023! In 'Vox Populi: Spain 2023', you and the characters around you must promote your ideas and your popularity throughout the country to claim victory!

name: Suns of Wiraqocha
short_description: Help the God Wiraqocha to recover all the stolen suns that have been hidden in different dimensions, which you can access through the Great Gate of the Sun, to return light to the Milky Way.

name: I commissioned some cats 6
short_description: I paid artists to hide cats and wool in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

name: Myriad Mayhem
short_description: Myriad Mayhem is a challenging Hero Siege game with Roguelite and Base-Building mechanics, where you create builds with equipment and abilities with excluding talents in talent-trees, to destroy enemies bases - before they overwhelm you.

name: Last Lesson
short_description: It's your first night as the caretaker of a scary quest. The last visitors have gone home. You need to turn off the lights, check the equipment and not die of horror, because someone or something suddenly starts a nightmarish game. With you in the lead.

name: Forgotten Roads
short_description: Forgotten Roads - a game, where you can immerse yourself in an off-road road adventure. Drive through beautiful locations, muddy roads, and other obstacles that will stand in your way! Transport the cargo with extreme caution otherwise you will have to start all over again!

name: Aerial Nature Jigsaw Puzzles
short_description: Explore 'Aerial Nature Jigsaw Puzzles' and experience the mesmerizing beauty of our world from above. Solve captivating puzzles while discovering Earth's wonders in stunning aerial views. Unleash your inner explorer!

name: Starfield
short_description: Starfield is the first new universe in 25 years from Bethesda Game Studios, the award-winning creators of The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim and Fallout 4.

name: Billy Bumbum: A Cheeky Puzzler
short_description: Solve thinky puzzles as a cube with a butt. Flip, push and fart your way through colorful levels as you rescue your adorable friends in need in this cheeky, cozy and slightly absurd feel-good adventure. Fart for freedom!

name: Knight without sword
short_description: A strategy and tactics game, you will play the role of an apprentice knight, use your wisdom to kill enemies without using any attack means, get gold coins, and reach the end point, in addition, don't forget to bring your chicken, it is your important partner !

name: 英灵学院 Soul Academy
short_description: 'Soul Academy' is an academy simulator with automatic battle MOBA. You will manage a shabby soul academy, recruiting and training students. Your ultimate goal is to challenge various academies across the continent and reach the top.

name: The Midnight Town Stories: Adam's Diary
short_description: Adam wakes up trapped in his apartment building, where darkness and strange visions abound. To unravel the mystery and escape, he must find missing diary pages, embarking on a heart-pumping First Person Escape Room Adventure in 'The Midnight Town Stories: Adam's Diary.

name: The House
short_description: The House is a new first-person horror and psychological game for the computer. Escape the house where it all began, collect items, weapons and level up. Travel between worlds and time to reach your goal. Go discover the dark secrets of the House where it all began!

name: You Will Die Here Tonight
short_description: Explore in top-down retro aesthetics and face the horrors of Breckenridge Hall in pulse-pounding first person combat. Scavenge for supplies, solve puzzles, and upgrade your gear. Do whatever it takes to survive, but remember: You Will Die Here Tonight.

name: JumpMan
short_description: ATTENTION: This game is nearly impossible to beat! A challenge only made for the strong-willed gamers out there and should not be taken lightly. You take control of a ball named Gaton. Prove yourself to Ludwig and complete all nine challenges. You'll then be qualified to partake in real missions.

name: YUME 3
short_description: YUME 3 is a maze break-through game. Players need to use the keyboard to control two characters to reach the designated position, and then they can enter the next level.

name: My Legend of Immortal Cultivation
short_description: Immortal cultivation hanging game, with a rich system, experience the world of immortal cultivation

name: Melody of Seasons
short_description: Farming RPG and Life Sim. Harvest crops, raise livestock, forage, fish, mine, craft, and cook. Get to know the locals. Collect items and uncover mysteries. Customize your appearance, upgrade your house and improve your farm. Get married. Have a kid. Make grandpa proud! Live the farmer life!

name: Keylogger: A Sci-Fi Visual Novel
short_description: Each person’s family name in the Continuum is given a debt which they must pay back, or they risk being wiped by the Grid.

name: Avium
short_description: Avium is a sci-fi action adventure role-playing game in a city ruled by those of great cybernetic wealth and influence, such as the Big Four. A Plutocracy, a 'banana republic' that keeps its peace with the employment of Vigilantes like you, Diezel, a War-Suit donning, crime-fighting hero with a past

name: Save Prinvess:Infinite Loop
short_description: A game that combines Rougelike and traditional RPG. Gather heroes from around the world to save the princess.

name: Pandemic Train
short_description: In Pandemic Train you are in charge of the crew aboard a train roaming the postapocalyptic wasteland, ravaged by both war and a deadly plague. Your goal is to survive long enough to discover the cure… or die trying. Humanity’s fate is in your hands! Start your journey now!

name: Anathema Tower Defense
short_description: Anathema Tower Defense is a Hero Tower Defense game where you command a powerful Hero and build and upgrade towers to fight back against increasingly powerful waves of enemies.

name: Builderment
short_description: Earth has run out of resources! Travel to a distant world to harvest materials and build a factory capable of teleporting items back home to save the planet...

name: Land of Crystals
short_description: Embark on a journey of exploration in Land of Crystals! A captivating collectathon RPG through a whimsical world filled with healing crystals. Collect and cleanse your crystals to save the island from the attacking monsters and overcome your vulnerabilities!

name: SOS Zombie Survivors
short_description: SOS Zombie Survivors follows a group of survivors that fights waves of increasingly aggressive zombies while preparing for a rescue helicopter scheduled for evacuation a rescue point.

name: Heli-Cats
short_description: Dual elevation horizontal 2D arcade shoot 'em up co-op helicopter action!

name: Royal Razzle
short_description: A match 3 puzzle adventure set in a whimsical medieval world of candy and princesses. Return to a simpler time when match 3 puzzle games were actually fun and didn't have advertising and in-app purchases.

name: Party Animals
short_description: Fight your friends as puppies, kittens and other fuzzy creatures in PARTY ANIMALS! Paw it out with your friends remotely, or huddle together for chaotic fun on the same screen. Interact with the world under our realistic physics engine. Did I mention PUPPIES?

name: Silent Paws: Hidden Valley
short_description: Embark on a tranquil journey through the mesmerizing landscapes of the Hidden Valley as you take on the role of a graceful fox in this enchanting walking simulator.

name: The Lotus Holidays
short_description: A stylish single player story-based game, where you win a free weekend at the 'Lotus', a luxurious spa resort. But soon, things take a strange and sinister turn.

name: Golful
short_description: Run, jump, and putt yourself around the map in this golf-themed puzzle platformer. Collect items, test your knowledge, and think critically to solve various physics-based puzzles.

name: The Adventures of Sheep and Sheep
short_description: Yangyang Road Finding Adventure is an adventure puzzle solving casual game.

name: SCRUMLORDS
short_description: Fight off hordes of angry peasants and reclaim your realm in SCRUMLORDS! Lead your formation of loyal soldiers into battle in this action-roguelite, unlocking new gear and increasing your abilities as you play.

name: Early-blooming black lily
short_description: Maybe it was the curse of the black lilies that bloomed early in the winter-- A girl falls in love with a girl before graduation.　Her pure feelings are torn apart by a 'tragic loop'.　 You will weave her feelings by interrupting choices and typing letters.

name: Abandoned Dark
short_description: The game is a 2D platformer with puzzle elements where you play as a chick trying to go through dark depth. You need to go through different levels along the way, destroying enemies in the location and avoiding traps.

name: Boing Bang Adventure
short_description: Boing Bang Adventure is a 2D arcade game in the style of the classic arcade game 'Pang' Face almost 50 levels, in 8 different world in single player or in local co-op!

name: Highland Panic
short_description: Highland Panic is a fast-paced, Scottish/Highland-themed card game with solitaire mechanics for 2-4 players. Race to be the first player to play all the cards from your 'panic' pile to the common 'clan' piles. It's a thrilling game of strategy and skill, perfect for game nights and parties.

name: Alien Land
short_description: This is a special simulation tower defense game, where you need to command each citizen to build a base. To produce food, one also needs to resist monsters from the night.if you want to pass the level, it has a certain difficulty and requires you to have a certain strategy and observation rules.

name: LightBear
short_description: LightBear is a randomly generated action RPG whackathon with heavy Rogue-like elements. Players will lose their vision the further from the starting point they get. Don't be deceived by its appearance, this game will challenge you to no end. Watch out for 100s of randomized monsters.

name: Slime Alchemist
short_description: Slime Alchemist is a roguelike deckbuilder with turn-based tatical combat. Steal your foes' cards to build your deck, scour a procedural world for power-ups, and unlock powerful synergies on the way to the slime throne!

name: Desktop Pet
short_description: Desktop Pet is a life simulation game where you can take care of cute creatures while working or playing on your computer. Stream, write documents, play games, watch videos, all together with your little companion.

name: DreamWorks All-Star Kart Racing
short_description: An all-star cast of iconic DreamWorks characters brings the fun and hilarity to high-speed kart racing action like never before! Race on 20 different DreamWorks-themed tracks with your choice of 20 of the most iconic DreamWorks characters in a kart racing experience like no other.

name: LANDNAV
short_description: Land Navigation is the backbone of elite military training. Aspiring infantry, paratroopers, Rangers, Special Forces, Search and Rescue, and many other elite professionals must develop and maintain traditional navigation skills. LANDNAV fills the gaps between infrequent field training.

name: 修炼成仙
short_description: 《修炼成仙》是一款极简主义的文字挂机游戏。创建人物，踏上仙途，自动战斗，获取战利品，修炼功法，装备法宝，一步一步登上仙途，获得永生轮回。游戏永无止境，无需焦虑通关限制，即开即挂，随缘随心，修炼成仙。

name: Space Threat
short_description: Drive through beautiful locations and dangerous roads, but be careful and avoid obstacles! Be prepared for anything and prove that you can withstand any situation!

name: Railway Islands 2 - Puzzle
short_description: Railway Islands 2 is a minimalist and relaxing puzzle game about designing a railway map for a large archipelago. Design a smooth journey for your trains as they transport people and vital resources between islands.

name: Tankitos
short_description: Tankitos!Even the name reveals what is this game about, game inspired by old school game 'Battle City' originally on NES in modern stylized style is full of tanks and tank battles in various arenas. Check out more.

name: The Dreaming City Chronicles: Quest for the Vanished World
short_description: Can you fathom the riddles that lie within? Prepare yourself for a transcendental journey that will challenge your perceptions and unearth the hidden depths of your own consciousness. Unparalleled, introspective experience, harmonizing mesmerizing storytelling with visual splendor

name: TYPECAST
short_description: TYPECAST is a bullet hell where you type to shoot. Get swarmed by enemies, manage the chaos, and climb the leaderboards in this unique arcade experience.

name: Snaileeyo Save Them
short_description: Step into a world where cute and dark collide in our thrilling 3D platformer game! Follow the journey of our adorable Snaileeyo as they navigate through a hauntingly beautiful world filled with challenging obstacles and ominous creatures.

name: Vox Populi: Poland 2023
short_description: Play as an existing or fully customisable political figure, and campaign for the Polish parliamentary election of 2023! In 'Vox Populi: Poland 2023', you and the characters around you must promote your ideas and your popularity throughout the country to claim victory!

name: 7th Domain
short_description: '7th Domain' is a horizontal version action game derived from Roguelike Metroidvania combined with treasure grinding gameplay. You will play a child of destiny who repairs the world and finds the truth of the broken world. You will grow in battle and challenge the unknown and hidden forces.

name: Rune Factory 3 Special
short_description: Bridge the divide of an ancient schism between humans and monsters in Rune Factory 3 Special as half-human, half-wooly protagonist Micah. Farm, fight and fall in love as you revisit a classic in the series that perfected the blend of RPG & Life-sim genres.

name: Doodle Harmony
short_description: Find and match 100 cute doodle pairs scattered all over the screen in this point-and-click game. Can you match them all

name: Naheulbeuk's Dungeon Master
short_description: A dungeon in danger ! Build, manage, and defend your tower in the satirical heroic fantasy universe of Dungeon of Naheulbeuk. From a shaky establishment to an infamous lair!

name: Him
short_description: Thousands of spaceships entered the galaxy to mine what does not belong to them! Him is a third person casual game where the player runs and jump between home planets to destroy the invading space pirates and their spaceships under a limited time before they mine the lands.

name: Parasomnum
short_description: Minimalistic horror experience that offers 25-90 minutes of suspenseful gameplay as you try to escape from this unnerving reality.

name: Monster Killcker
short_description: Incremental game where you have to kill as many monsters as you can in order to become stronger. Besides, you better make those monsters stronger too so you can get more experience from them.

name: Omega Tower
short_description: Omega Tower is a small tower defense game mixed with rogue-lite elements!Pick a loadout with unique abilities, Upgrades for your towers, and create unique synergies.But most importantly, try to defend your core !

name: Logic Town
short_description: Does Jim like chocolate cake? WAS JANET WEARING A HAT!?! Solve exhilarating mysteries like these in Logic Town, a relaxing coffee-break puzzle game of pure deduction.

name: The Bunnyman
short_description: The Bunnyman is a psychological survival horror. Police in Virginia has issued a public appeal to find a pregnant woman after reports of her missing. Her husband, a journalist is out to find her after the police search went cold. Something Evil is lurking...

name: Forest Adventure
short_description: The little girl's favorite handkerchief was taken away by a wolf. In order to get her handkerchief back, the girl who has no fighting ability decided to follow the wolf to the mountain.

name: Cell Wars
short_description: Cell Wars is a classic arcade shooter where your goal is to consume all enemy cells by shooting and eating them. Inspired by NES graphics, gameplay from arcade 80s cabinets, and early 2000s skill tree systems. Unlock abilities and skills to survive waves of regular, elite and boss cells.

name: Puzzle Game
short_description: Jump into the puzzle-solving action of The 'Puzzle Game' and discover what Grandpa left for you.

name: Invention 4
short_description: Save the world from an impending threat in a dynamic 3D shooter with quest and puzzle elements.

name: Cricket 24
short_description: Cricket 24 is the culmination of a decade of Cricket video game development and includes teams from every corner of the globe.

name: Side by Size
short_description: Side by Size is a puzzle game where taking damage and healing changes the puzzle layout. Purposefully get hurt to open the way to the exit in 100 hand crafted puzzles!

name: Tavernacle!
short_description: Grab your hammers and start to craft in this co-op Tavern Defense for one to four players. As a team of Dwarves, you must gather supplies and build towers to protect your beloved brewery. Learn to cooperate to achieve victory in this chaotic multiplayer game!

name: Samurai Beat
short_description: Slice bamboo to the rhythm while dodging projectiles to maintain your flow and pace. Will you conquer the beat and become a true samurai master?

name: Square City Builder
short_description: Build the small pixel city of your dreams! From classic city-building games, Square City Builder offers various ways to customize your gameplay, from constructing houses, farms, or roads to facing random events. In this game, you're in control!

name: Cuisineer
short_description: A super cute and tasty roguelite-flavored dungeon crawler! Explore a lush world and defeat monsters with your trusty spatula and some boba tea, then gather delicious ingredients and bring them home to cook and serve at your restaurant!

name: Obsidian
short_description: Venture into the surreal worlds of Obƨidian...if you dare. In Obƨidian, your life is in your hands, so tread carefully. Forget everything you know about existence and prepare to be flipped on your ear. Welcome to the unknown...

name: Free For All
short_description: What is most important to you? Money? Honor? Love? Or any other things? It's all good. Please enjoy this adventure according to your values.

name: The Dollmaker
short_description: The Dollmaker is a first person horror game, where after being captured, you find yourself searching a mansion for a way to escape. But the Dollmaker and his creations will be searching for you, will you become a part of his collection?

name: Delicious Dungeon
short_description: Delicious Dungeon is a combination of action-adventure and simulation game. The player is the owner of a local restaurant in a fantasy world. But to run the restaurant they have to explore dungeons full of dangers and enemies to get the ingredients needed to cook delicious meals for their guests.

name: Dirt Bicycle Rider Simulator
short_description: Choose your bike, conquer the town and mountains! Test your skills in Dirt Bicycle Rider Simulator, packed with realistic graphics and exciting missions.

name: Nobody's Home
short_description: After a night of extreme drinking and partying, you wake up in a stranger's bed to discover... Nobody's Home.

name: Posthaste
short_description: An arcade rally game.

name: Lumins and Shades
short_description: Lumins and Shades is a cute puzzle game about turning on lights and making memories.

name: Zbuki Zoo Strategic Comedy
short_description: Humorous strategy with unique set of characters: buff genius, precious kung fu lady, half-ton puppy, cool spitter and much more. Plus some non-standard structures to build and quirky maps to explore. You can find these only in Zbukiland.

name: Under the bed
short_description: Under the Bed is a spine-chilling horror game that will take you on a nightmarish journey into the depths of fear.

name: Bloxtacle Course
short_description: Bloxtacle Course is a block breaker game where you are given nearly full control over the ball itself.

name: The Search for a Colour Palette
short_description: Play as Mr. Colourfool, a father looking for his son that was lost in the castle that appeared out of thin smoke. The colours are all gone, the creatures have turned hostile and there is a voice beckoning you towards the castle. Perhaps it is fate, or just your imagination, it really doesn't matter.

name: Ski Jumping PVP
short_description: Experience the thrill of being a ski jumping champion! Step into the shoes of a professional jumper and engage in exciting competitions against players from across the globe. Take on authentic ski jumps inspired by real-world locations.

name: Space Captain McCallery - Episode 4: The Turquoise Temple
short_description: Space Pirate Captain McCallery travels to a mysterious planet of Turquoise to uncover the secrets of the Turquoise Temple

name: Iron City (Iron Man Flight Experience)
short_description: Get ready to be the hero of your own city ?

name: FROGGIN' AROUND
short_description: A little frog in a little pond eatin' bugs, takin' naps, and just froggin' around.

name: The Backrooms: Escape
short_description: The Backrooms: Escape is an experience in the liminal world of backrooms. Move freely, explore the secrets of the corporation, but remember - you are not alone.

name: Pocket Race: Driver
short_description: Pocket Race: Manager is a miniature race driving game with simple controls, but demanding driving and some strategic elements and lots of different car parts. Push other miniature cars off the track into the void! Don't fall yourself...

name: Nephilim
short_description: 'Nephilim' is a single-player social deduction game to reveal the heretics who have infiltrated the congregations. Throw down God's judgment on the fools who rebel against the omniscient machine god 'La Place'.

name: Traversion
short_description: Introducing Traversion, a movement-based arcade platformer with a focus on rocket jumping, strafing, and grappling to navigate levels as efficiently as possible. Enjoy a minimalist, skill-based experience where the primary goal is to achieve faster completion times and hone your senses.

name: Skye Tales
short_description: Join Skye the friendly dragon and glide across the colourful, musical, cosy valleys of Brinn in Skye Tales, a gentle puzzle exploration game set in a world that couldn’t be happier to see you. Your playful world awaits!

name: Squid Commando
short_description: Squid Commando is an action-packed, classic arcade run & gun game that can be played solo or in co-op.

name: The Green Room Experiment (Episode 2)
short_description: You're locked in a dream and you need to wake up. Unravel the mysteries of this surreal exploration game and immerse yourself in a dreamlike, strange and solitary universe.

name: Saints Row
short_description: Welcome to Santo Ileso, a vibrant fictional city in the American Southwest. In a world rife with crime, where lawless factions fight for power, a group of young friends embark on their own criminal venture, as they rise to the top in their bid to become Self Made.

name: Viking Chef: Feast Frenzy
short_description: Dive into 'Viking Chef: Feast Frenzy', a cozy co-op cooking adventure set in the Norse realm. As a Viking chef, challenge yourself to create divine feasts across dynamic scenarios like a forest camp, a boat, or a classic Viking village.

name: The Dot
short_description: I’m releasing this collection of games so that you may start talking to me again

name: Wild Shot
short_description: In the age of monsters, you guard the most sexy and beautiful girls in the world, and they determine the fate of mankind. In the face of noble freedom and high-quality genes, do you choose heroic redemption or killing and plundering?

name: Gray Destiny
short_description: An indie precision platformer that offers an atmospheric and captivating experience. Take control of the young boy as he navigates through a series of meticulously crafted levels. The game's visuals blend terrifying traps with dark environments, immersing players in an exciting adventure.

name: Step By Step
short_description: In a game where you can't stop moving, every step is progress. But whether that progress is forward or backward, that is up to you...

name: End of Knights
short_description: Destroy unholy hoards of the undead and defend your stronghold! Gain new abilities and hone your skills in this challenging arcade action game. Can you survive the End of Knights?

name: Escape Escape
short_description: You awaken in a mysterious room and promptly clear items from the desk. The individual behind this watches in surprise on the monitor. 'Hey! What are you doing? Let me play my game!' 'Escape Escape' is an adventure where you explore, interact, and advance through maps and characters.

name: Dashbounce
short_description: A 2D Speedrunning Puzzle-Platformer about going fast and intentionally abusing physics quirks! Seek the goal in each level before the clock hits zero - but watch out, you can't jump! You'll have to use your surprising speed and bouncy body to turn every object and obstacle into an advantage!

name: Space Shooter 24
short_description: Join the war in the depths of space with Space Shooter 24! Customizable ships, realistic graphics, and breathtaking action await you. Take action now to save the galaxy.

name: Easy VTT
short_description: The easiest Tabletop without all the bloat! Need a grid that scales perfectly to your maps? Or a fog-of-war system that just works? Easy VTT can setup and host your table within minutes for up to 8 friends! Save hundreds of custom tables with ease! Don't let your VTT distract from what matters!

name: Hot And Lovely ：Uniform
short_description: Hot And Lovely: Uniform is a classic puzzle game. Players need to eliminate more than three blocks of the same type to complete the goal and pass the level. After completing all the levels, the game is successful!

name: Another Bar Game
short_description: A casual action game where you serve craft beer to thirsty bar guests. Become the most popular bartender in town! Wash glasses, clean tables and keep everybody happy!

name: Wetory
short_description: 'Wetory' is a 3D action roguelike game with a cartoon-style graphics. The story revolves around a child who can create watercolors from their feet, embarking on an adventure to restore all the colors in the world after they are stolen by a villain.

name: Volden Idle
short_description: Grind your way to 99 in this MMO inspired idle/clicking game!

name: DAVIGO: VR vs. PC
short_description: DAVIGO is a VR vs. PC physics-based battle game. Become the GIANT in VR or a small KNIGHT on PC and fight your friends in local or online matches. KNIGHTS play for free with DAVIGO KNIGHT'S PASS.

name: Sasha's Stupid Coffee Shop
short_description: Start from the bottom and work your way to the top of selling the world's best coffee!

name: Chess Royal
short_description: A simple yet satisfying game of chess that anyone can play - and learn from. Challenge a powerful chess AI, play against your friends, and try to get through a massive tower of puzzles!

name: Idle Transport Tycoon
short_description: Build platforms to transport people, increase your customer population by buying and merging houses. Advance through levels.

name: Far Star
short_description: Far Star is a story-driven action-adventure game with Metroidvania influences. There is something fishy going on in this galaxy, but this won’t stop your intergalactic general services crew from doing their job using a varied set of skills, weapons and outfits.

name: NURTOPU
short_description: It is a rabbit game for collecting 2d diamonds.2d hyper casual platform game.

name: The Impossible Game 2
short_description: The original rhythm platform game is back! Test your skills with all-new levels, online battle royale and more.

name: Dungeon Cleaner
short_description: Clean and slide endlessly. Dungeon cleaner

name: NINE -Errand-
short_description: The protagonist, Nine, embarks on his first errand at the request of Alice. With his unique ability, Nine can resurrect no matter how many times he dies. Let's keep pushing forward without giving up, even in the face of death. Otherwise, you might incur the wrath of your master, Alice.

name: Burger Shop 3
short_description: Make tasty food items to serve hungry customers in this fast-paced sequel to the amazing food making games Burger Shop 1 & 2!

name: Echo of Extinction
short_description: In the desolate remnants of a world once thriving, you must scavenge and explore the open landscapes of Echo of Extinction. Uncover precious resources scattered throughout, harnessing their power to forge formidable gear and destroy the corrupted Robot Lords.

name: VAPOR TANKS
short_description: Explore Cyberspace in VAPOR TANKS, an arcade 3D shooter with a focus on satisfying gameplay, addictive replayability, and surrealist visuals. It features a 30 level long single player, including modes such as Time Trials, Arcade, and a One Hit death mode

name: ACRES
short_description: ACRES is a small strategy simulation game about growing crops for evolving market demands. Build a farm, one acre at a time, to create a prosperous enterprise. Upgrade equipment, optimize harvests, and nurture the soil against increasing time pressure. How long can you keep the farm operating?

name: Tenebris Pictura
short_description: Exploration, ghost hunting and puzzles in the Victorian era.

name: Stop Dead
short_description: A rogue AI is hell-bent on destroying its creators and has swept you up in its plans. Use your superhuman abilities to run, jump, slide, and pull hundreds of objects as projectile weapons to blast everything in your path in this funny and chaotic first-person telekinetic brawler, STOP DEAD.

name: NBody Gravitation
short_description: Place asteroids and planets and send them orbiting into targets in a physics-based puzzle game where everything attracts everything.

name: 芒果TV《大侦探》官方授权VR游戏：超脑侦探(潜入篇)-上篇-
short_description: 《超脑侦探》是一款密室逃脱与侦探解谜类结合的VR游戏。你将扮演一名擅长通过骇入人脑、解决各种棘手案件的“超脑侦探”，即将进入一名空难幸存者的大脑，骇入他的记忆，揭开案件背后黑暗的真相。游戏分为上下两篇，本体内容为游戏的上半部分，您可购买DLC来体验游戏的下半部分。

name: Corrupt
short_description: Survive in a dark and atmospheric action-platformer characterized by environments full of mystery and fearsome enemies.

name: 花园魔三国2 -The Sacrificial Girl of the Fantasy 3 Kingdoms 2-
short_description: 本作舞台将会发生在曹魏的大陆，数十个全新的人物将会登场，因此即使是没玩过前作的玩家也不会有困扰~ 而且后期可以驾驭飞龙自由飞行在大陆上! 本作除了主线剧情外~支线可以达成和女主角的恋爱结局哦~

name: SGS We The People
short_description: The complete American Revolutionary War from July 1775 to April 1783, with all units, weapons and events included on a two week turn base. The most complete strategy game made on this conflict. Fight for your ideals, and take command of America!

name: This Bed We Made
short_description: This Bed We Made is a third-person mystery game in which you play as a maid in a 1950s hotel and snoop around strangers' rooms to uncover their deadly secrets. Discover what links guests together in this tale of love, heartbreak and murder!

name: I Believe in Capybara Supremacy!
short_description: We are the chosen one to take care of Capybara, a one-of-a-kind creature that lives on Earth and has the potential to destroy the world when it gets angry, in order to help it control its anger and prevent the destruction of the world!

name: Timberman: The Big Adventure
short_description: Enter the Timberman universe! Enjoy the retro vibe of a 2D platformer with a classic 16-bit pixel art aesthetic.

name: PUSHER - Drug Tycoon
short_description: Thrilling business tycoon sim where you step into the shoes of a drug dealer in 1980s USA. Your main goal is simple: BUY LOW and SELL HIGH. Get ready for a experience where you'll combine strategy, risk-taking, and decision-making to build your criminal empire.

name: Junkyard Fury Breakout
short_description: Junkyard Fury is back, with a vehicular combat style game! Each vehicle has its own progression and story, and each environment has its own destructive mechanics. Breakout and destroy everything and everyone in your way!

name: Lucky Island
short_description: 《Lucky Island》is a roguelite deckbuilder game about using slot machine to build your island. It combines island building and resource management. This game does not include any real world currency gambling or micro trading.

name: Memories: Millennium Girl
short_description: Welcome to the heartwarming world of Memories: Millennium Girl! Join your sister's journey through 8 unforgettable years, forming bonds with 25 adorable NPCs. With 50+ unique endings awaiting your choices, create a cute and captivating tale filled with connections, joy, and cherished memories

name: Words of Yendor
short_description: A word puzzle adventure set in a steamgoth world of amalgamated steam-age technology and antediluvian sorcery. Collect resources, solve dangerous situations and prepare for a showdown with each Master Villain to discover the meaning behind the Word of Yendor!

name: Undead Quest
short_description: Undead Quest is a VR rogue-lite wave shooter where your primary weapons are a bat and magic ball. Hit the ball, dodge arrows, slash zombie limbs. Unleash spells, master alchemy and craft your ultimate skillset, to carve your way through hordes of quirky enemies and find out the secret of the Undead.

name: I commissioned some cats 3
short_description: I paid artists to hide cats and wool in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

name: 勇者屠龙 之 永恒幻想
short_description: A turn based RPG game! Players will use the traditional RPG game mode to play two major scripts and three additional content. Players will follow the plot to encounter various events, defeat various bosses, explore different worlds, and welcome friends who love traditional RPGs to play!

name: M.E.R.C. Genesis
short_description: Get ready to experience high-octane Sci-Fi horror with 'M.E.R.C Genesis'. Embark on a journey that pushes the boundaries of fear, survival, and discovery. Can you withstand the darkness that awaits?

name: Chaos on Wheels
short_description: Take a wheel of a heavily armored car of your choice, and drive yourself to victory while shooting and destroying enemy cars, turrets, and hazards in this chaotic vehicular combat experience. Choose a driver, customize your cars, upgrade armor, buy new weapons, and leave nothing but chaos!

name: Shape Shifter: Formations
short_description: Shape Shifter: Formations is an action twin-stick shooter with rogue-lite elements, where you must destroy hordes of geometric enemies alone or with a friend. Select your ship and combine a large variety of weapons, abilities and infinitely stacking upgrades to craft your own unique build.

name: Moonlight In Garland
short_description: A cozy open-ended life sim about finding your feet in the big city. Decorate your apartment, make new friends, grow too many houseplants and love your city life!

name: Nine Realms: Revolt
short_description: A story driven deckbuilding adventure set in a nordic world with an epic soundtrack. Roll your dice, then alter your dice and reinvent the fate of the realms! Build to suit your playstyle and discover an intricate plot from the eyes of a fledgling elven warrior.

name: Police Heroes
short_description: Use multiple heroes, each with their own choices, abilities and play style to defeat the zombie apocalypse! Play several stages in different locations, against hordes of increasingly stronger and more dangerous zombies. All this with a unique mechanic where damage equals money!

name: Battle zombie
short_description: This is a large-scale shooting game with real military battlefields and modern military equipment. Different shooting gameplay challenges your limits!

name: Planet Iridium
short_description: Planet Iridium is a third person, top-down, fantasy, Sci-Fi game. The game is heavily based around colony, economy and base building. Along with close-quarter combat and unique survival systems that will keep you on the edge of your seat as you unveil the deep dark secrets of Planet B58.

name: Beer n Pee Dreams VR
short_description: Strap in for a pee-rific short adventure! In Beer n Pee Dreams VR, platforms surround you in 360 degrees while you're on a mad dash to the bathroom. Score beers and dodge barrels, all to the beat of rock, funk, and the classic Clair de Lune. All this with light-hearted humor.

name: Symmodance
short_description: Dive into the symphonic chaos of geometric warfare! Unleash futuristic weaponry, customize your hovering platform, conquer relentless foes and dance to victory in this mesmerizing reverse bullet hell shooter.

name: 新叶旅者与少年的回忆
short_description: New Leaf Traveler and Youth's Memories 'is a short story RPG that involves playing the role of a young owner of a forest tavern and trying to run your own business to repay your debts. Meeting various guests and understanding their stories...

name: Blackjack Simulator 2024
short_description: Blackjack Simulator 2024 is a simple, fun, and realistic simulation of blackjack. Battle against the dealer every single round as you try to use the right strategy to win big!

name: Squeebing Up the Tower of Friendship
short_description: Can you make it to the top of the Tower of Friendship? Run, jump, climb, fall, and then do it all again. Play by yourself or with your friends. Be nice and lay down to make jumps easier for others, or push each other off when the falls are the highest. But whatever you do, never stop squeebing.

name: Shadow Rebirth
short_description: Shadow Rebirth is a classic top-down ninja game with an exciting story, dungeon exploration, monster and ninja fights.

name: Midnight Monitor: Anomaly Watch
short_description: A 'spot the difference' horror game where you have to monitor cameras in a haunted house and report anomalies. You have no choice but to finish the job. Can you spot every anomaly? Can you survive the night?

name: Queen of Moths
short_description: It's a winter night. You are coming home by train. You have to change trains at a small train station in the middle of the forest.It's not the first time you've traveled this route. But now you feel like something is different.As if something was watching you.

name: Geko: In Search Of The Big Fly
short_description: Geko is a friendly gecko with a delightful goal: catching the big fly to ensure a delicious meal! To help him on this thrilling adventure, you'll jump, climb platforms, dodge obstacles, and defeat enemies that appear along the way.

name: ART IS RIFLE
short_description: Unleashing the Chaos in Puzzle Shooter Genre!

name: MALWARE Rewritten
short_description: A game where you play as a malware, and your goal is to destroy the computer from within.

name: Hidden Nightmares
short_description: Hidden Nightmares is a horror experience set inside the endless nightmares of a psychiatric patient. Experience the horrors generated by the human mind and wonder if you will ever wake up again.

name: Streetoir
short_description: STREETOIR is a first-person / open-world / graffiti-painting game, where you paint everywhere you want and whatever you want.

name: Kobold Castle
short_description: Kobold Castle is a 2D arena survival game that takes place on the wall of a besieged castle. As one of 4 kobold defenders, you must hold the line against dangerous waves of attackers, collect upgrades and powerups, and defeat a variety of enemies and bosses. Try to survive as long as you can!

name: It Happened Here: Streaming Lives
short_description: Are you ready, detective? Step into a tale of mystery, intrigue, deceit, and murder!

name: Flappy Swan
short_description: Flappy Swan is a casual game where u control a swan to fly and dodge skyscrapers in an stunning synthwave style.100x Steam Achievments (just start the game)Have A Good Flight!

name: Plunged
short_description: Plunged is a casual, first-person single-player 3D-Platformer where you use your plunger and rope to climb to the top.

name: RIPOUT
short_description: Ripout is an online Co-Op horror FPS that will have players fight their way through procedurally generated derelict ships filled with mutants capable of reconfiguring their alien bodies. Survive with your trusty Pet Gun companion, collect loot, and customize your character to fit your playstyle.

name: Outpath
short_description: An experimental clicker base building game. Craft, gather & manage resources, build your base and buy more islands to exploit and expand!

name: Rune Gate
short_description: Rune Gate is a deck-building roguelite where you design your own cards by slotting in various elemental runes. Gather your party, craft your runes, gear up and defend against hordes of enemies from the Rune Gate. How long can you survive?

name: Dark Envoy
short_description: Dark Envoy is an RPG-adventure with tactical real-time combat and online co-op. Control a party of relic hunters in this tale of destiny, set in a conflict-torn Guns N’ Sorcery world.

name: Pew-Pew Land
short_description: Pew-Pew Land is a fast-paced platform shooter where you take on the role of the protagonist and destroy demonic creatures. There are several types of weapons available in the game. The lingering levels are filled with enemies and platforms of various tactics. Shoot the enemy and complete the level

name: Magnet Mania 3D
short_description: Magnet Mania 3D, it's a simulation game for small and big engineers, school children to learn about magnetism and physics.

name: Food Truck Time Machine

short_description: Immerse yourself in a post-apocalyptic wasteland in this intense horde combat shooter that combines roguelike and bullet-hell elements. Battle relentless waves of monstrous foes as you strive to survive and conquer challenging levels. In my game no vampire, survive 20 minutes!

name: We Need To Cook - Drug Empire Simulator
short_description: We need to cook! You are a drug-designing genius, living a bland existence in a middle-class neighborhood in Utah. You decide you want more out of life, so you buy a beat-up RV, drive it into the desert, and cook drugs. Make immense profits! (Made by one dude, hope you enjoy)

name: Logic Escape
short_description: Put your intellect to the test with challenging escape rooms featuring high interactivity and intricate logical puzzles. Observe, search for clues, combine information, apply logical reasoning, and uncover mysteries through exploration.

name: Forbidden Art
short_description: Forbidden art is a VR room escape puzzle game where you escape from the killer’s secret hideout. Use all your abilities to escape the dangerous and terrifying hideout created by a psychopathic killer who thinks killing is an art, without being discovered by the killer.

name: Vinterget
short_description: Brave the mountain in this short platformer. Use your axe as a grappling tool to skillfully swing across multiple challenging levels. Fight through the perils of the snowy mountain of Vinterget.

name: Dinobreak
short_description: Dinosaurs have returned in this retro survival horror crisis.

name: The Unlikely Prometheus
short_description: A classic humorous 2D Point and Click adventure game, reminiscent of the classic Lucas-arts and Sierra games, all in a hand drawn silent movie inspired visual aesthetic.

name: Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Realms of Ruin
short_description: Wage a campaign of brutal conquest in this realm-shattering real-time strategy game set in the Warhammer Age of Sigmar universe. Become a warlord and lead four unique factions to conquer the wild and savage Realm of Ghur in tense and tactical battles.

name: The Hallway - Escape Room
short_description: “The Hallway - Escape Room” is a story-based single player puzzle adventure game that will take you on a mind-bending journey to uncover the mysteries of a long-forgotten curse brought back from an expedition to South America. Will you be able to lift it?

name: Cat city
short_description: In this game, you will have to explore the whole city to find all the cats (and various secrets) and get closer to the goal of making this world and the lives of the cats living in it a little better, and restore their faith in people!

name: Into the Dungeon
short_description: Into the Dungeon is a cooperative deck builder rogue-like game. Venture into the dungeon on your own, or connect with your friends in fast-paced strategic card battles against fantastical and gnarly creatures in a quest against evil itself!

name: Buddy and Friends on Halloween
short_description: Halloween's here, and Buddy the cat and pals are set for 'tricks or treats' in the neighbourhood. But as they venture into the unknown, will compassion and kindness triumph over fear? Join these kittens in a heartwarming Halloween tale in this beautifully illustrated jigsaw puzzle game.

name: Enemy Trench
short_description: Enemy Trench is a Roguelike set during the First World War. You play as a British soldier fighting your way through enemy lines hoping to survive. You must contend with an onslaught of enemy soldiers, deadly terrain, gas attacks and more. Do you have what it takes to survive in the Enemy Trench?

name: 富甲天下5
short_description: 《富甲天下5》的主公人數由7位提高至21位，全新的寵物系統、玩家可自由分配升級點數和學習技能 ，全新3vs3將戰系統，還有更多的武器裝備及兩百多位武將等你來募集！搜集資源率先打造出經典建築也能贏得勝利！參考玩家意見，展現更流暢爽快的《富甲天下5》STEAM版！支援一台電腦四人同樂！

name: School Cafeteria Simulator
short_description: Manage your own Indonesian school cafeteria in this simple first-person simulation game!

name: DomiNOo
short_description: Unleash your creativity and explore endless possibilities in our immersive sandbox game! Knock down dominos, play with different toys, and customize your world. With multiplayer mode and sharing features, the fun never ends.

name: Ocean Pressure
short_description: Ocean Pressure is a singleplayer game where you as an old scientist piloting your handmade submarine in the bottom of the ocean. Your mission is explore the ocean and collect required data with help of your submarine.

name: Persona 5 Tactica
short_description: Join the Phantom Thieves as they lead an uprising of the heart! Assemble an all-star team of heroes in a brand-new story in this thrilling combat adventure set in Persona’s iconic universe.

name: 古代风流传
short_description: The first work of an independent small team, many deficiencies, please do not hesitate to correct! We will fix and update your problems as soon as possible. The scholar's career is not good and he retires to the countryside. Intertwined with the fate of five different styles of women.

name: Corgi in the Box
short_description: You are locked in an unfamiliar room with your beloved dog. Use the items in the room and cooperate with your dog to escape. There is a short story and three different endings. When you reach an ending, a hidden secret will be revealed.

name: Pray Game
short_description: Washed away to the island of Anatol, Alcy now must embark on a journey to escape the island and find her way to safety.

name: Neoclip
short_description: An arcade-like explorative experience about revealing unique De Stijl inspired compositions. Navigate a complicated labyrinth of evolving levels using the shadows of the walls to highlight the obscured regions.

name: Basics In Intermediate Filmmaking
short_description: Basics In Intermediate Filmmaking is a pre-apocalyptic puzzle horror. You explore an abandonded power plant in order to document what happened to the infamous Fortitude Electric power company. Use your camera to solve different puzzles around the facility, and try to survive.

name: Bish Bash Bots
short_description: Bish Bash Bots is a unique mix of casual tower defense strategy and all-out brawling action. Team up in couch co-op / online play or go it alone and fight to save the world by building upgradable turrets, unlocking gadgets and bashing bots with giant hammers.

name: Illuminate Frame
short_description: 'Illuminate Frame' is a mouse-click-only simple puzzle game where you strategically place various tiles on the board to conduct electricity from power tiles to terminal tiles, aiming for high scores.

name: 笼中困兽
short_description: Trapped in a Cage is a text adventure game developed by Disposable Club, where players will witness various events beyond human rationality that occur in an anti utopian prison. This is a small incision in a turbulent world, and also a brief moment of endless human nature.

name: Axis Football 2024
short_description: Axis Football is a simulation-style football game featuring the industry's best franchise mode, massive customization, and realistic gameplay.

name: METAL GEAR SOLID 3: Snake Eater - Master Collection Version
short_description: Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater is the origin story of Naked Snake and his mentor The Boss and the fifth title in the METAL GEAR series.

name: Evelone Wrath
short_description: You are Evelone192, the founder of the Freak Squad. Your friends are captured and held hostage by your sworn enemies - members of an 'Anti-Freak Squad'. Can you save Buster and Lixxx?

name: Malice
short_description: Malice: Burn haunted objects, banish demons in a spooky mansion. Multiplayer or single-player options. Are you brave enough to survive?

name: Pretty Girls Escape PLUS
short_description: The 'PLUS' version is now available in the game 'Pretty Girls Escape'! Slide the blocks left and right in the stage to connect and then erase them, and guide the characters to the exit! Collect costumes of 9 beautiful girls from idol groups, athletics clubs, and more, and have fun dressing them up!

name: Sushi for Empress Setsuko
short_description: “Sushi for Empress Setsuko” is a cozy and comedic point & click adventure game and yuri dating sim set in a fantastical Japan-inspired land. Follow Mizumi Nagashima as she travels around the Empire, seeing gorgeous views, catching delicious fish, and charming beautiful women.

name: GARDEN OF EDEN
short_description: Commander, lead your army, build the strongest weapons, conquer the harsh weather and enemies, and build a new Eden on the sea!!!!

name: The Last Windmill
short_description: Embark on an epic journey in The Last Windmill an action-adventure game where you defend the last standing windmill against relentless hordes of monsters. Engage in intense battles, face increasingly challenging waves of enemies. Become the hero that saves humanity in this thrilling fight.

name: Gravity Castle
short_description: Gravity Castle is a 2D puzzle platformer where you explore mysterious subterranean ruins using gravity augmentation powers. Overcome impossible Trials, trudge past the remains of fallen explorers and make your way to the very bottom.

name: The Westcoast Drive : Lowrider Simulator
short_description: Experience 1960s American lowrider culture. Customize your ride, hit the streets, and dominate with iconic hydraulics

name: Cradles
short_description: Cradles is the first time-lapsing metaverse game – a living, breathing virtual world that continues to evolve and progress, simulating the laws of time and physics just like in real life.

name: Demonheart: The Cursed Trial
short_description: You are a girl with a demonic heart, trapped with a group of suspicious individuals. A demonspawn arrives, setting off a chain of mysterious murders. Can you trust any of your fellow captives and find love amidst the chaos? Or will you fight for your life alone?

name: Gem Defender: Soyjak Survivors
short_description: Follow Chud on his fight against Dr Soystein's 'jak army in this spine-tingling survival shooter.

name: Refind Self: The Personality Test Game
short_description: Games can really show someone's personality, don't you think? By way of a simple exploration-based adventure, this data-science game analyzes your actions to estimate your personality.

name: First Up
short_description: 'First Up' is a cooperative platformer with parkour elements, skills, and various auxiliary devices. 'Don't give up, be the first up!'

name: Hex Cats
short_description: Twist and move hex pieces to connect yarn threads for playful felines. A charming twist on classic hex pipes puzzle!

name: Hidden Kitten
short_description: Hidden Kitten is a cozy hidden object game with a variety of hand-drawn levels. Follow the adventures of Charlie the cat and explore hidden objects in captivating black-and-white scenes. Turn on the sound and let’s go!

name: Airship: Kingdoms Adrift
short_description: Welcome to Suthseg! As the newly commissioned airship captain, forge a mercantile empire across the archipelago, until the great powers of Europa turn their attention toward it. Build up a fleet, chart trade routes, establish industries, and explore the frontier at your airship's helm!

name: Burger Restaurant Simulator
short_description: Join Burger Restaurant Simulator for delicious moments! Enjoy making hamburgers with great graphics and rich content.

name: Monster Path
short_description: A monster collecting roguelike-JRPG with stacking power ups, a 2.5D storybook fantasy art style, and a dynamic score

name: VISCO Collection
short_description: With the VISCO Collection, you'll have the chance to relive the glory days of arcade gaming with these seven fantastic titles. Whether you're a fan of shooters, fighters, sports, or racing games, there's something here for everyone.

name: Tenioha! feat. Mami
short_description: In this 2022 Moe Game Award–winning dark romance VN, step into the shoes of a submissive young corporate cog whose dream of a big-city bachelor’s lifestyle remains elusive—that is, until he catches the captivating gaze of one Mami Himekawa, his dommy-mommy, slightly older coworker...

name: Relight The Dark
short_description: Relight The Dark is a chilling and emotionally charged short horror experience that tells a story about a girl living with her abusive mother.

name: Temple Knight Saga -Oath of the Knight's Sword-
short_description: The story of the Three Temple Knights, dispatched on a secret mission, and takes place .Along the way, Sir Virginio accepted a request from a certain lady. But what truly awaits him. JRPG Quality. Translated with help from native English speaker, and not machine translation.

name: Ilysia
short_description: Experience the adventure of a lifetime in the first true MMORPG built for VR! Embark on an expansive open world and explore hidden ruins and dungeons, seek out lost treasure, climb and fight massive titans, quest alone or alongside friends and hone your skills in numerous professions!

name: Dog Years
short_description: Intrepid explorers embark on a perilous space expedition to save their dying civilization by securing vital resources. They are accompanied by 5P4RKY, an android dog, but trouble ensues as the journey begins.

name: HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED™ 2 - Turbocharged
short_description: The world’s raddest cars are back and taking the fun to the next level! Race over 130 vehicles with crazy new mechanics and even more vehicle types. Plus, build your tracks with stunning new environments and different game modes to have fun off and online!

name: Only an Alien Going Up!
short_description: 'Only an Alien Going Up!' is a difficult 3D platformer where your only goal is to climb to the top, without checkpoints.

name: Combat Mission Fortress Italy
short_description: Combat Mission Fortress Italy brings wargamers to the 'soft underbelly of Europe', a place that was anything but.

name: BIKEOUT
short_description: Take a bike and go on extreme tracks BIKEOUT! Here you have to grow from a noob to a freeride legend.

name: Too Many Cooks
short_description: Fired and blackballed by Chef Hamsey, you are a chef looking to find your next position. Unfortunately, the employees of any restaurant you walk into want you dead! Fight off hordes of enemies while upgrading through a food-themed upgrade tree.

name: The Backrooms Deluxe
short_description: A new, immersive Backrooms game featuring many entities and many levels.

name: Pumping Simulator 2
short_description: A gas station management game, start by selling a car to raise funds and invest in an abandoned plot of land. Build, expand, and upgrade your gas station, diversify services, customize and manage time efficiently during peak hours. And maybe you will become rich

name: Echoes of Madness
short_description: With innovative gameplay mechanics in this genre, a story that immerses you in the depths of unimaginable horrors, and an immersive visual and auditory setting, Echoes of Madness represents the revival of this subgenre forgotten through time. Will you be able to survive your shift?

name: Dream Knight
short_description: Welcome to 'Dream Knight', this is a highly playable ACT+Rougelike game. You will play 4 heroes with different playstyles, experience bloody battles, and grow stronger in countless reincarnations. 6 major levels/massive skill branches/huge weapon system, enjoy the fantasy world!

name: Paperman: Adventure Delivered
short_description: Explore colorful worlds, uncover secrets, and collect all golden letters in this 3D collectathon platformer. Go on an adventure with Paperman and the team, find the lost mail and defeat the greedy dragon!

name: Headlong Hunt
short_description: A puzzle game about capturing a creature. Learn to guide it and hide from it in simple yet surprisingly deep and satisfying ways.

name: Tide—1927—
short_description: In the 16th year of the Republic of China, Shanghai. Bai Youfu, a young girl who was dissatisfied with the arranged marriage, saw the news of her fiancé's murder in the newspaper one day, pointing to the innocent woman as the murderer. In order to protect her father, she decides to leave home.

name: Mechanization
short_description: Mechanization is a factory building game. Build huge production lines, utilizing an array of droppers, conveyor belts, smelters, upgraders & more! Upgrade the size of your factory & use factory modules to enhance your factory's efficiency.

name: Operation Valor
short_description: Operation Valor is a tactical top-down multiplayer shooter that provides large scale combined-arms combat through base building and teamwork.

name: FarmCraft 2
short_description: Investigate an experimental Farm and stop the Global Vegetable Crisis!

name: Inescapable: No Rules, No Rescue
short_description: Inescapable: No Rules, No Rescue is a social thriller set in a tropical island resort: you’ve been kidnapped and forced to participate in a twisted reality TV show with 10 strangers. At the end of their stay, they’ll each receive $500,000... If they survive.

name: GeneWars
short_description: Gene Wars is a WarSong(Langrisser) like turn-based game . You will lead the army of cells to fight for the jihad of creating life. Train soldiers and characters, master the combat between arms and defeat the enemy on the battlefield!

name: Cyber Avenger
short_description: Cyber Avenger is a top-down action game where you take on the role of a highly skilled covert operative on a dangerous mission to stop a group of terrorists. You must navigate through five maps, facing a variety of enemies, including shotgunners, snipers, melee fighters, kamikazes, and more.

name: Soulbind: Tales Of The Underworld
short_description: It's up to you to become the Endless, a mysterious skeleton, and embark on a perilous journey. Collect monster body parts to enhance your character and use a variety of abilities. Explore sinister locations, fight mythical creatures and uncover the secrets of the Underworld.

name: OASIS: Tokyo
short_description: OASIS: Tokyo is an FPS with a focus on inventory management that has roguelite elements. Complete procedurally generated missions in a shady underworld.

name: Catch Up
short_description: Welcome to the enchanting world of 'Catch Up'! Get ready to embark on an exciting precision platforming adventure like you've never seen before! Join an epic journey with a brave cat where skill and precision will be your best allies.

name: Solune
short_description: Enter Solune, a world of fantasy and magic! This turn-based JRPG is inspired by the classics, with modern improvements. Challenge yourself with 50 optional puzzles, discover hidden secrets and face off against powerful end-game bosses, all while on an adventure to save the world!

name: Shadow King
short_description: Explore a mysterious castle in this pixel perfect metroidvania and take on the Shadow King! Upgrades, secrets, combat, and more!

name: Labyrinth
short_description: The aMAZEing Labyrinth now with a completely new look and at long last for PC: for more than 35 years, the simple and unique gameplay of the board game has inspired more than 20 million people worldwide.

name: Dark City: Kyiv Collector's Edition
short_description: Gather your courage for a journey into a mysterious world beyond our view in this hidden-object mystery!

name: 3D Chess Online
short_description: 3D Chess Online combines the magical world of chess with a modern and three-dimensional experience! Determine your strategy and fight against your opponents worldwide in this simulator equipped with realistic graphics.

name: American Arcadia
short_description: American Arcadia is a cinematic puzzle game that combines a 2.5D platformer and first-person game to tell the tale of a thrilling escape. Experience the extraordinary story of Trevor, an average man escaping from the world's most popular reality tv show.

name: Loca Deserta: Odesa
short_description: Take on the role of a simple Cossack who helps to build the economy of a new region. Find all treasures and place them on the Hill of Glory!

name: Killon
short_description: Killon is a retro shooter that features exhilarating combat, manic enemies and a charged cannon waiting to be unleashed. Fly a starship across the universe and restore the future today.

name: Trapped In Here With Me
short_description: Heart-pounding arcade shooter.

name: Xonix Casual Edition
short_description: Remake of a classic old-school hit from 80s, one of the first arcade games ever!

name: Demon's Blood
short_description: Demon's Blood is a first-person shooter that throws you into a Demonic universe, Become a special agent, arm yourself and improve your equipment in different games to repel the demonic forces trying to invade your world.

name: The Keyboard
short_description: This is a text based game. You need to use the given keyboard to achieve the level goal.

name: ATV Offroad Simulator 24
short_description: Are you ready for the real offroad experience with ATV Offroad Simulator 24? Discover the excitement of ATV riding in an adventure-filled, open world.

name: Wildstrive
short_description: Wildstrive - is an open-world first-person survival game. Craft tools, build a camp, harvest crops, explore the land, tame and fight wild animals. Challenge nature and solve the mystery of the lost island!

name: Mon-Yu: Defeat Monsters And Gain Strong Weapons And Armor. You May Be Defeated, But Don’t Give Up. Become Stronger. I Believe There Will Be A Day When The Heroes Defeat The Devil King.
short_description: Defeat the Devil Kings! You have been guided to the land of fairies where the Dragon King’s Tower housed the hidden treasures that had brought peace to the land. But one day, the Seven Devil Kings stole all of the treasures, and used their powers to turn the tower into a terrible dungeon!

name: Five Nights: No Escape
short_description: Multiplayer co-op and real-time voice chat supported! A faithful tribute to Five Nights at Freddy's. Welcome to Megan’s Mall! Uncover the mysteries, explore the truth, and experience the unknown fear and excitement - It's going to be an experience you'll never forget!

name: Pudding
short_description: 'Let's defeat the demon lord together!' A thrilling action-adventure of destruction!

name: Save The World
short_description: The story is a young man summoned to another world is suffered from the scourge of aggression by monsters,and save the world with the native heroes. Game mode is rogue,you only release your kill desire to kill the monsters all! Special Zhen Fa System,allow you active powerful Zhen Fa to bombing!

name: END UP ALONE
short_description: In a dark world, in an empty place full of hidden secrets and parasites, you have to try to escape.

name: Demon Slayer Shion
short_description: Shion's fellow Demon Slayer has gone missing in an otherworldly cave, and it's up to her teammates to find and rescue her! Just what horrors await them?

name: Rage Of Towers
short_description: Rage Of Towers is a modern Realistic Tower Defense game. Typically, you build towers on the path to destroy enemies before they reach the end, But what if you could take control of the tower by yourself and feel the battlefield?

name: Solitary Cat
short_description: The ultimate lightweight solitaire featuring simple yet robust rules for hours of dark-mode fun! Based on Klondike, 40 Thieves, and Bakers Game.

name: Collectamon
short_description: Collectamon is a creature collecting game with an additional focus on upgrades. Upgrade your character, upgrade the area and place your caught monsters in your sanctuary. Catch all monsters in the game? Upgrade Everything? Try and get all achievements? It's up to you!

name: Games for Stream!
short_description: An exhilarating chat interactive game, where the chat becomes your co-pilot, shaping the course of the game in real-time. Engage with your favorite streamers and viewers like never before as you type commands, make choices, and influence the game's outcomes directly through chat.

name: The Talos Principle 2
short_description: The Talos Principle 2 is a thought-provoking first-person puzzle experience that greatly expands on the first game's philosophical themes and stunning environments with increasingly mind-bending challenges.

name: Mercenaries Wings: The False Phoenix
short_description: “Mercenaries Wings” is a tactical simulation RPG where you level up, equip and command a group of mercenaries to fight through the stages. Character design is by the illustrator Raita Kazama, who has spared no effort in detail to make each character expressive and alive.

name: The Outbreak Story
short_description: Join Noah as he follows in his deceased father's footsteps: becoming an agent of the Special Paranormal Defense Forces, a secret organisation that protects people from the paranormal. The organisation has its hands full, however, as a strange disease turns people into monsters.

name: Super Dungeon Designer
short_description: Build your own dungeons and share them with others! Create tricky puzzles and fun challenges and share your creation with the world!

name: BTD:BTD
short_description: BTD:BTD is a TPS/FPS game similar to a tactical shooter or survival horror where you fight for survival in a post-apocalyptic world. It is a casual, hard-hitting game that emphasizes a realistic and severe game balance with an ease of play that requires no time or effort to prepare.

name: Koala Kids Golf
short_description: Control your Koala and collect treasure while avoiding dangers in this non-traditional Golf Game. Play through Challenges or with friends, Local or Online!

name: Xiangqi—the Chinese chess
short_description: 'Xiangqi—the Chinese chess 'Is a strategic and challenging chess game, whether you are a beginner or an advanced player, you can find fun and learn in the game. You can search and download the game in the app store, and start enjoying wonderful chess matches!

name: LunarLux
short_description: Experience a sci-fi action-adventure RPG on the Moon in the year 30XX! Join Bella in a story of science, truth, justice, and trust, as she travels the silver globe to find a way to save humanity from Comet Coda! It's time to unleash your Lux!

name: CASTILLO: The Nine Circles
short_description: CASTILLO: The Nine Circles is an FPS Collectathon. Collect power shards in each circle of hell to unlock new areas and progress on your quest through 9 diverse worlds. Embark on a journey through the circles of Hell, using unique abilities and weapons.

name: The Lab - Escape Room
short_description: Walk through a futuristic complex while solving puzzles and discover how you got there. What are these mysterious creatures? Why everything looks abandoned? Could you escape from The Lab?

name: Nature Escapes 4
short_description: Nature Escapes is back with another delightful assortment of enjoyable hidden object scenes!

name: Suika Shapes
short_description: Match a variety of colorful shapes in an ever-enclosing space in ​this addicting match two puzzle game

name: Deep Nest
short_description: Deep Nest is a fast-paced single player action shooter roguelite where you play a space marine fighting off an endless horde of alien monsters in an infested facility.

name: Sugar Shack
short_description: Grab some friends, fire up the boiler, and let the syrup flow! Build the world around your cabin as you fulfill orders of hungry villagers with endless sweet tooths. There's never a dull moment in this cozy forest inspired by Quebec lore and art!

name: Cush's Amazin' Adventure!!
short_description: A monster living in a small town embarks on a journey to become a hero. Explore the stages of a typical fantasy world. Help this monster kill the dark lord to become the savior of the world... or not.

name: Back to the Dawn
short_description: You were framed and incarcerated. Learn to survive in prison. Explore every inch and exploit any weakness. Manipulate and scheme. Make friends (or foes) with fellow inmates and with their help, break out of prison.

name: Death Lease
short_description: You will die.

name: GAZZLERS
short_description: Set in a cartoon world, you shoot, block and dodge your way through hordes of hilarious enemies that drive and fly around in their clunky vehicles. Steal their scrap, upgrade your skills and build a weapon so insane it just might work! How far will you get?

name: Hypogean
short_description: Welcome to the world of Hypogean, a casual mining simulation where you will be tasked with mining valuables for Hypogea, a mining corporation. Your main task is to operate a drilling machine and delve into the caves in search of ore, minerals, and other rare collectibles.

name: Splat Arena
short_description: Splat Arena is a over the top violent top down shooter inspired by the madness combat series.

name: Aim Trainer (With Cats)
short_description: A simple aim training game with images of cute cats, developed in Unreal Engine 5. Support kitties and improve your accuracy.

name: Dreaming Diorama
short_description: A casual cozy puzzle game where you create various dioramas. Explore and assemble dioramas in a 3D environment. Enjoy relaxing gameplay that allows you to create dioramas at your own pace with no time restraints.

name: Snow Blocks
short_description: Snow Blocks is an addictive 3D puzzle game where you have to break snow blocks! Your task is to destroy the blocks so that the ice blocks are on the ground! But be careful, there are other rules in the game!

name: VenusBlood GAIA International
short_description: Embark on the impossible quest to rescue the decaying world of Palastra in this dungeon defense SRPG, interwoven with a story of epic proportions!

name: 小世界模拟器3
short_description: Ability to create and run wordplay worlds (support for workshops); Attribute values between different worlds can be correlated and inheritable (gathering is a large universe, scattering is full of stars), or they can be isolated from each other. Small World Simulator is a lot of fun!

name: Ecstatic
short_description: Rave spider goes to the bullet-hell ball: shoot rockets out of your butt, dodge and destroy waves upon waves of drones, slow down time whenever you don't move.

name: Shooting Game Builder
short_description: Shooting Game Builder is a tool for creating and distributing shoot 'em up with no programming required! You can create your own graphics, sounds, and ideas.

name: 田园画境 Pastoral
short_description: 《Pastoral》is a casual simulation, placement of hang-up + oil painting style healing system placement game. The breeze is quiet and the sun is fine! Let's get away from the hustle and bustle and enjoy a moment of idyllic beauty in the game.

name: These Doomed Isles
short_description: Harvest cards to raise land from the sea, build settlements and rain fire upon invaders in this survival city-builder with roguelike deckbuilding mechanics. Choose from 3 gods with unique cards, playstyles and abilities to lead their civilisations to victory in strategic run-based gameplay!

name: System Critical 2
short_description: System Critical 2 is bigger & badder than ever before! Get ready to experience a platformer shooter like no other in VR. Blast your arm cannon and use guns, melee weapons, grenades,& shields to make your way through the carefully crafted levels with epic boss battles and tons of enemies to kill.

name: Defiled Survivors
short_description: Slay the night creatures and save the church, you are the last hope! Defiled Survivors is a time survival medieval game with rogue-lite elements, where you choose your character's path and slay hundreds of enemies on your way.

name: LIZARDS MUST DIE
short_description: The great exploits of the Ancient Rus in the war with the lizards. Immerse yourself in the world of Hyperborea and defeat hordes of Lizards and other unholy who encroached on holy places Ancestors. Choose a blessed hero and go save the world from the green plague.

name: Reach the light
short_description: Jump twice every so often to reach the light in this difficult precision platformer with the power of a simple ball. Explore a world full of challenges that will test your patience and skill.

name: Kona II: Brume
short_description: Northern Québec, 1970. A bizarre mist —the Brume— is disconnecting a rural mining village from its quiet reality. Step into the shoes of Detective Carl Faubert as he unfolds the mysteries haunting the region while battling for his own survival.

name: Dungeon Golf
short_description: It’s mini golf in a dungeon (duh). Whack your way through lava, traps and monsters using a lute, your fists, or your own skeletal leg. You can even score a hole-in-none! Compete with your friends online or together to be the true Dungeon Golf champion.

name: Paleo Pines
short_description: Welcome to Paleo Pines, a charming island known for its friendly dinosaurs, quirky townsfolk, and mysterious past. Befriend dinos and enlist their help to fix up your ranch and farm crops to create your cozy dino sanctuary! Then set out with your companion, Lucky, to uncover the island’s secrets.

name: Jewel Match Aquascapes 2 Collector's Edition
short_description: Set off on an enchanting Match-3 journey into an underwater realm where the everyday fades away! Explore a mesmerizing aquatic world filled with intricate Match-3 challenges that will lead you through vibrant coral gardens and beautiful submerged landscapes.

name: Spooky Dwellers - Collector's Edition
short_description: Unleash the power of the talismans of light, cast out lurking spirits, and transform Grandma's haunted house into the ultimate Halloween party destination!

name: Whispers In Paradise
short_description: Save Emily from a malevolent force in this chilling Puzzle-Action-Horror adventure. Navigate treacherous landscapes, solve mind-bending puzzles, and confront monstrous entities. Embrace the challenge and embark on a journey that will test your courage, wits, and determination.

name: Super elastic
short_description: The girl said that this game is really flexible, come and play together.

name: 修仙家族模拟器
short_description: 玩家扮演一位家族老祖，开创一个家族，然后在一片海域中，占领一个修仙小岛，带领家族逐渐壮大发展的故事，在壮大过程中你可以攻占其他修真小岛，探索深海，秘境探宝等等。

name: Cobalt Core
short_description: A sci-fi roguelike deckbuilder with a deep new single-axis spin on tactics games! Dodge missiles, line up your cannons, and blast 'em out of the sky... Then get to the bottom of these time loops, before it's too late!

name: [Chilla's Art] The Kidnap | 誘拐事件
short_description: The Kidnap | 誘拐事件 is a Japanese horror game about a kidnapping incident.

name: SILENT SCREAM
short_description: Play as a fast-food restaurant worker in a Lovecraftian-themed world and face a Junji Ito-inspired monster. Buy mysterious items from The Gatekeeper. Sacrifice your customers to an otherworldly entity.

name: Memory Patches
short_description: A visual short novel about a girl who wakes up in an empty apartment and tries to figure out what happened. In front of her are four boxes filled with different items from her past. Touching them, she recalls pieces of memories, but one of the items is cursed.

name: Par for the Dungeon
short_description: Putt, explode and fight with everything from grapple hooks to laser beams and conquer over 100 increasingly puzzling levels!

name: Sunlight Scream
short_description: Max returns to Sunlight City, his childhood town to his own brother. A new university, new acquaintances, friends, love... And all the fun comes to end when students one by one begin to die at the hands of a masked killer. Try to survive if you can!

name: Chain
short_description: Chain is an open world 2d action adventure game inspired by the gameboy era. you will have to explore a vast island with different biomes in search of the seven magical petals, but be careful, the island is under a curse that mixes all the items inside the chests.

name: The Leak
short_description: Wake up, watch tv, make a cup of cofffee and try to bear your own meaningless existence.

name: Jetpack Kiwi
short_description: Jetpack Kiwi is a classic 2D side scrolling shoot em up game featuring 20 levels, 5 bosses, hordes of enemies spaceships, with multiple characters to choose from; each one with an unique special attack. Complete the game in single player or with a friend in local co-op!

name: Cozy Desert
short_description: Embark on a heartwarming journey through the enchanting world of Cozy Desert, a delightful and charming exploration game that will warm your soul and captivate your imagination. Step into a whimsical desert village, where the sands hold secrets waiting to be uncovered.

name: The Unknown Fear
short_description: The Unknown Fear is about a prisoner, sentenced to death, that had his memory deleted. His only chance of changing his life is by retrieving a file on the main computer of a secret settlement. Will you be able to get a new life or will the imprisoned creature in the settlement devour your body?

name: HumanitZ
short_description: HumanitZ is a co-op, isometric, open world survival game in a world ended by the zombie outbreak. As one of the few human survivors, try to last as long as “humanly” possible. The past can’t be changed, but you can make a difference today for the future of humanity.

name: Super Words
