short_description: Super Words is a reversed crossword puzzle & word game. You need to place and connect all words on the board according to the given clues

name: The Will of Arthur Flabbington
short_description: A comedy point-and-click adventure game about a dead uncle, a hidden treasure, a reluctant ghost sidekick, old people and pizza.

name: Plungeroo
short_description: Plungeroo is a colorful puzzle game about tinkering with mini pinball cabinets, no quick reflexes or quarters required! Maneuver your ball through Pop Bumpers, Flippers, and more until you become a pinball wizard!

name: 死写 -SHISYA-
short_description: Horror adventure game to appraise spirits photos

name: Stolen Mushrooms
short_description: Stolen Mushrooms - a 2D platformer where you as a frog take revenge on the brazen mutants who stole your winter supplies, jumping through different levels and destroy enemies. Purchase everything you need in the in-game store and complete all levels. There should be only one left!

name: R00000
short_description: A home brewed 360° interactive horror flick. Witness a troubled soul craving to make a chilling home movie realize that the monster lies a lot deeper than he could have ever guessed. Play the cassette and rewind the terror hidden inside.

name: Chess Exerciser
short_description: Become a better chess player with learning by repetition. Exercise from 3.000+ opening lines and discover their best continuation. Learn tactics from millions of puzzles split into 38 categories and 11 difficulty levels. Master 18.000+ endgame positions sorted by category and difficulty.

name: Xenoterrestrial
short_description: Time and date are not important. Aliens have boarded a military vessel deep in space. Little do they know, #T217, a combat clone onboard the dreadnought, has been waiting for them. Use a wealth of weapons and mechanics to eliminate them with expert precision.

name: BattleCakes
short_description: Indulge in a delicious adventure as you choose to battle or befriend your enemies to save the day your way! Personalize your cupcake hero and meet charming friends along the way. Leave the world better off than you found it in this turn-based RPG.

name: In His Time
short_description: Enter the hauntingly beautiful shadow world of In His Time, a 2D puzzle-solving adventure game. There you will meet Olly and join him to solve puzzles throughout each step of his emotional journey of growth and self-discovery.

name: Storage Hustle
short_description: Storage Hustle is a Simulation RPG where you go into storage auctions to buy different mysterious storages. Discover and sell many items, join Yard Sales and haggle your way for profit!

name: CARROT: The First Seed
short_description: A magical family decides to start a new life in a peaceful small coastal town, but it seems their peaceful days are being interrupted by Greek fire.

name: Castle Guardian
short_description: Legendary action with tower defense warfare! Become a castle guard in fantastic medieval era! Destroy the enemies with your wingman Centaur. Defend your castle!

name: Popcorn Rocket
short_description: Popcorn Rocket is a silly food based old-school arcade space shooter. Pilot the Popcorn Rocket as you blast through hordes of food spaceships in order to save the galaxy from the evil Nebula Empire! With a wacky cast of heroes and villains, Popcorn Rocket will leave your stomach wanting more!

name: Hazy Monochrome Wand
short_description: A roguelite action game drawn in black and white pixel art. Operate a magic wand that uses actions such as 'time stagnation', 'time leap', and 'explosion magic', Break through randomly connected dungeons

name: Womb
short_description: During a route next to Prasinos, a colonized little planet, Helena received an order to investigate an S.O.S. sign streamed by the mothership Z9. When landing on site, she discovers that the situation was much worse than she thought.

name: Forebloomed: Evergreen Edition
short_description: An action rogue-like about garden plants fighting back against the hungry pests that threaten their home. Spend the day blasting through hedges to find loot, but take care to make it back before dark! Gather synergistic items, confront formidable bosses, and play as several unique characters!

name: Clarent Saga: Mana Chapter 0
short_description: A short RPG with great action battles, graphics and music inspired by the Mana Series.A great entry point for newcomers!

name: Squidding Over It
short_description: Can you overcome the challenge without losing your mind in your attempt to become a Squidding Master?

name: Wildsilver
short_description: Wildsilver is a JRPG featuring an active-time battle system. With a party of up to four characters, visit towns and explore dungeons, find items and equipment, level up, choose between abilities and defeat powerful bosses. Enjoy beautiful and epic music in an emotional story with plot twists.

name: Underground gnome
short_description: Underground gnome - is a 2D platformer with puzzle elements. Destroy enemies on the location and complete the set goal to go further along the storyline and collect bonuses.

name: Ratyrinth
short_description: You are drastically separated from your family in a scary forest with dangerous creatures, and you have to find them again! Ratyrinth is a cute and challenging precision platformer.

name: ツクモガミーズ！
short_description: The not-at-all heartwarming school gag game ”TSUKUMOGAMIS！'. Sumika, a girl possessed by a half-human Musubi, born of a Tsukumogami god father and a mother of kotodama, is a reclusive and scruffy JK! Will Musubi be able to collect many 'good words' and become a man of his own?

name: Retro Mystery Club Vol.1: The Ise-Shima Case
short_description: This classic-style mystery adventure game, inspired by the Famicom Detective Club series and illustrated by Famitsu's legend Kiyokazu Arai, will take you on a suspenseful journey through the beautiful landscapes of Ise-Shima.

name: HexaWars
short_description: Retro twin stick shooter that gradually gets more difficult as you defeat more waves of enemies and Bosses.

name: Hold The Door
short_description: Hold The Door is a 2d pixel-art tower defense game where you influence the monsters paths by placing your towers strategically. With procedurally generated levels & waves, it's guaranteed to always provide a new experience every time you play.

name: Word Dungeons
short_description: Word Dungeons borrows attitude from dark and gritty RPGs, and adds these elements to a word game. Solve words, collect loot, power up your runes and discover the mysteries that lay within the dungeon. Can you escape?

name: Horace Hagfish
short_description: Eat colorful meat to create slime trails, blend colors by crossing paths, and collect the chromatic orbs to unlock the exit. But whatever you do, don’t make brown or it’s game-over for you and the cosmos!

name: Car Mechanic: City Driving
short_description: Customize your own car and go on a serene ride through the city streets!

name: ReThink | Evolved 5
short_description: ReThink | Evolved 5 is a Puzzle Game in a peaceful futuristic setting, that features a variety of Puzzles that utilize Lasers and the behavior of light and it's colors to create challenging problems to solve.

name: Armed Farm
short_description: As an armed farm owner, you can hire farmers, purchase farmland, research technologies that accelerate crop maturity, trade your crops in the store, unlock crops and firearms, hire security personnel, defend your farm from bandit attacks. Face the challenges, decide your farm’s destiny!

name: Sole Seeker
short_description: Land on unique planets to survive the horrors that await in this adventure survival RPG. Use the spoils to upgrade defensive buildings and explore the galaxy further. Can you survive the hunt all alone?

name: Ontotis
short_description: Ontotis is a psychological horror game focusing on atmosphere, mystery and an engaging story. Uncover scattered clues to unveil the chilling fate of the house's residents, while encountering a mysterious humanlike figure seemingly connected to them in their haunting tale.

name: Gym Simulator 24
short_description: Gym Simulator 24: Build Your Fitness Empire! Embark on a journey to create your dream fitness haven in Gym Simulator 24, the ultimate simulation game where you'll ascend the ranks and craft your very own fitness empire.

name: GameDev Trash
short_description: GameDevTrash is a highly unconventional game.Each level presents a new genre for you to experience: shooter, open-world RPG, horror,and much more! The game's plot revolves around the modern gaming industry and its peculiarities. All of this is mixed with a slightly insane storyline and trashy humor.

name: Asterix & Obelix: Heroes
short_description: Original gameplay combining deck building and turn-based combat. 24 heroes from the comic series available for you in this original adventure. To foil Caesar's plans, upgrade your deck and make the right tactical decisions!

name: Kingdoms Of Ereloth
short_description: Kingdoms of Ereloth is a medieval pirate survival rpg with survival and rpg focused servers by Arcadius Entertainment.

name: CJ Dreams
short_description: CJ Dreams - An interactive side-scrolling shooter in which you have to fly on a jetpack on the rocks, trying not to crash. Avoid spatial anomalies and rock crashes to avoid damaging your jetpack and periodically cool it down on special rocks.

name: Virtual ULTIMATE Beach Dancer [HD+]
short_description: Virtual ULTIMATE Beach Dancer [HD+] for your Windows devices...

name: COLDSTEEL's Sprite Studio
short_description: COLDSTEEL's Sprite Studio is a new generation pixel editor purpose built for game development (although it can be used for anything). Sprite Studio offers creation of graphics and images, animation creation, and scripting via Python, so you can create new features for Sprite Studio.

name: Paraopticon
short_description: Paraopticon is an Observation Duty / Puzzle Game Style mix. Try to spot all anomalies and report them so you don´t die.Make it till 6 AM and you survive.

name: Ruin
short_description: Escape the levels of Ruin in this 2D platformer with tight controls where you traverse dangerous traps and difficult obstacles.

name: The Isle Tide Hotel
short_description: Explore a mysterious hotel and infiltrate a cult in this FMV detective game, featuring a cast from GoT, The Witcher, and more. Every decision counts as you gather clues and question guests. Can you unearth the ominous secrets at The Isle Tide Hotel before it's too late to save your missing daughter?

name: Money Garden
short_description: You have a tree in your garden a MONEYTREE! Strap your lawn vacuum on you back and collect all the money it drops. Try to keep your garden clean.

name: OTurret
short_description: OTurret - is an action tower defense game with elements of engineering and survival where you play as a brave frog defending itself against giant insects. Build various defensive structures, from cannons to magnetic traps, to help the frog survive in a dangerous world.

name: 三国志-群雄涿鹿
short_description: 本游戏主打休闲娱乐，抛开了传统的内政军事亲历亲为的操作方式，除了君主所在的城池需要玩家自己操作发展，其他城池的内政军事发展该城池的太守会自动模拟发展，战斗也不需要玩家亲自指挥，只需要坐着享受双方战斗带来的沉浸感，完全实现了三国模拟器的开发初衷，一切以模拟为主。

name: BlooDooMooN SurViVoR
short_description: Welcome to this survival sandbox game! Your plane made a forced landing during the Bermuda storm. You will need to establish your own survival base from scratch, collect materials, make tools, build towns, manufacture weapons, explore unknown fields. Will you conquer the challenges ？

name: Killing Bullet
short_description: You need to survive every round of enemy attacks, kill enemies to get rewards, buy props or extract stronger weapons to deal with stronger enemies, until you kill the last enemy. Enjoy the thrill of battle.

name: Redline Racing
short_description: High Pace, High Skill Time-trial Racing Game

name: Microcivilization
short_description: Incremental clicker strategy, where you expand, construct, research, fight, collect heroes and make choices between good and evil. Ascend through difficulty tiers by playing through challenge campaign going back and forth through history. Mammoths included.

name: Chillquarium
short_description: Chillquarium is a cozy and relaxing idle game. Buy fish and raise them in real time, then sell them to turn a profit! Customize your aquarium as you progress from a simple starter tank to your dream setup by filling your collection with rare exotic fish and ultra-rare color variants!

name: Spot the Diff 3D
short_description: The first ever brand new 3D Spot the difference game!

name: Getting Out Alive
short_description: A FPS modern time game.

name: Lost in fantasy
short_description: Lost in fantasy - 2D platformer with RPG elements. You will go through different levels as you progress through the story of the game! Create your character, equip it with the necessary weapons and go to battle! Go to a wonderful world, explore it, and most importantly, beware of dangerous enemies!

name: Just The Two Of Us
short_description: Just The Two Of Us is a 3DCG visual novel made using the Ren'py about the budding feelings between a boy and a girl that meet for the first time in a post-apocalyptic world. A story-rich game with plot twists and multiple endings

name: Last Memories
short_description: A dark story about a short but tragic journey. Adventure game with a rich storyline and multiple endings.

name: Death Must Die
short_description: Descend the nether in search of Death himself! Choose from God-given powers to slay his hordes of minions. Unlock new heroes, collect powerful items and create game-breaking synergies in this roguelite hack and slash survivors game.

name: 探しものは、夏ですか。
short_description: ──じゃあ、私のお願い……聞いてくれない？

name: Outlive
short_description: Outlive is an intense game of survival! Run, hide and outsmart mutants in a post-apocalyptic world. No fighting allowed, only puzzles to solve. Created by an indie studio founded by a father and son.

name: UKI-UKI-TENGOKU2
short_description: Retro 2D side-scrolling shooter with pixel art. Control a penguin (Laser), a fish (Firebreath), and a human (Railgun) to achieve a high score!

name: Joy Life 2
short_description: In the game, players need to find two cards with the same picture and successfully eliminate them. If the cards on the flop are inconsistent, no changes will occur. After eliminating all the cards in the picture and entering the next level,

name: Dokapon Kingdom: Connect
short_description: Make friends or frenemies! Be a savvy schemer in this hybrid RPG party game!

name: Poly
short_description: Simplistic roguelike shooter, Blast your way through countless enemies while earning powerful upgrades which turn you into a shape obliterating machine! 50+ upgrades with countless synergies and stacking effects!, Unique enemies which have unique abilities

name: G-MODEアーカイブス+ 魔神転生 blind thinker
short_description: Set in the year 20XX in 'NEO TOKYO,' a symbol of the new era What is the 'demon summoning program' left behind by the father who disappeared?

name: Sniper Hunter Shooter
short_description: For game lovers seeking realism, Sniper Hunter Shooter is an experience not to be missed! Fight as a sniper in a post-apocalyptic world, create your strategy, and test your shooting skills.

name: Song of Nunu: A League of Legends Story
short_description: Two best friends, one wild adventure. Join best friends Nunu and Willump on an adventure across the frozen wilds of the Freljord. Song of Nunu: A League of Legends Story is a single-player story adventure developed by Tequila Works.

name: Golf VS Zombies
short_description: Golf VS Zombies is an arcade golf simulator with RPG elements which combines golfing precision with action-packed combat against the undead. Grab your clubs and get in your golf cart, for in this zombie apocalypse, there is only golf.

name: Magicraft
short_description: 'Magicraft' is a Roguelike game that uses a variety of spells to match unimaginable spell effects, and the construction of ultra-high degrees of freedom cannot even be exhausted by developers.

name: Diamond Rush
short_description: Diamond Rush is the simplest 3D game in which you have to overcome various traps and look for diamonds.

name: Noah's Descent into Madness
short_description: Noah's Descent into Madness is a short horror-themed adventure and puzzle game. Make your way through a dark forest of unknown horrors while trying your best to escape the nightmare you've found yourself in.

name: 孤高之人
short_description: 这是一款3D横版平台跳跃、跑酷类休闲、冒险游戏。您将扮演一位专业的冒险家，前往征服探险界内最为著名的险地“孤高”。尝试克服道路上各种各样的陷阱，不畏挫折，征服你脚下所走过的所有土地，直到攀上顶峰。

name: 接触: 第一章(The Encounter: Chapter One)
short_description: This game tells the story of a Chinese family who inexplicably disappeared in 1999. Afterwards, a journalist was sent by the TV station to investigate and visit this incident and the subsequent events. The final outcome will be unimaginable to you! Looking forward to your experience!

name: Absolute color perception
short_description: Absolute color sense is a very test of color sense eye game. Among the many colors, can you tell which one is different?

name: Bud Spencer & Terence Hill - Slaps And Beans 2
short_description: After the shipwreck in Africa, Bud and Terence save a village from criminals and make their way home on a raft loaded with bananas. But of course it wouldn't be a Bud and Terence adventure if everything went according to plan.

name: Last Barrier
short_description: Last Barrier is a tower defense game set in a zombie apocalypse setting. Defend the base with army machine guns, rocket launchers and a wall built around the perimeter. Purchase unit upgrades with kill points. Your military base is the last line of defense against the countless forces of zombies.

name: Grand Strokers
short_description: Comedic Horror RPG / JRPG that will leave you breathless with a sticky keyboard --- or offended! No holds barred, no filters. Pure unadulterated sexiness monster orgy goodness!!

name: Crossfire: Sierra Squad
short_description: Fierce military arcade shooter in VR for single-player and co-op multiplayer. Drop into a variety of indoor and outdoor battle scenes with 63 missions, 39 different weapons, and 17 types of enemies as you lead an elite fireteam into immersive 360° combat.

name: DOS-PLAN
short_description: The game is a 2D platformer with puzzle elements where you play as a a professional agent whose goal is to sneak into the most protected corners of the map and go unnoticed. The zone is very well guarded and in order to reach the desired target, you will have to be very careful.

name: Riley In The Abyss
short_description: Riley In The Abyss is a stealth action shooter. You wake up as 'Riley'in an underwater facility to research the depths of the ocean. Upon waking up, something is wrong... Everyone is seemingly dead. Sink or swim in this short psychological horror game.

name: Pigeon in Hurry
short_description: Pigeon In Hurry is a fun 3D runner about a infinitely hungry bird. Feel the free flight at low altitude. Fly around various obstacles, collect as many tacos as possible, feed the pigeon.

name: Into The Sky
short_description: In this first-person puzzle platformer you will try to figure out the right way through each level and afterwards can try to improve your timings by finiding hidden paths and secret short cuts. Your goals are to sucessfully finish a level as well as to beat the fastest time of our level designers.

name: Candy Creeps
short_description: Candy Creeps is a Halloween themed retro arcade co-op platformer. The very first entry in Digital Eclipse Arcade, a series of all-new games inspired by classic '80s arcade vibes.

name: Jumpy Paws - World Adventures
short_description: Casual adventure game where you are a brave puppy traveling the World and discovering new cultures and challenges. Visit iconic places of the world and use unique dog skills to unfold this short and cute story.

name: Cattie
short_description: Cattie is a platform game with retro graphics.

name: Algor PEW PEW
short_description: One day, invaders from the other world attacked and kidnapped all ARPs. Your mission is to travel through parallel worlds, enjoy the rhythms, rescue the ARPs and survive until end. Let us dive you into the first rogue-lite survival game from Algorhythm Project.

name: Zakantosh Cardgame
short_description: A Collectible Single Player Card Battle Game that focuses on Story Content. Your enemies are all kind of creatures, goaded by the evil influence of the mysterious crystals, that appeared out of nowhere. You will need to collect powerful cards and gems to fight your way through Zakantosh.

name: Jelly & Toast
short_description: Jelly & Toast is a local co-op game where you control Jelly and Toast on an exciting quest for stolen magical ingredients. Throw your friends or boxes, beware of enemy cooks or kitchen hazards, and explore a world full of culinary challenges!

name: Blitz Guard
short_description: Embark on an indie souls-like game! Master the unique Parry Gauge system, where successful parries fill the meter, but beware: a failed parry or taking damage will deplete it. Show your skill and strategy to unleash powerful abilities in epic battles!

name: Red Barrels Go Boom
short_description: The world is overrun with zombies! They are fast and they are immune to bullets! The only way to kill them is EXPLODING BARRELS!

name: Neyasnoe
short_description: Wastelands, grim folks behind garages, a nightclub, and a huge gray sky — a lost world for a lost generation. Let techno trance music and white verses lead you through the wastelands of the Neyasnoe.

name: Fallen Ninja
short_description: Lord Mordenai has captured Treasure. Ninja warrior mission is to kill Mordenai and steal Treasure Chests back

name: I commissioned some cats 7
short_description: I paid artists to hide cats and wool in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

name: Way to the light
short_description: You are a real digger, having descended down a vertical shaft of a mine, you find yourself in an abandoned tunnel system.

name: Nuwa
short_description: Nuwa is a Sci-Fi Strategy Game. Explore an unknown galaxy, discover alien civilization relic and incredible giants, make creatures to help you terraform the planets.

name: You Have No Time
short_description: Rev up your inner speedster in this high-octane puzzle adventure. Navigate slow-motion challenges inspired by lightning-quick heroes, where you'll outwit foes, snatch treasures, and rescue your allies. Each puzzle demands swift thinking and nimble fingers with just 30 seconds to conquer time itself.

name: Pirate Patrol
short_description: Lead anti-piracy operations and secure trade routes, command your carrier ship and send your fighter pilots on missions, train new officers and pilots, discover new technologies in this immersive sci-fi RPG. Created by old school hardcore gamers with 35 years of experience in the industry.

name: Evocation
short_description: A dark fantasy JRPG that focusses on equipment-based progression rather than leveling up. Explore, meet people, and simply survive in order to gain what you need to overcome the trials of the Goddess's temple.

name: Commander: Zombie Wars
short_description: Embark on a gripping turn-based tactical game in a zombie-infested world. Choose survivors or zombies. Gather resources, recruit allies, and strategize against the undead or join the undead. Shape custom maps, and decide the fate of the world. Join the fight now!

name: Wound Man
short_description: Wound Man is your guide on a gruesome adventure through the ages. Piece his epic story together while literally piecing him together. Poke, prod, stab and slice away to reveal his secrets. It's a jigsaw adventure! - but not for the faint of heart.

name: The Camp
short_description: You have been sent to The Camp. You cannot leave unless you collect all tents. There are a lot of monsters, so be careful. If they touch you, you die.

name: Mini Star Survivor
short_description: Collect stars and use them wisely to become stronger. Use each character's personality to establish a growth strategy. And survive and escape for 5 or 10 days.

name: Rhino Puzzle
short_description: Solve different puzzles to go forward and collect all skulls in this 3d puzzle game

name: Tonight, I Die in My Sleep
short_description: Navigate broken memories in a powerless fantasy fueled equally by nightmares and confessional poetry.

name: The Legend of Ogorets #1: Wrat
short_description: An immersive, barebones-style interactive visual novel with choices, lore, and endgames. Not for heroes.

name: Princess of Zeven
short_description: A lone warrior princess must explore a dangerous dungeon while surviving the dangerous streets of Zeven. Will she triumph over the dungeon, or be defeated by her brother's bid for the throne?

name: The Prospector Odyssey
short_description: A lonely trek to a desolate planet unearths a strange anomaly, seemingly causing denizens of a nearby station to become horrifying, violent mutants. Run, think, scavenge and improvise. Only the smartest will survive.

name: Chickado
short_description: Chickado is an isometric rogue-lite game where you play as an armed chick who seeks revenge against the other animals on the farm by battling them.

name: Boti: Byteland Overclocked
short_description: Jump, Dash, Slide! Dive into a classic 3D platformer experience with Boti: Byteland Overclocked. Explore the stylized insides of a computer as a determined data robot and save Byteland from an ominous threat. Play solo or team up with a friend in seamless co-op.

name: Medieval Kingdom Wars Story
short_description: Experience 100 Years War through fusion of RTS and Grand Strategy genres. Featuring a story driven and grand campaign as an English or a French lord in service to your King. This is an introduction for new players to Kingdom Wars franchise.

name: I Expect You To Die 3: Cog in the Machine
short_description: Outwit your most cunning adversary to date in the latest installment of this popular, spy-themed VR puzzle series. Wield new gadgets, visit action-packed locales, and wear custom disguises as you dive back into the world of espionage in this escape room game.

name: Chromosome Evil 2
short_description: Dive deep into this Lovecraft-inspired RTS survival for a second time. Assemble your strike team and manage your convoy. It's up to you to survive the onslaught of nightmares that are surely coming your way. Will you find the source of the darkness?

name: Bemis Wamilton Racing
short_description: Drive with Bemis Wamilton race in this race game with electronic racing cars against other competitors

name: Ceiba
short_description: Ein, a simple-hearted member of an expedition sent by mankind to distant planets, tries to get romantic with a pretty but cold co-worker girl. Unfortunately, he is not the only one trying to make contact as from the abandoned and desolate alien ruins, the girl receives a message in human language.

name: Tribes & Monsters
short_description: Tribes and Monsters is a survivor-like game where you can choose a tribe and become the leader of your own army. Try to collect materials in worlds inhabited by vicious monsters. Craft, upgrade, and enhance your tribe's base to unlock more features, stronger weapons, pets and so much more!

name: Task control
short_description: Task control is a 2D platformer with action elements. You have to play as a special agent and destroy enemies on the level, moving around the locations. Your goal: Destroy the maximum number of enemies and complete the level. First aid kits and grenades will always come to your aid!

name: Dead Signal
short_description: Monitor camera feeds, report valuable info, and hand-deliver shady packages. An hourly quota of reports will test your keen eye to spot the differences, while timed deliveries will force you outside unexpectedly. Until you clock out for the night almost nowhere is safe.

name: Kungfu
short_description: Kungfu is a simple strategic martial arts game.Enjoy it.

name: Up or Lava!
short_description: Participate in only up races with 100 players. Fall down, and you'll burn in the lava! Play with friends or other players. The last survivor wins. Could it be you?

name: Big Adventure: Trip to Europe 5 - Collector's Edition
short_description: 'Big Adventure: Trip to Europe 5' is a hidden object game that offers you an exciting journey through 15 beautiful European countries. During the game, you will find interesting objects in historical places of Europe and Scandinavia, play exciting mini-games and collect tons of objects souvenirs.

name: Tonalities
short_description: Tonalities is a relaxing single-player puzzle game where you position tiles to complete elaborate trick shots.

name: Missiles Away
short_description: Humanity faces its darkest hour as an alien force launches a relentless invasion. As a skilled pilot, you must take control of a powerful combat helicopter and engage in a fast-paced, high-octane first-person shooter experience.

name: Oni Station
short_description: Oni Station is a horror game with roguelike and arcade elements where you pilot a train to outrun the creature chasing you. Carefully plan which stations to stop, search for resources and, above all, how far can you survive?

name: True Colours
short_description: When three new hires join the office, love is in the air! Get to know your new co-workers, go on dates and discover what potentially dark secrets lie beneath. There's nothing to worry about - it's just a cute, innocent dating sim style visual novel... or is it?

name: Heretic's Fork
short_description: Dear candidate, we are pleased to invite you to take up the position of manager of Hell. You will punish sinners by using our deck-building computer system to construct hellish towers capable of keeping the endless hordes of the underworld in check. Best of luck!

name: One Life To Alice
short_description: This game consists of two interconnected parts. The first part is a visual novel about a girl named Alice, living in the near future. The pleasant visual presentation and a story based on real events will not leave you indifferent.

name: Parkour Game 2
short_description: Parkour Game 2 is a 3D first person platform game where you have to jump your way to the finish line.

name: Realm of Dread
short_description: Take a step into the Realm of Dread's world of horror and suspense. Explore mysterious locations, fight for survival within the realm of supernatural entities and uncover the secrets hidden in the shadows. This journey through darkness requires courage and intellect. Are you ready?

name: Karting Superstars
short_description: A kart racing game without weapons! This is a pure motorsport arcade racer. Compete vs very challenging AI, get on the global leaderboards and play with others online.

name: Kanji Industry
short_description: Kanji Industry is a Kanji production automation game. It is great fun to watch the production line move automatically to assemble complex kanji characters! It is also a great way to study kanji characters.

name: the ISLE survival
short_description: The ISLE survival is a vast open world survival / crafting game. Loot resources, craft items, build camps and explore the environment. Protect yourself from hazards and wildlife. Find ways to survive in hostile living conditions.

name: Elfboarders
short_description: Elfboarders, a competitive snowboard-racing, beat-em-ups brawler! Relative to the games of the 90s, Elfboarders brings a focus on LAN, multiplayer play, and a try-to-beat-the-computers-solo attitude. Four player maximum. Online play available.

name: Hyperlight Survivor
short_description: A Competitive Bullet Hell with roguelite mechanics. Fight against endless hordes of enemies in ever-changing arenas, unlock new spaceships and upgrade them with devastating weapons and Power-Ups. Complete contracts and reach new ranks to become the ultimate Champion!

name: Feywing
short_description: Feywing is a short game loosely inspired by classic internet ritual stories. You must memorize and navigate the strange environment of the Crossroads to collect materials for the ritual, and escape the Crossroads. During all of this, the whimsical Feywing will be there to guide you along.

name: 古诗消消大师-Chinese Ancient Poetry Matching Game
short_description: This game is a classic tile-matching game. Players can match tiles by clicking on the corresponding tiles in the order of Chinese ancient poetry, lyrics, and prose to pass levels. Through this game, players can experience the charm of traditional Chinese culture.

name: Hodgepodge Hunch
short_description: Hodgepodge Hunch is a who-done-it game where everyone chips in to make a hotpot dish. Collaborate with your buddies to collect ingredients in the dungeons and whip up a delicious feast. There's just one problem... A backstabber may be lurking among you who'll throw your dinner plans awry...

name: Witch Cram Sorceries
short_description: 魔法塾の新米講師となったマリエッタは、入塾した生徒を指導し、鍛え、優秀な魔術師の育成に努めます。

name: G-MODEアーカイブス50 ミッドナイトホラースクール
short_description: Can you save the school from a crisis with your mysterious powers? Mystery-solving adventure set in a school at midnight.

name: MEAT AND METAL
short_description: You are the operator of a combat turret defending the border beyond which lies the last human city! MEAT AND METAL is a challenging survival shooter with a ranked system, upgrades and different types of enemies.

name: Ghostrunner 2
short_description: Blood will run in Ghostrunner 2, a hardcore FPP slasher set in a post-apocalyptic cyberpunk future. Become the ultimate cyber ninja and prepare for epic boss fights, improved skills, an interactive story, new game modes, and captivating synthwave soundtrack.

name: Maxix Robotics
short_description: Survive the night in this Survival Horror environment as you navigate a Historic Robotics Facility by solving puzzles in various wings of the factory. By utilizing a Robotic companion called 'DOTT' you can open doors, activate terminals and more... Just make sure to look behind you.

name: Ashes O
short_description: Hurry up, the world stops in 5 minutes!Gain 100 levels in one swing of your sword and place your stat points in action to face the end of the world.A “Fast RPG” tinged with action and exploration with unique gameplay!

name: Mahjick - The Realm Taker
short_description: 'Mahjick - The Realm Taker' is a turn-based strategy game combining Roguelike and Mahjong Elements. Embark into this epic journey of taking the throne and to become the Keeper by defeating enemies for Enchantments and Skills, and Ronning your tiles for Attribute and Talent skills.

name: Inertia ball
short_description: This is an unusual adventure future simulation space game, in different gravity under your operation will also change. Players can feel the vastness of different planets in the game, feel different gravity, feel their own different operations. Conquer the universe!

name: Apocalipse Maromba
short_description: 'Apocalipse Maromba' is a quick 2D platform shooter game inspired by memes from the Brazilian bodybuilding and fitness universe, with its main objective on making the player smile! This is a parody that combines comedy, bodybuilding, and fun, without using real names, images, or brands.

name: Corn Kidz 64
short_description: The unauthorized, kid-friendly version of the classic Stephen King thriller (or maybe not, maybe it's just a game about one-horned goatbabies)

name: DRAGOT
short_description: DRAGOT is a fast paced bullet hell dungeon crawler in which you live or die by the mysterious items you find hidden in each room; Fizzle out early or snowball your newly acquired powers to fight through all six areas and finally defeat the dragon that pursues you.

name: 3 Scary Games
short_description: Three different first-person horror experiences, each with unique enemies to overcome: a Man, your Mind, and a Monster. Each game presents diverse playstyles and challenges. Outsmart the Man, solve the Mind puzzles, and parkour around the Monster.

name: Eternal King
short_description: Eternal King is a wave-based hack 'n' slash with deep, involved combat. Hone your skills against unrelenting hordes of monsters in a surreal fantasy world.

name: Flyout
short_description: Build and fly realistic aircraft. Use free-form fuselage and wing editor tools and tune your engines to recreate aircraft from any era or design your own.

name: Possessions
short_description: You're trapped in a house cursed by a Kitsune and forced to play his game. Now you have to compete with other souls for control of a burglar's body in order to gain your freedom! As a stray soul try to ambush the burglar by possessing household objects! As the burglar finish tasks and find an exit!

name: Infinity Strash: DRAGON QUEST The Adventure of Dai
short_description: The memories of the Hero, in your hands! Experience the story of the legendary anime series, DRAGON QUEST The Adventure of Dai, in an exhilarating action role-playing game that combines stunning visuals with art from the anime and manga.

name: Hoboman
short_description: Hoboman is a 2D NES-style platformer with a unique Sci-fi story and wild characters. Play as Pluto the Voltran as you hop ships from planet to planet and collect geodes to get your life back!

name: White Hat
short_description: White Hat is a bullet hell roguelite where you upgrade the game, not yourself, to progressively increase the difficulty. Earn points on runs that you can use to add more waves or research gameplay modifiers. Upgrades make the game harder, but increase your score multiplier.

name: The Coffin of Andy and Leyley
short_description: Walk-n-talk adventure with light puzzling. Brother and sister practice cannibalism after witnessing a botched satanic ritual.

name: Hot Dog Reporter
short_description: A fast paced platformer about a hot dog in a hurry

name: Mobile Store Simulator
short_description: Immerse yourself in the captivating world of Mobile Store Simulator! Build and manage your own tech haven, from store design to product selection. Experience the thrill of shaping a thriving mobile tech business and conquer the tech industry.

name: RUSSIAN FIGHT SIMULATOR
short_description: RUSSIAN FIGHT SIMULATOR is a 2-D combat simulator with many different weapons, maps and views to choose from!

name: Soul's Spectrum
short_description: You wake up in a mysterious dungeon, full of dangerous traps and unlucky inhabitants. Brain cracking puzzles await you while a dark story will slowly unfold in this supernatural place!

name: NecroAttack！
short_description: Armies of zombies are coming! The Edgar Kingdom is teetering on the brink of collapse! Young Edgar Princess stands out and leads her subjects to defeat enemies. Follow the story of the princess to explore uncharted land, and might unravel the mysteries behind such disaster?

name: Fuzzys Quest 2
short_description: Fuzzys Quest 2 is a cartoony platforming game full of magic and fairy-tale. Enter a magical world of mystery, engaging against the evil Koodies while racing to rescue all captured wizards in training. As you embark on your quest, you unravel the mysteries and secretes of the wizards.

name: Robo Rush
short_description: Robo Rush is a fast-paced action platformer focused on finishing one level as fast as you can!

name: Cats Hidden in Bali
short_description: Find 100 cats hiding in Bali in this cute hand-drawn hidden object game

name: Living Pages - Children's Interactive Book
short_description: Living Pages is a customizable interactive book, aimed at young ones, but who says it can't be for everyone?! Take reading time to the next level.

name: Ucube Avcıları
short_description: An absurd comedy-focused turn-based adventure

name: Balloons
short_description: Balloons is a single-player 2D racing game with roguelite elements. You can play as different emotive head balloons, breathe to gain lift, and enjoy fun and challenging tracks. The game has random map generation, different skill combinations. Win by reaching the finish line first.

name: Survivor Cells
short_description: Discover the beauty and fragility of life in Survivor Cells, a unique survival game against viruses and bacteria, which strategically combines the elements of roguelite, bullet hell and tower defense in a challenging experience. Your destiny depends on your agility and choices. How far will you get?

name: The Forgotten Village of Gondomayit
short_description: Kinan, a Yogyakarta native, became a civil servant and was posted to Gondomayit Village in remote Central Java. Here, electricity is scarce, and locals depend on traditional lighting. Evenings are quiet due to the lack of illumination.

name: Temporis Arts
short_description: Temporis Arts is Pretty Maniac Rhythm game with a circularly rotating Judgement Line! What you have to do in a spinning, sounding world is just - hit the notes in Tempo!

name: BULLCRAP!
short_description: Meet Bucky the bull and his crafty farmyard friends! Bullcrap is multiplayer turn-based bluffing card game. Race against your friends to offload your cards. Use wild cards to play dirty and change the rules!

name: Mayhem’s Adventure
short_description: The Mini 8-bit game! With lots of secrets...

name: Cleric and Goblins
short_description: 'Cleric and Goblins' is a VR action game where you rescue a Cleric from a dungeon filled with goblins. The procedurally generated dungeons offer infinite adventures, while the physics-based combat system provides engaging battles.

name: 天界异闻录
short_description: 《天界异闻录》是一款俯视角的暗黑类冒险游戏，讲诉主角在寻找宝物的途中揭开了一个关于人界，天界，暗域之间的巨大阴谋。

name: Text Adventure
short_description: Look at art, listen to jazz, and immerse yourself in the world of Joey Pawelko's Text Adventure.

name: The Castle Mystery
short_description: The Castle Mystery is a short first-person horror game where you step into the shoes of a historian who receives a tempting invitation to explore a long-abandoned castle. Drawn by the promise of a generous reward, you accept the offer without hesitation. Explore outcomes with three endings...

name: You Must Become A Lich
short_description: Prepare for the ultimate Coin Pusher experience in 'You Must Become A Lich.' Conquer epic bosses, customize your lich with Steam items, build a monstrous army, and siege lands. Rise to Lichdom and unleash your power in this captivating and visually customizable adventure.

name: Witching Hour
short_description: Witching Hour is a zombie wave shooter where you have to survive until the clock strikes 12. You are trapped inside the house while hordes of zombies attack you from every angle. Can YOU survive until witching hour?

name: Norwegian Jigsaw Puzzles
short_description: 'Explore Norway's beauty through captivating puzzles. From serene fjords to the Northern Lights, discover the magic of Norway!'

name: Only go up™
short_description: Get up there to avoid the rising water! It's scary, but you have to step up. It's up to you to adapt to reality or struggle.

name: The Winning Secret of the Newbie Strategist Princess
short_description: A neighboring country has declared war! The first war in a long time. Due to a shortage of personnel, Estelle, the princess, has taken command of the army. She can't afford to lose this war, but... What will she do, Estelle!?

name: Edge Of Survival
short_description: Escape to a relaxing, survival sandbox surrounded by wildlife and nature. Scavenge materials and craft tools to turn your base into a warm, well-supplied home. Survive by fishing, hunting, cooking, and growing your own food.

name: GARNOUILLE MUST LIVE!
short_description: Help Garnouille. In a magical world full of dangers, Garnouille, an intrepid frog, embarks on a quest to save his habitat from imminent destruction. To do this, Garnouille must navigate through levels riddled with deadly traps using his special “dash” ability.

name: LIMINAL PHASE
short_description: LIMINAL PHASE is a VR action horror game set in a parallel ‘90s. Fight malevolent monsters, solve peculiar puzzles, and explore the dark corners of a fractured mind consumed by video games.

name: Dreamscape Puzzles
short_description: The beauties are magically sealed in the picture and need warriors to rescue them. Warriors come and rescue the beauties and bring them home!!

name: Finding America: New England
short_description: Explore scenic landscapes, uncover hidden treasures, and immerse yourself in the rich history of this iconic region.

name: Slap Fight
short_description: Artificial intelligence threatens the galaxy. Buckle up and fight computing power with the only power that counts: FIREPOWER! Experience Toaplan's brain-melting Slap Fight (AKA Alcon) with its gauge-based power-ups and strategic gameplay. Now on PC with the latest features!

name: Mini Garden Cafe
short_description: Mini Garden Cafe is a cute and simple relaxation game where you make and sell coffee, bread, and plants to expand your shop and fill up a Dex.

name: Sandy's Great Escape
short_description: A crabby twist on the sokoban (box-pushing) genre, where you use deaths to create shells and solve puzzles.

name: 幽谷战域 Mystic Valley Battleground
short_description: Valley Battlefield is a casual adventure game where you explore various monsters or events to gain equipment and skills. By strategically upgrading equipment and matching skills, improving one's own attributes, defeating a powerful boss to achieve ultimate victory!

name: Clone Knights
short_description: Clone Knights is a platform game. Navigate across various platforms using high jumps and get to the end of the level to get to the next, much more difficult one. Lead your army to victory and watch your step, sire.

name: Adventures of Helio
short_description: In Adventures of Helio, you play as the young dragon, Helio, as he must battle and trek his way home before the sinister thief, El Ladron, does and steal his treasure! Play through 60 levels across six worlds, discover new powers, battle scary bosses, and collect treasure!

name: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Enjoy the End of the World
short_description: Turn-Based RPG set in post-Covid times where you take on an elite secret society that is depopulating the world using Saturnalian Monsters, Military, Hospital and Government personnel to conquer humanity. Satire/Parody/Comedy.

name: Squirrel Stapler
short_description: Hunt squirrels, staple them to a corpse, and meet god.

name: Kudos 2
short_description: Kudos is a turn-based game that puts you in control of a single character and manages their life from age 20 to 30. You get to pick their friends, their job, and how they spend their free time, but there is a catch! You can only choose to do one thing each day, or two at the weekends.

name: Secret Photo
short_description: The player plays as a photographer, owns a photography studio, and works with beautiful models to take photos according to the customized requirements of clients, in order to earn commission.

name: RETRIS
short_description: A fresh take on the the falling block puzzle genre. Embrace imperfection with glitches and broken pieces to overcome this new challenge. Chase high scores or learn new techniques in a puzzle mode with over 50 handcrafted puzzles.

name: Deep Space Solitude
short_description: 'Deep Space Solitude' is a first-person horror game. As a journalist, you investigate the disappearance of a scientist in a remote cabin, tackling puzzles, challenges, and fear to survive.

name: Cowpocalypse
short_description: An arcade style game, abduct cows to increase your score!

name: Knight vs Giant: The Broken Excalibur
short_description: Step into the greaves of King Arthur in this fantasy action roguelite and wield the Broken Excalibur in a quest to rescue the scattered citizens of Camelot, vanquish the calamitous Void Giant, and escape from the Astral Dimension once and for all.

name: Night Loops
short_description: Journey through the psyche… Welcome to the Seaside Hotel, where the final hour of your night shift awaits. Tend to guests, explore their dreams, and lose your sense of Self – time and again. In this dark, labyrinthine adventure, unravel the path to the truth below.

name: Heavy Duty Challenge®: The Off-Road Truck Simulator
short_description: Drive realistic trucks through challenging terrain and explore open world environments. Master your skills and win truck trial championships.​ Experience off-road driving like never before!

name: Savant - Ascent REMIX
short_description: A twin-stick shooter with a twist! Move between two platforms to survive this elevator ride through a robot-infested tower. Use magic and acrobatics to increase your power meter - and blast your way through the mechanical horde! The immortal Samurai awaits you at the top!

name: STSP: Super Titty Space Prison
short_description: STSP: Super Titty Space Prison is a fast fast-paced momentum based platformer with a high skill ceiling. Master bunny hopping, wall jumping, and slamming to defeat the prison and your friends!

name: Lizard Survivors: Battle for Hyperborea
short_description: They have launched an active invasion on our lands in late September this year, so let us break free of the slavic hand that held us by our balls for many ages! Rally all of our reptile militia, we will end this all together! LIZARDS, WE WILL NEVER BE SLAVES BUT WE WILL BE CONQUERORS!

name: We're Closed Sorry
short_description: We're closed sorry is a metroidvania in which the player controls both a titular hero traversing the interior of a retro supermarket store and the owner of the store. Immerse in an action-adventure while combating bugs, finding secrets, and becoming a dreamt hero.

name: Hidden World War II Top-Down 3D
short_description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

name: CRYMACHINA
short_description: CRYMACHINA is an action RPG where mechanical girls strive to survive in a post-apocalyptic world to become “Real Humans''. But what does it mean to be a “Real Human”?

name: Save City R
short_description: Introducing 'Save City R' – an adrenaline-pumping game where you take on the role of a courageous team of tank fighters on a mission to liberate the сity of R from the grips of the notorious criminal organization known as 'Shai Guu'.

name: Crop Rotation
short_description: Crop Rotation is a farming-theme card drafting game. Cards are played automatically so you can focus on the deck building and building synergies.

name: Stray Souls
short_description: Enter a world of nightmares in this third person, action-horror, inspired by the classics of the genre. Fight terrifying creatures, solve mind-bending puzzles, and unravel a horrid family secret to expose the chilling truth behind your existence.

name: Saltsea Chronicles
short_description: It begins with a kidnapped captain and a stolen ship. Where it leads next? That’s up to you… In this story-driven adventure game you will explore strange and wonderful communities, uncover a deep conspiracy, and chart a journey through twists and turns, difficulties and delights.

name: Anger Of Peace 5
short_description: Anger Of Peace 5 is a multiplayer/single player FPS combat game that supports up to 10V10 players in online battles, as well as offline single player games.

name: The Expanse: A Telltale Series
short_description: Take on the role of Camina Drummer and explore the dangerous, uncharted edges of the Belt. From scavenging wrecked ships in a zero-g environment, to combating fearsome pirates, you make the difficult choices in this latest Telltale adventure. All five episodes playable at launch!

name: THE JUSOU
short_description: 'THE JUSOU series', renowned as the most terrifying horror escape game in the history of smartphones, is now available on Steam! Many players have abandoned their games due to the sheer terror it instills! *Please play at your own risk if you experience any unusual phenomena after playing this game.

name: Dungeon's Legion
short_description: You have been reincarnated as the Demon Lord in another world! Can you lead your forces to victory?

name: Darker Skies: Remastered for PC
short_description: Darker Skies comes fully remastered to PC. Incorporating new graphical features and gameplay enhancements for the definitive way to play Darker Skies. Survival Horror set after the War of the Worlds.

name: Finite State Automaton Challenges
short_description: In this game, we will play with the simplest automaton model, Finite State Automaton, and use it to cope with 30 challenges.

name: Asagos
short_description: - 1916: The Canadian Parliament - As the Great War incites fear and suspicion, lead an investigation into the heart of Canada's government. But beware of who you trust. What lies within the depths casts a shadow upon the stars themselves.

name: Spells & Secrets
short_description: In this rogue-lite adventure, you free the Academy of Greifenstein from magical creatures by using your spells creatively. Explore this modern magical world alone or in local co-op mode with friends and family, customize your character, solve mysteries, and find powerful artifacts.

name: Daily Thread: The Sewing of Discontent
short_description: Henrietta is a seamstress in early industrial Manchester, enjoying Victorian age manufactory work. Relive your favorite moments from Dickens, Zola, and Marx, learn about the history of working conditions and worker rights and how they got where they are today, and think of where they could still go!

name: Listenbourg
short_description: Play a sci-fi turn-based strategy game while an AI threat the humanity. A VR experience allowing to discover the famous Listenbourg.

name: Age
short_description: This is a happy game.

name: Juna - The Dreamwalker
short_description: Immerse yourself in a captivating retro-style adventure. Utilize the transformative power of the rod to take on the appearance and abilities of monsters and objects. Unravel the dark origins of the monstrous invasion and discover the secrets behind the ancient portal.

name: Vasilisas Torment
short_description: Pass all the tests to free the soul of Vasilisa. But will you be able to do it and will you have enough skills to overcome the ingenious traps that the evil spirits set up.

name: Last Minute
short_description: Last Minute is a first person horrorgame.

name: Polylithic
short_description: The Polylithic is a 3rd person crafting survival set in the Paleolithic/Neolithic era where the player crafts items, unlocks technology, discovers the world, builds bases, and can either grow the tribe and command the settlement or play the game solo.

name: Max Capacity
short_description: Step into the high-pressure world of industry and unleash your inner factory tycoon with Max Capacity - the ultimate test of your strategic prowess and financial savvy.

name: EA SPORTS FC™ 24
short_description: EA SPORTS FC™ 24 welcomes you to The World’s Game: the most true-to-football experience ever with HyperMotionV, PlayStyles optimised by Opta, and an enhanced Frostbite™ Engine.

name: Dark Mysteries: The Soul Keeper Collector's Edition
short_description: Unravel the secret of Pawtuxet Island and face an evil necromancer in the hidden object adventure „Dark Mysteries: The Soul Keeper“!

name: Roll me Home
short_description: Roll the character with the rudder and jump. As usual, it's a space bar It has simple manipulation, but it's not going to be an easy challenge Understand the physics of things and explore the silhouette.

name: Air Twister
short_description: Take flight with Air Twister - the new all-out rail shooter by legendary arcade developer Yu Suzuki! Similar to Suzuki’s massively successful Space Harrier series, you will encounter a large array of diverse and creatively designed enemies and challenging bosses.

name: Gold Rush Clicker
short_description: Dive into 'Gold Rush Clicker,' an idle clicker game where you start as a novice miner. Tap to mine gold, buy upgrades, and face strategic challenges. With procedurally generated levels, stunning graphics, and Steam achievements, it's an endless journey to become the ultimate mining tycoon!

name: High Strategy: Oradros
short_description: High Strategy: Oradros is a minimalist grand strategy game set in an original, low-fantasy world of hoplites and dinosaurs. There is no micromanagement, only decisions. All 40 playable realms have distinct starting conditions and goals.

name: Sprout Valley
short_description: Sprout Valley is farming simulator game where you can step back from the busy life and grow the garden of your dreams. Captivating story, hand-crafted experience, cute graphics and many more!

name: Black Spire
short_description: 'Black Spire' is a side-scrolling action-adventure game. You will control a brave warrior to experience a unique souls-like combat series, which features simple controls yet offers rich gameplay. Hone your combat skills and unveil the secrets hidden in the depths of the spire!

name: Homebound Haerold
short_description: On one really bad day of his own vicious cycle. On his way home, Little Haerold's car breaks down in the bad part of town. And then he breaks down, in the violent way. Now Haerold is Homebound and Postal.

name: AstroRunner
short_description: AstroRunner - 3D runner game, in which you control a self-driving robot to safely collect scattered solar panels from a remote location. Collect as many parts as possible and increase the mileage of your pedometer.

name: The Sheriff's Town
short_description: The Sheriff's Town is a game where you control a sheriff to exterminate hordes of zombies.

name: The Territory of Egg
short_description: The Territory of Egg is a unique twist on tower defense game. You need to build defense lines with egg warriors to protect the Holy Egg, the core of all eggs. Remember to upgrade your Tech Tree with the resources you've collected and unlock more skills to fight against the evil monsters.

name: Devil Seeds
short_description: Explore a ghost island dominated by mystical creatures. This game offers an experience that mixes horror and RPG, allowing you to explore every dark corner, solving puzzles, finding files and meeting strange characters.

name: EGG DROP
short_description: Flutter around to dodge falling eggs from chickens above, and collect corn and power ups to drop eggs on the unlucky fowl below!

name: Jump'n'Brawl
short_description: Fight with your friends in this fast-paced brawler mixed with a platform game, where lovely 2D pixel art meets stunning visual effects. Choose a character and use its super-powers to defeat your opponents (up to 4 players).

name: Dungeon 3D
short_description: The ultimate 3D Virtual Tabletop, Dungeon 3D is light-weight, incredibly easy to use, and extremely robust. It has everything you could possibly need to run full sessions, create gorgeous 3D maps, access character sheets, initiative, dice rolling, animated and customizable avatars, and so much more!

name: Charm Match-Up
short_description: Want to conquer a beautiful boss and take a beautiful woman home? Want to win the favor of beautiful boos? Come on, all kinds of beauties waiting for you to conquer!

name: Idol VS Furries
short_description: Survive to Furries, and Farm Skins, in stylized gunfights

name: Hell Grinder
short_description: An intense 2D action rogue-lite game. Fight your way level by level through masses of demons and defeat bosses to delve deeper into hell. Collect demon souls to unlock permanent skills and weapons and become even more powerful.

name: 神様ノ筐庭
short_description: 'God's Miniature Garden' is a horror game where you can freely explore a residential area at night, both indoors and outdoors, and aim to capture each location. Find out what the heck is going on in this area!

name: Phantom Rose 2 Sapphire
short_description: Phantom Rose 2 is a roguelike deckbuilding game. Fight and collect powerful cards as Aria, trying to survive in her cherished school that’s being ravaged by evil creatures.

name: 星火
short_description: 可以自由搭配无人机机体和武器，采集、研发建造设施的俯视射击游戏

name: Entity: The Black Day
short_description: Entity: The Black Day is an action and psychological horror game with a long psychological story The game is developed on Unreal Engine

name: Wild Card Football
short_description: Arcade Football for Everyone!

name: Baby Time Simulator
short_description: Escape the busy daily grind and become a baby again! The ultimate game for recapturing the pure joy of babyhood that everyone has forgotten.

name: Truth of Beauty Witch -Marine's treasure ship-
short_description: A miraculous collaboration between Houshou Marine and 'Tsugunohi' has come to fruition! When the main character becomes a crew member of a pirate ship led by Houshou Marine and realizes a certain fact, you are struck by a series of horrors. Can you unravel the secret behind Houshou Marine's beauty?

name: SNAKE FARM
short_description: A top-down action roguelike about buying snakes, fighting them, selling their oil, and buying more snakes. Upgrade your weapons, get stronger snakes to fight, and chase down a high score with only ten days to live.

name: Tricky Typing
short_description: Compete against your friends in this Absolutely Ridiculous Typing game! Using every single button on your controller (and then some), your typing skills will be put to the TEST as you type out each letter to compete in this Extravaganza >:)

name: Dark Year
short_description: Dark Year medieval fantasy game with a dark air, embark on this adventure as Marius, a commander of the army of the northern kingdom, who must return to the castle his journey will be full of enemies and an evil that never sleeps awaits him... You will be able to face them.

name: Secret of the Vikings 2 - The World Tree
short_description: Inexplicable disasters haunt the Vikings. Help Valkyrie Fenja and Raven Yorin rebuild the destroyed village and find out what is behind the mysterious events.

name: Super Double Dragon
short_description: Super Double Dragon rises again! Now with new features such as customizable wallpapers and speed options!

name: Maeldor: Quest Of The Artifact
short_description: Ready for an adventure? A RPG inspired handcrafted story-driven action-adventure platformer! Control a fellowship of 3 heroes as they travel to Mount Trumnor! Discover a magical world, fight your enemies, upgrade your heroes, find treasures, meet locals and be part of an epic quest to save Maeldor!

name: At the Dream End 2 - Beyond Gods
short_description: How does one confront the unfathomable horror of knowing too much, of peering into the abyss and finding a reflection of their own insignificance? Story-driven point-and-click adventure game with tons of lore and intriguing concepts about the universe, bio-experiments, and life itself.

name: Xaphan - Battle Simulator
short_description: Xaphan is a third person shooter mixed with sandbox battle simulator featuring zombies, huge insects, medieval knights, animals and monsters.

name: World Spin
short_description: Simple and satisfying! Unwind your mind with this new brain training puzzle action game!

name: BIRD BALL
short_description: BIRD BALL!! You scream out and all your friends rush to their computers to fire up the next big thing in online multiplayer video game entertainment. Play with friends or alone and spawn in some friendly bird compatriots to play with or against. The aim is to score goals and have fun in the sandbox.

name: Arise from Shadows
short_description: Lost, isolated, you must find the truth by exploring the remains of an ancient extinct civilization. With your animal possession abilities, you have all the tools to find the answers to your questions.

name: 終わりの鐘が鳴る前に Chapter.2
short_description: 「邂逅と追憶の果てに辿り着く未来」 前作から季節は変わり秋になる。死神の条件のために主人公、長谷部涼平は文化祭・修学旅行のイベントで菅野を幸せにしようと右往左往する…そこで、彼もまた過去に向き合うことになる。本作のテーマは「家族」、Chapter.1から大幅にボリュームアップしたChapter.2開幕！

name: eseala
short_description: As Eseala, you navigate misty cliffs and forgotten pockets of time, uncovering knowledge of the past, present and future.

name: Bob the Elementalist
short_description: The magical power of the elements is our last hope for survival! Master the four elements if you want to survive.

name: Foxcrate
short_description: In this casual delivery roguelite game, you are the newest employee of Foxcrate, and must deliver all the packages on time, with an increasing number of packages and extra difficulties added each day.

name: Mary Skelter Finale
short_description: The last installment of the dungeon-crawling RPG trilogy reaches its stunning conclusion! Will the Blood Maidens finally get their happily ever after?

name: Slaughter: The Lost Outpost
short_description: Slaughter: The Lost Outpost is a single player campaign third-person shooter, with a large arsenal of weapons, crowds of various enemies and difficult locations, concealing many secrets.

name: Sundermead
short_description: Sundermead is an open-world, casual RPG where you can build a farm to live peacefully out in the wilderness with your friends. Beware though, there is more to this land than first meets the eye!

name: Myths of Rules
short_description: This is a text-based adventure puzzle game, where you must struggle to survive in a world filled with ghosts and urban legends. While collecting clues, you'll uncover the truth behind the world and find the way out. The game features a wealth of levels, unconventional rules, and a touch of horror.

name: Snow Blocks 2
short_description: In the game you will find many levels of varying difficulty and different blocks that you have to destroy! Read the game from start to finish, solving interesting puzzles! Whether you can walk this path depends only on you!

name: The Egg
short_description: You always wanted to be an egg or maybe you just want to know how an egg lives? Then you can now with 'The Egg'.

name: Stump Simulator
short_description: Stump Simulator is a game in which you can become a tree stump.

name: BlockJump
short_description: BlockJump is a difficult platformer game with the idea that you replay sections of the game to try and beat it faster with each attempt. There are various ways to beat almost every level and some routes require you to master the mechanics of the game to beat them in quick succession.

name: ReLinked
short_description: 'ReLinked' is a pixelated Rogue-lite Action/PRG in a Sovietpunk setting in which you'll have to fight back against extraterrestrial intelligence and fend off countless waves of enemies!

name: Awakened
short_description: The world has never been the same ever since the outbreak happened.

name: Evil Snowmen 2
short_description: Evil Snowmen 2 - This is an improved port of the mobile game with a nice winter atmosphere and evil enemies snowmen. The game is not long, the average passage of the story will take about 30 minutes.

name: Streamer Girl Simulator
short_description: Streamer Girl Simulator is a fun and exciting simulation game where players can create their own streaming career for their custom streamer girl character.

name: Little Dasher!
short_description: Little Dasher! is a mini-game that offers an average of 30-45 minutes of enjoyable and challenging platform game experience with fantastic music. Please note that the time depends on your reflexes and abilities.

name: Bomb Crossing
short_description: The monster has captured the maids. Dear brothers, please act urgently! Use bombs as weapons to blow up all the monsters guarding you to save these lovely maids.

name: Thunder Ray
short_description: Thunder Ray is Arcade-Boxing, Retro-like gameplay with blood and violence. Defeat all the best fighters in the galaxy to become the GOAT of the universe.

name: Tilted
short_description: Tilted is a psychedelic platformer with abstract visuals, accessible to all fans of the genre. There is no health or lives to worry about, only time, as you slowly ascend to unknown heights. Don't go too fast though, or you may fall and be set back! This game was made with speed running in mind...

name: Adventurer Farmer: Save my son!
short_description: 2D PLATFORMER where you DON'T walk or jump. Become strong! MASTER PHYSICS with the rope, COLLECT all the fruits to PROGRESS, gain LIVES and OPEN NEW PATHS. 💪 SURVIVE all the dangers of the journey and SAVE THE BOY!

name: MiLu MiLan
short_description: 'MiLu MiLan'is a casual game of architectural maze exploration and puzzle solving.

name: The Kindeman Remedy
short_description: The most blasphemous, diabolical and insane management game ever created. Aided by a lascivious nun in a grim prison, rig executions, conduct horrid experiments and do the unspeakable to cook up your cure-all: The Kindeman Remedy. Do not be afraid. This time, you're the monster.

name: The Castle
short_description: Do you enjoy listening to stories and having the ability to influence their unfolding? If so, then immerse yourself in the role of an active participant as you join Yaren on her quest for freedom.

name: Ducky Bouncy
short_description: Cotton was swimming in the river one day when a lone duckling swam past. It got lost. Set yourself up for a beautiful journey to help Cotton return its friend to its family.

name: Forest Football
short_description: Car football game with multiplayer.

name: All-Ways Up
short_description: Dive into a world where the ground betrays and the only way is up. 'AllWaysUp' is a thrilling Jump and Run adventure set against a backdrop of mystery: why must humanity constantly ascend? Master your moves, uncover the story, and support my main game's journey with every leap you take.

name: Talented
short_description: Slay waves of spooky enemies for 20 nights to survive 'The Demonic Conveyor Belt'. Talented is an arcade roguelite with randomly generated skill trees. Choose your upgrades and abilities wisely and you might just make it out alive. Are you truly Talented?

name: Polimines 2
short_description: Polimines 2 is the sequel to Polimines, a challenging logic game that combines Nonograms and Minesweeper mechanics. All levels are designed by hand so that guessing is never necessary.

name: Filly Astray
short_description: A platforming adventure game with a new take on combos, dare you adventure into the world of Filly Astray and face the monsters and mayhem within?!

name: BRAVE22 -ブレイブ22-
short_description: 2Dタイプのシューティングゲーム。VC++で白紙から完全手打ちで自力のみで約1万行のプログラムを組んで作成。グラフィックも音楽もオリジナル。見事！新型機ブレイブ22で、敵惑星をせん滅することが出来るのか！？

name: Manus Dei
short_description: Wield the holy weapon Manus Dei and annihilate creatures from the Rift in this fast-paced shooter. Only your skill will grant you passage into the halls of eternity.

name: Set Off Fireworks Together
short_description: Set off fireworks together, here you can experience a different feeling, you can create as much as you like in the game, combine fireworks, and pursue the taste of childhood!

name: Two Hour Escape Mystery: A Puzzling Voyage
short_description: You're trapped on a strange ship! To escape, you must solve puzzles, explore unique rooms, meet a couple interesting characters, and uncover a mystery to figure out why you're here. Who knows, you may even stop something bad from happening along the way… Bon voyage!

name: Rally Rock 'N Racing
short_description: Get ready to skid around at full speed with your family and friends!

name: Flunky Farm
short_description: The big bad guy, has been captured by the neighborhood hero, now, it's up to his clever kid to plan a 'rescue' mission with the help of some not-so-serious helpers, you! Prove yourself in the Kid's arena, kick, dodge, and toss your rivals out of the ring to become the champ!

name: Radio Silent
short_description: You're a marine that just latched onto a ship that went radio silent for 10 years after entering a wormhole in space. Battle hoards of aliens, upgrade your arsenal, and collect audio logs to discover the chilling history of the ship you've boarded.

name: Loot and Shoot
short_description: Loot and Shoot is a dungeon crawler 2D platformer action roguelite. Travel through various procedurally generated lands, battle challenging enemies, and collect diverse resources to expand your city and unlock new weapons. Avoid lava and carve your own path to the top as everything is destructible.

name: Click Click Click
short_description: The most simple idle clicker game. Are you able to reach the one octillion value? Buy upgrades and use prestige system to achieve the goal! Fun and relaxation are included

name: Chez Croggy
short_description: Chef Croggy, AKA Croggster, AKA Croggison, is on the trip of a lifetime! Get ready for a gruesome, and rage inducing experience as you run, jump, and push your way through the wacky physics and camera angles Chez Croggy has to offer.

name: Car Parking Real Driving Sim
short_description: Build the vehicle of your dreams in this parking game full of realistic details and challenging missions! Complete missions now, earn rewards and get your dream vehicle.

name: FINIS
short_description: FINIS is a puzzle game with a difference, we create a psychological evaluation based on your choices. Each universe offers a different experience, terror, calm, destruction, war, progress... You can choose between 8 completely different paths and each path will take you to a unique ending.

name: Pigments
short_description: Be a fruit locked in a room, dodge circular saws and paint as much of the level as you can.

name: Paranormal Files: Trials of Worth Collector's Edition
short_description: Paranormal detective Rick Rogers is on the case after two archeologists from the same expedition are found catatonic, but the real mystery has only begun!

name: Run For Exodus
short_description: You find yourself in a zombie apocalypse in our RUN FOR EXODUS game specially designed for VR. Alone, wield weapons with real-life moves and explore a post-apocalyptic world in virtual reality. Get rid of these dead with the quests.

name: Dragon's Ruler
short_description: This is a single-player, turn-based strategy war game set in a fantasy world. With over 140 different units, strategize to maintain a balance between governance and military strength as you aim for territorial expansion!

name: SleepWalk
short_description: Sleepwalk is an indie survival horror game, the story begins with the player waking up in an unknown and dark place, trying to escape and discover hidden secrets with no memory of their arrival.

name: Galvanic Bride
short_description: Feel the intenseness of stealth in the eerie great mansion of Frankenstein. Play Bride, Frankenstein’s creation, Perfect yet incomplete. Use electric interactions and skills to overcome challenges in your style. Think and struggle through the intertwining conspiracy, and resolve in your own ending.

name: Jabuti Adventures
short_description: Jabuti Adventures is a platform game about a turtle, whose basket of eggs disappeared due to a brief oversight, and now she needs your help to get them back.

name: Sky Hunter
short_description: Who can become a monster-fighting warrior? I heard that young ladies like such warriors.

name: Frayspace
short_description: Fraypace is a local multiplayer top-down space arena shooter for up to 4...8 players. Choose your fighter, select your weapons, and enjoy the fast-paced and physics-based action with friends or AIs in fully destructible maps.

name: Twofold
short_description: In a bid to avoid failing out of college, Olive Penn inadvertently finds themselves caught in the middle of a feud between two campus club leaders whose rivalry seemingly threatens to tear their friendship apart.

name: Isekai Rondo
short_description: Quest for a parallel universe after being reborn with the ultimate job!

name: Sudoku Symphony
short_description: Want to dance with a beautiful woman? Come to the challenge, use your wisdom to solve the puzzle step by step, enjoy the gorgeous light of beautiful pictures!

name: Terracards
short_description: Farm, sell, learn, repeat. Terracards is a tactical roguelike-deckbuilder where you manage your own farm, You'll utilize animals, crops, and structures through cards, transforming them into valuable resources and wealth with each turn. But beware - deplete your funds, and it's game over.

name: 异星孤垒
short_description: 无穷无尽的怪物正向你涌来，而你所能依靠的仅仅只有一座最后的堡垒，用你的智慧活下去吧，直到击败最后的黑暗！《异星孤垒》是一款科幻主题的策略向rouge游戏，玩家可以从9条科技树近百种科技中自由选择组合，利用9个体验迥异的角色完成不同的挑战来追求最终的胜利。

name: Idle Blocks
short_description: Idle clicker game with simple but really addictive gameplay. Destroy endless blocks and proceed as far as you can. Complex prestige system and upgrades with endless possibilities and pure fun

name: BastogneBreakout
short_description: Hex, Counter and Card simlation of the battles around Bastogne during the Battle of the Bulge in 1944. You play against yourself or play as Germans against Allied AI. Units are regiments, battalions and kampfgruppen. New Supply procedures make the Germans keep an eye out on the road network.

name: Sebil Engineering
short_description: Sebil Engineering is a game about fixing roads. Use your wrench and hammer to engineer the perfect traffic jam. Play in overhead view or first person in this realistic Civil Engineering simulator.

name: Cyber Knights: Flashpoint
short_description: Squad tactics heist RPG! Clever stealth, strategic combat, unique 23rd-century cyberpunk. Build your crew of hackers, mercs and malcontents wisely; their stories will become interwoven with your own. Use powerful cyberware, faction connections, and more to outsmart the odds & determine your future.

name: Agatha Christie - Murder on the Orient Express
short_description: Step on board the legendary Orient Express and immerse yourself in the most famous detective suit in a race against the clock to unmask the murderer.

name: Stellario
short_description: In a large star field, the Spirit flies around and absorbs stars to build up mass and take on a different appearance. But you have to be careful on the journey - there are black holes scattered around the field, and also spaceships flying at unthinkable speeds.

name: Train Sim World® 4
short_description: Feel the power of simulation in your hands. Experience immense velocity and express unrivalled creativity with Train Sim World 4! Expand your rail hobby and discover the raw emotion of driving a diverse array of iconic routes and trains. From training center to mountain pass, this is your journey.

name: Dirty Wars: September 11
short_description: Historical indie videogame about the suburbs of the Cold War in South America.

name: 武林立志傳
short_description: ◆ 巧妙搭配各大派“武功秘笈”，練就獨步武林之絕世神功 ◆ 創新仇恨值戰鬥系統，重視團隊分工的作戰技巧 ◆ 可改變的裝備屬性的合成系統 ◆ 網狀式的關卡設計與多樣化的分歧路線，故事結局由你決定！◆ STEAM版本加強功能！

name: 破碎之家
short_description: 奇怪的妈妈，强权的爸爸，究竟如何才能离开这个地方...

name: MythForce
short_description: Step into a Saturday Morning Cartoon! Adventure through crypts and castles with your friends in this First-person Melee Roguelike.

name: Run or Die
short_description: Embark on an adventure across multiple worlds in this dynamic 3D platformer! Utilize the BunnyHOP ability to leap through obstacles, face unique challenges, and uncover hidden secrets. Fun and excitement are guaranteed with every jump!

name: Launcher Heroes
short_description: Launcher Heroes is a tactical, artillery, party game where you try to knock your opponents off the world. Use an assortment of items such as bombs, rockets, and jetpacks to help you navigate and destroy the terrain.

name: Hokkaido Game
