short_description: This is a physics puzzle game in which you build Hokkaido by piling up prefectures of Japan. You become a 'big person' and drop prefectures into a box. Connected same prefectures will evolve into a larger prefecture! Create the largest prefecture in Japan, Hokkaido, before the box overflows!

name: Tower of Pandemonium
short_description: Tower of Pandemonium is a top-down RPG and 2D platformer where your choices determine your fate, featuring 6 guilds, 6 classes, action, puzzles, mystery and memorable characters.

name: Underground Blossom
short_description: Underground Blossom is a new adventure game by Rusty Lake. Fulfil various tasks at every station to find the metro that will take you through each important event from Laura Vanderboom's life.

name: Powerful DABL
short_description: Powerful DABL is an action roguelike, find yourself in a snowy location, go through corridors filled with enemies, and only by destroying all the monsters can you move forward!

name: Bright Day
short_description: You awaken to a bright and sunny day. Wanting to go out and enjoy the beauty of the sun, you find that mysteriously, you can't leave. The doors are locked. No one is home. Strange noises can be heard behind your shoulder. Can you survive the nightmare slowly forming around you?

name: Hazardous
short_description: Hazardous is a crafting-survival game where you explore cyberpunk and biopunk worlds.

name: Worldless
short_description: Worldless is a stylised 2D platformer with a unique, active, turn-based combat system, and a mind-bending interpretative narrative. Players embark on a journey of self-growth and understanding, pushing the limits of their nature in a newly born and abstract universe.

name: Midnight Prowl
short_description: Midnight Prowl is a horror exploration game set in a Japanese town, where you will experience the horror that takes place there.

name: Galactic Heroes: Rise of the Black Alliance
short_description: Embark on a perilous journey as Max, the space ranger, to hunt down the leaders of the Black Alliance. Pilot different spacecraft, dodge asteroids, battle enemies, and confront ruthless leaders. Become a true hero of space!

name: Embrace of the Downpour
short_description: 'Embrace of the Downpour' is a psychological horror experience set in a lonely apartment, where you face an unexpected series of events. Can you handle the unfolding madness?

name: G-MODEアーカイブス49 グレゴリーホラーショー
short_description: Use the abilities of the terrifyingly cute guests, Escape from the mysterious 'Gregory House' hotel...

name: Lucky Hero
short_description: 'Lucky Hero' is a Roguelike symbol-building game. Your weapons and equipment have transformed into symbols, and by spinning the Wheel of Fortune, you will face various powerful enemies. This game offers a vast array of symbols and character skills for players to explore and combine.

name: Six Meat Under
short_description: Embark on a thrilling journey through the eyes of a security gate officer who must face super-biological horrors beyond both knowledge and comprehension in this first-person shooter styled after old PS2 game graphics.

name: Snow Fortress 2
short_description: Dive into a VR winter wonderland! Build your own icy fortresses, engage in epic snowball battles, and defend your village from an army menacing snowmen. Stay Frosty!

name: Stoneman's Adventure
short_description: Enter an island full of puzzles and secrets as a stoneman and explore by harnessing the power to generate and manipulate stones. The gameplay is a unique combination of sokoban and one-line drawing.

name: Ball Breaker
short_description: Create crazy combinations and crush all the insects by taking out balls with various effects and improving your powers. Survive as long as you can and make the wildest molecules you can. With each round, you get stronger, but so do your enemies...

name: Good fruit
short_description: This is a simple casual game. The main content is to cut off various fruits that constantly pop up on the screen, which requires players to move quickly and accurately. Once the bomb is cut, the game ends.

name: Brawl Tactics: Origins
short_description: Brawl Tactics: Origins fuses deck-building roguelikes and the tactics RPG genre like never before - lead your units, collect valuable trinkets and cast powerful spells to ensure victory!

name: NINJA KIDZ: TIME MASTERS
short_description: America's most popular online ninja family's first video game is here! NINJA KIDZ: TIME MASTERS is a colourful action adventure for the whole family where you can play alone or together with friends. Rescue the 3 greatest martial arts masters kidnapped by Dr. Disaster.

name: 12 Angry Hours
short_description: Play as a clock and survive twelve waves of formidable enemies in this shoot 'em up roguelite where every second counts.

name: Detective Montgomery Fox: The Case of the Missing Ballerinas
short_description: A Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure Game - Detective Montgomery Fox is back in the Case of the Missing Ballerinas and he's ready to solve another thrilling mystery!

name: War Of Being
short_description: War of Being is a single-player VR sci-fi adventure with standard mode playability, based on the music and concept for TesseracT's 2023 full length album. Explore 'The Strangeland' filled with surreal landscapes and characters. Solve puzzles and find hidden objects that unlock TesseracT's new music.

name: Halloween Pinball
short_description: Prepare for this night of horror with the most entertaining Pinball!

name: The Paper Aircraft of Childhood
short_description: How far can a childhood paper airplane fly.?

name: Game Collector
short_description: Become the ultimate game collector in this time management simulation/strategy game! Beat minigames for money, relax by playing your games, develop strategies to balance money and fun. Begin your journey to become a legendary game collector!

name: Chicken Done
short_description: The more stressful anti-stress game that eleven out of ten psychologists advice against. Dangerously addictive for neurodivergent people.

name: Replik Survivors
short_description: This game is a time survival game with role-playing and roguelite elements. Through the choice of upgrades in battle to make the character stronger and stronger, defeat the oncoming enemies.

name: The Sleep Experiment
short_description: Experience the horrors of one of the most infamous experiments that ever took place. As a test subject in a top-secret Soviet research facility, you must endure days without sleep while facing unimaginable terrors that lurk in the shadow.

name: Doodle Taxi
short_description: Doodle Taxi is a Zen-like taxi driving experience in a paper world! Why doodle-like? Don't question my artistic vision. You can figure out that by game's story. If you missed early 2000s open world car games, this one is for you.

name: Antipsychotic
short_description: This nonlinear, immersive docu-music album aims to help destigmatize mental illness by allowing the user to journey through the mind of an individual with bipolar disorder.

name: Revenguard
short_description: Evil creatures took your dog! They have taken over the kingdom and are threatening all the inhabitants. Can you pass the obstacles, uncover all the secrets and save them?

name: Get Them Boats: Orca Revenge
short_description: You are an orca, a killer whale, out for revenge against the elites mucking up your waters. Attack the rudders, and eat the rich!

name: The Impossible Tower
short_description: In Impossible Tower, a young boy with no particular skill has been transported back to the Medieval Times by a clumsy wizard. There he will find lots of adventures and fun while trying to reach the tower top in order to escape this zombie-infested and full-of-magic world!

name: 911: Prey
short_description: Search items and solve puzzles to escape from the cannibal's plate. Cover up your tracks so that the maniac does not suspect anything.

name: The knight's path
short_description: Based on the classic Peg Solitaire game with a variety of levels and scenarios, and one goal: find the princess! Unravel ancient riddles, take a journey through forgotten lands and find the knight's way to his lady. Will you be the champion?

name: No Sun To Worship
short_description: A short, minimalist stealth-action game about the importance of art. We painted the sky ashen gray. Burned the heavens to starve each other. Now we walk an endless cemetery of regret.

name: Fellowship
short_description: Embark on a heroic journey in Fellowship, a captivating action-roguelite game. Assemble a party of unique heroes, master their movements, and enhance their abilities through crafted items in an enthralling medieval fantasy world.

name: Webventure
short_description: Webventure is a enchanting two-player co-op game. Join cute spiders on an extraordinary journey. Collaborate, spin webs, and overcome challenges together. Unleash creativity, build a strong bond.

name: HotDog TD
short_description: This is an awesome Tower Defense game that you need to protect the world from Alien 's invasion

name: Save the settlers
short_description: This is a tower defense game in which you have to defend a settlement from bloodthirsty creatures.

name: Run Tank Run
short_description: Drive your tank, blast everything blocking your way, and rush forward with exhilaration.

name: Sea of Brave: Aidan Adventure
short_description: Sea of Brave - Aidan Adventure is an action-adventure platform game, explore the different levels of Figon Island to discover its mysteries, find treasures, challenges and new skills. Confront and defeat Captain Skull's fearsome pirate crew that has enslaved the island.

name: Jewel Legends: Atlantis
short_description: In the Match-3 game 'Jewel Legends - Atlantis' you have to discover the secrets of Atlantis and repair the magnificent city! Build rows of three or more symbols - you will have huge chains built before you know it! Collect ancient artifacts and secret treasures that you can use to build your city.

name: 意识空间
short_description: Awareness Space is a 3D action role-playing game where players will battle various bizarre monsters in the consciousness world, cooperate with the reclusive Merry to search for rare energy bodies, and gradually approach the truth behind the consciousness world.

name: Escape From Mystwood Mansion
short_description: In this first-person puzzle escape room game, you are trapped in the mysterious Mystwood mansion. Explore the mansion and find hidden compartments while solving puzzles and deciphering codes to find a way out. Will you escape or linger to uncover the mansion's final secret?

name: Depthris
short_description: Depthris is a 3D puzzle game inspired by the classic BlockOut game for DOS. Move and rotate the pieces almost anywhere (except backwards) and aim for the highest score.

name: Unearth
short_description: Dig for the bones of your creators in this mashup of Bomberman, Digdug, and Lemmings.

name: Hero Planter
short_description: Hero Planter is a new game experience in the farm simulation genre. Forget about that quiet corner in the back yard! In the dark dungeons, alone with cunning pests you will have to make every effort to grow crops and stay alive. One hero, one life, 100 unpredictable floors!

name: Zombie Survivor: Undead City Attack
short_description: Dive into Zombie Survivor: Undead City Attack – a retro FPS on-rails shooter. Roam iconic cities - NYC, London, Rio - against mad zombies. Wield pistols and rifles, strategize for scores and medals. Embrace 90s visuals, defend humanity in this nightmare!

short_description: Experience an explosive and nerve-wracking adventure! Eliminate other players, strategically use bombs, collect power-ups, and survive to earn trophies. The first player to reach the required number of trophies wins the game. Are you ready to triumph as the last survivor? Let's go!

name: Below the Stone
short_description: Below the Stone is a pixel-art roguelike about dwarves on the quest for the deepest depths. A place where each and every descent will lead to new adventures -- and where only the most determined dwarves with many lost lives will be rewarded by the hidden world lying below the stone.

name: Lost Oath
short_description: A Souls-like platformer with Roguelike elements

name: subpar pool
short_description: A whimsical adventure of playful pocket antics at the intersection of golf and pool, from the developer behind holedown, twofold inc & rymdkapsel.

name: Desktop Girlfriend NEO
short_description: A girlfriend-themed desktop pet game that allows deep customization of character appearance, with built-in reminder function, mini-games, Steam workshop, and interactive features!

name: Risk of Rain Returns
short_description: Carefully designed, beautifully remastered, and loaded with new ways to play—Risk of Rain is back and better than ever! Dive into the iconic roguelike full of unique loot combinations, enhanced with new Survivors, overhauled multiplayer, fan favorite content from Risk of Rain 2, and more!

name: Downstairs
short_description: Developed and published by Levienze Games, this game is a short story based horror and thriller game.

name: Around the World: Travel to Brazil
short_description: AviGames presents the first game in the series 'Around the World: Travel to Brazil'. Go on a trip to the sights of Brazil, search for various objects, play exciting mini-games and collect souvenirs.

name: Goddess Detective 3
short_description: < Goddess Detective It is a sequel to the second film. Let you feel the game better with an immersive experience. If you really like puzzle games. This is a very good casual moment game.

name: Apocalypse Run!
short_description: Apocalypse Run... Apocalypse Fun! A Roguelike-Strategy-RPG with guitars and cats, and lots of car battles— and very little Florida.

name: Multiplayer Drone Simulator
short_description: Take part in breathtaking drone simulation in a realistic city with Multiplayer Drone Simulator! Enjoy the freedom in free mode, test your skills in levels, and drive drones with players worldwide.

name: Mow VR: Challenge Your Limits
short_description: Mow VR is a wave-based simple shooting game. If you want to enjoy a casual VR shooting game, this game is perfect for you! No need to reload, just keep on defeating the oncoming enemies. It's so exhilarating. Defeat the enemies, earn stars, unlock weapons, and challenge your limits!

name: Real Motocross Driving Simulator
short_description: Get the real Motocross driving experience! Complete exciting missions, earn rewards and unlock new motorcycles.

name: Cryptower
short_description: Welcome to the world of Cryptower! In this captivating tower defense game, creativity and strategy intertwine. Develop your unique talents, enhance tower parameters, and unlock powerful abilities to defeat endless waves of enemies. Become a master of defense and protect your world

name: Inspector Gadget - MAD Time Party
short_description: Go Go Gadget! Become the famous Inspector Gadget and have fun with your friends in this brand-new adventure!

name: Grey Area
short_description: A tough platformer following a girl diving over the heads of terrifying creatures and bouncing off walls to traverse a mysterious, unsettling world that's so much bigger than her: the 'world between all worlds'

name: Polygon Fantasy Battle Simulator
short_description: Welcome to Polygon Fantasy Battle Simulator, the most colorful medieval fantasy battle simulator in existence! Throw tens of thousands of soldiers into battle, enjoy the show, or take direct control of one of them to prove your valor!

name: SUPER 56
short_description: SUPER 56 challenges players to overcome 56 genre-bending mini-games with the press of a single button. Compete in daily challenges, earn achievements, and destroy high scores. Outlandish chaos awaits you in Hell!

name: The Infernal Masquerade
short_description: The Infernal Masquerade is a gothic horror PS2 -inspired take on the classic minesweeper game, along with additional hints on the hidden undead, that make it more up to the player's skill to find the vampires behind the venetian masks.

name: Living Cell
short_description: You are the liquidator survived the samosbor in block G-326 of the endless Gigakhrushchyovka. You have to find out what happened in this block, evacuate the residents and find a way out for yourself. But is everything as simple as it seems at first glance?

name: Zoo Park Story
short_description: Well, what are you waiting for? Build a top-ranking zoo, set social media ablaze, and show the world your wild side!

name: The No-Name Project
short_description: Welcome to 'The No-Name Project,' where limitless freedom awaits! Adopt various characters, from animals to NPCs, even resurrecting them with necromancy. Explore, mine, and interact with the world's secrets. Frequent updates ensure endless adventures!

name: Intruders
short_description: Intruders is a survival horror / strategy game where you get kidnapped and in order to save your life you will need to survive five nights. Use camera system and environment to defend yourself against different intruders.

name: Edge of War
short_description: Edge of War delivers an isometric, turn-based CRPG where the world reacts to you. All side quests are main quests, as every decision matters and impacts the fate of the Northlands. Explore and complete missions, but keep your heroes on their toes: the wilds do not forgive.

name: Aery - Flow of Time
short_description: Enjoy a combat-free journey through colorful worlds! Lean back and enjoy the scenery as a little bird in search for a cure in different eras of timw! A great game for relaxing and calming down after an exhausting day.

name: Sunbeam
short_description: A garden-themed 2D RPG which tackles the struggle of problem-solving in an uncomfortable and unknown place. Solve and explore your way across this dark landscape to uncover the truth behind your visit, meeting a familiar face to keep you company.

name: ! Shakabula *
short_description: A South African urban legend called the Shakabula traps you in your house, could it be connected to your problematic past? You will need to find a way out of this horrendous curse. Creepy FMV+2D Art Atmosphere. 'Steer' 'n Click + Metroidvania navigation system. JRPG + Twin-Stick Bullet Hell battles

name: Ooblets
short_description: Ooblets is a relaxing and offbeat farming, town life, and creature collection game. Manage your farm, grow and train your ooblets, explore strange lands, and have dance-offs!

name: Vaccine Rebirth VR
short_description: Enter once again into the world of Survival Horror, this time in VR

name: Stick Slasher
short_description: Stick Slasher is an epic 2D fighting game where you combat relentless waves of adversaries armed with shields, swords, or guns. Confront a range of enemy types, secure the highest scores, and ascend to the title of the ultimate warrior!

name: Noise-o-matic
short_description: High-quality soundboard software for voice chats: play sounds, record & alter your voice in real-time. Add music and sounds to your microphone for others to hear. Text-to-speech feature included. Elevate your audio experience effortlessly in any application or game! Lets make some noise!

name: Kickback Slug: Cosmic Courier
short_description: You, Slippy the Slug, must fly across levels filled with increasingly difficult obstacles by using only the kickback from your weapons. Collect parcels, deliver the goods, and defeat bosses on your way. Be the best Cosmic Courier and win the space race of postal work.

name: Rampage Agents
short_description: Rampage Agents is a VR game that fuses battle royale with multi-player action adventure games. Obtain powerful agents with unique powers and team up with your friends now!

name: com__et
short_description: A queer romance/horror visual novel about being locked into a path, and having _______ words hidden from You. Find Your way to discover what's missing and reach Your ____ End.

name: Castle Of Void
short_description: Your main goal is to defend the castle, because the enemies will stop at nothing. Do not let them break through the defense, as their ambition is to capture your fortress and gain power over your kingdom.

name: Gluck
short_description: A short 2D drilling adventure set in a mining company.

name: Up to the Unknown
short_description: Step into a delightful 2D pixel platformer adventure! Explore a mysterious world with a dark world, an invisible cave zone, and so much more. Use simple controls to get past those scary traps. Enjoy charming pixel art and an enchanting soundtrack. Get ready for an unforgettable journey!

name: Keali
short_description: The other guardian spirits have gone missing, and it's your responsibility as Keali, self proclaimed master of chores and errands, to fix whatever has gone wrong. Use your tether and other movement abilities to traverse past the creeping vines, fly past dangers and master your skills.

name: Brightstone Mysteries: The Others
short_description: A local toy-maker and all his factory workers mysteriously vanished on the same night. Uncover shocking secrets in this eerie hidden object puzzle adventure game!

name: Diablo® IV
short_description: Join the fight for Sanctuary in Diablo IV, the ultimate action RPG adventure. Experience the critically acclaimed campaign and new seasonal content.

name: Kid Bubblegum
short_description: Aliens have invaded, and Kid Bubblegum is too cool to let that slide. Armed with his trusty Gumslinger, he’ll kick some alien ass and shoot bubblegum…and he has plenty of gum!

name: Boiling Point: Road to Hell
short_description: Saul Myers is back in action and ready to take on the world to get his daughter back. Do you have what it takes to complete his mission?

name: Great Flame
short_description: Great Flame is a 3D adventure game with role-playing game (RPG) elements. Take on the role of a traveler who has magical powers and go on a dangerous adventure to explore the depths of the dungeon! You have to clear locations from monsters and bosses using magical weapons!

name: Fun with the Fitzgeralds
short_description: Welcome to the Battle of the Fitzgerald's there can be only one King or Queen of the land, so join in on the funniest battle you will ever play. It's all just about the FUN.

name: 100 Steps
short_description: 100 Steps is a roguelike tower crawler in a fantasy boardgame setting. There is only one rule, you have 100 actions to reach the top. Defy the gods' rules, but beware their impending fury!

name: Randoville
short_description: Randoville is a medieval chill-builder where everything is decided by your luck! Will you get a shabby hut or a gorgeous palace? Throw D20 and find out!

name: Harvest Island
short_description: Harvest Island is a mysterious, dark-cozy story-rich adventure with horror and farming elements. Pray to the gods, never ask questions as you enjoy your blissful farming days. Don't wander off too far from the comfort of your home. It's safer to play around the farm than exploring this remote island

name: Cyberjump
short_description: Cyberjump is a fast paced 2D cyberpunk-themed platformer game where you need to jump on platforms that appear only for a short time and avoiding deadly traps, keeping track of the time of existence of the platforms and think over the movements in advance so as not to fall down.

name: Taxi Simulator in City
short_description: Explore the city, pick up passengers in the thrilling Taxi Simulation-Arcade game! Join Taxi Simulatır In City with diverse vehicle options, 50+ missions, fun stunt tracks, and free roam.

name: Touhou Artificial Dream in Arcadia
short_description: Explore Gensokyo from an outsider's perspective in this old-school Touhou DRPG!

name: RedRaptor
short_description: Blast off for a retro arcade experience in RedRaptor, a vertical shoot’em up inspired by genre classics of the ’90s!

name: Nope Nope Nope Nope Nurses
short_description: The thrilling final installment of Dark One!'s hit visual novel series! Hapless protagonist Yamada is once again at the mercy of the tender depredations of the world's worst staff of nurses... and this time, it's up close and personal with the ruthless Head Nurse who dominates all the rest!

name: Castle Push
short_description: Castle Push is a fantasy and strategy game developed by Blue Cat Studio. Play the classic browser strategy. Complete all levels and unlock all possible achievements in this game. And listen to the best music from Haindale.

name: Heavy Burden
short_description: How does Sisyphus feel as he climbs to the top of the mountain? Tired from the weight of the stone, the scorching sun, and the steep climbs, he nevertheless continues on his way up. What awaits him there?

name: Space Recall
short_description: 'Space Recall' is a side-scrolling game with action Roguelike structure, skill and equipment combination as innovation points, and economic operation as the driving force. players can build character skills according to the situation, and at the same time with special abilities

name: Tourist Trap
short_description: Face an evil corporation™ with the help of a talking monkey in Tourist Trap, a surrealist dark comedy point and click adventure set in a South American coastal city.

name: Good Bones
short_description: Your new house has old secrets in this haunting point-and-click mystery, where you'll search for clues about a mysterious death, solve narrative puzzles, and make heartbreaking choices to navigate amnesia, grief, and revenge.

name: Up Against Aliens
short_description: Navigate cosmic debris using time-bending tech in this 3D platformer. Solve puzzles and thwart the alien threat across shifting landscapes. Will you be Earth's unexpected savior when you go Up Against Aliens?

name: Warf
short_description: Unleash strategic survival in Warf, where you guide Warf through relentless hordes, deploy towers, and engage in thrilling combat. Defend against the horde and emerge as the ultimate survivor in this innovative fusion of survival action and tower defense

name: Skull Survivor
short_description: Swing your nimble weapon at hordes of enemies! Collect the souls of your fallen enemies and reinforce your skull. Exterminate thousands of Vampires, Zombies, and Demons. Choose the best build and compound your abilities to deal the most damage possible to the onslaught.

name: Capytales: A Folk Adventure
short_description: Accompany Capytu on her journey against the hideous Dry Body. Challenge powerful members of Brazilian Folklore to protect the mother nature using the power of Capybara spirits, solving puzzles and platform challenges. And catch all the collectibles hidden along the way.

name: Twin Blades of the Three Kingdoms
short_description: 'Twin Blades of the Three Kingdoms' is a retro-style RPG inspired by the Three Kingdoms period. Embark on a story featuring Xu Shu guided by the sword, and enjoy the nostalgic turn-based battles and retro pixel art accompanied by 8-bit sound!

name: BIT.TRIP RERUNNER
short_description: The classic rhythm platformer is back as BIT.TRIP RERUNNER + RUNNER MAKER! The fun of the original now sports fresh mechanics, art, and soundtrack – plus RUNNER MAKER, which allows you to create custom levels. A must-play for rhythm newbies, experts, and everyone in between.

name: Boogeyman 3
short_description: A child lays awake in the light of the moon, unaware the Halloween curse will be starting soon. The radio crackles to life, a mysterious girl...

name: A Quest That Became Legend
short_description: A Quest That Became Legend is a game inspired by old school RPG classics, with turn based combat and an open world environment. Set out on an epic quest to defeat the dark conjurers and save your world from destruction.

name: Fantasy of Caocao 2
short_description: The most enjoyable Chinese-style Roguelike card game! Play as Cao Cao and conquer the Central, Japanese, and Western waifu with your allies, save the world!

name: Golf Evolution Simulation
short_description: 30 Main stunt missions, 15 Parking missions, a fun test course map and a complete all-in-one game with all golf carts and modifiability. A different experience with a mix of Arcade and Simulation.

name: Department 14
short_description: You're a regular employee of department 14. One day, after falling asleep at your desk, you wake up and notice that all the other workers have left early and you are alone in the department.

name: Apothecary
short_description: A cute story-driven zen puzzler in which you brew potions, customize your workshop, and interact with the quirky residents of the magical town of Mangrove.

name: The Lamplighters League
short_description: Recruit a team of misfits with unique abilities and unforgettable personalities, and chase the Banished Court to the ends of the earth in a mix of real-time infiltration, turn-based tactical combat, and a character-driven story of adventure and intrigue.

name: Hamster Scramble
short_description: Help twins Kaden and Quinn rescue their hamster pals in this wholesome puzzle adventure. Enjoy a cast of colorful characters, mess with your friends in competitive mode, and have hours of fun with delightful platform-hopping, bubble-popping action!

name: I commissioned some cats 4
short_description: I paid artists to hide cats and wool in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

name: KunKunNight
short_description: This is a fictional story in which you will embark on a thrilling escape experience with a man named KunKun.The game contains scare elements. If you lack courage, please exit in a timely manner.

name: Galaxy Bricks
short_description: Two classic games collide to create one amazing experience you can always just pick up and play. Enjoy Endless levels and see how high of a score you can get.

name: Arthur's Birthday
short_description: Arthur's Birthday is adapted from the original storybook into an interactive animated adventure! Interact with the pictures and discover hidden scenes. Many surprising encounters await with your favorite Arthur storybook characters!

name: Ray’z Arcade Chronology
short_description: Lock-on to an exhilarating sci-fi shooting fest with the trilogy which put Taito on the 90s arcade shooting map: The Ray Series, together in one collection for the first time!

name: Monkey Splash!!
short_description: Monkey Splash!! is an arcade, action-platformer featuring monkeys, diving, and historical landmarks! Fire your funky monkey up these colossal structures, avoiding rivals along the way to achieve the ultimate dive! It's time to SPLASH!!

name: Noun Town Language Learning
short_description: Noun Town Language Learning is the new way to learn a foreign language! Interact, listen, read, and speak your chosen language in a world that regains color as you learn. Test your skills with mini-games & talk to the local villagers. Learn Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, and more…

name: Station to Station
short_description: ‘Station to Station’ is a minimalist & relaxing game about building railway connections. Grab your conductor’s hat and bring the voxel-art world to life through the magic of trains!

name: The Protean Forest
short_description: 'The Protean forest' roguelike card games and turn based mechanisms. Unlike other card games, players will permanently lose their units and their skills will be released in coins. Therefore, in this game, players need to pay attention to the resources of unit cards and coins.

name: Alvara
short_description: You are Zoltae, hunter from a forgotten village of Occilargia, whose destiny will change Alvara. Go on an adventure, as your village asks of you. Explore, discover, fight and finally discover who you are.

name: Scary Maze Game
short_description: You and up to 5 friends need to find the exit of a maze, beware of the monster that lurks in the shadows.

name: DO NOT SMILE
short_description: The game is a 2D platformer with puzzle elements. Each game level is filled with various traps and quest items. You need to move around the level, bypassing the traps and completing the task. Carefully think over each of your actions, because the charges to change gravity are not infinite.

name: Woodland Town
short_description: Embark on a cozy journey of discovery and wonder in this enchanting exploration game. Immerse yourself in the lush embrace of a mystical town and the adjacent forest, where hidden objectives await your keen eye!

name: March of the Drunken Sailors
short_description: Stop the sailors from getting to their boat to fish the seas. Unite and use the creatures of the sea to prevent this from happening. Use physics to push and pull them off the dock before they can get there in this goofy physics based tower defense.

name: On Air Island : Survival Chat
short_description: 'On Air Island' is set on a mysterious 'remote island' that is full of intrigue. It tells the mysterious and horrifying story of the main characters trapped on a remote island.

name: Schlag den Star - Das 3. Spiel
short_description: Fans of the popular TV show 'Schlag den Star' can look forward to a new gaming experience: 'Schlag den Star' is back in its third edition. The game promises even more fun, excitement and challenging games for all fans of the format.

name: Shadows of Duat
short_description: An old school survival horror set in Egypt. An indie game with the essence of the classics of the genre, but modern gameplay, with realistic graphics and immersive sound. A difficult and terrifying challenge only for the bravest. No one will hear your screams from inside the tomb.

name: Fears to Fathom - Ironbark Lookout
short_description: Jack Nelson, a 24-year-old fire lookout, transferred to a new outpost. As he settled into his new home, he couldn't shake the feeling that something was off, little did he know what was transpiring down in Ironbark State Park.

name: Path to Knighthood
short_description: Learn the dark truth behind a gentle wyvern’s rampage, a cold-blooded murder, and a dragon-worshiping cult. Will you submit or defy the godlike creature?

name: DCOP
short_description: Step into the gritty world of law enforcement in DCOP, a groundbreaking full motion video (FMV) police simulator that thrusts players into the heart-pounding action of a newly graduated police officer facing off against a ruthless criminal syndicate.

name: Love Is All Around
short_description: The player becomes Gu Yi, uses the first-person perspective to immerse himself in meeting six beauties, and embarks on a joyful and sweet love journey with them. Six girls that are charming, innocent, intelligent, wild, sexy, glamorous, who will go to the end with you is up to you to decide.

name: EbonSide
short_description: Its been 300 years after the god of light died and the world is in a state of chaos. And now the legendary sword Ebonside is in the hands of evil! Take up arms and rise up to challenge the darkness and bring light to the world once more!

name: Digitanks!
short_description: Digitanks is a turn-based artillery strategy game set inside your computer. Battle against the Bugs in your computer in the campaign, and then join a skirmish in the arcade Artillery mode or in the base-building Strategy mode.

name: Tarantula Virus
short_description: Tarantula Virus is a randomly generated roguelike topdownshooter in a sci-fi style with a lot of items and enemies. Upgrade items unlock new characters find allies and defeat powerful enemies and bosses.

name: 只有向下 Only Down
short_description: 《Only Down》 is a platform jumping parkour game. It is produced by the independent studio OldCat Digital Studio, with a single person named OldCat.《Only Down》, as the name suggests, means players move from the sky to the ground or below, ultimately obtaining the treasure.

name: 猫咪黑帮
short_description: (Support English, bilingual subtitles!!)I am the black cat prince, an accident I lost my memory, I once had 88 brothers, at any time for me to go out to raise the flag, and now I only have myself, sleep until 2 o 'clock can not afford, hungry my little cat, can stage a comeback, depending on you!

name: Pickleball Smash
short_description: Unleash Your Pickleball Fever! Get ready to serve, dink, and smash your way to victory in the thrilling world of Pickleball Smash. Compete across multiple venues, jump into challenging minigames, and play in competitive tournaments to become the best of the best.

name: X-Force Under Attack
short_description: X-Force Under Attack brings back all the charm of shmup games from the 80's/90's. It's a frenetic and chaotic space shooter with insane battles against extremely difficult bosses.

name: Stories in Glass: Winter
short_description: Piece together winter magic in 40 stained-glass puzzles.

name: Stronghold Conquest
short_description: In this thrilling Tower Defense - type game, you will become the main defender of your kingdom. Build powerful guns and strategically deploy them on the battlefield to fend off waves of incoming enemies. Your goal is to protect your territory and destroy all threats using various types of guns.

name: ArcRacer
short_description: ArcRacer is a fast-paced, aggressive, and stylistic anti-gravity racer. Inspired by classic series such as F-Zero and WipEout, ArcRacer aims to provide a fresh new challenge for genre veterans, while also creating an accessible and engaging experience for newcomers.

name: Healer
short_description: This is a single-player action Isaac-like game in which you play the role of a doctor, select a disease from various medical records, and control various human immune guards equipped with various core weapons to enter various human body parts and fight against various pathogens.

name: Politon
short_description: Politon is a turn-based strategy game that has easy-to-understand mechanics and various game modes such as Online Multiplayer or Scenario.

name: 9 to Die
short_description: Your offices main server has made all of the electronics blood thirsty and you have to go and reboot the server. You will have to go through walls and floors to get to it.

name: Fire Shark
short_description: Get ready for classic shoot-'em-up action in Toaplan's Fire Shark, now on PC with modern updates. An evil and overwhelmingly powerful military force is about to take over not only a small country, but the whole world... Defeat the enemy and accept your place of honor!

name: Lost & Found Agency Collector's Edition
short_description: Play this great new hidden object game from AVI Games. Get and fullfill orders from the detective agency “Lost & Found Agency” to search for missing objects. Go to fascinating locations and explore dangerous places, decipher clues and uncover secrets. Find the missing objects and solve crimes.

name: RPG Alchemy
short_description: RPG Alchemy is a variation of the Alchemy genre in the RPG theme, so connecting two objects to uncover a third one until everything is discovered.

name: Monster Line of Defense
short_description: 'Monster Line of Defense' is a casual shooting game. Clicking the left mouse button allows the player to fire and shoot the monsters approaching from the front.

name: Chrome Wolf
short_description: Discover the endgame of Chrome Wolf's journey through epic tank battles and relentless action!

name: SwarmsurgE
short_description: Survive the Swarm of monsters Surging across the land, leaving destruction and chaos in their wake. Warriors with unique abilities and strengths can attempt to venture out alone to confront the raging swarms. But they will have to band together in order to survive and defeat the monstrous horde.

name: KarmaZoo
short_description: Share the love and die trying! KarmaZoo is a joyful, altruistic, cooperative platformer where up to 10 random players help each other with the unique abilities of 50 different characters - all for the sake of good Karma.

name: ReThink | Lite
short_description: ReThink | Lite is a Puzzle Game in a peaceful futuristic setting, that is a spiritual successor to ReThink 2 and features a variety of Puzzles that utilize Lasers and the behavior of light and it's colors to create challenging problems to solve.

name: Spellslinger
short_description: Harness the power of the elements and gather spells to defend yourself against hordes of enemies! Dozens of spells with unique functionality and traits that grant unique abilites and powers to aid you in battle. Stand your ground, Wizard!

name: Rising snake:The present world
short_description: 《Rising Snake》 is a semi sandbox horror decryption adventure game. A fictional university campus based on real size. A 'Taoist' with special abilities. A twisted and bizarre story. Waiting for your arrival.

name: We Are the Universe
short_description: Sci-fi tower defense where you create your own maze, manage drones and power levels, and harvest for resources. Upgrade your turrets, buildings and ground units. Upgrade and buy new vehicles and motherships.

name: Last Resort
short_description: Dive into the mysterious world of the 'Last Resort', a non-linear visual novel where past and future are woven together. His life’s breaking under the weight of life problems. Unable to fight any further, He decides to take his final journey. Will it change anything? Or will it lead Him to the end?

name: Meer's: Escape
short_description: Meer's: Escape is an island version of the classic city simulation. The game expands on some of the deep-rooted tropes of the city-building experience while introducing new gameplay elements to recognize the excitement and challenges of creating and maintaining a real city.

name: Mujina - Maze Game
short_description: Mujina is a Maze Exploration game where the player has to activate 4 objective points and reach the end portal. Beware of the monsters and the numerous traps awaiting you! If everyone dies, it will result in a failure! Group up with your friends or anyone online to complete the 3 type of mazes!

name: Black Beacon Hill
short_description: Follow the story of the [Phantoms] as forces beyond their control drag them back into a vendetta in the streets, the Ulstanian-Kostakovian war they left behind rages on in the distance, and an existential threat looms over all. A visual novel with a unique design minimalistic top-down shooter game.

name: the white chamber
short_description: Sci-fi horror anime point and click adventure game. Guide a young woman through a nightmarish space station as she tries to uncover why she's there and how she can escape.

name: Ring Stars
short_description: Ring Stars is a physics-based 3D fighting game with local multiplayer for up to 4 players.

name: Compass of Destiny: Istanbul
short_description: Discover the 17th Century Ottoman Empire, its mysteries and real historical events! Draw the path of your destiny with the guidance of the compass that will open the way of Fîtrat!

name: Hot And Lovely : Tease
short_description: Hot And Lovely: Tease is a classic matching game. Slide the blocks to make three or more adjacent blocks of the same pattern disappear. After eliminating specific blocks, you can enter the next level. The game is easy to operate and easy to play.

name: The Dark Survivors
short_description: This game combines survival, Diablo-like elements and randomness in a rogue-lite experience where players take on the role of survivors with various talents who use different weapons and abilities to fight off hordes of monsters.

name: MTBF
short_description: MTBF is a VR Multiplayer Parkour Arena Shooter. Hone your skills and master your surroundings to outrun, out-shoot, and outsmart your opponents in fast-paced back-to-back matches alone or with friends. If you can't make it to the top, just try and stay away from the bottom. Good luck.

name: Helion
short_description: Are you ready to embark on an intergalactic journey like never before? Step into the thrilling world of Helion, where tactical teamwork, role-based strategy, and stunning stylized graphics collide in an epic sci-fi adventure. Get ready to experience the future of team-based third-person shooters!

name: Tactical Rampart
short_description: Tactical Rampart is a RPG, survival game in which you will become the defender of a rampart from the attack of zombies in outer space. Using guns and towers, could you successfully defeat them?

name: 碧海潮生怀旧版
short_description: 碧海潮生怀旧版在重制时做了许多更新与优化：地图，物品，技能，UI界面均进行了大幅美化，人物建模与交互更加逼真；战斗系统采用了回合制与策略要素结合的新颖战斗方式，阵型，绝招，乃至地形都可对战斗结果造成影响；培育系统升级，可培养门下弟子各项属性，甚至能带着他们做农活。网络对战也进行了升级，与其他玩家PK可获取丰厚的奖励。此外，世界BOSS掉落物品也十分丰厚哦！自制剧情系统升级，支持更便捷的录入，赶紧与其他玩家分享你心中最热血最感人的武侠故事吧！还有更多的细节需要玩家满满体会，开发团队也会一直聆听玩家建议，不断改进，力争打磨出最好玩的坛说系列游戏。

name: Marsh
short_description: Face-off against wacky, cartoony, brought-to-life objects in this 2D platforming shooter! Challenge your squishy self to get the highest of scores, up the difficulties and take back control of your non-living life.

name: Halloween Stories: Black Book Collector's Edition
short_description: Your plans to have a fun Halloween night in with your little sister quickly turn dark when she’s kidnapped by a nightmarish specter! With the line between your home and the supernatural world blurred, can you save her in time?

name: コスプレリラクゼーション - Cosplay Relaxation -
short_description: A massage parlor where your 'relationship points' change the services available. There's an outfit for each 'treatment' plan you need the most!

name: The Sentinel
short_description: Defend your castle against waves of invaders in 'The Sentinel,' a tower defense game. Strategically upgrade weapons and defenses, make tough choices, and immerse yourself in intense battles. Will you triumph and protect your realm?

name: Woodland Isle
short_description: Explore the enchanting world of Woodland Isle, a captivating exploration game that invites you to embark on a tranquil journey through a lush, mysterious island. Uncover hidden locations, from ancient campsites to majestic trees and the remains of giants.

name: Simple Snooker
short_description: This is a two-player Snooker game, that runs on computer desktop or virtual reality device.

name: Faerie Afterlight
short_description: Embark on an enchanting adventure in this breathtaking 2D Metroidvania game inspired by the rich folklore of Indonesia. Control Kimo and Wispy as they seek to recover the Shards of Light. Manipulate terrain to solve puzzles, befriend the natives of Lumina, and take abilities from powerful titans.✨

name: 77p egg: Eggwife
short_description: After a sexual mishap, our hero 77p egg finds itself on a quest to find a new wife while the world is overrun by sentient sewage and a milk-obsessed cult. A dumb and crass FPS inspired by the likes of Postal 2, Duke 3D, and Goat Simulator.

name: Idling Gears
short_description: Click! Place gears, click! Make money, click! Place more gears, click! Make even more money, click, click and above all click!

name: Bizarre Mushroom Cycle Simulator
short_description: Let's become members of the mushrooms and enjoy life as mushrooms! With the mushrooms, you can watch enchanting fireflies, listen to the sounds of the forest, and experience a life that is unique to mushrooms. Living as a mushroom might not be too bad after all.

name: RAILGRADE
short_description: RAILGRADE is a train resource management game! Construct dense vertical railroads, build cities, construct vast factory chains with train automation! Restore an off world colony's economy all in the story driven campaign!

name: Three Minutes To Eight
short_description: Three Minutes To Eight is a mind bending pixel art adventure. A gaming experience threading the edge of consciousness, where everything is possible and yet remains elusive. Players will find themselves in ███ ██ █ ▓ ▒ ░ ¿⊕ξד¶¶¶ Error 0x80070570.

name: Made in Hell
short_description: 'Made in Hell' is a 2D pixel vertical scrolling action game.Throw bones and jump (warp).Throw a bone and keep climbing.

name: Spell Disk
short_description: Build unique synergy spell combos to destroy the hordes of monsters and bosses in this rogue-lite action game.

name: Backstab
short_description: This is a top view angle action adventure game, with refreshing combat methods and a rich world view, so that you can experience the feeling of backstabbing under the impetus of the story!

name: An Update is Pending
short_description: A game about updating the game! Collect bits and either spend them to help you beat the main game, or save up for upgrades such as better graphics, achievements, better music, and unlocking more upgrades!

name: Portals: Escape the Infinity
short_description: A transcendent point-and-click puzzle adventure. Can you escape 50 Portals?

name: Avatar: The Last Airbender - Quest for Balance
short_description: Team Avatar is back! Relive the epic adventure of the original Avatar: The Last Airbender series, as you play as Aang and his 8 friends to explore the most unique locations from the series, solve challenging puzzles and experience the most heart touching moments of Aang’s story

name: Glorious Storm
short_description: Glorious storm is a turn based real time strategy game. As a general, you lead to battle your army and different units such as cavalery, infantery and artillery on 3D maps. It is heavily inspired by the napoleonic era but it is completely fictional.

name: Gunslinger
short_description: 'Gunslinger' is a VR shooting game. You will return to the era of fire and blood, and write your own western legend with your gun. It is not easy to become a legend, As long as sticking to our faith, we will become a legend in the world.

name: Chores of Corruption
short_description: Chores of Corruption is a top-down arena shooter with roguelike elements where you defeat waves of enemies. Choose between different characters and from a variety of items and traits to create unique builds to survive the ever growing corruption.

name: Lair of Torment
short_description: This is an indie horror game with first-person puzzles. Terror and fear have enveloped the city. The maniac has returned. You sneak into his lair to try and stop him before he goes too far...

name: Hollybound
short_description: Introducing Hollybound: a game of underqualified heroes! A radioactive invasion is taking over Wayfield, and it's up to you to stop it! In this action-packed top-down shooter, you'll face inconvenient traffic, a crowded shopping mall, and even an Italian restaurant! ...It's cooler than it sounds.

name: Fruit Slash
short_description: In order to bind the maids, the devil scattered their souls and haunted them. Now, they need your help to defeat the demons, reunite the soul fragments, and free them.

name: Slappy Board
short_description: Blow off steam in Slappy Board! Immerse yourself in different themes with multiple scenarios. Keep calm or lose control, the choice is yours. But don't forget to have fun and SLAP!

name: Orb Hunter
short_description: In a world filled with darkness, orbs infused from darkness are spread around the world. You are an Orb Hunter and orb hunting you do. Join us in a Third-Person Dark Fantasy Action Game, and lets find gold and glory.

name: Evolings
short_description: Embark on a captivating journey in Evolings! This minimalistic turn-based roguelike lets you face hordes of evil monsters by recruiting a team of deadly yet cute creatures. With challenges and a unique experience in each playthrough, Evolings offers a captivating fusion of strategy and charm.

name: Kemps
short_description: Kemps is a fast-paced online card game that brings together 4 to 8 players, divided into teams of 2, where players score points by secretly communicating to their partner when they have collected 4 of a kind. Utilize teamwork, deception, and keen observation to pave the way to victory!

name: HexeD
short_description: Can you build and fight through endless levels to bring life and color to your world? Customize towers and troops to ward off enemies in this fast-paced and colorful tower defense.

name: Real Boxing: Steel Champions VR
short_description: Real Boxing: Steel Champions VR offers a casual VR experience where players get to battle others via fearsome robot boxers

name: Wizard with a Gun
short_description: Wizard with a Gun is an online sandbox survival game for 1 - 2 players set in a magical wilderness wrought with dangerous creatures and arcane mysteries. Embark on a journey alone or with a friend to collect, craft, and outfit your wizard however you see fit as you explore the unknown.

name: Terra Toy
short_description: Terra Toy is a simple, peaceful sandbox game about building a tiny planet! Raise mountains, dig rivers, paint beaches, and plop down trees to create the landscape of your dreams. There are no complicated menus or difficult-to-use tools, just a blank planet and your imagination.

name: Robospital
short_description: Become a doctor in Robospital and fix robots. Learn Python programming, write code, and test your code!

name: Orbital Cargo Division
short_description: The crew of a cargo ship arrives at what appears to be an abandoned space station. Power appears to be there, but no one is responding to their radio messages. A pixel art point & click adventure with an exciting story and lots of humor.

name: schleich® DINOSAURS: Mission Dino Camp
short_description: Find and rescue the schleich® DINOSAURS in an action filled adventure deep in the amazon jungle !

name: Light Up The Sky
short_description: Get ready to embark on an illuminating adventure like no other in 'Light Up the Sky'! In this game, you take on the role of a charming firefly, the guardian of a mystical forest. Your mission is to light up the night sky and save your fellow fireflies from the clutches of darkness.

name: Zombie Builder Defense 2
short_description: Defend against hordes of zombies in this fun filled top-down shooter. Build and upgrade your base, unlock powerful guns, and take on challenging bosses with up to 4 players in online co-op. Play minigames to earn bonuses and survive the zombie apocalypse one night at a time!

name: Flying Tank
short_description: Get into your Flying Tank and shoot 'em up like it's the good old days! Kill strange bosses, drop bombs from above and build an arsenal of fun, powerful weapons. Reclaim the stolen Earth - alone or with a friend - in a rich action-packed side-scrolling shmup!

name: Fate of New Albans
short_description: Engage with the townsfolk and native people to make decisions and choices, your actions will decide the fate of New Albans. With multiple endings, solve puzzles, speak to NPCs and explore the land in this story adventure.

name: Cyborg3003
short_description: 6-player co-op survival horror at its finest! Cyborg, monsters and aliens. Free updates

name: 山水画乡/Shanshui Haven
short_description: Explore, Build, Prosper — Embark on a tranquil and strategically rich journey of city-building in ancient China.

name: Miss Peach
short_description: 《Miss Peach》is a simple pixel puzzle game，There's not even a key or password here，I believe it will not be difficult for you.

name: Jewel Legends: Tree of Life
short_description: The Hods, magical beings and pure of heart, once lived in harmony with the holy Tree of Life. But the endless greed of a dark demon forced the Hods into hiding. Now, new hope springs eternal. In this Match-3 Game you have too restore the Tree of Life and rebuild the world of the Hods!

name: Arcanum
short_description: A Co-op 1-4 player horror survival which will have you searching for clues, items, aiming to solve the mystery of Arcanum whilst running for your life... Discover what happened to the previous residents and escape whilst you can..

name: Survive or Die
short_description: Survive Or Die is a first-person survival game. It takes place in an open world that is full of traps and mysteries. You are an outlaw who has escaped from death in prison. Can you escape all the manhunts? Can you survive the pitfalls the mysterious valley holds at night?

name: Destroy The Monoliths
short_description: Explore. Mine. Build. Fight. Destroy The Monoliths is a single-player real-time mining tower offense roguelike where you explore a randomly generated map, mine the terrain to get resources, and build turrets to both protect your base and fight monoliths that keep spawning ever more minions.

name: The book of death for dummies
short_description: Death has taken a well-deserved vacation in Cancun and left George in charge! He'll have to learn to deal with Destiny and decide who should continue their journey in the land of the living. But beware, wrong choices lead to undesirable consequences!

name: XR22-SEAGUARD
short_description: XR22-SEAGUARD is a PC and VR game that reimagines the classic grid-based game of Battleship. This immersive PC and VR game puts you in the heart of a dynamic 3D industrial environment, where you'll strategically place and sink ships using state-of-the-art weapons and defenses.

name: Archons: Arena
short_description: Step into the pit and become the champion in Archons: Arena, a unique blend of deckbuilder and RPG. Manage your skills, equipment, and strategy to survive round after round.

name: Scape Run
short_description: A terrifying Party Royale that will fill you with tension, fear and frenzy, pure adrenaline like you have never experienced before.

name: Hauma - A Detective Noir Story
short_description: Hauma is a deduction visual novel set in Munich. Discover a conspiracy amongst the upper echelons of society alongside former detective Judith, while visiting real locations in a comic-inspired look.

name: Run And Fire
short_description: Run And Fire is a 2D platformer with shooter elements in which you have to fight enemies.

name: Ultimate Solitaire Collection
short_description: Over 350 game variants await, from classics favorites like Klondike to exclusive original solitaire creations. Customize your solitaire adventure with card sets, backgrounds, and more. Journey through diverse locations, unlocking treasures along the way. Join now and conquer the world of solitaire!

name: Pumpkin Game
short_description: 'Pumpkin Game' is a falling object puzzle game in which players try to pile up as many vegetables as possible so that they do not overflow from the basket. When two or more vegetables collide with each other, they combine and evolve into a larger vegetable.

name: Delicious - Cooking and Romance
short_description: Join Emily & her family in a new Delicious Restaurant and Time Management game

name: Atomic Hazard
short_description: Atomic Hazard is a action puzle platformer. Take advantage of your environment in physics-based movement and combat.

name: Stone Guardian
short_description: Stone Guardian is a low-poly style 3rd person action-adventure game where you play as a guardian that needs to find the disappeared Stone. To find it he needs to enter the magical world and face challenges.

name: Milky Way Jigsaw Puzzles
short_description: Embark on a cosmic journey with 'Milky Way Jigsaw Puzzles'. Solve puzzles featuring stars, galaxies, and celestial wonders while unlocking Steam Achievements. Dive deep into the universe, learn astronomical facts, and connect with fellow puzzle enthusiasts. Your galactic adventure awaits!

name: Wonderland
short_description: Dive into fear in Wonderland, a first-person horror game where you navigate an abandoned mansion, solving puzzles and uncovering mysteries. Face chilling challenges, explore haunted rooms, and decipher the mansion's dark secrets. Can you survive the terror and unveil the truth?

name: Hellgineers
short_description: Help the minions of the underworld across bubbling pools of lava with rickety bridges and non-regulated constructions. Will you go for the easiest route, or test your skills and aim for the coveted skulls? Return to completed challenges to perfect your builds!

name: Tony Hawk's™ Pro Skater™ 1 + 2
short_description: Play the fully-remastered Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ & Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 2 games in one epic collection, rebuilt from the ground up in incredible HD.

name: Monkey See Monkey Doo Doo
short_description: Live in the heart of the Bermuda Triangle with all your Monkey friends! Swing on vines, throw doo at your enemies, and climb everything! A Variety of Playable Maps Multiple Gamemodes Customizable Cosmetics

name: Galaxy Pass Station
short_description: Build and manage a thriving space station with aliens, humans and robots. Verify documents, fight criminals and monsters. Do whatever it takes to save humanity from annihilation by the alien government! Graphics come alive in motion—check out our trailer to witness the charm!

name: Ghost Simulator
short_description: This is the story of a family living in a haunted house in New Hampshire. And you're the one haunting them.

name: Laika: Aged Through Blood
short_description: Laika: Aged Through Blood is a western-inspired motorvania set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. It is the story about a tribe oppressed by occupant forces, and the personal story of a mother coyote warrior who descends on an endless path of vengeance to take back what her people lost.

name: Platform Game Maker
short_description: Platform Game Maker is exciting tool to make your dream Platform Game!

name: Lillusion
short_description: An action role-playing game with a non-linear plot choice. Soul-like running and slashing combat system, Naruto-inspired seal system.

name: HERO'S PARTY R
short_description: 'Find 30 people to come to the Demon Castle party!' One day, the king received a letter from the demon king, the old enemy of mankind. Although it was obviously a trap, the king decided to take advantage of this opportunity to suppress the Demon Castle.

name: March of Shrooms
short_description: Embody a tiny shroom and try to unite all of shroomkind before a massive storm sends everyone back to the mycelial age. Lead a crowd of cheery mushrooms and brawl through the islands. Bring peace, berries, and the peace of mycelium to every agaricus bisporus in the land!

name: Ratopia
short_description: New game with combined genre of strategic survival, Sandbox, and city building simulation. Enjoy the simulation with vast world to adventure with a great number of contents. Build your own economical system to sustain your ideal city of Ratopia.

name: Cosmic Cowabunnies
short_description: Play as 'Sauce,' the Grey Alien, on a critical mission to hide alien evidence from humanity. Abduct, rescue, mine, and unravel Earth's mysteries. Battle formidable foes and prove your skills on the intergalactic leaderboard. Prevent disclosure, or the truth is out!

name: Undercroft warriors
short_description: Crush the forces of hell and get a high score in this addictive, action-packed, arcade-inspired twin-stick shooter!

name: Railroads & Catacombs
short_description: In this exciting Card Building Roguelike game you create your cards from scratch adding different upgrades. Build your train, explore this mad land and face fearsome bosses. Discover infinite synergies. How far will you go?

name: Project UNSEEK
short_description: Project UNSEEK is a 2v6 class-based asymmetrical online multiplayer horror game inspired by 80s slasher horror movies, SCP urban legend, and Science Fiction, where you compete against each other to survive the experiment as High Schoolers or Mythical Creatures.

name: Shadows of Revenge
short_description: Shadows of Revenge puts you into the sinister heart of a mafia-dominated Manhattan. As the boss of a once-proud family now fallen into disgrace, your journey to reclaim the city will test your wit, resourcefulness and determination.

name: 9th Sentinel Sisters
short_description: The battle of the clone girls unfolds on a post-apocalyptic Earth, devastated by the alien life form known as 'Bleed.' Pilot the manned weapon 'Father' to eliminate enemies. Upgrade weapons, create powerful builds, and strategize to successfully clear stages.

name: Quarantine Town
short_description: Survive against relentless zombie hordes in an immersive post-apocalyptic world. Battle through waves, explore treacherous environments, and make split-second decisions to stay alive. Can you endure the nightmare and outlast the undead? It's a test of strategy, skill, and nerves.

name: FishOrChicken
short_description: How long does it take to prepare the equipment in advance? Just a little shopping? You can have up to 16 items If you collect 3 of the same item, the rank will increase and you can combine them into one. Enhanced recycling function Items are completed randomly just by selecting and combining items

name: Ghost Signal: A Stellaris Game
short_description: Ghost Signal is a VR action roguelite set in the Stellaris universe, where you captain your ship to battle a multitude of alien species. Partake in dynamic space wars, encounter planet sized creatures, gather valuable loot to conduct research, and more. No journey is the same.

name: Claire's Cruisin' Cafe: Fest Frenzy
short_description: Join Claire as she embarks on a journey of culinary discovery! It's the first day of the festival, and she needs your help to run her food truck successfully. You'll need to swiftly take orders, cook up delicious dishes, and serve them with a smile.

name: Banana Co.
short_description: Banana Co. is a first person horror game in which you're placed into a terrifying banana factory where you have to avoid the dangers that await you. You're given no instructions but to collect bananas around the factory.

name: Roman Empire Simulator
short_description: Conquer, defend, and rise! Dive into the grandeur of ancient Rome in this gripping blend of Tower Defense and war strategy. Transform your humble settlement into history's mightiest empire. Defend against ferocious armies and expand your dominion over Europe and Africa. Ready your arrows and flames!

name: Wheelchair Tester
short_description: Test a wheelchair equipped with a jet engine to see if it can handle various real-life scenarios. Rest assured, you won't need to sit in the wheelchair – we have professional crash test dummies for that.

name: KimodameshiGolf
short_description: Kimodameshi Golf is a horror golf game based on golf!

name: A Fool's Art Gallery
short_description: A Fool's Art Gallery contains over 20 years of visual content by one surreal expressionist psychedelic Canadian artist. You are a flying magical mask who s*!*s stars; be sure to look for secret doors to reveal hidden content as you explore the gallery at large. Hundreds of works of art await you!

name: Checkmate Challenge
short_description: A chess arcade game where you play against the strongest chess engine in the world.

name: Inhibit
short_description: 'Inhibit' is an exhilarating and highly challenging speed run platform game that will put your reflexes to the ultimate test.Each level is more demanding than the previous one, and the slightest mistake will determine the difference between victory and defeat.

name: DEATH ANIMAL PARADE
short_description: Casual Strategy game full with Animals

name: SuiCats
short_description: SuiCats is an engaging puzzle game where you combine kittens to create amazing cat cascades. Diverse physics and a humorous design will keep you smiling while playing SuiCats. Join the feline adventure and break the high score today!

name: Fortune: Rewritten
short_description: Fortune: Rewritten is a PvP experience! Battle in head-to-head combat where only one can be the winner!

name: Love In The Dark
short_description: In this multiplayer horror game, a loving couple receives an invitation from a wealthy man for an event. Despite my concerns, she insists on going. To protect her, I decide to secretly join and keep her safe.

name: Dungeon Tale
short_description: Play different classes, explore dungeons with AI teammates, defeat enemies and bosses, collect a variety of gear, and build and upgrade your own Home City.

name: Insurgency Runner
short_description: Insurgency Runner - 3D runner with shooter elements in which you play as a soldier running along the road, jumping over different obstacles, collecting ammo and other bonuses, and killing rebels,. Don't get into their sightlines or you will be shot.

name: Azorius
short_description: Explore the world, get resources, go through dungeons, solve puzzles, fight monsters, use magic, craft items, build a settlement and recruit residents!

name: Legendary Slide - Platinum Edition
short_description: In 'Legendary Slide - Platinum Edition' you have to clear away mahjong tiles by sliding them next to matching ones. Solve mind bending puzzles and collect gems to restore the ancient temple of Air. This is the Platinum Edition with unique extra content!

name: Smoots Pinball
short_description: Enjoy an exciting and fun multiplayer pinball experience with Smoots Pinball! Play on 5 tables based on our popular Smoots games, complete missions, and unlock extras. Can you score 1,000,000 points? Play solo or with friends and show off your pinball skills!

name: Pathfinder: Gallowspire Survivors
short_description: A new roguelite survivor game set in the beloved fantasy world of Pathfinder. Enter Gallowspire, Pathfinder’s legendary tower of darkness, alongside your fearless companion. Slay hordes of enemies, upgrade your arsenal, and overcome deadly bosses to seal away the ancient king of undeath!

name: Touch Grass Together
short_description: Touch Grass with your friends, or on your own if you're into that sort of thing, we won't judge even if it is a little weird.

name: D or D
short_description: D or D is a psychological horror game that immerses you in daily experiences.One page in high school student Xiaoshan's notebook is written with some words starting with the letter 'd'

name: EXORCISM
short_description: Exorcism 'is a first person horror game. Facing the ghosts that appear and disappear, explore the map to find ways to eliminate them!

name: Chemical Sort
short_description: Chemical Sort is a science-themed casual puzzle in which you unscramble various colored chemicals by sorting them into their own test tubes.

name: Battle for Treasure
short_description: How many secrets and dangers lie in the vast expanses of the oceans and seas! In just one look at the immense waves, a spark of a thirst for adventure, a desire for wealth and fame is hidden in the very soul of every Viking.

name: ROOT
short_description: The is a beautiful and huge RPG game that tells the story of a human being on a mission to return to the past and prevent war in order to save a world ravaged by war. However, other races try to interfere with the journey, and in the process, humans face numerous dangers and surprising truths

name: The Void
short_description: Join the quest to overtake the void and become a hero! In this game, you will slay your enemies in a point and click fashion and overtake the void for good, or so you think... Join the quest in taking over the void to find out!

name: Wildmender
short_description: A desert gardening survival game. Start from a tiny spring and cultivate a blooming garden. Explore a vast world amid the sands and uncover its mysteries. Can you defend against the relentless forces of nature and mysterious wraith corruption, to bring life to a dying world?

name: GosickRogue
short_description: Gothic × Sickがテーマのデッキ構築型ローグライト。10枚のカードを入れ替えながらデッキを強化。攻撃をして敵を倒すか、防御に徹して耐えるか、2通りの戦略を上手く活用しよう。

name: Buried
short_description: You wake up buried alive. You are running out of oxygen and you can't remember how you got here. There must be a way out, can you figure it out in time?

name: Hellsweeper VR
short_description: DARE TO DESCEND INTO HELL? Hellsweeper VR is an intense first-person action-combat VR experience. Traverse the underworld where every step brings a challenge or a chance. Gain mastery of your weapons and elemental magic, or fall to the unrelenting onslaught of hell's twisted souls.

name: Mortal Kombat 1
short_description: Discover a reborn Mortal Kombat™ Universe created by the Fire God Liu Kang. Mortal Kombat™ 1 ushers in a new era of the iconic franchise with a new fighting system, game modes, and fatalities!

name: Lethal Company
short_description: A co-op horror about scavenging at abandoned moons to sell scrap to the Company.

name: Touch Force
short_description: Most unique top down shooter. Bring hell to insectoid robot invasion.

name: Polygon Survival
short_description: Polygon Survival is a low-poly zombie survival shooter with simple building and crafting. You find yourself in a mini world of zombie apocalypse and your only goal here is survival.

name: 逝去的群星
short_description: Probably as long as a place buries a corpse, it will really bind a living person.I would look back without hesitation, because when we walked together through the cold and wet mansion, I saw all the lives we spent together, and in the last moment, I chose to remember.

name: 御姐初长成
short_description: 这是一个回合制动作游戏。画风为低多边形，动作富有打击感，配音轻松明快。讲述了一个底层小人物，通过与黑恶势力战斗实现人生逆袭的故事。

name: Squares and Stuff
short_description: Build, experiment, and share in Squares and Stuff, a pixel-retro sandbox game inspired by classic 'falling sand' games. Unleash your creativity in an open-ended world filled with sandbox elements like water, paint, fire, sand, animals, humans, zombies, and a controllable 2D platform character.

name: Flashback 2
short_description: Immerse yourself in an action-packed cyberpunk universe where the fate of humanity itself hangs in the balance. The Morphs are preparing their final attack, determined to enslave every civilization in the Solar System — and it's your mission to fight back!

name: Misty's Shining Blacksmithing
short_description: A world called Fillwitz has finally ushered in an era of peace after the long war between mankind and the demon. But Misty, who lives in the underground city of Gondalva and runs a blacksmith shop, is distressed by the sharp reduction in work caused by the peace.

name: Pea Pod Power
short_description: Explore a colorful garden world in this unique 3D platformer! An evil alien fungus has invaded the planet and seized control of its crops... use your epic Pea Pod Powers to defeat the fungus and recover the sacred seeds before it’s too late!

name: Sweet Dreams Alex
short_description: Alex is still small, but her dreams are big. You are her Dream Builder, tasked with constructing labyrinths full of distractions to keep Nightmares away until the morning comes. Sweet Dreams Alex is a wholesome puzzle and construction game, filled to the brim with atmosphere and charm.

name: DYNABLASTER
short_description: Having been a blockbuster, DYNABLASTER® is a game for the strategic thinker whose smart tactics will instill fear in his competitors – playing online or local against others or against the computer. In this captivating action game, destroy your enemies with cleverly placed bombs.

name: Noreya: The Gold Project
short_description: Venture into a frenetic metroidvania and take part in a fight between divinities where you will have to choose between Corrupting Gold and Purifying Light to achieve your ends.

name: Ragnarok Survivors: Valhalla
short_description: Prove to Odin that you deserve a place at the table in the afterlife and survive Ragnarok. Or die, and leave your wordly belongings to the next Viking. Unlock new characters and buy new weapons and abilities to improve your chance of survival.

name: EMPTY SHELL
short_description: EMPTY SHELL will throw you in a dark industrial environment, a secret facility on a Japanese island. Each volunteer has signed a contract for a 'recovery operation' without being privy to too many details. A tense roguelite survival horror with a top down perspective.

name: 不朽之刃/Blade of Immortality
short_description: This is a world without ending, no boundaries, can experience a variety of battles in the game, the game will be in a linear form for players to explore, the game will be continuously developed and constantly updated new content

name: 리프 인 부트스트랩 - LEAP IN BOOTSTRAP
short_description: Manipulate the past, make the future! Leaf in bootstrap!

name: Power Punch
short_description: A multiplayer online game where you can enjoy boxing and happy sports in the battle royale arena. On the way to become the boxing king! We'll not afraid of opponent! but afraid of break the TV at home!

name: Ad Infinitum
short_description: When reality is a nightmare, nightmares become real. In this psychological horror game, you fight the terrifying creatures invading your mind. Can you save your sanity?

name: Search & Find - Hidden Objects
short_description: With beautifully detailed, hand-illustrated pictures by published puzzle artist Adam Doyle, Search and Find - Hidden Objects serves a relaxing adventure for everyone ready to perfect their spotting skills.

name: Knights Of Dice
short_description: Knights of Dice is a dice-rolling game, which aims to please gamers that are into boardgames, turnbased games, strategy, and a sprinkle of action

name: Hidden Through Time 2: Myths & Magic
short_description: Join Clicky on a new, enchanted adventure in Hidden Through Time 2: Myths & Magic! Search for hidden objects scattered around hand-drawn worlds, and unlock more as you go. With both a single player campaign and an online mode where you can create your own dreamworld, the adventure never ends!

name: Survivor Mercs
short_description: Command the bullet hell and extract with your loot–or die trying! Take control of a cloned commander and lead your merc squad against a relentless robot army. Test your skill in this roguelite, bullet-heaven extraction shooter. Survive the Onslaught. Grow your Mercenary Army. Unleash the Havoc!

name: Dreaming in the mountains
short_description: A dream and a question The game tells the story of a climber who enters a dream The player, as an abstract subject in the dream, experiences various dream slices hope you get something out of this

name: Down There Somewhere
short_description: Can you survive ?A small submarine is sent to the depths of the ocean for research. But an unidentified creature attacks the submarine. You know that the rescue team will send a new submarine in about 10 hours. Can you survive 10 hours in the dark depths of the ocean?

name: Damocles Gaze
short_description: A radical and mystical action roguelike top-down shooter where every run takes 12 minutes. How far can you go? What will you find?

name: Tasking
short_description: 'Tasking' is an idle monster-hunting game. You will start as an archer and recruit your own team members, use gold coins to purchase powerful skills, challenge formidable bosses, and defeat them one by one, gradually conquering each continent.

name: Spaceport Trading Company
short_description: Players take on the role of a spacefaring merchant in a galaxy filled with diverse planets, each with its own economy, resources, and challenges. Amass wealth and reputation by trading goods, negotiating with factions, and navigating the intricacies of interstellar commerce.

name: ToyMaker
short_description: A creepy lost-media videogame from the past will haunt your dreams.

name: Frontera
short_description: Frontera is a fantasy city builder and colony sim where you start with a small camp at the edge of a dark forest. Build up your settlement and economy to attract more settlers. Form a military to clear the forest, and claim it for yourself!

name: FatalZone
short_description: FatalZone is an auto shooter with roguelike and RPG elements set in a savage world of zombies. Exterminate zombie hordes, collect resources, upgrade your camp, and level up mercenaries. Humanity must survive at any cost!
