name: Fate/Samurai Remnant
short_description: “Your wish shall perish...” A Holy Grail War begins in Edo Japan. A brand new Fate action RPG presented by TYPE-MOON and KOEI TECMO GAMES.

name: Bilkins' Folly
short_description: Percy’s on a quest to find his missing relatives, and he needs your help! Join him and his beloved dog Drayton as they adventure through a series of unusual islands, solve puzzles to uncover valuable treasure, and bring to light the foreboding family secret buried beneath it all.

name: Fungus Reaper
short_description: Mushlings are your friends ... until you turn them into delicious soup! An 'eerie' turn-based tower defense roguelite!

name: Clue/Cluedo
short_description: Step into new Crime Scenes. Use your skills of deduction to unravel the mystery and find out who did it, with what weapon, where. It’s the original crime-solving classic with new investigation formats exclusive to the video game. Solve every case and become the detective you want to be!

name: DreadFall
short_description: Embark on a chilling odyssey in Dreadfall, a horror platformer where you descend into your own nightmare. Fight monsters, solve puzzles, and upgrade your abilities as you journey through a haunting dream world.

name: Ticket to Ride
short_description: Travel around the world in an epic adventure that redefined the modern board game genre! Build a railway empire that connects the most popular cities, claim the most exciting routes and dominate your competitors in this fan favorite classic!

name: Let 's be a Mouse
short_description: Let's Be a Mouse is a fun and engaging game that allows players to experience life through the eyes of a mouse.

name: The Hospital of Fear
short_description: The Hospital of Fear - indie horror from the first person, in the genre of walking simulator. The main focus is on the atmosphere of horror, which is emphasized by realistic 3D graphics and immersive sounds, as well as a well-developed storyline with two endings.

name: The Smell of Death - A Tsugunohi Tale - STEAM EDITION
short_description: 'Tsugunohi' creator ImCyan's former 3D dungeon horror film is now available on Steam. The game also features a battle mode against monsters, and if you complete the hard mode, which is new to the Steam version, a later story will appear. Can you escape safely from the 'world of death'?

name: CYBERFIELD
short_description: Will you dare to challenge the Cyberfield champions? Gather a unique combination of skills and enhancers in this roguelike game to rise to the pedestal of the best warriors of the steel arena.

name: Kwark
short_description: Kwark is a single player game about a creature that has to go through levels and then something impossible happens at the end! The game can be both from 1 person and from 3!

name: Okashi Towers
short_description: Okashi Towers is a Halloween inspired Real Time Strategy game with Tower Defense elements. Gather candy resources to build tower units or go on offense and summon cute creatures to attack other player bases. Join with up to 8 players and choose one of the four factions that fits your play style best

name: Slave Princess Finne, why did she sell out her own kingdom?
short_description: War of Paragons. A war for world dominion waged by 'paragons', the representatives of their races. Once, it was the human paragon who won the war, damning elvenkind to the fate of slavery. A thousand years has passed. Another War of Paragons is about to begin.

name: The Path to Memento Mori
short_description: In 'The Path to Memento Mori,' players explore eerie mazes in a co-op multiplayer horror puzzle game, uncovering buried family secrets and facing relentless monsters. Teamwork and puzzle-solving are essential to unveil the haunting truth.

name: KAIKAN
short_description: KAIKAN is a vertical scrolling shooter that focuses on destroying enemies. Destroy enemies with 6 types of aircraft with different performance, clear 5 stages, and aim for a higher score.

name: YOHANE THE PARHELION -BLAZE in the DEEPBLUE-
short_description: Yohane the Parhelion is an official spin-off of 'Love Live! Sunshine'. Yohane's fantasy world sets the stage for a 2D metroidvania in 'Yohane the Parhelion: Blaze in the Deepblue'!

name: AutoDepth Image Viewer
short_description: View any image in 3D with automatic depth map generation and fun interactive gizmos.

name: Plum Blossom Divination
short_description: This is a simulated divination game. Use 'Plum Blossom Divination' to help customers divine, learn its contents, experience the fun of divination, and understand the charm of traditional Chinese culture~

name: Shave & Stuff
short_description: Take on the role of a barber and tattoo master. Set your imagination free, use the tools of your trade to fulfill your clients’ needs, or just have raw creative fun! Become the master of the new look!

name: I Love Finding Wild Friends
short_description: Discover lovable wild animals in this thrilling hidden object game!

name: Leap to the Top+
short_description: You are a frog, leaping automatically every second to the top. But can you beat all 7 of the grueling levels along with defeating powerful foes in this precision platformer? Can you get the best times for true mastery along with collecting all of the hidden collectables in each stage?

name: Puzzle Valley
short_description: Puzzle Valley is a puzzle game which is set in a small and peaceful world. The goal is to explore this world and discover new puzzles and some hints to solve them.

name: 廃遊園地のメメントメモリア
short_description: An abandoned amusement park in a broken world. It was a paradise called 'Lagoon' where children were self-sufficient. A boy working as a mercenary in 'Lagoon' happened to meet a silver-haired girl. The wheels of their destiny begin to move.

name: cluck-a-thon
short_description: Cluck-a-thon: Merge and create extraordinary chickens in this enchanting indie adventure. Discover unique chickens and immerse yourself in a charming world of feathered fun! Join the clucking frenzy today!

name: Revenge of ILCOIN
short_description: In a futuristic sci-fi action setting you will become “The Miner” and your mission will be to take your powerful weapons and protect your ILCOINS (The ultimate treasure in ILCs) from the space aliens pirates and the evil DBOSS leader.

name: Space Salvage
short_description: Space Salvage is a first-person adventure seeking game. Your job is to skillfully maneuver your spaceship through wreckage and asteroids while destroying mines and enemy factions! All while your eager yet amoral ship AI guides you. Do you have what it takes to dominate space?

name: HE ESCAPED
short_description: A horror roguelike that can be played solo or with up to 4 friends locally and online. Find the hidden keys in randomly generated rooms and escape before the time runs out or you find something else...

name: POP OFF 2
short_description: Vertical Precision Platformer you can play solo or with up to 16 friends! Soar, Strafe, and Ascend your way up with ballistic physics as you propel yourself to the stars! Compete with the in-game leaderboard, push your friends off cliffs, and reach the top and claim your superiority!

name: Stick to the Plan
short_description: In this game you can't pet the dog... because YOU are the dog! A relaxing and charming puzzle game about Roberto, a dog who really loves loooooooong sticks with a plan in mind.

name: KOSMO AZS
short_description: In 2033 in Russia, Vitaly is looking for a job to provide for his family. He is given a good chance to prove his ability to work and get an average paid job. Can he cope?

name: Tanked Out!
short_description: A local multiplayer tank showdown with multiple maps modes and customization that effects how you play.

name: THE MULLER-POWELL PRINCIPLE
short_description: Welcome to a breathtaking storyline full of portals, solving puzzles with an energy-absorbing weapon, and other adventures in a sci-fi atmosphere! Can you travel through parallel dimensions and uncover the secrets of your past?

name: Poems & Codes
short_description: Explore the wonderful world of poetry through deceptively simple cryptograms. 10% of every purchase benefits Project Gutenberg, an online library of over 60,000 free ebooks.

name: The Firm
short_description: A Tactical Turn Based VR Gunfest. Translating classical turn-based mechanics into VR. 48 physics-based weapons to choose from. 16 levels and lots of foes with their own abilities and armament. Many destructible objects.

name: Freak Crossing
short_description: An accident has made you the head of a lawless village...

name: My Little Universe
short_description: Stranded on a barren moon with nothing but your tools, fuelless ship, and celestial powers of creation, you are destined to recreate what was once lost and be the hero of your own Little Universe! Don't forget to call in up to three of your friends to join your journey in the Splitscreen Co-op Mode!

name: Flag Defender!
short_description: Get ready to defend the flag and prove your strategic prowess!

name: Order from Caos 2
short_description: Order from Caos 2 tells the story of Thomas, a man who lost his family, murdered by a cruel knight known as Asmodeus. Thomas embarks on a journey of revenge, vowing to destroy his most merciless enemy. However, one detail could change everything, his family might've simply never existed at all.

name: El Paso, Elsewhere
short_description: STAKES. GUNS. SLOW-MO. Fight werewolves and vampires in a reality-shifting motel. Dive through barricades to escape the grasp of evil puppets. Destroy the villain you loved. A new, third-person love letter to classic shooters. Neo-noir never looked so good.

name: Islands of the Caliph
short_description: Islands of the Caliph is an old-school inspired action RPG based on Middle Eastern folklore and Islamic spiritual tradition. A KEYBOARD ONLY 1980s style Dungeon Crawler with an open world.

name: Spellsphere
short_description: Spellsphere is a fast-paced action roguelike set in the far future where society has reverted to an era similar to the medieval ages. You play as a mage locked up in a dungeon while an evil sorcerer has taken over the island. Can you escape the dungeon, travel the island, and defeat the Sorcerer?

name: Lucky Dungeon
short_description: Delve through a series of dungeons full of terrors. Fight battles by stopping a board full of your equipment and skills. Press your luck to gain battle resources, but be careful. One bad roll and you can lose everything. This game doesn't contain any real-world currency gambling/microtransactions.

name: WitchSpring R
short_description: WitchSpring R is a story-driven RPG combining elements of collecting, simulation, and battling. Experience the joy of training a young witch and accompany her on a grand adventure!

name: Scavenger of Dunomini
short_description: The world's first match-3 trash pile defender! Protect and manage your pile of garbage while recycling it into deadly defenses against thieving drones.

name: Stand Your Ground
short_description: Defend attacks from enemies from all directions within a limited time. Only by making full use of the differences in each tower and choosing appropriate random rewards can you survive.

name: Кукуево / Kukuevo
short_description: Kukuevo is a unique experience for those who are into mystery stories and love visual novels. Get ready for an exciting adventure in a world of mysteries and mysteries where every step you take can determine the outcome of the game.

name: Heard of the Story?
short_description: Forge a medieval community with intelligent AI villagers. Gather resources and transform the village into a town, or simply listen to captivating stories from various simulated and evolving lives. All in a beautiful, relaxing, and immersive fantasy world.

name: The Guest
short_description: The Guest is a first-person psychological horror game that focuses on creating fear and tension for the player.

name: 豆丁人 DOUDINGMAN
short_description: This is a defensive shooter Roguelite game where enemies will be coming from the right side in an endless stream and you need to survive for a limited time to get through. If you can keep the goods on the left intact, all the better.

name: Joy Life
short_description: In the game, you need to find two cards with the same picture and successfully eliminate them. If the flopped cards are inconsistent, there will be no change. The way to pass the level is to eliminate all the cards in the picture.

name: Behind the Frame: The Finest Scenery VR
short_description: The serene, heartwrenching tale re-imagined for VR! Guide brush strokes and solve a variety of puzzles to help an aspiring artist complete her masterpiece. As her painting starts to take shape, learn more about her brusque neighbor, pesky cat, and mysterious past!

name: Knight Cats: Leaves on the Road
short_description: Welcome to Catstown, a scenic village with beautiful views, quaint cobblestone pathways, and stunning architecture!

name: Elis in Winterland
short_description: In Winterland, everyone is in a winter slumber, but summer has arrived. Can Elis, the only one to wake up, save Winterland?

name: Kill The Topulus
short_description: Kill The Topulus is a simple first person shooter, shoot accurately to survive the attacks of giant rats and become a master of the Topulus by completing all the challenges in each level.

name: Valdamour
short_description: Valdamour is a multiplayer asymmetric PvP where the exorcist player performs rituals in a haunted mansion, while the ghost player tries to stop him by using his arsenal of spooky abilities. Avoid the ghost's attempts at killing you before you can complete the final ritual and exorcise it for good.

name: Paw Paw Destiny
short_description: Should not have been born? A secret story that your buddy before meet you... (cosmic horror comedy) The experience of this artistic game is like a deep taste of aged Wine / good Cocktail / craft Beer.

name: Mall Craze
short_description: Mall Craze is a builder game where you build, customize, and take care of your very own mall! Construct various shops from clothing to electronics, and explore it's wide range of products.

name: Mighty Slap
short_description: Mighty Slap is a Player vs Player Turn Based slapping game. Time your slap with a time based bonus multiplier to land a powerful slap to your opponent. First player to knock out the opponent wins.

name: Out of the World
short_description: 【 In this world, 'only what you see' is true. 】This game is a 2.5D platformer puzzle action game in which objects seen by the character materialize, and when you meditate and open your eyes again, the object you saw disappears.

name: CHIN CHINNY CHIN MOUSE CHEESE CHIN TOES
short_description: Embark on a toe-tally awesome adventure as a relentless little mouse with a big appetite for nibbling toes. Explore a world spiraling into absurdity as you nibble your way through various states of societal collapse. Toe the line of hilarity and insanity!

name: Lost Dream: Overgrown
short_description: Immerse yourself in the captivating world of Lost Dream: Overgrown, a serene walking simulator that will take you on a tranquil and introspective journey through a mystical overgrown realm.

name: The Dev: Enter The Blockchain
short_description: A 3D platforming game revolving around the creator of Bitcoin, The Dev. As The Dev you must journey into the blockchain to bring honor back to the world of crypto with nothing but some ciggies, a gun, and your undoubted devving power. This is the best game you will ever play.

name: Cannibal Island: Survival
short_description: It was a dark and stormy night when the helicopter had to make an emergency landing on an isolated island. Unfortunately for them, fate had a cruel twist in store. As the storm progressed, the chopper was violently tossed and turned until it landed on an isolated island shrouded in mystery.

name: Baby Shark™: Sing & Swim Party
short_description: Swim across the wide ocean with the Shark Family to enjoy the Fin-tastic Festival. Choose from five customizable characters and play either in the runner or rhythmic game mode. Sing and swim to fin-omenal songs and get rewarded with tons of musical cards to add to your album.

name: Lost Girl
short_description: The plaything heroine used to be a policewoman who solved many big cases. Then he was framed by the mob and ended up in a notorious prison. In order to survive, players need to take on the role of the heroine and use violence against the prisoners in the prison.

name: Purple Place - Classic Games
short_description: Welcome to 'Purple Place - Classic Games' a fun-filled game where you'll embark on three exciting adventures like good old times! Get ready to immerse yourself in the world of creativity and challenge.

name: Offroad: Dead Planet
short_description: Offroad: Dead Planet is an offroading adventure game. Play as a young driver, journeying to Earth and unwilling to abandon the old planet to ruin. Experience complex vehicle physics, dynamic terrain, soft tires, a reactive driver, trash to pick up and robots, all while carving your own path.

name: Vice City Race
short_description: Welcome to the world of speed and adrenaline, welcome in Vice City Race!

name: Maze Shooter
short_description: Maze Shooter is a smart challenge, a maze adventure VR game that can be freely combined through maze gameplay. Before playing, SteamVR needs to be set to OpenXR.

name: Reincarnatio
short_description: 'Reincarnatio' is a village-building card game. Build houses, populate them with people, and work to acquire resources. Construct various facilities to develop and expand the village.

name: Pretty Overseer - Dating Sim
short_description: Pretty Overseer is an animated romantic dating simulator in the anime style. You are a young lieutenant overseeing the correction of magically talented individuals in the closed and isolated complex of the military Academy. Your main task is to maintain order and train recruits.

name: The Legend of Ogorets #2: Tsundere
short_description: An immersive, barebones-style interactive visual novel with choices, lore, and endgames. Do not read in the dark.

name: Out Of Shapes
short_description: Drop matching shapes on each other to create larger shapes. The more shapes you combine in one drop the higher your combo score. The game ends when you run out of space.

name: Quadrilla
short_description: Quadrilla is about high scores, big combos and simple arcade fun. Dig out and re-arrange blocks, clear lines, carve a path!

name: Златогорье 2
short_description: Златогорье 2 — представитель жанра RPG, с большим игровым миром и пошаговыми боями. В игре развитая ролевая система, разветвленная сюжетная линия, состоящая из большого количества квестов, каждый из которых имеет несколько способов решения.

name: 破月执行-The Broken Moon
short_description: The Broken Moon Execution is a text-based fast-passing supernatural puzzle game. Game play is diverse, players need to explore through the map, collect various clues to solve the mystery, and gradually understand the truth of the collapse of 'Samle' ......

name: The Paracelsian Project
short_description: You awaken in an unfamiliar location with unfamiliar people and are surrounded by mystery. Will you be able to solve the puzzle and uncover why you are here in this sci-fi/mystery/puzzle visual novel? The future hangs in the balance.

name: Hammerwatch Anniversary Edition
short_description: Choose between seven hero classes, each with unique capabilities. Brave hordes of deadly creatures alone, or band together with your noblest of champions in co-op mode available both online and locally. Take on the challenges in three different campaigns, or build your own custom scenario.

name: Crazy Cursed Grandma's House
short_description: Explore Japanese houses and deal with the curses that attack you!

name: Good Luck My Lord
short_description: Good Luck My Lord is a deckbuilding game where, as a feudal lord, your goal is to collect various resources to contribute to the King. Collect resources each week and submit resources each quarter. Try using different items, upgrading your fief, or obtaining special items to earn more resources!

name: Block Queencard
short_description: Are you up for the challenge? Are you ready to get some beautiful women? Come on, while eliminating blocks, while launching a final battle against the beautiful BOSS!

name: RUNGORE
short_description: Card game mechanics - check; Real time battles - check; Silly humor - check. If this isn't the game of your dreams i don't know what is (Also we have hidden memes everywhere lol)

name: Days Of My Life
short_description: What is human destiny? Do our actions decide much in our fate? What if I told you that life can be lived in different ways? What if you had asked that girl out on a date and your life would have been different? Well, nothing can be returned…

name: Power Champions
short_description: Explore the universe and protect Zarion from evil invaders led by the fearsome KillDeath. Join the Champions of Power, the most powerful heroes of the universe, to combat destruction and madness in an epic adventure and action game !

name: 猫咪公寓
short_description: Cat Apartment is a 2.5D, swivel, find gameplay, dynamic cat hunt game where you need to take care of all the cats in the apartment. Find cute cats hidden in a relaxing apartment.(Support English, bilingual subtitles!!)

name: GearBlocks
short_description: Explore a world of creative building, interactive machines, and gears - lots of gears. Build all things mechanical: cars, trucks, cranes, tanks, gearboxes, engines, clocks, anything you can think of. Test your creations to destruction in challenging scenarios, and share them in the workshop!

name: Hat'venture
short_description: Jumping into a hole may not be the best idea, but your hair has been stolen. Master the powers of hats and get it back.

name: Eye of artist
short_description: Eye of Artist is a 3D puzzle game where you have to place some items from a list where they belong. Look for clues in your surroundings, carefully study each yard and don't forget: it's not as easy as it seems at first glance!

name: Last Devil - Family Friendly
short_description: You are the Demon Lord Kuro on a mission to protect demonkind. Use your abilities to capture and ensnare others. Tumble with different personalities in this 2D rogue-lite shooter!

name: Snail Simulator
short_description: Have you ever wanted to be a snail? Now you can be! Move around (very slowly)! Look at the beautiful (low poly) scenery! MMOS (Massive Multiplayer Online Snails)! BECOME a snail (in a simulation)!

name: Fairyland Solitaire
short_description: Embark on an enchanting solitaire adventure in Fairyland, where the mischievous goblins have kidnapped the fairies, and it's up to you to rescue them while unlocking hidden treasures in a whimsical world.

name: Countdown Timer
short_description: Countdown Timer is back! Create custom coundowns for any game release or event in your life. Great for new years count down, birthday countdowns, weddings and other things you can't wait for!

name: Hellboy Web of Wyrd
short_description: Hellboy Web of Wyrd is a roguelike action brawler with an original story created in partnership with Dark Horse Comics and Hellboy creator Mike Mignola. When an agent of the B.P.R.D. goes missing, Hellboy is sent to investigate; pulling him into the depths of the Wyrd.

name: Game Time Glizzys
short_description: Game Time Glizzy's is a casual cooking simulator where you must manage your money, sabotage your competitors, serve swarms of angry customers and pay back a mountain of debt to keep your concession stand alive.

name: HAG
short_description: In Hag, players must explore and interact with an innocuous home environment in first person, solving intricate puzzles and an unknown mystery whilst escaping the clutches of a sadistic hag and her morbid son.

name: Tacape
short_description: Tacape is a deck-builder card game with roguelite elements for those who love a tactical challenge. Take part in a series of combats, build your strategy, upgrade your cards and face folkloric creatures along the way!

name: Bowave
short_description: An addictive game in which the player takes on the role of an elite archer who is tasked with protecting the tower from the onslaught of enemies.

name: SCOOMART
short_description: SCOOMART is a INDIE-HORROR game created from an inside joke about a pet! As the protagonist, you get stuck working the night shift at a local gas station. What begins as a normal shift quickly turns into a very confusing night.

name: Nemo is going to School
short_description: Our main character, Nemo, goes to school. He goes up and up, which is 351m above the sky. There's nothing else to do if you fall. Just to not be late, he have to go up without a break! There are dangerous things above. You have to hold back even if you're angry. Now, head to school!

name: Raddoll
short_description: A ragdoll physics infinite runner

name: Cozy Jigsaw Puzzle
short_description: Cozy Jigsaw Puzzle is not just a game; it's a serene journey that takes you to a world of beauty and peace. Experience the joy of solving puzzles in the coziest way possible. Get ready to lose yourself in the gentle challenge and embrace the art of relaxation.

name: Tomb Of AnuBI0S
short_description: Tomb of AnuBI0S is an unique 2D tower defense-platformer with an Egyptian Sci-fi setting. Defend the AI deity RAm from waves of undead 'Organics.' Upgrade your arsenal from weapons to walls, turrets, and your player capabilities. Immerse yourself in meticulously crafted levels and defend RAm!

name: Speed Master
short_description: Speed is everything! Just go fast! Only one button needed. Accelerate and try not to crash. Single player arcade, daily online circuits, weekly online championships, split-screen local multiplayer and multiple cars to collect. May the speed be with you!

name: In Fair Spirits
short_description: A sweet slice of life boys love / yaoi visual novel set in the English countryside about a medieval knight who's been reincarnated into the 21st century and a memey goth boy who's spent far too much time on the internet.

name: Omnigon
short_description: A humourous little adventure where you have the power to shapeshift other objects and wear a great big stack of hats

name: Redemption?
short_description: Death came unexpectedly.It's time to understand whether I have lived this life correctly.It's time to finish the story of my life and understand what punishment awaits me for my actions, or were they right?

name: Draft Day Sports: College Football 2024
short_description: Draft Day Sports: College Football 2023=4 puts you in the role of head coach for your favorite college football team. Recruit, gameplan and make the right calls on the field to lead your team to the top of the ranks and the college football championship.

name: ANONYMOUS HUNTING SIMULATOR
short_description: ANONYMOUS HUNTING SIMULATOR is a dynamic first-person shooter. Your task is to explore the location and collect ten masks to complete the level.

name: Ukemeowy
short_description: In the world of Ukemeowy, you play as an ukulele player, you can mix and match chords to your liking and create the tune you like. Enjoy the vast green scenery as you play the ukulele to your heart's content.

name: Hunter Nightmare
short_description: HunterNightmare 'is a horror survival game suitable for 1-2 players. You have been entrusted to come to this village and need to search for items scattered in the area. Burning three cursed items among numerous items will result in the death of monsters in this area and victory.

name: Salaryman RESCUE!
short_description: Dive into VR-exclusive Salaryman RESCUE!, a puzzle-management game set in the neon streets of Tokyo. Guide inebriated salarymen to safety, manipulate coin-operated machines, dodge bustling traffic, and thwart UFO abductions, all while soaking in the unique citypop atmosphere!

name: Haunted Things
short_description: Haunted Things is an indie horror game that you can choose as third person or first person view in carrying out survival horror actions. Play as Guna, looking for his brother who mysteriously disappeared. On his journey, he is haunted by bad things from other worlds and even from his own world.

name: The 7th Guest VR
short_description: The iconic supernatural mystery, The 7th Guest, has been brought back to life with cutting-edge VR technology, that delivers an atmospheric story like no other. Explore the foreboding mansion, solve challenging puzzles, and uncover its dark secrets.

name: The Bugger!
short_description: Welcome to Silicon Island, where you are the only programmer in town! You enjoy the simple life of diskettes and dial-up connections, until one day your boss ruins it with an email. He sends you some files to review, but your computer explodes and releases a swarm of bugs that infect the island.

name: Obesity Simulator
short_description: Obesity Simulator boils down to 'eating smart', you are at the mercy of your own choices ....... and maybe also the food flying straight at you. Eat to survive, but be wary of what and how much you eat.

name: Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl 2
short_description: Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl 2 lets you duke it out with the biggest and best fighting character roster yet! Choose your favorite brawlers, master their unique move sets, and use all-new powerful Supers to land the finishing blow with friends or across a unique, roguelike player campaign!

name: SUPER CRAZY RHYTHM CASTLE
short_description: It’s Super Crazy Rhythm Castle, the chaotic rhythm adventure! A puzzling co-op mashup unlike anything you've ever heard. Solo, or with a band of up to three friends … … Can you conquer the castle?

name: Deadly Rain
short_description: Deadly Rain is a survival horror FPS game that puts you in a terrifying fight for survival against hordes of scary mutants in a rainy, abandoned village. Find and manage resources to stay alive in the worst and most unexpected situations.

name: METAL GEAR SOLID 2: Sons of Liberty - Master Collection Version
short_description: The fourth game in the METAL GEAR series: set over two incidents in 2007 and 2009, featuring Solid Snake and Raiden, introducing new stealth gameplay features.

name: Celestial Force: Magical Mayhem
short_description: Celestial Force: Magical Mayhem is a beat'em up where you are in control of a Magical Girl preventing an alien invasion. Choose your favorite combatent and defeat the invaders with your elemental-adjacent powers and a lot of glitter!

name: Grozs Fantasy World
short_description: 'Grozs Fantasy World'A action adventure game where players take on the role of adventurers traversing various fantasy-themed worlds.

name: Kombate Mexicano Elexiones
short_description: Kombate Mexicano Elexiones is a fighting game featuring digitized stereotyped character trying to win the presidency of Mexico

name: Endless Maze
short_description: Try to get to the end of the maze, if there is one...

name: Holua's Arcades
short_description: Get ready to dive back into the pure joy of gaming. Prepare yourself for four thrilling games inspired by the arcade genre's all-time favorites. From challenging platformers, to epic space battles and classic beat'em up action. It's like having four arcade machines at your fingertips!

name: Many Eyed
short_description: These dark and desolate woods appear abandoned. Can you still hear the whispers of its missing hikers? They ache for you to investigate

name: Lost Alien
short_description: Lost Alien is a 2D pixel game that combines elements of platformer, puzzles and planetary exploration. Move through the levels passing various obstacles, dodging enemies, use the jetpack.

name: Destroy Korcity
short_description: Tower shooting game with cool music and endless enemies

name: PROTOTYPE
short_description: In the neon-lit world of PROTOTYPE, 07Vanguard, a powerful AI prototype, battles hordes of menacing robots. Equipped with combat techniques and a vast arsenal, it faces increasingly challenging enemies. Power-ups aid its survival, but the ultimate test comes with the appearance of formidable Bosses.

name: Balloon Chase Journey
short_description: A cute art style, 2D scroll casual action adventure game, you need to play animals flying in the air on a balloon, fight and trample the balloons of others to win. You will see diverse natural scenery, face unknown challenges, start a joyous adventure, bring back the balloon fight fun of childhood.

name: Sabbath
short_description: Paul is a humble employee of Sabbath incorporated. a strange company where not only humans work, but also mummies, robots and who knows what else. Paul's greatest dream is to become the president of Sabbath Inc., but to do so he will have to defeat the current president.

name: Arthur's Computer Adventure
short_description: Explore Marc Brown’s classic 'Arthur’s Computer Adventure'! Arthur and his friends bring the story alive one word at a time, fully animated and voiced. Increase the challenge and the fun with an interactive at-your-own-pace option with lots of bonuses and secrets to discover!

name: Quasimorph
short_description: Take on a role of a hardened PMC fighter in a dark turn-based extraction RPG. Engage in unforgiving combat, manage your ship and pile up the bodies of your clones to unravel the dark mystery behind threat to all life.

name: Where's My Loot?
short_description: A hidden objects game in a fantasy world. The loot from your last adventure was lost. Search around and find all your precious items back.

name: Quantum: Recharged
short_description: Dodge and encircle your enemies in this neon-drenched revival of the one-of-a-kind arcade classic!

name: Dungeon Bar: Gachi Puzzles
short_description: Dungeon Bar is a classic puzzle game in neonoir style. You will have to piece by piece collect pictures of legendary personalities of the Gachimuchi...

name: Saleblazers
short_description: Build a cozy shop or start your retail empire in this open-world survival shopkeeping RPG for 1-8 players! Be prepared to fight off cowboys, samurai, and demons as you scavenge for items to sell, all to fund your way to escape the Island.

name: Flying 'N Frying Popcorn Dude
short_description: With your trusty frying pan help Popcorn Dude as he embarks on a sky-high escapade to sate his insatiable appetite for candy! But watch out! Mischievous clouds and pesky little devils want to spoil the fun. Can you keep Popcorn Dude soaring high above the threats?

name: Green With Energy
short_description: A relaxing game where you become a power engineer and iteratively design, test and build power grid designs. Balance budget and efficiency across a variety of biomes. Will you build resilient systems, or cobble something together with duct tape? It's your choice.

name: AK-xolotl
short_description: The cutest, deadliest and ONLY top-down roguelike shooter featuring AK-wielding Axolotls. Blast your way through the animal kingdom with an arsenal of kick-ass guns, mighty power-ups and even raise an army of trigger-happy baby axolotls.

name: Lempo
short_description: Find your way back home before Metsänpeitto, an otherworldly plane of existence, consumes you. Lempo is a psychological horror game inspired by Finnish mythology with an emphasis on exploration.

name: Tower of the Mad Wizard
short_description: In this brutal action, rogue-like, survival RPG chose one of many wily adventurers dead set on conquering the Mad Wizard's Tower. To reach the his sanctum you must conquer hordes of enemies, their ruthless generals and navigate the twisted halls of the Wizard's labyrinth.

name: VADI
short_description: Build your own kingdom in the dark valley where zombies rule and stay safe from zombies. It is up to you to survive in this valley.

name: Witchcraft Survivors
short_description: Annihilate hordes of enemies in this thrilling, fast-paced action roguelite rpg and fill the screen with your magic. Kill your foes, become stronger each second and upgrade your characters with new spells and abilities. Can you survive the monsters that threaten your very existence?

name: Old School
short_description: Relive your school days in 3D, where old school graphics bring back timeless fun! Create your own star student and attend a schedule full of classes in time to gather the knowledge you need to thrive, while an equally important popularity contest challenges you survive...

name: Simple Game
short_description: It is a simple game. Help Chibisi make a pie. Simply collect five apples and the victory is yours. But you must not think if there is something hidden there...

name: Royal Romances: Endless Winter Collector's Edition
short_description: Sometimes saving one life can change the fate of many. Can you melt the ice in people's hearts?

name: George McGeehan Gamer Hero
short_description: George McGeehan wants to save a cat! Play this chill platformer by jumping onto light fixtures while avoiding annoying enemies!

name: Samira´s House
short_description: Uncover the dark secrets of Samira´s House! Explore a haunted house, solve puzzles, and confront ghosts. Can you escape in time?

name: Seas of Kahtaone
short_description: A fantasy naval combat action-adventure game. Explore the open ocean and fend off pirates with your cannon broadsides and magical arsenal. Summon the wind to boost your ship forward and release fireballs to light up your enemies. Upgrade your ships armor, weapons, and much more to win the day.

name: City Zombie Madness
short_description: City Zombie Madness is a tower defense game in a post-apocalypse military zombie setting.

name: Lost Pixel
short_description: Prepare to embark on an extraordinary journey like no other in Lost Pixel. You won't be stepping into the shoes of a traditional hero – instead, you'll take on the role of a lone, wandering pixel in a digital realm.

name: Dungeon Survival
short_description: A side-scrolling, turn-based character development game, where you play as a lord leading your heroes to brave the depths of dungeons.

name: RoGlass
short_description: RoGlass is a tile-based roguelite puzzle game where you place unique tiles to score points and unlock new spaces. Reset the board once you're out of tiles but keep progress on achievements, unlocks, etc. Keep expanding the board and try to unlock every achievement!

name: Star Sign
short_description: Extend your arms to swing around and slingshot yourself across huge open levels in this fast 3D platformer. Discover a broken world and find your way back to the skies!

name: Midnight Thunder Drive
short_description: Get your dose of '80s nostalgia! Blaze through neon streets, master turbo boosts, and chase victory. With a synthwave soundtrack and addictive gameplay, unleash your inner '80s racer!

name: Hero Trial
short_description: Hero Trial is a LOW POLY STYLE TOPDOWN light ROGUE game. Players play the role of medieval warriors, defeat monsters and survive！

name: WarWar Battle Kingdom
short_description: An exciting game that requires you to plan and analyze the situation. Get ready for exciting battles, incredible opportunities and exciting challenges. Become a great warrior and win this exciting battle of the kingdoms!

name: 與魔共舞 我的頌歌
short_description: Will you fall in love with the devils? In Shikou-cho, the devils and the vampires are secretly vying for the Grimoire in the dark. How will the devils deal with the upcoming occurrences? And what the future holds for you two after falling in love?

name: Ancient Viking
short_description: Ancient viking is a 2D platform game with RPG elements. Destroy enemies on the location and complete the set goal to go further along the storyline.

name: Stack World
short_description: Stack World is a physics puzzle game. Place all the given blocks and make sure they do not fall off the screen before the countdown timer hits 0. Enjoy over 100 levels of gameplay and use the level editor to create your own levels. Compete for the fastest times on the leaderboards.

name: Calcium Contract
short_description: Calcium Contract is a fast-paced first-person shooter where you're on a mission to finish a contract that got out of hand. Learn to swiftly move around your enemies and master your arsenal as you fight your way toward the grand finale.

name: Demonic Episode
short_description: In this 4 player first person online co-op horror game, play as a group of content creators who are on a mission to banish a demon back to hell. The advanced, randomized game mechanics offer you and your friends a high replay value.

name: Love Quest VR: Los Angeles
short_description: Build relationships with intriguing characters through thoughtfully chosen questions. To win a girl's heart, you'll need to ask all questions correctly and eventually invite her on a second date. Can you unravel her desires and emotions to make her your girlfriend by the end of the game?

name: Metal Casket
short_description: Single player simple horror game, inspired by 'Iron Lung'

name: Unloop
short_description: Unloop is an elegant, relaxing and satisfying puzzle game about using clever mechanics to connect and remove portals.

name: Captain Kalani Definitive Edition
short_description: Control the captain after receiving a distress call from the biggest Factory of robots of the world. Discover the utopian world that hide a big mystery, and find out who are the Robot's Syndicate behind the truoubles.

name: Halloween Defense
short_description: The top of strategy battle game! Build villages and train units to defeat ghouls

name: Mercenaries Saga 2 -Order of the Silver Eagle-
short_description: “Mercenaries Saga 2: Order of the Silver Eagle” is a tactical simulation RPG where you fight through 32 stages with Claude, Captain of the Silver Eagles and his team.

name: HANK
short_description: When an evil teddy bear wields dark magic to corrupt all the other toys in the house, it's up to HANK to defend his home before his family returns.

name: Thriller Garden
short_description: Inspired by Vampire Survivor. you need to complete various tasks in the raging waves of monsters. During the mission process, you can choose appropriate enhancement options from 120+ unique non-numerical upgrade options to amplify the character's advantages or cover up the disadvantages.

name: Paper Can't Fly
short_description: Fly, Build & Share! Soar through the most challenging of levels and unleash your creativity by building your own. The sky is the limit!

name: Racine
short_description: Racine is an Autobattler Strategy Roguelike. Use your cards to increase your heroes stats or cast powerful spells. Find some artifacts and new cards to develop your own play style.

name: Samawa Idle
short_description: Unleash the power of specialized towers to annihilate hordes of monsters in this idle game with roguelike elements. Collect gold, level up your towers, face powerful bosses, and refine your strategy with an evolving skill tree.

name: Stepan 's Life (Beta)
short_description: A simulator of the life of a Russian, where the player must develop his character and make decisions that affect his fate. The player must solve various puzzles and tasks to advance through the story.

name: Detective Montgomery Fox: The Revenge of Victor Draven
short_description: As the clock struck midnight, a valuable painting was stolen from the museum. The only problem is that the thief had no idea he actually... well, stole it!

name: Fantasy Monster Clicker
short_description: Are you bored? Then step into the world of Fantasy Monster Clicker! Enjoy and explore a world full of upgrades, levels, monsters and bosses.

name: Mobile Droid Gumda
short_description: Build, upgrade, and research mechs, weapons, and components. Manage employees and expand your base. Explore and collect resources. Find wanted mechs, destroy them, and collect bounties. Explore the post-nuclear wasteland and make the choices you believe are right.

name: Nour: Play with Your Food
short_description: An interactive exploration into the aesthetics of food.

name: UNCOVER
short_description: 本遊戲為回合制冒險ＲＰＧ遊戲。 你將扮演一位失去??的勇者，與夥伴一起踏上了一個不斷探索的成長的旅程。 旅程中的任何發現和戰鬥都會影響結局的發展，尋找、探索，那些埋藏起來的記憶碎片。

name: Survivors of the Dawn
short_description: Run-based roguelike bullet heaven where you create strategic weapon and item synergies to survive the ceaseless hordes. Remember, every step back is a step towards a whole new strategy.

name: Pact of the Ancients - 3D Bara Survivors
short_description: Pact of the Ancients is a 3D Bara Survivor Action game about a group of ancient heroes summoned forth to fight endless hordes of enemies and save the kingdom.

name: Bestial Reception
short_description: In the game 'Bestial Reception' the strongest survives, grab a weapon and start running towards the enemy. Shoot and destroy everyone who happens to be near you. Get new more powerful weapons with the help of earned gold.

name: One Button Run
short_description: Press the button to reach your destination!

name: Fly Caster
short_description: Fly fishing is not like ordinary fishing. Learning to cast a fly is a sport all on it's own. It's challenging, it's rewarding and it's a thing of beauty when done well. One you've mastered fly fishing there's no going back.

name: The Three Kingdoms Era in China 2000 years ago
short_description: This is a Chinese historical story game that chronicles the dusty past of the Sima Yi family during the late Han Dynasty and the Three Kingdoms period - the unification of the Three Kingdoms.

name: The Last Game
short_description: Explore a strange dungeon in this nervous action/bullet-hell roguelite shooter. Take the right decisions, find items synergies and build an overpowered and unique character. The Last Game takes inspiration from great games like 'The Binding Of Isaac' and 'Tiny Rogues'.

name: Human Multiplayer Game
short_description: I need you all to work together, in order for us all to win. Please hurry, before time runs out.

name: Dungeons of Mysteria
short_description: A first person roguelite with town building and a unique npc creation system.... assuming you live long enough.

name: Fastest Cars Traffic Racer
short_description: Fastest Cars Traffic Racer invites you to endless highways for speed and adventure! Prepare for a real racing experience with four different racing modes and eye-catching graphics.

name: Little Learning Machines
short_description: Harness the power of real neural networks to befriend, train, and solve quests with customizable AI robots. Each quest brings a new island to explore, opportunities to train your robots in increasingly complex skills with different items, and more brain-bending challenges to overcome.

name: Plinko : Ball Falling
short_description: Classic Plinko Game With New Theme and Challenge

name: Dead Matter
short_description: After a rampant viral outbreak causes global society to collapse, you must survive the harsh wilderness of the Canadian Rockies amidst vast hordes of Infected and rival survivors.

name: Quarta Amethyst
short_description: The Olicts, dangerous monsters that prey upon human energy, have been suspiciously active lately. It's your job to find out why and to put a stop to their plans.

name: Joy-N Help Me
short_description: JOY-N Help ME

name: 英雄远征
short_description: This simple idle game will take you into a magical world, making you a hero. With the freedom to mix and match skills, choose talents, interesting companions, territory construction, and a variety of challenges and life skills, your gaming experience will be even more perfect.

name: 三千大世界(Three Thousand Worlds)
short_description: 'Three Thousand Worlds' is a massively multiplayer online game (MMORPG). The game provides players with a lot of different quality equipment, and the pursuit of high-level (or best) equipment is one of the most important goals for players in the game.

name: CottageVille
short_description: CottageVille is a cozy idling game, where you can design your very own cottage and do various activities (such as planning, listening to music, etc.) on your own, and together with your friends!

name: Sclera
short_description: Sclera is a Lovecraftian turn-based strategy roguelike set in a dying, near-futuristic world. Through menu-style combat, text exploration and skill-check events, maintain your sanity and manage resources as you gather a dark essence needed to survive the inescapable eldritch horror now hunting you.

name: Fast Equality
short_description: Fast Equality - A game with a choice of actions in a mathematical environment. You are given a set of certain mathematical symbols, each of which can turn the entire course of the game, both simplifying and getting the desired number, and away from it by a huge number of steps!

name: Mortal Street Fighter
short_description: The player takes on the role of a fighter who has to fight enemies that appear on the way. The fight is mostly fisted, only from time to time the player finds some kind of weapon on the stage. The characters in the game have specific designs for fighters.

name: 沙漠花开
short_description: - This game is a Japanese role-playing game with a lot of yuri content. - Single plot mode, some characters' likability will affect the final ending, there are 5 endings. - More than 150,000 words of plot text. - Character exclusive drawing 22, CG base map 16 and various map pixels.

name: Flock Party
short_description: Move your arms and body to stay aloft and avoid obstacles in this colorful, bird-brained VR racing adventure.

name: Inside the Labs
short_description: Inside the Labs is a 1-4 player online co-op survival horror game. News of possible failed human experiments within an abandoned lab has piqued your curiosity. Explore the labs, collect evidence, identify the mutation, and survive it.

name: HeroTower
short_description: 'Hero Tower' is a game without regular monsters where you directly face challenging bosses. Dodge the boss's attacks through rolling and jumping, and seize the opportunity to counter-attack. It tests players' reflexes, stamina management, and insight into the boss's moves.

name: Harpoon Shooter! Nozomi
short_description: Shoot the harpoon and pull the enemies! Pull them in close and defeat for a higher score. For beginners, collect sweets instead of beeing attacked. You can enjoy retro and kawaii pixelarts, and deep game mechanics.

name: Simply Moose
short_description: Reflex-based puzzle game based on Boulder Dash principles, but with its own unique style.

name: Super Picture Cross
short_description: A casual and stimulating nonogram puzzle game with endless logic puzzles to solve. Uncover a huge variety of 3D objects, and discover new puzzles - never run out of fun.

name: Stab
short_description: Escape from the house of a crazy and chatty killer... Accomplish objectives and collect points... Get your name on the leaderboard.

name: Block Room
short_description: Beat the challenges of each mini phase, where knowing the right moment for the action helps you advance in the game. With platform and speedrun elements, perform your best stunts and moves to free your island from John Meat's ambitions!

name: (Dis)assemble
short_description: Combine characters with unique abilities in this co-op puzzle game! Together they are stronger, but apart they can be in more than one place at the same time...

name: Freeway Nightmare
short_description: Freeway Nightmare - A 2D game with an overhead view, the protagonist runs forward in his dream, wielding various guns, which can be improved over time by collecting materials from killed enemies. More enemies and obstacles appear as you progress!

name: Perfect Landing
short_description: Rocket towards victory in Perfect Landing, a 2D minimalist speedrun racer. Dodge obstacles, dominate leaderboards, and create your own physics-based levels for an electrifying challenge!

name: Supermarket Security Simulator
short_description: Welcome to your first day of work as security in our supermarket.In this job you will have to prevent theft, check tickets, monitor cameras, prevent robberies and keep an eye on the carts.Be attentive and efficient, manage your family and don't mess up.To the top team leader!

name: Plasmatic
short_description: Plasmatic is a puzzle-solving game where every level is a race against the clock. Follow the clues provided by an AI named SPIRIT, who will guide you through a series of increasingly difficult puzzles. Discover new levels, unfold the story, and decide its ending for yourself.

name: Cube Chaos
short_description: Cube Chaos is a complex strategy rogue-lite about placing units to create giant armies, factories, combos, or self replicating murder crabs, overwhelming and outsmarting your opponents. Build and adapt new strategies each run using a ludicrous variety of units, perks and more.

name: ANONYMOUS;CODE
short_description: Hack Into God

name: TaliVan
short_description: Gear up for an adrenaline-fueled adventure in a mesmerizing fictional desert like no other! Take control of an awe-inspiring super car in this exhilarating car game and buckle up for an exhilarating journey through treacherous terrains.

name: Paradise Architect: Idle Tycoon
short_description: Click to get money. Build buildings, develop the city infrastructure to increase passive income. Keep the infrastructure of the city in working condition by completing quests on time and get bonuses.

name: Riot of Willy
short_description: Is a horror game with an adventure twist. Your task is to solve puzzles and not to get caught by monsters. They all hear and see you, so be careful. Explore the locations and survive in this thrilling horror game

name: Wolf The Lone Hunt
short_description: Play as wolf with the ability to transform into a werewolf. Explore, hunt your prey and overpower mighty foes.

name: Hill Dig: The Mysterious Signal
short_description: Hill Dig is a digging adventure game where you will have to explore a world full of exciting and challenging puzzles in a variety of different biomes with a custom built vehicule. Explore a 2D voxel world, solve more than a hundred puzzles, improve your vehicule and go always deeper.

name: VReken
short_description: VRekken is a physics driven beat 'em up and self-defense trainer built for VR. You can punch, headbutt and kick (with additional trackers) the bad guys. If you have been learning martial arts you can use your skills to your advantage.

name: Shot Supreme
short_description: Sink baskets to score points, complete missions to buy upgrades, rinse and repeat. Shot Supreme is an arcade basketball game inspired by incremental games. Like a clicker, but you have to score baskets.

name: Elon Simulator - Spend Like A Trillionaire
short_description: Elon Simulator is an immersive Trillionaire Simulator with TONS of fun mechanics and activities. As Elon, you can: Smoke Weed (a lot), Print your own Money, Sell Lithium to Earth for BILLIONS, Make MILLIONS while you sleep in real life, Become a Trillionaire, and TONS more! Made by one dude.

name: INVERSE
short_description: INVERSE is a multiplayer horror game where 1 player is the monster and 4 other players work together as Agents to complete their objective and defeat the Nul monster. Play together or die alone in INVERSE!

name: Chain Ninja
short_description: Chain Ninja is an exciting action-adventure game designed and developed by an experienced game development team. In the game, players need to play a chain ninja, traverse the entire room by hanging ropes in the air, obtain keys, and avoid various obstacles and traps in the level.

name: Jump Like a Grad Student
short_description: Smith, lingering as a graduate student for 20 years, hears of a rumor about an island where room-temperature superconductors were found. This is his last ray of hope. Help him ascend to the peak of the island and turn his life around. 'Jump, Like a Grad Student'

name: Storm's Harvest
short_description: Storm's Harvest is a 2D retro-style arcade game where you play as a ghost harvesting as many pumpkins as you can before sunrise.

name: 大宋广记
short_description: 在北宋世界之中，找寻历史的变数！ 玩家将扮演一位流民，嘉佑二年科举入仕。经历了仁宗朝的安稳守成、英宗朝的党争初现......最终在神宗朝迎来了轰轰烈烈的熙丰变法。 江山如画，王安石、蔡挺、文彦博、司马光轮番登场。 天下纷纷，跻身宰执的你能否以一己之力扭转华夏乾坤？

name: Afterdream
short_description: Get lost in a lucid dream, bending the lines between reality and fiction. Utilize the strange camera to navigate through the ghosts' mysterious residence. Find the purpose of your nocturnal visit in a vivid and dreamlike setting.

name: Defenders of Cardom
short_description: Defenders of Cardom is a traditional tower defense game blended with deck-builder roguelite elements. Build your deck, play your cards right, and hone your strategy to defend against waves of enemies!

name: PROJECT : GENESIS
short_description: You wake up in a research facility and hear from the managing AI that humanity is in crisis due to an unknown virus. The AI requests that you conduct various experiments. Recognizing the dangers outside the facility, you decide to proceed with the experiments.

name: Fly With The Yellow Crane
short_description: Soaring in the daytime, where are you going? This game will give a possibility. The night is long, and the road is full of branches. Good and evil are difficult to balance. Beauty is disaster or blessing? Regrets long live in the world. I can only imagine the utopia in the fairyland.

name: i Pick Skills
short_description: 200+ skills, 9 heroes with different styles, dozens of world effects, and many unique equipment with random skills!

name: Cryoterror
short_description: A space horror game with retro-like pixelation and dithering effects, where you explore a desolate spacecraft and its mysteries.

name: Silly Frog
short_description: Embark on an enchanting journey with Silly Frog. Overcome obstacles in a beautiful swan's introspective realm to win her heart and understand her better.

name: GuardGrave
short_description: GuardGrave is an old school styled game in the vein of BurgerTime. Players must close the coffins on each stage before the sun comes up. 7 Worlds, 7 Bosses and 37 Stages of co-op monster bashing mayhem!

name: Wandering Sword
short_description: Wandering Sword is a Chinese martial-arts RPG where you play a young swordsman caught up in a feud and nearly dies. Escaping the event puts you on the path of pursuing the highest form of martial arts and exploring the pugilistic world to become the great hero you are always destined to be.

name: Beyond fantasy
short_description: Beyond Fantasy is a top-down shooter mixed with survivor-like elements. In-game mini-games give you the opportunity to acquire pets and colleague.

name: Detective Montgomery Fox: The Case of Diamond Necklace
short_description: The Case of the Diamond Necklace calls a famous city detective, Montgomery Fox, to the countryside to solve the mystery in this Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure Game!

name: Cave Digger 2
short_description: Go on a mysterious journey in the wildlands in this 1-4-player action-adventure game inspired by Western, Dieselpunk and Lovecraftian themes. Explore old mines, nautical caves and ruins of ancient civs to unravel the secrets of the valleys. But beware! Best to keep a 6-shooter close just in case.

name: Monastery
short_description: Step into a wild deckbuilder adventure in the Monastery's shadows. Battle unexpected foes, gather potent loot, and refine your deck. Gear up for the ultimate challenge against fearsome bosses, each with unique tactics. Every playthrough offers a whole new thrill. Are you ready for the showdown?

name: JACKPOT 2
short_description: JACKPOT 2 is a casual game. After starting the game, it has three wheels to turn. When the wheel stops, the icon stopped at the winning line matches the winning pattern, and the player will get the winning amount indicated by the winning pattern.

name: Wormhole: Battle for Planet Earth
short_description: Wormhole: Battle for Planet Earth - This is a fantastic third-person action game. In the game you are waiting for aliens, teleporters, dark matter and hurricane action.

name: UsoNatsu ~The Summer Romance Bloomed From A Lie~
short_description: This is a story about finding love to overwrite the feelings for the one they held dearest. A girls love visual novel about summer, love and adolescence.

name: HUNDRED FIRES: The rising of red star - EPISODE 3
short_description: Prepare for the climactic finale as Montenegro returns for one last mission. Use your stealth skills to rescue your beloved daughter, Merche, and unravel the trilogy's thrilling conclusion amidst intense action and suspenseful gameplay!

name: Breaking Box: Rush!
short_description: A physics puzzle game that can only rush

name: Trading Simulator
short_description: Build your financial empire in Trading Simulator by strategically investing in businesses, navigating a dynamic market, and using realistic trading mechanics. Are you ready to turn your financial dreams into reality?

name: DERE Vengeance
short_description: A meta-horror story about a haunted platformer game. Handcrafted pixel art, ghosts, and thrilling platforming await!

name: Poly Ego
short_description: Do you have what it takes to become the next test subject to pass my tests? I've crafted them with care! I'm looking for robots willing to be part of the...good robots! Use your logic to pass the laser experience tests and become a legitimate robot!

name: 666 Second Rule
short_description: 666 Second Rule is an action game where you take the role of a tormented parent battling relentless insects. Utilize dark powers to fend off their disturbing attempts to crawl into the baby's head. Embrace the darkness within and prepare for an intense and gritty showdown.

name: Hopping Up for It
short_description: A magician has stored a rabbit in his enchanted top hat. Inside the hat is a pocket dimension he uses for storage. But the rabbit can smell a bag of carrots outside... help the rabbit hop out, for freedom and carrots! As you hop ever-upwards in this challenging game, you can save any time.

name: Figurality
short_description: Figurality - A game with a choice of actions, by controlling the mouse cursor you must guide it to the correct figure before you hit the wall, the further you progress the more difficult the figures become.

name: GunDeck[100]
short_description: GunDeck[100] is a lightning-fast twin-stick shooter where you’ll build your arsenal from randomly-dealt cards. Weapons fire in a rainbow of elements with unique effects. Dart and dodge to survive the fireworks unleashed against you, and retaliate with your own display! Can YOU survive to wave 100?

name: Escape The Glubinka
short_description: December 6, 1994. the village of Glubnkovo. You were driving home after a very difficult day along an abandoned village and did not notice a tree peeking out ahead. In an instant, complete darkness overtook you and you passed out...

name: Cold Verdict 2
short_description: A direct sequel to 'Cold Verdict'. Another group of people wake up in a strange abandoned location, trying to find a way out and understand why they were put there. What is the killer's endgame in all this? A short interactive story with choices.

name: Mountain Bicycle Rider Simulator
short_description: Are you ready to experience the thrill of cycling on snowy mountain peaks? Mountain Bicycle Rider Simulator invites you to an unforgettable adventure with realistic graphics. Now explore and pedal to the top!

name: Neon Dash Tales
short_description: Neon Dash Tales is a balanced game between die & retry and puzzle-game. Avoid being hit by enemies and create safe place thanks to your trail to collect all the star at each level. Be careful to the different enemies behavior !

name: Fear Of The Darkness
short_description: Fear Of The Darkness is a narrative psychological horror game that will push you to face the serious phobias of some patients. Play as the enigmatic doctor, avoid being overwhelmed by the heavy emotional burden of your patients, come out of the Darkness and explore the various corners of the Truth.

name: Only Jump!
short_description: Only Jump is a timed vertical climber, jump by pressing space or A on your controller. Race to get to the top in the fastest time.

name: Pellet Dodge
short_description: A 2D top-down arcade-style game where you must evade and destroy the corrupted debris of space to rescue your friend from fueling the aforementioned corruption.

name: 都市物语 city story
short_description: City Story is a horror-suspense-declassification game. The story begins through the production of a paranormal program, where a newbie cameraman and a down-on-his-luck producer visit a series of paranormal legends happening in Japan for the program.

name: 24H Stories: The Blackout
short_description: You are a young boy. Tonight, your parents have gone out, leaving you alone at home overnight. Soon after, strange things start happening: your head inexplicably starts to ache, you realize your brother is missing, and there's a sudden commotion outside the door...

name: Something In The Well
short_description: Something stirs in the backwoods of Montana. You can hear it trying to get in. All you have is your trusty dog and a camcorder. A short 5-10 minute game with 2 endings.

name: Fading Afternoon
short_description: Seiji Maruyama is a middle-aged yakuza recently released from prison. Known as 'Gozuki' (one of the demon generals from Buddhist mythology) he is the power that his oyabun counts on. But there is one thing his aniki is not taking into account: Maruyama is getting old.

name: Monos: The Endless Tower
short_description: Guard the last remaining tower with an array of weapons and magical powers! In this unique tower defense on a tower game, the horde of monsters coming from down below is relentless, and it is your duty to dispatch them.

name: The Cursed Oasis
short_description: A relaxing first-person exploration game. Trapped in a mysterious, uninhabited oasis, you must follow the clues and break the curse before it's too late!

name: Road Rampage
short_description: Avoid all the cars and try not to crash in this fast paced endless highway game!

name: Elaria: The Corrupted Throne
short_description: Elaria is an old school inspired, top-down, story-driven ARPG. Slay, loot, play cards, dungeon dive, and unravel the storied mysteries of a falling kingdom in this epic tale of action and adventure!

name: Ocelot Sunrise
short_description: Die...and then die again in Ocelot Sunrise, the action roguelite with a dark and atmospheric comic art style and extra-galactic weapon combinations! Help is on the way, but can you survive?

name: Echoes of Fear
short_description: Solve clues left by the valley's previous inhabitants to determine the location of the Artifact. Your task is simple. Get in, get the artifact, and get out.. Alive.

name: Idle Catfarmia
short_description: Help the cat fairies to arrange resources, produce and harvest crops, and manage the farm. The more efficiently the farm grows, the richer your pockets become. Show some clicking skills to unwelcome visitors who occasionally appear on the farm.

name: Cerulean Days
short_description: On a seemingly idyllic island, the Internet is shut down. What will become of those unable to adapt? In 2018, a lethal biological attack claims a significant number of lives. While tragedy occupies people's minds to the brim, a controlling governmental plan is put into effect.

name: Drift Survivor
short_description: Paying Tribute to Classic Arcade Shooting Games. Drift Survivor is an addictive and fast-paced arcade shooting game that combines 'drifting' with a 'bullet hell' gameplay style!

name: Bump and Run Racing
short_description: Get ready to tear up the streets and smash your way to the finish line! Bump & Run Racing is an ode to classic arcade racers where crashing opponents is not only allowed, but encouraged.

name: My Mundane Life Is Threatened by the Tropes of an RPG!!!
short_description: Natsuna's boring mundane life is interrupted by Slimes, Boss Monsters, and Unpaid Overtime!

name: Gordy and the Monster Moon
short_description: Gordy and the Monster Moon is a bite-sized exploration-driven game about a pumpkin astronaut going on spooky adventures.

name: 长征1934-1936
short_description: his is a role-playing turn-based game based on the history of the Red Army's Long March. You will play a mass,soldier or cadre and follow different Red Army units to experience the Long March!

name: The Johnny Papa
short_description: The Johnny Papa is a strategic multiplayer horror game with 3 main characters, 5 side characters and 1 murderer. Welcome to the village of Agris.

name: DON'T SCREAM
short_description: If you scream, you restart. An Unreal Engine 5 short horror experience made by two indie devs. The challenge: explore the forest for 18 minutes without screaming. The catch? Time only ticks when you move. It’s the perfect game to scare the pants off your friends and family. MICROPHONE REQUIRED!

name: Veriscape
short_description: Veriscape is a 2D side-scroller/rhythm game where the stages are generated using music

name: Elemental Escape
short_description: Bullet hell, but kill the bullets instead of dodging them ;)

name: Starri
short_description: Starri is a body-controlled rhythm game you can play with just a webcam, no VR required. Feel your heart pumping as you slash or catch the beat, dodge obstacles, and turn the wheel. Engage your body with music from Indie classics, Global Top Hits and Asian lineups.

name: REMEDIUM
short_description: The fast-paced twin-stick shooter game in the grim post-apocalyptic Renaissance setting. It had been more than a hundred years since the terrible plague devoured the whole continent and turned almost everyone there in the maddened mutants.

name: Lair of goblins
short_description: Clear the cavern of goblins by hunting as many as you can in this action Roguelike. Seek out and kill their king if you are able, but above all, recover the stolen gold.

name: Kuroinu 2 Redux
short_description: As the Nation faces invasion from the peoples it has pillaged for a century, one man defends it: Derek Rondo, the second coming of the Mercenary King Vult. He fights for his country, but plots to seize the throne for himself... A new visual novel betrayal epic begins from within!

name: Stereograph Museum VR
short_description: Step into a mesmerizing world of vintage wonder with Stereograph Museum VR, an enchanting virtual reality experience that transports you back in time to explore a captivating collection of 1200+ high resolution antique 3D stereograph images.

name: TerraForge
short_description: Be the best blacksmith! Manage your mining operation, mine resources, craft items to sell for profit. Upgrade your mining tools, unlock new blueprints, discover powerful relics and go deeper and deeper!

name: Greedy Chicken
short_description: Greedy Chicken is a 3D arcarde 'endless-runner' type of game where you need to lead small chicken through the numerous obstacles, highway passes and collect as many coins as you can.

name: Come Together
short_description: A Puzzle-Adventure game where you have to connect 2 squares together, but the player changes every time you move. Will you be able to keep track of two squares on this adventure full of puzzles, items, secrets, difficult challenges, quests and mechanics?

name: Tank War Shooting Simulator
short_description: Experience the excitement of tank wars with the Tank War Shooting Simulator! Feel like a tank driver with realistic graphics and various game modes.

name: Skybreakers
short_description: Skybreakers is an action roguelike thriller. Choose from various characters, arm yourself with a vast array of weapons, and create your own unique build by combining artifacts, random talents, abilities, and bonds. Plunge into exhilarating combat and use unique abilities to defeat the evil.

name: Superbot Arena
short_description: Design your own Superbot and fight alongside or against others in this VR battle arena! Make your own motion gestures to activate a variety of abilities and effects to aid you in destroying your opponents. Includes AI bots and different game modes like 'smash off' and endless play.

name: 诡雅异俗
short_description: NodeGame，原版游戏名为：脱出ゲーム | Nodes，由岩崎、はとむね开发，并在日本举办的GAMEJAM上首次亮相。 诡雅异俗，出自。原意为：与雅正相悖与长俗相违，也指异端邪说。 之所以选定这个名字，是因为我感觉他更有神秘感，也代表了很强的创作能力！！

name: Dreadhunter
short_description: Plough through hordes of deadly monsters and defeat vicious bosses in an intense fast paced shooter RPG where all items are “legendary”, levels are ever-changing and combat is razor-sharp.

name: Beast Slayer
short_description: Embark on an adventure in an 8-bit open world where monsters roam free. Track down and defeat dangerous beasts. With different classes & genders, skills & spells, each time you play will be different. Feel the nostalgia as you listen to an 8-bit soundtrack while flying on the wings of a dragon.

name: Goblin Daily Life
short_description: Goblin Daily Life - 3D walking game with elements of time management and survival. You have to perform the routine work of a usual goblin, whose duties include maintaining order in the forest. Have time to feed the animals, harvest, heat the house and many others tasks.

name: Freaky Trip
short_description: Put your imagination to the test and go on a freaky rescue trip. Help rescue Salcy’s beloved cockapoo from unknown danger in which she was sure to find herself. In Freaky Trip you will encounter many logical puzzles, which you can find everywhere.

name: The Legend of Yan Loong 1+2
short_description: A nostalgic collections of the chapter 1 and 2 of “Yan Loong Legend” series. Pick up your sword again, transform into Yan Loong, Zhi Loong or Shui Yan with your friends to have a battle of light and darkness with the final boss Bai Loong and regain the occupied Green Hill Lake.

name: Baker Street Breakouts: A Sherlockian Escape Adventure
short_description: 'Baker Street Breakouts' combines the thrill of an Escape Room with the storytelling of an Adventure. Use your superior deduction skills in this story-driven mystery to help Sherlock deducing his way through an old film studio to finally face his arch nemesis Moriarty. Become a Master of Deduction!

name: Golden Leaf Jigsaw Puzzles
short_description: Unfold the tapestry of the season, from golden forests to festive harvests. With breathtaking artwork and a heartwarming narrative, it's an ode to autumn's splendor in puzzle form.

name: The Smurfs 2 - The Prisoner of the Green Stone
short_description: With your crack team and the help of the SmurfoMix, liberate the village of the Smurfs from the grip of the Green Stone!

name: Death Unphased
short_description: Invent your own path! Phase through walls with your dash and blaze towards the exit. Death Unphased is a short experience fusing precision and puzzle platforming. Speedrun the smartest routes and aim to beat your fastest time in each level.

name: Apothecary Hero
short_description: The player will take on the role of a hero. being summoned to another world In order to help the people of this world, 'Kaphrao' must concoct a medicine to successfully cure the 'Plague' caused by the death of the 'Demon King'!

name: Arcade Sundown
short_description: Challenge the pinball people! Get shrunk down and play a mad points-scoring game inside pinball machines. Feint, travel, and tackle your way to high score glory — all’s fair under the glass.

name: Thirsty Suitors
short_description: Thirsty Suitors is a stylish, story-driven turn-based RPG. Battle your exes. Disappoint your parents. Find yourself. Play as Jala on her journey to heal the wounds of her past through fantastical turn-based combat, skateboarding, and cooking.

name: Ogo
short_description: Ogo is an arcade twin-stick shooter where you control yin and yang to defeat your enemies, complete varied levels or just relax in different endless game modes.

name: Halloween Stories: Horror Movie
short_description: Four friends are pulled inside a movie where the special effects are all too real!

name: Doughbee
short_description: A real time wave based roguelike about battling doodle creatures and collecting perks along the way, with ranging effects from elemental damage to things like rammer Doughbee and even a scorpion mech, see how far you can make it through this bullet hell of a nightmare.

name: Auto Checkup Simulator
short_description: Auto Check Up Simulator is an immersive simulation game that offers realistic car inspection and driving experience. Earn money, buy and upgrade vehicles, manage the economy, and prove yourself in the world of automobiles!

name: Defenders Guild
short_description: A thrilling fantasy tower defense game! Instead of towers, you'll recruit and lead brave adventurers in the fight against hordes of evil enemies. Do you have what it takes to lead the best guild of defenders and safeguard the land from the growing darkness?

name: I commissioned some ladybugs 2
short_description: I paid more artists to hide ladybugs and aphids in 20 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

name: Bald Man Climbs Up
short_description: A bald man with a unique weapon attempts to get as high as possible

name: The Events at Unity Farm
short_description: Adventure, dark fantasy and a dash of steampunk, EVENTS AT UNITY FARM is a fresh take on Open World VR. Use your ancestral power to cast spells, overcome undead evils and merciless bosses. Gather and craft potions, search for clues to solve puzzles all to stop the impending Multipocalypse.

name: I commissioned some cats 2
short_description: I paid artists to hide cats and wool in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

name: Choose Your Cutie
short_description: The girls are ready to meet you! Each of them is special. Choose your cutie!

name: Fae Farm
short_description: Escape to the magical life of your dreams in Fae Farm, a farm sim RPG for 1-4 players. Craft, cultivate, and decorate to grow your homestead, and use spells to explore the enchanted island of Azoria!

name: They Are Coming
short_description: They Are Coming is a hybrid game that combines roguelike, tower defense, and base building in a side-scrolling shooter format. It offers a straightforward gaming experience for pure enjoyment.

name: SUPER BOMBERMAN R 2
short_description: The latest title of the party battle games series SUPER BOMBERMAN R! With new adventures and game modes, it has the largest content volume in the series' history!

name: You are the Judge!
short_description: As a judge of the Kobardde court, solve complex cases inspired by actual events. Your decisions will directly affect people's (and perhaps yours) lives. You may have to make difficult decisions for your family, country, and life. What kind of judge will you be?

name: Hand Simulator: Aliens
short_description: Hand Simulator: Aliens is a multiplayer game where your mission is team survival. You either battle infected colleagues, saving the ship and crew, or sow chaos and death as an infected member.

name: Challenge from the Black Cat
short_description: Old-fashioned block crumbling with a cat motif Simple controls allow a wide range of players from small children to adults! It also comes with an ending! The volume has been increased to play up to a total of 10 stages! Can you win the challenge from the black cat?

name: After University
