short_description: As a desperate unemployed university graduate, your dreams seem distant until fate guides you to your uncle's worn-out doner restaurant in a new city. Dive into a world where gangsters lurk, and true love Amy reappears. Your goals are clear: Achieve Career Success, Get Married, and Earn Respect.

name: Faded Stories: Full Moon
short_description: Unburied and forgotten undead gather in the city center, while the citizens of Greenberg go about their day-to-day lives.

name: 808s&Genetics
short_description: A puzzle game that combines nonogram and genetics rules.

name: Extraordinary: Soul
short_description: 'Extraordinary: Soul' is a hand-drawn wind suspense story puzzle game, the story takes place in a shamanic legend of the town of Mutuso, you will follow a naughty robot Moe to investigate an unusual disappearance case.

name: Insanias
short_description: In Insanias you must explore what happened to find a truth that only you can find. To do so, you must be able to control your sanity to avoid falling into the madness that lurks around every corner. Are you ready to face your fears and discover the truth?

name: Root Of Win
short_description: Root of Win is a 3D puzzle game where you solve levels with a friend in a co-op or alone.

name: PowerWash Adventure VR
short_description: In PowerWash Adventure, you are a magical janitor on a whimsical rinsing journey across different themes. Upgrade your water gun to flash away dirts and restores items to their original states. Enjoy varied scenarios in dream mode, clean graffiti or design your own unique stage to share with others.

name: The Elephant Collection
short_description: Say helloaphant to jmtb02’s classic series of elephant games–now remastered into one elephant-sized package!

name: Space Shark Wrangle Fest
short_description: Space Shark Wrangle Fest is a fast-paced, top-down 2D action arcade game where you wrangle space sharks! Collect power-ups, hit combos, and fly through wormholes that react to the beat of the energetic soundtrack. A fresh take on classic arcade gameplay that's packed with adrenaline and excitement.

name: Nordland Mahjongg
short_description: 'Nordland Mahjongg' offers many hours of challenging gaming fun for both beginners and passionate Mahjongg players. Enjoy different, hand-drawn tiles sets that can be coordinated with beautiful backgrounds.

name: One Night: Burlesque
short_description: Step into the smoky, seductive world of the Angels Den, a luxurious burlesque club. Get into the high heels of Holly, a talented dancer graced with a unique gift of telepathy. Help her on a desperate mission to save a friend from certain doom.

name: Planet of War: The Legend of Fu
short_description: Save the world the way you want to: Most main and side quests as well as the game itself have several endings depending on your choices. A tactical combat system with over 100 different character and equipment skills. Over 20 hours of gameplay and over 20 original soundtracks.

name: Haunted Hotel: Pheonix
short_description: Uncover the truth behind the legendary fire that destroyed a university.

name: Evil Officer
short_description: Evil Officer is a mystery horror game where you are stuck in a Jail. Solve the puzzles to pave your way out. Stealth is the key to surviving this scary adventure. Multiple game modes to challenge you in different ways.

name: 淤積的祈禱（Silted Prayer）
short_description: A hundred years ago, the chaotic world was suddenly pacified by the sword saint Nedidora, gradually moving towards peace. However, the crisis of the curse of all things was also uncovered... On the dark world tree, what kind of things will Karulu, as a lord, encounter...

name: Idle Exorcism Hero
short_description: This is an idle turn-based combat game. While obtaining the best equipment, it doesn’t require too many operations.

name: Bluey: The Videogame
short_description: Play a brand-new story set across 4 interactive adventures, explore iconic locations, play your favourite games from the TV show and also play with your friends and family in local multiplayer.

name: Adrift in the Backrooms
short_description: Adrift in the Backrooms is an adventure multiplayer game that is a mix of backrooms games and more traditional co-op.

name: Sandtrix+
short_description: Retro Falling Sand Puzzle Game

name: AfterWar
short_description: AfterWar is a new global strategy about the world in 2024

name: Dawn Destiny's Child
short_description: Dawn Destiny's Child is an RPG turn based storyline game. Players will play the role of tribal leaders, creating different storylines and endings in their interactions with various NPCs. Ultimately, players will learn the truth about gods and humans under the Tree of Life.

name: Shadows of Rogue: The Sorcerer's Curse
short_description: In this roguelite game, you'll face increasingly hordes of enemies and formidable bosses, all while discovering an array of valuable items and surprises along the way. Prepare for a casual yet intensely challenging gaming experience, with a wide range of battle combinations at your disposal.

name: Folk Hero
short_description: Folk Hero is an action-slasher with rogue-lite elements set in the world of Slavic fantasy. Explore the ever-changing island, find treasures, combine weapons and artifacts to defeat mythical enemies. Challenge your skills! One life, one try.

name: LOCURA
short_description: LOCURA is a first-person immersive horror game. It is a thrilling journey into the unknown. Prepare for moral ambiguity where the line between light and darkness blurs.

name: Dolphin Spirit: Ocean Mission
short_description: Explore the island of Maupiroa and discover its deep-sea secrets!

name: Invincible Presents: Atom Eve
short_description: Become Atom Eve and take control of your own path as one of the most powerful superheroes in the Invincible universe! Unravel a mystery and balance the dangers and responsibilities of being a superhero with the relatable challenges of everyday life.

name: 月光下的冒险-Moonlight Adventure
short_description: 《Moonlight Adventure》 is a strategy card game, featuring fairy tale-style vertical graphics. Let’s build your deck. In the forest under the moonlight, monsters are infested. The brave man is about to experience a mysterious adventure, exploring the restraint relationship and genre of the deck.

name: Bunny Guys!
short_description: Welcome to Bunny Guys! Dive into an exciting climbing adventure, experience discoveries and emotions, courageously conquer obstacles on your way to the top. Your determination accompanies you on this unforgettable journey!

name: FLEX Disc Golf
short_description: Play countless disc golf courses throughout the world, find lost discs or buy new ones, and learn new throws and styles! Experience realistic gameplay while being surrounded by highly detailed nature.

name: YetiFree
short_description: YetiFree is a retro role reversal of the 90's classic SkiFree. Smash, slam, and blast your way down the slopes to rack up the highest score. The Yeti must feed!

name: C.I.E.B The Backrooms
short_description: CIEB The Backrooms Project is a base building rouge-lite explorer game where you traverse the backrooms, Encounter Entities as you collect photos and turn them in for cash. DEATH is permanent and every run is different so be sure to turn in your spoils when you can. you may lose it all.

name: Astrosmash
short_description: ASTROSMASH® was originally a Shoot´em up game for the Intellivision® console in 1981. This reimagined version is based on the game’s original theme and gameplay but much more exciting and challenging. The new graphics are phenomenal and the amazing background music adds a lot of excitement.

name: The Queen's Quest
short_description: “The Queen’s Quest” is a fantasy point-and-click adventure game and Yuri dating sim. Play as Elysia Fernwhisper as she goes on an epic quest for Queen Drusilla that takes her across her vast and majestic kingdom. Along the way she will meet many beautiful women and may even fall in love!

name: CADDE
short_description: Are you ready to let it rip in the streets of İstanbul? Cadde combines fun physics, realistic sound design and the atmospheric air of İstanbul.

name: Daydream Mosaics 4: Shades of Blue
short_description: Join the Twin World saga's latest chapter as you dive into the mesmerizing underwater kingdom of the Azure World. Solve nonograms to restore submerged sanctuaries, and explore the tranquil beauty of the deep blue. Enjoy added challenges with hidden object, spot-the-difference, and jigsaw mini-games.

name: It's Dungeon Time!
short_description: It's Dungeon Time is a simple 2d puzzle casual game. Start out with the simple soldier or warrior class. Descend into the dungeon and survive against hoards of skeletons, zombies and other creatures.

name: Room cleaning
short_description: Room cleaning - addictive game to help you relax. You are only hiring and offering a solution for cleaning dirt, stains and waste disposal and offer it in perfect order! use all available items that can be used in your task!

name: CatExpress
short_description: Cat Express is a relaxing and healing game that combines running, fishing, and collection gameplay. In the game, you can play as a cat to complete express delivery tasks and earn coins to buy various furniture to decorate your cat house. In your free time, you can also go fishing to relax.

name: Split square
short_description: Split Square is a deck building rogue-like game featuring cute pixel characters. Defeat all enemies in a random block space and collect rewards to build a stronger deck!

name: PolyCity Stories - The Affair
short_description: The first short story from PolyCity. A point and click adventure delving into the dark and dirty polygonated corners of the City of angles... mostly right angles. The Affair follows a soft boiled/over easy private detective as he unpicks an organised crime syndicate operating across the city.

name: STAR FLEET II - Krellan Commander Version 2.0
short_description: Welcome to the future of space warfare! Star Fleet II: Krellan Commander puts you in command of an advanced space battlecruiser and tasks you with exploring sectors, fighting and boarding enemy ships, and invading planets. Manage your ship, crew and escorts effectively and find your way to victory!

name: 传说之始
short_description: 'TheBeginningOfLegend' is a Diablo like game where you can freely combine your understanding of equipment, skills, and runes to build your own exclusive BD, and through your own efforts, grow from an unknown person to a legendary character who saves the world.

name: Carousel
short_description: Ready to start unlocking your puzzle skills? Come on, challenge and bring the beautiful image back to full display!

name: Sniper Wild West Shooting Simulator
short_description: Experience the thrill of sniping in the Wild West! Realistic FPS experience awaits you with Sniper Wild West Shooting Simulator. Shoot your enemies with one shot and become the best sniper.

name: Broken Spectre
short_description: 25 years ago your father climbed the mountain and never came back. Now he’s calling for you. Broken Spectre is a narrative cosmic horror game from one of the creators of The Blair Witch Project. Can you unravel the mystery of your father who disappeared in the remote wilderness 25 years ago?

name: Jumanji: Wild Adventures
short_description: Explore Jumanji’s lost world of dangerous beasts and secret treasures.

name: Cursorblade
short_description: Cursorblade is a bullet hell game where you play as the cursor, fighting your way through waves of enemies. Combine weapons and items to become more powerful with your own unique builds. Slash, dodge, upgrade, and repeat!

name: Last wish
short_description: Last Wish is an interactive non-linear novel in the mystical detective genre. Student Kris is on the trail of a mysterious killer. What awaits her around the next corner is up to you to decide.

name: Strange House
short_description: Сity of sadness, where everyone tries to survive, in which there is no place for anyone and which is infinitely huge. It absorbs everyone who is not ready to live by his rules. Are you ready for this?

name: Plunder Islands
short_description: A fast paced 2D platformer, Plunder Islands has you running, jumping and climbing for treasure. Are you ready for the challenges the islands reveal?

name: Wizardry: Proving Grounds of the Mad Overlord
short_description: Wizardry: Proving Grounds of the Mad Overlord is a full 3D remake of the first game in the legendary Wizardry series of RPGs.

name: Super Adventure Hand
short_description: Hands down the most adventurous and handsome hand in the world! You play as a hand on a gripping handventure where you single-handedly face dangerous obstacles and de-feet a handful of evil feet.

name: Godzilla Voxel Wars
short_description: Get ready to battle using your brain! A full-fledged turn-based strategy game with a difficulty level: GODZILLA! Godzilla, Mothra, King Ghidorah, and more are here to rampage across an 8x8 grid! Control Toho monsters and save the world from the Fungoid mushroom invasion!

name: Tornado
short_description: 200 feet. 600 knots. Adrenaline off the scale.

name: Football Streaker Simulator
short_description: We all thought about it, and now you can give it a try. Run onto the football field, take a selfie with your favorite player, escape from a huge crowd of stewards, and disrupt the game for the entire stadium. What could be better?

name: Battlethorne
short_description: Battlethorne is a third person Conquest game with rpg elements and large scale battles. Conquer bases in a large open world, gaining loot and vanquishing your foes. Fight against multiple factions in a four way war across a 4.5 km2 open world using six unique weapon classes.

name: Gehinnom
short_description: Gehinnom is a multiplayer horror game for 1-4 players. collect clues and complete various quests to perform a ritual and banish the demon that hunts you. Everything in Gehinnom is randomly generated, so you will always be scared.

name: Only Up: With Friends
short_description: Only Up: With Friends is a multiplayer parkour game where speed is essential. Race against your friends to the top by climbing a variety of dynamic obstacles. One mistake and its back to the start...

name: Panda Choice Mahjong
short_description: The panda has made her choice! Follow her into the wonderful world of the most ancient game.

name: Cashier Simulator
short_description: Have you ever wondered what cashier job feels like ! Here is a simulator game for you to experience that, Sit back, relax and watch some in game TV shows while serving those customers

name: Alpha Sorcerer
short_description: An elite sorcerer king with forgotten magical powers mysteriously reappears in a bloody quest for revenge in the supreme action platformer.

name: Guardians of Lodino Forest
short_description: This is 'Guardians Of Lodino Forest' (G.O.L.F. for short); a surreal need to play experience, an amazing hybrid sports action-adventure rhythm game about shooting an Armored series of giant golf ball boss Guardians into submission and then striking them back into their lair for a hole in one!

name: Paramorfosi
short_description: Atmospheric horror thirds-person experience

name: Ninja Party
short_description: Ninja Party is a 2-4 player local multiplayer game! Play as one of four ninjas in disguise and blend in with the townsfolk. Identify your friends and take them out... or enlist the help of an aggressive yet adorable dog to do the dirty work for you.

name: Square Dungeon 2
short_description: 'Square Dungeon 2' is a dungeon exploration + roguelite text-based indie game. The demon king left a prophecy to the human king before death that the warriors would betray him when the Armageddon came. As a warrior, what will you choose on the Armageddon?

name: Knuckle Sandwich
short_description: Knuckle Sandwich is a turn-based RPG by Andy Brophy. Get a job, beat up some monsters, and solve a mystery that's plaguing Bright City.

name: Mini Continental Saga
short_description: Mini Continental Saga is a biotope strategy history card game letting you freely stir small worlds! Human, elf, slime? Or lead your fishman to create your favorite fictional world! One play takes 5 to 30 minutes. Weave a tale that you've seen somewhere before, but doesn't exist anywhere else!!!!

name: Disgaea 7: Vows of the Virtueless
short_description: Disgaea is back and better than ever in Disgaea 7: Vows of the Virtueless! Join Fuji as he embarks on a perilous journey of redemption, and experience unique features new to the Disgaea series!

name: Dance Dash
short_description: Stomp the beats in this pulse-pounding, full body sensory symphony. Craft your own rhythm, groove to community music, maps, and mods.

name: Spectrum Forces
short_description: Make up your squads out of 9 unique spaceships and go clear 3 planets from hordes of robots in not-so-classic horizontal shoot-em-up style!

name: GINKA
short_description: 'Return to that summer with you...' Ryusei returns to the small island of his younger years, where time flows by gently, to spend a fairy-tale summer vacation with his childhood friend who was spirited away.

name: Bombabomb!
short_description: Bombabomb! is a by old pre-installed games inspired game, where you light the bombs with matching neighbors to detonate them. The game is only complete when all the bombs have been detonated! When you say you can remove all the bombs easily, walk the talk!

name: Dragon Wings
short_description: Embark on an epic journey of self discovery! Set out on a thrilling adventure through treacherous landscapes and overcome exciting challenges. Will you be able to find your way home?

name: Steel Roamer
short_description: Immerse yourself in Steel Roamer's chilling experience, trapped in an RV, pitted against unimaginable terrors lurking outside.

name: KoboldKroniken
short_description: The KoboldKroniken - a unique new world full of exciting adventures. Master the catacombs of Kwertz in the dunegon runner full of puzzles and dangers, collect valuable kokkatts, grow your own umpfs and create your personal goblin avatar.

name: Bananarang: The Scattered Shards
short_description: The coolest, weirdest, wackiest and most fun 2D platforming game you'll ever play!

name: GREED IS GOOD
short_description: In GREED IS GOOD, a PvPvE game, you will enter the mysterious dungeon as a Bounty Hunter. In the game, you need to cooperate with your teammates to fight against enemies and fears. Be aware of the toxic gas and be sure to escape before you are drown out.

name: The World's Hardest Game - On Steam
short_description: I present you The World's Hardest Game... On Steam! An aesthetic take on a classic browser game from 2008. Wait, are you sure you're ready to face The World's Hardest Game again? With aesthetic visuals and enhanced gameplay? Oh, and a revamped soundtrack? Alright. You can try.

name: Pixel Gun Master
short_description: Pixel Gunmaster is a roguelike shooter action game about a protagonist who is turned into a demon and goes on a journey to undo his wish. Will you be able to defeat powerful bosses and return to human form?

name: The Ruins
short_description: You've found yourself alone in the darkness lost and afraid. There are boobie traps and human remains all around you, echoing through the ruins you hear scuttling and grunts from a creature you've never heard before. The only way out is to travel deeper into the maze and hope it doesn't hear you

name: Forest Grove
short_description: In Forest Grove, a teenage heiress has gone missing. Foul play is suspected. Uncover a cast of characters, collect evidence, and find the truth in this futuristic detective game!

name: Chants of Sennaar
short_description: Legend says that one day, a traveler will reunite the Peoples of the Tower who are unable to communicate with each other. Observe, listen, and decipher ancient languages in a fascinating universe inspired by the myth of Babel.

name: 艾人的长夜
short_description: A relaxed casual adventure game

name: Gears of Dragoon: Fragments of a New Era
short_description: Dungeon crawl through a magical JRPG world. Turn-based battles, waifu romance, and visual novel choices await!

name: Escape From Nalaxion
short_description: Prepare for an adrenaline-fueled, intergalactic battle like never before in our intense FPS shooter game! As a brave commander leading your platoon on a critical raid on Nalaxion 54, fate takes a thrilling turn when you accidentally stumble upon a hidden trap door.

name: Loddlenaut
short_description: Play as an interstellar custodian sent to clean up a polluted ocean planet. Pick up trash, explore the vibrant waters, and take care of axolotl-like alien creatures!

name: Cattails: Wildwood Story
short_description: Become a cat! In this cozy life sim RPG, you'll lead your colony into the mysterious Wildwood. Hunt prey, harvest herbs, collect magical treasures, & defend your new home from intruders. Build a thriving town to recruit new cats. Get to know the residents, fall in love, & raise a litter of kittens!

name: Pixel of Memory
short_description: Pixel of Memory is a wholesome minimalist puzzle game about an amnesiac painter piecing himself back together through his childhood mementos.

name: 圣维丹物语
short_description: A team mode RPG strategy game, it has a ranch cultivation system, operates ranches to obtain role cultivation resources, and can freely choose role cultivation methods. It uses different roles to combine a strong team and strengthen the team's ability to take risks.

name: Path of Trials
short_description: Save a friend in an exciting platformer with a cat hero! Complete challenges and uncover the story of friendship. Beware of mistakes, plan every jump, and achieve success in this captivating platformer.

name: Project Planet - Earth vs Humanity
short_description: Destroy Humanity with virus outbreaks, asteroid impacts and more as Planet Earth! Or team up with up to five friends as the World Leaders, Industry, Media, Scientists and Public, and try to survive. Impossible dilemmas and branching narratives create countless paths in this strategic party game!

name: Waifu Fighter -Family Friendly
short_description: One day, women became very powerful and dominated all fighting arenas. You had been living in seclusion for training for twenty years. You aimed at the championship of martial arts. Encountering female fighters all over the world, you had to do your best to defeat them successfully!

name: Cook Fest
short_description: Cook Fest is a unique combination of tower defense and cooking genres. Create and design your own complex maze. Cook and serve dishes to satisfy your customers & unlock new recipes. With unexpected roguelite elements & fast-paced gameplay, you can play solo or in chaotic co-op with your fellow chef!

name: Mother Ghoul - The Curse of Unborns
short_description: The next victim is you. Mother Ghoul is a horror and thriller game in which you try to survive against a cursed ghost to whom you are offered as a sacrifice. To escape the curse, you must find and destroy her stillborn children through a ritual. This is the only way...

name: I commissioned some bees 13
short_description: I paid more artists to hide bees in 7 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Spooky.

name: Harvest Moon: The Winds of Anthos
short_description: Explore the wide world of Anthos with the help of your wacky inventor friend Doc Jr. and many others! It’ll be up to you to revive the Harvest Goddess and the Harvest Sprites, as well as reconnect all of the villages of Anthos with each other! Farm all around Anthos using the improved Expando-Farm!

name: The Sisters 2 - Road to Fame
short_description: Get on trend and take the road to fame! Double the trouble, double the fun, our Sisters are back to cause twice the chaos!

name: The Stormy Islands
short_description: Survive mother nature, prepare for the different seasons protecting yourself from cold, heat, hunger and thirst. Beware of Tornadoes, Storms, Tsunamis and predatory animals, on a variety of islands where each one will have to adapt to its limited resources.

name: Flipper Soccer
short_description: Play a quick game of Flipper Soccer - the game that mixes football with pinball. Control the flippers to score goals against your opponent, who can be your friend or the computer.

name: NBA 2K24
short_description: Experience hoops culture in NBA 2K24. Enjoy loads of action and limitless personalized MyPLAYER options in MyCAREER. Build your perfect lineup in MyTEAM. Feel more responsive gameplay and polished visuals while playing with your favorite NBA and WNBA teams in PLAY NOW.

name: Tactics Below
short_description: Tactics Below is a turn-based strategy roguelike where you assemble a party of 4 characters and conquer challenging waves of diverse enemies. Unlock new skills, upgrade your characters and create distinct synergies each time you play.

name: RoboDunk
short_description: DUNK FROM SPACE in the 1st basketball roguelite! Smash and blast in the replayable single player and coop campaign: buy robots, upgrade their stats and unlock tons of new skills. Choose your path among different opponents, traps and rewards.. Up to 4 players versus where every match is different!

name: Elzzup
short_description: In Elzzup, your goal isn't to assemble a puzzle, but rather to disassemble it. The variety of tiles and increasingly complex interactions between them might make this task more complex than you think!

name: Gods of the Twilight
short_description: How will you end the world? Play as Althea and Farkas as old Norse magic returns to their world of tech, and they realize they're more than human. Encounter gods, monsters, governments, corporations, and criminals... decide who to trust, and prepare for Ragnarök.

name: R is for Rachel
short_description: A romance about falling in love for the first time, while suffering from social anxiety disorder.

name: Substitute Priest
short_description: Welcome to [REDACTED], our lovely village. Get acquainted with our community, pray for a bit, and let's go. Meet our newly acquired priest and get rid of your sins as quickly as possible. PS: We advise you not to stay outside buildings after 9:00 p.m.

name: Ping Pong Deluxe
short_description: Ping Pong Deluxe immerses you in a world of table tennis that revolutionizes the classic game with new modes and different maps! Here you get fast-paced rallies and dynamic gameplay that will keep you enthralled. Become the undisputed table tennis champion!

name: Cleaning Time VR
short_description: Clean up your virtual world with 'Cleaning Time VR', a fun and immersive game that challenges you to clear away the clutter! Use your skills and special virtual tools to reign victorious as you scrub, wash, and mow your way to success.

name: Midnight Acres
short_description: Experience Midnight Acres — an indie farming sim by day, and intense FPS by night. Unwind and battle on, all in one game as you grow and nurture your farm, plan and upgrade turrets and defenses, engage in combat with horrifying beasts, and explore the beautiful and mysterious world around you!

name: Desktop Pet Project
short_description: Elevate your PC experience with charming desktop pets. Inspired by such a wonderful invention as Shimeji, Desktop Pet Project has tried to collect the most interesting and curious mechanics. You can summon up to two pets that will have slight personalities in behavior.

name: Surface: Project Dawn
short_description: Something lurks beneath the surface... Can you save yourself and your daughter in time?

name: DreamWorks Trolls Remix Rescue
short_description: Play as Poppy, Branch and more of your favorite DreamWorks Trolls as you explore, smash, dance and battle your way towards rescuing the Troll Kingdom from a melodic mastermind who’s trying to alter the Trolls’ musical harmony!

name: Night Pact: Azuru
short_description: A broken deal will lead you into the depths of a strange cult-like group of moonshiners. Fight through with your loyal revolver, gather knowledge and solve puzzles as you keep advancing into the unknown.

name: Ziggy's Cosmic Adventures
short_description: Ziggy's Cosmic Adventures is a VR cockpit game combining ship management with action-arcade combat. You play as a bounty hunter with possibly questionable morals, currently in possession of a little alien that you may or may not have stolen from the evil Empire. Do you have what it takes to survive?

name: Greg's Deadly Draft
short_description: Fight against Greg White Shark, the maniacal mascot whose sports team you've been recruited to try-out for.

name: Enigma Code: Prologue
short_description: 'Enigma Code: Prologue' - a small science fiction game where you act as an artificial intelligence. Help CEO uncover the mystery of catastrophic failure in the most protected part of the virtual environment.

name: Dungeon Evolution: Nemesis
short_description: Face the ever-evolving Nemesis, utilizing your character's skills and attributes to overcome challenges. Explore the mysterious dungeon, encounter thrilling events, and make strategic decisions. Are you ready to embark on an endless adventure in 'Dungeon Evolution: Nemesis'?

name: Who is Abby
short_description: A gripping psychological thriller, Unravel deep mysteries and interact with a world teeming with secrets. Who is Abby challenges you to discover the truth behind enigmatic characters and twist-filled narratives in this immersive mystery journey.

name: Step Quest
short_description: Uncover a vast world and story in this creative turn based dungeon crawler. Explore different environments, meet characters, fulfill mysterious quests, acquire enigmatic items and defeat all kinds enemies. Will you uncover the truth that lies within?

name: How To Hack In?
short_description: A real-time hacking sandbox simulator with procedurally generated content. Multiple tools and techniques to use, multiple computers to hack, multiple missions to solve, multiple vulnerabilities to exploit!

name: Jurassic Park Classic Games Collection
short_description: HOLD ON TO YOUR BUTTS! THE 8-AND 16-BIT ERA OF JURASSIC PARK GAMES HAS RETURNED, COMMEMORATING 30 YEARS OF THE ICONIC FILM!

name: MULTIPLAYER BOTS
short_description: MULTIPLAYER BOTS - BAD BOTS ARE ATTACKING TRONIX CITY, IT IS UP TO YOU AND YOUR TEAM OF DROIDS TO STOP THEM!

name: Create Your Own Universe
short_description: Create Your Own Universe is a survival, crafting, exploration, base building, third person, open world, go anywhere you see on screen space game.

name: Desktop Garage Kit : Go
short_description: Desktop Garage Kit : Go is an ultra-cute and loveable desktop application. It utilizes an advanced 3D cartoon shader, inspired by Genshin Impact, making the desktop characters more delicate and realistic, breaking through dimensional barriers.

name: Gem Wizard
short_description: Gem Wizard: Match gems, cast spells, and collect relics as you venture through a perilous dungeon. Battle fierce foes, build your wizard's power, and face the ultimate boss to save the realm. A fusion of puzzle-solving and RPG action!

name: Lost Meridian
short_description: Enter the world of 3D Roguelike deckbuilding adventure! Craft the perfect deck for your party to survive an adventure of magic, swords, and hidden discoveries. Online co-op play with up to 4 friends! Victory is but a deck away!

name: Alphadia I & II
short_description: The legends of energi once again in a new edition! Step into the enchanting world of Alphadia, a revitalized epic fantasy RPG series that merges the first two titles, 'Alphadia I' and 'Alphadia II', into a single, captivating adventure.

name: Dungeon Full Dive
short_description: Gather your party and play your favorite tabletop RPGs. With DFD, you can bring your fantasy worlds to life! Create and customize your own heroes & maps. Experience your adventures from the eyes of your miniature or using a classical TTRPG top-down mode!

name: Backrooms Descent: Horror Game
short_description: If you are not careful enough, you may end up in that place, the place some call The Backrooms. The Backrooms of existence, a hellish dimension of infinite maze-like constructs, each level pushing deeper into the despair. Could you, a normal person find the way out? Dive deeper into the horror

name: Twistingo: Turtle Bay Collector's Edition
short_description: Endangered turtles threaten Turtle Bay's legacy. Join Kanoa and Malia to rescue these creatures, unearth hidden treasures, and unveil the island's legends. Assist the locals, tackle enthralling puzzles, dive into mini-games, and breathe life back into the island.

name: Endless Apocalypse
short_description: Endless Apocalypse is an exhilarating shooter game that immerses you in an infinite adventure across diverse levels. Encounter a captivating array of enemies and formidable bosses, challenging your reflexes and strategic thinking for triumphant victories.

name: Yupitergrad 2: The Lost Station
short_description: In Yupitergrad 2, the players have extended mobility, a wider selection of tools, and a much richer game world with an open-ended structure. This is a VR adventure worth waiting for. The legend is back, bigger and better.

name: Plebs
short_description: Plebs is a casual real time strategy game about controlling ancient Nations to victory through strategic town building, creating mighty and diverse armies, and intelligent resource management.

name: Fakeway
short_description: Dig, fight, collect, and explore. If you like Terraria very much, you can try this game. It will also give you a different experience.

name: Dark Invasion VR: Doomsday
short_description: A scary brutal horror VR shooter adventure with quests, zombies, mutants and guns! At the start of the apocalypse you are inside of an old bunker. You need to fight your way with full force through the rows of the undead army of the dark invasion to find a way out of that forsaken place.

name: Purrfect Tale
short_description: When you awake, you find yourself transported back to the time when you were a student. You find it hard to breathe under the massive study load and oppressive environment, until you meet a stray cat that manages to wriggle its way into your world by chance...

name: Paranormal VHS
short_description: Paranormal VHS is a horror game that features a VHS tape-inspired aesthetic. The game's story revolves around a popular vlogger who spends a night in haunted locations in search of paranormal activity. Brace for intense jumpscares.

name: CD 2: Trap Master
short_description: Become THE Trap Master - play your deck of lethal traps to mow down waves of bizarre creatures and protect your altars! Craft a unique deck of traps and powers, discover treasure of surprise effects, and guard a different base each time until you are ready for the unforgiving boss.

name: March of Tulpas:Xanadu
short_description: Lies, delusions, become the light that shines on the truth too. This is a poetic,cute turn-based RPG with a bizarre style that adventuring in a looping world ending in three days.Discover the secrets hidden in the depths that lying all over the breaking world!

name: Taimanin Asagi
short_description: A classic visual novel about a demon-slaying ninja. Asagi was the strongest Taimanin in Tokyo, but after completing her last mission, she just wants to settle down and marry her lover Kyousuke. Her old nemesis has other plans, however, and creeps back from the dead to seek vengeance...

name: Listen
short_description: There is no interface, it's all sound. The biggest feature of 'Listen' is that there is no screen display throughout the process, and everything is entered by the keyboard and mouse movement.

name: Into The Inferno
short_description: A retro-style first-person dungeon crawler RPG where you rescue kidnapped children from an underground demon horde.

name: Cat & Gold
short_description: A 3D side-scrolling action game in which a cat retrieves stolen gold.

name: Humanities Legend: Dark Horizon
short_description: A segmented open world action-adventure game. Fight bosses, explore dungeons, and find magic abilities to push out the Dark form the land. Collect and level up to fight stronger enemies.

name: Shalnor Legends 2: Trials of Thunder
short_description: A Story-Rich RPG/Action-Adventure game. Step into the shoes of the young Orc Mogren and explore all of Thunder Island. Venture into dangerous dungeons, explore caves, solve puzzles, and help the residents of the island with their quests.

name: 海王模拟器2 Lover Simulator2
short_description: 《Lover Simulator2》is a love simulation game with up to 16 male and female characters that can interact. The characters have unique storylines, a plethora of dating scenes, and a built-in casual game to kill time. It's up to you to decide whether to be a sea king or a pure love party.

name: Hedgehot - Battle Strike
short_description: Turn-based strategy card game where you use different creatures and spells to defeat your enemies.

name: Vacation Adventures: Park Ranger 15 Collector's Edition
short_description: Help Rangers run Pinecreek Hills and enjoy National Park Activities

name: harmony
short_description: out maneuver your opponent without letting them leverage your own pieces against you. play against your friends or the computer to see if you can bring balance to the board.

name: Chains of the Goddess
short_description: Chains of the Goddess is a delivery mechanism for uncomfortable existential questions, cleverly disguised as a roguelite game. Our lawyers warn that you should not follow financial or medical advice dispensed by the Goddess.

name: Aftermath
short_description: This is a shooting game!

name: Tau Cubis
short_description: Tau Cubis is a Mazing Tower Defense game in colorful Scifi Landscapes. Repel the onslaught of crazy robots !

name: 6N23
short_description: 6n23 is a action-platfomer-racing game. Rush fast as you can. Use your finger, find path. It has controls similar to a fighting game, allowing you to practice your control skills.

name: Headbangers: Rhythm Royale
short_description: Headbangers is a light-hearted, Rhythm Battle Royale Game where you and 29 other Pigeons compete against each other, all to complete your quest of claiming the title of Master Headbanger!

name: Ronshade
short_description: 'Ronshade' is a turn-based roguelike game. Players collect items and challenge the depths. The turn system displays action results, with intuitive and quick controls. Over 100 unique items greatly influence combat outcomes.

name: Plant Trader
short_description: Plant Trader is a 2D time-management economical game where you act as a gardener who buys seeds and grows plants, and then, before they rot, has to sell at a bargain price and make a huge fortune, buying even more expensive plants!

name: Logicubes
short_description: Logicubes is a fascinating puzzle adventure game. Discover an enchanting universe reeling on the edge of darkness. Accompany Wis on a dangerous journey alongside new friends, solve mind-bending puzzles and awaken The Great Architect, save the Cubeverse from the eternal darkness.

name: God's Forest
short_description: God's Forest is a Roguelite Bullet-Hell. Gather powerful items and weapons, battle the guardians of the dungeon, and maybe even make a few friends along the way!

name: Space Cowboys - Riders of the Storm
short_description: Embark on a cosmic journey! Choose your role: Pilot, Engineer, First Mate, or Commando. Conquer the stars with intense teamplay, powerful upgrades, and thrilling battles. Take command, repair systems, or unleash chaos. Victory awaits in this immersive space adventure!

name: Space Gun
short_description: Space Gun is an exciting physics puzzle game in which fun and exciting levels of varying difficulty await you. Plunge into the space age of technology and take control of a killer gun and destroy everything in your path! The game features many unique buildings and levels, so complete them all!

name: Crimen - Mercenary Tales
short_description: Raise yer glasses high, me hearties! Embark on a (bloody) journey through eight swashbucklin' tales of grandeur, riches, and legendary feats! Experience visually captivating comic book graphics, while being entertained by the mercenary humor of the tavern’s patrons and their over-the-top deeds!

name: Submachine: Legacy
short_description: Submachine is a hand-drawn puzzle adventure game. You find yourself in a vast network of desolate locations containing puzzles, secrets, notes and items to collect to help you along the way. Follow the story of a banished lighthouse keeper to discover his descent into ruins.

name: Puma: the Cat
short_description: Play as Puma, a cat on a quest to find her friend Mia. Explore challenging maps and confront enemies in this thrilling 2D pixel art platform game.

name: Dune: Imperium
short_description: The award-winning board game of strategy and intrigue in the iconic universe of Dune. The Spice must flow.

name: Autumn's Bounty
short_description: Find your friends, save your potluck.

name: Project Cartaphilus
short_description: 어느 날 한 연구실에서 눈을 뜬 주인공 '하연'. 하연은 아무도 없는 낯선 곳에서 눈을 뜬다. 계속 사람을 찾아보지만 아무도 없었고 그러다 로봇을 만나게 된다. 로봇이 말하길 세상이 멸망하여 내가 마지막 생존자라 말한다. 또한 하연이 세상을 되돌릴 열쇠라는 사실을 전하는데...

name: zombie sanctuary:Juliet
short_description: In the ancient Middle Ages, a lot of zombies have appeared in an abandoned village. As a member of the Seabird Strike Team, you were reasonably assigned to check it out. Your captain gives you a total of 6 different weapons that you need to use to defeat hordes of zombies.

name: Draft Day Sports: Pro Football 2024
short_description: Draft Day Sports: Pro Football 2024 puts you in the role of general manager of your favorite football team. Every decision can be made by you from drafting, trading, signing free agents right down to creating and calling your own plays to lead your team to championship glory and becoming a dynasty.

name: 封神榜2023
short_description: This game takes Nezha, Xiaolongnv, Yang Jian and Jiang Ziya as the protagonists. The game tells the legendary story of the protagonists going to various places to adventure, and finally to Zhaoge City to destroy the three demons and defeat King Zhou.

name: Pizza Possum
short_description: Live your ultimate possum dreams in a snackable, chaotic arcade game focused on eating as much food as you can in single-player or local co-op - without getting caught.

name: Never Ending Nightmare
short_description: Life has been tough for you after the tragic incident with your parents. Your way of coping has been through reliving all the good memories with them, but all the memories had a dark turn this time... will you be able to figure out why?

name: Perry the Pumpkin
short_description: Perry the Pumpkin needs to save Halloween! In this epic platformer with RPG elements, you will learn secrets about the mayhem surrounding the spookiest of holidays. Perry will spit out pumpkin seeds to stop enemies and learn new abilities to help him with his mission.

name: Internet Cafe Creator
short_description: Internet Cafe Creator is a new type of gameplay in the internet cafe game series. Build, expand, buy computers, hire staff, fight off bandits - all this wait you in this great game!

name: Labrys
short_description: Labrys is a multiplayer (up to 5v1) horror game where players are thrown into a randomly generated labyrinth against a minotaur. Play as the minotaur or one of up to five human players trying to escape the labyrinth.

name: Zombie Rooms
short_description: The zombie apocalypse takes a hilarious dimension

name: Bloodbound
short_description: Bloodbound is a Vampire, Vampire Slayer multiplayer first-person action shooter. Locations are varied and detailed, and each character comes with its own unique weapons and special abilities. Pick a side, squad up, and master a rising roster of fearless characters in this fast-paced bloody FPS.

name: Pygmalion
short_description: Pygmalion is a puzzle game using the properties of colors. Clear the set stage by manipulating the color block. Removing all blocks within a certain number of times limits clears the stage.

name: Velocity Ventures
short_description: Embark on a thrilling platforming adventure in 'Velocity Ventures.' With bow and arrow combat system, 20 levels ranging with different difficulties, speedrun mode, and global leaderboards, test your skills and claim your spot at the top!

name: Changdong's Bikini Adventure
short_description: Adventure of finding a bikini with Changdong! Enjoy fun games with online update technology combined with the latest 3D graphics!

name: 负罪者：方石
short_description: This is an easy to get started role-playing, adventure and exploration single player game that tells the exciting story of several criminals who experience adventures in a desolate and forbidden world.

name: Poly Backrooms
short_description: Welcome to Poly Backrooms, an unique multiplayer co-op horror game that combines the infamous backrooms creepypasta with a fun, low-poly aesthetic. With up to 4 players, you and your friends will navigate through the backrooms, solving intricate puzzles and avoiding dangerous entities.

name: Superfetch Dog
short_description: Play as Gale, a Good Boy, and fetch a mysterious orb for your little owner who keeps throwing it into the forest!

name: Goliath
short_description: Goliath is a Pre-Alpha Sci-Fi Multiplayer Shooter from 3 Feet From Gold Games. Master an ever-growing roster of legendary characters with powerful abilities, dashes and weapons, and experience strategic multiplayer and innovative gameplay in the arena!

name: Maze Maverick
short_description: Dive into dynamic mazes, outsmart weird ghosts, and snatch coins in this thrilling arcade adventure. Are you maverick enough?

name: Extreme Riding
short_description: Extreme Riding is an racing game where your task is to test your skills in driving different cars on exciting tracks. Choose your car and go to the track! Go through unusual obstacles, jump over cliffs, maneuver, and get to the finish line in a certain time.

name: Insanity's Grip
short_description: Insanity's Grip is a first-person psychological horror game in which the player uncovers the secrets of his forgotten past and experiences nightmares from which he can no longer escape. Be careful, some visions can be more dangerous than they seem!

name: Chapter Wars
short_description: Immerse yourself in thrilling first-person shooter battles across three unique maps. Confront rival clans, adapt to hostile locals, and face off against relentless alien creatures. Join the eternal struggle for dominance and choose your side in this action-packed battle for supremacy!

name: Yog-Sothoth’s Yard
short_description: Manage a hotel and hire employees including Death, a dragon, a Demon-Slayer, and a bioroid maid. Build your wealth through various means and refine your strategies based on the predictions of Oracles. Your choices will determine which employees become enamored with you.

name: Mystery Box: Escape The Room
short_description: Welcome to the 3rd chapter of the 'Mystery Box' series. You're trapped inside dark rooms and must solve intriguing enigmas to open boxes and escape. Can you make it?

name: Hans
short_description: Hans is a physics-driven, parkour adventure. Ascend to the sky with our lonely watermelon hero. Navigate treacherous platforms, defy physics by slowing down time, try not to fall and chase the dream of reuniting with humanity. No saves. Bounce, fail, adapt, and bounce again.

name: Birnchen & Friends: Minor Confrontations
short_description: Visit Birnchen and Mr. Blue in their playroom and fight each other for a bowl of candy in this colorful RTS! Whether it's fruity attack or stormy chaos, you choose the side!

name: Strike Force Heroes
short_description: Strike Force Heroes is an oldschool arena shooter rebuilt with modern mechanics with full co-operative and PvP online multiplayer. It melds over the top action with epic story-telling in this intense remake of the hit Flash game.

name: The Golden Eyed Ghosts
short_description: The Golden Eyed Ghosts is a dark fantasy soulslike heavily influenced by the legacy of Zelda adventures, set in the crumbling kingdom of Andromeda. As exiled warrior Orion, search for a way to restore his memories and unravel a terrifying conspiracy.

name: Star Overhead
short_description: Star Overhead is a short but challenging 2D platformer following a retired military chaplain turned pastor. On his deathbed, he uses his connection to music to process his journey into the great beyond.

name: DroneZ XL
short_description: DroneZ XL transports you to a hostile future that, because of neglect and pollution, has forced people to live immersed in feedback units. These units, which are connected to the V-Space network, are dominated by Artificial Intelligences who forbid people to disconnect.

name: Flawless Darkness
short_description: Flawless Darkness is designed so that blind and non-blind people can have the same play experience. That's why you play the game only with sound, with no graphics at all. Players will have a special experience just escaping the maze in darkness.

name: Totum
short_description: 'TOTUM' is a non-linear visual novel. In a conversation with eternity, the main thing is not to be crazier

name: 摸金校尉之九幽将军
short_description: This is an adventure treasure hunt game. Players will play the role of 'a long-lost scientist' to collect, produce and build, prepare for all survival . Take risks with teammates and be wary of competitors. A mysterious and thrilling adventure feast is about to begin.

name: Glowstrike: Robot Obliteration
short_description: You're in a dark universe filled with enemies, and your goal is to eliminate them all in intense, colorful combat. On the terrain, helpers in the form of parcels will be there to assist you in your victory.

name: SpaceRace
short_description: Futuristic 3d racing game where players compete to set rapid lap times on visually striking recreations of classic race tracks and future circuits.

name: Super Woden GP 2
short_description: Super Woden GP 2 is a love letter to the world of motor sports, offering a unique experience. Arcade-style isometric racing meets unrivaled campaign depth and a huge variety of vehicles to buy, sell and unlock.

name: Siege Showdown
short_description: 'Siege Showdown' is an exciting strategy game that will give you the opportunity to defend a majestic fortress and fight with the troops of your opponents in a battle for power and territory. An exciting fantasy era world awaits you, where magic and powerful warriors merge in one battle.

name: Rooftop Postgirl
short_description: Jump from one building to another, dodge the birds and face many obstacles in order to accomplish a simple task... delivering letters! Isn't it fun? Play as Carolina, the postgirl and Alice, the... normal person? I guess.

name: Doomsday Paradise
short_description: Can you get a date before the end of the world? Doomsday Paradise is a goofy, multiplayer dating sim about finding love before the apocalypse. With over 100 different endings and 12 different singles to woo- no two games will ever be the same.

name: Orbitect
short_description: Space debris is out of control! Craft a station to take out the trash in this construction roguelite mashup.

name: World League Baseball
short_description: Enjoy an excitement-filled baseball game rendered in a casual art style! Experience all the fun found only in ball games with simple and easy controls!

name: Pixel Petals
short_description: Pixel Petals: Relax with 2D pixel flowers. Crossbreed to unlock vibrant colors, complete quests, and create your tranquil pixel garden.

name: John Christian 3.0
short_description: John Christian 3.0 is a Christian adventure game with spiritual battles. The game presents the story of young John who, dressed in the Armor of God, embarks on his new mission to fight against the forces of evil in a universe with many challenges to free the imprisoned people.

name: The Turgenev Study
short_description: A unique arena game of dodging, harvesting and assimilating enemies under a microscope with a relaxing soundtrack.

name: AIKAGI After Days
short_description: AIKAGI After Days is a visual novel which depicts a young couple enjoying their college life together. If you enjoyed their blossoming love story in AIKAGI, you will love this summer full of dates, swimming, fireworks, travel... and maybe just some studying.

name: Ancient Warfare: The Han Dynasty
short_description: Ancient Warfare: The Han Dynasty is a wargame demonstrating ancient warfare in China and combining elements of Big Strategy, RTS and RPG. You can learn little-known stories of heroes in ancient China by experiencing battles accommodating thousands of soldiers.

name: REMORE: INFESTED KINGDOM
short_description: A challenging turn-based tactical RPG that transports you into a medieval apocalyptic infestation. Your survivors are fragile, and every step you take could be your last.

name: Parking Tycoon: Business Simulator
short_description: Are you ready to immerse yourself in the exhilarating world of car parking management? Step into the shoes of a visionary entrepreneur and become the ultimate Parking Lot Tycoon! Take Charge and embark on a thrilling journey of strategy, expansion, and success.

name: The Cannon Fighters
short_description: The Cannon Fighters is an action game with fully destructible environments. Experience loads of fun alone or with friends! Randomly generated levels in various environments await you for even greater entertainment. Gain experience and show that you belong among the best!

name: StickSpinner
short_description: 'Challenging Action' meets 'Party Game' for up to four players! Introducing our latest game where players navigate using rotating sticks and control their jumps based on stick angles. The unique feature that sets this game apart is the 'Jump' mechanic, which also presents its greatest challenge.

name: Before Sunset 日落之前
short_description: Ah-Dan lives with his near blind mother and his dog in an old village. Since a very young age, Ah-Dan knows the rule of the village - to always come home before sunset.

name: 追杀
short_description: A horror game. Players need to look for the exit in the building, and try to not caught by monsters. This game contain some jump scare.

name: Shut Up, Rabbit!
short_description: Shut Up, Rabbit! is a shooting survival game mainly for relaxing. A chatty rabbit with sci-fi laser gun and cannon to fight with animals to survive in the forest.

name: Checkmate Showdown
short_description: Chess meets Fighting games. Crush your opponents in the arena and on the chessboard in this online multiplayer competitive tactical fighting game that mixes the strategic elegance of Chess with the fast-paced execution of fighting games.

name: Riddle for your Life
short_description: Do you have what it takes to solve all riddles? Your life may depend on it. The stakes are high. Winning grants you a powerful reward, losing means certain death. Are you brave enough to play the odds?

name: Street Stallion: The Jaywalk Simulator
short_description: Jaywalk Simulator! Take control of the Street Stallion, who must dodge incoming Obstacles and jaywalk himself to be finally united with a herd of horses. Test your reflexes with its challenging gameplay. Can you beat the game and become the ultimate jaywalking champion?

name: Angola '86
short_description: The first strategy game to capture the essence of the entire South African Border war, from Omugulugwombashe to UNTAG (Aug'66 - Mar'90)

name: HELL HUNTER - Damned Soul
short_description: A story driven adventure horror audiogame in which you have to interact with room elements, survive to environment gimmicks and fight real time battles based only on stereo audio. Learn the enemy patterns and hear where the attacks come from to dodge their attacks in time and then attack.

name: Shopping in a Winter Zombieland
short_description: An apocalyptic Visual Novel from Zombie Zone Germany for Christmas with German voice acting, lots of decisions and seven different endings. There is only a version in German language.

name: The CEO Love Me
short_description: you take over the position of CEO of a family business with a market value of 100 billion. Cold and domineering, gentle and rich, you need to strengthen the family business, and recruit more employees you like. Usually, you need to keep in touch with the beauties and cultivate a close relationship.

name: Rawisland
short_description: You have to go to a desert island and find hidden treasures. Crafting items and unique upgrades scattered throughout the island will help you survive.

name: Avo Escape Space
short_description: AVO Escape Space is a dystopian, story-driven escape the room style VR game set in outer space! Assisted by AVO, the spaceship's AI system, you embark on a journey to escape your doomed vessel. To do so, you must engage your mind with a series of intricate and mind-bending puzzles!

name: Total Vengeance
short_description: Fueling the desire for vengeance, players must survive against ghastly creatures, uncover the truth behind the gas station's abandonment, and confront their own inner demons. The choices made throughout the journey will shape their destiny, blurring the lines between redemption and revenge.

name: Dead Trip: Hope
short_description: Take part in the adventures of Lars and Jessica in a world of death and chaos. Surviving among the crowds of zombies in search of supplies and fuel in order to pursue the last hope of saving humanity and defeating the virus.

name: Defendron TD
short_description: Defendron is an epic, acion-packed, cyberpunk/futuristic themed tower defense with unique twist on upgrade path. Place towers, fend of huge enemy waves and emerge victorious!

name: Rocket Jockey
short_description: Welcome to the most brutal sport around. Destruction derbies are so passé, audiences want blood, so we strapped the drivers to volatile rockets. Smash your opponents into dust or better yet each other. Drag their faces across the ground at over 100 MPH...and give a whole new meaning to road rash!

name: The Gray Man
short_description: The Gray Man is a surreal first-person point-and-click adventure about a serial killer who confronts the player, as the murderer's conscience, with interpretations of his internal conflict.

name: Raicing
short_description: Mastermind the race in Raicing! Craft, train, and compete with AI drivers. Conquer rivals in thrilling multiplayer battles. Customize cars for the ultimate victory!

name: Enypnion Redreamed
short_description: Enter a surreal adventure that delves deep into the subconscious mind of a young boy. Guided by a dream spirit, solve puzzles and explore a realm of eerie wonder, as you find your way back into the waking world. An illusory adventure redreamed!

name: The Brittle Epoch
short_description: An immersive short story walking simulator. About an hour to complete for people who enjoy relaxed exploration while investing in a long term narrative project.

name: Peaky Blinders: The King's Ransom Complete Edition
short_description: Prove you have what it takes to join the Peaky Blinders in The King's Ransom, a narrative VR game inspired by the epic gangster drama. Complete with all DLC included – including 7 additional missions and challenges!

name: Love's Crescendo
short_description: Love's Crescendo is a cozy visual novel with rhythm mini-games about finding true love and reigniting that spark for your passions. Join Valerie and Cadence in this heartwarming sapphic romance centered around their love of music and the spark between them.

name: Pro Basketball Manager 2024
short_description: Welcome to Pro Basketball Manager 2024 - the best basketball management experience, offering unparalleled depth and authenticity across 175 elite basketball competitions. Show the world you're the ultimate basketball manager!

name: Soul of Butterflies: Incubation
short_description: 'Soul of Butterflies: Incubation' is a point-and-click adventure game with a unique worldview. Players will take on the role of Anders and explore an extremely enigmatic world. Amidst indescribable struggles and fears, they will gradually piece together the truth of this world.

name: Final Resistance
short_description: 'Final Resistance' It's a strategy game with a time-sensitive element. Control a castle under siege by monsters, gather resources within this prison-like castle, craft equipment, and arm your warriors.

name: Secret Shuffle
short_description: Social deduction games meets dance parties?! Secret Shuffle is a party game for 4 or more players with phones & headphones. Guess which player doesn’t hear any music but instead pretends to, or find the others dancing to the same music!

name: To The Mars
short_description: Are you ready to climb toward to Mars just for fun? This is a concise game, nothing more. You can always repeat it, you learn from mistakes. It should be simple enough, good luck to everyone.

name: Brain Overload: Calculate
short_description: A computing training game where you get shot when you open the game. Train yourself, challenge the game producer, and exercise your brain!

name: Roody:2d
short_description: Use simple machines to build complex assembly lines and automate increasingly advanced blocks. Weld together blocks and move them as one unit for vehicles, elevators, or mining machines.

name: Falling Down XR
short_description: Falling Down XR invites you to an immersive VR adventure. Our game is a compilation of several game genres. Choose what you like. Jump on moving platforms, find your way through a maze or unleash a hurricane fire on evil forces.

name: Picket Line
short_description: This casual tower defense game tells a story of factory strikes and workers' rights in 20th century industrial Zagreb.

name: Minigame Madness
short_description: Minigame Madness is a frantic multiplayer party game for up to 16 players online. Compete with friends or strangers in a massive, ever-growing collection of free-for-all minigames to unlock awesome outfits and shiny badges!

name: Gas Station Tycoon
short_description: Build a gas station from zero to become the best gas station business empire in the world!

name: Where Is Sarah?
short_description: You shall look for Sarah that faded out of your whole memory. The circumstance and unknown guy who often interrupts you would bother you continuously. Chronic drinking and overtime works had destructed your mind, but you will get back your memories and your wife, Sarah, too.

name: Cry Babies Magic Tears: The Big Game
short_description: Your favourite Cry Babies characters are ready to play! The Big Game is a friendly and fun adventure perfect for young players. Join Lady, Coney, Dreamy and friends in an all-new adventure as they take part in an exciting multi-stage tournament to win the fabled Golden Pacifier!

name: Skibidi Toilet Hero
short_description: You are the last Cameraman who will have to fight off the army of Skybidy Toilets with the help of various weapons and cheerful music

name: Brave Trial
short_description: Brave Trial is a mild ROUGE combat shooter that also allows you to turn on Endless Mode after completing the game. Before you start, you need to set up SteamVR as OpenXR. Have a crazy fight.

name: Tragedy Theater
short_description: Tragedy Theater is RPGmaker Horror game. You'll get the thrill of being chased by those mascots. Don't get caught. Help your friend, result puzzles and choose the choice that won't make our boy out of his mind.

name: Sweetcore Brews - an otome game inspired by witchy sitcoms
short_description: An anime, choice-driven witchy otome visual novel where you bond and interact with two romance-able characters to unlock romantic scenarios in the story! Play minigames to experience branching relationship routes (GxB or GxG)

name: Slime Warrior Sokoban
short_description: You are the Warrior on a quest to find and defeat the Slime Gladiator. With a limited movement, you need to think carefully about every step until you reach the door. Use your special power, push boxes, find keys, beware of traps, and slay every slime that get in your way!

name: 扔彩虹模擬器 | Coin Toss Rainbow Simulator
short_description: Coin Toss Rainbow Simulator. Made in Hong Kong. Toss the coin and test your luck. By Unreal Engine 5.3.1.

name: OctoRaid VR
short_description: OctoRaid VR is a Cross-Platform-Based Asymmetric PvP VR Party Game in which you become an Octo or Hunter character and Fight against each other. If you access a VR device, you play Octo, a Giant Octopus Monster, and if you access Only PC or Mobile, you play Hunter, a Employee with a Diver concept.

name: Another Day
short_description: Ivan sets out for the abandoned hospital in the town of Olkhov, where his brother Tolya disappeared after witnessing something horrifying, causing him to stop communicating and eventually vanish.

name: GeoDepths
short_description: Pilot your drill deep below the surface of a remote planet, to mine ore to refine into resources, which will be used in drill upgrades and construction of your homebase. Upgrades will allow you to drill deeper to find more types of ores. Explore caves to uncover mysteries and secrets.

name: Bottle Can Float
short_description: Watch the bottles quietly flowing down the river, listen to the pleasant sound of running water, throw small stones into the water, and discover the small animals living by the river... I believe you will definitely gain a wonderful mood.

name: Dungeons 4
short_description: The Absolute Evil and its trusted *cough* servant, the Dark Elf Thalya, return in Dungeons 4 after the events of its fabulous predecessor to bring about their triumph over the forces of good once more.

name: Tintin Reporter - Cigars of the Pharaoh
short_description: Tintin and his faithful companion Snowy are going to experience some extraordinary adventures…After meeting Professor Sarcophagus whilst cruising the Mediterranean Sea, the famous reporter sets out in search of the tomb of the Pharaoh Kih-Oskh.

name: Zipp's Café
short_description: Love, betrayal, and coffee! Zipp's Café is a 'noir & chill' little game about a café between the city of animals and the district of insects. Make unusual recipes, get involved in shady dealings, and try to start a new life while searching for love and revenge.

name: Berzerk: Recharged
short_description: Blast your way through an endless maze inhabited by deadly robots and their invulnerable, menacing master Evil Otto. Tag in a friend in local co-op to help you survive this twin-stick revival of an arcade classic.

name: NARUTO X BORUTO Ultimate Ninja STORM CONNECTIONS
short_description: Legendary ninjas reunite in the next exciting entry of the STORM series! NARUTO X BORUTO Ultimate Ninja STORM CONNECTIONS is an action/fighting game with fast-paced ninja battles and two different story modes.

name: Mad Jyacer
short_description: Bring healthy food to the finish line. Help your family lose weight!

name: ArenaWar
short_description: FPS Arena Competitive multiplayer

name: Windy Meadow - A Roadwarden Tale
short_description: Windy Meadow – A Roadwarden Tale is an interactive slice-of-life visual novel about choosing your own path. Help three protagonists make the most important choices of their lives. Featuring a multitude of hand-crafted characters and a richly detailed village set in the Roadwarden story world.

name: Gem Galaxy
short_description: Decorate the board by stratetically placing gems to build up your highscore.

name: GUNHEAD
short_description: Gunhead is a fast paced strategic roguelike FPS where you take the role of a pirate mech with a gun for a head, looting derelict spaceships filled with monstrous drones made out of bone and steel. Sequel to the 2d roguelite Cryptark.

name: My Next Life as a Bird
short_description: 'My Next Life as a Bird' is a speedrun platformer game. Players can customize various mechanics using 'Bird Coins,' evade incoming magical projectiles, and aim to reach the finish line as quickly as possible, creating their own fastest completion journey.

name: Kingdom Shell
short_description: Kingdom Shell is an atmospheric 2D platformer with a captivating storyline. Explore the local lands to stop the invasion of nightmarish creatures and unravel the mysteries of the Kingdom.

name: Scene Investigators
short_description: Scene Investigators is a deductive reasoning game for fans of the 'true crime' genre. Step into re-created crime scenes, observe closely for pieces of evidence, analyze possible motives behind the crimes, and uncover what truly happened.

name: Shadow of Fear
short_description: In 'Shadow of Fear', your only purpose is to solve puzzles and then escape; You can also continue to survive, whether you can survive until the end depends on yourself

name: Polymino
short_description: A fast-paced puzzle game for 1-4 players. Match blocks by color to build up combos and cause huge amounts of destruction!

name: Park Up - Car
short_description: Painfully fun.

name: Non-Fellows
short_description: Follow adventures of four not as much friends as they finds their way through zombie city, get acquainted with an ancient vampire and discover what happened to their cute blonde friend after this meeting. Republish of an old point-and-click adventure, with all 3 episodes in a signle game.

name: Lost Princess: Winterland
short_description: Play this walking simulation. Lost princess are again missing. Collect items and try to find missing Princess in big open snow world

name: Violet Kingdom
short_description: A single player RPG adventure

name: Happy Lab
short_description: Welcome to the 'Happy Lab'! You are a new intern at the most advanced science facility. Your daily job would be to train our AI 'Aurora'. 'Aurora' purpose is to create the most advanced armor and fix all glitches on the way if there are any.

name: Pool Cleaning Simulator
short_description: 'Pool Cleaning Simulator is a PowerWash Simulator-esque cleaning game where you use a variety of tools to make filthy pools sparkling clean.' The game recreates the entire process of cleaning, scrubbing, and maintaining various pools, from luxurious backyard havens to community swimming complexes.

name: Lucky Mayor
short_description: This is a Rogue Deck-building game where you play as a mayor, recruit various citizens to earn coins, meet their needs, and submit enough coins by the deadline to complete challenges.

name: Puzzillion
short_description: A logic puzzles 3D first person game. Move things around, toggle switches, open doors, blend colors - train your brain solving challenge after challenge. Includes classic puzzles and new puzzles, physics and logic, light and electricity, twists and surprises.

name: Days of Doom
short_description: Gather your heroes and fight to make it to Sanctuary in this tactical RPG roguelite. Did we mention the zombies, raiders, and mysterious monstrosities that inhabit this post-apocalyptic wasteland? Welcome to the world of Days of Doom.

name: Jusant
short_description: Enjoy meditative vibes in Jusant, an action-puzzle climbing game. Scale an immeasurably tall tower and ascend to new heights alongside your watery companion. Master your climbing tools, find your way up through diverse biomes, and piece together the tower’s past.

name: Void Crew
short_description: Void Crew is a 1-4 player co-op First Person Space Adventure: Rally your crew, power your spaceship, and get ready for epic space battles, facing chaotic dangers you and your crew never trained for!

name: Drum Roll
short_description: Have you ever wanted to roll an oil drum? Roll the drum as far as you want with Drum Roll!

name: 末世少女 Zombie Girl
short_description: This is an extremely thrilling and challenging third-person shooter. If you like shooting games and Zombie Crisis, then this game must not be missed! It will give you an immersive gaming experience, immersing you in a world full of danger and mystery.

name: Neurotypical
short_description: You Wake up as A teenager Named neo in a strange place,apparently in someones mind and they want your help?! Collect items,fight enemies and try not to get yourself anhillated! But always remember,nothing in this game is as 'typical' as it seems

name: Stream Basketball
short_description: Vossel's Stream Basketball: A live Twitch video broadcasting game that helps engage viewers and grow your channel! Compete in a physics-based game, shoot hoops, and climb the leaderboard for ultimate viewer retention and excitement!

name: Unusual quest
short_description: The game is a 2D platformer with puzzle elements. You have to go through many levels, completing certain tasks and destroy enemies in the location.

name: XALADIA: Rise of the Space Pirates X2
short_description: Face cosmic threats in 'XALADIA', the ultimate twin-stick shooter! Conquer the battlefield with stunning 3D graphics and evolving combat. Use missiles, lasers, barriers to decimate space pirates. Upgrade weapons, unleash a relentless barrage. Experience the real space warfare!

name: Seedlings
short_description: Immerse yourself in nature as a sentient seed in this relaxing award-winning 2D puzzle platformer. Possess different plant creatures with unique abilities and find your way through the New Zealand native forest, made using real photos and videos.

name: Eastern Europe Train Sim 2
short_description: Take the helm of a powerful locomotive in 'Eastern Europe Train Sim 2.'

name: Fallen Prince
short_description: Fallen Prince is an atmospheric combat-focused metroidvania with retro elements. Explore a bleak undead zone, hone your skills and rid the kingdom from your brother's vile sorcery.

name: So Much Stuff 4: Bits & Bobs
short_description: Uncover an abundance of new stuff in this exciting sequel!

name: Part-Time Adventure
short_description: 該遊戲為第一人稱視角冒險RPG，玩家將在該世界中扮演一名公會職員，因某些原因必須親自上任兼職冒險者，遊戲中你可以選擇戰鬥蒐集掉落物，也可以躲避魔物，採野生的藥草賺錢，升級自己的裝備，並探索這個世界，發現隱藏道具，進而觸發不同的遊戲結局。 遊戲中涵蓋白天、黃昏、夜晚時間段，挑選一個適合的時間出門狩獵才是真正的賺錢之道。

name: Mercenaries of the Kingdom: First Blood
short_description: Party-based rogue-lite RPG set in Earthial, a fantasy world. Hire various races of mercenaries, equip them, create battle formations, and grab the loot! Kill tens of thousands of enemies using steel and spells!

name: Habroxia
short_description: Blast your way through a myriad of extra-terrestrial incursions in this arcade-style scrolling shooter! Pilot the ship Habroxia through 15 levels featuring intense boss fights, rescue missions, shifting perspectives, and untold surprises.

name: Pixel Cafe
short_description: Step into Pixel's shoes in this one-of-a-kind journey that bridges time, memories, and the aroma of fresh coffee. Dive deep into a city balancing its past and future. Engage in intense arcade challenges, immerse yourself in heartfelt stories, and navigate a world crafted in pixel art.

name: Mystery Solitaire. Grimm's Tales 9
short_description: Fairytale heroes in a fairytale world! Amazing locations and interesting levels solitaire based on the Grimm brothers fairy tales.

name: Railgunners
short_description: Railgunners is a shooter built to highly customizable difficulty levels. Fight your way through hundreds of enemy ships, and help humanity fight back against the alien invasion!

name: BLACK RUNES
short_description: Black Runes is a horror game with first-person puzzle elements, in which you have to play as a person caught in a hopeless situation, shrouded in magic.

name: Echoes of Karma
short_description: Echoes of Karma is a game about a flirty demon and gay magician who travel the multiverse. As they travel, they discover a threat known as Glitch. The game is a turn based RPG, but with Blocking Mechanics during the enemy turn. Save TP by skipping your turn to use higher level abilities!

name: Entities
short_description: Dive into horror in Entities. Solo or up to 4-player matches offer dynamic puzzles, relentless entities, and extraction shooter mechanics. Investigate, unlock paths, and survive in dangerous zones as a private operator. Master skill and terror. Are you ready to confront the unknown?

name: Cities: Skylines II
short_description: Raise a city from the ground up and transform it into a thriving metropolis with the most realistic city builder ever. Push your creativity and problem-solving to build on a scale you've never experienced. With deep simulation and a living economy, this is world-building without limits.

name: Pixel Colony
short_description: Build and manage your own colony. Citizens are primary resource. Make them happy by producing a variety of resources. Protect your settlement and colonists from hostile environment and make a great city.

name: Spectral Trail
short_description: In this pseudo-3D action FPS, try to survive a maze full of ghosts in your search for the Seven Rings of Xeoncor.

name: Liberation
short_description: Fight back against the evil Galactic Federation! It'll be good for humanity and probably OK for you. if you only play one space game this year, play Starfield, if you play two, play Liberation!

name: Culinary Survivors
short_description: Food has revolted! Never-ending hordes of ingredients are after you. Fend them off in this casual, action game with a variety of decision making rogue-lite elements that influence your character build against the food army.

name: Birch Simulator
short_description: The main characters of modern games can be very different. Brave knights, brilliant scientists or superheroes saving entire worlds. This game offers you a more unusual experience. Here you can become a Birch.

name: Red Head - To The Rescue
short_description: Rescue the gem stolen by the evil sorcerer Vamooth and restore peace to the kingdom. Prepare yourself to face a wide variety of enemies, such as slimes, evil trees, and giant bosses that occupy almost the entire screen.

name: Mystical Riddles: Ship From Beyond Collector's Edition
short_description: All hands on deck! A strange, oily fog has enveloped the waterfront of the port town of Quietcape, where local fishermen go, never to return again... Can you solve this mystery?

name: Pyramid Curse
short_description: Research materials about the explorers of the mysterious underground pyramid. An analog horror game about found footage tapes.

name: Sonny The Mad Man: Casual Arcade Shooter
short_description: Welcome to Sonny The Mad Man! Are you ready for adventure and epic fights?

name: Sacabambaspis Chronicle
short_description: As a player, you become Sacabambaspis and live each day with your fellow Sacabambaspis, growing and evolving by swimming in the sea and eating plankton. Progress through the story with your companions in Sacabambaspis, and see what happens in the end.

name: Little Splash
short_description: Little Splash is a 2D precision platformer inspired by the classics you love. Here you play as an agile protagonist who will splash paint all over your path, are you ready to make the cleanest run possible?

name: Nothorian RPG
short_description: Nothorian es un RPG de rol medieval estilo Roguelike gótico y oscuro con una historia profunda y centrado en la acción, la exploración y la construcción de tus personajes desde el Inicio.

name: 求婚失败了，我还不知道她的名字
short_description: 这是一款短篇情视觉小说。母胎单身三十年的工程师王强，去酒吧后在酒店床上醒来，旁边还坐了个陌生女生。他立刻提出负起责任和对方结婚，被拒绝后，又接下了送她到学校的任务。但此时大堵车，按时到达几乎不可能完成，他们要怎么办呢？能不能按时到达？两个人的感情又会如何发展？

name: BAR OLD PAL VR : PROLOGUE
