short_description: 'BAR OLD PAL VR: PROLOGUE' is a VR bartender simulation game that focuses on experiencing bartending directly based on the International Bartender's Official Recipe (IBA), while also allowing you to enjoy storylines related to the protagonist.

name: We'reWolves
short_description: Slay the hordes and survive the night! Journey through a wild and untamed world filled with dangerously relentless foes. In this bullet heaven inspired by Vampire Survivors, you'll use a wide range of melee and ranged weapons to stay safe while you duck and dodge through massive waves of enemies.

name: Escape Z
short_description: Survive the apocalypse with friends in Escape Z. Fight and plan tactics to face hordes of zombies. Choose your character, map and prepare. Survival is your only option.

name: Diluvian Ultra
short_description: Diluvian Ultra is a single-player, first-person shooter focusing on a retro aesthetic and fast-paced, strategic combat. The game is set in its own expansive fictive universe. Rather than gritty or dark, Diluvian Ultra is colorful and fantastical, like the cover of pulp sci-fi novels of the past.

name: Front Office Football Nine
short_description: Put yourself in the Front Office with Front Office Football, the professional football simulation from Solecismic Software. Manage your roster through trading, free agency and the amateur draft. Create game plans, organize depth charts and watch your franchise thrive for decades.

name: I commissioned some frogs 2
short_description: I paid more artists to hide frogs and flies in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

name: Alone and Dangerous
short_description: Alone and Dangerous is a 3D action shooter in the setting of a zombie apocalypse. Controlling an armed soldier, you confront the constantly arriving forces of zombies. Collect experience points, upgrade your weapon, and continue on!

name: 少女与机甲/Girls And Robots
short_description: This game is a survivors rougelike game.World is lost by monsters and bugs. Player can pick three diferent girls and robots, to make a special team.They will face thounds monsters and bugs, fight, live, evolution and find the trueth of the lost world.

name: Mining Mechs
short_description: Unleash your inner miner as you commandeer a high-tech Mining Mech! Mine for valuable resources and upgrade your mech for even bigger hauls as you explore the underground. Fun to play alone or with up to 7 friends in online co-op multiplayer!

name: Truth
short_description: Step into the role of judge on a new reality show and award the one million dollar prize to the contestant you feel most deserves it. There are six contestants hooked up to lie detectors who must answer any question you ask them. Vote one off each round until only the winner remains.

name: Trash Panda
short_description: A small, chill, low-fi raccoon simulator, where you play as a raccoon roaming neighbourhoods of Toronto making a mess. Knock over trash bins, find power-ups, challenge other raccoons, and get lost.

name: Porusz Umysł PLUS
short_description: Aplikacja wspomagająca rozwój dzieci i młodzieży w wieku 7-13 lat. Podnosi umiejętności szkolne, zapobiega deficytom, pomaga osiągać sukcesy, podnosi motywację do zdobywania wiedzy w sposób szybki i trwały. Wydobywa potencjał intelektualny dziecka i rozwija go wszechstronnie.

name: The Spectral Web: Hitodama
short_description: Explore a Labyrinth full of magic, monsters, and mystery in this dungeon crawler inspired by retro classics. Wield unique spells to battle enemies, break blocks, and uncover hundreds of secrets hidden within the Labyrinth's walls.

name: The Adventures of Bruce Flea
short_description: Welcome to 'The Adventures Of Bruce Flea' , an action-packed fighting game where Kung fu powered Fleas live, love, and engage in thrilling battles across vast microscopic lands of the dog.

name: Sqube Darkness
short_description: A unique endless running game. Only 1% of the racers reached 5000 meters!

name: Betrix
short_description: Betrix is ​​a unique block game that combines the block puzzle game and the music game, allowing you to play with the rhythm of music in the stack.

name: Eternights
short_description: Eternights is a dating action game where you try to make the most out of life during the apocalypse. Monday: Go on a date. Tuesday: Clear dungeon. Friday: Freak out! The clock is ticking!!

name: Kitten Tales
short_description: Embark on an exciting quest in Kitten Tales, solve puzzles to find your mother in story mode, and challenge up to 10 players in online races and multiplayer challenges. Do you have what it takes to be the bravest cat?

name: Redrum Hotel
short_description: Redrum Hotel is a short, first-person horror adventure game. Roam around the haunted hotel, collecting strangely scattered notes and avoiding the evil presence that seeks to rid you of your sanity.

name: BALL PIT KING 3D
short_description: BALL PIT KING 3D is a fun and addictive puzzle game where you drop, stack and merge quirky 3D balls with hilarious faces to create the ultimate King Ball! Play and see if you can rule supreme over the Ball Pit!

name: Pteranodon
short_description: A prehistoric singleplayer fps experience featuring unique spear throwing mechanics! Hone your skills as you compete to be the best on the public leaderboard!

name: Jolly Putt - Mini Golf & Arcade
short_description: The jolliest Mini Golf & Arcade Tycoon game! Design and Play your own courses. Manage arcade ticket prizes, food stalls, staff and much more to satisfy your park guest's every need. Customize, decorate and explore your park in first-person.

name: Project: Artificial Legacy Saga
short_description: Embark on journey through the 'Project: Artificial Legacy Saga' a four-part series, crafted to feel as if it was released across four console generations. Follow Kirana on her heroic journey, as she protects her family and her homeland from a mysterious evil force.

name: DAY 10,909
short_description: One day, a light falls from the sky! For 10909 days, everything in your life seemed completely normal, until suspicion suddenly arose. You decide to escape the set and journey to Fiji to find your first love, who said that everything is a show.

name: Here Goes Muffin
short_description: An exploratory, physics-based platformer, with powerups that enable you to explore the world in new and exciting ways!

name: Escape the Dark Tower
short_description: Step into a realm of mystery and magic with Escape the Dark Tower, a captivating escape room adventure in charming pixel art.

name: Ghost at Dawn
short_description: In 1947, hard-boiled private eye Ben O'Hara is searching for a missing girl in an abandoned hotel. Investigate room by room, piece together clues, and give the living dead lead poisoning in this noir horror. Can you push through your fear and discover what became of her?

name: Wastelander
short_description: Wastelander is a turn-based colony-building strategy game with roguelike elements. Build a colony up from nothing on a remote desert planet, unlock unique buildings and re-activate powerful relics to protect yourself from destructive storms. Every game and every colony is different!

name: MAKOTO WAKAIDO’s Case Files TRILOGY DELUXE
short_description: A game based on a simple concept: a mystery puzzle you can complete in an hour. Can you solve the cases narrated in this beautiful pixel-art adventure?

name: Mini Cars Puzzle
short_description: Mini Cars Puzzle is a 3D puzzle where you need to unload the parking lot occupied by cars and help each driver get out of the parking lot without harming other cars.

name: Death Elevator
short_description: A short and minimalist roguelike where every hit is lethal but time slows down whenever you are in danger. Reach the top floor or die trying!

name: Become A Star
short_description: Play as a musician on his journey to success in this virtual reality rhythm game! Choose your instrument, prepare your concerts on stage, and feel the crowd vibrate to the rhythm of original songs!

name: Turf Wars: A Snail Escape
short_description: Strap on your shell and dive antenna-first into a thrilling action roguelike. Spread slime, snag upgrades, and splat bugs. You only have one mission: escape the garden or dry trying...

name: Molly Medusa: Queen of Spit
short_description: A gravity-bending 3D adventure where everyone turns to stone!

name: Secrets of the Haunted Mansion
short_description: 'Secrets of the Haunted Mansion' is an immersive interactive adventure game that transports players into the dark and mysterious world of an abandoned and haunted estate. Step into the shoes of an explorer, ready to unearth forgotten secrets and unravel intriguing puzzles.

name: Football Manager 2024
short_description: Build a world-class team ready to dominate your rivals in football’s most prestigious competitions. Progress never stops when you’re pursuing footballing greatness.

name: Chinese Pope Door
short_description: This is a role-playing game where the player can fight freely with the enemies. You can run and jump freely, use sword and dart to attack the enemies, and special attack to give the enemies a heavy blow. If you like Super Mario's style of operation, you must try this game.

name: Laruaville 5
short_description: Use your Match 3 skills to build a ship and help ghosts leave an uninhabited island!

name: NIGHT FEAR
short_description: NIGHT FEAR is a fast-paced roguelike where you play as a brave knight, the last of a line of liberators. Use the best weapons and skills to defeat enemy units and not die in a dark dungeon. You must give it your all, collect the best weapons, complete all levels of the dungeon and stay alive!

name: The Silent Swan
short_description: The Silent Swan is a contemplative first-person narrative experience across a megalithic, derelict world. Mixing elements from both walking simulator and open levels.

name: Half Alive
short_description: Half Alive is a Low Poly Multiplayer FPS Game. Survive each round of zombies after which a more difficult round begins. Enlarge your playing area and your weapons backpack to provide yourself good chances of survival !

name: Pro Strategy Football 2024
short_description: PSF 2024 - even more customizations! Sports Ticker! Waiver Draft! More stats! Improved AI! Improved Editor! Career can have 1 to 16 conferences and up to 140 teams! Fatigue and Injury sliders! More rules and overtime options!

name: Salah Simulator
short_description: Salah simulation game lets players learn and practice Salah. It guides players through the various postures and steps of the prayer with intuitive controls.

name: Combat Zone
short_description: Welcome to the exciting world of Combat Zone! Get ready for an intense first-person shooting experience like never before. The game is currently in the Beta Test phase, and we are thrilled to share this journey with our players.

name: Ekans
short_description: Experience the classic Snake game with a twist! You're the fruit, and your mission is to escape the snake. Outsmart your opponents, climb the leaderboard, and face the thrilling challenge!

name: Vampire's Kiss
short_description: Unleash your lust and your thirst in a battle for the soul of London! Will passion lead you back to humanity, or will you embrace the night as a vampire?

name: COCOON
short_description: From Jeppe Carlsen, the lead gameplay designer of LIMBO and INSIDE — COCOON takes you on an adventure across worlds within worlds. Master world-leaping mechanics and solve intricate puzzles to unravel a cosmic mystery.

name: King Kitty Saves The Animals
short_description: Jump, dash and do general cat things with King Kitty on an adventure to save his friends from the mean Ghost King.

name: Choice Clash: What Would You Rather?
short_description: Experience a world of choices in this ultimate decision-making game with 300 mind-bending dilemmas. Your path, your destiny awaits! And You What Would You Rather? Be invisible for a day or Be able to fly for a day? Your Choice matter!

name: In Stars And Time
short_description: Live with the ever-present burden of being trapped in a time loop only you can know about in this turn-based RPG. Create a better future for you and your friends. Find hope where there is none left. Pray to the stars and free yourself from time.

name: Fightcore Forge
short_description: Confront opponents and friends as a training robot in a maze arena. Playable online or in local up to 6 player, have some fun driving around and shooting everything you can with the help of power-ups and strategy.

name: Halls of Watershot
short_description: A deck-building ARPG in a dark fantasy setting. Find powerful items, wield elemental magic, and battle dangerous monsters as you explore a dark and twisted castle. Combines the decision making and variety of a card game, with the fast paced combat of an ARPG.

name: The Walking Dead: Betrayal
short_description: Betray your friends in this 5-8 person game of cooperation and social deception set in the universe of The Walking Dead. Work together to survive, but trust no one! Traitors have so many ways to sabotage the team, the walkers are the most predictable threat.

name: The Grinch: Christmas Adventures
short_description: The Grinch has had a wonderful, awful idea – steal all the presents in Who-ville, using gadgets like his stealthy Santa costume and Candy Cane Lasso. Help him sneak around, freeze creatures with snowballs, and learn the meaning of Christmas along the way, in this festive platformer!

name: Wicked Times
short_description: Wicked Times is an RPG manager/autobattler. Embark on a journey to stop the demon Kugraltha and his minions who occupy the lands. Collect gold. Upgrade your equipment. Find new towns and activities that give you extra experience and gold along the way.

name: DENDAM
short_description: DENDAM is a game of hide and seek, you can fight and will be given weapons but can only load 1 bullet, besides that there will be ghosts that bother you, some puzzles to complete the task.

name: Iron Dungeon
short_description: Iron Dungeon combines a twin-stick shooter, a 2d platformer and a roguelite. Explore a dangerous underground complex in search of dozens of weapons, gadgets and upgrades to find a way to the surface and find out if there is still life on Earth!

name: Fear The Void
short_description: Something goes wrong during your subway journey home, leaving you in quiet darkness. Can you find your way back to reality? And are you sure you're alone? An atmospheric horror game, that will get you consumed…

name: Forgive Me Father 2
short_description: Embark on a journey into the darkest nightmares to restore your sanity. Blast your way through hordes of possessed enemies, unlock an arsenal of deadly weapons and unearthly abilities, and get ready to face even more Lovecraftian madness in this action-packed FPS sequel.

name: Jank Cube VR
short_description: Jank Cube is a fun VR physics sandbox filled to the brim with cool unique objects for you to interact with using the fully physically simulated player rig in maps made from the ground up for VR.

name: Astrominer
short_description: Embark on an epic space adventure in AstroMiner, where you must build a base, overcome challenges, and construct a space ship to return home from the asteroid belt.

name: Call fur Help
short_description: Call for Help immerses you in the exciting world of firecat firefighters. Save the city as a brave feline firefighter! Tackle fires, clear obstacles, and showcase your courage in cooperative mode with friends. Action awaits around every corner!

name: Charles Haunted Mansion
short_description: Charles Haunted Mansion is a 2D Top-Down Survival Horror game based on the story of a mansion, haunted by the vengeful spirit of a woman and demons.

name: Alaskan Road Truckers
short_description: Experience life in the definitive trucker simulator. Deliver cargo to make your business a success. Get out of your truck to explore Alaska while maintaining your vehicle and preparing for treacherous conditions on the road. Have you got what it takes to become an Alaskan trucking legend?

name: The Night Watch : Ranger Survival
short_description: The Night Watch : Ranger Survival is a tiny top-down shooting game where you must survive through the night with ranger's oldest friends - bow, arrow, and a bonfire. Shoot down monsters marching out from darkness, keep your bonfire and yourself safe, and survive to see the next sun rises.

name: Open Wheel Manager 2
short_description: The ultimate racing management sim - Strategize, customize, refine to create your racing edge. Hire, research, win sponsors and attract the best drivers all while managing every aspect of your 90’s race team.

name: Spirited Thief
short_description: Scout, loot, and get out in Spirited Thief, a tactical turn-based heist simulator with a twist. Search ahead as spirit, Trin, and grab the goods as thief, Elaj. Just make sure you have the loot before the guards come looking!

name: Matriarchy Attack
short_description: Pixel woman character game, you are figthing with abnormal enemies. dystopian platform based story game.

name: Ortharion : The Last Battle
short_description: The Mage Ortharion has chosen you for The Last Battle! Make the right choices as you explore a world filled with magic and secrets. Improve your character in multiple ways and manage an adventurer's guild.

name: Jake's Apple Harvest
short_description: A Sokoban game where you have to help Jake pick his apples.

name: Retro Revengers
short_description: A retro-style adventure platformer game, inspired by hits of the past and featuring wonderful music created by Manami Matsumae, will take you on an eventful journey through the diverse environmental stages to encourage you to save the world of retro gaming.

name: Incredible Dracula: Dark Carnival
short_description: It’s for a magical conundrum like no other! Elizabeth, Dracula’s beloved wife, has been cursed by the mischievous magician, Bestby. Her head was transformed into a pumpkin, and Dracula must embark on a quest to break the curse before it's too late.

name: Chaotic Pursuit
short_description: Chaotic Pursuit is a hardcore Top-Down Shooter with cute graphics. You miss a shot and you're out!

name: Haunted House
short_description: Creep, sneak, and dash your way through hordes of ghouls and eerie ectoplasms in this roguelite reimagining of the classic Atari adventure!

name: Robots Shooting Simulator
short_description: Join the epic battle in deep space with Robots Shooting Simulator! Create your robot hero, determine your strategy, and destroy enemies.

name: Arthur's Reading Race
short_description: Arthur’s Reading Race centers around everyone’s favorite Aardvark. Arthur is trying to teach his little sister, D.W, to read. However, she insists that she already knows how!

name: Tsetseg's Adventure
short_description: Tsetseg, the little witch, is in crisis. Her friends are taken and converted to bad guys by the Mad Wizard. Explore castle, fight Bosses, rescue friends, regain special power, and defeat Mad Wizard! A classic pixel style, 2D platformer game.

name: Polygon Race
short_description: Polygon Race is an arcade car game with minimalist graphics. Your task is not touching the cones, get to the finish line or collect the flags for a certain time. Be careful not to crash the car.

name: The night of erosion (prequel)
short_description: 'I', an ordinary high school student, turns into a monster every night after a certain incident. The protagonist struggles to find out why he became a monster and at the same time avoid being restrained. Please join this girl on her journey toward truth.

name: Slime 3K: Rise Against Despot
short_description: Welcome to Slime 3K, an unhinged roguelite bullet-heaven set in the Despot’s Game universe! Build a deck of crazy weapons, grow stronger and devour hordes of pink puny humans as a murderous jelly blob on a warpath of death, violence and pretzels.

name: Beatmons 2
short_description: Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! Do not die ! I don't want to die

name: Kinduo 2 - Frostbite
short_description: Kinduo 2 is a local co-op game where two elemental friends with unique abilities need to help each other to overcome obstacles! Create blocks of ice, burn or melt things, and combine your skills to create plants!

name: SEMU
short_description: Space adventure can be scary, so that's why we at InkForge Studios have developed the most advanced Space Suit ever - the SEMU suit. Standing for Survival Extra-vehicular Mobility Unit, it will keep you safe as you journey the cosmos. With survival guaranteed, what else is there to worry about?

name: The Runemaster's Diary
short_description: Explore environments full of secrets and meet quirky characters in this short rpg. Collect items, use them in battle and to get access to different places. And most importantly, help Mac in his adventure to save a puppy from some evil oranges!

name: Gearbits
short_description: Fast-paced mecha themed third person shooter.

name: Liberty Belle
short_description: In this bite-sized 3D Platformer adventure, a villain has unleashed havoc across the United States! It's up to the heroic LIBERTY BELLE to put a stop to his plans!

name: Tuk Tuk Taxi
short_description: Tuk Tuk Taxi is an exciting game that lets you experience the thrill of being a tuk tuk driver in a bustling city.

name: Case 03: True Cannibal Boy
short_description: A horror mystery adventure game with ghost story elements. Anxiety plagues college student Lily, whose crush Sally has gone missing. As Lily explores the truth, Sally's boyfriend starts to look increasingly suspicious. Even worse, the story of the Cannibal Boy seems to be involved somehow...

name: Musical Vibes
short_description: Discover a new dance game playable with the camera of your smartphone connected to your PC! Dance, hands free, to great music and learn new cool moves! Full-body tracking thanks to AI!

name: Alaca
short_description: Alaca is an action rogue like game with a Top down perspective. While it contains different types of weapons and elements, you must build and master your character by combining them in the most correct way. There is no save point. kill, build character, learn and repeat..

name: Cute Farmer Life
short_description: Cute Farmer Life is a small indie farm game. Grow, craft and collect resources in a game designed to relax and enjoy the moment. Discover the secrets of the small town you have moved to.

name: Dee's Nuts 2
short_description: Dee is back, in an all new game of grabbing Dee's nuts. Fill your tree to the brim with nuts before the winter season. This time you can race your friends in an all new single player, up to 3 person multiplayer experience and battle to collect the most nuts.

name: Slum musketeer
short_description: The game is a 2D platformer with puzzle elements. Go through many levels, find out what happened to the teacher. Overcome various traps, fight enemies with swords, and also destroy bosses! Find a way to bring it back!

name: Deceit 2
short_description: Deceit 2 is a 4-9 player social deduction horror game where two among you have been Infected. Whilst the Infected do the Game Master's bidding, the Innocent must work together to escape the Ritual whilst deducing who is plotting against them. So who can you trust?

name: Growth
short_description: Growth is a cozy, hexagonal-grid based soft-strategy game. Explore and populate a procedurally generated world by utilizing unique abilities of animals. Growth blends the beauty of cozy exploration with challenging navigation around obstacles.

name: CyVenge
short_description: CyVenge is a fast paced and action packed rougelite arena shooter. Choose from many upgradable weapons and abilities and help Cy fight against numerous waves of enemies!

name: 一梦封神
short_description: 《一梦封神》是一款基于封神演义为背景的回合制战斗游戏，以姜子牙的视角游历封神演义中著名的经典战役！并且玩家可获得各种知名英雄，养成自己最强大的队伍。

name: Pixel Descent
short_description: Pixel Descent is an action rogue-lite in which you navigate a series of complex dungeons packed to the brim with monsters that want you dead. Sign the contract and descend into the deepest depths of the abyss knowing full well that you will definitely die there, it's just a matter of when.

name: Long Way
short_description: Long Way is an immersive arcade driving simulator with diverse vehicles and customization. Driving different type of vehicles with trailers, various landscapes, and weather conditions. Impressive graphics, dynamic time, and challenges enhance immersion. Multiplayer support for up to 8 friends.

name: Haunted House Builder
short_description: Build a haunted house and scare some guests.

name: Garden of Seif: Chronicles of an Assassin
short_description: Garden of Seif is a visual novel with dating sim mechanics. Play as a female assassin and choose to embark on a path of trust... or betrayal.

name: ISLAND CLASH
short_description: 'ISLAND CLASH' is an adrenaline-pumping, fast-paced first-person shooter game! Unlock brand new weapons every time you eliminate enemies, with no ammunition limits, delivering a completely different shooting experience! Are you ready to take on the hail of bullets?

name: Astronimo
short_description: Astronimo is a construction platform puzzler that takes you and your friends out of this world into a vast solar system, providing them with expansive creation tools to stretch the bounds of imagination.

name: Asterix & Obelix Slap Them All! 2
short_description: Asterix & Obelix – Slap them all! 2 is a Beat’em Up with an original story. Explore different places such as forest ruins, a vast Roman camp and even Lutèce. Encounters and fights punctuate the storyline. This dynamic game invites you to come on an adventure — with a generous distribution of slaps!

name: Resident Fear : Redistribution
short_description: 'Survive a zombie nightmare in 'Resident Fear: Redistribution.' Explore, solve puzzles, and confront the undead in this thrilling horror adventure from Gamesoft Studios.'

name: Deadfall
short_description: Deadfall is a dark, bloody, atmospheric, dynamic, brutal shooter in the spirit of action movies of the 80s and 90s.

name: Heads Up! Phones Down Edition
short_description: Showcase your wit (or lack thereof) in this hilarious party game, fit for the big screen!

name: Marauder of Dystopia: The weakest go to the wall
short_description: The people of the Omega Empire suffer under the oppressive rule of Emperor Duke—but a beautiful, dark-haired woman, sword in hand, has risen up to assassinate oppressors until her people are free! A doujin RPG from hit circle ONEONE1 featuring animated battles and more.

name: Gearhead Karting Simulator - Mechanic & Racing
short_description: The ultimate kart racing game with deep customization, realistic physics, and a variety of game modes. Build, tune, and race your way to victory!

name: Ninja Issen (忍者一閃)
short_description: With its cyberpunk city brought to life with retro graphics, Ninja Issen invites players into a world filled with 'hyper ninja action' as they work alone to annihilate waves of enemy troops using a variety of ninja skills and fight bosses coming at you with relentless, diverse attack patterns.

name: Battle for the Board
short_description: Adventure through a colorful tabletop-themed world, strategically rolling special moves and attacks to defeat enemy pieces in this turn-based action strategy game!

name: Only Up!
short_description: Get set to defy gravity, leap like never before, and experience the exhilarating world of parkour in a whole new light! This isn’t just your ordinary parkour jump simulator - it’s a dynamic ONLINE MULTIPLAYER adventure that transforms your every move into a gravity-defying spectacle.

name: Big D Randy
short_description: Randy is not playing around.. Collect all candy's on huge map and don't get caught!

name: Topswap
short_description: Topswap: A high-octane, shape-shifting FPS.

name: [케인] 돈통 쌓기
short_description: 오우 나 미개하구나 우마우도

name: IMMORTAL BEAST
short_description: IMMORTAL BEAST - Dynamic 2D roguelike with a wide variety of enemies and weapons. You will play as a treasure hunter who has decided on a desperate adventure in search of wealth and glory! You will go down into a dark dungeon and enter into an unequal battle with dangerous enemies!

name: Sempiternal
short_description: Sempiternal is a psychological thriller survival game. In the universe of back rooms, you will experience the loneliness to the fullest and find yourself in a different mystery in each level and get lost in the back rooms.

name: Legendary Creatures 2
short_description: Sequel to the acclaimed Legendary Creatures, created by HideChara, and a fun treat combining both roguelike and auto-battler gameplay. Recruit and evolve a large array of troops, creatures, and an arsenal of weapons, to defeat the demon lord spreading corruption across the land.

name: Orbit Zero
short_description: Create a Company, Build structures, Collect Resources, Make Investments and Speculate on Assets. Carefully manage your Workforce, Finances, Resources, Shareholders, BOD & Political Partnerships.

name: Galaxy Kart VR
short_description: An arcade kart racing game focused in COMBAT and the UNIQUE SKILLS of each driver!

name: Sunset Racer
short_description: Sunset Racer is an immersive racing game that transports players to the golden era of automobiles, where powerful cars with full tanks of gasoline raced into the sunset.

name: 傀儡の宿 - Kairai Inn -
short_description: A score-attack action game where you aim for high scores by subduing dangerous 'kairai.'

name: Infection Crisis : Fight For Life
short_description: Welcome to Infection Crisis: Fight for Life. This is a budget-free survival game created by a single developer. A zombie apocalypse has erupted in your country, and players must fight for survival on this treacherous journey.

name: Wantless : Solace at World’s End
short_description: Wantless is a fast-paced Tactical RPG set in a dystopian future. Fight off torments inside your patients' minds using a deep skill-crafting system and innovative combat mechanics. Utilize your environment, confront horrors made manifest and walk the fine line of morality in a dying world.

name: Orbo's Odyssey
short_description: Hop into Orbo's shoes! Run, jump and drill around your boss's office, make some new friends, and uncover terrifying secrets about the company you work for in this comedically surreal 3D platformer!

name: SKIBIDI BACKROOMS
short_description: SKIBIDI BACKROOMS is a cooperative horror game for a group of 4 players. Solo mode is also available. You have to survive among the BACKROOMS and find a way out before you are overtaken by the SKIBIDI TOILET. Updates and various interesting things await you...

name: FIND ALL 4: Magic
short_description: Find over 800 cute animals and objects in a lot of levels of varying difficulty. The magical black and white world comes alive after coloring. Relax and enjoy playing.

name: YouTuber Survivors
short_description: Youtuber Survivors is a 2D BEAT 'EM UP + Roguelike game. Team up with various YouTubers such as fitness, piano, and gaming YouTubers to survive! From the creator of 'Meteor 60 seconds!'.

name: Mostroscopy
short_description: Mostroscopy is a fighting video game that takes up the aesthetics of the horror and Luchador films of Mexican cinema from the 1950s, with an eclectic roster of monsters and masked Luchadores and a simple gameplay style with a retro presentation.

name: Bahamut2-Come on,Fight
short_description: Roguelike combat mode, every battle is a new start, choose your favorite transfer route, learn new skills, face different enemies, and challenge the invincible devil. Bahamut 2-Bride of the Dragon parallel time and space, what different stories will there be?

name: Tower Song
short_description: A 2D turn-based retro-fusion JRPG! Engaging combat and character-driven drama await players and their chosen hero in this strategy mechanics-rich role playing adventure. (Don't forget to pet the cat!)

name: PAW Patrol World
short_description: Explore the world of PAW Patrol like never before and stop Mayor Humdinger’s super blimp mayhem, in a free-roaming 3D adventure full of pup-tastic fun!

name: Space Battle Royale
short_description: Welcome to cosmic chaos. This non-stop action arcade will test you to see if you are truly worthy of space travel. The full use of 3d space, five classes of weapons, and upgrades based on alien technology and alternative dimensions make for the most competitive and mind-expanding game out there.

name: Dark Bunny
short_description: You are the Dark Bunny. You want carrots. You kill farm animals to get carrots. That's it. That's the game. In this roguelite, topdown arena, semi autobattler you will use various skills and items to create unique, powerful builds to defeat all the mega evil farm animals. And get all the carrots!

name: Stick and Balls
short_description: Stick and Balls is an exceedingly difficult climb up a minimalist tower. Control two balls, separately yet simultaneously, connected by a stick, with other physics shenanigans that are simple to learn, hard to master. The smallest mistake might lead you on a (psychologically) painful fall.

name: The Inner Demons
short_description: The Inner Demons is the first game in a new genre of “Cinematically Cut Games”. Explore a horror environment through a cinematic lens in this innovative interactive experience.

name: Fall Of The Son
short_description: Fall Of The Son is a roguelike deckbuilder. Assemble powerful strategies to battle through hordes of enemies - with 3 playable characters and over 200 unique cards at your disposal. Do you have the grit and determination to make it to the end and face off against The Son?

name: Clanswoman
short_description: It is a story about the adventure of two sisters who leave their quiet lives behind and embark on a journey of revenge due to some unfortunate events. Turn based adventure game. --Warning-- This game may contain swearing and offensive (sexual) words, blood and violence. NOT SUITABLE FOR CHILDREN.

name: The Making of Karateka
short_description: Play the history. Go behind the scenes of Jordan Mechner's landmark game Karateka in this interactive documentary from Digital Eclipse, with archival materials, video features, and more. Experience pixel-perfect versions of this legendary game, with all-new features.

name: Exotic Kosmos
short_description: Invite your friends to an exchange of punches where up to four players can compete in the same arena in search of the glory of being the great champion. Also face the adventure mode where there are numerous mysteries, in a virtual and exotic adventure to the sound of a beautiful soundtrack.

name: Land Above Sea Below
short_description: Land Above Sea Below is an atmospheric building strategy and puzzle game where you have to build your island from tiles in order to raise its height as much as possible, to avoid it getting flooded by the constantly rising sea level.

name: Buff Huckem Fully  Wrecked
short_description: A humorous action platformer. Fight through standard enemies and bosses using melee and short ranged combat as you platform through a world based in 90's cartoon style. Upgrade your abilities as you progress to become an unstoppable force of...gas.

name: Terror in the Kitchen
short_description: This is a first person atmospheric horror game. The style of the game is influenced by old graphics trend (PSX games etc). You play as a part timer in a restaurant. You wash dishes, take out trash, pump the toilets and organize the table tops.

name: Another Crusade
short_description: Discover a 3d wooden puppet style world while exploring as a platformer, and taking battles in a turn-based combat as an old school RPG where timing and strategy are the keys to victory!

name: Liquid Havoc
short_description: Craft custom liquids with mind-bending properties and create immersive scenes using the Scene Editor! Enjoy 60+ simulations that bring realism to destruction with shatter physics, soft body dynamics, real-time fluid simulation, structural integrity, and other exciting features!

name: DJLand
short_description: ▼ Exquisite Art Style - More exquisite and comfortable than arcade graphics, perfect upgrade for gaming experience!

name: Forest Spirit
short_description: Tired of office life, you go to live in nature. In this new life, you have to build, craft, farm, fight and interact with the locals.

name: Magical Hike
short_description: Welcome to the enchanting world of Magical Hike, a soothing and immersive walking simulator that invites you to embark on a tranquil journey through picturesque landscapes and captivating environments. Leave your worries behind as you explore breathtaking locations.

name: 12 Labours of Hercules XV: Little Big Adventure
short_description: Help Hercules free from the tiny folk’s shackles and save Lilliputians' lands from a shadow-casting island floating in the sky!

name: Core Defence
short_description: Core Defence is a tower defence game with roguelike elements. Build towers to defend the Core, unlock new ones and upgrade them, choose from a variety of powerful effects and defeat bosses.

name: MEGA MAN X DiVE Offline
short_description: Mega Man X DiVE reimagined the world of the Mega Man X series, and now it's getting an offline version! Strengthen your characters and weapons with a variety of powerups to make them all your own. Then test them out in the side-scrolling action of 'what-if' worlds in Mega Man X!

name: Off Grids
short_description: The ultimate open-world survival game that redefines the genre. Welcome to a world where you get to experience hunting, gathering, building, crafting, looting, exploring and even travel in time from 2030 to 10.000 Bc. Your resourcefulness is your greatest assets. It's time to embrace the wild.

name: CTRL+ALT+REPEAT
short_description: CTRL+ALT+REPEAT is a multiplayer 3D parkour platformer where you race against the clock and your friends. As you progress through harder obstacles you will unlock increasingly complex movement abilities.

name: Meowing Point
short_description: Point and meow. 3D hidden cat game. These creatures have been turned into stone. Find and save them all.

name: Solace State: Emotional Cyberpunk Stories
short_description: Can you retain your humanity while fighting against a corporate biotech conspiracy? Play as the young hacker Chloe who confronts political plots as she fights for her friends and her neighbors. Your choices in building up relationships and communities can revolutionize into hope or hostility.

name: Space Maze
short_description: Help the crew of the Aurora and their captain, the fearless John Smith, to reach their destination and deliver the cure for humanity, thus saving the human race.

name: Vampires' Melody 2
short_description: Emerald seas! Blue skies! Sandy beaches! An island adventure in the ocean sounds like a trip to paradise. However, the place is a nightmare with no one to provide any blood for Raylan to feed on after he turned into a vampire by accident, especially since he has another hungry vampire at his side.

name: Elon's last chance
short_description: Elon's last chance is a time management simulator with a running astronaut under your control. Complete tasks that appear gradually within the timer. Try to hold out as long as possible, because if any of the timers expires, the game will be over.

name: Abscission
short_description: Abscission is a Lovecraftian, story-driven horror point-and-click investigation game. It involves searching crime scenes for evidence, combining clues and questioning suspects. Puzzles can have multiple solutions as you guide the protagonist - Detective Will Stanhope - through the story.

name: Roots of the mind
short_description: Brave the perilous world of insects battling mind-bending roots.

name: Adventure Story
short_description: Play the role of the Adventure Guild President of the Magic World. Manage and utilize every resource at hand. Dig out legendary stories from various regions and spread your guild name throughout the entire empire. Finally, obtain powerful artifacts hidden around the world.

name: Torn Away
short_description: Torn Away is an award winning interactive story with a unique blend of adventure games, side-scrollers, and cinematic first-person levels. Help little Asya find her way home in the middle of World War II.

name: Fantasy Craft
short_description: Fantasy Craft is a medieval fantasy life simulator with survival and RPG elements. Build, craft, hunt, go fishing, farm, cook, brew potions, explore the world, go treasure hunting and fight monsters.

name: Sorrow Asylum 2
short_description: Sorrow Asylum 2 is a looping horror game, a mix of an abandoned asylum and your mind's prison, as well as a sequel to Sorrow Asylum.

name: Surrogate
short_description: Visit a surreal world and help a blue girl navigate the perils of paranoia and the intrusion of mysterious beings in her life...

name: Caster's Trap
short_description: Enter the vanishing cabin and discover its secrets and magic, while avoiding ghastly entities.

name: 廃集落探索
short_description: This is a horror game where you explore an abandoned village at the request of a friend.

name: Cozy Fishing
short_description: Cozy Fishing is a game where you can chill and fish to grow your aquarium fish collection in chilling environments and a relaxing atmosphere.

name: LineMaze
short_description: LineMaze is one of the most creative puzzle game for your brain. This brain-stimulating puzzle game, very simple, and enjoyable for all ages.

name: Fantasy Blacksmith Shop Simulator
short_description: Step into the enchanting world of 'Fantasy Blacksmith,' where hammers clang, furnaces roar, and raw materials transform into awe-inspiring arms. Forge your destiny today!

name: Silent Seeker
short_description: Silent Seeker is a Hide & Seek multiplayer game. Play in the clutches of the hunter to find the props hidden in the map! Or Play as a prop and hide from the hunter!

name: Ring Racer
short_description: Navigate through rings in stunning canyons and race against the clock.

name: Backrooms:Run For Your Life!
short_description: This is a Backrooms game created by fans. In this game, the main experience is the 'Level!' in Backroom(or 'Run For Your Life').

name: The Unvisited Grandma
short_description: How long have you been visiting your grandmother?You abandoned your family. But she remembers you. The house remembers you.Visit the house where you grew up.Peculiarities:-Tense atmosphere-Visions-You need to understand yourself and your past.

name: Sociable Soccer 24
short_description: Sociable Soccer 24 is a FIFPRO licensed arcade action game from Sensible Soccer creator Jon Hare. This world of soccer features fast, intuitive gameplay, couch & online PVP, 80 trophies to win, over 1000 teams to play & 13,000 licensed players to collect & upgrade as you ascend our league system.

name: Real Drift Multiplayer 2
short_description: Real Drift Multiplayer 2 offers a unique experience waiting for drift enthusiasts! Experience a real racing simulator with customizable vehicles, competitive online modes, and realistic drift dynamics.

name: Златогорье 2: Холодные небеса
short_description: Златогорье 2: Холодные Небеса - продолжение популярной ролевой игры Златогорье 2, открывает новые вехи истории этого игрового мира. Добавлены новые локации, новые герои, новая структура сюжета.

name: AREA93
short_description: A final struggle for survival in the zombie world

name: Bopl Battle
short_description: A couch/online game where you battle your friends with unique and wild abilities. There are many choices such as a shrink ray, creating black holes, stopping time and attaching a rocket engine to the stage to send it flying. Choose a combination that synergizes well to win the round!

name: Jigsaw Together
short_description: jigsaw Together is a jigsaw puzzle game that supports custom materials. In this game, you can customize the number of puzzle pieces and use local images, MP4 videos, or specify web pages as background materials for playing.

name: Under A New Sun
short_description: While searching for a new home, an unexpected failure in your ship has left you stranded on a planet surprisingly similar to Earth. Discover a vast open world, hunt for food, develop technologies, and build yourself a new home to survive!

name: The World's Hardest Game 3D Nostalgia 2
short_description: Easy to play, hard to finish. The World's Hardest Game 2, which you used to play on flash game sites, is now with you in 3D! The same 50 levels as in the original game are now here. Be patient, dodge enemies and reach to the end in this 3D Hard Platformer!

name: All Alone
short_description: A missing father, a mysterious murder, paintings depicting missing children. A Short horror game in which the protagonist, who has lost his memory, is forced to get to a horrific truth. Who in the world are you?

name: Ghost Mission
short_description: Inspired by stealth-action classics of the past, take control of an elite commando with the ability to turn invisible on a tense adventure where staying out of sight is the best way to stay alive, where the line between truth and fiction is always blurry, and where nothing is ever as it seems.

name: Flower Simulator
short_description: You are a blooming flower. Relax and enjoy the tranquility.

name: Alien Hominid HD
short_description: The 2D side-scrolling shooter from The Behemoth is back! With your mighty blaster and a group of mysterious kids by your side, destroy the agency and reclaim your spaceship!

name: Concealed
short_description: As the first official work of the 'Parallel' series, 'Concealed' told a story about the mysterious disappearance of some students in '帝英灵' high school. Is it some supernatural powers behind all of this? Facing abundant plot branches and diverse story-driven gameplay, you may need to choose wisely.

name: Raven Simulator
short_description: Isn't that too complex living as a human being? Then live your life as a raven and enjoy as you can!

name: NO Logic
short_description: NO Logic is a puzzle platform game where you have to disable your logic in order to complete this game!

name: Joyville
short_description: Joyville is a horror-puzzle adventure game set in an abandoned children's camp. Brace yourself for a gripping journey through the shadows, solving puzzles, and trying to survive amidst the hidden horrors that await you.

name: Frogs also struggle
short_description: platformer with simple jumping mechanics, you will know why frogs also struggle.

name: Bee Craft Sweet
short_description: Real-time simulation game of bees Can you survive?

name: Max Twist
short_description: In this futuristic Xtreme Sport, you'll mount hover boards and spiral down eye-popping sci-fi tracks full of obstacles. Smoke speed records and set seamless twist scores to a heart-pumping soundtrack. Inspired by games like 1080° Snowboarding and F-Zero, Max Twist takes the concept to the space age.

name: Divinity Hunting
short_description: A turn-based combat strategy game, Open world treasure hunt exploration,looking for the magical skills left by the ancient immortals.

name: Hotel: A Resort Simulator
short_description: You are the manager of a hotel in an idyllic location. Build, design and develop your hotel, while creating unforgettable memories for your guests through expert management and by offering exceptional entertainment.

name: Stronghold: Definitive Edition
short_description: Greetings sire! Your stronghold awaits you. Build a castle economy, besiege unforgettable villains and return to the 'castle sim' that started it all. Experience this classic RTS with upgraded visuals, modernised gameplay, Steam multiplayer and a new campaign.

name: Hidden Space Top-Down 3D
short_description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

name: Celente Immortal
short_description: An Action-RPG game where you can recruit characters from all over the world as you go on adventures and explore new areas.

name: Plenty Karts
short_description: Make your way through over 20 tracks as you attempt to become the new champion of the Plenty Karts league. Mixing together the concept of classic kart racing games with side-scrollers, Plenty Karts is a nonstop action kart racer with 16 difficulty levels and a full story mode.

name: Cyber Lounge Tycoon
short_description: Cyber Lounge Tycoon is a sandbox management game where you get to build and customize your own gaming club. Serve each customer or get a staff to do that for you. Upgrade and maintain your existing services. Expand and unlock new options. Decide what kind of club you want to run!

name: Tome of Fates
short_description: Indie text-based interactive RPG that presents a unique spin on the adventure Gamebook genre. Experience many stories where your decisions will directly impact your path and, ultimately, Your fate!

name: Dwarves Mining Idle
short_description: Starting with a lonely Dwarf, endlessly mine to gather materials and use them to progress farther. Have more Dwarves join in, craft resources and upgrade literally everything! The mines of the idle Dwarves await you!

name: Backwoods
short_description: You will survive in forest,build your base, craft items and grow crops

name: Falling for Beans
short_description: Falling for Beans is a platformer where you must strategically descend a mystical Beanstalk, while you manage your health and outrun a Giant constantly on your tail. Do you think you can survive?

name: EMZOMBED
short_description: EMZOMBED - You must kill ALL of the Zombies and solve the mystery of the island. * MATURE CONTENT WARNING (BLOOD & GORE) *

name: Drift Cars Zombie Crusher
short_description: Join the gripping battle against the zombie invasion with Drift Cars Zombie Crusher! A breathtaking experience awaits for car enthusiasts and action lovers. Use your drift skills to crush the zombies and survive.

name: Vlad Circus: Descend Into Madness
short_description: Vlad Circus: Descend into Madness puts your sanity to the test, challenging you to escape a labyrinth of nightmares and torment. Test your mind against a slow burn of puzzles, light survival mechanics, and methodical action.

name: Gelatinous: Humanity Lost
short_description: Gelatinous is a platforming adventure with deep roots in games like Mega Man, Metroid, Castlevania, and other classics.

name: School Days
short_description: Go back to school and attend a schedule full of classes in time to pick up the knowledge you need to pass each test! But with hundreds of fellow students walking the halls, an equally important popularity contest decides whether your days are filled with fun or fear...

name: Echoes
short_description: サクッと遊べるダンジョン探索型2Dドット絵ローグライクゲーム

name: The Lemonade
short_description: As a scrawny goblin, find lemons in a cave to enjoy a glass of freshly squeezed lemonade. Sokoban-style.

name: Dark Lovers - Extended Edition
short_description: Dark Lovers is a short pixel art teenage romantic mistery visual novel game about a highschool prom night in 1979 which contains multiple endings and secrets.

name: All in Pairs
short_description: A warehouse worker's day can't be boring. Every day things are scattered on the table in front of you.

name: Heroes Of Drakemire
short_description: Embark on a grand adventure in Heroes of Drakemire, where the fate of a mesmerizing world balances on the edge. Cultivate a party of distinctive heroes, and journey through vast, danger-filled maps in this turn-based adventure inspired by classic JRPGs.

name: Football Stars Legend 24
short_description: Step onto the football field with Football Stars Legend 24, full of exciting football matches, realistic graphics and gripping tactics! Choose your favourite team, feel the fans' enthusiasm and start the match to embrace the victory.

name: Astral Tracks
short_description: Astral Tracks is a precise and competitive 3D platforming speedrunner where you run, dash, slide, swing and wall run your way to victory. Compete against friends online and refine your runs to top the leaderboards for each procedurally generated track!

name: Fuzzy Flip - Matching Game
short_description: Colorful and huggable, the Fuzzies invite you to join their exciting puzzle quest to make everybody happy in this fun and relaxing Matching game!

name: Cozy Village
short_description: Welcome to the enchanting world of Cozy Village, where tranquility and adventure intertwine in a picturesque setting. Immerse yourself in a heartwarming village exploration game that invites you to uncover hidden treasures and unravel the mysteries of this charming hamlet.

name: Lighthouse Simulator
short_description: You are forced by your girlfriend to participate in a program: staying at a lighthouse on a haunted uninhabited island for ten days can earn you 100000 dollars, and your girlfriend will come to the island to comfort you when you win

name: Bzzzt
short_description: Jump into the retro-future world with the nostalgic arcade journey of a tiny robot ZX8000! Experience an engaging story, upgrade your robotic abilities, challenge yourself in stages full of ever-changing gameplay mechanics and compete with other players in global and friends leaderboards.

name: Solitaire Quest: Garden Story
short_description: Join the captivating journey of Solitaire Quest: Garden Story and watch the garden bloom under your care. Solve solitaire puzzles, restore the garden's beauty, and uncover the secrets that await. Play now and immerse yourself in the world of solitaire delight!

name: Home Restoration VR
short_description: Grab your tools, put your creative hat on, and get ready to restore, renovate, and create beautiful homes in Home Restoration. This game has been downloaded nearly 100 million times on mobile devices and now it’s available on VR! It’s time to bring old houses back to life and make dreams come true!

name: Nightmare Side: The Game
short_description: Experience Indonesian first-person survival horror, inspired by 'Nightmare Side' from Ardan Radio. Confront eerie voices in their haunted office, solving puzzles in this immersive, true-to-life adventure. Dare you enter the heart of darkness?

name: Li'l Red
short_description: Hop, skip, and jump with Lyra as she journeys back to her homeland in this retro adventure. With harp in hand, no foe is a match for Lyra and her animal friends.

name: Ocnus Theory
short_description: Ocnus Theory is a challenging sandbox platformer that will test your creativity, reflexes, and ability to rise from a painful fall. Explore the mysteries of this open environment, shape your Ocnus to match the current challenge, and ascend to the peak! Just don't look down.

name: A Tiny Sticker Tale
short_description: A Tiny Sticker Tale is a cozy miniature adventure about changing the world, using the power of stickers!

name: Rock Simulator 2
short_description: Rock Simulator 2 is a multiplayer, meditative idle game with many secrets to uncover. Begin your journey in the hideaway to relax and enjoy the greatest objects created by mother nature!

name: Battleship
short_description: A modern Naval warfare game.

name: Shelter in the Doomsday
short_description: A casual decompression role-playing game developed by myself, in 2D horizontal version, mainly focused on defense and adventure, with storyline tasks, capable of collection and construction. Please subscribe to the download image resource package at Steam Creative Workshop before playing the game

name: Raioh
short_description: Raioh is a retro style shot and bomb style vertical scroll shmup.

name: Halloween Again
short_description: Step into a world teeming with anticipation, and join us for a hair-raising adventure.

name: DEAD END MISSION
short_description: The humans fled for their lives! Now only aliens remain in the city. Your name is Mark, a professional marksman. You have one mission, to kill the alien Queen! Your helicopter buddy will provide you with supplies during the mission. But this will not be easy...

name: Sut
short_description: A cute 2D platformer where you stick to walls and fight your way out of a hot fireplace. Features environment-based combat and a cozy, retro aesthetic.

name: Survivors of the Mare Vitalis
short_description: Survivors of the Mare Vitalis is a Rogue-Lite action game, which you can discover unique planets and it's biomes while thousands of animals and uncategorized life forms coming after to kill you!! Earn Credits while destroy them, upgrade yourself and destroy the Ecosystem of each planet!!

name: Gold and Glory
short_description: Gold and Glory is a classic exploration game developed specifically for VR. Discover the treasures of a derelict pirate ship! Fight off the peculiar creatures that dwell in this strange and magical place! Seize your gold and glory!

name: PAYDAY 3
short_description: PAYDAY 3 is the much anticipated sequel to one of the most popular co-op shooters ever. Since its release, PAYDAY-players have been reveling in the thrill of a perfectly planned and executed heist. That’s what makes PAYDAY a high-octane, co-op FPS experience without equal.

name: Island Hopper
short_description: Oh no! Your island got hit by a tornado. Can you rebuild your island and help out your friends? Enjoy randomly generated islands with different biomes to collect the resources you need to upgrade your gear and save your home. But don't leave the enemies out of your sight!

name: Don't Panic
short_description: Navigate through ever-changing mazes and outsmart inanimate pursuers. Trust your flashlight and compass, but never let your guard down!

name: The Last Commander
short_description: You are the last remaining commander. Grow your sector well and protect Earth from invading alien spaceships for 50 days. Build the best building combination on the hexagonal terrain.

name: Survivor - Castaway Island
short_description: Do you have what it takes to outplay your mates and become the sole Survivor? Explore a deserted island where you can only rely on instinct and strategy to outlast competition and survive on the island.

name: The Last Faith
short_description: A dark, gothic fusion of metroidvania and soulslike. The Last Faith thrives on merciless and precise combat with a huge range of weapons, firearms, and custom executions at your disposal. Let nothing stand in your way.

name: Rush On
short_description: Fast runner roguelite in which you blast through gorgeous abstract landscapes. Dodge lasers, avoid lava and score as much as you can. Perfect for a quick game whenever you got a few minutes.

name: Lost Puzzle: City
short_description: Lost Puzzle: City is a 3D puzzle game in which you will have to place some items from the list where they belong. Look for clues in the environment, scrutinize every street and don't forget: it's not as easy as it seems at first sight!

name: God Of Weapons
short_description: Embark on a thrilling journey in God of Weapons, an action roguelike where you must ascend the tower of Zhor to reclaim the last light for the world. To survive the monster onslaught on each tower's level, you'll need to obtain and carefully organize weapons and accessories in your inventory.

name: Spellfield
short_description: Farm! Fish! Sail! Do magic! Fall in love? You can do all this and more in Spellfield, the fantasy RPG. Fulfill the Ancient Prophecy, if you dare...

name: Art is dead
short_description: Art is dead is HARD. This 2D top-down shooter DOES NOT forgive mistakes. Enemies have the high ground, and you are trapped like a little mouse inside experimental levels. If you're skilled enough, you might unravel everything behind that annoying creature that forces you to play its games.

name: Hero Survival
short_description: Hero Survival is an action-roguelite where you have to shoot down hordes of monsters from classic horror movies one by one to please the Mad Time God. Choose from a variety of skills, weapons, and items to create a unique build for every bizarre character.

name: Unending
short_description: A roguelite-puzzle anthology.

name: Fortune's Run
short_description: Explore a decaying industrial world left behind in humanity's never-ending race to conquer the stars. Beneath its iron skies, desperate souls kill and steal for passage to the still-plentiful frontier worlds. Sink or swim in this high-octane first-person shooter with immersive sim elements.

name: Gunbrella
short_description: Uncover the dark secrets of a gritty, tangled metropolis and battle diabolic villains with your trusty Gunbrella, a bulletproof brolly that doubles as a firearm.

name: Chronicles of Vaeltaja: In Search of the Great Wanderer
short_description: A fantasy grid-based dungeon crawler role-playing game set in the kingdom of Twin Falls, a lush and colourful world created with beautiful pixel graphics.

name: Lost Recall
short_description: Puzzle game with the addition of skill-based elements. Move, push the objects, solve puzzles, and uncover new mechanics. Use unique abilities of the robots, which will allow you to unlock the next levels.

name: Sojo
short_description: An online RPG with a persistent world, gear/level based progression, fast active turn based combat, platforming puzzles, and challenging objectives. Kill creatures, get loot, sell and buy loot, group with allies, and progress to overcome the games greatest challenges.

name: Assassin War Sniper Shooting
short_description: Embark on a realistic desert adventure with Assassin War Sniper Shooting, hunt your enemies with your sniper rifle, and achieve victory! Are you ready for an unforgettable FPS experience?

name: The Front
short_description: The Front is a survival open-world crafting shooter. You play the role of a resistance fighter sent back in time to stop the rise of a tyrannical empire. Collect resources, craft tech, build shelters, and fight monsters to accomplish your mission.

name: METAL GEAR SOLID - Master Collection Version
short_description: The first 3D title in the METAL GEAR series pioneering a new level of stealth action with live action footage, cinematic cut scenes, and innovative gameplay.

name: Stations in Seoul: Card Game
short_description: Immerse yourself in the captivating universe of our enthralling prequel to Find with Seoul. This game beautifully weaves together the exciting elements of a card game RPG with a fascinating narrative that propels you on a quest for continuous development.

name: Grapploteer
short_description: A puzzle platformer about a defect robot where you grapple from wall to wall and escape the factory. Pixel art graphics and many music tracks. Head through factories, sewers, trash dumps and cities to find freedom.

name: Living Legends: Bound by Wishes
short_description: In Wishville, all dreams come true, for a price.

name: Living Legends: Voice of the Sea
short_description: The dark seas are calling... Can you undo Neptune’s deadly curse in time?

name: Two Cubes
short_description: Two Cubes is an Online Co-Op platformer where players can only touch their colour! The game requires 2 players who own the game to play!

name: Wisp Child
short_description: Join Mylo in this coming of age adventure as they explore magical woods, hone their alchemy skills, and repair their troubled relationship with Ademia. Unravel the secrets of wisps, and even learn to control them. Meet fun and quirky characters, and find your place in the village.

name: FireKrackers
short_description: Grab a firecracker and try to clean up the board as quick as possible. You can chain-destroy similar blocks together, use different kinds of firecrackers and rockets.

name: nekowater
short_description: You are a cat.You live in a place where small houses line the area as sea levels rise.You wake up and sleep when you like, and eat what you like.You spend your days like that.'Nekowater' is an adventure game where you explore the map, interact with characters, and progress through the game.

name: UFindO
short_description: Are you ready to find the difference? Then quickly run after the magnifying glass and get ready to spot the differences in an exciting puzzle game!

name: SteamWorld Build
short_description: Break ground on a new frontier as the planet dies around you! Dig deep and build wide to excavate long-lost spacefaring technology, while ensuring everyone has the vital water, fuel and creature comforts they need! Do you have what it takes to reach the final frontier?

name: How To Build Your Igloo
short_description: Skate your way in a grid-based arctic world and watch your new igloo grow as you help our friend Siku solve puzzles full of snow, creaks and ice cubes!

name: Hexle
short_description: An original take on Sudoku with hexadecimal numbers and binary restrictions, presented in a minimalist artstyle.

name: NOTICE
short_description: A game about presence.

name: The Walking Dead: Destinies
short_description: Change the course of AMC’s The Walking Dead history. Fight walkers, relive iconic moments, and change the destiny of The Walking Dead Universe as your choices separate heroes from villains, and the living from the dead. Will you make the same choices as Rick, or will you forge your own path?

name: LOFI Katana
short_description: Slice the beat with your katana and wave your fan to the rhythm of music. Generate unique gameplay from any song and enjoy the personalised experience of playing your own beats. Welcome to LOFI Katana, your musical sanctuary.

name: Snacko
short_description: Lift a curse and revitalize a ruined island in Snacko, where former big city kitties Momo and Mikan are starting a new life! Grow crops, raise fluffy cows, go fishing, exploring, customize and decorate as you please, and much, much more in this farming cat-venture.

name: FireFly(萤火)
short_description: It's an intense,adrenaline-pumping zombie mowing game where youll overcome many odds to find a cure.The game is not finished yet,and I will do my best to complete this game in the future,learn from the feedback,increase the gameplay,and make sure that it does not disappoint each and every one of you

name: Zombies Wars
short_description: 'Zombies Wars' is a shooting game.The terrifying zombie shooter game immerses players into places infested with horrifying zombies.

name: 貢がせろ！女苑ちゃん！！
short_description: 疫病神の依神女苑ちゃん。 女苑ちゃんが提示してくるお題に大急ぎで答えて 見返りも求めずに物品を貢ぎまくろう！！

name: Frontline Battles
short_description: In this tug of war style strategy game you can send out soldiers to destroy your enemy's bases. Deploy army's comprised of multiple different types of soldiers that each fill a different role. Push across the map to your enemy's HQ and destroy it to win in these short less than 20 minute matches.

name: 手積み麻雀
short_description: 物理演算を搭載した唯一無二のリアルタイムネット麻雀です。ルールのカスタマイズは自由自在！すべてにおいてリアルを追求しました。

name: Seybul Tech
short_description: Seybul Tech is a walking simulator. Navigate as an office employee, confronting peculiar encounters while in search of an exit from this enigmatic abyss.

name: Scavenger vr
short_description: An unknown crack resembling the Mesozoic Era discovered in the near future. Collect dinosaur eggs while avoiding the eyes of dangerous dinosaurs. Collect dinosaur eggs and hatch them to collect dinosaurs!! Collect points to get upgraded and enjoy a great vacation!!

name: Natural Craft
short_description: A funny Blocks Puzzle game.

name: 江华号
short_description: 《江华号》是一款国风水墨横版卷轴叙事游戏。1928年，武汉的大街小巷流传着一则“头七夜死者还魂”的诡异消息，引发各界关注。《楚城时报》新人记者虞慧龄奉命前去采访，却误打误撞，被种种谜团指引着登上了一艘名为“江华号”的豪华客轮。在那里，一段不为人知的隐秘往事渐渐浮出水面……

name: AntiGOLFity
short_description: A unique spin on the golf genre where you play as the course — in space! Interact with the environment by moving, manipulating, and disabling pieces of the level in order to help guide your ball to the goal.

name: Tram Simulator Urban Transit
short_description: Welcome to Tram Simulator Urban Transit - get on aboard! In this game, you take on the role of a tram driver and manager. Drive 6 tram models. Transport passengers and drive them to the numerous stops. Plan your own routes, manage your timetables, and expand your tram network.

name: Drunkoff V.
short_description: 'Drunkoff V.' is a narrative game with elements of horror, telling the dramatic story of the main character. You will have to come face to face with skeletons in the closet along with him. The events unfold in the post-Soviet era.

name: Bug & Seek
short_description: Catch bugs and clues in this cozy bug-catching sim/creature collector styled like an 8-bit classic. You’ve bought the local bug museum, abandoned after a mysterious robbery. Fill orders, build your collection, and upgrade your skills and equipment while exploring Buggburg and uncovering its secrets.

name: Sona-Nyl of the Violet Shadows Refrain
short_description: The 5th entry in Liarsoft's Steampunk visual novel series is a mysterious fairytale in which fantasy and reality intertwine. The story unfolds from the perspectives of 2 women: one who travels in the ruins of Engine City New York, and one who finds herself in an underground world with a violet sky.

name: Kingpin: Reloaded
short_description: Kingpin: Reloaded is an enhanced re-release of the classic tale of revenge. Take control of a street gang and order your recruits to attack, defend or even do a little safe-cracking to pick up some needed cash.

name: Abtos Covert
short_description: You are in a remote military outpost at Mount Abtos and you're tasked to guard it. The only things visible from there are an old shrine and the forest. Many are afraid of this infamous outpost because of the local folklore stories. Actually, too many stories... Will you be safe, all alone?

name: Shadow Strike: Street Combat
short_description: Enter the heart-pounding world of Shadow Strike: Street Combat on Steam! Engage in 3D side-scrolling combat, navigating gritty urban landscapes. Master diverse combat techniques, customize your fighter, and gear up for an unparalleled urban battleground. Are you ready to dominate the streets?

name: 黑巢姐妹
short_description: 主角就是那种在人群中扯着嗓子接电话，占着2个停车位，蹲在马桶盖上撒尿，待人粗鲁，完全不顾他人感受的没教养的无赖，你要驾驭她，并干掉那些与她作对的那些家伙.

name: I Love You Freddy
short_description: ah the celebrity life, the fame, and glamour, the wealth, and the insane psychopathic fan girl who chases you around an island she trapped you in, isn't the celebrity life wonderful!

name: Chessarama
short_description: Chessarama is a collection of chess-inspired puzzle and strategy games that use chess pieces and their established move sets, then reimagines their goals and themes. Solve challenges, unlock collectibles, and compete against each other on the leaderboards. Welcome to Chessarama!

name: All I Want for Christmas are Subgames
short_description: A Sleigh-full of Subgames for the Holidays!

name: Blagmoz
short_description: Dash, cast, and buff your way to the top of Blagmoz Tower in this lightning-fast PVP precision platformer. Power up by drinking potions, getting kills, and sacrificing your friends at the Altar. Become the ultimate glass cannon in this one-hit-kill battle of sorceries, online or on the couch!

name: Arizona Sunshine® 2
short_description: It's time to say hello to your old pal, Fred. Arizona Sunshine® 2, the next-gen sequel to the fan-favorite VR apocalypse, packs even more gore-geous zombie action! And what's better than braving the end of the f*cking world alone? Surviving it with your new best friend--Buddy.

name: A Chocolate World remastered
short_description: This is 3d platformer an unusual adventure, come inside a world of chocolates and desserts where every move can be fatal each level differs from the other.. No save point the goal is to finish every level with absolute precision it's challenging it' has zero calories.... press f4 to quit game

name: The Great Below
short_description: Immerse yourself in a haunting map-based horror experience. Break free from the loop and the mansion where you find yourself while unveiling the secrets underneath it all. The Society expects something from you but are you ready to face the consequences?

name: Click Cricket
short_description: Click Cricket is a single player casual cricket simulation for PC. The simple but engaging gameplay makes each match is unique with its own set of challenges to overcome and ensure victory on the field!

name: CUBE ROYALE
short_description: The agile multiplayer arcade battle royale experience for soldiers of fortune and strategy experts.

name: Monster Loves You Too!
short_description: Live the life of a Monster within a society of fantastic creatures. Hunt for food, make friends and allies, and battle your own instincts in order to rise above your humble origins in the sequel to the best-selling Monster Loves You!

name: Revive & Prosper
short_description: Mutants go to work! Gather resources, build a base, automate, and optimize in Revive & Prosper, a voxel base-building strategy game. Remodel terrain and cultivate food with 6 mutants and their golem sidekicks. Produce and deliver by belts and catapults. Can you revive and prosper?

name: The Dire
short_description: Dean Holt, popular Urbex vlogger, sets off on another exploration of an abandoned home but this time things aren't going as planned. Something dark is lurking inside and Dean quickly finds himself in over his head

name: Chain Reaction
short_description: Create your own custom chain reactions from scratch or try and explore a variety of set challenges.

name: Lycans
short_description: Lycans is a multiplayer game. It can accommodate up to 10 players. Investigate to find the werewolves hiding among the villagers during the day and hide at night to survive their attacks !

name: Hollow Cocoon
short_description: 'Trapped in a cocoon, the silkworm weaves her final dream.' Hollow Cocoon is a first-person horror adventure game set in 1980s Japan. Immerse yourself in meticulously recreated environments as you venture into the depths of unspeakable horrors that await you.

name: Sweet Home: Look and Find Collector's Edition
short_description: Immerse yourself in the comfort and tranquility of home as you relax and enjoy finding objects, solving puzzles, and conquering mini-games in this cozy and clever new hidden object game from Avi Games!

name: Runemancer
short_description: Support your teammates by combining runes to activate powerful abilities! Fight procedurally generated enemy waves and unlock new powers in this fast-paced roguelike!

name: Shores of Plunder
short_description: Avast ye! Welcome aboard to the ultimate pirate adventure in SHORES OF PLUNDER! Battle friends, outlast hordes of enemies, and amass the greatest fortune in the seven seas. Race against time on a dangerous island filled with treasure, then unwind in a secret pirate cove full of shenanigans.

name: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader
short_description: Made in a close partnership with Games Workshop, Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader is a story-rich classical RPG from Owlcat Games, developers of the critically acclaimed game, Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous.

name: The Day Before
short_description: The Day Before offers players a uniquely reimagined journey into post-apocalyptic open-world MMO survival set in the present day on the US East Coast following a deadly pandemic.

name: Little Chefs: CO-OP
short_description: Call up your friends and dive into the world of culinary madness where you get to be Little Chefs! Cook dishes, customize and improve your kitchen with the building system, upgrade your character, complete missions and remember: nothing without teamwork, speed and a pinch of madness!

name: Ungate
short_description: The action is about a young man named Jason, who follows the steps of his friends to find them and to get them out of a mysterious cave that has its own ecosystem and is known by the locals of the West Village as the gate of hell...

name: Awesome Pea 3
short_description: Awesome Pea is a fast precision platformer where you must run&jump through a series of challenging stages

name: Warplanes: Air Corp
short_description: Engage in combat at the core of the modern battlefield in Warplanes: Air Corp in VR. The third installment of the best-selling Warplanes series introduces a new era of modern military aviation. In addition to fighter jets and multirole combat aircraft you are able to pilot attack helicopters!

name: Stacks:Jungle!
short_description: Stacks:Jungle is an engaging adventure card game set in the lush heart of the jungle. Unlock new cards with booster packs, combine them to uncover craft recipes, build amazing structures, venture into uncharted territories, make new friends, discover hidden treasures, and so much more!

name: Conclave Virtual Tabletop
short_description: Conclave aims to not only replicate the TTRPG experience, but also enhance it with a wide array of tools, effects, and atmospheric settings. It's never been easier to start a session; with just a single copy of Conclave, the whole party can play and create together whether local or online.

name: Phantoms
short_description: 'Phantoms' is a retro-styled first-person horror game that takes place on a strange train. Fix an electric box to escape from a level that is random every time... but you're not alone in here. And these 'things' will do anything to stop you.

name: Bad Egg
short_description: One egg stands alone vs an army of zombie chickens! Get to the chopper or you're clucked. A free-range frenzy from the eggheads behind Shell Shockers, Slayaway Camp and Plants vs Zombies.

name: Stellar Ghosts Settlers
short_description: Stellar Ghosts Settlers is a Sci Fi Fantasy 3rd person action shooter game. Chose amongst 6 of the playable characters to go through the missions or the arenas. Kill as many enemies as you can to earn even more credits to update your favorite character(s).

name: This Game Is Easy
short_description: This Game Is Easy is a game that challenges you. It will test and confuse you. Are you up to the challenge of this super-easy game?

name: Sky Sojourn
short_description: Welcome to the world of Sky Sojourn! You are an adventurer who embarks on an amazing journey overcoming obstacles on floating islands. Will you be able to conquer the peaks and reach your goal? Get ready for an unforgettable climb full of amazing discoveries!

name: Square Word: Hello Winter!❄️
short_description: Square Word is coming on Steam! Discover 140+ words spread in 4 chill themes! Handcrafted grids, hints, mini-objectives & more!

name: Petey Pedro unBEETable Adventure
short_description: A nostalgic game for those RAD 80's and 90's kids. Help Petey Pedro get back home after falling into a magical world where the SWEETS he chose over a healthy beet are now his worst nightmare.

name: A ARMY BASE
short_description: 2D side-scrolling shooting, 5-player local cooperative combat, base defense, zombie survival, firearms, melee weapons, vehicles, and mechs.

name: Vigaro Runner
short_description: Player is Vigaro pill and his mission is to avoid traps and use platforms to find star and finish levels

name: The Wagadu Chronicles
short_description: The Wagadu Chronicles is a sandbox MMORPG focused on gathering, crafting and building villages with friends.
