Customize your skill-based character and join parties to defeat Spirits through unique PVE multiplayer turn-based tactical combat. Compete to claim Wagadu’s open world islands with your guild

name: Garbage Crew!
short_description: Garbage Crew! is a chaotic, roguelike, couch coop game for up to four players. Work in a team to empty garbage cans, extinguish fires clean up the city and... fight?! All while keeping up with the garbage truck whose driver really hates to stop!

name: The Witches Pond
short_description: The Witches Pond is a horror-adventure game based on the real-life place with the same name. Enter a world of mystery and strange places where you will experience events that may or may not seem real.

name: Curse of Blood
short_description: This is a game about survival and betrayal. Ten explorers ventured to the corrupted land to prevent the arrival of the Blood Moon. The bad news is that there are werewolves and vampires mixed in.

name: Sledders
short_description: Rev' up your sled & dive into fresh powder in Sledders! Realistic, physics-based snowmobile simulator in backcountries full of deep snow. Ride with and against your friends in online multiplayer. Can you reach the peak before others? Show off your sled-skills now on Sledders.

name: Legend of the archer
short_description: Legend of the archer - the game will tell you the story of a legendary archer who finds himself in the midst of a war between two clans.

name: Soulash 2
short_description: Soulash 2 is a sandbox RPG roguelike with a procedurally generated open world, simulated history, skill-based progression system, customizable abilities, material-based crafting, building, trading, and the possibility of total mayhem. Will you save your world or destroy it?

name: The Last Soldier of the Ming Dynasty
short_description: The Japanese pirates have terrorized the Ming Dynasty for generations. You've devoted your life as a soldier to fighting them.And now you are in their turf, alone with your sword; the last soldier in pirate's land in this 3D-action game inspired by traditional Chinese ink painting landscapes.

name: The Dark Tones: Loss
short_description: Sooner or later we all have to make a choice and live with it, are you ready to make your own in order to achieve the goal at any cost regardless of the consequences?

name: Christmas Rocket Pudding
short_description: A fast-paced 3D platform game. Skillfully control the speed of your pudding to beat the levels fast while avoiding pitfalls!

name: 失眠诊所
short_description: In today's fast-paced life, the pressure is suffocating, leaving people breathless. However, while slowing down in dreams to reminisce, sleep is lost...

name: Cyber Tower
short_description: Cyber Tower is a 3D cyberpunk Tower Defense game. Defend the city against virus-infected autonomous vehicles across 40 missions. Strategically place towers to eliminate enemies efficiently.

name: Praise Dead
short_description: Praise Dead is a roguelike auto-battler where you create minions from the parts of dead villagers and monsters. Collect relics that power up your zombies. And defend the town from the nightly demonic incursions that threaten to slay us all.

name: SUSHI SOUL UNIVERSE
short_description: Multiverse sushi eating 3D action game! An epic love story with a sushi theme! ...sushi! very delicious! Apologize because it's too delicious!

name: Extremely Powerful Capybaras
short_description: Become the bullet hell as a Capybara in this roguelite adventure! Brave the chaos solo or with up to 4 friends, forge your path through hordes of enemies, gather capy-powering weapons & skills and embrace your inner capybara in this action-packed bullet heaven frenzy!

name: Espresso For The Demon
short_description: A new coffee shop suddenly opened in the city. On-time, because Visa really needs a moonlighting. She gets a job with her classmates: cheerful Frank and quiet Estr. What could possibly be wrong?

name: Idle Cave Miner
short_description: Idle Cave Miner is an idle game about crafting items, mining gems, and building your team of miners. Prestige, craft, and travel to other mines to increase your strength to dig deeper, and find what lurks below.

name: GRIDROAD
short_description: GridRoad is a traffic optimisation simulation game. Build roads, place roadsigns and tweak traffic lights to build the most efficient traffic junction!

name: Judgeball: Lethal Arena - Early Access
short_description: Let your skills or you muscles do the talking, it's your call. Judgeball: Lethal Arena is a fast-paced competitive 3V3 handbrawl game. Choose between multiple Scavengers with their unique set of skills to seize the victory.

name: Crossroad OS
short_description: Explore the mysterious operating system Crossʀoad OS. Adventure through its decaying programs, solve puzzles, collect items and meet strange creatures.

name: Cosmic Gunslinger: Alien Outlaws
short_description: Cosmic Gunslinger: Alien Outlaws is a pulse-pounding single-player video game where you, as the gunslinger cowboy Cosmo, and your trusty canine companion, must survive relentless waves of Aliens. Upgrade your weapons, collect crucial items. Can you outdraw and outlast the alien threat?

name: Planet Suika
short_description: Take your Suika stacking skills to a new planetary level in this Casual Puzzle Game! Combine smaller planets together to turn them into larger planets. Master the games Physics to combine the planets until you make a big Sun!

name: Hospital Aliens 2
short_description: You must find two items in a land of Aliens. Use stealth tactics and a weapon to complete your mission.

name: Rulers of Aden
short_description: A fantasy turn-based indie rpg with character customization and enemies that may leave you struggling.

name: VRogue
short_description: Ported directly from the open source project, VRogue is the classic game Rogue in an entirely new perspective: Virtual Reality! Dare the Dungeons of Doom to deliver the Amulet of Yendor... and then find your way back out!

name: Spinshot Party
short_description: Join the excitement of a real-life table football game! This game is easy to learn, but challenging to master, making it perfect for players of all skill levels. It's a family-friendly game that's sure to liven up any party.

name: Arms Race 2
short_description: Arms Race 2 is a PC strategy game based on the historical conflict between the USA and the USSR that took place in the 20th century.

name: Grandfather Simulator
short_description: Open the door to Grandfather's life! Watch TV series, play with the dog, argue with your wife, take pills, eat lunch, sleep, go for a walk. Live the measured life of a grandfather, where every day is an adventure, and routine is an art!

name: Sees Game
short_description: Play as Sees in a reimagined take of the classic Snake game. Eat apples and compete with your friends for the hi-score!

name: Endless Glory
short_description: Lead your army to endless glory

name: 溢爱~fragile love
short_description: 《溢爱~fragile love》是XUWULE游戏工作室制作的一款百合题材视觉小说。 QQ群：806366756

name: RTM - The Last Days
short_description: RTM - THE LAST DAYS : In this harrowing adventure, you awaken in the heart of a mysterious, ever-changing forest with no memory of how you arrived. As the sun sets, an eerie transformation takes place, turning the once tranquil woods into a realm of darkness and dread.

name: Anon's Neko Waifus
short_description: Discover an enchanting world where cute neko girls await to steal your heart. Immerse yourself in a tale of romance and emotions. It's the perfect getaway for a good time.

name: Twinkle Hunter
short_description: Twinkle Hunter is a 2D action game focused on boss battles. Become a hunter whose teddy bear was stolen by the great villain 'Twinkle Thieves', and experience journey to retrieve the teddy bear. Can you hunt the thieves who attack you in various ways and rescue the teddy bear 'Mari'?

name: Snowmen
short_description: Escape this infinite snowy realm full of grotesque snowmen by exploring and collecting the ingredients your captor demands in this short fairy tale like xmas horror game!

name: Hotel in the Dark
short_description: That's the day it all started on Sept. 13. 2020. In the early morning of the same day, I was already standing at the bus station, waiting for my bus. I had to travel a couple of three hundred kilometers to a small town. I found a hotel quickly. It was quite a modern building at first glance.

name: A Highland Song
short_description: Moira McKinnon is running away. A wild adventure through the Scottish Highlands, with open platforming and dynamic storytelling, maps and music. From the creators of Heaven's Vault and 80 Days.

name: Laboratory X-29
short_description: Laboratory X-29 is a sci-fi roguelite-like top-down shooter, where the protagonist takes his chances to escape from the Lab after an accident. Shoot your way out to freedom, clear rooms full of other dangerous experiments, find out the secrets hidden in this place and eat chicken to survive.

name: Exp10sion
short_description: 'Exp10sion' is a pixel-art puzzle platformer. You'll play as a bomb that explodes within 10 seconds. Each explosion respawns the bomb, starts a new round, and generates a 'Time Shadow' of your last round. Use your shadow wisely to solve the puzzles!

name: Life in the Twilight
short_description: Life in the Twilight - this is a world of hopelessness in which the guardians are looking for you to stop your escape.

name: Regular Spacecraft - Defending the Mothership
short_description: Defeat the enemies. Upgrade the spacecraft. Defend the mothership. Regular Spacecraft - Defending the Mothership is a shoot em'up game with roguelite elements.

name: Aerodangle
short_description: Aerodangle is a chaotic mix of high-speed flying, parkour with a grappling hook and a stream of airplanes falling apart in the air.

name: Super Retro Retry
short_description: 100 levels, some are easy, some not, sometimes flipped horizontally, sometimes flipped vertically, always randomized! And ONE SINGLE LIFE. Customize your experience. Are you ready for the ultimate Retro challenge? Are you ready for Retry?

name: The Spellswapper
short_description: The Spellswapper is an arcade roguelite where you use spells to defeat waves of enemies. Command an ever-moving arsenal of spells. Swap out old spells for new ones after each wave, crafting a unique magical repertoire in every run.

name: Back Then
short_description: Back Then is a first-person narrative game taking place in the mind of Thomas Eilian, an elderly writer diagnosed with Alzheimer's Disease.

name: Faeland
short_description: Take on the role of skilled hunter, Sam, in Faeland, an adventure RPG set in a beautiful world inspired by 8-bit classics.

name: Sofi Origins
short_description: Sofi Origins is an adventure, suspense, and horror game in which you play as Sofi, a girl with a very sad past, but who in her world has powers. Alongside Sofi, you will experience fear and sadness in a unique way. You will have to use your skills and stay focused to confront the past.

name: Arashi: Castles of Sin - Final Cut
short_description: Become one with the shadows with the award winning VR shinobi adventure. Master the art of stealth-action as you infiltrate castles across feudal Japan with your arsenal of weapons, tools, and techniques, outwitting all enemies on your quest to defeat the Six Oni of Iga.

name: VIRUS 91
short_description: VIRUS 91 is an adventure game with first-person shooter (FPS) elements. You have to take on the role of a sergeant and go to the laboratory, in which all the equipment is out of control. Explore mysterious locations and find out who is behind this whole situation!

name: HIP GAME
short_description: A game of cute, pudgy butts! 'HIP GAME' is a puzzle game in which you have to connect the same buttocks of the demon girls so that they do not overflow from the box. Each time you connect two of the demon girls' butts, they will evolve into a different species!

name: Svarog's Dream
short_description: Awaken as a soul from the Underworld. Discover who you are and explore an ever-changing open world full of mystery. Fight the beasts and gods or ally with them. Die and be reborn in this unforgettable adventure.

name: 令和罕见物语
short_description: 一部魔幻现实主义的视觉小说，一部荒诞主义的GalGame。

name: Another Dungeon Game
short_description: Battle your way through this 2D Action RPG Dungeon Crawler with over-the-top skills, extensive passive trees, and all the randomized loot you can carry! Another Dungeon Game has been designed with casual players in mind, making it quick and easy to dive right in and start slaying from level 1.

name: While the Iron's Hot
short_description: Reforge a blacksmith’s village on an isle of the land’s finest artisans! Step into the boots of an expert smith for a crafty adventure filled with mystery and charm. Explore the land of Ellian, and prove that a hammer, anvil, and your wits can overcome any challenge.

name: My Girls’ Secrets
short_description: This is a 'casual' game with exquisite art style, where you can explore a mysterious world and challenge various levels. In this world, you will encounter girls of all kinds. Each level features a new girl and scene. Gentlemen, come and join us to uncover the little secrets of these girls!

name: Golf Odyssey 2 DX
short_description: Golf Odyssey 2 DX is the ultimate relaxing and challenging experience in a 2D golf game. Hole out all holes to unlock new and challenging courses, improve your skills and become a real golf legend!

name: CUSTOM MECH WARS
short_description: Take customization to the extreme with the Omega Customization System and battle with one-of-a-kind combat units in this all-new third-person shooter mecha game.

name: RBM Studio's Gettysburg
short_description: A historical hexagonal turn-based strategy wargame using markers to represent units designed by the legendary Mark Herman. Throwback to the great hex-based wargames of the 70's and 80's. Solo and online multiplayer modes are supported.

name: My Little Blood Cult: Let's Summon Demons
short_description: Embark on a demonic fishing adventure in My Little Blood Cult! Combine skill with luck to master a unique fishing mechanic and collect demons, creatures, and more to fill out your oddities cabinet and become the most powerful cult.

name: Djikstra's Enigmatic Puzzle Cube
short_description: A 3d puzzle game inspired by 2048. Spin your cube and merge magical elements to produce elements of greater power, to get the highest score you can.

name: Cultivation Fantasy
short_description: Why would a cultivator have to repay debts?

name: Deathstreak
short_description: Deathstreak is a fast-paced, linear single-player action game with a focus on Melee Combat. Deathstreak has environmental storytelling that doesn't interrupt gameplay. Progress by killing the surrounding enemies and discover the secrets of your world.

name: Dragon Bobby - The Story of a Life
short_description: A uniquely beautiful game with third-person exploration and puzzles that tells the story of a man's life from birth. You control a dragon who is an analogy of this man in the story. A true reflection on life.

name: Mirage: Beyond The Screen
short_description: Experimental cartoony adventure horror-ish experience developed on Unreal 5, where you will uncover the mysteries of haunted reality where the line between reality and computer game blurs. What will you uncover?

name: Koumajou Remilia Ⅱ: Stranger's Requiem
short_description: Koumajou Remilia Ⅱ: Stranger's Requiem is a direct sequel to side-scrolling action game Koumajou Remilia: Scarlet Symphony, featuring characters from the Touhou Project, adored by fans around the world.

name: Schism
short_description: Schism is a challenging roguelite action RPG with guns, gods, leveling, and frequency-switching action. The combination of deep leveling and stat systems, full gun customization, deity worship, intense bullet hell combat, and difficult bosses make for a unique and highly replayable experience.

name: Katana Robo: RTA
short_description: Katana Robo fights his way to the top floor of the Robot Tower, which looks like a platformer game stage, to thwart Samurai Robo's ambitious plan to use the Dominion Sphere at the top of the Robot Tower to control the robots throughout the universe.

name: The Night Of The Inquisitor
short_description: A VHS/PS1 Survival Horror Experience! Play as Emilia, a young woman cursed by an ancient rosary, transported into the Realm of the Inquisitor, a surreal dimension filled with the ghosts victims of the Inquisitor himself. Solve puzzles, free ghosts, and escape the Inquisitor!

name: Shooting Squirrel Simulator
short_description: The Checkered Squirrel who shoots cool weapons and parkour through levels in slo mo.

name: My Incubi Harem
short_description: My Incubi Harem is a visual novel about how you became an incubi king and ended up with beautiful men in love with you. Featuring a lewd mentor, a hot singer, a queer dom activist, a cold-hearted nobleman, and a sensible daddy. This is the first episode of a game series made by Male Doll.

name: I Hate You, Please Suffer - Complete
short_description: A woman becomes an adventurer and makes friends on a quest to pay rent - and maybe something much more.

name: Paranox
short_description: Paranox is a singleplayer horror game. Dive into darkness as a daring paranormal researcher, unraveling the ominous mysteries of a forsaken school. In its haunting corridors, you're not just a spectator—evil lurks in the shadows, stalking your every move. Will you survive the terror?

name: John Mambo
short_description: John Mambo is a frenetic Retro Arcade Game with an isometric top down view. Meet John, a one man army, crazy enough to embark on a dangerous mission in the heart of a jungle all by himself...

name: Otome Riron to Sono Shuuhen -École de Paris-
short_description: 《少女理论及其周边 -École de Paris-》是日本美少女游戏资深大厂Navel制作的超人气女装作品《近月少女的礼仪》的续作。讲述了前作主人公大藏游星为了陪同自己的妹妹里想奈前往巴黎留学而再次扮演小仓朝日成为女仆所展开的全新故事。本作曾在美少女游戏大赏荣获综合第3，剧本第1，作画第5等诸多奖项。

name: Worker Simulator
short_description: 'Worker Simulator' is an open-world video game where you play as Jack, a newcomer to Land No. 6. The game offers the freedom to explore the island, work in factories, trade with other players, earn money, buy or rent a dream home, and raise animals from young to fully-grown adults.

name: Speak of the Devil I: A Deathly Proposition
short_description: Experience the impact of making a pact with a demon in this linear visual novel, where the consequences can be life-changing in an instant. Michi, the main character, has the chance to pursue a romantic relationship with any of the female characters, including the demon he made a deal with.

name: Home Defender
short_description: Home Defender is an adventure game where you play as a young boy who is alone in his home at a winter night. Your goal is to protect your home from two burglars who are trying to get you.

name: Wanting Wings
short_description: At Seiyou Girls' academy, there are rumors of an angel. Roommates Hina, Rin, and Fumi all have completely different personalities, but they all experienced 1 strange event: They all once saw an angel in their youth. They gradually begin to suspect that one of their roommates might be that angel.

name: Card Detective
short_description: Players will take on the role of newspaper reporter Hazel Gong, who was originally covering a practice exercise at an abandoned building site, but stumbles upon a mysterious corpse in an accidental collapse!

name: Speed Night
short_description: Late at night, a young driver was driving his beloved sports car on the road. When he passed a bus stop, I found a girl being bullied by some hooligans. He stopped the car...

name: Emplacement
short_description: Emplacement combines the elements of turn-based strategy and builder games. You must place tiles to construct farms and barracks, use them to produce resources and units. Connect tiles and rotate them around to create different layouts and strategies. Your ultimate goal, kill your opponents king!

name: Onsui
short_description: A cosy physics-puzzler in hell that has you match colourful creatures without any overflowing.

name: 精灵幻境  Elven dreams
short_description: Welcome to this elven-infused world, where you'll be free to capture the elves you want, control them into battle, level them up and evolve, and finally fuse into that unique 'strongest elven'!

name: I'm the Policeman
short_description: Immerse yourself in the gripping world of law enforcement with 'I'm the Policeman.'

name: Crack it!
short_description: Crack it! is a fun and challenging game that puts you in the shoes of a recycling plant worker.

name: Orcish Skies
short_description: Orcish Skies blends Roguelike deckbuilding, turn-based, Slay The Spire-styled gameplay with a grid-based map. Fire a missile into a cluster of enemies. Rain down lightning on an enemy Carrier from afar. Fly past a swarm of frigates to pick off the sniper shooting you from across the map.

name: QuietMansion1
short_description: The nightmare returns... Explore a dark and creepy mansion crawling with terrifying monsters, find keys, and use weapons to fight back as you try to find your way out!

name: Bahnsen Knights
short_description: 1986, Tornado Alley, USA… Go undercover as Boulder, an agent infiltrating the notorious religious cult known as the Bahnsen Knights. Face off against occultists, biblical storms, and an enigmatic car salesman turned preacher as you investigate the disappearance of a fellow agent and close friend.

name: HunterX: code name T
short_description: HunterX: code name T is an action adventure with fast and stylish combat. Perfect your own fighting style using various weapon actions and magic, and explore an ever-greater world.

name: Spellshot
short_description: Survive against hordes of zombies using bullets enchanted with spells purchased from a rerolling shop. Spellshot is a fast-paced, rogue-lite fps in which you create unique builds by combining and upgrading spells, activating set bonuses, and collecting rare items.

name: House Flipper 2
short_description: It's time to dust off your hammer - House Flipper is back in a brand-new fashion! Buy and renovate run-down houses! Or maybe you want to build new ones? Now you can! Start as a rookie Flipper and make a fortune by helping out the community of the charming town of Pinnacove.

name: My Slow Life with the Princess Knight and Her Devoted Handmaiden
short_description: Garland used to be a formidable adventurer... But then he was betrayed and left for dead. Now he has a reputation as the Dragon Survivor and no one left in the world he can rely on. When he brings two beautiful servants into his life to tend his wounds, will he learn to open his heart again?

name: Pogo3D
short_description: One-Handed Rage-Inducing 3D Platformer! Use only a mouse. Bounce off platforms and even the walls to reach the next checkpoint. Go on a linear adventure through an interconnected world, or quickly test your skills in challenge mode.

name: ConSPYration
short_description: In this showdown of stealth, ConSPYration is the party game of frantic espionage! Sneak around the guards and perils of each stage, collect the briefcase and race to the exit. But beware - rival spies can swipe the briefcase right out of your hands! Be quick to steal it back!

name: My Academy's Special Place
short_description: Our hero's homeroom teacher is also his big sister, Yaeka. She's popular with the students, but at home, she's a slobbish drunk. There's Maika, an exchange student and Akiba nerd. She's always asking him to go to Akiba with her. But Maika is told to return home. Two love stories are about to begin!

name: Simulator Z
short_description: A world where you can create your own zombie apocalypse to your liking!

name: AWA 2024
short_description: AWA 2024 is a fast paced shoot-em-up featuring modern military aircraft. Choose one of the ten fighter aircraft and take the battle to the skies throughout nine action-packed stages each with their own special end-level boss.

name: The Brave Little Cloud
short_description: In the game you will become the main character - a little cloud that fights against evil to protect its world!

name: Roguenarok
short_description: Destroy the enemy base before they can destroy your own. In this single-player MOBA action roguelite bullet-heaven, you play as a viking dinosaur wielding up 4 abilities and weapons at a time. Unlock new warriors and fight along with your soldiers and bring an end on the Alien’s reign.

name: Mycosis
short_description: Mycosis is action-platformer situated in an underground laboratory complex. The gameplay includes fighting various enemies, mostly the fungus infected zombies, collecting different items and solving some simple puzzles. It was inspired by Abuse, Half-life and everyday laboratory work!

name: Yeetus
short_description: You are YEETUS! Your weapon? The very floor beneath your feet! YEET your surrounding terrain into destructive projectiles. Be strategic, though. A hasty shot may mean a long fall down to your doom in YEETUS, a casual time survivor game with rogue-lite elements.

name: (the) Gnorp Apologue
short_description: (the) Gnorp Apologue is the journey of the gnorps as you guide them towards their goal of delightfully excessive wealth accumulation.

name: SPIDER MALL !
short_description: A night of urban exploration goes wrong for Explorer X as he finds himself trapped in an abandoned shopping mall facing off against security guards and a giant hungry spider. You make the choices in this live action bodycam FMV game. Escape the mall or die trying!

name: Garden of Seif: Curse of Gravehollow Peaks
short_description: Lost in the cursed mountains of Gravehollow Peaks, two rival assassins must set their differences aside and find a way home... unless something finds them first. A story-rich fantasy with magic, romance, and choices that matter.

name: 甜蜜狂潮Honey Fury
short_description: Base Construction and Strategic Card Management. You will construct and defend your base from enemy invasions. Employ clever layouts to enhance your base's defenses and acquire resources through card management. Get ready to embrace this strategic and thrilling honey-fueled frenzy!

name: Manitas Kitchen
short_description: Welcome to Manitas Kitchen, a casual cooking game with a dressing of arcade and mini-games, where you'll meet Trexito, a T-Rex with short arms that has one dream: to become the best pizza maker!

name: Cookie Cutter
short_description: Love turns to rage and chainsaws in Cookie Cutter, a totally unique hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania. Become Cherry, a violent android on a rage-filled quest to save her creator.

name: Mechanic Heroes
short_description: Build your team of mechanics and work together to repair and deliver as many cars as possible before the time runs out! Playable with up to 4 players, locally or online, Mechanic Heroes will make you love mechanics or simply hate your friends.

name: Dark Riddle
short_description: Find out the scary secrets of the neighbor.

name: Auto Tow Truck Simulator
short_description: 'Auto Tow Truck Simulator' is an exciting and challenging game that puts you in the shoes of a tow truck driver in a busy city.

name: Tru Or Die: Chiraq
short_description: Tru Or Die: Chiraq is a third person single/multiplayer roleplaying game.

name: Super Sushi Roll
short_description: Super Sushi Roll is a 2D roll-a-ball platformer where you control platforms and launch sushi to dinner plates. Master the mechanics, mind the time limit, unlock new sushi rolls, and search for hidden collectibles!

name: Crossing Frontier: Fate Foretold
short_description: Crossing Frontier is a side-scroll action game with brawling elements, , featuring multiplayer PVP content and the thrilling combat! Bring your A-Game and join the fight!

name: Jewel Match Solitaire Winterscapes 2 - Collector's Edition
short_description: Escape to a picturesque winter wonderland with enchanting backgrounds that change as you build fantasy locations throughout the game. Don't miss out on the most delightful Solitaire experience of the year. Let the snowflakes guide your cards to victory!

name: Risk of Pain
short_description: Risk of Pain is a hardcore puzzle platformer that challenges you to complete many challenging levels. Use parkour, wit and luck to avoid dying! Are you ready to take a risk?!

name: Destiny Star Girlfriend
short_description: A surprise kerfuffle with unhinged space demons sees campus nobody Seiji “tied by fate” to Yuuri, the undercover magical girl who’s also his covert classroom crush! With both their secrets out of the bag, can Seiji still shoot his shot? Or will the evil Majin’s minions invade Earth first?

name: Heatchain
short_description: Arcade game where you need to find the next glyph to make the longest chain

name: DarkMatter: The Strange Messenger
short_description: Explore the Earth that has been transformed by dark matter. Listen to the stories of life told by those who survived the harsh environment. You may not be able to hear their story. Why? You may find it hard to survive in this harsh environment. Don't give up! Your abandonment will make us sad.

name: Stay Still 2
short_description: Welcome to Stay Still 2, a spine-chilling first-person survival horror game. Based of the Vietnamese culture, this game unfolds as a daring experiment in which survival seems nearly impossible. Engage in a story gameplay, where puzzles are your key to progress, while surviving various threats.

name: Dangerous Coins
short_description: Dangerous Coins is an exciting game that puts you in the shoes of a character who is obsessed with collecting coins.

name: Tales from The Dancing Moon
short_description: Tales from the Dancing Moon is a casual story-driven RPG with elements of life-simulation, questing and sandboxing. All based on a story threaded by mystery. Presented using a detailed isometric style, inspired by classic role-playing games.

name: Detective Hayseed - The Cloning Madness
short_description: Join the crazy police detective Francis in his search for a kidnapped cloned beauty and go through countless escapades with him in this classic point & click adventure full of comedy.

name: Art is Boom
short_description: Let's create the art of explosions—different characters, different bombs. It's about the art of detonation and the creativity of crafting new bombs. Dive into the joyous game of various explosions!

name: Wisdom Watcher
short_description: Wisdom Watcher, a VR action/shooter set in a clockpunk universe inspired by European folklore, offers diverse arenas and gameplay modes. Manage your arsenal of upgradable weapons and cards with unique abilities to challenge astral foes, achieve high scores, and climb leaderboards for rewards.

name: Endless Furry Tower Defense
short_description: Slaughter furries before they destroy your base! Get upgrades and climb leaderboards to be the best!

name: FarWest Colony
short_description: Lead a rebellion against tyranny in this open-world, survival sci-fi RPG game. Utilize alien technology to explore, build bases, craft, and farm. Prepare for an unequal combat to rescue humanity from tyranny and a mysterious deadly virus.

name: Stellaris Nexus
short_description: Stellaris Nexus is a social strategy game offering all the depth of a full spectrum 4X experience played start to finish in about 1 hour. Choose a unique faction and leader and challenge up to 7 other players, plotting, battling and backstabbing your way to galactic dominance.

name: PARANOID
short_description: Paranoid is a horror that tells the story of Patrick who has been living in isolation from the outside world for many years. One day he receives a phone call from his sister, who announces her visit more than a dozen years after she disappeared.

name: Hell: distant lights
short_description: A puzzle with shooter elements and a small addition of horror.

name: Pioneers of Pagonia
short_description: The city builder Pioneers of Pagonia is all about exploration, discovery, and reuniting the fantastical islands of Pagonia. Build over 40 different buildings, use more than 70 different types of goods, manage widely branched production chains, and get creative in establishing your economy.

name: Captain Pawsome
short_description: Set sail with Captain Pawsome on the relaxing 2D fishing adventure! Craft, upgrade, customize, and conquer the high seas. Clean the environment, catch unique fish, and unleash your inner adventurer. Dive in now and make a splash!

name: Tameshi
short_description: Somewhere in outer space an epic battle is about to take place! Battle 7 stages of pixel-art chaos and become the true champion.

name: Turbo Chicken Simulator
short_description: Turbo Chicken Simulator is an immersive, open-world action RPG. It is the latest and greatest in high-tech Chicken Simulation technology.

name: Room
short_description: In ROOM players find themselves trapped in an unnerving and ever-shifting nightmare where escaping one room only leads to the discovery of another, each more sinister than the last.

name: Meeple Jump
short_description: Make your way through the Simulation by jumping over lava, dodging dangerous spikes, and spending time with the helpful assistance program. All... as a meeple.

name: Samurai VR
short_description: Grab a Katana and stand on your daimyo's castle defense, alone against an infinite horde of enemy shinobis. Kill the enemies, hit back shurikens, dodge bombs and beware of enemy Samurais!

name: Grandmaster's Revenge
short_description: They say one person in the field is not a warrior. And what if this one is called to fight by the White Grandmaster himself, endowed with super powers and even the ground on which he steps helps him. Find out in the new skirmish of the Grandmasters and regain control over all the clans of Whitehills

name: Highway Cleaners
short_description: The world is overrun, and your survival depends on your skills behind the wheel. Are you ready to take on the apocalypse and become the ultimate Highway Cleaner? Get behind the wheel, gear up, and let the mayhem begin!

name: Reign of the Renegade
short_description: Reign of the Renegade is a challenging roguelite deckbuilder. Learn Actions, Collect Artifacts, and level up your Character to make powerful synergies.

name: Square Logic
short_description: Square Logic is a minimalist puzzle game about coloring the grid with squares and rectangles, respecting the number of each cell.

name: Diceheart
short_description: Diceheart is a roguelite dungeon-crawler with turn-based tactical dice battles. Delve deep into the Quantum Realm, gather powerful reality-bending items, upgrade your dice, and conquer luck itself!

name: PROJECT;HYPATIOS
short_description: Project;Hypatios is an FPS game inspired by Portal where Aldrich was cursed with a time-loop ability and must escape from Mobius Corps' Hypatios Lab by shooting his way through the chambers.

name: Summon My Girl
short_description: This is a puzzle-solving casual game, challenge levels to collect hearts, and summon your beloved girl.

name: SeaOrama: World of Shipping
short_description: Experience the challenges of running a successful shipping company with Seaorama: World of Shipping.

name: Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising
short_description: Rise to the challenge in Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising! This powered up, revamped sequel to GBVS is more enjoyable and accessible than ever before. With simplified input options, even newcomers can engage in thrilling and strategic matches!

name: Buried Alive: Breathless Rescue
short_description: Are you ready to embark on a spine-chilling adventure? Step into the shoes of the protagonist and experience the terror of being 'Buried Alive' in a crypt. Your mission is clear: Escape the confines of your coffin, find the key to unlock the door, and unveil the dark secrets that lie within.

name: Cosplay Club
short_description: In this turn-based RPG you'll embark on the journey of becoming a Magical Girl cosplayer! But don't let this journey fool you, because this is not just roleplaying: your costumes will give you real life powers, and the world's fate will be in your hands!

name: Roll for Life
short_description: Roll for Life is a Chaotically Challenging Bowling Game with Platforming mechanics. Explore a variety of Weird Levels, Unlock new Balls and Powers on your journey to become the Champion!

name: 幸存者少女/Survivor Girls
short_description: 'Survivor Girls' is a roguelite which is about pretty girls and added a variety of strategic ways based on the traditional roguelike,13 different characters available plus hundreds of weapons and items bring the game more possibilities.

name: Siege Island
short_description: Step into the world of Siege Island, a tribute to the classic arcade game 'Rampart'. Prepare yourself for an immersive 3D action-puzzle game that will test your strategic skills and reflexes. As the Orcish fleet draws near, the duty to safeguard your island from their assaults is yours.

name: Return from Core
short_description: Unleash your creativity in this sandbox RPG that combines exploration, building, farming, automation, and Monster Girls. Build your camp, develop agriculture, and encounter charming Monster Girls. Get ready for an unforgettable adventure!

name: Aztec Tiki Talisman
short_description: Embark on a thrilling adventure in Aztec Tiki Talisman! Explore 50 challenging levels in the mystical Aztec jungle, battle foes, solve puzzles, and confront epic bosses. Will you find the blue talisman and unlock the portal to the next level?

name: DemonStar - Original Missions
short_description: The Shareware legend Demonstar comes soaring back with new game modes, revised gameplay, and new Eastereggs to encounter. Originally published in 1997, and later earning Shareware Game of the Year 1999, Demonstar was, and still is one of the best Space shooters ever created.

name: Very Hard Game
short_description: Can you conquer the VERY HARD GAME!!! Can you keep your SANITY INTACT!!! If you feel like you can then I challenge you to beat me and my masterful maze of creatures and.... walls.... -GameMastr

name: AutoHeroes
short_description: A Roguelike Autobattler, where you focus on the development and priority setting for a single hero. In each game, four competitors battle for the throne. You have the control to adjust the difficulty and teams, and even invite friends to join. Study your enemy's heroes and counter them!

name: Booze Masters: Freezing Moonshine
short_description: Freezing Moonshine is a unsettling first-person adventure game with elements of plant cultivation, puzzles, and lots of high-proof beverages. To survive, you'll need to gather harvests, take photos, and craft a wide variety of spirits.

name: Dungeonman
short_description: DECK OUT YOUR DUNGEON! Play the Original Deck Battler/Dungeon Builder Hybrid. Create your own Dungeons with a unique set of story-telling tools and battle through other players' campaigns online.

name: UNITED 1944
short_description: UNITED 1944 is an innovative WWII shooter combining weapon crafting, base building, and team strategy. Fight for territory in 16v16 urban guerrilla battles in Domination Mode, or explore a city in ruins as a lone wolf in Survivor. Unlock skills and customize your hero. Play your way. Make history.

name: CRASH TEST IDIOTS 2 (MULTIPLAYER)
short_description: CRASH TEST IDIOTS 2 (MULTIPLAYER) - You and Your Steam Friends must Destroy every car in the city.

name: LOCKED
short_description: LOCKED in a deadly cat-and-mouse with a relentless serial killer, you must outsmart, escape, and survive in this intense 2D horror experience. Solve chilling puzzles, and stay one step ahead of a relentless pursuer. Inspired by PS1-PS2 classics and iconic horror films.

name: Centrist
short_description: Centrist is a block stacking game where your goal is to place blocks around the center piece in a perfect square formation. Blocks will appear from 4 different directions.

name: WITCH ON THE HOLY NIGHT
short_description: A tale told with vivid colors and rich sound in a classic TYPE-MOON visual novel.

name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted 2
short_description: Five Nights at Freddy’s: Help Wanted 2 is the sequel to the terrifying VR experience that brought new life to the iconic horror franchise. As a brand new Fazbear employee you’ll have to prove you have what it takes to excel in all aspects of Pizzeria management and maintenance.

name: The Castle
short_description: Title: Hidden Castle This is a first-person perspective exploration horror game where you aim to escape from a mysterious castle you stumbled upon while seeking shelter from the rain.

name: MATH IS HORROR
short_description: 'Math is Horror' is a math based horror game where you must answer equations to unlock doors in an attempt to escape The Math Clown! Stuck in an asylum where the equations grow more difficult, How many rooms can you survive?

name: Danger Drone
short_description: Return the world to humanity by destroying the evil aliens

name: Pixsaw
short_description: Arrange pieces to their letters and discover a beautiful hidden image. Pixsaw combines classic jigsaw and color-by-number genres to create a whole new type of puzzle that will give you a joyful surprise every time you create a masterpiece pixel artwork!

name: Ep.家族
short_description: A first-person Japanese horror game.

name: DANGER ZONE BOMBER
short_description: Danger Zone Bomber is a survival defense roguelike game where you have to defeat waves of zombies and protect your base. Drop bombs from the plane to kill zombies and protect your base.

name: Christmas Girls
short_description: It's Christmas time! Everyone is looking forward to it, including our girls! They have already put on their Christmas hats, so they are ready!

name: Xmas Clash
short_description: Help Santa claus and his christmas elfs to stop the angry babies, toddlers, and kids. Use strategy and management to secure the road to the workshop.

name: Match Gem 99
short_description: MatchGem 99 is a unique large-scale 3-match puzzle battle royale game where 99 players compete in real-time. Master the use of special blocks and gauge attacks to outlast your opponents and be the last one standing!

name: Glixel
short_description: Each Entity has a role to play... A reason why it is created... Something weird is going on in the Core... maybe an opportunity to do what she was made for?

name: Star Command
short_description: STAR COMMAND offers the thrill of the best sci-fi novels, and then some. In this epic multiple-character role-playing game, you don't just read about the adventure — you live it!

name: Virago: Reality New
short_description: Virago: Reality New invites you to a chilling adventure where you guide Willow, a survivor escaping abuse, through a world of terror. Master the torchlight, outwit relentless stalkers, and navigate between reality and nightmare. Can you ensure Willow's survival in this heart-pounding pursuit?

name: Gallery of Things: Reveries
short_description: Explore nature and tech through Dada-inspired hidden object puzzles.

name: Nebel Geisterjäger ~ The First Lamb
short_description: An NTRPG from a male POV. Use tools like heart monitoring and surveillance to shield your girlfriend, Kana, from her scheming boss. With 5 endings and choices shaping interactions, can you keep her safe? Amidst exorcism, intrigue, and personal choices, protect your bond and confront inner desires.

name: Micro macro farm
short_description: Micro macro farm is a small relaxing and cozy game about farming. Plant seeds, harvest them and create products. Make money and gain experience to unlock more seeds, buy machines and expand your garden.

name: Meteoric VR
short_description: Meteoric VR is a first-person shooter where your mission is to defend the Earth from dangerous meteors in space! The fate of the planet is now in your hands. Will you live up to the task?

name: Lost in Space
short_description: A sci-fi turn-based card strategy game in which you must guide your team of astronauts through horror, food shortages while maintaining their sanity, and uncover the mystery of the mission.

name: Up N' Down
short_description: Up N' Down is a multiplayer racing game where you have to use items to your advantage. Race to the top, grab the crown and find a safe way down to the finish line.

name: Trim For Your Dream
short_description: Rise as LA's elite cannabis trimmer. Hustle and perfect your trim skills to earn big. Spend your cash on the ultimate luxuries. This 3D simulator combines the grind of real-world trimming with the thrill of living large, all against a backdrop of cannabis histories and dub beats.

name: Mosaic Mysteries
short_description: Assemble the broken shards of intricate stained glass mosaics. Use the illuminated watch glass and shuffle through dozens of pieces. Reveal fantastical landscapes, fairytale castles and art-nouveau murals.

name: You Got Crabs
short_description: Watch your crabs live their lives and force evolutionary changes by altering the environment in this calm, relaxing life simulator

name: Fairies Love
short_description: This is a casual gentleman game with exquisite characters. Go on adventures and get to know six different girls with unique personalities. Faced with their challenges, what choices will you make to let them become your girlfriends successfully?

name: Lazarus A.D. 2222
short_description: The final part of the Sons of Welder game series, set in a dystopian universe, which uniquely combines games from the Magnus series. A game that you can experience on two levels. Hand-drawn motion comics. A metaphorical journey into oneself. A mystical experience with a touch of good humor.

name: Super Cube 3D
short_description: Explore beautiful worlds and make new friends in this seemingly innocent 3D MMO Platformer.

name: ModelMaker
short_description: Experience the fun of assembling bit by bit. The player needs to determine the exact assembly position by carefully comparing the model and real-time preview. In addition, logical reasoning is required to determine where parts may be placed, and tips can be relied on to get help.

name: Aery - Calm Mind 4
short_description: Calm down from the hassle of your daily life, experience the feeling of flying, and immerse yourself in beautiful and atmospheric landscapes.

name: Ultra Engine
short_description: Ultra Engine unlocks the full power of your GPU to deliver up to 10x faster performance for your games. Use Lua to build scalable VR simulations and 3D games, with a developer-friendly royalty-free license.

name: ONE.
short_description: The pioneering nakige that made a generation cry... Legendary '90s visual novel ONE. is back and better than ever with updated art, animations, and features!

name: Cosmic Armada
short_description: A fleet combat and space exploration game. Pilot ships, control a fleet, build and upgrade colonies, mine resources, craft items, trade, upgrade your ships and fleet, carry out missions, board ships, destroy ships and get revenge on the empire that conquered your home planet.

name: Stealth Blade
short_description: Stealth Blade is a side-scrolling action/dark art-style game. You need to save your son from demons.

name: Dolls
short_description: Dolls is a first-person horror game in which the player must escape from a dark school inhabited by seemingly lifeless dolls. Confront your fears, unravel the mysteries, and survive this suffocating environment in order to return to reality.

name: Ultra Engine Pro
short_description: Ultra Engine Pro unlocks the full power of your GPU to deliver up to 10x faster performance for your games. Use C++ to build scalable VR simulations and 3D games, with a developer-friendly royalty-free license.

name: Punzel: Chapter I - Toujours la Meme Histoire
short_description: Imagine you are a captured princess...but the hero never arrives. Join Punzel in her adventure of trying to escape her tower prison. Experience the boredom of captivity, the daily frustrations of haggling with your captors and crows. Lots of crows.

name: Paranoia: Happiness is Mandatory
short_description: Lead a team of four Troubleshooters of dubious loyalty, who (mostly) obey orders from Friend Computer, a paranoid and irrational artificial intelligence. Inspired by the classic games of the CRPG genre, experience the first official adaptation of the cult role-playing game!

name: Garten of Banban 6
short_description: Explore the forgotten levels of Banban’s Kindergarten. Survive the new terrors that reside below. Uncover the truth behind the place, and find the whereabouts of your missing child…

name: Supreme Ruler The Great War Remastered

Includes more than 50 countries set in 1914 or 1917 with no fixed end date. Enjoy improved game performance and visuals in this remastered title.

name: Chimp Quest: Spirit Isle
short_description: Swing into a heartwarming tale in Chimp Quest: Spirit Isle.

short_description: Orbius is a suika-like, rogue-lite casual game where the goal is to get the highest score possible. As your score rises, you must select spells that make furthering the game more and more difficult. Will you master Orbius?

short_description: Polyhop is a platforming game. Jump across the sky islands of a broken world, traverse through numerous hazards, and reactivate ancient pillars to pull the world together.

name: New Stars
short_description: Expand your own galactic empire across new stars, research technologies, and challenge great alien powers in this immersive 4X grand strategy game. Build interstellar colonies, and starbases to gather more resources. Explore a unique galaxy full of secrets, great perils, and limitless possibilities.

name: King Jister 3
short_description: A classic medieval point & click first person adventure game.

name: DETECTIVE - Stella Porta case
short_description: DETECTIVE: Stella Porta Case, puts you in the shoes of a detective who investigates three strange disappearances. In all cases there is a contract signed by the disappeared, that contract is from an organization called 'Stella Porta'.

name: Gaia's Blessing
short_description: Gaia's Blessing is a casual deck building farming simulator with hundred of cards for you to discover and use. Plan, Plant, and Profit as you build up your personal card collection. Help develop the so-called card tech and discover the truth behind it all!

name: Another Chance

name: Oil Coin

name: Photoelektric
short_description: Photoelektric is an atmospheric, VR platformer experience. Using a physics-based movement control scheme, you will illuminate your path though a 3-dimensional world by solving puzzles and avoiding enemies.

name: Project Bridge

Gather resources, build bridges over procedurally generated levels, upgrade your character's skill set and run as far as you can before the void swallows you!

name: Path of the Abyss
short_description: Dive deep into the Abyss.

name: Ruff City

name: Hidden Cats in Santa's Realm

name: Phantasie Memorial Set

name: 鬼打墙
short_description: This is a horror game adapted from the Chinese folklore. Players need to decrypt and collect key items in different stages. Ultimately find a way to escape the foggy forest. While searching for an exit, players will be disturbed by ghosts, players need to avoid the ghosts and evade their attacks.

name: My evil clones
short_description: My evil clones is a dynamic shooter-puzzle game where players combat armed aggressive clones. Face diverse enemies, use agility and strategy to survive, and prevent a global catastrophe.

name: Knights of the Rogue Dungeon
short_description: Cleanse the Rogue Dungeon of three Demon Knights as you battle through the depths in this addicting rogue-like dungeon hopper from the creators of Mutant Mudds™ and Xeodrifter™.

name: Hire Me!
short_description: Dream Big, Apply Recklessly! Welcome to the whimsical, wacky and slightly weird world of AllJobs Agency, where 'All' is not just a catchy prefix. Choose any job you want — or even make one up — and brace yourself for the most relentless job interview of your life.

name: T-night
short_description: A quiet family life ended at the moment when the Doomsday came. Nightmares in the dark have come to life and are thirsting for your blood

name: TRAMCITY HAKODATE
short_description: The game is set on the 'Hakodate City Tram' in Hakodate, Hokkaido. Players assume the role of a tram operator, transporting passengers to their destinations.

name: Froguelike
short_description: Your choices matter in Froguelike where you play as a frog on a mission to eat all the bugs. Level up, choose new tongues and upgrades, become unstoppable and run straight into the swarm! Unlock all frogs, tongues, items and chapters to become the most powerful frog in the pond.

name: Project XSTING
short_description: Fight your way through swarms of elite WASP soldiers and bosses using character-specific ranged and melee attacks. Survive by making strategic upgrade choices, using enemy drones to your advantage and overcoming unique stage challenges in the sci-fi survival roguelite, Project XSTING.

name: Shotgun Chicken
short_description: Shotgun chicken is a Foddian Precision Platformer Where you use your trusty old shotgun to make it back to the chicken coop but just one wrong move can send you tumbling down to the bottom.

name: MagicGirls★Shooting!!
short_description: This a side-scrolling gal-shooting game, which is an old project I made in the past, and only has one level. Just earning a listing fee. The game will last about 5 minutes, so if you don’t like it, just refund it. If you are willing to support and keep this product, sincerely thank you! !

name: Skeleton Rebellion
short_description: A turn-based RPG about a skeleton who sets out to take back an unjust, institutionalized mage tower, with the help of some fairly likely allies.

name: The Night is Grey
short_description: Graham is alone in a forest filled with strange wolves. While he’s fleeing for his life he finds a lost girl in an abandoned lodge that won’t survive without his help. Try to find their way to safety in this game filled with puzzles, engaging dialogue and innovative storyline.

name: TOON
short_description: TOON is a First Person Shooter game.

name: The Day Before You Gone
short_description: An adventure shattering stereotypes, a psychological experiment forcing a struggle within oneself. The tale of a girl with magical abilities who loses her beloved. Will she have a chance to turn back time? It's up to you!

name: Akai Onna
short_description: Akai Onna | 赤い女 is a psychological J-horror game featuring a student.

name: Heart
short_description: 'Heart' is a rhythm defense game where players protect the heart of love. Using precise reactions and rhythm, they wield a sword to fend off attacks synced to musical beats from all directions. Evade or counteract each attack in time with the rhythm, testing reaction speed and rhythm sense.

name: Boaty Tanks 2
short_description: Get ready for exciting naval combat with Boaty Tanks 2! Take control of a small boat as you navigate through various biomes, armed with your trusty weapons. But be warned - enemy ships are out to get you!

name: Disco Dave
short_description: Fun rhythm game for disco enthusiasts!

name: 真三国割草 DynastyKick
short_description: This is a 2D game originating from the Three Kingdoms period in ancient China. During the game, players need to fight independently and select appropriate skills through upgrades to improve their spells and abilities.

name: AdventureQuest 8-Bit: Dungeons & Doomknights
short_description: Can you defeat the DoomKnight and his army of the evil undead? Explore a huge world and battle vampires, ghosts, deathknights, liches, ancient evils, giant flying eyeballs, chicken cows... and other unspeakable horrors!

name: Backrooms: Eight Levels
short_description: 'God save you if you hear something wandering around nearby, because it sure as hell has heard you...'

name: Drop Doll
short_description: 'Drop Doll' is a casual puzzle game. In this game, players earn points by combining balls of the same type.

name: Oneiric
short_description: Dive into 'Oneiric' a charming walking simulator. Play as a 7-year-old boy exploring a nostalgic world of dreams and solve the riddles in a single enchanting night. Short nap, thats 15 minutes game experience focused on visual aspect.

name: Puppeteer's Curse
short_description: It's a first-person horror room escape game. You have to solve puzzles in a dark atmosphere, avoiding monitors. Never get caught.

name: Ant Farm Simulator
short_description: Ant farm (formicarium) with a colony of ants. Ants have artificial intelligence that mimics the full life cycle, behavior, nature and physics of real insects.

name: The Holyburn Witches
short_description: An atmospheric survival-horror game made from chilling panoramic photographs and terrifying sound design. According to folklore, witches haunt the forests of the accursed village of Holyburn, Maine.

name: Digital Girlfriend
short_description: 《Digital Girlfriend》 is a nurturing game of survival on an island with excellent hair, skin, and physical lighting that simulates sunrise and sunset, spring, summer, fall, and winter, including wet and dripping effects, so you can get up close and personal with your digital girlfriend!

name: Above the Hill
short_description: A hicker twists his foot in a dangerous curve in a mountain and finds himself in an unknown area, Injured and lost all he can do is search for a shelter that protects him from dangeous animals.

name: Cats VS Ghosts
short_description: Tower Defense: Cats are towers, ghosts are enemies and humans are target. You must put the correct cat to destroy the ghosts.

name: Popmoji
short_description: Merge emojis to create even bigger emojis until the cycle is completed! Use special abilities, and battle for the biggest score on the leaderboard while enjoying the juicy visuals and sound effects.

name: Supernormal
short_description: Inspired by Allison Road. SUPERNORMAL is a psychological horror game set in a seemingly ordinary apartment harboring dark secrets. Play as Detective Wyatt, tasked with unravelling the disappearance of Masato Sakamoto's daughter. Search for clues and unravel the sinister truth.

name: Drilbert
short_description: Drilbert is a short puzzle game with a unique digging mechanic, made by a solo developer.

name: ISOLAND4: The Anchor of Memory
short_description: ISOLAND4 is the fifth installment in the ISOLAND series by CottonGame. The game continues to feature the distinctive hand-drawn style of CottonGame, with point-and-click gameplay. The game also features a second playthrough mode, which allows players to gain a deeper understanding of the game.

name: Voxelotl Garden
short_description: Raise, train, and breed Voxelotl to create the most unique Voxelotl patterns and shapes. Feed them treats to keep them happy and level up their skills in training exercises. Participate in races to test your Voxelotl’s skills. Enjoy spending time with your cute Voxelotl pets!

name: Terranny
short_description: Design and program drones, then send them into battle. Inspired by 'Carnage Heart' for PS1

name: CaS-Puz: Camera Surface Puzzle
short_description: Your perspective changes the world. In this hardcore platformer, the existence of walls depends on the angle of your camera. A seemingly impassable level will transform once you look from a different angle, and every careless jump and camera movement can turn into a flight into the void.

name: Pixelment TD
short_description: Pixelment TD is an Element based Tower Defense game, You are facing a new tower defense game with unique graphic experience.

name: CROSS DUNGEON
short_description: Connect the tiles and conquer the dungeon. Monsters and treasure await! Defeat monsters and move on. Power up when you get the treasure. Let's proceed while collecting treasures.

name: Noxious Weeds
short_description: Face the corruption that poisons your harvest! Noxious Weeds is an action rogue-lite where you slay hordes of creatures with the help of cute veggies and a combination of your favorite tools. The harvest is power. Choose wisely!

name: 天神印（THE BLOCKADE）
short_description: Tenshen Print is a fantasy single-player role-playing game by Emeng Shanhai Studio, which uses a 2D perspective rarely seen in fantasy RPGS. In the course of the game, the player will set foot on the journey of cultivating the immortal as the spirited young 'Qin Xiao'.

name: Slayin DX
short_description: Run through wave after wave of monsters with your weapons, spells or mounts in this endless single screen arcade game.

name: KARNAL
short_description: A short atmospheric FPS experience. Escape confinement, return to your wife, and kill anything that stands in your path.

name: breakfive
short_description: 'Broken Fifth' is an interactive video app set in the era when Emperor Chengzu Zhu Di relocated the capital to Beiping, drawing envoys from diverse nations. On the crucial day of New Year's Break of the Fifth, Tang Ge, an Embroidered Uniform Guard captain, becomes entangled in a mysterious case.

name: sCATch 2: The Painter Cat
short_description: sCATch 2 is a puzzle game where the goal is paint all colorful places of the maze and come to the exit. Combining colors and items with different mechanics on the way.

name: Call of Sentinels
short_description: Call of Sentinels is an exciting action game where you will have to challenge real evil! Epic battles await you with hordes of diverse enemies and charismatic bosses that will not leave you indifferent.

name: Mortisomem
short_description: Donald Barnes is a successful merchant who one day on his way home, starts being stalked by a dangerous demon from the Colonial Times. Now he has to find a way back home or finally defeat Mortisomem.

name: Arlo
short_description: Dodge, attack, face thousands of enemies and level-up to survive. 27 weapons with 11 different main attacks and more than 70 equipment. Customize your starter character and dodge hundreds of enemies rushing to you while you level-up and boost your stats or pick passive attacks.

name: Illegal Mahjong
short_description: Yuri, the former heiress of a company, finds her father's business bankrupt. To repay the debts, Yuri must compete in mahjong and continue to win. Can Yuri truly defeat her formidable opponents?

name: I Think I'm in Love with a Demon Prince
short_description: An enthralling blend of strategy, story, and magic in a world of angels and demons. Demon Prince combines the intricacies of tower defense with real-time strategy elements, set against a backdrop of a riveting narrative where love dictates the fate of kingdoms.

name: Hertz
short_description: Launch into a fierce roguelite action in this top-down twin-stick shooter with bombs! In a robotic world, control Lizzy and their team of unlockable beasty bots in a quest for upgrades. But beware, needed resources are guarded by swarms of Steel Sentinels. Survive them to craft synergistic builds.

name: Mystical Map
short_description: Mystical Map is a rogue-lite that allows players to draw out their own path in each playthrough. Maps are randomly generated, but YOU have the ability to choose your path and use any items found to enhance it. Chart your course and take on various action platforming challenges!

name: F*ck This Game
short_description: A difficult arcade game; multitask by controlling 8 minigames at once to reach the highest score you can!

name: Dragon Lair Depths
short_description: A turn-based strategy game with a light roguelike twist. Bring heroes of different races, break into the dragon's lair full of monsters, improve heroes and use strategies, defeat evil dragons time and time again...

name: Rage of Mechs
short_description: Experience intense mech battles in the post-apocalyptic wasteland of Rage of Mechs. Command powerful mechs, upgrade weapons, and strategize in multiplayer sessions. Unleash your rage and conquer the wasteland!

name: Get Out Joey !
short_description: Be precise! In this precision platform game, every jump is a challenge to guide Joey to the end of his adventure. Arm yourself with your spear, your patience, swing, concentrate, but above all, don't tremble: the further you progress, the harder the fall will be...

name: Angel at Dusk
short_description: Profusely Genuine! Explosively Orthodox! Shoot, dodge, and destroy! A die-hard style, faithful return to the origin of top down shooters!

name: YUME 4
short_description: YUME 4 is a maze-breaking game, in which Chen Xi moves in the opposite direction to her previous life. Players need to use keyboard control to reach the designated position to enter the next level!There will be many dangers to stop your progress, be careful not to get Chen Xi injured!

name: Syllogism
short_description: Explore an open world full of beautiful views and locations, and enjoy a relaxing atmosphere while immersing yourself in unique challenges that will challenge your imagination and logical thinking.

name: ThroneForge - The Fortress War
short_description: Throneforge - The Fortress War:Build an arsenal of diverse towers, each with unique abilities and strengths.Strategically place towers along the enemy's path to maximize their impact and create impenetrable defense lines.

name: Crystal Story: Dawn of Dusk
short_description: Crystal Story: Dawn of Dusk is the first entry in the Crystal Story epic, and features charming retro-style graphics, with fast-paced action and turn-based battles, heavily inspired by 16-bit classics!

name: VRosty
short_description: Pull-along VRosty, the little snowman, through a warming world in this VR-only puppet-puzzle-platformer. His life is hanging by a thread.

name: War Hospital
short_description: Take charge of a WW1 field hospital on the Western Front, and make all the decisions necessary to help the soldiers recover and to support the war effort. In this narrative management game, you are the last bastion of humanity.

name: Primateria
short_description: Embark on an epic journey in Primateria, a game redefining the roguelike deckbuilder with a nod to classic Yu-Gi-Oh! experience. Fuse cards, battle divine beings, and navigate through a universe teeming with challenges and surprises. Embrace the thrill of endless combinations and tactical depths.

name: Rutabaga Desert Storm
short_description: Lead the vegetable revolution alone or with a friend in the side-scrolling shoot ‘em up Rutabaga Desert Storm! Take down wave after wave of enemies, dodge their projectiles, and grab power-ups to boost your destruction! Can you defeat the oppressive humans and free the proletariat vegetable masses?

name: Searching For Rest
short_description: Gain upgrades and form powerful synergies in order to break the curse that is keeping you from your eternal rest. Unlock new game changing upgrades each time you play and come back stronger than ever before.

name: Garbageman
short_description: In this retro-style arcade game, help Frank to keep the columns of the Clock Building free of trash to prevent its imminent collapse.

name: Last Dino Standing
short_description: Last Dino Standing is a fast-paced game where you control a T-rex to avoid crazy elements.

name: Haunt Monster
short_description: Haunt Monster is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror multiplayer FPS zombies game set in a random generated environment. Build, defend and survive waves of zombies, monsters and aliens. Play solo or co-op with friends to survival.

name: Unveiling
short_description: Experience the UFO abduction in first person and take a trip to meet the keeper. Explore layers of reality and learn what is concealed behind the modern Unidentified Anomalous Phenomenon (UAP) in this esthetic and eerie interactive experience.

name: The Sand Knight
short_description: Kill your foes and power up your mech in this combat-heavy game of destruction and mayhem. Maneuver around the battlefield, avoiding enemy fire while dishing it out in kind.

name: Metal Ascension
short_description: Metal Ascension is a horde survival game with rogue-lite elements. Upgrade your mech with over 200 pieces and more than 1 000 000 combinations.

name: KinitoPET
short_description: KinitoPET is a psychological horror experience that takes place through Kinito, an early 2000s virtual assistant. Kinito is able to walk, talk, browse, adapt, and play games as Kinito is like no other with its adaptive technology!

name: Package Runner
short_description: Your number is 22, a Package handler at Zenith Company. Your job is to fix those packages and keep your workspace tidy. Hot bath service is the only reward in this damn job. With work going on, you'll find the truth of the company.

name: Haunted House
short_description: 'Cheong Wing Mansion' A plot game set in a public housing estate, Prosperous Mansions is an exploration of Hong Kong in the olden days, with elements of ghosts and urban legends. The game is divided into units, each of which has its own story, yet is closely intertwined.

name: Martha's Dolls
short_description: Dive into the adventures in ' Merphy Town ' where Martha's Dolls lives , solve the mystery , prepare yourself for a great horror experience !

name: BUZZ
short_description: BUZZ is a challenging, free-form, momentum-based platformer with fast-paced, fluid gameplay.

name: Despair: Blood Curse
short_description: A third-person survival horror game featuring non-linear gameplay, puzzles, and enemies from the depths of hell. When Anna's mother passes away from a sudden illness, she receives a worrying letter from her sister suggesting that not all is as it seems. Will she uncover the truth?

name: Skies above the Great War
short_description: Skies above the Great War is a hybrid of action and grand strategy sandbox game set on the Western Front during the First World War. Manage your air forces or take control of any plane yourself in real time.

name: Mystic Strife
short_description: Mystic Strife is a fast-paced chaotic party fighting game for up to eight friends. Choose one of six characters with unique abilities and prepare yourself for a simple yet surprisingly deep platforming deathmatch!

name: Trash Top Down Racing
short_description: Top down 2d racing game. Race against AI opponents in different racing tracks

name: Grapple Tanks
short_description: Traverse dynamic terrains and engage in an endless deathmatch with a grappling-hook-equipped tank. Outlast and outmaneuver your opponents in Grapple Tanks, a 2D multiplayer shooter game playable with up to 4 people.

name: French Fries Pusher Friends
short_description: Do you love French fries? Then this game is for you! A game where you push out fries with French fries to create a set of a burger, fries, and a drink.

name: Archaelund
short_description: Explore a vast open world and crawl through dungeons in first person, then fight tactical turn-based battles from a top-down perspective. Guide your adventuring party through Archaelund, mankind's last frontier, and uncover its many secrets.

name: Unrestricted Pest Control
short_description: U.P.C. is a top-down shooter where you play as a fearless exterminator to solve a small bug problem at a nuclear research facility. With the rogue-lite elements, you must choose your path to the upper floors carefully, while trying to bug fixing in the facility.

name: Progeria: Vae Victis
short_description: XXI century, Russian Empire. Kirill Yeletsky is a fifth-year student at the Saint Petersburg Academic University of Necromagic. Help him defend the honor of his noble family by winning in the grand imperial necromagic tournament.

name: Medieval Revenge
short_description: Playing a card game where you navigate from the revenge of an English peasant against marauding Vikings in medieval England to the attainment of kingdom power.

name: Computer Repair Shop
short_description: Become a dishonest computer repairman, steal rams. Burn the motherboards!

name: Momodora: Moonlit Farewell
short_description: 'Momodora: Moonlit Farewell' is the latest installment in the Momodora series. Join Momo, High Priestess of the village of Koho, as she embarks on a divine mission to save her people from imminent destruction at the hands of the demon hordes summoned by a malevolent bellringer.

name: Chat Guess Games
short_description: Chat Guess Games is a community game for Twitch Streamers. A game for your community to battle it out and see who truly knows the most about video games!

name: My Lovey-Dovey Demon
short_description: A cute love story between a young man and an affectionate, adoring, utterly insatiable demon girl set in the Japanese countryside.

name: NovaX
short_description: Nova-X is a solo/cooperative survival game currently in development. Immerse yourself in a multiplayer pirate/fantasy world where you can embark on world exploration, conquer territories, build ships, seek treasures, or gleefully indulge in pillaging.

name: Grudge
short_description: Grudge is a fantasy based exploration and survival sandbox MMO! Collect, fight, explore, build, siege and more! Alone or with friends, you can choose to build your stronghold, make alliances or wage war in the open world!

name: Beer Factory
short_description: Beer Factory is a business simulation and management game. Take the challenge and manage your own beer factory, employees, production lines, as well as the import and export of merchandise.

name: Cozy Island Idle
short_description: Cozy Island Idle is a cute and relaxing 3D idle game where you catch all sort of fantasy fishes to showcase them in an Aquarium. You can sell them to turn a profit and customize your island.

name: Beyond Doors
short_description: Caleb woke up in a mystical dimension after experiencing burnout in his job. Door-to-door, guided by enigmatic musical notes, he needs to be reminded of his true calling. Immerse yourself in this mind-bending platformer.

name: Frontline Survivors
short_description: Frontline Survivors is an intense top-down shooter with roguelite elements that puts you in the boots of a soldier fighting for survival on the battlefield. With countless enemies coming at you from all sides, you will need to use all your skills and strategy to stay alive.

name: 北斗将星录
short_description: 《BeiDou hero legend》is a turn-based RPG game.You will play the role of a Taoist and go back to the Three Kingdoms Period.You must collect seven powerful magic weapons and use the power of historic hero to fight with the evil king.

name: Little Elf Tanks
short_description: A bombastic bug busting adventure! Play as one of four playable characters in their quest to to free their fellow elves from the clutches of an evil army of spiders. If they crawl, blast em all! Let nothing stand in your way.

name: Halcyon Days
short_description: While exploring ancient ruins, Teflon accidentally releases a mysterious woman and her guardian from their cryosleep. When it's revealed that they are from a lost civilization that shaped the world as it is today, an adventure of treasure, betrayal and friendship begins.

name: Aquascapers
short_description: Bring Nature Home! Experience Aquascapers, a single-player and co-op aquascaping simulation that invites you and friends to discover and gather various ornamental resources for your aquascaping projects. Enhance your business and dominate the market!

name: Atlas Wept
short_description: A Humanist retro-style RPG game about sincerity and empathy, featuring friendly robot dogs and evil smiley faces.

name: The Last Medic
short_description: The Last Medic is a 2D precision platformer set in space. Earth was hit by an asteroid and you are the last surviving medic. Your space suit is equipped with a jetpack, a dash booster, and a healing device. Use these tools as you travel from planet to planet on your way to save Earth.

name: The Glitch Prison
short_description: Use the glitch you have discovered to break out of jail!

name: Extreme Evolution: Drive to Divinity
short_description: Evolution concludes in this expressive platformer. Movement is your power, transformation is your gift. Discover sites and evolve as you explore an organic underworld open-world, Earth looming in the distance...

name: Dominions 6 - Rise of the Pantokrator
short_description: In Dominions 6 you take control of a powerful being that rules a nation and aspires to godhood. The type of Pretender Gods can vary from magically powerful arch mages to old dragons or an enormous tree. Dominions is a deep 4x turn based strategy game with a very large variety of spells and units.

name: Bulletstorm VR
short_description: Bulletstorm VR is a brutally creative action shooter that puts players in the ass-kicking boots of the hotheaded space mercenary Grayson Hunt as he shoots, kicks, and leashes all he can see across a hostile world in Virtual Reality!

name: Holidays in Khrushchevsk
short_description: Do you like spontaneous purchases? Do all your purchases bring you happiness? Everything is not as simple as it seems at first glance.

name: Room231
short_description: Room231 is a single player horror game, which is based on the famous creepy pasta called 'Backrooms'. Player must find an exit to leave room231 and reach the truth of room231.

name: Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs The Thrilling Steamy Maze Kiwami
short_description: Want to dive into a bath? Or into a dungeon? 'Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs' is now an RPG that's pushing all sorts of boundaries! Power up in the hot spring, then push through clothes-ripping dangers to clear out the dungeon! A new story of hauntings, hot springs, and high adventure awaits!

name: Bisyntho
short_description: Bisyntho is a casual physics-based arcade game about combining orbs. Use and abuse the few tools provided to you in order to last as long as possible and push your high score to its limit.

name: Exiled
short_description: Charlotte is missing. Decode an ancient language, investigate a mystery, and stay away from ancient monsters in this compact puzzle thriller.

name: No Case Should Remain Unsolved
short_description: Twelve years after Senior Inspector Jeon Gyeong's retirement, she is visited by a young police officer: a woman who pleads with her to reexamine Seowon's case. But with each uncovered memory, only one thing becomes clear: everyone in Seowon's vicinity was lying.

name: LONESTAR
short_description: LONESTAR is a strategic Roguelike spaceship deckbuilder. As a bounty hunter, you will capture criminals scattered across the universe. Win the shockwave battle to gain rewards and vacations. Find treasures, customize spaceships, unlock talents, defeat the felons and be a legend!

name: Strange Survivors
short_description: Come and sweep slime! Live on, make tomorrow's dawn more dazzling! Strange Survivors is a survivor like game that continuously allows characters to enter dungeons and receive rewards from monsters to make them stronger and stronger. Even in dangerous situations, they can move forward bravely!

name: Master Manager
short_description: You are the manager of a football club, determine its future by making the best decisions regarding tactics, training, player contracts, sponsorship deals and infrastructure. Watch your players performing on our amazing 2d match engine.

name: Sakura Succubus 8
