short_description: The eighth part of the Sakura Succubus series is finally here! Join Hiroki and his loyal harem as they try to help Alice overcome her greatest challenge yet: trying to find a job.

name: What's Up There?
short_description: A simple journey but which requires enormous concentration. Will you be able to reach the Light above or will you stay forever below? Fake and true game endings for the most curious players.

name: Choc N Roll
short_description: It's time to get the ball rolling, but slow down! Be careful what you roll yourself into because too much chocolate can be harmful to you! Prepare to wind down and melt away as you enter the sweet world of Choc N Roll!

name: Spellbound Hearts
short_description: 'Spellbound Hearts' is a visual novel where Lycos, a trapped vampire, meets Zephyros, a wizard seeking his blood to save a village. Together, they journey through trust, redemption, and love.

name: Time Survivors
short_description: The Most Historically Inaccurate Roguelike Ever Made. Slay hordes of minions as Lincoln, Tesla, Cleopatra and other historic heroes with unique abilities! Fight through various historical eras, collect resources, unlock and enhance gameplay through a deep skill-tree metaprogression.

name: MechaJourney
short_description: This is a placement game. Due to the invasion of EB and D&D, humans learn and research new technologies, which enable them to manufacture and transform mechas; It can also cultivate pilots and develop cities. Finally eliminate all invading enemies

name: Palworld
short_description: Fight, farm, build and work alongside mysterious creatures called 'Pals' in this completely new multiplayer, open world survival and crafting game!

name: Toy Trains
short_description: Let’s play Toy Trains! A playful track-building VR game where you create your own small world and engage in a captivating storyline. It’s all about imagination, creative thinking, having fun and… trains!

name: Knights of Grayfang
short_description: Unleash Bloodthirst skills in an epic vampire RPG! Will nightfall or twilight triumph in a vampire war? Seize victory by claiming all nine temples and unravel the mysteries and battle the monsters within to conquer them!

name: Crumbling
short_description: Woosh! Bam! Pow! Remember playing with action figures? Put on your VR headset, grab your favorite Crumbling and fight your way through an onslaught of plastic monsters in this unique third-person action rogue-like that brings you right back to your childhood!

name: Just Xiangqi
short_description: This is a refreshing Chinese chess game with realistic graphics and a detailed audio tutorial that will keep you entertained, even as a novice. A variety of well-designed challenges will test your tactics. Sit back and relax, as you transform into a master of strategy.

name: New Cycle
short_description: New Cycle is a city building game with focus on survival. After an apocalyptic series of solar flares, human society has been thrown into disarray. Establish a settlement and develop it all the way from humble beginnings to industrial metropolis.

name: Panda Go
short_description: This is a turn-based board puzzle game in which a variety of unexpected levels are combined through a simple guard mechanism! You need to skillfully operate your character to pass through guards and various obstacles to finally reach the end!

name: Fantasy Kommander: Eukarion Wars
short_description: Immerse yourself in the epic battles of Fantasy Kommander, a turn-based strategy game set in a European fantasy world. Lead your armies, master the battle system, and unravel the captivating storyline across four campaigns filled with heroes, quests, and powerful enemies.

name: Three Kingdoms Zhao Yun
short_description: At the end of the Eastern Han Dynasty, the heroes were fighting for hegemony, and the flames were everywhere. In the game, players played the role of Zhao Yun, a well-known general of the Three Kingdoms, and interpreted the story of his youth.

name: Family Ties
short_description: Discover the power within you, challenge the hardships of life, and keep your family together in this epic game called 'Family Ties.' Take on the challenging tasks that await you and seize control of your life. Stand strong in the face of life's sudden twists because there's a hero within you!

name: Jump, Froggy! Jump!
short_description: Embark on a frog's odyssey in 'Jump, Froggy! Jump!' a challenging 3D platformer! In this enchanting world, you'll step into the webbed feet of a courageous frog on his journey to rescue the Princess Frog. Can you conquer the castle and rescue the Princess?

name: Starlight Scouts
short_description: Pure physics-based rocket-powered fun. Solve puzzles, fly fast, crash hard. Become a Starlight Scout...

name: Contain
short_description: Contain is a Tactical Co-Op FPS game. Form your squad of four players to fight against the anomalies. Try to 'Contain' them where the line between ordinary and extraordinary is blurred.

name: 镖行天下
short_description: 这是一款策略类运镖类游戏，采用战旗战斗模式， 运送镖物、买卖特产、建设镖局、传递信件、触发事件、触发战斗、探索世界。 你需要在十年内尽可能发展你的镖局，强化你的镖局成员，游戏时间到达十一年时将迎来大决战。 您发展镖局的方式将决定您的终局。如果您嫌十年太长，您可以通过自己的探索用其他方式通关游戏。

name: The Pony Factory
short_description: Winston thought he could use heavy machinery and power from the depths of hell to transform sinful men into magic ponies. Winston was wrong.

name: Chiyo
short_description: [Chiyo] is a first-person hardcore escape room horror game set in Japan's Edo era. As Idate Chiyo, a paranormal investigator possessing supernatural abilities, you are tasked with investigating an abandoned mansion and unveiling a family's dark history and it's ultimate secret.

name: Sun Spear
short_description: When ancient darkness threatens to swallow the world whole, call upon the power of the light! Wield the Sun Spear against the creatures of the night as Bonnie, a steadfast warrior determined to save her village. Can you seal away horrors untold before night falls forever?

name: Renovation Plan
short_description: This is a relaxing and leisurely home decoration game, you need to follow the design map to put all kinds of furniture in the corresponding position. Each room has unique furniture and decoration style, more gorgeous large apartment waiting for you to decorate.

name: The Spiritless Shaman
short_description: Read through this visual novel that will soothe the loneliest of hearts.

name: Kingsvein
short_description: Explore and reclaim the infested castle-city of Kingsvein! Ride into its depths on your trusty wyvern, and lead your customizable party of Knights and Mystics in deep tactical combat.

name: Sovereign Syndicate
short_description: A Victorian steampunk RPG with tarot cards instead of dice. Investigate the disappearance of society’s most vulnerable to uncover a mysterious cult. Play as three characters, each with their own skills and motivations. Customize your characters with narrative choices to unlock new tarot cards.

name: Multi Turret Academy
short_description: Multi Turret Academy is a top-down tank action game with roguelike elements. Select your vehicle from a growing list of historical models, then equip dozens of weapons and upgrades to lead your local tank club to victory!

name: False Dream
short_description: You find yourself trapped in a dream. If you capture anomalies in the dream with a camera, you might be able to escape.

name: Pitch Black
short_description: Escape Mary-Anne, a doll developed by The MonolIth Corporation, where lessons are learned through play. Stay out of the light, and flip switches to stay in the dark.

name: Homebrew32
short_description: Drawn into your PC by an antivirus, control a 1-5 barrel tank in this Action Roguelike, 2D Shooter. Defeat motherboard viruses to unlock new zones. The 'UPGRADE MACHINE' grants enhancements every 1-10 seconds. Use points to add upgrades in this Arcade, Top-Down Adventure.

name: The Lab and Dungeons
short_description: The Lab and Dungeons is a fusion of roguelike action and shooter RPG. As a robot, mine ores, craft unique weapons, and conquer procedural dungeons. Collect materials to unlock more advanced weapons. From a novice to a high-spec warrior robot, enjoy physics-based combat solo or in co-op mode online!

name: Deadly Nightmare Unwanted Heritage
short_description: Deadly Nightmare Unwanted Heritage brings you back to the nightmare world, where your mission it so try and break the curse before 6 AM. In the first Deadly Nightmare game, you played the role of John, but this time around you take the role of his grandmother. Surviving is not easy!

name: Turnip Boy Robs a Bank
short_description: Turnip Boy is back! This time he’s teaming up with the fearsome Pickled Gang to plan and execute the weirdest heist of all time. Shake down hostages, steal precious valuables, battle the fuzz, and use wacky tools bought off the dark web to move further into the vaults of the Botanical Bank.

name: Home Safety Hotline
short_description: Hearing noises? Seeing things? Call Home Safety Hotline! Our operators are standing by, waiting to give you the answers you need to protect your home from all manner of pests and household hazards.

name: Belonging
short_description: Belonging is a game about a cult and its victims. As a hacktivist breaking into a target location, the player searches an abandoned estate of a cult to find data to leak to the public and uncover uncomfortable truths about what happened to the people that lived there.

name: MiceGard
short_description: Play MiceGard, adventure game where viking mice fight for honor, fame and survival. Explore the world inspired by Norse mythology, meet with gods and warlocks and seize the glory of the fiercest mouse-warrior in this action-packed saga!

name: Garlic Builder
short_description: Garlic Builder is a unique building game. As the new builder of the Garlic Family, can you inherit your father's building hammer, take various orders, follow the blueprint, or use your imagination to fulfill the strange needs of your customers?

name: Chaos Sisters
short_description: Chaos sisters is a beat'em up of demon girls fighting their way through monsters and heroes. Fiery Puna fights in close combat hack and slash style, while Sini casts a barrage of spells and combines them to conjure powerful Invocations. Uncover secrets and survive the night!

name: First Cut: Samurai Duel
short_description: Every strike is lethal in this blood-soaked sword fighting game. Slash, clash, parry, dodge and watch limbs fly. Choose your move carefully - the first cut is also the last.

name: Aground Zero
short_description: The world has ended. You are deep underground, and all alone with a cheery AI companion. You will have to mine and build to survive, and search for other survivors to help you. Will you be able to reach the surface? And what will you find when you get there?

name: Kebab Chefs! - Restaurant Simulator
short_description: Kebab Chefs! is a Co-Op, cooking and restaurant management game that can be played up to 4 players. Design your own restaurant. Cook delicious foods, fill your menu with various recipes, feed customers and become the biggest kebab restaurant in town!

name: TEKKEN 8
short_description: Get ready for the next chapter in the legendary fighting game franchise, TEKKEN 8.

name: Stargate: Timekeepers
short_description: Stargate: Timekeepers is a real-time tactics game where you lead a team of specialists through a story-driven campaign set in the SG-1 universe. Sneak your characters behind enemy lines, use their unique skills, craft the perfect plan to unravel a timeloop mystery, and defeat the Goa’uld threat.

name: Soundscape
short_description: Exploratory musical metaverse hybrid reality warp world.

name: JongRo 3_Street
short_description: 'In the year 2024, South Korea has become a wasteland due to the Epsilon virus. South Korea is full of infected people. In this desolate landscape, a man hears a rumor about a path to salvation at Jongno 3-ga Station and decides to head there.'

name: Zero World
short_description: Gather resources, craft items, kill others, raid houses, but don't get raided yourself

name: 100 Hidden Cats in China
short_description: 100 Hidden Cats in China - Join the cutest adventure in the China! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of China Landscape as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.Can you find them all?

name: Six Cabins in Serpent Ridge National Forest
short_description: 'Six Cabins' crafts a subtle, atmospheric horror experience relying on environmental storytelling. As a lost hiker navigating an unfamiliar section of forest, you progress through the environment searching for lost keys that unlock clues to the enigmatic history of Serpent Ridge National Forest.

name: The Witch's Cauldron
short_description: The Witch's Cauldron is a narrative roguelike game about being a medieval witch. Grab your cauldron and get brewing. Love, curses, laughter, wisdom for sale! Do what thou wilt shall be the whole of the Law. At least before the inquisitors come around.

name: 西游伏妖传
short_description: 《西游伏妖传》是一款以《西游记》为题材制作的生存动作类游戏。 在本游戏中，玩家将选择一名西游世界中的人物来作为自己的“取经人”，并通过不断挑战关卡来解锁不同的技能，装备，人物和后续关卡。 本作关卡没有通关一说，玩家最终必然会面对死亡。而玩家所能做的只有从每一轮的战斗中收集金币，购买并强化自身，以提升自己在关卡内的属性与存活时间，从而解锁更多的人物，技能与装备。

name: AaaaaAAaaaAAAaaAAAAaAAAAA!!! Remastered
short_description: You're a skydiving, video-streaming guerilla artist in the floating city of Boston High. Your job is to leap from buildings, cause mischief, and not get caught.

name: Absence of Light
short_description: 'Absence of Light' is an exploration based shoot 'em up that combines intense bullet-dodging combat with a metroidvania-style level design. Solve, shoot, and shine your way through the kingdom of Luminara and reawaken the light!

name: Combat Mission: Final Blitzkrieg
short_description: Combat Mission Final Blitzkrieg (CMFB) follows the Western Allies through the battles along Germany's border and into the heart of the Reich itself.

name: Sky Base Venus
short_description: Survive in the skies of Venus with your floating colony as you balance buoyancy, mass, and altitude. Launch balloons and probes to explore the planet while harvesting resources from the atmosphere. Build up your colony and thrive in a simulation based on real science. Venus awaits.

name: Kagura Genesis: Kuon's Story
short_description: Vanquish and recruit youkai in randomized dungeons in Kagura Genesis: Kuon's Story, a replayable roguelike RPG!

name: RIN: The Last Child
short_description: Join RIN, the last child of the Creator, on a journey to restore order in a mystical world. Collect aspects and runes, craft spells, and confront powerful bosses - your transformed siblings. The fate of the world rests in your hands. Can you restore harmony to this enchanted realm?

name: Funny Football
short_description: This is a casual football game. You can control the movement of two football players by your two hands respectively at the same time which is not only definitely a big challenge but also can bring you a lot of fun, especially when you play the local PVP mode.

name: Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney Trilogy
short_description: Join rookie attorney Apollo Justice and his mentor, the legendary Phoenix Wright, in this collection of 3 games! This title features 16 episodes (including previously DLC-only episodes) and supports English, French, German, Japanese Korean, and Traditional and Simplified Chinese.

name: Escape The Aquarium
short_description: This is an exploratory puzzle game Third person operation: The protagonist completes each box court level one by one The satiety that requires constant attention prevents you from slowing down and thinking!

name: Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth
short_description: Two larger-than-life heroes, Ichiban Kasuga and Kazuma Kiryu are brought together by the hand of fate, or perhaps something more sinister… Live it up in Japan and explore all that Hawaii has to offer in an RPG adventure so big it spans the Pacific.

name: Veggie Quest: The Puzzle Game
short_description: Build a game dungeon. Watch a perfectly smart AI beat it with ease. Redesign. Improve. Optimize to what seemed impossible. Outsmart the perfect AI.

name: The Source
short_description: A sci-fi visual novel where our main heroes journey through time and discover the mysteries of their world.

name: 三国志之匡扶汉室
short_description: More than 100 generals are available for recruitment. Each warrior has a unique passive skill. With the powerful rune language. Set up your own special team of generals, and go to Kuangfu Han Room together.

name: Flash of the Blade
short_description: Flash of the Blade is a retro-inspired first-person Ninja slasher with brutal difficulty and an old-school feel. Slice and Dice your way to freedom against the Evil Ninja Clan across 11 hand-crafted levels using an assortment of period-accurate weaponry.

name: Enshrouded
short_description: You are Flameborn, last ember of hope of a dying race. Awaken, survive the terror of a corrupting fog, and reclaim the lost beauty of your kingdom. Venture into a vast world, vanquish punishing bosses, build grand halls and forge your path in this co-op survival action RPG for up to 16 players.

name: UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes
short_description: The newest riveting installment in the epic Under Night In-Birth saga rises from the Abyss! Improved visuals and battle system! Witness the curtain fall on the tale of the Hollow Night. Vie for supremacy through exhilarating combat and a deep, robust battle system!

name: TASOKARE HOTEL Re:newal
short_description: 一日中夕暮れに染まっている「黄昏ホテル」。そこは、生と死の狭間を彷徨う魂たちが羽を休めるために存在する場所。ある日、ホテルに迷い込んだ少女が、出会いと事件をきっかけに、自らの運命を大きく切り開くことに。生死の狭間で謎解きに挑む、世にも奇妙な異世界脱出アドベンチャーが登場！

name: Creeper Nightmare: Season 0
short_description: Season 0-is a prologue that will introduce the player to the series, and will allow you to learn the origin of the monster, which the locals perceive as a cursed deity.Plunge into a terrible night, which will start a chain of events - which will not give anyone hope of surviving until the morning...

name: Horror Nightmare Collection
short_description: The Horror Nightmare Collection is an anthology of retro-style horror games. Immerse yourself in unique stories, from eerie forest horrors to forsaken prison nightmares, pushing your nerves to the limit. Explore psychological and grotesque terrors in this dread-inducing assortment.

name: Pirates Journey
short_description: You and your crew have been shipwrecked on a tropical island in the late 1600s. At the beginning of the adventure, you find yourself with only a few basic supplies, including ropes, sticks, and stones. With skill and cunning, you can survive on the island and thrive as a pirate crew.

name: Unforetold: Witchstone
short_description: Unforetold: Witchstone is an RPG sandbox with a deep, reactive influence system that allows you to shape the fate of the world.

name: Dracula Awakens
short_description: Kill monsters using your camera and solve puzzles as you try to survive Dracula himself in his castle in this retro-style survival horror game.

name: Desktop Tourney World
short_description: Desktop Tourney World is a simulation construction, immortal cultivation survival game, you need to collect food, construct buildings, build equipment, and fight with all kinds of monsters.

name: Taddle Quest
short_description: This is an adventure RPG with a focus on boss battles, defeating powerful enemies and gaining lots of equipment rewards. With different equipment to enhance yourself, challenge more powerful bosses and uncover the secrets of this fantasy world.

name: Little Loki & The Yggdrasil Maze
short_description: A hundred years ago, the defeated Demon Lord Loki has now been resurrected! Disregarding the dissuasion of his former subordinates, Loki is determined to reach the Yggdrasil. Faced with powerful enemies, will Loki be able to succeed in seeking revenge?

name: Hailing from the Abyss
short_description: Hailing From the Abyss is a rhythm game with a unique duel setup. Beat powerful enemies in rhythmic battles by using consumables, acquiring power-ups, and skill. Guide Suri while she faces her past memories in style and rhythm!

name: Saiko no sutoka no shiki
short_description: Saiko no Sutoka No Shiki is a spin-off of the original game Saiko no Sutoka, in which Saiko is a zombie anime girl who wants to play with her senpai, with the senpai needing to complete her parts and give her food to satisfy her hunger while simultaneously trying to escape.

name: Tomorrow's Love Puzzle
short_description: Play as 'Ming Tian' in a romantic game, where you meet six unique women. From dominant to innocent, mysterious, dignified, cheerful, to clingy, your choices determine Ming Tian's love story. Who will he choose? You decide.

name: Webshooters
short_description: Midway City is in a chaos! A new type of criminal needs a new style of justice... Battle for the streets as a hero or villain, on or offline, in screen space or VR!

name: 虚构未来（Imaginary future）
short_description: Embark on the journey to your envisioned future! In this Japanese-style role-playing game infused with elements of microcosm and yuri, you will take on the perspective of Koushuki, a former gang girl. Experience the profound changes unfolding in the Serbian town through a series of events.

name: 「怪奇参道」（Kaiki Sando）_BugFix_ver1.1
short_description: 'Kaiki Sando' is a horror game exploring ancient secrets and yokai in Japan's mountains. Players encounter supernatural events and choose paths at mysterious torii gates, affecting the story.

name: From Scratch
short_description: From Scratch is survival game set in a huge open world of over 50 square kilometers. Fight, craft and acquire resources to survive in a world overrun by zombies and wild animals.

name: Ball is Life
short_description: Ball is Life is a challenging 3D precision platformer and visual novel that follows the life of a ball (yes, a literal ball) as he searches for ways to conquer life's greatest challenge—life itself.

name: Roots of Yggdrasil
short_description: Build settlements, explore the Nine Realms, collect artifacts and upgrade your buildings deck to reach the top of Yggdrasil in this post-Ragnarok roguelike city-builder! Can you survive the end of the world?

name: Plastomorphosis
short_description: Evacuated from his hometown due to the dangerous bursts of dark energy, the ordinary citizen is trying to overcome and survive a series of events in a new reality, where living as a human being is not possible anymore. 3rd-person horror with fixed camera angles and retro-styled graphics.

name: Aim in Space
short_description: A fantastic space game to train reaction and aiming skills. Don't let the aliens destroy your base!

name: Re into Another World
short_description: 'Re into Another World' is an RPG adventure game set in a fantasy world. Players need to accumulate souls by challenging monsters, using these souls to unlock characters in order to defeat the final demon. Character growth and upgrades, equipment combinations, and puzzle-solving included.

name: Impasse Journey ~ Kaohsiung Chapter ~
short_description: In post-apocalyptic Taiwan, a young girl, Yang Qiongqi, arrives in Kaohsiung. To fulfill a promise to her father, she is forced to stop in her journey, although in this very place, her icy heart begins to stir once more. In such a lawless world, what on earth could keep the smile in her?

name: Caught On Camera
short_description: Survive 6 hours as a night guard, monitoring for anomalies. Act fast, or risk losing your mind to the unexplained horrors that lurk beyond the screens.

name: NOSE
short_description: An easy [climbing] game by a gentle author.

name: Lil' Guardsman
short_description: Imagine you're a 12 year old, suddenly in charge of the guard shed at the castle gate, where you decide if elves, goblins and 100+ other characters should be admitted. It's a wonderful combination of deduction, narrative and puzzle games.

name: The Lost Tape - Cellar
short_description: A psychological horror game in which you wake up in an unknown cellar with a VHS camera and a journal. In the narrated journal, the main character will be recording their thoughts. Your task will be to get out of the cellar.

name: Fractured Veil
short_description: Embrace the Aloha Spirit to chill in your choice of safe, social or PvP zones. Build with a quick craft and effortless building system. Take a killer risk into the jungle for greater rewards and endless exploration where you'll meet mutants and friendly vendors waiting to say Aloha

name: TryAndLove
short_description: A man's life is a life of pursuing love. The childish love of childhood sweethearts? White Moonlight's pure love? Ignorant of the astringent love of forbidden fruit? Blind love like a moth flying into a flame? True love that transcends the world? Act Ren Xing and make a willful choice.

name: Disaster Golf
short_description: Disaster Golf is a new, fast-paced take on golf that requires you to react on the fly. Experiment with many combinations of natural disasters to navigate the golf ball through wild and diverse courses as fast as you can!

name: Saga of the Moon Priestess
short_description: Explore a mystical world in classic top-down style and save the kidnapped prince! Saga of the Moon Priestess is a retro top-down action-adventure inspired by 8-bit and 16-bit classics.

name: 隔壁老王的退休生活
short_description: 游戏讲述了一名王姓退休人士帮助邻居解决各种问题，以及拯救地球的日常生活。故事由四个章节组成，全长大约1小时左右，包含少量解谜元素。（无代码无美术的零添加纯天然游戏。）

name: 天下統一SSB
short_description: 数多の群雄が割拠する戦国時代…… 。 この戦乱の世を治めるために、織田信長や武田信玄などの戦国大名に 成り代わって天下統一を目指す戦国シミュレーションゲーム。

name: Splurge
short_description: You and up to 7 of your friends must battle it out to become the ultimate splurge-lord. Fill up your tiles and splurge them in order to spread your colour and eliminate every other player. Watch out though, as after too long, the map will start to shrink. Happy splurging!

name: The Street 10
short_description: Caught in an infinite alley, look for Street 10 to find your way out.

name: JAILBREAKER
short_description: A punishing, one-button platformer about escaping prison. Test your skills and intellect as you ascend a tower of hand-crafted challenges. Jump, fly, slide up walls, float in bubbles and perform somersaults; all with the press of a single button. Reach the paramount. Reach.

name: Walls of Rust
short_description: Take command of humanity's last Mechs with a deck of cards, and control the hex-based gameboard to stop the spreading corruption. In this turn-based strategy game, each run is one continuous battle, so make every action count.

name: Anomaly Agent
short_description: ANOMALY AGENT is a cyberpunk action-platformer featuring fluid combat, a time-bending story, quirky characters and a catchy synthwave soundtrack! Punch or shoot through mobs of enemies, impact the story with your choices and stop the anomalies before the world plunges into chaos!

name: Writer's Rush
short_description: 24 writers, and you’re one of them. Challenge yourself to become the best writer in the world. Write books, create characters, choose endings, team up with rivals, answer letters from readers, and don’t let other authors beat you!

name: Quallet
short_description: Quallet is a game where you are a criminal in the land of Qualle, but be careful to not get caught by the police of Qualle!

name: CubeCubeRubik
short_description: CubeCubeRubik is a casual Rubik's Cube game with a simple and classic gameplay. If you are interested in the Rubik's Cube, want to challenge the limits of your speed or logic, or want your children to learn about the Rubik's Cube, you might as well give it a try.

name: 古龙风云录
short_description: 《古龙风云录》是一款大型武侠RPG，拥有古龙作品授权，还原古龙笔下武侠世界。玩家在武侠世界里探索百态江湖，体验超百万字剧情，奇遇各路豪侠，选择并养成你的伙伴，最终一起解开当年回雁峰谜团……

name: Persona 3 Reload
short_description: Dive into the Dark Hour and awaken the depths of your heart. Persona 3 Reload is a captivating reimagining of the genre-defining RPG, reborn for the modern era with cutting-edge graphics and gameplay.

name: Hawaii Detective: Killing of a Krypto King
short_description: 'Hawaii Detective: Killing of a Krypto King' is a Detective Mystery Visual Novel and Yuri Dating Sim where you play as Detective Laura Ko as she interrogates suspects, investigates clues and follows leads to solve this tropical tale. Maybe she even finds the woman of her dreams along the way too!

name: Memories Off
short_description: *This game is only available in Japanese, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese. 「メモリーズオフ」シリーズ1作目 1999年に登場した恋愛アドベンチャーゲーム「メモリーズオフ」をフルＨＤ移植。

name: Solace Inc.
short_description: A survivors-like about a time-travelling company where you recruit your employees against endless hordes of enemies.

name: Batsugun
short_description: Experience the epic conclusion of Toaplan's legendary shooter series with Batsugun including the lauded Special version! Choose your favorite character and spaceship in this thrilling genre-defining bullet-hell action. Now on PC with modern enhancements!

name: Energy Fighters
short_description: A modern retro inspired side scrolling shooter with a deep upgrade system and the ability to absorb enemy fire and also deflect it back to your enemies. A fast paced shooter that can be played solo or local co-op with 12 difficulty modes and lots of boss battles.

name: 永恒幻境 Eternal Dreamland
short_description: This is a third-person beautiful girl fighting zombie game. Elements such as shooting, changing clothes, and shelters are included. The heroine is a high school student in the countryside, in a constant cycle, looking for her former friends alone, and taking refuge in a small villa.

name: Granblue Fantasy: Relink
short_description: A grand adventure in the skies awaits! Form a party of four from a diverse roster of skyfarers and slash—or shoot or hex—your way to victory against treacherous foes in this action RPG. Take on quests solo or with the help of others in up to 4-player co-op play!

name: Twilight Oracle
short_description: Journey to a strange world in search of the fabled Oracle in this fantasy comedy point & click adventure. Play as Leo, a struggling student with the ability to breathe underwater, and explore a desert island and the depths of an alien ocean to uncover your school’s dark past.

name: My Recycling Center
short_description: Operate, configure and expand your own recycling center in this first-person simulator! Work fast and sort the trash. Use the compactors to destroy the bulky waste. Earn satisfaction and cash to buy new containers and unlock new trash types.

name: Under A Star Long Cold
short_description: You have 30 minutes to loot this place and pay your debts before the planet is destroyed. Intense stealth-action with permadeath. An exploration of agency and hope.

name: Balls of Steel
short_description: The Balls are Back! The legendary 90s pinball game Balls of Steel returns to PC in all of its radical retro glory. Play through 5 classic top-down pinball tables and two BRAND NEW tables in classic BoS Style! Get 7 awesome retro tables in one package, rebuilt to run on modern PC hardware!

name: The Great Rebellion
short_description: The Great Rebellion is a cyberpunk 2D sidescrolling run'n'gun roguelite using mouse/twinstick-shooter controls. It features randomly generated levels, multiple difficulty modes (including optional permadeath), a dynamic soundtrack and an upgradeable player character.

name: Goat's Tale Adventure
short_description: Step into the shoes of the new heroine and pursue the treasures in this exceptionally demanding adventure. Explore lands where only the most resilient players will reach the summit.

name: Find The Backdoor
short_description: Find the Backdoor is a single-player horror game. Go through different sinister levels in order to find the next backdoor. Survive those you meet and discover all the secrets. Will you manage to complete the game?

name: Murders on the Yangtze River
short_description: 'Murders on Yangtze River' is an Ace Attorney-like detective game that takes you on a journey through early 20th century China as you solve a series of intriguing cases. Use your logical reasoning and deduction skills to uncover clues, interrogate suspects, and solve the mysteries.

name: AstroPanic
short_description: AstroPanic is a top-down rogue-like 2D space game. Upgrade your ship by battling aliens, progress to new levels with the points you earn, and get ready for an exciting space adventure!

name: Clean Up After Your Dog
short_description: This parody RPG is about picking up your dog ploppy's in different locations.

name: The Cauldron Kids: The Summoning of Mr. Vermicelli
short_description: You're a 6 years old witch and today, you're home alone: turn the house upside-down, play games with your sister, race to other dimensions and bewitch your plushie in this charming short narrative RPG!

name: Don't Pee
short_description: You've woken up in the middle of the night and you've gotta pee. Get to the bathroom as fast as you can before you pee your pants.

name: Memories Off #5 Togireta Film
short_description: *This game is only available in Japanese, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese. 千羽谷大学の２年生「河合春人」は、映画作りという夢を目指して、小さな映画サークルに所属している。 だが春人は、１年前に親友「日名雄介」の死をきっかけに、その夢をあきらめかけていた。 そんな春人の前に突如現れた謎の女「仙堂麻尋」 彼女の登場で、「日名あすか」をはじめとする仲間たちとの間に、微妙な変化が訪れる……。 立ち止まったままの春人の胸にかけがえのない想いが宿るとき、途切れたフィルムは静かに回り出す。

name: Fixeight
short_description: Introducing FixEight, Toaplan's thrilling vertical run-and-gun game featuring eight peerless warriors with cutting-edge weapons. Embark on an exhilarating cosmic escapade with up to three players at once. Now on PC with modern extras!

name: Five elements for 24!
short_description: On that day, mankind remembered the fear of being dominated by the math Olympiad in primary school. 4 random numbers, 3 operations, get 24 points!

name: Hiddenverse: Kingdom Fall
short_description: In 'Hiddenverse: Kingdom Fall' it´s your task to help Tom save the life of Princess Sarah and restore order in the kingdom. Are the heroes ready to see the true face of the kingdom and how will they choose which side to take? Play over 100 ho and puzzle levels and help Tom save the kingdom.

name: Melon Madness
short_description: A relaxing and engaging fruit merge game! Combine fruit without spilling any out of the box, and try to get the highest score! Play alone or with a friend, in coop mode.

name: Nexus PI
short_description: In a reality stuck in a technologically unadvanced society stricken with the negative impacts of a worldwide climate disaster, you are a uniquely powered private investigator tasked with uncovering advanced technology from another reality with the potential to save your whole world.

name: Norgame. Город полярной ночи
short_description: Help the moon girl defeat the ancient monster that stole the sun. The action in a fabulous adventure puzzle game takes place in the scenery of the polar cities of Norilsk and Dudinka under the mysterious light of the Aurora borealis.

name: Block Hopper
short_description: A short 2D platformer meant to be enjoyed at your own pace and possibly annoy you with its challenges.

name: Skeleton War
short_description: Players will face a raging army of skeletons, through flexible and resourceful decision-making construction, with agile and athletic positioning, to deal with a variety of enemies of various attacks, through the challenges of the levels, and the BOSS narrowly meet, a showdown.

name: Dealer Simulator
short_description: Dealer Simulator invites you to a world where your bargaining skills will be tested to the limits, and you'll never know what lies behind each door. Are you ready to become a top-tier trader? Join the warehouse adventure with Dealer Simulator!

name: Chronique des Silencieux
short_description: Set in 1970s southern France, you play a rookie private eye tasked to dig out the secrets of a stubborn old man. Think on your feet while you follow your leads : ask questions to witnesses, detect their lies, hypothesize why and finally confront the silent ones running from their past.

name: Don't Wake Me Up
short_description: You’re trapped in a malfunctioning virtual reality with no memories—except of every video game you’ve ever played. Jack into a wild dream in cyberspace.

name: JOY OF PROGRAMMING - Software Engineering Simulator
short_description: Use real Python code to automate machines, robots, drones and more: Program self-driving vehicles; crack passwords; apply machine learning; automate logistics; use image processing to guide missiles. Gain real coding skills and solve exciting bite-sized programming challenges.

name: Omoide Ni Kawaru Kimi Memories Off
short_description: *This game is only available in Japanese, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese. なんとなく大学生になった主人公、「加賀正午」。 それなりに一人暮らしの大学生活を楽しんでいる一方で、彼は漠然とした憂鬱さを感じていた。 その原因は数年前、理由も告げず突然消えた恋人、「黒須カナタ」だった。 カナタとの唐突な別れは彼の心に大きな傷をつけていたのだ……。 それから数年後── 偶然にもカフェで再会するカナタと正午。 失ったと思っていたカナタとの再会で彼の心は乱れてしまう。

name: Hexseeker
short_description: Combine hexagons in the quest to find the 'F'. Discover tons of hype unlockables. Compete on numerous Steam leaderboards and enjoy over 20 achievements in this innovative 'increaser' style puzzle game. With mouse, keyboard, and game controller input!

name: Roads Of Rome: Portals 2 Collector’s Edition
short_description: Another adventure of Romans who lost in the mysterious portals while searching the way home.

name: Cave of Illusions: Twistyland
short_description: A surreal, atmospheric and vivid horror game about a mysterious board game and the little Sophie trapped inside it.

name: Purrfectly Hidden Cats - Kittenbay
short_description: Explore 'Purrfectly Hidden Cats - Kittenbay', where elusive felines await discovery in a day-and-night adventure. Find hidden cats, interact with locals, and unveil the charming secrets of Kittenbay!

name: Enspell
short_description: “Enspell” is deck building-RogueLike game based on a medieval fantasy where you unravel secrets and explore to seek treasures. While you fight against monsters in dangerous dungeons, you can collect relics and make your own deck.

name: Memories Off 2nd
short_description: *This game is only available in Japanese, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese. 主人公「伊波健」は、私立の高校に通う高校３年生。 ずっと変わらないと、信じていた。 半年前から交際している同級生の「白河ほたる」との幸せな状況も、２人の関係も。 しかし、ある出来事を境に変化が訪れる。 些細な誤解。すれ違う心……。 小さな変化は、やがて取り返しのつかないところまで膨らんで……。 そんな最中、２人の間にある数え切れぬほどの想い出を振り切ってでも、一緒にいたいと思える女性が現れたとしたら……。

name: ClickeRogue
short_description: Slay enemies using clicks, spells and get stronger by leveling up in endless dungeons !

name: Separated Worlds
short_description: Go to the dungeons and find out where it leads. On the way you will meet a lot of creatures from different worlds. Maybe we should find out where they came from ?

name: Lone Lamp
short_description: A point-and-click puzzle adventure

name: Legendary Hoplite
short_description: A combination of Action RPG and Tower Defense: slay monsters, find weapons, upgrade your armies, defend your base… Prevent humanity from extinction at the hands of monsters from Greek mythology and ancient tribes. Don't let them cross the gate, commander!

name: VR Driver School
short_description: Do you think taking a driver's license is very difficult! Especially subjects two and three are easy to fail! The unique driving test simulator makes it easy to learn and practice driving. It can effectively grasp the viewpoint and timing of turning the steering wheel.

name: Carnage Cuisine
short_description: You are a banana with a gun! Blast your way through hordes of evil cooks and machines in this survivors-like, action rogue-lite. Collect loot, unlock powerful skills, rally your food allies, and lead them to victory! If you fail, upgrade your character and skills, and rise stronger for the next run!

name: The Forgotten Tapes: Twisted Forms
short_description: The second collection in the widely received 'Forgotten Tapes' series, where we explore the theme of 'Body Horror' with 8 unique games from different developers. Explore a morgue after hours & experiment on 8 poor souls who have lost their way. Can you make it through the night?

name: Vimana
short_description: Uncover the magic of Indian mythology, unique power-ups, and an enchanting soundtrack in this electrifying space showdown. Toaplan's vertical co-op shooter Vimana debuts on PC, offering accessible, action-packed gameplay and modern enhancements!

name: Y. Village - The Visitors
short_description: Batu, tormented by nightmares, is lured to a nameless village via cryptic letters. Investigating the village's secrets with just one friend, he wakes one night to discover his ally gone. He must now locate his friend and elude the village's dark mysteries.

name: ALAA-MOGUS MUST DIE
short_description: This is a historical action game from 3rd person based on Yakut mythology. Alaa-Mogus the devil has come to seize our land! Uraankhai Sakha, let's take up our weapons and drive him back to the dungeon! Uruy-Aikhal!

name: Shards of Chaos
short_description: “Raising the blade over my dear friend, I could only curse this broken world with all my soul. Nothing to worry about... If my blade turns out to be the slower.” Shards of fate, heart and soul.

name: Galactic Breakout
short_description: Return to the classic with Galactic Breakout! This space-themed Arkanoid game challenges players to destroy diverse blocks to conquer each level. Unleash the power of 10 unique upgrades while dodging 10 debuffs. Overcome 75 thoroughly created levels and achieve the max game score

name: Dominoes Colors
short_description: Dominoes Colors It is a puzzle relaxing game where you need to mix colors when put each piece on board. The mix result is the next step to solve the puzzle. The piece with a chequered flag is the last piece, your last mix of colors needs to be equal of it.

name: INFECTED - Super Soldier Project
short_description: A police officer goes to investigate an old house where he hears reports of noises and screams, a team was sent before him and they didn't give any feedback, something macabre awaits this police officer.

name: Pru the Pigeon
short_description: Pru the Pigeon is a bite-sized 3D platformer with precise and expressive controls. Join Pru on adventures through charming levels, collecting various items for a nostalgic, fun-filled experience!

name: Pyrocast
short_description: An exciting 2D adventure game in which the player takes on the role of a pyromancer who has the powerful ability to create and control fire.

name: OG Puzzlers: Synthwave Cars
short_description: OG Puzzlers: Synthwave Cars is an hardcore puzzel game with cars in an stunning synthwave style. You have to assemble a single image from random generated indivdual pieces. Combine all of the smart singel frames into one big image and unlock the next level.

name: Satanislas
short_description: Gamble your lives in this fast-paced, hard-as-hell precision platformer, and overcome countless devilish traps across five realms of carefully handcrafted levels. Having trouble? Spend a few souls to gain formidable powers... Or handicap yourself with some curses.

name: Mothman
short_description: A 1-4 player CO-OP horror game, a nightmare from hell, it is your objective to hunt down a sinister demon known as Mothman. Underequipped you must search the landscape for resources. Lay bear traps, stalk from a distance, and stay quiet. You came to hunt, only to be hunted.

name: Hex Racer
short_description: Race through the asteroid belt, hit checkpoints to increase your score, Use power ups to help you. Game Modes include - Monthly event with leaderboard - Endless/practice - Split Screen - Story mode

name: UDO
short_description: A delicious arcade down-scroller roguelike where you dig into a creepy hole with an oversized drill!

name: Memorion
short_description: Memorion is a puzzle game in which you need to turn on all the orbs. Each orb you turn on changes the state of the adjacent orbs. Will you have the courage and the wits to turn on all the orbs and recover your memories? The answers lie within the depths of your own mind.

name: Sushi Bar "Moebius"
short_description: A physics puzzle game. When you put sushi on top of sushi, the sushi you make will flow down the lane. Feed the customers and keep them full! When they are full, the next customer will come. The game is over when the sushi is out of the box! Aim for a high score!

name: Russian Hut Simulator
short_description: An interactive tour of a traditional wooden hut.

name: Home Detective - Immersive Edition
short_description: With hi-tech tools, and snarky comments from your holographic assistant Steve, it's up to you to explore the crime scenes, piece together the clues, and find the perpetrator!

name: Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League
short_description: From the creators of Batman: Arkham, Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League is a genre-defying third-person action shooter where the ultimate band of misfits must do the impossible: Kill the Justice League.

name: Trinity Survivors
short_description: Select from a diverse roster of unique characters to assemble a trinity force and strategize to find the best skill combinations. Witness the astounding synergy that emerges. Engage in 2 player online cooperative multiplayer, team up with a friend to challenge orc hordes, and strive for high scores!

name: Corsairs Legacy - Pirate Action RPG & Sea Battles
short_description: Get ready for ‘Corsairs Legacy’. It’s an adventure in the Caribbean, the historical pirate life simulator. Sail the sea, engage in naval battles, and explore islands. Will you rise to become a legendary pirate or meet your end at the hands of your enemies? The choice is yours in ‘Corsairs Legacy’.

name: The Symbiant Re:Union
short_description: Take a deep dive into Danya’s and Brahve’s heat and romance in The Symbiant Re:Union. The events take place after two Endings of The Symbiant’s main game.

name: Memories Off Yubikiri No Kioku
short_description: *This game is only available in Japanese, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese. 今年もここ、神奈川県藤川市にある藤林高等学校にも春が訪れた。 教室の窓から差し込む暖かい日差しにまどろみながら「芹澤 直樹」はいつも願う。 ｢ちなつは、なおくんの嫁なのです！」 そんなことを恥ずかしげもなく言える幼なじみの「天川 ちなつ」や学校の仲間たちと、ずっと楽しく過ごせればいいのに──。 しかし、その願いは唐突に打ち砕かれる。 突如として現れた謎の少女「南雲 霞」 そして始まった霞と秘密の同棲生活。

name: Chushpan Simulator
short_description: A game in which you have to go from an insignificant person to the king of the world

name: Rite of Eris
short_description: Rite of Eris is a survival roguelike inspired by the likes of Vampire Survivors, Hades, and more. Unlock new characters, each with their own unique abilities, then jump into battle, unlocking powerful abilities along the way to aid your conquest against hordes of enemies.

name: NO RELOADING: Survival Trials
short_description: NO RELOADING: Survival Trials is a stylish rogue-lite in a homebrewed video game, where your best doggo plays as dungeon master! You're Roger, armed with tractor beam limbs and 90s nostalgia, ready to slay simulants and look cool while doing it! Challenge yourself further in STREAMER MODE!

name: Half-demon Kamia
short_description: Immerse yourself in a 3D single-player game, set in an expansive boxed world. Embark on a journey as a being torn between humanity and demonic heritage.

name: Schrodinger's Cat Experiment (SCE)
short_description: Get ready for a gaming experience in Schrodinger's Cat Experiment that combines brain-teasing puzzles with enchanting aesthetics and feline charm. Dead or alive? The cat's fate is in your hands.

name: Departed Away
short_description: Discover 'Departed Away,' a captivating visual novel where friendship intertwines with mystery. Uncover secrets, engage in verbal duels, and make choices that shape your story. Delve into emotional depth and intricate connections in this unique story.

name: Memories Off 6 T-wave
short_description: *This game is only available in Japanese, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese. 神奈川県澄空市────。 秋は深まり、枯葉が道を彩っている。 ｢塚本志雄」は、幼なじみの「遠峯りりす」と歩く通学路でしみじみと思い起こしていた。 後から付いてくる感じだった幼い頃のりりす。 しかし、数年の間を経て再会したりりすは随分と我侭になっていた。 そして、志雄はいつしか下僕のような扱いに……。 その日、同級生の「箱崎智紗」をりりすに紹介される。 地味だった智紗は、大胆にイメージチェンジをしていた。

name: Memories Off Sorekara
short_description: *This game is only available in Japanese, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese. 浜咲学園に通う高校3年生「鷺沢一蹴」 彼には同学年の彼女、「陵いのり」がいた。 何もかも順調だった。 しかし、それは唐突に訪れる……。 卒業も間近に控えた雨の日のバレンタインデー……。 いのりからデートに誘われた一蹴は、いのりから告白された想い出の場所に連れて行く。 そこで渡されるチョコレートと一緒に渡されたのは…… いのりからの一方的な別れ話。 果たして別れの訳は……一蹴といのりの関係は……！？

name: Empty Skull
short_description: 'Empty Skull' is a pixelated indie puzzle game with RPG elements that revolves around a skeleton trying to recollect its life.

name: Speed Crew
short_description: Arrange a pit crew of 1-4 members and, amidst total chaos, secure the gold in 4 decades of racing championships against the mighty Dominion Torrento. Retro vibes and buckets of stress blend in this friendship-testing party game, where you fix stylish sports cars in both local and online co-op.

name: 妄想大碰撞 Fantasy Clash
short_description: 《Fantasy clash》is an innovative real-time strategy fantasy game with hundreds of skills and flexible AIs for a battle of wits and strategies!

name: Dungeon Legends 2 : Tale of Light and Shadow
short_description: Dungeon Legends 2 is the ultimate old-school RPG dungeon crawler with a modern look. Explore a world of magic and danger, engaging in dynamic AI-supported dialogues with NPCs. Develop your character, find 700 items, and battle 30 types of enemies in this epic 15-hour adventure!

name: MyMustache
short_description: 'My Mustache' is a narrative game that tells a story about childhood.

name: Love n Life: Lucky Teacher
short_description: After the pandemic Covitch69, you lost your job as a space aviation expert and now become a teacher in a small town. Luckily, every cloud has a silver lining as you are stepping into a world where love blooms unexpectedly and leads you to captivating ladies with immersive romantic tales.

name: Dark is the Void
short_description: Dark is the Void is a combat focused JRPG-inspired roguelike featuring fast paced, menu-driven battles. Build, level-up, and optimize your party of four from a mix of 24 distinctly unique classes. The game blends in MMO threat mechanics and class roles for intense tactical battles.

name: Cards Survivors
short_description: Cards Survivors is a unique mix of card games, action games and roguelikes. Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, discover relics of immense power, and survive as long as you can!

name: Tiger Heli
short_description: Take off on a classic arcade journey with Tiger-Heli, Toaplan's pioneering vertical shooter that set the stage for an entire genre. Now available on PC with a host of modern upgrades!

name: Jujutsu Kaisen Cursed Clash
short_description: Master the Jujutsu of your favorite Sorcerers and Cursed Spirits! Bring a friend and dive into the world of JUJUTSU KAISEN in this action-packed, 2-on-2 fighting game!

name: Ludicrous Leap
short_description: Fast-Paced, Level-Based 3D Platformer - Jump, Dodge, Climb, and Run! Try to beat the Bronze, Silver, and Gold times for each level (if you can even beat the levels at all)!

name: Boxes: Lost Fragments
short_description: As a legendary thief, your next assignment lures you into a grand and lavish mansion. There you find a series of puzzle boxes, designed for an unknown purpose. What should have been a quick in-and-out, gradually turns into your own harrowing struggle for freedom and answers.

name: Until It’s Undone: Unmastered
short_description: A forgotten oldie returns with a full makeover. Control some lost idiot by typing commands. Unmake puzzles to progress. Bump into several lovely weirdos along the way. Discover a wonderland of disturbing nonsense and industrial amounts of sarcasm.

name: Purrs in Heaven
short_description: ‘Purrs in Heaven’ is a challenging platform game. Using the power of a sacred talisman, the poor Lanna can create echoes of herself to reach inaccessible platforms, solve puzzles and continue her mission to defeat the guardians of her soul.

name: super bad hero
short_description: The game uses physics engines, bullet time, and many parody types of enemies, such as sirens, toilet people, gun demons, superheroes emitting laser light, etc. It is a bit like the 3D version of 'Metal Slug' or the gun version of 'Blade and Sorcery', which is very exciting and interesting.

name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Justice
short_description: Become a vampire. Strike from the darkness and drink the blood of your prey. Use stealth, persuasion, and an arsenal of upgradable abilities to sneak past enemies undetected or punish the guilty in the seedy backstreets of nighttime Venice.

name: Terror Mansion
short_description: Terror Mansion is an exciting first person Horror video game that catapults you into a frightening Mansion. Your main objective is to escape the infested Mansion, finding objects and challenging riddles while exploring incredible scenarios.

name: The Krampus
short_description: A realistic third-person horror set in the 1800s. Play as brave children escaping Krampus. Navigate diverse levels, including Krampus' workshop and a haunting Victorian home. Choose to brave the nightmare solo or team up with a friend in online co-op. Run, hide, and find your way to survival

name: Touchdown Pinball
short_description: Score some touchdowns and win the game in the most entertaining Pinball!

name: 黄毛漂流记
short_description: You encountered a storm at sea and unexpectedly arrived at this small island. On this island, you can start a new life through activities like planting, construction, fishing, and more. Experience the storyline with various NPCs as you join the team to build and develop the small island!

name: Murder Is Game Over: Deal Killer
short_description: Murder Is Game Over: Deal Killer takes you on an immersive journey through the Italian Alps. Unravel the murder mystery amidst an alpine backdrop, exploring opulent settings and unmasking the killer in this thrilling detective game.

name: Slot Shots Pinball Ultimate Edition
short_description: Thirteen awesome pinball tables and its Steam Deck compatible at 60 FPS. The newer tables feature bigger playfields, better physics, better graphics, better special effects, better camera angles, longer soundtracks, full controller support, online leaderboards, and more slot machine shots!

name: Border Bots VR
short_description: As a human border agent, you begin a new role as a booth operator at an AI travel border. Interact and check over a variety of robots as they try to get through security.

name: Desert Kingdoms
short_description: Desert Kingdoms is a minimal real time strategy game. Protect your king and conquer the desert.

name: Beacon of Havoc
short_description: Post-apocalyptic city builder, where you Build, Defend, and Thrive in a desolate landscape overrun by enemy attacks. Manage resources, production and manufacturing to expand your settlement.

name: Hoverkitty In The Hoververse Chapter Three
short_description: In this 3D game, you can play as either Hoverkitty or Hoverflea, which means you have multiple ways of completing a level. This has aspects of an adventure, first-person shooter. You will meet enemies, such as the Hoverkitty Hunters, and also new allies.

name: Star Shift Rebellion
short_description: Infernis Prime is a mining colony in the Outer Rim, under brutal occupation. With the help of a hacked android and the discovery of a dark secret, the rebels finally have a chance. This is the story of how the Outer Rim Coalition formed, and how they broke free...

name: Beetle Nest
short_description: Try yourself as a commander in the new Rogue-lite shooter with a top view! Upgrade your clones, explore planets, unlock new weapons and costumes. Don't let the waves of hostile creatures defeat you!

name: What if your girl was a frog 2
short_description: The girl looked longingly at the thick rain. She dreamed of the creatures she loved so much. Frogs are different, green and yellow, big and small, but one thing is for sure, they are so cute! The girl made up her mind and ran through the rain in the direction of her dream!

name: Limsod
short_description: Limsod is an FPS set in a post-apocalyptic universe in which you must fight for survival in a world infested with flesh-eating zombies. Upgrade your equipment and play in a variety of maps and game modes.

name: Digital Eclipse Arcade: Q.P.I.D.
short_description: Rescue cats! Collect hearts! Defy the laws of physics! Q.P.I.D. is part platformer, part physics puzzler, part race against the clock. Did we mention the cats?

name: Oberty
short_description: Oberty is a puzzle game where you XOR-blending shapes.

name: Market Simulator
short_description: You've embarked on a journey to acquire your dream market and have finally reached your goal. Now, manage your market to offer friendly service to the neighborhood! Provide a range of products, from beverages to food, cleaning items to electronics, meeting community needs.

name: Dead Hook
short_description: Dead Hook is an explosive mix of rogue-like and shooter genre with brutal combat and captivating storytelling. Explore the elder planet Resaract and take on the role of Adam Stone, a mercenary, smuggler, thief, and devoted husband.

name: MIX IT!
short_description: Embark on an educational space odyssey in Mix It!, a captivating Astropilot training adventure. Master the physics of light through dynamic gameplay, stunning visuals, and award-winning sound design. Explore, learn, and conquer the universe in this genre-defying educational experience.

name: CLeM
short_description: CLeM is a narrative-driven puzzle adventure game with a dark twist. Wake up in a world where puzzles intertwine with exploration, weaving a unique narrative rooted in alchemy. A voice awakens you. It gives you purpose. To guide you, you find a notebook with mysterious entries and a house to explore.

name: Republic of Jungle
short_description: Gather your friends (5 to 10 players) and play as advisors to President Puma. His re-election depends on your loyalty. In a social deduction party game, Leakers try to sneak into missions to leak Puma's secrets- Loyalists try to suss them out. Read the room and bluff your way to a political victory.

name: HELLDIVERS™ 2
short_description: The Galaxy’s Last Line of Offence. Enlist in the Helldivers and join the fight for freedom across a hostile galaxy in a fast, frantic, and ferocious third-person shooter.

name: Failed Trust
short_description: In 'Failed Trust', you explore a mysterious technical center where you are sent to retrieve important documents. Immerse yourself in the world of technology, collect energy and solve puzzles to uncover the secrets of this mysterious place.

name: MindKatt
short_description: Action and stealth game set in a dystopian world. Engage in strategic and challenging combat, facing off against ranged or melee opponents. Master the art of stealth and the environment to avoid detection. Levels will vary with different activities.

name: Hunt Together
short_description: Feel the thrill of a hunt in a 1v1 Duel or up to 1v3 Hide and Seek mode that will push your wits, perceptiveness, and courage to their very limits. Employ an array of items, triggers, and skills fit to your class to outsmart and defeat your foe - a terrifying Ghost or a dauntless, vigilant Hunter.

name: Sukfaristo
short_description: Discover Sukfaristo, a captivating puzzle game where you combine animals to harvest their precious juice. With unique physics-based gameplay and stimulating challenges, dive into a cute and addictive adventure!

name: Spheric Bombs
short_description: Explore an explosive world of strategy and reflection in this 3D turn-based tactical puzzle game! Guide a bomb through 25 unique levels, combining puzzle and tactics. Immerse yourself in a relaxing and stimulating experience, balanced between relaxation and reflection.

name: Tire Friend
short_description: Tire Friend: A friendly platformer!

name: Shanghai Summer
short_description: Shanghai Summer is an adventure game set in the millennium. Our protagonist, Baichuan, goes through a series of 'anomalies' over the length of twelve days. In his pursuit of the truth, he found that his hopes and regrets from the past finally seem to converge. Will he be able to 'fix' it for good?

name: ForkJump
short_description: A dark, third-person, open-world exploration game set in a sci-fi environment. Dodge dangers, jumping fork monsters and fork-jump-scares. Master parkour and teleportation to discover secret areas and Forks, delving into the mystery of the Fork obsession and aiming to become the ultimate giga cyborg.

name: 平面星舰：银河前线 Plane Starship:Galactic Frontline
short_description: This is a roguelike game which is minimalist (crossed it out) which has no money for art. The player needs to play as a fleet commander, commanding the fleet to travel to a galaxy bathed in war, purifying the dangerous enemies entrenched in it, and saving your people from fire and water.

name: Burrito Bear
short_description: Burritos are raining from the sky - Bear wants to eat them, but colliding with dangerous falling garbage causes serious gas! Before indigestion strikes, Bear needs your help to eat them all!

name: Small War
short_description: You need to choose your camp and build the building! Build combat units through barracks and factories, and then manipulate combat units to destroy enemy bases!

name: KONOSUBA - God's Blessing on this Wonderful World! Love For These Clothes Of Desire!
short_description: It's time for a Visual Novel Quest with a twist! Join Kazuma, a reincarnated adventurer, and spend turbulent days with his unfortunate party members. Prepare for waifus, dress-up and resource management and get ready for an Isekai comedy that’s out of this world!

name: The Isle of Elanor
short_description: You wash ashore on The Isle of Elanor, the last bastion of humanity remaining in the world. The situation on the island is grim. You're given a small plot of land. Can you help humanity survive?

name: Boldly Forward
short_description: Join a roguelike battle immediately, where you need to recruit human warriors, activate bonds, purchase divine equipment, and form a powerful combat team. Facing waves of growing undead, elf, and orc teams, lead your warriors to charge happily and enjoy the fun of electronic cricket fighting!

name: Touhou Danmaku Kagura Phantasia Lost
short_description: A rhythm game in which players can play popular arrangements of Touhou Project songs. A rebuild of 'Touhou Danmaku Kagura' as a stand-alone version with a completely new storyline.

name: OFFROAD MotorBike VR
short_description: Get ready for an immersive offroad experience! Conquer challenging tracks and leave your competition in the dust with Offroad MotorBike VR on Steam. With realistic physics, stunning graphics, and VR technology, Download now and kickstart your offroad adventure!

name: The Inquisitor
short_description: Jesus did not die on the cross, but came down and unleashed vengeance on all the nonbelievers. 1500 years later, an army of Inquisitors brutally enforce the faith. In this dark fantasy adventure you solve intricate cases and unveil abysmal secrets as Inquisitor Mordimer Madderdin.

name: Hua Mulan: A Chinese Learning Adventure
short_description: Travel back in time to help defend Hua Mulan against evil time bandits all while learning Chinese in this story-driven, role-playing, open 3D world episodic adventure.

name: OuterRealm
short_description: Play as a Elite soldier in ironclad atomic power armor, collect powerful weapons, crush endless waves of voidborn horrors and step into the realm portal, to finish their demigod masters. An old school FPS,collect items,unlock powerful upgrades,kill boss,find exits,and endless mode.

name: Grieve
short_description: This is a single player, action based thirdperson shooter. where the player travels to different mini openworld type locations to clear out enemy bases and gather intel

name: ULTRATORO
short_description: Drive at full speed in donut-shaped worlds. Your car is a hacking device and your mission is to destroy the biggest megacorporation on the planet. Experience an adrenaline filed arcade-like experience in the story mode or unleash your creativity with the level editor and community made maps.

name: IFU
short_description: IFU is a psychological horror about a young guy who is forcibly locked in an abandoned mansion of a dead surgeon along with his restless soul.

name: WitchHand
short_description: You're a witch, leading your coven into new, unfriendly lands. Use the cards you find to build and expand your civilization. Befriend the local covens or use their bones to fuel your spells. Gather your familiars, the witching hour is nigh.

name: Hentai Clicker
short_description: Hentai clicker is your ultimate idle hentai game where you have to satisfy your waifu and dress her up as you please ;)

name: Fairy Treasure
short_description: Gorgeous original brick-breaking game with tons of new fun bricks and amazing power-ups never seen before!

name: Hook Line & Sinker
short_description: Catch fish, earn gold and defeat the Sea Lords to escape the Island! A top down shooter with a fishing twist. With your trusty hook you will dash and swing in the ocean, throw bombs and fight your way out to victory.

name: Van Gogh's Masterpiece Jigsaw Puzzles
short_description: 'Explore the artistic style of Van Gogh in 'Van Gogh's Masterpiece Jigsaw Puzzles.' Solve intricate puzzles, unlock Steam Achievements, and immerse yourself in a world inspired by a legendary painter.'

name: Night Feeder
short_description: Night Feeder is a bullet heaven where you embody the monstrosity of darkness. Choose a deity to bless your run. Battle foes, upgrade your gear, and summon minions on a journey shaped by destiny.

name: Acapella Master
short_description: Dive into the world of vocal creativity! This unique music game lets you record and create your own acapellas using a webcam and microphone.

name: O Holy Knight
short_description: Master the art of formation and lead your medieval squad in strategic battles. Command, level up, and triumph over monstrous waves in this thrilling roguelite adventure!

name: Souls : "위령"
short_description: The souls are imprisoned in the mansion. Free them. Then you too can live.

name: Project Hybrid
short_description: In Project Hybrid, you'll find yourself ensnared, desperately seeking an escape while unraveling the enigma of your surroundings and the mysterious circumstances that brought you here.

name: Bullion - The Curse of the Cut-Throat Cattle
short_description: A frantic brawler for 1-4 players with a cast of bovine buccaneers and a unique blend of PvP and co-op gameplay: grab the most loot and stab your friends.... but be sure to keep at least one crewmate alive as you battle to become the sole survivor of the Curse of the Cut-Throat Cattle!

name: And the Hero Was Never Seen Again
short_description: The Demon King lies defeated at the Hero's hand, but the Hero himself has changed... in more ways than one!

name: Timeshift
short_description: A unique take on 2D platformers. Use your momentum and warping abilities to escape the Rift!

name: Spectator 2
short_description: Spectator 2 – now with Single and Coop mode! Brace yourself for new levels of atmospheric terror and captivating surveillance, you'll face even more dangerous events as you carefully monitor cameras and report any suspicious occurrences.

name: EcoGenesis
short_description: EcoGenesis is a 2D black-box ecosystem simulator where you need to craft an ecosystem that can withstand the test of time. You must unlock creatures and balance your environment while driving towards one of the three victory conditions in this turn-based simulation.

name: Jax: History Repeats Itself
short_description: Jax: History Repeats Itself is an exciting horror game. Inspired by other animatronic-mascot-horror games, this game follows the story of Ernel, a young man hired as a security guard, and his adventure throughout his mandatory 5 nights at Jax's Burgers.

name: Arms Trade Tycoon: Tanks
short_description: Arms Trade Tycoon: Tanks is a unique combination of tank design and tycoon game. It puts you in charge of an arms trading company specialized in tanks from WWI to the modern era. Research, design, sell and follow your tanks in battle to make your own history!

name: Finding Anastasia
short_description: Finding Anastasia is a 3D first person horror game. You have to find missing girlfriend Anastasia.

name: Dungeonoid 2 Awakening
short_description: Classic dungeon crawling gets a block-busting twist in Dungeonoid 2 Awakening, a top-down adventure presented in retro pixel art style!

name: Solar Serpent Squadron
short_description: Solar Serpent Squadron is a survivor bullet heaven game with snake-like movement. You will build your snake 'body' as weapons, and destroy hundreds of enemies swarm coming right at you!

name: Noxium
short_description: Welcome to your new job mining Noxium for a sketchy business. Keep the power on and everything should be fine.

name: Space Garbage
short_description: Do you like Tetris? Doesn't matter. Space Garbage is here to rotate Tetris 90 degrees on its head and add a little car to it. Blast and stack your way to the top of the leaderboard with this farm-to-table, indie, retro, solo, arcade... experience!

name: MY ANIMA BOY
short_description: A short visual novel depicting the struggles and romantic entanglements of a composer attempting to write lyrics for the first time in his life. It's a BL (Boys' Love) story.

name: Airhead
short_description: Help a small body save a head-like organism full of air, from a leak that threatens its life. Explore their Metroidvania-style world and overcome challenging environmental puzzles to find the key to the head's survival.

name: DINOS vs ROBOTS
short_description: DINOS vs ROBOTS - Robots from the Future time travel to the Present to fight Dinos from the Past.

name: SpellRogue
short_description: SpellRogue is a turn-based, deckbuilding roguelike where you cast powerful spells using your Mana Dice, gain legendary artifacts, upgrade your spells and experiment with potent combinations to annihilate the Voidwalkers corrupting the world.

name: A Nutritious Boyfriend
short_description: Amazing! You have just started a new position as a professional trainer at the prestigious Squirrel Fitness Club, a club for dedicated squirrels! Motivate and coach squirrel members until you stumble upon love with fun obstacles along the way.

name: PERIOD SURVIVAL
short_description: 큰 상금을 노리고 목숨을 거는 예능에 출연하게 된 6년차 가수 헤일리. 과연 그는 이 곳에서 우승하고 상금을 얻을 수 있을까요? PERIOD SURVIVAL은 배틀을 통해 '변종' 출연자를 찾아내는 마피아 방식의 추리 어드벤처 게임입니다.

name: Runestone:Pathfinders
short_description: 'Runestone: Pathfinder' is a 3D adventure platformer game set in the world of Runestone. Players will play as a rookie pathfinder and help the rookie get through his first trial.

name: Zapper: One Wicked Cricket
short_description: In this action-adventure game, Zapper (a cricket) hops his way through six worlds in a quest to find his brother, held captive by the evil magpie queen. Dangerous traps and even more dangerous enemies await! It will take skill and timing to conquer all the worlds and survive the final showdown.

name: Telvoikai
short_description: You've been tasked with collecting data on an alien planet. Choose between exploring the jungle tropics or navigating deep into the bioluminescent sea.

name: Library Fantasy
short_description: You are a powerful sorcerer working in a vast library of magic known as Fantasia. You need to unravel its secrets and restore order. Fantasia was known for its unparalleled collections of magical books, artifacts and knowledge, but in recent days, something has gone wrong.

name: Sifting Thyme
short_description: An otome visual novel where you choose your romance with an attractive boy in culinary school. A perfectly delectable romance for foodies.

name: Area 51 : Beyond The Wall
short_description: Join the top-secret mission to defend Area 51, the world's most enigmatic military base. With fast paced action, realistic combat, and a dynamic environment, 'Area 51: Beyond the Wall' will immerse you in a thrilling and challenging experience. Play now and see if you have what it takes!

name: Seven Bullets Horror 7発の弾丸ホラー
short_description: In this game, players have seven bullets to defeat monsters. Use bullets wisely and aim for head shots. It is also possible to avoid being found by the monsters. The game ends when the player is attacked. To clear the game, the player must find three tools and reach the goal.

name: Delivery Boy
short_description: Become the best courier in Crystal City and build your own delivery business. Explore a big city, complete tasks, collect resources and build your own delivery services.

name: Inspection
short_description: A Single Player, First Person Horror Experience within a mysterious corporate bunker. Play as a military inspector and uncover the secrets the corporation is hiding while safeguarding your own survival against the robotic mysteries lurking deep within the facilities confines.

name: Supermarket Times
short_description: Prepare to enter the supermarket! Supermarket Times is a surreal comedy point-and-click shopping simulator. Complete legendary supermarket tasks: buy alcohol for the teenagers, stamp on the rat, and hit a seagull with a rock. Chat to the local hoi polloi, and buy the products of your wildest dreams!

name: They Can Hear Us
short_description: 'They Can Hear Us,' the first episode, narrates horror stories that interact with you through the microphone, playing on the fear of whoever is listening.

name: I Wani Hug that Gator!
short_description: I Wani Hug that Gator! Is a choice-driven narrative about teenagers struggling to find their way. Help Inco, loser highschooler extraordinaire, navigate his budding friendships (and romance!) while surviving being the only human in a dinosaur-filled school.

name: Knight's Saga Evil Goblins
short_description: Knight's Saga: Evil Goblins is an exciting fantasy game where the world has been invaded by evil goblins and you take on the role of a brave warrior on a dangerous journey to destroy them. Exciting adventures and battles await you in the name of saving the kingdom.

name: Traveler Eternal Night
short_description: In the game 'Traveler: Eternal Night' you will embody a brave fighter who goes on a dangerous journey to destroy the evil that threatens the world. You have to explore different locations, fight monsters and complete quests to become stronger.

name: OPERATION TEMPLE
short_description: You have to take on the role of a mercenary going on a dangerous mission, you are sent to an abandoned city to restore magical totems and destroy enemy invaders.

name: 所谓侠客 So-called Hero
short_description: In the game ,you can choose born in different family: Poor ,or Rich, or Strong, or So-called Evil. Then, do what you want in this complex WuXia world.

name: DarkLight: Platformer
short_description: Welcome to the world of DarkLight: Platformer, where adventure and fun await you at every step. This exciting 2D platformer promises you an unforgettable journey through 150 unique levels and five diverse biomes.

name: Hero Tale
short_description: Explore medieval fantasy island in idle RPG with rogue-like elements. Grind to gain experience, train your skills and fight more and more difficult enemies to unlock new maps and drop best loot. Strategize your growth when choosing your path on massive skill tree.

name: Search of the Source
short_description: Search of the Source is an exciting role-playing game in which you take on the role of a young squire venturing into a dangerous and mysterious magical forest. You have to complete many different tasks, explore mysterious places and fight mystical enemies.

name: Worldcrusher - a survival clicker game
short_description: Travel in space and scrap other planets to rebuild your own homeworld in this simple clicker RPG.

name: Godsvivors
short_description: Prepare for epic battles between gods and Hades in this top-down action roguelite! Choose your deity, unleash powerful combos, and fight against underworld enemies. Feel the adrenaline for 15 minutes and restore order in the underworld.

name: Crayon Computer
short_description: Crayon Computer is a 2D physics-based open-ended programming puzzle game. (if you call that programming)

name: Herbal Hunter
short_description: Herbalist simulator, explore the mountains and collect collectibles.

name: Circle Hitter
short_description: It looks casual, but it's hardcore. This is a mouse-controlled bullet arcade game, move the mouse to dodge bullets, click the mouse to bounce bullets and destroy enemies, unlock more characters and abilities, and constantly challenge for higher scores and rankings!

name: 风岬-The Everlasting lovestory at the Windcap
short_description: 被世界抛弃的我，被时间遗忘的她。 因为孤独而彼此吸引，因为不幸而互相依偎。 两人编织的幸福童话，最终化作绝望的诅咒。

name: Crush Link TD
short_description: Protect your inbox from spam to find a message from your crush. A Tower Defense game with new mechanics in virtual setting about online dating.

name: Lords of Exile
short_description: Embark on a quest for revenge in Lords of Exile, an 8-bit side-scrolling action platformer set in the far Lands of Exilia. With classic retro mechanics and linear level design in 8-bit graphics.

name: Champy the Useless Vampire
short_description: Join Champy, the useless vampire, in this charming 2D point-and-click adventure with hand-drawn environments and funny puzzles. Embark on an adventure amongst a cult of vampire hunters, a giant octopus and zombie animals. Will Champy find a way to save Dracula before it's too late?

name: GUNVOLT RECORDS Cychronicle
short_description: A new rhythm music game starring the songstresses of the Azure Striker Gunvolt series, Lumen, Lola, and Luxia singing 15 different songs. Follow the notes to the pounding beat and aim for a top score in this electrifying rhythm game!

name: Spirit Hunter: Death Mark II
short_description: Spirit Hunter: Death Mark II is a suspense-horror game set at a prestigious academy. When rumors circulate about supernatural occurrences at the famed Konoehara Academy in Tokyo’s H City, it’s up to the head of the Kujou family, also known as the “Spirit Doctor,” to take on the case.

name: Hope is Gone
short_description: A retro-style first-person horror game set in a dark, decaying parallel dimension where people from our world are not welcome.

name: Tether
short_description: Grab, climb, and swing through rock-climbing gyms in Tether, a unique multiplayer platformer for you and your friends!

name: Arrowstorm Ascendant
short_description: Defeat hordes of dragons and wyverns using your outstanding elvish archery skills. Create the most insane combination of upgrades and get your name into the leaderboards, showcasing all your might and glory!

name: The Tale of (Your Name)
short_description: Embark on a procedurally generated dungeon, make choices to craft your own narrative. Select your hero and confront monsters, solve puzzles, and make decisions that shape your unique story as you play.

name: Goat Simulator 3
short_description: Pilgor's baaack! Gather your herd and venture forth into Goat Simulator 3; an all-new (at least on Steam), totally realistic, sandbox farmyard experience.
