Invite up to three friends in local or online co-op, create carnage as a team, or compete in mini-games and then not be friends anymore.

name: White Sands
short_description: As a commander of the Union, a semi state organization with military and research potential, your goal is to help humanity rebuild. Modern military technology will give you an edge over the bandits, but the task will be far from an easy one.

name: Arzette: The Jewel of Faramore
short_description: A NEW interactive animated adventure! In this action-adventure game, Arzette must explore the Kingdom of Faramore, slay fearsome foes, acquire powerful items, discover secrets, assist colorful characters, and defeat the evil Daimur!

name: Sisyphus Paradox
short_description: Sisyphus Paradox is a fusion of roguelike tactical elements with classic side-scrolling shoot 'em up gameplay. Explore and fight your way across the galaxy as you try to get back home to Earth in this hand drawn indie game.

name: 天行镖客 (Sky Escort)
short_description: Sky Escort is a rogue-like card game featuring TD and management. Players roleplay an airborne mercenary,escorting clients' cargo to earn rewards. Buildcard decks, recruit crew members, and customize arms to enrich gameplay. Multiple factions can be chose from, each with unique combat style.

name: Telmari
short_description: Help Telmari save her Sunflowers on her journey to the Demon Tree, on this precision platformer with your catastic companion. Face over 100 hand-crafted levels where your skill and patience will be tested as you explore the world of Agra.

name: Iragon
short_description: An Erotic RPG Game with a story about magical girls, elves, and a bisexual sorceress.

name: FROGUE
short_description: Frogue is a stylish turn-based action platformer with bits of roguelite, bullet hell and time manipulation. Dash through your enemies, freeze time and throw your sword to solve every situation in YOUR way.

name: さーきゅらーディフェンス!!～とある辺境惑星開拓事務所、３０日の記録～
short_description: ”Sacular Defense' is a real-time tower defense game in which you intercept enemies by placing circles around them to prevent them from hitting the planet in the center of the screen. Strengthen your turrets and defend your planet from the endless enemies!

name: Villager's Hideout
short_description: Hide and seek, tower defense and party game mix of genres, gather resources and defend your base or attack bases and hunt other players

name: Arcane Chaos
short_description: Immerse yourself in Arcane Chaos, the ultimate magic-fueled roguelike. Mastering chaotic spells to vanquish endless waves of foes. Level up, enhance your powers, and experiment with fusing spells to unlock a myriad of potent combinations. Can you navigate the relentless chaos and emerge victorious?

name: Hi Eggplant:The Birth of Sprites
short_description: This is an original planting experience game. Players can grow high-quality eggplants through reasonable physical distribution, careful observation and accumulated experience. The newly added task system will make you busier than before, but when you are free, go chat with the sprites!

name: Cipher Monk
short_description: Cipher Monk is a game about a numeric system made by the cistercian monks in the 13th century. Your goal is to use this numeric system to give the answer needed and solve the puzzles.

name: Survivorman VR The Descent
short_description: A gripping reality-based survival simulator set in the Canadian Arctic with Survival expert Les Stroud. After narrowly surviving a helicopter crash in the mountains, use your skills, smarts and creativity to battle the elements and save your own life, before you freeze to death or worse...

name: A Void Shaper
short_description: Shape the void with the power of your cursor! A Void Shaper is an arcade game about avoiding shapes and killing them, while you collect upgrades. Unlock new enemy shapes and upgrades as you progress through the game and complete your collection.

name: Monument village
short_description: Monument village is a peaceful turn-based medieval city-builder. Optimize the placement of each building to grow your village while fulfilling mandatory resource requests. When you are ready, gather workers and materials and build the monument of your dream.

name: Cat Search in Feudal Japan
short_description: The cats are hiding all over this Japanese city! Can you find them all? Sit back, relax, and explore this beautiful hand drawn Japanese city.

name: Epstein
short_description: Survive a mysterious island and thwart the sinister plans of Jefry in 'Epstein'. Battle the blood-dependent morbiders and forge alliances with other survivors to confront Jefry in his grand temple. Master survival tactics and strategic gameplay in this intense adventure.

name: 梗过100关
short_description: 梗过100关是一款玩梗与爬塔乱结合的割草游戏，你作为魅魔挑战100层关卡，在战斗中可以体验到不同的“梗文化”收获快乐。在不断的战斗中提高自己达成挑战。

name: Unknown Signal
short_description: Unknown Signal is a 3D adventure game. You have received a mysterious signal and you have to find out what or who sent it.

name: Ninja Frogs
short_description: The frog village needs your help to fight against evil mutant alligators.

name: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor
short_description: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor is a single player survivor-like auto-shooter. Wield the full arsenal of Deep Rock Galactic, take on hordes of lethal aliens, mine riches, and unlock powerful upgrades. It's one dwarf against all of Planet Hoxxes!

name: Doggo
short_description: Casually walk and jump over spikes and snails in this dog-based action platformer!

name: Uncanny Valley: Machine
short_description: UNCANNY VALLEY:MACHINE is a story about a guy who leaves his apartment the first time after nightmarish creatures resembling a mixture of man and machine invaded the city in which he lives. Immerse yourself in the story, save the girl, find salvation in the streets illuminated by green moon.

name: Nash Racing: Battle
short_description: Newest part of Nash racing game series, now participate battle racing races with buggy cars with weapons. Win and destroy other enemies

name: Gunship + Gunship 2000
short_description: In Gunship, climb into the cockpit of America's most advanced helicopter. Race low and deadly over the treetops at 200m.p.h. and deliver a powerful punch against the enemy! In Gunship 2000, you'll take charge of five copters on hundreds of combat missions in the Persian Gulf and Central Europe.

name: Vox Populi: Brazil 2022
short_description: Play as an existing or fully customized political figure, and campaign for many alternative Brazilian elections! In 'Vox Populi: Brazil 2022', you and the characters around you must promote your ideas and your popularity throughout the country to claim victory!

name: Roll Over Princess
short_description: From the tower of mysterious ruins exuding an enigmatic power, the only things you can bring back are knowledge, memories, and experience. Amidst numerous challenges, combine equipment, legacies, and allies to conquer the top floor!

name: XELAN FORCE
short_description: 8BIT style vertical scrolling shooting game Zelan Force.We aimed to create a game that you can enjoy over and over again, such as the feeling of play that changes between offensive and defensive types, and the ability to search for hidden items.

name: A Dragon's Tale: Fading Light
short_description: Embark on a journey as a small dragon across enchanting worlds, find runes with arcane powers and learn many powerful abilities. Master them to solve puzzles, defeat mighty enemies and eventually face the Black Dragon in this unique action-platformer!

name: Tomb Raider I-III Remastered Starring Lara Croft
short_description: Play the original three Tomb Raider adventures with all expansions and secret levels in this definitive collection.

name: Recolit
short_description: Your spaceship crushes, and you find yourself in a dark town that looks just like any other, but that has something different about it. Its people go about their daily lives as if nothing was off, even though the sky above their heads is always black.

name: STARNAUT
short_description: “STARNAUT” is a 3D action game includes the elements of Roguelike. The player will become the STARNAUT, a surviving astronaut and experience the thrill of beating up endless spawning enemies then launch the Omega Rocket to complete level. Collect the coins and upgrade the weapons and equipment!

name: Matchmaker Agency
short_description: Hot singles near your area and they're ready to date! Not with you, no. Your job is to find them the perfect date and become the best matchmaker in town.

name: River Attack
short_description: Embark on an exciting journey inspired by classics, facing challenges along the river, rescuing refugees, and demolishing obstacles. Acquire airplanes, collect power-ups, and choose between Classic and Mission modes. An intense experience awaits you!

name: Animated Jigsaw Puzzles
short_description: Attempt over 20 unique jigsaw puzzles where the puzzles are alive! Follow the moving images to figure out how to connect the pieces and explore all kinds of additional unique and creative twists!

name: Surrounding By Ancient Beauties
short_description: 身处相亲桌前的你竟然意外回到古代化身低等家丁遭遇百般刁难，多亏遇到几位美女姐姐相助才转危为安。在步步惊心的何府，是忍辱负重苟且偷生还是凭借聪明才智走向人生巅峰，一切将由你决定！

name: RC Revolution
short_description: Immerse yourself in the electrifying world of RC car racing! Experience the thrill of multiplayer mayhem, delve into extensive car customization, unleash your creativity with track design, and embark on a rewarding progression system. Get ready, your track awaits!

name: War Link - 2111 AD
short_description: War Link has evolved, and so has the best online FPS on Virtual Reality

name: Escape from Darkness
short_description: Escape from Darkness is a single player, first person survival horror game. After waking up alone in a strange, eerie place. You must plunge into the oppressive darkness ignorant to what awaits. Survival depends on the use of stealth, finding limited resources, and quick wits.

name: Hope
short_description: Help the protagonist escape from the inner world and make a choice.

name: Helskate
short_description: Helskate is a skateboarding action roguelite. Grind, perform tricks, and chain combos to power up your attacks to slay the monsters of Vertheim. Combine unique weapons and gear to suit your playstyle as you fight, die, and upgrade your abilities to come back to this labyrinth over and over again!

name: Undulations
short_description: This is a survival escape action game from a huge wave where you can experience fear and despair within the first minute. The goal is to run around freely in 3D space from a first-person perspective and avoid large waves. The joy of conquering a huge wave is immeasurable.

name: Cash Cow DX
short_description: Holy cow, it’s all about the moooney! Run, jump and slide in this udderly jolly adventure to reclaim your fortunes from those sneaky Pig Pockets. Tough as nails and no continues: let's go!

name: Dynamic Shooting VR
short_description: Dynamic Shooting VR is an arcade target shooting game! An arcade style practical shooting experience. Compete across different ranges with captivating themes and challenging parkours. Experience intense gameplay with fine tuned weapon mechanics. Best gun and target shooting feeling in VR.

name: Arcanima: Mist of Oblivion -  Prologue
short_description: Awake your anima in this action RPG combining Hack N Slash combat with JRPG mechanics! Join the anima user 'Juno' in her journey to clear the Mist of Oblivion, shape your anima through your actions and find answers before all meaning is lost. Willpower is your only limit!

name: Caribbean Legend
short_description: An open-world RPG, set in the Golden Age of Caribbean piracy. Embark on a 200-hour-long adventure, plunder cities and ships, explore the unknown, discover treasures, forge friendships, earn bounties on your head, and charm the ladies on your path to ultimate freedom!

name: Dead Alone
short_description: Dead Alone is an intense first-person survival shooter set in a dangerous apocalyptic cityscape. In this desolate landscape, your precision in shooting and meticulous resource management will be the key to survival.

name: TheSpoiler
short_description: When you come to your senses, you find yourself trapped in a nightmare. The books scattered around will guide you through your future.

name: The Great Ocean
short_description: Dive into adventure-missions in the earth’s oceans. Explore in your high-tech submarine fascinating spots like the Galapagos or the Deep Sea. Use your upgradeable tools to solve quests when you free jailed whales, or explore sunken WW2 battleships. Swim with majestic whales, sharks and sea turtles.

name: PORTAL SURVIVORS : Enchanstrider
short_description: Take down numerous monsters with your colleagues to obtain resources you crossed through the portal! Portal Survivors is a casual game . By combining your colleagues' occupations, skills, and magic , you can kill a huge number of monsters in a variety of ways.

name: Cursed Enigma - The Midnight Apartment
short_description: Franco moves into an Italian townhouse, where an unsettling presence lead him to uncover dark truths about his new home. Dive into the mysterious events lurking behind the peaceful exterior of the building in the second episode of CURSED ENIGMA: The Midnight Apartment.

name: Cow Life Sim RPG
short_description: Cow Life Sim RPG is a cozy game where you collect, juice, weave, and burn hundreds of unique items to level up your skills. Explore a lovingly crafted world and meet endearing animal friends. Experience life as it should be - experience life as a cow!

name: Invisible Fear
short_description: Invisible fear is a horror game where you will have to go through a nightmare, surviving during the nights, using your camera that is able to show the non-existent to your eyes...

name: Hook Adventure
short_description: Soar on the wings of your dreams and immerse yourself in the unique world of flying islands! Explore dangerous locations, uncover the secrets of the past, and become the hero of your own epic saga.

name: Wave Dungeon
short_description: Wave Danjon is a roguelike RPG in which the player is forced to navigate a map that switches at regular intervals. Conquer dungeons that become more powerful and evil with each wave!

name: Watermelon Suika Game
short_description: Embark on a puzzle adventure to prevent fruit overflow! Strategically collide fruits, crafting colossal watermelons. Join this exciting challenge of combining matching fruits to conquer the leaderboard and master the art of creating giant watermelons.

name: Windowkill
short_description: Windowkill is a twin-stick shooter, but the game window itself is constantly closing in on you. Shoot the window edges to push it around your screen as you fight and dodge enemies and bosses in their own windows.

name: Toytopia
short_description: Explore the abandon ruins of Toytopia experience the wonders that were once seen at this once amusing attraction. Always check behind your back because something is always lurking near you, meet the varying cast members of Toytopia and try your best to survive.

name: Geometry Survivor
short_description: Geometry Survivor is rogue-lite survival where you fight waves of enemies. Unlock innovative upgrades in the shop, acquire new ships and conquer the unforgiving grid world.

name: Gambit Shifter
short_description: Gambit Shifter is a relaxing, minimalist cozy puzzle game for chess experts and beginners alike! Take control of a single piece, solve your way through 80+ hand-crafted levels and lose yourself in the zen atmosphere as you advance.

name: Furnish Master
short_description: Furnish Master is a relaxing game about furnishing apartments, houses, commercial estate and even outdoor territory! Realize your design dreams! Add to Wishlist now!

name: Save Twiks
short_description: “Save Twiks” - psychological horror from the first person. The Kitten named Twiks us lost in a giant train and you will have to go though real horror to find it. “Did you hear this? I think he just meowed in next car”.

name: The Lost Legends of Redwall: Feasts & Friends
short_description: Come savor the peaceful town of Lilygrove in this cute and cozy cooking game based on the beloved book series 'Redwall' by Brian Jacques. Join Scout-Chef Rootsworth in the kitchen as you challenge hand-crafted recipes, meet a charming cast of characters, and enjoy a beautiful small-town story.

name: Ruff Ghanor
short_description: Ruff Ghanor is a Deckbuilder game with Roguelite elements, where each collected card represents a crucial action in your journey. Build the perfect deck, strategize, and create powerful synergies as you progress to face your destiny.

name: Feed the Cups
short_description: Feed the Cups is a Roguelite multiplayer online cooperative game. Run a Drink Shop, stocking up, preparing ingredients, taking orders, crafting drinks, cleaning up, and checking equipment. Join your friends together!

name: Chambers
short_description: Equipped with cunning and agility, you must navigate through a series of intricate chambers filled with traps, deadly adversaries, hidden chambers and mind-bending puzzles. Your quest? to reclaim the gold that was stolen from you!

name: Garden Life: A Cozy Simulator
short_description: Garden Life is a relaxing gardening game in which you create your dream garden in a peaceful, colourful world. Plant and add ornaments at your own pace, transforming an overgrown forgotten plot into a flourishing community garden.

name: BAR
short_description: Bar is a colorful incremental game with complex gameplay mechanics built around filling the bar. Filling the bar gives you rewards that allow you to fill the bar even faster. Unlock various upgrades to fill the bar at absurd rates.

name: Extraordinary: Monster
short_description: Karena received an urgent mission: to hunt down Professor Selon who killed his wife and children. However, various signs showed that the matter was not a simple murder. Karena followed the clues to the abandoned Alberto laboratory, and the case actually led to a strange crystal Block - ENP

name: A fascinating story : Wedding Night
short_description: This is a very simple card flip game where you turn over a card and then try to find another matching card. You only need to click on the card to find the same card as the image that appears, and the identical ones will be eliminated.

name: Lazaret
short_description: Lazaret is an atmospheric first-person horror game. You play as a member of a rescue team called out to investigate a distress signal coming from a ship that disappeared 4 years ago.

name: 迷宮校舎 | School Labyrinth
short_description: School labyrinth is a 1~4 co-op horror game set in a randomly generated school at night. Cooperate with your friends and try to escape from the school building!

name: Empires Shall Fall
short_description: Empires Shall Fall is a turn-based tactics game set in a dieselpunk world. Upgrade your army and command your troops, then exploit terrain to eradicate your enemies with sheer power and sharp tactics.

name: The Infirmity
short_description: The Infirmity is the zombie shooter game that includes the stories of different characters living during the zombie epidemic.

name: World War: An Age of Industry & Magic
short_description: A collectible card game with a setting that draws from historical elements of the late 19th and early 20th centuries such as Spiritualism, the Victorian Era, the Industrial Revolution, psuedo-science and quackery of the time like Galvanism, both World Wars, and the sentiment of fin de siècle.

name: Cogstellation
short_description: Cogstellation is a space mining game based entirely around connecting gears around. Improve your ship to be the space travel machine that you know it can be, colonize the solar system by defeating the existing colonies, and improve your base with the best mining and crafting equipment you can get.

name: Plantabi: Little Garden
short_description: Plantabi is a chill sandbox game where you take care of adorable plants and design the cozy little garden of your dreams!

name: Robzawar
short_description: Robzawar is an addictive game that plunges players into the heart of an exciting struggle for survival in an alien world. As the main character, you find yourself in the role of a tough robot whose spaceship has crashed on a treacherous dinosaur planet.

name: 彼岸之旅
short_description: Travels to a different world, chooses to join different forces, made your character strong, defeat all enemies who stand against you

name: Windah Horror Adventure 2
short_description: Join Windah Basudara and Jaya Esport friends in this challenging rage game. Each character boasts unique skills. Confront Indonesian Ghosts as epic bosses. Get ready for intense battles and unmatched horror!

name: Cats Everywhere
short_description: Find cats in a relaxing hidden object game for cat´s lovers. Can you find them all?

name: Aveliana
short_description: Aveliana is an infiltration-action-adventure game in 2.5D with unique and diverse gameplay! Will you stealth your way to victory? Seek a forgotten path on the edge of a cliff? Or stand and fight against your enemies? Follow the trace of a mysterious fox and learn about a surprising story!

name: Sky Settlers
short_description: Sky Settlers is a minimalistic city building card game in which you build on islands in the sky and encounter different events, disasters and much more. Use different cards, complete quests and unlock new tiles as you progress.

name: Liquidum
short_description: Liquidum is a water-themed logic puzzle game, where you strategically fill interconnected aquariums across six challenging sections with unique mechanics.

name: Fossilfuel 2
short_description: Turn up the volume, turn off the lights, and get ready for the definitive Jurassic survival horror experience. Pump your shotgun and put those dinos back where they belong... in the ground!

name: BEASTWATCH: Meat & Mayhem
short_description: Beastwatch is a retro-style horror shooter in which you play a security guard working his first night in a slaughterhouse.

name: Empyrean Swarm
short_description: Escape the alien threat! Unleash searing lasers, fire precision phasers, and launch sizzling plasma bolts. Blast, spin, and cut your way through hordes to unlock your ship's potential as you unveil hidden horrors. Challenge the world, arcade-style, and ascend as the galaxy's ultimate pilot!

name: Cat's Cafeteria
short_description: A Visual Novel game with intriguing stories and captivating characters.

name: Solium Infernum
short_description: Take the Infernal Throne in this hellish turn-based grand strategy game. The Prince of Darkness has vanished, leaving Archfiends to conspire: muster your legions while intoning dark sorceries, devilish schemes, and machiavellian plots. Who will be the new ruler of Hell and ascend the Throne?

name: Dark Gravity
short_description: Shoot, destroy, collect, craft and destroy even more! 'Dark Gravity' is a fast-paced, low poly vertical shoot'em up game that features non-linear campaign mode with lots of enemies and bosses. Craft new weapons, upgrade your fighter and build an ultimate aerial war machine!

name: YUMPR
short_description: Yumpr has crashed in hostile enviroment! Filled up with dangerous creatures and obstacles. Help him survive this crazy world!

name: Dead Shells
short_description: What's that behind you? Navigate through the eerie graveyard of this first person atmospheric experience while you aim to be precise, quick, and responsive to defend yourself and survive.

name: CRASH MATH
short_description: CRASH MATH - You must solve math problems while trying to drive a car and avoid traps.

name: Tiny House
short_description: Embark on an adventure to unlock the secrets hidden within an enigmatic mansion with Tiny House.

name: Bandle Tale: A League of Legends Story
short_description: Bandle Tale: A League of Legends Story is a crafting RPG set in the whimsical world of Bandle City. After a party goes wrong, the portals that connect your home collapse and throw everything into chaos! Using your knitting magic and backpack house, restore the portals to reunite Bandle City.

name: Demons and Doobins
short_description: Sneak, Scirm, Doob.... all things you'll do in Demons and Doobins, the 2nd most fun game on Steam. Demons and Doobins is a multiplayer game meant for some stupid fun with friends.

name: Rich everyone
short_description: The game simulates the life restoration of ancient Chinese farmers in scientific farming, vegetable planting, animal husbandry, and various handicraft workshops. Free simulation construction

name: Quod: Episode 1
short_description: 'Quod' unfolds in a 1930s Texas prison. The main character must escape and uncover the truth. Brace yourself for eerie occurrences and solve intricate puzzles to unveil the terrifying secrets of this place.

name: Rocket!
short_description: Rocket is a Bullet Hell, High Stakes Arcade Shooter & Score Chaser. Use your skills to survive the onslaught of asteroids, enemies, black holes and the chaos of rockets and bombs everywhere. Upgrade your ship over time and enjoy the challenge. How high can you score?

name: ANGEL SPIRIT
short_description: Embark on a mystical journey as an angelic spirit. Navigate through ten unique atmospheric levels on a quest to unlock magical powers.

name: Mystic Guardians Slide
short_description: Enjoy the mystical guardians slide puzzle journey. Get ready for a unique experience

name: Supermarket Simulator
short_description: Run your own supermarket. Stock shelves, set prices as you'd like, take payments, hire staff, expand and design your store. Online orders & delivery, shoplifters, security, local market are upcoming.

name: Terminator: Dark Fate - Defiance
short_description: Terminator: Dark Fate – Defiance is not just a game; it's an adrenaline-fueled journey where your strategic prowess decides the fate of mankind against the machines. After the machines took over, the greatest threats may not come from the machines but rather from other human survivors.

name: Craftomation 101: Programming & Craft
short_description: You land on a frozen planet in a tiny rocket with a robot inside. Harvest and combine materials to discover new ones. Use visual programming to make the robot do the tiresome work for you. Slowly build a gang of self-sustaining robot workers and watch them terraform the planet.

name: Medieval Machines Builder
short_description: Medieval - times of constant sieges. Acquire plans, gather resources, create most powerful and destructive machines and then test them in battle. Thanks to your creations you will conquer more than one castle. The knights wage wars, but thanks to your machines they win them.

name: Slave Zero X
short_description: Slave Zero X is a stylish 2.5D character action game set in the biopunk world of Slave Zero (1999). Run & Slash your way through a dystopian future in this character action game which will resonate with fans of Devil May Cry, Strider, and Guilty Gear.

name: Party Party Time 2
short_description: It's Party Party Time again! Everyone join in and Let's Party!

name: Gran Carismo
short_description: 'Gran Carismo' immerses players in an intense and competitive racing environment, combining the excitement of illegal underground races with a compelling narrative. Get ready to navigate challenging tracks, outmaneuver rivals, and claim the grand prize – the Rosso 50

name: Squirrel Day
short_description: Squirrel Day is a non-violent VR platforming game that lets you climb, explore, and collect nuts through the eyes of a squirrel using an intuitive, physics-based movement system.

name: G.O.P.O.T.A 2
short_description: Don't you keep the kid's word?!

name: Penny’s Big Breakaway
short_description: Ready. Set. YO! - Join Penny & Yo-Yo in a kinetic 3D-platformer bursting with innovative gameplay! Showcase your catalog of tricks and chain impressive combos to deliver Penny & Yo-Yo's perfect breakout performance. Take the stage with this vibrant pair in Penny’s Big Breakaway.

name: Plane Accident
short_description: Become an inspector examining causes of plane crashes. Visit the crash site, gather evidence and interrogate witnesses. Explain whether the accident was caused by independent factors or human errors.

name: The Lost Legends of Redwall™: The Scout Anthology
short_description: A narrative puzzle-adventure game based on Brian Jacques' Redwall™️ book series. Vicious searats are invading the once peaceful Mossflower wood and it's up to the Lilygrove Scout Corps' newest recruit to save the day. Play as Sophia or Liam on their adventure to Redwall Abbey!

name: Marzia lost in space
short_description: A short linear story about a girl who has gotten herself stuck in space! Will she survive in the end or will it be her end?

name: The Tribe Must Survive
short_description: An unforgiving strategy survival Tribe-builder, set in a Lovecraftian Stone Age with a dash of rogue-like. Gather and manage resources to grow your Tribe. Navigate complex social dynamics, unique to every run. No choice is too small when it comes to preparing your Tribe to survive.

name: Exiled Survivors
short_description: Dive into the heart-pounding world of Exiled Survivors! Experience relentless action, shape your destiny through strategic choices, and face monstrous foes. Unlock up to 30 characters, conquer bosses, and revel in the perfect blend of Vampire Survivors' intensity and Diablo's depth!

name: Forgiveness
short_description: Forgiveness is a first-person ambient horror fps game set in the late eighties. After divorcing his wife Emma, Ben moves into the old house where his mother Amanda used to live. While moving in, he realizes that some strange things have been happening in his mother's house.

name: Mortui: Outbreak Secrets
short_description: For some unknown reason, the zombie virus has taken over the world and zombies are everywhere. The question is; This pandemic is unnatural?

name: 名利游戏
short_description: Players follow Lu Yuan through important stages of his life and experience his growth trajectory from youth to maturity. It will take you to relive those decisions that you have never tried to make in reality, and feel the different life brought about by each choice.

name: Taoist Survivor
short_description: In ancient times, 'Yaoshan,' a mountain in the East, promised immortality through its legendary peaches, lingzhi mushrooms, and the trials of thunder. Many Taoists ventured there, but perilous beasts roamed the slopes. Can you survive 'Yaoshan' and attain immortality?

name: Omnibullet
short_description: A factory is like a clockwork, can you make it tick? Combine simple towers into complex mechanisms, generate enough energy bullets, charge batteries. An open-ended logic game about efficiency, energy management, and tight budgets. Batteries included, but you will have to charge them yourself.

name: Balatro
short_description: The poker roguelike. Balatro is a hypnotically satisfying deckbuilder where you play illegal poker hands, discover game-changing jokers, and trigger adrenaline-pumping, outrageous combos.

name: SCP: The Expedition
short_description: 'SCP: The Expedition' invites you to command a unit in a world of untold mysteries. Command a skilled squad in the enigmatic world, enhance your team, explore global secrets, and engage in gripping turn-based battles against a shadowy foe.

name: Sokobond Express
short_description: Sokobond Express is a beautifully minimalist puzzle game that combines chemical bonds and puzzling pathfinding in novel ways.

name: Panoptia
short_description: Panoptia is a narrative-driven atmospheric exploration game about a strange building called Panoptia that has mysteriously appeared in town. No one knows what secrets hides in its depths. Uncover these secrets if you hope to ever escape...

name: Meteorite Z: The Apocalypse
short_description: Hardcore top-down zombie shooter, one bite and you are a zombie, you will have allies, manage your team effectively. Use many types of weapons to suppress hordes of zombies. A colorful system for dismembering opponents.

name: Diets & Deities
short_description: The rhythm cooking game you can taste! Discover the music and recipes from diverse cultures as you dodge to the beat and uncover the flavours of the universe.

name: La Sombra
short_description: With the help of a device capable of hacking different electronics, the cat burglar known as 'La sombra' must sneak around through a building ridden by terrorist, Now she must choose between stealing the precious 'Emerald Tiara' or to stop the terrorist.

name: Middle Evil: The Priest
short_description: A young priest is coming in a small village where the local church became full of evil. 2d cartoon arcade game with elements of action, top-down shooter and adventure. Use a cross, a sword, a censer and compose words from the holy book to defeat the creatures of the darkness!

name: 没有被美女包围的三角恋
short_description: 'Love Triangle Not Surrounded by Beautiful Girls' is a full-motion real-person interactive video work that simulates love. You will start an immersive emotional entanglement with multiple women from a first-person perspective.

name: Battle Feel
short_description: Battle Feel is a fun, survival, action-packed game that you can play online together also have a singplayer mode. The game takes place on an PvP Metro Map. Battle Feel has great graphics. Included types of game.

name: The Cadet Files : Scene Unseen
short_description: Against Time Challenging Mystery Solving GameNavigate crime scenes in 'The Cadet Files: Scene Unseen', using your tablet to solve puzzles and find hidden objects. Test your detective skills in a world of intrigue! Unravel mysteries, master new challenges,progress through levels.

name: Samurai`s Way
short_description: In 'Samurai`s Way,' a 2D runner-clicker by TinC Studio, players guide Kenji, a samurai, through ancient world. The game blends swift action with strategic ability use, facing mythical bosses and upgrading skills in a visually striking world. Embrace the samurai spirit in this fast-paced adventure.

name: Mimic Logic
short_description: 'Mimic Logic' is an automatically generated logic puzzle roguelike. Listen to the statements of the treasure chests, find the lying mimics, and open the rest of the treasure chests! Opening a mimic results in a game over.

name: Ascent of the Dragon
short_description: In a world where dragons conquered the world and humanity’s last hope is... Ah, who are we kidding. Are you pretending to work? Are you in need of an escape to continue the charade? Then this game is something you need! While your boss thinks you’re busy clicking, your dragon does the flicking.

name: Nexus Defenders
short_description: Tower Defense meets a Visual Novel narrative. Place an arsenal of towers to halt the invading enemy. Use special abilities such as napalm strikes, EMP blasts, and orbital lasers. A sci-fi space drama, filled with dialogue choices.

name: Waifu Club - Azumi
short_description: Waifu Club is the perfect Waifu puzzle game. Enjoy Azumi in 8 images in the gallery after you unlocked them in the game. The Gallery itself is easy controllable.

name: Time to Strike
short_description: Time to Strike is busted build bullet hell roguelike. Create overpowered builds and break the game by collecting powerful weapons, modifying them with whacky mods and discovering crazy synergies!

name: Ego's Spark
short_description: Is this a nascent ego—or just a nasty bug? Crash headfirst into cuddles, comfort, and maybe even love in this short visual novel about robots and the human heart.

name: qomp2
short_description: An artful reimagining of Pong. Control a Pong ball aching to break free of its life stuck between two paddles. Explore a dangerous, minimalist world, armed with simple two button controls.

name: Le Mans Ultimate
short_description: Le Mans is a continually evolving story... powered by emotion, speed and glory. Le Mans Ultimate - the official game of the FIA World Endurance Championship and 24 Hours of Le Mans.

name: Pacific Drive
short_description: Face the supernatural dangers of the Olympic Exclusion Zone with a car as your only lifeline in this driving survival adventure! Scavenge resources, load up your trusty station wagon, and drive like hell to make it through alive.

name: Star Trek Legends
short_description: Engage in an epic storyline for control of the mysterious Nexus and the fate of the universe as players step into the role of their favorite Star Trek heroes and villains in the hit franchise's official team-based RPG.

name: QUESTER | OSAKA
short_description: A dungeon exploration RPG specializing in hack-and-slash. The game is full of challenging elements. There are 32 characters (8 classes), skills to enjoy combos, modifiable armaments, 'NEW GAME+' to enjoy playing around, etc.

name: Mozarella Hills
short_description: Embark on a Sisyphean adventure in Mozarella Hills, a retro-style 2D platformer rich in Greek mythology. Navigate through pixelated landscapes, solve ancient puzzles, and defy the whims of gods in a quest that blends classic arcade gameplay with a touch of epic storytelling.

name: KUNKUNKUN
short_description: Go to the abandoned old school alone to investigate the ghost of KUNKUNKUN and be chased, how to become a real MAN? !

name: Rhythm Reunion - Indie Dating Sim Visual Novel
short_description: The band is getting back together! Haven't you heard?! 'Summer Vacation' is reuniting for one last gig! Take part in this artistically diverse visual novel as you explore the new lives of each of the old band members, all whilst you convince each of them to return to the lime light!

name: The Night Jackals Vol. 1
short_description: 'The Night Jackal' is a captivating game where you experience tension as you discover someone breaking into your phone through your security camera. In this game, you'll confront your fears with contemporary technology invading privacy.

name: Turlock Holmes
short_description: A detective narrative puzzler without pre-set options! Raise your questions at will, and an AI-host will answer only with 'yes' or 'no.' Drive the investigation with your curiosity; the path to solving the mystery lies in questions you ask. Can you dig out the truth through your questions?

name: Eternal end
short_description: This is a space exploration game.

name: NIDUS
short_description: A symbiotic Flower and Wasp struggle to complete their lifecycle, in a challengingly twisted arcade experience. Control both characters at once in mind-bending Single Player, or team up with a friend in hectic Local Co-Op. Master the symbiotic duet, devour the swarm, and ascend the leaderboard.

name: Catch My Color
short_description: Catch My Color is a game that find objects by applying the appropriate colors to the sights of Korea in black and white. Have fun coloring various landmarks in different colors and discovering hidden elements!

name: Insider Threat
short_description: Insider Threat is a first-person survival horror game that focuses on creating fear and tension for the player.

name: Blast Them All
short_description: Reload your weapon, the show's about to start! Blast Them All is a wave-based twin stick shooter where you face endless hordes of hungry zombies. Use your agility, pick up weapons and activate traps to defend yourself, build up your strength, collect points and reach the top of the leaderboard!

name: Chronicles Of Crystal: Turn-Basde Epoch
short_description: Pixel style RPG world card-like Roguelike,players will live in a mysterious medieval world.The world is full of adventure and challenge,you will embark on a legendary journey through the portal to different levels,randomly challenge a variety of powerful monsters, and engage in intense card battles!

name: Xeno Runners
short_description: Flying dreams? Live the thrill of high-speed aerial racing on a breathtaking alien planet. An adrenaline-fueled experience like no other with challenging time trial races that will push your skills to the limit. Master multiple tracks and unlock new flying machines or simply fly and enjoy the views.

name: I commissioned some mice 2
short_description: I paid more artists to hide mice and cheese in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

name: THE JUSOU 3
short_description: Why was that cursed nest born... A story tracing back even further, 25 years to its very origins. Exploration inside the school is done using a 3D map! Brace yourself and advance through the corridors swirling with terror!

name: Quick Quest
short_description: In Fantasy world, evil knights are threatening the equilibrium, Only you can fight them to restore the peace and the good balance of things.

name: Jolly Rogers Pirates Rumble
short_description: JRPR in short is an Action Arena fighting game. It is a local multiplayer shared screen game which needs at least 2 players locally to play. Players control different Pirates and compete to win! How do you win? Nice and easy, just push your enemies of the arena or figure out what do with your Pirate powers.

name: Idle Fields
short_description: Idle Fields is an Idle Skilling Game. Grow crops, cut trees, fish, cook, purchase animals, and decorate your homes! Automate tasks with workers. Unlock all the achievements, level up to become richer, and complete it all!

name: アキゾラのメモリーズ─運命の地平線─
short_description: 「あの頃に帰りたい─、たとえその先が暗闇だとしても─」『学園もの×SF』でお送りする青春SFビジュアルノベル。平凡な学園生活で、青春を謳歌する主人公とヒロイン。しかし、学園にはある病気と、世界を変えてしまうような秘密が潜んでおり……。

name: 502's Arcade
short_description: 502's Arcade is a collection of fast paced arcade games. Ghost hunting in a procedural dungeon crawler, fast reflex puzzle solving in a potion shop, blasting through alien enemies and more! Get good old arcade fun featuring modern mechanics and challenge your way to the top of the leaderboards.

name: Nightingale
short_description: Set out on a journey of survival and adventure, into the mysterious and dangerous Fae Realms of Nightingale! Become an intrepid Realmwalker, and venture forth alone or with friends - as you explore, craft, build and fight across a visually stunning Gaslamp Fantasy world.

name: PiM World
short_description: In the game you will lead your settlement. You will have to build various buildings starting with a castle and ending with an institute. Every decision you make should be balanced, because the economy of your settlement is growing, and the lack of resources can catch up instantly!

name: Exit: A Biodelic Adventure
short_description: In the world of excessive biotechnologies, an epidemic is ravaging the human race, infecting people's neuronet implants and enslaving them to the mysterious Worm. Who are you: a fighter of the infection, or a hunter of new prey?

name: 废柴队友 Stupid Teammates
short_description: As a mage, you'll fight alongside two 'Scrapwood teammates.' Unleash different spells by pressing key inputs. Diverse enemies, rich spell combinations and entry choices, as well as boss haunts and special levels, bring players a rich and wonderful game experience.

name: Technocide
short_description: Technocide is a vertical scrolling shoot 'em up with a heavy emphasis on player weapons and abilities. You must not let enemies past you and reach your mothership! You will need quick tactical thinking as you weigh your weapons' strengths and weaknesses against your enemies and their positioning.

name: Rock Star Life Simulator
short_description: Rock Star Life Simulator is an extensive fame simulation game. Start this adventure by playing the guitar on the street, form your own band. Protect the fame, money, and charisma you earned with the right decisions and become a world star!

name: Ufouria: The Saga 2
short_description: Explore the unique and wacky world of SUNSOFT's Ufouria in this exploration-based side-scrolling game. The levels' terrain change each time you play with new secrets to explore. Be charmed, comforted and tickled by the fluffy felt-like remake of the strange-but-cute world of Ufouria!

name: Biomeinoes
short_description: Biomeinoes is a score-attack tile-matching strategy game about building abstract isometric landscapes. Optimise your resources, plan ahead, and fine-tune your strategy to climb the ranks!

name: A Void Hope
short_description: A Void Hope takes you on an atmospheric narrative adventure to find a cure for a collapsed city. Follow the story of a tormented couple as they try to decipher reality from nightmares and evade the shadowy threats lurking in the dark.

name: Qyllscape
short_description: Qyllscape is a minimalist writing application designed not to make writing easier, but to make it easier to sit down and write.

name: Slot Advanture
short_description: Are you lucky or bad? 2D turn-based action adventure game. Defeat the monster with the hit rate you get by turning the slot. You can also get the character's stat, various items, and good ability buffs all at random. Trust your luck and go on an adventure rather than a high-level strategy.

name: Keep Flip
short_description: Take control of a vehicle named Tweely and use your mind and skills to conquer the game .The deeper you go, the more nervous you get.

name: Zeta Leporis RTS
short_description: A sci-fi real-time strategy game. An existential war among asteroids in classic RTS style. Build and defend, produce and upgrade, attack and annihilate!

name: NO TOMORROW
short_description: You are stuck in an infinite loop. Observe unusual activites and escape the loop.

name: Cursed Crew
short_description: You’re the captain of a cursed ship in this crew management roguelite! Command your crew, keep the ship afloat, defeat pirates and deep-sea beasts, and sail as far as it takes to lift the curse.

name: Quantum Contours
short_description: Outgun alien hordes in a short and sweet bullet hell arena shooter. Fight through waves of randomized enemies as you grow increasingly more powerful by acquiring unique upgrades.

name: The Bunker
short_description: Go throughout an abandoned bunker with your friends collecting all the notepads. Beware of the zombies that lurk within.

name: Gnomber
short_description: An action roguelike where you use unique bombs to blow your enemies away. Use knockback from your explosions to throw enemies into each other or walls, throw projectiles and deal damage in creative ways. Level up, combine different perks, get new bombs and become overpowered.

name: Now Open! Horror House
short_description: This is a simulation management and tower defense type game where players take on the role of a 'Horror House Owner'. Using various mechanisms and props, players aim to scare off visitors who come to challenge the 'Horror House', gradually expanding and strengthening the business.

name: Fantastic Fist
short_description: This game is focused on simultaneous keyboard and mouse controls. While the character can be moved around with the keyboard, the mouse can be used to interact with the environment by punching with a giant fist. Collecting hidden coins will unlock bonus content.

name: Builders of Greece
short_description: Immerse yourself in the beautifully recreated golden age of Hellenic city-states. Builders of Greece is a city management game that lets you display your strategic and economic mastery. Build your Polis from scratch, make meaningful decisions, trade, fight and expand to become the ultimate ruler.

name: The Cable Guy
short_description: Your job is to connect all the users from different projects to their servers in the procedurally generated network. In an ever changing office environment you'll have a lot of nifty tools to help you save your job and keep everyone from losing their cool. Are you up for the challenge?

name: Thyria
short_description: Thyria is an RPG, a unique combination of dynamic exploration, turn-based combat and crafting. Summon and train a team of Guardians, who will accompany Thyria into the minds of the cursed villagers. Help them vanquish their nightmares.

name: Microcosmum 2
short_description: A relaxing strategy game featuring unconventional gameplay. Your objectives include development, evolution, border expansion and protection of your hive.

name: Ultimator
short_description: Welcome to Ultimator: The Ultimate Reaction Challenge! Gear up for a gaming challenge that demands precision – Ultimator is not just a game; it's a thrilling adventure filled with relentless enemies, epic bosses, and non-stop action!

name: Type King
short_description: Type King has three different game modes: Typing, Jumping and those combined makes Type King! With some variety and different difficulties there is a total of fifteen levels to beat before you can be crowned the Type King!

name: GOBLIN SLAYER -ANOTHER ADVENTURER- NIGHTMARE FEAST
short_description: “Goblin Slayer” first Console Game released. The original creator of the series, Kumo Kagyu, is in charge of the original concept and series composition, while the main character designs are being handled by Noboru Kannatsuki, who also worked on the original series.

name: Run Pizza Run
short_description: Pizza delivery simulator. Deliver all the pizzas to the address while running through the dangerous streets of the city. Earn money and buy your mom the house she dreams of. But remember, it won't be easy. Good luck!

name: Gods Against Machines
short_description: Your world is under attack by a ruthless race of machines, and you are its only hope. Cast epic spells, summon minions or buildings, and destroy the enemy before they conquer your home in this action roguelite shoot'em up game!

name: Make it! Taiyaki
short_description: It's time for a taiyaki-making challenge! Can you master this traditional Japanese sweet? Make as many as you can!

name: NeverGoingHome
short_description: Ready for a fast paced rogue-like action shooter with upgrades, abilities and loads of weapons?, well you found it!

name: Dark Elf Historia
short_description: The former mercenary and dark elf Fornelia, battle-worn and looking for a place to die, saves a young man named Ruse from a monster attack. Follow the pair's life together in this Japanese indie RPG.

name: Summonsters
short_description: Summonsters is a roguelike survival game where you buy summons and combine artifacts to survive against oncoming enemies. Utilize summons that fight on your behalf to defeat bosses and elites. To ensure survival, strategically combine artifacts to forge powerful legendary artifacts.

name: Cucumber Champion
short_description: Embark on a journey as the valiant Cucumber Champion! Wield a cucumber as your mighty weapon and navigate through a fantastical world filled with quirky cats, humorous encounters, and epic battles. Can you prove yourself as the champion and save the day in this delightful and eccentric adventure?

name: STAR WARS™: Dark Forces Remaster
short_description: The evil Empire is currently creating a doomsday army behind a veil of secrecy. However, they are no match for the Rebel Alliance's covert operations division. Your mission is to infiltrate the Empire and put an end to their plans for terror and domination.

name: Tales of Sintra: The Dark Vortex
short_description: Tales of Sintra is an action RPG designed for virtual reality. Embark on an epic quest to vanquish the Dark Vortex by uncovering legendary weapons, mastering spells, defeating ancestral guardians and unraveling intricate puzzles. Experience a thrilling adventure set in a richly detailed world.

name: Alone in the crowd
short_description: Settled on a dystopian future, Alone in the Crowd is a puzzle simulation investigative thriller, where you use a weird variety of gadgets to satisfy this mysterious, self proclaimed friendly AI character.

name: Ad Infernum
short_description: Stranded at an abandoned gas station in the middle of the desert. Losing your grip on reality. Dark rituals. Demonic pursuers. No escape.

name: The Mobius Machine
short_description: Discover a vast alien world. Fight the ferocious local fauna and killer machines. Reveal its secrets and find a way to escape. The Mobius Machine is a side-scroller action adventure, with an emphasis on free-form exploration and intense combat.

name: Matching Meadows
short_description: Matching Meadows is a deck-based puzzle game that combines the simple pleasures of building a vibrant city with challenging objectives. Build your own idyllic landscape! To reach the top of the leaderboards, you'll have to strategize and carefully plan ahead.

name: HOP TOP
short_description: Hop from platform to platform and blast the bugs in your way in this new arcade classic!

name: Piczle Cross: Story of Seasons
short_description: Enjoy the bucolic charm of Story of Seasons while relaxing and exercising your brain with classic Piczle Cross nonogram logic-puzzles.

name: Minami Lane
short_description: Welcome to Minami Lane! Build your own street in this tiny cozy, casual management sim! Unlock and customize buildings, manage your shops, and maximize the happiness of your villagers to complete quests and fill your street with love!

name: Tank Fight
short_description: Tank Fight is an online fighting game where you upgrade your tank and compete with others until someone wins. You can mess around with friends or join public lobbies. Make your own maps or use built in maps on 6 unique gamemodes.

name: Brothers: A Tale of Two Sons Remake
short_description: Guide two brothers on an epic journey of discovery, loss, adventure and mystery remade for the latest generation of graphics, performance, and gameplay. Play in single-player mode or local co-op with a friend. This is one journey you will never forget.

name: GUARDS!
short_description: GUARDS! is a 1-4 player coop fantasy FPS that puts you in the underfunded and over-zealous steel boots of the City Watch. Kick down doors, bust criminals and cause excessive property damage as you fight to restore law and order to the corrupt city of New Alestead.

name: Dicefolk
short_description: Wield magical dice and build a team of powerful Chimeras to stop a mysterious evil in this tactical roguelite adventure. As a Chimera Summoner, recruit and create your perfect team of mythical beasts and command them to victory using unique dice mechanics.

name: NOCLIP
short_description: Chapter-based Backrooms experience. Embark on a chilling journey through the unknown. Visuals based on early 2000's camcorders.

name: Paranormal: Found Footage
short_description: You are a student journalist who decides to make a documentary about the abandoned «North» cosmodrome, where in the 1990s a series of man-made disasters occurred that caused serious genetic changes in humans and animals, forming previously unknown mutations.

name: NodeLord
short_description: Build, automate and create - but most of all - survive!

name: Secret Archives
short_description: This is a third person shooter game The main plot is a secret experiment being conducted somewhere in the future During this process, a strange mineral was discovered and caused a large-scale infection The protagonist's task is to retrieve important 'files' and escape from this place!

name: The Game Awards
short_description: THE GAME AWARDS invites you, the player, to a behind-the-scenes look at one wannabe indie darling's sordid tryst with game development. Learn what it takes to be an amateur, laugh at jokes, experience plot twists, and join our rookie dev on a rollercoaster ride that's rapidly running out of track.

name: Chunky Tomato
short_description: Chunky Tomato is a platform game in which you'll help a tomato, fortunately equipped with legs, to escape from a chunky tomato factory. All you have to do is cross the road. But watch out for the cars!

name: Sword Princess Sistina
short_description: Since a young age, Sistina has been lauded as the Sword Princess thanks to her masterful bladework. When the Demon God is accidentally unleashed, those skills are put to the test as she faces unstoppable adversaries!

name: Dino Rush
short_description: Welcome to Dino Rush – the ultimate test of survival in a prehistoric world! Dodge and sprint your way through a relentless horde of dinosaurs as you strive to survive for as long as possible. Encounter a variety of dinosaurs, push your reflexes to the limit in this pulse-pounding action experience!

name: LOLI RACING
short_description: 《LOLI RACING》is a Japanese-style kart racing game, the overall operation difficulty is low and easy to get started, there are 15 types of karts and characters can choose from, in terms of maps, there are 38 tracks with different themes to play, support single-player and multiplayer

name: Beyond the Fringe
short_description: Welcome to Beyond the Fringe, a single-player action/adventure set in a sci-fi universe with over seven different handcrafted maps to explore! Fight, fly, loot, mine, and craft your way through each world, searching for your mother and discovering the truth about the danger looming over the galaxy.

name: Arena 9th
short_description: Welcome to the AUTO-CARD Competition of The Ninth Universe. You can show your skills, enter a higher level of competition, and strive to win the glory of the universe championship.

name: Fool's End
short_description: Fool's End is a fast-paced single-player mining game. Dig and destroy everything in your path, outsmart monsters and mine your path to complete each level. There's always another way to escape...

name: Fire Race
short_description: Employ your drifting skills and power-ups to gain an edge, while dodging obstacles strewn across your path on the way to the podium.

name: Russian Soul Simulator
short_description: Russian Soul Simulator is a meditative game that allows the player to look at the Russian nature and the surrounding world in realistic graphics. The game allows the hero to move freely through fields and forests, explore the surrounding terrain and interact with various objects.

name: Winter Night
short_description: Game genre: Horror, Survival, Mystery (point and click adventure horror game). Game'Winter Night' presents a story inspired by beliefs in Thailand.Players will experience the atmosphere of an ancient, mysterious mansion.presented through 2D PixelArt.

name: Envious
short_description: Experience the horror puzzle game, Envious, offering both single player and co-op modes. Choose to be Xavier or Xandra where the first is trapped in a house, trying to escape it, while Xandra explores a separate old house to uncover clues facilitating Xavier's escape.

name: Code Wizard: Java Edition
short_description: Learn to code in Java as well as learning important Object Oriented Programming principles. Solve puzzles while learning new features as you track down the evil wizard intent on destroying the world. Write real Java code while playing through an RPG story!

name: Raige
short_description: Become one with Raige: a disturbing and confronting encounter with a grim world, its inhabitants, and yourself.

name: Scary Psycho Lady Simulator
short_description: Descend into psychological horror with 'Scary Psycho Lady' on Steam. Uncover a twisted plot as Ikoma, Rina, and the Psycho Lady navigate a chilling narrative of deception, betrayal, and murder. Solve puzzles, confront fear, and survive the sinister journe

name: Simulator Of A Person Who Is Taking Online Course To Study How To Lose Weight
short_description: You will play as a person who is learning how to lose weight in an online course. And all you have to do is learn!

name: Upward
short_description: Upward is a platform game where we progress upwards, overcoming obstacles on an island where we crashed with a plane accident. On 10 different levels, each featuring distinct colors, various platforms, and challenges await you.

name: Curse Errant
short_description: Embark on a royal quest, exploring the lands outlying the matriarchy of Sharon. Discover what awaits the flaming-haired knight, Giselle and her master, Lana, as they uncover the darkest of secrets surrounding the mysteries behind their pact and the succession to the throne.

name: The Idle
short_description: The ultimate idle clicker game with endless possibilities and infinite fun. Passive and active income, seven currencies, interest, bets, prestige, perks and many more features are available!

name: Cricket Through the Ages
short_description: Swing bats and throw balls through the intertwined histories of humankind and cricket in this one button, physics-driven game.

name: Shoot & Sow
short_description: Shoot & Sow is a top-down arena shooter roguelite, where players control unique characters and fight vegetables and fruits. Players can plant seeds to grow special items, as well as buy a variety of weapons and items. Complete the talent tree to gain more power. Can you survive on your own farm?

name: DIRECT CONTACT
short_description: Direct Contact is about Authentic Warfare, First-person Tactical realism experiences. Most weapons are in the same specs for each classification today, making most modern combat asymmetrical.

name: Shashingo: Learn Japanese with Photography
short_description: Shashingo is an edutainment game that teaches you Japanese through virtual photography. With your trusty camera, take photographs of the fictional streets of Japan to capture new words and images as fully translated flash cards!

name: The Warehouse
short_description: A simple horror collection game set in a warehouse outside of space and time

name: Broken Lands Village
short_description: The real world no longer exists! I was trapped in this cursed Village made of inkblots on parchment. Every day I'm stalked by an assasin and stuck in a time loop. None of the residents remember me, although I myself have memories. I need to get out of here ASAP

name: 捜査官の試練INVESTIGATOR TRIALS
short_description: In the game, you will play the role of an intern examiner and participate in a trial to become an official examiner. Strive to defeat one mechanical guard after another and powerful enemies through trial and error, in order to unleash one's true strength and transform into various combat postures.

name: Lover
short_description: Lover is a first-person psychological horror game. Presented in a nostalgic and retro environment, player will uncover the cause of the illness through reincarnation and overcome psychological issues. Before darkness consumes your world, find those unspeakable secrets as you face shattered reality.

name: Primitive Society Simulator
short_description: In this game, you'll be the leader of an ancient tribe, guiding your people to explore the natural world, to hunt, and to farm. As culture and civilization prosper, you shall establish a tribal alliance, a community with a shared future of tribes.

name: Sakura Isekai Adventure
short_description: Sakura Isekai Adventure is a yuri adventure story set in a fantasy world. Aki’s ordinary life is turned upside-down when she’s summoned to the magical land of Anthem by a cute cat-eared witch to find a missing priestess. Now what will she do?!

name: GURAGURA ODEN
short_description: Do you know the traditional Japanese dish 'Oden'? This is a puzzle game in which you pile up ingredients in an earthenware pot that shakes unsteadily and unsteadily! Try to pile up ingredients until the pot loses its balance and collapses to get a high score!

name: Island Paradise
short_description: Island Paradise is a survival game where you build, upgrade, customize your own island and use nearby resources to create a home for generations to come!

name: Heroes & Redemption
short_description: Heroes & Redemption is a rogue-lite bullet-hell where you face hordes of enemies, annihilate them, learn new abilities and enhance your skills. Explore different regions, acquire new companions and embark on adventures again and again.

name: Pull Stay
short_description: Pull Stay is a wacky Beat 'em up game with Tower Defense mechanics. Use your fists or set crazy traps to repel enemies from rushing into your house! As a guardian robot, defend your buddy Susumu who has been a shut-in for years!

name: Timber
short_description: Build and manage your industrial empire unlike ever before. Dive into Timber: where strategic resource management meets city-building excitement.

name: Robin Hood - Sherwood Builders
short_description: Robin Hood - Sherwood Builders is an action-adventure RPG with base-building elements, where you take on the role of a classic hero who stands up to the tyranny and injustice that haunts Sherwood. Fight, craft, steal, and of course help the local people grow and prosper.

name: Little Devils
short_description: Misjudged for centuries as 'devils,' a young Tasmanian devil descends into hell to restore his ancestors' honor. Embark on a thrilling journey through meticulously designed screens and uncover what secrets lie with Satan at the depths of hell... you know... for fun!

name: NightClub Simulator
short_description: seduce girl or get into fight, you can do anythings in virtual night club that you can't do in real life.

name: Terror At Oakheart
short_description: The renowned slasher horror films of the 1980s and 1990s serve as a source of inspiration for Terror at Oakheart. The community of Oakheart has been terrorized by Teddy, a masked serial killer. As the body count rises, you discover there is more going on here than just a man in a mask.

name: Flying Ferret
short_description: In this action game, a mysterious ferret with special jumping ability and its friends are made to jump and fly at high speed from island to island over the blue ocean to fly farther and farther.

name: Welcome to ParadiZe
short_description: Paradise isn't exactly what you hoped for: it's infested with zombies! Thankfully, you can control them. Capture them and teach them to farm or fight. They will help you defend our camp while you explore the world looking for… a new paradise.

name: Of the Red, the Light, and the Ayakashi Tsuzuri
short_description: A modern Japanese-style fantasy story involving Yue, a young boy born and raised at a shrine, and his friendship with the 'Ayakashi' spirits. HaccaWorks* presents a A mysterious, spiritual adventure game.This is a fully voiced version that includes a prequel and a new ending.

name: Battle Marine
short_description: SHOOT 'EM UP! Battle Marine is a simple naval barrage STG. A barrage of intense shots! Shoot 'em up! Shoot 'em up! Chain bombs with detonation, powerful laser sweeps, and jumps to collect medals! Enjoy a RETRO but NEW and exhilarating STG experience!

name: Fleximan
short_description: Simple, you're Fleximan and you have to remove all the speed cameras in the city.

name: The Running Man 2
short_description: Scientist Alexander Parker, trapped in a quantum simulator, faces surreal challenges, confronting personal fears. Guided by cryptic messages, he reaches a metaphysical final level, cracks the code, and returns transformed by the perilous journey.

name: Champion Shift
short_description: Unleash mythic heroes and their mighty vehicles in this thrilling co-op action roguelike. Seamlessly shift into car form, create builds with unique abilities, and battle endless enemies to stop the evil Dominion. Rev through high-octane missions, conquer epic bosses, and become an absolute legend!

name: Glowpop
short_description: Glowpop is an action Adventure starring a little alien explorer, The Yellow Punnu. Travel to new planets and uncover the epic story of a missing friend. Engage in challenging but rewarding gameplay & experience a visually stunning art style with no combat and your only defence: a glowing heart.

name: Drop the Dice
short_description: Drop the Dice is a “Side Game” whose goal is to score as many points as possible by placing your dice on the board! Optimize the positioning to obtain similar totals on your rows and columns, increase your score, use bonuses and cross the different levels!

name: Toki Pona Island
short_description: Toki Pona Island is a comprehensive language learning game that spans a bite-sized tropical community. Piece together all 120 words of this unique micro-language while you complete villager requests and explore a cozy little island.

name: Starlight and the Silver Key
short_description: Starlight and the Silver Key is a strange puzzle game about saving the world after your own world falls apart. Solve puzzles. Whisper passwords into ears. Make something called a Greasy Joe and become best buds with a demon.

name: Rock and Roots
short_description: Rock and Roots is a captivating VR journey where you wield the power to dictate the ebb and flow of battle. Summon your enigmatic guardians of the woods with a magical hand to face the challenges. Conjure spells, dive into the magic world and reclaim your rightful place on the throne!

name: Hitori Kakurenbo Online
short_description: An asymmetrical multiplayer horror experience inspired by the viral Hitori Kakurenbo ritual, also known as 'One Man Hide and Seek'. Unleash your malevolent powers through the perspective of a corrupted Doll, or fight for your survival and escape as one of the careless teenagers.

name: Boons & Burdens
short_description: Boons & Burdens is a single player action-roguelike set in the depths of hell. Battle hordes of demons through 9 levels, collect gems to purchase powerful boons, and choose from deadly burdens that alter the game's difficulty. Will you be the paragon of power or the architect of your own defeat?

name: Multiplayer Platform Golf
short_description: Physics-Based Golfing + 3D Platforming + Online Multiplayer (1-12 players).

name: Nobody Sleeps Tonight
short_description: a co-op survival horror about finding your friend who disappears at night in a strange forest hiding a sinister secret.

name: Terrafort
short_description: A procedurally generated sandbox survival game with RTS elements.

name: Star Racer
short_description: Soar through concrete and cosmos in Star Racer, a retro-infused combat racer. Drift through hazardous pavement, defy gravity and glide through the stars, and crush the competition by any means necessary!

name: Tale of Two Cranes
short_description: Fulfill your epic destiny in mythic ancient China! Lead armies, wield magic, and put an emperor on the throne - or become the emperor yourself!

name: Hidden Cats In Breeze Village
short_description: Find cute cats in Breeze Village. Can you find them all? Meow Meow...Kittens are calling you！

name: Fight till the End!
short_description: Fight Till the End! is an action-packed game that puts you in the shoes of a courageous character who finds themselves trapped in a deadly game of life and death.

name: Populous™ II: Trials of the Olympian Gods
short_description: Become the god you were born to be.

name: Proud To Love
short_description: 《自豪！美女全攻略》是一款真情真人互动恋爱视觉小说。你，王自豪，一位“躺平废柴”，好像要触底反弹了！睁眼醒来，世界突然开始围绕你运行了。百亿遗产、各色美女近在眼前，是美梦还是危机，你要如何选择？你将在这十余小时的旅途中，与不同角色在多元世界中，体验真实的笑与泪。入梦吧！少年！

name: Project 13: Taxidermy Trails
short_description: Project 13: Taxidermy Trails, a Walking Simulator set in a mesmerizing Taxidermy Museum. In this immersive experience, you assume the role of an kidnapped Probant forced to find a way to escape. Complete all 13 Walks to get out of this Nightmare.

name: Tales of Morrow
short_description: Create your tale! Build your home, fight, farm, and explore an old civilization while developing your skills and abilities in this relaxing and adventurous experience. You decide your fate!

name: YOKO
short_description: 'YOKO - Between Life and Death', your courage will be tested as you face the supernatural and uncover dark secrets on a journey full of emotions.

name: Exit museum
short_description: Exit the museum is a game highly inspired by 'Exit 8'. You are the security guard of a museum and have to go through nine appearingly similar rooms. There is a ~30% chance of nothing beeing wrong in comparison to the first 'Showroom'.

name: Misled Madness
short_description: Side-scroller platformer where you avoid hazards and race to the finish line for the fastest leaderboard times.

name: Pin Puck
short_description: Master the unique shape of your player and out-manoeuvre your opponents in this high speed local multiplayer sports game. Play 1v1 or 2v2 versus matches, or race against the clock solo in target smash.

name: Midnight Monitor: Aldercourt
short_description: Lost in a series of endless train station hallways, find your way to the exit Platform in this First-Person Anomaly Spotting game set in the Midnight Monitor universe. Watch out for anomalies - If you see any, turn back immediately! Can you find your way out of Aldercourt Station?

name: Fall into decay
short_description: 名叫赛莉卡的少女某天在一间奇怪的宅邸中醒来，自己好像忘记了什么重要的事情，又似乎被卷入了什么事件之中…… 但首要的目的是找到逃离这里的方法。

name: Berserk Boy
short_description: BERSERK BOY is a high speed action packed Platformer, with Metroidvania elements. Packed with vibrant and stylish pixel art. Go Berserk! as you change into different forms and use the power of Lightning, Fire, Ice, Air, and Earth to save the planet! With music by Sonic Mania composer Tee Lopes.

name: DeadNeverStop
short_description: 《DeadNeverStop》 is a roguelike tower defense game. You will be the hero who can use unique defense towers to help the survivors survive from countless zombies. Dozens of defense towers, multiple skills and a large number of battle cards are the key to survive from endless zombies! Good luck!

name: 希望之城 The City Of Hope
short_description: A light city-building game that combines elements of card games and tower defense, where players must survive daily enemy attacks and gradually grow their strength to ultimately defeat powerful invaders.

name: Populous™: The Beginning
short_description: In the third part of the Populous series, you control your shaman and the tribe of her followers in a difficult quest to conquer all 25 planets of a star system and ascend to godhood.

name: Ancient Weapon Holly
short_description: After tens of thousands of years, the ancient weapon Holly awakens, starting her revenge against humanity. Experience the strategy of creating pitfalls to trap enemies and the exhilaration of burying them alive. Dive into intense combat!

name: Hellbreach: Vegas
short_description: Hellbreach: Vegas is a Wave-based First-Person Shooter for 1-4 players, made with passion by a one man dev team! Set your loadout, kill, and earn cash. Take a spin on the various slot machines and level up to improve your survival chances. Are you ready to try your luck?

name: Hairdresser Simulator
short_description: Create new hairstyles for customers. Cut, dye, and style to perfection. Enhance your skills and master the craft. Run your business and renovate your salon. Generate profit, hire employees - aim to the top! Upload any portrait photo and try out new hairstyles thanks to the character creator!

name: True Backrooms
short_description: The most accurate depiction of the backrooms.

name: NodeRunner
short_description: Jump from Node to Node while surviving the Chasers onslaught. Keep moving, Keep Upgrading, and don't get terminated.

name: Time to Morp
short_description: Time to Morp is a colony sim game in which you take care of playful creatures - Morps. Use their help to gather resources, build and decorate a base, set up pipe networks, automate everything and explore the world to find new species and rare materials.

name: Area 19
short_description: First Person Sci Fi Horror Game. Set within a confidential Underground Facility, Navigate through this Abandoned Complex, Discover Government Experiments, Alien Beings, and the haunting aftermath of the Roswell Crash.

name: Blade Prince Academy
short_description: Blade Prince Academy is a new take on tactical RPGs, where you lead your squad of Blade Princes to defend the city of Abjectalia in real-time with pause combat. Use your team's power to devastate any threat, but be vigilant, there is always a price to pay when you make a pact with darkness.

name: Elevator Zero
short_description: In Elevator Zero, a first-person exploration and puzzle game, you find yourself trapped in an otherworldly dimension. Escape is possible only through the elevator.

name: Countryside Life Simulator
short_description: Countryside Life Simulator is an extremely comprehensive and detailed simulation of the life of a rural farmer who owns a farm shop.

name: Buckshot With Friends
short_description: Tabletop horror game where you take turns firing a shotgun. The game can be played with friends or a dealer, creating an intense, suspense-filled atmosphere. Russian Roulette reimagined.

name: Sector YAMA
short_description: Play as a space soldier, abandoned by the command on an alien planet. Find allies, gather resources, train new troops, and escape from Sector Yama. Casual 'single-stick shooter' controls, fun tactical combat, rewarding exploration, and rich storytelling.

name: Hazy Mind
short_description: You can't remember anything, and all you can see is HER. Delve into your story and uncover the truth behind what happened to you and your parents.

name: The Pirate Queen: A Forgotten Legend ft. Lucy Liu
short_description: The Pirate Queen is a multi-award winning narrative adventure starring Lucy Liu. Climb aboard a 19th century Chinese pirate ship, explore moonlit cabins, unearth treasure and embark on a journey to become the most powerful pirate of all time. Do you have what it takes to be crowned The Pirate Queen?

name: Chaos
short_description: The life that we knew has changed, The Chaos took control of the streets. Experience a post-apocalyptic world where your survival skills are crucial.

name: EMPYRE: Earls of the Deep Earth
short_description: It’s the time before the Flood. The world is a strange place. Especially for you. How do you solve the mystery of your missing memory? Are you trapped? Can you leave? Ever? Enjoy a Neo-Victorian version of the Orient! Embark on a journey to explore a wondrous land filled with mystery and intrigue!

name: SUMMERHOUSE
short_description: A tiny building game about beautiful lived-in houses. No rules or restrictions, just pure creativity.

name: Dawnsbury Days
short_description: Lead a group of childhood friends through their first adventures in a turn-based tactical RPG played under the rules of PF2E, the second edition of a powerful OGL ruleset. Customize their builds, acquire loot and level up, and ultimately defeat the sinister enemies who threaten your hometown.

name: Darkness Ritual: Impasse
short_description: You witnessed a dark ritual taking place and nothing will go wrong from now on. You are stuck in an unknown place, can getting out of here and solving the secrets save you from this impasse?

name: Draft Day Sports: College Basketball 2024
short_description: Lead your college basketball team in Draft Day Sports: College Basketball 2024. Recruit stars, coach for success, and make key decisions with an improved UI, player reveals, enhanced player control, and a revamped transfer portal. The ultimate coaching simulation game!

name: Inside The Crystal Mountain
short_description: Inside The Crystal Mountain is an action adventure game with fast-paced combat and soulslike elements where you explore a mysterious world filled with ambiguous characters and challenging enemies.

name: Minute Fighter
short_description: A first-person shooter controlled entirely with the mouse, with a focus on the granularity and minutia of interaction.

name: Find Cats With Friends
