short_description: Find Cats With Friends - gather friends, search the island for 100 mischievous cats, and bring them back in this cooperative multiplayer quest!

name: Contra: Operation Galuga
short_description: The legendary Contra series returns! This reimagining of the classic run-'n'-gun action game from the ‘80s features new stages, new enemies, new play mechanics, and co-op combat for up to 4 players!

name: Zombies vs You
short_description: Step into a world overrun by the undead in this thrilling survival game.

name: Populous™
short_description: Move mountains, part the seas, and lead mortal armies to victory in Populous. Take on the powers of a mighty deity and battle for supremacy against an enemy god, using thoughtful strategy to shape the isometric world and the fate of its people.

name: Antipaint
short_description: An action-packed roguelite shooter where you battle famous works of art and each level you beat becomes a masterpiece to add to your colorful collection.

name: 末世围城（Survival Odyssey）
short_description: Immerse yourself in this epic survival game teeming with strategy and thrills! Confront relentless attacks, fighting tooth and nail to survive in a world overrun by chaos. Select from a diverse pool of 100 heroes, each boasting unique skills, allowing you to craft endless strategic combinations.

name: Dungeon Keeper™ 2
short_description: Bad guys have all the fun. Discover your dark side as you build an evil underground kingdom and defend it against the forces of good.

name: Out of the Park Baseball 25
short_description: Out of the Park Baseball 25 marks a milestone - 25 years of sports gaming excellence! Officially licensed by MLB, the MLB Players Inc. and KBO, this year's Anniversary Edition puts you in charge of your favorite baseball franchise. Your team, your legacy, your dynasty. Play what the pros play!

name: BUMS
short_description: BUMS - a game with a great variety of mini games where funny and scary. Go through them together with your friends or against them, all to win. The entrance to these worlds lies through cassettes, which are hidden all over the map, and some of them are unique and only a few will be able to find them

name: Sixty Four
short_description: Dive into the world of Sixty Four, where you transform simple machines into a thriving factory.

name: Fountain
short_description: Lead a squad of up to 7 members entering a constantly changing barrier. In this mysterious adventure, meet interesting companions, fight against various enemies, collect rare treasures, and reveal the secrets concealed within the barrier.

name: Desert Special Forces
short_description: Captain, you have a new mission!

name: Disco Simulator
short_description: Disco Simulator is a tycoon type game based on club management. Your task will be to set up the club from scratch, put up walls, arrange furniture, hire staff, plan events, invite artists, put on concerts. Create your own club!

name: Orrstead
short_description: Orrstead is a relaxing city builder that combines resource management and incremental game mechanics. Unlock technologies, complete quests, and adapt to the changing seasons.

name: Nuke Them All
short_description: An RTS classic reborn with a twist. Time is of the essence, Commander! Capture the flags, conquer the territories, and eliminate the enemy fort. And finally, nuke them all! This old-school sci-fi Indie real time strategy game, crafted by devoted team, revives the genre's enduring allure.

name: Somniata
short_description: Uncover the mystery—turned nightmare—of a missing family in rural Massachusetts. A lone detective must survive the horror unleashed upon a family of four.

name: The Unknown
short_description: A psychological horror, first-person platformer. Dive into the depths of Mike's tormented mind as you navigate deadly obstacles, solve puzzles, and confront inner demons. Do you have what it takes to escape The Unknown?

name: Astral Vangard
short_description: Pilot your Vangard and battling against various enemies and bosses. Astral Vangard is a casual game with rogue-like elements in a futuristic world filled with Mecha. You can choose their own Vangard with different start weapon and characteristics, improving their abilities as they advance.

name: Princess Quest
short_description: Join Princess Lilia in her adventure to take back her country in this old school RPG!

name: Liminal Border Part II
short_description: Unfairly saddled with crippling debt after the events of Part I, Itsuki Ninomae and the gang turn to fellow student and daughter of a crime lord Kotoko Teshigawara for help. An intertwined web of loyalties and desire awaits as Itsuki, Kotoko and the others fight for justice.

name: A Difficult Game About Climbing
short_description: This is a difficult game about climbing.

name: Time Escape : A Prototype
short_description: A side-scrolling obstacle jumping game including Twitch integration and achievements.

name: Death Trick: Double Blind
short_description: The star magician of Morgan’s Traveling Circus is missing, but the show must go on! In this non-linear detective visual novel, unravel the mystery from two different perspectives as you learn the varying stories of an entire circus of performers, each with their own lives... and their own secrets.

name: DREAMIO: AI-Powered Adventures
short_description: DREAMIO is a 'choose-your-own-adventure' game where stories and visuals are dynamically created through the power of artificial intelligence in response to your decisions. Explore endless worlds with limitless possibilities; go anywhere, do anything.

name: Anominal
short_description: A 2D platformer with a twist: instant teleportation! Solve brain-scratching puzzles, engage in adrenaline-pumping traversal, and discover the purpose within.

name: Paragon Pioneers 2
short_description: Dive into the captivating world of Paragon Pioneers 2, an engaging city-building idle game filled with extensive content promising months of immersive gameplay. Even with limited playtime, you can delve deep into this simulation, experimenting with various strategies to enhance your realm.

name: Quiet on Set
short_description: Quiet on set! Action! Amidst a grand mansion, an elite movie production turns sinister with a sudden murder. Investigate, interview suspects, gather clues, and solve the murder. But beware, push too hard and you could be the next victim!

name: Goblin Stone
short_description: Goblins have been hunted to extinction by cruel adventurers. Embark on a heartwarming roguelite adventure to rebuild their lair and help them thrive in this award-winning turn-based RPG where every decision counts.

name: 9 Days
short_description: You have 9 days before the final fight. At your current state, you do not stand a chance! Explore this Open World to gain new skills and abilities for the battle. Choose where you go, what you do carefully. You cannot waste time! You have 9 days.

name: Farmer Survivors
short_description: Welcome to Farmer Survivors, where you'll embark on an epic rural adventure, defending your farm against hordes of hungry insects in this action-packed Arcade Survivor game!

name: revere
short_description: 'revere' is a psychological found footage horror game where every detail matters. Prepare yourself for an experience where your sanity will be condemned.

name: Count Pumpcula
short_description: One misty moonlit night, Count Dracula is attacked by an orange object from the sky. He finds himself awaking on a mysterious island with a pumpkin stuck to his head. With the new power of the pumpkin that protects Dracula from sunlight, he must find his way off the island and back to his Castle.

name: Duelists of Eden
short_description: Build a deck and battle online in real-time action with rollback netcode!

name: Poorzzle - Puzzle Alive
short_description: Welcome to Poorzzle - Puzzle Alive, a pure speculative puzzle game. Here, simple lines outline the ultimate purity, and 12 crafted puzzles will subvert your way of thinking. Puzzle comes alive when you unlock it.

name: Warbyte: Operation Falcon
short_description: An old-modern school fps, where you can play tactically, or engage in crazy fast-paced combat. Host your own rooms easily, and enjoy a fair game, where victory is determined by your skill.

name: Eldgear
short_description: Live a grand adventure as an agent of Eldia to seal the ancient ruins!

name: Saving Mrs. Hinako
short_description: In this visual novel by Studio Pork, make a strong-willed yet acquiescent, pure-hearted but rebellious housewife fall in love with you!

name: Ys X: Nordics
short_description: The story takes place in the northern sea Obelia Bay, a bay filled with countless islands of all sizes. Ys X: Nordics depicts a brand-new adventure in the northern sea Obelia Bay, featuring the young adventurer, Adol Christin, as its protagonist!

name: With in the Obscurity
short_description: A first-person perspective mystery puzzle-solving game where players immerse themselves in the role of characters involved in each episode's abnormal event to uncover the truth. The plan is to release 1 episodes per month, totaling 6 episodes per season.

name: Alian
short_description: This is a normal shooting game. There is nothing extra in it.

name: Code Racer
short_description: Code your vehicle with a series of commands to complete various courses, tasks, stunts, and races in this physics-based brain teasing racing puzzle game!

name: Kz Icon Center
short_description: Kz Icon Center is your go-to application for effortless icon customization. Whether you want to select from over 150 pre-made icons or convert any image into an icon, our tool provides a seamless and user-friendly experience.

name: Dream Escape
short_description: It's a first-person adventure game that's not terribly scary. Players will be thrown into a variety of frightening scenarios, trying to find clues and avoid deadly traps in order to escape the dream alive.

name: Penny Blood: Hellbound
short_description: Unleash the hounds from hell and fight your way free of this otherworldly prison in a roguelike adventure that explores the world of Penny Blood’s darker side! Can you find the distinction between good and evil…?

name: Umbra Fields
short_description: A Black and White Choose Your Own Adventure game in the Open World of the Umbra Fields. Customize who you are between 15 distinct classes, choose what nation you wish to be in, and explore to your heart's content. Do quests, explore dungeons, fight, and discover your fate, and the fate of the world.

name: Boba Bar: Bubble Tea Tycoon
short_description: Boba Bar: Bubble Tea Tycoon is a Kawaii themed pixel art game where you start your journey with a humble drink stand. Learn new recipes and unlock new equipment and locations, manage sales prices and inventory in order to succeed in becoming the largest bubble tea tycoon in town!

name: Amygdala
short_description: Welcome to Amygdala, seeker of nightmares. In the presence of the Absolute Judge, you are assigned a task that only you can accomplish. Immerse yourself in this place made of emotions. Discover unique creatures called 'lords of nightmares' and uncover the beauties of horror in this unique adventure.

name: 放置地下城-Idle Dungeon
short_description: This is a idle RPG game.In the dungeon, you can encounter various monsters and powerful bosses guarding levels. Only by defeating the boss can you enter the next 10th level. In the boss tower, you can challenge increasingly powerful bosses, obtain various materials, gems, and advanced skill books.

name: Skill Up!
short_description: It's time to jump and run! Skill Up provides an extremely satisfying 3D Jump & Run experience combined with exciting colorful stages that wait be mastered... with nothing but pure skill and the might of your hands!

name: Taken Soul | Đoạt Mệnh
short_description: Taken Soul is a survival horror game developed by SOGA Studio. The protagonist play in third-person perspective, he must navigate through dangerous and tense situations, try to survive till the sun rises, and fight against dark forces to investigate the disappearance of his mother and sister.

name: IdleCraft
short_description: An idle loot short game, with some clicks and a bit of luck, you can beat it.

name: Auto Auto: Maximum Autodrive In The Alien Apocalypse
short_description: Aliens have taken over humanity and now have the goal to destroy Lexi Lane, the last hope of human resistance. Step into Lexi's 'pedal to the metal' shoes. Help the last heroine drive, drift, and blast her way through the alien onslaught and meet her destiny in a last act of defiance and glory.

name: FAST BEAT BATTLE RIDER
short_description: I will be entitled 'the fastest'! Slip between the cars that try to block you on your motorbike and run through the highway in a 'super-highspeed-battle'' just like in movies! The more you use the machine, the higher the status will be. Improve your skills and defeat the first Ghost Rider!

name: Space Will
short_description: Sixty basic cores, hundreds of base station equipment, and thousands of chips, you can freely cooperate and shoot through the dual-angle joystick operation in a survival Roguelike game! Explore the sci-fi space and build your strongest battleship!

name: 黑暗征途：魔王的命运
short_description: 《黑暗征途：魔王的命运》是一款回合制角色扮演游戏，跟随失踪将军的足迹，探寻魔王存在于大陆中的秘密，收集诡异的恶魔火种，踏上登天阶梯追寻属于自己的命运。

name: MAGIC CHAOS
short_description: 'MAGIC CHAOS' is an online multiplayer bullet-hell shooting party game for up to 4 players. Customize your own unique combination of diverse characters and strategic skills to win the seriously chaotic battle royale!

name: Micro Dungeon
short_description: Turn-based gameplay with roguelike and random elements. What could be better?

name: Leash
short_description: 목줄(leash)은 은유적인 메세지를 담은 시리어스 단편 게임입니다. 당신은 아름닯고 넓은 세계를 탐험할 수... 없습니다.

name: King Must Survive
short_description: In the enchanted world of the Middle Ages, it's a king's struggle for survival! Equipped with top-down shooter mechanics and rogue-lite elements, you must battle against increasingly challenging waves of enemy swarms.

name: TV Studio Story
short_description: Create shows, sign stars, and dominate the airwaves in this TV studio sim.

name: End Of Legends
short_description: A blend of real-time strategy, auto-battler, and roguelike deck building, where you play as the Dark Lord who has lost his memory but retains his purpose to destroy his enemies. Unleash the dark memory, enjoy endless upgrades, vast battles, powerful spells, and ULTIMATE DESTRUCTION!

name: Puzzles For Clef
short_description: Join Clef on an adventure set on a magical sky island where her family once lived. Solve puzzles, discover secrets, and experience a story of sisterly love – and something more, if you are willing to dig deeper…

name: Greebles
short_description: A modern reproduction of a classic game! Navigate the maze and crush Greebles to rack up a high score, just don't let them touch you!

name: Unlock
short_description: A group of passwords in front of you, with no way forward. Impossible to solve.

name: Xatrom Command
short_description: Team up and shoot down waves of invading aliens. Single player or multiplayer top-down shooting action

name: Classified: France '44
short_description: Command an elite team of allied special operators in Nazi-occupied France wreaking havoc in the run up to D-Day in this ambitious turn-based tactics game. Take on the might of Germany's war machine and launch daring raids in occupied territory. Can you do enough to ensure Allied victory?

name: 独闯江湖  lone ranger
short_description: 穿越到武侠世界，看小虾米是怎样从基础拳法开始一步步走向巅峰。击败敌人，可以获得武功秘籍和各类招式。少年，合理使用秘籍释放招式，去击败更多的敌人吧。

name: The Gauntlet
short_description: The Gauntlet is a fast-paced movement driven game where you must survive a series of trials to claim the prize, your freedom. Bad Bat's brutal Game-Show has got a new contestant, lets hope they live to see the re-runs.

name: Stellar Settlers: Space Base Builder
short_description: Stellar Settlers is a chill space base/city builder and colony sim game. With unique vertical and horizontal base-building gameplay, settle on 5 hostile alien planets and build your own thriving colony. Get enough materials to build a physics-based Spaceship and try to escape from disasters.

name: The Saboteur™
short_description: This open-world action thriller takes you through the seedy streets of Paris as you seek to undermine the German authority and lead a rebellion. Fight across rooftops and through dangerous alleys, and operate a wide variety of vehicles as you navigate your terrain.

name: Exanimum: The Silent Call
short_description: 'Exanimum: The Silent Call' is a first-person psychological horror game. In this chilling experience, you will find yourself confronting terrifying mysteries and chilling secrets.

name: LiveMeat活肉
short_description: This is a first person single player horror adventure game. You need to sneak or run in the scene to avoid monsters, search for resources to survive, and find a way to leave.

name: Roses Of Love
short_description: You will be immersed in the story of Yukiko, a girl who wanted to fulfill her dream of studying in the big city of Tokyo.

name: Mister 9
short_description: Look for irregularities in the house where the uncles live. Irregulars are the enemy. For the sake of world peace, shoot without mercy.

name: Zoonomaly
short_description: You must survive a monster infested zoo while searching for key shards that unlock the truth to its origin. Collect all the key shards by solving puzzles throughout the grounds and put a stop to the monster mayhem.

name: Card Fencer
short_description: Journey through distant lands, collect cards to defeat your enemies, and discover other powerful treasures along the way in Card Fencer, a deck building turn-based RPG.

name: The Singing Saw Simulator
short_description: Dive into the sensational world of Singing Saw Simulator - a rythm game with a twist! (Or should that be a bend?) Unleash your inner virtuoso as you soar, swoop, sing, and shred your way to your next musical masterpiece in this pulsing, two-tone, musical performance of a lifetime.

name: Passing By - A Tailwind Journey
short_description: Take to the skies in your balloon ship and explore a colorful world of floating islands. Befriend fellow travelers and quirky islanders, use your wits to solve immersive puzzles, and gather resources to continue your journey towards an unknown destination.

name: Manic Mechanics
short_description: In Manic Mechanics, up to four players pull on their overalls and head to the auto-obsessed Octane Isle, looking to make a name for themselves as travelling mechanics. Whether played solo or with friends, co-op or versus, Manic Mechanics has plenty of comedic chaos to go around!

name: Slidemagi
short_description: Slidemagi is a turn-based strategy game in which units move by sliding the lines of the board. You are a Mage who, using your deck of cards, can summon spells or create units with unique abilities to fight under your control.

name: Wrath of the Roothless
short_description: Wrath of the Roothless is a 2d melee roguelike, where you play as jacob wielding his trusty Drumstick and Trashcan Lid to fight your way through hordes of monsters. Fight your way through to exact revenge and teach those monsters a lesson!

name: Patchouli's Adventure In Doll's House
short_description: Let's unravel the mysteries of the Doll's House with witch Patchouli! Embark on an adventure in the mysterious and beautiful doll's House, find items, solve puzzles, and find the whereabouts of her beautiful lover - Alice. Experience a relaxed and fun story, and discover the secrets of the witches.

name: Ghost Ninja
short_description: Ghost Ninja is an action-packed game that puts players in the shoes of a skilled assassin.

name: Quilts and Cats of Calico
short_description: Quilts and Cats of Calico is a wholesome, award-winning complex puzzle game for 1 to 4 players. Meet adorable cats and sew the coziest quilts. Compete with other players in multiplayer mode, play solo, or delve into the story of a quilter sewing their way through the city of cats.

name: Across Kiloparsecs
short_description: A short science-fiction visual novel where you investigate the mysterious circumstances surrounding the death of a close friend.

name: Touhou ~Red Empress Devil.
short_description: 'Touhou ~Red Empress Devil.' is a bullet-hell shooting roguelike action game. Set in The Scarlet Devil Mansion, the inhabitants of Gensokyo go on a rampage!

name: FloraMancer : Seeds and Spells
short_description: Grow spells! Floramancer is a loop of farming magical plants into spells and then using them to fight for powerful seeds. Every cycle getting closer to saving your forest from deforestation.

name: Acid Planet
short_description: Acid Planet is a strategic wave-survival auto-shooter. Build your base, command your drones and battle to survive against hordes of monsters and gigantic Kaiju.

name: Backpack Battles
short_description: A PvP inventory management auto battler! Buy and craft powerful items, then carefully arrange them in your backpack.

name: Revenge of the Antagonist - BL (Boys Love)
short_description: Gerald isn't a known actor, so he struggles to land roles. But the guy who (unintentionally) made a mockery of him became a popular heartthrob. Who wouldn't feel resentful? Years later, the two reunite as the antagonist and protagonist for a romance drama.

name: 霊迷の湯
short_description: あなたは人気旅館「黎明の湯」の新人アルバイト。毎朝、各客室を見回って「霊現象」が発生していないかを確認しよう。1つも見逃さずに無事にバイトを乗り切ろう。

name: Trash Horror Collection 4
short_description: This collection includes 7 games that will bring you 80s trash movie vibes. Plus a story mode including all games in a unique, bizarre and bloody story!

name: Witches Wishes and Whispers
short_description: Witches Wishes and Whispers is a 'Einstein'-style elimination puzzle where you sort ingredients to make potions. Based on the card clues, you must pick the correct ingredients so all the clues remain true!

name: Where is the meaning?
short_description: «Where is the meaning?» is a JRPG made by two Russian developers with very special attitude to this genre. The action takes place in unknown universe where the player should make conclusions what is happening around. You are the geometric figure «square» which need to reach the end of this world.

name: Endless Ascent
short_description: It begins with you waking up in a strange basement after a tranquilizer has been shot, you realize you've been taken hostage. Now, you must escape! Ascend your way out of the mess through a variety of puzzles and avoid traps to ensure your survival.

name: Top Racer Collection
short_description: The thrill of 16-bit racing from the 90s is back! Play the complete Top Racer series with Top Racer, Top Racer 2, Top Racer 3000 and Top Racer Crossroads, a brand new game with new cars and exclusive content made especially for this unmissable edition.

name: AI Roguelite 2D
short_description: The world's first AI-generated 2D Action RPG.

name: Strange
short_description: The main character, who moves to another city, finds himself in unexpected mysterious events when her new friend disappears.

name: Wild West Saloon
short_description: Howdy partner! In Wild West Saloon you manage and maintain your own saloon. Serve drinks, cook food, clean tables and most importantly keep your customers happy.

name: Corrupted: Dawn of Havoc
short_description: A hardcore auto battle rogue-like deck-building (H.A.R.D) game, 'Corrupted' has the strategy of an auto-battler and the challenging difficulty of a rogue-like. Build your own team and skill card deck, and retake the stolen planet through strategic placement and real-time card use!

name: Win or Crash!
short_description: Win or Crash! is a heart-pumping racing game that will push your driving skills to the limit.

name: Super Boba - Pachinko Cafe
short_description: This is a modern twist on arcade-style pachinko! This is the perfect AFK game for when you would rather watch or put minimal effort and still win! Create shockwaves and gravity wells to manipulate falling objects into target cups. The more you more catch, the more you score!

name: Athena Crisis
short_description: Athena Crisis is a modern retro turn-based strategy game that places you in command of 40+ units in your journey across the multiverse. Embark on a challenging single-player quest or dive into the thrill of ranked or casual multiplayer modes to become the best Athena Crisis player!

name: Inside the machine
short_description: A simple yet challenging puzzle game where a soul has lost its body. It has to navigate from machine to machine through various puzzles in search of its real body. Will it reach its goal or be forever lost in a foreign body?

name: Dreamscape Return
short_description: Let's play games together.

name: BORE BLASTERS
short_description: Blast through rocks with your machine gun drill. Collect rare gems, ores and ancient artefacts, upgrade your ship and unlock new abilities. Uncover the mysteries of the deep and the dangers that lurk below.

name: Chasing the Unseen
short_description: Embark on a challenging journey as you climb colossal creatures, explore otherworldly landscapes, and find what you've been seeking.

name: Let's be a Tiger
short_description: Let's Be a Tiger is an exciting and immersive game that puts you in the role of a powerful tiger in the wild.

name: Hive In Space
short_description: You must overcome the anomalies occurring in space.

name: Outcast - A New Beginning
short_description: Explore the breathtaking alien world of Adelpha, support the local Talans in their struggles and fight your way through fast-paced battles against invading robot forces in this 3rd-person, open world, action adventure sequel to the 1999 cult classic.

name: 13 Seconds
short_description: [13 Seconds] is a hardcore bullet hell roguelike game.Use both hands to control two robots at the same time and fight your way through a barrage of bullets and death rays from merciless machines of destruction!Will you be able to reach the ultimate level 13?

name: MOMENTS OF LOVE
short_description: A young FSB officer from Siberia, he had previously been involved in dubious matters, but believed that it was in the interests of the Motherland. However, one day he met Lena...

name: Potions: A Curious Tale
short_description: Potions: A Curious Tale is an adventure & crafting game where wit is your greatest weapon and combat is not always the answer. Play as Luna, a young witch who overcomes obstacles with the potions she brews, as she gathers items from enchanted lands and conquers devious puzzles on her quest.

name: Slavania
short_description: Fantasy metroidvania with a moral choice and hunting the bosses who are not going to patiently wait for you in their lair. Study the monsters. Track'em. Kill'em. Exploration of the vast interconnected fairytale world, an acrobatic combat system and weird locals are what awaits you.

name: Krosfighter
short_description: Who will be the last one standing? Choose your hero from a wide range of universes and play with friends in this party shooter packed with colorful graphics and rogue-like features. It's just plain fun, online or locally, for two to four players.

name: CHAM THE CAT ADVENTURE
short_description: Jump, punch, and whip enemies as you guide Cham the Cat through her action packed treasure hunt in this retro action platformer!

name: Bery'sCase
short_description: This is a first person horror game where players will take on the role of a detective who discovers the truth behind a family murder case, embarking on a brave adventure

name: Fox Golf
short_description: Do we do a “little” activity? The Fox Golf game opens up a new vision of the sport of golf.

name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley
short_description: Join Snufkin in this musical adventure about restoring harmony and balance to Moominvalley, protecting it from the industrious Park Keeper.

name: Chinese Empire
short_description: Chinese Empire is an economic city-building strategy taking place in the picturesque areas of China. Create your own new empire that will go down in history!

name: Pancho's Mission
short_description: Embark on an epic journey alongside Pancho, the brave panda who has decided to save his world from the tyranny of the evil eagle and its loyal followers. Explore three unique locations — a mysterious forest, an unforgiving desert, and the eagle's cave — by completing 15 captivating levels in each.

name: Lobby 2
short_description: Play as Fallenshadow by taking on the form of 12 girls and access 70 perks to help you fight off your husbands.

name: Backrooms Rec.
short_description: Dive into the Backrooms' mysteries in a solo-developed survival game. Explore eerie corridors, uncover secrets solo or in multiplayer, and face unique challenges. Coming soon to Steam Early Access.

name: Stilt
short_description: Arm up with stilts, get your stolen spaceship back, and join your fellow furballs in the world of Stilt for play!

name: VR Houses: Glass Apartment
short_description: VR Houses: Glass Apartment is a groundbreaking experience where photorealism takes center stage. Step beyond the borders of traditional VR games and immerse yourself in a hyper-realistic digital environment.

name: ReThink 3.5
short_description: ReThink 3.5 is a previously unreleased Puzzle Game rebuilt in Unreal engine 5, in a peaceful futuristic setting, that features a variety of Puzzles that utilize Lasers and the behavior of light and it's colors to create challenging problems to solve.

name: Crystal Guardians
short_description: Crystal Guardians is a tower defense game with rogue-like elements. Fight of waves and defend the world crystal. Gear up your towers with a powerful combination of items for your strategy. In an ever expanding map, find hidden powers and conquer the enemies.

name: Bunny Game
short_description: A multiplayer social deduction game for up to 12 players. Bunnies stock up for winter, while traitors plan mischief. Better watch your back!

name: King of the Bridge
short_description: Face off against the bridge troll in his bizarre game of chess! Decrypt, Twist and Enforce the rules as your devious opponent attempts to break them in King of the Bridge!

name: TEEFAX: Cold Case
short_description: Unravel a cold case after an old laptop containing the photos of a long unidentified victim and a strange app called 'The Door' is found in an abandoned house. The police reckon it may be a cipher of some sort, but after unsuccessful attempts at decoding it, they turn to the public.

name: Horst - Der Ultimatives Rollenspiel
short_description: This game is one but a bad way to learn german. German: Ein Rollenspiel, das versucht seine Existenzberechtigung mit schlechten Wortwitzen zu erklären.

name: 十字防守(X Defense: Timing TD)
short_description: Strategy, timing and fortune: Novel and immersive tower defense game experience!

name: Gravity Pro
short_description: In this arcade game, use your paddle to strike the ball and shatter bricks. Gravity and physics are both your allies and challenges. Master skill and precision to navigate dynamic levels and get high scores. Every hit, every angle, and every rebound plays a crucial role in determining your success.

name: REVEIL
short_description: REVEIL is a narrative first-person psycho-thriller game that focuses on story, puzzles and exploration. Find out what’s going on inside Walter Thompson and what his dark past at the Nelson Bros Circus has to do with it.

name: Endless Wonder VR
short_description: Endless Wonder VR is a colorful VR platformer in which you will need to use unique sticks with unique abilities that can be combined in any way to complete a campaign consisting of various levels with a unique stylized environment, enemies and obstacles.

name: There's No Easter Eggs
short_description: There's no Easter eggs is a casual hidden object game with over 500 Easter eggs to find.

name: CRUX
short_description: Crux is a fast-paced single-player arena shooter roguelike, where you face waves of enemies, unique bossfights and earn powerful magic abilities across 13 arenas. Master your fluid movement, trusty arsenal and the power of the blood gods to reach the top of the CRUX Champions Leaderboard!

name: Abyssal Reflections
short_description: Abyssal Reflections is short Atmospheric depressing 'non-jumpscare' game where you go through a total of 8 different time periods. You'll have to take care of your owners and how you relate to them is up to you.

name: JUSFASLEX
short_description: JUSFASLEX is a short kinetic visual novel about a dreamy boy who strives to create a society in a different dimension while struggling to connect to others.

name: Left Behind
short_description: LEFT BEHIND is a hyper-realistic psychological horror game where you take on the role of a real estate agent with a client looking to sell you a property. Instead of a straightforward and quick interaction with the client, you find yourself thrust into a deeply unsettling and frightening situation.

name: The Thaumaturge
short_description: The Thaumaturge is a story-driven RPG with morally ambiguous choices, taking place in the culturally diverse world of early 20th-century Warsaw. In this world, salutors exist: esoteric beings that only thaumaturges can truly perceive and use for their needs.

name: 3秒ばなな
short_description: This is Banana!

name: 魔星兄弟
short_description: 《魔星兄弟》是一款以刷装备刷宝为核心玩法的单机游戏，敌人和宝箱可以无限重置，打败boss获得不同品质、随机词条和数值的装备，从一无所有到战力巅峰，打败外星侵略者！

name: Gas Gas Rocket!

name: Astro Duel 2

name: WWE 2K24

name: Taxi Life: A City Driving Simulator
short_description: Climb into the driver's seat of your car and your business, transport passengers across Barcelona and grow your company! Can you help relieve the transportation challenges of a city that never sleeps?

name: The shadow of the evil tower
short_description: This is a platform action game with various traps and tons of levels for players to challenge!

name: TRIBES 3: Rivals
short_description: TRIBES 3: Rivals is a team-based first person shooter that elevates the genre with jetpacks, skiing, and class-based warfare. Teamwork, tactics, high speed, and intense combat are supreme in this rebirth of the world’s fastest shooter.

name: Sid Meier's Alpha Centauri™ Planetary Pack
short_description: Sid Meier's Alpha Centauri™ Planetary Pack includes the original Alpha Centauri and the expansion, Alien Crossfire.

name: Subterrain: Mines of Titan

name: Hidden Clues
short_description: Crack the cases! The murders are escalating in the city! Follow the clues to crack the cases and arrest the killers!

name: Synthwave Glider
short_description: Synthwave Glider lets you blast through an abstract world inspired by the 80s, have fun as you chase after your friends high score!

name: Sim City 3000™ Unlimited
short_description: Sim City 3000 Unlimited brings you the classic strategy gaming of Sim City 3000 with all-new scenarios that open up a whole world of city planning and building possibilities! The thrills of the classic Sim City 3000 are here again!

name: The Dawn Of A Flower

name: Burning Ass
short_description: It is a multiplayer platformer set in a post-apocalyptic world full of mysteries, where water is the most valuable resource. If you are an hardcore player, bypass all the traps and be the first to get it! Blood, Gore, Fun!

name: The Czar is Dead

name: God Of Death
short_description: Try to survive by destroying enemies before time runs out. Strengthen your inventory by collecting loot. Combine similar weapons to make them more powerful or upgrade the weapon of your choice. If you're ready, let the battle begin!

Utilize twin stick controls for precise player and racket control. Are you ready to master the ball and dominate on court?

name: Discarnate: Locust
short_description: You are tasked by The Collector to find a painting that has been locked away in the depths of an abandoned house. The Collector does not care how you find it, he cares about results and confidentiality. DO NOT attract unwanted attention, DO NOT fail him. Good luck.

name: Reigns of Samosbor: П747

short_description: RoboSync is a puzzle game that requires logical reasoning and precision to overcome challenges. Release and lock passages at the right time to synchronize your robots' movements and achieve perfect coordination.

short_description: A tribute to the magnificent side-scrolling Arcade shoot’-em-up games with a modern look, physics-based movement, and some challenging twists that will test your speed, reflexes, accuracy, patience, and memory at the same time.

short_description: Monster Shooter is a 3rd person point-based shooter in which you are humanity's last hope to protect your military base and the resources collected on the planet Hoperium against the Roncospheres. Take control and defend every part of the facility. Humanity depends on you!

name: Beach Club Simulator 2024

Wander a vast and colorful fantasy world filled with puzzles, exotic creatures, forgotten dungeons and ancient guardians.

In this dark fantasy Metroidvania, face formidable enemies and explore a bewitching post-apocalyptic world. Humans and Homunculi — what awaits at the end of the quest for their salvation?

name: Weed Harvest
short_description: Drive harvest machine in this simulation game where mission is to cut weed

name: Uncle's Basement
short_description: Are you trapped in a small dark room and want to get out? You don't have much time, so hurry up! Oh, and good luck!

name: Spring Dash
short_description: Catapult yourself to incredible speeds in this first-person precision platformer. Use your command over vegetation to build up momentum and decimate the bugs in your way. Just be careful not to fall!

name: Qwepoi
short_description: Qwepoi is an arcade spaceshooter game using QWE IOP keys where you paint the Infantry ships before they enter the base.

name: Adventure of Rikka - The Cursed Kingdom
short_description: The Adventure of Rikka is a top down 2D action RPG with a focus on puzzles, exploration, secrets and collectibles. You must defeat the dark forces that has cursed the lands, fight enemies using your sword and an arsenal of items such as the bow and fire wand and save the kingdom!

name: Pepper Grinder
short_description: Pepper Grinder is an action-packed 2D adventure blending traditional platforming with an alternate drilling mode that allows you to dive in and out of the earth like a dolphin swims through water.

name: Unleaving
short_description: When everything seems hopeless a child is awakened by the whispers of the last leaf, drawn into an imaginary world. Unleaving invites the player into a narrative-driven puzzle platformer where each challenge unfolds within a hand-painted landscape, exploring perception and meaning

name: FURTIVE
short_description: Prisoners of war, your team was captured but on the run on a large military controlled island. Explore, gather resources, build a shelter and survive the dangerous military presence on the look out for your team in this epic first person, multiplayer, open world, survival adventure.

name: The Last Explorer
short_description: Discover an alien world, study and befriend creatures and take beautiful photos along the way.

name: Blood Midnight Blossom
short_description: An ordinary girl named Annihilation inherits a huge debt from her father and is desperate to find a way out. On the street, she meets a stranger in a raincoat, called Catharsis, who offers a demonic part-time job for a week.

name: The World's Egg - For Those Who Dream
short_description: Mari lives an ordinary life with her best friend, Kotone, in an ordinary town. Suddenly, their peaceful lives are shattered when they're attacked by monsters from another world.

name: Claw Machine Sim
short_description: Physically accurate claw machine simulator! Win 200 unique prizes in the Fun or Realistic difficulty mode.

name: Casual Mahjong
short_description: A single-player Japanese Riichi Mahjong game. After intense battles with real players, why not enjoy a relaxed and delightful match?

name: PLEASE STOP CRYING
short_description: PLEASE STOP CRYING is a lighthearted horror game about a father taking on housework and babysitting all at once.

name: Stranded Shootout
short_description: Stranded Shootout is a roguelike bullet hell game about a space marine who crash-landed on an unknown planet. Upon awakening, the marine realizes that he and his ship are besieged by hostile aliens. Test your skills and see how long you can endure the endless onslaught.

name: String Theory
short_description: String Theory is a colorful puzzle game about matching a given pattern by building it out of different colored shapes.String theory has 60+ handcrafted puzzles, daily challenges, free play modes, and a level editor, making for hours of fun.

name: Psychometric Personality Profiler
short_description: This is a very interesting personality Test made to specifically suit you as the Perticipant. Please be honest about the answers and take your time. And by all means don't take your eyes off the screen...

name: Anidu: Animal Dust Puppet’s Adventure
short_description: 『Anidu: Animal Dust Puppet’s Adventure』 is a 2 player online co-op game about animal puppets' adventures in the world. Use all kinds of superpowers given to each puppet to explore by solving puzzles.

name: Monsters of Mican
short_description: A whimsical party-based first person turn-based dungeon crawler RPG. Discover the origin of Monsters in Mican as you explore unique handcrafted dungeons, battle hundreds of diverse monsters, learn dozens of spells, and find tons of secrets and loot!

name: SwordSpin: Arena of Blades
short_description: SwordSpin is a indie game in the casual genre that combines different aspects of game design, such as strategy, creativity but still retains its casualty. Players will play as a character that wields a warrior who is using a spinning sword, and his task is to fight mobs to survive in the arena.

name: Escape the Traps
short_description: 'Escape the Traps' is an addictive and challenging game that puts your skills and reflexes to the test.

name: BouncingBalls
short_description: You will start with a weapon in a kind of training box with the sides slanted. Then balls fall from the sky that you have to hit, big balls that are easy to hit and small balls that are difficult to hit. Try to get as far as you can and don't let the balls hit you

name: Dawn of Mages
short_description: Dominate and prove your supremacy in this new PvP Battle Arena. Dawn of Mages employs your skills and makes good use of your cunning, with a free targeting system, over 100 different builds and unique maps. Lay down the classical guns, the sword&board and join the realm of reality bending spells.

name: 御剑传说
short_description: Legend of the Sword is a casual survival game. In the game, players first need to ensure their survival. The operation of the game is very simple. Clicking the left mouse button is the operation of the sword. Clicking the right mouse button is, homecoming, the operation

name: Zombies!!! Board Game
short_description: Zombies!!! puts you in the middle of the action in this video game adaptation of the hit board game. In order to escape the ever advancing zombie horde, players must use a combination of wits and brawn to be the first to the heliport and certain escape.

name: AutoForge
short_description: A 2D automation sandbox adventure. Build an automated factory reaching up to the sky and deep underground, uncover a vast world filled with wonder and danger, upgrade yourself with ancient technologies, and defend it all from enemy attack.

name: Voice Love on Air
short_description: A BL dating sim with elements of studio management and interactions with voice actors! Follow Aki, a newbie voice director who has to complete the recordings for several BL dramas, and interact with the charming voice actors. Come give voice to the language of love!

name: Hunchback's Dungeon
short_description: Destroy hordes of undead skeletons in this top-down roguelite arena shooter. In Hunchback's Dungeon, you play as a deformed, magic-wielding human who can control up to 4 different spells. Unlock new characters, collect unique items, equip powerful spells, and survive until the end.

name: Dollar King
short_description: Cute & cool cat politicians battle in this deck-building game! Play unlimited against players worldwide in this online two-player game! Win by collecting more votes than your opponent using a variety of cards!

name: Godsworn
short_description: Godsworn is a classic mythological RTS. Experience an epic fantasy retelling of the northern crusades, where pagan gods and their tribes clash against crusaders and armies of heaven. Choose a divine hero, rally worshippers alongside mythical creatures, and smite the unworthy!

name: Potato Arena
short_description: Potato Arena is a Party Game in which you are playing with total of 4 players. Lots of fun and challenging parkour maps are waiting for you to discover and overcome! Grab your keyboard or favourite gamepad, and join the party!

name: King Island
short_description: The first installment of the King Island Trilogy! An immersively funny ARPG. Explore, fight enemies, complete quests, and level up your character in a world filled with treasures, battles, comedy and crazy cows!

name: War Tortoise
short_description: War Tortoise is a new type of idle game, taking core incremental gameplay and adding new features and advanced graphics. Explore, command and upgrade, equip weapons and armor, level up, unlock abilities, recruit heroes and pilots, and more!

name: King Kong City Destroyer
short_description: Your mission is clear: fulfill King Kong's relentless desires as he wreaks havoc upon everything in his path.

name: Doll Impostor
short_description: 'Doll Impostor' is a horror game where you're the guardian of possessed dolls. Identify the impostor before 9 a.m. or face dire consequences. Every hour counts in this race against fear.

name: Tokyo 30 days
short_description: 《Tokyo 30 Days》 is a narrative card game. The male host comes to Tokyo from the countryside and unexpectedly lives in sisters Hua's house for 30 days. Whether to leave or stay... Different choices will lead to different endings. Are you ready to embark on this enviable journey?

name: Meow Legion
short_description: Meow Legion is a game about assembling an army of cats to defend against waves of enemies.A top-down roguelite shooter game where you hire cats and level them up to fight mice from the evil Mousy Empire!

name: The Land Past Redemption
short_description: The Land Past Redemption is a medieval, turn-based combat rogue-lite. Take on bounties, recruit more heroes, get better loot, and earn enough gold to pay your way out of the Land Past Redemption.

name: Knowledge, or know Lady
short_description: You, the 'sole male student' at a women's university, are about to embark on a sweet and laughter-filled campus love journey from a first-person perspective! How will you resist the temptations of the beauties and create your own legend in this girls' school?

name: Jet Skiing Race
short_description: Prepare to immerse yourself in the ultimate aquatic thrill ride with Jet Skiing Race!

name: Bass Invaders
short_description: Infinite Rhythm Action. Join Ace and PZO-116 as they repel alien invaders whose only weakness is music. Battle using any song from local files or online video with automatic beatmap generation. Nail the perfect run and top the leaderboard on your favourite tracks. Your music will save the world.

name: Millennia
short_description: Create your own nation in Millennia, a historical turn-based 4X game that challenges your strategic prowess across 10,000 years of history, from the dawn of humanity to our possible futures.

name: Mole Royal
short_description: Get ready for an adrenaline-pumping, multiplayer thrill in 'Mole Royal' - the ultimate whack-a-mole experience. Race against the clock and your friends, proving your whacking skills in this ultimate arcade experience !

name: KERIBATO!
short_description: This title is a simple RPG puzzle game. In a dungeon crawling with monsters, the goddess Nike is fighting to regain her wings. Level up by kicking weak enemies in the back while running away from strong enemies that are chasing you! Aim to defeat Kronos, the king of the Titan tribe!

name: To Be In Love With Girls Group
short_description: 'To Be Love With Girls Group' is the world's first real-life interactive video game for nurturing girl groups, produced by 'Guanghe Media'. Game players will take on the role of a girl group agent from the first perspective in the game to search for and discover girl group trainees

name: 漂流瓶盖 Drifting Bottle Cap
short_description: you returned home feeling exhausted. Everything has put a lot of pressure on you. Suddenly, you see several bottle caps in the water, your pressure is not high anymore. The most fun thing you found about this game is that it can't be played, you think to yourself: that's really fun.

name: Your Majesty
short_description: Enter your name and start your own dynasty. Rule your empire and choose between developing technology or culture, governing diligently or lazily. Through a series of memorials and decisions, you will determine the fate of your nation.

name: Exit: Left or Right
short_description: You can go left or right, but remember, a mistake will cost you your life…

name: Buckshot Arena
short_description: Play Russian Roulette in western setting with a shotgun loaded with live and blank shells. Use items to gain a tactical advantage. Fight against friends or random people at the same table of up to 8 people and become the last survivor with full pockets of money.

name: My Life: Farm Vet
short_description: They need you on the farm - examine and treat lots of animals!

name: Help the Cats
short_description: Here are some cute hand-drawn cats that need your help. You can help by finding hidden things around you. Guess the cats' clues to lift the tablecloth, search through the mouse hole, and open the door. If you open the tomb incorrectly, you may be in for a surprise!

name: Clutter Puzzle Magazine Vol. 15 No. 1 Collector's Edition
short_description: By far, the most challenging and exciting Clutter ever. More fun and challenging than even Clutter RefleXIVe. You will not believe the Spot The Differences Puzzles. And wait until you see the Eyeballs!!!

name: Loop Theory
short_description: Loop Theory is a horror game in which every minute spent in the game changes your idea of the story. Take on the role of a character with a mysterious past and find out about what happened.

name: Spark Of Nature
short_description: Experience the adventure of a curious Aloe Vera in a magic and fun big world!

name: Battle RC
short_description: Immerse yourself in this new robot combat game where you'll fight against others and build your own bots to find out who's best. Are you prepared to dominate the arena and claim victory in Battle RC?

name: Outflow
short_description: Experience Atlas’s journey in the future world to save his planet. Beat the enemies with unique mechanics and explore a huge open world in this action RPG.

name: Wrestling Cardboard Championship
short_description: In the WCC, cardboard boxes with unique skills and moves, fight in large arenas based on Madison Square Garden, Arena Mexico and the Tokyo Dome.

name: Peraglees - The Ooloufian Resistance
short_description: Dive into the world of the Peraglees! Embark on an epic quest with KAOTIX, Dexter and Slade Fury (in co-op) as they face off against the evil Old Whiplin. Traverse nine exhilarating planets, each brimming with distinctive boss to battles. Be the hero and save the Fennyverse!

name: Little Eden
short_description: In this mix of farming simulator and spaceship shooter, you control Little Eden, a flying farm-ship. Destroy planetoids, collect seeds to plant, craft ammunition and fight for survival against the terrible Pirate Coalition.

name: The Vampire
short_description: The Vampire is a first-person horror adventure game designed for single player use only. Would you like to spend the night with Cooper, a stoic vampire hunter who holds the secrets of an ancient legend? Defeat the vampires and escape their world.

name: Jishin
short_description: Jishin, is a tower defense game where the ground is anything but stable. As waves of relentless enemies surge towards your base, you'll not only need to strategically build towers, but also adapt to the ever-shifting battlefield.

name: Shadow Corridor 2 雨ノ四葩
short_description: Lost forever in the pitch black! But that's what makes it fun! The vast corridors covered in darkness change with each play. All you can do is run or hide from the frightening Apparitions. Use unique items and Karuta cards with special powers in your desperate search for an escape from the darkness!

name: Le Château
short_description: Create your own Medieval Kingdom and watch your world come to life in this minimalistic city builder. Choose your world's size and shape, and turn it into a kingdom any ruler would be jealous of.

name: Outpost: Infinity Siege
short_description: Command Mobile Outpost and take XEN Firearm to venture deep into the Signet surveillance off-limit area. Collect unique Weapon Units. Amp up the firepower of the Outpost that fights with you. This is an FTD game - FPS, Tower Defense, Base Building and much more all at the same time.

name: Fancyland
short_description: After breaking in to an abandoned indoor amusement park, finding clues and solving puzzles, you soon realize that your investigation is not just a search for answers, but a desperate struggle for survival against a sinister force that lurks within.

name: Fuck You Witch
short_description: Your best friend has confessed her love for you... but the problems don't stop there. You've started to hallucinate. All this interferes with sleeping and eating, and in general disrupts your ideal lifestyle. Yell obscenities at the witch, immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the Qazaq steppes

name: What's Missing?
short_description: What's Missing? is a first-person, surreal puzzle game where you spot the differences between repeating identical rooms. Explore the limits of changes as it goes beyond just physical objects. Follow Gregory's journey to escape this magical loop and unveil the mystery of his dark past...

name: Vellum
short_description: Dive into the magic tomes of Vellum, a cooperative action roguelike. Discover pages of increasing power, sling ink-infused spells, and choose how your foes evolve - as a group or solo!

name: Ruins Escape
short_description: Ruins Escape is a thrilling and challenging game that puts you in the shoes of a character trapped in an ancient ruins complex.

name: Distant Bloom
short_description: From a world in ruins to a world in bloom. This serene management game lets you explore an alien planet where things have gone amiss. Harness the power of plants to restore the environment and build a flourishing community with your crewmates.

name: Beach Club Simulator
short_description: Beach Club Simulator goes beyond just managing a beach club; it also offers an impressive social interaction and relationship system. In the game, you can engage with customers, make friends with them, and experience relationships.

name: Open Roads
short_description: Long-lost family secrets. Hints of a hidden fortune. And miles to go before they sleep. Tess Devine’s relationship with her mom has never been easy, but they’re about to set out together on a journey into the past that they’ll never forget.

name: VECTOR ZONE
short_description: VECTOR ZONE is a gripping survival game where the weight of leadership rests on your shoulders. Set in a post-apocalyptic world teeming with dangers, your task is to manage a camp of diverse NPC survivors and lead them to safety while constructing vital structures for their survival.

name: Bulwark: Falconeer Chronicles
short_description: Bulwark: Falconeer Chronicles is an open world builder with freedom and expression at its core, allowing players to build sprawling towns, spires, and fortresses that become hubs for trade, or rallying grounds for conquests.

name: Gift for You
short_description: 'Gift for You' is a puzzle action game consisting of 25 stages. Players must conquer a variety of puzzles and aim for the top ranking by clearing time.

name: Go Fight Fantastic
short_description: Bird Planet is under attack! Team up in co-op (local and online) or fight the invaders solo in this fast-paced, light-hearted and vibrantly hand-drawn hack n’ slash for 1-3 players.

name: Drop Mahjong tiles
short_description: A fusion of drop-style gameplay with Mahjong. Enjoyable for Mahjong enthusiasts and newcomers alike, offering a novel gaming experience even to those unfamiliar with Mahjong rules.

name: Crystal Guard TD
short_description: Stop hordes of robots from destroying your Crystal shrine in this random shop tower defense game! Instead of choosing exactly what tower to place down, the random shop gives you 3 random towers to choose from. Set up your defenses and see if you can survive!

name: Armored War
short_description: Armored War is a realistic tactical first-person shooter set in the realities of modern conflict. Take part in ground battles using a full arsenal of weapons and equipment

name: Kādomon: Hyper Auto Battlers
short_description: Collect and battle over 180 unique creatures in this roguelike auto-battler. Level-up and evolve your Kādomon as you assemble the ultimate team, creating awesome synergies to beat BIG bosses!

name: Seven Lovers In The House
short_description: 这是一款让你尽享「齐(七)人之福」的男性向恋爱互动影游。在这里你将与七位美女同住、同乐、同风雨，在这里爱与梦想绕梁不绝。

name: King Towers
short_description: Welcome to King Towers, a challenging Retro Flash Tower Defence. Protect your life, gold and mana from fast and very ugly villagers, knights, evil witches and cows armed to their teeth!

name: Clean the Sea!
short_description: Make the planet beautiful!

name: Other Side Of Mist And Mountain
short_description: In 2005, a sophomore student named Maha Igarashi boarded a private train to Soukyo City. However, she vanished upon alighting at the 'Kisaragi' station. Five years later, her lover, Shizuno Yokoyama, initiated an investigation into her disappearance, unraveling a series of mysteries along the way.

name: Tennis Girl
short_description: The player is about to enter a girl's tennis academy, where the students are all beautiful, and extremely talented tennis girls. Outsiders call them 'tennis girls'. Player need to conquer these girls with you tennis skills!

name: Polda
short_description: Pancras is a neurotic cop investigating a case of mysterious kidnapping in the town of Lupany. Help him find out, who’s behind the abduction of two orderly citizens!

name: Contraptions Collection
short_description: Contraptions is a physics-based puzzle game with a fun cartoony look. This game takes three games; Contraptions, Contraptions 2 and Contraptions 3 and combines them into one value pack of creative fun.

name: Under The Yoke
short_description: Under The Yoke is a 2D medieval peasant life-sim. Make your mark in the Domesday book as you control a family of serfs through 250 years of English history. Cultivate your lands, craft goods and hone your reputation as you navigate the tumultuous Middle Ages. Your family’s future is yours to shape!

name: Engine Room
short_description: Fight your way through hostile space while managing a fragile ship from its heart - the Engine Room. Retreat to upgrade the ship or push your luck further into enemy territory for better rewards - or maybe get blown to pieces! Fight bosses, balance power, and manage supplies to stay alive!

name: Stellar Orphans
short_description: 'Explore 'Stellar Orphans, a captivating deck-building game where every choice determines the fate of your crew lost in the infinite space. Form alliances, manage resources, and resolve crises to guide your 'Stellar Orphans' to survival. Ready to defy the stars?'

name: A Divine Guide To Puzzle Solving
short_description: A Divine Guide To Puzzle Solving is a narrative puzzle adventure that transports you to the realm of the gods. As a mere mortal, you are chosen by the enigmatic puzzle deity Tobla. Your task: test the latest collection of divine puzzles - all completely (not) at your own free will, of course.

name: Lost Lands: Stories of the First Brotherhood
short_description: A strong brotherhood is forged only in difficult trials. “Lost Lands: Stories of the First Brotherhood” is an adventure game in the genre of Hidden Objects, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters and complicated quests.

name: Hulzuyot: Horror Game
short_description: You are a salary man who will experience terrifying situations due to a special illness, all while carrying out household chores.

name: MACROSS -Shooting Insight-
short_description: Introducing an all-new Macross game, the latest entry in the landmark science fiction franchise! Embark upon a galaxy-spanning mission to rescue the missing songstresses!

name: Katana's Path
short_description: Katana's Path is a fast-paced arena arcade slasher, where you can control your samurai and your katana in a unique game mechanic. Slash through many enemies at a rainy cyberpunk city or colorful forests using the best gear you can get!

name: Sealed in Wax
short_description: This isn't your grandpa's roguelite, deckbuilding, card game.

name: Jets Killer
short_description: Jets Killer is an action-packed game where you are in charge of defending your military base from enemy helicopters that are attacking.

name: Giant Hornet
short_description: Giant Hornet is a simulator of the survival struggle of a newborn hornet against many enemies in the deadly forest to become a giant queen hornet.

name: Cannot Contain
short_description: Cannot Contain is a horror game set in an underground containment facility with point-and-click style elements combined with free-roam. As a new security guard, you must maintain the facility and ensure the containment of all residents, while also trying not to die in the process...

name: There's Something In The Ice
short_description: In 2015, three scientists at the Antarctic research station 'Zarya' drilled into the ice to a depth of 2 kilometers and took samples for study... It seems that what they found was not at all what they were looking for...

name: Fantasy Madness: Bloodbath
short_description: Fantasy Madness: Bloodbath is a roguelike action-survival game where forces of nature fight against hordes of evil. Gain new skills, loot powerful items and defeat all who stand in your way… By all means!

name: Felvidek
short_description: In Felvidek, a JRPG set in 15th century Slovakia, you embrace the role of an alcoholic knight Pavol. Meet diverse and interesting characters to help you drive out the Hussites and Ottomans who blight this land.

name: Mini Zen Garden
short_description: Create your own mini zen garden in this calming sandbox game. Decorate your beautiful garden with a minimalistic set of objects. Share your garden with others, sit back, and relieve your day’s stress.

name: Terra Memoria
short_description: A shortage of magic crystals and the sudden awakening of ancient robots leads six new friends on an incredible investigation across Terra – a cozy and fantastic world that combines 3D and pixel art.

name: NYZD
short_description: Yup you guessed it, another zombie shooter game but I swear it is diffrent just try it out lol. And while you are there bring your homies so you can have a LAN party like in good ol days

name: Carpathian Night Starring Bela Lugosi
short_description: Prince Dracula, Lord of the Vampires, has returned from the Devil's Scholomance with the Army of the Dead at his back! Guide vampire hunters Abbot Dorin and Irina Dracul across the monster plagued countryside and into the heart of the ancient Castle Dracula!

name: Orb of Aeternum
short_description: A bite sized dungeon manager game that requires new strategies every time you play! Mine, build, and fight your way to success.

name: Turbo Champ
short_description: Turbo Champ is a fast-paced, arcade racing game. Unlock unique cars in the single-player campaign, play locally with your friends, or online via Remote Play Together. Will you be the world's next Turbo Champ?

name: Back in Prehistory
short_description: Back in Prehistory is an exciting adventure game where you take on the role of a character who stumbles upon a time machine while exploring prehistoric times.

name: Room
short_description: I thought it was just an ordinary day, but I accidentally entered this endless cycle of rooms. Among the countless terrifying and anomalous things, there is a girl who seems like she shouldn't exist here.

name: Monster&Strategy
short_description: A dungeon adventure card game, a maze generated by the program, unpredictable monster combinations, and a large number of cards, treasures, to measure the trade-offs and build your unique card set!

name: MY DESTINY GIRLS
short_description: Xiao Bao opened his eyes, he was surrounded by six women. He embarked on an immersive journey of love with them. Amongst them were a gaming enthusiast, a sultry dancer, a childhood crush, a sexy doctor, an innocent schoolgirl, and a wealthy businesswoman. Who would be his true love?

name: Roll the Ball
short_description: Balance, pace and win the race! Embark on a thrilling journey with Roll the Ball! Dive into vibrant visuals across three unique biomes as you race against the clock to reach the finish line. Choose from three engaging game modes, Time Rush, Challenge and Speed Run and try to reach the top!

name: Hot And Lovely ：Suger
short_description: Hot And Lovely: Suger is a classic puzzle match-3 game. Players need to eliminate three or more tiles of the same type to complete the specified goal, and within the specified number of steps. Every time you complete the goal, you pass the level and you can unlock the photo album.

name: Emotional flow
short_description: A precision platformer game where there is no jump button!

name: 東方幻想魔録W ～ The Devil of Decline
short_description: 四人の主人公から一人を選び、幻想郷全土を巻き込んだ 「神隠し」の異変を解決せよ！ 「式神」と呼ばれる仲間は百人以上。 自分だけの式神の組み合わせで異変を解決に導こう！

name: HEBEREKE Enjoy Edition
short_description: Where am I pyooooo??? HEBEREKEis back and so is his great and surreal adventure! A mysterious little creature Hebe fell into a mysterious world. Discover a brand new world, explore every corner, find the treasures with your new wonderful friends, and use their skills to find new places.

name: We Are Not Alone
short_description: We Are Not Alone is a new twist on horror that combines first person exploration and third person point and click adventure. As a member of a 'safe' isolation experiment you'll explore an underground facility, solve puzzles and uncover the mystery of an unknown creature. Just don't make eye contact.

name: Bot Patrol
short_description: Guide your robot through hours of puzzling fun across three vibrant biomes, brimming with unique mechanics. Uncover the mystery behind missing colleague bots as you strive for freedom in this truly puzzling adventure.

name: SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY!
short_description: Play as the New kid in South Park and join Cartman, Stan, Kyle, and Kenny, in three-dimensional glory, to celebrate the most magical day in any young child’s life - a snow day!

name: BOXHEAD:Immortal
short_description: A deadly plague arrives as a falling meteorite lands at BOXHEAD World. Mankind with blood type B gets infected by the plague and becomes zombie like creatures. You who are trying to survive must shoot your first bullet, and trigger any explosive materials to demolish in this bloody battleground.

name: Neoproxima
short_description: Investigating a time-loop during the Cold War, light years away from Earth. Neoproxima is a text-based adventure game that combines exploration and simple RPG and survival mechanics. Plan your next loop carefully, and go as far as possible before time catches up with you.

name: thanks mom
short_description: 'thanks mom' is an adventure game where you control a baby. You are given milk by your mother and sleeping soundly. In your dream, you remember the trials and tribulations that happened in the past. It may have been the days of struggle before you were born.

name: PC Tycoon 2
short_description: Manage your computer company and develop your PC components, create your own laptop, monitor, develop an interactive operating system or build your PC. Research new technologies, improve your office and your factory, hire the best employees, buy other companies and build your computer empire!

name: The Settlers: New Allies
short_description: The Settlers®: New Allies is a strategy game with an in-depth build-up experience and real-time strategic battles.

name: Missile Dancer 2
short_description: Missile Dancer 2 is a new sprite scaler shmup that combines rail shooter and caravan STG.

name: Necrosmith 2
short_description: Like a dead man reanimated by dark sorcery, the necromancer simulator is back! Give the undead the ability to fly over mountains and swim across rivers, explore a fully generated world at night and fend off enemy hordes during the day. Start a new, uhm, life.

name: The Wrath of the Goose King
short_description: The Wrath of the Goose King has been unleashed and it's up to the red pandas to save the day! In this rogue-lite adventure you recruit adorable and cunning Pandamembers to fight the geese in turn-based combat. Will you be the one to save pandakind?

name: The Journalist
short_description: Equipped with 35mm film camera, a journalist embarks on a journey into a neighborhood of Seoul that is slated to be redeveloped. The Journalist is a photography action adventure filled with unique challenges.

name: DYSCHRONIA: Chronos Alternate - Dual Edition
short_description: Solve an impossible murder case in the far-flung future in this VR & Non-VR investigation action adventure! Multi-awarded title DYSCHRONIA: Chronos Alternate - Dual Edition contains all three episodes from the acclaimed trilogy.

name: Hide for Cat - all for the best -
short_description: 【A talented cat hides 'floors and walls'】 This game is a 2D puzzle action game where you aim to clear the world in a world where the terrain changes exactly as you see it by hiding floors and walls so that they are no longer visible.

name: 黑石
short_description: The game will center around two investigators who uncover a profound terror while delving into consecutive disappearances. A man with a dual-layered memory, a fragmented reality, an endless rainy night... What in the world is the Black Stone? Could it possibly mark the genesis of everything?

name: Nine Lives Ninja: Explore!
short_description: Take control of a cat (who also happens to be a ninja) in this platformer with metroidvania elements! Explore the ancient cave system and find new powers to help you overcome obstacles in your search for the Fountain of Kitty Youth.

name: DUCK's most terrible day
short_description: A time-bending 2D platformer in the least amount of pixels possible.

name: Duck Dash
short_description: 'Duck Dash' is a top-down arena shooter roguelite game. Players take on the role of a little duck and embark on a journey of growth, strategically selecting optimal skill combinations to become a mighty warrior.

name: Bridge Maker
short_description: Each level presents a fresh puzzle, testing your creativity and engineering acumen.

name: SENTRY
short_description: SENTRY is an action-defense first person shooter where you defend your spaceship against invading aliens. Plot an escape route through hostile space and battle the enemy across your vessel with the support of traps, turrets and environmental destruction.

name: Enlisted: Reinforced
short_description: In Enlisted, you are not only commanding a single soldier, but an entire squad! This MMO squad based shooter recreates the key battles of the bloodiest war of the 20th century, with hundreds of soldiers, tanks and aircraft taking part in each battle.

name: Geneforge 2 - Infestation
short_description: Wildly open-ended adventure in a unique fantasy world. Use battle or diplomacy and trickery to change the world, served by an army of custom-made mutant monsters. Almost 90 zones to explore and 50+ hours of gameplay. Enormous range of abilities, factions, quests, and paths to victory.

name: WizUp!
short_description: Incremental game with unfolding mechanics, resource management, and WIZARDS!

name: Unstrayed
short_description: Detect anomalies and survive in a space module! Can you break the experiment loop and reveal all the secrets?

name: Super Pixel Merge Balls
short_description: Drop balls and combine them to get enough points until you find the Master Beach Ball Thug Life on this cute, fun and relaxing pixel art game. How many point will you get?

name: BMX Streets
short_description: Ready to hit the streets? BMX Streets brings the essence of street riding to your fingertips. Experience the next generation of BMX gaming with realistic physics, meaningful customization and a massive open world. Practice, experiment and explore to find your own unique style and master the streets.

name: The Russian Roulette Game : PR
short_description: The classic Russian roulette with friends, With a small twist to bring more chaos and fun to the gameplay.

name: Unspoken
short_description: You find yourself in the center of inexplicable nightmare. Make your way through the horror, come face to face with terrible events. Immerse yourself in the dark mystery of the events in which you found yourself an unwitting participant.

name: Sinister Night 2
short_description: Nine Streamers enter an ancient Chinese mansion, hoping to attract a huge following and become famous through livestreaming. However, two of them are tragically possessed by evil spirits. These possessed will slaughter their companions, and complete a malevolent ritual of a ghostly wedding.

name: bing chilling
short_description: This is an minimalist clicker game called bing chilling. In this game you will be clicking an ice cream, and with each click you will gain one more ice cream. The only goal in this game is to gain more ice creams.

name: Banshee Hunt
short_description: Banshee Hunt is a hunting horror game featuring the Banshee, a supernatural spirit from Irish folklore, on an island isolated from the world. Track the creature by listening to its distant cries and loud screams, prepare your weapon and kill it, before it reaches you.

name: Ario
short_description: A fantasy land plagued by nightmares, a common lad trying to rescue his missing mother and an evil forces conspiration to be unveiled. Join Ario in this thrilling adventure where your crossbow and skills will determine the fate of your people.

name: BIOMORPH
short_description: BIOMORPH is a dark metroidvania game where you become the creatures that you kill! Solve ingenious puzzles and navigate a stunning hand-drawn world. Meet quirky characters, rebuild a city, and uncover the secrets of a sprawling, fallen civilization… and of your own mysterious origins.

name: Interstellar Plunderer
short_description: Interstellar Plunderer is an indie arcade-style 3D roguelike space shooter game. Take control of a pirate spaceship as you fly through wormholes, do battles with hordes of oncoming enemies, fight fearsome bosses, and gain plunder to spend on new ships and upgrades. How far can you go?

name: Victory at Sea Atlantic - World War II Naval Warfare
short_description: Victory At Sea Atlantic transports you to the cold, unforgiving waters of the Atlantic Theatre in WWII. With a vast array of ships, planes, and subs, engage in epic sea battles & secure your place in history. Victory At Sea Atlantic is the ultimate naval warfare experience.

name: Skybound: Card Survival
short_description: You're exiled to floating islands by the Gods, forced to entertain them forever. Stripped of your free will, you are cursed to act only through cards. Gather resources, battle monsters and survive the night. Explore the mysterious world and lead your character to triumph.

name: Sons of Valhalla
short_description: Sons of Valhalla is a combat and base-building game set in the Viking Age. Build fortresses and lay siege to enemy strongholds, gather warriors and board longboats, and engage in personal combat as you raid and conquer across England.

name: Pseudo-Haunting
short_description: Fend off spirits by ripping your spirit off your body. Explore a glitched haunted house. Recall twisted memories. Get out alive.

name: NO REPORT
short_description: 'NO REPORT' is a first-person, walking simulator, psychological horror game. Be cautious and observant; there is something hiding in these rooms, looking for you..

name: Toy Toy Up!
short_description: Experience the thrill of Toy Toy Up, where the whimsical world of toys meets adrenaline-fueled action!

name: I Can See You
short_description: I Can See You is a riveting first-person horror game based on real home invasion stories. With ultra-realistic graphics and a minimalist UI, it offers a heart-racing survival experience. Navigate a terrifying environment, make critical choices, and outwit an unseen enemy.

name: DESOLATIUM
short_description: DESOLATIUM is a first-person point & click Graphic Adventure based on Lovecraft Mythos. Live this horror story where you will have to visit mysterious locations, face lovecraftian creatures, find clues and combine objects to solve puzzles.

name: Silverwood Bay: An Eleanor Grey Mystery
short_description: Eleanor Grey moves to Silverwood Bay to seek inspiration for her writing.

name: Horror School Story
short_description: Immerse yourself in the foreboding atmosphere of Enspire School of Digital Art, brought to life with realistic graphics. Solve intricate puzzles and face psychological challenges to progress through the nightmarish school environment. FACE YOUR FEAR and ESCAPE THE NIGHT.

name: 13层：公寓异常管理员 13 Floors: Anomalies
short_description: You get a strange job. Your job is to patrol a 13th-floor apartment, look for anomalies...

name: Purpose 1951
short_description: 'Purpose 1951' is an almost pure walking simulator set in the United States of 1951. You play as a retired doctor whose life falls apart.

name: Seifuku Kanojo
short_description: 《制服女友》是日本视觉小说游戏资深大厂ENTERGRAM制作的一款新时代恋爱模拟游戏。在本作中，玩家可以通过社交软件自由地与穿着制服的各位女主角发展关系，增进情谊。 而你，想与谁相伴，让她成为独属于你的「制服女友」呢？

name: From Glory To Goo
short_description: From Glory To Goo is a Sci-Fi Survival RTS set on an alien world. Serve as humanity's bulwark by establishing a colony and supporting your colonists still in orbit. But beware, for The Goo, a relentless and shape-shifting force approaches from all sides, even above and below.

name: GESTALT: The Fifth Day
short_description: Wickeina 'Wicke' Gestalt lives in a haunted house. Trying to balance the stresses of life with the horrors of her home, play through a point-and-click psychological horror and multiple scenarios, where success and failure both progress the narrative of her story.

name: FateChessboard
short_description: 《Fate Chessboard》 is a Minesweeper and DBG-style Roguelike game that combines an innovative turn-based combat system. you'll need to use wisdom and strategy to continuously build your own deck of cards, battle powerful enemies, and emerge victorious. Get ready to embark on your adventure!
