name: Deitydead：Elder Trial
short_description: This is a innovative Roguelike game. We've replaced traditional, linear skill progression with a revolutionary custom skill system.With this system, you can transform a simple fireball spell into a rapid-fire fireball machine gun, or even a high-damage, wide-area fireball cannon！

name: Buckshot Roulette
short_description: Play Russian roulette with a 12-gauge shotgun. Two enter. One leaves. Roll the dice with your life. Good luck!

name: Super Drunken Guy
short_description: 2d Platformer in a drunken beer world - are you drunken enough for this game ?

name: I AM KILT
short_description: I AM KILT is a twin-stick shooter roguelite where you fend off endless hordes of enemies. Combine upgrades to overwhelm the opposition and dominate the field. Do you have the forethought and skill to survive?

name: Center Station Simulator
short_description: Inherit an abandoned shopping center. Make it functional and produce many products in your underground laboratory! Get rich by selling them to your customers. Develop and expand your center with many features!

name: Seren Nova
short_description: Seren Nova is a top-down 3D retro sci-fi game set in a solar system at war. Choose the best ship to complete each mission and take out the enemy across various planets. You can even land your ship and take the war to the enemy on foot. Featuring a fun retro sci-fi live-action cutscenes and puppets!

name: Chamberflame
short_description: Action-roguelite shooter. Each run is different from the last, with unique weapons, items, enemies, and randomly generated biomes.

name: Anzeigenhauptmeister Simulator
short_description: No exceptions!Make the streets (in)secure as the Master Chief of Criminal Complaints and conquer the leaderboard of the local online watch!

name: Military Transporter Sim
short_description: Prepare for an adrenaline-fueled journey into the heart of military logistics with Military Transporter Sim.

name: Exit 13 Gallery Escape
short_description: Exit 13 Gallery Escape is a psychological horror game where you are trapped in a gallery on the 13th floor of a building. Your only hope is to find the exit and reach the 1st floor, but every time you do, you end up in the same gallery again and again.

name: Add Astra
short_description: Add Astra is a math game about racing, and a racing game about math, developed by Coincidence. You’re the best arithmetech racer on Earth. But what about everywhere else?

name: Hotdog Kitchen
short_description: Set to what a lot of people are calling a banging soundtrack, this casual puzzle game challenges you to fit as much meat into a jar as you can.

name: Home Construction Sim
short_description: Home Construction Sim is a fun and engaging game that lets you experience the process of building a house from start to finish.

name: Golf & Domino
short_description: Introducing the ultimate remedy for boredom: the Golf & Domino game, a captivating hybrid simulator that combines the finesse of golf with the strategic thrill of dominoes.

name: Force and Motion
short_description: Force and Motion is a physics puzzle game where you apply your knowledge of real physics to solve puzzles in the game.

name: DEVICE 0101
short_description: Device0101 is a mystery action adventure that aims to find a key in a mansion, open the door, solve puzzles, and destroy monsters to escape.

name: Unknown Signal: Invasion
short_description: Unknown Signal: Invasion is a continuation of the exciting sci-fi game. This time you have to go to an unknown planet to investigate a new mysterious signal coming from an unknown source.

name: Taxi Driver Life VR
short_description: Experience the thrill of real taxi driving in Taxi Life! Navigate through city streets, encounter diverse customers and tackle various tasks as you manage your taxi.With realistic graphics, dynamic weather and detailed vehicle controls, immerse yourself in the world of taxi driving like never before

name: Ubersoldier
short_description: Deal another deadly blow to fascism!

name: Anonymous Hacker Simulator
short_description: Step into the shoes of a skilled Anonymous hacker and embark on a mission to unveil the truth hidden behind a sinister organization's plans to monitor civilian data and enforce mass surveillance.

name: はいすくーる☆さばいばる
short_description: 恋愛×サバイバル！？　マルチエンディングアドベンチャーゲーム！ヒロイン3人はフルボイス！-平和な島に訪れた、突然の悲劇-ある日突然、島中がゾンビだらけとなり・・・主人公になって、女の子3人と協力し、ミニゲームや選択肢を駆使して上手く脱出しよう！女の子たちの好感度を上げると、特別なイベントも・・・？

name: Cubus
short_description: Descend through a series of endless falling cubes in this fast-paced game. Test your reflexes and timing as you navigate through tight spaces and avoid obstacles.

name: Protocol Delta
short_description: <DESTROY> enemies. <COLLECT> orbs. <COMPETE> on leaderboards. <INITIALIZE>

name: Dark Age
short_description: Embark on an electrifying journey through 5 offbeat themed locations that will test your skills. Dark Age promises a different and unique gaming experience.

name: Knock'Em Out
short_description: Fight with your whole body. If you lose an arm, it's just a scratch. If you lose the other, it's a flesh wound. If you lose your legs, headbutt them. LET'S FIGHT, FIGHT, FIGHT!

name: Backflip
short_description: Backflip is an exciting game that challenges you to perform as many back jumps as possible, pushing your acrobatic skills to the limit.

name: Solar Storm
short_description: Solar Storm is a turn-based Scifi Artillery game with lots of Explosions and Unique Weapons. Play casually with your friends in Procedural and Fully Destructible Arenas to see who is the best!

name: Human Milk Seller
short_description: In the not-so-distant future, humanity teeters on the brink of extinction. The world lies in ruins, ravaged by nuclear fallout, climate disasters, and corporate greed. But amidst the desolation, there's one last hope for survival: the Lactomans.

name: Holy Maid Academy
short_description: When Ryunosuke Kokuto lands a professorial role at an exclusive academy, his hopes for his new charges prove more ambitious than most! In this characteristically crispy dark comedy VN from Liquid, navigate an unlikely career filled with breakneck twists through the lofty halls of St. Martius.

name: Kitchen Crisis
short_description: Kitchen Crisis is a culinary defense game. You are abducted by aliens and must satisfy their appetite. If you want to live to see another day, efficiently arrange your cooking appliances, upgrade your ingredients and tools! In order to survive, make wise decisions according to everchaning recipes.

name: Player Non Player
short_description: Explore a strange island and meet four enigmatic characters. Interact with them, tame them and uncover their dreams. Can you help these characters so they can finally rest in peace?

name: Sequential Dungeon
short_description: Welcome to Sequential Dungeon, where 64 different levels in 8 uniquely themed floors await you in a simple yet challenging experience! Get ready to clear each of the levels in a limited amount of moves while mastering a varied array of different mechanics!

name: Of Life and Land
short_description: Of Life and Land is a charming settlement-building strategy game paired with a rich simulation experience. Every animal and plant strives to find its place in nature while you lead your villagers to their future. Expand to different regions and trade with local factions to gain needed resources.

name: Auto RiskRisk
short_description: A strategic equipment-based auto-battler with single player and cross-platform multiplayer. Equip your fighters with over 125 different items and artefacts to build a strategy strong enough to be the last player standing.

name: Content Warning
short_description: Film your friends doing scary things to become SpöökTube famous! (strongly advised to not go alone)

name: Swarm Fortress
short_description: Build walls, turrets and summon allies to survive hordes of enemies in this top-down sandbox base builder.

name: Backrooms：The Exit
short_description: Backrooms: The Exit is a single-player adventure game based on theme of backrooms.Inside the game you will need to avoid all threatening entities and find the cutscenes (exits) for each level, and perhaps many unexpected ways out of a level.

name: Planetiles
short_description: Dive into Planetiles, where strategy and creativity converge. Build and transform barren planets into flourishing worlds. Outwit natural disasters, develop vibrant habitats, and navigate complex challenges. Embrace a boardgame-like depth with thoughtful planning and strategic decision-making.

name: Minishoot' Adventures
short_description: Fly into a charming handcrafted world and go on an adventure that mixes up open exploration with crispy twin-stick shooter action. Fight your way from the shiny overworld to the deepest caves, improve your ship and overcome the dungeons' bosses to rescue your friends!

name: Barbarous: Family Secrets
short_description: Help Emyr save the world in a Time Management game full of adventure and comedy!

name: Twilight Survivors
short_description: A time-limited survival game infused with rogue-lite elements and an adorable art style! The world has plunged into darkness, and you are its sole beacon of hope. Will you endure until dawn, or succumb to repeated deaths in your quest? Fear not, for you can collect more coins to arm yourself!

name: 15th Floor
short_description: You are stuck in an apartment building with endless floors. Observe your surroundings carefully to go up to the 15th floor and reach the roof of the apartment building. Do not ignore any abnormalities. Your carelessness could result in death.

name: Roadway Traffic Racer
short_description: 'Roadway Traffic Racer' is an exciting and thrilling game for lovers of high-speed racing on the highway.

name: Moorhuhn 'Traps and Treasures'
short_description: Moorhuhn 'Traps and Treasures' brings 21 challenging levels + 6 bonus levels full of dangerous traps, devious enemies and hidden treasures!

name: Saviorless
short_description: Embark on a journey to The Smiling Islands, the realm of the Saviors, where an enigmatic guide beckons. The seasoned narrator has shared this story countless times, yet none have graced the miraculous land. Can you seize your narrative and ascend as a Savior?

name: 0th floor. - The cursed elevator to floor zero -
short_description: You've been trapped in an elevator that always goes to the 0th floor. Don't overlook any anomalies, and try to move to the designated floors.

name: Universe Size Comparison VR
short_description: How does an atom look like compared to a planet? How big is the Milky Way compared to other galaxies? In this simple application you have the opportunity to see and compare the real sizes of various objects in our Universe, from atoms to galaxies.

name: Skaramazuzu
short_description: Enter the mysterious world of Skaramazuzu, and get ready to be tested. Meet strange beings and whimsical personalities, face challenges, and solve riddles in a hand-drawn, black and white 2D world.

name: Horror of Victim
short_description: Psychological horror about a girl captured by an insane family.

name: Maximum Gas!
short_description: Maximum Gas! is an action-packed racing game designed for adrenaline junkies and speed enthusiasts who love the sound of roaring engines.

name: PIPELINE RTX: 2
short_description: PIPELINE RTX: 2 is a puzzle game. The goal of the game is incredibly simple: you need to turn various parts of the pipe into certain positions so that in the end the water can, albeit with a large number of convolutions, pass through the water supply.

name: Route8
short_description: 'You're lost on Route 8. You must find a way to escape. This eerie road is terrifying.''Night falls, the phone rings. Who are you? You find yourself driving along Route 8, repeating endlessly.'

name: ダンジョンアーティファクト
short_description: Dungeon Artifact is a roguelike deck-builder game with authentic card game elements. 300+ cards offer the possibility to create new combos all the time. Build the most powerful deck by your own hands and overwhelm your enemies!

name: Bring The Chickens Home
short_description: Fight against the clock as you gather as many chickens you can and bring them home. Whilst being challenged by an endless wave of varying predators. Convert your following chickens into an army to push them back. Play in single player or work together in local co-op.

name: Monsters Domain
short_description: Monsters' Domain is an FPP RPG action game where you play as an overlord necromancer on a quest to regain power. Build a domain of monsters, command undead armies, and use powerful skills to defeat enemies. Explore dungeons, confront enemies, and master necromancy to shape the destiny of your realm

name: Roll It To The End
short_description: Immerse yourself in Roll It To The End, a captivating puzzle game. Match dice numbers to reach the endpoint, encountering special platforms that trigger unique events. Utilize the builder to craft and share custom levels.

name: Cubon
short_description: Cubon is a casual platform and puzzle game where you have to find your place in the world. Jump, open doors, and find your way through each level. But watch out! Everywhere you go, you'll leave a trace behind you, making it impossible for you to go back to the same place again.

name: MOUTHOLE
short_description: Keep an eye on the time to ensure you make the most of your week in the psychospherical house of MOUTHOLE. Solve puzzles and unravel mysteries to forge convoluted paths of discovery and exploration. Navigate quotidian existence. Crawl into your mouth. Brush your teeth?

name: Snowy Flag
short_description: Snowy Flag is a 3D car game in which an exciting adventure awaits you! You have to drive a van on snowy roads and collect flags! Show dexterity and skill in driving vehicles to successfully overcome all obstacles on your way!

name: Loathful
short_description: Dive into a bone-chilling horror experience with PS1-style graphics. Step into the shoes of a Neural Net Solutions employee testing a virtual reality vacation system. Brace yourself for an immersive journey into terror, where the past meets cutting-edge fear.

name: Pathless Woods
short_description: Embark on a cozy open-world survival journey inspired by ancient China's heritage. Gather resources, cultivate crops, build your dream home, and defend it from marauders. Team up with friends to explore and uncover a world where adventure meets serenity.

name: Daria: A Kingdom Simulator
short_description: Rule your realm, train heroes, and build a legendary kingdom in Daria. Experience strategy, storytelling, and diplomacy in this immersive sim.

name: Curse seal rotation
short_description: 'Curse Seal Rotation' is a Roguelike deck building game. Build a powerful deck by collecting cards, blessings, seals, weapons, etc., and try to survive in the six-story tower and defeat the final boss.

name: M City
short_description: Crazy and strange town. Mysterious events. A hero with multiple personality disorder. Laughter, tears and madness!

name: Bug Heroes: Tower Defense
short_description: Help the Bug Heroes defend their food stash from hordes of enemies! Control powerful heroes, build your defenses, level up your heroes and towers, equip upgrades, and more!

name: 《未解之谜2：桥师》
short_description: 一款在架空世界中进行逻辑推理的游戏，玩家只需要使用鼠标进行点击，即可完成所有操作。 游戏采用二次元动漫风格，玩法和逆转系列相似。

name: Spider Fox
short_description: A ridiculous, web slinging adventure game where you play as a Spider Fox. The Mad Scientist has made some wild animal combinations. Climb, use Grappling Webs, and other items to overcome his obstacles to save them all.

name: Spy Guy Hidden Objects Deluxe Edition
short_description: Venture out on a colorful and hand-drawn adventure with Spy Guy! Travel between cities in search of clues and don't let the bad guys get away with the treasures! Will you manage to find them all? Explore the detective world of the bravest Treflik the detective and help him save Treflik City.

name: Cat Billiards
short_description: This is a simple casual game. You bring the cats home by playing billiards. The cats you bring home can be interacted with the mouse and make cute sounds. Can you collect all 50 cats?

name: Foulbreaker
short_description: Welcome to the exciting fantasy world where the mix of adrenaline, strategy and magic reaches its peak! 'Foulbreaker' is a bagel in the classic sense, where you will have an endless battle with frenzied monsters in a troubled kingdom.

name: 糟糕！他们太爱我了怎么办？
short_description: You'll immerse yourself in first-person perspective, encountering four boys with diverse personalities and appearances, embarking on various sweet love stories with them. The aloof boss, the gentle neighbor, the adorable coffeeboy, or the platonic friend? Among them, who will be your final choice?

name: Hunting with Dad
short_description: Dad needs you to hunt slimes. Do it, he will give you magic powers.

name: Frogmonster
short_description: Discover some of the most charming and challenging bosses in Frogmonster, a Metroidvania FPS adventure where you explore a lively world filled with creatures, bugs, and beasts.

name: QUIT TODAY
short_description: 'QuitToday' is a beat ‘em up game around the workplace theme. You will step into an epic resignation adventure and kick your colleagues' asses.

name: Vectored Armada
short_description: Build ships, break fleets. No distractions. Design ships without constraint upon your workbench, built out of destructible blocks of all shapes and sizes: hull, weapons, engines. Compose Fleets of your self-architected battle craft and obliterate the armadas of the dictator! THE OPPRESSOR MUST FALL.

name: Asteroid Drift
short_description: Alone on a collapsing asteroid. Weave your way through 26 nail-biting, butt-clenching deep space tunnels, where victory is about deft handling of inertia and momentum. Go faster, score higher.

name: VOID CRAWLER
short_description: Void Crawler is a horror game set in a dystopian future, where you pilot a vehicle nicknamed 'The Mole' into a mysterious void deep within the Earth to collect an extremely valuable material for a company dedicated to solving the world's energy crisis.

name: Rime's quest
short_description: Rime's Quest is an exciting adventure in the world of the Roman Empire, where an ordinary traveler decides to leave his everyday life and go on a dangerous journey. During the game, the player will go on an epic quest full of interesting events, riddles and encounters with numerous enemies.

name: XP Racing
short_description: XP Racing is a love letter to the classic racing games from the NES era!

name: Nasty Zombies
short_description: The Nasty Apocalypse is upon us. Fight off relentless hordes of Nasty Zombies with brutally goreific weapons. Earn money to unlock game-changing perks and power-ups. Master the snappy movement system and conquer over 60 achievements in this old-school-inspired, wave-based shooter.

name: Quest Master's Realm
short_description: Realtime Action Combat MMORPG. Battle Foes and Complete Quests to Level up your Skills and Equipment. Prepare to face the most Mythic of Enemies. Swap between different Skill Sets whilst playing the Same Character. Craft and Discover New Items of Increasing Rarity.

name: Code Has Price
short_description: Collect and buy commands. Construct program from them. Run code to get more coins and commands. Repeat.

name: FolkOrigin
short_description: Start taking control of the map and build buildings, recruit units, fight monsters and conquer enemy villages. It's a 2D game in which you move on a hexagonal map. A strategy game combined with an RPG game. All in the times of the early Slavs. More information soon...

name: The Legend of Skye
short_description: We will step into the shoes of a young druid who will be called upon by her tribe to undertake an important mission. After some events in her village, she will have to leave behind the safety of the forest and venture into a world full of dangers. The fate of the grove will be in her hands.

name: Azoove
short_description: Adventure with your friends in this co-op card roguelike. Manage your resources and communicate effectively to lead your expedition across the hazardous Azoove desert. Only through strategy and cooperation can you return the Cursed Book, seal away the evil Ur'gan, and save your village

name: NETGHOST
short_description: Netghost is a Crime Drama visual novel with a mystery-driven story full of intrigue, twists and turns. The story follows Ian Newfield, a cyber security engineer who transforms into a cold-blooded criminal in his struggle to protect the company he works for and aid his ailing sister.

name: Answer To Survive
short_description: Can you win in the best show in the afterlife?

name: GunGuru
short_description: A game made by a real world US Marine Veteran Machine-gunner. Explore the every evolving jungle of GunGuru, an ancient procedurally generated environment, full of magic and mystery. Unlock the secret of the Runes and find out what is hidden beneath.

name: Mutant Boxing League VR
short_description: Face various opponents, each with their own unique boxing style and abilities. Progress through the matches to unlock and explore new opponents, environments and gloves by mastering essential boxing techniques. Learn how to effectively utilize special gloves like the power glove and speed glove.

name: Dungeon Renovation Simulator
short_description: Physics-based dungeon cleaning, in a medieval setting. Play as a Goblin cleaner, dive into messy dungeons, clean up, find loot, and become the ultimate dungeon master!

name: Homeland
short_description: The ancient Darkness has awakened, a black abyss of madness opened up in the mythical and real world.. Our protagonist's girlfriend has been kidnapped by strangers without reason, why they did this? You need to deal with these creatures!

name: you feel normal.
short_description: You find yourself stranded along a lonely, abandoned road, desperately seeking help. You stumble upon an old, farm-themed amusement park, you will feel.

name: Sugar Tanks 2
short_description: This is an intense, fast-paced, and super-sweet tank shooter game. Defend your sweet home world from evil grey tanks, trying to sap all the color from it. Unlock more heroes with their own sweet perks and upgrade your tank.

name: Magic University
short_description: Magic University is a 3D puzzle adventure game. Welcome to the magical university, where mysterious walls hide incredible possibilities!

name: Ataraxie
short_description: ATARAXIE, in the pure style of retro games, ties itself with the SNES Gaming era and embrace difficulty, for it wishes to give experienced gamers/players the test they are really looking for!

name: Virvius
short_description: Scour through the fallen foundry, obscuring enemies and creatures whilst plundering to your death, get ripped apart or circumvent through harsh environments and traps. Let the gun do the talking, so sit back, relax and blow everything to pieces.

name: Godrop
short_description: One level of warning, cosmic droplet rampage! A roguelike game featuring impact piercing. Collect holy relics, build up your energy, and morph the droplets to invade the solar system and destroy the ignorant human fleet to the ground!

name: Apartment of Death
short_description: Venture into the abandoned jungle apartment, embody lone survivor Ross, on a gripping adventure. College friends Joanna and Ivan went missing here. You must unravel mysteries room-by-room while evading a lurking killer's attacks. Can you pierce the enigmas and escape unscathed?

name: Moto Parkour
short_description: Moto Parkour is an adrenaline-pumping game that will take you on a thrilling ride high above the clouds.

name: The Monarch
short_description: Will you be the savior to purify this land? The Monarch is a lane-defense game where you control a monarch, expand your kingdom, and defend against evil by strategically managing gold resources, recruiting diverse units, and exploring a world filled with mythical threats.

name: FAN POP RHYTHM STAGE〜Aim for the♡〜
short_description: Idol experience in VR! A new type of action casual VR game where you can enjoy shooting x dancing!

name: Wizdom
short_description: Wizdom is a Role Playing Game、that focuses on the world of Medieval swords and magic. Overcome trials and save the world from demon lord.

name: NightFeed
short_description: Play alone or invite up to 3 friends in this co-op online action rogue survival. A coven of Shadow Hunters perform a nightly feed across the moors, consuming the dead and acquiring relics from the graves, all to provide an even stronger protection against the darkness during the next NightFeed!

name: The boy sorcerer - Lost memory
short_description: Help Anant escape the tower curse. You will climb the tower, unlock new memories until you complete all game modes for each floor. Good luck and may your memory serve you well.

name: Finally Free
short_description: Play as Jonny, the most stereotypical, flat and generic protagonist you can encounter in a video game. Explore the nightmare that he didn't choose to live through and seal his fate with your decisions.

name: SILENT BREATH
short_description: Unpredictable horrors lurk around every corner, forcing you to find the missing people while desperately clinging to survival. In this experience even your own mind can become your enemy. Stay vigilant and keep your voice hushed, or risk becoming another victim of the forest's darkness

name: Reign of Guilds
short_description: Reign of Guilds is a classic MMORPG. Dark magical middle ages: open world, castle sieges, economy and diplomacy, merchant and craft associations, church and mercenaries, counts and of course the King. Choose your side.

name: Death Noodle Delivery
short_description: It's your first day of work for Death Noodle Delivery Inc. Ride your hoverboard and try to survive in a cyberpunk world on the brink of collapse. Deliver the noodles, hack the hoverboard and build cat bombs. You may find that this world hides a filthy secret.

name: Alone Or Together
short_description: Two people will work together to clear the stage.

name: yasai game
short_description: This is a physics puzzle game where you stack up vegetables to harvest larger ones. You become a farmer and drop a yasai into the box. When yasais stick together, they evolve into larger yasais. Harvest your cabbage or squash before the box gets too hot.

name: Beat Slayer
short_description: Beat Slayer is a roguelite hack n’ slay game like no other. Instead of just being in the background the music takes centre stage. Join Mia, a badass music lover and crafty tinkerer, as she battles hordes of robots in a dystopian 90s inspired Berlin. There’s only one rule: Stay on beat!

name: Bodyrain
short_description: Slaughter hordes of zombies and challenging bosses in Bodyrain: a zombie FPS game! Accumulate money to acquire new weapons and gain experience to strengthen your character and clean up Dawn City!

name: AsteroidTD
short_description: Try to survive in infinite asteroid cloud as long as possible in reworked tower defence style. FInd your own playstyle and beat your own records or chillout with original ambient soundtracks. Build, explore, think - everything to create your own colony in this cold space.

name: Music Man 3: Last Dance
short_description: Collect all music notes in 3 different big worlds to finish maps. Beware dangerous enemies and use platforms to move forward. Also try to find crystals to get achievements

name: CONCRETE VISIONS
short_description: Concrete Visions is a first-person psychological thriller video game with survival horror, FPS and beat’em up elements. There are two main components to the gameplay - melee / lite arms combat and environmental exploration as you strive to survive the night.

name: Eldorado FPS
short_description: Eldorado FPS: A thrilling FPS adventure with diverse modes - Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, Gun Mode, and Zombie Survival. Customize load-outs, compete globally, and rise in the ranks. Intense action, strategy, and endless fun await!

name: Night Bus
short_description: Night Bus is a thrilling public transit simulator that costs less than a bus ticket! It's your first night on the job: Pick up passengers, take their fares, enjoy the beautiful countryside, and please ignore That Which Has No Eyes.

name: Anomaly Collapse
short_description: Command a squad of adorably fierce warriors in Anomaly Collapse, a turn-based Roguelite strategy game that offers a fresh twist to an old formula! Face off against otherworldly beings and uncover the dark secrets of supernatural calamities. Immerse yourself in a story where every move counts!

name: Under The Whisper
short_description: You are a curious and brave mother cat, a furry tabby with a heart of gold and an adventurous nose looking for the best gift.

name: Political Punchers: 2024 Arena
short_description: Choose from 11 politician fighters and duke it out across 10 unique stages. Featuring cross-platform online multiplayer match-ups and 11 hilarious single player stories. As the 2024 presidential election approaches, Political Punchers offers a humorous way to make light of the political chaos.

name: Broken Roads
short_description: Broken Roads is a story-rich, party-based RPG set in a decaying, post-apocalyptic version of the vast Australian Outback, featuring a genre-redefining morality system. Survive, form bonds, and make tough choices that will shape your dangerous yet mesmerizing 25+ hour journey across the wilds.

name: Witchy Woes
short_description: When a power hungry, egotistical young witch disobeys her school’s headmasters, she is cast out and exiled. Play as Devious Donna as she wreaks havoc on those who have wronged her. Harness the dark arts and exact your revenge on the masters of magic.

name: DEAD MAN'S HAND: Card Roulette Action
short_description: Dead Man’s Hand is a 2-8 player online party game that combines the classic game of Russian Roulette with the unpredictable nature of card games. Featuring private lobbies and public matchmaking, only one can win DEAD MAN'S HAND.

name: Over Islands
short_description: Travel from island to island, build a thriving flying city, battle air pirates aboard your zeppelin, and make important decisions as you dive into ancient temples to defeat the children of the goddess and slay their demonic armies.

name: Lotus Lantern: Rescue Mother
short_description: Lotus Lantern: Rescue Mother is a rougelite top-down action game, inspired by a Chinese mythology. Players will experience the journey of Chenxiang rescuing his mother, Sanshengmu, after mastering martial arts skills from Sun Wukong.

name: Ereban: Shadow Legacy
short_description: Ereban: Shadow Legacy is a fast-paced stealth platformer game where you become Ayana, the last descendant of a forgotten race. Harness mystical shadow powers, high-tech gadgets and avoid or kill to uncover the truth about your past and the key to saving a dying, morally grey universe.

name: Birthright Cataclysm - Overture
short_description: A shamelessly difficult and strange RPG aimed at speed runners and masochists, or anyone who enjoys a bizarre and deep story. Birthright Cataclysm - Overture marks the beginning of a new series by Hisoka.

name: Banbard
short_description: An RPG focused on character customization for combat, and having characters break their own fate to grow and build upon themselves. Customize your play style as you see fit, build relationships with your party and grow to overcome any personal or interpersonal challenge that comes your way.

name: SokoPenguin
short_description: SokoPenguin is a Sokoban-style puzzle game, where you control a penguin who must push boxes to clear the path to its cozy igloo.

name: Yellow Taxi Goes Vroom
short_description: Make full use of your advanced move-set to navigate hand-crafted retro worlds without a jump button in this vibrant love letter to the N64 era of collectathons!

name: Time Traveler - Escape Room VR
short_description: This Escape Room gives you the opportunity to embark on a journey through time, exploring the enigmatic world of the most famous characters in history, unraveling complex riddles and enigmas with clues you find along the way.

name: Yet Another Fantasy Title (YAFT)
short_description: Become a rogue in a fantasy action adventure game filled with absurd humor. Go on a quest to kill the dragon - and realize this is only the beginning. Learn spells from a wizard and brawling from an orc. Save the kingdom, destroy a ring, fight a monstrous beaver!

name: Final Factory
short_description: Final Factory blends factory building, spaceship design, and a rich universe to explore. Build a mega factory and command a massive fleet against the hostile local aliens. Discover new technologies and unlock the secrets of an ancient civilization as you explore an infinite cosmos.

name: 银河战争一(Galactic Wars One）
short_description: A tower defense strategy science fiction game, in the future era, when aliens invade the solar system, players need to build various turrets to resist alien attacks and guard the Milky Way and solar system.

name: Headquarters: World War II
short_description: Headquarters: World War II is a fast-paced turn-based strategy game where your battlefield tactics are as important as your army management skills. Experience both sides of the war, battling in Europe as the USA, the UK, or Germany. Storm bunkers, occupy houses, win tank duels.

name: Doodle Streets: London 1950's
short_description: Search for hidden things and troubles in this highly interactive, 2.5D, playful take on London’s 50s & 60s.

name: Whale Captain
short_description: Embark on your Dream Adventure: Discover uncharted lands, master the waves, and soar the skies! A challenging shoot-em-up bullet dodging game with a dash of side-scrolling platformer featuring a crew with hearts of gold at the ready, awaiting their Whale Captain.

name: The Cursed Legacy
short_description: The Cursed Legacy is a Puzzle Game set in a dark and mysterious atmosphere. Keep calm and solve the riddles to unravel this strange disappearance. But be careful, you're not alone!

name: Frank Fux
short_description: Put your skills to the test and join Frank on his daring adventure into the world of ultimate thrills! Every jump must be well planned, because one wrong step could send Frank plummeting into the abyss.

name: Cirrus Business
short_description: Help Cloudi and friends restore their home in this whimsical story-driven farming adventure. You’ll learn that growing and managing magical crops while defending against the slobsters isn’t a breeze, but very serious business.

name: Throne of Bone
short_description: Draft minions to defeat all who oppose the honest work of necromancy. Learn spells, find relics, and reclaim your castle to unite the land through undeath in this unholy amalgam of roguelike and autobattler.

name: Spirit City: Lofi Sessions
short_description: Spirit City: Lofi Sessions is a gamified focus tool, set to a soothing lofi soundtrack. Discover and collect Spirits, customize your cozy virtual space, and facilitate your real-life tasks with a collection of handy features designed to improve concentration and ease stress.

name: Night Grove
short_description: This is a first-person indie horror game. A young deliveryman took an unusual order that led him to Night Grove. This place has a dubious reputation among the townspeople, because for many years it has been sent to live with people that society has long since abandoned.

name: Goons: Legends & Mayhem
short_description: A frantic blend of beat 'em up and arcade hockey that plays out over various themed levels with opposing teams of heroes outfitted with unique abilities. Insane sports action like you've never seen before!

name: Last Hope Bunker: Zombie Survival
short_description: You wake up in a bunker! The Earth became a battlefield. Dangerous creatures at every turn. We give you everything you need: medicine, weapons, shelter. Your task is to find your family. And please try to survive in this post-apocalypse.

name: Zombie apocalypse survivor
short_description: This is a survivor zombie game, you encounter a lot of zombies in an abandoned village, they are very dangerous, you must survive here. So you must strengthen yourself, upgrade your weapons, enhance your various attributes, and fight the zombies face to face!

name: Ignis
short_description: Ignis is a puzzle strategy game with the goal of burning down everything in your path. You control the spreading flames where strategic thinking is the difference between dying out or raging on.

name: Poop Spotter ~ The game to improve the quality of poop~
short_description: Monitor the line of the poop factory and find out the defective products. This is a 'spot the difference' game with poop.

name: Case Files: Behind Closed Doors
short_description: An FMV murder mystery, police interrogation, detective experience.

name: Wizards Vs Soldiers And Robots
short_description: Grab a gun and punch those stupid wizards RIGHT IN THEIR DUMB FACES

name: Desktop Creatures
short_description: Desktop Creatures lets you have your favourite creatures roam around in your desktop! Whether you're playing, working or studying, these creatures will be on your desktop, there for you.

name: Water Festa
short_description: Water Festa is a top-down shooter inspired by Thailand's Songkran water festival. You play as a mermaid girl, balancing wetness to remain human, dodge water to avoid becoming too wet, but seek it when dry. Expect a casual bullet hell experience as people continuously shower you.

name: 遗忘魔塔
short_description: A dark maze style map exploration meat pigeon game, defeating enemies in a foggy dungeon to search for treasures, finding the entrance to the next level, and gradually collecting equipment to strengthen and defeat bosses and difficult official cards

name: Cast Out Colony
short_description: Cast Out Colony combines roguelite and bullet-heaven action with robust town-building elements. Choose from various characters, fight hordes of foes, and grow your colony, which in return grows your stats, offering a unique twist on the survival genre.

name: Waki & the lost spirits
short_description: Waki & the Lost Spirits is a 2D action platformer with some tastes of a metroidvania game. In this game you will explore the forest, fight enemies, solve puzzles, complete challenges, beat some bosses in order to save the lost spirits of the forest.

name: Rainbow Yggdrasil
short_description: In a white world tree, the rainbow world tree stands... Color-changing game series from Otora Kobo! This time we present color change x roguelike!

name: Princess Chessboard
short_description: “Princess Chessboard” is a turn-based casual light strategy card-building game based on dice. As a warrior in the animal kingdom, please go and find the runaway princess.

name: Der Anzeigenhauptmeister
short_description: Schlüpfe in die Rolle des Anzeigenhauptmeisters! Erfasse Falschparker in einer großen Stadt und wähle aus einer Liste das korrekte Vergehen aus. Treibe Geld für den Staat ein und strafe die Verkehrssünder für Ihre Taten! Gesetz ist Gesetz!

name: Handsome Me with 100 Girlfriends!
short_description: I started a part-time job with my hard-working personality and earned money to buy gifts for my favorite characters.

name: SpectroPhobia
short_description: 'SpectroPhobia' is a spine-chilling adventure where you must outsmart the shadows in a haunted mansion. Find hidden objects, solve puzzles, and evade the lurking entity. Uncover the mansion's dark secrets to survive.

name: The Devil Within: Satgat
short_description: Join Kim Rip, a Royal Guard whose humanity is gradually slipping away, on a thrilling 2.5D action-adventure platforming journey in 'The Devil Within: Satgat'. Uncover the mysteries of a desolate realm as you engage in stylish battles against formidable foes.

name: Shoot Giant Robots and Wallrun
short_description: A fast-paced, score-attack movement shooter. Mow down an endless horde of robots, flying through hand-crafted arenas at breakneck speeds.

name: Three Kingdoms and Martial Arts and Jianghu
short_description: A sandbox role-playing game that combines the Three Kingdoms and martial arts

name: Ignited in Cavern
short_description: In the waning years of the Northern Wei Dynasty, in the town of Dunhuang, a rumor circulates about a stone statue that bestows blessings in the mortal realm. Anu and Chu Qingqing, rushes to this place only to discover that the merchant holding the stone statue has already met his demise.

name: Summoneer
short_description: Summoneer is a platformer and puzzle game, where you engineer your own designs.

name: outside the door
short_description: Outside the door is a mystic visual novel set within one office. You are about to figure out the stories of a few visitors without having a single memory of yourself.

name: Touhou Eternal Spell Cards
short_description: In Eastern Eternal Spell Cards,The balance between humans and yokai is at stake as the evil yokai, Black Shadow, awakens to conquer the Eastern world. Through intense bullet-hell battles, she faces challenging stages and enemies to become the savior. DISCORD：

name: Kit Cat
short_description: Cute cats need love! Discover the best jigsaw puzzle story with animals, a relaxing adventure for kids in 2D.

name: Jump Heroes
short_description: Experience the ultimate thrill of becoming a Jump Hero in this hyper-addictive arcade game! The goal is simple: survive as long as possible, beat your high score, and dominate the leaderboard. Play solo or compete with friends with local co-op mode!

name: Aiyana
short_description: A procedurally generated open world survival craft game with traditional RPG mechanics such as talent trees and spells

name: Infection Free Zone
short_description: Choose any real region from the world. Choose your base of operations, then rebuild and readapt the buildings around you to create a self-sustaining settlement. Take charge of a group of survivors from your city. And when the night falls - Defend the zone from the infected!

name: Math Pixels
short_description: Engage in pixel strategy: calculate sums to colorize rows and columns. Dive into a minimalist challenge of precision and calculation.

name: Urban Entrepreneur
short_description: Manage inventory, staff, prices and more while creating a monopoly!

name: Children of the Sun
short_description: On a deadly road trip into darkness, control the path of a single bullet and unleash a fury of vengeance on the sinister cult that ruined your life in this tactical puzzle-shooter.

name: Botany Manor
short_description: Welcome to Botany Manor, a stately home in 19th century England. You play as inhabitant Arabella Greene, a retired botanist. Explore your house and gardens, filled with research, to figure out the ideal habitat of forgotten flora. Grow each plant to discover the mysterious qualities they hold…

name: Sheba: A New Dawn
short_description: Embark on a Metroidvania, Action-RPG inspired, journey. Explore, Fight, Overcome, and unravel the mysteries of a vast interconnected realms. Wield powerful weapons and abilities to battle challenging enemies. Experience the breathtaking story of self-discovery.

name: Anomaly Loop
short_description: You woke up and found yourself in an anomalous endless place from which it is not so easy to get out. Carefully observe your surroundings to find a way out of this place.

name: Laysara: Summit Kingdom
short_description: Build and expand your very own settlements in high mountains! Carefully plan production chains and satisfy various needs of your three-caste society while dealing with mountain hazards such as weather breakdowns and avalanches. Are you skilled enough to make your town thrive?

name: Prehistoric Gal
short_description: Gal is a cave girl who had her boyfriend, Dude, abducted by aliens! Now she needs to save him, in this 2D mini metroidvania set during prehistoric times!

name: Pinhead Adventures
short_description: The First Game from Neversold Studios, Pinhead Adventures is a planet hopping, gun toting, sword swinging, grappling adventure! Zortan has killed every last living soul except for the Pinhead and Orbo. Join Pinhead and Orbo to fight Zortan in this 3D Action Platformer!

name: Damn Sewer
short_description: An indie horror game in which you find yourself in a mysterious abandoned sewer where people disappear. At first there is nothing unusual, but gradually you realize that something terrible lives in the sewer.

name: 6年1組
short_description: I went to school that night to pick up something I forgot... Aim for class 1 of 6th grade, and if there are no abnormalities, go up the stairs, and if there are any abnormalities, go down the stairs.

name: Incursion Red River
short_description: Incursion Red River is a tactical first-person extraction shooter set in war-torn modern day Vietnam. Exclusively single-player and co-op gameplay! Customize your loadout, complete contracts & extract, or die trying!

name: My Head On Your Body
short_description: You've moved into a new house where the previous owner was murdered. They never found his head. But it has found you.

name: 暮雨流花
short_description: What is happiness? Happiness is the sea, the wind, the rainstorm -- and the eternal love 'Perhaps I can also live a peaceful and happy life like an ordinary person.' Stay tuned, the exciting story of the evening rain and flowing flowers

name: Gigantic: Rampage Edition
short_description: GO GIGANTIC! THE UNIQUE MOBA HERO SHOOTER RETURNS!

name: ちょこナナ
short_description: シングルプレイヤーで戦闘・収集・探索・育成の基本要素を楽しめるRPGです。全てがちょこっとな要素で構成されているシンプルなゲーム体験で、可愛いキャラクター達による楽しいやりとりも魅力です。

name: ARC: Antic Runes Combat
short_description: Classic 2D Arcade ! You are 'Shadow', a lost soul who has the mission to rescue other souls after the great apocalypse. New for Steam Launch, Events and FREE DLC 'Underworld' includes in version 1.5.

name: Laughing to Die
short_description: 囡囡回乡参加奶奶一百岁的丧礼。家人们都说老人百岁去世是喜丧,因此家里正大摆宴席招待亲友。独自一人的囡囡看到一个酷似奶奶的身影之后随之而误入某个奇怪的房间，在寻找离开的道路同时，囡囡也逐渐从这些房间的故事中知道了奶奶的来历,更从中得知在喜丧背后所隐藏的秘密。

name: My First Horse: Adventures on Seahorse Island
short_description: Get ready for an adventure on Seahorse Island! Olivia and her horse are eager to explore every bit of it, so saddle up and join the adventure. Whether you love racing through meadows, jumping over hurdles, or just chilling and taking in the views, there's something here for you.

name: Truxton 2
short_description: The sequel to Toaplan’s shoot ‘em up masterpiece Truxton is a thrilling insane space action with an unforgiving difficulty level. Enjoy the visually stunning pixel graphics and vibrant music as you dodge the high-speed bullet rain and take on tough bosses.

name: Glimmer Chain
short_description: Use the chain to swing and propel yourself through the buildings. Execute fluid and epic moves to light up the city in the shortest possible time!

name: Tumble Ball
short_description: Tumble Ball is a 3D-cubic maze solver with a simple goal; find the exit. Navigate complicated labyrinths in various shapes and sizes, and compete with people from all over the world, for your place on the leaderboards.

name: Deep in The Fear
short_description: Dive into heart-pounding terror with our CO-OP horror experience for 5 PLAYERS. Uncover chilling mysteries, face unspeakable horrors, and survive together in this intense collaborative nightmare. Will your team escape the shadows, or succumb to the darkness that lurks within?

name: Underspace
short_description: The spiritual successor to Freelancer with a Lovecraftian, sandbox RPG twist. Explore a vast handmade universe with Day 1 mod support and a planned PvP/co-op multiplayer on the Early Access roadmap. You're going to need a bigger ship.

name: escape
short_description: A sports zombie fighting game that uses props from different scenes to fight against zombies, completing various level tasks and opening the next level. Each level has different gameplay

name: Steel Republic Rail Defender
short_description: SRRD is a hybrid of Strategy Railroad Logistics, Resource gathering, Base building, and Tower Defense

name: Mojito the Cat
short_description: Mojito the Cat its a 3D Puzzle labyrinth game that will push your space vision to the limit, use the logic to find the shortest path to the exit. Rotate the pieces to reach all coins, get the fish scrape and go to the gate to jump to the next level

name: Monster Bullets
short_description: Monster Bullets is a first-person roguelite where each monster has a specific weakness. Quickly load the correct bullet for each monster and fire them off! Experiment with upgrades on each procedurally generated attempt and try to slay the goblin king!

name: 乱斗先锋
short_description: This is a card game that combines 'Tavern Flag', 'Slaughter Tower', and 'Potato Brothers'. Players need to constantly purchase followers, spells, and relics to strengthen their lineup, and then challenge new enemies

name: Artificer's Tower
short_description: Are you a master of the magical arts? Prove it in this cozy colony-sim wizard tower defense game. Curl up and build your base, keep your mages happy, craft recipes, research new magic spells, and defend your wizard's keep. Will your Artificer's Tower be the envy of all your magical friends?

name: Nine Realms
short_description: Rule the god of thunder and challenge all the gods of the nine realms! In this Rogue-like, hack and slash game, develop your strategy and skills, subject all the gods who challenge you to your wrath, and become the only god of the universe.

name: DeResolution
short_description: BANG...You awake to find yourself in a foreign place called the BIT-GRID. Explore, fight, and throw your vorpal frisbee to escape this digital landscape.

name: One More Day
short_description: ¡Welcome to One More Day! Embark on an exciting and challenging experience where fashion and survival intertwine in this pixel art 2D game. Confront the dark threat of endless hordes of zombies as you embody a brave hero, equipped only with trusty underwear! Survive One More Day.

name: 100 KILLS CHALLENGE
short_description: Enter the fray in an intense, fast paced first person shooter experience. Kill using firearms, explosives, drones, and air support. Dominate maps in deathmatch, team, and PVE. Win with tactics - or sheer brutality. Remember: Hundred kills. One arena. Zero rules. May the best player win!

name: X-Mutation
short_description: Survive against thousands of monsters with the ability to mutate your body into various weapons! X-Mutation is a hardcore 3d top-down rogue-lite action game. Choose from hundreds of exciting mutations and upgrade them in different ways to create your unique build!

name: Tales of Anturia: Hejstos
short_description: Perfect for old school gamers and those eager to be part of the creation process. Help us develop an exciting third-person RPG. We're at a very early stage, which allows us to remain flexible and responsive to your feedback

name: Caviar
short_description: Dive into an immersive underwater world with your Polaroid camera, capturing stunning fish and growing the ecosystem with each snapshot. Explore this short, whimsical sandbox experience as you bring life to the depths beneath the waves.

name: Knights & Guns
short_description: An action-packed 2D shooter where knights don't joust, they blast! Journey into a world where medieval bravery meets heavy-duty firepower. Battle monsters, venture through thrilling stages, and be the knight that makes ghouls say 'oh no, not the shotgun!' It's old-school arcade fun, with a bang!

name: Exodus
short_description: Exodus is a puzzle game where you play as disembodied hand of God. You need to find a way to help the Hebrews reach to safety and defeat the Egyptians. Each level requires to manipulate the environment and the people in it in creative ways in order to solve it's puzzles.

name: Twenty-second: Stories of Underground Kharkiv
short_description: The Twenty-Second: Stories of Underground Kharkiv is a quest and a visual novel that will tell you in the first person about the events of 2022 in the Kharkiv metro.

name: Vivat Slovakia
short_description: Vivat Slovakia is an open-world video game set in the freshly established country at the border of Eastern Europe, Slovakia. As old norms are still present, the enforcement agencies are weak and corruption is widespread.

name: Lifecraft
short_description: Survive and evolve as an organism with this simulation game in which you will literally start as a single cell and manage and organize all its functions to a fully fledged system! Assemble, breathe, eat, fight threats, produce energy, grow, anything is possible!

name: My Lovely Dog Adventure
short_description: Explore the world as a little Corgi! You wander mysterious and different landscapes in search of your beloved friend, collecting shiny chrystals on the way.

name: Ghost Talker
short_description: Have you ever wondered if your house is haunted? With ghost talker you can find out and have conversations with potential paranormal entities.

name: Before The Dawn
short_description: ”Before the Dawn“ is a top-down view roguelite shooter game! In an infected city with endless deads, faced with the constantly coming Deads, choose different tactics and find the way out through overwhelming firepower!

name: A New Leaf: Memories
short_description: You wake up on the beach of a foreign island, unable to recall anything. Alone and equipped with only basic farming tools provided by the town residents, you aim to recover your memories. Complete quests and explore Omoide Island to unfold your story.

name: Unnamed Project
short_description: Unnamed Project is a game about playtesting. You are the player, who’s job is to explore a game developer’s projects and touch everything possible. Touching any and everything will help the game developer in every way possible, so don’t listen to their concerns. Thanks ahead of time.

name: ColorBlend FX: Desaturation
short_description: Help Splatians blend the stolen colors back with the world and get rid of the evil Lord Ashen in this 2.5D puzzle-platformer metroidvania. Splat'n'stomp juicy enemies, swim in paint pools, solve physics and color puzzles and of course survive the death while figuring out the evil plans of the Lord.

name: Galactic Ruler Enlightenment
short_description: Play campaign stories within the Galactic Ruler universe. Invade the galaxy to eliminate those who stand in your way or rally alien races to defend against the invaders. Fight battles at both planet and space across a procedurally generated galaxy. Use new unit control systems to manage your forces.

name: Eclipse: Echo of Dimension
short_description: Eclipse: Echo of Dimension is an adventure game. Players explore the ruins of an alien civilization, discovering and listening to fragments of poetry from another dimension, searching for clues to the lost remnants of an extraterrestrial civilization, where vast distances shrink to mere steps.

name: Just Read The Instructions
short_description: Fight off thousands of enemies with a variety of powerful weapons in this surreal co-op shooter. Enter a simulation controlled by a corrupted AI to disrupt and destroy it. Explore procedural worlds, eliminate enemies, break logic, and watch it all collapse.

name: Solar Survivors
short_description: Bullet hell meets bullet heaven. Build the ultimate space fighter as you uncover clever strategies and hidden synergies. Solar Survivors distills the deep strategy and progression of an RPG into quick, arcade-like sessions.

name: Harold Halibut
short_description: Harold Halibut is a handmade narrative game about friendship and life on a city-sized spaceship submerged in an alien ocean. Join Harold as he explores a vibrant retro-future world in his quest to find the true meaning of ‘home’.

name: Gaming Cafe Life
short_description: Manage your very own gaming cafe!

name: My love with the GirlsGroup
short_description: Under the Seoul lights, you, a designated driver, snatch an order from a mysterious girl. Nation's girl group angels stand before you. In a sudden scandal, you pose as their agent and become a mainstay in the music industry! Love's fragrance and career's brilliance await you - how will you choose?

name: The Night Guard
short_description: This facility was built on a very interesting location and had an interesting history. It grew up on the site of a former hospital for the mentally ill, the only one of its kind. There and spent their final days people suffering from a bunch of ailments.

name: Divnozemye
short_description: 'Divnozemye' is a card game like the famous game 'Arcomage' (from 'Might&Magic'), but in the setting of folk fairy tales and with its own feature - heroes.

name: Scary In The Journey
short_description: Scary In is a Co-op Horror game, set in the post-apocalyptic future due to radiation called Solar, and you have to live in underground station where it connect to all the world station. Travel with friends, many solar entity lurking around, and you have to solve puzzle, Start your journey now!

name: No Rest for the Wicked
short_description: From Moon Studios, the award-winning developers of Ori and the Blind Forest and Ori and the Will of the Wisps comes No Rest for the Wicked, a visceral, precision Action RPG set to reinvent the genre.

name: Scheming Through The Zombie Apocalypse Ep2: Caged
short_description: Join Hank and Larry, two small defenseless animals, as they manipulate their way through the zombie apocalypse. Meet various characters and get them to scavenge for you while guiding them to 'safety.' Make life-or-death decisions, bargain, manage inventory, trade, and gamble.

name: DopeNet
short_description: DopeNet is a stupidly fun, dark web fantasy drug dealing simulator. Buy low, sell HIGH, go get it.

name: Oh Baby Kart
short_description: Kart Racing. Ultimate abilities. Over 100+ Karts. 100+ Challenges. Unique racing modes including Race Royale and Grand Prix Duo.

name: GLOW
short_description: GLOW is an addictive physics-based arcade game that will challenge you to your limits. Push, dodge, and trick enemies while collecting points as the difficulty increases.

name: Sokoseed
short_description: Discover the joy of puzzle-solving with a natural twist in Sokoseed. Grow saplings and strategically maneuver boxes through clever, minimalist stages in this peaceful yet challenging gaming experience.

name: KitHack Model Club
short_description: Developed by the creator of the original Kerbal Space Program and a tiny three-person team, KitHack Model Club is a physics-based model building sandbox that provides limitless freedom for you and friends to design, build, battle, fly (and crash!) your very own RC vehicles.

name: SUNSOFT is Back! レトロゲームセレクション
short_description: SUNSOFT revival commemoration! Three carefully selected songs from SUNSOFT's works from the 1980s: 'Wings of Madura,' '53 Stations of the Tokaido,' and 'Ripple Island' are included!

name: 共鸣 ReMix
short_description: ReMix is a unique musical rhythm action game that combines the elements of Rogue games. In this world, you are able to choose from a variety of heroes with different fighting styles and use the power of music to battle against evil void monsters.

name: Just a Cute Capybara Puzzle
short_description: Just a Cute Capybara Puzzle to keep you happy.

name: Rauniot
short_description: Rauniot is an isometric post-apocalyptic point and click adventure game which takes place to Northern Finland.

name: Guerra de Insetos TW PREMIUM
short_description: play, win insects and use multiple insects to beat your opponent

name: BIG SHOTS
short_description: Gear up, team up, and exterminate! Become the ultimate mech pilot in BIG SHOTS, the action-packed VR roguelite where you’ll battle alien hordes, earn upgrades, and forge an unstoppable mech to reclaim Earth.

name: FoolHut Pack - 3 games in 1
short_description: Play three* tiny BolHut games developed for April Fools! *There might be a fourth game inside.

name: Kill It With Fire 2
short_description: Arachnophobia. The Game. The Sequel. Take on the arachnid menace alone or with friends in full campaign co-op. Wage the arachnid war across time and space and exterminate every last spider across the multiverse, or jump into Spider Hunt PvP and play as the eight-legged menace for the first time!

name: Dungeons of Alethrion
short_description: Dungeons of Alethrion is a dungeon crawler roguelike game based on the Youtube animated series, Tales of Alethrion. Play as epic heroes from the show, each with unique abilities. Play it alone or grab a friend to join you in the dungeons!

name: Once a Tale
short_description: You are invited to step into the enchanting world of fairy tales like never before. Play as Hansel and Gretel in this unique stop-motion-style single-player 3rd-person narrative adventure where you'll uncover mysteries, solve puzzles, and meet a reimagined cast of beloved fairy tale characters.

name: Uneasy Memories
short_description: A Psychological Horror Game Set in Everyday Life

name: 44 The Jail
short_description: They got locked up in a prison for a reason. Try to get the answers in this point and click adventure.

name: Cyber League Football
short_description: Futuristic robot football! Upgrade your team, call the plays, blow up your opponent, and drive your robots to victory on the field.

name: Epic Dumpster Bear 1.5 DX: Dumpster Fire Rebirth
short_description: 'Epic Dumpster Bear 1.5 DX' is an enhanced version of the indie cult classic platformer that introduces 'Epic Dumpster Bear 2' play control into remixed 'Epic Dumpster Bear' levels. Inspired by the 16-Bit classics, this retro 2D momentum platformer has 7 worlds, 10 boss fights, and 3D bonus levels

name: Koe (声): Part 1
short_description: Koe (声) is a JRPG with the Japanese language at the core of gameplay. Koe (声) combines traditional RPG gameplay with communicative language learning techniques to bring you a truly unique and rewarding gaming, language and story experience.

name: The Happies - Amber Falcon
short_description: The Happies: Amber Falcon is a small casual game, where you control a hot air balloon and explore different mission environments. In a disaster of cosmic proportions, the Happies are forced to leave their planet in a hurry on evacuation ships. One of these ships is the Amber Falcon.

name: Rogue Samurai
short_description: Rogue Samurai is a roguelite action game where you must battle against relentless waves of incoming enemies. As Musashi, achieve victories and face bosses in deadly duels. Musashi is striving to survive in this world with his bravery. Choose the path of the samurai and light up the night!

name: Don't Puke!
short_description: Only a few will make it to the top! Ride, jump, and fly either solo or with friends, in this virtual reality game! Mastering your cart control skills is essential to reach the island's highest peaks.

name: Reigns Beyond
short_description: From the makers of Reigns, get ready for Reigns: Beyond, a swipe-based adventure game through the stars!

name: Silicon War:Blitz
short_description: In 'Silicon War:Blitz' ,you will pilot your mech through an onslaught of endless bullets and enemies! Each battle is a crucial test of your reaction skills and strategic planning. Continuously upgrade and enhance your mech until all adversaries are vanquished!

name: Abraca
short_description: Now is the time for justice! In this Roguelite game, players will be able to learn spells, strengthen skills, use the currency obtained from battles to purchase items from mysterious merchants, kill numerous demon claws, and ultimately conquer this world!

name: PicoTrains
short_description: A retro-styled railway management strategy game!

name: Life Eater
short_description: If you don't sacrifice your neighbors, the world ends. Life Eater is a horror fantasy kidnapping simulator where you must become intimately familiar with your targets' lives one intrusive action at a time... and hope that the dark god you serve is even real.

name: Tenfold Loop
short_description: Tenfold Loop is a short walking simulator where the player is trapped inside an endless loop. The only way to exit is to find 10 consecutives anomalies.

name: Dodo
short_description: Dodo is a tricky puzzle game where you have to enter the correct word to get to the next level. The letters you enter will change the grid on the screen - and you must get that grid to match the symbols!

name: The Crew Motorfest
short_description: The Crew Motorfest is an open world online racing game set on the island of O‘ahu, Hawaii. Experience the best that car culture has to offer as you compete in intense races, experience themed events, and collect hundreds of iconic cars. Enjoy the game free for five hours!

name: Gensokyo Odyssey
short_description: Gensokyo Odyssey! A Touhou satirical visual novel with air hockey bullet hell and a script both written by a madman.

name: SolForge Fusion
short_description: SolForge Fusion is a CCG card-battler with robust single-player and PvP modes, where players use uniquely generated card ‘fusions’ to outmaneuver their adversaries. A game designed by Richard Garfield (Magic: The Gathering) and Justin Gary (Ascension Deckbuilding Game).

name: Project13: Nightwatch
short_description: A new Observer Gametype where you take on the role of an Observer tasked with guarding the HQ of the Project 13 Corp. . Prevent any Observer Prisoner, each potentially containing a anomaly, from infiltrating the HQ. Equipped with a high-tech binocular, your observation skills are the key to success.

name: Inn of Eight Horizons
short_description: 《八荒客栈》是一款使用虚拟现实设备游玩的第一人称角色扮演游戏。玩家将作为隶属于八荒客栈的灵能者，游离于现实与虚拟的场景中。使用各种上古的符箓与法术，击败传说中的各种妖邪，维护现实社会的稳定。

name: BioGun
short_description: Get injected into the microscopic world of BioGun. Face viral threats and winding corridors on your mission to save man’s best friend from the inside. Will you be the vaccine to save dog-kind from extinction?

name: I Got Trapped in the Succubus's Dream!
short_description: サキュバスの夢に落ち込んだ主人公は目覚めることができない。 唯一の脱出方法は夢に仕掛けられた罠を避けながら、出口を探すことだ。 罠に落ちると最初から脱出しなければなりません。 夢に囚われないように逃げ出しましょう。

name: Minako: Beloved Wife in the Countryside
short_description: Happily married couple Minako and Tatsurou trade the busy life in Tokyo for a nice, long vacation in the countryside. Visiting her husband’s hometown for the first time in her life, Minako soon finds herself charmed by nature’s beauty and the villager’s hospitality.

name: 岛与工厂 Island And Factories
short_description: Set management, strategy, planning, breeding elements as one. Randomly generated islands have different resources, industrialization or agriculture is up to you. Planting crops, breeding animals, mining minerals to obtain low-grade products, factory processing to obtain high-grade products.

name: Progress Chess
short_description: Progress Chess is the most complete simulator of chess and chess competitions to date, taking place in realistic 3D spaces: from a home apartment to a chess club! By playing in tournaments and solving problems, go from beginner to world champion!!

name: Tech Shop Simulator
short_description: Manage your own tech shop. Arrange the shelves, buy the products, put them at the price you want and sell them. Expand, organize and upgrade the shop. Hire and manage employees.

name: Exosuit
short_description: Exosuit is a dynamic shooter in a unique style, where focus is on maximizing fun of gameplay. Game has no plot and the emphasis is only on unbridled action and unusual visual style.

name: Hearts 3D Premium
short_description: Hearts 3D Premium brings a lot of game variants, challenging opponents and game environments with great 3D graphics on your PC. You can play in Singleplayer offline or LAN and Online Mode! The full animated Tutorial explains rules of the popular card game step by step.

name: SAND LAND
short_description: SAND LAND is an action RPG where you become the main character as Beelzebub, a Fiend Prince. Lead your company of heroic misfits and explore the legendary world of SAND LAND created by Akira Toriyama.

name: Buggy Derby Arena
short_description: Buggy Derby Arena is an exhilarating game that puts you in the driver's seat of a powerful buggy, fighting for survival in a closed stadium.

name: Bootleg Steamer
short_description: In this rogue-like game, you embark on your journey as a captain during the tumultuous American Prohibition. Overcome challenges like inclement weather, relentless Coast Guard pursuit, shrewd Mafia dealings, and your own financial pitfalls, all while ensuring your path to wealth remains unhindered.

name: Land of the Survivors
short_description: Roguelike-style survival game, enhance your character through upgrades. Survive as long as possible and fight against thousands of zombies.

name: TopSpin 2K25
short_description: The TopSpin franchise returns with TopSpin 2K25, featuring tennis legends Roger Federer, Serena Williams, and a cast of other playable pros, competitive single-player and multiplayer modes, all four historic Grand Slams®, and much more!

name: Jack Holmes : Master of Puppets
short_description: Survival Horror in first person where you must manage your ammunition well, explore varied scenarios and face nightmarish beings, while investigating the macabre experiments with children, the result of a mind unhinged by madness and family loss.

name: Retro Rally!
short_description: Get ready to embark on a nostalgic journey back to the golden era of arcade gaming with Retro Rally! This top-down racing game pays homage to the classic arcade racers of yesteryears, offering an adrenaline-pumping experience that will have you hooked from the moment you hit the accelerator.

name: Assault Suit Leynos 2 Saturn Tribute
short_description: Modify your robot and head to the battlefield!

name: SaGa Emerald Beyond
short_description: FORGE YOUR OWN TALE The latest standalone entry in the SaGa franchise, SaGa Emerald Beyond, brings together the very best elements of the beloved series to offer each player their own unique gameplay experience.

name: CONVRGENCE
short_description: CONVRGENCE is an immersive single-player VR shooter with survival and horror elements. Explore the Chernokamensk exclusion zone: scavenge for loot, fight bandits and hunt for mystical artifacts. However be sure to return to base before duskfall, for when night arrives the hunter becomes the hunted.

name: Night City
short_description: 'Night City' is a cooperative first-person horror game with survival elements, here you will play as one of the company's clones, and go down into the dungeons to search for resources. Death will be waiting at every step, so work as a team.

name: Sidereal Wanderer
short_description: As Captain, you must lead your spaceship to defeat the rebel forces scattered across the galaxy. Scour the sectors for enemies and remain alert! Determine the right coordinates and torpedo your foe down.

name: Rotwood
short_description: The world has been thrown into chaos, and it's up to you and your friends to battle the corrupted beasts of the Rotwood. Upgrade your gear, choose your preferred weapon, and hone your skills to defend your safe haven.

name: S.O.L Search of Light
short_description: Dive into the darkness and discover the light in the narrative adventure of S.O.L SEARCH OF LIGHT! Explore a steampunk and dark fantasy world as you face hordes of enemies, manage resources and fortify your robotic village to survive in a dark, hostile reality.

name: Letters & Legends
short_description: Embark on an epic linguistic adventure in Letters & Legends, where words and wits are your greatest weapons! Sharpen your tongue and show your enemies who the true wordsmith is!

name: Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes
short_description: Eiyuden Chronicles: Hundred Heroes is designed to bring players a modern take on a classic JRPG experience. Get ready to lead 100+ playable characters through a war-torn world only you can save.

name: Virtua Unlimited Project
short_description: Virtua Unlimited Project is a 2D pixel-art style ACT game featuring VTuber characters. With classical platformer gameplay, challenging combat, and retro game feelings, VUP presents you a surreal, virtual world in which you will play as Aizawa Kana to venture and seek the truth beneath.

name: Arena of Trophies
short_description: Join the epic battle in an arena filled with gladiators and test your skills in a game where every move can lead to glory or downfall. Collect achievements, refine your strategies, and become a legend in the endless fight for survival and recognition!

name: Forest Keeper
short_description: Survival Horror set on a sinister island. As a lone forest keeper, you'll unravel its grim secrets from the eerie backstory of a royal vacation home turned nightmare. Journey through the changing seasons, from day to night. Confront nightmarish abominations that emerge in the winter cold.

name: Dimension Omega
short_description: Explore, survive and escape the numerous levels of Dimension Omega in order to return to the real world in a creepy, liminal and eerie First-Person-Singleplayer experience while avoiding various terrifying entities that lurk in the shadows, waiting for you...

name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Arcade: Wrath of the Mutants
short_description: Re-experience the 2017 arcade classic with 3 additional stages and 6 additional boss battles! Take control of Leonardo, Michelangelo, Donatello or Raphael in this classic beat-em-up inspired by the cult favorite Turtles in Time. Play with your friends through 4 player local co-op

name: MEGATON MUSASHI W: WIRED
short_description: Launch a counteroffensive to take back the Earth from alien invaders in this mecha action RPG.

name: BlockStar VR
short_description: BlockStar VR is a VR shooter where you put your reflexes to the test by shooting blocks and completing challenges in an action-packed futuristic tournament. Play the 40-mission story mode and show that you have what it takes to flex on the leaderboard!

name: Fatermyth
short_description: 'Fatermyth' is an RPG game that combines tabletop role-playing and adventure. The storylines of seven characters from different eras intertwine, depicting an epic of human heroes. The strategic battles with dice + skills add more challenges to the adventure.

name: Urban Escape
short_description: Urban Escape is a first-person, fast paced parkour game. Go on an adventure in this toon world as the journey will take you across the earth and space. Pass through various challenges and hazards to reach your destination.

name: Rogue Girl
short_description: Rogue Girl is a roguelike game that will immerse you in an exciting adventure, where you will play as a beautiful devil girl called upon to fight an army of sinister zombies. Your path of progress depends on your decisions. Various types of enemies, random rooms, and skills.

name: Backrooms Break
short_description: Explore and break the environments of the Backrooms and Poolrooms! Utilize Thor's demolition hammer, firearms, and explosives to carve your way through the walls and entities. This isn't just another mundane walking simulator game. Now the entities are the victims. Overcome your fears with violence.

name: Brand New World
short_description: You are given a chance to influence the development of your characters and settlement, forcing you to think strategically and make decisions that will affect the events in the game. Enjoy this immersive game experience where your every move will have meaning and consequences.

name: Oddsparks: An Automation Adventure
short_description: Oddsparks is a blend of Automation and Real Time Strategy for both the die-hard fans of the Automation genre and the Automation-curious. Explore a strange fantasy world, uncover the mysteries of the past, automate your workshops, and go on adventures with your odd & adorable Sparks!

name: Toing's Pops 2
short_description: Toing's Pops 2 is a singleplayer adventure horror game. Save your friend from his isolation while unlocking the secrets to Chardonnay's plans. Become empowered, and prepare to end this all.

name: Piranha Feeding
short_description: Piranha Feeding is a thrilling action game with rogue-lite elements, where you control a voracious school of piranhas on a quest for the ultimate feeding frenzy. Conquer a succession of prey, ranging from smaller aquatic creatures to formidable adversaries, unlocking new abilities along the way.

name: Simple Sanguo
short_description: 连角色头像都没有，谁会想玩吗？你别说，汉字就是有这样的魔力。有的人，你只要看到了他的姓名，就愿意舍命追随！恰好，刘备就是这样的人！如果你也厌倦了武力、智力的争吵，简易三国志同样是你不该错过的游戏！在《刘备篇》里跟随刘备纵横天下，然后在无尽挑战中验证自己的操作吧！！

name: 镜花饴情 Mirage Sugar Acacia
short_description: 饴情甜蜜转瞬即逝，女生之间的爱情就像镜花般脆弱。 踏入大学校园的自由舞台，交织着理想与现实迷茫前行，她们的缘分是否可以开花结果呢？ 甘之如饴的一对一百合故事，多结局。

name: Tales of Kenzera™: ZAU
short_description: Wield the dance of the shaman. Reclaim your father’s spirit. Brave the beautiful and treacherous land of Kenzera with the God of Death in Tales of Kenzera™: ZAU, a metroidvania-style adventure crafted by Surgent Studios.

name: Shadow of the Depth
short_description: Shadow of the Depth is a top-down action Roguelite game. Delve into a dungeon world of light and shadow to eradicate the monsters that ravage your home. Be prepared to step into the abyss before you!

name: Pine Harbor
short_description: Pine Harbor was a small fishing town on the shores of the North Atlantic Ocean, surrounded by cliffs and dense pine forests, shrouded in thick fog. But everything changed as a result of a technological disaster. Explore the town, help its residents, and delve into the depths of the dark forests.

name: Hoversteppers
short_description: Hoversteppers is a freestyle hoverboard skating game. Flip, spin, and test your boarding skills with timed challenges across multiple stages.

name: Sucker for Love: Date to Die For
short_description: Put the ‘love’ in 'Lovecraftian horror!' Avoid the fanatical cultists and survive dangerous rituals to escape the Black Woods with your life in this 90’s anime inspired visual novel!

name: Dice Assassin
short_description: Dice Assassin is a challenging game where you defeat enemies on the board according to the dice numbers. Choose attacks using cards, position yourself strategically to overcome enemies on the board, and devise tactics using action cards.

name: Oh No! I Died and Woke Up a Greek God!
short_description: Oh No! You died and were reborn as a god on Mount Olympus! Your goal is to find a way back to Earth! The problem? Gods keep falling in love with you! Go on dates, party through the night, and find out what’s happening on this crazy mountain!

name: Masonic Mysteries: Secrets Unveiled
short_description: Unravel the secrets of the Masons and survive FBI's pursuit in Masonic Mysteries. High stakes and hidden dangers await.

name: Spellarium 6
short_description: Spellarium is becoming increasingly puzzle-like! In this game, we've introduced the Iron Box, which adds some twists to the levels. As usual, there's a story to follow, a town to build, and some bonus games!

name: DeMiriam Magic: Blueprint of Miracle
short_description: Create your sweet memories with the girls on the island, manage and build your own island in a relaxed atmosphere, operate the island's airport, and try driving a small plane to visit the island you have built

name: Rustil: Eternal Labyrinth Castle
