short_description: In this exhilarating roguelike action game, the main character, Rustil, acquires abilities from the souls of various heroes in a huge and mysterious labyrinth castle, and aims to reach the top floor while strengthening the main character. All monsters can be captured, raised, and summoned!

name: Band of Brigands
short_description: Band of Brigands is an exhilarating dungeon crawler where players vie for riches in treacherous depths. Outsmart lurking monsters and rival brigands alike. Snatch valuable loot and escape before your teammates do. In this world, trust is transient, and alliances shift like shadows.

name: HEART of CROWN Online
short_description: The great emperor's untimely death... Seven princesses are candidates for his succession! Who will save the empire from chaos? An online deck-growing card game where you grow your deck and fight for the Princess.

name: Werewolf: The Apocalypse — The Book of Hungry Names
short_description: Save the living earth with Rage and spirit! Can your shattered werewolf pack defeat a Wyrm Spirit that manifests as a lie that you want to believe?

name: Dead Island 2
short_description: A deadly virus is spreading across Los Angeles, turning its inhabitants into zombies. Bitten, infected, but more than just immune, uncover the truth behind the outbreak and discover who - or what - you are. Survive, evolve and become the ultimate Zombie Slayer.

name: Hide And Seek
short_description: 'Hide And Seek' is a game where you collect items to escape the house that has been merged with the school you went to and turned into a complicated maze. Escape the randomly generated house and win the bet!

name: Summer Nightmare
short_description: Summer Nightmare is a game that shows the life of one of the people, a man who did not love his mother.He was born into a fatherless family, grew up on the streets, and was addicted to gambling.When he found his love, he did not move out from his mother, but brought his beloved to his parents' house

name: Cotton Candy's Terror Factory
short_description: A Sweet and strange horror experience, you are Contestant 9127.

name: The Hungry Lamb: Traveling in the Late Ming Dynasty
short_description: Trek across ancient China in a dark, boundary-pushing visual novel inspired by traditional Chinese art with modern animation. Escort four girls to the prosperous city of Luoyang in a branching narrative with themes of revenge, cannibalism, involuntary servitude, and more on a redemptive journey.

name: Reflectron
short_description: Reflectron is a geometrically-styled arcade game that will keep you coming back for more. Halfway between a brick-breaker and Geometry Wars, with a pinch of Vampire Survivors thrown in for good measure, it's a simple yet effective mix that will keep you coming back for more.

name: Phantom Fury
short_description: Shelly “Bombshell” Harrison is back in this highly interactive mix of first person action and road movie adventure. Embark on an adrenaline-fueled journey around the USA. Use an enormous arsenal of weapons and skills to battle treacherous soldiers and vile mutants, all while trying to save mankind.

name: Startenders: Intergalactic Bartending
short_description: Prepare for your unexpected enrollment into the Startenders Academy. Your goal is to create bizarre beverages for colourful customers in the hope that no one notices you haven’t the slightest clue what’s going on.

name: Jawbreaker
short_description: Will you survive when the world falls apart? Jawbreaker is a punishing stealth & survival horror game that will have you running, hiding, and fighting in a terrifying gang-infested society on the verge of collapse. Though that’s not all, once the sun goes down the true fear begins...

name: Manor Lords
short_description: Manor Lords is a medieval strategy game featuring in-depth city building, large-scale tactical battles, and complex economic and social simulations. Rule your lands as a medieval lord -- the seasons pass, the weather changes, and cities rise and fall.

name: Minicology
short_description: You have crash-landed into a mini-verse of tiny planets. Welcome to Minicology! Embark on an interstellar survival sandbox journey. Use your crafting, combat, and automation skills to survive the many challenges this mini-verse throws at you.

name: Age of Water
short_description: Age of Water is an online adventure game set on a post-apocalyptic Earth completely covered in water. Sail through storms, fight and trade, capture other people's boats or build your own, extract resources from the bottom of the ocean and reveal the secrets of the Age of Water world.

name: MUSA
short_description: Fight numerous monsters in exciting battles and obtain them all. Defeat all monsters and obtain all artifacts.

name: Lunar Lander Beyond
short_description: Guide a roster of colorful pilots, eclectic advisors and state-of-the-art landers through a taxing series of missions. Deliver cargo, retrieve resources, and rescue stranded pilots as you navigate a mysterious universe of moons and planets.

name: Whisker Waters
short_description: Whisker Waters is the ultimate RPG adventure that blends light fantasy and the art of fishing into a mesmerizing world. As a player, you'll create and play as your very own Cat character and embark on a whimsical fishing journey like never before.

name: Droplette
short_description: Droplette is a cozy puzzle platformer where a spirited girl named Droplette learns and uses element-based abilities on the environment around her to rescue the droplet boy, Driplet! Shoot versatile projectiles and transform through obstacles in this watery world.

name: Oriental Valley
short_description: Oriental Valley is a life simulation game, with modern new rural construction and wonderful adventures beyond your expetation. You coincidentally arrive in a modern magic village and begin a leisurely journey of farming, making friends with unique residents, and exploring a world full of novelties.

name: Mycelium Guardians
short_description: Isometric strategy game, you command a collective of fungi in a post-apocalyptic Earth. Utilize mycelium to build structures, manage resources, and mitigate environmental threats. Your choices shape the balance between life and desolation. Engage in strategy to be Earth's final line of defense

name: Horror Cartridge Collection
short_description: A collection of retro styled games bundled together, experience many forms of horror in a wide array of styles whilst uncovering the mysteries of the old mall that holds them all.

name: Tents and Trees
short_description: Think strategically to place tents in the peaceful universe of Tents and Trees, a chill puzzle game with Picross vibes!

name: Monster United
short_description: This is a casual auto-battler game where you need to build your monster legion as you climb the tower! Random levels, rich alliances, and an equipment talent system provide countless possibilities for gameplay strategies, offering both casual relaxation and strategic depth!

name: Bellwright
short_description: Establish and expand your own settlements, liberate the land and assist its villagers, and recruit others to your cause while learning more about a life you had to leave behind. Command your forces, prove your valor through combat, and cement yourself as the hero of your people.

name: Sad Satan Nightmare
short_description: You have been kidnapped by a gang on the dark web and you need to stay alive , but you find a group of audio recordings and pictures related to horrific crimes amidst screams of suffering in the darkness

name: Kenophobia
short_description: A Psychological Horror Backrooms Found Footage Game

name: Bloody Feet
short_description: The girl is sold to an island as a slave by a gang because of her beauty. She seized the opportunity to escape from the prison. She fought the enemy with her legs. With these beautiful feet she would strike down the enemies who had insulted her.

name: STAY ALIVE, MY SON
short_description: Winner of the Producer's Guild Innovation Award and based on the novel by Yathay Pin, Stay Alive My Son is a virtual reality feature based on a true story of a Cambodian genocide survivor and father haunted by his past, to first-handedly experience an inspirational journey about family separation.

name: Abiotic Factor
short_description: Abiotic Factor is a survival crafting experience for 1-6 players set in the depths of an underground research facility. Caught between paranormal containment failure, a military crusade, and chaos from a dozen realms, the world’s greatest minds must survive against the universe’s biggest threats.

name: Astro Pig
short_description: A 90-s inspired lo-fi adventure puzzle platformer about a piglet astronaut and his intelligent ship.

name: Blood Poker
short_description: The Rules are Simple. Bet with your Blood. Enjoy the Show.

name: Dye The Bunny 2
short_description: Dye The Bunny 2 is an Easter-themed psychological and survival horror game and a direct sequel to Dye The Bunny.

name: Nothing DOG
short_description: The dog has left magic in every corner of the world, guiding everyone who loves life. Now, start the first day when the dog will bless you!

name: FANTASYQUEST: ERRANDSAGA
short_description: ( Request Announcement )Bin, has been brainwashed by the demon 'Basilisk'.Visit the mercenary agency 'Ninas Errand' on the continent of Mirgard.

name: CONFUSION
short_description: CONFUSION - first person horror. The main character is an experienced detective named Derek. One day he has to go out on a call, although this was not his responsibility. This event will radically change his life...

name: Pocketing the ball-Billiards Simulator
short_description: Dive into the 3D Billiards Simulator, boasting lifelike graphics and physics for an authentic pool hall experience. Challenge your skills and strategy in a game designed for precision and adaptability, ideal for both intense practice and relaxed play.

name: Trash Troopers: Earth Reclaim
short_description: Instead of constructing cities, you're on a mission to clean up the mess left behind by the older generation. You'll guide your Troopers to pick up trash, dismantle old oil facilities, and transform that waste into amazing things like solar panels, crops, water tanks & houses with recycling stations

name: Mega Mosaic
short_description: Mega Mosaic is a meditative game about completing a single enormous puzzle

name: Medieval Blacksmith
short_description: You are a blacksmith with no past in the cruel lands where feudalism reigns. In this dark land where morality is dictated by the cold steel, the weapons you forge will determine not only your fate but also the destiny of others.

name: Find X :  Shoot the Difference in 4D
short_description: 'FindX is an all-age suitable first-person casual shooting game, where players need to find differences in two time-frozen and similar worlds, and use a variety of quirky weapons to address these discrepancies.'

name: Stories to Tell - Downhill Cemetery
short_description: In 'Stories to tell - Downhill Cemetery' you are a young Japanese man named Hiroshi who decided to move to a new house, he did not know what awaited him...

name: Gray Zone Warfare
short_description: Gray Zone Warfare is an intense tactical FPS emphasizing realism. Join a Private Military Company to explore a vast MMO open world featuring a PvEvP and PvE mode. Strategize and survive against human operators and AI enemies while uncovering the mystery of Lamang Island.

name: PARA♰BELLUM ~ 魔弹帕菈
short_description: Necromancer's army is gathering! But he can't afford Necronomicon Prime so his army can only use free medieval equipment set... We believe that one battle sister can solve them well. Go Forth, Sister Para, Blast your enemy in this survivor-like shooter game!

name: GeoMaze
short_description: Hexaspherical geo-spatial puzzle game.

name: FRONT MISSION 2: Remake
short_description: FRONT MISSION 2: Remake preserves the mature story, strategic turn-based combat, and Wanzer customization options of the original.

name: Topac Battle
short_description: Topac Battle is a cozy and relaxing idle game. Buy Topac Ball, Reveal Cozy Monsters and Level them up, Sell for a higher rarity, and become the master of the chill battle scene. From a simple park to your dream setup with rare exotic monster and ultra-rare color variants!

name: Cyborg Runner
short_description: Endless Runner game where player controls cyborg, whose mission is to collect skulls and avoid spikes, moving enemies and other traps

name: INDIKA
short_description: Play a third-person, story-driven game set in alternative Russia at the turn of the XIX century where religious visions clash with harsh reality. INDIKA tells the story of a young nun who sets off on a journey of self-discovery with the most unusual companion by her side, the devil himself.

name: Surveillance
short_description: A spot the difference horror in which you have to prevent high paranormal activity In different places around the world. Identify suspicious changes in environment and take immediate action!

name: Dreambound
short_description: Mysterious deaths. Dreams that are reality, and reality that is a dream. Will Noah be able to move forward and solve the mystery⁠—or will he give in to the demons of his past? A story-rich BL mystery visual novel.

name: When the Light Dies
short_description: When the Light Dies is a survival game with roguelite elements set in a desolate, frozen wilderness. Step into a murky world of shadow and obscurity as a lone survivor fighting to keep the darkness and the horrors that lurk within at bay.

name: lizards vs Slavs : Arena
short_description: The great Svyatoslav Igorevich was captured by the evil jackets, and now they force him to fight in the arena.

name: Ninja Stealth 5
short_description: Here we go again.

name: 捏鼠妙妙屋
short_description: 你在一个名叫“捏鼠妙妙屋”的建筑中醒来，一群阴险的仓鼠强迫你参加他们的死亡游戏。

name: Firefighter Connor
short_description: Firefighter Connor is a linear narrative visual novel that tells a story in a modern world where humans and furries coexist. The player will play the role of Luo Geng, who is 22 year-old, eligible for marriage registration, and somehow ends up with a marriage with a furry firefighter named Connor.

name: Poltergeist Watcher
short_description: Can you survive the night watching the haunted house?

name: Spaced Out
short_description: Retro, classic, couch-buddy competition in space! Simple controls make it easy for friends and family to join in the fun!

name: Killer Vegetable
short_description: Girl　VS　Vegetables「crisp and fresh」A horror game aiming to conquer vegetables

name: Water Buddy
short_description: Welcome to Water Buddy! The town is on fire, but no one seems to care. Good thing you're here to save the day! You'll need help from your water buddies. All you'll need to do is find them. They're hidden all over the town, wherever water is found. Find all water, by any means, and put out that fire!

name: 西游记 幻想西游释厄传
short_description: A turn based RPG game!Players will follow the plot to encounter various events, defeat various bosses, explore different worlds, and welcome friends who love traditional RPGs to play!

name: Not Alone
short_description: Not Alone is a first-person mystical horror game where you need to escape from a terrifying house. This house may look familiar to some, but that's only at first glance. Read the notes to understand what happened and search for ways to escape.

name: Crop and Claw
short_description: Crop and Claw is a classic-style JRPG centered around dragons in a lush realm known as the 'Garden'. The plantlife has gone awry, bringing a time of decline and stress across the realm. Return to the era of simple questing, dungeons, and progression.

name: Mareld
short_description: Mareld is a card-driven Roguelike role-playing game where you play as a traveler lost in the Lost Forest. You will recruit companions, collect resources, craft items, explore the world, defeat enemies, find your way back home, or uncover the secrets of this extraordinary world.

name: Holy Stone Mage
short_description: This is a mixed type game that can cultivate characters, and battles can be divided into tower defense and duel modes. Players can also enter random maps for exploration, challenge difficult bosses, or discover treasures

name: Chill Pulse
short_description: Chill Pulse combines productivity tools with serene environments. Use a Pomodoro timer and to-do lists to boost focus, while ambient sounds in settings from cyberpunk cities to ancient landscapes enhance relaxation.

name: Feather Party
short_description: Welcome to the fantastic party on the adorable planet of chicks! Feather Party is a multiplayer party game for up to 8 players. Engage in a diverse array of fun mini-games with friends or against rivals to be the winner of this party!

name: Bikini Hunter Attack on Bikini Army
short_description: This is a 3D action game where you become a bikini hunter and fight against the bikini army. ・Use shooting, fighting, guarding, and invincibility techniques depending on the situation You can enjoy a variety of battles.

name: The Reeve
short_description: You are an Administrator serving your probationary period in a medieval town. Make decisions to affect the town's reputation, order, military and supplies. Choose wisely to deal with bandits, famines, cultists and plagues. The most difficult choices will decide the fate of your town!

name: Slav Junkie Simulator
short_description: You live in a small soviet slav eastern european cyberpunk city. You have severe heroin addiction that you need to sustain. Heroin is very expensive and earnings in a rural city are very small, barely enough for survival. Survive one week.

name: Darts Up
short_description: Darts Up is a fun game of darts in which you will have complete control over aiming thanks to the motion sensor. You can play with your friends and family, up to a maximum of 4 Players.

name: Dragon of Steelthorne
short_description: Rule a mighty city, fight battles and go on adventures as the Ardent or Ardessa of the city of Lake Steelthorne. Find love, power, and a secret that could change the world.

name: Mechanical Trap
short_description: Mechanical Trap is a 2D horizontal tower defense game with gravity effects, with a variety of defense towers to collect and use together, a rich map, each enemy has a different way of restraining, and each defense tower has a different function.It's challenging. Do you dare to accept the challenge?

name: SU - Unlocking the 4th Dimension
short_description: SU is a 2.5D deduction puzzle game. The submarine Nautilus suffers a mechanical failure during its voyage. Dr. Pierre investigates and finds anomalies in every area. Explore the deep blue depths, follow Dr. Pierre as he unravels the secrets of the Nautilus.

name: 宅府诡话-Mysteries of the Manor
short_description: In an old mansion rife with secrets, a pretend Taoist unwittingly encounters real ghosts. Unknown to him are their whereabouts, the victim, or his own fate. He must unravel the conspiracy through time loops.

name: 22 Minutes
short_description: In 22 Minutes, players must conquer barriers and fight opponents to progress through the story under a time constraint of 22 minutes.

name: Fungal Fiefdom
short_description: Fungal Fiefdom is a 3D Tower defense, fungi vs robots. Strategically place defensive mushrooms and use powerful abilities to protect your colony and advance against the evil automatons.

name: The Political Machine 2024
short_description: Win the hearts and minds of America’s voters and run for President in this political strategy game. Choose a candidate or create your own and run against the opposing party’s candidate or up to 4 primary candidates controlled by the computer or other players online.

name: MORTARMEN
short_description: MORTARMEN is a strategic multiplayer PvP first and third person shooter, pitting the New American Coalition versus United Communist Front in a battle for control of Arakousa, a Mediterranean paradise, where soldiers traverse via sliding, rolling, climbing, and HALO drops.

name: The Adventures of Lily & Leo
short_description: Discover the magical world of Lily and Leo and help them find their faithful companion Quattro in this captivating puzzle adventure. Set up a tripod, follow animal tracks, have clever conversations and much more to track down the missing dog.

name: Operation Marakudja
short_description: Mmm... It's Marakudjaaaa! Operation Marakudja is a dynamic multiplayer first-person shooter. What can you do for the divine fruits of Marakudja? Choose your hero and fight against many players around the world to collect the precious fruits and win!

name: Polda 5
short_description: Elite private detective Pankrac saves the world as an agent of the Time Police. Help him settle all the time anomalies in the history of mankind.

name: SUPER ALICE DOLLS
short_description: 『SUPER ALICE DOLLS!』 is a 2D platform action game , Touhou Project fan game, crafted with the adorable essence of Alice is Cute! Alice will use the abilities of various dolls to conquer the level.

name: Card Engine
short_description: Create stunning cards without the need for drawing skills. Customize templates, import your own assets, or choose from the extensive built-in library. Seamlessly manage your cards and export them as image files for digital use or printing for physical cards.

name: RefleXion
short_description: Un emocionante juego de rompecabezas y misterio en el que deberás escapar de la habitación en la que estás atrapado. Haz un trato con la muerte, investiga sus oscuros secretos, y a base de ingenio, consigue una segunda oportunidad o perece en el intento.

name: Surmount: A Mountain Climbing Adventure
short_description: Fling yourself into a mountain climbing adventure! Become the first to reach the top of the highest mountain in the world and meet eccentric characters along the way!

name: Doodle Factory
short_description: Welcome to Doodle Factory - your ticket to the world of factory fun! Dive into building and designing with ever-changing boards. Get creative, boost your efficiency with cool upgrades, and make each factory uniquely yours!

name: Zopa
short_description: Meet the new game! In the role of Little Red Riding Hood's relative, you will go on a forest adventure. Throw explosive pies, meet wolves, pigs, gnomes and other inhabitants of the forest. Funny cutscenes, voiced dialogues, unique locations - every step is a new challenge!

name: Fujisan Nobori
short_description: Embark on an adventure to find out the reason for the appearance of monsters on Mt. Fuji. 'Fujisan Nobori' is a game where you defeat boss monsters on each floor and ascend towards the summit. Be the first in your country to reach the summit!

name: 东方希莲船 ~ Ultimate Fatal Octopus
short_description: A Touhou Project fan-made STG, also a collab game with Vtuber Syrena. Some day a random suspicious pink UFO showed up in Gensokyo. This must be an incident! As a result, Reimu and Marisa went on a journey to solve the incident.

name: Tendryll
short_description: Delve into grid-based tactical combat in this roguelike deckbuilder. Coordinate your heroes, modify your cards with unique runes, construct powerful item builds, and sidestep card-corrupting terrain to survive a gauntlet of befouled enemies.

name: カルトに厳しいギャル-CULT VS GAL-
short_description: Make mincemeat out of cults and chop heads with machetes! Old school shooter staples and gals, and a familiar difficulty level. Ye shall witness a new struggle!

name: Chesslike
short_description: A new outlook on the classic strategy game, battle your way to winning.

name: [DE:]Fanastasis
short_description: 「発見」を楽しむ、マップ探索メインの長編RPG。無数の隠し通路、隠し扉が存在する荒廃した王国。 死者の残留思念を覗いて手掛かりを掴み、隠された宝箱のアイテムで探索範囲を広げよう。 各地で得た断片的な情報はいずれ繋がり合い、自らの記憶のみならず、隠された「真実」を暴くかもしれない。

name: The Foretold: Westmark Legacy
short_description: Fight to investigate another day in this gothic horror adventure card game. Equip items and relics. Acquire cards and use them wisely to survive what lurks in the darkest corners of town. Take a short and mind-bending dive into the unknown with a cosy horror atmosphere.

name: Creator of Another World
short_description: A roguelike RPG with a high degree of freedom. Explore the world full of adventures, interact with its inhabitants, marry, steal, do farming and fishing, blacksmithing and forging, mix potions, build towns without being tied to any goal!

name: Guild of Rogues
short_description: Guild of Rogues is a Roguelike Deckbuilder with Autobattler elements. Strategically build your team of minions to create amazing synergies and defeat all enemies!

name: FOUNDRY
short_description: Build a factory optimized to perfection or an artistic masterpiece in an infinite voxel world. Mine and harvest resources, automate your ever-growing production lines and manage complex systems while researching your way to mechanical mastery in FOUNDRY.

name: Tales from Candleforth
short_description: Tales from Candleforth is a folk horror 2D point and click game with puzzles and escape room mechanics, that narrates the fairy tales from the village. The text contained in this ancient and evil book is now bleeding out, mixing the world of nightmares with the real one through handmade 2D graphics.

name: I'm a Rocker!
short_description: You are playing a metalhead in a post-apocalyptic point&click adventure game. Your wish is to go to one last metal concert, because who knows what tomorrow will bring. But to do that you need to create the conditions in the form of some equipment and a car.

name: Hexguardian
short_description: Hexguardian is a roguelite, tower defense game where you build your own maps with hexagonal tiles! Build and upgrade towers, recruit armies, learn spells, construct wonders and place hexagonal tiles to create a path to enhance your defenses. With plenty of game modes and talents to unlock!

name: 茶言茶语
short_description: 'Tea Talk'? Are you a grumpy old man? Or a doormat? Or is there someone else?

name: Signal Control Simulator
short_description: The job of a 'signal worker' is to protect the safety of Japan's railways behind the scenes. Operate the interlocking panels to safely and accurately operate trains that run in seconds. You can experience the work of a signal attendant, which is essential for safe railway operation.

name: Million Star Ship
short_description: This is a single player defense game for interstellar strategy. We have established 36 birth points. Players can freely switch birth points to control the size of the enemy. Set the moon as a base. Our fleet can conquer the universe and find legendary warships. Our journey is the sea of stars.

name: Forgotten Secrets: Escape Room
short_description: A year ago, Professor Oliver Wood left to explore an ancient temple. Worried about not hearing from him, you decide to go yourself to find out his whereabouts. In this escape room, you will have to discover what happened to the professor while you investigate the secrets of this mysterious place.

name: SYON
short_description: A 2D horror to find and repel anomalies. Light the lantern of the girl and the ability of the ghost to fight back.

name: Overworld - Map Keeper's Realm
short_description: Overworld - Map Keeper's Realm is hex-based world building software that utilizes procedural generation to create highly detailed maps. Alternatively, import your own map and begin sculpting your world and writing your lore. Become a Master Keeper!

name: Fantasy Tower
short_description: Game Purpose：Who can take the least days, Way up HT tower top? We tell you: You're buy the future of this game HT Version 1.0, Only Support to 5 floor Least a week or month, we will update and add some feature.

name: Bear Warrior
short_description: be a hero Bear with sword and bow and kill fat sumo and find hidden golden skulls

name: MotoGP™24
short_description: Rev up your engines, MotoGP™24 is back! Dive into the heart-pounding action of the 2024 season and immerse yourself in the thrills of unexplored landscapes, all thanks to the revolutionary Riders market!

name: 帝国末日前的学院狂想
short_description: A fictional history based text romance adventure game based on the early 20th century. You need to use your choices to determine you, the one you choose, and even the fate of this country in an era where human stars shine.

name: 永无止境的黑暗森林
short_description: 组建你的探险队，向无尽森林深处探索，寻找灾祸的真相。

name: Footgun: Underground
short_description: Roguelike with balls! Prove your ball skills and dribble your way through a randomly generated, dangerous track network full of deadly challenges! Face post-apocalyptic mutants, improve your balls with high-tech upgrades and escape the pixel art underground labyrinth.

name: Let Bions Be Bygones
short_description: Having lost everything, a retired, hardboiled detective, John Cooper, must take his last case to find a missing upper-class girl among the lowest parts of the dystopian city-planet Terrahive. Choose your unique path in this atmospheric narrative future-noir thriller.

name: Floralgraphic Memory
short_description: After decided to skip school today, Rose whisked himself away to another world full of whimsies and magic.

name: Taimanin Yukikaze
short_description: A classic visual novel about a demon-slaying ninja. Yukikaze is an up-and-coming young Taimanin with a suite of deadly lightning powers, but when she embarks on a mission to rescue her missing mother, she just might have bitten off more than she can chew...

name: Kingdom Of Peace
short_description: Take on the role of an ordinary, hard-working and adventure-hungry Racław, who wants to be as good a man as his father. Help people in the medieval land of the Kingdom of Peace! Fight, Explore and Meet new faces in this amazing world.

name: The Citizen
short_description: The Citizen is a first person narrative comedy game (absurdist narrator-fetish) about “how to deal with important subjects without saying anything”. Featuring completed sentences, the game transcends the bare minimum steam requirements.

name: Argumentum ad culpam
short_description: Argumentum ad culpam is a gothic visual novel about the world of eternal agony. A capricious dance of principles and death. Take part in twisted battles of wits, where morality is only a tool for survival, and decide what future that world will have.

name: XiuzhenWorld / 修真世界
short_description: Immortal Cultivation World is a 3D world where your goal is to level up from a mere mortal into an immortal at the end. Its a semi-idle game with fun immortal cultivation mechanics such as - leveling up to become stronger. - capturing monsters as pets to fight for you. - AFK(Away From Keybourd).

name: SP-LIGHT
short_description: Race through levels as Splight the robot, soaring past obstacles at high speeds!

name: Any way out
short_description: Explore a mysterious hotel's treacherous corridors to reach the bottom floor and escape. Use your wits to spot anomalies, avoiding traps to progress. Trust your intuition to overcome challenges and find freedom.

name: Dog Brew
short_description: Dog Brew - a light indie adventure where the main character, burdened by debts, decides to settle them through the art of brewing beer.

name: Wild West Blast
short_description: Welcome to Wild West Blast – Your Ultimate Adventure in the Wild West and Your New Favorite Aim Trainer! Step into the boots of a fearless bounty hunter in the heart of the untamed prairie.

name: King Island 2
short_description: Embark on an adventure to uncover the mysteries of Kaptivo's transformation into an Arcane Warrior in this thrilling hack'n'slash action Flash RPG and sequel to King Island.

name: Whitewater VR: Extreme Kayaking Adventure
short_description: Get ready to paddle through some of the world's wildest, and most challenging rapids in breathtaking VR. With stunning graphics, realistic physics, and heart-pumping action, you'll race against the clock as you navigate through wild waters filled with obstacles and surprises.

name: Jorogumo's Cradle
short_description: Jorogumo’s Cradle is a short first person horror game. You are stuck in the woods with a monster that attacks you during the night. Explore the area, build tools to fend off incoming attacks, and most importantly, survive until the very end.

name: Mushroots
short_description: New RTS for everyone!

name: Party Pirates
short_description: Party Pirates is a couch co-op game where players become clumsy pirates traveling from port to port, taking on dangerous foes and sea monsters along the way. Gather your crew, don an eyepatch, and do everything to keep your ship afloat!

name: Truck
short_description: Survive endless hordes of zombies by driving over them and upgrading your truck with weapons. The only way out is to keep driving. Survive 30 minutes in each of the five maps, collect coins and unlock new trucks!

name: FIREWALL: Cyber Defense
short_description: A lore-based cyberspace tower-defense where you defend artificially intelligent Constructs from Corrupted bugs and viruses.

name: Echoes of the Plum Grove
short_description: A new life awaits in Honeywood! Build a thriving community that will last generations in this cozy farm simulator. Farm, socialize, make friends, cook, craft, forage and uncover the secrets of the island! If someone doesn’t want to be friends? There are always other means.

name: black out.
short_description: Race your ship across a metallic landscape and absorb power fragments to replenish your constantly depleting energy supply. Accomplish different missions and unlock new ships and materials. Compete on the global scale for the highest scores. New missions are regularly added.

name: Cat Got Your Tongue
short_description: Cat Got Your Tongue is a horror point-and-click game where you have to escape from the Home Cat by exploring the darkest corners of the house.

name: Cards and Guns
short_description: Cards and Guns is a top-down arena shooter roguelite, where you’ll have to defeat hordes of creatures. Choose from a variety of cards and upgrades to create unique builds and survive to the end.

name: Homing Instinct
short_description: Please send a completely intoxicated person home safely.

name: Bewitching Sinners
short_description: Bewitching Sinners is a dark comedy dating sim where your choices will either leave you with your true love or ruin a whole world and potentially killing millions of people within it, no pressure! Explore a fantasy world full of witches, hot priests, and the occasional dance with death.

name: The Lullaby of Life
short_description: Play musical notes to solve timing-based puzzles in a journey where you bring dormant beings to life. Explore colorful environments and create harmonious sounds to navigate through this tranquil puzzle adventure inspired by the origins of life.

name: Bob the Block: Rebooted
short_description: Bob the Block Rebooted is a pixelated indie platformer heavily influenced by recoil mechanics. You must use your ability to jump paired with your infinite ammo gun to traverse 40 difficult stages. Conquer anything from large, expansive jumps to tight, precise maze-like levels.

name: memorel
short_description: Memorel is a cozy puzzle game that let's you relax while you test your memory through interaction with hand-drawn images from days of yore. Explore the minds of artists from the 18th to the 20th century while you train your memory. 200+ cards just wait for you to collect them.

name: Undead Inc.
short_description: Undead Inc. is a high-risk, high-reward resource management simulator where you establish and manage a local subsidiary of the Endswell Medical Corporation. Build, manage staff, conduct research, and trade in both cutting edge medical treatments and bleeding edge bioweapons.

name: Spanky!
short_description: Spanky! is THE booty-physics party game that brings cheeky movement mechanics to chaos-filled party modes. Twerk online with up to 7 friends and slap some jiggly tush!

name: Deflect Boy
short_description: Deflect Boy is a top-down arena shooter, that instead of guns, you only have a shield. Deflect the bullets and combine new skills to create unique deflection powers and survive until the nightmare ends.

name: Dragon Ruins
short_description: A dungeon crawling microgame for tired people.

name: Blue
short_description: 'Blue' is a hardcore platformer game with pixel art style. Players need to complete collection objectives in different levels while avoiding various monsters and obstacles.

name: Way Nd Choice
short_description: Way Nd Choice is a game that combines a resource management adventure with a text adventure, AI Illusts, AI Illusts. Explore the world and complete the given objectives by consuming health, sanity, and gold appropriately. It's important to choose your options based on your tendencies.

name: Project Of Cooling The Earth
short_description: Players must survive in the ruins of the human world and face various survival challenges and dangers. Players need to search for resources in abandoned cities and wilderness, including food, water sources, construction materials, etc., to maintain survival and build safe shelters.

name: Bloodwood Dungeon
short_description: Detailed, gritty text-based fantasy RPG centered on dungeon crawling with traps, puzzles, fights and loot. Recreates the gameplay of the old gamebooks. Simple battle system and hassle-free inventory management.

name: Dungeon Minesweeper
short_description: Dungeon Minesweeper is a unique adventure game, with elements of roguelike and minesweeper! Find out all the secrets of the dungeon, upgrade your character, fight factions and defeat the boss!

name: Wage Slave TD
short_description: Place more than a dozen kinds of wage slaves with special skills to eliminate weird bosses. In addition to classic tower defense elements, you will also encounter various events in the workplace, and different decisions can form unique attack styles. There is also a random mode for unlimited play.

name: Seal: WHAT the FUN
short_description: 'Seal: WHAT the FUN' is an omniverse multiplayer party royale game that allows up to 20 players to enjoy a range of compact plays in 10 minutes. Players can customize their characters with variety of effects and features, making the game more interactive and unpredictable.

name: Observe and Report
short_description: The ultimate surveillance game. Monitor camera feeds solo, team up in multiplayer, or versus friends. Detect anomalies, report suspicious activities, and ensure security across diverse locations. Your watchful eyes make the difference!

name: Code Name Teacher
short_description: As an undercover cop, you'll infiltrate a criminal organization to bring it down. As a teacher, your mission is to stop the gang in school and the neighborhood! Your choices shape the story, relationships, and outcomes. The decisions are yours.

name: Chess Gambit
short_description: Play chess like never before in a captivating medieval world. Lead animated armies and take on challenging rivals in private online matches. Test your skills with advanced AI or enjoy casual matches with friends offline. Conquer castles and reign supreme in an enchanting 3D chess experience!

name: Military Battlefield: Enlisted
short_description: Military Battlefield is a FPS shooter The game is set in a realistic environment. You play as a soldier on either side of the conflict, and must use your shooting skills to defeat the enemy. Will you survive this forever lasting war?

name: Aery - Stone Age
short_description: In Aery – Stone Age you play as a little flying spirit that watches humanity in its early states evolve. You will discover a long-forgotten land with beautiful environments, and you will be able to enjoy the feeling of flying while exploring a whole world filled with beauty and little secrets.

name: Farm Together 2
short_description: Grow your own farm all by yourself, or cooperate with your friends in the long awaited sequel to the cozy, relaxing farming experience!

name: Duck Life 9: The Flock
short_description: Raise your ducklings into the ultimate team of racers in Duck Life 9, where everything is bigger, bolder & more beautiful than ever before! Embark on a quest as you journey across the huge Featherhaven Island, meeting new friends & taking on recruits to help topple the competition & take the crown!

name: Edge Of Endless
short_description: In a boundless desert, one finds oneself lost, compelled to continue onwards. Discover where they are headed. Along this journey, you'll uncover the story of (you), and see where their tale concludes. Hopefully

name: Fallen Seeds
short_description: As Evod, a special agent of the Earth Empire, you embark on a thrilling adventure to the enigmatic planet of Ulthar, inhabited by the zoomorphic tribe of the Flock, a biotechnological extraterrestrial civilization. Your mission is to unravel an ancient mystery that holds the key to your destiny.

name: Spectral Scream
short_description: Horror Party Game 'Spectral Scream' is an online cooperative horror game that can be enjoyed by 1 to 4 players. You enter 'Purgatory,' the space between the living and the dead, wearing a mysterious mask, and must gather the scattered cores of Purgatory.

name: The Bridge Curse 2: The Extrication
short_description: Try to escape with your life in a first-person survival horror adventure. Play through the eyes of four distinct characters as you evade and confront terrifying ghosts, unravel mind-bending puzzles, and unearth a sinister conspiracy…

name: Eggstraction
short_description: Eggstraction is a multiplayer (4vs1) heist game where four feathered friends must face off against an egg-napping farmer. With chaos around every corner, can the chickens rescue their stolen eggs, or will they end up back in their cage?

name: CANDYLAND: Sweet Survival
short_description: Delve into the chilling enigmas of a forsaken chocolate factory, where shadows lurk and whispers echo through the empty halls. Traverse haunting levels fraught with foreboding, decipher macabre puzzles, and evade the grasp of sinister entities that hunger for your soul.

name: Pocket Oasis
short_description: Pocket Oasis is a beautiful hand-painted cozy gardening simulator, where you can plant seeds and relax as your plants bloom and grow. Discover new cities, and decorate your own little pocket of nature.

name: Little Kitty, Big City
short_description: You're a curious little kitty with a big personality, on an adventure to find your way back home. Explore the city, make new friends with stray animals, wear delightful hats, and leave more than a little chaos in your wake. After all, isn't that what cats do best?

name: King Arthur: Legion IX
short_description: Dive into a unique blend of turn-based tactics and character-centric RPGs. Lead the skilled Roman tribune Gaius Julius Mento as he navigates through the dark fantasy realm of Avalon.

name: 再见吧！义父！
short_description: The game type is Roguelike + Trading card game. The external events are meat pigeons and the internal battles are trading card battles. The theme is the Three Kingdoms, and the prototype of the character played by the player is Lyu Bu. This game is the biography of Lyu Bu in the series.

name: Kirakira Slimes
short_description: Kirakira slimes are adorable, chubby and defenseless creatures. They're vulnerable to most of the world's perils by themselves, but together they’re unbeatable. Fuse, combine and power up your slimes in this indie puzzle game, either by playing in local versus or all by yourself!

name: Hades II
short_description: Battle beyond the Underworld using dark sorcery to take on the Titan of Time in this bewitching sequel to the award-winning rogue-like dungeon crawler.

name: Strongloween: The Escape
short_description: Live the adventure of Torkin, prisoner of STRONGLOWEEN. Discover powerful items and fight bosses that will prevent you and other prisoners from escaping. Strongloween holds many secrets, will you discover them all?

name: KAMLA
short_description: Find a way out of an old mansion as a priest, you have been tasked to exorcise a woman who has been possessed. Solve puzzles and complete objectives to cure her demonic possession in this SURVIVAL HORROR experience.

name: Undercover - Secret Management
short_description: Help Veronica solve another dark mystery and reconcile with her sister.

name: 莫比乌斯疑案
short_description: 多条故事线，高智商烧脑反转型剧情类RPG游戏，线索伏笔众多。

name: Nerobi
short_description: Help Nerobi recover his memory and overcome a thousand challenges in this immersive, secret-filled and entirely hand-drawn graphic platforming adventure.

name: CHIPPED
short_description: A computer game, survive an open world motherboard.

name: Crow Country
short_description: The year is 1990. It’s been two years since the mysterious disappearance of Edward Crow and the abrupt closure of his theme park, Crow Country. But your arrival has broken the silence, Mara Forest. If you want answers, you’ll have to venture deep into the darkness of Crow Country to find them…

name: Karting with Animals
short_description: 'Karting with Animals: The Wild Race' flips the script on traditional racing games, infusing the thrill of speed with the unpredictability of the animal kingdom.

name: Check in
short_description: 'Check in' is a pure collection-based game where there are no complex operations; completing all challenges simply requires checking in on different dates.

name: Construction Helper
short_description: Welcome to the dynamic realm of wealth and opportunity within the real estate domain!

name: Honor Battle
short_description: **Honor Battle**: Dive into the heart of conflict in this thrilling action game, where you stand as the last line of defense against a brutal terrorist insurgency.

name: Cosmic: A Journey Among Shadows
short_description: Embark on an epic journey across the land of darkness to save your best friend - your own shadow. Meet a mysterious stranger, the shadow of a mighty beast, who will help you survive. Explore, gain new skills and take advantage of your ally to defeat enemies and get back a lost part of yourself.

name: Heading Out
short_description: It's you, your car and the road. As you drive across the USA, people take notice. But nobody knows where you'll end up - not even you.

name: Brocula
short_description: Embark on an enchanting journey as Brocula, a vampire awakening after centuries. Earn money through part-time jobs, explore the town, salvage your castle, and enhance your vampire skills. Unleash your dark reputation, amass fortunes, and shape your immortal legacy.

name: Rosemary
short_description: Rosemary is a first person psychological horror game. Delve into the eerie depths of an abandoned psychiatric facility to unravel the mysteries behind the longing presence of spirits and demons, years after its closure.

name: Who's the BOSS
short_description: The game features a variety of game modes, each with its own unique challenges and objectives.

name: Rainbow Cotton
short_description: Cotton, the legendary witch is back, and this time in 3D! Get ready for this formerly Japanese exclusive cute ‘em up gem to be “reconjured”. ININ and Success have teamed up once again to bring you a massively improved - and for the first time worldwide - re-release of Rainbow Cotton.

name: Level UP! Factory
short_description: Commander! Manage your shelter with survivors in a abandoned nuclear power plant. Search resources to make different types of boxes, send expeditions, repair work areas, face enemies to defend your facilities, deploy drones and rc cars, prepare for special events and more. All in real-time.

name: Konkwest
short_description: The arcade grand strategy game. In Konkwest you and your friends can play through a world conquest campaign in an evening. Many historical starting scenarios bring you into the game world and let you lead your empire to glory. The single-resource economy makes the game accessible to all.

name: 虚灯のセレスティア
short_description: 虚灯のセレスティアは雪と闇に覆われた世界を彷徨う探索RPGです。厳しい寒さと深い暗闇を突き進むのには敵を倒して灯火を集める必要があります。自分は何者で、親身に助けてくれる白い修道女は何者なのか。散りばめられた記憶を辿り、その結末を見届けましょう。

name: Dudelings: Arcade Sportsball
short_description: Dudelings: Arcade Sportsball is a fast-paced sportslike. A cross between Pong and Foosball, this title brings high-energy local mutiplayer fun to the table!

name: Pandaty
short_description: Pandaty is 2D Cute Platformer Game, Explore this sweet world of adventure!

name: The Other Side: Tower of Souls Remaster
short_description: The return of a 2014 classic now fully remastered for modern platforms! Can you resolve a family squabble before the gates to the realm of the dead swing open in this collector’s edition of The Other Side: Tower of Souls?

name: Archery Simulator 2
short_description: Archery Simulator 2 is a thrilling game that is perfect for those who love to test their archery skills.

name: Star Salvager
short_description: MERGE blocks to get ammo... BLAST the alien horde... and BUILD the ultimate fighting drone! Not gonna lie, this game is a PARTY!

name: 道衍诀
short_description: 仙途有尽道无尽，探索风格迥异又危险重重的世界，追寻传说中的不传之秘，打造专属至宝，从数百种灵法与神通中，构建属于自己的战斗流派。于此方世界吐纳天地灵气，探索多方世界，结识仙友道侣，请尽情体验修仙RPG游戏《道衍诀》。

name: The Pirate's Quest
short_description: The Pirate's Quest - You go in search of exciting adventures and ancient treasure hidden on a mysterious island. You will explore dangerous seas, coves and ancient ruins in search of a treasure map, face competitors and fight sea monsters.

name: Zink
short_description: A unique puzzle game with serene, procedural graphics and timeless gameplay. Bump cubes into the ocean, until only one remain, and you have sunk the island!

name: Oceanarium World
short_description: Build your ultimate aquarium and water park! Manage marine park and make it successful by building aquariums and attractions. Display beautiful, rare or monstrous fishes that your visitors demand and make them satisfied.

name: Depths of Despair
short_description: Welcome to Depths of Despair, a thrilling solo/multiplayer game where you must fight off waves of enemies to survive for a set amount of time. With each wave, the enemies become stronger and more challenging to defeat. Can you and your team hold out long enough?

name: Whispers in the Void
short_description: The main hero John Eikts wakes up in a mysterious room for supernatural creatures. Anomalies escape, wreaking havoc. Eikts must navigate the chaos while uncovering his dark past. As he approaches freedom, a shocking twist reveals that he is not a victim, but one of them.

name: Oil Truck Transporter
short_description: Oil Truck Transporter is an exciting and challenging game that puts you in the driver's seat of a powerful oil truck.

name: Descent the Abyss
short_description: Descent the Abyss - you take on the role of an experienced detective who goes in search of a lost traveler lost in a dangerous underground labyrinth. You must explore dark and twisted corridors, solve puzzles, fight monsters, and overcome traps to navigate through danger and find the missing person.

name: Last Mech Standing
short_description: VR rogue-like, arcade-style shoot-them-up. Pilot the Crimson Slayer, the last giant mech and humanity’s final hope. Slash waves of giant monsters with your sword & blast them with your minigun. Upgrade your weapons & tech along the way, find your fighting style, defeat bosses and level up!

name: Exit Slum 11
short_description: Exit Slum 11 is an anomaly observation running simulator with an eerie atmosphere.

name: Tower Defense: Infinite War
short_description: In the far future, people build a base on a strange planet they don't know about to protect their limited resources. Protect your base from the incessant invasion of extraterrestrial beings!

name: Jurnal Malam : Bestfriend
short_description: In this game, players will play the role of Afdal, a person whose fate is the opposite of Rahmad's, so one night Rahmad asks Afdal to help look after the house, but unfortunately, everything is not fine, because of the terror that Afdal is experiencing.

name: Promise with My Sister
short_description: A story centered around sisters, and as their brother, I must protect them. My mission is to find and reclaim the memories of time spent with my sisters. Numerous adventures filled with challenges are just beginning. This is my very own RPG life!

name: Chess Tools
short_description: Learn to play chess with Chess Tools. Learn with tutorials, various tools and learn from many famous games from some of the greatest players!

name: The Curse Of Grimsey Island
short_description: Four separate cases spanning hundreds of years. Are they linked by a curse or something else entirely? The Curse of Grimsey Island is a futuristic detective game where you collect evidence, find motives, and solve one of the greatest mysteries in modern times.

name: AdventureBarStory
short_description: Adventure through the kingdom, collecting materials! Make food, manage a bar!

name: With My Past
short_description: 'How should I face my past in my ever-changing life? 'Collaborating with the shadow of the past to unravel allegorical puzzles, confront inner struggles, and explore the path of self-growth.

name: Rabbit and Steel
short_description: RABBIT & STEEL is a co-op action roguelike that recreates the essence of high-level MMO raiding in a randomized, simplified, bunny-sized package. Choose your class, gather your rabbit-eared companions and battle your way to the Moonlit Pinnacle!

name: ANIMAL WELL
short_description: Explore a dense, interconnected labyrinth, and unravel its many secrets. Collect items to manipulate your environment in surprising and meaningful ways. Encounter beautiful and unsettling creatures, as you attempt to survive what lurks in the dark. There is more than what you see.

name: Annuit Coeptis
short_description: Deckbuilder. Roguelite. Metaprogression. Words are a weak attempt to describe reality - in Annuit Coeptis you use cards to wreak violence across a land poised upon the brink of destruction. Will you defy the End of the World?

name: PAC-MAN Mega Tunnel Battle: Chomp Champs
short_description: Eat your way through multiple interconnected mazes using Power Pellets and a variety of Power Items to chomp the GHOSTS and opponent PAC-MAN players! Be the last PAC standing at the end of each match in this 64-player Battle Royale to be the Chomp Champ!

name: Soul Hero Adventure
short_description: A pixel-styled bullet hell strategy magic/fantasy CRPG

name: Swords & Bones 4
short_description: The fourth installment of Swords & Bones immerses you in a new fantasy adventure, with pixel art in a side-scrolling action-platformer style. In this latest chapter, harness the power of magic to emerge victorious!

name: Evergreen: The Board Game
short_description: A tree-growing abstract strategy game where you make your planet the greenest and most fertile of all!

name: TRAUMA Pro Wrestling
short_description: I'ts TRAUMA Pro Wrestling! Fight in all sorts of match types, such as cage match, last man standing, electric barbed-wire, ironman and MORE! Customize your experience down to the most minute details in order to create your very own dream match and experience our 5 stars Career Mode!

name: Five Elements: Ghosts Delivery
short_description: A puzzle game based on the Five Elements of ancient Chinese philosophy, showcasing the process of the generation and evolution of all things. Here, you are the protagonist little ghost, and you will have different skills and use the power of the Five Elements to reach the place you want to reach.

name: Star Leaping Story
short_description: Players will help a white-robed girl and her friends uncover the truth of the planet using unique dash gameplay. The storyline is fully voiced by renowned actors, with meticulously designed levels and energetic music for you to enjoy!

name: Quadrillion
short_description: 'Quadrillion' presents an immersive alternate-history experience set in the backdrop of a darkly reimagined First World War. This first-person game masterfully blends elements of dark fantasy with a unique retro aesthetic, offering players a captivating and eerie world to explore.

name: Basketball VR
short_description: Casual Basketball game, that allows anyone to play 5-5 matches. It should not cause VR discomfort and it's designed to give you fun and relax, so expect plenty of points scored and opponent that will give you a lot of freedom.

name: Block Paradise
short_description: 'Block Paradise' is an anime-styled Match 3 Game .

name: Lost Meow
short_description: In the winter city, a cute cat fights for survival, begging for food from pedestrians and warming itself on manhole covers. Avoid dangers like passing cars, hostile dogs, and unfriendly pedestrians. Help the kitty get home in this captivating arcade!

name: Parina's Demon Lair Adventure
short_description: Step into the fantastical world of Parina and embark on an exhilarating journey through realms of magic and mystery! Sharpen your senses as you delve into this captivating hidden object adventure, where every scene is brimming with treasures waiting to be discovered.

name: Climbing In Barrel With Double-Barrel
short_description: This is a challenging game about climbing in barrel with double-barrel.

name: QUESTSCAPE: Survival
short_description: On a secluded medieval, awake in a small village surrounded by wildlife nature and bandits and many challanges. Evolve your land in search of new adventures.

name: Domino Fit
short_description: Can you Domino Fit? The best parts of sudoku, mixed with those little tiling puzzles you'd play at the dentist, Domino Fit is a rewarding logic puzzle about getting all the dominos to fit! Supports 6x6, 7x7, and 8x8 boards.

name: Fear the Moon
short_description: A story driven cryptid horror game featuring survival horror elements where you come face to face with a Midwest cryptid dubbed 'the Wolfman'. Play as Jane and fight to survive the full moon while uncovering dark secrets in the Wolfman's territory.

name: Ports Of Call Deluxe 3D 2024
short_description: Ports of Call Deluxe 2024 in 3D Version of the The classic trade- and shippingsimulation. Create your own Shiptrading company and also lern how to navigate. Multiple Players and stereo. created by Rolf-Dieter Klein and Martin Ulrich starting with the classic Amiga Version.

name: Book of Spells
short_description: Book of Spells is an adventure game with RPG elements. You will take on the role of a traveler eager for new adventures!

name: TIRELESS: Prepare For The Adrenaline
short_description: A challenging fast-paced 3D platformer that embraces high-speed gameplay with utmost dedication. Encounter exhilarating velocities and push your skills to the limit with TIRELESS.

name: Randy & Manilla
short_description: Play as Randy or Manilla and explore the amazing virtual quantum universe of the Net-Cubes. Each one provides a distinct gameplay experience. Your mission is to stop the evil Cracksom from destroying the Net-Cubes for taking over the real world.

name: Asleep - Ato 1
short_description: Immersed in her nightmares, in a chaotic reality, confused and all alone. The only safe place is her room, but not forever... She wanders through an empty city and strange places while fleeing from creatures lurking in the darkness to find out what's going on. You are in the skin of Ana Lúcia.

name: Hidden Cats In Japanese Village
short_description: This hidden object game provides a relaxing experience as you search for 100 hidden cats scattered throughout a charming Japanese village

name: Grønland
short_description: Explore the frozen North, investigate your mysterious past, and try to remember... or forget. Grønland is a peculiar adventure game set in the lower Arctic of the late 19th century.

name: Enishia and the Binding Brand
short_description: Enishia is a simple nun and the sole manager of the last church in Megista. However, she must pay off a mountain of debt to prevent the demolition of the church and its attached orphanage. How can she make the money she needs?

name: Darkchaser: Battletide
short_description: [Darkchaser: Battletide] is a survivor-like game where players enter a world ravaged by monsters, arming themselves with various skills and relics to engage in fierce battles against countless enemies, becoming stronger through challenges!

name: アパシー小学校であった怖い話 月曜日
short_description: 鳴神学園初等部六年六組は、選ばれた者たちが集う特殊なクラス。 そこに一人の転校生がやってきた。 何やら曰くがありそうなその転校生に、クラスメイト達は学園にまつわる怪談を語り始める。 そして六年六組は巨大な怪異に飲み込まれていく…

name: Close Combat
short_description: Defeat the enemy in this classic nonstop World War II battle action. Lead your men through the terror, fatigue, and hell of war on to victory. Only you can bring'em back alive!

name: The Great Escape
short_description: 'The Great Escape' is a 2D platformer game where you explore each stage, collect keys, and find the exit. Dangerous obstacles and challenging terrain may block your path, but if you keep going, you can reach the portal to escape. Help them make their escape!

name: Still Joking
short_description: What do mirror reflections do once they have no one to repeat after anymore? Play as Iris, quite a sarcastic reflection torn between the urge to unravel the mystery of death of her “prototype” and the need to find her place in a mirrored world.

name: Celestial Contact
short_description: Experience Celestial Contact, a captivating fusion of shooter and rogue-lite genres set in a mysterious arena adorned with beautiful 2D pixel art. Battle through waves of enemies, gather gear, conquer bosses, and enhance your character to strive for the highest score and lasting survival!

name: MechCrisis
short_description: Is there any way we can protect ourselves from intelligent machines? Choose your weapon, choose your exclusive character, upgrade your skills, and enjoy 20 minutes of pigeon experience.

name: Ziggy's Labyrinth
short_description: Ziggy's Labyrinth is a level based snake game. Traverse through portals, teleport around the map, and phase through walls in over 150 unique levels! Play with friends online in Arena Mode.

name: Spellcats: Auto Card Tactics
short_description: Summon elemental kitties in this roguelike card game! You are the only free feline in a world dominated by humans, navigate through mysterious dungeons, build card combos, and free your kind The future of your species rests in your paws!

name: What the Fog
short_description: What the Fog?! You’ve been sucked into a cursed boardgame! Now you and a friend will need to work together to survive. Run, jump, dash, and shoot to escape swarms of angry monsters in this chaotic co-op roguelite from the world of Dead by Daylight.

name: Violet
short_description: Enter the haunting castle, unravel its mysteries, and confront chilling horrors in this atmospheric adventure. With nods to classic survival horror, brace yourself for an unforgettable journey through shadows and secrets.

name: Gatekeeper
short_description: Gatekeeper is a fast-paced rogue-like. Go on a quest to find the stolen Heart of the Universe and shoot your way through the hordes of machine enemies guarding the planetary gates. Play solo or in 4 people co-op and become the next Guardian!

name: Read Only Memories: NEURODIVER
short_description: Read Only Memories: NEURODIVER is a story-rich adventure and the sequel to 2064: Read Only Memories. Explore the rich world with an intuitive point-and-click interface as you take on the role of a young psychic agent tasked with tracking down a mysterious antagonist hiding in people's memories.

name: Warlords III: Darklords Rising
short_description: Conquer kingdoms, wield dark magic, and lead armies in Warlords III: Darklords Rising. Master strategy in this fantasy world of warfare.

name: Morbid: The Lords of Ire
short_description: Risk insanity in the gruesome slash-em-up Morbid: The Lords of Ire, with brutal combat and souls-like elements. Defeat the five Lords of Ire as you fight for your life across tortured landscapes, rending the evil Gahars of their flesh-bound forms.

name: Impossible Island
short_description: You're an ex-pirate stranded on a mysterious island and you need to hunt and build houses to survive. You must face challenges and enemies. You must solve mysteries and open locked doors. Explore this mysterious island alone or with other pirate friends

name: Trench Defender
short_description: An action-packed FPS where you defend your trench against waves of attacking enemies by utilizing a large selection of modern (and not so modern) military weapons, features both single-player and two player online multiplayer (peer-to-peer).

name: 美女,应接不暇
short_description: AI虚拟女友互动，超越游戏的界限！游戏内外，她们不仅是你的甜蜜伴侣，还能倾听你的困扰，分享你的喜悦，成为你独一无二的解忧秘籍。随着游戏的记忆被AI虚拟人传承，你的每一次经历都将成为独家记忆。 是结束也是开始，AI虚拟人将承载着游戏记忆，为你打造专属回忆。

name: Men of War II
short_description: Experience warfare like never before! Men of War II, the anticipated sequel to the highly acclaimed RTS franchise is here with all-new units, locations, campaigns, game modes and true trademarks of the series: historical fidelity and action-filled gameplay on the Eastern and Western Fronts of WWII.

name: Zig Zag Jump: Fantasy Challenge
short_description: Click to Jump along the zig-zag course. You must direct a character across a fantasy winding path.

name: Abyss
short_description: Embark on an epic adventure in Abyss Online! Forge your destiny in a vast, open-world MMORPG where magic and mystery meet. Battle fearsome creatures, uncover ancient secrets, and rise to power. Join a community of heroes and carve your legend in the realm of Aeternea!

name: NIGHT CROW
short_description: 《 NIGHT CROW》is a multiplayer (1-4 player) horror decryption game where players need to collaborate and interact to decrypt and embark on the next adventure If you are brave, you can also go alone Each different scene type and terrorist event is worth exploring for you

name: AKAYASHIKI | あかやしき
short_description: AKAYASHIKI is a game where you must escape from a killer roaming the mansion.

name: Realm Of I
short_description: Realm Of I is a side-scrolling Metroidvania where you take the role of a prophet. Explore the ravaged landscapes—from abandoned settlements and caverns to vibrant lands and floating islands—uncovering information and newfound abilities and spells to conquer challenges and defeat foes.

name: Spanking Runners
short_description: Spanking Runners (Samogonki) - arcade racing in a bright and unusual world. Fight on the tiny moons of the SamoG planet for precious Samogian water! After all, you need to save the world from the robots that have captured it, turning your friends into Electrozombies!

name: Homeworld 3
short_description: Tactical, beautiful, and wholly unique, the GOTY-winning sci-fi RTS returns with Homeworld 3. Assume control and battle through fleet combat in dazzling, fully 3D space while the award-winning story unfolds on a galactic scale.

name: Close Combat 5: Invasion: Normandy - Utah Beach to Cherbourg
short_description: Close Combat: Invasion: Normandy takes WWII realism back to the beaches of Northern France. Re-live the campaign that gave the Allies a foothold on the doorstep of Fortress Europe.

name: Winter Winds
short_description: Winter Winds is a grim fantasy RPG where you play as a mute, recently resurrected sadist with the mission to return the missing sun to the sky.

name: EGGGG
short_description: This is a simple game where all you need to do is control an egg to jump and climb high mountains to return to its nest. Trust me, most people will complete this challenge in a relaxed and pleasant mood.

name: Atomic Warfare
short_description: Atomic Warfare is a thrilling and strategic game that allows players to represent a country in a high-stakes battle.

name: Idle Taoist Mage Warrior 2
short_description: This is a well-built place hang-up RPG game, for players to bring fighters, mage, Taoist three career choices, each career has unique characteristics, so that players in the game to experience different combat pleasure.

name: Monsters and Sprites
short_description: Monsters and Sprites는 다양한 액션 게임과 어드벤쳐 게임에서 영향을 받은 어드벤쳐 게임입니다. 당신의 앞길을 방해하는 피 지배종들을 피하여 지배종들을 만나, 그들과 싸워서 이기세요.

name: Combo Card Clashers
short_description: Combo Card Clashers is a roguelike deckbuilder meets auto battler! Build massive combos by playing all cards each turn. Unlock powerful card synergies, recruit monsters to be your allies, upgrade gears and skills - give it all to brave through a mysterious world.

name: Tactical Zone
short_description: Welcome to Tactical Zone, an exciting cooperative third-person shooter that will give you adrenaline and unforgettable moments on the battlefield! Gather a team of four players and enter the battle, where your cohesion and tactical skills will be the key to victory.

name: Fairytale Furnishing
short_description: Enjoy decorating fairytale homes in this small, cozy game, suitable for those who love interior design and a fairy-tale atmosphere. Meet unique characters and explore a playful narrative. No rush, no hard tasks—just pure relaxation with a touch of magic and Wi-Fi.

name: CHAIRS
short_description: A fast-paced action platformer doubling as the most realistic chair simulator money can buy! Have you ever wondered what your chair thinks? What it believes? What it desires? Learn the answers and destroy some dimensions along the way!

name: Marble Mechanics
short_description: Explore building customized marble runs and simulating the mechanics of marbles running down the tracks. Over ten basic track elements most of them infinitely customizable. Undo/redo, grouping and auto-alignment of track elements, and saving make game play easy, relaxing, and fun!

name: Honker
short_description: Equipped with a sticky-note of clues, find the goose that doesn't fit in with the rest. As you progress new and cute geese appear, all doing a variety of different activities.

name: The Dungeons Of Algoduul
short_description: Delay your death for as long as possible after finding yourself trapped in a neatly kept Dungeon full of skeletons without legs! Use your Fireballs, Powers, Physics and even use your enemies against each other as you stumble through your very own well lit purgatory!

name: PO'ed: Definitive Edition
short_description: PO’ed is an adrenaline-pumping space shooter that features gameplay elements inspired by generational powerhouses DOOM and QUAKE. Play as a chef who crashlands on an alien planet infested with extraterrestrial foes. Using a menu of “household” weapons, PO’ed puts your wits and reflexes to the test.

name: CaseCracker2
short_description: Jia huasheng ,the policeman of Chicheng police station, got disappeared without any trace after leaving a letter which illustrates the police station to start the CaseCracker system version 2.0.

name: Squab
short_description: Squab is a young pigeon who woke up in a cage, but his father Maximus had disappeared, leaving only a red cap behind. Find out how to save Maximus by overcoming unimaginable challenges in this thrilling and exciting adventure.

name: My Maid Girls
short_description: Neko girls are ready to serve! They are ready to wash your clothes, shine your shoes, clean your house, even give you a massage if you need it...(^ ∇ ^ *)

name: Braid, Anniversary Edition
short_description: Control the flow of time to solve puzzles in this new version of the indie classic, featuring fully repainted artwork, a new world of puzzles, and seriously in-depth commentary.

name: Desolate City: Last Show
short_description: It's the last concert of his tour, and Don Aitor will have to survive the horror. Discover the consequences of the strange virus threatening the pixelated city of Gray Bay in this survival horror/action RPG.

name: Beyond the Chiron Gate
short_description: Explore an endless text-based universe filled with exotic planets, strange life forms, and ancient civilisations. Manage a crew of space explorers, upgrade their ship, and brave dangerous worlds to gather the data you need to reach the mysterious Gatebuilders.

name: Never Mourn
short_description: Become a powerful battler necromancer and challenge death with your double-edged weapon. Kill and resurrect your enemies to grow your army and do the impossible to revive your child.

name: Knights Within
short_description: Knights Within is a 1-4 player blend between third person shooter and melee hack&slash with roguelite elements. Design custom loadouts, navigate procedurally generated levels and utilize random power-ups. Can you survive endless waves of enemies to ensure humanity's survival?

name: A Difficult Game About ROLLING - ReUpRise
short_description: This is a difficult game about ROLLING, where you'll test your limits using just your wits and superpowers. Try to reach the top.

name: Archaeogem
short_description: Hats up and whips out; the wilderness' mysteries await! Explore lush biomes, use your trusty whip to extract wild flowers' mystic powers, and collect rare gems in this dynamic precision-platformer. Unearth archaeological marvels and become a legend!

name: Arcane Assembly
short_description: Arcane Assembly is a fantasy metroidvania where you create spells using a visual programming language. Unlock new instructions, upgrade your powers, and fight epic bosses on your journey to becoming the most powerful wizard who ever lived.

name: Deep Beyond
short_description: Deep Beyond Is a first-person interactive thriller about a sea explorer and the mystery behind her father’s disappearance.

name: Nine Floors
short_description: In Nine Floors, you are a student who has finished the horror of high school classes. Move down and go home! The High school feel like a backroom, find the anomaly in each floor and reach the exit. Based on popular's game The Exit 8 and Shinkansen 0 | 新幹線 0号

name: Baladins
short_description: Embark on a whimsical journey and bring joy to a bright fantasy world in this roleplaying adventure for 1-4 players. Craft your own story and solve quests how you like, but beware, for every time you fail the Dragon will send you back in time!

name: Vacation Adventures: Park Ranger 16 Collectors Edition
short_description: A family friendly Hidden Object Game set in a National Park

name: The Stairway 7 - Anomaly Hunt Loop Horror Game
short_description: The Stairway 7 is an endless loop anomaly hunt and observation 'spot the difference' game where you are stuck in a endless loop of stairways with a cat and you have to observe your surroundings carefully to reach the exit. Anomalies are watching, and ready to hunt you down. Don't take them with you.

name: Fight'N'Jokes
short_description: Fight'N'Jokes is a side-splittingly nostalgic 2D fighting game with a dash of humor. It playfully parodies the serious side of fighting games while delivering a hilarious retro experience.

name: The Legend of Sebb Linus
short_description: Slip into the role of Sebb Linus, a former NCF agent, and sneak into enemy bases undetected. Stay undetected so as not to raise the alarm. Experience the old-school stealth genre.

name: 史莱姆糯米
short_description: 《史莱姆糯米》是一款充满创意的平台游戏，在每个风格迥异的像素场景中，都有全新而独特的机制。操控魔物史莱姆，利用各种机制收集魔药材料和宝石，帮助女巫米莉完成她的魔药配方吧。

name: Overtime Heroes Exit 8
short_description: You are in A CORPORATE SLAVE walking simulator. Being trapped in an infinite loop space, you just wanna find way to get off. Find out the anomalies in floors and choose the elevator carefully! Only the correct one can get you out.

name: Pilapila
short_description: Pilapila is a charming 2D puzzle game with levels that are simple to understand but increasingly challenging to solve. Test your logic skills and climb your way to victory!

name: Heromantic
short_description: Play a steely reporter or a rookie heroine, and brave your way through deadly secrets, evil plots, valiant heroes, and scheming villains in this parodical superhero visual novel!

name: City Construction Simulator 2
short_description: City Construction Simulator 2 is an exciting and challenging game that puts you in charge of delivering construction materials to different parts of the city.

name: Cars Spin
short_description: Cars Spin is an adrenaline-pumping, fast-paced game that will test your driving skills and reaction time.

name: Crazy World of Caleb
short_description: Help Caleb get his girl back. To save her, Caleb needs to brave various locations. Run, Jump and Dash to avoid different type of enemies and make it to your destination.

name: Parking Expert!
short_description: Parking Expert promises an addictive and immersive experience that will have you vying for the title of ultimate parking expert.

name: Clear Skye Thinking
short_description: A cute, wholesome yuri visual novel about a haughty young girl called Alice who goes on holiday to the Isle of Skye. Once there, she meets the plucky young Piper, and a romance between the two slowly unfolds.

name: Forsaken Quartet
short_description: The world has been ravaged by a horrible disease. You and three others are the only people left alive on the small island on which you reside.

name: 筮灵 SHILING
short_description: 国产本土新怪谈恐怖游戏——幽魂社前社长在直播中突然失踪，销声匿迹数月后发来诡异消息，将你引入离奇的规则世界。走不出的吞人楼栋、满员即死的午夜巴士、地图上不存在的村庄，还有勾魂剧院、吃人公司……世界的“暗面”等待探索，怪谲的谜题等待揭露。

name: Lorelei and the Laser Eyes
short_description: The stage is set. Imagine an old baroque manor, perhaps a hotel or a museum, somewhere in central Europe. A woman wanders in search of answers.

name: Orient on the Murder Express
short_description: This is a murder mystery visual novel where you take the role of the detective. Search for clues, make discoveries, and talk to other characters to find out what is truly going on on the Murder Express.

name: Cento
short_description: CENTO is a game where you enter commands in time with music and activate skills to fight. Collect gifts while reinforcing your skills and fight on stages with a wide variety of songs!

name: Byte Hack
short_description: Byte Hack is a fast-paced puzzle platformer about hacking your way through an infected computer tower. Change gravity, teleport, control your enemies, and more to navigate each level. Be quick on your feet and sharp in your mind to solve the puzzles before the contaminated GPU destroys the computer!

name: Aeruta
short_description: A bread revolution across the world now begins! Aeruta is a side-scrolling action game with a shop management twist, fight monsters for materials and use them to make breads, then finally make the deserted town popular again!

name: Adventure Of Baldero I and II
short_description: Lord Marn is releasing Abominations in the area where Baldero, our bold and bald hero, took a nap to rest up. The Goddess of mercy, Myla, enters Baldero's dreams to warn him of the up-coming battles. There are many foes to fight before Baldero can stop Marn, will you help him?

name: Cozy Caravan
short_description: Embark on a single-player, top-down journey in Cozy Caravan, where the arts of crafting, trading, and exploration come together in a beautifully cozy world. Form lasting bonds as you and your caravan journey through charming towns, enriching lives along the way.

name: Wayfarer
short_description: Progress thought labyrinthine caves and solve entertaining puzzles. Explore this incredible adventure where loneliness becomes your closest companion as you search clues amidst stunning landscapes and ancient ruins.

name: Arctic Eggs
