short_description: A Sci-Fi Cooking game where you take up the role of a Poultry Peddler stuck in Antarctica and longing for a way out. Cook your illegal eggs for those who look hungry.

name: Doot-Type
short_description: 2D Side Scrolling Shoot Em Up action. Cinematic cut-scenes carry the story on a quest to locate Mother Gator's secret weapon. Unlockable cheats will mix-up the gameplay or enjoy a randomizer mode. Game includes commentary by the developer and musical composer on the process of making the game!

name: Kingdom of Fallen: The Last Stand
short_description: This is a game inspired by survival and souls-like games. You need to gather clues of your missing daughter, using your own way to defeat fearsome bosses, fighting to survive, crafting to weaponize, building for your future, to reveal the secrets, and get out of this cursed kingdom.

name: Climb up to the Sky
short_description: Climb Up to the Sky is an adrenaline-fueled game that will put your reflexes and precision to the test.

name: Element Release: Water Territory  元素释放：水之领域
short_description: The element race gifted on Element Release rules the ungifted slave, but appearing of the Element Ring breaks the mold. The rebellion of slaves raid the Water Territory, and the lord spells a Water Enchantment. As a memory loss prisoner of element race, the most important thing for you is escape...

name: Down is Relative
short_description: A first-person story-based puzzle game with an emphasis on subverting your current familiarity to gravity. The perfect game for those that enjoy interesting twists and unique puzzle elements.

name: Auto Clicker Pro
short_description: Auto Clicker Pro, easy setup and operation, customizable X-Y positions, adjustable click intervals, fast performance without freezing or lag, ideal for gaming and personal use, achieving up to 130 clicks per second with a record

name: Shogun Curse
short_description: Face demons and monsters while seeking revenge for the curse casted upon you. Will you find those responsible and finally lift it?

name: Stupid Space Shooter
short_description: This game is a Stupid Space Shooter. Control your ship to blow up the bad guys, they are red. Levelup to gain upgrades to fight more bad guys

name: Close Combat 2: A Bridge Too Far
short_description: Close Combat 2: A Bridge Too Far challenges you to take control of five strategic bridges in the most dramatic battle of World War II. From war-room strategy to gritty trench combat, battlefields come to life as you command Allied or Axis powers. It's a fight where every second counts.

name: Bellhop
short_description: Bellhop is a casual hotel management game. Meet clients' demands and basic needs to earn tips. Use your savings to upgrade and improve your tools, or just change up your looks.

name: Just You
short_description: 'Only One Must Remain Alive' thrusts you into a relentless battleground where survival hinges solely on your individual prowess.

name: Hexton
short_description: Explore, build, harvest. Hexton is a relaxing building game where you try to create the largest city possible. Looking for a light challenge? This game's for you!

name: Gilded Eternal
short_description: Gilded Eternal is an action arcade game about luring monsters into the King's crushing hand.

name: GROKAI
short_description: GROKAI - An A.I. Generated Text Based 'Choose Your Own Adventure' Game

name: Labyrinth Hotel
short_description: Labyrinth Hotel is an immersive, first-person, action-adventure game where the player wakes up locked in a jail cell and must escape, but the only way out is through the Hotel. Contains 20 unique levels, 4 bosses, many unique characters, and also some secret levels which unlock an alternate ending.

name: MULLET MADJACK
short_description: MULLET MADJACK is a single-player fast-paced FPS that brings you directly inside a CLASSIC ANIME. Power up your character and reach the last floor; Beat your best time or try again. Haste makes waste… OF YOUR ENEMIES!

name: Seablip
short_description: Go from humble beginnings to a feared pirate captain in this seafaring open-world adventure! Enhance your reputation as you take on bounties, upgrade your ship, hire a crew and search for treasure, or just go fishing instead!

name: Vigor
short_description: Outlive the apocalypse! Dive into intense Encounters and extract the most valuable spoils the Outlands have to offer! Loot, shoot, and build to become the absolute Outlander and explore the landscape of a post-war Norway in Vigor.

name: MEMOLOGY: GOYDA
short_description: Take the annual meme exam and prove you're an expert!

name: Athenian Rhapsody
short_description: Forge your own story and explore the world of Athens in Athenian Rhapsody, a souls-like platonic dating simulator with cooking-mama and WarioWare style battle mechanics... and by that I mean it's a choose-your-own-adventure action RPG with the ability to trade ENTIRE PLAYTHROUGHS between friends!!

name: Revelatio
short_description: 'Revelatio' is a turn-based strategy game that combines tile-based combat and elements of roguelike. Strategically summon and control units to claim victory. Stain the world with your darkness by corrupting various units, bosses and even NPCs.

name: Warlords I + II
short_description: Warlords 1 + Warlords II Deluxe is a compilation of two great award-winning games. Both bring different worlds to conquer, mighty armies to conquer, and enemies to vanquish.

name: SAMURAI WARRIORS 4 DX
short_description: The sparks of destiny ignite in this rich depiction of the Warring States period that features a total of 55 different officers. The deluxe edition contains more than 150 previously released DLC from 'SAMURAI WARRIORS 4,' including costumes, weapons, customization parts, scenarios, and BGM!

name: A Matching Game
short_description: Match the cards to defeat Robo Dog in this fun matching memory game!

name: Khuga Bash!
short_description: Take control of Kuro, the fearless brawler who's on a mission to prove their combat prowess in the mysterious PAW Labs. In Khuga Bash, it's not just about luck; it's about proving you're the ultimate champion of the Khugaverse!

name: Skill Random Defense
short_description: - Game Description Combine awesome skills to win against waves of enemies! Skill Random Defense is a casual defense game that combines 60 skills to block enemies. Combine the optimal skills using the skills you have.

name: Dino Dino – Playful Paleontology
short_description: Playfully extend your knowledge about dinosaurs in a collection of mini games. Created in cooperation with the German Paleontological Society, featuring voice recordings and hand-drawn illustrations, Dino Dino sets out to awaken your kids's interest in complex topics while being a lot of fun.

name: Astral Rift
short_description: Fight and Explore your way through randomly generated dungeons full of hordes of dangerous enemies and powerful bosses to recover the lost Astral Shards and save the world from spatial collapse! Expand your arsenal of weapons, potions, and spells as you grow into the strongest adventurer of all!

name: V-Monsters Digital Farm
short_description: Embark on a journey with V-Monsters: grow magical plants, cook unique recipes, and evolve your creatures in an adventure-filled world. Dive into diverse minigames and customize your experience. Join our community and start your saga!

name: Thorns: Police never sleeps
short_description: Thorns. Police never sleeps is a kinetic visual novel about an alternative future. After global warming, cities were separated by a giant ocean. Our story begins in one of these cities.

name: Carth
short_description: Carth is a survival rpg set in a ravaged open world. You will need to explore, build, and fight to thrive. Gain extraordinary skills as you take on an incredible evil. Join together or go at it alone as you attempt to survive Carth.

name: Rotating Roads
short_description: Rotating Roads is a puzzle game that challenges players to connect paths and guide a character safely through the game.

name: Touhou Genso Wanderer -FORESIGHT-
short_description: Become stronger with Reimu by taking on challenge after challenge in this dungeon-crawler RPG! Set out once again to explore mysteries!

name: Animal Bomb Chess
short_description: This is a Chess games. You can choose your animal at the beginning of the game. animals with their own characteristics, manipulate them to obtain props on the map, and use them. Although the process may test one's luck, you must still make every effort to survive until the end.

name: Tamaniwatori's Puzzle
short_description: This is a simple and sometimes tricky 3D puzzle game in which the egg-shaped chicken 'Tamaniwatori'' hatches eggs. While avoiding the natural enemy 'Tamawani', advance on the various scaffolds set up, hatch all the eggs, and aim for the goal.

name: Cyber Workshop
short_description: Cyber Workshop is a resource creation video game. You control a small workshop and, using the machines available to you, create custom items for order - drones, reactors, implants.

name: Pyramid Game
short_description: Pyramid Game inspires you to comprehend the real world in the game, hope you find your position in the pyramid early!

name: ワールド・ネバーランド２～プルト共和国物語～EXPERIENCE OF FICTION LIFE
short_description: In this fictional, peaceful country where many people live, players are free to do everything in their lives, including work, training, love, raising children, and participating in events and tournaments. It's a game that you can relax, enjoy, and be happy.

name: Shield Knight
short_description: Gain glory by defeating several leaders of a kingdom in ruins using only your shield as a weapon. Talk to the few remaining inhabitants and discover what secrets this kingdom holds.

name: Spartacus Card Game
short_description: Spartacus Card Game is a Gladiator Fighting Card Game for 1 to 2 players.

name: The Very Idle Game
short_description: The most satisfying idle clicker game in the world

name: Look Closer!
short_description: Look Closer! is a single-player horror surveillance game. Monitor haunted locations through cameras, spotting and reporting anomalies like moving objects and sudden intruders. Sharp observation skills are essential to survive the eerie challenges.

name: Magic Trap
short_description: Protect the obelisk!

name: Ship Regulus
short_description: In the first year of the ephemeris, the warp engine was invented. Due to the initial engine being too large, it was installed on the space city Regulus. During engine testing, the jump signal attracted an alien fleet, and the Ship Regulus embarked on a flight path.

name: The Bathrooms
short_description: You awake near a foggy, deserted school with no memory of what happened. You soon discover a horrible secret and descend into a realm of cold, endless halls. Beware—The Custodian is watching you. Your escape from this nightmare depends on your wit and skill.

name: Little Odyssey
short_description: Relax while traveling around a fantasy desert on your Giant Magical Turtle. Deliver packages and explore the world in your Little Odyssey!

name: Leaf's Odyssey
short_description: A turn-based puzzle game with combat and exploration

name: ROBOBEAT
short_description: Keep your trigger finger on the pulse! In rhythm shooter ROBOBEAT, you'll play as Ace - a bounty hunter on a mission to capture robot-gone-rogue Frazzer in his ever-shifting lair. Wall run, slide, and shoot to your own beat using the in-game custom music editor, blasting through Frazzer's armies!

name: Escape Peng
short_description: Can you reach the top of the crevasse?

name: Our Little Friend
short_description: Our Little Friend is a short horror game that follows your 'Little Robot Friend' and it's completely trustworthy and reliable instructions for some silly and innocent lil' games!

name: Ghost of Tsushima DIRECTOR'S CUT
short_description: A storm is coming. Venture into the complete Ghost of Tsushima DIRECTOR’S CUT on PC; forge your own path through this open-world action adventure and uncover its hidden wonders. Brought to you by Sucker Punch Productions, Nixxes Software and PlayStation Studios.

name: STRIDE: Fates
short_description: Step into the shoes of a parkour spec-ops officer. Traverse your way through the rooftops and basements of dystopian Airon City - from slums to affluent skyscrapers. Deal with power shifts in gangs, dirty family feuds, corporate secrets, forbidden tech, and other obstacles to understand your past.

name: Dash x Survivors
short_description: Defeat endless hordes of demonic robots in this hack n slash action roguelike. Use 100+ unique upgrades to create your own game-breaking build and claim victory.

name: The Bad Boy's Cars
short_description: Welcome to The Bad Boy's Cars game, where dominance is the name of the game.

name: Turbo Pulse Race
short_description: In the game, when you drift, you increase your level with the points you earn and unlock cars accordingly. With fast and fluid gameplay, your mistakes might not leave cars behind you.

name: Toxic place
short_description: Toxic Place, an exciting story in the form of a soul like game, combined with a sandbox for you to experience adventure. In a world full of pollution and monsters that have been affected have mutated into terrifying creatures. Will you be able to survive this cruel world?

name: Ru Lin Wai Shi Fan Jin
short_description: Fan Jin, who has failed in the exam for decades, has only one way to change his life - to pass the exam and become a successful candidate.

name: Break the Loop
short_description: Break the Loop is a turn-based Rogue-like RPG. Compose your team and create a timeline by selecting the events you'll go through. Each decision will bring you one step closer to the ultimate threat, but will you have accumulated enough power to stop the apocalypse?

name: CABALL
short_description: Veronica doesn't believe in mysticism, but the unexplained events that occur after she loses her job will make her change her mind forever.

name: Kanna Maze
short_description: In an isolated lab beneath the earth, a childhood friend is resurrected. Amidst sealed walls, a spree of killings unfolds. In a godless abyss, parallel worlds entwine like a maze. Where does one find the path to the sole universe of bliss?

name: Jade Guardian
short_description: Jade Guardian - You take on the role of an unusual guardian made from precious jade who goes on a dangerous adventure to return stolen magical signs.

name: Die by the Blade
short_description: Vanquish your foes with a single strike in 1v1 weapon-based fighter Die by the Blade. Dive into a samuraipunk world and wield a range of traditional Japanese weapons to determine your moveset. Outwit your opponent in intense, tactical battles and master the art of the one-hit kill!

name: MY ADAPTATION IN(TO) HUMAN
short_description: You are a body snatching creature. Capture the body, explore the environment, reproduce.

name: Space Horde Attack
short_description: Collect weapons and destroy enemy ships

name: Random Core Defense
short_description: 'In 'Random Core Defense,' acquire and enhance cores using limited resources to withstand relentless enemy onslaughts. Defeat powerful bosses and test your strategy to survive until the very end!'

name: Land of Futures
short_description: Build and defend your dream village using structures specific to the elf orc and human races. Chat with NPCs containing artificial intelligence language models as if you were talking to someone from daily life.

name: Shadow of the School
short_description: The player finds himself in an abandoned school, which was once a place of study for local schoolchildren. The protagonist is a paranormal researcher who came here to solve the mystery that shrouds this gloomy location.

name: Dig Deep
short_description: Grab a shovel and let's get digging! Join the adventure, hire miners and dig for a treasure

name: Sakura Isekai Adventure 2
short_description: The second part of the Sakura Isekai Adventure series. A yuri fantasy story about Aki, a young woman on a journey to rescue a kidnapped priestess alongside her companions, who might be more than just fellow party members.

name: C.A.R.D.S. RPG: The Misty Battlefield
short_description: This game combines roguelike-style deckbuilding with SRPGs to create an all-new experience! Follow Vel as she leads the Clausewitz Battalion into battle against Fahftania and the Hellmuth Brigade. Collect 100 different cards to build the strongest deck and fight enemies on a map shrouded in mist.

name: Synergy
short_description: Synergy is a city builder where humanity must adapt to the ecosystem in a strange world. Explore and analyze your environment. Provide for the needs of your citizens

name: The Fate of Baldr
short_description: Join the Vikings in an epic tower defense adventure! Defend your ship against mythical bosses while mining resources and upgrading skills. Battle solo or team up with friends in online co-op for a journey of strategy, conquest, and victory.

name: The Quintessential Quintuplets - Five Memories Spent With You
short_description: I want to confess my feelings for you...

name: My Bakery Empire
short_description: Enjoy this yummy cake-baking story and help Lizzie fulfill her dream of opening her own sweet bakery!

name: Senua’s Saga: Hellblade II
short_description: The sequel to the award winning Hellblade: Senua’s Sacrifice, Senua returns in a brutal journey of survival through the myth and torment of Viking Iceland. Intent on saving those who have fallen victim to the horrors of tyranny, Senua faces a battle of overcoming the darkness within and without.

name: Starstruck Vagabond
short_description: A space captain accidentally freezes themselves for two thousand years, finding themselves in an unfamiliar galaxy. Fortunately, there's always someone who needs cargo delivered.

name: Knight Runner: Blade and Bolt
short_description: Fight your way through an endless forest, slaying monsters, dodging traps, and chasing the highest score possible in this simple yet addictive pixel art runner.

name: Potion Problem
short_description: Potion Problem is a whimsical potion making puzzler about discovery, problem solving and potions! Create potions and fulfill orders, prepare bizarre ingredients and learn the deepest secrets of the alchemist's world.

name: Pirarucu's Money Rush
short_description: From the asymmetrical party action game 'Goonya Monster' designed by Terada Tera , a spin-off work has emerged! 'Pirarucu's Money Rush' is a side-scrolling shopping rampage game! At each stage checkpoint, which changes with every play, you can purchase items to gain an advantage in the game.

name: Skizz
short_description: In Skizz, ski down the mountain, explore legends, and enhance your skills. There are no set objectives, just fun and discoveries. Descend, level up, and unravel mysteries at every turn.

name: Love Undying: A Kiss Before Dawn
short_description: Hunt your prey as a vampire on windswept Victorian moors—but who will capture your unbeating heart?

name: Cyberpulse
short_description: Slam your way through waves of viruses and hurl your friends through cyberspace in this flashy arcade thrower that combines classic twin-stick action with inventive physics for an electrifying adventure.

name: Casino Simulator
short_description: Casino Simulator Expand Your Casino From Scratch, Hire Employees, Customize It, Gamble, Enjoy Your Own Casino

name: Five Nights at Roner's 2
short_description: Searching for fast money, you stumble upon an ad for a paranormal investigation. Upgrade your office, maintain your systems, and above all else: don't let them get to you. It's easy work, right...?

name: 勇者救魔神—阿奎拉尼大陆战记
short_description: The demon god, who maintains the order of the demon world, was attacked by several demon kings, causing a large number of demons to freely travel to the human world. Several protagonists with the ability to save the demon god gathered together and exerted their respective powers to end all of this.

name: Keep Health!
short_description: Keep Health! Is a regional arena type rogue-like game, players will become a defender in the game, control several weapons against a variety of germs. Get a variety of weapons and items in the game to strengthen the guards, so as to overcome difficulties and complete the breakthrough.

name: ZSG
short_description: Would you like to do some... EXTREMELY SATISFYING ZOMBIE-ALIEN PIMPLE POPPING WITH AWESOME RETRO GUNS WHILE TRYING TO NOT FALL OFF A METEOR FLYING THRU SPACE? Good, then ZSG is you're one and only choice.

name: SUSHI Race
short_description: The sushi you know and love... as racecars?! Operate your sushi vehicle and tear through course after course!

name: Slam and Roll
short_description: Slam and Roll is a modern 2D platformer where you beat enemies by throwing them sport balls. Play 200+ stages while travelling around the world rescuing new characters. A frantic tribute to the '90s arcade 'stage clear' games. Play solo or with a friend. Unlimited hours of fun playing 'chaos mode'.

name: Venture to the Vile
short_description: Dive into the strange town of Rainybrook, taken over by the “Vile” in this 2.5D metroidvania! Fight your way through treacherous terrains and defeat formidable bosses to absorb their powers! Will you save the town and find your missing friend Ella — or will you give in to the monster you've become?

name: Snail's Knock Out!
short_description: From the asymmetrical party action game 'Goonya Monster' designed by Terada Tera , a spin-off work has emerged! Enemy in sight? Throw bombs! Blast away! 'Snail's Knock Out' is a casual shooting game. Blast away the undead appearing in stages with increasing speed and relieve accumulated stress!

name: Path Weaver
short_description: Path Weaver is an interactive puzzle game where you can solve puzzles by controlling your characters and placing the right scenes in the right timelines, as if you were filling a storybook. Different puzzles are waiting for you in many places, from pyramids to Aztec temples.

name: The Piano That Staying Time
short_description: “Can you play the piano?”Summer vacation starts soon.However, she says that she has rented out the entire music room during the vacation, and instead of postponing the lesson, she proposes one condition...A full-voices visual novel with a theme of memories with emotional music.

name: Mob Control
short_description: Are you ready to become the ultimate champion in the world of tower defense battles? Create, grow and lead!

name: CoinBlock Clicker
short_description: CoinBlock Clicker is an idle clicker with a unique way of merging idle and clicker fun into one game! You simply click thousands of times on the coinblock and make those coins fly all over your screen!

name: バズってVTuber ゲームでいいから万バズしたい！
short_description: Attention: Currently only available in JapaneseThe First Vertically Streamer-Recommended Game? You, Enlarged by OBS, Are the Protagonist!In the fictional social media platform 'Vitter,' you aim to go viral as a VTuber in this game.Not just stream-friendly, but stream-recommended.

name: Yolk Heroes: A Long Tamago
short_description: Someone has to protect this realm... is it you? Become a guardian spirit and raise your very own Hero to stand against the Dark Lord.

name: Trap Trek: Ultimate Other Me
short_description: 'Trap Trek: Ultimate Other Me' is a chaotic high-difficulty action game. Use your doppelgangers to navigate and conquer various instant-death traps!

name: Speglar
short_description: Frantic 4-player laser ricocheting top-down shooter. Keep it casual and enjoy the chaos, or master the surprisingly deep mechanics to obliterate your enemies. Duke it out locally in free-for-all or 2v2.

name: Publish or Perish
short_description: Publish or Perish is a game that simulates working in academia. In order to keep your job, you must publish scientific work. Reviewers are here to get you and all you can do is try to survive. Can you publish enough papers to enjoy tenure? (Contains practical advice for academics)

name: RKGK / Rakugaki
short_description: Turn heads. Drop jaws. Be bright. In this single-player 3D platformer, you’re the only one who can take down Mr. Buff and his lackies to restore color and life to the citizens of Cap City. Accompany Valah and the RKGK crew on their journey to take down the oppressive B Corp.

name: Sonar Shock
short_description: Submarine’s haunted! Hunt and be hunted in this horror dungeon crawler inspired by the decay of the Soviet Union (and immersive RPGs from the 90s).

name: Serum
short_description: Dive into a thrilling survival adventure where an unknown liquid takes control of your life. Extract Serum to stay alive, battle dangerous creatures, solve puzzles, and uncover clues about past events.

name: Boop a Cat
short_description: Boop a Cat is made for stress free gaming, a way to just relax and care for a virtual feline.

name: Crown Wars: The Black Prince
short_description: The War of Crowns rages on. Knights and brigands run rampant throughout the land, sowing destruction. From your castle base, rise to become the lord who leads the battle against the forces of evil in this turn-based tactics and strategy game.

name: Duck Detective: The Secret Salami
short_description: Solving crime is no walk in the pond. You are a down-on-his-luck detective who also happens to be a duck. Use your powers of de-duck-tion to inspect evidence, fill in the blanks, and bust the case wide open, in a narrative mystery adventure where nothing is quite as it seems.

name: Faint Call
short_description: Faint Call is a psychological horror game about a police officer investigating a distress call from someone at a notoriously cursed house.

name: Echoes Of Despair
short_description: 'Echoes Of Despair' plunges players into the horror of an abandoned hospital, where Sarah, an investigative journalist, must survive supernatural forces while uncovering the dark secrets of the past.

name: Falco Tunes
short_description: Falco Tunes is a fun arcade game where you have to collect notes and attack harsh animals with them!

name: Load Shedding
short_description: Load Shedding - Bad Dudes have taken over the island and stolen all of the power, it is up to You to stop them!

name: The Method of Hiding a Body
short_description: A story-driven horror puzzle game where the player takes on the role of a resentful ghost, possessing others in order to search for her own corpse.

name: Dooblets
short_description: This adventure supports 2 - 4 players! Play through 4 unique worlds filled with challenges and puzzles with your friends!

name: Pam's Fantastic Adventures
short_description: 2 cute escape room games & a bonus matching game in one!

name: Anomaly Hotel
short_description: You start from the 10th floor in a hotel and must make your way to the exit. However, you must look for any potential anomalies on each floor to safely make it out.

name: Star Trek: Resurgence
short_description: Authentic Star Trek adventure from former members of Telltale Games. Engage in diplomacy, pilot shuttlecraft, and use your tricorder and phaser to overcome challenging puzzles and deadly threats. Tough decisions will impact relationships, your story, and the fate of the galaxy. What will YOU do?

name: Toad's Soul Hopper
short_description: From the asymmetrical party action game 'Goonya Monster' designed by Terada Tera , a spin-off work has emerged! 'Toad's Soul Hopper' is hopping action game where you aim for the top from bottom to top! Will he soar into action with weapons in hand to stop Anemone's mischief and save his friends?

name: Lost in Tropics
short_description: Lost in Tropics: Embark on an unforgettable survival adventure where the lush, unpredictable tropics become your testing ground. In this immersive game, you find yourself stranded on a mysterious island, where every corner hides both breathtaking beauty and perilous challenges.

name: Ouros
short_description: Ouros is a calming puzzle game about forming beautiful curves in a serene space. Find your flow as you nudge, bend, and stretch curves into pleasing shapes. With over 120 handcrafted puzzles to solve, Ouros invites you to discover the inherent mathematical beauty of its world.

name: The Fear of The Past
short_description: The Fear of the Past is First person psychological horror game. You find your self in abandoned places and you have no idea how did you end there. Stalkers try to catch and you have to fixed the puzzle to escape the nightmares.

name: SHINJUKU SOUMEI
short_description: We invite you to enjoy this story, through Torao's perspective, which raises profound questions about the value of life For those living in modern times, for those residings in this city, for all of us.

name: Harvest Hunt
short_description: A Dark Folk Single-Player Survival Horror: You are the chosen. Reap the harvest to save the village of Luna Nova before the Devourer taints the crop. But beware: the harvest is not the only thing the Devourer seeks to destroy.

name: Mr. Hopp's Playhouse HD
short_description: Step back into the unsettling world of Mr. Hopp's Playhouse where every child's nightmare becomes a chilling reality.

name: Necromantic
short_description: Start out as a lowly freshman at Valorborn Academy and prove yourself to the school and other students – or don’t, and repeatedly fall to the legions of horrors that await in Necromantic. Study up to survive in this dark and dangerous fantasy Bullet Heaven ... solo or by online co-op.

name: Galacticare
short_description: Build, manage and optimise intergalactic hospitals! Recruit staff to satisfy the whims of various alien species, and cure their bizarre illnesses - for money! Save the (literal) Galaxy in story mode, or head into sandbox to design the hospital of your dreams.

name: Pampas & Selene: The Maze of Demons
short_description: Join Pampas and Selene as they overcome monsters, demons, and the Dark Priest with the help of the gods themselves! Explore this co-opvania 8-bit platformer alone or with a friend. This retro game is a loving tribute to an MSX2 masterpiece from the creator of UnEpic, Ghost 1.0, and UnMetal.

name: Escaping DandyLand
short_description: Strange, colorful and unusual; Escaping DandyLand is unlike any else preceding in the genre of frustration platformers. Can you traverse the central spire and escape? Can you piece the secret of its true nature together?

name: Feet Paradise
short_description: What is a paradise for the feet? It's when your feet are tender and gentle, when your feet are kissed and just admired. This is exactly Feet Paradise!

name: Anchors: Blockade Zone
short_description: Anchors:blockade zone is a Cthulhu style 2d shooting game.The game requires players to explore in various maps generated by the program,find and bring back equipment,and live in a base full of doomsday atmosphere.When you explore the map,you see some strange things,calm down.Maybe that's truth!

name: Soul Link
short_description: Soul Link is a challenging puzzle game where you use your intelligence to build bridges with falling pieces of various shapes. Reconnect this broken land with Soul Bridges, and make the world whole again!

name: Bucket Crusher
short_description: Power up your machine and get caught up in the craze of destruction!

name: Paper Dash - Invasion of Greed
short_description: Jump into 'Paper Dash - Invasion of Greed,' a relaxing escape into a world where your paper plane soars through levels shaped by human desires. Fly, glide, dash, scare away ghosts, and enjoy a peaceful journey, facing the ghosts of greed in abstract and beautiful environments.

name: Wake Cup
short_description: Fight against the flock of tired workers on a boring Monday morning with a cup of coffee and keep the economy flowing. Wake up, sell, lose, improve, repeat! A clicker tower defence game with rogue-lite meta progression.

name: Imaginary Friend Asylum
short_description: A psychological horror game about being a child in an insane asylum. You're in a cruel world but your imaginary friends have your back. Here, you will uncover a dark conspiracy where you are to receive a terrible fate.

name: HARSH.
short_description: HARSH. is a fast, challenging action roguelite filled with emergent combinations, agressive music, engaging bossfights and diverse enemies. Your dash is the only way to switch guns and recharge your ammo. Choose buffs to create strong combinations and try to reach the core.

name: Tiny Breakers Camp
short_description: It is time for true heroes to stop an evil invasion that is spreading across our land. Face enemies from the deepest caves and dungeons in an engaging brick-breaker style of fight. Bring peace and justice to your homeland yet again.

name: Block Pieces - 3D Jigsaw Puzzle
short_description: Block Pieces is a 3D jigsaw puzzle, minimalist and relaxing experience. Exercise your skill in reassembling 3D models back to their original form, while listening to a relaxing soundtrack.

name: Robo Pose
short_description: Robo Pose is a difficult game about Robot that needs to strike the right Pose in order to overcome procedurally generated obstacles.

name: Ships At Sea
short_description: Experience the thrill of navigating a wide range of ships. In single- and multiplayer modes, immerse yourself in tasks such as service, cargo transport, and commercial fishing as you explore the breathtaking open world of Norway´s Islands and its stunning scenery. The ocean is within your reach!

name: 女神保卫战
short_description: 一觉醒来？好像是醒来了，又好像是梦境，这是一个我和4名女子关于回忆的故事。

name: A Tower Full of Cats
short_description: A Tower Full of Cats is a hidden object game where you need to gather cats through the whole history of catkind... and beyond!

name: Prism Indigo DX
short_description: Fight your friends to save your friends in Prism Indigo, a vicious retro-styled bullet hell shooter starring a rookie magical girl.

name: Zet Zillions
short_description: Zet Zillions is a single-player roguelike deckbuilder where you use your cards to make freakish combinations and explode entire planets. BIG-BADDA-BOOM!

name: PERIMETER: Legate Edition
short_description: Perimeter is a real-time strategy game with a destructible world. Utilize the environment for resource gathering and defense against enemies. Immerse yourself in the millennia-spanning history of the Chains of Worlds and lead a faction in the struggle for survival.

name: エルミナージュORIGINAL ～闇の巫女と神々の指輪～
short_description: Inheriting the fun of classic dungeon RPGs Eluminage ORIGINAL, a popular title that inherits the fun of classical dungeon RPG finally appeared on Steam. The hack-slash gameplay is challenging and and a high degree of freedom in character creation, Once you start playing, you won't be able to stop.

name: Paper Trail
short_description: Paper Trail is a top-down puzzle adventure about leaving home, set in a foldable, paper world.

name: Bird Year
short_description: Bird Year is a gentle, family-friendly arcade game where you're a bird. Feed your hungry babies and avoid the dangers of the forest all year long. Catch bugs, eat berries and dodge predators while using your chosen bird's unique abilities. Unlock bonus content including more birds and a bonus level!

name: Venatrix
short_description: Venatrix is a unique hybrid of action-packed and stealth-based horror game. We choose to play as either Matthew or Della, resulting in two different play styles, either third-person action/horror or first-person stealth/horror.

name: Golf Guys
short_description: Face off against a dozen opponents in an ultimate golf battle royale, or invite friends to play in multiplayer mode for up to 4 players!

name: Witch and Lilies
short_description: Witch and Lilies is a 3D dungeon-crawling RPG where you foster romantic relationships between girls. Form a party of five girls from ten unique classes to navigate dangerous dungeons - all the while managing the relationships between them!

name: You Are Liam: Shadow Memories
short_description: You have done some things you're not proud of. Now you must enter your own mind to come to terms with the things you've done. Loop around rooms, solve puzzles and hide from different monsters as you uncover your own truth.

name: Little-Known Galaxy
short_description: Join Space Alliance as a new captain-in-training and work with your crew to solve the mysteries of an ancient relic found on the Grey Planet. Little-Known Galaxy is a cozy single-player RPG space adventure full of friendly characters, exploration, crafting, and farming.

name: Kill The Climbers
short_description: Kill The Climbers is a retro roguelite arcade game where you play as a mountain and yeti with the goal of defending the peak. Use your quick wits, skillshot-slinging abilities, and animal defenders to Kill The Climbers!

name: Infernal Elements
short_description: A bullet hell, boss rush game, where you control the newest Fire Elemental on his journey fighting against the elements of the underground.

name: Shape Survivor 图形幸存者
short_description: Damn it, quickly kill the enemies surrounding you. Choose your weapon, freely combine weapon enhancements, and obtain advanced effects when fully reinforced.

name: Rooftops & Alleys: The Parkour Game
short_description: Ever felt like the world was missing that one Parkour/Freerunning game? That game that scratches that itch that other games just don't? Rooftops & Alleys aka TheParkourGame is here to deliver! In this game, there's is no 'hold button to parkour' mentality. Here, you, the player is in control!

name: Kid Pilot
short_description: Kid Pilot is a flight adventure game where you soar through amazing worlds just by moving your hand. Explore beautiful environments, earn badges, discover secrets, and overcome challenging boss fights and become a Top Pilot!

name: IRIDESCENT
short_description: Take to the skies in this vibrant eldritch roguelike as you blast away foes as a moth! Fell colossal creatures, collect items, and trade with cats in this colorful explosion of a game.

name: Isles of Sea and Sky
short_description: A fantastic, oceanic, open world puzzle adventure. Solve innovative block puzzles while unearthing a mystifying story, gaining new friends that change the puzzle landscape, and unlocking powers that provide more options for how you choose to progress through the enigmatic Isles of Sea and Sky.

name: Hauntii
short_description: A beguiling adventure in which you uncover the secrets of an expansive and mysterious world - haunting both the environment and its denizens to craft ingenious solutions to the many challenges that await.

name: Rasant
short_description: With your ship, face several exciting space battles, full of shots and powerful enemies. Customize your spaceship by making it more and more powerful and get ready for a space trip that will make your adrenaline skyrocket!

name: Hole io
short_description: Show who is the biggest black hole in the town!

name: Room 14
short_description: You are inside an endless Highschool but there is a way you can escape. Search in the hallways of the school and find the changes within them to reach Room 14.

name: Bagel Love Story
short_description: A light-hearted and enjoyable short romance VN! The protagonist, Fan Tong, struggles to lose weight in hopes of finding a job, but the journey is far from smooth. Until one day, a cute and sunny girl named Bagel comes into his life, kickstarting a story of weight loss, cross-dressing, and romance!

name: An English Haunting
short_description: While looking for the existence of the Great Beyond, Professor Patrick Moore, aided by a fake medium, will build a device to see the other side, embark on a search for a millenary artefact, and investigate the most haunted manor of 1907 England.

name: Way of Rhea
short_description: Way of Rhea is a puzzle game with hard puzzles, but forgiving mechanics. Solve mind bending color puzzles, unlock new areas of a vibrant hub world, chat with townsfolk, and undo any mistake with the press of a button.

name: LOGIX: The Missing Part
short_description: A First Person Puzzle Game in which you fix the Logic behind the Puzzle, and then solve the Puzzle to verify what you fixed.

name: Re≒Connect  Exit LOOP
short_description: Trapped in a station that loops endlessly. Go to red if you find an anomaly/go to blue if there is no anomaly. Can you reach the end?

name: Captain Stu
short_description: Captain Stu is a 2.5d platformer set in the bright and beautiful Caribbean. Defeat enemies with sword or pistol and navigate through the dangerous world.

name: Old Market Simulator
short_description: Old Market Simulator is a coop bazaar adventure for 1-2 players. Dive into commerce, manage your reputation, and build your dream market together.

name: Kubikon 3D
short_description: Cubes, cubes, cubes... Cubes everywhere. Whether you're in the mood to challenge your brain or just relax, Kubikon is here for you!

name: Tennis Manager 2024
short_description: The courts have missed you, it’s time to sign your comeback and prove yourself as the greatest tennis manager. Tennis Manager 2024 is back and better than ever! Get ready to strategize, train your new wonderkids, and conquer the courts in the most immersive tennis management experience yet!

name: Magical Mic Duel: Senpai, Hear My Spell
short_description: ଘ(੭ˊᵕˋ)੭* ੈ✩‧₊˚ Embrace your destiny in Magical Mic Duel: Senpai, Hear My Spell! Your voice commands the forces of fabulousness. Chant spells with conviction, and witness dazzling displays of magical might! The world needs your power. Step up and claim your place as the ultimate magical girl!

name: Esports Godfather
short_description: E-sports Godfather is a Deck-building game simulating MOBA e-sports. You will play a role as team coach and build your team. You need to train players and make strategies in various game versions, beat other teams and finally, take the Champion of the World. Be nobody, or lead your team to dominate!

name: Redneck Joe Vs The Swamp Zombies
short_description: In this exciting third-person shooter, play as brave Joe, a typical Redneck who must fight against hordes of zombies and scary monsters.

name: Kong's Wrath: City of Mayhem
short_description: Become the banana-hungry kaiju, Kong. Climb, fight, and leap your way through a highly militarized concrete jungle. Collect bananas, and compete for the highest banana count on a world-wide leaderboard. This is a roguelike, arcade style game with no ending, only further mayhem.

name: Hotel Overloop
short_description: You’ve stucked into a loop in the mysterious hotel. Find anomalies to escape the hotel’s loop.

name: Love Chase
short_description: 男主隋必安是一名FBP 探员，接到了一项异常任务：调查六个甜心女孩中谁是AI仿生人，随着调查的深入，男主对调查对象逐渐产生了不一样的情愫。至此感情和职责开始产生冲突，他陷入了一个充满迷雾和危险的境地。这是一段既扣人心弦又充满科幻色彩的有关于爱和选择故事。。

name: Timeless Tesseract
short_description: Introducing Timeless Tesseract - The First 3D Parkour Platformer That Lets You Control Time! By Captain Tesseract

name: Taora : Survival
short_description: Taora is an open world survival game with unique character building and crafting. Build and upgrade your base, and survive the zombie apocalypse !

name: DEVIL BLADE REBOOT
short_description: An immersive pseudo-3D shoot 'em up experience that pushes the limits of pixel art. Push your score higher with the innovative Berserk System: the closer they are, the more points you get!

name: Infantry Attack
short_description: Soldier! War is coming and duty calls! Enemies are invading our country and we need YOU to defend it!

name: Magic Research 2
short_description: Welcome to Magic Research 2, an incremental RPG from the creator of Magic Research. Learn countless spells, face powerful foes, and command a team of Wizards who can cast spells for you as you journey to find or create the Philosopher's Stone.

name: OVRDARK: a Do Not Open story
short_description: OVRDARK: Dive into the chilling sequel to 'DO NOT OPEN' in this intense VR experience. Explore a cursed mansion, face your former companion turned ruthless enemy, and unravel dark secrets. Can you survive the ultimate horror in virtual reality?

name: Octo's Balloon Challenge
short_description: From the asymmetrical party action game 'Goonya Monster' designed by Terada Tera , a spin-off work has emerged! Master the art of flying balloons and balancing on the catching device to collect lots of Souls! Challenge yourself in this new sensation game where 'buoyancy' is the key!

name: Spready
short_description: Let's solve artists' dilemmas while solving 3D puzzles using optical illusions. Paint the canvas with crayons, erase with an eraser, turn the wheels, and change the camera perspective. To create a perfect piece, you must use all art materials to color every square of the canvas.

name: Brain Tester : Mind trick quiz 2
short_description: This game is about riddles and mind trick quiz with all the reason needed for each answer. You will need higher brain power than previous one to clear this game

name: Machorium -Muscle Aquarium Simulator-
short_description: Machorium - Muscle Aquarium Simulator - is a relaxing idle and sandbox game where you can unwind and have fun. Use points generated by cute little decorative muscle men to unlock various items and create your ideal muscle aquarium, Machorium.

name: Lesson Learned
short_description: Help Frank travel through history in this unique approach to the tower defense genre. Enter a bizarre daydream world in co-op or solo mode. Gather resources, build defense towers, and manage your minions. Take up the challenge and defeat the incoming enemies!

name: Vendir: Plague of Lies
short_description: Vendir: Plague of Lies is a classic party-based RPG with a deep storyline and turn-based combat. Experience an intricately crafted world, steeped in history and brought to life through a carefully crafted atmosphere and the trials and tribulations of stories of the people that inhabit it.

name: Maze Endless
short_description: 'Maze Endless' is a challenging adventure casual game that tests your wit and luck. In this endless maze journey, players will experience an unprecedented adventure. Starting from the simplest maze, gradually challenge more complex levels, unravel their mysteries, and find the exit.

name: True Boxing VR
short_description: True Boxing VR brings real life boxing experience into Virtual Reality. With super realistic game play animations, and movements the game is designed to be as close to a real life experience as possible. You will learn the basics and tactics of boxing, and use these skills to beat the opponents.

name: 天呐！找不到真爱就扑街！
short_description: First-person perspective through role-playing When getting along with the 'Destined Heroine', they constantly make choices to deepen mutual understanding, and strive to exchange sincerity for true love. These choices determine the final emotional outcome. In the end, who will Huang Di's true love be

name: Super Onion Boy+
short_description: Super Onion Boy+ offers an exhilarating journey in a 2D platformer filled with action and adventure, in the nostalgic retro style. Your mission is to rescue the princess, who has been imprisoned in a magical bubble by a terrible monster.

name: The Echoes of Mars
short_description: The Echoes of Mars is a voxel-style tower defence game. Defend your research base on Mars from ancient creatures by strategically placing towers and using advanced tech.

name: PANICORE
short_description: PANICORE is a survival horror game that mixes permadeath, AI monsters and a co-op experience up to 5 players (4 players in demo). Try to escape and don't get caught, but beware: they don't only hear your steps, but also your voice.

name: Lizard Slayer
short_description: Evil anthropomorphic lizards have attacked your lands. You need to solve this problem. Choose a character and go slash lizards!

name: Poseidon
short_description: Poseidon wants to return his beloved golden sharks back to the Greek seas, go to a small island and help God find his subjects!)

name: Basket Brawl DX
short_description: Embark on a quest with Himari and her friends! Traverse 40+ rooms, unlock characters, and groove to chiptune tunes in this speedy platformer.

name: Trans-Siberian Railway Simulator
short_description: Get behind the controls of a classic Russian locomotive and see if wild animals, bad people, strong frosts and a constantly breaking locomotive is able to stop you. Try to survive on the longest railway line in the world!

name: Fly Fly Monster Truck 2
short_description: Get ready to fulfill your childhood dream of driving a monster truck in Fly Fly Monster Truck 2!

name: The Cyclop
short_description: Embark on a journey of precision and determination in 'Cyclop,' where every move counts and every decision shapes your ascent.

name: Madzik - Episode 1
short_description: Smash Your Path to Destiny! Embark on a narrative-driven hack and slash adventure infused with a nostalgic '80s vibe. In the ever-shifting world of Zikverländ, every creature undergoes formidable transformations, providing a thrilling and dynamic challenge through perilous moons.

name: Shopping Simulator
short_description: 'Shopping Simulator' is your ticket to a virtual mall adventure! Dive into diverse stores, manage budgets, and make friends in this nostalgic Scratch-style game. Ready to shop 'til you drop? Let's go!

name: Hive Jump 2: Survivors
short_description: You are the lone survivor of your squad, on an alien planet with just your weapon, a jetpack, and the courage to keep fighting. Kill off alien swarms and transform their valuable guts into explosive upgrades and vital utilities. Become an agent of vengeance in this bullet-heaven action roguelike!

name: Hood Story: Kaito Yamazaki
short_description: Explore the thrilling life of 'Kaito Yamazaki,' a Japanese delinquent from Kamagasaki, Osaka. Navigate the challenges of love, friendship, and violence as you help Kaito regain control of his life.

name: Dungeons of Blood and Dream
short_description: Play as a mighty Blood Wizard on a quest to escape a death-loop of psychedelic dungeons. Slay disgusting creatures using a large array of bladed weapons and unnerving spells, harness the power of cursed rings, find mysterious treasures, and learn the secrets of the universe you are trapped in.

name: Blocks and Bones
short_description: Blocks and Bones is a zombie wave shooter with endless hordes of the undead in custom maps built by players. Build mode is the sandbox side of the game where you build levels from blocks and publish them online in-game so other players can survive the apocalypse inside your chilling creations.

name: Marsmare: Alienation
short_description: Marsmare: Alienation is a thrilling adventure of an earthling kidnapped by malevolent aliens. Improve your gear and gain new abilities as you progress through the game. Encounter numerous enemies such as Martians, robotic spiders, space slugs and flying drones.

name: Tiny Terry's Turbo Trip
short_description: Terry wants to launch himself into space using his new car. Doing something this cool and reckless will surely make him the talk of the town. Run, drive and glide through this small journey of big discoveries as Terry works towards achieving this goal.

name: Oh my god!Crush!
short_description: What is the most heart wrenching moment for you? Is it a warm smile from the person you like? Or was it a sudden surprise waiting for him? Is it the sweet expectation of ordinary life? Or a sudden look back after a thousand twists and turns—— Oh my goodness! It's a heartwarming feeling.

name: Nine Sols
short_description: Nine Sols is a lore rich, hand-drawn 2D action-platformer featuring Sekiro-inspired deflection focused combat. Embark on a journey of eastern fantasy, explore the land once home to an ancient alien race, and follow a vengeful hero’s quest to slay the 9 Sols, formidable rulers of this forsaken realm.

name: Check and Slash
short_description: Check and Slash combines the action and combat of a hack and slash game with the movement patterns of chess pieces. Find your way through a maze of boards, slash your enemies, dodge attacks, rescue black pieces to receive upgrades and fight against formidable opponents until you find the enemy king.

name: FLATHEAD
short_description: Over or Under? A simple game of gambling with your life.

name: Shelf Life
short_description: Shelf Life is an action FPS set in a near future conglomerate, that will seem eerily familiar if you spend your time around online dumpster fires. Use your arsenal of weapons to shoot, burn and fungible-ize your way through the Edison facility fighting a lizardy hostile takeover.

name: Selaco
short_description: Selaco is a brand new original shooter running on GZDoom, featuring thrilling action set pieces, destructibility, smart enemies and a fleshed out story taking place within an immersive game world.

name: Jump Higher
short_description: 'JumpHigher' is a 3D game combining jumping and survival elements. Players control a character focused on ascending by jumping, while fending off zombie assaults and strategically choosing supplies to aid their climb towards the peak.

name: Guard the Tower!
short_description: A tower defense game filled with 12 varied levels across 7 biomes and 14 unique monsters with 3 increasingly harder difficulties to challenge even the most experienced of tower defense gamers lurking in their strongholds.

name: Perfect  Dice
short_description: Incredibly complex card-based roguelike that challenges you to learn and exploit the nuances of chance, mastering luck itself.

name: Necromancia
short_description: NECROMANCIA! A skele-puzzle type game where your bones and your wit may guide ye through the delving of the dungeons and catacombs. Take command of your undead hordes and collect the spreads to form the ultimate sandwich!! The only brain your minions will be eating is yours!

name: Odyssey of the Explorer
short_description: Single player Hack and Slash casual sci-fi

name: 夢幻四驅車
short_description: 底盤、上蓋、輪胎、馬達、電池、齒輪、導輪，蒐集各式極速配件，組合出獨一無二屬於你的車型，挑戰多變的惡魔賽道，實現興建環市賽道的夢想！針對賽道特性組出適用的車型，還有更多神秘配件，等待您來探索。

name: Wraithbinder
short_description: An action roguelike RPG with secrets, loot, necromancy and metroidvania-inspired ability progression from the creator of Songbringer. Each run you build a different sequence of weapons, abilities and relics. Play offline solo. Online co-op coming soon.

name: Ultimate Godspeed
short_description: Ultimate Godspeed is a party racing game. Place items on the track and bring chaos to the race! The goal: Create the shortest way for you or the most pain for your opponents.

name: Capes
short_description: Superheroes clash in this turn based strategy game. Recruit, train, and deploy your team in order to take back the city from the villains that hold it hostage.

name: Elegy of Fate
short_description: Embark on a unique RPG journey as a resurrected hero. Obtain the sealed power of a malevolent deity in a ring, evading the pursuit of a goddess. Explore the world, awaken legendary heroes, and shape your destiny with a formidable order of knights. Uncover the long-buried tales of this continent.

name: F1® 24
short_description: Join the grid and Be One of the 20. Drive like the Greatest in EA SPORTS™ F1® 24, the official video game of the 2024 FIA Formula One World Championship™.

name: TOKYO PSYCHODEMIC
short_description: 5% of murder cases remain unsolved... it's time to open up these cases and confront the supernatural with forensic science! Solve cases by analyzing evidence and consulting with specialists. Enter a world that artfully blends 2D illustration and real-life visuals!

name: Angry Penguin
short_description: ANGRY PENGUIN is a die and retry platformer with numerous and varied trials, where every step is a difficulty.

name: Tabletop Hero
short_description: is a roguelike deck-building game. With a variety of heroes and classes, hundreds of cards and treasures, and a rich array of genres to explore, there's plenty to discover. Additionally, card enchantment and fusion mechanics help you build a stronger deck.

name: Creepy Tale: Some Other Place
short_description: Creepy Tale is a mysterious adventure rich in riddles and eerie atmosphere. An autumn morning promised a quiet fishing trip, but events took Martin to 'some other place.' Find the way home, uncover loads of secrets, and save everyone that you can.

name: Unearthing Invasions
short_description: A 3d tower defense game set in space. Protect the last resource outposts from the ongoing Alien attacks! Can you hold out in these ever increasing difficult waves of enemies and protect the last of your resources and Energy?

name: No Rules Box!
short_description: In this intense and action-packed game, you will forget about the rules of traditional boxing and instead, focus on using weapons to take down your opponent.

name: Banner of Blood
short_description: An ever-shifting action RPG rich with Rogue-like elements. Lead your troops across randomly generated battlefields as a commander. Clash blades with savage orcs, and call a hail of arrows to vanquish monstrous foes.

name: Soul of Savarog
short_description: Soul of Savarog includes four of Twisted Universe's mobile horror thriller games. All of these plays tell the story of Savarog. Play Savarog, Savarog 2, Rule and Savarog 3 respectively.

name: ContractVille
short_description: Start almost penniless and create your own journey. Demolish, build, decorate and purchase your own land. Build your own design, decorate and sell by auction. Create your own company and do all of this with your friends up to 4 players CO-OP in an open-world.

name: Echoes
short_description: Follow the clues, question a cast of quirky witnesses and uncover the secrets of the little town of Greenhearth, but the deeper you dig, the more your risk awakening Eldritch horrors. Will you crack the case with your sanity intact?

name: Alpine
short_description: Alpine is a Skiing Arcade Game where your objective is to avoid rocks and other skiers while zooming down a mountain at lightning fast speeds! Collect power ups to help you on your mission to conquer the mountain! Collect coins to purchase new gear from Badger’s shop!

name: Beneath the Cardboard: Be Happy
short_description: You will have to survive the cold New Year's Eve, look for food in the trash in the world where no one cares about you. This is an adventure where you have to survive Christmas, a holiday that has never been so cold before...

name: ENDLOOP
short_description: You are trapped in an endless stairway with no end in sight. Solve twisted puzzles and maybe you will escape your fate.

name: Shotengai 10
short_description: Suddenly, I realized that I was in a Japanese shopping district that I was unfamiliar with. An unusual shopping street where even if you proceed blindly, you will end up returning to the entrance. Let's exit from this shopping street by relying on the hints left behind.

name: Folie Fatale
short_description: All capture targets are mentally 'Jirai'(landmine)!? Meet these eccentric boys, reveal the truth beneath in this Psycho-love-horror VN!

name: Women's School Simulator 2022
short_description: School simulation game 2022 edition. A school simulator game that recreates a girls' school with cherry blossoms on a small anime-style island. You control the yandere-like protagonist and attend classes, participate in club activities, buy sweets, and go to the beach.

name: Quest Master
short_description: Quest Master is a dungeon maker inspired by the classics that first made us love dungeon crawling. Unleash your imagination, alone or in local co-op, to make dungeons full of puzzles, traps and monsters. Upload them for others to explore and challenge yourself with other players’ creations.

name: Dream Addict
short_description: 「Dream Addict」は、夢の世界を旅するアクションRPGゲームだ。 夢の世界では、様々な動物、モンスターなどが生息している。剣やスキルを使ってモンスターを倒すことでそのモンスターとの「戦いの記憶」をゲットし、拠点となる家で「戦いの記憶」を具現化することで新たなスキルを得ることができる。敵を倒したり夢の世界を探索したりすることで自身を強化して夢の果てを目指そう。 戦いに疲れ現実から目を背け夢の世界の中毒者になってしまったあなたは夢の果てに何を見出すことができるのか...

name: Break Free
short_description: Come shoot some balls and break stuff in this incredible next-gen graphics with realistic physics fun game.

name: Sakura Hime 4
short_description: Adorable nekomimi, enchanting sorceresses, and stunning girls from a different realm have enveloped you. Aim to be the most devoted caretaker and have a wonderful vacation with them!

name: Romanticized Dreams of a Post-Apocalyptic Cowpoke
short_description: Romanticized Dreams of a Post-Apocalyptic Cowpoke is a top down action shooter with randomly generated loot, levels, and enemies. Find unique weapons and upgrades to blast, explode, laser, and kick your way through an army of dastardly bandits!

name: Shadow Hush
short_description: In 'Shadows Hush' infiltrate 'Guard' to unveil sinister experiments. Stealth mastery is key. Unravel secrets with cunning, aided by your radio partner. Will you save the world?

name: Debug Girl
short_description: Spend a summer with an old high school classmate making games! Play and debug a 2D action RPG to make the best game ever.

name: Arcus Chroma: Classic
short_description: Say goodbye to jumping and hello to intense, lightning-fast grounded battles! Arcus Chroma is an offline juggle combo fighting game where dodging and countering are the keys to victory. With a truly unique cast to choose from, let your mind run wild as you master the game's creative combo system.

name: SKALD: Against the Black Priory
short_description: SKALD:Against the Black Priory is a retro-style party-based RPG set in a grim-dark fantasy world of tragic heroes, violent deaths and Lovecraftian horror. Take a chance and roll the dice as you embark on a compelling story filled with deadly creatures, branching story and tactical, turn-based combat

name: Mutant Football League 2
short_description: Mutant Football League 2 is a hard-hitting, arcade-style football game that combines intense gameplay, wisecracking mutants, weapons, deep strategy, and outrageous humor. Prepare yourself for the most insanely brutal football you’ll ever experience.

name: Brutalismus: Chapter 1
short_description: The first chapter of Brutalismus. A short first person, walking simulator atmospheric exploration series.

name: Baisu
short_description: Step into the shoes of Detective Clay Kriest in 'Baisu,' a chilling tale of family, art, and the haunting unknown. As you arrive at the secluded residence of Maple Street 22, responding to an eerie call for help, you'll find yourself immersed in a quest shrouded in darkness.

name: Bridges of Patience
short_description: A single-player Third Person Parkour game where you, as a pirate, try to pass levels by overcoming challenges such as moving bridges (you'll see others in the game).

name: あなたはチャットAIです
short_description: 'You are a chat AI' is a simulation game. No real AI is used, and the player pretends to be a chat AI and converses with NPCs. This game consists of two parts: 'conversation' and 'learning'. The appeal of the game is that players who normally use AI can experience being used on the other hand.

name: 仙途
short_description: 一款战斗激烈，技能众多的大型MMORPG游戏。

name: Umbraclaw
short_description: Umbraclaw tells the story of Kuon, a house cat who has died in the mortal world, after she awakens in the Soulplane, a realm of the dead. She must challenge the perilous underworld to return home to her owner in this 2D action adventure.

name: Human Souvenir
short_description: You just visited the earth and got a famous 'Human Souvenir'. Would you be able to keep your human alive enough time to see them through their whole life cycle?

name: Loonyland: Halloween Hill
short_description: Classic console action-adventure vibes in Kid Loony's first adventure. Collect powerups and special weapons, solve puzzles, and deal with pesky werewolves and mummies as you explore Halloween Hill's lush forests, swamps, and graveyards. Now enhanced for Steam!

name: Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change
short_description: Heralds of the Avirentes is a visual novel, which brings you into the “Crystal punk” fantasy setting, where the world of Nanraas in which the dragon race lives. The game combines a visual novel, role-playing game elements, social simulator, a turn-based combat system.

name: Flagdashers
short_description: Fight alongside your friends or compete against them in this game's fresh take on capture the flag. Choose your hero, each overflowing with cuteness and boasting unique abilities, to secure your flag. The first team to score 5 points wins.

name: Seven Second Summer Camp
short_description: It's time for a meditation game that’s actually fun. After years of meditation practice, and years of gaming practice, GoldVision has combined the two into a meaningful and powerful experience that cares for every frame of the players time.

name: Reus 2
short_description: Shape worlds with your godly titans. Make symbiotic ecosystems and inspire humanity with your creations. Their achievements unlock new possibilities. Make different planets for different human spirits, and fill the universe with life!

name: BOND
short_description: Bind together to solve puzzles!

name: Blood Within
short_description: With the absance of the mighty Bloodstar, the universe plunged into chaos. Unleash your inner power alongside Captain Thorne, vanquish demons and restore the order of light.

name: Stages of Life
short_description: Follow the journey of a girl from childhood to old age in 'Stages of Life,' an exciting puzzle-adventure game. Overcome challenges and reflect on your choices in a vibrant world with an inspiring soundtrack. Try it now and discover the meaning of life!

name: Beer Simulator
short_description: You are single? You have a very hard work and small salary? Then this game is just for you. In this game you can earn beer just by clicking on beer. Upgrade your beer, sell your beer, earn gold, purchase more beer without becoming an actual alcoholic.

name: Hazing - Night Shift
short_description: A young police officer arrives at a country house after a disturbing call... This VHS tape captures the horrors that happened to him.

name: Trash of the Titans
short_description: It's turn-based fantasy tactics with trash animals. Defend your trash from invading rats, and eat your trash to upgrade your team. Think your way out of ruin by using the shape of each level to your advantage. Be creative, and try to not die.

name: Our War: The Strongest Shield
short_description: A grand and intense tower defense science fiction game, where you only need to purchase once to enjoy all the content of the game.

name: Mister Furry: Hot Muscles
short_description: ♂ Unique Furry Horror with Muscular Mister Furries, Deep Plot, Great Sound Effects and Creepy Atmosphere of Furry Dungeon. Hot Milk, Dungeon Items, Gym, Gay-Bar, Pool, Locker Room, Atmospheric Music and much more! Will you be able to escape punishment from Mister Furry? ♂

name: Undead City
short_description: After a global pandemic, humanity has to survive against hordes of zombies in the “Undead City”. Set in a post-apocalyptic world crawling with zombies and raiders. This action packed FPS game throws players into intense battles.

name: ReplayBellSuikaSlotLikeGame
short_description: A merge puzzle inspired by slot machine icons! Start with replays, then bells, watermelons... and grow them in order, aiming to hit the rainbow seven to enter bonus time! With a continuation rate over 50%, let's earn massive scores during bonus time!

name: Rejuvan
short_description: Make money, rejuvenate, repeat. Find about all wonder of this modern factory game in which your whole purpose is making money. Watch out for any surprising unnatural weather-related events as they may greatly impact your game experience.

name: Lappelduvide
short_description: A VHS-style found footage, analog, psychological horror game about the experience of one of the extreme cases of the virus that was left untreated.

name: Switch Range
short_description: Step into the heart-pounding world of Switch Range, where you become the last line of defense against relentless robot onslaughts. Arm yourself with an arsenal of weapons, each meticulously crafted with realistic projectile dynamics, demanding strategic thinking and surgical precision to survive.

name: Cowboy 3030
short_description: Step into the Wild West future of Cowboy 3030, a third-person shooter with 3D bullet hell and roguelike elements. Play solo or team up with friends, as various heroes with unique abilities. Take on notorious alien outlaws, forge unique builds in every run and rise to become top gun of 3030!

name: BYTES: The Reverse Tower Defense
short_description: BYTES:T.R.T.D is a twist on the classic Tower Defense formula. Build your own path to the exit and use special tiles to keep your Bytes safe against a dynamic AI that tries to counter your actions.

name: Arhaekon
short_description: Become an Arhaekon and recover lost treasures & knowledge, bleed your minions and forge them into something more, rebuild what has fallen into decay and lay waste to the abominations holding the world captive, in our Tactical turn-based dungeon crawler.

name: Chornobyl Liquidators
short_description: Chornobyl Liquidators is not a fantastic tale of exploring the Zone. It's a story about real people facing a real threat — the CNPP disaster. Invisible radiation, KGB, difficult moral choices... Do you have enough courage and strength to take on this challenge?

name: Penguin Helper
short_description: Penguin Helper is your chance to go to the South Pole, become a hero for penguins and enjoy a peaceful atmosphere

name: Idle Planets
short_description: Idle Planets is a game where your objective is to extract the maximum amount of minerals in a galaxy with different planets, aiming to become the master of the universe.

name: Cats, Guns & Robots
short_description: Step into an exciting journey in Cats Guns & Robots, a rogue-like action game where you are the last hope for the world. In this outlaw-like action game, surviving enemy attacks in each room will require careful choices of upgrading your character abilities and features of weapons in your inventory.

name: Graphsx
short_description: You turned on your monitor right now? It isn't giving to you a image? Maybe the pixels of your monitor is in to a trip why don't help them in this hard physics-based platform platform DJ trip?. Explore hundreds of challenges, become more and more sharper and find out more about a pixel journey.

name: Fear the Spotlight
short_description: Fear the Spotlight is an atmospheric third-person horror adventure with a disturbing mystery to unravel. Sneak into school after hours with Vivian and Amy, survive a séance gone wrong, solve tactile puzzles, and, whatever you do, stay out of the spotlight…

name: Festivals - Headliners
short_description: Design your Event Sites, Book Artists, Build your Career as a Promotor and Produce your own Festivals!

name: Kristala
short_description: As a feral warrior blessed with the gift of Kristala, you must master the six magic specialties of the sacred Kristals to join ranks with the famed Raksaka warriors. Simultaneously, you must uncover the source of a terrible curse that has transformed planet Ailur's creatures into mutated monsters.

name: The Ancients
short_description: The Ancients is a turn-based survival strategy game where you lead a prehistoric hunter-gatherer tribe through the last ice age. Survive the elements, hunt fierce animals, migrate to new continents, advance your technology, make social and political tribe decisions, and evolve your civilization.

name: Fix it - The Handyman Simulator
short_description: With Fix it - The Handyman Simulator, the player experiences the profession of a craftsman in all its facets. Whether electrical work, installation, gardening or renovation - all fields of activity are covered.

name: Tour de France 2024
short_description: Claim the Yellow Jersey in the official game of the 2024 Tour de France. Outperform your opponents, push yourself to the limit and show what you can do in the brand new multiplayer mode: Criterium.

name: ASTA-POOL: Can humans beat bots?
short_description: Everybody loves playing pool, especially if it's in outer-space against robots! Asta-Pool is the perfect casual game for humans who have never played AND for those whose friends call them 'shark'. Play old favorites, discover new ones, and help J.J. prove that humans can still beat bots!

name: Madhouse Madness: Streamer's Fate
short_description: Dive into Madhouse Madness: Streamer's Fate, where your stream turns into a wild, eerie adventure. Uncover secrets, solve puzzles, and expect the unexpected in a haunted asylum where nothing is as it seems. Will you brave the madness and reveal the truth?

name: clickyland
short_description: clickyland is a tower defense village builder where clicks are your main resource. Use clicks to harvest resources, fight enemies and manage your village, but use them wisely as you only get 20 clicks every day! Can you reach day 100?

name: Diabotical Rogue
short_description: Welcome to our online first-person shooter that combines fast-paced combat and roguelike upgrades. Choose from 3 base suits each with their unique flair. Improvise. Adapt. Overcome your opponents and teammates alike.

name: Killer Klowns from Outer Space: The Game
short_description: Plan your own alien invasion and harvest humans as the iconic Killer Klowns, or gather a team of survivors to fight the extraterrestrial threat, in a game based on the ‘80s cult classic movie. Welcome to a new, craazzy take on the asymmetrical multiplayer horror experience!

name: Aidan in Danger
short_description: Aidan in Danger is a retro-style 2D platform game. The player takes on the role of Aidan, the guardian of the last dragon. Face challenging levels, menacing creatures, and an interdimensional villain, all while enjoying beautiful graphics and an exciting soundtrack.

name: Ghost Teen Escape from Limbo
short_description: Make use of your newfound ghostly abilities to make your way back to the world of the living!

name: Zero-Point
short_description: Zero-Point is a 3D space roguelike featuring tactical ship-to-ship combat, crew command and an immersive view of your ship's interior. As Captain of a Star Federation cruiser, lead your crew and ship to victory over the rebellious Galactic Liberation Front!

name: Master Level Maker
short_description: Make an interesting map by yourself and share it with the world，freedom 2d platform game。The game includes a wide variety of props and items, and players can even create their own material packs. There are also triggers that can be used to create even more exciting levels.

name: The Hidden Room - Pyramid
short_description: Welcome to The Hidden Room - Pyramid, a gripping adventure that will take you through an extraordinary journey into the world and culture of ancient Mesoamerican civilizations

name: Rose and Cross
short_description: Our main character, absorbed in the study of sects and the occult, made a big mistake by going to an abandoned farm.

name: Pro Cycling Manager 2024
short_description: Become a sports director, take part in the world's top cycling races and lead your riders to victory. Set race objectives, negotiate contracts, find new sponsors and build your team season after season.

name: Ultimate General: American Revolution
short_description: American Revolution is a sandbox strategy game featuring the epic historical period during the rebellion of the American colonies against the British Empire.

name: Fireside
short_description: Fireside is an uplifting narrative experience about a journey, and the breaks that follow it. Make friends, trade and chat at the campfire, weave connections, and explore a serene magic-filled world.

name: Songs of Silence
short_description: Songs of Silence is a strategy game set in a fantasy world threatened by the all-devouring Silence. The game features a mix of turn-based kingdom management, auto battler, and hero development, contrasted with intense real-time battles.

name: Swarmsign
short_description: Protect your small off world farm from a variety of oversized and hungry alien bugs. Gain access to a varied assortment of weaponry and equipment designed for high caliber pest control. Bring a friend or two for added firepower.

name: Field of Glory: Kingdoms
short_description: Politics, religion, war. They are nothing without a legacy that can stand the test of time. Lead any nation, and turn it into a mighty kingdom in one of the most compelling grand strategy games ever created.

name: Bloody Knuckles Street Boxing
short_description: The Sweet Science Meets The STREETS!

name: ZpellCatz
short_description: Stranded on a cursed island, near death, you fight your way through dungeons full of loot to develop your cat hero's magical abilities. ZpellCatz is an action RPG with a dark campaign, exciting boss fights, hundreds of epic items and - of course - cats.

name: Cosmotroid
short_description: Escape from the asteroid X-474 which has been invaded by aliens. Take your weapons and destroy every enemy who tries to stop you in this amazing arcade style third person shooter game full of action, creatures and explosions.

name: Rolling Hills: Make Sushi, Make Friends
short_description: Serve up sushi as a robot chef in Rolling Hills, a life sim about running your own restaurant in a cozy village. Make new friends, purchase ingredients, enhance your shop, and improve the lives of your neighbors as you perfect your craft!

name: Undersea 8
short_description: You are trapped in a dangerous undersea ruin. Let’s escape from the deep sea with observation and quick situational judgment.

name: Grave Gunner
short_description: A fast-paced gothic arena FPS focusing on stellar game feel. Survive as a gunslinger against waves of monsters, utilising smooth and expressive movement, sliding, rocket jumping, and formidable duel handguns.

name: Cricket Captain 2024
short_description: Build your own dream team with Cricket Captain 2024. New commentary from Daniel Norcross tells the story of your matches. Honours boards showing every international century and five-wicket hall across all formats at every ground. Score predictor helps you manage your matches.

name: HSHS
short_description: HSHS! Turn me on is a virtual interactive romance game designed for women. You will take on the role of Pricilla Tang, a new entrant live streaming operations assistant, you will encounter him amidst the hustle and bustle of daily life, leading to a destiny that is uniquely yours!

name: CompressorX
short_description: CompressorX is an AI-powered file compression utility for Windows that saves space by transparently compressing files, apps, games, and project files. Set it and forget it, or compress with just one click.

name: Dragon Is Dead
short_description: Dragon is Dead is a hack-and-slash, roguelite action platformer. It offers tons of customization fun with different character skill trees and legendary equipment. Overcome repeated deaths to defeat Guernian, the leader of the Dark Dragons.

name: We Were Monkeys
short_description: Trying to escape the lab with your monkey pal, your realize the experimentations made you two see things differently. Can the two of you find your way out in time ?

name: Autopsy Simulator
