short_description: Autopsy Simulator is a first-person horror-sim hybrid where players take on the role of a practice pathologist and study case files, created in collaboration with real-world forensic doctors, to help guide their dissection of anatomically accurate bodies to determine each subject’s cause of death.

name: The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road
short_description: A forgotten Daedric Prince has returned, bringing chaos to West Weald! Explore a new zone and defend the city of Skingrad, now beset by a dangerous Daedric cult and the jungles of Valenwood. Customize your skills like never before with the new Scribing system.

name: Fork Road
short_description: Fork Road is a first-person immersive atmospheric game with new gameplay , Be prepared to face fears you've never faced before

name: Whacking Hell!
short_description: The gates of hell have opened: whack all the monsters before they whack you! Collect their souls, ramp up your weapons and your spells, and become a slaughtering machine in this frantic roguelite top-down 2D shooter!

name: Psychroma
short_description: Psychroma is a narrative-driven side-scroller where you play as a digital medium. Confront the past by piecing together the broken memories of a cybernetic house, and exorcise the ghosts in the machine.

name: Rocket Knight Adventures: Re-Sparked Collection
short_description: Rocket Knight Adventures:Re-Sparked has 3 games. This collection immerses players in these thrilling classic titles on Steam.

name: The Feathered Serpent
short_description: Battle through a lost world full of dinosaurs, magical golems, and oversized bugs in this roguelike action platformer. Your deal with the God of Death will bring you back as many times as it takes to slay the Feathered Serpent, each attempt bringing new items, levels, and story progression.

name: Anomalous Deception
short_description: A PSX-retro-style first-person survival horror game that takes place in an underground bunker that is randomly generated for each playthrough! Discover its secrets and mysteries of what lead you down there in the first place.

name: Rhythm Bang
short_description: Rhythm based aiming game focused around hard electronic music. Aim the blaster with your mouse as it blasts rhythmically to the music, and aim at the falling blocks!

name: Space Fishing
short_description: Space Fishing: Explore, catch, win! Are you ready for a unique fishing experience in space? Explore different regions with your custom spaceship, catch exotic fish, and win unique rewards. An unmissable experience for space adventure enthusiasts!

name: Figure Workshop2
short_description: 【Figure Workshop2】 is a figure making simulator.Here you can design designs for your favorite characters and make them into your own collection.

name: Master of Chess
short_description: First and only chess career simulator! Play chess with help from your AI character, solve chess puzzles, build an unrivaled openings repertoire, and win tournaments worldwide. Can you become World Chess Champion?

name: Miner Tower Defense
short_description: This is a game that combines mining and tower defense elements. Players need to build defense towers by digging and gathering minerals underground to resist a constant stream of monsters!

name: Defense of the Dauntless
short_description: Endless horde mode tower defense with permanent and per-run progression. Unlock dozens of towers, survive and become dauntless.

name: XF Extreme Formula
short_description: Race at the speed of sound and beyond in the great XF Extreme Formula championship! Taking place in the year 3000, you will tour trough the solar system proving you’re worthy of the title of champion.

name: Be My Horde
short_description: Be My Horde is a top-down 2D survival roguelite. Become a formidable necromancess, and make your enemies a resource! Resurrect each fallen foe, create massive hordes of the undead, and use the harvested souls to enhance your skills, growing more powerful with each death. PRAISE BE MORIANA!

name: City Transport Simulator: Tram
short_description: Become a tram driver! Hop back into the cab for the ultimate tram driving experience. Drive modern real-world trams from various cities with physics indistinguishable from the real thing.

name: Viking Survivors
short_description: Embark on an epic journey through the realms of Viking Survivors, a heart-pounding action roguelite that pits you against relentless hordes of monstrous foes. Unleash the true power of a Viking warrior as you slay enemies, learn potent skills, and forge your own path to victory.

name: Push The Cat with WASD
short_description: A cat-pushing puzzle game where narratives are puzzle levels. With an emotional story and a little bit of 4th wall breaking. By pushing the cat, you are pushing the cat to think, to remember why they are stuck in this game...

name: Deathless. Tales of Old Rus
short_description: A roguelike deck-building game set in the universe of the Tales of Old Rus that features epic Slavic heroes and monsters.

name: Hell's Underground
short_description: Descend into the eerie depths of the London Underground in this spine-chilling horror game. Navigate through claustrophobic tunnels and ominous sewers while evading terrifying monsters. Every step brings you closer to escape... or to your doom.

name: TRADESMAN: Deal to Dealer
short_description: Travel. Buy. Sell. Protect. Fight. Do Quests.

name: EON Trooper
short_description: EON Trooper is an exciting adventure where the player’s actions and decisions are crucial in every mission. Venture into enemy territories, carry out crucial missions, and face hordes of enemies to achieve your objectives.

name: Baten Kaitos I & II HD Remaster
short_description: Baten Kaitos: Eternal Wings and the Lost Ocean and Baten Kaitos Origins are now on Steam with improved graphics and new features to aid game progression, making them even easier to play!

name: Not a Masterpıece
short_description: Not a Masterpiece invites players on a whimsical journey through a vibrant cartoon world, where nothing is quite as it seems

name: Forest Of Fear
short_description: On a mission to explore a secret island discovered by the military, your plane crashes, leaving you as the sole survivor. Now, on the Island of the Condemned, your only concern is to survive and escape at any cost.

name: Pixel Hunt
short_description: Use unique cursors to find and fix simulated defective pixels on your desktop in this relaxing hidden object game. Enjoy multiple singleplayer modes and online multiplayer with friends, exploring others' desktops or inviting them to yours. Become a pixel hunter!

name: Little Fish Swims On
short_description: Little Fish Swims is a relaxing and enjoyable idle game with a casual simulated fish tank located at the top of the screen. There are over a thousand types of fish in the game, and you can customize your own fish tank and background skin style.

name: Pax Dei
short_description: Welcome to a vast, social sandbox MMO inspired by the legends of the medieval era. Here, myths are real, ghosts exist, and magic is unquestioned. Join thousands of players as you explore the land, build your home, forge your reputation, and craft your own stories. What world will you make?

name: EVERCHAINED
short_description: Defeat bosses & harvest trinkets. Feed it shards & get fed upgrades. For it is your Master. Rise and follow the path, Soul of the Great Hero.

name: Republic of Pirates
short_description: Establish and grow a pirate utopia during the Golden Age of Piracy. Create a resource-based economy, engage in real-time naval combat, and navigate diplomatic relationships with rival powers. Explore the far reaches of the Caribbean in search of the ultimate fortune and glory…

name: Crab God
short_description: Crab God is an atmospheric underwater strategy game. Guide your Crabling colony through wild ocean depths, and defend the egg of the next Crab God.Restore and protect diverse coral reefs, making a difference in the real world as you progress in-game. Make waves, praise the claw!

name: Medieval Conquest
short_description: Welcome to the world of medieval battles and heroic deeds! In this game you will go on an exciting journey through the era of knightly tournaments and great battles.

name: Demon Slayer

short_description: UBOAT: The Silent Wolf is an amazing combination of a role-playing game and a simulator, offering a deep and immersive experience, allowing you to feel like a real submarine captain during World War II.

name: Mannequin

name: Snow Plowing Simulator
short_description: Experience the serene joy of snow plowing in this relaxing simulation game! Drive powerful plows, clear roads, and keep your town safe. Uncover a surprising story, face survival challenges, and tackle advanced weather systems. Embrace winter's chill and become the ultimate snow-clearing hero!

name: Love & Country
short_description: Tensions run high and the boys run UPSETTINGLY HANDSOME in this World War I historical romance-spy thriller visual novel!

short_description: This is an open world survival game.

name: Dragon's Chronicles
short_description: This game is for maniacs who are no longer satisfied with the conventional difficulty level.

name: College Bowl
short_description: College Bowl is a beautifully pixelated on-field simulation of American Football! Challenge college rivals on your way to winning a National title! Take on various game modes, including a deep Dynasty mode with in-depth recruiting, scouting, stat tracking, ranking, bowl games, yearly goals and more!

name: SPACE
short_description: SPACE is an atmospheric horror game set in eerie, abandoned structures floating in space. Explore labyrinthine corridors, face unsettling encounters, and endure the psychological tension of cosmic isolation. Discover the haunting beauty and terror lurking in the unknown

name: GooGooRise
short_description: Reaching the top is just the beginning. Don't fear failure; you can always start over. Climb upwards with all you've got!

short_description: Embark on a perilous journey through the haunting depths of the forest in Jorogumo, a gripping stealth and puzzle game. When your brother vanishes in the eerie woods, you must summon your courage and venture into the heart of darkness to unravel the enigma surrounding the ancient legend of Jorogumo.

name: District Panic
short_description: an action-packed arcade shooter that takes you deep into the heart of a computer under siege.You're the system's last line of defense.

name: CRUELTY
short_description: 'CRUELTY' is a Japanese-made splatter horror. You were in an accident and lost consciousness. The moment you wake up, you find yourself in a nightmare world, one that is not of this Earth. In an abattoir ruled by madness, horrific scenes unfold, and inescapable terror awaits you.

name: Bureau of Contacts
short_description: 'Bureau of Contacts' - ghost-hunting game for 1-4 players, in which you'll encounter 2 enemies at once - location itself and the ghosts with most human-like intelligence ever. So...look around and watch what you say!

short_description: Build your perfect defenses with hexagons! Use hex tiles to explore cyberspace, upgrade your defense towers, and complete quests in this unique turn-based strategy game. With a story campaign, a procedurally generated endless mode, and a powerful editor, HexaScape offers endless challenges.

name: PegIdle
short_description: PegIdle is a Pachinko idle game! Aim and shoot your balls to clear all the pegs on the board. Recieve gold by hitting the golden pegs or by landing balls into the moving bucket. Purchasing auto ball drop will automaticly drop balls onto the board. Spend your gold on new balls and ball upgrades!

name: Chained Together
short_description: From the depths of hell, climb chained to your friends through diverse worlds. Solo or co-op, try to reach the summit and discover what awaits you there...

name: Jrago II Guardians of Eden
short_description: Jrago II Guardians of Eden is a Multiplayer Co-Op METROIDVANIA style 2D Platforming Action-Adventure Role Playing Game. The darkness has once again returned, and this time Jrago teams up with his fellow guardians as they slay the evil demons and bring back the light!

name: Angvik 2
short_description: Angvik 2 is an action roguelike platformer with a unique style. Explore a variety of character builds as you navigate randomized levels, offering new challenges and surprises with each adventure.

name: once in hell
short_description: Once in Hell: I tried to create a game where i union History,Horror,Riddle and Parkour. In game u can use: Inventory,torch,flashlight and everything that can help you to survive. I am sure that, time you'll spend on a game will be enjoyable.

name: Natsuno-Kanata: Beyond Summer
short_description: ──終わってしまった世界の夏、少女はあてのない旅をする。通話を介して終わってしまった世界を共に生きるアドベンチャーゲーム。

name: 起夜  Get Up In The Night
short_description: 'Get Up In The Night' tells a sci-fi story set in the future, filled with dark humor. An old man wakes up in a completely unfamiliar place... His bladder can no longer hold, and he must rush to the bathroom! But what exactly is going on? What secrets are hidden within all this?

name: #BLUD
short_description: Save your friends, fight off the vampire apocalypse, and survive the horrors of freshman field hockey practice in #BLUD, a delightfully zany animated dungeon crawler that blurs the line between action RPGs and hyperkinetic 90s cartoons.

name: Neural Shock
short_description: In Neural Shock, you must cleanse the world of horrid and bloodthirsty creatures by utilizing turrets, traps, wits and weapons. Choose from different class choices with unique playstyles and over 20+ different turrets and traps in this unique sci-fi Tower Defense / Action RPG.

name: Giltsteader - Tower Defense
short_description: Farming meets tower defense in Giltsteader, a relentless & highly replayable strategy game. Create and combine randomized turrets to fend off deadly drones as you cultivate crops and carefully time their sales in a dynamic economy.

name: Astrodle
short_description: Ready for some chill time in space? Astrodle has you covered. Watch the numbers soar as you upgrade your ship and travel the stars. Oh, and you might just become a god.

name: Facehand
short_description: Facehand is a synergy-driven roguelike deckbuilder with autobattling mechanics. Craft the perfect deck and chain card abilities to create wild combos!

name: PACIFICATION LIGHT
short_description: PACIFICATION LIGHT is an exciting 2D platformer that takes us back to a time when spirits and ghosts inhabited our world. During this period, there lived a brave hero who decided to confront the darkness and cleanse the earth of sinister supernatural entities.

name: Letter Lancers
short_description: A 4-player couch co-op rogue-lite bullet-hell that will have you and your friends laughing your way through epic battles! Grab your friends, pick your characters, and get ready to ruin someone's day! Level up, select from hundreds of modifiers, get loot, and earn your place on the leaderboards!

name: Taskmaster VR
short_description: Submit to the judgement of The Taskmaster in glorious virtual reality! The hit TV show comes to VR and YOU are the contestant. Step into the world of Taskmaster, endeavour to complete a menagerie of challenging and extraordinary tasks and get creative in how you solve them. Your time starts now!

name: Breakthrough Mars
short_description: Based on the classic brick breaker, embark yourself on a journey to Mars and fight your way destroying walls and collecting power-ups against the Martian fleet.

name: Drug Dealer Simulator 2
short_description: What turns a person into a drug dealer? A drug dealer into a drug lord? Find out in DDS2, a first-person co-op sim set in a dynamic open world. Make contacts, cook drugs, and manage your cartel on Isla Sombra, where power is the only law.

name: Shade Silver
short_description: Avoid Traps, Shoot Enemies, Collect Treasure, Discover Secrets, Solve Puzzles, Beat Bosses, Unlock New Places.

name: HexoCity
short_description: HexoCity blends tranquility with strategy in a vibrant synthwave-inspired puzzle game. Build a futuristic city on a lush archipelago. Seek challenges? Strategize for high scores in this serene yet engaging city scaper.

name: Coffee Mania
short_description: Experience seven nights in the apartment, being dependent on coffee, prepare for power outages, make sure the mining farm doesn't break down, exercise caution in the darkness. You won't be alone for sure!

name: Nonogram Animals
short_description: Use your logic to paint beautiful images in this relaxing puzzle. The gorgeous visuals and relaxing soundtrack will help you forget all your problems and have a great time!

name: Scars of Mars

name: Night Driver
short_description: Night Driver - 3D car game in which you will drive at night through dark alleys!

name: 100 hidden Cthulhu fish

name: Nightrunner
short_description: Buckle up in this minimalist retro arcade high score chaser.

Gather resources and upgrade yourself, choosing to be robotic or human as you fight horrors of the compound.

short_description: El Dorado is a strategy city-building game in which you plan, build and develop your settlement to conquer Jukatan and earn the title of The Golden City. Become a leader, whom even Gods will bow to. Offer sacrifices to the Gods to earn their favor, but beware and don’t lose yourself in your riches.

short_description: Build a bond with your horse and gain its trust. Develop yours and the horse’s skills. Discover the surrounding open world. Complete tasks and take part in competitions. Rebuild a run-down stud farm!

short_description: Are you ready to shape fashion world? Make a brand deal, order products, fill the aisles, dress the mannequins and start selling. Dresses, shirts, coats, pants, nightwear, underwear, shoes and more are waiting for you.

name: Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora™

name: Dessert Storm Girls

name: Litha and the Sunhouse
short_description: Litha and the Sunhouse is a rogue-lite dungeon crawler with a flashy, fast-paced combat system. You will explore the complex lair of the mighty Sun Usurper while defeating monsters, collecting treasures, avoiding traps, discovering secrets, and helping unlucky fellows you meet along the way!

name: Pomberito
short_description: Survive 5 nights in the heart of northeastern Argentina as a local farmer and reveal the truth behind the haunting tales of the Pombero in a world where folklore meets terror.

name: The PARADOGX Incident
short_description: Welcome to 'The PARADOGX Incident,' a puzzle/rhythm platformer where every beat and move counts! Join Dox, the clever dog, to collect bones, solve recursive puzzles, and conquer rhythm levels. Experience dynamic gameplay and an adaptive soundtrack!

name: Cluminati
short_description: Test your linguistic skills in Cluminati, a puzzle word game where you decipher clues to unlock passwords and join a secret society. Use your wits while racing against time to advance through 13 challenging rounds of initiation.

name: Was God Birthed!?
short_description: Explore a lush, liminal museum with surreal suprises at every turn as you avoid your dad with your wits and scooter, and make it downstairs in time to catch the Club Ruby Rave!

name: Evil Hunt - Evil never sleeps
short_description: Evil Hunt is a 4-player online co-op psychological horror. Paranormal activity in the neighbourhood is increasing, so it's up to your team to use the right ghost hunting equipment at your disposal and identify the houses where paranormal activity can be found to collect as much evidence as possible.

name: MagFighter
short_description: Dive into the chaotic world of MagFighter! A top-down multiplayer brawler featuring 60+ spells for epic magical battles. Witness dynamic spell collisions, strategically customize your loadout, GBA-era pixel art visuals. Unleash the magic and become the ultimate MagFighter! Join our discord!

name: 残雪凝辉录-Truth in Turbulent
short_description: Truth in Turbulent 'Truth in Turbulent' is an AVG mystery set in a chaotic era. As Meng Xubai, uncover truths behind your uncle's disappearance and find the truth with wit and courage.

name: Eternal Vampire
short_description: In this 2D action game, you control a vampire with melee and magic abilities. Defeat enemies and earn XP, get new swords and spells. Explore random dungeons, fight bosses and reach new enemies using teleport points.

name: The Overseer
short_description: You are an Overseer on duty. Cycle through the camera feeds looking for anomalies. Upon finding one, report it quickly. Too many anomalies can lead to severe distortions in reality and result in deaths, including yours.

name: Defence of the Arcane Realms
short_description: A 3D tower defender where you must strategically use a combination of magical powers, traps, and towers in order to defend your castle against hordes of orcs, undead, and other unsavory sorts.

name: Realmcraft VR
short_description: RealmCraft is the original Sandbox Game. Try to Survive & Use 100+ Types of Blocks to Build Your Unique Town

name: She Could Fly: Documentary Escape Game
short_description: Online gamer Tiger Orchid has picked up the new release 'She Could Fly: Documentary Escape Game'. Play with Tiger as she enters a flat covered in comic book art. Who lives here? What's up with the creepy knitted birds? How do you get out? Will someone fix the toaster?

name: True Love
short_description: If you are looking for the True Love... Here you go xd

name: Teeny Tiny Trains
short_description: All aboard the Teeny Tiny Train tracks! Choose the perfect strategy to guide your trains from A to B!

name: You know my name?
short_description: A short visual novel about finding your name and a girl in the fog.

name: Super Power Man
short_description: How about a new challenge?

name: REDNEG ALLSTARS SWING-BY EDITION
short_description: Cosmo Dreamer Like Dreamer 'Outside' is a fantastical and comical boss-rush bullet-hell shooting game remade from a free game. Both beginners and experts can enjoy the intense boss rush.

name: Aleph
short_description: Aleph is an enigmatic cube, a repository of human lore and simulacra. After the fall of human civilization, as a traveler, you depart from the space station and eventually reach the ruins of the dilapidated city, searching for scattered cubes to read the images and texts left behind by humanity.

name: Parking Expert 2!
short_description: Get ready to put your parking prowess to the ultimate test and become the ultimate Parking Expert in this thrilling sequel!

name: Time Re:Quest
short_description: A survival game with a classic style of the graphic adventures of the 80s. Current graphics, updated to the new generations and with a simple way to play. Two game modes. Discover your way and one great game. Procedural game, it is generated as you progress. Every game is different. Survive!

name: Jailbirds
short_description: Despite his hellish prison cell and the constant suffering, Felix the good giant always seeks the bright side of life. His bullet-proof serenity infuriates the vicious Chief-Warden who has sworn to uncover the inmate’s secret and eradicate his happiness once and for all.

name: HeavensSea
short_description: HeavensSea is a turn-based strategy game with a tabletop game style. Players build and strengthen their air fleets to compete for control of various island regions against enemies. Each region has different defense facilities, so players must choose suitable aircraft and firepower to deal with them.

name: Kubits Gallery
short_description: Kubits Gallery is a logic game for casual players where you will have to solve nonogram grids to repaint the vanished paintings inside museums around the world. Solve puzzles at your own pace more than 120 levels in various fictional galleries.

name: Simple Trains
short_description: Simple Trains is a transit simulation game where you build efficient railroad networks and manage trains and routes. Streamline complex passenger flow utilizing eight unique upgrades!

name: Young Hearts
short_description: ‘Young Hearts’ is a visual novel in the genres of romance and slice of life, telling stories about the everyday life of a student company living in a warm southern town: stories about their secrets, dreams, love, their problems and ghosts of the past…

name: ChingMing
short_description: As a Taoist from the Heavenly Master's Mansion, you will come down the mountain to experience various demons and monsters on this land. You need to personally build a camp, search for food, establish defenses, and do everything you can to survive.

name: Mystery Of Dust
short_description: A sudden mechanical rebellion. An ordinary girl who has gained power. Faced with a 'world-class' crisis. Is there a secret behind the rebellion? Is the power gained safe? Can a few people's journey save the world? Find out in our Tower Defense game-- Mystery of the Dust!

name: Ghostboy
short_description: Would you return from death to help your loved ones through grief? Make fate turning decisions, micromanage the family’s relationships and defeat the negative thoughts on tower defense levels. Watch out, your job will be harder the more severe their mental disorder is.

name: Poor Man's Adventure: Narco Sub Simulator
short_description: Join a small community of rejects, try to survive in hospitable world of peak capitalism. As a modern pirate you will scavenge wrecks of rich peoples' yachts for resources, grow weed and manage automated factories.

name: Space Drop
short_description: Can you become the best 'Space Jumper' in the universe? Jump out of a spaceship into a warp tunnel. Feel the thrill of the high speed. Evade obstacles and collect pickups on your way. Full VR experience Unique music

name: Last victim. House of Fear
short_description: This is an indie horror game in which you have to face your fear and escape from house by solving puzzles and escaping from a ghost. Find out the story of a serial killer...

name: Park the Retro Car
short_description: 'Park the Retro Car' is a challenging and exciting game that puts your parking skills to the test.

name: デュエホロ (DUEHOLO)
short_description: Rogue-like card RPG where you build your deck with cards of hololive members! Fight against holomem to strengthen your deck and defeat boss holomem!

name: HUDDAM 2 BERZAH
short_description: HÜDDAM 2 BERZAH It is a type of psychological horror blended with Turkish culture.single playercrosswordfearIt is a game in FPS style.You must progress and as the chapter passes, you will find yourself in new places and events..

name: Nocturnal Visitors
short_description: Investigate morally grey crimes in this fantasy thriller in where magic and science, chaos and order, are two sides of the same coin.

name: Universal Conquest
short_description: 4X/Grand Strategy/RTS Hybrid Space Simulation based on principles - and developed in consultancy with - alien contactees.

name: Little Hero Adventure
short_description: Immerse yourself in the captivating world of Little Hero Adventure, an exciting 2D platformer game. Explore diverse levels, battle enemies, overcome traps, and collect berries to help your village.

name: Tsugunohi -Pocky dog’s adventure-
short_description: 'Tsugunohi' and the video game play-by-play artist, Pocky, have collaborated. 'Tsugunohi -Pocky dog’s adventure-,' created in conjunction with Pocky's 10th anniversary event, is now available on Steam. Lured by a white butterfly, Pocky the dog's 'little adventure' now begins.

name: The Backrooms: Unseen Tapes
short_description: 'The Backrooms: Unseen Tapes' is a first-person survival horror game where you navigate a maze-like, ever-changing procedurally generated environment. With stealth, speed, and strategy, evade monsters and conserve limited resources to maintain your sanity and escape this nightmarish dimension.

name: Zombi Efem
short_description: Join the battle for survival against zombies with 'Zombi Efem'! Play solo or online with up to four players in both TPS and FPS modes. This horror survival game invites you to face challenging combats and thrilling moments. Plan your strategy, prepare your weapons, and fight to survive!

name: EZ-Crosshair
short_description: Enhance your gaming precision with EZ-Crosshair, a user-friendly app providing customizable crosshair overlays for a personalized and immersive gaming experience.

name: Conge's Crunch Time
short_description: 'Conge's Crunch Time' is a puzzle game where you solve factory tasks by using intuitive Drag&Drop-based programming. Write a code for your robot to complete specific tasks for each level, progress deeper into the factory. Meet new puzzle concepts and data structure creatures, and uncover the truth.

name: Salvation Hours
short_description: Salvation Hours is Single player - First Person Shooter, based on the true story of Benghazi 2012 Attack on American Consulate. Play as one of the GRS Operatives in this slow paced and tactical shooter, developed by one-man development studio 'Wolf Wire Studios'.

name: Masala Drive
short_description: Super high-occupancy over 1000%! How many passengers on the bus can you goal with? Many Masala sound BGM for driviving.

name: Teatime Samurai
short_description: Up to four player retro arcade style twin-stick shooter featuring a colorful cast of monsters inspired by Japanese folklore.

name: Astrosphere
short_description: In Astrosphere, a sci-fi strategy adventure game, you explore mysterious star systems and expand your space station. Collect resources and navigate unexplored galaxies as you survive on your interstellar adventure.

name: Bad Dream
short_description: You're stuck in school. What has trapped you is a non-human creature. Run away from him (her?). Find the key and escape from the school to survive. Use w,a,s,d, ESC, left shift, mouse

name: Times Tables Games
short_description: Get ready to multiply the fun with Times Tables Games!

name: Cozy Escapes
short_description: Experience the uncanny adventure of Cozy Escapes, where the cozy merges seamlessly with mystery in a thrilling cooperative escape. Ready for a puzzle-packed journey with your partner, fueled by the shared desire to escape reality for a cozy moment?

name: 河神：沉溺之流
short_description: 踏上《河神：沉溺之流》的旅程，在那里一个古老的村庄与深入其骨髓的诅咒斗争。揭开一个邪恶祭司的秘密，他的黑暗仪式将村庄与生死界限之外的领域连接在一起。

name: Get Those Bugs
short_description: Commander, hordes of angry bugs are on their way! Play your cards right to upgrade your units and overcome the constantly evolving bug threat before they take out the artefacts. Get Those Bugs!

name: Neon Flight
short_description: Speed through space, narrowly dodging obstacles in this high-speed arcade-style endless runner. Compete for the top spot on the leaderboard and collect ship customizations.

name: Inverted Angel
short_description: A girl visited your home, who you don't know but she identified herself as your girlfriend. She seems a little bit Menhera, but she knows too much to be just a stalker. This is a Kawaii Future Mystery, you will answer by free input for branching story. Please Try to find out true identity of her.

name: Hot Blood
short_description: Take down zombies as a deadly cutie in 3D low-poly style! Hot Blood is physics-based brawling fun inspired by action movies of the 80s & 90s.

name: Ancient Sacrifice
short_description: RTS x Deck-Building Card Battle!An RTS-style card game that you can easily play with a deck of 10 cards and simple rules.

name: 召唤师崛起  summoner rises
short_description: GameplayPlayers have multiple skills and dozens of different equipment, and the special entries of the equipment will directly affect the effect of the skills, and even change the original skill form to become more powerful

name: Unity-chan the SharpShooter!
short_description: A casual sports TPS that can be played using only the mouse! Let's try clay pigeon shooting, rifle shooting, and rail shooting with Unity-chan!

name: My Museum: Treasure Hunter
short_description: Welcome to My Museum: Treasure Hunter! Restore your own museum, go on expeditions and explore faraway lands. Use your talents to restore ancient artifacts and build the greatest exhibition of all time!

name: Drive Me Crazy
short_description: 'Drive me crazy' is a game inspired by the urban legend 'Yua Mikami's wedding and retirement event.' You play as her fiancé, qiangzi, in this interactive adventure. During the game, you will be asked one question: 'With Yua Mikami by your side, would you still have a change of heart?'

name: Knight Fall
short_description: Welcome to Knight Fall, where every move is a challenge! Battle bosses as you climb through dangerous lands. Be careful; a single wrong move could mean the end of the journey. Will you beat the horrors or fall to the bosses on your daring quest?

name: The End
short_description: Survive and lead the score. Swarmed by ghosts, you have to do whatever it takes to survive and it is not going to be an easy task. Lead your way as Bit, earn experience, spend points on upgrades and survive!

name: Hexalert
short_description: Scifi strategy game combining turnbased strategy and tower defence genres with a new twist! Upgrade and customize your own mechs to adapt in an ever changing world!

name: Cake Platformer
short_description: Be a Ninja character in this 3rd person platformer. Avoid traps, enemies, solve puzzles and finish maps

name: Z-APE: Tower Defense
short_description: Z-Ape is a unique tower defense and first person shooter mash up game. Hordes of enemies attacking your base, it's up to you to stop them by placing towers or fighting them on FPS mode with guns, or both!

name: Ark of Charon
short_description: Build a mobile fortress on the back of a giant and mysterious walking Tree and embark on a journey in this merge of tower defense and colony simulation.

name: Biological Incident
short_description: Cases of disappearances have become more frequent in the small town. The tracks lead to an empty house on the outskirts of the city...

name: Silhouettes
short_description: You see them in your dreams, only you can solve the riddle. Immerse yourself in crime, fantasy, horror events.

name: Samurai Elemental
short_description: explore the map and defeat insects

name: Playground Mayhem
short_description: Defend your base solo or with friends against endless waves of foes using your weapons and turrets. Are you up for the challenge?

name: Where are the creatures of mountains and seas
short_description: The mythical creatures in the Classic of Mountains and Seas have all escaped. You need to analyze over a thousand characters in 12 Chinese cities, recall over a hundred mythical creatures and races, please embark on an exciting journey.

name: Seekers of Darkness
short_description: Dive into 'Seekers of Darkness,' a thrilling deck-building roguelike RPG with intense card battles and tower defense RTS elements. Unlock powerful characters, build unique strategies with over 70 cards, and compete in offline rankings. Burn enemies, freeze them, or overpower with weapons. Enjoy!!

name: Drop It! Jelly Man
short_description: There's only one reason the Jelly Man goes into the deep end. He just needs a beer. Please join him on his dizzying adventure! To survive, you must fall into the water. Continue down. It won't be visible. Still, don’t give up and take the courageous plunge!

name: Slime Coming
short_description: Slimes have invaded the world! 6 heroes have to save the world and investigate the cause. Slime Coming is a casual game with light rogue-like elements and survivor type. Fully automatic attack, through upgrades, strengthen your hero and defeat slimes and monsters.

name: Multiplayer Survivors
short_description: MULTIPLAYER SURVIVORS - a highly advanced multiplayer and single player RPG survival looter shooter game, packed with lots of great maps to explore.

name: Lifeforms: Binary Fission
short_description: Clone yourself to take over the environment in this bacterial evolution roguelite. Choose mutations and abilities each time you multiply. Use swarm mode to direct your species to attack enemies. Unlock abilities and perks to improve your odds. Compete against other multiplying and evolving species.

name: Ladder it Up!
short_description: One guy, one ladder, and a tower you must get to the top of. Get ready for an unforgettable adventure to the top in a platformer that demands patience and precision, filled with diverse environments and various challenges!

name: MyLittlePool
short_description: It is a neglected swimming pool simulator that runs at the bottom of the screen and can be enjoyed comfortably.

name: 晨海星澜 - 追忆篇
short_description: 少年们的梦想，是清晨大海般壮阔的晨光，他们立誓冲破黑暗的牢笼 —找到光。 安然的日子稍纵即逝，命运的交织都随着夜雨之季的到来而备受考验， 人间冷暖、烟花绽放，十七八岁的年纪里，所有的一切都是故事的开始。 根据游戏制作人【真实经历】改编，愿你我的青春永不散场。—《晨海星澜》

name: Aoi Tori
short_description: Shiratori Ritsu, the sole male at Kirihara Academy for Girls and its priest, protects the school from demons but finds his sanity tested by the arrival of a new student, the one-hundred-year-old vampire Mary Harker, and a call from the devil, questioning his purpose in life.

name: Archery RED
short_description: Dive into a futuristic world as an archer, aiming to hit targets and vanquish robotic foes. Experience advanced mechanics and realistic shooting in an engaging single-player campaign or endless mode. Ready for the challenge?

name: NAUS
short_description: NAUS is a thrilling 2D action roguelike that takes you deep into a dark dungeon for deadly battles against hordes of monsters and exciting adventures. Explore dark corridors and caves, where every step can be a challenge.

name: TAMU
short_description: TAMU Open your eyes to a dark world and confront your deepest fears. TAMU drags you into a terrifying adventure where nightmares reign and reality blurs with dreams. In this mansion filled with horror and uncertainty at every corner, are you ready to fight for survival?

name: Paranoid
short_description: Paranoid is Dungeoncrawler/Roguelike with an oldschool pixelartstyle where you need to survive alone in the dark and discover new items and pills that help you through this dangerous World. Can you find a way out and wake up?

name: Dustland Delivery
short_description: Dustland Delivery is a post-apocalyptic survival business simulator. Scour the wastes for profit, complete missions to grow your trading empire, and assemble a rag-tag band of adventurers to turn your city into the capital of the Dustlands. Danger lurks around every corner—but no risk, no reward!

name: Back To Home
short_description: Back To Home is a cozy third-person cat adventure game where you explore stunning worlds and solve puzzles. Uncover the captivating story of a cat’s past as you embark on this heartfelt journey

name: NYO-NIN-JIMA -My New Life in Charge of a Tropical Island-
short_description: Japanese romance-adventure VN from hit developer PacoPaco Soft! Stepping ashore a remote southern island, the protagonist’s battered spirits are soothed by the lovely Kowakame family that takes him in. However, many more unexpected surprises await him on the island...

name: Kevurah Horror Tale
short_description: You must organize a funeral in a remote location while witnessing strange events.

name: CORPSE58
short_description: 'CORPSE-58' is a slow-motion bullet hell shooting game by UnderDoor. Players become human weapons created through clone and genetic engineering technologies, tasked with destroying former allies turned into 'corpses'.

name: SpaceCraft Brawl
short_description: Build spacecrafts and fight with or against your friends! This multiplayer game offers physics driven gameplay, with a variety of weapons and powerups. Slice your enemies in half with a laser beam, or erase them from existence with a black hole bomb!

name: Neon Rider Classic
short_description: Race your bike through cybernetic landscapes, switch your color to navigate between glowing neon tracks and perform crazy flips in Neon Rider Classic. With upgraded graphics, this nostalgic collection Includes Neon Rider and Neon Rider World.

name: Comrades, We Have a Mole Problem
short_description: 'Hear me comrade, lives are at stake here. You are to take matters into your own hands, saving yourself and your comrades from spies from the West. The party appreciates your work, but don't forget, the party will not forgive incompetence.'

name: Chronicles Of Errodean
short_description: In the dark realm of Errodean, Morgath's malevolent rule casts a shadow over all. Confront the sorcerer and restore peace. Hone your skills, and prepare for the ultimate battle. Will you rise as Errodean's hero?'

name: DeepWeb Simulator
short_description: DeepWeb Simulator is a simulation game where you will get lost in the dark corridors and experience the thrill of illegal trade. Place ads, make secret deals and build your criminal empire in the illegal world of the deep web.

name: Astro Combat
short_description: Astro Combat is a Pixel Space Shooter, with Action-RPG elements.

name: Glass Heart: Retold
short_description: A modern romance otome/visual novel filled with drama, angst, adventure and, most of all, love. With a twenty percent chance to survive, you decide to experience living outside of a hospital for the first time. Can your heart handle the love that you find along the way?

name: Black & White Lite
short_description: 'Black & White•plot exclusive version' is a dystopian visual novel game: black and white, sensibility and reason, freedom and order: follow your beliefs and join your camp.

name: Flee the Backrooms
short_description: Flee the Backrooms is a multiplayer (4vs1) top-down game where one player takes on the role of the Backrooms Entity, and the other four players play as Hazmat Team, trying to escape the Entity and avoid being caught and killed.

name: BOKKIE
short_description: Dare to enter the world of 'BOKKIE' where the line between childhood innocence and supernatural terror is blurred, and every corner hides a secret waiting to be unveiled. Will you brave the haunting whispers of the abandoned toys, or succumb to the darkness that lurks within?

name: Shallow Sea Roaming
short_description: Find the secret treasure and explore the secrets of this mysterious island,and there are a large number of enemies on the island.You need to use your courage and scientific knowledge to survive on this island,And find a way to leave this island!

name: Chaos Hero Village
short_description: This game is a turn-based strategy adventure where you play as a king's trusted confidant sent to a remote village to investigate a mysterious power. Search for clues, recruit heroes, confront unknown enemies, and uncover the truth behind the 'inaccessible place.'

name: 勇者与亡灵之都
short_description: 游戏存在多周目与多结局。 目前开放1.0版本，后续会有三次左右重大更新，增加新区域和新剧情，第三次重大更新后，游戏将不再有重大更新。 游戏借鉴了NPCDream，Blacksouls等rpg。

name: Realistic Ragdoll Sandbox
short_description: Realistic Ragdoll Sandbox is an immersive game that stands out for its realistic ragdoll physics, which together with various creation and damage tools, provides the player with a mix of realism and fun.

name: Mystery Detective Adventure Collector's Edition
short_description: Mystical events haunt locals. Conduct your own investigation to uncover the truth. “Mystery Detective Adventure” is an adventure game in the genre of Hidden Objects, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters and complicated quests.

name: Diatomic
short_description: Diatomic has face paced action, gun juggling, epic boss fights, Agility Challenges and much more! Level up, unlock new abilities and customize your power ups to try and conquer this brutally difficult arena shooter where the only way to survive is to keep moving!

name: Templar 2
short_description: Templar 2 is a 2D indie action platform game. Immerse yourself in the darkest, scariest and bloodiest Middle Ages. A story told in comic format, and with spectacular dubbing.

name: Fair and Square
short_description: Try this small real time strategy and roguelike game where you need to defend your base against multiple waves . Each run you will have to choose between unique units and unique buffs.

name: Manhattan Dolls
short_description: “Manhattan Dolls” is a comedic yuri dating sim where you spend a wild weekend exploring all the different corners of Manhattan to find lesbian women to charm. This game is both a love letter to New York City and the wonders of lesbian love!

name: Beat the Fed
short_description: Run the Federal Reserve in this macroeconomics time-traveling simulation game. Apply monetary and fiscal policies and monitor and assess the impact on unemployment, inflation, and other key economic metrics. Can you Beat the Fed?

name: StellarDefender
short_description: Search for the scattered items within the planet to prevent a planetary collision.Let's search for supplies scattered across the planet, build a foundation, and launch a compressed-power missile to eliminate other planets that threaten the Delta planet.

name: Villienville. Echoes of Deception
short_description: A text role-playing game about the fate of a mercenary who finds himself in the strange village: Villienville. Investigate who benefits from the sudden appearance of “ghosts” and help residents protect their homes from a mysterious enemy. The main thing is not to make a mistake in your choice!

name: FINISHLINE
short_description: A driving simulator that helps you reconsider your life choices

name: NARAKU
short_description: This is a survival horror action game in which a young girl 'Enri' tries to escape from a mysterious facility filled with blood and madness.

name: kallio
short_description: Help players trapped in a collapsed mine find their way out through different levels in a puzzle-style game, either in single-player or multiplayer online.

name: Nekokami - The Human Restoration Project
short_description: Start an epic world-building adventure with Nekokami! Architect beautiful, peaceful worlds in a far-future universe ruled by Cats. Befriend wondrous yet whimsical spirits of nature. Restore and manage extinct Humans. With Cats in charge, what could POSSIBLY go wrong?

name: Fisher's Idle
short_description: Welcome to Fisher's Idle! Immerse yourself in the relaxing world of fishing, where you can buy and manage fishing boats to build a thriving fishing empire.

name: Robot Arena Survivors
short_description: Robot Arena Survivors is a single-player arena auto-shooter. You are piloting one of your own Hovercraft Units to fight against many waves of deadly robots. Unlock powerful abilities and rewards to get the job done.

name: 我说什么她们都答应（OKeverything）
short_description: This is a sci-fi interactive visual love novel.you will play a 25-year-old virgin,in an accident, you obtain a magical 'love button'. Pressing this button on anyone makes them agree to anything you say.You may interact in love with diverse beautiful women across land, sea and air.

name: Zombie War:New World
short_description: 'Zombie World War: New World' is a shooter where players and three AI teammates battle a massive zombie invasion. They must cooperate using skills and strategies to survive and defeat mutants. Intense combat with high-quality graphics and PBR materials providing a visually stunning experience.

name: Angor
short_description: Immersed yourself in an interactive story with multiples choices, in the style of 'choose your own Adventure book' (CYOA).Will you be able to survive ?Probably not!

name: Warchief
short_description: Warchief is a brand new kind of Action RTS. Choose your hero, recruit and customize your armies, explore the jungle, and seize strategic objectives to become the ultimate Warchief. Ready to dominate the battlefield?

name: Multiplayer RPG
short_description: MULTIPLAYER RPG - The Kingdom is under attack, You and Your team must save the day.

name: Redlight
short_description: Redlight is a chilling multiplayer first-person horror experience. Traverse a liminal maze alongside friends while being hunted by a relentless AI-driven terror lurking in the shadows. Work together to activate generators, but remember: survival demands stealth when the lights turn red.

name: ハチバンバスピス
short_description: 異変を見つけたら引き返しましょう。異変が見つからなかったらそのまま進みましょう。 ただし、泳ぎが下手なバスピスにそれができれば...ですが... バスピスは一方向にしか泳ぐことができず、引き返したくても引き返せないかもしれません。 ですが、適切なタイミングでクリックすることで、狙った方向に進むことがきっとできるはず。 泳ぎが下手なバスピスを上手く誘導して、頑張って先に進みましょう。(あるいは引き返しましょう。)

name: From The Mystery Zone
short_description: You find yourself in a pitch-dark world. Avoid dangerous events, restore memory, and escape from the “Mystery Zone”.

name: Virus 3D
short_description: Eradicate the logic viruses infecting your android baby sister in order to save her life in this fast-paced twin-stick shooter.

name: Rogue Bot Adventure
short_description: Rogue Bot Adventure is an on-rails 3D platformer. Your goal is to collect the 10 parts of your ship and escape the enemies and hazards of this mysterious planet, including robots, lasers, acid, meteors, and more. Jump, slash, and reflect using your ancient artifact.

name: System Malfunction
short_description: 'System Malfunction' is a first-person horror game set in a mysterious building. The player takes on the role of a security guard who witnesses strange occurrences during the night shift. In a fear-inducing environment, the player explores the building to uncover hidden truths.

name: Eternal Cocoon
short_description: Eternal Cocoon is a horror adventure game centered around Olivia, a girl whose boundaries between reality and dreams are blurred. Olivia must choose her own destiny while avoiding danger and an onslaught of monsters to uncover her truth.

name: Slimelon
short_description: Try to defeat the chaos generated by a multitude of slimes, each one cuter (almost) than the other. Discover all the fusions, collect them... And try to be the best (temporary) slime breeder!

name: That Level Again 3D
short_description: Embark on a mind-bending journey through 3D puzzles inspired by the cult classic series. Explore unique mechanics and conquer challenging levels in this innovative twist on the original concept.

name: Conquest Reforged
short_description: A Casual Board-style Strategy game with a colorful pixel art Fantasy theme! Deploy units using your available energy, march them across the board and attempt to deal enough damage to your opponent's base to win!

name: KoroNeko
short_description: Relaxing puzzle game, roll your way in a Kawaii world full of Charming characters in a calming journey ahead of you to save your siblings from Strawberry the witch!

name: Emberward
short_description: Build twisting mazes with tetromino blocks and deploy unique towers in this engaging roguelite tower defense game!

name: Fortress Challenge : Fort Boyard
short_description: Return to Fort Boyard and take on the new challenges of Sir Fouras!

name: mole mine rocks 0.15
short_description: Mole Mine Rocks is a clicker game where you manage a mole mining operation. Mine rocks, gather resources, upgrade your abilities, and explore levels. Hire moles for passive income, fix leaks, and interact with dynamic dialogue. Enjoy cutscenes and strategic planning to become a mine manager.

name: Kunkun Terror Express
short_description: You're trapped aboard the endless loop of the Kunkun Terror Express. observe your surroundings and search for items.it's your only hope of escape! But beware: Kunkun might be right behind you! A meme horror game by the creators of 'Exit Kun'.

name: Casino Simulator 2024
short_description: Casino Simulator: Build, manage, and expand your own casino from scratch. Hire staff, design your casino, and delight customers by offering the most popular games. Enjoy the thrill of the casino experience!

name: Anomaly Hunter - Observation Duty
short_description: In Anomaly Hunter - Observation Duty, you're not just a security guard; you're the last line of defense against the unexplained. With only security cameras as your eyes, witness eerie movements and unsettling whispers echoing in the shadows.

name: If you touch me, I will marry you. Pt.1
short_description: “If you touch me, I will marry you.” is an escape room tag game where you can move your character to avoid obstacles and enjoy mini games.

name: Gaiadon: Eternal Quest
short_description: An Epic Incremental RPG

name: Deck of Souls
short_description: Roguelite deck-building meets souls-like. Break out of an infinite loop to close the hell gates, turn enemies into cards, and build your own omnipotent Deck of Souls! Rolls included.

name: Forward Brave
short_description: 《Forward Brave》has no turning back. Choose your hero, explore the program-generated card dungeon, collect resources, kill enemies, combine and match active skills with various special-effect artifacts, make rational use of various props and buffs, move to the next floor, and finally win the victory!

name: Legends of Crystal
short_description: Legends of Crystal is a turn-based RPG that blends two cultures, namely Nusantara and Japan. It tells the story of a child chosen by a god who must save a crystal from evil. The crystal is divided into 6 powers due to the greed of jinns and mythical creatures in the past.

name: Sealed
short_description: Sealed is a horror game that will immerse you in a disturbing and mysterious experience. You will find yourself trapped in a haunted hospital, where every shadow and every whisper will remind you that you are not alone.

name: Asterisk 2: Next -Now a Days-
short_description: 'Asterisk 2: Next Now a Day' is a JRPG created with RPGMaker that blends action elements. It features pixel art graphics, an engaging story, and immersive gameplay. The game offers stunning visuals, compelling characters, and a dynamic world designed to captivate players throughout.

name: Scroll the Pain Away
short_description: Step into the shoes of Indigo, the owner of a small magic shop. Help your customers with a wide variety of problems!

name: Cafe Rosa
short_description: Cafe Rosa is a cafe management simulator. Serve food to unique customers and earn coins. Manage your own cafe by upgrading the facilities and changing the interior. Dive into the world of cafe ownership and watch your business flourish!

name: life is not auto
short_description: 'LIFE IS NOT AUTO'is a rhythm + survival based timing game. You manually control the organs to keep your character alive until life ends.

name: Calculate It
short_description: We've made a calculator roguelike! Yes, it's not a joke. A boring device has turned into an interesting strategy, where each calculator you collect sets its own style of play. Can you count all the numbers and prove who's the king of calculations here?

name: CEO Tycoon: My Game Studio
short_description: Every swipe is a decision, every decision a potential path to glory or downfall. How will you lead?

name: SkyNuggets
short_description: Click to fly and avoid Obstacles, increasing your score.

name: MACHI KORO With Everyone
short_description: 'MACHI KORO With Everyone' is a competitive digital board game. From board game beginners to experts, kids and adults come together!Play online or offline and have a blast!

name: Mini Reaper
short_description: Inspired by classic video game Creepypastas, in Mini Reaper, you'll run, hop, and explore through a fictional retro 3D platformer. Collect lost souls for the Grim Reaper, but be sure to avoid anything that might be haunting the old game.
Embark on a journey of Zen koans in a Buddhist mandala space Reach Nirvana with a 1 in 8192 chance in a mystical world adorned with tombstones and Buddha statues.

name: Love Quiz Battle: LoveLove Quiz
short_description: Honestly, what do I have to lose now that I've lost my job in middle age? So, I dragged my heavy steps to the place the old man mentioned and slowly pushed open the door... 'Welcome to the Love Quiz Battle!'

name: A Witch's Game
short_description: Seeking solace from the hunt of the blasphemed, a witch has made a game of tarot cards. She uses the intentions of her enemies against themselves, redirecting opposing attacks to work in her favor instead.

name: Be Silent
short_description: You got trapped in a garden by something. In order to escape you have to find hints and items - but be silent, something is listening...

name: Grouls
short_description: Uncover the chilling secrets of an abandoned house as Denis. Collect body parts, solve puzzles, and escape terrifying entities. Your choices shape your fate. Can you survive the nightmare?

name: Cube Jumper
short_description: Join in on the fun of tackling different obstacles in each level!

name: Motorbike Simulator MX Driving
short_description: Hit the gas in Motorbike Simulator MX Driving! Equipped with realistic 3D graphics and adrenaline-filled jumps, this game takes you to the top of motorcycle riding. Test your driving skills now!

name: Exorcist: Reviewer of Minds
short_description: Everyone must resist the relentless unfairness with the cards they've been dealt. Use the randomly distributed holy verses to identify the names of the 10 demons. Save 5 people and exorcise the sixth threat lurking in the shadows. This is a compact game of continuous gambles and judgments.

name: SUPER BATTLE POLYCARS
short_description: Hop into the driver's seat in this modern old-school vehicle combat game! Fight for victory alongside your teammates in our Massive Online Vehicle Arena to put your driving skills to the test or spawn into Arena Deathmatch! DRIVE the fastest, DESTROY the competition, and DOMINATE.

name: Non Stop Driver
short_description: If you slow down you die, if you speed up you live!

name: Interregnum: False Prophet
short_description: A tactical, turn-based strategy game in a post-apocalyptic world of eternal winter. As the titular False Prophet, recruit and lead a group of survivors to a promised land. Loot, craft, and make the best of what you find.

name: StickmanQuiz
short_description: 'StickmanQuiz' is a game where players control a stick figure to tackle two-choice quizzes. With three modes and nine challenges, players can test their knowledge across various quizzes. They can also compete against 100 NPC rivals. Aim to clear all challenges!

name: Bad Omens: 8th Apartment
short_description: You play as a student named Lisa, who has just moved in with her university friend. But instead of a carefree student life, Lisa faces events full of despair and fear when she is left alone in her apartment number 8...

name: Infinite Innocence
short_description: Infinite Innocence is a game about finding anomalies, but it is very easy to see them with lighting. What if we give it a little more difficulty and tension? Will you be able to remember everything until the end?

name: Fledge
short_description: Fledge is a 2D platform game in which the player takes on the role of Corentin, a young pigeon who takes flight to find his idol and become, like him, a great explorer. However, this hasty flight is far from a success... Help him make his dream come true!

name: Gugong
short_description: Gugong is a board game with hand management and influence as its core mechanisms. The gift cards you offer as a player have to be of a higher value than the one you receive, forcing you to make strategic choices regarding which actions you want to take each turn.

name: Underwater abyss
short_description: This game immerses you in a lush green forest where sunlight filters through the canopy

name: Control the Ball
short_description: Control the Ball is a fun and addictive game where you play as a boy who is passionate about soccer and loves to make scissors with the ball.

name: ココロワヒメ、おにぎりを届けるの巻　-Kokorowa Onigiri Delivery-
short_description: 'Look over there, it's Sakuna, and she's starving! It's my time to shine!' This is a fan-made puzzle game based on Sakuna: of Rice and Ruin, where you place contraptions on the board to deliver onigiri to Sakuna. There are no real-time elements, so you can play at your own pace and take your time.

name: 青恋
short_description: A campus multi ending pure love game

name: Rota's Nautical Chronicles of Trade
short_description: 'City building' and 'Trade' simulation game by Rota, the princess of the forest country! Rota strives to realize her plan for sea trade with the entire world. Let's greatly develop the port town of Portamare through the production, import and export of goods, and business negotiation battles!

name: Mazed Joseon
short_description: Welcome to the eerie nights of the Joseon Dynasty!Navigate the winding maze of stone walls and find the key to escape!But be careful... if you open what should not be opened while focusing on finding the key...?!

name: Versus GO
short_description: Welcome to Versus GO! Versus GO is a shooter game with a 3rd person camera angle that you can play over Lan or with bots. It is a shooter game where you can compete against your enemies in multiple game modes and game maps.

name: G WARRIOR
short_description: G WARRIOR is a retro hardcore action shooting game. Pick up the gun and destroy all robots and aliens. Fight in colorful scenes such as snowy mountains, caves, seas of fire, alien lairs, etc.! !

name: Catch the dustling
short_description: Due to an experiment gone wrong, dust creatures from a parallel world have appeared in the laboratory. They pose a threat because of their bad temper and their habit of ignoring certain laws of physics

name: Shell Runner
short_description: 2045. Life's never been cheaper. Shells mean you can come back if you have money. You used to. Now you're on the bottom in a cyberpunk sprawl. Claw your way back up through wet work as a Shell Runner, in a PvE extraction looter shooter, where a gig can make you rich - or broke.

name: Zenith Armada
short_description: Embark on interstellar conquest in a 2D space strategy game. Command ships, explore galaxies, engage in real-time battles, and customize your fleet. Traverse hazardous star maps, unlock factions, and strategize for victory. Are you ready to conquer the cosmos?

name: Pennon and Battle
short_description: 'Pennon and Battle' is a turn-based strategy war game. As a lord, you will play a crucial role in the revival of the kingdom! Lead heroes and armies to expand territory in Ruachland,  utilize tactics and magic to eliminate enemy forces, and create your own legend!

name: Stratum Descent
short_description: Stratum Descent: a micro rogue-lite deck builder where you forge customizable cards, navigate through dangerous stratums, and confront powerful stratum lords. Upgrade your character, collect relics, and delve deeper into an ever-challenging journey. How far will you descend?

name: Distant Realm
short_description: Distant Realm is originally an adventure game from 2006, combined with role-playing elements. Now the experience is masterfully redefined.

name: Super Dark Deception
short_description: Death awaits you once again in Super Dark Deception, a fun 2D reimagining of the hit horror maze game, Dark Deception!

name: Escape Memoirs: Safe House
short_description: 'Escape Memoirs: Safe House' is a co-operative reverse escape-room puzzle game. You are a member of a criminal organization who must break into one of their own safe houses to fetch some important tools. Do you think you have what it takes to overcome the puzzles that stand in your way?

name: Feed Da King
short_description: An idle clicker game that features moments of active and passive play, with a dynamic window system that allows you to toggle the game on top of other applications and adjust it to your preference.

name: Dark Daemon
short_description: This is a fantasy themed RPG game. In a dark world, players need to constantly improve their combat power and strategically challenge various monsters and monsters, embarking on an unprecedented adventure journey

name: 病娇X契约
short_description: 当某一天你（张一文）被持有电击器的病娇女孩（杨小露）堵在巷子里告白 是不顾一切逃离还是暂时答应之后另寻它法？

name: Taoism
short_description: Taoism: The Card Game is a rougelike card game inspired by Chinese mythical tales. When evil spirits are all over the space, you’ll explore the mysterious country Luo Nan, use different cards to defeat Taoist priests as well as evil spirits and find the truth of the decline of Luo Nan.

name: Get Rich
short_description: To Be or Not to Be? That is the Question!

name: SPY×ANYA: Operation Memories
short_description: Anya Forger has to create a photo diary! Collect memories at school and other exciting locations. Play with over 15 minigames inspired by the popular manga series! Can you help Anya fill up her photo diary?

name: KunKun dream Startles the Soul
short_description: I know you saw him think of an old friend. Yes, you are already trapped in Kunkuns dream. You need to find a way to escape and avoid these ghosts and animals with your trapped companions. Some ghosts and animals like to play basketball worship chickens, dislike watermelons, and even come and show me

name: Nakamers: La huida
short_description: Escapa del colapso de una civilización que está a punto de extinguirse. Acompaña a Xioon en busca de su familia perdida mientras intentas ponerte a salvo de los desprendimientos y sorteando los ríos de lava. Sumérgete en una historia épica llena de emociones.

name: BigFool
short_description: A small little game where you and your friends have a once in a lifetime opportunity: Hunt BigFool. BigFool is an elusive, fearsome creature of the night from unknown origins. Set in the Crimblr Forest, explore various points of interest, keep an eye and an ear out, and take down this iconic beast.

name: Supernatural
short_description: Detective Wyatt confronts a chilling mystery as he investigates a housemaid's disappearance. Unearth sinister secrets as you navigate through a haunted house, where every shadow hides a lurking terror.

name: Fleeting Iris: Alansya Chronicles Ren'Py Edition
short_description: Ayame travels to Heaven City, USA to be with her fiancée but all is not what it seems. How will Ayame's life unfold in this updated release now built in Ren'Py!

name: Heirs
short_description: Inheritance can be different, and it is not always pleasant, right?

name: Arena Warrior
short_description: Jump, Slide and Wallride your way across a multitude of arenas fighting off waves of enemies using different weapons and movement equipment to survive. Fight epic bosses and gain new abilities to strengthen your run in this fast past rouge-like arena fighter.

name: Realm of the Everbound
short_description: Dive into Realm of the Everbound, a narrative-rich adventure where you awaken in a mystical game world as a sentient pumpkin. Navigate through enchanting dialogues, unravel the mysteries of Alehaven, and seek a path back to reality in this captivating blend of fantasy and intrigue.

name: UFO Sightings Simulator
short_description: UFO Sightings Simulator is a survival mystery game about shooting photos of paranormal phenomena. Take photos, sell them and buy rations, tools, decorations and more, while discovering the island(s)!

name: Soundsaber
short_description: A twin-stick shooter where your music is your weapon. Whichever track you choose will power your engines and your lasers, but beware: your enemies are also driven by the music.

name: Silly Billy
short_description: A horror survival game, where you explore an open-world town set in the Wild West, find and upgrade weapons and vehicles, and use them to beat an evil clown monster named Silly Billy.

name: Alien Outpost
short_description: Alien Outpost an adrenaline-pumping 2.5D twin-stick shooter places you at a remote outpost besieged by relentless waves of alien invaders

name: Brazen Blaze
short_description: Brazen Blaze is a 3v3 Smack & Shoot VR Action game with emphasis on close quarter melee combat! Choose from a range of unique Runners each equipped with individual skills meant to destroy whatever blocks your path to sure victory!

name: Time To Go
short_description: Guide Angus or Lucy through a maze of tunnels in their search for food. Watch out for bad foods and dodge the obstacles in your path.

name: Chinese Online Game
short_description: The player will play the role of an older unmarried young man Lao Wang, because of the lack of money for marriage in thinking of ways to accidentally be attracted by the pop-up ads of an online game endorsed by a certain celebrity, and the gears of destiny began to turn at that moment.

name: Candy Golf
short_description: Minigolf game. 3 different levels with totally 42 holes. Play alone or against bots

name: The Mobius: Apartment
short_description: In a eerie apartment, explore and discover anomalies, find the rules,seeking the correct Floor and Exit of The Mobius Apartment.

name: Bedrotting
short_description: This game is about bed rotting. You lie in the bed for 20 days trying to survive.

name: The Heights
short_description: The heights is a story based first-person single-player action puzzle game. Shoot and climb to the top of the skyscraper whilst avoiding assured death. Solve puzzles to proceed to the next floor. Destroy all research and eliminate the CEO to save the future from doom.

name: SWARM 2
short_description: Swarm 2 is a roguelike shooter built VR with a unique movement mechanic, global leaderboards, and weekly challenges. Endlessly replayable and infinitely challenging. It's like Spider-Man with Guns!

name: Rogue Citadel
short_description: Unlock new defences, collect powerful items and create game-breaking synergies in this roguelite tower defence survivors game. Will you conquer the citadel's ever-shifting challenges and emerge victorious, or succumb to its sinister temptations?

name: IRIS
short_description: IRIS is a psychological horror game with PS2-era graphics. Players navigate a young woman's dream world, confronting symbolic monsters representing her past traumas like poverty, bulimia, bullying, and loneliness. It emphasizes the pursuit of happiness amidst life's struggles.

name: Enelia: Dawn of Madness
short_description: Immerse yourself in the enigmatic world of Nauris, where enchanting landscapes hide terrifying secrets: the strange behavior of elders, sinister rituals of priests, and the disappearance of citizens. Madness lurks everywhere – will you master it or become its victim? The choice is yours.

name: Bule Form
short_description: 《蓝色形态(Bule Form)》是一款BL向角色扮演。以都市为主要活动地点，在都市与战区之间辗转。在战斗中打败你的敌人，探索地图破解机关谜题推进剧情发展。

name: PPA Pickleball Tour 2025
short_description: Play pickleball with the PPA Tour pros in the most advanced pickleball game ever!

name: Drinks Down Under
short_description: “Drinks Down Under” is a Cozy Bartending Game where you bring an old bar back to life! Explore strange ingredients, talk with unusual customers and survive to see another day in The Underground.

name: Hypothetimania
short_description: Inspired by 2D classic platforming games, Hypothetimania is a game that is about speed platforming with only a couple things in mind: collect everything and get to the end as quickly as possible. The faster you are, the better your score.

name: The Dragonhood
short_description: The Dragonhood is a clicker RPG with roguelite elements and automatic battles. Collect eggs, hatch dragons, and loot stuff on a variety of 1 vs 1 adventures or 3 vs 3 dungeons. Complete quests and build your dragons the way you want with various evolutions, abilities, amulets, and more!

name: Baimason's Thing Finder Puzzle
short_description: This is a small and relaxing game in which you have to find objects made with pixels, within levels made with those same objects! Each level is unique, adorable and procedural, allowing you to play your favorite levels infinitely.

name: The Tunnels of Saint Mercy Road
short_description: The Tunnels of Saint Mercy Road is an immersive horror experience that spans 4 unique areas, each providing a sense of unease and a new mystery to unravel.

name: Wooden Battles: Spec Ops
short_description: Wooden Battles: Spec Ops is a stealth action strategy game. Take control of a group of 4 special forces units with unique abilities, infiltrate the enemy base and complete the mission objectives. Use the in-game level editor to create your own missions and upload them to the Steam Workshop.

name: Fallen Leaf
short_description: Fallen Leaf is a retro side-scrolling adventure focused on tight, action-packed level design set in a whimsical world where almost anything goes!

name: LUNA'S EYES
short_description: A first-person horror adventure set in a red-tinted otherworld. Use clues from Luna the cat to escape from the otherworldly house.

name: Parkour Labs
short_description: Are you good at parkour video games? Are you number 1 in surfing mode? This is your game, welcome to Parkour Labs, an experience that will test your skills.

name: SpinGhost
short_description: In this score-based game, control a runner on a rotating ring. Dodge obstacles by switching edges with a click or space bar. Face gimmicks and increasing speed over time. The spinning camera adds complexity. Quick decisions lead to high scores.

name: Nephilim Resurrection
short_description: Embark on a furious journey, protecting precious cargo in a perilous world. Boomer shooter mechanics blend with puzzles and strategic encounters. Engage in PvE action, solve puzzles, and battle foes to a heavy metal soundtrack, immersing you in the adrenaline-fueled atmosphere.

name: Buccaneer
short_description: BUCCANEER is a 17th-century Caribbean 3D adventure that blends high-seas combat with resource management. Opt for combat-only, engage in ship-to-ship battles or lead crew boardings. Dive into the buccaneer world through campaigns. Plunder, negotiate, survive, and live to tell the tale!

name: GUNCHO
short_description: In this small scale, turn based tactics game, you spin Guncho's revolver cylinder to keep his bullets aligned to enemies. Fight your way through randomly generated shootouts. Upgrade your bullets and use tactical abilities to defeat your foes. Ride your donkey and become the ultimate Pistolero.

name: Cyber Clutch: Hot Import Nights
short_description: Immerse in a multiplayer world where high-speed racing blends with intense vehicle combat. Choose from a variety of uniquely armed cars for strategic battles across vivid cyberpunk cities, focusing on skillful driving and deep customization.

name: Gestalt: Steam & Cinder
short_description: Inspired by 16 and 32-bit classics, Gestalt: Steam & Cinder fuses tight 2D platforming and exhilarating combat with an engrossing, twist-laden narrative in a stunningly handcrafted steampunk world.

name: Odd Night
short_description: You're stuck in an endlessly looping hallway, but every time you enter it, something seems to be different. Try to spot everything that isn't supposed to be there, but most of all, make sure to get out alive.

name: Get To The Top
short_description: It's a difficult game about a man with hooks.

name: Island Ops
short_description: 'Make the leap; dive into Island Ops! Unexpected obstacles await. Overcome them as the skilled secret agent, Blade. The secrets of hidden experiments and genetic mutations lie waiting to be discovered. Are you ready for an action-packed adventure?'

name: Entombed
short_description: You wake up in the middle of the night. The lights are all off and something feels off. You grab your flashlight and try to figure out the source of this anomaly. However, you grow hungry and head to the kitchen where things start to go horribly wrong.

name: Dojo Masters
short_description: DOJO MASTERS is a 2-button martial arts indie fighting game. Battle against your friends or head online to challenge warriors from around the world!

name: Hello World
short_description: You have strayed into the world of computer! ? During the exploration, you will have a series of interesting interactions with folders, garbage files, Word documents, PowerPoint documents, Excel documents, anti-virus software, blinking cursors while typing and even binary 0 and 1 in computer!

name: 恋爱单选题
short_description: Male Lord Wu worry because of an accident dying, fell into a coma. Then the mysterious female NPC appeared, creating a different space for Wu Worry to create a chance to save themselves, the protagonist of the game Wu Worry to find out his true love in the end, in order to wake up and survive.

name: B-PROJECT RYUSEI*FANTASIA
short_description: Become the A&R of the famous B-Project in this unforgettable idol Visual Novel. Support a group of 14 idols from their humble beginnings through to fame. Befriend them, influence their music and help them through turbulent times as they follow their dreams

name: Life as a Lich
short_description: Embrace lichdom: research powerful spells, recruit undead legions, manage your domains, rule the underworld, and become a demigod!

name: Steel Warrior
short_description: Evil company Morning shift studios army has captured Steel warrior birthday cake. Steel warrior need revenge for his army and find all 6 cakes

name: R-Space
short_description: R-Space is a fast-paced first-person shooting game that supports up to 4 people online. Players need to survive round after round of trials, continuously strengthen their abilities, and challenge higher rounds.

name: Fire Thief
short_description: Twin-stick action fire fighting game. Extinguish fires, rescue citizens, and protect property... at least until you steal it. Sneak past other fire fighters and police to sell your stolen loot while trying to keep the fire under control.

name: Spotless
short_description: Clean, Clash, and Collect across the crummiest corners of this Single-Player Rogue-Lite. Spend your meager earnings wisely on both permanent and temporary upgrades, so that even the thriving haunts of cute and creepy creatures can’t stop you from cleaning until everything is Spotless!

name: Anchored Hearts: A Tale of Destiny
short_description: A pirate on the run, La Belladonna must escape imprisonment and prove her innocence in this roguelite adventure-meets-romance novel! Navigate wild waters, fight enemy ships, and decide to whom you’ll give your heart. Through narrative choices, unravel the truth behind your cursed fate!

name: Trade And Fight
short_description: Explore, trade with towns and villages, and fight enemies.

name: Gems Of Evolution
short_description: Gems of Evolution is a top-down action roguelite featuring 4 elements, 4 races and 4 classes. Choose your unique hero from diverse combinations like Human-Warrior-Fire. Fight, make various builds with skills, items and evolutions and try to survive 30 wave!

name: Split Personality Doctor
short_description: A doctor who suddenly gains the ability to shrink his body enters the patient’s body to treat them.

name: The Curse of Elmwood
short_description: You hear quiet whispers from deep inside the house, but no one sees. You begin to feel that you are not alone in this house. Curse of Elmwood is an atmospheric horror where you find yourself trapped in a gloomy 18th century mansion, steeped in mystery and horror.

name: Shahmaran
short_description: Kingdom's ruler falls gravely ill and for the cure the Vizier revealing his true side as the evil sorcerer conjures a spell to summon vile creatures to assail Shahmaran for obtaining her flesh. Shahmaran and her helper friend Jamsab must defeat the evil sorcerer.

name: Versus Dev
short_description: Explore, evolve and take on the developer.

name: Zany Golf
