short_description: Nine of the craziest holes you've ever seen...Each one like a separate arcade game... Featuring Individual music tracks, rich animated background graphics and a host of very unusual obstacles.

name: Melo's cat cafe
short_description: 'Melo's Cat Cafe' is the perfect game for players who want to relax in a stress-free environment. Instead of chasing goals, players can simply enjoy spending time with the cats. Observe the cats as they eat and sleep, and find peace of mind in their calm presence.

name: Trial Traction
short_description: Jump onto your cross bike and drive along a trail filled with many obstacles and humps to overcome!

name: Frogun Encore
short_description: Frogun ENCORE is a dashing standalone expansion/sequel to indie hit FROGUN! Join now older Renata and Jake in a trek around the whole world to prevent the return of Beelzebub. ENCORE builds on FROGUN's retro PS1/N64 formula. Plus, enjoy the whole adventure in true couch co-op.

name: Fuse The Bomb
short_description: A reverse arcade where you have to make bombs and prevent the special forces from defusing it. Make life difficult for the special forces by making them play mini-games.

name: Don't Let It Die
short_description: As the first tribe to discover fire, master its creation amidst prehistoric survival challenges. Synergize 17+ unique characters, items, and strategize to ignite your legacy and secure humanity's dawn. A quest for fire's mastery awaits those with the will to not only survive, but thrive.

name: Space Order Mine
short_description: Turn-based strategy roguelike ​game combining reverse minesweeper with inventory management. Collect items, organize inventory, mine for energy and vanquish your foes!

name: House of Cards: TD
short_description: A game where you must defend against robots that came from the future and want to destroy all of humanity. You must use various strategies and characters to survive this time-traveling adventure! Are you ready to join this adventure?

name: Alcoholic Daddy
short_description: In this 2D arcade racing game, take on the role of a father who must complete a simple but important mission - to deliver his beloved dog to his daughter. However, the task is complicated by the fact that the father has had a bit too much to drink.

name: Silent Breach
short_description: A short cosmic horror game where you remotely operate a land rover through an unknown planet labeled the silent zone.

name: Burkina Faso: Radical Insurgency
short_description: BF:RI Is a Hardcore Tactical Shooter depicting the ongoing Burkina Faso Insurgency. You are CIA Special Operations Group tasked with hunting down ISIS insurgents

name: Eternal Fighters
short_description: Dive into Eternal Fighters, a fast-paced 2D fighting game that blends classic arcade action with modern dynamics. Choose from a roster of ninjas and warriors, each with unique abilities, and master modes like Arcade, VS, and Online. Prove your skills and become the ultimate Eternal Champion!

name: Ostallian Core
short_description: A modern omnidirectional space shooter with colorful retro-style ASCII art and light RPG elements, featuring optional permadeath.

name: The Tomb of Corruption
short_description: Explore procedurally generated dungeons and slash hordes of monsters in THE TOMB OF CORRUPTION! - A 3D action RPG with rogue-lite elements. Fully customize your melee and ranged weapon with hundreds of upgrades, unlock skills, upgrade your armor and get ready to enter the voxel dungeon!

name: Over Clock
short_description: 'Over Clock' is an innovative adventure game that combines puzzles and exploration. Players place blocks and delve deep underground aiming for the 100th line. Experience different terrains in each stage, collect materials to develop new skills. Strategy and speed are the keys to success.

name: Corvos Dynasty
short_description: Build your heroes, loot the kingdom, and discover rare treasures. Corvos Dynasty is an RPG inspired by old-school classics. Will you be the legendary hero who saves the princess or the conquerer who burns the monarchy to the ground?

name: BABAVA's Playspace
short_description: BABAVA's Playspace is a horror puzzle adventure game. In your search for the answer you will have to go through puzzles, difficult moral choices and slip past monsters lurking in the shadows. Are you ready to play outside the rules and win?

name: Stair Tower
short_description: This is a vertical platform game: climb the terrible tower and reach the top to make your wish come true. More than 16 horizontal levels medium-high difficulty Variety of settings

name: MonCon
short_description: Plunge headlong into MonCon, a surreal convention teeming with social monsters, where your conversation skills must be sharpened in order to survive.

name: Centauri's Favourite Archer
short_description: Ten years after the events of the Albino Hunter™, Aline Andrews lives a quiet life in Centauri along with her brother's family. But, when her brother's pregnant wife gets sick with an unknown illness, Aline must journey outside her comfort zone and face the perils of rest of the world...

name: Pixel Dash
short_description: Run, jump and dash in this fast-paced platformer inspired by Celeste and Neon white, where even the non-speedrunners can feel the thrill of a good run.

name: Anger Foot
short_description: Anger Foot is a lightning fast action FPS where the only things harder than your ass kicking feet are the ass kicking beats.

name: Space Shooter
short_description: Welcome aboard! Here, we gain points by destroying meteors. Try your best to destroy as many as you can and avoid destroying our ship! This is a wave-type game, where the more you play, the more difficult the game becomes!

name: Teeny Tiny Town
short_description: Proving that all good things come in threes! Welcome to Teeny Tiny Town, where you connect three identical tiles to evolve your city, merge by merge. Watch your metropolis grow from scratch, from 'aww' to 'awesome!'

name: Escape From Clive
short_description: Escape From Clive is a simulated real war evacuation computer game. Successfully evacuating to safety zone is your ultimate goal. Players would go into the Clive and come back with fruitful supplies. Remember that if you are ambushed, you will lose everything.

name: Urban
short_description: Urban is a horror game based on the Japanese legend of the 8-foot-tall spirit. Players explore an abandoned village haunted by Hachishaku-sama spirit, surviving encounters to uncover its dark secrets. Can you escape from Hachishaku-sama in Urban?

name: Angelstruck
short_description: Angelstruck is a 2D roguelite shooter where you demolish the forces of Heaven as you attempt to reach the pearly gates. Overcharge your holy rifle, and min-max your way into insane game-breaking builds. Unlock permanent capabilities and powerful screen-destroying weapons that feed on kills.

name: The Nine Tailed Celestial Fox
short_description: It's a sandbox cultivation game where players recruit and train talents, build their own homesteads, practice alchemy and crafting, battle monsters and collect materials. The combat mode features automatic side-scrolling battles with companions, meanwhile player can decide cards to execute attacks.

name: Harold's Walk
short_description: Harold's Walk on Steam is a remaster of the original Harold's Walk game that debuted on the Nintendo 3ds in 2020. Odd and unusual spaces comprise most of your journey as you venture through this surreal collectathon.

name: Unclogged
short_description: Unclogged is a puzzle horror escape game. Collect items, solve puzzles, unclog the toilet, and hopefully make an escape.

name: NEKO-NIN exHeart SPIN!
short_description: Kikumaru's life was fairly normal until a gun wielding catgirl appears during his grandfather's funeral. Even his little sister suddenly sprouts tanuki-ears! A beautiful woman (with cat ears as well) comes to his rescue. The curtain rises on the latest chapter in the NEKO-NIN exHeart series. Nin!

name: Run, Run at Marathon!
short_description: Get ready to immerse yourself in the adrenaline-pumping world of 'Run, Run at Marathon!'

name: Quack Invasion
short_description: Pilot mechs as you slaughter hordes of a diverse cast of alien quacks in this survival roguelike. Build your arsenal from a variety of mechs, power ups and items to survive in ever-changing scenarios.

name: Riven
short_description: Uncover a story of intrigue, betrayal, and a civilization teetering on the brink of collapse as you solve intricate puzzles to unlock the secrets of Riven. Built from the ground-up and expanded from the award-winning original game released in 1997.

name: Hydrogen
short_description: Enter a post-apocalyptic Sci-Fi world in 'Hydrogen,' a thrilling Roguelite ARPG. Navigate through procedurally generated instances, each playthrough offering unique challenges, random items, and perks to level up your character.

name: EvilVEvil
short_description: Live out your ultimate vampire power fantasy as you carve, bite, and shoot a path through evil in this action-packed blood-thirsty co-op shooter.

name: Survivor in the Forest 2
short_description: Survivor in the Forest 2 is a 3D puzzle adventure game with clicker elements. Meet the continuation of the first part of the adventure game. You returned home, but something strange happened.

name: Strategic Command WWII: War in the Pacific
short_description: Strategic Command WWII: War in the Pacific is a turn-based strategy game. It offers a comprehensive experience of the Pacific Theater, challenging you to achieve victory in one of history's greatest conflicts.

name: Stolen Hearts: Wolf Knight
short_description: Stolen Hearts: Wolf Knight is an action precision platformer. Dash through challenging obstacles. Take powers of the enemies. Discover hidden secrets. Find the lost Hearts and guide them safely home. Defeat the Wolf King and his minions. Collect fireflies for character customizations along the way.

name: Railink
short_description: Railink takes you on a colorful puzzle/strategy adventure across deserts, icescapes and everything in between. Your job is to link up the remote Railink inhabitants to the rail network, one house at a time. Along the way you will face steep cliffs, vast waterways and tall mountains.

name: Songs of Steel: Hispania
short_description: Relive the conflict between the mighty Roman Republic and the brave Celtiberian people of Numantia! Featuring hand-drawn illustrations, classic turn-based strategy mechanics, and combat tactics, with decision-making and side missions.

name: Love Letter
short_description: Move the love letter, collect the sweet words scattered around the classroom, and send your feelings to that girl! Love letter creation love simulation action game “LoveLetter”

name: OUTBRK
short_description: Storm Chasing Simulator

name: Black light wave
short_description: This is a casual and relaxing game based on the classic fable of a turtle and rabbit race

name: The Crust
short_description: Automate a lunar base as you become the savior of humanity exploring the future on the moon. Mine, craft, research, and trade resources with Earth in this gripping narrative basebuilder.

name: BLOWFLY2:OVERLIMIT
short_description: 'BLOWFLY2:OVERLIMIT'is a superhero-style platform action game. Use the protagonist's unique abilities to explore and collect pink POOBABYs in the map. This time, you will go deep into the enemy's lair and challenge more powerful levels and enemies! Blowfly! flight! Dash!

name: 4D Games
short_description: 4D Shapes, 4D Chess and 4D Mazes!? Take a deep dive into the world of Four Dimensions, with more control than ever before!

name: YEAH! YOU WANT "THOSE GAMES," RIGHT? SO HERE YOU GO! NOW, LET'S SEE YOU CLEAR THEM! 2
short_description: 'Those Games' are back! Play through familiar minigames to your heart's content! Take on five different minigames with a total of 250 stages! Sit back and play fully, thoroughly, and enjoyably!

name: fishTDX
short_description: Buy towers and discover new islands as you prepare your defenses against waves of fish! Unlock new towers and affixes after each round with new play styles and new synergies. Build your defenses and experiment to create the ultimate fishing machine!

name: CHURIP
short_description: 'CHURIP' is a horror adventure game set in modern times. On the day of the funeral, her casket was beautifully adorned with many flowers. She often appears in my dreams as she was when she was alive.

name: You Have To Climb Out
short_description: A short narrative puzzle experience about a lost frog who has dug too far into the sand during a beach day. Use your trusty shovel to move blocks and create paths for you to continue upward.

name: Towerheart
short_description: Towerheart is a simple sokoban-style puzzle game where you can swap with objects.

name: GachaPon!
short_description: In GachaPon!, your mission is to drop colorful capsules into the case and fuse them together, all in pursuit of creating the legendary Rainbow Gacha. Over thirty enchanting keychains, offering a unique twist to your gameplay! GachaPon! lets you customize your experience with endless possibilities.

name: Survival Mission Z
short_description: Loot and shoot in this action-oriented adventure set in a zombie apocalypse. Acquire different guns, explore various locations and interact with other survivors on your mission towards a better future.

name: I Am Part-time Worker!!
short_description: This is an action-comedy game where you work part-time at a convenience store register while taking down troublesome 'nuisance customers.'

name: Descending The Woods
short_description: By day, tend to your farm, care for your pets, and explore the mysteries of the haunted woods. By nightfall, They will come from the woods, Beware of ghosts and demons of the haunted woods. Hide, Survive, Build, Fight and Explore in this eerie Survival Horror alone or with friends.

name: 巧|合/co|incidence
short_description: 'co|incidence' is a FVN produced for Renpy.

name: Cursed Labyrinth Redux
short_description: Incomparable deck building new type hack & slash card battle game is reborn! ■New Type Hack & Slash Card Battle with Curse Magic ■Simple to play ■Create Your Own Strategy by Deck Building ■Freely Grow Skill System and Release Job Skill ■Dungeon with Unique Enemies

name: JudgeSim
short_description: Things were worse than ever in Banana Republic, a somber island country. While anarchists roamed the streets, corruption was running deeper due to economic crisis and rising crime rates. Bearing these burdens were 'judges' who tried to make things right with honesty...

name: Flock
short_description: Flock is a multiplayer co-op game about the joy of flight and collecting adorable flying creatures with your friends. Soar through beautiful landscapes, seeking out rare and elusive creatures to add to your flock.

name: Blenderman
short_description: Blender would love to have you for dinner. Dinner is served at 6 o' clock. You have until then to escape.

name: Normal Days
short_description: Sometimes you encounter anomalies. Find them or none and react correctly to go back to normal days.

name: 相亲攻略之宝贝别再选我了
short_description: 《相亲攻略：宝贝别再选我了》是一款恋爱模拟的真人互动影像游戏，讲述关于“你”的相亲故事。 从接到母亲电话开始，你踏上相亲之旅，和你预想的不一样，苦恼的事情并不是如何找到一个对象，而是……这么多对象该带哪一个回家。

name: 呪巣 -学校の怪談-
short_description: THE JUSOU Series, known as the scariest smartphone escape game ever, is finally available on Steam! A steady stream of people have given up on completing the game because it was too scary! Extremely horror and scares have caused the horror infection to spread in X (Twitter) and live videos!

name: Governor of the West
short_description: Governor of the West is a turn-based game of exploration, resource management, and outlaw placement set in the Old West. Choose a starting character, explore the West, recruit your gang, build up your town, and maybe -- if you play your cards right -- become the Governor!

name: Inevitable Light
short_description: Survive and explore the vast and brutal desert of the INEVITABLE LIGHT. Shelter-in during sand storms, make fire during freezing nights, walk in the shade on boiling hot days, and most of all, stay away from the hyenas. Think through your next move. Resources are scarce. Death is inevitable.

name: Sweet Home 2: Look and Find Collector's Edition
short_description: Avi Games presents another cozy collection of hidden-object fun with Sweet Home 2: Look and Find Collector's Edition! Grab a warm blanket and get comfortable for more object-seeking and puzzle-solving in the fun first sequel in the series that proves that home is where the heart is!

name: Man I Just Wanna Go Home
short_description: Man I Just Wanna Go Home is an 'MSPaint-noir' visual novel with 13 endings, a unique visual style and a killer 80s inspired soundtrack. The story revolves around a delivery person stranded in an unfamiliar part of the city under the devastating rain. All he wants is to get home. Help him!

name: Best Mayor
short_description: As the new mayor of the island, you need to manage the island's regional planning reasonably to help the island get rid of difficulties and repay the huge bank loan. A variety of rich cards, terrains, and blessings will give you different challenges in every game!

name: NightGhast
short_description: NIGHTGHAST is a first-person horror game about wicked witches and sinister widows...

name: Time Treker
short_description: Choose your pilot and build your own custom mecha with 10+ weapons and 15+ attachments, then jump to the battlefield against hundreds of enemies to save spacetime itself in this thrilling sci-fi bullet heaven!

name: The Last Alchemist
short_description: Master the wonders of alchemy! Solve alchemical puzzles by transforming and combining Essences. Craft items, tools and machines. Explore the enchanting world, gather peculiar resources, and befriend the Agari, adorable mushroom folk who will help you find the cure for your mysterious disease.

name: Ball In The Box
short_description: Move platforms to get the ball into the box in a challenging minimalist physics puzzle

name: Rogue Ascent VR
short_description: Save the World with Finger Guns! Rogue Ascent VR is an electrifying roguelike shooter with a strong sci-fi aesthetics. Featuring full controller support!

name: One Night With Kawaii
short_description: Run and hide! Find a way out before she catches you.

name: Encounters: Music Stories
short_description: Two-handed casual music rhythm game with cute characters.

name: The Darkest Paths: The House
short_description: The Darkest Paths - The House is a Psychological Horror Game in which you slip into shoes of Michael Holster, a journalist going back to his old hometown, Ravens Hollow, to investigate weird and mysterious cases, hoping to get fame, money, and maybe even closure.

name: Food Fight: Culinary Combat
short_description: Get ready to splat, splash, and spill as you mess it up with friends in this family-friendly shooter! Customize your character, chat it up with iconic Atari characters, and blast your way to claim the cone in this reimagined classic!

name: ElderGods Simulator
short_description: 'ElderGods Simulator' combines auto chess and rogue-lite elements. Play as a resurrected dark god, recruiting followers and captives to build and upgrade relics. With randomly generated allies and enemies, freely mix transcendent materials to enhance relics and create unique skills and legions.

name: The Mystic Fortune
short_description: The Mystic Fortune - a captivating narrative 3D game set in an enchanting magical forest! Immerse yourself in a world of mystery and wonder as you interact with four unique characters. Embark on side quests that enrich your journey and unveil the hidden depths of the forest

name: Game of Gods
short_description: Create your own religion and battle for domination of Earth's souls. Collect souls to upgrade your religion and battle other religions to control more territory and expand. Evolve your religion to higher states and dominate earth's souls to create your own utopia here on planet earth!

name: Nihiland
short_description: Have you ever felt the Nihility? A feeling that everything is meaningless and feeling down because of it... Come to Nihiland to relax and meditate and hopefully you will have all the answers.

name: Station Zeta
short_description: Run, jump, shoot, and think your way to safety in this retro-inspired 2D puzzle-platformer. Station Zeta is out of control, and you'll have to deal with crazed robots, terribly designed station machinery, and blatant safety hazards as you try to make your escape across 35 levels.

name: Souvenirs
short_description: Explore a house in search of Leonardo's memories. Souvenirs is a merge like strategy game, created by a tiny independent French studio.

name: Cosmic Mirage
short_description: Welcome to the exciting universe of Cosmic Mirage, where incredible space battles await you. Free the captured planets from the dark forces of the galactic conquerors.

name: Technoblade The Quest Of L'Manburg
short_description: 10% of the profit of this game will be donated to Cancer Research.

name: LATEST ISSUE
short_description: LATEST ISSUE is a psychological horror in which the protagonist has to descend into underground tunnels to disprove or confirm sinister rumors about the place.

name: Project Soulflow
short_description: Survival horror game where you try to escape a monster that is chasing you, try and escape in the shortest time possible

name: The Day Of Survival
short_description: The Day Of Survival Immerse yourself in a post-apocalyptic world where every decision is crucial. 'The Day Of Survival' is a thrilling survival game that challenges players to explore a harsh, unforgiving landscape filled with zombies and enemy soldiers.

name: Crossedland
short_description: Crossedland = Take a box made of blended sci-fi and fantasy with souls-lite combat and base-building. Throw in some villagers to recruit, extraction arenas, gameshows, and an audience judging each action and move you make. Then you wrap it in some nice action RPG paper and top it with a goofy bow.

name: 北宋风云
short_description: A real-time strategy game based on the history of the Northern Song Dynasty. The player can experience the fun of conquering cities, directing the country, and ultimately uniting the world through their own efforts in the simulated historical background of the game!

name: Vorago
short_description: Welcome to the Oracle-Fields. You are AL-1, a droid tasked with assisting research across space stations on the edge of the galaxy. But now, the 'Time-Event' has changed something. Everyone has disappeared. Locate the others. Face the horrors of space. Solve puzzles. Find your way home.

name: Lost Hope: Prologue
short_description: The main character is an amateur journalist who sets out alone to collect materials about the bloodiest estate in the darkest depths of the forest, putting his own life on the line.

name: Résop Paz Yandere True ( Rpyt ) ( R-pyt ) ( Resop Paz )
short_description: Cute horror choice game with a lot of varied gameplay, from bloody battles to platforms. Come break the fourth wall that separates us! Choices that have real impacts, charming characters, a blend of retro and realistic video games. Come meet Résop and Paz.

name: Dead for Dread
short_description: Dead for Dread is an exciting game in which you take on the role of a brave hero who goes into the dark labyrinths to retrieve a stolen artifact. Embark on a dangerous journey through mysterious dungeons full of mysteries and sinister creatures.

name: Starters Orders Touch Horse Racing
short_description: Starters Orders Touch now on desktop from www.startersorders.com! A brand new GUI and improved game play and the most advanced simulation engine to date cement Starters Orders as the No.1. horse racing management series.

name: Wine Hunt: Aim Fidelity
short_description: Wine Hunt: Aim Fidelity is a thrilling blend of aiming and memory training, infused with elements of dodgeball. Test your skills in scenarios like survival and dominate the leaderboards!

You wake up with a bad hangover and don’t recognize your home. You see a boy and you understand... that something is wrong with him. Someone's presence causes anxiety, fear and is about to plunge you into the realm of horror. But you don’t lose hope and try to get out of this nightmare.

name: Cthulhu Mythos ADV The Isle Of Ubohoth
short_description: A horror dice roll adventure inspired by the Cthulhu Mythos. Much like in a tabletop RPG, 'abilities,' 'luck,' and 'dice rolls' influence the story's progression. The protagonist is cursed on an island in the Seto Inland Sea. Investigate the island, uncover the mysteries, and break the curse!

name: Terres
short_description: Terres is a 4 player co-op horror game. Our agents reported something went wrong at a certain facility. Your team were appointed to investigate the area and complete the given objectives. Be careful and do not leave any Terres personnel behind. It is not easy to train a Terres staff.

name: Dungeons of Hinterberg
short_description: Armed with a sword and a tourist guide, explore the beautiful alpine village of Hinterberg and uncover the magic hidden within its dungeons! Master magic, solve puzzles, slay monsters; all this and more await you in Hinterberg!

name: Terro Eliminator
short_description: **Terro Eliminator: New Terrorist Tension Alert!**

name: Dokkalfheim Magical University
short_description: University life has never been so magical! Recruit friends, complete story quests, upgrade your equipment and skills, decorate your dorm and so much more! This exciting saga will satiate your desires for witchy themes, turned based battles and side missions!!

name: Artificial Gravity Cat
short_description: 2D physics platformer! Control a cat in space and gravity itself!

name: SuperSpec Rallycross
short_description: SuperSpec Rallycross is a classic top-down racer. Big jumps, joker laps, authentic action.

name: Itsy
short_description: Itsy is a heart tug the length of a bus ride. A narrative climb up the waterspout about the struggles of Autism-burnout. Play for story (progress saves), or endlessly & conquer the leaderboard. You ever felt endlessly stuck? So has the Itsy Bitsy Spider. Together, can you both help him out of it?

name: State Your Business
short_description: Play the role of white house security officer, check visitors for discrephancies by inspecting documents, interviewing, frisking and searching vehicles. Take care of dignitaries. Earn salary, upgrade skills and materials, level up your security rank to keep the president and the white house safe.

name: Dungeon World
short_description: Dungeon World mixes roguelike and sandbox elements while keeping simple gameplay and retro style. Explore procedural worlds, plan your journey, make a family, modify the lands, get old and reincarnate with more world knowledge.

name: Candy & Toys Store Simulator
short_description: Run your own candy and toys store. Place online orders for supplies, receive them via delivery truck, stock shelves, set prices, take payments, expand, and design your store. Hiring staff and dealing with shoplifters are upcoming.

name: SpaceFire Fury
short_description: Take control of a powerful spaceship, face relentless waves of cosmic enemies, and battle colossal bosses in this intense, action shoot-'em-up. Use unique powerups, and save the galaxy in SpaceFire Fury.

name: Until Then
short_description: A fateful meeting sets off a chain reaction, upending Mark's life. People disappear and memories prove unreliable. Uncover a hidden truth with Mark and his friends in this narrative adventure and race to unravel the mystery before it's too late.

name: 异世界模拟器
short_description: 《异世界模拟器》是一款模拟人生轨迹的游戏 游戏玩法为扮演各个不同降生于异世界的人。从呱呱坠地到上学工作，或是斩妖除魔结婚生子死去中途或开始都伴随着各种即死事件，请用尽全力活到善终

name: Squirrels Forest Race
short_description: Exciting arcade racing game, inspired by the classic Diddy Kong Racing, from the 90s and the graphics of Nintendo 64 games! 6 squirrels need to find the Golden Nuts and get them back. To do so, they must win the Most Fantastic Races ever seen!

name: Lizard Quest!
short_description: Crawl into the ultimate co-op RPG lizard simulator, set in a variety of lush environments ranging from beautiful jungle rainforests to harsh dry savannahs. Grow your lizard to incredible sizes while honing your platforming skills to become the ultimate lizard!

name: Knightess
short_description: Anastasia, Artemisia & Lozen, three mercenaries who roam the Kingdom' looking for work, are seen by the King as the possible solution to keep the peace, even if only temporally. Join the three of them, as they journey in what will become a path of discovery, friendship and betrayal.

name: Spiritoké
short_description: A roguelite turn-based rpg. Gather mystical treasures to power up your party and engage in battle with monsters that become stronger with every step within a dungeon! Each character has unique abilities to dominate the battlefield, growing in strength as the journey continues!

name: Somnium Tenebris
short_description: Somnium Tenebris is a 5-player, investigative horror game set in a Lovecraftian world. Explore the depths of the ocean with your team as you uncover evidence in your efforts to identify the megalithic creature... and escape before it's too late.

name: Trio Tactics TD
short_description: Dive into our exciting Tower Defense game! Choose from three unique towers and utilize specialized skill trees and powerful abilities. Develop your strategy, defeat various enemies, and become the ultimate defense strategist!

name: Hexpire
short_description: Hexpire is a relaxing city builder where you build a prosperous empire by careful building placement.

name: Restore, Reflect, Retry
short_description: A haunting horror text-based game.

name: Jenga Cat
short_description: Cat on Jenga tower - land it softly! Click Jenga pieces to collapse tower with cat on top - gently to the ground! Remove pieces with greater height difference from cat for higher scores. Clear target score to safely land the cat and win!

name: Princess Maker 2 Regeneration
short_description: Dad, it's time to start our journey together! Princess Maker 2 is a simulation-style childcare game where you experience raising a daughter gifted to you by the stars.

name: Old Coin Pusher Friends 3
short_description: In this installment, there is a Sugoroku themed around the old Japan, with various events triggered by the squares you land on. Work together with other players to defeat yokai, and aim for the jackpot. As you progress in the game, you can enhance your abilities with various upgrades.

name: Cubicatch
short_description: Cubicatch is a puzzle game where you navigate a mind-bending world as a cube, shifting between 2D and 3D, and use the properties of different blocks to solve intricate puzzles! Discover and master different mechanics in this unique and challenging puzzle game.

name: Été
short_description: Été (summer) is a relaxing painting game set in Montréal. Color the city to explore, create artworks on canvas, collect stamps in your album, decorate your studio, fulfill commissions from your neighbors, and unleash your inner artist!

name: 女神試煉 Quest of Goddess
short_description: 《女神試煉》是一款闔家歡樂的輕度格鬥休閒派對遊戲，提供最多四人的離線與線上對戰，同時也是台灣動漫品牌《九藏喵窩》的第一款全3D遊戲。本作描述亞甸大陸的喵喵們為了完成回收亞威寶石的任務，必須召開格鬥大賽決定出一位「最強者」，才有資格碰觸寶石。

name: Escape From Castle Frankenstein
short_description: Escape from Castle Frankenstein is a thrilling platformer game where you play as Frankenstein's monster, a creation desperate to flee the dark halls of the doctor's ominous castle. Will you outsmart Dr. Frankenstein and gain your freedom, or will you be trapped within these walls forever?

name: Otokonoko Fishing
short_description: 'Otokonoko Fishing” is a dual fishing action game where you can enjoy two types of fishing in one game. Fish in rivers and oceans, and 'fish for men' on land while dressed as a woman. Enhance your fishing gear and outfits, and aim for the fishing grounds where the strongest monster fish live!

name: Last Whisper
short_description: Last Whisper Survival is a cooperative zombie survival game where exploration of the open world is key. As you venture further, you'll need to upgrade your gear and level up your character and skill tree to handle the increasing challenges as you move through the world.

name: Kingdom, Dungeon, and Hero
short_description: Lead your kingdoms. protect your lands, conquer your enemies. Stop the fallen god Draeul. Collect the Unity Runes to prevent the Corruption Curse from destroying the realm. Armies keep you in power, Heroes do your bidding and adventure to defeat the horrific creations of the curse.

name: Commando Collection
short_description: This is a collection of 2D horizontal action shooters. Players take on the role of Allied soldiers, traveling through the major battlefields of World War II, using a variety of advanced and even exaggerated weapons, sweeping through enemy positions and defeating powerful enemy bosses.

name: Hookah Haze
short_description: It's the year 2xxx. The inexperienced Toru Sumiki lands a job managing Hookah Haze, a new hookah lounge on the outskirts of Akihabara, where they meet three eccentric girls. The story unfolds as the girls gradually open up to them, connecting through their fondness for hookah...

name: Cats And Mice
short_description: Cats and Mice is a multiplayer game that offers an online PVP experience and a Battle Royal game mode experience. In the game, you can do team battles up to 4 vs 4 with the competitive Deathmatch mode. Also you can also fight individually to be the last player standing with the Battle Royal mode.

name: RPM - Road Punk Mayhem
short_description: Hit the road for explosive bullet hell action through a post-apocalyptic wasteland!

name: Power Solenoid
short_description: Meet Rockhound, multidimensional traveler living inside Grand Palace, a place filled with strange creatures called Goblins! Discover their personalities and requests!

name: Strike Team Delta
short_description: Strike Team Delta is a gripping first-person shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world. Battle hordes of undead, team up with friends, and reclaim our world. Survival is in your hands.

name: Holidays
short_description: In this interactive adventure, you play as a teacher suffering from delirium tremens. A world will open before you where every choice you make matters. Explore different locations, engage in battles, make decisions that will correspond to your desires and moral principles.

name: Hogvalord: The Ranch
short_description: Play as a fresh graduated Hogmaster and manage your own ranch in a remote land. Collect different types of Hogragon egg, raise them up, roaming forests, show everyone in the kingdom how adorable these mythical beings are. Build houses and workshops, design this ranch to your heart's content!

name: The Nameless City
short_description: Narrative-driven first person horror adventure inspired by Lovecraft's short novel 'The Nameless City'. Explore the ruins of a city that some say they are older than humanity itself. While you delve deeper into the ancient buildings, reality and visions blend into an indistinct haze.

name: Hexis
short_description: Hexagons are falling from all directions! Move them around to form lines and make them vanish into points. How high can you score before they pile up too high?

name: Matt Murphy: The case of the stone guest
short_description: In this pixelated adventure from Sock Films, you'll have to help Matt Murphy and his faithful friend Trey to catch, look, talk and search the underworld of Naperville.

name: 西游-琉璃盏
short_description: This is a side scrolling action Rougelike game set in the three realms of humans, demons, ghosts, and gods. It tells the story of Lao Sha and other characters from Journey to the West before they learn from the classics

name: INTERN FOX
short_description: Intern Fox is an exciting game in which you as intern Anna Fox go on a search for stolen jewelry in an ice bunker in Antarctica. Help Anna find all the treasures to prove her professional skills and earn a spot in the police department.

name: Barrhell
short_description: In this challenging ordeal, a man cursed by an evil barrel must use his newfound form to escape a mysterious cave and earn his freedom.

name: SurvivalScape
short_description: Immerse yourself in SurvivalScape, a fast-paced auto-shooter bullet hell! Select your hero from a diverse roster, each boasting unique abilities and play-styles. Battle relentless waves of enemies, gather crystals to level up, and face off against formidable bosses. Can you survive?

name: Eternal Escape: castle of shadows
short_description: You have lost your memory and are looking for a way out of the castle. The power of the nightmare magic has put the castle into an infinite loop. Carefully observing all possible abnormalities is the only way to crack the secrets of the vampire castle

name: Permanence Break
short_description: A sci-fi first-person puzzle game based around object permanence. Move and look around rooms in order to pick which objects you see and which you don't.

name: 5 Days, Minimum Wage.
short_description: You have five days to earn the contract to be the Junior Office Assistant for Insert Name Here Inc. Completing tasks each day, sounds simple enough but can you do it against the clock? Tasks will challenge memory, reaction time and coordination.

name: Exophobia
short_description: Explore and fight your way through a crashed human spaceship infested with relentless hordes of aliens as you become more powerful with exciting weapon upgrades and powerups in this retro inspired first-person shooter.

name: Adventure Forest: Rabbit Story
short_description: Embark on a fascinating open-world adventure in Adventure Forest: Rabbit Story! Filled with realistic rabbits, this game offers unforgettable moments full of exploration, customization and survival. Solve the mysteries of the forest with your hero rabbit and embark on an adventure!

name: The Adventures of Detective Donut at Shao-Lu Temple
short_description: Detective Donut is at the sacred Shao-Lu temple, which preserves the ancient martial art of Kung-Funghi. Complete the objectives to progress through the ranks and win the coveted black belt! Oh, and watch out for the wasps...

name: Seafarer's Gambit
short_description: Play as a captain who ventures into new lands with his crewmates until a storm passing by mysteriously parts him away from his ship and crew. Help the captain find his missing crew and overcome the challenges on the path by fighting unwanted guests using his trusty old sword.

name: Welcome Home
short_description: Welcome Home is a bone-chilling horror walking simulator that plunges you into a world of terror and intrigue. Set in a decrepit and sinister house that you have just purchased, this game will test your courage as you navigate through the eerie halls of your new home.

name: Sea of Change
short_description: Sea of Change is a game that blends exploration with strategic base defense. Build, defend, and expand your base against waves of enemies, all while uncovering the mysteries of a dynamic world that shifts with every playthrough. Set sail to find islands and collect resources. How long can you last?

name: DEATHWATCHERS
short_description: DEATHWATCHERS is a 4 player online co-op 'spot the difference' style, psychological horror. Use the equipment at your disposal to locate & log as many events as possible. Build your ritual and try to cleanse the locations of any demonic threats. An incorrect ritual and you may never leave.

name: EARTH DEFENSE FORCE 6
short_description: Live the future of despair.The year is 2024 AD. The survivors fought against the remaining threats while trying their best to continue their recovery.Three years passed in the year 2027. In a new world without hope, the time has come to once again resist the fate of the Earth.

name: FLIKK
short_description: A fast-paced precision platformer where your aim is to reach the goal by toggling objects on and off.

name: Archipel Logic Infinite
short_description: Explore archipelagos and chart the boundaries between land and sea in 「Archipel Logic Infinite」. Dive into grid-based puzzles by marking cells as land or sea. Immerse yourself in story-driven puzzles and endless AI-generated challenges for limitless brain-teasing adventures.

name: 辩经[Yo_Choice!!!!!]
short_description: 一个沉眠的“意识”被唤醒，一个自称是“纳米机械”的管理者带来了一道“选择题”。即将发生的究竟是一个故事…亦或是某个故事的开端？而这一道“选择题”…又能折射出这个世界的多少样貌呢？

name: 4.1.60Co
short_description: Cobalt 60 of April 1 is a magical text-based adventure game in which players play Anton Andreevich Sidorov, the protagonist of the Soviet Union in the 1960s. - My name is Anton, the name of the man who helped me is Anton, and the name of the man who tried to kill me is Anton, so who am I?

name: Sky Jumping
short_description: Sky Jumping is a challenging first-person platformer.Complete all the challenges, get to the top and leave your message for future conquerors.

name: Grub Truck
short_description: Grub Truck is a food truck simulation game where you cook up mouthwatering meals, strategise enticing menus, set the perfect prices, complete quests and decorate your trucks with style. Invest your earnings wisely to upgrade your fleet as you build, cook, and conquer the culinary scene!

name: Sleep Stream
short_description: Sleep Stream is a roguelite survivor game that exquisitely combines the fun factors of roguelite with the tension of survival. Host a bloody livestreaming to fall asleep with synergy combinations and equipment enhancements to match Layla's various personas.

name: StellarPlans
short_description: StellarPlans is a VR adventure shooter where you play as a human or Warcraft creature, experiencing different worlds. With advanced tech and lethal weapons, battle human armies, machines, beasts, and aliens to uncover the StellarPlans and Sky City's secrets.

name: Valley Peaks
short_description: Embark on a cozy climbing adventure in Valley Peaks, a ribbiting first-person platformer where each mountain is like a puzzle. Install Radio Towers at the top of every ridge to connect the froggy inhabitants to the wider world, venture further into the Valley, conquer peaks and unravel mysteries!

name: Legends of Dionysos
short_description: Legends of Dionysos is a 2,5D Action RPG that combines RPG elements with fast paced gameplay and hordes of enemies! Minmax your character, level up and find precious loot. Venture through a beautiful open world and slay loads of orcs, demons and giant dragons!

name: Trace Hunters
short_description: Trace Hunters is a third-person shooter where you pilot a futuristic combat vehicle. Outnumbered and alone, blast through hordes of enemies to discover precious resources and traces of lost technology. Unlock new weapons to take on even greater challenges!

name: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- Sweep the Board!
short_description: The anime Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba makes its virtual board game debut! Enjoy events and minigames with up to four players!

name: The Little Witch and The Lost Memories
short_description: The Little Witch and The Lost Memories is an exploration-based adventure game set in the dreams of a girl who has lost her memories. The game's story unfolds as she uncovers various secrets while exploring her dream world.

name: Vampire Therapist
short_description: Guide vampires through centuries of emotional baggage, decades of delusions and the odd bout of self-loathing with real cognitive behavioral therapy concepts and become a Vampire Therapist! Even vampires need a shoulder to cry on when a neck to bite just won’t do.

name: Slide!
short_description: Slide is a Puzzle Game where you control both the protagonist and his enemy, in it you are tasked with finding ways to defeat your enemy Angry Man, be it with a sword or using the environment, every level features multiple ways to beat them and the game features over 20 of them!

name: 그랑 엠파이어 : 그래픽 리마스터
short_description: The great powers and the human kingdom surrounded by them are, so to speak, like the moe of East Asia. Save the human kingdom in crisis, and aim for their hearts, the leaders of great powers!

name: Back from Void
short_description: Back from the Void is like a solo 'Prophunt' game with some puzzle and platformer elements. You search and collect different resources to progress in the story and finally find a way to your home dimension.

name: LOCKDOWN Protocol
short_description: A first person social deduction game, combining real time action and communication, 3 to 8 players. While most players will do their best to complete objectives and ensure victory, a small portion of dissidents will try to stop them at all costs, without getting caught.

name: MIMIC
short_description: MIMIC is an atmospheric horror game where you face off against your own shadow, trapped in a deadly game of wits. How do you defeat something that mimics your every move?

name: CHAOTIC ERA
short_description: AT THE LIMITS OF EARTH, AT THE EXTREMITY OF HEAVEN. A REAL-TIME STRATEGY NIGHTMARE.

name: Dungeon Keeper: Labyrinth Legacy
short_description: Dungeon Keeper: Labyrinth Legacy is a dynamic tower defense. Develop your dungeon and create monsters to guard your territory against adventurers.

name: Travelin' - Across Europe
short_description: Travelin' is a turn-based card game that will test your abilities to make the right decisions. Pack your skills and be prepared for the trials, tribulations and triumphs of a journey across Europe. Are you ready for this journey?

name: Incredifall
short_description: We aim to make the most Entertaining and Exhilarating game possible! Incredifall! Also, offer CASH PRIZES in the future!! :D 65 Challenging Levels at the moment and there will be 200 levels offering hours of entertainment! Are you excited as we are to play this amazing original game? Play now!

name: Flintlock: The Siege of Dawn
short_description: From games studio A44, makers of Ashen, comes an explosive Souls-lite, where Gods and guns collide in a battle for the future of humanity.

name: Meta Pong
short_description: IT'S DEMON TIME!

name: Retale
short_description: Experience working in retail with hardly any similarities to actually working in retail! Manage your time wisely to keep the shelves stocked, control the complaints of colorful and cranky customers, and be wary of the watchful eye of your manager to avoid being fired... or worse.

name: SuperAnthony's Joltzsi
short_description: Can't get enough falling blocks in your diet? Then curb your appetite with a whole new layer on the genre, literally! It's the arcade action of Tetris meets 1010 and 2048. Now, clear 4x4 Joltzsis for that Boomshakalaka!

name: Happy Sheepies
short_description: Happy Sheepies is a relaxing sheep farming game that includes some Crafting and Business Management elements with its simple Drag & Drop gameplay. Meet the needs of your sheepies, craft and sell your products, and grow your business!

name: Roll of Fate
short_description: Participate in a mysterious show, taking place far from civilization. The visual novel Roll of Fate gives you the opportunity to make decisions that affect the lives of the other show participants. Don’t try to save everyone – there’s no guarantee you can even save yourself.

name: 子归 - Blossom
short_description: Early spring, 1999, Taoyuan Village. In just several days, a series of drowning incidents occurred in the same quaint village. Then, on the night of the fifteenth day, numerous villagers witnessed a woman in red who bore an uncanny resemblance to a lady who had previously met an unjust demise...

name: Metal Queen Dungeon
short_description: Defend the Metal Queen Dungeon! Adventurers have set out on a heroic quest to raid your very existence. Assemble your evil army by customizing your deck with powerful minion and spell cards. Show those wannabe heroes that in your dungeon, the prison cells stay empty and the riffs are heavy!

name: Space Will
short_description: Sixty basic cores, hundreds of base station equipment, and thousands of chips, you can freely cooperate and shoot through the dual-angle joystick operation in a survival Roguelike game! Explore the sci-fi space and build your strongest battleship!

name: Wired Gambit
short_description: Cut wires and outsmart Smuggy in the high stakes game of Wired Gambit. Strategically use your items, manage your shields, and choose your cuts carefully to emerge victorious!

name: InfestStation
short_description: INFESTSTATION is a multiplayer Sci-Fi horror game. Board danger-filled abandoned space craft, work together to complete objectives, and sever the dimensional gateways that have allowed horrifying threats to take over and infest these now derelict spaces.

name: DAISY THE SWIMMER
short_description: Hunt fish with the iron swimmer Daisy at the beautiful beach of Parang Blue Island. And crush the vile pirates aiming for the caught fish. Daisy's companions each have their own unspeakable stories. Gain their trust and reach the hidden truths of Parang Blue Island.

name: OCON
short_description: 2D Adventure, Puzzle

name: Codename: Ocean Keeper
short_description: The entire underwater world will be hunting you. Find caves and dig tunnels to obtain valuable resources to upgrade your mech. Combine a vast array of weapons and create your unique build that will allow you to last as long as possible and unravel the mysteries of the ocean.

name: Dream World Adventure
short_description: This is a cute and casual Roguelike game. Experience a thrilling journey in the dream world! Those seemingly cute little monsters are actually murderous. Use different weapon props to eliminate groups of enemies and survive.

name: Anomalous Crossing ~Shibuya~
short_description: Suddenly, you find yourself standing at an empty ticket gate at Shibuya Station. Exit Shibuya Station, cross the scramble crossing, and head towards Center Street. However, please be careful about any anomalies.

name: The Great Couturier
short_description: What if a fashion game offered you unique situations every new playthrough? Choose a model and journey from a novice apprentice to a grand master in the fashion world over 10 rounds. And then - try again. Each game is different from the last.

name: Amber Alert
short_description: Step into the shoes of a policeman in 'Amber Alert,' a difficult survival horror game. Responding to a late-night call, you find a sinister cult of women abductors. Your mission: rescue a captive girl. Navigate perilous streets, evade cult members, and survive.

name: weekdays
short_description: Black-and-White Style: Immerse yourself in a unique atmosphere where light and shadow play a crucial role.Variety of Locations: Explore strange corridors with rooms, a forest with a witch's hut, an old cemetery, an abandoned house on a wasteland, and more.

name: Catacomb Rogue Clawsaders
short_description: Welcome to Catacomb Rogue Clawsaders! In this deckbuilding roguelite you'll embark on an dark journey alongside a fearless band of kitties as they claw their way through hordes of monstrous adversaries lurking within the corridors of a strange catacomb.

name: Magret & FaceDeBouc  "The buddy-buddy case"
short_description: Control the unlikely duo of detectives Magret, a refined duck, and FaceDeBouc, a diabolically opposed goat! Help them solve the mystery of the murder of Mr Couane, a local shopkeeper found turned into sausages, in this cartoonish point-and-click police investigation.

name: Proxy Adventure: Small Test
short_description: Control the proxy to battle enemies, upgrade skills and stats, and find new weapons in this side-scrolling fantasy adventure game.

name: Artisan TD
short_description: Artisan TD is a Maze-type Tower Defense game where you have to survive by building mazes.

name: Wukong's Pool
short_description: Wukong’s Pool is a unique fusion of roguelike elements, poker strategy, and the gameplay of billiards. In this pool game, you take on the role of Wukong, the Monkey King, facing a series of challenges.

name: Ducky: The Brave
short_description: The journey of a pet duck 'Ducky'! Healing(Hard) game going up the river towards the top of the mountain.

name: Nightshift Nightmares
short_description: In Nightshift Nightmares, navigate a night of horror in a mysterious asylum. Follow eerie rules, avoid dark entities, and uncover secrets to survive until dawn. Will you escape, or succumb to the nightmares?

name: Cakey's Twisted Bakery
short_description: It's bake or die at Cakey's Bakery, where human children are the secret ingredient to strange monsters' delicious pastries. Find the recipe for survival to escape the bakery and it's sweet and scary staff!

name: Puke
short_description: As a journalist, it is your duty to investigate the mysterious, remote town of “Frieden.” You must observe and document the events happening in the town. Only in this way can you uncover the town's mysteries.

name: The Wicked West
short_description: A Low-Poly Western-themed FPS that can be played alone or with with up to 6 friends! Wield iconic weapons like the revolver, lever-action rifle, shotgun, and sniper all while relying on strategy, quick reflexes, and steady aim to outduel your friends!

name: Up & Down
short_description: Up or down? This is the question.

name: CONTINUUM
short_description: Fight as far as you can into an endless series of simulations in this sci-fi arcade shooter with roguelike elements.

name: Movies Tycoon
short_description: Movies Tycoon is a simulation game where you dive into the world of film-making. Start with a humble studio, scout and manage top talent, customize unique characters, and direct blockbuster films.

name: Riviera: The Promised Land
short_description: The long-awaited 'Riviera: The Promised Land' is back with many added features for easier play! The story unfolds like flipping through a picture book with various variations of music color the adventure. Let's set out on the journey to protect Riviera from the devastation of the 'The Retribution.'

name: MDNE
short_description: MDNE - The game about your nightmare dream.

name: OutRage: Fight Fest
short_description: OutRage: Fight Fest is a hilarious 16-player beat-em-up party brawler! In short, chaotic sessions, you’ll fight through Battle Royale, Free for All and Team-based game modes. Do damage, build rage and become the best fighter in the arena!

name: Shooting Donut
short_description: 'Shooting Donut' is an addictive puzzle game with 100 diverse stages, where you shoot donuts to break candies. Utilize 4 items strategically to clear the levels.

name: Galactic Tennis
short_description: Stop making excuses about not having time for sports!

name: Sparedevil
short_description: Sparedevil is an arcade FPS with the graphic charm of classic '90s bowling alley animations.

name: Countless Army
short_description: Be the villain in this Reverse Tower Defense. Send waves after waves of troops to break the enemy defenses. Summon, upgrade your troops and conquer the whole world.

name: 8 Days of School
short_description: Play through this loved-filled adventure. Find friends, lovers, or enemies at every turn. Some “friends” are not as they seem. Danger lurks here! Unravel the mystery and find love before time runs out in 8 Days of School.

name: Breaking Bricks
short_description: Brick game space themed.

name: Artificial Division
short_description: Online co-op dystopian casual shooter game with some cyberpunk wibe that has some plot in it. A few quest lines that can be completed solo or with friends.

name: Extreme Jump
short_description: Welcome to the adrenaline-fueled realm of the Extreme Jumping Simulator!

name: Superscout
short_description: 'Superscout' is a live-action interactive movie game where you will unravel the secrets of the girls you meet. The love beyond lifetimes, never let it go; the kindness in this life, engraved in your soul. Your choices will change your loved ones’ fate; those who love you will change yours...

name: Vojna
short_description: A soldier searches for documents in a desolate zone at night. Suddenly, a voice on the radio, claiming to be a fallen enemy, warns that any negotiation error could awaken evil forces in the forest.

name: Nexus Rumble: The Ultimate Showdown
short_description: Welcome to Nexus Rumble, the ultimate showdown where champions clash in a fierce competition for survival! Prepare to embark on an adrenaline-fueled journey through diverse landscapes and exhilarating challenges in this heart-pounding multiplayer extravaganza.

name: Toree's Panic Pack
short_description: Toree's Panic Pack is a collection of three tiny 3D Platformer games in a classic low poly aesthetic.

name: MistsBook
short_description: MistsBook is a deck-building roguelike game where automatic chain reactions form the core gameplay. where you can play all the cards you draw with just one button press. You will collect patterns, symbols, and seals to uncover clues and reveal the pages of this book that has no beginning or end.

name: A Dwarves Day
short_description: A Dwarves Day is a 2D adventure game with platformer-style gameplay. You play as a dwarf who finds himself tricked by greed into tumbling down a treacherous hole by a pesky goblin. You must delve deep in search of a way out and get back to that gold! Just a typical day in the life of a dwarf.

name: Mango 64
short_description: Join Mango on a high-speed adventure in this fast-paced 3D platformer!

name: RetroZen
short_description: Iconic rides, iconic vibes! Relive the soul of the '80s with retro supercars, synthwave tunes, and endless cruises in RetroZen!

name: Vay
short_description: The 16-bit cult classic RPG from 1994 returns with tons of improvements! When your peaceful kingdom is attacked on your wedding day and your wife-to-be is kidnapped, it falls to you to journey across the world and stop the terrible machines of war that threaten to lay waste to it.

name: WACKY WONDERLAND WOLLOP: A 3D PLATFORMER FOR THE AGES GAME OF THE YEAR GREATEST GAME OF ALL TIME : THE GAME
short_description: A 3D Platformer 3PShooter Dialogue Driven Soulslike with RPG elements and free Unity assets. What it doesn't have in Art Direction, it makes up in charm, mechanics, features, and very funny smart political commentary that says alot about are society.

name: Vorax
short_description: In the gripping world of VORAX survival takes on a new terrifying dimension. As you step into this Open World Survival Horror game brace yourself for a journey where every moment is a battle for survival. Every choice, every move, every breath could be your last. Are you ready to face the unknown?

name: Earl vs. the Mutants
short_description: Earl vs. the Mutants is a post-apocalyptic top-down chaotic shooter, where you are an exterminator on a mission to save humanity from waves of mutants!

name: Emo Quest XD
short_description: A colorful dark retro-styled RPG adventure about Soul, Love and Emotion. Never lose faith in yourself!

name: Football Referee Simulator
short_description: Football Referee Simulator—the groundbreaking game that puts you in the referee's shoes! Are you ready to kickstart your career in the lower divisions and ascend to legendary status by overseeing thrilling finals?

name: Dice Dice Dice
short_description: This is a casual deck-building game based on dice rolling. Players will rely on their choices and some luck to achieve victory.

name: Ova Magica
short_description: Stardew Valley meets Pokémon! Experience a wholesome JRPG-farm game inspired by the classics! Train cute blob creatures, take care of your farm and make friends with the people of Clover Town.

name: Centauri Dark
short_description: Centauri Dark is a bullet-hell FPS where you fight against wave after wave of mechs in a bid for your own survival.

name: Swing Scale
short_description: Swing Scale is a game that uses centrifugal force to explore various worlds and aim upward. Adjust the length of the wire, adjust the speed, and push the limits.

name: Sir Quest and the Temple of Apollo
short_description: 3D action adventure where a treasure hunter medieval knight will delve into a greek mysterious temple in search of the flying artifact which, according to mythology, Daedalus used to escape from the Labyrinth of Minotaur.

name: 重生了还要我谈恋爱？
short_description: 重生恋爱模拟 什么？我重生了？还有系统？都穿越了为什么还要我谈恋爱？不能直接走上人生顶峰吗？问好？问号？问号？？

name: AbyssalRestaurant
short_description: You will play as a tavern owner in a fantasy world, entertaining guests, shopping at the market, cooking yourself, fully customizing your own delicious (and possibly peculiar) recipes, and promoting your shop and dishes to more friends~ (with lots of physics in the game)

name: Cast or Pass
short_description: Battle your friends in a real time card game where wizards sling spells at each other. Has a unique spot as something in between a card game and a fighting game. Games usually take 1-5 minutes, depending on the characters that get picked.

name: Space Prison
short_description: Survive the galaxy's toughest prison and rise to the top of a space gang! Explore, fight, craft, trade and learn convicts' stories to escape the facility. Space Prison is a turn-based tactical survival game with deep strategy and social RPG elements.

name: 仙道孤旅
short_description: 修仙生存类游戏，在游戏中你将打造法器，喂养灵兽，种植灵草，在不断的修炼中提升境界提升寿命，达到化神境界飞升灵界。

name: Tiny Archers VR
short_description: Draw your bow and defend your kingdom in this immersive VR tower defense archery game! Step into the role of the realm's finest archer as you face waves of attacks from cunning goblins and ruthless orcs. Test your skills, compete on leaderboards, and be part of the evolving community!

name: Speed Run
short_description: Speed Run is a first person platform video game, each level is full of traps, obstacles and fatal falls that you must avoid at all costs. Each level has its unique theme with different music and environments. The objective of the game is that you can complete the levels as quickly as possible!

name: Synaxarion: Great Martyr Theodore the Tyro
short_description: Holy Great Martyr Theodore the Tyro (or Theodore the Recruit) lived in the early 300s. This Synaxarion will step through his story as it is known today.

name: Norland
short_description: Lead your noble family in this medieval colony sim, facing off against class conflict, religious struggle, and political treachery. Tend to your people’s needs, uncover the lost knowledge of a fallen empire, and engage in nefarious plots against your enemies.

name: Monsuta
short_description: Vast action RPG bullet-hell where you take part in an adventure to defeat the evil Monsuta and restore peace to the world.

name: How to turn a Cherry tree spirit into an idol
short_description: The protagonist who lost his mother in an accident and returned to his hometown with his father. Small town, countryside, and first-timers are all uncomfortable, and he faces an unexpected connection.

name: Five Nights At PT's II
short_description: A horror survival game set in your bedroom as you try and fend off 5 different and unique enemies using only a flashlight, doors, and a generator. Dive deep into the story with fully playable pixelated cutscenes and smooth animation.

name: Feed
short_description: A top-down survival horror, where you must fight your way through a mysterious mansion, surviving it's crazed inhabitants.

name: Infinity Blaster
short_description: In Infinity Blaster you blast through space, defeat challenging enemies and upgrade your weapons! Compete on the global leaderboard, survive an infinite loop of increasingly difficult foes, and unlock 100 achievements. Can you prove yourself as the ultimate space adventurer?

name: Highway Hijinks
short_description: Highway Hijinks is a roguelike endless runner that takes place in a futuristic post-apocalyptic world controlled by a mysterious artificial intelligence. Discover wacky items, race against computer opponents, and upgrade your vehicle with powerful gadgets to get as far as you can.

name: Galaxy Flavored Heroes
short_description: Join our Heroes in this top-down 2D action-adventure game as you shoot your way through baddies then rumble it out with a boss fight. Select any stage and show 'em a fight!! Part of a Complete Breakfast!!

name: Mobiles Tycoon
short_description: Mobiles Tycoon is a brand new game about creating your mobile devices: smartphones and tablets. In the game you have to manage your company and develop your devices (smartphones and tablets), operating systems and processors

name: TOiLET
short_description: A casual puzzle game. Go to the toilet, one must also strategize.

name: Neon Phonk Robots
short_description: A GAME FOR REAL PHONK FANS! INFECTIOUS BEATS, EXPLOSIONS, ROBOTS, NEON, BASSES, GUNS, FUNK!!! CREATE YOUR OWN DRONE ARMY AND TEAR YOUR ENEMIES TO SHREDS! AND OF COURSE, TURN THE VOLUME UP TO FULL! AFTER ALL, THESE ARE NEON PHONK ROBOTS!!!

name: The Quantum Conflict
short_description: Jump into action-packed space dogfights with up to 8 players (or AI's) locally or over Remote-Play-Together. Use outlandish sci-fi weapons, including the wormhole maker and time altering munitions while avoiding asteroids, wormholes, planet gravity, and other hazards in endless space exploration!

name: Horticular
short_description: You have been magically summoned by mysterious gnomes to restore a long-lost garden. Attract adorable animals, build a lush environment, and immerse yourself in this relaxing garden-builder. Will you manage to reclaim the wasteland or succumb to a looming corruption?

name: Pico Pico Dungeon!
short_description: A turn-based roguelike RPG that's easy to pick up and play! Casual yet challenging! Strategic depth is preserved! In addition to roguelike stages, there are over 20 diverse stages, including puzzles and tower defense!

name: Alpha Rooms
short_description: This is Alpha Rooms, 'It was created to experience infinite possibilities with infinite pleasure.'

name: Silent Depth 2: Pacific
short_description: Silent Depth 2: Pacific is a lite sub-sim. You enter the Silent Service at the command of a Gato class submarine on War Patrols during World War 2. How long will you survive, and ultimately how much tonnage you sink is down to skill and cunning.

name: CROPS!
short_description: CROPS! is an autobattler in which your fruits and vegetables come alive! Plant your crops in specific patterns and place them strategically to defend against rats, kobolds and even dragons.

name: Transit Loop
short_description: Escape from an anomalous looping subway by determining the correct exit.

name: Retaliate
short_description: You are valiant space hero who is not as fortunate as those in the golden age of scrolling shooters who had infinite ammo. Instead you must absorb your enemies' weapons and retaliate!

name: 奇雞快打
short_description: A typing game for children designed to improve typing speed and accuracy in Chinese and English. It includes an idiom dictionary and learning mode to help kids learn idioms easily. Players earn coins during practice, which can be used to unlock and play fun mini-games, enhancing learning motivation.

name: ReThink 5
short_description: ReThink 5 is a Puzzle Game in a peaceful futuristic setting, that features a variety of Puzzles that utilize Lasers and the behavior of light and it's colors to create challenging problems to solve.

name: Behind The Backrooms
short_description: Behind the Backrooms is a 1-4 player co-op horror exploration game

name: Daydreamy
short_description: Explore the imaginary worlds of Nela in Daydreamy, the indie first-person narrative adventure that takes you back to those years when everything was possible. Discover how she lost her imagination and let yours soar. Are you ready to embark on a unique adventure?

name: Red Door Ylw Door
short_description: Red Door Yellow Door is a first-person psychological horror game. Starting with what seems like a normal ritual but quickly revealing its sinister nature. Beware, something malevolent lurks in the shadows.

name: SphereCats
short_description: A merge puzzle game about spherical cats, with a twist. Play the classic suika experience or try new variations every day!

name: Parfait Remake
short_description: 《纯爱咖啡厅～帕露菲重制版～》是由GIGA/Entergram所制作的经典恋爱冒险游戏的重制版。原版于2005年发售，是广为人知的高口碑杰作。游戏拥有多达6位女主角以及13种结局的丰富内容。著名剧本家丸户史明凭借为本作编写剧本而一战成名。经典主题曲《Leaf Ticket》由KOTOKO献唱。

name: 100 Dogs
short_description: 100 Dogs - The goal of the game is to find dogs! You will find several levels and a variety of musical accompaniment that will not let you get bored. Test your powers of observation in the pursuit of 100 unlucky adventurers.

name: Gates of Despair
short_description: Gates of Despair is a captivating single-player survival horror game with multiple chapters. Experience randomized gameplay, creepy jumpscares and terrifying enemies. Uncover the captivating story through cutscenes and master a variety of challenges. Are you brave enough?

name: Under The Crisis: Dárlia Island Remaster
short_description: (Release 2024) In the control of Nilgo, a ranger responsible for guarding the region, you will need to escape the chaos that has taken hold of the island while surviving by battling creatures that are beyond the rational comprehension of science.

name: The Sacred Acorn
short_description: A cozy souls-like adventure about a small squirrel embarking on an epic quest to save her tribe from the corruption threatening to destroy their world. Upgrade your magical abilities, battle legendary guardians, and explore a dangerous, enchanted land in this 2D action-adventure.

name: Let's Boogie
short_description: Use your power to swap places to complete stages as fast as you can in this speedrun platformer!

name: GOOOAL
short_description: GOOOAL! is exciting sports arcade. The goal is to defeat opponents in wagers. Use powerful soccer balls with special effects and minigames. Level up your GOOOOOOAL to save up money for a ticket to the big game.

name: Nobody Wants to Die
short_description: Lose yourself in the dystopian world of New York, 2329; immortality comes at a price that someone has to pay. In this interactive noir story, lead the investigation using advanced technology, as Detective James Karra who risks it all in pursuit of a serial killer targeting the city’s elite.

name: Where is the Tutorial
short_description: Where is the Tutorial is a game where the biggest challenge is simply figuring out how to play. Dropped into a whimsical world with no instructions, no hints, and no mercy, you're left to navigate a series of increasingly bizarre levels using only your wits and a growing sense of frustration.

name: Farlands
short_description: Congratulations, you’ve bought your own planet! An agrarian rock at the edge of the galaxy that, for some reason, was practically being given away for free. So the time has come to leave your hectic, stressful life in an overcrowded metropolis for a more rural and rewarding life.

name: Shadowed Descent
short_description: A series of inexplicable events spread throughout the village, causing chaos and disrupting the balance, leading you to find clues using all available resources to unravel the mysteries that triggered this chaos and disorder.

name: Taxi Rush
short_description: Hey hey, ready? Have the most fun in Taxi Rush! Buckle up for an exciting ride; with Taxi Rush, you become the best taxi driver in huge city!

name: River God: Enshrouded Current
short_description: Embark on a journey with 'River God: Enshrouded Current,' where an ancient village battles a curse woven into its very fabric. Uncover the secrets of a malevolent priest whose dark rituals connect the village to a realm beyond life.

name: Errships
short_description: Join forces with friends in Errships, a cooperative adventure where you construct epic flying contraptions and conquer escalating challenges. Unite with teamwork and defy the enigmatic tower to keep your scrap-filled vessel soaring high in the open skies.

name: Galactivore
short_description: Galactivore is a gory retro-style action-platformer inspired by the 16-bit era and featuring an all female cast.

name: In Search Of You
short_description: This game is to rekindle the exhilarating sensation of youthful passion—to perfectly capture the essence of romantic endeavors, making the experience of falling in love both sweet and meaningful, and to inspire players with the beauty of love within the nightlife entertainment industry.

name: Dead Zone Defense
short_description: A new look at tower defense, full of dynamics and tactics! A terrible virus has struck humanity. You will have to build defenses with your friends or alone and fight off the hordes of zombies who want to get to you.

name: Silent Sonata
short_description: Dive into a chilling symphony of horror & harmony. Solve ancient mysteries, wield enchanted instruments & face nightmarish foes. Will you compose your escape, or succumb to the melodies? Players control a musician who's experiencing more than just stage-fright in this psychedelic thriller

name: The Fight Of Escaper
short_description: Humanity has lost sight of itself, blinded by the false prosperity of AI development. You, the protagonist, begin to break free from AI control to uncover the truth of this world. Torn between escaping and erasing your memory, you yearn to leave this city of mechas and reach the shores of freedom.

name: 鬼轉身
short_description: In the nightmare, you keep cycling through In the nightmare, you keep cycling through loops, each one marking a new beginning. Every character has their own purpose, and your choices will affect their outcomes. Can you uncover the truth of the story and dig up the buried mysteries?

name: 12 Hours Museum
short_description: 12 Hours Museum” is a 3D exploration adventure game. The goal of the game is to find 45 anomalies in order to escape from the museum using a pocket watch. Once you find an anomaly, you can view and re-experience it. Collecting all endings and performing certain operations will open an extra mode.

name: Factory Outlet Simulator
short_description: Factory Outlet Simulator is a very comprehensive product manufacturing and selling game. You can produce the products of world famous brands in your factory and sell them. Or you can expand your business and create your own brand. Use your business acumen to lead the market from zero to the top!

name: Weather Dominance
short_description: Weather Dominance is a 2D roguelike side-scroller where you play as a intelligent cloud. Fly around, blast lightning, freeze enemies, and control other weather phenomena to defeat enemies and solve puzzles in randomized levels over the course of three days

name: Tormentis
short_description: Prepare your dungeon against intruders and protect your loot chests with monsters and well-placed traps. Train your hero, equip powerful gear and conquer other players' dungeons to fight your way to the top of the league.

name: Idiots' Fantasy
short_description: Idiot's Fantasy is an idiotic hack-slash Roguelike in a world where every rule can be changed by equipping various rule books. Fight, explore, buy, switch, and die as you conquer this randomly generated world using the idiotic gameplay you've created yourself.

name: Who am YOU?
short_description: Who am “you”? Who am “you’”? depends on only the selection of “me”. There would be 7 days to find who you are. You may or may not notice the 'I' at first during that time.

name: Everspell
short_description: Everspell is an RPG with card battle and deckbuilding mechanics. Explore the world. Cast spells. Be the best mage, outsmart your enemies, and create your own story!

name: NINJA SLAYER NEO-SAITAMA IN FLAMES(ニンジャスレイヤー ネオサイタマ炎上)
short_description: A fast-paced action platformer based on the world of Ninja Slayer, a hit manga that sold 4.44 million copies! In the fictional cyberpunk city of Neo-Saitama, take control of Ninja Slayer as he does battle with numerous evil ninjas, all to avenge the death of his wife and child.

name: Avian Enigma
short_description: Avian Enigma is a sci-fi visual novel game featuring in a world where birds have become extinct. The story begins with a young man working in a factory accidentally saves a bird. Soon, a girl who has a mysterious relationship with birds appears in front of him. A romance with a tiny twist begins.

name: Angel Tear: Goddess Betrayed
short_description: As the evil Demon God's power strengthens, all hope seems lost. However, one day, Yuri Maishima transforms into the powerful Angel Tear. Can she master her powers and ward off this evil?

name: Journey to Monolith
short_description: Choose your general, build your team, customize your fighters, and battle your way to the Monolith in this strategic, turn-based roguelite game.

name: Furry Sniper + Aim Trainer
short_description: Your mission is tough: eliminate 30 furries scattered across a vast woodland. As an elite sniper, you’ll need precision, patience, and perseverance to track them down and complete your task.

name: Skeletos Sword
short_description: Skeletos Sword plunges players into a thrilling third-person sword battle against a legion of crazed skeletons.

name: Union of Gnomes
short_description: Onwards to revolution in this challenging deck-building roguelite. Free your gnome comrades, assemble your squad, mind wieners (supplies), slay the slavers, and take down the fiercest of them all – Snow White! FREEDOM TO GNOMES!

name: ASTRODRIFTER
short_description: A fast-paced, top down movement shooter. A drifter must master the art of drifting, the nature of the enemy and the rhythm of attack and defence. Only then can a drifter become The Astrodrifter.

name: Unable to Exit 8
short_description: You receive an invitation on a 'special' dating app, get excited and then get involved in an endless cycle of couples' hotels. You have to watch carefully for any unusual information. Can you solve these puzzles?

name: Gorgon Shield
short_description: Gather your party of expendable heroes. Climb a vast tower atop a shiny shield. Who will fight? Who will heal? Who will laze around and take all the treasure? The choices will be yours alone, but only those who work together will be powerful enough to face Medusa at the top of the GORGON SHIELD.

name: Windstorm: Start of a Great Friendship - Remastered
short_description: Rediscover the breathtaking world of Windstorm. Delve into the fascinating story of Mika, a girl known as a horse whisperer, as she befriends the majestic black stallion called Windstorm – with fully updated graphics and a new photo mode!

name: Tempter
short_description: 'Tempter' is a suspenseful first-person horror game that shows how humans can be even more dangerous than demons when they gain power. It centers on the struggle to save one's soul against a demon after breaking a pact.

name: Midnight Ramen
short_description: In Midnight Ramen, you play as the owner of a late-night ramen stand and his apprentice. You interact with your customers, listen to their troubles, and help them out whenever you can. But as the bowls of ramen are cooked and served, troubles are beginning to brew in your own life as well...

name: Shale
short_description: Discover the abandoned world of Shale in this 1-3 player action adventure. Shoot, craft and loot through cities of possessed creatures, industrial parks of corrupted bodies and fields of forgotten souls.
