name: Ranch Mayhem - Active Idler
short_description: Ranch Mayhem is an active idle game. Grow, spend and export 15 different crops, face invasions, and spend them for bonuses. Enjoy the changing seasons and the farming adventure at your own pace.

name: Butanooo! Simulator
short_description: I got you a job delivering butane. You will have to drive the delivery van, pump gas and deliver fast with the forklift. You will have a helper for miscellaneous tasks. Remember to use the nearest bathroom and put your music on the radio. Don't buy anything from beggars. Good luck!

name: Bō: Path of the Teal Lotus
short_description: Flow gracefully through a colorful, hand-drawn 2.5D action platformer inspired by Japanese folklore. Engage in acrobatic aerial combat, unlock powerful mystical abilities, and explore an interconnected world of myth as you seek to unravel the mysteries of your origin.

name: The Alpha Wolf
short_description: The Alpha Wolf is an RPG animal simulator game. Play as a wolf in this open world environment. Hunt and kill animals, gather your own wolf pack, upgrade their skills and become stronger. Gain experience and unlock magic skills to hunt stronger animals and to fight bosses.

name: Reimu Needs Help!? Aunn-chan to the Rescue!
short_description: Speedily solve Reimu's problems by skillfully stopping slot reels to pick two words to create items to give to her!

name: Security Simulator: Nightshift
short_description: A spot-the-difference-horror game; you use a camera system to locate and report disturbances and thieves, but you can't stay in the cameras the whole night. Getting up from your office to patrol is necessary to keep thieves at bay.

name: Artifact Seeker: Resurrection
short_description: Artifact Seeker: Resurrection is a 3D Roguelike Survivor RPG game. Aurorium continent is just a board of gods game. You can obtain artifacts by slaying enemies. How to use the power of artifacts, to play the game of gods? To end the game ? Or just be a god yourself. Artifact Seeker, Your choice.

name: Bounce Ball
short_description: In this casual 2D puzzle platformer, create multiple platforms to bounce the ball into the goal.

name: It's Kooky - Land of Aotearoa
short_description: Welcome to another kooky game! This time, you will explore the lands of Aotearoa and discover all the hidden quirky elements throughout the game which is full of challenges, histories and, most importantly, fun!

name: SCHiM
short_description: SCHiM is a game about jumping from shadow to shadow in a relaxing and lively environment. This 3D platformer takes elements of light, shadow & animation and adds them directly to the gameplay, delivering an experience that you will only find in SCHiM.

name: Aim Camp
short_description: Aim Camp is the new tool to improve your aiming and precision skills. It combines military simulation with the fun of gaming. Face intense challenges with realistic graphics and comprehensive training, including CQB, sniping, and drones. Get ready to dominate every shooter game!

name: Oasis Mission: Sci-Fi Economic Colony Sim
short_description: A Sci-Fi strategy game and colony sim with a complex economy. Explore lands using your flying ships and create your own colony. Choose whether to assist other corporations or oppose them. Experience immersive logistics, a dynamic trading system, and world interaction.

name: Snowsquall Grip
short_description: Escape the snowy nightmare or be trapped forever — your call.

name: Runeroots TD
short_description: Synergize rune traits to give your towers powerful new abilities in this roguelite tower defense! Collect perks, relics, and items you can equip to your towers for unique builds each run!

name: Athralis Tower Defense
short_description: Defend humanity from the Athral Vanguard in Athralis Tower Defense. As the S.O.D.S. Commander, deploy manned turrets and advanced equipment from orbit to stop alien invasions. Experience intense sci-fi tower defense action and strategic gameplay.

name: Dusk City
short_description: A flourishing civilization had sunk into the sea. The night never dawns...... and a sense of apocalypse hangs over the world. You'll land on an island in such a world, and as you explore the town and ruins, you'll come into contact with fragments of the world's mysteries.

name: The Ransom of Atawallpa
short_description: An Adventure in Edutainment

name: 除邪(CHUXIE)
short_description: 除邪(CHUXIE) is a surreal first person horror shooting game developed using Unreal Engine 5. With the powerful capabilities of Unreal Engine 5, players will experience stunning realistic visual effects, smooth game controls, and intense battles with terrifying monsters.

name: CONSCRIPT
short_description: During the First World War, a lone French soldier must navigate twisted trenches, scavenge for limited supplies and solve complex puzzles - all whilst fighting for survival in the midst of mankind’s most brutal and horrifying conflict. CONSCRIPT is a new take on classic survival horror.

name: Pair Horror
short_description: Nothing is scary when we work together! Team up and complete a variety of games!

name: Ghost fire
short_description: Gameplay transports you instantly to a mysterious green forest

name: The Star Named EOS
short_description: The Star Named EOS is a story-rich puzzle adventure built around photography. Recreate compositions of past photos to uncover the truth of a family mystery. Experience a harmonious mixture of beautiful hand-drawn art and engaging puzzles on a journey of reminiscence.

name: Thou Shalt Not Kill
short_description: 'Thou Shalt Not Kill' is a VHS-style first-person psychological horror game. You play as Angel, a girl traveling through a forest who finds a VHS tape on the ground. As she watches it, she discovers unsettling footage telling a mysterious story, leading to shocking revelations.

name: The Awakening of a Villainous Lady: A Crimson and Pure White Romance
short_description: Step into the role of a young woman who suddenly discovers she's the 'wicked rival' in a novel. Navigate the intricate social landscape of an elite academy as you attempt to rewrite your destiny. Can you transform from a predestined antagonist into the author of your own story?

name: Humanoid
short_description: Embark on a heart-pounding journey in this survival open-world game, where a relentless creature, Humanoids prowls the landscape. Explore, craft, build, and fight for your life as you navigate the dangerous world.

name: SpHero
short_description: You are a Sphere, you are a Hero, you are... a SpHero! Use your Spherical powers to overcome your enemies and the trials ahead. You will be able to roll faster, bounce higher, throw fireballs or be a rolling magnet! Venture in 60 hand crafted levels and defeat 6 Boxes (bosses).

name: Incremental Town RPG
short_description: Incremental Town RPG is an idle game where you manage the workforce of a small village, inputs, capital, other resources and help provide all the equipment and weaponry needed to progress and defeat creatures in distant Dungeons.

name: Night Poetry
short_description: Night Poetry is a story-driven rogue-lite RPG with an existential and subjective narrative! Face waves of enemies, collect XP, and experience your evolution by obtaining various power-ups, while uncovering the consequences of an uncertain past in an ancient and mysterious city...

name: Battimals
short_description: Battimals: Combine animal DNA and battle foes in fast-paced matches. Hilarious, strategic fun in quick play sessions. Create your ultimate team!

name: PATHOGEN X
short_description: An atmospheric first-person survival shooter game in which you take on the role of Special Agent Aiden Clark and embark on a deadly mission into an underground laboratory to destroy a biological threat and extract a pathogen sample.

name: Run Run Boy 2
short_description: 'Run Run Boy 2' is an exciting and adrenaline-fueled game that puts your skills and reflexes to the test.

name: NeoSprint
short_description: The exhilarating Atari racing classic “Sprint” series returns! NeoSprint zooms back to life as a single screen arcade racer for up to 8 players, paired with a robust track builder and intuitive sharing tools, ensuring a racing experience that satisfies speed demons and architects alike.

name: Withering Flowers
short_description: In a world of magic, Shira embarks on a journey to find a cure for her sick girlfriend, facing her enigmatic teacher and her fiery sister. With the aid of a fearful friend and a bold rival, she seeks answers and a chance to mend their bond after breaking up.

name: Andarin Weppes
short_description: Andarin Weppes is a first person puzzle experience of a man with ever advancing dementia...

name: Chess Club Valley
short_description: Chess Club Valley is a 2D Open-World Chess RPG. Experience this epic chess adventure for the first time across a world filled with unique character’s, monsters, secrets and super bosses, while playing chess to level up your XP. A total of 20+ hours of gameplay!

name: Legends of Savvarah: Time of Pariah
short_description: A fantasy interactive tale about the beast-man Hidu investigating murders in a port city.

name: Inkighter
short_description: A game that fuses mythical fantasy, 2D fighting mechanics, frame-by-frame ink painting, and free strategy. The game deeply explores four mechanisms. Before playing, it is necessary to understand the concepts of these mechanisms, making it relatively difficult to get started.

name: Corsair`s Madness
short_description: As the captain of the pirate ship Sam, you'll dive into the adventure of a mystical archipelago brimming with secrets and treasures. Utilize your pirate skills and ancient artifacts to rescue your crew members scattered across various islands and uncover the dark secrets of a mysterious temple.

name: Dragon Eclipse
short_description: Choose your Tamer and fight dangerous creatures with your companions - powerful Mystlings! Travel the mysterious world of Dragon Eclipse. Catch and train Mystlings to put together your own team! Build a strong card deck and create efficient synergies of three Mystlings to fight your enemies.

name: DOUGH: A Crime Strategy RPG
short_description: A crime based 4X strategy game with heavy RPG elements. Money, power, women... in the Prohibition, the world of crime is prospering, but in it, the road to the top is filled with blood. The ruthless competition, the greedy politicians and the pesky policemen, everyone wants to come out on top!

name: 陨铁山 Falling Mountains
short_description: One day, two weird mountains fell from the sky. As a brave and curious villager, you entered the mountains. You have to build your card deck and equip talismans to conquer the mountains. In this Roguelite Deckbuilder game, you can make some strong talismans into heirlooms and use them the next time

name: STAR WARS™: Bounty Hunter™
short_description: Bring In Your Bounty, Dead or Alive

name: Laserstorm
short_description: Welcome to Laserstorm, the wild, free-for-all, shooter where you can unleash chaos as your favorite critter, decked out in your choice of stylish hats! Join up to 3 other friends in a frenzy of lasers and excitement, where only the savviest animals survive.

name: They Came From Venus
short_description: You are alone at your uncles remote mountain estate, when a mysterious package gets delivered to his doorstep. Soon after, things get out of hand and the house becomes your last bastion of survival.

name: Dawnmaker
short_description: Dawnmaker is a turn-based city building and deckbuilding game, made by 2 strategy fans. It feels like playing a solo board game. Build luminous cities, optimize your deck and create powerful combinations between buildings and cards to bring life back to a dead world. Play the demo now!

name: Plateman
short_description: Explore the steampunk world in Plateman. Fly over the world of machines full of gimmicks and monsters. Uncover the secrets of Shaman and the difference engine. Try to change this decaying world by Shaman Drum and the special lightning power.

name: Roll
short_description: Relax as you explore an infinite world of thought and beauty in this 2D ball-rolling game. Collect stories, discover secrets, and upgrade your abilities to traverse further, all while listening to procedurally generated music that responds to your journey.

name: Thought Experiment Simulator
short_description: This is a stupid game that might include Trolley Problem, Ship of Theseus, Brain in a Vat, Infinite Monkey, Sisyphus, Prisoner's Dilemma, Schrodinger's Cat, etc.

name: Legend of Tai gong
short_description: You will embark on the journey of immortality as a disciple brought back and raised by Jiang Ziya. While searching and saving Jiang Ziya, you will uncover the secrets surrounding yourself and write a different legend.

name: Pixel With Your Friends
short_description: In 'Pixel With Your Friends' you have to restore artworks pixel by pixel for a museum. You can color the artworks alone or together with a friend online!

name: Backrooms: Lost
short_description: Backrooms: Lost supports multiplayer, allowing players to navigate mysterious environments, evading lethal entities while striving to escape. All future content updates, like new levels and game modes, will remain complimentary.

name: Haunted Elevator - 闹鬼电梯
short_description: Play as a photographer compelled by a haunted elevator to uncover a tragic story. Find dark secrets about your company, using your camera and choices to seek justice or follow a darker path. The outcome is in your hands.

name: Only High
short_description: A 3D platformer where you explore the dark cyberpunk world. You have to get way up from the underground facility to the spaceship. Discover secrets, play with friends, drive cars, and many more in Only High.

name: Middle School Zombie 2
short_description: In this adventure game, you play as a student trapped in a cursed junior high school, trying to escape while defeating zombies. The game world, presented in realistic images, gives players an immersive experience.

name: Astoria: Fate's Kiss
short_description: It's a dangerous thing, gods and monsters living among mortals. Good thing your agency exists to keep them in line. With big dreams and an even bigger heart, you aspire to climb the agency's ladder... That is, until one day five mythical beings ask for your help!

name: INESCAPED
short_description: Stuck in an abandoned school, you must solve the puzzles to escape while evading a monster lurking to kill you. Solve puzzles, hide, and follow the notes of previous victim to survive. Can you find a way out of the inescapable nightmare of Inescaped?

name: Block Mover Challenge
short_description: Block Mover Challenge offers a captivating puzzle experience with minimalist graphics and subtle sound effects. Use the white block to push others into the door and complete each level. Navigate obstacles and increasing complexities. Test your problem-solving skills with engaging gameplay.

name: The Paradixion: Christmas
short_description: [The Paradixion: Christmas] is a point-and-click adventure game with a mysterious atmosphere.Solve various puzzles with a unique atmosphere and find the hidden elements in the game to gather clues about the story.

name: ナレハテ / Karma
short_description: Explore the mysterious world of hell in this walking simulator. Search for six hearts while encountering strange characters and impressive landscapes. The haunting music, composed for this game, draws you deeper into the depths of hell.

name: Sky's The Limit MAH-JONG
short_description: A roguelike deck-building Riichi Mahjong game. Utilize tile trading, special tiles, and status enhancement to build your own deck and aim for an eight consecutive wins (Pa-Ren-Chan)! And then, reach even greater heights!

name: Grove Grown Guardians
short_description: A fantasy turn based strategy game about growing plants. Position plants strategically for the best results. Sell plants to buy seed packets. Compost plants to gain grove energy to fuel powers. Feed plants to guardians to make them strong enough to fight off the corruption in auto-battling format.

name: Let's Minesweeper
short_description: This is an online Minesweeper game that allows worldwide players to play simultaneously! Across 48 million tiles, each game has over 10 million mines. Dive into a minefield, claim your territory, clear the mines and have fun!

name: ARC SEED
short_description: Face the interstellar Archangels in a turn-based tactical game with deckbuilding elements and destructible environment, where you pilot powerful mechs to save the Earth from destruction.

name: Sawmill
short_description: Quest games, such as 'Sawmill', offer an engaging immersion into a world of puzzles and mysteries. One of the most exciting aspects of these games is the ability to play both solo and in pairs, which makes the gameplay even more interesting and diverse.

name: Himegashima Island
short_description: Kokomi is sent to the island of Himegashima, where his cousin demands that he spend his summer making happy memories. Having grown up sheltered, there's a whole new world of things for Kokomi to experience.

name: Suppress Academician
short_description: An innovative game combining simulation management, auto chess, and strategy competition. Rebuild an ancient academy, recruit and train students. Utilize the Ban & Pick mechanism and resource management. The open creative workshop offers rich strategy and interactive experiences.

name: Polyoshapes
short_description: Polyoshapes is a captivating puzzle game where players engage in the strategic placement of various geometric shapes on a grid.

name: King of Snatchers
short_description: King of Snatchers is a story-driven multiplayer snatching game where players will try to complete an investigative quest by an AI. Through this gaming platform, the AI will be able to gather data regarding a catastrophe set to happen in the future. Compete to gather important data.

name: Paranormal place
short_description: Alex is a blogger who explores places with paranormal phenomena. At the request of his subscribers, he goes to an abandoned place where, according to rumors, some creepy things were noticed. What is happening there? You have to find it out.

name: Crash Time - Undercover
short_description: In Crash Time - Undercover you will experience non-stop racing action, and embark on a high-octane manhunt, with thrilling car chases and lots of explosive missions! Are you ready? Highways are waiting for you!

name: Sift Heads - Cartels 4
short_description: Join Vinnie in a battle against powerful criminal organizations in Chicago. With his sidekicks Shorty and Kiro, navigate a dangerous world of violence and greed. Use special tactics, powerful weapons, and specialized skills to survive. Uncover secrets and be merciless.

name: Uprising: Kingdom Come
short_description: Uprising: Kingdom Come is an immersive survival strategy game set in the turbulent 1800s, where you lead a group of people from bondage to freedom and beyond. Traverse the vast and beautiful countryside of Virginia. As your group evades capture and grows into a massive formidable army.

name: Mermaid Tale
short_description: Kaya wants to help her friend with her task. Only she can open secret passages for souls trapped in deep waters. But spirits from the dark depths are trying to stop the mermaids. Prepare an ancient magical ceremony with other mermaids in this little exploration game.

name: Masternoid
short_description: Step into Masternoid, an electrifying arcade brick breaker designed for players of all ages. Experience the nostalgic thrill of classic gameplay, reimagined for the VR era, infused with dazzling explosions and game-changing power-ups.

name: Golf Tour
short_description: Golf Tour is a game made by a group of friends for the same friends. Funny absurd locations, where in addition to the standard obstacles you are waiting and uneven level design. Draw anything on the balls, show your wit. Some bugs we have elevated to the category of features, also for your fun

name: Galactic Glitch
short_description: Galactic Glitch is a roguelike shooter, with Physics! Throw rocks, catch missiles, and rip apart your enemies - then use them as ammo! Craft your own builds from a large array of weapons and powers. Explore the far reaches of this simulated universe, become more powerful, and discover its secrets.

name: Hexual Deflection
short_description: Multiplayer Tower Defense Game - Send out units and defend against enemy units in this Arena RTS with up to 32 players

name: Lich's Dungeon
short_description: Lich's Dungeon is an autobattler roguelike RPG, buy and upgrade skills, find synergies and use powerful items in your quest to defeat the undying lich.

name: Find the stalker
short_description: Find the Stalker - a psychological thriller, that is set in a rural village. As our heroine, deal with your dark past, before it deals with YOU.

name: Musician Simulator
short_description: Make your career as a musician. Start as a street singer, become DJ in local pub, organize concert at a local hall, play at a largest music festival in your country. Create your own live music using musical instruments. Sing using real microphone in karaoke mode. Become a worldwide known musician.

name: The Midnight Bus
short_description: A short narrative horror experience, in which you find yourself in the middle of nowhere in a snowstorm without knowing what has happened to the driver or the other passengers in the vehicle, you just know that there is something out there lurking.

name: State of Matter
short_description: State of Matter is a First-Person Puzzle Action Shooter utilizing a new element and its three states of matter to traverse through a derelict mining outpost in the Kuiper Belt. Armed with an experimental mining tool, you must solve puzzles and defeat enemies as you travel deeper into the facility.

name: 真愿交错
short_description: 高三的生活，对于学生来说是人生中最重要的时刻，刚刚踏入高三的主人公晨约，对未来感到了迷茫，对高考之后的志愿，以及今后的职业规划有着非常模糊的感觉。就在他迎接着为止的将来的时候，有一位许久不见的朋友闯入了他的生活中。

name: A Walk in the Park
short_description: There is a fireworks event in the evening and your friend knows just the right place to watch it. All you have to do is get there through this perfectly normal park. Just follow the arrows and you'll reach your destination. Eventually. How hard can that be?

name: BROKEN TAPE
short_description: Broken Tape is a narrative-driven first person walking simulator with the elements of psychological horror. You take the role of a test subject in a secret organization. You were tasked with a job to eliminate anomalies in a series of old tapes, containing more than you might expect.

name: Candle Wood
short_description: A brutal and gorgeous hand-drawn 2D platformer in a world of candle folks!

name: Rail Maze 2
short_description: Navigate 100+ original puzzles, build railroads, and outsmart PIRATE foes on rails. Create your levels with the Level Editor and solve limitless challenges created by other players. Unleash creativity and conquer the rails in this thrilling puzzle adventure!

name: Moth Planet
short_description: Moth Planet is a kinetic, energetic 2D platformer where you interview moths and explore an interconnected world in search of the truth!

name: Deathless
short_description: Embark on an online co-op Survival Roguelite adventure. Team up with friends, slash through endless waves of foes, conquer formidable bosses, fulfill quests, craft potent weapons, and unlock unique characters!

name: Bulletrooms - Backrooms Shooter Game
short_description: It's still the same yellow rooms, but now you're the hunter here instead of the victim.

name: Scripted Land
short_description: Code your territory's AI to make it prosper! Manage production and processing, strengthen your adventurers and let them explore! Can you prevent enemy invasion and win the war? This is a hex-based 2D game in which coded Lua scripts are registered with NPCs to run a territory.

name: Chicken Game
short_description: 'What if I, an ordinary chicken delivery man, have a chance to win a 1-million-dollar prize?' What kind of ending can they reach in the battle over love and money?

name: M.O.O.D.S.
short_description: Roguelite shooter with Robots addicted to Emotion substance. Blast crazy mechs with a myriad of Weapon x Addins combinations. Talk to Bosses to change their combat style. Play solo or with friends!

name: Run, Vivian Run
short_description: Vivian starts running to change her fate――― A simple and rhythmic 2D side-scrolling action game. Match the correct actions to the music as you race through a collapsing fantasy world. Currently, only Stage 1 is available in this early access version.

name: STREET UNI X
short_description: Classic EXTREME sports at their best: on ONE WHEEL! Perform unicycle stunts and combos with style, smash goals, unlock new levels, characters, cheats, and more! REAL uni pros, REAL uni tricks, REAL underground jams, and REAL retro play that begs for one more run!

name: Touhou Picross ~ Nazrin's Puzzles
short_description: Help Nazrin solve the incident of the mysterious puzzle craze spreading throughout Gensokyo!

name: Muscle Girl Lisa: Training Diary
short_description: 'Muscle Girl Lisa: Training Diary' is a visual novel game that follows the story of Lisa, a cute girl from the United Kingdom who aspires to be a bodybuilder. Make the right choices to help Lisa grow her muscles and enjoy unique dates with her.

name: Project L33T
short_description: Dive into Project L33T, a hardcore first-person tactical extraction shooter. Confront AI foes and rival players, engage in high-stakes battles for precious loot, and risk all your gear to collect, secure, and extract Artifacts in this hostile environment. Die and lose all of your gear and loot.

name: Old School Rally
short_description: A nostalgic racing game that combines the charm of classic retro style visuals with the thrill of international rally competitions.

name: Into the Radius 2
short_description: Into the Radius 2 is an immersive VR survival shooter, set in a realm of surreal landscapes and deadly entities known as Pechorsk Anomaly. Arm yourself with realistic weapons and venture deeper into the mysteries that lie within, either solo or with a friend by your side.

name: W.O.T.E - Waking On The Endtimes
short_description: Embark on this journey with W.O.T.E, an action-adventure game with simple and captivating visuals. Norah is in a world overrun by strange creatures, full of challenges, secrets to uncover, collectibles to find, and missions to complete to restore peace. Available in Portuguese (BR) and English.

name: Young Detectives: Space
short_description: Dive into a world of colorful discovery with the ultimate spot the difference game designed for young minds! Your mission is to identify the subtle distinctions between seemingly identical scenes.

name: Tomba! Special Edition
short_description: In Tomba! Special Edition, leap, bite, and throw your way across stunning 2.5D landscapes in this vastly-enhanced update to a platforming classic!

name: Particle
short_description: A minimalist procedurally generated roguelike bullet-hell where you play as a microscopic robot fending off a bio-mechanical plague.

name: Sailist
short_description: Upgrade your ship and expand your fleet in a thrilling adventure on the infinite seas! Take a relaxing voyage and enjoy the scenery while listening to the soothing sounds of the ocean, or diligently search for other ships to plunder. Live the life of a sailor on the free seas.

name: Exhausted Man
short_description: You're so exhausted you can only crawl, but still refuse to sleep.

name: Time Is Honey
short_description: Time Is Honey is a relaxing idle game where you manage bee hives. Collect unique bees by opening bee packs, take care of them in real-time and then turn it all into profit. Unlock, upgrade and customize your hives, and enjoy completing your collection of bees.

name: Cursed Bet
short_description: Cursed Bet is a horror game where you play from a body camera perspective. Enter the abandoned preschool, the subject of terrible rumors, in the midnight. Struggle the cursed doll Ebeleen as you investigate the school's dark past. Will you be able to destroy him and his curse?

name: Kitsune Tails
short_description: Run, jump, and dash across a land inspired by Japanese mythology and untangle the love triangle between three young women on a journey of self discovery. Explore the complicated relationships between kitsune and humans through classic platforming action.

name: The Old Gentleman
short_description: Use Morse Code to communicate with your crewmate and ward off a stalking monster in this short point-and-click horror game.

name: Gym Manager
short_description: Gym Manager is a simulation game where you can build, expand and manage your own gym. To attract more customers, invest in new equipment and sabotage your competition. But beware: the town's shady streets provide opportunities for illegal business ventures.

name: 风物恋歌（The Memory of Mallet)
short_description: September 2020, Shenyang, where the story begins. Originally the most beautiful youth, it has been cast a faint shadow by the epidemic. Did we make another choice at the time, and our outcome would be different?

name: Espionage Activity
short_description: Espionage Activity is a precision stealth action game focused on a fast-paced gameplay loop in enclosed spaces. Overcome challenging encounters by incapacitating guards with your powerful takedowns, or utilize your superior mobility to run circles around them. Now, complete your mission!

name: Boyce the Voice
short_description: Boyce the Voice is a fast-paced rhythm game where an you play Boyce! An unlikely voice actor who is on a mission to change the world...with his voice! Embark on 6 custom designed levels where only quick thinking, wit, and speedy fingers can win the day!

name: Madness
short_description: Arcade combat racing game with physics defying stunts Inspired by Burnout, FlatOut, and Need For Madness?

name: S. Prysm Destroyer
short_description: A 2D platform shooter where you DESTROY!! Get Elemental Powers from the Prysms and help Amor defeat the Primordial Threats agains Humanity! Get cute costumes and be stylish!

name: Setteeh
short_description: Setteeh - is a horror game created based on real stories of Yakutia residents. Each episode of the game tells a new story.

name: Endless Desert TD
short_description: Endless Desert TD is a tower defense game with roguelike elements. Carefully choose the rewards after each conquered stage, your survival will depend on it. Adapt to survive a challenging world where every playthrough is a new experience.

name: The Ensign
short_description: Pre-sequel to the critically acclaimed, minimalist text-based RPG: A Dark Room. Death awaits.

name: Firepower Forge
short_description: Firepower Forge is a fast-paced multiplayer FPS with custom classes, interactive maps, and lots of chaos.

name: POO PUSHER
short_description: Play the retro console classic as reviewed in 'George's Gaming Grimoire'. Experience the arcade thrills of shoving other people's dung around on conveyor belts, repeatedly. Quick reactions are a must to avoid a nasty mess! Will you uncover the enriching secrets of bum-based alchemy?

name: Five Gods of Kung Fu
short_description: Five Gods of Kung Fu is a story driven Beat 'em Up.

name: Devil Road Run!
short_description: Run away from the oncoming heroes! Create a path by placing blocks in the direction the Devil is going, and lead her to the goal by blocking the way of the heroes with monsters and blocks, so that the heroes will not catch up with her!

name: Dungeon of Erotic Master Plus
short_description: This is a pseudo-3D dungeon/animation RPG. The girls hailed as the Erotic Masters after solving the mystery behind the world's toughest dungeon are now living legends. Explore the dungeons and acquire maps with these beautiful warriors and grow stronger. It's time to set off on a new adventure!

name: Etera
short_description: What is your purpose inside Etera?

name: Ghost
short_description: This is a farm themed platform jumping game with simple gameplay but quite cute and interesting.

name: Fishing for cats
short_description: If you are tired of fighting and killing, then come fishing and feed the cats. In this game, you will fish in the park and feed the fish you catch to the hungry stray cats in the park, constantly improving your intimacy with the cats and becoming good friends with them.

name: Spider Caro
short_description: 'Spider Carlo' is a thrilling 2D platform strategy game. Navigate obstacles and traps as an experimental spider, escape the lab, and explore the perilous human world. Uncover mysteries, crafting your legend with wit and bravery.

name: What's The Point?
short_description: Experience the ultimate existential crisis simulator! Our FPS-loving indie studio took an unexpected detour into philosophy. Push a metaphorical boulder, question life's purpose, and maybe find meaning (or just sore muscles). It's Sisyphus meets game dev madness in our debut title.

name: Gatherings
short_description: Gatherings is a 4 player party game focused on breaking any kind of friendship you may still have. Create a Lobby, gather your friends and just play ! No board, no overly long gamemodes, just pure fun, excitement and friendship destroying.

name: Silent Threat
short_description: you will embark on a psychological exploration experience that will engulf you in deep curiosity and tension. in this world of modern buildings, dark corners, and mysterious tunnels, you will chase the unknown. walk, look around, and listen to the sounds.

name: Locally Sourced Anthology I: A Space Atlas
short_description: A collection of 8 experimental games from different indie game developers. Grow tea on the Moon! Fish on Saturn! Find love on Mars! And 5 other things!

name: CrossOver: Roll For Initiative
short_description: Defend your tabletop RPG character sheet from invading pixel enemies. Find matches in your tray of dice to power attacks to clear the evil from your shelf full of campaign books. Extremely frantic match-3 RPG puzzle meets action-strategy tower defence. Sort of. NOT a relaxing game!

name: Relentless Frontier
short_description: Relentless Frontier is a fast paced sci-fi FPS running on the GZDoom Engine, with a strong focus on mobility, strategy, and exploration. Use your Omnistruct to replicate new weapons and abilities to help you traverse the terrain and demolish threats, while escaping from Ross 128-b in one piece.

name: Scoop it! Goldfish
short_description: It's time for a carnival game classic: goldfish scooping! Scoop as many as you can and become a master!

name: Let's Café
short_description: Food makes everything better in this cozy café business simulator. Discover recipes and set your menu to rake in those tips and five-star reviews. Solve your fuzzy clientele’s problems with the power of good cookin’ and earn the favor of satisfied customers.

name: Destiny Encore
short_description: Blast through hordes of enemies with your cybernetic and magic abilities. Adapt and combine magical and technological skills to face endless challenges and master your powers to defeat relentless demonic pursuers.

name: Unsought
short_description: Unsought is a 360-degree first-person, panoramic horror-adventure game set in a regional town of Japan in the 90s. Step into the shoes of an elementary school student who has found themselves lost in an abandoned town. Will you find your way back home…?

name: Red Rampant
short_description: Red Rampant is a narrative-driven action-adventure game set in Medieval Scotland. With the ability to travel back in time through their memories of previous gameplay and begin again, players use knowledge gained from past mistakes and hindsight of future events to change the course of history.

name: ReBullet
short_description: This is a local two-player tank battle game where two players control blue and red tanks; Players will use a limited number of bullets to eject and defeat enemies in the scenario!

name: Master Blaster
short_description: Grab your controller, charge your blasters and prepare for the physics shooter of the Universe! Take on diverse gameplay challenges, manage and upgrade your resources and abilities while you unfold the mysteries of the Cosmos. Defeat LORD CHAOSBRINGER and earn your title as the MASTER BLASTER!

name: Parasight: Chlorophyll worms
short_description: Parasight is a 2D Action-RPG with souls-like mechanics. In this game, you will embody a little girl striving to save herself from a perilous biological virus, confronting numerous challenges and hardships along the way.

name: Warriors Of Freedom
short_description: Old schooled turn based tactics game. You have an army of warriors and a leader. Pick your leader, gather up your army and fight for your freedom. You have to decide carefully as you have finite amount of everything. Prove your value.

name: ZOMBIE RAID: No One Survives
short_description: Join the fight for survival in a top-down shooter with realistic-looking combat. Raid the infected city and fight for survival in team battles.

name: Bella Wants Blood
short_description: Entertain the god-like Bella’s thirst for blood in this absurd bite-sized roguelike terror defense game.

name: Fish Hero
short_description: A physics, parkour adventure! Launch yourself up a collection of biomes to reach the summit. Compete against friends by pushing them off platforms to throw them off course. Explore a unique world as a fish out of water.

name: Cosmic Pebble
short_description: Jump, double jump, and throw your boomerang to navigate a mysterious, alien planet called Pebble. Fight bosses, find collectables, and uncover secrets, while enjoying an atmospheric sci-fi story about family, disability, and perseverance.

name: Asylum Nightmares
short_description: Awaken in a forsaken asylum filled with zombies in Asylum Nightmares. Scavenge weapons, solve puzzles, and brave the undead to find freedom. Every corner holds a dark secret and a fight for survival!

name: Befriended Curse
short_description: Witches, curses, and fairy tales meet horror in this classic walking sim with an eerie atmosphere and well-paced jumpscares.

name: Hirocato - The Delivery Hero
short_description: Hirocato is an adventure-platformer game where you control a cat and have to parkour over platforms to deliver food. The game is loaded with hard-to-beat levels, great music, hand-made pixel art, and an emotional story

name: Cat Good Work
short_description: Cat Good Work is a simple bullet shooting Rogue game that can be operated with one hand. As the most beautiful kitten in the Cat Village, you need to recruit multiple partners and combine their unique skills and attributes to pass the most difficult trials in the village.

name: Kappa's Asylum
short_description: Kappa's Asylum is a survival horror game in which you control a YouTuber in an abandoned asylum to record a video.

name: The Operator
short_description: Welcome to the FDI. As our newest Operator, your role is to use your detective skills to assist our field agents and investigate mysterious crimes. Use cutting-edge FDI software to dig for clues, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth.

name: Melly the naughty dog
short_description: Melly the Naughty Dog is a short, funny point-and-click puzzle game with hand-drawn and digital art. Play as Melly, navigating his dream world, solving puzzles, and meeting characters like the fairy dog and the knight to reclaim his jug and return home.

name: Tomb Explorer VR
short_description: Tomb Explorer VR is an adventure game where you navigate/explore ancient ruins and tombs in search of historical treasures, relics and artifacts.

name: Demons are coming!
short_description: Demons are coming! is a bullet hell rougelite shooter where you fight a high variety of demons that occupied your holy land. Use the upgrades you find to your advantage and create your ideal guns to help you kill the most terrifying monsters.

name: Towerful Defense: A Rogue TD
short_description: A roguelike tower defense where you control a single tower to fight against hordes of aliens coming from all directions. Pick your tower, equip up to 4 skills, and choose from a variety of traits and unique effect items to craft powerful builds that lead you to victory.

name: Rolmi
short_description: Rolmi is a roguelike that takes place in an infinite, procedurally generated world, where you'll have to fight increasingly numerous enemies as you explore your surroundings and collect pennies so that you can buy more items and survive the next wave.

name: Small Living World
short_description: An ecosystem simulation running in your hands. Transform a desertic world into a lush forest. No stress, play at your own pace. This world is at your disposal. Terraform the landscape, add plants and animals. Create your perfect ecosystem.

name: Mineral
short_description: A minimalist sci-fi physics based ball-rolling puzzle game. Use abilities and gather collectables to solve puzzles and unlock secrets!

name: Moonless Moon
short_description: When night falls, she wanders into another world... Moonless Moon is a text-based adventure game following a girl as she travels through a variety of different worlds.

name: Luminus
short_description: A 2D puzzle platformer where you use light and shadow to manipulate the world.

name: Let Me Out
short_description: Play as Alvin, a 10-year-old indigo child, in search of his mother and escape Mata Koetjhing, an ancient Javanese village. Get help from your little sister’s spirit, your pet spider and brew potions to exorcize mysterious creatures.

name: Eve of Calamity
short_description: Prevent a world-ending Calamity your way! A player-driven old-school RPG inspired by both the Japanese and western classics of the 80s and 90s.

name: Flea Market Simulator '24
short_description: Flea Market Simulator '24 Work, Bargain&Buy, Repair&Sell Take care of antique or fake items. Adding this game to your wishlist allows me to improve my game further. If you care about my project, add it to your wishlist to improve the game together with me.

name: Animal Race Run VR
short_description: This is an exciting leisure game, which brings players the opportunity to watch and participate in animal race. Using VR technology, players are on a runway arena, and they will enjoy the fierce competitions of animals.

name: The Playful Triangle
short_description: Each encounter with these 'angry squares' pushes you to use your intellect and strategic thinking to evade danger and stay one step ahead.

name: Holiday Farm
short_description: A sandbox game that simulates life on a farm. Experience life, growing vegetables, raising animals, diving in mineral water on a happy island.

name: Bump in the Night
short_description: You are trapped in a terrible dream. Observe your surroundings carefully and discern whether you are truly in your own home, or if you are experiencing a waking nightmare.

name: MASTER OF FRIED RICE
short_description: Fried rice————Wok stir-frying————Rice dynamism realized by physics calculation! Complete the best fried rice by using various ingredients!

name: Одиночество Скуфа
short_description: A real journey into the depths of yourself, an atmospheric immersion in the night city, soaked with rain, melancholy and the mysterious whispering of destinies. You are not just a reader, but the creator of your own story, a composer whose decisions are the chords that form the unique melody of fate

name: Outpost 3
short_description: this is a mining , got resources to upgrade device and weapons game,monsters will appear and defence your mecha . player landed on different planets,them can collect diffient ore and upgrade weapons,find mining device and relics to make every round special . move character and mining ore

name: Omni Blade
short_description: Omni Blade is an immersive and tactically challenging retro RPG inspired by classic games such as 7th Saga, Grandia, and Chrono Trigger.

name: Danger and Deadlier
short_description: Danger and Deadlier is a hardcore medieval fantasy dungeon adventure game. Join intense 6v6v6 battles with different classes. Dungeon-style exploration lets you find valuable treasures. What are you waiting for? Join this gold rush now!'

name: Volgarr the Viking II
short_description: A hardcore, 2D action-platformer where only precision can keep you from death.

name: Caramel Performance
short_description: Caramel Performance - Game about circus, magic and personal troubles of the girl Evelyn Vozui. Where will the fate take her? Only you decide!

name: Obsessed With The Streets
short_description: A next-gen open world street racing game. Defeat your rivals, earn their cars, customize them, repeat!

name: Wurzelnsisters
short_description: Cute Shooting Game: Drive Away the Goblins Attacking the Town with Modern Firearms!

name: Minds Beneath Us
short_description: MINDS BENEATH US is an emotional sci-fi narrative game. Through the eyes of a humble individual, experience a mad world where humans are exploited as computing devices for AI. Listen to the concerns of those you meet and offer guidance. Together, face challenges and confront an uncertain destiny.

name: Photo Playhouse
short_description: This is a 2D pixel action game where the protagonists defeat bosses. Players can switch between four different characters, each with multiple skills, to experience the thrill of combo attacks and the excitement of combat.

name: Wolf Hero: Animals vs Robots
short_description: Build a strong pack and protect the forest from evil robots!

name: Lines On Sides
short_description: A minimalist puzzle game in which you arrange tiles so that their sides match the symbols / colors of adjacent tiles.

name: Dungeon Board
short_description: Dungeon Board is a virtual tabletop and companion app that puts you in control. Author your encounters and play them out with friends! Now with built-in multiplayer via Steam, or screen share with your friends!

name: Alone in the School
short_description: A girl who has lost her memory must collect five scattered memory fragments in the school to remember the events of that day.

name: The Anomaly Project
short_description: Your goal is simple, spot anomalies to escape. Play alone or together with up to 8 players in online co-op. Make the right decisions to advance to the next level, or risk being reset to the beginning!

name: Slide Treasures: Lydia's Hunt
short_description: Set sail to discover treasures and mysteries in an engaging and intriguing story in this casual puzzler.

name: Fragment: A Story in Growing
short_description: Your wife passed away before the bell ring of the millennium. The sun still rises, you are together with your daughter Wei ran.It’s the path of growth for both of you. 'Fragment' is a new form of interactive narrative game. Step into the time machine and grow up again with Wei Ran!

name: Infinite World:Dice Team
short_description: This game is a roguelite infinite theme game. In the game, players need to form a team, build characters, use dice to fight, combine skills based on the dice results, get rewards, and become stronger to defeat the final BOSS.

name: Treasure Hunter: Idle RPG
short_description: Let your team kill the bad guys and gather all sorts of loot for you to play with

name: Scissor Girl's Weed Crisis
short_description: This is a game that can be played alone or with two players. Players play as a girl using scissors to fight against weed enemies. They need to avoid the attacks of weed enemies, find opportunities to attack them, and eliminate all enemies.

name: Elemental World
short_description: ✓ RANDOMIZED WORLDS & ROGUELIKE GAMEPLAY ⚔️Each adventure is unique thanks to randomized worlds. A challenging game play with roguelike elements will put your skills to the test. Play as Mage, Hunter, or Ronin!

name: CHAINED

name: Violent Horror Stories: anthology

name: Songs Of Death

name: Head Collector VR

name: Clank!
short_description: Burgle your way to adventure in the award-winning board game!

name: Penalty Challenge
short_description: Embark on an exhilarating journey with Penalty Challenge, the definitive 11-meter shot simulator crafted for those passionate about elevating their football abilities.

name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Into the Pit
short_description: Survive five nights of terror in this chilling adventure game. Travel between time periods to solve puzzles, gather clues, and outrun the threat relentlessly pursuing you. Move swiftly and stay hidden, and you may just survive. But be careful—it's not just your own life that’s on the line this time.

name: Drug Lord Tycoon
short_description: Start from nothing and rise to the top as you expand your criminal empire in Drug Lord Tycoon.

name: Berry Hunt Survivors
short_description: Berry Hunt Survivors is a Reverse-Bullet-Hell Game with Rouge-lite elements. Choose your character, defeat enemies, learn new abilities and destroy the big bosses!

name: Kunitsu-Gami: Path of the Goddess
short_description: A new tale of the Kami awaits... Kunitsu-Gami: Path of the Goddess is a unique Japanese-inspired, single player Kagura Action Strategy game.

name: Tyraels Ascension: Hell Walker - The Video Game
short_description: A short Action Adventure game based on the music of the band 'Tyraels Ascension'

name: Dark Ascent
short_description: Dark Ascent is designed to be a test of skill, patience, and perseverance. Every decision counts, and you must learn from your mistakes to climb higher.

name: Good Soup
short_description: Good Soup is a spine-chilling indie horror game where your quest for a simple bowl of soup turns into a nightmarish adventure. Navigate dark alleys, solve puzzles, and evade a relentless soup monster. With multiple endings and intense atmosphere, can you survive this terrifying culinary quest?

name: よりそいデリバリー
short_description: 'Yorisoi Delivery' is an adventure game for lonely nights. It's a game where you call for a 'just being there delivery' and spend a late night together. As people gradually gather, the house turns into a hangout spot, allowing you to enjoy a lively and fun night.

name: BULLET
short_description: Bullet is a top down Action Arcade game. You have one shot at killing your enemies. Dodge and weave through each level, gain points and upgrade your abilities. You have one shot... Make it count.

name: Nucleuz Underground
short_description: The planet is dying, a team has been created that has to go underground, in the exile of the machines and hit the core. Only in this way, humanity will be able to survive and we have the mission to do so every day. A classic 2D platform game, in a dystopian and survival future. Join the team. Now.

name: No Return
short_description: No Return is a first-person psychological horror game set in modern-day China. With a focus on family tragedy, the story unfolds as our protagonist is mysteriously prevented from returning home by an unseen force. Can he navigate a nightmarish maze of hallways and uncover the disturbing truth?

name: Riddle Tower
short_description: Riddle Tower is all about solving a wide variety of riddles, including classic riddles, math brain teasers, and rebuses. The main story features riddles inspired by two classic games from my childhood, Notpron and GodTower, known for being some of the toughest riddle games of their time.

name: Saikyo Robots
short_description: Real time strategy meets Roguelike. Command your robot army to fight enemies and gather resources. Upgrade your base and robots to make them the strongest! Explore the wasteland during the day for scraps. Defend your base from the king's relentless nightly attacks for survival

name: Evolve:Mecha Squad
short_description: Build mechas, form mecha teams, and command them to fight.

name: Pyhare
short_description: In Pyhare, lead a village besieged by corrupted monsters. By day, gather resources and upgrade defenses. At night, face intense battles. Build a relic to contain the evil and save your village. Can you survive and complete your mission?

name: MushroomJump/蘑菇跳跳

name: Sand in a Box
short_description: Sand in a Box is a 'falling sand' game that simulates thermal flow, electricity, radioactive decay, and gravity. Create art, experiment with physics, and craft your own simulation rules with user-friendly mod support!

name: Haruka Ao no Hanayome ni
short_description: 《献给蔚蓝之海的新娘》是由日本美少女游戏知名品牌Lump of Sugar（方糖社）于2023年最新发售的作品。本作由人气原画师萌木原文武担当人物设计与原画，由业内多位剧本家携手担当剧本；结成惠乃香、风花真白等知名声优领衔出演游戏女主角。片头主题曲《Eternity Blue》由知名歌姬Kicco献唱。

name: Circle TD:Defence War
short_description: A tower defense game.In the wave after wave of enemy attacks like a tide, constantly configure defense tower ties, player talents, props and equipment, build a powerful defense position, and eliminate the enemy before they fill the map!

name: Zebulon: A Lost Cat
short_description: Zebulon the cat is lost in a strange place, but he has a lot of courage and curiosity quickly replaces fear as he explores and unravels the world around him. It also helps that smelly green food is everywhere to grab!

name: Tetris Crush
short_description: A game of Tetris played with guns.

name: BattleClaws
short_description: Experience the ultimate local multiplayer claw 'em up! Battle for glory in this fast-paced arcade elimination game. Collect prizes for points, outlast your rivals, and be the last claw standing. Dominate the leaderboard and prove you’re the ultimate BattleClaws champion!

name: Anomalum
short_description: You are trapped in an endless nightmare. Carefully observe your surroundings and look for anomalies while checking the clock to track your progress and escape from Anomalum.

name: Flint's Hints
short_description: Flint's Hints is an escape-room-like puzzle game where you investigate your surroundings to appease your fussy pet cat, Flint. Search for hints to figure out what he wants and how to give it to him, but be careful with what you investigate. Some things are meant to be left alone and forgotten...

name: CLICKOLDING
short_description: The man in the corner of your hotel room wants you to click something. He wants to watch you click it.

name: Warp speed: Infinity
short_description: Put your reflexes to the ultimate test with this unique arcade-style racing game: Warp speed: Infinity. Make your way through space at incredible speeds while dodging asteroids and space junk. Unlock a variety of different ships with unique features and handling by reaching ever higher scores.

name: Incremental Island
short_description: Build and expand a vibrant civilization on a procedurally generated island. Trade and conquer with other island nations to grow your wealth.

name: where is my cat
short_description: 'Where is My Cat' is a horror shooter game where you play as a janitor in an abandoned medical school and spend your days looking for your missing cat.

name: Muggo Clicker
short_description: Introducing Muggo Clicker, the addictive idle clicker game! Muggo, the adorable alien who loves clicks. Each click raises your counter and offers a chance for epic drops. Equip, flaunt, or trade your treasures. Click, collect, and conquer – who knew clicking a Muggo could be this fun? Start now!

name: Blacklist Mafia
short_description: Blacklist Mafia - is not only a struggle for power and money, but also a dangerous game of survival. Who will be blacklisted, and who will become the new boss? Find out with us!

name: Pickup Point Simulator
short_description: Become an entrepreneur and develop your retail outlet. Order goods and place them in the warehouse, give orders to customers by scanning QR-code, design and expand your premises, hire employees and learn new skills!

name: 风流公子romantic young man
short_description: 好不容易成为了慕容家的贵公子，身边美人环绕，上乘武功唾手可得，却不得不投身于家仇国恨之中。正所谓人在江湖，人不由己，如何才能在不多的时间里完成爱情与霸业的双丰收呢 ？

name: Ice Cream Wars
short_description: A madcap arcade driving game in the unexpectedly cut-throat world of the frozen confectionary distribution industry. Race against the clock (and Gelatoni's henchmen) to provide the residents of Rippleton with the sweet frozen treats they're craving.

name: Phyto
short_description: Grow and evolve 32 different plants in this tower defense! Unlock new skills an units by finding seeds throughout 100 levels. Replay each map as much as possible, to push the challenge and rewards even further!

name: Super beast activation
short_description: Type: Science fiction and theology style FPS multiplayer shooting game; Topic: Discovering the Truth of the Universe in the Future of Humanity and Its Impact on the Evolution of Human Bones; Modes: PVE (Gun Shooting Battle and Summoning Flying Shuttle Battle), PVP (Gun Shooting Battle).

name: Sugar Rush
short_description: Enter the sweet world of Sugar Rush, an action packed top-down roguelike filled with sweets and treats to empower your journey. Test your skills by facing various fruit snacks, defeating them with color instead of damage. Find the best set of treats to survive as long as possible!

name: Pub Sim
short_description: You've just bought your first Pub. First steps are to clean it, stock it, set your markup and let in the Patrons. Keep the drinks flowing and try not to shortchange anyone! If you keep it going long enough you might just earn enough to spruce up the place, hire staff and expand the premises.

name: When You See It
short_description: Search for 5 creatures across real photos in this hidden object horror game. Look closely at each image. If you see the creature, press spacebar before the camera changes. But be careful, if your face is too close to the screen, the jumpscares will be worse.

name: Arco
short_description: Enter the breathtaking world of Arco, a dynamic tactical RPG where your decisions shape the story. Three tales forged in bloodshed, laced with magic, and united by revenge.

name: 艾比奥尔金
short_description: Who am I? Where am i? It's not important, I'm going to kill the enemy! Go to the dungeon, keep fighting, constantly eliminate strong enemies, draw the power of imprints, and challenge the strongest dungeon in Abby Orkin

name: War of Charge
short_description: Buy soldiers, assemble troops, and simply command them to fight. Each branch has its own strengths, rationally match your lineup, break through the other side's defense line, defeat all the other soldiers, or go to the other side's base camp. Support multiplayer online,and lobby matching

name: TACTICAL BANDITS
short_description: Dive headfirst into the chaos of a ravaged world, where survival means mastering the art of combat and outsmarting your foes. In this hardcore arcade action game, TACTICAL BANDITS, the remnants of civilization teeter on the brink, and it's up to you to chart a path through the desolation.

name: Harmonis: the hand-made kingdoms
short_description: Harmonis: The Hand-Made Kingdoms is a minimalist strategy game where you shape living kingdoms with unique tiles. Explore biomes, complete quests, and unlock new elements. Immerse yourself in a serene atmosphere as you design vibrant, living worlds bursting with your creativity.

name: Iron Psycho: RETRO
short_description: Iron Psycho: RETRO is a retro First-Person shooter in which the player must eliminate all threats aboard the ship and collect keys to reach the end of each level. Some levels contain secrets.

name: Mindform
short_description: A fantasy forms in your mind: becoming an (e)sports world champion. Experience this journey with a first-person, climbing game set inside your brain. Feel the thrill of overcoming obstacles and reaching new heights. Discover your inner resilience and unravel the mindset of a true champion.

name: Qazaq: Son of the Sun
short_description: Qazaq: Son of the Sun - a single-player first-person open-world game with puzzles set in Kazakhstan, where you are the last surviving Qazaq saved by the Sun God.

name: The Man in the Fields
short_description: The Man in the Fields is a first person horror experience based on a ritual of the same name. Once you summon The Man in the Fields, every door and item in your house will be opened. Close everything in time to prevent it from getting in.

name: Prune & Milo
short_description: Join Prune and Milo, a sister and brother duo, in this charming turn-based puzzle game. Immerse yourself in a unique and original pixel-art adventure, full of secrets, dangers and many unusual characters!

name: Midnight Fury
short_description: Experience a TV show featuring Max Cobra and his teammates as they clean up zombies in quarantine zones. Impress sponsors and boost your fame.

name: Mech Builder
short_description: Welcome to Mech Builder- a relaxing puzzle game inspired by Model building(gunpla). You will experience the relaxing process of building a model kit with complete freedom with over 50+ puzzles.

name: ChatWaifu
short_description: With one-click import of various local AI LLM and powerful customizable tools, ChatWaifu is undoubtedly the smartest desktop pet in history. From reporting news and checking the weather to operate computer, she handles it all with ease. Endless possibilities await with Workshop support!

name: Old School Tower Defense
short_description: Build and upgrade towers with unique abilities to stop waves of enemies. With the advanced augment system, every 3 rounds you can boost your defenses and create strategies that fit your playstyle.

name: Wonder Loop Village
short_description: You’ve wandered into a mysterious village. Let’s search for anomalies and aim for the exit!

name: Black Hole Survivor
short_description: A physics based twin-stick shooter. Survive as long as possible and get a high score. Use your gravity beam or your gravity mine to destroy endless waves of enemies.

name: Darok
short_description: Darok is a simple 2d platformer where you have to navigate Darok back home. There are breakable floors, moving platforms and Geysers to help Darok on his journey home.

name: The Fall of Aether Station
short_description: Customize your Ships, Upgrade your fleet, and Command your way to victory in this ruthless rogue-lite tower defense/real time strategy hybrid. Take on an enemy that learns from your moves and adjusts its own path. Do you have what it takes to persevere?

name: These Thieving Hearts
short_description: A wealthy benefactor. A master lockpick. A magical bodyguard. A trusted ally. A skillful rival. All of them are out to steal priceless treasures. Which one of them will steal your heart?

name: Catbo
short_description: This is a cute, casual, and fast-paced arcade pinball game .Using Combo to increase feelings with cats.

name: Marfa
short_description: Marfa is a quest with elements of a visual novel, where you can immerse yourself in the airy atmosphere of the summer and sunny world and help the cat Marfa fulfill the dream of her owner, an artist, to realize the plan of an ideal city.

name: Strandzha Adventures 3D
short_description: Epic Fantasy 3D Platformer Game To Experience The Mystical Mountain of the Ancient Thracians. Inspired by the 3D platformer games of the late ’90s. It is an exciting experience among the amazing nature, ancient sanctuaries and legends of the real Strandzha Mountain.

name: BloodLight
short_description: BloodLight is a cooperative first-person horror game for up to 5 players. While working as a night watchman, you will face a demon that constantly changes form. Set out in a team or alone through the chilling environment to complete all the tasks.

name: Tres
short_description: Tres is a cards-based game where you, with another player, have to compete againt each other to see wich one is the first to put on the table all of their cards.

name: 公主：东方与远征（Princess: The East and the Expedition）
short_description: In the course of the expedition, you can choose different means such as friendship or strategy to expand the land, experience the cultural features of different countries and open the love and hate between the NPC with different features ~

name: The Burst
short_description: The Burst is a smashing high-speed VR shooter. Play as a spec ops operative to bring down the tyrannical warband leader and her goons. Restore order on a prison planet the best way you can - with violence.

name: On Point
short_description: On Point is an arcade-inspired VR first person shooter, filled with Warioware-style minigames. Think, aim, and blast your way to a high score through endless shooting minigames, but don't hit those bombs or you'll run out of lives!

name: Home Snatch
short_description: As night falls, you are alone at home and experience strange events that reveal an evil entity. Survive the night in a desperate struggle with your worst nightmares. In this four-chapter journey, every shadow hides peril, and every noise could spell your demise.

name: Closed world
short_description: HD-2D Dungeon Exploration JRPG. Strengthen your weapons and armor with obtained materials and acquire hidden skills across the land to delve deeper into the world. Conquer complex labyrinths, break the seals of the world, and aim for the land of ancient legends!

name: Bonoru Adventures
short_description: Although it is a protected species worldwide, it is a harmful species in its own korea. The story of Bonoru, the water deer. I tried it as a casual former death, a platform game. space jump Arrow keys (wasd) movement Right mouse button special ability

name: Forgotten Mines
short_description: Wreak vengeance and retake lost mines from goblins, orcs, skeletons, and demons in this small-scale tactical roguelite RPG. Build the perfect expedition team and turn the underworld red with each challenging, fast-paced run.

name: VLADiK BRUTAL
short_description: Fight under the onslaught of mutated monsters, obsessed soldiers and even darker bosses. Just try to survive and find out what to do next in this life, simultaneously tearing your enemies to pieces.

name: Eight Balls
short_description: This is a ball platform jumping and leisure game. You can race against time in this game or play it casually. How you want to play depends on you

name: Frontline Crisis
short_description: This is a top-down shooter with tower defense elements‘ set during the great war between insects and humans.

name: Back To Back
short_description: Back To Back is a Top-Down Rogue-Lite built for Multiplayer. Survive endless waves of enemies while continuing to get stronger, but be careful to work with your friends as their bullets are just as dangerous as the enemy's.

name: Legend of the Moon
short_description: -Classic dungeon exploring action RPG -For those who get sick and tired of endless and meaningless level up we developed it so they can get nostalgic about the moment you held a controller to see the ending part when young.

name: Banishing You
short_description: Step into the world of Banishing You, a visual novel where choices shape your journey. Accept a mysterious invitation to a dream realm full of enigmatic characters and challenges. Navigate passive-aggressive comments, flirtatious strangers, and unravel a quest that could save or doom both worlds.

name: CasualMuyu
short_description: Peace comes from nature and regularity Tap the screen to knock the 'Muyu' and advance the time while enjoying the neglected daily nature, and you will find peace. Suitable for relieving anxiety and insomnia symptoms.

name: OveRRooT
short_description: A Sci-fi Action Platformer, focused on challenging and fast paced combat, where you control Root: a sophisticated malware created to bypass the defences of malfunctioning computer systems. Use each ability at your disposal to erase everything in your path.

name: Block & Shot
short_description: Block & Shot will immerse you in the captivating world of logical puzzles, where you will have to control various weapons to overcome obstacles in your path and reach the main goal - the golden cartridge

name: Dropped into the Modern World: Surviving the Red-Light District
short_description: After an attack by a monster, the sorceress Daiya suddenly gets teleported to modern-world Kabukicho! Without a home and all alone, she gets offered shelter by a person named Kobeni. With their help, Daiya is able to start a new life, but can she return to her home world…?

name: Salus per aquam
short_description: Salus per aquam is a climbing game set in a dreamlike world where the goal is to reach the highest point of the protagonist's existence by climbing surreal objects and navigating metaphysical landscapes.

name: monoch room
short_description: After losing consciousness, I found myself in a strange room. An unknown figure guided me deeper into the room. 'I thought you would make it this far.' Eventually, I saw a past I had forgotten... 'monoch room' is an adventure game with puzzle elements.

name: The Breakup Arena
short_description: A Beat 'Em Up game where you confront your exes, blending intense action with deep emotional storytelling. Explore the complexities of relationships and discover inner peace through unique gameplay.

name: Pretty Girls Pop Match
short_description: Embark on an epic journey with the adventurers as they navigate through this captivating 3-tile match puzzle game!

name: Packit List
short_description: Packit List is an organizing puzzle game that follows the wonderful adventures of Hana, a high school girl who travels across multiple worlds to organize various themed objects in a limited space.

name: Sleep Simulator
short_description: Sleep Simulator is a cozy real-time strategy game in which you sleep.

name: Boxed In
short_description: In a voxel-based world, you control a ball that moves in the direction you choose until it encounters a wall or obstacle. Navigate through intricate levels filled with challenging hazards and features.

name: Desvelado
short_description: Turn off the lights, dodge the ghosts and go to sleep as soon as you can in this hand-crafted 2d platform experience! In this vampiric precision platformer you will overcome challenging puzzles and deadly enemies before going to sleep in your cosy coffin.

name: Love, Ghostie
short_description: Become a wholesome ghost matchmaker and grow relationships between the manor’s residents! Gift items to lift their spirits, set them up on dates, and watch love bloom! Discover cute romances with a unique story between every pair of residents! How will love blossom in your manor?

name: Lunar Nightmare
short_description: Lunar Nightmare is a retro-inspired sci-fi thriller, set on an abandoned Moon base, where you have to solve the mystery behind missing crew members, ancient discoveries around deep down the Lunar surface, rouge-AI trying to control your fate and ghastly androids to revolting against your command.

name: 三国英雄演义(Three Kingdoms Heroes Epic)
short_description: This is a Three Kingdoms strategy role-playing game. Players can take on the role of any general from the Three Kingdoms period. This game features a rich set of adventure explorations and character development events.

name: AERO BATTLE ROYALE
short_description: Dominate the skies in breathtaking environments, battling opponents and mastering high-speed flight. Utilize your weapons and piloting skills to be the last pilot soaring!

name: ALEPH
short_description: Wield the power of light manipulation and talk to inhabitants of the destroyed planet on a quest to discover the secrets of a lost language. Solve mind-bending puzzles and stick to the shadows in this unique adventure.

name: Super Antonio
short_description: Super Antonio is a difficult 3D platformer with satisfying movement. Climb to the top while enduring a punishing experience.

name: The Best Duck Clicker
short_description: A small clicker game about destroying ducks! Collect 25+ ducks, upgrade all your stats, and repeat!

name: Mayonaka 10 chome
short_description: Currently, in the town of Mayonaka, anomalous phenomena and terrifying apparitions have been witnessed. If you encounter them, never approach,Please turn left at this road. If there are no abnormalities, please turn right. Will you be able to safely navigate through the eternal road of terror?

name: Unlock the Three
short_description: Unlock the Three is about a Police,Medic,Security Worker and a Father trying to escape from a monster in locked hospital. Monster is also controlled by a player and each survivor has its own unique skills to perform.Survivors must be collaborate with each other to be able to escape.

name: Shoot on Sight
short_description: The System built a world of injustice and oppression. Pressed up against the wall, it now fights for its survival. Uphold the law as an elite police officer or join the Stagers to liberate the world, defining the future of society in this multiplayer isometric tactical shooter!

name: Swamp Up
short_description: Jump between mushrooms, collect power-ups and break records while exploring your own path through a procedurally generated map in this fun yet challenging Precision Platformer with Roguelite elements. Be fast, precise, and skillful to avoid all of its dangers. And remember, never touch the water.

name: ReEarth
short_description: ReEarth is an exciting TD & (RTS) indie game. Here, you will play as humanity's last hope. You will fend off the oncoming swarms by continuously building your base and dispatching various types of units. Prepare for the challenge and save the future of humanity!

name: To the Stars
short_description: To the Stars is a fast-paced, whimsical and tactical planet-hopping game. Choose your own adventure as you conquer the universe - one constellation at a time.

name: myPOPGOES
short_description: 'Of course you'll never get to experience Freddy Fazbear's Pizza like I did. And maybe that's a good thing. But a few months ago, I wondered... What if Popgoes could?'

name: Tidy Cauldron
short_description: Help 3 messy witches tidy up their chaos! Arrange magical ingredients to fit perfectly within increasingly bigger grids through 100 puzzles in pixel art.

name: Dreamsweeper
short_description: The floor isn’t lava, it’s Minesweeper! Dreamsweeper is a cozy Dungeon Crawler x Minesweeper Roguelike! Explore procedural dream worlds, solving puzzles and battling your nightmarish anxieties to the beat! Chill to an original lofi soundtrack from Oatmello!

name: Fear Calibration
short_description: It's your first day and you're trapped in your school–or at least what seems to be of it. Through piecing together hints hidden across rooms, accessing your teachers' computers, and fixing what's broken, find your way out of the room... before they can catch you. This game should work on laptop.

name: Guayota
short_description: Unveil the darkest secrets of Saint Brendan’s Island, the paradise on Earth, in this 3D Puzzle-Adventure game. Only equipped with a torch, walk through ancient gods’ temples and solve their enigmas.

name: OMUSUBI
short_description: One day, Hinako, a high school student, finds her path to school transformed into the Sanzu River, where she meets a strange-looking man named Issa. Will she be able to get through the mysterious devices of the mysterious mansion and return safely to her family?

name: Rev'd Up Racing
short_description: Rev'd Up Racing is a fast paced, action packed arcade racing game which will push your driving skills to the limit. Destroy the competition and prove that you are an expert racer in a variety of events and challenges including, tournaments, time trials, drifts and more.

name: Necrosphere64
short_description: A 64×64 Metroidvania with only 2 buttons (neither of them jumps)

name: 城市怪谈之不要看月亮
short_description: The moon, once serene, now portends doom. Air raid sirens blare, TVs warn: 'Do not look at the moon.' Your world's turned upside down. Messages flood in, all asking: How to survive in this world of bizarre rules?

name: Pixelorama
short_description: Unleash your creativity with Pixelorama, a powerful and accessible open-source pixel art multitool. Whether you want to create sprites, tiles, animations, or just express yourself in the language of pixel art, this software will realize your pixel-perfect dreams with a vast toolbox of features.

name: Hitobashira - Human Suika
short_description: A fun human fusion puzzle game, merge people to sacrifice them and feed their souls to the Monolith.

name: Dark and Deep
short_description: A conspiracy podcast drags you into a hauntingly illustrated world of mystery and terror. Reveal secrets and horrors with mystical frames given to you by a strange observer. Dark and Deep is a first person cosmic horror game with a focus on puzzles and exploration. PLAY THE DEMO NOW

name: Gem Blast
short_description: Mine gems on an infinite hex board. Play as a cute robot stranded on an alien planet. Find ship parts to repair your broken space ship. Use markers and logic to find gems and avoid bombs. Skillful play lets you dig longer. Spend gems to upgrade Dig Bot. Unlock achievements for even more power!

name: PingViewer
short_description: PingViewer is a network visualization tool that displays real-time ping on a graph. At a glance, you can understand your current network stability for gaming.

name: Relaxing Drift
short_description: Immerse yourself in the world of car adventures, where you will feel the real adrenaline when you get behind the wheel of powerful cars, improve your driving skills and master the art of drifting.

name: Mythical Ruins
short_description: Discover a mysterious world without annoying quests in 'Mythical Ruins'. Fight a variety of enemies, explore different biomes and level up your skills in this epic Soulslike adventure. Venture into the hardcore area for the ultimate challenge!

name: Ells Tales: Chicken
short_description: Welcome to the survival horror sokoban! Make your way through the maze of puzzles and try to save the chicken's life.

name: Mossroot
short_description: Mossroot is a party-based tactical-RPG Roguelike. Fight against a monstrous King! Climb the mountain, Increase your power, make dangerous bargains with unknown sources. Recruit allies to help fight against tyranny. Bring them to your Home, Build it to gain more power, and climb again!

name: Morbid Inhale
short_description: Hungry zombies want to devour you. Take the biggest gun and fight them back! Get experience, upgrade skills, use perks, bonuses, and kill them by any means. Shoot, blast, burn, rip and tear!

name: Last Day to Die
short_description: The game offers intense survival gameplay where you and your friends must battle zombies by night and fend off bandits by day in a post-apocalyptic world. Work together to survive!

name: Path of Hero. Story of Dartes
short_description: This fun jRPG will immerse you in a fantasy world. The game makes fun of the clichés of old jRPGs, essentially being a funny parody of the games of our childhood. Immerse yourself in complete absurd satire. Learn professions, hire mercenaries and perform feats as if you were a Hero (Probably).

name: Defiance Survivors
short_description: Defiance Survivors is a fantasy style casual Roguelike game. There are two modes in the game. To become a hero and survive among monsters, Or to become a summoner summoning monsters and hunting heroes. Both modes exist independently and can be freely chosen.

name: Hornet the Vanguard
