short_description: 'Reveal all, deceive all.' Hornet the Vanguard, a mystery-solving adventure game. Solve mysteries and gather information in the exploration part, and uncover the truth in the deduction part! …The key to the case is always with buddy.

name: SPGP Super Polygon Grand Prix
short_description: It's all about speed, it’s all about the competition. Choose a car that suites you and race highly competitive AI at brake neck speeds over a vast variety of locations. Unlock 48 tracks and 20 cars in Progress Mode. Local Multiplayer and Online Leaderboards.

name: ZombiGON
short_description: Pick up any weapons you have. Then deal with the zombies that are intent on eating you. We provide you with lots of weapons and ammunition. Eh! But we're not sure. If this is enough for you to survive in 'ZombiGON'

name: Deep Space Survivor
short_description: Survive massive amount of enemies in space in this top-down action auto-shooter.

name: Apartment No 129
short_description: Emir, who has an interest in mysterious events, steps alone into the abandoned apartment known as 'Apartment No 129' to trace the trail of a paranormal event that occurred in 2009 and shook the country. However, he will find himself in an unexpected confrontation within this horror apartment.

name: Rodland of Pipes
short_description: This is a horror game about pipes and in pipes. Crawl through the pipes, do your job and get out before Rodland and friends find you. But just who is Rodland? Is he really running a small plumbing business or is something more sinister in motion?

name: Mage's Legacy
short_description: In Mage's Legacy, you play as a brave mage who fights monsters, explores mysterious areas, and uses magic to overcome challenges. Bringing along your familiars, you will search for treasures and solve mysteries to uncover mystical stories and the ultimate secrets of this magical world.

name: Feed the Deep
short_description: A lovecraftian roguelite. Dive into procedurally generated undersea caves. Collect gold, upgrade your equipment, and Feed the Deep.

name: Sorrow Asylum 3
short_description: Sorrow Asylum 3 is a looping horror game, a mix of an abandoned asylum and your mind's prison.

name: Beauty Riddle
short_description: 'Beauty Riddle' is a fun click puzzle game, each game level contains a number of word riddles, the answer to each riddle is hidden in the image of the beautiful girl, come and see how many riddles you can solve!

name: RAT MEMORY
short_description: The 3D ratformer game you didn't know you wanted; RAT MEMORY is a 3D platformer game with exploration, in which you will have to complete tasks, such as collecting items and coins, and overcome challenges as a rat trying to discover his present and change his future.

name: 美少女花札紀行 みちのく秘湯恋物語
short_description: カメラマン志望の天草遊也がコンテストの作品を撮るため、東北地方の各所を巡りながら、 ヒロインたちと撮影権をかけた花札で勝負し、物語を進めていくアドベンチャーゲーム。

name: El Mono
short_description: El Mono just as your great-great-great-great-great ancestors intended. It's high pace first-person arcade ape rage where the only limitation is your degenerated Homo sapien bloodline. Come home. Be the monkey they wanted you to be.

name: Lost paradise of Karuta
short_description: 'To those who find living in the present difficult, a visual novel ensemble drama dedicated to life and the human psyche.

name: みんなで推理
short_description: Players throw questions at an AI and deduce the correct answers in this competitive multiplayer game. Compete based on your accuracy rate. Have fun with friends while testing your deductive skills and aim to become the ultimate knowledge champion!

name: Fate/stay night REMASTERED
short_description: Seek the root of the Fate franchise. Return to where it all began.

name: Before The End
short_description: In this game you play as an experienced paranormal investigator. On the way you will need to look for keys from the doors, notes from the staff and those who studied here.

name: Joe Biden Vs. Jeo Boden - Escape From MAGA Chapter 2
short_description: Joe Biden is back as the one term president hoping to become the two time president. November 2024 is only months away but the world is getting more ridiculing by the day. Choose your decisions wisely and help Mister 46 survive his next 3 weeks in office. You must help Joe Escape From MAGA, again.

name: Kingdom Rush 5: Alliance TD
short_description: While a formidable evil emerges, an unexpected alliance is taking shape! It will take the finest warriors of Linirea and the relentless Dark Army to stop it. Beware! Though they may journey side by side the ever-changing winds of fate could swiftly alter their course.

name: KillerNight
short_description: Killer Night is a psychological survival thriller where a group of death row inmates face extreme trials in an isolated mansion to gain freedom. Among them lies a ruthless killer. Will you be able to discover the killer's identity before it's too late?

name: Intravenous 2
short_description: Intravenous 2 is the ultimate blend of tactical gameplay and immersive storytelling. Will you embrace the shadows or confront your foes head-on? The choice is yours. Experience a new era of tactical stealth action. Save lives. Uncover secrets. Take vengeance.

name: Train Valley World
short_description: Train Valley World is an engrossing transport tycoon inspired by the genre classics. Build and manage efficient railroads across the globe, create sophisticated logistics chains, design your own levels*, and become a business mogul – solo or in multiplayer!

name: Tiny Pixels Vol. 1 - Ninpo Blast
short_description: Jump on your hoverbike and blast off for unlimited ninja-themed bullet hell mayhem!

name: Diari
short_description: Arise player, welcome to Diari! Explore the world of Ekrose with Aimacra, giving them insight as she traverses through platforming and puzzles to meet her friend Sirestias. Guided by intuition and emotion, you will shape Aimacra through her journey and how it all ends.

name: SUPER Dungeon Muncher
short_description: Avoid becoming Muncher's next meal in this fast-paced adventure! Control your anger, this game is hard!

name: We Heist Too
short_description: Welcome to the city of Rywadorium! Explore the unique regions of the city and pretend you're a regular citizen with no illegal intentions. Enter people's homes without permission and immerse yourself into a role of a thief in a unique setting of atomic 1960s fiction, at this regular day at 'work'.

name: Lost Castle 2
short_description: 'Lost Castle 2' is a 2D Beat'em up Rogue-Lite game. Explore abundant treasures and items to enhance yourself, master various weapons to showcase your skills, and challenge powerful monsters to demonstrate your strength. A new adventure is calling for treasure hunters!

name: Terra revive
short_description: A simulation of rebuilding a planet after it has been almost completely destroyed. Your task is to make the earth fit for human life again. Survive, build and explore!

name: Mounted War
short_description: Mounted War is a third-person shooter where players ride horses, shoot, and command armies. Deep strategy and action: using military units like archers and cavalry for victory through medieval battles and trade.

name: The Ghost and the Golem
short_description: Can your magic amulet save your Jewish village from destruction? Uncover the truth and forge alliances with soldiers, bandits, anarchists, and demons!

name: Farewell North
short_description: Restore color to the Scottish isles of Farewell North, an atmospheric journey where you play as a border collie on an adventure with your human. Explore land and sea, uncover hidden paths and free wildlife to bring color back to her world, while revealing an emotional story about saying farewell.

name: Attack on I-Ching  进击的易经
short_description: A master needs you to help him practice the I Ching. As a goblin, have you conquered the master in the midst of all kinds of difficulties created by the master? It's a roguelike educational game designed to keep you engaged. Through the game, you will learn the I Ching like never before.

name: Beats of Betrayal
short_description: Beats of Betrayal is an adventure game with roguelike mechanics and rhythm-based combat. Explore dungeons, gain skills and grow stronger to defeat challenging bosses and unlock the secrets surrounding the 'Power of the Waves'!

name: Before Exit: Supermarket
short_description: Before Exit: Supermarket combines features from roguelike with walking simulator. As Supermarket employee you clean up damaged items, wipe up stains, and turn off the lights. Your task is close the store behind you, hoping that all tasks have been completed.

name: Chaos Moon : 1CC Edition
short_description: A classic style SHMUP in the tradition of 80's and 90's vertical scrolling shooters. Maximize your run and get to the top of the High-score Leaderboard. Can you achieve the rank of Fleet Admiral? It's a challenge. Visit our website for a free playable browser demo of the game.

name: 糟糕，我要坠入爱河啦！
short_description: The user takes on the role of the male protagonist Lu Shichuan and embarks on a journey of time and space with a photo. They meet seven beautiful women with completely different personalities and appearances. The final chapter of who you can stay with in the world is up to you to decide.

name: CYBERMATRIX
short_description: CYBERMATRIX is a fast paced game about movement. A place where the style of your moves really matters.

name: SteamWorld Heist II
short_description: Join Captain Leeway and his ragtag crew as they uncover the enigmatic menace threatening the Great Sea. Equip and upgrade your crew for turn-based gunfights packed with ricochet action and engage in real-time naval combat. Get ready to aim, plot, and plunder in this turn-based tactical adventure.

name: Tactics Greed
short_description: Perfect for RTS beginners and veterans alike! 『Tactics Greed』is an action RTS game with deck-building elements. Master unique tactics combining units and magic to climb the global rankings!

name: Bunker Farmer
short_description: Bunker Farmer is a farming arcade game about defending your crops from some unwanted guests. You the player will have access to technology to Grow, Harvest and Defend your crops. When things get a bit too much or you need to research an item its time to return to your bunker for safety.

name: I am Sorry
short_description: 'I am Sorry' is a game where you investigate objects and solve puzzles to uncover the story. Become a janitor, clean the house, and uncover the hidden truths of the story.

name: GraveyardGambit
short_description: GraveyardGambit is an exciting 3D first-person game where you loot graves as a grave robber, evade guards, and buy upgrades. Experience a dark atmosphere, random events, and various weather scenarios.

name: The Gravedigger
short_description: You're hired to dig up graves at a local church, looting valuables while demonic activity escalates. You must find and return all the burnt bones to stop the demonic activity. Each night you will dig for valuables to find bones, fend off growing corruption, and survive to solve the mystery.

name: みんなでクイズ ラビィとふしぎな惑星
short_description: Laby and the Mysterious Planet can be played anytime and with anyone! A quiz game where up to 8 players can play together to win. On a mysterious planet where 'piece of quiz' are floating, you and your robot buddy 'Laby' will try to restore the liveliness of the planet through quizzes!

name: Under the blue horizon
short_description: 'Under the Blue Horizon' is an idle simulation game. Play while performing other tasks on your computer! Place your own aquarium anywhere on your screen, coexisting with your work, games, and more!

name: X Simulator Drone
short_description: Experience stunning drone realism with two difficulty levels. Fly two advanced drones across beautiful maps. Switch perspectives, including a controllable drone camera, for the ultimate piloting challenge.

name: Cataclismo
short_description: Design and build fortresses brick by brick to stand against endless hordes of Horrors in this real-time strategy game with resource management, siege defense, and exploration. Lead from the ramparts, push back the darkness, and hold fast against the creatures of the Mist.

name: Shadowforge
short_description: Shadowforge is a painting software with sandbox features. Upload your own made brushes and share with the Shadowforge community!

name: Wild Americas
short_description: Your work on Mountain Island as a geologist for the multi-national mining company GeoCorp places you at the center of an epic tale with earth-shattering revelations.

name: -HOME- Survival
short_description: -HOME- Survival is an open-world game that is a unique combination of first and thirt person shooter, survival, crafting, and role-playing games. Experience your own path. Whether it's building the home of your dreams, tending to your crops and watching the sun go down...

name: Castaway
short_description: Retrieve your weapons, face bosses to save your dog in a retro adventure focused on 3 dungeons. Finish the Story mode to unlock the Survivor mode: a 50-floor 'Death Tower'. You'll enjoy classic mechanics, charming visual style, and an enchanting soundtrack.

name: Pixel Car Racing: Blocky Crash
short_description: Incredibly addictive, dynamic blocky cars that give you a lot of positive emotions! In Pixel Car Racer you have to take part in a breathtaking racer car game where you have to rush along a track full of secrets, obstacles, bonuses, jumps and finish first.

name: Kinetic Storm
short_description: Annihilate endless swarms of enemies with devastating weaponry, survive this Kinetic Storm by unlocking powerful skills and upgrades. This sci-fi action roguelike will test your skills like no other, with responsive twin-stick controls and unique enemy design.

name: DeathStairwell99F
short_description: You are trapped in a stairwell, and as you delve deeper, the stairwell becomes increasingly abnormal and dangerous. Abnormal event, unknown monster, can you escape alive.

name: The Curiosity
short_description: The protagonist Ken and his friend Jun have come to a certain mountain to visit a rumored ruin. What awaits them there is...

name: Black Goblin
short_description: Black Goblin is a first-person escape type game. In nightmare, You must survive and escape avoiding 'Thing's.

name: 孵道
short_description: 振り返らずに帰るだけのアンリアルホラーアドベンチャー

name: DefenseCraft
short_description: DefenseCraft brings revolutionary new mechanics to the tower defense genre, combining the traditional tower defense style with exploration, crafting, and more! Gather materials to create the ultimate defenses to survive the hostile ecosystem.

name: Operation: Polygon Storm
short_description: A fastpaced, military tug-of-war game with minimal micromanagement. Choose and deploy from a mix of specialized military units to overwhelm the enemy. Experiment with a huge variety of unit compositions, synergies, abilities, and upgrades to lead your army to victory!

name: Director Simulator
short_description: You, who lack talent, always have strange dreams. Until one day, all kinds of beautiful women from dreams entered your life one by one. You will experience an unprecedented legendary journey from a first person perspective.

name: Elevator Warp
short_description: Your goal is simple. Take the elevator to floor 6. But this is no ordinary elevator... Who knows which random floor you'll end up at. A hotel, dungeon, hedge maze, a train? Check the clues on each floor to be able to progress, and achieve the perfect run!

name: Rasvyat Nuclear Power Station
short_description: A co-op experience in which you operate the RBMK-1000 series of reactor.

name: Outta Hand
short_description: Outta Hand lets you embody one of the Hand-People, wide-eyed, hop-happy lab experiments with the power to jump great heights, leap impossible lengths, and shake hands from… really, really far away. Like a whole big dining room away.

name: Inner Darkness
short_description: Inner Darkness is a first-person horror game made in pixelated 3D graphics that immerses you in an atmosphere of loneliness. The gameplay consists in walking around locations, solving riddles.

name: Harmless Lies
short_description: A short 3D Visual Novel with an emotional and dramatic story.

name: Ratten Reich
short_description: Ratten Reich is an RTS focusing on realistic combat in a unique, steampunk/dieselpunk world ripped apart by an ongoing war between rats, mice, cockroaches, and lizards.

name: アパシー 鳴神学園七不思議
short_description: 怖い話を聞いているだけなのに何かおかしい……。新聞部の新人、坂上修一となり、学校新聞の特集のために集まった6人の語り部より怖い話を聞いていきます。語り部は話の途中で坂上に質問や感想を求めてきます。それが選択肢となっており、答えることによって物語が変化していきます。

name: Play Chess with Lady Bongcloud
short_description: Lady Bongcloud... She is generous, cute, and loves the 'Bongcloud Attack', in which the king moves first and goes forward to show his bravery.

name: Wilderness: Survival
short_description: Wilderness: Survival is a single or multiplayer survival game. It is a pirate-like game where you can hunt, mine,fightning ,farming,gun crafting,fishing, fight skeletons and evolve. Duel with your friends etc. You can do. The game is still under development, please give constructive criticism.

name: 50 Pinch Barrage!!
short_description: Shout-inducing 2D side-scrolling action! Alligators! Sharks! Zombies! Escape from a dangerous desert island! Its controls are simple but deep! Use your wit and technique to overcome perfectly balanced stages that will have you saying 'Just one more try!!' as you play over and over again!

name: KOKORONULL
short_description: 'KOKORONULL' is a hardcore action game that adds the element of 'slipperiness' to the usual platform action gameplay. Conquering all 20 stages is an impressive achievement.

name: BlackJack Math Trainer
short_description: Level up your BlackJack mathematic skills along with discovering many secrets, features and challenges!

name: Blubber
short_description: This game is a mechanically-styled flying hazard avoidance game

name: Elder Legacy
short_description: Elder Legacy - This is a role-playing game. Embark on a soulful journey inspired by Boreyian myths and legends, filled with vibrant and unforgettable experiences. uncover the mystery behind the attempt to conquer the noble Boreyian people.

name: Just Crow Things
short_description: You're a little crow trying to prove herself to the world. Make new animal friends, poop on unsuspecting hoomans, and steal all the shiny trinkets! Each level is a little sandbox full of fun items to discover and puzzles to solve, while leaving a bit of chaos behind. Why? Just caws!

name: A room you can't exit unless you find the numbers
short_description: You have been trapped in a room you can't exit unless you find the numbers. Let's find the numbers inside the room and escape.

name: Demonsomnia
short_description: Demonsomnia is a CO-OP multiplayer bodycam horror game about the impact of a nuclear reaction. Radiation has spread everywhere, put on your gas mask, go to the forest, collect objects and return to the mansion. Your goal is to collect evidence with the equipment and hunt the demon in the mansion.

name: MENSEKI Genius!: Area maze puzzles
short_description: That satisfying feeling that comes from solving a puzzle! Presenting the novel Japanese logic puzzle game that's been attracting attention from around the world! This Genius version is a compilation of the most difficult puzzles included in Menseki: Area Maze Puzzles, for the most expert players.

name: Werewolf: The Apocalypse — Purgatory
short_description: A choice-driven RPG thriller set in the World of Darkness universe. Step into the shoes of Samira, a young werewolf refugee in Poland, as she battles dark forces and loneliness, caught between rage and despair. How will your story unfold?

name: Abnormal1999:Sector 49
short_description: Abnormal1999: Sector 49 is a challenging mystery puzzle game. You play as Sam, searching for your daughter in the abandoned Sector 49. Collect 10 consciousnesses to open the portal and escape.

name: Targeted -10 Days
short_description: Can you survive 10 days in this anomaly-finding game? Stay vigilant, because YOU ARE THE TARGET!

name: Choo-Choose
short_description: So, have you ever heard of the Trolley Problem? Do you know the price of the choices you make? How far are you ready to go to act according to your values? Will you sacrifice the life of the other to hold the moral high ground?

name: HITM3
short_description: Help your love Dei make his own movie. HITM3 is a third person, slice of life adventure where you control Nam on his days in Santiago de Chile.

name: The Last Sight
short_description: You started a neighborhood security program, which gradually expanded in size. Over time, it evolved to monitor not only homes but also warehouses, gas stations and various other locations. However, as your program grew, it began attracting the attention of dubious individuals.

name: Haunted: Attack of the Dead Men
short_description: Inspired by the most epic and little known battle of the Great War, Haunted: Attack of the Dead Men puts you in the middle of a chaotic fight for your life against hundreds of resurrected Russians. Put your arsenal of 8 weapons to good use through 14 levels as you rid the world of this nightmare...

name: Planetaries
short_description: Experience a vast Sci-fi open-world survival TD game set on a distant planet deep in the universe. Craft, build, mine, trade, explore, and survive in this alien world. Collect Data and defend against waves of enemies seeking to banish you. Enjoy the adventure in Singleplayer or Multiplayer.

name: Whisper Forest
short_description: Whisper Forest is a Japanese-style horror game where 'Nesting creatures.' lurks. Players collect Amulets and offer them to lanterns.

name: 咫尺遥心-Proof of existence
short_description: 即使存在相同的目的，每个人也会有各自的实现方式，理念背道而驰的两人，就算共处一室，也始终无法理解对方。 能跨越这道鸿沟的，就只有……

name: Minigames Mayhem
short_description: Minigames Mayhem is a fun collection of minigames, that can bring joy for players not only in single-player but also with friends in your living room or across vast distances. Try to beat the high scores, compete with others, and bring mayhem on other players in many simple but fun games!

name: Goblin and Coins II: The Lost Recipes
short_description: A much easier stand-alone expansion to Goblin and Coins II. Use unlimited continues to run and double-jump through 25 handcrafted levels, and retrieve the recipes lost in the midnight raid from the original game.

name: Nodebuster
short_description: Nodebuster is a short, experimental incremental game about busting nodes and destroying reality.

name: Nine Tereasures of Liuyin
short_description: This is a dark, soul like role-playing game, trying to create a different experience in this genre. The protagonist fights against a powerful enemy in this city in search of a divine artifact.

name: Knights of the Road
short_description: An adventure game with focus on acrobatics and discovering secrets. Classic platformer gameplay in the spirit of the 8-bit era games.

name: Flob and the Shattered Dimension
short_description: After an experiment went wrong, a lab assistant embarks on an adventure to rescue his creator, the great scientist Dr. Franz, who is now trapped in another dimension. Join Flob on this journey, explore hostile environments, and rescue Dr. Franz.

name: Afterplace
short_description: Made by one person, an open world adventure game filled with silly characters and terrible secrets. Explore the woods, find hidden paths, hack and slash through strange monsters, and try very, very hard not to break reality. Or don't. You do you.

name: Rollin' Along
short_description: Rollin' Along is an endless marble shooter game about an armadillo's journey! Play as Arma the Armadillo on her quest to save her cactus friends. See how far you can last through multiple in-game nights while using different power-ups and strategies!

name: Lexicon
short_description: You awaken in a sealed tomb surrounded by darkness. Your new body flows with an unfamiliar, powerful energy. Reality calls you to return from the world between worlds. You see a glimmer of light that pierces the darkness... Who will you meet? What will you discover? #duckinadungeon

name: Rogue Tiles
short_description: Rogue Tiles merges tower defense with roguelike elements, offering a dynamic experience where you shape the expanding path. Unlock, build, upgrade, and defend against waves of enemies.

name: PopIt!
short_description: PopIt! is the popular, poptastic game of popping possibilities! This fun clicker game offers three distinct game modes and leaderboards!

name: Shift Legacy Collection
short_description: Step into the monochromatic and mind-bending universe of the Shift series developed by Antony Lavelle, where black and white landscapes hide more than meets the eye. This collection unites the original four titles - Shift, Shift 2, Shift 3, and Shift 4.

name: 交织的印记
short_description: 'The Intertwined Imprints' is a yuri visual novel that tells a story about youth, growth, and love. Due to an accident, Mei Yu was temporarily brought back to the village where she spent her childhood. She didn't think it was a good idea, but... she didn't feel like she had much of a choice.

name: 高温计划 Heat Plan
short_description: Heat Plan is a strategy roguelike game about unit placement. Make good use of randomly appearing units and buffs, and strategically place your units within the limited grid spaces on the board to earn more coins and achieve the set goal.

name: Bloodless
short_description: Stylish, action-adventure game featuring counter-based, non-lethal combat centered around ronin Tomoe's signature dash-counter mechanic, fighting with nothing but her bare fists to disarm her former allies, the samurai army of Shogun Akechi.

name: Black Myth: Wukong
short_description: Black Myth: Wukong is an action RPG rooted in Chinese mythology. You shall set out as the Destined One to venture into the challenges and marvels ahead, to uncover the obscured truth beneath the veil of a glorious legend from the past.

name: Treasure Journey
short_description: A charming puzzle adventure where you'll guide a pirate across uncharted islands to uncover hidden treasures!

name: PBN  - Da Game
short_description: PBN? Mais qu'est-ce que c'est? Et ça veut dire quoi? Tout ça, vous le découvrirez en jouant à l'incroyable aventure PBN - Da Game. Un jeu ou vous rencontrerez vos meilleurs amis. Enfin un jeu calme, sans difficultés, et sans méchant ! Vraiment ? Un jeu à jouer seul ou sans amis.

name: Mechanophagia
short_description: Mechanophagia is a challenging bullet hell shooter with roguelite elements, set in a dark and gritty sci-fi world. Blast through waves of fleshy aberrations and defeat monstrous bosses. Can you outmaneuver the relentless enemy onslaught and save the robots from their inevitable extinction?

name: Lamina Island
short_description: The legendary hero trainer Evolym has taken on a new pupil. Being cursed as a slime, she will need your assistance. It is up to you to take the promising mage Neemu from zero to hero.

name: Deitrus
short_description: Conquer complex and comical fast-paced grid-based combat as Wren and Chloe, an unlikely duo about to discover just how much they don't know about the world of Deitrus. An Hour Long Action RPG with a Non-Linear Narrative.

name: The Simp - 舔狗
short_description: A horror decryption game. The player needs to carefully observe the interactive items in the scene and deduce how to crack them. Time to test courage and patience!

name: Between Life & Darkness
short_description: Explore the mind of young Léa as she experiences the trauma of losing a loved one. Solve puzzles and help her overcome obstacles in her life.

name: Dungeon Diver
short_description: An arcade-like maze crawler full of treasures and traps!

name: Roulette Club
short_description: Play against the devil and experience the thrilling roulette game. Accept the call from hell and challenge other online players in PVP betting points to become the undisputed winner in the club!

name: Pantsu!
short_description: Experience the ultimate thrill of a 2D side-scrolling endless runner game, controlling your character to jump, dodge obstacles, challenge yourself for higher scores, and enjoy relaxing background music.

name: SMITE 2
short_description: Become a god and wage war in SMITE 2, the Unreal Engine 5-powered sequel to the legendary third-person MOBA. Join our 24/7 Closed Alpha, where we are forging a challenging, team-based, mythological Battleground. Become a Founder today to jump into the action and be a part of the development.

name: Myth Survivor
short_description: 'Myth Survivor' is a super cool high-speed action game. Multiple character choices, dozens of skills, different combinations have different skill effects, a higher degree of freedom, fight against the incoming alien beasts, crazy output, and experience violent and fast-paced battles.

name: Magical Monsters
short_description: Magical Monster is a casual action game with heavy Rogue-like elements where you explore randomly generated lands. Play at your own pace as you slay monsters, level, upgrade and make a solid build. But do it before you face the champion of the land.

name: ONE BTN BOSSES
short_description: It's One Button Bosses, it's all in the name. You have one button. There are big bosses to beat. Push, tap, and bash in the handcrafted campaign or in the roguelike rifts.

name: Engraven
short_description: Engraven is a single player sci-fi real time tactics game. Build and customize your regiment of soldiers and fight endless hordes of sorcerers and graven thralls.

name: Volleyborne: Unbound Horizons
short_description: Volleyborne: Unbound Horizons redefines sports gaming with its groundbreaking first-person volleyball experience. Offering realism and immersion, it brings every aspect of real-life volleyball to your screen with unmatched precision. From powerful spikes to insane digs, it mirrors every court move.

name: Hour of Survival: Zombie Craft
short_description: Navigate a post-apocalyptic world, where every decision can mean life or death. Scavenge for food, water, and supplies to keep your character alive in the face of constant danger.

name: End Gate - The Last Passenger
short_description: You wake up, alone, in a hypersleep box, with no memories left. You find yourself in an enormous space station, orbiting with a strange asteroid, around a gigantic black hole. And now, it's time to search, everywhere, to understand who you were. And most importantly, what's left to do here.

name: Terminal ESC
short_description: NO DOCS. NO TUTORIAL. NO ESCAPE. Tackle an evolving spectrum of puzzles within a simulated computer system using only terminal commands. Inspired by a bad day with a package manager.

name: Dream Warrior
short_description: Can you, Dream Warrior, defeat the Demon Lord? Enter the Dream World in this streamlined, retro RPG and find out! It's harder than you might think, because you're no great hero. No, you are the town drunk.

name: Circuit Runner
short_description: Circuit Runner is a fast-paced cyberpunk game where you collect resources to escape a dystopian tower. Use active and passive skills to outwit enemies and overcome obstacles. Compete on Leaderboards for ultimate bragging rights in this thrilling race for freedom.

name: What's done is Done
short_description: A narrative-driven puzzle game about souls and forgetting. On the brink of reincarnation, she loses all her memories, and her soul is scattered. The memories of lingering spirits on the bridge seem to be connected to her story...

name: Kiopioke!
short_description: Experience the whimsical world of a quirky 2D puzzle platformer about a resilient bird with a broken wing. Master the unique mechanics of wall-poking to launch yourself through challenging levels. Meet a colorful cast of friends and foes as you navigate this delightful adventure!

name: GUNDAM BREAKER 4
short_description: Create your own ultimate Gundam in the newest Gundam Breaker! With more customizable parts than ever before, you finally have the freedom to build your perfect Gunpla. Test it in battle using the brand new dual-weapon system and break parts off of your enemies and add them to your collection.

name: HopHop Fox
short_description: Hop Hop Fox is a fun puzzle game for adults and kids! Enjoy fun and stimulating puzzle gameplay, play through the offline puzzle sets, and create your own to share online!

name: CBO TD
short_description: CBO TD is a build your own maze tower defense. Protect your castle from hordes of mobs with different classes of towers.

name: Laser Tanks
short_description: Laser Tanks is a fast-paced top down shooter game where you battle against alien monsters across diverse environments using weapons and laser tanks. The game features wild monsters, numerous weapons, laser tanks to operate, and a never-ending Dungeon Survivor Mode for endless adventures.

name: Day of Invasion: Reloaded
short_description: Day of Invasion: Reloaded is a First Person Zombie-Shooter that takes place within the Horton-Genetics Disaster of Milespring. Find Weapons to fight your way through hordes of Infected!

name: Lurch
short_description: A 4-person co-op horror game where teamwork is the key as players face malevolent demons in a mysterious mansion. An immersive experience with unpredictable AI that continuously changes and adapts to the players’ behavior. Can you conquer your fears and escape?

name: Ouija Escape VR
short_description: BEWARE THE EVIL THAT IS OUIJA. now you must escape the evil and save your soul before its to late. experience the scares and the dark truth behind what happened. each question you ask the board, you might not like the answers can you survive the terror.

name: 100 hidden Cthulhu fish 2
short_description: 100 hidden Cthulhu fish 2 is a hidden objects / clicker game. There are 100 fish hiding on each map. Your task is to find them all

name: Crime Scene Cleaner
short_description: Once you get tangled with the mob, you will forever be a part of the mob. At least they pay a decent salary and all you have to do is clean up after their dirty work, but you know what you’re doing. So clean crime scenes, earn as much money as you can, and get ready for the next mission.

name: Paris in 2000 Years
short_description: 'Paris in 2000 Years' is a city-builder game focused on the history of Paris. From the Gallo-Roman era to the Middle Ages and the Renaissance, you can construct, upgrade, and beautify various buildings. Completing historical quests will also reward you with iconic landmark architectures.

name: Forklift Simulator
short_description: Start your career in logistics today in Forklift Simulator! Take on a variety of different missions, a selection of vehicles and an extensive career mode in which you can put your skills to the test. Are you ready for the challenges ahead?

name: Floops Big House Adventure
short_description: Shoot, loot, and toot your way through Saturday morning cartoon inspired Floops Big House Adventure! This love letter to 90's and Nickelodeon cartoon style will have you rolling with laughter as you defeat hordes of evil monsters and giant disgusting bosses.

name: The Yamamura Estate
short_description: Are you ready to face your nightmares?

name: The Candy Adventure
short_description: Dive into The Candy Adventure! Join your friend after falling through a magical portal and getting lost in a world of enchanted sweets. On an epic journey home. Alone or in cooperation, every moment is a delightful surprise. Adventure, friendship and sweetness await you!

name: Renaissance Kingdom Wars
short_description: The year is 1510. As wars rage across Europe, Africa, and the Middle East, it is the age of gunpowder and mercenaries - that changed the course of history. You can do it as well, going from a leader of men to the ruler of an empire in this unique mix of RTS and grand strategy.

name: Memetomo
short_description: To Be a Cat Meme Master!

name: Ducks in a Row
short_description: Help Mama Duck navigate parks, factories, and more in this super cute puzzler, and bring all her baby ducks home!

name: Fwog
short_description: Frogs don't walk, and neither do fwogs! Hop, jump and swing your way through each stage in this unforgiving 2D-platformer. Be prepared to fall again and again and again as you slowly learn what it takes to fwog.

name: The Maker
short_description: 『The Maker』A 3D immersive puppeteer simulation short game. Welcome to an elegant night in the never-ending rain.

name: Seal the Rift
short_description: Discover an endlessly replayable roguelike deckbuilder. Craft a unique deck, collect powerful relics, harness potent magic and enhance cards with 'Boost' to overcome the challenges ahead as you set out to Seal the Rift!

name: Dr. Planet
short_description: Create mini planets and civilizations. Let them flourish, or let them fall - literally. The choice is yours, Doctor Planet.

name: Unbodied
short_description: Unbodied, a small adventure in which you play a skeleton whose body has been stolen. Control your magic wand, solve all the puzzles and find all the spells to finish with the powerful wizard and thus, recover what is yours.

name: Girls on Campus, from Freshmen to Faculty, All Fall for Me!
short_description: In this exciting love interaction game, players act as a photography-loving sophomore who, after being knocked out during a shoot, finds themselves entangled in various indescribable scenarios with female seniors, juniors, and a married teacher!

name: Harlot's Diary
short_description: In a ruthless world where you've lost everything, only desperate measures remain. Fight to survive as a sex worker and reach the top, avoiding deceit, murderers, and abuse on your path to success.

name: New Yankee: Through the History Mirror
short_description: Guide John and Mary and their friends on two thrilling parallel escapades filled with excitement, perils, and regular errands! Explore mysterious lands and times, navigate mystical phenomena as you join them in traversing space and time.

name: 拯救骑士 save the knight
short_description: 拯救骑士 is a 2D horizontal panel pixel puzzle game where players take on the role of a female hero to challenge various powerful enemies and save the knight.

name: Finding Mosey
short_description: Find your cat Mosey, choosing your degree of destruction and dedication. Fight, sneak, or talk your way into new areas and upgrade your character along the way as the search gets messy. Loot ridiculous items and discover hidden stories that help you explore this open world.

name: Squiggle Drop
short_description: Draw shapes to solve physics puzzles! Over 250 levels each with their own unique objective. Put your brain to the test by making bridges, levers, weights and more. Iterate on your solutions again and again until you complete the goals.

name: Magic wand
short_description: This game immerses you in a captivating world of immortals and heroes

name: Pape Rangers
short_description: 'Pape Rangers' is an exhilarating indie roguelike game where you'll choose different classes to defeat monsters in the caverns. Build unique and powerful playstyles for each class through a variety of skills, and even discover hidden talents and classes! Every new game offers a fresh experience.

name: Skulltide
short_description: Skeletal mischief reigns as the Skulltide begins! Join the undead in co-op adventures as the skeleton of your dreams, or lead them yourself, and hunt down the necromancers who reanimated you. Build, throw, and enchant your bones... but try not to misplace them along the way!

name: Made in Tower
short_description: Go up to the 100th floor！

name: Ghost Girl Lasling (G-rated)
short_description: This is the story of Lasling, a genius girl with excellent working abilities, who becomes a ghost after an accident. The only person in the world she is visible to is Mofft, the main male protagonist. Their meeting is as if a fateful encounter and love story begins.

name: EternAlgoRhythm
short_description: A 10-key rhythm game where both the notes you hear and the notes you play are procedurally generated. Tap and hold notes through eternal, ever-changing melodies!

name: Chushpan Simulator 2
short_description: On their way from Ugryupinsk, Egor and Nastya find themselves caught in the middle of a conflict between two gangs — the Pavers and the Glaziers. Egor must find common ground with the Glaziers, deal with the Pavers, and rescue Nastya

name: Terrors Of North - Finnish Cabin
short_description: You think you're in luck for getting a cabin for such a good price but you will soon find out why the previous owner wanted to get rid of it. Will you survive the Finnish Cabin experience?

name: Метаморфоз
short_description: Интерактивная визуальная новелла в жанре мистики. Майки помещают на лечение в необычное заведение, где он сталкивается со сверхъестественными явлениями и готовится к метаморфозу, чтобы попасть в иной мир.

name: Iron Diamond
short_description: Explore the mysterious island of Kindara in this vibrant 2D action-adventure. Fight and platform your way through jungles, icy peaks, castles, and crystal caverns in a non-linear interconnected world. Adventure awaits!

name: Keyboard Souls
short_description: Oh my friend, are you one of the strongest typists in the world? Come and try this typing rouge shooting game, practice and become more stronger. Finally you will prove yourself.

name: Unwanted Xmas Gift Burning Simulator
short_description: Under Santa's watchful eye, burn wood logs, wrapped gifts, or a random mix from the elves' workshop. Enjoy the mesmerizing fire as your pile of gifts turns to ashes. Just sit back, relax, and let the magic of the flames warm you. Happy burning!

name: project HECK
short_description: This is a casual and entertaining typing game that lets you experience the thrill of hacking systems by rapidly typing on your keyboard. Whether stress-testing your keyboard or unwinding after a tough day, this game has got you covered!

name: Brave Quest
short_description: 'Brave Quest' is an ARPG with a behind the scenes perspective. By taking missions in the main city and challenging various powerful boss, players can obtain random equipment with various entries.

name: 魔塔史话：开篇
short_description: 'The History of Magic Tower: Opening' is a fantasy adventure game based on the 'Magic Tower' game mode. This work is set against the backdrop of various traditional magical tower worldviews and tells the story of events that occurred before the time point of the classic game '50-layer Magic Tower'.

name: Yarimono
short_description: The protagonist's life takes a turn after their partner Yarimon learns the ultra-invincible move, the 'Cheat Tackle'. While challenging various trainers to participate in the Yarimon tournament, the protagonist unexpectedly discovers the secrets of this world.

name: Black Wolfberry:WuJing
short_description: This is a third-person action shooter where you need to break through a maze

name: FOREST GOD
short_description: Forest God is a psychological horror game from the first person. The investigation of Agent X of the secret service turns into an endless journey deep into the universe, filled with abnormal incidents, the nature of which is previously unknown to anyone.

name: Horror Office
short_description: As you open your eyes, it's already deep night, you find yourself waking up in the office due to overtime work. But tonight is different: strange sounds fill the air, and a knife-wielding rabbit is hunting you. Use anything you can find to escape, solve puzzles, and get out before it's too late.

name: I SUPPOSE
short_description: A story of a simple walk home, with a sprinkling of intrusive thoughts. Make a few choices, decide what's best, and please, try not to overthink.

name: The Journey into the Virtual Void
short_description: The Journey into the Virtual Void is a captivating low-poly VR platformer/adventure game, reminiscent of classic 90s platformers like Mario 64.

name: Sakura Succubus 9
short_description: In the ninth part of the Sakura Succubus series, Hiroki returns to Astoria with Ayu as she prepares for the concert of a lifetime: a joint show with her fellow idol Mihama Shizuru. Will this concert end in success, and will Hiroki's harem get even bigger?

name: Rent A Car Simulator 24
short_description: Rent A Car Simulator. Start by renting your first car. Expand your rental car fleet by purchasing different vehicles and grow your car rental business. Drive your cars and get them fixed when they break down. Find new customers. You can also develop your Rent A Car business by playing Co-Op.

name: American Election Simulator
short_description: Plot your way through an American political campaign as you go head-to-head against a rival political party. Make tough decisions as you travel across the country and try to earn enough votes to become the next President of the United States!

name: Dog vs Cat Othello
short_description: Cute Growth-Based OthelloA growth-based Othello game featuring cute dog and cat characters. Flip your opponent's character and evolve my character into stronger one! Playable in both single-player and local two-player modes.

name: Car Manufacture
short_description: Car Manufacture is an automotive tycoon game. Start in the beginning of the XX century and create thriving business. Build cars, manage people, expand your plant and research new technology. Make tons of money and stay on top.

name: 逐鹿问鼎：君王成长计划/Strive For Power:King Growth Program
short_description: As a king who strategizes within the royal court, govern the country, engage in trade and diplomacy, nurture capable ministers, and enjoy the company of countless beauties in the palace! Immerse yourself in the life of an emperor, holding the world in the palm of your hand!

name: Exoracer
short_description: Compete for the world record in this fast-paced multiplayer racing platformer! Dash through short and fun levels, or be creative and build your own levels in the fully fledged level editor!

name: Retail Company Simulator
short_description: Run your retail company. Sign contracts with leading brands, order new products, meet customer needs, and never let your customers leave the store empty-handed. Hire new workers, expand your store, and enjoy the growth of your retail company.

name: SPIRITGRAPHER: THE ASYLUM 99
short_description: This first-person horror detective. You are a spiritgrapher, your camera can see what is beyond the reach of the human eye. Head to an abandoned hospital and shoot a report about supernatural events.

name: Caesar's Revenge
short_description: Caesar’s Revenge is a die-and-retry retro FPS set in classical antiquity. Bring retribution to the greedy senator’s that betrayed you. Become the fall of Rome.

name: Shadow of the Ninja - Reborn
short_description: After 34 years in the shadows, prepare to see this legendary action adventure in a new light! Looking and playing better than ever before, Shadow of the Ninja - Reborn is Tengo Project’s remake of a cult classic, that the fans have been waiting for.

name: The Cummunist Manifesto: Dommy Mommy Commie Adventure
short_description: The Cummunist Manifesto is a kinetic novel retelling of the classic Communist Work 'The Communist Manifesto' by Karl Marx except Karl is now a busty babe.

name: Hero Emblems II
short_description: Hero Emblems II is a Japanese-style RPG that combines elements from side-scrollers and Match-3 games. Players will control members of the Night Chasers and embark on an adventure to become heroes in order to help the people who are suffering.

name: 200 Hidden House Cats
short_description: Uh-oh! 200 mischievous house cats are causing mayhem in homes everywhere! Embark on a purr-suit to find them all!

name: 不思議な世界の観光日記
short_description: This game is finding them and trying to clear the game. I can't give away any secrets, so I can't give you any detailed explanations. You'll just have to buy it! Tom: 'But it's only available in Japanese language. Is there no English version?' 'sorry. then I took an arrow in the knee... '

name: Cat Quest III
short_description: In Cat Quest III you play as a purrivateer in a freely explorable 2.5D open-world swarming with Pi-rats. You can sail the seas in your ship for treasures galore! But prepare for peril, as the Pirate King aims to hunt you down...

name: EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 25
short_description: Hit like you mean it with FieldSENSE™ powered by BOOM Tech. Experience how the new physics-informed dynamic tackling system unlocks realistic collisions & new gameplay animations on both sides of the ball.

name: Billy Blade: Temple of Time
short_description: As Billy you'll have to travel to Ancient Persia, The Ice Age, and The Caribbean and hack and slash your way to the top in order to fight The Guardians of Time. Each level challenges the player with platform jumping as well as sword fighting and also simple puzzle solving.

name: DEATH IN UNISON
short_description: Survive the world's deadliest psychopaths. Experience a unique 2-player co-op experience that puts your teamwork and communication to the test. Complete your duties alone or with a partner in a prison like no other.

name: Sins of a Solar Empire II
short_description: Battle for galactic dominance in this real-time 4X strategy game with unrivaled scale! You’ll explore, expand, exploit, and exterminate through military force, diplomacy, trade, culture, influence, and other underhanded tactics.

name: Orbs of Chaos
short_description: Harness the Orbs of Chaos! Choose 3 orbs each run to create 10 overpowered spells in real time in this noisy action roguelite. Slay Lovecraftian horrors and face deadly bosses every 3 minutes. Embrace the Chaos and uncover the unholy secrets of a grotesque world, all set to a haunting soundtrack.

name: The Violinist
short_description: If you love the violin, classical music, or any instrument, this vertical rhythm game is for you.Rosin up your bow, tune your violin, and launch yourself into musical success.

name: The Spewnicorn
short_description: Build the ultimate deck of cards and wield it to defeat the Gatekeepers! A cute and colorful roguelike full of fantastical whimsy!

name: Ojol The Game
short_description: Experience what it's like to be a taxibike driver.

name: FAIRY TAIL: DUNGEONS
short_description: Fairy Tail: Dungeons is a deck-building rogue-lite featuring characters from the Fairy Tail series. Collect Magic Cards based on moves from the series to build your own unique deck and take down powerful monsters as you head for the dungeon depths!

name: The Crimson Diamond
short_description: Follow amateur geologist and reluctant detective Nancy Maple to the ghost town of Crimson, Ontario to investigate the discovery of a massive diamond in this retro-inspired, EGA text parser mystery adventure!

name: Hadley's Run: A Starship Saga
short_description: Stranded in a distant galaxy, portal jump your way home and defeat the DraadMek in this roguelite space shooter adventure. Unlock epic upgrades, explore alien galaxies, make friends, find love and do battle against a relentless alien AI threat.

name: Drug Dealer Sim: Street Hustle
short_description: Drug Dealer Sim: Street Hustle is a thrilling journey from a small-time gangster to the revered Godfather of Hollywood, Las Vegas, and Chicago in the Prohibition Era!

name: Rocket Jump Race
short_description: Have you ever wondered what would be races like if wheels never invented? You are about to find out. Rocket Jump Race is a FPS racing game that we compete with the explosive force of our weapons. If you are here to be the last player standing by destroying your rivals, you came to the wrong place.

name: Holy Heroes
short_description: Cooperative gameplay for 1 to 4 players on a single computer using keyboards and controllers. Choose from 9 distinct hero classes to explore diverse floors and biomes, battle monsters, and acquire upgrades, equipment, and items.

name: Colorizing
short_description: Coloring by numbers game for relaxation. This coloring book is a guarantee of good mood.

name: Love is...
short_description: 'Love is...' is a hidden picture game with emotional art by artist 'Puuung'. It is a healing game that can relieve stress and excitement like relaxation, and enjoy the charming emotional coloring game that spreads at your fingertips.

name: GONZO VR
short_description: A VR stealth game about a ridiculous conspiracy involving cults, nukes, aliens & more. Snap pictures, use slingshots and realistic guns, sneak, distract enemies, and explore a variety of environments as you seek out the mysterious mastermind behind it all.

name: Starground
short_description: Build a formidable factory and go dungeoning alone or with friends. Solve logic puzzles and automate resource collection and crafting, or venture into dungeons filled with dangers and rewards. Find your own ideal gameplay balance, as any unique path will advance the story!

name: Unreal Wukong
short_description: ' Unreal WuKong' is an open-world action RPG based on the classic Chinese mythological novel, 'Journey to the West.' You will play as the Monkey King, Sun Wukong, embarking on a perilous and wondrous adventure to save the world by vanquishing demons that have traveled from the future.

name: Ant Keeping Simulator
short_description: Grow, feed and care for your colony of mighty ants in a realistic semi-idle simulation of ant keeping. Created in collaboration with ant keeping enthusiasts, Ant Keeping Simulator will be an accurate experience to ant keepers.

name: Boosted Survivors
short_description: Survive waves! Choose new abilities! Modify your hero in any way you like! Craft a powerful masterpiece, or a horrible concoction of awful ideas! Discover secrets! Sandbox your way to victory! Boost! Survive! Boosted Survivors!

name: XOverse
short_description: Dive into this innovative version of the classic with exciting new modes and features that will keep you entertained for hours. Customize your game board, mix up the game styles, and challenge your friends for endless fun!

name: Circuit Artist
short_description: Draw and simulate your microchip using NANDs and pixels. Plan and optimize your circuit layout. Explore and experiment digital logic concepts. Solve puzzles. Interact with your circuit. Save, share and load your circuits as simple PNG images. Create your own level using lua script.

name: Adrenaline Rampage
short_description: Survivor platformer. Action Roguelike. You are trapped in a distorted space city. You need to survive and return home. Standing in your way are hordes of techno zombies. And something strange is going on in this space city.

name: Toy Shire
short_description: Are you prepared for a thrilling toy army tower defense adventure? Welcome to the Toy Shire! Battle diverse foes in various locations, defend your family, and repel foes from your area. Save the world by strengthening your defense with toy towers!

name: Typing Test
short_description: TypingTest – Fast and Exciting Typing Challenge Where speed and accuracy meet fun! Play solo or multiplayer, improve your typing skills, and compete with friends. Available in 13 languages with detailed stats to track your progress. Join the TypingTest community and become a typing master!

name: Aestik
short_description: Make impactful decisions in moral dilemma situations, which will change the course of your journey through this atmospheric, hand-drawn metroidvania. Explore the hazardous paths of the Realm of Aestik and fight its corrupted inhabitants as you unravel its deep-rooted mysteries.

name: Before They Wake
short_description: Set in the summer of 1984, The story follows Alfred Baptiste as he venture into isolation world as he battles a mutating virus that caused him temporary paraplegia. Help him find solace and a cure before its too late.—Will you save him?

name: Pure Golf
short_description: This immersive, relaxing 3D golf simulator lets you hone your skills on 6 stunning courses inspired by real-world locations. Set your tee time, choose your tee box, and play in a peaceful sunrise or test your skills in a thrilling thunderstorm! No gimmicks, no microtransactions – just golf.

name: Wowo Island
short_description: A alpaca arrives at a place called Wowo Island and begins a leisurely and happy adventure. You can level up and there are many magical weapons and monsters on the island. Start your adventure now.

name: Parse-O-Rhythm
short_description: Parse-O-Rhythm is a rhythm game about slashing your way through errors in files! Slice and dice your way through positive and negative errors with nothing but the mouse and two buttons!

name: Fishing Tale
short_description: Fishing Tale is a relaxing fishing adventure game where you catch over 40 unique fish across diverse environments like oceans, lakes, and rivers. Customize your character, track your catches in a detailed journal, and enjoy the soothing sounds of nature.

name: Fly Me To The Home!
short_description: One Home, Two Boots, Infinite Retry! Simple & Challenging jet boots homecoming action game using only two buttons

name: Walter Walnut
short_description: Glide, collect nuts and slap birds in this small, casual 3d adventure. Play as Walter Walnut, a gliding squirrel on a quest to find the mythical golden hazelnut.

name: ODDADA
short_description: A tactile music maker with endless freedom to play! Use gadgets, gizmos and funky melodic toys to piece together a hand-crafted music track. Share what you make! Unlock new instruments! ODDADA!

name: Duel Hell Purgatory
short_description: One weapon. One character. One hit - one kill. Equal conditions for everyone. At any time. Find and eliminate your enemy without getting hit in a tactical and atmospherically dense PVP experience with a slow pace. The only thing that makes the difference in DHP is you.

name: Cute Fames Adventure
short_description: Cute Fames Adventure, Is a Turn Based - RPG, Where you turn back into a human! Utilizing two protagonists to fight, Run and discover new areas! The main goal being to find a way to return to normal, With the game's story.

name: Thank Goodness You're Here!
short_description: Thank Goodness You're Here! is an absurd comedy slapformer set in the bizarre Northern English town of Barnsworth. As a traveling salesman, take the time to see the sights and meet the locals, who are very eager to give you a series of increasingly odd jobs…

name: 通天之井The Well of Heaven-Reaching
short_description: the Well of Heaven-reaching is a platforming game. Choose from a variety of jumps where you'll need to make your way through traps and obstacles to reach the top of the Well of Heaven-reaching.

name: Lu[Idle]
short_description: Lu[Idle] is an Incremental game with Idle and Clicker elements as well as pixel art visuals and music.

name: Tech Store Simulator
short_description: Run your own electronic shop! Stock shelves with the latest tech gadgets, set prices to attract customers, handle payments, hire and manage staff, and customize your store layout.Create the ultimate tech shopping experience in your Tech Shop Simulator!

name: Fertiliel - Cupid Simulator
short_description: As a cupid in this visual novel, help couples have great conversations and get together on dates! These couples you create will have many kids and help repopulate Earth.

name: Big Adventure: Trip to Europe 8 - Collector's Edition
short_description: AviGames presents the eighth game in the series of games 'Big Adventure: Trip to Europe 8'. It is a brand new hidden object game with an exciting new way of searching for objects and a lot of new interesting mini-games.

name: Level Zero: Extraction
short_description: Tactical extraction shooter meets immersive survival horror. Play as rival mercenaries fighting for loot, or as alien monsters hunting humans from the shadows. Solo or with friends, experience this unique dark take on asymmetrical PvPvE multiplayer.

name: Stupid Cars
short_description: BECOME A BACK SEAT DRIVER

name: Crypt Custodian

name: Visions of Mana
short_description: Explore a world of elemental spirits and adventure in the latest Mana action-RPG.

name: Office Fight
short_description: You’ve been unfairly laid off by Mega Corp and the news kills you. Literally. As a vengeful spirit, use your ghostly power to fling cups, chairs and tables at your co-workers all in the name of revenge. Start fights and watch the destruction unfold in this casual physics-based destruction game.

name: Next of Kin
short_description: Next of Kin is an emotional story about Thomas's endeavors to find his lost wife, Martha. Solve puzzles, find clues, and uncover the truth of Martha's disappearance.

name: Rubber Head Bob

short_description: Oak City terrorized by a deadly predator. Navigate through dark offices, sequential rooms, and hidden passages, solving intricate puzzles to survive. Uncover the horrifying truth behind the terror and face a shocking conclusion, the fate of Oak City is in your hands.

name: Drunk Woman
short_description: 'Drunk Woman' is a desktop game that allows you to place characters on your computer desktop. The characters have excellent physical softness effects and can be swung around, interacted with, observed closely, etc., which can bring you some fun in your free time!

name: Hannah’s Day
short_description: Hannah's Day is a puzzle adventure about Hannah, who aspires to put together her own band. Put all doubts aside, grab your skateboard and go chase your dreams!

name: Calvice Survival
short_description: Calvice Survival is a 2D platform game in which at each level you will have to face numerous traps to recover the hair growth potions and thus save Trenzania.

name: Exo Mayhem
short_description: Exo Mayhem is the ultimate supervillain experience! Fly, Shoot, Stab, Explode, and Traverse Paradise Mall, a lush multi-biome open world ripe for conquering!

name: Monster Run: Downfall of the Empire
short_description: Monster Run is a dark fantasy beat’em up with roguelite elements. Fight as a giant monster cat protecting your home forest. Destroy massive armies of human soldiers and their allies. Evolve your attacks, master non-human tactics, and discover the joy of breathing fire.

name: Dreamlike Love with Seira

name: September Fall - Loneliness
short_description: You are playing the role of a husband going to meet his wife, who is on a deserted island fighting for survival with others to obtain a powerful stone.

name: Back

name: Luna and the Wasted City of Sin
short_description: A ruin-delving turn-based RPG. After taking on a request, half-beast Luna heads into the overwhelmingly shady ruins, but finds only evil monsters running rampant within... Each time you enter the ruins, the enemies and traps you encounter will change.

name: Gori: Cuddly Carnage
short_description: Humanity has been destroyed - and it's up to Gori, along with his deadly but wise-cracking sentient hoverboard, F.R.A.N.K, and morose AI companion, CH1-P, to shred and slay the evil Adorable Army!

name: Squigley
short_description: Traverse and experience a massive, cohesive 2D world as Squigley. Use your wits, resources and unique movement mechanics in order to explore this dark digital world.

name: Fields of Mistria
short_description: Start your new life! Build the farm of your dreams as you discover a world brimming with possibilities. Magic, romance, and adventure all await you in this nostalgic farming / life sim RPG!

name: Multiplication Mayhem

short_description: 'Oniwaki Village' is a first-person Japanese horror adventure game set in a Japanese village that has been abandoned due to an incident. Players endure horror as they explore the village and pursue the mystery of the incident....

He must navigate between dream and reality to understand why this happens. Always treat Teddy with respect; he loves you and remembers everything.

name: MT Force Aliens Uprising

name: The Land of the Magnates

As Shahbaz, a disgraced prince, travel across magical realms, defeat minions of darkness with the magic of your sitar, and reclaim your throne, bringing the light back to the Land of the Sun.

name: Elden Sword
short_description: Step into the mystical and perilous world of Mount And Sword, a single-player survival adventure that immerses you in an expansive and visually stunning open world. In this game, you'll embark on a journey through diverse landscapes, from dense forests and treacherous.

name: Zombie Police: Christmas Dancing with Police Zombies
short_description: Rookie human detective and energetic zombie detective, a mismatched buddy tackle mysterious cases! Get to the truth with the zombie's super powers and human deductive skills in this Japanese mystery ADV! Now on release!

name: Rodeo Clown
short_description: Welcome to Aurora, TX. Stay a while and learn a thing or two about yourself.

name: Mission: Rift seeker
short_description: Mission: Rift seeker is a colony simulation game about building and managing your base on an unknown planet and exploring the surrounding void rifts that are full of horrific and mysterious entities that you are tasked to capture before they to eat the brave and fluffy seekers that you command.

name: 寿司王 -sushi ou-

name: Multitales
short_description: Crazy competitive top-down shooter in the multiverse of fairy tales and legends.

name: Preserve

name: Shore Doodle
short_description: Let's enjoy your own personal beach. Wander around at your leisure and use a branch to draw in the sand. What will you draw in the short time you have before the sea washes it away? The time-of-day changes as you draw, bringing you relaxation, and perhaps new discoveries...

name: Womb Defense Force
short_description: Run and gun your way deep into the neo-humanoid territory and save mankind from its own creation! Fight as special ops commander Layla in this mutant blasting weapon rich 2D action sci-fi shooter!

name: Dale & Dawson Stationery Supplies

name: Battle Wizard Attack
short_description: Unleash your inner spell caster in this action-packed, retro-style RPG! Choose from eight powerful magic disciplines and face monstrous hordes across sprawling maps packed with destructible chaos.

name: ARVIS Punch
short_description: Become the best boxer by training and fighting with all the boxers and immersive elements. Test your senses and enjoy real boxing simulation at your fingertips.

name: Old School RPG
short_description: Old School RPG is a first-person fantasy role playing game. It is heavily influenced by The Bard's Tale, Might and Magic and Wizardry series of games. Create a party of adventurers and clear out dungeons and solve puzzles. Find and eliminate the source of evil that has come to your lands.

name: Sublimity
short_description: As the girl Chloe, you have fallen into The Backrooms and are exploring the surroundings while hiding from scary creatures. Try to uncover the story of The Backrooms and survive long enough to maybe find a way out...

name: Sarab 2: Thalj Mountains
short_description: Sarab 2: Thalj Mountains is a JRPG-styled game which focuses on story-telling, exploration and turn-based battling. Each main character has its own mysterious story. Furthermore, the game has a unique atmosphere which absolutely makes it a different experience in comparison to other JRPG games.

name: Fishlike
short_description: High speed microgames involving fish, fishing, and fishlike activities.

name: Tunnel Escape
short_description: Embark on a daring journey with Beatrice as you kick, shoot, and loot through a secret underground lab. In this rogue-lite RPG/ADV, engage in strategic combat and face intense encounters that may strip her bare... of her defenses and expose her to unspeakable dangers!

name: 拯救日记
short_description: Saving Diary 'is an independent single player storyline card game. A game gift unexpectedly led the female protagonist Hua and her childhood sweetheart Ma Hai into an unknown world. In order to save herself and Hai, Hua embarked on a series of adventures alone in the card world.

name: APEIROPHILIA
short_description: Create the longest word chain by starting with the last letter of the previous word. Play in English, French, or Spanish, and challenge yourself in Relax or Speed modes. Compete on the global leaderboards and become the ultimate word master in your language!

name: KAMITSUBAKI CITY ENSEMBLE
short_description: 'KAMITSUBAKI CITY ENSEMBLE' is a rhythm game in which AI girls who were awoken after the apocalypse use special song magic to create melodies with you, in an effort to restart the world. How did the destruction happen? Why do these girls exist? All answers will be revealed...when the music stops.

name: Iron Apartment Guardian
short_description: This exciting TPS mecha action game is set in the future of Seoul, offering a unique experience that combines intense combat with strategic depth. Defend, destroy, and take over apartments with the cool robots you build!

name: Debtors' Club
short_description: Be the tax collector of a shady city hall in this narrative-driven resource management game. Talk to debtors, manage a team, make difficult choices, and challenge the city's moral decay. It's their money, but it's your job.

name: When The Devil Takes Hold
short_description: When The Devil Takes Hold is a first-person psychological horror game. Step into the shoes of James Davidson, a fearless content creator whose search for views leads him to a cursed location. Explore the haunted grounds and solve puzzles to uncover the dark past.

name: Ghost Story
short_description: This game transports you into a charming pixel town brimming with retro appeal.

name: Runes of Aereal
short_description: Traverse the nightmare realm of Aereal in this horror-themed roguelike deckbuilder. Collect new cards and items, build your deck, and gather the nine Runes of Aereal as you search for immortality.

name: RIOO
short_description: The goddess of water who summoned you is nowhere to be found. Facing a tidal wave of monsters, you must join forces with other brave people who were summoned like you to repel them! Find the best combination of various strange weapons to survive the waves of attacks!

name: The Mightiest Sword is Mine!
short_description: A clicker game where you can enjoy limitless growth! Strengthen your skills to embark on a journey aiming for the strongest in your preferred playstyle!

name: Fit My Cat
short_description: Purrfect cat organizer – fit them all

name: WARCANA
short_description: WARCANA is a fantasy inspired base defence, RTS game with a deck-building mechanic. Face hundreds of thousands of unrelenting monsters in a battle royale between 30 other mighty magicians. Build your deck. Prepare your defences. Summon your armies. Survive the onslaught. Be the last one standing.

name: HAREM！RANCH LIFE
short_description: This is a relaxing farm RPG game where you can earn money by collecting and raising livestock! Interact with adorable villagers to increase your popularity in the village through chatting and giving gifts. Please enjoy a cozy farm life in this small village!

name: Climbing with Silly Cat
short_description: Fun and difficult game about climbing with cute silly cat that rotate a lot! With 10 unlockable skins Game includes cute cat pictures! And you can meow!!!

name: INCEL SIMULATOR
short_description: You are Alex Dysfuctional and you have never had a girlfriend. But maybe it's not too late to change things. The only question is what is closer to you - to try again and again to pump up your body and spirit or to become the king of the incels? Make life-changing decisions and change Alex's life.

name: Guard
short_description: This game is a classic adventure game where you can control a character in a colorful world full of danger.

name: Sulphur Memories: Alchemist
short_description: Sulphur Memories: Alchemist is a traditional roguelike of crafting, discovery, and immersion. Explore the uniquely generated world full of hidden knowledge and little stories, and use your creativity to overcome its challenges.

name: Get To The Gate
short_description: GetToTheGate is a RPG about a girl that needs to reach the Gate to the world of the living while being extremely scared of monsters. When her fear builds up, she loses her mana and runs to safety. Find a shortcut to bypass the enemies and explore the dungeon from a new location.

name: SLIME ORDER
short_description: Players just decide the order of the slimes! A puzzle game that is easy to play.

name: Toubatsu
short_description: You are a martial artist. You trained desperately and challenge gyms after gyms to reach the peak of martial arts. Today, you're at a new gym waiting for you to take down─

name: Kamikaze Lassplanes
short_description: Fly and fall for powerful Lassplanes! Discover a hand-crafted anime VN with story-driven arcade shoot-'em-up gameplay. Take part in a romantic story with drama and comedic elements set in a steampunk Kingdom filled with magic and torn by a brutal war. Decide the fate of your country and heart.

name: Clairvoyance
short_description: A 2D roguelike PvE fighting game where you can see through time and space, with very tight combat mechanics.

name: VR NINJA DOJO
short_description: VR NINJA DOJO offers an exciting training program that uses your entire body. Heated melee combat wielding swords, precise long-range attacks with shurikens, evasion training to dodge enemy attacks, and training to master ninjutsu await you.

name: Snezhinka:Sentinel Girls2
short_description: A fast-paced shooter with simple controls. Enhance your character by purchasing cards and hold the line against waves of hostile mechs as an employee of a private military company.

name: FindMe
short_description: This is a 2D flatformer game where you go on an adventure to regain your body, and you arrive at your destination through various sections. Lots of prepared obstacles, traps, and tricks. I hope you reach your destination with all your detailed manipulation, memory, persistence, and luck.

name: The Casting of Frank Stone™
short_description: The shadow of Frank Stone looms over Cedar Hills, a town forever altered by his violent past. As a group of young friends are about to discover, Stone’s blood-soaked legacy cuts deep, leaving scars across families, generations, and the very fabric of reality itself.

name: Void Reaper
short_description: Pilot your ship through the Void in 'Void Reaper'. Face diverse enemies, upgrade your ship, and battle bosses to reach the End Boss in this action-packed void odyssey. Can you destroy the Void and save the world?

name: Utopia Must Fall
short_description: Defend humanity's last surviving metropolis from mysterious alien machinations in this challenging base-defense arcade shooter. Featuring rapid upgrade progression, procedurally generated attack waves, dark humor and laser-sharp aesthetics.

name: Scourge Of War - Gettysburg
short_description: Welcome to Scourge of War, a real-time 3D computer game/simulation developed by NorbSoftDev, the company headed by renowned game designer Norb Timpko, designer of Mad Minute Games' acclaimed Take Command series. Scourge of War is the epitome of historical command simulations.

name: Dynasty's Defender: The Scroll's Curse
short_description: Dynasty's Defender: The Scroll's Curse is a strategic bubble shooter game set in the Western Han Dynasty. Players assume the role of a great general battling a magic scroll-wielding assassin. Precision shooting will burst all magical bubbles to rescue the emperor and empress.

name: ELDORANTE
short_description: Shipwrecked on an unfamiliar island with no money or goods to pay for a ride home... What's a merchant to do? Explore the Dungeon and make her way to the golden land of Eldorante, that's what!

name: Brawlberry
short_description: Battle the fruit guardians as you hack and slash through the fruit scape in this coop rogue-like dungeon crawler.

name: How Luck
short_description: Welcome to LuckyOne! Here, there is only one rule: be the luckiest of all! Beat the mini-games in record time and take your place at the top of the leaderboard!

name: Break the Empire
short_description: A fast-paced, yet tactical, action-roguelite! 100% focus on experimenting how to kill/conquer efficiently while having fun. Permadeath, unique builds, wild combinations and high replayability!

name: Multiplayer Pirates
short_description: Multiplayer Pirates - The island is under attack, grab Your sword and go get 'em! (Multiplayer or Single Player)

name: Endzone 2
short_description: Endzone 2 is a post-apocalyptic survival colony builder, where you embark to secure humanity's survival after a cataclysmic disaster. Discover and repopulate the last habitable grounds, while the survival of your people hinges on your wits, foresight, and resilience in a harsh and unforgiving world.

name: Devils Adventure
short_description: 2.5d Platformer where you control devil character. Mission to avoid traps and enemies and finish different levels and find skulls

name: Animal Water Pang!
short_description: Combine cute animal plushies to earn points and create even larger plushies! Create a large teddy bear as your final goal. However, be careful not to let the plushies spill out of the claw machine on your quest for a high score.

name: Pawn Planet
short_description: You're in charge of managing the pawn shop in this weird galaxy. Make deals with strange customers, flip items, attend auctions and keep the shop going!

name: Yark Survivors
short_description: Yark Survivors is a small and casual action roguelike where you play the role of a small kobold trying to survive against the minions of the Proginator, a cosmic entity set on testing the limits of mortality. Pick up various skills and spells to fight your way and prove your yipping worth!

name: My Lovely Empress
short_description: My Lovely Empress is an empire management sim inspired by Asian mythology. As the Emperor of the Crimson Empire, you will build relations with neighboring rulers, balance internal factions, and ensure the prosperity of your people, all before you reap their souls to resurrect your beloved empress.

name: OVRLRD
short_description: OVRLRD is a mech combat simulator built from the ground up for Virtual Reality. Take the real, physical controls of a 50-foot bipedal weapons platform as you carry out complex operations across a challenging single-player campaign.

name: World Without Reason
short_description: Miss [FIRSTNAME] Audacity is the only sane mind in an unreasonable world. Help our protagonist as she tries to remember the past in order to save her sister, her friends, and herself.

name: Chernobyl Again
short_description: Chernobyl Again is an adventure game adjusted for Virtual Reality headsets for a more immersive and engaging experience level. The story full of challenges and turbulence will let the players transform into a character trying to save the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant.

name: The Adventure of Ninomae Ina'nis
short_description: The Adventure of Ninomae Ina'nis is a vertical shoot 'em up game where you control Ninomae Ina'nis from Hololive Myth and her companion AO-chan.

name: TDS - Tower Defense Strategy
short_description: TDS - TOWER ▪ DEFENSE ▪ STRATEGY. Control Vessels. Utilize their uniquely deep, yet simple set of towers. Create an everchanging defense. Protect your Basin at all costs. An absolute Tower Defense, Real-Time Strategy Hybrid

name: Aooni
