short_description: [This is the origin of 'Blue Tragedy']The legendary horror game 'Ao Oni' is now available on Steam!

name: Why don't they laugh?
short_description: A first-person narrative horror game where you will get dangerously close to the secrets of the Kensington circus dynasty and discover what lies behind their famous shows' scenes.

name: CannonCraft
short_description: Real-time strategy game. Players move freely to find a suitable place to settle down and develop. They build various buildings to explore, attack, and defend themselves, so as to resist AI attacks. They also find and defeat other targets on the map to become the only surviving human player.

name: RP7: Spin Your Own Encounter
short_description: RP7 is a slot-managing roguelike. Spin the reel and beat the odds in this RPG adventure!

name: Hard Glide
short_description: Hard Glide is an experimental fast-paced arcade game with inertial mouse control only. Are you ready to test your reaction and speed?

name: Balocks
short_description: Balocks is a casual arcade game made for people that enjoy arrenging pieces without leaving spaces with a twist, you move all the pieces at the same time!

name: Tactical Breach Wizards
short_description: In Tactical Breach Wizards, you lead a team of renegade wizards in kevlar through turn-based battles to unravel a modern conspiracy plot. Combine their unique spells in clever ways, or rewind time to try every crazy plan you can think of to punch a Traffic Warlock through a 4th story window.

name: Thunder Jumper
short_description: Rocket, hook, and pound your way all across the land to destroy Motorhead's evil expansion of factories! Speedrunners beware: There is no max velocity. Can you handle the power of lightning speed?

name: Castlevania Dominus Collection
short_description: Three incredible action adventure games from the Castlevania series have finally returned, for the first time! But wait, there's more! Haunted Castle Revisited, a redesigned version of the very first Castlevania arcade game, makes its debut!

name: Esoterica Order
short_description: Drop in take on the challenge, in this third person shooter. The odds will be against you and continue to not be in your favor. Good luck Phantom.

name: Dice Player One
short_description: 'Dice Player One' is a roguelike strategy game where dice reign supreme! Roll your dice, seize pivotal moments, and transform limited chances into boundless opportunities. Conquer challenges, unearth hidden secrets, and master the art of dice manipulation!

name: Jewel Match Solitaire Seasons - Collector's Edition
short_description: For everything there is a season, and for every season there's Solitaire! Play more than 1000 levels across 10 locations in any season. Be sure to participate in the best Solitaire experience of this season and last. Shuffle your cards to victory with Jewel Match Solitaire Seasons!

name: Difference
short_description: An officer who decided to take the subway home was trapped. Each time he returned to the same station, which is endlessly repeated, but something different from the original. You will need to detect and mark all the anomalies to get out.

name: FootCareer ULT
short_description: FootCareer ULT, the new way of Football SimulationFootCareer ULT is the latest and most simplistic Football Career simulation game there is. Want to becomethe greatest (or the worst)? Then try FootCareer ULT today!

name: Perennial Order
short_description: Perennial Order is a 2D plant horror boss rush with challenging one-hit-death combat. Set in an atmospheric Dark Age world plagued by nature-infested horrors, explore a lore-filled and eldritch land alone or in two player co-op, all in a realistic painterly style.

name: Find it! festival in the Hotel
short_description: We are holding the Find it! festival in the hotel! Walk around the rooms and search for hidden items. In rooms filled with many things, can you find the items you're looking for? Enjoy 10 different themed rooms.

name: The Ritual
short_description: The ritual is a third person survival horror game. You have been hired to find out how a school began crawling with demons. Search the school for information. Run. Scream. Shoot. And remember don't get caught.

name: Biblios: Tome of Darkness
short_description: Defeat an ancient cult and stop the return of the Wretch Messiah in this short retro FPS set in a public library.

name: CORRUPTION 2029
short_description: From the creators of Mutant Year Zero comes an intense and Hardcore Turn-Based Tactical Game. Command your squad of four units and venture into a war torn America, where every turn counts in fierce tactical battles. Designed for those who crave a serious challenge, not for the faint-hearted!

name: Star Trucker
short_description: Haul cargo, trade salvage and keep your space suit close as you search for fame and fortune among the stars in a game that puts an interstellar twist on the truck sim genre.

name: OneKind
short_description: Onekind is a 3-10 player social deduction game set on a farm. Among the peaceful animals, there are evil creatures hiding, causing chaos and messing with the hunter’s mind. Luckily, there’s a hunter, a former wizard, ready to hunt them down. Get ready for some fun!

name: Chronicon: Survivors
short_description: Fight a mix of familiar and new dangerous foes in this fast paced horde survival game! Upgrade your weapons, unlock new items & characters, advance in the permanent passive skill tree, and try to survive the horde!

name: Let's play Cards Baccarat
short_description: Let's Play Cards: Baccarat is a thrilling and exciting card game that is perfect for players who love strategy and luck.

name: Minesweeper Collector 2
short_description: Big minesweeper game with a storyline and a variety of minesweeper-based mechanics. Each level affects the game world and advances you through the storyline. You will discover collections, crafting, level chains, hexagons, fishing, runes and you can even build up your own level in the editor!

name: Arcane Blast
short_description: Arcane Blast is a fast-paced, action-packed roguelike brimming with sorcery. Master the seven elements, combine them to achieve powerful reactions and face swarms of enemies to help feline Mage Adrian find his way home from a time dungeon.

name: CORPUS EDAX
short_description: An immersive first-person-melee RPG where you create your character so you can play your way. Fight, talk or sneak your way out of confrontation - your choice.

name: Cat On My Desktop
short_description: Cat On My Desktop is an adorable cat pet that will accompany you while you work, remind you to take breaks, and even bring you back surprise gifts.

name: Not Enough Space
short_description: Land with your friends on the surface of various planets, gather resources, create items and buildings, defeat enemies and move to other planets to discover their secrets and secrets

name: Wasp Wars 2
short_description: A run n' gun FULL ON ACTION 2d shooter. Pretty difficult, lots of explosions.

name: 異常階段 - Abnormal Stairs
short_description: 'Abnormal Stairs' is a game where you go down the stairs while looking for abnormalities.

name: Medieval Heroes Gold Hunt
short_description: In 'Medieval Heroes Gold Hunt' immerse yourself in a kingdom of endless riches where your path to fortune lies in your hands—literally! By swiping your heroes, you’ll generate gold and unlock powerful new characters to join your ever-growing roster.

name: BlowHI
short_description: Eliminate monsters, receive rewards, improve abilities. Use party skills. Unique skills and 4 random passive skills. Form parties regardless of class.

name: Submarine Terror
short_description: A sinister entity lurks in the depths. Descend into the abyss and extract knowledge about it.

name: Spellarium 11
short_description: Play Match3 Puzzle and return the dying world back to life!

name: Adrift
short_description: Casual Single Player Space Fishing Game

name: Together in Between
short_description: Together in Between is a first-person adventure-puzzle game. You have been imprisoned in a magic book with your partner, in the same place but in different dimensions. Will you be able to overcome the Wizard-King's puzzles, and see your partner again?

name: ALL IN THE GAME: Crime Strategy
short_description: ALL IN THE GAME is a turn-based crime strategy game. Start off with a small street gang, earn money through robberies and black market, expand your territory and become a kingpin running a fearsome criminal empire. Use violence, money and clout to take over the city before the other players do.

name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Reckoning of New York
short_description: Vampire: The Masquerade - Reckoning of New York is a narrative game set in the World of Darkness Universe. Play as one of the members of the Vampire Clans in a shifting political landscape between the Camarilla and the Anarchs while trying your best to survive.

name: MARVEL vs. CAPCOM Fighting Collection: Arcade Classics
short_description: The legendary crossover hits are back! The action-packed lineup consisting of seven unique titles, is full of heavy hitters like X-MEN VS. STREET FIGHTER, and MARVEL vs. CAPCOM 2 New Age of Heroes. The collection also includes the rare beat 'em up game, THE PUNISHER.

name: Arderico's Journey
short_description: Arderico’s Journey is an interactive fiction adventure that draws inspiration from the fascinating realms of fantasy tabletop RPGs and classic gamebooks, enriched with dynamic character interactions, meaningful choices, and content that reacts to your decisions.

name: Endless Casual Drive
short_description: This is an immersive leisure solo journey. All you have to do is focus on driving and enjoy driving. Slowly gain peace and return to yourself in the white noise brought by the engine and the environment.

name: Nitrogen Narcosis
short_description: Nitrogen Narcosis is a thalassophobes deep diving nightmare, set in sinking and sunk abandoned facilities. You and up to 7 other employees wearing the cheapest deep-dive suit money can buy are sent in to recover old materials from these facilities and return it to your captains submarine!

name: AMPBOUND Soccer
short_description: Blend of soccer, arcade and beat'em'up with online multiplayer.

name: Squirrel with a Gun
short_description: Squirrel, meet gun. As the neighborhood’s most obnoxious rodent, develop a knack (and a love?) for crime and mayhem in pursuit of golden acorns in this nutty sandbox shooter and puzzle platformer. Fight tooth, claw, and gun to escape a secret underground facility and defeat the Agents.

name: Valhalla Path: Survival
short_description: Valhalla Path casts you as a Viking warrior stranded in a hostile land. Build a village, defend against the fallen warriors, lead your people to glory and secure your place in Valhalla's legends.

name: PlatinumS
short_description: PlatinumS is a roguelite top-down arena shooter that brings the ultimate hero's party-building experience to life, empowering heroes to conquer dungeons. Players have the option to select from a range of items and buffs to craft their own distinctive builds.

name: Doll Catching Simulator
short_description: In the busy life, do you long to experience the fun of catching dolls but are limited by time and space? Now, the doll catching simulator brings you a brand-new entertainment experience!

name: STRETCHER MEN
short_description: 'STRETCHER MEN' is an action game where you transport a patient on a stretcher. Control characters at the front and back, avoiding obstacles to safely reach the clinic. Simple yet deep gameplay tests your attention and coordination.

name: Desu Vult
short_description: A new power is rising on Flat Earth! Figure out who the villain is in this old-school turn-based strategy game and save its mostly innocent denizens with the help of the world's most unhelpful sidekick. Explore secrets, fight bizarre enemies and test your wits in this fantasy adventure!

name: DeathSprint 66
short_description: Compete in a bloody fight to the finish in DEATHSPRINT 66, fusing high-speed on-foot racing with deadly obstacles and brutal abilities. Unleash your velocity, push limits, and claim glory like never before.

name: Hockey Legacy Manager 25
short_description: Build the ultimate legacy as the general manager of a professional hockey team!

name: Harry Potter: Quidditch Champions
short_description: Your next chapter takes flight! Immerse yourself in the enchanting world of Quidditch by playing solo or sharing the magic with friends and family.

name: Cathy And The Others
short_description: The sound of a pickup truck starting. A hammering headache. And this locked room. What happened to Cathy? Cathy And The Others offers a narrative experience where the player must escape a strange house.

name: Unakis
short_description: Beliefs, old ways, and superstitions loom over the tired land of abandoned beings; each escaping and fighting for what they believe is right, heading straight into their demise. A lone soul watches over them, an angel named Nala, she plots to save them, while calling out for your helping hand.

name: Trash Battle
short_description: A casual turn-based card game based on the rules of Trash or Garbage. A classic card sequencing game that involves organizing a hand Ace through Ten in sequential order before your opponent can.

name: On the Keyboard
short_description: Keyboard action game where you control a virtual keyboard to carry a Sphere.

name: Pro Strategy Football 2025
short_description: PSF 2025, now with encyclopedia/historic careers, league expansion, more customization, and awesome animation!

name: Murder Next Room
short_description: Murder Next Room is a multiplayer role-playing game. You are trapped in a location with others and one or more of them are killers. The police has been called and in the mean time try to survive. You can try to report the killer but there is no guarantee that the phones will be working.

name: Hit of Chernobyl
short_description: Hit of Chernobyl is a Survival FPS. The action takes place in the Zone, which was heavily polluted after a mysterious disaster. Marauders, journalists and just adventurers began to illegally enter the Zone. Many of them disappeared without a trace, and some lucky ones returned with unique artifacts.

name: Rise Eterna War
short_description: Rise Eterna War tells the bloody tale of Arthbane, a great general who led the last stand to reclaim his homeland Ars Rare from foreign invaders. Play as Arthbane, 10 years before the events of Rise Eterna, rallying loyalists in a desperate bid to seize the capital Gaiacus.

name: Don't Bow
short_description: Old school shooter. Gibs give you ammo, going Berserk gives you health. Kill them all.

name: Test Drive Unlimited Solar Crown
short_description: TDUSC is a lifestyle and social experience that redefines what an open-world racing game can be. Explore a fully recreated Hong Kong Island. Take to the road behind the wheel of exceptional cars and live the ultimate life of luxury.

name: Second Rate Superheroes
short_description: An addicting, chaotic, nerve-wracking action-roguelike where you command 20 superhero former-rejects to save yourself and the Mayor from hellswarms. Dozens of weapons, 4 sidekicks, insane combos, 400+ upgrade 'cards;' your fingers will be sweating like you're wearing wool mittens in July.

name: Frenzy Extinction
short_description: The Frenzy Virus has mutated. Now, you and your team must defeat hordes of 'The Ridden' in Frenzy Extinction! Survive waves of mutated monsters as your team upgrades their gear, powers up with custom abilities, and races to extract after defeating the boss.

name: Battle Street
short_description: To fight alone or side by side with your friend,one-on-one for fun. Defend yourself Tuesday with special powers and attack.

name: Moonshine Madness
short_description: A competitive 8 player racing game which contains items that can be used as well as interactive objects and randomized map events. The game has online matchmaking and custom lobbies so no worries! You will always find someone to play with!

name: The Knights Order
short_description: A simple puzzle game about a Knight saving a village from goblin invasion.

name: Gnome Expedition
short_description: A retro-style fantasy horror game where you must try to escape as a gnome from the giant demonic knight that hunts you down on your quest to collect ingredients.

name: Sports Hero
short_description: Step into the world of Sports Hero, where the thrill of competition meets retro-style visuals and addictive gameplay.

name: Fantasy Senate Simulator
short_description: Create a political party, win elections, respond to events, pass laws, govern, create your version of utopia and even go to war with your neighbors in this senate simulator with a fantasy twist.

name: Echoes of The Backrooms
short_description: 'Echoes of The Backrooms' is an indie horror game that masterfully captures the unsettling atmosphere of the Backrooms and the uncanny eeriness of liminal spaces. This game excels in creating an immersive horror experience with its cinema-quality visuals and meticulously crafted environments.

name: Electric Fairyland
short_description: Join Stix the fairy on an a tiny 3D adventure through the dense undergrowth of a fantasy garden. A bite-sized collectathon inspired by 90s platformers and childrens' picture books.

name: ENDLESS DAYS Z
short_description: 'Immerse yourself in a post-apocalyptic world where you face a variety of enemies, save what is left of this world. Endless Days Z is an intense and immersive survival experience.'

name: Koboo: The Tree Spirit
short_description: Koboo is a fast paced action rogue-lite platformer. Battle against towering hunters as a small tree spirit by attacking their weak points. Forge powerful synergies, explore a handmade world with branching paths, fish and garden to rebuild your home - death is not the end!

name: Z.O.N.A: Origin
short_description: Z.O.N.A: Origin is an immersive adventure in a harsh post-apocalyptic world. Dive into a captivating story, explore a stunning open world, avoid dangerous anomalies, and hunt for powerful artifacts. Every choice you make can be decisive in this unpredictable world.

name: I Hate Balloons VR
short_description: 'I Hate Balloons' is a VR single-player game where you pop all the balloons with limited darts. Use power-ups like bombs and trampolines to overcome obstacles. Perfect for VR beginners!

name: 茜色
short_description: 《茜色》是一款百合视觉小说，讲述了青梅竹马的两人从相识到相恋，以及之后在一起生活的点滴。通过游玩这款游戏，玩家能欣赏到甜蜜的百合爱恋与多分支的丰富剧情。

name: Garden Witch Life
short_description: Experience a cute, cozy witch life! After losing your job your life just took a whimsical turn. You're now on a quest to create a magical food forest and make it a home for all kinds of adorable creatures!

name: Aim Zen - Rhythmic Aim Trainer
short_description: Aim Zen combines classic aim training with musical innovation to elevate precision. Dive into an unparalleled FPS experience, designed for all skill levels, where rhythm and gameplay merge for an engaging challenge.

name: NAGAISAN
short_description: I came to know 'her.' Since then, I've felt someone's gaze from somewhere. Memories of the place I reached while searching for a lost dog in the past. I'm not sure if it's connected, but I did something. 'NAGAISAN' is an adventure game based on urban legends.

name: GLOBAL ELITE
short_description: Save the Earth from countless swarms of giant insects as a valiant member of the GLOBAL ELITE! Auto-battle your way to victory with a ragtag crew of survivors! Use every weapon at your disposal to crush those bugs and save humanity! Join the fight and become a member of the GLOBAL ELITE!

name: 平安果
short_description: 为了调查两宗案件相关嫌疑人，白小果只身来到了苹村，然而经过一些探索后却发现事件比想象中更加错综复杂，自己也在不知不觉中被犯人设计，陷入了精神迷幻中......你能否带她顺利完成任务归来呢？

name: Last Home
short_description: Last Home is a rogue-lite tower defense pixel art game where you defend your home against relentless waves of enemies. Gather coins and food to deploy powerful units that will fortify your defenses. As you progress through the waves, unlock over 10 different types of units to enhance your strategy.

name: The Fast and the Flirtatious: LA Drift
short_description: “The Fast and the Flirtatious: LA Drift” is a Yuri Dating Sim that delves into the LA underground racing and drifting subculture but also explores the thriving lesbian dating scene that flourishes in this community.

name: DJ SIMULATOR
short_description: DJ SIMULATOR takes you from 'Bedroom DJ' beginnings to festival headlining superstardom! Master REAL DJing techniques, upgrade and buy more gear, learn to read crowds and climb the ranks to fame and success!

name: Twistingo: Blue Moon Collector's Edition
short_description: Twistingo: Blue Moon is a captivating hidden-object adventure where you solve puzzles, manage resources, and rescue animals to restore the frosty island of Lunara. Uncover secrets, collect moonstones, and break the Blue Moon's icy spell in this heartwarming conservation journey.

name: Caribbean Pirates
short_description: A tactical board game about the battles of sailboats in the Caribbean Sea. Spaniards, Englishmen, pirates, privateers, corsairs and the ringing of piastres and doubloons.

name: Scary School Simulator 3
short_description: Walk into a horror anime stories, solve dark mysteries, and escape from the ghost!

name: Gun Maker - pimp my weapon
short_description: This is a design application that allows users to intuitively create original gun designs from a wide variety of parts. You can enjoy the guns you create by adding various actions and sounds.

name: Finger Flex
short_description: Step into the past with your LCD handheld! Test your reflexes and coordination as you navigate challenging obstacles to defeat the alien invasion. With two unique game modes, master the sequences and climb the leaderboards. Can you rise to the challenge?

name: Solus Machina
short_description: A lone robot, deemed worthless by its creators, seeks freedom and adventure in a hostile world

name: Dark Era
short_description: A Game set in post-apocalyptic world where an alien virus has taken over, kill the infected ones ,Survive their attacks , clear the levels to complete the game. There are currently two game modes one is level based and another is Arcade mode.

name: Motordoom
short_description: Motördoom is a freestyle-sports roguelite horde shooter that combines high octane, visceral combat with fluid movement and trick mechanics. Perform gnarly tricks while defeating grotesque monsters and upgrade your character with demonic offerings to become ever more powerful.

name: Castle of Lord Velimir
short_description: Take the main role in the epic battle against encroaching darkness. Dark Souls, Super Mario Bros and Warcraft 3 had a baby and it's this game. How did the baby happen, you ask? Well, it was that wild of a party.

name: Backwater Eulogy
short_description: Musings on grief, moving on, and a life made and lived in the rural Midwest. Features a collection of lovingly hand-drawn panels and pixel art.

name: Elsie
short_description: Elsie is a technicolour, hyperkinetic, rogue-like action-platformer filled with procedurally generated levels, an army of robots to blast through, and a wide scope of items & weaponry to make each run unique. Master countless magitek weapons and abilities in order to embrace the chaos.

name: Skull and Bones
short_description: Set sail into the vibrant open world of Skull and Bones, a naval online action RPG where you rise to become the most fearsome pirate kingpin. Customize your fleet, craft unique ships, and forge formidable weapons to dominate in exhilarating sea battles.

name: Fiz and the Rainbow Planet
short_description: The unique little dragons run around with three buttons. A pixel art style 2.5D action game that goes beyond dimention! Fiz and the Rainbow Planet' is a 2.5D dot-picture action game in which players switch characters in a resourceful manner as they progress.

name: Necroking
short_description: Necroking is a turn-based tactics roguelite with vast deckbuilding. You play as a Master of Necromancy. Build your skulls deck, raise skeletons and other scum to defeat settlements desecrated by life.

name: Dj 8 Beats: Infinite
short_description: ... some bits ... ... some beats ...

name: Pixel Art Academy: Learn Mode
short_description: Learn how to draw pixel art with a video game! Start from zero and develop real art skills in a relaxing way. Complete interactive tutorials, draw pixel art sprites, and play the games you create. Everyone can do this!

name: Almost reversi
short_description: This is a board game that combines deck building and Reversi. Buy powerful stones from the store and try to win 12 times within your time limit of 12 minutes!

name: The Hunter Cursed by Night
short_description: A short-and-sweet 1-bit adventure game with real-time combat. Engage in ranged or close combat to defeat supernatural monsters. Upgrade your tools to progress deeper into the woods and seek revenge, or seek greater power by conquering dungeons and the powerful bosses inside.

name: OddBallers
short_description: OddBallers™ is a totally bonkers multiplayer party game where each round is a new, absurd type of dodgeball.

name: Chef RPG
short_description: Craft your culinary adventure in a beautiful pixel art world. Manage your restaurants, forage and hunt for ingredients, befriend locals, and grow your culinary empire. What kind of chef will you be?

name: Gravity Escape
short_description: Gravity Escape is a pixel platform puzzle game where the protagonist, K, accidentally acquires a gravity gun that grants him the ability to manipulate gravity. He must find a way to overcome various dangerous traps and enemies to discover how to escape the planet.

name: Take A Leak
short_description: Navigate toilet puzzles, conserve pee, and follow the eccentric Mr. Latrine in Take a Leak. Choose to ascend to the Toilet Realm or explosively escape the facility. Your bladder, your choice!

name: Fields of Asphodel
short_description: Befriend misfit deities and make a life for yourself in the Underworld! Can you escape your arranged marriage to the King? Do you want to?

name: Empire: Sound of the North
short_description: Empire: Sound of the North, a swipe em up cards game. Swipe the cards, go on adventures, solve puzzles and mysteries, make everyone happy and create your own kingdom.

name: The Ball
short_description: Are you ready to conquer all the worlds and master every level?

name: Lord of the Click 4
short_description: Join the epic battle in 'Lord of the Click 4' — an exciting sequel to the popular clicker series! Now the kingdom is in danger more than ever, and only you can save it from the impending darkness.

name: Missing Mildred
short_description: A 2D platformer game with puzzle elements in a retro NES/SNES style. The story is about finding a missing cat named Mildred.

name: RAYS
short_description: RAYS - the plot unveils complex emotions and psychological conflicts, forcing you to make choices that will determine the fate of the main character and the surrounding world.

name: Immortal Hunters
short_description: God is dead, killed by a mighty Church that conquered the world with his power. Now, it faces the Apocalypse. Experience it in an RPG beat 'em up as one of its Immortal Hunters. Defy fate, expose the lies of the Cardinals, and find a reborn God before the Khemrids destroy humanity.

name: Cam Op Simulator
short_description: Cam Op Simulator allows real world camera operators to learn and practice operating a virtual camera using a gamepad (joystick), Nodo Inertia Wheels, or several supported 'Mouse Wheels' like Rexy Wheels, Hammerhead Wheels, Blacktek, and Kino Wheels.

name: Stormgate
short_description: Stormgate is a free-to-play RTS in active development. Featuring competitive 1v1, 3P co-op missions, and an evolving campaign, Frost Giant aims to build the next great RTS, guided by player feedback. A 3v3 mode is also on the way, so join our development journey today!

name: Mad Smartphone Tycoon
short_description: Build Your smartphone Empire in Mad Smartphone Tycoon, your main goal in this game is to create the ultimate smartphone that combines both performance and aesthetics. Expand your company, dominate the global market, become a tycoon in the world of mobile phones!

name: Periphery Synthetic
short_description: Explore a planetary system, synthesize new abilities, and reveal its past. This interactive EP offers a chill and non-violent metroidvania experience across procedurally-generated musical playgrounds.

name: Smells Like a Mushroom
short_description: Boomer jokes ✅ Vegetable puns ✅ Strange characters ✅ Join the Aveggers to fight through the solar system in a dynamic third-person platformer shooter and defeat the alien mushroom invasion. 99% silly, 100% vegan!

name: Cat God Ranch
short_description: Lead hundreds of 'wise' little animals to pay tribute to the Cat God!! 7 animal families, 100+ animals, 10+ Cat Gods, 100+ items, and various animal combinations waiting for you to explore!

name: 星河防线
short_description: This is a 3D PVE Tower Defense rouge game that supports teams of up to 4 people. You and your teammates can choose the right trap turret according to their own division of labor to deal with different scenarios, so as to resist the wave of insects.

name: Blocky Ascent
short_description: Each step matters in this high-stakes first-person parkour platformer, as falling means losing progress. Overcome dynamic obstacles like moving platforms and anti-gravity fields. Discover shortcuts to reach the summit faster, but beware, the climb demands mastery. Will you conquer the ascent?

name: Stardiver
short_description: Descend into the depths of an underwater world filled with wonder, mysteries, and peril. Fight to survive among unknown, dangerous species. Discover the story behind the abandoned base. Explore this submerged world and learn its history.

name: Mechanical Lab
short_description: Mechanical Lab is a 2D action game focused on the physical interaction of machines with the environment. Explore, build and experiment to survive in the city of robots long after the end of human civilization.

name: HOLYHUNT
short_description: A love letter to 8-bit era in a punishing, rewarding, tight retro top-down shooter.

name: Hollow Floor
short_description: Hollow Floor is an exploration-based single-sitting Metroidvania inspired by VVVVVV and REDDER. Hollow Floor is a relaxed game that is full of secrets and hard challenges that can be tackled at any moment in the game or completely ignored.

name: Secret Diaries - Royal Wedding
short_description: Attend lavish balls and meet handsome bachelors in the new Time Management game!

name: Backrooms: Last Room
short_description: Experience the unknown world of utility rooms through a VHS camera, you will have to feel all the fear and anxiety of loneliness, plunging deeper and deeper into the world of utility rooms behind the scenes In search of that very, cherished, last room

name: Master Detective Archives: RAIN CODE Plus
short_description: Yuma, an amnesiac detective-in-training, and Shinigami, the spirit haunting him, tackle unsolved mysteries.

name: Escape Party
short_description: Embark on 3D online multiplayer escape rooms in Escape Party. Solve puzzles, test your speed, and conquer challenges together.

name: Psychomachia
short_description: Confront your deepest fears in Psychomachia, trapped in a nightmarish loop at the heart of the dorms of mental instability. Explore the intricacies of the human mind, faced with terrifying manifestations of madness.

name: Battlecry Berserkers
short_description: Fight your way trough waves of enemies and make your own path. Unleash new powers, consume the power of the runes, and defeat mighty foes. Free Eldrathia from these monsters!

name: Assembly Line 2
short_description: In Assembly Line 2, you take charge of your factory, where strategic organization is key. Create intricate production lines, unlocking a plethora of blueprints to craft advanced resources. Fine-tune and upgrade machines for optimal efficiency and elevating your empire to new heights.

name: 死掉的女儿（The Dead Daughter）
short_description: 一款单人心理恐怖视觉小说。玩家只需要持续点击体验文字和图画呈现的主线剧情。流程短但情节引人入胜。

name: Creatures of Ava
short_description: Let your empathy guide you as you play an exciting action-adventure, creature-saver game. Understand and tame the creatures of Ava and let them lead you through a variety of ecosystems – all in the hopes of saving the planet from a life-consuming infection.

name: Path of Dragoon
short_description: Path of Dragoon is a Fantasy RPG that is inspired by Dragon Warrior and Final Fantasy. When not completing the Main Quest, you can restore the Kingdom by completing quests for villagers. You can Mine, Fish, and Explore the world to discover powerful items and abilities.

name: No Signal Escape Room
short_description: A small escape room with 5 original puzzles and a very special ending

name: Gah!
short_description: Gah! is a blend of hack'n'slash and roguelite focused on short adventures. Choose a character, fight through randomized levels, level up, and defeat the final boss!

name: Amata
short_description: Rage across the mad realms of a dead god as Charlet, the immortal artificer. Explore a vast, arcane desolation wrought by hatred. Cleanse the twisted inhabitants of ancient, forgotten worlds. Help Charlet find a way home using her powerful and varied suite of combat and platforming abilities.

name: KALPA: Cosmic Symphony
short_description: KALPA, the authentic rhythm game, is now available on STEAM! The doomed universe needs you to play your life away. Play your life's music with Kalpa to save the dying Yggdrasil and revive the universe!

name: Block Master 3D Puzzle
short_description: Test your mental skills with Block Master 3D Puzzle! Master this classic block puzzle game with realistic 3D graphics, strategic game modes and addictive gameplay. Race for the record without wasting time!

name: Selatria
short_description: Dragged into a re-awakened war, it is up to Mage, Melanie, and friends to take arms and summon up their strength to prevail against the assault on their home from an unruly usurper with a multigenerational grudge. Selatria is a turn-based RPG inspired by the 90’s classics.

name: Gimmick! 2
short_description: Embark on a sparkling journey in this long-awaited sequel to SUNSOFT’s legendary 8-bit platformer Gimmick! Solve puzzles, trick enemies, and explore a physics-based playground. Yumetaro is back!

name: The Rookery
short_description: All the strategic depth of chess with all the fun of roguelikes! Upgrade your army with boosts, relics, and consumables to take on formidable bosses - without all the tools at your disposal, you won't stand a chance!

name: Creepy Camping
short_description: Indie Horror. The main character arrives in the forest in a Motorhome. The forest is covered with secrets and mysteries. Exploring the forest, over time, the campsite turns into a real nightmare. The hero understands that he is not alone in the forest...

name: Hexeract
short_description: Roguelike deck-building game on hexagonal tiles. Enjoy a dopamine-boosting experience by maximizing the synergy of your deck and tiles.

name: Slash Quest
short_description: Slash Quest is a quirky action adventure with unconventional controls and unlikely heroes. Spin a magic talking sword through exotic lands, fight nasty creatures, overcome puzzles and make friends on your way to reunite it with its rightful wielder, the Queen.

name: Mystery On Lost Island
short_description: Mystery On Lost Island is a low-poly first-person-shooter with a story game mode where you're shoot dinosaurs, try to find your missing friend and escape an uncharted island, and a wave survival mode where you fight hordes of dinosaurs on different maps.

name: oath
short_description: A short story companion to vai5000's EP, oath

name: Courier Tale
short_description: You've joined the gig economy as a courier for T.A.L.E. Couriers! Explore, meet and chat with a cast of characters, complete deliveries for the company while doing jobs on the side in this walkin' n talkin' pixel art adventure where this job is not everything you expected it to be...

name: SwayBods
short_description: In this puzzle game, tap the bubble monsters to move them in a pendulum like swaying movement along the arc. Time the taps carefully so that the monsters do not bump into each other. Get all the monsters in a level swinging to complete the level.

name: Spaceman
short_description: Conquer the heights of space by navigating treacherous landscapes. Battle gravity and test your skill to reach the top. Get ready for the climb of your life.

name: マカブルの残党: Remnants of the Macabre
short_description: Navigate 1980s Japan as a schoolgirl in this Junji Ito-inspired horror game. Each choice shapes your fate, leading to safety or deeper into the macabre. Uncover hidden horrors in an urban street filled with sinister details. Will you find your way home, or be consumed by the unknown?

name: Megaloot
short_description: Megaloot is an addictive Inventory Management Roguelike RPG, where meticulous loot management paves the way for creating diverse and powerful builds. Combine deck cards and loot strategically to craft dominating builds and become the ultimate power hunter.

name: ELEVATE
short_description: Offroad Driving Skills + A Weekly $392 Contest... Welcome to ELEVATE, the game that PAYS YOU back.

name: Ultra Sudoku
short_description: Sudoku puzzle game with 4 different variations including mixed boards

name: Wolf Simulator: Silent Paws
short_description: Survive in a wild world as nature's strongest hunter with Wolf Simulator: Silent Paws! Explore, survive and write your own legend! Join this epic adventure now and become the true hero of the forest.

name: Average Human Ball Game
short_description: A Fighting game and a sports game merged together to create a high energy point based fighting game

name: Mutant Crisis
short_description: If you like to fight zombies purely, and hope to have talents and attribute growth, be able to unlock epic weapons for free that previously required a recharge of $3888 in krypton gold games, and be able to cooperate with friends online to challenge BOSS, then don't miss this game.

name: Pineford: Part I
short_description: Investigate the murder of Evie Roots. Save the town from disaster. Learn the history of the Great Houses. Immerse yourself in the centuries-old history of Pineford.

name: Elon and the Divine Proof
short_description: Elon found himself on a beautiful beach with dozens of tasty burgers. He didn't know how he got there. He decided to embark on a mission to collect all the burgers scattered around the island.

name: The Hidden Art of Innkeeping
short_description: Transform an old farmhouse in a seaside village into a luxurious inn! Meet interesting guests, unlock delicious dishes, discover new areas and hidden treasures, configure rooms and amenities, uncover secrets, and rejuvenate the struggling village in this inn-management game!

name: Power of Petanque
short_description: A druidic and magical adaptation of pétanque. Compete against your friends!

name: 終焉少女
short_description: Girls, resist the world and burn your lives! Full-voice stylish action!!

name: BAKERU
short_description: Bakeru's adventure begins in this Japan-esque Wild Action Game!

name: Sam & Max: The Devil's Playhouse
short_description: The last game in the episodic Sam & Max trilogy, beautifully remastered! As the intergalactic villains who seek the Devil’s Toybox close in and Max’s psychic abilities grow beyond his control, the Freelance Police will come up against their most frightening adversary yet: the power of Max’s mind.

name: Cardboard Fish
short_description: Dive into the captivating world of Cardboard Fish! Experience gripping gameplay as Nozzle, the heroic fish, in a physics-based adventure filled with skill challenges and mind-bending puzzles for thrilling progress and achievement.

name: Formula Racing Manager
short_description: FRM offers a unique sandbox experience. The game focuses on bringing the management aspect of the motorsport world to life by providing a challenging simulation, where you steer a racing team in a dynamically changing racing world while respecting your time. Seasons are dynamic, quick, and exciting.

name: Cubidle
short_description: An idle clicker game with prestige, perks, interest, evolving system, difficulty tiers, ranking and many other features!

name: Arthur and his companions
short_description: A traditional pixel style role-playing game...

name: Speed Factor
short_description: An old-school racing game featuring 2D pixelated visuals, inspired by 80s and 90s classics, arcade-style gameplay, rock songs and high speed!

name: Arch Legends
short_description: Arch Legends is a classic RPG full of stories and maps to explore, focused on hunting for treasure and killing monsters. Build your own hero by challenging your limits and join thousands of players on this journey into a dark fantasy world. No micro-transactions! No cash shop!

name: GhoulScrapers
short_description: Ghoulscrapers is a precision platformer where you play as Eggroll, the new employee at Ghoulscrapers. You owe the government one gazillion dollars and it's your job to pay the debt before it's too late!

name: Decipher The Deck
short_description: Decipher The Deck is a rule discovery puzzle game that turns traditional playing cards into interesting puzzle mechanics. Discover the secrets of cards, their abilities, and much more in 70 hand-crafted levels.

name: Tank Chess
short_description: Have you ever dreamed of being a great general of the armoured forces? Or maybe a chess grandmaster? Perhaps what you want is just a fun, challenging game you can explain quickly and play with anyone? If that’s the case, you’re in for a real treat!

name: Shells Shooter
short_description: A new sensation action game that blends coin pusher and shooting elements. Players take on the role of a crab, throwing shells to battle monsters born from ocean pollution while rescuing trapped fish. Utilize various skills to enjoy a thrilling coin pusher experience.

name: Never Forgotten
short_description: A uniquely stylised survival-horror adventure game. Explore a dying world, averting enemies, managing your resources, and solving puzzles.

name: Home Deception
short_description: A teen who’s gotta go to his grandma’s house to take care of her, realizes that taking care of her isn’t his biggest deal.

name: Skoof Simulator
short_description: Are you Skoof?

name: Demolish & Build 3
short_description: Step into the boots of a demolition company owner. Accept and complete contracts to earn money, allowing you to buy new equipment and upgrade your business. Use powerful tools, from sledgehammers to giant excavators, and experience the realism of a true construction site, where every brick matters.

name: Doggy Farmer
short_description: 'Doggy Farmer' is a casual simulation game where players can control a dog character to herd livestock by making sounds. They can earn bone point rewards by correctly submitting farm produce.We hope players can relax and unwind by playing this game!

name: Intense! Miyu-chan and Teacher's Rock-Paper-Scissors battle!
short_description: Win the game to make them study during detention!

name: Don't Stare
short_description: A cartoony narrative platformer where you avoid extroverts who want to talk to you!

name: Investigation
short_description: Investigation is a singleplayer body-cam styled psychological horror game about searching for clues and answers while a demonic killer brings these gruesome victims back to life in terrifying ways. Solve the puzzles or be consumed by them....

name: RERODENT
short_description: RERODENT is a first-person psychological horror and puzzle game about rats and cultists. You play as Jimmy Rodentim, and one day you get a call from your Uncle Vic, who asks you to clean up his house for 100 bucks. Little did you know that a simple task will get you killed.

name: The Cesspit
short_description: The Cesspit is a first-person adventure horror game set in the sewers. You must explore the dark passageways and escape from the twisted inhabitants. You must find your way using candles and deal with the threats in the darkness.

name: PICO PARK 2
short_description: PICO PARK is back with all new levels! Play with 2-8 players locally or online in this co-op action-puzzle game!

name: Escape From Lesco
short_description: Escape From Lesco is a horror/puzzle adventure, where you must survive through your night shift, navigating through various puzzles and obstacles within the store, in order to find a way to escape...

name: Self Defense Kinda...
short_description: Use your wits to defeat many cartoonishly unique fights whether in game or custom community made fights! Learn from your defeats and best your overwhelming foe in this Boss Rush RPG game! Maybe, you can help Alice escape the BR World and learn true Self Defense! eh, don't count on it.

name: The Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria™
short_description: The only survival crafting video game set in the Fourth Age of Middle-earth™

name: Ringlorn Saga Gaiden
short_description: Ringlorn Saga Gaiden is an adventure RPG inspired by the Japanese PC classics. A lost soul is called upon this accursed world to end the Dark Lord's reign over humankind and rediscover its purpose and memory along the way.

name: Cat Bait
short_description: Cat Bait is a casual game with cute pixel graphics. Control the Cat Bait, dodge enemies, and use the unique abilities of helper cats.

name: ホロポップ
short_description: Let's liven up the broadcast together with talents and listeners! A Hololive fan game that's easy to enjoy by simply shooting and hitting! Despite its simple gameplay, it's a pinball game that you can enjoy strategically, collecting, and getting deeply involved in

name: Island Survival: Escape from Paradise
short_description: A casual and strategy game where you will have to help a bunch of lazy and good for nothing people escape from a tropical island. To do this, you must discover the likes and skills of each character and assign them the most appropriate tasks.

name: Seeking Cat
short_description: In 'Seeking Cat,' explore a cozy, cluttered room filled with cleverly hidden cats. Can you uncover all the hidden cats and become the ultimate cat finder?

name: CatCat Save The World
short_description: This is RTS puzzle game. One holy girl in other world who call Yuna just complete the Hero Summon, but there has no hero coming from this summon, a cat just show up. That white cat call him as 'CatCat' and his name is 'GiFi', He steers up the mobile-human armor, and start to save the world.

name: The Whisper Ghost
short_description: The Whisper Ghost is a single-player game where a ghost haunts you over 7 days. As a cleaner, you find that each day becomes more unsettling, with the same customer calling you with new stories. Each day, you begin to notice strange things happening in the house.

name: Ninja 1987
short_description: Ninja 1987 is a dive back into the past with the most authentic 8-bit side-scrolling action-platformer. Use shinobi skills to thwart a nefarious threat and rediscover all the adrenaline of timeless classics!

name: WHAT THE CAR?
short_description: An absurdly silly adventure full of racing, laughs, and unexpected surprises. Roll, sprint, jump, fly and sneeze your way to victory on the racetrack and beyond!

name: Tape Art
short_description: Tape Art is a unique Artistry game, inspired by the infamous Italian Banana art “Comedian” by Maurizio Cattelan. The art swayed the Internet for a while. The artifact taped on the wall is a reminder that art can be anything. It does not need to be complex or expensive to be meaningful.

name: Stay Home It Rains Outside
short_description: Your digital refuge at the Alpha Centauri settlement. Visit whenever things aren't going well. This is a productivity tool with game elements. Customize your second body, gather fluffy creatures, and tackle real-life tasks using built-in productivity features.

name: Wizard's Legacy
short_description: Wizard’s Legacy blends VR immersion with roguelite replayability, offering action, adventure, and fantasy. Play as a powerful wizard, explore dynamic dungeons, face formidable foes, and uncover ancient secrets. Become the wizard you were meant to be.

name: 多元守卫者 Diverse Defenders
short_description: Diverse Defenders is a strategy game that combines Roguelike and Go elements. Here, you will be able to recruit characters with unique skills and form a powerful hero army. Go deep into various levels and defeat powerful bosses to achieve ultimate victory!

name: Ichiro
short_description: This is a difficult metroidvania style game with 90's arcade mechanics. It requires precision jumping and good highlights to shoot and jump.

name: Ace Attorney Investigations Collection
short_description: Miles Edgeworth's dramatic turnabouts take center stage! Experience both Ace Attorney Investigations games in one gorgeous collection! Investigate crime scenes and solve tough, intriguing cases through logic and deduction. When Edgeworth's past and present collide, his future begins!

name: Gunfire Girl: Zombie Hunt
short_description: This is an extremely exciting VR shooting game. It provides players with a brand new shooting experience, allowing players to feel endless stimulus and fun in the process of destroying zombies.

name: Multiplayer Bikini Brawlers
short_description: Multiplayer Bikini Brawlers - The island is under attack by evil sea monsters, go get 'em! (Multiplayer or Single Player)

name: Bring Me...
short_description: Play as a young woman who has been caring for her sick father and has been trapped in an anomalous cycle. Observe your surroundings for anomalies to find your way out of this nightmare.

name: Byte The Bullet
short_description: Get into my infected computer and restore every virus-ridden system by recovering game attributes like color or save functions. Enjoy this parody of multiple classic games from 80s & 90s.

name: Elrentaros Wanderings
short_description: The dual life where Fantasy meets Reality begins! A brand-new action RPG, “Elrentaros Wanderings”!

name: Mouse Pointer Engine
short_description: Mouse Pointer Engine is an open creative workshop led mouse pointer switching software, with a massive number of pointers installed and replaced with just one click!

name: Return To The Village
short_description: Return To The Village is an exciting village simulator with survival elements and an open world where complete freedom of action reigns. Immerse yourself in the unique gameplay of the game that will not let you get bored.

name: Murder On Space Station 52
short_description: Trapped on a space station with the Keychain Killer you must unravel this mystery, or it will be your last. Collect evidence, interrogate suspects and solve puzzles to stand a chance.

name: Puzzle Dungeon!! Earthmage Erin
short_description: Puzzle Dungeon!! is a series of games where fantasy classes solve puzzles themed after their abilities! In Puzzle Dungeon!!: Earthmage Erin, play as Erin, an Earthmage with the power to control gravity. Solve 30+ puzzles in themed dungeons to rescue Erin's lost goats and bring them back to her farm.

name: Castles on Clouds
short_description: A Roguelike Tower Defense game set on a user controlled procedurally generated island. Select unique cards and relics that enhance your towers abilities, crafting powerful builds to defend against the growing hordes of enemies.

name: Demon's Mirror
short_description: Step into the Demon’s Mirror and enter a fantastical, nightmarish world in this roguelike deckbuilder! Strategy meets the arcane in a unique fusion of deck-building and chain-3 mechanics. Can you face your demons and come out unscathed?

name: You Want to Watch the World Burn
short_description: YWTWTWB is a fast-paced puzzle in which you are an arsonist burning locations and landmarks to the ground. Balance risk versus reward with the amount of havoc you can cause while staying alive!

name: Ahro
short_description: Release your spirit and fly through mystic landscapes as you search for a cure for the darkness. Ahro is a side-scrolling adventure based on the developer’s experience with panic disorder.

name: Multiplayer Romans
short_description: Multiplayer Romans - Rome is under attack, grab Your sword and go get 'em! (Multiplayer or Single Player)

name: Sporeborn Dark
short_description: Break out of a maze surrounded by darkness, infested with growths and filled with hideous monsters. Explore the randomly generated locations of the experimental zone to find something that will help you delay your doom. A dark, atmospheric, scary top-down horror roguelike

name: SEEING THINGS
short_description: Full tilt surveillance horror. Keep your eyes locked on security cameras for an outrageous collection of horrific anomalies, suspicious movement, and the occasional T-Rex. Observe, detect, survive!

name: Welcome To Everdell
short_description: Build your perfect make-believe city in the digital adaptation of the beloved family-friendly board game!

name: スペルトナエル
short_description: Strategic roguelike in which you physically move around the on-screen keyboard and continue to cast magic spells while avoiding a barrage of bullets

name: My Little Sister Callie
short_description: My Little Sister Callie is a visual novel about a brother helping his little sister to adapt to life outside of a refugee camp. How far will you go to bring her home?

name: MOBA Dodge Trainer
short_description: A dodging skills trainer specifically developed for MOBA game players. Want to show off your maneuvering and reaction skills to your friends? Then try to survive as long as possible against an endless barrage of attacking skills!

name: Abnormal1999:The Compass and the Sand
short_description: The fate of exile, like an endless river, carries Ann to a distant and unfamiliar land. A flame of unwavering determination burns within Ann's heart. She knows that one day, either Sam or SU will surely find her. Until then, Ann must find a way to escape this place.

name: Lindwyrm
short_description: No one suspected what lurked beneath the village of Sigiswal. Meet creatures from ancient legends and save the village in this roguelite action RPG. Dungeons with hack'n'slay combat, platforming and puzzles? We've got it! Strong bosses, co-op mode? That's a given! Are you ready for the Underground?

name: Journey of Seasons: Heroes
short_description: Begin as a bear girl who has to find her way through a dark dungeon fighting monsters. By selling items that you find along the way, you can gain new heroes to play as in the dungeon or assist you! While dungeons can be scary, the Heroes will help you along this journey!

name: Strike Buster
short_description: A new STG game that is both retro and modern, with unique gameplay. Accumulate combos, switch weapons, collect relics, destroy waves of enemies and powerful bosses, survive and get the highest score!

name: HAPPY SAIN† SHEOL
short_description: Two thousand years ago, the Pestis Disaster swept through the land, corrupting all living things and making it to difficult to live on the land. Having touched the darkest darkness the world has seen, one must now face the dazzling light. Thus I pose this question. Whose wings did I see that day?

name: Slay or Fall
short_description: As the lord of the dungeon, defend yourself from the attacks of the heroes before they reach you! Manage your own subordinates, mess with heroes, solve urgent problems!

name: An Everyday Story
short_description: An Everyday Story is a 2.5D story-driven puzzle platformer with a heartfelt twist. Experience life from the view of three trinkets... what do you think happens when our dreams become so real that they stain our reality?

name: 神选之地
short_description: 'God Chosen Place” is a fantasy adventure game that combines visual novel and RPG elements, featuring a rich narrative that weaves an epic journey! - Localization in progress

name: The Abandoned Planet
short_description: A throw-back, retro-inspired, point and click adventure with chunky and beautiful pixel art

name: Star Conqueror 舰队指挥官
short_description: Engage in real-time battles with customizable space warships. Explore the galaxy, forge alliances, develop powerful ships, and defeat alien invaders.

name: Skystrider
short_description: Embark on an epic journey in 'Skystrider,' a 3D action platformer. As a resurrected hero, explore a ruined world, navigating perilous paths amidst clouds and tides. Unleash ancient technology, unravel secrets, and shape your destiny in this captivating adventure.

name: Fealty
short_description: A tactical, turn-based strategy game for solo or multiplayer play, lasting about an hour or two. Easy to learn, difficult to master. Plan your moves, conquer your foes, and claim victory on a procedurally generated island kingdom. Fight for the throne or support your liege’s rise to power.

name: Panic In The Woods
short_description: A horror survival and extraction game playable in single player or co-op for up to 4 players. Lost in a creepy forest, you and your friends are hunted by a monster. Stay quiet while extracting keys through nightmarish realms using items like traps, sonars, and flare guns to survive!

name: Chains of Fury
short_description: Welcome to Volume I of a high adrenaline, fast-paced Boomer Shooter where you have only one goal: spread furious mayhem among the scumbags keeping you locked up. Stuck looking for an exit? Just punch through walls and then shoot the suckers behind them.

name: Ominous
short_description: Ominous is a thriller/horror game for up to 4 players. In this game, you must collaborate with your teammates to face a creature within an indoor setting. What sets Ominous apart is its unique approach to multiplayer, offering a distinct experience compared to many other horror games available.

name: Stars And Empires: Colony Defense
short_description: An RTS/Action 3rd person shooter that will eventually let players take part in many scenarios solo or in a team of up to 4 and defend their base against waves of unknown threats of all kinds. Use strategy, unique abilities, tech research and combat skills to hold off any invaders.

name: Nightmare
short_description: This game places you in a besieged city filled with enemies.

name: Chuzzo
short_description: Drop pucks. Score points. It's Chuzzo time.

name: Satellite Odyssey: Prologue
short_description: Satellite odyssey: Рrologue - is a short first-person story-driven adventure with horror elements.Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of classic science fiction and retro futurism, inspired by Soviet sci-fi films. Your partner is the artificial intelligence 'Zarya,'

name: Zombie GO Remastered
short_description: Zombie GO is a puzzle turn-based game with more than 50 beautiful levels. You play as a man who survived the virus and must run away from zombies. On some levels, you must survive people.

name: Seasonspree
short_description: A game about nurturing friendships and celebrating the changing of seasons, where you play as Sunny, a cute little tanuki with the ability to control the flow of time just by walking around.

name: Nerl's Crazy C”rough”t!
short_description: A falling block merge puzzle game starring the wizard Nail. Drop blocks from above and evolve them... but there are three evolution paths! Each block has a freshness level, and if left unattended, it will turn into trash!?

name: Ice Run
short_description: Your fast-paced penguin adventure.

name: CarX Street
short_description: Conquer mountain roads, highways, and city streets. Build your dream car with detailed tuning that unleashes the potential of “CarX Technology”© physics. Take part in thrilling races, enjoying realistic gameplay and dynamic driving.

name: Overboss
short_description: Become a villain in this retro-inspired board game. Draft terrain tiles, recruit monsters, build your dungeon, and become the OVERBOSS!

name: Paper Kingdom
short_description: Paper Kingdom is a colony management game. Stack cards to gather resources, build structures, explore and fight invaders. Turn a nomadic tribe into an empire.

name: The Town of Nie
short_description: The protagonist is a young man named Hisora, who works several blue-collar part-time jobs. One day, he suddenly finds himself lost in a strange world. This is an otherworldly boys-love fantasy in which Hisora will risk his life to find a way back to his world.

name: Bloody Sky
short_description: This is a game where you defeat three bosses. The hero's challenge continues until all the bosses are defeated.

name: Let Them Breathe: Selena's Awakening
short_description: Selena awakes in a dark and hot room where fire burns in stone ovens. She is told by her 'roommate' she needs to find the key to unlock the door. Unlucky for Selena, she has to find many keys to unlock many doors all the while enemies lurk in the shadows.

name: UFO 50
short_description: UFO 50 is a collection of 50 single and multiplayer games that span a variety of genres, from platformers and shoot 'em ups to puzzle games, roguelites, and RPGs. Our goal is to combine a familiar 8-bit aesthetic with new ideas and modern game design.

name: Yesterday's News
short_description: Craft hilarious headlines with your friends in this 3-8 player party game. Score points by composing the wittiest headlines or by supplying the perfect words for your friends' creations!

name: Cozy Desktop: Relaxing Weather and Atmosphere
short_description: Turn your computer into a relaxing and cozy safe place. Activate global weather effects such as rain, snow and falling leaves that play no matter what you are doing. Customize them to fit your preferences and your current mood! Light a comforting camp fire, collect friendly companions and more!

name: Star Knight: Order of the Vortex
short_description: Star Knight: Order of the Vortex is a rogue-lite, bullet-hell, shoot-em-up with the ability to create unique builds and synergies, and test your skills in action-packed gameplay. Choose your crew, upgrade your ship, and explore the unknown depths of the Vortex.

name: ALL IN ONE ADVENTURE VR
short_description: It's all about adventure! A complete collection of cliff climbing, gunfights, zombies, freediving, mystery dungeons, mystery traps, ziplines and roller coasters! ALL IN ONE AD VENTURE

name: HSS:Reload
short_description: This is a very fast God's perspective roguelike shooter, the player will pilot the mech, explore the alien frontier, enjoy the 'Crimsonland + Vampire Survivors (Vampire Survivors)' endless killing!

name: Scary Shadow Spot - Last Farewell
short_description: Scary Shadow Spot: Last Farewell - Haunted by his past, Mark explores a haunted house where nothing is as it seems. Chilling puzzles and shocking truths await. Are you ready to uncover the mystery hidden in the shadows?

name: PERSEPHONE
short_description: PERSEPHONE is a dream-inspired, unique approach to first-person survival horror. With no weapons to attack, you'll need to utilize your environment in order to survive. When your surroundings won't save you in some scenarios, the only option is to run and redirect the threat.

name: InfernHells: A Divine Comedy
short_description: Infernhells is a retro turn-based RPG themed on the mythos of the Inferno. Play as Dantus as he travels deep into the 9 circles of hell. Defeat the diabolical demons of hell and have epic boss battles with the 7 deadly sins in order to reach Lord Lucian's castle in the deepest depths of the Inferno!

name: Cellka
short_description: Cellka is a cute little merger game based around the cells of the human body! Merge cells together to try and get the high score before the entire body fills up!

name: 深空七号 Deep Space 7
short_description: This is an independent action shooting game with a third person horror atmosphere. Facing the terrifying monsters in the space station, you must overcome the shortage of supplies, solve numerous mysteries, and successfully escape danger

name: Coin-Op Vice
short_description: 2.5D Top-Down retro action with deckbuilding and 100+ arcade mini-games. The feature of Coin-Op VICE is the variety of short mini-games that provide different weapons and enhance the hero's characteristics.

name: Escape From Warehouse
short_description: The journalist goes to the warehouse to record a documentary, but becomes a witness to creepy stories. The guards and warehouse workers look very strange. What is really hidden behind the endless shelves and how not to become a victim of the warehouse?

name: Wizard Realm
short_description: Wizard Realm is a challenging rogue-like with RPG elements set in a fantastic 3D world. Craft strategies, master magical skills, equip powerful items, and fight against various types of monsters to survive. Team up with a friend to take down monsters together.

name: TunTown
short_description: ***** This Game is only abailable in Chinese*****卡通風格的RPG遊戲，玩家扮演主角樂樂，地點在木桶鎮，帶領著自己的夥伴們聯手對抗各種威脅小鎮的勢力，解決神秘事件。

name: The Moon 2044
short_description: Explore a secret NCIS facility and discover its dark secret. Take on the role of the XV-11 unit and face hundreds of enemies in a dark sci-fi shooter inspired by old school hits!

name: Shattered Dreams: that one time when all my applications got rejected, so I started my own company. My life became an idle / clicker game where I must increase all incremental values and squeeze my employees for every last bit of soul they have left.
short_description: Do you hate your life? Well, boy, do I have the game for you! Follow the story of a social reject turned evil, soul-sucking CEO. Battle your inner demons, suppress workers' unions, and travel through space and beyond to increase your profit. But watch your step while getting off your ship.

name: NO STRANGERS
short_description: A co-op game where you explore a cursed town and one of you is possessed by the curse.

name: PromptCrafter
short_description: Command line crafting game with procedurally generated crafting trees and programming-like automation.

name: FAIRY TAIL: Beach Volleyball Havoc
short_description: The cast of Fairy Tail is ready to bring mayhem to the summertime beaches! Unleash over-the-top magic to BLAST that volleyball!

name: Rugrats: Adventures in Gameland
short_description: When Tommy, Chuckie, Phil and Lil see a commercial for the new Reptar video game, they pretend that they're in a video game of their own! Toggle between beautiful 8-bit and HD art, select your favorite baby and play solo or co-op in Rugrats: Adventures in Gameland, a neo-retro platformer.

name: Baby Blues Nightmares - Toddler Horror Game
short_description: Baby Blues Nightmares is a survival horror stealth game where you play as a toddler going into a little adventure with your tricycle which you can fix, maintain and customize. Paddle, hide and survive but remember; try not to cry when you are scared.. or the monsters will hear you and get you.

name: Caution Ahead: Part 1
short_description: John Rand, a search and rescue officer stationed at Richburg National Park, finds himself isolated from the rest of the search party looking for the missing girl Elena. Uncover the dark secrets lurking within the shadows of Richburg National Park in this three part series.

name: SuperOffice
short_description: SuperOffice is an intense top down view shooter experience where time moves only when you move.

name: NBA 2K25
short_description: Command every court with authenticity and realism Powered by ProPLAY™, giving you ultimate control over how you play in NBA 2K25. Define your legacy in MyCAREER, MyTEAM, MyNBA, and The W.

name: Signals To EV
short_description: Soak up the music, listen to the stories, and in the end choose the path that's right for you.

name: green ogre gives you terrible life advice and dies
short_description: Enter the swamp and meet green ogre who will guide you through some of the struggles of life by giving you some God tier advice.

name: Labyrinth Of Shadows
short_description: Dive into the Labyrinth of Shadows, a game that challenges your wits and bravery. Navigate dungeons filled with traps, enemies, and hidden treasures. Use unique artifacts to overcome obstacles and uncover secrets. With procedurally generated levels, each playthrough offers a new adventure.

name: DGGWare
short_description: DGGWare is a collection of meme based micro games in the vein of WarioWare. The game centers around streamer Destiny's community and covers topics from gaming, politics, philosophy, debate, art, culture and drama.

name: Bestion
short_description: Bestion is a game that combines Roguelike tower defense elements with automated factory construction. Players are required to construct their own factory on a planet and protect the kernel from monster attacks.

name: Magic Cauldron - Dungeons
short_description: Magic Cauldron - Dungeons is a classic dungeon crawler with a pixel art look. The game is reminiscent of the good old days of grid crawlers, which were still completely 3D-free.

name: Usurper
short_description: A turn-based roguelike deckbuilder where your King is your strongest weapon. Play cards from your deck to drop units onto the battlefield and checkmate your opponent. Build your Deck, Upgrade your Ruler, and Claim the Throne.

name: Bookworm
short_description: Travel across Wonderland in this zen little typing game.

name: Silent Still
short_description: Silent Still is a first-person psychological horror game that delves into the terrifying experience of sleep paralysis and nightmares. You will feel the true horror that sleep paralysis can bring and the overwhelming fear it instills in a person.

name: Dustborn
short_description: Ragtag crew? Check. Musical gear? Check. Tour bus and robot driver? Check. Stolen package? Check! Embark on a perilous road-trip across a Divided States of America. Use the power of words to shape relationships with your crew, get out of trouble and reach your final destination.

name: The Crimson Call
short_description: Set in a post-apocalyptic dystopian future, two young men set out on a journey to find The Great Appearance which manifests itself inside mankind's mind.

name: My Corp Cargo Simulator
short_description: Become the leader of the cargo world! Manage your cargo company, make fast and reliable deliveries. Start on foot, move up to bicycles and motorcycles, expand your fleet. Make strategic decisions and write your own success story in this exciting business simulation game!

name: Chicken Strike®: Cluck Ops™
short_description: Chicken Strike®: Cluck Ops™, the action-packed adventure where feathers fly and the claws come out! Join the uprising to liberate FCK!

name: Rune Bender VR
short_description: Rune Bender is a fast-paced single player rogue-like VR Wave-Shooter in which players fight against monster waves from Slavic mythology to protect the shrine of the god “Veles”. Draw runes to cast spells of different elements and shoot them wisely against 'Perun' the mad god of thunder.

name: UniMed+ solfeggio with VR
short_description: Solfeggio frequency meditation to improve concentration and memory. Aim for a high score with brain training. You can also use VR devices to immerse yourself in a fantasy world and meditate.

name: Deckception
short_description: Deckception is a rouge-like deck builder with local co-op allowing for 1-2 players to conquer the endless floors. The game has one player using the keyboard which can control the cards in the game while the other player controls the mouse which can control the dice. How far can you make it?

name: Tails Noir: Rebel Rush
short_description: Rebel Rush is a single-player speedrunning driving platformer where you sacrifice himbos for hideous carkour moves.

name: かまいたちの夜×3
short_description: サウンドノベル「かまいたちの夜」シリーズ30周年を記念して、『かまいたちの夜×3』がSteamに登場！ シリーズ3作目にして完結編となる本作には、『かまいたちの夜』『かまいたちの夜2』のメインストーリーも収録。 初めてシリーズを遊ぶ方でも登場人物たちの関係性や過去にあった事件を知ることができるので、安心してプレイできる。

name: DOMUS ABSCONDITA
short_description: DOMUS ABSCONDITA is single player horror and mystery adventure. Step into the shoes of a private investigator and try to uncover all the secrets of the Manor. Will you escape with the truth, or will you become another lost soul within its haunted halls?

name: Broadside Renegades
short_description: Broadside Renegades combines auto-firing weapons with manual ship abilities in a rogue-like space pirate adventure. Choose your captain and upgrade your ship to steal the space kings booty. Warp ahead to stay alive, and mind your bearing.

name: ReMix
short_description: ReMix is a unique musical rhythm action game that combines the elements of Rogue games. In this world, you are able to choose from a variety of heroes with different fighting styles and use the power of music to battle against evil void monsters.

name: Tribute
short_description: In 'Tribute,' a fast-paced roguelike, escape prison and save your son by harvesting souls for power, unlocking abilities, and facing numerous foes. Discover 15 endings shaped by your choices, with extensive upgrades and classes enhancing your journey.

name: Fantasy Map Simulator
short_description: Fantasy Map Simulator: Create and watch imaginary worlds evolve over centuries. Design maps, simulate nations, and control destinies. See empires rise and fall on your desktop wallpaper. A unique simulation for history buffs and creative minds.

name: Just a To the Moon Series Beach Episode
short_description: The Beach Episode™ of To the Moon, Finding Paradise, and Impostor Factory. But something's off.

name: Kimi no Hitomi ni Hit Me
short_description: 《你的眼眸命中我心头》是由日本美少女游戏资深大厂GIGA/Entergram（戏画社）制作的一款校园恋爱喜剧作品。发售后赢得了市场好评，中文版收录了家用机版本中追加的人气角色桐原步鸟的路线以及大量新CG。种崎敦美、大桥步夕、户田惠等业内当红声优为本作女主角献声。

name: Land of Artificial Jellies
short_description: Travel at one second per second through this unusual 'puzzle'-like click'em'up!

name: Ether
short_description: Help a Space Mercenary, Ether, complete a difficult scavenging mission in an abandoned ship. Explore 4 different biomes, each with its share of dangers, and escape a swarm of mutant space bugs.

name: CyberCorp
short_description: Brutal fast-paced isometric Co-op Loot Shooter in Cyberpunk world. Equipment-based combos. Exotic Weapons and Armor. Easy to start, hard to master. Play solo or with friends.

name: PeakPals
short_description: PeakPals offers a multiplayer game where players strive to reach the top, either alone or with friends. The game involves overcoming obstacles, solving puzzles, enduring falls, and engaging in playful acts of sabotage, like throwing grenades at teammates' feet.

name: Witchfire
short_description: Witchfire is a first-person dark fantasy RPG shooter in which you play as a wicked sinner turned witch hunter on his final mission to reach salvation.

name: Night of the Dead Simulator
short_description: Grab a weapon and come with us: the end of the human race is near. Enjoy messing around for a while, use your weapons, seek out and keep track of ammunition, and face hordes of hundreds of zombies in an immersive bodycam experience.

name: SuperNovem
short_description: The Galaxy is dangerous. Build your perfect deck, and dominate the skies! SuperNovem is a roguelite deckbuilder packed to the brim with tactical strategy. Fight your way through 100 levels, unlock card upgrades, build your perfect deck and tweak it as much as you want to, and win!

name: The Spell Brigade
short_description: Survivors-like with ONLINE CO-OP for 1-4 players. Team up with your wizard friends to slay hordes of dark creatures. Complete team-based objectives, unlock new upgrades and create overpowered spell synergies. Friend nor foe is safe in this friendly fire bullet hell!

name: Liminal Leap
short_description: Liminal Leap is a heart-pounding escape room challenge set in the unsettling world of the Backrooms. Reality warps, familiar spaces twist, and you're trapped in a labyrinthine facility

name: Eggs: All Guns Broken
short_description: Can the player help a hungover capybara fly 10,000 inches and graduate E.G.G. academy? In this bullet hell resource management rail shooter: waves of enemies, platypuses and a headache caused by gunfire make it a no win situation. Seizure warning.

name: Water Delivery
short_description: Water Delivery is a first person, horror experience where you play as a water delivery boy. Ride along in the delivery truck from house to house. Deliver filled water jugs, find and return empty jugs, and collect all the payments. Will you be able to finish your final route of the evening?

name: Drift Desert Race
short_description: Drift Desert Racing - A wild and chaotic game where you will embark on an 8-hour non-stop journey across an endless desert, all to discover the answer to the ultimate question: 'What is the meaning of life?'

name: 失业了，我获得了亿万游戏财产！
short_description: 《财产》是一款真正的真人互动游戏，内嵌市场仿真的商业系统、非线性叙事恋爱养成。31天，通过投资、拍卖、收购、上市等策略打脸所有人，成就商业帝国！约会、酒吧、QTE互动、私密空间...8位风华绝代的美女将与你共度每一个难忘的夜晚~激活《财产》，打破传统，拒绝按部就班！

name: Undergod
short_description: Take over heaven in this airborne-combat roguelike where you fight hordes of angels while growing stronger every minute.

name: Last Dream Fishing Arcade
short_description: Fish your way across lush Gaia in this retro 2D pixel-art fishing RPG. Enjoy a relaxing day or battle for your fishing life against monsters of the deep. With 12 selectable characters, varying difficulty, equipment options, and numerous surprises, you’ll be hooked on this buried treasure of a game!

name: SUPER SHAKING GIRL!!!
short_description: Shake things up with SUPER SHAKING GIRL!!!, an exhilarating action game that'll have you shaking sodas to propel yourself through the air! Shake, fly, rinse, and repeat... The sky's the limit!

name: Sticker Delight
short_description: Sticker Delight is a short and cozy sticker game about completing errands to prepare New Year's dinner for family and friends. Play with stickers inside the game.

name: Hero Guider
short_description: A construction puzzle game about building various facilities and guiding the hero to go through the mazes.

name: Stevedore 2024
short_description: It's intermodal mayhem! Shift that freight in a hurry without incurring disaster in this physics simulation action RPG. Learn to drive some of the oddest vehicles on the planet as you load huge ocean-crossing ships. And where is that strangely elusive operations manager, the Stevedore?

name: #DRIVE Rally
short_description: #DRIVE Rally is an arcade-inspired rally-driving experience set in the golden racing era of the ‘90s. Grab your co-driver and burn some rubber on iconic race-winning cars across a variety of terrains in some of the most iconic rallying locations in the world!

name: Hue Hop
short_description: Hue Hop is a visually captivating color-matching game in a minimalist isometric world. Navigate a luminous circle across a grid of colorful rings, aligning matching colors to score points. With intuitive controls and a competitive scoring system, it offers a relaxing yet challenging experience.

name: Rainbow Sea
short_description: Rainbow Sea is a multi-ending adventure with pixel-art style based on the myth of the traditional Japanese gods — Seven Lucky Gods.
