You explore inside a treasure ship and make choices to change the storyline. All twenty two endings are true endings, and only you can know the authentic story.

name: The Train Station
short_description: As a Stationmaster of a sleepy English station, it is your duty to carry out the nightly tasks and tend to the customers, but can the customers be trusted?

name: Flowstone Saga
short_description: Master a totally unique puzzle-battle system in this 16-bit, JRPG-inspired adventure featuring an epic story, charming characters, stunning pixel art, and epic music. Follow a grand story set in the mysterious Ocean's End islands full of lost memories, ancient ruins, pirates, treasures, and frogs.

name: Edge of Sanity
short_description: Set in the unforgiving lands of Alaska, Edge of Sanity is a Cthulhu-inspired, 2D survival horror game. Uncover a disturbing story while madness claws at your mind. Lead a group of survivors and explore, scavenge and survive together - against untold eldritch horrors.

name: Frostpunk 2
short_description: Develop, expand, and advance your city in a society survival game set 30 years after an apocalyptic blizzard ravaged Earth. In Frostpunk 2, you face not only the perils of never-ending winter, but also the powerful factions that watch your every step inside the Council Hall.

name: Reach The Beat
short_description: Dive into the stunning world of 'Reach The Beat,' where your shooting skills are tested to the electrifying rhythms of electronic music. In this game, every move and shot you make creates a musical harmony, illuminated by the neon lights of an abstract city. Ready to feel the rhythm?

name: Clostrophobia: Vol 1
short_description: Clostrophobia is a short but very difficult maze crawler horror game where you find yourself trapped inside an unusual and deadly air duct maze filled with unpredictable monsters and deadly traps, and you'll have to find your way out of it.

name: Nocturnals
short_description: A short, choose your own adventure game about two boys that find each other in a lonely, post-apocalyptic town.

name: Strider-X
short_description: Strider-X - Multiplayer First Person Competitive TDM Shooter featuring massive, high quality maps, and immersive gameplay crafted to attract all gamers. Proudly being built based on our communities feedback and input.

name: Sunrise GP
short_description: A classic racer with a sunny twist. Enjoy up to 4p splitscreen, crazy bosozoku like tuning, leaderboards, cell-shaded graphics, synthwave music, and laid-back vibes. Grand Prix is waiting for you!

name: Micro Star Command
short_description: In this minimalist roguelike strategy game, you will take control of your nation's star systems and command your troops as you race to the galaxy's edge. Make split-second tactical decisions as you plot the routes of your forces and gain powerful new upgrades as you expand across the galaxy.

name: Art-Therapy: Cross Stitch
short_description: Perfect for all ages, Art-Therapy: Cross Stitch offers a serene escape from the hustle and bustle of daily life. Whether you're a seasoned stitcher or a newcomer to the craft, our intuitive gameplay makes it easy to dive in and start creating your own masterpiece.

name: Demon Loop
short_description: Demon Loop is a digital board game from renowned tabletop author Alexander Pfister. Build your deck, hone your strategy, protect your people, and unravel the mystery of the ever-changing Demon Loop.

name: Doner Master Simulator
short_description: 'Run your own döner restaurant in Döner Master Simulator! Prepare delicious döner, satisfy your customers, and grow your business. Become a master döner chef and own the most popular spot in town!'

name: Sunset Hills
short_description: After being discharged from the army and starting to write novels, Nico embarks on a trip to the world with the roar of a train, encountering all kinds of people and events on the way, and experiencing the new world after the war, and the real purpose of Nico's trip gradually emerges ......

name: Parking Garage Rally Circuit
short_description: Retro Arcade Rally Racing... in Parking Garages?!? Precision driving with tight simple controls and arcade physics, all in a Sega Saturn style presentation

name: Street of the Cats
short_description: Search and find cats in a relaxing hidden object game for cat's lovers. Can you find them all?

name: Project Castaway
short_description: Project Castaway is a survival crafting title set in the Pacific Ocean. Live the life of a stranded castaway, with only yourself - and the island's inhabitants - for company! Sail the ocean, hunt, explore unique islands and gather resources as you fight for survival.

name: Gym Nights
short_description: Psychological horror with a true immersion into the nightmares of the main character. You are the caretaker of an old abandoned gym, but what is this place hiding? Immerse yourself in this nightmare to deal with it all forever...

name: Retro Dungeons
short_description: A fantasy wave based dungeon crawler with randomized and unique loot. Discover new areas and battle a wide array of different foes in your quest to achieve the fastest dungeon clear time.

name: The Tome of All Tales
short_description: The Tome of All Tales is a minimalist old-school shooter that generates an unique adventure in an new setting every day.

name: Fishing Cat
short_description: A cat that was chased away from the fish market dreams of opening its own fish shop. Catch fish by fishing to gather funds. Help the cat open a fish shop where it can happily eat with its friends without being scolded. Mrrrow!

name: Voids Vigil
short_description: Blast your way through robotic hordes in this auto-battler arena shooter. Use auto-firing weapons and drones, timely dashes and special abilities to reach the Void where a final Conservator Custodian awaits computational convergence. Spend your Cogs wisely among the shops to create unique builds!

name: shapez 2
short_description: Dive into a factory-building game where the focus is on just that — building huge factories! Construct sprawling multi-level factories and min-max your layouts without limits. Shapez 2 is tailor-made for enthusiasts who crave the thrill of optimizing production lines and perfecting automation.

name: Endlessly side-scrolling Balloon Simulator 2024
short_description: Embark on a serene hot air balloon journey, but don't get too comfortable! The real-life-inspired physics can present a challenge as you navigate over towers and under clouds in this easy to learn (but hard to master) endless side-scroller. How far will you make it today?

name: Tidy Backpack
short_description: Tidy Backpack is a relaxing puzzle game where you must organize found fantasy loot in your backpack in a tidy way. Find forgotten artifacts and learn details about the old world... at least supposedly!

name: iZolated
short_description: iZolated - A game of 2D-Action genre with Survival and RPG elements.

name: Back to Dust - Hold it Together
short_description: You and your daughter are in a conflict zone and running low on food, you must travel to the border and try to enter the neighboring country. The path to the border is full of other refugees asking for your help. The more refugees you accept in your party, the tougher will be your journey.

name: Trap Tower Trials
short_description: Trap Tower Trials is a 3D single-player platformer that will test your dexterity with various traps and obstacles. This game is designed to be a challenge; therefore, we are not responsible for any peripherals broken in anger. Do you think you'll be able to climb the tower?

name: The Jackbox Naughty Pack
short_description: Bring the heat with a threesome of fun in Jackbox Naughty Pack. Find out who’s the best liar in Fakin’ It All Night Long, illustrate spicy prompts in Dirty Drawful, and answer questions like “How does this avocado get aroused?” in Let Me Finish.

name: Star Chef Simulator
short_description: Have you ever dreamed of running your own restaurant? Then your dream is about to come true! Set up and manage your restaurant with staff, equipment and more in Star Chef Simulator.

name: Hime Cut
short_description: Defeat countless enemies and aim for a high score! Dot-style 2D shooter.

name: Train Sim World® 5
short_description: The Rails are Yours in Train Sim World 5! Take on new challenges and new roles as you master the tracks and trains of iconic cities across 3 new routes. Immerse yourself in the ultimate rail hobby and embark on your next journey.

name: Pawsome Hidden Cats - Kittynawa
short_description: Discover 'Kittynawa', where hidden cats, quests, and puzzles await in a highly interactive, hand-drawn world. Choose your path, interact with everything, and uncover secrets in this enchanting adventure. Your curiosity is the key!

name: The Neighbor - Escape Room
short_description: Do you dare to discover the secrets hidden behind the next door? 'The Neighbor' will immerse you in a thrilling adventure filled with mystery and suspense. Set in a haunting house, your mission is to unravel its dark secrets before it's too late.

name: Inn Tycoon
short_description: Welcome to Inn Tycoon! Build, design, and manage your dream inn. Serve delightful meals, offer various services, and hire a stellar staff. Create a top-notch hospitality empire and become the ultimate Inn Tycoon!

name: Be Fly
short_description: Be Fly — a meditative 2D game where you control a plane to help the main character win competitions. Navigate around obstacles, catch tailwinds, and perform aerial tricks to soothing music.

name: GoobnBalloonsDX
short_description: Fight off waves of evil balloons and save the galaxy - solo or co-op! Travel between worlds in an extensive story mode, save your friends, and recruit them to challenge dastardly bosses in this arcade shoot ‘em up adventure!

name: Pyrene
short_description: Defeat hellish monsters and rebuild your home in Pyrene, a fast paced roguelike dungeon-crawler. Play with different heroes & spells, collect powerful relics to upgrade your deck while uncovering the mysteries behind your village’s destruction.

name: Plank Builders
short_description: Plank Builders is a captivating yet relaxing construction game. Magical marbles have the ability to make stuffed toys come alive. Together with the monkeys, the player can plan and construct different buildings made out of wooden planks. Find all the monkeys and help them to come alive too!

name: Cyber Tunnel Escape
short_description: Immersive 6 degree of freedom 1000kmh+ high speed flying experience! Drive fast and carefully to survive from a plasma blast as long as you can. Over 2000 different styled tunnels to explore! Support PC & Meta Quest VR.

name: JoY
short_description: JoY is a horror game where unsettling mini-games and chilling cutscenes take an unexpected turn into darkness. Brace yourself for a unique, terrifying experience that will keep you on edge from start to finish.

name: Sewing Stuff
short_description: Sewing Stuff is a delightful and immersive game that invites you to explore your creativity and precision with every stitch.

name: Rockhopper
short_description: Become a space mining astronaut in this chill rogue-lite mining game. Explore, mine and complete objectives while unlocking and upgrading your equipment along the way.

name: FINAL FANTASY XVI
short_description: An epic dark fantasy where fates are decided by mighty Eikons and the Dominants who wield them. This is the tale of Clive Rosfield, a tragic warrior who swears revenge on the Dark Eikon Ifrit, a mysterious entity that leaves naught but calamity in its wake.

name: Pharmacy Simulator
short_description: Experience a realistic pharmacy management experience with Pharmacy Simulator. Set up your shop, decorate it as you wish, and purchase over a hundred types of medications. Pharmacy Simulator offers you an incredibly realistic pharmacy experience. Prove your skills in a challenging economic system.

name: Dark Sky
short_description: Dark Sky is a narrative RPG deckbuilder that features tactical combat and a branching card upgrade system. Assemble your party, customize your deck, and harness powerful synergies to master strategic battles as you unravel the mystery behind a planetary catastrophe.

name: Keylocker | Turn Based Cyberpunk Action
short_description: In a silent world where music is outlawed, play as a singer to shatter the strings of fate and sing the melody of freedom in this unforgiving Turn Based Rhythm JRPG.

name: Shogi
short_description: Master the art of Shogi! Dive into Japan's classic strategy board game.

name: The Hokkaido Serial Murder Case The Okhotsk Disappearance ~Memories in Ice, Tearful Figurine~
short_description: The legendary Okhotsk Disappearance... is coming back.

name: 中传有戏
short_description: This is a serious game developed by the teachers and students of the Communication University of China. The game is set in a real campus space, and players take on the role of a freshman and enter a mysterious and engaging virtual scenario.

name: Kudamono Drop
short_description: Kudamono Drop is an arcade game all about catching fruit to get the highest scores possible!

name: Deep Among the Swarm
short_description: Deep Among the Swarm is a challenging survival RTS roguelite about surviving against thousands of enemies. Drill ever deeper underground while fighting the endless onslaught of the Swarm. Can you save humanity?

name: Dynasty Detective
short_description: DynastyDetective is a visual Novel-style mystery story game set in the fictional Joseon Dynasty where monsters appear.

name: Akimbot
short_description: In the action-adventure platformer, Akimbot, blast your way through armies of robots, pilot spaceships and forge your own path to save the universe from impending doom! Set in a sci-fi world where only robots exist, travel the galaxy and experience non-stop robot mayhem and explosive action!

name: Card Rogue
short_description: A roguelike RPG that you can play in 2-3 minutes! You get three randomly dealt cards, but you can only choose one! This is what happens when you distill the essence of a roguelike RPG!

name: From The Dust
short_description: From The Dust is a fun and dynamic shoot'em up action game! Requiring reflexes and motor coordination. Fight steampunk machines to save your village. Can you complete this challenge?

name: Everlasting Flowers - Where there is a will, there is a way
short_description: A moving, tearful story presented by SPRITE, the creators of 'Love, Elections, & Chocolate' and 'Aokana - Four Rhythms Across the Blue.'

name: A Robot's Tiny Adventure
short_description: A Robot's Tiny Adventure is a calming, short and peaceful game where you take on the role of a tiny robot created to help others. Explore a small open world at your own pace

name: Yep!
short_description: Intonight Prequel: YEP, presents your wonderful encounter at the nightclub.

name: Machinika: Atlas
short_description: Machinika: Atlas is an indie puzzle game and is the direct sequel to Machinika: Museum, you play as a museum researcher who just land on Atlas. Will you unravel the mysteries of the alien vessel? Solve cryptic puzzles to find out what happened!

name: Deja Vu : The Backrooms
short_description: Deja Vu portrays The Backrooms as a manifestation of mental illness. Join forces with a friend and endeavor to escape the confines of both your own mind and the mundane existence that led you here.

name: Empire IDLE
short_description: In this game you will be harvesting resources, upgrading your buildings, waging war, and prestiging, Most mechanics in-game are automated. You won`t need to be active while playing it.

name: Rune Coliseum
short_description: A deck-building roguelike game with unique semi-real-time combat system. Step into the shoes of an ancient gladiator and do your best to survive in the coliseum. Combine various skills and equipment, develop your own fighting style, and defeat all the enemies to become the next champion!

name: MONOPOLY®
short_description: MONOPOLY® is back with a fresh look and an improved game experience. Buy, sell, trade properties, and grow your empire in a fully animated 3D city that follows the days and the weather.

name: Resident Fear 2
short_description: Take part in heart-stopping first-person action with waves of ravenous zombies. Use your weapons wisely, keep your ammo count at bay, and stay focused—all decisions are literally matters of life and death.

name: MOE MOE DAIUNDOUKAI
short_description: MOE MOE DAIUNDOUKAI is a survival game with minimalistic gameplay and roguelite elements. the rivals are here, and there's no place to run or hide. All you can do is survive as long as you can until death inevitably puts an end to your struggles.

name: Kozyrev Horrors
short_description: Step into the Kozyrev Mirror to unlock your Extra Sensory Perception. Beware: dread and horror await. Investigate to find an escape from this liminal space. Are you truly alone? A short and chilling singleplayer horror game, inspired by the Kozyrev Mirror experiments.

name: Survivors Of The Zombie World
short_description: Survivors Of The Zombie World is a 3D pixel-style zombie survival game. Survivors fight in a world full of zombies. Your goal is to survive, find food, ammunition, medicine and other supplies on the map and try to survive.

name: Twilight Express
short_description: A short novel about travelling by train. Become the one who (not)helps three girls to get to the final destination at the sea.

name: Yars Rising
short_description: From the renowned development studio WayForward Technologies, Inc. (Shantae, River City Girls, Advance Wars 1+2: Re-Boot Camp) comes Yars Rising, a 2D action adventure exploration of one of Atari’s richest, and best known classic titles.

name: Easy Ball Game
short_description: Defy gravity in this game out of BALL!

name: Survival Story
short_description: Survival Story is a zombie-infested world where every step can be the last. Look for food and water, hunt and craft, and find out all the secrets that this world hides. Can you survive in a harsh world where everyone wants to kick your ass?

name: Runa & the Chaikurú Legacy
short_description: A fantasy world like no other! Help Runa uncover the mysteries buried deep in the ruins of the ancient Chaikuru civilization, in a classic and epic 3D adventure platformer.

name: Copycat
short_description: A poignant narrative-driven game about rejection, belonging and the meaning of home. It follows the story of a newly adopted shelter cat whose space in the home is taken by a copycat. Bring the tissues.

name: Checkers & Pawns
short_description: Checkers & Pawns is a minimalist and relaxing puzzle game that combines elements of checkers and chess. With more than 50 challenging levels, unique mechanics, and a balanced difficulty curve, it's perfect for casual players looking for a relaxing and challenging experience.

name: ENDURA
short_description: Follow the journey of ex-convict, Jack Jr as he traverse the broken realm of Yagra to finish vital deliveries by utilizing grappling mechanics akin to Spiderman but with guns and swords, and hunting down titans reminisce to Monster Hunter.

name: Ear Clicker
short_description: Ear clicker clicker game to expand your castle

name: Tiny Glade
short_description: Tiny Glade is a small diorama builder where you doodle whimsical castles, cozy cottages & romantic ruins. Explore gridless building chemistry as the game adorns your glades with procedural detail. No management, combat or goals: just kick back and turn forgotten meadows into lovable dioramas.

name: Terrorformer TD
short_description: Terrorformer TD is a tower defense roguelite with a procedurally generated map that YOU shape! Raise or lower tiles, divert enemy paths and funnel monsters into perfectly designed killzones. Randomly drawn cards result in plenty of run variety, as you seek to survive endless waves of enemies.

name: Sword Trip
short_description: 'SwordTrip' is a Chinese-style action roguelite VR game. Pick up your sword, block, slash your enemies, and enjoy a skill system specially designed for VR to create your favorite combat style.

name: Horde Survivor
short_description: Battle hordes of monsters in this top-down roguelite arena bullet hell game. Play alone or with up to 4 players online. Choose what character to play, what stat to gain, and which spell to learn. Every decision matters in your survival against the hordes of monsters.

name: Ale & Tale Tavern
short_description: Get ready for a thrilling mix of genres: a cooperative, first-person, open-world fantasy tavern simulator, action, fishing, hunting, exploration, and completing fun and diverse quests. And, of course, COOKING! Play with friends, feed and quench the thirst of the entire world!

name: Multiplayer Shooters
short_description: Multiplayer Shooters - A fast paced shooter game with lots of different game modes and weapons

name: Perfect Hand of Nostalpix [REMASTER]
short_description: Perfect Hand of Nostalpix is a remaster of the 1989 digital card game classic. Defeat your foes with a deck you tweaked to perfection by collecting, upgrading and evolving each card, in this blast from the past enhanced with new mechanics!

name: Just Walk
short_description: One Character, One way and One Button you must never let go of.Just Walk.

name: Trap for the Heir
short_description: Gwen is an experienced werewolf mercenary. One day, she comes across a simple and very monetary order. But who is her mysterious customer? And will it be so easy to get to destination alive? New friends, old enemies and maybe a meeting with love...

name: Idle Towers
short_description: An idle survival game with tower defense mechanics. Build your own perfect defese and face infinite waves of enemies!

name: Ark's Wonder Dungeon
short_description: Explore looping halls, chat around the campfire with dungeoneering misfits, and learn to make the most of each turn in this JRPG dungeon crawler!

name: The Hilarious Three Kingdoms
short_description: In the game, players will play the role of Liu Bei, the monarch of Shu Han during The Three Kingdoms period, and defeat the strong enemies encountered by cultivating the military generals and forming the characteristic army. Whether you can change your life and unify the three countries is up to you

name: ESports Simulator
short_description: ESports Simulator is a simulation game where you can create and manage your own esports team.

name: Project Evolve
short_description: Take control of Azula in this action-packed beat-em-up adventure game, where you will recover your abilities as you progress through the simulation. Use close combat attacks and powerful electrical strikes to defeat your enemies and reach the end!

name: The Plucky Squire
short_description: Storybook characters discover a three-dimensional world outside the pages of their book and must jump between 2D & 3D realms to save their friends in this charming action-adventure.

name: Sustained
short_description: This is a open world Survival Zombie game with survival mechanics in single player and (PVP) (PVE) in Multiplayer or Co-Op. Join a few friends and look who can survive the island full of zombies and other players trying to survive like you, it has base building, Crafting, food, water, Temperatures.

name: Dead Rising Deluxe Remaster
short_description: Dead Rising returns with modern graphics in this Deluxe Remaster!

name: Cozy Sudoku
short_description: Sudoku, tunes, and some furry friends.

name: Evil's Maze
short_description: A Horror Game with Escape Room Mechanics. A Player will need to find a way out by looking for items and clues in various locations and Escape from the Maze. You rented a house to get some sleep. It turns out the house is not normal and you have to find a way to escape in order to stay alive.

name: Blazing Balls
short_description: Collect unique and powerful upgrades while fighting through hordes of charging, shooting, angry and most importantly, evil enemies in this chaotic rougelite shooter.
You are locked in a quiet apartment room. The only way out of the tightly closed door is to get to the truth of the case. Overcome your fear and try to escape.

name: Bloody Hills
short_description: Survive Sunny Hills camp as The Hiker stalks you relentlessly. Brace for brutal chases, gruesome encounters, and agonizing escapes in this merciless survival horror game. Outsmart the killer, unravel secrets. Can you escape his bloodlust?

name: Grind Rush
short_description: Join an intense off-road racing with destruction. Quad bikes, buggies, and monster trucks compete on tracks across grasslands, forests, and beaches. Use boosts and find shortcuts to claim the top spot!

name: Iron Meat
short_description: Iron Meat is a run-and-gun arcade shooter that immerses players in an apocalyptic future overrun by 'The Meat,' an iron-ravenous mass mutating everything in its path. Blast your way through retro-inspired stages and bosses to uncover the shocking horrors behind secret experiments on the Moon.

name: Sandbox World
short_description: Welcome to the Sandbox World! Here, you bring your ideas to life: create tanks, airplanes, ships, and anything else – with over 120 unique blocks at your disposal. Engage, defend, and showcase your masterpieces in tense multiplayer battles that await you!

name: City Bus Simulator 2024
short_description: Embark on the ultimate urban adventure in City Bus Simulator 2024, where the bustling streets are your playground and the city's pulse beats through every road. Get ready to take the wheel of detailed buses, transporting passengers through a dynamic metropolis teeming with endless possibilities!

name: Idle Stellar
short_description: Embark on an epic adventure through the cosmos in Idle Stellar. Gather, craft and upgrade your spaceship to destroy your enemies. Play actively or relax into idle progression as you experience the feature-rich journey ahead!

name: Whispers of Prague: The Executioner's Last Cut
short_description: Classic first-person point-and-click adventure game set in contemporary Prague. As a programmer and treasure hunter, you embark on a long journey to uncover the secrets of the infamous Executioner. Your task will be complicated by a sect of fanatic cultists and your own unexplained heritage.

name: Chromacell
short_description: In this sideways scrolling shmup, take control of your spaceship and navigate through vibrant pixelated environments filled with hordes of enemy spacecraft. Upgrade your ship and weapons, dodge enemy fire while blasting through each stage. Emerge victorious as the ultimate space pilot!

name: Solar - Survival Space Battle Simulator
short_description: In SOLAR, you survive in space, expand and customize your fleet, and battle enemy fleets and up to 12 bosses. With tactical decisions and rewards, you optimize your spaceships for epic battles.

name: Wander Hero
short_description: This is the fantasy of a two-dimensional traverser in a different world. You can take a leisurely and strategically deep adventure. You can also collect beautiful girls without hurting your wallet, and form your own harem... ahem, mercenary group.

name: NEODUEL: Backpack Monsters
short_description: NEODUEL: Backpack Monsters is a PvP inventory auto-battler with a monster-trainer twist! Collect Cosmions and items, and strategically manage your backpack to create unbeatable combos in tactical duels. Rise through the leagues to become the ultimate Cosmion master!

name: Forgotten Skies
short_description: Discover the mysteries of Forgotten Skies, a fun platforming adventure where ancient secrets and hidden dangers await in this captivating adventure game. Forgotten Skies invites you on an incredible journey into a world of mystery and adventure and fascinating unique creatures.

name: Clean Your Room
short_description: Clean Your Room is a first-person memory puzzle game. There are several levels (denoted as hours) that you must complete. Each hour is more difficult than the last, taxing your memory more and more. Return all items to their designated location before time runs out!

name: Can we be three?
short_description: “Can We Be Three?” is a playful and heartfelt Yuri Visual Novel and Dating Sim. Step into Yolanda’s shoes as she navigates sun-soaked days in the Dominican Republic, rekindles old flames, and discovers just how far she’ll go to find happiness.

name: Rain and the Wolf
short_description: A boys love / yaoi visual novel based loosely on Little Red Riding Hood. Follow Rain as he meets a mysterious werewolf, Zero, deep in the woods, and shape his fate with your choices. Will Rain be able to tame the werewolf, or will he meet a grisly end?

name: Slum Guide
short_description: Explore a mysterious slum town and recruit women seeking fortune. Use them as fighters in a coliseum or to defend yourself against local threats. As a cunning guide, gather intel, use tools, and manipulate secrets to immerse them into the town's hidden desires.

name: Jousting Manager
short_description: Jousting Manager allows you to play a sports management game from a new angle. Take control of a medieval jousting team and handle all aspects of the club as you compete to reach the top.

name: In My Brain
short_description: In My Brain is a pixel art sci-fi action-puzzle game that follows Nano, a nanoparticle that infiltrates minds and fights against the mental health problems that haunt them. Learn about them and fight them from the inside!

name: Tilescape Defense
short_description: Tilescape Defense is a puzzle-like tower defense game with expansion and resource management elements. Expand by placing tiles with matching edges. Manage resources. Modify enemy path. Equip forts with different weapons.

name: G-MODEアーカイブス+ 牧場物語モバイル Life&Love
short_description: Enjoy a heartwarming farm life while growing crops and interacting with animals!

name: Ancient Savo
short_description: Raise a family in the pristine woodlands of ancient Finland. Manage your homestead, craft tools and items, barter for goods, live off the land. Continue as your offspring, start new homesteads. Plan wisely to survive in the wilderness where cold, hunger and accidents are your enemies.

name: Delivery Point Simulator
short_description: Welcome to 'Delivery Point Simulator'!Manage a parcel pickup point: receive and deliver packages, improve infrastructure, purchase licenses for new products, manage transportation, and invest money in the bank. Become a leader in the logistics industry!

name: Politica: Nothing Ideological. It's Just Business
short_description: Politica is a mini-game political simulator. Assuming the role of a lobbyist in republican Italy, players will have to accumulate as much money and power as possible through lobbying strategies, political relations and intrigue.

name: Wizard of Legend 2
short_description: Face perilous magical trials in the fast-paced rogue-lite follow-up to the acclaimed original, featuring co-op and vibrant new 3D visuals. Master new Arcana and elements, experiment with spell combinations, and become the next Wizard of Legend!

name: Daddy Comes Home
short_description: You will play as a father who, in a nightmare, sees his wife and son smiling at him bizarrely. When you wake up, you find that reality is even more cruel.

name: Summon: Joint escape
short_description: Summon: Joint Escape is a cooperative horror survival game for 1-4 players. Find a way to escape from a stalker in camouflage uniform who wants to give you a piece of paper with the inscription 'Summon'.

name: Cat Nips
short_description: Cat Nips is a game about a cat eating people to escape an office. This cat will need to sneak past guards, cameras and other dangers in order to escape.

name: No Arm
short_description: Reach the destination. Even if you get frustrated, don’t smash your keyboard.

name: Schizophrenia: The Last Shift
short_description: Remembering the past while corruption occurs, you are set out to finish the remainder of your shift until you cannot anymore. Stock the shelves using your forklift and be a productive member of society while evading the inner demons within you in this horror survival to meet quota.

name: Cat Fusion Quest
short_description: Dive into the enchanting world of Cat Fusion Quest, a delightful and addictive puzzle game where the goal is to combine adorable cats to create even more charming and powerful feline friends!

name: Only Pinball
short_description: At 'Only Pinball' you can expect pinball tables in the style of the 80s, 90s and modern. You get realistic physics, elaborately modeled tables, atmospheric lighting, high-quality sounds and exciting themes.

name: Virtual Training Ship
short_description: Our ‘Virtual Training Ship’ is an educational game designed for maritime professionals, maritime colleges and academies and those curious in life at sea on a modern ship. This is a lite version which showcases a few of the custom scenarios we could develop for you!

name: Gaming Cafe Simulator
short_description: Revive a closed-down gaming café and build it into the ultimate gaming hub! Manage rentals, sell gaming merch, and expand with PCs, consoles, and an in-house café to prepare and sell fresh food. Attract customers with unique gaming sections. Can you turn your dream café into a bustling success?

name: 勾八公主狂想曲（J8 Princess Rhapsody）
short_description: Chinese love simulation, with different styles of female masters began a fantasy journey, and in the process of contact with them in-depth understanding.

name: Pinball Spire
short_description: Action adventure meets pinball in this one-of-a-kind pinballvania adventure. When a mysterious spire appears from thin air, it's up to an intrepid pinball to bump, spin, shoot, and flip its way to the top and solve the tower’s mysteries!

name: Baker's Agony
short_description: Enter the dungeon to get the coveted sacred flour in this sword-focused action-roguelike. Make your way through bizarre and/or cute bread creatures thanks to the weapons and resources you'll find along the way, and if you don't succeed, try again, as the dungeon will have changed.

name: Endoparasitic 2
short_description: Three limbs ripped off, infected with a deadly parasite, you must survive. Drag yourself through the hallways of an infested arcship, fight off twisted eldritch creatures, craft vaccines and ammunition, and escape to civilization.

name: Train Yard Builder
short_description: Enter the world of Train Yard Builder and customize your railway to your heart's content. Work with different models of trains and wagons, control them the way you want, and use modeler tools to unleash your creativity.

name: Yume No Office
short_description: 'Yume no Office' is a visual novel where the protagonists will fight for their performance bonuses using the oldest method to solve their problems: Pong. Their moods are different each day, so don't be swayed by the first impression.

name: Egg Squeeze
short_description: Egg Squeeze is a biological intuition test where you squeeze eggs for as long as you can without breaking them.

name: Dungeon And Darkness
short_description: Create your own avatar and live as an adventurer in the town of 'Elbern,' surrounded by dungeons. Delve into the dungeons and collect weapons and equipment with random effects. The goal is to conquer the final dungeon, the 'Great Hole of Elbern.'

name: MEMORIAPOLIS
short_description: Memoriapolis invites you to construct a city that spans 2,500 years of history, from Antiquity to the Age of Enlightenment. Choose your culture, manage resources, face historical events, build 'Wonders' to achieve the status of Capital of Capitals and leave your mark in history!

name: SomnaBuster
short_description: BE WILD! BE WONDERFUL! BE-WITCHING!

name: Combat Directive : Napoleonic Wars
short_description: Inspired by legendary classic wargames , Combat Directive brings the strategic depth and ideological brilliance of these classics to life, reimagining the monumental battles of the Napoleonic Wars. It's crafted for the true enthusiasts of historical warfare.

name: Puffin Planes
short_description: A casual airline management game set on Earth and Mars. Supports singleplayer and Steam co-op.

name: Alchemy in Dungeon
short_description: Roguelike auto chess, delve into dungeons to slay monsters, collect materials, and craft the ultimate potion combinations!

name: Zone 13
short_description: Find anomalies, escape the endless loop, and uncover the dark secrets of Zone 13.

name: Nightmares Mansion: Scary Dreams
short_description: Explore a scary mansion in the first-person adventure horror game. Talk to kidnapped souls, collect grimoires, and discover the hidden secret inside the many doors. Your soul was stolen, and you found yourself in the underworld. Can you escape?

name: Shadow Bounded
short_description: A horror game where a relentless AI enemy haunts your every move. Navigate through darkness, uncover the secrets of the cabin, and survive the nightmare.

name: JeliWave
short_description: JeliWave is a linear 3D platformer with the visual appearance of retro games from the 90s. Swing your way through various worlds, unlock new abilities and master the art of Jeli's grapple!

name: One S'More
short_description: Can you help an adventurous marshmallow fulfill its dream of becoming a tasty S'More? Watch your mind crumble as you break apart islands and rearrange the whole world to help your little marshmallow friend reach their goal of getting squished between two chocolate cookies.

name: Food Boy
short_description: 1980's Paperboy meets 2020's Food Delivery Service in an exciting, stylish arcade adventure.

name: Liberator TD
short_description: Liberator TD is a glorious mix of tower defense and top down shooter genres set in a sci-fi world. Tasked with the mission to establish a new colony on a distant planet, you find yourself in grave danger of the local wildlife.

name: Enotria: The Last Song
short_description: Enotria: The Last Song is a soulslike set in a beautiful sun-lit world inspired by Italian folklore where the brightest sun casts the darkest shadow. Wear unique role-altering masks, face formidable foes and alter reality with the power of Ardore to unravel the secrets of Enotria.

name: Elemental Exiles
short_description: Elemental Exiles is an RPG deckbuilding roguelike. Play as one of 12 heroes, each with their own personal quest, starting location and initial cards. Overcome challenging battles and adapt to unexpected narrative encounters as you grow your deck and explore.

name: GTAQ
short_description: 'GTAQ' is a highly flexible top-down shooting and strategy game!

name: Sonny Legacy Collection
short_description: Sonny 1 and Sonny 2 team up in the Sonny Legacy Collection. Traverse a story-rich world where strategy meets supernatural in a quest for identity and survival. Master tactical turn-based combat and discover the truth behind Sonny's resurrection in these classic RPGs.

name: Spooky Pixel Hero
short_description: Enjoy 2D pixel platformer levels inspired by old-school classic retro games and haunting glitch horror.

name: Zombie Battlefield Survivors
short_description: Zombie Battlefield Survivors is a top-down view roguelike action shooter game. Fight against hordes of zombies, constantly upgrading attributes and collecting credits to enhance your character's abilities.

name: TCG Card Shop Simulator
short_description: Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.

name: Tescaris  -  A Soothing Cute Puzzle Game
short_description: Tescaris is a soothing puzzle game. Unlike typical puzzle games, the puzzles here are more relaxed, allowing you to enjoy a stress-free and pleasant break. Each level is carefully crafted with countless solutions. Use your imagination to find a path to victory that is uniquely yours!

name: Mine From Here
short_description: Avoid mine and find route to develop this new land of opportunity! MINE FROM HERE is a 2D rouge-like puzzle game inspired by minesweeper. Scan the map, find the mine, get item and drive your rover to escape from mindfield!

name: The Orange
short_description: In a forgotten universe lies a legendary orange: the Orange of Infinity. Press it to shape existence itself and confront the darkness.

name: The Nameless: Slay Dragon
short_description: The Nameless: Slay Dragon is a gamebook-adventure flavored turn-based RPG In short - how to slay the immensely powerful and cunning evil dragon? You will play as a young man having a bloody feud with a dragon, and face powerful, sinister and tricky enemies with friends....

name: Samuel Sage: The Mystery at Penby Inn
short_description: A murder-mystery visual novel about a young man who inherits a charming English hotel. Some would say he’s fortunate, but with a growing list of unexplained disasters and murder, has his luck finally run out?

name: Legends of Kailrate
short_description: Put yourself in Kailrate's shoes, he needs all of us to defeat the enemies who attack him. Help him defeat all of this, but be careful legends, bosses also form from time to time, be careful.

name: Bubble Wrap
short_description: The simple and fun way to relax!

name: Escape the Space!
short_description: is a thrilling action-adventure game where you play as a space explorer stranded without fuel. Using a portal, you travel to another realm to collect and sell trash to refuel your spaceship.

name: Auto Sale Life
short_description: Build an automotive empire. Buy, sell, and customize cars to create your own brands and showrooms. Become a shrewd entrepreneur in this immersive car trading and customization game.

name: NanoApostle
short_description: NanoApostle is a dark sci-fi boss rush action game featuring intense reaction-based combat and the unique 'Destruction Point' system. Play as Anita, a child augmented with lethal nanomachines, as she battles against twisted cybernetic experiments to escape a top-secret facility.

name: SorcerialBladeCannon
short_description: ■Bullet Hell Shmup with a Huge Sword This game is a bullet hell shmup to have you satisfy with a beginner and the arcade senior player! Swing a huge sword around if you become dangerous!

name: Pixelmon Arena
short_description: Pixelmon Arena is a roguelike action-adventure where you play as Pixelmons! Explore and battle your way through the different biomes and discover exciting encounters to see if you have what it takes to emerge victorious.

name: Critter Crops
short_description: Enter the world of Mutter Island as Sylvie, a newfound witch with the ability to grow magical Critters. Restore the island, welcome the unwelcome, and uncover the mystery of Sylvie's past!

name: Math in Space
short_description: Are your kids tired of the daily grind of school classes? Hold on—don’t rush to dismiss the value of learning just yet.

name: Tenebris: Terra Incognita
short_description: A turn-based tactical RPG in which you will explore a harsh planet teeming with terrifying monsters. Experiment with talent builds for 23 heroes. Combine abilities with equipment and other characters. Assemble a squad and learn the secrets of the planet Tenebris!

name: Repent
short_description: Robert Watford, a retired cop with a troubled past, starts his first day as a night shift guard which unbeknown to him, would directly implicate him into a series of paranormal events revolving around a secretive cult with evil intentions.

name: Forever World Cup Simulator
short_description: Simulate over 40 events, including the World Cup and continental cups. Enjoy high replayability with 220+ national teams evolving dynamically over the years. Use powerful in-game editors to create new teams and edit tournament formats, while tracking detailed statistics for every team and event!

name: DATE A LIVE: Ren Dystopia
short_description: Play as Shido and unravel the secrets of the mysterious spirit Ren in the visual novel follow-up to DATE A LIVE: Rio Reincarnation, based on the acclaimed light novel and anime series.

name: 硅心_Silicon Heart——AI少女情人梦 _AI Girl Lovestory
short_description: 超越程序化的爱——阿宅插画师与机器人少女的温馨恋爱喜剧！

name: Afternoon of Resurrection
short_description: As just a citizen detached from society, in this top-down horror game with point-and-click mechanics, try to survive the nights while dealing with your psychological problems and hallucinations, living in a weathered house.

name: Escape Gaia
short_description: you will play as Gaia, the shattered will of a planet, and command your spaceship to explore new worlds, collect and refine various resources, build a home on the damaged spacecraft, summon a wide range of monsters, and ultimately, devour other shattered wills to repair yourself.

name: Alexandria IV
short_description: Tasked with commanding of one of the most challenging sectors of the galaxy, the future of the Alexandria IV space station depends on your diplomatic and strategic capabilities. How far will you go to prevent a war? A space opera visual novel by J.M. Beraldo.

name: Lorn's Lure
short_description: An android is led through a vast structure by a glitch in his visual system. Lorn's Lure is an atmospheric narrative first-person platformer with novel climb-anything mechanics and modernized retro 3D graphics.

name: Car Detailing Simulator VR
short_description: In Car Detailing Simulator VR, you have the power to renew and restore cars to its former glory, catering to the demands of your discerning customers. Transform neglected vehicles into stunning and well-maintained machines that can be the envy of all.

name: Project: AHNO's Ark
short_description: This game merges elements of tactical RPG, Go, and introduces Roguelite features. Players will need to make decisions among numerous random events and capability divergences, trying to survive in an apocalyptic game of mutual destruction.

name: Dance Eden
short_description: This is Dance Eden, a VR game where you can dance solo or with others! You can dance in real-time with other players, fully enjoying the joy of music and dance.

name: Spiral
short_description: Spiral is a third-person narrative exploration game that shares a poetic vision of cognitive degeneration. Step into the shoes of Bernard as you help him and support him while braving his unravelling mind and reliving his most treasured moments.

name: Devil's Hideout
short_description: Devil's Hideout is a horror point and click adventure. Lauren learns from a mystic that her young sister is still alive, with cultists staging her death. Traveling to the hospital where her sister received care, Lauren plunges headfirst into a nightmare.

name: BlindSpell
short_description: BlindSpell is an adventure draw-based game in which you have to guess what enemies you are fighting.

name: Stargazer
short_description: Jaxx Fury returns to his hometown as the last hope against the dark wizard Nachtengel. With bravery and determination, he must save his people and fulfill his destiny. Guided by Nala, navigate the cursed town's labyrinth and defeat Nachtengel. The town's fate depends on you!

name: BreakBall
short_description: Shoot your friends with balls that bounce off walls in this fast-paced tactical arena fighter. Discover dozens of modifiers and millions of combinations, and beat your friends by being the fastest to adapt to the ever-changing rules!

name: Robo Reckoning
short_description: A Casual Singleplayer game that lets the player explore the open world map. Made with low poly design and family friendly vibes to give a relaxing experience.

name: 異変麻雀
short_description: Can you escape from the never-ending strange Mahjong game? 'Strange Mahjong' is a Mahjong game where you need to notice 'strange events' during matches. It consists of rounds where you point out these 'strange events' and rounds where you must solve 'Mahjong puzzles' under special conditions.

name: Five Hearts Under One Roof
short_description: Yuman’s, the player, once solitary home and routine are now invaded by five beautiful women! Each has her unique charm – the 'childhood friend of 20 years,' the 'first love and former idol,' the 'demanding boss,' the 'bold younger girl,' and the 'shy recluse.' Who will you choose?

name: RantCPU LiteByte
short_description: Welcome to LiteByte, a mindful puzzle game where you reveal beautiful images. Combining the mechanics of classic Minesweeper with the image discovery of color light games, LiteByte offers a unique experience. Embark on a relaxing journey of discovery and uncover hidden wonders.

name: The Beast in the Silent Valley
short_description: A forgotten village, cut off from civilization, had a curse that would bring only death and fear. Gravets, in the role of the most soulful mandrivka, finds himself in this village, where all the bastards have become deprived of a trace of their thirst.

name: ISEKI
short_description: Embark on an ancient adventure, uncovering secrets in a 3D dungeon. Automatic combat based on Memory Threads, each with unique abilities. Manage fuel for exploration; depletion means retreat. Expand fuel, collect Threads, follow commands, and discover ancient mysteries.

name: Fraudster
short_description: Fraudster is a role-playing game set against the backdrop of telecom fraud. Players take on the role of a recent graduate who accidentally ends up in a fraud company. While striving to achieve the fraud goals, players can also engage in various other activities.

name: Choppie's
short_description: A horror game where you have to escape a restaurant from a killer rabbit that has got a really sharp arm. Will you chicken out or face your fears?

name: BomboCat
short_description: In BomboCat help the mice in their revenge against the cats. In this shooting puzzle game, use physics to destroy buildings in the most efficient way possible, use different techniques and skills to overcome 30 levels with increasingly difficult challenges.

name: Late Shift
short_description: Late Shift is a first-person horror game. Immerse yourself in a realistic thriller and try to escape the death that follows your life as a night shift worker at a gas station.

name: Robot Rampage
short_description: *Robot Rampage* is a thrilling multiplayer robot shoot 'em up that immerses players in fast-paced, high-stakes combat. Set in a futuristic world where advanced robotic warriors clash in fierce battles.

name: Alphabet
short_description: A stage-clearing 3D wire action game that tests your 'use of wire movement inertia' and 'puzzle-solving skills.' The shapes of all 26 stages are based on various letters of the alphabet. Complete the missions for each stage!

name: Boyhood's End
short_description: Boyhood's End is an adventure horror game following Giovanni, the boy with the lowest human score in the universe, and Campenella, the delinquent genius, and their journey on the galactic railroad regarding the 'human' and 'inhuman'.

name: exclusive memory
short_description: Exclusive Memories 'is a first person immersive suspense love full dynamic live action interactive video game. A sudden accident caused you to lose your memory. Can you retrieve your memories and everything that belongs to you in the turbulent undercurrents?

name: 3 Minutes to Midnight - A Comedy Graphic Adventure
short_description: In a race against time, Betty embarks on a thrilling, comedy-packed adventure to crack a conspiracy that starts with a bang and ends at 3 Minutes to Midnight.

name: 创世法则
short_description: Open world turn-based RPG, you can explore, collect stat enhanced items, weapons, in a certain order to beat the copy, magic has a variety of attributes, if the enemy stat weakness, can greatly increase the damage

name: Melty Amethyst
short_description: The full-voiced otome visual novel that adds colour to ordinary life.

name: INDUSTRING
short_description: A minimalistic urban planning puzzle. Manage resources. Manage building locations. Accumulate knowledge points and discover the secrets of the destroyed planet

name: Nuclear Lizard Island Rampage
short_description: Play as an enraged kaiju and defend your home against industrialists stripping it of its resources.

name: SnowDown
short_description: SnowDown is a shared-screen party game for up to 12 players using their phone or web browser as a controller. Unleash a flurry of snowballs on the other team as you race your forts to the top! Will your team stand victorious or will your hopes come crashing down?

name: Japanese Rail Sim: Hakone Town of Natural Beauty and Hot Springs
short_description: Next stop Hakone! Come operate the Hakone Tozan Train, a famous mountain train located in Hakone, one of Japan's top tourist destinations! Experience the spring and autumn seasons in Hakone!

name: Epstein 2
short_description: Join detective Michael in his psychological horror-filled adventure to gather evidence and find his mother on Epstein's dark island. In this single-player game, read notes carefully, collect equipment to protect yourself from aggressive test subjects, and uncover the truth...

name: EA SPORTS FC™ 25
short_description: EA SPORTS FC™ 25 gives you more ways to win for the club. Team up with friends in your favourite modes with the new 5v5 Rush, and manage your club to victory as FC IQ delivers more tactical control than ever before.

name: Ultimate Zombie Defense 2
short_description: 4-player co-op, zombie slaying, base building, boss battling mayhem! Cleanse the infected wave by wave and upgrade your base with traps & defenses in Ultimate Zombie Defense 2!

name: Deathly Dominion
short_description: Deathly Dominion is an intense survival game where players face endless hordes of zombies in a post-apocalyptic world. Each wave brings new challenges, requiring quick skills and well-thought-out strategies to survive. An immersive and challenging game for fans of the genre.

name: EVOTINCTION
short_description: In 'Evotinction', a third-person hacking and stealth game, you are Dr. Liu, the only one who can stop rogue AIs in a futuristic research facility. Use a variety of hacking skills to overcome robotic threats and uncover the secrets that hold the key to humanity's survival or its potential extinction.

name: Hook-a-Duck VR
short_description: Exactly what it says on the tin; Hook-a-duck, in VR! ...except some of the ducks have outboard motors, and can actually 'fly'.

name: BeYourCat
short_description: 'Be Your Cat ' is a real love game,like an experience in life, one interesting dream. We all wish we had superpowers, but what would you do if one day you had superpowers, but not like Superman? What will you do with your limited abilities? How does it affect and change the people around you?

name: Cosmic Guardians
short_description: Become a Cosmic Guardian in this thrilling space shooter! Defend Earth from alien threats, battle colossal bosses, and save the universe. Play solo with A.I. or team up in co-op mode. Level up, unlock abilities, and collect power-ups for an epic adventure!

name: Alpha Runner 2
short_description: Alpha Runner 2 is a challenging endless platform game with different game modes, Make your way through different obstacles and mini games that get more difficult the further you get. Show off to your friends by getting the highest score on the leaderboard.

name: Little Rooms
short_description: Welcome to Little Rooms! Enter a house, pick a room and search the requested objects! Take your time.

name: Blind Man's Sun
short_description: My name’s Jack. I’m possessed. There’s a spirit living in my body with me — he heals me and sometimes gets on my nerves. Oh, and he lets me see through his ghostly eyes — since I went blind after the crash. And you know what? I’d be better off staying blind...

name: Outland Kingdoms
short_description: Colony building RPG with detailed characters, driven by procedurally generated Stories. Build a hut, a village, a town, a city, a kingdom. 5 different races. Ally with unique factions. Rule an Undead empire. Craft Legendary items. Tame creatures. Enslave enemies. It's all here.

name: Grand Numbers Plus
short_description: Welcome to the Kitty Academy. Add numbers, memorize the plus and reach the goal. Reveal and prove that you got it right. Earn amazing Badges, Increase speed and level. It's a test for your brain. A simple game of mental skill, with 2 game modes, Classic and Advanced. Play and overcome.

name: Waifu Simulator
short_description: Waifu Simulator is a simulation game whose ultimate goal is to bring you pleasure and relaxation!

name: Gravitorium
short_description: Harness the power of gravity to maneuver through challenging precision platforming and puzzle levels in this fun and kinetic 2D platformer!

name: City 20
short_description: Embark on a dystopian-tinged survival sandbox adventure where the world dynamically responds to your actions. Craft your own narrative through a series of choices, navigating harsh environmental conditions and organized factions, and delving into unsolved mysteries.

name: hoptix
short_description: hoptix is a movement playground game where style and speed come easy! Play as Rocket, a cyborg rabbit who is as cute as they are radical. Explore, race, and stunt on rollercoasters and skateparks in idyllic spaces. Share footage of your movement style with your friends.

name: Fera: The Sundered Tribes
short_description: Fera: The Sundered Tribes is an enthralling mixture of monster hunting survival action RPG with village building and tribe management with groundbreaking aerial traversal and combat mechanics.

name: Cyberwar: Neon City
short_description: Explore a cyberpunk universe where monkeys rule. Challenge the fearsome Cyber Monkeys as you take on the role of a hero armed with a living shark weapon.

name: Wukong Monkey King's Journey West
short_description: Quirky Journey to the West: Wukong has learned more skills—capture balls, rocket launchers, and dark magic to subdue demons. If the teachings don't resonate, I also know a bit of hand-to-hand combat.

name: Fowl Damage
short_description: Fowl Damage is an atmospheric puzzle platformer where your default jump provides enough fall damage to destroy you! Carefully manage your jumps and falls as you adventure through this chilling, beautiful, and occasionally cute world.

name: Dadlympics
short_description: Engage in physics-based fun! Conquer hilarious dad-worthy challenges with friends in the DADLYMPICS. Are you ready to claim the title of ultimate dad?

name: Marko: Beyond Brave
short_description: Marko: Beyond Brave is an action-packed Metroidvania adventure. Wander through lush forests and crumbling castles, battle corrupted creatures, and escape intricate traps. Jump, slash, and shoot your way through challenging foes and mighty bosses inspired by Slavic myths and legends.

name: A THOUSAND MOUTHS TO SCREAM
short_description: Psychological Body Horror visual novel in a space setting with different endings depending on your actions.

name: Dodge Barrage
short_description: Dodge Barrage is a chaotic dodgeball party game. Use quick reflexes and aggressive plays to throw, dodge, and parry your way to victory. Play with up to four players either locally or online.

name: The Writ
short_description: The truth is out there, if You can survive long enough to find it.

name: Choice of Life: Wild Islands
short_description: Conquer the jungle and prove that in any situation you - the master of your fate!

name: Crazy Zombies
short_description: In a world ruled by zombies. As one of the survivors, you will embark on an adventure full of unknowns and challenges, using your wisdom and courage to challenge zombie armies of different difficulty levels and find hope for survival.

name: ▼スライム娘は人間と友達になりたいようだ+
short_description: 「にんげんさん、はじめまして！おともだちになってくれますか？」人間と友達になりたいスライム娘のアウラを描くポイント＆クリック型ノベルゲーム。出会った人間の心に染まりやすい純粋無垢なアウラは･･･

name: Monomyth
short_description: MONOMYTH is an immersive, first-person dungeon-crawling RPG inspired by the genre's late classics. Embark on a journey through a vast and highly interactive game world as you unravel the mysteries hidden beneath the ancient fortress of Lysandria.

name: Gourds Up
short_description: Gourds up is a 2D shooter, with many roguelike-y elements. You will progress through runs by choosing the next rooms, through the form of cards, that you will fight in, allowing for more strategy during the run. Get random weapons and upgrades, and just don't die!

name: Ashes of the Union
short_description: A vehicular shooter with roguelike elements, offering a wild take on an alternate future of the Soviet Union. Build your combat vehicle and show nature who's boss!

name: HiPurrLand
short_description: Hundreds of cats and fifteen brand-new levels await your exploration!

name: Fury's Path: To The Stars
short_description: A colorful 2D platformer adventure to the stars! Navigate vibrant levels filled with tricky enemies and collect shiny diamonds. Each stage offers fun challenges that test your skills and patience. Jump, defeat enemies, and reach the finish line in this exciting journey!

name: Angelica's Chaotic Hardcore School
short_description: Angelica's Chaotic Hardcore School is an Indie Horror Game inspired by Baldi's Basics in Education & Learning, featuring a young girl named Emily in a Chaotic School with 5 different floors. From Solving Math Problems to discovering new Science Experiments. Different Knowledge is Required!

name: Sparky: Hills of Death
short_description: Hito Corporation immerses players in a dark universe where the monster, Sparky, comes to life in a sinister way, blurring the boundaries between reality and game. While cyber security expert Zac and his girlfriend Marina face strange events both in the game and in real life.

name: Far Horizon
short_description: Far Horizon is an action-adventure RPG set in the far reaches of space where floating islands, beautiful vistas, and alien creatures await. Embark on an epic adventure of exploration, ingenuity, and survival as you loot, shoot, and craft to forge your destiny among the stars.

name: The Dark Horde
short_description: The Dark Horde is a roguelike deckbuilder where you control the flow of time by playing cards! Summon a horde of minions at your command, harvest the Souls of fallen enemies and send your disposable Goblin Looters on the Battlefield to seize precious Gold. Lay waste and enjoy being Evil!

name: BANAN'EM UP!
short_description: BANAN'EM UP! is a tiny challenging arcade shoot’em up where you shoot down quirky aliens to save your planet. Evade bullets, shoot enemies, get upgrades, survive for challenging waves to defeat the final boss, 'The MONKE'. Die, learn, repeat: get stronger, be powerful!

name: My Sweet! Housemate
short_description: Faced with the cruel and harsh reality of homelessness, you seek out affordable housing in your area. Luckily, it seems you've found the perfect rental, but something is very off about your landlord...

name: Sovereign Stars
short_description: Build your galactic empire, conquer planets and emerge as the last player standing in this real-time strategy game.

name: Starstruck: Hands of Time
short_description: Starstruck: Hands of Time is a story-rich rhythm adventure game where you play guitar and abuse time travel! Control a giant hand destroying a miniature town, or play as the two guitarist kids living in it. For extra fun, optionally plug in a Guitar Hero controller!

name: Simulator of Countries
short_description: This game is a global strategy game that gives you the opportunity to play for countries in the modern world. Here you will be given a choice of 198 countries for which you can play.

name: Liar's Bar
short_description: Dive into this multiplayer online experience set in a sketchy bar where the games are as dangerous as the patrons. Join a table of 4 and test your skills in Liar's Dice and Liar's Deck, where lying and bluffing are key to victory. Ready for a night at Liar's Bar?

name: Echo Point Nova
short_description: Echo Point Nova is an open-world FPS that offers unparalleled freedom and thrilling speed. Designed for both singleplayer and coop. From the creators of Severed Steel.

name: Refuted Wind
short_description: Mysterious murders are happening in the area where Dave lives. In an attempt to draw attention to these horrific events, he decides to make a short film. As his project becomes known, frightening events begin to happen around him.

name: GreedFall II: The Dying World
short_description: Dive back into the unique world of GreedFall again in an even deeper RPG experience. Uprooted from the island of your birth, find your freedom, explore the old continent and forge your destiny through alliances, scheming and battles!

name: Zombie invasion
short_description: A fast-paced first-person shooter where you fight endless waves of zombies in a crumbling temple. Armed with a Pistol and Shotgun, survive increasing challenges with each round. Earn points to buy ammo and health from the in-game store. How long can you last against the relentless horde?

name: Judero
short_description: A handmade action/adventure game based on the rich folklore of the Scottish Borders.

name: Lunara: Planet IX
short_description: Build and explore in Planet IX, a vibrant 2D pixel art simulation game where you create a colony on a mysterious planet, face monsters, and uncover secrets while managing resources and oxygen.

name: Hitmen Havoc
short_description: Hitmen Havoc is a cartoony, fast-paced 2D arena party shooter for 2-8 players. Imagine a wild mix of Worms and Unreal Tournament—customize battles with unique characters in modes perfect for quick sessions or lively parties with friends, foes, strangers, or viewers. Can you finish on top?

name: Age of Mythology: Retold
short_description: From the creators of the award-winning Age of Empires franchise, Age of Mythology: Retold goes beyond history to a mythical age where gods, monsters, and humans collide.

name: Void Stealer Bodycam Horror
short_description: Survive the hostile wilderness of the Cluster in a ferocious bodycam trip to find the source of a mysterious Delta radiation. Use its power to turn yourself into the deadliest hunter and knock the shit out of the most horrifying beings of the multiverse.

name: You will be cursed
short_description: Someone has proof of your crime. You must escape from the cursed house by finding evidence that accuses you. With your guns and wisdom, ostracize and remove the cursed. Your life depends on this job...

name: Sweet Dreams
short_description: Light hurt his eyes, use that to your advantage and keep him away. Learn the different points where the creature can enter to be prepared. Sound will give you clues to the creature's arrival. Keep your flashlight charged up. Every night the creature will try new ways to trap you.

name: Chromatic::/Resonance
short_description: Bullet hell meets auto-shooter in this roguelike color-matcher where RGB itself is your weapon! The Maiden of Light has been captured by the forces of entropy. Six challenging bosses stand in your way and only you can save her!

name: Cult of the Dragon
short_description: An open world RPG with 10 different classes to choose from, 1 evil cult to defeat, & 1 massive world to explore.

name: Arcane Arts: Sorcerer's Quest
short_description: Return to the world of magic for another academic year!

name: A Hunter's Tale
short_description: Explore Fuji's mysteries in this VR RPG adventure. Battle massive beasts, conquer challenges, and grow stronger with each encounter.

name: Market master Simulator
short_description: Take charge of a bustling supermarket in Market Master Simulator. Manage staff, inventory, and product creation while mastering advanced energy systems. Navigate challenges in this dynamic simulation game now in Early Access.

name: You struck gold
short_description: Stranded on a mining planet, your escape hinges on quarrying gold. Solve challenging puzzles by using unique card abilities to uncover riches and escape in this strategic, card-based puzzle game!

name: Bankshot Launchers
short_description: Create havoc in this ricocheting arena shooter where precise trick-shots are king. Master a variety of unique weapons and work with your team in challenging levels to achieve victory over your opponents.

name: Parkour Is White?
short_description: Are you good at parkour games? And are you looking for something different? This is your game. Use the cards and complete the level in the shortest time. Climb the leaderboard!

name: Beardbarians
short_description: Prepare your hair to attack, smack and knock back anyone who dares oppose you in Beardbarians! Pick from a colourful cast of characters and stages to duke it out with friends, locally or online, or work together to protect your gem from goblins by upgrading your abilities in the tower defence mode!

name: Shinehill
short_description: Yet again they dumped the toughest job on you. Now you are on a Shinehill Island, where you suddenly replaced one of the new residents. Explore the world, meet charming townspeople, do farming, fishing, cooking and try not to reveal yourself.

name: Town Keeper
short_description: Build a rabbit town while defending it from the fluffy empire's invasions.

name: A Space Between Time
short_description: Play as a robot with time-manipulating abilities. You can go to places you've never been before by going back in time in the X and Y axes independently. Just beware pockets of time corruption, and tracking your positions in time consumes a lot of memory. At max capacity, you can no longer function.

name: Beware The Ghost
short_description: A spooky party game played on two screens. Up to 4 players explore a haunted house while another player tries to do them in as an invisible ghost.

name: Amazing Weekend 2 - Search and Relax Collector's Edition
short_description: 'Amazing Weekend 2 - Search and Relax 2 Collector's Edition' is a great new hidden object game. Experience hiking, horseback riding, and boating provide unforgettable escapes from the rush and bustle of city life. Discover all of the hidden objects and complete loads of challenging mini-games.

name: Bloomtown: A Different Story
short_description: Bloomtown: A Different Story is a narrative JRPG mixing turn-based combat, monster taming and social RPG set in a seemingly pleasant 1960s Americana world. Join Emily and her group of friends to save their cozy town from the demonic creatures that live in the hearts of its residents!

name: Dawn of Defiance
short_description: You are the Defier, subjected to a mythic plot across ruined isles. In this Greek myth-inspired survival craft, ascend from weak soldier to god-like anti-hero. Build impressive Greek structures, craft and upgrade your gear, and face down the trials of Gods with up to 3 friends.

name: Pharaoh's Purse
short_description: An economy focused tower defense where you play as an Egyptian pharaoh seeking to reclaim his lost wealth in modern times.

name: Bulletmancer
short_description: In this horde survival roguelite you don't move, but you do shoot! Choose a wizard to wield the Arcane Turret, combine different bullet spells and survive until the final boss comes to face you.

name: Bush Simulator
short_description: Welcome to Bush Simulator, the game you never knew you wanted and probably still don't, but hey, it's here! Get ready to experience the ultimate in bush observation—because who needs explosions, zombies, or epic quests when you can just... look at a bush?

name: Golden Lap
short_description: Step into the polished shoes of a racing team manager in the heart-stirring Golden Era of motorsport where every decision can lead to glory or gravel. With sleek minimalist charm and deep strategic gameplay, Golden Lap offers a unique experience in the motorsport management genre.

name: Pushing It! With Sisyphus
short_description: A game about a very happy guy and his boulder.

name: Dread Dawn
short_description: This is an open-world zombie survival game set in a quarantined city. You play as a student left behind due to missing the evacuation convoy. Together with classmates and other survivors, you must defend the school, survive, and await rescue.

name: Eye of the Commando
short_description: Classic turn based dungeon crawling with an 80's action movie twist! Raid, explore, and fight through the grid-based island hq of a group of non-specific international terrorists and deliver hot lead freedom turn after turn. Secrets, puzzles, discovery, oversized weapons and the Commando Spirit!

name: ExoColony: Planet Survival
short_description: Space-colony simulation game. Guide generations of colonists, raise and educate them, manage resources, and ensure food supply. Maintain a breathable atmosphere, tackle pollution, and refine materials to build essential structures. Terraform planet and build ecosystem to make it your new home.

name: Gengu Survival
short_description: Survive on an open-world island with unlockable abilities that help you on your journey in Gengu Survival. Craft new items as you level up and build your own base wherever you want. But be aware, there is something strange on this island...

name: Best Gun
short_description: Best Gun is a light-hearted arcade flight action game featuring both single-player and multiplayer content. Fly (or walk) and take part in fights, mini-games, races, and more.

name: Chaos in the harem
short_description: is a casual light rogue-type game. You play a beautiful girl with magic. Defeat all kinds of enemies, enemies are beautiful but also very powerful. Don't be attracted by their beauty. Pick up your weapon and don't let it crush them.

name: Passageway of the Ancients
short_description: Inspired by classic CRPGs from the ’90s and early 2000s, Passageway of the Ancients transports players to the world of Aieryon – the galaxy’s sole remaining magical planet – where they explore the city of Ithgar to solve their parents’ murder.

name: Tower of Dreams
short_description: A vertical platformer roguelike where you use your sword to pogo off obstacles and enemies and ascend the tower

name: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Dark Prince
short_description: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Dark Prince comes to Steam®! Recruit monsters from the DQ series, synthesize new creatures and compose your ideal team.

name: Nick Jr. Party Adventure
short_description: You're invited on a party adventure with your favorite Nick Jr. characters, in a colorful puzzle platformer that everyone can enjoy!

name: THE DAMN PSYCHIATRIC
short_description: The 'San Lucas' psychiatric hospital, which was built in 1985 to help people with mental illnesses, became the scene of crimes and suspicious experiments in the year 2035. Patients mysteriously disappeared and some were found found dead in a strange way.

name: HiddenSet
short_description: Uncover hidden color combinations to recreate the original cube design. In advanced mode, combinations rotate at various angles. Enjoy dynamic bonuses and customizable difficulty for endless fun!

name: Guns And Draguns
short_description: Experience the thrill of teamwork and competition in Guns And Draguns, a roguelite shooting game. Navigate through a perilous fantasy dungeon, defeat enemies together, and gather upgrades to defeat the final boss. But don't trust your friends too much; you all aim to be the best player!

name: XENO WIPEOUT!
short_description: After centuries of invincibility, it became popular for humans to watch live alien hunting shows, participate in alien hunts, save up money, equipment, and use all the loot you find to move on to new maps and defeat more powerful enemies.

name: Street grabbing of territory
short_description: 未来人类的生存空间受到了极大的挤压，贫富差距走入了极端，为了生存街区和街区的矛盾严重激化，为了争夺街区之间的生存空间，街区的老百姓为了生存拿起了武器相互对抗了起来。 玩家扮演的是一名街区的执行官带领街区的兄弟姐妹一统街区重新建立起街区的新秩序。 在游戏过程中可以点击街区的指挥中心招募街区兄弟姐妹为自己作战防守或者击毁对方的街区。通过建造防御设施可以防守或者推进街区的战线！ 这是一款休闲的对线游戏。玩家可以扮演第三人称射击娱乐也可以和RTS游戏一样建造和招募队友或者士兵作战。游戏有丰富的随从单位，和随机获取支援的宝箱系统。有随机的补给NPC出现在地图上为其提供补给。

name: Meowmewbug
short_description: ' Meowmewbug' is a relaxing and stress-relieving idle game. Tap on the magic circle to summon unique meowmewbugs, collect the paw balls they drop, unlock more styles of scenes, fun features, classic mini-games, and summon even more meowmewbugs. Come and spend the best day with the meowmewbugs!

name: Dreamstate
short_description: Dreamstate, can you survive your worst nightmare? In a point-and-click sit-and-survival psychological horror game, you fight off your nightmares throughout multiple nights to make it to the end of the week, with each night getting more challenging.

name: VR Sailing
short_description: It allows players to transform into sailboat navigators, sailing their beloved ships in the endless sea and enjoying the thrill of 360 degree immersive sailing and waves! Feel the forward momentum brought by the wind.

name: Elemental Guardians
short_description: The world has plunged into chaos after the altars were deactivated. As the chosen hero, only you can restore balance by taking the unique abilities from the Guardians. Harness their powers to bring harmony back to the shattered world and revive the altars!

name: Yugo: the non-game
short_description: Yugo: the non-game is a virtual space where you can drive a car, listen to the radio, and invite people to talk and share the experience with.

name: Bombergrounds: Classic
short_description: Bombergrounds Classic: Blast your way through action-packed multiplayer mayhem! Drop bombs, swing bats, and outsmart your opponents to rise to the top in this nostalgic arena battle experience. Join the chaos and claim victory!

name: Idle Space Force: Retro Clicker
short_description: A retro idle adventure that plays like a top down shooter!

name: Assassin's Creed Mirage
short_description: Experience the story of Basim, a cunning street thief with nightmarish visions, seeking answers and justice as he navigates the bustling streets of ninth-century Baghdad.

name: Măgurele Mystery 2
short_description: After Captain Burcea's discovery from the previous game, the secret services started experimenting with what they found, but everything goes out of control and a virus is created by mistake... or was it? Peoples zombie-like starts wandering around and mutated creatures start killing.

name: Infinite Widgets
short_description: Elevate your desktop with Infinite Widgets, the ultimate tool for creating and sharing custom widgets. Monitor system performance, hardware temperatures, control media, create dock/taskbar widgets, and more with the built-in editor and our Lua and JavaScript implementation.

name: Animal Connect Fusion
short_description: Animal Connect Fusion is a delightful and engaging game with simple yet captivating gameplay. Players collect animals by connecting those located close together, forming the brightest straight line. The more animals connected, the higher the score.

name: They Do Not Die: Call of Crimson Tgirl Apex Land Zombie Shooter Duty 2D Keywords
short_description: I just think that top down shooters are neat. It's a pretty zen time. A podcast game.

name: War Of Castles
short_description: Capture the enemy castle! Conquer all the islands! 'War Of Castles' is a war-themed real-time strategy game where players lead soldiers to seize castles and claim islands. Beware of surprise attacks from the enemy while assaulting their castles!

name: Last Time I Saw You
short_description: First loves. Family issues. Yokai. 'Last Time I Saw You' is a coming-of-age adventure set in 1980s Japan.
