Explore a haunted forest hiding a terrible secret, and interact with a vast cast of friendly and deceitful characters in this beautifully hand-drawn story with some light action elements.

name: TIMORE NARHELMA
short_description: Timore Narhelma is a surreal experience about human mind and horrors within.

name: Heavens Loss
short_description: Embark on a surreal journey in Heavens Loss, an atmospheric adventure where you play as a frog traversing mystical realms. Solve abstract puzzles, navigate bizarre landscapes, and adapt to new forms as you uncover the secrets of this enigmatic world, all set to an immersive electronic soundtrack.

name: Sword and Shield Idle
short_description: Enter a never-ending idle game. Battle creatures, rescue captives, forge swords, wield shields, and get special boosts. Each restart makes you tougher. Easy to play, deep in strategy.

name: Merchant in Dungeon
short_description: This game is all about managing shops.Hercules enters Dark Gate Town solo, aiming to repay his father's debt. Starting with a store, he grows capital, hires, expands shops, and manages relationships with diverse female NPCs. Dominating the business scene? Quite a challenge!

name: LightRay
short_description: LightRay is a top down logic puzzle game in a peaceful setting, that features a plenty of Puzzles that utilize Lasers, the behavior of light and it's colors to create problems to be solved by you.

name: Abyss Rebirth
short_description: ●Game overview 'The Labyrinth of the Abyss' has a depth of over 4000 layers. There is only one adventurer who challenges the labyrinth. Visit the central city of Midgard.

name: Unplagued
short_description: Play as plague doctors with your friends in this multiplayer co-op medieval horror! Purge the plague. Create the cure. Escape the mutated creatures. Make the queen proud.

name: BRAZILIAN DRUG DEALER 3: I OPENED A PORTAL TO HELL IN THE FAVELA TRYING TO REVIVE MIT AIA I NEED TO CLOSE IT
short_description: A BRAZILIAN BOOMER SHOOTER GAME MADE USING THE ID TECH 2 ENGINE! SHOOT, JUMP, EMBARK ON A JOURNEY THROUGHOUT THE STATE OF RIO DE JANEIRO, HELL AND EVEN HEAVEN! SAVE BRAZIL!

name: Wings of Redemption
short_description: Wings of Redemption is rogue-lite top-down action game with focus on combining melee and ranged combat. Destroy hordes of monsters in randomly generated maps with variety of weapons on your way towards freedom.

name: Being John Gogh
short_description: 'Being John Gogh' is a life simulation game where you play as John, navigating through a world rendered in the style of Van Gogh's paintings, focusing on improving relationships, managing health, and enhancing charisma to find happiness on Bozca Island.

name: 电子心理治疗：愈见群岛
short_description: 【心理数字疗法】自行疗愈心理创伤，缓解焦虑、抑郁情绪。开发团队来自北师大心理大佬与中科院心理所博士。游戏采用EMDR训练的游戏化设计，宛如一座通往快乐天堂的奇幻乐园，每次交互都是心灵净化之旅，每段旅程都疗愈创伤。无论环境如何变化，让我们一起维系心理健康吧！

name: PolyZ
short_description: Imagine DayZ mixed with Escape From Tarkov, but in Low Poly. A persistent world survival game featuring PvP, PvE, crafting, base-building, and zombies infected with a contagious virus.

name: Backrooms: The Labyrinth
short_description: Explore non-linear paths and evade lurking monsters as you uncover the mysteries of this eerie maze. Beware of the sinister entities that inhabit the shadows, ready to drag you deeper into the unknown.

name: Escape From Island
short_description: After a helicopter crash on a mysterious island, your mission is to survive and escape before the island’s dark forces consume you. Explore, gather resources, and face dangerous enemies as you navigate the island’s open world. Can you escape before it's too late?

name: Shadow of the Orient
short_description: Shadow of the Orient is a 2d pixel art action platformer where you play as a young warrior named Xiaolang who must venture across the orient fighting hordes of Samurai warriors and mythical creatures in an attempt to rescue the kidnapped children of the orient and face off against the dark lord.

name: MagicTowerReset
short_description: Retro RPG game, gameplay includes storyline, numerical calculations, equipment and item acquisition, HD-2D style, CRT TV screen

name: Bean There, Won That
short_description: Bean There, Won That is a physics driven party game designed to test your skills and your friendships! Engage in a variety of crazy minigames as you shoot, boot and bash your way up to the top of the scoreboard! Online or split-screen, you can crush your friends in your home or worldwide.

name: Train Traffic Manager
short_description: All aboard the chaos express! In Train Traffic Manager, you're the maestro of mayhem, directing an orchestra of trains, drawbridges, and cataclysms. Keep your cool, your trains on track, and your sense of humor intact!

name: MASH VP! Re:VISION
short_description: [Fusion, synthesis, coalescence][MASH VP! Re:VISION] is a next generation music game with exciting 2 column gameplay! Featuring new tracks composed by hugely popular music game artists, choose your favorites to mash up and create a new sensation!

name: Island Treasure Chase
short_description: We explore the pirate island searching for treasures and trying to escape from skeletons.

name: Who Dies First ?
short_description: You will be put into silly and funny situations in real life where you have to predict who will die first. Try to predict as many correct as possible to get the highest IQ score. Compete with other players in intelligence.

name: Loop
short_description: Loop is a visual novel set in a dark Irish Forest. Deirdre is set to find her husband who was sworn to become the Forest King. But it’s not easy for a human to walk in the magical realm. What will Deirdre learn about this other world? What will she find out about herself?

name: Witching Stone
short_description: Witching Stone is a puzzle game matched with a deckbuilder! Customise your spellbook and weave spells with coloured stones.

name: World Diplomat
short_description: Embark on a diplomatic journey to impact the world with skills and strategy.

name: Cozy Keep: Farm, Craft, Manage
short_description: Experience the daily life of a shopkeeper! Clean and decorate the place, pay taxes, gather resources and craft products that can be sold for maximum profits! Explore the world, hunt, and cultivate the land! Own the best shop in the region and save your father from the wrath of the King!

name: Beyond Shadowgate
short_description: The original design of the never-before seen point and click adventure has been brought to life after 30+ years in the vault - Beyond Shadowgate! This new massive game (created by the designer of the original hit Shadowgate and a leading 8-bit adventure studio) is 5 TIMES BIGGER than NES Shadowgate!

name: Sniper Killer
short_description: Eliminate your victims as a serial killer dubbed ‘The Sniper Killer’. Terrorize the city with your keen eye and thirst for blood while staying one step ahead of a detective hell bent on bringing you to justice.

name: Pneumata
short_description: Prepare to question what is reality, and what is insanity in one of the scariest psychological horrors in years. The tenants are going missing, screams echo and blood seeps through the walls of Clover Hill.

name: Re:Flex
short_description: Dance to the rhythm with your mouse!

name: Dawn of Anarchy
short_description: In Dawn of Anarchy, you become an experienced soldier and combat mech pilot tasked with a secret mission. A factory producing artificial intelligence robots has gone out of control. Prepare for the decisive battle at the dawn of anarchy.

name: Oh My Goddess!
short_description: 玩家将扮演男主角龚贺，以第一视角沉浸式地与五位长相、性格、风格、职业等都不一样的女生开展甜蜜和有趣的故事。大大咧咧的美女主播、内心小狂野的女演员、霸气温柔的女高管、搞怪活泼的小护士以及温柔贤淑的舞蹈老师，丰富和精彩的剧情，结局由你决定。

name: Viking Fish
short_description: An idle-fishing game played at the bottom of your screen, letting you multitask effortlessly. Progress by unlocking Vikings and upgrading their gear to fish for better loot, faster.

name: Arbor Island
short_description: A short, relaxing game about exploring different areas on an island. There is also a scavenger hunt for each area.

name: HAWA:99 - Cyberhive
short_description: HAWA:99 - Cyberhive is set in a city dominated by a company named 'The eye'. One day, with a loud noise, building of the 'The eye' cracks-the protagonist has to find out whereabouts of his friend, 'Malus', who said he would bring down 'The eye''s server and get to the bottom of the truth.

name: Ninano: Dream Ranch
short_description: Welcome to the Ranch, where you can raise animals! Diverse locals such as Elves, Demons, Vampires, and others await you. Collaborate with them to build new facilities and invite new neighbors to make the Village vibrant. Enjoy activities like fishing, cooking, gathering, dating, and mini-games!

name: Unknown 9: Awakening
short_description: You are Haroona, a Quaestor born with the ability to venture into a mysterious dimension: the Fold. On her quest for powerful hidden knowledge, she must learn to master the powers of the Fold to fight a secret society with a hostile agenda.

name: Waifu Slots
short_description: Step into the vibrant world of Waifu Slots, the most exciting slot machine game where you can experience the thrill of winning big while surrounded by stunning waifus!

name: Aquarium at August 32nd
short_description: The rumor says that strange events will come to those who recite the words to regret their summer vacation. On 32nd of August, you will become part of an urban myth. A mysterious day at the curious aquarium awaits you.

name: Floor 9
short_description: In Floor 9, you find yourself trapped in a mysterious hotel known as 'Hotel Liminal.' To escape, you must identify anomalies on each floor. These anomalies can be anywhere - on the ground, in paintings, or even right in front of your eyes.

name: Subside
short_description: Subside is an immersive aquatic VR experience with multiple areas to explore and lifelike aquatic creatures to interact with. Crafted with unparalleled realism, it aims to replicate the nuances of real-life swimming and diving in shallow waters

name: Press Paws: Idle Clicker
short_description: Press Paws is a casual, laid-back and cute Idle Clicker Game in Pixel Art style with mini-games.

name: Anomaly Corridor
short_description: Navigate a seemingly endless corridor, uncovering eerie anomalies as you struggle to escape your doomed ship!

name: Night Drive: คืนหลอน ซ่อนทาง
short_description: Welcome to 'Night Drive,' a driving simulator that challenges you to navigate a seemingly endless night in search of anomalies to break a mysterious loop.

name: Blazing Strike
short_description: Challenge fighters from all dimensions with Blazing Strike! In this dystopian world run by a corrupt and murderous government, a resistance group is ready to stand up for the people. Will they succeed in overthrowing these evil autocrats?

name: Mask Quest
short_description: A platform game about running, jumping and breathing.

name: Multiplayer Ninjas
short_description: Multiplayer Ninjas - The village is under attack, grab Your sword and go get 'em! (Multiplayer or Single Player)

name: Pazinko!
short_description: Pazinko! is a fast-paced arcade pachinko game. Launch chrome balls through vibrant, dynamic pegboards. Test your reflexes and timing as you launch balls through a maze of obstacles, aiming for the highest score.

name: Melobot - A Last Song
short_description: An adorable musical robot named Melobot, created to preserve harmony, awakens on a strange, silent planet consumed by a mysterious dark matter. Now, Melobot must embrace a role it was never programmed for: the role of a hero.

name: Security Control
short_description: Don't Get Fired! Clock into this Party-Horror adventure for 1-4 players. Hide, run, complete objectives, steal money and escape before you get caught and fired! Team up with or challenge friends in this spooky multiplayer adventure, available in both VR and non-VR modes.

name: Loot Stack - Relics Hunter
short_description: Explore ancient dungeons, uncover hidden treasures, and master the art of inventory management as you organize, stack, and collect precious relics in 25 scenarios. Can you find them all?

name: Forget
short_description: Immerse yourself in a living nightmare where every dark corner of the apartment hides terrifying secrets. Wake up without memories, Pursued by an enigmatic presence, and discover the truth about a missing child. Reality or illusion? It's up to you to unravel the inexplicable.

name: 易经·占卜
short_description: This divination simulator, grounded in the ancient I Ching principles, offers traditional Chinese 'Numerical' and 'Hexagram Divination' methods. With an AI feature, it answers queries on both ancient metaphysics and modern topics like astrology and MBTI, catering to diverse mystical interests

name: A Quiet Place: The Road Ahead
short_description: A Quiet Place: The Road Ahead is a single-player horror adventure game inspired by the critically acclaimed blockbuster movie franchise. Survive in silence.

name: Kosmo Skirmish
short_description: Kosmo Skirmish is a multiplayer space combat game. From 2 to 8 players, take on your friends on the various destructible planets. Choose the right combination of weapons and tools to win the game.

name: NightDirge
short_description: Dirge, Anna and Fang travel the now apocalyptic world which has been overrun by sentient vines, moss and more. Do you have the soul needed to traverse and overcome this nightmarish land of Halleumask?

name: STAaRS
short_description: In STAaRS, you play as a volunteer investigating unknown activities in a simulated environment. During a 24-hour test, events appear randomly, and you enter the virtual house via a portal to investigate. Observe, categorize, and report events based on Space, Time, Anomalies, and Reality.

name: Colors
short_description: Dive into the world of Colors, a delightful puzzle game where your wits put to the test. Uncover the hidden hues beneath each square by analyzing the colors surrounding them. Simple yet challenging, Colors offers an engaging experience that will keep you guessing and entertained for hours.

name: Convoluted Incident: Pinch me
short_description: Confusing Incident: Pinch Me is an adventure game with horror elements. You play as an ordinary guy who got into an accident and ended up in a mysterious house. He has to find a way out of the house and solve the mystery of this house.

name: KOUR 64
short_description: KOUR 64 is a goofy 1st-Person Parkour platformer, inspired by Collectathon games from the late 90's. Explore a wacky dream world using a dreamlike depiction of parkour, meet funny characters and grab a bunch of loot in this short adventure.

name: 6 Keys: The Gym
short_description: Please obey the school rules You're on key duty in charge of the gym. Find and organize the keys scattered in the gym and leave school. Organize your keys and organize the phenomena around you together.

name: The Exit 8 VR
short_description: The popular indie game “The Exit 8” is reborn and brought to virtual life as “The Exit 8 VR”! Experience the eerie and thrilling atmosphere of Japan's underground passageways, now with new anomalies!

name: The Eightfold Path
short_description: The path of a Buddhist monk is a path of enlightenment. Find your way through the mystical forest, encounter beautiful creatures, magical places, evil spirits and puzzling challenges that will test if you have what it takes to become a buddha.

name: No Ghost in Circus Caravan
short_description: It's a small... somewhat eerie circus caravan. Each round lasts a few minutes, leading to numerous endings. Unravel the mysteries and control the outcomes. In the end, you might just hold it in your hands...

name: Tankbot Battle
short_description: A fast paced, action packed, roguelite game with tanks! Blast your way through procedurally generated levels, and build overpowered combinations of upgrades! Face off against a variety of different enemies and epic bosses.

name: Survivor Alliance
short_description: Go hunt zombies! Survivor Alliance is a survivor like game that combines zombie and pigeon elements, strengthening oneself through repeated choices and constantly improving in a world full of crises. Use strategies and operations to fight until the last moment.

name: Mouthwashing
short_description: The five crew members of the Tulpar are stranded in the empty reaches of space, shrouded in perpetual sunset. God is not watching.

name: Underwater Cycling
short_description: **Underwater Cycling** takes you on an exhilarating underwater adventure where you as main character race on high-tech bicycles that glide through the ocean's depths.

name: Anthology Of The Killer
short_description: The complete surrealist horror-comedy series! A mysterious world of zines and blood!!

name: Conquistador
short_description: Conquistador is an adventurous roguelike platformer. Navigate hand-crafted and procedurally generated levels as you jump, slash, and maneuver through thick jungles and ancient temples. Collect valuable items, abilities, and precious loot to help you conquer the game's challenging traps and enemies.

name: MANIKA
short_description: 'MANIKA' is a psychological horror game played in the first-person perspective. Solve puzzles to escape from a mental hospital where you don't know why you are there. Good luck, because you are not alone...

name: Up to Par
short_description: Up to Par is a minigolf game with roguelite elements. Stay under par, or you're out! Play through procedural levels, spend your spare shots to unlock abilities, and push your golf game to the limit across unique environments.

name: Madness on Display
short_description: Venture into the world of chilling psychological horror, where the line between reality and nightmare is thinner than a spider's web. Grandview is not just a game, it is a test for your nerves and mind.

name: The Memory In Walden Pond
short_description: Imitate ancient Chinese,In the bamboo forest landscape, survival hunting, farming herding horses, fishing qiao Jiang Zhu, build their own peach blossom source.

name: Don't Wake Up The Dead
short_description: Seal a ghost before it wakes! Armed only with a weakening flashlight, move quickly through a haunted house where doors lock randomly. But beware—The faster you move, the more noise you make and too much noise will awaken the spirit. Can you survive the night?

name: Their Navy Is Their Doom
short_description: Command an advanced submarine in a heart-pounding horror experience as you hunt the last remnants of a defeated enemy beneath the Mariana Trench. Can be completed in under 50 minutes.

name: Elevatrix
short_description: 'A first-person indie horror shooter where players solve puzzles on each floor of a haunted building, all while surviving attacks from the undead and racing against the clock.'

name: Russian Roulette: Online
short_description: 'Russian Roulette: Online' is a pulse-pounding multiplayer survival game where speed and luck determine the victor. Dive into the chaos for an adrenaline-fueled showdown—only the fastest and luckiest will emerge victorious!

name: IZGUB 2001
short_description: You decide how a civil war in the country of Izgub is supposed to end. Visual novel with strong themes of war, political violence and moral dilemma.

name: ViruStream
short_description: One day, the game distribution site “ViruStream” was infected by a virus caused by hackers! Solve the riddles that the hacker gives you and remove the virus! Inspired by a certain experiential escape game, this is a puzzle-solving game with a time limit of 60 minutes!

name: Sky Oceans: Wings for Hire
short_description: Sky Oceans: Wings For Hire is a homage to JRPG classics! Set in the open skies, experience adrenaline-filled turn-based dogfights as you take the role of captain and unite a party of rag-tag sky pirates setting upon an unforgettable, touching journey.

name: GatePass
short_description: GatePass is a 2D platformer game with strong puzzle elements. Escape the 100-level labyrinth and return home safely.

name: Class of '09: The Flip Side
short_description: The final chapter of the Class of '09 VN series... this time from a different perspective! Join Nicole's best friend Jecka as you help her navigate the pitfalls of post-grad life! See what 2009 was truly like in this fully voiced interactive sitcom!

name: Cat Journey
short_description: What interesting story will happen when a little cat falls asleep on the sofa and goes to an underground city?

name: Marmoreal
short_description: Marmoreal is a Bullet Hell Action RPG with magical girls, swords and fully automatic crossbows. Join the Mages of the Arcanum and the Warriors of Melkirion in their quest to stop the evil Necromancer!

name: Daily Threat : The Storm
short_description: When a storm hits the town of Miman, young Ho Chang stays home alone to fend off the threats that sneak in with the storm.

name: Lost Mastery
short_description: Roguelike deckbuilding meets memory gameplay. Embark on an adventure in Lost Mastery, a unique blend of card battles, memory gameplay and strategy. Collect powerful cards, battle mysterious enemies and uncover hidden secrets. Can you master the game?

name: Haunting: The Rosefield Manor
short_description: Haunting: The Rosefield Manor is a carefully designed single-player psychological horror game powered by Unreal Engine 5. The spirit of Rosefield Manor still lingers, and it is up to you to uncover its mystery.

name: I'll be Brave, Tomorrow
short_description: A first-person narrative adventure game, telling the story of a sick child playing a 2D platformer. Made in partnership with Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity!

name: COROCONNECT
short_description: 'COROCONNECT' is a multiplayer-only action game where teamwork is key. Players use various gimmicks to tackle different stages. Synchronized cooperation is essential for success! Team up with friends or online players to clear all the stages!

name: Backward poiesis
short_description: A short walking simulator with a horror feel that recreates actual found footage, which can be related to Liminal Space and Backrooms.

name: Hard Time III
short_description: The toughest prison sim in the yard is back to serve its 3rd consecutive sentence - combining classic moments from the OG with the best aspects of 2D, while putting out a few hits of its own! Tackle crime from either side of the prison fence, while a larger world beyond it makes life worth living.

name: Mika and The Witch's Mountain
short_description: Mika and the Witch’s Mountain is a fantasy adventure about an aspiring witch who delivers packages to the townspeople of a small island. Explore every cranny and soar through the sky with your magic broom.

name: FALLEN
short_description: FALLEN is an exciting psychic action shooter. Chris and Heidi gain superpowers after encountering an unidentified entity. Using abilities like telekinesis, teleportation, and more, they must escape the lab.

name: Rebots
short_description: Rebots is a first-person automation game with an expansive universe to explore. Using intelligent(ish) rebots, you can gather resources, terraform planets, and scan all of the things. Traverse the galaxy in the name of space capitalism!

name: Dungeon Antiqua
short_description: Dungeon Antiqua is a simple RPG inspired by the Wizardry and Final Fantasy games of the 1980s and 1990s, in which players traverse dungeons by repeatedly exploring and developing their characters.

name: Kronos
short_description: All units, heed my orders! The enemy is approaching! Call for reinforcements! Set up turrets! And someone bring me a new gun! And quickly! Now, all fighters, time is short, everyone to Kronos! Go, go, go!

name: Aqua TV
short_description: Build, decorate and populate Aquariums and ocean reefs to your heart's content. Create a peaceful background for your PC as you work or relax as either a fullscreen app or wallpaper background.

name: 808 - Firetower12
short_description: You are Max. A 17 year old that has just graduated from school. Your mother want's you to get a job. You search endlessely but the luck just isn't on your side. Until one day. You have been accepted as a Fire lookout. A week later, you head out.

name: Europa
short_description: On the moon Europa, a lush terraformed paradise in Jupiter’s shadow, an android named Zee sets out in search of answers. Run, glide and fly across the landscape, solve mysteries in the ruins of a fallen utopia, and discover the story of the last human alive.

name: Zoochosis
short_description: Zoochosis is a bodycam horror simulation game. You’re a zookeeper. Identify infected mutant animals, make a vaccine and cure them. Will you save all of them and survive?

name: LEGO® Harry Potter™ Collection
short_description: The LEGO® Harry Potter™: Collection brings LEGO® Harry Potter™: Years 1-4 and LEGO® Harry Potter™: Years 5-7 together in one game, now remastered with enhanced graphics.

name: Gamer Stories: Dating Real Japanese Female Gamers
short_description: This is a game where you can date real Japanese female gamers. Through dates, you can learn about each character's actual life experiences and hardships, getting to know them deeply. All of them share the common trait of being gamers, so you, who love games, will have lively conversations with them.

name: Merge It
short_description: This puzzle game is about creating new objects by colliding other ones. Also you can change instructions that say how exactly this process works.

name: ULTIMATE ARMORED TURBODRIFTER ~ SaGa Chapter 2 ~【TANK AUTHORITY WOLFRAM】
short_description: ~~ Take control of a powerful drone tank meant for drifting and destroying cars!~~ Destroy cars, earn your wage. ~~ WARNING: [Drinking hydraulic fluid will make you poop smoother]

name: Abdicate
short_description: This game captivates players with its distinctive pixel art style, crafting a fantastical realm where yellow earth meets a blue sky.

name: Light Towers
short_description: A Tower Defense Action game, set in a bright geometric world. Combine shooting skills with strategic thinking to fight off waves of enemies, and defend your base.

name: The Wetrooms: Liminal Pools
short_description: The Wetrooms is a surreal liminal space pools horror game.

name: Line Time
short_description: Time is on your hands! Challenge yourself in this strategy puzzle game where you move a ball to its destination through a grid. Plan your movements, interact with different balls and become a master of your own Line Time.

name: The Killing Antidote
short_description: This is a TPS game. Shooting, fighting, dress-up, puzzle solving, and more. In the future, a special germ causes humans to be constantly infected and mutated. The protagonist, Jodi, is a brave journalist who goes on her way to find the legendary antidote and is in danger.

name: Phoenix Springs
short_description: Lose yourself in the mystery of Phoenix Springs, a modern point-and-click set in a striking neo-noir world. It begins with an investigation: find your brother Leo. You already know where it ends.

name: Fog Racing Circuit
short_description: Get ready to push your limits in the most challenging racing championship yet!

name: FrogFlop
short_description: In Floppy's Great Leap, you play as Floppy the frog, aiming to reach the highest peak. Jump and climb through challenging levels in this 2D pixel art adventure. Reach the summit to make your wish, but be careful—one wrong move and you could find yourself back at the bottom!

name: HALF-BAKED GIRLS
short_description: This is the tale of two girls, trapped in a dark mansion with no easy way out. They must battle evil spirits and encounter friendly ghosts to grow strong enough to uncover the truth that lurks within...

name: Fears to Fathom - Woodbury Getaway
short_description: Sydney Harper, a 23-year-old working at a consulting firm plans a weekend getaway to a Woodbury rental with her college friends. Little did she know what was about to unfold during their stay.

name: NBB.EXE
short_description: NBB.EXE is a challenging fast paced puzzle platformer. Bomb your way to victory through devious gauntlets to reveal the secrets of the mysterious NEON Corp. in a modern reimagining of Bomberman with a metroidvania twist.

name: Horror Prison
short_description: Uncover the secrets hidden in the shadows, confront the monstrous results of these experiments, and escape with your sanity intact.

name: Animal Trainer Simulator
short_description: Become a real-life animal trainer! Manage and develop your animal training center, create a safe and happy place for them! Train different types of animals, and give them a lot of attention and they will surely become calmer and more cooperative with their owners.

name: Slackers - Carts of Glory
short_description: Step into the wonderful world of Slackers! Picture this: you and your friends run out of drinks and the store is closing! Hop in a shopping cart, the ultimate eco-friendly marvel, master the art of riding an unpredictable beast, discover shortcuts as you pave your path to glory!

name: Cats Hiding in 3D
short_description: Explore the coastal town and find cats in this cute and relaxing searching game. Can you find all 100 of the hiding cats?

name: Mr.Robbo
short_description: Mr.Robbo is a 2D logic game with action elements in the style of the 80s. Collect all the bots, clear the way to your flying saucer and try not to die from enemies, guns or magnets. 56 exciting levels await you. Good luck =)

name: Super Retro GP
short_description: Inspired by SEGA's Virtua Racing, Super Retro GP is a modern retro arcade racing game featuring a clean flat shaded polygon retro aesthetic with modern lighting effects to help it stand out without losing the retro charm.

name: REKA
short_description: Channel your inner witch! Build your cozy chicken-legged hut, practice witchcraft, and forage for ingredients in autumnal woodlands. Solve quests & uncover the great mysteries of the legendary witch Baba Jaga…

name: 辐海
short_description: Radiant Sea 'is a survival sandbox game that uses nuclear contaminated water discharged into the sea to cause marine pollution, thereby affecting human survival.

name: Cylinder: Puzzles Returned
short_description: Looking for a new spin on puzzle games?? Rotate your expectations and stack your high score in Cylinder!

name: Mind of War
short_description: Turn-based strategy game set in an epic fantasy world. Your units and their abilities progress throughout the game. With different factions to use, each with their own tactics and qualities, collect all units, and level them up to the maximum level!

name: 夜弦酒吧员工守则（Employee Rules of the Night Strings）
short_description: This is a bartender simulation game. While mixing drinks that satisfy customers, you also need to carefully identify whether the guests in front of you are human or something similar to human.

name: 8 Ball Goal
short_description: Kick the white ball as best you can and score the goal before time runs out.

name: Heart Of Squid
short_description: Returning from vacation, he finds that the island has been invaded by workers who plan to cut down all the trees and blow up the island. Not agreeing with this decision, Grandpa decides to engage in an unequal battle to defend his home.

name: Casino Manager Simulator
short_description: Step into the mesmerizing world of slot machines and elevate your casino to the top! 'Casino Manager Simulator' is a comprehensive simulation game that allows you to meticulously manage the operations of your casino.

name: Cursed Home
short_description: It is a psychological horror game and walking simulator. Monsters jumping towards at your screen.

name: Heavy Cargo - The Truck Simulator
short_description: Transport oversized cargo in a variety of missions across a 175km² open world. Drive customisable, highly detailed trucks through dynamic weather and day and night. The official cooperation with Gruber Logistics allows you to get behind the wheel of real-life heavy cargo transports.

name: Defense of the Earth
short_description: Gather a task force of the best fighters earth has to offer and research technology to defend against the alien invaders. You have to lead your squad through various grid- and turn-based battles. Between missions, you plan your next moves, manage your crew's abilities and unify humankind.

name: The Attic
short_description: Visual Novel and Walking Simulator style game with multiple endings. A love letter to the classical horror stories about old haunted houses, basements and ofcourse attics. Psychological horror inspired by author's experience with OCD-like symptoms and intrusive thoughts.

name: Wizard Survivors
short_description: The fantasy pixel art survivors-like game. Fight endless waves of monsters as you learn powerful new spells, buff yourself with magical items and gain skill points. What powerful builds will you create?

name: Critter Cove
short_description: A deep, open world life sim and town building game set in a cozy post-apocalyptic paradise. Restore an old town, sail across a mysterious archipelago. Hunt for relics and farm, fish & craft everything you need. Can you help turn Critter Cove into a thriving tourist town once again?

name: DOCE
short_description: Escapa de la estación de metro con vida, encontrando las llaves y eliminando a toda persona que quiera eliminarte, juego desarrollado por estudio mexicano.

name: Chicago Project
short_description: 'Chicago Project' is a linear, narrative-driven cyberpunk RPG puzzle game. Players embody a seasoned female engineer, grappling with the guilt of war and the grief of losing a mentor, to unravel a sinister conspiracy by those in power.

name: Broken Sword - Shadow of the Templars: Reforged
short_description: The classic multi-award winning adventure 'Broken Sword - the Shadow of the Templars' returns with glorious 4K visuals and iconic remastered audio, pitching intrepid American George Stobbart and fearless journalist Nico Collard into a journey of perilous adventures and ancient conspiracies.

name: Classic Racers Elite
short_description: There was a time when pilots were TRUE pilots. It was the 60's. The time of Rock'n'Roll, movie stars and iconic cars. Drive furiously fast on gorgeous landscapes and fight against your monstrous car. A pure Time Attack game where you're driving cars from the 'Gentlemen Drivers' era.

name: Meme Mayhem
short_description: Hurl emojis and battle the internet's biggest stars to rise as a meme master in Meme Mayhem! Collect powerful perks and relics, enjoy a darkly comic social media story, and assemble the ultimate emoji attack stack in this roguelite idle RPG.

name: This Is Not Your House
short_description: Crush someone's skull, Suffer from Hypothermia, Transcend your Mortal Frame, Find all 10 Endings. GET YOUR HOUSE BACK.

name: Date Z
short_description: 'Date Z' - a captivating mix of high school drama, romance, and mystery. As a transfer student, your challenge is to navigate relationships and secure a date by Friday to survive a deadly virus outbreak. Unravel the hidden secrets. Every choice you make counts.

name: SkyBrew: Entropic Strategist
short_description: Experience entrepreneurship in a floating cloud cafe. Manage your flying cafe, customize construction, train staff, handle random events, and uncover the secrets of the commercial empire, growing from a small shop to the sky's brightest star.

name: My Special Summer Vacation 2
short_description: Boku has been sent to live with his aunt over the course of his summer vacation. The small town where she lives may be out in the sticks, but it still has a number of interesting characters to meet and play with, and plenty of activities for a young man to enjoy!

name: Robot Rumble 2
short_description: Build your robot. Battle your robot. Robot Rumble 2 is the premier robot combat building simulator, where you create your robot from real-world inspired parts, then drive it in the arena to defeat other robots.

name: Fortune Crafter
short_description: Fortune Crafter is a roguelike(rogueLite*) game that focuses on crazy synergies. You can play this game in local coop with as many friends as you wish. Or you can play several pvp modes. This game will be perfect for minmax enjoyers, since it has lots of deep mechanics and interractions.

name: Alien Agent X
short_description: Due to technical glitches in the game content, some game content cannot be displayed and the game has been temporarily removed from the shelves, has been submitted to the official. The game will be re-released after the fault is repaired. Thank you for your understanding.

name: Fullbright Presents TOILET SPIDERS
short_description: Eight Legs… Four Eyes… Limitless Terror!

name: Ice World
short_description: A blizzard brought a long winter, Humanity on the brink of extinction. you had to face ferocious beasts, mine ice and snow to build a base, and survive in the cold apocalypse.

name: Horror at the Harpers
short_description: Dive into a gripping first-person horror adventure as Tony, a father searching for his lost daughter, Ellie. Connect with the spirit world, face demonic forces, and explore a chilling atmosphere that will test your nerves and courage to the limit.

name: Sneebles The Half Cat
short_description: The world's first score attackin’, tomato smackin’, burrito snackin’, video game about a half cat!

name: Canadian Robot Racing League
short_description: A party platforming challenge! CRRL is a 8 player local party game to see who can survive in wide range of quick paced, frantic and deadly levels.

name: Virulent Vessels: The Legend of Gobbledygunk
short_description: Virulent Vessels is a turn-based strategy game where you fight against waves of enemies in a chess-like battle royale, each of them aiming to leave Land of the Dead! Each foe has a tricky pattern for you to learn over the course of two campaigns, and an Endless mode. Reclaim your second chance!

name: 9th Dawn Remake
short_description: Rediscover the magic of the 9th Dawn series with this complete re-imagining of the original game. Venture into a massive 2.5D open world. Explore 45 new dungeons in single-player or online/local co-op, craft weapons, raise pets, play a deck-building card game, and take down the Castle of Maltyr!

name: Metaphor: ReFantazio
short_description: The throne sits empty after the king’s assassination. With no heirs, the will of the late king decrees that the next monarch will be elected by the people, & thus begins your fight for the throne..

name: Motus Paintball VR
short_description: Motus Paintball VR is a Single Player VR experience where players will compete against engaging AI on custom field layouts as well as classic layouts from the “Golden Era” of tournament paintball. Created by an indie developer as a passion project to bring his joy of paintball to the VR headset.

name: 规则怪谈：欢迎来到森林马戏团
short_description: This is a rule-based puzzle game full of mysterious and thrilling elements. You will play a character who wakes up in the forest and loses all memories, forced to become a circus bunny girl. Strive to find and abide by rules that will keep you safe and unlock the secrets of the circus.

name: Flag or Rage
short_description: Flag or Rage is a physics-based platformer game for up to 8 players! Choose and place obstacles and platforms, cooperate with your teammates to reach the top and capture the flag, or cunningly hinder your opponents and survive alone.

name: Paws for Adventure
short_description: Hunt, Fight and Meow your way to saving the cat colonies. A purrrfect adventure for cat lovers.

name: つばめの世代
short_description: A young man, rational and cold-blooded because he has lived on the battlefield since childhood, is attacked and injured by bandits. Injured, he takes refuge in a nearby abandoned shelter. There he meets someone. She is an android girl who was manufactured in the olden days as a babysitter.

name: Skies Above
short_description: A fast-paced, action-packed pixel art game, where you have to help a Leviathan to reach space by defending it from an endless robot army.

name: 7 Minutes in Hell
short_description: 7 Minutes in Hell is an intense, co-operative horror game, where 1-4 contestants must face high-stakes challenges! In this thrilling gameshow experience, work together to hunt for loot and internet fame, while escaping from monsters, traps, and obstacles, before your 7 minutes are up!

name: Monkey Forward
short_description: Race through cherry tree seasons as a speedy monkey collecting honey and dodging obstacles in this thrilling endless run Indie game but with advanced gameplay.

name: Cozy Designer
short_description: Position furniture and objects however you prefer and decorate 60 incredibly cozy environments. Without right or wrong, the only limit is your imagination. Photograph the finished spaces and create your own design gallery!

name: Evil Corporation
short_description: Evil Corporation is a co-op horror exploration game. Travel through eerie levels, while avoiding creatures and other dangers, trying to get even with the Corporation.

name: 最终战车
short_description: This is a top-down barrage shooting Roguelike game. You will experience driving a tank in a dangerous post apocalyptic wasteland to dodge enemy bullets and use weapons such as cannons and machine guns to defeat enemies and save the world

name: Block Strategy
short_description: Block Strategy is an RTS Base Defence roguelite with a fully destructible world. Build your base and find fuel to power your reactor before you're overrun by an onslaught of enemy robots.

name: The Infernal Abyss
short_description: Face the nightmares of the main characters and find a way out of this hell.

name: Parasitic Descent
short_description: In a world ravaged by a catastrophic event, humanity teeters on the brink of extinction. In 'Parasitic Descent,' you step into the boots of a lone survivor navigating the haunting remnants of a once-thriving civilization.

name: Daemonologie
short_description: A short folk horror story about the Scottish witch trials. You play the role of a witch finder. Speak to the locals and sort their truths from their lies. On the last morning a witch must hang, best you know who by then.

name: Damien Crawford's Golf Experience 2024
short_description: A minimalist golf game where the only competition is your own amount of patience.

name: Chronicles of Ultiria
short_description: Chronicles of Ultiria is a classic strategy RPG where you command a diverse cast of characters through turn and grid-based battles. Strategize to overcome enemies, traverse dangerous maps, and unravel the dark plots of the Ultiran Emperor.

name: Spear Song
short_description: Ancient Slavic knights fight against evil in turn-based tactical combat! Lead your group through the kingdom to cleanse the land from fiends and monsters! Each attempt presents a new, randomly generated journey.

name: Devious Path
short_description: You are trapped in an endless astral world. Keep a close eye on your surroundings to get out of the astral world.

name: Moving Houses
short_description: A silly little physics-based game about moving on... or is it? Be neat, be careful, or be a chaos goblin. The choice is yours. But be warned, not all is as it seems in this quiet little house.

name: Clarity: The Seven Demons of Vanguardia
short_description: Clarity is a 2D side scrolling platforming adventure. Choose to face seven demons and acquire their demon sword and demon magic. Each sword and spell, has an elemental strength against a corresponding demon.

name: Galandrix
short_description: Galandrix is a rogue like arcade game played from a top-down view and features both fast-paced action and real time strategic choices. Select your ship and blast off into the unknown against countless hordes of enemies.

name: Targeosity Horror
short_description: Maniac brothers escaped from a secret laboratory taking equipment and samples of bio-weapons with them, which put the entire city in danger. Scary story from two different characters who accidentally became victims of the brothers. You will have to solve their puzzles and play mini-games to survive.

name: No Ducks Given
short_description: Indie mix of a Math Puzzles & Tower Defense. Use you brrraaain and fast calculation skills to defend friendly fowl agains the hungry monsters! Explore 8 different Levels, face 8 awesome Bosses and complete this crazy story!

name: Mouth Trap
short_description: Mouth Trap is a retro-style arcade game where your aim is to eat as much food as you can. But watch out for those pesky germs that get in your way! Lots of treats can help (or hinder) you in your mission to complete over 100 levels of fun. Can you become a 'Champion Chomper'?

name: Motel Manager Simulator
short_description: Restore an old motel alongside a shop and a gas station. Design, furnish, decorate and rent rooms. provide products for customers and fuel for cars. Hire employees to help you and be the boss of your own empire.

name: ChanceBall
short_description: Engage in intense matches solo or with friends, supporting up to 4 players locally. Choose between classic gameplay or use special abilities for a tactical edge. Enjoy a mix of competitive and humorous gameplay with unique blend of strategy and fast-paced action.

name: Rogue Waters
short_description: Rogue Waters is a Pirate Tactical Turn-Based Rogue-lite. Play as Captain Cutter, commanding your ship and crew through procedurally generated encounters to seek revenge. Recruit, train, and upgrade crew, use powerful sea creatures, and engage in dynamic naval and melee combat to gain the upper hand.

name: FPV Worldwide
short_description: Dive into our FPV drone simulator on Steam, featuring stunning global visuals with Unreal Engine 5. Share and discover spots, control the weather, use real drone controllers, and teleport anywhere. Perfect for drone enthusiasts.

name: Prince of Persia The Lost Crown
short_description: Dash into a stylish and thrilling action-adventure platformer set in a mythological Persian world where the boundaries of time and space are yours to manipulate.

name: Cursed Hours
short_description: Cursed Hours is a psychological horror game. You play as a thief breaking into an old mansion, hoping for treasure. Soon, you realize something is wrong. Doors slam, eerie noises fill the air, and you're locked inside. A dark presence is watching you. Escape may be impossible.

name: Garlant: My Story
short_description: I am a Falconeye who just graduated from the academy. In pursuit of challenges, I came to the distant border of the kingdom: Garlant in the Doe region. Here I will start a new chapter of my life, and it's going to be an amazing adventure story!

name: Subterror
short_description: Explore abandoned biospheres at the bottom of the ocean, alone or with up to 4 friends.

name: Gourdlets
short_description: An easygoing sandbox game about building towns for cute vegetable folks. Create your perfect community then watch as the gourdlets make themselves at home. No objectives, no points, just good vibes. Play in full screen, or let your gourdlets hang out at the bottom of your screen!

name: Pro Philosopher 2: Governments & Grievances
short_description: The 'Debating Sim' returns! Engage famous philosophers of all stripes, challenge their ideas, and change the world— or just tell everyone they smell terrible. NONSENSE!

name: The Holy Gosh Darn
short_description: Play as Cassiel, a foul-mouthed angel trapped in a time loop with a mission to save Heaven. Use the magical clock bestowed upon you from Death (yes, that Death, from Manual Samuel, stop asking) to jump between timelines across Heaven, Hell, Earth and Helheim to stop Heaven from going boom. Again.

name: PLANTOONS
short_description: Powerful plants fight off invading weeds in a wacky 2D tower-defense game with Roguelite elements!Build your defenses, upgrade your abilities, complete challenges... and survive the onslaught!

name: The Moments Before Death
short_description: (Text Base Adventure Visual Novel) Input via text with VN graphics. Waking up in a mysterious field, you find yourself invited into a quaint house overseen by a gaunt old lady and her children. Yet, an unsettling feeling grows. The house's rules, seemingly straightforward, begin to unravel.

name: Meddl Dash
short_description: In this unique adventure you have to drive Ford Blu as far as possible on the highway without getting caught by the haters. Visit exciting places such as zoos, motel ones and motorway service stations on your tour of Germany. Meddl.

name: Master of Love
short_description: Single and unemployed, 33-year-old Jun-Ho finds himself transported back in time ten years. He takes the chance to romance five women from his past – and get it right this time. Unlock five unique endings in Master of Love, an FMV game that offers the ultimate K-drama experience.

name: Thor's Breakout
short_description: Immerse yourself in a thrilling Breakout adventure with 20 unique levels that challenge your reflexes, strategy, and endurance. Each level is meticulously designed and features creative obstacles that provide hours of fun. Are you ready to take on the challenge and master every surprise?

name: SpongeBob SquarePants™: The Patrick Star Game
short_description: Step into Patrick’s shorts and create hilarious, physics-based mayhem, as you make the open world of Bikini Bottom your playground!

name: Exovoid Carnage
short_description: This HEART-POUNDING WAVE-BASED ARENA SHOOTER catapults you into an alien-infested space station. SHOOT, SHRED, and SURVIVE as you crush enemy hordes, dodge chaos, and challenge yourself to set a new record. The battle escalates with every second—GET IN THERE and FIGHT!

name: Murder Mystery Mayhem AI
short_description: Find the murderer in this AI-powered 1920s whodunit. Interrogate suspects with rich personalities and piece together clues in procedurally generated cases. Experience infinite replayability as you roleplay a detective in this unique blend of deduction, strategy, and AI-driven storytelling.

name: Dimensional Phobos Threat
short_description: Dimensional Phobos Threat You are trapped in a cursed place in this horror investigation game for 1 to 4 players that you can play with your friends. The only way to lift the curse is to search the place and find and destroy the cursed items according to the clues

name: Townframe
short_description: A relaxing puzzle game where you recreate towns from people's memories. These people will give you written puzzles and to solve them you'll be able to either modify the buildings or use different tools, such as one that makes wind, and many others. Each puzzle will surprise you in a different way.

name: UFO
short_description: About, A Boy's Summer Dream.

name: Epic Space Trader
short_description: Commanding a starship, you’ll trade goods across the galaxy, evade cosmic threats, and grow your trading empire. Do you have what it takes to outmaneuver rivals and become a trading legend? Take command of your destiny in Epic Space Trader, your journey to the stars begins now!

name: The Puzzle Maker: Cebba’s Odyssey
short_description: Do you have what it takes to solve Cebba’s trials and take over her role as Puzzle Maker? Strategically command your units to overcome obstacles and defeat enemies in this casual, grid-based puzzle game.

name: Simulakros
short_description: Fight the evil CORP from the inside. Confront deadly robots in this fast-paced third person shooter with rogue-lite elements.

name: VR Iron Fist Guardian
short_description: This is a fighting game specially designed for VR devices, which brings players into a world full of tension. In this world, players will play a steel warrior, standing on the ring to start a fierce contest with other opponents.

name: 懒人也江湖
short_description: 这是一款以武侠为背景的挂机放置类单机游戏。闲暇摸鱼时打打BOSS，做做师门任务，收集江湖与门派武学，最终登顶江湖之巅。

name: Mirage Feathers
short_description: 「Maybe one day, I won't have to fight when I fly.」

name: Plattis
short_description: Be a hero robot guy in this 2d platformer. finish levels and avoid dangerous enemies

name: Forever Space: First Person Edition
short_description: On an isolated space station, no one is who they seem in this interactive narrative thriller.

name: Challenge N°1
short_description: The hardest platform game ever. Climb to the top before you drown

name: Shadowed: The Demon Castle of Ooe
short_description: Step into the shadows as a lethal ninja, or go in katanas blazing. Shadowed is a traditional roguelike with a focus on stealth, combat, magic, and long-term planning. Beware, because at the bottom of the demon castle, the red-handed Shuten-doji revels, and there's no turning back to grind.

name: Dungeon Tycoon
short_description: Build your own dungeon and attract heroes from all over the realm! Grow your business by exploiting every facet of your visitors' dungeon exploration experience. Will you be able to keep your evil dungeon business going?

name: How to Build a Flying City
short_description: When tasked to build a flying city, it's up to you to rake in all the money you'll need! Recruit travelers and adventurers to help your city flourish!

name: Sammy Jukes: Twin Lakes
short_description: Detective Sammy Jukes is the man on the job when an anti-oil activist is reported missing in a small town on the new oil pipeline route. Talk to witnesses, shovel through evidence, wrestle with the wolves and chase after chickens to find the truth in this first-person open-world adventure game.

name: Zly.ii: The Hacked Station
short_description: Zly.ii The Hacked Station is a first-person sci-fi adventure game made for the 10th anniversary of the Black Cube series (ASA, Myha...). Visit an abandoned space station, and try to get a Black Cube while searching for your lost friend...

name: EcoGnomix
short_description: A quirky mix of roguelite and city builder. Build a lively little city above, by looting mystical caves with a team of gnomes below! Use multiple runs to unlock upgrades and abilities to help your gnomes venture deeper into the dangerous underground.

name: The Fox's Way Home
short_description: Before you know it, you find yourself in the realm between the hidden world and the real world. Rely on the guidance of the Fox Shrine Maiden who lives there, and escape from the otherworld!

name: President 47
short_description: President 47 is a controversial, action-packed shooter that thrusts you into a political revolution. Fight through three epic stages against media moguls and corrupt officials using firearms, explosives, your fists. If you enjoy high-octane gameplay with a political edge, this game is a must-play!

name: Alruna and the Necro-Industrialists
short_description: Alruna is a compact and high-density Metroidvania, with a focus on sequence-breaking and playing things out of order.

name: Guild Saga: Vanished Worlds
short_description: On your maiden voyage with the Heroes Guild, your ship was capsized by an enigmatic maelstrom, stranding your party on Respite Island. Navigate your way through pirates, ferocious beasts, and shady alchemists as you unravel its mysteries.

name: Beyond Hanwell
short_description: Explore Westminster, London on a journey to the ruins of Hanwell. Fight with whatever you can find or use the environment to defend yourself against an ever increasing scourge of Anomalies.

name: Creepy Creepy Love
short_description: Rosa Akuma is in love with her childhood friend, Samon Ribasa. Rosa loves him so much that she is ready to defend her love with her fists, challenging all her rivals to a brutal duel.

name: Craftimals: Build to the Sun
short_description: One part crafting game and one part 2D platformer, Craftimals lets you build your own way to the top! Checkpoints along the way give you new powers and hats. Find out what happens when you touch the sun, or simply have fun building!

name: Boötes
short_description: Boötes is a Space Sim where you get to jump on astroids. Collect Crystals, Unlock New Abilities, Find Secrets to Unlock New Suits, and Much More. You are all alone in The Boötes Void where you find mysterious crystals that can help fuel your space shuttle so you can visit the Cold Dark.

name: Chicken Fall:Joint raid
short_description: Supports up to 4 people online! Feel the fusion of action shooting and tactical strategy. In various harsh environments, skillfully use various props and weapons to defeat forest bandits composed of various predators.

name: Cats Hidden in Germany
short_description: Find 100 cats hiding in the cozy medieval Germany in this cute hand-drawn hidden object game.

name: Tragala
short_description: Tragala is a graphic adventure game in which you will play Kurt, a restless young man who tries to escape from the system house ruled by the junjuma, a control and blame machine that is part of a systematic and terrible monster known as Tragala.

name: Glowie Shooter
short_description: They glow in the dark and they are coming to get you. You’ll need to endure the relentless waves of upcoming glowies. Can you survive the night and get them before they get you?

name: The house of the missing hands
short_description: A first person survival horror game where you have to escape the dark farm where you are being kept against your will after finding out the package you were delivering contained a human hand. Use stealth to avoid The hand collector while unraveling the reason he collects hands.

name: CYGNI: All Guns Blazing
short_description: An unrelenting onslaught of eye-popping visuals, ear bursting soundscapes and mind-melting action makes CYGNI the vanguard for the next generation of shoot-em ups. Outgunned, outmanned and out on your own, plunge into a sky full of hell in a last-ditch battle for survival.

name: HaltClimb
short_description: Climb using your ability to stop time. Discover why you're aiming for the summit and what awaits you there...

name: Hooked On Speed
short_description: Race through 24 thrilling levels in Hooked On Speed! Use speedboosts, jumpboosts, and a grappling hook to hit checkpoints and finish the level as fast as possible. Unlock medals by beating record times, how fast can you go?

name: Three Kingdoms 2024 阿达三国志2024（战棋·回合）
short_description: In this game, as the protagonist, you can recruit the heroes of the Three Kingdoms, form a dream team, and conquer cities with minimal casualties, minimal time, and optimal strategies, ultimately dominating the world.

name: The Throne
short_description: 'The Throne' is a medieval adventure in true Metroidvania style. Get lost in a huge castle with 2.5D pixel art environments and increase your power with new abilities you find along the way. Fight fearsome bosses and navigate dangerous traps to make your way to the throne room!

name: X Run 3
short_description: Utilize parkour skills to avoid all obstacles and dangers, and reach the finish line as quickly as possible. With a fragile human body, defy gravity and pursuit, showcase your advanced parkour techniques, and experience the fun and excitement of the sport.

name: You Must Mop
short_description: You live alone. Someone is coming over. You must mop. Play as a raccoon who has to mop up the floor in anticipation of big changes.

name: Skyward Extraction
short_description: A light horror roguelike adventure through a post apocalyptic world, with airships.

name: 穿越奇迹
short_description: 'Crossing Miracles' is a 3D shooter from northwest China, set in a zombie-ravaged post-apocalyptic world. Drive a unique tricycle through a detailed rural setting and battle relentless zombies in a thrilling survival adventure.

name: Gate Guardian
short_description: Gate Guardian is a fantasy roguelite in the horde survival genre. Take advantage of unimaginable freedom in creating your magic spells. Build perfect combinations of skills, change and modify them. Defend Life and Survive Death!

name: Brave and Desire
short_description: Brave and Desire is a party battle, rogue-lite RPG, where the structure and events change each time you start the game. Advance through the dungeon by selecting a route and trying to reach the deepest depths of it.

name: Junkyard Killbots
short_description: Junkyard Killbots is a rogue lite auto battler where where you build robots, equip killer items, and smash your enemies. Manage your robot army by combining items to upgrade their power or spreading them out between your bots. Scavenge new items, find new blueprints, and discover new combos!

name: Selfloss
short_description: Selfloss is an emotional exploration game filled with rich lore, set in a whale-worshipping, Slavic-inspired world. Embark on the journey of the healer, Kazimir, and his magical staff as he fights a mysterious Miasma in search of a ritual to cure his wounded soul.

name: Dude Fighter
short_description: 'Dude Fighter' is an exciting side-scrolling 2D arcade game where you play as a boy who finds himself in a world populated by terrifying flying monsters. Your task is to survive and emerge victorious!

name: 太古洪荒
short_description: 《太古洪荒》是一款以修仙为题材的独立游戏。玩家扮演宗门掌门，在洪荒世界中，经过一代一代长老和弟子的努力，战胜强敌和天灾，成就名门大派。

name: Hitler is My Crush: Love and Fascism
short_description: Hitler is My Crush: Love and Fascism is a crazy love story that defies logic, common sense and everything you knew about the world. You play as a girl madly in love with... Hitler.

name: Bread
short_description: Bread is a fun and simple clicker game where your goal is to click on a loaf of bread as many times as possible! Each click brings you closer to unlocking unique achievements and customizing your experience. No baking, just endless bread-clicking fun. Ready to start clicking?

name: The Hallways
short_description: The Hallways is a horror game where you play as Emma, trapped in shifting, looping corridors. With just a flashlight you have to uncover hidden paths and solve the mystery of the hallways.

name: Retro Runner
short_description: Embark on a high-speed adventure in my passion project! Choose from 39 cars and race down vibrant streets while dodging traffic and collecting coins.With a killer synthwave by DavidKBD and an addictive, intuitive gameplay, this game promises a unique atmosphere.Get ready to rev your engines

name: Keepers of Astraela
short_description: A dark fantasy otome visual novel that follows a writer whose characters come to life. Join Eva as she fights against forces of Darkness, flirts with a fiery man, and consumes all the coffee she can find.

name: Little Hooky
short_description: Little Hooky is a tiny fishing game for a little slack off. if there's nothing to stop you now then, Why don't you play a Little Hooky from work.

name: Matchbox™ Driving Adventures
short_description: Jump into your vehicle and use your imagination to tackle missions and win races. Navigate dynamic landscapes, earn medals, and Drive Your Adventure.

name: Dungeon Mercenaries
short_description: Dungeon Mercenaries is an endless replayability RPG. Every time you wake up, it's a new start, procedurally generated map, randomly generated characters,explore the dungeon with different mercenaries, get reasure chests, gold coins, mercenaries, potions, food, and glory!

name: High School Rizz Party
short_description: After being invited to Mogwards University in Ohio,A young boy named Virgin needs to Rizz some badies before big end of school Rizz Party. Will he be able to defeat his Beta side and become a true Sigma?Help him get some baddies in this new Brainrot Rizz Simulator.

name: Good Night Pan Pan
short_description: Explore and investigate the dimly lit halls of a nearly abandoned shopping mall in cyberpunk Hong Kong all while being stalked by a mysterious Yuan Gui, a malevolent spirit hell-bent on taking your soul. Good Night Pan Pan is a short 3rd person survival horror homage to Cantonese horror and culture!

name: Cats Hidden Timeline
short_description: Cats Hidden Timeline is an exploration game in which you go back and forth between the past, present, and future to find cute cats and pet them a lot.

name: 云玩家:口口
short_description: 《云玩家:口口》是一款反氪金题材的文字冒险解谜游戏, 你将扮演这个荒谬的大氪金时代中'最有前途'的游戏代练, 在自我救赎的同时破解层层谜团, 逐步揭开这个世界的真实面纱. 现在下单免费赠送多款风格迥异的老虎机小游戏, 绝对良心!

name: Put it here
short_description: 'Put it Here' is a casual puzzle gameplay that includes item storage, arrangement,Here players need to place scattered items according to certain rules. A variety of interesting and healing levels are waiting for you to unlock!

name: Suzukuri Dungeon: Karin in the Mountain
short_description: The diabolical demon queen Karin has risen—and you’re in charge of the dungeon she calls home! Expand your budding labyrinth, train monsters to defend it, and build amenities to shake intruders down for cash before you send them packing!

name: Along the Edge of the Sky
short_description: Along the Edge of the Sky is a dynamic first-person action-platformer where you must escape Limbo and reach the Heavens. The road ahead is tough, and you will need to destroy hordes of demons along the way. Can you traverse this path and not give up? In this thrilling escape, it all depends on you!

name: Kind Words 2 (lofi city pop)
short_description: A game about being kind to real people. Send nice letters from your cozy room, go outside and say hi to your neighbors, swap recommendations, dress up for the poetry slam and add your dreams to a sky full of wishes. Join a community of real people with their hearts on their sleeves.

name: A Death in the Red Light
short_description: Amsterdam, 1988. A dead body in the Red Light District, the Dutch capital of sex and drugs, is a washed-up detective’s one shot at redemption. Explore the seedy underbelly of Europe’s most notorious city, solve complex puzzles, and crack the case while experiencing Amsterdam at its worst.

name: 黑悟空vs东瀛忍者
short_description: This is an action RPG game that blends elements of Journey to the West with sci-fi themes.

name: BouncingBall
short_description: A simple and relax puzzle game, shooting different ball to the hole, with diffetent mechanism.

name: Breachway
short_description: Explore the galaxy in this deckbuilding, sci-fi roguelike where ship upgrades and crew management are key to your survival. Optimize resource generation, engage in intense turn-based battles, and take on ever-growing threats as you seek out The Signal.

name: The Forever Winter
short_description: The Forever Winter is a co-op tactical survival horror shooter where you and your squad must loot the dead to survive under the shadow of terrifying and gargantuan war machines locked in a never-ending conflict.

name: Lost Diskettes Vol.1
short_description: This is a collection of short and experimental horror experiences, focused on surreal and bizarre plots.

name: The Patient
short_description: Dr. Ellen Reed returns to work as a therapist only to discover an inpatient has been mistakenly dosed with a deadly mutative drug. With hospital records erased due to a power outage, she must work overnight to identify and discreetly euthanize the affected patient before it's too late.

name: Spellagis
short_description: Spellagis is an arena-shooter and roguelite hybrid. Brave mages unite to prevent darkness and restore balance. By combining knowledge and artifacts, they engage in a battle where every step towards victory is deceptive and dangerous.

name: Mushiverse - Online Boardgame
short_description: Mushiverse is an Online Board Game that can be played with 4-6 friends. It offers a unique experience with its diverse mechanics. Each player starts the game with unique characters and aims to reach the targeted number of flags by navigating various risks and luck factors.

name: Rionag: Survey Fleet
short_description: Rionag: Survey Fleet is a top-down starship builder and logistics game where it's your job to balance the needs of the crews with cutting-edge equipment on board. Unlock tech that adds new capabilities for your ships to go through hazardous environments, enabling you to explore new worlds.

name: NOIRCOTICS
short_description: All drugs are legal in the city. Your job is to manipulate them to keep up with the demands of the mobs.

name: Silent Surveillance
short_description: Silent Surveillance is a horror puzzle game where you monitor multiple security cameras to find anomalies. Stay vigilant—you wouldn't want to succumb to the lurking terror waiting for a single moment of distraction. Can you survive the night?

name: Confronted
short_description: A terrifying first-person survival horror game where building cover to hide is your only refuge against the unspeakable terrors within Radu Castle.

name: Plague: London 1665
short_description: Plague: London 1665 is an RPG with pixel art graphics set in 1665's during the Bubonic Plague outbreak in overcrowded and polluted London. As a body collector, graveyard keeper, and family provider, avoid the disease while clearing the streets. Will you survive the outbreak or become another victim?

name: Whispered Secrets: Cruise of Misfortune Collector's Edition
short_description: How deep do the dark waters go?

name: Mutable 50
short_description: Explore a 50-floor dungeon crawling with countless monsters. Collect items and use your special stealth abilities to reach the deepest part of the labyrinth.

name: TRAILCAM
short_description: In TRAILCAM, you are a wildlife investigator called to the Appalachian Mountains to solve mysterious missing person cases. Using trail cameras from your watchtower, you’ll uncover a sinister truth, navigating a non-linear plot full of twists. Can you solve the mystery?

name: LOLLIPOP CHAINSAW RePOP
short_description: The legendary zombie hunter Juliet is back in 4K!

name: HackeRPG
short_description: HackeRPG is a coding-based top-down arena roguelite in which you control a programmer avatar to battle hordes of viruses, bugs, trojans, etc. Upgrade your character, create unique builds, and automate your fights by writing code.

name: Rally Arcade Classics
short_description: Rev up your engines, it’s almost time to race back to the past with Rally Arcade Classics! Including 44 iconic cars from the 70’s, 80’s, 90’s and 00’s, and 48 thrilling tracks to rev up their engines to the max while drifting every close turn, you will never run out of challenges to take upon.

name: Bonk The Goblins!
short_description: Bonk the Goblins! is Whackamole meets microgames! It's full of hectic and funny score attack arcade action.

name: Bunker
short_description: You have to visit an abandoned bunker and find mysterious artifacts in a limited time, your flashlight charge will not last long and staying in such a place in complete darkness will mean certain death

name: Ash & Adam's GOBSMACKED
short_description: You are a goblin gladiator in this mini-FPS roguelite. Fight your way through the Arenas. Wreck junkbots. Delight the crowd. Get paid. Cause chaos.

name: The Last Drop
short_description: The Last Drop is a pixel art top-down shooter where you control the last water droplet on Earth. Battle waves of enemies with unique weapons, customize the map, and compete on the online leaderboard.

name: Goblin Camp
short_description: Goblin Camp is a fantasy city-building game inspired by Finnish mythology. Deep simulation mechanics capture the unique challenges of surviving the harsh winters and carving a thriving settlement out of the northern forest. Lead your goblins to greatness!

name: Vestiges: Fallen Tribes
short_description: As head of your clan, face opposite tribes in strategic solo missions and PvP battles. Build and improve your deck of cards, make the right tactical choices, and place your soldiers on the battlefield so that they destroy the enemy. Can you lead your people to victory?

name: NEURO
short_description: NEURO is a narrative first-person shooter in a cyberpunk setting. The action is taking place in the future, in the 4th century of the Space Era, which starts after humans invent a hyperspace engine.

name: Macho Shot
short_description: Macho Shot! Raise your Machos and grow them as big as possible!

name: XEYYEX 2: Colour Wars
short_description: The space-eyed couple is back! This time they will use the ability to change color to fight. An arcade genre game that pays tribute to the first titles of the 80s. 1 or 2 players.

name: Slime's Journey
short_description: “Slime's Journey” is a 2D platformer where players guide a slime through varied levels, facing challenges from quick reflexes to puzzles. New mechanics unlock as the game progresses, keeping the experience engaging and immersive.

name: Kana Seito Defense
short_description: Kickstart your Japanese learning journey with Kana Seito Defense, a typing defense game to learn the writing systems of Hiragana and Katakana, and to build proficiency in Kanji through extensive practice. This game offers a fun and efficient way to quickly master Japanese character recognition!

name: Dungeon Divers
short_description: Dungeon Divers is a dungeon-themed roguelike puzzle game about clearing derelict dungeons. As the newest employee of Dungeon Divers Inc., you must advance through multiple levels, use your wits, and tools you acquire along the way to get to the core to defuse it and bring home the cash.

name: GASLIFT: A Chair Horror
short_description: You are a prisoner, kidnapped by a psycho along with five other factory workers. Forced into a deadly tournament based on the rules of the prisoner's dilemma, you must make difficult choices: cooperate with others to escape or betray them to save yourself. Choose wisely, or face death by a chair.

name: G.I. Joe: Wrath of Cobra
short_description: Yo Joe! Cobra returns once again with its most fiendish plot yet and it's up to G.I. Joe to defeat them once more! Pick one of the real American heroes, gear up, and get straight into the fight in this retro side-scrolling beat 'em up - and make Cobra RETREAT yet again!

name: Solitaire Quest: Love Blossoms
short_description: In this game you'll find everything you need for an perfect vacation – vibrant locations, varying difficulty levels of solitaire, hidden object levels, and a heartwarming love story.

name: Demon Core
short_description: Abandon hope and delve into the core of an old nuclear power plant in this psychological survival horror experience. Trust your map and radiation detector to navigate the irradiated plant... And be forced to discover the monstrous cause of its sudden reawakening.

name: 天命三国
short_description: The Three Kingdoms of Destiny is a turn-based strategy simulation game, the opening has four different characteristics of the monarch representing 4 countries for players to choose, there are as many as 100 controllable generals, rich transfer system and rich skills of generals,

name: Emerald Geography
short_description: Learn the countries of the world in style.

name: Lost in the Mirrors
short_description: Enter a mysterious mirror maze. Your cleaning job becomes a survival game as darkness falls. Mirrors reflect your fears, creating eerie illusions. Grasp your cleaning tools and wipe away stains - it's your only escape route. Clear all stains to flee this maze. Dare to face 'Lost in the Mirrors'?

name: How We Die
short_description: Pack your bag with good tools, modify your character's dice, and reach the end of the story.

name: Putrika 1st.cut:The Reason She Must Perish
short_description: 'Even though I knew this love was forbidden...' While the tragedy is being told, the girl's true love is revealed! Enjoy this crazy pure love drama with beautiful visuals and cute characters!

name: Chimera
short_description: Play as the mythological Chimera in this action-packed rogue-lite. Make your escape from a deadly tower filled with unrelenting enemies as you uncover its dark secrets. Enter this fantasy world and overcome intense challenges, find hidden lore, and discover the true reason behind your imprisonment.

name: Drill Core
short_description: Corporate greed meets strategic planet-mining in Drill Core! Drill to the heart of planets while managing workers, researching cutting-edge tech, and fortifying against alien attacks. Will you prioritize efficiency and risk your workers' safety, or focus on defense for survival?

name: Shutter Stroll
short_description: Take a break and relax! No rush – enjoy the journey and soak in the sights. Capture stunning photos across millions of unique islands in this tranquil walking simulator.

name: アパシー殺人クラブ
short_description: 『部活動の時間です。さあ、人殺しをはじめてください』 一癖も二癖もある強者ぞろいの巨大コミュニティ、それが鳴神学園。 そこには、ありとあらゆる部活動が存在し、到底常識では考えられない特殊な闇の倶楽部がある。その一つが殺人クラブだ。

name: Square of Joy
short_description: Climb up, reach the top, using nothing but your skill and will. Compete with steam friends and players from all over the world. Discover secrets along the way.

name: Go Babies
short_description: Welcome to *Go Babies*, the ultimate baby racing extravaganza!

name: Lily
short_description: Step into the story of a young girl tormented by her past. Discover dark mysteries and solve complicated riddles on a scary school campus. The unsettling atmosphere, important clues, and Lily's broken recollections await you. Can you help her find comfort in darkness?

name: Stick It!
short_description: It's a challenging platform climbing game featuring sticks as playable characters, which can be played with friends.

name: 滅ぼし姫
short_description: This is a small and concentrated Roguelike RPG. It offers short but crunchy battles and powerful growth. It is a simple adventure that the protagonist alone takes on, but a series of profound choices are continuously pushed upon you.

name: Time Turned
short_description: Time Turned is a time-bending puzzle game where you use time clones to solve puzzles that would otherwise be impossible to complete alone.

name: Klobgniak
short_description: Klobgniak is a first-person puzzle game where the player is trapped in a fictional space and time. The player will have to solve puzzles in order to escape from the 'Klobgniak's Home' where the 'Others' now (un)happily reside.

name: Seasonal Bloom
short_description: Players unlock the beautiful blossoms of each season by drawing branches on the canvas. The game features four chapters—Spring, Summer, Autumn, and Winter—each representing a different stage of love, from the budding of first love to the eternity of affection.

name: 谁偷了我的女朋友
short_description: This game tells the story of the player through the clues on the slips of paper to find the stolen girlfriend！ (It's only 20 minutes long, and the plot is a little hard to understand)

name: Dungeons and Raids
short_description: Dungeons and Raids is a gacha game where you will collect heroes and make them fight in the dungeons...

name: Come Back Home Please
short_description: Entrusted with a difficult task, begin an incredible adventure in the world of Come Back Home Please!

name: Hardstrike: The Fall
short_description: Hardstrike: The Fall is a first-person shooter that puts you on the front lines of a growing global crisis. Set in a world similar to our own, extremist violence is surging, and you're tasked with stopping it.

name: Two Souls
short_description: Two Souls is a gripping 2D platformer that pushes the boundaries of skill and precision. Immerse yourself in a world, offering an intense and challenging gaming experience. Prepare to face the ultimate platforming challenge!

name: MY DIRECT DAMAG 7 TRILLION
