short_description: A strategic pixel-style dungeon-crawling game where you can purchase hundreds of different weapons and armors in the shop, mix and match freely to create the best battle strategy for you, enhance your output capability, defeat bosses, and strive towards the astonishing goal of 70 trillion output.

name: Spin Hero
short_description: Spin Hero is a roguelike deckbuilder, where you spin the reels to decide your fate. Collect powerful symbols for your inventory, adapt and evolve your strategy, learning from defeats to unlock new possibilities and synergies.

name: Silence of the Siren
short_description: Turn-based sci-fi strategy game that combines exploration and exciting clashes on the battlefield. Take control over several different species, raise powerful armies and destroy your opponents!

name: Ancestral
short_description: Play as Miguel, a member of a Masonic fraternity, as you investigate the disappearance of your brothers in a mysterious residence. Uncover the secrets brought from Egypt, deal with supernatural forces and interdimensional horrors. Discover what really happened and face the unknown.

name: Leo: The Firefighter Cat
short_description: Meet Leo, the courageous firefighter cat, and help him on his exciting adventure as a junior recruit at the fire station! Take on missions that get trickier each time and climb the ranks with the guidance of Commander Nox. Don't worry, you're not alone!

name: Divide By Sheep 2
short_description: In this colorful cartoon world, you will never think that math can be boring! Solve ever-changing puzzles with our fluffy sheep, divide like never before and get the most of an adventure full of riddles! Can you conquer the evil grim reaper from flooding the sheep and become the ultimate math hero?

name: Blue Light
short_description: Blue Light is a horror adventure game set in the year 2029. The main character goes in search of his missing sister, exploring the most dangerous and paranormal places in the city.

name: ATC Ground Point
short_description: Control the ground movement of airplanes at various airports. As the air traffic controller, ensure the airplanes move safely and get to the stand or runway on time.

name: Deadshot
short_description: You wake up as an army soldier in the middle of a mutant apocalypse, trying to figure out what the hell happened and blasting some heads on the way. Deadshot is a retro styled first person shooter inspired from classics like Half Life, Doom, Quake and many alike.

name: The Sun Shines Over Us
short_description: An award-winning visual novel that dives into the lives and minds of high school students. While focusing on the stories of victims of bullying, The Sun Shines Over Us also explores the social, mental and emotional issues facing modern teenagers.

name: My Fantasy Hostess Club
short_description: Manage a cabaret where you get paid to talk and eat with customers. How you talk and respond determines the fate of your club. Advertise on the newspaper, do fashion runways, or hang out with the cute hostesses and develop their social skills.

name: Scarmonde
short_description: 8-Bit Styled dungeon-crawler wherein you assemble a party from 12 Classes to brave The Depths in search of the Dragon God's Sacred Treasures!

name: Bootlegger: Moonshine Empire
short_description: Make your name as a whiskey-runner, a politician, or a gangster as you quench thirsts from rural Pennsylvania to the New York City nightlife!

name: Lucky Pikinini - Advanced Killer Cyborg
short_description: Nathan Kennedy a U.S. Military Advanced Futuristic Cyborg must race against time to complete sophisticated U.S. Military Super Soldier courses in Nevada as part of The Pentagon's Project-X, A Project Being Monitored And Pending Full Approval by the White House.

name: Hexwielder
short_description: Hexwielder is a bullet heaven that tasks you with mixing and matching characters, hexes and upgrades to create the ultimate monster slayer. Choose your character, wield arcane power, and pit yourself against hordes of monsters!

name: Balls Crush Simulator
short_description: The only simulator where you can crush balls with fun and pleasure!

name: Veiled Skies
short_description: Step into a world above the clouds, into a cloudpunk fantasy with foxgirls!

name: Prison Alone
short_description: A psychological horror game with NO jumpscares. Feel the tension and suspense, get goosebumps, experience strange frightening events, and explore, look for keys, solve puzzles, while thinking hard to find a way to get out of this huge, and maybe not so empty prison.

name: Noonna The Rock
short_description: Embark on a music-driven adventure across dimensions in this choice-based death metal visual novel. Lead your band between the human and demon realms, experience romance, and make destiny-altering decisions. Stunning graphics and an death metal soundtrack will amplify your thrilling journey.

name: CatBox
short_description: In this 2D puzzle game you will have to arrange your feline friends in more than 150 levels. Gradually changing locations will add new challenges.

name: 死亡禁地 2   The Dead Zone 2
short_description: Go to various death zones filled with unknown creatures, complete the mission at all costs, and then evacuate. Of course, in the rear base, we will also provide various black technology blessings for you. Spend time exploring and discover unexpected surprises. Good luck to everyone.

name: Monster Hunting: Incremental Grind Forever
short_description: An idle incremental adventure. Fight monsters, buy upgrades, recruit a party, craft equipment, join a faction, battle across different regions, and complete hundreds of rewards. Unlock a variety of fun features and use them to make your numbers go up!

name: Stonerill
short_description: Stonerill is an addictive game where you have to drill down through the ground endlessly, collecting resources and upgrading your drill. You need to be careful and attentive to avoid buried bombs and set a record for drilling depth.

name: Redline Royale
short_description: A Fueled Up Free-For-All! Redline Royale is an action-packed multiplayer game where players must take down opponents and earn trophies with a team of custom vehicles and a wild arsenal of weapons and boosters. Drop into a world of destruction and join the mayhem!

name: Sleepy Heroes
short_description: A great Deck-Building Rogue-Like with Lo-Fi heroes awaits you! With Sleepy Heroes, where each round is a completely different puzzle, you can make great card combos, build your deck and win victories against sleepy creatures.

name: BURGGEIST（ブルクガイスト）
short_description: With the walking fortress Burggeist at your command, fight back the enemies and build 'the Tower.'

name: Hexity
short_description: Build your city! Start with tents. Expand and improve life in your city. Explore new technologies and discover new buildings.

name: Poetry of Blood: Eclipse
short_description: Blood Poem: Eclipse of the Moon is a 2D Rogue Lite hyper-speed action-adventure game. In the game, you play as the heroine code-named Ishtar, also known as 'Moon' exploring a post-apocalyptic world. Your mission is to defeat beautiful bosses and bring them back to your lab.

name: Apartment Story
short_description: A third-person thriller about three people and a gun in a single apartment. Navigate escalating real-time narrative events whilst managing Sims-esq stats to stay strong for an inevitable showdown. You play as Arthur, a young man trying to make it day to day before a gun turns his life upside down.

name: Lawnmower Game: 2024
short_description: Lawnmower game saga is back. Drive now original lawnmower vehicle, cut grass, hang around and collect items in this story which is based now to futuristic food place

name: Time Over
short_description: Unlock the secret to unparalleled success through the power of teamwork!

name: Just Platformer 100
short_description: 'Just Platformer 100' is a platformer game that focuses on the pure enjoyment of the genre itself. The game starts with simple levels and gradually introduces new rules. As these simple rules accumulate, the game continuously takes on new aspects.

name: LUNARiA -Virtualized Moonchild-
short_description: Genius gamer T-Bit rakes in the prize money in VR races day after day. One day, after experiencing a network error mid-race, he ends up in Lunar World, a moon-based server. There, he meets an AI avatar by the name of Lunar-Q. A love story spanning the 384,400 km between the Earth and moon begins!

name: Orange Roulette
short_description: Trapped in a prison hell, a desperate orange will play a deadly game in the hopes of getting shipped to safer markets. Can he survive what his captors have freshly squeezed for him?

name: Therapy
short_description: This game is a fascinating adventure, where players rapidly advance in a whimsical world.

name: 自宅警備
short_description: 異常が発生する『自宅』で、24分間の警備をおこなう。

name: False Mall
short_description: You have wandered into an infinite looping shopping mall in Japan. If you notice changes within the mall, you might be able to escape.

name: Thread the Void VR
short_description: Thread the Void is an action/arcade game that requires a VR headset to fully experience its unique thrills. Weave in and out of neon blocks as you try to activate the 8 strips in each of the 8 action-packed tunnels. VR headset recommended but not required.

name: Calm Skies: The Wingsuit Flying Experience
short_description: Experience the thrill and tranquility of flying in Calm Skies. Perfect your wingsuit skills as you explore diverse biomes, dodge obstacles, and perform daring tricks to complete skill-testing challenges. Customize your character and enjoy a unique blend of excitement and serenity in the skies.

name: HOTEL WAZUMA
short_description: Hotel Wazuma is a horror game with the concept of 'Napolitan Ghost Stories'. Read the instructions carefully. Everything is written in the instructions.

name: CrimSaw
short_description: RIP. THEIR. HEADS. OFF. CrimSaw is a small, fast-paced, and deadly arena FPS with a ‘spin’. You can’t jump and only armed with a badass weapon. Charge, launch and recall your sawblade to slice up endless hordes of demons into pieces. Survive as long as you can and climb up the global leaderboard!

name: FunkyMouse's ISO
short_description: ISO is an indie built one shot–one kill airsoft first person shooter. Fight alongside your friends in intense 5v5 battles or fight solo in 10 player free for all matches. Immerse yourself in the stunning visuals created in Unreal Engine 5 and dive into fast paced gameplay where every BB counts.

name: My Happy Village in the Kingdom
short_description: Welcome to your village in the kingdom, manage resources, complete tasks and events in real-time, get gold and materials from dungeons, win a new castle, steal items from magic characters, increase affinity and work on your popularity. And more in the Medieval Clicker. The magic dragon awaits you.

name: POKER BATTLE
short_description: Origin & Inspiration‌: Derived from the Chinese fable '‌The Race of Tian Ji's Horses‌'. Light strategy 3D card game. Top-down perspective. Turn-based gameplay. Compares poker card numbers. Players control all actions through ‌mouse clicks‌. Offers a joyful gaming experience.

name: An Unexpectedly Green Journey
short_description: From birth to death, craft your orc's legacy. Wield the powers of a shaman or chief. Conquer the world. Become a god or a demon lord. Do what orcs do best!

name: Into The Matrix
short_description: 'Into The Matrix' is a multiplayer horror game where you and your friends must explore, survive, and outsmart dangers. Beware the Matrix Overseer, who watches and twists reality itself. Many entities are after you, but the Overseer is the true threat. Can you escape its grasp?

name: Wedding Day
short_description: As I reached adulthood, a village bully murdered me and abandoned my body in a temple. Instead of seeking revenge, my fearful parents arranged a ghostly marriage to appease my soul. But the pain will never cease, and my hatred will never fade.

name: Jet Fighters with Friends 2
short_description: Jet Fighters with Friends 2 - UFOs are attacking Paris, Go get 'em! Single Player OR Multiplayer Jet Fighter Game with A.I. UFO Bots. PvP or COOP.

name: Cheddar Beach 0 - Party on Mango St.
short_description: Take a trip to Cheddar Beach in this interactive visual novel! Join Hamston & The Homies as they search for a crackin’ house party on a Friday night, in a world inspired by LA in the early 90’s. Let’s Chase That Cheese, Ya’ll!

name: ATTENZIONE PICKPOCKET!
short_description: You're a pickpocket, being hunted but refusing to get a regular job. Don't get caught with the loot.

name: PISTA Motorsport
short_description: Get behind the wheel! With realistic graphics and physics, a wide selection of Argentine racing cars, and various game modes, it provides an authentic and thrilling racing experience for enthusiasts.

name: End of Everything
short_description: End of Everything is an open-world survival game where players scavenge for resources, build shelters, and defend against zombies, hostile survivors, and alien invasions. How long will you survive in a dynamic and immersive post-apocalyptic world.

name: 能准点下班吗？
short_description: This is an independent role-playing puzzle game. You will play as a worker who is about to get off work at six o'clock, but encounters a series of workplace troubles that prevent you from getting off work on time. Is it really just a luxury to get off work on time?

name: Jurassic Tower Defense
short_description: Welcome to Jurassic Tower Defense! Command your defenses and fend off waves of dinosaurs in this thrilling tower defense game. Strategically build turrets and manage resources to protect your base. Are you ready to rewrite history and bring about the extinction of the dinosaurs?

name: Vampire Memories - 吸血鬼的回忆
short_description: This is a SHMUP/STG game that allows anyone to experience and play happily; Games that will allow you to enjoy playing; Games that can make it easy for you to get started with low technical requirements; SHMUP/STG games that have completely different experiences from other games;

name: Wild Bastards
short_description: The spiritual successor to the award-winning game Void Bastards, Wild Bastards is a roguelike strategy shooter with heart-pounding FPS action, mod management, and a tactical campaign. Saddle up and lead the most notorious outlaws in the galaxy.

name: STUX.net
short_description: You are STUX.net, a virus with the special ability to compress axes. Now it’s time to destroy the computer according to the hacker’s orders!

name: ESCAPE FROM 8-12
short_description: This time, you're trapped in a convenience store, and it’s nighttime! The difficulty has been raised—find every anomaly and escape through the correct door.

name: Fisherman Simulator
short_description: Forge your path through the islands—Hunt for sea animals and other resources to make a profit. Buy and upgrade boats and fishing gear, and sail across the seas!

name: Owold : A simulation distortion
short_description: Owold is a type of Psychological Horror game. A story that emerged after an event that took place years later when humanity completely placed itself in the multiverse.

name: Backrooms Media
short_description: Backrooms Media is a 1-4 player co-op horror that plunges you into unsettling, hyper-realistic liminal spaces. Navigate eerie environments filled with lurking horrors. Group up with your friends to face the terror of the endless backrooms together and... try to escape.

name: MIDNIGHT GETAWAY
short_description: MIDNIGHT GETAWAY is a top-down getaway driving game set in the decrepit hellhole called Midnight City. You play as the getaway driver of a small crew of criminals, dead set on making it out of the city after amassing a personal fortune robbing banks. Will you be the one who makes it out of the city?

name: Global Farmer
short_description: Farm the world in an immersive top-down management game that lets you choose your farm's location anywhere on the real-world map! Want to experience a rich strawberry harvest in the French countryside? Or challenge the hot sun in South America? The choice is yours!

name: You Are Grounded
short_description: 'You Are Grounded' is a short psychological horror-slasher game from a first-person perspective. A terrifying killer clown terrorizes a teenager and his family on Halloween Eve.

name: Gensou Gold Rush
short_description: Rogue light shooting game based on Touhou Project!You can pick up reinforcement items by defeating enemies and progressing to a certain degree!Increase your firepower and defeat enemies as you go!

name: The Late Arrival
short_description: In an effort to prove his own sanity, Jordan’s grandfather sends them to the family hunting cabin. Where Jordan would find more truths than they could've ever prepared for.

name: Merge Marbles
short_description: Merge Marbles is a relaxing puzzle game where your goal is to merge as many pairs of the same coloured marbles as you can. Each time you merge a pair it creates the next tier all the way up to the big pink marble. Try your best to merge the pink marble to clear as much space as you can!

name: WOYO!!
short_description: Play as Sam, freshly arrived in Paris's outskirts from his native countryside, who finds himself embroiled in a rollercoaster ride of adventures. Discover this mysterious world and meet colorful characters who will help you become familiar with local customs.

name: Tower Defense: Goblin Wars
short_description: Defend your kingdom from relentless goblin hordes in Tower Defense: Goblin Wars! Strategize with unique archers, battle epic goblin bosses, and outsmart your enemies.

name: Terracrest
short_description: A data retrieval mission down in the evacuated Mine 41-A. This is a short experiance that can be beaten within an hour.

name: Fight School Simulator
short_description: Are you ready to become a legendary martial arts master? Build your own school, train your students, and battle rival schools to become the strongest. Join tournaments, raise your grasshoppers, and most importantly, collect tuition from your students!

name: Doll Grabber
short_description: 'Doll Grabber' is a casual puzzle game that simulates a claw machine. Players need to grab a specified number of dolls in each level. Come and challenge yourself!

name: Melt Them All
short_description: Melt them All is action rogue-lite where you must survive as long as possible to maximizing your energy production in the process. Automate the resource collection and upgrade buildings and weapons to kill, mine and produce even more effective.

name: Tidekeeper
short_description: Ride the waves in Tidekeeper, a strategy adventure game where you guide Finn and Chumby to help the residents of the Hourglass Isles. Master the art of scheduling to maximize your impact as you assist islanders, complete time-sensitive tasks, and dive into a variety of fun and engaging minigames.

name: Croswa
short_description: A world where mechanical and magical civilizations intersect. A strategy and simulation game in which you become a god and build multiple civilizations.

name: Dead Detention (Rescribbled)
short_description: DEAD DETENTION is a scribbly interactive story about a nerdy teen turned dooms day survivor! Play as 14 year old Max as he tries to escape his high school during a deadly zombie pandemic! Will he and his new friends get to safety?!

name: Twelve Sticks
short_description: Play hide-and-seek with friends online, hide from the monster, or play as a monster and catch other players. Get scared, have fun, collect points, buy upgrades, and most importantly, have fun.

name: Frog Box
short_description: In 'Frog Box,' help a frog push boxes to form lines of three or more matching ones to clear the board. Explore challenging levels with natural obstacles like logs and streams that affect the movement of the boxes.

name: DICEOMANCER
short_description: DICEOMANCER is a roguelike deck-building game. Though you long for a peaceful life, you're forced to embark on an adventure. In this world of swords, magic, and guns, make good use of your dice and deck to find a way back to tranquility! What can the dice be used for? To change... anything.

name: My Nights at Singing Monsters
short_description: Think Five nights at Freddy's meets My Singing Monsters. You find a billboard for a job 'feeding monsters' at a place called the 'Plant Island'. You are strapped for cash and you decide to look into it. Next thing you know, you are fighting for your life fending off strange creatures. Scary!

name: Tipston Salvage
short_description: Operate dysfunctional junkyards together with your friends in this knockabout couch co-op game for 2-4 players. Tipston Salvage is all about cooperation, communication and hard work!

name: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2
short_description: Embody the superhuman skill and brutality of a Space Marine. Unleash deadly abilities and devastating weaponry to obliterate the relentless Tyranid swarms. Defend the Imperium in spectacular third-person action in solo or multiplayer modes.

name: Towerborne
short_description: The Belfry stands as a beacon of hope and safety amongst the ruins of humanity and the City of Numbers, with monsters lurking right outside the tower’s walls. You are an Ace, born anew from the spirit realm with the skills, the grit, and the determination to protect the people of the Belfry.

name: Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed
short_description: Embark on a magical journey in Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed! Shape your adventure with the stroke of a brush and transform Wasteland as Mickey Mouse in this beautifully recreated 3D platformer.

name: Hand-Holding Simulator
short_description: An incremental idle game that is sure to make you feel love again. Synergize your Love Languages to produce a seemingly endless amount of satisfaction for you and your partner

name: Dead Season
short_description: Guide a group of unprepared strangers in their struggle to survive a zombie apocalypse, in Dead Season, a turn-based tactics game. Strategize to endure against relentless undead hordes, but beware, noise attracts more danger. Can you escape the outbreak's grip?

name: Theater of Death
short_description: Wander through dark corridors, look into abandoned editing rooms, penetrate dusty archives and uncover the secrets of the movie studio and its employees. Collect puzzle pieces: Study notes, letters, photos, listen to audio recordings to understand what happened on the set of the cursed movie.

name: Elements: Path of the Wizard
short_description: A card game where you will be responsible for the fate of an entire kingdom. Try on the role of a wise court magician, who is able to prevent a catastrophe with just a wave of his hand. At your disposal will be valuable magic items and all the existing elements.

name: Hotel of Shadows
short_description: Hotel of Shadows is an immersive detective game where you step into the shoes of a rookie investigator in a mysterious hotel. You must find all stoles items and gather them to identify theft. There are 3 investigations where player have to find different, stolen items.

name: Necro Story
short_description: Necro Story is a creature-collection RPG where you play as a (kind of) evil necromancer more into undead shenanigans than saving the world! Command quirky minions, outsmart foes, and snag their souls to power up your team. Expect strategic combat, laughs, and plenty of mischief.

name: Path to the Goal
short_description: The protagonist, who aims to become a professional soccer player, sets out on a journey of training! Overcome various obstacles to become a professional soccer player!

name: Nightwatch: Closer
short_description: 'Nightwatch : Closer' is a first-person horror game whose goal is to hold out for 10 minutes by preventing unknown anomalies in a small post. In a dark, narrow post, you have to hold out until the shift worker comes, keeping out the anomalies by yourself.

name: The Devil is in the Details
short_description: You're trapped in hell, and the only way out is to beat the devil at its own game. With the help of a mysterious entity known only as 'The Arbiter,' navigate through ominous surroundings and place talismans on anomalies while trying to survive the many traps and foes lurking in the shadows.

name: Neva
short_description: Experience the moving tale of a young woman and her lifelong bond with a magnificent wolf as they embark on a thrilling adventure through a rapidly dying world.

name: Elven City Simulator
short_description: Revive civilization and save it from mysterious darkness. Story-oriented colony simulator with elvish flavor and indirect control. Demo available!

name: KILL KNIGHT
short_description: KILL KNIGHT is an ultra-responsive arcade-inspired isometric action shooter. Condemned to eternal sufferance, deep within the voids of an eldritch arena, you must wield an arsenal of devastating weaponry to obliterate swarms of otherworldly horrors - and MASTER THE DEMON WITHIN.

name: XiuzhenWorld2
short_description: 《XiuzhenWorld2》is a 3D world where your goal is to level up from a mere mortal into an immortal at the end. Its a semi-idle game with fun immortal cultivation mechanics such as - leveling up to become stronger. - capturing monsters as pets to fight for you. - AFK(Away From Keybourd).

name: CRISIS Command
short_description: The peaceful island of Yukrea has been invaded by the evil Dread Corps! It's time to blast your way through over 6 stages of mayhem to rescue civilians and push those robots out. Use their own powers against them and help reclaim peace to the island.

name: Morvyn Gutter
short_description: In Morvyn Gutter, a pixel art horror RPG, you explore a nightmarish sewer system, battling monsters in turn-based combat. Level up, buy gear, and uncover a twisted story filled with eerie secrets and surreal dangers.

name: Pa!nt
short_description: In the puzzle platformer 'Pa!nt,' your journey starts in a doodle world. Solve puzzles by changing colors, themed around Gimmicks that hold imaginations and memories, and face new experiences and challenges with each new notebook.

name: Soul Drifter
short_description: Soar into a gravity-defying parkour adventure. Run, jump, and glide through surreal landscapes and deadly factories on a mission to liberate captive souls.

name: The Karate Kid: Street Rumble
short_description: Dominate the dojo in The Karate Kid: Street Rumble, a pixel art beat ‘em up adventure. Grab your friends for local co-op multiplayer and dive into the classic The Karate Kid journey with retro-style gameplay, dynamic combat, and epic boss battles.

name: Falling Cube
short_description: Falling Cube plunges you into an adrenaline-pumping adventure where every second counts.

name: Astro Mining
short_description: Build a small mining colony in deep space and defend it from alien invaders as you extract precious minerals from asteroids in Astro Mining.

name: Bot Loop
short_description: Embark on a roguelike turn-based adventure where simulations become your battleground. Read enemy attack patterns and become the Master of Parrying.

name: Nobodies: Silent Blood
short_description: Step back into the shoes of Asset 1080, the intelligence agency's top cleaner. Puzzle your way through 14 unique locations, devising clever ways to hide all evidence of your employer's deadly actions. Get in, get out, and leave no bodies behind.

name: The Best Treasure
short_description: The Best Treasure is a precision platformer game where an adventurer enters a mystical cavern inhabited by felines. He must gather treasures as a bargaining chip to save his brother, transformed into an insect by dark magic. Each jump and climb brings you closer to the cure and the true treasure.

name: Mountain Eye
short_description: The protagonist returns to their hometown due to the relocation of their grandfather's grave. During a day spent in their former home, an extraordinary event occurs.

name: Victory Heat Rally
short_description: Welcome to VHR! Unlock the secrets of speed in this turbocharged neo super scaler arcade racing experience. Dominate the track & drift your way to the finish line on the road to becoming the VHRC champion.

name: Magic Jewelry Craft
short_description: Magic Jewelry Craft (MaJew) is a casual puzzle game where you merge gems to level up, unlock treasures, and achieve high scores. Merge three gems of the same tier to advance through 7 tiers. Complete sections to open treasures and earn rewards.

name: Half Billion: Love Choice
short_description: 'Half Billion' is a surreal simulation business interactive game, where you will complete the entrepreneurial journey with a start-up capital of half billion. Six beauty enter your life. How will you balance the relationship? Note that 'wealth' and 'likability' will jointly determine the your story.

name: Exographer
short_description: Exographer is an exploration game based on science. Become an explorer, stranded in an alien planet, and discover the secrets of an extinct civilization. Gain new powers to avoid dangers and obstacles in your journey, and use your camera to reveal particles and hidden clues.

name: ZERO PROTOCOL
short_description: In this immersive sci-fi thriller, you will experience the atmosphere of classic 3D games as you solve puzzles, follow an intriguing non-linear storyline, and engage in battles with monsters.

name: Sugar Mess - Let's Play Jolly Battle
short_description: Sugar Mess - Let's Play Jolly Battle is a fun arcade first-person shooter for the whole family. Shoot from a variety of weapons at hilarious opponents! Pass colorful levels with different mechanics and immerse yourself in a fascinating story!

name: The Waiting Room - An Existential Simulation
short_description: Ever been to a waiting room? Ever wanted to? Well now's your chance! Enter The Waiting Room, get your ticket number and wait. 'For what?' you might ask. Does it matter? It is an existential life-simulation metaphor? Or a ridiculous waste of time? Well, that, my friends, is up to you.

name: Charlie Charlie Challenge
short_description: A 1-4 player CO-OP horror game, you have come to try and banish a ghost, or is it a demon? At the end of your venture you will just be trying to escape.

name: AWAKE
short_description: The world has been destroyed by war and governments have collapsed. It's full of Rombies and mutants everywhere. An environment full of mystery and terror, you have to find a way to escape with guns, bullets and blood and try to survive Open the chests to get ammo and health and break the boxes.

name: Burger Typer
short_description: Type Burgers | Make BIG Money | Upgrade Your Restaurant | Include Your Twitch Viewers | BURGER TYPER

name: 小小无常 Little Wu Chang
short_description: 'Little Wu Chang' is a 2D top-down soul-like APRG game based on Chinese mythology. You will play as a newly born Little Wu Chang and experience a journey through mythology that is both familiar and unfamiliar.

name: 與妳響起的樂音 -Our DreamMelody-
short_description: 《與妳響起的樂音》是一款文字冒險遊戲。故事講述彼此是青梅竹馬的兩人，悠月與璃音分別已久，某天碰巧重逢的時候，悠月卻發現璃音遇上了意外，化身為只有自己能看見的幽靈。劇情圍繞在夢想和兩人的戀情下展開，不僅逐步拾回從前的約定，日子也將邁向幸福的同時──高中時，曾經見過的那場流星雨再次劃過了夜空。而，這次的兩人會許下什麼願望？

name: Isle of Swaps
short_description: Grab your cards, it's time to swap! Battle your school pals in this roguelite deckbuilder where you'll trade for new cards when you win defeat them and rip open booster packs looking for rare cards. Conquer everyones dungeon decks to become Critter Champion of the Playground!

name: HAELE 3D - Portrait Studio Lite - Drawing References
short_description: HAELE 3D - Portrait Studio Lite is a 3D facial anatomy drawing reference tool for the artist, with various characters, expressions and environments. It is an easy to use app to complement tutorials, for those who are learning how to draw faces.

name: Leximan
short_description: Craft spells by combining floating fragments of words in Leximan, a whimsical adventure that uses creative wordplay to summon countless weird and wonderful solutions to puzzles. Alongside an awkward assembly of basement-wizards, save Academy Elementinia and become the hero nobody asked for!

name: For the pine cone
short_description: This is a strategy single-player game where players need to make plans based on the terrain, and each move and decision needs to be carefully considered, controlling the character's movement to achieve victory conditions. Players who like strategy games should not miss it!

name: THE TAG-ALONG OBSESSION
short_description: 《THE TAG-ALONG OBSESSION》 is a first-person horror puzzle game. You will play Hui Ting and enter the long-abandoned resort to explore the truth of everything. The props survive as much as possible and solve all the mysteries and connections to her own past.

name: Archipelago: Island Survival
short_description: Survival simulator on an archipelago of islands. Sandbox with a huge open world. Over 300 different items and resources, over 100 different enemies and NPCs. Elements of trade and RPG.

name: Path of Kung Fu
short_description: 'Jianghu Road' is an open world side-scrolling action RPG . it is a heavy dark style martial arts plot, it is a self-operating open world built by random NPCs and events, We pursue the 'punch to flesh' effect of martial arts . Friends who like it, please add it to your wish list to support us!

name: Starlight Riddles
short_description: Starlight City is a city where the boundaries of reality blur. Awakening in an unfamiliar city with no memories of the past, you discover that not only you suffer from amnesia. The city's inhabitants have also lost their connection to their past, shrouding the place in mysteries.

name: Amanda the Adventurer 2
short_description: In Amanda the Adventurer 2, the story continues as Riley encounters a mysterious masked figure after destroying the TV in the attic. Travel to the Kensdale Public Library and dig deeper into the mystery of Amanda the Adventurer.

name: Little Ghosthunter
short_description: Uncover the stories behind a family of ghosts to free them from the confines of their own house, as you search for a way to summon your best friend from the afterlife.

name: Dust Courier
short_description: Dust Courier is a text game with pixel graphics and resource management. Navigate the wasteland using the map and face unpredictable situations. Make choices and deliver the cargo safely.

name: SherloCAT Holmes Nonogram
short_description: Sherlock Holmes has disappeared without a trace. Who can find the master of investigation? With the charming detective cat, SherloCat, tackle various nonograms. Prepare for a journey full of challenges, where each solution can bring you closer to the final answer.

name: The Backrooms: Expedition
short_description: Explore the world of backrooms from this solo developed game. explore creepy and eerie levels, and also calm and liminal levels, but be careful, you're not the only one there.

name: Bean To Me!
short_description: Use strange and magical beans to bend the rules and chain together absurd synergies in a wild twist on the ancient game of Mancala. Battle your friends, collect new beans, and build the ultimate bean loadout!

name: Neonova
short_description: As an Administration A.I. of a deep space probe, you're tasked with scanning and reporting back about a new galaxy. You'll weather cosmic events, witness oddities of the universe, and fly through points of interest to find answers for the base station.

name: Human Fall Flat VR
short_description: Experience the blockbuster physics platformer, now in VR! Explore an imaginative world of floating dreamscapes with an all-new control method, providing direct control of each of your Human’s arms.

name: Devil's Trap
short_description: You will find yourself in the middle of an investigation, you will ask many questions but you will not find the answers.

name: 幽霊写真-GhostShot
short_description: Photographer player goes for the best shot of a ghost at a haunted site. The camera's eye on the ghosts is a deadly risk!　Please go to the scene with an open mind.

name: AI Fantasy
short_description: A text adventure with everything pre-generated and illustrated by AI. 100 unique stories, over 10,000 events, several thousand items, narrated story, AI-generated music, and progression between runs.

name: Maestro
short_description: Step into a gorgeous opera house with Maestro, the VR orchestra conducting rhythm game that's the essence of elegance, control, and high-society french sophistication.

name: Cursed Deal
short_description: Forget all those other cooperative horror games. You never know who's going to win in this 4v1 game where teams and roles can change. The hunter can be the prey, and the prey can be the hunter. Complete the ritual and become a vampire or die as prey to cursed creatures.

name: I'm on Observation Duty 7
short_description: As an employee of a mysterious organization your job is to monitor live surveillance camera footage and spot anomalies using your sharp eyes and good memory. Can you survive the entire night shift or will you succumb into paranoia?

name: Lazarus -Side Story of COMRADE FORCE-
short_description: 'LAZARUS' is a BOUKEN action RPG where you freely explore the world while mowing down countless monsters. Strengthen your character with skills and equipment, and aim to defeat the demon king Lazarus! Various dungeons, summoned beasts with mysterious powers, and relics await players in the world.

name: 公考模拟器—数量关系
short_description: 《公考模拟器—数量关系部分》，可以作为数量系统学习的工具，并不仅仅是刷题，有详细的知识点介绍和思路步骤分解，并且为了提高掌握熟练程度，题干、数据和选项都会随机生成，同一类型题目可以反复练习，直到掌握为止，这也是本软件所建议的学习方法，只了解用处不大，需要反复练习直至掌握和熟练。 可以配合其他学习视频或app，不会产生互相干扰情况。

name: 从0开始的VUP生活
short_description: 《从0开始的VUP生活》是一款虚拟主播模拟游戏，您可以在游戏中安排主角的日常生活、直播、交友、阅读八卦、与粉丝互动，最终达成不同的结局。

name: Arrive In Time
short_description: A minimalist puzzle game. Drive a car and collect stars within the time limit.

name: Drak(c)ula
short_description: Drak(c)ula is a typing game where you type the horror novel Dracula by Bram Stoker.

name: 规则怪谈：盛崖小区
short_description: 这是一款怪谈类剧情游戏。在宏大的原创世界观下你需要一步步探索盛崖小区的“全貌”，你能做到仅仅是依靠“规则”在这里觅得一线生机。你可以假装无事发生，安然度日；也可以想尽办法，逃出生天；或许你也可以直面它，成为它的一部分……但无论如何，请你记住，保持理智，遵守规则。

name: Why Me
short_description: 3D 3rd Person Perma-Death Climbing/Running/Swimming Game with progressive difficulty. Some Traps are unfairly tedious. Set a Record Time or Record Death Count. The Question is 'Can you beat the game ?'

name: Tower of Nod
short_description: In Tower of Nod, master sleep-based controls to manipulate falling blocks and build your path upward. Navigate shifting floors, deadly traps, and monsters in this action-roguelike deckbuilding platformer. Every run is unique—discover powerful relics and conquer the ever-changing tower.

name: Railroad Corporation 2
short_description: The 20th century heralds the new age of electrification for the railroad, and a new opportunity to make your fortune. Build your corporation carefully, as you deploy modern electric and diesel locomotives, lay new tracks, transport goods and passengers, and stay ahead of the competition.

name: Miner Open Chests
short_description: It's a platformer game mixed with action, puzzling and collecting. You can use various tools to break barriers or make a great leap. Find your way through maze-like levels by solving puzzles and operating mechanics to find treasures. The pixel mode bring you classic 1990s' game experience.

name: PINEAPPLE: A Bittersweet Revenge
short_description: Pineapple is a puzzle and story-revenge-driven game where you become the hero of the school by pulling pranks on the top bully. Time to give that witch a taste of their own medicine. With a pineapple.

name: Atomic City
short_description: Mouse-only for super simple gameplay, but the challenge ramps up. Survive waves of enemies bombing your city. Shoot 'em up!

name: SINce Memories: Off The Starry Sky
short_description: Follow the story of Junya, lost in his own world but soft-hearted and ready to help those in need, his close friends try to keep him grounded following the tragic loss of his brother. Trying to move on from his grief, focusing on his studies and his work, he loses himself in trying to help others.

name: Scotophobia
short_description: Scotophobia is a psychological horror in which you’re your accommodation is rapidly changing ceasing to belong to you. Will you be able to uphold your abode, reveal the origin of the mysterious guests, keep sanity, and… survive?

name: Whispers in the Shadows
short_description: A Top-down Horror game, where light is your only weapon against the monsters lurking in the shadows. Keep your torch alive as you attempt to uncover the secrets hidden within the forest.

name: Bump in the Night
short_description: Bump in the Night is a single player game where strategy meets psychological horror. Confined to one room, you'll use cameras and commands to direct NPC investigators and collect evidence. Each environment offers unique challenges and frights. Can you survive what goes bump in the night?

name: Keepers of ancient lands
short_description: ou are one of the defenders of ancient lands. In this game, you have to destroy crowds of enemies with the help of your faithful warriors.

name: Karate Survivor
short_description: Become a martial arts master in this survivor-like roguelite inspired by action movies of the ‘80s. Use your fists, feet, and the environment to fight off relentless thugs. Master powerful combos, enhance your skills, and remember: everything around you is a weapon!

name: Settlements Rising
short_description: Settlements Rising is a medieval city building and colony management game. It offers a lively colony experience with simulated villagers, dozens of professions and resources, natural disasters, and raids, while providing full control over the colony through trade, production chains and datas.

name: Reblica
short_description: Reblica is a cyberpunk-style action platformer shooting game. In Ark, a city full of chaos and crime, become the mercenary Bianna, defeat various enemies and complete quests.

name: ICARUS84
short_description: Recreate yourself and break free from the simulation, in ICARUS84, a focused retro ARPG that will take over your mind and heart, but not your life. Make the build that plays the way you want to play, unravel the mystery behind why you're trapped, and find a way out.

name: Storage Hunter Simulator
short_description: Play as one of the bidders for abandoned warehouses and uncover hidden treasures! Storage Hunter is a garage auction simulation game. Bid, win, and sell for profit! Become the king of storage auction.

name: Battle for Vera
short_description: Battle for Vera is a Real-Time Strategy game that draws inspiration from beloved classics, and improves upon many of their ideas to create an exciting new experience.

name: Doomsday cleaner
short_description: In the game, you will play as a survivor, facing endless zombie threats. You need to use your weapons and intelligence to clean up every zombie, protect yourself, and find hope for survival.

name: Puppet House
short_description: Puppet House is a puzzle-adventure horror with escape room elements. A freak ritual creates a killer puppet, murdering anyone who enters the ventriloquist’s mansion. Detective Rick, seeking missing locals, will soon face his greatest horror.

name: Fruitbus
short_description: A journey of flavors and friendships awaits you in your cozy, customisable food truck! Forage for fresh ingredients to create your own menu, then feed tummies and souls with home-cooked meals. Change the world, one apple at a time.

name: Unmasked: An Inner Journey
short_description: Unmasked: An Inner Journey is an emotion-driven adventure platformer told without dialogues. Become a manifestation of a restless mind, and go on a journey to find closure.

name: A Story About Birds
short_description: The birds are coming back! So, gather some wood, some bird food, and build some amazing shelters. Explore Plumage Farm on a relaxing day and get to know its inhabitants and regulars. How will you use the day?

name: Dunjungle
short_description: A 2d action-packed roguelite about a monkey hero protecting the jungle from the rise of a corruptive power. Explore ever-changing dungeons, fight weird enemies and gear up with lots of weapons and relics you can combine for a new experience every run. Explore, fight, die, and repeat!

name: Angles of Death
short_description: 'Angles of Death' is an action RPG and roguelike game. It blends the intensity of real-time combat and the unpredictability of roguelike mechanics. The pixel art aesthetic adds a nostalgic yet modern visual appeal, while the atmospheric soundtrack immerses players in a dark and captivating world.

name: Hot Springs | 温泉 (Onsen)
short_description: This is a simple idle game with productivity tools, relaxing minigames, and decor options, all centered around the serene theme of an onsen (Japanese hot spring). Let me know if you'd like any other adjustments!

name: Sigh of the Abyss
short_description: Embrace the monster within in this dark fantasy visual novel with inclusive romances. Befriend charming allies, defy bitter rivals, fall in love. Your choices will save or condemn mortals, shaping the fate of a city as beautiful as it is cruel.

name: Terminal Error
short_description: Play as a soldier in this experimental reimagining of point-and-click horror. Set in the suffocating chambers of an underground military facility, discover macabre truths, evade ghoulish monsters and delve deeper into the heart of the Eternal Engine.

name: Nimbusfall
short_description: Dive into a new and thrilling boss rush-style video game where revenge is the only motivation. Step into the shoes of the last survivor of a race decimated by The Moon, now seeking to settle the score with the culprit of its extinction. But what secrets does The Moon hold?

name: Dimensional Warrior
short_description: This is a strategy RPG inspired by classic Tower Of The Sorcerer. In addition to the core gameplay, we've added numerous new elements such as a weapon system and an open world. We believe these features will provide you with a fresh and exciting experience!

name: UFO-Man
short_description: Control the UFO. Carry the Luggage. DON'T DROP IT. – A simple yet challenging foddian game for aliens.

name: EggGarden
short_description: Control adorable animals and start running a bustling café! As you manage the ever-increasing number of customers, your café will expand and new menus will keep appearing! Get ready to enjoy a new kind of 3D action game featuring cooking mini-games and serving challenges!

name: Necrotyper
short_description: Conquer humanity with your army of undead in this unique blend of typing game and strategy.

name: Tower of Madness
short_description: A cowboy named John is compelled by an insidious voice in his head to ascend an inverted floating tower. Encounter atmospheric horror, defy gravity, and make impossible choices in this third-person psychological horror game inspired by Stephen King's The Dark Tower.

name: Hammer of Pain
short_description: Hammer Of Pain. Dive into a pixel-art, medieval adventure with Silver, the master blacksmith, and his huntress daughter, Nora. Their riveting tale of courage and heritage awaits you. Unfold their story, savor the detail, and get hooked on their world!

name: Instinct
short_description: INSTINCT encompasses horror on a whole new level — experience the chilling gameplay and story through the eyes of three different playable characters in this FPS game!

name: WORMHOLE
short_description: Eat, shoot, dash, and explode your way through the cosmos in this adrenaline-fuelled arcade action game. WORMHOLE is a roguelike twist on the classic snake format featuring a stackable perk system and 100+ hand-crafted levels.

name: Samurai Shiba
short_description: This micro-game based on a retro classic will test your reflexes in a series of increasingly challenging lightning-fast duels.

name: Tostchu
short_description: A slow-burn atmospheric horror game about managing a toast shop in a desolate location in Central Anatolia, Turkey. Make toasts for customers, cash in, buy more ingredients, and witness strange events unfolding.

name: Innsmouth 22
short_description: In this visual novel the main character, Lorenzo Righi, an Italian Professor, is invited to a meeting of History Scholars held in Boston. Excited and flattered by the invitation, he discovers that something else, hidden and mysterious, awaits for him.

name: Depths of Darkness
short_description: You are assigned as part of a four-person team to investigate a nuclear weapons facility that has lost communication with the government, only to find that the tunnel is occupied by creatures. You need to find the secret agent within your team and uncover the mystery behind the creatures.

name: IDILI
short_description: IDILI is a first-person Survival Horror video game. Discover Sardinian tradition and experience its terrifying legends as they come to life in your hands. Investigate, explore, escape. You will have to survive with all your strength to uncover its secrets.

name: Proportions
short_description: Jump into the exciting world of Proportions, a multiplayer game where players have different roles. Minis complete tasks while a Giant tries to stop them. Use voice chat to talk to your team, but be careful—the Giant can hear you if you’re close!

name: 浮游
short_description: 紧锁的木门，消失的同学，神秘的鬼怪。爸爸妈妈去哪里了？我为什么在流眼泪…在世纪初县城的家中探索并重拾回忆，拼凑出所有谜团的答案。

name: VTBattle-VTubers aren't about the number of subscribers! It's about power!
short_description: VTuber Battle: It’s Not About Subscribers! It’s All About Power! is a card game combined with auto-battle mechanics! You can use over 100 VTubers as protagonists. Make your favorite VTuber the hero! Win battles, acquire even stronger cards, and aim to become the strongest!

name: Black Submarine
short_description: Deep into the unknown, navigate the shadows to uncover forgotten treasures. Every click, a choice; every shadow, a secret.

name: Altarium
short_description: Altarium is a first-person, asymmetric PVP Co-Op horror game that can be played by 1-5 players together. Players can choose to play as either the victim or the evil character. Get ready, choose your role, shape your destiny, and survive!

name: Whisper Of The Shade: Gray
short_description: 《煙硝絮語 灰鷹》是基於手遊《煙硝絮語》製作的咖啡廳模擬經營遊戲，遊戲中玩家扮演的主角因為姐姐失蹤前往一間咖啡廳；而在看似普通店面的偽裝之下，這裡其實為一處國家級的情報機構秘密據點，為了能找到失蹤的親愛家人，女主角誤打誤撞成為這間咖啡廳的店長，將在尋找線索的同時肩負起經營咖啡廳的責任。

name: LAW: Transporter
short_description: LAW (pronounced Land Air Water) is a not very realistic, but funny arcade transporter racing game about transporting goods and passengers by land, air and water.

name: The Last Man Survivor
short_description: The Last Man Survivor is a gloomy roguelike in which you have to fight tons of enemies, slay giant bosses, discover new abilities and characters, and also find out the dark secret of the Last Survivor

name: Hannah
short_description: Hannah is a 3D puzzle-platformer game. You play as Hannah, whose doll goes missing and now must rescue it and try to understand her nightmares by making an internal journey to her childhood and find out what went wrong.

name: Evolution of Species 2: Online
short_description: Welcome to the world of microscopic creatures! Help your creation evolve from an inconspicuous inhabitant of the microscopic depths into a unique creature that can stand up for itself. Create the most unusual creature! Show it to the world! Fight with other players online!

name: Galactic Thunderdome
short_description: Galactic Thunderdome is a 2D sci-fi platform brawler with a focus on physics-based mayhem. Best your friends with a vast array of weapons and gadgets in a world rich with emergent gameplay, explosive antics, and bloody remains.

name: GOST of Time
short_description: 42 and more ways of using your own dead body in time travel. GOST of Time is an absurdist top-down action and puzzle game with time-traveling mechanics.

name: Drill to the Stars
short_description: In 'Drill to the Stars,' you build your OWN base! Guide enemies with walls into traps and eliminate them before they destroy your drill. Strategically adapt to the environment and place the towers cleverly for maximum attack speed in this roguelite tower defense game.

name: Shadows Are Alive
short_description: Enter the ever-changing world of Shadows Are Alive! Team up, channel epic alter-egos, and outwit 'The Shift' in a series of shape-shifting maps. Relentless suspense, vibrant visuals, and unmatched strategy. Can you escape the Shift, or will you fall to his wrath?

name: The Spire of Mech Zero
short_description: A lite roguelike card deck building game inspired by Slay the Spire. You can experience battles of robots with cards and components! Try to conquer the spire with one perfect run, every choice matters!

name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutants Unleashed
short_description: Join the Turtle brothers straight from the sewers and slide into this new adventure of shell-shocking proportions!

name: Vicera
short_description: Vicera is an online co-op game. Play as relic hunters, solving enigmatic mysteries and escaping a terrifying monster. Will you dare to face the darkness to find the cursed relics?

name: Technotopia
short_description: Welcome to Technotopia, a city-builder card game. Take on the role of an AI designed to build a perfect city. Build districts, meet the needs of diverse communities and maintain the delicate balance between factions vying for control over you!

name: God of War Ragnarök
short_description: Kratos and Atreus embark on a mythic journey for answers before Ragnarök arrives – now on PC.

name: Throw Bro
short_description: Throw Bro is a modern Gameboy-style 2D platformer where you throw things to solve problems and beat enemies!

name: Starship Scramble
short_description: Craft a starship from hundreds of unique weapons, battle through waves of enemies to rescue stranded survivors and gather resources - Use them to rebuild your homebase and unlock powerful upgrades. Restore the lost civilization and strive for a new future for the people of Verdantia.

name: Card-en-Ciel
short_description: Card-en-Ciel is a roguelite card-battling RPG featuring over 300 different cards and 50 unique vocal songs! Play as Neon, the 'Gaming Chair Detective' famous for solving net-crimes, as he encounters a strange new case when he dives into an in-development game world.

name: Son of a Gun
short_description: A retro-inspired, action packed, twin-stick shooter full of bullets, blood and explosions. Collect and manage your guns to exterminate jungle zombies, swarming bugs, heavy robots, slimy monsters and even space ghosts.

name: Kill the Reaper
short_description: Grim Reaper's perfect vacations was interrupted. Zombies wants revenge and now all hell breaks loose. Hold back armies of the dead and find out, how long does it take to Kill the Reaper?

name: Sequence: The Ranked Poker Dice Game
short_description: Sequence is a dice-based poker game, multiplayer & competitive, inspired by the classics Generala/Yahtzee/Yacht/Yatzy (every area of the world has a name for the game!). Now, players from all over the world can compete to climb the ranks - will you become a Senior Master?

name: Finding Frankie
short_description: Finding Frankie invites YOU to a true experience of terror as you compete in a terrifyingly twisted parkour show. Stealthily navigate around horrifying characters and swing through challenging parkour courses. This is one game show you won’t want to miss!

name: Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven
short_description: In this non-linear RPG, rule and expand the Empire of Varennes across multiple generations. Discover a vast array of story experiences as you fight the Seven Heroes in an epic battle that plays out over thousands of years.

name: Clone Your Way Out
short_description: Embark on a retro sci-fi journey in 'Clone Your Way Out,' a puzzle side-scroller with nostalgic pixel art. You'll control clones escaping from a mysterious lab, using a Clone Gun to solve deadly puzzles and traps. Enjoy retro visuals and unique cloning mechanics as you guide your clones to freedom.

name: CAPTURED
short_description: Trapped in what appears to be an endless hallway in your home, rooms begin to feel unfamiliar. Capture anomalies on camera and stay away from any sinister entities.

name: AetherShot
short_description: Aethershot is a 2D top-down shooter rogue-lite featuring a modular spell system to allow for huge build variety and progression.

name: Pancake Patrol
short_description: A unique blend of Bullet Heaven & Hell! Embark on a pancake-fueled roguelite adventure! Defeat thousands of monsters with food-based weaponry, face bullet hell bosses, & explore many game modes. Unlock 10 characters, conquer Boss Rush challenges, fight 1v1 boss battles, join the Pancake Patrol!

name: From Hell
short_description: From Hell is a first-person psychological horror game that focuses on creating fear and tension for the player.

name: 这班上够了 Escapism Ltd.
short_description: This is a pixel-style platformer. Players control Little Blue Hair, who has been tormented by work and finally made up his mind to resign. Using skills such as jumping, dashing, and climbing, he finds a way out and escapes from the maze-like work area.

name: Dexterous: Time to Steal
short_description: A Match-3 Roguelite where you build your deck of blocks, collect game-changing relics, and battle your way through crime bosses in an attempt to pay off your debt and escape the time loop.

name: Lawnmower Game Racing 2: Drunken
short_description: Sequel to lawnmower racing game. Drive now against stupid ai opponents in this world slowest racing game. Try to finish tracks and collect achievements

name: Tales From The Arcade: Fartmania
short_description: There is no one else, just you, a bad case of IBS, and a family of fellow swine to save. Bounce, fart, jump, and explore your way up into the very stratosphere to rescue your friends from the clutches of their alien kidnappers.

name: Magic Cats Pots
short_description: Restore broken porcelain and reveal hidden magic in Magic Cats Pots puzzles! Step into the magical world of Magic Cats Pots and breathe new life into old treasures!

name: Ghoul Smash
short_description: Ghoul Smash is a turn based physics game where you smash into enemies, fight bosses, and loot randomly generated items. With simplistic click-and-drag controls you can experience the thrill of smashing enemies into dust while gaining dopamine fueled rewards and progressing your character!

name: H.A.R.D.
short_description: Are you able to overcome the obstacles in the 40 levels of H.A.R.D. ? Enter this insanely difficult game to figure it out.

name: Vagneria
short_description: In Vagneria, dive into an immersive gaming experience with randomly generated stages, exciting exploration, building mechanics, and thrilling battles. Get ready to become the hero the world needs!

name: Party on Hallow Grove
short_description: Talk to kooky guests, trade party items, and explore Death’s mansion as you throw him the spookiest birthday party EVER!

name: TiME WASTER
short_description: TiME WASTER is a fast corridor first-person shooter with a special style. You will find yourself in a place where you must kill for the sake of time and will be killed for the sake of time... Do YOU ​​value your time?

name: Monospaced Lovers
short_description: Monospaced Lovers is an exploration-driven platformer about closeness and distance. Journey through a metafictional, fantasy-filled land and find the truth of your fragile world before it disintegrates.

name: The Pane Puzzle
short_description: Layer and match colored tiles to restore pictures in The Pane Puzzle. Simple at first, but it gets tricky as you progress!

name: Inventory Quest: Hero's Hoard
short_description: Inventory Quest: Hero's Hoard is a short and fast-paced inventory management and loadout optimization auto battler. The player must upkeep a hero's loadout from random item drops and survive as long as possible to achieve a new high score.

name: Deepest Trench
short_description: In 'Deepest Trench,' a gripping narrative drives your every move, immersing you in a covert operation deep beneath the ocean’s surface. Every decision shapes your journey. As you delve into the Mariana Trench, you'll face mind-bending puzzles that challenge your intellect and resourcefulness.

name: Blood Lily Loop
short_description: Your bestie seems to be hiding something. There's something about your world that seems odd as well, like it has...secrets. Dive into the Cthulhu Mythos universe of this horror game and witness a 'friendship' that rewrites the world.

name: Скуф на рыбалке
short_description: Рыбалка никогда не была скучным занятием и она никогда не была на столько весёлой и иммерсивной! Присоединяйся к рядам настоящих скуфов, лови рыбу и веселись

name: Muscle Ninja VR
short_description: This is a Muscle Obstacle Cource VR game with grip controls. Become a challenger of the muscle athletic show 'Muscle Ninja' and conquer the steel demon castle! Your play can be streamed to an external monitor from a third-person perspective. Use your VRM model as your avatar and stream it!

name: From Hell
short_description: From Hell is a third-person action survival horror. Explore an ancient manor in the late 1960s, fight ghouls and all kinds of monsters from the mythical underworld. Survive, craft items, solve puzzles and unlock secrets in the hunt for secret of your missing old friend.

name: Captain of the Guard
short_description: You have been charged with the defense of a new settlement in a hostile land. Prepare your guards and send them into battle against the horde of creatures that stalk the wilderness. As time passes and the settlement grows, so do the threats that you face.

name: Slime Farm
short_description: Dive into Slime Farm Simulator, where you'll play with, and care for the Cutest magical slimes ever seen! Watch as they Evolve in whimsical ways, strategically manage their Elements and moods, and expand your enchantingly cute slime farm.

name: Tenement
short_description: A frantic 2D arena shooter against up to 64 bots. Play Free-For-All or Mission Mode. Unlock guns, perks and characters. Call in helicopters, airstrikes and nukes!

name: TEN SHOT
short_description: Add to 10.

name: Rats in a Cage
short_description: A corporate satire puzzle game. As a typical corporate rat, you manipulate your coworkers with coffee and gossip and take credit for their work in order to beat every level of a skill assessment test controlled by a cheeky AI that goes beyond the game window to stop you.

name: Swordia
short_description: Traverse Swordia, a community-driven MMORPG with skill-based progression, PVP, PVE, and endless possibilities. Inspired by the classics, experience a mix of dungeon crawling, farming, mining, and more. Help development with your choices and feedback.

name: Seas of Hydra
short_description: “Seas of Hydra” is a cozy fishing survival game that takes place in a fantasy realm where the player is tasked with satisfying the eternal hunger of The Lighthouse Turtle. Catch unique sea creatures to sell to the local Seagull merchant to improve your fishing arsenal and sate the turtle’s hunger!

name: revive of the moon(リバイブ・オブ・ザ・ムーン)
short_description: Mitsuki, a high school girl, is caught up in an unprecedented disaster that comes out of nowhere. And the town is filled with deformed monsters. What is her destiny? A fusion of light action and zombie horror, A zombie action game supervised by Eiko Kano.

name: Quantum Sleeper
short_description: Research Facility G-1-6 has gone dark. Your mission: reestablish contact and investigate the communication blackout. Equipped with AEGIS-scanner and a flashlight, uncover what is really going on here.

name: OKIRO
short_description: OKIRO is a post-apocalyptic 3D adventure puzzle game where players embody Lulu, a plant sprite, exploring toxic fog-covered ruins. Solve intricate puzzles, navigate hidden paths, and collect energy stones to activate seeds that restore ecological balance through the power of plant growth.

name: Speedollama
short_description: Speedollama is a fast platformer shooter that sets a new benchmark for speed in the genre. Bursting with quirky humor and vibrant pixelated carnage, this game is not for the faint of heart. Are you ready to embrace the chaos and prove your skills?

name: Gym Camp Simulator
short_description: Manage a fitness camp on a tropical island to guide your customers to a healthier lifestyle by creating personalized fitness programs and meal plans, organizing engaging activities, and creating an environment that helps campers reach their fitness goals.

name: Oversleep
short_description: Oversleep is a 3D First Person Puzzle game. In this perplexing adventure, you’ll be taking on a series of puzzle rooms one-by-one. Each room will contain a different scenario for you to figure out as you explore. Take advantage of various physics based mechanics to complete each challenge.

name: Touch Grass VR Simulator
short_description: Touch Grass VR Simulator is a VR experience where you can relax in a virtual environment and touch grass, without actually going outside!

name: Supermoves
short_description: Supermoves is the ultimate parkour showdown where you and your friends run, jump and grind rails to glory! Go head to head in Bomb Tag, reach the finish line before the Rising Tide or race against friends in Tournaments. Make your own games and levels with our powerful tools. Never stop running.

name: FLARE NUINUI QUEST
short_description: Play as Shiranui Flare in this retro action platformer, wielding her dual pistols, as you explore the world on a quest to save your friends!

name: Realm of Ink
short_description: Realm of Ink is an Ink-style action Roguelite game. While pursuing the Fox Demon, the swordswoman Red, unexpectedly finds that her life is dictated by the 'destiny' within the world of the book. Only by breaking free can she unveil the truth of her existence and challenge the constraints of fate.

name: Bearnard
short_description: Collect cards and use them in tactical turn-based battles across various biomes. Master the physics to defeat enemies, and solve environmental puzzles. Join Bearnard on his quest!

name: Hidden in my Paradise
short_description: Hide objects, decorate, and complete missions in this cozy hidden-object game where you can create little paradises and share them with the world!

name: Orb Of The Watcher
short_description: A tribute to the old adventure games of the nineties. Orb Of The Watcher is party based RPG where you explore the tunnels under a large city to find a magical artifact. Encountering friends, enemies and the odd pile of gold along the way.

name: Bad Parenting 1: Mr. Red Face
short_description: Mr. Red Face, a fictional character created by adults to teach their children, suddenly becomes real..

name: Toziuha Night: Order of the Alchemists
short_description: This is the story of Xandria, an iron alchemist. She seeks revenge regardless of the consequences. To achieve it, Xandria fights with a powerful whip and the power of chemical elements. Find out more about her in this modern metroidvania adventure.

name: Happy Chase
short_description: This is a horror game that isn't scary. Why? Because you are the source of fear! As the Grim Reaper, you must collect the poor souls trying to escape. Your job is to explore dimly lit rooms using a large scythe and special abilities.

name: Fool's Gambit
short_description: A rogue-like turn-based card strategy game where you have to play and beat opponents in games of Blackjack with tarot cards.

name: Recesses
short_description: It's recess. Time to play cards, find your missing friend, discover the meaning of life. The usual 5th grade playground stuff.

name: 泳装乱舞
short_description: 作为泳装乱舞大赛中唯一的男性，挑战最强三名女性，考研判断和反应的简单对抗游戏！

name: Cat Guardian
short_description: Cat Guardian is a flexible card game blending tower defense and survival. Manage resources, build, and strategize to protect the Tree of Hope from zombies. Can the cats of Meowx Planet succeed in their mission and survive? It’s up to you!

name: The Dead Await
short_description: Build your deck and try to survive in The Dead Await, a deck-building RPG set during a zombie apocalypse. As one of many survivors, set out across the desolate world, discover the truth about the outbreak, and rebuild human civilization - or die trying.

name: GENBA no Kizuna
short_description: A Mesozoic murder mystery, 4 suspects, 1 truth. Investigate, interrogate and present evidence as you set out to unravel the case with your team. Will you be able to accurately determine who took the victim's life? Or will your deductions lead you to arrest someone for a crime they did not commit...?

name: REWOLBOROUGH VOL.1
short_description: Welcome to Rewolborough, a hard-boiled metropolis whose faceless facade hides the reeking wastes of the human psyche.

name: Ninja Ming: Wu
short_description: A mini 2D puzzle platformer with double teleport mechanic. Brainstorming is as important as hands-on experience. Thinking clearly before taking action can make it easier; If you are confident in your operation, you can engage in simple thinking.

name: REYNATIS
short_description: Fantasy meets reality in Shibuya, Tokyo, where magic is something to be feared. In this action RPG, a young wizard seeks freedom through strength, and an officer seeks to control magic and restore order. When their paths cross, a darkness that will transform the world descends.

name: Alnico Smithery
short_description: Alnico Smithery is a hand-drawn, physics-based forging simulator. Mine for ore, smelt ingots, discover alloys, forge tools, and rebuild the smithery your grandfather left behind.

name: Frogbound: the Legend of Sir Hopper
short_description: Frogbound: the Legend of Sir Hopper is a 2d pixel art platformer adventure where you will play as an intrepid amphibian hero! Discover the mystery of the hallowed relics, ancient and powerful artifacts, without succumbing to the perils of your treacherous quest.

name: Deep Inside
short_description: Deep Inside - is a first-person psychological horror game! You are a police officer trying to find out who is behind the most high-profile murders in the city and have therefore become the number one target for a maniac!

name: The Apocalypse Sacrifice
short_description: As an adventurer, you have unintentionally uncovered a horrifying secret hidden in the town for years. Every choice you make will shape the story and become part of your personality test. Will you be the hero who saves the villagers, or will you sacrifice them to create your own legend?

name: After Tasks
short_description: Overtime horror game to be played at school late at night. Wait for the video playback to complete or go solve the paranormal, the choice is yours.

name: BARHEIM
short_description: BARHEIM is a single-player, 3D Time Management Tower Defense where players experience the chaos of mixing drinks and maintaining a bar while defending themselves from thirsty Vikings!

name: Rubicon: Cubindom
short_description: Rubicon is a turn-based puzzle strategy game based on the principle of the Rubik's Cube. Use the game mechanics that the world has loved and our innovations to restore order to the inhabitants of Cubindom.

name: Dungeon Online
short_description: A Dungeon Crawler that you can play alone or with your friends in online co-op. There's also Arena Mode where you can fight against other players in online pvp.

name: refarm
short_description: The ocean took it all… now take it back! In this short semi-idle island builder you’ll resurface fertile farmland - tile by tile. As you plant, harvest and expand you’ll obtain helping hands and discover what else lies below the surface.

name: Wild Harmony
short_description: Strategically place animals, unlock upgrades, and master the art of ecosystem management. Are you ready to shape the balance of nature? Explore Wild Harmony, a captivating idle clicker.

name: TOUHOU GENSOU MAHJONG
short_description: Engage in all manner of Mahjong! From standard matches to total chaos, featuring over 130 Touhou characters from 20+ entries! The match of your dreams awaits!

name: Combine 2 Pumpkins
short_description: Combine 2 similar pumpkins into a new larger one! Use special pumpkins to achieve crazy combos and compete for the highest score!

name: WEBFISHING
short_description: WEBFISHING a multiplayer chatroom-focused fishing game! Relax and fish (on the web!)

name: BombMaze
short_description: Blast through mazes in this modern take on classic bomb placing gameplay. Strategically place bombs, outsmart AI opponents, and collect power-ups in thrilling single-player action!

name: Doctor Arcana and The Secret of Shadowspire
short_description: Doctor Arcana's second adventure takes you to a legendary castle on a mysterious island where new puzzling challenges await and dark secrets are guarded by deadly traps. Can you complete the Trials of the Elders?

name: Dark Hours
short_description: Dark Hours is a co-op survival horror game for up to 4 players. Your heist has been disrupted by a supernatural event, and your team of robbers is now trapped with an evil entity. Forget your plan, your mission is to survive. Explore and cooperate to find a way out or hide and wish for daylight.

name: Nonogram Halloween
short_description: Use your logic to paint beautiful images in this relaxing puzzle. The gorgeous visuals and relaxing soundtrack will help you forget all your problems and have a great time!

name: Gelatina is Hungry
short_description: A hungry slime from Outer Space wreaks havoc throughout the Universe! Control Gelatina and plow through different levels and platforms, eat everything you can and avoid obstacles. The more you eat, the more you’ll grow. How far will your hunger take you?

name: Platform
short_description: Humans are imprisoned on a platform filled with evolved creatures. Scientists investigate that the creatures feed on fear. Are you ready to survive and face your dark fears?

name: Барабан: Майстер-торгаш
short_description: Baraban: Master of Bargain is a first-person marketplace buyer simulator set in the setting of retroview and Kharkiv of the future!

name: The Fallen Kingdoms
short_description: A brand-new board game that combines turn-based strategy and card-drafting mechanics to provide an enjoyable experience with friends! Build your kingdom, defeat your rivals, and seize the throne!

name: TOLD GOD - The legacy of cthulhu
short_description: This is a Cthulhu theme survival adventure game. You can play Vincent, the descendant of the survivors in 'The call of Cthulhu', and a mysterious woman of unknown identity, in a island in the South Pacific Ocean, experiencing the thrilling adventure that makes human beings become 'originer'.

name: Downstairs 2 Nightfall
short_description: Can you unlock the secrets of darkness and find out what happened to your girlfriend in Downstair 2 Nightfall, developed by the dreamers who harbor the mysterious secrets of history? I don't think so...

name: Holiday Party: Mascot Brawl
short_description: A silly multiplayer party game, Holiday Party: Mascot Brawl brings festive cheer with battles and mini-games matched with absurd weapons. Compete against friends and roast them with a flamethrower and slap them with a GIANT FISH. Jump into this hilarious holiday-themed brawling mayhem today!

name: Bad 2 Bad: Apocalypse
short_description: The open-world survival role-playing game 'Bad 2 Bad: Apocalypse' tells the story of Delta Team and his comrades as they work to rebuild a world devastated by humans and their race turned into zombies.

name: Climb Quest
short_description: Climb Quest is a challenging vertical platformer where you navigate through a fragmented world of floating islands and overcoming devious traps. Your goal is to ascend to the top, close the source of destruction solo or with your 3 friends.

name: Orebound
short_description: Journey on a quest to find the Emberstone. Lost in the depths of time. The king has tasked you to find it buried in the mountains. Dig deep and automate mining in the mountains before you. Craft, discover runes, send precious metals and gems back to your kingdom. Grow, mine and find the Emberstone.

name: Ballads of Hongye: REBORN
short_description: 《东方：平野孤鸿》是一款休闲、轻度的“国风造景”游戏。游戏中包含大量细节精美的国风建筑，还原了许多祖国的大好河山和人文景观，你将沉浸在古建筑的精致美学和壮阔的东方情怀之中，并由此打造出自己心中独一无二的、充满东方韵味的古代盛世。

name: La Llorona Wants Your Soul
short_description: Join a group of young streamers traveling to the town of 'San Juan de los Muertos' to find real evidence of the spirit of a tormented woman called 'La Llorona,' who haunts the villagers every night.

name: Raccoon Roller
short_description: Armed with your grapple cannon, race your way through the city's raccoon built obstacle courses and climb your way to top spot on the leaderboards.

name: Abnormality
short_description: Abnormality is an authentic & realistic multiplayer ghost-hunting horror game. Explore fully abandoned locations, investigate, and find evidence of the paranormal, but beware—the former residents may not appreciate your intrusion. Use night vision goggles to navigate through the pitch darkness.

name: Shop Simulator: Pet Shop
short_description: In SHOP SIMULATOR: PET SHOP you can fulfill your dream of running a pet store. Immerse yourself in the fascinating world of retail and keep your customers happy. You and up to three friends can customize your store and take care of all the needs of a pet store.

name: Sofie: The Echoes™
short_description: Sofie: The Echoes™ is a story-driven, third-person action-adventure where you guide Sofie, a determined mother, through combat, exploration, and puzzles in a dark world, unraveling secrets in a quest to save her family.

name: Ara: History Untold
short_description: Build a nation and lead your people throughout history to the pinnacles of human achievement as you explore new lands, develop arts and culture, conduct diplomacy, and go head-to-head with your rivals to prove you are the greatest ruler ever known. It's Your World Now.

name: A fascinating story : Ice Cream
short_description: In the game, you need to find two cards with the same picture and successfully eliminate them. On the contrary, the cards with different faces will not change. The way to pass the level is to eliminate all the cards in the picture. You can experience more character pictures after passing the level~

name: Scotland Yard – Hunting Mister X
short_description: Find Mister X in Scotland Yard’s trickiest case yet! Mister X has gone underground somewhere in London, and the only clues are the tickets he carelessly threw away. But where did he use them? Look! There! Was that a quick glimpse of him?

name: Guess the Flag!
short_description: Test your knowledge of 255 countries, islands and international organizations in 6 addictive modes. Test your memory by matching the flag to the name of a country or play the reverse mode.

name: Citadelum
short_description: Citadelum is a city builder set in legendary Ancient Rome. Build your own settlement, gather resources and evolve it into a magnificent city. Explore the world, trade and lead your mighty legions in epic tactical battles. Earn the favor of the Gods or challenge them, if you dare.
