name: Lockjaw: Robo-Royale
short_description: Lockjaw is a party brawler where robots use interchangeable arm, leg, and head parts to knock each other around to win a robo-royale! Play with up to four players locally or over Steam Remote Play Together.

name: Snowless Night
short_description: Snowless Night is a VR adventure where darkness has swallowed the light and Christmas is on the brink of extinction. Fight powerful enemies, uncover secrets, and restore hope to the world using an arsenal of modern magical technology. Early Access Fall 2024.

name: Dollmare
short_description: You've accepted a shady job offer at a doll factory. Inspect dolls for defects and anomalies. Follow strange protocols. Don't get fired and stay alive.

name: Portrait of a Torn
short_description: As a young soldier returning to an eerily deserted home, you'll explore enigmatic rooms and uncover a haunting, tragic story. Experience an atmospheric journey filled with suspense, mysterious encounters, and a deep narrative.

name: Clock Tower: Rewind
short_description: The 16-bit nightmare returns. Survive, hide, and avoid the deadly Scissorman in this legendary horror classic.

name: Slide Faster
short_description: Master precision and agility as you conquer the ice. Race against time and challenge friends worldwide with asynchronous multiplayer features. Compete against the ghosts of friends and top players in time trials, pushing your skills to the limit.

name: Zero Factory
short_description: Embark on a journey from Stone Age to industrial power in Zero Factory, where survival meets automation in a magical, corrupted world. Face bosses, harness artifacts, and build a mechanical empire.

name: BAN: The Prologue of GUCHA GUCHA
short_description: 【A richly coloured horror and mystery tale】BAN: The Prologue of GUCHA GUCHA is a third-person horror adventure game. Experience the messy horror from the perspective of the protagonist, who is caught up in the whirlwind of events in a certain town in Japan, Utagacho.

name: Connection: The Nightmare Within
short_description: Inspired by the classics such as Resident Evil, Silent Hill and Alone In the Dark: Detective Stone investigates a shadow conspiracy. Explore atmospheric levels, fight monsters, and solve puzzles. Unravel a story of twists and turns. Choose classic fixed camera, or over-the-shoulder.

name: Heavens' Revolution: A Lion Among the Cypress
short_description: In a Persian steampunk empire, will you use your arcane alchemy to repair a spaceship, or pilot a mech? Ignite a revolution, or snuff it out?

name: Commando Hero 2 : First Blood
short_description: Hero has now become a commando. Now he has tasks to accomplish. Finish missions quickly. Let your flag be at the top.

name: Interior Designer
short_description: Step into the world of Interior Designer. Embark on client jobs, dominate the Design League, and create stunning interiors. Shape your spaces, and unleash your style. Your masterpiece awaits.

name: Dungeon Reborn
short_description: Prepare to descend into the depths of Dungeon Reborn, a thrilling RPG dungeon crawler that will test your courage and cunning. Explore treacherous dungeons, battle hordes of fearsome foes, and uncover powerful loot.

name: Speedball
short_description: A brand new entry into the legendary Bitmap Brothers series! Venture into the grim future of 2138 where mega-corporations use Speedball to distract the downtrodden masses from their miserable lives.

name: BEHEMOTH
short_description: Dodge ‘n flap your wings in this new arcade extravaganza from The Behemoth! In BEHEMOTH™, you become one with the chicken to secure your flock in the nest and collect as much candy corn as possible!

name: Multiplayer Mongolians
short_description: Multiplayer Mongolians - They attacked Your village, They killed Your family. Revenge is a dish best served ... Mongolian! (Multiplayer or Single Player)

name: Exterminant
short_description: Exterminant is a small casual game where you exterminate every bug you find to feed your killing machine. Research new technologies to increase your destruction power and create powerful decks using your new tech.

name: Zector 7
short_description: Craft, Build and Fight alongside your friends across this deadly open-world. Use both modern day and sci-fi tech as you Loot, Harvest and Trade for resources, gear and vehicles in order to survive the wasteland.

name: The Rise
short_description: Help Sam and Elicy on their challenging journey through the abyss. An epic 2D precision platform game where exploring the unknown, overcoming obstacles, and discovering secrets are crucial to reaching the top of the abyss. Adventure awaits you!

name: Nuclear Nightmare
short_description: Venture forth as part of a specialized team of fellow players tasked with retrieving classified materials, evading the black goo virus, and the nightmarish entities it has spawned. With time running out before the US government initiates a devastating nuclear strike to contain the spreading menace.

name: Dual Gun
short_description: 《Dual Gun》is a survival horror first-person shooter game,set in a world infested with various mutated creatures. You are a member of the military skilled with dual pistols. You are dropped into these locations, and your mission is simple: survive long enough to clear out the mutated beings!

name: Hidden Cats - Spooky
short_description: Dive into the enchanting world of 'Hidden Cats - Spooky' a hidden object game where your mission is to uncover every cat hidden within stunning hand-painted artwork. Let your keen eye and curiosity guide you through this captivating journey.

name: My Confounding Cat is Criminally Cute!
short_description: A cute, wholesome yaoi / boys love visual novel about a grumpy wizard and... a black cat? Wait, what?

name: Widget Inc.
short_description: A hybrid factory builder / incremental clicker game. Starting from humble beginnings, master the many crafting processes to build up resources and expand your factory. Then, using your newly automated production, unlock new technology and grow ever closer to your goal of spreading to the stars.

name: Survive: Forgotten and Abandoned
short_description: Survive: Forgotten and Abandoned is a first-person survival horror experience. Six months have passed since the outbreak. Haunted by his past, Stanley Bell must find a way to survive between hallucinations and monsters.

name: Time to Escape
short_description: 'Time to Escape' is a cooperative puzzle game. Finding yourselves in a locked room, you and your friend, who is on the other side of the wall, must work together to solve complex puzzles. This must be done before the countdown timer reaches zero.

name: Mound of Music
short_description: “Mound of Music” a game that blends storytelling with music. Test your skills by mimicking real instrument performances, matching rhythm and pitch to bring classic tunes to life. Journey through global music and uncover the truth behind humanity's end.

name: Monkeys & Typewriters!
short_description: Ever heard of those million chimps with a million typewriters writing the collected works of Shakespeare? Guess what, you're that monkey! Join Typo the Monkey in this rogue relax simulator which allows you to generate any type of story you can think of, explore and win it, and share it with others!

name: Monster High™ Skulltimate Secrets™
short_description: Save Monster High and join the Boo Crew by creating your authentic monster self in this spooktacular mystery adventure!

name: Lil' Airport
short_description: Lil' Airport is a an idle airport management game. Build and manage your own airport directly on your desktop. Expand your airport from a small airstrip to a bustling travel hub. Schedule flights, delight passengers with amenities, face emergencies - or just watch the planes go by.

name: Zaru
short_description: Explore a PSX-style horror game where your senses are your tools for survival. Sacrifice one sense for another to detect threats and make it out alive. Experience the sensory deprivation as you sneak throughout the warehouse, doing your last tasks for the night.

name: Survivors of Mayhem
short_description: Survivors of Mayhem - a fast paced fantasy survivor game. Embark on a heart-pounding journey through waves of fantasy battle, where chaos reigns, and your every decision could mean the difference between life and death.

name: Gunz & Golf
short_description: Gunz & Golf is a single-player, physics-based precision platformer. Master 3 unique guns, blast your ball through outlandish obstacles, and conquer a handcrafted pixel art course by the omnipresent Developer. Prepare for hilarious frustration and satisfying triumphs!

name: DragonMirroreD with Hyoga & Magma
short_description: The two dragons, the main characters, move symmetrically during the puzzle as if they are mirror images of each other. Over 300 puzzles appear in the game. As the game progresses, various gimmicks appear one after another.

name: Hard as Hell
short_description: It's 1999, and C.R.T. City has plunged into chaos. The crime ridden city has been devastated by vandalism, theft, and destruction... But the tired populous band together. Protect your store, property, and pride from the angry masses, in this blend of a Tower Defence and FPS.

name: Glyphica: Typing Survival
short_description: Weaponize your WPM. Glyphica: Typing Survival is a single-player roguelite horde survival game that lets you mow down hordes of enemies in a minimalistic arena using your finger dexterity, your choice of weapons loadout, and sheer determination.

name: Miller's Fantasy: PARTY
short_description: Discover the secrets of the city's most famous park! Don't let Olliver meet his end in this park, or follow what must be done

name: Hero's Warband
short_description: Embark on an epic journey in Hero’s Warband, a captivating 2D Survival Autobattler. Recruit and manage a diverse array of heroes with unique classes and skills. Discover the perfect synergy between classes to suit your strategic vision. Lead your heroes to greatness and conquer the land of Astoria!

name: AWAKEN - Astral Blade
short_description: Weave your own story in this dark fairy tale. In the mysterious ancient ruins, you will adventure with Tania to reveal her origins and fate. Is there any chance of survival in the darkest and desperate place?

name: 刻印战记2：七圣英雄
short_description: ' Countermark2 Saga: Seven Sacred Heroes' is a 2D tactical strategy game and the sequel to 'Countermark Saga Frozen sword.' The game tells the adventurous story of a modern-day youth who travels through time.

name: Shop Simulator: Supermarket
short_description: DESIGN, SELL & EXPAND – YOUR SUCCESS IS IN YOUR HANDS. Put your entrepreneurial skills to the test in Shop Simulator: Supermarket. Immerse yourself in the world of retail and start your own business today!

name: Astro Link
short_description: Astro Link is a Portal-like puzzle game that takes place within the mysterious Astro Link facility. What happened to this place? Will test subject #602 be able to find out?

name: Nightmare Knight ~Sacred Maiden & Fallen Magic~
short_description: The young girl Rayne, who became the sacred knight of the kingdom, was entrusted by Jas, the leader of the sacred knights and her lover, to investigate the disturbances occurring in a distant town named 'Hakudeti'.

name: Psycho Fear
short_description: Psycho Fear is a heart-pounding escape room puzzle where players must escape to survive. Solve challenging puzzles, overcome deadly obstacles in an intense atmosphere, nerve-wracking and dark environment will keep players on edge.

name: ГОООООООЛ!
short_description: Have you ever tried playing cards with a bear? But bears don't know how to play cards... That in this incredible game you will feel yourself in the role of a bear who is trying to play cards, but he does not succeed. All he can do is smash everything around and scream GOOOOOL!

name: A frog in a well
short_description: This is a hellishly difficult 2D pixel platformer/avoidance game, one of the toughest you've ever seen. You play as a space miner trapped in a mental world by alien monsters, repeatedly escaping the depths of a well and striving to reach your own blue sky, just like a frog at the bottom of the well.

name: Stickin' the Landing
short_description: Stickin’ the Landing is a relaxing puzzle game where you use stickers and their gravitational properties to guide a spaceship adrift around outlandish worlds until you reach your destination. Travel through the home’s nooks and crannies and discover everything this marvelous universe has to offer!

name: Blindfire
short_description: Blindfire delivers unique FPS action in pitch-black arenas. Rely on sound and high-tech gadgets to develop your skills in new ways. Ideal for quick, high-tension matches with friends.

name: VRShogiMates
short_description: Dive into the immersive world of board games with VRShogiMates! Play Shogi, Chu Shogi, Chess, Xiangqi, and Gungi in a virtual environment. Challenge friends in real-time or turn-based multiplayer. Learn the rules, while enjoying regular updates for an ever-evolving gaming experience.

name: Sunset Humanity
short_description: Help a rogue A.I bring about the end of humanity in this short psychological horror game.

name: Scramble: Battle of Britain
short_description: Scramble: Battle of Britain is a tactical dogfighting game set in 1940, featuring intense aerial battles in a 3D airspace. Players lead squadrons of Luftwaffe and RAF fighters, planning maneuvers, witnessing real-time simulations, and analyzing battle damage with detailed camera tools.

name: HackSlash
short_description: Action RPG electronic game, with soulslike elements, the environment is an arena with infinite waves of enemies with a medieval fantasy theme. Your goal is to get the highest score possible, killing as many enemies as possible and passing as many waves as possible.

name: Elite Hacker: Retro Hacking Evolution: Grand Theft Transsexual Uplink Matrix Terminator SEO Words
short_description: Do you ever lay awake at night thinking about Zero Cool wearing the dress?

name: Lynked: Banner of the Spark
short_description: Lead the resistance and arm yourself with a dazzling array of weapons and skills in this fast and frenetic co-op roguelite. Slash, dash and grapple through hordes of evil Combots and strengthen your base by enlisting robot allies along the way.

name: Tower Pets
short_description: Tower Pets is a turn-based auto-battler where you summon and upgrade a team of pixelated monsters to face off in asynchronous multiplayer matches. Spend coins, equip gems, and create powerful synergies to outlast your opponents and claim victory in the tower tournament!

name: Hot Air Balloon Simulator
short_description: Novelty first person exploration game

name: Moon Mystery
short_description: The Moon's haunted - and when an astronaut loses contact with Earth, the adventure begins in full. Fill up your oxygen, load up the guns, and set out on an interstellar FPS adventure across the stars, filled with puzzles, fights, exploration, and strange secrets of the universe.

name: BeatRider
short_description: Mioi and the others, as apprentice Tuners, embarked on a six-month investigation in Baixiang City. As their mission progressed, the city's normalcy began to unravel, with dissonance and disturbances growing increasingly frequent and severe.

name: Haunted Space Hotel: Vacancy
short_description: You play as an Artificial Sentient in an Immersive 3D Space Hotel Builder, with unique Alien Factions, fascinating Guilds, and thousands of Technologies. Earn wealth to invest in your massive Brain, unlock Ancient Mysteries, thwart the exploits of Ghosts, and accommodate Pirates.

name: K-Bot
short_description: K-Bot is an innovative puzzle casual game that cleverly combines classic block stacking and path planning game elements. Players need to strategically move within a dynamically changing play area to achieve the goal of clearing lines.

name: Game Builder Tycoon
short_description: In Game Builder Tycoon, begin as an indie game developer. Personalize your character, craft hit games, manage marketing, research stuff and manage a skilled team. Overcome competition to guide your game development studio to global recognition and dominate the gaming industry.

name: Band Space
short_description: Grab your friends and get ready to rock - Band Space is the VR game that lets you form your dream music group. Tune up and take the stage, mastering guitar, bass, drums and keyboard with up to four players. Slide to catch notes, power through the drum beat, and dazzle with your keyboard.

name: Takoyaki Surprise
short_description: Journey to Restaurant Island to save the Octopus Princess from being cooked on live TV by the evil celebrity chef, Shefu, in this thrilling point-and-click action game!

name: Grunn
short_description: A gardener gets hired for maintenance work over the weekend. A simple task, but strangely some tools are missing… The owner of the garden isn't around, and their house is off-limits. Perhaps new tools can be found in the mysterious town, or maybe some of the reserved townsfolk have seen them?

name: Siren's Call: Escape Velocity
short_description: A surreal, coming-of-age tale set in early 2010s Central Florida, Siren's Call is the small town you swore you'd always leave. Something inside you knows this is your last chance. Will you reach escape velocity?

name: Where is Billy?
short_description: Where is Billy? is a hide-and-seek party game for 2-8 players playable locally and online. Figure out which character you are and blend into the crowd to complete various objectives across multiple game modes. Act natural, avoid detection, and outsmart your opponents!

name: Trolddom
short_description: An old-school 2D fantasy open world MMORPG featuring character progression, classes, monsters, quests, guilds, dungeons, epic loot, achievements, procedural world generation, player-versus-player combat, and much more.

name: WolfFang SkullFang Saturn Tribute Boosted
short_description: The steel wolf running across the earth × the sonic corpse that buries its prey. DECO shooting game redeployed!

name: Cosmic Raze
short_description: Cosmic Raze is a sci-fi tower defense strategy game. Control advanced weapons, build powerful synergies, and then blast away as aliens attempt to conquer Earth. Between rounds you'll earn unique augmentations, purchase and upgrade a huge variety of weapons, and unlock powerful synergy bonuses.

name: The Mad Pantser
short_description: Dawg, we getting pantsed up in here!

name: Hyperdrive Inn
short_description: Your father has triggered a set of cataclysmic events and escaped into the depths of his creation, the infinite hotel of Hyperdrive Inn. It's up to you to find him and save the world in the process. In this point & click adventure you never know what you find, who you meet and where you end up.

name: Stunt Granny
short_description: Stunt Granny is a funny action game where you wake up and choose violence. Run over unsuspecting third graders, perform sick stunts, and swag out your mobility scooter. Casually drift around, collecting secrets and competing in challenges and races. Or just run over the kids — up to you, really.

name: Devil Slot Machine
short_description: On a cursed slot machine, you engage in a deadly game of souls with the demons. Devil Slot Machine is a roguelike pinball tower defense game. Purchase chips as defensive towers and release elemental bullets to destroy your enemies. Enjoy the exhilarating feeling of annihilating demons!

name: Times Dungeon
short_description: Can you survive before time runs out? Times Dungeon is an exhilarating dungeon crawler that blends rogue-like and FPS genres, where you must defeat four deadly bosses within a limited time

name: ChessRogue
short_description: A chess themed roguelike featuring online high scores.

name: Primal Rift
short_description: Turn-based, solo character roleplaying adventure set in a flooded research facility. This is a classic console-style RPG with an emphasis on exploration.

name: Umbra: The Last Summoner
short_description: As the sole Summoner, save Umbra from a demon invasion by summoning 60 unique heroes. Engage in strategic, turn-based battles against 150+ monsters, explore 15 vast areas, and conquer challenging quests and colossal bosses. Your epic RPG journey awaits!

name: Zero-Sum Heart
short_description: 'I' make a deal with the witch to give up my heart, in exchange for love— from everyone. Is it worth it if losing my heart means gaining *his*?———————————————————————In this short visual novel, make choices and answer the question: is love a zero-sum game?

name: Nightgate
short_description: In the year 2398, a network of intelligent computers known as Nightgate, is the last remaining life form on Earth. Step into the computer and uncover what lies beyond the futuristic landscapes of Nightgate.

name: NIMRODS: GunCraft Survivor
short_description: Assemble a limitless arsenal in this survive-em-up roguelite shooter. As a Gun Manufacturer's testing force, your mission is simple: test the latest gun tech and scavenge alien planets. Collect insane weapon parts to invent crazy guns that slay thousands. You may not survive, but your guns will!

name: Dreamless
short_description: In a remote provincial town, teenagers mysteriously disappear every 25 years. You're a high school student about to turn 18... But what if you become the next victim?

name: Otherplane
short_description: Reports of paranormal activity have been creeping up across the nation. You and your team have been instructed to investigate. Explore and solve puzzles, all whilst avoiding deadly horrors from the Otherplane.

name: Liminalcore
short_description: Explore and admire while navigate through eerie, surreal environments inspired by the Backrooms lore. Explore this uncanny world lost in time and get lost in the otherworldly architecture in a world where reality bends and your sanity is tested.

name: Abaddon's Veil
short_description: A short horror game where you pilot a tiny spaceship through turbulent 'waters' surrounding a supermassive blackhole. Retrieve and scan sites of interest while managing your noise footprint.

name: Metal Thunder
short_description: Command the legendary gunship in a high-octane action-roguelite! Engage insurgents with devastating firepower in ever-changing missions. Upgrade your arsenal, adapt to dynamic challenges, and survive relentless waves of enemies. Every run offers new tactics and chaos as you dominate the skies.

name: My Protogen Engineer ⚙️
short_description: You've almost died, you lost your body. Gladly, you were saved by your old friend Xena, a genius engineer who lives on a desolate planet. Now it's time to recover and find a new goal in your life!

name: Final Outcry
short_description: Final Outcry is a first-person horror game that centers on classified government found footage of an urban exploration trip gone wrong. As you venture further into an abandoned prison, do you have what it takes to face the horrors lurking within and reach the end of the V/H/S tape?

name: GULLET
short_description: GULLET is a difficult psychological horror game in which you will rappel down into and explore a colossal mouth post-rapture. In it you will manage resources and control how quickly you descend by how tightly you squeeze your left hand brake in real life and in the game.

name: Worshippers of Cthulhu
short_description: LEAD the CULT OF CTHULHU. Decide the fate of your followers, perform eldritch rituals, and master the art of city-building in a world where the line between sanity and madness blurs. Can you endure the horrors you unleash?

name: Left to Rot
short_description: Left to Rot is a walking simulator psychological horror game. You take on the role of Luca, a young man caught up in a horrific mystery. If you make noise... It's game over! (You will need a Microphone)!

name: Me & My Friend Pippa!
short_description: Make your mark as an aspiring adventurer by embarking on a journey to save King Elesio's missing Pippa in this charming bite-sized RPG!

name: Cape Hideous
short_description: Amongst the motliest of all crews, an enigmatic woman prepares the ship to enter an intense thunderstorm that rages in the middle of the ocean. What otherworldly mysteries lie within?

name: Virtual Heritage Tour: VR Museum Adventure
short_description: This is a virtual museum tour game. In the game, players will delve into the Chinese Museum, the History Museum, and the Cybersteampunk Museum from a first-person perspective, and explore these places full of history and culture for themselves.

name: Escaping Darkness
short_description: Find your way out of an abandoned mansion, avoiding an evil entity set on hunting you as you escape through pitch black rooms. Scavenge for resources to keep the dark at bay and solve puzzles to move forward. Escaping Darkness is an escape room-based survival horror game designed for VR.

name: Casino Island Simulator
short_description: Run your own casino. Buy new gambling games, take payments, hire employees, expand and design your casino. Slots, blackjack, roulette, poker, baccarat, craps and more...

name: Hydroponics Farm & Store Simulator
short_description: Transform your passion into profit with Hydroponics Farm & Store Simulator! Design, build, and manage your own sustainable hydroponics system. Experiment with different plants and fish, customize your setup, and harvest your success. Dive into the future of farming today!

name: Zombie Blitzkrieg
short_description: Survive against zombies in this turn-based tactical roguelike. Outsmart your enemies in fast-paced battles using different tactics. Pick rewards and power up your character to conquer increasingly challenging levels.

name: Fighting for Singleship: I am Chased by a Bunch of Women But I Just Want to Play Video Games
short_description: You relish indoor life, gaming, but now, a challenging twist: every woman adores you. Witness the story unfold. Conquer challenging waves of unhinged admirers, aiming to remain unmarried. Climb the leaderboard against your friends, proving your supremacy.

name: The Phantom Fellows
short_description: The Phantom Fellows is about two best friends who start a paranormal investigation business together, since one of them is already dead.

name: Xenowars
short_description: This is a turn-based strategy/RPG game set in the stars. In the early stages, you will recruit a team of experts on Earth for exploring a distant alien homeworld, choosing between scientists, mutants, and soldiers. Scour the planet for lost alien technology and uncover the secrets to Earth’s doom.

name: The Coma 2B: Catacomb
short_description: The Coma 2B: Catacomb is a Korean survival horror adventure. It is the back story to the previous game, The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters, and a story bridge for the full series. You return as Youngho, the hero from The Coma 1, as you once again venture forth into the terrifying mirror dimension…

name: Rolling Football Player
short_description: Rolling Football Player is a nonsensical athletic game where a soccer player endlessly rolls while tackling various challenges! Take on the limits in single-player mode! This new athletic game is created by the developer of 'Nibansen,' which sold 20,000 copies worldwide!

name: Card Weapon Shop
short_description: Card Weapon Shop is a simulation of running a weapon store using cards.

name: Claws & Chaos
short_description: Claws & Chaos is an auto-chess-style battler featuring quirky creatures in dire circumstances. Build your team and hone your skills while battling across both story and PvP modes. Will you earn your place on the Ark?

name: The Nightwatch
short_description: Fight your way through hordes of monsters in this challenging 2D roguelite. Explore the dark rooms of the wizard tower, unearth and make the most out of the upgrades, talent trees and items available to push through the attack.

name: The Hungry Fly
short_description: Once upon a time, there was a fly. A hungry fly. A fly with razor-sharp teeth, with a taste for dead things. This is the tale of its adventure to find something dead to devour, in a swamp where nothing dies, everything is grotesque, and every choice matters, no matter how surreal.

name: Valley of Shadow
short_description: Valley of Shadow is a narrative puzzle game that tells a poignant true story of loss and grief through the discovery of real-life home videos and photographs. Harness mysterious abilities to solve puzzles and heal a broken family.

name: GwenBlade: Halloween
short_description: MAKE DEMONS LOSE THEIR S#^T in Roguelike Horror Action when you combo them in quick succession! SLAY while investigating dreamworld kidnapping right before HALLOWEEN and most importantly - STAY STYLISH

name: The Bonerooms
short_description: The Bonerooms is a goofy horror-themed multiplayer game about surviving in a living maze. What will be your downfall? The spooky inhabitants of the maze, or your fellow players?

name: Goblin Auto Club Manager
short_description: Imagine building fantastic cars out of junk and letting idiots drive them. Goblin Auto Club Manager is like an auto battler, but with racing instead of battling. So it's an auto racer? Buy parts from the junkyard, build cars with them, and choose your racing strategy. Your goblins do the driving.

name: The Christopher Redemption - I
short_description: The Christopher redemption part I is a story-driven action thriller game that explores the intense and original story of Christopher and his sister.

name: Happy Fisherman
short_description: This is a fishing, fish farming casual game. Experience the fun of fishing in the game, earn gold to build a beautiful fish tank.

name: TRANSFORMERS: Galactic Trials
short_description: Roll out for intense arcade racing and robot combat, fused together in a battle for the lost Prime Relics. Cybertron’s future depends on you!

name: Telebbit
short_description: The rabbit has commenced its revenge on humanity! A fast-paced action platformer where teleportation is key.

name: Bug Ball 3D
short_description: Jump, roll, and crawl as quick as you can through a mountain of challenging courses. Your speed is uncapped, how fast can you go?

name: Rogue Station Defense
short_description: A rogue-like sci-fi Tower Defense strategy game with infinite replayability!

name: 明治東亰恋伽 Full Moon
short_description: “Meiji Tokyo Renka Full Moon” (also known as “Meikoi”) is a historical romance fantasy game in which the main character travels back in time to the Meiji era and meets and falls in love with the great figures of history. Having ability changes her relationship with them....

name: PixelQuest - Herb's Adventure
short_description: A classic, story-driven JRPG with a modern dice-building combat system. Level up your skills and dice, meet intriguing characters, and guide Herb on his path to become a hero!

name: 逗比危机
short_description: Embark on a journey of several can-be-seen-everywhere ordinary students from the 'Breakfast High School' saving the world, in this simple traditional turn-based RPG that makes no sense at all.

name: Deep Despair 3
short_description: Deep Despair 3 is an open-world survival action-adventure with RPG elements! Fight, survive, dig, build, explore vast worlds, engage in farming, breed animals, gather resources, and level up to the max!

name: Monica's Newlywed Life
short_description: Monica has married her childhood sweetheart and is now settling in the city with her new family. But it's going to take one million gold to buy her citizenship! Work odd jobs and fight monsters to make enough gold before time runs out!

name: Combat Complex
short_description: A fast-paced sci-fi ARPG with lasers, alien centipedes, WASD / twin-stick controls, random loot, and procedurally-generated levels. Wield legendary weapons, unlock devastating skills, create overpowered builds – and turn your enemies' attacks against them. Try the free demo!

name: Windblown
short_description: Brave the Vortex and dash your way to greatness in this lightning-fast action roguelite for 1-3 players from the crafters of Dead Cells. Absorb the powers of fallen warriors, rebuild their weapons, and WIPE THE FLOOR with those Sentinels in search of that perfect run!

name: Waifu Simulator: Beach Edition
short_description: Waifu Simulator is a simulation game whose ultimate goal is to bring you pleasure and relaxation!

name: ROGUE FLIGHT
short_description: A breathtaking arcade space combat game inspired by prestige anime.

name: Beyond Up
short_description: Beyond Up is an exhilarating adventure that will push your platforming skills to their limits! Your goal is simple: ascend through a world filled with obstacles, platforms, and unexpected twists, all while defying gravity and conquering your fear of falling.

name: Tile To Tile
short_description: Tile to Tile is an action platformer where the longer you move the faster you go! There is no time for hesitation. Your goal is to get the gem at the end of each level as fast as possible!

name: Motion Soccer
short_description: Motion Soccer immerses you in 11v11 matches that you'll experience in a whole new way thanks to Virtual Reality: control the game from an aerial view, play in first person with classic controls, or use real movement to control the player's feet. Get ready to dominate the field!

name: Finnish Cabin Mayhem - Mökkimähinä
short_description: Alcohol. Action. Violence. Get ready to take your friends 'behind the sauna' using whatever there is at hand.

name: Adventure of the Bucket
short_description: Embark on an adventure with the Iron Bucket and Wooden Bucket! Adventure of the Bucket is a cooperative multiplayer game where you control buckets connected by a spring to solve stages. Don't worry, you can play solo too!

name: Escape Toon Kingdom
short_description: You are a mascot trapped in a nightmare version of a former amusement park. Explore its haunting attractions, outsmart deadly enemies, and work together with friends to solve puzzles and escape the park's sinister grip in this co-op horror experience.

name: Sakura Alien 3
short_description: When Haru discovers that his friend, Hiyori, was hiding a huge secret, he’s forced to say goodbye to her. Haru misses Hiyori, however, and he’s determined to see her again – even if he has to travel into the furthest recesses of space to do it.

name: The Inn-Sanity
short_description: Early 90s. You stayed in a quiet hotel for just one night and the next morning you’ve found out that the old world was destroyed. Alien dreams, secrets of your past and other guests that are turning into monsters. This hotel will not let you to check out.

name: Blackheart
short_description: Weaving together action RPG and top-down shooter elements, Blackheart tells a tragic tale centred around the royal Blackheart family and the internal conflicts that are consuming them from the inside out.

name: Retro Rally
short_description: With PSX style graphics and arcade physics, this rally game offers a nostalgic and fun driving experience with old rally cars.

name: Look or Die
short_description: What happened at this school back then? A mystery horror story unfolds in an abandoned school.

name: Levana Horror Tale
short_description: You must complete a lunar mission only with the other person on the radio. When you realize that you were not sufficiently informed about the place.

name: Quiet House Massacre
short_description: Quiet House Massacre is a psychological horror game in which you try to find your missing cat. You come across an abandoned house and run in after it. Can you reveal the dark secrets hidden in a familiar old, quiet house? The truth awaits revelation!

name: Starlair
short_description: Fly through an endless universe visiting the planets of other users and taking on their challenges in a Metroidvania style game!

name: Monster Jam™ Showdown
short_description: It’s time to jump into a groundbreaking off-road arcade racing game, packed with thrilling sprints and unique tricks. Get behind the wheel of the most iconic Monster Jam™ trucks ever, and show your skills in several game modes!

name: The Last Plague: Blight
short_description: The Last Plague: Blight is an authentic survival experience rooted in realism and immersion. Endure the hazards of a brutal open world and uncover the origins of a mysterious disease. You are humanity’s final hope in ending the Blight

name: Nocturne Island Obscuria
short_description: NOCTURNE ISLAND OBSCURIA is a horror and adventure experience created in Unreal Engine 5, where you will investigate an abandoned island with many secrets, mysteries and scares.

name: Heartbeats
short_description: Would you survive a panic attack? Test your limits in this anxiety-inducing twin-stick shooter, blasting away intrusive thoughts using your Inner weapon.

name: Cricket: Jae's Really Peculiar Game
short_description: Cricket: Jae's Really Peculiar Game is a hand animated JRPG adventure that draws from genre classics. Join Jae as he goes on a journey with his best friends to try and fix the past in a story full of laughs, tears, and Elemelons. Engage in silly battles that involve timed hits, meter, and teamwork.

name: Containment Initiative 2
short_description: Containment Initiative 2 is a local asymmetric co-op VR shooter which can be played by two people on the same PC. Kill zombies alone in VR or have a friend cover you by using the mouse and keyboard. Explore and scavenge to unlock new gear and weapons to help you survive the infected horde!

name: Profiteer
short_description: Embark on a thrilling journey in Profiteer, a turn-based strategy game where you build and expand your business empire. Manage resources, outsmart your rivals, and experience dynamic worlds with co-op gameplay.

name: EchoesⅡ
short_description: サクッと遊べるダンジョン探索型2Dドット絵ローグライクゲーム第2弾

name: URAANKHIANS Dygyn - The Beginning
short_description: URAANHAI! Finally, we have all together driven Alaa-Mogus into the underworld! Now let's have a real Ysyakh and celebrate! Let's organize the first 'DYGYNA' game and find out who is the fastest! Play in multiplayer and become the FIRST!

name: Drova - Forsaken Kin
short_description: Drova is an Action-RPG that marries the dark grim tones of its genre with the mysticism of Celtic mythology. Encounter a society where ancient restless spirits and divided factions battle for dominance. Uncover forgotten abilities and unravel the secrets of a past shrouded in mystery.

name: Grave Filler
short_description: It's the night shift, and Batbo needs help filling in some graves in the graveyard! Help him by dropping rocks, dirt, bugs, and mushrooms into the grave and watch them merge into bigger and bigger graveyard treasures! Shoveling dirt can be hard when you don't have any fingers!

name: Night Winter Drift
short_description: Night Winter Drift is an arcade racing game set in the snowy mountains during winter. Enjoy the unique atmosphere as you drift along icy roads.

name: Across the Abyss: Voidborn
short_description: Enemies are your best weapon in this challenging hack-n-slash survivor! Slash and throw probes at bio-engineered foes, while meeting quirky characters and wielding elemental powers against an evil galactic mega corp. Get stronger, go further, and conquer the chaos in this short adventure!

name: O.W.L Projekt
short_description: O.W.L Projekt is a 3D isometric puzzle game that will test your mind and logic skills. Controlling Elysion, a young being created in a mysterious experiment, you will face the enigmatic Watchers in a journey to escape and uncover secrets.

name: Last Subway
short_description: Have you ever had such a gaming experience? Filled with wild screams, even mocking the developers, yet moved to tears by the end. Perhaps this game is one of those! Why? The truth lies at the last subway station.

name: Cosmorists
short_description: You find yourself completely alone on a different yet very familiar looking planet. Explore the planet, craft tools, fight enemies, and build bases! Do science to learn new technologies that will allow interplanetary travel and better tools at your disposal!

name: Frights
short_description: A Retro-Style Horror Survival Adventure. After a long day at the Riverside Forest, you wandered far from your parents...too far. Now it's nighttime and you can't seem to find your way back. As you follow the sweet voice of a sheep(?!), you fall inside an old, haunted cavern.

name: Quadrober Simulator
short_description: Are you a quadrober?

name: Cursed Broom
short_description: Fly with Maya through this charming 2D platformer! Find your way through the different parts of Maya's hometown, collect artifacts to gain different powers and experience a heartfelt tale of self-discovery and friendship.

name: Money And Lady | 财貌双全
short_description: 'Money & Lady' is a party game that requires luck & management strategy! (4K HD,5.6G free Hpatch)This is also the gentlemen's favorite game, the game won the New Earth Best Happiness Award and Not Tired to Replay Award! Support up to 4 players, and 7 different heroines is waiting for you...

name: Submergent
short_description: Explore and navigate an underwater cave in your submarine.

name: TETRACHROMA
short_description: TETRACHROMA is a block stacking puzzle action game with a new color changing mechanic inspired by Reversi. Manage the constantly changing colors of the board to clear 15+ lines with a single piece.

name: Night Slashers: Remake
short_description: Night Slashers is a pulse-pounding, horror-themed beat 'em up game, in a nightmarish world filled with bloodthirsty creatures and unspeakable horrors.

name: Another Hope
short_description: Trapped in a doorless room, you must follow the commands given to you. This psychological horror experience will test your resolve and sanity. Can you escape, or will you remain imprisoned forever?

name: Pulse
short_description: A low-poly action-adventure game where you play as a warrior fighting skeletons and monsters in an open world. Master sword combat, double jumps, and stamina management as you battle through a vibrant landscape full of challenges.

name: ThinkExplosive
short_description: ThinkExplosive is a small first-person puzzle-platformer about bombs! Throw bombs to overcome obstacles - or launch yourself to new heights. Explore the corridors of an abandoned facility and discover new game mechanics.

name: Meanings hidden in plain sight
short_description: Meanings hidden in plain sight is an captivating word-guessing game where quick wit and sharp observation skills are your greatest assets. Look at an image, think quick, find the hidden meanings and grab the points for solving them!

name: Chaos Entropy
short_description: This RPG features a unique combat system! After obtaining the Chaos God's Ring, you must evade the Goddess's minions while exploring the world, collecting divine weapons, and awakening heroic spirits. Assemble a knightly order to battle powerful enemies and uncover the ancient secrets of Eusayard.

name: Cats Go!
short_description: ‘Cats Go!’ is an innovative strategic defense experience combining 'Tower Defense', 'Asymmetric', and 'Brawl'. You either be a demonic cat, teaming up with demons to destroy the World Tree, or a heroic cat, joining forces with allies to protect it from the Dark Lord Kairos and his minions.

name: QUADRICOLOR: Ultra Sentai Color Ranger
short_description: Put on your sentai hero suit and join the chromatic battle! Protect the color balance in this lightning-fast 2D arena shooter. Snack it on with friends on a couch or online up to 4 players. Fight against evil forces and rise through the ranks in Quadricolor: Ultra Sentai Color Rangers.

name: Midnight Shift
short_description: One girl worked at a gas station in Wisconsin, and during one of her midnight shifts, the most unexpected thing happened to her.

name: SWORD ART ONLINE Fractured Daydream
short_description: In this online co-op action game, enter a distorted version of the SWORD ART ONLINE world. Pick your role in the form of favorite SWORD ART ONLINE characters and team up with 20 players for raids to defeat powerful enemies.

name: Cappi: Starbound Saga
short_description: Cappi: Starbound Saga is a 2D Action Platformer that challenges the player to defeat enemies, collect muns and reach the goal! Explore 18 levels spanning multiple worlds and save the universe from the hands of the Bastion of Darkness!

name: Din's Champion
short_description: Mine and gather resources, craft useful items, and explore a dynamic, evolving world all while fighting off the evil gods' minions and machinations in this side scrolling, action RPG. Become a Din's Champion and stop Valta's new scheme to destroy the world. Oh, and beware of exploding barrels...

name: Apples Busy Day
short_description: Apples Busy Day is a short and cozy game about exploring and helping your silly neighbors. Come check out all Apple has to do on the island of fruit!

name: Halloween Candy Reclaim
short_description: Halloween is threatened: Monsters stole the candy! Grab your dual-wield pickle guns and reclaim it! Eat it! Win!

name: EPIC ZOMBIES
short_description: EPIC ZOMBIES - This Game is in Early Access, The Story and Structure are still in Development. You are the last remaining Human on Earth. Can You Survive?

name: Kong: Survivor Instinct
short_description: When giant monsters fight, no one’s safe. Embark on a thrilling quest of survival in a city that’s become a battleground for Titans. Use the lethal strength of Kong and other monsters to your own advantage in this official Monsterverse game set shortly after the events of Godzilla vs. Kong.

name: Backroom Company
short_description: Backroom Company studies 'Noclip,' a supernatural phenomenon creating randomly linked backrooms. Its founders and purpose are unknown. Many explorers hired have disappeared in backrooms. Players trace past expeditions, farming unique items. Goal: deliver them to the main control room's dumbwaiter.

name: IRONSTRIKE
short_description: IRONSTRIKE is a 4-player co-op roguelike featuring physics-based swordplay, gestural spellcasting, and archery. Wield a sword, bow & arrow, or magic, and customize your build as you fight to rescue the gods of a vibrant fantasy world.

name: Call of Duty®: Black Ops 6
short_description: Call of Duty®: Black Ops 6 is signature Black Ops across a cinematic single-player Campaign, a best-in-class Multiplayer experience and with the epic return of Round-Based Zombies.

name: Sailaway III
short_description: Sailing simulation. Explore the world's oceans or compete in races in the most realistic sailing simulator available. The sailing waters are as big as the real world and circumnavigation will take several months. Using true weather, true conditions and true sail trim.

name: I Am Your Beast
short_description: Hunt the military-industrial complex across stylish comic book micro-sandboxes in this fast-paced covert revenge thriller FPS from the developers of El Paso, Elsewhere.

name: Cosmic Call
short_description: Cosmic Call is a brutal 3D FPS Roguelike Boomer shooter set inside the prison of the Great One. Fight your way out of this hellish nightmare, collecting otherworldly weapons and horrifying items along the way.

name: Botworld Odyssey
short_description: Venture out into a huge and diverse open world to discover new bots, collect rare scrap to build them, and deploy them in tactical real-time battles on your quest to become the world’s greatest Botmaster.

name: QANGA
short_description: QANGA: Dive into a sci-fi adventure of exploration and resilience across the cosmos. Merge your mind with a state-of-the-art cyborg crafted by ICLab's Industry labs, and journey through this expansive universe!

name: Who is Paul
short_description: Isaac, a failed detective, receives a mysterious letter that leads him to investigate a desolate and abandoned house in order to make ends meet. However, upon arrival, he realizes that instead of investigating, he must survive. To escape this house filled with dark secrets,

name: Locust Hunter
short_description: Though faraway, they shall be vanquished! 'Locust Hunter' is a third-person, level-based space shooter game. Pilot WHEEL fights through Locust defenses with lasers, missiles, and more. Her ally, NIGHT, gathers parts for weapon upgrades. Enjoy unlimited ammo and regenerating armor—just push forward!

name: Until Dawn™
short_description: Rebuilt and enhanced for PC – Until Dawn invites you to relive the nightmare, and immerse yourself in a gripping slasher horror where every decision can make the difference between life and death.

name: Monochrome Painter
short_description: Travel the world, overcoming challenges, monsters, and ravines to find new colors and paint the monochromatic world where you and your friends live.

name: Honey Bee
short_description: Your main mission is to explore a vibrant and lively scenario filled with beautiful flowers. As a skillful bee, your goal is to collect the nectar from these flowers. But wait, there must be more to it, right?

name: Hypcampex®
short_description: Hypcampex® is a 2D-Platformer that embarks you on a remarkable adventure across Planet Photonus as the legendary Electrex Bolt®, where he strives to acquire the Artifact of the Hypcampex® and battle through the war against the malevolent Avengers of Light, the Lavengers.

name: KBF: Knight Bar Fight
short_description: Play as a squire defending his knight's honor in this versus couch game for 2 to 4 players. Eliminate your opponents by touching them with your sword, complete quests to satisfy the tavern crowd and win the final victory !

name: Nuckelavee
short_description: You awake in the night to a foul smell. Your crops wilt, livestock perish. He has risen. Find the artifacts, break the curse, save your home.

name: Bane Murrain
short_description: Dayne Muren, a nervous wreck of an engineer working on the K.R.E.V research station, is thrown into the midst of a biohazard bloodbath when a meteorite collision turns his crewmembers into mutated creatures.

name: Keep Keepers
short_description: Tower Defense meets Base Management. Strategically place your defenses. Craft wacky ammunition like fiery peppers and boomerang bananas. Discover amazing weapons and automate your economy while defending against waves of enemies. Can you handle the chaos?

name: Whimel Academy
short_description: Live the day-to-day life of a witch/wizard student! Whimel Academy is a cozy time-management dating simulation game set in a magic academia. From the 1st person perspective, you can study magic, develop hobbies and befriend (or romance) classmates in this wholesome and enchanting world!

name: Despot Zombie
short_description: The experimental AI chip in his brain could be humanity's salvation... or it's end. Experience mind-bending combat, explore a dark fantasy wasteland, and unravel a twisted tale as Kurt, humanity's unwilling hope.

name: [REDACTED]
short_description: In [REDACTED], a fast-action isometric roguelike, a shadowy agent watches Black Iron Prison spiral into chaos. As one of the last guards, fight through monsters, rivals, and reanimated corpses of your fellow guards to escape the penitentiary alive.

name: PirateWar
short_description: piratewar is an fps/tps game. Kill your enemies and win.

name: Labyrinth of Wild Abyss: LayeRedux
short_description: A horror game about paranoia and endurance predation. You cannot beat the monsters, you can only outrun. They are slow, they aren't smart, but they are patient, they are many, and they are powerful.

name: Dragonium Adventure
short_description: Fight and make your way through the world of Akinori in this strategic turn-based RPG! Defeat powerful enemies, complete the intriguing story mode, upgrade your character, unlock new skills and join the fray!

name: Virballs
short_description: Six outlandish planets are overrun with Virballs - viral elemental creatures that consume each other to create exotic hybrids. Clean up this ecological disaster using Virball hybrids as devastating weapons!

name: VOXEL Hunters
short_description: Fight, die, repeat! VOXEL Hunters is a 1-4 player co-op, top-down roguelite shooter. Team up to blast and defend through a sprawling alien solar system. Upgrade, strategize, and face endless challenges in an epic fight for survival!

name: Tiny Boxes
short_description: Tiny Boxes is a relaxing collection game. Simply pick a box and get a cute prize. Trade your prize in for coins, exchange it for another prize, or add it to your collection. Complete collections to unlock more boxes. What's in the box? Come find out!

name: Teppo and The Secret Ancient City
short_description: 'Teppo and The Secret Ancient City' is a throwback to 90s platformers where you collected jewels, flicked switches to open up new paths and backtracked to the new area before finally finding the exit. The soundtrack has a classic early 90s platformer vibe, as do the in-game sound effects.

name: Pig Rush
short_description: 'Pig Rush' is a maze adventure game set in a deep forest. In this game, you guide a brave little wild boar named Argan. Argan will evade traps, defeat enemies, and keep moving forward to find the answers needed to save his tribe.

name: RetroRealms Arcade
short_description: The RetroRealms Arcade connects select RetroRealms games with other titles in the series that you own (games and DLC sold separately) to unlock new access and abilities and create the ultimate mash-up of horror legends!

name: Jennifer's Fragments
short_description: Despite the tricks her mind plays, Jennifer is trying to put the pieces of her mind back together. It is up to you to help Jennifer on this dark, uncanny and mysterious journey. Be prepared for a story full of terrible secrets and traumas.

name: KURU
short_description: Help Kuru go home! However, Kuru is a bit... of a neat freak, so he can't leave until he cleans up everything along the way! From teahouses to bamboo forests to shrines, KURU comes with 5 regions and 125+ handcrafted levels for you to rearrange and relax to!

name: Jewel Match Dracula Collector's Edition
short_description: Sink your teeth into a gothic Match-3 adventure in this ghoulish new installment of the Jewel Match series. As a powerful vampire lord, tackle eerie match-3 puzzles to resurrect and refurbish the legendary Castle Dracula.

name: Extreme Offroad Racing
short_description: Extreme Offroad Racing is a FREE all-terrain, off-road monster truck racing game featuring hundreds of race challenges. Get behind the wheel and buckle up for the most addictive and FUN physics-based driving experience!

name: GOD'S GIFT
short_description: God's Gift is a 2D puzzle platformer inspired by Lemmings and Pikmin with an emphasis on forward planning, exploration and experimentation. Guide mindless cultists throughout 24 levels overcoming environmental and enemy based puzzles by mutating the cultists giving them fantastic eldritch abilities.

name: PRIM
short_description: PRIM is a creepy-but-cute point’n’click adventure game full of dark humor. When her mother dies, Prim finds out she’s Death’s daughter and now has to live with her father. But the Grim Reaper has strict rules and when Prim breaks them, things take a fatal turn. Can you breathe life into her misery?

name: Paraplasm: Beyond the Veil
short_description: You fell into this cursed house! But will you be able to cope with the paranormal activity? Solve the puzzles and try to find your way out!

name: Buckshot to Hell
short_description: Russian roulette game where you can have fun with friends or compete with other people!

name: Oh My Lord
short_description: Manage your fantasy city, balance resources, and navigate the demands of different factions. Unlock new characters to join your city and help maintain order. Earn new cosmetics to customize the look of your lord. But beware the dangers that plague your little city at night.

name: Tormenture
short_description: Tormenture is a psychological horror game where you play as a child trapped in a cursed 8-bit game with a dark secret. To survive, you must find four relics and solve reality-blurring puzzles. But beware—some creatures may escape the game and haunt you in the real world. A game within a game.

name: Looney Tunes: Wacky World of Sports
short_description: Get ready for Basketball, Soccer, Golf and Tennis combined into one Looney Tunes sport game! Gain power-ups to incite chaos against your friends and family as you control your favorite Looney Tunes character in 4-player, local co-op mayhem, but watch out for falling anvils!

name: 7 Meters away. Oscar and the Cell of the Soul
short_description: '7 Meters Away. Óscar and the Cell of the Soul' is a point and click game in which you must help Óscar escape from a mysterious cell by solving various puzzles to discover why he has been imprisoned before it's too late.

name: Mars Mirage
short_description: This is a first-person rule-based horror puzzle game. You unexpectedly get a job, complete the observation work at the Mars exploration base, and receive a huge reward. But on the first day of work, you saw a very strange 'rule'. You need to 'complete your mission' while ensuring your own survival.

name: Arsene Lupin - Once a Thief
short_description: Discover the youth of a legend - Experience the transformation of Arsene Lupin, from whimsical thief to legendary hero, in 'Arsene Lupin - Once a Thief', an adventure and investigation game freely adapted from the works of Maurice Leblanc, with its events unfolding in the early 20th century.

name: Halley2061
short_description: This is a space sci-fi survival and building game. You take on the role of a retired astronaut on a top-secret mission to the Halley’s Comet. Resource and time management will be key to your survival. Will you wisely use limited supplies to build your own space base and achieve self-sufficiency?

name: Maniac Land
short_description: 'Maniac Land' Summon your mages to the court! Gather resources and transform them into powerful wands, mysterious books, or, well, stones. Develop new spells, defend your small land, or snatch up your friends' territories and zap them into another dimension.

name: Aunt Fatima - خالة فاطمة
short_description: Aunt Fatima's House: Solve puzzles, find items, and unlock doors while avoiding Aunt Fatima in this scary horror game.Can you escape the deadly house?

name: Once Upon a Rogue's Tale
short_description: Embark on a journey through your favorite fairytales in this charming roguelike deckbuilder. Trade dice in battle to play lots of different cards or to use powerful character abilities. Encounter story events and make tough decisions that shape your journey as it unfolds in your personal storybook.

name: Sail of Dreams
short_description: Sail of Dreams is a vehicular combat game with pirates! Pilot and juggle with all parts of your ship, assisted by a mischievous feline crew. Raise your canons, bolster your prow and board enemy vessels in quest of gold and glory!

name: Incaved Runner
short_description: Escape a concealed, mutated monster that's disrupting your scavenging. Master running, jumping, swinging, shooting and combining upgrades to end up as the powerful beast you once feared, turning the cave system from a nightmarish hollow into a playground.

name: The Scourge | Tai Ương
short_description: The Scourge game tells stories revolving around urban legends from the 1990s in Saigon, Vietnam. The male protagonist is trapped by past sins caused by his and his family's mistakes. Now, he must confront and overcome the consequences to find a path to redemption, and you are him.

name: Shards of Realm
short_description: Immerse yourself in a turn based tactical RPG set in an expansive open world, where you manage a diverse party of heroes and construct formidable fortresses. Strategize in battles, explore vast lands, and lead your team to glory in a dynamic fantasy adventure.

name: Liminal Void
short_description: This is a horror dungeon crawler where you snatch souls, cast spells, and die repeatedly. Select from 4 colorful characters and occasionally listen to them yap about their problems. It's very 'mood.'

name: Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond
short_description: Prove your political brilliance in a grand strategy like no other: pick any contemporary country, set up your government and navigate the pitfalls of domestic and international politics. A glorious destiny awaits - the domination of not just the Earth, but the whole Solar system!

name: Distressed
short_description: Distressed is a 5 player online co-op. You have been hired to locate, identify and extinguish paranormal entities.

name: The Lost Gallery
short_description: Works of art are attacking people, turning an exhibition into a bloodbath in a single night. At the same time, you – a phantom thief – happen to be there to steal a valuable masterpiece.

name: Hashihime of the Old Book Town append　fullscreen
short_description: The setting material book and supplementary reader for 'Hashihime of the Old Book Town append' are now available in multiple languages. Enjoy digital graphics and controls tailored to this game, with detailed profiles of each character, explanations of all the routes, illustrations, and much more.

name: Legend of the Wargod
short_description: A dark fantasy epic RPG with turn-based combat, with an emphasis on strategy and survival. Aid Zieg in his quest to recover his stolen voice and unfold the Legends of Aeasyn.

name: Duelite
short_description: Help the Coust brothers fulfill their fantasy of becoming sheriffs like their father. Defeat countless rivals of all kinds on different routes in this roguelite card dueling game set in the Wild West. Do you have what it takes to defeat the most wanted? Find out in Duelite!

name: Mycelium
short_description: Mycelium is a mind-boggling turn-based RPG game with action elements, set inside an ancient infamous cave system with the same name. It tells a story about a diverse cast of characters exploring their inner selves and the cave.

name: CROWDED. FOLLOWED.
short_description: You have the briefcase. Now it's after you. It's not going to stop. Be careful—it may take the form of someone else. A short horror game by NIGHT DIAL.

name: Peachy Derby
short_description: This is a casual racing game where the girl Natsuki is forced to join the 'Ninja Racing Tournament' to pay off her debt. Include 10 playable girls, 600 Japanese voices, 16 story chapters.

name: Eden Crafters
short_description: Embark on a journey of survival, crafting, and automation in Eden Crafters, a solo and co-op open-world game that challenges you to turn a hostile planet into a habitable haven for humanity. Temper the climate, create a breathable atmosphere, and turn toxic lakes into water: shape a new world!

name: Scarecropia
short_description: Here is Scarecropia! Lead at most 400 people to build a settlement. Arm your village to fight against the Goblin army, or invest limited resources in yourself to become unparalleled! Take every cost to survive!

name: Slayaway Camp 2
short_description: Take control of masked maniac Skullface in the goretastic sequel to the most violentest award winning Overwhelmingly Positive puzzle game ever made! This darkly hilarious puzzle game tribute to classic horror movies that puts the laughter in slaughter.

name: GT Manager
short_description: Take charge as the ultimate racing manager, leading your GT racing team to victory. Build your team, improve your car, and deploy winning race strategies across 5 official GT leagues, including the pinnacle of endurance racing: the hypercar category! Are you ready to dominate the world of GT racing?

name: Breach the Abyss
short_description: A sci-fi wave-based shooter with roguelite elements. Collect powerful upgrades and unique combinations to wipe out hordes of bloodthirsty creatures and make your way into the Abyss.

name: Kizuyami | 刻闇
short_description: Kizuyami is an atmospheric psychological horror game. You find yourself in a never-ending Japanese street that you cannot leave no matter where you go. You stumble upon the same house over and over again, which calls for you in inexplicable ways. Will you be able to find your way out?

name: The Carnival Killer
short_description: Step right up to the most twisted carnival you’ll ever encounter! In The Carnival Killer, 4 players find themselves trapped in a nightmarish amusement park where laughter turns to terror. Killer Clowns stalk the grounds, hunting down anyone who fails to escape the nightmare.

name: Vyanka's Memories
short_description: Vyanka's Memories is a platform-style game with metroidvania elements. Vyanka is a monster hunter who was called to her home village to protect it from a vampire. In the confrontation, she loses all her memories and powers and must remember them by defeating monsters in different biomes.

name: Deadzone Blackout
short_description: Deadzone Blackout is a competitive, fast-paced, arcade FPS. Immerse yourself in the pure adrenaline of a frantic, almost generic FPS. Master the fast-paced action, show off your quick reflexes and claim victory!

name: Descensus
short_description: Descensus is a souls-like action-RPG with challenging combat set in post-catastrophe diesel punk world. The player's goal is to reach the heart of the mysterious Rift of the Fallen Star. It is necessary to stop the expansion and spread of the anomaly before it absorbs the whole world.

name: Blood On The Thames
short_description: A murder mystery puzzle game with visual novel elements in a Gothic, Lovecraftian world. Collect clues, solve puzzles, interrogate suspects, and uncover the mystery surrounding the death of Mini’s husband.

name: Improbability Control Bureau
short_description: Monitor live surveillance cameras. Spot anomalies. From eerie furniture shifts to unexpected intrusions, report anomalies to correct them and survive.

name: StrangePool
short_description: You are trapped in a pool that looks familiar. Take a good look around and try to escape from the pool. This game is an anomaly search game. If you don't find any anomalies, proceed, and if you do find an anomaly, go back.

name: Dolls' Domain
short_description: You find yourself in a dollhouse - can you escape, or will you meet your fate? Navigate through the escape room-style puzzles, and avoid being caught by the creatures who exist in this place, and gain your freedom from the dollhouse!

name: Dragonero
short_description: Dragonero is a classic turn-based RPG with a strategic twist that will challenge you: explore dungeons, plan journeys in a open world filled with events, and face dozens of enemies in turn-based combat. Follow the different champion's paths in this vast comic book-style fantasy universe.

name: SILENT HILL 2
short_description: Investigating a letter from his late wife, James returns to where they made so many memories - Silent Hill. What he finds is a ghost town, prowled by disturbing monsters and cloaked in deep fog. Confront the monsters, solve puzzles, and search for traces of your wife in this remake of SILENT HILL 2.

name: Garage Flipper
short_description: Become a builder and renovator of garages and car repair shops. Your task is to complete jobs and build up your empire by buying and restoring old facilities. Grab your hammer, your mortar, and get to work!

name: Welcome to Empyreum
short_description: Welcome to Empyreum, the video game that will transform your gaming experience into a fun-filled party for the whole family! This exciting local cooperative party game for up to 4 players immerses you in the fascinating and wild universe of Hotel Empyreum.

name: Some Goodbyes We Made
short_description: I have some memories of saying goodbye that I don't want to forget, so I turned them into 11 minigames and backed them up in this collection.

name: Geo-Political Simulator 5
short_description: The new 5th edition of the hyperrealistic global simulator game where you play as the Head of State or as the opposition or the president of a large multinational company, with a completely redesigned interface, a new ultra-detailed map, complete control of companies and new scenarios for 2024.

name: Say Cheese
short_description: Hunger speaks louder! Help our rodent hero find his way to the cheese in a maze full of challenges

name: Banana Blitz
short_description: In this fast-paced, first-person online multiplayer runner, you and your friends race as monkeys to claim the idol. Use crazy gadgets like trip mines and freeze rays to sabotage rivals. Outsmart and outrun opponents in a chaotic scramble to reach the goal while the idol constantly changes hands!

name: Guardians of the Sanctree
short_description: You and allies, avian inhabitants of Sanctree City, build structures and production lines on the tree, crafting weapons to fend off subterranean insects. Defense is just the start—dig deeper, destroy nests, fortify new defenses against escalating threats for an impregnable stronghold.

name: Lullaby Data
short_description: Follow the story of Lullaby and Echo in a futuristic world. Mixing action and adventure, meet many unusual characters, play numerous mini games, and explore space to discover the secrets of Lullaby and the mad gods.

name: Hellwatch
short_description: Join a squad of 4 desperate daredevils to protect a celestial artifact from demon invasion in this online cooperative roguelite. Act like a munchkin way: support your team or drain their power. Fight your way to better gear and beware the consequences of death. Kill, die, defeat, repeat!

name: 皎月坠落之时
short_description: 'Moment of Moonset' is a thriller story game. The heroine Pang Lu comes into contact with Aileen by chance, and encounters a strange mysterious power on the way to learn Aileen's identity. How should she respond, or should she choose to fall into crisis? Or escape intact? Or...

name: Vox Populi: USA 2024
short_description: Play as an existing or fully customisable political figure, and campaign for many alternative US elections! In 'Vox Populi: USA 2024', you and the characters around you must promote your ideas and your popularity throughout the country to claim victory!

name: Math Seeker
short_description: Push the boxes and solve the math puzzles! Here, you will enjoy the charm of math seamlessly woven into the gameplay. A variety of boxes and mechanisms infused with mathematical elements await your discovery. Unleash your wit, unravel the game's secrets, and claim the crown of math!

name: Goodboy Galaxy
short_description: A vibrant sci-fi platform adventure game where you help Maxwell the dog explore unfamiliar worlds, make strange new friends and contend with mysterious forces - by jumping, shooting, slicing, shrinking, warping and drilling.

name: Cat Apocalypse
short_description: Play as a cat and as an American Templar soldier, in this very hard survival game! As a cat, attack enemies or evade them with your speed! And as a soldier, decimate the enemy with sci fi weapons!

name: Treat-Seeking Tricksters
short_description: In this Trick-Or-Treating Simulator, explore the mysteries of a rumoured street which only appears after sundown on Halloween night! Get as much candy as possible by judging which houses have candy and avoid those which instead hide nasty tricks!

name: Turbo Fat
short_description: A tasty twist on classic block stacking! Spin, squish and combine pieces to serve up delicious desserts. Explore 100 scrumptious levels, each with unique surprises and hilarious gimmicks. Team up with the mysterious Fat Sensei and grow your restaurant empire, catering to a cast of quirky creatures!

name: Year Unknown
short_description: A story-based exploration game about the very far future. With the help of two Artificial Intelligences, explore a universe conquered by humanity, uncover your purpose in it, and try to stop it from falling apart.

name: The Last FARMER
short_description: 'The Last Farmer' is not just a tale of survival; it's a journey of restoration. Amidst the sprawling deserts of a forgotten Texas, your farm becomes a symbol of hope and persistence.

name: Life is Strange: Double Exposure
short_description: When Max Caulfield finds her friend Safi dead in the snow, she tears open the way to a parallel timeline. Here, Safi is still alive - and still in danger! With her new power to Shift between two timelines – can Max solve and prevent the same murder?

name: Sociopat
short_description: Sociopat is an absurd comedy driven game that combines point and click adventure with action packed FPS game. Play in a role of an anti-hero and do some mischievous acts, NOW!

name: Planternauts
short_description: Welcome to Planternauts – an immersive adventure in planetary terraforming where you play as a brave explorer tasked with greening barren landscapes. Explore, discover, and transform an alien world into a lush paradise by initiating a grand project to create a new ecosystem.

name: Seed of Heroes
short_description: Journey through the realms with your heroes party. Defeat hordes of enemies in a bullet heaven and reach Valhalla where you belong.

name: The Axis Unseen
short_description: The Axis Unseen is a heavy metal horror indie game created by one of the developers of Skyrim and Fallout. Hunt nightmarish monsters from ancient folklore in a mysterious open world, collecting their enhanced sense powers and discovering elemental arrows. Beware, the hunter is also the hunted.

name: The Rocky Horror Show Video Game
short_description: A strange journey

name: Ulia Chronicles
short_description: Ulia Chronicles is a city-building game set in a fantasy universe. Build your city, gather resources, and make your citizens thrive. Overcome the challenges that will arise on your path both on the earthly and spiritual plane.

name: Bees vs Zombees
short_description: In this Roguelike Tower defense, Zombees are approaching. Protect the hive by building powerfull turrets and utilizing the queen bee's abilities to fight off enemy hordes. Manage resources, strategize carefully, and wield spells to survive the ZUMBEECALIPSE.

name: COVEN
short_description: COVEN is a hyper-violent retro FPS where your path of vengeance will take you across time and space. Destroy your enemies and eat their flesh.

name: Subterranauts
short_description: Subterranauts is a 2-6 player multiplayer horror game with proximity voice chat and terrifying creatures. Your job is to complete assignments by gathering scrap for the Association of Scrap Allocation. Work together with your team to complete assignments, earn company Bucks, and survive!

name: Decline's Drops
short_description: Grab your punching gloves, put your clogs on and smash your way in the world of Decline's Drops, a fully hand-drawn platform-brawler full of weird frogs, bizarre chickens and odd hydras! Avenge your destroyed garden and defeat the 6 heads of the Eternal Corp.! If you can, that is.

name: Carry The Glass
short_description: Team up as two quirky construction workers in this fun 2-player co-op platformer! Carry a fragile glass window through colorful levels filled with challenges. Communicate and coordinate to dodge obstacles and solve puzzles. Can you finish the job without breaking the glass?

name: DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO
short_description: DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO takes the legendary gameplay of the Budokai Tenkaichi series and raises it to whole new levels. Make yours the destructive power of the strongest fighters ever to appear in Dragon Ball!

name: New Journey to the West
short_description: 'New Journey to the West' is a multiplayer RPG. Form a four-player team to defeat demons, explore poetic landscapes, and enjoy scenic beauty. The revolutionary aerial combat system allows you to enjoy smooth and graceful battles. Join this with friends!

name: Umamusume: Pretty Derby – Party Dash
short_description: A colorful cast of pixel-art Umamusume are all in line and ready to compete in the Slapdash Grand Prix, a school festival featuring four zany events! Which team will run, shoot, and eat their way to gold and glory?

name: POROTO
short_description: POROTO is a chaotic arcade adventure - blast red pegs in action-packed platforming! Jump and run across vibrant levels, strategically bouncing and shooting to eliminate all the red chaos. Pachinko/pinball-style mechanics, bite-sized levels, and a pumping soundtrack make it a nostalgic experience.

name: GirlsStrage
short_description: Challenge auto-battles by successfully placing items in the storage possessed by cute girls! Purchase rare items and create your own original item placement. When you are ready, compete against other players and win with the girls!

name: World of PaintBall
short_description: World of Paintball is a sports simulator based on the real-life sport called paintball! Real markers and realistic maps. Colorful and exciting battles! Come in and prove that you are the best!

name: Fairy Card Battlers
short_description: A DCG with fast-paced strategic battles that conclude in 8 turns. Simple yet deep mind games emerge from card placement and the choice of benefits at the start of each turn. Will you enjoy the fairies' antics in the story, or aim for the top of the rankings in pseudo-multiplayer?

name: Stardust Demon
short_description: A retro story-rich metroidvania filled with unique and diverse abilities, and quirky, charming aliens and demons. Algol is witness to a catastrophe that sends the universe into disarray, uncover a mysterious evil plot and find many hidden rooms that test your skills.

name: Deck of Darkness: Infernal Depths
short_description: Deck of Darkness: Infernal Depths is an atmospheric dark fantasy dungeon crawl sure to get the blood flowing. Battle your way through the many levels of the lightless abyss to come face to face with your terrifying destiny.

name: Caravan SandWitch
short_description: Embark on a journey across vast landscapes in Caravan SandWitch, a captivating narrative-driven exploration adventure.

name: Hell Survivors
short_description: Hell Survivors is a survival roguelite where countless hordes of demons rise from the abyss. Compose a multitude of mighty builds and eradicate waves of nightmare creatures. Will you be able to survive Hell?

name: DEATHTRIP
short_description: DEATHTRIP is a daring, stylish, high-octane FPS catered to the speedfreaks, mid-2000s weirdcore enthusiasts, hypercore fanatics and adrenaline junkies. Rack up style points as you strafe and bunnyhop through a demonic near-death experience.

name: Destiny Star Girlfriend 2
short_description: Seiji’s “tied by fate” again, this time with a magical girl one year his senior! In part 2 of this rowdy rom-com VN series, a freak faceoff sees Seiji become Maja’s familiar—and bound by an enchanted tether to survive. Will proximity lead to love, or is he doomed to serve till the end of (his) days?

name: Dark Arena
short_description: It's humans versus genetically engineered monsters in Dark Arena, a futuristic first-person shooter that combines run-and-gun gameplay with strategic play and puzzle solving.

name: Jumpscare Scare Jump
short_description: This is a casual horror game similar to a haunted attraction, where you search for 50 jumpscares. Whether you like them or not, this game will help you build up your tolerance to them!!

name: Love Is All Around Prequel
