short_description: 在本作中，“你”化身为即将迎来毕业季的男主顾易，在对未来的迷茫与憧憬中，你将与六位性格迥异、各具魅力的女生发生一连串的故事，她们或是鬼马少女、或是温柔甜心、猫系娇女、豆腐西施，千娇百媚、亦幻亦真，敬过往。

name: [ANOMALY TAPES]: Beyond Reality
short_description: Uncover the truth in '[ANOMALY TAPES]: Beyond Reality'. Navigate through haunting levels, survive deadly anomalies with unique mechanics, and piece together a chilling mystery hidden within the tapes. Dare to uncover the secrets?

name: Life of Kanji Island
short_description: Life of Kanji Island is a game that helps you understand the ‘meaning’ of Japanese Kanji characters. Survive the island where all elements are composed of Kanji and master the Kanji!

name: Chores in the Night
short_description: 'I want this apartment spotless!' shouts your mom before going to her night shift. Use your cleaning supplies and courage to have the house cleaned before your mom comes back. A first person short story about doing chores and avoiding evil forces to survive the night.

name: Kingdoms: Merge & Build
short_description: Enjoy a soothing merge-2 experience blended with kingdom-building gameplay in this story-rich adventure!

name: Pure Pure Pero Pero Princess
short_description: After a sudden and chance meeting with an otherworldly beauty, Toshio Kaname is whisked away to a magical world, the Kingdom of Perahim. There, he learns of a prophecy to decide Perahim's next king and must embark on a quest to recover two magic relics.

name: I HATE MY LEGS
short_description: In this difficult-to-master Foddian adventure, embark on a hilariously BRUTAL mission as Jeff, a turtle with massive human legs trying to find his father! Spin, Jump, and Zoom through the world as quickly as you can, your father awaits!

name: Scarlet's Haunted Hotel
short_description: Help Scarlet unravel the mystery of the nightmare hotel and experience a dark romance.

name: Car Tycoon
short_description: Welcome to 'Car Tycoon', running your car company, hire employees to develop and produce cars, sell your cars, and become the best car company!

name: Silent Slayer: Vault of the Vampire
short_description: Become a vampire slayer and eliminate powerful sleeping monsters — an endeavor undertaken by only the bravest souls. In this jumpscare game with elements of horror and puzzle, you must destroy a clan of ancient vampires by carefully disarming their coffins’ defenses with the help of your guide.

name: Malpractice
short_description: Malpractice is an Online Multiplayer Horror Experience. Solve puzzles, discover secrets, and avoid corrupted entities to escape a plague ridden hospital.

name: Hidden Object: Prison Diaries
short_description: Find all the hidden objects and deep dive into the psychology of murder cases!

name: Bubble Frog DX
short_description: Bubble Frog DX is a fun and challenging short Action Puzzle game where you take on the role of a Frog in a Bubble who's been tasked to save 160 Onigiri from all kinds of hazards across 50 levels and 4 colorful zones in this retro throwback title!

name: VETITUM_VRC
short_description: Explore all the video tapes about the forest and the paranormal activities that happen, discover all the secrets by controlling who records these videos in a first person experience. Do not watch the video too many times, there is something strange about it.

name: Barricade
short_description: Barricade is a wave-based zombie FPS with a 90s aesthetic. Use physics props to build barricades and defend against zombies. Balance building, shooting, and repairs while spending money on weapons, upgrades, and defenses.

name: Shin chan: Shiro and the Coal Town
short_description: Shin chan starts a mysterious daily routine, traveling between two worlds: the Village in Akita and Coal Town.

name: Grow Empire: Rome
short_description: Hey Caesar! Defend your fortress and build your roman empire

name: DOT & DOT DUNGEONS
short_description: Adventure in dungeons that change every time you enter! The equipment you get in the dungeon is randomly selected to determine its strength! What will you see at the end of your adventure?

name: Crown Simulator - Royal Life simulation
short_description: Crown Simulator — a royal life simulation where every decision shapes the fate of your kingdom! Manage your army, strengthen relations with neighbors, care for your people and treasury. Can you maintain balance and become a great ruler? Make your choices and rule!

name: Balling Up
short_description: Immerse yourself in a colorful journey through universes that does not forgive any mistakes. Jump well in the ball parkour game, where falling can cost you everything!

name: Sewing Machine Simulator
short_description: Play as a prisoner in prison and operate a sewing machine. Use various methods to make him operate faster!

name: Potions In Motion
short_description: You are a travelling potion maker. The land is rich in ingredients. And the heroes need your help! Potions In Motion is an arcade game based on Snake with a wholesome theme and unique mechanics that provide new and fun challenges and the potential to achieve really high scores and infinite gameplay.

name: 地下城与小小猎魔人 Dungeon Tiny Hunter
short_description: In 'Dungeon and Little Monster Hunters', you can create your own dungeon adventure, travel through a dungeon kingdom full of demons, constantly overcome obstacles and eliminate monsters, and invite partners from the monster hunting camp to join you. The whole game is a rich action-mowing 2D game.

name: The Garden of the Gods
short_description: ―Do you believe in Gods' existence ?――This is the story of a young girl led by an unexpected fate― ''The Garden of the Gods'', a love simulation game (otome). The curtain is opening now on a life with the Gods in an alternate world of Japanese style and gorgeous Live2D illustrations!

name: We Could Be Heroes
short_description: We Could Be Heroes is a retro style, action packed beat ‘em up in the style of classic 90s brawler arcade titles. Featuring a huge array of attacks, destructible environments and brutal deaths. Become a hero and fight bad guys while stopping crimes and rescuing innocent civilians along the way.

name: Creatures Of War
short_description: Embark on a survival horror saga set in a treacherous world ruled by primal terrors. Scour for invaluable treasures, fortify your arsenal to combat evolving threats, and unravel the chilling mystery shrouding Delta squad's fate. Can you survive amidst the lurking jaws of the ancient predators?

name: Ascending Inferno
short_description: Experience rage-inducing precision platforming as a recently deceased soccer player damned to Inferno! Kick your sibling's soul out of Hell for your chance at redemption!

name: Mini Lax Sim 24
short_description: Small But Powerful Lacrosse Simulator + Auto-Battler Game. Draft your team, upgrade your players, set your strategies and win the championship!

name: Dai-chan's Great Adventure: World's End
short_description: A 3D Touhou Project action fangame with 5 maps to explore! Explore the world alongside the energetic kappa Nitori!

name: Destiny Star Girlfriend 3
short_description: In the final(?) route of this award-winning VN series, Seiji survives an attempt on his life by Kanoko, aka secret magical girl no. 3. The leads all point to a childhood tragedy and a certain deep-space Majin, so why him? And will Kanoko leave the dark side to save Seiji—and mankind—from herself?

name: Death Forest Abyss
short_description: Escape from the Forest of Fear by searching for the broken bike parts while running away from the creatures that are the remains of the massacre victims!

name: Cybernetic Ninja Nuns
short_description: To accomplish your mission, battle the Robo Demoniac legions and deliver Europe from the clutches of darkness in a race against death itself. An action platformer from another world, brought to you by The Good Bad Guy.

name: Polygon of Reality
short_description: 'Polygon of Reality' is a horror game in which you will have to unravel the mysteries of other dimensions and a research complex. Descend into the complex buried in the ground, uncover the mysteries of what happened, meet with forgotten fears and unknown creatures.

name: The Villainess Is Adored by the Prince of the Neighbor Kingdom
short_description: A popular light novel series in Japan with over 5 million copies sold, ' The Villainess Is Adored by the Prince of the Neighbor Kingdom ' (B's-LOG Bunko/KADOKAWA), is being turned into an otome game! Featuring many popular voice actors! Packed with beautiful illustrations!

name: Chroma Cross
short_description: Chroma Cross takes Nonograms beyond the binary of black and white and brings them into a rainbow of color. Experience Picross in refreshing polychrome.

name: Escape from the Cannibal Family
short_description: Never get caught! Jack up the doll's vision! Feel their presence!

name: The Last Night
short_description: 'The Last Night™' is a horror point and click game, mixing 2D and 3D with a very particular pixel art style. Will you be able to make the right choices ?

name: Terrorbytes
short_description: 4-player co-op: Share resources in this TRON & Stranger Things inspired horror that focuses on team work mechanics. You and your friends are sucked into an arcade machine, and forced to gather pellets for a horrifically mangled retro-arcade hero.

name: Mansion Restorator
short_description: Become a one-person house flipper. Buy, repair, and renovate neglected mansions. Restore these grand estates to their former glory and sell them for a profit

name: Rotate or Die
short_description: Rotate or Die throws you into a heart-pounding, high-speed adventure, where danger lurks around every corner.

name: Rivals of Aether II
short_description: Rivals of Aether II is the sequel to the hit indie fighting game, Rivals of Aether. Play as both new and returning elemental fighters in the next generation of platform fighters.

name: Mexico, 1921. A Deep Slumber.
short_description: Immerse yourself in an emotional and intriguing narrative adventure video game about the awakening of a country.

name: Playback Trauma®: The Dog
short_description: Your dog Marla got lost in the most terrifying forest in New Jersey while on a walk, and now it's up to you to find her. Search the area, clean up Marla's poop, and avoid the creatures that may be lurking in the darkness.

name: Evil Awaits™
short_description: Uncover the mystery of Archdale Castle in this Indie Action Survival Horror when an explosion threatens to expose a family curse and a new epidemic

name: Clock Rogue
short_description: Clock Rogue is an Action Roguelike game which you attack with your stopwatch timing. Build your own time clock and protect the hedgehog from viruses attack!

name: Customer Disservice
short_description: Customer Disservice is a fast-paced soul-crushing hostile work environment game designed to put your minimum wage skills to the test. Using the information provided in your handbook, determine what sales are allowed or disallowed by company policy and enforce appropriately.

name: Lumina Rush
short_description: Lumina Rush is a single-player speed running platformer. Master speed by utilizing sliding, propulsion, swinging, and teleportation to dominating levels at the speed of light.

name: Draft Day Sports: Pro Basketball 2025
short_description: Draft Day Sports: Pro Basketball 2025 puts you in the role of general manager of your favorite basketball team. Every decision can be made by you from drafting, trading, signing free agents all the way to making each substitution to lead your team to championship glory and becoming a dynasty.

name: IfSunSets
short_description: 「IfSunSets」 is a survival RPG adventure game. During the day, secure necessary supplies across the island, and survive the night against strong and terrifying monsters that track you down. You can utilize resources you've secured to build a base to fend off threatening monsters.

name: WAIFU IMPACT 2
short_description: Discover the secrets of the paradisiac Waifu Islands. Shoot and level up your characters in this sequel of the acclaimed Waifu Impact.

name: Underground Garage
short_description: Dive into Underground Garage, a mechanic sim blending car customization with fast driving. Craft builds for every drive, test them in an open world filled with challenges. Gear up and rev up your ultimate automotive adventure!

name: Drizzlepath: Picturae
short_description: Have you ever wandered inside images? Images that blow your soul away? In Drizzlepath: Picturae, you embark on a journey of gorgeous landscapes. While some of these landscapes melt your heart, some will give you the chills.

name: Terror in the Corn
short_description: In an endless cornfield where the sun never rises, you must break the curse or risk being trapped forever.

name: Pinevale Settlements
short_description: A simulation where you build and manage your own successful colony, defending it against enemy attacks. Grow your settlement from scratch by balancing your skills. Perfect your strategy and watch your colony evolve!

name: Coup Ahoo
short_description: Gather some cargo of dice and take down your fleet!

name: Hotel 12th
short_description: Trapped in a mysterious hotel with 12 floors, you’re caught in a never-ending loop. Each floor hides secrets and clues—only by paying close attention to the details can you break free. Your goal? Descend to the 0th floor and escape, but beware, the hotel doesn’t want you to leave…

name: REDLINE CROOKS
short_description: REDLINE CROOKS is a fast-paced roguelite combat racing game in which you destroy cops, walls and possibly yourself in a chaotic pursuit of freedom and riches. Upgrade, Slam, Taunt and Boost your way out of imprisonment through the lawless roads that lie ahead, and you may find personal absolution.

name: Easy Mahjong
short_description: Mahjong using Chinese rules against 3 AI players.

name: Kimi ga Nozomu Eien: Enhanced Edition
short_description: 'Kimi ga Nozomu Eien' returns as an Enhanced Edition! This legendary visual novel left fans emotionally wrecked for days after its release, and two decades later, its rollercoaster storyline still captivates hearts. Experience the romance that shook a generation!

name: Florist Business Simulator
short_description: Bring flowers from nature to venues in Florist Business Simulator. Develop your business by gathering flowers, making stunning arrangements, and decorating venues to delight your customers with beautiful spaces.

name: Shop Manager Simulator
short_description: Take charge of your own retail outlet. Stack shelves with products, hire staff, set prices, appease the customers, manage suppliers, expand your space. Grow from a little store into a massive supermarket.

name: Last Stance: A JuVentures Game
short_description: Fight your way through endless waves of enemies in this fast paced 3-button punch game.

name: HOOD RPG
short_description: Dark Humor & Satire: Experience a story that blends comedic mischief with clever parody, ensuring laughs and surprises at every turn. Engage in unconventional turn-based battles. Be ready to fall over laughing!

name: Epic Pixel War
short_description: An action roguelike where you send armies of powerful units to fight against hordes of enemies and bosses, upgrading and finding new units as you go.

name: Scales and Tails
short_description: Team Dragon or Team Sheep? Who will win this epic and absurd contest?!? Test yourself and your friends in this retro arcade style, top down, 2D flight shooter with single and couch co-op options. Level up! Upgrade your characters! And finally answer the question of who is better: Dragons or Sheep!

name: ASTROSMASH 1981
short_description: In this retro arcade hit, you control a laser gun and have to shoot asteroids, bombs and other objects to collect points and ensure your survival

name: ArkCraft: The Rebirth of the World
short_description: In this open-world crafting and building game, you explore an ancient world full of dangers and secrets. Collect animals and plants, build bases and master the craft as you build your ark and save civilization from destruction by the flood and then rebuild it.

name: Depths of Faveg
short_description: Fight your way through hordes of monsters, and try to reach the fabled treasure at the bottom of the dungeon of Faveg in this brutal Roguelike RPG. Can you train a party strong enough?

name: Pogo Knight
short_description: Bounce your way to the top and claim victory... How hard could it be?

name: 魔石
short_description: In a vast continent, there is a country called Reese, where ancient human civilization lives for hundreds of years of peace. Until one day, evil forces descended from the sky and launched the most brutal attack in history, plunging Reese into endless chaos...

name: Hanctt Origins
short_description: Hanctt Origins is a dark retro FPS straight out of the Lovecraft novels. Witness our character complete his journey on the Hanctt continent.

name: Emberwake
short_description: A dark fantasy survival strategy game where you manage villagers, gather resources, and defend a burning campfire against waves of undead in a relentless battle for survival.

name: Insectum - Epic Battles of Bugs
short_description: Immerse yourself in the epic battles of 'Insectum' and unleash the power of your monstrous insects. Face off against your rivals on the battlefield by strategically using cards.

name: 独特的友谊 - Special Friendship
short_description: 《独特的友谊》是一款恐怖治愈RPG。雷雨交加的夜晚，一个在充满垃圾的小巷中居住的机器人，遇见了一位幽灵少女。伴随着雷鸣，两人在黑暗世界中建立起不逝的友谊……

name: Virtual AI - KURONYAM
short_description: Touching, feeling, and melting experience. Looking for a cute VR game? Neko girl 'Kuronyam' is waiting for you.

name: Number Stomper
short_description: Number Stomper is a minimalistic puzzle game where you move in one of 4 directions to step on numbers, reducing their value by 1. Clear every number on the grid to complete a level. Explore the different tile types and challenge yourself with 100 levels!

name: The Japanese Calligraphy
short_description: A Japanese Calligraphy Simulator Game! Not only can you practice writing with a brush following examples, but you can also practice writing hiragana and katakana! Self-scoring kanji tests! Grateful sutra copying! Let's study Japanese!

name: Pix'Hard
short_description: 'Fight off endless hordes of enemies with your ship! Upgrade it to defeat increasingly powerful opponents! Choose your upgrades carefully, manage your priorities, and find your enemies' weak points!'

name: Veil of Shadows
short_description: Veil of Shadows is an action-adventure with roguelite elements, echoing the vibes of classics from the past. Explore the surroundings to understand what's happening to Sirene. With the essence of retro games, face monsters, complete quests to gain experience, and evolve, preparing for the journey.

name: Hunt and Fight
short_description: Explore the island, fight monsters, use various combat combinations to defeat bosses, and earn a reputation. Who knows, maybe one day you will be able to kill the DEATH itself. Hunt and Fight is an exciting Action RPG in which you must overcome difficult challenges to find the way to get home.

name: TUONELA
short_description: Descend down to the dark hellish realms of madness and despair and fight your way through hordes of undead, demons and other creatures of nightmarish powers. Collect treasures and unlock more heroes as you journey through the underworld alone or with your friends.

name: The Parish
short_description: A slow and atmospheric retro horror game. These hills hide more than just this congregation. Tend this remote church, give services to the needy and you never know... you might just survive the night

name: Supurr Cat Cafe: Sandwich Rush
short_description: Stack towering sandwiches with the help of cute cat friends while building up your dream cat cafe. With plenty of hungry quirky customers around, you’ll need to upgrade your cafe, find new cats to help you and up your sandwich game to keep them happy!

name: The Lighting Ages
short_description: RPG adventure game where player mission is to find skulls to finish levels and also accomplish different quests and avoid enemies

name: Departed
short_description: Departed is an anomaly detection game, where you are stuck inside a looping subway system. Explore the station carefully and spot the differences. Nine consecutive correct decisions will bring you closer to your goal. Can you make your way through the endless platforms or will you get lost forever?

name: Dawn of the Ashen Queen
short_description: Dawn of the Ashen Queen is a classic grid-based dungeon crawler. Set out with your party to reveal the legacy of a millennia old curse in a narrative-rich experience. Explore the colorful world of Eshavon, unearth its many secrets and fight dangerous foes sent out to stop you in your mission.

name: Ruku's Heart Balloon
short_description: This puzzle game can be enjoyed by players of all ages. The gentle story is straight out of a picture book with voices, like telling a story to a child. There is also a puzzle mode to enjoy at your leisure.

name: Mytho Duel
short_description: It's an adaptation of the classic card game 'Triple Triad' for an interactive in-menu experience. This game offers engaging and strategic gameplay, allowing players to challenge their own strategic planning skills.

name: An Aisling
short_description: An Aisling is an adventure game focused on exploration, story, and character. Make friends or enemies as you try to uncover why people are dissappearing on the island of Rashinmore.

name: Rusts Of Corruption
short_description: You've mysteriously awoken on an isolated island on an unknown world. A corrupting force spreads through the island, leaving only a short amount of time to learn about the islands mysteries... Who will you meet? What will you learn? Are you ready to see the world die?

name: Vending Machine Business Simulator
short_description: Build your business! control every aspect of a thriving vending machine business. Buy, place, and restock machines to increase profits. Do you have what it takes to manage, expand, and dominate the vending industry?

name: The Little Maze
short_description: Now you are traped in a maze and you should find the exit.During the process,pay attention to all kinds of obstacles and signboards indicating the wrong,oppsite direction.

name: Call the Tune
short_description: In this detective/idol game fusion, every decision you make will influence the narrative. Your choices will shape relationships, uncover secrets, and determine the fate of the characters and the school itself.

name: Pyramid Clicker
short_description: Pyramid Clicker is a real adventure! Upgrade your perks, buy artifacts that grant incredible bonuses, and experience the power of prestige. This game offers vast opportunities for progression that will keep you hooked for hours on end.

name: Cave No. 6
short_description: Cave 6 'is a pixel style 2D action adventure game where you will freely explore dangerous underground caves, engage in battles with monsters, collect materials and clues, and find the true way out of the legendary cave world.

name: Fantasy War Heroes: Chilling Fog
short_description: Press one of your houses and drag to other house to move your troops. Conquer all houses for victory. Enemy wants to destroy your troops. Now with movable heroes that appear later in the game when you have learnt basics.

name: HeistGeist
short_description: Get in, get the goods, get out. What could possibly go wrong? In this single-player, story-driven cyberpunk RPG, play as Alexandra - a street-smart thief on the run after a failed heist. Put together a team of unusual allies, pull off thrilling heists, and fight and hack using your deck of cards.

name: De-coding Armageddon
short_description: Fast paste, fast typing, arcade, die and retry game. De-coding Armageddon is a game to practice your speed and reflexes, perfect for when you are waiting on another game or wether you just wanna kill sometime.

name: Three Against the Odds
short_description: Three Against the Odds is a base defense fantasy roguelike. Build your amphibian hero(es) and settlement as wave after wave of enemies descends from bordering terrain that you can terraform. Play through three campaigns, conquering the shadowy powers that have corrupted the world of Primeva.

name: The Overseer: Field Trials
short_description: Step into the role of a paranormal agent. It's time for field trials where you’ll identify anomalies firsthand. The trials are held in a partially controlled environment, but stay alert—unexpected threats may arise. Successfully report anomalies multiple times to earn your Field Agent badge.

name: Fish Idle 2: Underwater Mystery
short_description: Dive into the most fun idle fishing arcade game! Manage your Fish Kingdoms with automated fishing, upgrade your boat and gear, invest in passive income, and outsmart the market. Become the ultimate fish tycoon!

name: The Secret of Whispering
short_description: The Secret of Whispering is a psychological horror puzzle game. The player is lured into an abandoned house by mysterious calls. As he explores the eerie property, he uncovers dark secrets and is drawn into a maelstrom of puzzles and gruesome revelations.

name: Take me
short_description: In every woman's life, there comes a moment when she walks into the wrong door... The last thing I remember is a masquerade party at a nightclub and a tall, muscular man with a Belarusian accent who offered to buy me a cocktail...

name: Leshy Prelude
short_description: A horror action-adventure with a gripping story. Fight through the forest using energy granted to you by greater powers lest you succumb to the will of the forest guardian Leshy.

name: Lovely Memory Challenge
short_description: Cute memory challenge(Unlimited levels)(Super high difficulty)

name: The Watcher's Pursuit
short_description: You’ve uncovered dangerous secrets, and now the corporation you work for is hunting you down. Survive the night, monitor camera's and find a solution to the problem. Trust no one. Stay sharp. Your life depends on it.

name: Nazar
short_description: Experience the world's first fusion of FMV genre and 2D platforming in this revolutionary sci-fi adventure. Explore Cappadocia's mystic realm where fortune-telling meets quantum physics. Join Nazar, unlock psychic powers, and race to prevent a dark future in this genre-defying journey!

name: Dookie Clicker
short_description: Dookie Clicker is the most absurdly addictive game that unapologetically puts you in charge of a steaming pile of... well, you know. Your mission? Click the crap out of it and watch as your dookie evolves from a simple turd into a majestic, over-the-top, freak show of fecal artistry.

name: Fuel Station : Drive & Pumping
short_description: Inherit an abandoned gas station in a desolate desert. Raise funds, renovate, and modernize the station. Expand your services to attract more customers. Test your entrepreneurial skills and maybe you'll become rich

name: Absolute Insanity
short_description: Armed with a diverse arsenal of weapons battle through ever-changing mazes and confront eerie, evolving enemies in a pulse-pounding survival horror action-packed experience.

name: Spray Cola
short_description: Control a can of cola, spray out soda, and reach the target through differect mechanisms before all soda is depleted.

name: Abolish
short_description: This is a delightful pixel-style adventure game set in a world of yellow land and blue sky, where you embark on an adventure as a Corgi puppy.

name: Fire in the Dark
short_description: Online duel isometric arena-shooter where the best witch wins! Use the power of fire and ice, navigate the shadows and hidings to defeat your opponent in a duel in the darkness. Use the light, hide in a bush, and show your friend who's the best witch in town!

name: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival
short_description: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival is a drum-based rhythm game featuring songs from genres such as Anime and VOCALOID™, and also a variety of game modes! Have fun playing solo or online!

name: Election Tycoon: Trump vs Harris
short_description: Election Tycoon is a real-time strategy game where you lead a campaign to win the 2024 US elections as Trump, Harris, or your own independent candidate. Influence states, color the US map in your party's colors, and outmaneuver your opponents in a high-stakes, map-based political battle.

name: The Forsaken Anthology: Obsession
short_description: The Forsaken Anthology: Obsession, a psychological horror game that explores the dark side of human desire and the lengths one might go to fulfill it

name: Miniatures
short_description: Miniatures is a collection of strange tales where childhood imagination and reality merge with darker undercurrents of mystery and magic. Explore a vast seascape, build odd furniture, feed a lizard and play with sand castles.

name: The Protagonish
short_description: A short adventure game, where you don't control the adventurer. Play the side characters in a medieval village, and decide to help or hinder the adventurer in their mysterious quest.

name: Place of Decay
short_description: Explore a corrupted game project in this horror-puzzle adventure. Uncover the mystery behind its collapse and the developer's abandonment. Use the Code Cannon to break through the digital barriers and navigate the chaotic realm to uncover the truth behind its downfall.

name: TransMemory
short_description: I woke up in a dimly lit basement. You have no memory of who you are or why you are here. Can you escape from this place?

name: Elara's Light
short_description: Elara’s Light is a relaxing, yet punishing 2D precision platformer. Every jump tests perseverance and precision—one mistake could drag Elara back into the darkness. Uncover the stories of the forsaken, and guide Elara toward the light she longs for.

name: Parcel Master
short_description: Outsmart the Gridlock! Master the art of delivery in this deceptively simple puzzle game where every road counts!

name: Back to the Rooms
short_description: Back to the Rooms is a 6-player co-op horror experience. Survive and explore the backrooms with your friends or alone to save your home.

name: Sucker head: Bodycam
short_description: A co-op horror game. In it, players take on the role of a group of people who are trapped, full of dangers and horrors. The goal of the game is to get out by solving puzzles, avoiding traps and fighting monsters.

name: Dark Manor
short_description: Dark Manor is a single-player, first-person horror game. Explore the manor and collect the amulets that will allow you to escape this cursed place. Different types of monsters and creatures inhabit this old, dilapidated mansion, and you'll need to avoid them to successfully make your escape.

name: Stellifier
short_description: Stellifier - an otome game inspired by older idols An idol drama game about an older group making a comeback from retirement, featuring a GxB/BxB/non-binary romance!

name: クソデカ囃子(ばやし) | Kusodeka Bayashi
short_description: 'Shatter the family curse with the thunderous power of 'Kusodeka' heavy metal!' Kusodeka Bayashi is a first-person horror comedy game where you, as the young protagonist, must face the eerie terror lurking at your grandparents' countryside home.

name: Trouble In Paradise
short_description: Dive into an unforgiving adventure where you unlock characters, control vehicles, and master your weapons. Solve puzzles, relax by beaches, and shop at local markets. Collect 'kilos’ for snacks. Enjoy retro visuals, hand-drawn cutscenes with amateur voiceovers, and a groovy original soundtrack.

name: Shadow Trick
short_description: Turn into a shadow and clear all the levels. Shadow Trick is a cute platformer game starring a wizard able to switch between the real world and the shadow realm. Keep an eye on your shadow and don't let your eyes trick you!

name: Beanrise
short_description: First-person Action, Puzzle-Solving game. Unfold the Mysteries of two interconnected timelines. Discover the truth of the present within the past!

name: 勾八狂想曲
short_description: 看圖就知道這是個神經的遊戲！

name: The Memory Thieves
short_description: Immerse yourself in a unique cooperative multiplayer game for 1 to 4 players. Explore the graveyard of Ravenwood, pass through mysterious portals, and steal as much treasure as possible while avoiding the dangers.

name: Fatal Falls
short_description: In Fatal Falls you explore the dark secrets of 'The Grand Elysium', a posh luxury hotel in the middle of nowhere. Interact with its guests, drink a cocktail at the bar, peruse the noble premises – the choice is yours! Just make sure you don't get entangled in the hotel's dark deeds...

name: Parking World: Build & Manage
short_description: Build, manage, and expand your own lucrative parking enterprise in this management sim. Parking World puts the power to build your perfect parking garage at your fingertips while solving everybody else's parking problems in unique narrative scenarios or without any objectives in freeplay mode.

name: Drunken FC
short_description: Ever wanted to get drunk, play football (soccer), and not worry about the medical bill later? Do you hate animation and love physics? Then here's some physics-based sports action for you and your friends. Play locally or remotely. Move your feet, but don't break the sticks on your controller.

name: Among The Stars :UFO Hunting Simulator
short_description: The relaxing UFO hunting experience. Enjoy the peaceful nature sounds and the crackle of the fire as you gaze the stars and ponder the universe's secrets. Manage your hunger and stamina as you catch some UFO action swimming through the night sky. Some are satalites, but others... who knows?

name: Mask Around
short_description: Mask Around is an action-packed, weird and colorful 2D roguelite with tons of hidden secrets. Buy weapons & items, unlock masks with unique powers and combo enemies using melee attacks and shooting power.

name: Space Cycle
short_description: Space resources are the battleground for warring factions. As a Space Defense Officer, protect your faction's assets in a vast, hostile universe. Allocate resources, upgrade defenses, and repel relentless enemy attacks! With over 50 unique units and deep strategy, experience real-time tower defense!

name: Yawnoc
short_description: Destroy hordes of strange machines that have invaded the forest. Yawnoc is a chaotic top-down shooter roguelite focused on immersion into the world of Conway's Game of Life and other cellular automata.

name: Codex Lost
short_description: The new open world, spellcasting action-RPG. The grimoires have been stolen, civilisation is in ruins. Rise, Curator! Craft ancient elemental magics and challenge the great lords who threaten to fracture reality itself.

name: Goblin: Mutation
short_description: This is an open world adventure RPG game Having over 100 types of weapons and 30 sets of collectible armor Simple operations unleash exceptional skills

name: LEVEL 37
short_description: A calm horror and exploration game from Backroom Dreamcore. Walk, look around, and listen to the sounds. There are no monsters chasing you or jumping at your screen in the game. You may find that they seem to have appeared in your dreams or childhood memories while exploring the game scenes.

name: Alpha Response
short_description: A fast paced tactical police shooter featuring dynamic missions that take place in real world locations that can be played in singleplayer mode or co-operatively.

name: Wally The Seal 2
short_description: Wally The Seal is back! And this time he's not alone. Armed with the new Salmon Radar, explore all new maps with new items to find and collect. Can you survive the combined might of Wally and his partner Mrs. Wally?

name: Cosmic Kitchen
short_description: Cosmic Kitchen is a 2D cooking game set in space! Your mission: Feed hungry monsters or else they will take over all the galaxies! Think fast and grab food as it flies into orbit. Use planets, asteroids and more to get cooking and save the universe! You'll never run out of space in this kitchen!

name: My Bloody Weekend 2
short_description: 'My Bloody Weekend 2' is a new survival horror experience for the MBW franchise. Try to survive at some new and improoved Quick Time Events, set in a new mansion ready to be explored. Play as a new character for this live action game. A new week is going to pass, a new terror is about to rise.

name: The Halloween Incident
short_description: A detective story with elements of analog horror, in which you will have to conduct your own investigation to get to the truth.

name: Roots of Harmony
short_description: Text-based 4X with a focus on turf war and resource management. Roots of Harmony is a keyboard-controlled strategy game where you have to lead your colony to different stages of development, while facing various threats and managing your doctrines and disciples. 100% gameplay, no graphics!

name: KiNoKoe : Tree's Voice
short_description: You play as Hiro, a young Japanese man whose life is filled with a boring job. One evening, you see a strange light in the park’s trees near your home. You walk to the oldest tree and discover strange symbols on a piece of bark...

name: Mahjong Riddles: Egypt
short_description: Solve mahjong levels and complete artifact collection to uncover secrets of Ancient Egypt. Try new game features: huge treasures, tricky locks, new bonus tiles and more. Discover why Only the pharaoh could own a cat and many more surprising facts.

name: Five Nights At Skibidi Toilets
short_description: FNAST offers a unique gameplay that combines elements of strategy, survival and horror. Will you be able to solve the mystery of this mysterious building and prove the truth of the information from the newspapers?

name: The Throne of The Clock - remasterd
short_description: Enoch, sneaks into the bride's waiting room on their wedding day. He wanted to catch a glimpse of her But the she was found dead, stabbed by his sword. That sword was a gift from the Clock Witch, with the words, 'You will have to pay.' Enoch starts riding, towards the throne where the witch awaits.

name: Tricky Madness
short_description: Tricky Madness is an upcoming arcade snowboarding game with a focus on speed and big air inspired by classics like SSX and 1080. Race down the mountain, explore secret areas, catch big air and perform Wicked tricks.

name: Crayon Legend
short_description: Cursed nobles turned into Magic Doors watch their possessions eaten by an insatiable Mimic. Transported to this time-locked island, you must Jump, Lift, Search, and Feed to restore the kingdom. A family-friendly, 3D platformer with hand-coded physics, Unlock the doors to find your way home.

name: Limb Chopper
short_description: Find the masked killer responsible for butchering innocent citizens of 1980s Los Angeles...before he finds you. Uncover clues about the killer's whereabouts to save the city and put the Limb Chopper away for good.

name: Unwhole Hill:LAKE
short_description: Serve as today’s Dormitory Inspector in the North Campus dormitory, escaping from this lakeside university’s dormitory or uncovering the truth behind the strange mysteries.

name: Garden Snap
short_description: A relaxing game where you can remove alien plants to restore the forest. No quests or enemies, just relaxing. You can also change the weather if you prefer rain. Alternatively, you can also just walk around in nature in a peaceful forest.

name: SUPER MARKET
short_description: SUPER MARKET is a fun, silly game about shopping with superpowers, throwing items at friends, and racing to be the first to finish your shopping while the world around is gets crazier and crazier.

name: Naive Boy Super Lash
short_description: Do you like whips? Have you ever wanted an accurate, next-generation, stimulating whip simulator? Well, this game is far from it, but at least it tries!

name: Cursed Loop
short_description: Trapped in a nightmare, every death pulls you back into the same dark cycle. Test your spirit and courage as you escape the depths of a sinister mansion.

name: Mouselash
short_description: Mouselash is an action roguelite where you are the mouse cursor. Create your build by combining weapons and stats as you satisfyingly pop waves of enemies!

name: Lucky Hunter
short_description: Lucky Hunter is a deck-building auto battler Roguelike game. Your pieces are automatically played on the board, and players will focus on building unique decks and relics, making the best of the synergies between pieces to defeat increasingly powerful prey.

name: Chior
short_description: You had a pretty rough fall. Trying to regain your composure you try to look around before realizing you can't see anything. Hope that your other senses will serve you better.

name: Tide—1932—
short_description: A new story of a young girl who escapes from a murder charge and weaves with her chosen lover.

name: ShapeHero Factory
short_description: ShapeHero Factory is a game that fuses the factory simulation, roguelite, and tower defense genres. Use different shape combinations to mass-produce a variety of heroes, who will then fight all on their own. All you need to worry about is building the optimal factory to manufacture them.

name: PENGUIN HOTEL -Chapter 1-
short_description: You have been invited to the popular “Penguin Hotel”. There, you get caught up in a terrifying event. Solve puzzles and battle with a special camera! Experience a very strange penguin horror.

name: Age of History 3
short_description: Grand strategy wargame where the destiny of Civilizations rests in your hands - will they stand united under your leadership or fall divided in conflict? Journey through the entire saga of human civilization, from its earliest days to the futuristic era, crafting your legacy age by age.

name: ColdRidge
short_description: Catan meets Balatro in this push-your-luck puzzle roguelike. Gamble on resource contracts, plan your moves carefully, and explore the land of Coldridge to meet your quota!

name: Diatribes
short_description: 'Diatribes' is a poetic VR interactive experience that explores the internal conflicts that arise when we’re confronted with the reality of climate change.

name: Shooting Aircraft
short_description: I heard it takes a truck of shells to shoot down a plane? A decompression game that simulates anti-aircraft gun attacks on airplanes.

name: Investigate
short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game where players can select their preferred difficulty level at the beginning.

name: 卫国战争 The Patriotic War
short_description: The enemy has invaded the territory, the motherland needs you, soldier! Gather your troops and defeat all enemies!

name: Eagles of World War 2
short_description: A fantasy based arcade shooter set in World War 2 with frantic bullet hell shooter style gameplay and a bullet time slo motion mechanic. Take on the enemy forces solo or with a friend either in local co-op or online with STEAM's remote play together.

name: Cod Quest!
short_description: Run, grow and defend the UK's last Fish and Chip Shop. Your chippy is under threat from an impending invasion; you have 30 days to prepare. Upgrade your shop, unlock better recipes, purchase new equipment and more!

name: Goolee
short_description: Relax and exercise your brain with challenging goolee puzzles.

name: Paragnosia
short_description: Observe every corner of your apartment by moving your camera along a rail that runs through the rooms. Find and take pictures of paranormal anomalies to exorcise them. Locked in your surveillance room, will you survive tonight's 8 rounds?

name: Stellar Rising
short_description: Embark on the difficult journey of returning the stars to the sky. Precisely control the stars, leaping from the bottom to the top of each level. Feel the sense of achievement with each successful leap, and enjoy this challenging process. Are you ready for this shining adventure?

name: Novi Blaster
short_description: Bullet Hell or Heaven? A rogue-like where you upgrade yourself and your enemies. Strategize around your build choices and dominate the battlefields of Novi Blaster.

name: Trainee Death Simulator
short_description: You will play as a Trainee Death, harvesting Souls to pay off your debt. Random choice events offer you various options: Lie in bed and slack off since the debt is endless anyway, Or follow your senior to earn some extra Souls, collecting outfits to switch up your style.

name: 8MAN-ENTRANCE
short_description: Trapped in a shrine, you must navigate by following rules: proceed unless anomalies occur, turn back if anomalies are found, and reach Hachiman. This walking simulator, inspired by exits like '8 Hachiman,' includes sound-based anomalies and mild horror elements. Playtime: 20-60 minutes.

name: Zombie Survivors - Eternal Nightfall
short_description: Zombie Survivors: Eternal Nightfall is an action-packed roguelike survival game. Battle through relentless waves of zombies while collecting powerful upgrades to stay alive. Will you outlast the eternal nightfall, or will you join the ranks of the undead? Your legacy begins now.

name: Asylum of the Forsaken
short_description: Asylum of the Forsaken is a gripping horror survival game. Play as Nathan Scott, an investigative journalist exploring the abandoned Ravenwood Asylum. Search for clues, solve dark puzzles, and avoid a relentless entity. Uncover the asylum's terrifying secrets and survive the horrors in the shadows.

name: River City Saga: Three Kingdoms Next
short_description: Get ready for River City Saga: Three Kingdoms’ finale

name: Butcherbird
short_description: 10 years have passed since a swarm of apocalyptic constructs wiped out most of humanity. Among the ashes of old Earth, a small band of survivors now find themselves with little else to do and far too much ammunition.

name: Darkfield
short_description: A person named Marc buys a house in a remote location, and strange things start happening in the house. Despite this, he continues to live there. However, as the situation persists, he decides to move out of the house.

name: Cain × Nica
short_description: 'Cain x Nica' is a post-apocalyptic story of love, sacrifice and the unbreakable human spirit. In the world of eternal winter, Cain and his little sister Nica do their best to fight the poverty and find happiness. And they'll get there, no matter what it takes. Game length - 8-10 hours.

name: Dark Hunting Ground
short_description: Hunt the monsters that swarm the Dark Hunting Ground, collect the spoils, develop your skills freely and wisely and fight to become the strongest hunter!

name: Idle Animal Plaza
short_description: Idle Animal Plaza is district management simulator.

name: Run From Mummies
short_description: Dodge traps, escape mummies, and face off against dangerous bosses in this hectic couch co-op dungeon crawler! Find hidden unlockables, try challenge modes, or kick back with lots of mini games. Play solo or with friends!

name: DUCKSIDE
short_description: Imagine DayZ or Rust but you're a duck. A persistent world survival game with PVP, PVE, crafting, base building and hat wearing ducks, wielding weapons.

name: Let's play Cards Solitaire
short_description: Let's Play Cards Solitaire is a classic single-player card game that is perfect for players of all ages.

name: 초요소녀 리리나 완전판(Choyo Girl Lilina Complete Edition)
short_description: 'Choyo Girl Lilina' is a role-playing game about the adventure story of a 15-year-old girl.

name: Chained Runes
short_description: Plan your chain of runes as well as possible, analyze your opponents, and build up an optimized deck to reach King Gormnoq. Get your brain working, Chained Runes requires a good dose of reflection, anticipation and analysis.

name: Death of the Reprobate
short_description: Explore a world built from the luscious landscapes, turbulent townscapes and preposterous portraits of real Renaissance paintings. Death of the Reprobate is a Rabelaisian adventure game from the creator of Four Last Things and The Procession to Calvary.

name: Bird Simulator 24
short_description: Take flight in Bird Simulator 24, a chaotic bird game where you reclaim your territory from humans! Soar at supersonic speeds, unleash mayhem, and poop on targets from above. Scavenge food for power-ups, unlock skins, and explore hidden secrets. Become the ultimate bird overlord!

name: Damn Zombies
short_description: First-person action survival game set in a post-apocalyptic overrun by flesh-hungry zombies. Roam a city devastated by a mysterious virus epidemi

name: Merge Together
short_description: Merge Together is a relaxing two-player puzzle game where strategic thinking, harmony, and teamwork are key. Players aim to combine sweet fruits, level by level, to achieve larger fruits and ultimately reach the final goal: the watermelon.

name: Floating with Spirits
short_description: In this cinematic virtual reality, magical stories are told by 2 young Mazatec, indigenous sisters, Jocelynne and Jaquelyne, who recall the ancestral knowledge and mystical cosmogony that their shaman grandmother used to share with them, in the misty mountains of Oaxaca, Mexico.

name: Disillusion ST
short_description: A strange journey throughout an elaborate labyrinth awaits, featuring hundreds of characters and happenings as you try to gather items that once brought happiness to others.

name: TENNISTRONIC
short_description: Increase your reflexes by hitting the ball that reaches higher speed with each bounce, and at the same time give it spin to score a goal to your opponent.

name: Clamb
short_description: A punishing VR climbing game. Climb a surreal mountain with nothing but a hammer.

name: Wilmot Works It Out
short_description: Wilmot Works It Out is a puzzle building game about completing beautiful images and using them to decorate the walls of your house.

name: Captain's Call
short_description: Captain's Call is a strategic RPG where every decision shapes your followers' future. Manage your resources, morale, followers, and treasury wisely to protect your followers and keep your settlement thriving as you face constant challenges.

name: Colony - Arena Online
short_description: Fight against rebel robots together with your friends and save planets from invasion....

name: Ruins of Dawnseeker
short_description: Awaken to a world shrouded in mystery in this captivating JRPG dungeon crawler. Follow the intertwined fates of Feriza, Layla, and Yosephine as they navigate treacherous dungeons and face formidable foes, all while piecing together the fragments of their lost memories.

name: CarGo!
short_description: CarGo! is a chaotic couch co-op for up to four players. Working as a team of couriers try to collect and deliver as many goods as possible while keeping an eye out for time, traffic and roadworks!

name: Wash the Cars
short_description: Wash the Cars is a highly entertaining and immersive game where your passion for perfection meets your love for vehicles.

name: Talisman: Digital 5th Edition
short_description: Are you ready to enter a new era of Talisman? Discover a world where every roll of the dice can lead to a new adventure in this digital adaptation of the latest edition of the iconic and beloved fantasy adventure board game.

name: Drift On Snow
short_description: Who doesn't look forward to winter as much as we do?

name: Presidential Beatdown
short_description: The Ultimate Political Party-Crasher! Presidential Beatdown is a silly local/couch 2-D multiplayer fighting game in which super-soldier Presidents battle it out for political dominance. ⚠️NOTE: This game is an unfinished work in progress. The only available fighters are Trump, Obama, and Washington.

name: A Cat & His Boy
short_description: Leif, the little boy, is feeling a bit sad since that happened. Take on the role of Midnight, the mischievous cat, and help your human friend through a rough time in his life.

name: The Fox Hare Disaster: Chapter One
short_description: Prepare to explore an abandoned mall from the 90’s in this first-person, psychological horror! Tackle puzzles and come face to face with the haunting creatures that lurk inside. Will you be able to make it out alive, or will you suffer the same fate as those who came before you…?

name: Ad SHOOt（アドシュー）
short_description: A 2D vertical scrolling bullet-hell shooter game where you shoot down fictional advertisements. Features 7 stages and full Japanese voice acting.

name: Interpret
short_description: This game is a light and fun casual game where players use the AD keys to control a trophy moving left and right at the bottom of the screen.

name: Where wh..?
short_description: 'Where Wh..?' is a Lowpoly-style point-and-click puzzle game. The goal is to find the 'differences' and hidden 'treasures' in the picture, travel through nine worlds, explore unknown areas, experience a variety of gameplay, and listen to melodious melodies.

name: Slitterhead
short_description: 'I must eliminate them...ALL...' The bodiless 'Hyoki' hunts down the brain-devouring 'Slitterheads', lurking in the alleys of a neon-lit city

name: Mindcop
short_description: Mindcop is a non-linear „whodunnit“ detective game. It mixes a story driven adventure with real-time puzzle gaming. As the infamous Mindcop, you can dive into the minds of your suspects to uncover their secrets and unravel their lies.

name: Duckiost
short_description: An exciting game in which you will find yourself in the role of a duck with a machine gun and will fight for your life.

name: Church Simulator
short_description: Manage your own church. Perform baptisms, hear confessions, collect donations, oversee weddings and funerals, sell souvenirs, and customize your church. Manage the church’s economy and work to expand your church.

name: New Battle of Shanghai Beach
short_description: Blood Battle Shanghai Beach is a shooting game! In the game, players will play the role of an anti Japanese hero named Hua Chenglong and complete a series of unlikely missions deep behind enemy lines

name: Abode: Definitive Edition
short_description: Abode: Definitive Edition is the updated edition of Abode, it is a short walking simulator horror game, you are stuck in a loop going through a small house, when horror starts happening around you.

name: Home_0
short_description: You are trapped in a memory of your past. Observe your surrounding carefully to end your nightmare.

name: Multiplayer Mummies
short_description: Multiplayer Mummies - Egypt is under attack, go get 'em! (Multiplayer or Single Player)

name: Enemy on the tail!
short_description: “Enemy on the Tail!” is a turn-based tactical dueling game about aerial combat. Choose your plane, use its unique traits, anticipate enemy moves, and attack! Or shake off enemies with clever maneuvers! Train against AI and compete with friends online. Ready for takeoff?

name: Big Trouble in Little Chimney
short_description: Krampus is Coming! Grab your Shotgun, finish your hot punch and don't forget your mission: Save the Christmas! Big Trouble in Little Chimney is highly-addictive and fast paced arena bullet-hell shooter.

name: My Final Cursed Days
short_description: My Final Cursed Days is a fantasy mix of dungeon-crawling RPG and time-management life-sim made for the Game Boy! Navigate a strange dungeon in the first-person. Fight monsters, find magic artifacts, make choices, chat with villagers! You only have so much time left after all.

name: Emberdrift
short_description: Emberdrift is a roguelike platformer focused on speed, flow, and over-the-top upgrades. Run, dash, grind, shoot, and blast your way through this uniquely andrenaline-pumping roguelike experience.

name: Beloved Rapture
short_description: Beloved Rapture is an indie jRPG inspired by the classics. Explore beautiful landscapes, fight in turn-based battles, and uncover many secrets. This mid-length adventure balances both an intimate coming of age story, and larger threats looming over the troubled kingdom.

name: Kanji Legends
short_description: Become a Legend! Dive into the world of Kanji and demonstrate your knowledge against challenging trials.

name: Vengeance Hunters
short_description: Vengeance Hunters is an adrenaline fueled Neo-Geo hardware developed beat’em’up that lets you and a friend in local co-op fight mutants, zombies, punks, gangsters, lab techs with bombs (you read that correctly), suited mystery men, cyborgs and more across multiple stages, sublevels and secret areas.

name: There's No Monsters
short_description: Have you checked under the bed? Or in the closet? We guarantee there's no monsters there!

name: Difficult times
short_description: Monsters are attacking!

name: Anti Terrorist Shooting Game
short_description: Join elite forces in this fast-paced anti-terrorist FPS. Engage in tactical gunfights, master a variety of weapons, and outsmart enemy squads in immersive multiplayer battles. Your skills, reflexes, and strategy will be crucial for survival and victory!

name: Totally Spies! - Cyber Mission
short_description: Get ready for an electrifying 2.0 adventure! The Spies are back into action in a brand-new story set in the lively city of Singapore. Brace yourself for the return of high-tech gadgets, ecstatic missions, old friends, and the signature humor of the animated series.

name: CrapShoot
short_description: Kick the crap out of them! Side-scrolling bullet-hell shooter.

name: FUEL & FURY
short_description: Smash, crush, and blast through relentless hordes in this adrenaline-fueled, apocalyptic, car driving, roguelike! In FUEL & FURY, you're behind the wheel in a frantic race against time and winter's icy grip to flee the country. Good luck survivor!

name: Werewolves 3: Evolution's End
short_description: It's the ultimate battle between werewolves and human supremacists, and your werewolf pack is caught in the middle of a four-way fight!

name: Emirati Tales
short_description: Dive into Emirati Tales, a family-friendly 3D platformer where players explore the rich folklore of the UAE while learning essential life lessons. Journey through diverse levels, face unique challenges and mythical creatures, and enjoy adaptive difficulty that suits all play styles and ages.

name: Ancient Ruins
short_description: Every choice matters!

name: Reverie
short_description: This game presents a vivid animated style where players take on the role of a kitten armed with a gun

name: Capt Crabs a Slimy Adventure
short_description: Capt Crabs, the pirate crab, was out with his crew searching for treasure on a mysterious island when suddenly his ship was taken by some mischievous slimes! Now he's on a mission to retrieve his ship and treasure and get back to the pirate life he loves!

name: Cheese - The Cheese Collector
short_description: Cheese - The Cheese Collector is a grindy clicker game. Compete against friends or the globe to have the most cheese. Unlock upgrades, choose a theme that fits you, View a user's profile and statistics.

name: Split Souls
short_description: The Player's soul has been split into 2 and it's the job of the player to get the souls back together.

name: Dreadful Night at School
short_description: A thriller set in the corridors of a high school during a sleepover. Experience a dark story where an ordinary sleepover turns into a fight for survival. Find the murderer before everyone loses their life!

name: VirusRush + Hazard of the Ages
short_description: Take control of a tiny virus that has just developed self-awareness and engage in intense battles against dangerous pathogens in a bullet-hell challenge! Embark on fast-paced action on a microscopic scale, now also through space and time!

name: Square Fishing Builder
short_description: Build the fishing village of your dreams! From classic farming RPG games comes a mix with strategy and RTS! Choose the map, build, and fish!

name: Vladimere's Lhore
short_description: A 10 year anniversary collection including 14 short games by Vladimere Lhore, plus a museum.

name: Hell Shooter
short_description: Hell Shooter is a roguelike dungeon crawler game. It features unique attack methods, exhilarating action, an oriental hellish atmosphere, and each character's storytelling.

name: Mirthwood
short_description: Embark on an enchanting journey and brave ferocious creatures in an immersive medieval fantasy world. Will you settle a new homestead to live a life of farming and trade, or pick up the sword and take up the adventurers' path?

name: Liminal Death
short_description: Liminal Death is a first person psychological horror game with liminal space environments where you will expirience what will happened when someone mind after it falls into comma and have to fight to get back to the body.

name: Single Espresso
short_description: Transform your old camper van into a thriving mobile cafe! Master coffee-making skills, customise your kitchen and serve delicious recipes as you embark on a trip around the British Isles. Live your ultimate cafe adventure in this cosy yet fast-paced barista and cafe sim - Single Espresso!

name: Roll Five
short_description: Roll Five is a thrilling dice-based roguelike. Explore a medieval fantasy map packed with deadly dangers, compose overpowered dice figures, and use your absurd luck to deal shocking damage to monsters until you free Fortuna.

name: Heart-Lung Machine
short_description: HEART-LUNG MACHINE is an intense horror game that focuses on delivering an immersive VR experience. Trapped in an abandoned underground complex, you stumble upon unspeakable horrors. To make matters worse, something is stalking you in the darkness. Hide!

name: BMX Bastards
short_description: Customize your BMX and dive into a giant open world wich include Bike Parks from all around the world waiting for you.Can't find your favorite spot? Create it by yourself in our park editor.Don't wait any longer and come to prove you're a true Rider!

name: boringFly
short_description: A turn based casual card game with a storyline that only requires the use of a mouse throughout the game. On the basis of simulating the gameplay of Lianliankan, add combat elements. At the same time, players can choose different talents and adapt to different gameplay expressions.

name: Carnival Of Souls
short_description: Embark on Carnival of Souls, a first-person, rogue lite, shooter where strategic weapon choices and upgrades are key to surviving intense battles across strange dimensions.

name: Sandbox Apocalypse
short_description: Sandbox Apocalypse is a 3rd person view, open world post-apocalyptic survial game where you are responsible for your own fate. Survive in a world inhabited by zombies, gather loot, build your base and explore the world.

name: Maxwell's puzzling demon
short_description: 'Thermodynamic' puzzle where Maxwell's demon does work of block-pushing. Deal those hot blocks with cold blocks so that the demon doesn't get burnt.

name: Elin
short_description: Successor to the roguelike RPG 'Elona'. Adventure, survival, crafting, home-building, myths passed down, and stories of humans and Elea spun. What scars will you leave on the land of Ylva?

name: The Strange Story Of Brian Fisher: Chapter 2
short_description: Brian Fisher wakes up 30 years in the past as a small child, in an unfamiliar place, with no memory of how he arrived there. He is trapped in a different dimension of time and space, and his mission is to find something hidden within this dimension of time and space and bring it back to the present.

name: IFSolitaire
short_description: Classic and simple Solitaire card game.

name: Decayed Evil
short_description: Decayed Evil is a semi realistic first person horror adventure puzzle game. Kill, his grandson seeks to unravel the mystery, only to discover that behind this dark and gloomy ancient mansion lies an unknown and terrifying truth.

name: Daemonium
short_description: Daemonium is a 1-4 player online co-op psychological horror. Demonic possessions are running rampant. Grab your equipment, join your team, locate, and remove the source of the demonic presence. Enter the portal to the demon's home and stop the possession once and for all.

name: Tales of the Uncanny
short_description: A horror game featuring standalone stories filled with eerie atmospheres and unsettling mysteries. Each chapter reveals a new, chilling narrative where your choices shape the outcomes. Dive into the unknown and embrace the uncanny.

name: Shiba Knight
short_description: [b[i]]jump Up!!!!!!! Save your Princess!!![/i][/b]Countless obstacles are waiting for you! Show your jumping and control skills!The princess is waiting for you!!!It's an action game that emphasizes jumpingDo jump action and save the princess in the last place to avoid various obstacles!!

name: VED
short_description: VED is a story-driven, hand-drawn RPG with a unique turn-based combat system and roguelite elements. Set in two different worlds, VED tells the story of Cyrus, a young hero who sets out on a quest to become a master of sword and magic, and save everything he knows from destruction.

name: Ludovischi Survivors
short_description: This is a pixel, casual game with elements of a simplified roguelike, in the genre of survival in hordes, for which you need to use bullet hell. Defeat hordes of mutant monsters. Earn solar coins for which you will pump the blessings of the Ludovischi. To defeat everyone who will stand in your way.

name: Massacre At The Mirage
short_description: For less than the price of a movie ticket, experience your very own horror-fueled slasher flick in Massacre at the Mirage. Step into The Mirage cinema and face a chilling nightmare, where staff and patrons must survive a masked killer's rampage.

name: ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS 8 REMAKE
short_description: Theater of war, infinite drama. A masterpiece of historical simulation 'ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS 8' is revived after 20 years. Enjoy the greatest military drama in the Three Kingdoms series, with the largest number of officers and scenarios!

name: Absence of Light
short_description: Embark on an epic journey in Absence of Light, an enchanting Action RPG set in the mesmerizing world of Cloudia. Unleash devastating attacks, uncover hidden secrets, and save the realm from darkness! Join the gaming community, master formidable combos, and claim your heroic destiny.

name: Elemental Realms
short_description: Element Realm is a puzzle game with a magical adventure theme. The game tells the story of a wizard's adventure to the elemental world in order to protect the world. You play as a wizard, visit different worlds, use different magic to solve massive levels.

name: 8ALLOWEEN
short_description: －Rules ・Proceed if nothing is unusual. ・Turn back if you encounter something strange. ・Aim for the exit. ◆ Walking Simulator Inspired by the 8th exit, this game requires sound for identifying anomalies. Use speakers or headphones. Contains mild horror elements. Playtime: 20-60 minutes.

name: Little Big Adventure – Twinsen’s Quest
short_description: Step into Twinsun's fantastical world in this action-adventure remake! Little Big Adventure - Twinsen's Quest brings brand new visuals, new music by the original composer, and smoother gameplay to the iconic classic released back in 1994.

name: FIND ALL 5: Vikings
short_description: Hey you, warrior! Do you want to go to MeowHalla? Then grab your axe and sail with us to new lands full of glorious battles and rich booty.

name: Creepy Shift: Roadside Diner
short_description: A broke young man takes on the night shift at a roadside diner. In the glow of the blood moon, routine tasks turn into a fight for survival. First-person horror based on a dark creepypasta with a set of rescue rules.

name: Man on the Block
short_description: 'Man on the Block' is a game where you control a man and jump down blocks that serve as scaffolding. Points are added each time you land on a block, so try to land on as many blocks as possible.

name: Farming Simulator 25
short_description: Farming Simulator 25 invites you to join the rewarding farm life, single-handedly or cooperatively in multiplayer. This Farm is Your Farm!

name: Heritage - A Dragon's Tale
short_description: Conquer 17 challenging levels in this 2D platformer adventure game, using a combination of spells, your sword, and other skills and abilities. Explore the overworld between levels, defeat demons, find secrets, and gain experience to make yourself stronger for the challenges ahead.

name: The Fear Business
short_description: A survival horror mixed with found footage elements. Unveil the secrets of a dark satanic cult and solve the Solomon Manor puzzles while hiding from the deadly Goat Face.

name: Grumpy Gaffer
short_description: Join Mr. Gaffer on his mission to protect the peace of his home in this dynamic strategy game. Test your wits and reflexes as you face intense waves of enemies, and compete in thrilling mini-games against other players.

name: Franchise Hockey Manager 11
short_description: Franchise Hockey Manager returns for the 2024-25 season with plenty of additions to the deepest, most authentic hockey strategy gaming experience you can find. Choose from teams around the globe and select a team to guide to glory, including a chance at the ultimate prize, the Stanley Cup®.

name: The Factory Must Grow
short_description: The Factory Must Grow is a 3D first-person factory builder where you mine resources, craft machines, and research tech. Begin by unlocking your first technology, then expand into a sprawling, multi-layered production empire. From small setups to massive systems, your imagination is the only limit!

name: Souno's Curse
short_description: Embark on a short and emotional journey through a cursed cave in this 2D hand-drawn platformer with action and metroidvania elements. Uncover a touching story about regrets and the value of living the moment

name: 大鹏 - The Roc
short_description: Due to work, Wu Shengyou was forced to leave home for high school in a big city. The sensitive, introverted poet felt out of place with classmates.As they grew closer, he seemed her only friend, yet appeared to completely misunderstand her inner thoughts...

name: Oryks
short_description: 2D platform game inspired by the Halloween atmosphere like in Tim Burton's films. In the game, we conduct conversations, solve investigations, move left and right, jump and shoot to defeat enemies, we also interact with the environment. We also make decisions that affect the course of the mission.

name: Beastieball
short_description: A turn-based volleyball RPG where you coach a sports team of Beasties! Your Beasties' relationships grow and change, unlocking new abilities and combo plays!

name: 雾之大陆(TheLandOfFog)
short_description: Game type: turn based strategy action bar mode Rich plot, diverse skills, players play as several mercenaries, use strategies to challenge various levels, gradually unravel the fog of the Mist Continent, and complete their legends

name: Backyard Baseball '97
short_description: Rediscover the joy of the original Backyard Baseball 1997, now updated for modern systems! Build your roster from among the iconic Backyard Kids, aim for those home runs, and various game modes. Relive the magic of this classic baseball game!

name: Georgie-Yolkie
short_description: Georgie-Yolkie is an all-new purrfect open-world platformer and collectathon! With huge, beautiful worlds, meet an unforgettable cast of silly characters as buddy-duo Georgie (The cat guy) and Yolkie (The yellow bird) embark on an epic, funny adventure to thwart the evil King Rattie!

name: BeyondThere
short_description: Beyond There is an immersive first-person horror game where you explore the eerie house of a missing friend. As you uncover dark secrets and confront terrifying encounters, your sanity will be tested. Can you uncover the truth behind their disappearance, or will the house consume you too?

name: Snake Classic 3D Reborn
short_description: Dive into Snake Classic 3D Reborn! This exciting snake simulator features vibrant 3D graphics and three unique maps filled with challenges. Collect blocks to grow your snake, unlock various skins, and compete for the highest score.

name: Echoes Of The House
short_description: Christopher arrives at his grandmother's countryside home late at night for a seemingly ordinary visit. But soon after reuniting, he begins to notice something isn't right. The familiar setting warps into a place of unease, and the mystery that unravels is far more complex than anyone could expect.

name: After Midnight
short_description: Open-world, online multiplayer ghost hunting game that plunges you into a vast and eerie world filled with haunted locations waiting to be discovered. Whether you're braving the darkness alone or teaming up with friends, your mission is to identify the terrifying entities lurking within this world.

name: Agora Project
short_description: Agora Project is a short first-person horror game, Walking Simulator. You play as Mary, an 18-year-old girl who is going to a party with their friends. Little did she know who was driving her to the party.

name: ToriDori 2
short_description: TORIDORI 2 is the wonderful world of a photographer who is able to capture his dreams in the photo, but he can only take 2 shots per dream. The differences of some details will be the difference between these two shots. Carefully explore every corner and enjoy the game.

name: LEGO® Horizon Adventures™
short_description: Join machine hunter Aloy as she leads a colourful crew of heroes on a quest to save the world and learn the secrets of her past. Dive into boundless adventure, customize to your heart’s content, and take on action-packed battles solo or with friends.

name: Haunted Halloween
short_description: Experience Halloween in this 1-4 player co-op game! Traverse eerie haunted attractions, solve puzzles, evade sinister entities as you try to escape together.

name: Dark Skies 2: Keepers of Nemansk
short_description: A whole new Journey in Nemansk awaits you! 5 Years after the Nemansk Incident you enter the Area as a young Mercenary named Dima. Experience a whole new Story set in the fictional Nemansk Region and explore dangerous new environments!

name: Dog And Goblin
short_description: Dog and Goblin is an auto-battler Roguelike deck-building strategy game where you assemble a mixed army to stand against humans. With nearly 150 units across 19 different types, build your ultimate army and conquer their castles!

name: Professor Doctor Jetpack
short_description: Professor Doctor Jetpack is a physics based lunar lander game, in which you embark on a dangerous journey to ... control your jetpack. Also to save the world.

name: Neko Times: Purrfect Shapes
short_description: 'Neko Times: Purrfect Shapes' is a relaxing, feel-good puzzle game where you organize cute, quirky cats into grids. With 80 delightful levels, charming visuals, and soothing gameplay, it's the perfect way to unwind while having fun!

name: Pool 2
short_description: Gather your friends and get ready for a chaotic twist on pool! No more waiting for your turn, each player controls a cue ball, and shots are taken in real-time! Play up to 4 players on wacky pool tables in this physics-based party game!

name: No Heroes Here 2
short_description: A group of non-adventurers is the last hope in defending the castle in this chaotic co-op tower defense game with roguelike features. With up to 4 players, your party must organize the castle, work as a team to craft ammo, and shoot at enemies to protect your kingdom!

name: Mother's Home
short_description: Mother’s Home is a psychological horror game. The player is left alone at home while their mother is taken to the hospital. Sarah soon finds out she is not alone, and her mother is back inside the house.

name: Divine Dynamo Flamefrit
short_description: 'Divine Dynamo Flamefrit' is bringing back classic 2D action! Play as the hero Yuto in top-down slashing adventure stages, and pilot the magical robot Flamefrit for first-person boss battles! Master both styles of gameplay to restore peace to the parallel world of Hologard!

name: Tic Tac Toe World
short_description: Jump into the world of Tic Tac Toe World and have endless fun. Enjoy the colorful art style and challenging A.I. while enjoying this classic game.

name: SPACEUM
short_description: You're stranded on SPACEUM, a sprawling space base with a deadly alien parasite hiding in the shadows. To escape, you’ll need every ounce of energy you can find. Can you crack the code to freedom, or will you face down the monster that stands in your way? How far will you go to make it out alive?

name: Autocraft
short_description: Autocraft is a game where you will be playing as a mighty champion that can collect loot.. as well as enchant his shield with bonus gems found around.

name: Planet Scanner
short_description: Scan the stars and claim planets for your corporate masters! In Planet Scanner, you will discover unique new worlds, decode transmissions, and upload data all in the name of keeping your job. But what happens if you gaze too long in the void?

name: Musicmenia
short_description: Musicmenia is a strategic and musical card game. Face off online against other players, build your deck, and adapt your strategy to win. Adjust the tempo and lead your concert to victory!

name: Vasilisa and Baba Yaga
short_description: An adventure game based on the Russian folktale 'Vasilisa the Beautiful'. A scary story about the journey to the mistress of the forbidden forest for magical powers.

name: Airborne Justice
short_description: Airborne Justice is a shoot 'em up that pays homage to classics from the golden age of video games. Take control of a helicopter, fight enemies, and restore peace to the skies!

name: Everholm
short_description: Lilly was spirited away to a mysterious island. As her memories fade, everyone seems to know her and her quest for her missing sister. It’s time to establish a homestead, meet your friendly Everfolks, then learn their secrets and solve the mystery of Everholm, in this open-ended minimalist RPG!

name: Скуфы против ящеров
short_description: A game in which you really look like the main character!

name: LightRay | Wayfinder
short_description: LightRay | Wayfinder is a top down logic puzzle game in a peaceful setting, that features a plenty of Puzzles that utilize Lasers and Wayfinders which interact with your solution and the puzzle.

name: 暗色战争(Dark Conflict)
short_description: Welcome to 'Dark Conflict'! This is a game full of strategy and war elements, allowing you to play as a leader, constructing buildings, assembling armies, and developing resources to compete for the glory of victory.

name: Bible Jigsaw Puzzle
short_description: Bible Jigsaw Puzzle offers a relaxing and uplifting experience as you piece together biblical scenes. Challenge yourself and climb the rankings to compete with friends and players worldwide, while exploring the beauty of the Holy Scriptures.

name: Pet Cam
short_description: Arya living a peaceful life by day, but each night, an eerie phone call from her father haunts her sleep. One night, the call turns into a nightmare, unraveling a terrifying story about her past. Can you uncover the truth before it consumes you?

name: Cube Jumper VR
