short_description: Cube Jumper VR is a fast-paced, immersive VR platformer where you leap across a world of cubes, avoiding deadly lava. Collect diamonds and resources while mastering the game modes: Free Play, Time Attack, and Shooter, where you fend off enemies like spiders and drones.

name: Dead Oculus
short_description: Dead Oculus is a lethal, fast-paced bullet-hell that fuses arcade and roguelike elements. Brutalise your foes in gauntlets of handcrafted arenas by wielding deadly weapons with cataclysmic augments.

name: Simulation
short_description: Try and make as much money as you are able to or grow the biggest community you can, there is so much possibility in here to have fun. Manage them, give them tasks or put them to rest as the community grows bigger in this retro-styled management/simulation game.

name: 7 Ate 9
short_description: Why was 6 afraid of 7? And why did 7 resort to cannibalism? Its your job as detective number 9 to find out what happened in this case of murder by numbers. 7 Ate 9 is a small horror adventure with a lot of secrets to uncover and multiple endings to find.

name: Endless Life
short_description: This game is a captivating puzzle platformer where players control a string of three square blocks that leap over gaps by pressing the space bar.

name: Good Kill!
short_description: Good Kill is an immersive FPS game where players take control of a door gunner in a military helicopter during the Vietnam War. Engage in intense combat across destructible environments, complete missions, and upgrade your helicopter and weapons to dominate the battlefield.

name: Hare 136
short_description: Drag adorable coin-riding rabbits and slide them across the board. Solve engaging cozy puzzles. Help our little fluffy friends get back to their home!

name: Rogue Tanks
short_description: Blast through random levels of enemies with or against up to 3 of your friends in this action roguelike top-down shooter! Travel from the desert to the enemy base and...into space!? Upgrade with quicker firing, bouncing bullets, and more. Defeat huge bosses to unlock more tank classes!

name: Aeonic
short_description: Aeonic is a text based adventure where you will travel through all of human history by being presented with decisions to choose from to solve the problems of the short stories set in the various featured time periods.

name: Echoes of Dread
short_description: Echoes Of Dread is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore the mansion, solve puzzles, and uncover the secrets hidden within. Prepare for unexpected encounters with terrifying entities.

name: Riot Operator
short_description: The Riot Police need great operators like you. Protect the peace in real places and manifestations. Your ability, perception, and skills will be tested. Control the Uncontrollable!

name: Try Dying
short_description: A PvP party game where your goal is to DIE FIRST! Choose your cutest water dragon and hang out with your friends in a noose, catch knives and hug dynamite. But don't forget to stop your buddies who try dying!

name: 酒馆战争
short_description: 经典军团自走棋来了，这是一款多人PVP策略游戏，融入了类Rogue和自走棋元素。玩家需要为自动战斗的军团搭配合适的英雄指挥官,神器和法术，最终击败所有玩家夺得冠军

name: Paper Ghost Stories: Third Eye Open
short_description: Third Eye Open is a supernatural narrative adventure about a young girl coming of age. The game is set in a small Malaysian suburb which the player navigates to speak to friends, families, and ghosts. Various minigames immerse the player deeper into the protagonist's journey.

name: Super Blockbuster
short_description: Super Blockbuster is a retro action-puzzle game. Kick blocks to solve tricky puzzles and take on a diverse cast of enemies, all in gorgeous pixel art, inspired by the golden age of 2D puzzle games.

name: PowerCharge
short_description: Take to the stars in PowerCharge, a revolutionary new card game. Assemble your crew of over 100 possible cards. Position your workers strategically on the board to combo with beacons you place. Increase your power and deal massive damage to your enemy all at once. Will your crew rule the galaxy?

name: Fatal Midnight
short_description: At night, Dan woke up from unusual sounds coming from the depths of the house. Concerned about his sister, he decides to check on her. Entering her room, he discovers that she has disappeared. Fear confronts him, and he begins to rush around the house in search of her.

name: MeiQi 2024
short_description: Meiqi Mystery 2024 is a narrative puzzle game and the latest installment in the MeiQi series. Liu Qingchun, the bureau chief, personally takes charge of investigating the cases of the 403 Intelligence Division. This season presents you with six unique cases to solve.

name: The Last of the 9 Lives
short_description: Leap through an endless series of platforms as a nimble cat, racing to stay ahead of the ever-rising water. Collect milk and fish for bonus points while mastering precise jumps in this challenging infinite jumper. A throwback to simpler times. How long can you jump for before the water catches up?

name: Bloody Rune
short_description: Turn-based single-stroke drawing roguelike deck-building game. Draw and use various runes to defeat all enemies and win the Rune War.

name: LandFall Survival
short_description: Landfall is a thrilling low-poly co-op dungeon crawler and extraction game. Build and upgrade your base, trade with vendors, and team up to explore diverse maps, complete quests, gather loot, and defeat bosses. Gear up, survive, and thrive together in this unique low-poly PvE adventure.

name: Two Falls (Nishu Takuatshina)
short_description: Explore 17th century Canadian wilderness through the eyes of Jeanne, a French woman who crossed the Atlantic to start anew and Maikan, an Innu hunter trying to discover what’s disturbing the forest. Your choices will shape the traits of the protagonists in this narrative single-player experience.

name: Dziedzic: Księga pytań bez odpowiedzi
short_description: Zlot rodzinny to dla Miłosza Dajskiego okazja, aby spotkać się z dawno niewidzianymi członkami rodziny. Przechadzając się po pałacu, w którym nie było go od lat napotyka człowieka, który zdaje się twierdzić, że jest jego kuzynem, ten jednak za nic nie potrafi go sobie przypomnieć.

name: 玩仔的冒险
short_description: Choose your skills, combine your equipment, match them with unexpected combinations and enjoy the joy of mowing grass. playgus is a survival-like game. Players will be free to take risks in a relaxed and pleasant style.

name: Game Dev Fantasy
short_description: Join the adventure of game development while sailing the seas with your indie studio! Use your wits and strategy to complete development tasks, learn new skills, and launch your game before the deadline. With the sea breeze on your face, you're all set to create an amazing game!

name: Lost Eidolons: Veil of the Witch
short_description: From the world of 'Lost Eidolons' comes an all-new roguelite tactical RPG! Stranded on a mysterious island with scattered memories, your only means of survival is to fight. Recruit allies, undertake a perilous journey, and battle to reclaim what you've lost... no matter how many deaths it takes.

name: Palm Simulator
short_description: Palm Simulator is a game in which you can become a palm tree.

name: Avenir Tower
short_description: JUMP, FALL, AND JUMP AGAIN.

name: 水浒群侠传
short_description: The Legend of the Heroes of the Water Margin is an ancient Chinese RPG game based on Shi Naian's novel Water Margin, in which players can have adventures with some of Shi Naian's characters from the protagonist's point of view. This only to understand the purpose of the protagonist is to find.

name: Ricochet Rodeo
short_description: Saddle up for Ricochet Rodeo, a 2D-platform, pvp brawl to see who's the fastest shooter in the pixel-rendered west. Assemble a posse of up to 8 cowboys to dance in chaotic deathmatches where bullets bounce and 1 hit kills.

name: beyond.frontiers
short_description: beyond.frontiers is a vast space exploration game. Pilot over 20 ships across 125+ handcrafted and procedural sectors. Customize the game with extensive modding, and dive into fully voiced storylines. Explore, trade, or fight—endless adventures await in the expansive universe of Beyond.Frontiers.

name: Dragon Age™: The Veilguard
short_description: Unite the Veilguard and defy the gods in Dragon Age™: The Veilguard, an immersive single-player RPG where you become the leader others believe in.

name: 赛博杀手 Cyberkiller2049
short_description: Cyberkiller 2049 is a platform-action fast-paced game that battles numerous enemies on destructible platforms. Manipulate the character, kill with one hit, sprint, kill enemies. Picking up bats, remote-controlled bombs. Fight enemies with different abilities.

name: Empire of the Ants
short_description: Conquer enemy nests and lead your colony through the perils of the forest in this groundbreaking RTS. Empire of the Ants is a photorealistic, third-person real-time strategy game where you command your insect legions in epic battles.

name: Rescue Girl Operation: Code X
short_description: Take up arms to drive away the mutated zombies and save the beautiful girls!

name: Drive Thru Miami
short_description: A simulation of running and expanding a drive-thru shop where players take orders, prepare various beverages and foods, manage supplies, and serve customers efficiently.

name: Graveyard Gunslingers
short_description: Shoot hordes of zombies in a bullet hell roguelite arena. By day, harvest resources, unlock map areas, and prepare for the upcoming night. Craft unique strategies by combining characters, weapons, and exploring a vast ability tree.

name: Maniac Path 3
short_description: Go into the abyss of madness to go through the difficult path of a broken beast that spares no one

name: Glingdom
short_description: In 'Glingdom,' you're a hero in a medieval world, battling enemies and bosses with a deck of cards. Beat enemy waves and bosses, buy cards to strengthen your deck, and unlock new cards. Each deck offers unique challenges.

name: Ritual Night
short_description: Summon Cthulhu in this social deduction game with no early eliminations! Monsters work together to complete the ritual, while stealthy humans secretly sabotage and cause chaos.

name: Support
short_description: After sending several probes to a certain planet, all contact was lost, so an exploration team was sent to investigate, but they fell into an unknown struggle.

name: Seven Cities
short_description: Dive into Seven Cities, a colorfull explosive action RPG set in a near-future New York. Customize your hero with modern weapons and skills. Explore seven unique districts, blending reality with digital chaos, and uncover the secrets behind the city's division.

name: Time's Prison
short_description: A pirate who is burning with love for treasure finally finds the treasure island on the map. However, the pirate has puzzles to solve and adventures to go through. The story of the game starts right here.

name: Rusty's Day Off: Episode One - Janitor on Duty
short_description: Rusty's Day Off is a stylized FPS with puzzle elements in which you play as Rusty, a janitor, facing his own rogue robots. You'll have to fight, solve puzzles, and jump & run all over the place to get through this day.

name: Go! Chicken Jump!
short_description: Become the best chicken rope jumping king in the world!

name: Mortality
short_description: This game takes place against a pure white background, with black columns positioned at the top and bottom, creating a simple yet challenging environment.

name: Shattered Truth
short_description: Explore a mysterious house filled with terrifying secrets. Armed with only a gun and flashlight, search for clues, survive dangerous encounters, and unravel the shocking truth behind the eerie silence in The Shattered Truth.

name: Jill O' Lantern: Final Cut
short_description: Find the clues to make a time bending turnabout in this off the rails visual novel about murder, mayhem, and a thicc pumpkin girl with a machete.

name: Psychopathy Assessment
short_description: Psychopathy Assessment is a retro-80s V.H.S PS1 style analog horror game that blurs the line between reality and delusion. Step into a universe where you're not just playing a game; you're taking a psychopathy test, but the stakes are considerably higher than a straightforward diagnosis.

name: Scribe
short_description: Scribe is a scribe simulator in which you can secretly shape the destinies of the inhabitants of the estate: resolve disputes, influence the course of family intrigues, decide who lives and who does not. Choose what to write in letters and whether to change their recipients!

name: Late Homework | 遅れた宿題
short_description: Highschool student Haneko has forgotten her class assignments and must retrieve them by traversing a world of haunted horrors. Explore the dilapidated halls, find your missing homework, and avoid whatever's lurking around the corner in this bite-sized, retro survival horror experience.

name: The Dark Mind
short_description: Locked in Jessica's endless hallucinations. Carefully observe your surroundings to guide her back to reality. An Unreal Engine 5 short horror hidden object game.

name: VHS: Recovered Tapes
short_description: Discovered VHS tapes of truly horrifying experiences, immerse yourself into the tapes and experience the fear of escaping unworldly demons. This experience is not for the lighthearted, as the only way out is to escape.

name: Aldoria
short_description: Explore your way through the dangerous fantasy land of Aldoria where a single hit will kill you! Slay monsters and collect magical abilities in this small skill-testing metroidvania.

name: NineHells
short_description: Ninehells is a psychological horror first person single player, with an unraveling mystery, enriched with voice acting, and has virtual haunted attraction feeling. You play as Davie a man trying to remember his past while traveling though Hell. Play and find out what in the ninehells is going on!

name: Miami Fighters
short_description: Unleash the chaos in Miami Fighters! Engage in fast-paced fights with power-ups and diverse arenas. Easy to pick up, hard to master. Every player has a chance to win. Challenge your friends and claim victory!

name: Stronghold Defenders
short_description: Gather and manage resources, defend your stronghold, explore and expand your kingdom and fight back against corruption.

name: D-Day VR Museum
short_description: Experience the best of both worlds with a unique blend of a traditional museum and immersive exploration of the iconic places in Normandy on D-Day in Virtual Reality!

name: DAEMON MASQUERADE
short_description: An anime-inspired supernatural detective game. Uncover the identities and powers of your adversaries using a conspiracy board full of evidence.

name: Junk Blocks
short_description: This is a relaxing and casual puzzle elimination game. Drag blocks onto the board to fill rows or columns and clear them. Watch out for 'junk' blocks that obstruct progress and require match-three combos to remove. Use your skills to achieve high scores and test your mental limits!

name: Minesweeper & Dungeon RPG - 扫雷与地下城
short_description: A unique RPG that combines minesweeping and rogue-like gameplay. Players explore the game world using classic minesweeper mechanics, collecting coins and treasure chests. By building up their skills, equipment, and items, they enhance their power. Can you complete the game?

name: Your wife oh
short_description: Your wife. His wife. Whose wife? Everybody's wife! Want to raise a wife of your own? Just play with it! Wanna dance? The pas de deux kind. Just play it!Anyone who doesn't have a wife should report~

name: Project Starcrash
short_description: Use your powerful punches to defeat alien invaders in this side-scrolling action platformer.

name: Necromancer's Revenge
short_description: Summon the Dark Lord for revenge! This game combines survival and roguelite elements, where you summon monsters and place totems to defeat monsters and take down the Dark Lord!

name: Don't Wake Grandpa
short_description: In 'Don't Wake Grandpa,' survive 5 nights managing threats like Stunna Boy and Jim Jim while preventing Grandpa from waking. Fix the malfunctioning TV, balance limited resources like batteries and bananas, and use quick reflexes to stop enemies from disrupting Grandpa’s sleep.

name: Lucky Farm
short_description: On this tranquil island, you will manage your own farm. Grow crops, build facilities, and sell products to earn rent and drive farm growth. Accumulate wealth to purchase permanent land use rights and become the true owner of the farm.

name: Halloween Stories: Inspiration's Spark Collector's Edition
short_description: A literature professor is recruited to help a master of horror!

name: Ski Patrol
short_description: Immerse yourself in a massive open-world ski resort while tackling objectives such as rescuing injured skiers, mitigating avalanche hazards, and finding hidden locations. Use realistic ski techniques such as parallel turns and hockey stops to navigate freely through the rugged mountain wilderness.

name: PRIZE ANIMALS
short_description: 'PRIZE ANIMALS' is a casual action game in which players collect cute animals with a crane. You can hook the crane's claws into the ring, or go for the antlers and tails. Would you like to collect over 50 different animals in a way that only you can?

name: Softie
short_description: Softie is a short creepy (but cute!) point-and-click adventure game. Take on the role of a cuddly teddy bear trying to find their lost owner in a peculiar house.

name: Warlords Battle Simulator
short_description: Test your mettle as a commander in a Tactical Roguelike Auto Battler where positioning and unit combinations are key! Write your own story in Roguelike mode, try out over 100 unique challenges or create interesting battles with the Sandbox tool!

name: Archaeology - Post-Apocalypse
short_description: A game of the genre find the hidden object.

name: NEON Squad Tactics
short_description: An electrifying turn-based tactics experience where you, your friends and online allies work together to complete missions for the powerful corporations using a captivating holographic table, projecting part of your consciousness into a cybernetic team of heroes called 'NEON Squad'.

name: PopSlinger Vol. 2 - Loveless
short_description: Return to the PopSlinger universe in this coffee-fueled sequel! Join an elite agent and a digital idol on a mission to rescue a lost heroine in a world full of vibrant chaos. Face new enemies, uncover the mysteries of the Purple District, and groove to a freshly brewed beat!

name: Cone Flyers Mercenaries
short_description: Welcome to Cone Flyers Mercenaries! Fight many dangerous enemies, delve into deep dungeons, and pilot your cone ship with precision platforming and a unique combat system in this tough as nails bullet hell.

name: Hidden Oddities
short_description: Hidden Oddities is a cosy Hidden object game where you search in the nooks and crannies across lush miniature landscapes, it's amazing what you might find in some of the oddest of places

name: Love Me or Die
short_description: Yuki, a lonely teenager, embarks on a desperate quest for popularity and fame. But her path soon turns into a dark and tragic journey that will change her life forever. A retro graphic adventure with challenging puzzles, intense tweet battles, and a pixelated world filled with humor and mysteries.

name: Messticulous
short_description: Aim and throw incongruous objects to create an organized mess by following the directives of a completely wacky 'tidy up' system!

name: 扭扭乐(Twist Logic)
short_description: Hundreds of Levels Await Your Exploration

name: Globalism
short_description: A global strategy for the 21st century. The threat of nuclear war, economic inequality, overpopulation of some regions and extinction of other regions, the crisis of capitalism... Find your solutions to the current problems of mankind!

name: Do you have SALT?
short_description: A girl named Anastasia, who lives in an old multi-story building, decides to leave her apartment. She goes to get some salt to ask her neighbors and find a treasure hidden in this house. But what kind of treasure is this, and is it worth looking for?

name: VHScape
short_description: You find yourself trapped in a haunted VHS rental store, can you survive their twisted games and escape?

name: Last Vanguard
short_description: Explore a stunning hand-craft world ravaged by war and ruled by an evil tyrant. Face a wide variety of enemies as you customize your strategy, change your weapons and unlock different abilities.

name: The Memory Machine
short_description: In this interactive story set in a world where memories are a source of energy, Arthur must help the townspeople reclaim their past. Along the way he will befriend talking vegetables, explore a magical forest, and uncover the town’s mysterious history.

name: The Great Tree
short_description: The Great Tree is a building game where you choose how to grow each branch of your tree, maintain enough resources to continue growing and reach higher and higher.

name: CatMelon - Suika Game
short_description: Combine several adorable cats dressed as fruits inside their favorite playing space: the cardboard box! Match two identical cats to create an increasingly larger cat until you reach the CatMelon. Develop your best strategy to remain at the top of the ranking!

name: Сквозь завесу
short_description: A horror game in which the line between madness and reality is blurred.

name: Neo Harbor Rescue Squad
short_description: Live the life of a rookie paramedic through frantic minigame action and a wild, funny story. Juggle waves of patients with a battle-like triage system; master dozens of treatment minigames; and win the city's recognition from the rival fire department!

name: 封神
short_description: 游戏以周朝开国丞相姜子牙的视角展开。从他受师命下山辅助明君开始，一路作战，最终推翻残暴的商王朝，完成封神大任。

name: Doge Head Attack
short_description: Transcends mere platforming—it’s an adventure that captures the essence of excitement surrounding Memecoins. Featuring charismatic characters and captivating artistic design, each jump brings you closer to victory and reveals the unlimited potential of Doge Head Coin.

name: The Smurfs – Dreams
short_description: The fate of the Smurf Village rests in your dreams: dive into a fantastic journey to save it in this fully immersive and magical 3D platformer!

name: Temporal Purge: Z
short_description: Become an interdimensional zombie slayer in Temporal Purge: Z, an action-packed zombie-survival FPS. Face the zombie onslaught as you eradicate countless undead monsters on your quest to save the future.

name: World of Unlit
short_description: World of Unlit is a fast paced, first person movement shooter where your goal is to utilize your grapple hook, melee weapons, guns and bows to destabilize a culture.

name: Tetris® Forever
short_description: Celebrate 40 years of Tetris® with 15+ games, a new game, and documentary videos

name: Desert Kingdoms 2
short_description: Conquer the desert in this minimal real-time strategy game. Manage settlements with resources, develop villages, protect the king and take control of the desert!

name: Mining And Achievements 挖矿与成就
short_description: Mining and getting Steam achievements, this is a casual idle game. Players travel to a world where mining is king. As long as you mine day and night, you can dominate the world; unlock powerful weapons and creatures, and let them join your mining army!

name: Cursed Toy
short_description: It is a psychological horror game and walking simulator. Monsters jumping towards at your screen. Do housework. You get haunted by a monsters.

name: Recoil Rush
short_description: Recoil Rush is a fast-paced movement shooter where your weapon’s recoil is your only means of movement. Master the art of propulsion as you blast through over 40 challenging levels in the single-player mission mode and go head to head against other players in multiplayer.

name: REAPER
short_description: YOU ARE DEATH. The Grim Reaper. You must travel throughout various action packed scenarios, Reaping enemies and collecting their souls. FEAR THE REAPER

name: Hidden Cats - Haunted Mansion
short_description: Dive into the enchanting world of 'Hidden Cats - Haunted Mansion' a hidden object game where your mission is to uncover every cat hidden within stunning hand-painted artwork. Let your keen eye and curiosity guide you through this captivating journey.

name: Standoff Beat
short_description: Standoff Beat is a fast-paced rhythm/duel gun game where quick thinking and decision-making are your best weapon. Match the beat, outwit your opponent, and shoot them down before they do. Timing is everything. Are you ready to face the music and win the standoff?

name: House of Dred
short_description: In this horror game, you play as a young woman returning from work. Running low on gas, you pull into a gas station, but there's no gas to be found. Something feels off, and a sense of unease creeps in as you realize you might not be alone.

name: Elder Legacy: Survival
short_description: Elder Legacy: Survival is a fun cooperative open-world survival game where you and your friends will find ways to defeat bosses and progress through biomes together.

name: Breakthru
short_description: Imprisoned without a fair trial, it is up to Silas Nanashiel to escape together with the help of other inmates and save her elder sister Leila from receiving a fatal punishment.

name: Kindred [Subject 6244]
short_description: In this eerie, horror visual novel, you are confined in a room with a monster. How will you fare against petrifying odds? Will you be able to work your way into the mind of an indecipherable beast, or will you be added to the casualty count? A word of advice: Choose a side; don't look back.

name: Celestis
short_description: Celestis is a real-time strategy game where the goal is to take control of the procedural galaxy by capturing stars.

name: EGG RAIDERS
short_description: EGG RAIDERS is a cooperative horror game where four players work together to infiltrate an area teeming with aggressive monsters. You must survive for three days, gather valuable loot, and escape before more monsters come after you. Teamwork and strategy are the keys to success!

name: Escape From Infection Zone
short_description: Escape the zombie infected zone, using an arsenal of weapons, in this arena shooter game.

name: Falco Xolon
short_description: Collect plasma to fuel your weapons, as every shot counts.

name: Don't Be Afraid 2
short_description: Descend deep into the nightmare that seamlessly blends with reality in this uncanny horror escape room game. Can you find your way out of the horrid mansion or will you succumb to your fears? Can you face and overcome your past, or will it break you?

name: 江湖宝鉴
short_description: 《江湖宝鉴》是一款武侠题材，带有轻度肉鸽元素的文字冒险游戏。你将扮演一位初出茅庐的少年，踏上游历江湖的艰险旅程。是一心向善，带领村民抵抗山贼侵扰，成为一代大侠；还是落草为寇，卷入山贼寨子中的阴谋诡计，杀出一片天地；抑或是访仙问道，遁入山林逍遥自在，都在你的一念之中。

name: SULFUR
short_description: SULFUR is a modern old-school action-adventure: Outsmart enemies, find treasure, improve weapons, harness powers. Delve deeper, find answers, make it end.

name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate
short_description: TMNT Splintered Fate - Unleash the Turtles in a rogue-like quest to rescue Splinter from the Foot Clan! Master ninja skills, unite in bodacious co-op gameplay, and conquer iconic NYC locales.

name: Hotelnomaly
short_description: Hotelnomaly is an endless loop anomaly hunt game where you play as a mechanic hired to fix an elevator in a lonely 1930s hotel. Discover eerie anomalies, navigate haunted corridors, and uncover dark secrets. Could you finish your job and escape safely?

name: The Pirate's Casino
short_description: Gamble and sail through adventures in The Pirate's Casino! Experience 5 unique games, conquer 10 challenging parkour maps, and become the ultimate pirate gambler! You can move around in casino and play whichever game you like. Good luck! You will need it...

name: Oh no, orcs!
short_description: Oh no, orcs! is a pixel art archery shooter in which the player needs to stop hordes of orcs that will try to destroy the main gate and invade the fort.

name: Nest
short_description: Defend your base from enemies that come every day as much as you can.

name: Putrid Beasts
short_description: Care for the dogs, raise them for the ritual, and fend off twisted feral ones. Battle attack dogs and grow food to feed the pack. Can you escape the cycle of sacrifice or will you be trapped forever in this icy nightmare? Engage in explosive fishing, decorate homes, and fight for your freedom.

name: Insight
short_description: Insight is a single-player horror story game shrouded in mystery. You'll take control of different characters to solve crimes and unveil the dark secrets behind them.

name: Perfect Teams
short_description: Perfect Teams is a Rogue Like deckbuilder in which you have to assemble a team of three characters, each one with unique cards and unique powers, to explore different universes and fight the corruption caused by the fusion. What will be your Perfect Team ?

name: Gravity Force
short_description: Gravity Force puts you into the seat of a drone pilot. Steer your spaceship through narrow caves (2.5D) to fulfill your job: locate and retrieve cargo crates without wrecking the ship. The minimalistic controls and realistic physics are easy to learn, but hard to master.

name: Critical Fishing
short_description: Take part in wormkinds heroic struggle for freedom from their archnemesis. Upgrade your arsenal, tools and submarine to decimate the fish population to reach the ultimate goal: to boldly go where no worm has gone before.

name: CatTrio
short_description: A physics puzzle game in which you have to put cats in a pot and match them!　Aim for a high score!

name: Diced Up!
short_description: Survive as long as you can in an endless bullet hell with randomized stats and weapons.

name: Tower Factory
short_description: Tower Factory is a tower defense and automation game with roguelite elements. Optimize resource production using conveyor systems while defending against monster waves. Can you find and destroy the enemy tower before it's too late?

name: Cascadia
short_description: Compete to create the most perfect ecosystem in the award-winning board game journey!

name: Find Charlie
short_description: Find 40 little Charlies in an interactive cartoon world. Some can be spotted by careful obersavation. For others, you need to interact with the world and solve a few puzzles.

name: POGOMAN
short_description: POGOMAN is a fast-paced physics platformer where you navigate tough, nerve-wracking levels on a pogostick. Master cool maneuvers, unlock abilities, and survive intense challenges as you bounce through unique biomes. Precision and timing are everything. Oh, and don`t get hit in the head.

name: Food Rush
short_description: It's time for the Food Rush! Customize your very own restaurant to your liking, provide fast service and get high streaks of customers served for some extra cash! Hire staff to keep your franchise running and manage your ever-increasing upkeep and other financial matters. Oh.. and rush that food!

name: House Hopper
short_description: JUMP, FALL, CRACK, REPEAT! This stress inducing golf-like 3D platformer will push your resolve to the limit. Climb through super-hard levels, solve puzzles, unlock hidden playable objects! Beat your highscores! Is the game too hard? GET BETTER!

name: Afterlight Catacombs
short_description: Afterlight Catacombs is a horror exploration game in which you attempt to escape a procedurally-generated labyrinth while a mysterious stalker chases you in the dark. Explore the winding tunnels, learn the secret about this dungeon and, above all, do not let your torch run out!

name: Idyllic cats: japan
short_description: You love cats, right? Then team up with up to 4 friends or search for them alone in colorful Japan! They will run away and hide in new places. Will you find them all?

name: Dr. Yaga Lost House
short_description: Dr. Yaga Lost House is a scary first-person game where you play as a Video Content Creator exploring an old, creepy house. Dr. Yaga used to live here, and many strange things happened. Your job is to find out what happened and try to escape safely.

name: The Rise of the Golden Idol
short_description: The Award-winning detective saga returns in this standalone sequel to The Case of the Golden Idol. Uncover the truth behind 20 strange cases of crime, death and depravity in the 1970s. The world has changed dramatically - the sins of humanity have not.

name: Отделение 38
short_description: После неожиданной смерти студент Александр попадает в 'Отделение 38', где бюрократия переплетается с мистикой. Раскройте тайны этого потустороннего мира и найдите ответы, которые изменят всё.

name: Pantomime
short_description: Pantomime is an immersive collection of interactive story-driven games designed to make learning English an epic adventure. Every choice you make deepens your language skills and unravels new paths in these captivating, dynamic worlds.

name: Great Adventure: Alice's wonderland
short_description: Build your deck of cards, defeat your enemies.

name: Storybook of Tactics
short_description: Storybook of Tactics is a rogue-lite auto battler with deck building elements. Survive all the story chapters, upgrade unit cards, and experiment with dozens of builds while acquiring game-changing powers and powerful items.

name: Office 29
short_description: You overslept at work, and when you woke up, everyone was already gone. The office is eerily empty, and strange anomalies seem to have taken over. Explore the office, gather your 29 items, and go home.

name: Save the throne
short_description: A simple and short game about shooting against waves of skeletons in order to save the throne.

name: Horizon Zero Dawn™ Remastered
short_description: Experience the critically acclaimed Horizon Zero Dawn™ with stunning new visuals and upgraded features. In a far future where colossal machines roam the Earth, pockets of humanity survive in unique tribes among the lush, overgrown ruins of our long-lost civilization.

name: Sea Town - Fish Market Simulator
short_description: Build your fishing empire in Sea Town - Fish Market Simulator! Explore oceans, upgrade boats, and conquer a dynamic market across unique islands. Ready to rule the seas? Start now!

name: Terralysia
short_description: In the vibrant realm of Terralysia lurk relentless enemies. Brace yourself for grueling missions, endless onslaughts, and formidable bosses in this third-person roguelike. Use the right strategy and spells to survive a bit longer, but be warned, as you grow in strength, so do your enemies.

name: Shut the Box
short_description: Shut the Box is a classic dice and strategy game where players forecast the possible outcomes of rolling dice, make smart calculations, and rely on luck. Play in hot seat mode with friends or face off against advanced AI opponents.

name: Sketchy Marathon
short_description: Platform in a world that's drawn for you! A 2D endless platformer game where you must evade obstacles drawn by a rogue pencil! Explore a variety of biomes while improving your high score and collecting hats along the way.

name: Kaiju Control Force
short_description: Lead a team of survivors into the abandoned Kaiju Control Force facilities, where bioengineered rats escaped and research went awry long ago, in this one-screen arcade platformer. Jump, climb and buy items from vending machines to reach the Mecha Kaiju Maintenance Bay and reclaim our city!

name: For a long time, I built plans to steal a boy at work and didn't dare to do it, but I happened to get him, so now I can do all sorts of T H I N G S with him…
short_description: Watching my attractive colleague from work, I didn't even notice how I woke up at her house. Only the duct tape over my mouth and the heaviness in my legs bother me a little. I hope this is just a joke and she won't do A N Y T H I N G to me…

name: Escape from the Trap World
short_description: Help our friend Hatdevil to get back to his world, passing through a world full of deadly traps.

name: Monkey Tag Arena
short_description: Hide and run from the hunters, or catch them if you are a hunter. The game has many arenas and 3 modes: - Monkey run mode.- Tag mode.- Open world.

name: Deep Space Tavern
short_description: Deep Space Tavern is a clicker management game. Command your cantina with an arsenal of trash-guns, booze-drones and a Scottish AI.

name: Valefor
short_description: A Tactical Auto-Battler set in a Dark Fantasy world- complete with Roguelike Dungeons, a PVP Arena, Crafting and Kingdom Building.

name: I've Fallen For You!
short_description: Eight women simultaneously appear in your life, offering you unconditional love and support! Will you choose to uphold your beliefs and become a good man, or give in to human temptations and become a bad man?

name: 御祝呪 -oshukuju-
short_description: This is the story of curse and blessing hidden under a bloodline. Tamako wakes up to see an unfamiliar ceiling. She seeks an escape from the mansion, through traces of distorted feelings. “Novel-to-Experience” Adventure Horror.

name: Laundromat Simulator
short_description: Furnish, Manage, and Maintain multiple stores in Laundromat Simulator! Collect and Count your hard-earned pennies and improve your stores to keep customers happy and maximize your profits. Expand your business, improve customer experience, and make your laundromat the best in town!

name: Omega Luma : The First Battle
short_description: Fight and Survive. The destiny that awaits you will affect you and the entire world.

name: Sea Power : Naval Combat in the Missile Age
short_description: From the lead designer of Cold Waters, Sea Power lets you control NATO and Warsaw Pact forces in modern naval conflict campaigns. Use your advanced naval weaponry and sensors to respect rules of engagement and defeat the enemy forces in a tense fight for initiative and air/naval supremacy.

name: Boardguard
short_description: An occult themed turn based strategy game where you fight off waves of possessed entities.

name: Invaders from the Lost Sectors
short_description: Invaders from the Lost Sectors is classic arcade action. Aliens descend with increasing speed towards your base. Shoot them all before they land. Player controlled settings like guided missiles, rate of fire, enemy speed and more help you customize exactly the game experience that you want.

name: Frog Corner
short_description: Frog Corner is a single-player horror game where you go to an abandoned arcade looking for the arcade machine 'Frog Corner', yet you go too deep inside the building. The deeper you go in the weirder and deadlier it gets.

name: Recycling Center Simulator
short_description: Recycling Center Simulator is a business simulator game with a first person view. Make money from garbage, collect raw materials for your recycling center from different locations, recycle them, make money by producing new products and improve your factory.

name: Wild Planet
short_description: Discover, craft, and survive in Wild Planet's captivating open world. Build bases, explore dungeons, and embark on adventures. Immerse yourself in its relaxing atmosphere and uncover the secrets of this mysterious planet!

name: Void Sols
short_description: Illuminate the shadows in this approachable but relentless top-down minimalist soulslike. Gather Sols, level up, and uncover secrets to fight your way through this abstract fantasy.

name: Broad Daylight
short_description: The day awaits. Whether it ends with you going to visit family, taking a breath in the park, or hiding inside your apartment, it all can be taken away without you having a say in the matter. Regardless of all the chances that life might provide, one truth persists: carpe diem.

name: Shady Knight
short_description: Shady Knight is a first-person skill-driven melee action game centered around swift swordplay, acrobatic archery, and fluid platforming that seamlessly blends combat and parkour skills into a stylish dance of death full of creative chaos.

name: DRAGON QUEST III HD-2D Remake
short_description: DRAGON QUEST III HD-2D Remake is a stunning reimagining of the beloved masterpiece and narrative beginning to The Erdrick Trilogy.

name: Babette
short_description: There's this old 90s virtual pet game at a yard sale. It's called 'Babette'. Now you can play with Babette the cat from the comfort of your bedroom. Just you and her! Keep Babette happy by playing with her, feeding her, and more! Except... Babette's more than just a cat. And she's coming for you.

name: Zombie Survivors
short_description: Fight against thousands of zombies and evil creatures in this action roguelite. Collect cards, pets, characters and evolve them to become strong and not become zombie food.

name: Gregory Horror Show: Soul of Roses
short_description: Soul of Roses is a 2D rogue light action game. Absorb the abilities of your enemies, fight, die, revive, and repeat to advance the story.

name: 封神榜重置版
short_description: 回合制角色扮演游戏，升级速度快，边走边升级，加入了很多新的地图，可玩角色：哪吒，金吒，木吒，小龙女，黄天化，杨戬，姜太公，雷震子，土行孙等等，新的武器化血神刀，火龙镖，杏黄旗等等。

name: Relentless Impetus
short_description: Classic FPS gameplay with exploration

name: LEAPO FAITH
short_description: Play as LEAPO FAITH, and climb the tower by running, jumping, sliding, and swinging to find out what lies above.

name: Liminal Universe
short_description: An exploration game that delves into the depths of loneliness. Wander through empty rooms, search for signs of an abandoned world, and listen to the sounds around you. No dangerous chases, just silence and an empty world to explore.

name: 49 Keys
short_description: It all began when you opened that letter. Penned by your late master, it details how you are now heir to his mysterious legacy. You set off for the island on which he'd spent his final years... and so a truly unsettling journey begins, a journey into the deepest secrets of magic and the occult.

name: Mad Void
short_description: Sent by the Galactic Confederation to clean up after a 'glorious' space battle. As a crew of up to 4 Anglernauts, navigate through gloomy rocks in the cold, uncaring void of space to scavenge secret tech. Do it before the Enemy returns and really ruins your day.

name: Walrus Run
short_description: Walrus Run is a 2D Action Platformer, compatible with conveniently-shaped bongo controllers. Slide, dash and eat through obstacles to get a high score and take back your fish from the greedy Sargent Seal!

name: Bullet Runner
short_description: A clone army is taking over the world. Kill them all in an epic single-player campaign to save humanity, and yourself!

name: Agent Brain: Tricky Puzzles
short_description: Every level introduces a unique solution method, breaking the fourth wall between the game and the player in unprecedented ways. From using a pause button to halt threats to turning off the sound to put an enemy NPC to sleep, the game continually surprises and engages players.

name: tilt frog
short_description: Get that Frog to the Top! Squishy frog, elastic tongue. An oddly moist Rage Game.

name: CornField
short_description: CornField is a cooperative first-person horror game for 1-5 players. Collect all the necessary items and escape the cornfield! Run, scream, hide, but most importantly don't get caught! You will be chased by a scary monster that hears your voice from your mic and is definitely trying to kill you!

name: No More Room in Hell 2
short_description: No More Room in Hell 2 is a terrifying 8 player co-op action horror experience. Find your friends in the dark and survive - in a dynamic, endlessly replayable zombie apocalypse.

name: StarLightRiders: HyperJump
short_description: StarLightRiders: HyperJump is a fast paced and frantic multiplayer arcade shoot em up. Protect the solar system from the alien invasion and stop them from eliminating all life on Earth! Take control of the powerful HyperJump ships and blast the hell out of everything that moves.

name: Arisen Force: HeroTest
short_description: Join the exquisite pixel world of 'HeroTest,' team up with heroes across time and space, and engage in thrilling battles against the 「Void」!

name: MOM
short_description: Mom says I can't get out of my room after 12:00 AM. But I always hear the door opening and closing after that hour. Why isn't mom sleeping?

name: Reality Rifts
short_description: 3D platformer with a portal gun! Solve puzzles, exciting levels, become a master of portal travel.

name: Project Scrapper
short_description: Project Scrapper is a casual 2D beat-'em-up where players manipulate gravity to accomplish objectives. Armed with just gravitational rivets and an anti-gravity jump, players will need to come up with their own strategies on the fly to succeed.

name: Nightshade Mysteries: Eternal Moon
short_description: In 1930s Southern Europe, dauntless archaeologist Helena Nightshade gets entangled in the mysteries surrounding an ominous eternal lunar eclipse, prophesied by estranged Moon Worshippers also known as the Anaxagori.

name: Mountain Hook
short_description: A simple, zen-like time-waster about scaling giant stone towers. Pick your route up each new mountain and take as many risks as you think necessary to reach the summit.

name: IMPETUM
short_description: IMPETUM - horror, thriller, drama with elements of detective fiction. Can you uncover the truth without losing your mind?

name: EXOcars
short_description: Strap into EXOcars and compete against real players in single-player races and real-time multiplayer. Exciting driving feedback, advanced physics and graphics make for an unparalleled VR buggy racing experience.

name: Isekai Idle
short_description: Reincarnated as an adventurer from another world, you have gained a powerful skill panel where you can upgrade your skills, recruit like-minded adventurers, work with you to solve Warcraft threats, and write epic chronicles for yourself and your companions.

name: I Only Magic Bullet
short_description: I Only Magic Bullet is a game that fires a huge number of bullets to attack a steady stream of enemies. Spread bullet all over the game world. There is not a single enemy debris to be seen in the sea of bullets.

name: BLOOD=BULLETS
short_description: BLOOD=BULLETS is a bullet hell boss rush action platformer where you dash into bullets to refill ammo. In order to kill the blood itself, one must hack into the sequence.

name: Boyfriend For Hire
short_description: Boyfriend for Hire is a high school romance visual novel where your choices shape the drama. Customize outfits, make impactful decisions, and choose your love interest as you navigate emotional twists and turns in this captivating love triangle.

name: Cursed Halls
short_description: 'Cursed Halls' is a horror game set in a dark, abandoned school, where you must escape a relentless creature. With randomized object placement and permadeath, can you survive this haunting experience?

name: Recovery Phrase
short_description: Uncover hidden words, piece together clues, and think beyond the game screen to unravel mysteries. Every challenge pushes the boundaries of your creativity, demanding you to use both in-game elements and real-world insights. Each step brings you closer to decoding the Recovery Phrase.

name: Ghost Master: Resurrection
short_description: Command an army of specters, unleash terror on the town of Gravenville, and solve puzzles to unlock mysteries in this strategic adventure game of resource management and supernatural mayhem.

name: Rainbow Fighter
short_description: This is a fast-paced flying shooting game.

name: Blood Running
short_description: Blood Running is a stylish extraction shooter where you'll enter the cyber-wasteland, fight off creatures and bandits, loot valuable gear, and venture into the remnants of a world in ruins. Are you willing to bleed to survive, Blood Runner?

name: Metro Awakening
short_description: Metro Awakening is a story-driven first person adventure built for VR that blends atmospheric exploration, stealth and combat in the most immersive Metro experience yet. Don your gas mask, brave the crippling radiation and venture into the depths of the Metro where threats haunt your every step.

name: Blobbton
short_description: Blobbton is a bright and colorful world of hexagon-based puzzles. Challenge your pattern recognition and strategic thinking skills in a casual environment!

name: Halloween Picket Maze
short_description: Halloween Picket Maze is a single player puzzle game. Night is long and ghosts are scary. Can you guide the cat all the way back home?

name: THE BREAKFIVE
short_description: In 1421, the seemingly peaceful Ming Empire is actually rife with undercurrents. As the capital relocation project progresses, numerous forces across the realm are beginning to stir. A massive conspiracy is quietly brewing, and the facade of peace and tranquility is about to be torn apart.

name: Out of Your Mind
short_description: Immerse yourself in a hand-drawn, comic-style visual novel where your choices shape the storyline. Guide Lia through various decisions and emotions that lead to different outcomes. This original story and art present a take on a dystopian world, enhanced by an original soundtrack.

name: 请叫我英雄
short_description: Players will transform into the male protagonist Lin Feng, meet three beautiful women with vastly different appearances and personalities, and embark on an exciting love journey with them, becoming their heroes in the process.

name: Whiskey-Four
short_description: Never stop running, not with the galaxy at stake. Save it at all costs, and save yourself if you can.

name: The Dreamwalkers
short_description: Take control of Morgan's destiny as his world is turned upside down. Explore the world of Dreams, where mythological creatures and Nightmares are real. A story-heavy adventure game with multiple endings, romance options and a symphonic music! Inspired by Neil Gaiman and Inception.

name: Terra Alia VR: A Multilingual Adventure
short_description: Unlock the magic of 10 languages. Embark on quests with word challenges across dynamic biomes, from campuses to mystical realms. Engage with characters and face foes. Craft spells from hundreds of words, creating an arsenal for battles, puzzles, and dialogues.

name: Twisted Logic: Abbotsfield
short_description: As an Exorcist from the Office of Unexplained Phenomena, your task is to solve intricate logic puzzles - both in reality and in-game - in order to exorcise a demonic force. You have one hour.

name: AUTO_BATTLER_RPG
short_description: This is a game about automatical upgrades and unlocking of resources The game plays by itself while all you do is upgrade your hero... and attempt to move even further in the dungeon and by doing that growing in strength.

name: Clicker Clicker Clicker
short_description: Click on the cursor to receive clicker gold. Upgrade your clicks with your clicker gold. Click on the falling cursors to receive more clicker gold! Purchase projectiles in the shop that will clean out the falling cursors for you.

name: Cadente
short_description: Reach the skies and make it to space with just your jumps. In this platform game, help Cadente collect stars and overcome various challenges. Escape the cave, climb the tower, and reach the skies. Face bosses, show them the power of words, and finally shine like a star.

name: The Comeback Kingdom
short_description: This game is incredibly dialogue heavy and story driven, especially for a comedy. Combat is turn based akin to the original Final Fantasy. Should you choose to play this game, you will find yourself surprisingly engaged in the story and characters.

name: Boss Breaker
short_description: In this twin-stick beat 'em up, a lowly employee goes all out to uncover the truth and gain their freedom in an underground corporate facility.

name: 63 Days
short_description: Coming of age as a part of the first generation born free, WWII stripped me of my family, home, and future. Now I'm left with only one choice: to get my revenge and independence, or die trying. The odds are against us: will our tactics, stealth and teamwork be enough?

name: Signed Mary
short_description: “Signed Mary”, a psychological horror visual novel, in which not your choices of action will determine the story’s end, but the choices of how to perceive your reality.

name: Portrait of a Cornish Woman
short_description: Portrait of a Cornish Woman is a Victorian Romance Visual Novel of Manners, capturing the subtle, yet powerful emotions of two women as they fight for their place in each other's lives while living under a veil of discretion.

name: BOBRKUR
short_description: 'Bobr Kur' is a clicker game where players control beavers gathering resources to build a dam. Earn money to upgrade beavers and buy boosts to speed up progress. The goal is to finish the construction faster.

name: Gooper
short_description: Gooper is a challenging 2D puzzle game. Work your way through 200 levels with escalating difficulty and mechanics.

name: Proverbs
short_description: Proverbs is a picross/minesweeper hybrid featuring a single ENORMOUS puzzle, inspired by Bruegel the Elder's 1559 painting 'Netherlandish Proverbs'

name: Mental Hellacious
short_description: 【Experience a New Sensation! A Novel Action Game】 The Most Difficult Action Climbing Game Hold to adjust jump distance simple controls. You'll likely fail countless times before mastering the jump. A single moment of error can ruin everything. Enjoy the experience the process of improving.

name: Sqube Escape
short_description: A unique action-platformer game set in the Sqube universe. Challenge yourself through 60 levels filled with obstacles and bosses. Choose from four difficulty levels and enjoy immersive graphics and sound.

name: Hidden Pinball
short_description: The secret game for your desktop. Enjoy over 100 themed tables, over 50 daily special events and real-time challenges. Beat the records at all the tables and earn your crowns, badges and increase your prestige. Configure it to play the way you want, even in full screen. Improve yourself.

name: Hidden Monsters
short_description: Find 55 monsters set in a surreal world. Unlock various level sections to find all the monsters and enjoy the atmospheric music.

name: Ms. Holmes: The Milverton Plot Collector's Edition
short_description: Can you uncover the truth behind your uncle’s dangerous past?

name: Soccer in a Box
short_description: 'Soccer in a Box' is a soccer game that supports 2-8 players competing on the same stage. Use various dances to kick all the balls into the opponent's goal!

name: Tales Of The White Knight
short_description: This is a new SRPG strategy role-playing game created by the WK-Studio. The game will feature beautiful graphics presented in a 3D top-down perspective. Set in the war-torn continent of Breskan, the protagonists will face many trials and tribulations, what will be their fate?

name: I am going for a beer
short_description: You're just an ordinary guy, coming home after a long day. Beer in hand, TV on... but suddenly it runs out. Time to leave your cozy apartment, go down the stairs, cross the street, and get to the supermarket to find the best beer in the world. But isn’t this a strange dream? When will it end?

name: Breecell
short_description: Breecell is a simple yet profound puzzle game that allows you to enjoy deep strategy. Aim for a high score by increasing and erasing cells in a chain! Slide the board to escape from a pinch as you earn a higher score. Aim for the top of the world ranking!

name: BEAR SHOOTER くまっとシューティング
short_description: Simple vertical scrolling shooter with a bear as the main character, 5 stages in total

name: Little Buddy
short_description: Little Buddy is a casual pet simulation where you care for a virtual companion. Feed, play, and interact with Buddy while they wander around your screen. Designed to be played alongside other activities, it’s the perfect idle game to keep your little friend happy and healthy.

name: BRUTUS MAXIMUS
short_description: Embark on a hellish road trip around the Roman Empire. From Teutoburg to Rome, slay anything standing in your way, survival roguelite-style. Unlock new heroes, weapons, and skills to create synergies. Wipe out entire Roman legions in this hack-and-slash, stab, and shoot survivors game.

name: Crab Crawl
short_description: A short, cheerful action-adventure game where you guide a crab in search of food. Avoid a variety of predators, sea-born obstacles, litterers, rival crustaceans, and explore the hostile waters to find all the tasty treats and save the bay along the way.

name: Salvation:Immortale
short_description: The fog city detective with exceptional intelligence and keen insight, Mei Qu, one day encounters a snow country girl with snow-colored long hair and witch-like beauty, Snell, at a crime scene. From this moment, their fates begin to intertwine, and an adventurous story unfolds.

name: DEATH NOTE Killer Within
short_description: DEATH NOTE Killer Within is an online social deduction game for up to 10 players. Players will be split into two teams with different objectives. To win the game, players will need to figure out each other’s identities and either eliminate L who threatens Kira's power or seize the Death Note.

name: 失踪した友人の部屋に残されていたゲーム
short_description: would like you to solve the mystery contained in the game.

name: 8 Ball: Reborn
short_description: Ready to save Snookyland?

name: Left to Float
short_description: With no supplies and rescue unlikely, you're left to float on your own in this dark, dreary space adventure.

name: Doodle Hunt: Halloween Rush
short_description: Doodle Hunt: Halloween Rush is a thrilling seek-and-find game set in haunted, hand-drawn Halloween scenes. Explore eerie maps, uncover hidden spooky items, and bring them to life with glowing color! A magical Halloween adventure for all ages.

name: Fungiculture
short_description: A cute and relaxing mushroom farming idler. Collect a variety of mushrooms, watch and help them grow, then sell them off for more money to buy more packs and discover them all.

name: 100 Hidden Kooky & Hiking Boots
short_description: Welcome to another kooky game series! Find 100 hidden silly characters with unusual behaviours on a BIG mountain scene & an additional 100 hidden hiking boots to complete the game. Also, play mini challenges to get help with your quest.

name: Emergency Cleanup Co.
short_description: A simulation game that you work for a cleaning company and tackle various maps, including offices, movie theaters, homes, and wrestling gyms. Showcase your cleaning skills in single-player mode across different locations. Prove your professionalism in this challenging cleaning adventure!

name: Lake of Creatures
short_description: A fast-paced action FISHING ROGUELIKE, where you're on a quest to save the lakes from mutated creatures! Catch Fish - Find Treasures - Conquer enemy riddled randomly generated lakes!

name: TOUHOU RHAPSODY OF MOON RABBIT
short_description: Rhapsody of the Moon Rabbit is a second player game in Valkyrie Studio. You will operate Reisen Udongein Inaba and Youmu Konpaku,smash the plot of the scientific eccentric.

name: A Conversation With A Magical Deer
short_description: Have a conversation with a magical deer.

name: 201 - The Bad Number
short_description: '201 - The Bad Number' is an interactive science fiction game-book set on a post-apocalyptic Mars. In a world where only 200 people remain, each new inhabitant may hasten civilization's end. Players make choices that impact the fate of humanity and the colony in a unique dystopian setting.

name: Difficult times 2
short_description: Monsters have returned to our lands!

name: Hidden Cats - Zoo
short_description: Dive into the enchanting world of 'Hidden Cats - Zoo' a hidden object game where your mission is to uncover every cat hidden within stunning hand-painted artwork. Let your keen eye and curiosity guide you through this captivating journey.

name: Care Bears: To The Rescue
short_description: Care Bears: To The Rescue is a brand-new action-platformer set in the world-renowned Care Bears universe, drawing direct inspiration from the original animated show “Care Bears: Unlock the Magic”!

name: CatClimber
short_description: Adventurous 2D platformer, Smash bricks and climb up the floors of the dungeon to find the treasures of the dragon

name: Is this Game Trying to Kill Me?
short_description: An old shack deep in a dense forest, a strange computer and a game that's trying to kill you!

name: MUBOSAMA
short_description: We were spending our usual summer—catching beetles, chasing dogs, finding good spots. And then, we learned about her existence.MUBOSAMA is an adventure game based on urban legends.

name: 双相：水管（Bipolar: The Tube)
short_description: East-Asia-theme horror visual novel with tarot elements. This game shares the same world with When the Wind Knocks (Ready to Kill) and The Dead Daughter. If you have played that game, you will meet an old friend here.

name: Barbie Project Friendship™
short_description: Join Barbie™ on a fun summer adventure to save the Malibu Waves Community Center! Help friends, unlock minigames and earn points for upgrades while you restore a beloved landmark.

name: PrisonSoul:Reunion
short_description: An ancient castle with human-making technology.A human, a dummy...Unrelated brothers, imprisoned by time in a castle...When you unlock the secrets of time, can you escape from your predicament?

name: CONCRETE

short_description: Prepare to test your wits, agility, and problem-solving skills as you navigate through a series of meticulously crafted one-screen puzzle stages.

name: The Art Collector
short_description: You're an artist tasked with taking over an art gallery in order to help your mentor. Given a set of clues with several correct answers each, players strategically craft layouts of words to satisfy the puzzle and earn stars that unlock themed packs, hints, and bonus content.

Build a base on the surface and in space. Сomplete the construction of an intergalactic beacon to absorb the entire planet.

name: The Mansion of The Macabre

name: Jolly's Park

Meet our mascots, and avoid them, so you don't get in trouble. Anyways, they are adorable, not? Any damage is YOUR fault, and if you feel uncomfortable, just leave!

short_description: Rapid Eye Madness is a short grim & cute collection of mini-games that are as cryptic as they are engaging. Venture into the eldritch nightmare, and stream for your life as you solve the challenges the screens throw at you. Will you survive this eerie gamescape, or become another one of its victims?

name: ConstructEx
short_description: ConstructEx is a factory building game, with a single goal... to automate EVERYTHING!!!

name: soul Interface

name: Psychopomp GOLD
short_description: Psychopomp is BACK. The catacombs stretch down farther than ever before. Your entire life has been a lie. Delve into the depths, and discover the horrors that lie below. More realms, more modes, more secrets. An ancient voice calls to you from the center of the earth. Will you answer it?

May you rise from the fair battles and become the strongest and cutest bug in the Jungle!

name: Raiden NOVA | 雷電NOVA | 雷電新星
short_description: 'Raiden' unites! Get ready to blast into a thrilling new dimension like never before!

name: King of Ping Pong: MEGAMIX

name: Forsaken Frontiers
short_description: Step into the frozen unknown in Forsaken Frontiers, a cooperative analog horror adventure set in the unforgiving embrace of an everlasting winter.

name: Kooky Kids Fort Defense
short_description: Tower Defense x Roguelite! Recruit Kids with branching Elite paths, use powerful Items, and gain randomized strategic Perks to defend your Fort against the Brats! Various challenging environments, Brats, and Bosses await you and the Kooky Kids.

name: Ad Agency Simulator

name: MOOZ
short_description: This is an adventure novel of suspense and horror in which the story diverges depending on the choices you make. An online drinking session with friends. A person with a knife is lurking in the background. What will you do to rescue your friend?

short_description: WiThu, It's Time To Go is an RPG Maker Horror puzzle game. You wake up in a familiar place. Something that everyone has is called a name, but you don't. Searching for who we are and the truth of these things. The adventures in mysterious lands are waiting for you.

name: Mac Biskwi Adventures
short_description: Mac Biskwi Adventures brings back a nostalgic feeling with a modern touch in this retro-inspired 2D platformer. Jump on this fun & colorful journey, where you'll explore different levels, collect biscuits and golden tokens to help Mac rescue his missing girlfriend.

name: Rage of the Dragons NEO
short_description: Engage in intense tag team battles in Rage of the Dragons NEO! Play the cult-classic among the fans of Fighting Games with brand exclusive content!

name: Blackthorn Arena: Reforged
short_description: Re-experience the thrill and challenges of managing a Gladiator arena in this management/simulation game. With new content, new graphics, Quality of Life updates, and all DLCs packed into this new experience, this is how Blackthorn Arena was meant to be experienced.

name: Zodiac Revenger
short_description: Zodiac Revenger is A 2D Platformer Action game. Follow the Cat as he seeks revenge on the one who caused him to lose the Zodiac race, the vile Rat, and sweep away other Zodiacs or any obstacles that stand in his way.

name: Galactic Defense: Automation

short_description: Craft and upgrade the ultimate ship and survive an onslaught of enemies in this top down, rogue-lite shooter.

short_description: Bounce, fall, repeat! Guide Jack, our clumsy pogo stick rider, through tricky obstacles on his way up. Jack's only goal to climb higher but no one knows what awaits at the top -a way out or an even greater mystery. But remember, one mistake could send you tumbling all the way down!

name: Shadows of the Damned: Hella Remastered
short_description: Shadows of the Damned, an action-adventure road trip through hell, has been remastered at last! Get ready for a story about rock, love, and just a little bit of demon slaying.

But the outdated hardware isn't the only thing that's decaying: devoid of any memories, all you know is a toxin is destroying your body little by little - and it's only one of the things out to kill you. Get ready to die like it's 1981.

name: Outbreak Overlord
short_description: Outbreak Overlord is a real-time tactics game set in a post-apocalyptic world that puts you in command of a zombie who must infect other humans to increase his horde. Send them on a series of hazardous missions and devastate any remaining communities.

name: The Last Customer

name: Elemental Empire
short_description: An economic 4x strategy in a space filled with magic and procedurally generated planets. Build your own empire and become the sole ruler of a new world.

name: PROXIMATE
short_description: Congratulations, contractor! You've been approved to trial our cutting-edge AI visor. Use it to explore the Neuras lab and recover the staff's research. Your visor is safe, reliable, and up to 99% accurate. Just don't ask why the 'ketchup' in the corner makes such a horrible crunching sound.

name: Yakiniku Party Survival
short_description: This is a game where you challenge yourself to survive using only the ingredients from a yakiniku restaurant. Survive by maintaining a balanced diet and eat as much as you can. If your stomach gets full, burn off calories with squats to get hungry again!

short_description: A psychological horror adventure where you investigate a large art gallery following many disappearances. You'll go on a journey filled with fear and stress to find out what happened to all those who went missing.

name: Waffle Cone Willie

short_description: Parkour Civilization! Progress from a noob to a god by mastering parkour courses, crafting parkour gadgets, and solving parkour puzzles. It's even more fun with friends!

short_description: Mini Dungeon is a couch-coop action RPG with an emphasis on tactical combat with your friends. A variety of playable classes let you fill the role your team needs, whether damaging the boss or healing your teammates.

short_description: BRUTAL KATANA is an easy to learn but hard to master, short and satisfying, first-person parkour action platformer where your goal is to slice meat statues in half as quickly as possible.

short_description: The Territory of Egg 2 is an unique tower defense indie game. Place Egg Towers, choose evolution branches, combine skills and build defenses. The souls of Heroic Eggs await your awakening! Explore and gather resources in the dark forest, unlock the technology tree, and defeat even stronger enemies!

name: The Lost Penguin
short_description: The lost penguins is a Sokoban style puzzle game where you move the penguins on a 2D grid. It features original mechanics that require the player to strategically plan the route, connect with friends, interact with eggs, blockers, teleports, enemies, and solve unique problems on each level.

name: Miraculous - Paris Under Siege
short_description: Step into the suits of Ladybug and Cat Noir in their most daring adventure yet! Embark on a thrilling adventure where heroism, acrobatic combat and parkour agility collide as Shadow Moth unleashes a wave of villains across the city. It’s up to you and your friends to save Paris!

name: Railroad Manager
short_description: Build tracks, drive trains, transport passengers and goods! Relaxed railway construction in retro style with a large campaign and countless missions and maps.

short_description: Become an elite hacker in cyberpunk typing simulator. Infiltrate networks, steal data by typing simple commands. Navigate through pixel art cyberspace, unlocking new abilities as you go deeper. No coding skills needed. How far can you hack before the system catches you?

name: Happy Birthday: With Sergio Spellbound

name: Hands of Necromancy II

Choose from two characters, wield new weapons and learn even more powerful spells and transformations to prove once and for all that you are the supreme Necromancer, master of death itself!

name: SplitPool
short_description: Stop the invasion on the pool table! SplitPool brings a new twist on a classic pool game! Each time you hit a ball and don't pocket it, it spawns another one—raising the stakes and making every shot count. Use your skills and wit to prevent the table from overflowing.

name: Bunker Invaders
short_description: A co-op horror game where you must scavenge for loot and maintain the bunker to keep it standing

name: Darkwood Tales - Beast in the Shadows
short_description: Find out the truth about the mysterious legend and the monster in this exciting hidden object adventure! Solve tricky puzzles and play many relaxing mini-games!

name: Save Scream and Run
short_description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful place.

name: Elements and build
short_description: Form your own genre with skills in different elements, use building rewards to build your own unique maze in randomly generated levels, and fight to survive waves of monsters to win
Idle clicker game with a percentage based math inside. Compound percent is used for all calculations. Slow start, exponential growth and lots of fun!

name: Euclid's Inferno
short_description: Euclid's Inferno is a fast-paced 2D shooter where math is your enemy. Play as the father of geometry, explore a hellish version of the works of ancient mathematicians, and defeat polygonal beasts as you upgrade your geometric arsenal.

name: OPG: Clan Wars
short_description: Online multiplayer with PVPVE battles. Five game modes. Single-player, team battles, raids, global mode, and bunkers.Arena shooter, open world, quests and crafting resources await you. Join the world of OPG.

name: Fork-U Forklift Simulator
short_description: Fork-U is a physics based forklift simulator. Drive and operate a forklift in 1st or 3rd person. Try your hand at loading and unloading pallets in a warehouse, delivering building materials in a construction site, keeping shelves stocked in a grocery store, and more!

name: Chrono
short_description: Chrono is a puzzle/platformer game where you control how time affects objects in the world. By freezing time, fast-forwarding, or rewinding objects, you can crack a wide variety of puzzles. The goal is to escape the facility where you are trapped, before time runs out.

name: 他他与他的秘密（Their Invitation）
short_description: Return to high school and uncover the friendship and special emotions between high school boys. BOYS'LOVE STORY

name: Planet Coaster 2
short_description: Build and customise thrilling roller coasters and incredible water slides, manage the ultimate theme park experience, and share your epic creations. Are you ready to ride the wave?

name: Earthquake: Margarita School
short_description: A horror game set in a school, in which you will be a police officer who will have to investigate an earthquake. You will have to complete puzzles and face the paranormal events that occur. You have to be careful, the school covers a fairly dark past that you will be able to discover.

name: Your Heart
short_description: Puzzle game with a little story. The rules are simple! Clear the stage by absorbing the three colored orbs into the pedestals of each color. Gradually, various gimmicks are added, and the difficulty increases. By the way... who are you, and why are you solving these puzzles?

name: Dark City: Amsterdam Collector's Edition
short_description: A legendary ghost ship has returned, and ghostly sailors walk the streets!

name: InFlux Redux
short_description: InFlux Redux is a high-def remake of the 2013 ball-rolling puzzler InFlux, built on a new engine with improved graphics and physics. Roll through a series of beautiful environments filled with elaborate, mind-bending puzzle structures.

name: Infinite Zombie Tide
short_description: Zombies, zombies, zombies. Fortunately, we still have guns to protect us and turn these zombies into resources in our backpacks.

name: Death City
short_description: Death City is the story of Loy, a protagonist trying to overcome his fate as he repeatedly faces death amidst a world in the grip of a zombie apocalypse. Solve various puzzles, defeat enemies with firearms, and experience multiple endings based on your choices.

name: The Blackwood Legacy
short_description: Step into the unsettling world of The Blackwood Legacy, a first-person puzzle horror game set in the eerie halls of Blackwood Manor. Solve intricate puzzles, unveil long-held secrets, and decipher the mystery surrounding your father's disappearance.

name: Defense Golem
short_description: Defense Golem is a tower defense game that supports random evolution.

name: Kung Pao Banqi
short_description: Kung Pao Banqi is a two-player game of chance played on half a xiangqi board. Play hot seat, against AI, or online and beat your opponents with luck and strategy!

name: Hotloop
short_description: Use the force of gravity in this fast-paced space shooter with realistic physics and orbital mechanics.

name: Backrooms: Lost Place
short_description: Single-player horror game based on the backrooms universe. Your task is to pass levels, puzzles and try not to die during all this.

name: Retail Mage
short_description: Welcome, Retail Mage, to your first day of employment at MageMart! Get 5 star reviews from customers before the store closes. Say and do (almost) anything in this open-ended, creative co-op game!

name: Tales Beyond The Tomb - Pineville Night Stalker
short_description: After her mother's unexpected death, Megan receives a call about a mysterious inheritance awaiting her in the town of Pineville. With her work friend, Lenny, she embarks on a journey that should be simple, but quickly turns into a web of danger and deception.

name: 在一切晴朗的日子里｜On all clear days
short_description: This is an ADV game work in the style of short story writing. On a sunny holiday, the main character returns with his sister to the place where he went when he was a child. 'There are so many things I want to say to her, and I want to tell her that I wish I could live with her like I used to.

name: Unterholz
short_description: Explore the murky corners and abandoned ruins of an isolated enclave in 15th century Europe. Prevail in chivalrous battle and unveil the mysteries of a dark world. Embark on a non-linear psychological journey through the underbrush of this sinister setting as well as your own soul.

name: SONIC X SHADOW GENERATIONS
short_description: Shadow the Hedgehog is back with Classic and Modern Sonic in SONIC X SHADOW GENERATIONS, an all-new collection featuring two unique experiences!

name: 草批模拟器：NTR
short_description: Explore the city, engage in deep interactions with your favorite characters, and accumulate affection to unlock the ending!

name: Deathpuddle: Choose Violence?
short_description: Enter the chaotic, not-so-superhero world of Deathpuddle: Choose Violence? Guide Deathpuddle through epic and absurd missions filled with dark humor, bizarre characters, and unpredictable outcomes. Can you help Deathpuddle survive and clear his name, or will he always end up back in jail?

name: Relieve
short_description: 'Relieve' is a hand-drawn comic style narrative puzzle visual novel with unique art and high-quality music. It allows you to experience the story of a couple's separation and reunion from different perspectives.

name: InvisibleHand
short_description: In the bustling tavern, a variety of people are gathered. It's time to showcase true thieving skills!

name: Chickens Be Crazy
short_description: The greatest chicken-based, single-screen puzzle platformer of all time (according to me)! Use your skillz to collect produce, outwit crazy chickens, and jetpack through 100 levels of family-friendly fun. Smash bricks, unlock doors, and discover secrets that will keep you coming back for more!

name: Save Girl
short_description: Attention! Terrorist activity at an airport! A flight attendant was found tied up in a toilet with a heavy bomb attached to her body! Bomb Disposal Specialist Zero, proceed to bomb disposal immediately!

name: Great God Grove
short_description: THE WORLD IS ENDING AND THE GODS ARE SQUABBLING! Suck up and launch dialogue in a world of puzzles, puppets, and weird gods… or THE RIFT WILL CONSUME US ALL!

name: Don't Be Scared - Episode 1: The Lost Soul
short_description: A psychological horror game based on exploration and Storytelling. Complete your work, play minigames and stay alive. Discover all the secrets of this condominium and why there are few residents.

name: Newspaper Day
short_description: In Newspaper Day, you take on the role of a newspaper delivery person in a seemingly quiet neighborhood. Every morning, you carry out your job, delivering the day's news to your neighbors' doors. However, you soon realize that things are not what they seem.

name: Crack it Up!
