short_description: Crack it Up! is a trading card collecting game. Order booster packs from your 90s computer, crack them up, sell your duplicates and rarest cards for profit and complete your collections!

name: A-Train9 TRAIN CONSTRUCTION
short_description: 'A-Train 9 TRAIN CONSTRUCTION' is a 3D railway vehicle customization software that allows you to craft your very own unique train. Let your imagination soar as you design every detail from the shape and paint to the smallest parts of your dream train and set it in motion!

name: Seer's Gambit
short_description: A strategic, hero-drafting roguelite RPG that rewards smart positioning, player agency, and synergies-building within your party. Explore a perilous world brimming with upgrades to discover and unlock. Choose the right combination of heroes, equipment, skills, and buffs to craft your perfect team.

name: 诡事其一珍珠剧院
short_description: You will play a boy who lives with his childhood sweetheart and is preparing for the law test, but is involved in a strange incident because of a prank of his childhood sweetheart who travels for work.

name: Move Out Manor
short_description: “Move Out Manor” is a grid-based action puzzle game set in a haunted mansion. Explore the halls of the manor, find keys to enter its rooms, and pack up everything in sight while avoiding spooky ghosts. Move out quick, or you may become a permanent resident!

name: Right Turn
short_description: Challenge your attention to detail and driving skills in this 3D psychological thriller. Spot the anomalies and take a right turn to draw closer to the exit. Fail and be forced to start over!

name: Servonauts
short_description: An absurd couch co-op gas station builder for 1-4 players! Manage a servo (that's Aussie for 'gas station') as impatient space travellers demand service. Wrangle wobbly pipes, set up refineries, and mix the right fuels to build space gas stations with peak efficiency.

name: Which Wizard?
short_description: A multiplayer social deduction game with mystery, mischief, and magic! Use magical abilities and your powers of deduction to figure out who in your party of Wizards is a secret traitor. One (or more) in your group is truly evil... but Which Wizard is it?

name: Thrive: Heavy Lies The Crown
short_description: Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown is a complex city builder, where the fate of your kingdom hinges on your every decision. Explore this medieval land alone or with friends, make tough moral choices and conquer your foes in RTS combat. Will you struggle to survive, or find the strength to Thrive?

name: Super Mining Mechs
short_description: Build your own Super Mining Mech and explore the underground in search of new natural resources. Customize your mech with unlockable parts to dig deeper than ever - by yourself or with up to 7 friends in online co-op multiplayer! So, what are you waiting for? There’s mining to be done!

name: Voodoo Strikers
short_description: Unleash your competitive spirit and cuteness overload with this local multiplayer sports game! With randomly generated fields and different physics for each ball, each match will be completely different. Choose an adorable character and get ready to enjoy with family and friends!

name: Star Wars Outlaws
short_description: Experience the first-ever open world Star Wars™ game and explore distinct locations across the galaxy, both iconic and new. Risk it all as scoundrel Kay Vess, seeking freedom and the means to start a new life.

name: Dreadful Delivery
short_description: In the dead of night, when the streets are quiet and the neighborhood sleeps, you’re on the clock, delivering packages no one else dares to touch. Each delivery is a race against time—and against the dangers lurking in the shadows. But the job pays well… if you can survive the night.

name: 九州：立志
short_description: 《九州：立志》是一款以古代中国为背景的开放模拟养成游戏，本作以《九州：商旅》为框架进行了优化与改进，以使其能适应更多游戏玩法。

name: Electrogical
short_description: 'Jigsaw Puzzle + Arithmetic' is a casual yet engaging game that appeals to puzzle gamers who enjoy immersive experiences. Customize your gameplay by rearranging 'piece placement,' 'number manipulation,' and 'score selection' to aim for a high score in each stage.

name: Starship Destroyer
short_description: A sci-fi space vehicle combat game, where the player must defend their capital ship from being destroyed, while attempting to destroy the alien force's own capital ship!

name: Ottoman Dreams: Rise of Süleiman
short_description: 'Witness the rise of the great 16th-century Ottoman Sultan Suleiman the Magnificent. Navigate palace intrigue, strategic battles, and critical decisions to guide the Ottoman Empire. Shape Suleiman's destiny and write your own history with multiple endings.'

name: Light de deux
short_description: Ballet is a lot like love: in both, the partners' connection is all about trust. But will this bond be strong enough to keep two burning hearts together?

name: Endless Defense: Survival
short_description: This is a innovative roguelike TD game made with the 『Y3 Editor』. No need for path planning or tower combos—just one tower! With almost 100 weapons, you’ll be mowing down foes and dominating the battlefield. Enjoy the rush and let off some steam!

name: Bat Blast!
short_description: Bat Blast! is a 2D game about magical bats. Take control of one of many magical fruit bats and blast your way upwards through the minions of 'The Master' as you strive to escape his spooky tower.

name: October Panic
short_description: An arcade-style platformer with five levels and no saving/loading. A small trick-or-treat bag packed to the brim with both treats and tricks.

name: Ant protect the queen
short_description: Face endless hordes of fierce and powerful invaders. Fight, gain experience, evolve and become stronger to protect the queen.

name: Western Shadowlands
short_description: Create unique card combinations to grow stronger and stronger. Reach a certain number of cards to obtain a special card! With a wave progression system, enemies become increasingly harder to defeat!

name: Atomic Picnic
short_description: Swing and dash across the wasteland to slay monsters, smash loot pinatas, and synergize your upgrades with powerful weapons in this co-op roguelike shooter!

name: DevilReversi
short_description: 'Devil Reversi' is a groundbreaking battle game that redefines Reversi. Two demon kings battle using humanity as their playthings. Utilize special abilities and magic in strategic matches with stunning graphics and immersive sound. Enjoy robust online multiplayer to compete with players worldwide.

name: Backrooms: Partygoers
short_description: Backrooms: Partygoers is a backrooms horror game based on Level 0 where you play as a researcher tasked to find anomalies inside the backrooms. You are equip with devices that can beep whenever an anomaly is near, where the partygoers roam and can hear you.

name: Alien Cat Story
short_description: Help the cat survive and repair his flying ship after an accident on an unknown planet. Use dexterity and ingenuity to overcome obstacles, fight enemies and solve puzzles. Exciting adventures are waiting for you ahead!

name: MasterQuest Fantasy
short_description: MasterQuest Fantasy is a love letter to the classic 70s and 80s tabletop RPGs. Enter a procedurally generated world where no playthrough will ever be the same!

name: Forestygian
short_description: Roguelike Deckbuilder inspired by Action RPGs. Build a powerful deck to support abilities of your hero. Use abilities to puzzle through hordes of enemies.

name: Time Travel: Escape Room Game
short_description: The heart of the time machine beats with the power of a rare crystal. Play Time Travel: Escape Room Game, find the crystal, and see what it feels like to be a real time traveler!

name: Rat Hunter
short_description: Rat Hunter features traditional, by-the-book gameplay, which does not wander into the realm of tactical shooters. Players will have to overcome different obstacles and solve various puzzles in order to get to the next level.

name: KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It
short_description: One 4 All, All 4 One, This is a game that checks your ability to be considerate to make the world a little more peaceful.

name: Love is in the Airship
short_description: In this wacky yuri dating sim, come aboard a magical airship cruise and experience romance, hijinks, and a crazy story with over 15 endings! Lots of choices and lots of really cute girls to date.

name: Inspector Waffles Early Days
short_description: A top-down detective adventure with point-and-click mechanics, inspired by classic Game Boy games. Follow Waffles in his first days as an inspector who wants to prove to everyone that he is more than just a rookie. But beware… Your future worst enemy is hiding in the shadows.

name: Toey Weedz Smoke One
short_description: An funny early 3D retro inspired FPS. Become Mr. Weedz himself and fight on the power of Evil. Pass through 6 unique level and upgrade a Toey with gunz and skillz to put an end to the madness once and for all!

name: ATLYSS
short_description: Enter the world of ATLYSS, a Singleplayer/Online RPG where you can fight with or against friends in a surreal world filled with creatures beyond comprehension. Customize and progress your character(s), complete quests, and discover strange locations.

name: Voltage Box
short_description: Voltage Box is a challenging puzzle game where players must overcome obstacles to activate a set number of switches in each level. For those who love a challenge, try activating all the switches and collecting all stars in each level to achieve a perfect score.

name: Seaside Cafe Rush Hour
short_description: Seaside Cafe Rush Hour is a challenge-based single-player game about cooking.

name: Find-o'-Lantern
short_description: Solve logical riddles in this simple, yet challenging game based on the classic star battle format.

name: Fields of Gold
short_description: Fields of Gold is a casual farming game where you grow crops, expand your fields, and build manufactories. Defend your farm from mischievous rabbits as you transform your land into a thriving agricultural empire. Start playing now and defend your farm before the rabbits take over!

name: Shuffled Sky
short_description: Explore your own continent in the skies in this Roguelike Deckbuilding RPG. Use cards to modify the world or use them in tactical combat to discover new abilities!

name: Fill Multicolor
short_description: A relaxing, minimalist and challenging puzzle game.

name: Archaeology - Egypt
short_description: A game of the genre find the hidden object.

name: Randotura
short_description: Randotura is a top-down action roguelike with inventory management. Dive into bullet hell action and collect unique modifiers, all in a selfmade dungeon.

name: Trouble in Pacifica
short_description: Explore the Pacifica archipelago, different islands, secrets and villages await you...Earn money by fishing in a fishing mini-game. Hunt down the sea monster with your upgraded boat and save your home!

name: Coaching Simulator
short_description: Coaching Simulator is an educational simulation game that combines study techniques, short and long lesson videos, AI university coaching, English practice NPCs, creative crafting areas. Enhance your learning experience and enjoy diverse activities in a virtual library setting.

name: World of Football
short_description: A physics-based football game, where matches are won not by randomness or luck, but pure skill! Easy to learn, yet difficult to master, World of Football lets you bring up to ten players together to test your skills on the pitch! Then go pro and fight for the title of GOAT!

name: The Broken Ceiling
short_description: The Broken Ceiling is a hand-drawn, 2D, top-down eldritch horror adventure where the player must use a fragile light, which constantly needs to be recharged, to hold back the darkness, explore alien caverns, and uncover why fate has summoned a little rabbit into a pit of incomprehensible beings.

name: You Left Us
short_description: Crowned the victor of Pirate Software Game Jam 14, You Left Us promises a heart-pounding journey through the depths of psychological horror. Stranded in the desolate snowfields of Greenland, your survival hinges on the fragile lifeline of your listening post.

name: Toads of the Bayou
short_description: Lead a group of toads as they fight against Baron Samedi’s evil forces in a challenging mix of turn-based tactics and roguelike deckbuilding. Synergise card effects, gain the aid of powerful allies and engage in strategic combat to thrive in the cursed bayou.

name: While We Wait Here
short_description: Share thoughts and hot food with your last ever clients, as you wait for the world to end.

name: Terror of the Seven Seas
short_description: Become a Mighty Captain in a Age of sail naval combat game, set in all of the Seven Seas! Sail the entire world: conquering, plundering, exploring and trading along the way! Gather your crew, ready your ship, hoist your sails and enter a world of swashbuckling and piracy!

name: C.V. 私と私の中の人 The Fourth Insider
short_description: 「私には『中の人』がいるらしい」 「声優×メタフィクション」新感覚ビジュアルノベル、開幕！ゲームの世界を認識している高校1年生・五月山さつきと、その親友・真野ユイ。そして二人の声を演じるのは声優・宮白桃子。キャラクターと「中の人」が交わるとき、物語はどこへ向かうのか。

name: Shadows At Bay
short_description: This is a first-person horror game where you find yourself trapped in a haunted hedge maze at night, chased by a terrifying ghost. You need to use the voice activated lamps to protect yourself and find the way out.

name: Cat Survivors
short_description: This bullet hell roguelite pits you against waves of ferocious demons, where strategic upgrades and dynamic builds are your keys to survival. Can you outlast the demonic onslaught and emerge as the ultimate Cat Survivor?

name: Viscera
short_description: Viscera is an arcade-inspired, gleefully excessive top-down shooter. Fight through the muck and gore against the mutant menace. Master over 50 weapons and more than 80 abilities. Prove you’re the best at withstanding the horde until the end takes you. Viscera awaits. Soak in it.

name: Towers of Aghasba
short_description: Explore a stunning open-world filled with majestic creatures and quirky characters. Nurture withered lands into vibrant ecosystems and flex your creativity as you build a thriving civilization in balance with nature. Invite friends to co-op multiplayer to craft, harvest, and cozy up together.

name: Game of Fate: Chasing Through Time
short_description: Immerse yourself in the first-person perspective, cross time and space, solve bizarre cases, save innocent victims, and catch a mysterious killer! You will solve murders, uphold justice, and also gain love. Are you ready? Play the 'Game of Fate' that crosses time and space, life and death!

name: Endless Conflict
short_description: Endless Conflict! You will take on the role of different commanders, traversing various environments such as forests, volcanoes, and deserts. Use resources wisely, gather allies, upgrade technology, defeat endless waves of enemies, and destroy enemy defenses.

name: Lone Hero Path
short_description: You can hang up and fight monsters, brush equipment, match skills, and break through characters. Features: Comes with a mod editor that allows you to create your own game.

name: Jixo: The Season of Joy Collector's Edition
short_description: Explore a variety of holiday-themed games, from hidden object challenges in enchanting Christmas scenes to captivating jigsaw puzzles that piece together the wonders of winter. And if you’re looking to flex those brain muscles, our clever puzzles will keep you happily engaged all season long

name: Warriors United
short_description: Warriors United is a cooperative action game for up to 4 players. You'll fight and progress through levels filled with increasingly powerful enemies and bosses. Upgrade your skills and unlock abilities to become even stronger in your battles.

name: Mind Over Magnet
short_description: An attractive puzzle platformer where you use magnetism to escape a factory. Meet a cast of magnet characters and work together to solve logical conundrums.

name: Black Mountain Kings
short_description: You were thrown in a strange world. You are alone, and you got nothing. What to do next? You decide it! Explore, defeat monsters, get riches, learn new abilities, discover secrets, and learn the truth.

name: Cybertrash STATYX
short_description: Cybertrash STATYX is a story-driven 2D action-platformer with tactical elements, set in a cyberpunk world.

name: Flappy Tank
short_description: Do a 360 and gain a shield! The faster you go, the farther the tank jumps through the pipes! Use the power-ups to your advantage! Let's GO!!

name: THE THIRTEEN FLOORS
short_description: In a steampunk dystopia, you play as a doll navigating a 13-floor maze filled with random events like healing, enemies, and treasure. Dice rolls decide your fate as you strategize your way to the top floor.

name: The Soldier and the Golden Princess
short_description: Princess Knight Lucrezia is known for her exceptional swordsmanship and striking beauty, but when whispers about a secret relationship with the much-maligned General Abol start sweeping through the ranks, it falls to you, a lone soldier, to uncover the truth!

name: TIME TO STARⅡ偶像之路终极版
short_description: A female-led star training game where players aim to win the TTS Starlight King Award. Features include open-world exploration, unique romance systems, and diverse career choices.

name: Exo Wanderers
short_description: This is a sci-fi top-down tank shooting game that can be played solo or with two players. As human civilization is on the brink of extinction, you will take on the role of one or two 'Exo Wanderers,' seeking the truth of the Galactic and Earth civilizations on Gliese 667Ce.

name: EARTH DEFENSE FORCE: WORLD BROTHERS 2
short_description: The Earth is in pieces...again! We've gotta do more to save the planet!

name: Come on,Fantasy baby!
short_description: Watch out for a heart-throbbing adventure! Let us take you into an ideal world for men, where you can control and save various Korean beauties from different dimensions, each with their own unique style. Every day unfolds an irresistible and exhilarating fantasy life.

name: Luma Island
short_description: Travel to Luma Island to go on an epic adventure by yourself or with your friends and family. Build your dream farm, master professions, collect magical Lumas, find treasures and unravel the mysteries of the island.

name: Coffee Please
short_description: Become a cozy coffee shop owner. Manage inventory, set prices, take payments, pet the cat, expand, and decorate your venue to build the best coffee house. Enjoy the charm of a heartwarming cafe simulator!

name: RFA Station
short_description: A space shooter in which you must defeat alien robots.

name: Worlds of Aria
short_description: Lead your own DnD-like adventuring party on an epic adventure narrated by Laura Bailey. Invite your friends for free to the group with the Friends Pass, or strike out on your own. Cooperation, betrayal, and the luck of the dice… what wild escapades will you and your teammates get up to?

name: LSD: Dream Emulator Retro
short_description: Immerse yourself in a dreamy and psychedelic world through low poly enviroments and liminal spaces. A Retro game influenced by the original LSD: Dream Emulator from PSX.

name: Don't Play Breakout Deluxe
short_description: A little stroll with a ball that you only control horizontally, while it keeps going up and down, inverting itself each time you touch a floor or a ceiling. Just a comfy, short game, with nice ambiance.

name: QUICKN
short_description: Shoot, blast and slash your opponents to win this dynamic top-down shooter in luscious neon colors.

name: Casino Simulator
short_description: Become the boss of the casino and lead your way to wealth and success with your strategic decisions. Casino Simulator offers an exciting experience full of realistic graphics, discover the intricacies of casino operation.

name: Sudoku Topology
short_description: Explore classic sudoku variant rules on 3D boards ranging from cubes and spheres to dodecahedron and the Klein bottle. Experience beautiful logic of handcrafted puzzles where no guessing is required. Or design your own 3D sudoku puzzles and share them with the world!

name: Industry Giant 4.0
short_description: Build an industrial empire from scratch in Industry Giant 4.0. Produce goods, build up your industries, construct transportation networks, plan production, manage finances, and navigate global events. Become the next business tycoon and write history!

name: Catch The Beaukes
short_description: In Catch The Beaukes, Beaukes (spheres) fall from the sky, and you need to collect them to earn money. Then you can upgrade things so you earn even more!

name: TropTopia
short_description: TropTopia is a single-player and local co-op 2D platformer where you make your way through enemy and trap filled levels. Your goal is to collect every fruit in every level. Each level is timed, and you can track your best times in the level select menu for an extra challenge!

name: Maskared
short_description: Endure as long as you can, harness the power of unique masks, and conquer your foes in Maskared!

name: Lady Dracula's Mansion
short_description: Explore a creepy gothic mansion and survive the night while being hunted down by a lady dracula! Lady Dracula's Mansion is an FPS horror game with retro graphics where you must sneak around and use your wits while scavenging whatever weapons and resources you can find to help you survive.

name: Freenergy
short_description: Develop your robot, combine abilities. Fight in turn-based tactical mode, effectively distributing energy. Overcome all difficulties and gain freedom.

name: Multiplayer Barbarians
short_description: Multiplayer Barbarians - They attacked Your village, They killed Your family. Grab Your sword and Go get 'em! (Multiplayer or Single Player)

name: In The Middle
short_description: you work in a haunted laundry. In the morning, you run your business, at night you survive through the scary night.

name: Cats Bounce Ball
short_description: A malfunctioning pinball machine has unexpectedly attracted a bunch of cats! Come and explore the mystery while challenging higher scores with the company of 100 cats!

name: Netveil
short_description: A pixel art psychological horror game with a point-and-click system that takes the style of an interactive desktop environment.

name: Nightmare Pursuit
short_description: Nightmare Pursuit is an intense multiplayer horror game where survivors must avoid the deadly traps and unique abilities of terrifying killers. Rely on stealth, strategy, and teamwork to survive in horrific environments. Experience the thrill of the chase—escape or become the hunted.

name: Robot Detour
short_description: А fun and innovative puzzle game about a wired robot who delivers batteries to his wireless friends.

name: Native Isekai Defense
short_description: As part of the Pioneer Corps, form a party with other players and take on missions to protect humanity's last remaining land and reclaim the contaminated territories from the enemies! An action RPG game, playable solo or in online 4 players co-op.

name: Grid Ranger
short_description: A shortform heart-pounding 3D shmuplike. Level up your dexterity and see what lies beyond the grid...

name: Extra Extra Poison
short_description: At Bernard Cinemas we work harder not smarter! Work may feel like a loop but once you get infected, we'll take care of you! During the vaccination process please make sure to cover majority of your immune system's field. Good luck!

name: Omakase (お任せ)
short_description: Omakase is a relaxing cooking and creation game. Slice, mix, and explore new ingredients while completing quests. Customize your display to your liking, crafting unique compositions of ingredients and objects. There's no pressure; unwind and enjoy the culinary art at your own pace.

name: 东方裁判梦~Rookie Attorney Legendry
short_description: 'Touhou Saibanmu ~Rookie Attorney Legendry' is a puzzle-solving detective game based on the Touhou series. It mainly tells the story of Marisa Kirisame who, by chance, becomes a lawyer. The story is divided into three chapters, each with multiple endings.

name: ACESurvivor
short_description: This is a refreshing survival game of shooting and slashing that uniquely combines long-distance sniping, directional rhythm fitness, equipment matching, and battlefield support gameplay. It is perfect for players who enjoy exciting battles, violent killing, and satisfying decompression.

name: Arizona Sunshine® Remake
short_description: Arizona Sunshine® Remake elevates the original, award-winning game, completely rebuilt with GORE-geous VR graphics and next-gen VR combat and weapons. Face the undead alone or with up to three fellow survivors in a post-apocalyptic southwestern America overrun by zombies.

name: The veil of the forgotten
short_description: Survive on a dark island where light is your only ally. Escape the dangers hidden in the shadows and uncover the secret that lies behind the veil.

name: Squash Ball
short_description: Welcome to Squash Ball, the ultimate idle clicker sandbox game with physics, themes, clicking stats, and a leveling system. Perfect for casual gamers and those who love to fidget with items digitally. With its colorful design and addicting gameplay, it's easy to pick up and hard to put down.

name: 100 hidden Cats : Pirates
short_description: 100 hidden Cats: Pirates is a hidden objects/clicker game. There are 100 pirate crew cats on the map, Your task is to point out all of them.

name: Sherlock Holmes – The Hunt for Moriarty
short_description: Heads up, sleuths! In this action-packed platformer, the famous detective Sherlock Holmes is in pursuit of his criminal nemesis Professor Moriarty, who has pulled off a spectacular diamond heist together with his accomplices.

name: Final Exit
short_description: Welcome to Final Exit, an escape game set in, 20-floor hospital. Play solo or team up online with friends as you hunt for clues to crack the code and escape each floor. But watch out—the hospital’s dark halls are patrolled by a doctor who is ready to find their next victim to throw inside its prison

name: Cryptid Farm
short_description: Cultivate a thriving farm to survive in this peaceful horror farming game! Play online with up to 16 players in the same lobby. Work together with your fellow farmers to repair your tractor and escape the farm, try not to fall victim to the eerie and mysterious creatures that lurk nearby.

name: They're Alive!
short_description: You are a simple provincial engineer eager to change his worthless life. What could be a better place to start everything anew than Moscow where everyone can find some way to earn for a living? But things there are not as easy as you thought…

name: Starsim
short_description: StarSim is a spaceship strategy RPG with live galaxy simulation. The game combines real-time with paused starship combat, turn-based crew combat, text quests and more. Be a hero, a trader, a scavenger, a mercenary or a pirate.

name: Mr Trials
short_description: Trials Bike Madness! Pull off stunts and as you try to pass each stage!

name: Sweep Maidens
short_description: A Minesweeper game in which anime girls assist you. (◕ω◕✿)

name: Shyondemic
short_description: You play as a Husky Girl, Survive the Pandemic, make a story path for her. Move fast or Die fast.

name: IT Startup: Tech Fodder
short_description: A dev themed Roguelike Deckbuilder. Play Developer Cards, upgrade them and watch out for burnout! Sabotage your opponents or steal their Developers. Craft a unique deck and squeeze out your employees to win the next Project Battle!

name: Demiurges
short_description: I mixed a classic turn-based strategy game (Heroes of Might and Magic 3) with deck building game like Slay the Spire. Also added a lot of reptiles :) Immerse yourself in a rich fantasy world. Develop your town and armies. Collect cards to create new crazy strategies.

name: 流る星 -a wish star-
short_description: 俺はあの日、『カミサマ』を拾った。人気イラストレーターななかまいが送る、“カミサマ”の女の子と忘れられないひと夏を過ごすビジュアルノベルです。

name: Fear Is In The Mind
short_description: Immerse yourself in Fear Is In The Mind, a psychological horror game that blurs the lines between reality and the mind's darkest corners. Face your fears, decipher the truth, and explore a world where every word can alter your fate.

name: Mati
short_description: Explore the quiet forest of Suverdale in the third person as Mati (or Matine), a 12-year-old kid visiting his grandparents on his summer vacation. In this relaxing walking simulator, try to discover the mysteries behind Suverdale's history, but expect a surprise or two.

name: Cosmic Ultramarine
short_description: 从高维度接入超次元，漫步于由你的数个前世构成的景观宇宙。藉由终端机展开一场穿越虚拟与现实、过去与未来的奇妙旅行。在一切的尽头，宇宙、自我和生命的终极答案，将为你解开面纱。

name: This game was made by AI
short_description: This game was made by AI is a roguelike action game where players navigate procedurally generated rooms, battle enemies with sword attacks, and search for potions and exits. Each run presents new challenges, requiring strategy and skill to survive and escape the endless dungeon.

name: Skygard Arena
short_description: Lead your team to victory in this fast-paced tactical RPG. Choose Champions with unique abilities to create your own strategy. Dash, teleport, and unleash game-changing combos on every turn. Complete challenging missions to save Skygard in the campaign or fight against other players in the Arena!

name: Goldenheart
short_description: Face challenges and uncover secrets in an all new, all original 3D fantasy world. Experience a rich story from a first person point of view as you journey through the carefully imagined fantasy desert realm of Tuldenorrea, and perhaps even into realms beyond.

name: Small Wars: Mohicans
short_description: Small Wars: Mohicans offers you a quick and fun to play experience of the French & Indian War (1754-1760) in the vast wilderness of 18th century North America. Play the French and their Indigenous Allies or Britain troops and colonials and gain control of the new world.

name: Spirit Mancer
short_description: Slash, Shoot and Break demons. Capture their spirits and summon them out into your battle in the beautiful yet dangerous world of Inferno. Fight against hordes of demons and stop the evil queen with the power of the Spirit Mancer.

name: Zardy's Cave
short_description: Beneath the farm something terrible awaits. You fell down a giant hole into a dark world full of terrifying scarecrows and monsters. Now you must make your way through the tunnels deep underground while watching your back. Solve puzzles, find tools, and most importantly… Stay alive!

name: Super Rolling Heroes Deluxe
short_description: Destroy, bounce, explode! Roll downhill with Super Rolling Heroes Deluxe, a 3D platformer all about maintaining momentum, pulling down every object, avoiding deadly obstacles, and collecting some nice shiny gems too.

name: INNERSCAPE
short_description: Play as a scientist in this short sci-fi horror adventure, tasked with eradicating a mutating parasite within a human body. Navigate eerie corridors, solve complex puzzles, and survive the lurking horrors inside.

name: Ambasu
short_description: Ambasu, an online role-playing game with 10 characters, has a much simpler and more balanced gameplay system compared to its counterparts. You can gain great experiences by playing fast and fun matches both alone and with your friends.

name: Metal Slug Tactics
short_description: METAL SLUG makes an explosive return! Dive into this dynamic tactical RPG with a roguelite thrill and experience the iconic run'n'gun action of the original series, redefined. Grab your weapons, assemble your squad and conquer the battlefield to defeat the infamous Rebel Army.

name: A Beaver's Tale
short_description: Set in a picturesque, Canadian maple tree forest, A Beaver's Tale is a cozy, adventure RPG. In story mode, learn to protect your beaver kits and become a master builder! In builder mode, take control and fully customize this colorful and cozy world!

name: 下一个就是你
short_description: 你跟随秦苏言调查一起十年前的学生跳楼事件时，突然收到了两封神秘的邮件。一封邀请你参加高中毕业十周年聚会，另一封则警告你如果继续调查“下一个就是你”。察觉异样的你决定赴会，试图找到更多的线索，却被卷入了一场“密室狼人杀”的局中。面对生死，是善念的互助，还是释放人性中的恶意？

name: FatSheep Crisis II
short_description: Roguelite casual game with various professions and equipment. After defeating enemies, your profession switches randomly, each with unique abilities. Play solo or with friends, explore hidden content, find the best gear, and defeat the final boss in co-op gameplay!

name: Select Oblige
short_description: Select Oblige is the latest title from the popular Japanese visual novel brand Madosoft. It features character design and artwork by renowned illustrator Hiyo Yuzuna, with the story crafted by Shoukei Wakaba. The main heroines are voiced by Hana Akino, Kanau, Ren Sagami, and Yuuka Nanakusa.

name: Tentacuddle
short_description: Tentacles have you surrounded! In this score-attack action rogue-lite, sacrifice is the key to reinforcing your power. Set the difficulty of the game and use your Ooze to battle slithering hordes. Maintain your sanity and slither your way to victory!

name: Extra Coin
short_description: Extra Coin is a story-rich life sim set between the real world and a virtual utopia: explore the city, do activities, and face your opponents. Would you rather respect the Loop or break it to find your lost parents?

name: SnackTimeActionGame
short_description: [Snackable hero experience!]Zombies in the city, a western street corner, a samurai battle... Snack time action game is a 2D action game where you can easily enjoy feeling like a hero or a monster in various situations! 6 types of situations + α&10+ playable characters! The combination is up to you!

name: Скуфоритянин
short_description: Meet Scoof, a hardened bachelor whose childhood trauma of betrayal has built an impenetrable wall around his heart. He hides in his gray world, avoiding all relationships. But a sudden encounter with a bright and enigmatic personality turns Scoof's life upside down.

name: ShipOS 1994
short_description: Are you ready to recover your family's fortune and rebuild the greatest shipping empire the world has ever known? Well if you are, then you're going to need the latest integrated shipping management system to get you there. Welcome, to ShipOS 1994

name: Fruit Run: Challenge
short_description: 'Fruit Run: Challenge' is a casual action game with parkour as its core gameplay, complemented by challenge elements. The game is easy to get started, but difficult to master. Let's embark on this adventure filled with challenges!

name: Garage Works
short_description: Car simulation game where all kinds of handling and performance affecting parts can be changed as well as tested on road or on track.

name: IHAS
short_description: Find yourself aboard a giant spaceship in IHAS, a gripping Sci-Fi adventure handcrafted by a solo Ukrainian developer. Experience intense FPS action, mind-bending puzzles, and epic boss battles.

name: One Socket
short_description: Charge the generator to power your devices, but be careful, you only have One Socket to work with. Make tough decisions to keep you safe from the monster in the dark while you solve the mysteries that will free you. Do you have what it takes to survive?

name: Stall Life
short_description: 《Selling Life》 is a simulation business game. Different characters and backgrounds have opened up a stall life due to their respective choices. In this game, you will encounter various customers and things, hoping to make money and buy a big house.

name: Infest
short_description: Infest is a roguelike deckbuilder where every pixel on the battlefield can burn, freeze, corrode, shock, and melt. Carefully craft your deck and deploy cards to alter the environment, buff your stats, and unleash stunning pixel-by-pixel damage upon your enemies!

name: The Cursed Ritual
short_description: The Cursed Ritual is a horror genre FPS game about a person who gets stuck in the middle of the forest in midnight as his car crashes. With no signal in midnight he wanders through the forest finding a shelter to pass the night and finds an abandoned house. Explore the secrets of the haunted house.

name: Pharaoh's Riches
short_description: Toss coins and explore the mysteries of Ancient Egypt! The pharaoh's golden riches await you!

name: Touch Type Tale - Strategic Typing
short_description: Touch Type Tale is the strategy game you control by typing! Join a brave new era of strategy — tactical typing. Use a satisfying mesh of mechanics across a range of surprising challenges, with storybook campaigning and online play. You are Paul. (Hi there.) And the keyboard to the kingdom is yours.

name: Koi Land
short_description: 'Koi Land' is a highly relaxing idle game. Purchase various types of koi fry, raise them over time, and sell them to earn money! Over 40 types of koi , listen to soothing music, and enjoy the sight of colorful koi as they accompany you through pleasant times!

name: Slaughter Me Street: 1999
short_description: You are being hunted for your misdeeds. With blood on your hands and weight on your conscience, you must collect the relics of your past, and confront your demons once and for all...

name: Magibrick
short_description: An uniquely styled deck-building game. Assemnble a deck with the right Magibrick and challenge diverse enemies in different regions. Fill the board, destroy enemy bricks,play amazing combo, and occupy the entire board with your Magibricks, leaving no space for your enemy.

name: Shadowhand Solitaire
short_description: Ride with Lady Cornelia Darkmoor - aristocrat by day, highwaywoman by night. Play your cards right to untangle a web of corruption, smuggling and blackmail in this swashbuckling solitaire adventure. Your fortune and freedom are at stake!

name: I'd Kiss THAT Fish
short_description: Let your creativity run wild in this Fish Dress up game and create a new Mascot, OC or Friend! Take full control of your vision with a whole wardrobe of items! Make the most stunning fish in this sandbox experience and take pictures to share your styles or create stickers to use as emojis!

name: Mishaka Ubivaka
short_description: Mishaka is an ordinary mouse with extraordinary courage. Upon learning of the cheese theft, he decides to take gun into his own paws and reclaim the lost delicacies. Throughout his adventure, Mishaka will encounter dangers, traps, and a multitude of enemies — from cunning rats to giant predators.

name: Journey to Earth
short_description: You are an experienced astronaut, stranded in space. Will you reach Earth, or will you get lost in space and die?

name: Project SJHG
short_description: The Journey to Restore the Distorted Time and Space

name: Scientist Creature
short_description: Try to escape from Dr. Henry Hoismer’s mansion while being chased by a monster we believe is called 'Prototype C – 23.' You'll have to hide, search for keys, solve a maze, and find codes in order to escape.

name: Minha Casa
short_description: Come with Robertha in this horror point'n'click about changes of life.

name: Mistwinter Bay
short_description: Rule a town in this story heavy, visual novel-like fantasy RPG! Interact with townsfolk and foreign leaders, build and expand, and tackle randomized events that affect the town and its people.

name: PortalBox
short_description: This game introduces portals to the classic box-pushing game! With the addition of portals, problems that were impossible in the ordinary box-pushing game become possible. Let’s explore this wonderful box-pushing game together!

name: Haunted Hearts Hotel
short_description: Check in to your hotel, and check out the ghosts! Sexy specters await you - but can you fix up the hotel in style so that the living guests will find luxury, too?

name: Mortal Rite
short_description: Use the ancient Godstone dagger to embody resurrected champions and fight with swappable abilities and items to reclaim the shattered lands. Mortal Rite is a crossover between a Souls-like and Roguelite game, single-player or up to 5-player Co-Op!

name: The Blogger: Pumpkins and Witches
short_description: Step into the shoes of a young photographer tasked with documenting the macabre. Explore a haunting world filled with secrets, solve chilling puzzles, and confront your deepest fears as you unravel a terrifying mystery.

name: SVA
short_description: Simple rules, extreme challenge! Just move your character and loop around bubbles to clear them. Sounds easy? Don’t be fooled—no one’s conquered this game yet. Are you up to the task?

name: Ancient Mind
short_description: Ancient Mind is a puzzle-action-adventure game about discovering the remains of an ancient civilization. Explore dungeons, fight monsters, solve puzzles, and discover the truth about ancient mysteries.

name: Max Mustard
short_description: Max Mustard is a made-for-VR platformer with 40 unique levels, 4 ridiculous bosses and 8 powerful upgrades. No boring bits! It’s the perfect combination of first-person power-ups and classic third-person platforming. This is a VR platformer you’ll find impossible to put down.

name: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024
short_description: Explore the world with our largest fleet of aircraft and take simulation to new heights while pursuing your aviation career within Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024.

name: NAIRI: Rising Tide
short_description: Explore a lively oasis city filled with charming characters, forgotten ruins and ominous conspiracies in the second chapter of NAIRI, a narrative puzzle adventure about Nairi's perilous quest to save her family.

name: Positron
short_description: Positron is a fast paced arcade style game inspired by the classic arcade games of the 80's. Battle against opponents in the Arena, navigate your way out of the Maze, and collect power-ups while avoiding your own trail in Snake.

name: Bonesaw
short_description: Bonesaw is a turn-based strategy game with a stress-inducing saw mechanic. Plan your moves carefully using special abilities to outsmart the devil, or challenge the odds against the saw and gamble the fate of your fingers… and your soul!

name: Slopecrashers
short_description: Shred the slopes in SLOPECRASHERS! Carve your way through epic courses, stomp mind-blowing tricks or unite your crew for gnarly multiplayer mayhem. Feel the rush with our next-level physics engine that brings rad arcade snowboarding action to life.

name: Just Catch Fireballs
short_description: Control a fireball-catching bucket to stop fireballs from hitting innocent villagers and their flammable homes. Get a random upgrade as you clear each wave. Twin-stick controls requiring quick thinking and hand-eye coordination. Do you have what it takes to just catch fireballs?

name: A Night Duty
short_description: Your duty as a South Korean army officer just began. You must check out mysterious anomalies to finish this endless night.

name: Teach Kids Games
short_description: This holiday season, spend quality time with your child and teach them to play games on the computer! Practice your Mouse and Keyboard Skills through Games! Explore 50+ fun mini-games for kids 3+, improve PC skills, track stats, and learn through play in a colorful, kid-friendly world!

name: MXGP 24: The Official Game
short_description: After a 3-year break, the official game of the MXGP is back. Experience the full 2024 MXGP championship with its 20 official tracks and over 50 MX1/MX2 riders. Immerse yourself in the MXGP with a full and deep career mode.

name: Way of the Bullet
short_description: Discover your breath as you shoot your way through a whimsical madness! Slash and dash in a dynamic dance against hordes of enemies and bosses! Accept your losses, and bring a friend, it's time to go again...

name: Animal Workforce: Idle Tycoon Clicker
short_description: Animal Workforce: Idle Tycoon Clicker is a simple and laid-back game that’s easy to jump into. Perfect for casual play, it lets you unwind and progress at your own pace, all while collecting rewards and achieving upgrades. There are also plenty of easily obtained Steam Achievements!

name: The Cabin Factory
short_description: Your job at the Cabin Factory is simple: inspect the cabins and decide on whether they’re haunted or not. If you do find any anomalies, get out…immediately.

name: Darling, Darling... Dead?
short_description: Yandere x yandere x yandere: one must go. Yandere x yandere, a vampire-themed Visual Novel.

name: Blackout Memphis
short_description: Blackout Memphis is a fast topdown shooter, characterized by bloody melees and action-packed gunfights. The demanding gameplay is backed by electronic music that adds a special atmosphere to the gritty and violent action.

name: Pet Lands
short_description: Collect quadrillion of coins, hatch pets to mine for you, and unlock 100 unique hand-crafted areas! An incremental clicker/idle creatures-collection adventure. Dopamine heaven has arrived!

name: Staying Fresh
short_description: Manage the culinary heroes, fight the rotten zombie food in this TBS roguelike game. Use fresh food to upgrade and create new defenders. Explore the abandoned kitchen in search of ingredients and new recipes.

name: The Void Project
short_description: Fight through relentless demon hordes in a fast-paced and retro-inspired arena shooter, where mastering speed, strategy, and precision will push you to the top of the leaderboard.

name: The Acorn Bounty
short_description: Help Samson the Squirrel battle his way through peril, as he tracks down what was ruthlessly stolen from him. Adventure through the forest battling your way through a variety of critters, unlocking cosmetic hats, completing the beastiary, and claiming what's rightfully yours.

name: Feudal Baron: King's Land
short_description: Turn a humble settlement into a medieval city! In Feudal Baron: King’s Land, you build houses, craftsmanship workshops or churches, fight battles, and create supply chains mightier than swords to satisfy your fussy citizens – or to squeeze them to the last penny.

name: Panelak
short_description: Panelak is an post soviet old apartment building where wierd things happens. Can you manage to get to the roof and save helpless man?

name: Urbex Awakening
short_description: It’s 1999. As a detective, you've discovered a set of eerie VHS tapes at a gruesome crime scene. Play as the urban explorer recorded on the tapes, reliving their terrifying journey through abandoned places. Investigate, uncover the truth, and survive the horrors captured on film.

name: CARnage
short_description: A top-down arcade combat racing game that celebrates the classic 2d racing games of old. Upgrade and expand your garage of vehicles to survive the dystopian future that is CARnage.

name: Arobynn: Sword of Adventure
short_description: [Sword Art Online]-Like | Welcome to the adventurer's guild! Fight, explore, and grow stronger in this VR world (keyboard and mouse support coming soon!).

name: Odd Remedy
short_description: Escape the open-world island infested with monster spiders while on duty as a prisoner with your friends. Loot the city, destroy the caves, take some selfies on the way out in your car before you set sail.

name: Rough Rivals
short_description: Experience the perfect blend of American football and bar brawling. Be brutal and cunning, customize your team, upgrade your players, and dominate the field! Challenge your friends in split-screen to relive the joy of couch gaming. May the fiercest one win!

name: Aquatic Store Simulator
short_description: Dive into the vibrant world of aquatic retail with Aquatic Store Simulator! Take on the challenge of managing your underwater-themed supermarket, blending business management with the beauty of marine life. Stock shelves with exotic fish, decorations, set prices, take payments and maintain aquariums

name: Judofuri
short_description: You only need one button to compete in this fruity party game! Press it, squeeze it & mash it in a series of silly mini-games for up to 9 players and claim your spot as the juiciest fruit of ‘em all!

name: 星海的流言
short_description: XingHaiDeLiuYan is a bullet-screen shooting game that features random enemy ships and bullet-screens, but also has a focus on strengthening the player's game content. Players can acquire three types of aircraft and 18 types of weapons to challenge increasingly powerful enemies.

name: Dream of a Nightmarish Runaway
short_description: At all costs, escape from a place where you should never be. The question is, can you do it?

name: Dustgrave: A Sandbox RPG
short_description: Embark on an epic journey, enjoying complete freedom in a dynamic sandbox RPG. The world and its inhabitants will witness your deeds and react accordingly, adapting the narrative to your choices and delivering a truly unique and free experience.

name: FANTASIAN Neo Dimension
short_description: Embark on an adventure to discover your memories and save the world from a mechanical infection. Maneuver your skill trajectories during battle, and dive into a new dimension with a unique twist on a classic RPG experience.

name: NoseBound
short_description: An adventure game like no other. A detective story in the vein of Film Noir. An unusual path into a paranormal realm.

name: A Shelter Full of Cats
short_description: Everyone can be a hero! Help a cat rescuer take care of her rescuees and root for their adoption! Every cat deserves a chance to be loved. ❤️

name: Dough Slapping: A Touch to Desire
short_description: Enter the quirky world of Dough Slapping: A Touch to Desire, where you slap dough with your left or right hand. Join Mark's journey filled with humor, heartfelt monologues, and unexpected revelations as you master the art of the perfect slap in this unique and comedic simulator.

name: Sumerian Six
short_description: Lead an unlikely team of commando scientists behind enemy lines to fight Nazis, uncover arcane mysteries, and wield experimental technology to turn the tide of WWII in this real-time tactical stealth adventure.

name: Dungeon Clawler
short_description: Dungeon Clawler is a Roguelike Claw Machine Deckbuilder. Build your deck, grab weapons and items from the claw machine to battle enemies, discover powerful perks that create game-changing synergies and unleash crazy combos as you fight your way through the dungeon!

name: Frog Escape
short_description: A frog girl, trapped in an underground lab, overhears a shocking plan to dispose of her. Determined to escape, she sets out to find freedom. Navigate obstacles, avoid enemies, and help her break free!

name: Poly Fire
short_description: Poly Fire is a tactical multiplayer team 1st person shooter. Using a variety of weapons and characters, you will battle with up to 32 players on Various maps . By managing your skills correctly, you will lead your team to victory.

name: Junkcity Factory Simulator
short_description: Collect scraps, manage a factory with 29 machines, 33 workers, and nearly 300 items, and sell your products in Junkcity Store. Optimize efficiency and dominate the market in this dynamic simulation game!

name: Magnet Jack
short_description: Magnet Jack is a challenging action-oriented puzzle-platformer. It has a fast-changing assortment of wacky mechanics and a top-down overworld with off-the-wall themes and characters. Alright!

name: Cosmo Chef
short_description: How to play After the game starts, press the start button to display the gameplay screen. You must obtain as many items as you can see in the bottom right, avoiding arrow-shaped obstacles flying from both sides.

name: Thumb Tanks
short_description: Tease your friends and get medals for it! Shoot, deploy mines, and use your tank's special ability to take down your buddies in this local PvP frenzy and gain bragging rights. Collect coins to buy special items, earn points for skilled play, and upgrade your tank after each round.

name: NIGHT STORE SIMULATOR
short_description: NIGHT STORE SIMULATOR - is a PSX-style simulation game where you work in a night store. Sell goods and enjoy the process.

name: The Last Humble Bee
short_description: The Last Humble Bee is a cartoony survivors-like with a lot of heart. Explore a pixelated open world, cast bumble bee magic, and slash through demonic bugs to uncover what happened to all the bumble bees.

name: Fury!
short_description: A sci-fi action arcade run-and-gun game.

name: Sweet Home 3: Look and Find Collector's Edition
short_description: Avi Games brings you the next part of the hidden object game 'Sweet Home: Look and Find'. Enjoy an even cozier collection of hidden-object tasks and mini games with 'Sweet Home Look and Find 3'! This is the collector's Edition with exclusive extras you won’t find in the standard version.

name: Suddenly Meow Christmas
short_description: A fun holiday adventure with furballs Tim and Spooky! A blend of Match 3 and Puzzle like no other!

name: Road Maintenance Simulator 2 - Winter Services
short_description: In Road Maintenance Simulator 2, you take on a variety of authentic tasks that occur every day in a road maintenance depot - now including winter service! Choose from a wide selection of tools, attachments and vehicles to master the challenges ahead.

name: Kitter
short_description: experience 2d platforming inspired by 3rd and 4th gen console games, with a modernized twist. Our novel movement system will challenge you to reach new levels of self-expression in your traversal of a 2d world.

name: Sprite's Honor!
short_description: In Sprite’s Honor!, a colony farming sim, troop leader Teal must lead a marooned group of scout fairies home by collecting resources and regrowing the island’s native seedlings to liberate them from invading gnomes.

name: Esca
short_description: Esca is a gripping survival RPG where you play as a repair robot maintaining an underwater research station, facing tough decisions and uncovering secrets of your past.

name: Lost Lost Lost
short_description: An adventure puzzle game where you explore a colorless city to find hidden red, green, and blue color balls, solving challenges to restore vibrancy to Relax City.

name: Completely Stretchy
short_description: A befuddling mishap has made you COMPLETELY STRETCHY! Stretch, swing and stick around the delightfully odd and vibrant Grombi Isles in this eccentric and light-hearted 3D platformer.

name: Black Dragon Mage
short_description: The Hall of Relics calls out to you, traveler! Unleash elemental magic, slay demon hordes, and absorb their souls to grow in power. Hatch your very own companion dragon from an egg. Fly your dragon into battle. Avenge your death. An action-roguelite survivors shooter.

name: CaveLoop
short_description: In the world of Caveloop an evil villain has trapped you in his cave without any clear motive. It is up to you to surmount the scientist and escape the cave. Level up and unlock new weapons. Blast through the enemies with your favorite gun while wearing a neat hat.

name: Frontline Footage
short_description: Frontline Footage is a tactical first-person shooter with a bodycam perspective. Play as José Herrera, a GOE rookie officer, and uncover a conspiracy in Ecuador. Featuring realistic graphics and strategic gameplay, every decision is crucial for survival.

name: 3.2m2
short_description: Don't try to find achievement in this game. Don't try to make something of your life. You are very nothing. if you only know the room you can use and the duties you have, you can clear this game . . . even your ego

name: We Are Alive
short_description: We Are Alive is a Co-Op horror game, that can be played with at least 1 and up to 4 players. You are a detective and your mission is to investigate the old psychiatric hospital and find out the truth. Your standard equipment is a flashlight and a gun.

name: Songs of the HMong
short_description: A Hmong girl named Xiaomiao meets a mysterious old man in the forest who has lost his memory. The old man tells Xiaomiao that to restore world order, she needs to find the seed of the Sacred Tree. Can Xiaomiao, with the power of music, successfully find the seed of the sacred tree?

name: Ambulance Driver Life VR
short_description: Experience the intensity of emergency response in Ambulance Life, where you drive the ambulance and perform life-saving medical interventions in VR.

name: Only a Billion?!
short_description: Congratulations, you won a billion dollars! Now it's time to find a way to spend it. It might prove more difficult than it sounds.

name: “LIGHT” IS
short_description: LIGHT IS is a 2D platform jumping game about exploration and puzzle solving. Explore the hand drawn style underground city. Use thinking, operation, and ability to reach new areas. Finally discovering the secrets of the world.

name: Cosmic Outpost
short_description: Cosmic Outpost is a turn-based strategy game where you build an outpost on a new planet. As pioneers, you will construct an outpost while defending against enemies. Gather enough materials to build a spaceship to explore new worlds and expand humanity's frontiers!

name: Flower For A Farewell
short_description: Flower For A Farewell is a visual novel, Scroller-Adventure, that takes you on a journey with a turtle named Toby, who is going through grief. Meet characters who are dealing with a similar painful experience.

name: Čtyřlístek a Strašidelný hrad
short_description: Čtyřlístek a strašidelný hrad' přináší legendární český komiks k životu v úchvatné 4K grafice, která zachovává původní umělecký styl Jaroslava Němečka. Připojte se k Fifince, Myšpulínovi, Pinďovi a Bobíkovi na nezapomenutelné cestě na tajemný hrad Okřín.

name: Jellies of the Deep
short_description: Explore a dreamy, hand-drawn world where little deep-sea jellies roam. Jellies of the Deep is a relaxing, hidden object and spot-the-difference game in one.

name: Mystical Maritime Adventure
short_description: Here, you can freely sail your ship, explore the endless ocean, and find hidden islands and treasures!

name: Kill Dee
short_description: Kill Dee is a super interesting platformer with a super exciting story. It has a mix of parkour and fighting. The game changes gameplay from level to level, but mainly it is a platformer. It contains 2 story lines.

name: Japanese Psycho
short_description: Stop the invaders and save the city in this dynamic arena third-person shooter. The city has no hope, there is only a crazy girl

name: Veiled Edge
short_description: Veiled Edge is a dynamic cyberpunk action-adventure platformer featuring multi-genre gameplay and innovative hacking mechanics. Dive, hack, and adapt your abilities to uncover the secrets of Full-Dive technology in a thrilling journey through virtual worlds.

name: World Drawn
short_description: World Drawn is a game in which you play as two characters who save a young girl.

name: EXFIL
short_description: A realism-focused milsim, combining sandbox elements and tactical round-based FPS gameplay. Up to four teams of eight battle to secure objectives in short, customizable, single-life matches. Enjoy self-hosted or dedicated server options, ensuring you and your community can always access the action.

name: Flashcard Hero
short_description: Foreign language vocab builder. Level up your hero and progress through increasingly difficult challenges with innovative flashcard combat! This unique study method is currently available in French, German, Spanish, Italian, Russian, Ukrainian, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Arabic, and Turkish!

name: SHLEMO
short_description: Action-packed stories of 3 different guys who kill people to get to a briefcase with supposed wealth. The question is which of them will get it, will it solve their problems, which of them will die and what is in the briefcase?

name: ONIBITO KIKI
short_description: Experience ONIBITO KIKI’s first game adaptation in 90s-style 2D action! Play as KIKI, leader of the ONIBITO clan, using special abilities to conquer tough missions. Enjoy retro pixel art combined with modern gameplay—join KIKI on an epic adventure!

name: Incredible Dracula: Academy of Shadows
short_description: Join Dracula to stop runaway students, recover magical items, and restore order before a graduation ceremony begins. In doing so, you’ll face fears, conquer challenges, and finally prove that the legendary Count Dracula isn’t one to be trifled with.

name: Cookie Monster Clicker
short_description: Bake cookies endlessly and feed the monsters! Grow cookie monsters with powerful jaws by making strategic upgrades and hiring workers. Use the prestige system to speed up progress, unlock all upgrades, and enjoy the stunning visual feast!

name: The Backrooms: Anomaly Containment Unit
short_description: A first-person horror game with bodycam gameplay and tight controls. Explore the eerie, randomly generated Backrooms, catch anomalies, solve puzzles, and face atmospheric horror. Survive endless corridors in this intense PC survival experience.

name: SpellWheel
short_description: Strategic puzzle-like combat where you mix runes with a magic wheel to defeat goblins, knights, and killer robots. Experiment with magical runes, fight quirky enemies, and defy the will of Death itself, all to rescue your beloved.

name: Clione's Bomb-Bomb Sweeper
short_description: A spin-off from the asymmetric party action game 'Goonya Monster,' with character designs by Terada Tera! Break through the oncoming blocks and advance! This is a fresh, exhilarating puzzle action game that fuses bomb puzzles with unique 'Goonya Monster' action!

name: Sister Lumina and the Hypnosis Cult
short_description: When Lumina is forced to open a forbidden book passed down by her grandmother in order to rescue her best friend, she will have to pay a hefty price to gain the power to free her and ensure her safety.

name: Depths of Endor: Dungeon Crawler
short_description: Classic turn-based dungeon RPG. Join guilds, explore dungeons, and collect loot! Dive into a retro-styled adventure that combines the best elements of old-school role-playing games with modern features of a roguelike.

name: Slug's Sister Defense
short_description: A spin-off from the asymmetric party action game 'Goonya Monster,' with character designs by Terada Tera! Experience exhilarating roguelike tower-defense action! Defend the captive Snail from enemies approaching from all directions by acquiring and upgrading a variety of weapons and gear!

name: MemoryMaze
short_description: MemoryMaze is an atmospheric puzzle-platformer where you roll through vibrant, wind-swept levels, shift realities, and use the environment to solve puzzles. Explore hidden paths in a world full of color and mystery.

name: Industrial Annihilation
short_description: The next major game in the Planetary Annihilation universe, Industrial Annihilation combines the iconic real-time strategy of the beloved Annihilation games with deep factory-building to deliver a blend of genres unlike any you’ve experienced before.

name: Revelations
short_description: Revelations is a zombies passion project created solely by me, Brock de Beaubien. It's heavily inspired by bo2 and bo3 zombies.

name: Cardaire
short_description: Explore, collect, and build sweet decks. Cardaire is a single-player collectible card RPG. Adventure awaits in the Duelist Frontier, so crack some packs and bring your best deck to take on the challenge.

name: Dungeon Inn
short_description: This is a cozy strategy management game where you manage an inn placed cleverly at the mouth of a dungeon. Juggle visits and business from 2 rivaling guilds, maximize profits, but keep your double-dealing a secret! Keep everyone happy and watch your inn thrive!

name: Stones of Flesh
short_description: You are flesh, blood and bones. A fragile mortal, in a land of something far bigger than yourself.

name: Dungeon Deck
short_description: Explore a dungeon in the form of a deck of cards! Collect rare items, build your own deck, and defeat the dungeon in this cozy card-based roguelike!

name: Ship Of Mist
short_description: In the future world, artificial intelligence will replace the human brain, causing humans to lose their dreams and self-awareness. Weak Water will steal dream storage tanks to restore self-awareness and earn rich rewards for a small number of people, but she will encounter various thrilling events.

name: One Little World
short_description: What is One Little World? A unique collection of mini-games featuring puzzles and action. Play 'BoxMover,' inspired by Sokoban, and 'SuperAlien,' a shooting-style game. Aim for high scores or clear stages for fun!

name: Hidden Cats In ButtonWood Street
short_description: Find cute cats in Buttonwood Street. Can you find them all? Meow Meow...Kittens are calling you！

name: Sayonara Okaasan
short_description: Sayonara Okaasan is an interactive abstract poem about saying goodbye to a mother and exploring life and death.

name: Art Spotting Co-op
short_description: Art Spotting Co-op is a casual game about spotting the difference between several art pieces together with a friend while listening to relaxing music. A controller is not required for local co-op play.

name: Coffee Beans
short_description: Coffee Beans - A fun and challenging Match 3 Type Game

name: Faith Of Life _ Survive Edition
short_description: Third-person combat shooter that mixes zombies, action, horror, and sci-fi elements. It features two distinct missions' modes and an exhilarating arena. Enjoy and have a fantastic time!

name: LazerGrrl
short_description: Fast paced PVP strategy. Bomberman meets RTS.

name: Undead West
short_description: A western themed roguelite bullet hell where the player uses an array of weapons, whiskey infusions and buffs gained from defeating bosses to complete each stage.

name: 风之歌
short_description: In this visual novel, you will meet a group of distinct characters with different pasts from the perspective of an ordinary college student - the protagonist Luo Yu, and experience a profound love story, feeling youth and illusion in the university where you are studying.

name: Dead Dawg Delivery Co.
short_description: Deliver the package, sabotage your friends, and avoid the horrors lurking in procedurally generated maps. Only one of you can claim the reward—everyone else is just in the way.

name: Blaster Bunny Redemption
short_description: Due to an experiment failure, a machine explodes and causes all humans to turn into bunnies. The protagonist, Gunner Bunny, must investigate and find out who is behind this matter, and the disappearance of his wife, Fire Lily!

name: Pixel Arcade
short_description: Portal into neon cyberspace in Pixel Arcade®. Defy gravity, optimize your strategy, and vault through adrenaline-packed levels. Achieve global dominance in the leaderboard to become a VR champion in the ultimate test of precision and agility.

name: Guns of Succubus 2
short_description: A boy named 'Cain' has lost his memories. Join him and the musket-wielding succubus maid 'Grenadier' as you shoot your way through hordes of diverse monster girls! Can he safely recover his memories and return to his happy days? That's entirely up to the choices you, the player, make!

name: SUGOROKU CASINO PARTY
short_description: Get ready for a thrilling adventure of strategy and luck! Let's play Sugoroku Casino Party!

name: Archetype and the Four Winds of Hell
short_description: Master the four elements, and kill demons. In this short Metroidvania, you play as the Archetype, a legendary elemental master, on a mission to close a portal to hell and end a demon invasion. Learn new abilities, fight demons, and if you fail, be reincarnated with mastery of a different element.

name: BECOME THE DEVIL
short_description: Two college students travel to a remote area to interview the owner of a resort. Along the way, locals warn them to stay away from the people at the resort. Since the new owner moved in, strange incidents have frequently occurred. The locals suspect something terrifying must be lurking in the resort

name: Crazy Voyage
short_description: Enter this journey and help your pilot to destroy all kinds of opponents that will stand in his way in 6 different worlds. A vertical shooting game with the aim of destroying obstacles and reaching the defined distance to detonate the boss of each level. Travel in this universe of oddities!!!

name: Oceanarium
short_description: Oceanarium is a meditative underwater interplanetary exploration game about all the forces that tie the strange creatures of the universe together.

name: Whispers Of Fear
short_description: You step into the shoes of a woman being stalked by a mysterious figure. What was supposed to be a safe haven in an isolated forest house turns into a nightmare as strange events unfold during the night. Each night grows more terrifying... Can you escape before it’s too late?

name: DREAMERS
short_description: Created by an indie team of two people, DREAMERS is inspired by the stories and games of our childhood with slow-paced narration grounded in good moral values. Designed to be played with a gamepad, DREAMERS delivers a cozy, family-friendly experience.

name: Cursed New Year
short_description: Cursed New Year is a first-person psychological horror. You are a children's animator who has come to another challenge on the eve of the holiday, but something goes wrong...

name: Dicey Chess
short_description: A chess game in which the throw of the dice decides how far you can move.

name: Ravensthorn
short_description: Woken up on an uncharted land, it is now up to you to defend the Dreamrealm from corruption. Embark on a folkloric journey and find out what's the source of all evil in this world of fairytales.

name: Broke Alchemist Emma's Debt Repayment Plan
short_description: Emma, a young alchemist living in Echichi Town, suddenly has to repay a debt of 1,000,000 gold after her mother, Beth, goes missing. As it turns out, Beth had a debt with the Baron, but was unable to repay it due to unknown circumstances. Will Emma be able to repay this immense amount of money?

name: Slenderman: Shadow of the Forest
short_description: Slenderman: Shadow of the Forest - is a thrilling first-person horror game that immerses you in a terrifying and mystical forest. Your goal is to find a way out of this dark and gloomy place by collecting necessary items that will help you survive and escape to freedom.

name: Prison  X - Chapter 1: The Devil and The Sun
short_description: Heavy doors open and you're swept into the surreal world of Prison X, an infamous Bolivian jail in the Neo-Andean underworld. As you navigate amongst devils, saints, wicked characters, corrupt prison guards and even a Western filmmaker; hold onto your soul so La Diabla doesn't snatch it away.

name: Beff Jezos Simulator
short_description: Build Your Online Empire! Create and manage your store in Beff Jezos Simulator. Customize your shop, source products, set prices, hire employees and grow your business. Face realistic challenges with addictive gameplay, perfect for all gamers. Don’t forget to ask yourself—what would Beff Jezos do?

name: Lexica
short_description: Lexica is a word-puzzle, roguelike deckbuilder where you harness the power of classic books to spell your way to victory.

name: Gunslinger Express
short_description: Defend a moving train against relentless bandit attacks. Shoot enemies, repair wagons and upgrade your character as you explore diverse regions each with unique guns, enemies and upgrades.

name: Cyber Quest
short_description: Cyber Quest is a roguelike deck-building game where you pit your crew against the toughest gangs in the city. Assemble your team, gather weapons, and restore order.

name: Footage
short_description: Unravel a spiritual entity, learn its behavior, manage your anxiety, loot for medicine, and exorcise its presence.

name: Ninja Former
short_description: Dive into the fast-paced world of NinjaFormer, a 2.5D platformer where you control a skilled parkour ninja. Navigate hardcore levels, pick up powerful abilities, and face off against ninja and samurai enemies. With no checkpoints until the end, only the swiftest will prevail!

name: KartMania Silver
short_description: Invite your friends to have fun with you playing KartMania! A Kart game where you race around the tracks in the universe of Silver Games games, use and abuse special items to get ahead of your friends and thus win first place! Speed ​​to glory in KartMania Silver!

name: Cataclysm: Bright Nights
short_description: Cataclysm: Bright Nights is now on Steam! A reimagining of classic survival in the roguelike genre: featuring a deep crafting system, dynamic events, and unique threats in a post-apocalyptic world. Develop your skills, build shelters, and explore a vast world filled with dangers and opportunities.

name: I AM DOG
short_description: I AM DOG is a 2D vertical scrolling platformer where you play as DOG! CHOMP, STOMP and BOMB your way through dirt, stone and enemies and reach the bottom of the DEPTHS to rescue DOG’s friends!

name: Traverse Colour Space
short_description: Traverse Colour Space is a maze game where the player is also building walls as they move. Similar to a Hamiltonian Path the player must find the best path of best fit though each level to maximise their points. As the player collects paint they gain more points as they move about.

name: Irritated Mind: Fear of Warehouse
short_description: After a tragic event, moving to a new city leads you to work in a dark warehouse. Unravel the mysteries surrounding the protagonist's past and survive through 5 shifts, avoiding ruthless enemies, where a convoluted story unfolds in the style of retro-stylized graphics.

name: The Slime Races
short_description: Slime Races is the ultimate Twitch-integrated meme game where your viewers can join the fun by predicting which slime will win the race! Watch the slimes wobble and squish their way to the finish line in this completely automated showdown.

name: Grizzly Man
short_description: 1983, Alaska... During the Salmon Run, a deadly figure known as The Grizzly Man terrorizes a group of tourists led by Bob, an amnesiac former Man in Black. Survive the journey or become the catch of the day in this breathtaking pixel-art interactive fiction with heart-pounding pace!

name: Defensurvivor
short_description: DEFENSURVIVOR is a strategy game where you build obstacles and place and move units to block zombies. There are various units with unique characteristics and powerful high-level units that can be obtained through combination. Use randomly given units to survive until the end!

name: Critter Café
short_description: Welcome to your Critter Café! Rescue and bond with adorable, fantasy critters in need of your help and build a new home together. Design and run your own café, care for your critters, uncover the secrets of mysterious portals, and create a wholesome café for all to enjoy!

name: Jerico Proxyma - Zsivanyur
short_description: At the end of human civilization, the world's most unfortunate mercenary squad accidentally sets off a chain reaction that completely transforms Jerico Proxyma's solar system and sheds light on the history of dark creation in this corner of the galaxy. Outlawman!

name: 帝缚山海
short_description: 《帝缚山海》是一款以修仙元素，山海经背景的开放式收集养成探索游戏。玩家作为修仙者，踏上一段令人激动的征程！你可以寻找、封印、培养异兽，组建最强队伍，也加入神域，强化自身，招募绝世豪侠，灵草种植，挖矿钓鱼，云游四海八荒，与仙侣双修，当圣兽被镇压，一切的阴谋才得以浮现。

name: Iron Trails: Outlaw Pursuit
short_description: Step into a semi-open world where your mission is to deliver supplies to stations while fending off bandits. Explore a vast, relaxing environment while engaging in shootouts or simply enjoying the scenery. Each delivery strengthens your country’s war effort. Are you ready for the challenge?

name: 星界远航 Stellar Realm Voyage
short_description: A high degree of freedom space shooting game for building spacecraft. Modular editing, building a spaceship like 'building blocks'. Order, branching, and inheritance of weapons, constructing weapon systems like true 'magic'. Physics based motion systems, diverse, shield, energy systems, and more.

name: ION Shift
short_description: ION Shift offers fast-paced, precision combat with sleek visuals, designed for fans of Katana Zero. Play as a deadly creature and destroy everything in your path to escape.

name: Go
short_description: Classic Weiqi, Igo, Baduk, 圍棋 Discover Go Like Never Before! Welcome to a world where strategy and skill meet in the ancient game of Go, now available at your fingertips.

name: Little Heroes
short_description: A real-time strategy game where you build your own army to consolidate your territory.

name: Entropy Survivors
short_description: Entropy Survivors is a bullet hell roguelike where you simultaneously control a powerful mech and a sharpshooting space frog, featuring outrageously creative abilities and powerful weapon customization. Save the universe in single player or 2-4 player online co-op!

name: Bonnie Blob in Shapeville
short_description: Welcome to Shapeville, a colorful world filled with friendly shapes and endless fun! Meet Bonnie Blob, a bubbly little hero with a curious mind and a heart full of adventure. Explore the whimsical corners of Shapeville, where every click brings something delightful to life!

name: Lower? Higher!
short_description: your pawnshop will usher in guests with different needs every day, bargain with them, let the income soar! With the expansion of pawnshops, activities such as sending shop assistants and responding to emergencies are also essential. you seem ordinary transaction may cause the butterfly effect.

name: Nightmare Flight
short_description: A first person horror game that takes place on an airplane. Play as a lone pilot that must survive three different horror scenarios. Check on passengers and noises in the plane, but do not leave the cockpit for too long, or you will plummet to your doom.

name: Morning Brew: Coffee Shop Management Simulator
short_description: Run and expand your own cozy restaurant in a peaceful Italian village. Serve bakery items and coffee to customers while customizing and upgrading your space. A relaxing simulation with resource management and building, perfect for stress-free, creative gameplay.

name: Swine's Revenge
short_description: Enter the dark and twisted world of Swine's Revenge, a first-person horror game. Play as a police officer investigating disappearances around a secluded farm. What starts as a routine case quickly descends into a nightmare as you uncover sinister secrets lurking in the shadows.

name: Containment Corp, Inc.
short_description: A co-op horror game where you team up with friends to hunt anomalies and collect rare loot. Customize your loadouts, your looks, and get to work!

name: Raccoon on a boat
short_description: Get unforgettable photos at the ultimate eco-learning park, Raccoons on a Boat. A boat ride at night is always fun.

name: Digseum
short_description: Digseum is a short incremental journey about digging up ancient relics and building the greatest museum ever!

name: Proto Garden
short_description: Factory automation, but the conveyor belts are bees! Gather pollen, automate honey production, and research new flowers to create your own ecosystem from the ground up.

name: KLETKA
