short_description: KLETKA is a co-op (up to 6 players) horror game about going down in an elevator that is trying to eat you. Feed the elevator, explore deadly floors and descend deeper.

name: Suffering with Tang Sanzang
short_description: For people who enjoy suffering, or those who enjoy making friends suffer.

name: Sainthood
short_description: Sainthood is a cozy strategy game about serving your community and growing your faith. Explore a miniature world and help the islanders by constructing buildings, delivering resources, and volunteering. Pray and attend to other spiritual activities as you rise to become a Saint!

name: That's My Monster: Neighbor Among Us
short_description: A turn-based strategy and supernatural investigation game where you hunt and capture paranormal creatures. As a member of Monster Hunters, you will interrogate suspects, use specialized tools, and battle against ghosts, vampires, demons, and more while uncovering dark secrets.

name: Escape the End
short_description: Lead survivors through a crumbling city, building a thriving colony amidst chaos. Manage resources, construct buildings and defences, and deploy units to protect your people. Every decision shapes your colony's fate in this strategic survival management game.

name: Heal The Survivors
short_description: Heal The Survivors is a horde survival game, where survival means staying awake, while trying to heal as many patients as possible. Collect coins to buy upgrades, advancing thru multiple incidents, crewmembers, and difficulties, using a wide assortment of tools and skills.

name: ANTONBLAST
short_description: ANTONBLAST is a fast-paced explosive action platformer that's all about destruction. Play as the enraged Dynamite Anton (or his cranked-out coworker Annie) and use your Mighty F’n Hammer to demolish bizarre worlds, tussle with screen-filling bosses, and steal your Spirits back from Satan!

name: Open Hunting XL
short_description: Open Hunting XL is a hunting simulator with an emphasis on player freedom. Quickly spot animals using your drone or sneak and spot with binoculars depending on the difficulty you select. Hunt in several locations and level up to unlock mechanics seen in no other hunting game.

name: Santa Slides to Town
short_description: Race through snowy slopes with Santa! Dodge obstacles, collect stars, and unlock levels, upgrades, and sleigh skins. Play solo, split-screen, or online in festive fun!

name: ワールド・ネバーランド～オルルド王国物語～EXPERIENCE OF FICTION LIFE
short_description: In the peaceful, fictional country of 'World Neverland,' where many people live, players can freely enjoy work, training, romance, child-rearing, participation in events and tournaments, and all aspects of life. It’s a game where you can relax, unwind, and feel happy.

name: The Big Book of Monsters
short_description: EARLY ACCESS: Embark on an epic journey in The Big Book of Monsters! Customize your heroes, face unique enemies across adventures, and master a dynamic upgrade system. Unlock powerful abilities, manage alchemy timers, and dive into a prestige system where strategy shapes your path to ultimate power.

name: Fallen Depths
short_description: 'Explore a building that has become a den of monsters and recover crucial documents.' Fallen Depths is a roguelike action horror game where you navigate procedurally generated maps and aim to reach the top floor. Use logical strategies to overcome grotesque monsters.

name: Horizon's Mirage
short_description: Horizon's Mirage is an atmospheric first-person platformer set in a deserted cityscape where all kinds of anomalies and dangers await. Explore and search for ability points to unlock powers like slow motion, jetpack, air dash and more.

name: Chromapix
short_description: This is an extremely relaxing pixel art game. The operation is simple. Just hold down the mouse and drag to fill in the colors. It's easy to get started. Come and enjoy the fun of coloring and relieve your stress!

name: Idle Tiers
short_description: A real idle game with more than 2000 upgrades and deep management

name: Backyard Soccer '98
short_description: Return to the soccer field with your favorite Backyard athletes! The original Backyard Soccer 1998 is back and now enhanced to run on Steam. Build your roster from among the iconic Backyard Kids. Kick, pass, and score in this classic game that made soccer fun for everyone!

name: Chroma Zero
short_description: Explore a unique and connected world. Understand its fragile balance, uncover its deepest questions, and find more than just the answers.

name: Midori no Kaori
short_description: Welcome to Midori no Kaori, a relaxing cozy game that allows you to create your own Japanese shop and manage customers. There are no winners or losers here, just unleash your creativity and enjoy a unique experience.

name: Druta-Cinta
short_description: Druta-Cinta is a relaxing and replayable game to play in your free time that doesn't require your full attention. Time is controlled by the player, and the speed of obstacles matches the player, so take your time in here.

name: Slime Puzzle Story
short_description: Slime Puzzle Story is a slime-rolling puzzle game set in a mysterious village filled with puzzles. Journey through this comedic adventure story!

name: Food Delivery Simulator
short_description: Live the life of a food delivery driver. Deliver orders, earn money, upgrade your vehicle, explore a vast city, and make way to your success. Dive into a realistic daily adventure and level up to become the best delivery driver.

name: Jump & Fall
short_description: Jump & Fall is a challenging platformer game where players control a tiny assassin, using simple movement and jumping mechanics to move precisely between platforms.

name: Billy Saves the World
short_description: A narrative-driven platformer that lets you choose between action or adventure.

name: babe-lathe
short_description: Climb and explore the Queen's tower-island in this grid-based 3D platformer filled with bonk-like random encounters, mischievous ghosts, tricky jumps and a horrible, horrible curse..

name: Haloo
short_description: Fight the endless mass of enemies, collect loot, get stronger and Haloo!

name: LAYERED ORDEAL
short_description: LAYERED ORDEAL is a bullet time FPS. A barrage of various bosses will attack you. Take advantage of the slow-motion feature to avoid the barrage, defeat the bosses, and reach the lowest level.

name: SIX FINGERS الأصابع الستة
short_description: Six Fingers is a psychological horror game where you solve puzzles, face obstacles, and experience Jump scares in a terrifying environment that tests your psychological strength

name: Elevator 25
short_description: You are trapped in an office on the 25th floor. Observe your surroundings carefully to reach the exit on floor 0.

name: CheckOut
short_description: Checkout is a psychological horror walking simulator where players attempt to escape from endlessly looping hotel corridors. The game delivers an intense immersion with its tension-building soundtrack and realistic graphics. Unravel the hidden stories and find your way out of the hotel.

name: Enigma of Fear
short_description: Become Mia, a paranormal detective searching for her missing father inside the Perimeter - a place that doesn't exist. Investigate clues like a real detective and unravel the mysteries behind the Enigma of Fear, defeating the terrible monsters who'll try to stop you.

name: Keyboard Crush
short_description: 2D action game where every click determines your survival! Enemy shapes - squares, circles and triangles - drop down from above and it's your job to destroy them before they overwhelm you. Each enemy has its own specific characteristics that force you to be ever vigilant and quick.

name: Irresistible Love
short_description: 在本作中，你因意外进入文艺圈，成为即将出道的男子偶像团体的生活助理，一步步从一个小助理成为陪伴团体成员一起出道的经纪人。在这一过程中，你将与偶像团体成员们共同成长，找到工作目标与动力，并找到属于自己真爱的方向！

name: Recycling Factory
short_description: Your goal in this horror game is simple: collect bodies, get rid of them, and find a way out. But in this dark place, everything is dangerous. Solve puzzles and escape the fear that surrounds you.

name: Eden Survivors
short_description: Welcome, hackers, you're being transferred to Eden City to defend its citizens against the alien threat! Eden Survivors is a single-player survivor-like auto-shooter where players must defeat hordes of alien invaders until the extraction time.

name: Red Star Over America
short_description: Red Star Over America is a political simulation game that establishes a proletarian political party in the United States, expands propaganda through various means, fights against bourgeois parties, and ultimately achieves victory!

name: Ducky Runnerz
short_description: Ducky Runnerz is a fast-paced 2D precision platformer where you play as a determined mother duckling rescuing her stolen eggs from the malicious raccoon gang!

name: Legacy of Kain™ Soul Reaver 1&2 Remastered
short_description: Experience the epic conflict of Kain and Raziel in original form or with remastered graphics.

name: BLOCK-CRACKER
short_description: A Simple Game That Does What It Does.

name: They Yearn For The Mines
short_description: 'Can you feel it?..... The yearning for the mines!' Are you ready to send some Goblins into the Mines? In this fast paced action adventure game your job is to guide many many Goblins through the Mine to either their death or the sweet sweet glory of reaching the ore!

name: Golden Mansion
short_description: Smart people go to college, and college graduates live in apartments. My cousin didn't go to college, but he had an apartment. I went to college, but I have not graduated, now I am helping my cousin. My cousin doesn’t care who lives in the apartment, he cares about how much rent I receive.

name: Pepper Blast
short_description: Experience explosive match-3 gameplay with 5 sizzling modes: Classic, Rock, Ice Block, Thief, and Fusion. Overcome unique challenges across 85 fiery levels. Ready to feel the burn? Chili Blast is waiting!

name: Bleak
short_description: Dissatisfaction and frustration are common feelings in life. You face a path where every choice can bring you closer to or further from the improvement you so desire. Difficult decisions require strong wills.

name: Savage Arena: Dead Ball Zone
short_description: Savage Arena: Dead Ball Zone is a futuristic all-out action sports game, which seamlessly combines frenetic sporting action, brutal special moves, and quick draw weaponry to deliver addictive, balls-out arcade style gameplay.

name: Friendly Sheeps: A Cozy Simulator
short_description: FRIENDLY SHEEPS is a relaxing sheep farming game in which you create your dream farm in a peaceful, colorful world. With its simple gameplay, meet the needs of your sheeps, craft and sell your products, and grow your business!

name: Aquarium at August 32nd VR
short_description: The rumor says that strange events will come to those who recite the words to regret their summer vacation. On 32nd of August, you will become part of an urban myth. A mysterious day at the curious aquarium awaits you.

name: Code Breaker
short_description: Welcome to the wireless security code-breaking trial system CODE BREAKER. This system digitizes security system code into a virtual format or “brick breaker video game.” You will have access to the three systems: Code Breaker, Classic, and SYSTEM UNKNOWN, each offering alternate gameplay styles.

name: SGS Battle For: Fort Donelson
short_description: Fight the first decisive battle of the U.S. Civil War. Lead the Union force as General Grant to seize the key forts on the Cumberland, or play the Confederate defenders to maintain the gate to the South closed.

name: Dominate & Conquer
short_description: Dominate & Conquer is a tactics autobattler set in a medieval fantasy world. Take on the role of a king and challenge rival kings for their resources. Build your army by choosing from a variety of units. Enhance your army further by creating synergies between units based on their skills.

name: Cast Dice Away
short_description: A board game-style survival adventure on a deserted island! In Cast Dice Away, roll dice to explore the island, gather resources, and survive. Each roll triggers unpredictable events, challenging you to strategically navigate diverse environments as you seek escape.

name: Outbreak Survivors
short_description: In the apocalypse, survive against the zombies until the rescue come for you. In this Action Roguelite game, you will unlock new weapons, characters and unique skills to help in your survival.

name: REM: The Dreamer
short_description: 'REM: The Dreamer' is a single-player action-shooter game set in the depths of dreams. Are you ready for Harvey's war against the gods, or are you too weak for it?

name: Guidus Zero
short_description: Guidus Zero is a real-time grid-based action roguelike game. Explore the sinkhole known as the 'Scar' to search for spirits and treasure chests, and defeat the corrupted enemies and bosses as you strive to reach the deepest floor of the Scar, where the source of chaos awaits.

name: Rogue Gladius Survivors
short_description: Aim to be the fastest conqueror in the world with special moves and the strongest build! Rogue Gladius Survivors is an Isekai Musou SpeedRun survivors-like game.

name: Layup Legends™
short_description: The basket-brawler for up to 4 players! Use your skills to outplay your opponents on a variety of stages. Unleash powerful super moves to destroy your enemies and become a Layup Legend. Play with your friends or CPUs in 1v1 and 2v2 matches locally or online.

name: Space Wackos
short_description: Space Wackos is an online and local party shooter for 1-8 players. Featuring 2 game modes, over 10 maps and and over 12 game types, players have the freedom fight against each other in free-for-all or as a team in Coop and PVP games.

name: Dungeon of Grandmasters
short_description: You've embarked on an adventure in a cave. Take out all the monsters that will try to defeat you and survive until the end. Dungeon of Grandmasters is a roguelite game that allows you thousands of combinations to defeat the enemies that appear, allowing you to play alone or with friends.

name: 修仙•母珠传 Pig Training Legend
short_description: Cultivate immortals, grow vegetables, and make elixirs. You are a disciple of a sect, and the master thinks you have learned everything he has taught you. Now it is time for you to practice! Go to Dongshan until you defeat the last female demon!

name: World Crafter TD
short_description: A highly addictive survival crafting tower defense game! Gather, craft, build turrets, shoot guns, and expand the land to defend against waves of enemies in World Crafter TD!

name: Claymores of the Lost Kingdom
short_description: We infused a fast Roguelike Deckbuilder with classless RPG progression to give you an open sandbox adventure. Forge your hero and increase your attributes to craft a deck that changes based on your unique build. Level up, hunt bandits, and get strong enough to face the Harbinger of Doom.

name: Coffee Quest VR
short_description: The ultimate coffee shop simulator where you become a professional barista

name: 喵路昭昭 The long journey
short_description: In order to find the lost cat, the girl must embark on a difficult road！

name: Mammon: Devil Help
short_description: Mammon: Devil Help is a turn-based, resource management, indirect battle between you and the will of any unfortunate victims. Drive them to desperation and buy their souls while being a human in the shoes of the Devil.

name: Who Needs to Study?
short_description: The emptiness of the chosen path ensnares souls, hindering their progress. A soft, relentless fading persists, where only hope has the power to interrupt it...

name: While Sleeping
short_description: A first-person horror game dealing with sleep paralysis. You are lying in bed, unable to move, experiencing creepy phenomena and having to survive until morning from ghosts.

name: Ballionaire
short_description: BALLIONAIRE is a fast-paced, kinetic roguelike where strategy meets physics to create outrageous wealth! Find and exploit game-breaking synergies as you theorycraft your way to victory. Welcome to the autobonker genre!

name: Sociable Soccer 25
short_description: Embrace the excitement of the world's favorite sport in Sociable Soccer 25. Created by legendary game designer Jon Hare, Sociable Soccer 25 features his signature fast-paced, arcade-style and intuitive gameplay, enriched with multiplayer head-to-head matches and collectible player cards.

name: Loco Motive
short_description: On the Reuss Express a passenger has been murdered, and you’re the prime suspects. Uncover a thrilling mystery and solve satisfying point and click puzzles to prove your innocence! A slapstick adventure, packed full of deadly surprises, shocking twists and larger than life characters!

name: Lock Down
short_description: A Sci-fi horror multiplayer VR shooter thrill ride

name: STAND: Survive, Team-up, And Never Die
short_description: STAND is a tower defence in a post-apocalyptic environment. Other survivors can join you, but also lots of upgrades. Combine weapons with items. Make a spinning flamethrower or install barbed wire to face the hordes ! Survive, Team-up, And Never Die !

name: Anode Heart: Layer Null
short_description: Isometric card battler RPG with a touch of virtual creatures, set in a futuristic, digital world, with over-the-top villains and a very shadowy plot.

name: 爱坤新手教程
short_description: There is no one of the most nervous games in all of Steam

name: DETECTIVE - The Motel
short_description: DETECTIVE The Motel is a deduction game where, to advance, you must take a pencil and a piece of paper and write down everything that seems like evidence in order to answer all the questions that arise. Solving the case will depend only on you.

name: RAIDING PARTY
short_description: RAIDING PARTY is a retro action roguelite with horror gameplay elements. You play as the Wastelander, a retired agent who is ordered to retrieve an ancient AI device. Recruit, train, and lead a raiding party of elite warriors against an evil empire as you discover the AI can help save humanity.

name: Jumper, Jumpy Time Attack Adventure
short_description: Jumper is a 2D platformer arcade style, the goal is to stay alive as long as possible, jump on as many platforms as possible but be careful for traps ! As the score is increasing so is the difficulty and the speed.

name: ReHash
short_description: In this extraordinary realm, where time itself bends to the will of speed, your agility is the key to survival. Unleash your inner cheetah and sprint through this ephemeral landscape, leaving the constraints of time in your dust.

name: Banana Next Gen
short_description: Banana Next Gen is a fun-filled 2D/3D side-scroller where you control a flying banana trapped in the Banana King's castle. Collect coins, unlock levels, and face the tyrannical Banana King in an epic final showdown. Can you save your family and escape?

name: Colonization Simulator
short_description: Colonize rich planets with vegetation or deserted moons. Build a functional and prosperous colony. Take care of your colonists. Experience adventures on distant worlds or build a colony on planets in our solar system.

name: SKIBIDI TOILET: Operation Terror
short_description: The Skibidi has escaped. Your mission: retrieve 10 vials of Toilet water for DARPA to synthesize into a poison against it. Carefully observe each stall to escape the Endless Bathrooms, avoid the Skibidi, and reach 'Room 10'

name: VOIN
short_description: Crafted by a solo developer, VOIN is a first-person hack-and-slash. Cleave through hordes of enemies in fast-paced combat. Explore dark fantasy realms filled with secrets and dangers. Discover powerful gear and weapons, and face menacing bosses in your quest to cleanse a broken world.

name: Inside The Forest
short_description: You and a group of friends decide to go on a camping trip in the Darkwood Forest, It starts off smoothly, but unforeseen events occur. and it’s only a matter of time before the true horror reveals itself.

name: Sonar Scout
short_description: Pilot your submarine to activate and reestablish a network of beacons while carefully utilizing your sonar to navigate the low-visibility depths of the ocean.

name: Fruit Switch
short_description: 99% will Fail this challenge... This will be the Toughest challenge you'll face this year! Navigate through 23 brutal levels. One small mistake? and You’re back to the beginning. Passion is key, frustration is guaranteed. Good luck… you'll definitely need it...

name: Mortal Vessel
short_description: A dungeon crawler turn-based RPG where you play a hero that has the ability to possess creatures. Featured more than 10 creatures, each of them have a unique skill and ability, Including upgradable skills, ultimate skills, and combine with other skills.

name: Seedsow Lullaby
short_description: 'My mother, my daughter, and me—three sixteen-year-olds on an extraordinary adventure.'After traveling through time to meet their sixteen-year-old counterparts, three generations of women set off on an adventure through the Land of the Gods. What could await them at the end of their journey?

name: Arrowscapades
short_description: A top-down, quick-shot arrow game where precision is key. Master explosive, piercing, and homing arrows as you battle relentless foes and navigate unpredictable attacks. Test your skill in the realm of aberrations to save your loyal pet hawk!

name: Puffer Bounce
short_description: Puffer bounces is an old style arcade game. The pufferfish doesn't stop and there's always a bounce on the ground. Help him move on safely with your reaction speed and proper controls.

name: Don't Drop The Wall, Jack!
short_description: In this construction game, you’ll play as Jack, a proud contractor. Using his crane, Jack will build various structures, including houses, hotels, and bridges. Skillful crane operation is crucial for progress and achieving new objectives. But above all, be extra careful with your walls!

name: SGS Battle of the Bulge
short_description: On 16 December 1944, under appalling weather conditions, the Germans launch their last major offensive in the West. Their goal: cut off the Allies from their sources of supply by taking Antwerp. To do so, they must break through the Ardennes salient, starting the battle of the Bulge…

name: Go Home Annie
short_description: A twisted psychological thriller and an original story set in the SCP universe. As an employee of the SCP Foundation, test artificially created paranormal events, solve puzzles, interact with anomalies, and uncover the secrets of the Replication Division.

name: Cloudy Valley
short_description: Go on a summer vacation to the Cloudy Valley archipelago! Swim, climb, and explore the different islands at your own pace. Discover treasures or enjoy a cozy and relaxing atmosphere by the waves...

name: MasterChef: Learn to Cook!
short_description: MasterChef: Culinary Showdown- Master the Kitchen, Challenge the World!Sharpen your knives and compete with global chefs in wacky mini-games! Master over 120 recipes, unlock culinary challenges, upgrade your kitchen, and become the ultimate MasterChef! ‍

name: No Greater Glory: The American Civil War
short_description: In No Greater Glory: The American Civil War, you take on the role of Abraham Lincoln or Jefferson Davis in the epic conflict of 1861. Manage military, political, and economic challenges, lead armies into battle, and navigate diplomacy to change the course of history in this deep strategy game.

name: ROBOCRACY
short_description: Take on the challenge and face off against a rogue AI bent on enslaving humanity! Strap on your VR headset, step into the boots of a Galactic Ranger, and tear through waves of robots with explosive blasters, devastating shotguns, and an insane arsenal — just like classic arcade shooters!

name: LumineNight
short_description: LumineNight is a story-driven detective adventure. Play as Detective Foster and his daughter to solve a series of murders spanning a decade. Interrogate suspects, infiltrate locations, solve puzzles, and gather evidence from crime scenes. Uncover the dark truth behind these killings.

name: Overthrown
short_description: Lift and throw anything as you build and manage your kingdom in this chaotic city builder for 1-6 players. Harness the power of your soul-stealing crown to defend your citizens from bandits and mutants, farm the land, and gather resources. Keep citizens happy or see them desert you!

name: Pest Apocalypse
short_description: Pest Apocalypse is a hyper-realistic post apocalyptic physics based pizza delivery action rogue-lite! Boost, jump, and drift across different maps in a bouncy pizza van. Pick up kooky passengers along the way and focus on the driving while they handle the shooting!

name: 9 Hallways: The Anomaly Agent
short_description: '9 Hallways: The Anomaly Agent' is a first-person horror game where you explore cosmic passageways connecting all realities. Investigate eerie disturbances, report anomalies, and survive encounters with malevolent entities in a constantly shifting, otherworldly environment.

name: HexaTerra
short_description: Dynamically change the landscape in this hexagon block puzzle game. Strategize to solve complex puzzles with biomes that shift depending on adjacent tiles. Complete the story or play endless levels.

name: NaturesAscendancy
short_description: Natures Ascendancy' is an exhilarating open-world survival game where players explore a mysterious alien planet, uncover ancient secrets, and survive its treacherous environments. With stunning visuals and immersive gameplay mechanics, embark on an unforgettable journey of discovery and survival.

name: What is in the Black Box?
short_description: Prepare to embark on a journey of reflection, where you’ll seek answers to profound questions and uncover the ultimate truth: What truly lies within the black box?

name: Granny: Escape Together
short_description: This is a creepy co-op horror game. In which you find yourself locked in a crazy Granny's house. But Granny is not the only danger that awaits you in the house, someone else creepy lives in the basement. You have five days to get out of the house!

name: Hunt Me
short_description: HUNT ME is a co-op horror survival game for 1-4 players. Gather the ingredients for the ritual, weaken the threat and banish it. Be careful, you're also the prey!

name: The Spirit of the Samurai
short_description: A village in peril. A samurai reanimated. An Oni advancing. Fight an army of undead warriors and Japanese monsters as a human, a Kodama, and a cat in this 2D stop-motion action adventure.

name: Only Lead Can Stop Them
short_description: Boot up your 486 and launch olcst.exe for this retro fps from an alternate 1990's. Descend into the madness of the Spanish Civil War fighting vicious fascist forces and supernatural monsters. Conquer three action packed episodes wielding machine guns, rifles, flamethrowers and explosives.

name: 3D Don't Die Mr Robot
short_description: Fresh from the Neon Dunjun, Mr. Robot returns in the third dimension! A heart pounding bullet hell dodge 'em up from veteran arcade developers Infinite State Games

name: CZO Online
short_description: Combat Zone Operation - This is a dynamic tactical multiplayer first-person shooter.

name: Wisper
short_description: Wisper is a relaxing 3D open world filled with magical creatures, unique people, and their secrets. Learn about them and the world they live in. Save villages from corruption on your journey to become a Wisper.

name: Globs
short_description: Meet the size-changing Globs in this colorful puzzle game. Use the curious properties of their bodies at your advantage to solve a variety of puzzles, all in a expressive pixel art aesthetic and upbeat soundtrack.

name: Escape Floor Zero
short_description: Trapped in an infinite parking lot, your only escape is through Floor Zero. Detect subtle anomalies and make crucial decisions in this mind-bending, psychological horror experience. Dare to escape the unescapable? If you see an anomaly... turn back.

name: Mystic Watcher
short_description: In this cozy observation game, you are forced to report strange anomalies around your house. Do you have what it takes, or will you face the consequences of using dark magic?

name: Red Dead Redemption
short_description: Experience the story of former outlaw John Marston as he tracks down the last remaining members of the notorious Van der Linde Gang in the PC debut of the critically acclaimed predecessor to Red Dead Redemption 2.

name: Leif's Adventure: Netherworld Hero
short_description: Join Leif and his loyal sidekick Ghost as they combine their strengths to overcome the sinister forces of the Netherworld. In this story-driven, co-op action-adventure inspired by Nordic folklore, friendship proves to be the greatest power of all.

name: Crab Game 2
short_description: Crab Game 2 is a multiplayer PvP game with up to 25 players where you have to survive different mini games to be the last one standing.

name: Remorse
short_description: Remorse is a first-person psychological horror game. Where you have to get out of an unusual prison, where your jailers are your fears and awakened conscience. But is there a way out of it ...?!

name: Foragery
short_description: Washed up on the shore of an abandoned island, you find that dying opens up an entirely new world beneath the living. Meet the people and their mysteries, complete quests, uncover secrets, and bask in scenery like no other in this story-based adventure game.

name: Mindlock - The Apartment
short_description: Colin’s apartment maze has puzzles, dialogues, and some dry humor waiting for you. A surreal adventure of a special kind.

name: Wild Country
short_description: Wild Country is a cozy-competitive card game with city-building elements! Collect cards, construct buildings, explore Big Sky, and challenge friends in this one of a kind strategy game.

name: Chess Infinity
short_description: Whether you're new to chess or a seasoned master, welcome to Chess Infinity—the art of timeless strategy. Immerse yourself in serene environments, sharpen your skills with an adaptive AI mentor, and connect with players worldwide. Embrace endless challenges that transcend eras and borders.

name: Bobos FunZone
short_description: Step into the haunting realm of Bobo's Funzone, in this horror/puzzle adventure. Your mission: find your daughter, who was attending a birthday party here. Navigate the eerie corridors, unearth what happend, and be careful and cautious as Bobo is about.

name: Operation Athena
short_description: Operation Athena is a tactical first person shooter that takes inspiration from classic tactical shooters with updated modern mechanics. Take part as an operator of Athena Team solo or with up to 4 players against a global terrorist threat.

name: Ark Nova
short_description: Plan and build a modern, scientifically managed zoo to support conservation projects in an acclaimed strategy board game.

name: Botanical Chronicle
short_description: Discover a third-person adventure as a robot seeking the last traces of life! Technology morphed into nature! Explore, unravel secret paths, hide and escape dark forces of this mysterious landscape. Rivers, rocks, bushes seamlessly merging into digital realm and try to stop you!

name: Fall Of The MS Estonia
short_description: Step into the shoes of a passenger aboard the ill-fated MS Estonia in this immersive simulation. Discover what caused the ship's demise on the tragic day of 28th September 1994. With time running out, are you able to find a way off the ship?

name: Fault - Broken Promises
short_description: After losing in a duel of power and prestige, academy apprentice Albel has to brave the depths of the dungeon to save the beautiful swordswoman Aiel from falling into his rival’s hands. He promised her a future together… Can he keep it, or will their bond get broken?

name: Tower of Mask
short_description: Survival horror RPG where new terrors await! This game inherits the charm of 1980s dungeon RPGs. Step into the mysterious deep tower where bizarre masked humans roam!

name: Afterlife Gladiator
short_description: Warriors, mysterious creatures and even prehistoric animals have all become trapped in a realm beyond death where once a year they must fight each other in a team tournament for the ultimate prize: Freedom.

name: Lust Sisters
short_description: In each level of the game, players need to turn over the cards in turn and find the same pattern combination. After turning over two cards each time, if their patterns are the same, they will be successfully matched and disappear; if they are different, the cards will be covered again.

name: How to Melt a Maiden's Heart
short_description: A cute, sweet boys love / yaoi visual novel about a high school student who discovers the formidable student council president is crossdressing on the sly and working at a maid café.

name: Flint: Treasure of Oblivion
short_description: Experience the golden age of piracy through a strong and original narrative, real-time exploration and turn-based tactical combat in Flint - Treasure of Oblivion.

name: Valledi
short_description: Dive into a journey of grief and overcoming with Diana and her drone, in search of an ancient legend, passing through mountains, caves, mines, and a lot more in a great adventure filled with challenges.

name: Fantasy Quest
short_description: Anime themed Arena Shooter, where you fight cute monsters, in a beautiful fantasy world, being helped by a cute anime elf girl.

name: Menticide
short_description: Menticide is a survival horror game that takes you through chilling investigations. As a special forces operative, you'll delve into routine missions that unravel into terrifying mysteries. Dark secrets await beneath the surface. Will you survive long enough to uncover the truth?

name: The Worries of Santa Clauses
short_description: They are somehow arrested when the police find them.

name: Split Brain
short_description: Share the same body with a friend in Split Brain. One of you controls, the other one sees, but the decisions are made together! Face the illusion and uncover the truth to find your way out of Hexarture.

name: Novice Dungeon Master
short_description: [Novice Dungeon Master] is a dungeon management simulation set in a fantasy world of dungeons and adventures. Turn your beginner dungeon into the ultimate dungeon of your dreams. Greet adventurers who come to visit your dungeon, grow herbs, summon monsters, and more!

name: Temtem: Swarm
short_description: Can you Survive the Swarm? Unlock mighty abilities and upgrades, find and collect Tems to evolve and become stronger, discover overpowered strategies, and battle massive bosses in this survivor-like bullet heaven! Play solo or online co-op with up to 3 players, building the wildest synergies.

name: No Space For All
short_description: A fleet to defeat, a weapon to collect, and one life to decide everything in the roguelike shooter No Space For All. Let the universe know your second name!

name: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: Rita's Rewind
short_description: In Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: Rita's Rewind, the team faces off against a robotic reincarnation of the Power Rangers' long-time nemesis. Robo Rita has conjured a portal to send herself back in time so she can finally vanquish the Power Rangers by forming an alliance with her younger self.

name: PizzaPanic
short_description: People are starving for Pizza! Become our new delivery operator. Race through the city with your trusty courier bot, and bring joy to your customers. Customize your robot and experiment with dozens of unique skills and upgrades. Bring your friends and enjoy chaos in online and local multiplayer.

name: Waifu Survivors
short_description: Advance with badass heroines, customize your skills, and face bosses with unique powers in Waifu Survivors. Fight against hordes of monsters, explore diverse maps, and engage in epic battles. Get ready for an exciting journey!

name: UNPUNISHED
short_description: Realizing that Mark will have to return to his family home, he begins to gradually sort through the family archives. Mark will have to read his parents' old letters, go down into the deepest parts of the house to unravel the secrets that have been hidden from him all these years.

name: Hypnosis Card 2
short_description: 'Hypnosis Card 2' is a card battle game with deck building, introducing a new concept of body parts. Players can interact and battle with many girls through cards of different genres.

name: Echoes Afterfall
short_description: Team up in a chilling co-op experience, delving into procedurally generated backroom style buildings. Survive together or succumb into the Echoes.

name: Necromorphosis
short_description: In this unliving hell, become the bullet heaven. Gather the bones of fallen foes and morph into the ultimate skeleton to claim your throne of skulls as King of the Undead, if you can survive the Necromorphosis.

name: Dates & Wires: Augmented Edition
short_description: The year is 1995, and you're newly single and ready to mingle in Stradania, the dysfunctional micronation whose chief exports are pig iron, human misery, and radioactive souvenir mugs. Sample the nightlife, try a VR trip or two, and maybe even find love - just try not to get your organs stolen.

name: A Winter Haunting
short_description: Everlyn Sterling, a young woman tasked by her grandmother to take care of a historic mansion, finds herself entangled in a mystery involving supernatural forces. Join her in this point-and-click style game to uncover the secrets behind this landmark!

name: Shiren the Wanderer: The Mystery Dungeon of Serpentcoil Island
short_description: A new adventure for Shiren and Koppa begins!

name: Luna's Twilight
short_description: Luna's Twilight is a fantasy romance visual novel that brings together classic fantasy elements with heart-fluttering romance. In a secluded mansion hidden deep within a a silent forest, four men from different races whisper words of love to you. Who will be the one to win your heart?

name: Aldriak, the advent of a new world
short_description: It's a RPG turn-based strategy game inspired by the first games of the genre but with a new and original mechanic. This mechanic takes the form of 3 distinct rows in which all the battlers are placed. Each skill requires being in a particular row and can only target by following certain rules.

name: Miami Horizon 2077
short_description: GTA cop chase if it was a 2D arcade . Drive your way through the street of miami 2077 in style.Buy upgrades, cars , collect power-ups and battle your way out like a real-badass.

name: Bunches For Bart!
short_description: Hike your way up an expansive African mountain, one grab at a time, in this gamepad controlled 'Foddian' platformer -- where any one bad fall could send you tumbling back down to the bottom.

name: Hard Chip
short_description: Hard Chip is a 3D simulation/puzzle game about building processors focusing on realism. Explore the world of semiconductor chip design and delve into the intricacies of CPU logic, floor planning, and propagation delay.

name: PoetryAdventure
short_description: This is a combination of creativity and elegance in one, specifically for love and addicted to the Chinese poetry culture of the majority of lovers tailored to guess the word puzzle game.

name: Hina-chan's Sticker Survival
short_description: 文字も音声も送れなくなってしまった端末で、不審に思われないようにスタンプだけでチャットを乗り切ろう！

name: Elise
short_description: Awakened in a bunker amidst a zombie outbreak after a car crash, guide Elise through harrowing challenges, solve puzzles, and face relentless undead hordes and uncovering the bunker's dark secrets

name: Clueless Crew
short_description: Scavenge through abandoned locations with your friends, buy tools, and venture further into eerie corridors and rooms filled with monsters and ghosts, then haul the loot back to the truck before dawn.

name: Iconia Defenders
short_description: Build mazes, customize your deck and travel through time, in a nostalgic tower defense game with a minimalist feel and a rogue-lite twist. Only you can save the Tree of Life from the malevolent forces of The Corruption...

name: Rogue Knight
short_description: Experience fast-paced roguelite gameplay. Explore ever-changing locations and fight vicious enemies in souls-inspired 2d combat. Every run you will find variety of items and spells to compliment your playstyle, as well as resources to upgrade your town for future runs.

name: Chrysalis
short_description: Defend your Chrysalis from growing hordes of monsters in this hybrid game that combines elements of tower defense, survival, and roguelike RPGs. Explore procedurally generated levels, possess and control animals, and grow deadly gardens. How far can you get before the next wave of monsters?

name: Rascal's Escape
short_description: Rascal's Escape is a co-op adventure game to satisfy your wanderlust.Join the nimble Squirrel and the strong Bear on a wild journey. Jump, stomp, zoom through colorful cities following Rascal's clues. Travel Europe with your friends and experience nutastic moments.

name: Birds Organized Neatly
short_description: In this 2D puzzle game, you have the responsibility to arrange your avian friends in a way that fits the grid. Birds Organized Neatly comes with 80 different handcrafted levels and a whole bunch of birds in all shapes and sizes.

name: Anima Flux
short_description: Anima Flux is a co-op metroidvania with two genetically enhanced soldiers, special agents of a theocratic dictatorial regime. Fight your way through swarms of mutants through a desolate, dystopian space city and save humanity's last stronghold, if, of course, anyone is still alive...

name: Jump Over It !
short_description: play as a multicolored cube whose mission is to jump as high and as far as possible... But beware of fast moving obstacles !

name: Match 'Em
short_description: Shapeshift your way through neatly-crafted levels to stay alive: just match the shapes and colors to dodge the obstacles! Play at your own pace in this adaptive action/puzzle game, or make and share your own levels if you're feeling creative :)

name: Stack Graffiti
short_description: A puzzle action game in which players try to clear stages by moving their own drawn rakugaki through trial and error!

name: Satisfrustration
short_description: Satisfrustration is a trippy first-person puzzle game with directional gravity. Complete satisfying and disorientating puzzles made by The Taskmaster that become more frustratingly difficult to find solutions.

name: Clicky Coven
short_description: Clicky Coven is an incremental game about building a witch coven. Assign witches to gather ingredients, brew potions, and sell them to earn gold. Spend gold to get more witches and pick from upgrades to enhance them. Use prestige upgrades to strategize on how you want your coven to become rich.

name: OutRUN
short_description: You play as two different people in the same creepy motel, and everything you think you know keeps changing. One moment you're Allison, running from something in her past, and the next you're Emma doing a late-night cleaning shift. You see the same events from totally different angles. You're JUDGE!

name: Lost Pages: Classic
short_description: In this roguelike deck-building game, uncover ancient secrets in dark mist. Build your deck with magic circles and artifacts, battle monsters, and plan routes on a shifting map. Face the 100 levels of the dimensional gate. Grow and take on new challenges as you progress.

name: WHAT THE PAK?!
short_description: WHAT THE PAK?! is a minigame-rush party game with fast-paced gameplay for up to 8 players. Our various mini-games are designed so you can pull off all kinds of shenanigans with your friends. Punch them, lick them… Steal their chickens before throwing them overboard.

name: Battle Waves: Card Tactics
short_description: A fast-paced Card Battler with Tower Defense action! Claim victory in the Roguelite Deckbuilder campaign and Online Multiplayer. Collect all the factions to explore thousands of strategic combinations.

name: Stars In The Trash
short_description: Stars in the Trash brings the magic of animated movie classics into a narrative-driven platformer that combines action, exploration and puzzles. Tired of feeling trapped at home, Moka, a spoiled cat decides to run away and seek adventure. Explore, make friends, fight, and escape from the kennelman.

name: Youlogic
short_description: Indie logic puzzle game

name: Fallacy Quiz
short_description: Sharpen your critical thinking skills in this quiz game that challenges you to spot rhetorical fallacies. Everyone likes this game so you must too, right?

name: Junk-o-Tron
short_description: A fast-paced match-3 block puzzle game. The scrapyard is filling up! Help your robot team refine and recycle everything so we can warp it out of here. Hone your skills to clear everything fast and get the maximum score!

name: Dark Web: Vigilante
short_description: You are Vigilantus, a master hacker fighting to fix a rotten society. Immerse yourself in a world ruled by corrupt corporations, politicians, and greedy pharmaceutical companies. Uncover dark political secrets, sabotage systems, redistribute wealth to the poor, and destroy entire corporations.

name: There Exists Nobody
short_description: You arrive at a deserted street that feels familiar yet is filled with unease. Pick up your camera, capture the hidden anomalies, and break this endless loop.

name: Dungeon Done
short_description: Dungeon Done is a PvE co-op horror survival extraction game where players explore dungeons previously cleared by heroes. The objective is for up to six players to team up, gathering hidden treasures and evading lurking dangers to make their daring escape.

name: Chonkers
short_description: Chonkers is a cozy and relaxing idle game. Adopt the cutest fur balls and watch them ramp up the chonk scale as you play with them. Find them a new family. They’ll pay A LOT for your hefty chonker! Complete your collection by finding all the breeds and the rarest space cats!

name: Rise & Muse
short_description: 'Rise & Muse' is a single-player game that blends RPG, deck-building, and Roguelike elements. Set in the land of Muse, you will engage in strategic battles against formidable enemies, unravel the seal of the male deity, defeat the goddess, and restore world order.

name: КВАДРОБЕРЫ
short_description: The game is a visual novel with a choice system. The player controls Kirill's actions by choosing from the offered options of answers and actions. Each choice affects the development of the plot and Kirill's relationships with other characters.

name: Polylylyrhythm
short_description: The much-talked-about 'Polyrhythm' on social media has finally been officially released! Can you handle the 3/4, 5/4, 7/4... and all those crazy polyrhythms!? It’s simple yet incredibly challenging! A new kind of rhythm game is here! Come and test your rhythm skills in this beat-pounding madness!

name: Hatsuyuki Sakura
short_description: 'Hatsuyuki Sakura' is one of the most popular works by SAGA PLANETS, a popular Japanese developer for visual novels. Experience Hatsuyuki Sakura for the first time in 1080p! This version includes the English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese versions.

name: Clearing Blade
short_description: Rescue your companions from the battlefield and escape together! Experience the thrilling combat of Roguelite Hack and Slash!

name: Struggle F.O
short_description: What the newly awakened girl saw was an unfamiliar world and unfamiliar creatures. And on her arm, there was a mysterious gadget that could speak. Somehow, the girl who could now communicate with all living creatures, starts to struggle with her allies to survive in this world!

name: Node Farm
short_description: Node Farm is a game about building a fully automated farm using nodes. Connect nodes, harvest and sell veggies, buy new islands, discover new nodes, and automate the process - all in a cozy farm simulation formula!

name: Scourge of the village
short_description: Scourge of The Village is a Chinese folk horror-themed text decryption game. A young female intern reporter who was inexplicably trapped in a nightmare while investigating a factory sewage discharge incident. In order to solve the mystery, she decided to go to the land of her dreams alone.

name: PawnShop Simulator
short_description: Turn the space into a pawn shop! Use fresh paint, stylish floors, and organized shelves to display your items. Buy and sell different goods, making smart, profitable deals. Keep the shop clean to attract customers and sell your items.

name: Ace Squared
short_description: Ace Squared is a multiplayer arena first-person shooter. You can build huge structures and dig tunnels behind enemy lines. Imagination is the only limit. Featuring 32-player servers, different classes and gamemodes.

name: Creeper World IXE
short_description: The unstoppable alien force known as The Creeper has returned, devouring thousands of worlds in its path, and yours is next. Battle against the Creeper fluid in a groundbreaking pixel-level simulation to prove that humanity will rule the galaxy forever!

name: Polismos
short_description: Polismos is a city builder set in ancient Greece. To ensure your city's prosperity you will need to care for your people, trade valuable resources, enact wise policies, and maybe even dominate other cities.

name: World War Forex
short_description: Rule the Financial Frontier: Immerse yourself in the role of a powerful politician in a world of war and unrest. Lead your nation to prosperity through cunning forex trades and dominate the financial battlefield. Live the life of a master strategist in this innovative game

name: Dungeon Flowy
short_description: An auto-battle hack-and-slash RPG. Assemble a party of six and combine your favorite jobs to aim for the deepest part of the dungeon. Enhance your stats with passive equipment obtained from treasure chests or alter the probability of skill usage. Create your own unique build!

name: Garden Trills
short_description: Garden Trills is a cozy puzzle-platformer where you fly as an adorable sparrow through enchanting Mediterranean gardens. Help your neighbors, grow vibrant flowers, and harness their powers to reach new destinations as you flutter into the heart of Vernubiel’s gardens.

name: Hypotheses on the Symmetry between Vision and Hands
short_description: The hypothesis regarding vision-hands symmetry is a validation experiment where separate characters are controlled with the left and right hands. It measures the connectivity and enhancement of cognitive character recognition through both hands and vision.

name: HomeNaut
short_description: Change the gravity to help the little mouse explorer HomeNaut on his journey to reach the legendary cheese in this puzzle platformer

name: Not Easy
short_description: Get ready for the ultimate challenge with Not Easy, a hardcore platformer that tests your skills and patience. Navigate relentless obstacles, gather keys, and unlock doors across 60 intense levels. Each level is designed to push your reflexes and determination to the limit. Can you conquer Not Easy?

name: Lost In Static
short_description: Lost In Static is a psychological first person horror game. After a day out, your daughter has gone missing. You must find her.

name: Gehenna
short_description: The sun has vanished, and darkness corrodes the world. An angel named Helvetica is summoned. She claims to be 'an angel that surpasses even the gods' and repels the distorted sun goddess. However, in order to restore the sun, she must capture the goddess.

name: The Regis Family Experiment
short_description: The Regis Family Experiment is an independent narrative horror game that immerses you in the dark secrets of an abandoned farm. Uncover the mysteries of a cursed family and prepare for the terror that has only just begun. Will you survive the night ?

name: Rocket Rats
short_description: Rocket Rats is a survivors-like game where you defeat cheese-based astral bodies in space – as a rat! Clear waves of enemies, collect cheese, upgrade your gear, and conquer the moon!

name: Hypnosis of Corruption
short_description: Hinata Yuzuzaka is highly respected and admired among her peers. When strange things start to occur at her school and the surrounding town, it will be up to her to get to the bottom of it all.

name: SNOW BROS. SPECIAL: ANNIVERSARY EDITION
short_description: “It is a modern remake of Snow Bros., an arcade platform-based action game popular in 1990, characterized by its accessibility for people of all ages. It also provides diverse fun with new stages and new modes, and allows players to enjoy the original game as well.”

name: Cherry Jump
short_description: Cherry Jump is a 2D platformer where players race through levels, collecting cherries and aiming for the fastest completion time. The game features multiple paths, achievements to unlock, and various characters to discover. Players test their speed and skill in this fast-paced pixel art world.

name: CASE
short_description: Expand by producing and defending through tiles against other players, conquer your enemies. Use the various cards you find, each with different mechanics, on your enemies or allies, and become the victor of the battle. The battlefield awaits you.

name: Tiny Tales: Hidden Objects
short_description: Explore, observe, and find the differences. Each scene tells its own story! Tiny Tales: Hidden Objects is a relaxing game with 60 environments blending isometric and low poly 3D. Test your observational skills and be transported into the stories.

name: Tesseract - First Chapter
short_description: Journey into the world of Tesseract, a mind-bending VR puzzle adventure through a labyrinth of mysterious realms. Navigate perplexing shifts in gravity, travel through portals bridging dimensions, and activate ancient mechanisms that transform the environment around you.

name: Tri Breaker: A Sacred Symbols Odyssey
short_description: If Twin Breaker was a brick breaker about space, Tri Breaker is a brick breaker on steroids, and this go-around, it’s all about time. Explore 40 stages spread across periods of galactic history, and obliterate the brick-breaking formula.

name: Ocean Planet
short_description: Jump and Climb your way to the top in this ocean-themed atmospheric and challenging rage Foddian platformer!

name: Shui's Odyssey
short_description: This is a puzzle game that combines text and images. Players use visual illusions to piece together fragments of memories from Alzheimer's patients, in order to reconstruct the truth of the story and witness the passage of time for three generations.

name: AIRANBLADE
short_description: AIRANBLADE is a 3D vertical progression action game, like the classic shoot 'em up games. Fight against squadrons of enemy aircrafts and gigantic bosses. Enjoy beautiful special effects and lots of explosions and lasers coming from every corner.

name: Escape from Pine Mountain
short_description: Escape From Pine Mountain is an online asymmetric horror game where players, as members of the Critical Crime Scene Unit, investigate eerie cases in Pine Mountain. Host players can choose to be the killer, adding suspense. Navigate tense environments, solve mysteries, and fight to survive.

name: Alien Video Game Scientist
short_description: A 3D platformer collectathon featuring puzzles, mazes, and a bit of speedrunning in a retro-minimalist package evocative of the PS2 era. Can YOU figure out how to grab all the things, and do it efficiently? FOR SCIENCE!

name: Himei Dam
short_description: 'Himei Dam' is a horror game where you patrol the dam at night with your senior, who has an afro. Recommended for: People who want to be scared People who want to be surprised People who want to try working at a dam Streamers known for their great reactions

name: Airport X-Ray Simulator
short_description: Step into the critical role of a baggage security operative in Airport X-Ray Simulator. As part of the backbone of airport security, you are the last line of defense against prohibited or illegal items making their way onto an aircraft or into the airport.

name: Ginger's Letter to Santa
short_description: 'This is it! This year I will cook the best roast Christmas dinner the Zodiacs has ever seen! They will all scream for more and then nobody will try to eat me, no more no more!' Join Ginger, Sullyvan and the Gonk on this RPG Christmas Adventure as they deliver their letters to Santa's Factory!

name: On Your Tail
short_description: A cozy detective adventure where you play as a vacation-bound writer who stumbles upon an idyllic town plagued by an enigmatic thief. Crack the case in this charming seaside town, build relationships, and unravel secrets in a world full of quirky characters and heartwarming stories.

name: Fernageddon
short_description: Do you like to burn things? We do! A combat turn-based RPG / strategy game. About burning down the world...

name: MINE MEMORY
short_description: Uncover the skeletons in Hana's closet in 'MINE MEMORY,' a gripping psychological visual novel. Dive into Hana's memories, shape her destiny, and confront haunting choices with deep consequences.

name: Sea Of Radiation 2
short_description: Welcome to the perilous nuclear-contaminated waters, where all creatures are mutating. Start as an ordinary small fish, struggling to survive in this toxic sea. Through continuous evolution and adaptation, you will grow into a powerful ocean monster and ultimately become the sole ruler of this ocean

name: Crossed Wires
short_description: Navigate your oblivious companion through a world filled with dangers such as lasers, rush hour traffic, homemade flamethrowers and aggressive cleaning robots by solving a variety of puzzles in this hilarious and unpredictable adventure. Can you keep him safe from himself?

name: WALKING IN FOG
short_description: A first-person live-action crime suspense interactive experience. Multiple story branches and endings — Dozens of story branches and six different endings. Live-action performances and on-location shooting — Real actors and real settings enhance immersion in both the plot and characters.

name: Toastercide
short_description: You are a Toaster. You have been tasked with eliminating targets by expertly maneuvering into their bathtubs. Use your power cord and toast abilities to slow down time, grapple and swing around physics-based environments to execute a Toastercide, all while navigating as fast as possible.

name: Super 3D Maze 16
short_description: Trapped in a neon labyrinth, Elias Nova wished he’d played Super 3D Maze 16 during his astronaut training. Unfortunately, he didn’t, so it’ll be up to you, intrepid gamer, to guide Elias through these mazes in search of a way out.

name: Dog Man: Mission Impawsible
short_description: Dog Man: Mission Impawsible brings the beloved book series to life. Help Dog Man and his friends chase down the supa bad guys in their most impawsible mission yet!

name: The Abyss
short_description: 'The Abyss' is a first-person survival horror. After an accident, explore a dark world filled with horrors, puzzles, and secrets that challenge your sanity. Will you escape the Abyss or succumb?

name: Short Trip
short_description: An interactive illustration five years in the making where you drive a cat tram through picturesque mountain villages. A relaxed, casual, delightful experience. Ding ding!

name: PIT OF GOBLIN
short_description: In this online horror co-op, you play as a scrappy goblin, scavenging dungeons, dodging traps, and fleeing monsters to feed the Goblin King. Team up with goblin pals, or go rogue, as you dive deep and cause chaos! Fail to feed him, and you might be the next meal!

name: The King of Wall Street
short_description: This is a rougelite card game that combines parkour-style with stock speculation. You can experience the journey from a stock trading novice to the most powerful king of stocks! More casual or more strategic? It's your choice!

name: FREE DUROV
short_description: FREE DUROV – Dive into the most meme-worthy horror game. Experience the hardships of prison life and try to escape by securing the encryption keys. Save anonymity!

name: Paper Bride 6 Nightmare
short_description: “Paper Bride 6 Nightmare” is the sixth work to the Paper Bride series. Dive into a bewitching dream and immerse yourself in yet another immersive Chinese horror puzzle game!

name: Édgimon
short_description: Catch wild Égdimons, dig, build, craft, and explore an infinite world, in this open-world creature-taming and role-playing game.

name: Torque Drift 2
short_description: From the vibrant streets of Tokyo to high-stakes professional competitions backed by global brands, Torque Drift 2 invokes all aspects of drift and street culture to offer an experience as diverse and dynamic as the motorsport itself.

name: Unrailed 2: Back on Track
short_description: The chaotic co-op railroad construction game is back! Team up with your friends to build a railroad through procedurally generated worlds with new biomes and bosses. Permanently upgrade your character and engine, even create your own levels - just don‘t let your train derail!

name: Wizlite: Everybody loved RPGs
short_description: A 15-Minute Dungeon RPG! Wizlite combines classic command battles with roguelite gameplay. Experience tense battles, traps, and careful health and spell management. Inspired by Wizardry, it blends nostalgic RPG tension with fast-paced roguelite fun. Streaming and game commentary welcome!

name: Broken Psyche
short_description: Play as a detective investigating his wife's disappearance. Suspecting the asylum she was researching, he infiltrates it, only to uncover a realm of horror. Solve puzzles, maintain sanity, and confront monsters as you unravel the asylum's secrets.

name: ESCAPE SITE 13
short_description: ESCAPE SITE 13 is a side-scrolling adventure set in the SCP universe, continuing the narrative of SCP-1730. As Investigator Liu Zhiming, explore Site 13, solve puzzles, and confront deadly anomalies. Uncover dark secrets in this chilling tale where reality warps and the past refuses to stay buried.

name: Goo Goo Grapplers
short_description: Grab a friend and take your first steps to victory in Goo Goo Grapplers! Brawl as super-powered babies in a wacky 1v1 local MOBA. Mix and match wild abilities and upgrades to turn your baby into an unstoppable force of nature!

name: Dangerous line
short_description: You are a hero who faces waves of enemies who are trying to get into your kingdom and seize power in it.

name: あまつそらに咲く
short_description: みんなで過ごすことができる最後の夏。 『この夏を忘れない思い出にしよう。』 だれかが言ったその言葉から始まる、茹だるように暑い、鮮明な夏の日。 大丈夫。きっと忘れない。 たとえ、目に見えるものが偽物だとしても。

name: Voxel Shogun KIritan Castle
short_description: A very cute RTS! Modify the voxel ground and defend your castle with Zundamons! A game set in Japan's medieval period, created by Japanese developers.

name: Mary
short_description: Mary is a mystery and investigation game, in which you are a private detective who has been called to solve a case of a massacre in a bar. Collect all the clues and find an answer to all the mysteries of this case!

name: Rise of a Legend
short_description: Rise of a Legend is a third-person action RPG that immerses you in the ruthless era of gladiatorial combat. Engage in rich single-player progression or take on challengers in online multiplayer matches. Manage your Ludus, level up your fighters, and boost your house's prestige with every victory.

name: Forest Ranger Services: Episode 1
short_description: Horror game series about the investigation of missing hikers in the U.S. National Parks. Follow the story of a wannabe reporter who got a job as a ranger to investigate the disappearances - several episodes that tell one story! Based on true events.

name: The Ape Tales: An Epic Adventure Game
short_description: Experience an epic 2D adventure game by becoming the legendary ape who is the last hope for innocent animals. Traverse through diverse realms and eras, encountering evil that threatens your species. Prepare for the unexpected as each location unveils unique enemies and challenges that you will face.

name: PrismNeedle
short_description: PrismNeedle is a Roguelike Survivors game where you can take control of living magical helmets and fight waves of enemies using unique swords and upgrades.

name: Retrowave 2
short_description: Neon lights, palm trees, synthwave, '80s supercars speeding down an endless highway... Welcome to the world of Retrowave!

name: Cube Survivor
short_description: Cube Survivor is an engaging roguelite experience that challenges you to harness the power of your mouse and a diverse array of unique abilities in your relentless quest to protect your core from relentless enemy assaults.

name: Cannoneer
short_description: A 2D top-down shooter game

name: Weapon Rearing
short_description: Idle game! Collect legendary weapons, acquire food, earn a My Room, obtain a jukebox, and earn game money. All of this can be done just by keeping the game on. Level up your weapons to level 9999!

name: Westild's Law
short_description: Journey to the heart of the Wild West in this thrilling pixelated 2D shooter and challenge the gang of Wild Joe to free your hometown from their iron grip!

name: Xiaomei and the Flame Dragon's Fist
short_description: The story revolves around two sisters: Xiao Mei, the master of the Flame Dragon Fist, and Xiao Ying, the master of the opposing fist, the Dark Dragon Slaying Fist, and Xiao Mei's older sister. Xiao Mei is fascinated by the power of the Dark Dragon and sets out to save her sister who has disappeared.

name: The Pilgrim's Progress
short_description: Join us in 'The Pilgrim's Progress,' an epic journey inspired by John Bunyan's classic. Follow Christian's path to the Celestial City, exploring stunning environments, solving puzzles, engaging in strategic battles, and experiencing themes of faith, redemption, and perseverance. Support our vision!

name: Arts & Hearts Academy
short_description: In the romantic visual novel Arts & Hearts Academy, immerse yourself in a world of mysteries, art scandals, and love! A student girl dreams of winning a prestigious architecture competition and finding love. Little does she know, a cunning criminal has already set their traps.

name: Dicey Tales
short_description: Roll the dice in your hand! Dicey Tales, a TRPG-inspired game, combines deckbuilding with strategy in a unique SRPG experience. Assemble the ultimate expedition team with a variety of heroes. Defeat powerful bosses through strategic decisions and a bit of luck!

name: Dungeons and Ducklings
short_description: In this QuackMan Roguelite, Baby ducklings have been kidnapped, and you are a very ANGRY Mama Duck.

name: HexWind
short_description: The ultimate built-for-VR magical combat experience, designed for those who crave intense mayhem & relentless real-world physical gameplay. Catch that perfect flow as you slow time & lay waste to the hordes, all to the adrenaline-pumping beats of an original Metal soundtrack. Prepare to die. A lot.

name: Tanks of Freedom II
short_description: A turn-based strategy with up to four armies fighting against each other. Challenge yourself in a campaign against AI, or a hot-seat battle with a friend. Follow the story of Prince Tybalt and restore peace in the Amber Noon kingdom.

name: WonderLang French
short_description: Learn French through immersive quests, interactive dialogues, and spaced repetition combat challenges. Help a young hero lift a magical curse by mastering French. Customize your learning experience and explore a vibrant world filled with unique characters. Start your journey to French fluency today!

name: Mercury Abbey
short_description: In a mansion surrounded by mist, as the curse made by the Alchemist and Fairy reappears, the danger is quietly lurking in the darkness, awaiting its visitors.Follow Harrod and Willie to unravel an incredible story in Mercury Abbey, and go on an adventure that you would only find in mystery novels.

name: Hellgate Senigallia Remake
short_description: An RPG-infused boomer-shooter with dark and mysterious tones, offering innovative gameplay with a nostalgic nod to the '90s. Get ready to blow everything up and turn enemies into cannon fodder before facing the massive end-level bosses!

name: LOK Digital
short_description: Learn a cryptic language of world-changing words and master their mind-bending effects. Embark on your charming puzzle-solving journey to help the LOK creatures thrive.

name: Doraemon Dorayaki Shop Story
short_description: A simulation game where you create a wonderful sweets shop with Doraemon

name: 杀青
short_description: 'Shaqing' is a Chinese horror puzzle game set in 'Wuzhan Town'. Players must help the protagonist escape an evil scene where dreams and reality blur, and save his beloved. The objective is to help the protagonist escape and save his beloved.

name: Night Shift Nurses
short_description: A washed-up mad doctor is hired back by a devious former test subject and asked to twist her hospital into a corrupt donation mill. Will he seize this second chance to practice his own vision of 'science,' or will his many failings drag him down once again in this pseudo-medical visual novel?

name: Blue Hunter
short_description: Welcome to hell! Blue Hunter is an RPG roguelike deckbuilder where you forge your own path as a hunter and turn into a god! Create your own army of undead monsters, unlock powerful skills and beat all the gods that stand in your way. How far can you go?

name: Tundralia: The Frigid Frontier
short_description: Tundralia is an RPG in which you play as a novice adventurer, seeking to find fame and fortune in a frozen wasteland. Explore a stylized open world, fight as one of three classes using traditional tab target combat, complete quests, delve into dungeons, and collect a plethora of equipment.

name: EvilPunk
short_description: VR shooter, base defense game set in a dark Western world. How well can you defense the church? Fight against the demon army and shed light on the darkness. The fate of humanity is at the tip of your barrel.

name: Tormented Soul
short_description: Team-Based Fantasy Extraction Arena where risk is rewarded. PvPvE featuring AOE-centric skill based action combat with continuous gear progression. Gather resources, defeat monsters, bring down bosses, best your foes, and acquire Ultra-Rare Ancient Equipment.

name: Mighty Marbles
short_description: Welcome to Mighty Marbles, a cute physics based game where you control the level to guide the marble to victory. Inspired by the desire to see real life physics toys as a video game! Roll, solve and triumph in the fast paced bite sized levels.

name: Virus Hunter
short_description: Become a nanomachine and defend the human body from viruses and bacteria! How long you can live depends on your efforts.

name: Archons
short_description: Archons is a Roguelite/Survivor game where you control two characters, the Archons- simultaneously! Customize your build and abilities to fit your own unique playstyle and blast your way through enemy parasites and bosses!

name: Drone Strike: Engineer Simulator
short_description: Power up your drone, take on intense missions, and push it to the limit — from combat to high-risk deliveries!

name: The Night Games Collection
short_description: This collection takes you into mysterious events set in isolated locations and seemingly ordinary jobs, offering immersive experiences with a night-time theme. Each game features unique, choice-driven stories with multiple outcomes and memorable moments.

name: Tomb of Hope
short_description: Something strange is happening in the newly discovered tomb. One of the archaeologists went missing during the exploration and even a search party was not able to help. Will you find her? What is happening in the dark depths? And are you really the only one here?

name: [Bober Bros] The Hole
short_description: [Bober Bros] The Hole is a first-person horror game that explores the cracks in domestic life. Your neighbor’s drilling starts the nightmare, but the holes reveal dark secrets far deeper than any wall could hide. No cheap scares, only disturbing reality.

name: OHV
short_description: Survival simulator in 1990's Poland.

name: 魔女黏糊笔记
short_description: 这是一款结合卡牌与骰子的roguelike游戏，通过卡组构筑，在战斗中拼点尽可能无损耗地击败敌人。 魔女缪可苏带着她的笔记来到了一个魔物洞窟面前，你将在这里遇到各种各样的魔物，以及魔物娘！将她们击败，或是被她们击败吧！

name: CODE Bunny
short_description: Axel and Hazel are members of the VY Space Program. When the new enemy dubbed Mad Bunny threatens the project, they must fight, as they uncover a hidden conspiracy... CODE Bunny is a 2D-Action Platformer where combat mechanics and high-speed movement merge together!

name: Silent Mourning
short_description: Your sister has been missing for a few days. You head out to the cabin she was staying at, but it seems you're not the only one there

name: Grand MALL Simulator
short_description: Manage and expand your own shopping mall in Grand Mall Simulator! Open diverse boutiques, stock shelves, decorate, and attract customers to grow your profits. Hire workers for automation and create a unique mall experience. Can you turn your center into a bustling mall?

name: TeeTINY Online: Smart Tower Life
short_description: Looking for a Second Life MMO?A Relaxing and Welcoming One-Server Community MMORPG Enjoy your adventure in 'TeeTINY Online' with 'Smart Tower Life'!

name: CASE RECORDS: Fear of Abduction
short_description: Psychological horror, which is part of the games CASE: Animatronics and CASE 2: Animatronics Survival.

name: Lost Islands
short_description: Lost Islands is a Cold Weapon PvPvE online multiplayer action game. You will play an adventurer to an unknown island, killing and co-operating with monsters and other adventurers on the island, embarking on an exciting adventure and eventually escaping with the treasure.

name: Herreshoff's Legacy
short_description: Explore a story-rich mystery in this atmospheric puzzle game. As a police officer, investigate the grand mansion of Dr. Wilfried Éric Herreshoff, uncover hidden compartments, solve challenging puzzles, and unravel the secrets of a dark family legacy.

name: Aerial Cleaner
short_description: Players take on the role of a high-rise cleaner. Equipped with a water jet gun, they clean dirt off various unique skyscrapers while swinging through the air using the recoil from the water jets. At the same time, players must fend off flying monsters to protect their lives.

name: Sin Slayers: Reign of The 8th
short_description: Seven Deadly Sins. Have you heard about the 8th? Delve into madness in Sin Slayers, a challenging RPG Roguelite where you decide how much sin to bear as you transform the world. Assemble a party of wicked adventurers, kill, and pillage to drive off a gluttonous nightmare in turn-based battles

name: Moon Watch
short_description: Bullet heaven, deckbuilding, and strategy – Moon Watch is a wild new mix from the creators of Backpack Hero! Master your tactics, not reflexes: stop time at will, craft a killer deck, stop the horde in their tracks!

name: The Adventurers
short_description: The Adventurers is a turn-based tactical RPG where every decision shapes your legacy. Lead your party of heroes in an open world filled with random events that affect your story. Survive a high fantasy landscape where your epic saga is waiting to be written.

name: Menace from the Deep
short_description: Menace from the Deep is an enthralling Roguelike Deckbuilding card game that unfolds in a dark world, drawing inspiration from Howard Lovecraft and the Cthulhu Mythos.Set against the backdrop of 1920s USA, the narrative revolves around a clandestine occult society.

name: Cavalry Charge·Three Kingdoms
short_description: Cavalry Charge·Three Kingdoms is a game that combines the historical theme of the Three Kingdoms with strategic elements. The game features a connected large-scale map design, supporting national wars with up to ten thousand players on the same map.

name: Ericanskinsmonsters
short_description: Join Erica and her band of outcasts in Ericanskinsmonsters, a mature turn-based RPG. On a perilous quest to save the realm of Strifestav, they must face a cruel necromancer, his undead army, and relentless God-beasts. Can you deliver the world from chaos, or will darkness consume everything?

name: Zort
short_description: Zort is an action, adventure, and horror game that can be played with up to 4 people. Explore maps with your friends and have fun while escaping from various creatures. Experience a realistic horror experience with in-game voice chat with your friends!

name: ABYSS SEEKERーーWhat Do You See Deep in The Abyss
short_description: A dungeon known as the Abyss has suddenly appeared. To open the 'Door of Darkness' at its deepest point, the Seeker plunges into the dungeon gate... in search of the truth. Survive the onslaught of dark forces in this twin-stick survival shooter! — Are You Ready to Face Your Destiny?

name: Gladio Mori
short_description: Gladio Mori is a physics-driven multiplayer gladiator combat game featuring slow-motion battles, organ-specific damage, and a fully customizable move editor. Craft your own fighting style or use community created movesets to fight your way to glory.

name: WhatRogue：Exile Land
short_description: 'WhatRogue：Exile Land' blends roguelike, card construction, and tactical turn-based gameplay. The tactical element requires spatial strategies, enhancing strategic depth. Choose different heroes and companions to defeat various monsters and bosses.

name: Prey of the Night
short_description: Become a night owl, soaring through an infinite forest under the moonlit sky. Skillfully avoid obstacles, hunt for prey to gain strength, and perch to regain stamina. But beware—every moment in the shadows tests your survival. How long can you conquer the night?

name: Clone Drone in the Hyperdome
short_description: Cut robots apart in VR. Feel your sword disintegrate their metal bodies. Now you live and die in the Crashloop, a roguelike tournament to the death. Lock swords! Shoot shurikens from your wrist! This is CLONE DRONE... in the HYPERDOME!!!

name: Cabin Escape
short_description: First person escape room style game with multiple puzzles to solve and a mystery to unravel.

name: Work Adventure
short_description: A calm and relaxing construction, creature collection, and RPG elements game that stays at the bottom of your screen. Perfect for those who want to play while using the computer for other tasks!

name: Cozy Solitaire
short_description: Classic Solitaire game, accompanied by music and kitties.

name: The Limb
short_description: In a post-apocalyptic world overrun by monsters due to an unknown virus, some people have managed to survive. During these times, an organization formed by elite members of society emerged, fighting against the monsters and aiming to restore the world to its original state.

name: 天鶴之戀
short_description: 'If you want to change yourself, start with this blazing summer—'

name: Wizard Shrimp
