short_description: Wizard Shrimp™ is a bullet-hell roguelike game where you play as a Shrimp who is inexplicably also a Wizard?! Battle your way out of a slimy swamp, escape amethyst caves, and climb the Mushroom Wizard's Tower to become the most powerful Shrimp this world has ever seen!

name: UnDuster
short_description: Escape the depths of an intricate spiky dungeon in UnDuster. Master the peculiar abilities of a powerful vacuum to run, jump, suck, and blow your way through precarious and horrifying platforming challenges.

name: Ooze Keeper
short_description: Ooze Keeper is a tactical roguelike that combines monster collecting and resource management. You'll harness the unique abilities of various slimes, construct efficient structures, and optimize resources to grow your farm and earn money with each turn. Beware - miss your rent, and it's game over.

name: Onyx
short_description: A more or less fortunate event led to you receiving your own piece of land, which you can freely develop. You can also explore the already accessible regions of Hyalen to complete quests, obtain new recipes, mine resources and improve your crafting skills.

name: Alien: Rogue Incursion
short_description: Alien: Rogue Incursion is an all-new action-horror VR game that transforms you into ex-Colonial Marine Zula Hendricks on a dangerous mission to the uncharted planet Purdan, featuring innovative real-life motion gameplay, a whole-body loadout, and the most cunning Xenomorphs ever encountered.

name: SOMEWHERE
short_description: The goal of SOMEWHERE is to survive on the wild island of Esterhull. Gather resources, craft tools, and manage hunger, thirst. Explore mysterious locations, uncover the secrets of a lost civilization, and interact with other players: form alliances or compete for survival in a hostile environment.

name: Astral Ascension
short_description: A choice-driven, space sci-fi visual novel featuring full voice-over and an intricate relationship system!

name: Tokyo Waning Moon
short_description: Tokyo Waning Moon is a two-button survival action in moonlit Tokyo! Slash zombie hordes rushing from left and right - no escape, no retreat! Level up your skills, chase high scores, and conquer time attack challenges!

name: Prickle
short_description: Play father hedgehog on a quest to bring his prickly children back home, in this wholesome grid-based puzzle.

name: 改名師 -Kaimeishi-
short_description: あなたは、珍しい名前への嫉妬心から生まれた妖怪を名前の力で祓う『改名師』です。次々と現れる妖怪たちを珍しい名前に改名して祓い、朝まで生き延びることを目指します。

name: pedalverse
short_description: PedalVerse combines the thrill of downhill MTB racing with the freedom of FPV drone exploration. Customize your rider and bike, tackle challenges, and explore a semi-open world. Race on dynamic tracks to earn your spot on the leaderboard. Ready to take on the challenge?

name: The Link
short_description: This application lets you use a webcam and a microphone to play any game with real-world movements and voice commands.

name: FAIRY TAIL 2
short_description: The final battle of FAIRY TAIL is about to begin

name: Tetra Dungeon
short_description: An innovative pigeon fighting game. In dungeon, defeat enemies by placing block cards. Experience new building dynamics around blocks, relics, and hero traits.

name: Pantheon: Rise of the Fallen
short_description: Pantheon: Rise of the Fallen is a deeply social high fantasy MMORPG that challenges its players and rewards effort. Join the denizens of Terminus to uncover the mysteries of a world divided by Celestial loyalty… and betrayal.

name: Vagnerun
short_description: Vagnerun: Race, fight, and upgrade your ship to win thrilling races filled with obstacles and danger!

name: Mythwrecked: Ambrosia Island
short_description: You’re shipwrecked on a lost mythical island. As backpacker Alex, you must befriend the forgotten gods of Greek mythology and restore their memories. Explore the dynamic island and its story sandbox to build new friendships, solve the mystery and save the gods.

name: City Multi Fun
short_description: Adventure alone or with your friend in a highly interactive city. Six competition modes and just wandering mode. Drive cars, shoot aliens, search for food or places. Hide yourself inside funny objects and let your friend find you etc. Communicate with automatic voice chat.

name: Skolly's Adventure
short_description: Explore a sky filled with floating islands as Skolly, an unusual adventurer in search of all the hidden treasures of this forgotten world.

name: Phantom of the Twilight
short_description: Enjoy a sweet romance with vampires in this otome novel adventure.

name: Escape From Vampire Castle: Miss Luna's Diary
short_description: This game is an escape game about survival from vampires. Hide in the shadows to avoid being found by the vampires and search for effective items in the mansion. To survive, find the items you need to escape.

name: Mini Mini Golf Golf
short_description: Mini Mini Golf Golf is an indie storytelling experience that goes beyond the lanes of the here and now into distant memories of a future planetary collapse. Destabilize the present and plunge into a neon psychohistory of a bizarre entity in distress. This is not a game about minigolf.

name: Spire Horizon Online
short_description: Spire Horizon Online is an MMORPG where players become skeleton adventurers on a quest to find their capybara friend. Choose from a variety of classes, battle numerous monsters, and explore diverse regions.

name: Katagiri-san is very cold
short_description: You wake up in a dimly lit room, with your classmate Katagiri-san in front of you. Why are you here? Who could've done it? Why is she here? Maybe there is a way to get out of this place... Try to find your way out in this short escape room RPG with hints of horror, comedy, and a bit of spice!

name: TRex Hero
short_description: TRex Hero is a hilarious action game where you must literally run from one side of the screen to the other to save your life, while rescuing future generations of dinosaurs from an asteroid rain. Avoid the funny effects caused by the asteroids, while taking advantage of powerful power-ups.

name: Couple-Cultivation Saves the World
short_description: This is a live-action interactive game. As the hero, you find out you become the best cultivation power bank in Jiuqiu by chance. Are you willing to Couple-Cultivate with the girls from another world, save the Earth, and maintain peace in Jiuqiu?

name: Highway Police Simulator
short_description: Welcome to Caminora! Immerse yourself in the authentic police work of the American Highway Patrol. Solve cases, chase criminals and explore the open-world. Choose your officer and tackle the everyday life on the highways. Will you be able to maintain law and order?

name: THRESHOLD
short_description: In a lonely station atop a mountain, a train rumbles its precious cargo to places unknown. Now is your shift. Keep the pace. Uncover a mystery. Fight for your last breath. The air is thin up here.

name: 1 Trait Escape
short_description: An action rogue-lite set in the 1 Trait Danger universe. Fight your way through swarms of enemies and bosses with minigames sprinkled in-between. Grow stronger every time you fail until you are able to escape back to Earth.

name: New Arc Line
short_description: Take a stand in the eternal conflict between Arcane Magic and Steampunk Revolution and tip the uneasy balance between sorcery, elves, dwarves and mysterious monsters on one side and steampunk gadgets, zeppelins, and tesla guns on the other in this single-player, party-based, story-rich RPG.

name: Kemotaku
short_description: 'Kemotaku' is a brand new roguelike card game mixed with puzzle, deck-building and tower-defence. Beat away attacking enemies and defend your town with a variety of animals!

name: Fishing The Abyss
short_description: An idle game with elements where you fish for creatures while descending into a fishing pond. With its desktop-accessory vibe, it focuses on visuals and atmosphere. Place the tall vertical window at the edge of your display and enjoy by clicking occasionally.

name: MK-ULTRA Psychic Defense
short_description: Play as a young Ted Kaczynski, experiencing first hand the horrors of the MK-ULTRA program in this highly unique psychedelic tower defense game.

name: Necroverse - Undying Shadows
short_description: Dive into the apocalyptic world of Necroverse, where survival is just the beginning. In this adrenaline-pumping zombie shooter, you'll face relentless hordes of the undead and rival players in two heart-pounding game modes:

name: One Pass
short_description: 'One Pass': A Stress-Reliever,a New Leisure Favorite!Control adorable little characters,collect gold coins, and navigate through fantasy levels.But don't underestimate the challenges, as each level hides the author's 'little pranks' full of traps and humorous moments.Are you ready? Let's get started

name: Escape From Sandhill
short_description: A horror puzzle adventure begins in the spooky tunnels of Sandhill, which can be played as FPS and TPS. Navigate dark corridors, solve complex puzzles, and survive encounters with vengeful shadows born of sinister experiments. Escape the tunnel and survive the mysteries of the neighborhood.

name: Glitch Hero
short_description: A fatal error has trapped Ada’s father inside Codeland! As young Ada, wield the (virtually) mighty hammer.exe and debug the corrupted virtual world while learning basic coding concepts in an irreverent, fun and thrilling action puzzle adventure!

name: Dino-Ducks Dash
short_description: Dino-Ducks Dash is a 2D Hi-Score Multiplayer Runner you can play PvP, Co-Op or as a single player to beat the leaderboard.It has a couch co-op mode and an online co-op mode.And you can also beat the stuffing out of the other cute Dino Ducks with a machete!

name: Carnage Kart X
short_description: Carnage Kart X™ is a retro-inspired Hack N' Slash Karting game combining hand-drawn 2D pixel art and 3D gameplay like it's 1996! Use your weapons and driving skill to survive swarms of fiendish ghouls and horrendous horrors who would like nothing more than to see you join the ranks of the dead!

name: 저주받은학교 (Cursed School)
short_description: Cursed School is an indie horror game where Hyun-soo and his friends accidentally enter a cursed school filled with dark forces. They face terrifying choices that lead to multiple endings. Unravel the secrets and escape the demon’s grasp. Can you survive this nightmare?

name: W.A.N.D. Project
short_description: Fast-paced, roguelike bullet hell with deep, unique spellcrafting. Create and use overpowered, game-shattering spells by combining a multitude of magical elements. Defend Tokyo from a monstrous invasion using magic, reflexes, and game-changing combos.

name: Anime City
short_description: Anime City reinvents classic visual novel mechanics by transferring them into full 3D environment. Study at anime high school, engage in after school clubs, and interact with your classmates.

name: Magic Overflow
short_description: Magic Overflow is a first-person shooter where you fight using magic. With a programming-like crafting system, connect spells logically, and create your own powerful magic. And destroy these horde of enemies

name: Christmas Is Coming
short_description: Christmas is coming and you must stop it at all cost! Place down towers and ground defences to fight back against Christmas themed enemies. Break through stone and groom snow to expose new buildable areas. Upgrade your towers and collect Christmas cards that apply special abilities.

name: MechWarrior 5: Clans
short_description: In MECHWARRIOR 5: CLANS, players become new Smoke Jaguar pilots in the Clan Invasion of the Inner Sphere. Lead a five-mech 'Star' squad across diverse planets, engaging in an expansive campaign with immersive gameplay and intricate combat. Customize BattleMechs and explore strategic options.

name: Zombies and Orcs
short_description: You have discovered ways to quickly move using teleportation and when visiting new lands you will have to protect your portals so that aggressors do not penetrate them.

name: UnPlugged
short_description: Embark on an adventure with a friend in UnPlugged. Work together with a friend in a challenging Local Co-Op as two robots who work their way through challenging puzzles and mazes in an epic adventure.

name: 傲世修仙录
short_description: 傲视修仙，唯我独尊！ 相信本作独有的很多玩法会给你带来一段不一样的rpg冒险体验！

name: Homecoming -KITAKU-
short_description: Uncover the truth hidden in the darkness with your own hands.

name: Yamizome Liberator
short_description: Yamizome Liberator is a visual novel about adventure between worlds. After defeating the demon lord, a boy with a dark secret becomes the target of beautiful heroines and a goddess.

name: We're Here, Papa
short_description: We're Here, Papa is a VR horror game. In the dark depths of the sewer, you must find your way and escape on your own. But you are not alone down there. Something is pursuing you. You don’t know what it is, but one thing is certain… you must not let it catch you.

name: Sensei! I Like You So Much!
short_description: Sensei! I like you so much! is a fandom business simulation game. You will play as a fanfic author, create fanfic of all genres, release your fanzine, join comicons, gather followers, and become a legend. In the meantime, buy goods of your pairing, build itabags, and decorate your room.

name: Demon Alive
short_description: Enter the ancient forest ruled by cursed demons. Your mission: Find the hidden chalices. But beware – the demons use these chalices to teleport you to eerie, dangerous places!

name: Time of War - Airstrike
short_description: Dogfight through time! Upgrade your plane, from biplanes to modern fighter jets. Face off against historical and futuristic foes, and dominate the skies!

name: Fledgling Manor
short_description: A supernatural horror visual novel where vampires compete to save their eternal unlives in a high-stakes reality show.

name: Clones Run
short_description: A puzzle action game where Clone humans race through stages aiming for the goal! Move blocks that are impossible to handle alone by teaming up with everyone! Bring as many clones as possible to the goal!

name: 中年失业模拟器2-When a man lose his job 2
short_description: You are a 35-year-old man who was fired by your boss,and still need to pay heavy mortgage and rise 2 kids,in previous game you establish your own company and make a lot of money,however a huge disaster is coming to your city...

name: Cartier 06
short_description: After a long day at work, all you want is to relax on the couch—but the night has other plans. Step into the shoes of a Romanian engineer in the mid-2000s and survive a harrowing night as something hunts you in the shadows.

name: Guardian Grids
short_description: A simple and fun tower defense game! Combining light card elements with the fun of randomness.

name: Riverside of Dice
short_description: The boy found himself by the river. A table, dice, and a cat are in front of him. A simple dice-based combat.

name: Aaero2
short_description: Trace ribbons of light, releasing the energy in the music as you speed through stunning alien worlds. Fly solo or team up with a friend. Encounter strange enemies and giant boss creatures. Unleash devastating missile barrages and rain cannon fire to the beat of the epic Monstercat soundtrack.

name: Pholee
short_description: In search of fragments of the past and the future, embark on a journey through photographs that were once created by a great artifact - the Time Camera

name: Crimson Moon
short_description: Isekai survival horror RPG. defeat the enemy or escape, your decision will make the difference between life and death. ...... A horror RPG with large character dots and a death-defying storyline.

name: Sprout's Words
short_description: The setting sun dyed the clouds in the sky red. The whole sky looked like a burning painting, with many golden clouds floating above the heads of the two little boys.

name: Breath of Death VII: The Beginning: Reanimated
short_description: The fast-paced supernatural RPG, Breath of Death VII, has been resurrected and remastered! Embark with our undead heroes on a bone-rattling post-apocalyptic adventure through an undead world, now more vibrant than ever, to exhume the mysteries of the past.

name: Fishtronomy
short_description: Fishtronomy is an adorable minimalistic puzzle game where you launch fish through space to form constellations and help decorate the skies! Make the sights in Fishtronomy.

name: Slap It Together!
short_description: Slap It Together is a first-person horde survival game, full of slapstick shenanigans and zany zombies. Customise your character, arm yourself with objects you find throughout the levels and escape a perilous gameshow. Playable in solo or online co-op.

name: Sklime - A Difficult Climbing Adventure
short_description: Two arms, twice the difficulty. How high can you climb before the Depths reclaim you? A brutally difficult twin-stick climbing game

name: Tilebreaker Next Level
short_description: Earth is under attack! Take control and defend the planet in this adrenaline-fueled top-down shooter. Blast through blocks, dodge relentless enemy fire, and face off against formidable bosses. Can you save the Earth in record time? Get ready for the ultimate challenge!

name: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle
short_description: Uncover one of history’s greatest mysteries in a first-person, single-player adventure. The year is 1937, sinister forces are scouring the globe for the secret to an ancient power connected to the Great Circle, and only one person can stop them - Indiana Jones™.

name: Coffee Shop Simulator
short_description: Wake up and smell the coffee in Coffee Shop Simulator. Manage, and personalize your very own coffee shop. Craft the perfect coffee, serve up delicious pastries, and create a cozy place for coffee lovers from all walks of life.

name: Trade Conquest
short_description: Rise from a cunning strategist to a powerful ruler. Master economic warfare, manipulate global events, and build industries or armies to conquer the world. Every decision in this modern Grand Strategy game shapes your ascent to power—will you rise through wealth or force?

name: MIGLORN
short_description: Gather resources and strategically build up your Viking settlement by day, fortifying it to withstand the relentless onslaught of skeletons by night

name: Xmas, Super Puzzles Dream
short_description: What idea! Imagine a game where precision and speed combine in a unique experience. In this fusion of jigsaw puzzles and 'Tetris' style, each puzzle piece must not only fit perfectly, but must also be placed quickly before time runs out. If you like the idea, don't be left wondering!

name: Afterlife Reverie
short_description: A challenging 2D puzzle platformer where a damned spirit must navigate her way through the Underworld and beyond in search of her past. Take over bodies and teleport your way to the answers you seek!

name: The Rake
short_description: The Rake is an open-world singleplayer horror game where you have to survive and hunt The Rake while exploring the world or completing the main quest. Use Beartraps, Trailcams, Pistols, SMGs, Rifles, Weapon Attachments, Drones, and anything else you find to survive.

name: Margarita (Berkeley's Maid: Remake Edition)
short_description: The ghosts of the past, recounting the tragic past

name: 眼傀公司（EYEPUPPET COMPANY）
short_description: If there are any abnormalities in your robot at home, please send it back to the company for testing and inspection as soon as possible. Our company provides safety and other aspects of robot testing, adjustment, and repair to make your robot look brand new, just like it just left the factory.

name: The Thing: Remastered
short_description: The Thing: Remastered is a faithful restoration of the cult-classic 2002 third-person survival horror shooter game inspired by Universal Pictures’ genre-defining 1982 film, The Thing

name: Planet Miners
short_description: Control a mining robot and dig for mineral resources on various planets. Transport the valuable ores with your spaceship. Buy or craft upgrades to improve your tools. Defend yourself against the dangers of each planet to mine even the most valuable treasures!

name: Hidden in Clickville
short_description: Discover the charming people of Clickville across the four seasons, as you assist them in locating their misplaced items. Search for all the hidden objects across various levels. The grateful townsfolk of Clickville will be sooo happy! Bonus level as a surprise for you!

name: Master Leaf Blower
short_description: Master Leaf Blower is a physics-based arcade game with a comic book twist. Become a leaf-blowing hero and save the city! Navigate unique districts, tackle fun challenges, and test your skills in this crazy simulator.

name: Year of the Ladybug: Season 1
short_description: In 'Year of the Ladybug: Season 1,' characters traverse a nightmarish realm filled with fear and despair, revealing sinister secrets while evading the relentless terrors that pursue them at every turn.

name: Puropu Defense Squad
short_description: Defend your world as sentient Props in Puropu Defense Squad! Build, upgrade, and evolve your heroes to crush waves of filthy humans worldwide. Dive into a unique mix of third-person action and tower defense—solo or with friends—in an endlessly replayable co-op campaign!

name: JUMPY BUNNY
short_description: Reach the top of the burrow! Jump, jump, and jump. This game is about jumping with precision and determination. Oh yeah, it's also playable with your friends.

name: Magehunter: Phoenix Flame
short_description: Stalk the city streets with ancient technology! Will your sword clash with mages, or will you betray your order in exchange for power? Magehunter: Phoenix Flame is a dark fantasy text-based rpg.

name: Astrometica
short_description: Astrometica is a space exploration and base-building survival game. After a catastrophic event, explore vast space, gather resources, build bases, and uncover cosmic mysteries. Use advanced technology, craft tools, and discover new blueprints to survive and thrive in the unknown.

name: Dash Connect 2
short_description: Dash Connect 2 is a deceptivly simple puzzle game in which you have to connect all the dots. But don't be fooled by the simple appearance, difficulty ramps up quickly, as new mechanics are introduced.

name: Christmas Hustle
short_description: Christmas is coming and Santa's elves are quite busy. Can you help them to pack the presents?

name: Last Signal
short_description: Last Signal is a short, story-driven, walking simulator visual novel. On a mysterious journey through space, astronaut Adam 'Echo' Winters awakens in an abandoned station with amnesia. He must unravel the secrets of the station, where reality and illusion are intertwined.

name: Argonauts Path
short_description: A card-based combat roguelike. A fantastic adventure of growth and struggle for the future of humanity. You will help in different villages, fight against incredible creatures and fearsome demons until you reach the 7 divine ones and you will fight against them, if you are up to it.

name: Canvas Menagerie
short_description: A slice-of-life boys love romance about a group of TV actors going through their mid-20s together.

name: ZOMVIRUS
short_description: 'ZOMVIRUS' is a first-person zombie apocalypse survival shooting game set in Hongdae, Korea. Within the quarantined zone, gather survival supplies and weapons to protect yourself from zombies, and move to safe zones to stay alive. the zombies won't wait for your transformation.

name: Nikoderiko
short_description: Run, jump, ground pound, slide and ride through seven unique worlds in Nikoderiko: The Magical World, a charming platforming adventure game! Play in single-player or couch co-op, and enjoy music by legendary composer David Wise.

name: Romania Prop Hunt
short_description: Romania Prop Hunt is a multiplayer game where you play with your friends and hide as a prop, an object from the game, and the Hunter tries to find them!

name: Cats Visiting Christmas Town
short_description: Embark on a Christmas quest to uncover hidden cats in charming holiday scenes filled with snowmen, festive shops, and a grand tree adorned with gifts.

name: Nightfall House
short_description: Nightfall House is a first-person walking simulator game that allows you to feel as if someone is always around.

name: Neptune Island
short_description: Neptune Island is a short puzzle game where you have been tasked with repairing the light of a lighthouse. The light has been out for some time, and the owner hasn't done anything to fix it. Unbeknownst to you, you have a much more difficult job ahead of you than you anticipated...

name: CATRUN
short_description: Join Philip the cat in CATRUN, an exhilarating runner game set in a bustling city. Help Philip avoid wolves, navigate tricky obstacles, and use fall acceleration to speed through challenges. Explore dynamic environments, collect power-ups, and uncover a heartfelt story of adventure and friendship.

name: I Lost Someone
short_description: The story of a father and son experiencing the ups and downs of life, and how they try to make the best of the twists and turns life puts them through

name: The Ghost Treasure
short_description: Use your soul as a stake to gamble for a treasure of the undead captain. As long as you take the randomly distributed flintlock gun and fight a duel with the ghost pirates, you can leave with the treasure, or your soul will remain on the undead ship forever. Good luck.

name: Coconut Simulator
short_description: Coconut Simulator is a game in which you can become a coconut.

name: Dungeon Destroyer
short_description: Dungeon shooting exploration game

name: Care
short_description: Care is an atmospheric first person horror game where your choices have consequences. Be observant with your surroundings and unravel the horrific secrets that hide within these walls.

name: NINJA KAMUI: SHINOBI ORIGINS
short_description: A thrilling ninja action game based on the hit original anime “NINJA KAMUI”

name: Wasteland Kitchen
short_description: Run your very own restaurant in the post apocalyptic wasteland! Serve 'meat' made from rats (or your customers)

name: Periodicity - Hats and scars
short_description: Survive against hordes of monsters. Equip different weapons with unique abilities. Forage for materials to rebuild a destroyed town. Upgrade your gear for maximum damage.

name: Evil Holiday
short_description: Returning to parents' house for Christmas and a regular holiday dinner turns into a bloody hell filled with horror and death.

name: Symphonia
short_description: Awaken an expansive musical realm in this non-violent and poetic platformer. In Symphonia, you'll use the power of your violin coupled with your platforming skills to gather an orchestra to bring the musical machinery of the world back to life.

name: Defense Breakers
short_description: A roguelike tower defense game. Pick your players, collect treasures, and break through the enemy's heavy barriers. Each expedition brings a new experience. Tired of playing? You can also participate in the design of game levels as a game development engineer to give yourself a boost of intensity!

name: HIDDEN CATS 2: Crafts
short_description: All professions are important, all professions are needed! Explore a world of crafts, each with a place for cats. Find them and the world will be colored!

name: SMOKY WHITE
short_description: 雪の降る冬の屋上で、 不思議な雰囲気の先輩と出会って別れる短編ノベルゲームです。 会話中の選択によって結末が分岐します。

name: FINAL STEP
short_description: ▎Final Step is a very difficult platformer in a mysterious universe, where all levels are made diverse and dynamic. Go through difficult levels, each of which demonstrates new mechanics and complexity - requiring a new approach and tactics to complete it.

name: 无梦少女 DreamlessGirl
short_description: Light up your fantasy with extra lives ✈︎ ⋆｡˚A new type of bishoujo game combining 'bullet hell shooting' and 'visual novel.'

name: Reel and Riddles
short_description: Catch fishes by... solving puzzles?! Discover the correct moves in limited attempts. Uncover diverse fish species with unique twist on the rules. Relax, and enjoy the cozy world as you reel in your next big catch!

name: Bigfoot vs Scots
short_description: Bigfoot vs Scots is a dark comedy adventure set on the quirky Scottish island of Amadan. Play as Ann, a fiery outcast uncovering bizarre secrets, battling Bigfoot, and navigating eccentric locals. Packed with biting humor, Scottish culture, and heartfelt themes of belonging and resilience.

name: Path of Exile 2
short_description: Path of Exile 2 is a next generation Action RPG from Grinding Gear Games, featuring co-op for up to six players. Set years after the original Path of Exile, you will return to the dark world of Wraeclast and seek to end the corruption that is spreading.

name: Heat Death: Survival Train
short_description: Heat Death is a sci-fi survival game where you can build, upgrade, and customize your battle train to explore and survive a frozen world! This train is not only your shelter and vehicle, but also your weapon and ally to face hostile drones, deadly storms, and hidden mysteries of an unknown world!

name: A Drop of Color
short_description: A story-driven RPG puzzle game where you solve color-based puzzles and engage in side-scrolling shooter action in an arcade.

name: Lovely Composer
short_description: This is a music creation tool that inherits the spirit of a game console music editor! You can enjoy create 8bit chiptune like music on a cute screen.

name: Real Pharmacy Simulator
short_description: Become the owner of a pharmacy in Real Pharmacy Simulator! Manage the business, serve customers, and balance profit with ethics. Order medicines, organize the space, and decide how to run your business - honestly or riskily. Your decisions will determine the fate of the pharmacy!

name: RANDungeon
short_description: Take on the role of a legendary hero on a quest to find the Dungeon Lord: a powerful creature lurking deep within a treacherous dungeon.Every game is different and completely random, but if you adopt the right strategy maybe you can reach and defeat the Dungeon Lord!

name: Gacha Addict Simulator
short_description: A simulator game where you play as a gacha-addicted human of society. Go to work, earn money, survive, and do what you were meant to do as a human being - play all the gacha games in the world. Gacha pulls earn you collectibles that you can place in and decorate the space of your small apartment!

name: Sheep Quest
short_description: A traditional 2D platformer. Overcome obstacles in your struggle against wolf-kind.

name: Dino running from a FURRY: GAMESFORFARM
short_description: Run, Dino, run! You can't fall into the clutches of Mr. Furry

name: Shadow Prisoner
short_description: 'Shadow Prisoner' is a 2D fighting game with simple and exhilarating combos. There is also a simple mode for those who have no experience with fighting games, so you can play with confidence.

name: Whistling Waters
short_description: Catch as many fish as possible to meet your boss' quota and avoid damaging your steamboat! Upgrade your boat and catch RARE fish!

name: Just Grill the Steak!
short_description: This is a game for anyone who just wants to grill a steak. That’s it. You grill steaks. We’ve really focused on getting that jiggly meat texture just right.

name: Ultra Cop
short_description: A challenging retro arcade FPS/TPS straight from the late '90s. The Crime Wars have started and it's up to the Ultra Cops to bring back ultimate justice. Use Mechs, Riot Cars and serious firepower to bring the pain to the criminal underworld in this 6th Generation Y2K inspired game.

name: Bum Bum Monsterz
short_description: Bum Bum Monsterz is a 2v2 to 4v4 team-based multiplayer party game! Gather friends for hilarious challenges, tackle obstacles, and solve puzzles. Engage in absurd minigames with vibrant graphics and silly characters. Get ready for a wild ride and JIGGLY butt-filled madness!

name: Paper Perjury
short_description: It all started with a simple robbery. When that thread was pulled, a tapestry of mysteries was revealed. Solve cases and outsmart criminals in a detective story full of lies, confessions, and maybe even a murder or two.

name: Cat Needs
short_description: Cats are adorable beings but they can be temperamental, some like one thing and some like another. Find the purrrfect way to organize the cats so that everyone has their wishes fulfilled. Be careful for them don't fight each other.... or eat each other's food by mistake. ΦωΦ

name: Magical Magic World
short_description: All main characters are Vtubers!! [/]Pixel art side-scrolling comical fantasy magical action sent by Vtuber magical girl!!This game is an orthodox side-scrolling 2D action game.You can experience various worlds from the beginning with the stage selection type.

name: Ominous Horizons: A Paladin's Calling
short_description: It falls to you, a noble Paladin, to undertake the quest to retrieve the Gutenberg Bible, that was stolen, and to keep the darkness at bay.

name: ICBM: Escalation
short_description: ICBM: Escalation is a grand RTS where you command armies, develop cutting-edge tech, and wield devastating weapons. Conquer enemies with conventional forces or nuclear firepower. With new modes like Standoff and Conquest, the game offers deep strategic layers in a global warfare setting.

name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl
short_description: Discover the vast Chornobyl Exclusion Zone full of dangerous enemies, deadly anomalies and powerful artifacts. Unveil your own epic story as you make your way to the Heart of Chornobyl. Make your choices wisely, as they will determine your fate in the end.

name: Level Tank
short_description: Blast your way through the endless swarm of enemies and live for as long as possible in this fast-paced, top-down shooter. Upgrade your tank, collect power-ups, and activate abilities to help you survive on a variety of maps in various game modes. How long will you last before meeting your demise?

name: Don't Drown
short_description: Dive into the world of Don’t Drown, an underwater precision platformer. Navigate treacherous landscapes and avoid menacing creatures while balancing your oxygen and health. Line your pockets with treasure at the cost of mobility. Race against time, yourself, and others on the global leaderboards.

name: Chester The Chest
short_description: Play as an animated chest named Chester, embracing the captivating atmosphere and breathtaking scenery as you guide him on his journey. Play around solving simple puzzles and uncover cool objects and secrets.

name: I'm the Game Developer
short_description: In the game, you are a game programmer writing game code as assigned by your company. But don't worry, you can build a game just by dragging and dropping nodes and connecting them! With this game you will experience the process of game development and improve your logical thinking.

name: Space Duck: Escape
short_description: Collect equipment and climb upwards to assist Puddles the Duck escape from an erupting volcanic planet in this fast paced rogue-lite vertical platformer. Move quickly to avoid the rising lava flows to help this Space Duck Escape!

name: Tomb Stalkers
short_description: Tomb Stalkers is an Arcade Action Puzzle game with fast paced mechanics. Walk around the tombs to open them and reveal their content, you require to get a key and a relic to be able to unlock the exit to the next level. But beware, the sorceress minions are upon you with their unique abilities.

name: Ink Inside
short_description: INK INSIDE is the CO-OP beat-em-up RPG with the heart of a Saturday Morning Cartoon! Play as Stick (Brian David Gilbert) an unfinished doodle in an old notebook trying to discover who they are. Fight back against the wet 'Sog' corrupting the world while saving your friends!

name: Dagger Froggy
short_description: Dagger Froggy is a small action Roguelike, Where you face hordes of enemies... Cute? With each round you get stronger, But so do the cute creatures. >:)

name: Spore Valley
short_description: A bite-sized resource management puzzle, inspired by engine-building board games and the weird world of real-life slime molds, fungi, and lichen.

name: Mayhem Mail
short_description: The mail has been scattered! Take on the mail route from hell, recover and deliver the mail to its rightful place! Mayhem Mail is a classic single screen arcade platformer in the vein of Donkey Kong, Bubble Bobble and Mario Bros. with some added puzzle elements.

name: The Restless Sheep & The Lone Wolf -A Tale of Cutthroat Lovers-
short_description: In this twisted love story of a visual novel by CLOCKUP, an insomniac must decide whether to protect his position as a yakuza bigwig’s pet killer or the mysterious woman who can put him to sleep.

name: NAIAD
short_description: Immerse yourself in a relaxing, minimalist and colorful adventure. Flow with Naiad across a mysterious river and interact with its fauna and flora to discover little secrets. Enjoy a wholesome experience with an original and dreamy visual style.

name: MiSide
short_description: Let's imagine that you have a game in which you care for a character. But could you imagine one day getting into that game yourself?

name: The Midnight Crimes
short_description: Point-&-Click Adventure Game,Play as a retired private detective investigating a missing child case while battling your past demons. Explore Midnight Cove, a wicked Victorian city with semi-open world mechanics and characters relationships. Experience the story episodically, chapter by chapter.

name: Dreamcore Retro
short_description: Dreamcore Retro is a short and relaxing low poly indie game based on lucid dreaming and liminal spaces to concern about endangered species and other problems from the future society. The game mainly consists in exploring the dreamy surroundings of these psychedelic and minimalistic worlds...

name: Furball Farm
short_description: Welcome to Furball Farm. The current version only has the orchard map and a small amount of white noise, the remaining white noise will be fixed in the next update. The garden map and food map will be presented in the big update next year, all the updates are free, no purchase, stay tuned.

name: Who Killed
short_description: Who Killed is a multiplayer murder mystery game that brings a different idea, offering a wide variety of abilities for both classes, where various types of different events can occur throughout the match.

name: Kraken City
short_description: She is the dark magician, an apostle of the great Kraken, Nialato. Through brute strength and magical prowess, show the terrifying Kraken powers to the foolish humans! Experience the thrill of unparalleled hack-and-slash action with the fearsome Kraken

name: AICE
short_description: AICE is a game about designing increasingly complicated processor chips, all while hiding sneaky extra capacity from the 'supervising' humans. Carefully design and layout your chips so that all the extras you've added are well hidden in amongst the regular components!

name: Bug.Splash TD : Debugged
short_description: Bug.Splash TD : Debugged is a strategic tower defense experience set in a fantasy universe. Defend your gate against hordes of bugs using a variety of towers and the environment. The game features 24 towers, 15+ enemy types, dedicated idle farming maps, custom diffculty options and tons of upgrades

name: 重返现场：真人版
short_description: 游戏故事发生在东南亚某国，这里潮湿闷热，城市混杂着现代化高楼与旧街小巷，充斥着神秘与危险。玩家将扮演一名法医实习生，通过在各类案件现场进行取证、分析线索，逐步揭开案件背后的真相。

name: Hidden Evil
short_description: Hidden Evil puts you in a house where you must escape by finding items around the house. But you are not alone. Creatures will appear trying to get into the house and you must use your UV light to defend yourself. Good luck trying to escape.

name: FPV Battleground
short_description: FPV Battleground is a dynamic FPV drone control simulator with realistic physics. Players get the opportunity to control drones from a first-person perspective, maneuvering with maximum accuracy and efficiency. Your task is to destroy enemy vehicles using all the capabilities of FPV drones.

name: Pico Topia
short_description: A tiny citybuilder where you combine tiles to gather points and unlock new ... tiles!

name: The Restless Sheep & The Lone Wolf -Woolly Eyes GAIDEN-
short_description: The romantic noir visual novel The Restless Sheep & The Lone Wolf returns to Kabukicho in this unhinged simul-quel. Me, Azami, and the whole ragtag gang rampage through five all-new short stories!

name: Bulbs 2.0
short_description: Mix colors and light in Bulbs 2.0, a challenging puzzle game where your logic skills are key to turning the entire board white.

name: Void Phantom
short_description: A space roguelike shooter with epic naval battles. Pilot your ship, face ruthless enemies and massive bosses, and customize your fleet with devastating weapons.

name: Bronana
short_description: Bronana is a thrilling and hilarious survival roguelike. Embody the spirit of a fearless banana warrior to take down waves of vicious snack monsters. Through a rich variety of random events, grow stronger, evolve abilities, and face off against challenging bosses to save the homeland.

name: Randall the Grape Jelly Cube goes to Soda Valley for some reason
short_description: A 3D platformer where you go to a place to do a thing

name: Queen Ant Perfume -The Mad Love of Jack the Ripper-
short_description: Journey through modern Tokyo and 19th-century London—the iconic home of Sherlock Holmes—in this romantic mystery adventure. You forges connections with the fascinating men you meets, unravels the mysteries hidden in their world, and fights to avert the looming crisis of global destruction.

name: My friend Mango
short_description: A great friendship trascends the limits of the afterlife and to meet again a friend it only needs a call. Venture alongside Mango between incredible worlds and big challenges to find the way back home.

name: Paradise's Secrets
short_description: After accepting the invitation from the Paradise company following the events we've experienced, nothing on our journey may turn out as we expect. You must be very careful to uncover all the mystery and reveal the truth. Learn everything and expose the true face of the Paradise company.

name: 5 Minute Raid
short_description: A boss raid where the boss is also a player! A team of 3 guardians. 6 classes 12 perks. An abomination from the 3rd dimension, ready to singlehandedly destroy the world. Only 5 minutes until the destruction of the 2nd dimension! A casual quirky 1 vs 3 asymmetrical PvP experience: 5 Minute Raid!

name: PROMIZED LAND: Outer Town 2025
short_description: PL:OT 2025 is a third-person shooter horror survival simulator where you will experience terror while exploring an infected city, alone or with your closest person.

name: Puzzle Machine
short_description: Puzzle Machine is a classic 2D logic game in which the player has to find the only possible solution based on statements.

name: I Am The Registered Environmental Engineer
short_description: This world is plagued by pollution, and as an engineer, you need to plan waste routes, gather, sort, and transport it to safe areas. Use powerful equipment to finally clean it up and restore cleanliness to the world.

name: When Push Comes To Shove
short_description: Play as a robot going through a series of tests for QA. You can push blocks and jump short gaps in this tile based block pushing puzzle game. Watch out for spikes, gaps and lasers. What are they testing you for, and are these dangerous traps really necessary? Find out in When Push Comes To Shove.

name: Çimen Adventures: Story Teller
short_description: Çimen Adventures: Story Teller!, A Journey Full of Your Imagination! Create hilarious stories with Cem and Fazlı, solve imaginative puzzles, and explore adventures filled with pranks and clever challenges!

name: Trump Cake Mania
short_description: Be a hero President Trump in this 3rd person walking game. Collect new cryptos shitcoin and try to find birthday cake. Also beware deathly democratics items

name: Dungeons of Dreadrock 2 - The Dead King's Secret
short_description: Dungeons of Dreadrock - The Dead King's Secret is Part 2 of the (yet unfinished) Dreadrock Trilogy. In this episode you'll puzzle and fight your way through the ancient cavern parts of Dreadrock Mountain. The game features 100 levels, 5 bosses, two different endings and tons of adorable pixel art.

name: Get To Work
short_description: You are poor and bald. Get to Work.

name: The House: A Maple Street Story
short_description: Explore a cursed house where a family was driven to madness by a dark presence. In The House: A Maple Street Story, uncover a terrifying mystery through enigmatic puzzles, an engaging narrative, and a psychological horror atmosphere that holds your every move captive.

name: Tibor: Tale of a Kind Vampire
short_description: Help Tibor save his beloved one and their village from the evil Countess and her vampire army! Based on a popular Croatian fairy-tale book, this warm and inviting jump n' run platformer game will provide hours and hours of fun to both grownups and kids.

name: Baratrum
short_description: Baratrum is an arcade horror game where every playthrough is different in this procedurally generated game.

name: Gangster Clicker
short_description: At the beginning you click People to stun them to get their gold. You spend the gold to buy new new items and not just deal more damage. The more damage you deal, the more gold you gain. Your power will grow exponentially and you will become the best in the world!

name: Takki Jump
short_description: Do you love real challenges and platform games? Then immerse yourself in the world of a Takki. Master difficult jumps and find hidden collectibles. You need jumping skills and a chill head to accompany the Takki on his journey.

name: Boardquest: Tales of Liria
short_description: Lead Orcs, Humans, Elves, or Demons toward victory over Liria in this turn-based strategy for 1-4 players. Advance your skills, wield powerful weapons, and form alliances to defeat your foes. Bring peace over Liria with the solo campaign or face your friends in a local or online multiplayer.

name: DOSMan: Space Aliens in Space!
short_description: Planet DOS is under attack by Space Aliens, DOSMan needs to fend them off and defend his home planet!

name: Forest Heroes
short_description: Forest Heroes combines tower defense with roguelike deck building. Enjoy intense battles and diverse strategies with simple controls!

name: Crop Chronicles
short_description: Chaotic farm management game where teamwork is key. Each level tests you with tight deadlines and complex orders. Play solo or join friends in couch co-op to meet the demands and keep your customers happy. Fast action and smart collaboration are your tools to success!

name: Morrigan's Isle
short_description: Stave off waves of enemies that grow in strength and number as each night passes and defend the Tree of Life. Survive, harvest resources, craft armor and weapons, outfit helper NPCs, and build a base protected by auto-firing towers. Explore the island to find gear with the power of the Celtic Gods.

name: Elite Exorcist Miko
short_description: A bullet hell shoot 'em up featuring hololive’s Sakura Miko! hololive has been possessed by evil spirits! Combine melee and ranged combat with a variety of items to fight your friends and set them free!

name: The Dark Gift
short_description: The Dark Gift is a horror game about Christmas and New Year.

name: ReTrime
short_description: You have 24 hours to explore this land and prepare for its inevitable end. Fight a variety of enemies and bosses; discover a huge arsenal with near-endless potential for player expression and, through each attempt, learn to do it as efficiently as possible.

name: The Ultimate Collector
short_description: Run a card shop with friends in this 4-player co-op simulator! Open packs, trade cards, sell merch, customize your store and map, restock, and cater to collectors while chasing the rarest cards. Build the ultimate card shop empire!

name: Red Fox Unit
short_description: A Third Person 3D, Adventure puzzle game. You awaken on an intensive care hospital ward and must navigate puzzles and conundrums in order to escape. However there is a rapid onset virus sweeping the secure unit - beware it is highly infectious with fatal consequences!

name: TABLE GAME END
short_description: After school today, I talk with her again. Through the window, I see the sunset and someone playing in the schoolyard. We simply watch the scene or share memories from the past.'TABLE GAME END' is an adventure game.

name: Apocalypse Shop Simulator
short_description: Apocalypse Shop Simulator is a sandbox game set in a post-nuclear war world. Buy goods and sell them to customers.

name: Joyville 2
short_description: Joyville 2 is a first-person horror puzzle-adventure game set in an abandoned children's camp. Explore two parallel worlds where the joy of the past meets present horrors. Uncover the camp's dark secrets, face magical yet dangerous creatures, and discover the truth behind events from decades ago.

name: Ted
short_description: Parent Ted, your own childhood. On this journey, you will have the chance to discover your inner child and better understand the trauma and emotions of your childhood.

name: Castle Doombad Classic
short_description: BE THE VILLAIN and slay any hero who dares enter your dark domain! Deck out your castle with traps and minions as the ultimate diabolical dungeon keeper in this strategy / TD puzzler. Includes the original Castle Doombad game, rebuilt and remastered, plus brand new content.

name: Brave Joe
short_description: Step into the life of Joe Martin, a detective haunted by secrets in his childhood town. Uncover the truth of his father’s death, face eerie encounters, and navigate dark challenges. Third-person horror adventure.

name: Neko Odyssey
short_description: Neko Odyssey: A Game for Cat Lovers You Can't Miss! Here’s a slightly unusual Casual Adventure game where the main gameplay centers around taking pictures of cats. The pixel art graphics in a 3D setting create a charming atmosphere reminiscent of Japanese animation.

name: Roid Chimp
short_description: A 2D platformer in the vein of Super Mario World, Megaman, and Sonic, play as Roid Chimp, a personification of our collective rage at a terrible system. Run, climb, and punch your way through a world to explore, filled with books that increase both regular stats and elemental upgrades.

name: The Gate Of The Moon
short_description: This is a game that combines puzzle and platform jumping elements. There are multiple rooms in each level, and the boundaries between adjacent rooms must perfectly match in order to pass through. Players need to navigate between multiple rooms and find the right path.

name: The House of Da Vinci VR
short_description: As Leonardo's apprentice, you will solve puzzles, uncover inventions, and search for hidden objects in 16th-century Florence. Use a unique device to glimpse the past and unravel mysteries. Encounter war machines, intricate lockboxes, and immersive room escapes inspired by Da Vinci's genius.

name: Tawa Defense
short_description: Defend your neighborhood from zombies, build archer, sniper, bomber or electric towers, as the case may be. Strategically place your units, enemies have different abilities, such as agility, shield and amount of life. Each enemy eliminated will give you resources to improve your towers.

name: Reality Core
short_description: Blast through chaotic dungeons and unleash powerful weapons as you journey through the multiverse in search of a way home. Dodge, loot, and survive against deadly foes, extracting hard-won treasures to repair your ship and make it back!

name: Steam Prison -Beyond the Steam-
short_description: The Heights are a gorgeous utopia. The Depths, a filthy industrial wasteland. Our heroine, raised in the Heights, has nothing but contempt for those below. Now an observation mission requires her to descend into that world, and the gears of fate have begun to turn.

name: Rapture Recovery Squad
short_description: Rapture Recovery Squad is a dungeon crawling, deck building auto-battler. Map out the depths beneath humanity's last refuge and build up your roster of psionically charged fighters to prevent the end of the world.

name: Cat's Vote
short_description: A resource management game where every decision matters. Manage your family's happiness by balancing limited resources and casting votes in unpredictable feline elections. Will the candidate you choose lower prices, or will their promises lead to chaos?

name: Denshi Life 2 / デンシライフ 2
short_description: Control life forms, represented by the movement of particles, through “mutation”, “wind”, and “activation” to take the pictures directed by the mission! The simple, new gameplay of the previous title has been developed in a more accessible way, with greatly enhanced visuals and sound.

name: One More Question
short_description: A game utilizing the concept of “Situation Puzzles”, One More Question gives a new perspective on familiar quizzes, presents a backdrop and story to immerse yourself in, and give a workshop editor of your own to share your own puzzles with others. Enjoy!

name: Cutie Panda
short_description: Cutie Panda is a panda-raising app. You can set timers for your panda to remind you to drink water, attend meetings, complete office tasks, or follow any healthy habits you choose. Your panda grows and levels up as you feed it bamboo and play games within the app.

name: Greengrocer Simulator 2024
short_description: Can you rebuild a career that has hit rock bottom? Strive to rise from nothing to the top. Arrange your fruits & vegetables however you like. Keep track of price updates. Play the stock market and aim for the top. Meet people and grab a drink. Show the whole world who's the best.

name: ReThink | Evolved 6
short_description: ReThink | Evolved 6 is a Puzzle Game in a peaceful futuristic setting, that features a variety of Puzzles that utilize Lasers and the behavior of light and it's colors to create challenging problems to solve.

name: Driveland
short_description: Driveland is an open-world driving adventure where every road leads to opportunity. From odd jobs to shady deals, carve your path in a vibrant sandbox world. Drive, explore, and leave your mark on the city!

name: Pirates of Planet B
short_description: A Lo-Fi Survival VR Game, where surviving the end of the world with friends is what matters the most! Explore, Craft and Survive on the remains of a flooded world.

name: The Hookmarine
short_description: What would happen if during an expedition the submarine's engines stopped working and you only had your grappling hook to move and do your work?

name: NDE - Near Dungeon Experience
short_description: A dark turn-based RPG. A survival game where you must conserve and plan accordingly. You must solve puzzles, collect memories and make decisions as a part of the sin system. Collect tools to aid in your traversal of each dungeon. Develop strategies to take down each enemy.

name: Golf Up
short_description: Enjoy Golf Up with friends and family!

name: Shuriken Trigger
short_description: Master the ninja art of wall-running while fighting room after room of syndicate thugs and deadly robots in this unique top-down action shooter.

name: Storage Anomaly
short_description: Storage Anomaly puts you in the role of a cashier assigned to identify unusual anomalies in a store's storage room. Use your phone to take photos of the anomalies, stay alert, solve puzzles, and face unexpected challenges as you navigate through a dark and creepy environment

name: Gnomdom
short_description: Gnomdom is a point & click puzzle game where you find little gnomes stuck in various places and help them return to their home.

name: Ways
short_description: A lone urbex in an abandoned hotel - what could go wrong? Explore the surroundings and find the mysteries of this place. Don't forget to be quiet - urbex is an illegal adventure, and you don't want to be found...

name: 123 wooden figures
short_description: one. Two. Three. We are all wooden people, no talking, no moving. 'Then we pose and stop moving. Whoever can hold on until the end is the winner. Although I have never won,

name: Exorcist
short_description: You are an exorcist tasked with completing a ritual under the threat of malevolent spirits. This game features no narrative and plays like a hide-and-seek game with additional rules.

name: Wheelie City
short_description: Wheelie City is a game about doing deliveries as fast as possible, climbing the urban ranks while collecting and customizing your bike to fit your style! Stunt your way accross hand crafted maps to find shortcuts and secrets and become the best delivery driver in the Wheelie City

name: Moth Cry
short_description: Moth Cry is a non-linear visual novel about life and its consequences. Experience life alongside the main character. His fate is in your hands.

name: Pine: A Story of Loss
short_description: Alone in the forest glade he shared with his wife, a woodworker struggles to accept her passing. Help him hold on to cherished memories of their life together as he struggles to care for himself and his now empty home. Pine is a single-serving game focused on telling a beautiful, emotional tale.

name: Lilia
short_description: Explore the island with your unique companions and aim for the top of the tower! An action RPG where you explore using various items and magic.

name: Lonely Christmas
short_description: It’s a story about an 8-year-old boy Kevin who was left alone at home at Christmas. Protect your house from a crazy robber and wait for your parents. Can you handle with it? We’ll find out.

name: SANTA
short_description: A 1-4 player co-op Christmas horror game. You have 3 days to deliver the presents and save Christmas, or die trying.

name: TruckerX
short_description: Build and manage your own trucking empire in TruckerX. Plan and schedule cargo routes across the globe. Adjust routes in real-time to ensure efficiency and profitability as you expand your fleet and logistics hubs.

name: Senpai and the Mysterious Island
short_description: An RPG where you get to uncover the secrets of a mysterious island inhabited by succubi that was rumored to contain a lost ancient technology. Play as either the warrior Hula Elstia, or Sonia Lanternlily to a variety of combat styles, and dress them up with various outfits.

name: The Fallen Kingdom
short_description: The kingdom is at war and you are the wizard who can save it! Get ready for a 2D isometric journey with spells, combat, bosses, an incredible soundtrack that accompanies the simple, yet epic story!

name: The Three Kingdoms: The Tales of Jian An
short_description: This is a historical strategy game set in the Three Kingdoms era, told from Liu Bei's perspective. It covers the Yellow Turban Rebellion to early Three Kingdoms. Featuring classic turn-based gameplay, it reinterprets historical events, offering both engaging battles and rich cultural insights.

name: Tower One
short_description: How long would you last before the invading monsters destroy and eat everyone in the village!!? Build towers!, build houses!, plant trees!, build tombs for the deceased so they can still help defend as friendly ghosts!, and survive the endless waves of monsters!

name: Front Lines
short_description: Medals, honour, VICTORY. Overcome tyranny in Front Lines, a tactical twin-stick shooter. Use an arsenal of weapons and upgrades to crush your adversaries in this visually stunning single-player epic.

name: Blackthorn Witch
short_description: A psychological horror story set in the town of Blackthorn; a place that lives in constant fear of a witch. The two main suspects? Levi’s mom and sister! His only lifelines to the outside world. Can they live a peaceful life? Or will they be dragged down by the dying town?

name: Poveglia: The Island of Non Return
short_description: Visit one of the darkest places in Italy where hundreds of souls were forgotten in time. After an acclaimed career as a private investigator, detective William Miller takes on one last case; the disappearance of the Family Pierangelli, which has remained in mystery for over thirty years.

name: 5 nights at Timokha 4: School
short_description: Continuation of the legendary saga about the naughty Timokha and his delicious pie!

name: Classroom Whispers
short_description: Classroom Whispers immerses you in the eerie hallways of an Argentine school during the night shift, where nothing is as it seems.

name: World of Slavic glasses
short_description: World of Slavic Glasses – a bullet-hell action game set in the world of Slavic folklore. You will fly on a stupa, fight hordes of undead creatures, and shop at Baba Yaga's store, which can surprise you as you upgrade it! Build your perfect character and try to survive all 20 waves!

name: 桃色武林
short_description: 玩家将扮演一个初出茅庐的江湖小生，在战斗和历练中结识红颜知己，并与她们共同闯荡这个充满危机与机遇的江湖世界。

name: UNHEIM
short_description: UNHEIM is a psychological horror surveillance game of exceptional difficulty in which you must not only report anomalies, but also learn to survive paranormal attacks. Every night is a fight for survival against lurking horrors.

name: Launch And Loot
short_description: Launch & Loot is a rogue-lite dungeon crawler with vibrant pixel art, where each room is procedurally generated. Use the environment to your advantage by throwing objects and loot to defeat enemies. Discover unique power-ups that change your playstyle with every run!

name: ROAD TO EXOTICS!
short_description: 'ROAD TO EXOTICS!' is a casual racing game, Cannon-Style! Race against up to 300 aliens simultaneously, A unique perspective on the racing genre.

name: 30 Birds
short_description: Lantern City is on the verge of disaster: the Goddess Simurgh has been kidnapped by the evil Scientist! 30 Birds is a narrative puzzle game laid out on the surface of rotating lanterns. Wander through a gorgeous world inspired by Persian art, meet quirky birds, and solve puzzles to rescue Simurgh.

name: 云梦之音 The Melody of Yunmeng
short_description: This is an auto battler game that requires backpack management and equipment management! Buy rare equipment to create a powerful combination and then compete with other players!

name: Alpha and Iota
short_description: Alpha and Iota is a puzzle platformer about repairing a computer system inhabited by sentient agents. You operate a repair core, which can navigate the system by ejecting between a variety of different host types. Some hosts are fixed in place, while others jump, slide, climb walls, or follow rails.

name: Delivery Mayhem
short_description: Race against time, embrace chaos, and become the ultimate delivery daredevil in 'Delivery Mayhem.' Top-down mayhem meets high-speed action!

name: Life Saver
short_description: Earth is on the verge of World War 3. All life as we know it will be gone tomorrow. Take control of 'Super Star Dan' to build a super SSD that can store every DNA on earth before the world goes up in flames. 'Life Saver' is a twin stick shooter that you don't want to miss out on!

name: Janosik 2
short_description: Janosik 2 is a retro action-platformer with metroidvania elements. Get ready to jump, slash, dodge roll, dive, smash and bash your way through deadly traps, mischievous villains and bosses, and more in this sequel to Janosik.

name: I Think
short_description: One day, a programmer had an idea. If he could make an AI learn his diary and have the same life experiences as himself, he could create himself in the electronic world.

name: Dami and Secret Library
short_description: Embark on an adventure and healing journey as Dami in a fairytale fantasy world! This third-person 3D game includes light platforming, offering exploration and fun. The first episode features 8 levels with an easy difficulty, giving around 15 minutes of playtime.

name: Miracle Heroes: Temporal Bounty Hunter
short_description: Miracle Heroes is a multiplayer light rogue-like game. In the game, players must choose suitable combinations from a rich arsenal of weapons and items, with each playthrough offering a fresh experience.

name: Weaveborn Heroes
short_description: Survive relentless waves and take on powerful bosses every 5 levels! Weaveborn Heroes is a roguelike arena game where each victory brings you closer to becoming unstoppable. Level up, choose from unique spells and passive abilities, and build your hero to beat the final boss!

name: Bit-Cremental: Fishistry
short_description: Grow fish with a gashapon twist in this bite-sized idler! Feed, nurture, and watch as fisher people reel in mature catches, earning money to upgrade things like feeding, growth, and fishing speeds for even faster profits.

name: Papa's Pizzeria Deluxe
short_description: Top, bake, and serve delicious pizzas in Papa's Pizzeria Deluxe! Craft pizzas for Papa Louie's loyal customers while earning tips, points, and Special Recipes. Unlock holiday ingredients for seasonal pies, and take a trip in the Food Truck to serve your own unique creations!

name: The Cube of Love
short_description: The Cube of Love is an enchanting blend of strategy, creativity, and romance, where you become the ultimate matchmaker.

name: Animal Farmland
short_description: A casual simulation management idle game. Players can click to place crops and buildings, earn coins, unlock a wealth of animals and buildings, and expand the farm

name: Math Master
short_description: Math Master is a retro-style game to practice math with basic operations. Earn all the achievements, compete for the top of the leaderboard with other players and set up a tournament to challenge your family and friends locally.

name: Farm Invaders
short_description: Top down stealth based puzzle game about an alien stealing cows from a farm. Use futuristic gadgets and stay in the shadows to avoid detection. Get all golds in every level to appease the queen and bring honor to your colony!

name: Ad Astra: Sci-Fi Tower Defense
short_description: Lose yourself in an indie solo-dev. treasure that harkens back to arcade classics! All while thumping along to killer retro-inspired beats by Ovani sound. Embark on an epic tower defense adventure against awe-inspiring machine monstrosities, made by a devoted gamer for devoted gamers.

name: CargoSpace
short_description: Deliver packages in a world torn by goddesses. Working for Cargon they guarantee your package will arrive no matter what hazards!

name: Colony
short_description: A teenage guy is playing cricket with his friends outside a haunted house, and as he strikes a six,the ball travels inside the home.He goes to pick up the ball. During his search, he experienced a horrifying incident with the ghost.

name: Wild Woods
short_description: Wild Woods is a couch co-op game full of action, teamwork and woodland critters. One to four players take on the role of brave little cats defending their wooden wagon on its way through a dangerous forest. Clever cooperation is key - their way is full of obstacles!

name: LIMINAL SHIFT
short_description: Liminal Shift is a unique atmospheric suspense game developed using the latest Unreal Engine 5 technologies such as Lumen and Nanite. With every step you take, Liminal Shift pushes you deeper into an eerie, unsettling experience like no other.

name: LightCells
short_description: LightCells is an elegant and minimalist logic puzzle game that captivates players with its simplicity and depth.

name: Neon Blood
short_description: Viridis, year 2053. Growing inequality drives Bright City and Blind City further and further apart until idealistic detective Axel McCoin starts a revolution to change the world in this fast-paced cyberpunk adventure.

name: FallNation Lost Stories
short_description: FallNation: Lost Stories is a procedurally generated first-person roguelike filled with handcrafted locations, powerful upgrades, and an evolving storyline. Discover deeper questions about the fate of humanity in the cosmos, dive into the adventure and discover what lies beyond!

name: Just A Village Clicker
short_description: Just a Village Clicker is a game where you collect resources to rebuild your village and help your villagers with their tasks. Improve your village and combat stats with over 50 upgrades available! Advance through the dungeon floors and defeat powerful enemies!'

name: Twas The Night
short_description: Build and manage Santa's North Pole mega-workshop in this festive city builder where workshops produce toys for the world's children. Spend Christmas Spirit to create new holiday traditions and upgrade your workshops, but lose your spirit and you'll cease to exist.

name: Unknown Tapes
short_description: You are the prey. Unknown Tapes is a horror video game that employs the found footage technique to narrate a story focused on survival in a modern setting overrun by dinosaurs. It aims for realism and draws inspiration from Dino Crisis and Outlast.

name: My Aquarium
short_description: 'My Aquarium' runs at the bottom of the screen while you are doing other things, making it an idle aquarium simulator you can enjoy comfortably.

name: Pic-Me!
short_description: Pic-Me! is a card game about deception, where players use wonderous images to spark creativity and imagination. Each round becomes an intricate mindgame against the other players at the table. Will you be able to outsmart your friends or will you be tricked by them? 4-8 players only.

name: Purrgonia
short_description: There are many things hidden within the unexplored wilderness. Venture into a mysterious forest to gather resources so you can rebuild the village of Purrgonia. Bring back life to the forgotten lands but be wary: the illusive serenity can make you forget about the true dangers of this place.

name: Trash Goblin
short_description: A wholesome, cosy shopkeeping game! Uncover & clean trinkets then upcycle them to sell to endless colourful & quirky customers. Spend your savings to upgrade your shop, buy better tools, plus expand and customise your space.

name: CrimeBot 2: Unsolved Cold Case
short_description: Become a detective in CrimeBot 2 and travel the world solving criminal cases. You'll have only your logic and intuition to analyze dossiers filled with clues, suspect profiles, and photographs. Can you catch the culprit?

name: Milo's Dream
short_description: A top-down adventure game about a doggy in a world of dreams, featuring colorful pixelated visuals and chiptune songs.

name: HOPE: Winter Tale
short_description: Every New Year is similar to the previous one. No friends, no family, no magic. But what if a fairy tale exists? And everything can change? HOPE: Winter Tale is a story about a man who has lost his all taste for life. But one winter night, everything changed.

name: Crosshare - Crosshair Overlay
short_description: A crosshair overlay program focused on improving the gaming experience. Create highly customizable crosshairs using the editor and quickly switch between them. Record hotkeys to allow you to stay in the action.

name: Hidden Cats - Winter
short_description: Dive into the enchanting world of 'Hidden Cats - Winter' a hidden object game where your mission is to uncover every cat hidden within stunning hand-painted artwork. Let your keen eye and curiosity guide you through this captivating journey.

name: 轮回之境
short_description: This game centers on monster hunting, equipment collection, random talents, gear enhancement, and top-tier loot drops.

name: お名前バトル
short_description: ”Onamae Battle” is an easy-to-play game in which you simply enter your favorite ‘Onamae’ and the game will automatically battle for you! The name automatically determines the battle power, so it is easy to enjoy regardless of age or gender. You can also add your favorite images to the battle screen!

name: Echo Stalker
short_description: In this game, players explore a randomly generated map using a Lidar scanner to reveal their surroundings. As they scan for paths and hidden dangers, a relentless enemy chases them. Players must use the scanner to find escape routes and avoid being caught, creating a tense and fast-paced experience.

name: DigDigDrill
short_description: DigDigDrill is an underground mining and resource collecting game. Dig freely for minerals and treasures. Use the items you collect to forge your original drills in a hack-and-slash style equipment system.

name: Fast Food Simulator
short_description: Welcome to the world's most chaotic place! Play solo or co-op with up to 6 players. Run a fast-food restaurant, and work with your friends to expand your business. Take orders, make burgers, and increase your earnings by dealing with customers.

name: Tales Beyond The Tomb - The Farm's Secret
short_description: Dragged into a web of secrets and lies, Samantha seems to be part of a puzzle impossible to solve. What once seemed obvious soon turns into something far more sinister, and the line between villain and victim begins to blur.

name: Jack of Clubs
short_description: Play golf, fight robots, and explore an 18-hole course as Jack, a pilot stranded on a recently-abandoned island resort. Discover secrets and complete challenges to earn items that improve your golf game. Unravel the mystery of the island in pursuit of your golf ball across a huge, continuous course.

name: 箍の外れたビスクドール
short_description: Now, taste the infinite despair! People in a town suddenly turn violent due to unexplained symptoms. This is a story about enjoying the bad endings that befall high school students.

name: xukaackque
short_description: An experimental shooter where you play a ninja trapped in a spider's nightmarish realm. An imaginary landscape to escape with hellish spider guards. Will the world ever hear your story? Are you just another one that tripped, fell into a spider web in the basement, never to return?

name: Retaliation Path of Kingdoms
short_description: Path of Kingdoms is a strategy game where the player must defeat all the factions of the kingdom to reach the goal, each faction has a story that evolves as it conquers territories.

name: ファンタジーワールド ～魔王の想いと真実と～
short_description: 数十億通りのキャラメイクが可能な、懐かしさと新しさが融合した究極の2DレトロハクスラRPG！個人制作ながらも、初心者から熟練プレイヤーまで奥深い冒険が楽しめる事を目指した作品です。

name: Accurate Adjacent Ballistics Simulator
short_description: A.A.B.S. Accurate Adjacent Ballistics Simulator The Most Advanced Ballistic Damage Detection/Application System In Virtual Reality.

name: Chicken Police: Into the HIVE!
short_description: A wild tale of conspiracy, loss, friendship, and... chickens?! Two rooster detectives are about to venture into the insect underworld to uncover a worldwide conspiracy, while also battling their inherent demons in this animal noir adventure satire.

name: The NOexistenceN of you AND me
short_description: Use 'game' as a medium to showcase the world of 'you/girl'. Explore the truth of 'you/girl/world' through the form of a 'visual novel'.

name: 100% Wedding Mission ~Love Love♥Christmas~
short_description: 100% Wedding Mission! is a real time strategy game playable only for a streamer with 45~ viewers. Gather gold and upgrade chat viewer's Unit! Collaborate with chat and streamers to capture the ❤️Love❤️

name: MudRunner VR
short_description: Take the wheel in this ultimate off-road automotive experience designed for VR, with all-new vehicles and tools to navigate harsh landscapes.

name: Dustland
short_description: Dustland is a reimagined take on the survival genre. A world where expeditions, looting, and battles are just the tip of the iceberg, hiding secrets and mysteries of a fallen region in its depths.

name: Precept
short_description: Precept is a first-person psychedelic action horror game with a heavy focus on exploration. Players take control of a night guard whose purpose is to finish his daily task. The player must find way to escape and survive from mysterious company's environment and entities.

name: 再刷一把2：金色传说
short_description: A few days ago, a bright meteor streak across of the sky, the golden light lit up the whole sky. The color of golden symbolizes wealth, power, strength, sacredness and happiness, has attracted countless adventurers, including you, on the adventurous journey for this reason...

name: Letalis
short_description: Letalis is a a non-linear RPG set in coliseums controlled by Caesars, where you train warriors called 'Letalis' to fight for “Glory or Death”. Delve into a unique journey with over a thousand Letalis, each with their own fighting styles, quirks, and aesthetics.

name: Swordhaven: Iron Conspiracy
short_description: Swordhaven is a classic party-based RPG. Explore the land of Nova Drakonia, embark on quests unique to your character, discover mysterious artefacts of the ancients, and unravel a hidden conspiracy that threatens the very existence of the world.

name: My Insect Girl Can't Be This Cute
short_description: Warm soft skin, contrasted with hard chitin. It isn't something you've thought of until one day where your curiosity forced an encounter with an actual insect girl! Will you be able to help her integrate into society? Or will there be someone who stands in your way..?

name: Project Legion
short_description: Immerse yourself in terrifying dreams and unravel mysteries playing alone or with friends. Confront supernatural horrors, survive terrifying enemies, and complete various missions to solve the cases.

name: Escape from Irene
short_description: Escape from Irene is a psychological thriller where you wake up in a mysterious place, with no memory, under the watchful eye of Irene. Explore the house, uncover its secrets, and try to escape without alerting Irene—because if she catches on, something terrible will happen.

name: がんばれ！受付嬢2 ～Stardust Liberate～
short_description: Become the receptionist of the guild and protect your precious daily life! This is a simulation game of a receptionist. Whether you run around to protect your village, follow the king, or expose the darkness that pervades the country, the future depends on your choice!

name: Charming Blood
short_description: Embrace darkness as an unwitting vampire in this choice-driven romance. Navigate ancient powers, brewing conflicts, and passionate relationships with four captivating vampires who could become your greatest allies – or something more. When night falls, will you surrender to its dangers?

name: The Sheriff
short_description: An infiltration and hide-and-seek game in 1v1 with multiple maps and powers

name: Chaotic Conflicts
short_description: Chaotic Conflicts is a casual and chaotic fast-paced Online FPS game. In this chaotic shooter you'll try to shoot your way to the top of the scoreboard while competing with other players and random events.

name: Puppet Seed
short_description: Collect humanoid and monster companions from 8 races, each with their own regions, settlements and elemental affinities. Spend stat and skill points to gain new abilities for your team and player character. Mix different squad compositions in real-time combat while exploring on foot or by vehicle.

name: Reknum Fantasy of Dreams
