short_description: Reknum: Fantasy of Dreams is a 2.5D adventure and exploration game with hand-drawn graphics and an instrumental soundtrack. Explore a dreamlike world, face mysterious enemies, and solve puzzles in this exciting adventure. Discover the world of dreams now!

name: Ruined Nurse
short_description: Explore the hospital by Thwarting the creatures that are trying to stop you and solving puzzles. Successfully install the internet and surprise customer...

name: Beyond Citadel
short_description: Beyond Citadel is an anime style retro throwback shooter inspired by the classics of the 90's, with realistic gunplay mechanics, anime violence and fast paced combat. Fight your way through the heavily armed mechanical fortress and discover the secret that lies beneath.

name: Urban Strife
short_description: Old school TBS, post-apoc survival and RPG. Recruit deranged locals in your militia, ally local factions and fight those you hate. Haul loot back and rebuild your shelter, doctor your wounds, and fix your guns. People need feeding, booze needs brewing and there is an end of the world to enjoy.

name: World War 3: Card Battler
short_description: Play as your favorite country, in a card battle for world domination.

name: vROVpilot: TITANIC
short_description: Experience the bow of the Titanic wreck as captured by Magellan at the bottom of the North Atlantic Ocean. Immerse yourself as an ROV pilot to explore the wreck and complete missions to scan key features of this sleeping spectacle.

name: Limoria
short_description: Welcome to a world where you are lost between consciousness and dreams. As you wander the dark corridors of an old hotel, face the games your mind plays on you. Your memories linger like a shadow following you. But there's nowhere to escape... Are you ready to confront your darkest fears?

name: The Memories That Shape Us
short_description: The Memories That Shape Us is a narrative video game that lasts about an hour and half to two hours. Find the Memory Capsules to uncover the story of a person’s life from childhood to adulthood, all the joys, all the struggles, and all the lessons. How much can one take before they’ve had enough?

name: Nothing To Declare
short_description: As a guardian of the customs realm, you hold sway over the comings and goings of travelers, packages, and cargo containers alike. Do you possess the mettle to tackle such a formidable responsibility?

name: Idle Colony
short_description: A condensed incremental experience, where you build a colony to collect and merge bigger and bigger fruits. Combine game-changing technologies and special upgrades to find the best synergies and take your cash flow to another dimension.

name: HuntNPrey
short_description: HuntNPrey is a multiplayer hide-and-seek game for up to 8 players. By day, act natural and blend in with the herd to escape the hunter's sights. By night, transform into a wolf and flip the script—now it’s your turn to hunt! Stay sneaky, stay sated, or get caught!

name: VRenity
short_description: An interactive, conversational VR and PC experience where you explore, unwind, and chat with your virtual companion, Nerdle. Designed for immersive relaxation, VRenity blends exploration with lighthearted conversation and engaging insights, allowing players to de-stress in a virtual oasis.

name: Reavers of New Rome
short_description: When your ancestors were exiled from New Rome, they left as Senators. Now, 100 years later, you return as a barbarian at the gates.

name: Winion Virus
short_description: Winion Virus is a pixel-art visual novel horror game. It features adorable and charming graphics paired with a dark fairy-tale story full of unexpected twists. As a point-and-click adventure, your task is to fix the errors occurring within the computer.

name: Asteroid King
short_description: Fast pace shooter that has a story to tell. Upgrade weapons and kill bad guys is what this game is all about. The story will make you excited about each level and boss fight!!! Good Luck and Enjoy!

name: Fox Leap
short_description: This is a 2D platformer game where players take on the role of an agile fox. Players must dodge traps and enemies along the way to reach the destination. The game currently features only one level.

name: Realife Simulator
short_description: Feature Contents Once you have created your character, you can go to the clothes shops and barber shops if you want to get a unique look. Social Events In case we meet new people, take your cell phone number, record it in your own guide and send a message or call each other.

name: DEDALO - Escape Room Adventure
short_description: Uncover the secrets of a frozen world in Dedalo: Escape Room Adventure. Explore ancient Arctic ruins, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the power of a lost artifact. Can you unravel the mystery and make it home before it’s too late?

name: Wallsurf
short_description: Wallsurf is a game that combines elements from CS:GO's Surf minigame, Jumps, and the beta release of Karlson. This game is a fast paced 3D racer based on the movement mechanic of sliding down walls.

name: Among Ashes
short_description: Among Ashes is a terrifying first-person survival horror game. Your friend has sent you a link to a game that someone posted online, but as you play you quickly realise that something is terribly wrong. Whatever you do… K̴͉͚̗̅̃̄E̷͓̤̺̊͠E̴̤̰̿̽P̴̠̳̀́ ̴̨̮̭̕̚P̷̠͇̳͐̓̀L̶̹̔Ả̷̧Y̵̘̺͆̓Ï̸̻̏͂N̷͙̯͊G̵͖̹̠̽̿

name: Glider Simulator
short_description: A glider simulator based on VR technology, with strong 360 degree immersion and 12 scenes including canyons and islands for flight. When you put on the VR device, you instantly become a free bird, flipping, hovering, and sprinting as you please, feeling the resonance of heartbeat and passion.

name: Tobacco Shop Simulator
short_description: Run your tobacco shop. Sign contracts with leading brands, order products, hire workers, expand your store, and never let your customers leave the store empty-handed. Play with friends or go solo, and enjoy the growth of your shop.

name: Smoothcade
short_description: Smoothcade is a cute “clear the screen” modern-arcade game that features co-op gameplay for up to four players. Recover the missing golden blender through 100 platform-jumping, puzzle-solving levels in story mode - consisting of handcrafted levels and a ton of fruity critters!

name: BeachHead Rogue
short_description: BH Rogue is the next exciting iteration of the BeachHead brand. It blends the action FPS of the original BeachHead game with new Rogue-lite elements. Join the BeachHead defenders against the Musso Khan forces!

name: Grove Fisher
short_description: A relaxing idle game about fishing. Discover dozens of fishes and treasures! Spend your resources on growing your operation and unlocking new varieties of underground life! Achieve goals, buy skills, and mutate rare fish to improve your profits!

name: Explore Dreams: Dreamcore
short_description: Now you can explore your dreams while solving puzzles...

name: PIRORO
short_description: チップチューン専用の作曲ソフト『PIRORO』で 8bit音楽制作を楽しもう！

name: Zombies Ate My Femboy
short_description: A Run-and-Gun indie shooter! Avoid various monster and save big booba women! 9 playable levels with 7 different enemies!

name: 拜托！请你先告白
short_description: This is an immersive live-action love simulation game from the first-person perspective. In the game, players will have sweet interactions with six girls. You will have an immersive love experience! Choose the one you love and love the one you choose. The direction of love is up to you.

name: Potion Wilds
short_description: Explore the wilds filled with curious creatures, delve into a mystery and grow fantastic plants as a tiny cat with a huge talent for potions in this 3D action adventure RPG.

name: 回生九命 The Nine Rebirths
short_description: This is a 2D platform decryption adventure game about a cat rescuing its owner. The underworld is full of organs and challenges, can you use the cat's connection between 'soul' and 'body' to complete this adventure full of dangers and difficulties? Download and play 'Back to Life Nine Lives'!

name: Thunderman - Adventures in another realm
short_description: Thunderman: Adventures in Another Realm is an exhilarating 2D action-platformer where you embark on an epic journey alongside Kaelan, a young archer chosen as the defender of the universe. To restore peace, you must face dangerous enemies, gather resources to survive.

name: Bonk the Rat
short_description: Relax with this goofy clicker, as rats are meant to get bonked!

name: Project Hover
short_description: Antigravity racing game with multiplayer and single-player. Each player can either lose his hover or take over the hover of another player in online full loot PvP mode.

name: Akumon Summoner
short_description: 'Akumon Summoner' is a captivating RPG where you play as a young Akumon summoner. Catch, train, and mutate your Akumons to build the best team possible. One goal: make your village, your region, and your country proud!

name: sea fight
short_description: 'Naval Battle' is a simple game. Players control submarines and fire torpedoes to attack the enemy. By upgrading the base and obtaining modules in battles, players can become powerful quickly. Have a great time playing!

name: Ancient Cultivatrix
short_description: 'Ancient Cultivatrix' is a Roguelite cultivation game with tower defense elements. The world was corrupted by chaos and became utterly depraved. Please gather the surviving cultivatrices and unite them. Enhance Taoist energy and spiritual prowess together, gradually uncovering the elusive truth.

name: Doggy Up!
short_description: A platformer game where you play as a German Shepherd named Ollie, trapped in his own dreams. Can you pass the main challenge and free Ollie from captivity?

name: Gridiron Grilling: The Refusal of the Garden
short_description: Gridiron Grilling is a deckbuilding roguelike where you control 1 of 5 different meats - er, characters to face off against the food pyramid. With over 50 legendary cards, craft your deck to take down fruits, veggies, dairies, grains, sweets, and vicious meat pretenders!

name: Dungeon Watchers
short_description: Survive and destroy monsters to your heart's content with the help of powerful and unique characters. Unlock new characters and discover the synergies with their abilities to unleash game-breaking builds and slay everything on your path.

name: Burger Shop Simulator 2024
short_description: Welcome to the most chaotic place in the world! You can enjoy it solo! Run a fast food restaurant and expand your business. Let's make an original burger!

name: Ripple In Dirac Sea
short_description: PvEvP 3rd-person extraction-lite action game. Reaching the end of time with companions, explore nine realms suspected in Norse mythology, hunt Vikings, mechas, Valkyries, Tyr, and of course, other players! Capture treasures, evacuate! All items can be traded in free market.

name: CELL 0: Cyber Entertainment Leisure Lounge
short_description: CELL is a short non-linear visual novel in a post-apocalypse/cyberpunk setting. Kenzo is an artificially grown human who lived his entire life alone isolated with a sweet, but artificial service intelligence. He's not okay. Help him to go through the disturbing situation he's about to get into.

name: Start Of LunHui
short_description: The main character is reborn. Can he live?

name: Conradito Cafézito
short_description: It costs the price of a coffee – but it lasts much longer! Conradito Cafézito, is an idle and incremental game where you unlock recipes, automate processes, and expand your coffee empire while watching your profits rise with every click!

name: Bloodshed
short_description: Bloodshed is a Roguelite Survivors FPS; an exhilarating fusion of Roguelite elements merged with retro-styled visuals and first-person “Survivors-like” frenetic combat action!

name: Gift Collector [ギフトコレクター]
short_description: Gift Collector [ギフトコレクター] - this is a New Year's horror game from the first person, in the Japanese style and genre of walking simulator. Collect gifts and make the kids happy on New Year's Eve. But don't forget that Midnight is a time of miracles!

name: Security: The Horrible Nights
short_description: Every time you die, a new story begins. You are the nighttime security guard at a hospital. Your job is to monitor the hospital and fix problems when they happen. Every night, a new horror tale will unfold. If you can survive enough nights, you will learn the truth behind all the horror!

name: OverRider
short_description: A beat'em up style action game, thrilling, hardcore. You can choose between exploring a cyberpunk city, takeover enemies' bodies; or perform a surgery for implants? You play as a female doctor with a mysterious past, hunting at night in Yayoi City and perform surgeries on day in her clinic.

name: Xeno
short_description: Xeno is a 2D platform game - we move left and right and jump in the game, we can shoot and, in some cases, sneak to eliminate enemies from hiding. The game will also feature the use of the environment, such as exoskeletons or vehicles of all types, and puzzles.

name: Baptisterio
short_description: “With an analog camera, a gift from my father, a photo of the missing tourists and the illusion of my first big news I prepare to enter with the brothers to the enigmatic baptistery.”

name: Julian & Friends
short_description: Join Julian and his friends in this psychological horror experience inspired by point-n-click computer games from the early 2000s. Witness many shenanigans with characters from the infamous 98xx.

name: Street Race Kings
short_description: You are brought into a racing league, the SRK. Once you can qualify and prove yourself to the league, you then make your way to the top, racing against various competitors, and taking down stage bosses to move up in rank! Multiple vehicles, customization, open world maps, and more!

name: Long Live Caesar
short_description: 44 BC. Caesar, the dictator of Rome, discovers that the threat of conspiracy comes from the people closest to him. Can you resist the impending danger and rewrite history?

name: My Putrid Ponies
short_description: A zombie ponies game where you have to survive with a shotgun.

name: Gorgon's quest
short_description: Gorgon's quest is a single screen action/platformer. Play alone or with a friend (local co-op) as the mythical gorgon sisters use your petrifying gaze to turn your enemies into stone. Explore ancient Greece, find power ups and defeat great bosses.

name: Gakuin Makyo ~High School Crisis~
short_description: A group of boys and girls is thrown out of their world by a sudden earthquake... finding themselves in a new realm—a demon realm filled with strange monsters. Their fight to return begins now.

name: Light Fingers
short_description: Light Fingers is a magical mechanical board game where thieves compete in a test of skills to prove who among them is the most deft!

name: C.A.S.T.
short_description: C.A.S.T is a third-person PvE extraction shooter playable solo or in co-op. Select your character and loadout to battle enemy hordes, evade anomalies, and complete objectives across handcrafted maps with dynamic procedural elements.

name: The King Cat Clicker
short_description: You are the King of Cats, collect coins, renovate the kingdom, and enjoy adorable visuals in this IDLE/Clicker game.

name: Bricks Survivors
short_description: Bricks Survivors blends retro brick-breaker charm with modern roguelike intensity. Survive fast-falling brick waves and face pixel art bosses in a game crafted by a single creator. A unique and addictive experience, available exclusively on PC.

name: Maki: Paw of Fury
short_description: Maki: Paw of Fury is a beautifully animated fighting game in the style of retro arcade gems. Use your martial arts skills to stun and defeat your opponents and kick the main villain’s ass!

name: Diesel Legacy: The Brazen Age
short_description: Diesel Legacy is a 2v2 fighting game where four players battle on the same stage at the same time. This unique twist on the traditional fighting game formula adds an entirely new layer of strategy where cooperation will become the key to success.

name: Misericorde Volume Two: White Wool & Snow
short_description: White Wool & Snow is the second visual novel in the Misericorde series.

name: The Jackbox Survey Scramble
short_description: Discover how people across the country think! The Jackbox Survey Scramble is a collection of hilarious survey-based game modes, using real one-word answers from real people. Really! Grab some friends and start guessing!

name: Crush Lab
short_description: Break the beautiful glass objects in your way.

name: Gunning for Jean: The Final Update
short_description: A difficult top-down shooter with 4 bosses (featuring Big Jean). Each boss will try to stop you with their unique abilities. Despite this, you are still gunning for Jean.

name: Sentinel Agency
short_description: Sentinel Agency is a First-Person-Survival-Shooter with dinosaurs! Shoot, sneak, uncover secrets, survive!

name: Ignisia
short_description: Ignisia is a magical world where majestic dragons and other mysterious creatures live in harmony, protecting their lands from the forces of darkness. However, not all the secrets of this world are revealed at once — some of its inhabitants remain hidden in the shadows, waiting for their time.

name: Summons Sword: Pot Guardian
short_description: 'Summons Sword: Pot Guardian' is a top-down, highly challenging action game. Teleport to dodge enemy attacks, fight with swords and summoning magic, and recover the treasure 'Clay Pot of Darkness' stolen by the evil summoner!

name: Hero of the Kingdom: The Lost Tales 3
short_description: Lovely adventuring RPG series. Casual, story-driven journey and quests. A darkness is coming that will engulf the whole kingdom. Prepare for an adventure full of surprises and heroic deeds.

name: Abyssal Blood
short_description: Abyssal Blood is an Action Rogue-like/Survivors-like where you can dual-wield many types of different weapons at the same time. Play as Lucy, the daughter of Lucifer, who must eliminate all outlaw souls and demons from hell.

name: Madness inside
short_description: 'Madness Inside'' immerses you in the dark depths of an abandoned psychiatric hospital, where horrifying experiments were once conducted. Police Lieutenant Vic Voight, in pursuit of a dangerous criminal, unexpectedly finds himself trapped in this nightmarish place.

name: Lone Wolf
short_description: Lone Wolf: A Post Apocalyptic Beat-Em Up Role Playing Game. This action/adventure game lets a player use martial arts skills, weapons, and turn into a werewolf to fight their way through a world set in the aftermath of post nuclear devastation.

name: Over Heroes
short_description: A third-person MOBA shooter game with heroes of various distinct skills, there's always one that suits you. In battle, you can choose weapons like guns, wands, bows, swords, and spears. Combine them with your teammates' magic to charge into the enemy and achieve ultimate victory.

name: Dorpie
short_description: Stack quirky buildings skyward in this charming city builder! With limited space, the only way is up. Place structures, complete objectives, and unlock new possibilities. Express your creativity, relax, and watch your absurdly wonderful town reach new heights!

name: Grave Deceiver
short_description: Grave Deceiver is a rogue-like where a corpse swaps places with you in the grave, casting you into hell while it takes your place in the world of the living. Now, you must fight to escape and return home.

name: Follow the meaning
short_description: Follow the meaning is a surreal point-and-click puzzle adventure. Join detective Paul Trilby as he works to unravel the mysteries of a peculiar town, seemingly ruled by the local Hospital. Over the wall and behind tightly shut gates, a dark secret lies in wait…

name: Duckthing's Rolling Rooms
short_description: Duckthing's Rolling Rooms is a puzzle platformer with a weird duck. Rotate the rooms to help Duckthing through each level and reach his goal.

name: Use Your Words 2
short_description: WARNING: This game might make you pee your pants! The cult hit Use Your Words is back with all-new prompts and 2x as many mini-games where you compete to write the funniest punchline. You can customize your own playlist of mini-games, there's a new-and-improved spectator mode, and more!

name: Near-Death-Expedition
short_description: After quitting the job, you were casually browsing a video site when you saw a strange video with a blank thumbnail. 'Can you hear me? Can you see me...?' The next day, you receive a message requesting you to be the manager of the mysterious VTuber 'Owarino Rinne'. The endless journey begins.

name: The Sushi Bar | 寿司バー
short_description: The Sushi Bar | 寿司バー is a Japanese-style horror game where you play as a sushi chef working the night shift.

name: Architect Simulator
short_description: Manage your own architecture firm! Would you prefer to design one skyscraper or many residences, or maybe all at once? Create buildings, beautify the city, sell land plots, manage a warehouse, hire employees, buy real estate, and watch your health.

name: Doggins
short_description: A point-and-sniff adventure

name: Skydance's BEHEMOTH
short_description: Skydance’s BEHEMOTH is an original story set in the Forsaken Lands, a fallen kingdom haunted by tragedy. Play as an outland warrior, Wren the Hunter (the player), and embark on a perilous quest to save yourself and your village. Your only hope is to slay the unslayable, the monstrous Behemoths.

name: WHITE CHOCOLATE
short_description: consume WHITE CHOCOLATE to escape this pitch black facility. share it with that vile creature that survived alongside you. or dont, be an nuisance, it's always profitable to be an nuisance.

name: Cyborg City
short_description: Year 2225. Step into Cyborg City, a cyborg-apocalyptic world where Jax fights to survive from the Scrapyard up to Cyborg City. Using Bullet Time, Jetpack, and Upgrades to destroy enemies, he is avenging his family and saving the girl he loves in this third-person shooter.

name: Gun Reflex VR
short_description: Realistic VR shooter game where you try to complete all the floors by killing your enemies with limited ammunition. It also features zombie, shooting range, and weapon carnival modes.

name: Hunter of Ming Dynasty
short_description: An open-world adventure game set in the middle of the Ming Dynasty, players will experience the process of ordinary people growing into bounty hunters, and turn the tide in times of crisis in the Ming Dynasty.

name: Taiwan Love Story⁵
short_description: 'Taiwan Love Story ⁵' is a romantic interactive novel. To write a thesis on love, you meet girls from different parts of Taiwan. As you conduct your academic research, you gradually become captivated by them, leading to a series of sweet, bittersweet, and complex romantic encounters.

name: The Wanted 3
short_description: Earn game money during the day, crash a police car at night, and become the most wanted man. Whether you can successfully finish the race and escape the police car, everything depends on 'The Wanted 3'!

name: Götz
short_description: Join knight Goetz and his friends on a puzzle adventure across the kingdom. Create elaborate choreographies with the help of your units and bring your enemies to their knees. Indulge yourself in a picture book style medieval world and follow along the lovingly illustrated story.

name: Gangs of Neo Tokyo
short_description: Dominate the streets of Neo Tokyo in this high-speed motorbike brawler. Inspired by classic cyberpunk anime and retro road combat games, fight rival gangs and claim the neon-lit highways as your own.

name: Encounter
short_description: Your mission, locate and free a kidnapped teenager in less than two hours. Use your Private Investigator instincts and skills to explore the area, craft items to get rid of obstacles by entering text commands.

name: KUMAMAWASHI
short_description: 'The witch… took her.' Bear's puzzle adventure, rotate panels in tower.

name: 有请祖师爷
short_description: 国风灵异大作《有请祖师爷》是一款充满恐怖与诡谲的探险游戏。在世道动荡不安，千年僵尸将臣即将破除封印霍乱人间，你将化身茅山派掌门天师继承人，受邀前往城中调查忽然出现活人尸化的原因，不料所携带的法宝力量唤醒了一缕冤魂——鬼公主地宫现世，化为鬼魅的倾国怨魂携恨复生。为了阻止鬼公主和将臣为祸人间，你施展茅山道术，以剑降妖，以符除魔，与邪恶的鬼公主展开了一场世纪末日大战！

name: Assassinvisible
short_description: A cute bite-sized puzzle and stealth game that takes place in the margins of a bored pupil' notebook. You're an invisible assassin, sneak your way past the guards to reach your target and erase it!

name: UnSeen
short_description: UnSeen : you won't see death coming. A first person horror game about immersion, where truth and madness are never far away. Be careful... fear is on your feet.

name: Morningtide Motel
short_description: Your motel is busy for the first time in years. Antsy city-folk and dispossessed teens flood your rooms, and you can barely keep up. Now, after a week of all-nighters spent managing reservations, room service requests, and Yup! reviews, you begin to wonder… could you even fall asleep if you tried?

name: Supersize My Heart
short_description: Welcome to Flavor City, Crew Member! Slip into some non-slips, cozy up to one of four deliciously dateable mascots and flame broil your way into their heart in the premier fast food mascot dating sim! Because in this crazy town, the most craveable item on the menu...is love.

name: Funko Fusion
short_description: Experience a festival of fandom like never before in Funko Fusion! Play through iconic worlds and mashup characters inspired by some of your favorite franchises in an action-adventure game with uniquely authentic, irreverent humor from the creative minds of 10:10 Games.

name: Frostgrims Revenge
short_description: Frostgrims Revenge is a co-op survival horror game set in a snow-covered village haunted by the snowman Frostgrim. Players must collaborate to collect Santa’s cursed naughty list while avoiding Frostgrim.

name: Snowball Fight Game
short_description: Dodge, parry, and throw as fast as your reflexes allow. A very difficult bullet hell that is built on parrying and pure, weightless movement—no keyboards, just the speed of your mouse.

name: Eclipse - 2nd Dawn for the Galaxy
short_description: The galaxy, once peaceful after the Terran-Hegemony War, now faces rising tensions. The Galactic Council's efforts to maintain peace are failing as alliances shatter and secret treaties form. A confrontation looms—who will emerge victorious and rule the galaxy? Lead your people to victory!

name: Schoolteacher Simulator
short_description: Become a teacher in a local school. Teach kids, but make sure that your students stay focused during the lesson and react if they misbehave. Each day has unique events. Living school environment with each teacher and student having their own personality.

name: Truth Seekers
short_description: Truth Seekers is a horror multiplayer cooperative shooter game centered around hunting urban legends and folklore monsters. Find and craft items to aid in your attack, all while strategizing with others to learn the monsters' behaviors before they learn yours...

name: Builder Simulator VR
short_description: In Builder Simulator VR, you take on the role of a real builder and feel as if you were standing on a construction site. Design, create and complete your project. Plan every detail and see your construction from different perspectives. Use a variety of materials and tools.

name: 召しませ！レミリアお嬢様！
short_description: 決められた文字を並び替えてお題に当てはまるようなアイテムをリズムよく作り出し、お嬢様に渡して喜んでもらったりいじったりして遊ぼう！

name: Vibrant Frame
short_description: An otome novel adventure that captures a slice of life and sweet romance of youths striving for their dreams without despairing over reality.

name: Night at the Office
short_description: You work late at the office not long after the death of a colleague. Throughout the night, all sorts of phenomenon begin to terrorize you, slowly uncovering the death of a fellow colleague. Who killed Joseph Anadam and why must you go through this trial to find out?

name: Straight to the Bone
short_description: Auto-running, speed run supporting, achievement hunting Roguelike, with a unique twist on how to manage your build

name: Wheelie King 7 - Motorbike simulator 3D
short_description: Realistic 3D motorbike simulator All devices cross-play (IOS,Steam,Android). Steam-deck compatible. Realistic motorbike wheelie game. Customize bikes. Play offline & online. Change bike parts. Spray paint bike parts. Play offline & online Change bike parts Spray paint bike parts.

name: RealEscape
short_description: Enter The Lethe, where reality and nightmare collide. Once a haven for healing, this asylum hides dark secrets. In RealEscape, a 3D single-player escape room game, explore 3 unique rooms, solve intricate puzzles, and survive threats. The Lethe is calling—will you escape or become its next victim?

name: Multiverse Loot Hunter
short_description: This is a brush treasure adventure game across the heavens. The protagonist awakens his powers and freely passes through different planes such as Xiuxian, history, Wuxia, magic, and future. Collect equipment, spirits, characters and cheats distributed across all planes through battle.

name: Sengoku Logic - Kumamoto Castle
short_description: Welcome to Sengoku Logic! Sengoku Logic is a drawing puzzle game where players build famous castles from the Sengoku Period in Japan.

name: Cafe Paris
short_description: Welcome to Cafe Paris, a 3D coffee shop sim in the heart of Paris. Run your café 24/7 by the Eiffel Tower, serving coffee and pastries to customers with unique stories. Sip, serve, and immerse yourself in the charm of Parisian life.

name: After Dark
short_description: After Dark is a horror adventure game filled with monsters, oddities, and more! Traverse a strange, other-worldly forest to rescue your sister and bring her back home! There will be many dangers along the way, can you survive?

name: PISSed Off: Peeing Simulator
short_description: Another job simulator at the top of Steam, seriously? Piss on work and a bunch of dumbass simulators in this game!

name: 纸片飞机
short_description: Players need to skillfully employ various flight techniques to weave through dense bullet barrages while simultaneously aiming and firing at enemies. The fighter jets are equipped with multiple weapon systems, including machine guns, missiles, and energy shields.

name: ADEN
short_description: Dance, dance, and dance some more! A kawaii side-scrolling dance battle for the new age! Control the mysterious girl Toaka and save the world from destruction!

name: Heather Wreath: The Reporter
short_description: This game acts as the prologue to Heather Wreath: Shoban. In the shadow of a rundown estate, tormented by demented visions you must solve puzzles, fight dreadful monsters, and escape the masked man haunting every step. Inside a retro fixed camera narrative horror.

name: 3D Escape: Chinese Room
short_description: Step into the role of a pilgrim in Chinese-style rooms blending culture and puzzles. Explore ancient temples and studies, experiencing the poetic ambiance and Zen spirit of Chinese art while uncovering hidden mysteries. A must-try for puzzle lovers and fans of Chinese culture!

name: Cook For Love
short_description: Win the hearts of Parisians with your cooking, discover delicious recipes, and become a chef worthy of working onboard the Orient Express.

name: Mental State. Game One
short_description: A fantastic first-person adventure with elements of the action and horror genres. A feature of the game is the 'System of Thoughts' - a kind of generator of quests and various thoughts in the head of the main character, which directs and motivates the player to explore the outside world.

name: Only Up: LIZARDS MUST FALL
short_description: Only Up: LIZARDS MUST FALL is an incredible multiplayer parkour game where precision and speed are important. Jump and climb over various obstacles. Defeat the cursed Lizards. The slightest mistake can result in falling to the starting location and your Rus brothers will stop respecting you.

name: SnaPaul
short_description: SnaPaul is a first-person psychological horror game where you explore a dark, mysterious house. With 30 minutes of intense gameplay and 4 unique achievements to unlock, every step brings you closer to a chilling finale. Face your fears and uncover hidden secrets in this unforgettable experience.

name: The Static
short_description: The Static is a 3D-platformer where you control a television-traversing ghost dead set on rescuing their spectral neighbors. Reunite lost spirits and breathe new (after)life into a once-forgotten ghostly neighborhood.

name: One Boss One Fight
short_description: One Boss One Fight is an Action Roguelike game that center around a single epic battle. Many skills to choose from, multiples phases, complex patterns, challenges and more! Step into the arena and face off against Death!

name: FOUNTAINS
short_description: Master high-skilled combat to uncover the secrets of an ancient, interconnected world.

name: The Chimera Chronicles: Usurper
short_description: A dark fantasy themed ARPG where you can enter the randomly generated dungeons. Please keep in mind that this is game is in pre-alpha and is subject to change.

name: ASTRA : Era Of Anguish
short_description: Explore the valley of Laywind and unravel a grand mystery.

name: Natsu no Sagashimono ~What We Found That Summer~
short_description: Summer vacation is finally here, and the next few weeks promise to be anything but uneventful! Natsu has just 30 days to acclimate to life in the countryside, help the locals face their demons, find that special someone, and gain the self-confidence to return home with his head held high!

name: Kill Ze Bugs
short_description: Survive for as long as you can while shooting down hundreds of carnivorous insects! Kill ze bugs is a bullet heaven/survivor game in which your success depends on good aim, tactics and - most importantly - synergies between dozens of available augments.

name: Not an Aim Trainer
short_description: Not an Aim Trainer is a Cozy Aim Trainer with heart warming story and cute minigames.

name: Chrono Sword
short_description: Chrono Sword is a somber souls-like action RPG uniquely crafted around time travel. Stepping beyond the limits of pixel graphics, players travel between the past and future to uncover the complicated truths of the destruction of this world, all set within this beautiful, intricately-crafted realm.

name: Twnkl Gft 2: A Lust For Blood
short_description: It's Christmas! Pelt the humans with gifts! Quickly!!!

name: Emergency Call 112 - The Attack Squad
short_description: Take on the role of the attack squad and complete a variety of diverse missions ranging from apartment fires to rescuing people and many more. Get an overview of the situation at the scene and decide strategically how to tackle the upcoming tasks depending on the situation!

name: Special Agent Training
short_description: Skillful marksmanship and teamwork are the keys to victory.

name: Orbital Defense Force
short_description: Orbital Defense Force (O.D.F) is a multiplayer shoot 'em up co-op rogue-like game. play as mercenaries working for the O.D.F., accepting contracts to defend planets from invaders and earn precious scrap that can be used to upgrade their ship to take on more difficult contracts.

name: SchoolBoy Runaway
short_description: “You little rascal! Go study your lessons right now!” said the angry parents, grounding you. Try to outsmart them and find a way to have fun with your friends.

name: Holbrook Hotel
short_description: Step into Holbrook Hotel, a chilling psychological horror. Strange noises disrupt your stay, pulling you into a deadly chase through its shadowy halls. Uncover the town’s dark secrets and face lurking terrors as you fight to survive!

name: Paper Battlefield
short_description: A strategy where battles are limited only by the boundaries of the notebook! Experience a unique real-time strategy experience where every battle unfolds on the pages of a sketchbook, and all your units and structures are drawn with ink!

name: Blasteroids
short_description: Blast your way through waves of space debris in order to reach what is waiting for you on the other side. Find your fighting style with multiple unlockable ships in this fast paced space adventure!

name: GT Racing 1980
short_description: Take a journey back to the 80's and race some of the greatest cars ever made, in a retro arcade style racing experience. Race against some of the most iconic racers, build rivalries and unlock special rewards.

name: Uncle Chop's Rocket Shop
short_description: Come on down to Uncle Chop’s Rocket Shop, for all your roguelite spaceship repair simulation needs! WARNING: Untested genre not suitable for people with tentacles for arms or an aversion to dying horrifically. Side effects include improved reading comprehension under pressure and a furry fetish.

name: Nuclear Frost
short_description: Nuclear Frost is an action-adventure first-person shooter where you have to face the threats that the new world has brought to bear. Fight mutants, keep yourself warm, avoid radiation and fight fungus to save your home.

name: Shadow Siege
short_description: Shadow Siege is an exhilarating third-person shooter (TPS) that plunges players into heart-pounding, action-packed battles. With fast-paced gameplay and strategic combat

name: Skuf vs beer bottle party
short_description: Once again, the thirst for alcohol drives him

name: Make Good Choices
short_description: You’re just trying to get home. It’s only a quarter mile. One street. What could go wrong.

name: Your Daughter
short_description: desktop mascot

name: Flash Doll
short_description: Surprise blind boxes and custom outfits combined with physics-driven action figures, automatic battles, custom moves, and intense showdowns ready to start!

name: Fear deeps
short_description: This is a horror game where the player controls the protagonist (Tom) to go to a mental sanatorium to find Lily, but who knows that there is something weird in the sanatorium! You'll need to explore the sanatorium, find Lily, and uncover the final truth!

name: Annihilation Plan
short_description: In the land of dusk, the night ends. You'll explore the apocalyptic world with your friends, scavenging for treasure and slaying countless Cthulhu-like monsters. At the end of the day, you'll be able to sell the items you find to strengthen your equipment!

name: Dungeon Team
short_description: Turn-based tactics team builder in ASCII art. Explore dangerous caverns and battle monsters in a PvE idle dungeon crawler. Fight other players in live or async battles in the PvP arena. Create a unique band of heroes with 8 mix&match skill trees, loot powerful gear and become the best Dungeon Team!

name: Seeker: Quest
short_description: Build your ultimate team in this action-packed monster collector. Unlock dozens of playable characters, explore the planet of Naturia to obtain its loot and treasures! Engage into thrilling combat while building your village to obtain new heroes and powers for your expanding collection of Seekers.

name: Laundry Store Simulator
short_description: In Laundry Store Simulator, you'll start small and work your way up, upgrading your equipment, designing a stylish store, and expanding your services! Are you ready to own the best Laundry Store in the world?

name: Planet Factory
short_description: A small quick game about building a factory to launch planets into a solar system! Grow your base and increase production to make the ultimate factory for launching planets!

name: Final Sanctuary
short_description: A year after the disaster, the bunker's life support systems fail critically. Communication with the outside world is completely lost. You are a mechanical engineer, awakened in your quarters by a piercing siren, alone and cut off from the world.

name: Cheese Party
short_description: Match cheeses to complete party orders in this casual match 3 game. Play through story, endless, and puzzle modes. Compete on leaderboards and design your own levels.

name: The Edge of Allegoria
short_description: Turn-based RPG, inspired by classic titles from the golden age of handheld gaming. But make no mistake: This ain't no f@#%ing kid's game.

name: Idle Tower Defense
short_description: Idle Tower Defense is a game where you control a single tower to fight off hordes of enemies. No randomization. Choose from a variety of modules to create unique builds and upgrade modules and survive endless waves.

name: Beat the Humans
short_description: Beat the Humans is the turn-based tactical strategy game. Here you lead an army of aliens against invaders from the human race. Collect your squad, protect planets, strengthen your army with equipment and look for allies if you want to survive and win.

name: I Am Cat
short_description: I Am Cat - a unique virtual reality game, there's nothing like it in the world! A sandbox adventure centered around a Cat protagonist bearing. A captivating journey where you embrace the role of a Cat. Immerse yourself in a world brimming with diversity and excitement, awaiting your exploration.

name: Nanoplanet Survivors
short_description: Nanoplanet Survivors is a heart-pounding bullet hell survival game set on a hostile planet. Battle relentless waves of alien foes and adapt with powerful upgrades and unique character abilities. Epic boss fights make every playthrough a thrilling challenge. Can you emerge as the ultimate survivor?

name: Exit Station 7
short_description: You entered a train station and appear to be stuck in a loop. Multiple levels to test your observation skill. See if you have what it takes to escape the loop!

name: Happy Hotel
short_description: Happy Hotel is a mildly horror-themed game where you descend through creepy, handcrafted floors filled with traps, puzzles, and eerie surprises. With randomized challenges and Happy, the sinister mascot, your goal is to escape the hotel. Playtime: 15 mins to 2 hours.

name: Mika's Battle S 2
short_description: Mika's Battle S 2 is a 2D Platform Action game based on the story of Mika, the Sunshineland warrior, who has been assigned with a special task, that is, to rescue Sayuri, the Sunshineland Intelligence Department officer, who was imprisoned by the enemies.

name: AI Asylum
short_description: Immerse yourself in a realm of madness and bone-chilling terror as you step into our gripping horror adventure, meticulously crafted to send shivers down your spine. Explore a nightmarish world where each step unveils sinister secrets and heart-pounding encounters.

name: BOWLOUT
short_description: Defeat pins with rapid-fire bowling balls or powerful melee strikes to avoid getting guttered in this First-Person PvE Bowling game.

name: The World of Marius
short_description: Get ready for an epic journey in The World of Marius

name: 2Synth
short_description: Use your synthesizer to manipulate and match video signals in this Y2K aesthetic, arcade, puzzle game!

name: HO-HOP! - Christmas Board Game
short_description: HO-HOP! is a Christmas board game for 1-4 players. Roll the dice and move across a board full of surprises: bonuses, debuffs, skipped turns, and unexpected obstacles! The first to reach the finish line wins.

name: Undead Realm：Ego
short_description: Time stands still, space warps, whispers in the dark and indescribable things are approaching you step by step. You will embark on a survival journey with several strangers in a desolate and mysterious place, and immerse yourself in a horrible battle royale full of despair from the first perspective

name: X-teroids
short_description: Look back on the classic arcade games of the 80s. X-teroids is a retro-style, addictive, and fast-paced arcade shooter game.

name: Plant the Towers
short_description: Grow gigantic mutated plants in an apocalyptic world. Every vegetable can stand up for itself and shoot custom projectiles. Place the plants wisely to defend yourself from different types of dangerous bugs.

name: Hyper Flux
short_description: Hyper Flux is a single-player speedrunning 3D platformer that demands you to speed through shattered planets using your zero-gravity suit and force-manipulating orbs. Fly through the skies of insane levels to reach the end portal as fast as possible.

name: SPACE INVADERS: Deck Commander
short_description: You are humanity’s last line of defense in this retro-inspired deckbuilder. Immerse yourself in the battle and unleash powerful attacks on rivals. Every hand brings you a step closer to victory against the waves of SPACE INVADERS!

name: Colorize
short_description: Colorize is an indie precision platformer roguelite that combines fast-paced action with mobility and combat abilities.

name: Reel Fishing: Days of Summer
short_description: Catch the largest of lunkers from a variety of picturesque locales! Join three good friends as they spend the last days of summer together with one last memorable fishing trip!

name: DA-VI-NC1
short_description: DA-VI-NC1 is a Turing-machine-based coding puzzle game. You must complete the puzzles, pass the Turing test, and discover the philosophical world of DA-VI-NC1 with the Mona Lisa.

name: Deep Horrors of Fishing
short_description: DHoF is a fishing game that involves catching monstrous creatures that are lurking beneath. Armed with a fishing rod, bait, and a fragile boat, players must fish up everything in the deep. Players will encounter grotesque fish with their own rarity and items. Will you dare reel these up?

name: Pyromania
short_description: Pyromania is an action-packed horde survival game. Strategy and movement are key to surviving the ever-growing hordes of zombies, wild animals and other monsters. It can be played either solo or in online-coop with up to 4 players.

name: Sea Fantasy
short_description: Save the world by fishing! This is a brand new action RPG game where you stand on an adventure to fish the SeaAZ, the marine life of this world, in a vast pixel world. This is not a peaceful fishing game. The destruction of the world is imminent....

name: Fantasy Soul Revenge
short_description: Fantasy Soul Revenge is an exhilarating action RPG game that thrusts players into a vibrant, mythical world where dark forces threaten the realm. Players assume the role of a vengeful hero, harnessing the power of ancient souls to vanquish enemies and uncover hidden truths.

name: Coffee, Snow, and You
short_description: A short visual novel about a lonely soul spending December 31st at work. A funny and heartwarming story about searching for joy and meaning on the eve of the most magical night of the year.

name: UNDERGROUND
short_description: You should read the description before playing.

name: MINE
short_description: Oh, I think there's something wrong with the mine Why don't you run away now?

name: Dying Water
short_description: Sail through oceans of blood and survive what lurks beneath the waves. A slow burn retro horror game inspired by Voices of The Void.

name: Soli-tair-ror
short_description: A Horror strategy game involving with the well known singleplayer card game Solitaire. Be careful of what might lurk around you, play the cards and see where the night leads you whether that be life or death.

name: Bulletproof Tank Adventure
short_description: In a post-apocalyptic world, engage in a thrilling 3D tank battle game, fighting zombies and AI robots. Navigate challenging terrains with your tank and defeat enemies using powerful weapons. A struggle for strategy, danger, and survival awaits you!

name: The Fourth Anno
short_description: Build your team, collect equipment, potions, gems, choose upgrade rewards, and withstand wave after wave of enemy attacks.

name: Scary Granny
short_description: **'It Seems That We Will Never Leave Here!'**

name: Room Escape: Open Doors
short_description: Escape from the rooms. Open the doors in the rooms. Look for keys and solve puzzles. Get to the roof of the skyscraper.

name: Breachwalk Survivor
short_description: Breachwalk Survivor is a single-player game combines survivor genre with inventory management. Before sneaking into another dimension, it’s better to plan which weapons to craft and strategize the path. Stealing just one 'World Core' will save your world, but there’s still extra space in your bag...

name: NOMANUAL
short_description: NOMANUAL is a first-person single-player horror game. You are a security guard at a hotel and must complete all your duties safely. Refer to the daily rulebook and properly deal with unpredictable abnormalities. As long as you follow the rules, the hotel is safe.

name: Beach Boys: Zodiac date
short_description: Discover the fascinating world of the zodiac signs as you embark on a journey to win the heart of the boy of your dreams.

name: Beyond The Tales
short_description: A turn-based RPG about some friends that want to discover the meaning of their existence, but if they do, the world will end. This game will break the story to enter to a surreal aftergame experience.

name: MolaMolaAdventure
short_description: 'Molamola Adventure' is a danmaku shooting game. Players will control a molamola and embark on an underwater adventure alongside a girl.

name: Tactics of World War I
short_description: Tactics of World War I is a real time tactics (RTT) game that puts you in the role of a military leader in the First World War. It requires you to plan your actions thoroughly and make smart tactical decisions in the blink of an eye.

name: Plebs and Pillagers
short_description: Rebuild your kingdom in this village management game. Command your loyal villagers to help you on your quest, and to expand your realm while defending it from unknown threats. The king has returned!

name: SwordSpire
short_description: Command a rebellion against an oppressive kingdom in this medieval tower-defense strategy game. Manage resources, upgrade units, and battle through 21 intense matches. Protect your tower, crush the enemy's, and lead the people to justice in a fight for freedom and equality.

name: 赢了嫩模 输了不活 All In Everyday
short_description: Winning gets you a model, losing means no life. Reincarnation follows, give it another shot! Don't talk to me about game theory, probability, or value regression, I'm all in! With a leverage that reaches the sky, I'm all in!

name: Ball Race Party
short_description: Ball Race Party is a physics-based, fun-filled ball racing game. Players compete against time and opponents in challenging tracks. Climb the leaderboard in single-player mode or enjoy thrilling competition with friends in multiplayer modes!

name: Marks of Ki
short_description: Marks of Ki is an adventure-RPG game featuring intense, souls-like combat, developed single-handedly by one passionate guy. Players can choose from six unique customizable characters, each offering distinct abilities and fighting styles.

name: The Redundant
short_description: Step into the metallic boots of an abandoned robot and fight back against an army of virus-infected machines. In this exciting action-adventure, sneak or battle your way around the facility, uncover its secrets, and isolate each section from the network - before it's too late...

name: Chinese overtime
short_description: A simulation SLG (Simulated Management) game that simulates working life in a modern city. In the game, you will play as a young graduate starting a magical working journey.

name: ZipSokoban
short_description: Zipsokoban is a unique and innovative take on the classic Sokoban genre. While the core mechanic of pushing boxes remains, the rules of space and form are redefined—you and the boxes can be compressed.

name: Vigaro Runner 2: Return
short_description: Vigaro pill is back. Solve and finish 15 different themed levels and find yellow star in this 3d platformer

name: Check Inn
short_description: Build hotels, accommodate guests and expand your hotel business throughout the world!

name: Galactic Slice
short_description: Galactic Slice sci-fi shooter game all about pizza, you use the WASD keys to move & the spacebar to shoot. Galactic Slice is all about an alien race wanting to destroy & ruin pizza forever, which simply cannot happen! Your job is to eliminate the aliens & save all pizzakind.

name: Ice Eyes
short_description: Build a snowman to keep the monster at bay and throw snowballs to defend yourself in this Christmas horror game!

name: SpyGuys
short_description: Travel through time blending into different lives as you hunt for fakes in the crowd. Chaos slowly takes control as you learn to shoot first, and face the consequences later.

name: Submarine Survivor
short_description: Dive into the ocean's depths, face fearsome sea creatures, and collect their experience crystals. In this roguelite action game, upgrade your submarines with various combinations of weapons and chips. Become the Lord of the Ocean!

name: MyPawnShop
short_description: Have you always dreamed of running your own pawn shop? Now it's possible with MyPawnShop!

name: Hidden Cats in Tokyo
short_description: Hidden Cats in Tokyo is a hidden object adventure game where you must vaccinate all the cats in Tokyo before they turn into dangerous monsters. Collect cards of heroes, monsters, and cat things. Join the adventure and fight the huge monster with your giant robot in this fun hidden object game!

name: Status One
short_description: Status One is a top-down 3D tactical shooter where you create your own task force from scratch and lead your squad while being personally on the field

name: Ninth Hotel
short_description: You are trapped in a Hotel by accident Find out all the signs of abnormality in the hallway Escape by going down to the first floor while carefully observing your surroundings

name: Chasing Cassidy
short_description: Explore the west through the eyes of a writer and confront different civilians, outlaws and criminals with the hope that your conversation skills can make up for your complete lack of combat knowledge in this narratively driven adventure.

name: Yet Another Climbing Game
short_description: For the few who reach the top, something curious awaits.

name: 本草归元录
short_description: 'Herbals tycoon' is a game that combines ancient style with deep management strategy, bringing players into a mysterious and fantastic world of traditional Chinese medicine. Here, you are not only a healer but also an explorer, manager, and inheritor, writing your own herbal legend every moment.

name: Deckarium
short_description: Deckarium is a deck-building pet simulator. Play pet cards to populate your terrarium or aquarium, be on the lookout for card-packs to expand your deck, keep your creatures fed to collect coins, and use them to buy more pets! But look out for ghosts! They hunger for the souls of your pets.

name: 深夜1時の交換手
short_description: Have you heard the rumor? If you call a certain number at 1am, you will be connected to a person called the 1am operator. This person is said to be able to connect you to the past.

name: All The Stars
short_description: Welcome to All the Stars, a retro-inspired space shooter where thrilling combat meets a cosmic narrative. Face waves of enemies, alien horrors, and a galaxy-changing choice. It’s an amateur passion project but it just might surprise you, no load screens, no microtransactions, just pure arcade action

name: Rhythm Drum 节奏鼓
short_description: A dynamic rhythm game where players follow the dynamic music beats by tapping the drums with the mouse and keyboard.

name: Zombies ruined my day
short_description: This is the story of how the best day of your life can become a nightmare full of zombies. Survive in a hostile environment using all sorts of weapons, defend your position with barricades, and more! All in a fully action packed game with colorful backgrounds and fearsome monsters.

name: Q Dungeon
short_description: It’s a simple dungeon exploration card game featuring a first-person perspective as players venture through caves, charming chibi-style monsters, and a large collection of cards. Players need to form sets of three cards totaling a multiple of 10 to launch an attack.

name: Catch the Skunk
short_description: Will you be the hero who gets rid of that heavy smell? Catch those skunks in this stinky SmartGames adventure!

name: Rugby League Team Manager 4
short_description: The fourth instalment of “The Number 1 Rugby League Management Game”. The biggest leagues and competitions. Take full control of managing your own Rugby League club. Training schedules, coaches, physios, scouting, finances, sponsors and more. MUCH MORE!

name: Paranormal Snap Shot
short_description: Trapped in an endless looping school, can you find your way out by photographing all of the anomalies?

name: Monsters Auto Battler
short_description: In this game, you need to fight monsters in small arenas, where, having placed mercenaries, you just have to watch the battle.

name: Forest Of Perdition 2 - The School Trip
short_description: James Everhart and his classmates embark on a school trip to the abandoned Tranquil Hills, a forest park shrouded in mysteries and horrors. As they explore the area, they uncover dark secrets and confront malevolent forces that threaten their lives and the truth of the past.

name: Platform Run
short_description: Run and complete different kinds of platforms. Platform Run is a 3D platform game where you can interact with different platforms and score.

name: Non-Euclidean Minesweeper
short_description: Non-Euclidean Minesweeper is a minesweeper game played in non-Euclidean space. You can play this classic game on square, pentagonal, hexagonal and heptagonal tiles. All problems are definitely solvable with pure logic.

name: Barrel Baller
short_description: Barrel baller is a 3D platformer where you take control of v806 autonomous hauler unit across different planets. Your goal is to deliver cargo to hard accesible locations.

name: Slender Reborn
short_description: Rediscover terror in this reimagined classic survival horror. Collect eight pages and evade the relentless Slenderman in a hauntingly realistic world rebuilt with updated graphics, adaptive AI, and immersive sound design. Prepare for unpredictable scares and a chilling atmosphere that redefines fear

name: I wanna be The King!
short_description: I Wanna Be The King! is a top-down roguelike arena shooter where you can use up to 6 allies as your weapons defeat waves of enemies. Customize your gameplay by selecting from a variety of allies and items, allowing for unique strategies and playstyles.

name: Drunk Alien
short_description: Help this drunk alien find his way back to his spaceship in this challenging adventure!

name: The Search For Fran 3
short_description: The Search For Fran 3 - Fran is missing (Again), it is up to You and Your friends to find her

name: アネモネ / Anemone
short_description: This is a board game set in the fictional Japanese city of 'Neverland.' Enjoy local multiplayer with simple mouse-based controls. Original music and an unusual world await you.

name: Freeky Faucets Arcade
short_description: A bug-sized roguelike adventure of boogas versus faucets! Choose your booga, powerup with items, and destroy every last faucet foe!

name: Hullbreaker
short_description: A fusion of arena PvP combat on the high seas and roguelite mechanics. Outfit your ship with powerful weapons, clash with rival captains on the high seas, and proudly hoist your custom flag in the ultimate pirate showdown!

name: Brawlers of Duality
short_description: Brawlers of Duality is a top-down arena fighter where damaging enemies launches them harder. Launch enemies out of the arena to defeat them using martial arts, magic and technology. Battle in 1v1, 2v2, and a free for all mode where you defeat enemies to power up and take on other players.

name: Chicken Hill
short_description: Find 250 Genjouin of various species and hundreds of items for brother KUN. Rescue your frustrated and devastated brother KUN in the KUN space. We are the most devout believers.

name: Workshop Wonders
short_description: Workshop Wonders is a simulation game that invites you to manage a DIY store and repair shop. Design your store, display products, make repairs and manage your employees. Every decision is critical to the success of your business!

name: TetriMatch
short_description: TetriMatch is a matchup of two popular games combined to make something new and challenging. Test your skill in this combination of Tetris and Match 3!

name: Love, Internet, and Murder Magic
short_description: Love, Internet, and Murder Magic is a Roguelike game. You will role-play an agent of a streamer who died because of a murder. You are trying to 'bring her back' through AI technology on the Internet, making her the unique creation of the Internet.

name: Victoria: La Primera
short_description: Immerse yourself in the world of the nao Victoria, a ship with its own spirit and personality that historically sailed around the world for the first time. Explore mysterious places by point-and-click and face challenges that will test your wits.

name: Only Out
short_description: “Only Out” is a cooperative survival game for two players. Set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, you and your partner must navigate a desolate village plagued by scarcity and danger. Trust each other, strategize together, face the relentless zombie threat, and uncover the only path to survival.

name: Hello Love: 18 Again
short_description: Unexpectedly back at 18, you embark on a thrilling and sweet campus rebirth journey with the memories! The campus goddess, the sexy girl, the childhood sweetheart, the frigid CEO, the gentle teacher. Who will ignite your heart among the dreams and regrets of youth? Relive old dreams without regrets!

name: Trapped: Family Vacation
short_description: Spot the differences, but each room has a survival rule.

name: CrabbleUp
short_description: Dive into an oceanic odyssey, where serene exploration meets thrilling challenges. Embark on a journey through endless underwater mazes, armed only with your cunning and defending yourself from perilous foes with the power of your bubbles.

name: Marron's Day
short_description: Marron's Day is a silly pocket-sized adventure where you're a bunny trying to save the town festival! Help out your animal friends, play cute minigames, and explore this cosy and retro pixel-art town.

name: Guardian's Guide
short_description: A daughter raising sim/RPG

name: FPS英雄
short_description: There are many robots in FPS Hero that you need to defeat! Come and relax and unwind in this game!!!

name: Seedbo And That Time The Sun Exploded
short_description: Re-assemble the sun in this bite-sized adventure platformer!

name: Primal Fear
short_description: This footage has been acquired illegally. I need to get this out to as many people as possible. Be warned, what you will see will be disturbing, you will question your sanity and you may not be the same person you were before viewing...

short_description: Weed Simulator is a game in which you can become a weed.

name: Lurking Among Shadows
short_description: A co-op survival-horror about looting houses for money to help you live to the next day.

name: Superhero Market
short_description: Become the manager of a dynamic supermarket! Manage inventory, optimize store design, plan shelves and improve the customer experience. In this immersive management game, every decision counts to develop your business and satisfy your customers. Are you ready to take on the challenge?

name: Mosquito Simulator

With each run, unlock characters and weapons, each with their own playstyle and abilities.

name: JUMP! The Floor Is...
short_description: Do you remember the excitement of hopping from spot to spot, avoiding the ”Lava”? We’re bringing back those childhood memories with a game inspired by the fun we all had growing up. You can test your reflexes, strategy, and competitive spirit. The goal is simple: be the first to reach the trophy.

name: Christmas Wonderland 15: Collector's Edition
short_description: Santa's Amazing Christmas Wonderland Adventure

name: Unless
short_description: Take a trip back to the nostalgic era of pure platforming games built without gimmicks and minimal story. Race through bite-sized levels solo, or with a co-op helper in pursuit of achieving elusive S-Rank times.

name: 秋空回憶 -命運的地平線-
short_description: 就读于一所普通高中的新太，过着平静且祥和的生活，但这种枯燥的生活让他感到沮丧。 就在这个不太可能有波澜发生的时节，一名转校生出现在他的班级—— 随着学园祭的临近，新太和朋友们满怀喜悦期待着青春的最后时刻， 但某个疾病忽然在全校师生间开始蔓延……

name: Voice Quest
short_description: Voice Quest, a 3D platformer, you control with your voice. Guide Shadow Man through seven increasingly challenging levels, collect bananas, dodge strawberries, and compete for global records. Your adventure, your voice, your victory!

short_description: Crazy Dungeon is a third-person action roguelike. Choose your character and level, survive as long as you can, and level up your skills after each round! Try to improve your stats with every run!

name: Reviver
short_description: A narrative puzzle game with themes of love, fate and time. Follow the life stories of the two main characters and influence their destinies through interactions and choices. The game combines hand-drawn style and an immersive interactive experience to explore a profound journey of love and choice.

name: Tenshi
short_description: Don’t Blink. They’re Always Watching. Enter the haunting corridors of the Fukushima asylum, a short but intense bodycam-style horror game that will leave you breathless.

name: The Road To Harvest: Food From Across The Ocean
short_description: Become the God of Harvest, explore the world of food and adventure, plant, trade, and spread deliciousness to create your own path to prosperity!

name: The Unlife of Gorlak
short_description: Play as a Gorlak, a recently resurrected dragon in this raising sim JRPG adventure! Featuring deep combat and multiple endings. Become the dragon you want to be!

name: Hop Step Sing! Summer Live 2023

name: Minimalist Sudoku
short_description: A customizable Sudoku game that allows you to enjoy the joy of solving puzzles alone, as well as the fun of collaborating with others.

name: Slay the Alice
short_description: A short visual novel presented with pixel art and cute animations. Chasing after a rabbit, Alice found herself in a land of talking plants. Now, it's time to go on a tiny little adventure.

name: Mushroom Moonrise
short_description: Embark on a relaxing journey with 'Mushroom Moonrise,' an enchanting turn-based strategy game. Dive into a world where the moon's glow nurtures a unique battle for territory, led by the most unlikely of champions! Mushrooms!

name: NinjaThea 2
short_description: Help NinjaThea exact revenge on the nasty critters and reclaim her diamonds and fruits!

name: Amarela
short_description: With precise controls and refined mechanics, Amarela offers an intense and rewarding experience, perfect for those seeking exciting challenges. Find hidden secrets, unravel an engaging narrative through environmental details.

Players can combine herbs based on their grades and elemental attributes to create unique alchemy recipes and refine distinct elixirs. These pills can help those who enter Xugu.

name: Crystal Breaker
short_description: Shoot the enemy at close range! Crystal Breaker is a vertically scrolling shmup that focuses on close range attack.

name: Saucepanhead I - Pangalactic Panic

short_description: Situational card battle and adventure to find the best combo from a randomly dealt hand.Deck editing is not required....... To use your cards well, you need to bond with your friends.Only time will tell.......

name: Birates
short_description: Survive the pirate island! Craft by day, battle waves of enemies by night in this roguelike survival game. Gather resources, unlock powerful abilities, and upgrade your gear to stand against increasing threats. How long can you last in this relentless fight for survival?

name: Hunter: The Reckoning — The Beast of Glenkildove
short_description: Full moon. Cold night. Dark shadow. Warm gun. The Beast of Glenkildove has stalked Ireland for centuries. Now, you must hunt it. A text-based interactive novel set in the World of Darkness.

name: Party Spirits
short_description: An online party game for 2-6 players. Play with friends or by matchmaking. Experience unique physics-based minigames. Use your spirit form after death to sabotage others and turn the tide in your favor.

name: BURGER RACE
short_description: Get ready to race at top speed in Burger Race! Which machine will be the first to cross the finish line?

name: Dragon Ruins II
short_description: A dungeon crawler for tired people.

name: Top Sellers - Ecommerce Simulator
short_description: Are you ready to start your own e-commerce business and grow globally? Explore wholesale stores, select your products, manage your warehouse, and prepare and deliver your orders flawlessly. Join an adventure filled with opportunities in this highly competitive world!

name: Towercore: Survivors
short_description: The dark creatures are coming, and you are the only obstacle to stop them. Survive night by night in those monster-infested lands! Towercore: Survivors is a challenging dark fantasy survival game with minimalistic gameplay and roguelite elements.

name: FLOOR X
short_description: FLOOR X is an anomaly hunting game. You need to escape from a surreal office where the space is constantly changing. Take pictures of anomalies, try to survive and reach floor 0.

name: Blood Soaked Bastard!
short_description: Blood Soaked Bastard! Is an RPG set in a dreary medieval fantasy setting. Become a much abhorred Blood Knight and kill monsters in turn based combat, alongside a cast of freakish companions. Draw the blood of wretched monsters, you Bastard!

name: Otherworldly Air Gunship

name: Christmas Store: Santa's Supermarket Simulator

Construct buildings, make equipment, produce items, so to develop your city into greatness together with your adventurers.

name: MannaRites Gold

name: 我的修仙世界My Xiuxian World

name: Lern Island Letters
short_description: You play as a postman, sorting mail for the five intriguing residents of a remote island. Pick up on their peculiar habits, discover their secrets without opening the envelopes, and try to save this peaceful haven from its fate!

name: Kill Me If You Can: Multiplayer Edition
short_description: Kill Me If You Can: Multiplayer Edition is an RPG and construction-based zombie survival defense game. Explore by day to gather resources and grow, then build defenses at night to hold back zombie hordes. Each character has unique skills, and you can control multiple characters during gameplay.

name: 大科学家
short_description: Antoine is a tavern owner who privately conducts her own secret research. Due to an accident, a little girl enters her life and her once-quiet existence is forever changed. Antoine is forced to take risks involuntarily, and bit by bit the truth of the world is revealed to her again.

name: 2nd Shot
short_description: In the vast depths of space, lies a man with a dark past. Setting himself apart from that old life, and seeking justice against wrongdoing instead of being the cause of it, Captain Righteous uses the Freedom Fighter, his trusty space fighter to search for and combat the evil Captain Buster!

name: Find All Things
short_description: Welcome to the world of puzzles in the new exciting game Find All Things! Play a variety of mini-games in different themed locations, from Japan to a car repair shop. Look for hidden objects, find pairs, solve puzzles, enjoy match-3 games or train your memory, all in one game.

name: The Mirror's Curse
short_description: The Mirror's Curse is a first-person escape-room puzzle game with a mysterious, action-packed twist. Trapped in limbo — a distorted version of your own home — you must solve intricate mirror puzzles, navigate maze-like rooms, and outsmart vengeful spirits to break free

name: Moorhuhn Remake

short_description: No Give up is a 2D Rouge+ strategy combination game.Heroes from different worlds are thrown into an unknown uninhabited planet, where there are only monsters and perhaps gods.Take up weapons, choose rewards, fight with monsters, and leave a legend of the unyielding……

name: Mitigate
short_description: This game captivates every player with its warm animated style, featuring soft yet vivid colors that create a world both dreamy and lifelike.

name: 方块消一消
short_description: Block Match is a relaxing and casual match-3 puzzle game suitable for players of all ages. In this game, players simply drag and connect three or more matching blocks to eliminate them and earn points. With a variety of level designs and progressively challenging puzzles

name: Château Royale Jigsaw
short_description: Step into the enchanting world of 'Château Royale Jigsaw'—a puzzle adventure celebrating the grandeur of European castles. Piece together stunning scenes of majestic spires, lush gardens, and royal estates, uncovering the opulence and history of Europe’s iconic palaces with every puzzle.

name: Puyo! Push Brain
short_description: Puyo family challenges you to test your brain! Meet diverse Puyos and conquer tough levels. Top scorers earn a spot on the Brain Power Honor Roll. Aim for the #1!

name: ­Into the Deep Dark Green Sleep
short_description: A story woven with the sound of rain, poetic text, and gentle narration... A short visual novel where you can spend a relaxing moment in your own place, with time to yourself, where no one will disturb you, no one will come barging in. It could be a small, secretive café.

name: Wacky Volleyball
short_description: Wacky Volleyball is a casual arcade game where you play volleyball in a wacky humorous way with highly customizable character choices. Defeat your opponent by making sure they can't catch the ball, be it by perfect aim or by the strength that each power up brings to the volleyball court.

name: Thirsty Bird
short_description: A retro-ish, rhythm-ish game about catching raindrops and dodging hazards with an unusual two-level control scheme. You've got to try it to understand it.

name: Ala Mobile
short_description: The great indie success Ala Mobile is a Formula Racing game brought to you by a single developer. Race across different tracks from all over the world, tailor your gaming experience to your tastes with a huge degree of customization, but most of all, have fun!

name: Terror Diversion
short_description: This is a text-based horror game in which you investigate mysterious urban legends. Along the way, the player takes on the role of a character who gets “lost” and encounters a series of random events.

name: Phrenetic Shooting Reunion
short_description: [CONTENTS] A playable shooting game 'PHRENETIC SHOOTING REUNION' + All future updates/bug fixes. Phrenetic Shooting is a retro tasted shooting game. This game provides an exciting experience for retro 2D shooting game funs.

name: Orpheus' Revenge
short_description: Get ready to put your mouse to use and get smack talked by a bunch of pixels!  Orpheus' Revenge is an 80s inspired arcade shooter with more sass than sense. Pixel graphics, neon colours and electronic beats meet greek mythology.

name: A Marble's Muse
short_description: Fall in love with marbles and learn to believe in yourself again.

name: Cake Space Shooter
short_description: 2d space shooter where player need avoid and destroy different space ships and asteroid waves

name: Peter Pan: Hidden Objects
short_description: Join the captivating adventure through the Neverland and Peter Pan's hidden treasures! Discover magical locations, from the Lost Boys' hidden spot to the Jolly Roger. Peter Pan, Wendy and Tinker are waiting for you to conquer challenges and experience the timeless story like never before together!

name: Game of Fate 2: A Century's Promise
short_description: Transported back a century by fate, you find yourself in a legendary tale of vengeance. Amidst powerful enemies in a tumultuous era, your mission is to assist those around you. Experience this immersive epic from a first-person perspective—authentic, weighty, yet brimming with hope.

name: Pawn Shop: Simulator
short_description: Pawn Shop Simulator is an exciting simulation game where you take on the role of a pawn shop owner. Your mission is to manage your inventory, negotiate prices with customers, and grow your business.

name: Hero Hellspawn - Math Edition
short_description: Hero Hellspawn is a roguelite educational math game. Strengthen your hero, use skills, and conquer math problems from 1+1 to more challenging equations.

name: Aleator
short_description: Can Debt-laden gamblers grab at straws and escape, or plunge into a bottomless pit

name: Airborne Empire
short_description: Build your sky city while exploring a vast landscape in this Open World RPG City Builder. Combining the methodical construction and management of a city builder; the unique lift, balance, and propulsion needed for a flying city; and the compelling characters, dangers, and adventures of an RPG!

name: ParallHex
short_description: ParallHex is a puzzle game where you'll navigate increasingly challenging levels. Solve puzzles simultaneously in two distinct worlds, interconnected by your every move.

name: SCP: Retrieval
short_description: SCP: Retrieval is an indie multiplayer action horror game set in the SCP universe. You will play as a Mobile Task Force unit sent to retrieve dangerous anomalous creatures after a massive series of major breaches.

name: HexaMerge 2048
short_description: HexaMerge 2048 is an exciting puzzle game that combines the satisfying “merge” mechanics with the strategic depth of 2048. Set on a visually captivating hexagonal grid, players slide and merge number tiles to create higher-value combinations.

name: Dreaming Isles
short_description: A farming life sim with high seas adventure. Grow crops, grow ammo, grow a backbone! Side with the Pirates or help restore Global Trade. Feed the islanders, forge relationships, find romance, and call people 'scurvy dog'! Raise the mainsail, fire the cannons, and set sail for adventure!

name: RANDOMAX
short_description: Ride or drive the turbulent waves of luck toward victory! A novel rogue-lite vertical scrolling Shmup that puts your resourcefulness to the test!

name: Starving Cat
short_description: Starving Cat is a third person sci-fi shooter where you explore planets and fight monsters to find food for scientist cat Simon.

name: 失欲
short_description: 《失欲》是一部基於帝國主義時期歐洲的短篇反烏托邦小說，它通過多線敘事，描繪了奧盧格帝國從資本主義逐漸過渡到半奴役制度的過程，呼籲人們反資本、反戰、反封建。 The English version is still being translated and produced.

name: 饥饿的英灵殿
short_description: A minimalist game with minimalist gameplay: go out, gather resources, return home to build, and repeat. Its drawbacks include the lack of visuals and a steep learning curve. The development team consists of just one person—the author—driven by passion and persistence.

name: Space Survivors
short_description: Annihilate hordes of enemies with devastating, unique, and powerful weapon upgrades! In Space Survivors, a survivor-like game with roguelite elements, every move could mean victory or death! head back to your station, hack cargo for pets and prepare for an even tougher run!

name: Chaos Rush : Tower Defense
short_description: A tower defense game that follows the story of Kalidos, a mercenary nation during the sixth period of chaos.
