name: Test Subject
short_description: An action-packed single-player FPS where you fight your way off an alien ship using fists and power-ups. Test your strength, wits, and resilience to survive and escape.

name: Keep it UP
short_description: A thrilling rock climbing puzzle action game with simple click challenges

name: Waifu Simulator: Horem Edition
short_description: Waifu Simulator is a simulation game whose ultimate goal is to bring you pleasure and relaxation!

name: Skyeisle Cube
short_description: In the colorful world of 'Skyeisle Cube,' become Michelangelo to precisely remove the superfluous, sculpt time, and find order in chaos. Reveal hidden beauty and let art blossom at your fingertips.

name: Infection Warfare
short_description: This is a bio infectious shooting game. You will play as a human, resist the attack of infected individuals, wait for the opportunity to become a hero, and kill infected individuals to the point of no return. Or play the role of an infected person, infect humanity, and defeat all heroes.

name: Booty Run
short_description: Enter the world of an adventurer who is exploring the Aztec Jungles. You come across something you should not and awaken the beast. Now you are on the run for your life as you run through the Ancient Ruins. Made by women and those with disabilities. Anything we receive we will improve thegame

name: PiMon
short_description: PiMon are virtual pets that live right on your PC! Take care of your PiMon while you do your daily tasks. Train them, update them into new forms, raise PiMon together or battle with your friends. Or do none of that and raise your PiMon your way! Welcome Admin, what kind of PiMon will you raise?

name: Call of Heroes: Tower Defense
short_description: Embark on a magical and exciting journey to protect the fairy kingdom in this epic TD game. Recruit unique heroes with powerful magic. Craft exclusive weapons for each hero. Defend the fairy kingdom!

name: Pond Twister
short_description: The cutest dragonflies need your help! Navigate twisting ponds full of ambushes in this swirling SmartGames adventure!

name: Local Opera
short_description: Welcome to the mysterious village of 'Folk Show'! This is a domestic plot-oriented micro-horror game that will take you into a rural story full of suspense and thriller.

name: HOLE
short_description: Casual & Hard FPS. Be careful with jam.

name: GRING×GRIND
short_description: GRIND×GRIND is a dynamic arena shooter where players control Hiro, a slime on a quest to regain his human form. Battle through six arenas, using a variety of weapons like piercing shots, ricocheting attacks, and melee strikes. Upgrade gear, earn coins, and customize your playstyle!

name: Stranger Watch
short_description: In 'Stranger Watch' players step into the shoes of an elementary school student in a town plagued by recent sightings of suspicious figures. As they make their way home, it’s up to them to spot and report these lurking dangers

name: Weird Wormholes
short_description: Weird Wormholes is a casual game about traveling through wormholes to try and get back home. Use your ship to mine planets for resources and process these resources into components to enable your travels.

name: Creepy Claus
short_description: Its your first day on the job but Santa isn't impressed Wrap the presents to escape OR ELSE!

name: Nazireu 1.0
short_description: Nazireu is an indie-casual. Progress through the level by collecting coins, avoiding falling prohibited objects and enjoy your journey while listening to good music! Nazirites don't cut their hair, eat or drink anything that comes from grapes, and they don't touch dead bodies, so don't touch them.

name: S4U: CITYPUNK 2011 AND LOVE PUNCH
short_description: This is a modern adventure of young adults seeking love and meaning. Return to 2011's Castor Yard, tap on your keyboard, and make those letters dance: Use your online persona to make meaningful decisions for your clients and yourself.

name: Locomotive 115
short_description: It's difficult to know how many locomotives have been swallowed by the suffocating blizzards of the Widow's Run. Cursed with creeping tales of things that lurk in the dark and overshadowed by frequent casualties, it now stands as your only path forward. Will you be able to survive?

name: BBB: Balls Bangs Blocks
short_description: BBB is a VR game that brings back the fun of classic brick-breaking from childhood. Move freely in a 3D space and enjoy smashing bricks with a fresh twist. With more levels and challenges, BBB offers a new way to experience the simple joy of brick-breaking in an exciting VR world!

name: Starpuffs
short_description: Your Starpuffs are in trouble! You need to rescue them! Split and merge your way through 125 increasingly challenging and complex levels in this cute and colourful puzzle game. Can you save all the Starpuffs?

name: Skullhunter A Worm's Tale
short_description: In a post apocalyptic future where 13G cell towers have spoiled Earth with their radiation, a worm wakes you, begging you to help him get back his family… and YOUR SKULL! In this boss-battling adventure you are a headless skeleton fighting for your bones so that you can once again rest in peace!

name: ONE DOG'S DAYS
short_description: A quiet story of a dog’s days, woven in MS Paint-style graphics.

name: Epoch of Guardians
short_description: In history, many brilliant civilizations faced annihilation due to the invasion of powerful empires, leaving only sighs of regret. In a fictional world, you will take on the role Guardian of Civilization. Can you help these civilizations grow and thrive, resisting the invasion of formidable enemies?

name: I AM PILL
short_description: I AM PILL: A neon-drenched arcade challenge, testing dexterity and resolve. Master push-pull mechanics through increasingly difficult levels. Experience intense visuals, unforgiving gameplay, and themes of addiction and triumph in this psychedelic, precision-based journey. Rage, reset, conquer.

name: Asterism
short_description: Immerse yourself in the cosmic symphony of Asterism - a playable indie-rock concept album set in outer space. Follow astronaut Ruby as she embarks on an emotional journey of self-discovery through a stunning, hand-crafted solar system, unlocking a playable music video with each planet you explore.

name: Blindernoth
short_description: Jack Cunningham is a partially blind private investigator. Help him escape from rooms reaching the light, rescue little kittens or recover valuable objects. An innovative game where your good memory, skill and patience will be key to completing the rooms. Platforms 2D game. Test your patience.

name: Sydney and the Cicadas in "Immanentize"
short_description: In the summer of 1992, three girls, Sydney, Ruby, and Tally, began exploring their first album in a trip to the woods. Only Sydney returned to complete it. The events of their trip are the subject of the point-and-click puzzle adventure Sydney and the Cicadas in 'Immanentize'.

name: BattleTanks - Animal Wars
short_description: Welcome to BattleTanks! Join friends to defend animals from moles in co-op game. Explore 5 worlds with 80+ missions. Face bosses, gather tank parts, and craft your machine. Play with up to 4 friends. Ready to save the world?

name: Romantic Life
short_description: In each life cycle, choose your traits, set attributes, and explore a unique and fulfilling life!

name: Endless Alice
short_description: Endless Alice is a third-person action-adventure game combining Roguelite elements, anime aesthetics, and endless possibilities. Choose characters with unique combat styles and embark on adventures! Play solo or with friends in cooperative challenges for up to 4 players!

name: Vamos Rafa
short_description: A Dark 3D Platformer Hardcore Experience. Guide Rafa through treacherous heights, lit by flickering ghostly flames, with every move a battle to survive. The climb begins when you take control.

name: Beyond the Bridge
short_description: Beyond the Bridge is a tribute to one of the earliest roguelikes, Moria. Your journey begins with creating your character by choosing a class. From there, you'll explore six procedurally generated levels before reaching the goal of your quest and making your escape!

name: Pod Jam
short_description: Assist alien pods to land safely, solve retro puzzles that come with unique mechanics in this ambient sci-fi adventure.

name: Rogue Rollout
short_description: Rogue Rollout is a thrilling roguelike deckbuilder where you score points in a classic dice game style, choose powerful artifacts, and face challenging obstacles as you push through endless rounds.

name: Castle Dark
short_description: Brand Warcford must track down the evil force plaguing the land in this single player ACTION RPG.

name: Dimensional Dilemma
short_description: A first-person physics-based puzzle game reminiscent of Portal. Manipulate the sizes of different objects to forge a path back to your ship.

name: Hmph! Hmph! Yowai
short_description: A Singleplayer Guild Battle RPG where you are a guildmaster. Recruit and manage NPC guild members, construct and defend your guild base, and attack other guilds' bases. Expand your resources through trading and completing guild quests. Defeat all the other guilds and become the top guild!

name: Krashimals
short_description: Rev up your imagination and hit the track in Krashimals! Get ready for wacky, fast-paced racing action like you’ve never seen before. In this family-friendly adventure, you’ll take control of adorable animals, such as a daring duck, piloting makeshift go-karts.

name: The Life and Times of Daniel Vastberaden
short_description: Daniel Morris Vastberaden first died on December 22nd, 1862. The following thirty-nine years of his life are the subject of the (pseudo)biographical point-and-click puzzle adventure The Life and Times of Daniel Vastberaden.

name: YieldTrillions
short_description: Hello, I'm a corn alien, I need to start the ship and go home, please V I have 10000000000 pounds of corn for spaceship fuel and I'll give you half a pound of popcorn as a reward when I get home.

name: Anzu
short_description: Solve match-4 puzzles with Anzu to gather treasure, hatch eggs, and discover all the secrets of the prehistoric hub!

name: Inside Intruder
short_description: Inside Intruder - is a psychological horror game that mostly focuses on atmosphere. Game takes place in your own home, where a uninvited guest comes in.

name: Cursed Digicam | 呪われたデジカメ
short_description: You receive a cursed digital camera that captures ghosts from a strange website. The website allows you to liberate your loved ones by uploading images of their spirits using the camera. You decide to go to the nearest park where your girl was last seen.

name: Wormventures - Barrier 51
short_description: Wormventures - Barrier 51 is a classic 3D cartoon point & click adventure game. Help Looky the worm to save planet Vermis in this big and funny adventure! Explore Looky's odd world, talk to its quirky inhabitants, find clues and use your collected items to solve puzzles.

name: Cats of Mona Lisa - A hidden object game
short_description: Step into the world of timeless art with a playful twist! Cats of Mona Lisa is a relaxing hidden-object game where you explore beautifully reimagined classical paintings in search of ten mischievous cats cleverly hidden within each masterpiece.

name: Phantasia: The Sun Thief
short_description: Escape the forest! A VR adventure. Stay warm, collect energy spheres and use bow & arrows to make your own path.

name: Bistro Brave
short_description: The hero's tale doesn't end with defeating the Daemon Lord—this time, the stage is the bistro you've opened! Former companions and even past adversaries now visit your establishment.

name: Sarukhstart Takeover
short_description: Sarukhstart Takeover is a mascot horror indie game inspired by Baldi's Basics in Education and Learning.

name: Robot girl's dream -RobotBattleChampionship-
short_description: This game is an RPG game that follows the growth of a robot girl who has lost her memories. Players can aim for victory in the robot battle tournament, the main objective, and also enjoy interactions with both humans and robots.

name: Fragrance Point
short_description: What went wrong on Fragrance Point? Explore, hang out, and poke around where you're not supposed to.

name: Whispers in the Wood
short_description: Whispers in the Forest is a single-player base defense strategy game where you must build, upgrade, and defend your base against demonic creatures in a cursed forest. Manage your resources, lead your troops, and survive the darkness of the night as you fight to protect your only hope for salvation.

name: BLADE CHIMERA
short_description: Explore a dark and sinister Osaka as the Demon Hunter Shin. Battle demons, regain lost skills, and uncover the truth of your forgotten past in this exciting occult-inspired cyberpunk metroidvania.

name: Satan Santa
short_description: Satan Santa is a first-person horror walking simulator where you play as a child trapped in a Christmas nightmare. The jolly Santa you once knew has become a bloodthirsty demon, and now you must fight for survival through an eerie house and a forest filled with horrors.

name: Myths and Legends
short_description: 'Myths and Legends' is our next-gen semi-idle, trading real time strategy, that takes the player 2500 years back in time, but with a sense of humor. The game combines elements of exploration, combat, trade and diplomacy on procedurally generated islands.

name: Gummy Jump 2
short_description: you just climbed out of the machine only to realize it's a lot bigger then you imagined, you meet an older gummy that seems familiar, there are enemies trying to track you down, find collectibles, use the furnaces to melt the robots and consume the gummy bear enemies.

name: Warden's Will
short_description: Warden’s Will is a fast paced movement shooter roguelite, playable solo or in up-to 3 player co-op. Choose your Warden, master unique movements and abilities, and overpower hordes of robots in intense battles. Fly, dash, smash, and turn bullet-hell into bullet-heaven!

name: Dealer's Life Legend
short_description: Become a legendary merchant and haggler in this medieval fantasy world. Explore, trade and use potions to give you the upper hand in the latest instalment of the tycoon phenomenon Dealer’s Life!

name: Quadernion
short_description: Quadernion is a skill game about collecting items on multiple maze maps to overcome obstacles so you can collect more items or even go through the opened portal to complete the maze maps.

name: Wobbly Construction!
short_description: Be warned: Wobbly Construction is not a fun game - it's a challenge. It's difficult, unforgiving, and the controls are awkward. You'll experience hours of climbing, falling, failed jumps, and frustration. But if you reach the top of the tower, you'll feel an incredible sense of satisfaction.

name: Keyboard Soldier
short_description: A fast-paced action-survival game where you fend off hordes of zombies by typing words, level up to unlock powerful items, and strategize to survive as long as possible in an ever-challenging environment.

name: Fizz Quiz
short_description: FizzQuiz is a trivia game with over 100 topics and 10,000 questions. Play alone or with up to 10 friends in seven unique rounds, featuring questions in text, images, models, and audio formats. Test your knowledge, earn points, and defeat your friends. FizzQuiz – challenge your intellect!

name: InoLab Trials
short_description: InoLab Trials is a multiplayer game where players compete in a series of skill-based trials, either solo or with friends. Customize your character, tackle challenges, and climb the leaderboards.

name: Cave Hikers
short_description: Cave Hikers is a relaxing and humorous 2D interactive cartoon mockumentary that follows three characters through a cavernous world, on a quest to find the mystical “cave with an infinite ceiling”.

name: クビトリドオルズ・レトリーバー: 島津怪談01
short_description: 少女の首を奪う怪異「クビトリドオルズ」から首を盗み出す謎の仕事。１人でも複数人でも、推理とステルス、探索とクビトリを楽しもう。少女３人と少年１人は、これから始まる全ての怪談を呪うことになる――

name: Checkout: Cashier Simulator
short_description: Step into the shoes of a supermarket cashier in this cute point-and-click game. Scan and bag over 300 unique products to earn as many points as you can before your shift ends! Between shifts, unwind by getting to know a cast of quirky coworkers.

name: City Heist
short_description: A thief steals diamonds from the bank and tries to escape from the security guards and get the highest score.

name: Moxter
short_description: Explore colonial Brazil on a unique off-road experience along the Estrada Real. You will be the Pilot transported to a time when the roads were traveled by muleteers and explorers, full of mysteries, gold and surprising encounters with historical figures from Minas Gerais.

name: Virtual Sniper
short_description: Virtual Sniper invites you to step into the shoes of a professional sniper and embark on an adrenaline-fueled adventure. Engage in missions set across three unique and immersive environments: a bustling city, a remote oil field, and a seemingly peaceful neighborhood.

name: Café Keeper
short_description: Immerse yourself in the exciting world of managing a cafe, where every detail matters! At the heart of the story is a person who decides to open their own cafe. Your task is not only to manage the business but also to create a unique cafe that will attract customers

name: KAVERNUM
short_description: Winston Bradley is an amateur explorer who is always looking for new adventures. His latest destination is a cave in Algeria, which is known for it famous cave paintings. But the further he goes into the cave, the more he realizes that something is wrong with it.

name: Personal Finance Simulator
short_description: Choose parameters like starting money, wage increase, and yearly inflation. These parameters combined with how you spend and manage your money will determine your financial future! Will you end up rich or get evicted?

name: Holidays Survivors
short_description: Fight to save the holiday season as Santa, a Deer, or an Elf! Battle hordes of mutated insect-like infected and demonic foes in action-packed survival gameplay. Bring joy back to the snow-covered lands!

name: Cult -Vein-
short_description: Cult -Vein- is a psychological horror game about post-cult trauma, featuring a girl who is striving to lead a normal life. Unravel the story behind her as you struggle to survive in a twisted world where every interaction has consequences.

name: Wing It
short_description: Wing It is a relaxing simulation game where you build and manage a bird sanctuary. Discover, care for, and unlock diverse bird species, customize your haven with unique decor, and explore new locations to expand your sanctuary. Create a paradise for your feathered friends!

name: SickWay VR
short_description: Sickway is a realistic VR game where you drive a two wheeled electric vehicle in the heights of the city with the goal of getting down. Good advice: Avoid falling down! You can use your creative abilities in track editor, or you can become the fastest among your friends in multiplayer maps.

name: Lefty
short_description: A cozy 3D puzzle game where Lefty, a left-handed character, navigates whimsical mazes by only moving to the right. Experience unique mechanics, culturally inspired gameplay, and increasing puzzle complexity, perfect for fans of casual, cozy, and puzzle games.

name: Things Too Ugly
short_description: Clock in at TEREBRO INC. for the night shift in 1986. Protect the company's legacy as Risk Assessment Data Processor. Equipped with era-specific technology, navigate through obscured narratives to shape the company's future.

name: Willie's Nightfall
short_description: Willie's Nightfall is a first-person horror game. Explore the eerie offices of Willie's Company in search of secret documents. But you're not alone. The sinister company mascot, Willie—a distorted, murderous mouse—is hunting you down.

name: Dark 4799
short_description: Dark 4799

name: Hyper Light Breaker
short_description: Enter the Overgrowth, a new realm in the world of Hyper Light. Play alone or with friends to explore open worlds, create new builds, rip through hordes and overcome the Crowns and the Abyss King.

name: Furion Chronicles 3
short_description: The story follows a young girl, Sigma, who is forced to become an adventurer, meet her companions, and eventually establish the Gallia Mercenary Corps in order to pay the dramatically increased poll tax in the Imperial Territories. However, the rapids of the times, what will ultimately await her?

name: School Hero
short_description: Beat everyone in the school and save your beloved girlfriend in this anime-inspired Beat Em Up game!, as Sakura high calls for a new Hero. Will you answer the call and save her?

name: Idiom‌
short_description: This game places players in the midst of an intense space battle, with finely detailed graphics showcasing the vastness and depth of the cosmos.

name: Deliverance
short_description: Deliverance puts you in the role of a delivery driver on a routine night shift. But when one last delivery leads to a shocking twist, you’re trapped in a nightmare. Navigate dark corridors, find hidden objects, and uncover a sinister mystery as you fight to escape.

name: Tanks of Chaos
short_description: Tanks of Chaos is a fast-paced top-down 2D pixel art game where you battle waves of enemies using customizable tanks. Upgrade your arsenal, face unique foes, and conquer diverse worlds in intense, retro-style combat. Can you survive the onslaught?

name: ⁤Square Wars
short_description: Square Wars is a real-time strategy game featuring resource gathering, survival, and card-based mechanics in a rogue-lite block capture game. Randomly generated maps make every game unique! Embark on the adventure alone or with friends!

name: Battle Balls
short_description: Battle Balls is a wild 4-player 3D platform fighter and party game! Choose from a variety of unique balls, each with special abilities, and compete in chaotic battles and over 20 mini-games. Fight locally or online, and prove who has the best balls of them all!

name: Idle Hero Siege
short_description: is a hard core 'AI' based MUD. Player could config 'AI' for each hero to take wonderful fights.

name: Big Cat Jigsaw Quest
short_description: Embark on a majestic adventure into the wild with 'Big Cat Jigsaw Quest'—a thrilling puzzle game that immerses you in the untamed beauty of lions and tigers. Piece by piece, bring to life breathtaking scenes of roaring kings of the savanna and stealthy prowlers of the jungle.

name: Try to survive Today
short_description: Try to survive today - This is a fast-paced hybrid three-dimensional first- and third-person action game with the ability to switch to an isometric camera. Control your MECH or attack enemies as Zlata!

name: Pack Lunch
short_description: Fill your lunchbox to the brim with a variety of colourfully designed fruit, sandwiches, snacks, and more, in this vibrant 2D puzzle game with over 70 levels. Drag and rotate to discover which shapes fit, and which don't, as you try to complete each grid.

name: Gauntlet
short_description: Working as a common grunt for CannoSec, you have been chosen by the owner to be a candidate as a distinguished Elite. A position thousands in CannoSec work hard to attain. However, you have to show CannoSec that you are a worthy candidate through the Certification Run. Are you meant for this?

name: The Secret Ops 2
short_description: This TPS game was developed by an individual using UE5. The story is set several years after an alien invasion has taken over the world. You will play as a taciturn and ruthless agent tasked with completing missions and doing whatever it takes to eliminate hostile forces and their resources.

name: DREAMSTAIRS
short_description: DREAMSTAIRS is a long-term experimental project that focuses on an atmosphere or a moment. These concepts may not support a full game, or perhaps it is not intended to develop into a complete game.

name: Super Waifu Ball
short_description: Super Waifu Ball is an arcade-style adventure where you roll through colorful, obstacle-filled worlds as a cast of adorable waifus. Complete levels, collect stars, and unlock collectible waifu figurines from the gacha machine!

name: 致命终局 Deadly Endgame
short_description: 一款恋爱模拟视觉小说游戏，玩家将扮演一名转校的大学生，在全新的大学校园中，邂逅两位截然不同的女生，体验美好细腻的校园恋爱。是一步步走入她们的内心，还是抽丝剥茧地了解她们背后的故事，一切的发展都由你来作出选择。通过点击阅读剧情，选择属于自己的结局。

name: Twilight APARTMENT
short_description: 16枚のカードとミニマルな窓から語られるローグライクADV。 あなたの存在以外すべてがふたしかな場所「トワイライトアパートメント」。 あなたはある日、謎の人物と出会い、自分に課せられた使命を告げられます。 あなたの全ての行動、そして決断はカードとなって現れ、その選択の末に世界の姿を変えていくでしょう。

name: Origami Treasure
short_description: Origami Treasure is a 2D platformer, where you are in the role of Papelina, an adventurer in search of the Origami Treasure. Face challenges, obstacles and enemies on this journey with its different folds.

name: Bunny Mazes
short_description: Bunny Mazes is a 2D maze game where you need to make your way through 50 levels, consisting of 500 mazes, within time limit. Collect time bonuses, avoid dangers and decide what path to go to complete all the mazes.

name: Rabolut: Escape From Hell
short_description: A 2D pixel art game where you escape crises born in a toxic workplace. With semi-randomized maps and an increasing variety of traps as you progress, players must master movement techniques and carefully plan the use of limited resources to survive. Perfect for fans of Celeste and Getting Over It.

name: The Dream Within
short_description: A pixel-graphics open world survival craft RPG, where player is locked in a deep dream world, survive in this elusive world, forage, hunt, mine, and build up shelters. Find a way to escape.

name: The Rangers In The South
short_description: Purge the lands in this 2.5D HD Pixelart RogueLike ARPG! Create hundreds of characters with unique strategies and abilities, face hordes of enemies, explore different biomes, procedurally generated dungeons, and obtain unique items!

name: WANTED?
short_description: It's not often that you look closely at the faces of people you pass on the street, is it? It's no wonder that there are people near you who look exactly like the ones on the wanted list .This game will test your observational skills.

name: Moon Keys
short_description: 'Moon Keys' is a 3D platformer focused on gameplay with a subtle story in the background. The game has three sections: underground, surface, and space. It’s played with 40 keyboard keys, which are randomly assigned. Each time a key is pressed, the assigned keys change.

name: Red Pill Cola
short_description: Play aim and shoot with a slingshot, knocking down soda cans.

name: Commander Tiberius Troubleson
short_description: A roguelite platformer with powerful yet limited use spells that will force you to plan ahead. Play as a wizard with a gun, explore handcrafted levels full of secrets and rain fire upon your enemies. No spikes. No fall damage.

name: Neverland永无乡
short_description: Waking up on a strange island, you find yourself transformed into the appearance of a child. You could make new friends, have fun, and explore the island. Depending on your choices, you may even become one with the darkside of the island.

name: So Many Zombies
short_description: So Many Zombies is a fast-paced top-down shooter with roguelike elements that leverages your GPU to render mind-boggling numbers of 3D animated zombies! Face relentless waves of the undead where every second counts. How long can you last against the swarm?

name: Real Shoot（BODYCAM）
short_description: Welcome to Real Shoot, an ultra-realistic single-player first-person shooter with a bodycam perspective. As an elite operative in the Shadow Hunt unit, you'll complete various combat objectives and eliminate international crime syndicates.The game is coming soon!Add it to your wishlist now!

name: Hooptown Hero
short_description: Become the Hero of Hooptown in this roguelite basketball game. Improve your skills, impress the fans, and unlock unique abilities by battling the other residents of Hooptown. Win the city championship and bring glory to your local business sponsor.

name: Magicbook AutoBattler
short_description: Magicbook AutoBattler is a non-traditional strategy game that combines Roguelite moves. This game has unique binding combinations, rich weapons and equipment, cool magical effects, and thrilling combat scenes. In the world of magic books, you will face endless challenges and rewards……

name: Molo's Revenge
short_description: Molo's Revenge is the incremental journey of a mole dragon to avenge his village by doing the thing he does best: Digging.

name: Intrusive Thoughts
short_description: A short story that turns everyday tasks into journeys. Can you be the voice that doesn’t let her down?

name: Relictor
short_description: Relictor is a strategy game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Manage a mobile base. Create AI-driven modules like tanks and gliders for exploration, resource gathering, and tactical battles. Survive, trade, and uncover mysteries in a dangerous world.

name: Maze Racer Balls
short_description: Maze Racer Balls is a game of speed and reflex to win races in mazes. For 1 or 2 simultaneous players, the runner has to win a number of mazes in the estimated time. Let's see who will win this race?

name: The Reunion
short_description: The Reunion is psychological horror where you will visit abodend school but be carefull someone is already wating..and he does not like any kind visits of people..

name: Another Way of Gettin' Paid
short_description: Japanese romance VN from hit developer PacoPaco Soft! As Shunji's various acquaintances begin to interact in ways they were never supposed to, he finds his social circle expanding farther than he could have ever imagined...

name: ARVIS Punch 2
short_description: Train in our virtual gym to become the best fighter. Defeat every one of our fighters, and get ready to face other players!

name: Honor Bound
short_description: Protect an exclusive boarding school and rebuild your life after scandal as a military bodyguard! How far will you go for ambition, duty, and your country?

name: Rogue Hex
short_description: Play your cards right to conquer the world in the Roguelite 4x. Explore mysterious lands, survive against the barbarian horde, and grow your stone age empire into the stars! ✨

name: Solider AutoChess
short_description: You will own all the kungfu in the world. 'Solider AutoChess' is a cricket-fighting auto-chess game. Every battle is 1V1. You need to constantly upgrade and skillfully combine kungfus to reach the top.

name: CatboyZOOM
short_description: Zoom through the many handcrafted worlds in this FPS Platforming Speedrunner! Master your control over the Source-inspired movement system and leave your best times for others to challenge!

name: Homelessvania
short_description: Fight for your rights as a homeless person in this mini Metroidvania SPEEDRUNNER.

name: Finger Fury Clicker
short_description: Click and create small balls. Progress and earn money. Unlock new features. It's great fun to earn money for free. Don't forget to check the prize bags at short intervals. There will be more prizes in your chest in these bags! In the final, a very special creature will be waiting for you.

name: Nexus Knights
short_description: In a Action dystopian future, humanity's last hope lies within the Nexus Order. A covert organization that trains elite warriors known as Nexus Knights. Thrust into high-stakes simulations, you must navigate through procedurally generated mazes, defeat deadly zombies, cyborgs, robots, and more.

name: SYM Shepherd
short_description: SYM Shepherd - Sam the German Shepherd is exploring a construction site. Help him perform tasks in this fun & challenging dog simulator.

name: 三界铲屎官
short_description: 欢迎踏入《三界铲屎官》，一款融合养猫乐趣与修仙奇幻元素的休闲模拟经营游戏，让你在繁忙的生活中找到一片宁静的避风港，与萌态可掬的喵仙们共赴一场心灵与灵魂的治愈之旅。

name: Cryst
short_description: In this action-packed game, unknown creatures invade a factory and steal diamond pieces. Your mission is to play through exciting stages, recover the missing pieces of diamond scattered across various locations, and restore them to the factory.

name: 三九
short_description: 《三九》是一款包含中式恐怖元素的第一人称悬疑解谜游戏。 玩家将以第一视角经历主角身上发生的神秘案件，在游戏中以图案搜查，平面迷宫， 思维解谜小游戏等不同形式破解案件剧情发现游戏真相，并通关故事结局。

name: Eternal Challenger
short_description: Eternal Challenger is a roguelite boomer shooter which aims to create retro style combat experiences and visuals with modern systems which randomize and create content.

name: Panda Runner
short_description: Help the panda save her baby. Catch up with the bird and collect crystals. Buy useful bonuses and weapons.

name: Penguin Panic!
short_description: A penguin's life is never easy. Even more so when you're a penguin mother, looking to protect her eggs. Penguin Panic is a cute platformer and features simple controls, secret challenges and cheerful graphics. A fast-paced action game that no one will want to put down.

name: Fight Back The Night
short_description: A fantasy twin-stick shooter! Burn away the Forces of Darkness that infest the land, slowly ridding the kingdom of their presence! Play through an epic story and meet charming characters in this pixel world!

name: Verfall
short_description: Verfall is a turn-based tactical RPG where you must strategically form teams to face a decaying world. Explore, uncover secrets, and use Karma-based abilities. Face challenges, make choices, and determine the fate of the world through multiple endings.

name: Water game simulator
short_description: A classic casual puzzle game that simulates a water ring machine.

name: 飞机大战 hit a plane
short_description: This is a simple casual flying game where players control their fighter jets to eliminate enemies, and their scores accumulate points as the enemies are eliminated!

name: All About Maze
short_description: A casual, retro, Atari-inspired maze traversing game. Controllers recommended! Play by yourself or couch-coop with your friends and family.

name: Harvest Hills
short_description: Harvest Hills is a charming and relaxing farm simulator that allows you to run your own rancho. Cultivate various crops, take care of animals, and produce homemade products. Sell the goods in the local market to earn money and use it to upgrade or automate the farm.

name: 花奴令 HUANU POEMS
short_description: Huanu Poems is a multi-ending love adventure game. As a photographer, carrying the secret of being a bloodline inheritor of HuaNu Town, you will take lovely Peach to run a B&B, encounter gentle Cloudia. Your choices will affect the direction of the story.

name: Endeavor: Rite of Passage
short_description: Take command of the world's military elite and liberate planetary resources. Fabricate bases, train soldiers, build a mechanized army and rid the planet of powerful enemy combatants and mysterious alien threats.

name: SATAN
short_description: Experience the thrill of retro boomer shooters in this action-packed game where you'll battle hordes of demons and face the ultimate challenge: Satan himself. Relive the glory days of classic shooters with intense gameplay, a variety of weapons, and relentless enemies.

name: Dungeon Minesweeper Chronicles
short_description: Dungeon Minesweeper Chronicles is a thrilling fusion of classic Minesweeper mechanics with turn-based roguelike deckbuilding gameplay.

name: 16BitSurvivors
short_description: 16Bit Survivors is a retro horror horde-survival game with roguelike-elements, where you must annihilate ceaseless waves of monsters. Unlock, upgrade, and forge unbreakable synergies to become godlike against the hordes of demonic creatures coming for your flesh

name: Gaung
short_description: Experience the spine-chilling horror game where you explore the haunted depths of an ancient cave shrouded in mystery. As Rani, you will navigate cryptic puzzles, eerie spirits, and survive the supernatural to uncover dark secrets and escape with your life.

name: Toy Shop Simulator
short_description: Run your own toy store! Arrange shelves, set prices, process payments, and manage staff. Expand and design your shop, handle online orders, deliver with a scooter, trade rare toys, and ensure security. Create a magical shopping experience in Toy Shop Simulator!

name: Save the sheep
short_description: Sheep are a valuable resource, protect your sheep! Hire soldiers and build barricades on the enemy's path! Explode bombs and set traps!

name: The Tale of: Bubble Boy
short_description: Help Bubble Boy reach the highest mountaintop in the Alps by moving him upwards inside his giant soap bubble, but don't let the bubble pop, or you will fall, all the way, back down...

name: Ascendrix
short_description: The ascent nightmare

name: 通缉令 wanted poster
short_description: Top-down barrage shooter. Refer to the Vampire Ancient Survivor Meat Pigeon gameplay to add barrage, random character attributes, and random equipment.

name: Arken Age
short_description: Arken Age is a VR action-adventure game set in the Bio-Chasm—a terraformed fantasy world created by the Grand Arborist. Engage in full physics combat using Arkenite infused swords & guns—and freely explore the densely filled environments under siege by Hyperion's neural corruption.

name: CyberQuQu
short_description: CyberQuQu is a card-collecting and character progression game. In the open world, do your best to level up your main character—get stronger, stronger, and even stronger! Take your powerful character into PVP to showcase your skills and claim the legendary title!

name: N3Rally
short_description: 'N3Rally' combines a charming aesthetic with intense racing action. Drive a range of vehicles, from production cars to rally cars, and master various terrains such as tarmac, gravel, and snow!

name: Scales of Justice
short_description: Travel across a magical kingdom with four eccentric individuals! Will you find your destiny—or will you write it for yourself? A text-based interactive fantasy novel, 600,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects.

name: The Lies We Tell Ourselves
short_description: The Lies We Tell Ourselves is an episodic first person psychological action-adventure game with introspective/horror elements and a focus on subtle storytelling and atmosphere. Explore, solve puzzles, survive and uncover truths buried deep within a castle of lies.

name: Undead Cave Defence
short_description: Undead army fills the world, and we are trapped in the cave of an ancient god. Roguelike strategic defense! Use your resources wisely, lead your soldiers, and unite the survivors. Ultimately, turn your cave into a fortress capable of defeating the undead king. The fate of the world is in your hands.

name: Sisyphus The Game
short_description: An action platformer based on the myth of Sisyphus. The player controls the mythological figure cursed by the gods, pushing a boulder up a mountain while avoiding various obstacles like falling rocks and divine lightning. The game challenges players' persistence and skill as they defy fate.

name: 4 Rush Together
short_description: '4 Rush Together' is a light-hearted and funny obstacle course game where you and your friends are tied together with a rope, adventuring through creative levels filled with fun. You can invite up to three friends to play together in local multiplayer or online co-op mode. What are you waiting for?

name: Take Notes
short_description: Take Notes is a puzzle game set in the near future within a bunker filled with 40 unique puzzles. Prepare yourself for a mind-bending adventure where every puzzle solved brings you one step closer to stopping the unthinkable

name: Hell's Descent
short_description: Start your roguelite adventure as a sorceresses that wields the arcane elements of fire, ice, lightning and more, acquire talents and find new gear! You must survive the relentless enemies of hell and defeat the seven deadly sins.

name: Tribe Nation
short_description: Tribe Nation is a real-time strategy with roguelike elements, set during the Gallic Wars. Lead your Celtic tribe across Europe in search of a new homeland. Strategize on a randomly generated hex battlefields, adapt to unexpected events, craft, upgrade, and equip. Make your tribe a nation.

name: DuaLight
short_description: In this challenging cyberpunk platformer switch between day and night environments, go through dangerous obstacles by manipulating gravity and time. Upgrade your abilities to conquer these levels with an intense soundtrack. Are you ready for the ultimate adrenaline rush?

name: Final Knight
short_description: Final Knight is a beat 'em up action roguelike where you combine characters into a formidable party. Move left-to-right with retro arcade-style gameplay and coordinate party members to inflict massive damage by exploiting the weaknesses of your enemies!

name: Hangul Typing Tale
short_description: Learning to type Korean 한글 from ZERO!

name: Anomaly Corridor
short_description: Escape from the Corridor!

name: Emoji Face Jump!
short_description: A frustrating jump action game. An emoji wandering in a broken world. Guided by a mysterious voice telling you to aim for space to escape, you must leap your way to the sky using only jumps. The mysterious voice insults you every time you fail. Can you endure the verbal abuse and reach space?

name: CapitalismCraft
short_description: Welcome to the wonderful world of capitalism! Exploit your workers to earn money! Hire managers to crush their spirits and drive them harder, then fire them once you’ve achieved your ends! Be agile, ruthless, merciless, become the richest CEO in the world, winning in rapid clicker management!

name: Nurikabe World
short_description: Nurikabe World is a relaxing logic puzzle game where you solve puzzles by creating islands and connecting rivers to create beautiful sceneries. Experience different landscapes and seasons, solve puzzle campaigns and create your own levels.

name: Galaxy Dreamer
short_description: Galaxy Dreamer is an 2D old-school vertical space shooter that will remind you of your childhood.Сontrol a spaceship and shoot your opponents alone or with a friend! You can choose from a dozen spaceships and weapons to destroy a variety of enemies and BOSSES!

name: Dinosaur Cousin Squad
short_description: A cozy lil' prehistoric platformer where you help five dinosaurs escape an apocalyptic disaster through five biomes.

name: Nyctophobia
short_description: A short Horror game about navigating a pitch-black urban environment, using limited sources of light.

name: Resurrection The Judgment
short_description: Unravel the truth, master your skills, and forge your legend in Resurrection: The Judgment!

name: Ancient Kingdoms
short_description: Explore a vast open world filled with unique creatures and dungeons. Choose from six powerful classes and embark on an epic fantasy journey in this classic 2D RPG. Play singleplayer or multiplayer with your friends (up to 4 players).

name: Space Escape
short_description: A rogue-like arcade shoot-'em-up.

name: Strange Monsters Memory
short_description: A simple Memory match game with monsters where you will be tested with 4 different game difficulties. Try to achieve the best time with less tries in each mode and collect all the monsters!

name: De Conditione Mortalis: BLOODBATH/metanoia
short_description: Embrace the human condition in this creepy RPG game. Sink in an abyss of loneliness, pain and anguish: will you forge your path out?

name: 迷路会社 | Maze Company
short_description: A short horror walking simulator where you just head from the workroom to the exit. Something may happen along the way, but don't worry, just keep going.Your goal is to return.

name: Greybit
short_description: Greybit is a heart-pounding, adrenaline-fueled first-person shooter (FPS) game paying homage to the iconic 1993 'Doom' while adding a fresh twist. Play as a lone warrior battling hordes of demons in a nightmarish landscape where every corner hides a new threat.

name: FlurryHurry!
short_description: Survive as long as possible in this DSi-ware-inspired arcade game. Every zone is pseudo-randomly generated, making each run feel unique!

name: 10run
short_description: It's a game that removes characters by creating pudding

name: Valkeala Birds
short_description: Puzzle game where mission is to use slingshot and shoot and kill all pigs at different levels. Player can use 3 different birds at each level

name: Pinball Storm: Lokanta
short_description: Pinball Storm:Lokanta is a RPG game combing Roguelike and pinball gameplay. You will be part of the resistance against plutocracy. Use your marble pinballs to eliminate waves of enemies, and collect resources to further enhance your marbles. Save the world from hell!

name: Coffee Express
short_description: Open your own coffee shop and become a barista in the cozy and colorful world of Coffee Express! A unique experience awaits you with stock tracking, realistic coffee making experience and shop customizations. Make your customers happy by making excellent coffee in your own coffee paradise!

name: Monster Meals
short_description: Monster Meals is a fast-paced cooking game where you control a small monster chef in your food truck, preparing meals with exotic creatures for monstrous customers. Serve quickly, or you’ll be on the menu!

name: Severed Decks
short_description: Feel the tension rise with each flipped card, knowing one bad choice may cost you your head—literally.

name: Sol-Rui -after mini-
short_description: Rui can't catch a break... She had only just returned to her world after saving Roots, thanks to the power of Sol, but now monsters are attacking her town and kidnapping people! However, the challenge awaiting her is very different this time. It's all smoke, mirrors and illusions...

name: Burrow Wing
short_description: You wake up, feeling a bit hollow – and stumble down a hole. Now you're stuck here. Burrow Wing is an atmospheric exploration/adventure game about getting lost in a desolate subterranean expanse.

name: XIII - A Final Game of Tarot With Death
short_description: XIII is a hypnotic and psychedelic card game. Let death read your future with tarot cards and decide your fate. Play the right cards in the right places to keep the scales of karma in check, for that's the only way to delay the inevitable. And never forget: death comes to us all.

name: Cards of Divinity
short_description: Become a Greek Deity and command heroes drawn from myth, legend, and history. Cast spells & enhancements, and conquer the realms to triumph over the other Gods!

name: Focus
short_description: This game transports players into a wondrous world filled with challenges and adventures, starring a particularly charming bird wearing a hat.

name: DEBUG DEADLINE
short_description: The main character is hired as a debugger at the game company “Dokidoki Games”! With a time limit of one week, will he be able to find the bug safely? The debugging work with fate on the line begins now!

name: Lawnmower Game Jigsaw
short_description: Lawmmower game jigsaw is jigsaw puzzle game with lawnmower game themes

name: SIPE
short_description: In this Self Inflicted Puzzle Experience your goal is to assemble all puzzle pieces in several jigsaws.

name: We Are Square
short_description: WARNING: This game will destroy friendships. In We Are Square you and up to seven friends must work together to control one square and platform yourselves to the goal.

name: Belote 3 in 1
short_description: Experience the ultimate Belote game with our feature-packed app that brings the classic French card game to life! Our digital version offers Belote, Coinche, and Contrée, all in one place - enjoy a wide range of customization options to tailor your gameplay experience.

name: Paranormal Night Shift
short_description: Paranormal Night Shift is an observation and spot the anomaly game set in a haunted house in the 1980s.

name: Gokai Awesome Simulator +
short_description: Gokai Awesome Simulator + is a premium version of Gokai Awesome Simulator Lite with tons of new content than the original!

name: Convict Team Tactics
short_description: Turn-based tactics. 20 dangerous convicts. Suicide missions.

name: Nunholy
short_description: In a world overrun by vampires, a group of nuns with their own stories have arrived at the Hunters' Guild. They are ready to wield any power—even that of demons—to defeat their enemies. What fate awaits them on this perilous journey?

name: Tiny House Simulator
short_description: Design and build custom tiny homes for various clients in this relaxing open-world building game. Create unique spaces suited to each client’s requirements, and dive into different layouts with the sandbox mode for total creative freedom.

name: Warranty Not Included
short_description: Warranty Not Included is a fun and accessible VR shooter perfect for newcomers. Practice your aim in various ranges and blast away at hordes of robotic enemies. Join the Resistance Now!

name: Elemental Defender
short_description: Elemental Defender is a tower defense game using card to power up your units. Build your deck and place powerful units to defend your base from passing enemies.

name: Stig
short_description: A sokoban-style puzzle game about finding a path through colors.

name: That Level Again
short_description: A small logic game where all levels are the same but ways to win are not

name: Witch Stories
short_description: In Witch Stories, the forest doth whisper thy name, and the witch’s gaze falleth heavy upon thee. The world shall not wait, though thou choosest to act or abide still. From sunrise to sunrise, face trials dark and truths most grievous.

name: BorderMind
short_description: A retro horror FPS that takes the player to an intermediary world between the material and the spiritual. With a compelling story, jump scares, and a very dark atmosphere, this game blends classic FPS and horror elements with a spiritual and scientific storyline.

name: Skystead Ranch
short_description: Transform a desolate sky island into a vibrant sanctuary. Using your enchanted crook, cultivate your garden, befriend quirky creatures, build a home, and unlock secrets along the way. Each choice adds a personal touch to your unique Skystead Ranch!

name: Curse of Darkness
short_description: is a tense survival game in a post-apocalyptic world where the player has to collect parts of a crashed car to save himself while avoiding deadly monsters. Four different creatures roam the world, each with their own special abilities

name: GutBuster
short_description: Digest the ravenous Rebbecca's meals in this arcade style run and gun erotic comedy game. Dodge and blast the chewed food, collect powerups, and spend lipids at the upgrade shop to survive the challenge and prevent indigestion! For mature players.

name: Minidinos
short_description: In this fun, family-friendly real-time strategy game, kids can control dinosaurs, beasts, and bugs as they battle for supremacy! Build your army, gather resources, and outsmart your enemies in epic showdowns. Play solo against the computer or team up with friends for multiplayer action!

name: Running Through Backrooms
short_description: Experience a visually stunning solo survival horror built in Unreal Engine 5. Navigate through 15 unique levels filled with haunting environments, challenging parkour, and lurking entities. Immerse yourself in the chilling atmosphere as you fight to escape the horrors of the Backrooms

name: Liminal Spaces: Outside The Backrooms
short_description: Have you ever wondered what Liminal Spaces are outside the Backrooms? Explore them in this surrealist short game based on lucid dreaming and liminal spaces in the nature.

name: popyAlive
short_description: The game has a high level of strategy and skill, and players need to move flexibly and use various weapons and tactics to deal with different levels and enemies.

name: Project Rebirth
short_description: Fight for your life in a high-security prison where dangerous experiments have unleashed a deadly mutation. Solve puzzles, hide from a crazy doctor, and survive intense encounters as you attempt to escape this nightmare.

name: The Corn Maze
short_description: Navigate a haunting corn maze in this atmospheric exploration game. Manage your flashlight battery, search for compasses, and uncover eerie secrets while avoiding what lurks in the shadows. Simple mechanics, immersive tension—can you find your way out?

name: The Noble Quran
short_description: This is a digital version of The Noble Quran with full vocal recitation and various translations. Enjoy listening to the message of Allah as it is fully recited and translated for all to experience.

name: Jewel Match Solitaire Winterscapes 3 - Collector's Edition
short_description: Warmed by winter's gentle magic, unwrap a cool Solitaire classic, A thousand levels to explore, Klondike, Spider – and much more. Through sparkling snowflakes reach new heights - Freecell and Yukon, such delights. Embrace the season, pure and clear, let Solitaire enchant your year!

name: Survivor Story: The Apocalypse
short_description: Your goal in this text-based choice game is to help the protagonist survive until he uncovers the mysteries surrounding the city in order to reunite with his daughter, Susan.

name: Dreamcore
short_description: Step into the surreal with Dreamcore, a body-cam styled psychological horror game that plunges you into the eerie beauty of 'liminal spaces.' Unravel the mysteries of Dreamcore’s non-linear worlds and uncover its hidden secrets. Can you discover what lies beyond the edge of reality?

name: Go-Kart Racing 2
short_description: Test your skills out in Career Mode and race for the championship against your rivals.  Race on seven different go-kart tracks and earn your spot at the top of the leaderboards.

name: Tragedy at Ashville Lane
short_description: Dive into a psychological horror experience and try to uncover the mystery at Ashville Lane. Step into the shadows of your fears and face them to figure out what happened that day. Survival is your only option and remaining hidden is a must.

name: The elevator
short_description: Something is going on in the elevator of your new home.

name: Truck Driving Cargo Simulator
short_description: Improve your driving skills and prove yourself as a skilled truck driver by delivering heavy trucks with cargo attachments from origin to their destination places in this Truck Driving Cargo Simulator. The games include dynamic weather conditions such as rain, snow, fog and changing day/night cycles

name: Cryptical Path
short_description: Cryptical Path is an action rogue-lite that pushes the boundaries of the genre. Play the Architect, build your own rooms, and tame an ever-changing labyrinth you've been summoned in.

name: 走亲戚大作战
short_description: 《走亲戚大作战》是一款以春节走亲戚为背景，轻松且愉快的沙雕休闲小游戏。在游戏中，你将化身春节期间走亲访友的主角，与各种奇葩的亲戚们展开斗智斗勇心理大战。你要凭借智慧和策略，通过特色性格词条选择合适的回答，处理那些让人避之不及的琐事、挑战一个又一个令人挠头的'家人'，成功走完所有亲戚家就能顺利通关。每一次走亲戚都是一次全新的挑战，把熊亲戚们强加给你的死亡聊天大声勇敢的“怼”回去，从亲戚们层层叠叠的连招里收获最完美的过年关体验。

name: FREEDOM WARS Remastered
short_description: Born into a one-million-year prison sentence, you must survive deadly missions to earn any hope of freedom. Die in prison or live on the battlefield. The choice is yours.

name: Shadows Over Whispering Pines
short_description: A first-person mystery adventure where you solve puzzles, answer calls, and navigate dangers as a nightwatch in a secluded wilderness park.

name: Your Android
short_description: Your life is changed forever when a mysterious package arrives at your front door. Go on many different outings with your new android companion as you both form unforgettable memories in this beautiful visual novel.

name: Pizza Blitz
short_description: Prepare and Cook Joe's classic pizzas while drinking on the job. Deliver them while evading an active warzone. Make your mark as the worlds last chef / delivery driver! Uphold the distinguished Hungry Joe's Pizzas reputation!

name: Los Pingheros
short_description: Duck, dodge and toss. Los Pingheros is a multiplayer brawler for up to 8 players online or local. Join hectic battles in various modes and strive to become the ultimate Pinghero in Mexico by snowing your opponents out of the arena.

name: World Traveler
short_description: Fly around the world, deliver packages to different countries, and learn geography along the way. Meet friends and fly together to your next destination. Kids friendly and educational.

name: Save Me My Hero
short_description: ’Save Me, My Hero’ is a defense game with roguelike elements.Complete your own battle style with the hero's various skills and special abilities.

name: Sword of Jade: Parallel Dreams
short_description: A lengthy fantasy adventure role playing game based around a day/night cycle, customizing your heroes, and a storyline where every choice has an impact on the story. Upgraded from the original MS-DOS release to run natively on all platforms with QOL updates!

name: Defender's Quest 2: Mists of Ruin
short_description: Rise above the Mirk and protect your ship from dangers unknown in the latest entry in the classic Defender’s Quest tower defense series!

name: Retro Endurance 8bit
short_description: It's an 8bit retro game compilation, but with a big twist: You are randomly picked a set of games and you'll keep switching between them, keeping you on your toes! Sounds chaotic, but it's actually really fun! Contains more than 20 retro game recreations, all well designed around this fun mechanic.

name: Mountain Legends 5
short_description: Mountain Legends 5 is our car racing title of the Mountain Legends Series for macOS & Windows devices. Race to the finish line before it’s too late. Defeat your opponents & be the first to cross the finish line.

name: Cozy Campzone
short_description: 'Short gorgeous experience of gathering ingredients for coffe in the peace of nature'

name: Government Contractors: Arms of Influence
short_description: Historically accurate strategy game where you act as a government contractor researching, developing, and manufacturing weapons and technology for your clients. You choose the parts for each product, but be aware that cheap or wrong political choices may affect your success rate!

name: Cat Detective Albert Wilde
short_description: Play as the Cat Detective Albert Wilde. Walk, talk, interrogate, joke, solve a mystery, and experience an old film noir setting with humanoid animal characters. A story of quantum theory and parallel universes served with a lot of humour.

name: Wendigo Blue
short_description: Action-packed 2D beat-em-up with intense boss battles and a large variety of customizable equipment and skills. Up to 4 players with local co-op.

name: Trashcan Simulator
short_description: The moment you throw something into the trash can is an exciting moment in your daily life. Through this game, you can enjoy the exciting moments of your life over and over again! You might discover something new by staring at the trash can in the room.

name: Gaming Copilot
short_description: Gaming Copilot is your AI gaming buddy, providing you with precise guides. With efficient assistance from intelligent models and powerful databases, it supports instant voice responses and excellent screenshot analysis. It can also share jokes with you! Let's game with Copilot for a blast!

name: IDUN - Frontline Survival
short_description: A defense RTS where you can move turrets at will. Extract resources, upgrade technology, and defend against enemy swarms in a gripping space campaign. Hold the line, set up your turrets, and brace for screen-filling hordes!

name: Stage Break Idle
short_description: Stage Break Idle is a relaxing incremental game where you defeat enemies at each stage. As you progress, you'll discover meaningful upgrades and unlock engaging new features. Unlock powerful companions to aid you in battle, and continue advancing until you conquer the final stage.

name: LIBRITOPIA: Librarian Simulator
short_description: Manage your own library! Organize and classify books however you like, furnish the space with shelves, help visitors find their books, and maintain silence to keep them happy!

name: Banana Massacre
short_description: In this goofy horror shooter, you play as a cop who has received a 911 call from banana people claiming that they need to be rescued out of a slaughter house that is being run by pigs. It is your duty to free the bananas from slaughter and to eliminate any pigs that stand in your way.

name: Defense Builder
short_description: Defense Builder is a science fiction tower defense game. Players can build different defensive towers to resist enemy attacks, and finally defeat the final Boss of each level. There are day and night shifts, and each map introduces additional game mechanics.

name: Dice with the Devil
short_description: Dice with the Devil is a party-based, dice-chucking, deck-building roguelike. Assemble your crew of adventurers, Defeat the DEVIL!

name: Trials Of Randoom
short_description: Trials Of Randoom is a unique puzzle game with immense challenges and great mysteries. Each level is unique and your experience will be unforgettable as you solve the puzzles to advance through the different levels.

name: A Happy Place
short_description: 3D Platformer Collectathon Throwback

name: The Catalyst Acolyte Tower Defense
short_description: Defend the Catalyst Crystal against adorable yet menacing bugs in The Catalyst Acolyte. Strategically construct defenses in handcrafted levels, aided by helpful items every 10 waves. Engaging gameplay and charming visuals make for an addictive tower defense adventure.

name: ATC Flight Operator
short_description: ATC Flight Operator is an air traffic control simulation engine with a powerful interface that gives users complete control of their airspace.  Are you capable of taking control of an iconic airport while preventing mid-air collisions, and still directing airplanes to land as quickly as possible?

name: Border Town
short_description: Restore the former glory of Border Town in an open-world sandbox RPG set in a fantastical realm. Explore the world, craft tools and weapons, cultivate fields, and socialise with your neighbours while dealing with dark forces that threaten to destroy everything you have built.

name: TANK ZERO
short_description: TANK ZERO is an action-packed game with tanks where players build their own unique tank from various parts, such as the hull, chassis, cannon, engine, and armor. Each time, players can create different combinations of characteristics and appearances for their tank.

name: FYGameCompany
short_description: Build your game empire! Manage a company, develop hits, win honors. Recruit, innovate, cultivate, invest. Real exp, free dev, pers. cult., fun play.

name: Farmer's Shop Simulator
short_description: Create your own farm. Harvest crops, take care of animals, sell goods, set prices at your discretion, hire staff, expand, design, and build your dream farm.

name: 万象群侠传
short_description: 《万象群侠传》是一款PC角色扮演类单机游戏。我们致力于为玩家创造一个可以自由探索的武侠世界，凭借跌宕起伏、扣人心弦的丰富故事，为玩家铺陈出与众不同的江湖万象。在这里，玩家每开启一局游戏，都如同踏入一段独一无二的旅程，深度体验截然不同的侠客人生。

name: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O.
short_description: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. takes the gameplay of Virtua Fighter 5 and raises it to new levels! Rollback Netcode support, gorgeous 4K visuals and additional content make it the best version of this legendary game ever.

name: Mark of the Deep
short_description: Mark of the Deep is an epic pirate-themed adventure with a strong narrative and a thrilling mix of Metroidvania and Souls-Like elements. Embark on this journey, explore the mysteries of a cursed island and find your missing pirate crew!

name: Turbo Dismount® 2
short_description: Turbo Dismount 2 is a comedy physics racing sandbox with Mr. Dismount and his friends. It is the officially ambitious sequel to the wildly popular, immensely successful, world-renowned entertainment juggernaut - Turbo Dismount.

name: The Little Adventure
short_description: A brave dog from a distant planet embarks on a perilous journey through a beautiful yet dangerous world in search of an old friend. Face intense battles, explore breathtaking landscapes, and uncover hidden secrets in this action-packed adventure filled with heartwarming moments and deep connections.

name: Welcome to Maison Chichigami
short_description: Deep in the mountains, there is said to be a legendary hot spring: called the Spirit Spring. Becoming lost on the way to the spring, you are rescued by a mysterious, reclusive family. But what secrets does this family hide away in their manor?

name: Pew Pew Gaem 3
short_description: You owe the mafias some money... Fight trough the deadly waves of enemies and stay alive while trying to get to the person behind all this chaos.

name: Rusty Dudes
short_description: Manage a gang of dudes to complete various missions on 35 levels. You will have access to two dozen mercenaries with unique skills. Combine them at your discretion.

name: Wild Rumble
short_description: Wild Rumble is a 3v3 roguelike soccer game in which you'll evolve your team as you score goals through dangerous arenas. Unlock new characters, master their abilities and pick the best upgrades to lead your team to victory!

name: Scary Shadow Spot - Bitter Glass
short_description: Scary Shadow Spot: Bitter Glass. Without memory, John Doe wanders the desert until he finds refuge in a haunted saloon. The ghosts of the past demand justice, and every clue brings him closer to an unsettling truth. Are you ready to uncover the secret of the Bitter Glass?

name: Ropuka's Idle Island
short_description: A cozy idle game that sits anywhere on your desktop. Watch the frog cut grass, upgrade his tools, and decorate the island while you work or relax.

name: Pyramids and Aliens: Escape Room
short_description: Embark on an archaeological adventure inside an ancient pyramid to find your missing mentor. As an intrepid explorer, solve puzzles, investigate clues, and unravel the pyramid's secrets. Spoiler: it was not built by humans!

name: Rift of the NecroDancer
short_description: The NecroDancer's back in an all-new rhythm game! Dragged into a strange new world, Cadence must engage in musical combat with monsters surging through the Rift! Face pulse-pounding Rhythm Rifts where every beat is a battle, all set to an original soundtrack by Danny Baranowsky & friends.

name: Waifu Simulator: Latex Edition
short_description: Waifu Simulator is a simulation game whose ultimate goal is to bring you pleasure and relaxation!

name: Forces of Ether
short_description: Blast your way through an Isometric Open World Galaxy. Fly seamlessly to space. Lead your chosen faction in ground and space battles. Stop the imminent Collapse of civilization... Or let it all fall into ruin.

name: Cycle Sever
short_description: CycleSever is a game where you progress through stages by selecting the right commands to defeat enemies. The game offers a tense and thrilling experience as you read your opponent’s actions, deflect their attacks, and seize opportunities to strike back.

name: Hired 2 Die
short_description: Hired 2 Die is a cooperative horror game for 1 to 4 players. Terrifying monsters haunt your workplace. Study them using the security system, survive by remembering that every change is permanent, and capture them with precise planning. Most importantly, finish your job.

name: THE 8IGHT
short_description: Max, who suffers from schizophrenia due to childhood trauma, decides to break free from the endless torment of hallucinations and delusions.

name: City of Nightmares
short_description: You are a detective who wants to investigate how all the inhabitants of a city died due to a virus. It all started in a hotel that was abandoned along with the city, and it was rumored to be haunted. You are on a quest for answers.

name: Goblins With Guns
short_description: Goblins With Guns is a game where you fight in 4 player free for all battles as goblins who need to win in order to earn their freedom. There are several different maps, guns and perks that change the game and every battle is filled with bullet hell madness.

name: Armor Stride
short_description: Sir Stepsalot is trapped in the Cursed Forest! Luckily, he has his trusty sword and bomb pouch to fend off dangerous monsters. He will have to travel deeper into the forest fighting monsters and avoiding traps. Our knight can't stay in place for too long though. There's a dark curse chasing him!

name: Can No One Hear Me?
short_description: All you have to do is press a key and speak into your microphone... But which key?

name: Lurking in Tenebris
short_description: Lurking in Tenebris is a psychological horror game where you participate in a mysterious drug experiment, forced to escape mazes that intensify with every pill you take.

name: Ohjata
short_description: Skillfully redirect your weapon to reach victory against hundreds of enemies and survive by taming the games mechanics in this challenging survivors inspired rogue like with low poly aesthetics. Collect tons of upgrades to create powerful synergies, and explore the map to unveil its secrets.

name: horrher
short_description: horrher - a creepy exploration mystery game

name: Donerksela -Sacred Area-
short_description: Pass to Ordeal and become the God!! You become the Guardian on a certain place, and management that dominion. Defeat the attacking enemy through the 'produce resource', 'enhance build' and more. If growing to adult appearance, then should be fight on an equal footing with strong Bosses.

name: Hayden's Odyssey
short_description: Hayden's Odyssey is a roguelike dungeon crawler where you explore procedurally generated levels, battle a variety of challenging enemies, and collect powerful upgrades. Each run brings new obstacles, ensuring that every journey through the portals is a fresh and intense experience.

name: I commissioned some dogs 4
short_description: I paid more artists to hide dogs and bones in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

name: Parkour Assassin: Sprint Run
short_description: A 3D parkour game in a cyberpunk style, where you can experience breathtaking speeds, dodge various traps, and continuously break through to achieve the furthest distance. Terrifying bombs and robotic enemies will stand in your way, but you can use the quick blade in your hand to slash through them!

3072 is a classic puzzle game that combines two identical color block numbers into a new number by moving them up and down, left and right. Your goal is very simple, to reach 3072, come and challenge.

name: Masters of the Air
short_description: This is a flying barrage shooting game, the background is the Pacific theater of World War II, the player controls a fighter plane in the game, in order to experience the exhilarating barrage shooting.

name: NUSNUR
short_description: Explore the multiverse with different versions of NUSNURs where every universe has its own mechanics, style, story, and lore. Observe how their lives connect and how everything ends.

name: Puyo! Sokoban
short_description: The protagonist, Fluffy, lives in an underground cave and is naturally fond of organizing. It can't stand the messy arrangement of boxes and needs to restore order here. This is a game of considerable difficulty, but as long as you are willing to take the first step, success is within reach.

name: Bioframe Outpost
short_description: Bioframe Outpost is a 2d sci-fi action adventure game, dedicated to exploration, experimentation, emergent gameplay, and narrative. Its photography-based approach to non-linear exploration and action gameplay offers a fresh take on Metroidvania gameplay.

name: Rum N' Gold Royale
short_description: Set sail in Rum N’ Gold, a naval Battle Royale action. With tactical combat, ship customization, and a relentless storm, every round is a thrilling adventure. Go solo or form a fleet with your friends and fight to be the last ship sailing!

name: Your Girls
short_description: A dancing desktop pet. Want to watch something exciting while at work? Summon a girlfriend to keep you company. Steam WorkShop supported.

name: Stray Path
short_description: Stray Path is an innovative adventure and strategy game that blends FreeCell mechanics with roguelike gameplay. Choose from colourful characters and explore a randomly generated world. Drag cards, optimize your choices, select equipment, and uncover the mysteries of this mysterious stray world!

name: Color Madness
short_description: Color Madness is a side-view game where the player controls a cube that loses its eyesight when moving

name: Mini Star Math: 4 Routes
short_description: Mini Star Math: 4 Routes is a math memorization challenge game with 13 stages.

name: Treefiner
short_description: Treefiner is a short chillmulation game. Use your mouse to purge popups and collect currency. Buy upgrades to get deeper in the loop and refine your skill tree to crack the game.

name: THE DEEPWATCH
short_description: As the head of security, you will decide the fate of those who try to enter the underwater colony. Among the hundreds of arrivals, you may encounter dangerous criminals, spies, and the infected. You will decide who lives here, who is banished, and who is eliminated.

name: Undead Desert Massacre
short_description: Venture through a wasteland desert killing zombies and military units as you progress on your journey to close the source of infection and free the cities swamped by the desert from its unwanted inhabitants.

name: STAR WARS™: Episode I: Jedi Power Battles™
short_description: Take back the Theed Royal Palace in this fast and furious lightsaber action game. You will have the power of the Force and your trusty lightsaber to help you ward off legions of battle droids, destroyer droids, assassins, and other creatures from Star Wars: The Phantom Menace.

name: Interstate 35
short_description: A visual novel exploring a near-apocalyptic vision of North Texas, told through the poetic words of a young woman going home.

name: Virtual Campus
short_description: This is a first-person VR campus simulator where you can roam around the campus at night and cause some chaos.

name: Catechumen
short_description: 171 A.D., a great evil lurks in the shadows of ancient Rome. Face demons and beasts of unspeakable horror. Follow your divine quest through the catacombs and unravel an engrossing tale that tests you against the profane and unholy, stepping into the legacy of a Guardian of Truth.

name: Abeline Rush
short_description: A scream at night and you'll take flight on this Single-player Fantasy Action Adventure through a mystical castle filled with monsters, mystery, and giant bosses. Can you force your way to the top and foil the villain's plot?

name: I Can't Handle My Body
short_description: Embark on a poignant journey with Jung Eun Yi, a fairy drone toy that gains consciousness and the ability to feel pain. Help her escape the harsh human world and find peace through the fireplace.

name: One Room Dungeon
short_description: A roguelike team builder, auto-battler meets inventory management, where you are a little dungeon keeper who has to fit minions, artifacts, and items in a very tidy way in his tiny one-room dungeon to empower himself to protect the dungeon from the raiding adventurers.

name: 春の音はまるで君に似てて
short_description: 「春の音はまるで君に似てて」は暗い夜、道に迷ったような時期に悩んでいた主人公、相原愛理が偶然蒼の歌声を聞くようになり、二人の物語が始まります。日本の女学校を背景とし、少女と少女が出会い、お互いを通して自分が進みたい道を見つけ、一歩、また一歩踏み出していく、成長と恋の過程を込めた「ゆり」キネティックノーベルです。

name: Prism: Master Tape
short_description: This is a dystopian soft sci-fi game. One day, you and your family received a flyer from the community to watch a movie for free. Your family has already set off, and you arrived later – but you find out that they are not there. After that, you discover the untold secrets of the medium of 'video'.

name: 恶魔的房间 The Demon's Room
short_description: 《The Demon's Room》is a horror suspense interactive video game. Players need to establish a good feeling with the characters, and the plot triggers and selects to influence the story. The game contains many ways of playing. With the deepening of the plot, players can unlock 11 story endings.

name: Legends of Savvarah: Children of the Sun
short_description: A fantasy interactive story (visual novel) where the mysteries of ancient gods, enigmas of bygone eras, magic, and the complex relationships between various beings are intricately woven together.

name: Find The Flaw
short_description: 'Find The Flaw' redefines the traditional spot-the-differences genre with a fresh, polished approach. Experience nice 3D isometric environments, accompanied by meticulously crafted ambient music.

name: The Ultimate Gate
short_description: Look around… there's a door. Light outside; inside, You await. Obviously, it's a room. A lock on the door, and a key to find, no doubt that's the rule. A door, a room, a lock, a key, and most importantly - You. What are you waiting for? It's the time to ESCAPE! Isn’t that the TRUTH you seek for?

name: Relaxing Fields
short_description: A short, simple and relaxing idle game where you grow crops, build homes for farmers, and earn money to decorate.

name: Agent Fall
short_description: Agent Fall is an action game inspired by classic titles, where you face an intergalactic government conspiracy. With aliens siding with the government, you, as an agent, must take down this dark alliance. Prepare for frantic combat, with powerful weapons, relentless enemies, and epic bosses.

name: My Sticker Zoo
short_description: My Sticker Zoo is a relaxing strategy and puzzle game where you build your own zoo. Construct impressive habitats for your sticker animals by placing tiles. Manage a variety of wildlife parks as you unlock new scenario's. Collect all the stars, set new high-scores and become an expert ranger!

name: Danger Horizon
short_description: Danger Horizon is a multiplayer, first-person shooter game made using Unreal Engine 5. The game features realistic gunplay, and advanced blood and gore features that everyone can enjoy.

name: 4番線 | Platform 4
short_description: The sequel to the acclaimed anomaly-finding games 'Nibansen' and 'Sanbansen' has finally arrived! Find the pattern and escape if an anomaly occurs in the mysterious homage-inspired escape game 'Platform 4,' where you journey from a repeating station to the airport.

name: Builders of Egypt
short_description: Builders of Egypt is a city-building economic strategy taking place in the Nile Valley. Immerse yourself in a world full of pyramids, where you will become a part of the ancient world. Create history, be history!

name: Sister's Curriculum After Story
short_description: The Story of Tutoring Top 1% Repeat Students Sisters, After.

name: Idle Grid
short_description: Build and optimize your industrial empire in this grid-based idle game. Place factories, power plants, and research labs strategically to maximize efficiency through adjacency bonuses. Upgrade your buildings, manage power consumption, and watch your profits soar while you're away.

name: Triptych Book I: Blockhead
short_description: Triptych Book I: Blockhead is a graphical adventure set in an alternate version of World War One with simple point and click interface, easy to use controls & rip-roaring adventure in the skies!

name: The Madness
