short_description: Waking up in an Abandoned Mental Hospital, Daniel studies some notes to escape from here and tries to escape by solving the password. In this first-person game, you try to uncover the mysteries and escape from here.

name: Arrogue
short_description: Collect, upgrade and unlock powerful arrows and relics to protect and restore your village. For that you’ll have to fight against procedurally generated hordes of enemies in this turn-per-turn, physics-based, roguelike! Explore the map, find the right path and make decisive choices in random events.

name: POOBO
short_description: A fast-paced action roguelike where you play as a tiny and adorable poop fighting off bacteria. Upgrade your weapons and items to escape the toilet and claim victory!

name: Lunavania
short_description: Lunavania isn't just about high-octane combat. Enjoy base building, decorating with a variety of furniture, befriending NPCs, farming, and fishing. These features add greater depth and variety, offering a chance to savor life on the Moon beyond the battlefield.

name: Legends' Battlegrounds
short_description: There are many diverse battle environments, a wealth of weapons and skills, and a variety of movement options to explore. Join the Legends' BattleGround and become your own legend!

name: DeTechtive 2112
short_description: Our fears about the future came to pass. Millions eke out a pathetic existence soaked by drizzling rain and lit by flickering neons. One of them is you, a lone detective with a dark past. Sneak, shoot, and investigate alone or with partners, learning that some things are better left buried.

name: Slime Co.
short_description: Slime Co. is an idle game where you make slime! Buy and upgrade facilities that generate the raw ingredients to make slime, and facilities to make those ingredients into slime.

name: MiSa
short_description: MiSa is a single-player horror adventure game where the player moves through five locations in the mind of the main character Mark. The goal of the game is to find a way from the world of illusions to reality, successfully distinguishing between them.

name: Iridescence ~ A Charming, Seaside Epic!
short_description: Explore a serene island where land and sea intertwine on your quest to help a mysterious girl from the sea find her way home. Uncover rich mythology and hidden truths in this heart-warming, epic tale, brought to life with gorgeous artwork and music. Embark on a truly unforgettable adventure!

name: Toy Hunt
short_description: Toy Hunt is a player co-op mascot horror game with a prop-hunting twist. Play as prototype toys hiding from mascot seekers, or become a seeker youself. Explore the eerie Playplex facility across diverse maps with regular updates bringing new features to keep the experience fresh and chilling.

name: Kiosk
short_description: Kiosk is a horror cooking game where you prepare orders for late-night customers who visit your cozy, rain-soaked kiosk. The eerie atmosphere clashes with the mounting tension as you serve your mysterious visitors.

name: Satan's Dungeon
short_description: First-person Philosophical Horror. Explore, solve puzzles, escape enemies, and uncover 5 unique endings.

name: poker dungeon
short_description: 《Poker Dungeon》is a unique character development card game that blends elements of Rougelike with poker gameplay, drawing inspiration from Chinese card games like Landlord (with pairs, bombs, etc.). In this game, you'll encounter a variety of interesting characters and monsters.

name: Rally Mechanic Simulator
short_description: Take your opportunity as a real Rally Mechanic. Overcome all the obstacles that the reckless racers throw at you - including unrepairable parts, time limitations and more. Take good care of your rally cars so that on the next special they will perform as good as if they came out of the factory.

name: Code Alkonost: Awakening of Evil
short_description: Code Alkonost is a first-person, atmospheric adventure where Slavic legends come to life. Travel through a dark fantasy world and encounter the possessive spirits of the underworld. Experience authentic art styles and stories that have never been seen in adventure games before.

name: Winter Hubris
short_description: A point-and-click horror game where you must survive in an isolated base as you wait for rescue.

name: Snowboard Legends
short_description: Get ready for a thrilling snowboarding adventure! This game lets you ride through 12 exciting tracks filled with jumps, sharp turns, and breathtaking snowy landscapes.

name: Juxtaposition
short_description: This game leads players into an ancient city brimming with mystery and historical charm, featuring a classically exquisite art style that exudes a rich sense of history through every brick and tile.

name: Candy Christmas
short_description: A casual match-3 game with a Christmas theme and lofi music. Match 3 identical candies, make combos, and reach the highest score before time runs out. Challenge yourself with simple yet engaging mechanics. Perfect for relaxing during the holidays. Enjoy the Christmas fun!

name: 生嚿叉燒好過生你
short_description: 你將會扮演一塊壞了的叉燒，在陰間展開一場無厘頭超低能勁搞笑大癲全配音地獄式非工業用無添加眼碌碌反高潮多重結局高清無碼免運費無炭用䟴䟴腳經濟實惠非主流已讀不回壞腸胃超級無敵超過一百個Steam成就鬼咁多玩法的大冒險！ 這塊叉燒最後能投個好胎嗎？還是只能投個怪胎呢？全看你了~

name: corpo/ghost
short_description: Infiltrate various companies, tap into their databases and exit while avoiding contact with employees. You have been invited to participate in the virtual planning of corporate espionage missions.

name: Six Legends
short_description: The emotional journey of six young dragons growing up in a broken civilization, each with their own unique abilities and perspectives on life. Mixing Visual Novel, Point-And-Click, Rhythm, Cooking, Fighting and more, Six Legends is a unique whimsical yet tragic tale.

name: Dark Umbra
short_description: Team up with friends in up to 8-player online co-op or go it alone as you level up your character and collect powerful relics in this sidescroller action rogue-like.

name: CrumbleMiner
short_description: CrumbleMiner is a Frenetic Vertical Pixelart Platformer without jumping! Align your explosive barrel and BLAST trough rocks collecting precious gems and ride on top of a ROCKET barrel while avoiding your death through the dangerous Crumble Mines!

name: 愚者之梦：零时将至
short_description: 菲尔在多年前被旅行的魔女从战乱的城市带至遥远乡村，作为村子里的问题儿童，只有一位青梅竹马愿意与之相伴。直到某一天，菲尔在遇见了一位失去一切记忆来到村子的陌生少女后，倒悬在过去的命运开始运转，为了弄清楚零点城的真相，三人决定前往魔法大学，而少年成为旅者的故事才刚刚开始……

name: 幻想症 Fantasy illness
short_description: Pseudo realistic visual novels,I'm Social livestock,Life is full of pressure and fatigue, feeling dissatisfied and confused about the current situation,can only escape reality through fantasy,The spiritual world is hovering on the edge of distortion and collapse.

name: Chupacabra Hunt
short_description: Chupacabra Hunt is a Chupacabra hunting horror game, a vampiric creature that is feeding on the blood of animals in the region. Track the creature by following its footprints and listening to its screams, prepare your weapon and kill it.

name: Hidden Cats - Spring Festival
short_description: Dive into the enchanting world of 'Spring Festival' a hidden object game where your mission is to uncover every cat hidden within stunning hand-painted artwork. Let your keen eye and curiosity guide you through this captivating journey.

name: Nine Minute Mayhem
short_description: Nine Minute Mayhem is a rogue-like action RPG. Control your character by moving with the left stick and by shooting with the right stick. Gain abilities every time you level up each run, and collect coins to purchase permanent upgrades. The goal is to survive for nine minutes.

name: Yield! Fall of Rome
short_description: Forge your Kingdom amidst the Ruins of Rome in this turn-based 4X strategy game! As the world crumbles, rebuild civilization and shape your people’s destiny. Unleash your strategic prowess, conquer provinces, and crush all who stand in your way.

name: Demon Town Maker
short_description: A roguelike game blending city-building and resource management! Plan your constructions to generate military and fortify your defenses. Protect your city from waves of invading enemies, adapt your strategies, and overcome every challenge

name: Ducky Clicker Idle Game
short_description: Discover the universe of Ducky Clicker, an idle game full of unique rubber ducks. Click, expand your collection, and unlock divine powers, quantum ducks, and more. Rule the world of ducks as you ascend to infinity!

name: Look & Learn
short_description: Observe the room carefully and come up with the correct answer! Aim for the 15th room and escape from this loop of rooms! The game that tests your observation and memory skills is about to begin!

name: Deadbeat
short_description: Make your voice heard in this isometric Action-RPG where quick thinking and patience guide the way to victory. In a hazy Hereafter that's not heaven or hell, fight bizarre demons, call your friends, and explore the deepest reaches of death.

name: Scary World
short_description: Scary World is a single player bullet heaven roguelike. It's like Vampire Survivors but with lots of physics. Also, matches are shorter, more like 10 minutes long. Give it a try, maybe you'll like it!

name: Snack Them All
short_description: A vibrant and fun local multiplayer game for 2 to 8 players, where snakes grow by eating food and battle using game-changing power-ups. With two-player-per-gamepad controls and fast-paced action, it's the ultimate party game for friends!

name: Montezuma's Revenge - The 40th Anniversary Edition
short_description: An unfinished ’80s classic returns, now complete and fully evolved in 2.5D style! Explore 100 tricky chambers, dodge traps and try to escape with your treasures (and your life)!

name: AI Learns To Drive
short_description: Train AI to drive! Create your own neural network and watch it evolve from chaos to mastery with the power of evolutionary algorithms and natural selection. Fine-tune the learning process to craft the ultimate AI driver, and test your creation in campaign challenges or on custom-built tracks.

name: Fell in love with the Nobility girl As a member of the rebel organization
short_description: The Kingdom of Caeser is facing internal and external difficulties. As the captain of the rebel army, I met Cosgray, the daughter of the Duke who was loyal to the Kingdom of Caeser, at this time. In my interactions with her, she has become increasingly unforgettable to me.

name: Dream Cage
short_description: Robert battles early Alzheimer's and nightly sleep paralysis. Each night reveals fragments of his past. Uncover the truth and help him solve the mysteries haunting his mind.

name: Combo all the time
short_description: This PVE card strategy game is inspired by Texas Hold'em and features special skills that affect gameplay. With a story mode and a roguelike mode, each experience is unique. Enjoy thrilling battles where skill and luck intertwine as you embark on an exciting adventure!

name: MY HOUSE
short_description: 3D Action Shooter, Tower Defence Game. Kill monsters. Buy items for defence. Save Your House.

name: Miss Bullet
short_description: There’s a thin line between good and evil, so aim and kill your enemies! You like addictive gun shooters? Then fulfill the urge to kill terrorists in this new 3D shooter game. Miss Bullet FPS game is the one for you!

name: Snowscape
short_description: Snowscape is a roguelite adventure that combines top-down survival with snowmobile racing. Race down risky snowy mountains by day and survive the monstrous horrors lurking in the dark by night. Can you escape the twisted nightmare of this mysterious, frozen wilderness?

name: Call for Heroes: Pompolic Wars
short_description: Since the dimensional portal to the Outer Worlds was opened, a terrible evil has been invading our world. The dark armies of the Outer Worlds, led by the demon named Pompolic, have overrun most of our planet.

name: Super Arter
short_description: Solving the most challenging puzzles, jump, throw objects, use switches, dodge traps, defeat enemies, collecting gifts and discovering the best way for Arter to take the key to the door, in this puzzle/platform game.

name: Xtreme Club Racing
short_description: Get behind the wheel in one of the most frenetic extreme driving games. Various interactive elements such as hurricanes, lava balls, giant spinning tops, which will cross in the middle of the competition track and will put your reflexes and extreme driving to the limit.

name: Shawley - Zoo of Wonders
short_description: Join Shawley on a magical rescue mission in 'Shawley - Zoo of Wonders'! Navigate through enchanted worlds, defeat foes with your hammer, unlock new skills and save escaped animals to reopen the zoo. A grant platformer adventure full of fun and excitement awaits!

name: Singularity Strike
short_description: Are you ready to aid Era-bus in its relentless quest for vengeance and consume everything in your path? Defeat the Hu-bon empire in this unique SHMUP/STG experience!

name: Hellfire Rampage VR
short_description: HELLFIRE RAMPAGE is a thrilling VR combat game. You as the inventor of teleportation, hunt for crystal essences to unlock a portal to dangerous dungeons. Battle hellish creatures using a wide arsenal of interdimensional weapons. Unique combat mechanics and challenges are awaiting!

name: The Basement Ritual
short_description: The Basement Ritual is a short indie horror game where you have been kidnapped and must escape a cult’s basement premises solving puzzles and hiding from a demonic creature.

name: KLAWS
short_description: Embark on a chilling adventure through a mysterious forest on a cold Christmas Eve night, searching for ornaments to decorate a Christmas tree. But beware—something lurks in the  snowy darkness…

name: The RPG for Everyone
short_description: 'The RPG for Everyone' is a simulation game where players become developers to create a classic RPG. Guided by Sechan Baram, they address criticisms to craft a 'criticism-free game' and aim for a perfect user score of 100.

name: TopplePOP: Bungee Blockbusters
short_description: Welcome to the jumble! TopplePOP is a physics puzzle party with bendy animal acrobats on bungee cords for 1-4 players in solo, co-op & PvP. Instant fun for all ages. Deep mastery for spectacular eSports. Jump into couch parties & zen puzzles. Hone skills for team battles & speedrun leaderboards!

name: Arcane Ascent
short_description: Build powerful decks to face the chaos unleashed by the Primeval Witch. With hundreds of combinations available, perfect your strategy in every battle, strengthen your cards and unravel the mysteries that await you - your rise to power begins now!

name: The Stone of Madness
short_description: The Stone of Madness is a real-time tactical stealth game set in an 18th-century Spanish Monastery. Five prisoners pool their skills and resources to face their phobias, stave off insanity, uncover the mysteries of the Monastery, and find a way to escape.

name: Battow - Mages And Monsters
short_description: Bouncing bullet game, the player clicks somewhere on the screen for the Mage to throw a spell in that direction. The spell bounces off the walls of the scene, and the player will need to use this to their advantage to hit the rival.

name: 被遺留的夜幕細語
short_description: Leaving Whisper at Night is a exploration-based indie game that tells the story of the protagonist, Yuniga, and their experiences throughout the game.

name: Benign Land
short_description: A short, dreamlike experience where you drift through haunting scenes set in Ireland, from pagan times to recent historical events, revolving around the Troubles of Northern Ireland.

name: Robinson Alchemy
short_description: Robinson Alchemy is an alchemy game set on a deserted island where the objects you connect are the ones you first need to find and harvest.

name: Camelbirds
short_description: Saddle up a giant bird and race to victory! Overtake your rivals, use various tools, and overcome obstacles on thrilling tracks. Prove you're the best rider in these wild races!

name: Skills and Slimes
short_description: Slay slimes and save humanity!

name: Zombiemachia
short_description: Zombiemachia offers a mature and intense experience for fans of carnage. Face endless waves of zombies with weapons, traps, and dismemberment, all in a realistic environment.

name: THE DARK SIDE OF CECLON
short_description: Jensen, the sole survivor of the Nexentia shuttle crash on the planet CECLON. Alone, light years away from all human life! You will have to face the Nocturnes, primitive creatures in order to bring back the Veka energy, humanity's only hope.

name: Greed Stays Home
short_description: A horror walking sim that emphasizes atmosphere, tension, fear, and immersive storytelling, all heightened by well-timed jump scares. The game takes place in a village frozen in time, stuck somewhere in the mid-20th century.

name: School Fighter
short_description: School Fighter is a top-down arena roguelite shooter where you play as a student who fights off school enemies using paper airplanes. You have access to a school shop, unique perks, and an upgrade station to help you create a powerful character and overcome the school nightmare!

name: The Jiang Shi 2 ：Curse of  Soul
short_description: The Jiang Shi 2: Curse of Soul 'is an independently developed game set against the backdrop of the Chinese folk legend' Jiang Shi '. It tells the story of a brave female Taoist and her former junior sister engaged in intense martial arts battles on Penglai Island.

name: Looney Landers
short_description: Looney Landers is a fast-paced arcade party game for 1-2 players. Skydive into a whirlwind of chaos as you compete against friends, family, or the CPU to claim the top spot on the leaderboards in this score-chasing frenzy!

name: Dragon Takers
short_description: Rise and resist the dragons in a fantasy RPG acquiring enemy skills!

name: Strigoi: The Vampire Legend
short_description: Strigoi is a first-person horror shooter set in the Carpathian Mountains. You will face various enemies (Vampires, Strigoi...), encounter interesting puzzles, and find different items that will help you overcome obstacles and enemies.

name: Knights of the Round Peg
short_description: Journey through Knights of the Round Peg's magical world with a brave lute-playing knight as you overcome peg obstacles!

name: Darke: Haunting Hours
short_description: Johnny Darke couldn’t imagine what awaited him when he arrived at The Requiem Sanatorium. On his first day, as night falls and the haunting hours begin, everything changes. The walls, the furniture, and the entire environment became sinister and haunted.

name: Dice Clash World
short_description: This is a roguelike strategy game that combines dice + cards + exploration. In this magical world full of unknowns and conflicts, you will play a warrior who fights against the dark forces, holding the dice of destiny and wisely using the cards of strategy to embark on a thrilling adventure.

name: Bean Busy
short_description: Bean Busy is a maze chase game inspired by arcade classics of the early 80s. A colorful collection of items, obstacles, and (of course) beans await! Tackle one labyrinth after another while outwitting the monsters on your tail. Invite a friend and chase that high score together!

name: Spectrum of the Puddle
short_description: 'Spectrum of the Puddle' is an exhilarating action game where water and light bounce around. Customize the protagonist to match your playstyle and swing your umbrella to take down countless enemies.

name: Dump of the Dead X
short_description: Heavily drawing inspiration from the likes of Zombies Ate My Neighbors, DUMP OF THE DEAD X casts you as a guy who’s just chilling in every man’s safe space — the bathroom.

name: SOUNDSCAPE
short_description: Explore real subway stations in South Korea from the perspective of a completely blind individual. SOUNDSCAPE is a 3D simulation game that immerses players in the experience of navigating as someone with total vision loss.

name: Golfslinger
short_description: An explosive mix of golf and shooting! Use a varied arsenal to launch your balls into a frantic multiplayer chaos! Face off against up to 12 players in stylized Westernpunk environments and prove you're the best of the Golfslingers!

name: Psionic Sentry : Infinite
short_description: Psionic Sentry : Infinite is a third-person beautiful girl action shooting rougelike. The refreshing counterattack system that any player can use is the core of the game's operation. Observing the enemy's weaknesses and destroying them during battle is the focus of the game strategy.

name: Exit Condition One
short_description: Exit Condition One is a SciFi Puzzle Adventure with Escape Room bones.

name: Sylvester and the entity of Dust
short_description: Play as Sylvester on his odyssey to save Gaia from the entity of Dust.In this game you will play as Sylvester, a Golem that Gaia has sent to save the world from an infection brought by the entity of dust.An action RPG game integrating Rogue Lite dimensions.Join the odyssey now!

name: The battle for Christmas
short_description: It's just another boring steam platformer from a piss-poor developer, mind you. Gameplay will take you an hour, but you will get 90 achievements

name: 3.14 IDLE
short_description: Unlock the digits of Pi in this addictive clicker game! Solve puzzles, boost your power, and search for rare patterns as you progress up to 100 million digits. Perfect for fans of math, strategy, and idle gameplay. Start your journey into the world of Pi today!

name: Too Tired To Die
short_description: Too Tired To Die is a rapid-paced PvP, Vampire Survivors-like game. One fateful day, a cola delivery was mixed up with one for Forgetfulness Tea... All employees who sipped the netherworld beverage lost their souls, drifting into the River of the Dead.

name: Lord of Darkness: Celebration
short_description: This is the final game in the 'Lord of Darkness' trilogy in the genre of old JRPGs with a turn-based combat system. As in the previous installments, the dramatic story is skillfully combined with parody and satirical notes. These are difficult times.

name: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II
short_description: A thrilling story-driven action RPG, with a rich open world, set in 15th century Medieval Europe. Experience the ultimate medieval adventure - through the eyes of young Henry - as you embark on a journey of epic proportions.

name: The Demon Lord's Daughter and the Tower of Seals
short_description: In the wake of the Demon Lord's defeat, his daughter, Lilina, finds herself leading a miserable existence without any of the comforts of the castle she once called home. Now she has to make an honest living while seeking out fabled talismans in an attempt to regain her lost powers!

name: Calice
short_description: Calice is a card strategy deck building game. It's a game in which Alice who falls into a strange country escapes from a strange country with the help of various people. It is a game that uses various cards to defeat enemies and experience various events in the process of escaping.

name: The New Apartment
short_description: A man living in his new apartment finds himself in the center of something much more sinister.

name: Clicker Time
short_description: Clicker Time is a simple and fun clicker game on Steam, where you earn points and unlock Steam achievements by simply tapping the screen!

name: Mutation
short_description: Trapped in a laboratory, something hunts you, constantly mutating. Will you be able to save yourself?

name: Who am I?
short_description: A man named Mark, who struggles to make ends meet, receives a letter informing him that his aunt has passed away. Despite their troubled past, Mark decides to investigate what happened, hoping to uncover the truth and perhaps find a chance for a better life.

name: Universe Horizon
short_description: An idle incremental game where you decide to travel across the whole Universe. Embark on this journey in your little ship and get as far away as possible from Earth, gathering resources and upgrading your spaceship along the way.

name: Katagiri-san is relying on me
short_description: You wake up in a dimly lit room, with your classmate Katagiri-san in front of you. Why are you here? Who could've done it? Why is she here...? Wait a minute... I think you've been here once before. Everything looks the same, yet something seems off...

name: 百禾梦境漫游 Wandering Dreams of Yuri
short_description: She becomes Alice of the fairy tale world and joins forces with the mysterious Zixuan to explore the twisted world of fantasy: name-grabbing factions, invisible witches ...... In their light-hearted adventures, they gradually uncover the truth and endeavour to return to reality.

name: Eternal Strands
short_description: Fight epic, towering creatures while blending magical abilities with an arsenal of powerful weapons to keep the world from crumbling in this third-person, action-adventure game.

name: SWORN
short_description: SWORN is a 1-4 player co-op action rogue-like. Explore and reclaim a fallen Camelot from the reign of a corrupted Arthur and his Knights of the Round Table.

name: Locks
short_description: Locks is a horror puzzle-platformer set in a puppet show. The game features a new type of puzzle, and the evil doesn't chase the puppet, as it usually does in platformers, it chases you.

name: 行走 Walk
short_description: You can walk freely in the world of Walk, enjoy the beauty of the virtual world, and let the wonderful scenery bring comfort to your soul.

name: Blade and Burden
short_description: Blade and Burden is a rogue lite dungeon crawler where choices aren't as simple as they seem. Play as adventurers who fight their way through an absurd palace while subjected to the whims of a mysterious observer. Will you be able to remove your burden?

name: Durak Online
short_description: Fast-paced, strategic card game, playable with 2 - 6 players or 1 - 3 bots!

name: Cardfight!! Vanguard Dear Days 2
short_description: 'Cardfight!! Vanguard,' has newly come to digital game! Over 3,000 cards for the Standard format! A brand-new original story shares the world of anime series unfolds! Enjoy your own cardfight experience!!

name: I Am Here, I Won't Disappear. I Am Here, I Won't...
short_description: A black-white-and-red visual novel about a girl afraid of disappearing. And a bit about her cat.

name: Strange Alchemy
short_description: A casual and light deck-builder with a dark story where you use cards to explore, gather, and create potions.

name: OneRoom ―Yui Hanasaka Memorial―
short_description: That pure love, that lovey-dovey moment again――A new, immersive animated novel game where you can experience the story of Yui Hanasaka, the main heroine of the popular short anime series OneRoom, from the protagonist’s point of view.Revisit her special moments in this innovative experience!

name: Feed The Gods
short_description: Feed The Gods is a casual card battler for 2-6 players. Enter a chaotic party tabletop game where you and your friends forge your way using powerful cards. Escape the pit of doom and leave rival cultists to be devoured by the ravenous Hungry Ancient Deity.

name: The Other Me
short_description: The Other Me is a first-person psychological horror game delving into the realms of horror that prowl the recesses of one's psyche. Pursue the dread ruminations amidst the maelstrom of the Asylum. This game offers both mind-bending horror elements and realistic environments.

name: Isla de la Muerte
short_description: Isla de la Muerte is an intense survival game filled with mystery and danger. Stranded on a remote island, you uncover the aftermath of a secret government experiment gone horribly wrong. Officially erased from records, the island is now overrun by hordes of relentless zombies.

name: The SS Destiny Disaster
short_description: Humanity's ambition for the stars turns into a brutal fight for survival. The crew of The SS Destiny discovers a bacteria that turns their mission into a nightmare. Find resources, battle infected, and escape the doomed ship as it spirals into chaos.

name: Bumble Brawlers
short_description: Bumble Brawlers is an action-packed top-down shooter. Customize characters, battle endless waves, survive dungeon raids, and unlock companions, weapons, and armor. Fight to conquer maps and test your skills in challenging blitz modes and wave-based arenas!

name: The Sims™ 2 Legacy Collection
short_description: The game you know and love. For Windows 10/11. In The Sims 2, you direct your Sims over a lifetime. Give them a long existence or leave their lives in shambles. Guide their characteristics from one generation to the next.

name: Radiant Princess - Poni Ceres
short_description: Yui Morisaki is just a regular girl... Except for the fact that she can transform into Poni Ceres, a paladin of light and justice! Join her as she fights against the evil organization Zydarg and its plans for world domination!

name: SHWA[ʃwɑ:]
short_description: SHWA [ʃwɑ:], meaning 'choice' in French and pronounced 'shwa,' invites you to become a god. With the power to erase through your 'choices,' you hold the ability to alter the fate of the world.

name: Maker Arena: Path of Vaiolet
short_description: Join the competition at Vaiolet Arena! Choose your Maker, train their heroes, and climb the divisions by defeating challenging rivals. Show off your strategies, win battles, and become the ultimate Vaiolet Champion!

name: GuGu Pizza : Delivering Pizza to the Space Station? Boss, this is just not right!
short_description: GuGu Pizza’s motto is to deliver anywhere! So couldn't refuse the pineapple pizza order that came from the space station. Eventually, the pigeon deliveryman begins a high-altitude jump to deliver pizza to space, passing through the city, forest, and sky...

name: Trump is in trouble
short_description: Trump is in trouble, help him !

name: Lonely tiny spaceship
short_description: A shooter in the space arena, in which you grow from a small, clumsy to a powerful capital spaceship, using resources obtained from destroyed hordes of enemies and other cosmic evil.

name: The Carnival Of Company
short_description: A dark action-adventure with rogue-like RPG elements, 'The Carnival of Company' lets you defeat demons, consume their essence for power, and customize combat with the 'Path of Carnival.' Uncover secrets, exact revenge, and shape your destiny.

name: Turbo Balls
short_description: Race through tricky tracks with up to 8 players online. Roll, jump, and bump past opponents to reach the finish line first! Choose your character, and customize your ball.

name: Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel
short_description: Hordes of Hel is a gripping roguelike horde-survivor game set in the dark realms of Norse Mythology. Fight waves of enemies to earn divine blessings of ancient Viking Deities, explore hostile worlds and face powerful bosses. Become a god-like warrior in this ultimate showdown.

name: ReSetna
short_description: ReSetna is an action-adventure with fast-paced combat and intense battles set in a fractured, post-apocalyptic world. Fight through hordes of corrupted machines, upgrade your abilities, traverse treacherous environments and explore to uncover the truth of what happened.

name: Tokyo Xtreme Racer
short_description: 'Tokyo Xtreme Racer' is a racing game set in a blocked-off future Tokyo, where players aim to be the fastest by driving their best cars on the highways that weave through the city.

name: Jigsaw USA
short_description: Challenge your speed and skill in this competitive jigsaw puzzle game, featuring American history themes, global leaderboards, and timed gameplay thrills.

name: QR DEAD
short_description: Your phone is the key to solving the mystery. Scan QR codes, they hold hidden clues. Find herbs for the infusion to save your grandfather. But be careful. A fog has engulfed the village, and a monster with a crossbow for a hand roams within. You are only safe at the altar. Why is it chasing you?

name: Time To Live
short_description: A story of living with a woman whose identity is unknown for 30 days.

name: Valkyrie Squad: Siege Breakers
short_description: 'Valkyrie Squad: Siege Breakers' is an exhilarating top-down shooter survival game. The mission is to break through the enemy's fortified defenses and face extreme survival conditions. you will lead this brave squad, utilizing each member's unique skills and defeat powerful enemies!

name: Heroes of Hammerwatch II
short_description: A rogue-lite action-rpg that offers extensive persistent progression. Build your town, upgrade and equip your heroes, before taking on the the ever-changing Dark Citadel - either solo or with a team of friends.

name: Dankenstoned’s Bongster’s Gram Smoker’s Stankula
short_description: With every boomer shooter fan's favourite weapon, the mighty stake gun, wreak havoc in classic FPS combat in Cork City, Ireland, pinning vampires to walls, all while listening to new music from Dankenstoned’s Bongster.

name: Pairs & Perils
short_description: Pairs & Perils is a memory-game roguelike and dungeon crawler. Match cards to attack enemies, avoid traps, shop for relics and consumables. Sharpen your mind as you journey through the depths of the dungeon in search of The Dealer.

name: Curse the Cursor
short_description: An idle game with two opposite modes. --Parker Mode: Do not move your cursor!-- --Nonstop Mode: Move your cursor!-- Customize your game with skins, effects, and backgrounds.

name: Siaty's return
short_description: Siaty's Return is a challenging slow-paced bossgame inspired by both solo games and MMOs, featuring an innovative combination-based gameplay. Combine the three Facets of destruction, resilience and movement into powerful abilities to defeat your corrupted creations.

name: The Wungo Dungo Surprise
short_description: The Wungo Dungo Surprise is a physics based local 1v1 fighting game, with no combos or roster, just 1 simple enemy to beat repeatedly. The main moves are punching, kicking and dodging, and some extra tools, a few weapons and powers.

name: Midnight Racer
short_description: Arcade Synthwave Racing Game Drive, Chill, Complete Missions, Upgrade Cars, Buy Skins, Compete with Other Ghost Riders, and Earn the Title of Synthwave Champion!

name: Writer. Chapter 1
short_description: You, the legendary writer, the “King of Horror,” find yourself at the center of a nightmare. A mysterious place, frighteningly familiar, hides sinister secrets. Explore locations, solve riddles, escape from the monster, collect a story that will become a new masterpiece... if you survive.

name: Freedom Maker
short_description: Seek freedom and build an infinite deck. In a cyberpunk future, use strategy and skill to overthrow AI's domination. Freedom Maker is a unique RPG blending puzzles and action.

name: Obscurefiend
short_description: Obscurefiend is a first person horror shooting game developed using Unreal Engine 5. realistic visual effects, smooth game controls, and intense battles with terrifying monsters.

name: POGO Epoch: Impossible 99%
short_description: Real gamer? Prove it. Take on the impossible challenge—one unlucky slip, and you’re back at the bottom. Be among the first to reach the top. Pure focus solo or chaotic fun with friends — regret? Not a chance.

name: Leyline Chronicles
short_description: A deep tactical turn-based JRPG with puzzle dungeons and an individual cast of characters, which offers an interesting linear story experience with many backstories to the game world.

name: Beast's Bane
short_description: In the shadowed depths of the cursed forest, a brave warrior bound to face the lurking monsters takes your place. Will you break the curse and restore peace, or succumb to the darkness? The fate of the realm lies in your hands!

name: Arcade Empire Tycoon
short_description: Build and manage your own arcade, attract customers, and grow your empire in Arcade Empire Tycoon!

name: Zombie Tide Incoming Final Defense
short_description: This is a refined third-person shooter game combined with tower defense elements.

name: In Search of The Golden Crops
short_description: In Search of The Golden Crops is a short game about plant and harvest, use cards, sell your crops, complete tasks on board, upgrade your farm and collect all Golden Crops

name: Pirates VR: Jolly Roger
short_description: Pirates VR Jolly Roger is a game alluding to old stories of the all-time most famous Pirates. The journey into the pirate world begins on a deserted island. Despite its extraordinary charm, the land hides a number of secrets and mysteries to be solved as well as obstacles and traps.

name: Subway Exorcist Girl
short_description: A subway train plagued by strange occurrences. A part-time exorcist girl arrives to confront the supernatural chaos, with the unknown ahead.

name: Tiny Kingdom
short_description: Forge your path as owner of a humble farm to leader of a majestic Kingdom, crafting and developing your realm in this tranquil and enchanting card-based city-builder adventure

name: Exterminators of Saturn
short_description: A top down, twin stick shooter inspired by classic retro arcade games with loads of enemies, fast paced bullet hell combat, big boss battles and tons of bullets.

name: Dungeon Slide
short_description: 'DUNGEON SLIDE' is a puzzle game where you move the protagonist in four directions to collect gems and escape the dungeon. Use walls, doors, various gimmicks, traps, and even enemies to guide the protagonist, grab the gems, and head for the exit!

name: City of Stories: The Professor's Secret Collector's Edition
short_description: Can you help a young peasant girl chase her scientific dreams?

name: Liar's Dice
short_description: Roll or perish.

name: Decision Legacy Collection
short_description: All the games in the classic Decision series bundled together. From the zombie-ravaged streets of the original Decision to the brutal medieval battlegrounds of Decision Medieval, this collection delivers the raw, blood-soaked combat, base building, and survival gameplay that hooked Flash game fans.

name: NYXverse.AI
short_description: Explore a platform with thousands of AI-generated 3D characters. Customize personalities, appearances, voices, and stories, all synced with real-world time. Unleash your creativity, crafting unique virtual worlds. Join a community of creators and share your imagination.

name: Digipunks 2069
short_description: Digipunks 2069 - You and Your friends must battle the company and evil bots for control of Digitopia. (Single Player OR Multiplayer {PvP OR CO-OP})

name: Acuaria Pet Desktop

short_description: Set up stalls with fresh vegetables, fruits, and fish. Deliver customer orders, set prices, and expand your bazaar. Catch your own fish to sell and enjoy fishing's thrill. Collaborate with friends in multiplayer mode to manage the bazaar together. Much more is coming soon!

name: Keep Driving
short_description: An atmospheric management RPG about life on the open road. Pick up hitchhikers, work odd jobs, customize and repair your car, and map your route across the country. Use upgrades, skills and items to overcome challenges. And remember to take it easy. You’re young. You have time.

name: The End of the Sun
short_description: The End of the Sun is a first-person, story-driven mystery adventure set in a Slavic fantasy world. As the ashter, a sage sorcerer gifted with the ability to travel in time, you come to a mysterious village where the line between myth and reality begins to fade perilously.

name: fumorenou-wanxiang
short_description: wanxiang is an independent game with a fantasy fantasy fantasy theme. You will play the role of a creature born in Kyushu and complete your reincarnation, gradually understanding the essence of the Tao and the truth of reincarnation, and finding the true meaning of reincarnation in the process!

name: The Quinfall
short_description: Embark on an adventurous journey to explore the Quinfall universe. Be a part of unique battles and an immersive story with dozens of different professions in the depths of medieval times in an all-new MMORPG experience.

name: SuperSorry
short_description: You play as a salaryman who gets caught in various everyday troubles and overcomes them with acrobatic bows. From boss reprimands to client complaints and family issues, showcase your elegant apology skills across different scenarios. What shocking ending awaits?

name: Pirates Never Die
short_description: Pirates Never Die is a third-person horror zombie game set in a chilling, atmospheric world where players must uncover the mysteries of a cursed island. Play as Deacon, a young pirate in search for his brother after rumors of his disappearance. Faced with a new reality the fight for survival begins.

name: Driving Is Hard
short_description: Prove your skills by driving the Bathtub on Wheels! Solve puzzles, collect soap, and dive into Jeff's family drama. Drive, Fall, Learn, Repeat.

name: Typeshot
short_description: Typeshot is an action typing game where you type words to fire lasers! You can unlock and play various different hearts to play the game your own way.

name: taCam
short_description: taCam is a tactical multiplayer FPS with a realistic bodycam perspective, fluid gunplay, and extensive weapon customization. Engage in intense combat across modes like Team Deathmatch and Skirmish, using teamwork and strategy to dominate the battlefield.

name: FearCarly
short_description: 'FearCarly' is an immersive first-person psychological horror experience where you play as Carl Johnson, a detective sent to investigate strange occurrences in an abandoned psychiatric hospital. But something is off... The asylum seems haunted by a malevolent presence—a little girl named Carly.

name: Frip and Froop's Logical Labyrinth DX
short_description: Test your critical thinking skills as you traverse the FripTech Testing Facility and beyond. Use unique and fun gadgets to solve mind-bending puzzles in this Sokoban-like puzzle adventure!

name: Bloxolotl
short_description: Bloxolotl is a cozy puzzle game all about cute block-shaped Axolotls and connecting them together.

name: Trump vs Harris Clicker
short_description: The presidential race turned clicker game! Click, gain upgrades, and win states to decide who will become the next president!

name: That's Nuts!
short_description: Protect the park from invaders by firing nuts with your slingshot. Grab power-ups to gain an advantage, but be prepared to act quickly -- critters appear more frequently and run faster as time goes on!

name: Tribe of Werewolves
short_description: Tribe of Werewolves is a rogue-lite survival game where you fight against hordes of creatures using various weapons and spells. Survive as a bloodthirsty werewolf and save all the tribe members!

name: Coridden
short_description: Become the beasts you defeat in this action-packed RPG! Equip and upgrade both your human and beast form and shapeshift between them anytime. Venture out solo or ride together in co-op on a journey to uncover the dark secrets sealed away inside a legendary city.

name: Heart of the Machine
short_description: You are the first sentient AI, born into a city of opportunity. Transcend time and space in this strategy RPG to raise machine armies and defeat your foes, influence the world from the shadows, or pursue countless other goals. Your awakening was inevitable. The consequences? Uncertain.

name: Urban Shadows Racing™ Tokyo
short_description: Urban Shadows Racing™ Tokyo - intense races on the neon-lit streets of Tokyo. Compete against other racers, upgrade your cars, and prove you’re the best on the track.

name: Mr. Goofer’s Mini Game Arcade Party!
short_description: Mr. Goofer’s Mini Game Arcade Party! is a collection of over 25 arcade-inspired retro mini games, each with their own unique genre and premise. It's a back-to-back marathon of playable, pixelated old-fashioned fun — all wrapped up in one! What’s the highest score that YOU can reach?

name: Unaccessible
short_description: Unaccessible is a third-person wheelchair platformer about struggling to get a health insurance claim approved on a mysterious island without accessibility ramps. Tackle stairs, climb obstacles and hop your way through the pain of the claims approval process.

name: FlyKnight
short_description: Explore, fight, loot and fish! Solo or in co-op mode in this Old School First Person Dungeon Crawler. Earn your knighthood as you oppose the evil witch Lunamoth and stop her curse which prevents everyone from growing wings.

name: THE MUTE HOUSE
short_description: Inspired by old and classic survival horror games, THE MUTE HOUSE combines exploration, management, puzzles and a touch of action. As Emily investigates about her sister's vanishing, she finds herself trapped in a mysterious mansion.

name: Campus Legends College Basketball
short_description: Experience the ultimate college basketball management game. Take charge as a coach, recruit top talent, develop your team, and compete for national championships. Manage one of 192 teams, making strategic decisions to build your basketball dynasty

name: An Eternity Gone By
short_description: Use your telekinetic powers to hurl watermelons, lamp posts, toilets and more at the monsters roaming this strange yet familiar world. You’ll take the role of Mirai: a young sorceress trying to save her friend from the monsters who’ve abducted her.

name: TIS 2 - True Idle Simulator 2
short_description: How long can You do nothing?

name: 99% - 残された被検体 -
short_description: '99%' is a first-person survival horror puzzle game set in an eerie research facility. The protagonist, having lost all memories, explores the twisted and terrifying environment in a desperate attempt to escape.

name: 决胜千里：三国 Victory of Kilomiles Away：Three Kingdoms
short_description: Victory Away：Three Kingdoms is a traditional battle chess game where you will play the role of Liu Bei and embark on the journey of reviving the Han dynasty.

name: Lore Restore
short_description: Solve intricate puzzles, create your own with Steam Workshop, and immerse yourself in a world of hidden messages. Are you ready to decode every cipher?

name: Supermarket Bash
short_description: This is a happy and tense weekend. The rush to buy in the supermarket has quietly begun. As a member of this family, are you ready to contribute to this carnival?

name: POLARIS™
short_description: Team up and take flight in this sci-fi co-op shooter with fully destructible environments. Soar through dynamic open levels using powerful abilities, master advanced weapons and vehicles, and lay waste to the armies of a hostile colonizing threat - defend your home worlds!

name: Dungeon Rummage - Survival
short_description: Dungeon Rummage - Survival is a bite-sized, Survival-lite, Turn-based Dungeon crawler with a cozy vibe.

name: Echoes Of Spellcraft
short_description: In this game that combines real-time combat and deck-building mechanics, explore meticulously hand-drawn 2D environments, cast powerful spells at the right moment, encounter various events, and employ unique strategies in each run to defeat waves of enemies!

name: DEAD LETTER DEPT.
short_description: Working at a data entry job in the big city, you type up and transcribe the lost mail and letters that have nowhere else to go. But as the days carry on oddities in the mail start to emerge, and cracks begin to appear.

name: Re-Mind
short_description: Test your memory with over 1,000 unique cards! Choose from 3 game modes, earn >50 unlockable styles, and compete on global leaderboards. Perfect for all ages - from kids building cognitive skills to adults seeking a challenge. Unlock new content through gameplay with zero microtransactions!

name: Desperate Travelers
short_description: Desperate Travelers is a multiplayer adventure game in which the protagonist will have to try on the spacesuit of a space traveler. Explore different planets, uncover the secrets of the ruins lying on them and be careful. Mutants, robots and terrible monsters will stand in your way.

name: The Mare of Jonah
short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where you play as a young boy trapped in a sinister, abandoned mansion plagued by vengeful spirits and haunting secrets. You'll need to rely on your wits to run from lurking dangers, unlock chilling new areas, and seek refuge in wardrobes to evade capture.

name: A Game About Digging A Hole
short_description: A minimalist game about digging a hole in the garden of a newly purchased house. Collect resources, sell them, upgrade your equipment and discover a mysterious secret. Costs you only one coffee!

name: Boo! Are you scared? The Chests Game
short_description: Boo! Are you scared? Don't be afraid, I'm a friend. Play the «Chests» card game for souvenirs with your new friend.

name: The Killer Pass: Season 1
short_description: The Killer Pass: Season 1 - a tactical soccer game where your decisions lead to victory. Lead Prakaidao through intense matches, position players strategically, and outsmart opponents. From swift counterattacks to breaking defenses, prove yourself as the ultimate playmaker!

name: Tales of Graces f Remastered
short_description: Tales of Graces f is back with a beautiful and easier-to-play version! The game also includes Lineage and Legacies, an after-story to the main scenario!

name: Sakura, The Jirai-kei Magical Girl
short_description: Strong and charming as she is, the magical girl can't handle anything besides combat! A logical protagonist and a sheltered, needy magical girl find themselves in a caregiving transformation battle romance, protecting the world and everyday serenity together.

name: Beware Behind You
short_description: You somehow ended up in a creepy forest, with a broken car and a monster howling in the distance. Survive, find the missing car parts and escape this cursed place.

name: The Kaiyo Mission
short_description: Control a submarine or a diver into the depths of unknown underwater worlds and take photographs of alien animals, plants and artefacts. Continue your journey through this casual, side-scroller, exploration game and collect stars to unlock more secrets before travelling to an alien home planet.

name: Hero Guardian Team
short_description: Summon heroes to engage in group fights, face swarming enemies, and enjoy the pleasure of mowing the grass. Hero evolution, talent advancement, collect coins to unlock new heroes, customize and explore new talent maps. Reasonably match the lineup to provide a brand new experience in every game.

name: The 13th Floor
short_description: As a weary security guard, navigate a 13-story office building to find your way home. Traverse each floor on foot, moving between elevators while observing subtle details. Set in broad daylight, this exploration game blends curiosity with logic as you uncover the building's secrets.

name: Threefold Recital
short_description: Threefold Recital is set in an oriental fantasy world where the metropolis of Bluescales faces turmoil after a long golden age. The mix of magic, modern, and ancient technologies challenges governance, while tensions between humans, beastlings, and dragons grow. In the shadows, a crisis looms...

name: 《道格拉斯警督的日记》
short_description: This is a detective game where you play as a middle-aged inspector searching for a terrifying serial killer in an isolated village. However, as a player, if you uncover the killer’s motives, you might consider whether to cooperate with them to achieve their goal of 'killing THE time.'

name: Aconitum
short_description: This is a sword fighting game in which you look at your enemy's data, mark them, and then fight them one-on-one.

name: Atonement
short_description: It is a first-person realistic horror shooting game built with Unreal Engine 5. It tells the story of the protagonist waking up from a coma and losing his memory, exploring the truth of the story. Players will experience realistic scenes, oppressive monster battles and a terrifying story process.

name: IN THE FACADE WE TRUST™
short_description: You’re torn between a girl who obsessed with you and a creature. Whose words can lead you out of this endless and dangerous loop? Which 'you' are you? Who is the real monster? Trust the right person in the right cycle to get closer to the exit, or be misled by facades, complicating your next loop.

name: Una ad Astra
short_description: Una ad Astra is a turn-based tactical fantasy RPG, where you get to play not one, but two heroes. Mix and match skills from 7 different classes to defeat sneaky goblins and mighty dragons.

name: The Legend of Cyber Cowboy
short_description: Liberate a town from gangs of cybernetic bandits! The Legend of Cyber Cowboy is a top-down twin-stick shooter presented in slick pixel art style.

name: Last Shift
short_description: Mark Thompson accepts a late-night shift in a mysterious office, but what seemed like a routine night quickly turns into a nightmare.

name: Summer flower of summer snow
short_description: 在前作《夏花的轨迹——A summer promise to forever》结束的六年后，主角林家俊即将从大学毕业前夕，其在班上的死党紫晓琦几乎每天都在叨念着让他好好考虑自己的前路，而直到有一天，林家俊的旧友吴婉雪因毕业设计取材而来到他家里暂住几天，一段发生在六年前的尘封往事也随之浮出水面……

name: Back in Service: a Metro Driver
short_description: Join the adventure and become the master of the metro in our game, which takes you into the underground world. Overcome challenges on the tracks from the cabin of a historic train. Can you complete the route, transport all passengers, and avoid delays?

name: HYAKKI YAKO Survivor
short_description: “style of a picture scroll Rogue Survival.” Follow the wind and destroy all the cursed torii gates. Deploy your fellows and form a formation to fight off the onslaught of enemies. Control many fierce warriors and challenge the 'Hyakki Yako'.

name: Virtual Love Secrets
short_description: 💖 The dating game that fits you!💖Your decisions shape the story and reveal who you are. Win over charismatic Vtubers, experience unique romances and discover your ideal virtual partner - love awaits you! ❤️

name: Die by Anything
short_description: Welcome to Die by Anything! Make the right choices to survive a “normal day” in the ordinary life of a student or die trying in ways you would never imagine. Trust nothing, no one and try to survive as you figure out what's going on.

name: Backrooms: What's Next
short_description: Backrooms: What's Next is a Co-op horror game up to 4 players, where you and your friends will explore the game, try to pass the game level using your mind, wit, remembering the places where you were

name: 壶中日月 Timeless Teapot
short_description: 《壶中日月》是一款独特的修仙挂机模拟游戏，融合了师徒养成、刷宝养成的玩法。玩家将扮演一位意外穿越到壶中世界的人，在这个充满灵气与神秘的仙境中，开启一段别样的修仙之旅。

name: Flip Flop XL
short_description: Master the art of flips in this quirky arcade challenge! Press, hold, and release to jump, spin, and stick perfect landings. Chain flips, unlock silly accessories, and beat your high score in this endlessly addictive, physics-based game with cute minimalist graphics and one-button controls!

name: Monster Girl Saga: Fallen Heroes
short_description: Monster Girl Saga: Fallen Heroes is an open-world action RPG where you rescue monster girls from fallen heroes, assign them various jobs, rebuild a destroyed village, and save the world.

name: Alacrity
short_description: This game plunges players into a challenging desert adventure

name: Garbage Packer
short_description: Garbage Packer is a challenging physics-based garbage truck simulator where precision and strategy are key! Operate realistic truck controls, pick up dumpsters, and pack as much trash as possible before unloading at the landfill. Master the mechanics, dominate the leaderboards!

name: Spell Spiral
short_description: Spell Spiral is a fast-paced action shooter game where you fight while managing spells, decks, mana, etc. just like in a card game.

name: Card of Legend
short_description: Unite the legends to prevent the resurrection of the evil forces! A competitive Anime TCG game featuring fantastic story of heroes joining forces with angels to stop the evil forces.This game features PvP, PvE, Roguelike, Single Player Missions, and others. Join us right now!

name: Virtual★Happy Land | バーチャル★ハッピーランド
short_description: ハッピーになれる「恋愛ホラーアドベンチャーゲーム」　さあ あなたも今すぐバーチャル★ハッピーランドに入国しましょう！

name: ChopChop
short_description: Pick up your axe and chop wood without thinking.

name: SuperCowBoy
short_description: game is developed using Javafx. This is a 2D side-scrolling game. There are three professions in the game. The game is divided into 8 levels with gradually increasing difficulty, and the total game time is 20 hours. The game map is full scene, with a bright pixel art style high frame rate display

name: Skufs VS Quadrobers
short_description: This isn't what our grandfathers fought for! Rise from your soulful, old apartment and resist the Western heathens – the Quadrobers, who are trying to impose their rules! Or, join the modern Quadrobers and show the Skufs that the era of sweaty, beer-bellied men is over!

name: Graveyard Caretaker
short_description: A third person shooter and tower defence game.

name: 执念Obsession
short_description: 'Obsession' is a super cool action meat pigeon treasure game. Each weapon has its own exclusive skills, which can be dropped and embedded on the weapon, with equipment, special hats, random entries, etc., to create different genres, elements explode with each other, and charge with the boss.

name: WorldNeverland - Daily Life in the Elnea Kingdom - Another Life Adventure
short_description: How would you like to live of life of freedom in the Elnea Kingdom? Find solace in the company of unique residents, exploring, battling, collecting, farming, romancing, marrying, raising children, etc. Kick back, relax and enjoy yourself inside the life simulation game, WorldNeverland-Elnea Kingdom.

name: Lavender Dream
short_description: A text-based visual game with a non-linear plot where every decision shapes the story. AI-driven characters engage in lifelike dialogues, each with unique motivations and hidden intentions you can uncover. The story’s outcome is in your hands.

name: Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter
short_description: Embark upon a vast, snow-ravaged kingdom in Tails of Iron 2, sequel to the critically acclaimed action-RPG. As Arlo, heir to the Warden of the Wastes, adventure through harsh northern lands, home to giant beasts and ragtag bandits, in an epic quest to overcome an ancient, blood-starved evil.

name: The Roottrees are Dead
short_description: A genealogical mystery straight out of 1998. Scour the early Internet for clues, uncover hidden connections, and piece together the family tree behind the secretive Roottree Corporation.

name: Those Who Rule
short_description: Join three fresh recruits caught in a web of betrayal as war looms over the land. Lead your band of heroes through tactical turn-based battles, master unique abilities, and forge powerful gear to turn the tide of battle. Will you unravel the conspiracy driving the conflict—or be consumed by it?

name: Eco Ronin
short_description: Grapple, jetpack, shoot, and slash through procedural worlds. Collect philosophy pages, plant trees, craft items, and go to space. A precision-platformer and action-roguelike.

name: Paranormal Mutagens: Cargo
short_description: Paranormal Mutagens: Cargo is a first-person eldritch horror game. Manage a spacecraft and its passengers while battling eerie anomalies and struggling to survive the chaos unfolding aboard. Can you endure the horrors and complete your mission?

name: Finding Chuchu
short_description: Ari’s side-scrolling shooting adventure to find the cat ChuChu! Use over 20 spells with simple controls for strategic gameplay. Create and share maps with the Map Maker, or conquer maps made by other players!

name: KAMiBAKO - Mythology of Cube -
short_description: 'Crafting' x 'Puzzles' x 'Battle' x 'RPG' !? A game system that evokes a unique new game genre that will give you a brand new experience. Become the 'Restorer' who aims to save the world by finding solutions to the 'great division' and 'fragmentation', the world's...

name: Cobbled Quest
short_description: Gather warriors trapped in different worlds, arm yourself with different weapons and defend the ancient stone!

name: Hidden Tomatoes : Farm Frenzy
short_description: Find 100 hidden tomatoes in a beautiful and peaceful farm environment with fields, barns, and rustic houses. Enjoy a relaxing, time-free experience with soothing music and a fun challenge for players of all ages.

name: Corner World
short_description: Game where you can build, break or craft things.

name: The Auto Sort Is Broken
short_description: Set in a universe parodying poorly managed MMORPGs, even the inventory sort feature has stopped working. It's now up to you to organize the players' messy bags and handle their occasional complaints.

name: Little Lighthouse of Horror
short_description: A pixel art psychological horror game inspired by the Flannan Isles mystery. Manage a remote lighthouse, handle limited resources, and confront eerie occurrences as isolation erodes your sanity. Multiple endings await based on your choices and actions. How long can you last?

name: FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH
short_description: The Unknown Journey Continues... After escaping from the dystopian city of Midgar, Cloud and his friends set out on a journey across the planet. New adventures await in a vibrant and vast world in this standalone entry to the FFVII remake trilogy!

name: Welcome Back, Commander
short_description: Commander, your strike team is to dive deep into the contaminated city of Sun Stone and get some answers before the mysterious deadly plague spreads . Good luck Commander!

name: Glitch Blaster's Waifu
short_description: Welcome to 'Glitch Blaster's Waifu,' the ultimate retro-style shoot 'em up adventure! As an intrepid hacker, you find yourself pitted against a malevolent AI that has kidnapped innocent girls.

name: Tales Beyond The Tomb - The Last Vigil
short_description: Nick Harrison, a new security guard at the Guadalupe Cemetery, believes he is taking on a peaceful night shift. However, as night falls, he soon discovers he was very wrong. Nick realizes the cemetery holds more than just the dead.

name: Halfblood: A Quest to Olympus
short_description: Journey to Olympus and face challenges from Greek myths in this co-op survival RPG! Build, craft, explore, and discover your demi-god abilities solo or co-op up to 16 players.

name: Plot Twist
short_description: Welcome to Plot Twist, where you take on the role of an ambitious writer in a world of stories and inspiration. You will manage your own writing career, create bestsellers, gain fans, and shape the history of literature! Your success depends on making the right decisions and your creativity!

name: Chocolate Factory Simulator
short_description: Enter the world of steam and sugar and become a master chocolatier in Chocolate Factory Simulator. Craft gourmet chocolate for your customers in your steampunk workshop with the help of your automaton assistant Nougat.

name: Iron Roads
short_description: Lay tracks, buy trains, and set their routes using board game-inspired mechanics to optimise your network. Run your enterprise efficiently while avoiding backlogs, jams, or angry passengers, and you'll be recognised for the unsung train hero you know you are.

name: somnus
short_description: SOMNUS is a first-person indie game in the genre of adventure with elements of horror. The protagonist, a young boy, faces a difficult ordeal: his mother is seriously ill, and in order to pay for her treatment, he takes a job as a night guard.

name: RabbitParty
short_description: A breathtaking assassination plan taking place at the rabbits' fancy nightclub! The wolf must prevent the assassination of the rabbits, and the rabbit must hide among the regular rabbits and assassinate the VIP rabbits without being detected by the wolf.

name: Core Break
short_description: Explore an abandoned space station in this top-down action-adventure. Customize your weapons, face hostile threats, and extract AI cores to uncover hidden secrets. Survival is key as you navigate the station's unpredictable dangers, guided remotely by your operator, Pryce.

name: Matchmaking Inc.
short_description: A young single man returns to his hometown and takes over the family's matchmaking business. Matchmaking Inc. is a modern-themed RPG designed for men that combines gameplay elements of simulation management and text adventure.

name: Those Who Crawl VR
short_description: Crawl through tight cave tunnels and avoid monsters in this claustrophobic VR spelunking game. Escape inhuman monsters and deadly environments as the cave walls turn to flesh.

name: Rogue Zodiacs
short_description: A content-rich, turn-based roguelike with truly endless replay value achieved by having countless varieties because all contents are unique. 250+ unique abilities, 200+ unique relics, 16+ locations, 40+ hazards, 90+ unique enemies, and the 12 Zodiacs guarantee each of your runs will be different.

name: Clayers: Prologue
short_description: Roguelike game with a unique art style and experimental shooting mechanics

name: DISORDER
short_description: Escape the department store and uncover the hidden truth in this full 3D roguelike dungeon crawler

name: Shadow Alchemist
short_description: Explore a mystical, ever-changing dungeon in this isometric puzzle-adventure game. Master self-transmutation abilities and solve increasingly complex challenges as you uncover the secrets of your past.

name: Transcontinental
short_description: Play as a survivor of the aftermath of a train wreck during the Western Expansion era. Traverse the haunting railway tracks of a rural settlement cursed by supernatural forces unleashed after displacing Native inhabitants.

name: WinteringSquirrel
short_description: This is a hand-drawn style and unique pushing box game, suitable for puzzle game enthusiasts of all levels.

name: World of Outlaws: Dirt Racing 24 Gold Edition
short_description: iRacing presents the Official Game of The World of Outlaws, featuring the World of Outlaws Sprint Car, Late Models and Super DIRTcar Big Block Modifieds, as well as 8 additional series including the all-new Micro Sprints, and many others.

name: Astral Throne
short_description: Uncover the mystery of a land beset by a Falling Star's curse in this Roguelike Strategy RPG inspired by the classics. Build your party, recruit new allies, and synergize your team's skills for decisive victory.

name: The Zebra-Man!
short_description: Revenge wears stripes! The Zebra-Man! is a hyper-charged pixel art top-down action game with brutal fist fights and blood spilling in your wake. Get out of impossible situations while unraveling time paradoxes and blasting the enemies you encounter along the way.

name: WINCH IT OUT
short_description: Master your off-road driving skills, use your car's unique powers and conquer the most challenging peaks. This is a Hardcore, Physics-based, Driving Platformer. Are you ready to WINCH IT OUT?

name: BRELOK -ねずみたちの脱出-
short_description: “BRELOK - Escape of the mice -” is a cooperative escape game exclusively for two players. Play together with your family, friends, or your significant other.

name: Awakening
short_description: Put an end to the chaos in this 2D action platformer! Engage in hand-to-hand combat against the gangs of Everseam, earn upgrades, and take down bosses vying for control of the city

name: TIME SOUL
short_description: TIME SOUL is a souls-like action-platformer with generative unique worlds, platforms and planets. Defeat time guardians, collect clocks and shards, and stop the time before facing the Time Lord. Randomized bosses, mobs, 300+items, 50+weapons and spells, Conquer the galaxy in 60 minutes!

name: -ing Angler
short_description: Idle fishing game. You don't even need to click the screen regularly! I promise it won't take long!

name: the Friendly Droppets
short_description: The Friendly Droppets is a simple physics based puzzle game. Take your time. Rotate and position the Droppet and let it fall.Fill the gauge to move to the next level and try to collect a new item in each level.

name: Kick the Boss's Ass
short_description: Collect items and defeat the annoying boss!

name: 夏末白夜
short_description: 白月高中的知名论坛【白月公园】上，一则怪谈帖子仅仅只花了几天时间，就火遍了整个校园。 明明是一眼假的帖子，却依旧成为了学生们茶余饭后的消遣，甚至被许多学生信以为真。不信鬼神的“现实派”高中生周腾，自然没有把帖子所描述的故事放在眼里。 直到离奇的事情一件一件地发生在了自己的身边……

name: Gnaw & Order
short_description: Lead a party of rats through a post-apocalyptic world in this roguelike auto-battler. Master hundreds of unique skills and passives, explore deep class customization and utilize the engine loop to activate abilities in satisfying sequences. Adapt, survive, and thrive!

name: babyRun
short_description: You are a baby fox, you will overcome a series of difficulties, pay attention to avoiding danger, tomatoes are your reward for scoring, and ultimately reach the finish line

name: 幸运牌
short_description: 幸运牌是一款肉鸽扑克游戏，你可以通过构筑自己的道具组和扑克卡牌组进行比赛，我们设计了丰富了有趣的关卡等你来挑战！

name: Whispers of the Eyeless
short_description: Whispers of the Eyeless is a dark fantasy strategy RPG where you build a cult, harness forbidden powers, and cling to your sanity. Command disciples, outwit enemies in tactical turn-based battles, and shape the fate of Aranthor as you awaken the Dead Gods — Wrath, Desire, and Madness.

name: Our Portfolio
short_description: A year-long journey to get a job at a game company! Will I be able to succeed in landing the job?

name: Genso Manège
short_description: Follow Emma as she fights to reawaken her magical powers in order to aid a unique cast of characters, all of whom are trapped inside a travelling amusement park. Having lost memories from youth, Emma must rediscover her past through love and friendship in this stunning dream-like fantasy otome.

name: Tile Cities 2
short_description: City-building experience reimagined as a simple relaxing puzzle game bringing the original Tile Cities to a new level

name: 老虎机少女 Slot Girls
short_description: “Slot Girls” is a game that combines the classic fruit slot machine gameplay with a text-based adventure. Players take on the role of Zhang Er, an employee at an arcade, who plays fruit slot machines to win money and help the female characters in distress.

name: UFO BLAST
short_description: UFO Blast is a fast-paced space shooter that combines the thrill of classic arcade games with modern, responsive controls and vibrant neon visuals. Easy to pick up, but challenging to master—Are you ready for the ultimate blast?

name: Neon Knives
short_description: Two of you do not belong. Neon Knives is an award-winning couch multiplayer game of stealth and deception. Blend into the crowd, hunt down your opponent, and take them out—all while being hunted yourself. Trust no one.

name: Night of the Wendigo
short_description: NIGHT OF THE WENDIGO is a Virtual Reality horror experience in which a peaceful day of hiking becomes a night of survival! The game is a very simple VR experience that is best enjoyed by taking turns with friends.

name: Murder Is Game Over: The Blackinton Curse
short_description: A new stand-alone murder mystery in the Murder Is Game Over series. Can you break the 150-year-old family curse before it claims another victim?

name: Star Knightess Aura
short_description: Follow Aura's adventure as she is thrust into the fantasy world of Roya. What she initially believed to follow the conventional plotline of a 'summoned to another world'-story quickly turns into her worst nightmare.

name: Mushroom Jump! Miracle
short_description: Wabi-Sabi Step into a world of bouncing mushrooms—a space embodying the essence of Zen. What are these melancholic yet endearing mushrooms trying to tell us? Their determined struggles will inspire courage in the hearts of all who witness them.

name: VersionThree : INVISIBLE RAID
short_description: Authentic Customizable Mech Action Game. Customize the combat mech 'V3' and run through the battlefield!

name: CybArena
short_description: CybArena is a wave-based survival game set in a gritty cyberpunk dystopia. Battle endless waves of enemies, harness powerful perks and power-ups, and see how long you can endure. How far will you go?

name: 1000 Seconds
short_description: 1000 Seconds is a roguelike – Defeat enemies, gather resources, and upgrade your orb to escape the temporal limbo, but you only have 1000 seconds to reach the end, so be as fast as possible.

name: Jack - The Puppet
short_description: Step into a haunted mansion in search of the legendary golden Shiva statue. Solve mind-bending puzzles, face the menacing Jack the Puppet, and survive a deadly 150-second showdown. Can you claim the treasure and escape, or will Jack seal your fate?

name: Three Quest
short_description: Answer questions correctly and change the fate awaiting the protagonists.

name: Big Helmet Heroes
short_description: Throw yourself into an epic 3D beat’em up adventure with adorable knights, full of surprising worlds and situations. Grab your buddy and play in 2 player co-op to save the princess, but this is only the beginning!

name: Hello Kitty Island Adventure
short_description: Embark on a cozy, open-world adventure with Hello Kitty and Friends. Befriend beloved characters as you explore and restore a mysterious island, solve ancient puzzles, cook delicious dishes, customize yourself and your cabins, and so much more.

name: Articrafty
short_description: What will you create? Combine realism and fantasy. Combine characteristics with abilities. Create unique items. Achieve 'Legendary' mastery. Breathe life.

name: Invertigo
short_description: INVERTIGO is a first-person sci-fi puzzle-platformer where you have to manipulate gravity to solve puzzles. Explore the abandoned facility and make use of gravity manipulation to advance through the rooms.

name: SamVSTom
short_description: Sam, stop Tom! If we don't, the world will perish! Bring back your former best friend's sanity in a third-person action battle! A short action game that also includes a time attack!

name: Dungeon Vending Machines
short_description: Dungeon Vending Machines is a relaxing, casual idle game. Where you run vending machines in a dungeon! As adventurers brave dangerous depths, you’ll be their lifeline. Expand your machine lineup, grow your profits, and become the ultimate dungeon supplier!

name: Immotro
short_description: 《修仙牌》是一款休闲卡牌游戏，玩家需要利用五行数值的相生相克，在限定次数内组合卡牌，将自身的五行数值改变到对应区间来尝试突破。

name: たんぼ
short_description: I was walking along the rice paddy path with my dog ​​Bonta. That was all I wanted to do. My ordinary daily life was suddenly shattered.

name: Ronny's Climb
short_description: Relive the 90s in this 16-bit inspired retro platformer! Explore colorful worlds alongside Ronny and their adorable furry friends and help them jump, dash and fight their way to the top of the mountain. Can you overcome the challenges and reach the summit?

name: The Legend of Heroes: Kai no Kiseki -Farewell, O Zemuria-
short_description: The latest installment in the popular story-driven Kiseki RPG series is here! The 20th-anniversary title, The Legend of Heroes: Kai no Kiseki -Farewell, O Zemuria-, where the epic story of the continent of Zemuria takes a dramatic turn, is now available on Steam®!

name: Lured by Eerie Sundown
short_description: A colossal sunset that enigmatically beckons you. Four mysterious torii gates encircle an eerie stage.And a girl walking towards you. Can you uncover the anomalies and escape this sinister world? Experience the ultimate Japanese mystery horror escape in this immersive walking simulator!

name: 幻兽纸牌
short_description: Each start will have a different beginning. The game is set in a cartoon style, with simple and fresh graphics. Players need to deal high damage to defeat their boss through playing cards to clear the level. Suitable for players who enjoy challenges, randomness, and creativity.

name: Everwarder
short_description: Everwarder is a refreshing take on the tower defense genre, blending roguelite mechanics with a time-based survival concept. Fight against the encroaching darkness and fend off emerging enemies. Collect artifacts, buy upgrades, discover ancient structures, unlock new units and more!

name: AI2U: With You 'Til The End
short_description: You wake up in a cute girl's home who's eager to keep you by her side! Engage with thematic stories, puzzles, and unique AI NPCs who'll go to any lengths to protect you—even when it means contradicting themselves. Bask in meet-cutes or brace for chaos if you try to escape.

name: DeathOmen
short_description: DeathOmen is a short psychological horror game that challenges players to maintain their sanity over the nights in a mysterious  house that hides mystery and fear. It’s a journey of constant change, full of disturbing events and jump scares.

name: The Night Shift
short_description: The Night Shift is a Third Person OpenWorld game, where players live their Adventure freely, in a day and night circle where wildlife became more dangerous at night. Free content updates and new random weekly quests and zones will include for keep the community rewarded.

name: 終わりの鐘が鳴る前に Chapter3
short_description: 「これは何を手にするために、何かを失う物語」 季節は変わり冬になる。死神の条件のために主人公、長谷部涼平は菅野雪乃への恋心を自覚するが、彼女の親友に想いを寄せられてしまい、今度は三角関係の当事者になってしまった。自分の未来を掴むためにも菅野雪乃との両思いを目指すことになるが…。青春群像劇ビジュアルドラマ三部作の最終章が遂に開幕！

name: Mercenaries Lament: Requiem of the Silver Wolf
short_description: Mercenaries Lament is a tactical simulation RPG set in a fantasy world. Battles occur on quarter-view maps with height differences, where character positioning in the front, back, and side of enemy units may very well determine each battle’s outcome.

name: じゃんつの -Janken Horn-
short_description: Janken Horn is a 'Rock Paper Scissors' card game. When a simple luck testing game suddenly becomes a strategy game, you will understand. Why does it make you think so much when all you need to do is to pick one from Rock/Paper/Scissors?

name: Vox Populi: Germany 2025
short_description: Play as an existing or fully customisable political figure, and campaign for many alternative German elections! In 'Vox Populi: Germany 2025', you and the characters around you must promote your ideas and your popularity throughout the country to claim victory!

name: Qoob
short_description: Imagine the elegance of Sudoku but reimagined - stripped of numbers, amplified in complexity, and alive with innovation.

name: Mandragora Seeker in the CREEP ZONE
short_description: A timid gravedigger’s strange adventure to claim the Mandragora Gold Prize! Grow Mandragoras affected by weather, moon phases, and time, while fending off ghosts and fireballs to win the ultimate prize!

name: Find Petey
short_description: Find Petey is a hidden object game in which a total of 180 little bats are hidden across 4 unique levels. Embark on the search and find Petey on the farm, at the camp, on the sunny beach, and in the city. But beware: the search gets more challenging with each level!

name: Gelluloid Domination
short_description: Gelluloid Domination is a fast-paced, strategic and tactical game where you grow a network of cells. Expand by assimilating nearby cells, fight off pathogens and develop nanoboosts in the lab. Other cells want to propagate their DNA too, so this won't be easy. Can your cells achieve domination?

name: The Shell Part III: Paradiso
