short_description: The coiling chains of obsession that began with The Shell now threaten to strangle Detective Reiji Tokisaka in the third and final entry in the trilogy. As old friends and foes rise up for one last confrontation, can anyone break the cycle—and can Reiji's heart ever be set free?

name: Aloft
short_description: Soar the skies in Aloft, the co-op sandbox survival game set in a world of floating islands. Build any island into a skyship, your home in the clouds. Find lost knowledge, cure the fungal corruption, and brave the hurricane to restore the ecosystem.

name: Rise of Kenshin
short_description: Demons invasion, the young heroes face the heavy siege of the enemy, they fought in blood and finally recovered the lost land. This is a national style Roguelike casual game, players can play a variety of roles, gradually grow, and experience the hearty grass-cutting battles.

name: Last Outpost
short_description: Last Outpost is a minimalist Base Building & Strategy game where you build and defend your outpost in zombie apocalypse.

name: VR Basketball: Training Challenge
short_description: VR Basketball: Training Challenge is a VR experience designed to improve your basketball skills based on scientific principles. With advanced tracking systems, a realistic physics engine, and immersive gameplay, it brings the court to life.

name: Bat to the Heavens
short_description: Can't run or jump? But with a bat, you can surpass any obstacle! Climb to the heavens, learn techniques, and discover secrets across the valley in this challenging puzzle - execution - momentum game!

name: Internet Cafe Simulator 2025
short_description: Run your own internet café! Manage, upgrade, and customise every detail to create the ultimate hangout in this immersive first-person simulation.

name: Mysteries of Perception
short_description: Mysteries of Perception is a detective game where you will see the same scene through the eyes of different characters. Uncover their secrets by analyzing all the clues. Switch perspectives and learn everything about the artifacts of the Distant and the deaths in their wake. Glory to the Stars!

name: NOROI KAGO: the Grudged Domain
short_description: NOROI KAGO: the Grudged Domain is a four-player co-op survival horror game based on 'Yokai', supernatural beings from Japanese folklore. Trapped in a cursed domain, you and your companions must work together to endure the curse and find a way to escape, all the while hiding from the roaming yokai.

name: Orcs Must Die! Deathtrap
short_description: Orcs Must Die! Deathtrap combines chaotic third-person combat with devious trap-laying strategy. Enjoy endless replayability as your War Mage grows stronger through roguelite progression. Repel relentless orc hordes solo or with up to 4 players.

name: UNDERWARD
short_description: UNDERWARD is a 1-4 player co-op horror exploration game. Investigators must carry «TEST-SUBJECT» monsters from a deadly underground abandoned hospital ward.

name: Galactic Simulator
short_description: Galactic Simulator is a clicker game based on the Fermi Paradox and the Great Filter theory. Players can simulate the evolution of celestial bodies and civilizations in the galaxy from an observer's perspective. The game supports multiplayer mode. Create a unique galaxy with friends!

name: Rust of Steel
short_description: 'Rust of Steel' is a post-apocalyptic ruins exploration RPG with a high degree of freedom. Take on the world in your own style with multiple scenarios, free stat distribution, and the option to play as the good guy or the bad guy!

name: Cursed Feed
short_description: In first-person horror game 'Cursed Feed,' players embark on a chilling journey with the Thornvale family as they confront a malevolent force unleashed by their own patriarch's archaeological discoveries.

name: SYNDUALITY Echo of Ada
short_description: In this PvPvE extraction shooter, players, aided by an AI partner known as a Magus, must survive against xenomorphic creatures and other players in the hunt for resources.

name: 跳一跳一跳
short_description: In this action-adventure game, players will use the arrow keys or touch the screen to precisely control the character's left and right movements as well as jumping. The game world primarily unfolds from left to right but occasionally introduces vertical levels that move upwards or downwards.

name: SACRIFICE VILLAINS
short_description: Ever since the day the powers appeared, crime has ruled the streets of Scum City. As the conniving villains grow stronger and stronger, and the heroes find themselves walloped rather than walloping... it falls to you to rehabilitate S-rank villains in this short visual novel!

name: Quantum Joe
short_description: Jump, bounce and warp through 100+ levels of fun, fast-paced retro-arcade style. Complete challenges and unlock stickers to decorate your play area, build custom levels with built-in level maker and share them through Steam Workshop. Includes single player and local co-op.

name: 汉尘：腐草为萤
short_description: “The last day of Han dynasty”It is a survival simulation business game based on the background of the end of the Han Dynasty in China. From the perspective of ordinary people, you can spend a difficult but warm time, and keep warm together with the characters you know in the troubled times.

name: MONSTER MERCHANT
short_description: You are a monster merchant. Catch cute monsters, sell them, take pills. This is your job, if you don't do it, someone else will, and you don't want that. This is a psychological horror game about catching cute creatures.

name: While Waiting
short_description: Presented by the team behind critically acclaimed 'Moncage', this is a transformative adventure exploring the art of waiting. Clear the game by doing nothing, but discover the power of acceptance and patience in numerous situations from birth to death. Learn to embrace life as you wait.

name: 巴哈姆特1-REMAKE(BAHAMUT1-REMAKE)
short_description: In this land where magic and crisis intersect, a blue-haired boy fearlessly joins the ranks of adventurers with the ambition of defeating the legendary Dragon God Bahamut. Facing countless trials and challenges of fate, he will uncover the hidden truth and embark on his own destiny journey.

name: Bauhaus Bonk
short_description: In this single-player one-button dexterity game, movement is not straightforward. Alternate between pivots to spin through 54 Bauhaus-inspired arcade levels. Avoid obstacles, clear levels, and beat the global high score!

name: Core Trials
short_description: Core Trials is a motion-based, pixel-art bullet hell you play using just your webcam. Move your body to control the core, protect it, and survive intense trials. Immerse yourself in high-octane action and uncover the true power of your core!

name: Foxes' Festival
short_description: It's festival day! and there's lots to do around the town to get ready. Help the villagers out around town to get ready for the festival by doing various tasks including fishing, farming, and painting. Maybe you'll earn some cool shirts, hats, and glasses along the way!

name: Saber Survivors
short_description: Saber Survivors is a survival action roguelike where the evil galactic emperor has declared that all “Space Wizard Samurai” must be exterminated. You, a Space Wizard Samurai, must fight to survive. And your only weapon… a saber to deflect laser beams.

name: Come Up with Hyper
short_description: You are a young Hyper from the ghetto who wants to get out of poverty and embark on a journey of learning about the world and yourself. The world has definitely gone crazy, though it has never been normal, but maybe now is the chance for you. Crisis is a time for action and decisive steps..

name: TheLostWoods / 迷いの森
short_description: You find yourself lost deep in a strange forest. Will you be able to find the right path and escape this mysterious forest safely?

name: Crimson Rite
short_description: In times of peace, a lone wanderer decides to camp for the night. He faces an unexpected attack from an orc. Trying to find out why he has been kidnapped, then learns the dark history of an outcast orc tribe. You must escape before the Crimson Rite.

name: The Cursed Soul
short_description: A single-player horror game where you explore a haunted house, collecting items, solving puzzles, and face scares at every turn. Use your inventory to manage your items as you uncover clues to escape. Confront and defeat the monster before it traps your soul forever.

name: Sword of the Necromancer: Resurrection
short_description: Sword of the Necromancer: Resurrection is a 3D remake of the original ARPG, featuring revamped graphics, dynamic combat, and a tactical summoning system. Turn your foes into allies and dive into an adventure full of strategy and action, inspired by the classics of the 6th gen of consoles.

name: Basureroes: Invasion
short_description: “Basureroes: Invasion” is a 2D platform game with retro aesthetics in which a group of heroes with different abilities must save the world from an alien invasion. Run, jump and fight your way through twenty levels full of danger and epic boss fights.

name: 我的一个多重人格朋友
short_description: This is an AVG game that involves reasoning and decryption. He Zhou has 7 different personalities, which alternate seven days a week. Players will play as a detective and deduce the truth behind the horrifying cases surrounding He Zhou through the diary he left behind.

name: Jump Man
short_description: Simple operation, full of challenges, come and play it.

name: Survive till 100 years old
short_description: How hard is it to 'survive' to 100? This match-3 strategy game brings the answer with fun and challenges! In the game, players must use match-3 mechanics to gain nutrition, maintain health, and acquire skills to survive. Wisdom and strategy might help you achieve the goal, but luck is indispensable!

name: Everseeker: Little Critters
short_description: Everseeker is a Hidden Object game and a charming exploration and discovery experience where your goal is to find 100 small insects hidden in a picturesque town of cute rabbits. All the artwork is carefully hand-drawn, providing a relaxing and immersive atmosphere.

name: Doomed Brigade
short_description: Doomed Brigade is a survival game where you pilot a spaceship, battling hordes of enemies from three different alien races. Level up during each game, unlocking upgrades, modules, and diverse ammunition to equip yourself and crush your foes.

name: Farm Invader
short_description: Pilot a UFO to abduct cows and humans in this retro arcade-style game! Boost your score while managing suspicion as humans roam the farm. Collect power-ups like score multipliers and time slowers to enhance your gameplay. Can you balance abductions and suspicion to achieve a high score?

name: DangerousPath
short_description: Think quickly, plan wisely, and victory will be yours!

name: Apple Man
short_description: Apple Man is no ordinary fruit... Due to a mysterious force beyond anyone's comprehension, He has been blessed with two unbreakable legs, and a myriad of special abilities. With his newfound power, he is absolutely determined to accomplish his lifelong dream of reaching the sky.

name: Lost in Anomaly
short_description: In Lost in Anomaly, you wake up on the 9th floor of an unknown building. The only way out of here is to detect and mark anomalies. One wrong move and you could be trapped forever.

name: Hunter Moonstrike : Ai NPCs version
short_description: Hunter Moonstrike is the first survival game integrated with artificial intelligence. In this game, all npc have their own unique story and you can see the story of the game from their point of view. Talk to any person, ask any question you like, they will answer and think they are alive

name: Flat Fat Fartfest
short_description: Our friend Chuggy just devoured a hearty plate of extra spicy noodles and is on the brink of an epic bout of diarrhea. The nearest toilet is several kilometers up… several. I wish you good luck on your journey, but be warned—the diapers were left at home.

name: New Year Home
short_description: 'New Year Home' is a horror game set during the New Year. Players explore a familiar yet eerie home, navigating festive yet dangerous spaces. They must solve abnormal events to uncover a terrifying truth.

name: The Day Before
short_description: A tiny story about putting together a Day of the Dead offering. Walk around the village you live in, talk to your neighbors, find a way to obtain all the objects you need to put in the offering, and welcome your departed joyfully!

name: Pacifish: Recast
short_description: Pacifish: Recast is an incremental fishing management game with several mechanics to interact with and improve. It can be played both idly, or more actively to progress faster.

name: None Shall Intrude
short_description: Venture into None Shall Intrude, a roguelite deck-builder with tile-based combat where you become a powerful Raid Boss. Epic battles, intricate strategies, and the ever-present threat of heroic challengers seeking to vanquish your reign. Will you conquer all or fall to valiant heroes?

name: Backyard Boxing
short_description: 'Backyard Boxing' is a gritty urban boxing game where you fight to rise through an illegal league while hustling in the streets. Battle fierce opponents, gamble, drug deal, and travel to new cities, gaining fans and respect. Dominate the league and become a street legend!

name: Diamond Thief
short_description: An arcade 2d Platforme game

name: Kraken's Canvas
short_description: Experience the ocean through a child's eyes to confront the legendary Kraken in this amazing hand-drawn adventure.

name: VARYZNEX
short_description: classical horizontal scroll 2D Shmup

name: Shalnor: Silverwind Saga
short_description: Rynna has arrived on one of Shalnor's most dangerous Islands. Prepare yourself for an epic RPG/Action Adventure game. With focus on gauntlet-style combat, traps, boss fights and beautiful pixel-art scenery.

name: My Bird
short_description: Your bird is one of the first birds to learn the basics of jet-powered flight

name: Simulator: Parking Lot
short_description: Manage your own parking lot. Administer, improve, and expand your establishment. New services and features are coming soon.

name: Electrial
short_description: Welcome to Electrial!, an innovative puzzle game based in electrical physics. You will clear levels by interacting with charged elements. Choose between a positive or negative charge, then launch it at an appropriate speed and angle to reach the target!

name: Just Eat The Rich
short_description: Take the role of Birdman, a delivery man fed up with his minimum wage job. Politics have failed him so he takes matters in his own hand. With an arsenal of weapons and abilities you can help Birdman take back what the Elite took from us and redistribute the wealth. It is time to just eat the rich.

name: DoomWall
short_description: Hack your way through the Nex-Us in this turn-based puzzle indie game from a small team of three designers. Will you be clever enough to use the right programs you find along the way to locate the access point before the DoomWall catches up?

name: SHADOW
short_description: In SHADOW, expect the unexpected. Every shadow conceals danger, every sound fuels your dread. Dare to survive a night of terror where the darkness is your enemy, and the unknown waits at every turn.

name: The Legend Of The Crystals
short_description: The Legend Of The Crystals is a story-driven fantasy action RPG where you will embark on an epic journey to uncover the secrets of the ancient crystals that bring balance to the world.

name: Eva's Lab
short_description: Eva's Lab is a first-person puzzle game developed independently by an individual. You will play as Eva who wakes up in a laboratory. Under the guidance of artificial intelligence, you use the force field gun in your hand to solve puzzles one by one, leave the laboratory and gain freedom.

name: Brave Escape
short_description: Embark on a thrilling co-op adventure in 'Brave Escape,' a challenging platformer demanding teamwork to conquer perilous traps and treacherous terrain.

name: Turret Titans
short_description: Turret Titans is a classic defense game where you take on hordes of enemies with your powerful machine gun! Fight boats, helicopters, trucks, and insurgents across 5 intense levels, defending your position from relentless waves of attackers.

name: Take a Walk
short_description: Take a Walk brings nature trails to the comfort of wherever you are! This cozy, open-world walking simulator is the next best thing to touching grass. Embrace the calm, uncover hidden treasures and enjoy your walk.

name: A Butterfly
short_description: The abyss called your name. You followed it here. Now you are its prisoner. A Butterfly is part horror, part interactive poem about overcoming and bittersweet surrender

name: Studio System : Guardian Angel
short_description: An investigation of a secret film studio underneath their school has lead 3 students down an estranged rabbit hole. With the fixed-camera as your weapon, shine a light on the truth and save your friends.

name: Pathogen: Code Omega
short_description: Survive on an island overrun by zombies, destroy infected nests with molotovs to collect samples, and signal for rescue before it’s too late.

name: Chaos Faction Legacy Collection
short_description: Chaos Faction and Chaos Faction 2, both in their original format, return in the Chaos Faction Legacy Collection. Experience the frantic action that helped define the earliest generation of brawlers. Master arenas, outmaneuver foes, unlock new characters, and relive the legacy of Chaos Faction.

name: cats diner
short_description: Hire cats to run a sushi restaurant. You will cook the fish you catch in the sea in your sushi restaurant. To get to other towns, you need a boat and cats to row it.

name: { v e l o c i t y }
short_description: { v e l o c i t y } is a lovechild of ultrakill's movement and portal's puzzles and atmosphere.

name: PETS
short_description: PETS is a platformer puzzle game. You will cross different dimensions and go through the maze, find your dogge.

name: Click Painter
short_description: Click Painter is a Minesweeper-like puzzle game with colorful pictures, comfortable rest, and new ideas.

name: Discolored 2
short_description: All the colors have gone missing from the world. While on a mission to bring them back you discover you are being hunted by those who would see the colors banished. Your only hope is a woman in red who may be holding the key to preventing the world from becoming discolored.

name: Claritas - Dungeon Crawler RPG
short_description: Claritas is a 2D, turn-based, party-building dungeon crawler RPG. Assemble your party from diverse characters with unique abilities. Battle through challenging dungeons, earning experience and loot as you prepare for the ultimate test of your skills. Endless strategic combinations await!

name: Astral Blaze
short_description: Embark on a quest for a rumored treasure while exploring ruins of an old civilization. A half survivor and half roguelike type game with partly randomized dungeons and character development by choice of cards found in the dungeons. Featuring unique dash attack and simple controls.

name: Enso
short_description: Slingshot your way to the top of a beautiful minimalist landscape. A deceptively tricky platformer where a single slip could lead to a long fall back down!

name: Lonely Mountains: Snow Riders
short_description: Crash over and over until you master the mountain in the snowy followup to Lonely Mountains: Downhill. Now also including 2-8 person crossplatform multiplayer - work your way down as a group the slopes sharing a small number of checkpoints, or risk it all in a breakneck race to the base!

name: Stickman Adventures
short_description: Stickman Adventures is a 2D Stickman Action Shooter. Fight your way through various levels and dimensions, defeating challenging bosses and enemies along the way! This game is very hard.

name: Bellfortis
short_description: Bellfortis is a strategy game from the early Middle Ages. Expand your kingdom, use politics and power. Strategic planning on the map alternates with realtime battles of armies. Play as a grand strategy or on smaller local maps, build, recruit armies and fight!

name: Sniper Elite: Resistance
short_description: Offering unparalleled sniping mechanics, stealth and tactical third-person combat, Sniper Elite: Resistance turns the attention of the award-winning series towards a hidden war, far from the front lines, deep within the heart of occupied France.

name: My Little Life
short_description: A relaxing life-sim that lives on the bottom of your screen while you do other things.

name: Bananitro
short_description: Bananitro is a 2D game where you control Monkey on his bicycle, using Bananitro to perform maneuvers and conquer obstacle-filled tracks, with creativity as the key to success.

name: School Days
short_description: 《学生时代》，一款高自由的校园养成游戏。夏日西瓜、午后吊扇和悸动的心拉你重回千禧年初。学习、锻炼、恋爱，你是要复刻曾经的成长之路，还是活出不一样的人生？12年后，你的未来如何，由你来决定！

name: Hispania
short_description: HISPANIA is the computer adaptation of a famous historical board game that broadly depicts the two thousand years of history of the Hispanian Peninsula.

name: 心所向往的北极星
short_description: A text adventure game that combines the elements of beauty, suspense and love. A visual novel game, the player takes the role of the main character in the story and uses options to advance the story to different endings.

name: Pocket Lint
short_description: A deceptively hard little game of deduction. I’m now thinking of a specific combination of pocket items. If I give you hints about what you’ve got wrong, can you guess it in as few guesses as possible?

name: Virgin Simulator
short_description: Virgin wants to find a girlfriend

name: Slime Knight
short_description: Slime Knight is Pixel-Art Side-Scrolling Puzzle Game That Slime Get into the armor and go on an adventure

name: Unlucky Chicken
short_description: An unlucky chicken fell to the bottom of a ravine and was injured. It can no longer fly smoothly, but now it just wants to go home and hopes you can help it.

name: Revenge of the Mage
short_description: RotM is an Action Roguelite FPS game where players get in the robes of a Mage. Let the hands of fate open ways for the power of your magic. Save the Multiverse to power up yourself! Unlock, collect, discover, live, die, repeat!

name: Ailuri
short_description: A hand-drawn, 2D platformer following the breathtaking story of an endangered red panda, named Ailuri. Climb, explore and survive the intricate levels while trying to defeat enemies to restore balance of life in the world.

name: Backrooms [REDACTED] - Chapter 1
short_description: Backrooms [REDACTED] is a short action-adventure game that plunges you into the infinite cosmic horror inspired by the Backrooms concept.Navigate through the procedurally generated liminal spaces, uncover hidden secrets, while avoiding different entities.

name: Stage Cleared
short_description: Your home security system is powered by a game. Keep it running. Stay sharp. And whatever you do... make sure he doesn't reach you.

name: Atlas Protocol - Escape Room
short_description: You appear in an abandoned facility without knowing how or when you arrived. 'Atlas Protocol' will immerse you in an intriguing adventure full of mystery and suspense. Will you be able to unravel the enigma hidden in every corner? Dare to find out.

name: War of Resistance
short_description: In this turn-based strategy game simulating the Second Sino-Japanese War, players will take on the role of the Communist forces, fighting against the Japanese army in the upcoming War of Resistance, and later, battling the Republic of China to win the Civil War.

name: Roll With Friends
short_description: A challenging ball game where you can compete to climb the top 100 leaderboard, play with friends, or chill in offline single-player mode.

name: Slasher: Origins
short_description: Slasher: Origins is a chaotic, 2.5D, auto-attack survival game with rogue-lite elements and noir-anime storytelling. Unlock powerful heroes, create builds of unique abilities, and survive the escalating inferno of Mephistopheles’ underworld.

name: RBM Studio's Waterloo
short_description: A historical hexagonal turn-based strategy wargame using markers to represent units designed by the legendary Mark Herman. Throwback to the great hex-based wargames of the 70's and 80's. Solo and online multiplayer modes are supported.

name: 挂机修仙之我能合成功法！
short_description: 重活一世，我竟然能通过合成功法来无限变强！这一次我一定要升仙做祖，超脱世界！ 主角逆天改命，获得了无限合成功法能力，因此他不断努力，只为了一览更多的世界，在无尽的轮回之中超脱己身。

name: Mr. Hopp's Playhouse 2 HD
short_description: A young girl confronts eerie manifestations and deciphers cryptic puzzles as she sets out to defeat three cursed toys and rescue her friends.

name: The motel
short_description: Work the late-night shift at The Motel, an old roadside stop near Oakhill Grove. Complete simple tasks until a news broadcast reveals a dangerous killer is nearby. Can you survive the night?

name: Broken Alliance
short_description: From the makers of Death & Taxes comes a turn-based adventure-strategy game, an indie love letter to pixel art, old-school adventure games, mythical creatures and fantasy storytelling. Choose your faction and harness the vast power of magic to save your dying world, shaping your personal storyline.

name: Assetto Corsa EVO
short_description: Assetto Corsa EVO redefines the realism and features of one of the most popular multiplatform driving simulations ever developed. Featuring cars and tracks from different classes spanning across years of motoring history.

name: Ascendant
short_description: Defeat legendary abominations, build-craft unstoppable combinations of enchanted items, investigate an ancient evil, and ascend to freedom!

name: Lightracer: For Judge
short_description: In a dystopian future, as The Judge with immense power, you journey through space to find hope in a divided society. This sci-fi adventure explores hope amidst adversity.

name: Car-Toon Chaos
short_description: Escape and hunt down criminals, dinosaurs, or your friends in car deathmatch. Drive through a 7 level campaign on PC or VR, with nearly 4,000 combinations for your vehicle. Pick up chicks, blow up hideouts and discover the mystery of Bang City's Mayor.

name: Blood Bar Tycoon
short_description: Blood Bar Tycoon is a vampire bar management game. Build bars and blood factories, lure humans to harvest their blood, process it, and serve your customers: other vampires. Research quirky machines and deal with hunters! Expand through Crimson City to become a mighty Elder!

name: Your Girlfriend
short_description: Is your computer desktop too ordinary? Are you looking for a cute girlfriend? Then how about trying this desktop pet girlfriend?

name: Goppy
short_description: Goppy is a cute little fish who loves eating his yummy green treats, but he needs help to avoid the nippy-creepy-crawlies. With its vibrant graphics and easy-to-pick-up gameplay, 'Goppy' feels like a holiday.

name: 엑설런트 러브코미디
short_description: Let's write a web novel! Excellent love comedy!

name: Into The Depths
short_description: Escape the lab and survive through dangerous monsters and military personnel

name: Dead of Darkness
short_description: Dead of Darkness is a 2D survival-horror action-adventure. Investigate a mysterious island and unravel its disturbing secret. You’ll have to face grotesque creatures, hurdle deadly traps, solve puzzles, and most importantly, survive.

name: Awakening Sarah
short_description: Awakening Sarah is a 2D platformer with emphasis on exploration. Unravel the dreams and realities of Sarah, a girl who's recovering from a coma, while helping her understand the world around her and herself.

name: Red Tower
short_description: Master new powers as you face hordes of demons in intense battles in a frenetic top-down action shooter with rogue-lite elements. Fight against the darkness consuming the tower and uncover mysteries capable of saving or dooming everything around you.

name: Shadows Of Lir'Ah
short_description: A battle ensues and the fauna of the depths has awaken. Those who seek fortune, those who seek power gathered. You find yourself amidst it all, with no memory on how you reached the Island in the first place. What will you do?

name: 吃脚
short_description: The mystery puzzle visual novel of the Republic of China - Grandma died, the coffin is placed in the funeral hall. My mother asked me to come to the vigil and repeatedly warned me not to open the coffin.

name: Streamer Life Simulator 2
short_description: In the second game of the series, competition has increased and now everyone wants to be a streamer. Are you ready to stream until your cpu burns out?

name: Nagi no Koi
short_description: A Japanese-style visual novel where two stories intersect.

name: NINJA GAIDEN 2 Black
short_description: Using Unreal Engine 5 to significantly enhance graphic expression, this is the definitive version of 'NINJA GAIDEN 2,' featuring additional playable characters and enhanced battle support functions.

name: Hexarium
short_description: A minimalistic traffic management game where you build and maintain a bustling road network as more and more demand appears in increasing environment. How long can YOU maintain the network?

name: Godly Survivors
short_description: Face thousands of lost souls in the arena of the gods! Godly Survivors invites you to embark on an epic journey through an action rogue-lite game where you will hunt down the mobs' souls to improve your skills and survive the trial of the gods.

name: HPL: Nyarlathotep Rising
short_description: Dive deep into the twisted HP Lovecraft universe with this oversized narrative RPG. Slip into the intertwined souls of Mark, Anna, and Victor, surrounded by cult worshippers, as Nyarlathotep, the cosmic horror, strives to enslave humanity in 1929.

name: Drone Dash
short_description: Race, boost, and soar through physics-driven tracks in this fast-paced 2D drone racing game. Master precision flying, compete on global leaderboards, and push your skills to the limit!

name: Youtopia
short_description: Youtopia - You awaken in an empty city. How did You get here? Where is Everyone? Collect ALL of the Clues to solve the Mystery!

name: CrimeSceneCleaners｜特殊清掃
short_description: The protagonist, who has taken a job as a special cleaner, goes to his first cleaning site with his seniors. Witnessing the scene of a gruesome death, he begins to feel something that he has never felt before. He begins to feel the presence of something he has never felt before.

name: Careening
short_description: Careening is a bullet-heaven CarPG with a focus on exploration and movement. Drive across a small open world, defend yourself from the robot horde, then do it all again.

name: Guns of Fury
short_description: Guns of Fury is a retro-inspired action platformer that combines the run & gun and Metroidvania genres. Explore a vast interconnected world, gain new abilities and weapons, battle epic bosses and stop the plans of an evil corporation before it’s too late!

name: So Much Stuff 5: Mix-Knacks
short_description: Explore beautifully crafted levels, clear diverse scenes, and relish in a multitude of engaging mini-games. Collect charming trinkets to adorn a fresh room in 'So Much Stuff 5: Mix-Knacks.'

name: H Index
short_description: The Earth's poles began to change places, and this caused chaos. People sensitive to the changes become aggressive and start attacking each other. Scientific minds have created the Hindex scale, which shows the level of activity of storms on a 12-point system.

name: Dim
short_description: You are a wandering soul that has just arrived in limbo, pale landscapes and suffocating darkness surround you, you must escape only with your own light, crossing the dangerous paths that await you within a melancholic world.

name: H+H=H2
short_description: Sokoban-like, Fake-chemistry, Solitaire

name: find y
short_description: Players will need to unlock hidden formulas and solve logic puzzles to gain new skills while battling powerful digitized creatures in turn-based combat. During the quest, players can also collect equipment and resources to strengthen their abilities and prepare for the eventual discovery of “Y”.

name: Legacy: Steel & Sorcery
short_description: Legacy: Steel & Sorcery is an action-combat PvPvE extraction RPG set in the classic fantasy world of Mithrigarde, rich with expansive outdoor zones. Play solo or with friends to gather loot, slaying creatures or even other players.

name: Hand Simulator: Shooter
short_description: Hand Simulator Shooter — a true contender for the shooter throne, inspired by iconic games of the genre. Take control of your hands to survive and dominate in physically realistic shootouts. Experience unique gameplay where every move matters, and become the master of the new king of shooters.

name: Night at Grandma's
short_description: A single-player experience where your grandma got possessed by a demon. Search her house to find torn pages from an ancient book and items needed to free your grandmother’s soul from a sinister force. P.S. Remember, demons don’t like salt.

name: Urban Myth Dissolution Center
short_description: Join forces with the psychic Director of the Urban Myth Dissolution Center and solve a variety of cases involving cursed relics, rental properties with shady histories, and dimensional anomalies. Monstrous oddities and otherworldly planes abound in this occult mystery adventure game!

name: Saltwater
short_description: Play as a pistol shrimp and survive waves of enemies while collecting pearls from oysters scattered throughout the map.

name: Stranger Things VR
short_description: Experience the world of Stranger Things from the never-before-seen perspective of Vecna as he explores unknown realities, forms the hive mind, and enacts his plan for revenge against Eleven and Hawkins.

name: FlyingChicken
short_description: Two-dimensional (2D) graphics: simple and colorful. Easy to play: control with just one tap, but be careful, every move is recorded! Challenges are fun: levels full of exciting thrills and increasing challenges. Global Competition: Compete and challenge your choices for the highest points!

name: Tea House Simulator
short_description: Offer a warm tea experience while keeping up with the dynamic flow of the city. Step out of being an ordinary business owner and get ready for a simulation where you set the rhythm of the city!

name: Grand Fantasy Heroes
short_description: An epic Fantasy RPG where you will level up heroes, go on adventures, and progress in power until you can take on the Demon King.

name: purrounding
short_description: Dive into Purrounding and customize your very own cat! Watch as your adorable feline strolls across your taskbar, and create the perfect workspace with a variety of furniture pieces. Boost your productivity with a Pomodoro timer and chill out to some lo-fi tunes while you work!

name: Forecursed
short_description: Survive or become the monster in this cursed game of tag with up to 12 players. Escape the roaming entity that possesses and kills its victims. But death is not the end—lost souls can return as ghouls, each with unique abilities to torment the remaining survivors until there's only one remaining.

name: Elysium
short_description: Sebastian is a janitor in a nursing home, but in a world of drugs and mysteries, his reality unravels. Under Dr. Malverick's watch, his ordinary life twists into strange experiments, missing patients, and inner turmoil. What is real?

name: The Last Experiment: A Memetric Story
short_description: After the technological singularity, the world lies in ruin. The surface is overrun by a parasitic species, devouring all it touches. An underground team of scientists works to develop resistant lifeforms to reclaim the world – but they need a brave scout to face the dangers above.

name: Hell of a Birthday
short_description: IT’S YOUR BIRTHDAY!!! and nobody came to celebrate with you… Hell of a Birthday is a First-Person comedic horror game where you play as the Birthday Boy trying to survive your special day. From the maker of Bite Night and Invasion of the Halloween Fiends comes another unique adventure.

name: OCTOBER'S  CURSE
short_description: October is here, and with it comes the whispers of old tales. Strange things happen when the leaves turn red and the nights grow cold. Solve challenging puzzles to unravel the truth about what October hides. Be warned—some mysteries are meant to stay buried.

name: Block Shop
short_description: Block shop is an automation puzzle game in which basic blocks are transformed and combined to create increasingly complex blocks.

name: Tigershark
short_description: 2060 A.D. The Red Menace has resurfaced. The Sea Boils with submarines and battlecruisers, blood and oil. The skies are dark with enemy birds. Tigershark has been deployed. A fully-loaded subfoil prototype.

name: Gigabot Run
short_description: Gigabot Run is a fast-paced non-stop action game that will challenge your skills

name: Fleet Summoner
short_description: Control a fleet of ships to gather resources and survive endless waves of enemies. Purchase hundreds of upgrades across many skill trees, unlock new powerful ships, and push through higher and higher prestiges of enemies to reach the final boss.

name: Pumpking Spice
short_description: Guide a playful little ghost through spooky maze. Dodge mischievous bad guys, collect candy dropped by a flying witch, and uncover whether it's a trick or a treat! With vibrant visuals, simple controls, and fun challenges, Pumpkin Spice is perfect for kids and casual gamers alike.

name: zombie tide incoming Rising
short_description: 'Zombie Tide Incoming: Rising' is an immersive first-person shooter. After the apocalypse, you will face a world overwhelmed by a tide of zombies.

name: Mysterious Mystery, EP 1: The Duo Dilemma
short_description: Mysterious Mystery is a fully voiced mystery visual novel centered around the detective duo, Justin and Dakota. Solve multiple cases using Dakota's evidence gathering abilities and Justin's expert interrogation. Discover outlandish cases, meet unique characters, and become world class detectives.

name: Shadowgate 2
short_description: The sequel to the critically acclaimed, re-imagined, point-and-click adventure game is now available for preorder! Shadowgate 2 leaves 2D adventuring behind, expanding its horizons, and letting you lift the veil on the mysterious castle once again!

name: Bakka
short_description: Bakka is a tactical infiltration game where your goal is to plan the perfect path in advance to avoid being detected. More specifically, you plot the way for the Reaper, who will follow your instructions to the letter. Watch out for the guards and good luck!

name: 咸鱼殿下 / My journey
short_description: This is a Interactive Live-Action Game. You will travel back in time to become a noble Highness and experience the local customs and practices of ancient times. A series of your choices will influence the development trajectory of this world.

name: Sign White
short_description: 'Sign White' is a text visual novel set in a fictionalized medieval era. Send letters from your pigeon house to communicate with people for a limited period of time. Make connections to save people, listen to their worries, and participate in important decisions to change the fate of the world.

name: Edda Physics 1
short_description: Explore the world of Edda Physics 1 which contains 6 labs where you'll get to experiment with Archimedes' principle, newtons laws of motion, nuclear physics, the theory of relativity, the coriolis effect and coloumbs law! All labs are entirely interactable and teaches you a ton about physics!

name: The Night of the Exorcism
short_description: An unsettling visual novel where every decision shapes your destiny. Face seven diverse, cunning demons in a dark, atmospheric world and uncover hidden truths through multiple branching paths, culminating in nine distinct endings.

name: Nobody Nowhere
short_description: a side-scrolling, story-driven text adventure game in pixel art. The story is set in 2079, when a Replicant awakens in a lab facility amidst a life-or-death situation. The replicant aid agency tries to rescue him but fails. In the process they stumble on the real secret of the Replicant project...

name: THIS IS KIKO
short_description: A long time ago, my younger sister and I lived together in a house by the sea.And then, one day—I remember meeting her.Was she a good person? I should have asked myself that question sooner.'THIS IS KIKO' is an adventure game set in the modern era.

name: Moon's Creed
short_description: Choose your zodiac hero. Craft unique decks. Collect astral boons. Vanquish corrupted constellations. Ascend through cosmic chaos!

name: Wren's Resurgence
short_description: Wren’s Resurgence is a 2D action platformer where Wren must fight her way through the Yokai-infested lands in order to rescue her sister Swan. With the evil force’s tyrannical grasp on the island, it’s up to Wren to brandish her katana and bring peace back to the land.

name: Blêktre 2081
short_description: Blêktre 2081 is a real-life simulator where you face the thrills and struggles of a capitalist society. Survive this harsh world and carve your own path in the society : be a cop, a trader, a dealer, a junkie, a welfare recipient, or just try to get by ! A required training for the near future.

name: Catalyst: From The Stars
short_description: Catalyst: From the stars, a Boss-Rush First person shooter. As a lone mercenary sent into a ruined military base hired to steal a power source, you must fight for your life through dark halls and thrilling boss arenas to complete your mission! Do you have what it takes to face the Catalyst?

name: Kira☆Kano
short_description: 《闪亮☆女友》是由日本美少女游戏知名品牌AZARASHI SOFTWARE（海豹社）与Lump of Sugar（方糖社）联袂制作的作品，同时也是海豹社品牌成立10周年的纪念作。本作由人气画师萌木原文武担当原画与角色设计；由保樱企划并编剧；并由知名歌姬梦乃由纪献唱主题曲。

name: The Shape Killer - Sniper Game
short_description: Take on the role of a sniper and get paid to eliminate geometric head and face shaped targets in crowded colorful cities across 72 challenging missions. Sharpen your aim and prove you're the deadliest sniper on the global Steam leaderboard!

name: Message in a Melody
short_description: Can music save the human race? You and the Raqullan Empire will soon find out. Decide whether music, and the humans who make it, should survive.

name: Dungeon Spheres
short_description: You are the lord of spheres. You must protect your castle from enemy spheres by correctly summoning those at your disposal. But be careful, not all of your spheres will be your allies. Use the synergies between them to achieve victory.

name: The Curse of the Demon Tree
short_description: A top down 2D JRPG exploring the stages of grief and loss in a post-apocalyptic landscape.

name: Move Dash Rush
short_description: Move, dash and move again. Identify the most efficient route to complete the race more quickly. Will you be able to make it into the top 10?

name: Tank Simulator
short_description: Relive World War II inside a tank. Experience the most famous and greatest tank battles first-hand. Many historic battles await you, taking you all over the world. Experience the invasion of Poland, the attack on France, the war in the East and Africa, the liberation of Europe and the fall of Berlin

name: 鸭鸭大冒险 (Duck Duck Adventure)
short_description: Duck Duck Adventure is a 2D top-down roguelike with deck-building mechanics. Play as a duck disguised as various characters to defend a village from invading monsters and bosses. Trade for equipment, craft unique card builds, grow stronger, and survive waves of enemies to claim victory.

name: Dawnfolk
short_description: Dawnfolk is a charmingly dark and minimalist survival city-builder. Gather resources, rebuild your realm, and protect your people from oppressive shadows. Can you unveil the secrets of the monoliths to bring light back to the world?

name: Dark Sword: The Light of Ainn
short_description: Dark Sword is a frenetic action game that mixes bullet-hell and hack-n-slash in the midst of a devastating and dark open world with a tragic backstory, where the player must immerse himself in order to defeat the powerful guardians that guard it.

name: Thin Threads
short_description: Thin Threads is a first-person psychological horror game about a family's desperate struggle to survive poverty. Step into the shoes of each family member, witnessing their story unfold from different perspectives, immersing you in a truly haunting and disturbing experience.

name: Try Not To Plummet
short_description: Determination, a jetpack and a dream of returning home is all you have against the might of Mt. Cadere. There is a high chance that you'll plummet back down to the depths, but don't lose hope! Keep climbing using what little fuel you have, or you might just end up like the others on the mountain...

name: ابو فانوس - Abu Fanous
short_description: Wake up to a mysterious knocking in an empty house. Shadows, cryptic notes, and unsettling events blur the line between reality and fear. Can you uncover the truth, or will the darkness consume you?

name: Orc Incursion
short_description: Command powerful heroes in this dynamic RTS with PvE and PvP modes. Level up your champions, unleash devastating abilities, and lead your army to victory. Build and manage your base, train diverse units, and master their strengths and weaknesses to outsmart your enemies on the battlefield.

name: 10 Second Rule: Infinity Labo
short_description: Download on Steam Now!'Just 10 Seconds of Thrill!'The '10-Second Rule', an 8番-style horror game, has finally arrived!!The rules are super simple! 'Leave the room after 10 seconds.'Download on Steam Now!

name: 黄色猫片
short_description: [Button Cat] is a comprehensive game that consists of several mini-games [horizontal board jumping, snake eating, jerking off, big fish eating small fish] connected into a plot

name: Oracle of Meles
short_description: An ancient prophecy, a chosen one? Shoot your way through an evil castle, collect powerful artifacts, and defeat the evil king. Explore this 2D hand-drawn world full of magic and monsters where nothing is as it seems.

name: YOU Game+
short_description: The popular 'YOU Game' is upgraded! Let’s combine 'YOU' and 'YOU' to create a BIG 'YOU'!!

name: soul of Y
short_description: Soul of Y is an RPG centered on soul exploration and combat, where players take on the role of a wanderer who has lost his memories and searches for the truth about the “Soul of Y” in a broken world.

name: 她杀 - The Suspected Murder
short_description: Deep night, famous suspense novelist fell from the balcony, leaving his young wife an enormous heritage. Accident, or calculated murder?Novelist's nephew secretly began investigation.He found a hidden manuscript, which contains a creep story, as well as the key clues concerning its author's death.

name: DON'T GET GOT
short_description: Get the key. Get up to 8 of your friends in trouble. Get out. DON’T GET GOT.

name: Stories from Sol: The Gun-Dog
short_description: Survive the mystery that awaits the JFS Gun-Dog in deep space in this retro visual novel / graphic adventure.

name: Enemania TD
short_description: Brace for enemies, prepare for mania. Hordes monstrous enemies are after your treasure! The only thing that keeps them away is your arsenal of weaponry: cannons, catapults and bombs. Arrange your weapons carefully and defeat the enemies before they reach your treasure.

name: TRS22 Model Railroaders Edition
short_description: Bring Your Model Railway Dreams to Life with TRS22 Model Railroaders Edition, where cutting-edge technology meets the charm of classic layouts. Whether you're a seasoned enthusiast or just starting out, TRS22 Model Railroaders Edition offers endless possibilities to create, play, and explore.

name: Syn-Chorus 01: The New Life
short_description: ——欢迎来到珀炼市，秘知使大人！准备好迎接新生活了吗？ 《协律01：新生活》是一款幻想都市生活RPG游戏。 一块废弃基地为起点，耕作，制造、冒险和探索，当然还能享受丰富多彩的社交生活！ 在复兴城市、化解危机，享受跌宕起伏的剧情故事的同时，与亲密友好的友伴一起享受愉快的都市日常……

name: Dynamic destruction
short_description: 'Dynamic Destruction' is an innovative destruction simulation game. In this game, players are tasked with demolishing various structures, ranging from simple walls to complex buildings, using a plethora of tools and construction elements.

name: Museum No.9
short_description: Massive artifact collection! Build your museum with extreme freedom! Visitor revenue depends on your route design, and whether you can achieve perfect profits is entirely up to you! Enjoy light rogue-style adventure exploration, and use different skill combinations to battle monsters every time!

name: Arctic Motel Simulator
short_description: Have you ever been to the Arctic? Do you want to open a motel in the Arctic? With the company of aurora, blizzards, polar days and nights, primeval forests, and wild animals, can you turn a run-down motel into a landmark in the Arctic?

name: FootballLife
short_description: Football player simulation game

name: Au Revoir
short_description: Use your investigative skills in this point-and-click adventure to retrieve human minds stored in synthetic brains in 2071. Immerse yourself in a retro-futuristic world with neon-noir graphics from the 90s, and uncover a conspiracy that will challenge everything you know.

name: Котыха
short_description: Kotiha is a visual novel parody. This is laughter, this is falsehood, this is pain, this is life.

name: Lamentations
short_description: You and your teammates are part of an elite undercover unit tasked with finding out information on a mysterious complex known as 'the backrooms'. Explore various locations, solve puzzles, check your six, and escape with your life!

name: Utter a Name
short_description: Disembodied souls linger in this old estate. To each one, utter their name.

name: More Far Land
short_description: Aim for the distance → Defeat enemies → Collect materials → Craft → Grow and eat vegetables → Improve abilities → Improve varieties → Create drones → Build a landfill → Passive income → Aim for the distance (continue the loop)

name: Sky End Market
short_description: This is a game to manage a supermarket. Set up shelves, arrange products, and make your store bigger and bigger!　Sell your goods to the remaining people, animals, and robots in the last place on earth just before the human race is exterminated.

name: 猫様の古民家からの脱出
short_description: 「猫様の古民家からの脱出」は、かわいい猫たちが暮らす古民家を探検するポイントクリック型の脱出ゲームです。

name: Twilight
short_description: Twilight is a small dividing line between light and darkness. Sometimes you have to choose where you should stay and for what purpose.

name: 画剑Draw Sword
short_description: Draw Sword combines the elements of Chinese fairy and meat pigeon to create a rogue like game with the theme of Chinese fairy. The choice of rewards is very important, and the reflection on the arrangement of skills and weapon also needs serious consideration.

name: Planet Pioneers
short_description: Planet Pioneers is a relaxing building and puzzle game where you prepare new planets for settlers. Build tiles strategically, fulfill quests for your settlers, keep pollution low and enable new buildings along the way. Shape the planet as you wish until it’s time to move on to your next challenge.

name: Sovereign Brain Empire
short_description: “Who isn’t a baby anyway?”~You travelled to a parallel world governed by the Sovereign Brain AI. In SB Empire, you’re an adopted “one-year-old”, recognized as a 'Monarch-level' prodigy! There will be beauties giving you a sheltered babyhood. Your brilliance and privileges will change their fates!

name: Phantom Bound
short_description: Everhollow is in danger! Fight the haunted halls with your arsenal of gadgets, discover new upgrades and abilities, and unravel the dark secrets of Shadowthorne Manor in this cozy horror, Metroidvania-like ghost hunting adventure.

name: Lumi Trek
short_description: Lumi Trek is a unique rhythm platformer where you have to combine the three primary colors of light to overcome obstacles. Change the color of the moving star at the right time, and stay calm when deadly traps appear. It may sound simple, but this challenge will make your hands sweat!

name: Survive Society
short_description: How long can you survive in a Society?

name: Once upon a Dungeon - Infinity
short_description: Travel through dark dungeons, defeat dangerous creatures, and collect unique loot as you play endlessly in this hardcore, traditional roguelike.

name: Somnium Eleven
short_description: Somnium Eleven is a text-based, dating sim RPG where you find romance as you try to explore the world, meet characters, and survive through a series of competitive trials to unlock your fate.

name: 108 Silly Ways to Die
short_description: Caichen made an appointment with a female netizen from the same school to meet at an abandoned medical college, but was caught up in a conspiracy. Caichen planned to explore here and find a way to escape, but the sudden roar and the appearance of zombies implied that there were secrets hidden here.

name: Silence-Dream
short_description: 《Silence Dream》is a indie puzzle game. you could take on the role of musican, change or retain different abilities and take it into difference scence, gradually uncovering the man's past.

name: Block Jump
short_description: 这是一款已收集十个字母为目标的平台跳跃游戏，游戏时常10-20个小时，玩家需要克服重重困难，最终逃离[方块迷宫]的束缚。游戏控制简单，上手容易，只需跳跃、冲刺、下蹲、观察四周，但若想通关也绝非易事，玩家需要在每一次失败中吸取教训，控制心态，不断进步。强烈推荐用手柄游玩

name: FriendShapes
short_description: A jumpscare-free abstract horror existential crisis of a lite-RPG. Explore Digressions - areas that continue longer than they should with sets of randomized text events and map variations for a differing experience each time. Features a unique non-violent interaction system with various Entities.

name: The Escape Room Chronicles ep4:The 24-Hour TV Station
short_description: Discover items and use your wits to solve puzzles in this mystery! Episode 4: Escape from the TV station!

name: Tomb Raider IV-VI Remastered
short_description: Her legacy lives on! Play the next series of Tomb Raider adventures in this remastered collection of Lara Croft's darkest adventures.

name: New Meat
short_description: New Meat is a fast-paced horror-comedy roguelite about burgers, monsters and dead-end jobs. Survive five days of mayhem on the path to your first paycheck, meet a fun cast of extradimensional horrors, and maybe even make it out alive.

name: No Border
short_description: No Border - an action-puzzle platformer where platforms appear and disappear at your command! Control which parts of each level exist as you toggle and leap your way through mind-bending challenges.

name: КВАРТИРАНТ
short_description: Eighteen-year-old Maxim Karasev, full of hopes for adulthood, finally left his parents' home. He invested his small savings in renting a modest apartment in an old, somewhat dilapidated neighborhood of the city.

name: Chained in the Backrooms
short_description: Chained in the Backrooms is a 1-4 player co-op, mission-based horror game. Trapped in a blurry subconscious and chained together, toy bears must solve puzzles, complete challenging missions, and survive against creatures trying to destroy them.

name: THE BRiLLiANT COUP
short_description: A fun and exciting 2D pixel art point and click adventure game with classic commands. Steal a world-famous brilliant from the best guarded bank in the country.

name: Dusk Pub
short_description: As the manager of Dusk Pub, you have to put in a lot of efforts to run your own worn-down bar and expand your business to other parts of the land Brendt. Meet a variety of cute girls and recruit them as servers, helping them develop their business talent and know them inside out.

name: Unblinking
short_description: Trapped on death row, unravel the dark mystery of an ancient horror to escape alive. Outsmart the abyss, cheat death - if you dare.

name: Slavic Winter Simulator
short_description: Doomer's Paradise

name: Days with girlfriends : Kello&Cammy
short_description: By moving and matching these colorful gems, reaching 3 or more to form a straight line to eliminate them, each successful elimination will bring gorgeous special effects and satisfying sound effects, as well as beautiful illustrations unlocked after completing the level

name: The Paradixion: Restroom
short_description: [The Paradixion: Restroom] is a point-and-click adventure game with a mysterious atmosphere.Solve various puzzles with a unique atmosphere and find the hidden elements in the game to gather clues about the story.

name: Cats Hidden in Japan
short_description: Find 100 cats hiding in Japan in this cute hand-drawn hidden object game. Can you find them all?

name: GridFiller
short_description: GridFiller is a minimalist block puzzle game that tests your spatial reasoning and logic. Rotate, move, and fit blocks to fill every square on the grid while navigating obstacles. Featuring 200+ handcrafted levels, vibrant visuals, and a relaxing lo-fi soundtrack, it's perfect for puzzle enthusiasts

name: Geminism
short_description: Two pairs of twins war for love, life, and limb beneath the curtain of a dark Tokyo night. From the artisans at CRAFTWORK comes a visual novel lush with art, action, and mystery; a story of GEMINISM—deformity and divinity.

name: Cyber Tower 2048
short_description: Cyber Tower 2048 is an action tower defense game where players fight insectoids by building defenses and developing tactics.

name: GeoBoxer
short_description: Punch glowing geometry to the beat in this future arcade come to life in VR - Work up a sweat unlocking 100 of the best Phonk, EDM and Drum & Bass tracks as you cyberbox through Campaign mode!

name: zu xing
short_description: zu xing - A fun Social Simulation game set in a nice forest town with adorable animals to befriend!

name: Bachelairs
short_description: Race through a set of short dungeons, trying to collect the most treasures. The player that has the most coins at the end wins the game! Will you horde your coins? Invest in stronger gear? Or perhaps try to win extra gold with one of the awards? Face off against friends or play against the computer!

name: Rental Store Simulator
short_description: Run a store in the nostalgic world of video rentals. Manage inventory, serve customers, and customize your store to create the ultimate rental store experience. Purchase a range of movies and consoles. Hire and train employees. Upgrade and design your store.

name: Automate!
short_description: As the CEO and factory manager, strive for efficiency by installing and upgrading a variety of equipment! Optimize equipment placement, make improvements, and unlock new equipment to experience the endless potential of automation!

name: BURN
short_description: A short zero-gravity horror game where you investigate a religious research station gone silent.

name: 許願ReadyGo!
short_description: “Wish Ready GO!” is a game combines visual novel, simulation and role-playing. In the game, players will role as an goddess candidate, who need to pass the final exam to be a real goddess. Make your choices carefully, and help the heroine to finish her tasks!

name: Berty the Giraffe
short_description: Step into the Shoes of Berty the Giraffe in this 2D Top-Down Dungeon Crawler

name: RLChess
short_description: Dive into the ultimate chess showdown with RLChess! It's not just a board game; it's an epic battlefield where classic chess meets wild party antics. Get ready for a chess revolution that's packed with thrilling twists and lively interaction. Charge into RLChess and turn the chess world on its head!

name: Unforgotten: Ordinance
short_description: Face your fears, uncover the secrets of the past and fulfill your own destiny. In the wild impenetrable forests of Siberia you will face those who look beyond our reality and only the right choice will allow you to reach the end. Test yourself in a new psychological ethno-horror.

name: Voices in the Dark
short_description: The story of a young anthropologist who sets out on an expedition to investigate the disappearance of a group of scientists at an ancient excavation site. Creepy atmosphere and a constant sense of persecution will not let him go the rest of the way.

name: Trade 'Em Up! TCG Empire Shop
short_description: Trade 'Em Up! TCG Empire Shop is a 3D simulator where you run a bustling card shop. Stock shelves with booster packs, grow your collection, set prices, and host events. Balance inventory, manage budgets, and build customer loyalty to create the ultimate TCG empire and become the top shop in town!

name: Weirdo
short_description: Parallel-Weirdo is a Japanese manga-style visual novel set in DYL High School. It follows Wang Zhe, an ordinary and frail boy, who tries to win the hearts of girls and complete his experiments. He gets entangled in bizarre events, plunging into darkness. Each choice you make determines his fate.

name: Crabs
short_description: Take care of your very own hermit crab in Crabs! Keep your little crustacean happy and healthy. Relax, unwind, and enjoy the simple joys of hermit crab care.

name: Obsession
short_description: In a dark world where reality blends with illusion, you strive to uncover the mystery of your sister's death. Explore locations, interact with characters, and gather clues. Gradually, your mind begins to betray you, and each step could lead either to the truth or to madness.

name: The Mysterious Thief; Forget Me Not
short_description: A story-rich, girl's love visual novel about phantom thieves.

name: Dark Return
short_description: Immerse yourself in a dark journey filled with secrets and horror, as John returns home after receiving a mysterious letter from a family member stating that he must return home after traveling for treatment. Discover terrifying facts and uncover buried secrets in an exciting and fun experience

name: Trump Tariff
short_description: President Trump need avoid traps and find country flag every different countries

name: Pure Heat
short_description: Action-adventure game with very detailed worlds.

name: Alien Frontier
short_description: Alien Frontier is an open world, third-person shooter roguelite. Explore, search, and mine resources in the deadly alien wilderness... assuming you can survive combat with hordes of bloodthirsty aliens. Collect loot and upgrades to become the most dangerous (and wealthy) prospector in the galaxy!

name: 一剑江湖
short_description: 'Sword Lake' is a national style survival Rogue, class survivor game. There are no superfluous skills here, only swords, please feel free to build your unsurpassed sword

name: The Wickie : Journey of a Lighthouse Keeper
short_description: The Wickie is a first-person thriller set in the 1930s Outer Hebrides. Explore handcrafted islands, uncover cosmic horrors, and survive deadly dangers. With no weapons or maps, rely on wit and courage to solve mysteries. Rich in story,art, and Lovecraftian dread, Will you uncover the truth?

name: Tap Derby: Horse Racing
short_description: Tap Derby allows you to step into the shoes of a rookie horse trainer. Under the guidance of legendary trainer, Rusty Hayes, buy, train, race, and breed as you grow your stable. Conquer prestigious racing events and rise to Horse Racing Stardom.

name: Cafe Haven
short_description: Welcome to Cafe Haven, a cozy cafe management game! Unlock new recipes, decorate your cafe, and grow your business into the most beloved spot in town. Can you create a cafe success story?

name: Piczle Cross: Rune Factory
short_description: Experience the character, monsters and world of the Rune Factory series through addictive nonogram logic-puzzles!

name: Masquerade: Hell Academy
short_description: A Boys Love visual novel set around a pulse-pounding hostage situation. Can Numata make it out of things unscathed? Every choice matters! Fully translated into English with the original Japanese voice acting intact.

name: TAPE DENIAL
short_description: A psychological thriller where reality and memory collide. Unravel abandonment, depression, and shattered love through mysterious tapes. Dare to face your ghosts...

name: Aure
short_description: Aure is an open world exploration RPG where you take a role of an adventurer in a large and living fantasy world.

name: 寒いから鍋食いたいね女苑ちゃんと！！
short_description: 一文字だけ入力してしりとり形式で具材を決め、おいしい鍋や妙な鍋を作って色んな反応を楽しむ闇鍋シミュレーション！

name: Distorted Hallways
short_description: An The Exit 8 inspired anomaly game run through the hallways of a school spotting anomalies, turn back when you spot an anomaly, and level 0 will always be safe.

name: Millennium Whisper
short_description: It’s 1999 and there's a rumour going around. Whoever you confess your feelings to at the end of the millennium will be with you for a thousand years! Who will you choose on New Year's eve?

name: Going for Nuts
short_description: Do you like playing platform games and especially the old ones? A brand new and yet old game (in appearance) in 16-bit cartoon graphics. Experience a crazy adventure with an unusual hero.

name: The Tower
short_description: Play a almost endless simple roguelite dungeon-crawling RPG! Choose your character, customize their class and name, and delve into randomly selected dungeons filled with enemies and treasure. Gather loot, and gear up at The Tower's Guild to tackle higher floors..

name: Guud Dawg!
short_description: Embark on a goofy, chaotic adventure as a dog, dodging wacky enemies through a maze of mayhem, all while carrying out your owner's wishes.

name: Ellingby House
short_description: Corporate collapse, financial crisis, a ransomware plague... and you have become trapped! The crumbling head office of J.R Holder & Sons will ensnare you in a mystery. Interact and navigate between rich, detailed 360° panoramas, while using items to uncover the story in Ellingby House.

name: Opus Castle VR
short_description: Opus Castle VR is a 3D horror, adventure and mystery game with a narrative based on the true and tragic story of the small castle on Apa Street, located in the city of São Paulo, Brazil.

name: Zombie Marauders
short_description: Zombie survival FPS with idle game mechanics. Kill hoards of zombies, upgrade your arsenal, and survive for as long as you can. Earn XP to level up faster each time you play.

name: Divine Legacy: Neo Amburia
short_description: Divine Legacy: Neo Amburia is a medieval-fantasy RPG where a young woman must save her childhood friend, who’s been pulled toward a dark fate. With little more than determination, she'll battle powerful foes, form unexpected alliances, and uncover secrets that could reshape the world.

name: 祛魅·化始（祛魅4）
short_description: 《祛魅·化始（祛魅4）》是一款剧情JRPG像素回合制游戏。祛魅系列历代作品第四部，故事发生在三代格心事件结束后，西方大陆教廷所在地的自由都市联盟。拥有着非凡战斗天赋，秉承着“心中无男人，拔刀自然神”人生座右铭的芳香少女即将开启冒险征程，为您揭示这背后的一切。

name: Rogue Rhythm
short_description: A roguelike with rhythm-based combat. Learn a new mechanic after every boss and become skilled enough to challenge God Himself!

name: Echoes Of The Past
short_description: Welcome to Echoes of the Past, where the past comes alive and fears take shape. You are a night guard in a psychiatric hospital. Sinister creature emerge from the darkness, and your survival depends on cameras, light, and hiding. Every action matters. Can you survive the night?

name: SNØ: Ultimate Freeriding
short_description: SNØ is a minimalistic freeriding game. Push your limits for the high score, or simply explore the raw, endless wilderness.

name: The Escape Room Chronicles ep3:The Southern Resort
short_description: Discover items and use your wits to solve puzzles in this mystery! Episode 3: Escape from The Southern Resort!

name: 单词农场
short_description: 这是一款结合英语单词学习与语音识别的教育类游戏。游戏的核心机制围绕着玩家通过跟读单词、匹配单词的翻译和语音来阻止农场里的小动物逃跑。玩家将通过重复正确的单词发音，快速匹配单词和它们的翻译，或者正确识别单词的语音，来“捕捉”逃跑的动物。随着游戏进程的推进，难度逐步提升，玩家不仅能提升自己的词汇量，还能提高单词发音的准确性。

name: Moorhuhn / Crazy Chicken  VR Blast
short_description: Get ready to blast some chickens like no other with “Crazy Chicken VR Blast!” Feel the arcade vibe as you enter in Virtual Reality. Test your arcade shooting skills in a variety of all the classic levels you know and love. Every level offers new challenges and new weapons to unlock.

name: WARRIORS: Abyss
short_description: Through victory and defeat, traverse the merciless trials of hell.

name: Cute Robot Time
short_description: Cute Robot Time is a creative and challenging 3D platformer where you control an adorable robot through a world filled with traps, obstacles, and puzzles. Jump, parkour, and solve puzzles as you face unique level designs and enjoy smooth action in beautiful 3D environments.

name: The Secret Story
short_description: On the night of Friday the 13th, Henry Caviar was just a traveler seeking relaxation at a hotel. He helped a young woman who warned him about the 'ghost hunting day,' leading him to encounter numerous bizarre events that made him feel he had been mistaken.

name: TactiCats
short_description: Knock down your enemies and collect all the cats and achievements in this pixel art party game for true cat lovers. Use different power-ups and survive the dangerous traps to show your friends who's the fluffiest of them all!

name: LIFE EFFECT
short_description: Alien invaders invaded the planet, having exterminated most of the population, humanity, being on the verge of annihilation, united the armies and gave a serious rebuff to the enemy. After several years of war, the climate on the planet has changed. The military founded fortifications.

name: Shujinkou
short_description: Learn one of the world's hardest languages while immersed in this JRPG adventure. Shujinkou is a story-driven, turn-based dungeon crawler that provides players with the opportunity to learn Japanese. Play as Shu, Jin, and Kou as you try to save the world from the Akuma!

name: Unreachable
short_description: A first-person investigative thriller where your family is kidnapped and you must carry out various demands from the kidnapper in order to prolong their lives. However, if you are sharp, you might also uncover clues to track down their location and devise a rescue plan.

name: Gunforged
short_description: Gunforged is a goofy fantasy roguelite shooter where you create broken builds every run. Forge your guns with randomized gun parts, collect passive abilities, and embed gun-changing runes into your guns to create the ultimate build.

name: Dark PGT
short_description: Dark PGT – A Souls-like game in an alternate universe of future USSR on Unreal Engine 5. You will play the role of alcoholic-schizophrenic experiencing psychological disorders and hallucinations. Travel to a village in 2030 to unravel all its secrets and solve all its problems.

name: Magical Bakery
short_description: Experience a life full of magic, challenges, and the joy of creating sweets that will leave a spellbinding impression on your customers. Become the ultimate magical baker and prove yourself worthy to inherit the Magical Bakery!

name: The Hyperreal Rock in a Surreal World
short_description: You are a hyperrealistic rock trapped in a surreal world. You jump, roll… and fall. Over and over. 99% frustration, 1% satisfaction. Do you have nerves of steel? Find out as you try to escape this absurd chaos. Download now and suffer in style!

name: holo8
short_description: Escape from the looping office. Observe the office carefully and look for any anomaly to reach the main entrance.

name: Machinicide
short_description: Machinicide is a boomer shooter with imm sim and bullet hell elements. Reduce all evil robots to scraps with a huge arsenal of futuristic weapons and abilities, such as telekinesis, changing of gravity and many more.

name: Sodaman
short_description: Sodaman is a bullet-heaven roguelike where you play as a supersoldier fighting alien hordes with soda powers. Find game-breaking sodas and concoct custom cocktails. Discover planets, unlock weapons, sodas, cybernetics, power-up cards, and more. But first, crack open a cold one.

name: Medieval Questionnaire
short_description: Medieval Questionnaire is an educational game that tests your knowledge of medieval times with true or false questions.

name: Sailing The Winds
short_description: A game about sea adventures. Here you will find many different quests, here you can find an alien, find various treasures. Catch from the sea not only fish, but also different items that can help you in trouble.

name: Driving Master D
short_description: Driving Master D is a tough game where you drive a “brakeless” car with 2 buttons. Challenge yourself to complete a variety of stages including roads, towns, and circuits. Can YOU become the DRIVING MASTER D?

name: Wild West Saloon Simulator
short_description: Wild West Saloon Simulator is an immersive Wild West simulation where you can manage and upgrade your own saloon, mine for resources, bet on horse races, and invest in the stock market.

name: Red is Lava
short_description: In Red Is Lava, every jump counts! Control a color-shifting cube and paint the world as you leap through challenging levels. Touch the platform of the wrong color or the deadly red, and you die. Prepare for intense, precise action with no room for error! Can you survive?

name: Debt City
short_description: A retro open world life sim RPG. Explore a seedy sandbox city, and do anything you can to pay off a debt to a mob boss.

name: Maraka
short_description: Shoot magnets and send enemy flying! Push, pull, propel and shatter hordes of frenzied creatures with magnetic manipulation. Use environment as your weapon. Kill, collect and craft in this fast-paced action-roguelike game!

name: Eclipse
short_description: A tense and challenging pixel art roguelike focused on Russian roulette mechanics and resource management.

name: Voxel Project VR
short_description: Voxel Project offers an immersive sandbox experience set in a fully destructible voxel environment. Explore a dynamic world teeming with vehicles, dynamic fire mechanics, enemy NPCs, voxel gore, weapon customization, and a bunch of additional features to discover.

name: A Tower's Will
short_description: A Tower’s Will is a 3D platform game where you have to climb a sentient tower that doesn’t want to be climbed. Will you rise victorious or tumble down in defeat?

name: DBall
short_description: The Dual Ball Challenge: A Clash of Coordination. May the dance of your fingertips guide you forward on this uncharted path. This is a game genre that has never been seen before, and it will undoubtedly take you on a singularly unique journey unlike anything you've ever experienced!

name: Click the block  点击方块
short_description: Inspired by 'Cookie Clicker' This is my first game, I hope everyone likes it

name: Lines 98
short_description: Rediscover a Classic: Color Lines Reimagined

name: Traffic Jam Simulator
short_description: Super casual 3D low-poly style mini game

name: Bad Guys Good Boys - BL
short_description: Reginald is a ringleader of a criminal organization who'd received a concussion and lost his memories. When he finds out that he has committed crimes in the past, he wants to repent and do good deeds. He wants to convince his henchmen to change with him. Unfortunately, he can't escape his past.

name: Vex Clock
short_description: Vex Clock is a Clockpunk styled action-adventure, where you must run, gun and save the kingdom from absolute corruption. Your choices with who you bond with will shape the final outcome.

name: Station
short_description: Station is a single-player, tactical first-person shooter game with elements of survival through combat or avoidance, navigation, and resource management. It is designed with a minimalistic approach, focusing on tactics and orientation rather than attempting to visually stun the player.

name: Gallery: Coloring book & decor
short_description: Gallery combines a coloring book and house design game with a rich story. Become a painting master, express yourself through a range of artworks!

name: Probability Dungeon
short_description: A turn-based roguelike where skills have a probability of execution. ¡You will have to keep improving your list of skills and decide in which order you want them to be executed! Set your strategy, create synergies and try to overcome the different threats.

name: Necrocat
short_description: In a card field, choose wisely your next move on the grid, for every item collected and every monster defeated brings you one step closer to death. Answer the call and uncover Necrocat's schemes that disrupt the cycle of life!

name: Avowed
short_description: Avowed is a first-person fantasy RPG set in the world of Eora, where your choices carve a path through war, intrigue, and ancient mysteries. Navigate a land in turmoil, forge powerful alliances or deadly rivalries, and wield magic and steel to shape the fate of the Living Lands—and your own destiny.

name: Re:Fragment ~Absolute Ambition~
short_description: We all dream of a bright future ahead, but life doesn't always turn out how we expect. Yuuma, the protagonist, lives a peaceful life until the student council president proposes a new controversial policy that changes everything they once knew forever.

name: Minesweeper World
short_description: This is a classic minesweeper game that supports multiple ways of burying mines such as guessing without guessing. It also supports generating up to 200x200 situations, caching situations, and allows players to leave or continue at any time.

name: Azoth & Ignis
short_description: A challenging top-down action role-playing game about restoring the soul of the world. Overcome the cursed minions of The Alchemist! Discover the hidden drama! Find incredible loot! Level up! And then power up your build! Break the crystal balls! Explore the dungeons! Replay endlessly!

name: Mini Bash
short_description: Punch, Grab, and Throw your friendships away in Mini Bash! Join your friends online or locally in this chaotic party brawler and compete in a variety of physics-based mini-games! Laugh, cry, and never speak to your friends again!

name: mule of graves بغلة القبور
short_description: A person named Ahmed travels by car to his village, but faces a tire explosion near an abandoned village. When entering the village in search of help, Ahmed finds himself facing terrifying and unexpected scenes, the person tries to understand the curse that has fallen on the place and escape from it

name: Harvest Village
short_description: Harvest Village is a resource gathering and crafting paradise. It is a mini city building game where we process resources and try to craft the most valuable items and complete various quests. Upgrade your buildings and become the best miner, cook and toolmaker.

name: Dad's Coming
short_description: Chaotic, fast paced and co-op! Tidy up your mess before your dad comes back home! Help Kate and Bob cooperate to get objects across rooms to get rid of the mess in time! Careful not to break anything and beware of your cat Jack, who loves knocking things over!

name: SGS Battle For: Dien Bien Phu
short_description: The emblematic siege battle of Dien Bien Phu that ended French rule over Indochina in 1954. Fight for the defense of the fortified camp or try to storm it, in order to reach the upcoming Geneva Peace Conference in a position of force.

name: Pumpkin Hop
