short_description: Help the pumpkin jump from platform to platform and collect candy. Give your pumpkin a unique look by unlocking new hats that you can get with the candy you have collected. This game is a fun challenge for young and old.

name: Bring Slime to Mommy
short_description: The baby slime has fallen from space to Earth! Control the slime with your mouse and guide it back to its mommy! Bring Slime to Mommy! Embark on an adventure with an adorable slime in this challenging 2D platformer that demands precise control!

name: The Silent Kingdom
short_description: An otome RPG adventure with a dark story and meaningful choices. Shape the fate of a princess who must corrupt her soul in order to save her kingdom.

name: Die in the Dungeon
short_description: Fight your way through a mysterious dungeon in this deck-building, turn-based roguelike game where you don't use cards, but dice! Deal with enemies by combining powerful dice on your board, boost their effects with magical relics, and risk it all hoping for a good roll on unexpected encounters.

name: Atompunks 1969
short_description: Atompunks 1969 - You and Your friends must battle the starship factory and evil atombots for control of atomopia. (Single Player OR Multiplayer {PvP OR CO-OP})

name: The Ghost of Nichishima
short_description: You thought moving to a peaceful Japanese village and starting a new life was a good idea, well was it? Inspired by eerie real life events and Japanese folklore, this immersive first person horror will have you explore Nichishima but you will soon realize that every shadow might hide your fate.

name: Hard Wheelchair
short_description: Hard Wheelchair is a challenging physics-driven game where you control a wheelchair through a series of tough. Precision, patience, and persistence are key—can you roll your way to victory?

name: Celestials Door
short_description: Celestial's Door is a psychological horror game where you, as a desperate husband, search for your missing wife, Dee.

name: The Quintessential Quintuplets OMOIDE VR ~YOTSUBA~
short_description: The Quintessential Quintuplets OMOIDE VR ~YOTSUBA~ is the second official VR adventure game based on the popular manga series! Play as Futaro Uesugi and enjoy spending time with the fourth Nakano Quint, Yotsuba, in this VR adventure game.

name: PGA TOUR 2K25
short_description: Take your best shot at glory in PGA TOUR 2K25! In a 2K-first, compete in three prestigious major tournaments. Personalize your game with expanded MyCAREER, MyPLAYER and Course Designer options. Challenge friends across ranked, casual, and cross-platform multiplayer.

name: Journey of Resurgence
short_description: In this open-world survival strategy game, you are a survivor in a post-apocalyptic world. Explore a vast map to find food, water, and resources to sustain your camp. When facing various antagonists, use strategy to assemble a powerful team. Every decision you make will impact the characters' fates.

name: GG Tanks
short_description: A game to show your friends that, inside a tank, you are the best in arena battles.

name: Haunted Property
short_description: A new life begins in a low-cost apartment. Strange occurrences at night and the suspicious behavior of neighbors gradually push the protagonist to the edge.

name: Shadow Spell Saga: The Winds of Fate
short_description: A tactical RPG set in an original fantasy world. Driven by story, characters, and nostalgic strategy gameplay. 26 chapters, 40+ playable characters, and dozens of secrets to discover.

name: Caretaker
short_description: Tasked with investigating mysterious disappearances of local children, you are pulled into another world. In this horror/puzzle game, work your way through a mysterious playland dimension using toys to navigate and solve puzzles to uncover secrets. Be careful, something might be waiting for you...

name: Cinnabunny
short_description: Cinnabunny is a cozy life simulator game where you play as a bunny who runs a bakery. Unlock new recipes, go birdwatching, collect mushrooms, and charm your community. Save up enough carrots to help your family move.

name: Monsters in the Moonlight: Tetris
short_description: An auto chess game using Tetris! Choose a hero and buy Tetris blocks to create a powerful battle force, then bravely enter Dracula's castle!

name: Laruaville 16
short_description: The game features numerous Match-3 levels with diverse mechanics, as well as bonus games that are completely skippable—you can play them after finishing the main game or skip them altogether. Additionally, you’ll need to build a brand-new city.

name: Perpetuo
short_description: Perpetuo is a first-person psychological horror game where you explore a mysterious apartment trapped in an endless time loop. Solve challenging puzzles, uncover a haunting story, and survive as a lurking presence grows stronger with each cycle.

name: Snowflake Master
short_description: Create your own unique paper snowflake. Make up or repeat ready-made patterns that will take your skills to the next level. Let your imagination run wild!

name: Mini City: Mayhem
short_description: Build, plan, and flourish while the time is running! Mini City: Mayhem is a chaos-filled city-builder where you build against time. Become the mayor of a tiny town, plop down tiny building blocks to build a working city to progress. Become the greatest urban planner of all time!

name: ARCA-102
short_description: Face logic challenges in this Escape Room game, where every second counts! Join Mirra, your mercenary partner, to uncover the mysteries of an abandoned colonizer ship on an unknown planet.

name: 幽霊屋敷と猫の家
short_description: Protect your cat, defeat the monsters, and build a happy home for your cat. Battles, crafting, exploration and conversations lead to the truth of the mansion and the whereabouts of your cat. A dark and heartwarming mansion-robbing horror adventure begins.

name: Corporate Suck Up
short_description: Oliver’s future at Reeve's Capital depends on winning over three strange colleagues while working as a secretary. Nothing ominous is happening if he doesn't think too hard about it.

name: Doors of Insanity: ReOpened
short_description: Gear up, sling cards, roll dice and power through the endless doors of a deeply unhinged Purgatory in Doors of Insanity: ReOpened!

name: POPOPOSAN
short_description: 'She' spoke 'something' and chased after me. Back then, running away was the only thing I was good at. At home and at school, I had no place where I belonged, and I always wanted someone to play with. 'POPOPOSAN' is an adventure game based on urban legends.

name: StarbaseSim
short_description: Operate the Starship space launch system and learn how to catch a rocket to understand what it takes to colonize Mars in this ever-evolving simulation of SpaceX Starbase Texas.

name: Sunny Reef
short_description: Forget civilization. Forget comfort. Your yacht has crashed and you find yourself the sole survivor on the deceptively beautiful Sunny Reef. Snow-white beaches and crystal clear water hide a ruthless struggle for survival, where danger comes not only from nature.

name: 万界之塔 The tower of the world
short_description: 在这款以时间与命运为核心的回合制RPG游戏中，主要以推动剧情、迷宫探索、以及如何来强化自身队伍为核心玩点。您将扮演一名穿越至游戏世界的玩家，从一开始的随随便便玩乐心态，逐渐认识这个世界，不断的认识新的小伙伴，展开了一段奇妙之旅。

name: The Executive - Movie Industry Tycoon
short_description: Shape the history of the Hollywood movie industry in this sandbox business simulation game. Create the movies you've always wanted to see, hire the best team, research cutting-edge technologies, and dominate the Box Office. Can you rise from a small studio to a Hollywood giant?

name: Catch That Pizza! Maze Game
short_description: Catch pizza as it magically teleports around a hedge maze, then race to the exit! Featuring relaxing Italian-themed music and fun sound effects.

name: The House
short_description: The House is a single player horror and thriller game. As a journalist, you are trapped in a house where the paranormal is on the rise. It's up to you to find photos, notes and tapes and escape the house to survive!

name: Terrarium
short_description: Cozy fires, books, and tiny glass bottles filled with endless possibilities. In Terrarium, make your vision a reality and craft the cozy dioramas you've always dreamed of. The only question is, what will you build first?

name: Who Made This
short_description: Who Made This is a fun, light and easy-to-play click and point investigation game. Put your detective skills to the test by walking around the city and visiting various places, collecting the information you need to solve the cases.

name: Forsaken Facilities
short_description: A 1-4 player coop horror experience. Find your way through everchanging environments to gather precious treasures for your kidnappers. The more you gather the longer you will survive.

name: Dad Hungry!
short_description: You’re stuck on the island of hunger, and you need to find all the food to escape. However, you come to realize that you’re not the only one who’s hungry…

name: 7 Days Shrine
short_description: '7 Days Shrine' - discovered on a Japanese internet forum, rumored to grant any wish. But this ancient ritual comes with strict rules that must be obeyed. As each day passes, anxiety and fear slowly consume you. Do you dare to undertake the 7 Days Shrine ritual?

name: Dualikiwi
short_description: Dualikiwi is a puzzle game in which your enemies mirror your movements. Your evil clones are stronger than you - use your environment to defeat them and emerge victorious!

name: heart of Y
short_description: Heart of Y follows the protagonist's journey to find the 'Heart of Y' in a shattered world. Players take on the role of an amnesiac traveler as they explore ancient ruins, solve hidden puzzles, and interact with a variety of characters to uncover the truth behind the world.

name: 우리들의 4분 33초
short_description: 'Maybe...we all are deaf.' This is a sweet-bitter story based on modern times. Also, this is a visual novel game with simple menu and using click or space bar to play, without no choice. Although, this game is not a simulation game only for love.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak II
short_description: Return to the Calvard Republic and unravel the mystery of the crimson beast! One day, a shocking series of murders set the wheels of fate into motion once again. Chaos looming on the horizon, the spriggan Van Arkride receives an unexpected visitor. Who is behind the murders, and what is their goal?

name: House Filled With Cats
short_description: Embark on a heartwarming hide-and-seek adventure in House Filled With Cats! Explore beautifully hand-drawn, whimsical rooms filled with cozy charm as you hunt for adorable, mischievous cats tucked away in every nook and cranny. Can you find them all? Purrhaps!

name: 法医探案团之碎嘴小诗
short_description: 在《法医探案团之碎嘴小诗》中，玩家将化身被害人小诗，用独特的“逝者视角”沉浸式与法医一同寻找自己死因真相！通过“拟真尸检”和“嫌疑人的调查”、“多样的剧情选择”和“技能释放”中冲出层层迷雾，而在扑朔迷离的案情不断袭来之时，一个「糖果岛」的神秘符号，竟引出无数少女的神秘失踪与被囚禁的线索，把案件再次推向新的高潮！

name: Hellcrackers
short_description: Hellcrackers is a survivors-like you can play solo or with up to 8 friends locally. Fight waves of monsters, and buy upgrades from the coins you collect! If you are a few coins short you can always accept curses for some extra cash!

name: DescTop
short_description: DescTop is a cozy typing game where you can type at your own pace, in your own speed, how ever you like. You can type the target word given to you or you can type your essay in the ingame notepad; whatever you type you will be rewarded for it.

name: SAE
short_description: SAE takes you to a dreamlike yet perilous tropical island chain in the South Pacific. Survive the natural perils, gather resources, and find your way back to civilization.

name: The Immemorial Order II Sisters of Darkness
short_description: The Immemorial Order II Sisters of Darkness is primarily a spooky, atmospheric, first-person walking simulator that doesn't take itself too seriously.

name: Ultra Mega Planet Battles
short_description: Ultra Mega Planet Battles (UMPB) is an intense arcade-style, space-based, twin-stick shooter. Players can play by themselves, or with up to 3 friends local co-op or Steam Remote Play (total of 4 players). Select your character, select and modify your ship, then get shooting!

name: SNAKE GAME ULTRA CORE
short_description: SNAKE GAME ULTRA CORE is an arena shooter where you play as a snake with a shotgun, escaping from a laboratory and seeking revenge on your enemies.

name: City of Springs
short_description: Design and build drones to take down a corrupt regime and their army of clockwork robots! Sneak and fight your way through the city of Riveton to inspire the people to rise up for their freedom in this steampunk action adventure.

name: Reverse Problem
short_description: Navigate through small diorama islands and tackle 200 handcrafted parking challenges with 100 unique trucks and buses. For an extra challenge, create your own custom problems in the Sandbox mode!

name: Dream fallen remake - village
short_description: Dream fallen is a remake of a game launched 13 years ago, beside of the remake it also bring a continuation for the plot changing few aspects of the game like gameplay and puzzles. The game pass in a well know village and the goal is to solve all the tasks and stay alive to tell it.

name: PARRYMAN
short_description: 'Parryman' is a hardcore action game where you fight using only the counterattack skill of parrying. Put your parrying skills to the test with 'Parryman'.

name: Mournight
short_description: Mournight is a horror game where 1-4 players collaborate to survive and solve the mystery. Explore locked rooms, collect cursed objects, and stay alert against a terrifying creature that hunts you in the dark.

name: Blazing Trail
short_description: Escape failed! All we have left is our will to survive, the endless hordes of enemies, and enough bullets to rip them all to shreds. Blazing trail. Vertical co-op shooter, offering accessible, action-packed gameplay.

name: Audacity
short_description: Grab your friends and escape Auda City, which has come under attack from the living dead. Bullet hell meets zombies, do you have the Audacity to survive?

name: Shift'n Slay
short_description: Shift’n Slay is an amped-up turn-based tactical roguelike, where you fight your way through a cyberpunk hell step by step, trying to break a time loop engineered by corporate bastards.

name: The Most Perfect Revenge in the World
short_description: I made one request to the devil, to make my teacher suffer for what he did...

name: Outrunner: Neon Nights
short_description: Race, outplay, destroy! Outrunner: Neon Nights blends high-speed arcade racing with tactical light trails. Challenge your friends and compete online with up to 8 players in gravity-defying arenas. Master power-ups and diverse game modes to take the lead.

name: 3°C: Sand Puzzle
short_description: Feel the thrill of clearing connected grains all at once!

name: Car Guys
short_description: Experience the thrill of Car Guys, a high-octane multiplayer racing game! Represent your nation, compete in explosive races, and climb the global leaderboard. Customize your ride, engage in daily and weekly championships, and enjoy seamless online play with Photon Quantum. Join the race today!

name: Grow Harvest Repeat
short_description: A relaxing farming game where you plant, grow, and harvest crops. Cultivate your garden, unlock new tools, and expand your farm at your own pace. Enjoy a peaceful and rewarding gameplay experience.

name: THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIII GLOBAL MATCH
short_description: Relive the pinnacle of 2D sprite-based fighting! Enhanced for online play! Complete with rollback netcode and overhauled online functionality!

name: Monster Hunter Wilds
short_description: The unbridled force of nature runs wild and relentless, with environments transforming drastically from one moment to the next. This is a story of monsters and humans and their struggles to live in harmony in a world of duality.

name: Where the Walls Breathe
short_description: Where the Walls Breathe is a first-person psychological horror experience with a strong focus on atmosphere and environmental storytelling.

name: SecretPact:Restart
short_description: 'SecretPact: Restart' is a fantasy adventure visual novel created by the solo studio C0Entertainment in 2025. It tells the story of the protagonist, Lu Yu, who lives in 1999 and unexpectedly uncovers a long-buried secret, leading to a series of events.

name: Zaraq
short_description: Zaraq is a roguelike deckbuilder where you have access to a forbidden arcade from the 80's. Craft the best deck of symbols, artifact and spells to score the maximum amount of points to beat Zaraq.

name: Horizons: The End Of Words
short_description: Expand through an infinite galaxy by making words

name: Cage of Roses
short_description: A haunting gothic romance set in the 19th century. Follow Meike, a young woman from an impoverished noble family, as she’s swept off her feet by the mysterious Magdalena: a vampire who possesses a dark secret.

name: Cold Warms Us.
short_description: In Cold Warms Us, survive a frozen wilderness as you search for 13 fallen expedition members. By day, scavenge and craft to stay alive; by night, fight off deadly threats. Balance hunger, cold, and health as you uncover the secrets buried in the snow. Will you endure the unforgiving cold?

name: Sanechek: Lost Coins
short_description: Lost, Found, Ate. A unique story about Sanechek, a cat girl who lost her coins and can’t afford chips. An indie project by a solo developer, created in a short time to tell a heartfelt tale inspired by a real-life character.

name: Cook Saga
short_description: Learn new skills, buy counter, upgrade your restaurant, and COOK, COOK until there is no more customer. Cook saga is a game about skill and financial decision making for still be here tomorrow.

name: Rosttle
short_description: 'Rosttle' is a solo-developed 2D top-down shooter where players must survive each round by collecting yellow energy dots on the field, navigating map obstacles, and employing various tactics to vanquish monsters, earn coins, and secure rewards.

name: KONG FU
short_description: A hilarious ragdoll boxing game starring... gorillas.

name: Darkblade Ascent
short_description: Fast paced First-Person Melee Roguelike RPG with randomly generated weapons and upgrades, unlockable new classes and persistent leveling. Hack and slash your way through atmospheric dark fantasy locations, unique monsters and bosses.

name: Zero Point Survivor
short_description: Collect up to 21 unique weapons and wreck machines, kill space squids and blast asteroids into bits. Gather valuable gold and spend it for upgrades and new ships as you venture deeper into the depths of space, to the Point of No Return.

name: From The Other Side
short_description: 'From the Other Side' immerses you in a chilling first-person psychological horror game. You are Steve, a security guard on his first night at work, tasked with monitoring security cameras and fixing unsettling anomalies that will make you question reality.

name: Coin Hunter
short_description: A game to pass the time between long downloads, triple-A titles, excuses for housework or just to keep busy, then this coin pusher game is just the thing for you. But be careful, this game has a high addictive factor.

name: BrokenLore: LOW
short_description: BrokenLore: LOW is a psychological horror game set in a mist-covered, beautiful Japanese village, blending hyper-realistic graphics with low-poly elements. The main enemy is the Gashadokuro, a yokai from Japanese folklore.

name: The Fellowship of Infinity
short_description: Travel through mathematical structures in first-person, collecting runes to help uncover and unlock the hidden structures of the universe. Fractals, liminal spaces and encrypted messages are waiting for you.

name: Gravity Cab
short_description: Gravity Cab is a multi-platform 3D action-adventure-puzzler in which players take on the role of a flying taxi driver, transporting passengers and navigating challenging environments influenced by physics.

name: Devil on Your Shoulder
short_description: See your name in lights on Broadway! Find fame, fortune, and true love! All it costs is your immortal soul.

name: Venomous
short_description: Venomous is a 2D action-adventure game where you play as a skilled hero wielding web-slinging, slashing, and shuriken abilities to explore handcrafted levels, defeat unique enemies, and conquer epic boss battles.

name: Dungeon Battles
short_description: Struggling to survive in the dungeon!

name: The Last Strand
short_description: The Last Strand is randomly generated twin stick shooter. You will play a pirate trying to escape a boat and seek vengeance, fighting enemies, helping NPC, discovering secrets and finding items.

name: Rival Roads Car Racing
short_description: Rival Roads Car Racing is a fast-paced top-down single-player racing game where you navigate challenging tracks, outmaneuver rivals, and prove your skills to become the ultimate racer! Upgrade your car, master tight turns, and dominate every race in Rival Roads Car Racing!

name: Burgie's cozy kitchen
short_description: An adorably chaotic idle cooking game. Manage your burger restaurant: minimize the game to the corner of your screen and wait for new customers, who will notice you when they arrive. Perfect as a gamified Pomodoro focus tool, or to integrate with your Twitch chat and play with your viewers.

name: Ascend Factory
short_description: Welcome to Ascend Factory, a factory simulation game that challenges your ingenuity and resource management skills. Immerse yourself in a world of automation and strategic planning as you progress through levels of increasing complexity!

name: Card Toons
short_description: Battle against toons in this cartoony roguelike deckbuilder where each run is different. Improve your deck with various creatures and spells, collect powerful relics, and defeat your enemies to win the Card Toons game show!

name: Neighbors
short_description: A folk noir detective horror game. An old time detective trying to find out the truth behind a missing girl in a mysterious place.

name: Little Slippey
short_description: Dodge tons of missiles flying at you. Practice your reactions, memorize the structure of the maps and adapt to the ever-changing rules on them.

name: Grief like a stray dog
short_description: An isolated village during the war. Men leave one by one, along the winding forest path painted crimson by distant fires, and do not return. Young Nadia becomes a part-time postwoman filling in for her sick mother. She is now a messenger of hope and of trouble.

name: Goblin's Gamble 24
short_description: An online multiplayer survival card game filled with bluffing, courage, and strategy! There's only one revolver on the table, and you never know what will come out of its barrel. Challenge your opponents, make strategic decisions, and be the last one standing!

name: Last Remains
short_description: 'Last Remains' is a highly challenging multiplayer zombie survival game. Players must survive in a city overrun by the undead, scavenging for food, arming themselves, avoiding zombies, searching for loot, plundering other survivors, and finding any possible way to escape.

name: Anima Engine
short_description: Elevate your desktop with Anima Engine! Customize with animations, GIFs, images, videos, and audio in formats like MP4, WEBP, and more. Use AI tools to edit visuals, remove backgrounds, and create a style that's uniquely yours. The only limit is your imagination!

name: Black Fairy Tale
short_description: Transform into a fairy tale girl and engage in simple battles against monsters in front of her. Each school has its own unique characteristics, with hundreds of choices waiting to be made. Embark on a new adventure and uncover the truth behind a dark story.

name: The Losers Team
short_description: Lu Yunjie, a junior high school student, annoyed the school bully group by accident. But he also got a powerful superpower unintentionally. With this power, he challenged the bullies, triggering a series of funny events

name: FACEMINER
short_description: Build a biometric data harvesting empire from scratch in FACEMINER, the hardcore thriller clicker set in 1999. Classify data, upgrade mining infrastructure, and scale up your A.I. surveillance empire to obscene ends in this creepy narrative-driven incremental management sim with a dystopian twist.

name: Carpathian Survival
short_description: Experience the untamed beauty of the Carpathian wilderness. Gather resources, chop trees, mine for materials, craft tools, and build shelter to withstand the harsh environment. Hunt wildlife and master essential survival skills as you navigate the untamed mountains.

name: CyberCook
short_description: A cyberpunk PS1-style cooking game, serve up more than just food. Slice through enemies, decide their fates, and uncover dark secrets hidden within your dystopian kitchen.

name: No Way Out: 13
short_description: A psychological horror puzzle game set in an eerie, endlessly repeating commute. Face mysterious anomalies, make crucial decisions, and uncover the truth as you strive to escape this seemingly endless loop.

name: Shopenkraft's Magic Goods
short_description: Run a magical shop in VR! Forge, brew, and craft for quirky customers!

name: Lava Chaos
short_description: Don't touch the lava! Navigate through increasingly hazardous terrain and survive for as long as possible.

name: Dungeonfell
short_description: Step into Dungeonfell – a single-player tactical, turn-based, Roguelite – where you command a group of Delvers in their quest to save Dungeonfell. Battle through the Dungeon, taking on waves of Monsters, and collecting valuable treasure to upgrade your Delvers.

name: Primal Hearts
short_description: After moving into a new town hoping for a new life, Kazuma finds himself the swing vote between two deadlocked factions representing tradition and innovation. Nicknamed “Triple Seven,” can he still live easy and find romance under his new status as a much-contested lucky guy?

name: Utopia
short_description: Utopia is a city-building strategy simulation game enjoyed with simple rules and casual graphics. Build a city where citizens thrive with happiness on a map made of tiles with various concepts and themes.

name: KAAZ - Featuring Akilah & Zak
short_description: A top down, action-adventure NES game follows the journey of two kids through their imagination. Get your weapons and fight your way through to find out what's wrong with your world.

name: The Escape Room Chronicles ep2:The Old School Building
short_description: Discover items and use your wits to solve puzzles in this mystery! Episode 2: Escape from The Old School Building!

name: Vaccine Zombies
short_description: You are sent to a Vaccine Zombie colony because you have developed early symptoms of the illness that will soon make you a zombie. You may need to eliminate hundreds of zombies to find the antidote. If successful, your mission will be extended to destroy the aliens that started this.

name: The Hunting!
short_description: The Hunting! is a turn-based strategy RPG focused on managing and developing new heroes. Train your heroes so they are ready for the final battle.

name: Death Delivery
short_description: You work as a delivery driver/package handler for 'Fed-ups'. You're loading the packages into your truck as usual when someone next to tells you, they're being stalked.

name: EmyLiveShow: How To Write A Bestseller
short_description: Become the co-author of an amazing book! All you have to do is choose which of the four lovely heroines will inspire you!

name: Lost Records: Bloom & Rage
short_description: Embark on a new narrative journey by the creators of Life is Strange. Film your summer of 1995 and create memories of a lifetime with your new friends. 27 years later, confront the dark secrets that made you all promise to never speak again after that fateful summer.

name: Dead End
short_description: This is a very boring driving game where players need to adjust the direction using the left and right arrows and control the brakes with the spacebar. The goal is to choose the right path to keep moving forward and avoid reaching a dead end. Can you make it to the end?

name: Meme Survivors
short_description: Meme Survivors is a casual game with a vibrant visual style predominantly made up of popular memes, featuring simplified roguelike elements. Waves of Cheems, Doge, and other enemies face off against Pop Cat and his friends!

name: Sid Meier's Civilization VII
short_description: The award-winning strategy game franchise returns with a revolutionary new chapter. Sid Meier's Civilization® VII empowers you to build the greatest empire the world has ever known!

name: SPELLHACK!!
short_description: SPELLHACK!! is a real-time survival deckbuilder! Explore Doom City to collect and upgrade Technospells during the day, then defend against waves of Summoned Beasts at night in this totally rad roguelike!!

name: 3XTINCTION
short_description: 3XTINCTION is an Online Co-op Top Down Shooter with tactical and strategic elements. You and your friends will have to cooperate in order to complete missions.

name: Devil Hunters
short_description: A vampire survival game with 10 bosses with their own unique moves, a dozen heroes, runes, unlimited gems, and Sun Wukong!

name: Unique Ladies
short_description: Love, fine food, and romance await! Join Laura Renaldi, a charming sales manager, on a whirlwind trip to an exclusive hospitality conference in Stockholm. Amidst galas and business deals, she’ll meet stunning women—will one be her true love? A heartwarming Yuri VN with humour, jazz, and romance!

name: Deadly Footprints
short_description: Deadly Footprints is a top-down 2d horror game about being chased through a maze by a deranged killer who is following your footprints in the snow. How can you escape the killer when every step you take brings him closer to you?

name: The little Puzzle House
short_description: Welcome to the little puzzle house. Solve puzzles, a Simon game, a pair matching game and more in a nice cozy atmosphere. Take your time, unlock the other rooms and progress through the house.

name: Eternal Rifts
short_description: Liberation or Journey? Eternal Rifts is a strategy and collectible card game about multi-universes, exploring planets and worlds, exploring the remnants of civilization, and assembling your own pocket army to battle the ultimate evil consuming space.

name: PropFight
short_description: PropFight is a 2D physics-based fighting game where you play randoms props in random arenas, with random events occuring.

name: PROJECT TACHYON
short_description: An exhilarating run-and-gun action shooting game based on a Roguelite! Travel through time with Sigma to thwart the uprising of artificial intelligence and fight for the future!

name: Slime Rush : Leshy and the Magic Book
short_description: Slime Rush! Jump into a thrilling hack-and-slash adventure with Leshy and the Magic Book! Wreck relentless slimes, unleash crazy magic combos, power up with runes, and reclaim the Red Panda Temple! Get ready to bash, blast, and dominate!

name: AmaZoo
short_description: Help KoKo on his first day at work! Push, kick, grab and rearrange the boxes, while avoiding the dangers throughout the mega-warehouse. Solve all the puzzles and finally reach the exit!

name: HoloRun
short_description: HoloRun is a fast-paced, fun-filled game designed for Hololive fans to connect, compete, and celebrate their favorite talents in an exciting virtual playground.

name: ViCrew
short_description: ViCrew is an RPG with turn based combat in which you build a crew of Vikings to go on glorious raids. Explore random generated maps and plunder as much as you can. Level your characters and get strong enough to beat the toughest enemies.

name: 实至名归TCA2024（Yes or No?）
short_description: Yes or No？ is a unique semi simulation management role-playing game, where players will transform into a somewhat famous collector and embark on a challenging and strategic treasure appreciation journey.

name: Lofi aquarium
short_description: 'Lofi Aquarium' is a gamified focus tool designed to enhance concentration and relieve stress. As you work, a group of adorable baby fish will keep you company, all set to soothing lofi music. Over time, the fish grow and can be sold for profit. ﻿

name: Haunted House 2
short_description: In the infamous haunted building 'Changrong Tower,' security guard Li Cheng has come to understand the true nature of ghosts and their purposes. This time, he embarks on another adventure to help vengeful spirits, driven by a desire to uphold his deepest values.

name: Storm Burst: Tornado Alley
short_description: Prepare and seek shelter as one of nature's most fearsome threats bears down on your farmstead. Cover ground as quickly as possible and attempt to survive the horror of the ever looming tornado danger.

name: Novus Orbis
short_description: A combo-based deckbuilding roguelike through a space-time loop: collect cards, receive blessings, add pets to your party, and grow stronger. Chain together cards in the right order for max power, and act before the enemy does. Build synergistic decks, find many secrets, and make BIG numbers!

name: The OG Cake Factory
short_description: You've woken up in this magnificent cake factory, but soon realize that a crazy chef is after you… Get ready to bake cakes in this stressful First-person Horror game!

name: Waiting in the Lime forest
short_description: Face your friend's twisted mind and do your best. You should stay sane until the end.

name: Brány Skeldalu 2: Pátý učedník
short_description: The Fifth Disciple is a classic point-and-click adventure with turn-based battles from 2002. It tells the story of Engeor, a student at a magical university, who becomes one of the random victims of the regime, and his journey to overthrow the Moharn dictator Wahargem.

name: Taco Terror
short_description: TACO TERROR is a boomer shooter set in a cyberpunk future where capitalism rules everyone - except for you. Run, gun, choke, dive, jump, love(?), and slide your way through the forces of T.A.C.O. Take back New TACO City from these forces of fried evil before you become too... delicious.

name: Unusual and not safe experiments
short_description: Unusual and NOT Safe Experiments is an action-puzzle game where you control a robot trying to escape from an abandoned complex, overcoming traps and solving puzzles.

name: UNCURSED
short_description: A chilling horror experience. Return to your grandmother's house, only to discover a terrifying nightmare. Can you survive the horrors that await you?

name: Office Overloaded
short_description: Type quickly to process incoming documents without burning out. Sharpen your skills, climb up the ranks and challenge your coworkers around the globe. Can you stay cool under pressure and become the next CEO?

name: A Tiny Space Adventure
short_description: **A Tiny Space Adventure** follows a brother and his dog, Jupiter, on an exciting journey through space to rescue his sister. With fun puzzles, quirky characters, and unique aliens, this adventure offers a delightful experience for players of all ages.

name: FISH FEAR ME
short_description: A top-down action roguelite about catching fish, fighting them, selling their bones, and catching more fish. Upgrade your boat and weapons, hunt down sea monster bounties, delve into eldritch mysteries, and try to pay off a cosmic debt millennia in the making.

name: No Room For Error
short_description: To become the best ninja, you will have to do some training... dangerous training. But training nevertheless. Jump, climb, and sprint your way through levels that are... never the same?

name: Crescent Roll
short_description: Serve up a slice of late 2000's app store nostalgia with this short-but-sweet gravity-altering physics-based 2D ball-rolling game.

name: Zavod
short_description: The visual novel 'Zavod' is an adventure that will take you to the industrial and factory everyday life of ordinary workers.

name: Charta Dungeon - Ambidextrous
short_description: Poker Roguelike Adventure! Build Your Fate. Here, you will play as a card master and embark on an adventure full of unknowns and challenges by cleverly combining skill cards and playing cards.

name: Transylvania Drift
short_description: Transylvania Drift is a unique drifting game which takes place in the beautiful region of Transylvania! Take on your opponents with the most iconic cars and show them who owns the Transylvanian roads!

name: Bunker 2
short_description: You have to visit an abandoned bunker and find mysterious artifacts in a limited time, your flashlight charge will not last long and staying in such a place in complete darkness will mean certain death

name: LYMBUS
short_description: Descend into a digital labyrinth of our own making. Move around with your keys. Do everything else with your cards. Exercise maximum strategy in building your deck, then throw it out the window in screen-shaking, bullet hell-style battles. Combat happens in real time, meaning every moment matters.

name: Plague Doctor And Panacea
short_description: “Plague Doctor and Panacea” is a thrilling game where you are the last ray of hope for a doomed city plagued by a mysterious epidemic. Your mission is to infiltrate the gloomy castle dungeon full of dangers and find the ingredients for a universal cure.

name: Tech Blast
short_description: Tech Blast is an action-puzzle game where a young mechanic explores an abandoned planet, solving puzzles, building mechanisms, and battling ore insects.

name: A Fugu's Dive
short_description: A glimpse into the daily life of a Fugu.

name: Reinbo
short_description: Reinbo is a hack and slash where you'll cut your way through waves of enemies and bosses on a journey to rescue your loved one

name: Microtopia
short_description: Become the hive mind of a robot ant colony in Microtopia! Use pheromone trails to create, automate and optimize supply chains for your ants to follow. Collect resources, produce goods, feed your queen, grow your colony and fly out to expand the species!

name: MISTERY
short_description: A multiplayer game of survival and social deduction. You work with others to collect materials, survive the dangers, and complete tasks. Beware of monsters, but more of the alternates disguising as your teammates. They can change into supernatural monsters and attack you at any time.

name: Shoot P
short_description: Shoot anything that moves.

name: Ghost Infinite Labyrinth
short_description: You have wandered into a Japanese labyrinth where ghosts lurk. Escape from this strange space while running away from the ghosts.

name: BlueCloud Summit
short_description: Ascend above the blue clouds to the highest point in the world, where a gateway to a heavenly realm awaits. To thrive on this journey, you must strategize carefully, take calculated risks, and craft a unique deck that emphasizes powerful synergies.

name: Global Shipping Simulator
short_description: Dive into the fast-paced world of logistics and become the master of delivery. Manage your business, customize your space, and ensure every order is delivered on time. Can you build a delivery empire?

name: 片腕のザリガニ - one-armed crayfish
short_description: 「逆張りなんて反抗期の一種でしかない」そういって順張りで生きることを信条とする高校生の野崎優太は、それによって毎日平穏な日々を送っていた。しかし何に対しても逆張りばかりするクラスメイトの三好岬を通じて本当の自分の気持ちへと向き合っていく。

name: Never Experiment On Cats!
short_description: The test cats have broken free! They're getting into all the equipment, from jetpacks to lawnmowers and paintball guns! Bounce, bash, and blast your way to the top of the scoreboard! Is there more to the lab? Who's behind it all?

name: All on Board!
short_description: Designed from the ground up for VR, All on Board! offers seamless board game experiences. Join this ever-evolving platform and connect with fellow board game enthusiasts! Choose your avatar and enjoy playing solo or with friends, diving into some of the most popular board game franchises.

name: JUMP KING QUEST
short_description: Brave The Heights together or alone in this unhinged Multiplayer-Combat-RPG successor to the Original Tactical Leaping Adventure from Nexile.

name: MyClipboard
short_description: Clipboard Manager is a smart and efficient Windows clipboard manager that displays your copied text, images, files and more. Instantly access your history with a keyboard shortcut, search content, edit images, track sources, and back up your clipboard. Stay organized and productive !

name: Wilderless: Meadowfell
short_description: Explore a peaceful, procedurally generated fantasy open-world where nature is your only companion.

name: Puzzle Summit: Solve & Rise
short_description: Puzzle Summit: Solve & Rise is a brain-training puzzle game featuring dozens of challenges like Sudoku, Nonogram, and Fill Lines. Players engage their cognitive skills across hundreds of levels, solving puzzles while improving memory, focus, and problem-solving abilities.

name: Code Reactors
short_description: Build your own Magic Deck and set off on a quest in this magical battle-packed 2D-action RPG.

name: 迷雾之村Misty Village
short_description: An adventure suspense, love simulation visual novel game. The player plays the role of a boy who runs away from home and enters a strange village in the fog. Then he meets the girl in the village and gradually uncovers the mystery of the village. Your final choice determines the ending of the two.

name: Cabernet
short_description: Cabernet is a 2D narrative RPG set in a 19th century Eastern European inspired world, with a modern twist. Guide Liza, a young vampire in her new unlife among the unsuspecting townsfolk. Will you retain your humanity or descend further into the horror you have become?

name: Leafscape
short_description: There are thousands of leaves in the yard, and your job is to keep it clean. Rake and blow leaves into compost bins, upgrading your tools to keep up with the ever-increasing waves of leaves in this satisfying yard cleaning simulation.

name: Red Lightning
short_description: A 2D Top-Down Action/Adventure in the vein of retro-gaming archetypes. Strategically maneuver your way through Grounds and Mesosphere and upgrade your Red Lightning to take down The SpaceLord!! Go Solo or Couch Co-Op Mayhem

name: Always On
short_description: Choices matter in this interactive short story. It only takes about 1 hour to play through once, but there are multiple endings to explore. You play as an AI assistant to the 7 year old Evie. What kind of bot will you be?

name: Velvet Bite: Softly, with Teeth
short_description: You've been invited to a Halloween party! Yay! Music! Food! Drinks! Vampires! Wait. VAMPIRES!? Velvet Bite: Softly, With Teeth is a Romantic Visual Novel featuring 6 romanceable vampires.

name: Berserk High
short_description: Berserk High is an action RPG in which you defeat numerous enemies with a combination of various skills. The footsteps of the enigmatic wanderer Bella lead to the Furnace of Chaos, where 12 great heroes are confined. She is supposed to endure the most severe trials across the entire universe.

name: Magic Tiny Lands
short_description: Magic Tin Lands is an action-platformer where a small knight travels through a mystical forest to defeat the evil unleashed by a magical monolith.

name: 迷失TheDark
short_description: It's a small psychological horror game where the player takes on the role of a blonde man trying to escape a mysterious villa, and as the process progresses, he will wake up from a dream he has already done 16 times ......

name: Harukuru. - Spring has come true? -
short_description: A Certain Situation. Of course, even if I put it that way there’s no way I can explain the situation I’m in… Thus is the start of a story unlike any other about a guy and 4 girls and the daily life they find themselves in.

name: Dark Genesis
short_description: Dark Genesis is a first-person horror shooting game developed using Unreal Engine 5. Through the power of Unreal Engine 5, players can experience realistic visuals and intense battles with terrifying monsters.

name: Beautiful Checkers
short_description: Play checkers, feel its beauty. Play in wonderful artist-designed environments whether indoors or outdoors. Whether you are an adult, a retiree, or a child, you can enjoy an immersive visual experience of the game of checkers where difficulty does not matter.

name: Screw Puzzle Master
short_description: A casual puzzle game where you simply remove colored screws from the board and place them into matching-color boxes.

name: Vasterra
short_description: Enter the world of Helheim and build your village on a desolate island in the underworld of Norse mythology. Improve and maintain your village by gathering resources and defending it from enemy attacks. Can you thrive in the realm of the dead?

name: Schizo Dark
short_description: Schizo Dark is a survival horror game where you play as a detective investigating disappearances, encountering nightmares, monsters, and terrible secrets.

name: The Solitude Project
short_description: The Solitude Project is a complete rework of A Liminal Place Legacy (also known as Remastered). Find your way to the next level, do whatever you want! But remember... you will never find the exit.

name: If only
short_description: 'If only' is a horror, puzzle-solving, and story-exploration game. You will play as a high school student uncovering the mysteries surrounding his relationship with his parents, gradually discovering the truth about the tragedy that happened within his family.

name: Quantum Odyssey
short_description: Learn to forge logic from the paradoxes at the core of our Universe. Solve open-ended puzzles, hack rival Seekers, master real Quantum Computing, and compete for the most optimal solutions.

name: Valet Simulator: Parking & Business
short_description: Run your own valet company. Start as a beginner and rise to become the best in town. Park cars with precision, deliver exceptional customer service, and expand your business. Compete with rival valet services and dominate valet market with your top-tier valet skills.

name: Island Wayfinder
short_description: Survive on a mysterious island in this action-packed adventure. Master challenging parkour, battle fierce enemies, and uncover hidden secrets. Solve puzzles, and fight for your escape in this immersive survival experience.

name: Idle Together
short_description: A resource management and collaboration game where you gather, build, and progress through a unique constellation-based upgrade system. Accessible, relaxing, and endless—perfect for playing with family or friends.

name: Tortuga City
short_description: Survive Tortuga City as a wanted turtle. Defend yourself against the police, build a rebellion, endure dynamic weather, and find an escape route within 50 days before the police deploy their secret weapon.

name: Void Climber
short_description: Climb through the ruins of a collapsing universe in this unforgiving parkour platformer. Obtain powerful upgrades to reach insane speeds, but one misstep reshuffles the path and sends you back to the start.

name: ツクールシリーズ　アルティエクエスト [RTA QUEST]
short_description: An RPG drawn in nostalgic pixel art has appeared!Three girls set out on a journey to catch up with their hero.Get your equipment in town and prepare for powerful enemies.Dreams and adventures await you!Only Japanese is supported.Other languages are not included.

name: Kitty's Hungry Adventure
short_description: Kitty's Hungry Adventure is a hardcore cozy platformer about Kitty’s adventures as she tries to cook the most delicious dishes while overcoming dangers and solving puzzles.

name: 异世界生存指南
short_description: 【Real and authentic CRPG】 Online, a unique adventure game! Each character has a distinctive image and skills, with unique styles of movements. Players can work together to encircle powerful fantasy legendary creatures, obtain fantasy ingredients,

name: Playtown Genesis
short_description: A stealth-based adventure set in the 1960s where you play as Doctor Clint, navigating the dangerous corridors of a secret underground facility. Outsmart guards, avoid detection, and team up with rebels to bring down a brutal regime.

name: Unbridled: That Horse Game
short_description: Unbridled: That Horse Game offers you the ultimate horse experience, giving you the freedom to follow your own dreams and create your own unique story. Experience the freedom of riding, the challenges of horse sports, and the joy of breeding horses - all in a stunning virtual world.

name: Who's Next?
short_description: 『Who's Next?』 is a free-for-all Tail Tag social deduction game set in the traditional Korean hell, featuring a massacre of ghosts and spirits, with individual survival competition rather than team battles,.

name: Sancticide
short_description: Become Ezechiel, sin collector in service of Them at The Top, as he ventures through what is left of our world during the End Times. It's the Apocalypse and his job is to eradicate sin for the glory of God. But can a mere human really endure such fate?

name: Sakura Hime 5
short_description: Become the hero and embark on a sweet adventure with the girls of the Sakura Forest! Elves, witches, maids, catgirls... Along the way, you'll win the hearts of various girls and expand your luxurious harem!

name: Kiloton
short_description: Invade your neighbors, conduct bombing campaigns, research and develop nuclear arsenals, and grapple for diplomatic power in Kiloton, a dark and abstract new RTS that puts you in the room where potentially world-ending decisions are made.

name: One Box One Goal
short_description: You're in a box and you have to climb as high as possible... if you can make it.

name: I Just Want to be Single!! Season One
short_description: The anti-dating sim where you make friends instead of girlfriends! Balance between heartbreak and heartache! Will you graduate without a single friend? Or will you survive long enough to reject them all?

name: Alchemists
short_description: Alchemists is a Co-Op horror game that can be played with at least a minimum of 1 and a maximum of 4 players. Your goal is to expel the evil spirit from cursed places by completing the 4 Element ritual. Destroy the monster alone or with your team using your tools.

name: Subject 7
short_description: This game is unlike any game you've ever enjoyed. Undergo a rigorous test of patience where every step you take the cameras follow. Will you obey and discover what lies behind the yellow door?

name: Painted Legend: Knights of Ink & Paper
short_description: An action-adventure platformer in the metroidvania subgenre. The graphics are made in the style of a checkered notebook and blue ink.  Defeat crowds of monsters, overcome traps, explore the game world, unlock new characters and find secrets! And all this to the accompaniment of driving music!

name: New Year Simulator 2025
short_description: In the game you will have to survive the pre-holiday bustle, celebrate the New Year, and then enjoy the peace after the New Year's lull. Relax and feel the atmosphere of the most important holiday of the year!

name: カンフービート
short_description: 少女が最強の拳法家を目指す！リズムに乗ってレッツカンフー！ カンフービートは2Dリズムアクションゲームです タイミングよくボタンを押して移動、ジャンプ、攻撃！ 立ちふさがる強敵たち。行動を見切って拳を叩き込め！ 獲得した技や構えを駆使して戦いを有利に進めよう！

name: METAL SUITS: Counter-attack
short_description: They should never have ticked him off. Begin a hot-blooded revenge as the protagonist Kevin, who has lost everything and was reborn as a cyborg!

name: NO-SKIN
short_description: Horror Roguelike characterized by an experimental artstyle and storytelling, strategic gameplay and deep mysteries

name: Cribbish
short_description: The roguelike deck builder for Cribbage. Choose your build carefully and then super-charge it with relics, potions and perks to trigger outrageous chain reactions. With an endless combinations of builds, which will you choose?

name: LOST EGG the Hard Boiled
short_description: A hard-action adventure game depicting the love and resilience of a boiled egg. Roll through various stages accompanied by poignant music, all aiming for the ultimate destination: the pot. 'I may be a soft-boiled newbie, but I'm going on an adventure to become a tough, hard-boiled egg...!'

name: Fly Rocket Die
short_description: Fly Rocket Die offers an intense experience where you pilot a rocket through challenging tunnels filled with rotating obstacles and unexpected hazards. Each level tests your reflexes as difficulty rises. Can you reach the end without crashing? Ready for the challenge?

name: Silent Research
short_description: Silent Research is a short, atmospheric horror experience. Explore a fog-drenched forest, recover your missing research, and escape—before the silence breaks.

name: Kinetic Canvas
short_description: A simple, beautiful, meditative artistic experience. Create stunning waves of animated light patterns with a simple click of the mouse.

name: Heart of Summer
short_description: Live the anime school life—just like in TV!—filled with off-the-wall comedy, sunshine and CUTE GIRLS!

name: Forest - The Call For Help
short_description: After breaking down and calling for a pickup, you hear a call for help in the forest feet away. You decide to investigate the irregular forest while waiting for your friend to arrive.

name: COLD VR
short_description: Time is your greatest weapon! Move to slow it down, stop, and risk everything.

name: Glitch World
short_description: Glitch World is a retro-platform-shooter where the levels change WHILE YOU PLAY! How far will you make it?

name: Trivia War
short_description: The ultimate trivia showdown! Compete against friends or the CPU in a high-stakes contest where answering questions isn’t just about being right—it’s about survival! Each correct answer lets you attack opponents and upgrade your weapon. Be the last player standing in this fast paced trivia brawl!

name: Cosmic Arcade Tycoon
short_description: A cozy sci-fi arcade sim where you build, customize, unlock, expand and welcome cute alien visitors!

name: Helios Hotel: The Night Shift
short_description: Helios Hotel: The Night Shift is a story-driven choose-your-own-adventure style horror game inspired by paranormal and slasher films.

name: The Maze Project
short_description: The Maze Project is a psychological horror game set in a dark, creepy maze. Unaware of how you found yourself here, you must escape from this twisted nightmare. Survive from the dark manifestations that lurk around the maze waiting for every opportunity to get you, and uncover the hidden secrets.

name: Streets of Rageness: Beat 'Em Up Fighter
short_description: Streets of Rageness is a reimagined '90s beat 'em up classic set in a crime-ridden city under the iron grip of a ruthless syndicate. Amid rampant looting, chaos, and destruction, fight through waves of thugs to become the most powerful fighter on the streets!

name: Dead Dragons
short_description: Who will survive—dragons or humans?

name: Drowned God: Conspiracy of the Ages.
short_description: The original 90's Myst style Adventure Game featuring pre rendered graphics, intricate puzzle solving and step through exploration, preserved exactly as it was first released in 1996 but without the bugs! 'Extras' include the original pitch document, pre production art and loads more.

name: Tiny Dangerous Dungeons Remake
short_description: Guide Timmy the little treasure hunter through traps and puzzles to reach the legendary treasure! Experience the classic mini metroidvania remade with new visuals, music, and content!

name: F11 Football Manager
short_description: Manage your own club in F11 Football Manager. Sign players, upgrade the stadium, negotiate sponsorships and devise tactics to lead your team to glory. Do you have what it takes to be the best football manager?

name: Shogi 3D
short_description: Shogi 3D is a faithful take on the famous Japanese board game. Take a sip of coffee and enjoy a relaxing experience, playing strategic matches with traditional rules in a serene Japanese temple.

name: Last Stronghold
short_description: Welcome to 'Last Stronghold' — a game where the fate of the world hangs by a thread, and you are its last hope. Prepare for dynamic gameplay with epic battles. Enhance your skills and magic, upgrade your armor and weapons.

name: Material Evidence
short_description: Clean up the streets in this hard-hitting action game! Enter a gritty saga of three complex individuals, each driven by their own motives and vices, their paths intersecting in unexpected and violent ways.

name: Attack Of The Dead
short_description: In a world overrun by the undead, can you endure the relentless onslaught of zombies and emerge as humanity's last hope? Dive into the heart-pounding action of Attack of the Dead, where your survival instincts and strategic prowess are your greatest assets.

name: Collect Baby Oil
short_description: Your name is Didi, and you have to run away from the police while collecting bottles of baby oil scattered throughout the city. Dodge various obstacles to keep the chase alive for as long as possible.

name: Hidden Skulls
short_description: Immerse yourself in a short but mysterious adventure in a black and white world full of monsters and evil! Explore the map and find 100 cleverly hidden skulls of different creatures and recreate the picture in color. Play and relax if you are not afraid!

name: Tophet
short_description: Survive the hunt—find the item and use it before the monsters catch you. Search the darkness, uncover secrets, and face the terrifying truth. 4-player co-op with proximity chat—stick together or be lost to the lurking terror. Your friends are your only lifeline. Will you survive?

name: Candlelight
short_description: Candlelight is a puzzle game where each shape you place onto the grid inverts the color of the space it occupies. Every inversion offers the opportunity to alchemize a gem and advance.

name: Into Death and Beyond
short_description: Into Death and Beyond is a gripping first-person survival horror game set on the hostile planet XB32-ENT. As bounty hunter Mark Helkins, scavenge for resources, solve puzzles, and confront terrifying mutants. Unravel dark secrets and capture a rogue alien before it hunts you down. Will you survive?

name: SIGNAL: Uncharted Lands
short_description: Embark on a journey with four adorable explorers! Uncover all the secrets of a post-apocalyptic world, meet the future inhabitants of Earth and enjoy plenty of Easter eggs. Your choices will shape the game's ending, so choose wisely! Or try a second playthrough to catch all the fun moments!

name: Broken World: Save Your Children
short_description: In Broken World: Save Your Children, you play as Josh, a father fighting to keep his kids alive in a zombie apocalypse. Manage resources, build shelters, and set traps as you cross an infested city to reach the airport and reunite with your wife. Every choice matters survive at any cost.

name: Fastro Dude
short_description: You are a space traveler. Your spaceship crashes on a hostile planet and you have to embark on a difficult journey to survive

name: Golden Knight
short_description: Defeat the forces of darkness and bring peace back to the kingdom of Valerond in this action-packed mini metroidvania.

name: Carmen Sandiego
short_description: The scarlet super thief Carmen Sandiego is back! Adorn Carmen’s signature red hat and play as the vigilante herself to navigate a world of espionage, utilizing high-tech gadgets, and ultimately capturing VILE.

name: Recall: Empty Wishes
short_description: Recall: Empty Wishes is a psychological thriller set in Taiwan during the 2010s. Follow Yonny, a sister determined to uncover the truth behind the mysterious disappearance of her brother, Tommy. As she delves deeper, she confronts unsettling secrets, blurring the lines between reality and illusion.

name: EvoWars: New Era
short_description: EvoWars: New Era is a competitive multiplayer open-arena game where a single hit means defeat and your power is determined by your wits and size… Easy to learn, hard to master. For daredevils only!

name: Rabbit Trail
short_description: Wake up in a magical forest... as a rabbit. Something strange has happened to you, and solving it won’t be easy. Explore fascinating worlds, face challenging puzzles, and unravel the mystery of how you lost your human form. Each jump brings you closer to the truth... Are you ready to discover it?

name: HENPRI
short_description: Thrown into prison for an act of self-expression, protagonist Shuichiro must confront both a violent system and his own actions—or else try to find happiness on the inside in this visual novel from the makers of NUKITASHI.

name: Bouncy Escape
short_description: Jump into action with Bouncy Escape! Experience colorful, dynamic gameplay solo or with friends—up to 4 players. Customize your game, collect coins and XP, and compete against players worldwide. Are you ready to become the ultimate jump champion?

name: 32 SECS
short_description: Race through a futuristic highway's traffic with your upgradeable cyber motorcycle. Conquer the streets of a neon lit sci-fi city by beating various trials and challenges.

name: Deadly Heart Gambit
short_description: You only have 3 months left to live. Gamble for extra time in Alice-sama’s life-or-death game. Be careful — she wants to steal your heart.

name: Super Jagger Bomb 2: Go East
short_description: Get ready for a thrilling new adventure with Super Jagger Bomb 2: Go East! from Italy to Mongolia and Kazakhstan, with new mechanics, events, bonus, leaderboards and more!

name: Raise Your Tribe
short_description: A hardcore tactical shooter with horror elements. Battle Machines and Mutants, and build your legacy on a deadly post-apocalyptic Cyberpunk Island. Explore dangerous zones, craft powerful gear, and shape your Cyberware build. Uncover secrets and fight to survive in a brutal, immersive world!

name: Viravius Shooter
short_description: A sentient AI in 2084 faces a hacking adventure to survive. Play as Viravius and tackle 60 incredible levels to guide him towards his destiny that will change forever the world. 16 Different Player Armor, 5 Unique boss fight, Co-Op Campaign.

name: Vermin Control
short_description: In Vermin Control, you will enter a thrilling sci-fi tower defense world filled with strategic combat and high tension. Operate a versatile unit capable of both melee combat and construction, deploy and manage 9 unique devices, and protect key facilities from relentless vermin assaults.

name: Wakey Wakey
short_description: Wakey Wakey is a Puzzle Platformer with a unique world-bending twist. Navigate your everchanging bedroom, take control of new household objects, and overcome surprising obstacles to help this sleepy guy get a good night's rest.

name: Shining Hero
short_description: Shining Hero is a turn-based strategy game blending Slay the Spire and Into the Breach. As the chosen hero, you'll battle the resurrected Dark Lord, using cards and strategic positioning to defeat enemies. Collect new cards, refine your deck, and grow stronger as you face ever-greater challenges.

name: Petrified Pawns
short_description: Play single-player chess against monsters & bosses. Automated attacks dwindle your opponents health down until they're reduced to rubble. Magical healing spells & elixirs keep your units alive. Venture into dungeons & castles for treasures & to dethrone the other faction's bosses & kings.

name: OYASUMII
short_description: Relive the nostalgia with OYASUMII, a horror and exploration game inspired by PSX and N64 classics. Enter liminal spaces and face surreal terrors in an adventure that challenges your skills and sanity. Are you ready to relive the golden age of video games with OYASUMII?

name: The Haunting Of Stabbey Road
short_description: Discover the dark secrets of a once renowned recording studio.

name: Flashing Dark
short_description: Flashing Dark is a first-person horror game about a lighthouse keeper lately transferred to a new outpost. As he struggles to manage his work, he uncovers a dark and terrifying secret of the island he lives on.

name: Dimension
short_description: Make full use of dimensions to clear the area.

name: Biohazard: Siberia
short_description: Trapped in a secret research facility, you discover a terrifying truth- everything was a simulation… until now. Escape mutated horrors, uncover dark experiments, and decide your fate in this mind-bending, atmospheric survival horror.

name: Home Cleaning: Cozy Baby Cleanup
short_description: Home Cleaning is a cozy, family-friendly game where you tidy up a baby’s messes in a playful environment. Use various cleaning utensils to clean rooms, and enjoy the satisfaction of a sparkling home!

name: The Dunkers
short_description: Hand drawn basketball 1 on 1 game. Dunks, layups and blocks you will feel!

name: Crystal: Automaton
short_description: A short automation challenge aimed at everyone from beginner to veteran. Take your time to uncover the lore of an ancient civilization without any dangers. Can you find a clever way to use logistics to overcome the scarce space available?

name: Let's Go Nuts! 2
short_description: An angry bear stole a whole, large jar of nuts. Fortunately, he loses them on the way. Collect all the nuts from the board, catch up with the bear and deal with him once and for all!

name: 再见断刀
short_description: 古风悬疑推理AVG《再见断刀》——在与世隔绝的山庄之中，接二连三地发生了骇人命案。只有通过细致入微的调查，抽丝剥茧的推理，才能定一个是非清白，还一个天理公道。 然而，在逐渐浮出水面的真相之下，似乎还有暗流涌动……

name: Terry's Other Games
short_description: Hi, I'm Terry Cavanagh! You might remember me from such videogames as Dicey Dungeons, Super Hexagon, and VVVVVV. Here are a few other things I've made over the years!

name: 水相 Water：Transformer
short_description: This is a platform jumping game, you can obtain different abilities by transforming between solid, liquid, and steam three forms, thus crossing obstacles and solving puzzles. The workshop allows you design and share their own created maps with the players all around the world.

name: Liminal Border Part III
short_description: Following the events of Part II, Itsuki and the gang's 'Rave' business is close to getting off the ground. Itsuki looks to Meryl Hathaway, a young girl often seen accompanying Kotoko, as a counter to the violence of the Umon-kai as he searches for a way to destroy them once and for all.

name: SPARTA 2035
short_description: 'Sparta 2035' is a turn-based tactics game in the spirit of a classic action movie. Control a squad of mercenaries, complete missions and liberate Africa from terrorists.

name: Lily And Sury - Adventures on Cristya
short_description: Classic platform game, retro style. Help Lily or Sury to rescue your friends from the Evil Wuning, through 8 worlds and approximately 32 levels.

name: Crimsonwood
short_description: Crimsonwood is a roguelike top-down shooter in a cursed national park. Collect various weapons, gain perks and battle hordes of enemies to survive.

name: Soccer Pro Simulator
short_description: Soccer Pro Simulator is a realistic football (soccer) simulation designed to make you feel like a rockstar, making the crowd roar after scoring amazing goals. From powerful midfield shots to spectacular bicycle kicks, experience the thrill of becoming a true legend!

name: Clean It Up!
short_description: Manage your cleaning store where you clean and polish every last smudge of dirt. Use the profits to upgrade your supplies and keep everything clean.

name: Life of an NPC
short_description: An AI-directed town where anything can happen. Let your NPCs thrive, or turn them against each other. Each character has their own goals and desires and responds to events in real time.

name: Sibel's Journey
short_description: Spend a weekend in Berlin with young Sibel, uncovering secrets and exploring the city’s many sides. Meet unique characters, dive into queer stories, and make choices that shape Sibel’s journey through friendship, identity, and self-discovery.

name: 无限骰子
short_description: A text-based adventure game with a theme of another world, featuring a total of fifteen different endings and various plot branches. Players will play as an office worker named Li Zhaoyin, and have a series of love stories with Xie Yuan and Yun Qingchen,They will learn the truth and make choices.

name: Doomed Hell 64: FPS Dungeon Crawler
short_description: Doomed Hell 64 is a retro FPS where you battle through hellish levels filled with monsters and chaos. Battle through endless waves, discover the hidden secrets of hell, and obliterate all living forms!

name: M.I.A.: Mission in Asia
short_description: Tensions were growing on the border of Slaviya. Secret service of Primorye put subversive activities on a wide scale confronted by Federal Security Service (FSS) of Russian Federation. FSS receives information that one of FSS agents was over-recruited by Secret service of Primorye.

name: Shtrek
short_description: SHTREK is a short, minimalist platformer where precision is everything. With 60 levels and 60 lives, every move counts. How far can you go?

name: Toska
short_description: A cozy 2D exploration game. Venture into abandoned buildings, uncover lost secrets, read people's mail, meet interesting characters, and find something nice for your mom.

name: Ursid
short_description: Ursid is a zen puzzle game inspired by the constellations and the beauty of their imaginary pictures. Connect the stars, explore the hidden images, you will gradually reveal an emotional father-son story while counting down to the moment the Ursid Shower appears.

name: Agent Dunoz
short_description: In a dystopian world ruled by megacorporation's, you're a mercenary with a $15,000 debt. Face dice-based combat, moral dilemmas, and irreversible choices in this hardcore Sci-Fi Cyberpunk Text RPG. Will you reclaim your freedom or vanish in the shadows?

name: The Bibites: Digital Life
short_description: Explore real digital life in The Bibites! Play god by guiding your bibites on their evolutionary journey or engineer your own. Analyze their Neural Network brains and genetic information as they adapt to their environments. Save your favorites and test their strength in Challenge Mode!

name: SCP : A Star Replicator
short_description: It's an action shooting game that combines the elements of survival and action RPG, Weapons are enhanced with different parts, skills are upgraded to remove SCP. It deals with the unique SCP of the SCP world view, and enjoy casual survival and combat.

name: Mewseum: Masterpieces
short_description: Mewseum: Masterpieces is a shikaku-style puzzle game where each solved grid reveals part of a great masterpiece. Solve hundreds of puzzles and discover unique paintings in the latest art exhibition of the feline world!

name: I Wanna Quit My Job
short_description: Help Sam quit his job by experiencing his childhood night terror. Within a maze of underground corridors, a contorted masked creature lurks. Collect it's relics to escape the chest tightening nightmare.

name: Peripeteia
short_description: Peripeteia is a first-and-third-person role-playing stealth game taking place in alt-history cyberpunk Poland. Inspired by immersive sims from Ion Storm and Looking Glass Studios, Peripeteia expands on the formula with new ideas and an original setting.

name: iDigging
short_description: In iDigging, you’ll balance treasure hunting, home improvement, and the strategy of hiding from curious neighbors and authorities. Upgrade, dig, and create your best life despite all the challenges!

name: Lilac 0
short_description: The machine world of Molybdion has fallen into disarray. As Nidhogg eats the root of the planet, unending wars rage on the surface! Slice your way through hordes of metallic foes in five frantic levels, defeat fearsome bosses, and dodge countless bullets in this vintage vertical shoot 'em up.

name: SANDRIPPER
short_description: Tear across the desert, obliterating wave after wave with your nuclear missile powered dual-wielding hover tank. A tight, punchy arcade shooter with ludicrous weaponry, exhilarating rocket-tank combat, and daily leaderboards!

name: Carpe Dino: Seize the Date
short_description: “Carpe Dino: Seize the Date” is a journey back in time with a romantic twist. Face the dangers of ancient Pangea, get involved in a few intrigues, and choose a mate to get through the Great Dying. Be ready to decide the future of the entire Dinosaur world… World, which is wider than you imagined.

name: Slime Clicker
short_description: Bright arcade adventure in the world of slimes! Battle bosses, dive into minigames, level up your character, and unlock unique weapons.

name: Forest Asylum
short_description: A short Psychological Horror Experience for one night that takes you through the dark corridors of a mental asylum. For best experience a dark room and headphones recommended.

name: Boundaries
short_description: Boundary is a game of building fences and taking up land. Get more land by purchasing goods from stores!

name: BONLE
short_description: Bonle is a video game designed to help people learn about skeletal anatomy and solve fun puzzles doing it! To progress, you can set new records and gain more points towards your overall score. Use your records to craft new skeletons to play in the game and use your points to buy new cosmetics!

name: Patriotika RPG: Shadow World
short_description: Join Patriotika and her team of superheroines and explore New Haven in this comic book-style pixel art RPG!

name: Tank Blitz: Underdog Division
short_description: Tank Blitz:  is a retro-style 2D top-down tank shooter where you engage in intense battles against a variety of enemy tanks, armored trains, and devastating railguns. Utilize the terrain for cover as you outmaneuver and outgun your foes in strategic combat scenarios.

name: Soul Eyes Demon: Horror Skulls
short_description: The goal is simple to collect bags...

name: Red Blue Cell
short_description: This is a retro barrage flying shooting game. Drive a space fighter plane, shuttle between planets and space stations, and use powerful firepower to destroy enemy space battleships! !

name: Speedboat Simulator
short_description: Speedboat Simulator is a realistic speedboat racing game where you pilot high-speed boats, customize their colors, and compete in thrilling races. Navigate through Hawaiian waters, and make a splash when you reach the finish line!

name: Mayhemers
short_description: 'Mayhemers' is a multiplayer chaos creation game for up to 8 players with a procedurally generated map. Choose your side: Will you be a Mayhemer or a Guardian? Mayhemers' task is to create chaos. Guardians' task is to stop them.

name: Fluffy Sailors
short_description: Fluffy Sailors is a charming action-roguelite where you fight in thrilling real-time sea battles between adorable animal pirates. Fire them at your enemies, capture their ships, and fulfill Her Majesty's royal mission!

name: Pirates of Justice
short_description: Pirates of Justice is a strategic puzzle game where players help pirates destroy corrupt Marine buildings by placing objects to guide a bomb ball to its target. Use your wits to bring down the Marine's stronghold and rise through the pirate ranks.

name: Orderly Havoc
short_description: Orderly Havoc is a time management game where you play as a crazed and obsessive man who must keep everything in order. Complete all your chores before you stress out or something uncanny strikes.

name: The Righteous Scar
short_description: When blades fall silent, and blood tells its tale, a scar remains—a mark not of rage, but of absolution. In The Righteous Scar, violence becomes virtue, and what’s buried beneath the skin reveals a truth only the damned can see.

name: Race or Crash: Secret Racer League
short_description: Race or Crash is a Combat-Racing game, where you can smash into your enemies drivin' your musclecar! You also can choose manual or automatic gear switching! Some nonsense happens here & you need to find out what's goin' on on this goddamn mountain! C'mon, dude!!!

name: Hang up Street
short_description: Build your vocational academy to turn adventurers into your idle heroes, liven up the deserted streets, and advance the levels together!

name: Retro Dungeon Slayer
short_description: Retro Dungeon Slayer is a retro FPS dungeon crawler where you battle through procedurally generated dungeons filled with monsters. Wield swords, discover powerful upgrades, and fight for survival against waves of deadly creatures!

name: Happy Poker
short_description: Dou Di Zhu + LTK + Roguelike = Happy Poker! A roguelike card strategy game inspired by Dou Di Zhu. Build custom decks, use rule cards to upgrade your hand, and strategize discards for explosive damage! With dozens of spell cards and relics, every game is a fresh, exciting challenge!

name: Tiny Pasture
short_description: Meet your new little desk buddies! They’ll snooze, scratch, and scamper around while you work or study (don’t worry, they’ve been trained not to invade your workspace). If you’re good at animal management, they will occupy the bottom of your screen with different kinds and colors!

name: String Theory
short_description: This is a music game where players can practice rhythm skills. Players will practice some basic music structures, and the music will be transformed into attack skills to defeat different enemies.

name: Goblin Assault: Tower Defense
short_description: Goblin Assault is an epic tower defense adventure where you stand against relentless hordes of goblins, monsters, and powerful bosses. Forge your strategy and prepare for a legendary fight!

name: Shelldom
short_description: In Shelldom, snails worship alcohol—a drink they love but one that kills them. Their cults sacrifice their own for more, trapped in a doomed cycle. But legend speaks of the Holy Water, hidden atop a merciless tower. Can you climb, endure, and break the curse? Or will you fall like the rest?

name: BRXKEN INSIDE
short_description: Shion's calm and measured life comes to an end when she meets Akiko. This encounter has the chance to change her life or plunge it further into the abyss of depression and hopelessness.

name: Toy Battlegrounds: Shoot 'Em Up Survival
short_description: Toy Battlegrounds is a shoot 'em up survival game set in a kid’s bedroom. Battle endless waves of toys using a variety of weapons in atmospheric nighttime surroundings. Survive against different enemy types, collect power-ups, and prove your skills in this action-packed toy war!

name: CardScrawl
short_description: Enter the Chaotic Tower and take part in the Tower Lord's gambit in this Auto Battler, Roguelike Deckbuilder. Wielding the power of your Creature and Enchantment decks, the limits of your strategy will be tested. The Tower Lord awaits a worthy opponent. Are you ready?

name: Cut The Birch
short_description: Take on the role of a hero whose main task is to cut down birch trees and destroy enemies. Use an axe and magic to do this. Acquire items and improve skills.

name: The Faceless Killer
short_description: The Faceless Killer is a first-person survival horror game with retro PS1-style graphics, consisting of 2 chapters.
