Solve logic puzzles, fight against your enemies, or hide when there's no other option. Unravel this mystery surrounding the Faceless Killer. Who is he, and what are his motivations?

name: Dofamine VR
short_description: Dofamine VR is a first-person puzzle game in the science fiction genre. Players will navigate a maze of puzzles tied to the investigation of a catastrophic event at a scientific facility where experiments with the 'God Particle,' the Higgs boson, were conducted

name: X-Out: Resurfaced
short_description: Build your fleet and face the alien terror from the deep! Now it’s up to you alone to stop an alien invasion from the depths of the ocean in this legendary, home computer era shoot ‘em up dredged up and faithfully rebuilt for modern platforms – X-Out: Resurfaced!

name: Zero Line
short_description: Zero Line combines endless runner excitement with roguelite elements. Collect energy to unlock new abilities. Each run makes you stronger - death is just a checkpoint. With simple controls but challenging gameplay, push your limits in this addictive, lightweight adventure!

name: 18th Floor
short_description: You are trapped in a virtual abandoned building created by hackers. Find the escape password, or find the real exit.

name: Foddia
short_description: 'I can't leave yet. I came here for a reason. If I leave now, I'll never forgive myself.'

name: Frontline: Assault Corps WW2
short_description: A World War II Turn-based Tactical Wargame crafted with passion and care for history and strategy enthusiasts alike.

name: Stone Simulator – Just Be a Rock
short_description: Stone Simulator is a meditative idle game where you live as a rock enduring endless seasons and absurd events. Survive storms, unlock quirky achievements, and observe a serene, ever-changing world. Perfect for Zen-like relaxation or meme-worthy humor.

name: Serke
short_description: Serke is a hack and slash game where you fight against a virus invasion. Use 5 different weapons to defeat your enemies and save the virtual world.

name: Turbo Takedown
short_description: An infinite runner driving game where collisions are rewarded!  Take out enemies and dodge hazards as you travel through six different biomes and chase the highest score.

name: Poltergeist Prodigy
short_description: You are a new ghost, and to continue existing and uncover how you died you must haunt the living. Delight in being a mischievous ghost in this first person haunter.

name: Fracas
short_description: Fracas is a dungeon crawler that evokes a retro RPG experience and a complex story. In its short duration, it seeks to keep you intrigued as you solve the mystery behind this enigmatic character that has society on the brink of collapse.

name: Spirit Driver
short_description: From the everyday passenger to the horrors of Halloween, Spirit Driver is a short, casual conversation visual novel where your choices can affect the fates of people and spirits alike. Remember, your choices have consequences. Good luck!

name: Firelore: Short Tales
short_description: 3 short stories set in a mystical fantasy universe. You are a newborn Face of God. Hear tales of human suffering and triumph. Decide which Face of God you are. Pick a different fate for each main character. A short, linear experience that is introspective, emotional and spiritual.

name: Stray of Lost Cat
short_description: Welcome to Stray of Lost Cat! Here, your mission is to rescue a uniquely quirky kitten. Collect the soul fragments scattered across various scenes, evade the pursuit of 'Miaodis,' and embark on a relaxing, heartwarming adventure~

name: Yeet Thyself
short_description: Yeet Thyself is a side scrolling endless runner featuring arcade physics swinging.

name: Cute Space Shooter
short_description: Cute Space Shooter is a space shooting game. In this game, you'll pilot a small spaceship through space. The cute visual style combined with fast-paced shooting action offers a unique space adventure experience!

name: Narcissus
short_description: Narcissus is an adrenaline-pumping, top down, action-horror game that puts you in the shoes of the last survivor on a doomed spaceship. The clock is ticking, and danger lurks around every corner.

name: Don't shoot politics
short_description: 2d shooter game where mission is to shoot items to collect points and avoid shooting politics

name: Magical Girl Konoha
short_description: To aid the King, Priestess Konoha plunges into 'Grimoire'! The world inside 'Grimoire' is formed by another world called Grimoire Land in which Konoha becomes a magical girl, and has come to save the world!

name: Never 7 - The End of Infinity
short_description: Save me from this cage of infinity

name: NoRush!
short_description: Think you can conquer this tower? A thrilling climb filled with tough obstacles & lots of 'ouch!' No princess, no treasure, just pure, frustrating fun. Prove yourself!

name: Open Fishing 2
short_description: Open Fishing 2 is a chill open world fishing game. Fill out a book with 115 fish species, meet friendly fish gods, sail the oceans with your boat, cook, draw your own map, and enjoy fishing without worries.

name: SpyFall
short_description: Spyfall is a thrilling 5-player multiplayer game of deception and strategy. Blend in as a spy completing secret missions, or play as the sharp-eyed police officer tasked with catching spies among NPCs in a lively city. Who will outsmart whom?

name: Run Pro
short_description: How about a race against time? Create new worlds and race against the whole world with your friends!

name: These Darker Tides
short_description: Welcome [EMPLOYEE] to your new job protecting Deep Sea Cables from creatures of the deep. We're not liable for loss of limbs, sanity, or life while on the job. Don't forget to keep your desk clean and your eyes on those cameras!

name: Totally Defenceless
short_description: Totally Defenceless is a wave-based tower defence game. You will need to protect your energy cores from the invading alien bugs by strategically constructing a maze of towers to alter their path to your advantage.

name: Tiny Duck Hunt 3D
short_description: Next generation arcade game in a cute cartoon 3D world. Sweet graphics, nice gameplay, unique control system focused on handheld and joypad gaming.

name: Metamorph
short_description: Woken up one day to find your body turning into something in equal parts horrifying and unfamiliar, you decide to attempt to score a date with your crush before it's too late. Navigate high school and a kafkaesque nightmare, while trying to win the affection of your beau before the week ends.

name: Heroes Project
short_description: Turn based strategy, tough choices, short and long term consequences.

name: Suikoden I&II HD Remaster Gate Rune and Dunan Unification Wars
short_description: A hero's destiny is written in the Stars. The legendary KONAMI JRPGs Suikoden I and Suikoden II have now been remastered in HD!

name: Golden Warden
short_description: A rogue-like battle game with easy controls. Pick a card each turn as you aim for the dungeon depths and attempt to claim the treasure that the Golden Warden protects as your own.

name: Dice & Sword
short_description: DICE & SWORD is a board game base RPG developed by a solo-indie base in Hong Kong. Let roll the dice to start your adventure!

name: Lightning Katana
short_description: Kick doors, shoot lightning, and parry bullets in this blazing fast first-person shoot'n slash inspired by Hotline Miami

name: Do No Harm
short_description: Lovecraftian Doctor Simulator. Diagnose patients by analyzing unsettling symptoms and treat them using your Book of Medicine. Make moral choices — decide who to save or kill, discover whom to trust, and unlock multiple endings! Can you endure 30 days of perilous decisions?

name: Everhood 2
short_description: AN UNCONVENTIONAL ARPG where you battle enemies through musical encounters while being accompanied by a raven who promises to retrieve your voice if you slay the mighty Mind Dragon!

name: Tatar Altan vs Shaitan
short_description: An epic slasher about the Tatar warrior Altan and his battle with Shaitan on earth and underground.

name: The Fire Nobody Started
short_description: This is a train to 21C, via 19C. Passengers will require a valid click to use this service. Passengers are advised that this train consists of 9 cars, divided by each era. Please mind the fire. This train is ready to depart, please stand clear of the fire.

name: Hunt the Pale Gods
short_description: A cosmic horror roguelike tactical deck builder. Fight nightmarish creatures, add cards to your deck, discover powerful curios and combine all their unique effects in game breaking synergies. Awaken and Hunt the Pale Gods.

name: Level 13
short_description: Escape your apartment corridor starting on Level 13. Look closely for anomalies to find the way out and avoid any unpleasant neighbors you find along the way.

name: Same Room Same Day
short_description: Step into the mind of Rosaline in this psychological horror FPS. Face her fears, engage in intense combat, and help her find peace. Solve puzzles to unlock her psyche's secrets and progress by completing quests

name: Don't Let Me Rot
short_description: This is a psychological horror game where you will solve puzzles and explore a 90s-style house. The realistic art style enhances the eerie atmosphere of the game. (Please do not play this game before bedtime.)

name: ZAMOK
short_description: 5 stories of students in a dying dorm

name: Apocalypse ? No !
short_description: In Apocalypse ? No ! you play a survivor accompanied by his faithful dog in a world in ruins. Discover many varied maps: From a peaceful forest, through survivor camps to ruined cities, these maps are just waiting to be explored.

name: Stalked in Solitude
short_description: A teenager's quiet night home alone turns into a fight for survival in this psychological survival horror. Scavenge for tools, outsmart a relentless stalker, and make life-or-death choices in a chilling race to escape. Every decision matters—can you survive the night?

name: Sakura Isekai Adventure 3
short_description: The third part of the Isekai Adventure series. Follow Aki, Mina, and Scarlet as they try to rescue the kidnapped priestess, Luna, from the wicked demon queen, Fiore, in this yuri fantasy series.

name: WDF
short_description: ‘WDF’, Is a horizontal shmup game with a Boss-rush style in that the difficulty will increase slightly after the player clears all stages and continues to the next loop. Each loop will be different from the other.

name: Fully Dogomatic
short_description: A roguelite top-down shooter where you create a ring of guns around you to mow down thousands of enemies! Upgrade your guns with insane mods and experiment with the endless possibilities. You may be an adorable dog, but that won't stop you from raining death upon your enemies!

name: Split Fiction
short_description: Embrace mind-blowing moments as you’re pulled deep into the many worlds of Split Fiction, a boundary-pushing co-op adventure.

name: DUMS
short_description: DUMS is a roguelike deckbuilding game where you create custom characters, craft unique decks, and recruit up to 4 allies. Collect powerful party buffs, battle monsters, and choose your own path in procedurally generated dungeons!

name: Sugardew Island - Your cozy farm shop
short_description: In this cozy farming game, you have to run your own farm shop. Take care of your animals and your farm, sell your goods to the cute Forest Folk, upgrade the island and fulfill small orders from the Harmony Tree to fill the island with life again.

name: Crashers of Aetheria
short_description: Crashers of Aetheria is a strategy card collecting game. Players use Crashers to strategically take out their opponent in the arena online.

name: Cozy Dash
short_description: Cozy Dash is a fun-filled local multiplayer game where players can choose to be the cunning Snake or the elusive Apple. In this intense chase, the Snake must pursue the Apple while avoiding various traps and obstacles. The game aims for a fast-paced gameplay experience.

name: Hidden Cats: Japan
short_description: Go on a short but sweet adventure into the black and white world of Japan! Enjoy the search for cats and recreate a colorful picture. 150 cute cats, Nya! are waiting for you, Nya! Play and relax, Nya!

name: Siberian Way
short_description: Siberian Way is a detective thriller novel. Follow the dark non-linear story and decide how it can end! For all fans of snowy Siberia, Murder on the Orient Express and twisted plots, seasoned with mysticism.

name: Quetzal's Call
short_description: Experience the rush of soaring, dashing and leaping with unmatched agility as you navigate intricate levels and test your skills in a vibrant, treacherous world.

name: The Night of Escape
short_description: The Night of Escape' is an indie game personally crafted with themes of fear, escape, and decryption. Players take on the role of an escapee, constantly dodging danger and utilizing clues found to survive and flee. The game adopts a first-person perspective, immersing you in the experience.

name: Sentou Gakuen: Revival
short_description: You are one of the students of Sentou Gakuen, a random school in Japan, filled with delinquents, rascals, and of course some good students. How will you spend your days in Sentou Gakuen? Forge your own path in this online interactive Visual Novel, make friends or foes, the choice is yours.

name: Beast Saga
short_description: Beast Saga is an open-world RPG set in a martial arts universe where you play as a young wolf tribe member named Lang Jiusi. Immerse yourself in a world of free exploration, gathering, crafting, life skills, martial arts cultivation, forming alliances and experiencing unique Jianghu adventures.

name: Bricks Smasher
short_description: Bricks Smasher a bullet hell top-down arena game where your baseball racket is your only weapon! Smash bricks with your balls, level up and upgrade unique balls to face against waves of incoming bricks.

name: cat lines
short_description: Control a cute kitten that leaves a trail of yarn behind! Solve puzzles by covering all the blocks with the yarn line. A relaxing and challenging game for cat lovers!

name: Enemy Territory Terrorists Takedown
short_description: Venture deep into enemy territory and become an ambassador of justice! Enemy Territory Terrorists Takedown is an immersive FPS experience that puts you in the shoes of a brave soldier tasked with saving civilians from brutal terrorists.

name: Fight after Dark
short_description: Building! Auto-battler combat! Roguelike! Be stronger during the day and resist the enemy during the night.

name: Code Trainer
short_description: Code Trainer is a programming practice tool. Solve coding problems and improve your understanding of computer science. Prior programming experience is required.

name: The Little Brave
short_description: Become a brave hero and embark to the dangerous journey though mysterious forbidden lands. Reveal secrets of the legendary past, find the last pieces of gone magic and gain courage to slay the terrible monster!

name: SlimeBrew
short_description: 'Slime Brew' is a squishy slime merge puzzle game! Slimes of the same color combine to evolve, and as they progress, they miraculously brew delicious beer! Your goal? Create as much tasty beer as you can by merging slimes, and then drink, drink, and drink some more!

name: Nebulock
short_description: Nebulock is a short bullet-hell game with intense gameplay, where the player must destroy bosses made of blocks, collect resources and upgrade his spaceship.

name: East Trade Tycoon: Inheritance
short_description: Eastern Trade Tycoon: Inheritance is a trading simulator game.In the game,you can from zero to hero.By trading markets, build a business,earn money,level up, investing accurately, and manage family to become a trading tycoon!

name: ELDRADOR® CREATURES SHADOWFALL
short_description: The adventure-filled worlds of Eldrador are in danger! Lead battle-ready creatures in turn-based strategic combat to defeat a mysterious shadowy menace.

name: LAND MINE LAND
short_description: Land Mine Land is a Minesweeper Game that 4 to 8 people can enjoy.Get a random job and use your job-specific abilities to win!

name: Mushroom Picnic Party
short_description: Help find little mushrooms and prepare for an epic picnic party in this cute hand-drawn hidden object game! Explore 13 locations, chat with townsfolk, and solve puzzles!

name: 10 Blaze Escape
short_description: *If you have a weak heart, we do not recommend playing this game. It is too scary, so we recommend that only those with a strong heart play this game.

name: 九州纪之烽烟四起
short_description: 上古年代，混沌未开，大神盘古以盘古斧劈开天地，从此日月星辰得以显现，世间万物逐渐苏生。然而，西方部落的蚩尤与东方部落的黄帝在涿鹿展开了一场旷世之战。蚩尤战败，残部逃入深山秘境。黄帝命旱神女跋追击蚩尤残部，然女跋感染了人间浊气。为了保留神力，女跋将自身一分为二。黄帝得知此事后，将女跋放逐于山海界，以避其神力的耗损。 岁月流转，蚩尤残部在深山中潜伏了千年之久，渐渐聚集成一支强大的妖魔大军，伺机而动 到了西周初年，黑暗势力从阴暗角落中悄然爬出，蠢蠢欲动，天下危如累卵！与好友一同开创属于你的英雄传奇。 探索未知的土地，击败强大的敌人，收集珍稀的宝物，这一切都在等着你！

name: Grendel's Cave
short_description: Grendel’s Cave; a top-down 2D pixel-art adventure game set in the Old English text Beowulf, Norse mythology, and the historical early 6th century Scandinavian warrior culture. Create a Thane, kill monsters, increase value, stats and magic, collect items and become powerful enough to kill Grendel!

name: I Wanna Ascend
short_description: As you climb this place, you will fall countless times, sinking into despair. Prove that you're not just a loudmouth coward—reach the top. The 2D platforming jump game that will break your keyboard: I Wanna Ascend.

name: Malpractice Hospital
short_description: Malpractice Hospital is a new take on the strategy simulation genre, that blends purposeful patient mismanagement and surgical treatment into one unique malpractice experience.

name: Mother
short_description: A terrible disease knowns as the Spread roams freely through the world of Terra. Moira and her family are the only survivors of their village, in her attempt to flee the sickness by going to a safe haven, she loses her husband, becoming the sole responsible for her children's safety and life.

name: Gravelord
short_description: Gravelord is a fast-paced boomer shooter voiced by a badass protagonist featuring hand-crafted levels filled with secrets and hordes of enemies to kill. Dish out some brutal carnage with powerful guns and collect Tarot Cards to gain even more killing power. Let's put the fun back in funeral!

name: Cinema Simulator 2025
short_description: Cinema Simulator 2025 is a simulation game where you will manage your own movie theater and test your strategy and management skills. Starting from a small movie theater, try to become a giant in the movie industry.

name: Cradle of Nightmare : Flowers to you
short_description: Cradle of Nightmares: Flowers for You is an ATB turn-based game based on combat adventures made by RPGMaker. Players will take on the role of a high school student named Le Qing, who will fall into the dark and gloomy 'second world' and embark on a journey to end the filthy fate of mankind.

name: The Wall
short_description: Defend the city, Fight the dead. In this fast paced zombie wall defence game set in a neon cyberpunk world, you must man the wall, upgrade defences and build robots and turrets. Face relentless waves of undead as you hold out as long as you can. Its not about if the wall falls its about when.

name: Adventuring With Matilda!
short_description: Step into the shoes of an aspiring adventurer and delve into a perilous dungeon alongside Matilda, a beautiful elf with a secret, exploring and deepening your bond through shared trials and bonding moments.

name: 转生魔塔
short_description: 转生魔塔是一个集合了roguelike元素的三消割草游戏。勇者被魔王击败后，其灵魂转生成为了魔塔的一部分。利用三消击杀与各种魔塔技能，打败魔物。游戏内含有10+大关卡，多种难度挑战，150+魔塔技能与随机装备可供任意组合；70种带有各异技能的怪物，7种形态各异的BOSS挑战。

name: Unbroken
short_description: Brave the hostile lands in search of your goal. Forge your own path and discover the many secrets of the realm and the looming Township of Westfall. Unlock new abilities, perks and weapons. Soak in the atmosphere and head forth against all odds.

name: Wild Lynx Jigsaw
short_description: Step into the untamed wilderness with 'Wild Lynx Jigsaw'—a captivating puzzle game that lets you piece together the beauty and mystery of the majestic lynx. From 30-piece relaxing puzzles to intricate 285-piece challenges, immerse yourself in stunning scenes of the lynx roaming its natural habitat.

name: Chromocide: Prism of Sin
short_description: Shoot, shift color and race against the darkness in this short-run psychedelic action roguelite. Level up in color-specific ways as you span the visible spectrum and beyond. Will you atone for your sin?

name: GARDEN&BIRD
short_description: The arrival of birds turned the deserted island into a garden, creating your own unique garden in the sandbox!

name: Refence
short_description: Refence is a roguelite based idle defense game, where you can choose heroes and their traits, upgrade your castle, and manage resources to fend off enemies trying to attack your castle.

name: Lips Breaker
short_description: “Lips Breaker” is the world's first Arkanoid game to incorporate facial control technology. You can swing your lips to manipulate the baffle to bounce the ball and break the bricks to win the game. The novel gameplay and well-designed levels will bring you an unprecedented Arkanoid experience.

name: Dead Beats Survivors
short_description: A 2D shooting survivor game! Survive in a dark, zombie-infested underground disco and earn money!

name: Zombots: Invasion
short_description: Zombots is a fast-paced, wave-based survival FPS where players will have to utilize unique weapons, powerful upgrades, and exciting abilities to fend off hordes of invading robot zombies!

name: Legends of Heropolis DX
short_description: Build the town of Heropolis.Gather your strongest heroes and destroy Evilcorp!

name: Money Theft
short_description: Terlander gangster live in dystopian world which is full of zombies and enemy soldiers. Only way to survive is kill enemies and find money bags

name: The Adventures of Badgersaw Chapter 1
short_description: The Adventures of Badgersaw is the only RPG where you can restore your party's MP with a slap. The adventurer Badgersaw and his two companions are lost in a cave full of schizo-tech and nightmarish creatures. They must find their way out, but end up unwittingly unravelling a web of ancient secrets.

name: Desktop Cat Cafe
short_description: Build your dream cat cafe in this tiny cozy management sim that lives at the bottom of your screen! Unlock exciting new recipes, decorate your space with our wide variety of goodies, and hire cute staff to take care of the cafe while you're doing other things.

name: Clicker Conquest
short_description: MINE! DEFEND! MANAGE! UPGRADE! REPEAT! A clicker game about mining gold, defending that gold against waves of enemies, managing your people, and trying not to get overthrown.

name: UNPLUG - The Game
short_description: Live Action meets Video Game Cinematics in a trippy third-person shooter where fluid hand-to-hand combat and gunplay blend seamlessly, set in a world that challenges your mastery and speaks through its sights, sounds, and storytelling.

name: Z Ops: DeadZone
short_description: Z Ops: Deadzone is an intense FPS where you play as a member of Z Ops, a global organization fighting for humanity's survival after a zombie apocalypse. Battle hordes of zombies infected by the Bane-Z parasite and take part in dangerous raids.

name: Castle of Shikigami 3
short_description: ・A culmination of character shooting games set in a unique worldview! ・A wide variety of newly added playable characters and attack methods, as well as a 2P scenario that is different from 1P play. ・Features a high-tension MAX system that will satisfy your insatiable passion for shooting games!

name: Bangalore Daze
short_description: Hop into your auto rickshaw and explore the open-world driving adventure set in the streets of Bangalore. Take relaxing rides through iconic neighborhoods or challenge yourself to conquer the streets by facing off against rival auto drivers. The city is yours to navigate—choose your journey.

name: Call from the darkness
short_description: Enter this first-person shooter with dark and realistic scenarios, use your shooting skills to kill all the enemies and survive. Explore the scenario and collect all the resources you can because you will need them to get out alive.

name: The Stepfather Remake
short_description: A classic point-and-click adventure full of mystery, humor, and clumsy mobsters. Solve puzzles, talk to quirky characters, and uncover the truth in this fully remastered detective story!

name: Creeping Clark
short_description: After escaping her abusive brother, Sophie seeks a fresh start in a remote house in Hawthorn's forest. But strange events unfold, and her unsettling housemate, Elise, may be hiding something. Is it just her anxiety, or is there something more sinister lurking in the shadows?

name: Colors of the Past
short_description: Soo-ji is pulled back into her past through haunting melodies and unsaid words. As she uncovers hidden truths, she must face her trauma and decide whether to find redemption or let go forever.

name: Ninja Five-O
short_description: Ninja Five-O allows players to relive this classic game. Uphold justice with fierce Ninjutsu moves on Steam.

name: Moorhuhn Kart 4
short_description: The world's craziest chicken is heading back to the racetrack! Wacky characters, cool tracks and karts, and zany items await in a worldwide online battle for first place!

name: Goat Survivor
short_description: Choose your character, grow stronger, and defeat endless waves of enemies! But simple combat isn’t enough—stand on the magic circle and survive for a set time to win. Strategically move and combine skills to create the best survival strategy!

name: Only Way is Down
short_description: Embark on a purr-fectly perilous rage filled adventure as this lil kitty cat took an unfortunate cat-nap and ended up stranded sky high! With no way but down, master your feline agility and platforming prowess to navigate your descent through the urban jungle in this gravity-defying escapade!

name: GRUEL
short_description: Go on a rampage in this endless arcade Boomer-Shooter! Gain the weirdest weapons and destroy all the monsters in the never-ending temple of GRUEL!

name: Urban Jungle
short_description: Use luscious plants to turn your ordinary home into a green haven in Urban Jungle. Find the best place for each plant in your small apartment and enjoy gardening without worries. And don't forget to pet your cat!

name: Dominions 2 - The Ascension Wars
short_description: Dominions II is turn based fantasy game in which you take the role of a powerful being that is trying to become the supreme god. The type of Gods can vary from magically powerful arch mages to old dragons or statues. The game features a large variety of spells and units.

name: Tower of the Ice Lich
short_description: A pixelated homage to 16-bit RPGs, this former print-and-play card game has come full circle as a digital experience! Choose your champion, enter the tower, and make wise decisions on your ascent to face the Ice Lich at the top.

name: Lost Lullabies: The Orphanage Chronicles
short_description: 'Lost Lullabies - The Orphanage Chronicles' is a Co-Op horror game set in 1980, inspired by the real stories of an orphanage ruined by a fire in 1960 Lowell. Playable with 1-4 players, the goal is to identify and expel malevolent spirits alone or with your team.

name: Sultan's Game
short_description: The Sultan commands you to play a cruel game. Each week you draw a card, and have to complete its challenge within seven days. Forced to make dreadful choices to beat the Sultan’s Game and save your own life, you will have to find a way to survive not just the Game, but its consequences too.

name: Heian City Story
short_description: A city-building sim with a historical twist

name: Liar Game
short_description: Can you find out who the Liar is? Will you outsmart everyone in this intense battle of wits?

name: Duck Off!
short_description: Duck Off! is a parkour game with optional single or multiplayer modes. In multiplayer, random events like Egg Fight, Ice Mode, and Banana Mode add chaos and comedy. With no checkpoints, every fall is a fresh struggle and troll, try to make your way to victory in this unpredictable duck adventure!

name: Shining Princess Lapisphilia
short_description: Lapisphilia, the Heroine of Justice, has thwarted the Gestarks one too many times! In a final bid for victory, they have created a dungeon as their last-ditch attempt to finally bring her to her knees! Fight through enemies and traps to escape and get back on surface!

name: Paper 2 - Origami Refolded
short_description: Fold your way through over 100 levels and become an origami master in this casual puzzle game suitable for all ages.

name: Delta Vector - Turn Based Racing
short_description: DELTA VECTOR is an unique turn-based racing game where physics meets strategy. Plot your moves using vector-based mechanics, master different track surfaces, and choose from 9 possible actions each turn. Race solo, challenge friends, or compete in career mode across diverse tracks and cars.

name: Undefined Survivors -アンディファインド サバイバーズ-
short_description: This open-world survival crafting game puts you, an amnesiac protagonist, on a journey to rediscover your true self. Explore islands and oceans, crafting weapons, watercraft, and shelters to survive. Face threats as you uncover the mysteries of your past and reclaim lost memories.

name: Eyes That Hypnotise
short_description: Eyes That Hypnotise is a cozy puzzle that literally stares back at you! Arrange fluffy friends to fit the grid, solve handcrafted levels, and collect funny creatures. With big, hypnotic eyes and a calming mood, this game offers a relaxing escape.

name: Rogue Loops
short_description: Rogue Loops is a roguelite action game where a trapped family battles to escape an endless loop. Combine unique skills and relics to create powerful synergies against the loop’s guardians. As you grow stronger, so does the loop—can you break free from this relentless cycle?

name: DEAD TRASH
short_description: Years into a brutal lockdown, a once-thriving city lies in ruins, abandoned by its government and overrun by vicious, mindless infected. Grab your hammer, collect your nerves and enter the mayhem.

name: Math4TopDogs
short_description: Master the art of reflexes and mental math in a real action-adventure game. Explore magical worlds and uncover all their secrets, creatures, and treasures. Take on every challenge and, if you wish, compete in the global ranking. (7-120 years old)

name: Rogue Bricks
short_description: Classic brick breaker action—evolved! Blast through bricks, grab epic loot, and level up your game. Customize your playstyle with mods and star shards. Build your perfect loadout and bounce beyond limits!

name: SCP: November 2010
short_description: It’s November 2010. You find yourself lost in a forest rumored to be home to SCP-173, a deadly and unrelenting entity. With only a flashlight, you must search for hidden plushies while staying one step ahead of your stalker. Can you keep it in your sights long enough to escape the nightmare?

name: Country Hopper
short_description: Delivery Doug drives around the world delivering boxes. Help him find the shortest route from one country to another. Collect pieces of beautiful Jigsaw puzzles and improve your geography knowledge along the way.

name: GladMort
short_description: In a faraway kingdom in a land of legend, a mysterious plague of unknown origin has rapidly infected the population. Dubbed the 'Red Plague', the evil nature of the phenomenon is unmistakable: the dead begin to rise from their graves, and demonic incarnations begin to appear.

name: SHEOL INFERNO
short_description: Sheol Inferno is a roguelike card game in which you will accompany Dante on his journey through the 9 circles of Hell and fight alongside him to defeat the guardians of the circles.

name: Fisherman's Palace
short_description: Fisherman’s Palace is an adventure game about a man who escaped the chaotic city life to start a new chapter in a relaxing village, BUT a mysterious fish has appeared. You must fish, compete in tournaments, craft new gear and build your farm to become the BEST in the whole village!

name: Skuf for altushki
short_description: Welcome to the world of skufs and altushkas! In this game, it's not the skufs who have to look for altushki, but the altushki of the skufs.

name: MidSpring
short_description: This game is a spot the difference game. You and your friends have come to a village festival. If something different happens from the first day, go back the way you came. If the same thing happens, go forward. Will you be able to return home safely with your friends?

name: Strongest☆Angel Zerachiel!
short_description: In a city that worships the Goddess of Fortune, an angel descends. Her name is Zerachiel. Zerachiel struggles to rescue her comrades who are imprisoned by the cult, but she is defeated and stripped of her powers by a girl claiming to be a saint...

name: Cats Visiting Cozy Art Studios
short_description: Explore cozy art studios and uncover hidden cats in this charming seek-and-find adventure. Search through beautifully illustrated creative spaces, click to collect every feline, and complete each level. Can you find them all?

name: Retro Wave
short_description: A soothing VR rhythm experience where players drift through vibrant, retro-futuristic landscapes, immersed in mesmerizing synthwave beats. Relax and lose yourself in neon-lit visuals that captivate the senses, offering an immersive journey designed to calm and inspire.

name: Trash Horror Collection 5
short_description: A collection of 7 trashy horror games!... this will definitely give you an 80s vibe!

name: Demon Hunters
short_description: Demon Hunters is a 2D RPG with roguelike elements where you explore dungeons, fight hordes of enemies and epic bosses. Upgrade weapons, collect artifacts and close the demonic portal!

name: Kitsune
short_description: Meet the enigmatic stranger who’s been haunting your dreams and embark on a supernatural adventure of twists and turns, love and heartbreak, and foxes. A text-based interactive supernatural romance, 300,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects.

name: Itty Bitty Toilet Kitty
short_description: BE A CAT! SAVE YOUR HUMAN! You're a fluffy feline who must save their owner from the hordes of flesh eating greebles which dwell within the bathroom. Will she make it through her morning business alive? Only you can save her!

name: I Had a Plan!
short_description: You are a Wizard, with a brilliant plan. Unfortunately you also have teammates. As you make your way through dungeons and forests alike, you need to manage your team mates… and your frustration. I Had A Plan! is a Tactical Roguelite Semi-Autobattler set in a 3D world with 2D Characters.

name: 8 Ball Kings
short_description: 8 Ball Kings delivers a realistic and immersive billiards experience! Master precise shots, compete in single-player mode, or challenge friends in local multiplayer. Customize your cues and tables, enjoy smooth controls, and become the ultimate 8-ball champion. Are you ready to break?

name: Let's Get Larry a Haircut
short_description: Let’s Get Larry a Haircut is a 2D block-pushing puzzle game with sokoban elements, where you collect tokens to open a hairdressing place, then push a walrus inside for a trim. Larry is a relaxing game about not getting crushed or blowing up the wrong things.

name: Finnish Pub Simulator
short_description: Run your very own pub in the Finnish countryside either on your own or with friends! Manage your pub's inventory, set your own prices, and be ready to refuse service if things get too crazy.

name: Which Way Up: Galaxy Games
short_description: Perform graceful gravity gymnastics, outrun the relentless pull of a black hole and launch your friends into space as you compete across multiple events in the Galaxy Games!

name: Real Anime Situation! DT
short_description: I’m Shun, and I have a talent for crushing romance flags—in real life! Featuring even more eye-popping art, nuanced animations, plus a fresh-faced cast of DT-obsessed heroines, this Moe Game Awards-winning comedy franchise also received its own hit anime adaptation.

name: The Candle
short_description: The Candle - Rated R. As night falls and a storm rises over the annual county carnival, you are visited by a mysterious spirit. Tasked with laying his soul to rest, you must brave his long dilapidated manor and avoid the horrifying remnants of his estate staff.

name: Just Cat Slap
short_description: Two cats, one love. Both are competing for the heart of a beautiful female cat. But only one can win her affection! To prove who is more worthy, they must face off in an intense slap duel. Quick reflexes will decide who truly deserves her love!

name: Digital Revolution
short_description: This is a casual game that combines math and basic elimination gameplay. If you're confident in your math skills, give it a try! In the game, you'll decide the direction of all the 'blocks' and gradually strengthen the 'Blue Legion' to defeat the evil 'Red Legion.'

name: WastePunk
short_description: Third person post apocalyptic action shooter. Take jobs in the form of raider bounties to earn cash and explore a post apocalyptic wasteland.

name: OMEGA 6 The Triangle Stars
short_description: OMEGA 6 The Triangle Stars is an adventure game with 16-bit styling, based on the manga by former Nintendo art director, Takaya Imamura.

name: Tuggowar
short_description: Tuggowar is the big-brain deckbuilding duel. Engage in tense combat on a solarpunk frontier. Assemble your deck turn by turn, discover powerful card combos, disrupt the enemy strategy, and pilot your well-oiled war machine to victory!

name: Kokoro Clover SUN - Prehistoric Invaders!
short_description: The second installment in the 2000s era styled anime-themed Kokoro Clover series! A visual novel paired with boss battles! Our heroes' next adventure is in...dinosaur times?! This time the bad guys are trying to destroy the future! The only way to fight back is with dino-transformations!

name: Revenant : In Memory Of The Day
short_description: You are heading down an endless corridor in search of a missing child. Pay close attention to your surroundings to find clues about the child, and find a way to escape the dark, confined corridor.

name: Akuro & Bahaku 1: Jungle Adventure
short_description: Akuro and Bahaku were happily living in the jungle when the forces of darkness suddenly attacked, shrouding the entire jungle in darkness. Akuro and Bahaku had no choice but to set out on a journey to find a way to combat the darkness...

name: Dust & Courage: Jake Bolton’s Journey
short_description: 'Dust & Courage: Jake Bolton's Journey' is a historical fantasy RPG set in the Wild West. Play as Jake, a cowboy uncovering secrets and exploring towns. Your choices shape Jake's destiny through quests and tough decisions. Experience compelling and fun stories for a memorable experience.

name: Dancing Pandas: Ranger's Path
short_description: Calling all animal lovers! Become the ranger for Summery Islands! Find courage by helping other Pandas. Dancing Pandas: a cozy adventure where bravery blooms beyond your comfort zone.

name: Midnight Murder Club
short_description: Heart-pounding and hilarious multiplayer FPS fun. Trust your senses and overcome your fears as you’re armed with a flashlight and a revolver, then set against your friends in a pitch-black mansion with immersive proximity chat and surprises around every corner.

name: Draft Day Sports: College Basketball 2025
short_description: Lead your college basketball team in Draft Day Sports: College Basketball 2025. Recruit stars, coach for success, and make key decisions that will lead your team to the tournament. Navigate recruiting, the transfer portal and NIL options to build a winner. The ultimate coaching simulation game!

name: 8 YOUs+
short_description: You are trapped on a train that runs forever. What's worse, the train is filled with countless versions of YOU, all looking exactly like YOU... Pay close attention and find the one different YOU among the eight, then make your way to the last car and reach the exit!

name: Perimbó
short_description: Jaime falls into a mysterious cave while chasing a red bird. Now, he must solve puzzles, explore hidden paths, and aid trapped spirits using magic to create light blocks and collect sacred fruits. Uncover ancient secrets and guide Jaime on his journey back home.

name: TechnoSorcery
short_description: TechnoSorcery is a rhythm arcade game with a focus on memorizing spells and casting them to a beat. Help the fledgling Sorcerer Aiden as he embarks on an impossible adventure of revenge. Show off your skills Online in 1v1 card battles with your own custom deck of cards.

name: Who Wears The Crown?
short_description: Test your brain and your brawn in the toughest chess game ever made! Play against the Stockfish chess engine to build your path and climb upward to claim the crown, but be careful! One small blunder and you risk losing your progress. Heavy is the head that wears the crown, but who will wear it?

name: KONKONKON
short_description: Out of curiosity, I’m walking toward the 'town where all the residents disappeared.' Suddenly, I hear a noise and turn in that direction, just in time to see a small animal scurrying away. That was... a fox! Come to think of it, what sound do foxes make again?'KONKONKON' is an adventure game.

name: The Chef's Shift
short_description: The Chef’s Shift is a fast-paced typing game in a restaurant setting, where you’ll both cook & serve food to hungry customers, all done by TYPING.

name: Scary Tales: Horror School
short_description: Scary Tales: Horror School is a first-person survival horror game where you must solve puzzles, evade terrifying entities, and escape a haunted school. With three unique escape routes, each offering different challenges, can you survive the nightmare or become another lost soul?

name: Forest Mansion Incident
short_description: An ordinary evening after routine cleaning turns into a nightmare... Will you be able to get out of the mansion, unravel all its secrets and defeat the voracious entity that lives in this unfortunate place without losing the remnants of humanity?

name: Miryam: The Polluted Land
short_description: A narrative-driven tower defense game that plunges you into a cursed realm. Guide a 10-year-old girl, scarred by relentless school bullying and family neglect, as she battles monstrous embodiments of her inner torment in a desperate quest to recover her lost brother—and ultimately, herself.

name: 5番線おじさん救出編 Platform 5 Dungeons
short_description: The long-awaited sequel to Japan’s hit “Nibansen” is here! This new rescue-horror in the “Bansen Series” goes beyond anomaly hunting. Enter massive Senjuku Station (千宿), full of oddities, and save the stranded old man. Now the truth of “Nibansen,” “Sanbansen,” and “Platform 4” is revealed…

name: Alma and the Fragments of Cursed Memories
short_description: One day, Alma finds herself presented with a sudden money-making opportunity that could solve all her problems. And so she sets out to meet the client...An RPG mystery about doing whatever it takes to get paid!

name: The Deadly Path
short_description: Aid the Deities of Dread in their quest for vengeance and pave the way for their ascension. Gather grim materials, construct defences and expand the underworld to appease the rage of the gods in The Deadly Path, a unique building management and roguelike strategy game.

name: Bearly Delivered
short_description: A 3D physics-based package delivery game

name: Forest Smasher
short_description: 'Forest Smasher' is an exploration and looter-based TPS Rougelike game that focuses on 'shooting & explosion'. In randomly generated maze, you can destroy all obstacles and enemies you can see, with fast-paced battles, easy-to-use operations, and a amazing system of weapons and items.

name: SpaceVenture
short_description: A sci-fi comedy adventure game

name: Edge Islands
short_description: Discover a unique blend of Colony Sim and Tactical RPG. Recruit and train your heroes, build your outpost, explore dungeons and engage in turn-based strategic battles to protect and expand your domain. Shape your stories by managing moods, relationships, ambitions and more!

name: The Exit of Nightmare
short_description: The Exit of Nightmare is a psychological horror game with collection and puzzle elements. You're trapped in nightmare world and your goal is to find your way back to reality.

name: Atomfall
short_description: A nuclear disaster has left an area of Britain in tatters. Atomfall, a new survival-action game, will see you explore, scavenge, craft, barter and fight your way through beautifully recreated scenery in search of answers.

name: Evil Timefall
short_description: Evil Timefall - hardcore FPS, where you fight against medieval evil. Immerse yourself in dark horror, where you kill zombie knights, witches and demons. Dive into the meat slaughter, where cruel enemies attack you from the darkness. Upgrade guns to execute more servants of the bloody lord.

name: Devil's Derby
short_description: Devil's Derby is a fast-paced first person shooter on skates, where you fight endless hordes of demons as you use advance movement techniques to shoot, skate, and slide your way around a singular arena to compete for high score.

name: Joyquarium
short_description: Farm fish in idle mode, plant aquatic plants, and build a unique exclusive landscape!

name: River Towns
short_description: Solve puzzles by placing buildings and creating vibrant cities in River Towns. Each district has its own style and shapes, making every level a new challenge. Help to restore and rebuild our River Towns.

name: Ascendaria
short_description: Climb as high as possible through diverse and fascinating worlds. Overcome unique challenges, discover hidden secrets, and collect upgrades and bonuses. But beware, a single mistake can send you tumbling down. Dive into the adventure and see how high you can climb!

name: Lost Valley of the Frog King
short_description: You are the captain of an arctic expedition. Months into the voyage, you discover an uncharted island, encased in a wall of ice. You decide to take a closer look and meet with your boat on the far side of the island. What will you discover?

name: Once Upon A Tile
short_description: Once Upon A Tile is a rogue-lite strategic dungeon-builder, where you don't control the hero! Instead, you cleverly place dungeon tiles to guide your hero to victory - or to their demise, if you are careless. You will need to be tricky and clever in this dungeon-building puzzle game!

name: Mouse
short_description: Mouse is a fun 2D platformer where you control a small mouse, collect keys, and unlock doors to reach the next level. Jump through tricky obstacles, explore creative levels, and test your platforming skills. Can you unlock every door and complete the challenge?

name: Little Resort Simulator
short_description: Relaxed first person simulator where you manage a little hotel, you customize the Customer's room furniture, clean rooms, serve drinks at the Bar, serve buffet food in the eating area and unlock more facilities

name: Slayer : the Demon Haunted World
short_description: 'Move strategically or perish! Slayer: The Demon Haunted World is a thrilling action RPG where every move counts. Overcome challenging dungeons, battle relentless foes, and master the art of survival. '

name: Tales of Isenberg
short_description: Tales of Isenberg is a medieval fantasy-style, Hungarian-voiced 2D platformer that blends action and skill. The hero, Alrik, journeys to the frozen castle of Isenberg to face the forces of darkness. Dangerous foes and unexpected twists await you!

name: Tropical Clicker
short_description: Tropical Clicker is a simple clicker game where you need to make drinks by clicking on the fruits. You can upgrade your blenderto increase the number of drinks you generate each time, you'll also earn different title, and some rewards while playing.

name: Wispy Dreams
short_description: Get ready to dive into Wispy Dreams, a vibrant love letter to the classic arcade platformers of the 80s! Jump, collect power-ups, battle epic bosses, and unravel the secrets of the Wispy Isles in a beautifully hand-drawn adventure, whether you’re playing solo or teaming up with a friend.

name: A Regular Store
short_description: As a new staff member of 'A Regular Store', you're job is to complete tasks such as locking the doors, filling sections of the store, grabbing cash out of the register, etc. But as you do so, horrific events occur, and you learn the horrors of the store's past.

name: Trance Tank
short_description: Make Techno not War - Trance Tank is fast-paced action combined with cool beats. Get ready, load your gun and start the engine. „Panzer-Hurra!“

name: Xi
short_description: 'Xi' is a horror puzzle game set in the context of modern Chinese folklore. The story takes place in an long-abandoned mountain mansion. This immersive escape room experience feels a bit too real, with eerie and strange elements everywhere—an empty banquet, an endless corridor.

name: The Fall: Act I
short_description: The story of three foreign students at a private British boarding school. Becoming information brokers within the school walls brought them money and respect, but knowledge can also bring trouble. The forbidden fruit was forced in their mouths and its taste will remain forever.

name: Carnival Heroes - Super party minigames
short_description: Cross-platform online multiplayer board game for 2 to 4 players similar to super mario party. Collect crowns, gems, items and be the best in minigames. Play in 23 minigames in online and solo mode. Race with others, fight, shoot, catch, test your memory, and have fun.

name: Rendering Ranger™: R² [Rewind]
short_description: You are the Rendering Ranger, a special forces soldier defending Earth from a devastating alien invasion through nine levels of action platforming as well as blisteringly fast horizontal shooter stages. Originally developed for Super Famicom by Manfred Trenz, creator of the Turrican series.

name: Vault of Power
short_description: Vault of Power is an autobattler strategy roguelike. Equip powerful skills, strategically position your units, and conquer challenging dungeons.

name: 100% Plasma Vitae
short_description: Point and click game, with emphasis on narrative, time management, and luck on the dice!

name: The Darkest Files
short_description: Germany, 1956. The war is over, but justice is not served. Former Nazis walk free, while their victims lie in unmarked graves. As a prosecutor, you'll unearth long-buried evidence, confront witnesses and hunt down perpetrators. Will you have the courage to bring these 'ordinary men' to court?

name: Project Three
short_description: A psychological first-person survival horror focused on atmosphere, story and defending yourself with melee and weaponry against several creatures. The story is set in the alternate fan-made universe of Half-Life, Valve Corporation's successful series.

name: Tales of the Forgotten
short_description: Tales of the Forgotten features 3 short ghost stories that haunt everyday locations. Explore PSX-style environments in first person, endure jump scares, and experience surreal moments. Unlock multiple endings to uncover the secrets of the forgotten ghosts.

name: Broken Time
short_description: Broken Time - a world where time no longer matters. This low-polygon action game immerses players in a post-apocalyptic environment where every movement changes the course of events. Fight and gather resources to survive in this madness.

name: Wild Explorer
short_description: Wild Explorer takes you on an immersive journey deep into the wild. Capture stunning photos of wildlife, explore ancient monuments, and uncover hidden secrets. Use your torch to navigate the darkness and complete your exploration book with every discovery. Are you ready for the adventure?

name: Pizza Delivery Survivors
short_description: Experience the thrill of pizza delivery in a zombie apocalypse! 'Pizza Delivery Survivors' combines survival, strategy, and fast-paced action. Deliver pizzas, outsmart the undead, and turn everyday items into weapons to fight for survival.

name: Tick Hop
short_description: 'Tick Hop' is a time-based puzzle platformer where players control the Guardian of Time. Navigate through levels made of time fragments, solving challenges and unlocking the past to restore the future. Manage a dynamic countdown and use time-altering items to overcome obstacles.

name: RoundZ
short_description: RoundZ is a solo-developed round-based survival zombie game, with each round becoming progressively harder as the zombies get more health and in bigger waves.

name: Therapist Simulator
short_description: As a psychiatrist, journey into the minds of your patients. Make tough decisions, uncover hidden stories, and strive to maintain your mental well-being.

name: Kara Fantasy
short_description: Embark on an epic journey through five mystical forest worlds to save Princess Kara and show the world that the true hero lives in each of us!

name: Beachside Bloodbath
short_description: You arrive at a quaint beach house in a small New Jersey town for an idyllic weekend getaway with friends, but little do you know what horrors await... First person survival horror experience in a stylized PS1 / VHS-era aesthetic.

name: Kemono Heroes
short_description: Dash, slash, and relive the golden age of couch co-op! Kemono Heroes blends run ‘n gun action with fast-paced ninja combat and 16-bit arcade vibes. Play solo or team up with friends for a wild adventure full of unlockable weapons, epic battles, and nonstop fun!

name: Turbotz Testing 20XX
short_description: Demolish streams of antroids and advance the progress of science in the process! A pixel futurism tower defense game with rogue-lite elements, where you build turret robots—“Turbotz”—to annihilate research fodder. Upgrade both sides and push explosive research to its limits!

name: Lofirunner
short_description: Lofirunner is a single-player speedrunning game, where you speed your way through space.

name: Little Wings Deliveries
short_description: Embark on a short, playful adventure in your cozy flying boat and sail through fluffy clouds. Discover floating islands and befriend their quirky citizens. Jump, roll, climb, and skate through Cloudburg as Skye faces her biggest obstacle on her way to the Royal Postal Academy!

name: Alter Age
short_description: Alter between ages and adventure out in a fantastic RPG world!

name: Tiles in Time
short_description: Enter this challenge in which you must paint all the tiles before reaching the last one in the shortest time possible. Visit different worlds and face different puzzles which will test all your skills.

name: Nice Pro?
short_description: Have you ever dreamt of a better version of Nice Pro? Younger, more beautiful, more perfect.

name: Zombocalypse
short_description: Dive into a top-down shooter where you’ll battle relentless waves of zombies, either solo or with friends! Face off against formidable bosses, unlock upgrades through a tech tree, and enjoy a casual gaming experience crafted with passion by an indie developer.

name: Codebound
short_description: Trapped in Your Own Game! Codebound tells the story of a high school student trapped in the game he created. To escape, he must finish it! Along the way, he discovers surprises left by a mysterious friend who helped him. Dive into this pixel-styled world full of puzzles and exciting adventures!

name: ASYLUM
short_description: An epic supernatural horror adventure and the spiritual successor to cult classic Scratches set in a massive, decaying mental institute. Inspired by H. P. Lovecraft, Hammer Films and twisted Euro Horror from the 80s.

name: JusTD
short_description: Tower Defense with resource- and base management! Waves of enemy robots with special abilities, shield and armor! Mining, refining and production for building and repairing! Environmental hazards and the best: the Orbital strike!

name: Castle Xenon
short_description: Castle Xenon is a retro-themed, console-style RPG downloadable for Windows. A 30 hour adventure, take part in turn-based battles, solve puzzles, and explore detailed, handcrafted maps in your quest to save the world from destruction.

name: Birdfull
short_description: Birdfull is a small relaxing idle game. Attract birds with feed, try to keep them longer, and discover all of them including the unique ones! Watch the birds, generate more eggs in real time, and customize your cozy bird space.

name: Toy Scrappers
short_description: Toy Scrappers is a thrilling chase-based horror game that can be played with up to 16 players. Some players take on the role of a killer attempting to capture others. Escape the madness and stay alive!

name: There's a Gun in the Office
short_description: You've been kidnapped and have to get out but luckily, there's a gun in the office. Unluckily, your captor comes back home every day, so you have to cover your tracks when you go out of your cell. Use each passing day to get closer to the gun until you can finally leave.

name: Farming Isles
short_description: A relaxing farming simulator game that has the player focusing on resource management by maintaining growing crops, watering farmland, building additional structures for extending the stock.

name: Rotschwert
short_description: Rotschwert is a horizontal bullet-hell set in a faded, unknown world. Descend into a violent dream, Red Blade in hand. With scarlet apparitions at your side - nothing will stop your advance.

name: RAGMONTON ENDLESS for save indie game
short_description: Physics-Based Ragdoll Roguelike up to 4 players with Endless action to survive > Get items and discover powerful transformations to increase your power to survive the invading alien horde and save indie games.

name: Shizuoka Curse | 静岡の呪い
short_description: Shizuoka Curse is the story of a desprete young Japanese vlogger , who goes to an abandoned school in the woods in hopes of recording footage that would make him internet famous but it all goes wrong...

name: White Room: Mind’s Prison
short_description: White Room: Mind's Prison is a psychological horror game. Choose your own story in the White Room. You have 100 days to survive! Survive as long as possible.

name: Tales Of Miravia
short_description: Tales of Miravia is a fantasy role-playing game where players must explore a mysterious world, purify corrupted combat statues through turn-based tactics, and solve various mini-games to restore balance to the kingdom.

name: Jaguar Suns
short_description: Race through 15 progressive levels in this SNES/SEGA style 90's retro speed-run platformer.

name: Love, Elections, and Chocolate
short_description: Love, Elections, and Chocolate is a romantic visual novel developed by the Japanese game studio Sprite. Upon its release in Japan, it garnered numerous awards for its exceptional art, captivating music, and well-crafted characters.

name: Little Adventure Tale
short_description: Little Adventure tale is a Roguelike Deckbuilder set in a cute fantasy world where you can enlist the help of the Guild to Hire companions and manage several Card Decks & Accept Quests to earn more rewards! All this in order to banish the Evil Lord Obradin!

name: AI LIMIT
short_description: In the distant future when civilization is on the verge of extinction, people follow the legend of the Elysium in the last city, Havenswell. In this post-apocalyptic wasteland sci-fi ARPG, you will play as Arrisa, a Blader with immortality, and explore the city ruin to find the hope of a new life.

name: The Variant Void
short_description: This roguelike spaceshooter pits waves of enemies against you in your pursuit to reach the end of the galaxy. Improve your ship with permanent upgrades and select temporary upgrades during a run to pursue achievements and and kill bosses.

name: Subzero Stealth
short_description: Airdropped into a snowbound village under siege, you’re the lone soldier facing relentless enemies and harsh conditions. Navigate deadly terrain, combat armed foes and destroy critical targets. Master the battlefield where death is ever-present. Will you survive? The challenge awaits.

name: food inc: Home of the Supply
short_description: Dive into a farm co-op game where you can build, plant crops, care for animals and much more. In this game you can ride and drive while doing missions and expanding the farm. Inspired by real world elements like seasons and animal lifespan, food inc aim to deliver a fun and simple arcade gameplay.

name: Million Clicker
short_description: A humorless clicker-toy, where you click a million times.

name: THREAT -SCREAM AND ESCAPE-
short_description: THREAT -SCREAM AND ESCAPE- is a unique horror game where you must scream into your microphone to stun approaching creatures and make your escape. Use the power of your voice to clear the path and guide the protagonist, who wakes up in a mysterious research facility, to freedom.

name: Lilia: The Fallen Flower in the Prison City
short_description: Captured, imprisoned, and forced to work... Will you escape, or become another cog in the machine?

name: Vanguard Exiles
short_description: Vanguard Exiles is a new style of Auto-Battler designed by legendary game designer, Richard Garfield, where each player pits their Squad against their opponent in an ever-changing environment.

name: Paws and Whiskers
short_description: roguelike game which backpackage manage to army make army stronger.Your choice will make a diffrent end to the story.

name: Sculplings
short_description: Welcome to the world of Sculplings! Here, trainers collect and battle a random assortment of hand-sculpted monsters in order to become the #1 Sculpling Champion! Sculplings is a mashup of roguelikes with traditional monster fighter games!

name: Stellar Mess: Operation Kush (Chapter 2)
short_description: Stellar Mess is a point&click 2D graphic adventure game with retro style, where the least likely hero must rescue the princess and save the galaxy from a tyrannical Stellar Armada. All this while walking through a small town located somewhere in the Argentinian Patagonia.

name: Smile, you're being filmed together
short_description: Dive into an intense psychological horror experience with Smile, You’re Being Filmed: Together, the multiplayer version of the game where observation and cooperation are your greatest assets.

name: Maestro's Cold War 2
short_description: Revive the Cold War in this classic strategy game—easy to pick up, yet challenging and deep, offering endless replayability.

name: Stardust Skate
short_description: Skate through Stardust Valley in this endless runner, competing for the highest score and the coolest deck!

name: Rush The Towers
short_description: Will you break through enemy defenses, or watch your forces fall before the towers?

name: Accursed Isle: Survival
short_description: While trying to survive in harsh natural conditions, use resources wisely, avoid dangers, and test your survival instincts. A realistic survival experience awaits you!

name: Skyfear
short_description: Prehistoric arena shooter where players control fast-flying fire-breathing dragons! Up to 6 players in online battles or play vs bots offline, with a heavily customizable experience.

name: Cinemaster Cinema Simulator
short_description: Run your own cinema! Set showtimes, print tickets, buy new films, pop popcorn, upgrade and clean theaters. Vending machines, staffs, upgrades, and much more are coming soon!

name: Slice Adventure
short_description: Grab the blade and slice through hordes of enemies in this new 'bullet hell' game - Slice Adventure! Control a powerful cursor-sword with simple mouse-only controls. Survive endless waves, try your agility, and create unique playstyles using various weapons and items combinations.

name: Overtime Anomaly
short_description: You're working overtime again in your dead-end job, whilst your boss is on vacation. However, strange things are happening throughout the office. Complete your daily work tasks, explore your office, report any anomalies you may find, and you may just find yourself getting a promotion...

name: FATE: Reawakened
short_description: Reawaken the critically acclaimed FATE games like never before! Play all 4 classic dungeon crawler titles with enhanced graphics as you battle through challenging procedurally generated dungeons, learn powerful spells, and fish to your heart’s content. Are you up to the task? Your FATE awaits!

name: Pixel Pirates
short_description: Set sail on an epic adventure in Pixel Pirates. Play as James Flint, a reluctant hero who rises to stop the cursed Captain Blackwood. Battle across land and sea, uncover hidden secrets, and save the world, all in this byte-sized swashbuckling adventure.

name: Kingdom of Cards and Tiles
short_description: A combination of classic board games such as Carcassonne and Clank! A Deck-Building Adventure. Explore, build a deck of cards, and construct a medieval village from drawn tiles. Unlock new cards, mechanics, and magical artifacts that influence gameplay.

name: Vaporware Odyssey
short_description: Vaporware Odyssey is a fast paced action rogue-like combining souls-like and bullet hell mechanics. It features procedurally generated levels and a deeply synergetic upgrade system.

name: Dirt
short_description: Fight for the freedom. In this pixel-art JRPG, you will play as a young boy who has lost all his memories. Embark on a journey to become a hero and save the world, fight against the absurd fate that governs you, and ultimately uncover the truth about both this world and yourself.

name: AMseven
short_description: You’re a medium performing a séance in an apartment, spotting anomalies to advance time. One mistake resets the clock to midnight. Can you survive the night and reach morning?　A horror spot the difference game

name: Cabin Crew Life Simulator
short_description: Have you ever wondered what flight attendants do on each flight? Let's find out with Cabin Crew Life Simulator, the pioneering flight attendant simulator with variety of aircraft, airports, passenger services, handling emergency situations, in-flight business, teamwork and much more.

name: Chernobylite 2: Exclusion Zone
short_description: Explore the mysterious open world of the Chornobyl Exclusion Zone in this post-apocalyptic action RPG adventure. Shape your non-linear story, develop skills, and work with teammates and factions. Use crafted weaponry in first-person or third-person perspective.

name: Endless Nightmare: Never Awaken
short_description: Endless Nightmare: Never Awaken is a psychological horror game where you navigate an infinite stairwell filled with haunting events. Climb up to uncover its mysteries or descend to escape the terrors lurking in the shadows. Every decision tests your courage and sanity—can you survive the endless?

name: (The Lingering) Last Customer
short_description: Devi, a 27-year-old young woman, books a late-night massage at Ahola Spa & Reflexology—the only spa that is still open.. What should have been a relaxing escape turns into a lingering nightmare…

name: Silent Anomalies
short_description: Silent Anomalies is an intense surveillance simulator. You are a monitoring operator whose job is to find anomalies. Switch cameras, analyze changes, and detect things that look strange or out of place.

name: Spire Blast
short_description: Spire Blast is a unique physics-based puzzle game in which you match colors, shoot and blast towers. Step into the colourful world of Spire Blast. Work with your ever-hungry dragon companion to collapse numerous mysterious towers.

name: Terminal 81R
short_description: In 2016, a young Uruguayan travels to the neighborhood of 'Terminal 81' a place marked by violence, inequality, and vice, where a dangerous human trafficking network operates. Determined to find his sister, the young man ventures into the perilous and dark world of Terminal 81.

name: Robotic Arm Simulator
short_description: Control real-time physical simulation control and transform into a robotic arm operator. Challenging millimeter level grasping tasks in multiple precision industrial scenarios, any operational jitter could trigger a chain of disasters!

name: Isle Frontier
short_description: Make a life of your own in this isometric point-and-click life simulator. Level up your skills by fishing, hunting, cooking, crafting, and much more. The island has everything you need to not only survive, but thrive!

name: Kalia
short_description: Jump, climb, solve puzzles, and explore the ruins of Kalia. An engaging story awaits you, filled with mysteries and challenges. Discover the secrets of this lost world... if you dare!

name: MySims™ Kingdom
short_description: Meet New Friends and explore all the New Lands

name: Get a midnight snack without mom knowing
short_description: Find delicious food in the dark kitchen. But you have to move as carefully as possible. My mom may wake up.

name: Exit The Abyss
short_description: Exit the Abyss is a psychological horror game where you are trapped in an abandoned, haunted hospital. The game focuses on an oppressive atmosphere, exploration, and mysteries, with minimalist puzzle elements. Immerse yourself in a distorted reality, confront your fears, and find the way out!

name: Slime Dreamscape
short_description: Slime Dreamscape is a 2D pixel-style puzzle casual game. The core mechanic of the game is that elements of the same color can interact with each other. Players need to cleverly use various items to help the slime successfully eat the cake.

name: HAPPY ZONE - Battle Royale
short_description: Battle against thousands in HAPPY ZONE! Upgrade characters, unleash drones and airstrikes, collect loot, and outlast 12 players to be the sole survivor. Team up with friends and climb the leaderboard to become a legend!

name: Look Outside
short_description: Look Outside is a survival horror RPG set in a single apartment building. A mysterious event turns anyone who looks out the window into grotesque monsters, leaving the world in absolute chaos. Scavenge the building to seek food, supplies, and weapons while encountering strange characters.

name: Lantern of Worlds - Layla's Quest
short_description: Lantern of Worlds : Layla's Quest is a short adventure about the assassin Layla. Layla is banished by her order to a remote island, there to live out her days in exile. But strange events are happening on the island. Events which will steer Layla unto a new path, and towards a great destiny.

name: Ukrainian Shield: Iraq
short_description: Take command in a realistic RTS strategy highlighting Ukraine’s peacekeeping mission in Iraq. Lead your forces, call in powerful support, and complete a series of unique missions.

name: Mars Survivor
short_description: After an asteroid catastrophe, your rocket ship crash-lands in the wilderness of Mars. Explore the planet's mysteries, strategize your escape, and build a shelter to protect yourself!

name: Zexion
short_description: Seek out new weapons and equipment to delve deeper into the dangerous world of Cypher-X72! Be warned, you aren't the only one seeking the forbidden technology known as Zexion! It will take cunning and valor to succeed in this action-packed sci-fi adventure!

name: 美女公寓
short_description: During the holidays, my parents went out and I stayed alone in the apartment. There are many beautiful girls living in the apartment. Give them gifts to strengthen our relationship.

name: Caelum's Crux
short_description: A new card based action adventure RPG game set in the world of Caelum. Embark into a mysterious journey full of secrets and collect powerful cards to solve the riddles of this epic land and battle with other collectors!

name: YUKOMON
short_description: The protagonist's life changes when their 5-year-old sister is transformed into a Yukomon. The only cure is to complete the genetic search for the 200 cataloged Yukomons, but Team T is ready to sabotage their journey.

name: Kitten Food Alley
short_description: Kitten Food Alley is a casual management sim with the theme of petting cat. You can open various food shops and adjust food recipes, produce food by petting cat employees. Unlock various tools to automate petting. Enjoy the stress relief of cyber cat petting!

name: Top Burger Shop Simulator
short_description: In Top Burger Shop, whip up delicious burgers to satisfy hungry customers in a vibrant, fast-paced environment! Manage your shop, unlock new ingredients, and navigate fun challenges across 180 levels. Are you ready to delight your patrons?

name: Endless RPG - Untold Tales
short_description: Craft a party of diverse characters, each with customizable skills and looks. Explore a living world with dynamic day-night cycles, changing seasons, and diverse biomes. Embark on an epic journey where you shape your destiny as the director of your unique story.

name: Olympus of the Heavens
short_description: Challenge through the skies in Olympus of the Heavens! Face powerful Olympian gods, conquer their temples, claim their flames, and ignite your own. Customize your build, collect legend rewards, and master your skills in this fast-paced action RPG.

name: TinyCraft Town
short_description: Rebuild a ruined village in this hands-on resource management game! Chop trees, mine ores, craft tools, and expand your town. Manage resources efficiently, trade goods, and forge bonds with the villagers while uncovering the town’s mysterious past.

name: Pocket City 2
short_description: A city-building game with a unique twist—step inside and experience your city firsthand! Plan roads, zones, and infrastructure while growing your economy, managing resources, and unlocking special buildings. Host events, build mega projects, and watch your city thrive in a dynamic world.

name: O.W.L Projekt 2
short_description: Explore O.W.L Projekt 2 with Elysion in a renewed world, facing even more complex challenges, fast enemies, and new mechanics like portals of different colors. Use the Sanctum Staff to overcome traps and escape the Watchers in an exciting adventure.

name: Death Stream
short_description: You wake up in a basement room, bound, with a camera staring you down. A deranged masked man entices his audience. You’ve been abducted by a lunatic who thrives on chaos and carnage. His goal? To force you into a twisted game of luck while the entire internet watches in real time.

name: Phantom Relics
short_description: Phantom Relics is an isometric action slasher. Explore ancient catacombs, battle hordes of darkness, and find powerful relics. Face the challenges solo or team up with a friend in local co-op to stop the awakening of evil.

name: Aldo: Memory of the Kingdom
short_description: Action-adventure RPG meets city-building colony sim. An old king tells his kids about an epic past, full of brave adventures, building a kingdom and saving his settlement.

name: Dino Genesis
short_description: Dino Genesis is an action FPS that navigates you through the forgotten island, ISLA GENESIS. You will have to defend yourself from genetically created Dinosaurs, Arachnids and Insects while discovering the dark secrets of the island.

name: Spamware
short_description: You are sentenced to 30,000 hours in prison. Earn your freedom by identifying and reporting spam.

name: Lucky Hand: Roguelike Deck Builder
short_description: Lucky Hand is a roguelike deckbuilding game where every card drawn shapes your fate. Build powerful decks, strategize against challenging enemies, and explore dangerous places. With each battle, unlock new cards to help you in your adventure!

name: Metal Garden
short_description: Travel through an overgrown megastructure, and discover what lies beyond it. Metal Garden is a short, atmospheric singleplayer FPS game.

name: 见诡录：阴魂街 Haunting Record: Phantom Street
short_description: You step into a street both strange and familiar, where eerie events unfold one after another. The air is thick with lingering spirits and overwhelming resentment, as if something in the shadows is waiting to drag you into the abyss…

name: Space Operators
short_description: This is an old-school tank shooter set in space. Conquer newly discovered moons for Mega Corporation Mining Industry to earn your paycheck and make your parents proud! Win battles with your drone by blowing up your rivals in this retro pixel art game.

name: Broad Sword
short_description: Broad Sword is a formation based third-person tactical hack and slash game where you lead formations of troops to face off against a variety of factions in a fantasy realm. Engage in class-based combat as you defeat your foes in conquest, siege and campaign modes.

name: Scrap Dealer Simulator
short_description: Start from scratch and rise with scrap, dig through trash, process junk, and grow your profits. Buy warehouses, machines, and vehicles to build your own recycling empire.

name: Rome in a Day
short_description: The Romans are coming to destroy your humble village at nightfall. How long can you survive?

name: Balloon Friends
short_description: This is a mini puzzle game of cooperative puzzle-solving abilities that may test the emotional strength of the relationship between friends/partners, which requires you and your teammate to cooperate and let the Balloon Friends find the way to the end by conducting the gas!

name: Travel On, Pigeon!
short_description: This is a puzzle-rhythm game about a tourist pigeon having a good time, with engaging challenges you can take at your own pace. Stroll through cute and nostalgic places and get with the flow in this chill and charming experience.

name: 欺神弄鬼
short_description: Tricks of Gods and Ghosts is a female-oriented pixel rpg game set in a hollow female background. In the game, you will play the role of Zhen Wu Si's Tiqi to move freely in the Jianghu and the imperial court. The sea of bureaucracy is full of changes. The fate of the world is yours to decide.

name: Dark Crescent
short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you recruit your foes on a quest to kill the moon.

name: The Curse of Beatriz
short_description: Your parents are out celebrating their wedding anniversary. Alone at home, you decide to test the legend of Beatriz, a spirit that haunts those who summon her in front of the bathroom mirror. What seemed like just a joke soon turns into a terrifying nightmare.

name: Law of the Sword
short_description: Step into a fantasy world balanced by the spirits of swords and protected by law:Law of the Sword is a universe prepared with Stylized Fantasy and Hand Painted visuals, this story is about the events experienced by a knight of a kingdom in the Middle Ages.

name: Shake the Baby!
short_description: Shake the Baby! is a fast-paced satirical boomer shooter with a very peculiar weapon system. Pick up a wide variety of babies and merge them into an even more powerful baby. Rip apart your foes in arena combat or traverse carefully made tactical levels. Just remember: SHAKE. THE. BABY!
