name: The Curse of the Howling Woods
short_description: You came to pull weeds. You got cursed instead. Outsmart werewolves, dodge mummies, and survive the Howling Woods—tea included.

name: 學生騎士團
short_description: 角色扮演戀愛養成加入了大量戰鬥元素形成全新的風格。皇家騎士學院的新生臨危受命，一邊學習一邊拯救帝國，近100條分支可發展出52種結局。 十大魔元素、500種魔法帶你進入神秘的魔法世界。數十個壯麗場景，各種地形與建物都具備了不同的屬性，必須掌握地形優勢才能獲得勝利。數十位學員各有不同的特色，如何搭配裝備及在那一關出場，同樣在考驗玩家的智慧！

name: Defender's Squad: The Last Ride
short_description: Defender's Squad is a sci-fi vertical scrolling shooter 2D that combines 7 different levels. Play Solo and pick one of the 3 ships to kill enemies and save the earth from aliens.

name: Monster Girls and the Mysterious Adventure Remastered Edition
short_description: Turn monster girls into your 'Friends' and embark on an adventure together! This is a rogue-like game inspired by 'Mystery Dungeon,' where the terrain changes every time you challenge it.

name: Get Hired
short_description: 'Get Hired' explores resisting the corrupt capitalist systems that try to force you to become a part of them. As you move toward this system, which will make you work long hours and turn your life into torture, carefully reconsider your choices and decide what is best for you.

name: Six-Ear Macaque: Awakening
short_description: Six- Ear Macaque: Awakening is a casual role-playing game based on the Chinese classic novel Journey to the West. The protagonist is one of the Six- Ear Macaque, is one of the 'mixed four monkeys', ability and Sun Wukong equal. In the game, you will explore the legendary path of your destiny.

name: PianoGlow
short_description: QWERTY & Midi Piano. Multiplayer piano or use it as a visualizer (render video or save audio from within the app)! Keep track of stats and unlock achievements.

name: Bowlatro
short_description: Bowlatro is a rogue-lite bowling game where every run offers new challenges. Unlock powerful relics, purchase different items, experiment with modifiers, and master unique balls that alter gameplay. Ascend through increasingly difficult modes and customize your strategy for each game!

name: Octopus Goulash
short_description: Indie game developed by a single person. Explore a cyberpunk open-world megacity filled with NPCs and their unique stories. Pilot flying cars, become a cop, criminal, or relic hunter, and shape the destiny of a city full of secrets and intrigue.

name: Reignbreaker
short_description: Reignbreaker is a high-octane action rogue-like set in a dystopian medievalpunk world. Step into the boots of Clef, a fearless rebel ready to rid the world of the Kingdom’s oppression, take down the Elite and lay siege to the Queen’s grand Bastion. Grab your javelin and become The Reignbreaker!

name: Thinking Inside The Box
short_description: You play as a little, square guy trapped in a maze of cardboard boxes filled with a myriad of challenges. The rules are simple: move the diamonds to the appropriate pressure plates without letting different-colored diamonds touch—swap, push, and phase to complete levels as quickly as possible.

name: Remonstrator
short_description: The world has gone mad and lost every bit of justice. Take a part in well-known historical events against the police and unleash your protest!

name: Starborn Survivor
short_description: Starborn Survivor is a sci-fi action roguelite where you control a robotic warrior fighting relentless alien hordes. Navigate, shoot, upgrade, and strive to survive for as long as possible! Tailor your loadout and adapt to the increasing challenges in this thrilling bullet-dodging adventure.

name: Dark Shadows
short_description: Elena killed Jason to protect her friend but unleashed a terrifying curse. Now Dark Shadow is back for revenge. Survive, face your fears, and don’t scream—if you do, it all starts over!

name: Pocket Oracle
short_description: Uncover your destiny in this interactive divination game! Explore ancient Eastern wisdom and complete quests to unlock 64 hexagrams that reveal the mysteries of your destiny in love, career, health, wealth, and more. Embrace the timeless power of fortune-telling and find clarity on your life's path!

name: Puttler
short_description: Puttler is a mini-golf puzzle game featuring wacky obstacles and a charming backstory. Build contraptions to score the golf ball under par across 13 courses and over 200 unique holes to solve.

name: Death and Ladders
short_description: Roll the dice, climb the ladders, avoid scythes, take risky shortcuts, use Tarot Ability Cards to improve your odds or trap your opponent. Reach the end first to win.

name: Corner Kitchen Fast Food Simulator
short_description: Buy cooking equipment, prepare delicious meals, and serve hungry customers. Upgrade your setup, read customer reviews, and expand your business to become the top fast-food joint in the city.

name: SIGMA  WAR  NOTES
short_description: This is an ACT action game that can achieve a satisfying sense of impact through simple operations.

name: Your mini wife
short_description: Maybe you can ask a lady to play chess with you, play with you, or play sweet games between lovers with you on your computer desktop!

name: 最后的修仙者
short_description: A simple and playable placing game where you can hang up and place and wait for a reward

name: End's Reach
short_description: End's Reach is a 3D Exploration Action Adventure Game that focuses on a character lost in the depths of space. Players will solve puzzles, collect upgrades, items, weapons and even magical abilities as they uncover the mysteries of this strange new world. A classic tale of technology taken too far.

name: Yagazem Elements
short_description: In Yagazem Elements, a medieval fantasy RPG, you play as Kubke. A curious young golemancer / wizard, in search of knowledge. Experience a story about discovery and sacrifice as you guide your golems in a hexagonal world, clearing dungeons and helping gods solve their problems.

name: Hephep Fever : Retold
short_description: In this arcade game, remake of the classic Hephep Fever™, eat good stuff, avoid bad stuff, it's simple as that! ... or it is?

name: Astro Fighters
short_description: Astro Fighters is a tough old school vertical scrolling bullet hell shooter designed to test your skills with non-stop arcade style action. Fight against large bosses at the end of every level and compete for the high score across 4 difficulty modes to be the best fighter pilot in the game.

name: No Time to Build
short_description: No Time to Build is a cooperative casual game with parkour and action elements! Collect logs, avoid cars, trains, and walking bombs, overcome challenges, and build structures within the time limit. Teleports, speed-boosting bushes, and player interactions make every game chaotic and fun!

name: 5 NIGHTS AT BOBR KURWA
short_description: Beaver Lyolik ate too many mushrooms and became a KURWA! Only the chosen ones can survive these 5 nights!

name: Trail of Angels
short_description: 'Trail of Angels' is a virtual reality journey that explores deep themes of human existence, the nature of the world and the essence of being, brought to life through the captivating works of renowned artist, composer and abstract art pioneer Mikalojus Ciurlionis.

name: 仿生羊游戏
short_description: The Game Of Bionic Goat is a suspenseful story-oriented adventure game in which you manipulate the main character to interact with the scene and game characters, advancing the story through communication and choices with other characters.

name: Braise
short_description: Dive into the fantasy world of Braise, a narrative adventure game. Explore the Dragon’s Valley and complete quests and puzzles to uncover the mysteries it holds.

name: Daily Driven Racer
short_description: DDR is about racing everyday cars, or sleeper cars, on unique tracks, each offering a fresh experience. Enjoy various game modes in Single Player and Split Screen. The Simcade driving style ensures fun for both casual and hardcore players. Play with 2-4 players in local split-screen for maximum fun!

name: Mythic Battlegrounds: Demonic Siege
short_description: A turn-based strategy game where your tactical decisions are key to surviving relentless waves of enemy attacks. While battles unfold automatically, your choices before the clash, such as resource management, unit training, and skill selection, are critical to securing victory.

name: Jumalien
short_description: The great Jumalien tournament enters its final phase, only the god of gods will emerge victorious. Embody a deity and hunt down your opponents to receive the supreme sacrament in this local multiplayer hack & slash!

name: Morse Academy
short_description: Three operatives return to their abandoned boarding school to hunt a sinister fugitive. As old traumas awaken and paranoia takes hold, will they survive their own fears?

name: MYRIAD DEATH
short_description: This is an exhilarating action and shooting game where you fight using weapons with different abilities.

name: Leas: City of the Sun
short_description: When a new magic is discovered, it's up to you to unravel the mystery! Find answers from fae and humans, save your city, and maybe even fall in love! A text-based interactive fantasy novel, 400,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects.

name: MeMic
short_description: MeMic is an atmospheric stealth game where you play as a mimic hiding among objects to hunt adventurers. Explore a world filled with Easter eggs, secrets, and references, find the perfect moments to strike, and immerse yourself in a suspenseful survival experience.

name: A Short Death
short_description: A short 3D Platformer and Collectathon situated in Hell. Play as a humble cat (with wings!) and get to the top of the mysterious tower!

name: Geopogo Cities
short_description: Geopogo Cities: Explore real cities—SF, NY, London, Miami—in 3D. Place buildings, tweak layouts, and roam urban icons in early access. Roads, systems, and expanded tools coming to build a full city sim. Shape the future with us!

name: THEMIS
short_description: Explore The Sequence. A set of unique platform and puzzle rooms hiding a dark secret behind its digital walls. Using both physics and game play mechanics, THEMIS is challenging players into a battle of minds and quick reflexes. Do you have what it takes to become The Truly Awakened?

name: Chaos Caster
short_description: Cast spells, dash around hordes of enemies, and assemble powerful combos as you explore procedurally generated dungeons. Chaos Caster is an action roguelike focused on strategy, playstyle variety, and replayability.

name: Hello Girl
short_description: Have you ever felt like a rabbit with a telephone? Hello Girl is a thrilling kinetic visual novel about connection and disconnection, set during a time of great uncertainty.

name: Sapo 3D
short_description: A 3D/Pixel-Art Platformer With Classic Elements Where You Will Control an Acrobat Frog. Collect Golden Flies to Unlock New Worlds, Levels and Other Surprises.

name: Panelka
short_description: Panelka is a nostalgic, relaxing game where you immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the post-Soviet era. Create your cozy apartment or garage with that familiar, warm interior from your childhood. You have a wide selection of furniture and many other interior details at your disposal.

name: Bao Bao's Cozy Laundromat
short_description: Relax in Bao Bao’s Cozy Laundromat, an idle game where you join Bao Bao, a charming panda, in creating the coziest laundromat. Purchase colorful washing machines, add delightful decorations, and hire panda helpers. Watch your cozy laundromat bustle with life, even when you’re not around!

name: Final Eden
short_description: This is a side scrolling aerial shooting game where players need to operate the last human survivor, Lilith, to move and shoot in the air, use constantly improving weapons to eliminate enemies, complete all levels, and ultimately find her own value in the shattered world.

name: Nitronauts
short_description: Nitronauts is a 2-6 player couch/online multiplayer party game fusing classic Bomberman-like mechanics with explosive new twists. Battle across nine unique stages with an arsenal of wacky items & power-ups. Gather your friends and let the bombs do the talking!

name: High Spirits
short_description: Drink potions while you banish ancient spirits and recover your memories of the night before. In this RPG you'll recruit dysfunctional companions, collect strange ingredients, and concoct wicked brews.

name: BUTTON PRISON
short_description: You find yourself trapped in a mysterious room upon awakening. Surrounding you are sparse pieces of furniture, mannequins, and countless buttons. Can you safely escape this room?

name: PLEASE STOP CRYING: TERRIBLE TWOS
short_description: PLEASE STOP CRYING: Terrible Twos is a lighthearted horror game about a father yet again struggling to keep up with his baby at a restaurant.

name: Emissary Zero
short_description: Co-op horror (1-4 players). You are sent to explore a mysterious building at night. Find the Moon and try to return alive.

name: WYRMHALL: Brush and Banter
short_description: Meet quirky characters and clean strange artifacts in this short cozy comedy game. From an enchanted teacup to a cursed skull with a chip on its shoulder, each item and client brings new twists and surprises.

name: ROOM FOOTBALL - Hangar
short_description: Puzzle, artillery, casual puzzle video game with realistic physics.

name: Pocket and Zooom
short_description: Pocket & Zooom is a puzzle game in which you give commands to aircraft to guide them to their destinations. Players can give only six kinds of commands. It's more difficult than it sounds. Create a strategy to get the aircraft to their destinations!

name: Bober Constructions
short_description: Bober k***w. Patrz jakie bydle! And even more than just one. 4 beaver-builders, and you can control one of them. Create structures, manage time and resources, watch out for obstacles, and remember, fast action is the key to success!

name: Dinosaurs in Place
short_description: In this exciting two-dimensional puzzle game, you need to place your prehistoric friends on the grid so that they fit perfectly. Dinosaurs in Place offers 100 unique levels and 40 diverse dinosaurs that will not leave you indifferent.

name: Capibara Lost Dreams
short_description: Enjoy the story of Frank and his adventure to escape from an island dominated by a sect of humanoid Capybaras, fight, explore, and meet countless fun characters!

name: MoonSpire
short_description: A short 2D puzzle platformer with a rage element inspired by Nintendo's Legend of Zelda: Oracle of Seasons platforming sections.

name: LASTORAGE｜最果て倉庫
short_description: In this warehouse, it was supposed to be just a simple inspection job. But the shadows of the cardboard boxes writhe, and the security robots’ eyes glow with an eerie light. If you uncover everything… is there truly a way out?

name: Bubble Ghost Remake
short_description: Guide a small ghost and its bubble through an enchanted castle full of dangers and challenges in this incredible remake of the popular classic 'Bubble Ghost'. With over 40 levels of skill that include ingenious puzzles and challenging obstacles, get ready for hours of addictive gameplay.

name: Edd Skeleton Game
short_description: Survive Edd Skeleton's 'amazing' game, Mock his efforts, and watch him up the ante with scarier creatures, trickier puzzles, and surprises that will keep you on edge. Can you endure his trials and become friends... or will you just keep mocking his incompetence?

name: Scrap Collector
short_description: Collect, combine, and automate card production. Discover new areas, resources, and enemies all while growing your mechanized army. Plan ahead before taking on the challenges of the ruptured earth.

name: ぼくの葬式にようこそ -happy rebirthday-
short_description: 死後、白黒の世界に迷い込んだ「ぼく」は生前の記憶を取り戻す'旅'に出る。主人公の葬式から始まる、切なくて温かい成長譚。

name: KARMA: The Dark World
short_description: KARMA: The Dark World is a first-person cinematic psychological thriller set in a dystopian world where the Leviathan Corporation is omnipresent. The year is 1984, the place is East Germany, and things are not quite what they seem.

name: Super Block Boy and Friends
short_description: Super Block Boy and Friends is an exhilarating 2D precision platformer that puts your skills and sanity to the ultimate test. Dive into our world of challenging levels that reward grit and persistence.

name: Unbox The Cats
short_description: Find and rescue adorable cats hidden among boxes. Feed them treats to add them to your collection. Discover 100 unique cats in this casual puzzle game inspired by Minesweeper.

name: Eldritch Verdict
short_description: 'Eldritch Verdict': A dark fairy tale turn-based card game. Strategic planning and battle execution shape your adventure amid challenges. Progression customizes character growth for a deep, replayable experience.

name: Static : The Beginning
short_description: Immerse yourself in STATIC : THE BEGINNING , a horror adventure where Clara's quiet evening turns into a nightmare. Navigate a Moroccan riad, face sinister cultists, battle terrifying monsters, and uncover dark secrets. Can you help Clara escape the horrors that await?

name: Nekograms
short_description: Help cats get to sleep in this adorable puzzle game! Move the cats and cushions so that every kitty is nice and comfy. But there’s a twist! Cats only move left and right, and cushions only move up and down.

name: Harmony Of Fear
short_description: In Harmony of Fear, you will take on the role of Dian, a music instructor who brings her students to a secluded villa for a music rehearsal. Uncover dark secrets and face supernatural threats in this gripping psychological horror inspired by Indonesian folklore.

name: Escape the Tower
short_description: You wake up to find yourself on a radio tower 600 meters above the ground. With only 10 minutes to spare, escape the tower!

name: ROLLING STAR
short_description: Bursting with hilarious dialogue and comical encounters! The second installment of the super-exhilarating Metroidvania series is here!!

name: Dominions - Priests, Prophets & Pretenders
short_description: In Dominions you take control of a powerful being that rules a nation and aspires to godhood. It all takes place in a fantasy world with monsters, magic items and world altering spells. Dominions is a 4x turn based strategy game with a large variety of spells and units.

name: Secret Crush -Unrequited love-
short_description: My second spring in high school. Surrounded by my dreamy upperclassman, that classmate I'm interested in, and my childhood friend who's a year younger than me. She's been in the search for a boyfriend who would look at her, and only her. The protagonist Chika decides to confess her feelings to……

name: Realmweaver
short_description: In Realmweaver, every move matters! in this isometric grid-based puzzle game, both your puzzle solving and timing skills will be put to the test with a unique set of mechanics to master and puzzles to overcome!

name: ORDER 13
short_description: You wake up in a dark warehouse, tasked with packing orders while something lurks in the shadows. Work fast, stay safe, and protect your cat. He’s all you’ve got.

name: Oddventure
short_description: Oddventure is a lore-rich turn-based crazy RPG set in a cursed fairytale world. Fight your inner demons and reach for the spark of hope, or stare directly into the abyss.

name: Mystal Haven
short_description: Mystal Haven is a laid-back, open-world creature-collecting game with 4-player split-screen and online multiplayer with your Steam friends.

name: Tilemancer Dungeon
short_description: Tilemancer dungeon is a minimalist dungeon crawler - card game where you create & explore your own dungeon. Create your own path, fight your way through the dungeon, gear up and claim the dungeon to become the next Tilemancer !

name: LIMB: Origins
short_description: LIMB: Origins is a dark sci-fi horror game where you must survive in a mysterious parallel world following the disappearance of a research team. Unravel the mysteries of your missing colleagues, explore the world, repair the teleporter, and find your way home.

name: Prisoners of Ulag'Bol: A Dungeon Crawling Deckbuilder
short_description: Embark on a quest of revenge against the dark lord Ulag'Bol in this dungeon-crawling deckbuilder! Choose your class and starting deck, then delve into a three-act roguelike adventure. Collect powerful cards and equipment to unlock devastating synergies and defeat Ulag'Bol and claim your freedom!

name: SQR
short_description: YOU ARE SQR. PART OF YOU IS MISSING.

name: 風雨来記
short_description: 『旅』をテーマにしたアドベンチャーゲームです。フリーライターの主人公は北海道を旅し、各地で自然や風景、出会った人々の写真を撮りながら、ヒロインや様々な人々との出会いと別れを通じ成長していく。

name: Emberfly
short_description: Emberfly is a horror game set in Korea. One day, you wake up at school. The outside is dark, and no one seems to be around. Relying on the flashlight in your hand, you must find a way to escape from this dream that feels real but isn't.

name: Ultimate Soccer
short_description: Ultimate skills to shoot, attack and run to mix combat gameplay with a skill-based soccer game in third person perspective! Show how you kick the shot to other players and become an Ultimate soccer player, gates awaiting to explode with your amazing goals!

name: Proxyma
short_description: Proxyma is a hardcore retro-style 2D platformer that challenges you to finish 13 increasingly hard levels in a single run.

name: Ambidextro
short_description: A multi-player game for a single player. Learn to control 2 characters at the same time, one with each hand. Achieve ambidexterity and rescue both the prince and the princess at the same time.

name: Songs of Rats
short_description: The Wreckage resounds with the echoes of countless songs, filling the air of a constantly shifting maze where bravery and sacrifice are key to staying alive. Then, without warning, one song goes silent. Will you step into this dicey labyrinth and uncover its secrets in this minimalist and dark RPG?

name: The First Berserker: Khazan
short_description: The First Berserker: Khazan is a hardcore action role-playing game. The player will become Khazan, the great general of the Pell Los Empire, who overcame death, and sets out to reveal the incidents that led to his downfall and seek vengeance on his enemies.

name: Red or Blue
short_description: Red button and blue button. Your choice determines everything.

name: Turmoil Uprising: Dynasty
short_description: Fight in the chaotic world of three kingdoms era as legendary heroes, find unique ways to build your hero, face hordes of enemies, overcome challenges, become the legend itself!

name: Galactic Seals Survivors
short_description: Take down the evil carnivorous orcas while you fight your way to their big boss! Galactic Seals Survivors is an arcade game with rogue-like elements and upgrades to give you the power to take on the entire Galactic Orcas empire.

name: LiDAR Exploration Program
short_description: LiDAR Exploration Program is a relaxing atmospheric horror game where you are in complete darkness. Use the scanner to see the world around you.

name: Star Titans : War of the Galaxy
short_description: Various upgrades such as ship reinforcement, retention effects, and module installation, which are growth elements of the spacecraft. Adds more fun to the game with easy and simple strategies that anyone can enjoy Star Titans: War of the Galaxy is a light 4X march sci-fi strategy simulation game.

name: Terraspace
short_description: The game 'Terraspace' offers you a unique experience of planet settlement and terraforming — creating conditions for life on unsuitable planets. This will require you to build the necessary structures to populate the planet.

name: PENGUIN HOTEL 2 -Snake Penguin Ambition-
short_description: Mascot Horror: 'Penguin Hotel' Chapter 2 The Snake Penguin is after you. Solve mysteries with a mysterious camera and push forward!

name: Tilted Tennis
short_description: A competitive paddle and ball game, with a twist! As you hit the ball around the arena, the camera follows it. Spin the ball to disorient your friends and win the match, but take care not to lose track of which way is up yourself...

name: 传说世界
short_description: This is an open world real-time combat game The game contains multiple professions, including warriors, mages, shooters, assassins, and ball kings Eliminate the evil dragon in the legendary world, complete the mission, and also travel to the Three Kingdoms City to fight against Lu Bubu.

name: I Am Quadrober!
short_description: Are you ready to take on the challenge and become the best quadrober? Join us and prove that you are a true master of quadrobbing!

name: Guy Who Sells Jars
short_description: Step into the shoes of a brand-new jar shop owner! Create and sell jars to over 200+ unique customers! Be careful though, some jar shop owners don't take lightly to new competitors...

name: Port Town: Survival
short_description: A deserted port town, missing people, and a dark secret waiting to be uncovered… Dive into Port Town’s open world, collect mysterious photos, and reveal the truth. But be careful… some secrets are meant to stay buried.

name: Sticks Aim Trainer
short_description: Master controller aim with Sticks - the ultimate aim trainer built specifically for controllers. Fine-tune your skills with unmatched customization, replicate any game's feel, and share settings via cross-platform workshop. Warm up properly, dominate from match one.

name: Cheese Moon
short_description: Cheese Moon is an adventure game where cute rabbits explore the moon. Uncover a huge secret hidden on the far side by battling aggressive cheese creatures and mysterious machines marked with 'RTMK.' Summon rabbit clones to clear stages. With 5 worlds and 100 stages, an epic journey awaits!

name: Elroy and the Aliens
short_description: It's the year 1993. Talking robots, ghosts from the past, and ancient alien technology buried under desert sand. An adventure following Elroy and Peggie in the search of a long-lost father. How far would you go to bring back the ones you love?

name: INAYAH - Life after Gods
short_description: INAYAH – Life After Gods is a thrilling action-platformer with metroidvania elements. Immerse yourself in a story with multiple choices, explore diverse biomes, face more than 20 bosses, and develop your character with a unique progression system.

name: Isles Above
short_description: Take control of Ribbit, the brave astronaut frog, and explore a charming floating island world. Collect coins and energy crystals, pilot your spaceship, and enjoy a cozy, stress-free platformer adventure!

name: Jeff The Janitor
short_description: Jeff the Janitor is a co-op survival horror game for up to 1-5 players. Sneak into the mall at night for a heist, but beware - Jeff, the night-shift janitor, is on watch! Complete your shopping list, and make your escape.

name: Zack in Fight
short_description: 2D Traditionally Hand Animated Fighting Game based on the Animated Adventures of Zack in Time project

name: Lewis Quest
short_description: Reclaim the Lewis family heirloom, in this short 2-D Collectathon Platformer. Navigate treacherous lands and infiltrate Calculus Castle, finding various secrets along the way.

name: Legend of Heroes: Three Kingdoms
short_description: 'Legend of Heroes: Three Kingdoms' is a single-player RPG where you shape the Three Kingdoms era. Choose to be a ruler, a loyal advisor, or a cunning mercenary. Marry, build homes, or train in martial arts. Restore peace through diplomacy or conquer with mighty armies.

name: The Trolley Problem Game
short_description: The Trolley Problem Game has over 300 different interpretations of The Trolley Problem for you to solve!

name: Coin Smith
short_description: Welcome to Coin Smith, an addictive idle clicker game where your journey to unimaginable riches starts with a single tap. Set in a world inspired by the ancient Lydian Empire, the birthplace of coins, you'll build, upgrade, and strategize your way to wealth and glory.

name: Journey Up
short_description: Gain sentience and climb up out of the mines and beyond on your own or online with up to 4 players. Play with checkpoints or without for a more tense experience. Supports VR and desktop monitor mode. Can you reach the top?

name: Bomber Festival
short_description: Random map Bomberman, with customizable details, let's have a Bomberman party together!

name: 双雄风流传（Romantic Emperor）
short_description: In 双雄风流传（Romantic Emperor）, you will embark on an unprecedented gaming journey. This is a unique game that combines both visual fiction and business construction.

name: Mountain Taxi Challenge
short_description: Take on the ultimate driving challenge in Mountain Taxi Challenge! Navigate treacherous mountain roads, pick up diverse passengers, and complete 30 unique missions—from emergency rescues to time-sensitive drop-offs. Can you master the winding paths and become the best taxi driver in the mountains?

name: Overlook Trail
short_description: Embark on Overlook Trail, a mixtape of arcade gameplay, 3D platforming, and peculiar puzzles. Navigate through surreal landscapes with ever-changing challenges.

name: Space Shooter - Tryü Sora
short_description: A vertical-scrolling space shooter, and a love letter to classic arcade space shooters, Tryü Sora blends retro charm with modern gameplay. Master a handcrafted campaign, explore secrets, and dominate fast-paced modes in this addictive space adventure!

name: Unpatterned Cut
short_description: Unpatterned Cut is a VR action-reflex game where you have to finish the episodes by killing enemies to survive in the simulation and maybe save your loved ones. Also, push yourself on scores and climb the leaderboard rankings against other players.

name: Spilled!
short_description: Clean up ocean waste in this short & relaxing game! Recycle, earn coins and upgrade your boat. Explore new areas. Clean bigger spills and different kinds of waste!

name: SONOKUNI
short_description: Battle your way through a biopunk and Japanese mythology-inspired landscape filled with over-the-top, hip hop-infused 2D action. A single hit means death, but use your time-bending skills to take down your oppressors and you might yet save your dying nation.

name: The Other Side
short_description: Embark on a chilling co-op adventure in The Other Side, an action packed horror experience. Customize your gear, strategize with friends, and uncover paranormal mysteries. Are you prepared to face the unknown together in this immersive supernatural experience?

name: Downward Spear
short_description: Downward Spear is a single player isometric tactical action game with stealth and horror elements. The ice caps have melted causing flooding of most coastal land, and released ancient viruses that consume their hosts.

name: Three Sisters
short_description: Three Sisters is a goofy RPG featuring some cute little (not nightmare inducing) enemies and a story where nothing bad ever happens! Wait, what's that? You played the other games? crap.

name: Plantasia
short_description: A cozy, semi-idle, gardening game in a solarpunk universe that sits at the bottom of your screen while you work.

name: Reaper Rules - Episode 1
short_description: Fight and solve puzzles with two unique characters: ASSO (with his sharp scythe) and JAKE, who can transform into an okapi (don’t ask why). Experience a story filled with mystery, drama, and humor.

name: TETHER BRAWL
short_description: Friends or Frenemies? Team up or sabotage your friend in this fast-paced, 2-player brawler where you're literally tethered together. Set in a sci-fi world, play as a cute, unique animal wielding sports-inspired weapons. Beat up waves of killer robots, dodge attacks and score points to win!

name: Dice 'n Goblins
short_description: Dice 'n Goblins is a turn-based RPG that blends luck and strategy as you battle using dice rolls. Master your skills, chain powerful combos, and overcome the whims of fortune. Collect loot, upgrade your gear, and craft the ultimate dice arsenal to face monsters and other foes lurking in the shadows!

name: Barman Simulator
short_description: Take charge of your bar in Barman Simulator! Serve cocktails, manage inventory, and deal with thieves. Hire staff, decorate your establishment to your liking, and attract crowds with exciting activities. Make your bar the hottest spot in town!

name: 爱人：Aijin
short_description: ''Aijin' is a Chinese dreamcore psychological and survival horror game with multiple endings. you play as a student who has returned from the 'Lover Internet Addiction Treatment School.' After enduring severe psychological trauma, one day you discover the truth about 'Aijin' and your own identity...

name: Just Anomalies
short_description: A slow-burning psychological horror where the fear comes not from monsters, but from the unknown. Each step leads you back to the same room—familiar, yet subtly wrong. The silence weighs heavy, the air feels off, and the deeper you stare, the stronger the sense that something is staring back.

name: Infinity Cats Project
short_description: This is a typing-themed placement game. In the game, you can hire three cute kittens to type for you. At the same time, purchase various props to improve typing speed. Watch the cute cats typing and enjoy your relaxing and leisure moments here!

name: Disney Villains Cursed Café
short_description: Stir up a fresh take on iconic Disney Villains in this rich visual novel.

name: cheapskate
short_description: Retro inspired 3D skateboarding action sports game. Precise but forgiving digital input, snappy predictable arcade physics, fun playground levels, and free form skateboarding. Fully offline single player and optional old school peer to peer multiplayer.

name: Expelled!
short_description: A School Prefect has been pushed out of a window, and everyone's blaming YOU. Can you find the culprit - or someone to take the fall - before you get EXPELLED? Mystery with a wicked twist, from the creators of Overboard!, 80 Days, Heaven's Vault and A Highland Song.

name: Lost Lands X
short_description: The sudden madness of an old friend from the Lost Lands forces Susan, who has long since retired, to return to her old adventures. “Lost Lands X” is an adventure game in the genre of Hidden Objects, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters and complicated quests.

name: Strangers Lurk
short_description: What starts as strange phone calls from a unknown stranger who sometimes just breaths, Eerie creeks and sounds through out the house soon turns into a deadly game of cat and mouse. The calls might just be coming from INSIDE the house!

name: Shoes Store Simulator
short_description: Are you ready to outshine competitors? Order shoes, stock them on shelves, assist customers in finding the perfect shoes, and handle payments. Hire staff, design your store, and expand it step by step. Build the best shoe store, and enjoy the exciting journey. There’s so much waiting for you!

name: イル・ドー
short_description: このゲームは、海洋交易で資金を稼ぐゲームで、交易、探険、戦闘の３つが重要となります。交易で銀貨を稼いで仲間を増やし、探険で手に入れた資材で強い船をつくり、戦闘に勝利しましょう。交易、探険、戦闘をどういうバランスで進めていくかは、プレイヤーの自由な攻略に委ねられています。ゲームの舞台となる海域には、ライバルの勢力がいて覇権を競い合っています。プレイヤーはストーリー中の分岐によって、勢力同士争いに介入することができ、その選択が味方になる勢力と敵になる勢力に影響を及ぼします。

name: Pro Dino Hunt VR: Jurassic Hunting World
short_description: Step into a prehistoric world where danger lurks at every turn. Armed with powerful weapons, hunt massive dinosaurs in immersive VR environments. Face deadly predators, explore wild terrains, and test your survival skills. Do you have what it takes to be the ultimate hunter?

name: Cyborg: Rise
short_description: An adventure game that combines first person shooter and Roguelite random elements. Players can manipulate heroes with different abilities in the game. Embark on adventure challenges in random levels. Every time you respawn, you can unlock new skills and equipment to challenge stronger enemies.

name: FIND ALL 6: Netherlands
short_description: Immerse yourself in an exciting adventure in the Find All 6: Netherlands game! You will explore the unique landscapes, historical cities and famous landmarks of the Netherlands. Look for hidden objects and color this painted world.

name: Mudborne: Frog Management Sim
short_description: Mudborne is a casual nature management sim about discovering & breeding frogs! Awoken from hibernation you find your pond abandoned. Through the genetic keys of new species you must unlock the paths between the waking & dreaming worlds, and embark on a journey to restore lost populations.

name: Bowling Simulator
short_description: Bowling Simulator is a realistic bowling game where you’ll feel like a pro landing strikes, thanks to its easy to use controls. Grab your favorite drink and hit the lanes at Nashville Bowling Center, where bowling isn’t just a game—it’s life!

name: Kaiju Evolution Survivor
short_description: Kaiju Evolution is a top-down action roguelike game where you choose a Kaiju to evolve through four different size stages, from a microscopic creature into a gigantic world-ending threat. Survive for 20 minutes against increasingly larger waves of enemies as you learn new weapons and abilities.

name: Dungeon Story
short_description: This is a card-based adventure game where you command three adventurers to explore dungeons, acquire skills and abilities, defeat monsters, collect rewards, and strengthen your party. Lead your trio to conquer the final boss!

name: Castle Combat
short_description: RTS, but the soldiers will act automatically: Each soldier has different characteristics/attribute values/action methods. Choose the appropriate soldiers and buildings according to the battlefield situation, and destroy the opponent's castle only through your strategy rather than operation!

name: ROOM FOOTBALL - Petrol Station
short_description: Puzzle, artillery, casual puzzle video game with realistic physics.

name: Elemental Continent
short_description: 'Elemental Continent' is a nostalgic pixel-style JRPG game. You will play as a brave boy, meet various reliable partners during your journey, and face various powerful and insidious enemies together during the adventure. Come and explore this magical world!

name: Kindred [SnowBound]
short_description: In this dark romance, horror visual novel, a brutal attack on your village leaves you stranded and vulnerable. Making matters worse is your run-in with the beast of the nearby woods. Will you find a way to escape your demented captor, or will you earn his trust? Choose a side; Don't look back.

name: Archaeology - Grass Farm
short_description: A game of the genre find the hidden object.

name: Chorus of Carcosa
short_description: Chorus of Carcosa is a first-person psychological horror game about an anxious sculptor who is trapped in a dark and ever-changing building. Stay silent, survive its twisted labyrinths and escape the monsters. Just don’t lose your way in the shadows or within your own mind.

name: Smack Monkey
short_description: Monkey climb. Monkey fall. Monkey climb.

name: Exosky
short_description: Master the art of extreme flight in Exosky. Score points through death-defying aerobatics in a physics-driven flight sim where danger equals data. Push the limits of airframe and pilot as you train an AI cat's revolutionary autopilot system.

name: Dinosaur vs Hitler
short_description: In the game, create countless Hitler and monsters and use dinosaurs, firearms and cold weapons to make him suffer .

name: Let's Build Wonders: Galaxy
short_description: Let’s Build Wonders:Galaxy is a multiplayer cooperative space-building game. In the game, members within each alliance achieve efficient resource sharing and division of labor through trade transportation means. They work to expand their alliance's galactic territory to resist pirate harassment.

name: Mamizou's Mimic Check
short_description: Touhou Project's secondary Speedy Mistake-finding game!Check for errors in the content of the changes! The speed increases when you get consecutive correct answers!Let's check if the various Touhou characters are correct!

name: Decofarm
short_description: Welcome to Decofarm! Build your own cute and cozy farm in this clicker, farming sim! Destroy debris, earn coins and upgrade a magical windmill to unlock buildings, animals and crops that help you earn even more coins.

name: Mythic Merchants
short_description: Craft magical gear in a bustling workshop! Upgrade your tools, automate processes, and hire goblin interns as you travel through time. Meet quirky heroes like Tony the chronomancer, Mino the strong minotaur, Rana the alchemist frog, and Vulf the tech-savvy wolf. Will you become a Mythic Merchant?

name: Lizard Slayer
short_description: Lizard Slayer - an arena shooter with roguelike elements. You will take on the role of an ancient Slavs and participate in real historical battles against lizards.

name: Bonjin ~ An Ordinary Man
short_description: When your beloved wants to abandon his personality and become an absolutely ordinary person, what do you do? Bonjin ~ An Ordinary Man is an young adult romantic story about transgender identity, exploration of masculinity, and mutual understanding.

name: Remote Reaper: FPV Drone
short_description: FPV drone simulator. Destroy enemy vehicles with high-precision strikes. Simulation of electronic warfare and realistic armor model.

name: Ezrebeth
short_description: Ezrebeth is an old, bitter recluse who finds herself constantly invaded by her peculiar relatives during the winter holidays. Oh, and she's stuck in a time loop! Investigate, interview and cross-reference as you attempt to figure out what's going on in this surreal visual novel.

name: Phantom Thief Angels: Twin Angel - Labyrinth of Time and World - Re:light
short_description: Let's Go Fever Time! Lovely Angel! By day, ordinary girls. By night, the 'Phantom Thief Angels TwinAngel' - on a mission to reclaim stolen treasures. Winter 2024: The Angels descend on Steam.

name: The Fear Chants: Echoes of the Devil
short_description: Trapped in a cursed house, ancient chants echo in the darkness, awakening an unspeakable evil. The Fear Chants: Echoes of the Devil is a psychological horror where your fears come to life. Explore, survive, and uncover the truth… but whatever you do, do not repeat the chants.

name: Bomb Around
short_description: Physics based rage game inspired by jump king and other foddian games. Play as unique characters trying to reach as high as possible. Use interesting upgrades to reach new heights and discover the difficulty ahead. Compete on the leaderboards with speedrun, daily seed, or just casual play.

name: Toushin Gent
short_description: Seeking the coveted Goon Crystal and Bloodline Emblem, the Brutal Cook Gent must face Bendy Town and its strange dungeon. Guide our reluctant 'hero' as he faces unwanted attention from friends and foe alike in this 'unique' experience of a game.

name: Spidle Tridle
short_description: Build your industry and earn credits to buy your ticket back home to Earth. Minimalist sci-fi base building about resource extraction and refinement. A 100% organic indie idle game with an oldschool lo-fi aesthetic and a light-hearted & relaxed atmosphere. Made to be played in a window on the side.

name: Galactic Vanguard
short_description: Galactic Vanguard is a fast-paced, retro-style action shooter. Grab your weapons and eliminate relentless enemy forces and powerful alien creatures. Engage in intense battles across space bases, desert wastelands, lava valleys, and abandoned alien ruins!

name: Steven
short_description: Steven is a vampire-survivor-style game where you play as Steven, the swan. Use his attacks to devour enemies, earning points to upgrade Steven and make him stronger for the upcoming waves.

name: Argebe
short_description: A deliberately simplistic strategy game about equal opportunities and outplaying your opponents with stone cold logic

name: Retro Soccer
short_description: Retro Soccer is a highly playable well paced arcade action soccer game inspired by classics from the 90s with a visual upgrade. Compete in classic tournaments from the 86 World Cup to Euro 96 with teams having their own skill level based on FIFA world rankings of the time.

name: Occultus Vitae - Hidden Life
short_description: A psychological horror adventure where you explore abandoned locations and unravel dark legends. Set in a remote castle hiding a black magic experiment gone wrong, you'll face haunting environments, challenging puzzles, and a fight to survive the horrors lurking within.

name: MainFrames
short_description: MainFrames invites you to meet Floppy and to browse a clever and charming platformer that plays out entirely within the windows and desktop of a PC monitor. You won’t want to press the escape key on this cozy outing!

name: The Throng
short_description: An online frog-based game where survival is not guaranteed, so be ready to hide, run, and laugh.

name: MOBA大乱斗
short_description: This is a strategy game that uses cards to simulate MOBA tactics. You can make more reasonable combinations of your heroes and skills. The arena mode follows pure MOBA rules. Currently, 18 heroes (each with its own independent talents) and 28 skills have been created.

name: Dawn Awaits
short_description: The journey of a girl and her toy cat escaping a fractured home into a mesmerizing world of mirrored steps and emotional challenges.

name: Undershadows
short_description: A child without a soul. A world drowned in shadow. Embark on an eerie adventure, meet strange creatures, solve puzzles, and face horrifying foes – but the darkest threat lies deep within yourself.

name: Heroes' Call - A Casual MMO Guild Sim
short_description: Lead your guild and its members to conquer the challenges of perilous dungeons, all through a sleek and vibrant interface.

name: ROGUE LIGHT DECK BUILDER
short_description: Your house needs a deck. You have a hammer. Freedom is $1,000,000.

name: Grandma's In Hell
short_description: Tower defense meets Pac-Man-like in this addictive and unique strategy game. Play as Grandma as she outwits waves of demons across 40 challenging levels. Build mazes that send demons to their doom. Spend countless hours on one of the best strategy games available.

name: Backrooms: The Next Level
short_description: Backrooms: The Next Level is a Co-op horror game up to 4 players, where you and your friends will explore the game, try to pass the game level using your mind, wit, remembering the places where you were

name: Creator-initial
short_description: A real -time strategy game that can create items to operate logic.No resource collection

name: Centum
short_description: Every why has a wherefore. You are trapped, and you must escape. But is that really the goal? Centum is an unreliable narrative-driven adventure where everything may be a lie.

name: Bugaboo Pocket
short_description: A relaxing, semi-idle pet game starring bugs from land, air and sea! Play as a research scientist living in a cabin with just your bugs and a penpal for company. Spoil them with pets, minigames, food and furniture. Raise and release bugs to help Beetleback Ridge recover from a devastating fire.

name: Wordfright
short_description: A reimagining of the classic 'Hangman' game turned into a horrific thrill ride...

name: Killed by Love 99 Times
short_description: 架空世界悬疑、解密类真人影游——玩家将从房间莫名醒来，在和四位女生合租的生活中寻找唯一逃生之路，期间不仅需避开各种死亡陷阱，还要提防无处不在的黄色行刑队。最终解开真相时才发现，自己已身处百万年之后……

name: The Cursed Moon ~The Girl Trapped in the Haunted House~
short_description: After hearing a young girl's cry for help, Yukine as a kami went in to the unknowned dimension to help. While helping the ghosts on the way to fulfill their wishes, she also has to solve riddles and traps. Will Yukine be able to save the girl from this cursed dimension ...?

name: electrobillion
short_description: Shape the future of energy in electrobillion! Explore the complex systems underlying modern power infrastructure. Manage electricity production, distribution, and consumption while balancing industrial growth, environmental impact, and market forces.

name: Voxile
short_description: Explore gorgeous raytraced voxel lands, meet the local mutated wild-life, find out what went wrong, and quest, craft, loot, build, destroy and shoot your way to the top of the foodchain! Play alone, or with friends! Assuming you know how to share..

name: Dice Eater: A Supernatural Mystery Card Game
short_description: Dice Eater is a mystery card game based around supernatural powers where players must use their power to uncover the other player's tricks. Use your opponent's tricks against them to turn the tables and win.

name: Tayutama: Kiss on my Deity
short_description: Armed with spirit powers unique to his lineage, Yuri teams up with Mashiro and three other heroines to explore whether humans and Tayutai can coexist peacefully. This romantic fantasy adventure tells a heartfelt tale of growth, connection, and the mysteries of love.

name: Inn Trouble
short_description: A fantasy hotel furnishing simulator - for those who love to optimize and improve everything. Relax in cozy mode or challenge yourself by increasing the difficulty. Entertain fairytale guests, and, if you're lucky, the Queen herself.

name: Splintered
short_description: A unique RPG where the villain randomizes the world with each defeat. Start with a classic RPG experience, then delve into shifting worlds where the overworld, items, and enemies shuffle, creating new challenges. Conquer these worlds to unravel the story and make your way to the final showdown!

name: Primal Hearts 2
short_description: As new rivalries and old divisions threaten to split Ainoshima apart once again, only a new “Triple Seven” can restore peace once more! Torn between the machinations of the Liberal Arts and Sports factions, can our hero heal everyone's hearts—and steal just one?

name: Mini Cozy Room: Lo-Fi
short_description: Decorate your own cozy workspace! 『Mini Cozy Room : Lo-Fi』 combines relaxing Lo-Fi music and room decoration into one productivity game. Cute avatars and pets will keep you company, while desktop Pomodoro timers, notes, and to-do lists boost your efficiency.

name: Finnish Cottage 8
short_description: You've been trapped in a looping Finnish summer cottage. Use your observation and memory to find anomalies and make the right choice to escape the Finnish Cottage 8.

name: Mia and me – Magic Friends
short_description: Welcome to Centopia! Take your unicorn for a ride through enchanting tracks. Discover the Rainbow Island, Crystal Cave, Heart Valley, Blackwood Forest, and many more magical locations.

name: Psycho Patrol R
short_description: FPS/mecha hybrid europolice sim with emphasis on interacting with NPCs and different gameplay systems.

name: Sweet Tooth
short_description: In Sweet Tooth, become a young trick-or-treater armed with a magical sword, and defend the neighborhood from candy-stealing monsters! Fight off waves of enemies in this action-packed 3D melee horde mode with a unique polygonal art style.

name: Koira
short_description: Save a puppy and embark on a heartwarming, hand-drawn adventure together. Journey to the heart of an enchanted forest, solving puzzles and avoiding hunters to protect your newfound friend.

name: Sausage Cat
short_description: Sausage Cat is a puzzle game where you control a cat that needs to fill all the room and arrive at it's milk pot. The game has sokoban and labyrinth (you are the labyrinth) elements.

name: Astronomics
short_description: Top-down action and space exploration meet asteroid mining automation! Navigate to randomly generated asteroids passing by and start mining. Impress your employer, upgrade your equipment, fight off pirates and save up for that ticket to Earth so you can finally come home... for the very first time.

name: Static Sky: And Yet It █████
short_description: 'Static Sky: And Yet It █████' is a literary computer game based on the fear of and resistance to artificial intelligence. It imagines a future dominated by the generative AI 'Sekai', where reality and hallucination blend and become indistinguishable.

name: Zone 6
short_description: Zone 6 is a short choose-your-own-adventure game for 1-4 players. Experience the chaotic city of Zone 6 while raising your stats before venturing out into the perilous icy wasteland which has claimed the lands. Will you return?

name: Grim Tales: Light in the Darkness Collector's Edition
short_description: Help weigh the life of Richard Gray to determine his fate!

name: Leap Of Faith
short_description: Hop into the unforgiving world of Leap Of Faith, where you can play as a frog, and he is green. Use a variety of powerful jumping abilities and movement skills to traverse a treacherous landscape. Jump high, eat the bugs, and climb your way to freedom in this exciting frog game.

name: YUME 5
short_description: n the game, you will play the heroine Chen Xi, and control her actions through the WASD keys, while her past life memories act in the opposite direction.cleverly avoid various obstacles, solve the puzzles of the complex maze, and finally find the way to the exit!

name: Last Laugh
short_description: Last Laugh is a horror game that tells the story of the fate of 3 teenagers who often bully their classmates.

name: PARALLEL RIFT
short_description: Parallel Rift is a four-dimensional puzzle game where you navigate through interconnected spaces along the W-axis to reach the goal. Experience an unseen direction in this casual first-person puzzle adventure.

name: Splort
short_description: Splort is an intense party game brawler featuring unique mechanics centered around physics-based movement and force-based combat. You and your friends will enjoy mastering its challenging yet fun mechanics—like wielding physics-based weapons and battling through tons of creative levels.

name: The Isle of Cats
short_description: Rescue colorful cats to fill your boat in a new digital adaptation of the beloved board game.

name: DOOMED Detective Game
short_description: Doomed Detective Game is a game in which you will play the role of a detective who has arrived in the city of Redrock to figure out a very mysterious crime. Your task is to explore the city, find clues, talk to the residents of the city and find the killer! P.S: Every city resident is an AI...

name: Super Puzzle Blasters
short_description: With over 45 unique puzzle levels to solve in adventure mode plus local multiplayer for up to 4 people acrross 2 modes and 10 arenas there is a lot to discover in this seamingly pocket sized puzzle game!

name: King's Keeper
short_description: A game of base building and colony simulation in a world where night is permanent. Survive, build, explore, repel enemy raids and tend to the needs of your workers and your king.

name: MySims™
short_description: Explore a new world with MySims™ — it's your world to transform in this retro re-release with updated graphics! Move to an adorable town. With a little creativity and some help from the locals, you can make this place thrive!

name: Folklands
short_description: In Folklands - a relaxing settlement builder with simulated citizens - you'll find that great stories can emerge from humble beginnings. Farm or harvest materials, manage production chains and supplies, and make sure the folks in your ever growing settlement are happy, employed and safe.

name: Esteem - The little wolf saga
short_description: Esteem is a game that takes you to discover the saga of a little wolf called Laisa and her internal conflicts as she fights to save her village and her friends. How far would you go for your friends? What fears are you able to face to defend what is most important?

name: Mojika - Truth Rears Its Ugly Head
short_description: Haunted by the ability to read minds, Suteru embarks on a journey of revenge against those who wronged him. Uncovering the secrets of his tormentors, he must confront his demons in a story that explores the depths and darkness of the human mind.

name: The Void Corridors
short_description: The Void Corridors is a first-person puzzle horror game where you navigate a maze-like environment, solve intricate puzzles, and manage limited resources to survive.

name: Ligo
short_description: Explore a mysterious non-linear world filled with puzzles and secrets. Make small creatures work together to lift the curse and reconnect the world.

name: 破碎棱镜 Broken Prism
short_description: 本作为百合向视觉系恋爱游戏，围绕着黑色海洋探索世界的秘密，出场人物均为女性

name: Grimm's Folly
short_description: In Grimm’s Folly, find yourself falling through a wormhole and landing in a trash heap. The world around you, dark and unfamiliar, is not your own. Someone has trapped you here. And that someone doesn’t ever want you to leave.

name: Fiora
short_description: Fiora is a roguelike game in which you will see randomly generated maps, you need to fight shadows, and along the way collect firewood to maintain the flame of Fiora, without which you will not be able to use magic.

name: Propple
short_description: A somewhat rage-inducing physics-based puzzle game about manipulating objects with your mouse cursor. Gently nudge, quickly knock, or try to carry any objects to bring them to their target.

name: Suika Idle
short_description: Suika Idle is a unique incremental game where you easily and simply merge fruits, make juice, and run a café while dreaming of creating the world's best juice!

name: Dalafri
short_description: This title is a physics-based 3D sword fighting game. They fight against warriors with flexible bodies to become champions of the arena.

name: Enosis
short_description: In Enosis you explore a dystopian version of our planet, collect resources and have to escape or destroy all the creatures from legends and myths, uncover the truth about this world and free humanity or simply take care of yourself.

name: Cascadence
short_description: Survive and ultimately escape a foreign world using your creativity to assemble defenses with physics-based building. How many days can you hold out against an increasingly challenging threat?

name: A Very Simple Puzzle...
short_description: Discover a simple and relaxing solitaire with A Very Simple Puzzle. Match three cubes of the same color to unlock the next one. Can you reach the final cube? With its minimalist aesthetic and laid-back gameplay, this game is perfect for a short, zen break, and can be completed in around two hours.

name: Tesserarii: The Dice Rolling Roguelike
short_description: The dice rolling rogue-like. Tesserarii is an enchanting indie strategy game where you increase the power of your dice rolls and combos to deliver satisfyingly powerful blows to the enemy.

name: Error Loop
short_description: The ultimate troll game: It won't let you play, but it won't let you quit either. You're stuck forever in those endless menus full of glitches, unless you find a way to break the code open. A very unusual puzzle-game that will make you think outside the box.

name: Freddy Farmer
short_description: Freddy's daughter has been kidnapped by an evil dragon. To rescue her, he must cross the entire kingdom taking some ingredients with which to make a magic potion, but it won't be easy, they must be collected in a specific order and Freddy will have to overcome the dangers he finds in his path.

name: Twilight Monk
short_description: Embark on a quest to recover the Three Rings of the Triskelion, as the last descendant of ancient Kung Fu warriors in Twilight Monk!. Experience a richly crafted Metroidvania, RPG, with intricately crafted dungeons, linked across a vast overworld spanning multiple continents.

name: Haydee 3
short_description: Haydee III is a hardcore metroidvania with third-person shooter mechanics, platforming, puzzles, a sexy heroine and cake!

name: Rise of the Ronin
short_description: Embark on an epic journey across war-torn 19th-century Japan in this open-world action RPG from Team NINJA, the veteran studio behind 'Nioh' and 'NINJA GAIDEN.'

name: SurvAIval
short_description: SurvAIval is a 2D survival automation game where you gather resources, build a base, create AI assistants, and explore new areas to expand your domain while defending against threats and leveling up your skills.

name: Backrooms: Exploration
short_description: Backrooms: Exploration is a single-player horror game, which takes place in 2020. Two friends have lost their jobs due to COVID-19, but they still have to bring food to the table. After a failed heist, one of them ends up in the Backrooms. Now your only mission is to survive.

name: Countryballs Conquest
short_description: Lead your country through the Victorian age, expand your empire as you go head to head with the great powers of the world.

name: Surviving Skeleton Island
short_description: Surviving Skeleton Island is an open world survival crafting RPG set in a primitive 3D low poly island world of 12 unique biomes. Explore, hunt, craft, build, farm and fish to survive, while quests and clues unveil the secrets of the island, and your past. Forge your destiny and plot your escape!

name: ARIJIGOKU
short_description: A short, narrative driven, 2d pixel art, Adventure/Horror point and click game where you play as Erik. Explore your surroundings and use various items to progress. With multiple endings and accidental deaths, be sure to save often!

name: Stellar Navigator
short_description: Create a galaxy with individual solar systems and provide each with rich detail, history, and visual styles with Stellar Navigator. Set up visually stunning dioramas of your solar systems and define each celestial body, moon, asteroid, or even black hole with information that makes each unique.

name: Buffet Knight - Decadent Full Course
short_description: Gobble up everything around you in this hungry action adventure as Buffet Knight. Battle monsters, conquer puzzling dungeons, save the culinary world! The more you eat, the stronger you grow... But will you end up biting off more than you can chew?

name: The Unnamed Game
short_description: The Unnamed Game is a top-down hardcore online game where you beat monsters to survive on a cursed reality.

name: Girls Kitchen Dinner
short_description: Girls' Kitchen Diner is a chaotic and fun cooking game, where only women run the restaurant. Amid urgent orders, unpredictable situations, and unexpected romances, the characters discover that in the kitchen, chaos and love are always on the menu!

name: Cafemart Simulator
short_description: Create and decorate your cozy cafe, where guests can enjoy delicious food and drinks. Expand your service with a supermarket offering a wide selection of fresh products, so visitors can not only have a tasty meal but also do some shopping. Play solo or with friends in cooperative mode!

name: Moonbase Lambda
short_description: The base is silent—as if abandoned. The air feels heavy, and oxygen is running out. In the shadows, something stirs. You can hear it, but you can’t see it. Every step echoes in the darkness, every sound makes your pulse race. Survive. Escape. Before time runs out.

name: 翎之歌
short_description: 《Song of Feathers》 is a deeply immersive post apocalyptic survival adventure game. In this world shrouded in the shadow of the apocalypse, Players will play as the last human in this desperate land, searching for the meaning of survival and the opportunity to rebuild civilization.

name: The Phantom
short_description: The Ghost Who Walks is back! Comics' very first costumed hero is coming to Steam and console in an all new side scrolling beat-em-up adventure. Take on the Singh brotherhood across the globe with only your physical strength, skill with weapons and fearsome reputation!

name: SaGa Frontier 2 Remastered
short_description: Experience two tales woven in a world of watercolor graphics.

name: Sephiria
short_description: Sephiria is a top-down action rogue-lite game with pixel graphics. Go down the tower, meet various animals, and collect various talismans and artifacts to become stronger.

name: Mosaic of The Pharaohs
short_description: Mosaic of The Pharaohs is a picross/minesweeper hybrid featuring a single ENORMOUS puzzle inspired by Egyptology

name: MeowWare
short_description: A puzzle based clicker time attack game with nostalgic 1990's computer themes and cat culture. Click, type, and navigate through a litany of puzzles and memes to clear all the pop ups on screen!

name: Nomad Defender
short_description: You wake up in a gloomy room. Become the test subject of a shady software program that feeds on Tower Defense - Roguelike - Deckbuilder simulations.

name: Hidden Cats - St. Patrick
short_description: Dive into the enchanting world of 'Hidden Cats - St. Patrick' a hidden object game where your mission is to uncover every cat hidden within stunning hand-painted artwork. Let your keen eye and curiosity guide you through this captivating journey.

name: PolyPine
short_description: A forest simulator where you grow trees and create habitats for animals, plants and insects. Click on animals to make them poop, hunt, dig, cut and twerk! Start with a few basic seeds and attempt to grow a thriving ecosystem.

name: Prismatic: Nox's Gate
short_description: Hunt for Prismatic Gems and improve your team while getting embroiled in the complex situation of the Galactic Animal Kingdom. Prismatic is a retro turn-based tactical RPG with full voice acting, open world elements, and team battles.

name: Trucker Horror
short_description: The main character is a truck driver. Along the way, he finds a road that is not on the map and drives along it. On the road, abandoned cars and abandoned gas stations are a place shrouded in horror, secrets and mysteries. Soon the hero realizes that someone is watching him...

name: Arcade Manager
short_description: Build and manage the Arcade of your dreams. Unlock lots of fully animated games, set their jackpots and build prize zones. Start with a humble local arcade and expand into an major arcade entertainment center! Unlock Legend mods to change the rules and strategies of the game.

name: Ball Game
short_description: Control the ball in first person and try not to get motion sick! A movement system that is so relentless, unexpected and fun will put your gaming skills to the ultimate test!

name: Gem Exploration
short_description: Gem Exploration is a creative twist on the classic Tetris formula, blending timeless block-stacking gameplay with the sparkle and strategy of dazzling gemstones. Place, rotate, and strategize your moves to create stunning chain reactions and maximize your score!

name: Astroloot
short_description: Astroloot is a sci-fi bullet heaven infused with deep ARPG mechanics. Loot, level up, and customize your ship through a massive skill tree and deterministic crafting. Create a build that’s truly your own, as you uncover the secrets hidden within the Astroloot Sector.

name: Battle AirForce
short_description: Three years after Battle Marine a new battle is about to begin! Battle AirForce is the first orthodox style vertical scrolling bullet hell STG since NOKOGI Rider by SUZUKI PLAN. It was created in Z80 full assembly language, aiming at a level close to the limit of VGS-Zero.

name: Hydra Hide Land
short_description: 「Hydra Hyde Land」 is a deck-building rogue-lite game. The player must defeat a “certain demon” in order to break the curse placed on the girl who saved his life.

name: The Beekeeper's Picnic - A Sherlockian Adventure
short_description: Beekeeper (and former world’s greatest detective) Sherlock Holmes is arranging a surprise picnic for his friend Watson. Unfortunately pesky mysteries keep getting in the way! Explore, find clues and interrogate your neighbours in this cosy point and click adventure!

name: A Game About Mowing Your Lawn
short_description: A simplistic game about mowing your lawn. Harvest grass, sell clippings, upgrade your gear, and experience the beauty and detail.

name: BLITZ ARENA
short_description: FPS party game, 8 players compete in a tournament with a multitude of competitive gamemodes ! Solo, duo or team (4v4), prepare to fight in fast and tactical gamemodes. (Versus, Gungame, Battle royal, Dodegball, Runner ...)

name: Medieval Laws Elvan Rising
short_description: Try to survive for honor and glory as Elvan in the medieval world. Build cities, gather your men, construct castles, and follow the main story. While exploring the open world, focus on uncovering the mysteries and dangers that await. Survive and uncover the secrets of the past.

name: G-MODEアーカイブス22 ヘラクレスの栄光Ⅲ 神々の沈黙
short_description: A heartfelt masterpiece RPG woven by gods and humans— The series' most captivating story is revived in G-MODE Archives!

name: Lingo 2
short_description: Lingo 2 blends word puzzles and impossible geometry, with brand new puzzle mechanics and a large, colorful world to discover. Welcome back!

name: NMO - No More Operators
short_description: NMO is a thrilling multiplayer (3 to 6 players) game where one player, the impostor (Ox), lurks in the shadows to deceive and neutralize the Operators, while others take on the role of Operators, working independently or cooperatively to identify and eliminate the Ox hidden among them.

name: Drive Beyond Horizons
short_description: Rev up your engines and venture into the unknown with Drive Beyond Horizons! Conquer dynamic landscapes, customize your ride, and unearth hidden treasures. Get ready for heart-pounding challenges and endless excitement. Your adventure starts now !

name: Master Knight
short_description: Player controls Master Knight in this 3rd person rpg adventure. His mission is to kill Werewolf and collect skulls in different areas

name: Flight Catastrophe
short_description: Flight Catastrophe gives you a unique opportunity to become a crisis management specialist aboard the passenger plane. You are the only one who can handle dangerous situations occurring during the flight! Command the crew, identify the threats, make difficult choices - many lives are on the line!

name: BLEACH Rebirth of Souls
short_description: Awaken the blade within you and reverse your fate in BLEACH Rebirth of Souls! Engage in thrilling battles with powerful sword abilities and characters from this legendary anime franchise.

name: BACKSPACE
short_description: BACKSPACE is an adventure/puzzle game where you start your new job as an intern for the space vessel manufacturing company, MVEM! While getting settled in at your new job and meeting the office's odd cast of characters, you may get a sense that something strange is going on...

name: Miner Hoversurf 2 Multiplayer Madness
short_description: Have fun with your friends in this epic adventure, a 3D crazy hoversurf race to be the best in the world !!! Endless fun with procedural levels Solo or Online !!!

name: Supermarket Simulator Pro
short_description: Run your own supermarket! Buy, stock, and sell items, expand your store, and manage customers. Customize your layout, explore new locations, and hire staff. Keep things fresh with variety and new challenges as you grow your business.

name: Brassheart
short_description: Brassheart is an adventure game set in the alternative 1920s, inspired by dieselpunk and the classics of the genre. In this world, you play as Pola, a spunky pilot. She follows the clues that may provide a way to save her father kidnapped by his own invention, a rebellious supermachine, Valkiria.

name: The Storied Sword
short_description: An 8-bit action-adventure! Retrieve the fabled Storied Sword from the evil clutches of the dark sorcerer Vectre!

name: Wheel of Words: Crossword
short_description: 'Wheel of Words: Crossword' is a delightful word puzzle game designed to test your vocabulary and problem-solving skills. Connect letters to form words that fit into crossword puzzles, uncover hidden bonus words, and enjoy the rewarding feeling of completing each grid.

name: Lethal Dose
short_description: Fast Paced, Violent Top-Down Shooter. Magic Abilities. Difficult Levels. Twitchy Enemies. Level Editor.

name: Streets of Handbags
short_description: A shopping-themed rogue-lite game with cooking elements! Grandma is in the mood for shopping and goes to the local market as usual. Once again, she left her purse behind. But hey, no worries! You will find a way to get the money to buy the ingredients you need.

name: Escape Observation
short_description: You wake up in an endless loop within a mystery room, and you must pay attention to the signals given to you by the changes in each room in order to find the right way out.

name: Flat 9
short_description: A psychological horror set in a deserted apartment, where you're trapped in a relentless cycle. Armed with a strange device, you must find and report every anomaly to escape. Can you make it past Flat 9?

name: Tile Tales: Pirate
short_description: Solve tile-based puzzles while following the journey of a mischievous pirate as he plunders his way across a mysterious island in search of the ultimate treasure!
Let's do some easy math with the girls!

name: OUTLAWED
short_description: OUTLAWED is a crime-themed PvE or PvPvE first-person extraction shooter, set in a modern city overrun by gangs. Enter solo or with a squad to challenge powerful enemies and search for riches, and use everything at your disposal to make it out alive.

name: Tiny Garden
short_description: Tiny Garden lets you grow a pocket-sized garden inside a magical toy passed down through generations. Nurture plants, trade them for furniture, and customize your space in this relaxing mix of farming, puzzles, and strategy. No scores or time limits — let your creativity bloom!

name: Commandos: Origins
short_description: ALARM! You have been selected for a mission which will shape the fate of the entire world. Witness the very beginning of the legendary elite WWII force in Commandos: Origins. The long-awaited sequel to the Commandos series brings you right back to the foundation of the real-time tactics genre.

name: Sports: Renovations
short_description: Give sports facilities a second life in this relaxing story-driven simulator! Restore the glory of old gyms, courts and pitches, and add a sprinkle of your own style.

name: Rollover
short_description: Rollover is a brutally punishing climbing game where every roll could be your last. With unpredictable, difficult physics and a movement system designed to test your limits.

name: Pub Toilet Simulator 25
short_description: In Pub Toilet Simulator 25, you're trapped in Spetherwoons pub, racing to find a toilet. Navigate endless hallways, tricky stairs, and bizarre tunnels while keeping your beer meter full. Grab pub food for points, but don’t waste time! Every wrong turn brings you closer to disaster. Will you make it?

name: Bald Ball
short_description: Bald Ball is a difficult physics-based game where you control a man in a hamster ball climbing the world to reach the moon made of cheese. Will you master the power of the hamster ball?

name: Amber Alert TOTAL VR
short_description: Step into the shoes of a policeman in 'Amber Alert TOTAL VR,' a difficult VR horror game. Responding to a late-night call, you find a sinister cult of women abductors. Your mission: rescue a captive girl. Navigate perilous streets, evade cult members, and survive.

name: Suspense: Madman's Dreams
short_description: Explore the fears that shape lives and the unseen worlds that haunt them. You're not just witnessing their struggles — you're living them.

name: Emblem of Valor
short_description: Emblem of Valor is a roguelike deck-building game combined with RPG elements. Form your party, level up your characters, collect powerful cards and equipments to overcome all threats in the Shattered Realm and prove your valor!

name: Liminal Department
short_description: Trapped in what seems to be an endless hospital department. Carefully observe your surroundings in each loop to escape the Liminal Department

name: Bunny Hurling
short_description: Hunt the bunnies, load the catapult and hurl them… The King demands.

name: Fantasy Trader
short_description: Guide your trading post in a dynamic fantasy world to riches and fame. Build relationships with visiting heroes, confront their problems and needs. Defend what's yours from the monsters, thieves and tax collectors.

name: Phantomancer
short_description: Phantomancer is a deck-building roguelike where you summon phantoms to fight. Defeat the monsters threatening humanity and uncover the story of two sisters.

name: Metal Head Warfare
short_description: Metal Head Warfare is one of the best fast-paced shooting games in 4K and 120 FPS, modern and with wonderful graphics, where players collect super powers and become increasingly powerful to defeat chaos and evil in a world on the brink of the abyss.

name: Fruitgeddon
short_description: Blast through hordes of adorable yet deadly mutant fruits in this intense space shooter with bullet hell action. Shoot, dodge, and survive unique boss battles that push your skills to the limit. Only the strongest will uncover the truth behind the chaos. Are you ready to save the universe?

name: TIMEGAL HD-Remaster
short_description: Reika, the Time Gal, is warping onto Steam from 1985! Encounter dinosaurs, cavemen, giant robots, aliens, maniacally laughing villains, and more in this time-travelling, interactive-anime adventure!

name: Pinball Breeze
short_description: Experimental pinball in relaxing environments, featuring customizable play fields, new mechanics, satisfying sound effects, and a forgiving tilt feature that encourages experimentation.

name: Herogue
short_description: Why hello there, hero! Herogue is a game that combines turn-based battle mechanics with roguelike elements. Lead your team into battle, using upgrades to create custom skill styles. Test out tons of characters and upgrade paths to find a fighting style that will lead you to victory!

name: Spellbound Skirmish
short_description: Spellbound Skirmish is a fast-paced multiplayer 2D platformer where wizards clash in high-flying magical duels. Dodge, cast powerful spells, and outmaneuver your opponents in enchanted arenas. No upgrades—just pure skill-based combat. Master the elements and claim victory!

name: Be Brave, Barb
short_description: Barb the cactus has lost her positive affirmations! How will she get through the day? How will she face her fears? How will she defeat King Cloudy and his evil henchmen? I have no idea. Maybe you should play this gravity-bending platforming adventure right now and find out?

name: Nif Nif
short_description: The forest is being invaded by a mysterious evil goo! Meet Nif Nif, a cute piglet with the mission to clean and save friends in this cozy deckbuilder roguelike. Venture into a heartwarming story with accessible mechanics and themes for everyone!

name: Nubby's Number Factory
short_description: A plinko-style roguelike where you work at a number factory. Launch your spherical friend, Nubby, down a pegboard to make bigger and bigger numbers! But beware, if you fail to meet your number quota, the sun will explode.

name: Upstream
short_description: Play as a salmon journeying home in this challenging physics based platformer using only two buttons! Remember that on a voyage through innumerable obstacles and constant danger, it is your reaction to adversity that determines your success.

name: College Escape
