short_description: Use seven days to try to find supplies in the school in order to create an escape kit and get in touch with your classmates to finally escape from this school!

name: Within the Cosmos
short_description: Within the Cosmos is a sci-fi RPG. After awakening in a secluded star system, you soon discover a fractured human society grappling with an emerging android threat. Explore planets, uncover mysteries, and navigate differing philosophies. Your choices will shape how the story unfolds.

name: Waifu Cards
short_description: Welcome to the fairytale castle of sweets, where charming waifu and exciting card game Go Fish are waiting for you!

name: Crashlands 2
short_description: Slap your way across a vibrant world where interstellar friendships are the key to your survival. Befriend eccentric aliens, craft bizarre weaponry, and stick it to the man in this sequel to the award-winning open world crafting RPG Crashlands.

name: Shattered Time
short_description: Step into the chaotic world of Shattered Time, a 2.5D platformer set within the mysterious confines of a high-tech laboratory. As a lone experiment gone awry, you gain the ability to manipulate time itself, allowing you to reverse moments in the environment and use the past to reshape the present.

name: How Deep Is the Dark Water?
short_description: 'How Deep Is the Dark Water?' is a literary computer game. The player, guided by a fleeing man, slowly wanders through memories and visions constructed by the context of the war and individual experiences.

name: Beyond the Ice Palace 2
short_description: Arise from the dead as the 'Cursed King' in an enthralling action platformer. Wield the chains that once imprisoned you to vanquish foes and traverse your fallen kingdom. Uncover hidden areas, strategically level up, and reclaim your throne by banishing colossal bosses!

name: Malevolent Madness
short_description: In Malevolent Madness, explore a chilling world filled with mysteries and puzzles. As a gifted scientist, uncover the dark secret of a hidden time machine while evading sinister foes. Solve intricate challenges and unveil the truth behind your father's disappearance before reality unravels.

name: Stunt Bike Extreme
short_description: Stunt Bike Extreme is a motocross racing game. Compete around the world through adrenaline-pumping tracks.

name: There's Chaos!
short_description: An action-packed game with roguelike progression. Pilot a combat drone in intense battles, fighting for resources and territory. Collect and fuse enemy weapons to upgrade your arsenal. Survive chaotic 30-minute runs, earn permanent upgrades, and dominate the battlefield!

name: Raiders of the Apocalypse
short_description: Explore dangerous bunkers packed with mutants, scavenge vital loot, and race against dwindling oxygen. Upgrade your shelter, craft gear, and risk it all for bigger rewards. Solo or co-op, see how deep you dare go!

name: Don't Shoot First!
short_description: Face off in Don't Shoot First, a Wild West duel where timing is everything. Draw too soon, you lose. Wait too long… it’s over. Do you have the nerves to hold back and the reflexes to strike at the perfect moment?

name: Tanne: Portals of Eternity
short_description: Tanne: Portals of Eternity is an intense action survival game. Face endless waves of monsters while unlocking powerful spells and collecting magical artifacts. Fight to survive the relentless onslaught of hordes, testing your skills and reflexes in an endless battle.

name: CHAT CHAMPIONS
short_description: CHAT CHAMPIONS is an interactive pixel battle simulator built for live streaming on Twitch.

name: Wild Willy West
short_description: Wild Willy West is a western top-down shoot 'em up, featuring action packed levels and instant death combat. Use an arsenal of magical bullets to blast your way through the old west, and take revenge on those who wronged you.

name: Squirreled Away
short_description: Live your best squirrel life. Explore, gather, craft, and build incredible treehouses in acres of beautiful parkland. Scurry across lawns, up trees, and leap limb to limb solo, or up to four friends can play together in co-op. Endless summer days of adventure await.

name: Nature Picross
short_description: Nature Picross is a puzzle game where you use logic and deduction to create pictures themed around nature. Solve 100 satisfying pixel art puzzles, and continue playing with randomly generated puzzles.

name: Trump Jigsaw
short_description: Trump jigsaw is jigsaw puzzle game with Trump themed images

name: Pillar of gods
short_description: A real-time strategy simulation set in a medieval fantasy world where you can summon warriors and heroes to fight. 2D side-scrolling pixel game

name: The Jester
short_description: 'The Jester' is a first-person psychological horror game with VHS effect. Something lives in the shadows and feeds on your fear. Are you ready to dive into insanity?

name: Unforgettable: 4th Dimensional Bartending
short_description: A game about drinking and talking. After dying in a car accident, you are reborn in a bar and welcomed by the bartender. Talk to the bartender to better understand your situation while also having some drinks.

name: Pupupu
short_description: Collect mushrooms. Turn small mushrooms into big mushrooms. Be happy.

name: Floor 0
short_description: A psychological horror presented as found footage. Trapped in an endless hallway from floor 10 to 0, you must spot anomalies to survive. Move forward if it's clear—turn back if it’s not. Every choice pulls you deeper into the unknown.

name: Ale Abbey - Monastery Brewery Tycoon
short_description: Build and expand your monastery, craft recipes and brew holy ales in this unique brewery tycoon. No pre-made recipes in Ale Abbey, oh no. It's a canvas for true beer alchemists. It's as simple as: brew, sip, repeat. Welcome to Ale Abbey!

name: Game of Thrones: Kingsroad
short_description: A story-driven action-adventure RPG, bringing the world of Westeros to life with remarkable detail and never-before seen scale

name: Rising Sun - Iron Aces
short_description: The Valkirias are here. Fast paced action Shoot 'em up with beautifully rendered 3D graphics. Select between four characters with different abilities and follow their story. Upgrade and unlock fighters, battle bosses and play amazing special stages, solo or with a friend.

name: Mercenary Squad Auto Chess
short_description: This is a light Roguelike Auto chess game that combines Diablo Brush Equipment Elements . Hire mercenaries from four professions to battle the battlefield and fight monsters. By flashing equipment, refining entries, and matching relics, build a strong mercenary team to be invincible !

name: Neon Knights
short_description: Neon Knights is an action-packed, neon-drenched brawler that’s all about local & online multiplayer madness.

name: Out of the Park Baseball 26
short_description: 26 years of sports gaming excellence! Out of the Park Baseball 26 is here - officially licensed by MLB, the MLB Players Inc. and KBO! This year's brand new version puts you firmly in charge of your favorite baseball franchise. Your team, your way, your rules.

name: Beasts of Mystery
short_description: Have you ever wondered what it would be like to see Mothman fight the Flatwoods Monster? Well now you can find out in Beasts of Mystery, the cryptid fighting game with hand drawn animation and approachable gameplay inspired by the greatest of fighting games’ past and present.

name: Fish Shop Simulator
short_description: Run your own aquarium shop in a cozy New York neighborhood. Buy and sell fish, aquariums, and decorations to friendly customers. Create beautifully decorated tanks and make a profit by selling them!

name: Mayor of Woodtree Village
short_description: As the new Mayor, it is your job to make sure we becoming the most hustling, most bustling little village this side of the Continant! You start with only your shop, Mrs Bitbar and will, the will to sucecced! However, there is something not quite right with Woodtree Village.

name: hgmGame-panda
short_description: This is a casual puzzle game, where the position of each game image is random and can be repeated.At first, it may be very chaotic,Then gradually place the image in the corresponding position,The image gradually becomes complete,Come and give it a try!

name: PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark
short_description: Immerse yourself in the dark and mysterious universe of PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark, where intricate light-based puzzles await. Use physics to overcome obstacles and bring light to the heart of this enigmatic world.

name: Bot Hunter
short_description: Fast-paced roguelite shooter with modular weapons. Play as a vacuum cleaner bounty hunter. Use color theory to clean the galaxy of bot scum and collect rewards to pay your bills.

name: Nuts About Nuts
short_description: Nuts About Nuts is a single-player and co-op factory sim where you partner up, pick your tools, and let the factory floor become your playground. Use your skills, to manufacture and deliver complex parts to keep the assembly line moving and your friends in sync.

name: EXIT16: Byilhan Hotel
short_description: You're locked in a corridor full of anomalies. You must find all the anomalies in each level to escape.

name: Unnamed Arcade
short_description: The game is a creative 3rd person shooter / platformer, where players can earn rewards by completing challenges, or craft their own in game rewards by creating challenges for other players.

name: SAVE
short_description: SAVE is a coop survival horror game. The player plays as a PMC operative contracted by Miskatonic University, and embarks on a nightmarish mission to uncover the hidden secrets of the 6,000-ton vessel, “SENARA”.

name: The Gods of the Red Planet
short_description: Your team must uncover the secrets of the Terraforming Center on Mars and face an overwhelming battle for the future of the Red Planet. But remember: every choice you make will shape the outcome of this fight.

name: Forgotten Heroes
short_description: Forgotten Heroes is a roguelike turn-based RPG where you can create infinitely deep custom characters, build a team of 4 heroes, slay monsters, collect loot, and shape your own story. Choose your adventure path and dive into a world of strategy, exploration, and epic battles!

name: Lonefield Evacutation Survivor
short_description: Lonefield Evacuation Survivor is a... survivor in which you play as a ship facing an alien incursion. Destroy your enemies, collect bolts and upgrade your ship to survive long enough and escape. Play alone or with up to 3 friends in local multiplayer or with Remote Play Together for online gaming.

name: Rescue Team: Attack of the Atom
short_description: The world is on the edge of disaster, and it’s down to you to step in and save the day, again! You’ll join a team of familiar faces to lead the effort to uncover the scope of the issue and guide humanity to a safer and greener future!

name: OVERDOSE
short_description: Survive the night in a deadly asylum—deliver sinister meds, keep the insane in line, and outwit a killer hiding in the dark.

name: The Survivor
short_description: Manage your failing ship, evade lurking horrors, and navigate the galaxies to find the Lunar Star Base. With limited oxygen, dwindling power, and unknown terrors closing in, every decision is life or death. Will you make it home—or be lost forever?

name: Artisan Story
short_description: Aspiring to be the best artisan in the world, our young artisans are opening their own workshop complete with a monster ranch. Tame monsters from the dungeon, tend to your fantasy farm, collect materials and craft recipes, and experience a carefree story rich fantasy life

name: Brigands
short_description: Take command of a powerful steampunk airship in this fast-paced bullet hell shooter! Battle through 3 unique worlds, upgrade your ship with powerful weapons, and face off against epic bosses. Customize your challenge with adjustable difficulty—can you become the true Captain of the Skies?

name: Jump To Space
short_description: Aim for space from the ground. Climb up while jumping on objects. The jump distance changes depending on the degree of accumulation, so delicate control is required. Don't cry no matter how many times you fall! I am sure you can do it!

name: My Rose
short_description: 'My Rose' is a pixel-style precision platform jumping game. A boy sets out to find the soul fruit to save a girl. Will he be able to collect the soul fruit smoothly? And in the end, can he save the girl?

name: Chat Ragdoll Racing
short_description: Chat Ragdoll Racing is fully physics-based ragdoll animated simulation game where Twitch Streamers can host games for their communities and have people race against each other in a wild physics-based world.

name: Acid Web
short_description: Challenge your reflexes and defend your web from an onslaught of strange creatures to the beat of a dynamic, generative acid techno soundtrack in this all-nonsense arcade-style twin stick shooter.

name: Turd Merge
short_description: Take the browns to the super bowl in this goofy merger/combiner game that no one asked for! If you enjoy casual click and drag, scoring lots of points, poop, and flatulence, then this is a game you can't miss!

name: Antishoot
short_description: An action packed fast paced shooter where your goal is defend against ever increasing hoards of enemies. Shoot and rocket-jump to gain glory on the leaderboards and campaign while challenging to gravity.

name: EscapeGameShow: THE TIMELINE
short_description: Dive into an immersive adventure with EscapeGameShow: THE TIMELINE. You participate in a TV game show to try to win the jackpot. Explore fascinating eras by solving complex puzzles that will test your intelligence and ingenuity.

name: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? ~Fullland of Water and Light~
short_description: One fateful day, without any warning, the labyrinthine city of Orario was transformed. In the sunken Orario, Bell and his group follow the trail of the characters as dictated in the heroic tale.

name: Burial
short_description: A videographer receives the task of filming a wake in an old Soviet apartment. But he soon realizes that something terrible is lurking within these walls. And in the middle of the room there is a closed coffin...

name: Fish-Click Squad!
short_description: Fish-Click Squad! is a casual multiplayer idler where you purchase various aquatic creatures and nurture them to maturity with your friends through clicking and touching earning coins and rewards to unlock more fish and idle features! There is nothing happier than slacking with friends!

name: Zuido
short_description: You visit the tunnels to shoot a psychic video, The deeper you go, the more bizarre sounds begin to echo. What you caught on camera was an eerie human figure.

name: Go! Save The Queen!
short_description: The ants have lost their queen; help them find a new one! Armed with toys, explosives, and other items, think fast, draw lines to command your ants, and protect your queen from the hordes of enemy insects looking to put an early end to their rule in this funny but brutal escort tower defense game.

name: ComicKingdom
short_description: Comic Kingdom is a text-based adventure game primarily featuring a black-and-white comic style. It tells the story of a group of young manga artists who are trapped in a suburban farm.

name: Custom Hero
short_description: Stretch, expand and upgrade your storage organization x rogue light action ministry! Customize your hero by setting “chips” in the storage and aim to defeat the boss at the lowest level!

name: 梦镜—乌托邦Dream MirrorUtopia
short_description: 'Dreamland - Utopia' is a flat 2D Roguelike shot clear screen game, players will play different roles in the game, at the same time up to use six weapons, to fight off monsters in the dream world!

name: Justice Ninja Casey
short_description: The 16-bit classic comes to the West for the very first time! A princess in a castle has been kidnapped by a group of mysterious ninjas. Luckily for her, a young ninja named Casey is aware of the situation, and embarks on a mission to save her because... He is the Ninja of Justice!

name: Tank Hunter
short_description: Wasteland sci-fi style light meat pigeon tank shooting game

name: Nightmare Halls
short_description: Nightmare Halls is a short psychological horror game set in a mansion where you have to find your way out.

name: SUPER CAPSULE BOY
short_description: Super Capsule Boy is a thrilling platformer where you conquer obstacles, collect coins, and explore hidden areas. Perfect for fans of fast-paced action and platform games!

name: Sokowand
short_description: Sokowand is a top-down puzzle game which fuses sokoban-inspired puzzles with a magical floor that can be ripped out. Need to cross a gap? Use the floor next to you! Push boxes to open doors, manipulate signals, redirect laser by rotating mirrors and rewire entire floors full of electricity.

name: Black Light Kills
short_description: Welcome to the darkness of the town; here, you walk a fine line between reality and dreams, questioning your sanity. Black Light Kills takes you deep into Aiden’s mind, where nightmares begin as reality fades.

name: Merchant 64
short_description: Merchant 64 a tiny retro inspired traveling merchant game! Take control of Merchant as you buy goods at low prices and sell them in different towns at higher prices.

name: Puff Love Story
short_description: 轻松愉快的短篇恋爱AVG！男主角阿逅是个烘焙师傅，他刚经历事业爱情的双重打击一蹶不振。就在此时，一位爱吃泡芙的女孩出现在他的面前，这段吃泡芙、做泡芙的恋爱故事就此开始！

name: Velocity Rush
short_description: Velocity Rush is a fast-paced racing game with breathtaking speeds and a stylish visual design. Challenge yourself by competing against smart opponents, choose one of six unique cars and start your ride filled with vibrant colors and adrenaline.

name: Partisan
short_description: Our hero, a former Red Army captain, demoted during prewar repressions, finds himself on the frontline. Outnumbered and outgunned by the superior German forces, his battalion was destroyed and his few surviving friends were captured.

name: HOPSHOT
short_description: The hardest game about a gay frog with a gun.

name: My Liege
short_description: As lord of the smallest noble house sworn to your Liege, you must lead your people and family through turmoil. In this choose your own adventure RPG, can you grow your influence while keeping neighbors from taking over thy lands? Pick everything from house name, sigil, and commands for your house!

name: Furball Over the Front
short_description: Take to the skies over the western front in this WW1 casual run and gun style Sim-Shooter. Play as an Allied or German pilot in 6 different planes from 1915-1918. Balloon Busting, Ground Attack, and Dogfighting missions await you!

name: Merchants of Rosewall
short_description: As a new Merchant in the bustling city of Rosewall you'll manage your own shop, craft artisan goods, hire Companions, and even unravel a mystery of the city! Immerse yourself in a fantasy world where conflict is a thing of the past in this visual novel meets shopkeeper simulator.

name: Pudding Frog
short_description: Dive into Pudding Frog, a high-stakes, physics-based platformer where every leap and grapple could be your last. Master the art of the swing as you painstakingly ascend through a treacherous world to reclaim your precious pudding from the cunning Harry the Heron. Do you have what it takes?

name: Sweep
short_description: SWEEP is an adventure card game. Use your submachine gun and cards to escape the dungeon. 1 card = 1 bullet—play all 17 cards. Trigger chain effects, unleash damage, and take control!

name: Idle Space Shooter
short_description: Conquer your enemies in space, strengthen your ship with stats, and progress even in the background. A relaxing idle experience awaits you!

name: Just a Little Purr suit
short_description: In Just a Little Purr_suit, use cards to guide the kitten along the path. Use cannons, trampolines, and even interdimensional portals to reach the bird as quickly as possible and scare it away.

name: Haunted Service
short_description: A chilling psychological horror experience. Alone at home, you receive a cryptic message: 'Congratulations! You got a haunted service.' What starts as a prank quickly turns into a terrifying night as sinister events unfold. Will you survive until your parents return?

name: deer
short_description: This is a casual puzzle game, where the position of each game image is random and can be repeated.At first, it may be very chaotic,Then gradually place the image in the corresponding position,The image gradually becomes complete,Come and give it a try!

name: River of Time Yarn
short_description: Fixed-value RPG games, also similar to Evil spirit tower. Release different skills to restrain enemies. Observe the distribution of enemies, doors, and items on the map to find the appropriate route. The game has a rich story and four different difficulty levels.

name: 3D Escape Room: Detective Story
short_description: 3D Escape Room: Detective Story is an immersive 3D puzzle game that takes you to 1930s London. In the game, you play as an insightful private detective, searching for clues in realistic 3D environments, solving intricate puzzles and mini-games, and cracking bizarre cases.

name: Mr. Shorty
short_description: A retro top-down RPG shooter indie game where you play as Mr. Shorty: the heroic ranger in the wild west. Unlock weapons, take on bounties and discover the dormant evil behind the recent onslaught of bandit attacks.

name: Starseed
short_description: Starseed is an immersive farming sim that blends tranquility and subtle dark undertones in an atmosphere of isolation. Millions of miles from civilization, you find yourself alone on distant worlds, working without the distraction of combat. It’s a peaceful experience about saving our home world.

name: THE DARUMA CHALLENGE
short_description: A brutal bouncing challenge. No shortcuts, no mercy—just you vs. gravity. How far will you climb before it all comes crashing down?

name: Natural Selection University
short_description: Survive 100 days at Natural Selection University and write a world-changing thesis in this challenging strategy simulation game! Balance time, resources, and sanity as you navigate harsh conditions, random disasters, and absurd campus events.

name: Glow Journey
short_description: Glow Journey is a minimalist action-roguelike where you control an orb navigating a procedurally generated world. Dodge enemies and traps, collect XP, and choose powerful upgrades to survive longer and reach new levels in this fast-paced survival adventure.

name: Beyond The Limits
short_description: Beyond The Limits is an open-world crime-style game featuring vehicle theft mechanics, a weapon system, and NPC interactions. Coming soon, it will include main missions and a story mode. Experience an adventure full of action and freedom!

name: Bedtime Story : Saint
short_description: A writer obsessed with words, a voice in their mind like that of a god, and a strange story unfolding in the depths of winter. Between a cup of coffee and a cigarette, you are the deity that intervenes in the course of the story, guiding the writer to complete the narrative and its ending...

name: Motorcycle Night Ride
short_description: Imagine riding a motorcycle freely on an endless highway at night, embraced by the silence of the night. Cruising under the glow of streetlights creates an incredible atmosphere. Turn on your motorcycle's headlights and get ready to feel the joy of gliding across the asphalt!

name: Cat & Capy
short_description: Cat & Capy is a heartwarming 3D platformer where you play as the cat and capybara from the viral Matato Games video series on TikTok and Instagram. Embark on an adventurous journey to rescue dogs, explore diverse worlds, and battle the nefarious bird army!

name: Kalnazar
short_description: Kalnazar is a massively multiplayer online game. Play as adventurers and explore the new world, or become a gladiator and fight other players in arenas or battlefields.

name: The Hearts of Immortality
short_description: An homage to classic RPGs, set in a fantasy realm filled with conflict and intrigue. You will take on the role of a resurrected hero or villain, using your actions and choices to shape your fate and the destiny of the kingdom.

name: BANNED TAPES
short_description: VHS found footage horror experience. You have purchased a box of VHS tapes and now you have to select those tapes on which horrifying, violent, shocking events take place.

name: Battlefall: State of Conflict
short_description: Engage in a post-apocalyptic RTS showdown between three factions in Battlefall: State of Conflict.

name: Freeforce Airplanes
short_description: Freeforce Airplanes is a dynamic air racing game where you control airplanes, fight with opponents and strive for victory at incredible speeds. Choose from 10 unique planes, customize them with a variety of skins and conquer 8 exciting locations!

name: BLOCKADE War Stories .VR
short_description: BLOCKADE War Stories .VR takes you to various moments of the Great Patriotic War, now with full immersion in virtual reality. Take part in the defense of Moscow, fight in the ruins of Stalingrad, carry out sabotage behind enemy lines and complete the path to Victory in Berlin.

name: Makai Agito
short_description: RPG Dungeon Crawler set in the modern day. A group of adults must use the powers of supernatural beings from various folklore and mythologies to save a town from an ancient curse.

name: Zombieville USA 3D
short_description: Zombieville USA 3D is a stylized arcade shooter combining retro gameplay with strikingly polished visuals. Fight through an endless undead horde in the bleak hellscape of suburbia! Choose your weapons, grab a friend, and see how long you can survive.

name: Mystery Boxes
short_description: Mystery Boxes is a codebreaking puzzle game. Send 4-digit signals to a mysterious artifact, which will respond with another sequence. Look for patterns in the responses to identify the rules, then use this information to produce the target response.

name: Supershot
short_description: A retro game simple, complete and funny. Well projected and easy! Perfect for kids!

name: Exposed Livestream
short_description: Stream by day, prank by night, and build your fame in this RPG adventure game! As IRL streamer Laika, create content, earn subscribers, and expand your skills. Explore the city and risk it all to entertain your growing audience. Show them what they actually want to see...

name: Songs of Life
short_description: Famine and war have ravaged the land, leaving it in ruins. Step into the shoes of three legendary physicians—Hua Tuo, Zhang Zhongjing, and Dong Feng—and harness surgery, potions, and divine powers to restore order, end the chaos, and uncover the conspiracy behind the epidemic.

name: Sansagari
short_description: Tranquil, casual, minimal puzzle game with soothing audio visuals and unique gameplay.

name: Hollywood Animal
short_description: Make movies, even if someone has to die. Take the helm of a major Hollywood studio at the dawn of sound cinema, and guide it through decades of creative achievements and glamor, debauchery and dark deeds, tough choices and unpleasant compromises.

name: Liminal Lane
short_description: Welcome to Liminal Lane. A short, single player, first person, atmospheric walking simulator. A nostalgic, surreal experience exploring Liminal Spaces. Uncover the secrets of Liminal Lane and escape the Lucid Dreams and Haunting Nightmares.

name: Reincarnation in Another World
short_description: 'Reincarnation in Another World' is a roguelite game where you will have traditional barrage and different skills to fight against hordes of monsters. Choose from a variety of traits and power-ups to create a unique build and style to complete the game.

name: Hope's Farm 2
short_description: Build your dream farm in this unique blend of farming and puzzle adventure! Grow crops, raise adorable animals, and solve delightful puzzles to unlock new items and expand your farmland.

name: Another Game About Digging A Hole
short_description: A game about digging in the mines of an unknown and unclaimed planet. Collect resources, sell them and upgrade your equipment - discover all available resources!

name: Make Capybara Happy
short_description: Jump platform to platform with cute capybara.ㅤㅤㅤ This game much and much harder than it looks.

name: CLASS 3, THIRD GRADE
short_description: Through a strange coincidence, the protagonist 'I' stumbles into the childhood bedroom they once inhabited. It is a world where hazy memories of childhood vividly regain their original form. Will 'I' be able to return to the real world from this labyrinth of memories?

name: Easy as Pi
short_description: Easy as Pi is a challenging speed-running game where you only have 3.14 seconds to beat each level! Traverse through different areas and collect P.I.E.S. all while zooming around at the speed of Pi!

name: Cursed Dawn
short_description: Cursed Dawn is a wave survival FPS featuring complex maps packed with secrets, dynamic spawns, and hordes of zombies to turn into gory mulch. Plan your defense, stay on the move, and master the maps. Remember: Nowhere is safe, death is assured, how long until you're zombie chow?

name: 烟花自动机 - Firework Automata
short_description: 硬核可爱回合策略！操作具有各种奇妙能力的主角们，在青都烟火大会的前夕展开冒险，调查世界，与强敌战斗，聆听她们的故事，最终解封她们各自的心结。

name: Otaku Miracles
short_description: A story about you, an anti-social Otaku who is a student at Ashikaga Academy, a very traditional private high school in Japan. Suddenly, you awaken in a place called the Spirit Realm and are tasked with saving the world! How? Well, with the help of your friends of course!

name: 少女的求生之路：研究所
short_description: 2D pixels+beautiful girl+high-definition CG+super rich plot+numerous endings! Put aside the boring and peaceful daily routine, and enjoy the life of sticking with beautiful girls to the fullest in a different world~

name: War of the Wormholes: Janitor Duty
short_description: Welcome to the wild world of War of the Wormholes! Take the role of a janitor at an Astronaut in the Box who gets recruited onto the NASS Inconceivable, a formidable and feared Privateer vessel manned by humans and aliens alike in this exciting and comedic point and click adventure game!

name: Really Simple Golf
short_description: Really Simple Golf is a climbing platformer golf, that blends chill vibes with precision driven adventure. Embark on an adventure across vibrant courses, mastering tricky shoots, navigating obstacles, and sinking those perfect putts.

name: Watermelon (with a Broken Head) Game
short_description: Watermelon (with a broken head) Game is a thrilling, physics-based puzzle game inspired by polyomino puzzles and the Suika Game. Shake, mix, and merge blocks of various shapes to find the lost emotions one by one!

name: Tomb of the Golden Relic
short_description: The game set in an ancient labyrinth with a mummy. Players take on the role of an adventurer searching for a lost golden artifact, but uncovering it triggers the mummy’s pursuit. Along the way, they must decide whether to escape with the real artifact, a fake, or leave empty-handed.

name: Place Icebergs Apart
short_description: A peaceful puzzle game about placing icebergs apart so they don't touch each other. Meet adorable polar animals and protect them from orcas!

name: Odinfall
short_description: Ragnarok was just the beginning… of the end! Odinfall is a Viking-themed, rogue-lite, twin-stick shooter. Blast your way through procedurally generated levels, upgrade your character, modify your weapons and take down robotic Norse gods to earn your freedom!

name: Airlock Arena: Profit or Perish
short_description: Strap in, space slugs! Join forces with up to three buddies in this chaotic multiplayer roguelike. Dodge treacherous asteroid fields, outsmart the authorities, and secure precious cargo. Survival is optional, profit is mandatory. Are you ready to risk it all for the ultimate haul?

name: 神树残响（Echoes of the Divine Tree）
short_description: 'Fight with faith!' This is a traditional-style yuri-themed card RPG. Build your deck, unearth relics, forge equipment, strive to become stronger, defeat various oddities, and change the fate of the divine tree's offspring, Hecate.

name: Lets Get Loot!
short_description: Dive into a fantasy idle/incremental game where hack-and-slash combat meets endless progression! Defeat enemies, collect epic loot, and level up to unlock new powers. Craft artifacts, conquer powerful bosses, and grow stronger! Forge your path to greatness in a world of endless adventure!

name: Tale of the Leading star
short_description: Another World's uncle take over numerous Beauty Yo~

name: Shadow of The Forgotten
short_description: In a long-abandoned mansion of Dr. Victor Grimm, players find themselves trapped after a sudden collapse of the mansion's entrance. As they explore the sprawling, decaying building, they uncover secrets, and disturbing relics of Dr. Grimm's experiments.

name: Platzle
short_description: Platzle - is a puzzle platformer in which you not only have to act fast, but also think carefully.

name: A Dream About Parking Lots
short_description: Look for your car in a series of mazes and parking lots while you talk to your therapist about feeling lost. An interactive short story about trying to make sense out of the unreal. Based on real dreams!

name: Catcelona: Indies' Special 2025
short_description: A nice, cozy and entertaining video game that mixes Barcelona's architecture and hidden cats from other video games. All randomized, play endless games! Let's celebrate Indie games!

name: Bathroom
short_description: You're being trapped in your bathroom, be quiet and save yourself.

name: Marble Mash
short_description: A quick arcade style clicker game. Try to get as many points as you can! Click the blue and gold marbles to get points. The red marbles subtract points!

name: Idle Commonwealth
short_description: Idle Commonwealth is an idle game that pays homage to the best of the idle genre. Start small, grow your commonwealth, maintain morale, establish governance, invent technologies, trade and conquer your neighbors.

name: Fowl Legacy
short_description: What the cluck?! Ricardo was sent to Hell! It's time for revenge. Explore different landscapes, jump, run and dash past deadly obstacles, search every corner... and defeat the ultimate evil keeping you from returning to your world!

name: The Maid
short_description: The Maid is a first-person psychological horror and mystery game that focuses on creating fear and tension in the player.

name: Gedonia 2
short_description: Gedonia 2 is an online coop RPG, which allows up to 4 players to freely explore living open world and build absolutely unique characters. An expanded and improved sequel for RPG Gedonia.

name: Beer Runner
short_description: Run, jump, and deliver the last keg of beer to your boss. A stylized cyberpunk city presents many various obstacles and opportunities to be the best on the world leaderboard. The best time and every collected beer can count.

name: Lord Of Island
short_description: Defend your islands with real-time strategy and tactics! Lead as a Lord, build armies from diverse races, and defeat invading enemies. In a minimalist world, utilize each island’s unique design to rewrite the fate of your people and the destiny of your lands.

name: Distant Lands: Earendel
short_description: Distant Lands: Earendel is 3D clicker about knowledge, memory and reality

name: My Pet Femboy
short_description: My Pet Femboy is a simple pet simulator UwU

name: Niktophobia
short_description: NIKTOPHOBIA - sci-fi horror for 1-4 players. The team arrives at the space station to extract alien bio-samples. Players will use various tools and manipulate the station's energy to get out of trouble together.

name: Mind Keeper
short_description: Mind Keeper is a tower defense roguelite game where you construct your own stronghold, a representation of your mental integrity, and defend it from relentless waves of inner demons determined to destroy you.

name: Super Slime Boy
short_description: Super Slime Boy is a fast-paced precision platformer set in a black-and-white world filled with deadly traps. Jump, dodge saws and spikes, and race against time to complete levels while restoring color to the world!

name: Hidden Cat Outlaws
short_description: Become the sheriff and catch all the wanted cats! Explore 15 levels. Find over 600 cats. Find 45 secrets. Fight 15 bosses. Have fun and relax. MEOW!

name: KAMITSUBAKI CITY REGENERATE
short_description: Answer the summons to the parallel world of 'Kamitsubaki City' and meet a cast of colorful characters as you set out on a quest to save this city from the brink of destruction in this dark-fantasy sci-fi visual novel!

name: Schedule I
short_description: From small-time dope pusher to kingpin - manufacture and distribute a range of drugs throughout the grungy city of Hyland Point. Expand your empire with properties, businesses, employees and more.

name: Pluto Lost Its Colors
short_description: Join Pluto in its quest to reclaim its colors in this chaotic yet rewarding experience! Pluto Lost Its Colors is a fast paced platformer with physics based controls. Master the unpredictable physics of Pluto as you roll, jump, and dash through challenges. This game is your next addiction.

name: Cat Paws And Dungeon
short_description: All your milk has been stolen; it's time to embark on an adventure to catch the thief. Push, shoot, think. In this incredible game with beautiful pixel art, you'll test your intelligence and problem-solving skills as you navigate through the 51 floors of this cavern.

name: Leila
short_description: Leila is a heartfelt, hand-animated narrative game about the small yet significant struggles we all face. Solve story-driven puzzles, relive fragile memories, and discover a deeply personal journey that may feel more familiar than you expect.

name: Dr. Plague
short_description: In a world ravaged by plague, a lone plague doctor embarks on a journey to stop both the disease and a sinister order of knights controlling it. Dr. Plague is a stealth-adventure game that combines puzzle-solving, platforming, and ambient soundtracks.

name: ProtoDungeon: Episode I
short_description: Use the moonlight spell to trade places with objects and escape from the mysterious nightmare in this short puzzle adventure!

name: Big Jays Rattastic Adventure
short_description: Big Jays Rattastic Adventure is a 3D mascot platformer game with tons of collectibles. Every level can be finished without collecting anything, but the more stuff you grab, the better grade you get at the end of each level. Unlock more levels and stuff by getting higher grades on previous levels.

name: Enchanted Stories: Mystic Woods Collector's Edition
short_description: The forest has eyes, and they’re on you! Embark on a quest to preserve an ancient woodland brimming with magical creatures and hidden objects!

name: 我的人生
short_description: This is a wild and unpredictable life simulator, filled with laughter, banter, and endless possibilities. A strategy game that blends deck-building roguelike mechanics with Luck Be a Landlord-style gameplay. Shape your own life story from 100+ unique events and a deck of 250+ cards!

name: Revive
short_description: A mysterious plague known as the Sleeping Sickness has taken your beloved. But it is too soon for despair. There is still a chance to bring them back. Gather the tears of the Hero’s bloodline and reclaim your love.

name: Risk & Riches
short_description: This roguelite deckbuilder is set in the American West. Battle monsters, cultists, and folkloric creatures while searching for gold and the source of the evil within a mine. You choose when to leave, not where to go. Will you play it safe returning to the surface, or risk it all by going deeper?

name: ODDRooM
short_description: Hyper Action Shooting Rogue-lite ODD FPS !!! Open the Red Door and the ODD Room Opens! The fight to wake up from the Lucid dream! Hunt ODD monsters and collect Cat Coins! Begin your journey to wake up from the nightmare!!!

name: Deepest Dungeons
short_description: Venture into the ever-shifting labyrinth of Deepest Dungeons, a rogue-like with extraction elements. Explore a maze that changes with each attempt, battle enemies, avoid deadly traps and collect gear. Survive long enough to reach deeper levels, or escape with your belongings and try a new descend.

name: TETRIS® THE GRAND MASTER 4 -ABSOLUTE EYE-
short_description: The latest title in the 'TGM' series, 'TETRIS® THE GRAND MASTER 4 -ABSOLUTE EYE-' offers the ultimate Tetris game that no one has ever experienced before. Challenge yourself in new modes such as ASUKA and SHIRANUI.

name: Orb Tower
short_description: A Roguelike Bubble Puzzler! Choose your school of magic and reach the top of the tower! Chill pick up and play feel and nostalgic pixel art and music. Get your staff and prepare to shoot orbastical spells !

name: Find Clowns
short_description: The game is about finding 20 clowns who have wandered into a castle! There are a total of 100 characters in this game! Experience not only the search for clowns, but also what kind of characters live in the game world.

name: inZOI
short_description: 'Every life becomes a story' Create your unique story by controlling and observing the lives of 'Zois'. Customize characters and build houses using inZOI's easy-to-use tools to live the life of your dreams and experience the different emotions of life created by its deep and detailed simulation.

name: The Art Of Flight
short_description: Play solo or with your friends in this fast-paced space shooter. Pilot multiple ships at the same time while taking on waves of enemies, finding power-ups, and gaining additional episodes along the way. Who will make it to the top of the leaderboard?

name: Dry Sand Damp Steps
short_description: A short story about a water spirit wandering the wastes of a dry world. As you travel, you'll interact with the inhabitants, accumulate and manage your water, collect trinkets, avoid danger and push forwards into the uncertain future.

name: Party Club
short_description: Seat customers, serve drinks, and manage chaos with up to 4 players! Keep the peace by considering customer types while seating them. Survive disasters, handle quirky customers, and design the perfect venue to keep the party going!

name: Jump Potato
short_description: Help Potato find its way home by embarking on a long journey, overcoming obstacles, and learning more about the world through the characters you meet along the way.

name: MAGICAL BEAT
short_description: Drop colored blocks in a match-3 style to the background music’s rhythm with perfect timing to send blocks to your opponent’s screen!

name: Feudal Bros - Tonosama #1
short_description: Japan. Edo period. After many years of violent wars, peace has returned to the land, but it doesn’t seem like it will last for long. A new danger lurks in the shadows, and only two noblemen can stop it: Lord Baka, a Japanese feudal lord, and Prince Bouffon, a prince from the faraway land of France.

name: Cursor Survival
short_description: Prepare for a radical shift in Bullet Hell gameplay! In Cursor Survival, you're not piloting a character - you embody the... CURSOR! Unleash a new, utterly insane way to evade, strike, and endure in a chaotic universe of projectiles and adversaries.

name: Dark Deity 2
short_description: Verroa is a peaceful continent on the brink of war as the Asverellian Empire seeks to expand - at your homeland’s expense. Command unlikely heroes, fight challenging turn-based battles, and watch hardship forge iron into steel. Dark Deity is back, bigger and better than before!

name: My Life: Zoo Vet
short_description: Take care of sick zoo animals! Many exciting tasks await you in the zoo, and some of the cute residents need your help. From clumsy young animals to curious penguins and powerful elephants - they all need nursing back to health!

name: Kreuzwort++
short_description: Kreuzwort++ is a crossword puzzle app with over 5000 exciting puzzle grids for endless puzzle fun. Find the right words, solve tricky questions and improve your word knowledge. How many puzzles can you solve?

name: Kingdom of Cards
short_description: From cropland to forest, from academy to conqueror's guild, expand territory of your kingdom. As the kingdom grows, crises will quietly arise. No worries: prepare to use the resource cards to train a group of powerful guardians to eliminate enemies and protect your kingdom.

name: Grand Throw Auto
short_description: Launch a vehicle and make it have maximum impact! Grand Throw Auto is a fast paced action packed game with rogue like elements. Fight a battle for the cup victory. With many difficulty settings that you earn as you pass the previous tests, as well as various types of foes and weapons to collect.

name: Fur and Fables
short_description: Dive into Fur and Fables, a party-based bullet hell roguelike! Assemble a team of adventurers, level up, and recruit new heroes along the way. Experiment with party composition and synergies to fit your play style and save Fabletown from the endless hordes of monsters!

name: Alchemist Shop Simulator
short_description: Run your own magic business! In Alchemist Shop Simulator you can trade magical wares, brew potions and take on special orders, meet many quirky clients, grow your ingredients in your garden, restock your shelves and manage prices. Keep expanding your business as you gain experience and wealth!

name: Magicbook AutoBattler: Contract
short_description: This is a brand - new strategic auto - chess game that integrates RPG and roguelike elements. In the world of the Grimoire, players can freely create combinations and indulge in endless battles.

name: Carnegie
short_description: In Carnegie, players will recruit employees and expand their businesses by investing in real estate, producing goods, developing transport technology, and creating transport chains across the United States.

name: Used Cars Simulator
short_description: Used Cars Simulator - trade used or stolen cars, fix and customize them, drive around, and explore the open world! Grow your business, complete quests, and have fun with a physics-based sandbox!

name: Sea Balloon
short_description: Explore a variety of islands with a red balloon! An ode to the art of taking it slow.

name: RoboSamurai
short_description: RoboSamurai is a 3rd-person fast-paced sword-fighting action/slasher game about Nix: a robot mechanic turned katana-wielding fighter. Set in a cyberpunk dystopian city filled with corruption and tyrannical corporations waiting for him to let his guard down.

name: Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days
short_description: Texas, 1980. Walton City has fallen to a zombie outbreak. Lead a band of desperate survivors from refuge to refuge by scavenging, crafting, and fighting in a relentless struggle for survival. Plan wisely, stick together, and — above all — keep moving if you want to make it out alive.

name: Dipets
short_description: Most of the Dipets lost their memories and left the city for no known reason. Help Cakin rebuild Pixel City while you explore this strange world and discover what made them leave the city. Will you be able to discover the secrets of this new world?

name: Range
short_description: Range is a game that helps you stay on-task and focused when you want to be. Set a timer for your focus session, the tasks you want to complete, and enjoy a relaxing, distraction-free drive through a hand-drawn world.

name: Foul Bliss
short_description: Immerse yourself in the retro atmosphere of an 80s movie, accompanied by a vintage soundtrack woven into the gameplay and plot. Explore the intricate story of a fading mind. Survive in a surreal world located between creativity and reality.

name: Monster Energy Supercross 25 - The Official Video Game
short_description: Get ready for a new beginning with the upcoming 2025 season, official riders and tracks, a renewed gameplay thanks to Unreal Engine 5, and much more!

name: The Abandoned Crossroads
short_description: The Abandoned Crossroads is a first-person horror/puzzle game with very high difficulty. In this game, you must uncover many secrets and solve puzzles while under constant pressure from being chased by various monsters. This game is perfect for those who are looking for a fun and spooky challenge.

name: Full Effect
short_description: FULL EFFECT is a wicked piece of software that ended up being a side scroller with FPS mechanics. Complete your mission and run'n'gun every enemy who opposes you. This challenge will not tolerate a skill issue: They Fear You Less Than You Fear Them

name: Haste
short_description: Run fast, soar through the air, and master your landings as you speed through procedural worlds to outrun the end of the universe!

name: The Monetary Lever
short_description: In The Monetary Lever, you're the Bank of England Governor. Control interest rates and QE to guide the UK economy. Balance growth with inflation and navigate unexpected challenges. Test your economic skills in this engaging simulator. Can you steer the economy towards prosperity?'

name: The Last of Us™ Part II Remastered
short_description: Experience the winner of over 300 Game of the Year awards, now on PC. Discover Ellie and Abby’s story with graphical enhancements, gameplay modes like the roguelike survival experience No Return, and more.

name: Castle of Blackwater
short_description: Castle of Blackwater is a 2D, action-packed, social deduction game with a magical twist. In this intense game of trust and betrayal, up to 10 strangers are trapped in a castle of danger and deception, with a mission to complete tasks and escape with their lives.

name: Armored Brigade II
short_description: Armored Brigade II revolutionizes real-time tactical warfare in 3D, focusing on the intense combined arms combat of the Cold War era, from 1965 to 1991. Boasting a meticulously researched database and huge real-world terrain maps, this game offers an unparalleled combat simulation experience.

name: Cirno's Card Class
short_description: Victory or defeat depends on the placement of your cards, timing of usage, and combinations. Create your own tactics and unleash unpredictable plays!

name: Mordar Warrior
short_description: third person action rpg game where player mission is to kill enemy waves and survive enough long.

name: The Colony 2044
short_description: Balance survival with strategic combat in this unique simulation. Lead a bunny colony through a post-apocalyptic world infested with zombie bunnies. Manage resources, construct a thriving settlement, and navigate intricate social dynamics to uncover the cure held by one of your survivors.

name: Arthur's Camping Adventure
short_description: Arthur and Mr. Ratburn's class are taking a field trip to Mount Rockslide to explore the wilderness. It should have been all fine and dandy, but Mr. Ratburn ends up twisting his ankle on arrival at the campsite. It's now up to Arthur and his friend Buster to get some help!

name: Inspector Schmidt - The Ebbing
short_description: In this detective RPG, you untangle a thick web of intrigues, lies, and secrets that surround a mysterious death. Find the origin of eerie telegraph signals, question the villagers, decipher the strange symbols that are suddenly appearing all over town - and hide from the danger lurking in the moor.

name: Cargo Shop Simulator
short_description: Discover the excitement of commerce with Cargo Shop Simulator! Manage your own cargo shop and grow by meeting customer demands. In the evening, load your shipments onto vehicles and plan deliveries to build a successful business empire. Are you ready?

name: The Room in a Glass Box
short_description: Escape a captivating diorama! Rotate, zoom, and solve puzzles to find the key. Explore a miniature world and unlock its secrets!

name: DEMONS
short_description: DEMONS is a card game for 1-4 players. When an evil cult unleashes an ancient demon, all that can stop the coming apocalypse is you, your friends and a deck of cards.

name: All in Abyss: Judge the Fake
short_description: Either I die, or the Witches perish. I challenge thee to a deathmatch!” Asuha, a self-proclaimed gambling prodigy, challenges the Witch ruling the gambling district. Poised to win, she is defeated by a mysterious power. An adventure of gambling, exposing frauds and earning fortunes through poker.

name: Fisher Idle
short_description: Start from scratch in the middle of the ocean as a fisherman! Buy bigger boats, upgrade your ships, and build your fishing empire. Remember: more fish means more gold!

name: NINJA HAYATE HD-Remaster
short_description: Ninja Hayate infiltrates Steam, braving the evil ninja clan's lair and battling a dragon in this thrilling, interactive anime adventure, remastered from its 1984 debut!

name: Comet Rogue
short_description: Fast-paced roguelike where you mine and explore procedurally-generated asteroids. Collect unique stackable upgrades to aid you in your quest for riches! (and freedom...)

name: Red Cap Squad: Zombie Source
short_description: Red Cap Squad: Zombie Source is a hardcore survival roguelike auto-shooter game. Assemble a unique team, strategically utilize traps and mechanisms, and endure the endless waves of zombies to emerge victorious!

name: Space Sprouts
short_description: Launch into a chaotic spaceship adventure: bend the rules of physics, experiment with unusual gadgets and toss everything around. With each journey, you will have limited time to reveal the mysteries aboard your solar punk spaceship - how much will you discover before you arrive home?

name: Critical Point
short_description: Critical Point is a retro sci-fi casual strategy game. You have to make the particle count in reactor cells exceed 4, surpassing the critical point of fission to generate energy required for interstellar voyages.

name: My Virtual Friend
short_description: Feeling lonely? Not anymore with My Virtual Friend, a desktop pet/idler where different characters can keep you company. Take care of them, buy them new outfits, play games with them, or just let them sit back and follow along with whatever you're doing.

name: Hollow Survivors
short_description: Battle through hordes of horrific creatures as you hack and slash your way to the top of the Tower in this rogue-like dungeon crawler game. Choose from a variety of upgrades and weapons, and save the Tower.

name: Hyper Empire
short_description: Play a 4x game in 40 minutes... or less! We streamlined 4x strategy down to a game that captures the fun in a manageable play time. Lead your faction against escalating enemies and expand the reach of your empire. Multiple paths to victory allows for a variety of strategies. Build your empire.

name: Check & Clean
short_description: Check&Clean is a tactical First Person Shooter blending music, speedrun elements and intense action. It immerses you in a rhythmic universe, alternating analysis sequences and gunfights. The innovative music coordination allows players to synchronize explosive moments with beats.

name: Y.M.C.A.背包射手的日常
short_description: Aliens are invading! Load up your guns and eliminate them with the help of ancient indigenous equipment in your backpack!

name: Frenzy Islands
short_description: The cruise ship has sunk — just the perfect vacation, right?

name: Boeckham's Football Manager
short_description: An old-school football manager in the style of the management games of the 90s. Lead your team through the seasons, shaped by dynamic story events. Develop your club and yourself to gain reputation and conquer your league and the world.

name: Dream Cleaners
short_description: A metaphorical interactive story game which presents real mental health conditions through conversations and puzzles.

name: Frog Bard
short_description: Frog Bard is a short, poetic experience about finding inspiration in the world around you. Explore a simple forest and perform reflective ballads as you travel from inn to inn.

name: Ekoh Beach
short_description: Ekoh Beach has been destroyed by a nasty Robot Rebellion and is in urgent need of a new Town Planner! Your job? Get the town thriving again with your particle-harvesting skills and restore it back to its heyday. Collect resources, make friends, and solve the mystery of quantum scientist Dr Terra!

name: MOOD
short_description: Just a casual walk through an ordinary city. Nothing more.

name: SILENT BIBUS
short_description: You find yourself in a mysterious village shrouded in thick fog. There is a dark and tense atmosphere here, reminiscent of cult games like Resident Evil and Silent Hill. You have to explore ominous locations, solve riddles and look for important clues that will help you get out of here.

name: Grab it! Crane Game
short_description: Gear up for an arcade classic: the crane game! Win as many prizes as you can and become a crane game master!

name: Wanted: Dead Or Alive
short_description: Dive into the Wild West in Wanted: Dead or Alive! Spot the outlaw in a crowd before time runs out. Fast-paced, addictive, and challenging—can you capture every bandit before they disappear?

name: Grabbus
short_description: Grab, Throw, Build, Explore, Upgrade, Fuse, Shoot, and Loot in this surreal, high-energy adventure where breaking the limits and reaching further is encouraged!

name: RogueRampage
short_description: roguelike FPS! Use time-stop, barriers, and other powerful skills to defeat enemies. Eliminating foes or landing headshots grants XP to level up and gain items. Enemies grow stronger, testing your skills. Choose skills and gear to craft your build and survive. Adapt, strategize, and conquer!

name: 永夜镇EternalNightTown
short_description: Eternal Night Town is a horror game. Protagonist Xu Fan unexpectedly got a lawyer's letter about his great - aunt's inheritance. Curious, he went to her hometown. In the village, the people seemed oddly strange. Then, he entered a journey he couldn't escape.

name: My Waifu Becomes Real
short_description: Your waifu, Laras, is no longer virtual. She’s real, living with you, and bringing your dream to life. How will you handle the unexpected?

name: Three Skies Ascension
short_description: Three Skies is a turn-based, strategic RPG with challenging dungeons and hundreds of heroes and creatures to collect and customize. Explore over 100 hours of story-driven content delivered over the course of 12 chapters and more than 30 unique zones. Play now!

name: MiniGolf Showdown
short_description: Dive into the ultimate mini-golf competition where precision meets creativity, featuring challenging courses, dynamic mechanics, multiplayer action, and unlockable customizations across a variety of vibrant, themed worlds.

name: satori
short_description: This game is a multi-ending horror game set in Japan. The story branches based on the player's choices, leading to different endings.

name: The Dream
short_description: A dystopian, open-world shooter set in a simulated Barcelona of 2033. Survive, explore, and uncover the secrets of the metropolis while earning data tokens. Engage in intense battles or form alliances to survive.

name: Einstein's Cats
short_description: A cozy, relaxing puzzle game all about cats. Solve brain-twisting logic clues to sort picky cats into their favorite boxes. Unlock stickers as you play to use in your Sticker-book to create your own cute cuddly cat scenes!

name: Stan's Magic Museum: Olympian Trouble
short_description: A great new Match-3 game from 'eFunsoft Games'! Help a lighthearted, comedic story of a modern-day museum guard dealing with the gods and goddesses of Greek mythology. Fun match-3 puzzles let you test your skills and use a variety of tools and collect bonusses to clear each challenge.

name: VIDeoPHOBIA
short_description: You are in a room without windows or doors. The TV dimly illuminates the room. What is this, a box? How to open it? After solving the riddle, you find the TV remote control. Click... a door appeared. You step into the darkness and hear laughter... turn around and find out what's behind the screen.

name: Deadly rails
short_description: FIGHT YOUR WAY TROUGH THE HOARD OF UNDEAD AND REACH YOUR GOAL , THE ONLY LIMIT IS YOUR WITZ AND DETERMINATION.

name: Locomoto
short_description: Locomoto is a cosy, life-sim adventure game set on a train, where you are the conductor! Customise and manage your train, while tending to your colourful passengers. Get onboard and embark on a journey through beautiful landscapes, accompanied by a soft, lofi original soundtrack.

name: Bring the Book back
short_description: You wake up on the floor of a library, guilt-ridden for forgetting to return your borrowed book. Now, you find yourself trapped in an endless loop of bringing it back to ease your conscience, forced to check for anomalies to work off your debt.

name: Monaco 2
short_description: Get your crew back together for the ultimate heist experience! Return to Monaco, plan your operation, and skedaddle when things inevitably go awry in this co-op heist game. The city is yours for the taking!

name: EASOAR
short_description: The Easoar Corporation has made a horrible discovery, spreading the unending potential of Innaturum weaponry. Radicalize as a wildslinger in this fast-paced, action platformer, RPG. Lay waste as you mix and match all manners of weaponry, becoming a true force of Innature!

name: Gnomes
short_description: A turn-based tower defense with deep roguelike progression, set in ever-expanding, procedurally generated biomes. Build, farm and defend your village as you push deeper into goblin-infested territory. Unlock powerful upgrades and craft your environment to survive the endless goblin horde.

name: My Hidden Dreams
short_description: Immerse yourself in a world of cute and eerie dreams! Find, deconstruct, and assemble the thoughts and desires of the characters. Go through all the stages of personal development by helping the sleepers find answers.

name: OrbHand
short_description: Stack your cards to cast spells, get resources and recruit allies in OrbHand, a beautiful hand drawn card management game.

name: Desktop GOLF
short_description: Play on colorful courses made of stationery! Enjoy a refreshing game of golf right on your desk!

name: Path of the Ory
short_description: An 8-bit adventure of fate, survival, and the rise of legends. Before the rise of the Belt, before the Maid of Venia, there was Kayla—a lone survivor of a brutal bandit raid, rescued by a mysterious warrior of the Ory. Now, Kayla must carve her own path.

name: Trump Simulator 2025
short_description: 'Trump Simulator 2025' is a silly little game. Run the country while flying in Air Force One, thousands of feet in the air. Immerse yourself into the role of the President Elect!

name: Henshin MyBro!
short_description: Henshin MyBro is a rogue-lite game full of nonstop fun! Play solo or with a buddy, scavenge ingredients from monsters and bosses, experiment with weapons, cook dishes for boosts, and HENSHIN to special heroes. Cook, fight, and HENSHIN your way to victory!

name: Dino & Chill
short_description: Hatch and collect adorable dinosaurs that roam your screen while you work or play! Watch them gather gems, unlock perks, and customize your setup. Move and resize them freely, even across multiple monitors. But be careful—these dinos can get messy, so don’t forget to clean up after them!

name: Robot Fury: Mech Combat Simulator
short_description: Robot Fury is a mech combat simulator where you can feel like a true robot warrior. Fight enemies with a powerful flamethrower, soar into battle with your jetpack, and finish off foes with precise machine gun headshots. Customize your mech and engage in exhilarating, epic battles!

name: Lumiel the Awakening
short_description: Lumiel the Awakening is an Open World Top Down Hack and Slash RPG Game set in a Fantasy Sci-fi Setting. Stranded on an island, players focus on exploration, building, and harvesting while battling monsters, collecting rare items, and uncovering hidden treasures in diverse dungeons.

name: Metal Bringer
short_description: In this roguelike action-adventure, control humanoid 'Labor' and giant 'Arms' to uncover the mysteries of the world. Create fully-customizable robots, strengthen them, and take down hordes of enemies!

name: Hollowglass
short_description: Try to survive in the desert for at least a few more moments and let neither thirst, nor jackals, nor death stop you...

name: Grimoire Groves
short_description: Join the witches in their quest to restore the Grimoire Groves! Master magic, grow cute plant creatures and discover the mystery of the Rainbow Socks in this cozy, rogue-lite dungeon crawler.

name: ANEURISM IV
short_description: A dystopian simulator where your choices shape a decaying city. Join other players to protect the metropolis from ruin, hasten its downfall, or simply work in the factories. With no set goals or rules, every action has consequences in a world teetering on the brink.

name: AIPet
short_description: You can have a conversation with her, and you can reply with voice or text. You can change the size of the character, move the position of the character, etc.

name: Breakout Beyond
short_description: Breakout is back! In this neon-drenched take on the classic, you’ll need to literally break through each puzzle by clearing bricks to breach the final goal. Rack up a combo and create spectacular light shows alone or with a friend.

name: Blood Typers
short_description: TYPE TO KILL in this survival horror adventure. Alone or with friends, explore a sprawling cursed film studio as its horror movies bleed into reality. Choose from a roster of characters then plan your escape from this bloody homage to old school horror. But remember... death is just a typo away.

name: Counter Clash
short_description: A light-hearted, action-packed strategy game. Choose your faction and hero, build and defend your base, train and upgrade troops, level up your hero, and find the right strategy to defeat your opponent!

name: Horror Tale 3: The Witch
short_description: Fight the scary witch in the most terrifying chapter of Tom's adventures!

name: Germ Blasters
short_description: A hyper casual puzzle game! Select the right meds to remove the viruses or prevent the meds from hurting the antibodies. Contains Puzzle mode, Arcade mode, and Offline VS

name: Babushka's Glitch Dungeon Crystal 老奶的故障地牢大冒险
short_description: Hi so much! You are a little old lady who needs to clean up a big magical cellar. Learn colorful mind-bending spells, or just hit stuff with your broom.

name: Gun Factory Simulator
short_description: Take control of your very own firearms factory. Start with a workshop and a gun shop, and evolve it into a factory of mass destruction. Craft bullets to rockets, handguns to shotguns, hire workers & managers, and become a merchant of death. Get use to the smell of gunpowder and cash.

name: Godstone
short_description: Wield magic and weaponry in this roguelike dungeoncrawler, forge powerful builds and explore a story that evolves based on your actions. The end goal: Claim the Godstone before those who would use it to destroy your kind.

name: Type 'n' Fish
short_description: Welcome to Type 'n' Fish, a cozy indie game where your typing skills become your fishing rod. Cast your line into tranquil waters and type your way to catching a variety of unique fish, each with its own educational description.

name: My Wife
short_description: Meet your new digital companion - an ultra-cute desktop mascot that brings life to your screen! Place her anywhere on your desktop and enjoy immersive interactions and heartwarming moments.

name: Bones Beneath
short_description: Explore the Egyptian underworld in this precision platformer! Jump, whip, and dash your way through a challenging, interconnected world that weaves linear gauntlets with open-ended exploration.

name: Gal Guardians: Servants of the Dark
short_description: Take control of the demon sisters Kirika and Masha as they attempt to revive their Demon Lord Maxim and rebuild their castle in this 2D action Metroidvania adventure!

name: Foetality: Fetus Deletus
short_description: Foetality is a whacky couch fighting game where you battle it out as cannibal babies in the womb of your mother. Eat your siblings limb by limb in order to win!

name: High Seas, High Profits!
short_description: Live your medieval trader life! Buy low, sell high and explore the world! Buy ships, build businesses, find or train captains. Deal with pirates, manipulate mayors and challenge traders. React to hundreds of events that shape your very own procedurally-generated world!

name: PLATiNA :: LAB
short_description: A new rhythm game featuring innovative characters inspired by databases! Join the research of PLATiNA :: LAB to uncover the secrets of the locked data world as a special 'Decoder' with unique abilities.

name: Dooms Hair Salon
short_description: Dooms Hair Salon is a comedy simulation game about running a hair salon in a chaotic town. Survive by operating the salon alone or with friends!

name: Backrooms: The Silence
short_description: Backrooms: The Silence is a cooperative horror game for 1-4 players, where you have to explore and fight the game master on your own, use your own abilities to survive in this complex world, play with your friends to get the full range of emotions!

name: Aleprok
short_description: A cooperative survival and strategy game where you explore diverse environments, build and defend your clan town, upgrade weapons and skills, and master magic to survive relentless enemy attacks.

name: Red Supreme
short_description: The world ends in three days, and you, as a devoted cultist, must bring a new member to the cult. Find a balance between the cult, relationships, and job.

name: The fall
short_description: Dive into a thrilling infinite fall! Dodge obstacles as you descend, test your reflexes, and beat your high score in this addictive arcade game where gravity is your greatest challenge.

name: Dice People
short_description: Dice People is an incremental game about rolling dice, creating a mass of units, smashing enemies, and gathering resources to get upgrades in a big skilltree.

name: Dissent on Mars
short_description: A sci-fi life sim where you create new societies unlike anything on Earth. Design your economy and government, build your colony, and experience your choices firsthand by living as a colonist. Will your society become a living utopia, or another dystopia?

name: Veins of DARKNESS
short_description: Veins of DARKNESS is a first-person horror game. The hero is an ordinary shift worker. During a business trip, his company rented him a house on the outskirts. But no one knew what evil was hiding in this godforsaken place.

name: Syder Reloaded
short_description: Syder Reloaded revives the Syder series in this love-letter to 90s Amiga shmups with upgraded graphics and refined gameplay. Challenging levels, a fleet of ships and a motherload of alien invaders. Get back to your roots and curse at your monitor in this skills-first shooter.

name: Delos: Space Traffic Control
short_description: In Delos, you are the space traffic controller managing the flow of ships at a bustling space station. Direct docking, allocate resources, and prevent collisions in a real-time strategy setting. Balance efficiency and safety to maintain order in the interstellar hub.

name: Neon Merger
short_description: Click, Drag, and Drop shapes into each-other to merge them! A relaxing physics-based shape merging game. Play with a variety of colorful shapes in a limited play area with this simple yet addicting puzzle game. Get the highest score you can!

name: U桌球U
short_description: 'U桌球U' is a casual billiards game.

name: Fisher Haven
short_description: An immersive fishing adventure where you compete in the island's annual competition. Upgrade your gear, discover unique baits, and form alliances with fellow fishers to maximize your chances of victory. Explore diverse zones, catch over 100 fish types, and hunt down 7 rare species.

name: Secret Agent Puzzle
short_description: Dr. Von Bösenstein is plotting to take over the world and you’re the only one that can stop her! Ensure she can’t complete any of the “world domination”-inators by navigating your way through intricate puzzle rooms. Avoid traps, don’t get stuck, solve the rooms and most important of all… a cat?

name: Malachite: Temple of the Sun
short_description: Start your journey through the depths of a forgotten jungle temple in Malachite: Temple of the Sun. Match colorful balls, unlock powerful power-ups, and construct your own temple as you progress. Choose between adventure and endless modes, immersing yourself in classic match 3 gameplay!

name: Turtle Riders
short_description: Ride giant turtles and aim your weapons at hordes of enemies chasing you while you gather as many resources as you can. Pick your upgrades carefully and create strong builds to survive the long road to the Outpost!

name: Asgard's Fall — Viking Survivors
short_description: Embark on an epic saga in Asgard's Fall, a norse Survivors-like Roguelite. Fight your way through hordes of creatures and let the gods feel your relentless wrath. How will your saga unfold?

name: Nordhold
short_description: Enemies are coming! Every decision matters: build your city, grow the economy, and prepare for enemy waves. Strengthen your defenses, adapt your strategy, and unleash your hero’s full potential. This unique Tower Defense will test your skills – are you worthy to claim a place at Valhalla?

name: Rogue Conflict
short_description: Rogue Conflict is a turn-based strategy roguelike. Combining tactical wargame combat with procedural roguelike features, Rogue Conflict is a game made for both wargamers and general turn based game enthusiasts alike.

name: 谜境·AI剧本杀互动剧场
short_description: 这是一款创新融合人工智能与沉浸式解谜体验的数字化游戏平台，主打“AI NPC驱动交互”的核心玩法。平台集结了解密冒险、沉浸式剧本杀、动态推理剧场等多元内容，玩家可通过与由AI实时演算的智能NPC深度互动推动游戏的开展。 另1：本平台剧本内容均为玩家合作创作，工作室提供AI以及开发技术支持，如有内容问题请轻喷。 另2：有兴趣成为解密、剧本杀、密逃等剧本合作开发者请联系作者，有发行或合作开发意向请联系开发者

name: Bunny Roulette
short_description: Russian roulette horror with 2-4 players, featuring a new card ability system that allows for unique strategy and gameplay. Take a seat at the table. Intense, suspense-filled atmosphere. Russian Roulette reimagined.

name: WonderLang Italian
short_description: Learn Italian through immersive quests, interactive dialogues, and spaced repetition combats. Help a young hero lift a magical curse by mastering Italian. Customize your learning experience and explore a vibrant world filled with unique characters. Start your journey to Italian fluency today!

name: Entropy Architects
short_description: 'With each layer's laws collapsing, every decision reforges the world!' Will you become a desperate gambler, or emerge as a calculating tactician? Every choice remolds your fate – and sometimes, you'll need a dash of luck to tip the scales. Forge your ultimate build and conquer the impossible!

name: Streamlands: Defense
short_description: A low-poly Tower Defense game inspired by World War I and II, in an original universe.

name: AudioRace
short_description: Audiorace is an accessible audio game full of adrenaline and smell of burnt tires! Let the sound guide you and race your way to the top.

name: クロトピア
short_description: 'Chrotopia' is a 2D action-adventure game set in a monochrome world. As a wanderer, explore a fragmented land, meet unique characters, solve puzzles, and restore lost connections to bring back color. Experience a blend of platforming and storytelling in this atmospheric journey.

name: Lock In
short_description: Lock In is a realism strategy shooter. Immerse yourself in this all new action packed competitive thrill gaming experience. Test your combat skills and strategic savvy against enemy foes to ensure victory!

name: Oblitus mortis
short_description: Embark on an epic 2D adventure with this pixel art style game, a metroidvania set in a world full of legends and myths of Venezuela. Explore various scenarios, face mythical creatures and discover ancient secrets in this incredible odyssey.

name: Midnight Taco
short_description: Step into the shoes of a young girl who must face solitude and mystery while waiting for her mother at the taco stand where she works. It’s a rainy night, but that won’t stop some unwelcome visitors from showing up...

name: Heart: Future Whispers
short_description: Heart: Future Whispers is a top-down shooter set in a dystopian future. Face hordes of enemies, manage resources to acquire powerful weapons, and uncover the dark secrets behind the chaos. Test your skills in infinite mode and fight for the highest score!

name: Laundromat Manager Simulator
short_description: Manage your laundromat empire in Laundromat Manager Simulator! Upgrade your space, customize your layout, operate machines, and attract customers. Design a welcoming environment and grow your business into the ultimate laundry hub in town!

name: Dead Soul TowerDefense:Shadow Labyrinth
short_description: This is a pixel-style classic tower defense game. You need to summon souls to fend off enemy attacks, and each type of soul has its unique skill tree. You can also build your own maze in the game to prevent enemy invasions.

name: Castle War
short_description: 《Warcraft 3: The Frozen Throne》 and 《Mirage War》 are two games that I really love in my childhood, and it would be a lot of fun to mix them together with some design.....

name: Meow Time Machine: Munch
short_description: This is an immersive hidden object puzzle game that takes you through time and space to explore the tumultuous inner world of expressionist master Edvard Munch. From the shadows of childhood to the birth of 'The Scream,' from European travels to the tranquility of his later years.

name: Yurei Hunt
short_description: Yurei Hunt is a multiplayer hide & seek prop hunt game where deception is key. Play as a Yurei, possessing objects & using abilities, or as a Hunter, relying on instincts & proximity voice chat to track them. With a world full of tricks, surprises & eerie tension, every match is a battle of wits.

name: HalfMoon Adventures
short_description: You own a store for weekend adventurers and mainly sell maps of dungeons. You sell maps during the day and crawl through dungeons at night. However - the market for map sellers is in high demand.Try to offer the best maps and push your competitor out of the market!

name: Stars of the Valkyrie
short_description: Endless runner action has never been more dynamic with a unique 3D movement system. Fly through the stars in this Neo-Arcade game as you dodge asteroids shoot down enemies ships and protect transport ships. When you have finished upload and compare your score against the best from around the world.

name: Holy Grain
short_description: Holy Grain is a celebration of absurdity and over-the-top comedic brutality. It’s a full-on attack against political correctness and wholesome family values. In this roguelike, you’ll team up with two characters—the Counselor and the Entity—to save the world from its impending doom.

name: Wednesdays
