short_description: 'The hardest part is not to speak up. It’s being heard.' Part video game, part graphic novel, Wednesdays seeks to raise awareness about child sexual abuse through a surprisingly hope-filled story.

name: Remains of Yith
short_description: Remains of Yith is a point and click adventure puzzle game inspired by The Shadow Out of Time by H.P Lovecraft, play as Sarah as she explores a mysterious island trying to recover a lost alien artifact

name: Denbora
short_description: Break the laws of entropy in Denbora and jump through time to solve complex temporal puzzles. Can you defeat Dirua and the challenges it will put you through?

name: Dragon Attack Mythologies: A Night Wolf Revenge
short_description: Jump, dodge, and fight against anyone who crosses your path in search of revenge. Explore 8 challenging worlds filled with danger and classic arcade action.

name: Screen Pets
short_description: Cute pets live at the bottom of your screen while you do other things.

name: THE DOJO OF MOCHIKO
short_description: For just $1, battle through a fast-paced samurai fighting game where enemies grow stronger with each fight. Face relentless foes in the dojo, testing your skills and strategy. Only the strongest warriors can survive the final challenge and claim the title of the ultimate samurai!

name: Aerial Lockdown
short_description: Aerial Lockdown, an Arcade game where you'll navigate your airplane over a factory-filled city. Destroy them! Blow them to pieces! But avoid the mines in the sky. Now fly my friend, and make Davie Bones proud!

name: Yes Mr. President
short_description: Are you ready to test your leadership skills in Yes, Mr. President? Every decision you make will shape your nation's future. Answer wisely to improve your people's lives—but beware, wrong choices can lead to crisis!

name: Willow Guard
short_description: Willow Guard is a single player story-driven fantasy RPG that combines dungeon-crawling action gameplay with a choice-based interactive fiction.

name: R.E.P.O.
short_description: An online co-op horror game with up to 6 players. Locate valuable, fully physics-based objects and handle them with care as you retrieve and extract to satisfy your creator's desires.

name: Sayaka's Addiction
short_description: There are many ways to go about the game and progress the story. Money can be earned in many different ways and through a variety of minigames. Want to work earnestly at a part-time job? Go for it! Want to work as a waitress? That's also an option!

name: The Path of Ren
short_description: A challenging precision platformer with tight controls. Master orb abilities to conquer 300+ challenges, collect thought-provoking journal entries, and race the clock in timed trials. Dash, crystalize, ghostify, warp, and slow time as you help a boy recall a wish he was granted by a white fox.

name: Yu-Gi-Oh! EARLY DAYS COLLECTION
short_description: Yu-Gi-Oh! EARLY DAYS COLLECTION is packed with classic Yu-Gi-Oh! games from the very early days of Dueling — bursting with retro RPGs and strategic card games with beloved anime characters!

name: Harpagun
short_description: Harpagun is a fast-paced VR shooter where you smash alien critters, argue with your dysfunctional crew, and destroy everything in sight. Use weapons or everyday objects with a gravity ray to wreak havoc. Built for VR, it delivers chaotic fun, immersive combat, and a wild, hilarious storyline.

name: Phantom Ops
short_description: With stunning, realistic 3D graphics and an intuitive control system, Phantom Ops offers a truly immersive experience

name: Your Mother
short_description: 《Your Mother》is a computer desktop companion. Experience the love and kindness from mothers.

name: Skyline
short_description: Clicker with good music and any choice you make can change your gameplay, you also have autoplay, you don't need to use the mouse, but you lose the chance to see all the secrets in the game (you can get all the achievements with autoplay) + WOMANS + ECONOMY

name: Detective - The Test
short_description: Test your detective instincts across three challenging cases. No hints, no help—just you, your intuition, and your ability to piece together the truth. Can you solve the mystery?

name: Sitting
short_description: A linear narrative game blending card gameplay. Players follow a plot, choosing and replacing cards each round to advance the story. Every decision impacts the ending.

name: Harvester Arno
short_description: Harvester Arno is a third person automatic shooting casual grass cutting game with features such as an open world, random monsters, continuously increasing firepower, and simple operation. During the battle, there are items randomly dropped that can be picked up to assist in the fight.

name: SEAPORT MAN
short_description: SEAPORT MAN is a short horror game where the protagonist, having escaped from a sunken ship, wanders the sea.

name: Urgent Message
short_description: In this world, the road is never easy, and survival is never simple. Can you overcome all the obstacles and reach the final destination in time? The answer lies in your hands.

name: Door4:Ultimatum
short_description: Dive into the captivating world of puzzles with the new part of the Door game series. Your task is to find the correct door among many options to advance to the next level. But be careful: only by understanding the patterns and solving puzzles you can unlock the coveted passage.

name: Vint: Realtime Video Interpolation and CRT Emulation
short_description: Vint is a high quality and performant machine learning based interpolation and temporal upscaling system to upscale most video formats, web sources, and even video capture card sources all in realtime. Vint supports BFI strobing and CRT scanout beam emulation based on the work of Blur Busters.

name: Mayday
short_description: Mayday is an atmospheric 2D side-scroller sci-fi with simplistic gameplay.

name: The Oneironaut
short_description: Journey through an artists surreal and dangerous dreams in this ambient action runner. Jump, slide, grind and parkour in an ever changing dreamscape while avoiding dangers and traps as you race towards the final art exhibit.

name: House of Lost Souls
short_description: House of Lost Souls is a story-driven horror game about Jack, who returns to his old family home in search of answers. Explore distorted memories, uncover dark secrets, and learn the truth about the tragedy that changed his life forever.

name: Jumping kitten
short_description: This is a top-down platform jumping game. Control the cat to jump through one obstacle after another, obtaining different skins and using different abilities along the way to reach the final destination.

name: Chill with Lisa – She Listens, She Cares, She Supports
short_description: Lisa is here to listen. Choose what’s on your mind, and she’ll help you see things differently. This visual novel is a cozy space where you can relax, get support, and hear kind words. Sometimes, all you need is someone who truly understands.

name: Cross The Boundaries
short_description: This is a Touhou Fangame. Maribel Hearn is a girl with unusual experience with ghosts and supernatural beings. In Cross The Boundaries, you will solve riddles while trying to stay alive, and looking for a way out of the nightmare.

name: Dodot!
short_description: Want a quick warm-up before your FPS? Click the balls, boost your score, and rise to the top of the Dodot Challenge!

name: Tiny Europe
short_description: Tiny Europe is a strategy game in which you need to build your fortress in 60 seconds and then defend it from waves of enemies. Hold on as long as possible, it will be interesting!

name: Forsaken Island
short_description: Awaken as Captain Elias Blackbone, a cursed pirate turned undead skeleton, stranded on a haunted island. Scavenge, craft, and fight to survive as you rebuild your body, uncover dark secrets, and decide your ultimate fate.

name: 幻想 · 遇见秦始皇 Fantasy Encountering Emperor Qin Shi Huang
short_description: This work is a visual novel romance set in China's Warring States period, allowing players to explore this ancient era through dialogues and interactions with characters, map exploration, tool collection, and text-based choices, and experience multiple endings and storylines.

name: ERAZER
short_description: ERAZER is real-time action shooter with pixel perfect destructible terrain. Dig, sneak or blow your way through the campaign with various weapons and gadgets including the nimble ninja rope. Explore online missions crafted by other players or create your own using the built-in level editor.

name: The Stalked 2
short_description: 'The Stalked 2' is a standalone horror sequel to 'The Stalked', where you play as Rachel, an avid hiker. What begins as a relaxing hike to a cabin turns into a nightmare filled with eerie interactions and unsettling events. Will you survive?

name: e-Racer
short_description: Feel the rush in e-Racer! A stylish GT arcade racer with dynamic tracks, weather challenges, and intense competition. Dominate championships, unlock upgrades, and race through unique locales. Master tight courses, leave rivals in the dust, and rise to the top!

name: Deskquarium
short_description: Aquascape..... on your desktop.

name: King's Legacy: A Crown Divided Collector's Edition
short_description: The Kingdom is falling apart! But a group of brave and righteous protectors are on their way! Join them in this fun kingdom builder game! Build your own towns and settlements, upgrade the production, manage your food, resources and luxuries, trade, craft and take care of your people.

name: Laserboy VR
short_description: Laserboy VR is a fast-paced, retro-inspired first-person arcade shooter. Wield powerful laser-weapons and slow down time to outsmart enemies. With precise combat and intense action, every move is amplified in VR for a thrilling, immersive experience.

name: Slendrina Remake
short_description: Slendrina Remake is a scary survival game set in a dungeon where you must gather items, solve puzzles, and evade the sinister Slendrina herself to make it out alive. Experience the atmosphere of fear and tension in this gripping horror adventure.

name: Stop the Blight
short_description: Stop the Blight is a tower defense roguelite with powerful spells and destructible voxel terrain. Build your defenses, reshape the land, and wield elemental power to uncover the truth behind the Blight.

name: Rescue Q
short_description: The objective of this “Top-Down puzzle action game” is to assist rescue workers in their movements until they can rush to a person in distress and rescue him or her. Various terrains and gimmicks will block your and the rescue team's way.

name: Alex Hill: Whispers at White Oak Inn
short_description: A young woman died near the White Oak Inn. Now, her spirit is roaming around, and an employee is receiving strange letters. What dark secrets wait to be found? The clock is ticking and you, as Alex Hill, must uncover the truth before it’s too late.

name: Taming Yore Dragon
short_description: Embark on your own epic fantasy quest to restore colour and life to an abandoned world. Solve puzzles and learn about real strategies for managing anxiety taught in a fun and engaging way. Developed alongside a psychologist, Taming Yore Dragon innovates and expands on what videogames can achieve!

name: Mother Machine
short_description: Climb, jump, and explore procedurally generated alien caves in this 1-4 player co-op action-RPG platformer. Customize your cute gremlin, embrace the creative chaos, and unlock a vast array of mutations to shape your personal playstyle and role in a group!

name: Promise Mascot Agency
short_description: Explore a cursed Japanese town! Recruit mascot friends and come to the rescue when disaster strikes! Solve the mystery of your exile! Help a living finger work through her many anger issues! Turn Promise Mascot Agency into the best agency in Japan in this open-world narrative adventure!

name: 740 Racing
short_description: A sandbox-like drifting and racing game in an open world.

name: Electrician Simulator VR
short_description: Electrician Simulator goes VR! Experience the game like never before. Change bulbs, fix outlets, and have fun with cables and wires. Just remember to kill the power first. Electrocution might feel very real in VR!

name: Fire Me, I Insist
short_description: Workplace efficiency is at an all time low at Bog-Standard Solutions. You've been hired to sniff out inefficiencies and get rid of the rabble. Trouble is, everyone's up to something. Collect evidence, listen to gossip and tattle on your colleagues.

name: Mirrored Soul
short_description: A turn-based RPG detective story with focus on monster-collecting, exploration, and humor. Negotiate with enemies to recruit them to your party, and fuse your monsters to create new ones.

name: Mariusz: the game
short_description: Mariusz: The Game is a brutal platformer where every level becomes harder. Face relentless enemies, deadly traps, and fall damage. Progress is measured by traveled distance, and one rule defines it all: if you die, you start over. Your patience and endurance will be tested during the play.

name: Shooters, Ready!
short_description: 「青春 x スポーツシューティング」がコンセプトの アーケードスタイルFPSゲームです。連続した部屋を素早く駆け抜け 点在するターゲットを倒しましょう。素早く 精密に 連続して倒すことが出来れば より高得点が狙えます。

name: 8th Avenue
short_description: Endless looping streets, elusive anomalies, psychological and courage-testing pressure, the deeper you go, the clearer it becomes, integrate details to trigger multiple endings, success or failure hangs by a thread.

name: Hostile Dreams 2
short_description: An extremely challenging psycho-horror platformer with unique ragdoll controls – made of my dreams.

name: Mow Meow
short_description: A multiplayer catnip mowing simulator.

name: Tactics Unlimited
short_description: Lead your team from the very bottom to the top of international football. Use turn-based gameplay to strategically influence matches and surprise your opponents. Also, focus on management: player transfers, youth development, or the expansion of your infrastructure.

name: I Lost my Eggs: Easter
short_description: Embark on a fun Easter egg hunt! Explore seven enchanting rooms, solve fun Easter trivia, and uncover hidden eggs in the most unexpected places. Can you find them all? The hunt is on!

name: Teleport Master
short_description: The world is dying, and all you can do in this game is 'press the right-Arrow button'! Save the world using only 2 buttons!

name: Chess Visualized
short_description: A playable Chess board that visualizes where each piece can go and what every move does

name: Mills of Morris
short_description: Morris has long desired human life. He believes living as a human being is much better. Navigate through the Wizard’s puzzles and help him reach his goal in this pixel art sokoban, inspired by the classic Mills board game!

name: Tactical Mission: Target Rush
short_description: A minimalist target shooting game focused on improving aiming skills in a challenging way.

name: Isle Of Pochimoon
short_description: Isle of Pochimoon is a Bullet Heaven game that blends life-simulation elements, including a building system, crafting, selling products at a convenience store, fishing, taming Pochimoon, and Pochimoon Fusion where you can fuse two Pochimoon to create an entirely new one that help you in combat

name: Pachinko TD
short_description: Pachinko TD is a physics-based, minimalist tower defense game. Inspired by Thronefall.

name: Lord of the Wilds
short_description: Lord of the Wilds is a strategy game where you build and defend your territory in a wild land. Gather resources, train armies, and face threats from rival lords, orcs, and undead. Strategize to conquer the wilderness.

name: WWE 2K25
short_description: Celebrate The Bloodline in Showcase. Compete online in MyGM. Expanded gameplay includes intergender wrestling, chain wrestling, barricade diving, the return of Promos + much more!

name: Farmyard Survivors
short_description: Survive hordes of cute (but evil) animals attacking your farm in this fast-paced, lane-based roguelite. Recruit adorable heroes and unlock powerful support animals to protect your farm from relentless attackers!

name: FIND ALL: Bunker
short_description: Explore the underground bunker and the surface of the earth in anticipation of a nuclear explosion, finding various items and painting the black and white picture with colored inks.

name: Something Took Her
short_description: Within the rural town of Oakview, students are vanishing. One is Amy Morrison, a troubled friend of yours. People say she made a pact with something in the vents of the school. Unravel the mysteries surrounding the town's past, survive the supernatural trauma, and search for traces of your friend.

name: Yeonkyung
short_description: The game is a 3D first-person horror game and features Korean and Japanese soldiers and is played in a place called Yeongyeong, the palace of the Goryeo Dynasty. (Please understand that the game size is high for quality reasons.)

name: The Unholy Priest
short_description: Manage a haunted funeral service as a priest in a cursed forest. Bury or cremate the dead, perform exorcisms, fend off demonic possessions, and quiet restless souls. Survive terrifying encounters, maintain sanity, and experience the pinnacle of horror simulation in The Unholy Priest!

name: Zorro and Zedd
short_description: Slay Dragons, collect magical gems, unlock ancient powers, and adventure through the mystical land of Dundalk as Zorro and Zedd. Vanquish the dreaded Dragon Lords, defeat the Dragon King, and retake your Homeland for all Bat-kind!

name: Kun’tewiktuk: A Mi’kmaw Adventure
short_description: Kun’tewiktuk: A Mi’kmaw Adventure is a fantasy adventure game inspired by Mi’kmaw legend and folklore. It chronicles the adventures of siblings Wasuek ('Flower') and her brother U'n ('Fog'). They get separated one summer morning and they go on an adventure through the spirit world to reunite.

name: Find Love or Die Trying: Til Death Do Us Part
short_description: The afterstory to Find Love or Die Trying is here! Continue your romance with your chosen partner in the world beyond the killer dating show. Will your love survive, when the world turns against you?

name: Blast Hopper
short_description: Dive into an exhilarating 2D platformer adventure that blends classic platforming mechanics with the thrilling intensity of twin-stick shooting. Help Captain Hop journey to the deepest depths of Subterranea to restore the severed link with the surface.

name: Disaster Blaster
short_description: Disaster Blaster is a roguelite bullet heaven card game where you play a questionably sane scientist building the most over-the-top weapon in the universe. Evolve your blaster’s card sequence and let it rip against hordes of alien enemies across a galaxy of unfortunate planets.

name: Foepower
short_description: Foepower is a chill (but often spicy) roguelite auto-battle RPG - now with a chalk art pack drawn by the dev's daughter! Send heroes into the mountain to level up, gear up, and extract the all-important Foepower - because you'll need it to strengthen your next hero and move up the leaderboards!

name: The Bunker
short_description: Trapped in an abandoned bunker, you are alone—your friends locked out, something else locked in. This PSX, VHS-style found-footage psychological horror plunges you into a nightmare of analog terror. Will you unravel the truth, survive the bunker’s horrors, and discover the fate of your friends?

name: Undercover Fools
short_description: Infiltrate a secure building, cleverly bypass guards and traps, complete tasks with the help of cool spy gadgets. Play alone or with friends, upgrade your spy skills and plan excellent missions, and most importantly... Don't screw up!

name: 缠罗深梦
short_description: 《缠罗深梦》是一款以都市奇幻怪谈为背景的剧情向RPG游戏。在只存在于梦境之中的虚幻都市“犹蒙”，有着奇异能力的主角邂逅了不明身份的谜之少女，而后，平静的生活被打破了。你将穿越门扉，数度潜入梦境，在光怪陆离的梦之世界中见证故事的谜底。

name: Stair Tap
short_description: Tap your way through never-ending staircases, racing to the top before your time runs out!

name: Call of Boba
short_description: A cozy pixel art adventure about saving a struggling Boba Tea shop. Brew up tasty drinks, battle enemies for inspiration, make friends with customers, and much much more, on your quest to serve up the best tea in town!

name: 電視夢工場
short_description: 創造自己的夢幻電視台，製作、購買、編排電視節目、賺取廣告費、規劃提高收視率…等。還可以發揮絕妙點子與獨特創意，安排最棒的節目表，以締造驚人收視率，來爭取電視節目比賽獎項。或是努力尋找理想男女主角，來培養下一代偶像，創造夢幻的演員組合，拍攝出超級電視節目。

name: The Last Bloom
short_description: Margarete receives a letter from Veronika, her kind neighbor, saying she’s ill. Concerned, Margarete decides to visit, but the journey is challenging due to her blindness. Now it’s time for you, her trusty four-legged friend, to guide her and help her reach Veronika’s house.

name: AIR
short_description: Summer stretches on endlessly. Beneath the vast blue sky. Beneath the air in which she awaits— AIR, the second game released by visual novel studio Key, is now available on Steam! Now featuring the side story novel, 'First Sky Chapter' and full voice support!

name: Commander Quest
short_description: Congratulations! You just found a 'one of a kind' roguelike that combines deck-building card game and auto battle strategy game! Consider unit counters, then create powerful synergy by breaking down the boundaries between the battlefield and cards, then lead your army to victory!

name: Gas Station Manager
short_description: An ultimate 1-8 player Co-op Simulation game where you build and manage your gas station completely from scratch. Team up with your friends, provide exceptional service and grow your business! Collaboration (and some chaos!) is the key to success—fuel up, have your fun and rise to the top!

name: Monochrome Echoes - white -
short_description: This is an otherworldly summoning RPG set in a fantasy world, with an adapted and enhanced system from the popular hack-and-slash RPG 'QUESTER.'

name: Wild Assault
short_description: Wild Assault is an anthro-themed tactical shooter built with Unreal Engine 5, featuring large-scale battlefield gameplay centered around Valiant abilities. Work closely with your team, harness your instincts, and charge into battle to secure victory.

name: Max Manos
short_description: Max Manos is an incremental destruction game where you play as a powerful hand, known as Max Manos, eliminating shapes. Chain explosive reactions, collect shards, and upgrade your abilities to destroy shapes even faster.

name: FUBUKI ～zero in on Holoearth～ HOLOLIVE ALTERNATIVE
short_description: 『FUBUKI ~zero in on Holoearth~』is a high-speed pixel action game where you control the protagonist, Shirakami Fubuki, and battle using swords and skills.

name: DOORS : Haunted Tales of Lantern House
short_description: This game is about reliving mysterious tales surrounding the haunted location, 'Lantern House.'

name: Trump Searching Vigaro
short_description: President Putin has captured other big country president Trump all Vigaro pills. So Trump need find missing 10 vigaro pills. Play this awesome 2d platformer

name: Frogstool
short_description: Frogstool is an 8-bit action platformer where you control a frog using its tongue to fight monsters, defeat challenging bosses, and explore dangerous medieval landscapes.

name: SHOOPER NOVA
short_description: Craft Your Ultimate Circular Fortress! Dive into SHOOPER NOVA, where you choose props and components to build a unique fortress. Unlock combos to shape your strategy and battle style. Become an unstoppable barrage machine and obliterate waves of enemies from all directions!

name: Blobun
short_description: You are a blob bunny. Your goal? Touch every tile! Get your slime all over the place and overcome tricks and traps as you make your way through this casual puzzle game.

name: Tarot
short_description: Tarot is a Rouge-like deck builder themed around the Major and Minor Arcana of the Tarot.

name: petrichor
short_description: Petrichor is a first person horror game inspired by Outer Wilds. Other older games inspired us for the graphics. You are in a cabin in the woods, some strange things are happening here.

name: VR Wilderness Survival
short_description: You are trapped in a mine, and when night falls, wild animals will come to attack you. Use a machine gun to defend your camp.

name: Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii
short_description: Embark on an over-the-top, modern-day pirate adventure with an ex-yakuza, now pirate captain & his crew. Engage in exhilarating combat on land and sea in the hunt for lost memories and treasure.

name: Perspective Remastered
short_description: Solve portal-based puzzles using platforming and various other mechanics!

name: Raid Auctus
short_description: Grow your perfect raid team while the game runs! Build and train your squad from 20 unique classes, enhance their power through permanent upgrades, and watch them conquer challenging raids in Raid Auctus.

name: Ninja Ming
short_description: In this 2d precision platformer with a teleportation twist, play as Ninja Ming and embark on the Path of Trials. Dash through 241 levels using dynamic teleportation and diverse ninjutsu skills. Conquer challenges with style—growing stronger at every turn.

name: Echoes of Eldoria
short_description: A cute, nature-focused vertical puzzle platformer in which a powerless young wizard chases after the dragon Eldaria for his stolen abilities. Combining the exciting abilities & puzzles of Zelda with the thrill and risk of Getting Over It/Jump King! Get Echoes of Eldoria for 30% off until 4/14!

name: Gardener: Master of Trees and Flowers
short_description: Cultivate unique gardens, timelapse seeds to blooming orchards in seconds, design procedurally generated plants, nurture ecosystems and discover rare genetic traits in wild flora, to create ultimate species, in state-of-the-art botanical simulation.

name: Red Night
short_description: A 2.5D game immersing you in the atmosphere of Soviet perestroika. A grim mystery awaits in the city of M, where a terrifying incident has occurred. You’ll explore locations, solve puzzles, and uncover secrets hidden in the shadows of events that shook this world.

name: In Between All Times
short_description: In Between All Timesis a cinematic-visual novel about an graduate student's struggles finding purpose and identity, set in a surreal future in the stars.

name: I'm Truely a Good Guy!
short_description: Welcome to Cattlehorse Corp! Here, deadlines are brutal and backstabbers abound. Start missions with up to 10 staffers. Facing high - risk tasks? We’ll assign helper bots! Use wacky gear, bluff, or double - cross. Watch out—drones and hostile bots attack. Only the survivors get ahead!

name: Grit and Valor - 1949
short_description: A dieselpunk real-time tactics roguelite set in an alt-history World War 2. Grit and Valor – 1949 puts you in command of an elite Mech Squadron. Think fast and battle the Evil Axis forces to liberate Europe. Upgrade your Mechs and Pilots and develop new strategies to neutralise the enemy HQ!

name: Train Metropolis
short_description: Idle Clicker City Builder. Build and manage your railway company, helping the city expand and thrive as you grow together.

name: Rapid Impact
short_description: Rapid Impact is an online PvP-PvE shooter in a post-apocalyptic world. Fight players or AI in various modes. The game evolves with community feedback, shaping its future through player voting! Wishlist Rapid Impact now and be among the first to experience intense PvP-PvE battles!

name: Slime: The Cleaner
short_description: Join little Gooma as he strives to be the best cleaner in the Kingdom! Meet new friends, witness dubious things, and have a great time in this simple and cute game.

name: Ethereal Abyss
short_description: Ethereal Abyss is a single-player third-person shooter with psychological horror elements, inspired by the Backrooms. Navigate multi-dimensional levels, solve puzzles with time-inversion mechanic, while resisting enslavement by your mind.

name: Eternal League
short_description: Step into a futuristic battleground where every decision shapes your destiny. In Eternal League, you'll embark on an epic journey through a fast-paced roguelike RPG that combines customization, strategic combat, and a unique session-based progression system that rewards your skill and creativity.

name: KINTSUGI - A Journey Through The Broken Pieces
short_description: KINTSUGI is a 3D puzzle game inspired by the ancient Japanese art of repairing ceramics, which transforms cracks into decorative features, highlighting their beauty with gold.

name: Funny Volleyball
short_description: 'Funny Volleyball' is a modern remake of the classic arcade volleyball game from the 90s, giving new emotions and nostalgia. Immerse yourself in bright and picturesque landscapes, enjoying the game, but do not forget about the main goal - victory!

name: Aggrolotls
short_description: Aggrolotls is a top-down arena roguelike where you play as tiny axolotls and must evolve into a swarm that can take on powerful creatures from the sea. Level up and choose from upgrades that make each round feel unique.

name: Sea Chronicles
short_description: Sea Chronicles is a first-person comedy-adventure where you must escape a sinking ship while navigating a world filled with niche pop-culture references—mostly from SpongeBob. Experience a weird journey with unexpected twists, absurd puzzles, ridiculous deaths, and collectible bugs (insects)

name: It Digs Up
short_description: Be a spiderbot, crawl around on walls and ceilings, dig and drill, make critters go splat, find the exit.

name: Dream Chaser
short_description: Trapped in a strange world, the protagonist explores various dream worlds, escapes from a chaser, and finds the path to return to reality.

name: Parking Lot Simulator: Car Collector
short_description: Start as a valet parking cars and work your way up to becoming a legendary car collector! Park customer's vehicles quickly and safely, earn tips, and expand your parking lot to build the most prestigious business in town.

name: Great Powers
short_description: A 4x global turn-based strategy game with a well-developed economic and military model.

name: Bramble Royale: A Meteorfall Story
short_description: Bramble Royale is a wild, no-holds barred card brawl in the wacky world of Meteorfall. Build a face-melting deck, break the rules, and stomp your opponents in this fast-paced & fresh take on roguelike deckbuilders.

name: Another Try 2
short_description: The virus has devastated cities and lands. Most of the population died, the rest turned into the walking dead. You're one of the last survivors. Do whatever it takes to last another day.

name: I Come In Peace
short_description: Don't panic! survive this bullet hell action! As a goofy pacifist alien that crashed on Earth, use your defense abilities to evade paranoid humans whose deadly attacks on you cause destruction and mayhem. Navigate the chaos, collect your spaceship parts, and run the hell out of this planet!

name: Speedrun Academie
short_description: Take on a new challenge from the Speedrun Academy. This ultra-fast first-person game pushes you to chain fluid movements, keep your momentum, and cross the finish line.

name: Path of Dao
short_description: Path of Dao is a unique match-3 cultivation simulator where Eastern mysticism meets addictive gameplay. Gather resources, cast abilities, and unlock strategies on your journey to immortality. Every match brings you closer to ascension as you master the way of cultivation.

name: DUMMS!
short_description: Destroy dummies, unlock skills, buy quests and upgrades in this short incremental game. Earn XP to reach the highest level in all the skills and become the master archer.

name: Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced
short_description: Experience entertainment blockbusters Grand Theft Auto V and Grand Theft Auto Online — now upgraded for a new generation with stunning visuals, faster loading, 3D audio, and more, plus exclusive content for GTA Online players.

name: Ringer
short_description: Ringer reinvents the classic game of marbles with a deckbuilding twist. Discover game breaking synergies and accumulate an ever increasing score in this chill marbles roguelike.

name: Sacre Bleu
short_description: A fast-paced, bullet-time action-platformer with speedrunning and revolutionary flair. Hack n’ slash your way out of la Bastille, blasting yourself through the air in graceful bullet-time aerial battles on a quest to save all of France!

name: ころコロ
short_description: This game is a gyro-only game. Please make sure that your controller is equipped with a gyro function before purchasing. Roll around with the gyro control. Overcome numerous gimmicks and aim for the goal! A total of 50 stages. Tilt and roll 5 balls of different shapes to reach the goal.

name: Hamspater
short_description: Hamspater is a simple side-scrolling roguelike game that requires control. To keep your hamster alive and attack effectively, you must focus on movement control. Defeat slimes and survive for 20 minutes to get more gold.

name: Christmas Tree Decorator
short_description: Christmas Tree Decorator is a first-person simulator where you can unwind and decorate a Christmas tree. Whether you’re a casual fan or a dedicated celebrator, enjoy the cozy atmosphere free from pressures or perfectionism as you create your own unique holiday tree and decorations!

name: BLACKSHARD
short_description: BLACKSHARD is a first-person exploration game. Wander through a strange megastructure, the Labyrinth, to unravel its mysteries... Your behavior within the Labyrinth will define the outcome of your journey. What path will you choose to take?

name: Galactic Getaway
short_description: Decorate your planet, attract adorable creatures, and discover who chooses to stay. Build a cozy life in this multiplayer space sim where farming, fishing, and crafting can draw new companions. Play solo or with friends and create a home worth visiting.

name: The Fool's Apprentice
short_description: A wizard academy management sim where you—an obviously benevolent professor—must manage & cast spells on your many apprentices so that they might study the right spells… and perhaps even survive the researching process. Some may die, but oh well, can’t save them all!

name: Slimekeep
short_description: In a world becoming corrupted by the evil Slime King, KILL or CAPTURE various slimes to grow stronger and save Slimetopia! Venture through procedurally generated levels in this fast-paced roguelike, if you're tough enough to not get slimed...

name: Hauntsville
short_description: You're a nameless traveler, stranded in a ghost town in the Cursed West. Use your wits, elbow grease, and the iron on your hip. Build a homestead, work the land, and survive against unspeakable monsters in this unique Western horror survival game - alone or with friends!

name: Shape Brawl
short_description: “Shape Brawl” is a 2D synthesis-based bullet hell shooting game.

name: Collinwood
short_description: Explore a vibrant sandbox world full of wildlife and nature. Gather materials and craft tools to turn your small cabin into a cozy home. Build your shelter and hunt for food to survive—but be careful, the forest can be a dangerous place.

name: Ravenlok: Legendary Edition
short_description: Embark on an enchanting journey in Ravenlok, an action-packed fairytale adventure about a young heroine destined to fulfill a perilous prophecy.

name: Erenshor
short_description: Erenshor is a single player nod to the MMORPGs of the past. Partner up with our signature 'Simulated Players' to experience all of the joys of open-world MMORPG gameplay on your own schedule and without the time commitments. There are thousands of items, quests, raids, and secrets to discover!

name: STUDIO SCREAM - VERSE ONE
short_description: You play as a talented rapper on a mission to record his best song while being tormented by an entity that haunts the abandoned studio that your friend Keith bought. Will you be able to face the darkness and free the studio from its cursed grip, or will the entity silence your voice forever?

name: optimal conditions for a sacrifice
short_description: mild temperature, dim sunlight, good sleeping schedule, regular fluid intake

name: Flesh Psychosis
short_description: Flesh Psychosis is a little casual puzzle game, in which you have to score as much as possible. You have to collect various spooky ingredients and make deathly meals, using gravity and mad scientist tools.

name: Ninja Vs. Zombies 3
short_description: Fight Zombies, Monsters and a Nightmare with your Skills and Upgrades, use your Sword correctly and escape with Smoke Bombs, blast your way or smash Undead side by side with your Ninja Elite like never before. Action-packed meets Survival RogueElite Ninja Game.

name: Flail Your Arm, Hit the Ball.
short_description: A new form of suffering awaits. Imagine playing a home run derby… But with the same infuriatingly precise controls as a certain game where a man in a pot climbs mountains using only a hammer. Yes, that one. Now swing for the fences—if you can.

name: 4th Era - The RuneChild
short_description: Somewhere between a Casual open-world RPG and a wizard/Alchemist wet dream...

name: Fractured Perception
short_description: Discover a mystery, understand the danger you are living in, and find the true culprit of a series of disturbing crimes that have occurred around you.

name: Swingers
short_description: Navigate the beautiful—and sometimes dangerous—rainforest, swinging by your tongue and bunny-hopping with your tail in this precision platformer.

name: Octohill Ski Tycoon
short_description: Octohill is a casual game about building and managing your own ski resort. Mark ski trails, connect them with lifts and watch your snowmobiles rushing to rescue those daring skiers who went a little too far.

name: Russian Village Simulator on Mars
short_description: Develop a village colony on Mars, using various resources and bringing the unique flavor of Russian culture to the distant space.

name: Inhuman Resources: A Literary Machination
short_description: A literary machination about corporations, conspiracies, and the unspeakable horrors you’ll commit for minimum wage.

name: Swingularity
short_description: An indie space golf game set across an infinite multiverse filled with stylized planets, stars, and other celestial wonders. Bogey, par, or birdie your way through tailored and procedurally generated courses. In Swingularity, the cosmos becomes your fairway.

name: Word Warp
short_description: A short and entertaining typing game, where you need to type your way through space to find a way home. Upgrade your vessel and overcome enemy resistances with your linguistic arsenal. Hack away in this roguelite deep space typing bonanza.

name: Timber Wars
short_description: In Timber Wars, protect sacred trees from relentless lumberjacks and machines. Summon and upgrade guardian trees with points earned over time or by defeating enemies. Strategically place and strengthen your guardians to defend the forest for as long as you can in this intense top-down strategy game.

name: 不安ごと
short_description: インターネット上で怪談や怖い話を読み漁ることを日課にするあなた。いつもの日課の後、何か異様な気配を感じた気が...？

name: Chopping Spree
short_description: Welcome to the chillaxing world of chopping trees, where time slows down, and the only rush is the rush you get from numbers going up.

name: Polterguys: Possession Party
short_description: Supernatural multiplayer madness where 8 players use sneaky sabotage to get opponents caught by a raging monster! Play as mischievous ghosts who possesses every-day objects to gain special powers and show off! Battle in spooky maps full of traps and use whacky powerups to sacrifice your friends!

name: Zomboard
short_description: Zomboard is a post-apocalyptic colony sim and base defense game. Start with a few survivors, build your settlement, and fortify defenses to survive overwhelming zombie hordes.

name: Harold Rabbit - Finder of Lost Things
short_description: Harold Rabbit : Finder of Lost Things is a fully hand-drawn point & click game for all ages. Join Harold and his sidekick Maud on a quest to recover Harold's stolen trumpet!

name: Lands of Rumour
short_description: Lands of Rumour is a turn-based 4X game about hiding and gossip. Embrace the atmosphere of Robin Hood, develop villages, gather resources, recruit your men and defend your homeland in tactical combat, where every unit has unique abilities.

name: Neighbors: Suburban Warfare
short_description: Take the fight to your pesky neighbors in a mayhem filled team-based online co-op battle. Assemble a team of iconic residents, attack your rival’s home with crazy items, and deploy devious traps to defend your own. Whose house will survive to rule the neighborhood?

name: A Mirror, Darkly
short_description: Explore your surrounds in this short narrative using a novel mechanic to find objects in a mirror's reflection

name: Eldritch Survivors
short_description: Uncover the secrets behind the protagonists' fate, trapped in an endless cycle of death. Eldritch Survivor is a survival-like game that maximizes both the narrative and the excitement of each dungeon encounter. Immerse yourself in a 99% pure Lovecraftian world and confront the terror of the unknown.

name: Dream Life in the Country Side
short_description: A laid-back farming simulator where you play as Lisa, a dedicated farmer by day and a passionate partner of Honoka at night. Work the land, raise animals, and cultivate your relationship. Unlock special scenes as your bond and farm flourish.

name: Clonizer
short_description: Clonizer combines Hex-based tactics and roguelike deckbuilding! Play cards, manage clones, explore unique charming planets and outsmart aliens. Craft a powerful deck through your expedition and Clonize the universe to become employee of the month of CLONPO!

name: Zombies In Valkeala
short_description: Third person shooter game, where player controls woman character whose mission is to kill zombies in place called Valkeala in 4 different locations

name: Afterlove EP
short_description: From the creator of Coffee Talk and What Comes After, comes a slice-of-life adventure set in modern Jakarta about love, loss and finding your own way forward. Step into the shoes of Rama, a young musician struggling to move on with life after the death of his girlfriend, Cinta.

name: Demon Knives
short_description: Survive waves of demons and collect their gems to level up. Compete against your friends for the #1 spot on the leaderboard. Or conquer the worldwide charts.

name: Chains of Freedom
short_description: Embark on a thrilling journey in a high-stakes, turn-based tactics game. Lead an elite squad in a fictional, dystopian Eastern European country as you unravel a conspiracy threatening the state. Navigate intense strategic battles and adapt to ever-evolving challenges to prevail.

name: Picnic Penguin
short_description: It's picnic time! Help Pinguino the penguin push tasty treats onto the picnic blanket in this charming Sokoban-inspired puzzle game.

name: Gazebo Simulator
short_description: An absurdist 3D platformer.

name: The Grappler
short_description: Grapple or Fall. Inspired by brutally challenging platformers like Jump King and Getting Over It, this 2D adventure will push you to your limits, one frustratingly rewarding grapple at a time.

name: Dirt Bike Mini Racer
short_description: It will test your nerves and take you to the extremes offroad dirt bike racing capabilities

name: Memory Girl +
short_description: A tragic love story following Memori and her search for the missing 'him.'

name: Dear His Majesty
short_description: Dear Princes and Princess, a legendary kingdom awaits your inheritance. Your people eagerly await your wisdom and courage. Yet, this journey is fraught with challenges; obstacles will test your resolve. Do not betray the trust your people have in you. Lead them to true greatness!

name: It's On The Mouse
short_description: Become the best tiny maid on the block! Help Holly and her friends in this little café manager where jumping and running are key to make up for your lack of size! Scuttle around the tables, serve your customers and be careful as dangerous obstacles and bosses will show up to try to stop you!

name: Memory Lost
short_description: Memory Lost is a story-driven fast-paced cyberpunk shooter where you are not just fighting enemies — you become them. Possess enemies, adapt their weapons and skills, and fight ruthless corporations. Uncover secrets, upgrade abilities, and shape your own fate in this world.

name: Try them all!
short_description: A mysterious box is locked with a 4 to 8-digit code.Your only goal is to open it—with your own hands. No hints. No puzzles.But who needs them? If you try every number up to 9999... eventually, it will open.

name: Maximum Chaser : 1001 Squad
short_description: It is a universe similar to ours, where humans are technologically advanced but also full of evil. You will play as 2 member of the street organization 'Maximum Chaser' and confront an evil security company A.A.S.S., making them scream under your gunfire.

name: Sherlock Holmes i el cas d'Arthur Gordon Pym
short_description: A short puzzle exploration game, with progress based on your knowledge about systems that have been hidden from the very beginning. Uncover what happened to Holmes and Watson’s friend, face a strange cult, and reveal the hidden truth of our reality.

name: Hope Deferred
short_description: Hope Deferred is a first-person psychological horror RPG. Explore nightmare worlds and search for understanding in this PSX inspired dungeon crawler.

name: Framed Fear
short_description: You must discover the differences between what you see through the camera and with your own eyes to distinguish real floors from fake ones and escape. It is said that ghosts behave the opposite of humans, and taking the elevator is no exception.

name: Karaoke Love Song
short_description: Share your best beautiful voice with a karaoke game themed around love songs.

name: Silverpine Creek
short_description: Explore the chilling village of Silverpine Creek, trapped in fog and fear. Unravel its dark history as a reporter trapped within, facing the malevolent witch Korana. Realtime Physics gameplay, immersive VHS-style visuals, and reactive AI heighten the suspense in this harrowing tale of survival.

name: Don't Be A Baby!
short_description: Embark on a whimsical run-and-gun adventure with “Don’t Be A Baby!” Dash, skate, and fly through animated cutscenes, break the 4th wall, and groove to a fantastic soundtrack.

name: REPOSE
short_description: In the facility, each step, each shot, each mistake costs precious energy. Rendered entirely in black and white, this mystery can be unravelled. The puzzle can be solved. Don't ask who tried to solve it before. Do the job. Find oxygen and sleep. Go deeper. And don't ask about Aaron.

name: Warside
short_description: Welcome to Warside, the fast-paced turn-based tactics game. With a single-player story campaign, multiplayer support, and a built-in map editor, the fight for victory never ends. Choose your Commander, assemble your forces, and battle your way to victory.

name: MudGate
short_description: You're in lands torn apart, driven to mend your world by recovering compass shards and reclaiming seized ground.

name: blackhole simulator
short_description: Start as a small black hole suck up the galaxy and evolve into the legendary black hole!

name: Stopping Santa
short_description: Stopping Santa is a Jazzy top-down arena shooter where you play a mercenary fighting against Santa’s legions. Short play sessions, simple controls, instant action, and a global leaderboard for the Top 10. Inspired by classic arcade games.

name: Beats&Boss
short_description: Beats&Boss is a 2D action game that combines rhythm gameplay. Follow the Beats and defeat the Boss! Ues powerful AOE skills to clear the field! Continuously kill and enter COMBO state，maintain the state without interruption！

name: Backrooms Cleanup Crew
short_description: You and your crew are tasked with cleaning up after the last exploration team's ill-fated journey into the Backrooms. Dodge deadly incursions, scrub every surface, and leave no trace.

name: Dollhouse: Behind the Broken Mirror
short_description: Enter the broken mind of Eliza de Moor, a once-celebrated singer, now trapped in the labyrinth of her own forgotten memories. With the help of a new medicine, will you be able to piece together the mystery of your past?

name: Wizard of OZ: Hidden Objects
short_description: Join a captivating and bright adventure through the land of Oz! Search for hidden clues with your favourite characters and defeat the evil witch!

name: LivingBattle
short_description: Go to a right place and complete all battle mission

name: Murder in Crayontopia
short_description: Grab your crayons and delve into the world of Crayontopia in this murder mystery visual novel. Become an adept or inept detective as you gather evidence, get to know your fellow crayon-lovers, and seek to uncover the colorful secrets behind the murders that plague this seemingly perfect world.

name: So it's Simple!
short_description: A relaxing 2D platformer inspired by T.C. Aeelah’s 'So it’s Simple.' Follow Ivo and a playful fairy on an emotional journey through a colorful world, filled with simple joys, gentle puzzles, and heartwarming moments.

name: Tower of Kalemonvo
short_description: Crawl to the top of the TOWER OF KALEMONVO, a hardcore isometric ARPG with randomly generated levels meant for fans of slower paced action games. Fight cultists and monsters, scavenge for magical loot, learn powerful spells and fully customize your stats and skills!

name: Dreamland Farm
short_description: After living in a big city your dreams come true – today you start your new life on a peaceful pixel farm!

name: Bundle of Joy
short_description: Bundle of Joy is a lighthearted, story-rich, minigame romp about becoming a parent during the pandemic. Complete all your child-rearing tasks, manage your stress, find time to rest, survive the day, wake up, and do it all over again. It won't be perfect, but that's ok. You're doing your best.

name: Augmented Empire
short_description: Step into New Savannah, 2058 - a city divided by class and corruption, where your tactical choices spark a cyberpunk revolution. Assemble a team of misfits and lead them through 26 intense missions with deep strategy and immersive storytelling. Every decision shapes your rebellion.

name: Me and (My) Cat's Island
short_description: Eat onigiri and bond with everyone! The ultimate onigiri action game!A platformer where you control a character whose abilities change by eating onigiri, exploring and solving the secrets of a strange island.

name: Man Without Clothes Runner
short_description: Endless runner game where mission is to collect glass coins and avoid rocks. Speed is increasing so try to survive as long as can

name: Iron Saga VS
short_description: Take control of an assortment of superb mechs and engage in thrilling combat with other enthusiasts on the same battlefield! In addition to original mecha, well-known IPs such as 'Mazinger Z' and “Dancouga – Super Beast Machine God” also ready for the mecha war!

name: Samly's Merge
short_description: Easy to learn, hard to master. No time limits. No rush. Just relax and merge in pixel-art goodness.

name: Ascension to the Throne: Valkyrie
short_description: As a result of treacherous conspiracy the ruler of Airath Alexander was deprived of power and brought to the distant land of Oganthar. Craving for revenge, Alexander meets many friends and enemies on his way home, and beautiful warrioress Eneya is among them. It is she who will become the hero!

name: Echoes of Yi : Samsara
short_description: ECHOES of YI: SAMSARA is a dark martial arts action game infused with traditional Chinese culture. Players embody the Sword Saint's first disciple, battling fierce enemies and unraveling the mystery beneath the Jianmu Tree. Will you face the challenges or go with the flow? The choice is yours.

name: ESC (Electronics Security Company)
short_description: Experience the art of hacking as you unravel hidden secrets and accomplish intricate objectives. Type your commands to navigate the systems and unveil hidden secrets.

name: Blockcharted
short_description: Defy gravity in this fast-paced platformer. Master wall jumps, dodge obstacles, and use powerful bonuses like freeze time and teleportation to overcome challenging jumps. Every move counts in this precise and intense experience.

name: LIZARDS MUST DIE 2
short_description: LIZARDS MUST DIE 2 is a cooperative slasher action game, a high–quality continuation of the SENSATIONAL first part. Insidious lizards attacked the lands of the Rus again. HYPERBOREA is on fire and only the GLORIOUS HEROES can kick the invaders from their homeland.

name: Tokachi Detective: The Balloon Case
short_description: In the far south of Tokyo, the Ogasawara Islands. A wealthy individual ascended to high altitudes in a hot air balloon and died from lack of oxygen. At first, she thought it was an accident. There were suspicious elements, however.

name: Axyz
short_description: Axyz is a retro gravity switching puzzle game that asks the player to use their environmental and spatial awareness to beat every level. Soak in the vaporwave, switch gravity, collect tapes, and more in this tribute to 90s puzzle games.

name: Big Burger Tower
short_description: How high can you stack ingredients to build the tallest burger before it all comes crashing down?! Test your skills in this fun game! Join the ranking challenge and compete to see who can build the biggest burger!

name: Backrooms: The Deep Dark
short_description: Backrooms: The Deep Dark is a 4-player cooperative horror game where you will survive in a mysterious scary atmospheric world, wander through unknown dark corners and get scared of every nook and cranny!

name: The Electrifying Incident: A Monster Mini-Expedition
short_description: An adorable bite-sized adventure from the creators of A Monster’s Expedition - explore the facility, avoid the live electricity, and repair the malfunctioning reactor.

name: Sombra
short_description: Sombra is a 2D platform video game with a pixel art style where you have to guide a cat to the exit of the cave it has fallen into, with the only option of clicking a button to perform different actions.Help this scared little kitty find her way back home.

name: Falling for Yaoguais
short_description: Drama! Crisis! And four charming or adorable Taiwanese Yaoguai(supernatural beings) love interests! Over 150 choices lead you through a romantic adventure—who will you choose? Or... will you choose them all?

name: Tranquil Isle
short_description: Tranquil Isle is a lo-fi strategic townbuilder. Create cozy little settlements on the sun-kissed shores of your very own island paradise.

name: The Empty House - A Dementia Interactive Experience
short_description: A surreal interactive experience exploring dementia through FMV storytelling. Navigate a fading mind, make choices that shape reality, and uncover multiple endings in this emotional and psychological descent into memory loss.

name: Soko Spectacle
short_description: Push crates of fireworks and find a way to light the sky in this relaxing puzzle game.

name: Monster Trucking
short_description: Monster Trucking is an Arcade style game requiring speed, precision and a little bit of chaos to deliver cargo as quickly as possible. Enjoy the competition of racing around the city trying to rack up the highest score through delivered goods, destruction, and stunts along the way.

name: Temporal Gunslinger
short_description: Play as a supernatural gunslinger with the power to redirect bullets and rewind time in this action puzzle game. Travel across different time periods and slay the Reaper's traitorous Heralds. Achieve mastery over time and projectiles.

name: No Ticket Back: Craft, Survive & Escape
short_description: As the brave crew sets course for the Red Planet, their mission takes a terrifying turn. In the vast emptiness of space, their once-proud vessel becomes a haunted nightmare. Can they survive the horrors that await them in the darkness and escape or will they succumb before completing their mission?

name: Please pay the rent!
short_description: You found success through an unexpected investment, living a carefree life managing properties. One day, two letters from tenants spark your curiosity. Visiting their residence, you meet two elegant women, their refined demeanor hiding subtle unease, drawing you in to uncover the story behind it.

name: Arcane Board
short_description: Collect magical tiles and deploy them strategically on your Arcane Board in this block sudoku and roguelike deckbuilder. Set up combos and unleash them at the right time—whether offensively, defensively, or to build your power. Master and learn the secrets of the board.

name: Faun Town
short_description: After crash-landing on a mysterious island with no memories of the past, set out to explore the island and scavenge for resources to build automated production lines and repair the damaged ship.

name: FastShoot
short_description: A simple to understand and interesting in its process shooter that tests your reaction, tactics, observation and skill in using your surroundings!

name: Puzzle Paradise
short_description: Embark on an exciting adventure where you will have to investigate the mysterious disappearance of a local resident. Use your powers of observation and logical thinking to solve a variety of puzzles, collect clues and reconstruct the events.

name: Kaya's Prophecy
short_description: Kaya’s Prophecy is a unique card based village builder! establish your village, gather resources, and craft tools and buildings in a vibrant world. Explore and combat various challenges and other groups in this colourful, deck-builder while appeasing your god to earn his favour.

name: WHO'S WHO 2.0
short_description: Who's Who 2.0 is back with brand new team! Looking for another dynamic party game? Each characters now holds unique skills which now will impact each modes with its own advantages! You can play solo, or party up with your friends and become the winner by eliminating the real players among the NPCs.

name: Archaeology - Grass Kingdom
short_description: A game of the genre find the hidden object.

name: MonsterEnd
short_description: As a survivor, although you successfully avoided the invasion of the apocalypse, after several years of life, your resources are about to run out. In order to survive, you have to leave the shelter and face enemies from all directions!

name: Murim Survival
short_description: Murim Survival is a survival roguelite where you battle relentless enemies within a time limit. Explore a world on the brink of collapse, master martial arts, collect powerful equipment, and unlock unique traits to become a true hero of the Murim. The fate of this world is in your hands.

name: Lucky Hero Wanted
short_description: A roguelike deck-building auto-battler inspired by Luck Be a Landlord!Experiment with different combinations and build the ultimate deck every run.

name: Miuratale
short_description: Miuratale is a mermaid themed Action-RPG for all ages.

name: So Fart Away
short_description: Help Linguini, our hero, escape from a stinky trap using only your FARTS! Avoid farting on others and uncover the wild mechanics of your farts by solving simple and challenging puzzles in this comedic sokoban game! Think twice before you fart!

name: Viper Squad
short_description: 'Outsmart. Overload. Dominate.' Viper Squad brings high-stakes strategy to a futuristic FPS. Build your squad, master unique classes, and experience the explosive Overload Mode. Your skills, your legacy, your battlefield. Add Viper Squad to your wishlist and change the game.

name: Queen Slayer
short_description: A tightly focused, streamlined turn-based roguelike RPG you can finish in 2–3 hours. Challenge the short but razor-sharp journey to slay 8 corrupted queens.

name: Arete
short_description: Arete: The Battles of Alexander the Great is a classic hex-and-counter digital wargame where you'll relive the Macedonian king's most epic battles, from fighting alongside his father in Greece to climactic clashes with Darius in Persia to battling warlords at the extreme fringe of the empire.

name: Little Library
short_description: Build a brand-new library in a quaint village! Meet quirky villagers, recommend books, unlock rare titles, organize displays, host events, uncover the village's history, and revitalize the community in this cozy library-management game!

name: 乐吧斗地主
short_description: 这款单机的扑克斗地主游戏，让你可以在游戏中和电脑进行最大众化的三人斗地主，电脑随着玩家闯关的继续，智能也会同步增加。当前版本已经完整包括了闯关，和AI玩斗地主的功能。 未来还将加入赖子玩法，以及二人、四人斗地主玩法。 实在是不可多得的一款休闲类游戏。

name: File 47
short_description: A forgotten file. An echo that repeats. Memories that aren’t yours. The past always finds a way back. Are you ready to remember?

name: CTHULOOT
short_description: CTHULOOT is a cooperative arcade game in which you explore strange places filled with treasures to collect. Cooperation, agility and cthonic chanting will be required to solve the mysteries that await you. But watch out for tentacles!

name: Jumpscare Simulator: System Breach
short_description: Welcome to your childhood trauma! Inspired by Scary Woman Jumpscare, this experience features retro graphics and sudden horror elements across three game modes. Pass through doors carefully and battle the simulation while trying not to fall from your seat too much.

name: U.N.P.O.C. Vessel of Opportunity
short_description: Opportunity is near. Follow clues, solve the puzzles, and stay persistent in the chase of a new way of life. Explore, survive, and thrive in this open world adventure story.

name: Tracktopia
short_description: Tracktopia is a strategy game with city-building elements, where your city moves on tracks and serves as a super powerful unit. Expand it to boost production, advance technologies, and create smaller units to ultimately defeat the enemy nation!

name: Love Curse: Find Your Soulmate
short_description: Love Curse is a GL visual novel. You’ve fallen under a curse, and the only way to break it is to find your soulmate! The clock is ticking… Will you find true love? And what secrets will you uncover along the way?

name: Memories Off Sousou ～Not always true～
short_description: かけがえのない想いを見つけた、その先に――

name: Boutique Builder Simulator
short_description: Build your dream clothing store in Boutique Builder Simulator! Design layouts, stock trendy clothing, manage inventory, and satisfy quirky customers. Unlock upgrades, expand your shop, and create the ultimate shopping experience. Can you become the top boutique boss? Play now!

name: Roman Triumph: Survival City Builder
short_description: At the northern fringes of the empire, a new Roman city is born! Manage and grow your city, please the gods, and survive against barbarians and mythological threats to achieve Roman Triumph!

name: Lab Rat
short_description: A metrics-obsessed AI will monitor, profile, and entertain you as you progress through over a hundred genre-bending puzzles in this delightfully satirical adventure.

name: Rocket Squad: Infinity
short_description: Rocket Squad is a team-based first-person shooter. Infiltrate perilous planets, gather resources, and return safely to your shelter. Utilize each character's unique abilities and strategically form your team to restore order to the universe.

name: Rusty Rabbit
short_description: Humankind abandoned Earth as it entered another ice age. Over time, those who came to hold dominion over the world were... rabbits!? Stamp, a cute rabbit with an old soul, pilots his trusty mech 'Junkster' through the giant ruins of a frozen world in this Side-Scrolling Action Adventure.

name: The Talos Principle: Reawakened
short_description: Step back into a world of thought-provoking puzzles, philosophical intrigue, and breathtaking visuals with The Talos Principle: Reawakened - a first-person puzzle masterpiece for both new players and long-time fans alike.

name: GORN 2
short_description: Rejoice in the glory of battle in GORN 2, a massive sequel to Free Lives' brutal VR gladiator simulator.

name: Siberian experiment
short_description: Abandoned on the edge of the Siberian taiga, an old military barracks holds something more sinister than just memories of the past. A cold wind whispers through the broken windows, carrying the smell of damp and decay through the empty corridors.

name: Miracle Journey - 3D Find Differences
short_description: Leave 2D behind and explore 3D worlds, from pyramids to towns.Finding differences is a breeze! Look beyond the obvious, like a peddler's glance in a market or fireworks' shape at festivals. Players love it: 'Old games were dull. This 3D one is like a new world, full of surprises!'

name: Cheaters Cheetah
short_description: Everyone will be given ACTUAL CHEATS in this multiplayer shooter. Use wallhacks and aimbots to your advantage and dominate the other cheetahs. The winner will get to BAN all losers!

name: Big Rigs: Over the Road Racing
short_description: Get ready for some brake jamm'in, CB talk'in, convoy roll'in action across America! From Portland Oregon to Miami Florida, you'll be hauling loads and trying to stay one step ahead of the law as you climb into your Big Rig for non-stop driving action.

name: The Home Way
short_description: A long journey across the waves and obstacles, testing your patience and skill. Can you reach home?

name: Panama Canal Clash
short_description: Who will become the master of the Panama Canal? Everything will be decided in the game Panama Canal Clash!

name: Emoji Shooter
short_description: A tower defense game with Roguelike and casino elements. Players create diverse decks using Emoji shooters and various items, activating unique traits to defeat meme monsters from the digital world.

name: Super Dash
short_description: Dash through enemies, collect power ups and survive waves of enemies in this fast paced bullet-hell

name: Backrooms Escape Protocol
short_description: Backrooms Escape Protocol is a multiplayer horror game where you and your friends explore eerie backrooms, evade terrifying entities, and uncover hidden secrets. Work together to survive the endless maze and escape before it's too late!

name: Omega
short_description: A difficult precision platformer set in a surreal world. Overcome challenging environments with extreme jumps and overwhelming obstacles as you face a constant challenge on your way to the summit. Are you ready for the challenge?

name: Retro GameShop Simulator
short_description: Build and manage your dream retro video game store! Buy, sell, and stock games, consoles, and collectibles. Set your own prices, hire staff, and expand your shop to become the ultimate gaming destination.

name: Lana Longbeard And The Golden Stacks - Prologue
short_description: Enter the ten realms of Lana Longbeard in this 3D Adventure game based on the hit television series. Explore a vast sea of unique and interesting locations. Meet and help wacky characters as you uncover the mystery of the Golden Stacks.

name: Can You Make It man
short_description: A thrilling 3D platformer where you climb Mighty Oak Mountain, overcoming tricky obstacles in a stunning wooden block world. Jump, climb, and fly your way to the top to meet the Oak King. Master precise controls, collect hidden teddy bears, and test your skills in this exciting adventure!

name: The Last Camp
short_description: This is a top-down survival-building game blending farming, tower defense, and micromanagement, requiring you to fend off zombie hordes, grow crops, and strategically deploy traps to defend your homestead.

name: 扩张吧王国 Expand the Kingdom
short_description: 'Expand the Kingdom' is a strategy game based on construction and expansion. In the game, you need to expand and plan land, acquire resources to maintain the internal balance of the kingdom, and survive and defeat all opponents in the competition between kingdoms.

name: Yasuke Simulator
short_description: Step into 1579 as Yasuke, the African samurai, and join Oda Nobunaga in his quest to unite Japan! Master precise katana combat, uncover secret gear, and unleash your ancestral power in this historically inspired action-packed journey through feudal Japan.

name: FastPack
short_description: FastPack is the worlds number one leading logistics company. We offer the quickest delivery on the planet! This training program is made for you to get up to speed with our delivery methods. Do you got what it takes to work for us?

name: Isopod Keeping Simulator
short_description: Grow, feed and care for your colony of adorable isopods in this realistic semi-idle simulator. Watch your isopods multiply and split or sell your colony if they become too numerous. Created by the Kunstaat community, 100% of our proceeds support charity!

name: Rival Stars Horse Racing: VR Edition
short_description: Rival Stars Horse Racing: VR Edition is an immersive simulation game where you can become an equestrian champion from the comfort of your home. Raise, care for, and bond with your dream horses on a scenic ranch, then experience the thrill of the race track and the joy of horse riding!

name: The Dark Tower
short_description: Complete the Trials of Kornath to learn the location of The Dark Tower. Defeat the creature that lurks there, the one behind the events that transpired in The Curse of Feldar Vale and Mystery at Morgoth. An adventure for 4-6 characters of Level 6-15, loosely based on D&D Open Game License (1e/2e).

name: Delinquent Community
short_description: Welcome to Sterling Heights... Play as Jacob Stains and explore the town to learn about Jacob and his reputation in the community, meet unique NPC's across town, choose to make positive or negative decisions for Jacobs life, and optionally use violence against other residents.

name: 我在西游开黑店（Black shop in Journey to the West）
short_description: This is a simulation management game set in the world of Journey to the West, where players take on the role of a merchant running a shop in this mythical realm. At the start of the game, the player has only 10 days of lifespan remaining. You earn spirit stones to extend your life。

name: GIRLS MADE PUDDING
short_description: 'When there's nobody there to see you, you disappear.' In Girls Made Pudding, two girls tour a series of towns that people have disappeared from.

name: Cave Of Horrors
short_description: Explore and discover the secrets of a non-linear cave. Document everything you find in your logbook. You cannot return unless you find every single information about every monster, plant, ore and point of interest.

name: Welcome to the Chop House
short_description: Sneak, create distractions, use parkour and solve puzzles to escape this First-Person survival horror slaughterhouse. Trapped in a factory farm for humans you must survive being hunted by your captors.

name: 燈吉診療所 Hiyoshi Clinic
short_description: The newly renovated haunted house, Hiyoshi Clinic, is the star attraction of Horizon Amusement Park. Journalist Eiji Sakuma visits for a report but is drawn into eerily realistic scares. Guided by a child's voice, he encounters strange phenomena.

name: Silent North
short_description: Silent North thrusts you into the Swiss Alps, battling the elements, Infected, and other players. Fight solo or team up, scavenging gear and essentials. Intense PVPVE action ensures constant danger. Adapt, be resilient, and survive in this unpredictable, ever-changing landscape

name: XENOBREAKERS: Classic Tower Defense
short_description: Defend Billy and his crew on their way to the extraction zone! You have been authorized to use the defense system. Protect them from giant bugs, malfunctioning droids and more...

name: Tomb Offering
short_description: A thief broke into an ancient Chinese tomb, harboring ill intentions to plunder its treasures. The tomb was filled with countless riches of gold and silver. You trespassed into this grand tomb, driven by greed for wealth. Remember: 'As you act, God is always watching you.'

name: One Million Stars
short_description: A chaotic ballet of color, a face-melting symphony of laser light action, an epic quest to infinity with 4 characters, unlockable ships, and local co-op. Old school arcade gameplay meets roguelike replayability in a psychedelic fever dream. Hold onto your butts, it’s a long way to ONE MILLION STARS.

name: Bionic Bay
short_description: A scientist uses a unique teleportation instrument to escape an ancient biomechanical world filled with imaginative technology, deadly traps, and hidden secrets.

name: Red Pippy
short_description: Red Pippy is a 2D pixel art platformer starring a red bird who dreams of flying high! Before taking off, he must train with his wise master, facing challenges filled with obstacles and enemies that will test his strength, endurance, and courage.

name: Meow Time Machine: Newton
short_description: This is an immersive hidden object puzzle game that takes you through time to explore the extraordinary life of physics genius Isaac Newton. From the inspiration under the apple tree to the publication of 'Principia Mathematica', from Trinity College Cambridge to the Royal Society, every step is a journey into scientific mysteries.

name: Minutescape
short_description: Dodge bullets and upgrade yourself in Minutescape, a retro-inspired incremental game that keeps unfolding. Unlock new abilities and keep upgrading yourself to survive for 5 consecutive minutes.

name: The Test: Reality Check
short_description: The Test: Reality Check is one of multiple installments in an ongoing social experiment that can be classified as an atmospheric, psychological-simulation with horror elements. Dive deep into your own psyche to find answers to questions you've kept locked away, hidden from yourself for far too long.

name: Deep Space Bellhop
short_description: A cute turn-based-action game where your job is to transport strange and unfamiliar characters between floors in the galaxy's largest space hotel.

name: Thief Office Simulator
short_description: Simulation game where player mission is to steal as much money, jewelry etc in different places and avoid guardians and cameras

name: Star Dream Journey
short_description: Star Dream Trajectory - Chinese Style Agent 'is a celebrity development interactive game. As a new agent in a celebrity artist agency, you will encounter four artists with different personalities that you will be responsible for in your career, and cultivate them into legends in the industry

name: Kraktures
short_description: Collect, and fight powerful creatures known as Kraktures in turn-based or realtime RPG battles! You have full customization of your adventure so play it however you want.

name: BodyRecords
short_description: BodyRecords is a chilling horror experience, blending bodycam immersion,microphone sensitivity to your voice, and eerie spaces. Work together with teammates to solve puzzles, evade lurking horrors, and escape. True cooperative play and unsettling atmosphere make every moment a tense challenge.

name: Wizdom Academy
short_description: Build and manage your wizard academy as the headmaster. Feel the city-building thrill of constructing your magic school. Recruit students, guide them to become wizards, control resources, customize your castle, and expand your academy's influence and prestige. Start your legacy today!

name: Zombiefield
short_description: New Zombiefield contractors! Your mission is to open portals to attract tougher zombies and evacuate before the missile strike. Work together with your manager to reduce risks and get paid for completing your contract

name: WET VR
short_description: Play Wet VR, a calm puzzle game. Move land to guide water through 32 fun puzzles. Think smart and solve each task in a world of peace and ease. Simple to play, hard to master, and made to soothe your mind.

name: Dead Silence - Echoes of the Damned
short_description: An atmospheric horror game with an open world and cinematic scenes. Explore the dark forest, search for items, read notes, perform rituals, and uncover a terrifying story. A first-person experience filled with jumpscares and intense tension.

name: RuneScape: Dragonwilds
short_description: On RuneScape’s forgotten continent of Ashenfall, dragons have awoken. Gather, build, skill and craft to survive in this co-operative (1-4) survival crafting game. Only by mastering survival and uncovering ancient secrets can they hope to slay the Dragon Queen—alone or with allies.

name: One Last Job
short_description: Being a world-class fixer is about who you know: clients need discreet solutions, and crews want to see retirement. Then there's you, stuck in the middle with your rep on the line. Yeah, you're quitting the biz -- after one last job.

name: Jin & Jan
short_description: Get ready for a challenge! In Jin & Jan, you control two characters at once: Jin follows your commands, but Jan always does the opposite. Anticipate every move, dodge obstacles and enemies, and guide the brothers to the center of the map to complete the ritual of balance.

name: Escape from biochemical
short_description: 《Escape from the Biochemical》 is a 3D single-player puzzle horror game. The protagonist needs to complete various tasks while being chased by the experimental subjects and then escape from there.

name: Geo Mythica
short_description: Embark on an 8-bit style JRPG quest to save Earth. Battle in unique party-based combat mixing real-time action and strategic commands. Join Gio and a team of lively characters as they unearth bizarre global events, forgotten legends, and battle mythical foes to unveil the secrets of Geo Mythica.

name: BOO! ARE YOU SCARED?
short_description: 'Boo! Are you scared?' – game with realistic physics of collisions and destruction, where every step can be the last. Gloomy levels full of dangerous obstacles and bottomless abysses await you.

name: SD Dungeons
short_description: Create your favorite character and embark on a grand adventure! Randomly generated dungeons and gates that determine your fate await you on each floor! Can you escape with powerful weapons and gems before you run out of strength!?

name: Golf Gambit
short_description: Mini-golf with traps, tricks, and tornados! Deploy your traps to mess with your opponents or find a new path to a hole-in-one! Golf Gambit is a fun and frantic mini-golf party game for up to 8 players.

name: Robin Hood: Sherwood Defenders
short_description: As the legendary Robin Hood, fight the Sheriff's forces in the open field by defending the Merry Men's allies from invasions in this tower defense game. Produce resources, build up your fortifications, place units, and then join in the battle yourself!

name: GhostCry Hill
short_description: 《鬼哭岭》是一款以中国岭南地区都市传说为题材的恐怖解谜游戏。故事讲述一名在校女大学生，无意中卷入了一起都市传说之中，被困学校的她，迎接她的真相即将是...

name: Serre
short_description: A visual novel about a girl and an alien drinking tea and falling in love!

name: S.O.V: Passenger 23
short_description: A regular night shift turns into a chilling fight for survival. Explore a bustling rest stop, uncover dark secrets, and face the haunting legacy of a tragic accident in PASSENGER 23.

name: Legends of Immortality
